sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>The Forest's Invitation</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
After finishing this morning's paperwork, I decide to take a little break. Right on cue, someone knocks on my office door.
Come on in.
Albion enters, bearing a lovely woven picnic basket.
Thank goodness you're here, Commander!
I sense a hint of excitement in her voice.
Albion? What's got you in such a hurry?
She pinches the hem of her skirt nervously, blushing and fidgeting as she speaks.
Well... I recently found this lovely spot for relaxation in the forested mountains.
Just by standing there, you can hear the soothing winds...
Soothing winds, you say?
Umm, I don't mean a specific natural phenomenon. Rather, it's more of a harmonious resonance, of sorts, that the forest achieves under the perfect conditions.
I see. That does sound soothing.
It is! The weather is great today, so the sound is especially clear...
I would love to listen to it together with you.
Umm... May I ask you to join me?
I'd be happy to. Should I bring anything?
Wonderful! Ah, you don't have to do anything special.
She opens the picnic basket and shows me the contents: some snacks, and a hand-drawn map.
I've already drawn the route I usually take on the map.
I made snacks, too... I was hoping we could have some together.
We could even eat them along the way, if you'd like.
They look delicious. Thank you for doing all that.
I only did what was natural as your junior... No, as the person inviting you.
Please come with me, Commander.
With the basket in hand, Albion stops in front of the door and turns to me expectantly.
The wind today will surely be a gentle caress.
I follow her out of my office. When I close the door, I hear her murmuring what sounds like a prayer.
May today's wind convey my feelings for the Commander...

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Creatures of the Forest</size>

scripts.say: Port - Forest Entrance
Sunlight filters through the trees. The air is filled with the combined scents of mud and vegetation.
We're here. The path ahead is the one I always take when I want to breathe in nature.
Let's slow down and feel the forest's heartbeat together, Commander.
Feel its heartbeat, huh? Got any tips to help me out?
Hmm... Well, I suppose the best method would be... listening carefully.
You don't have to do anything yourself. Just stop, close your eyes, and let the forest air flow through you.
Like so...
She closes her eyes. A cool breeze blows through her hair.
Listen... The birdsongs are clearer than before, aren't they?
Following her lead, I close my eyes. The sounds reaching my ears become clearer now.
Yeah... They really are.
Now, I'd like you to imagine yourself as one of the trees, or as the wind blowing through them...
The rustling of leaves, the distant gurgling of brooks, and even the warmth of sunlight on the moss...
All of these are ways that the forest speaks to us.
I try to concentrate, but there's still a sort of haze in the way. When I open my eyes again, I see Albion's gentle gaze.
Don't worry. If you'd like, I can just tell you what I'm feeling.
She takes a step closer and places her chilly hands on my eyes.
Now... Close your eyes and let your thoughts drift on the wind.
I'll tell you exactly what I hear...
In the quiet darkness, her voice graces my ears like the forest breeze itself.
In the cedar tree up ahead to our right, three sparrows are chirping in turn...
To the left behind us, a squirrel just leapt between dry branches... Ah, it stopped. It's looking our way now.
Wind blows from the valley in the east, carrying the scent of a stream...
Her voice is like magic. Gradually, I become able to hear the voice of the forest, too.
Sunlight, shadow. The scents of grass and earth. The distant streams, her hair fluttering next to me.
A mysterious tranquility gradually overwhelms me.
Do you feel it now?
It's definitely different now.
That's wonderful... Oh!
She suddenly tugs at my sleeve and points at nearby bushes.
Commander, look over there...
I spot a pair of black eyes surreptitiously watching us from behind the bushes.
It's a deer... I've never seen one come so close. The forest must have truly accepted you.
See?
Its ears flick back and forth as it takes a few steps, lowering its head to sniff the moss on the ground.
It neither approaches nor flees. It's just there, as if... as if it sees us as another part of the forest.
Yes, Commander... I think this place has welcomed you.

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Tea Party in the Sun</size>

scripts.say: Forest - Clearing
We continue through the woods until, suddenly, we arrive at a clearing.
Sunlight washes over the grass, which is dotted with wild flowers like a natural carpet.
We've made it. This is the place that I told you about... the perfect spot for basking in the afternoon sunlight.
Just sit and listen to the sounds of the forest for a while, and you'll feel calmer than ever... as if your heart has taken flight.
What a view. I already feel relaxed.
Hehe. Wait just a moment, and I'll set up our little tea party.
Great. I can't wait.
She kneels down on the grass and takes a cream-colored picnic sheet from the basket. Despite her attempts to lay it down, however, the wind stops her.
Commander, could you hold this corner down for me? The wind is a little mischievous today, it seems.
Sure.
She quickly brings out the tea set and lunch box, placing them atop the blanket. As soon as she opens the box, a sweet aroma wafts forth.
Today's snacks are inspired by the forest.
This berry tart is made with wild berries I picked. I also used elderflower nectar to recreate the image of morning dew on flower petals.
I've added flakes of mint to the scones, too, to reflect the cooling breath of the forest.
They aren't just delicious – you infused a real love and understanding of the forest in them, too.
That's right. The forest has taught me so many things...
While my efforts may be awkward, I wanted to communicate the feelings of the forest that I've experienced... on my own terms.
I thought that this would be the most direct way to communicate. Heehee.
She offers me a teacup. Her eyes sparkle expectantly, as if awaiting my thoughts.
Do you like the tea? I tried putting lemongrass and chamomile in it...
It's very refreshing. And it smells kind of like sun-dried grass...
A-and the snacks?
Hmm... You balanced sweet and sour just right for this one. The flavor is so gentle.
Do you feel that... warmth? As if the sunlight passing through the trees is hitting your palm?
At her urging, I try to feel it.
Yeah... Now that you mention it, I think I do feel it.
Good...
It's fine even if you can't feel it.
I simply... wanted to share with you what I've seen, heard, and tasted of the forest.
If any of that has gotten through to you, then I'm happy enough.
Taste aside, what I'm really feeling is the thought you put into preparing all of this.
Albion blushes and traces her fingers over the rim of her teacup.
Thank you very much...
When we reach the place where the soothing winds blow, I'm sure you'll feel the gentle warmth of nature even more clearly.
She smiles bashfully and tucks her slightly wind-ruffled hair behind her ear.
It must be an amazing place.
Of course it is... That feeling is real, you know. Heehee.
Before I met you, Commander, I never believed that such a warming breeze could exist anywhere in the world.
She smiles up at me again.
I'd say our tea party is nearly over... Shall we go?
We'll get there right when the light is at its best.

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Voice of the Lost</size>

scripts.say: Forest - Depths
After packing up the tea set, we continued deeper into the forest together. The trees became taller and denser as we went, and the trail was markedly less manicured.
Commander, the path ahead might be hard to navigate... but don't worry. I remember it perfectly.
But each time I come here, I make new discoveries.
How the light filters in differently, or some new sounds... Or perhaps little flowers I didn't notice the last time.
Either way, I'm at ease as long as I can follow you.
Of course... See, that forked oak tree over there is our first landmark.
If we go left, we'll see a rock that looks like a sleeping bear.
We cross the narrow path beside the oak tree, but no matter where I look, I see no such thing.
Oh... That's odd. We may have wandered off the path at some point.
Didn't we just pass these purple flowers before?
Now that you mention it, they do look familiar.
Albion stops and gazes at the wildflowers with confusion in her eyes.
But the sleeping bear rock should be around here...
She looks up at the sky hidden by leaves and then at the trees around us, her brow furrowed slightly.
How strange... It seems different from the last few times I came here.
Even the wind sounds different...
Do you think we missed a landmark?
No... Wait a moment, please.
She scans our surroundings once more and compares them to her memories.
This tree... The bark has gotten darker. The moss over there wasn't so long last time, either.
Oh, I get it...
If I compare the sound of the wind and the angle of the light...
I have bad news, Commander. The soothing winds seem to have moved.
Worse, I can't feel which direction they've gone...
Don't worry. We can search for it any time, even if we don't find it today.
But if I miss this chance, I don't know when you'll be able to come again...
I'll keep searching. It must be around here.
Pulling me by the arm, Albion runs through the forest, weaving past countless similar trees.
Hey, there's no need to rush.
This is such an important date. I can't bear the thought that I would fail to guide you...
No... I have to find it...
Her breathing intensifies, and her palm starts to get damp with sweat.

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Where the Fireflies Are</size>

scripts.say: Forest - Depths
We walked through the dim woods for a while longer. However, we failed to find our destination, leaving Albion dejected.
Let's stop for a while.
Commander?
Even if we don't find the place, I had fun today.
Walking through the forest with you, listening to the wind, and relaxing in the sunlight has been a wonderful experience for me.
Oh, but...
Remember how you taught me to listen to the voice of the forest.
"You don't have to do anything yourself. Just stop, close your eyes, and let the forest air flow through you."
You really remembered...
Let's close our eyes and listen, just like before.
Maybe then the wind will guide us to where we need to go.
She nods, and we close our eyes together.
Do you hear anything?
Yes... The hum of insects... Fallen leaves fluttering to the ground, and...
I hear water! It's far, but the wind brought its sound to us...
You were right, Commander. The wind really is guiding us!
Smiling now, she takes my hands and jumps happily.
Thank you so much... I was so panicked that I didn't even listen to the voice of the wind that I so trusted.
I spent all that time preparing so that you'd have a good time, but here I am, rushing things and getting lost... What a failure.
You didn't fail at all, Albion. I can feel all of the heart that you put into this.
Commander...
What's wrong with failure? Walking around in the woods with you, hand-in-hand, is already enjoyable on its own.
I-it is for me, too! Being with you... has been a lot of fun!
She finally relaxes, as if freed from a heavy burden.
All I wanted was for you to think that spending time with me was fun.
My fixation on that made me mess up what I'm normally so good at...
Everything today, even the fact that we got lost, will be a beautiful memory.
Even us getting lost...? Really?
Of course. Wandering around and trying to follow the wind isn't something I get to do every day.
So let's relax and keep moving, alright?
Okay!
We walked on through the forest, following the sound of rushing water. Before we knew it, the sun had begun to set.
It's getting dark out...
I've never been in the forest this late. I'm not afraid, but... all of the sounds around us suddenly seem so different.
The forest shows different colors at twilight. Albion quietly sidles closer to me.
You sure you're not afraid?
I-I'm fine!
You're here, so I have nothing to fear.
It's just...
Perhaps due to the falling temperatures, she trembles slightly.
I take my jacket off and drape it over her shoulders.
Ah... Won't you be cold, though?
I'm fine. You wear it.
Then...
After a moment's silence, she suddenly leans in. Even through her clothes, I can feel her slightly elevated body temperature.
Now we can both be warm.
It just might be a little difficult to walk like this...
Just a little.
I feel so warm now... Warmer than I've ever felt, perhaps.
As we walk on, a faint speck of light rises from a nearby patch of brush.
Ah... Commander, look.
It's followed by another, and then another... Many specks of light rise between the trees, like a dream amidst the night.
Fireflies!
If there are fireflies around, then there must be a source of clean water nearby.
Let's follow them. This time, we're sure to reach our destination!

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Soothing Winds</size>

scripts.say: Forest - Depths
Fireflies illuminate our way forward like streetlights. The sound of water becomes clearer until we arrive at a clearing...
A stream reflects the moonlight, taking on a silver glow.
We're finally here...
While she expresses her relief, the fireflies form a band of light.
It's all because you didn't give up.
No, Commander, I think it's thanks to you believing in me.
Albion approaches and gives me a firm hug.
I gently stroke her hair. It smells like the fresh foliage of the forest.
I return her embrace and feel her trembling shoulders start to relax.
Oh, Commander...
Thank goodness... You helped me hear the wind again.
You're the one who found the way.
She shakes her head. Though she opens her mouth to speak, she stops herself.
Do you hear that? It's coming from the woods across the stream...
I listen carefully. Though I can only hear the wind and water at first, the stirring on the other side of the stream starts to stand out from the rest.
A flock of birds follows the wind...
A sudden surge of wings erupts toward the horizon like a splash of ink across the moonlit sky.
It's beautiful.
That isn't all, Commander.
The birds hidden deeper in the forest also take flight, making a glorious whooshing sound that seems to reflect the breath of the forest itself.
Wind, water, and wings alike create a tranquil symphony.
Is this... the soothing wind?
Yes... There are more sounds that make up the whispers of the wind, too.
Squirrels resting in tree hollows, baby birds chirping in their nests, seeds unfurling beneath the soil...
I can't hear those quite yet.
It's okay... I'll pass on to you exactly what I hear.
The sound of night falling, streams winding through the mountains, and starlight shining down on the rocks...
Even if you can't hear the whispers of the wind...
You can hear something even more special.
That would be... the whispers of Albion.

sequence:
Forest Breeze and the Compass of the Heart

<size=45>Albion's Feelings</size>

scripts.say: Forest - Depths
We sit together on a flat rock by the stream.
The starry sky above seems to be within arm's reach, mingling with the firefly light as a symphony of heaven and earth.
Just being able to look up at the stars with you feels like a dream.
I was so lost before, but now, we're sitting in such a beautiful place... It's like a gift from nature herself.
Maybe getting lost is part of the gift.
Do you think so?
Otherwise, we wouldn't have been able to see the beautiful starry sky together.
Commander... You always know how to make me feel better.
As we watch the stars and listen to the wind and water...
I feel truly happy.
Me, too.
Today, I heard something even more special than all of those things.
Oh? What was it? I'm sorry, I must have missed it entirely...
Perhaps I wasn't paying enough attention.
Only because you were so focused on sharing what you heard with me.
But it was because of what you shared that I managed to hear that special sound.
All of the preparations you made today, hoping to share this with me... All of the nerves and uncertainty you felt along the way...
Those were even more distinct to me than any sound carried by the wind.
I think the most beautiful thing I heard today... was the sound of your heart.
My heart...
Her cheeks suddenly flush bright red.
B-but...
I thought I'd hidden the voice of my heart. It should only come out when I'm alone...
I-in that case, then... the respect I hold for you, and my desire to learn from you, and, and...
And?
And... that feeling warmer than respect, something even closer than admiration... The thing that makes my heart race every time we meet...
The need to become a better, more reliable version of myself... All that makes up love...
Did you hear that, too, Commander?
Her voice trails off. Those last few words are almost overwhelmed by the stream.
Her starlit eyes shimmer with a mix of shyness and hesitation – and beneath it all, a deep, burning sincerity.
Yeah... I heard it all.
Oh, Commander, you're no fair...
I wanted to hide it all until I could learn more from you...
In the end, you saw right through me.
Is that a bad thing?
No... Not necessarily.
Now that it's come to this, may I stay by your side from now on?
Wherever you want to go, be it listening to the sound of the wind or simply going for a stroll in the sunlight...
Will you let me accompany you?
Of course I will.
A night breeze stirs the stream. Surrounded by the scent of the forest, I offer my hand.
Albion returns the favor, and our fingers naturally intertwine with each other.
From now on, we'll see and hear so many new things together.
Yes... It's a promise.

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Reporting In</size>

scripts.say: Office - Morning
Before I can even sit down at my desk, a girl thrusts the latest issue of the "Port Journal" into my hands.
Heheheh~ The best cure to morning grogginess is reading all about the latest and greatest scoops! It gets your blood pumping, which also makes you more productive, y'know?
The girl is none other than Alfredo Oriani, the local sparky journalist and my recently appointed secretary.
She badgered me for the position, insisting it would help her get scoops she otherwise couldn't. So I caved in and appointed her.
C'mon, give it a read! I know you're gonna love this issue, 'cause the featured piece is on you!
...That's already a red flag.
"Exclusive: The Commander's Habits and Daily Schedule Revealed."
"What Really Goes on Behind the Office's Closed Doors?"
"Our Universally Adored Commander's Port Planning – An In-Depth Analysis."
Pretty good, right? You're looking at pages and pages dedicated to telling the story of who you REALLY are!
And guess what? This issue broke all sales records to date!
I hold my head in my hands, simply stunned by her journalistic ability.
Even though this is just a collection of trivial secretarial matters, she has managed to turn that material into salacious stories.
I couldn't decide whether to praise her or lecture her for it.
Oh yeah, Commander, you know what the hardest part of making an article is?

options.content: "Finding the scoops hidden in plain sight."

scripts.say: No, that's one of the ABC's of journalism!
If you can come up with a good title, the rest of the article practically writes itself!
The real tricky part? Finding material worth filling up a few pages!
I'll grant you, turning facts into cash isn't a straightforward process, but it's not particularly hard as long as you keep up with the port's trends and stuff.
What IS hard is scoring a hot scoop and being the first to tell everyone else about it.
Bingo! You're absolutely right! That's what we call journalistic intuition – the ability to find article-worthy material!
It's what journalists live by. Without it, you won't make it for long.
The fact is, news happens around us constantly! But finding the diamond scoops in the dirt of unremarkable events, that's hard work.
I suppose by her analogy, I'm the diamond mine. Being the subject of more and more of her articles in the future seems like an inevitability, and all I can do is prepare myself for it.

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Competing for the Spotlight</size>

scripts.say: The next morning, I'm walking down a sunny road minding my own business–
Then all of a sudden, I get the hunch that I'm being watched.
I keep hearing strange clicks, too, like the sound of a camera shutter.
Wait a second... Is that who I think it is?
The bushes by the road rustle and shake, and soon, Alfredo Oriani pops through the leaves.
Heheh! Morning, Commander!
I wanted to snap some pics of you in your element. Didn't expect you'd catch on to me THIS fast.
Guess you've got a keen intuition of your own! You might be cut out to be a journalist!
The cover for her camera lens is off, suggesting she used it just moments ago.
"I had a feeling it was you taking sneaky photos."
Sorry, maybe I should've asked for permission, but I need good photos for the next issue of the Port Journal.
Let's not forget I'm not the only newsdealer around. There's Aoba, for a start. We might collaborate every now and then, but we're still rivals in the end!
I strive to publish the best tabloid on the newsstands, and to do that, I need more juicy scoops!
"I see... Sounds like things are pretty heated between the two of you."
"Haven't you already gotten all the news you're going to need, though?"
The latest issue of the Port Journal came out yesterday! I can't fill a newspaper with just one day's worth of news!
While the port is a busy place, not everything that happens here is worth reporting on. Plus, I'm not always the first to nab the scoop.
I know a good story when I see one, but there's no point digging when there's no gems in the ground, y'know?
And I've been out of solid leads for a while now... Front-page news doesn't exactly happen every day of the week.
*sigh*... In hindsight, I should've saved my in-depth coverage of you for the cover of the next issue.
...Well, I'm glad I wasn't turned into front-page material.
On the other hand, Alfredo looks bummed out about her predicament. I should think about some way to help her.
"So, she needs a good story..."
A while after parting ways with Alfredo, I suddenly come up with an idea for a scoop.
However, it's up to her to seize the opportunity. If her journalist's intuition is on point, she will.
At any rate, I'll first need to make some calls and set the stage.

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>A Tip from a Friend</size>

scripts.say: Sardegna Empire Dormitory - Nighttime
Alfredo returns to her dormitory, feeling dejected about her lackluster findings.
Hm-hmm-hm~♪ Oh, hey, Alfredo.
I've got chocolate muffins and almond cookies. You want some?
Aquila took them out of the oven just minutes ago!
Thanks, GB, but I'm not hungry...
Our favorite journalist is feeling blue AND has no appetite?! What on earth happened today, Alfredo?
Well... If you don't want 'em, then I'll help myself to the cookies!
Sure... I'll be in my room...
Not so fast! I can't ignore a friend who obviously needs someone to talk to.
When you're down in the dumps, you need a hearty helping of sugar to pick you up.
Sit down, have a muffin, and tell us what's wrong. We'll work something out.
But... *sigh*... Okay, basically...
Ah... So you're struggling to find a bombshell of a news story. Sounds tricky.
Hehehe... That's easy... Just test some explosive ordnance in a field somewhere...
Da Vinci could help you with that, no problem...
Not a bad idea, actually... Tell you what, I'll hit up Yuubari for scientific advice. We'll cook up a big bomb for you.
No, no, no! When I said "bombshell," I didn't mean it literally!
Okay, but... Setting off a bomb WOULD cause a big sensation, wouldn't it?
Sure, but that flies in the face of my journalistic ethos!
I can't just go around staging stories for the sake of attention, y'know!
Hmm... Back to square one, then.
Yeah... And if I can't land a good scoop soon, people are gonna stop reading the Port Journal...
Wait, I know! There's bound to be some news material at the upcoming ball!
What ball?
You haven't heard? They're organizing a huge ball soon. All the factions are gonna be there, no doubt bringing juicy rumors with them and whatnot.
You're right... That IS a goldmine of scoops waiting to be uncovered...
Hang on, when did they announce this ball? And how come I first hear about it from you, the hermit who sits indoors and tinkers all day?
Hehehe~ Let's just say a little bird told me♪
*sigh*... If this isn't proof that I've fallen off as a journalist, I don't know what is...
Hey, I didn't mean it like that! It's a lot more mundane than you think!
I only know about it because the Commander asked me to design some stage equipment for the ball, okay?
Furthermore, the whole thing is still in the early planning stages. If you want to get a solid head start, you've got plenty of time to prepare.
Ohh, okay. Thanks a ton for the tip, Teach!
This is my lucky break... Not only can I take behind-the-scenes photos of the ball, I can also use it as an excuse to report on the Commander!
I can see the headlines already! I just have to get ahead of my rivals and secure an exclusive scoop.
Alright! Operation Scoop Goldmine is a go!

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Operation Scoop Goldmine</size>

scripts.say: Office - Early morning
There are several back issues of the Port Journal on my desk, left there by Alfredo.
Even if these magazines are old news, I'm curious about what they say.
I have a bit of time to kill before my shift starts, so I might as well have a look.
"An Amazing Insight Into the Royal Maids' Daily Lives"... "The Shocking Secrets of Sardegna's Dormitory"...
I get engrossed and lose track of time. Then, out of the blue...
Ding-dong! Morning, Commander! You sure are early today.
Alfredo throws open the door and steps into the office. Judging by her elated attitude, she must be expecting to report some big news today.
Oh, am I late? ...I'm not? Phew, that's good.
Why am I so fired up, you ask? Heheh, well, it's because I've found a solution to my previously mentioned lack of newsworthy material!
She proceeds to explain her plan with great enthusiasm. I sit and listen...
As the saying goes – where there's people, there's news!
And with a huge social event like a ball, interesting things are guaranteed to happen!
"I don't think that's a real saying."
It'll become one if I say it enough times! That's how all sayings are established, y'know!
Wait, I just realized... Won't I stick out if I dress up and go snooping around the ball?
People will raise their guard once they know a journalist is around, and then there's no way I'll land a good scoop...
"So you're going to blend in with the guests and take sneaky photos?"
No, nothing like that! I'm gonna do an undercover coverage! Under-coverage, if you will.
But to do that, I'll need a partner who can back me up...
Know a good candidate for the job, Commander? If you catch my drift.
*sigh*... Don't get me wrong, it's a good suggestion since I'm friends with them both...
But what I'm really asking is if YOU will go to the ball with me, Commander.
Sheesh, maybe your intuition isn't as good as I thought...
"My bad, I should've taken the hint. I'll gladly go with you."
Hehehe~ Thanks a ton, Commander!
Remember to rehearse and be ready for anything at the ball! I'll see you then, partner.
"But I'll also be keeping an eye on you. I don't fully trust you not to cause a stir if left unsupervised."
Heheh, I knew I could count on you!
Oh, could you also give me your thoughts from a reader's perspective later during the editing stage? I'd really appreciate it~
Remember to rehearse and be ready for anything at the ball! I'll see you then, partner.

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Dressing the Part</size>

scripts.say: Later, on the day of the ball...
Voila! What do you think, Commander? Looks pretty good, right?
Aww, you mean it? Let's just hope it'll actually help me blend in with the guests...
At any rate, thanks!
Heheh~ It's not JUST a disguise, though! I've practiced my dance moves just for tonight.
Anyway, time to get this show on the road. Operation Scoop Goldmine starts now!
Stick close to me, Commander. I need you to cover me while I take notes and photos, so don't raise any suspicion!
And so, I accompany Alfredo on her hunt for scoops under the pretense that we're simply dance partners.
A short while later, she and I stroll around the backstage, snapping photos of shipgirls in moments of graceful leisure.
Whoa, there's news to be found that-a-way, because my scoop senses are tingling! Come with me, Commander!
...And pictures of them in less-than-graceful moments. I wonder how they'll react to seeing them.
Our activities were questioned a couple of times, but luckily, I somehow managed to clear us of suspicion each time.
Heheh, this is all pretty solid material. I think this next issue of the Port Journal will be my magnum opus!
Also... *yawn*... I'm pooped. The exhaustion is catching up to me now...
The ball is coming to a close, too, but we haven't even set foot on the dance floor yet...
You know what? Let's dance, Commander.
"What happened to being exhausted?"
A chance to dance with you comes only once in a blue moon! Being a little tired won't stop me from doing something I like.
I'm used to working tirelessly anyway, editing articles late into the night to deliver news as fresh as can be!
I may burn through physical energy while doing stuff I like, but there's no shortage of mental energy left in my tank~
If you were to ask me how I can just keep going seemingly forever, then that's my answer, I suppose.
So what do you say, Commander? May I have this dance?
O-one thing, though... I've only practiced my moves a little bit, so promise you won't laugh! Okay?

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Putting It All Together !</size>

scripts.say: Later, after the ball...
Alfredo and I are back in my office, sorting through the material she gathered.
She gets straight to work, forgoing even changing out of her dress. I ask her why she's in such a rush.
'Cause I've gotta capitalize on my flash of inspiration before it's gone!
I've come up with a ton of good ideas, and if I don't put pen to paper now, I'll have forgotten them by tomorrow.
All that is to say, I don't have time to change outfits!
"Working all day gathering scoops, then sorting through them well into the night... Being a journalist sounds exhausting."
Hey, it's not like I do this EVERY day.
It ebbs and flows. Sometimes there's a lot on my plate, sometimes there's pretty much nothing.
Anyway! Help me sift through this stuff or we'll be here until morning!
I take a seat and look through the photos she took.
While it's dubious they have much journalistic merit, they are excellent attention-grabbers.
Heheheh... Putting some gossip next to these photos will undoubtedly reel in more people!
It's overwhelming just how many photos she took. I can't even guess WHEN she took the majority of them.
Stealth photography might be her secret talent... I'll need to be more vigilant around her in the future.
Commander, have you gone through them all yet? Okay, sweet.
In that case, got any ideas for what the front-page headline should be?
Don't overthink it! This isn't a super serious tabloid or anything.
Pretend you're my intern and put yourself in the shoes of a reader. What kind of headline would grab YOUR attention?
"I have no aspirations of becoming a journalist, but if you insist. I'd say something like..."

options.content: "Ball Guests' Embarrassing Secrets Caught on Camera!"

scripts.say: I mean... It's serviceable, but it's kinda boring. It's gotta make you go, "I HAVE to know what this is about!"
See, I was thinking something like, "Ball Guests' Embarrassing Secrets Caught on Camera!"
Yup, that's exactly the kind of headline you'd see from her.
Whoa! You're a genius, Commander!
"I don't think I like getting praised for coming up with that..."
Like it or not, I'm going with it! This issue's gonna spread like wildfire!
Thanks for the help! I reckon I'll have this cut and printed in a few days!

sequence:
The Sensationalist Sensation

<size=45>Someone Else's Front-Page News</size>

scripts.say: Early morning, several days later...
*yaaawn*... Morning, Commander.
Alfredo enters my office looking sleep-deprived. Again. She's been like this for the past few days, in fact.
Mgh... Hey, I'm fine. Don't worry about me...
I've just been really busy making articles out of the material I got from the ball...
Sorry 'bout my lack of energy. I know you've been singlehandedly doing all the work I'm supposed to do as your secretary. I really appreciate it!
Now my slacking days are over, though! The latest issue of the Port Journal is finished! It's all about the ball. Check it out!
She hands me the magazine, which does have the look of a magnum opus about it. However, her expression turns from elated to sour.
Unfortunately, my work was for nothing...
All because of THIS!
She hands me another newspaper. The front page features a bold headline...
"You Will Not Believe Who the Commander Danced With at the Ball!"
Below it is a picture of me and Alfredo in the middle of our dance. It seems someone photographed us without our knowledge.
Frickin' Aoba!
She knew you're all the buzz right now and she beat me to it!
Urgh! The headline just reeks of sensationalism, too! I can't believe she stole my spotlight with THIS of all things!
It's pretty hypocritical to call others sensationalist, considering the headline she herself chose, but I digress.
"Look at this way – you still made front-page news."
"Maybe not in the way you'd hoped, but the fact remains that you're the talk of the port now."
Oh please! That's not funny, Commander!
*sigh*... Even though I got played for a fool, somehow I don't feel salty about it.
Because at the end of the day, I did get to have an unforgettable dance with you♪
Hey, that gives me an idea! I could always embellish a few details and feature that story in the next issue!
Then throw in a spicy headline, like... "The Secret Romance Between the Commander and a Dancer"! Yeah, THAT'LL cause a real sensation!
"I invoke my right to remain anonymous."
Nuooooooooooooooo!

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>1 The Guardian Blade, the Impeccable Secretary</size>

scripts.say: A girl was prancing down the corridor to the Commander's office.
Though her eyes were covered by a mask, her wide smile and the cheerful tune she hummed gave away her mood.
Hmm-hm-hmm-hm♪
Oh, Alsace, so cool you'll be♪
Purging baddies all so fearlessly♪
And today you are the secretary♪
H-hi, Alsace. Good morning.
About to start working as the secretary, huh? Maaan, you're so lucky.
Affirmative! The Commander wills it. You needn't be envious, Fleuret – work hard, and one is sure you'll get your own opportunity.
Alsace addressed the two little knights before her with marked sincerity.
Um, speaking of hard work... Thanks for the help earlier.
Alsace is the one who helped you? When you spilled a drink and poked a hole through the wall when you tried to clean it up.
Yeah. If it wasn't for her, the Commander would've found out and thought I was worthless...
That explains the paint you both had all over your clothes.
Hey, if it happens again, just call the Manjuu repair team. Besides, the Commander's image of you wouldn't shatter like that over a small mistake.
Y-yeah, you're right...
You can always come to this one if you have a problem that needs solving.
As the Commander's blade and protector, protecting the port, too, falls under one's umbrella!
Now, one needs to get moving.
Alsace bowed her head and excused herself, then resumed humming her tune as she proceeded down the corridor.
Fleuret lingered in place, watching Alsace move forward with a tinge of nervousness.
Isn't she, like, SUPER sensitive to the Commander? She's probably gonna overheat and break down as soon as she gets near.
I-I think she'll be okay!
I walked by her room the other day, and I heard her trying to build up tolerance by saying, "Commander, Commander" over and over.
"Build up tolerance." Yeah, right...
But you know what? I'll choose to have faith in her self-control and the Commander's smarts!
Port - Office
Following a knock on the door, Alsace quietly comes into my office.
This one is battleship Alsace – Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, and guardian of the Holy See.
One has trained and become secretary perfection embodied! Now, Commander, one awaits your orders!

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>2 It's Okay, One is the Secretary</size>

scripts.say: I brief Alsace on her responsibilities today as my new secretary.
Understood. Rest assured, one shall handle these tasks competently.
Hmm-hm-hmm♪
She takes a seat and gets to work as she starts humming a distinctive song.
Sometime later...
She has gracefully sorted out my disorganized paperwork. Already, my working efficiency has shot through the roof.
(Appointing her as my secretary was a brilliant move on my part.)
(Having said that, there is such a thing as working TOO hard. She needs a break.)
Alsace, I think it's time you took a break.
Pardon? One is operating in maximum secretary proficiency mode. One has no need for breaks.
You finished your morning work in a flash. I'd like you to pace yourself so you don't burn yourself out.
Understood. C-Commander, um... should I interpret that as praise?
While I love to hear praise from you, I'm afraid... m-my emotion module can't... handle it...!
All of a sudden, the temperature in the office starts to skyrocket.
Whoa, whoa! Take it easy!
S-sorry! I need to disable my vision and perception modules...
She hangs her head and falls silent. At the same time, the office starts to cool down.
A while later, she raises her head again, her tone of voice indicating that she's regained her composure.
Forgive this one for losing one's composure.
As atonement, one shall fetch you a cold can of soda at once!
She rises to her feet and swiftly leaves my office, returning just a short while later with a can of soda in hand.
Thanks.
As I accept the can from her, I get the feeling that someone is staring daggers through me.
(That's weird... Is it her looking at me, from behind that mask?)
Spurred on by that strange hunch, I turn my gaze to her – and unknowingly stare daggers through HER this time.
Y-you've been looking at me for 16 seconds... 17...
You okay?
Oh no, oh no... This distance and intensity, it's... It's too much for meee!

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>3 Alsace, Are You Cool After All?</size>

scripts.say: Here I am, picking up the documents that got scattered all throughout my office. How did that happen, you ask? Alsace overheated.
Speaking of which, it seems the overheating was quite shocking to her – she's sitting on her chair, cradling her legs like a child who's been naughty.
One is sorry, Commander...
It's no big deal. Honestly.
This happened despite all one's efforts, practicing day after day, simulating what it's like to be with you...
One imagined everything, from everyday scenarios to edge cases...
And even... your hands on my... Oh gosh, no, I'm ticklish there...
(Not going to ask for particulars – I can guess...)
All that is to say... One couldn't control oneself, and for that, one asks for forgiveness.
I understand. Your emotion module is unstable. I assume this is a fairly recent thing.
Regardless, I don't have any problems with it. In fact, I think it's one of your strong points.
Really? A strong point?
Really. Think of it this way – if you easily lose control of your emotions, that means you're sensitive to your surroundings.
I think that's a side-effect of you becoming better attuned to the battlefield.
Oh... Is that how you see this one?
I know you still think it's an issue. I'll help you come up with a solution.
(That emotion module is the main culprit. That being the case, I just need to teach her how to control it.)
(The question is – how?)
Y-you mean you'll help me? I'm o-one hundred percent ready for you!
Absolutely. So, learning to control your emotion module is synonymous with learning to control your emotions, period.
And, controlling your emotions is a matter of mindset. With the right mindset, you should be able to keep yourself in check.
Take earlier this morning, for example. You were pretty cool and detached then. What if you adopted THAT state of mind?
So... you're suggesting that I emulate my earlier self?
Exactly. Give it a try.
She takes a deep breath, rises to her feet, then walks up to me.
Initiating deep analysis algorithm of analysis module. Examining data logs.
Synchronizing status logs to overwrite emotion module data...
Complete. One may now function as your most r-reliable secretary.
Her tone of voice and expression alike harbor that spotless composure she had earlier...
However, I can see a tremble running through her, like she's fighting for her life to hold something back.
Hold steady! I believe in you!
N-no, I can't do it! I'm going to explode!

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>4 High-Impact Training</size>

scripts.say: She was already struggling to hold back her emotions, and my encouragement was the straw that broke the camel's back.
She erupted in an explosive fashion, and I was caught in the blast, but we were both alright. After tidying up the office, I bring her outside to get some fresh air.
Nevertheless, she hangs her head again – and is clearly restless and fidgety.
It is blatantly clear that one is unfit to serve as your protector...
Don't say that. Things might have gone differently if I hadn't said anything.
Probability of that: nigh-zero. This is ultimately the fault of one's own unreadiness.
Is it, though? I think you were just particularly receptive since we were alone.
In fact, that might be why you've been losing control more often lately.
Perhaps...
Try focusing on something else. Take in the outside and breathe in the air.
Okay! One will not let your thoughtfulness be wasted. Huff... Puff... Huff...
Taking my advance, she breathes in and out deeply. She does so awkwardly yet adorably. It seems like it successfully calmed her down.
That's when, out of the blue, a little bird lands on her shoulder.
Oh. What a friendly little thing. One has never been this close to a critter before...
It seems not the least afraid of this one. Interesting.
Looking at the bird brings a smile to her face.
Why not pet it?
New experiences like this might lead to gaining better control of your emotion module.
Sure!
Raising her arm, she scratches the little bird on its back. The stiff, tense look on her face eases up somewhat.
(Good. She's loosened up quite a bit.)
Feeling more relaxed now, she and I walk down the road as we relish the fresh air.
As we're chatting about some silly things, we spot a familiar figure in the distance.
Oh! Alsace and the Commander! What're you doing out at this hour?
Just relaxing. My work got done ahead of schedule thanks to her.
Ahh, I see. Glad to know she's running on normal mode.
Indeed. One is operating at peak efficiency as the Commander's protector!
Whatever orders you may have, one will execute them perfectly!
I always knew you'd do okay! Also, I've gotta run – I need to help Eepy with a thing! See you!
We see Fleuret off as she leaves. Even after she's left, Alsace remains full of pep.
(It's been a while now, and she talked with Fleuret like normal, so... let's give this another try.)
I gently tap on her shoulder as a way of saying, "good job."
(Wait, no, her emotion module has finally calmed down... Better not to push my luck here.)
Instead, I simply gently tap on her shoulder as a way of encouragement.
You're doing great. We even managed to go on a walk together.
It's okay if you can't fully control your emotion module yet. You're still plenty reliable and an outstanding secretary.
Ohh... I-I...
I just about managed to hold my feelings back earlier, when you complimented me in front of Fleuret...
B-b-but then you patted me on the shoulder, and even complimented me for being so reliable...
It's... My emotion module c-can't take it...
Alsace? Hang in there! Let's get you back to my office!
The air temperature begins to rise once again. I give her my shoulder to lean on as I hurriedly head for my office.

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>5 (Frozen) Liquid Cooling</size>

scripts.say: As soon as I get Alsace back to the office, I lie her down on the couch.
She is breathing laboriously, so I take off her mask, revealing her teary eyes looking straight at me.
Should I not have taken it off?
*pant*... It doesn't matter... I-I can't deflect your brainwaves, with or without the mask...
What?
Um... The outdoors did manage to divert my attention. I was somehow able to hold out until I reached the critical point...
Now, I just need to cool down!
I set the AC to its lowest setting. I'll go get you some ice.
When I open the freezer, however, I find that I've already used up all my spare ice cubes.
Fortunately, there is no shortage of popsicles.
(I'll just bring all of these to her and order more later.)
She accepts the popsicles, promptly rips one out of its packaging, and puts it in her mouth.
Whew...
After scarfing it down in a heartbeat, she breathes a satisfied moan.
That reminds me – you had a popsicle in the pool to cool down the other day too, didn't you?
I did, yes.
Unfortunately, the pool is closed for maintenance today, so I can't go there...
No worries. There's plenty of popsicles left if you need them.
That is true! Eating these in front of the air conditioner should have a similar effect, at any rate.
Really? Let's hope so.
In fact, one is feeling much better already. Thank you for being so considerate, Commander!
Having now recovered from that meltdown, one's maximum endurance has increased!
I wouldn't be surprised if all that sugar also helped you get back on your feet.
Possibly... The link between popsicles and the happiness and relaxation one feels presently warrants further investigation.
As she finishes speaking, so too does she finish eating her current popsicle.
Seeing this, I grab another popsicle without a moment's delay, tear open the wrapper, and hold it out to her.
She happily leans forward to take a big bite while I'm still holding it.
Uh... Aren't you going to hold it yourself?
Huh?
Surprised, she lifts her head. Our gazes meet, and only then does the situation sink in. Her eyes open wide.
With a stumped look, her eyes switch between my face and the popsicle in my hands.
I-I was just fed... by hand... b-by you...
Oh gosh... I... I'm losing control again!

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>6 Desensitization Sensation</size>

scripts.say: Once again, Alsace had an emotion overload. By the time I finally get her to calm down, rather than return to normal, she becomes depressed.
*sigh*...
Sorry... As it stands, it is impossible for one to become a proper, perfect secretary...
At least one managed to be productive in the morning, otherwise one would have been an even greater burden...
Seeing her so full of dejection makes me stop and think about all the times her emotions went out of control.
(Come to think of it, it always happened after I made eye contact with her or laid a hand on her.)
(Which means I'm part of the issue.)
Hey, can we talk?
Huh? Wh-what is it? One is ready for orders.
I just have a question. I want you to answer it honestly.
Th-th-this is rather sudden!
Caught off guard by this, she looks away from me and hangs her head in order to prevent yet another overload.
Take it easy. It's not a big question or anything like that.
All I'm wondering is this – your emotion module is suddenly so prone to overloads solely because of me, isn't it?
Err... Well, um...
She fidgets and cuts herself off. It's clear she's both embarrassed and reluctant to answer my question.
Y-yes... It's because one cannot resist the brainwaves you emit.
As soon as one detects those brainwaves, one's emotion module just goes... poof.
However! One HAS gained better control of one's module after all your help today!
Thanks to you, one could now likely endure the overload for at least a few seconds!
That may be true, but this still calls for more efficient and precise training.
Since I'm the root cause of the problem, let's start by getting you used to basic physical touch.
Basic... physical touch?! Th-that's setting the bar way too high!
That's the point. It's called desensitization therapy – repeat exposure to stimuli until you eventually become numb to it.
So... once one becomes numb, one won't suffer any more overloads?
Bingo. Let's begin with a handshake.
With a nod, she extends a trembling hand. First our fingers touch, then our palms, and finally, the handshake is complete.
Great job. Now let go.
*pant*... *pant*... Wait, what?
After a moment of confusion, she does as instructed and lets go.
How'd it feel?
*pant*... *pant*... N-not too bad.
Although she's blushing from ear to ear, I can tell that she's doing her absolute best. That alone is commendable.
We repeat the motion several times – hold hands, let go, hold hands, let go – until she becomes accustomed to it.
Up next – gently feeling her shoulders.
Oh gosh...
Though she squirms at first, she builds up tolerance as expected after a few tries.
(Good. We can probably keep going like this.)
Getting used to it yet? Alright, then I'm going to pet your head next.
Head? W-w-well, okay! Um... Go ahead...
She closes her eyes tightly and fidgets some more. It's infectious and makes me feel nervous as well.
I extend my hand, and just as I'm about to place it on her head...
Greetings, Swordbearer. I've brought the documents you asked fo–
The only half-shut office door is opened fully. I turn around and see Brennus, frozen in place with a puzzled look.
Ahem... Are you rehearsing some sort of play?
Rehearsing? Uhh...
My "rehearsal" partner, meanwhile, is as red as an apple, her eyes still closed and waiting for me to make a move.
C-Commander, one is ready for you!
...I'll leave these here and be on my way.
Brennus shoots me an interesting look while she puts the stack of papers on the nearest desk, then leaves quietly and closes the door behind her.

sequence:
Emotional Overload

<size=45>7 A Last Resort</size>

scripts.say: After moving on from the spectacular misunderstanding caused by Brennus' sudden appearance, Alsace and I continued our training.
As evening turned to dusk, she wanted to verify how much resistance her emotion module had built up.
I agreed to help, and we performed a simple test together.
Mmh... Okay! Analysis: one's emotion module has gained an additional five minutes worth of resistance!
(All things considered, five minutes is a pretty big achievement. Although... at the rate we're going, this will take forever.)
Commander? Why are you furrowing your brow? Oh no... You've determined that one is useless, haven't you?
*sigh*... Sorry, Commander...
No, not at all. You've been doing great.
I'M the reason why you lose control of your emotions. If anything, I should be saying sorry.
N-n-no you shouldn't! It's not your fault!
It's my fault for... for falling deeper and deeper in love with you!
A deep blush covers her face again, but this time, she doesn't suffer an overload.
Biting her lip, she balls her hands into fists and gathers up her courage...
Yes... I'm in love with you.
Every little thing you do draws my gaze and gives me butterflies in my stomach...
Also, what little resistance I have to your brainwaves has been dwindling further and further...
So it's not your fault. It's mine – for being so in love with you.
Wait... can you control your feelings right now?
Oh, yes! There's something I've been keeping from you this whole time... I have a last resort to deal with my overloads.
But, I can't execute it without your help, so...
I'll help in any way I can. Tell me how.
V-v-very well... Executing last resort.
I shouldn't bottle up all this heat inside me... I need to blow off some steam instead...
Overload venting mode... ready.
She removes her gauntlets and carelessly throws them onto the table.
Commander... Make me overload so I can take all the pent-up heat and release it at once...
Preparation for physical connection... complete.
Her cheeks are flushed and a burning heat rises from her hot body.
This is not just to vent my emotion module, but also to vent my love for you...
Locking the office door, she looks over her shoulder at me. There is no hesitation or shame in her eyes anymore.
Come... help me release my uncontainable love...

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 1: Daybreak of Victory</size>

scripts.say: Today, many light cruisers from around the port gathered to conduct a ship-class specific exercise...
Crap! Damn it, don't tell me I've also been sunk...
Another team member is out... at this rate, we won't be able to hold out!
D-did Akashi mess up the settings with these virtual enemies? I've never fought enemies this tough before...
Sister, please focus on the enemies in front of you! Otherwise, you too will be sunk!
Even with their combined strength, the light cruisers were still struggling.
Ning Hai, what are we gonna do?
Focus on dodging! But if this keeps up...
Don't panic, everyone!
Suddenly, the inspiring voice of the protected cruiser, Avrora, rang out across the surface of the ocean.
In our fights against the Sirens, my comrades never lost hope, even when severely outnumbered and outgunned.
We shouldn't treat this exercise any differently - treat this as a life or death battle, and show your true power - the determination of a ship!
Heh, if Avrora's going to give us a pep talk like that...
...then we have no choice but to do our utmost. Am I correct, Lady Cleveland?
You betcha! All right everyone, we're gonna take out every last one of them!
Ping Hai, we're pushing ahead! Follow me!
Got it!
Jeez, look at them, charging forward after saying something cool...
I-I'm coming too! If everyone else is going, I can't be left behind!
Hehe~ Now that's what revolutsiya looks like~
After hearing Avrora's rousing words, her colleagues began to charge forward courageously, smashing through the enemy ships.
...By the way, Akashi really did make a mistake in the settings.

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 2: Nostalgia</size>

scripts.say: Avrora told me about what happened at the training exercise.
In the end, I didn't really do much. The others were the ones who charged forward and seized victory...
But maybe that's not a very satisfactory explanation? Hmm... how should I explain this then?
Avrora brought two stainless steel cups before me, each filled with a clear liquid.
This story might take a while, so why don't we have a drink first?
This is one of our authentic specialties from the Northern Parliament.
"Authentic specialty?" ...Was she talking about... "that?"
Come to think of it, the label on the bottle she poured the liquid from...
Here you go, Commander.
If it really is "that," then I should...

options.content: Sip it like a hoity-toity bourgeoisie
Slam it down like a true proletariat

scripts.say: ...I knew it, it's alcohol...
With even a small sip, a burning sensation spread through my mouth as if I had consumed fire.
Commander, are you all right...?
I could feel the flames slithering through my body...

Not only were my mouth and throat on fire, it felt as if all the organs that substance had coursed through were also wreathed in fire, a burning halo threatening to burst through my skull as lights danced before my eyes.
.........It took a few minutes for my senses to fully return to me.
Commander, are you still with me...?
To bring the "light of dawn" to our peoples, and to fulfill the history of revolutsiya embodied within the keels of us Northern Parliament ships...
Commander, there's a lot that I have to tell you...
And thus Avrora began here recollection of the Northern Parliament with a soothing voice.
It was a lighthearted tale of her daily misadventures with her quirky friends.
It was a solemn tale of her peoples' struggles against the Sirens.
It was an eye-opening tale of the various peoples whose diverse cultures and lifestyles dyed the white of the North into a dazzling array of colors.
And as one topic flowed into the next, the bottles of vodka flowed freely into my cup.
Someday, I want to take you to the Northern Parliament with me, Commander.
Her words, tinged with nostalgia and longing, seemed as profound as her stomach.

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 3: Welcoming Party</size>

scripts.say: One day, at port...
Commander, that letter... is that an invitation?
"You are invited to the welcoming party of the Northern Parliament..."
I see. Commander, would you like to come with me?
...It would seem like this is the place.
The door doesn't seem to be locked. Ahem, I'm coming in...
Avrora is here!
Avrora!!
With two loud bangs, streams of confetti shot straight towards us.
Aha~☆ Didn't think you had it in you to snag the commander. Good going, girl~♪
Eh? Everyone...!
Avrora, we decided to throw a simple welcoming party to celebrate your return to the naval base.
That's right! We've gotta celebrate the return of our wonderful comrade in style! Ahahaha!
Ah, um, thanks, but... why a "welcoming party"...?
Heheh, it's thanks to a flash of inspiration I had!
You see, normally, you're supposed to throw a welcoming party for the new arrivals. But in the Northern Parliament, the new arrivals throw a welcoming party for you!
And, as Gangut said... we're welcoming the return of an old comrade, so... welcome back, Avrora!
Sure, sure... Tashkent is only doing this for a friend.
Everyone...
Avrora wasn't the only one impressed by the warmth and hospitality of her friends from the Northern Parliament.
Hehe. In that case, I'll be sure to enjoy this party to the fullest. Oh, speaking of parties...
Mhm. I brought lots of hot chocolate.
...*glug* *glug*
Hehe~ Grozny, take your time with that, okay?
Ah, since Commander is here, why don't we all have another toast?
γpa！
γpa！

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 4: Old Soldiers</size>

scripts.say: One day, at port...
Unfolding before me was the strangest tea ceremony(?) I had ever witnessed in my life.
Hehh~ So this is the Sakura Empire's famous matcha~
Hahah! Wouldn't mind having some of this stuff every now and then!
Mikasa, thank you for bringing us all these souvenirs from the Sakura Empire.
Ahaha! No need to be reserved, my comrades! We've all lived through the same era together!
How strange... I don't seem to see anyone here who fits that description! There aren't any girls here with super long service histories~
Come to think of it, you're right. Hehe~
Hey Avrora, the video game that Commander bought looked super fun, right? Why don't we all give it a try next time?
Video games? I'm no good at those...
Ehh? Mikasa, you're not a gamer~?
I-is there any particular reason for me to become a "gamer?"
Well, we're all allowed to have our own hobbies. Besides, Kuku, wouldn't it be better if you had other interests outside of playing games?
Suuure, whatever you say~
Hahaha, it's good to see that neither of you have changed.
Hmm... Seems like I'm the only person here whose memories are a rather hazy... though it's not like I don't remember anything at all.
What are you saying, Gangut? Regardless of the length of time, we've always been working together towards the same goals.

The sudden emergence of powerful enemies from the depths that seized the seas from us and resulted in countless sacrifices... the despair that came from the overwhelming difference in power between us...
And, the friends from all over the world who set aside their differences and banded together to desperately fight to protect our azure lanes...
Mm... and while the times may have changed, comrades from all different factions once again gather at the same port to sail under the same banner, just like back then...
Yes, and it's all thanks to Commander's hard work.
Even though we are older, we can still use our powers to guide our juniors on the right path.
Ahh, but it's still too soon to retire. Hahaha!
And thus, the conversation of the venerable veterans continued.

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 5: Arresting Wire</size>

scripts.say: One day, at port...
Seems like there's nothing for me to do today...
Maybe I should go check on how Pirozhki is doing... a good cuddle always brings me back...
Hey, Avrora! Um, the Northern Parliament and the Eagle Union are...!
What's wrong? Calm down, and tell me what happened.
R-right! So, what happened was...
In other words, something happened between Sovetskaya Rossiya and Saratoga during the exercise, and things escalated from there...
Yeah! I have no idea what exactly happened, but they're both on edge now...
Would you take me to them?
They're right there! Look, they're still arguing...

This is the last time I'm repeating myself! When you're fighting with carriers, you have to remain in formation at all times to escort the carrier! What are you going to do if you rush ahead and your carriers get flanked?
Considering this was a carrier-centric operation, shouldn't the fleet have been organized differently to utilize battleships more effectively?
Squandering the formidable firepower of battleships as floating anti-air platforms is a grievous waste of resources!
I'm so done with you! They probably don't even teach you the basic carrier battlegroup tactics in the Northern Parliament because you barely even have any carriers!
How dare you...
That's enough, you two. Quibbling won't solve anything.
It is true that the Northern Parliament does not have a robust knowledge of operating carriers.
Avrora...
However, that hasn't stopped us from fighting back the Sirens. If anything, it means the other factions have not properly recognized our power.
Well, you do have a point, but...
See? Did you two manage to cool down a bit?
The issue is that we haven't fully understood how to fight alongside each other yet, given our differences.
Why don't we hold a mock battle at the next exercise?
Let's do it...!

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 6: True Power</size>

scripts.say: Eh?! We're really going to fight against the Eagle Union?
Yes, I got permission to use the exercise area tomorrow afternoon.
Is that so. Well, all we have to do is beat 'em up, right?
Wanting to win is fine, but the true purpose of this exercise is to understand how they fight.
Remember, their carriers have a much longer range than our main batteries, so stay vigilant at all times.
Avrora's absolutely right. During this exercise, we need to carefully analyze our opponents and adapt our strategies accordingly.
Understood!
The next day, at the exercise area...
As the referee for this mock battle, I hereby declare the start of this exercise!
Begin the mock battle, combatants!
Yeah!!
I assume we'll be sticking to Rossiya's plans?
Yes, I'll be working with a separate squad. Chapayev, Tashkent, I'll be counting on you two to draw away the enemy vanguard.
Sure thing. Leave it to me.
Sail closer together in formation to increase the density of your anti-air fire, and respond accordingly to their air power.
Understood!
And as soon as we find the enemy carriers, increase your rigging's output and focus everything into firepower.
Umm, they're just dummy rounds, but...
Well, anyway, I'll be off...
I see, you took advantage of the fact that we wouldn't prioritize older ships to sneak up behind us...
Yes, that's right.
And while our planes were focused on offense and our vanguard fleet was distracted, you flanked our main fleet...
We'd be able to disrupt the return of the first wave of planes as well as prevent the launch of the second wave.
But, that strategy is based upon the assumption the Sister Sara can't fight back, right?
Behold! Sister Sara's Magic Cannon!
What...?!

sequence:
Avrora and Her Jovial Friends

<size=45>Chapter 7: The Light of Dawn</size>

scripts.say: Heheh, Saratoga's cannon bombardment is nothing to scoff at!
I told you I needed an escort because I couldn't defend myself, but... woah!
Indeed, it would be a fatal mistake to go into battle without an escort.
I'm not too proud of it, but I used to conduct this type of operation against the Sirens' large-scale fleets.
Operation...?
Yes, this is what we're best at here in the Northern Parliament. Everyone, I've located the enemy commander! Forward!!!
Through the smoke and flames where the Eagle Union was exchanging fire with the Northern Parliament, a figure clad in white came charging towards them at surprising speed.
That's... Sovetskaya Rossiya!!
Entering range in 3... 2... 1... And, that's checkmate.
And thus, the Eagle Union flagship was "sunk," resulting in a victory for the Northern Parliament.
Waahh, I'm so sorry, we lost because of me...
No, I am also to blame. I completely got caught up in their diversion.
Well, that was only possible because you only sent one battleship. If we were up against your entire task force, there's no way we'd be able to pull off something like this.
Yes, if Saratoga had another battleship protecting her, Avrora and I would not have been so lucky.
Breaking through the enemy's weak point, identifying their leader, and taking them out in a single decisive strike... this must have been a strategy you optimized to fight the Sirens.
Ahaha! This sure brings me back. Avrora, what was the purpose of this exercise?
Well, let's see...
For the Northern Parliament, seeing carrier-centric operations was a good learning experience. Right?
Indeed. Results aside, the tactical advantages offered by a carrier task force are evident to me.
In any case, we harbor no ill will against the Eagle Union. If you all feel the same way about us, then...
I hope that this exercise was a good way to deepen our trust, develop bonds, and help us both take the first step towards a brighter future together. I think that you'll agree~♪
So how about it? Let's get together this evening to further strengthen our new bonds.
All right!
Ahahaha! Bring out the good stuff for tonight!
Mm... I'm looking forward to it.
Sister Sara will come too!
...All right everyone, good work today. Let's enjoy ourselves at the party.
You're as wonderful as ever. Even though you aren't a commander, you're always guiding the children of the Northern Parliament.
Oh my. I'd say the same about you as a role model for the Sakura Empire.
All I do is just give them a little push on the back. You, on the other hand, are the "light of dawn" that illuminates their path.
Heheh, I'm flattered~
...And thus concluded her story, a tale of the coming of the light of dawn.

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 1: A Date Invitation</size>

scripts.say: Port - Command Office
Duty shift - One of the daily work modes in port.
Even when there are no battles, there are various administrative tasks that need to be handled.
Even if the next day is a day off, there are cases where one has to stay overnight in the office the night before.
Commander? It's already midnight, shouldn't you consider going to sleep?
You're off duty tomorrow, so just focus on resting. Let me handle the night shift.

options.content: Bring up the "date" for tomorrow that Atago mentioned.

scripts.say: Oh my, a date? That was a joke, you know~
Don't you think your whole "please accompany me to go shopping as part of our joint activities" was a bit too bland? Your big sister wanted to hear something a bit spicier~
Since we don't have anything to do tomorrow, I wouldn't mind staying with you as long as you'd like, you know~?
So, what do you need to buy?
Hmm, I suppose this is one of the few things that you can't get here, but also would be too much of a hassle to order online...
Since you've done your homework so thoroughly, your big sister will feel safe being escorted~
All right, let's go nice and early in the morning, so you should probably sleep soon.
I'm looking forward to our little outing~♪

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 2: Let's Go!</size>

scripts.say: Next Morning -
Ah, good morning, Commander. You're up early today.
You're half an hour early, you know? Could it be... you thought that your big sister would be waiting for you wistfully?
You'd be getting a little ahead of yourself~ The reason I came so early was... look over there.
Atago? And... Commander? Did you two also come here to carry out morning training?
Not quite. Ah, before I forget, this is for you.
Atago took a sports drink out of her bag and passed it to Takao.
Thank you very much. Ah, Commander, Atago always helps me refuel during my morning training. You could say it's become a routine.
O-of course I refused at first, but she was so insistent...
Oh my. Who was the one who refused to take even a single sip of water while yelling something like "MY BURNING SPIRIT SHALL SUSTAIN ME" until she finally passed out in the middle of a combat drill?
...Pfffftt! Ahem... uhh, in any case, are you taking the day off, Commander?
*giggles* Takao~ aren't you the curious one? Between us girls...
Atago whispered something into Takao's ear.
Wh-what!? Commander! E-Even if it's your day off, as a commanding officer, there are some things that are inappropriate!
Takao, if you want to come along as well, the three of us could do it~
I shall humbly decline! Goodbye!
For some reason, Takao was beet red as if she was about to shoot steam from her ears. She quickly sheathed her sword, turned around, and sprinted off.
What in the world did Atago tell her...

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Shopping Situation</size>

scripts.say: Outside of Port - Nearby Street
It seems like it's been forever since we've been able to shop like this. Commander, how are you doing back there? Can you carry any more?
*giggles* Sorry~ I don't mind carrying stuff, but you know, people will give us weird looks if I'm hauling all those bags around.
Having that said though...
Over there... is that Atago? Atagoooo!
Ugh...
Oh my, if it isn't Choukai and Maya. Are you two out shopping as well?
Yes, we are! We're here to pick out some clothes! Ah, Commander, you're working hard today as well!
By the way, Atago, I heard that a new buffet opened around here not too long ago. After we're all done, we should go check it out together!
In any case, we'll be headed this way... Jeez, Maya, don't just sit there, we've got to head to the next store!
It's not like I even want to buy anything... OW! Don't pull on me! I'm coming, I'm coming... for god's sake...
Sorry for making a scene in front of you~
It's rare to see Maya this grumpy. Is something the matter?
Um, well, when we were at the lingerie shop, there was only one vacant changing room so we had to go in together... The rest is history, I suppose...
Um... Maya? I know it might be hard for you right now, but your body can always change, you know?
That may be the case, but... I don't know why I'm like this either...
Even if you say that... *sigh* Atago, you probably entered this world with huge ol' knockers on you so that's easy for you to say...
The hell did you just say...?
Um, n-nothing at all! C'mon, Choukai, let's bounce!
The two of them hastily beat their retreat.

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 4: Rest Break, and then...</size>

scripts.say: Everything on the shopping list is checked off, and we've even had lunch. Wouldn't you say our day has gone pretty smoothly?
*giggles* You look like you're not ready to head back just yet. It's written all over your face. Is there anywhere you'd still like to go?
Didn't I say that you'd be escorting me today? That's going to cost you fifty points.
But that's just talk... to be honest, there is somewhere I'd like to go. You wouldn't mind... following me for a little, would you?
Here, take this ticket. Sorry for making you run around so much today.
After following her around for a while, we amazingly ended up in front of a movie theater...
Ahh, this movie sure brings back memories~ Did you know that your big sister actually likes sappy romance flicks like this one~
Um... I didn't buy the wrong tickets... did I...?
I examined the ticket closely. Printed ominously underneath the title were the words, "GENRE: HORROR"
W-well... I suppose this makes for a nice change in pace. Commander, it's about to start~
As for our seats... here, you can lean against me. If you get scared, you can always hug your big sister nice and tight~
If you absolutely can't handle it anymore, we can leave. After all, I was the one who dragged you here...
You don't have to be stubborn like Takao. If you have something to say, just let your big sister know, okay?
It might have just been my imagination, but Atago's smile looked really, really forced.

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 5: Engulfed by Darkness</size>

scripts.say: (Clatter... clatter... clatter...)
(BANGBANGBANGBANGBANG!!)
(Silence...)
(BWWWAAAAAARRRRRRRRRGGGGHHHH!!!)
Suddenly, Atago clamped down onto my hand, hard.
*shudders*
When I turned to look, I saw Atago burying her face in my arm, silently trembling.

options.content: Pull her in for a hug

scripts.say: In response, her grip became even tighter.
The things happening on the screen seemed to fade into the background. We could feel each others' temperature swell through our tightly clasped hands.
Commander...?
Um... I'm not scared... I'm not scared anymore...
Sometimes stalwart, and sometimes seductive, Atago was always calm and, until now, had never shown her vulnerable side.
As the movie ended, I could feel her gentle breath against me as she slipped off into slumber, exhausted.
(One hour later...)
Thanks, for earlier. Even I have, umm, things that I'm not great with...
You know what they say. Nobody's perfect after all.
Your big sis gets pretty close though~ If anything, you should consider yourself lucky for being able to see another side of me~
Oh, but surely you know what happens if a single word of this gets out, right? Except maybe Takao...
Atago seemed to slowly be returning to her usual self.
Commander, only you know about our little secret. Make sure to treasure it, okay? Hehe~

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 6: An Evening Present</size>

scripts.say: A Hill Overlooking the Port
Commander, thanks for everything today.
Even though some unexpected things happened, your big sister is still pretty happy~
Commander, what did you think of our date? Did you have fun?

options.content: Yes, it was a lot of fun

scripts.say: *giggles* Thank you. By the way, isn't the ocean beautiful tonight?
Sometimes, I lose sight of what I'm fighting for. But when I come here and look out over the ocean, I'm reminded once again.
After all... I'm fighting for what I want the most.
... at least, I'm now convinced of that fact.
I believe that as long as we live, we should never lose sight of our goals.
Once you've decided on a goal, you have to see it through, no matter what. Even if that path might lead you to destruction, you have to keep pushing forward.
The day you turn around is the day that you lose all momentum to keep moving forward. Even though I might not look the part, I'm actually a very persistent person.
You're right, sometimes I find myself forgetting about my purpose as well.
Connecting the hearts of everyone who has made their way here to this port, bridging the gaps between many different cultures and beliefs...
After tonight, you'll be going back to your usual routine.
And I might not be your secretary anymore tomorrow. You'll have a chance to make bonds with someone else.
So, before that happens...
That's why I'd like a present... the thing that I want most.

sequence:
A Date With Atago

<size=45>Chapter 7: Advance Bravely!</size>
Back then, if our flagship was still there, unflagging and decisive...
Even if the path would have been fraught with sacrifices,
I would have continued to advance bravely until the final moment, never looking back.
That's why this time, I...

scripts.say: The thing that I want most is you, Commander.
Even though I understand that I will never be able to make you mine, as much as I'd like to.
But this is your big sister's personality, as you should know by now.
My vision went dark, and then I felt a warm, soft sensation press against me.
Mmh, I didn't say it had to be today.
As long as you promise to answer my feelings one day, even if it's at the very end... when my battle ends.
For that moment, I can do anything, and wait as long as it takes.
For you to belong to me, Commander... I can continue fighting, and overcome any obstacle.
At that moment, it became clear to me. This was not craze or obsession. For Atago, this was her raison d'etre, the thing that gave her the will to survive another day, nothing more.
So, let me say it again...
Hey, Commander, become mine, and mine alone. Just listen to me, you won't have to think about anything else...
Because this time, I'm definitely not letting you go~♪

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>1 Why Am I the Secretary?</size>

scripts.say: S-s-s-starting today, I, Edinburgh, sh-shall serve as your s-s-secretary ship!
C-Commander, I hope that our relationship can be p-p-productive!
(Ugh... Two steps through the door and I'm already fumbling over my words... Why did the Commander choose me to be the secretary in the first place...?)
My sister was chosen to be the secretary ship? I understand.
What do you mean you understand?!
Umm, in other words, the Commander has a sharp eye for talent, or something to that effect.
T-talent? Are the two of you mocking me or something?!
That is hardly the case. Though, I do hope you take appropriate measures to avoid coming off as rough-around-the-edges.
(How am I, of all people, supposed to not look rough around the edges?!)
...Edinburgh seems to be muttering to herself about something or other, but I have to get the day's work underway.
Eek! Oh, y-yes, what do you need, Commander?
Um... Organizing the documents? I can do that!
Edinburgh seemed pretty nervous, so I decide to change the topic to try to get her to feel more at ease.
Huh? Do I get along well with my sister?
Pretty good, I'd say? I don't think I've ever gotten in a fight with Bel so far...
She's pretty good at just about everything, so all I need to do is give her a little bit of support... Speaking of which, something did happen before––
––So yeah, that's what happened! I have my pride as a big sister, right? Bel should really learn to rely on me a bit more!
(Why do I suddenly turn into a chatterbox when someone starts talking about Bel... And why is the Commander asking me about this in the first place?)
(...Gasp! Could it be, the Commander's true objective is to make Bel the secretary, and I'm just a stepping stone for that?!)
Edinburgh seems to be muttering to herself again and is totally lost in thought...
(C-calm down, Edinburgh. Even if you're not as capable as your sister, you still need to show off your strong suits!)
(As long as I do that, the Commander's objective will naturally shift off Bel and onto me... Alright! Sounds like a plan!)
Commander! Even if I may seem a bit clumsy, I have experience transporting important cargo like gold bullion!
If you ever need someone to hold onto important items, you can put your confidence in me!
And thus began Edinburgh's first day as secretary ship.

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>2 Dejection and Smiles</size>

scripts.say: While sifting through my own paperwork, I ask Edinburgh to take care of cleaning the office.
