Cleaning is one of every maid's fundamentals! I'll make sure it's done flawlessly!
Heh heh! See, my cleaning skills are certainly not inferior to Bel's. Now, to put away my cleaning tools...
*CLAAAAANG*!!
Ack! I knocked over the bucket! I don't even remember putting it over there! ...Where's the rag, where's the rag? ...Ahh!
S-sorry for my blunder just now... Just give me a moment to prepare the tea, so please rest for now––
Eek! C-Commander, there's a bug on your head! Please hold still, I'm going to get rid of it!
I've got you now! Hyaaah!
*THWACK*!!
Eep! I, I'm so sorry for hitting your head... D-does it hurt?!
And thus, the chaotic day finally draws to an end.
*sobs*... How did all of this end up happening...
Commander, I'm so sorry... I was just trying to shoo away the bug, and instead ended up hitting you on the head...
At least now that things have calmed down, I have an opportunity to savor Edinburgh's black tea.
*sigh*... I really wish I wasn't such a klutz... Um, what about the tea?
Oh, yes, of course, I brewed it earlier... Huh? It's really delicious?
Heh... Ehehe... I'm so glad that my efforts are worthy of your praise.
Edinburgh, who had been wallowing in dejection due to her missteps, finally smiles again.
I make sure to cast a little magical spell when I'm brewing tea~ "Become sweet and delicious~"
The trick is to imagine somebody else drinking your tea, and putting a smile on their face~
Hehe, would you like a live demonstration? I can pour you another cup if you'd like~
I hand the cup back over to Edinburgh, and she prepares another serving for me.
Become sweet and delicious, become sweet and delicious... Now, Commander, please give it a try.
Ahh... I'm sure this cup of tea came out great! After all, I put in so much effort praying for your happiness!
...Huh? Why'd you break out into laughter all of a sudden? Did I get something stuck on my face?
Edinburgh tilts her head with a puzzled expression. Seems like her dejection from before has completely vanished without a trace.
D-don't keep it a secret from me~! I want to know what you're laughing about!
What colorful, vivid expressions she has–– that was my first impression of Edinburgh after she became the secretary ship.

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>3 An Afternoon of Sighs</size>

scripts.say: Port - Courtyard
Sigh~~~
Suffolk, how many times have I told you that the sink must be cleaned thoroughly?
Ehhhh? D-don't you think your standards are a bit too high, Sheffield?
Sigh~~~
(*The two lean in for a closer look.*)
Ehh?! If the two of you are going to come in, don't just sneak back out again!
My apologies. We just happened to... notice some things.
Uhh, yeah, what she said.
Sigh... Do you two have a moment to listen to my troubles? It won't take that long.
...I suppose I can lend an ear. But make it quick, I need to get back to lecturing Suffolk about the importance of sink-cleaning.
P-please take your time. As much of it as you need...
...I see. In other words, you're worried about dragging the Commander down with your clumsiness.
But, what you described doesn't seem out of the ordinary for you.
So ruthless! ...Ugh, but at this rate, my own opinion aside, even Bel's going to have a lower assessment of me...
...I fail to see how these things are related.
Ah, um, it's because I'm a warm-up for Belfast, right? The Commander is probably going to appoint Belfast as the secretary ship soon!
There's no way the Commander would do something like that!
I'm sure of it! After all, why would someone as clumsy and dumb as me get chosen?
Sigh... Listen well, Edinburgh.
You are uniquely you–– and the Commander saw something about you that is valuable.
I am... uniquely me?
Yes. In other words, you have your own things that you are good at.
After all, the Head Maid wouldn't force someone who is completely useless into the Maid Team.
That's right! Just like how Kent is athletic and good at sports, and I'm often in charge of the weather forecast because of my good eyesight––
Suffolk, you know how to do weather forecasts?
Knowing how to watch the clouds counts, right?
Not in the slightest...
If you don't understand what I'm saying, just mull it over a bit. Anyway, Suffolk, let's go.
Noooooo! I don't want to be lectured! At least shorten it a bit... Waaah...
Uniquely me... Does something like that really exist?

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>4 Even the Meek Move Forward</size>

scripts.say: During the morning...
Mmmgh... *yawn*...
Mmh... I still don't know what is supposed to make me uniquely me...
And I was thinking so hard about it that I slept in!!! Gaaaah!!! What time is it?!
*pant*... *pant*... Oh no, I'm already late!
Commander, I'm so sorry, I– Wait, huh? Nobody's here?
Wait, my clock's time is–– No way, I actually arrived a few hours ahead of time?
Oh, I must've read the time wrong since I didn't put my glasses on... Ugh, how careless of me...
Well, since I already got up early, I might as well start my day off on the right foot––
I arrive at the office at the usual time, but to my surprise, Edinburgh is already waiting for me when I open the door.
Ah, Commander, good morning!
What do you think? I made all the floors, windows, bookshelves, and desks sparkly clean!
Certainly, everything in the office looks immaculate. She must've arrived really early to start cleaning...
It's because I got up early–– not because I rushed over thinking I overslept on accident!
Ahaha... Sometimes I feel like working extra hard so that you can have a more comfortable work environment, Commander.
It seems like the truth leaked out a little, but I didn't really see any issue with it.
So, I tell Edinburgh - "Thanks for all your hard work."
Thank you for your kind words! Oh, by the way, the tea should be ready just about now! How about a cup before you start with work?
When I look at Edinburgh, who is pouring tea while humming a little ditty, her mood seems extraordinarily clear, just like the pristine office.

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>5 An Unexpected Invitation</size>

scripts.say: A few days later...
The quality of Edinburgh's work as the secretary ship has been quite satisfactory.
Commander, shouldn't you be getting ready to retire for the day? I prepared a new dessert for you today.
*knock* *knock*
Hm? It seems like we have guests. Come in––
Edinburgh, how goes your secretary work?
Hey there, Edinburgh!
Émile? And Echo too? What brings the two of you here?
So the thing is, your partner for the dance can't make it due to an emergency. She asked me to come and apologize to you.
Eh? Oh no... that's quite troublesome.
Seeing the confusion on my face, Echo explains the situation.
There's going to be a social party between the Royal Navy and Iris Libre.
Edinburgh has been preparing a dance for the party. She's totally amazing, you know~
Echo! You're exaggerating way too much!
I just barely manage to avoid stepping on peoples' toes... Isn't that right, Émile?
Heh heh, Edinburgh is so dazzling on the stage that you should go see her when you have the time, Commander~
Wait, that's perfect! How about pairing our secretary ship here with the Commander for the dance?
Woah, that's a great idea!
Eh...? EHHHHHHH?!!
Doesn't that sound so romantic? Then this is for you, Commander~
Edinburgh never recovered from her state of panic, but I take the invitation from Émile's hands.
H-how did this end up happening...

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>6 Partners Through Thick and Thin</size>

scripts.say: At the social party between the Royal Navy and Iris Libre...
C-C-Commander, are you a-a-alright...?
I am perfectly fine, but Edinburgh... seems to be as nervous as the day she first started her duties as the secretary ship.
Umm, the rehearsals have been going well, but I get so nervous when I'm in front of an actual crowd...
I d-d-don't think someone like me can do this... Aha... Ahaha...
But... Even though I'm like this, the Commander still––
Edinburgh seems to have been bottling something inside...
I urge her to speak her mind, trying to convince her by saying that she'll feel better afterwards.
Ah, um... Well...
Commander... you chose me to be the secretary instead of her, right? I'm not just her benchwarmer, right?
Commander... you found something about me that's valuable to you, right?
I nod without hesitation in response to each of her questions with a dead-serious expression on my face.
I see... Even though I'm a total klutz, you still chose someone like me...
In other words... There's something that nobody else can do but me!
Th-thank you so much, C-Commander! I d-don't have to be fixated on this single thing anymore!
Edinburgh still seems ridiculously nervous... but at least I see some hope of breaking through to her.
A-and, even if I end up failing, we'll at least be partners through thick and thin!
Because, you chose me!
As the music begins to flow, the two of us take our first steps together.
The dance ends, and applause bursts from all over the venue.
I knew it! That was so amazing! The two of you were shining so brightly together on that stage!
Yes, that was quite a breathtaking performance~ As expected, the Commander and the secretary ship make a wonderful pair.
Thank goodness... I didn't make any wrong moves...
Commander, I won't keep asking about why you chose me anymore.
Since you chose me from among so many other worthy colleagues, all that means is that I have to live up to your expectations. Ehehe~
During the prolonged applause, Edinburgh says these words to me shyly.

sequence:
Uniquely "Me"

<size=45>7 Everyone Knows Her Worth</size>

scripts.say: After Edinburgh left the office for the day, I suddenly remember something that I need her to do.
Oh? I don't see you come to the kitchen often, Commander!
If you're asking about Edinburgh, she's not here right now. Said she had to buy some seasonings?
Unfortunate. Guess I have to come back another time.
...By the way, Commander. Edinburgh has been the secretary ship for a pretty long time now. Is she doing well?
Indeed. I always knew you had strange preferences, but this is...
Hey! That's rude, Sheffield!
But the truth is, ever since you appointed her, we've all been talking about how you have a good eye for talent!
Right. Even though Edinburgh may seem a bit rough around the edges, she has a mysterious ability to warm the hearts of everyone around her.
...I suppose that's something only Edinburgh can do.
––Master.
Thank you for continuing to look after my sister.
Right after leaving the Royal Navy dorms, I just happen to bump into Edinburgh, who was returning from her shopping trip.
Oh my, what brings you to the dorms, Commander? Wait, huh?!
It's gone! It's gone! My wallet's not with me?! I thought I had it a moment ago to pay for the groceries!
I must've left it behind at the cash register... Ugh, why am I always like this?

options.content: "We'll get to take a walk together now."
"I think that side of you is cute."

scripts.say: What a positive way of spinning things... But, hearing those words from you really makes me believe the same thing!
*sigh*... Are you sure you're fine with someone like me?
I nod before taking Edinburgh's hand. Her smile is shy, but genuinely happy.
Thank you, Commander! I hope I'll be able to do more to prove my worth to you in the future!
Inside a virtual space...
Hai Domo~! I'm Kizuna AI!
Some of you might be watching my video for the first time, so let me introduce myself! I... am actually an A.I.!
I normally like to do all kinds of fun things from this room here known as "Pure White", such as playing some video games~!
With that said, today I'm planning to do a broadcast of something you might not have seen me play for a while - Azur Lane!
Just in time for the new collab to start too~! I wonder who the collab is with this time? Can't wait to find out~!
What if.. they were doing a collaboration with me! Just kidding~!
Even though I've always said that I wanted to do a collab, it'll happen one day!  We'll just have to wait and see to find out when that is!!
Anyway, let's not worry about that and play some Azur Lane~! Takao-chaan~! Did you miss me!?
I don't mind playing normally, but today, I feel like using a random word generator to answer some of your questions~!
Here we go~ Jakajakajaka~jan!
Huh? Why is this thing starting to glow...?
What the heck is this?!?! UWOOOAAAAAaaaahhhhh!!!
CRAAAASSHHHHHH--!!!
Huh?! HUUHH?!!
The intelligent super A.I., Kizuna AI, who found herself thrown into the middle of a vast and boundless sea, let out a cry.
WHERE THE HECK AM I━━━━!!???
Phew, we managed to make it through without taking much damage!
I ... want to see a real concert.
Ayanami too...
Me three~! AI, when this battle is over, you should invite us to your concert~♪
Of course! I have a lot of songs ready~♪
Yay~! Also, we want to practice the songs so we can maybe get up on stage too~!
Perhaps. But we'd have to work hard at it every day
I suppose you're right... I'll give it my all!
I see, I see! This must be that "lovey dovey mode" I've read all about!
I think Commander would be very pleased with that!
W-w-w-wait~! It's not like that~!!
Ahh, this is what youth is all about... how nice!
Now that everyone has had a chance to calm down, let's resupply and head towards the next zone.
Aye aye!
Everyone~! Look, look!
Ooh, you've recovered another outfit!
Cuuuute~! It's all frilly and princess-like~! AI, it suits you really well!
I see, I see! So this is someone who looks good in everything! I also agree that this is super cute!
Ehehe~ Thanks, everyone~!
There's big trouble, nya! This isn't the time to be fawning over clothes, nya!
Akashi? What's the fuss all of a sudden?
A new Virtual Mirror Sea has appeared, nya!
If we leave it alone, the virus will rapidly multiply until it is nearly impossible to contain! Please hurry before we're out of time!
This Virtual Mirror Sea is a bit different than the ones you've encountered previously, so take this equipment just in case, nya.
Thanks, Akashi-chan! Let's get over there proto!
Virtual Mirror Sea - 4 kilometers above sea level
GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH! WHY DID WE GET WARPED UP HEREEEEEEEE!
We're faaaaaaaaaalling------!!!
Woooooooaaaaahhhh!
Laffey-channnnnnn~ saaaaaave meeeeeeeeee!
(Unconscious)
... She passed out------?!
*gasp* That's right... now is the perfect time to use that equipment that Akashi gave us!
Come to think of it, we do have something like that... Akashi's prototype parachute, deploying! ...Hopefully!
Pheww... we somehow managed to land safely onto the water... Thanks, Akashi!
I thought we were done for... Thanks, Akashi-chan~
I'm glad the one Akashi gave me was self-deploying... Thanks, Akashi...
Huh? But, uhh, why are we surrounded by some weird fog? It seems to be creeping closer...
Somehow... I have a bad feeling about this...
I see, I see! This must be like one of those games where you take damage if you stand inside the cloud!
*shivers* Eh...? Why is this giving me a sense of deja vu?
My super intelligent AI senses are telling me that we won't last anywhere near a fortnight here unless we get to the center of this zone!
Let's proceed carefully. Make sure you don't get caught inside the fog!
There are some obstacles in our way, and we can't get to the other side. We'll have to figure out some way of clearing this stuff out...
That amphibious vehicle is in the way...
What's the best way to handle this...?
Everyone, look what I found! Umm, this is... some kind of switch?
Is this one of those "self-destruct switches?" If you press it, it goes "BOOM" and you get a big "Game Over."
Ikazuchi has a point. We don't know what it does, so it's best to leave it alone...
*ka-chunk*
UWOOAHH! I accidently bumped into it!!
(A huge explosion... didn't happen at all)
H-Huh...? We... we're alive?
I heard a faint exploding sound in the distance though.
Look... that vehicle that was blocking the way is now gone!
Woot! Now we can keep going!
*staaaaaaaares*
I-I'm sorry! Please forgive me~!
It's okay, AI... it worked out...
Huh? I found a weird box!
What's this? It looks like it fell out of the sky...
Who dropped these supplies for us...?
It doesn't look like this is booby trapped...
Do you think someone is trying to help us out? Let's open it up and see what's inside~♪
That may be the case, but let's open it carefully since there's no telling what's inside.
Pay attention to your surroundings! We're not the only ones who saw this box drop so there must be enemies nearby!
AI? Suddenly, you seem like you're a pro at this?!
While you guys were chatting, Inazuma and Ikazuchi already started rummaging through the box...
See, someone definitely dropped these supplies to help us out. Whoever you are, we accept your gift graciously!
I see, I see! Looks like the more we collect, the stronger we'll be! Let's keep our eyes peeled and grab as much loot as we can!
We've pretty much cleared out all the obstacles, so isn't it about time to head to the boss fight?
We're done wiping out the bugged enemies as well, yes...
In any case, it's pretty amazing how you can still dart back and forth while fighting in that poofy, frilly dress.
That's for sure! Isn't it hard to move in that?
Like you two have room to talk...
It's fine, it's fine~ this outfit is designed for singing and dancing, so moving around is no problem!
Kizuna AI... you're amazing... I'm no good in clothes like that...
Oops, we've been chatting away for too long. Let's focus our attention - the boss might appear any moment now!
Miss AI? Watch out in front of you!!
THUNK!
Ooooowwwww!!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAaaaaaaaaahhhh!
You're the fake Kizuna AI?! Where did you come from all of a sudden?!
Kizuna AI... you're not amazing after all... Laffey is disappoint...
Don't say that, Laffey-chan... Saaave meeee~~~
Looks like I have no choice. Time to kick ass.
Jeez! Why is there another clone of me?! I know that my 3D model is open source and all, but there simply some lines that you shouldn't cross!!
Looks like it's equipped with battleship-type riggings... I'm afraid that it's heavily armored!
I see, I see! We were supposed to bring AP shells to do more DPS here!
The enemy's coming! Prepare to intercept them!
Phew... haah... finally... we won...!
Trying to find a safe place to fight while avoiding the fog definitely proved to be difficult.
Supplies dropping from the sky, and that fog... reminds me of that one game I tried playing with Long Island...
Falling from the sky like that is something I don't want to experience again... Ahaha...
I ... am in agreement...
I'm not sure why, but every piece of equipment that I found was a little different, with some being better than others. How annoying.
I know, right? That's just called RNG!
Ikazuchi, you really know everything, don't you? So smart~♪
Wh-what's your deal? Don't treat me like a cat! I only know what I know!
Ahhh, so cute~! *rub* *rub*
I don't mind if you dote on Ikazuchi, but... AI, you should have recovered the rest of your data by now, right?
Ahh... that's right! All right, watch me closely~!
Ta-da~! Super Gamer Kizuna AI, transformation complete~!
Woah... your ship rigging turned into battleship-type as well. Since we're all destroyers over here, our firepower just increased by a ton.
AI, you look super duper strong~!
Kizuna AI... battleship version... looks really strong.
Eh heh heh~ watch me closely, and I'll show you what being a capital ship is all about!
(I feel like she's going to shoot herself in the foot... but I don't have the heart to say anything... Guess I'll see what happens...)
I don't see anything out of the ordinary here. Just where are the enemies hiding...?
That's right... Until now, the enemies started showing up almost immediately. I wonder where they're hiding...
You have a point. For starters, let's split up and search the perimeter.
Understood!
Look over there. There's a very conspicuous random word generator just sitting there...
It's way too obvious...
Mmhmm... it's a trap.
Ehh? Um... I see, it's a trap... I totally knew that.
Ikazuchi, nobody would have known if you didn't say anything...
Be careful, everyone. Make sure not to get too close to it.
Yaaay! I didn't think I'd find my random word generator in a place like this~!!
Wait... Miss AI?!?!
MENACING!!
Eh? What's going on? Wait! Get away! Stay away from me! No, no, no, no, no!
AAAAAaaaaaaaAAAAAAAAaaaAAAAAHHHHH...
I-Impossible... how could Miss AI turn into... that...?
Woah~! What should we do? AI turned into a titan!
AI!!!! Are you okay------?!

Haah... so tired, so damn tired... Why am I fighting in a place like this anyway... Come to think of it, I was just minding my own business, shooting a video... Isn't it strange that I've turned into this?
And now, my body's turned into this monstrosity... Maybe it's better to just completely destroy this world. Maybe that's how I can get back home...?
Ahh... what a pain in the ass... I'll just let my clones run rampant and call it a day...
KABOOOOM!!
What...?! A mini-AI is lobbing bombs at us?!
We can't break through to her... She can't hear us at all...
A titan version of Miss AI, and a bunch of mini-AI's bombing us from the air... things are looking bad...
We might have to slap some sense into her, literally!
Shock therapy... is the only way...
But she's so huge... there's no way to beat that ><
Let's approach this calmly. In order to maintain that giant form, she would require a massive amount of energy.
You have a point... ah! Look over there! There's a power cord coming out of her! Perhaps that's what is supplying her with energy!
I see, I see! If we cut off her power supply, she'll go into a Down Phase!
If we do that, then we can win. Wait for us, Kizuna AI.
This is as far as you go. We won't let you get any closer to Kizuna AI.
Miss Eugen? You've also come to the Virtual Mirror Sea? But... why are you wearing your wedding attire...?
Zed, be careful. Something's not right here...
Ahaha~♪ We've come here to protect our beloved Kizuna AI.
Um... We won't let you lay a finger on Miss AI ><
They call us the "Kizuna AI Fleet." We shall be your opponents!
Kizuna AI Fleet, huh... But why are Prinz Eugen and Takao wearing swimsuits...?
P-Please don't mind that...
Is this also caused by that random number generator...?
What do you think? In any case, we won't allow you to touch our Commander, Kizuna AI. If you still insist on coming, steel yourselves!
Tch...! I didn't think they'd have reinforcements like this...
Even their name plates on the dialogue box are different! Kizuna AI must be a commander in her original world, and this is her fleet!
I see, I see! She must have given promise rings to these four! Their nicknames are super cute!
Ikazuchi, now's not the time to admire her taste. We have to find some way to get the upper hand.
Miss Eugen~! We all want to protect AI, right? So, we should work together!
I'm afraid that's not possible.
Huh? Why...?!
Milady's true desire right now is to destroy this world. As her vassals, we must carry out her will.
This kind of dedication... is wrong!
We... we've already made up our mind ><
Looks like... we might have a better shot if we tried to go around them...
Ara? Then, maybe we should do you a favor and let you go? Just kidding~♪ I'd never, ever let you get away~
Shoukaku?! Even if you say that... Ikazuchi isn't scared of you at all!
We won't let you get any closer to AI!
You'll never be able to escape us while fighting off all our other forces!
Wh-wh-wh-what do we do~! Why are they such tryhards~~~~ ><
We're going to have to find some way to hold back the Kizuna AI Fleet while we cut off the power supply...
No, our best bet is to fight them head on. If we take them out, there's nothing stopping us.
So, is this one of those stages where we have multiple win conditions? We can either do the high-power strategy, or the low-cost strategy!
Eat this!
KABOOOOM!!
For this to happen to me... how shameful...!
Takao, you were a formidable foe.
Uguuuu~ ><
Just when I managed to surpass Akagi...
If you had surpassed her a bit more, we might have been in trouble...
Fortune, don't cry! Just leave AI to us, we'll save her...!
Sincerest apologies, Miss Eugen.
It's fine. There's nothing you need to apologize for. However, I want to leave a message for Commander... for AI...
This shitty nickname that you gave me... I'm actually quite fond of it...
Even though we're all trying to help AI, I can't help but to feel that we're the villains here...
Maybe... but, we have to carry on the will of the Kizuna AI Fleet, and do our best to save Kizuna AI!
Let's put an end to all this! AI, we're coming to save you!!
This is the last one!
*CLICK!*
With this, we've turned off all the power switches!
Everyone, look at big AI!
That aura of invincibility... it's gone now...
Soon, she'll be crowd controlled and won't be able to move, right?
Maybe for the time being. But if we take too long and she hard enrages, we'll totally wipe. Let's find some way to finish it now.
Now, even we will be able to go toe-to-toe with the titan Kizuna AI.
Now's our chance, yes.
All righty! Everyone, let's end it here!
In a sea area close to Port...
Phew...! Hey guys~! We're almost back home. It's been pretty rough, but let's hang in there a bit longer!
Looks like my battery's in the red from "playing" too much? But I have enough juice to last another stage!
No problem here. Let's keep it up.
*pant* *pant*... Can... Can we rest for a minute...?
Z23, are you okay? Looks like... Laffey is doing fine...
Easy-
Hmm... I suppose we should take a break, overexerting yourself is not allowed! Zed, take your time and rest up!
Thanks... thanks a ton, Javelin...
Sitting around is boring, so I'll be right back...
Laffey, please be careful...
Time to... kill some time!
If Ikazuchi is going, I'll tag along as well.
Take care, you three. Make sure to get back before break time is over!
Got it~
... Is someone there...?
Abfffft... *glug* *glug* Someone... help meeeeEEEE!! Anyone!! I'm, I'm drowningggg!!
I see, I see! So this is what "thanatophobia" looks like!
Now's not the time to be saying stuff like that. Let's go help her.
*gurgle* *gurgle* *blub* ... (Huh? Come to think of it, I'm an AI, so do I even need to breathe?)
!? Crap, she's not moving anymore.
H-Hurry up and save her!
SPLAAAAASHH~!!
In a blur, Laffey dove into the water and pulled out a mysterious figure clad in pink and white.
... Still alive? Hello...?
Thank youuuuuuu! You saved my life~!
Huh...? Laffey-chan?!
Ahh, I'm so happy! I never thought I'd get to meet the real Laffey-chan! *huuugs*
You know who Laffey is...? Laffey, have you met this person before?
(Her cheeks are being rubbed against) Don't have a clue...
Ehhhhh?! You're kidding!? We overcame so many hardships together! Did you forget?!
Her memory seems to be fried...? Did she go into Panic Mode?
She doesn't even have riggings, so at least I don't think she's an enemy. Even if it's just to figure out the situation, why don't we join up with Javelin and bring her back with us to the base?
Okay... Stop crying, and follow us.
Have you calmed down a bit?
Mmhm, I'm fine now. Thank you, Laffey-chan♪
I was just thinking about how much I wanted to meet all of you in person~!
I see, I see! So this is that "summoned from another world" trope!
Talking about the "fourth wall" again...?
In other words... what are you talking about?
Akatsuki once said, "Never take anything Ikazuchi and Inazuma say seriously."
Ah, I haven't introduced myself yet! My name is Kizuna AI! You can just call me AI for short!
Actually, I'm an intelligent super A.I.! In my original world, I was a "Virtual YouTuber," and I posted a lot of videos-
It's a pleasure, AI... What's a "Virtual YouTuber?" It sounds... really futuristic, maybe...
Miss AI, it's a pleasure to meet you. Come to think of it, we picked up this box-like thing from near where we found you. Perhaps it was summoned here along with you?
It's white and pink... and has an "R" written on it...
Ah! The random word generator~! It followed me here as well?!
"Random word generator?" Is this something from your world as well, AI-chan? What's it for?
I... want to see how it's used...
Heh heh heh~ since you're all so curious, I'll have to show you for myself! Jakajakajaka~jan!
Huh...? How strange, nothing happened at all... Let me try this again! Hiya! *slap!* Hiya! *bang!*
BOOOOMM~!! Pshhhhhhhh~!
Wh-woah!? Did it malfunction? There's so much smoke coming out of it!
!? There's something coming out of it! Watch out!
There are two AI's now?! Watch out! She's coming at us!
--------BADOOOOM!!
Who was that? They took her out in one shot!
Ayanami! Are you all uninjured?
TA-KAO-CHWAAAAN~!! THANK YOUUUUUU~! *glomps*
Hnn...?! A new enemy?
No problem over here. That's the good Kizuna AI, probably.
But, how are we supposed to fix this box...
Sorry to bother you when you're all busy, nya~ Commander has assigned the investigation of this box to the Research Department, nya~
HELPFUL CAT GODDESS!! TIMES OF NEED!! COME!!! ━━━━ლ(´ڡ`ლ)━━━━!!
Unya?! Don't hug me all of a sudden, nya!
We've hypothesized that this "random word generator" connects a multitude of worlds together, or so it seems.
That's right~ It's only right that a super genius like me would be able to make a super item like this~
It would appear that Kizuna AI got stranded in our world because of a malfunction with the "random word generator." We thought that if we were able to re-establish a link with her original world...
But when we looked into it, we found a virtual space inside that gave off the same readings is a Mirror Sea, nya...
Eh!? A Mirror Sea?! Inside that box?!
What?! Isn't this like one of those light novels where I can't get home unless the bug gets fixed?
Looks that way, nya. We have no choice but to enter this Mirror Sea to search for some way to get Kizuna AI back home, nya.
You can project yourself inside just by thinking about it. Like this.
Sitting around isn't going to help us make any progress. Everyone, let's head inside and look for a way to get Miss AI home.
A Mirror Sea inside virtual cyberspace... in other words, the "Virtual Mirror Sea!"
Yuubari and Akashi will provide support from this side, so everyone, give it your all, nya!
I shall remain on guard here then. There's no saying if the enemy might appear on this side again.
Mmhmm! Thanks, everyone. Let's set out then~! Hip, hip, hooray~!
AI, we're coming to take you home! Let's go together?
She's not responding. As expected, we have to do this by force.
Miss AI... I'm so sorry!
It's working...! If we keep this up...
What...?! Someone just cast Mass Resurrection on all those AI clones that we took out before?!
H-How could this be?! It took us so much effort just to get one under control, and now there are three more!
Th-there's too many of them...! Wh-what should we do?!
Zed, we haven't lost just yet.
As long as there is even a sliver of possibility, Ayanami will seize it...
We're all in this together! We absolutely won't lose!!
That's right! We will never give up!
BOOM!! BOOM BOOM!! FWOOSH!
Just when everyone was preparing themselves for their last stand, the sound of cannonfire rang out from the distance...
Cannons...? From where, though?!
Look! Over there, it's...
The Kizuna AI Fleet?
Kizuna AI Fleet? What are you talking about? Were you so scared that you went delirious?
Sorry to have kept you waiting, nya! By Commander's orders, I've brought everyone here, nya!
It took me a long time to parse the random word generator. Sorry I'm late.
Is everyone all right? Everything's going to be okay, now that we're here.
I'm glad you're all unhurt. We rushed all the way from port into this Virtual Mirror Sea...
We'll handle these three. I'm trusting you to take care of the big one!
I see, I see! This must be our "plot armor!"
Thanks for the help.
Now, we have nothing to worry about.
We're just one step away from saving AI!
Why... I clearly just want to destroy this world... so why are you going through all this trouble for me...?
That's because...
You're our precious friend, AI!!!!
Miss AI! Please remember who you are!
Ugh... Arghh..
You can't lose to the virus...
It... hurts...
Let's play video games together when we get home!
Uuugh...! Aaaaaughhh!
You still have to return to your original world and record lots of videos, right? There are a ton of fans waiting for you, right? Please come back, AI!!
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!
Thanks... everyone... I'm so sorry for all the trouble I've caused!
Don't worry, AI~♪ Welcome home!
We did it! Our lively AI is back to normal!
Look, look! AI's body is returning to her normal size!
Awesome! With this, maybe it's time to roll the credits?
MENACING RUMBLING....!!!!!!!!
What's that "JOJOJO" sound? An earthquake? Is this entire Virtual Mirror Sea about to collapse...?
This is bad, nya! If we get caught when this Mirror Sea collapses, we might be trapped inside virtual space for an eternity, nya!
N-no way! Let's hurry up and get out of here!
So many Kizuna AI clones?! This is bad... we've already used up all our ammo!
The exit portal is too far away! Even if we manage to break through them, we might not make it in time!
Kizuna AI, can't you hack into something?
Huh... hacking...?
That's right... since AI was able to out-hack the enemy earlier, maybe she can do something...?
(Ehhhhhh?! I haven't done it for a long time, so I'm probably super rusty?!) I'm not sure what I'll be able to do, but I'll give it my best shot! Nnnhh... Hnnnnng.... Hah!!
Amazing! All the Kizuna AI clones stopped moving!
I-I somehow did it~!!!
I'm going to connect this Virtual Mirror Sea back to the home port! Although I can't stop this place from collapsing, it shouldn't be too late to send everyone home!
!! An error...?!
Teleporting player to home port. Please move to the safe zone to commence teleportation.
A gentle light began to envelop all the girls...
...except Kizuna AI.
AI?! AI, aren't you coming with us?!
I'm sorry. It seems that I have to stay behind in order to keep this portal open so that everyone can get home.
How could this be...!
Thanks for accompanying me all this time. Truly, I can't thank you all enough. Our time together was short, but I'll never forget it...
Miss Ai, wait!
No, no...! We have to go back together!
I swear to get you all back home safely.
After all, I am...
...an intelligent super A.I.!
--- "Goodbye."
AIIIIIIIIIIIIII------!!!
Port - Main Area
AI sacrificed herself... to save us...!
How could this happen...
AI...
After we defeated the three clones, we thought more enemies would start to show up. But instead, we were surrounded by a strange light and... what exactly happened?
In order to protect us, Kizuna AI stayed behind in the Virtual Mirror Sea...
What... are you saying...? After all that, we still failed to save her...?
If I knew this would have happened... I never would have turned her down when she wanted to make a video together... *sniffles* I'll help you as many times as you'd like, so... please come back...!
Huuuh? Reaaally~?!
Eh heh heh, I've come back, safe and sound~!

I'll give you the TL;DR! I'm originally an A.I., so I was a virtual existence to begin with. Therefore, it doesn't make any difference if I'm swallowed up by virtual space. Does that sound about right?
So that's how it goes, nya... I never expected that outcome, nya...
(Well, they probably wouldn't understand if I told them the truth, so I guess this will have to do)
Now that we've gotten through that mess together, let's swear to never be stubborn toward each other again!
Javelin-chan, sorry for making you worry about me.
All in all, we've managed to clear out the Virtual Mirror Sea, but we still have to repair the random word generator and completely eliminate the virus that it created.
Looks like we're getting a sequel! Everyone, let's do our best once more!
Well, things aren't quite done here but, I'm relieved...
Port - Near the Royal Dorms
(Some time has passed since AI returned to her original world. Since then, the waters near the port have been peaceful.)
(AI mentioned that after she returns to her world, she would post a video of some sort. I wish we could see it from this side...)
(We've been having a good time here! How have things been for you on your world, AI? You didn't accidentally pick up a scorpion while shooting your video, did you? I'm a bit worried...)
(Haah... I wish I could send this to AI somehow...)
AI... I wonder how you're doing...
Rubrubrubrub~! This little cutie over here is soooo precious~! Could you tell big sis' your name?
By the way, it seems that the random word generator made a copy of my 3D model. I only discovered this recently, so imagine how surprised I was~!
Jeez~! You should have said that earlier~!!
However, AI is back again. Ayanami is very happy, yes.
That's right! Will you be able to stay this time?
Mmhmm! I will be able to synchronize my memories with my other self in the original world, so we're the same person. There's no problem with the setting, yup!
As expected of a super intelligent A.I. I... want to know more and more about Kizuna AI's world...
It's because I'm virtual! Anything is possible!
I see, I see! So this is that obligatory "happy ending!"
I'd like to try clicking on the "Like" button.
No matter what it is, you can count on me! I'm an intelligent super A.I. after all~♪
From here on out, I'll continue to be in your care!

sequence: <size=51>As long as you reach out, there will come a day when our hands can connect.</size>
<size=51>The "Singularity" that begins from beyond the boundaries of Pure White...</size>
<size=51>Builds a bond between those that would never meet.</size>
<size=51>That is the reason why I was born into Pure White.</size>
<size=51>To make a promise with those who were born onto a star streaked with lanes of azur...</size>
<size=51>                                                              -- "Synchronicity."</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dorms
Another black screen this time?
That's right! Miss AI, because your random word generator was infected by a virus, you were sucked into our world, and then all kinds of things happened...
In the end, we never figured out where the virus came from...
I suppose that's true, but this isn't the first time I've encountered viruses. So why this time...
But, so many things happened all at once, it's hard to deny the possibility that there might be some greater conspiracy at play.
Maybe there's a "genius hacker" somewhere out there who sent AI a virus in order to conquer the world!
Conquer the world?! I mean, is it really possible to do something like that no matter how much you manipulate me? No way, no way, that's impossible!
Well, if you turn into that titan again, it feels like anything is possible...
Ahaha! You have a point. If you get THAT big, maybe you can conquer the world!
Jeez~! Everyone's poking fun at me now~! Being that size comes with all kinds of problems!
Haha, I suppose it's quite a liability to be unable to function at full capacity without an enormous power supply.
If we get to the bottom of this, I'll bet you that the Sirens caused all this! Just kidding... there's no way that the script writers would blame them for every little thing! Ahaha... ha... ha!
Even though we do usually say "the Sirens caused all this..."
Um... surely not this time, right? Zed?
R-right... Even the Sirens wouldn't do something this pointless...
Inazuma... can only pray that there is some literary integrity out there...
I see, I see! So that's what they mean by "ignorance is bliss!" Oh, is that also what they mean by "no harm, no foul?!"
The truth behind all this... is something God only knows.
Ayanami here. We were able to enter the Virtual Mirror Sea without issues.
It's similar to the Mirror Seas we've encountered before, but...
There are a lot of things I've never seen before! Is this one of those "virus" or "bug" things?
Huuh... I didn't see these in the patch notes. I guess it really must be a bug after all...
I have no idea what's happening, but let's all stay alert! Let's proceed carefully!
Hey hey, everyone, come take a look at this~
Tada! I've just installed this "Prototype Ship Rigging Construction Module" that Akashi-chan made for me! Now, I'll be able to fight alongside all of you~!
Oooohh, I was just about to ask how you were able to keep up with us. So this is the reason, huh? It doesn't stick out at all - I didn't even notice it!
She's been with us the whole time, Javelin... airhead...
It seems like she has destroyer-type equipment, just like us. The mobility is well-suited for recon missions.
Mmhmm! Every time I saw all of you on the game screen, I'd dream about how much I wanted to try gliding across the ocean myself. I never thought that dream would come true!
It's amazing how quickly you were able to pick up on how to use the ship rigging! Is this because of your "Super AI" abilities?
Heh heh! There's nothing that a Super AI cannot do, as long as you install the plug-in for it! If you're having trouble with anything, just let me know!
"Plug-in...?" I don't quite get, but I'm glad you're confident in yourself. As expected of a Super AI.
(I-I didn't think I'd get praised this much...! It feels... super good?!)
Come to think of it, Miss AI, when we found you, you seemed to be drowning but your clothes didn't even get wet. What's the reason behind that?
Good question! Because I'm an AI, my clothes are basically like holograms so they won't get wet or dirty. However, I sometimes will add them as special effects for my videos.
Well, since holograms are just data, I'm basically naked right now if you think about it~
*gasp*! Is Azur Lane going to get banned in several different countries because of what I just said? I'm so sorry... forget you heard anything!!
Ah, th-that's right! I actually have a variety of different outfits! Since I don't get to use them very often, I'll let you see my cute wardrobe!
Trans--form!
Huh? I can't change my skin? What's going on??
Is it possible... that some data was taken away when we entered the Mirror Sea?
No way...!? What should I do? I really liked those outfits too~!
We might be able to recover the lost data by exploring around. Let's see what we can do.
Th-that's right! As long as we work hard, we'll be sure to find it!? Cheer up, AI-chan!
Laffey... will also do her best...
Yes, you're right! Okay, let's do it~!
BA-DOOSH!!
Woooahhhhhhh! Just when I was starting to get my motivation back, this happens?!
Enemy attack from 6 o'clock!
I see, I see! So this is what you'd call a "tutorial boss!"
Stop right there! I've finally found you!
We've destroyed all your escort ships. It's seven against one - there's no way for you to win.
You can't get out of this one, even if you could turn things into bombs! Ready to give up?
This is... Miss AI? Everything is spinning around in front of me... I can't get a good aim!
Ai-chan! What are you doing?! You're not putting up a fair fight~!
Hold up! It's clearly the fake that's doing that!
At this rate... we're not going to be able to fight it!
It's hacking... so our vision is getting messed up...?
Calm down, everyone! There has to be some way around this!
You have some nerves to try to hack into me! Allow this intelligent super A.I. to teach you a thing or two about hacking! We're gonna turn things around~! Have a taste of my mad gaming skills!
I see, I see! So this is what it's like to practice combos on a copy of yourself in training mode!
Ahem! That's that! A clean finish to put an end to the hacking!
Phew, we managed to defeat it while the hacking was interrupted! I was worried for a second there~!
Looks like there’s nothing to worry about now!
I’m so glad nobody got hurt~!
But... hmm, it’s a bit weird watching yourself get beat up after all.
Don’t worry, you’ll get used to it. I couldn’t get over it either for the longest time.
When we defeated the clone, I saw some glowing light thing get absorbed into Kizuna AI. Is that... data?
That’s right, the clone was giving off a lot of light. AI, how do you feel? Is there any difference?
Ah! Is this maybe some kind of power rushing through me?! I feel like I’m transforming...!
Everyone, look closely~ Traaaans... form~!
I did it! I managed to change my outfit! It’s all thanks to your help, everyone!
Yay! Amazing! You look more mature and adult than usual!
In addition to your appearance, your speech seems more mature as well, Miss AI.
I’m relieved, yes. It would have been nice if the random word generator was fixed as well...
MENACING...!
Huh? Look at that, everyone! Another Virtual Mirror Sea is opening up over there!
Here we go again...
By the looks of things, we’ll need to investigate over there as well. Let’s refuel first, then head out at once!
*hums* Hehe~♪ All right, everyone! Full speed ahead~!
So this is the next Virtual Sea Area... it’s a bit noisier than the last one.
This sound is... a concert...? Is that San Diego...?
Why is someone putting on a concert here...?!
KABOOOM!!!
They're all coming at us at once...!
I see, I see! So this is what "rushing B" looks like!
We have no choice but to defeat the fake Kizuna AI and then keep searching.
Got it! With the way I am now, taking out the enemies will be a piece of cake!
I’ll start things off by taking care of my clone~! Take this!
Ah...! Miss AI, stop! Don’t charge in by yourself!
KABOOOM!!!
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!
SOME~ONE~! SAAAVE MEEEEE——!!!
I see, I see, so this is what we call a “death flag architect!” Impressive!
Setting off all those flags by herself, how admirable.
Kizuna AI is an expert flagsweeper...
Does Commander like the scatterbrained type...?
Stop standing there gawking at her, we need to go help out!!
Ugh... but from here, it’s hard to tell which is the real one...
Let go of AI! Ikazuchi, we’re going!
Ready when you are, Inazuma! Taaaake this!
“Secret Technique: Raiden Overload!”
KABOOOM!!
We did it! We managed to free AI from the grasp of that clone!
Kizuna AI, are you all right? Did you get hurt...?
Waaaahh... Th-thanks... Urghhh...
Jeez, AI, you have to stand on... your own!
Waaah... Sho... sorry...
There, there. Good girl, good girl~
You're through! Take this!
KABOOM---!
We did it! We've mopped up this area!
I see, I see! This must mean we've opened the path to the midboss!
We've finally found you. Now all that's left is to clear the boss.
At this rate, we'll be out of here in no time. I might even be able to solo this boss?
Kizuna AI, be careful not to end up like before. After all, it's dangerous to go out alone.
I-I won't do anything reckless like last time! I won't make the same mistake twice!
...But it's probably ideal that we do this as a team. Everyone, let's go!

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>1 The Collapse of Paperwork Mountain</size>

scripts.say: Ägir and I are in my office, organizing the files we need for today's work.
I put the organized files over here.
...Uh, don't you think there's a little too much work piled up for today?
She complains, furrowing her brow at the growing pile of files.
Exercise reports, meeting materials, storage manifests, and more have combined into a pile that's about as tall as me.
Nothing we can do about it. That's Monday for you...
Though even I didn't expect there would be this much.
Pitiful... Fine. I'll just have to help you out, Commander.
Be grateful and worship me. Heheheh♪
Ägir flips her hair back, gracefully returns to her seat, and resumes her work.
Despite some early issues, she's taken to her secretary work. She does a great job now.
(Likewise today. If she weren't here, it would take me until tomorrow to clean up this mountain of documents...)
I look back at the pile of documents and hardcover folders again.
(Welp... Better pick up the pace a little bit.)
Nighttime comes in seemingly no time, yet the desk is still covered in documents to be worked on.
(No shot of going home without overtime at this point. Just like every other day...)
(But Ägir isn't used to this.)
I stretch and yawn, not noticing her eyes are fixed on me.
She must be exhausted from the full day of mental work.
Thanks for your help today. I'll do the rest myself, so you go home and get some rest.
Is that supposed to be a joke? It isn't funny.
The girl in front of me raises her eyebrows and glares at me, with all the intimidation at the disposal of a god of the sea.
Do you think I could go home and relax knowing you're here dealing with this? Hmph. I'll make us coffee. Keep to your work.
(Aww. I wish she'd just accept the gesture.)
I surrender and accept her overtime request.
However, as soon as she tries to get up to brew said coffee, there's a problem.
As Ägir rises from her seat, her horn hits the pile of files...
And then, the mountain starts to collapse!
(Oh, no! It's gonna fall all over her!)
My body moves before my brain does. I seize her arm and yank her out of the way.
The pile falls apart, scattering documents all over the floor. That means we'll have to start reorganizing from the very beginning...
But at least Ägir isn't hurt.
Are you okay?
I think I've managed to pull her to safety, but just in case, I decide to ask.
Huh...?
Ägir looks confused in my arms. It's as if she doesn't quite understand what just happened.
After all, she's basically nuzzling my chest from the momentum of my pulling her close.
Her chest rises and falls with her heavy breathing, and her skin flushes red in the blink of an eye.
Commander... Y-you...!
Her confusion doesn't last long. She breaks free from my arms and lunges behind the couch.
(Is she embarrassed, or...? Wait, now isn't the time to be thinking about that.)
I stoop down and start picking up the scattered documents to give her some space.
After a while, having apparently recovered from her embarrassment, Ägir quietly watches as I pick up the files.
Unfortunately, it's such a mess that it's impossible to figure out which documents come from which files.
Don't worry. As long as you're okay, that's what matters... For now, let's just get all these documents back together.
I'll do it. This is enough for me to handle alone.
What about you? Aren't you exhausted? You work too much, so too bad, I'll just have to help.
She tries her hardest to act composed and tease me.
So YOU rest. The rest is my responsibility.
After that blunt statement, she forcefully chases me off to the couch for a nap.
And then, she starts picking up the documents all over the floor.
(Ägir really feels a sense of responsibility for this...)

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>2 Round Two</size>

scripts.say: Now, Ägir might've chased me off, but that doesn't mean I can just watch her do all the work.
(Forget this. I'm picking up those files first, no matter what she says.)
Five minutes later...
(Man... Five whole minutes just to get the documents back on my desk.)
(Ägir wants to do all of this alone? No way... I need to convince her to let me help.)
Now, leave the rest to me.
Reorganizing this mountain looks like quite the challenge. Heh... Prepare to witness my power!
While I think of a way to help her without her noticing, there's a sudden knock at the door.
(Oh, yeah! Yesterday, Peter Strasser said she'd come and deliver an exercise report today.)
(Surely she can help us!)
I sit up straight on the couch and yell to Peter that she can come in.
The moment she hands me the report, I shoot a glance at Ägir and point in her direction.
Peter's confused for a moment, but when she sees the ruler of the sea focused on organizing files, she quickly understands.
...Yep, that's the whole report. Sign here if you don't see any problems.
Also... Ägir, I know a more efficient way to sort those. Want some advice?
Peter smoothly changes the subject to Ägir's work.
Very well. Teach me this mystical method of yours!
...But no help allowed.
Of course, this is your job. I'm busy, though, so let's get to it.
Thanks to Peter Strasser's lecture, Ägir's organizing work approaches its end after just one short hour of valiant battle.
While Ägir's efforts reach their climax, Peter informs me that she needs to talk in private, so we step out of my office.
Heehee. You seemed like you had something to say before.
I asked you out here to find out what that was. If you need to say something, go on and say it. My scheduled reporting time is coming to an end.
You've got a keen intuition, Peter. It's about Ägir...
Oh, is that all? You want to build a better relationship with her? To me, it seems like you two are getting along just fine.
If that still isn't enough for you, then why not give her a nice little present?
A present... Like jewelry, or something?
Exactly. I'm sure you can come up with a good gift like it's nothing.
Wow, though. Coming to me about this... Heehee♪
Hmm?
Oh, nothing. Good luck to you, Commander.
With that, Peter leaves.
(Okay... Time to get back to helping Ägir.)

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>3 A Quiet Moment</size>

scripts.say: After Peter Strasser's exit, I go back into the office.
Thanks to Ägir's help sorting the files, work that could've taken all night to do has been finished as early as midnight.
I look at the desk she's working at.
She's sitting with her head in her hands, plumb tired.
What's wrong, Commander? Got something to say? You may speak.
Noticing my eyes on her, she returns to her usual imperious demeanor.
If I didn't have you here, today would've been a lot more difficult.
I'm really happy you were here with me.
Wha...?! Ahem! If you think so, then perhaps you should provide an offering to the lord of the abyss?
If you won't, then I expect some other means of recompense.
An offering, huh... Let me think about it.

options.content: How about we go out to eat together?

scripts.say: I know a nice restaurant here at port. Let's go on our next day off.
Heehee... One meal is far from enough to sate my hunger...
But if that is your heartfelt offering, then I'll accept.
Next time we're off, how about we splurge a little?
Ooh, shopping? Do you plan to buy me something? But what I want is...
Commander, you'd better prepare yourself. Heehee♪
I see you trying to be alone with me on our day off.
The very definition of a date... Was this your plan from the start?
Yeah. It's a date.
G-gah...! How direct! W-wait, are you serious?!
Her bravado disappears in an instant. She's totally shaken by my response.
When have I not been serious?
N-no fair! You don't play fair, Commander!
After that, we make arrangements to go out together, and another hard day of work comes to an end.

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>4 Shrinking the Distance</size>

scripts.say: As usual, Ägir and I are hard at work in my office today.
As I watch her immerse herself in work, Peter's advice from the other day flashes through my mind.
(A little present, huh...)
Commander?
(Jewelry that matches her vibe, but isn't too overstated, sounds nice...)
Commander? Bold of you to let your mind wander when you're faced with me.
While I'm thinking of the perfect gift, Ägir has sidled over to my side without my noticing.
I don't come to my senses until her silver hair grazes my cheek.
What in the world could you be thinking about? It's rare for you to be so distracted from signing documents.

options.content: I was thinking about you, actually.
Just thinking about what I have to do after this.

scripts.say: Just... thinking about the date, y'know.
B-but it's a mere date. Are you that excited about it?!
I just don't want to burden you too much. Rely on me a little more, okay?
Wh-what's gotten into you?! Shouldn't YOU be the one to rely on ME?! Do not underestimate a god, mortal!
After shouting at me, she looks down to hide her rapidly blushing cheeks.
Ahem... About that date we planned, I've changed my mind a little.
She looks back up and gazes into my eyes. Her tone is a little stilted.
Oh? You don't want to go on a date with me anymore?
That's not it! I just want to change the time and location a little.
For example... today! I say we finish up work and then go for a walk on the beach together!
So if you don't finish your work right away, you'll answer to the wrath of raging seas!
Well, I can hardly refuse a demand from the lord of the sea.
Thanks to Ägir's perfect sorting work, we finish today's work nice and fast.
Now, shall we go? It's the perfect time to feel the sea breeze, and the sun won't burn us this late in the day.
Phew... Yeah, good idea.
With my coat in hand, I follow her out of my office.

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>5 The Sea God's Invitation</size>

scripts.say: After leaving my office, we head to the beach.
Ägir walks just a bit faster than me. She relaxes in the soft sand and the gentle sea breeze.
Her serene figure brings a smile to my face.
What now? Is something funny to you?
She whips around and takes me by surprise.
Just watching you, I couldn't help myself.
Is that so? Dare I presume that you were taken by the sight of me?
Yeah, I sure was.
Wha...?! Now you're just trying to be rude by being so direct!
She immediately turns away in a futile attempt to hide how flustered she is.
(Now, at this point...)
I jog to catch up with her and align my footsteps with hers.
Ägir's unnaturally silent, but eventually, she reaches her hand over and intertwines her fingers with mine.
Her soft, slender fingers cling tight, showing her unwillingness to let me go.
Heheh. Be careful now, Commander. You wouldn't want to be engulfed by the violent waters.
Even if I was, you'd come and save me, wouldn't you?
Hmph...! If you beg for help, maybe!
She tightens her grip on my hand even further.
Thus, the two of us enjoy our walk together, touched by the sea breeze.

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>6 Prelude to Party</size>

scripts.say: Ever since our beach date, Ägir started coming to my office before work hours every time she got the chance.
(She calls it a favor for a friend, but...)
I think about it along the way to my office.
(Is she still not here yet? Hmm... There's something on my desk.)
There's a folded card on the table with my name on it.
As for the contents...
(A party held by the Northern Parliament and Iron Blood... tonight?)
(Is this an invitation? I'll have to ask Ägir later.)
Before long, Ägir comes back to the office.
Commander, have you already read the invitation I left for you?
I was just about to ask you about that, actually.
Yes, I was the one who left it there. I also left the office because I was off making arrangements, as well.
But don't worry. There's no dress code. It's a simple, casual get-together.
I've seen with my own two eyes how you've been exhausting yourself of late. It's about time you kick back and relax for once.
But let's be serious for a moment. You never had the right to refuse a god such as myself, did you?
Alright. I'll avail myself of your kind offer.
I accept her invitation, and we resume our work.
Thus begins the start of another busy day.
After the day's work is done, Ägir leaves early in order to prepare for the party. She is the host, after all.
I already told her that I'd catch up with her later.
Finally, a free moment to myself. Time to pick a present and get it for her.
In the port shopping area, the jewelry shop is chock full of dazzling and eye-catching goods.
I scour the entire store, not missing a single display.
Just then, an elaborate amber necklace catches my eye.
That charming golden stone encased in resin, the sparkle of it – they remind me of her enchanting eyes.
That's it. I'm picking this one!

sequence:
Lord of Raging Seas

<size=45>7 Divinity of Raging Seas</size>

scripts.say: When I arrive, the party is already booming with activity.
I pass by drinking friends and find Ägir on the second-floor terrace.
She drinks the amber liquid in her cup all at once and looks over at me with pure composure.
Commander, it's not nice to make a girl wait.
Sorry.
A god, waiting for one single human... Do you think you can afford to make up for this affront?
While she teases me, she gets closer and rests her chin on my shoulder.
I feel her hot breath on my ear as she wraps an arm around my waist.
The people downstairs know nothing about what's going on. Before they can find out, I reach into my pocket and hold the package inside.
Actually... I have a gift I'd like to give you...
Oh? So you are ready to pay the price. Go on. Show me what you've got.
I take out the box, open the lid, and show her the amber necklace within.
It's not to make up for making you wait, though. It's just a gift.
I had trouble finding out what to give you, but I thought this would suit you.
Wait a second... This isn't what you were whispering about with Peter, is it?
Huh? You figured me out that easily?
Of course I did!
That's not the only reason! Lately, you've constantly had your mind elsewhere. You keep looking at me and smiling, too. This is why, isn't it?
I do know I've been distracted, but did I really smile that much?
That's not what matters! You... You've been after this from the very start!
Wait... Oh. Do you mean back during our date?
She doesn't answer. Instead, she just glares at me angrily.
No, I didn't accept just for the sake of this. I only told the truth back on the beach.
I just like you a lot, that's all.
Y-you little...!
Ägir blushes madly, grabs the closest lemon water she can find, and gulps it all down at once.
It takes a while after that for her to finally calm down.
If you mean that... then hurry up and put it on me.
The proud lord of the sea lowers her head for me.
Surely you don't mean to make me do it myself. Don't make me wait any longer.
I take the necklace and gently put it around her neck.
The stylish gold matches her reds and blacks, drawing out her gold eyes even more and adding a touch of charm to her.
Hey... Commander.
She wraps her arm back around my waist, holds me tight, and pulls me close to her.
This time, we're pushed up so close together that we can feel each other's breathing.
You're going to pay a high price for shackling me, Commander.
In fact... Don't even dream of getting away before sunrise... Heehee♥

sequence:
"Virtual Connection Synchronicity" - Purification

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Random Word Generator</size>

scripts.say: What are you doing, AI?
Ah! Ayanami. I was just trying to get rid of these viruses in my random word generator.
AI, you know how to do stuff like that!?
She's an Intelligent Super A.I.
Ahem! Yes... but it's kind of hard to do on my own. Can you guys help out?
Hmm. Virus removal is kind of hard, isn't it?
I just treat it like a fun game.
So I go like this or?
Right! You put this here annnd... bam!
Thanks! That's one virus down. We'll wipe 'em out like this!
What's this...? Some kind of random word generator?
Oooh! We got some Kizuna Points! I'm sure you're familiar with the concept by now: you use these to get event limited items! ♪

options.content: Yeah! Let's go get those rewards!
How is it you know about points?

scripts.say: Let's see... what should I get? How about a little "Pyoko-Pyoko" something something...
I like the look of those "Mental Units."
I want some gold equipment boxes, and not the repainted ones!!
Nice! Let's keep knocking out those viruses and earn those Kizuna Points! ♪
Simple! I was a commander myself back where I'm from! A survivor of countless hard-fought battles!
Wow! So you were just like our Commander!?
Miss AI's true form is that of the Commander... I never would have guessed.
Anyway, now that we know how important these Kizuna Points are, let's make sure we collect tons of 'em! ♪
*shutter click*
Who's taking pictures!?
Hi there! You're that Genius Super A.I. from the virtual world, right? Kizuna AI? I'm Gridley!
Genius!? Y- yeah! That's me!!
I'm that Intelligent Super A.I. everybody's talking about. Me. Kizuna AI. Nice to meet you.
I see you're out taking photos, Miss Gridley, were you not given a mission today?
Actually, Laffey asked for my help recording and preserving our time with Kizuna AI. I'm hunting for the perfect shot!
Oh? Laffey-chan asked you!?
Gridley... is the worst spy...
Sorry! My bad! I tried to keep it a secret, but she is a Super A.I., you know!?
Hah hah hah! It's true. No one can hide from my sight.
Hehehe! And I always aim for the perfect shot, so it's no big deal.
Well, just make sure I look cute and we won't have a problem.
You got it!

sequence:
"Virtual Connection Synchronicity" - Purification

<size=45>Chapter 2 - The Fine Line Between Moron and Genius</size>

scripts.say: Yo, Commander! It's a new day and let's keep at the virus cleaning. Yeah! Woo! Alright!

options.content: Uhh... I have a lot to do today actually...

scripts.say: You're getting into it! I like that. Let's get started!
Huhhh? But I thought you almost finished your work for the day~? *glares*
Am I a joke to you? I know your whole schedule, Commander!
Just chill. Today's viruses ain't nothin', a walk in the damned park, easiest viruses of your life, hands down. Just knock 'em out and then we'll kick back!
One Hour Later
*Pant*... *pant...* but... how... why.... this was just level 2... how were they... so... tough... *collapse*
Perhaps as a consequence of her drive and intensity, Kizuna AI fell into despair.
Ughhh! I'm so ti~red~! It doesn't make any sense! I'm trying so hard!
This virus cleaning mission, it looked so easy at first, but proved impossibly hard. Could this really be a level 2 difficulty job...?
Heyooo! Is that Boss Lady Kizuna AI!? What are you doing? You can't take a nap here, you'll catch a cold. Don't you know anything?
Oh, San Diego. I'm not napping. I was trying to clean viruses, but I totally failed...
O~kay? Cleaning buy-rests...? Sounds hella fun~!
Huh? Hell yeah! I'm gonna try really hard!!!
Commander! What's wrong!?
The Commander.... did a really good job...
All right, you just rest there for a bit~ I've got this one in the bag~!
But are you gonna be okay? This one is crazy hard!
Uh huh! No clue if I can do it or not, but I'm gonna try!
Is it really okay to rely on San Diego like this...?
35 Seconds Later
Uhhh... so like I do this? And then that one I just... Oh. Now this one's gone too?
San Diego!? Is thi- did you actually clear the viruses!!??
But... how... did she.......?
Wha? It's all over? But I'm not done playing~!!
And so, by pointing randomly at things she did not understand, San Diego completely eliminated the viruses.
Don't ask me. Even I don't understand how it works....
Thank you so much, San Diego!! You're incredible! You're a genius, San Diego!
You knocked it out so fast! Can we have San Diego handle all the virus removal from now on!?
Sure! Just leave it all to San Diego~!
Can San Diego really handle all of that by herself....?

sequence:
"Virtual Connection Synchronicity" - Purification

<size=45>Chapter 3 -  Red Alert!?</size>

scripts.say: Virus removal complete! You've really gotten the hang of this, Commander!
Hey, what's that coming out of the random word generator?
Oooh? Th- this is...! A "random word!!!"

options.content: And what exactly is it for?

scripts.say: Excellent question! As the name suggests, this is a handy little box for generating random words!
That's what it's supposed to be anyway, but it's somehow built connections and converted matter into data, crystallizing into a super technology!
Incidentally, I made this.
Like... why would you want to generate random words though?
Er... yeah... like... for example...
Terrible. Even though it's our day off, we've been ordered to clean up flotsam and jetsam around the port.
Wow! That sounds really urgent...
Hey! Why don't I show you what the random word generator can do by using it to solve this little predicament!
Oh I know! This is what they call "pulling it out of your ass," right?
We can use the words generated by the random word generator to plan and name a crisis management sys-
"AI-CHAN, RED ALERT!"
All right, let's see what we've got. Heeere it comes.....! "Ramune"! You're a hungry fella today, huh?
Seems pretty useless actually. Okay, Ikazuchi-chan, let's see what you pull!
'kay! Drum roll, please...... "Oxy-Cola?" Is it only food in there? Inazuma, you're up!
Right. What is it... hmm.... "Manjuu" is it? At least it's a little more helpful than the food words?
Okay but what's the point of Manjuu and "Ramune" and Oxy-Cola together, how do they help?
Oh I know! This is what they call "the dark souls of video games!" There's no way I can figure this out!
"Ramune," "Oxy-Cola," "Manjuu".... Eureka!
First, let's put the "Ramune" into the Oxy-Cola and cover it. Then have one of those boats bring us a Manjuu.
Oh I know! I've heard that if you put "Ramune" in "Oxy-Cola" and seal it up, it'll explode!
Then, if we take all that Ramune-filled "Oxy-Cola" and load it into a boat piloted by a Manjuu...
<size=97.5>KABOOM!</size>
Disaster averted~!
...just a moment. While this "Cola Bomb" does indeed sound spectacular, does it truly have the power to annihilate the flotsam and jetsam...?
That's right... and we shouldn't bully the Manjuu! NO BULLYING!
Urk. You're not wrong.... all right then!
Okay, let's give the ramune and the Oxy-Cola to the Manjuu and gather up all the girls we can!
I suppose there was no other way this could have ended...
Thanks for your help, everybody! Let's all work together to get this done! LET'S GOOOOO!

sequence:
"Virtual Connection Synchronicity" - Purification

<size=45>Chapter 4 -  Until We Meet Again</size>

scripts.say: Aaannnnd... done! There we go! We eliminated all the viruses!
Nya! I looked into it and I found an internal connyection between Kizuna AI and the random word genyerator nya!
Seems only Kizuna AI can pass through it? Hrmmm... I'm so curious about that other world!
I suppose this means AI can finally go home now. The time really flew right by, but it was fun.
Please have a safe trip home, AI. And I swear I'll never forget you as long as I live!
I'm expecting you to frag out in those games of yours.
Good luck with your "tubing" and "streaming!"
Do make sure to visit us in your world from time to time.
Yeah! I'll never forget you guys!
Oh, right! I'd be so glad if you thought of me while redecorating the dormitory!
This is an... easel? Thank you very much. I will ask the commander to redecorate appropriately.
Thanks.... I could never forget... AI.
Brief though our time together was, I certainly had fun. Your... Kizuna Fleet, was it? We appreciate what you did.
Boss Lady Kizuna AI, I'll put all the things you taught me to good use. Look out for VTuber San Diego because I'm comin' at ya! You keep at it too, boss!
I know we- we're fated to meet again!
Don't worry about a thing. We'll take care of it. Hehehe ♪
While I regret that I cannot see you back to your own world, Lady AI, I look forward to the day we meet again.
Yeah! I'll treasure the memories I made here forever. Take care, everyone! I'll watch over you through the game when I get back to my world!
I'm definitely going to see you all again so I won't say goodbye. I LOVE YOU ALL!!!
"I won't say goodbye..." Yes! You're right! I can't wait to see you again!
--And so, the Intelligent Super AI left a deep impression in the minds of all the denizens of the port.
Carrying on with their hearts bound by the ties left by Kizuna AI, they looked forward to the day they would meet again--

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>1.Easily Distracted</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Oh, man! I so need to get these! Wonder if Akashi sells 'em at her store?
Ooh, they made a sequel to that novel Cooper liked! I'll give it a read then tell her about it!
Although... I don't wanna end up spoiling it for her. Hmm... I guess I'll save it for later...
I tasked Allen M. Sumner, my secretary, with organizing commission paperwork. It seemed she hadn't made much progress.
Right here!
What's up, Commander?
...The work you just assigned me? Oh, right, uhh...
My query caught her off guard. She quickly hid the magazine in her hand behind a pillow on the couch.
Sorry about that! I found that little mag among the docs you gave me, and kinda got sidetracked...
I couldn't blame her for getting distracted now and then, but this was the third time just today.
Enough being lazy, time to sort through the stuff right now! Just gimme a sec!
Whew... Here you go. How'd I do?
(Fingers crossed!)
We only barely finished the work on time, but her concentrated effort was what made it possible.
There was no problem with her performance in and of itself, but having to keep tabs on her like this felt cumbersome.
She may need an incentive to stay focused. I decided to brainstorm some ideas...

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>2.Sticker Star</size>

scripts.say: You serious?! You'll reward me if I do a good job?
Wowzie! You're the best boss ever, Commander! Now I see why everyone likes you!
Wonder what the reward's gonna be! Might just go the extra mile so I can find out~
Whether or not this would help her concentrate remained to be seen, but she definitely sounded more motivated than before.
I decided to take it one step further and give her a concrete goal to work towards.
Say what? You'll even let me choose the reward? You sure about that?
Like, what if I pick something that'll make people start weird rumors about you? Wouldn't want that, would you?
Unless... that IS what you want? Everyone gets their kicks one way or another.
She made a... strangely good point. If she asked for something too bizarre, I would just tell her to pick something else.
Port - Shop
I've decided, Commander! I want this!
Allen picked up a brochure from the counter, showed it to me, and pointed to a piece of furniture on it.
That's right! A three-star luxury massage chair!
It wasn't something I'd expect Allen to want, but if it would help her concentrate on her work, then it was all good.
There's this campaign where if you buy one of these, you get a limited-edition sticker set as a bonus!
I've always wanted this set, but I never had the money for it. Thanks a bunch for finally uniting me with these little beauts!
Now her choice made sense. She has always had a thing for stickers.
On that note, there's actually one more thing I want...
One more thing? That wasn't part of the deal, but I felt curious...
Before you ask, don't worry, it won't cost you anything! It's not something you can just walk into a store and buy!
As for what it is, you'll see soon enough~
All righty, we're done here! Let's head on back and get to work!

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>3.Work Hard, Play Hard</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Wonder what Cooper's doing ri– Wait, I'm supposed to be working. Save it for later, Allen...
Oh, was that a Juustagram notification? Wonder what's trending today. Maybe the commander sent me a mes–
No, Allen! Resist the urge and focus on work! The whole afternoon's gonna pass by in a flash if you check Juustagram!
Two hours to go until the commander's done for the day! Just gotta hang in there!
Allen was engaged in a tug of war with her own impulses.
Ugghh! Been two weeks since my last day off work... I wanna go shoppiiiing... Heck, I'd settle for just an evening of window shopping...
I want more star stickers! I wanna put another on my jacket, my rigging, and on Heinrich...
I had to step in, or else she may have given in to her whims.
Oops, right! I'm supposed to be working!
Just gimme a bit, I'll have that report written in no time!
She resumed work after I reminded her about it.
The incentive of a reward did increase her concentration, but it seemed a good idea to pursue another approach.
...You'll go shopping with me tomorrow? Really?
I mean, I'd work better after a day of taking it easy, but are you sure it's smart for you to tag along?
Y'know. People might get weird ideas and start rumors if they see us together... Actually, I've got an idea!
Mind if some of my friends come with us? Great! This is gonna be awesome!
And so, we decided to meet tomorrow to go shopping with her friends.

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>4.Shopping in the Daylight</size>

scripts.say: A'ight, we'll head down the street and look for the stuff the R&D girls wanted. Leaving the office supplies to you all~
Works for me. Here's the shopping list, folks.
Sweet! Let's meet up here after we're done!
After buying mostly everything on the shopping list, we returned to the meeting spot. Strangely, though...
They're still not back...
Allen and I were the only ones there.
This is awkward... The whole reason I invited 'em was so people wouldn't mistake us for a couple or something. Why'd they bail on us like that?
We gave Bremerton a call. She said the things they bought were really heavy, so she and Stephen Potter went back to port early.
Welp. What do we do now, Commander? Go home?
Allen sounded let down by this turn of events.
I arranged this outing expressly for Allen's sake. It would be a shame to conclude her day of leisure prematurely.
...We can have a look around the stores I wanna check out? Really?!
Oh my gosh, thank you, Commander!
Don't get me wrong, I'm so happy you'd do that with me, but you don't HAVE to go that far just for me, you know...
I didn't have any obligations to tend to on that day, so I decided to spend it together with her.
Well, if you say it's fine, then I'm not gonna argue with that. Let's go!
And with that, our shopping trip continued.

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>5.Dinner in the Sunset</size>

scripts.say: Om nom! Mmm! Thif if deeewifious!
...Oops, did I just talk with my mouth full? Excuse my bad table manners!
As I was saying: this food is *mwah*! Thanks for introducing me to this amazing restaurant, Commander!
After we'd visited all the stores she wanted to check out, I treated Allen to dinner at a restaurant I frequent.
Before we knew it, the day had grown late. The restaurant's fancy interior was basked in the beautiful glow of sunset.
All righty, lemme take a quick look at the shopping list while we wait for our next dish.
Check... Check... Oh right, this one was outta stock, so we'll have to ask Akashi if she can order it for us.
Allen wolfed down the appetizers and decided to spend the time checking off items on the shopping list.
Hey, Commander? There's something I've been meaning to ask you.
Aren't you kinda spoiling me for no real reason? I barely do any work around the office and I don't exactly make your job any easier.
Sure, the promise of a reward made me try a little harder, but I'm not giving you nearly as much as you're giving me...
She hid her face behind the shopping list. It must have been embarrassing for her to say this.
...What I'm trying to say is, it's literally my job as your secretary to help out around the office. Isn't it weird to reward me for just, you know, doing my job?

options.content: "I don't think it's weird at all."

scripts.say: "A commander's job and a shipgirl's job are very different, but I treasure my relationship with all of you."
"You always do your best, Allen. I know you do. It would be weird NOT to reward you for it."
"Although, I suppose it is weird to call it a 'reward,' now that you mention it. Think of it as my way of saying thank you."
Well, I suppose we are good friends, that's definitely true...
That explains it! If that's how it is, then it's about time I started giving it one-hundo percent!
Or at the very least, work as hard as you do, hehe~

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>6.A Surprise Gift</size>

scripts.say: Allen's work ethic underwent a drastic change ever since she said she'd "give it one-hundo percent" at the end of our shopping trip. And indeed, she did.
The documents you handed me? Already done! C'mon, Commander, keep it together.
Look! Left 'em right here~
Remember to do your own work too instead of focusing on making sure I do mine. Just saying.
She didn't need any supervision at all. In fact, the tables had turned. Now I was the one receiving reminders.
On another note, isn't my thank-you present supposed to arrive today?
Boy oh boy, I can't wait to finally have my hands on that sticker set!
Oh yes. She had her eyes on a three-star luxury massage chair. Although...
