There's this campaign where if you buy one of these, you get a limited-edition sticker set as a bonus!
I've always wanted this set, but I never had the money for it. Thanks a bunch for finally uniting me with these little beauts!
What she really wanted was the sticker set that came with it as a bonus.
Thank you for your patronyage~ The Manjuus will have your comfy new chair set up in the office shortly, nya.
Thanks, Akashi! And you too, Commander!
Also, who's going to be using this chair, nya? I'm asking for future reference with regards to warranty service, nya.
It was a gift for Allen, so naturally that's what I was going to say. But Allen was quicker to answer.
The commander, duh! You've gotta work your butt off to be worthy of sitting in a massage chair!
Right, Commander? Hehe~
I thought so, nya! So it's a gift to reward the commander's hard work, nya? How touching, nya.
It's a bit weird that the commander's the one paying for it, but I'm a merchant, not an interrogator, nya. Best to mind my own business, nya.
I was gonna say! Mind your own business!
It seemed, for better or worse, I had played into Allen's hand all along.

sequence:
Three-Star Luxury Romance

<size=45>7.What Allen Wanted</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
We went back to the office. Manjuus came waddling out the door, having finished installing the chair just as we arrived.
As per Allen's recommendation, I immediately gave the chair a try.
So, whaddya think? Pretty comfy, right?
Pretty much the best reward I could've chosen, if I do say so myself~ Once you're done, I wanna take it for a spin too.
Allen stood behind the chair and spoke to me.
Although, this chair's less of a reward and more like me returning your kindness.
It's funny when you think about it. Your reward idea motivated me to take my job more seriously, and because I did, you rewarded me.
I got pretty much all I could want. The stickers, access to this chair, and that thing I talked about before.
That reminded me – she still hadn't told me what that "other thing" she wanted was.

options.content: "What exactly is that last thing you want?"

scripts.say: What? Just told you, I've already got it. Didn't cost you anything, like I said.
Wait, don't tell me...
She flashed a teasing grin, then came around and sat down in my lap.
...You don't get what I mean, do you? You're one dense commander, huh~
Then let me spell it out. You know how your constant reminders helped me stay focused so I could do actual work?
I've kiiinda become dependent on them. I love the attention you give me, because you make me feel wanted and cared about.
That's when I realized what she wanted from me. A few words. I opened my mouth to speak...
Ahaha! Don't say it, Commander, I already know~
She put a small sticker on my mouth using her index finger.
You wanted to thank me because you treasure our relationship, remember? I feel the same!
So you don't have to say or do anything special. Just keep doing what you have all this time~
This is just my own way of saying thanks, Commander.
For everything you do, and for who you are.
Consider that kiss a little bonus for you, just like these stickers were to me~

sequence:
Émile, the Dancing Angel

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Popular Dancer</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dock
My newly appointed secretary, Émile Bertin, and I were waiting on a commission team's return.
The cloudless blue sky, the warm and bright rays of the sun – ah, what a wonderful day~
And on such a wonderful day, it'd be a shame not to go outside and move around~
Émile jumped onto a bollard and did a graceful pirouette.
Really, you ought to get more exercise, Commander! Going outside only to greet returning commission teams is not enough.
Of course, work is important, but sitting too much is bad for the body.
And the work you do, dear me, it seems really tough~ I'm doing the best I can just to keep up!
People who become commanders really are on a whole other level~
Ah, look, there they are!
The commission team all gathered around Émile like it was routine. They had a cheery girls' talk about their commission accomplishments and rewards.
Well done! You didn't have any close calls, did you?
But of course I would worry about your wellbeing! You're my dear friends!
Ah, is this for me? You're too sweet! Merci!
Commander, is something the matter? You seem taken aback.
... Oh, this? We're all part of the same fleet, so shouldn't we try our best to make friends with each other?
Apparently, Émile doesn't realize how popular she really is.

sequence:
Émile, the Dancing Angel

<size=45>Chapter 2 - A Fellowship of Gold?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Edinburgh was in the office, and it seemed like she wanted to meet Émile.
Hey, Émile, I'm here to chat~
Bienvenue, Edinburgh! Sorry, but we'll have to talk later, I've got my hands full with secretary work... Right, Commander?
Knowing you, you could get it done in a minute~ Believe it or not, I'm quite a good judge of character!
Have you two always been this close...?
Don't you know, Commander? We both transported gold during the war!
That's right! She transported more gold than I did, but my gold transport is way more discussion-worthy!
Aw, that determination to never be outdone of yours is so cute♪
Turns out Edinburgh's judgment was right; Émile finished her secretary work in a flash.
You're so talented, Émile... It reminds me of a pesky maid I know...
You mean Belfast? Good heavens, no~ I don't hold a candle to her.
Speaking of Belfast, I somehow get the impression that she's your big sister...
She's my LITTLE sister! I can't believe even YOU'RE saying that now!
And I don't expect you to understand the complicated feeling that is having a little sister who's so good at everything!
I'll admit that's true. But I think you have a more colorful character than her.
Not sure if I should take that as a compliment...
On another topic: have you heard of the Land of Gold, Edinburgh?
I read about it in a travel journal once. It said the Sakura Empire is a kingdom enveloped in gold! Fascinating, isn't it? Don't you want to see it in person?
We could just ask our Sakura Empire fleetmates about it...
Still, the land of the Sakura Empire certainly is a mystical place... I suppose I want to visit it someday.

Okay, then let's ask the Commander to assign us on the team next time there's a mission in the Sakura Empire's territory! Oh, just hearing the rumors about the Sakura Empire, the Land of Gold, makes me giddy!
Definitely! The idea of it is pretty exciting!
Seems their fellowship of gold will continue for quite some time.

sequence:
Émile, the Dancing Angel

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Hidden Talent</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Commander, I need to borrow Émile from you again, nya!
... For the third time this week? Really?

options.content: Ask Akashi what she needs her for

scripts.say: My sales for this month have miraculously increased thanks to Émile helping out at my shop, nya!
Huh? How is that thanks to me?
Because you're a nice person, nya! You're an angel, nya! You're always helping everybody out, nya!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Émile's Romance Theory Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Èmile and I were having a chat.
... And because we focus on the details, we can see the beauty of everyday things. A true romanticist values even the smallest of life's beautiful things, wouldn't you agree?
To me, life's small beauties are the things that make a subtle difference. In other words, no matter how small they are, you should be able to find them if you look for them.

The chirping of birds resting on the windowsill; the small flowers growing on the wayside. Once you calm your mind and scan your surroundings, you'll find the world is brimming with those sorts of things.
Émile closed her eyes and gestured like she was hugging something.
The same goes for people. No two people will have the exact same personality. They may have very much in common, but they will undoubtedly differ in some ways.
When you make new acquaintances, it's important to discover what characteristics and traits they have and which set them apart from others.
To find out a person's unique merits, the ones you've never seen before – that's just so wonderfully romantic, you know?
All I need to get through times of great sorrow and pain is remembering that there are still many, many beautiful things I've yet to see.
I want to see those things, I want to experience them, and I want to cherish them with all my heart.
Émile suddenly turned around and faced me, looking a little embarrassed.
Aha... That might've sounded a little pretentious. You may disregard what I just said.
Then Émile made a proposition to me:
I know! How about a date, Commander?
Romance is more easily understood through first-hand experience than through another person's description of it, you know?
Besides, wouldn't you like to have a date with me? *Giggle*
Èmile convinced me to go on a date with her... Which I guess isn't so bad?

How to share my happiness with others in joyous and fortunate times through my dancing...

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Émile's Romance Theory Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: Romance shouldn't be an act for the public to see, I believe it should be a feeling you convey to your partner.

Whether you're quietly admiring my dancing, letting me do the things I want to, or enjoying dessert with me...
Émile smiled and grabbed hold of my hand with both of hers.

When your actions are with your partner in mind and you're doing what they want, your feelings will unquestionably reach them.
... I am so happy that I met a romantic who's just like that.
I am so happy that I met you, Commander.

That feeling you get when you understand your partner, make them happy, and know what it is you want to tell them...

... Will you dance with me, Commander?

<size=45>Chapter 4: Essex Versus Enterprise</size>

scripts.say: Training Area
This is the last round! Congratulations for making it through all the competition. I'd expect nothing less from you.
I would congratulate you too, but you don't seem to have broken a sweat.
I'm not like the others though. I'm about to show you what I'm made of, so don't take me lightly!
Don't worry, I always give it my all. Come!
<size=45>Haaaaaah!!</size>
Woah... things are getting intense~
It's nice to see them go all out every now and then, hehe.
How's this!
Not bad! But you've still got a long way to go!
I've already seen through your attacks! Now it's my turn!
That's enough!
Woah, is this a double K.O.?
So it's a draw, huh... I'm not sure how I feel about this result...
But, your strength is undeniable, heh. Essex, you've really grown a lot.
Essex? What's the matter?
(mutters) This... isn't the result I wanted...
Sorry, I'm a bit worn out... I'm going to head back to rest first.
Essex seemed to be acting strangely.

sequence:
Enterprise Troubles

<size=45>Chapter 5: Knots of the Heart, Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Ever since the training exercise, Essex hadn't quite been herself.
Perhaps it was time to do something about this...
Huh? You'd like to take me somewhere to thank me for my service?
I'm just doing my job as secretary... there's no need to go out of the way to thank me...
F-fine, since you're being so insistent...
On our next day off, I took Essex into town not far from the port.
This doesn't feel much different from our usual patrols, just in a different location.
Ah, surely you have some specific instructions in mind?
How I feel about Enterprise...
Well, she's the legendary hero of the Eagle Union, after all. Everyone admires and respects her, and she's my role model.
Even though everyone has always had high expectations for the Essex-class, our specifications are just numbers compared to Enterprise's countless battles.
That's why I've always wanted to beat her - to prove my own worth and finally gain recognition.
Though I managed to fight her to a draw during the mock battle, I still feel unsatisfied...
Surely she was holding back because she still saw me as her junior and didn't want to hurt my pride.
I'm not strong enough to earn the recognition of the others, after all...
Mhm, that settles it! I'll just have to train harder when we get back!
Then, one day, I'll pass up Enterprise and earn her - no, everyone's recognition...
You're wrong about that.
E-Enterprise?!

sequence:
Enterprise Troubles

<size=45>Chapter 6: Knots of the Heart, Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: When you have these kinds of thoughts, you've already let your doubts get the better of you.
W-why are you here, Enterprise?
Commander... is this your doing?!
Indeed. Commander was concerned about the way you were behaving, so we came together.
Ugh...
Whether in practice or in live combat, I always give it my all. That is a basic courtesy owed to all opponents.
Enterprise...
Your growth has been evident to all of us. You could say that the result of the mock battle was within expectations.
B-but...!
Let me pose you a question. Are you planning to renounce all the hard work you put in by telling yourself that I didn't try my hardest?
Will your burning desire to beat me be quelled with this single draw?
Of course not!
I already know. Remember, true strength does not come from the recognition of others, nor is it a marker on the side of the road for you to pass. True strength is in its pursuit, for your own sake.
For my own sake...
Essex, I consider you one of my esteemed mentees, as well as one of my few rivals.
But the person you must overcome is not me, or anyone else. Rather, it is yourself.
Have more confidence in yourself. You still have a lot of untapped potential within you.
Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
Commander...
I understand now. Thank you again, Enterprise. Without your guidance, I surely would have continued to lose myself.
Commander, thank you as well.
However, I still haven't given up on my goal of beating you, Enterprise!
"I'm not gonna lose to you again!" ... and I'll prove it before that lucky crane does!
Heh. I'll be looking forward to that day.
Essex's smile seemed gentler than usual. The knot in her heart seemed to finally be dissolving.

sequence:
Enterprise Troubles

<size=45>Chapter 7: When We're Together</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Commander, I've already confirmed the furniture purchase order. All I need now is your seal of approval.
The research lab's expenses have been compiled? I'd like to check it against the list we have here, but...
Although managing a fleet is quite complicated, many tasks have become much simpler thanks to Essex's assistance.
All right! We're in a great condition today!
... Ah, someone's at the door! Come on in, it's unlocked!
Pardon me.
Enterprise! Do you need anything?
Can you show me yesterday's commission logs? There's something I wanted to confirm.
Give me just a moment. Commander, the log should be in that stack by your hand.
Appreciate it.
Essex, you seem to have changed. Your synergy with Commander has improved as well.
Anyway, I'll be heading out now.
I've changed...?
It's probably because of how much time I've spent with you, Commander. Since becoming secretary, I've learned a lot of things not just about myself, but also about how to deal with others.

options.content: I feel the same way about you.

scripts.say: Um, does that include, um...
Our relationship...
Actually, Commander...
Sorry, I actually left something in here...
...!! (blushes profusely)
Essex's expression was a strange mix of embarrassment and anger. Enterprise, who was in the process of pushing open the door, awkwardly stopped mid-way.
Ah, um... I'm very sorry for the intrusion. I'll see you two later.
Well, I guess stuff like this is bound to happen when we're together.

sequence:
Air Raid Drills With Essex

<size=45>1: Special Exercises, Commence!</size>

scripts.say: Our special exercise this time has two objectives: First, to respond to an aerial attack from enemy carriers, and second, to immediately launch a counterattack against an enemy carrier.
At the same time, we will take this opportunity to display the strength of the Eagle Union's Air Force.

Participants will be roughly distributed into one of two groups. The blue group is the "enemy" that will be launching aerial attacks. The red group is a mixed squad that will aim to neutralize the enemy's air power.
Um, in other words, some of us have to play the bad guys?
Precisely.
So, have you roughly decided who's going to be in which group?
The commander was supposed to be in charge of putting together the red group, but...
I was told to designate the leader of the red group instead. Independence, are you up for the task?
Me? Are you sure you want someone who was just assigned to this fleet...?
That's all the more reason. Don't you think it's a good idea to get to know everyone in the fleet?
I see... Understood. I'll give it my all.
(This drill is my chance to show everyone what I'm made of...!)
Now, as for the blue group... Based upon the difficulty of prolonged combat as well as strength of the enemy, I'll be the most suitable--
Enterprise, please let me handle this.
I think my ability and combat experience make me well-suited for this role. Plus, I want to see how far I've come as a result of my training.
Essex? But...
Enterprise, I think you should place some faith in your juniors. After all, you shouldn't try to shoulder everything on your own...
That's right, Enty! You've gotta give other people their time under the spotlight too!
...I see. Essex, you'll be in charge of leading the blue group then. I'll explain the key points to be aware of later--
...Show me everything you've got!
Yes ma'am!!
Exercise Area
That makes sense... You were able to get the enemy's position from Enterprise.
Although my original responsibilities were to oversee and record this exercise, Enterprise told me that I could lend you my aid if you needed it. Essex, are you sure you don't want my help?
Sorry, but I'm doing this alone. I need to find out how far I can push myself.
I see... In that case, you should get going.
Thanks for letting me know. In any case... all aircraft, prepare to launch!

sequence:
Air Raid Drills With Essex

<size=45>2: Independence's Battle</size>

scripts.say: Gah... Coordinating a fleet is harder than I expected...
All the planes are operating properly, and I should also be in good shape, but... What's going on...?!
Is there some limit to the commanding and operational abilities of light carriers...?
If I may say something, Independence...
You're the historian... Shangri-La?
Yes. I beg your pardon, but as the observer, I'd like to break the problems that you're currently facing...
While there are no problems with your aircraft, the main line has advanced too far forward and you've gotten separated from the sentry ships.
Aren't you... acting a bit rash? I'm afraid you'll rush headfirst into trouble if you press forward with the way things are right now...
I'm... being rash? I see. Thank you for your advice.
You're welcome. Anyway, I still have work to do.
Working together as a team, huh...
(I'm going to have to prioritize that if I want a shot at taking on Essex. But how do I do that...?)
Hmm? Whatcha doing, Independence? You look like something's really bothering you.
(Cleveland...? I wonder if I should ask her for some tips... As the lead ship of her class, I'm sure she knows something...)
To be honest...
Gotcha. So you want to improve the fleet's teamwork...
About that...
You don't know much about that either, right? After all, you're the one always charging ahead of the rest of us. Hehe~
Works out though. Cleve's the strongest, so she has no problem destroying all the enemies by herself.
Huh? When'd you all get here?
We were here the whole time?
(The girls who were supposed to be my sister ships... Cleveland, Columbia, Montpelier, and Denver... they're all here?)
...Looks like we can't come up with any good ideas even with all three of us here... Ahaha!
I feel like as well as we communicate and get to know each other better, that'll naturally carry over to our ability to cooperate during battle as well.
Independence, you were just assigned here, right? Lemme show you around port, c'mon!
Huh, right now? But the drill's right after--
Don't sweat the small stuff! It's okay, the commander will totally understand!
F-fine...
All right, shall we head out then?
...Wait, what the heck! She was asking me for advice, and I couldn't come up with anything useful at all!
Don't worry about it, Cleve. You'll get another chance!
(They sure get along well...)

sequence:
Air Raid Drills With Essex

<size=45>3: The Listener's Interlude</size>

3.say: You two must be tired. How about something to drink?

6.say: By the way, Essex, what do you think about playing the role of the enemy?

7.say: Like uh, do you ever feel like venting some old grievances against anyone, or saying badass things that only villains get to say, or--

9.say: S-sorry, I hadn't even thought about all that...

10.say: Considering the importance of this exercise, I have to take advantage of this opportunity to push my limits and display my abilities... That's pretty much what I think about this.

11.say: Mmhmm, that sounds just like what my overly-serious sister would say...

12.say: Heheh, unlike you, Hornet, Essex is actually the diligent type~

14.say: Oh, that's right! So, I know some stuff about Enty's habits in battle~ Want some tips, Essex?

16.say: Hornet, those two are tired from the exercises, so you should let them get some rest earlier. Don't keep bothering them, okay...?

17.say: Look, that much I do know!

21.say: What you mentioned earlier about Enterprise's habits earlier... Could you tell us a bit more?

23.say: I want to help Essex. But given her personality, she wouldn't ask for this kind of stuff herself...

24.say: Ahaha! It's not some game-changing secret though.

25.say: You'd notice these things right away from fighting together, so first--

27.say: Ack! Ahahaha... Sorry to hold you up! Anyway, gotta bounce!

28.say: Ahem! Thanks for your time, Hornet!

30.say: She already headed back to the dorms.

31.say: I see. Considering she was out there fighting all day, that's to be expected.

32.say: Could you relay a message to her if you see her? Tell her, "Great job today, and I hope you continue to keep up the good work."

33.say: I'll be sure to let her know.

34.say: Shangri-La, you also had a pretty impressive day out there.

35.say: And that's not just lip service. I don't think I'd be able to take on the role of the enemy so admirably.

36.say: I've always seen her as my hardworking underclassman, but that doesn't seem to do justice to her true strength anymore...

sequence:
Air Raid Drills With Essex

<size=45>4: Goals and Hard Work</size>

scripts.say: During the climax of the exercise...
Essex, do you have a moment?
Sure, what is it?
Um, Essex... What do you think it means to "become stronger?"
I've always struggled with how to overcome my own weaknesses. You've been universally praised by everyone here for your role as the enemy, so I'd like to hear from you.
I-is that so...
(...Normally, I'm always being compared to Enterprise, so... it's also nice to stand alone like this.)
Mm, and I'll title this photograph: "The cute little Essex who cannot wipe that goofy grin off her face after getting complimented."
Shangri-La? When'd you get here?!
Ahaha... I think it's my duty to record moments like these for posterity. Besides, aren't you going to answer Independence's question, "teacher?"
Ahem! ...Anyway, I think it's important to set a goal first.
A goal?
That's right. If you have a clear goal in mind, it'll help you be more efficient in your efforts.
I see, but what kind of goal should I have...?
For example... Essex's greatest aspiration of surpassing Enterprise, the person she respects most... something like that?
Ehh?! I-I guess... It's true that I look up to Enterprise, and at the same time want to catch up to her, but...

But, there are many others here at this port who are not to be underestimated either. For example, the Sakura Empire's Zuikaku, who is worthy of being Enterprise's rival, and the Royal Navy's Ark Royal, who I've heard is also quite formidable.
When I stopped only walking in Enterprise's shadows, I realized that there is so much progress to be made by learning from other people, not just from Enterprise.
Well, in the end, what I want most is for Enterprise to recognize me as her equal, but...
That's just like you, Essex. Hehe~ But if you ask me, I think Independence has known the answer to "how to become stronger" all along.
The idea of recognizing one's weaknesses and compensating for them, asking for guidance from others, and valuing their own growth...
As long as you don't get impatient, Independence, I'm sure you'll see great results.
I understand. Thank you for your advice.
Essex, Shangri-La, I'm looking forward to tomorrow's exercise.
(Finally the answer I wanted... I'm glad I got to talk to them.)
(It's just as Denver said. I guess I needed to talk to some more people.

sequence:
Air Raid Drills With Essex

<size=45>5: Best Memories</size>

scripts.say: Essex, Shangri-La, Independence, and all the participants of the special exercise--
This exercise not only allowed us to demonstrate the Eagle Union's air capabilities, but also let us gather valuable combat data.
It would not be an exaggeration to say that this result was a resounding success. For the sake of the azure lanes of freedom--
Cheers!
Essex, when you decided to take on the role of the enemy, I didn't think you'd launch such a comprehensive attack... But thanks to that, we were able to fully achieve the purpose of this exercise.
You completely caught me off guard.
I, I simply did what was expected of me! If you were in my position, you would've certainly done a better job...
You don't need to be so humble. You put more effort into this exercise than anyone else.
I took a lot of photos of this exercise for our future records. Why don't we look through them together?
Heck yeah! Is this going to become one of your collections?!
There's a note written on the back of this photo... "A cool-looking Essex getting ready to sortie." ...Hmm, fine words if I must say so myself.
Ehh?! R-really?!
(How embarrassing!!)
This one here is of Independence. Let's see, let's see... "Independence, after getting hit and requiring emergency damage control..." Uhh...
...How unsightly of me...
"The Laid-Back Wrangler?" It just looks like Hornet slacking off...
Hey, I wasn't slacking off at all!
"Saratoga, looking for her next prank victim," "Ms. Yorktown leading the destroyers," "Enterprise gazing beyond the horizons..."
There are so many pictures... these are simply amazing!
It's no big deal. It's just part of my job as the historian after all.
But there's one photo that I haven't taken yet. Yes, how about one last group photo of all the participants?
Good idea. Everyone, come over here.
Woah! Why am I being put in front?!
You're the leader of the red group, of course you have to stand in the front. Essex, if you would as well.
Everyone, on the count of 3... 3, 2, 1--
Cheese!
And thus concluded the Eagle Union's special air drills.

Summer Surprise

<size=45>1 The Arctic Eskimo?</size>

scripts.say: One day at port...
"Beneath the light of the glimmering stars and the moon spans a field of glaciers."
"A frigid wind blows across a white expanse."
"Within the pure white background, a girl clad in thick furs looks out in front of her, javelin in hand."
Mm... Mm... What's next?
"She advances carefully, her trusty hunting hounds at her side, the three surrounding their prey from different sides."
"With a snapping sound, the spear leaps from her hands, securing a splendid meal."
Woah... That's badass...
Hehe... I heard Eskimo apparently gives off the same kind of vibes!
A hunter who has lived in the polar glaciers for many years... What if she's a scary person?
Huh? You haven't met her either, Benson?
Nope, not yet! But, according to my sources, she'll soon be serving as the Commander's secretary ship~
So, we'll be able to meet her if we head to the office? I wonder what kind of person she is...
Oooooaaaaaaah!
Huh?! A voice came from behind those trees!
Badumdumdum!
Wait, now someone's drumming?!
Hey there, heard you girls were talking about me? Heh heh, I'll put your questions to rest!
*gulp*
Tadaaaah! Tribal-class destroyer, Eskimo, will be serving as secretary starting today! It's a pleasure to meetcha!
Woah, a girl calling herself Eskimo leapt out from behind the tree!
She doesn't have a harpoon on her... or vicious hounds following her. Phew! She's just a normal cutie just like us!
But she does have thick clothes from the frozen North! How cool!
Ehehe, I'm quite familiar with that story you mentioned! It's real interesting, but unfortunately, I'm nothing like that.
No no, I'm glad our new friend isn't super scary! Anyway, I'm Benson, this is Bailey right here, and this is Kalk~
Nice meeting all of you! Anyway, I need to go meet up with the Commander, so we'll talk later!
No problemo!
Huh, she's pretty cheerful. Not quite what I was expecting, hehe. Looks like things will be getting a lot livelier around here~

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>2 Ice Pops from Planet Bunny</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Hum, hum~ hum, dee dum~
While everyone else was seeking relief from the sweltering summer heat, Eskimo was happily humming away, going about her business.
Hmm? Why are you staring at me, Commander? Oh, I know! It's lunch break, right?
Hehe, you did a darn good job this morning too! It's real hot outside today... Maybe we should go find something cool and refreshing. Wouldn't want to get heat stroke, y'know!
*knock* *knock*
Commander, Eskimo, I've got something nice for you~
Let's see here... Planet Bunny... ice pops?
Wow, I was just talking to the Commander about getting something to help us keep cool! Talk about a sweet coincidence!
Heh heh! Because it's so hot today, everyone's been struggling to get anything done... So, Saratoga went and made ice pops to perk us up!
Saratoga made ice pops? Oh no, oh no...
That's right! Saratoga had her planes mix all the ingredients together, and us Benson sisters cut out the shapes!
We named it, "Planet Bunny Ice Pops From Outer Space!"
I'll be going around passing out the ice pops, so you two keep up the good work over here~
Bailey quickly hops away after leaving behind a box of rabbit-shaped ice pops.
Wowee! Want one, Commander?
Mmmm~ Ahh, I'm so blessed that the wonderful creations known as ice pops exist in this world!
"Right?"
Hmm... But, it still feels like something is missing...
Ways to beat the heat... Something bigger and larger... Ah, I've got it!
After looking at the ice pop in my hand for a bit, Eskimo suddenly seems to have a flash of inspiration.

options.content: "What'd you come up with this time?"

scripts.say: Heheh, it's a secret for now!
Just kick back and enjoy those ice pops! I'll be right back!

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>3 Preparations, Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Shop
Nya... Come swing by and check out my limited-time summer sale, nya...
Oh, Eskimo? Welcome, nya...
Heyyo! Hmm... Akashi, you don't seem your usual self today.
It's been too hot lately and nobody wants to go outside, nya... So business has been terrible, nya!
Haha, I see, that does suck... But the good news is, I'm here to ask for your help, Akashi-nya!
Hrmm? What can I do for you, nya?
Hmm... If I remember correctly, we do have a machine like that in the warehouse, nya. But it hasn't worked in ages even if I do rent it out to you, nya.
Aren't you amazing at repairs though? If you can even patch up our broken equipment, you should be able to fix up this machine, right?
Of course, nya! But I don't know why it isn't working to begin with, so the repairs might take some time, nya...
Besides, why are you interested in something like that anyway, nya?
Mm... I guess I can tell you, since you're basically my important business partner!
*whisper* *whisper*
(Nya?! Mm... hm... I see, I see!)
And if I take advantage of this opportunity to set up a stall, nya... I'll be able to turn my sales right around, nya!
Rest assured, Eskimo, nya. I'll have this thing patched up for you in no time, nya!
Really? Booyah!! Thanks a ton, Akashi-nya!

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>4 Preparations, Part 2</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office, a few days later
Over the last few days, Eskimo seems to have been working on something. I wonder if it's related to the "secret" she mentioned.
But, she's still been diligently taking care of her secretary duties. An absolute ball of energy, that girl...
Hum hum hum~♪
Eskimo continues to work while humming cheerfully. I can't really picture a girl like her having secrets at all.
But that only makes me more interested in what it is...

options.content: "Eskimo, what have you been working on lately?"

scripts.say: Ehehe~ I was wondering when curiosity would finally get the better of you, Commander~
I actually do have a plan in mind... Well more accurately, I should say that I've been working on a little surprise.
If I spill the beans now, it won't be a surprise at all! So you're gonna have to stay tuned!
Despite her usual carefree attitude, she clearly wasn't going to budge on this particular topic.
Buuuut, I have run into a teensy problem about the place I want...
So can you let me use the port's indoor pool for a day? That's about how long it'll take to get my surprise together anyway!
Think you could do me a favor, Commander? Pretty please?
The indoor pool, huh... Since it's the middle of summer, everyone just goes down to the beach anyway so the pool is pretty deserted.
Well, I guess one day couldn't hurt...
Woohoo! Thanks a ton, Commander!
That takes care of the most annoying problem!
Now to finish the rest of the preparations...
Even an energetic kid like Eskimo can't finish without a whole day's time, huh... That really makes me interested in seeing what she's been working on.
Well, whatever it is, I hope the pool manages to survive...

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>5 Spread the Word!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy Courtyard
It's been super hot outside lately, and I know you've all been looking for ways to beat the heat!
But look no further! Tomorrow, there will be a special surprise awaiting you all at the port's indoor pool!
It's gonna blow your mind! So be there or be square!
Since early in the morning, Eskimo has been promoting her work in the academy's courtyard. Her energetic voice seems to be drawing a lot of attention.
Good moooooorning, Commander! Here, take a flyer for tomorrow's event~
"Woah, you even made your own flyers by hand..."
I couldn't have done this without you, so come by and visit tomorrow!
So this must've been what she was working on. Just one more day until the grand reveal.
Woohoo! I'll see you there then!
Huh? A surprise event at the indoor pool?
I was wondering why it was closed all day yesterday... Turns out, Eskimo was behind it!
Things certainly are a lot livelier here now, just as I said the other day~
Hm... Do you think it's gonna be a swim meet? I'll have to head back and grab my swimwear.
Huh? Swimsuit? No, no, you won't be needing that. If anything, you'd better dress warm!
Pool... Pond... Something related to Eskimo... Woah, are you gonna have a fishing competition?
...Ah, the inspiration is coming to me. Cute girls sitting by a pond, locked in a life-or-death competition against starvation...
Absolutely fantastic! I'm going to go buy some fishing equipment!
Hold up, you're way off with that one... Look, you don't have to bring anything with you!
Just read the details on the other side of the flyer!
Huh, there was something written on the other side of the flyer? Never noticed that before...
"We've prepared a special surprise for you at the pool inside the port's gym tomorrow. Come and have some fun!"
"PS: Things might get a bit chilly, so dress warm!"
...Chilly?

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>6 Summer's Wintry Wonderland</size>

scripts.say: Port - Indoor Pool, the next day
Eskimo's advertising must've been a big success yesterday, because I saw a ton of people headed towards the same destination - the indoor pool.
Hm? I could hear joyous laughter coming from the other side of the door. Whatever Eskimo prepared must be pretty good.
Well, time to see for myself what's on the other side of the door. 3... 2... 1...
This is the big surprise I've been working hard to prepare for all of you! So, what do you think? Let's have a blast!
A snow machine in the middle of summer, huh? What a splendid idea... It reminds me of being back home at the Northern Parliament.
Woooow, it's snowing! There's so much of it, even though we're in the middle of summer! Look, Benson, let's have a snowball fight!
Let's do that later! First, let's make the biggest snow bunny EVER!
Yeah, yeah! Lemme help too!
When I opened that door, a frigid blast of wind hit me in the face, as if I had just stepped into the middle of winter.
Inside the pool was... Wait, I couldn't even see where the pool was supposed to be in the first place.
Instead, a pure white snowfield spread out in front of me, and there were even a few igloos spread around the pool area.
Hehe, whaddya think, Commander? Pretty awesome, isn't it?
Heheh, this is what I came up with when we were eating the ice pops the other day. If summer is such a slog, then why don't we change it to winter?
And this is the result! I rented a snow machine from Akashi, kept it running here for a day, and voilà! A wintry wonderland!
She really is quite the force of nature. And if Akashi is involved, then that means...
Come swing by Akashi's limited-time-only igloo shop!
If you get tired from playing in the snow, come by to relax and enjoy some hot drinks and snacks!
She never lets a business opportunity pass her up...
*splat*!
A snowball suddenly whizzed by me, missing me by only a tiny bit.
Sorry about that, my aim was a little off there!
Commander! And Eskimo too! We rarely have a chance to have a snowball fight in the middle of summer, so don't just stand there!
You're just in time for the second round anyway, so let's play together?
Heck yeah, count me in! I'll be right over!
C'mon, Commander! Let's enjoy the snow while it lasts!

sequence:
Summer Surprise

<size=45>7 What Fun Means to Eskimo</size>

scripts.say: While everyone was having fun throwing snowballs at each other, the sun was beginning to set.
I must say, I was impressed by the idea of turning a hot summer day into a little bit of winter. Definitely might be something worth repeating.
Phew... That was a lot of fun. So, what's the verdict, Commander? Had a good time?
Hehe, that's what I wanted to hear! The sun's about to set and everyone's planning to head back, so maybe you should as well?
I've gotta stay and clean up though. Have to return things the way you found 'em!
Huh? You're gonna stay to help me? Hooray! Then, let's get this done!
The clean-up work took longer than expected. And to think that Eskimo set everything up all by herself...
Sure, getting everything set up was a bit difficult and had me real tired, but everyone was totally blown away! Seeing their smiles made all the hard work worth it!
After all, seeing other people happy is what makes me happy as well!
Being able to play with everyone like this is the very definition of fun!
Oh, by the way, Commander, what's your favorite kind of fish?
My favorite kind of fish...?
Why would she ask me about that all of a sudden?
Heheh, the end of this surprise marks the beginning of a new surprise~
I'm going to work harder and harder to make everyone happy!
Maybe next time... I'll hold a fishing competition just like Benson wanted~
Commander, will you help me make that a reality too?
For the sake of seeing more brightly-shining smiles like Eskimo's... Maybe more events like this wouldn't be a bad idea.

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 1: A Small Luncheon</size>

scripts.say: Port - School Courtyard
My~ It sure has been a while since we last partook of lunch together~
I must say, Leander's cooking is simply delicious, without fail.
Ajax, isn't it about time you learned how to cook too? Considering how you're still making Commander cook all the time...

options.content: Ugh, how mortifying...! But I just can't help it!

scripts.say: Well, the person in question is happy about it, so isn't it fine?
Right? Commander is actually quite a hard worker, though it's not always apparent.
I-Is that so...?
Hehe~♪ Well then, what's the problem~?
Ajax, you shouldn't bully Commander around too much, all right? Here, have a drink.
Thanks... Phew. Oh my, are you thirsty too, Commander? Would you like some water?
Ajax held out the water bottle that she had just been drinking from.
C-Could this be...! An indirect kiss...?!
Go on, take a sip. Or... would you prefer it mouth to mouth~?
Jeez... I don't know anything about "indirect kisses" or whatever, but could you stop bothering the Commander already?
You might be wrong about that...
Okaaay~ It seems like we can't do these kinds of things where Leander can see.
But, if you do want to do these kinds of things with me later, I'll let you drink as much as you'd like, okay~?
Please, do look forward to it. Hehe~♪

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 2: The Meaning of Glory</size>

scripts.say: Ajax, you're really...!
I was simply speaking from a logical perspective. After all, we have a higher chance of victory if we face them in a night battle rather than facing them head-on.
Enough already, you're dragging the Royal Navy's Glory through the mud by ignoring the position of allies that have requested for help, are you not?!

Exeter, aren't you the one getting carried away by putting too much emphasis on "Glory"? Splitting our allied forces up like that, are you planning on fighting the enemy's main fleet by yourself? Though, if that's what you were going for, I wouldn't have stopped you~♪
As always, Exeter and Ajax were quarreling with each other.

Ajax's battle plans were surprisingly logical and accurate. That said, because she prioritized logic over all else, it appeared that she wasn't able to meet eye-to-eye with girls who prioritized honor or formalities.
Grr...! There's no point in arguing about this any further. I'll just follow the Commander's plans when it's time!
Are you running away? Or should I say, making an honorable retreat?
As one was bound to get more worked up the more the opponent rebutted one's argument, oftentimes the situation would get more and more tangled up...
I apologized properly to Exeter, since this is just what always happens.
Since Exeter is the kind of person who won’t listen even if you try to persuade her, is it not faster to anger her and then make her cave in, rather than explaining to her for days on end?
Well, that's also because my plans rely on you to come in there to deal the finishing blow~♪

options.content: Even if that's the case, you don't have to mess with her so much...

scripts.say: My, it appears that you do not support my actions, even though I am the secretary ship. Quite commendable, Commander.
Even though you're usually so gentle, you can act like a proper commander when it counts.
... And that's why I like you. Hehe~♪

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Secretary Ship's Responsibilities</size>

scripts.say: Commander. Here are the itinerary and exercise schedules that have been planned for the day, along with the situation reports from each sea zone patrol.

Also, here is the tally of the school's equipment, the inventory of our raw materials, the acquisition requests from the shop, the list of commissions entrusted to us, the progress of uniforms being manufactured, and the inventory of the blueprint storehouse.
And submission of the observation data of Sirens to the higher-ups, maintenance of mental cubes, and what’s left is the organization of Her Highness Elizabeth’s public assistance program...
As stated in the report, everything is progressing without any issues.
Right, this concludes today's duties as the secretary ship. Commander, thank you for your hard work.
Hehe~ I am merely doing the work of a Secretary Ship. Feel free to sit back and relax, Commander.
... You'll be making dinner and tomorrow's breakfast, won't you? As well as handling the cleaning?
Tomorrow I'm off-duty, so I’m going shopping with Achilles. I’d like for it to be earlier than usual.
Though Ajax was able to perform her duties as a secretary ship flawlessly, there was one glaring characteristic about her work...
And that was - she was unable to properly do anything that remotely fell under the category of "chores."
Are you dissatisfied? Even if I'm like this, I believe that I am properly handling my duties as secretary ship.
Or, could it be that you intend to make me do these chores, Commander?
Hehe~ I'm alright with doing just a liiittle bit, but... my evaluation of you will drop, Commander.

You're aware that you may ask a member of the maid team for help if needed, right? Of course, only if you're not satisfied with simply pushing chores onto your secretary ship, but also want to make a pass at one of the maids... Oh you~♪
You'd happily do something like that, wouldn't you? Little piggy~♪
Ajax was... bad at housework.

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 4: Friend? Foe?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Hallway
I've always thought about this, but... I'd love for an "incident" to occur on one of my patrols.
Don't you think so too, Commander? For example...
Ajax entwined her arm around mine.
I felt a soft but slightly firm sensation pressing against my skin.
Hm? The person over there is...
Ajax...
Oh, if it isn't Spee. Are you taking a walk by your lonesome?
In poor taste, as always. ... I feel bad for the Commander.
I wonder. To me, it doesn't seem like the Commander is bothered at all, isn't that right? Could it be that actually, you want to do something like this as well, Spee?
Not really... Unlike you, I don't have any interest in teasing the Commander. If I did so, I would sully the name of the Iron Blood.
You're suuure telling me, even though you've already lost once. Or, could it be that looking at this little piggy has made you feel jealous?
The feeling of a heated rivalry between them... was nonexistent.
... Sigh... Never mind what just happened. The restaurant we went to last time was pretty good. Will you take me there again some time?
Sure thing~ I really like that place too. Well, since that store has a strict "No Pets" policy... our little piggy won't be able to go~♪
Is that so... Also, regarding the outfit you gave me the other day... when Hipper saw it, she got really mad at me for some reason... I wonder if it's fine...
It's perfectly fine. Because those sweaters are especially effective against virgins, it will raise your battle power considerably more than it would otherwise seem.
I-I guess so... Thanks, Ajax.
Hehe~ I guess I'll have to ask Oklahoma for more good restaurant recommendations...
Before I knew it, Ajax had left me behind, all alone.

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 5: Cute Little Piggy</size>

scripts.say: When I woke up, I was in the bed in the office.
What a troublesome little piggy... Didn't I tell you to rest properly?
Since you're already having me nurse you back like this, if you don't follow my every order, you're going to be punished~
Hmm... How should I tease you once your cold gets better... I'm getting excited just thinking about it~
My head feels dull and sluggish... It seems like I've caught the cold.
But you know, I can't just neglect the work that has been piling up just because you're out with the cold, so...
Tonight, I'm going to stay up all night - I shall take care of work while also taking care of you. lit~tle~ pig~gy~♪
Why are you a little piggy, you ask? Why are you only asking this now?
To me, anyone that's worth teasing is a little piggy, you know? ... Well, that said, little pet piggies are special to me.
After replacing the soaked towel on my forehead, Ajax brought a bowl of chicken noodle soup and a spoon over.
I went through the trouble of making some chicken noodle soup. Eat it while it's still hot, got it?
Okay, open your mouth. Say ahhhn~.
Wait, it's still too hot... Phew~
Alright, once again. Say ahhhn~?
Good piggy~ ...Earlier, I said that pets are different, right? Despite the way I am, I still love pets.
But, the ones I'm raising are... hehe, to be exact, there's only one. So...
Get well soon, little piggy~♡

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 6: Stubbornness and Sincerity - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Achoo...!
Ajax was in bed, her face flushed red. The thermometer indicated that she had a high fever.
Though ships were said to be quite different from regular humans, it seems that they can still contract colds.
Good grief, colds truly are troublesome...
The secretary work is at a standstill, I can't learn how to cook from Leander, and...
Ugh... There's absolutely nothing good about this...
And on top of it all, I have to be seen in this kind of state by my little piggy...
It seems that she won't be satisfied unless she can be in control of the situation.
If I had things my way... I'd be laughing while teasing my little bedridden piggy...
I guess today is my turn to be laughed at... It's fine to leave me by myself today... I won't punish you for it later, so...
What is it? After seing me weakened like this, are you thinking something like, "Today is the day I'll get even with her!" or something?
Sigh... Considering how much I tease your normally... to be honest, I'm simply getting my just desserts.
Achoo! ...Well, do as you please.
Gently drape a wet towel on Ajax's forehead.
You... why...
Jeez... Anything would have been fine... *sniffle*... *cry*...
Ajax hid her face in the sheets.

sequence:
My Fond Memories

<size=45>Chapter 7: Stubbornness and Sincerity - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: Around one hour after nursing Ajax.
*Sniffle*... *cry*... Why do I have no choice but to be treated like this by little piggy...
Uwaaah...
Waaah... Why am I being teased by my little piggy...?!
You little...! Mark my words, when I get better...! When I get better, I'm going to...
It seemed that she was throwing a tantrum in bed.
As I am right now, I can't punish you...
Ugh... having this happen to me... There's no other choice... I'll have to step all over you!
Suddenly, all movement in the bed stopped.

options.content: Get closer to check on Ajax

scripts.say: When I got closer to check on how Ajax was doing, she suddenly pulled me under the sheets.
I felt Ajax's breath close to my face...
I'm sorry... I, just can't live on being pampered like this...
Having only my face be flushed red, being the only one that has to be seen in this weak state... is absolutely unfair.
So this time... shall we both have a cold, together?
My beloved little piggy~♡
Commander, you’re petting me so much...
{namecode:98} is busy ya know! She doesn’t have time to play with you Commander!
Since the Commander is so idle, then come help {namecode:98}!
Great timing, the inventory will soon run out... come quick and help me collect all these materials!
Cheering for ya, Commander! {namecode:98} believes in you, nyaa!
You’ve found it all, nyaa~ Commander, you’re the best! You’re {namecode:98}’s savior.
After all those years, {namecode:98}’s long-cherished wish will come true at last!
After all that hard work, the materials have been collected! Plus all those retrofit blueprints that I’ve been preparing for a long time. I can now finally get “that”!
---Nyaa? Will the Commander help me till the end?
You’re such a good person Commander... fine! All these materials and blueprints are for you! But give “that” to {namecode:98}, and have {namecode:98} join Commander’s fleet!
Commander... do you not have that many friends, nya?
No no, you can’t do this. Your popularity is also a part of your strength, nyaa!
Need to increase your friends! You know that right, Commander?! Build, nya~
Let {namecode:98} see your true talent when it comes to meeting new friends!
If you’re short on material, then ask {namecode:98}, nya~~ Whether its coins or wisdom cubes, you’ll get unlimited supplies!
Commander’s fleet... looks a bit weak, nya...
This is no good! Commander, you must become stronger!
Let {namecode:98} tell you the method of how to become stronger, nyaa!
Prepare to receive retrofit blueprints! Here’s also parts for your gear! Now go and design new equipments!
Commander’s storage is... so messy... {namecode:98} simply can’t bare to look at it...
The stuff that you’re not using should be disassembled immediately, nya!
I’ve finished tidying up the storage, we’re still good friends, ok! If you want new equipments then go buy tech packs from {namecode:98}!
--- of course there won’t be a discount just because you’re the Commander, nya!
Accepting to go on commissions is proof that I trust you, nya~
{namecode:98} wants to know if you’re a trustworthy person! nya~
To go on commissions is to help others!
{namecode:98} wants to see the Commander’s true mettle!
Commander, do you know what type of person will most likely be welcomed and respected?
Why don’t you let {namecode:98} teach you her ways! Which is ~~~~
Learn how to persevere to the end, nyaa!
Let {namecode:98} witness your will to persevere~ Push forward, many a little makes a muckle! Nyaa~
{namecode:66} also said so! Nya~
A talented Commander should constantly challenge himself to his limits!
--- Now that’s a challenge! Let {namecode:98} witness firsthand your determination and perseverance!
If you’re short on equipment then come find {namecode:98}, she will support you, Commander, to the best of her abilities!
Firstly, let's escort those cargo ships. C’mon, to battle! Growl~~
Nice one Commander! Next target, nyaa!
The sea is calling! Onwards onwards onwards!
Kill mission! Annihilate all enemies ahead, nya!
That {namecode:20} is such an idiot, she doesn’t trust what {namecode:98} says, nya...
---Nya? Oh, it’s only the Commander... it’s nothing… just that {namecode:20} said the Sakura Empire tech pack sold in store had shown a different company’s logo...
That’s impossible! All inventory has been double checked by {namecode:98}...
Nyaa? Great timing… the Commander can also join us and help test these...
I must make it so that idiot {namecode:20} will have nothing left to say, nya! ---
Hehehe, looks like {namecode:98} will win for sure~
Just in case, let’s test these out some more!
{namecode:98} has prepared everything, {namecode:20}, it's time for you to pay the bill!
Sure enough, {namecode:98} did not make any mistakes! Also, thank you Commander for your help! This time {namecode:20} will have nothing left to say!
--- Nya? You’re going to take your fleet out to commission, Commander?
You’re so hardworking Commander, purr ~ Cheering for ya ~
Nya, the Commander has qualified!
However, just passing regulations is not enough! The goal is to be the best, nyaaaaaa!
Challenge yourself to the limit!
Keep up the good work! If there’s any problems then {namecode:98} can fix it for ya, nyaa~
Next one!~
Almost there, nyaa~
I’m ready to go~ {namecode:98} is going to the port waiting for the Commander to return. Nya~
It’s been decided, {namecode:98} will give an award to the hardworking Commander!
When you come back, come to {namecode:98}, nyaa~ {namecode:98} has got goodies to give to the Commander!
Th.. there’s no more?! Those materials collected by {namecode:98} from a long time ago are all gone!!
Ahhhh! The bag holding the material is broken! After all, I’ve been using it for such a long time...
Could it have fallen somewhere? Nyaa... That spot seems to be very suspicious...
--- Great timing Commander, nyaa! Help {namecode:98} find something! It's very important to {namecode:98}, hmm it must be in the port area!
If you help {namecode:98} find it all, then {namecode:98} will be very grateful to you Commander!

sequence: On a faraway continent, there is a skyscraper-filled city that knows no night.
Many call it the Sleepless City.
Equal parts elegant and vulgar, this neon paradise both consumes and treasures money like water itself.
The fearless and the fools flock there chasing dreams, a gaping maw of collective greed.
Those living at the base of the Manjuu Tower experience no change...
...But the inside has reached a boiling point. A ticking time bomb of corruption it has become.

scripts.say: I hear someone calling.
Wake up.
Wake up, Knight. There's still work to do!
The haze in my mind gradually clears. First, I see a girl abounding with curiosity.
Second, I see a jail cell so decrepit that it looks ready to collapse at any given moment.
Caught me, huh...?
I try to recall my memories, but nothing comes up.
So you finally woke up, Knight.
Heheh, you don't remember a thing, do you?
Who am I? Not important.
Remembering who YOU are is a lot more important, though.
Commander.
What are...
*bzzzt!*
Suddenly, fragmented memories rush into my mind like a flurry of snow.
Cheep cheep!
Tweet! Cheep cheep cheep!
Cheep! Cheep cheep!
*KABOOOOM!*
An explosive wave of scorching-hot air blows in from nearby, toppling everything in its path.
Even one of the most powerful people of the Sleepless City, too lofty for its residents to ever look upon, is powerless before it.
Help... me...
Don't... you see...
This ID... that of the... noble... Valiant...
Save me... and my... fortune will be...
The CEO is motionless. The item in her hands falls to the ground.
Looking back, it's an odd feeling.
Such an important person had died so unceremoniously before my eyes. I watched it happen, and I did nothing to stop it.
The sight of it was even more shocking than the stun batons brought by security shortly after.
...Cheers to this crappy world.
You obtained 1 Ascension Box!
The ID card of "The Great"...
That's right.
Climb to the top of the Manjuu Tower with that baby, and you'll be the new master of this Sleepless City.
Saving countless suffering people, becoming the king of a new era, changing millions of lives with a single whim.
Heheheh~ Doesn't that sound fun?
What should I do?
Do what you gotta do.
That doesn't really help...?
Too bad. I just wanted it to sound dramatic, really.
By the way, my contact is coming soon.
See you later, you pretty little Knight!
Hold on! At least tell me your name!
Wow. You're a curious one, eh?
Then remember this well. I'm the coolest, cutest, most invinciblest girl under the stars, Pamiat' Merkuria!
A figment of your imagination!
*KABOOOOM!*
*KABOOOOM!*
Aim at the helicopter! Not the prison!
Those prison cells still have high-bounty marks in them! Be more careful!
Waaaaah! I'm sorryyyy!
Firing again... Huh?!
M-my weapons broke?!
The jail cell's iron-barred window isn't just blown away; a big hole has been made in the wall.
However, one would need the wings of Icarus to reach a prison cell located so high in a tower with security this tight.
Fortunately, one set of steel wings has accomplished just that.
Amidst the booming of the helicopter engine, she descends from the hole in the wall like an angel sent from above.
The famous Commander of the Sleepless City, unmoved even by such violent reception.
We're short on time, so let me introduce myself right away.
I am Agent Arkhangelsk of the Silverwing Resistance.
And my mission is to rescue you, symbol of rebellion – no matter the cost.

options.content: Are you sure you have the right person?

scripts.say: You led the attack on her caravan, no?
Nobody but you could bring down Valiant, the master of the Manjuu Tower.
I'd never mistake you for someone else.
Or are you saying that someone other than you led the attack on her caravan?
Tales of your heroism are spreading all over the Sleepless City.
If you join the resistance, our victory is all but assured!
(Rebellion...)
I remember the phantom Pamiat's words.
Climb to the top of the Manjuu Tower with that baby, and you'll be the new master of this Sleepless City.
Saving countless suffering people, becoming the king of a new era, changing millions of lives with a single whim.
"Do what you gotta do," huh?
Can you take me to the Manjuu Tower?
Don't worry. We'll evacuate you to... Wait, what?
Manjuu Tower? That place has the tightest security in the whole Sleepless City.
Going with this helicopter alone would be suicide!
There's no need for you to go through such a risk again, right? I mean—
But...
Tee hee~ Security patrol speaking!
Warning, intruders! There's nowhere left to run~
This is your final warning! Stop resisting and surrender right away!
Otherwise, we cannot guarantee your safety~
Damn. I didn't think Kronshtadt would send backup so fast...
But it's fine. The Resistance means to cooperate with your plans anyway.
...I'll lure security away.
The rest is up to you to figure out.
Good luck to you, Commander.
After the mysterious agent leaves, the helicopter suddenly rises upward and flies away from the jail.
Hooray! The intruders left!
I bet they were all scared 'cause our patrol team came running!
Don't be a fool, Ognevoy! This isn't just a matter of intruders coming and leaving!
H-Huuuh?! What?!
Calling all units from the prison! I repeat, calling ALL units on duty!
A helicopter has escaped with a very important target! Be on the lookout for any helicopters not registered with the Sleepless City's management system!
Ognevoy, you stay here! Abercrombie, ensure all water routes are sealed!
I will take responsibility for land routes! Now move!
- Okaaay! - Roger that!
The helicopter noise and security vehicle sirens gradually fade away.
It seems Arkhangelsk managed to draw security's attention. That only leaves the question of how I can escape this place.
Jumping out of the hole in the wall is obviously out of the question. Even if I managed to hit water from this height, the surface tension would still kill me.
Am I screwed?
More the opposite! When things get rough, I say you should go with the flow.
An unexpected voice comes from the dark of the hallway.
A girl wearing a security uniform peeks in through the prison cell's bars.
(Damn! They left someone behind just in case?!)
Part of me starts to regret not taking the "jump out the window" idea more seriously.
But she suddenly whips out a key and opens the cell door for me.
Open sesame! Heheh, come on. I'm not a prison guard!
Allen M. Sumner, also known as the phantom thief Miss Terious! Your reputation precedes you, Commander!
It's kind of amazing how easy it was to infiltrate this place.

options.content: Are you a member of the resistance, too?

scripts.say: Nope. I'm just a phantom thief flying solo and free. I'll die before I fight for someone else.
I only care about things that pique my interest, such as... you, you little big-shot.
Then you're after me?
Heheh, that's right. You've really piqued my interest.
Besides, I hear this prison is where they stow the baddest of the bad.
Stealing a legend like you is the challenge of a lifetime. How could I, the legendary phantom thief, refuse?
Phantom thieves are all about stealing heavily defended things, right?
Her explanation is simultaneously dubious and overconfident.
But strangely, it convinces me to trust her.
Is it because I've heard that line somewhere before?
Hellooo? Don't just stand there like a lump.
They're going to figure out my decoys soon, so we gotta get out of here fast.
Oh, I'm sorry. Let's get going.
Mind leading the way, Miss Terious?
Prison - Underground Garage
sequence: Prison - Underground Garage
Exit K-03
CAM03 LIVE

scripts.say: The elevator door slowly opens.
I follow phantom thief Miss Terious into an underground garage beneath the prison.
Now, get ready for the final step of my escape magic~
As soon as we can find a car, it's bye-bye prison!
Ahh, this was so easy that it was almost boring~
Here I was hoping for some more excitement!
Allen? What are you talking about?
Oh, it's no big deal. I just expected better security given the layout of this place.
If I were them, I'd put an ambush here and let the two escapees fall right into the palm of my hand.
Is that so?
I thought you'd show us some more interesting tricks. How disappointing.
Allen M. Sumner... Or should I say Miss Terious?!
Ack! Inspector Monarch... You again!
Look how shrewd you're being. You want to disrupt things this late in the game?
I do my best to be a spectator, but sometimes, circumstances dictate that I must act.
Monarch – the city's police inspector – turns her eyes toward me.
My dear friend, my old partner...
Hahaha... What a sad state of affairs.
...Ahem. Sorry, but just go with it for now.
We can discuss old times later. For now, there's something more important that must be done.
Allen M. Sumner, you've pilfered a far greater treasure than I anticipated!
Monarch raises a hand and snaps.
When she does, the garage's emergency exit is kicked down.
Please don't move! No more resisting!
"A friend in need is a friend indeed." You taught me this.
(whispering) Wow, she's really got it out for you.
Okay, then. On to plan B!
Now, Artist! Do your thing!
Sudden gunfire interrupted the tense confrontation.
The source of it is Svirepy's rather antique machine gun, and it has more than enough firepower to make Monarch and Ognevoy take cover.
Hahahaha! Fight me, assholes!
Thanks to her merciless fire, the tables turn back in favor of the phantom thief and her companion.
Alright! Suppressive fire has arrived!
Now go! Take the Commander with you!
Gotcha!
Symbol of rebellion, Comrade Commander! Come with me!
A manhole cover at my feet opens up, and Svirepy jumps right inside.
It would be easy to follow her, but I have reasons not to, as well.

options.content: Allen, aren't you going to run?

scripts.say: *sigh*... You never change, do you? Heheh.
Don't worry about me. You just go ahead and flee.
...Don't just sit there! That little squirt is setting up her heavy weapon as we speak! If you don't wanna die, then get in that manhole!
I look over to the pillar and see that Ognevoy is, indeed, assembling that same ridiculous weapon she'd fired at the helicopter.
(So I have no choice...)
I thought I'd made up my mind, but before jumping in, I turn to look at Monarch and Ognevoy again.
My eyes meet those of my former friend, the police inspector.
Dear friend!
It's not too late to do the right thing!
Full poweeeer!
Somebody closes the manhole cover, and before long, I hear nothing but an explosion.
In the dark silence, that phantom's voice comes to me again.
It's not over yet. Commander, it's not over.
Go to the Manjuu Tower.
Go to the Manjuu Tower...
Sleepless City - Block 33 Security Office
35 minutes later...
Yes? This is Block 33's security office.
...Excuse me? A jailbreak has occurred?
So the criminal has escaped through the sewer and is escaping through this block.
Yes. I understand. I won't let them escape this block, no matter what.
*sigh*... What a world we live in.
This is Tallinn, calling Inspector Kirov. Inspector Kirov, can you hear me?
Suspects are escaping through this block. I'm tracking them through the nanocircuit. Intercept them at once.
Understood. I'll take care of it.
Block 33 highway entrance 3 minutes later...
Tallinn, I'm at the target area... But I don't see anything unusual.
That can't be! The nanocircuit still shows them in this very location.
Is there interference affecting it?
I'll scan the area again. If they've already escaped to another block–
Ahem. Testing, testing.
Tch. Just as I was warming up my motor – Wha?
Noticing that she's receiving communication from someone else, Kirov pulls off a quick drift to a stop on her bike.
Aaahahaha! It worked!
Don't waste your effort, kid! Your nanomachines are all mine now!
You're not catchin' Comrade Commander today!
Who is this?!
Ahahahahaaa! My bad! I didn't even introduce myself!
I'm a genius mechanic... no, genius HACKER with the resistance! Haaahahaha!
Your security database calls me... What was it? Soobrazitelny?
Bet your boss Tallinn remembers me well.
...Of course I do.
The famous city-wide blackout was your doing, wasn't it?
I thought you were gone for good, but it seems you've reared your ugly head again. How do you plan to hurt our fair city this time?
Hurt? Now that's just slander. I joined this resistance because I agreed with their lofty ideals, that's all.
Those alone make them a whole lot better than your police force.
Empty words. From my perspective, all you're doing is interrupting our pursuit of a dangerous criminal.
Obstruction of justice. Is that your lofty ideal?
You peons are all the same. Nothing gets through your sick skulls.
You're not just chasing a criminal. You're chasing the COMMANDER. I wonder how the Commander would feel about that?
Tch. Just as I was warming up my motor – Wha?
It can't be!
Tallinn...?
I don't believe it...! Our security force lost its Commander long ago!
All records of the Commander have been scrubbed... You must be lying!
That's a funny accusation, noble Chief Tallinn.
You're the ones who nest under the Manjuu Tower. I think you know who in this Sleepless City are the real liars.
That's enough. Don't let her speak another—
No. Let her talk.
Tallinn?
You have one last chance. Skip the pointless noise and tell us everything. Otherwise, I'll personally dig you out of the depths of hell and judge you myself!
Aaahahaha! I'd like to see you try!
Here's the access key to your little security database. See for yourself!
By the way, Comrade Commander has the Ascension Box right now. You're clever, Tallinn – you must know what that means.
Are you just gonna watch this city sink all the way, or are you gonna plug the holes? That depends on you!
See ya never!
You little...!
Calm down, Kirov.
Tallinn... You don't seriously believe her, do you?
Remind me of our motto, Kirov.
"To maintain the principles of justice..."
"...And to see justice done."
Come back, Kirov.
I'm going to discuss things with other blocks' security offices.
Sleepless City - Block 13, Abandoned Arcade
We hide out in several places for nearly an hour until we finally arrive at a safe house.
It's an abandoned arcade. Svirepy, the Artist, seems to know a lot about this place.
Apparently looking for a change of pace, she continues to fiddle with a barely-operating crane game.
...She keeps trying, but she fails to win anything.
Realizing the tokens in her pocket have run out, she turns around to face me.
Tch. Too much going on today to focus.
I was gonna ask you if you wanted to play, but too bad.
She shrugs and leans against a shelf covered in graffiti.
(Is she... trying to chat with me, or?)

options.content: Svire... Ahem. I don't think I've gotten your name, stranger.

scripts.say: Hmph. Names don't mean much in this city.
...D-don't look at me like that. Fine, it's Svirepy.
Ahem. I'd prefer if you used my pseudonym, though.
I'm the Artist. I use this city as a canvas, painting over it with the rule of art.
Hmm... So that graffiti there is one of your rules?
Hahaha, close enough! Let's make it simpler – I'M the rules here.
Rules only have meaning when you enforce them. This is my territory, so I could just break into this game and take the prizes if I wanted.
But that breaks a rule, and that's lame as hell.

options.content: So your philosophy is that we should all follow the rules?
But aren't you painting over the rules?

scripts.say: Humans make the rules, and humans enforce them.
I'm no exception!
Ahahaha! C'mon, I gotta leave some canvas for other artists.
Most of all, I was born and raised in this city. I love it like I love myself.
I just can't stand the scum that pollute it and act like they're better than us.
Someone's eavesdropping on us.
Aww, you got me...
Quit hiding, already. Show yourself!
While Svirepy talks about her ideals, she suddenly becomes alert and yells at the arcade door.
When she does, the dusty door opens with a creak.
From it appears a girl wearing detective clothes and holding bread in her mouth.
G-good evening~
Don't be so tense~ As you can see, I'm just a private detective...
U-umm... I TOTALLY agree with you, Svirepy!
The rules of this city need to be changed from the bottom up!
...I've finally found you, legend of the Sleepless City.
Don't be surprised. You're more famous in this city than you think.
Famous Commander of the security force, famous do-gooder of downtown... You're all over the history of this city. *munch*
The oddly familiar private detective Volga takes a bite of her bread before turning serious.
...I come with an invitation.
My client is willing to take you to the Manjuu Tower – as long as you're willing to meet with her.

options.content: She won't take no for an answer, will she?

scripts.say: I-I wonder... Can I take that as a yes, though?
Hehehe, you're just like my client said~ She knew you wouldn't refuse.
This means I lost my bet, though... It's your victory, subordinate of the Queen.
The Queen never loses, Detective.
A voice, full of firm resolve, was accompanied by the appearance of another girl from the door.
Do not doubt the Queen's decisions.
Oh, I-I'm sorry...
Anyway, I should go... Commander, you just work with the Contact from now on.
Oh, and I'll get rid of any trace that we met here~
Right. Come with me.
Sleepless City - ??? Queen's HQ
The silent Contact guides us to a fancy building.
I was surprised to learn that the mafia headquarters were located in the most lively place in the city, but we get an audience with the Queen without issue.
However...
Svirepy, stay here.
Only the Commander may meet with the Queen.
What the hell?
That's not what you said before.
Only the Commander was invited. Accept it.
Wha?! You wanna get your ass kicked?!
I'm sorry. The Queen's orders are absolute.

options.content: I guess we have no choice...

scripts.say: Thus, I finally arrive at the Queen's office.
As soon as I open the door, I make eye contact with her. My heart skips a beat.
Her name naturally leaves my mouth, as if a long-dormant memory has been awakened.
Isn't that sweet? You remember me.
I thought the Sleepless City would get boring when I heard of your disappearance. How happy I am to be proven wrong.
And you still have your old charm... You're a tough one, Commander of the security force.
Did we know each other...?
Heehee... More than that. We were rivals.
But don't worry. You're my guest, and I'm not the type of queen to be rude to guests.
Besides... A much greater cause awaits us, no?
Yes. Us.
I'll get right to business.
The Ascension Box. You have it, yes?
Heehee♪ The resistance isn't the only group capable of launching an attack on her, you know.
So you're the ones who attacked Valiant...
Oh, I wonder. Who knows, really?
Let's be frank. I'm happy to take you to the Manjuu Tower.
In exchange, when you connect to the city's main server, I need you to do some... fiddling for me.
That is, I want you to make US the masters of this Sleepless City.
Once that is done, a new contract will be bound. The order of this city can be rebuilt.
You may lead in the light, and I will rule as Queen from the shadows. Doesn't that sound wonderful?

options.content: Doesn't that mean the Sleepless City won't change?

scripts.say: Heehee. Of course, it will change a little. But like human history, things here will only repeat in perpetuity.
If we can right the balance of power, the Manjuu Tower won't collapse.
You seem as troubled as I'd expected.
Think about it as much as you need to. It's not as if you need to answer now.
I'm sure you'll understand everything when you reach the top of the tower.
...My, security works quickly. It seems the delivery person I arranged for has already arrived.
Farewell, Comrade Commander. We may never meet again, but...
Comrade Commander, get down!
A wave of intense gunfire destroyed the glass window behind Poltava's throne.
Instantly after, a flash bang was tossed into the office.
I'm suddenly tied up and dragged away by some intense force.
In the midst of the white, I feel as if I've been thrown into a vacuum without gravity.
(Did they just throw me out of the building?!)
Ten minutes later...
That building is the Manjuu Tower.
I hope you're satisfied with your delivery.
Allow me to introduce myself properly. I'm Sovetsky Soyuz, a member of the resistance.
Tallinn from Block 33's security office contacted me.
Yep. I don't know the details, but security told me everything.
If not for their nanocircuit, I wouldn't have found you anywhere near as quickly.
They promised to keep the riots from getting close to the Manjuu Tower, too.
As a result, it all worked out.
Charging in head-on would be reckless. We'll have to detour around the security force's defensive line.
We're running straight up to the top floor of the tower. Get ready.
The already-familiar weightlessness comes over me again, and we charge directly to the top-floor office of the Manjuu Tower.
*CRASH!*
...We've arrived at the target area.
Through that elevator, we can reach the data center up above.
This is the end. It's up to you to remake the Sleepless City with your own hands...
And end all of this.
Heehee. I will say, it is an admirable idea.
However... You're far too naïve.
Well done on a successful delivery, Agent Arctic Hare – Sovetsky Soyuz.
The leather chair behind the office's desk spins around to reveal the person sitting in it.
Boss... Avrora?
(They know each other?)
Why are you here, Boss?"
W-wait. It can't be...
Well, aren't you smart?
You already understand the situation. But of course – you are my dear subordinate.
The resistance... was working with the Great all along?
Working WITH the Great? Hmm, not quite.
The Great doesn't understand that the resistance is the true master of the city.
Without the resistance, the order of this city would have collapsed a long time ago.
The hope we provide unites this city.
Unfortunately, that manjuu fool is in cahoots with the mafia now...
He doesn't know that Poltava's ambition won't be so easily sated...

options.content: So the resistance attacked Valiant, after all?

scripts.say: Heehee, how slanderous. I didn't fire the gun.
But that's enough. This farce is coming to an end.
Playtime is over, Knight. Why don't you just give up and hand over the Ascension Box?
Is that so?
Do it, Agent Arctic Hare.
Wh-why aren't you doing it?
By the time Avrora turns to Soyuz, a flash bang is already on its way to her.
*CRASH!*
Kh... You betray me?!
Comrade Commander, this way!
"Thank you for using the Manjuu Tower elevator. Selection: top floor."
"Please input access key."
Comrade Commander, use the Ascension Box!
There's no time—
There's a whoosh as the pursuer's bullet strikes the wall of the elevator.
I won't let you go that easily...!
Leave her to me. Commander... Do the right thing!
You used the Ascension Box!
Welcome back, Administrator. Have a pleasant day.
Noooooo!
Avrora fires a few more shots, but an energy barrier is deployed just in time to stop them.
The elevator door inexorably closes.
It's time to end this, Knight.
When the elevator door opens, a data center like one in a Sci-Fi movie comes into view.
This is the source of the megacorporation's ability to control the city. With the combined power of the nanocircuit and supercomputing technology, almost no secrets can remain secret.
Almost.
I enter the data center, and a pale blue hologram appears before me.
Welcome to the data center, Commander.
I have given you administrator privileges.
Awaiting orders.
(It looks like this last decision is up to me.)

options.content: (Become the god of a new world.)

scripts.say: Orders received. As you wish, Commander.

Tai Yuan found this while digging around in the warehouse.
H-heheheh...

It's not really a drawing book, it's more like a half-finished coloring book...

You're up to something again, Fu Shun...
