sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>1 The Unhulde's Invitation</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Having finished a good chunk of my accumulated paperwork, I stop and take a breather. That's when I hear a knock on the door.
Come in.
The door slowly opens, and August von Parseval steps in.
In her hand is a black envelope adorned with golden highlights. She approaches me with a graceful gait, the look in her eyes a bit more implicative than usual.
Just as I thought. You have time on your hands.
What brings you here?
The stars of fate will intersect tomorrow night. Take this, and give me your answer.
She presents the envelope to me. The luxurious paper gives off a mysterious smell.
What is this? An invitation?
For you, my familiar. Dare you to undertake destiny's ritual?
I manage to decipher the contents of the invitation, albeit after some effort.
So, if I understand this right, you want to go camping with me, right?
Something about this tells me it's no regular camping trip, though.
Would I take such elaborate measures, were it a regular wilderness excursion?
With grace, she sits down on a chair opposite me and gently runs her fingers through her long hair.
Perhaps you consider it a mere leisure activity.
To me, however, it is an ideal opportunity to guide you to your destiny.
That doesn't sound very laid-back.
I have said nothing suggesting thusly.
Will you join me on this occasion? You've yet to decline.
Yeah, I'll come along.
Question, though – if we're going camping, don't we need to pack a lot of stuff?
Don't worry about that. I've already composed a list of all the items we will need.
We will go on a shopping trip tomorrow morning.
Wow. You really came prepared.
Were you that sure I was going to say "yes"?
I do not make erroneous predictions.
Clearly not, as proven right here.
Just to be clear, do I really not need to bring anything beyond what's on the list?
There is one thing. Bring high expectations.
High expectations for the unknown and the destiny that's to come.
Okay then... What time do we meet up?
Tomorrow, six in the morning. By the gates.
Six? That's pretty early.
I'm not partial to the sun rising too high. It stifles the whispers of the stars.
Alright. Just don't be late.
How could I call myself a guide if I were late to my own rendezvous? You need only keep up with me.
"Guide"? So you'll be handling everything for me? Somehow, that sounds a bit risky.
Risk is, after all, the spice of destiny.
Okay, then that's everything.
Ah, you're using my title now, "Commander."
You've taken to your role quite well, I see.
Just trying to keep up with you, like you asked.
Of course. This is why I find you so amusing.
August gets up and gives me a small smile as she leaves my office.
A whiff of her eternally lingering scent lights inside my heart a spark of anticipation for the mystic journey ahead.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>2 The Unhulde's Trial</size>

scripts.say: It's the next day. I arrive on time at the place where August told me to meet her.
Your proactiveness has not escaped my notice.
Well done, my "Commander," my familiar.
Wouldn't wanna disappoint you after such a painstaking invitation.
We exchange some light jests as we head to the shopping district together.
The streets are lined with stores that just opened for the day. The smells of the sea and freshly baked bread mingle in the air.
What are we buying first?
Our first item: A starlight collector.
The... The what now?
I kind of assumed we'd just be buying regular camping stuff.
What do you think it is, then?
A small generator?
That'll give us access to a light source other than the stars.
An overly pragmatic guess.
Maybe a telescope?
A telescope lens collects starlight. It makes sense.
It does not. A telescope does not collect starlight, it gazes at it.
There is a hint of amusement in her voice, almost like she enjoys seeing me confused.
Whilst I ponder if there's anything that fits the bill better, she elegantly turns on her heel and heads into a shop specializing in illumination.
Will we find the answer in there?
Follow me.
She walks up to a display shelf and goes straight for a nightlight that glows like stardust. As she holds it, the soft light illuminates her delicate hand.
Starlight exists not to brighten up the night, but rather to linger in the memory of a certain someone.
A certain someone who is willing to approach the stars and understand them.
Such a light is just right.
She expresses a sentiment that's hard to put into words while she hands the nightlight to me.
I look at it for a while, then something dawns on me.
Esoteric though her phrasing may be, I'm starting to grasp her sense for naming things.
Next item: An effulgence of bygone days.
Uhh...
You mean like this antique oil lantern?
Not a bad suggestion.
Huh. Have to say, I find your riddles surprisingly fun.
You might even call them "the Unhulde's trials."
Ah, so you've grown accustomed to my manner of speech.
I like taking on intellectually stimulating tasks.
"Taking on"? No. What you're doing is being guided by me.
While I do not attempt to forcibly change anyone's way of thinking, I do lovingly impart teachings to those who come to me.
We continued shopping for a while, and I kept guessing what her extravagantly named items really were, with some hits and some misses.
After half a day of touring the district, we've now finally procured everything on the list.
The "eye of the abyss" is black velvet with an eye pattern, and the "echo of fate" is a string of bells...
Hey, are we really prepping for a camping trip here?
If anything, this looks more like a shopping list for some occult ritual.
At times, even stars must surround themselves with ashes for their light to stand out more.
What you do not yet know is how their visages appear in the night.
So you're gonna keep me waiting until night before I "see the light"?
No. I will have your undivided attention until then.
With a relaxed expression, she adjusts my collar before grazing the back of my neck with a cold fingertip.
Even something as pedestrian as a camping trip can mayhaps be the starting point of a contract.
The sunlight gently adds a contour to her side profile, on the lips of which a mysterious smile sits.
All of a sudden, I look forward to seeing the "visage the stars show in the night" to an absurd degree.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>3 The Destined Spot</size>

scripts.say: Having finished our shopping, August and I went to the suburbs.
The hustle and bustle of the city gradually grew distant while the landscape got filled with gentle hills and dense forests.
We come to a stop at an unremarkable, narrow path. There are no signs or guideposts.
Is this the place?
Yes. From here and onward, we will have to walk.
Not that I expect you'll get cold feet after coming all this way.
She walks up to a small road hidden under the shadow of the trees.
A tangle of foliage hangs overhead. The sunlight leaking through the gaps draws a patchwork on her fair skin.
This place is getting more barren with each step...
You're not gonna pick a campsite randomly, are you?
She comes to a sudden stop, turns around, and pinches my chin.
Casting doubt upon the Unhulde incurs a punishment.
I have, in fact, chosen a location in advance.
The stars of fate will intersect tonight, and I alone can witness this.
You need only come along for the journey.
After cutting through the woods, our visibility suddenly gets much better.
Talk about a pretty sight. Guessing this is the spot you chose.
I'll take that to mean you like it, my familiar.
This is an elevated location, surrounded by trees while simultaneously providing ample space.
Look over yonder – we have an uninterrupted view of the lake.
It's more open than I pictured it.
Basically the perfect place to enjoy the view.
"Enjoy" – yes, now you've touched upon why we came here.
To enjoy ourselves, and more specifically, enjoy the crossing of fates tonight.
We will be the sole beholders of one another's fate.
Slowly, she walks to the center of the clearing and stretches her arms out, as if gesturing for the curtains of fate to rise.
Listen. The wind has started to whisper.
Once the veil of night falls, you will understand its voice.
This remark of hers reminds me that we'll be staying the night here.
Well, I can't complain about the view...
But we're far, far from civilization out here.
You sure staying here is a good idea?
Is safety your concern?
Your safety, in particular. I have to keep you safe.
Remember, the fates are about to cross. Not just anyone is qualified to witness it.
Even if, as you worry, someone would come and disturb us...
It is not we who should be alarmed, but rather the disturber.
...Alright. I'll trust you on this.
Rest assured. This place is for you and me alone tonight.
Just for us...
Very good. Now, I have a reward for you. For being such an excellent familiar.
I will allow you to attend to me closely throughout the entirety of the process ahead of us.
As you say.
Very good. Obedience does at times symbolize not yielding to authority, but rather trusting in your partner.
Destiny will answer those who seek it out, and I never lead anyone astray.
Now, let us start building our temporary dwelling – or I should say, our camp.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>4 Place That Lights the Stars</size>

scripts.say: I finish looking around the campsite, put down my backpack, and start setting things up.
Do we start with the tent?
Yes. Somewhere around here. It will be your "stage."
August points to where to erect the tent and hands me a stack of materials.
Wow, this is a novel tent. It can't have been easy to find.
The tent's textile is covered with esoteric and complex patterns, its rim is fitted with antique gold thread, and it even has small spangles woven in.
It will be our dwelling for a brief time.
It will also be a world dedicated solely to us tonight.
Which is to say, be thorough in setting it up, my "Commander."
I spread the cloth just as she instructs, hammer in the pegs, and build out the frame.
Once the main part is done, I also put down a ground sheet, a layer of waterproof cloth, and set up a simple window screen.
You're quiet all of a sudden. What's up?
I'm simply carrying out my duty.
I exit the tent and find that the campsite has undergone radical change.
There are flowers and nightlights spread around everywhere, lending the place an irregular yet mysterious beauty.
You've got a reliable and proven aesthetic sense.
The stars tonight will not shine upon the banal.
For that reason, I need to make the campsite suitably worthy of their light.
I suppose I'll have to deal with spending the night without incandescent light.
You should also be grateful that the stars will shine for you tonight.
Then I will.
Alright, if you insist.
Good. Destiny more kindly greets those who look forward to it.
Okay, so what do we do next?
Go gather some rocks. We're going to make a domain.
A domain?
My domain, yes. Once it's complete, no outside noise will be able to disturb us.
I both trust and distrust her plan, but since it's not particularly hard work, I did as instructed.
Meanwhile, she took the nightlights and the velvet we bought today and used them to decorate the campsite.
This is one elaborate ritual you're setting up.
It's only for tonight. You'll be glad later that I didn't skip a single step.
I stand at the edge of the campsite surrounded by flowers, stones, and lights, and I look at her.
The sun is setting behind her, and it looks almost like the whole campsite – or even, this entire place – has become her domain.
Almost done. The domain boundary has been set and the points and lines have been linked.
However... there is still one crucial thing missing. Without it, this domain will not be truly complete.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>5 The Unhulde's Domain</size>

scripts.say: The sun sets on the westerly horizon, draping the whole campsite in golden light.
Do you smell that? Something's in the air.
I'm burning aromatic oils.
It's a mixture of medicinal herbs and resin. Old and calming.
Smells a bit odd, but you're right – it is calming.
Scent is the magic that makes people mingle.
Moreover, it makes you feel like this place is more than just a campsite, doesn't it?
That's true. Like you said earlier, it's missing some crucial thing, though.
I look around the campsite.
We have a tent, our essential camping supplies form a neat stack, and the flowers encircling the camp add a soft color as the cherry on top.
On the surface, we have everything we could possibly need.
So what is it that's missing?
This place has symbols, a campfire, stones, and vines. It's all here, and yet, the full picture isn't complete.
The scene feels like a full painting ready to come to life, but there's not a single sound.
It seems you've figured it out.
Color, smell, form, light – those are all here.
If there is a single thing missing, it would have to be...
Sound, I'm guessing.
She produces a velvet bag, prudently undoes the knot, and then takes out a couple of silver bells.
They're all fairly small and have minute patterns engraved on their surfaces, which reflect a cold light.
These are no mere ornaments. They are musical anchors, so to speak.
Each and every one of their syllables will summon an echo of fate.
Where are you gonna hang them?
In the four cardinal directions. Each somewhere where the wind blows.
The wind ringing the bells will awaken this domain.
She hangs a bell in all four corners of the camp.
As soon as she hangs the last one, a gentle wind blows by, and the bells start ringing one by one with a clear sound.
First there is one sound, then another – they resonate with each other, creating a rhythm. It's like some sort of signal from space.

options.content: You really prepared a lot for this.

scripts.say: So... has the ritual started?
You really prepared a lot for this.
The domain has been made.
There will be no turning back once you step forward. Are you ready, Commander?
The bells continue ringing without end. She stands at the center of the campsite, a mysterious smile on her face.
Her figure is bathed in golden light and encased in a strange aura. It really is like she's standing in a domain of her own making.
I don't even stop to ask a question, I simply walk toward her.
Welcome, my familiar.
Welcome... to my domain.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>6 The Unhulde's Feast</size>

scripts.say: Seizing the fading glow of sunset, August and I started making food.
She did most of the cooking, while I committed myself to a more supporting role.
She spread out a tablecloth with a star map motif and placed down one dish after the next. Her motions were careful at every step, almost like she was performing a ritual.
Will dinner also be in your signature esoteric style?
Naturally. I'd loathe to break up the mood tonight.
She takes out a bottle of jam from the basket and spreads it thinly on her rye bread, then covers it with a few slices of some purple vegetable I don't recognize.
Meanwhile, the fruit and meat stew in the pot simmers quietly. It smells rich, with a dash of the unknown mixed in.
The soup smells like... I don't even know what.
It's the flavor of destiny.
There's sweetness amid the acidity, and it's soft, yet prickly – much like the distance between us tonight.
She takes out a glass bottle with an antique shape and pours its contents into a cup.
The liquid is deep crimson. It looks like blood under the light of the campfire.
And this is the blood of the stars. Drink it and rejoice. I made it myself.
I don't like the dangerous ring that name has.
With danger comes rewards – nothing ventured, nothing gained.
Once she's done preparing everything, she presents me with the first dish.
Enjoy, my "Commander." You'll hurt my feelings if you won't even have one bite.
Uh... Just asking to make sure: All the ingredients ARE edible, right?
That is unimportant. What matters is that those who eat this will be etched into the Unhulde's memory.
Granted, you already are – but still, there is no wriggling your way out of this.
The corners of her lips curl upward ever so slightly. Her voice carries that familiar blend of danger and kindness.
The campfire's light is reflected in her eyes, twinkling quietly like the stars above.
I accept the food – black bread with jam spread on top – and take a bite.
It's... actually pretty good.
Next, I have a spoonful of the meat soup.
The meat flavor really comes through, and the freshness of the fruit meshes well with it.
Did you perchance think the Unhulde would give you food poisoning?
No, but I thought the herbs and weird jam you prepared were going to make me hallucinate or something.
Well then, do you think what I'm doing now is a hallucination?
She runs her delicate fingers along my cheek and lips, leaving them with a lingering warmth.
I'm pleased.
I was all but certain you'd refuse to touch the food.
Many flinch at the first sight of them, but you didn't.

options.content: I must be under a spell.

scripts.say: I must be under a spell.
Even if you are, it's a spell that you chose to receive.
You've never belonged to the mundane rabble.
That's because I trust you.
Trust, you say?
I see. Still, you'd be wise to remember this: Once you start, it's hard to stop with "trust" alone.
She pours the "blood of the stars" into my cup. Forebodingly, yet elegantly, the red liquid shakes.
We cling our silver glasses together, and they produce a clear sound.
I taste the suspicious drink. The first thing that hits me is a fruity sweetness, then a faint bitterness. It leaves an indescribable aftertaste on the tip of my tongue.
I've never tasted anything like this before.
This flavor was made specifically for this night and for you.
She leans closer, either probing me for a reaction or overtly cutting the distance between us.
Dinner is over, my familiar.
Now, let us head into the galaxy.

sequence:
A Night with the Unhulde

<size=45>7 Into the Galaxy</size>

scripts.say: The sun has completely set over the horizon and the curtain of night has descended.
The time has come to change the light.
She claps lightly two times, and the light sources all around the tent go out one by one.
Everything turns black, almost like the darkness itself has answered her summons. Even the wind seems to stop on August's command.
Is it finally time for your ritual?
Yes. Close your eyes and accustom yourself to the dark.
I close them gently and I sense that she's coming closer. I sit down, and she does the same.
Now slowly open them again, my familiar. The stars have lit up for us.
The vast night sky stretches on above. The stars seem so close it feels like I could reach out and touch them.
Give me your hand.
The touch of her hand is soft and cool – it's like the light of the stars on my skin.
She points up at the sky, toward one star in particular.
That is the first star. Remember it.
That's the second, and that one... a little more to the left.
She points to one, then another, connecting them like she's weaving a thread high up above.
This is Corona Borealis.
It looks like... a crown made of stars.
That's precisely what it is.
According to an old myth, it was a gift from Dionysus, the god of wine, to his lover.
It shines with a light that is not of this world and only appears during the night.

options.content: We must be really lucky to see it tonight.
What if I were to take it?

scripts.say: I suppose we should count our lucky stars for that.
What's even luckier for you is that I'm here, watching the stars right by your side.
Etch this good fortune into your memory, my familiar.
What if I were to take it?
Well, I wouldn't stop you, I know that much.
You are my familiar. You deserve everything.
She suddenly shifts away a bit and tilts her body, looking for an angle to the sky.
This crown is yours now.
Tonight, I will be the one to crown you.
Her fingertips grace my forehead.
It's as if something actually fell from the skies, and she's carefully adjusting it between my eyebrows.
Others may try to approach, but the stars will not respond – they only do so for the chosen.
Did the stars choose me, or did you?
Why not both?
She runs her fingers along my cheek, gently stopping at the very tip of my jaw.
Her gaze pierces through my body like a stake.
You don't seem intent... on running away.
You wouldn't give me the chance to in the first place.
Ah, my familiar has learned to struggle.
Now I'm all the more eager to see what becomes of you after I make you fully submit.
How far will you take things tonight? The decision is all yours.
All of a sudden, the starlight pouring down on us is starting to warm me up.

sequence:
Cubicle Dreamin'

<size=45>Productive Work</size>
<size=34>This is, apparently, all just a dream.</size>
<size=34>All characters in this scenario are entirely fictional and have no relation to real people in the port.</size>
<size=34>...According to Akashi's narrative disclaimer, anyway.</size>

scripts.say: Azur Lane Technologies Ltd. - Corporate Headquarters
Good morning, Your Excellency. Did you sleep well?
Still not fully awake yet, I suppose...
That's understandable. You did only get three hours of sleep.
Fired up and ready to get to work already? Wonderful.
Boss? Are you referring to me?
I'm afraid you have it backwards. You're in charge here. I'm just your secretary.
I have good news – everyone pulled through and managed to solve that problem that cropped up.
As you instructed last night, I gave today off to all project members and let them go home to rest.
This has been a ton of work for all of us. All that's left is a few minor adjustments, which I'll see to in just a minute.
Also, I made you breakfast and coffee. I wasn't sure when you would wake up, so I wrapped them up in foil to keep them warm.
...What is it? Do you feel guilty about dozing off on the job?
Please, you shouldn't. You were far too exhausted to perform any kind of work.
Had I fallen asleep, you wouldn't have tried to wake me up, would you? It's the same thing.

options.content: "Fair enough. Remember to take breaks, yourself."

scripts.say: I will take one once I finish this task. Rest assured, I'm no workaholic and I know when to stop.
Oh, I just remembered something important...
London rises from her chair and walks up to me.
Please hold still, Your Excellency. This will only take a moment.
There. I straightened out your necktie and collar.
We can't allow our boss to look sloppy before employees, can we?
I enjoy my breakfast and coffee while London updates me on our project. It's a relief to hear that we summarily resolved the issue that came up last night.

sequence:
Cubicle Dreamin'

<size=45>Office Romance</size>
<size=34>This is, apparently, all just a dream.</size>
<size=34>All characters in this scenario are entirely fictional and have no relation to real people in the port.</size>
<size=34>...According to Akashi's narrative disclaimer, anyway.</size>

scripts.say: Azur Lane Technologies Ltd. - Corporate Headquarters
Mmrgh! These stockings are so annoying to wear...
Same with these high heels. My feet hurt more than usual...
This is so dumb. Why won't these stockings just–
*RIP*
D-did... the stocking just rip?
No, dammit... I can't wear a torn stocking!
If I'd known this would happen, I would've asked for a larger size...
...But that's no excuse to give up. The whole point of this is to try to get the Commander's attention!
I'll get through this! Whatever it takes to capture the Commander's heart!
...C-Commander?!
When did you get here? You didn't hear me say anything, did you?!
...You just arrived? But why? You're a whole hour early to work!
(*sigh*... There goes the surprise factor of my stockings...)
(This totally ruins the mood! Why would you clock in THIS early, you doofus?!)
(No, wait! If I play my cards right, I can turn this in my favor and ask the Commander to help me put these stockings on...)
(Yes! This is the perfect opportunity for us to become closer with one another!)
(Deep breaths... You can do this, me!)
Say, um, my dear Commander...
Would you mind... helping me put on these stockings?
Be gentle, please. I don't want them to rip!
(Gosh... Not only am I alone with my to-be sweetheart, I even got help with putting my legwear on.)
(Ahh, this is like a dream romance come true!)
Heehee...♥

sequence:
Cubicle Dreamin'

<size=45>Living la Vida Pirata</size>
<size=34>This is, apparently, all just a dream.</size>
<size=34>All characters in this scenario are entirely fictional and have no relation to real people in the port.</size>
<size=34>...According to Akashi's narrative disclaimer, anyway.</size>

scripts.say: Azur Lane Technologies Ltd. - Corporate Headquarters
Weigh anchooor! Essex, setting sail!
Sharp right rudder and full speed aheeead!
It's nighttime, and the office is all but empty. A lone shipgirl-turned-pirate slides across the floor atop her five-wheeled "warship."
Whoa! Commander spotted to our bow! Hoist sails! It's boardin' time!
C'mere!
I grab her "warship" and stop her drunken charge by a hair's breadth.
What?! You've summoned a kraken to try and seize my ship, eh!
Well, that's not happenin' on my watch! Time to crank up the horsepower! *glug, glug, glug*...
Hey! That's my liquid courage! Give it back!
I'm so fed up with work... I wanna be a pirate and do what I want 'cause a pirate is free!
You wouldn't get it! You don't know what it's like!
I'll never be as good as my seniors, and my juniors are outperforming me like you wouldn't believe...
So you know what? Screw it! I'm peacing out of this damn rat race!
Hoist sail again, mateys! Head for the open sea! Ahahahaha!
I can hardly believe I'm talking to the same woman who, just this afternoon, completed her tasks efficiently without a grumble.
I should say something to try and calm her down.
It is? Oh, right! It is!
But... once the holiday's over, it's right back to work! Screw that! I'm quitting!
You do? Oh hell yeah!
Then I'll be the captain, and you can be my quartermaster! Together, we'll conquer all the seven seas!
I'm tired... Sho shleepy... *yawn*...
Actually... I'm retiring for the night...
Zzzzz... Commander... shtay with me...
Without any warning, she leans forward and buries her head in my chest.
Hopefully, come morning, she'll have forgotten about this whole thing...

sequence:
前进吧，{namecode:144}！

<size=45>一 战斗吧，{namecode:144}！</size>

scripts.say: 某日·演习海域
重樱的重巡们正在使用着演习海域。
身披舰装的少女们在海域里，赌上自己的一切，为着今天第一名的荣耀而奋斗……啊啊，这标题实在是太棒了！
别光顾着拍照啦，姐姐！你也是演习的一员啊！
{namecode:64}也是！演习的时候稍微认真点啊！指挥官也在看着呢！
哎呀，放心吧，区区训练演习，对我来说只是小事一桩~
比起这个，不关注一下正在场上的妹妹吗？
！好快…而且好准
啊呀？总觉得你有些不甘心呢。
唔…在、在下也还可以更加——
……哈啊啊啊啊！
呼——这样就结束了吗？
辛苦了喵！刚刚的表现毫无疑问是目前最好的喵！一定可以给指挥官留下深刻印象的喵。
真、真的吗！那、那实在是太好了呢。
不过，下次我会做得更好的——
（我还要变得更强才行！）

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Venerated Elder</size>

scripts.say: Port - Pier
Today I practice drawing against the waves.
It's my turn! Draw!
Hermes was in perfect form as usual.
... Just then, I saw someone peeking her head out from behind the wall...
Ah! Commander! Good morning!
Oh, I'm here doing... perfectly normal... ordinary things! You know...
I followed Centaur's line of sight all the way over to Hermes, practicing her draws.
I have a little sister whose name is also Hermes. She's named after her, the Grand Matriarch of All Aircraft Carriers. I just wanted to bear witness to her.
But I haven't been able to work up the courage to go talk to her... so I'd just as soon watch from the sidelines here...
I don't suppose you could help me, Commander...?
Waaaait?!
What is it, Commander? Do you feel the urge to Duel burning within you?
Um, Elder Hermes...
You are... Oh! You're Centaur, our new recruit! I've heard you have a younger sister named Hermes, is that right?
Y-Yes!
Centaur let out a sigh of relief.
Come then! Let's test your mettle in a duel!
Commander, I'll be borrowing this one for a bit!
Huh? Where? What?!
Hermes started dragging Centaur off somewhere.
She would grow accustomed to Hermes's eccentricities in time... probably.

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Centaur Pushes It</size>

scripts.say: Port - Plaza
I was on patrol with my secretary, Centaur.
Out for a stroll with Centaur, are we, Commander?
Good morning, Elder Hood! Indeed, we're making our appointed rounds.
My, how lovely it is to see a polite young lady who understands proper manners. Of course, you need not stand on ceremony. We are all equals here.
I understand. However, as I see it, all the ladies of the fleet... you are all respected Elders worthy of esteem.
Hehe, I hadn't thought of it that way. Very well, as you were.
I trust you'll be attending tomorrow's tea party?
Yes, Elder Hood! I wouldn't miss it for the world!
It seemed Centaur had no problem dealing with her "Elders" of the Royal Navy.
Comainder, and, um, you, Ms., um... have a candy~
Mutsuki, that's Centaur. She's new to the fleet.
Verily! Elder Mutsuki, Elder Kisaragi, I am Centaur of the Royal Navy.
Centaur gave a deep bow to the two destroyers.
Huuuuh?! Elder...?
Indeed. As far as I'm concerned, you two are honoured Elders worthy of my respect.
Wow! No one's ever called me "Elder Mutsuki" before!
Mutsuki, this isn't right... We can't have an aircraft carrier calling us "Elder," it's weird...
It's fine! We just gotta lift up our heads and puff out our chests and act like the proud Elders we are!
Yes, please don't mind me.
Errmmm... But I still think it's kinda weird...
... So Centaur would respectfully call everyone "Elder."

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 3 - The Meaning of Respect</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
The business of Centaur calling everyone "Elder" had become the talk of the fleet.
Hmmm...? Why is it I call everyone "Elder?" ... Commander, you know I was born after the War, don't you?
Since the fighting was already over, there was a chance our entire class of ships would be cancelled.
But in the end, for whatever reason, we came to be.
However, with the War behind us, we never had a chance at the glorious, tumultuous lives of our Elders.
I would be lying if I said I didn't yearn for that excitement.
Centaur spoke dispassionately.
And yet, it's more than that.
Commander, I lived my life in a world of peace. I have never known the horrors of war.
But the more I learn of the deeds of my storied Elders, the more I have come to understand what war is.
It is not something that I, who has never experienced that hell, can invoke so cavalierly.
That is why I so deeply respect and admire those Elders who fought in the War, and even more so those who did not survive it.
In fact, the word "Elder" cannot adequately express the level of esteem to which I hold them.
Centaur appeared lost in her thoughts.
But if I'm causing trouble then perhaps I've miscalculated...
I'll talk it over with everyone. If some Elders are bothered by it, I'll do what I can to show my respect through my actions rather than words.~
I realized I had no reason to worry about Centaur, at least with this "Elder" business.

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Unexpected Developments</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Centaur, come play house with us! Kisaragi wants you to play too!
Yes. Even though I don't like planes, I like you, Centaur... Won't you play with me...?
Oh, but of course I shall.
Centaur, did you forget you promised to play hide and seek with us?
Certainly not, Elder Sims, I've been looking forward to it.
C'mon, let's go! Hammann is getting all pouty.
Um, 'scuse me, Commander... I'm lookin' for Centaur. She was gonna rehearse with me...
Yes, Elder Cygnet, you go on ahead. I'll be along shortly.
Cheers. I've got a feelin' we'll have a lot more confidence with you there, Centaur. Don't forget now.
I wasn't sure why, but once everyone heard about Centaur's little "Elder" quirk, she quickly grew popular among the destroyers.
I simply told the destroyer Elders my feelings, and they welcomed me with open arms.
The destroyer Elders are truly kindhearted.
...You're so lucky... How is it that my heartfelt, impassioned feelings still go unrequited...
A cold, mature voice seething with jealousy emerged from parts unknown.
...Although I didn't see her approach, I knew all this talk of destroyers would naturally summon one particular individual.
Oh, Elder Ark Royal, good morning!
Yes. That one.

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Centaur's Image</size>

scripts.say: You've managed to attain everything I've ever wished for in life... Oh, how I envy you...
Oh, r- really...?
Envying the youth is not a good look for you, Ark Royal.
But that's everything I've ever wanted!
Ah! Good morning, Elder Victorious!
Morning. Here's my mission report, Commander. Please look it over.
My, upon closer inspection, I sense a sort of familiarity about you, Centaur. Why, I dare say with a change of clothes you could very well pass for me.
You think so too, Victorious? I'm glad I'm not the only one...
You're in good spirits again! ...But are you sure this isn't just some psychological by-product of your jealousy?
Absolutely not! It's more that this air of familiarity emanating from Centaur has me wanting to get closer to her... at which point we can address the prior issue...
All right then.
To be honest, I feel the same familiarity from both of you, Elders.
Do you now? What say we leave this silly old biddy behind and go for a spot of tea? We have much to discuss.
Commander, would you mind lending me your secretary for a tick?
Now Centaur, your appearance here truly is unique. Take these ears, for example, are they as real as Duke of York's?
Indeed. Actually, I was somewhat surprised when I noticed I was a bit different from my Elders.
That's true. They're not even like the animal ears on the Sakura girls. Really something special.
Any idea why that is, Commander?
Um, while I don't fully understand it myself, from time to time, I do get a sort of foggy image that comes to mind...
Oh? And what is it?
Might it have something to do with my name? A centaur is a mythological creature from deep in the forest, after all.
Perhaps that forms an association in the collective consciousness with the race of forest-dwelling Elves...?
"Collective consciousness...?" That sounds like the kind of thing Akashi and Yuubari are always on about.
Elder Akashi and Elder Yuubari? I'll have to be sure to ask them about it next time I see them.
So these ears truly are as mysterious as Duke of York's... Anyway, these fantastical clothes of yours are very much my style. You'll have to let me look at them so I can make myself a set.
That would be fine...
Now I have some matters to attend to. ――Commander, I'm returning your secretary.
I should be going as well. But Centaur, the next time you play with the destroyer girls, why don't you, um, well, invite me along...?
Certainly! Thank you very much, Elders!

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Childe of the Fleet</size>

scripts.say: Port - Plaza
I was on patrol with my secretary, Centaur.
Although, honestly, by this point, Centaur was capable of handling this particular duty on her own.
But she insisted it was bad for my health to sit too long, so she forced me to come out with her.
Out for a stroll with Centaur, are we, Commander?
Oh, yes, indeed! And good morning to you, Elder Hood!
Hehe, aren't you ever the polite child.
Oh my no, you flatter me.
Did you get a chance to try that tea I gave you?
Yes! I can't say I know much about tea, but it was delicious!
I'm glad you liked it. If you'd ever like to know more about tea, my door is always open.
Thank you very much.~
Hey! It's Centaur!
Are you working again, Centaur...?
Yes, I am! And I see these two Elders are in fine spirits today!
Make sure to work hard...!
I won't let you down!
Centaur, I'm giving you this candy so you'll remember to come play with us!
Of course. I'll play with you later today.
No candy for Comainder!
I felt ever so slightly spurned...
While she was still calling everyone "Elder," Centaur's interactions with the rest of the fleet had become much less awkward.

options.content: Ask her why she's still calling everyone "Elder."

scripts.say: Oh, that? I suppose it's because "Elder" has a new meaning for me~~

sequence:
Centaur and the Port "Elders"

<size=45>Chapter 7 - True Equals</size>

scripts.say: Centaur spoke of the "new meaning" of "Elder."
It has been some time since I first joined the fleet.
In that time, I've grown closer to my Elders, and seen past the walls they put up on the battlefield.
I know now they are people, just like me. They have sadness and they have joy, they have their likes and their dislikes.
Like you, Commander, you have those times when you just can't take work anymore and you doze off on your desk.

options.content: Explain to her that's completely normal.

scripts.say: Yes, it's completely normal. Just as everyone has their own opinions, and from time to time that leads to conflict...
But in service of our collective goals, we work together, we help each other. That's the fleet I always dreamt of.
And now I'm a part of that fleet too... so no longer do I merely respect everyone, now I truly love everyone.

options.content: Ask her if that includes her Commander...

scripts.say: C- Commander... of course, I love you too...
Centaur turned bright red.
What I'm getting at is, in the beginning, I called everyone "Elder" because I respected their service in the Great War.
But now, because I so love and cherish fighting alongside them in the name of peace, that's why I call them Elder.
Ahahaha, and I'm a little embarrassed to say it, but the main reason is I just got used to calling everyone that!
It was so complicated, and yet so simple...
I'm doing all the talking here. Now it's your turn, Commander.
I mean, I've been your secretary ship for this long. It's only natural I've gotten to know you very well.
But I'd still like to hear some of it straight from the horse's mouth. Tell me a secret, Commander. Tell me something you've never told anyone.
Hehe, won't you tell me more... about you? Commander...? ... Oh Elder One...?

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Regular Ol' Summer?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Beach
So this is the beach that is reserved for the fleet's use...
The vast blue that stretches across the horizon, the comforting warmth of the sand between your toes... what a wonderful place!
Elder Javelin is...
Ah, Centaur! Over here~!
Good day, Elder Javelin. Thank you for taking time out of your day for me.
(Haha! I never expected someone to call me "Elder"~) Good morning!
Don't sweat the small stuff! Commander's been working extra hard to finish everything up before vacation, so I have plenty of time to spare!
Yes'm!
Why don't I show you around?

The east side of the beach is where the Sakura girls like to gather. Last year, they blew everyone away with the quantity and quality of their swimsuits... but there might be some competition this year~
Look over there - it's Kaga and... huh? Where's Akagi?
Um, is that her over there?
There are a lot of pests trying to swarm around Commander this year... Ahaha, but I shall not permit that...!
Oh my, Akagi. Just what could you be talking about? Commander just wanted to enjoy some relaxation with big sister... isn't that right?
Aha... ahaha... ahahahahaha! So much filth... I simply must "clean" this beach up...
Hehe... Cleaning, huh? I'm not half bad at that myself, you know~?
See? All the Sakura ships get along with each other so well!
Should we really be walking away...?
It'll be fine! Probably...
I-I see, I am glad that my Elders are full of energy!
And over there... is that Elder Takao?
That seems to be... Takao's idea of training. Blindfolded watermelon splitting, she calls it. If she succeeds, everyone gets to enjoy fresh watermelon - two birds with one stone!
Strangely ingenious...
Oh, she just landed a clean blow.
Way to go, Takao!
Let's also go grab a couple of slices!
Because we have the support of the military, they provide us with all the watermelons we could ever want! There's always plenty of fun to be had!
That sounds like a fine arrangement, Elder Javelin.

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Summer's Secret Weapon?</size>

scripts.say: Ping Hai! Shigure! Are you two also getting watermelon?
Mm... watermelon is delicious.
Javelin, huh?
Is that the newbie over there?
That's right, I'm showing her around!
Good day, Elder Shigure, Elder Ping Hai.
Oh, I like this one already! If you ever need any advice, Shigure's got your back!
Um... I don't remember seeing you at the kung fu school...
Haha, don't worry about it~
Elder Shigure's swimsuit... is very distinctive. It gives off a completely different vibe than swimsuits worn by the others...
You're talking about this? It's a school swimsuit! These are considered legendary where we're from!
And, I'll let you into a little secret... Commander probably has a thing for these!
Ehh?! Really?
Who knows~? I promised Yamashiro that I'd go play with her, so I'm gonna head off. If you're interested in learning more, you know where to find me~
It's a promise, then! Tell me more about it later!
Sure, sure.
I had no idea the Sakura Empire had developed such a powerful secret weapon...!
There sure seems to be a lot of mystique behind this "school swimsuit..." Um, Elder Javelin...?
I-I'm totally fine! Just talking to myself! Anyway, let's continue the tour!
This is where the Royal Navy gathers! When it comes to swimsuits, the Sakura girls might be impressive, but we have nothing to fear as long as we have the invincible Hood!
Look over there - her outfit is as gorgeous as ever!
As expected of Elder Hood. Just by sitting there, she gives off the elegance of a Renaissance painting...

This year, we have our new contestants from Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion. And then, you can never count out the eccentric style of the Iron Blood... Mm, there's going to be some fierce battles this summer!
Um, Elder Javelin, what kind of "battles..."
...Centaur, listen closely. As your Elder, there's something important I need to teach you!
Y-yes?
Don't forget this. For a young girl, the summer, the beach, and her swimsuit...
... are a warzone!
R-really?!
Of course! Getting that perfect beach body, avoiding getting sunburned, coordinating your outfit, bringing out your charms to the fullest! It's a never-ending learning experience!
It's suuuuuper difficult to get everything right!
And the prize on the line is super important too - Commander's attention!
I... I see...

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 3 - The Coast Watcher's Vacation</size>

scripts.say: Too bad I couldn't teach this to you earlier, Centaur. You're really pretty, so it's a darn shame that you aren't also wearing a swimsuit...
Indeed... Sincerest apologies, but because I just arrived here, I didn't have time to prepare a swimsuit...
Don't sweat it! For now, why don't we sit down over there? I'll teach you just how important these summer battles are!
Um... weren't you going to show me around...?
Saratogaaaaaaaaaa!!! Stop running and give my soda back!!
Ahahaha! You'll have to catch me if you want me to stop!
This is where the Eagle Union sets up camp. Looks like they're not as interested in playing in the water...
But there's one thing you can always bet on - if Saratoga's around, things are going to be real lively!
Impressive... Elder Saratoga's reputation precedes her...
Well, even I call her "teacher" sometimes, but she looks no different from a little kid like this...
Huh? Who's that over there...?
I believe that is Elder Ark Royal. What an elegant swimsuit.
But what is she doing sitting over there...?
Muahahaha! It is I, Ark Royal, who shall ensure that all the destroyers can frolic safely!
Well, as you can see... she only looks cool until she opens her mouth...
Th-this dedication... Elder Ark Royal is so cool...!
Ahaha... I suppose so, if you ignore the creepy laughs that sometimes leak out.
In the end, everyone knows that she's a good person who cares the most about protecting our destroyers.
Unfortunately she often ends up scaring them away when she gets a bit too "passionate."
Nothing says summer like the sun, the beach, and destroyers! Summer is the best!
Elder Ark Royal! Good day!
*cough* Ahem! Centaur?! Javelin as well? I don't usually see the two of you together.
I'm currently showing Centaur around!
Ohh... Javelin, your swimsuit is... so very nice!
Ehehe, thank you~♪
How about you, Centaur? Not going to wear a swimsuit, even though you're at the beach?
Um, I just arrived recently, so I didn't have time to get one...
I see... It would be a shame to not show off your beauty.
Right? That's what I said too!
*gasp*! I'm getting carried away. I'd love to chat more, but I can't afford to take my eyes off the destroyers! Sorry!
All righty, we'll be heading off then!
Keep up the good work, Elder Ark Royal.
Centaur, you sure are innocent...

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Beachside Sweets</size>

scripts.say: Ah, the girls from Iris Libre and Vichya Dominion are over here!
Elder Rodney appears to be here as well.
Huh? Really?
Rodney! Dunkerque! Émile! Over here!
You must be... Ah, the one who recently joined the fleet, Centaur.
Yes! Elder Dunkerque, Elder Émile Bertin, and finally, Elder Rodney, it is a pleasure to meet you all.
Hello, Centaur. Just Émile is fine~
Hehe, nice to meet you.
Good day. I met these two along the way, so I came with them here.
I'm sorry, Javelin. I wasn't able to convince Jean Bart to come after all. But I'll make sure she'll be here tonight.
Thanks a ton, Dunkerque!
Excuse me... is something happening at night?
Hehe, that's when the real fun begins! It has something to do with you, so make sure to be there!
If that's the case, I'll be looking forward to it.
More importantly, I made sweets for all of you. Want to try?
Centaur, Dunkerque is famous around here for making super delicious sweets!
I've heard the same from my sister. Something about there being a world-class patissier from the Vichya Dominion.
Non, you're making me sound cooler than I am... Here, I just enjoy making sweets~
It's... amazing!
Right~? I'd love to dig in, but... I don't have the courage to look at the scales afterwards...
Same... These are absolutely delicious, but I'll have to hold back since I need to head to beach volleyball practice soon.
Ah, don't worry! Just let me know and I'll be glad to make more.
Dunkerque, why'd you decide to bring sweets to the beach though...?
They're as delicious as ever, but, considering how hot it is, wouldn't it be better to pack a lunchbox like Javelin did?
Then, should I rent a minifridge and make ice cream next time?
I wonder if you'll ever decide to bring something other than sweets...
Ah, but ice cream is a great idea, so I'm all for it!
It behooves a hot summer day.
Um, but the calories...
Ah, forget it... I want some ice cream too!

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Iron Blood Front</size>

scripts.say: Elder Javelin, the Elders from the Iron Blood have arrived.
Oh, you're right!
They're all dressed up in swimsuits as well!
Last year, Eugen was the only one who wore a swimsuit...
Heeey! Over here~!
Elder Z25, Elder Z46, it is a pleasure to meet you both.
Hwuh? P-p-pleased to meet you...
Miss Dunkerque, may we please join you?
What reason is there... to call me "Elder..."
But I also crave the delicious sweetness.
Of course. Here, there's plenty for you both.
You're so nice, Dunkerque~
Zweifü, Viersechs, you can have some of my food as well!
Looks like the party already started without us.
Graf, did you want to join in as well?
Do I look like the type that enjoys group activities?
I only came because Commander told me to wait here. Nothing more.
Sure. But since Dunkerque went through all the trouble of making these sweets, it would be rude of us not to try some.
Fine... Mmf!! What is this exquisite sweetness...!
I understand... this is why she has such a reputation. I'm a believer now.
Elder Tirpitz and Elder Graf Zeppelin from the Iron Blood, pleased to meet you.
So you're the carrier who's gained quite the notoriety for calling everyone your "Elder..."
Not a bad ring to it though... I don't mind. Pleased to meet you.
Elder...? I suppose it's suitable enough...
(whispers) Elder Javelin, these two Elders seem to be very nice people.
(whispers) That's right... They may seem hard to approach at first, but they're actually very nice.
Um... Come to think of it, where's Deutschland?

Eugen seems to have planted some strange ideas in her head. She's been going on and on about "the optimal method of seducing Commander with a swimsuit" and ran off to find Eugen as soon as she arrived at the beach.
*sigh*...
Well, at least Eugen managed to find some way to keep her busy. We should thank her for that.
I was thinking... since there are so many of us here, why don't we come up with a game to play together?
How about some beach volleyball?
Tirpitz, are you actually the sporty type?
Don't get any strange ideas about me...
No, no! I just thought that was a great idea since we had all these sweets to eat! Let's all play some volleyball~!

sequence:
Midsummer Sagittarius

<size=45>Chapter 6 - In the Evening's Glow</size>

scripts.say: What a beautiful sunset...
More and more people turned up to the beach volleyball game and it turned into a big tournament...
What an interesting day it has been.
For all my Elders who have been through so much war to be able to relax like this...
No, it is because they have endured so much that they are fully able to cherish times of peace.
For someone like me, who was born into an era of peace, there is much that I can learn from the experiences of my Elders... I truly am glad that I was able to join this fleet...
Centaur~!
Elder Javelin! What's the matter?
I was looking for you! Were you watching the sunset?
Indeed! I was just reflecting upon various things...
Today was an extremely educating day for me.
Really? I thought it was just a day like any other.
Nay - today, I caught a glimpse of how my Elders live their lives when not in the heat of battle. That is already a valuable lesson.
I dunno... I don't think anyone was really thinking hard about how to spend their time off. Sometimes, we just want to kick back and have some fun! I'm the same way!
More importantly, it's too early to look back at all the stuff that happened today, because the day isn't over yet!
That's true, but... the beach volleyball tournament already ended, and everyone is packing their stuff and getting ready to leave...
Don't worry, just get ready for the nighttime activities!
Just look over there!
Everyone seems to be carrying some boxes over... what are those?
Ehehe, tada~! Tonight's main event - the fireworks show!
We'd like to formally welcome all our new friends from Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion as well as Centaur to the fleet!
So this is what you told me to look forward to earlier!
That's right! Look, even Jean Bart came, just as Dunkerque promised!
Let's not stand around here though, everyone's waiting for us!
The fun's only just getting started!
It's too soon to look back, huh...
Yup! Now, let's play the night away!

sequence:
The Miniature Head Maid

<size=45>Chapter 1 - A Little Visitor</size>

scripts.say: Port - One Day
So... this is the "Port," is it?
It's much larger than I expected...
Right! I must report to this "Commander" Akashi spoke of~
Are these documents ready for the Commander, Your Majesty?
Naturally! You're not implying my royal self would make mistakes, hmm?
Hmph... and yet my servant still expects me to deliver them in person. The nerve of... Hm?
Ah...
Belfast?
Good day, mesdames. I am Belfast. May I ask, do either of you know where the "Commander" might be?
B-B-Belfast! You've shrunk! Aiiieeee!
What... what's become of you...?
Hm? What are you talking about? Mesdames, I can assure you that I have not shrunk.
Nya! I finally found you, nya! Didn't I tell you not to go running off, nya?!
Oh, Madam Akashi...
A-A-Akashi?! Explain yourself at once!
Well, er, okay, so it's like this, nya...

sequence:
The Miniature Head Maid

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Accidents Have Consequences</size>

scripts.say: Port - A Few Days Ago
Ready, nya?
Yep. Just give the word.
Hit it, nya! Commence "Wisdom Cube Composition Analysis Test #256," nya!
It's fair to say the Wisdom Cubes are sort of like our keels.
If there's something wrong with your keel, you're in big trouble, nya.
Although it's common knowledge we were born from the Wisdom Cubes, no one has ever successfully analyzed the internal composition of the cubes themselves...
The only way to get our hands on a Wisdom Cube is to harvest 'em, nya... They're what you'd call a "black box," nya...
But this time is different! This time we have this!
This "weapon" we got from a battle with the Sirens, nya.
We've tentatively named it the "Focused Beam Emitter."
While we don't yet understand the principles at work, we do know that the device emits a heat ray with tremendous penetrative power when stimulated by a high voltage direct current, nya.
We had a little problem last time... Yuubari said we oughta try recharging it, nya. Result was a base-wide blackout, and damn near a hole in my head, nya...
We must be willing to make sacrifices in the name of science...
Safety comes first, nya...
We've prepared a large capacitor to guard against any power surges this time.
So I don't expect we'll run into any such problems again...
Let's run through the experiment one more time, nya!
We will direct the high-energy heat ray at the Wisdom Cube in an attempt to disintegrate or penetrate it, that we may analyze its internal composition.
Wisdom Cube and Emitter in position nya! We're gonna see some serious shit, nya...
Engaging. Countdown: three, two...
Madam Akashi, I've come to retrieve those docu—
B-Belfast, nya!? Yuubari, halt the expe—!
One! Firing the Emitter!

sequence:
The Miniature Head Maid

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Sisters?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Present
The prismatic light dancing from the irradiated Wisdom Cube was spectacular, nya!
Belfast did take a direct hit from the beam, that was indeed a concern, nya...
But on the other hand, the results were...
On the other hand?
The Wisdom Cube we were testing just disappeared, nya!
And this little kid appeared in its place, nya...
Oh, my sister Madam Belfast is here too.
Here you are. Good day, Your Majesty, Madam Warspite.
Oh, uhhh... good day, your majesty... Come now, Little Bel, give your big sister a hug~
Er, Edinburgh, Dear Sister, this... hurts...
Awwww, you're so cute, Little Bel!
Calm yourself, Dear Sister.
Awww, does Big Bel want a hug too~?
So... does this mean there are three sisters now...?
That is to say, this child is Belfast's little sister, right?
When she first appeared, she introduced herself as "Belfast," nya.
So as not to mix them up, I wanted to call her "Bel-chan" in the Sakura Empire way, but Yuubari reminded me she ought to have a Royal Navy name, nya. Hence "Little Bel," nya.
I feel it needs to be said that I was born in precisely this form, having never known a childhood.
However, it is my duty as head of the Royal Maids to instruct, raise, and nurture new recruits.
I shall proudly follow in the footsteps of my older sister!
Very good, then. Proceed!
And it is my duty as your big sister to love you ever so dearly~
Big Sister Edinburgh...

sequence:
The Miniature Head Maid

<size=45>Chapter 4 - An Adorable New Recruit</size>

scripts.say: Office - Later
Good Day, "Commander," Maid-in-Training Bel, reporting for duty.

options.content: Ask Belfast what happened to her

scripts.say: I am over here, Master. This is my— No, that's not right. Rather, I am... Hmm...
Let me explain it, nya...
Get it, nya? Things've gotten a teensy bit complicated, so I thought we'd just bring her over here, nya...
May I... stay here? "Commander?"

options.content: Tell her of course she can

scripts.say: Splendid~ You know, you're exactly as wise and as kind as the ladies said you were.
Does that mean... I can stay? This "Commander" may be a bit odd, but all the nice things the ladies said about the Commander were true.
I knew the Commander wouldn't leave a kid out on the street, nya~
Thank you very much, Master. As head maid, I vow to educate this child in our ways, raising her to be a truly magnificent maid.
Aye-aye! I shall do my best!
And so, the port welcomes a new recruit...
But I still don't know how Little Bel came to be in the first place, nya...
Mental Cube... logrithmic casing... radiation... two similar people... radiation... ?
Yuubari, do you have an idea, nya?
It's like... I almost have something... but... No, it's gone...
Sounds like we've got more experiments to do, nya...
Right then, how shall we conduct Test #257...?

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>1 The Earliest Bird</size>

scripts.say: Port - Just outside the office
I was just about to enter my office and resume another day of fleet management. Right as I put my hand on the doorknob, though, I sensed something was off.
At last. Come on in.
Then I realized what it was. Someone had entered my office before me.
Well? Are you not coming in?
Then how about a bet? I think you're feeling too startled to enter the office.
And the reason? You forgot to lock the door last night. Am I right, or am I wrong?
She was right. I gasped in surprise. How did she know?
Now, I know what you're thinking. You're wondering how I deduced that when you were working late all by yourself.
I couldn't just keep standing there, hesitant to enter my own office. It would be humiliating.
Besides, I was less worried about who's waiting for me inside than about the weird looks the ships in the hallway were giving me.
The answer is blatantly obvious. So obvious that it's pointless to bet about.
I opened the door.
The reason I came early, of course, was to get everything in order to assume my role as your secretary.
There in my chair sat Sovetskaya Belorussiya, claiming the throne as if she owned the place.
Exercise plans, commission forms, and feedback from members of the fleet... Today's agenda looks to be jam-packed indeed.
The girl, clad in the Northern Parliament's signature white uniform, stood up. She softly thumped the stack of paperwork on the desk.
At ease, Comrade. I'm as capable a secretary as they come. You're free to work me as you see fit.
She had already finished the morning's preliminary work, which I was grateful for. She walked over to me and whispered into my ear.
Next time, remember to lock the door.

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>2 Eyes on the Prize</size>

scripts.say: Port - A later date
Belorussiya and I were out on an inspection around the port.
Dang it, that's the 30th bust in a row! I can't believe my luck!
Gremyashchy, do you have any money left? If I could just buy the last ticket, we'd be guaranteed first prize!
Nope, I'm all out. Talk about bad luck, burning through 30 tickets then not having enough for the last one.
That's RNG for you, nya! You win some, you lose some, nya!
We came across Akashi, who had set up a lottery and was selling tickets.
Want to try your luck, Comrade?
There was but one lottery ticket left. We're guaranteed the first prize if we buy it, I reasoned.
I felt that would be mean to Gromky and Gremyashchy, though. After all, they'd spent all their money trying to get it.
When I pointed this out to Belorussiya, she took on an astonished look. The next moment, her expression returned to its default nonchalant state.
If you won't do it, then I will do it for you. I will share the prize with our comrades, so you need not feel guilt.
No objections? Good. Then stay here. I'll be right back.
I decided to let Belorussiya go ahead with her plan.
I'm back. With first prize, of course.
Belorussiya returned, holding a small envelope in her hand.
Are you sure you wanna give it to us, Comrade Commander? It's not like Belorussiya cheated or stole it from us!
You don't exactly owe it to us... Mm, that's all.
We don't, but we insist even so. I wouldn't have known that was the last ticket if you hadn't said it. Take it, and share it with all our comrades.
The ticket didn't cost much anyway, so I was fine with giving the prize away.
Come to think of it, they didn't even say what the prize was...

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>3 Luck of the Draw</size>

scripts.say: Za zdorov'ye! To the revolution!
To the revolution!
After the workday was over, I attended a welcoming party for the new Northern Parliament girls.
I thank you for your kindness, Comrade.
Granted, it is I who came up with this idea, but I was worried for a moment that you wouldn't approve of it.
Rather than profit from the prize, it instead incurred us further expenses. I feared you'd want to cut your losses.
Belorussiya went on to explain to me that the lottery prize was in fact a discount voucher for an all-inclusive party bundle.
As Gromky was left without a coin to her name, she obviously couldn't use the voucher herself. Thus, a bit of additional funding was needed.
We kind of didn't stop to check what the prize was. Mm, that's all.
You really bought thirty tickets, unaware of what you were hoping to win?
S-seeing the "almost sold out" on the store display gave us tunnel vision...
In the end, I was left feeling like we did a good deed today.
Now that we're alone, it's time I offer you an apology, Comrade. I did, in essence, coerce you into funding this lavish party.
I blame it on my being insistent on having things my way. It's a bad habit of mine.
I can be a wildcard, I will admit that. It does inconvenience people at times, too...
That rang true. I looked back to the day that I appointed her as my secretary. It was astonishing, to say the least.
Nevertheless, I figured there was no need to limit her authority as long as she uses it for good things, like on this day.
Her forwardness just required a bit of adjusting to. To that end, I had to get to know her better.

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>4 Belorussiya, As a Person</size>

scripts.say: While we still had all the Northern Parliament girls gathered in one place, I decided to chat them up. At the same time, I asked what they think about Belorussiya.
Belorussiya? She takes good care of people, despite what her attitude might have you think. She's a hell of a drinking partner to boot!
In fact, she might've thrown this party today because I told her I wanted to get together with everyone and have a drink!
That "everyone" includes you, Comrade! I won't take no for an answer! Hahaha!
Belorussiya is a very good person~
You say that about everyone. Is there even such a thing as a "bad person" to you?
Hmm... Now that you mention it, nope~
Surprise... Look, the commander isn't simply asking if she's good or bad, it's about the details. What's she like? How do you approach her? What sets her apart from others in battle?
Also, the commander wants to hear it from us. Not from Belorussiya.
Because it's too embarrassing to ask her directly?
No. That girl is on another level. If you asked her about herself, she'd probably play mindgames with you rather than tell the truth.
"That's what I thought, too. It's why I'm asking you all instead."
All right, I'll give you my take on her. But I expect you to stick around and share a drink with me.
I'll go and get you some beers~
What's the matter, Comrade Commander? You look a tad ill to me.
...Asking around about Belorussiya? Ah, I see. So you both had the same idea.
I am saying that Belorussiya has been asking around about you.
That girl has a strong and accurate intuition, but she is not one to pass on gathering concrete information to supplement it.
You know of her habit of making bets, yes? You'd be wise never to accept one.
"She's brought bets up a few times before, yeah. Why shouldn't I accept them?"
Because she only makes bets she is absolutely certain she will win.
Oh, sorry, it just came to me that your glass is empty. We can't have that now, can we?
My glass was, indeed, empty. Rossiya produced a bottle of vodka and poured me a drink.

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>5 Drunken Stupor</size>

scripts.say: The Northern Parliament girls had me beat.
I'd drank so much that I was feeling dizzy and disoriented. This was not at all how I wanted the day to end.
Are we there yet, Comrade? We've been walking for aaaages.
Geeeeesh, they just wouldn't let you off the hook back there, huh? Good thing I was there or you'd been stuck partying 'till morninnnng!
Belorussiya cried out from behind me. The normally gallant girl was drunk out of her mind, and her speech very much reflected that.
You'd be passed out on the floorrrrr by now if I hadn't come to your rescue!
It's good to talk to people, but y– *hic*! You should be more selective, that's all.
But then again, you're a kind and caring person, it's no wonder you shared drinks with everyone. I made a bet with Rossiya that this would happen, and clearly, I was right!
After asking around, I'd developed a fairly good idea of Belorussiya's character. It came at the cost of having to drink with everyone I talked to, though.
We're back, Comrade? Good, then I'll just... Zzzzz...
I took a seat, as did Belorussiya. Just like that, she collapsed onto me and dozed off.
Oh dear me. It seems you both bit off a little more than you can chew.
Indeed. You've clearly had enough drinks for one day. With that, I think it's time for the party to adjourn.
The other girls started throwing me looks of concern.
I'd hate to think that I forced them to call it for the night sooner than they would've liked...
Sorry to ask for a favor, Comrade, but... *hic*... help me back to the dorm...
She helped me just earlier, and now it was my time to help her.
Carrying her on my back, I took her to right outside her room.
The problem was, since all the Northern Parliament girls were attending the party, there was nobody else in the dormitory.
What's the holdup, Comrade? I'm too drunk to walk by myself...
The door's unlocked, so just... open it. I want to get to bed...
Dropping her off just outside her room would not be decent of me. I had to carry her inside.
I mustered all my courage, turned the door handle, and stepped inside.
Putting Belorussiya to bed relieved all the tension in me, both physically and mentally. Out of energy, I blacked out on the spot...

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>6 A Refreshing Morning</size>

scripts.say: A rigging power system that uses Wisdom Cubes as an energy source... Now this is fascinating.
I should discuss it with the commander, then posit the idea to the R&D department. But first...
How are you doing? Are you awake yet?
Good morning, Comrade. Should I get you a remedy for your hangover?
Or would you rather have breakfast? At this hour, you could enjoy a quiet meal in the dormitory salon and nobody would notice.
Belorussiya put down a heavy book she was reading and greeted me good morning in her regular gallant fashion.
From the look of things, I'd had far too much to drink and passed out on the couch in her room.
I really must apologize. My intention was to exhaust the party's liquor reserves so you wouldn't need to get drunk. And I tried, but as you saw, things didn't pan out that way.
Ironically, my plan only resulted in us both collapsing. That's only a passing grade at absolute best.
I would've had to keep drinking if she hadn't pulled me out of there, which would've impacted my work the following day. Her plan was by no means a failure.
What's more, I had a great night with good company thanks to her. If anything, I owe her my gratitude.
It's five in the morning. The destroyers are still asleep, and I think you can imagine where everyone else is. You can avoid being seen if you're quick.
How about a bet? I think you'd rather return to your private quarters than head straight to the office with me.
Hahahah! I win once again.
Rest assured, I'll help you get there unnoticed. After all, I had you carry me all the way here, so I do owe you one.
I'll set off smoke grenades in 15 minutes to cover your escape. Nobody should see you, assuming you run straight for your room.
I found myself in a somewhat precarious situation. My only real choice was to go along with her plan.
Splendid, then that's what we'll do. I'll have the preparations done in no time.
She got out of bed, stood up, and offered me a hand.
I've finally understood why you're adored by so many, Comrade. Hehe.

sequence:
White Gallantry

<size=45>7 Back in Office</size>

scripts.say: Port - Just outside the office
I was just about to enter my office and resume another day of fleet management. Right as I put my hand on the doorknob, though, I sensed something was off.
Well? Are you not going to enter?
I know who's behind that door. It's a very certain Northern Parliament battleship who, despite her domineering character, I knew I could trust.
Then how about a bet? I think I know the exact reason why you don't want to come in.
I could've sworn I locked the door the night before...
Though I hesitated for a moment, I entered the office. Inside, I found Belorussiya, sat at my desk and looking ardently through some documents.
Hahaha! You've realized you can't win my bets, have you?
On a more serious note, I've drafted a proposal for the R&D department and compiled the paperwork for the next merchant vessel convoy mission. Likewise for your business outing schedule.
I might add that today's weather is perfect for battle. Just give the order and I will sortie at a moment's notice.
Of course, I still left some work for you to do. You are the commander, after all.
She led me by the hand, taking me to my same old chair located behind the desk. I sat down.
Your office key slipped out of your pocket when you blacked out in my room. I left it in the drawer to your right.
...What's wrong? You have nothing to worry about.
This chair behind this desk belongs to my beloved guiding light. It belongs to you.
I'm only your secretary. My job is to serve you...
I felt something soft press against the back of my head.
...Using my methods, of course.

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>I 「What is the Rabbit Planet?」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, Command Center
Recently, it’s Bailey’s turn to be the Commander's secretary.
Is Commander a bit tired today?~ Let Bailey energize you with my bunny power!
Commander, although stockpiling carrots is a good thing, going a mission to stockpile them will not be beneficial.
Commander, you’ve got new mail! Is it from the Rabbit Planet?
...although Bailey’s appearance doesn’t scream confidence in her ability to handle things, she is full of enthusiasm…
I just received a telepathic wave from the Rabbit Alien, they want me to help with the Commander’s work. So Commander, don’t be afraid to call on me for help~
Exactly what is this… Rabbit Planet?
What’s wrong Commander? Is there something troubles you?
Hehe, you can tell Bailey. Let Bailey use the wisdom of the Rabbit Planet to help solve your problem!

options.content: Ask Bailey about the Rabbit Planet.

scripts.say: Ah, so you all were curious about this.
Hummm~~ How can Bailey explain...Rabbit Planet….is simply a planet full of rabbits!
What kind of implausible answer is that——

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>II 「Rabbit Alien Characteristics—— “Rabbit Ears”!」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, Command Center
Although we haven’t figured out exactly what is Rabbit Planet, it’s certainly not interfering with Bailey’s secretarial work...
Commander, listen up~ One of the key characteristics of the Rabbit Alien is——
Commander, a report for you—— Zzz... Bailey?
Ah, perfect timing Laffey~ Commander, one of the key characteristics of the Rabbit Alien is this!
Laffey’s...ears?
Uh huh! A key feature of Rabbit Aliens are their—— “Rabbit ears”!
Do you mean to say, they all look like rabbits...
Hmm? Laffey’s ears, can actually be like this——
Laffey took off her rabbit ears headband, emm…?
Yes! Just like this! Say Commander, if you want to become a Rabbit Alien, then you must do this as well!
The Commander was forced to wear Laffey’s headband...
Oh...this is unexpected...is it working?
Hahaha! Now the Commander is a proud member of the Rabbit Alien!
Huh…? The confusion seems to get deeper and deeper...

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>III 「Rabbit Alien Characteristics—— “Effort”!」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, Academy
Sigh, I was delayed with some of my routine tasks and now it’s already night time.
Hmm, let’s start today's training!
Oh, it’s you again!
This sounds like Bailey and…?
Ha, good evening Nachi-chan~
Don’t pretend that we’re close by calling me chan, I don’t plan on being your close friend...
But...but...
...forget it, since we’re teammates on the battlefield, then do what you must.
Yea~
I must say you really do put in the work, do you always practice after work?
Yep~ Sara-sensei told me, “Practice is essential!”
Nachi-chan, don’t you always secretly come here as well to practice your dialogue and the likes?
I, I am merely reviewing, I am already familiar with those lines a long time ago.
Is that so, Nachi-chan you really are amazing.
...cough cough. Anyways, don’t tire yourself too much, don’t you have secretary duty during the day?
Yes~ Not to worry, though~ Helping the Commander is equally important to Bailey becoming an idol!
...you really are such a child.
Hehehe, am not~
Well, I won’t bother you, since you are practicing now.
Huh? I wanted Nachi-chan to see my progress though.
...Alright, I can do that.
Terrific!
Looks like “Effort” is also a key trait of the Rabbit Alien characteristics.

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>IV 「Rabbit Alien Characteristics—— “Idol”?」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, Command Center
Bailey and Benson were found inside the Command Center.
Very nice~ You’re looking very cute today little Bailey~
Hehehe… you praised Bailey too much.
Heehee, you’re so cute. So that’s why you’re trying to become an idol~
Once you’re finished with work today, you should come join me for idol training!
OK!
Ah, the Commander has arrived~
Good morning, Commander~ So, the super cute Benson will take her leave, and will not bother you while you’re working then~
Looks like Benson is going about her regular duties today.
So as Hobby, although, how come Bailey wants to be an idol?
Right...at the very beginning, it was just all about having fun. I joined Benson and went singing and dancing. Slowly, the idea of becoming an idol really grew on me.
...so you were influenced by Benson then.
Commander, let Bailey tell you something in secret, please don’t laugh ok...
If one day, Bailey can become a famous idol, even Bailey’s fame will be known on other planets...
Maybe one day, the Rabbit Aliens will invite Bailey to the Rabbit Planet to give a live performance!
...that’s really typical of Bailey when it comes to crazy ideas.
I feel like I’m getting a better understanding of the Rabbit Alien as the days go by.

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>V 「Rabbit Alien Characteristics—— “Love”!」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, City Square
We’re almost finished with today’s work, it’s time for us to go back and rest.
Yayyy, hehehe...
Bailey is carrying a box of hay and rushing towards the dorm.
Ah, Commander, good evening~
Oh, this? This is food for the rabbit~
Is Bailey actually raising a rabbit...
Commander, would you like to come and see? The rabbit is super cute~
Port Area, Bailey’s Dorm
This one is called Lucky, that one is called Pretty, they are both really adorable and nice~
…No matter what you named them, they are indeed really cute.
Ok, it’s time for me to take them on a stroll.
Look, when Bailey opened the cage, the two rabbits both leaped out immediately.
Don't hop around too far~ Here, Bailey is gonna give you more hay and water.
Ahhh, thank you Commander~
Ack, you two made a mess of your cage again, you’re really a handful for Bailey...
Seems like you’re used to cleaning up for after the two Rabbits, huh Bailey.
Actually Bailey never thought that raising rabbits would be such a handful...
but just by looking at how cute they are, Bailey feels that all her hard work is all worth it~
Look at Bailey, just talking about them puts a smile on her face.
Looks like another characteristic of the Rabbit Alien was  just discovered.

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>VI 「The Rabbit Alien Has Arrived?!」</size>

scripts.say: Port area, City Square
According to reports, there will be a meteor shower tonight.
Yep, it must be the Creator who planned for tonight’s meteor shower~
You’re such a show off Hobby~
What will you wish for...
….and so on and so forth, looks like the girls are very interested in meteor showers.
Sure am~
It seems like Bailey is in a happier mood than her usual self.
Hmm? Good mood? Of course~ I am also eagerly waiting for tonight’s meteor shower.
Bailey thinks that, perhaps the Rabbit planet has witnessed all of Bailey’s hard work and will send Bailey a spaceship to get her!
...so that’s what she is actually thinking.
Sadly, no matter how much Bailey hopes for it, I don’t think the Rabbit Planet will send a spaceship out for her…
Spaceship? Nope. Akashi saw from the telescope that it’s just an ordinary meteorite, nyaa!
As for the Rabbit Planet, scientifically speaking, there’s no such planet at the very least in our galaxy, nyaa.
Akashi gave her scientific opinion while passing by.
….ah, although, meow, Akashi did not see very clearly. Perhaps there was a spaceship mixed in all that meteor shower! Nyaa~
Also, for the Rabbit Planet, perhaps it exists in another galaxy far away, nyaa!
Although Akashi is remedying her words, the atmosphere has become awkward.
Umm…? Isn’t the Rabbit planet something that Benson made up?

sequence:
Mysterious Rabbit Alien?!

<size=45>VII 「The Real Rabbit Alien」</size>

scripts.say: Hey...Commander, Bailey thinks that you misunderstood her.
Bailey knew from the beginning that the Rabbit Planet was a lie told by Benson...
More rather, given Benson’s personality, even if she wants to keep something a secret, she won’t be able to.
But...does it really matter?
Benson-chan told Bailey that the Rabbit Alien must be kind, the Rabbit Alien must be strong, and the Rabbit Alien are idols, after all.
Bailey did it. So even if the Rabbit Aliens do not exist, then Bailey will be the first Rabbit Alien.
…It seems that Bailey has become so mature from her words.
And and, just now Akashi said that perhaps they do exist in another g-galaxy?
Indeed, nyaa~ Scientifically speaking, the universe is still vastly unexplored!
So, perhaps the Rabbit Alien Planet really does exist, only that we haven’t discovered it yet~
If given the chance, Bailey wishes to go see them with Commander!
Such an idealistic idea...
Although, seeing the smile on Bailey’s face, almost makes people think that everything she’s said must be real.
Bailey, the meteor shower has begun!
Coming!~
At the very least, even if the Rabbit Planet doesn’t exist, it will exist within the hearts and minds of this fleet.

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>I 「In Search of Lost Ghosts!」</size>

scripts.say: Heya!
Wow~ It's so big!
Is this the "Super Pumpkin Lantern" that we're showing off today?
Sure is! The pumpkin was home grown and then carved out! With everyone's help, we were able to create such an awesome pumpkin lantern!
By the way, I've made delicious pies stuffed with pumpkin filling inside!
Oh, I just can't wait, let's try out these effects, quickly!
...Strange? Nothing's happening? Could the lantern be malfunctioning?
Oh... This seems troublesome, the party will start shortly tonight...
There seems to be something inside...the pumpkin's mouth...
Eh? Oh, gosh, you're right! There's a note!
