"We have lost a ghost mingling amongst us at this Halloween party, only the combined power of three virtuous witches can send it home."
What does this mean?
“Three virtuous witches”?
Hehe, it's time! Here comes the witch from Planet Bunny!
Wow, a witch really did appear!
Let Bailey the rabbit witch help out!
Ooo-ahhh~

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>II 「A Curious Witch」</size>

scripts.say: If Miss Ghost can't find her way home, then that's so pitiful...
Wait there, Bailey will help you for sure! "Pretty", "Lucky", let's go!
Hmm... Speaking of which, where exactly is Miss Ghost hiding?
Also ghosts can fly, right? But people from Planet Bunny cannot fly...
Well, if only the broom could carry me and let me fly like a witch.
Hey, did you hear? Rumor has it the warehouse at port is haunted!
Really? I heard about that as well! Something about ghosts lurking in the warehouse...
How is that possible! I know it's Halloween, but actual ghosts shouldn't exist!
(Warehouse? Ghosts? Could it be...)
"Pretty", "Lucky", let's head over there!
Just let me, Bailey, unravel the mysteries of the hidden ghost lurking at port!
Although, "three virtuous witches"... If one counts Bailey as one of them, then who are the other two...
Hey... Ghosts or whatever, they seem so scary. B-but...
Ah! I found a new Witch!
It's tiresome to impersonate voices of multiple people...
Just as we planned! Well, good luck, everyone!

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>III 「A Witch Scared of Ghosts」</size>

scripts.say: How much longer...
What's wrong, Isuzu? Are you worried about Miss ghost that Shouhou was telling you about?
Eh? Nagara? How did you know——
Of course, I heard about it from Shouhou~
I, I really can't do it, ghosts are just too much for me...
But, if Miss Ghost can't find her way back home, then she'll wander the port area forever.
What if one day you bump into Miss Ghost, wouldn't it be more troublesome then?
Think about it this way, if you help the ghosts return home, wouldn't there be less to worry about
Hmm... yeah, That's true...
You can do it, Isuzu! I believe in you~
Back to present...
Ack! I found a new Witch~ Hey!
Ack~!!
Wow! You, you scared the heck outa me.
Huh? ...So it turned out to be Bailey, you are... the witch?
Yea~ Heehee. Is Isuzu also trying to find Miss ghost?
Hey, let me tell ya, I just heard that Miss ghost is actually in the warehouse!
Miss Ghost...? Um, yes, yes I was umm searching for Miss Ghost.
Then why don't you join me and we'll head to the warehouse together. Let's go~
Yes, yes! Together!
(If I got someone to come along... then I'll be less afraid!)

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>IV 「A Witch Afraid of Troubles」</size>

scripts.say: Sister, did you hear the latest gossip about Miss ghost lurking around the port area?
You heard about it from Cleveland? It seems awfully like a prank...
Regardless, I'm not interested.
Pfft, here you go again. You were all like "I'm not interested" during the summer time as well.
You could have joined us if you didn't hesitate to put on your swimsuit~
S-Swimsuits are shameless...
Alright, so now it's finally Halloween~ Let's all get together and have fun with everyone!
As it so happens, I've got a witch costume on hand right here~
Where did you get this... H-hold on, at least let me change into it myself!
Sigh... Rodney is such a troublemaker... Half the time I don't know what goes on in that mind of hers.
"Three witches" whatever... it's just a gossip. Let's walk around and deal with it.
I caught the third Witch!
Wow! -- So it turns out to be you girls...
Is Ms. Nelson also one of the "virtuous witches" who is looking for the "Miss Ghost"?
Ha? Um, yeah, sure...
(Crap, I blurted that out)
Now all three have shown up, great...
Then let's head to the warehouse, Bailey heard Miss Ghost is there!
(Even though it'll surely be a prank, it's not good to leave these kids alone without help... I'll follow them then)

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>V 「Helper From A Coffin?」</size>

scripts.say: Port - Warehouse
Miss Ghost~! Come out, come out! Everyone is worried about you
If you shout like that, you'll scare her away...
Also, it's dark in here, I feel like something ominous will...
Miss Ghost——! Hurry... huh? What's over there? A coffin?
Ack! A C-Coffin?!!!!
Let's open it first! Allow me!
Wait——
Boo! Surprise, surprise~~
Ahhhh!!!
O gosh, suddenly someone appeared!
You are... Terror?
Sigh... I need to practice more on how to scare people.
I thought it was a zombie or something, you scared me...
...Why are you in a coffin, Terror?
Wait, why is there a coffin in the warehouse in the first place..
Terror cannot say, Terror is keeping a promise...
Ah! Quick, look over there!
Hey, M-Miss ghost has appeared!!
Who is it?!
She's running away! Chase her!
Wait... Take this. These are "Witch's Broomsticks".
Wow, exactly one broomstick per person... We must catch up to that ghost
Don't think you can easily escape from us! I'm coming for ya!!
Bailey, don't rush...

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>VI 「Chasing Ghosts!」</size>

scripts.say: Over here!
No! Over there!
Huff... puff... I can't believe we chased her all the way to the rooftop...
I, I can't run any longer...
There's nowhere left for you to run. Who are you exactly? What are you up to?
Miss Ghost, Bailey and the others are not here to scare you, we've come all the way here to help you!
Sh-she flew away?!
Wh-what now! We can't fly...
F-Fly! I just got this broomstick! Could it be time for me to... jump!
Wa-wait! Wait wait wait, you'll fall off the roof if you jump.
She... she's flying... She's ACTUALLY flying?!
Hmph, don't think that you can escape this time!
No way, what's with this broomstick...
Hahaha~ I'm now a flying witch~ Quick, come join me Isuzu, Nelson~
Wait——
Wahahaha! I'm actually flying! I... am... flying!
Broomstick, catch up to them...!
...am I dreaming...
This is not a dream. Here, let me push you~
Rodney?! ...Yeeha~
Go and enjoy this feeling of flying, this is a once in a lifetime experience. Hold on tight. Have fun, sisters

sequence:
Trick or Treat, Halloween!

<size=45>VII 「Happy Halloween!」</size>

scripts.say: Finally, I'm back on the ground...
We've finally caught up to you, Miss Ghost!
...Eh? ...a glowing aircraft and a white cloak? What? Why is everyone here?!
What'd you all think! That was Sara's amazing airplane maneuvering skills!
Eh! So in the end, it was only Saratoga playing a prank on us?!
Hehehe, I also helped!
"Hey, did you hear? Rumor has it the warehouse in port is haunted!"...
"How is that possible!"... "Even though it's Halloween, actual ghosts shouldn't exist!"
The voice I heard that time was actually from Albacore!
Hehehe, looks like my acting chops were not bad~
Even if ghost is a prank, how can you explain what happened just now with the...broomstick, eh,where is the broomstick?
Well that... Yuubari just collected all of them. She said for the next test, they still need to be adjusted...
Terror?!
Is this typical for Halloween... I mean I knew it was going to be a prank, but I didn't expect you girls to use the research tech from our port laboratory
Bailey really enjoyed flying in the sky! Bailey wants to do it again!
So, Miss ghost will not appear again...
Relax relax, we should consider this "Happy Halloween Trick or Treat" to be a success, nya~
This is the pumpkin pie prepared by Kagerou? Great, let's dig in everyone~
Sister, how does it feel to fly?
Wow, this turned out actually not bad... Ah! Rodney! You knew all along from the beginning!
Hehe, I knew right after I received the costumes from Akashi. No harm no foul, you seemed to have enjoyed yourselves~
Hmm... After such a public showing, those witch costumes must be sold out by now, Akashi is such a genius!
That means the original culprit must be Akashi?!?!
Meow?! Pur... Nya~ There's not much time left for Halloween, please take advantage and enjoy the remainder of your time!
OK!
Wait wait! Don't change the subject!
My friends, raise your glasses!
A toast! To our glorious diplomatic achievement!
Salute!
Salute!
With the Arbiter's plans in the Antarctic foiled, today's meeting had greater zeal than usual.
Thanks to everyone's efforts with the Commander, discussions regarding our reunification have been going smoothly.
Brightest among our achievements of late has been the signing of a treaty between our Sardegna and the Iris.
For helping us show the other factions not just our authority, but our diplomatic capabilities...
I must thank you all once again.
No matter how the situation changes, Sardegna can respond flexibly and smoothly.
Let us not forget that it's also the first diplomatic agreement of a unified Iris. That's no small matter to them.
Why did they choose Sardegna for such an important milestone?
Obviously they see the potential of the Sardegna Empire. I mean, look at us.
Ever since the World Expo, our shipgirls have been center stage in world events. Sardegna's influence is rising like never before.
Good things are gonna happen.
We might just end up with a major voice in the new Azur Lane.
That's right. And we couldn't have done it without you all.
Know that this is only the beginning. Let's endeavor for the future of our dear nation.
But of course. Ahahahaha!
Another toast to our achievements.
For the glory of our great nation, salute!
Salute!
Salute!
Mirror Sea - Camelot White Rose Block
A place once home to only pristine forest has been transformed into a majestic structure.
This building, with walls as white as those of Camelot Castle, serves various functions.
The tower-like passage that pierced the sky serves as the core of this block, with an eye-catching exterior to match.
With this passage, Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth and a chosen few could travel anywhere within its reach without being noticed by prying eyes.
So this is Test Site Beta.
No wonder they call it the White Rose Block. There are white roses all over the place!
It hasn't even been that long, but things are progressing fast.
But if I were to stay here forever...
I'd need them to build me a Sleepless City block♪
...That won't be happening.
If we were free to make demands, then I'd sooner have my own underworld.
This isn't a vacation. Leave it.
Boooring. It might as well be a vacation!
Teaching girls how to fight, upgrading equipment, joining their training drills...
It's all so unfulfilling.
...This branch has powerful shipgirls, too.
Powerful shipgirls... Oh. You mean those two girls Sheffield knows?
No wonder they refused—
That's confidential. I hope you haven't forgotten.
Try not to get people killed so soon after our arrival.
Oh. Now that you mention it, yeah.
*sigh*... That's enough chit-chat. Our contact is here, so try not to embarrass us.
Welcome to the Gate of Avalon, dearest allies.
I didn't think you'd bother coming out to greet us. It's an honor to meet you, Miss Hood.
Greetings~ Wow, what an interesting girl you brought along today.
Hmm. Another who walks in darkness?
Thou art Vampire, too, I presume?
Yep!♪ Got a problem with it?
Of course not. In fact, it's just perfect.
I might just want rigging like thine own!
Tell me, how didst thou become a META?
You don't think I'd tell you for free, do you? It's our biggest secret.
...Then how much must I pay?
Let me think about it~
How about trading it for something I want to know?
Heheheh. Things are already taking a lively turn.
Already negotiating?
Miss Hood, it's almost time...
That's right. Thank you, Newcastle.
Everyone, you're just in time for tea. We'd love if you were willing to join us.
Sounds good~ I want... raspberry ice cream with extra blood!
She's already ordering...
Erebus, I don't know if we should be this carefree.
...There's nothing wrong with things being peaceful.
Relax a little... Yeah, I think it wouldn't hurt.
Haha, things are finally getting lively here for once.
Dragon Empery - ???
"The Vermilion Bird falls from the heavens." Something's going to happen in the south... Huan Ch'ang's divination is already half confirmed.
Man, she's something else.
No kidding. Things in the Antarctic have gotten extremely dangerous.
Siren hordes are going there from all directions. It must be because of the danger Observer's mainframe is in.
Some seem to be building a defensive line around a portion of Antarctica.
The battle in Antarctica rages on.
But it's difficult to get a read on such a hectic battle...
Fortunately, the Commander has withdrawn all allies from Antarctica and the research station.
Currently, the Royal Navy, Eagle Union, and Iron Blood are monitoring the Sirens' defensive line.
I'd love to see the Sirens take themselves out at this rate, but pipe dreams aside... If the battle did spill out of the area, they'd surely take care of it.
Antarctica has been peaceful for so long. What could have caused this sudden violence?
Our plans to build a research station will have to be postponed indefinitely...
We have no choice.
Besides, the Antarctic isn't an anomaly. Siren activity has increased all over the world.
Even in areas we've taken back from the Sirens, their patrols have been spotted again.
This is true of the NA Sea, too, even after Compiler's mainframe was destroyed.
They don't seem to be new models of Sirens, but they clearly work in unison.
They don't just evade battle. When forced to fight, they act in entirely different ways from before.
It's as if they're being controlled by an invisible command unit...
Do you think... Compiler's been rebuilt?
That is feasible, but we have no witness testimony to back that up yet.
Observer and the other high-level Sirens have obscured their whereabouts, as well.
The only Siren forces appearing in the world's seas are pawns, mass-produced fleets, and lower-level enforcers.
Our staff believe that the disappearance of high-level Sirens is the result of them focusing their forces in the Antarctic.
While it is possible that Compiler will return, we find it more likely that Observer has ceded control to another Siren.
For example, focusing herself on the fight with Gazers in the Antarctic while leaving the rest to another higher-level Arbiter...
Arbiters are no monolith. The Commander witnessed as much in the NA Sea.
You have a point...
Those Arbiters are already bad enough, and you're telling me there's one who can control all the Sirens in the world on her own?
Arbiters are one hell of an enemy...
We have word that a large quantity of Siren patrols have gathered outside the storm as well.
They seem to be planning something with the knowledge that we're analyzing said storm.
The other half of Huan Ch'ang's divination... This is sure to be another handful.
Things may get even worse than they have in the Antarctic.
Now I get it. You called me and An Shan here for a new mission, didn't you?
That's right. The situation has changed, so your current mission has been suspended.
I'll need you to rendezvous with Chi An's storm analysis team.
Also, An Shan, you've been given permission regarding the other matter.
You may use your advanced equipment at your discretion in case of emergency.
Good luck out there, everyone♪
Somewhere in the Iris Orthodoxy
In a small town, divorced from the hustle and bustle of the big city...
A quiet, peaceful place teeming with nature...
No unusual radio waves, no secret underground rooms, and no signs of suspicious folk.
Likewise here.
Tch... It's such a pain to work without clues. My only option is to comb the entire place.
...Still, I can't help but notice how friendly Master has gotten with Cardinal Richelieu's entourage of late.
Did she get a hold of your weaknesses? Or did you let a secret slip?
Either way, I need to find the cause immediately.
Clemenceau is a dangerous woman. If you're not careful, you may end up her prey – possibly in more ways than one.
If it isn't Sheffield of the Royal Navy. Fancy meeting you here.
Joffre... Angel of the Tribunal.
As I understand, you're responsible for guarding the Royal Navy's representatives.
What could possibly bring you out to this town?
Well, the Tribunal's venue security is perfect. It left me without any work to do.
So I thought I'd sightsee and make full use of my per-diem allowance.
Well, thank you for your appraisal of our security.
However... Abandoning your post is hardly noble.
Of course, the Tribunal and I don't mean to spoil our guests' fun. Especially not when they're clearly so interested in our attractions.
Out of deference to the blessed Iris for uniting us on this day, I'll show you my favorite attraction.
Come, come. Right this way.
Sakura Empire - Mikasa's Residence
Zuikaku sat on a bench near the manse's gate and thought to herself.
I can't get in contact with Mikasa, Lady Nagato, or Shoukaku...
I get it if they're out on urgent business, but EVERYONE can't possibly be missing at once, right?
The lights are on inside, so there should be someone...
Hm?
I didn't notice before because I was in such a hurry, but did Mikasa... repaint the exterior?
Huh? Was this path in such poor condition before?
And those stalls over there... weren't there last time I came here...
I'm sorry, big sister...! It took too long to clean up!
Oh, I'm gonna be late... Mikasa's going to lecture me, too...
Heehee. It's okay.
If we're going to be late either way, let's take things slowly. Safety first, you know.
Haste makes waste. And what a waste it would be if you ruined your makeup in your hurry.
While Zuikaku watched on vacantly, she heard familiar voices.
She turned toward the voices and saw two figures in red on the street corner.
Those voices... That can't be, but...
Could it be?
Heeey! Wait!
She stood up and ran to the street corner, but then –
*CRASH!*
Ouch...
Hm? You okay?
Well, if it isn't Zuikaku. What's got you in such a hurry?
Are you lost? No wonder I couldn't find you anywhere...
Mikasa?!
Wh-why are you here?
Uh, what? You were planning to come home today, weren't you? I'm here to pick you up.
The roads here are poorly maintained these days. Can't blame ya for getting lost.
Are you saying you've been waiting here all this time...?
Sure have.
(Weird... I didn't see Mikasa on my way through here before.)
(Wait, everything around me is different!)
(The walls, the road, the stalls...)
(Is this... a dream?)
(No, no. It can't be! I'm not how I used to be!)
(I went through that Tower of Midgard stuff, after all!)
(Does that mean... this is some kind of new mental attack?)
Zuikaku? You look pale. Is something wrong?
Mikasa, where are Lady Nagato and Shoukaku?
They're all waiting for you at the house.
Thank goodness... Let's go home, Mikasa!
It's embarrassing, but I just had this weird experience...
I want to tell you all about it!
In a luxurious reception room, two queens enjoyed a comfortable and graceful teatime together.
Heehee... Our detectives never cease to amaze.
The times may change, but Scotland Yard certainly doesn't...
Ugh, take your jobs a little more seriously!
Right?
To think that this is how I finally get to see the rest...
Do you always get testing data through such books and newspapers?
Isn't it a lovely method?
Not only does it minimize interference in the testing sites...
But it also takes no time at all. And it's fun, to boot!
Besides, every tea party needs a newspaper, no?
I must agree with that.
Hah, look at this article! A robber tried to rob a weapons store!
Pfft... And how did that turn out?
Let's see... The robber was arrested, and nobody was hurt in the end.
Unsurprising...
DING DONG! DING DONG!
BANG BANG! DA DA DUM!
Odd noises suddenly ruined the calm atmosphere in the reception room.
TARGET SPOTTED! GATHER AT ONCE!
BEEP BEEP! BEEP BEEP!
TARGET SPOTTED! GATHER AT ONCE!
Come again?
Elizabeth looked around her until she found a plushie on the corner of the couch. Said plushie was flashing and making all the noise.
...What is this?
A gift from Ms. D. It seems she's pinpointed the location of her next hunt.
Is this... handmade?
It certainly is.
It's, umm... very cute...?
It has the air of a person.
That is Ms. D. Do you feel you've reached a deeper understanding now?
...How scary.

sequence: Sakura Emp■■ - ■■■■
■■■■Flower-Viewing
Akagi

scripts.say: Akagi and Amagi walked together on a stony path lined with trees.
Akagi, I can already see it!
The flower-viewing has already begun...
There's still space, though. I don't think we're too late at all.
Apologies for keeping you all waiting.
We're really sorry for making you wait so long!
See? I told you Amagi wouldn't miss this.
You lose, Naka. Your snacks are mine!☆
I told you not to take that bet. Hahaha!
Uuugh... Just take it all...
Amagi, Akagi. Thank you for coming to today's flower-viewing event.
Oh, please. We should be the ones to thank you for waiting for us, Houshou.
Incidentally, I don't see Miss Mikasa around... Is she not here yet?
She was summoned to an emergency meeting on her way here.
Here I thought maybe you had been delayed for the same reason...
Did you run into any unexpected incidents along the way?
Well...
It was obviously that little sister of hers that delayed her.
I heard she was needy, but this is something else.
You're lucky Mikasa isn't here, or she'd lecture you over your irresponsibility in front of the whole group.
Kaga!
Hmph. I was wondering who that greying old lady was. If it isn't Kaga!
Of course I'm here. I was invited.
But you weren't, were you? You just got to tag along because big sister's a big shot, isn't that right?
Aww, look who got invited? Big deal! Back me up, Tosa.
...I'd appreciate if you didn't get bystanders wrapped up in this silly argument, thank you.
You don't see us for a few days, and you grow up to have such a big mouth.
Remember, all you are is that damn –
Hmmm?
D-damn... damn smart Amagi's pupil!
Now, now, I think that's enough talk. Would you allow us to sit now, Kaga?
...Why are you asking me? I don't care what you do.
Heehee.
Pffbbft!
After blowing raspberries at Kaga, Akagi followed Amagi to their seats.
Her tail wagged all the way – a symbol of her triumph.
Upon sitting, Akagi realized that she was in a sea of flowers.
I picked a flower for you on the way here.
Look, Akagi. What do you think this one is called?
Amagi showed her a flower of deep, bloody crimson.
Red spider lily...?
Correct.
Gorgeous, bewitching, magnificent, yet poisonous.
Just like you...
Just like... me?
Let these flowers bloom all over the world. See their petals light the world ablaze in crimson.
My dear sister...

sequence:
Javelin's Monthly Manga

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Good Morning, Javelin!</size>

<size=60>"This is a work of fiction. Names, characters, events, and incidents are products of the author's imagination, and maybe a World War II documentary. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events... well, might actually be somewhat intended but that's not really what's important..."</size>

scripts.say: Zzzzzzz...
Javelin... Javelin...!
J-Juneau...?
Javelin, hurry and get up! We're going to be late for school!
School...? Awawawa! I'm gonna be late!
(My name's Javelin. I'm just a normal J-class destroyer who's just arrived at port!)
(My dream is to be Commander's– Ahhh! That's a secret!)
Well then, Javelin's gonna give it her all today... eek?!
<I've been searching for a girl like you, nya!>
The Meowfficer is... talking?!
<Yes, Javelin. You are the prophecied one...>
<You are destined to have a fateful encounter today, nya!>
(Is the Meowfficer really talking...?)
... Akashi probably just had another weird lab accident again~
W-wait, what time is it? I've gotta hurry to school!
Oh no, oh no! I have to report to Commander this afternoon, so I have to make sure my hair is all perfect~!
Javelin's story is only just beginning...

sequence:
Javelin's Monthly Manga

<size=45>Chapter 2 - The Mystery Within the Drawer</size>

scripts.say: I'm so sorry I'm late!
You're late, Javelin.
Really now? Class has already started!
The notes you missed, here.
All right, that's no excuse for being late...
I'm telling the truth! I met a talking Meowfficer, and it said something about how I am "destined to have a fateful encounter today," or something like that!
The Seven Mysteries of the Academy just increased to eight.
Maybe Javelin just isn't a morning person...
That is a possibility, but... there is also a chance that the Science Club crossed a certain line without permission.
In any case, our best bet is to catch that thing and bring it to Akashi.
If I see it, I'll catch it...
I'll show you the agility of a special-type destroyer.
Hey... aren't you guys taking this a bit too seriously?
(Huh? There seems to be something weird in this drawer...)
This is... a pink envelope...?
Love letter...?
Be careful, everyone.
D-don't tell me this is...!
"A mysterious love letter appeared before Javelin..."

sequence:
Javelin's Monthly Manga

<size=45>Chapter 3 - A Strange Letter...?</size>
<size=60>"Splendid young lady of the J-class, there are words that I must share with you."</size>
<size=60>"When the grand bell strikes IV, I shall be waiting for you underneath the blooming flowers."</size>
<size=60>"There, you shall receive the truth and love of this world."</size>
<size=60></size>

scripts.say: What's all this nonsense...?
I thought for sure it was from Ark Royal, but guess not...
I can't tell who sent it...
This definitely is "objectionable literature."
What's this talking about, though? Grand bell tower... underneath the blooming flowers...
Let's ask around!
Unicorn doesn't really get it either...
A similar letter...? Um, I've n-never gotten anything of the sort?!
Hmm... the truth of this world... I knew it, whoever sent this letter must be an "Esper!"
Impossible. I can't feel any †Force† coming from this letter.
Even the Devilish Idol has never written such a powerful document before~
Tis true, this document is hard to read. But fear not, for we can interpret it.
Really?! Viersechs, you're the best!
But first I must clear, the name of my friend. This did not come from Graf Zeppelin's hand.
If that's the case...
The grand bell must be, the school's clock tower. The blooming flowers, the Sakura dorm. This time of the year, their flowers doth bloom.
In other words, "at 4 P.M., meet me underneath the cherry tree in the Sakura dorm's courtyard."
Th-that's it!
Javelin, fight on!
"Just what is the identity of the mysterious letter's sender...?"

sequence:
Javelin's Monthly Manga

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Javelin, to the Final Battle!</size>
<size=60>"And so, the story arrives at its climactic final battle..."</size>

scripts.say: <So we meet again, Javelin... Don't think that you can escape from my magnetism again, nya.>
Y-You're that...!
<Indeed! Yuubari's modified wisdom cube simulates the ability to reflect an oriented consciousness into reality, and I was manifested from your deepest desires...>
<I AM... MEOWFFICER J! NYAHAHA!>
You're the one who sent this letter!
<Exactly right. I am the embodiment of your heart's true desires, your destiny, your very existence! Nyahaha!>
Eeek!
<Nyahahaha! Defeat me here and transcend your limits, nya! Otherwise, you will never grow again!>
"With a roar, the Meowfficer rained fierce attacks upon Javelin and the others."
Javelin! Hang in there, I'm coming to help you!
Meowfficer J... is the final boss...
Taste the Demon's power...!
(KABOOOM!!)
<I-impossible! Nyagh... Even with the power that Master Yuubari granted me... I was defeated so easily...? Nyargh...>
Javelin, finish it off!
Got it! Strike Mode activated, maximum output! Take THIS!!!
<NYAAAAAAGGHHHHHH!!!>
... Did you see that, Graf?
Yes... Those girls are truly... the Heart of the Sea.
"The peace and tranquility of the port was protected once more."
"We're counting on you, Javelin! The fate of Azur Lane rests within your hands!"
"Written By: Z1, San Diego, et. al"

sequence:
Javelin's Monthly Manga

<size=45>Chapter 5 - What the Heck is This...</size>

scripts.say: ...... What the heck is this...
It turned into a trainwreck halfway through...
Javelin... rushed the ending...
I only got to write half of it when I was in the Manga Club! The ending was done by someone else!
So that's why only Lebe's and San Diego's names are left in the credits...
You should explain... why you stopped writing halfway...
W-well, so much was going on that I didn't know how to continue... and then I left my sketchbook in the classroom...
And then everyone took turns drawing in it...
Making a manga seems hard, yes.
You should have asked us to help.
Well, everyone has their slumps. Next time, let's do our best to see things through to the end!
Ayanami wants to help too.
I... will also help.
You guys... Mmhmm! Next time, we'll all make the best manga ever!
Yeah!
"Please look forward to Javelin and friends' next work!"
I see, I see! So this is what they call the "shameless plug" section!
But what if they don't see this message on time? You never know with extended maintenance...
Well, let's not worry about that!
Azur Lane will be coming to Anime Expo 2019 from July 4th to the 7th! Check us out at booth #206, as well as at Idea Factory's booth #3906!
There will be awesome events for you to get some exclusive goodies, like wall scrolls and t-shirts. You might even get to meet a couple of your favorite voice actresses!
We'd love to see you there!
The Dragon Palace – the legendary stronghold which the Sakura Empire laid hands on following a fierce battle.
It now belonged to Musashi. Silently, it rested at the bottom of the sea.
This place was always mine. Now, it is officially so.
Jintsuu, how goes the mission?
Swimmingly thus far.
We'll be ready to disembark by tomorrow noon and should reach the target according to schedule.
You make me proud. We simply must aid Akagi with her plan.
Of course.
Now, as for our own plan...
It is proceeding smoothly as well.
I've already installed all the monitoring equipment and performed updates on the defense systems.
...If need be, I can arrange guest seating as well.
That won't be necessary. All that matters is that Akagi's plan is successful.
Should the situation spiral out of control, however, we will be forced to take action. Surely you know this.
Of course. Apologies, I said too much.
BEEP BEEP!
Hey. I'm not interrupting you, am I?
It's of no consequence. Has something happened?
Zuikaku and Mikasa have shown up at your mansion. What should I do with them?
The plan has already entered its final stage. You could simply tell them that she is not at home.
That is the truth, after all.
Such an excuse would fool Zuikaku, yes.
However, I will not stoop to telling half-truths to Mikasa.
Here is my proposal – I shall go and meet Mikasa. In my absence, you are to hold the fort here.
Proceed with the preparations as normal whilst I'm gone.
Should I not return, or if I cannot be reached, depart with the Dragon Palace as planned.
As you say, Lady Musashi.
Please watch yourself out there.
Somewhere in the Northern Parliament...
A fireplace crackled beneath gentle lighting inside a house. A bowl of steaming hot food rested on the countertop.
Outside, a freezing blizzard rattled the windows. Despite its fury, its winds could not carry even a touch of cold through the four walls.
Here – hot soup. It's really good.
It's safe to eat. I'll have a bite first, if you're unsure.
(I was trying my damnedest to avoid this scenario...)
*burp*... See? Now you eat.
(How did I end up in here?)
God. Your rigging is barely holding itself together.
Comrade, give me the name of the bastard who did this! I'll make them pay!
Settle down, Gangut. You can talk about that later.
Yes, settle down! This lady fled from a hellish branch, so spare her the revenge talk for a minute!
Don't you worry, Comrade Kirov META. This genius mechanic will make your rigging as good as new! You just rest and relax!
("Fled from"? What is she talking about?)
We're all surprised to see you. Your coming was foretold by Pamiat' Merkuria META.
I can tell you've been through a lot by looking at you.
But it's okay now. You're safe here, and our Northern Parliament welcomes you as one of our own.
For the time being, focus on resting and recovering your strength. If anything happens, you can talk to us.
(Pamiat', you bastard... What lies have you told the people of this branch?)
(Whatever you tried to do here, I can tell that you failed. They wouldn't have shown me this much kindness if you'd succeeded.)
(And since you failed... that means I still have time.)
(There's still something I can do.)
(Comrades...)
(I hope you won't mind me staying here a while.)
Ventilation systems all green. Lights... working as normal.
Then there's this carpet. Soft to perfection.
A proud queen dressed in black stood inside a lavishly decorated train wagon, admiring every detail of her domain.
Yes, it is a nice wagon. Did you reference the Orient Express, by any chance?
Only for its exterior and interior design. The nuts and bolts of the train are completely different.
But that's all rather insignificant. Haven't you noticed how spacious it is?
Of course I have. It looks easily twice as big on the inside as the outside makes it seem.
Yes, and we could make it even bigger if we so desired.
To a degree, at least. It is still bound by the limitations inherent to the concept of a train.
And besides, its defences are stronger the smaller it is, so we settled on this size.
Fascinating, isn't it? The things you can do with spatial distortions. Did you base this technology on that found in Mirror Seas?
Hah! What a silly comparison. The Queen's Light is far more advanced than any Mirror Sea!
Though, we can see why you'd think that way. More importantly, we haven't named the technology yet.
How about... Yes, let's call them Mirror Rails!
These Mirror Rails boast far superior electromagnetic shielding, defences, and plasticity over a Mirror Sea.
But that's not their most impressive feature! You see, each wagon or engine can be affixed with its own concept.
Really? A different concept for each one?
Indeed. The Queen's Light has much more than just one concept attached.
It has not one, not two, but seven different and independent conceptual spaces!
Which is to say, each section of the train exists independently of the others as its own Mirror Rail.
What's more, they do not require a central control device somewhere within their space like a Mirror Sea does.
That's what sets them apart from Siren technology more than anything else.
Additionally, the concepts of each of these Rails are tied together by another concept – that of the Queen's Light.
Interesting. And since they're collectively perceived as a train, it strengthens their concepts as Rails.
Indeed it does. Aren't we brilliant?
As long as they form a collective, the defence of each Rail is also bolstered by the concept associated with it.
If necessary, though, the Rails can be decoupled and operate independently of one another.
That means, from an attacker's perspective, they must choose between three targets – the train as a collective, the individual Rails, and the third dimension.
This makes the Rails particularly resistant to conceptual attacks.
Right. That sounds like a lot of sophistry to me.
This is just how offence and defence work at the conceptual level.
The theory of it isn't hard to grasp. Reinforcing a concept in practice, however, is a very costly endeavour.
Supposing that a single Rail costs as much as your gate of Camelot, that cost doubles with each additional Rail you add.
Theoretically, you can keep adding new Rails, but for now, 7 Rails is the limit.
2 to the power of 6... That makes it 64 times the cost!
That's utterly absurd. All that time, money, and resources for what? A mere train?
It's not MERELY a train! And besides... Bah, forget it.
Once you see what abominations there are out there, you'll understand.
BEEP BEEP!
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Elizabeth! Start the train already!
Come on! I've waited for aaages!
Don't rush us! We're performing the final check!
No! Hurry uuup! Come on already!
Telling us to hurry up won't do anything. Or what, will you reimburse us when something breaks if we depart unprepared?
I can't afford that. Fiiine.
Do your checks or whatever, but make it quick! I'm getting bored!
Your call has been terminated. BEEEEP...
She can be such a bloody nuisance. If we could choose, we wouldn't take her along.
But, things are the way they are, so we just have to put up with her.
Now, have you any last-minute luggage to stow before we set off?
What? You mean we're departing now? Are we really going hunting with only the two of us?
We never said we were going hunting. We're only moving to a new location to prepare.
Say, why don't we travel to your branch? Your Camelot can surely accommodate one single train.
What?!
Hold on a minute! I've never said you're welcome to stay for who knows how long!
Lack of permission didn't stop YOU from crashing at OUR place and helping yourself to our tea and biscuits! What goes around comes around!
Now shush! Onward, Queen's Light!
It was a barren place, its endless vastness being its sole defining quality.
There was no sky, no land, not even a sea. It was a blank space in every sense.
For this was the border between truth and falsehood.
"I" sensed pain. "I" heard someone sobbing.
It's so lonesome, so noisy in this place...
Is this... "my" birthplace?
Perhaps it is. Perhaps it isn't.
No... At this moment, it certainly isn't.
"I" was born from the void. The void "I" brought with me, and the void "I" shall return to.
Travelers from afar, please give "me" your attention...
And witness "my" demise.
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
Signal received from monitoring device. Adjusted for relative time, test site F-45733 disappeared at the physical level approximately 3 hours ago.
Searching for the coordinates of F-45733.
100 plus 20? It was an extreme environment experiment?
Then we have a likely culprit behind the disappearance.
Yeah. A spatial impact event caused by a category V threat was detected, too. Observed intensity: superlative. Threat level: max.
This is no joke. We need to reorder our priority list and make this our number one issue.
The capacity of our local vessels isn't enough. The three of us will need to reroute at minimum 80% of our mainframes' resources.
Contact the other Arbiters in the region and request assistance.
On it. I can't promise we'll get much help on such short notice, however.
...Pause your active tasks. We'll move in right now.
??? - Ashes' Temporary Base
Our "old friends" have put their protocol on halt! It looks like they're getting ready for a transfer.
They are? Maybe their patience has finally run out.
The Hermit, Temperance, Strength... Those three have been a thorn in our side for an eternity.
I thought we wouldn't get to strike back at them until Scharnhorst and that Friedrich der Große were done constructing our new base.
...It's possible that that spatial impact caught their attention.
Wichita and Kimberly are already en route. They won't let those bastards do as they please.
Takao, the command baton is yours. We're gonna be a thorn in THEIR side this time.
Then once our new base is finished, we'll continue with our original plan and deal with those Arbiters once and for all.
One last thing – Wichita's unit will decide when we rendezvous according to the situation on the front.
Roger. Recovering that which Essex found takes top priority. Go, and rest assured knowing that I shall hold the fort.
A shipgirl sat by the windowsill of a steel building, gazing out at the vast white expanse as she downed her drink in one big gulp.
Ahh... Orange juice. That's a surprise. I didn't know you kept potable beverages around.
Are you moved?
A little.
I'm not as concerned with the drink as I am with this building. How in the world did you construct it?
Sorry, that's a secret between Arbiters.
You don't want to stay here for too long. The white void will drive you insane.
I know. That's why I hate going here.
Enough beating around the bush. Why did you summon me?
No particular reason. I was just doing someone a favor.
YOU do favors for people?
Of course I do. The person in question was down on her luck.
And I mean REALLY down on her luck! Ahahahaha!
First her home was stolen from her, then her big plan failed spectacularly.
I stumbled across her and thought it was so funny, I just had to give her a helping hand.
What are you talking about?
It'll be quicker if you just ask her yourself.
CLICK!
Pamiat', I've done what you asked. Now talk to her yourself.
...Pamiat'?
From what Devil told me, things aren't going so well for you.
"Not going so well"? Yeah, that's putting it mildly!
Do you have any idea how badly your intel screwed me? Things were COMPLETELY different from what you said!
Come again?
My intel should've been accurate. I just gave you what my probe had learned.
There may have been minor errors, but nothing that should've rendered the intel worthless.
That is... unless the Sakura Empire of test site beta actually knows very little.
Tell me, what exactly was wrong with the intel?
Too many things to list! We'd be here all day if I told you each and every one! Come here and see for yourself!
Unfortunately, I have something important to deal with first. You-know-who has her eyes on it, so my hands are tied.
You're talking about the spatial fluctuation, aren't you?
So you know about it, too.
Mhm. They asked me to come help.
Well? Are you going to?
I might. If YOU'RE leaving, do me a solid and take me with you.
Jumping such a long distance all by myself takes a lot of effort.
Sounds like a plan.
I love me a plan.
What do you MEAN "sounds like a plan"?!
What about me?
What am I supposed to do?
Take it easy. Just hang tight and a solution will come your way.
Yeah, right. Even you don't believe that.
Ahem. Pamiat', you're a legend. Whatever hardships you face, I know you will overcome them.
I'll be right there after I wrap up my own business.
Seriously? And how long is that gonna take?
Hmm... At this point, it's hard to say.
Are you done talking yet? I'm closing the connection.
Yes, go ahead. Let's resume our own conversation.
Alright. Buh-bye!
Hey! Wai–
CLICK!
Uggghhh...
So I'm not getting any backup. Great. Just great.
What was that about a "spatial fluctuation"? What's so important about that?
Eh, forget it. None of my business.
All I know is – she's not the least bit stressed, so I shouldn't be either.
If she wants me to wait, then I'm gonna wait on my own terms!
It just so happens there is a buttload of resorts nearby, so...
I'm gonna help myself to a test site vacation!
There was total darkness, broken up only by the faint light of an instrument panel.
The place was abuzz with electrical noise and the sound of running machines – it was a control room of some sort.
Initiate search...
A figure as pale as bone silently floated through the dark.
Search complete. Launch Death's Bridge.
The figure completed her authentication, then disappeared into the darkness again.
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
A jarringly exaggerated, high-pitched notification sound rang out, and a hologram projection appeared in the air.
BZZZT... Ahahahaha! BZZZT... thought it was so funny, I just had to give her a helping hand... BZZZT...
The Devil...
BOOP BOOP BOOP!
BZZZT... spatial impact event caused by a category V threat... BZZZT... reorder our priority list...
Strength...
DING DING DING!
BZZZT... This much... BZZZT... not nearly enough. BZZZT... Your battlefield is right here...
The Lovers...
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
BZZZT... Coordinates are too far away... BZZZT... Unable to provide backup... BZZZT...
The Moon...
BOOP BOOP BOOP!
Warning! Insufficient monitoring permissions! Warning!
The Empress...
DING DING DING!
Warning! BZZZT...
The person you have dialed cannot currently be reached. Please leave a message after–
The Tower...
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
BZZZT... Come ooon! BZZZT... Hurry up! BZZZT... Start the train!
...Found you.
Iris Orthodoxy - Conference Room
Whew... After all those detours, they're finally moving forward with your plan, Commander.
You've fought hard for this. Relish this moment.
Also, we should probably–
...Oh, look at the time.
I've got an urgent meeting I need to attend, so I sadly can't join you for dinner.
But please, DO eat dinner. I don't want to hear excuses about how eating is a chore.

options.content: Want me to save some for you?

scripts.say: Good.
Thanks, but no need. I have a feeling it's going to be a long meeting.
I'll just find something nice to eat after everything's done.
Crap! I've gotta run. Talk to you later, Commander!
I see Memphis off, then I leave the conference room.
I walk through the door and start taking my first step out into the evening sunlight... when all of sudden, it's all gone.
It has been replaced by that view of space – the one that always appears when Helena META and I talk.
Good evening, Commander.
I thought we agreed that you'd give a warning before you contacted me...
Since you didn't, it must be urgent. Am I correct?
Yes... BZZZT... Sorry about that. There was no time to give you a warning.
What's the matter?
BZZZT... plan... BZZZT... went wrong... BZZZT...
BZZZT... The situation is a lot... BZZZT... more complicated than anticipated... BZZZT...
Helena, you keep cutting out.
The connection is barely holding up.
Cutting out? BZZZT... Hang on... BZZZT... run a search... BZZZT...
BZZZT... No... BZZZT... jamming source, it's... BZZZT...
BZZZT... the guest room... BZZZT...
BZZZZZZT...
Helena? Helena!
As the noise intensifies, the projection of Helena becomes increasingly distorted, eventually collapsing altogether into a blue dot before disappearing.
The distant stars, too, seem to flicker and twitch.
I remember Helena saying this space exists somewhere within an Arbiter – The Tower, I think it was.
Therefore, it should be impossible for almost anyone to find this place, let alone jam it.
Given that, it's likely that an enemy of hers is responsible for this.
Before she cut out, she said something about a "jamming source" and that it was in "the guest room."
The question is – what guest room? Where?
Maybe she meant where I am. I should order a sweep of the whole building when I get back.
I have a bad feeling about this. The same group behind the near-superimposition event in Antarctica might be trying to catch us off-guard again...
If so, disaster is on the horizon.
I sure hope so. Your branch is currently under constant threat.
You stopped her from accomplishing her first objective. She still has two more.
Be on your guard, Commander.
The battle isn't over yet.
What happened in Antarctica was just a drill. Their real target is the Orthodoxy.
If the group behind Antarctica was responsible for jamming the line Helena set up for me back then, it stands to reason that they could also hack this virtual space.
I need to tell the girls about this ASAP.
I look around, waiting for the view of the stars to change, but it doesn't.
Dammit. I never did ask Helena what you do to "hang up" in here...
What do I do now?
HEY! IS ANYONE THERE? TELL ME HOW TO GET OUT OF HERE!
The echo of my yell disappears almost instantly. There is not a soul in sight, only stars above.
(There might be an exit somewhere around here. Better look around.)
I look from top to bottom, in and out, to and fro, and there is nothing but the galaxy overhead.
(Pinching yourself when you're dreaming wakes you up, so...)
It has something to do with the lack of pain and realizing you're dreaming. Maybe if I fall from a height, the impact will send me back to reality?
Unfortunately, there is nothing tall to stand on in here. Only the countless stars glimmering high up above.
(Pinching yourself when you're dreaming wakes you up, so...)
(By extension, if I can convince myself I've died in here, won't that send me back to reality?)
(No, what am I thinking? This isn't a dream, and even merely convincing myself that I've died is a risk I don't want to take.)
That's when, all of a sudden, I hear the ring of a wind chime close by.
(Ah... There's that wind chime again.)
The next thing I know, a door has appeared in front of me.
And there's that door again. The same one I saw when I delved into Anchorage's data and when I spoke to Soyuz.
Seems it can reach me anywhere – even in this virtual space you created, Helena.
Unless... it's an emergency exit, and you created this, too?
There is no answer. The door just stands there, silently.
It doesn't look like there's any other way out...
I'm opening it.
Sakura Empire Encampment
Sister– Ahem... Akagi. About that invitation from the Iron Blood...
Yes, I know the one. The invitation to their floating fortress for a demonstration of their latest technology.
I believe they said it's to return the gesture after we invited them to participate in one of our sacred rites.
It's a favorable trade for what we let them see at the Diadem of Light, for sure.
Although, the timing of this invitation is inopportune. We cannot send a sizable fleet to the Iron Blood right now.
Mhm. And if we ourselves go, it'll complicate our joint operations.
Sure, we might gain some technological insight, but we'd also be inviting our enemies to take advantage of our absence.
Precisely. Monitoring the Sirens and gaining more valuable intel is our top priority. Focus on that instead, Kaga.
Until we have what we need, the Sakura Empire will not mobilize on any large scale.
As you say. I'll tell them we have to decline their invitation.
Who said anything about declining it? The Iron Blood is our closest ally. We can't say we're too busy for them.
Then what do you suggest? It's not like we could send Lady Nagato...
Then I suppose we have to find someone suited for the job, won't we?
Anyone come to mind, Kaga? While I doubt the Iron Blood will show us anything too spectacular... you never know.
Since you and I are both out of the question... I think we have to appoint another envoy.
Perhaps we should request someone higher up...
Surely you don't think they'd concern themselves with such trivial matters.
You have a point. They have more important things to do.
Yes, and while it would be interesting to see them make a move, it would also place more eyes upon us–
If... If I might make a suggestion! What about sending the Great Veteran?
What about her, indeed? Am I supposed to laugh?
Mikasa is completely off the table. She's too prone to sticking her nose into places it absolutely does not belong.
Oh, well... In that case, maybe–
Shoukaku's merry gang? Not a snowball's chance in hell.
I see... Was it really that obvious what I was going to say...?
Better to hold your tongue than to let the world know that you are a fool. Jintsuu, care to share your wisdom with us?
Certainly, if you're willing to lend an ear.
If what you need is someone with an esteemed name who'll mind only her own business, then I can think of none better suited than Lady Shinano.
(Not a bad idea. Knowing her, she'd rather get her beauty sleep than try to pry where she shouldn't.)
Excellent idea, Jintsuu. I will take this proposal to our higher-ups. Shinano will act as our envoy to the Iron Blood.
Finally... It's time to spring the next step of the plan into action.

sequence: "Watatsumi Ritual held at the Diadem of Light, despite interference from Ashes members. Priority package from Akagi recovered."
"Transmission detailing Shinano's course for the mainland received. Used to infer authenticity of the package."
"Operation planned by Friedrich commenced. Floating fortress came under attack from Sirens. Peter Strasser's unit, with Sardegnian backup, fended the Sirens off."
"Result: insight into process of controlling Mirror Seas gained. Equipment testing concluded."
"Invitation to Sakura Empire higher-ups stamped and sent."
<size=51>「……」</size>
"I'm finished. Is my summary satisfactory?"
"Mhm. Sounds good to me. Well done, Thiele."
"Please, don't pat me on the head. It's infantilizing. Now, do you need anything else?"
"Nope. The stage has been set. Now we just wait for the guests to arrive."
"I see. In that case, I'll take a short nap. Wake me when it's time..."

scripts.say: KABOOOOM!
The seal around the mechanism dissipated under a fiery onslaught from Katsuragi's planes.
"Congratulations... But your trial does not end here. Continue onwards."
As the mysterious voice faded, so too did the violent wind and waves.
Huh, smashing that thing really did the trick!
Hey, uh... What's with this pedestal...?
Yamakaze, I don't think it's advisable to touch other people's belongings...
That's right! We're still in enemy territory, so don't go around touching random objects without telling us first!
True, true! Phew, that was a close one...
Say, how'd you know that the building was controlling everything?
Well, let's just say... This whole thing seems to be based off of the Sakura Empire's rituals, and I happen to know a thing or two about that... *snap*!
Woaaah! That's incredible, Katsuragi!
Ahaha! Don't underestimate the power of a full-fledged aircraft carrier!
I wonder who's more knowledgeable about these things between you and Yura~
Uh, about that! Not like it matters, because you have me here!
Does it really not matter...?
O-of course not! What's the point of asking? Let's hurry up and keep moving!
Otherwise, we're going to fall behind Team Chikuma! Shimakaze, I'll be counting on you to scout ahead!
Dragon Palace - Outer Ring
So then there was this... and that... and some more of that...
And that concludes my scouting report! Let's hurry on towards the Heart!
Please be careful, everyone!
I must admit, I didn't think of the brute force approach to unlocking that mechanism that Katsuragi used... Heh.
A bit unrefined, but I'm surprised you were even able to unlock the mechanism without applying the right method, as my Self did.
Truly, our carriers never fail to surprise me.
I did agree to make this a race, but I didn't expect both our sides to take it so seriously~
For better or for worse though, "they" have been sending us information, and I'm not sure what to make of it...
Do you have any ideas, Suruga? Shimakaze's group is about to break through the outer ring.
(I thought it was a better idea to take a detour, but... Yeah, that's just like that fuel-for-brains. She rushed headfirst into the fray last time as well...)
(Wait, doesn't this mean that Shimakaze's going to show us up? Wouldn't that make me the dumb one then?)
Suruga? What's wrong? We're about to leave...
You asked for it. If it's a serious match you want, it's a serious match you'll get!
Oh my. Are you finally starting to see the fun in our little competition?
(I'd be having more fun if we weren't trapped in a facility we have zero data on with no way of contacting the outside world, but...)
All right then, let's keep moving forward and keep our eyes peeled for any other mechanisms!
(I don't want to do this, but I don't really have a choice...!)
You know, this place really does look just like the Dragon Palace from our legends...
That's true. There's no place like this on the Sakura Empire's maps though.
I can't really see Akagi or Nagato doing something like this though. The Yamatos though... It might be more down their alley.
I'd agree with that.
...But, there is one more thing I'm worried about.
They never said anything about the fairytale castle having weird traps and the like.
In other words...
All of this somehow feels like a defense system, but maybe not quite...
We still don't have enough information, I suppose. Considering how we only just jumped in, we don't have much to work with.
But first, it seems like we've got company... Everyone, be careful!
Now then, let's get through this little puzzle~♪
KABOOOOM!
I'm sure that last shot landed, but I barely even felt anything...
These mass-produced models are pretty old and busted, but isn't their firepower a bit too low?
Having that said, I don't think our attacks are exactly having the desired effects either.
Any luck on your end, Suruga?
None! We're gonna be stuck here forever if we keep fighting like this...!
I can't tell if we're going to have any success with the direct attack approach, so let's try to avoid them for now and continue scouting ahead.
(Well duh, not everyone can charge headlong into the enemy like Shimakaze. Of course it's better to avoid fighting whenever possible.)
(But is this really the right way of doing things...? While I'm in the back overanalyzing everything, Shimakaze's group is already about to break through...)
It's so nice that Chikuma has a nice grasp over things with her "eyes." I'm glad I'm on this team instead...
Did you say something, Suruga?
(Oh, crap! I let my tongue slip...)
Err, it's nothing! I just was thinking out loud...
If you have any suggestions, I'm all ears. Naturally, you bring plenty of your own expertise that I cannot hope to match~
If you want to try leading the team, I'd be glad to pass that role to you any time~
I'm flattered, but err, I think things are better this way!
Suruga and her allies continued to press forward, neutralizing the mechanisms identified by Chikuma's "eyes" while fending off any enemies in the way.
Though they struggled to eliminate the extremely durable mass-produced ships, they continued to make progress, slow and steady.
However, the density of the enemy vessels continued to increase, to the point where they completely blocked off the waterway by lining up side-to-side.
They're blocking the way forward, just like a metal wall...
Damn it, why are the obstacles along our path this ridiculous?!
We seem to be much closer to the Dragon Palace's control structure than Shimakaze's fleet... so I guess this is what we have to deal with.
Suruga, are you able to bring your full firepower to bear?
Sure thing. I'm raring to go.
I'm sick and tired of being stuck here... and I'll give a piece of my mind to anyone who blocks our way!!
KABOOOOM!
Yura, hurry up and push through the opening Suruga made for us!
(With how long we're taking, Shimakaze's probably getting ready to lap us by now...)
Let's bust our way out of here, finish our mission, and then go back home already...!
……{namecode:175}？
Gaaah! Forget it, let's just keep going.
Dragon Palace - Middle Ring
Woaah, it's even more grandiose in here than it was outside~!
Katsuragi, do we really have to destroy a place this nice...?

Well, if this turns out to be one of the Sakura Empire's facilities, we're obviously not going to destroy it. But if it is a Siren facility, we don't have the numbers to collect all the information we possibly can and still ensuring Lady Shinano's safety... So that means we have no other options.
Aww... I would've loved to show my friends around the Dragon Palace...
Wait, if we're able to take control of this place and drive it back home, wouldn't we be able to avoid having to blow it up?
You think big, and I like that! Can you imagine the way the people back home would shower us with praise and sing our glories?
Oh~hohoho! People would address me as Lady Katsuragi, and as for you, the very wind would be named in your honor!
Ehh? Do you really think I could become famous?!
For sure, for sure! You're already a very successful shipgirl, so you should start getting used to your future title – Lady Shimakaze!
If this is the real Dragon Palace... Decades could have passed when we return to the surface...
Good thing it's not the real deal then! What's with this crappy hospitality? They didn't even roll out a banquet for us!
If it's hospitality you want, the only welcoming crew we're going to get are those mass-produced ships.
Got it? We've arrived in a new area, so remember to keep your eyes peeled! If you notice any irregularities, I expect you to notify the others right away!
Sure thing! Now, I wonder what kind of puzzles are waiting for us this time...
If there's anything you can't figure out, just leave it to me! Let's start by taking down these seals, just like we did before!
I'm on the job! Shimakaze, full speed ah––hwaaaah?!
Shimakaze, who had been enthusiastically dashing forward, suddenly came to an abrupt halt.
Th-there's an oil spill in the water? Wait, this is...?!
Nearby, a black stain on the surface of the cerulean waters reflected the light of the Dragon Palace.
Why would there be a patch of oil here?
There's more of this stuff floating around all over the place! Even if everyone emptied out their supplies, it wouldn't create this much of a mess!
Think the enemy mass-produced ships might be leaking or something?
So much oil spilled into the ocean... What if it catches fire...?
Ugh, I don't even want to think about it! Everyone, be very cautious when using your weapons––
Actually, no firearms at all, zip, nada, zilch! We need to get out of here, fast!
You've gotta be kidding me... Darn it, darn it, darn it!!
Well duh, the enemies weren't going to stop shooting at us just because we stopped!
Retreat! Run for it! I don't wanna sink in a sea of flames!
Isn't it way too reckless to spread oil all over your own castle and then set the freakin' thing on fire?!
Katsuragi, I think I might be able to do something about this...
Do you not see that gaping, flame-belching maw from hell? No matter how fast you might be, you're not gonna make it through there!
*cough* *cough*! If anything, I'll have my planes take out those mechanisms from a distance!
Ugh... You worthless pieces of mass-produced metal... If you wanted to see the world burn so badly, then let me show you what a true sea of flames looks like!
You've got this, Katsuragi!
Katsuragi's planes plunged into the thick plume of black smoke rising from the burning fuel, but were quickly repelled by the anti-aircraft guns defending the mechanism.
Katsuragi, your attacks aren't going to work!
I can see that! Damnit, where did that anti-air gun pop out from anyway?!
But, I won't be caught off guard twice! I'll just hit it with another airstrike!
However, the second wave of planes were repelled by the anti-air fire as well, retreating just before there could be any losses.
I'm not done yet! Third time's the charm!
Woah, um, why don't we calm down first? I don't think a single carrier's going to be able to get through anti-air fire that dense!
Arghh!! It's all because I can't utilize my full potential inside this cramped space! Hey, Shimakaze, don't just go rushing off on your own again! Get back here!
Huuuh? Why can't I go?!
Do you have eyes?! Everything's still on fire!
Fiiiiine, if you say so...
Sakura Empire
They all disappeared inside the Dragon Palace? Chikuma, Yamakaze, all of them?
The Dragon Palace... is it really gone now?
...To that place I sent my planes, but... I could find no trace of them...
Our counterparts in the Iron Blood said the same thing...
What foul luck... I thought it would be safe for us to head to the Iron Blood.
Did you request reinforcements from the home islands?
Nay, for there may be no need... I have seen much in my dreams, of the castle beneath the waves...
And though we may be in a crisis, I have also heard its calls...
But more importantly, I saw... the "Commander."
One who guides both the Sakura Empire and the Iron Blood equally...
The importance of this person's past cannot be understated... Alas, my dreams refuse to show it to me...
I beseech you, please, find the story of this one's past for me...
I would be glad to honor your request, Shinano.
Wait, Nagato, may I take on this responsibility?
...I don't know how much Shinano has seen about the Commander, but let me tell you something important first.
Something... important...?
Right. The reason why the Commander is able to lead ships of all factions.
Allow me to explain. Shinano, as you already may know, us shipgirls are born from the powers of the Wisdom Cube.
Humanity has been researching the Wisdom Cube since the previous war, but to little avail.
...As for our rigging and gear, those are essentially byproducts made from the energy given off by Wisdom Cubes.
Much of the military use of Wisdom Cubes followed the same process.
Indeed. In actuality... Us shipgirls are only a small part of the Wisdom Cubes' saga.
What?! I've been kept in the dark on this entire matter?!
Don't be so shocked. There's much I haven't even talked about yet.
It is often said that Wisdom Cubes "embody the wishes of humanity," but nobody actually knows what that means.
