Huh? What are either of those? Are you talking about the Great Veteran and Lady Nagato?
Hmm... The way I see it... They're all my friends!
I can only assume something happened between Akagi and the others, but that's not the end of the world...
Disagreement between people is perfectly normal! And I know they both care deeply about us all!
People can come to an understanding as long as they're willing to listen to the other side!
That's what I've always believed!
"That is a brave view to hold. Yes, this treasure is yours as well."
Thank you! We'll meet again at the next pedestal!
Umm, Ms. Disembodied Voice? I'm ready for the next question!
"Yes, of course. Answer me this..."
"When will you consider yourself victorious? What is your ultimate goal?"
To defeat all the Sirens and ensure the safety of our seas!
That, and to bring peace back to the Sakura Empire... No, to the whole world!
And to do this, I need the Palace's powers! Please, give me your strength!
"Very well. The treasure is yours. Please proceed to the next pedestal."
"Answer me this final question..."
"Supposing the war comes to an end, what comes next for the world's shipgirls?"
Huh? That depends on what you mean...
I can only speak for myself, but I'd like to travel all around the world... Or maybe start a dojo and teach the Shimakaze fighting style!
"The question is not about you specifically, it is about what will become of all shipgirls."
Hmm... Well, I don't think we exist solely to fight.
When we're not fighting, we all have fun hobbies to pursue. If there wasn't any more fighting for us to do, couldn't we just enjoy a life of peace?
As for "what will become of us," I'm afraid I don't know...
"That is... a pleasant idea. Yes."
"I have no more questions for you. The rest of this all is Eugen's problem now."
What was that? It's "Eugen's problem now"? What do you mean?
"Err, I meant... Listen closely, O brave one!"
I-I'm all ears!
"You have acquired every treasure the Dragon Palace has to give."
"Now go. Return to your friends and use the treasures' power to save them!"
Dragon Palace - Heart
While Shimakaze searched for the mechanism's pedestal, Suruga's group was fighting a fierce battle against the defender of the castle.
Even though Hakuryuu and I are both supposed to be aircraft carriers, I've never seen anyone fight like that before!
Doesn't it seem like each one of her blows are as powerful as Odin's?!
Katsuragi, focus on handling your planes! We'll try to draw Hakuryuu's attention!
Oh, um... Thank you so much, Miss Eugen! You've been protecting us this entire time...
Don't worry about it~ How could I let any misfortune befall the guests of the Iron Blood?
Besides, all of you must already be exhausted from your previous battles. Get too close to that Hakuryuu, and she'll take you out in a heartbeat.
Since this is a matter of life and death... I suppose I can afford to put in some effort~
(This woman, I swear... She was nothing like this back at the Diadem of Light! She's been holding back this entire time!)
(The same with Odin! Between her and Eugen, they've fired a total of one single shot since we found them! Who are these people...?!)
(And I sure hope Shimakaze doesn't mess up... If she figures out some way of bungling this, I'm going to be livid...)
Suruga, we're making our stand here! Buy her as much time as possible!
If Shimakaze can activate that mechanism, we'll surely have an opening!
What's this? ...My wounds are all healing up?
Is this the same mechanism that was causing Shimakaze's team so many problems earlier...?
But this is exactly what we needed...! Good going, Shimakaze!
The planes that Hakuryuu's using are obviously of Sakura Empire origin! Plus, that's one of our ancient fighting methods! There's no way the Sirens could mimic this!
...But why would she be attacking us then?!
Who you might be means nothing to me! I'm the guardian of this castle, and I challenge all those who trespass!
You might be fighting to try to escape from this castle, but... you've overstepped terribly.
...You now seek to turn my own mechanisms against me. But so be it, that is a fair handicap.
I'll hit you so hard that there won't be anything left to heal!
Barrier! Nah~ nah~ Can't touch this~♪
Impudent rodent!
(Hakuryuu seems to have a single-minded fixation on fighting strong foes. In that case...)
What good does it do for you to wait for prey to fall into your lap here in the Dragon Palace? Hakuryuu, why not test your mettle in the outside world?
...You speak the truth. But that has nothing to do with our current battle!
You shall see that I am the sole master of this domain! By thunder is sky rent, by flame shall you be cleansed!
What's that rising out of the water...?
Wh-wh-what kind of sick joke is this? What happened to a duel between aircraft carriers? Her rigging just combined with those massive cannons!
She's coming at us...!
The fuel... there's more fire spreading all over the water's surface...!
Maaan, I'm lucky I at least have this barrier protecting me, but talk about a tough nut to crack...
A third mechanism? Cheap tricks, but troublesome nevertheless...
She's going on the defensive...!
Listen to me, Hakuryuu! If we're both from the Sakura Empire, I have no desire to fight you! Let's talk things through!
That's right! I need you to tell me how to use massive cannons like that as well!
K-Katsuragi, now really isn't the time for that...!
How... to use...? Look, I don't know every little thing about how this place works!
But tell you what, if you can beat me, I'll hear you out.
If that's what you want, don't you dare hold back!
I'm finally back! Is everyone still hanging in there?
I never thought I'd be so glad to see you, but yeah, those mechanisms are making the fight much more manageable!
(What's more, she seems to be getting weaker every time she taps into the Dragon Palace's power, just like Odin...)
(Darn them, even though they knew all this, they barely lifted a finger to help!)
Press the advantage! Just hold out a bit longer, everyone...!
KABOOOOM!
Victory is ours!
I'm being pushed back...?! Impossible!
Don't you dare underestimate me! With the Dragon Palace's power flowing through me, with this blade in my hands... I'll crush you like insects!
But just in case! Just in case you somehow manage to win, I'll uphold my side of the deal and let you leave!
What about the control device and the "treasure"?
I'd be fine with that, but... How am I supposed to give you something I don't have?
Simple. If you are the master of the Dragon Palace... then we will take you.
...What?
Well, whatever. If you can beat me, you can take whatever you want.
In that case, I call dibs on all the research equipment~
(Woah, the mask sure comes off fast when it comes to treasure...)
Anything you'd like to add, Shimakaze? Hakuryuu said she'd honor the deal.
I see! In that case...
What is it that you want, brat?
The thing that I want...
Is the same as Chikuma! That'd be you, Hakuryuu!
Not just as the guardian of the Dragon Palace! I want you to come back to the Sakura Empire with us and be our friend!
What a foolish pipe dream, brat... As long as I wield this blade, I shall never bow to anyone!
Bow? There's no need to bow to us! We're all going to be friends through mutual trust and understanding!
Trust... and understanding?
You heard me right! Wouldn't it be so much more fun to go around and meet people, rather than wait for them to come to you?
Things are always more fun when we do them together! Isn't that right, Suruga?
A promise is a promise. If you defeat me, I will join you.
...That is, assuming you CAN defeat me!
Listen well, brat. While I wield this sword, you have no chance of winning!
I already know! So, all I have to do is become speed itself, and knock that sword right out of your hand!
Let's do this, everyone! Suruga!
Somewhere in the Sakura Empire...
Shimakaze, you've come back from the Siren facility?!
Good... I can see that you've brought it back, with the help of the Iron Blood...
I never thought I'd live to see this... They brought the entire Dragon Palace back?
"Hakuryuu"... I have heard this name uttered before.
Was that the name of a blueprint ship? Maybe something the higher-ups haven't told us yet?
When I was sealed inside the Sacred Tree, I would have dreams, similar to Shinano.
But one such dream was very different... I don't remember what kind of dream it was, but I know I heard that name.
Not just that name... But others as well, most of them unfamiliar.
Even when the fragments are in place, even when you can see them reflected within the mirror... Only emptiness awaits your hand when you reach out. 'tis a feeling that this one knows well...
I can't say I understand what's going on, but...
We can say with confidence that Hakuryuu is a member of the Sakura Empire, right?
This, I am sure of.
It's just been one major incident after another since Watatsumi was swapped out...
With Watatsumi gone, no more rituals can take place, and my dreams can no longer guide the Sakura Empire...
But alas, even this one, who used to mourn being lost in the currents of fate, can surely move forward...
Fear not. I am sure there is something we can do about the Watatsumi's fragments.
...Shinano, it is good that you have faith, but you don't need to push yourself.
Lady Shinano, the Iron Blood fleet is getting ready to depart.
The others are waiting, so... if you're still planning on going...?
Thank you for letting me know...
We will deal with the aftermath of the Dragon Palace incident, so you can continue with your trip to the Iron Blood.
Indeed. I wish you the best of luck.
Thank you for everything you've done...
Somewhere in the Sakura Empire, months later...
Hum, hum~♪
You're in an unusually good mood today. Gross.
Of course I am. I never thought Akagi would go out of her way to prepare such a nice welcoming gift for me...
...And that's a valid reason to slow down to a crawl?
I'm going to have gray hairs by the time we make it back home at this rate.
My, my, Thiele. I thought Lebe was supposed to be the impatient one. It's not like we're doing anything wrong~
Didn't Akagi hatch up the plan to swap out Watatsumi as well? Don't you think she's being a bit too conspicuous?
Assuming she doesn't have the entire leadership under her thumb–
I wouldn't put it like that, Thiele. Thanks to us, Watatsumi is safe. We did them a huge favor~
Besides, if the Sakura Empire doesn't want even more things to regret... they'll have the sense to not lay a finger on us.
...So, how do you explain that fleet in front of us?
Hold, Iron Blood guest.
If memory serves me properly... You're Kaga's other sister?
So, did you have a message for me from Akagi? Or did you come to give me the instruction manual as well?
There seems to be some misunderstanding. I'm not Akagi's messenger.
Is that so? Whose, then?
Someone a bit higher up? I guess you can say, someone who knows Akagi well.
We know all about what you and Z2 did at the Diadem of Light.
I see, I see! You're using intimidation to raise that persuasion gauge! So yeah, we'd like you to come with us.
And I assume... I don't have the option of refusing your offer?
We'd just like to have a little chat. About our "agenda," and about the future between our two factions.
We won't take too much of your time.
So be it. I guess we'll see soon enough... whether it's a serpent or a demon that comes out of that cave.
As the party approached the island, a huge building towered above the water.
In front of them was a lavish castle with pristine white walls, waterways flowing from a central spire like roads of cascading blue.
K-Katsuragi, any idea what this is...?!
Just as lost as you are! However, using my extensive aircraft carrier knowledge of castles, I would have to surmise that what we're looking at iiiis...
I dunno, looks like the legendary Dragon Palace to me!
Yeah, exactly what I was going to say! Shimakaze, let's tell Chikuma that we found something real amazing!
Sure thing! Chikuma, can you hear me?
Loud and clear. Something to report?
Well, we went just a little off course and came across a hereto undiscovered island, and...
That's... interesting. I would ask Lady Shinano about it, but she's asleep at the moment. For now, just stay put until I manage to get in touch with her.
"Just stay put," she says... It only makes me more curious to see what's inside the castle! Am I right, Shimakaze?
I won't deny I'm curious as well, but Chikuma did just give us very clear orders, so...

We won't figure out what this place even is without going inside, will we? What's more, this is a chance for us to earn accolades! Letting this opportunity slide by goes against my principles as a proper aircraft carrier!
If the legends are true, there's bound to be mountains of treasure inside! I say, let's gooooo!
Even if there is treasure inside, I fear we're in no right to claim it...
Oh, don't be such a stick in the mud! This is your best shot to earn Lady Shinano's respect after blacking out on her! Come on!
...You make a very strong case, Katsuragi! On second thought, I'm going with you!
Um, Shinano, I have to ask you something first. What do you think of the commander?
Commander... is the only one who understands what I've experienced...
Then, hold tightly onto the fragments of this dream when you awaken. And never forget what happened here.
I see... This dream, too, is about to come to an end...
Yes... I am about to rewrite the very core of this Mirror Sea.
I do not understand the principle behind your power, but... the aftershocks from what I am about to do will likely erase the fleeting changes you've been able to effect in this world.
That... is when your dream will come to an end.
Very well... Our meeting has been brief, but I will remember it forever... I wish you the best of luck...
(whispers) ...I'm sorry.
Do not stray from your path. Become the light in the darkness to guide your friends.
Three, two, one...
KABOOOOM!
Sakura Empire Fleet
Did you sleep well, Shinano?
Ah... A fragment of bliss that tempts me to indulge in it for the rest of time...
Kasumi... Do you know... the commander...?
Mhm. Kasumi knows the commander.
Do you wish to speak to the commander, Lady Shinano?
Not quite... I simply... wish to learn more about that person...
But first... How does Shimakaze's fleet fare...?
I was just informed they discovered a great castle atop an uninhabited island.
Yamakaze described it as looking just like the legendary Dragon Palace.
I ordered them to stay put until further notice so I could ask you how to proceed. What are your orders, Lady Shinano?
The Dragon Palace... Never have I seen such a thing, not even in my dreams...
We have reason to believe it's some sort of secret laboratory, as there's no record of an island ever existing there.
But, seeing as they found it simply sitting out in the open...
...It's very likely to be a trap laid by the Sirens.
If the Sirens are aware of us... then 'twould be folly to ignore this island...
Should I order them to bombard the facility, then?
We mustn't destroy this place if it is one of the Sakura Empire's secret facilities... And if it is a Siren facility, I do doubt if our cannons can even destroy it...
But at the very least... we must determine if the Sirens are behind this...
Chikuma, Suruga, my request for you... is to lend aid to the Shimakaze fleet...
But Lady Shinano! We can't leave your side! It's too dangerous for you!
Worry not for my safety... I have already seen what fate has in store...
If so... Then very well! Chikuma and I shall join up with the vanguard fleet!
(Ugh... I've got SUCH a bad feeling about this...)
Dragon Palace - Outer Ring
Um... I'm afraid we shouldn't be going so deep without waiting for instructions...
It'll be fine! This place is totally empty! Look!
Rooooooooooooaar!!
Yamakaze suddenly let out a roar that resounded across the palace's walls.
Y-Yamakaze! Wh-what if you woke somebody up...
...But nothing happened at all.
There's nobody here except for us, yeah? It probably got abandoned a long time ago.
Bzzt––––!
This is Chikuma. I've arrived at the entrance of a place that appears to match the Dragon Palace you were describing. Katsuragi, Shimakaze, please copy.
Chikuma?! And Yura as well as Suruga too? What are you all...
Lady Shinano personally sent us here. Hehe, I see you already have plans of your own though.
(Ugh, I knew it... It's just like during that dumb mock exercise. Why do I get pulled around so easily?)
S-sorry for acting without waiting for orders! What would you have me do?
(Wouldn't the obvious thing be to meet up first? Good grief, one look at this thing and it clearly has the Sirens' tentacle-prints all over it...)
Let's see... We'll investigate the facility, and if it appears to be dangerous, we'll level it... In theory, anyway.
So far, there doesn't appear to be anything questionable going on, but that can change without a moment's notice when you're dealing with the Sirens.
As for the position of your fleet... W-wait, how'd you have time to get that deep inside?
I'm so sorry! I just got caught up in the excitement of exploration...
Now that you mention it, I did end up pretty far from the entrance, huh... I'll turn around and head back right away!
(How do you get so distracted that you lose track of your surroundings?! My stomach can't handle much more of this disaster waiting to happen...)
If this really is some kind of Siren facility, there's probably no way for us to destroy it from the outside.
However, we should be able to shut it down by locating some kind of control device, just like in a Mirror Sea.
If we're lucky, there might even be some kind of self-destruct button lying around somewhere...
But in any case, gathering intel should be our first priority. Shall we meet up first?
Shimakaze, Yamakaze, and Katsuragi, gather up and return to the entrance. Understood?
Without warning, the Dragon Palace began to shudder violently.
Mweeehhhh?! An earthquake?!
No, it's not! Get out of there this instant, Shimakaze! The whole building is starting to sink!
Wh-what do you mean by "starting to sink"...?! I'm an aircraft carrier, not a submarine! There's no way I'd be able to handle going underwater!
Even at my top speed, there's no way we'd be able to make it to the entrance in time!
Katsuragi, have you noticed the "seal" at the top of the castle?
Seal? I'm not sure I know what you're talking about, but we're all gonna drown if we can't make it to the entr–– Oh hey, the water level's not rising at all~
So I guess the entire Dragon Palace is diving? Wait, won't that create a huge whirlpool that sucks everyone outside under?!
That would appear to be the case... Suruga, Yura, we'll have to enter this Dragon Palace, like it or not!
(I knew it, I knew it! Why'd I even bother trying to fool myself into thinking that nothing would happen?!)
Shortly afterwards...
We're pretty deep underwater, aren't we? The blessings of the sun and sky no longer reach us here...
I guess there really is some kind of "seal" around this place. Otherwise, the water would've come crashing in.
(I thought we were goners... This sucks so bad, I want to go home already...)
Our communications with the outside have been cut off as well... Yura, do you think this "seal" might actually be a Mirror Sea?
Who knows? It looks to me like one of those bags at a koi-scooping stall. Except millions of times larger, and we're the fish...
I had no idea it was possible to make something like this... Think it could be anything other than Siren technology?
Considering how deep underwater we are, it's not even unusual for our communication to be cut off.
Chikuma? Suruga? Anyone! Can anyone hear me?
This is Chikuma. Shimakaze, are you alright?
Right as rain! But... what do we do now?
Let's see... Well, there's no way we can ask for help from Lady Shinano now. The first and only thing we can do is figure out how to get out of here...
In any case, let's join up as we originally planned. The entrance obviously won't do any good for us now, so we'll have to explore around and see what we can find.
At least there's some good news – my seaplanes are still working.
Naturally, my planes are still operational!
Good, we have plenty of "eyes" then. Now as for how we meet up...
"The Heart. The Heart is what you seek."
"Within the Heart sleeps a secret and a treasure."
"Indeed, only those who reach the Heart will again see the light of day."
"Step forward, and find your way to the Heart."
"Yes, the Dragon Palace shall reward the brave."
That makes sense! Let's head to the center of the Dragon Palace!
Would ya look at that, Shimakaze? What'd I tell you? There are treasures waiting for us inside these walls!
Treasure Hunt! Treasure Hunt! Treasure Hunt!
I suppose having a landmark will make it easier for us to group up... I guess we'll meet at the Palace's "Heart" then?
(Whaaaat?! Is nobody going to comment on the mysterious ghostly voice giving us cryptic clues?!)
Suruga, since we're going to meet up anyway, why don't we have a race to see who can make it to the center first?
Absolutely not.
Ehhhhhhhh?!
Now, now. It won't hurt to have a common objective since we're all heading to the same place.
Fine, fine. I'll be counting on you to lead the way then, Chikuma.
You got it. Hehe, I guess that makes us Team Chikuma?
You're on! We'll be Team Shimakaze then!
Aye aye!
Aye... aye?
Let's get moving, Team Chikuma.
My planes have already finished scouting out this area. Now onto this path!
Wow, Katsuragi, you're super reliable! There's no way we get lost with you around!
Heh heh~ My recon planes are on a whole 'nother level from Chikuma's seaplanes! Feel free to shower me with more praise! Yes, keep it coming!
We've run into some straggler mass-produced ships, but they're pretty weak.
Maybe this place really was abandoned a long time ago...?
Is it just me, or have the waves been getting stronger and stronger...?
Huh, you're right! The deeper in we go, the rougher the waters get.
We're in a pretty narrow waterway inside an enclosed area... How are there even any waves in the first place?
Ahh! This must be what that voice meant by "rewarding the brave!" This must be like some kind of dungeon!
So you're saying that the wind and waves here are a part of the Dragon Palace's mechanisms? Sounds like a job for heroes like us!
Woohoo! We're gonna be real life heroes!
We got this! I'm already feeling that big protagonist energy!
Um, but... If the wind and waves continue to get stronger and stronger...
At that point, we can just use one of those mass-produced ships!
They might not be very strong, but at least we'll be able to use them to block the elements.
After that, all we have to do is jump from enemy to enemy! If you go fast, it'll be totally fine!
That sounds fine on paper and all, but you're the only person who can pull something like that off. An aircraft carrier like me can't keep up with a speedy destroyer!
Having that said, I'll totally back you up though! No need to worry about the enemies – just charge through with everything you've got!
Great! I appreciate it, Katsuragi!
All righty then, it's time to go fast!!
Shimakaze darted between the enemy mass-produced ships, skillfully avoiding the increasingly tumultuous waves as she made her way to the Heart of the Dragon Palace.
Gotta jump over that next huge wave and duck under that mass-produced ship up ahead...
Woooah! It almost feels like I'm surfing!
Shimakaze, do you see that weird-looking structure in front of you?
Uhhh... Oh yeah, I do! There's some kind of energy reading coming from it!
I think that's the mechanism causing all this! We'll need to hurry up and destroy it–
Right-o! Ready, steady... Wait, huh?
Don't you know you have to bring the right class for the job? Now this... is where a full-fledged carrier gets to shine!
Shimakaze, stand back! It's time for some aircraft-delivered fireworks!
Oh, of course. You're up, Katsuragi!

scripts.say: The sunset glow bathes the grandstands, the decorations and flags strung above high, and the entire circuit.
I came here at Bennington's invitation, but the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally pre-event had already begun some time ago.
Hi, Commander! Welcome back to my channel! Lovely to see you!
I hear a very familiar greeting behind me, but before I even have time to say anything, she grabs me by the hand and drags me to the center of the venue.
Wait, hold it!
We're already late! The pre-event started, like, ages ago!
If we don't move fast, I'm not gonna be able to get enough good footage to make content!
Bennington walks backwards as she takes pictures of everything, expertly pulling me along as we go through the entrance.
Time for the special event coverage! Ready for the summer race lead-up segment! And... we're filming!
We're all here, the location's set up, the sunset's just right, the sea breeze is breezing by... Yep, all perfect!
If I can hype up the opening well, all the videos about the event will have tons of views! That's just how it works, Commander~
As the lights illuminating the venue change in time with the music's beat, the place's already buzzing with excitement.
Basking in the lights, the guest MC, Vicksburg, notices our arrival and cheerfully waves the flag in her hand towards us.
Heart twinkle winkle! Lucky power♪
With a powerful drum beat and the cheers of the crowd, Vicksburg makes the whole venue vibrate with anticipation.
Whoa, the vibe's just the best!
The sea breeze, the sunset, the music, and the cheers... Now this is what summer is all about!
Did you come to watch the event, or film it?
Why not both?
Documenting everything and taking the time to enjoy myself... That's what my streamer sense is telling me♪
What's good, everyone? Welcome to the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally pre-event!
The stage's lighting shifts from bright and warm to a simple white light, and the large screen in the center stage switches to an overhead view of the circuit and the rally logo.
With brisk steps, Vicksburg moves onto the main stage and waves cheerfully at the audience.
Before I introduce our circuit, I have a big surprise for you all!
In order to help as many people as possible enjoy the event, we've prepared a special public experience team!
If you submit the initial entry today, then finish the car check and driver registration after that...
You'll drive and feel the wind rushing through your hair as you grip the wheel! Pitting yourself against drivers who can give professionals a run for their money! At max speed!
Why, maybe you could be the one to rise to the top and raise the trophy?
If you feel the speed calling you right now, don't wait! Gather your courage and get started while there's still time!
It's so cool. You love racing cars, don't you, Rodgers? You're participating for sure, yes?
Huh? I just came along to accompany you! Don't blow it out of proportion, please!
The air is positively crackling with excitement, and it rubs off onto Bennington in no time.
Hey, hey, Commander! Did you hear? Isn't this, like, a crazy opportunity?
Don't you wanna participate too?
While I ponder, the sisters Harrison and Rodgers approach us.
Hm? Commander?
Ah, how lovely to see you! And Bennington too!
Are you entering the race too?
Don't make it sound like WE'RE entering! I have not agreed to any of this! Not even once!
Besides, how could we put a team together when we can't even drive a car?
As soon as Bennington hears that, she turns her camera to focus on our conversation.
Commander, you know your way around a car, don't you?
Just a bit. But I'm just here sightseeing... You know, enjoying my vacation and all that...
Oh, come on! It'd be an uber-waste to let a super race like this just pass you by! Literally!
Hearing that, John Rodgers seems to make up her mind, and she comes over right away.
Commander, I'll have you know...
And just so we're clear, I'm not saying this because the cheering has me hyped or anything!
I... I thought about it really hard, and thought it might... it just might be worth it to give it a try.
Heheh, allow me to help as well!
Ahem... Anyway, that's about it.
Y-you're free to decline if you want. I was just curious, no pressure or anything...

options.content: It seems a bit sudden, but...

scripts.say: Sounds like fun.
It seems a bit sudden, but...
Okay, let's get in this race!
What?! Just like that?!
Oh yeah!
Nice! That's the summer spirit! Nothing screams summer like a last-minute challenger! Now this is content!
But your team will need a name! Commander, say the name loud and clear for the camera!
How does {car2026} sound?
Hm, I can live with that.
What a wonderful name, Commander!
Okay, that's settled, then! {car2026} is off to the races! I can't wait to see it high on that scoreboard!

scripts.say: The start goes smoothly, and now, I'm facing the first corner.
I hug the inside line and hit the brakes at the right time, perfectly hitting the clipping point.
The cars behind me start catching up. They're all vying for the optimal line, but I don't let go of my lead.
Look at that!
That's the first corner done and dusted!
Good going! Keep up your pace.
For the first few laps, the car maintains a consistent performance.
I put down my guard a little to avoid wearing down the tires too soon.
But now I'm realizing how different this is from the qualifiers.
How far do I push the car for one lap? How much should I take care of not wearing out the tires? What kind of pace should I aim for?
A firm sense of endurance and how to pace myself suddenly gain a lot more weight in this race's outcome.
Enterprise came up ahead!
She came out of that corner with great traction, and she took the lead in the long straight!
And Zuikaku follows close behind!
Aah, this is the real deal! Having the lead at the start doesn't mean it's easy to maintain!
Enterprise's movements show no hesitation and incredible precision. There's virtually no fat to cut in her maneuvering.
And Zuikaku is like a blade that doesn't miss a weakness to strike. She looks out for the moment your defense lowers and counters viciously.
And Indomitable follows along quietly instead of trying to force her way in, patiently waiting for an opportunity to seize.
In long endurance races like this, the more experienced runners will keep improving their lap times.
Commander, you should...
Keep my cool, right?
You know it.
But the situation does not improve.
I manage to defend my spot once, but I end up having to give way twice. My lack of experience makes itself apparent as the other drivers whiz ahead of me.
An hour and a half has passed since the race started! The situation for each team looks very different now!
Despite starting in the pole position, the Commander has been outdone by the more experienced racers!
The Commander has been forced to adopt a more passive strategy, trailing the leading group!
Our ranking on the big leaderboard shows we've dropped down to sixth place.
The initial illusion of victory was short lived, fading the longer the race continues.
But I manage to keep my composure.
Because I realize now that this is a race that can't be won with one person's power alone.

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>11 The Team's Fightback</size>

scripts.say: I pull up to the pit and hand the car over to Essex.
Compared to me, her driving is more efficient and her pace more consistent.
Tires ready!
Pit out! Pit out! Pit out!
Understood!
The moment the car leaves the pit lane, I'm left watching the race from our side of the track.
{car2026} has switched drivers smoothly!
13.1 seconds is a super good time! And the next driver is Essex!
Can she use her trademark steady driving to change the tide of this race for {car2026}?
It doesn't take long for the answer to make itself clear.
Essex doesn't try any fancy maneuvers or techniques, instead choosing to trail the car ahead closely.
But once she's given even the slightest of chances, she mercilessly cuts the car on the inside and overtakes it.
Collett, what's the time for the car in front in sector 2? Their team hasn't pitted in a while, have they?
Her lap time is getting worse!
Okay, I'm not gonna make a move on the first corner.
I'll get my chance when her traction drops by the third corner!
Essex is sorta scary...
That's another overtake in the bag for Essex!
She's not being aggressive and wedging herself into every corner like you'd usually expect, but she's still closing the gap with each lap!
John Rodgers nods approvingly as she listens to Bennington's commentary.
Mhm, that's totally right.
Are you sure you get it?
Of course!
Look at how she routes around corners. She's a total veteran, right?
She is taking those really consistently.
And fast too.
Collett's tablet also confirms that her lap times are getting faster and faster.
Hmm, now this I wasn't expecting.
Enterprise, Essex is catching up to us really fast.
She's always known when to strike.
Let's widen the gap while we can.
By the time the rally enters its second half, the team is hot on the heels of the top spots thanks to Essex.
As our team climbs up the rankings in the large circuit screen, the mood in the paddock switches up.
We're catching up!
The top spots are Zuikaku and Enterprise... And Indomitable's managed to keep a consistent third up until now.
This is where the race gets good!
Essex is breaking into the top three! Now she's facing off against Indomitable!
Hm?! Did Indomitable just move aside to let her through?! Now Essex is going off to Zuikaku!
The gap is closing fast! This is a crucial battle for second place! And to decide who gets a shot at the top spot!
Essex doesn't go for the attack right away. Instead, she rides the slipstream and aims to make her move on the next straight.
Back for a fight, eh?! Well, I'm not letting you get ahead of me now!
Not when I haven't had a chance to get back at the grey ghost ahead...
Hmph! Bring it on!
Sensing Essex's intentions, Zuikaku matches her and goes full speed just before the next corner.
Both are pushing their speed to the limit! Whoa... Zuikaku is going even faster and keeping her lead!
Zuikaku's not giving an inch today! She's holding on to her lead!
Even with her tires worn out, she's keeping up strong!
But a loud bang echoes in the track as one of Zuikaku's tires burst out. Her car slides out of the corner and goes off track a moment later.
Whoa! What a disaster!
Zuikaku's tire popped! And she's out of the course!
Essex manages to avoid Zuikaku's car as it veers off and pulls ahead!
*sigh*... Yeah, I figured it would go like this.
Though we're up to second place, the joy is short lived.
Collett, her face glued to the screen this whole time, frowns gravely and talks to Essex.
Essex, our tires... They're on their last legs too.
If we push them any further, our lap times could be the least of our worries – they might even burst.
I know. But if we go to the pit now, Enterprise will only widen her lead.
But then, an announcement from the race organizers suddenly rings out through the course.
VSC.
Virtual Safety Car deployed.
VSC?!
It's because of the debris left after Zuikaku's tires burst earlier!
It's the perfect time for a pit stop.
If I go in now, we can minimize the time loss!
Everyone's eyes are on me now.
One question remains: who will run the final stretch of the race?
After a moment, Essex finally speaks.
Commander, you're up!
I believe in you!
The gap's almost closed. I know you can make it to first place!
This is what we worked so hard for... Commander, you're the only one that can do this!

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>12 A Millisecond Miracle</size>

scripts.say: We complete our final pit stop during the VSC's forced slowdown.
Tire changes, refueling, and driver tag-in are all done in record time.
A perfect pit stop!
Position confirmed! We're still in second place!
Enterprise just finished her pit stop, too!
Roger that.
VSC ends, and the race resumes.
The final showdown for first place has begun!
Enterprise has taken the lead, but hot on her heels is the Commander, who has just returned to the driver's seat!
There's only a razor-thin margin between them. The whole six-hour rally is sure to be decided in this final moment!
Enterprise drives patiently and defensively.
She doesn't make any wasteful moves or burn through her tires unnecessarily.
Even getting one meter closer is a Herculean feat.
They're gaining on me... That isn't Essex driving, is it?
It's my honey~ You're gonna get overtaken~
Feeling the pressure yet, Enty?
Yeah... I am.
But I won't let the Commander get past me.
With each lap, my muscle memory of the track gradually returns to me.
Where I can brake later than usual, where I can push the throttle harder...
Countless lessons learned through trial and error lead me to the perfect line.
Commander, Enterprise has a habit of being gentler on her tires through the sixth corner.
Her exit speed is lower as a result, so try making a move on the next lap.
I take a deep breath. Sure enough, the opportunity comes on the next lap.
As soon as I have traction coming out of the corner, I punch it earlier than on previous laps.
My car shoots out of the bend, rapidly closing the gap between us.
Just before the next brake zone, I instantly go for a wider angle before cutting back to an inside line.
Enterprise's course correction comes just a split second too late, giving me an opening to barge in front of her.
It's happening!
The Commander has overtaken her!
We have a new leader!
Whoa, my honey really did it!
I'm amazed.
But the race isn't over yet.
Over the next few laps, Enterprise calmly stays behind, ready to pounce on any mistake I make.
The clock ticks away.
As the display signals the start of the final lap, there's still only half a car's length between us.
It's the final lap!
The Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally enters its last spurt!
Who will take the championship? Enterprise, or the Commander?!
They're practically glued together!
The gap is only two meters at most. Don't let her pass you!
But our tires are reaching their limit...
Two high-speed corners left. We'll have to slow down for them.
But if I slow down, I won't be able to stop Enterprise.
She'll slow down, too... You swapped tires at the same time, remember?
No – I know Enterprise, and she'll accelerate into the turn hoping she can keep control.
This is her only opportunity to win – she'll risk going off the track if it means a chance of victory.
The two final high-speed corners lie ahead.
Enterprise sticks to me, ready to stake it all on this as well.
What incredible speed! They're never going to slow down!
This is the final struggle for the championship!
We slam on the brakes simultaneously right before things get dangerous on the curve.
Then, in perfect sync – before we've even straightened out our steering wheels – we go full throttle again.
In that split second, if we'd pushed even a little harder, we would have rolled off the course.
Commander and Enterprise have navigated the corner perfectly in cars that are on the brink of collapse!
Neither giving an inch, nor going off the track!
Right now, they're roaring toward the checkered flag together!
They crossed at the same time!
I can't tell who won!
The crowd erupts into cheers.
A final result is displayed on the giant screen.
The winner is Team {car2026}!
With a lead of just 0.001 seconds!
Let's hear those cheers, everybody! The Commander is the champion!
BEEP! Championship victory confirmed. Ceremony unlocked!
The massive dome suddenly lights up after having been dormant throughout the race.
System jacked. Error XIII, the stage is yours.
A giant pixel-art cat face appears at the top of the dome.
Golden bubbles begin to float about, each one containing the name of a team member.
{playername}, Essex, Bennington, Harrison, John Rodgers, Collett, Error XIII...
Team {car2026}! We are the champions, my friends!
I knew you could win this, Commander!
We won! We're the champions!
You were incredible, Commander!
Collett? Did you prepare all of that?
Mhm. I did it just for this. Can't only let it celebrate on the dashboard, right?
Fair enough. This is OUR victory, after all!
Our trophy gleams brightly on the podium.
Essex and I reach for it together, and we raise it high with the rest of the team.
Cheers erupt from the stands again, as if the whole city is celebrating our victory.
Let's hear another round of applause for our winning team!
Hello, everybody! Thank you for watching the pre-race special for the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally!
I'm today's guest MC, Guam!
Next to me is our guest correspondent, Alfredo Oriani!
Good evening to everybody watching!
Alfredo and I are here to bring you the latest scoop on this race's teams!
>Front-row seats obtained!
>It's finally starting! Tell us about it!
>Waiting for the inside scoop here...
>Hurry it up already!
>Anyone want drinks and popcorn, nya?
Enthusiasm crackles in the air! Let's see here... Ooh! The day's first scoop is a hot one!
Details of the first racing team popped up on the monitor, accompanied by flashy visual effects.
First up, we have a top contender for the championship: Zuikaku!
As a driver, she's armed with both top-tier talent and precise control. Her control through corners is off the charts!
Wow! So what I'm hearing is, Zuikaku's technique is nearly flawless.
Her speed and routing through corners are truly world-class.
If she can capitalize on others' mistakes, she has a strong chance of winning the top prize!
Interesting! Let's take a look at her next rival, Enterprise!
>Who??
>This is gonna be EPIC!
>An iconic moment in the making!
>Enty is the ultimate jack of all trades!
Hm? Ooh... She has no weaknesses to speak of! After all, she's the best in the world!
Ahem... However!
A race can change at any given moment, so there's no telling who might win until it's over! Isn't that right?
>She's trying way too hard to spin this.
>That's Enterprise for you...
>I hope Zuikaku isn't watching the stream...
>Isn't that fascinating?
Yeah! Like Alfredo said, we'll never know who won until it's over!
Let's take a look at our last piece of info... Oh? An incredible team has appeared in the open tryout slot!
>Is it a new pro?
>Open tryout slot? Are you serious?
>Is it my Owner? It's gotta be!
>Wow, who knew they'd have such a crazy surprise in store?
>Whoever it is, I hope they enjoy the race to the fullest.
Heheh, some of you in the chat have already figured it out!
We don't have full details on the team just yet, but I promise, we'll reveal the answer next episode!
Yep! If you wanna know more, don't miss our live coverage!
Don't forget to like and subscribe! See you all next time!
>Bye!
>Quit acting like a riddler and spill the beans!
>Thanks for the stream, Guam!
>I'm so hot right now...♥
Bristol checked and double-checked the supplies list in the waiting room. After one last check, she snapped the file shut with a grim expression on her face.
...It's not here.
Seeing her distress, William D. Porter stopped labelling boxes and approached her.
Is something missing?
The container with 1.2 tons of race event collab chocolate bars is gone! It was supposed to be right here.
Maybe it was taken somewhere else?
Not a chance. I checked three times, and there's no record of it being received anywhere else.
Bristol could not overlook this affront.
This isn't just missing inventory! This is a chocolate heist we're dealing with!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Let's not jump the gun! Maybe someone made a mistake!
Whatever the case, we need to investigate! Let's start questioning people!
The two of them rushed out of the paddock and onto the venue, where they saw Vicksburg in the middle of a promotional photo shoot.
Sorry to bother you, Vicksburg, but have you seen any big vehicles leaving this paddock?
Um... A large one? I did see a truck heading that way.
Ah. The container did have an official logo on it.
I don't think anyone requested to take one of the trucks out today... Maybe that's our culprit?
It's looking rather likely! There's nowhere else that would even use such a gigantic chocolate bar... We're dealing with a highly coordinated and carefully planned heist!
We need to hurry and find it before it's too late!
William vaulted over onto Happy D, which happened to be parked nearby. Its engine roared to life.
Happy D, supersonic dash!
And so, she rushed out, kicking up dust as she sped off towards the coastal road.
Pressed low to Happy D, Porter caught up to the truck she was chasing after.
Hello, yes, you there in the truck! Pull over right now! Pull over, I say!
The truck slowed down and parked on the side of the road. When the side window rolled down, Kashiro's face came into view.
Oh?
Huh?! Y-you're the chocolate thief?!
Chocolate... thief? What?
This truck just has car parts in it, though? That's what the label on the box says, at least.
Label?
William got into the trailer and examined the boxes, which were indeed labelled "car parts."
But the handwriting was a little squiggly and messy, with a smiley face on the side as well.
Huh?
These are the labels I put on them yesterday. I must have mixed up "chocolate bar" and "car parts"...
After a couple of seconds of silence, Kashino blinked and spoke up.
I see! Well, that does explain the sweet scent I was getting this whole ride~♪
While everybody organized their gear in the maintenance room, Bennington burst in, pushing a cloth-covered whiteboard.
After wheeling it in front of the group, she yanked the cloth off of it.
Promotion is an important part of building a team. With popularity comes big sponsored deals!
And, naturally, BEING COOL is the secret to becoming popular!
As such, I think we should make a super-cool promo video!
Hmm... I don't object.
Wait a minute! A promo video? How are we going to film that?
You can leave filming, editing, and publishing to me!
Technically speaking, I've been filming this whole time♪
The super-sweet and reliable supporter, Harrison!
The super-energetic and charming team manager, Rodgers!
The super-popular ace driver, the Commander!
And the professional engineer, Collett!
Everybody in the maintenance room falls silent.
Can I ask a question? Why did you change the tone so much when you got to Collett?
You don't GET it, Commander!
Contrast makes a lasting impression with viewers! Mystery sparks curiosity!
Besides, Collett likes it, right?
Hmm... I don't object.
Umm... Can I stay behind the scenes, please? I'm not confident being in front of people.
Don't worry~ I've already taken that little problem into account!
Just act natural like you have been, and leave the rest to me!
Act natural, act natural... Wait, what even is natural for me?!
Oh, I'll check and see if we're missing anything!
Okay, then I'll keep caring for my pet... Let me know when you're done filming.
Very, very nice! Keep it up! Three, two, one, and... Rolling!
Oh, Commander? Are you practicing, too? What a coincidence~
After finishing a practice lap, I looked around in search of a place to take a break. There, Indomitable called out to me.
Wearing a snugly fitting race uniform, she gently swirled a bottle containing a chilled drink.
I just finished some rather... "intense" training too...
Phew... I suppose we've both been working hard.
She languidly lifts the bottle and takes a slow sip from it.
But from my perspective, her driving looked less like training for a race and more like a leisurely weekend drive.
How'd it feel?
Hmm... It was okay.
I was practicing my routing rather seriously, you know. Even if my speed was a little conservative...
A little, huh?
It's not nice to call me out on that, you know.
Maintaining that speed is enough to leave me feeling like jelly.
She sighs and leans against me, as if she really can't will herself to stand any longer.
I feel the heat radiating from beneath her uniform.
If I went any faster... why, wouldn't I just melt away?
Not to mention taking corners at such speeds... Just the thought of it scares me.
Indomitable leans in closer. Her breath occasionally tickles the side of my neck.
How about we try it together? You might not be as scared if there's someone there with you.
Oh? Hmm... I see what you're after, Commander...
When I get all light-heated like this, it does help to have you by my side...
She takes my hand and guides me to the driver's seat.
When we touch, I can feel the slick sweat on her skin.
Suddenly, she goes limp and falls into my arms.
Mmnh... I do wish we could start training right away.
But that last lap was already so draining...
My mind is cloudy, and I feel dizzy... It would be far too difficult to concentrate in this state.
The sweet scent of her cold drink wafts closer.
Before we can really begin... I'll need a rest.
Her hands trail up my arm as she nestles closer.
Won't you let me... rest on you for just a little while?
Don't worry. I won't keep you waiting too long...
After all... Your embrace is much more comfortable than any seat.
Before the race, Essex brought her car to a gentle stop and prepared for a technical inspection.
Wearing white gloves, Baltimore began confirming the car's data readings.
Chassis intact... Suspension and brakes operating normally...
She stood up, walked a lap around the vehicle, opened the driver's side door, and sat inside.
What the heck is that?
To the right of the dashboard's LCD was a pixel-art ball with cat ears.
That's my digital pet... Its name is Error XIII. Cute, right?
I mean, I don't care how cute it is.
It's against the rules to display non-functional visuals on the dashboard.
So it's fine as long as it's functional?
Collett took out her tablet and began tapping rapidly on it.
Moments later, the cat shook slightly and produced a speech bubble out of nowhere, which read, "Tire Pressure: 2.3 bar."
I just gave it a tire pressure monitoring feature.
Need me to add a few more features?
Collett tapped furiously once again.
More speech bubbles appeared and fell like Tetris pieces. Error XIII ran around frantically, trying to avoid getting crushed by them.
Eventually, it crashed into a speech bubble reading "Water Temp: 98°C" and fell pitifully to the ground.
There. Better?
Pfft... Ahem. Sorry. As much as I'd love to let you in... I'm a trained professional, you know.
If all it's going to do is display diagnostic information, then the pet itself could be done without, no?
Aww, come on...
Get rid of the speech bubbles and make it so that Error XIII only alerts to issues. How about that?
Oh... I see.
Collett's eyes lit up as her fingers danced to life again.
Error XIII stood up again, opened its mouth wide, and gobbled up all of the speech bubbles. In the end, it let out a satisfied belch.
Check complete. No data anomalies. Good luck with the race. Go, go, you can do it!
Pfft... Okay, fine. It is charming, I admit. You pass.
Phew... Finally.
Thank you very much.
Team {car2026}'s machine clears all checks. I'll go check the other teams' cars now.
Once Baltimore had left, Collett looked down at her tablet.
We passed! Off to the races!
As I walk along the coast one evening, I spot a familiar-looking, silver-grey sports car.
Rumey leans forward with one hand on the steering wheel, flashing me an easygoing smile.
So you came, huh? What's wrong? Still fretting over your team?
She uses a hand to fix her wind blown hair. The silk clothing she's wearing accentuates her curves rather well, and the twilight gives her a gorgeous glow.
Hm? Where are you looking now? Do you like this dress?
I had it made just for me. I wanted to wear it and show you something nice and befitting of the season.
It looks great on you.
Heh, I appreciate the praise. Now, get in. There's something important we need to discuss.
I accept her invitation, then go around the other side to get into her car. Inside, there's a faint hint of her perfume mixed in with the sea breeze blowing from outside.
If you want {car2026} to be going places, well, talent alone will only take you so far. A strong team ideal and organization is just as important as a good promotional strategy.
Partnering up with forward thinking contributors will give your team the leg-up it needs to succeed.
Rumey leans forward, resting her arms on the handlebars, her gaze clear and resolute.
...So you want to be that contributor?
Naturally. I never bet on a losing horse. And your team has... No, I believe YOU have a very good shot at victory.
After a short pause, she leans into me, bringing her face closer to mine.
Still... You look a little strung up.
You think so?
I do. That's why I came here today to talk with you.
She backs off, then retrieves what seems to be a file from the back seat. Instead of handing it to me, she places it besides the seat.
I thought I could help you relax a little.
How so?
You don't need to bear all the burden alone. Even you need someone to take care of you once in a while.
As she speaks, she reaches out and lightly traces a finger through the space between my eyebrows. Her touch is so gentle that it feels like she's taking away all my worries.
See? That's much better, isn't it?
I grab her hand as she tries to pull it away. Her fingertips shudder at my touch slightly.
Commander?
Instead of answering, I get closer and cup her cheek with my fingers.
Commander... Your eyes look a little intense...
What happened to helping me relax?
I know what I said, but I...
I lean in close enough to feel her breathing.
The moment I touch her tightly pressed lips, they part slightly as she shudders. Having completely let her guard down, she leans into my arms.
Commander... What's the meaning of this?
You don't like it?
It's not that... I'm just not used to it quite yet, I suppose.
Rumey turns her face away to the car's window, but she loosens the hem of her dress, and her expression softens into a sweet smile.
But to answer your question... It's not so bad.
Drawing a stark contrast to the tense atmosphere of the pit, the lively drum beat is the only accent to the sounds of the sea's ebb and flow.
Bennington parks the car by the sea. Here it is only her, me, and the ocean stretching out as far as the eye could see.
You said we were gonna get ready for the race, so why are we at the beach?
Ahahah... Part of preparing means getting in the right mood to be at peak condition!
If you keep doing laps right up until the race, you'll be worn out before it even starts.
We're here to avoid just that from happening. Just sit back and let the sea breeze and the music make your mind a blank slate. Let's enjoy ourselves while we're here.
And well, I do get to keep you all to myself while we're at it♪
She unbuckles her seatbelt and stretches out.
The sunlight accentuates the nape of her neck, giving her skin a radiant shine.
She basks in the sunlight, casually taking off her glasses and placing them in the back seat. She then turns her eyes, ever sharp and always looking for the best shot, to look straight at me.
Mhm... Perfect!
The sun, the breeze the music, and you... It's all perfect!
So.... You're just looking for content, and helping me relax was a good excuse?
This is the perfect sun, the perfect scenery, and your best, sweetest smile...
And this is all just for me♪
Her chest, covered by her pretty bikini, heaves slowly as she speaks, and the sunlight leaves faint white marks beneath the strained straps.
She kicks off her high heels, then places her long, slender and bare legs on top of my lap.
*sigh*.... Leaning back like this is way more comfortable than sitting in the driver's seat~♪
Commander~♪ Wanna try it with me?
What do you have in mind?
She motions for me to come closer, but as soon as I do, she grabs me by the collar and pulls me towards her.
I end up leaning on top of Bennington, her thin shoulder straps slipping off a little.
Aren't we breaking the speed limit a little here?
There's no speed limit when we're doing a personal collab project together♪
She lets go of my collar, letting her hand glide down my neck and chest until it stops right over my heart.
My heart rate is accelerating, almost as if someone had just hit the gas as hard as possible.
Your heart's beating so fast already...
Aren't we past minding a little speeding?
Bennington slips her hand over my own, intertwining her fingers with mine.
The sun's still not down... and this race's goal is still a long way ahead♪
Now, you can be my chief navigator today.
We could see just how fast and hot we can run on this road...
Or maybe you'd like trying out a new route with me? We can map it out together as we go...

<size=45>2 Trouble? Pit Team to the Rescue!</size>

scripts.say: Hi there! Welcome to my sweet new project! I'm calling it the Commander's Summer Race Project!
Bennington, we're not in the race course just yet. Can you tone down the intensity just a little?
While pulling off an unnecessarily flashy drift, Bennington slides a car into our temporarily assigned pit.
Commander! Over here!
I spot John Rodgers and Harrison carrying in supplies like drinks, toolboxes, boards, and various miscellaneous items.
Suddenly, I can't shake the feeling that I might just be surrounded by pros.
We've been waiting~
If we're really participating, I figured we should get everything we might need stocked up.
Yep, yep! The backup system is working like a dream!
I declare the {car2026} logistical support plan officially launched! Yay!
You don't need to hype up literally everything we do!
Or so she says, but it's clear the acknowledgment is giving her confidence.
We got all the paperwork ready.
The initial entry, the car check, and the driver registration... If we can complete all those before the qualifiers, we'll be an official team.
You're really pumped for this, huh?
O-of course! We're already here, so we can't go having people think we're just messing around without a plan!
As we go over the entry form that Rodgers brought, I'm immediately confronted with the first big roadblock.
Oh? The car registration is still blank.
Um... Car?
Well... It was a little outside our scope, so...
Rodgers throws an uneasy glance at the car parked in our pit lane. Currently, it's being occupied by Bennington's car.
Hmmm? What are you looking at? Oh, I'm such a klutz. I went and put my girl in your pit!
Wait... Were you planning for this the whole time?
Bingo! I knew we'd be here when you got all fired up yesterday~
My little girl's been modified for racing, so we can make this rally her debut! No biggie!
This is not quite what I had in mind... But we can enter the race, at least!
Commander, do you wanna take it for a trial run?
Mhm, great idea. We need to measure the car's performance and get familiar with the course. And it'll also let us make any adjustments we need before the real deal♪
Okay, let's go for one lap.
And so, {car2026} gets off to an auspicious start after a spot of trouble.
After swapping drivers mid-race, I come to the lounge and find it illuminated by only one table lamp.
Good job on the track, Commander.
Hehehe, we've been waiting for you to get back. Check this out!
Houston and Laffey wear bunny outfits complete with ears. Next to them, the table is piled high with energy bars, bananas, electrolyte water, and chocolate snacks.
You've got time until you have to tag back in... You gotta refill your energy.
We put together this energy supply station for you. Where do you wanna start?
That's very considerate of you.
I looked up a guide to endurance racing... Houston picked out the items...
Energy bars give a quick stamina boost, and electrolyte water helps rehydrate your lost fluids. Oh, and get this!
She pulls out a chocolate stick and holds it up to my lips.
Sugar is the perfect fuel to keep fighting through the second half!
I'll feed you, too... Here you go, Commander.
Laffey takes another chocolate stick and holds it up as well. That makes two being offered to me from either direction.
Open up, Commander. Say "ahh."
The sweetness of chocolate fills my mouth, perfectly complemented by that crispy texture.
Yay! Now, next up...
I wanna eat, too... with the Commander...
Laffey rubs her eyes, pulls another chocolate stick from the box, and holds it in her mouth.
Hm? Commander, um... Okay, I'll do it, too.
Houston follows suit, holding a stick in her mouth likewise. She blushes all the way to her ears, her words coming out mumbled.
This should... help you refill your energy faster...
Th-that's right! If we all eat together, the recovery effect will double!
Commander~
I can already taste the chocolate again.
I trudge back to the pit, looking for a quiet corner to take a breather.
However, just around the corner, I run into somebody who shouldn't be in the garage.
Vicksburg?
Oh, Commander!
Vicksburg is dressed in a sparkly idol outfit, standing on her tiptoes as she tries to get onto a makeshift stage.
Hush! Keep your voice down, Commander!
I cancelled all of my plans today and snuck in here to see you. We'd better not draw any attention!
After confirming that nobody else is around, she breathes a sigh of relief and faces me again.
The sparkle in her eyes makes my reflection look as if I'm surrounded by stars.
You looked so cool out there during your race! I could hardly stay in my seat at the host's podium!
Hehe, but you must be exhausted after so many days of rigorous exercise.
I prepared this little stage just for you! Are you ready? Here we go!
Vicksburg? What are you doing?
Cheering you on, of course! I saw every last bit of hard work you put in.
So I realized, it's up to me to come and be your personal cheerleader!
She picks up a nearby flag, hops onto the stage used for post-race interviews, and takes a deep breath to psych herself up.
Vicksburg makes a dazzling entrance – Whoops! I slipped into stage mode again...
She sticks her tongue out playfully as her cheeks glow the faintest hue of pink.
U-umm... Commander, can you clap to help me keep the beat? It isn't hard. Just go like this: clap, clap, clap...
Sure.
I clap my hands lightly. One, two, three... and Vicksburg forms her hands in the shape of a heart in front of her chest.
Heart!
After another three beats, she opens her arms wide, lifts a leg, and sweeps the flag through the air in a perfect semicircle.
Sparkle...
Finally, she traces an arc with her arm, stopping at her chest. As she does so, she tilts her head and gazes at me with sparkling eyes.
Lucky poweeer♪
How was that? Do you feel the lucky power surging within you, Commander?
I sure do. That was cute; can you do it again?
Of course I can! Today, I'm... Wait, did you just call me cute?
A blush spreads all the way to her ears. Despite her embarrassment, she accepts my request.
Okay... Watch this one, too!
Vicksburg raises the flag overhead with one hand as the other rests on her chest.
However, her focus on the pose causes her to miss the pebble at her feet. One twirl goes awry, and –
Whoa, whoa!
The instant she loses her balance, I lunge forward and catch her in my arms.
You okay?
Phew... Thank you so much, Commander. Talk about clumsy...
Thank goodness you're okay.
Once I'm sure that she's on her feet again, I start to let go – but I realize that she's holding tightly to my shirt.
Say, um... Can we stay like this, just... just a little longer?
Her breath is a sweet caress on my cheek.
Your embrace is so warm, Commander~
I came here to cheer you on, but... maybe I'm the one being cheered up right now.
She looks up at me, purses her lips for a moment, and then steels herself.
Commander, please accept my blessing.
That way, we can both feel good...♡
She slowly closes her eyes and offers me her lips.
As I lean in, time seems to stand still. When we part again, a deep red spreads across her cheeks.
How do you feel now, Commander? I'm sure... you must be full of energy now!
Still feeling the high of victory after the race, I go back to the garage on my own, only to find Musashi waiting there.
Just as I'm about to call out to her, she senses my presence first, slowly raising her head and directing a warm smile my way.
Heheheh... You finally come to see your tireless cheerleader, my racing champion?
Musashi's wearing a cheerleader outfit that's night and day from her usual dignified attire. She looks almost bewitching under the stage's gleaming lights.
I thought you left.
Oh, no. Tonight's shining star is still not well taken care of, so how could I leave?
I just... needed a little time to let my mood simmer after that incredible race.
You look great.
Heheh, what a smooth operator you are, offering such praise now of all times.
Now, Commander... No, my racing champion.
Tonight, I have something for you. Your very own victory present.
The pom-poms dance gracefully in her hands, making a satisfying rustling sound as she dances.
Every time she turns around or throws me a side glance, her fantastic figure seems to assert itself more markedly.
She performs her cheering dance routine, showing her full desire to offer me support.
Heheheh... It seems like actions truly do speak louder than words.
I will give you all my cheer and passion tonight.
Savor the glory, for it is all yours.
Musashi smiles, letting her pom poms drop by her feet.
Not a moment later, she steps forward, closing the distance and bringing her face close to mine.
Before I can even speak, she raises her arms and pulls me onto her chest.
I can feel the softness through the thin fabric, and her warmth completely erases the chill summer night breeze.
Tonight, you achieved the greatest victory.
You need not say a thing anymore.
But if you could be gracious enough to accept my gift to you... That'd be enough.
Musashi takes my hand and guides it to her tights-covered legs, letting me feel her warmth firsthand.
I just let her guide me slowly and deliberately.
Tonight... The lights, the cheers, and the glory are all yours.
Of course... I am no exception to that.
She lowers her head, playing with my ears with her lips, pecking at them playfully as her breath brushes against it.
Come inside, my champion...
I will relieve you of all that fatigue and tension, one lap at a time♡

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>3 A Helping Hand for the Rookie Team</size>

scripts.say: For the first lap of the trial run, I keep a steady pace instead of pushing the engine to get used to the racetrack and see how the vehicle handles.
Once the run is completed, I realize the car's tuning is not quite up to snuff, probably on account of being completely new.
That was a clean run! Good job, Commander. Go ahead and have a drink!
How was it? Think it'll work?
Hm, it works well enough, but the car felt a little stiff to handle.
I take a cold drink from her hands as I try to recall the feeling I got from the trial run. It's important to have some accurate feedback that we can use for tuning..
...Commander, you make it sound like you drove a tractor just now.
It's not that the car is bad, but it's not quite up for a real race just yet.
Hm, this might be more of a fixer-upper than we thought.
Not the kind of thing amateurs like us can deal with, though...
So what we need is someone who can identify the issues with our ride and adjust properly if we wanna participate?
Pretty much, yes. We need a real engineer.
Rodgers's expression sours as if something unpleasant crossed her mind.
Whoa, this is just like a movie! Let me guess, you know just the person for the job, don't you, Rodgers?!
...You pointing it out kind of deflates the moment, but I do know someone.
Really?! Oh, we're saved!
Okay, you gotta cool off! I don't know if it'll work out or not!
I just heard her talking about tuning and setting stuff up before... So I figured maybe she knows more about it than us! And that's a big maybe!!
Maybe?
A big maybe?
How big are we talking?
Yeah, that's why I didn't wanna say anything! I don't know if they're up for it!
Well, we're not exactly drowning in options, so why don't we go see if this someone might be able to help us for real?
Great idea. We might as well go find out ourselves.
When our brave team is about to throw in the towel... A helper appears to save the day! This is gonna be the best video series ever!
Can we not make it sound like this is all staged?!

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>4 Techie Jackpot</size>

scripts.say: To all my new followers, good morning, afternoon, and evening to you!
Bennington swings the camera around, capturing the entrance of the paddock before focusing on John Rodgers as she walks in front of the group.
Like you saw previously, the trial run revealed a bunch of issues with the car, and now we're on a quest to find a super pro engineer!
Now Rodgers is leading us to the car wash... If the movies I've watched are anything to go by, that's a prime hiding spot for world class engineers!
Can you stop recording? I only said it seemed like she knew about tuning. I didn't say anything about world class engineers or whatever!
I mean, what else am I gonna tell my viewers?
We follow the line of cars waiting their turn to be washed, and quickly reach the race car at the front.

There we find a girl floating in the air, suspended in place by a large drone. Somehow, she seems to come out of her restful sleep to spray water on the cars with a nozzle hose she's holding, all without opening her eyes.
Collett? She can tune a car?
I-I said maybe... Big maybe...
She's just kind of, floating... Is she okay?
Might as well ask her.
I step forward and call out to her.
Collett? Wake up, please?
She doesn't react, however. Instead, the drone starts rotating until its camera lens settles on me.
I am Error XIII... Identifying visitors.
Maximum priority target identified: the Commander. Executing emergency awakening protocol.
The drone vibrates in place. After a moment, Collett raises her head and looks down at me, still looking quite groggy.
Mguh... Are we done with the car wash?
Took you long enough, sleepyhead.
Rodgers?
Collett's gaze shifts from Rodgers to me, then settles on the camera Bennington is holding.
...No interviews.
Aw, that's a shame. I wanted to do behind-the-scenes interviews!
...Did you come here just to bother me?
Ah, Collett. Do you know about tuning cars?
She seems to ponder for a moment before lazily shaking her head.
I've never tuned a real race car...
Huh? But you were using a bunch of technical jargon the other day.
I've been playing this simulation racing game a lot lately... And I got really into the tuning aspect, that's all.
Once it becomes clear that this was just one big misunderstanding, the mood turns awkward really fast.
But instead of turning back and going away with our tails between our legs, Collett's words give me an idea.
Well, you may not be able to do tuning, but how about analyzing what the vehicle might need based on feedback?
She doesn't seem to dislike the idea.
...I could do that.
If it's just tracking parameters based on feedback, course analysis, and tire condition... I could take care of it.
Does that mean that our beautiful race car still has a chance?
As long as it's not in a really bad condition.
If the car hasn't been too modified, data based adjustments should help most problems.
That sounds great to me.
Wanna join $2, Colette? We're looking for someone who can do data analysis and tuning.
Colette lets go of the hose, signals to her drone, and drops in front of us.
Sure. Just don't give me too much work that involves talking to people.
Deal. Thanks, and welcome to the team!
Heheh, this is finally starting to feel like a racing team~
Phew... This didn't go like I expected, but it worked out in the end, so I'm glad.
"$2 gains another powerful ally on its way to the top! A mysterious, eccentric genius engineer joins the fray!" I got the next video title ready!
Having gained a reliable new ally, we make our way back to the pit.

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>5 Pulling Her Back In</size>

scripts.say: Hello! Great to see you all again! The Commander's summer race saga continues!
Bennington slides across the pit gracefully, pointing her camera at a corner of the room where Collett is curled up into a ball on top of a toolbox with a tablet in her hands.
Behold! Thanks to Collett, our car tuning is coming along swimmingly!
However... While the tuning machine warmed up, a new problem reared its ugly head!
A problem?
Yes! A six-hour endurance rally is not something a single driver can manage! You need a relief driver!
So we need a racer that can switch with the Commander?
We're gonna need a pro for this.
Heh, heh, heh! Well, it seems we're in luck! The perfect person for the job showed up just in time!
Bennington, who had clearly waited for this moment for maximum theatrical effect, quirks up a defiant smile.
Who are you talking about?
Heh! Heh! As it turns out, Essex is currently enjoying her vacation in a hotel nearby.
She's not participating?
Maybe she wanted to take a break like you? I'm sure she'd accept an invitation from you, though.
Well, it can't hurt to pay her a visit.
Let's go! The next video will be about the sea breeze, vacations, and racers!
Leaving the pit, I walk along the esplanade surrounding the venue until we come across a fancy seaside hotel.
As the evening sun sinks down on the horizon, I come across the hotel's outdoor pool, where I find Essex enjoying the water.
Commander?
Oh, Bennington was right about you being here.
I'm on vacation right now, you know? If you're here about work, well...
Oh, not at all. I'm on vacation too. Don't you wanna do something fun to make the most of it?
Make the most of it? W-what do you have in mind?
I'd like you to join our team. It's called {car2026}.
That sounds... Huh? Your team?
Seeing the surprise and confusion on her face, I explain the situation.
Essex listens closely, the gentle breeze passing by us as her expression hardens.
I think I get it now.
If you're really serious about gearing up for this race and competing, you'll need a capable racer who's able to make snap decisions and grasp the situation on the race track.
That's right. And I believe you're the last piece of the puzzle for us.
Essex studies me with her intense gaze, gauging how serious I am about this race.
...Very well.
I will join your team as a relay racer.
And now that I'm part of the team, "doing our best" alone won't cut it.
If we're racing, we need to set our expectations high and prepare for victory.
Pace plans, coordination, and dividing our driving roles... We'll execute a perfect plan to achieve victory.
Bring it on.
Heheh, I knew you'd see it my way.
She swims over closer, and I take her hand to pull her up to the poolside.
Let's go to the racetrack.
We're in this race, and I'll give it my all until we make it past the goal.
The sunset light plays about in the water behind her, giving her an almost otherworldly glow.
And so, {car2026} obtains its last crucial team member.

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>6 Pole Position Will Be Ours!</size>

scripts.say: Little time remains until the qualifier race begins.
Thanks to the team's efforts, the car is finally in a stable state.
Suspension, brakes, tire turning radius... I've got all of the details memorized.
Anything else we need to adjust?
Yes. I've adjusted the differential to a more aggressive setup per my preferences. That should allow for earlier and bolder acceleration when pulling out of corners.
The trade-off is that rougher handling will cause greater wear on your tires.
So what you're saying is, I can drive more aggressively during the qualifier, but I'll have a narrower window to shoot for lap records.
That's right... You'll only be able to hold up for two laps, at best. Any more, and your tires are done for.
Hi there, everybody! Great work today!
Bennington comes in, greeting us as energetically as ever.
Here I am – famously stylish, reliable, and popular car owner, WITH legal visitation rights – to check on my ride!
Checking on it, huh? Yeah, right. You're obviously just here to shoot footage.
Call it killing two birds with one stone. Behind-the-scenes footage, pre-race chit-chat, and technical updates are all primo material!
Let's see here... What modifications have you all made to my baby?
She points her camera at the driver's seat. Just as she opens her mouth to speak her mind, however, she pauses.
Hmm...? Was this little thing there before?
Everybody looks at where she's pointing. There, on the dashboard, we see a tiny virtual pet made of pixels.
Hi there!
BEEP! Voice activation detected.
Error XIII is now booting up.
Wait, what even is that?
Awww! It's so cuuute!
That's my digital pet. Consider it a support module with a visual interface.
It assists in monitoring vehicle status, sets off alerts when certain preset values are reached, and also has simple voice reminders...
Should you be installing things like that in a race car?!
Don't worry. I've checked the rules, and as long as it doesn't override control of the vehicle, it violates no regulations.
Heheh. I set up a big celebration for Error XIII, too... though it won't unlock unless you win.
It sounds like I'd better give it my all, then.
Too cool! I can't wait to film the team's victory declaration♪
Bennington excitedly raises her camera and records several videos of me and Error XIII together.
Alright! From now on, you're the mascot of Team {car2026}, little buddy.
BEEP! New identity confirmed. Receiving compliments.
Mood level boosted!
An announcement echoes outside the garage. It seems it's time for the final check-in for the qualifier race.
Tension that had been eased by this unexpected event suddenly returns to us.
Let's go.
Rodgers and I are standing by, ready to support at any time!
Data link functioning. Monitoring interface is A-OK, too.
BEEP! All systems on standby.
You're our first driver, Commander. Knock 'em dead!
For a team so hastily slapped together, {car2026} has come further than any of us have ever imagined. Now, we stand before the qualifying race.
All of the heart that we've poured into this effort will be tested in the upcoming race.
Here I go.
Pole position will be ours!

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>7 Let the Qualifier Begin!</size>

scripts.say: Commentary overlaps with the roar of engines, adding fuel to the fiery anticipation around the circuit.
Cheers erupt from the grandstands of Sunset Avenue as lights, flags, and countless cameras turn toward the track.
Finally, the moment has come.
This is your host, Guam, speaking! The Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally's qualifier is about to begin!
Who will win the coveted pole position?
Will it be our seasoned racer, Enterprise?
Or Zuikaku, known for her aggressive driving?
Or perhaps even the dark horse of the event, the rookie driver... none other than the Commander!
Now, before the race begins, let's hear your loudest cheers for all of our drivers!
Above the track, the five starting lights all drop to green. We all put the pedal to the metal in perfect sync.
Can you hear me, Commander?
Loud and clear.
Data transmission and monitoring look good.
Since this is your first race, don't feel pressured to push for time right away. Warm up as planned and get your car and mind used to the track.
Got it.
I gently push the accelerator further, pushing the car close to its limits but not quite there, taking each corner smoothly.
The steering feedback, feeling of tires against the pavement, suspension bouncing over the curbs... All of the senses I'd cultivated over days of practice are renewed.
The wind is starting to shift.
There's a rare elation in Collett's voice, prompting me to focus up.
Wind speed rising. It's about 20 minutes earlier than expected.
The weather forecast had predicted that cloud cover and crosswinds wouldn't come for another half-hour.
Unexpected wind on a race track can swing variables wildly.
Commander, pay close attention to the airflow changes.
Roger that.
As the qualifier continues, everyone on the track picks up speed.
