Fuel levels remain within expected levels, and the tires haven't quite hit their optimal temperature. However, the changes in the weather add to the excitement and tension.
Guess I'll have to push earlier than planned.
If I wait any longer, the wind will only get worse!
Whoa! The rankings are shifting like never before!
Enterprise just clocked a crazy-strong lap! Zuikaku is keeping up close behind, with Indomitable a steady third!
And our Commander is steadily closing in, too!
Today's qualifier might just be more intense than we'd imagined!

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>8 Wind-Racing Ace</size>

scripts.say: The time ticks by.
Twenty minutes later, clouds hang low over the circuit. The road surface looks dark compared to its previous luster.
Zuikaku, the wind is getting violent. Don't get too reckless out there.
It's still just the qualifier, so keeping up your current pace will be enough.
Got it, Sis.
The wind speed only picks up further. Before high-speed corners, my car even begins to rock slightly.
Crosswinds are intensifying, especially in the second sector.
Compared to ten minutes ago, you'll need nearly 10% more steering correction when entering corners.
By this point, everybody should be playing it safe. Whether you want to set a lap record here depends on your own judgment rather than your car's abilities.
I cross the finish line, ending a lap and displaying a new fastest lap on the screen.
You've set a new lap record.
2:00.135! We have a new lap record for the Sunset Avenue Endurance Rally!
However, that time does not last long. It's quickly overcome by a faster time.
Another update!
1:59.977! That's Enterprise's ninth lap.
1:59.977! Enterprise has broken the two-minute barrier!
She's far and away the fastest now! Will anybody be able to catch up?!
I take a deep breath and ease my pace slightly.
It's a minuscule gap – less than a quarter of a second – but it stands as an impenetrable barrier to the rest of us.
Unfortunately, the wind conditions have made it impossible to push any further.
If I let my ego take the lead and run the car off the track, it will put all of our preparations so far to waste.
Fuel at 20%. Tire grip is at optimal levels.
Essex, how much time is left?
Ten minutes.
The wind is now blowing strong enough to exert clear effects on machine handling.
She's right. It would be beyond reckless to push for pole position at a time like this.
And yet... I can't give up now.
If there's a chance, however minuscule, then I have to try.
There's a brief silence on the team's comms channel. Eventually, Essex speaks.
Prioritize safety and manage your tire conditions. Collett will identify the ideal opportunity for you.
Got it. Thank you.
Meanwhile, somebody on another team's channel has figured out our scheme.
My honey really isn't scared of the wind, huh?
That's not it. The Commander is just waiting for one last chance to surpass my record.
Then why are you so calm?
Because I would do the same thing in the Commander's shoes.
More and more cars slow down on the track.
Holding onto position seems the prudent strategy, after all.
That's exactly why it surprises everybody when I continue to pick up speed.
What's this?
Not everybody has chosen to play it safe!
The Commander is accelerating!
In the final moments of the qualifier, when the wind is most unstable, the Commander is going for a flying lap!
Go ahead! Seize that pole position, Commander!
I stare at the straightaway ahead, listening in to the wind shrieking against the car.
The persistent tug of the wind suddenly eases for a moment. With the changing of the airflow, my moment of opportunity has arrived.
Now!
This lap is everything! Go, Commander!
I put the pedal to the metal – top gear, full throttle.
With the wind at my back, I push the car to its limit, rushing through every corner.
The Commander is advancing at top speed!
No, even faster now! Still accelerating, still closing the gap!
Entering the chicane... Whoa! The wind is causing turbulence!
Can the Commander keep the car pointed forward?
I instinctively counter-steer and punch it, managing to keep the turbulence to only a minor wiggle as the car exits the turn.
The car exits the corner! It's going for the finish line!
BEEP! Target achieved.
Spectacularly done, Commander!
I ease off the accelerator, letting the car coast as Essex congratulates me.
My heart is still pounding, and the tension of fighting the wind itself still stings my palms.
What a big W! That was a heart-pounding finale!
Just when everybody thought that the qualifier was set in stone, the Commander pulled off a huge turnaround at the very end!
Today, the pole position belongs to a real ace!

sequence:
Scorching Summer Wavechasers

<size=45>9 The Main Event Begins!</size>

scripts.say: The members of {car2026} gather in the pit, making our final preparations for the six-hour rally.
Okay, we're about ready... Oh! The drivers' parade is starting soon. Are you good to go, Commander?
Yeah.
Since we'd secured the pole position during yesterday's qualifier, our car is given the pride of place.
Vicksburg makes a dazzling entrance! Welcome, everybody, to the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally!
Yesterday's qualifier was a real show, but the true competition has yet to begin!
Now, let's introduce the drivers! Give them all a big round of applause so good fortune will follow them on the track!
Drivers are displayed one after another onscreen. Enterprise, Zuikaku, Indomitable... They're all formidable drivers.
The instant our team is displayed, the stands erupt with even louder cheers than before.
Commandeeer! Look! Over here!
You got this!
Whatever happens, I'll be waiting for you in the interview corner!
Wow! The audience has gotten really fired up!
It looks like everybody is eager to see if the Commander can keep up yesterday's incredible performance!
Amidst the cheering from the stands, the most formidable rivals cast glances toward us.
Honey! I couldn't take my eyes off your last lap yesterday!
But the qualifier and the main event are two different things.
You'll need more than just grit for a six-hour relay!
New Jersey...
Alright, I just wanted to give a friendly reminder~
Commander, that last lap was brilliant.
But today's race will test your rhythm, judgment, and endurance.
If you wanna win, it'll take more than just speed.
I know.
Zuikaku and Shoukaku approach.
I'm not losing to you again!
We'll give it our all, too.
Hehe. Let's do our best, Commander~
The parade ends, and we return our race cars to the starting positions for the formation lap.
As the lead car, I can take my time warming up the tires.
Comms normal.
Tire temperatures normal!
Wind speed steady.
Commander, conditions are ideal for your start.
As long as there are no unexpected problems, you can take a smooth first corner.
But remember, you shouldn't push as hard as you can on your first lap.
This isn't a sprint. Only those who can keep going until the very end can take victory.
Roger that.
It's Bennington on commentary again! The cars are just about to finish their formation lap!
Everybody ready for the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally?
Five...
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...
Go, go, go! Let the race begin!
As the red lights turn off, the entire starting straight bursts into action with a roar as dozens of race cars rocket forth in unison.

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 1: The Spirited Secretary</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Hum~ hm hmm~♪
When I arrived at the office, my secretary, Hiei, had already started working.
Oh my, Commander? I'm terribly sorry for not waking you up sooner.
But when I reflected upon how hard you work every day, I thought you deserved to sleep 10 more minutes.
Not at all, it's only natural to look out after you as your secretary ship.
However... I'd appreciate it if you could keep this a secret from the others.
Especially from Haruna and Kongou... If they heard about this, I'd get an earful for "pampering the Commander too much."
Anyway, the tea is now ready. Please do enjoy it.
As expected of someone who studied abroad with the Royal Navy. Hiei's skill at making tea was easily on par with that of the Royal girls.
... Since you're done, I'll now go over today's itinerary.
First, here is the inventory for our commission rewards, as well as a roster for today's training exercises...
And here are the material and equipment orders from the research lab.
Hiei's itinerary and reports were flawless as usual. However, there was something I was concerned about...
Hm? What's the matter, Commander? Oh my, is there something stuck on my cheek?
For whatever reason, Hiei seemed to be in an especially good mood.

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Formal Invitation</size>

scripts.say: I'm in... an especially good mood? And you're curious as to why?
"Did something good happen," huh...? It's as you say, but... I suppose you forgot, Commander. Actually...
I finally found it, Hiei. I almost forgot that you were the secretary today... Ahem! I've managed to get everything that you asked for.
Oh my. Thank you for all your help~
I'm also looking forward to it. I've never been disappointed by an event you've hosted.
I'm glad to hear that.
And Commander, this is for you. Since you're already in the room, I might as well give it to you directly...
Kongou handed me a white envelope with golden lace. It seemed like an invitation of some sort.
Sorry for the formalities, but there's a certain way we have to do these things~♪
When I opened the envelope, I found a small card inside.
Upon the card were several lines of carefully handwritten words.
Commander, we cordially invite you
to attend the upcoming banquet to be held at 7 PM this Saturday.
We hope that you will be able to take time out of your busy schedule to attend.
I do hope to see you there.
Sincerely, Hiei

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 3: Reasons</size>

2.say: Do you remember now? The thing we were talking about before...

3.say: That's right, you mentioned something about a banquet...

4.say: A few days prior, near the Port

5.say: That's the end of the sea patrol... All right, nothing out of the ordinary.

6.say: I'm not exactly a fan of fighting, but it gets boring when all our regular patrols are this uneventful...

7.say: We should cherish the peace we have today. Nobody knows when it will be shattered by war.

8.say: Haruna, if you're that bored, why don't we go spar a bit?

9.say: Hmph! Come at me! I'll take you on any time!

10.say: I'm glad you two are in good spirits... but we're still on a mission. Would you mind putting it off until after we return to port?

12.say: Though Hiei's words were gentle, she had an unexpectedly intimidating aura.

13.say: Phew... I suppose that settles it. Let's start heading back to port.

15.say: Hehe~ Commander, the same goes for you. Speaking of which...

16.say: What better way to reward everyone's hard work than with a banquet!

18.say: Now that I think about it, something like that did happen...

20.say: And I was looking forward to you helping me this time...

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 4: Preparations</size>

scripts.say: In the end, I decided to help with Hiei's banquet preparations.
Kongou and the others are busy with their errands, so next up is...
Finalizing our menu and sending out the rest of the invitations.
Port - Shop
Can I help you, nya~?
Hm... nya?! Commander... and Hiei as well, nya?
Akashi, did you manage to get what I asked you for?
Of course, nya! I've got all the food ingredients and drinks taken care of, nya!
Thanks for your patronyage, nya~!
The pleasure is mine. Thank you for handling all my orders so diligently every time.
Hehe~ Here you go.
Nya? This is... an invitation, nya! Akashi is also invited?
Of course. The more, the merrier. Oh, would you also mind asking Shiranui if she wants to come?
Look, you don't need to keep calling us... I know, just take it easy, we'll be there on time.
Waiting for one of Hiei's banquets to start always makes me excited~!
*sigh*... As long as you don't make a mess of things~
Huh? I don't remember doing anything...
Hehe, it's not your fault, Kirishima. There's bound to be craziness when we have an open bar.
Well, um... my bad, I guess. It's hard to say no when so many people are goading me on. I'll make sure to watch myself this time though.
I wonder if everything is in order now... Thanks for helping with the preparations, Commander~♪

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 5: Different Strokes for Different Folks</size>

scripts.say: Port - Canteen
Have all our guests arrived?
Thank you so much for coming here tonight, valiant friends of the Sakura Empire.
Please take this opportunity tonight to wash away your fatigue and deepen your friendships. Do enjoy this banquet hosted by yours truly, Hiei.
As the Manjuu band began to play, Hiei's banquet officially began.
Meeaaaaat!! Ehehe, I loooove Hiei's banquets~!
Ewww! Yuudachi, at least make an effort to observe some table manners! Kongou and the others are staring at us!
Omnom! Even if that's true, I'm not puttin' this meat down. If you want some, you're gonna have to get your own!
You little...
You'd like to dance with me? Hehe, sure. Anything for a beautiful lady like you~☆
You brought this cake just for me? Why, thank you very much~☆
You'd like me to keep you company for one more song? Certainly. I don't mind at all~☆
Hahaha! Everyone, cheeers!!
From a distance, the banquet organizer was watching everyone, all by herself.
Hehe. Everyone has their way of enjoying the banquet.
Hiei smiled gently as she surveyed the scene.
However, she was the only person who wasn't participating...

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 6: A Table for Two</size>

scripts.say: Oh my, Kirishima is quite the popular one.
Being able to handle that kind of attention... takes some natural talent and charm.
My my, aren't you the sweet talker, Commander. How many girls have you used that line on? Hehe~♪
For a moment, it seemed like Hiei's face was a lovely blush of red... but maybe it was just an illusion.
I found Hiei with the Commander, nya!
Good evening, Commander. Good evening, Hiei. Thank you for the invitation.
I'm glad you two could make it. Have you been enjoying the banquet so far?
As expected from an Imperial Ship. The food garners nothing but praise.
Akashi supplied the ingredients, nya!
Even though Hiei obviously was the one who planned the menu... Ah, forget it. This tea is splendid.
This is black tea that was ordered straight from the Royal Islands. Of course the flavor is peerless!
Nyaaa?! Y-you scared me... It's just Kongou, nya...
Thank you very much, Kongou.
Say nothing of it! Speaking of which, it'd be a pity if you spent all your time standing out here. After all the work you put in, you might as well join in...
Ah, or perhaps... I get it now. Akashi, Shiranui, let's continue talking over there instead.
Why should I... unyaaa!? Don't pick me up like that! I can walk on my own, nya!
Ah, um... Commander, Hiei, see you two later.
How joyous youth is. Let's leave them alone for a while, hehe~
Oh my, Kongou certainly has her way of doing things...
For whatever reason, it felt like I had the most reliable wingwomen in the world...
Well, since we don't get to spend time together like this very often...
Commander, would you do me the honor of accompanying me for this dance?

sequence:
Hiei's Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 7: Moonlit Appassionata</size>

scripts.say: The banquet was drawing to a close.
Thanks for everything~ Bye bye, nya~
That was a splendid banquet. I'll be looking forward to the next one
Hiei throws the best banquets after all. Of course everyone was having a great time~
It helps that she has such a good reputation too~
Hehe. Please be careful on your way back~
Phew... I guess it's over now...
The more joyous the occasion, the more bittersweet it is when it comes to an end...
Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
Hehe~♪ That's not the important thing though. Ultimately, I just want to see everyone get excited and have a great time.

options.content: "Why do you like banquets so much?"

scripts.say: Hmm, how should I put this... The preparations are grueling, you get no compensation for doing it, and when it's over, you feel lonely...
However, during the banquet, you can see how happy everyone is.
We all build up so much stress during our everyday missions... If there's anything I can do to help alleviate some of that...
If you think of these banquets as a form of healing, doesn't that make them seem much more marvelous?
Of course, setting up a banquet is no easy feat...
But being able to see everyone's happiness makes me forget all about the hard work.
The silver moonlight falls gently across the harbor. The moon is beautiful tonight...
I recalled the dance I shared with Hiei earlier at the banquet.
Another dance... right now? The banquet's already over though, and the music...
Don't worry. Banquet or not, our appassionata is always playing.
Hehe. You're right, the night is still young...
Very well then. Let's begin our moonlit cruise... just the two of us~

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Let's Have a Week of Indy!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Well, Commander? I think it's a brilliant idea!
Not again, sis... You're dumping stuff on people again.
I can't help it! My head is always brimming with ideas thanks to how cute you are!
Okay, well, what did you come up with this time?
Mass-producible Indy merch! Collectible photos! Keychains! Pillowcase covers! And much more!
My desk is buried beneath giant stacks of documents, none of which go more than one sentence without mentioning Indianapolis.
I've rejected Portland's proposals over and over, but each and every day she comes back and tries again to convince me.
Please, not a pillowcase cover... That's too much.
Indianapolis doesn't like the idea of being commercialized, but her concerns don't seem to weigh much on Portland's conscience.
But why not?! All I want is to maximize your appeal to the widest audience possible!
I appreciate the sentiment, but this is way over the line...
I want to make more friends, and while this would introduce me to new people, I just...
I don't think it's the best way to do it.
Aha! Did you hear that, Commander?! Indy wants to make more friends!
That gives me an idea! I'll preach about Indy until more faithful followers join our ranks!
We'll have a whole Week of Indy! It's the perfect plan!
Portland's eyes gleam with enthusiasm. I remain skeptical of her plan, however.
Having said that... if it does work, and the two of them make new friends in the end, then that's great. And so, I give her the go-ahead.
Um, Commander... If this gets out of control, you have to tell my sis to stop, okay?
It won't get out of control! Just have some faith in me!
My plan is gonna make you some new friends, I guarantee it!
That's not the part I have my doubts about...

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Clash of Sisters</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy Schoolyard
The Week of Indy has officially started.
And with it, Portland's plan of converting others into the "Church of Indy."
Her first potential convertees: other people who adore their sisters.
So, you decided to come to me first, is that it?
That's right! You're your little sister's biggest fan too, aren't you? I figured you'd get where I'm coming from.
...You could say that. My dear Spee means the world to me.
It is true I adore my little sister, but that's all we have in common. Furthermore...
You're asking me to become a fan of *your* little sister. Now why would I do that?
Why? Isn't it pretty obvious? My Indy's cuter than your Spee!
How dare you! Hey, lowly animal, I demand you let me blast this little worm to kingdom come!
Deutschland doesn't seem to be joking. I order her to calm down and lower her cannons.
Hmph! One day, one way or another, you will pay for your slander!
Gosh, Deutschland gets really scary when she's angry...
Oh, that reminds me... When Indy's scared, she gets all teary-eyed.
And now that I think about it, she looks adorable that way! Like a cute puppy that deserves a hug!
Lowly animal, what's wrong with your secretary? Do you have some sort of aura that attracts weirdos?
Sorry, I lost my train of thought for a minute there.
What I was gonna say is: imagine Spee, all teary-eyed. Doesn't the thought of that just make you wanna hug her?
W-well... yes. But I would never let Spee cry. And I'd send anyone who would make her weep to a watery grave before they can even try.
Yeah, I guess so... If anyone tried to do the same to my little Indy, they would regret it big-time.
But now we're back at square one... How am I supposed to convert you to the Church of Indy?
You aren't. What made you think I want to revere someone else's little sister in the first place?
You're wasting your own time, and more importantly, mine. You too, lowly animal! Expect some punishment later.
No, wait, don't leave! I'm not done preaching yet! Come baaaack!
It seems like all we achieved here was make Deutschland angry...

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Like Two Peas in a Pod</size>

scripts.say: Port - Classroom
The Week of Indy continues. Portland is not giving up so easily.
She's trying again with a slightly different approach. Perhaps she will have better luck this time.
Goodness, yes, I totally understand you! It's so amazing to have a sister like mine!
I knooow, right? It's like, I literally never tire of talking about how great Indy is!
You said it! Even if I were to talk nonstop for three whole days, I wouldn't be able to express even 5% of Norfolk's greatness!
Same with Indy! We need more than words to convey our sisters's splendor! That's why I've been trying to get the Commander to agree to mass-producing Indy goods.
Ahh, making things in her image, eh? That's an ingenious idea! I'd love figurines of my dear Norfolk.
I'm honestly surprised. These two are almost on the exact same wavelength.
Keyword: almost. Listening a little closer, I realize that...
And then there's the time Indy hugged me in her sleep! My gosh, I just about...
Norfolk is still a little afraid of the dark, so sometimes I need to...
...Both of them are only talking about their own sister and not really listening to the other.
What do you mean "going nowhere"?! Of course it is! Dorsetshire completely understands Indy's appeal!
She's totally on board with joining forces and spreading the word of how cute she is!
All too true! Together, Portland and I shall enlighten the entire world!
Everyone will know Norfolk's name and celebrate her each and every charm point!
Hang on... Norfolk's name?
Yes...?
I thought you were going to join me in the Church of Indy and ask to be graced with her cuteness?
What? I thought you were the one who wanted to kneel with me before the altar of Norfolk and ask for her blessings?
That's, uhh... not what I had mind?
Turns out I was right. They were both talking to a brick wall.

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Distance Felt</size>

scripts.say: Port - Classroom
I don't get it, Commander. Despite all my efforts, my Indy fans counter remains at just one!
Here I thought I could convince my fellow sister-lovers to join me, but it seems I was wrong...
Since that's failed, all there's left now is to preach to everyone I come across!
Just as I'm about to tell her not to be ridiculous, a familiar face peeks out from behind a corner.
You there! Have you heard about Indy, the cutest little sister on the planet?
Wah! Don't spook me like that... Wh-what was that about an "Indy"?
You don't mean... Indianapolis, do you?
I do! If you want to be among the first people to join the Church of Indy, now's your chance!
Umm, the thing is, Portland...
I... had this mock battle with Indy the other day, and I... I sank her...
And ever since, I haven't been able to strike up a conversation with her...
You what?! Mock battle or not, you sank Indy?!
I'm sorry! Sorry, sorry, sorryyyyy!
Frightened, I-58 ran away.
Sorry for wh– Hey, wait!
Aww... I didn't mean to scare her, I was just gonna say how amazed I am that she defeated Indy.
Although I guess I understand how she feels. Back in the day, I had a similar incident with Yuudachi and Hiei...
Beating someone really badly, even if just in an exercise, does make them wanna distance themselves from you.
Portland seems nervous about how to deal with the people she's clashed with in the past.
And that's a problem, because if they won't want to talk to Indy, I can't preach her greatness to them...
There's only one solution: getting Indy back in touch with those people so I can then preach about her to them!
Once she's gotten her foot in the door, I'll sing Indy's praises until they realize how perfect and adorable she is!
With that decided... Commander, I need a small favor from you!
Could you gather all the people I've talked to over the past few days and send them and Indy on the same sortie?
The look in her eyes is that of utmost sincerity. I don't know what she's planning here, but I'm inclined to go along with it.
Commander? What is it? Why so quiet all of a sudden?
On second thought, I think the problem here is people distancing themselves not from Indy, but from Portland...
I'd have to think carefully about how I wanted to conduct the next sortie...

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Change of Plans</size>

scripts.say: Port - Noon
Today's the day of the sortie. I created a special fleet for the mission, composed of the girls relevant to Portland.
Deutschland. Dorsetshire. Hiei. I-58. Yuudachi. And last, but not least...
...Me? Why am I the flagship?! This isn't what I asked for!
*sigh*, so what is the idea behind this fleet, exactly? Three girls from one faction, but then there's me, Dorsetshire, and Portland...
Heheh, I'll work with any fleet composition as long as you'll listen to me talk about Norfolk.
Um... Hi, Portland...！
Woof? Yo, Portland! You ready for some payback after that time you dunked on me?
Oh geez... Don't tell me you still hold a grudge against me?
Now, now, let's not taunt Portland.
We once suffered an embarrassing defeat owing to her, but that's all in the past. Now let us fight side by side, rather than with each other.
(Gosh, Hiei's giving me scary looks...)
(Hope Portland's still not angry with me... It's probably for the best if I just treat this as a normal mission.)
Hmph. If any of you can work as a team, I'll be surprised.
Probably not, though. I don't expect much teamwork out of a pack of dogs.
A pack of *what*?! I dare you, call me a dog again! I double dog dare you!
Commandeeeer! You need to swap me out for Indy, because this wasn't the plan!
How am I supposed to preach Indy's adorable side to them if they won't even see her eye-to-eye?
Huh?! You're doing this to... close the gap between me and other people?
Well, all right, I suppose. And don't worry, I'll still play my part in the mission!
But in exchange, we're gonna have a double pass of Indy Appreciation Hour when I get back!

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 6 - More Layers Than One</size>

scripts.say: Exercise Area - Noon
Enemy submarine to our port side! Yuudachi, ready depth charges!
Got it! I'm gonna blow 'em to pieces!!
Their fleet is comprised mainly of light cruisers... We'll be playing catch-up with them since our ships are slower.
Hiei, fire a battery to the enemy's front! Disorient them with the impact while Deutschland and Dorsetshire flank them!
I'll suppress them with my own cannon fire! I-58, circle around to attack them with torpedoes!
Understood!
Okay! They won't know what hit them.
Let's go, Deutschland! I'll come in from the left!
Very well, then I will come in from the right and crush them!
All targets confirmed neutralized. Let's head back to port.
That went surprisingly well. Good job, everyone.
Hell yeah! We totally mopped the floor with them!
Plus, we only sustained minimal damage. It was all thanks to Portland's precise instructions.
(Holy cow... Portland's a pretty good strategist without Indianapolis around to distract her.)
Still, I could've done an even better job if only Indy had been here!
Really, now? So you weren't even at your best today?
Mhm! When Indy's with me, my brain works 100 times as fast!
But when she isn't, I just can't push myself to my limit.
Heheh, you're a curiosity, I'll give you that much.
To think you're this good at commanding, but you weren't even going all-out.
...Um, thanks.
My opinion of you has improved. You're not just some weirdo obsessed with her own sister.
You've also made me want to learn more about your sister, if she really gives you the power you claim she does.
Really? But you didn't want to hear me out earlier, so what's changed?
It's simple... You're strong and competent, two traits which I like in people.
More importantly, shouldn't we get a move on already? We're just standing around here.
Oh, right! Yeah, let's go, everyone!

sequence:
Anything and Everything for Indy!

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Happiness is Best When Shared</size>

scripts.say: Port - Noon
...Oh. Portland's team is back.
We've returned! I missed you, Indyyyyyy!
Grrghhh... N-not so tight, please... I can't breathe...
Sorry! But you know, *you* were supposed to go on that sortie instead of me!
This isn't how it was supposed to go! My plan was to help you make new friends!
Actually... I think this exactly is what the Commander wanted.
Huh? What the Commander wanted?
Heheh. This is just a guess, but I believe the Commander sortied us together so we could learn more about you, Portland.
Oh yeah, that makes sense! I've pretty much like, never talked to her before now.
All I knew about her is that she's crazy for her sister!
But as we found out from fighting alongside her, there are many more facets to her personality.
Like how capable she is when she gets serious.
I-I don't know what to say...
The Commander wanted to improve everyone's perception of you, and thought the best way of doing that was to have them see you in a new light.
The idea was that once they got to know you better, they'd be willing to listen to what you have to say.
So basically, the goal of this was to help you make some new friends.
Commander... is that true?
Sis... It really does make me happy that you like talking about me so much.
But you know what else makes me happy? You actually being happy.
Seeing you getting on so well with people... that really brings a smile to my face.
Oh, Indy...!
Thank you, Commander! Thank you for making Indy so happy! Her smile is as bright and essential as the sun to me!
I hereby declare you the second member of the Church of Indy, with honors!
Wait, that doesn't sufficiently express how grateful I am. You deserve something a little more special...
Mhm. Since you made me smile, I think you should do the same for the Commander.
Oh, yeah! Commander, you really thought all this through, didn't you?
Not only did you make Indy happy, you also made me really happy.
And by making me happy, I hope I make you happy. So... thank you so much, Commander!
Hehehe~
Portland giggled and smiled for me. I couldn't help but smile back.

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>1.Mermaid?</size>

scripts.say: One evening, I found myself strolling along the beach to alleviate the stress from a long day's work.
The stars of the night sky are perfectly reflected upon the water's surface, the scenery of peace and quiet gradually soothing my heart.
Suddenly, I noticed a figure approaching me from just beneath the surface.
A beautiful girl emerged from the water, droplets cascading under the moonlight as her emerald hair fluttered in the sea breeze.
...I could only stand there spellbound, as if having just met a mermaid.
Huff... Puff...... I think I spent too long underwater... I need to be more careful next time...
C-Commander...? What are you doing here...?
The "mermaid" was actually Boise, a light cruiser who had recently joined the fleet, now looking at me with a dumbfounded expression.
I let out a sigh of relief... At least it wasn't some enemy infiltrator.
H-had I known you were here, I would've been more careful when I surfaced...
Everything had happened so suddenly that I missed my opportunity to greet her.
Um, Commander... I'm getting nervous from how much you're staring at me...
I quickly shifted my eyes to the side.
Um, if you don't need anything...
I'll be off then...!
Before I could utter a single word, Boise had already disappeared from the pier in what seemed like the blink of an eye.
Even after returning to my office, I couldn't stop thinking about our new companion. I started to sift through the stacks of documents sitting on my desk.
Boise, Brooklyn-class light cruiser... Actually, isn't her turn for secretary coming up soon?

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>2.The Rookie Secretary</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
G-good morning, Commander... I, I hope we can have a productive relationship...
(Deep breaths, deep breaths...)
And thus, the first day of Boise's secretary duties arrived.
So these are my responsibilities as a secretary ship...? I understand.
Unlike the first impressions I got of her, Boise was surprisingly straightforward and quite easy to work with.
...But I couldn't stave off my curiosity about her uncomfortable-looking mask...
I've finished sorting through the commission-related paperwork.
Despite this being her first time as secretary, Boise was already well-adjusted to the job's pacing. She remained focused on her work, occasionally asking me questions.
Commander, shouldn't we take our lunch break soon...? Can I get you something to drink...?
An energy drink...? Um, Commander, I believe something lighter would be better...
After accepting her suggestion, I started to chat her up while waiting for her to finish preparing my beverage.
I, I like diving...
But, I'm not a submarine, so I can only dive for a little bit...
I never could've guessed that would be her hobby from the way she appeared and conducted herself.

options.content: "What is it that you like about diving?"

scripts.say: Um, how do I put this...
Sometimes, I like the feeling of being able to drown everything out and just be by myself... Do you ever get that way, Commander?
I'm sure everyone has times where they just want to leave everything behind for a while.
Being surrounded by the ocean... makes me feel like time is standing still.
Not to mention, it's also very colorful and beautiful. Coral reefs of all shapes and sizes, sea turtles and other wildlife...
You can swim with schools of fish, or you can just immerse yourself in the beautiful scenery there... It's a really profound feeling...
Her heartfelt description made me visualize the beautiful sceneries of the underwater world without me even being there.
And when I thought about her being in the middle of that serene, enchanting world...
...I felt like I got a glimpse into the mind of the girl in front of me.

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>3.Shopping</size>

scripts.say: The files from the archive room, the price list of the purchase orders... Mm, that's everything that Commander requested...
My secretary ship, Boise, was in the process of carrying out errands.
Hey there, Boise~ What are you up to?
Oh, St. Louis... Um, Commander wanted me to help gather some documents...
By the way, the diving equipment you got for me the other day was very easy to use... You're always picking out really nice things for me.
Oh, I'm glad you like it. I know how tough being secretary can be, so I thought about getting something for you to help you relax.
So, how's your new job going? Commander's pretty easy to get along with, right?
Mm... I thought things would be pretty stressful, but it's not too bad.
Commander doesn't seem to mind me wearing my mask either...
Well, I'm sure you'd be able to make more friends without that thing on~
Th-there's no way I could do that...
But that's not important... St. Louis, since you're so good at picking out presents for people... Um, do you think you could help me pick out something nice for Commander...?
Oh my, since when did the two of you have that kind of relationship~♪
(I was afraid that the commander was just being polite, but... is the mask really not an issue?)
Of course I can give you a crash course on what Commander likes, but on one condition~
What would that be...?
Hehe, nothing that difficult. You just have to beat me in a little game.
If Commander manages to not say "I want to see Boise's real face" for an entire week, it's your win.
And if Commander does...?
Wait, is this your game...?
Yup, that's the way I like doing things~ If Commander does say that, then...
St. Louis whispered something into Boise's ear.
Wh-what are you saying? There's no way I could...
Commander's tastes are a critically important piece of intel, you know? If you aren't prepared to put at least that much on the line, then I'm not sure I can help you.
Um, if it's just one week... It'll probably be okay...
Wanna drink to that deal?
Mm... It's not like I actually lose anything even if I don't win...
That's a promise then. If you lose, you'd better listen closely to what I tell you~
(I wonder what you'll do, Commander~ Hehe, don't let me down~)

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>4.Defeat?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Today's workload seems rather manageable... Shall we finish everything at once?
Boise appeared to be in high spirits today.
The results from the latest exercise? I'll get that for you right away...!
(Commander still doesn't seem concerned about my mask... Rather, I don't think it's ever been an issue...)
(Maybe I'll actually win at St. Louis's game...)
Commander! I've brought you your documents!
...Wait, wh-who's that?! Oh, it's just Boise...
Sorry... D-did I scare you...?
Not at all! The pursuit of justice never ends though, so I'll be off now!
After placing the documents on my desk, Cooper quietly slipped out of the office.
I, I knew it, my mask is scaring people off... Commander, if it's getting in the way of your work, then...
Th-thank you, Commander... I'll try to stay focused on finishing the work...!
After a quick break, Boise seemed to have recovered and continued to work as hard as ever.
Commander! I've brought you something from the intel room!
...Woah, what's that?!
S-sorry! Did I scare you...?
N-no, I just wasn't expecting to see that! Anyway, please sign right here, Commander...
Well then, see you later, Commander! Come play with us sometime!
Libeccio darted from the office, almost as quickly as she had swept in.
...I knew it, this is a problem...
After Libeccio left the office, Boise clearly was letting something affect the speed of her work.
I keep scaring people with my mask on, but if I was to take it off... I'm not sure I'd be able to function...
The situation seemed to be getting a little out of hand, and I had to do something.

options.content: "Want to go shopping with me tomorrow?"

scripts.say: Um, thank you, but... you don't have to go out of your way to change your shopping schedule because of me...
Wait, you just want to help me relax? I see...
(Phew... Commander still hasn't said anything about the mask...)
I could tell that the way Cooper and Libeccio acted had a negative effect on her.
While it was none of my business why she always wears her mask... I was very curious about the face underneath it.

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>5.An Invisible Smile</size>

scripts.say: Which one do you think looks better? I honestly can't tell a difference between them...
Honolulu, are you shopping for pajamas?
While shopping with Boise, we ran into the off-duty Honolulu at a clothing store.
St. Louis said something about pajamas needing to be fashionable as well... Boise, want to come take a look with me if you're not busy?
Sure. Um, Commander, you can come too if you want...
C-Commander...?! Y-you'd better not peek, I'm warning you...
Oh, I think this cute one would suit you well... I think it looks better on you than the really "daring" stuff...
You know, I'm glad you're here right now, Boise... St. Louis is always putting weird ideas in my head...
But, don't you think she has a better understanding of what's fashionable than me?
That may be true, but y'know... I somehow feel way less pressured about my decision with you here...
I, I guess that's good...? Want to try this one on as well...?
With Boise's advice, Honolulu was able to purchase a pair of pajamas that suited her well.
After leaving the store and taking a short break, I decided to take her to a recently-opened bakery.
Oh, I heard this place has a pretty good reputation for its desserts. I'd like to bring some back for everyone to try.
Indeed, the array of sweets before me would not disappoint even the most dedicated of sugar aficionados back at port.
But, sickeningly sweet stuff is no good either... What should I get...
Apparently, Helena was also browsing the store, caught in a similar conundrum.
Oh, hi Boise. I'm trying to pick out some dessert for my friends, but I don't think I want to go with something overly sweet...
Mm... maybe just go for things that everyone can enjoy?
Okay, I think everyone's a fan of caramel pudding...
Seeing Boise be able to talk naturally with her friends made me feel a bit of relief.
I originally offered to take her shopping to get her mind off whatever was bothering her, but it seems like she's doing just fine.
After we had finished picking out our desserts, the sky had already become dark.
I'm so sorry... It's gotten so late because I stopped to talk to everyone...
Though her mask tends to catch people off-guard, I could easily tell that she is a kind and thoughtful person.
Anyone who spent a little bit of time with her would be able to see her friendly personality.
Having that said though, it's undeniable that the mask gives her a sense of unapproachability...
Commander...?

options.content: I want to see what you're like underneath that mask.

scripts.say: ...I, I knew it... It's been bothering you all along...
But if that's how you feel... Umm, p-please let me think it over a bit...?
(I guess I lost the bet with St. Louis... But if Commander wants to see...)

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>6.As Promised</size>

scripts.say: Now then, I'll be the moderator to make sure Boise keeps her promise.
We almost made it all the way to the end too... I guess you're really taking this seriously, St. Louis.
The outcome would've been the same even if you had won. Hehe~
The same...? Does that mean you're going to tell me what Commander likes...?
Boise, I just thought up another challenge for you! You down?
Brooklyn, not you too...
Isn't this getup way too embarrassing...?!
Oh my, Honolulu, did you also want to try it on that badly?
N-not a chance in hell...
Do I have to take my mask off right now...? It's not time to meet with Commander yet...
Uh, there wasn't any agreement on that, but what do you think, St. Louis?
Don't bully Boise...
You can't even take it off in front of your own sisters?
Th-there are other people around too...
I get it, I get it. You just want Commander to be the only person who sees your face~♪
Uuu...
And thus, Boise set out to make good on her promise with St. Louis–

sequence:
Me and the Boise

<size=45>7.The Sweetness of Tiramisu</size>

scripts.say: Boise asked to have dinner with me, and I met her at a little bar by the Eagle Union dorms.
I felt like she wasn't the kind of person who'd do something as proactive as asking me out for dinner though...
C-Commander...
My eyes followed the sound of her voice back to its source–
Boise stood there dressed in an alluring bunnygirl outfit, hiding her mouth with her hair.
Haah... Haah...
I took off the mask... just like you asked me to...
Um, umm... would you like something to drink...
For whatever reason, the two of us were the only people at the bar tonight.
My mind was racing to come up with reasons as to why she was dressed like this...
I made a promise with St. Louis... If you asked to see my face, I'd change into this outfit and then... ask you out on a date...
And if I did that, she'd help me pick out a gift that you like...
Is that why she put herself through all this...?
C-Commander, um... Now that you see me, what do you think...?
Seeing her without her mask, and in this outfit... made her seem like a completely different person.
D-deep breaths... Haah... Haah... Okay, I feel a lot better...
Commander... Umm, thanks for always treating me so well...
I know I've caused you a lot of trouble, but I'm glad you've always been so patient and understanding with me...
If you like what you see, then, um... I'll do everything I can to support you, so, um...
Despite the fact that her face was beet-red from embarrassment, she mustered the courage to put her feelings forward.
Oh, um, I think the food is here...
Um, tonight was my way of saying... I've become stronger, and I want to continue being with you... is that okay?
Hrmm... we've been out this long and still not a single target...
nothing but icebergs. Not even a whale. I'm guessing faulty intelligence?
Even an ace submarine comes back empty-handed every once in a while
Then am I just unlucky? Everybody at the port's been saying I'm such a lucky girl.
What happens when I come back from my first sortie with nothing to show for it? I couldn't face Lord Bismarck like that!
Seems we're not so unlucky after all. I've got a contact on sonar.
Where?!
Target transport ship off our bow, bearing 040, advancing...
... Prepare to dive!
Witness... the first majestic battle of Unterseeritter U-556!
Ooohh! Such an invigorating feeling... coursing through my entire body!! I feel fantastic!!!
Shhhh! Quiet down... We need to dive before they see us.
(Whispering) Understood! Unterseeritter U-556, commencing operation.
Ahahaha! Didn't even break a sweat!
It was just a small transport fleet. They didn't even have anti-submarine capabilities.
Maybe you actually are blessed with luck, 556.
I'll be an ace in no time. And then they'll have to give me the Knight's Cross, maybe even with oak leaves! And then Lord Bismarck will notice me~!
Heheheheeheeee~
No... the transport fleet we just sank was maybe a thousand tons.
A thousand tons?! That much?!
"That little," you mean... You'd need to break at least a hundred thousand tons to make ace.
And then to be an ace among the aces you'd need something like two hundred thousand...
Aaaughh... I suddenly feel like it's so far out of reach...
No matter. It's time to prove the goddess of fortune stands with us!
Torpedo reserves still good. 557, let's continue our war patrol!
Phew... that sure was something. Ehehehe~
Conditions in this sector are rapidly deteriorating. With their transports under attack, the enemy is sure to deploy anti-submarine forces.
Also, our torpedo reserves have been depleted. I think we should quit while we're ahead.
Beep beep... beep beep...
Hm? I've got a weird distress signal here...
I'm getting it too... They're using an Enigma code, but I can't determine who the sender is.
Could it be a trap? Could the enemy have cracked the Enigma? ... That's impossible.
At this point... you don't think it could be Lord Bismarck...?
Gah! I have to see for myself!
Wait a second, 556! We're out of torpedoes, remember? What if it's a trap?!
557, you head back to port and let them know what happened. I have to go! I made a promise to Lord Bismarck!
... Okay. But you have to be careful! If you see an enemy you just dive as deep and as fast as you can!
Ehehehe, don't worry about me! The goddess of fortune stands with us!
嘿嘿~发现敌方运输舰队！

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>1 Constructing the Consultation Office</size>

scripts.say: In summary!
For the sake of everyone's mental health, and to help solve their problems...
I'd like to use your office to open a new consultation corner... no, consultation OFFICE!
That is all!
After rushing into my office, Bremerton rattled off her proposal without letting me get a word in edgewise. Then, she hands me a document.
I WAS just going to hand in my application.
But I couldn't help myself. I just had to tell you all about it!
All the details are in the application, though, so give it a good read!
Whoops. Let me reply to a post real quick...
Sure. Go for it.
I accept the consultation office request and read over it.
I don't have any problems with the plan, but... it says I need to give my opinion after the consultation?
Yep! This is my first consultation off of Juustagram, so I might overlook some things.
What better way to improve it than to have your opinion?
Is this mainly a process review question, then?
Yep yep! But I also want your supervision and feedback on whether I can improve my problem-solving process.
Are you sure? That would mean breaking the confidentiality between you and your clients.
No worries there!
I'll narrow down the consultations that I want your attention on. Plus, I'll get my clients' permission.
Okay...
With my issues addressed, I approve her application.
Hooray! I'll prepare the consultation office right away!
One more thing... Are you sure you can handle it alone?
If there's anything I can do to help, let me know.
Okay! Thanks, Commander! I'll come running as soon as I need anything!
The following few days went by quickly.
Sorry, Commander! Can I get some help with the door?
After the day's office work is over, I hear Bremerton's voice outside of my office.
When I open the door for her, she rushes in, carrying a bunch of bags big and small.
Judging from all the stuff she's carrying, it must be related to her consultation setup.
After some time and effort, we've put all of her things where they need to go.
Thanks, Commander! I wanted to bring all the stuff for my consultation office and set it up...
Oh! Got another message. Let's see...
Bremerton whips out her phone and types up a reply.
Send... And, done!
Anyway, it's time to set up my office! You go home and get some rest, okay, Commander?
It's still early. Let me help you.
Two sets of hands work faster than one.
You mean it? I think I'll take you up on that~ Thanks, Commander!
Now, where do we begin...
Can you get the sign from the bag in that corner and put it here for me?
Like this?
Yeah! Good stuff! Next, let's hang this ribbon here...
Two days of preparation later, and the consultation office is ready for business. Opening day is tomorrow.
Hmm. Something's missing...
Bremerton seems bothered as she stands in front of her new office.
What about putting out snacks?
That's it! They'll serve as a good decoration AND help people relax a little!
Thanks, Commander! I'll go buy some right now!
I happen to be free right now. Why don't I go with you?
After some shopping out in the port...
Umm... That's probably enough snacks and drinks for now.
I was thinking, what if we stop by a bookstore next?
Why a bookstore?
I mean, they're open, and it'd be nice to work on my psychology and consulting knowledge before I open shop.
It's my first time, after all. Even I get a little nervous!
She stops and smiles a little bashfully.
Her usual energy comes back in no time, but...
In that short moment, I saw the subtle bags under her eyes – proof of how much work she's put into her consultation effort.
I've made my decision! To the bookstore we go!
Thus, I follow her for a while...
Until her eyes are drawn to a certain storefront along the way.
(Is that... a home goods store? A bedding set and fluffy pajama sale, huh...)
Ahem. You've been working hard on this consultation business, right?
Once it's over, I'm sure you'll need a good night's sleep...
Ahahaha~ I appreciate your concern, really, but I'm always full of energy. I'm not tired in the slightest!
Anyway, let's hurry to that bookstore! We gotta get back soon so we can decorate more!

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>2 Open for Business!</size>

scripts.say: It's finally opening day for the consultation office.
I head out, surrendering my office to Bremerton and her clients.
In the evening, she calls me and lets me know that I can come back.
Welcome back, Commander! The consultation office was a huge success!
That's great!
I look around. Every part of her setup is gone, as if it was never there.
I cleaned everything up before I called. Heheh.
Good timing, though! I was just narrowing down the list of resolutions I wanted your opinions on.
She shows off a bundle of papers and waves it at me.
Good work. In that case, should we do the review together as well?
Uh, about that... I was kind of thinking I should do it on my own first and put together my own thoughts.
I'll have you help me after I do that.
Now, first things first... How do you think I can improve my problem-solving process? All opinions welcome!
She hands over the documents, and I open them.
Hmm...

options.content: (Pick one from the top at random.)

scripts.say: I take a random sheet from the top of the bundle. Client: Bristol.
Consultation: She's been exhausted lately. She considers herself too busy, so she's looking for help finding a solution to that.
(Too busy? What, too busy investigating mysteries?)
I suggested she clean her room and replace her couch and bed with softer ones.
Then, she should read novels from various genres and broaden her horizons as an investigator.
Basically, I told her to stay in her room and rest.
I choose one from the middle this time. Client: Louisville.
Consultation: She wants help being less forgetful.
I recommended she take notes and force herself to memorize the things she cares the most about.
For example, things related to you.
I pull from the bottom of the pile. Client: Chi An.
Consultation: She needs a way to get really good at cooking as fast as possible.
She needs a skilled friend to teach her, of course. For example, Lung Wu or Vestal...
Of course, I did warn her not to feed you her practice dishes, Commander!
That should do. Next...
I've checked Bremerton's consultations to her satisfaction.
This is all good advice. I honestly don't see anywhere I can contribute.
Really?!
Her previously worried eyes open wide with joy.
So my consultation office can help people, after all!
Ahaha~ But it only went so well thanks to your help, Commander!
Here, I'll put everything back where it was. Your office will be all yours again!
I'll help!
Hehe, thanks, Commander! You're too sweet♪
The two of us hauled all the documents and decorations to Bremerton's room.
You can put it right there! Thanks, Commander! Want a drink before you go?
...Oh! Sorry, got another message... Let's see.
(She sure keeps an eye on those messages. I doubt she'll sleep well like that.)
Aaand, sent! Okay, all done!
So, where was I...? Oh! Do you want a drink, Commander?
I'm fine, thanks. You've had a long day today – you should really take a break.
Hm? Are you that worried about me? I'm fine! See, I'm still full of energy!
But if you say so...
Heheh, go on a date with me next time you're off!
You wanted me to take a break, riiight? Then it's a deal. See you then!

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>3 The Big Day Off</size>

scripts.say: The next day...
As soon as I enter my office, Bremerton gives a hearty welcome.
Heheh. Bremerton here, ready to be your new secretary ship!
Leave any and every job to me, Commander!
With her full support, today's work comes to a quick and smooth end.
Hey, do you want a nice cup of milk tea to finish off the work day? No ice, and half syrup♪
I accept the tea and savor a sip.
(Hmm... Bremerton's acting a little weird today.)
Hm? Come to think of it, where's your phone?
Oh, yeah. I forgot I left it in "do not disturb" mode! Thanks, Commander!
Heheheh♪ Let's see what help everyone needs today!
When I leave the office, I run into Baltimore in the hall.
Oh, Commander! Sorry to bother you outside of work hours... I wanted to discuss the athletic field remodel with you. Do you have a minute?

options.content: Oh, fine. Let's go take a look.

scripts.say: ...Tomorrow, I'll examine the equipment that needs maintenance and updating, and collect them in a list.
The most urgent upgrade is the tennis court's pitching machine. Yesterday, it misfired and did a number on poor Bremerton's head...
Did a number on her?
Yeah. To be fair, she was hardly mentally there to begin with.
(Leaving her phone on "do not disturb," spacing out on the tennis court...)
(She must still be fatigued from her consultation office.)
I decide to tell her about Bremerton's recent efforts and her odd state.
Really... We should find a way to make sure she rests properly.
Not that she would listen if we just told her to, of course.
If it's really necessary... Commander, you could sock her good enough to knock her out.
I would really rather not.
(She did like those new pajamas back at that one shop.)
Hmm...
After I tell Baltimore my thoughts, the two of us begin devising a strategy.
Okay! Leave it to me, Commander!

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>4 A Special Session</size>

scripts.say: Soon, the day of the operation comes.
*knock* *knock*
Come iiin!
Huh?
Commander and Baltimore? Welcome... Uh, why'd the two of you bring so much stuff?
Did you forget my promise to spend the day with you in your room today?
Oh, yeah! Ahahaha, here I thought it was just going to be a regular pajama party!
Don't worry. That's still what it is.
But I discussed things with Baltimore, and we thought redecoration might help liven up the mood a bit more.
Huh, really? Okay, where should we start?
Just then, Bremerton's phone plays an alert tone.
You just got a consulting request, right? Leave the decorating to me and Baltimore.
Yeah. Take care of your consultations, okay? Then, you can come back and focus on enjoying the party.
Hehe~ Okay! I'm counting on the two of you!
After we finish redecorating her room...
Whoa! You two work fast. I barely even finished replying!
Then that's perfect. Let's get this pajama party started!
Just then, Baltimore's phone gets a call this time.
Hello? Hmm... Really? Right now? But I'm...
Does it really need me there? ...Okay. I'm on my way!
Hey, guys? It sounds like they really need me to go right now.
Huh? Does someone need help? It seems awfully sudden.
Oh! I just remembered I have work left over, too!
The Commander is busy, too? That's a shame.
Well, there's no point in trying to continue the pajama party.
Yeah. Sorry, Bremerton. You should just get some rest on your own!
Huh? You're really going? Even after you redecorated, and everything?
You must be hiding something! I'm really perceptive when it comes to this stuff, so out with it!
Bremerton interrogates us. We're forced to spill the beans on our plan.
Heheh... Ahahaha!
You did all that just so I'd rest and go back to normal?
Okay! Okay, I get it! Geez, you're so indirect~ I'll rest up good, so stop worrying so much!
Now that the secret's out, can we go back to our pajama party, though?
Ahem... Um, I actually did make plans, since we expected to leave you alone by now...
Awww! Commander, what about you?
Her expectant eyes turn to me.
Sure. I don't have any work to do, so I'll stay.
(I mean, this is Bremerton's bedroom, right? I should really say no...)
Sensing what I'm thinking, Bremerton clasps her hands together as if begging.
Please, Commander? You remember that date promise, don't you?
Let's have a stay-at-home date~
A stay-at-home date... But, umm...
Don't sweat the small stuff! Come on, Commander, stay with me!

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>5 Tell Me Your Troubles!</size>

scripts.say: After Baltimore left, Bremerton excused herself for a moment to change into the new pajamas I gave her.
While I wait for her, I happen to notice the consulting office sign on the floor.
Hmm... Sure, why not?
I pick up the sign.
Tadaaa! Sorry for the wait! But doesn't it look good on me?
Wait, Commander? Why'd you put up that sign?

options.content: Bremerton, let's do a consultation right now!
The consultation office is open for business for a limited time!

scripts.say: Now, tell me your troubles... I mean, it doesn't even have to be troubles.
Anything you want to ask, or anything you want to talk about, let me hear it.
Ooh! You really sound like a counselor, Commander!
Okay, I'll play along~
Umm... Where do I begin?
Let's start with your consultation office. Setting it up took a lot of hard work, right?
Not really? It was easy stuff for me!
But if I had to say, I guess it was pretty stressful...
Like... Would I be able to solve people's problems? Would my advice really help them?
You did a good job there. Your consultation office was a success, wasn't it?
Yeah! I think everything turned out great!
But... Now that I've relaxed after all that stress, it's gotten a little hard to focus...
And now you're forgetting to take your phone off of DnD, and you're letting tennis balls hit you in the head.
Hm? How did you know about the tennis ball thing?
Oh! I know! That's why you schemed to make me rest!
I confirm her suspicions, and she flashes a bright smile.
Roger that! To live up to you and Baltimore's wishes, I'm gonna rest and relax like never before~
But fiiirst... Let's play a game, Commander!

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>6 Off-Day Leisure</size>

scripts.say: I have one card in my hand, and Bremerton has two, one of which is the old maid.
A normal card. This wins me the game, and Bremerton falls back into her cushion while holding a single Joker.
Aww, I lost~ How did you get so good at this, Commander?
Okay, no more Old Maid! I'm done with that!
...I pull the Joker. When I lose, Bremerton gives me a big hug.
Yay! I win! I'm celebrating today's first victory with a biiiig hug!
It's rare for me to win against you. I wanna keep my undefeated record for the day!
Let's change games now!
After that, we play board games for a while... until she stretches and yawns.
Phew... Playing games can be exhausting~ How about we find something more relaxing to do?
Such as?
Such as... watching movies, or something!
In this movie, the characters talk about their troubles, overcome the pain in their hearts, and ultimately accept each other in the end.
Bremerton clings to my arm and rests her head on my shoulder.
Heheh. It all comes down to being open with each other.
When it comes to solving problems or relieving stress, you need to tell people how you feel...
I've been listening to other people's problems all this time, and I'm just now realizing... I guess I've been pretty dense, for once.
A little. If you have any problems, tell me any time, okay?
Yeah! Okay, it's decided! And... I'm gonna tell you things that aren't problems, either!
Of course.
Also... Thanks a lot for today, Commander...
You set aside a day off for me, stayed with me the whole time...
Zzzzz...
Bremerton?
On this warm night, backed by the gentle sound of movie music, she falls asleep on my shoulder.
That faint smile on her face makes her look very satisfied and relaxed, indeed.

sequence:
Consultation Corner's Day Off

<size=45>7 Brem's Big Rest</size>

scripts.say: The credits roll onscreen.
But Bremerton still sleeps.
(I think I'll carry her off to bed and head home.)
When I gently pick her up, she sleepily opens her eyes.
Yaaawn... Hmm? Commander, did I fall asleep?
Aww, why didn't you wake me up? We finally got some alone time! Ugh, I slept away all our time together...
You looked so peaceful. I didn't want to stop that.
Anyway, if you're awake, I'll put you down–
W-wait, wait!
She takes her phone out of her pocket, wraps one arm back around my neck, and raises her phone with the other.
Then, she leans toward me. Following her warm breath, her lips touch my cheek.
*snap!* She takes a photo of the kiss.
Heheh♪ Commemorative photo shoot complete, aaand... saved!
I put her down and take a peek at her phone's screen.
Come to think of it, you didn't look at your phone much today, did you?
Well, of course!
The screen displays the most recent Juustagram posts. The newest one reads...
The consultation office is closed for today!
I wouldn't want to ruin the mood you so carefully established. You're the most important thing to me in the world, anyway!
With that, she opens her phone settings.
Yeah, I love how close we are in this pic! I'm putting that as my lock screen!
The movie ends, the TV enters power-saving mode, and the room gets darker.
I'll get the lights...
When I try to stand up, though, she pulls me into a soft, yet tight embrace.
Hehe. Now we're even closer than before♡
You understand me better than anyone... So listen to my heart a little more, okay?♡

sequence:
An Exercise Gone Slightly Wrong

<size=45>1. A Miscommunication</size>

scripts.say: One day, at the port...
Hm? What's up, Commander?
What's this? A mission briefing?
I'm still on vacation, though. You'll have to find someone else.
...The mission's not for me?
So what's this about then? I hope you're not here just to mess with me.
Ingraham unrolled the sheet of paper and began reading it with a doubtful look.
"...Members of the fleet will participate in a combat scenario designed to test their improvisation skills..."
"...There will be no radio contact between participants. The addressee, Bristol of the Allen M. Sumner class, is to link up with the attackers near the abandoned naval facility..."
Ah, I get it now.
Once Ingraham finished reading the mission briefing, she cocked her head slightly as she looked at me.
Bristol hasn't come back yet, and you've got an important meeting to attend soon...
Basically, you want me to send her this on your behalf, am I right?
Don't sweat it. A few minutes of my time is no big deal.
I'll relay the message right away. You go on and head to your meeting, Commander.
Ingraham made off for the communications room with a thorough grasp of the mission's outline.
Bristol has a tendency to jump to conclusions. I decided it was best to let her sister, Ingraham, explain the mission to her than try and potentially fail myself.
At any rate, the job was done. I hurried back to my office to prepare for my meeting.
Testing, testing. 1, 2, 3... This is Ingraham. Do you hear me, Bristol?
Ingraham? Fancy hearing from you outside our regularly scheduled contact times. What's up?
Just relaying orders for you. The Commander was in a big rush, so I'm doing it instead.
Ahem... Change of plans. You are to head to the naval base ruins at once and link up with the attackers. I'll send you the coordinates.
There. Did you copy that, Bristol? ...Bristol?
The only thing Ingraham heard back over the radio was the sound of faint static.
Crap. The line must've cut right as she answered. Oh well, I've done my job. Back to enjoying my time off.
Meanwhile, on the other end of the line...
What did you say, Ingraham?
...Hello? Are you still there? Helloooo?
The comms channel closed?! You've got to be kidding me!
Did... Did something happen back at base? Is that why the comms went down?!
I think she said the Commander was in a rush, there's been a change of plans, and that I had to go somewhere at once?
That could only mean... Oh no... The port is under attack and the Commander needs someone to organize the evacuation!
And that someone must be me, because I'm closest to the port! So I need to run back there immediately!
Oh goodness, I'm starting to hyperventilate... Need to calm down!
Breathe in... Breathe out... Breathe in...
Gah, it's not working! I'm getting stressed because I'm wasting time!
My heart's telling me to hurry, but my brain's telling me to radio back and get confirmation before I...
No, what am I saying?! That's a terrible idea!
If the port is under attack, the enemy is without a doubt monitoring our radio channels!
That would explain why there was so much noise over what Ingraham said, too!
Oh geesh... Take it easy, Bristol... Remember your training...!
Okay, so... There's no way she'd send unciphered orders over the radio if she knew someone was listening in...
Which can only mean one thing... That message was some sort of code! Oh my god!
Bristol unfastened the lantern from her rigging and held it high, lighting up her surroundings... in broad daylight.
Whew... The glow of my lantern's helping me calm down.
I should probably hurry to the coordinates she sent me. Let's see here...
...Is this really right? Isn't this the location of that abandoned naval base?
Wait, I get it now! The idea is to gather everyone there, then launch an organized counterattack on the enemy!
Yes, of course! It all makes perfect sense!
All right, time to swooce!

sequence:
An Exercise Gone Slightly Wrong

<size=45>2. The Investigator Arrives</size>

scripts.say: KABOOOM!
Bristol came under heavy fire from afar the moment she arrived in the area with the ruined naval base.
Her attackers were the opposing exercise team. It's only natural they would target her.
S-someone's shooting at me?!
Aw crap! I can't believe this place has fallen too!
What's my damage... Huh? No damage?! Seems they aren't a real threat in that case.
She was hit numerous times, but suffered not as much as a scratch.
Which is no surprise, given the fleet was firing blanks as part of the exercise. Bristol, however, had no way of knowing this at the time.
I've got to stay calm! First thing's first, I have to find something to hide behind!
She took a quick look around and spotted an abandoned base. She sailed towards it while firing back at the opponents.
The base was barren and lonesome. Despite the daytime sun's glow, it inspired a melancholic mood.
Lights... on!
Whew... Helps calm my nerves.
If the enemy's advanced all the way out here, our hopes of turning the tables look pretty bleak...
But if things are this bad, why did Ingraham radio me just earlier...?
I can't even investigate what's going on here when I don't have any leads...
Bristol began thinking. Just then, a cold wind blew against her body, sending a shiver through it. She listened close, and seemed to hear a voice carried by the wind.
...stol...
Bris...tol... I've been looking for you...
EEK!
...Wh-whoever you are, I'm not scared of you! But I know better than to talk to strangers, so go away!
Bristol... c'mon...
The voice got closer and clearer until eventually, its source came into view.
Wh-who's there?!
It's me, dummy! Allen! What's the matter? Didya get hit on the head with a blank or something?
Also, didn't you get the memo? The attackers have moved to a new location, so we should reposition too.
Oh yeah? Out of all the stickers on your rigging, which one represents the Commander?
...What?
I knew it! You're not Allen, you're just an impostor!
What are you talking about?! I don't under–
Begone, doppelganger! You don't belong in this world! Leave me and my friends alone!
Bristol chanted a series of incoherent spells at the top of her lungs, then ran inside the base, shrouded in darkness.
Some time later, Ingraham received a status update from the fleet participating in the exercise.
...An unidentified ship came into the area and fired warning shots at you?
There's no way an enemy could appear out of the blue this close to port... Unless... Yeah, that's got to be Bristol.
She just got back from an excursion and needs some time to adjust, I reckon.
Thing is, I met her at the old ruins earlier. I tried to talk to her, but she yelled weird stuff back at me then ran off.
What did she say, exactly?
Uhh... The gist of it was, "leave me alone."
Geesh... She must be really bummed out. Maybe she wants us to suspend the exercise for her sake.
She could've just said it if so... I'll go ask the Commander about that.
(What the heck's up with Bristol? I told her to link up with the attackers, but instead she's acting independently.)
(Wait... What if she didn't get those orders because of the radio static?)
(Then I've gotta find her and make doubly sure she gets them this time!)

sequence:
An Exercise Gone Slightly Wrong

<size=45>3. Code Speak</size>

scripts.say: Is it just me, or are there more enemies here now?!
That's a bad sign... I hope everyone back at port is okay...
KABOOOM!
I can't hide here forever... My only hope is to call others who were out of port before the attack and ask for backup.
But... I can't do that since our comms have been compromised! It's too risky!
I guess I just... have to improvise some sort of code and hope they'll be able to figure out the message...
Ahem... This is Investigator. Agency, come in.
Why won't it connect?!
They must be jamming us... Oh man, I really hope everyone's okay...
Hang on... Ingraham's channel worked earlier! Let's see if I can contact her!
This is Investigator! Come in, Ingraham!
Bristol? Where are you now?
Err, just listen closely to what I'm about to say! Weather was all clear until I got here, when it suddenly started pouring down!
I'm in need of some umbrellas. Could you send some my way?
What're you talking about? It's not raining over there.
(She doesn't get it! Dang it... How do I make it clear what I'm trying to say? Maybe she'll understand if I put stress on it?)
Look, what I'm trying to say is...
I need UMBRELLAS right now! The rainfall is overwhelming!
Why do you need umbrellas when it's sunny? Look, if a squall comes in or something like that, just find shelter in the ruins and wait for it to pass.
Wait for it to pass...?
(Oh, I get it! She's saying reinforcements are coming and I just need to hold out a little longer!)
Mhm. Now listen, I just wanna make sure you got–
Copy that loud and clear! Investigator, out!
What? Wait–
The line sounded really choppy... Things must be really bad back at port. I doubt backup will be here any time soon if I do hold out here...
But maybe, just maybe, things will be okay if I stop the enemy from taking these ruins...?
Bristol took out her little notebook and began to write.
"Investigator's Log - Clear skies (but it's raining in my heart). The port is under attack and the future is uncertain."
"I've been told to make my last stand at the old ruins... I pray my friends are okay."

sequence:
An Exercise Gone Slightly Wrong

<size=45>4. Bristol with the Master Plan</size>

scripts.say: Allen relayed orders for the exercise fleet to cease fire. Bristol saw this quiet time as an opportunity to execute a plan she hatched.
A plan inspired by a movie she watched once. Using parts scavenged from inside the abandoned base, she built and laid traps all around the area.
Tripwires and booby traps are all set. Perfect! I'd like to see them get through this!
All I have to do now is lie and wait...
Exercise area - Abandoned naval base
Ingraham? Why're you here? Weren't you taking some time off?
Just... scoping out the situation. How's the exercise going?
It's on hold for now, per the Commander's orders, until we get to the bottom of the weird occurrences that've been happening.
And believe it or not, things have only gotten weirder since they first began...
Let me guess: Bristol asked you to bring umbrellas 'cause it started raining?
...No? There's not been a drop of rain the whole day. Why would she need umbrellas?
Y'know what, never mind. As I was gonna say: the others told me they've had weird things happen while passing by this abandoned base.
Things like paint buckets being hurled at 'em, floor tiles that spray water at you when stepped on, and weirdest of all... eerie wailing.
Almost makes me think this place is haunted. Maybe that's got something to do with why Bristol was acting strange when I saw her.
Haunted? Please. Nothing unusual's happened the thousand other times we've been here.
Anyway, is the Commander around?
Nope. Had to go straight into another meeting, apparently.
The Commander's radio channel is open though. Want me to patch you through?
Nah, no need.
All righty then. Now if you'll excuse me, I've gotta run an errand! Have a good rest-of-the-day off!
To think they actually put the exercise on hold... I wonder what's causing these "weird occurrences."
Occurrences? What'd I miss?
Cooper? When'd you get here?
I've been here all along! I'm part of the exercise fleet, y'know.
Been meaning to ask: was it you who told Bristol to head here?
Yup. Not sure she got the message though. There were some technical difficulties with our comms.
Hah, so I was right on the money.
Seems that little miscommunication led Bristol to hole up here and cause us all a big headache.
I'm gonna go in and catch the troublemaker. Meanwhile, you should probably start thinking about the formal explanation you'll be writing soon.
*sigh*... There goes the rest of my day off...
It was this exact moment when Ingraham's brief period of R&R came to an end.

sequence:
An Exercise Gone Slightly Wrong

<size=45>5. Clearing the Confusion</size>

scripts.say: Exercise area - Inside the abandoned base
Cooper and Ingraham entered the dark base and headed for their target.
Lights... on!
Geesh... Look at this place. It's chock full of traps.
Feels vaguely like the set of a horror movie. All that's missing is a puppet on a tricycle...
Anyway, move slowly and keep an eye out so you don't trip any of them.
Seen any signs of Bristol yet?
Hang on, I'm looking... Oh! There she is!
*gulp*!
Wait! Don't run!
Go away, fakes! The person you're looking for isn't here!
Calm down, Bristol! Tell me what happened!
You're... You're the real Cooper?
Yeah, it's me!
Oh, thank goodness... I was so sure I was the only one left!
Have you returned to port? What's the situation there?
No, not yet. Why do you ask? And what do you mean you thought you were "the only one left?"
It's awful... The port came under attack! It came so suddenly nobody had time to evacuate!
I think something happened to the Commander... I tried to radio the port, but the enemy's jamming our channels...
I see... That sounds pretty bad.
(So all this really did happen 'cause of radiowave jank... Ingraham really should've just called her again.)
Then uh, why are you here now, exactly?
I got orders to regroup with the others here so we reclaim the port, and then the enemy launched an assault on this place!
Now they're surrounding us! My traps have been going off nonstop!
Not to toot my own horn, but the only reason this place is still standing is because of my quick thinking!
Anyway, I have to defend this place to the end, no matter what... Those are the final orders I got.
I... see...
Everything will be all right if I just do that. I mean, you showing up is proof that it's working!
And more people are bound to show up! Then once we have a sizable force, we'll strike back at the enemy and reclaim the port!
What? You've made it your mission to defend this old place?
Ingraham! Thank gosh our radios are working again! How's it going back at port? Are you all okay?
Uhh... Yeah, I'm fine and everything's all good. Could you explain why you decided to hunker down in there?
I mean, isn't that obvious? You're the one who told me to find shelter in the ruins and wait for the rain to pass!
When I said "it started pouring down," that was code for "the enemy's attacking." And when I asked for umbrellas, what I really meant was reinforcements!
And since you couldn't send those, I took what you said to mean "hold the line and wait until we come for you"! That's what you meant, right?
You've got to be kidding...
Of course not! It's because you used code from the moment you contacted me that I managed to figure out the gravity of the situation so quickly and work out a plan!
Wow... Talk about jumping to some ridiculous conclusions.
*sigh*... Another thing to add to my explanation. I'm gonna hang up now.
Huh? What do you mean I jumped to conclusions?
Well... Let me explain.
Ugh, it feels like my world just got turned upside-down...
Makes sense, since you had it so wrong all this time.
So when I met Allen earlier... That was really her?
Ding-ding.
And the people who set off my traps...?
Shipgirls passing through the area after the exercise got halted, I think.
