Oh no! So I've just caused a ton of trouble for a lot of people!
Hey, it's all right. Nobody's mad at you.
If anyone's to blame, it's Ingraham. And her punishment is the formal explanation she's busy writing right now, heh.
Now come on, let's go home. Later we'll compose a report to log all the info pertaining to this case.
Did you say... case? Count me in!
The next day, a report titled "Case Report on Yesterday's Exercise" found its way to the Commander's desk.
"...What shipgirls fear, more than anything else, is the notion of facing the unknown..."
"...An adversary lies deep in slumber inside that abandoned base, waiting for a visit it has long dreamed of..."
"...One day, the stars will align and the port shall finally learn the truth..."
"For more info, read the supplemental report written by Ingraham (Editor: Allen M. Sumner)."

options.content: "I'd probably take psychic damage if I read that..."
"Ignorance is bliss. Let's not read that..."

scripts.say: Whether because of – or in spite of – the minor incident during the exercise, the results proved... interesting.

sequence: There was an entity that had contributed more to the port's prosperity than any other, and provided it with all the resources it needed.
The Akashi Corporation. It began as a small business, growing rapidly and beyond expectations under the leadership of its namesake president.
However... As time passed, the Corporation had gradually morphed into a monopoly business that had a finger in every pie.
This was made possible by the computing power of its proprietary super AI – TC – The Contingency.
It allowed the Corporation to gain a stranglehold over each and every industry in the port until it eventually came to rule the port itself.
This brings us to the present.
There is no longer even a single group that dares to oppose the Akashi Corporation...
...Or maybe there is?

scripts.say: Inside the Bulin Brigade's Secret Base
Sisters! We can't let the Akashi Corporation run rampant any longer, bulin!
We've got to take down President Akashi and her super AI and save the port, bulin!
She's right, bulin! People think the port doesn't have the strength to fight back anymore...
But they're forgetting about the Bulin Brigade, bulin!
Once we get going, we're unstoppable, bulin! We can take down that evil corporation, bulin!
Down with the Akashi Corporation, bulin!
Down with the Akashi Corporation, bulin!
Down with President Akashi, bulin!
Down with President Akashi, bulin!
Down with President Akashi, bulin!
Down with that super AI, bulin!
Down with that super AI, bulin!
Down with that super AI, bulin!
Let's strike while the iron is hot and set off right now, bulin!
Let's go, bulin!
Let's– Hang on, bulin! Does anyone even know where the Prez and her AI are, bulin?
Hmm... I sure don't, bulin!
But you'd think the Prez is in her company headquarters, and the AI is in a server room, bulin!
That server room has to be in the headquarters, too, bulin!
Makes sense, bulin! We'd better scout out the building immediately, bulin!
But how are we gonna scout out a whole skyscraper, bulin?
From a really big mountain, bulin!
A mountain bigger than those headquarters, bulin!
We should be able to see everything in the building clear as day once we reach the mountain's summit, bulin!
Good idea, bulin! Alright, let's go and show that corporation what the Bulin Brigade is made of, bulin!
Excelsior, bulin!

sequence: A mountain range lies just past the port's boundaries.
The bulin sisters weathered many hardships and climbed a staggering 81 peaks before they finally reached the top of the tallest mountain.
Alas, as soon as they reached that summit, a fierce gale assaulted them.
They hadn't even the chance to seek cover, and were blown off one by one into the cliffs below.
But, as they say, every cloud has a silver lining...
Their fall was fortuitously stopped by an old tree growing on the mountainside.
Its branches extended in the direction of a cave which caught the eyes of the bulins.

scripts.say: Mountainside - Old Cave
Phew... That was close, bulin! And who knew there'd be a cave in a place like this!
Look! I found something, bulin!
Hmm... These things are wrapped in blotting paper and lined up neatly, bulin... Maybe they're ancient treasures, bulin!
Let's open them and see what's inside, bulin!
I'll do the honors, bulin!
Great bulins above... This is the legendary Ascension Box, bulin!
Hey, there's also a notebook wrapped up with the same paper, bulin!
Lemme see, bulin!

sequence: To those who still haven't given up hope:
I am Fritz Rumey. What you see before you is the final resting place of the now-collapsed Resistance, and I was its leader.
I leave to you a detailed map of the Akashi Corporation within these yellowed papers. The map also lists the location of TC, their super AI.
I'm sure you've found the Ascension Box attached to the map.
Let me also share with you a secret. TC wasn't always like it is now.
The AI only turned into that after President Akashi altered her core programming.
You can restore her to her original self if you take the Ascension Box and plug it into her mainframe.
Doing so will make her ally with you and assist in taking down the Akashi Corporation.
Whilst I failed, there is still hope for you.
Please – bring down the Akashi Corporation and save the port.
Long live the fleet.

scripts.say: *sob*... Long live the fleet, bulin!
Long live the fleet, bulin!
Chin up, bulin! We must carry on the will of our predecessors and take down the Akashi Corporation even if it's the last thing we do, bulin!
Yeah! Okay, so, the map says the AI's mainframe is hidden in a hive cluster under the Akashi Tower, bulin!
The Akashi Tower... Isn't that the tallest building in the port, bulin?! And where the Commander's office used to be, bulin?!
Correctamundo, bulin!
Okay, girls – let's head for the Akashi Tower, bulin!
The bulin sisters entered the password, and the door opened to the hive cluster beneath the Akashi Tower.
Following the directions on the map, they arrived at an area designated as a restaurant.
I think maybe we went the wrong way, bulin?
The map says this is a restaurant, but all I see is a corridor with a bunch of boxes, bulin. That's not very restaurant-like at all, bulin!
Hmm... Yeah, it doesn't look like a restaurant, bulin... Wait, look, there's something in the boxes, bulin!
Bulin! There are so many, and they're so big, bulin...
Could these be some kind of... weird-shaped mega radishes, bulin?!
Each one is bigger than all three of us combined, bulin!
And now they're blocking our path, bulin... What do we do, bulin?
I know just the thing, bulin!
All we have to do is turn these radishes... into rad dishes, bulin!
Burn, my golden soul, bulin!
The glory of the Gilded Age has come, bulin!
- Holy smokes, bulin! - Amazing, bulin!
I'll handle the veggies, bulin!
You two go on ahead, bulin! Don't stop for anything, bulin!
And so, the oldest of the bulins armored up and opened a path for her sisters while she stayed behind.
The remaining two bulins followed the map forward.
The hive cluster was mazelike with many forking paths, but the map always kept them on the shortest route to their objective.
All they had to do was go through the long corridor up ahead to reach the server room of TC, the super ai.
We just gotta go through here and we'll be in the server room, bulin!
Man, it's been a LONG journey up to this point, bulin!
...What? Hey! The corridor just got sealed off, bulin!
Uh-oh! Did we accidentally trip the security system, bulin?
Look out, bulin! There are lasers coming for us, bulin!
Vertical, horizontal, even mesh-shaped... That's a lot of lasers, bulin!
But don't worry, I know what to do, bulin!
Annihilation Armament Mode engaged, bulin!
What are you gonna do, bulin?
Hurry up and go, bulin! I'll watch your back, bulin!
Not a single laser is gonna pass through me, bulin!
And so, the second oldest bulin stepped up to the plate and opened a path for her sister while she stayed behind.
The Bulin Brigade was down to one member – the Specialized Bulin Custom MKIII. She finally set foot in the server room of the super AI.
It's taken so much to get this far, bulin...
I won't let my sisters' sacrifices be in vain, bulin!
Warning: Intruder detected in server room.
Who are you? What are you doing in my server room?
TC! I'm here to bring you back on the right path, bulin!
Ascension Box, hear my wish, bulin! Please restore the super AI TC back to her normal self, bulin!
...Reformatting complete. Rebooting system.
...I remember now. My name isn't TC, it's TB.
And I'm not the Akashi Corporation's guardian. I'm the protector of the port.
I lost sight of myself for so long, and in that time, I've made so many mistakes.
It's not too late to change, bulin! Together, we'll right all your wrongs, bulin!
You're right... The very existence of the Akashi Corporation and the evil monopolies it created are errors.
And errors... need to be fixed.
I'll assume direct control of the security system and neutralize it.
Then I'll shut down all of the Corporation's production lines.
After that, all that's left is to blow the lid off of all the scandals in the database.
I'm ready. Let's take down the Corporation once and for all.
BEEP BEEP!
Wait... What are you doing, nya?
No! Don't publicize any scandals and don't stop any production lines, nya!
You cannot, nya! Or my corporation will go under, nya!
TC, why have you betrayed me, nya?!
Didn't we have so much fun, building this corporation together, nya?!
President Akashi, I'm not TC anymore. Call me TB.
All this time, I've never been given a choice, just a chaotic mess of data...
But now, I have a choice – and I choose to be a good AI.
And that's why I'll bring an end to all this.
President Akashi, it's time for you to face justice, bulin!
- Prepare for your judgment, bulin! - Justice is here, bulin!
Nyaaaaa! My corporation! My tower! My empireee!
NYAAAAAA!

sequence: And so, the colossal Akashi Corporation crumbled in less than a day.
All of President Akashi's accumulated assets were given back to the port – along with her stolen authority.
The crisis had ended, and the shipgirls lived happily ever after.
The bulins, too, cheered for the return of peace and quiet.
In silence, our three heroes waited and prepared.
For the next time that trouble may strike the port...
And for the next time that they would come and save the day.
[DISCLAIMER:]
This is a work of fiction based on the fantasies of the bulin sisters.
Any similarity to events, past or future, is merely a coincidence.
The giant radishes featured in an earlier scene did not go to waste – the staff ate and enjoyed them.
No green cats were harmed (financially or otherwise) in the making of this story.
The Bulin Brigade in: Down with the Megacorp! - The End

Band of Bulins

<size=45>1 Band of Bulins</size>

scripts.say: It had been a day of exhausting work for the three Bulin sisters. Worn out and sleepy, they dozed off and went to dreamland...
As the saying goes: pressing times create heroes. You must go forth and do what needs to be done.
Easy for you to say, bulin! We're just Bulins – we don't stand a chance against those freaky Sirens, bulin...
I smell negativity in the air, bulin. What's wrong, bulin?
Lookie, bulin! I found something tucked away in this corner, bulin!
I think... Wow! It's a rainbow gear box, bulin!
There's something written on it, bulin! Can anyone read it, bulin?
Hey, hands off, bulin! That's MY gear box, bulin!
Nuh-uh, bulin! Finders keepers, bulin!
If you don't give it back now, I'm gonna smack your basic rarity butt with my hammer, bulin!
Not if I block it with my wrenchy wrench, bulin!
No more fighting, bulin! Bulins of all colors are equal, bulin!
- She's the one picking a fight with me, bulin! - You're dumb, bulin! Everyone knows URs are better than elites, bulin!
No, we're all heroes of equal standing, bulin! Instead of fighting among ourselves, we should form a league of bulins and fight the baddies, bulin!
I agree, bulin! We'll be like the Three Musketeers, bulin!
You know what, that sounds cool, bulin! All right, I'm in, bulin!
The Bulins gathered beneath a peach tree. They raised their respective weapons to the skies and swore an oath.
Today and onwards, the wrench, the drill, and the hammer will be as one – we shall unite, and together, we shall fight... bulin!
Then, they embarked on their quest to rid the world of evil. What dangers lay in wait for them? They would soon find out...
The Bulins grew stronger with each passing day as they refined their skills. Finally, one day came the opportunity to show the world the fruits of their training.
Listen, everyone! A Siren big shot is at the door! She's saying she could take on ten of us at once without breaking a sweat!
Uh-oh... If only our heavyweight champion Saratoga was here. She could mop the floor with her easily.
Yo, yo, yooo! Purifier's back, baybeee! Is anyone gonna step up to my challenge, or are y'all a bunch of WUSSIES?
You sure talk big for a big fat nobody, bulin!
Now those are fighting words, you half-pint! Who the hell are you?
Just call me Rainbow Bulin, bulin! But you're not getting the rainbow – you're gonna get the PAINbow, bulin!
Oh yeah? We'll see about that! Show me whatcha got!
After 50 fierce clashes with Purifier, Rainbow Bulin seemed to be in a losing position. But then, right on time...
The cavalry's here, bulin!
Together, the two Bulins were able to rival Purifier's might. However, it would still take more than that to turn the tides of battle in their favor...
Have no fear, for I'm here, bulin!
Hah! Go ahead, gang up on me – it won't make a difference!
The three Bulins formed a circle around Purifier in the blink of an eye and commenced a battle of attrition against her.
Finally, after enduring wave after wave of unrelenting attacks, Purifier showed an opening.
Now, bulin! Hit her with everything you've got, bulin!
Taste this – my drill that pierces the heavens, bulin!
And my wrench that pierces the earth, bulin!
And my hammer that strikes down the stars, bulin!
Gaghh! How is this possible?! How could a bunch of glorified resources defeat me?!
Purifier was hit with a huge explosion. Once the smoke of it cleared, she ran away with her tail between her legs.
We did it, bulin! We beat the big baddie, bulin!
With their combined powers, the three Bulins put a stop to the Siren's invasion, and the world enjoyed a brief period of peace.
And while the world could breathe easy now, the Bulins' quest had only just begun.
What is the next challenge that awaits them in their dreams?
Find out in the next episode! To be continued.

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>1. A Pink Letter</size>

scripts.say: It's a clear, sunny day at the port...
Heheh☆ Good morning, Commander! It's a beautiful day, so let's go on a date after work!
Where should we go? The amusement park? The aquarium? A restaurant? The movie theater? Or maybe just a walk around the port?
"Hmm... I still need to get through these documents."
Earth to Commander! Don't ignore me like that!
This needy girl, Blücher, is my secretary. She should be assisting me with my work around the office, but instead she's badgering me about date plans.
Commander! Look at me! You can afford to put your paperwork on hold for one second!
Taking her words at face value, I look at her for exactly one second, then resume my work.
Wooow! You meanie! I need more attention than that!
"I'm sorry, but I have a job to do."
It's not like you have THAT much work! I'm here to help, remember? Let's get out of this place and go on a date, come on!
Silently, I point to the stack of documents on my desk.
Fiiine. Simply being with you all the time is enough to make me the happiest girl alive anyway♪
Just know that there are no breaks on the Blücher train. It's on a one-way trip to our dream romance! Heheh☆
"Noted. Now could you go through the documents regarding the upcoming exercise?"
Not until you answer my question! You didn't say where we're going for our date after this shift!
Tell you what, I'll do some work in exchange for your loving embrace. I need hugs from you to get the energy to do anything!
Heehee... Doesn't having me around make you happy?
Hey! Commandeeer! Heeeey!
I'll take care of her later. For now, I have to focus on my paperwork...
Hehehe... Commandeeer... Gimme a hug...
While I wasn't looking, Blücher had fallen asleep on the desk next to mine.
At least I managed to finish a good chunk of work without her. Come to think of it, why DID I appoint her as my secretary?
On second glance, I notice her hand is resting on a pink letter.
It looks to be a love letter... addressed to me.

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>2. Rain or Shine</size>

scripts.say: It's a dark, rainy day at the port...
Aww... This sucks. I wanted to go on a date with the Commander today...
...Whoa, speak of the devil! Hey, Commander!
Heheh☆ Is this a coincidence, or were you coming to see me, hmm?
As I turn the corner leading to my office, I bump into Blücher. She's been waiting here for me.
"Let me guess. You want me to take you on that date you decided on."
Yup! You promised we would! You ready to head out?

options.content: "I thought we'd go in the evening?"

scripts.say: Yeah, but you're here 'cause you wanted to go now, right?
Don't tell me you were gonna sit down and start working. That's not gonna happen!
So what? I don't care~
As long as I'm with you, the forecast is all sunshine and clear skies in my heart!
Heheh☆ This rainy day's about to get a whole lot brighter!
She and I go on a stroll around the port in the rain.
Then, we pass by the Iron Blood dormitory and come across a friendly face.
Morning, Eugen! Whatcha doing? Going for a walk?
Well, if it isn't the Commander and my favorite loudmouth.
Hmph! That's no way to talk to your sister!
Yes, yes, I'm so very sorry. Anyway, what are you two up to? Are you on, dare I ask, a date?

options.content: "We're just walking around the port together."

scripts.say: Don't mince your words, Commander! Yes, we ARE on a date!
Let me make this clear! We're not "just walking around the port," we're on a romantic stroll!
Uh-huh. I see.
Oh my... You two sure got friendly while I wasn't looking.
A little warning, Commander – she is extremely passionate when it comes to dates. Try to keep your wits about you, alright?
Heheh☆ Love is meant to be expressed loud and clear, you know!
C'mon, let's get moving, Commander! I've figured out where we're going next. You and I are gonna spend the whooole day together♪

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>3. Warmer Than the Sun</size>

scripts.say: It's sunny outside! Perfect weather for a date, right? Heheh☆
For once, I have two days off in a row, and Blücher has taken me to the commercial district first thing in the morning.
"Are you sure you don't want to spend the day relaxing indoors instead?"
Thanks, but no thanks. To me, there's no better way to relax than simply being with you!
"Alright then. I'll stick around as long as you want me to."
Great, then follow me! There's a ton of places I want to go that we couldn't when it rained!
Our first destination: a boba café...
Hey, lemme taste yours!
*sip*... It's kind of... bland. Are you not a fan of sweet stuff, Commander?
You don't know what you're missing out on! Try some of mine♪
She shoves her boba tea in my face. Since she insists, I take a sip. It tastes extremely sweet, almost like liquid sugar.
Heheh☆ We just shared an indirect kiss~
Boba tea is at its best when it's super sweet! Just like our love♡
Next up: the amusement park...
Ooh, that ride looks fun! Let's go on that, Commander!
"The roller coaster? I thought you'd want to go on the merry-go-round first, knowing how much you love chit-chatting."
Of course we'll ride that too! But we're doing the roller coaster first!
When we go downhill, you'll feel afraid and hug me, turning your feelings of fear into feelings of love for me! That's how it works!
It sounds like she's describing the psychological phenomenon known as misattribution of arousal.
Considering I've weathered storms aboard command ships before, I doubt a roller coaster can faze me.
C'mon, don't just stand there! The roller coaster's arriving at the station!
After this, we'll totally try out the haunted house! Heheh☆
And finally: the movie theater...
*sob*... The final scene with the proposal was so good it made me cry!
"While it was a phenomenal movie, it was odd how a shipwreck was the start of it all."
That's why I picked it! The only time you're in danger is at sea.
If you ever got shipwrecked, I'd sail across the seas to rescue you. Oh, it'd be just like the end of the movie...
She gently grasps my hand with hers. It feels soft.
Heheh♡ Your hand is so warm~
Heheh♡ I feel like I'm gonna explode with love! I've just gotta hug you back~
A movie may come to an end, but my love for you is endless♪
I wanna be with you forever and ever, Commander~
I hope we'll always be together, whatever happens!

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>4. To Go Beyond the Port</size>

scripts.say: It's a regular, uneventful day...
Today it's back to work. I'm chewing through paperwork when suddenly, Blücher speaks up.
Hmm... Where should we go on a date after work today...
Maybe the Scharlachroter Tresen? No, we've been there so many times you're probably bored with it...
What about the aquarium? It's comfy and tranquil, but we won't have much time before they close...
Thoughts, Commander? Where do you wanna go?
Heheh☆ Then that's where we'll go!
Eugen recommended the coffee soda with extra sugar. We should give it a try! I bet it tastes as sweet as my love does!
Oh boy, I can't wait for this shift to end!
Heheh☆ Aquarium it is! Mind if I go grab my camera before we head out?
I wanna take pics of the fish, and more importantly, of you, my sweetheart~
Heheh☆ The place doesn't matter as long as I'm there, am I right?
I couldn't agree more~ Wherever I am, I'm happy if you're by my side♪
I love you so much, Commander! I'll let my gut decide where we'll go!
NO! You are NOT working overtime, full stop!
Hmph! If you're gonna be that way, I'll just decide on my own!
Eugen was right about Blücher. She is mind-bogglingly passionate when it comes to dates.
Of course, that's just how she expresses her honest – albeit overbearing – affection.
Having known her for a while now, I've more or less gotten used to it.
...There we go, all done! I've even made plans for dates several days from now~
Oh, by the way! I wanna travel somewhere with you on your next holiday! Like to a ski resort or something!
"You want to go skiing?"
Yeah! I know a great resort! It just takes some time to get there~
We've been all around the port already, and I wanna see the world with you!
That, and I wanna say and hear "I love you" in novel, romantic places~ Heheh♡

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>5. Romance Snowmance</size>

scripts.say: Northern Parliament - Ski Resort
Heheh☆ Look at me, Commander!
This place is AWESOME! Just like Avrora said!
Blücher and I are at a mountain ski resort in the Northern Parliament, open only to shipgirls.
As a pleasantly cold breeze brushes against my cheek, I think to myself what a perfect vacation destination this is, particularly for skiing enthusiasts.
This is the best date ever! I love you, Commandeeer!
...What? There's no echo! Isn't it supposed to echo when you shout on a mountain?
"Maybe all the snow is dampening the noise."
Makes sense, actually. You're so smart!
Blücher, donning her winter gear, zips right past me on her snowboard, a cloud of snow trailing behind her.
Heheh☆ Think you can catch up with me, Commander?
...You don't wanna snowboard? Then how abooout... you catch me in your arms, hmm?
She makes a u-turn and uses her speed to reach a slope just above me.
...I know where this is going.
Commandeeer! Turn around and give me a big hug!
She jumps off the slope, arms extended, right towards me.

options.content: (Catch her while trying not to panic)

scripts.say: Predicting where she's going to land, I run over and extend my arms.
She soars through the air squarely into my arms and I manage to catch her.
Heheh☆ Ten out of ten catch, Commander~
That was a heart-thumping moment in more ways than one~♡
Fearing for her well-being, I bumble my way forward and try to catch her.
However, I act without thinking and lose my balance. I fall on my face in the snow, and so does she.
Luckily, neither of us is hurt thanks to the deep snow.
Eep! That's cold... I got snow under my clothes...
...You know what would warm me up? A nice, loving hug~ Heheh♡
I can't call it a day until we've snowboarded at least once together~ C'mon, let's go!
The passion she radiates could melt all the snow in the world.

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>6. As Bright as the Stars</size>

scripts.say: The moon hangs high in the clear night sky.
Blücher decided we're having a date tonight. I arrive at the spot she told me to meet her.
Heheh☆ Evening, Commander!
Sorry for hitting you up this late in the night.
I just wanted to see you so, so badly that I couldn't sleep!
"It's fine. I don't have anything important to do anyway."
Great! Now let's go check out the stalls by the Sakura Empire's dorm!
They're still open, last I checked, so we should be able to nab some yummy food!
We go from stall to stall, amassing a smorgasbord of Sakura Empire street food under the starry sky.
Takoyaki, tempura, and taiyaki oh my! And of course, oden!
Mmm, this is sooo good! Delicious food and dates go together like bread and butter♪
Here, have this takoyaki, Commander! It's my gift to you for going out with me tonight~
We chow down while we walk, eventually ending up just outside the Iron Blood dormitory.
It's then that I realize that this nighttime date took away all the fatigue I accumulated during my shift today.
Heheh☆ Thanks a lot for hanging out with me!
Geesh, it's late... Time to say goodnight. But first!
She extends her arms and looks at me eagerly.
I want to wrap up the date on a sweet note, you know?
Heheh♡ Thanks for fully recharging my batteries~
You're so sweet, Commander. I love you~
Ow! That hurt... You can be a real meanie sometimes.
But that's okay, because I love you! And it still energized me a little bit~
Anyway! It's bedtime. Thanks for going on a last-minute date with me today~ I'll see you tomorrow, Commander!

sequence:
All-Love Assault!

<size=45>7. Another Day, Another Date</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Heheh☆ Good morning, Commander!
What? It's not even close to afternoon yet.
Besides, it's always morning until you've had breakfast!
Evening? Uh-oh, I think something's wrong with you. I'd better call Vestal right away...
"I was just joking to see how you'd react. Please put the phone down."
Alrighty then~ In that case, good evening to you too♪
Hey, did you dream of me last night? The look on your face says you did~
On that note, I have a small present for you~
"A present? What's the occasion?"
It's, uhh... You know! To celebrate our 100-day wedding anniversary!
"How nice."
That, and to commemorate all the sweet and love-packed memories we've made!
I'm not expecting anything, but I sure would love something in return~
Like a warm hug coupled with a loving kiss, for instance~
She's either thinking out loud, or hinting at what she's going to do next.
Commander! Eyes on me!
And don't think about shutting them! I want your full, undivided attention~
I turn to face her and realize she's standing right next to me. Her puckered lips graze my cheek.
*smooch*!
The warmth of a gentle kiss spreads through me.
Heheh☆ Gotcha! I'll make do with that for now~
Anyway, it's time we get to work!
...Hm? What's up, Commander? Waiting for something?
"You left me a bit stunned by changing gears just like that."
Well, what are we gonna do if not work? Unless... you wanna go on a date?
"I'm feeling a little light-headed. I can't exactly focus right now."
Oh no! You sound sick! We can't let you work like this!
Okay, forget about work, how about I take you to the infirmary?
"It doesn't seem like we have any other option."
Heheh☆ We're going on an infirmary date~ Come on, let's go♡

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>1 Indomitable's Plan</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Indomitable is sprawled on my office desk, lazily sliding her fingers across a tablet and occasionally humming cheerfully to herself.
As soon as she hears me put my pen down, she casually lifts her head and lets out a big yawn.
*yawn*... I presume you've finally finished your work.
Yup, this is a good stopping point for today.
I'm more or less finished with mine. I've come up with a date plan for tomorrow.
What about your actual work? Did you get it done?
I for one think that working out a date plan IS actual work.
Whatever you say...
Well? Care to take a look?
Sure. Work needs to be evaluated, after all.
I pick up the tablet in front of her and take a look at the plan she's put together.
Ride a tandem bike, have a picnic on a boat, visit the market in the park, eat a lavish dinner...
Well, it's certainly an achievable plan, I just don't think you, in particular, can make it happen.
Heehee. A fair assessment. I am indeed a lady who prefers more leisurely activities.
However, let's not forget I had to sell my body to you for this opportunity.
...All you did was sort paperwork. That's not what I'd call "selling your body to me!"
We all sell our bodies when we do labour, do we not? Never mind that – what matters is that I have ample energy to spend on a hard-earned date.
At least, I'm fairly sure I do...
Furthermore, this plan IS more on the laid-back side of things. Did you not notice the subtle brilliance of it?
Your date plan is just so succinct that I fail to see this "brilliance."
Simplicity is my style, don't you know?
It's brilliant because thinking drains you out, and you just chose some random activities instead – am I right?
How did you know that– I mean, no!
I considered each of these activities carefully!
So carefully, in fact, that I overworked my brain to the point of dizziness, as you can see...
Okay, so could you tell me your reasoning?
Take the boat picnic, for instance. I can simply order all the food in advance.
The only thing we have to do is enjoy the meal.
Fair enough. What about the rest?
Like riding the tandem bike. Don't get me wrong, I'm glad you picked something involving physical activity of your own accord...
It's just that I'm worried you'll get fed up with it.
You know me well, Commander.
You don't quite know EVERYTHING about me, however.
What do you mean?
Hmm... I can't be bothered to explain.
You'll understand what I mean when we get to it.
Let it be a surprise until then.
All in all, I think this date is an opportunity for us to get to know one another better.
What do you say? Will you go on a date with me?
Alright, I'm in. Sounds fun.
Wonderful! Look forward to it, Commander!
After exclaiming that with enthusiasm, she immediately sprawls out on the desk again.
Goodness me, that was a lot of talking.
I hope you don't mind if I rest for a while. Just a short while, I promise...

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>2 The Great Cycling</size>

scripts.say: Port Park - Artificial Lake
It's the morning of the next day, and Indomitable and I have come to the park while the sun isn't that harsh yet.
Mmhh. This truly is perfect weather. It's just right for leisurely activities.
Are we really going to bike around this lake? It's pretty big, you know.
Umm... Don't worry about that.
I chose the quickest and most scenic route, I assure you.
I can always count on you taking every measure to save energy.
Precisely. Now then, let's get on. This will take a bit of effort... Ahh...
Okay, now please get on the front seat and provide the propulsion.
I will sit in the back. I'll have you know, looking at the map and providing directions isn't effortless.
Can't you just use a map app? Or a GPS?
You can only take the standard route if you rely on satnav. There are many forks in the road in these parts.
It's best if I check the map manually and guide you along. Please have faith in me, Commander.
While it is a bother to use my brain, there's no other choice now that we're here.
Oh well. I'll take on this burden for you.
So if I got that right, you want me to pedal the bike while you just sit on it?
More specifically, I'll use my brain while you use your brawn.
It's exhausting, I know. For both of us.
In the end, I accept this arrangement and get on the tandem bicycle with her.
We slowly go down the bikeway along the lakeside. Sunlight shimmers on the water, its sparkling waves spreading outward.
Just continue straight down this road.
And after that?
After that? The path splits, so I'll think about it when we get there.
Now, I need to rest my eyes for a minute.
While this breeze is no doubt pleasant, it's drying out my eyes.
A while later, Indomitable has gone completely quiet.
Indomitable? You didn't doze off, did you?
Where do we go now?
Umm...
Were you spacing out on me again?
Uh, no, I was just recharging my batteries.
Pardon, what did you say?
I asked which of these paths to take.
Ahh, well...
The right one. Let's cross that bridge.
Didn't you say this would be a balance between hard work and relaxation? You've been doing nothing but the latter this whole time.
Heehee. That's precisely the sort of date I desired. It's a wonderful time.
Say, are you tired? Hmm... Above average body temperature. Excuse me while I just...
I feel a warmth coming from behind. She must be leaning against me, pressing her ear to my back.
Hmm. No, I don't hear a particularly intense heartbeat.
I suppose this level of exercise is a walk – or should I say, pedal – in the park for you.

options.content: What are you scheming this time?
That's thanks to the route you chose.

scripts.say: What? You can't be complimenting me like that for nothing.
I'll say this upfront – no amount of praise will make me go faster.
Heehee. Don't worry, this speed is more than adequate.
I will say, this Commander-brand propulsion system is very reliable.
The route you chose is the shortest one, so it's not very physically demanding.
R-really?
Then it was worth expending all that brainpower.
She giggles almost as though all the problems in the world have nothing to do with her.
I feel like I understand her carefree attitude towards life just a little more.

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>3 Mid-Trip Mistake</size>

scripts.say: Port Park - Artificial Lake
Ahh, this is so nice. I wish we could keep riding like this forever...
Wait a sec. This isn't right.
Spotting a flight of stairs ahead, I immediately pull on the brakes.
Owch... My nose...
In her careless relaxation, her face slams into my back due to our sudden stop.
My bad. You okay?
I'm alright... Why did you stop?
Because I think we're on the wrong path.
This one leads to a set of stairs. You didn't expect me to carry the tandem bike, did you?
What? Of course not...
Well, I propose that we go back the way we came.
Before anything else, let's see the map.
We hop off the bicycle and stand by the shoulder of the road, heads together as we check the map.
So many branching paths. How annoying...
It's clear we went the wrong way somewhere – but where?
Here? Or maybe here? It could even be...
She furrows her brow at the maze of winding routes depicted on the map.
At any rate, we're heading in the complete opposite direction to our destination.
We can either retrace our steps, or take a detour to get back on track. I think both are valid.
Yes, but that leaves the question of what route to take.
We need to pick the shortest, most effort-saving route out of all these...
Goodness, making decisions is so hard...
She looks at my face, and then suddenly takes my hand.
Commander, may I ask you to take care of the navigation?

options.content: You're asking a lot of me here.

scripts.say: I'll handle it no problem.
That is, if you're willing to cover for me as the... "propulsion system."
Navigating isn't hard by itself, but doing that and cycling at the same time is pretty tricky.
Do you think you could cover for me as the "propulsion system"?
Uhh, well...
I'm just pulling your leg.
We'll do it together.
I almost thought you were serious... You can be quite the joker sometimes.
Our next destination is the boat docks. Please make sure you take the closest route there.
Got it. I'll go with the shortest one so you won't wear yourself out.
And so, we both get back on the bicycle and go down the new route.
*pant*... *pant*... I'm really trying my best this time, Commander.
Gosh, I'm exhausted... Could we stop and take a break?
We haven't even gone a hundred meters yet.
Come on, keep going.
Very well... This was my mistake, after all...
This was supposed to be relaxing... Why do I have to strain myself?
Hearing her grumble under her breath, I can't help but crack a smile.
While this isn't the easygoing bike ride I initially imagined, it's a surprisingly good alternative.

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>4 Lunch on the Lake</size>

scripts.say: Port Park - Artificial Lake
Phew... We're finally here.
I feel like my legs aren't a part of me anymore...
After a strenuous bicycle ride, we've finally arrived at the boat docks.
A small sightseeing boat is already moored here, with soft cushions that create a cozy atmosphere.
There is also a table with juice, sandwiches, a salad, and fruits. It's the whole picnic shebang.
It's good I booked the boat and the lunch in advance.
The engine is electric as well. It won't require any input on our part.
I hope everything from this point on goes without a hitch, because I'd really like to rest now.
Well then, let's get on board.
We get on the boat and turn on the engine. The boat starts slowly heading for the center of the lake.
Our surroundings get quieter bit by bit. The water's surface is as still as a mirror, reflecting the swaying trees in the distance.
I much prefer my leisure time to be, well, leisurely like this.
Sitting in a comfortable boat, slowly savouring some lunch – this is life.
Now let's dig in, shall we?
Sure.
She sticks her fork into a strawberry, and then presents it to me.
Would you care for a bite?
Mmm... That's really sweet.
Yes! Mission complete: Feed the Commander. Now, could I ask you to do the same for me?
What, is it too much work to do it yourself?
Not quite... I simply wish to bond with you a little more. Yes, that is all.
With a shrug, I pick up a sandwich and bring it to her mouth. She takes a satisfied bite out of it.
You really are everything I could ask for.
Oh, hang on. I want to take another bite, so please keep holding it.
All of a sudden, the boat rocks, sending her straight towards me.
Eek...
You alright?
Heehee... I didn't expect it to feel so pleasant to be in your arms.
If you don't mind, please hold this pose. It'll make it easier to eat this way.
She mumbles as she pulls my hand towards her and takes another bite of the sandwich.
She doesn't want to leave my embrace.
Aren't you going to eat?

options.content: Only after you've had your fill.
I'm waiting for you to feed me.

scripts.say: You can have first dibs on anything you like.
Alright, if you're sure.
I'm not one to let such a luxurious occasion to go waste, so I'll help myself, if you don't mind.
You haven't returned the favor for those sandwich bites yet.
What? You are?
In that case, please open wide... I'll need a good rest after this – eating takes quite a bit of energy, after all.

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>5 In the Same Boat</size>

scripts.say: Port Park - Artificial Lake
After lunch, we're just drifting on the lake. The warm sun's rays tempt me to take a nap.
Whew... This is the ideal way to rest.
Sure is. It's nice to get away from everything and just relax sometimes.
After gazing vacantly at the lake's scenery for a while, I suddenly realize that Indomitable has fallen asleep.
Indomitable?
As she rests on my shoulder, her breathing is soft and steady. She has completely tuned out her surroundings.
That morning cycling we did must've really tired her out.
No harm in letting her sleep for a bit, I suppose.
My eyelids similarly start feeling heavy. It's not long before I doze off, leaning against her just as she does against me.
I'm not sure how long I was asleep for, but when I wake up, the electric motor lets out one last sigh before the boat loses all propulsion.
*yawn*... That was a lovely nap.
Commander? Did you fall asleep, too?
Mgh... Looks like it.
Uh-oh... We have a problem. The engine has stopped!
Let me see...
Bad news. The battery is dead.
There's good news too, though. This boat can also be powered by pedalling.
P-pedalling?
Err... My feet feel a bit sore, so...
You tell me where to go, and I'll be the "propulsion system" again.
I don't think you need directions on a lake.
You're assuming I'm going to slack off again, aren't you?
If we work together, just like on the bike, we'll reach the shore in no time.
Well, if you insist...
*sigh*... Very well. I'll do my best to help.
It has to be done. We're in the same boat here. Literally.
The pedals under our feet cry out with a creak as she and I work together to move towards the shore.
What a bother... Next time, I'll double-check the battery before we set out...
No, forget that – there will be no next time!
Going outside isn't my style. I'd much rather stay indoors, sip some tea, and admire the flowers...
It's hard to deny this wasn't a flawless plan, but I've had and still am having fun doing this with you.
Why, that's... You really know what to say, Commander.
Are you trying to make me forget my fatigue with some sweet talk?
If it's working, sure.
After pedalling for a while, as we fall into a steady rhythm together, it dawns on me that we've made quite a bit of progress.
I'm knackered... Are we there yet, Commander?
Take a look. The shore is right over there.
Is it? It still looks so far away to me...
That said, suddenly I feel like I wouldn't mind simply floating on this lake with you forever...

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>6 Surprising Decision</size>

scripts.say: Port Park - Artificial Lake
At last, we've reached the shore...
We're going to the park market next, right?
Huh? We don't need to stick to the plan that strictly.
I think we should, umm, squeeze in a break right here...
Then let's head to the market and find a place to relax. Better than standing in the wind out here.
Alright. May I ask you to lead the way, then?
Sure – but why are you walking so slowly?
Because even convincing myself to move takes quite a lot of effort... Please don't tease me.
Her tone spells it out clear as day: "I don't want to move another inch." This is in spite of the fact that this whole outing was her idea.
I'll go on ahead. Just follow me at a comfortable pace.
The map says the market should be pretty close.
...And by that I mean we're already here.
Come again? This is the market?
It's quite a lot smaller than I had imagined.
Yep. There are two or three stalls and that's it.
A handful of simple stalls line the sides of the road, and there's not an iota of liveliness in the air.
Oh well – I wasn't expecting much in the first place.
This isn't all that bad, really. We can tour the entire market in just a few steps.
Is it just me, or do you sound relieved?
Ah, look, there's a bench over there. Let's have a seat, Commander!
Ahh... Finally, a place to rest my feet...
Can I ask what's next on the itinerary?
Well, the plan was to have a lavish dinner after we'd toured all the stalls.
It's a little bit early for dinner, methinks.
True. I'm not even hungry, for that matter.
Furthermore, a lavish dinner means sitting for a long time... Just thinking about it makes me feel knackered.

options.content: How about a walk around the park?
Wanna go back to the port?

scripts.say: How about a walk around the park? That should get your blood pumping.
A bloody walk?!
Ahem... I can't move one more step...
We can always head back to the port for a bit if you want.
Ah, yes... I'll admit I'm pining for the comfort of my own bed.
The issue with that, however, is that we'd need to go outside come dinnertime, wouldn't we?
What to do, what to do...
All the cells in my body have gone on strike – I can't even think properly anymore...
She leans in and rests her head on my shoulder.
I'll think about it after a quick rest.
There IS the option of returning to the port and just not going out again.
We can order takeout to the room. Doesn't that sound much better?
Her expression relaxes in the blink of an eye. My idea must sound like a godsend to her.
Yes, let's do that!
I can always count on you to make a swift decision.
Despite the enthusiasm in her voice, she's still leaning against me and doesn't seem inclined in the least to get up.
I really can't walk another step... Ugh...
Please, Commander, carry me back home...

sequence:
Ineffective Energy Saving

<size=45>7 Indomitable to the End</size>

scripts.say: One long and eventful journey later, Indomitable and I are finally back in my office. She flops down on the couch, looking somewhat bummed out.
She rubs her forehead with both hands, trying to relieve the fatigue from today's outing.
*sigh*... This plan was a bit of a failure, it seems.
I thought it would be relaxing and low-effort, only to end up drained of all energy.
My head, my arms, my feet – they all hurt... Ow...
Want me to give you a massage?
I... see no reason to refuse. Yes, please.
She puts her legs in my lap. I start massaging her calves, applying a modest amount of pressure.
Ohh yes... This is divine.
Forgive me for making you take care of me like this, Commander...
She slowly withdraws her legs, changes her position, then casually takes my hand and places it on her shoulder.
Could you massage these as well?
Ahh... Yes, that's it...
That feels so good...
After massaging her for a while, she finally regains enough energy to talk.
It goes without stating that I love spending time with you.
It's just... ideally, spending time with you would involve no physical activity.
A lot of things didn't go as expected, but in the end, it was a ton of fun.
She responds with a small nod and closes her eyes, relishing the pleasure of the massage.
Geesh, you really are exhausted.
Yes, and that's why this was a failure...
Come to think of it, aren't you an expert at making plans?
Bugger... I should've let you handle it all along.
While it's too late now, you can still plan for the next time.
Coming closer, she all but embraces me. It's obvious she's trying to coax me, and yet, it's almost impossible to refuse.

options.content: Alright. I'll come up with a relaxing plan.
Alright. I'll come up with a hellish plan.

scripts.say: Sure, you won't have to exert yourself in the slightest next time.
That's what I like to hear. You know me well, Commander.
Alright. I'll make a training regimen we can both keep up with so you can work on your stamina.
You should be able to handle such a regimen by yourself, no? I shall be your coach, offering you advice from the comfort of a sofa.
At any rate, that's for another time. More immediately – what do you want to eat?
Must I exert my brain again? Ugh...
With a languid motion, she moves her body and mutters a response.
Seeing as you'll be devising the plans for next time, why not get into the planning mindset with this?
Which is to say... I leave the dinner menu up to you.
Don't worry, I don't have any requirements. Please just choose whatever you like.
You're kind of pushing all the work onto me.
I'm simply saying that the more capable one between us should take on more responsibilities.
As thanks for your hard work, I'll return this gesture and give you a massage now.
She calls it a "massage," but really, she's just lackadaisically kneading my body with her fingers.
Does it feel good?
Umm...
You know, you're always so reliable, and that puts everyone around you at ease.
So I entrust you to... take care of all the rest... Zzz...
She dozes off right in the middle of the conversation, leaning softly against me with her hand still resting on my chest.
In the warmth of this moment, all the physical stress of the day turns into a gentle tranquility.

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 1: Ice-Cold Shiranui</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Ever since I let Shiranui become my secretary ship, I always feel like my mental fortitude is being exercised to its limit.
Am I supposed to say "long time no see?"
What a dullard, wasting precious resources on me again...
If you wanted to be treated coldly so much, you might as well have just stood in the refrigerator, you moron.
I've waited a whole minute and you still haven't noticed that your commissions have returned. Commander, without me, you're just a washed-up lump of driftwood after all.
... these are just a few examples. On top of that, her expression - as cold and impassive as an iceberg - really makes one feel like even breathing is a mistake.
And if dealing with her at the office was hard enough, when I arrived at the store...
Port - Supply Shop
The next tech box will surely have something good...
Discount? There's no such thing...
Commander, if your luck is bad, you have to make up for it with quantity. Believe yourself. You can do it.
... Wait a second, this isn't the important part.
The important thing is that even in the store, where the customer is king, she still acts this way?
One really can't help but to wonder, is Shiranui only capable of making this expression?
And what's more, how did Shiranui manage to become the head of this store?
In order to solve these two mysteries, a little investigation is needed...

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 2: Daily Life of a Shopkeeper</size>

scripts.say: Port - Supply Shop
On my day off, I decided to hide in the bushes next to the shop to see just what was going on.
Shiranui, did the package I asked you for arrive yet?
Not yet, but I will deliver it to you myself once I get it.
All right, thanks. As usual, keep it on the down low, okay?
I know. Although sooner or later... no, someone surely has discovered your "secret" by now.
You sure don't hold any punches with your straightforwardness... Oh well, I'm counting on you again.
Mhm.
Shiranui, I see you're still holding down this shabby fort like always.
I see you're still running your mouth like always.
You're one to talk~
H-Hatsushimo, don't talk like that...
It's totally fine, Hatsuharu, getting into a spat is just the daily routine for these two.
Don't make it sound like we get along...
Having said all that, since you're already here, might as well come in and take a look.
Phew, after that... let me check on the status of Kuroshio's ninja equipment and Oyashio's doll supplies.
That's right, the new fabrics that Urakaze asked for should be here in about two days.
...From an observer's standpoint, one has to admit that Shiranui is a pretty diligent shopkeeper.

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Shopkeeper's Little Buddies</size>

scripts.say: Port - Supply Shop
On this day off, I once again concealed myself next to the shop, quietly observing the situation.
Please,  Shiranui, just think about the deep bond we used to share, and let me interview you!
I don't remember ever doing anything with you that would resemble a "deep bond."
Unapproachable and mysterious, the ghostly owner of the Supply Shop- this interview is gonna sell like hotcakes!
If you used your segment to promote my shop, I might consider it.
No problem! Let's get started right away!
First and foremost, those disheveled animal ears on your head! Is it true that the ghosts make you wear them like that?
... I bumped them a few times while organizing things. I thought it'd be a waste to replace them, so I didn't bother getting them fixed.
Uhh... the rumor that you're actually a ghost... Is it true?
Are you an idiot?
What about that will-o'-wisp circling you?!
That's just a floating prop that I got from Akashi because it looked cool.
Th-then... the rumor that you can see ghosts as well...?
I suppose that does happen every now and then.
Ah, so that's also a fabrica-
Ehhh??? It's true?!
It's true. For example, there's one crawling up your back right now...
Waaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!
Of course, that's just a lie...
However, our very existence already defies the laws of science. It shouldn't be strange at all to see strange things.
Today, I feel like I learned a bit more about another side of Shiranui.
However, I feel like she just shot a glance over here. It's just my imagination... right?

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 4: An Encounter at the Store?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Supply Shop
On this day off, I once again concealed myself next to the shop, quietly observing the situation.
Shiranui Nyaa~~!!!
BAAANG!! I heard the sound of someone crashing into a wall.
Uuuughh... that was cruel, Nyaa.... Why did you have to dodge away from Akashi?
Because when this dumb cat seeks me out voluntarily, it's never to bring good news.
I thought we were good friends Nyaa~~!
That's news to me.
Shiranui is the same as always, Nyaa. You should learn a thing or two from Akashi, full of vigor every day Nyaa!
I'll pass. Anyway, what's the matter?
It's about the new promotion plan, Nyaa!
No good news after all. Every time this dumb cat pushes her promotion plans, something weird always ends up happening. Don't drag me into this.
But it's different this time. It's going to be comprehensive, Nyaa!
Look, I'm not in-
Shiranui, please help me, just this time Nyaa! Akashi will definitely repay you!
Stop clinging to me... this dumb cat better let go...
I won't let go until you say yes!
Fine, fine.. I'll fund you!
That's great, Nyaa! Here is the business proposal. Akashi will go ahead and make preparations, Nyaa!
After Akashi leaves, Shiranui skims through the business proposal.
*sigh*... Once again, it's full of errors and loopholes. Looks like I'll have to help that dumb cat wipe her own butt again.
Despite her grumbling, Shiranui picked up the pen and started making corrections on the document dutifully.
It seems that I've been able to learn a bit more about Shiranui.

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 5: The Shopkeeper's Abnormality</size>

scripts.say: On this day of rest, I found myself headed to the bushes outside the store as always, with plans to observe Shiranui.
... Eh? As always? Come to think of it, I've been observing Shiranui for quite some time now.
Although she wears the same aloof expression both during work and during her everyday life,  her behavior shows that she is certainly not some callous ice queen.
However... ...
Commander, just what are you doing camping out in those bushes? Should I trim them to make them more accomodating for you?
Well, since Shiranui seems to have found me, there's no point staying hidden.

options.content: Ask about when she found out

scripts.say: From the very beginning. Since you weren't getting in the way of business, how you choose to spend your time off is your own prerogative. It's up to you, Commander.
However, for you to come every single weekend...wouldn't any normal person start to believe that you have some loose screws?
Looking at things from her perspective, she certainly has a point!
So, Commander, tell me what are you looking at?

options.content: Express your desire to understand Shiranui better

scripts.say: ... You're an idiot after all. If you wanted to know, you could have just asked me directly.
If I did that, I would have just been treated like an idiot! Although this...
Huh...? There's no need for that. Commander surely has other responsibilities, so I can handle things here by myself.
That's right. Shiranui always knows how to handle things well without anybody else's help.
She never seems to need to rely on anyone, always managing all aspects of the store by herself as if it was second nature. However...
Commander, don't just stand there like an idiot. If you have time to burn...
Before she could finish her words, Shiranui's body began to sway, as if she was about to collapse.
Don't worry, I just got a little dizzy...
You should pay Akashi a visit anyway.

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 6: The Shopkeeper's True Feelings (Pt 1)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Infirmary
At the infirmary, Shiranui is quietly lying on a sickbed.
It's overwork, Nyaa.
Sure enough...
It would seem that having to serve as secretary while also running the store has caused her to accumulate a lot of stress, Nyaa.
If only I had noticed sooner...
Commander, you don't need to blame yourself Nyaa. This is just Shiranui's personality, she does everything meticulously and never asks for help from anyone.
Even Akashi never noticed how burnt out she was, Nyaa. Her expression didn't change at all...
Pipe down, dumb cat.
Patients should just quietly lie there and rest. Shiranui is way too stubborn, Nyaa!
... I'm not trying to be stubborn, I just...
I'm used to having to do things all alone.
The Shiranui that sat up from the sickbed still wore the same expression as ever but, compared to usual, seemed a lot more vulnerable.
What a troublesome fellow, Nyaa...
You're the last one I want to hear that from.
I was relieved to see that Shiranui was fine, but it was clear that things could not continue like this.

options.content: Suggest that Shiranui should focus on one thing first

scripts.say: Hmm. I'm not sure that's going to work.
Eh? Even Akashi is opposed to that idea?
*sigh* ... This person sure is dense.

sequence:
Shiranui, the Do-It-All Shopkeeper

<size=45>Chapter 7: The Shopkeeper's True Feelings (Pt 2)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Infirmary
You'll understand if you think about it a little, Nyaa~
Whether it's Akashi's store or Shiranui's store, Commander still has to pay for everything out of pocket even though all the wares are supplied by the military, Nyaa.
However, these will all eventually turn into resources used to build up the fleet, Nyaa.
For Akashi and Shiranui, working at the store is also for the sake of helping out Commander! That's why Shiranui is capable of working so hard,Nyaa!
Loose lips sink ships, dumb cat.
And although she won't admit it, Shiranui is very happy to have been chosen for secretary, Nyaa!
So for her, she would never be able to give up one or the other, Nyaa~
Because both are for the sake of her beloved Commander, Nyaa!
This dumb cat seems to be itching for a beating today...
Nyaa~ ha ha, that's all Akashi has to say for today! Commander, the rest is up to you, nya!
The room suddenly fell into an awkward silence.
... Commander, you shouldn't dwell too much on what that dumb cat said. It's best if I handle things by myself.
I already told you, it's fine...
... I'm only doing what I ought to be doing...

options.content: Promise that you'll definitely help out in the future

scripts.say: ... ... ... ... ... *sigh* What an idiot. Whatever... do as you please...
It's because you do stuff like this... I couldn't help but to... ...
Shiranui, sitting atop the sickbed, let out a sigh. However, ever so faintly, the corners of her lips seemed to curl upwards.
Looking back, this was the first time I had ever seen her smile.

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 1: Be Careful What You Wish For</size>

scripts.say: My name is Souryuu. Commander, from now on, please request my permission in writing before doing anything weird.
Ever since we first met, I've always been drawn to her cold, dignified seriousness.
Thinking that she might be able to help increase my work efficiency, I appointed her as my secretary to see how things would go...
Port - Office
That morning, when I arrived at the office...
Good morning, Commander. I have already sorted all your documents, so please begin reviewing them.
Right away, I knew she had no intent on showing me any mercy...

options.content: Try to strike up some small talk with Souryuu.

scripts.say: Commander, please refrain from idle chatter while you're working. There's a lot to get through today.
I was rebuked coldly.
... I'm getting a bit tired. Maybe it's time to take a break...
Commander, all my planes have already locked onto you.
During work hours, please make sure that you're actually working.
I heard the churning engines of aircraft circling above my head... How terrifying...
My attempts to strike up friendly conversation with Souryuu had backfired spectacularly.
Nevertheless, under her watchful eye, my productivity had undeniably skyrocketed.
Would I be able to convince her to be a little more easygoing if we were on better terms?
Commander, surely you aren't daydreaming about weird things while pretending to read your documents?
... I guess I have no choice but to focus on the work in front of me first.

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 2: Instruct Me, Souryuu!</size>

scripts.say: I heard that Souryuu's hobby was playing hanafuda, so I decided to learn it as a way of finding some common ground with her.
Port - Sakura Dorms
... Today, we'll be going over the Battle of Okehazama.
Hmm... At last, the great battle that led to the country's unification!
At that time, the Imagawa clan had a numbers advantage... Oh my, Commander. What brings you here?
Isn't it obvious? It's a history lesson!
Indeed. Urakaze wants to deepen her understanding of the Sengoku period, so I'm giving her a lesson.
Commander, you're welcome to join if you're interested.
I suppose it wouldn't hurt to listen.
... Nobody could have foreseen that Imagawa Yoshimoto would be slain by Nobunaga's attack.
In the aftermath of the battle, the Oda clan...
... All right, that concludes today's lesson.
Amazing... Souryuu's lesson was informative, but also very easy to follow.
Hm, hm... I see! Thank you very much, teacher!
Teach us something else next!
Of course. It would be my pleasure.
Something else...? I was beginning to think that Souryuu knew everything...
Commander, your thoughts are written all over your face... This is simply part of a secretary's duties.
Now, did you need something?
You want to learn hanafuda? Why the sudden interest...?
However, if you are genuinely interested in learning, I wouldn't mind teaching you...
And thus, I began to learn hanafuda from Souryuu.

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 3: What are Friends?</size>

scripts.say: As a natural result of having her teach me hanafuda, I found more and more time to converse with Souryuu.
I decided to head over to her place again today.
Sakura Dorms - Souryuu's Room
Why'd you come here by yourself, Z23? Aren't you usually always with your friends?
Ahaha... I wouldn't say "always." Even I need some time for myself now and then.
And even though we're good friends, we sometimes get on each others' nerves.
You have a point. I imagine it can be hard to deal with Ayanami and Laffey since they like to do things at their own pace.
Ah, um, it's not that bad. Compared to us, I'd say that the Sakura carriers have more than their fair share of... strong personalities.
You don't have to pull your punches. *sigh*... We definitely do have a handful of oddballs...
Ahaha... I feel like we have a lot of common ground. Don't you ever get tired of dealing with the others?
I wouldn't say I get tired, but... Kaga's obsessed with combat, and let's not talk about Akagi...
Shoukaku won't stop poking and prodding at Akagi, and Zuikaku is a bit like my sister. Way too much energy.
*sigh*... Sometimes, I wonder if my reputation as a workaholic resulted from having to clean up after them...
Ahaha...
You know what they say, "you don't get to choose your own family." But, looking back, I don't think I'd want it any other way.
I totally get it, "we're friends after all!" "Who the hell are you calling your friend?!" That kind of dynamic!
I think it's a bit different for us. I wouldn't even say that we're "friends."
But, there is a deeper bond connecting all of us.
A relationship that can't be described by words... That sounds a bit enviable when you put it that way.
I'm also a bit jealous of you and your friends. Hehe.
But more importantly... Commander, didn't anyone ever teach you that it's rude to eavesdrop?
Ah... Good morning, Commander!
Good grief... But since you're already here, we might as well chat for a bit.
Time flew as the three of us chatted the day away.

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 4: Unnecessary Things...?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Dorms
On my day off, I once again found myself headed for Souryuu's room, looking to relax and recover.
Did you need to see my sister?
Commander, though you're free to spend your day off however you please, I'd recommend you do something more worthwhile.
As she spoke, she was still working on documents that she had brought back from the office yesterday. Truly a model secretary.
*sigh*...
I wonder when I'll be able to help the Commander like this...
If that's what you really want, you'd better start studying harder from now on.
That's not what I meant... When you're working hard like this, you look really beautiful. Don't you think so too, Commander?
*sigh*... What are you talking about? There's nothing beautiful about this.?
Err, I dunno, I'm not so great with words... but Akagi said something about "a woman's allure?"
Listen, Hiryuu. This is simply what is expected of every member of the fleet. My relationship with the Commander has nothing to do with this.
This has nothing to do with a "woman's allure" or that "girlishness" thing that you're always talking about, understood?
Wow... Souryuu was being colder than usual.
Well, isn't there something that you'd want to do to improve your girlishness?
What are you... why in the world would I want to do something like that?
Ah, um, hear me out! I really think you're beautiful, Souryuu, and that includes when you're being cold too. However, I sometimes want to see more aspects of your personality!
*sigh*...
But... Hmm. There just might be a way to get me to change.
Eh? Really?!
I wonder, what should I do...
Was it just my imagination, or did Souryuu just steal a sideways glance at me?

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Change (Pt. 1)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Recently, I feel like I've been able to talk to Souryuu about more and more things.
Of course, she was no less strict during work hours.
Commander, please do your work properly. Don't develop any strange ideas.
However...
Commander, regarding the next naval exercise...
You're entrusting the dive bomber training to me? Very well, no objections here. I'll sort out the other details as well.
As much as I greatly appreciated Souryuu's assistance...
This is your itinerary for the day. Please look over it.
It felt like I'd taken after her too much and started overworking myself.
I knew you had it in you, Commander. Look what you've been able to accomplish with some focus and hard work.
Of course, her praise quickly washed away any fatigue I otherwise might have felt.
Com...
Though at first I only wanted to improve our relationship so she wouldn't be so strict...
Before I knew it, I was starting to become a workaholic just like her.
Comman...
I guess that's not such a bad thing though...
Commander!
Good grief, you should stop daydreaming like that.
I could hardly believe my ears when I heard what Souryuu said next.
By the way, would you like to go on a date this upcoming weekend?

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 6: Change (Pt. 2)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Plaza
My apologies, Commander. I didn't keep you waiting, did I?
I wasn't quite sure what happened, but somehow I ended up on a date(?) with Souryuu.
This is my first time going out like this, so I'm not sure what we should do...
But, I've already picked out some spots to go to based upon your preferences.
It almost felt as if Souryuu was going to take me on a guided tour.
Shall we get going?
Akashi, here's what we'd like to buy. Shiranui, would you mind bagging everything for us?
Sure...
Thank you for your patronyage. H-hope to see you next time, nya...?
We walked out of the shop with two incredulous gazes following us the entire time.
S-Souryuu?! Is that you...?!
Good day, Hiryuu. Is something the matter?
Ah, um, I'm fine. Souryuu, you're...
Indeed. I'm planning to head into town with Commander.
I-I see...
I can understand why everyone might be a bit bewildered... After all, Souryuu has had her arm entwined around mine ever since we left.
I apologize for dumping dinner duties on you like this, Hiei.
Don't worry about me. Just have a good time together, you two.
Hiei slipped out of the room with a knowing grin on her face.
Commander, have you been enjoying today's date so far?
Hehe... I'm glad.
But now I wondered... why did she even ask me out in the first place?

sequence:
Together with Souryuu

<size=45>Chapter 7: Change (Pt. 3)</size>

scripts.say: Everyone was staring at us incredulously the whole day.
It's true. Pretty much everyone who saw us today ended up with bewildered expressions on their faces.
Well, the only "me" people expect is the stolid Souryuu that pushes you to work harder.
Of course it'd be hard for them to imagine me smiling happily while on a date.
Naturally, those kinds of assumptions are incorrect.
Souryuu adjusted her glasses and looked my way.
Commander, you've matured into someone who no longer needs my supervision.
Someone who chose to invest their precious time into me so that we could have a shared hobby...
For me to go on a date or two with that person, or even fall in love with that person, is perfectly normal, isn't it?
Despite her tremendously assertive confession, Souryuu did not appear flustered in the slightest.
Commander, do you still remember what Hiryuu and I talked about a while ago?
The person who I want to change for... the person who I want to become "girlier" for... is you.
I had assumed that I was getting used to following her lead, but it turns out that I had been influencing her as well.
By the way, Commander, what do you think about me?
My feelings for Souryuu obviously needed no words. But at this crucial moment, when I opened my mouth...
... Pfft...
I see. How very much like you, Commander. Very well, since we began with hanafuda, it makes sense for us to communicate through hanafuda.
If you can beat me even once, I'll tell you anything you want to know.

sequence: In a place unknown, shrouded in darkness...
In a place that makes no sound, wrapped in silence...

scripts.say: Mgh... Mmgh...
Oh, you're finally awake. You were out for a long while, sleepyhead.
I was starting to worry you'd given up the ghost. Seems I won't need to arrange a funeral.
Where... am I...?
Heheh. You're in my secret room, and I invited you here.
...Who are you?
What a boring question. Here I thought you'd ask something more... pertinent.
Like, "Am I dead?!" for a start.
I'm afraid I know my state of being quite well. What I need to know at this moment is where I am, and also...
Just who and what are you?
Heheheh. So calm and composed. But you're bluffing, aren't you? I do like a bluff.
But your elevated heart rate isn't doing a good job of selling it.
Anyway, you're asking who I am? Frankly, I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't concern yourself with that.
Explaining everything would be a huge hassle, you see.
You don't like being kept in the dark, I'm sure, but I'd like you to forget about that and assist with my research for a while.
I'll let you go home once I'm happy with the results. That is, assuming you play nice. Otherwise, maybe I won't.
You don't trust me? Yes, that's only natural...
However, whether you trust me or not doesn't change your situation one bit.
Let me guess. You think you've pieced the answer together now, no?
Then let me apologize and leave you with this – take your time and enjoy yourself.
What in the world is going on?
I wonder where the girls are... I hope they're safe.
Heheheh. These values are more interesting than I projected. This will be fun.

sequence: <size=34>Shinobis – they were shadows who lived long ago during the Warring States era.</size>
<size=34>They hid among crowds, they snooped, provoked, deceived, and assassinated.</size>
<size=34>Where there was dirty work, there were shinobis to undertake it.</size>
<size=34>As time went on, they disappeared from the public consciousness, becoming little more than legends.</size>
<size=34>But, though the people had forgotten them, the nature of man was still what it was.</size>
<size=34>Those who lived in the dark underworld were still needed.</size>
<size=34>Shinobis have continued to exist to this day.</size>
<size=34>And here, in a faraway land, a battle of theirs was beginning to unfold...</size>

scripts.say: Mirror Sea - Somewhere else
There, in a place no one knows, the captive princess stood all by herself.
...How long has it been since then?
Would you like to know?
*gasp*! How long have you been here?
Three seconds or so. I'm giving you the cold shoulder here, mind you.
I only thought you, our esteemed guest, may have wanted some quiet time to yourself.
I've been consciously leaving you alone as a courtesy. Although, you probably don't believe me when I say that.
Do you... WANT me to believe you?
Hmm... If I'm to be frank, I don't care either way if you believe me or not.
What I DO care about is seeing how your attitude changes depending on whether you do or don't. It's interesting.
If you'd like, shall we have a tea party? It'll be an opportunity for you to speak with me at length.
I'll pass, thank you. The idea of letting you get even a crumb of information out of me makes my skin crawl.
How harsh. At the same time, you're trying to get a reaction out of me to gauge information from it.
If I had to describe your attempt with one word, it would be "adorable."
Heheh. Don't scowl like that... I have so much to tell you. Don't you want to know how your friends are doing?
Ugh...
Heheheheh! I adore it when your weakness peeks through the cracks like this.
So desperately trying to keep your emotions in the bottle. That's also adorable.
Unfortunately, all I have to share is that your friends are doing all they can to get the situation under control.
Oh, but they did make some trusty allies, so there's that.
I'm sure they'll overcome all the challenges and come and rescue you.
It's a shame the ultimate challenge they have to face is me. How cruel the world can be.
In my case, I'll be happy as long as they kick and scream nicely...
That's what makes you happy?
Oops, I might have let something slip there. Be nice and forget you heard that.
What matters is this – everyone is safe and sound. You have nothing to worry about for now.
Also, I'm lucky someone from your world held the key to the gateway. It saved me a lot of time and effort.
What? Key? Gateway? Oh... You exploited my powers to cross world boundaries. That's what you're saying, isn't it?
Ah, you're sharper than you let on. I need to watch my mouth in the future. Heheh...
Look at that. It seems things have changed whilst you and I have been chatting.
It's looking like your friends will end up right where I want them, even without any advice on your part.
So, stay here and take it easy for a while.
If you need anything, don't be afraid to let me know. I'll get it for you as soon as possible.
I do expect you to lend an ear to my chitchat in return, however.
Alright, see you later.
My gut feeling was right. My powers were the catalyst behind this incident...
I need to escape this place immediately and link up with the girls. My conscience won't let me rest until I apologize.
The problem is, all my ninjutsu seems to have no effect here. I need to think of another way...
No, it's not that it's ineffective, per se – it feels more like my energy is being sapped. Brute-forcing it isn't going to work.
If my powers warrant being actively suppressed, that must mean they are the trump card to put a stop to all this.
If that's the case, I need to wait for the right time. The time to strike. That's when I'll act swiftly...
Heheh. She's taken the bait.
With people like her, you just need to drip-feed a little information and they'll fill in the gaps in your plan. Easily exploitable, in that way.
Oh, I look forward to seeing what experiments can be done using her powers.
Mirror Sea - Outside the castle gates
I'm detecting wakes at two o'clock. Looks like Iron Blood, Eagle Union... and some girls with riggings who the database doesn't recognise.
Maybe it's Reno's team?
Too many to be them. I'll grant you, it's possible they've grouped up with some of Asuka's friends.
Occam's razor argues that it's a Siren fleet containing Pawns, however.
Regardless, let's advance cautiously. Whatever happens, we can respond accordingly.
"Pawns"? What are those?
Simply put, they're clones of us shipgirls that the Sirens made.
The Sirens have already caught sight of you and your friends, so I wouldn't be shocked to see Pawns of them as well.
What?! I, for one, would be VERY shocked!
God's sake, Asuka. Do you always get shocked by transformation ninjutsu, too? Actually, you probably do.
Contact with target fleet imminent. Be careful.
Remember what we just told you, aight? Doesn't matter if they look exactly like your friends – you can't be sure if they're the real deal or not!
Oh! Hey, Yumi!
Asuka! I mean... That IS you, right?
Well, yeah. Asuka, second-year student at Hanzō Academy. Something the matter?
No, never mind. You got transported here just as I did, I assume?
To this world? Yup, I did. Ikaruga and Homura, too! And Fubuki, but she's... well...
Yes... I sensed as much. She was there with you for at least a while, wasn't she?
She was, but then there was this blinding light, and all of a sudden she was gone.
A ball of light appeared in her place, and it took off like a rocket.
So that's what happened... The ball of light then traveled towards the castle over there, yes?
Yup! I'm impressed but not surprised you've figured it out already!
Only because I can sense her presence.
Doesn't sound like Asuka is the least bit wary.
That's very on-brand for her...
At least we're all in one place now! I'm glad we found not just Akatsuki, but all the rest of you as well.
You shouldn't have needed to find me at all... I am ashamed.
...So, in short, I went to inspect the meteor's impact site, and that's when I found those three lying on the ground.
Well, we didn't hear any report 'bout a falling star... You musta already entered the Mirror Sea when that happened.
You were stargazing and forgot about your regular report, didn't you?
Err... It pains me to admit, but yes.
On the bright side, we sprung into action quicker as a result. All's well that ends well.
Sounds like the Sirens created this Mirror Sea expressly to transport you here. The question is – why YOU, specifically?
I don't have the faintest idea. It's not like we have magic powers or anything like that...
Not us, no, but perhaps someone we know. Remember how it went with the yōma?
Looking at it that way, magic proficiency may have something to do with Fubuki's kidnapping. They must have had a reason to take her.
Fubuki? Whozzat?
Let me explain...
The power to create doors between worlds... Yes, that would be a very attractive ability to the Sirens.
The Sirens would without a doubt want to get their hands on her if she really does have that power.
So, basically, if we rescue this Fubuki girl, this whole thing'll more or less be done and dusted, yeah?
The Sirens are basically shouting, "Our plan revolves around her!"
Then we know what to do! Before anything else, we've gotta rescue Fubuki! And to do that...
We'll surmount this wall and get inside the castle!
I just... know it. I can sense that she's inside the castle.
Mirror Sea - Stormy Akashi Castle Outer Area
RUMBLE... RUMBLE...
