That was simple... Thought it'd be a pain in the ass to get the gates open.
Not just simple, they opened on their own! What kind of castle is THIS easily breached?
When I think of a castle's gates, I picture a sturdy barrier able to hold back an army...
You can't think like that. The Sirens don't operate on common sense.
They're probably going for form over function here or somethin' to that tune.
I say we should just be happy we didn't need to waste any energy getting inside.
Well, onwards and upwards! Follow me!
Hold your horses, Asuka! Let's exercise at least a little caution...
FWOOSH!
Oh! This feeling again... Fubuki?!
KABOOOM!
Huh? Was that an explosion?! Where did it come from? ...Hey! There's smoke rising from the keep!
Somebody's already attacking? And it's not any of us? That can't be right...
Either something happened to Fubuki, or she took matters into her own hands.
One thing I know about her is that she's no pushover! She's resisting the Sirens! We've got to hurry and help her!
Hang in there, Fubuki! We're coming for you!
BZZT! BZZT!
What's this? It looks like there are three doors. There is also a sign of some kind.
Let's see here...
"Past these doors, complete all trials three. Succeed and the path will open for thee."
Looks like... we have a quest on our hands.
Uh, yeah. Odd time for it, but I assume we don't have a choice...
Mirror Sea - The Trial Doors
The sign says "trials," so I bet there'll be tons of trap doors and pressure plates and stuff past this point.
What do you all think? Should we just pick a door and bullrush it?
It said to, "Complete all trials three." Don't we need to reach the end or destroy what's past each door?
Guess all of us charging in isn't gonna work... Dammit, why's it always gotta be so complicated?
Coming up with busy work is the Sirens' favorite pastime. I wish they'd stop wasting all our time.
There's no rhyme or reason to what they do... 'Least, I can't find any.
No matter! We need not understand to be victorious, only achieve the end goal!
Considering the circumstances, we don't have the time to go through each door as one big group.
Though it's not ideal, I believe we should split up and strive to complete all three trials simultaneously.
Agreed. This may be a race against the clock for all we know, meaning we have precious little time to waste.
Splitting into three groups and doing all the challenges at once seems to be the only choice.
Before we go, there's one thing I'd like to mention...
Judging by the castle's design, I expect what we'll find beyond these doors are traps and the so-called Pawns made in our image.
If that is all, we shinobis can deal with those. The Sirens themselves are a different subject, however.
We know next to nothing about their habits, techniques, and tactics, whilst you are much more familiar with them.
So, wouldn't it be best to have you accompany each of our teams? By splitting the team members evenly, I mean.
Hey, yeah! Good idea!
Mirror Sea - The First Door
We have decided that the team for this door will consist of me, Homura, Akatsuki, and Reno.
CLAP CLAP CLAP!
That being said, there is no foretelling how practical our shinobi skills will be if it comes to a battle with the Sirens.
Moreover, our rigging proficiency is lacking as we've only grasped the basics of handling them.
Which is to say, we will likely be wholly reliant on Akatsuki and Reno in the event of combat.
Kindly bear with us. I will try my best to not weigh you down.
Please, there is no need to be so humble!
You stand shoulder to shoulder with us, as shown by the various ninjutsu, advanced skills, and combat proficiency you've demonstrated thus far.
If battles are ahead, let us both take advantage of our respective strengths!
Thank you for your kind words. I will give it my all in battle.
I got you! You've got first-row seats for the showcase of the skills we in the Homura's Crimson Squad pride ourselves on!
(I hope they'll demonstrate as many of their skills as possible so I may copy them.)
Huh? What did you say?
Oh! Nothing! I didn't say anything!
Sometime later...
...Are you saying you take advantage of natural elements like fire and water in those cases?
Yeah. Each of us has our own specialization which our ninjutsu's focused on. I use fire, Yumi uses ice, and so on.
It's pretty adaptable to the situation. You can do stuff like wrap it around your weapon, or launch it with a snap of your finger.
Damn. We shipgirls can also change our method of attack by swapping ammo types, but that's entirely different.
I'm kinda jealous! I wish I had that level of flexibility with my attacks!
Power-wise, your guns pack the bigger punch, though.
Then there's the rest of the rigging... I'd kill for a shinobi gadget that let me move like the wind over the sea.
All the shinobi applications it could have... Bad time to daydream, I know, but it's exciting to think about.
You should teach me your shinobi techniques! Please!
I wanna learn how to vanish into a cloud of smoke and avoid an attack, or teleport behind an enemy like fwoosh... Think of the possibilities!
Hey! That's not fair! I want... I want to be her disciple as well!
It could be fun to start a ninjutsu class. After this is all done, that is.
For now, we should focus on rescuing Fubuki!
Yes, of course! I shall see that it's done!
Attagirl! Let's see who of us can knock out the most foes!
Mirror Sea - The Second Door
Murasaki, Yūyaki, Elbing, Lützow, and I make up the team for this door. Everyone cool with that?
Cool as a cucumber... Am I free to complain, though?
You are, but it's not gonna change anything. Only response you'll really get is, "Just put up with it for a while."
*whimper*... I wanna go home... I mean, no objections here.
Won't hear me complain as long as I get to grind some foes to dust.
Uh... Yeah, you can bet on it. There'll be so much dust-grinding that you'll get sick of it.
Man, I'm still not used to her switching personalities at the tip of a hat.
Think of it as... two people sharing the same body.
It shocked me the first time I saw it for myself, but now that I know why she's like that, I get it.
You can think of it like being around a pair of twins with opposite personalities.
(It's not really anything like that, but... Perhaps Emden would understand...?)
Enough yackety-yak, we've got skulls to crack! I wanna finish this before she changes her damn mind!
Oh, okay. Let's get in there, girls!
Sometime later...
In truth, I'd rather not be in this place... Nothing good ever happens when I go anywhere.
Same. I'd rather be alone in my room all I can... Forcing myself to move around is inefficient.
That is why I should be allowed to always study and train in the comfort of the indoors...
Plus, there's a good chance we'd lose if I fought in the battle anyway... Can I go home and wait for the rest of you?
Hey, losers! Stop daydreaming during combat! At least face reality this one goddamn time!
...Do you know any ninjutsu that conceals you?
You mean... camouflage? Like the technique known as leaf hiding, or another called quail hiding?
Subterfuge is the mission of a shinobi, so we have countless ways of hiding ourselves.
Water-related concealment options are... blending in among aquatic foliage and a technique called fox hiding, among others... It's when you hide underwater with only your head poking out.
Under the water? That reminds me, submarine shipgirls say you should stay still to avoid making any noise.
For us surface shipgirls, though... diving underwater isn't exactly in our toolkit.
That's unfortunate...
It's astonishing how brazenly you girls talk about getting out of doing any work...
Mirror Sea - The Third Door
So there's me, Yumi, Implacable, and Kashino... Alright, I'll try my hardest not to drag you down!
Oh, don't say that. If there's any "dragging" you do, it's dragging the team forwards. You have a knack for that.
Indeed she does. She has a certain power that drives people onwards.
A power that compels her to always keep fighting. That is why we all put our trust in her.
Wow... It sounds like we have nothing to worry about! Lead us forward, Asuka!
Whoa, hang on! What's this about "driving people onwards"?
I'm no leader! Now that you've hyped me up... I'm gonna have to give it my best shot.
Hey... Will you shipgirls put your trust in me?
Of course. Making people trust you is one of your talents. It's proof of your ability and excellence.
Learning to accept people's positive feelings and turning them into your strength is important, Asuka.
Yes. We all know that you're an exceedingly strong person.
Not just physically, but spiritually as well.
I once faced you as a foe. As did Homura, and even Fubuki.
All of us know and respect your strength. Please, for all our sakes, have confidence in yourself!
Gosh, you sound like you really mean it... O-okay, I'll try, for real!
With me, everyone! Forwards! We'll save Fubuki no matter what it takes!
Sometime later...
It's weird. We're sailing on the sea, and there's water all around...
So why do I feel like taking a shower? I wouldn't even care if it was a cold shower.
Ah, I know exactly how that feels!
I love relaxing in the bath or in hot springs, and whenever I'm out at sea on a mission, my urge to bathe gets even stronger for some reason.
When I'm carrying heavy cargo, I just think to myself, "Gosh, I'd kill to take a mineral bath."
Or I'll have thoughts like, "I heard citrus-scented bath salts are lovely. I should try one next time."
Mood. My favorite thing is getting a can of coffee milk and chugging the whole thing after getting out of the tub!
I wonder – why DOES milk taste so good right after a bath?
Right? It's delicious whether it's coffee-flavored or fruit-flavored. Cold, regular milk is great, too!
In fact, I know a very good brand of milk! I'll treat you to some when we get back, so let's go for a dip together!
You will? Sweet! I can't wait!
(I can understand wanting to share things, but this isn't a proper topic for a battlefield.)
Okay, that's enough chitchat. You can talk about bathing when you're not in the middle of a fight. At least take the situation a little seriously.
Oh, right! Sorry!
Sometime later, within the third door...
Is something the matter, Asuka?
No... It's just that I feel like I'm being watched, even if I can't put my finger on why.
My radar isn't picking up anything of note, for what it's worth. What about you, Yumi?
I feel it, too, albeit vaguely. Something isn't right. It's like there are eyes on me, or like I'm being watched.
That so? And yet, nothing is showing on the radar...
Perhaps it's some extraordinary sense you ninjas have. Or a superpower.
While it's nothing on that level, I've learned how to sense the presence of people over the course of my training.
Staying out of sight is a shinobi's main job, so that also plays a role in our heightened awareness.
But compared to our fuzzy instincts, your radar clearly indicating where the enemies are is way more impressive!
The difference between having it and not in a fight is worlds apart!
Although, who knows if it'd work when you're fighting a fellow shinobi...
Once they know you have it, they'll develop countermeasures to hide from it sooner or later.
It's the same deal for us. It's an endless back-and-forth of devising new ways to hide from and find each other.
Oh, makes sense! Guess it's the same in all worlds – you're always refining your technique every day.
...Following that train of thought, I have an idea why someone would be watching us.
Maybe they want to incorporate our shinobi senses into a new kind of radar?
That's certainly a possibility. The Sirens went the extra mile when they summoned you here, after all.
The idea of an organic radar with extrasensory perception sounds frightening, honestly...
Mirror Sea - Keep Entrance
First! ...Or not?
Finally, after a million years. The hell took you so long? Were you a turtle in a previous life or what?
You're here, Homura? Dang it, then I lost! That's so annoying! ...Hey, if I was a turtle, I'd have won! Slow and steady, remember?
I'm glad to see you've made it. Now to wait for Murasaki's team.
Umm... We've been here for a while now...
Oh, forgive me for not noticing you sooner... Yumi, any updates on Fubuki?
I can still sense her presence just past this point. Having said that...
Yeah... Looking at the rising smoke, anyone can tell something happened in the keep.
Doesn't look like there's any time to waste here! Let's rush inside as soon as everyone's ready!
Our team is fully prepared! Let us realize the finale!
Alright! Here we go!

sequence: At sea - Night
Akatsuki - On a regular patrol

scripts.say: Ah, what a calm and peaceful day. Nothing out of the ordinary, and nothing to be afraid of...
It's so quiet. TOO quiet... I think I'd prefer it if the Sirens came to attack...
No, no, no! What am I saying? I'd much rather be a little scared than be chased around all day!
Maybe if I pinch myself, the pain will distract me from... Actually, I don't want to hurt. Oh, I know! Some stargazing may lift my spirit!
That reminds me, either Ikazuchi or Inazuma said I should wish upon a falling star not to be scared...
If I do just that, hopefully I won't have to be afraid on my patrols anymore.
Yeah! I'll keep my eyes on the sky and ignore the murky water under my feet!
...That said, I'm not really seeing any falling stars tonight.
Most days, I'll usually notice a few whether I'm paying attention or not.
Just then, there was a twinkle in the sky.
Oh! There's one! Okay, now to make my wish... Please let me not be scared, please let me not be scared...
The thing she thought was a falling star did not vanish. It seemed to be going toward her.
What the...? Am I imagining it, or is it coming this way? It almost looks like it's getting bigger...
It drew closer and closer to where Akatsuki was...
AAAHHHH!
I don't think that was a falling star – it might've been a new Siren superweapon! And it crashed into that islet over there...
Thank goodness it didn't hit me. *sigh*, I suppose now I must investigate before I can report what happened...
I really don't want to, but they'll get mad at me if I don't... I wish Hibiki were here so I could ask her to do it.

sequence: At sea - Morning
Akatsuki - Forcibly scouting the area

scripts.say: Hmm... I'm fairly sure this is the impact zone. I can't see anything because of all this fog, though...
What even are these waters? This shouldn't be that far off from my regular patrol route...
And yet, I don't remember seeing any island like this before.
What if this is a Siren trap, and this is a Mirror Sea?!
...Huh? Is that a person? Oh no! They're passed out on the ground! I think they got caught in the impact!
Ma'am? Are you okay?!
Uuughh...
Oh! You're alive! Listen to the ninja's voice! Are you in any kind of pain?
I should probably radio the port and get some repair ships to help... But if this is a Mirror Sea, the lines are down!
*gasp*! Urgh... Where am I?
Phew! Looks like you're okay! As for where you are, uhh...
Hey! Homura! Fubuki! Are you two okay? Are you still alive? Noooo! They're dead!
I... don't think so...
You need to take a chill pill, Asuka! You really think we'd bite the dust just like that?
My apologies for all this ruckus. We didn't scare you, I hope?
Oh, no, I'm fine. May I ask who you people are?
We're all shino– Sorry, I meant to say, "normal high schoolers."
High schoolers? Yes, I suppose you look the part.
Asuka, I do not believe this land shares our laws... An instinctual feeling tells me so.
That being the case, we should come forth with our identities and ask for cooperation.
Besides, this young lady's attire suggests that she plays the same role as us.
Huh? You mean she's a shinobi?
Did someone just say "shinobi"?
Oh, yeah, I did! We're shinobis, and we support the world from the shadows, fighting bad guys day and night. Do you do that, too?
Well, I, uh... Y-yes. I follow the path of the ninja...
Wow, you really are a fellow shinobi! I'm glad we're in good company! I thought we'd be all alone in this scary new place.
My name's Asuka, by the way! I'm a second-year student at Hanzō Academy.
The tomboy over here is Homura, and this pretty lady is Fubuki. Now tell us about who you are.
Ah, right... Greetings. I am Akatsuki, from the Sakura Empire.
Sakura Empire Academy? Doesn't ring any bells... It's top secret, isn't it? Makes sense. That's how shinobis roll.
Umm, well... That's not exactly correct...
And what ninjutsu do you specialize in? Oh! Wait! Let me guess...
Hmmm. Judging by your gear and the fact we're in the middle of the ocean... I'll bet you sneak around in the water! Do you work with the navy?
Err, no, I'm in a Destroyer Division, specifically the–
Destruction ninjutsu?! Whoooa! That sounds awesome! And really powerful!
No, that means I fight primarily using torpedoes...
Torpedoes? As in, electric rays? So you've studied beastmastery. This sea-fighting academy of yours is impressive. I could use a tip or two...
Umm, I... It's...
You're barraging her with too many questions to keep up.
While I'm certain we all have many more questions, for now, let us look for a safe place to relax.
Heheh. Found you.
What?
That very moment...
I can't see a thing! What's happening?!
Huh? Where did Fubuki go?
What just happened?
Akashi Castle - Keep Interior
SLAM!
Hail! ...Egads, it's pitch black in here. This has to be the final room.
Wait, Akatsuki! There's someone there!
Hm? Ah, keen as ever, shinobi. I'm surprised you can see me without night vision goggles. Here, let me give you a treat...
Fubuki!
Stop. Don't wake her. I've finally managed to calm her down.
It was ridiculous. I can't believe Observer's report made no mention of her attacking with all she has if you look at her the wrong way...
Knowing her, I'll bet she intentionally left that out. Still, this is no way to treat the one who has to deal with the fallout.
Hey, asshole! Hold still so I can cut you in half!
Seems we have a specimen prone to extreme emotions here.
Settle down. The experiment has only just begun. Also, I have delightful plans for you. I hope you'll like them.
What do you mean, "delightful plans"?!
Ah, you're the girl who linked with this... thing. Heheh. Your biorhythms line up so neatly.
I knew your group would inevitably arrive here if they had you.
Now it's time to show you the fruits of our research. You will not be disappointed by what we've created.
RUMBLE... RUMBLE...
This – THIS is my latest work. Enjoy yourselves, now.
KABOOOM!
Oww! That was such a cheap attack!
Stop whining and fight back! It's not gonna go easy on you just 'cause you called it cheap!
Yūyaki! Can you keep that thing in check?!
For now, but I can't keep this up forever! Think of something to take it out, dammit!
The hell is this? Its attack pattern's the same, but different stuff happens every time! What're we supposed to do?!
It's purposely throwing us off our rhythm so we can't predict its moves. It's... a bit like how a ninja attacks.
She called it "battle ninja armor," yeah? It's got the schmoves of a ninja and the strength of Tester herself!
We've gotta think of something, quick, or we are so boned!
If it fights like a ninja, I shall hit tit for tat with the new techniques I've learned! High-explosive clone shell, strike my foe!
Then I'll whip out the new gear I made with the shinobis' help – the infinite caltrop gun! Fire!
Wow. I taught her the clone shuriken technique, and she's using it in a whole new way... Reno might just be a natural genius.
That caltrop launcher could be extremely useful! If you scaled it down a little, maybe we could use them as well!
Focus, people! Don't get distracted by her gadgets!
We did it!
Well, seems this is it. It held up well, for being so hastily constructed. Moreover, the results of this experiment were fascinating.
You're all that's left, bastard! Say your last prayers!
You still have the energy to fight? I'm surprised. I'm afraid this is starting to drag on, though.
While I wouldn't mind playing with you, I've run out of time.
Hey! Wait! Get your ass back here!
Now, now, this was fun. We will meet again another time.
Sometime later, deep in the keep...
Fubuki! Are you alright?!
Mmgh...
Let me have a look at her. Pupil dilation is fine. Pulse, fine. Breathing, fine.
...Yeah, she's okay, save for a couple of scratches. Just needs a little rest back at the port and she'll be back to normal in no time.
Oh, thank goodness...
Let's all get out of here before anything bad happens!
I wouldn't put it past the Sirens to be like, "I'm taking you with me!" and blowing the castle up at the last second!
RUSTLE...
Huh? Look! Fubuki – she's moving.
You're awake, Fubuki. Thank go– Aaahhh!
KABOOOM!
What's happening? Why is she attacking us?!
I think she's still in her slumber. Nothing suggests she's being puppeteered, though... She's either acting on instinct, or it's something automatic.
I knew it! The Sirens left us a parting gift!
They skipped past blowing up the castle and went straight to turning one of our own on us! They've hit a new low!
Fubuki, please! Come to your senses!
Mirror Sea - Deep Inside the Keep
Fubuki, how are you feeling?!
Fubuki! You have to wake up! Please!
Yu-Yumi...?
Fubuki! Oh, thank god you're okay!
Sorry for... all the trouble.
Do you have any memory of when you fought us?
Yes, albeit faintly... Like I was an outsider, peering in... It felt like I was someone else entirely.
But... now I'm fine. I know for a fact the words I'm speaking are my own.
Thank god... That's such a relief.
It's over now. This was very enlightening. Thanks for your "assistance." Heheh.
*gasp*!
Hmm? Is something wrong, Fubuki?
...No, it's nothing.
Okay, now let's REALLY get the heck outta here before something bad happens again!
Akashi Castle - Outside the Castle
Phew! We're finally free... Huh? Has the Mirror Sea been dispelled?
Guess they made it something like, the Mirror Sea would disappear when we freed Fubuki, or something?
Because otherwise, they'd probably have made us fight more before we could escape.
We've regained connection to the port. I'll ask Akashi to bring an investigation team while we escort the wounded home to safety.
You do that. I desperately need to rest back at the port.
What was the point of all this, anyway? I hate the Sirens and their stupid, confusing schemes!
After all of that, I think I know. The unique beings known as shinobis and their feats caught the Sirens' interest.
In the same way they caught Akatsuki's and Reno's interest.
What?! I am no Siren! You should not compare me to them!
Of course not. While their way of thinking may seem complicated, in truth, there's no point trying to understand them.
...Ladies, I'm sorry for all the trouble you had to go through today. Allow me to apologize to you once more, when we're in a safer place.
C'mon, it's nothing for you to apologize over! We're practically used to this!
RUMBLE!
Can't see a thing... Huh? Is that a door?
I... guess this is your literal doorway back home, girls. If nothing else, the Sirens do tie everything up in a nice bow at the end...
Wait, we can go back if we go through the door?
It does resemble a world gateway... Yet something's different about it. It feels a little nostalgic.
If our past experiences are any indication, it's probably broken. One of our interdimensional doorway experts should be on the way.
It'll take a while to fix it, but at least we'll figure out its functions as we examine it.
Until it's running again, you're welcome to stay at our port and rest! Fubuki'll need a check-up anyway!
Indeed. You've yet to formally introduce yourself as well, Fubuki. We'll have plenty of time to talk after you've healed.
Please, do allow me to invite you to a tea party after that. I'm not bad at brewing tea, as a matter of fact. You're going to love it!
I wouldn't if I were you...
Wouldn't what, hmm?
Uhh... Never mind...
Kindly forgive me for not giving you my due introduction. I'm pleased to be staying with you for a while.
It looks like we'll all be here for some time! Hooray! Asuka, you must teach me more ninjutsu!
You got it! I'll whip you up into a great shinobi!
Err, instruct me by all means, but please no whipping...
Mirror Sea - Outset Island
I've told you already! Somebody kidnapped Fubuki!
Yeah, I know! What I'm asking is who that "somebody" is!
"Somebody" means "somebody," okay? You know perfectly well what I'm talking about!
No, I DON'T know what you're talking about! I'm not some all-knowing god!
L-let's all calm down and discuss what we know...
It's simple. There's either an evil ninja or a yōma who's after us! I'm 100% sure of it!
Which brings us back to what I was saying – we need to go looking for Fubuki right now!
No! What we need to do is figure out what's going on and gather more information before anything else!
You need to work on this damn habit of yours of rushing in blindly!
For all we know, she could be being tortured while you're standing here, finding faults with me! We need to get a move on!
Ladies! Arguing is to nobody's benefit! Take a deep breath and...
We're doing it my way!
We're doing it MY way!
They won't listen to me... If only I were a full-fledged shinobi, maybe they would... *sob*...
Enough!
Ikaruga?!
Look what you did. You made the little girl cry. We are supposed to be role models for those like her.
Instead, you neglect her to quibble with each other. You should be ashamed.
Hey, hang on, that's not what we were doing...
It's not like we were ignoring her, we were just...
No. I will not hear any excuses. We are responsible adults, and as such...
Mirror Sea - Outset Island
So that's what happened... Forgive me. I jumped to conclusions.
And you, I'm sorry for frightening you. To reintroduce myself, I am Ikaruga. Like Asuka, I am a student at Hanzō Academy.
Imagine my surprise to see you in this world, too!
Indeed. The next thing I knew, here I was. Now, let us get a hold of the situation and survey our surroundings.
I saw a burst of light from this direction and came over in a hurry. What was that?
W-well, you see...
Oh. Someone kidnapped Fubuki...
Yeah, and we need to start looking for her now!
The question is, where? We don't even know where WE are at the moment.
Furthermore, we're surrounded by water in all directions. How are we supposed to cross it without a boat or an airplane?
Good point... Hey, Akatsuki, can your ninjutsu get us out of this pickle somehow?
What? My ninjutsu? Well... Getting around is one thing, but fighting or pursuing someone without a rigging is borderline impossible.
"Rigging"? Does that refer to the equipment you're wearing? Because if so...
Um, yes, those are riggings. There is one each, so they must be for you...
But, to be frank, this seems extremely fishy to me.
Fishy? You think it's a trap?
Not exactly. I mean that this has happened before.
The last time people from another world came here, they also obtained riggings at some point and brought them into battle.
You're saying there won't be any problems with us doing the same thing? Then the answer's pretty clear to me.
So, basically, we can use these things to traverse the sea and go rescue Fubuki! Everything works out!
Indeed. You can sail out by yourselves rather than waiting for rescue.
Speaking of which... As embarrassing as it is, I've been unable to reach the port for a while now.
If they have dispatched a search party, it'll be easier to locate your lost friend with more eyes on the sea.
This situation should be resolved very quickly if we can group up with the search party, then.
Phew. Then now is the time to act. Make hay while the sun shines, as they say.
Akatsuki, would you mind showing us how to equip these riggings?
Oh, sure!
Somewhere, on a small island...
A group of girls were under attack by a fleet of stray Sirens.
Murasaki! Multiple hostiles near you!
G-go away... Stop it... It hurts...
Ugh, unrelenting little bastards! One hit is all it takes to knock you out anyway, so stop dodging, god dammit!
These foes aren't human... Perhaps they're puppets? No, not quite...
Humans, puppets, doesn't frickin' matter when it's taking all I've got to hold 'em back. We're gonna get bent at this rate...
And with no hope of rescue, I fear...
KABOOOM!
New type of Siren fleet sighted! Let's blow them up before they catch on to us!
We're here, baby! Let's roll!
Alright, I think that's the last of them. You there, are you okay? You don't have riggings, so I'm assuming you're not shipgirls.
No. I am Yumi, a student of the Gessen Girls' Academy.
Gessen? Never heard of that one. What's that you've got there? Looks like the kinds of weapons ninja use in anime.
Those Enforcer Sirens had a similar vibe to them... What happened here? Was this a movie shoot or something?
You call those evil ninjas "Sirens"? They behaved so much like puppets on strings...
Puppets, that curious equipment of yours, and the need to specify EVIL ninjas... Hmm...
Err, before you ask...
No, no, I get it! Your existence is top-secret, right? That's so ninja-like! And so mysterious.
What I was going to say was... Yes, we are shinobis. However...
Whoa. So shinobis ARE real. I thought they only existed in comic books.
So, like, can you do cool ninja stuff? Like transform or create clones of yourselves?
Are you talking about embodying avatars and illusions of encirclement?
You must have dog companions who follow your orders, right?
Some of us do keep doggies as pets, yes...
What about haiku? Do you make those? Like, those death poems, and stuff?
We practice no such custom. There are those who compose tanka as a hobby, but that is a different subject.
Oh yeah! Now that's a real-life shinobi! Next-level Far East stuff!
Is this really the time for culture exchange?
It feels like... we've become friends just like that...
What matters is, I've officially met a super-ninja, and that's awesome! Now our victory's basically guaranteed!
Okay, we've heard enough! Stop nerdgasming already! Sorry 'bout this goofball confusing you girls.
Don't be. We would be confused no matter the conversation's contents in this case.
Moreover, we're already confused after being brought to this place without any prior warning...
You came to our aid when we needed it, and for that, thank you so much.
Mirror Sea - Somewhere else
...And there you have it. We study ninjutsu at school while fighting day and night to protect the peace!
Amazing! A shinobi needs to go through much training to carry out her duty, after all!
All that work makes it all the more satisfying when you complete a tough mission, though.
An attitude befitting a cool shinobi such as you! Speaking of which, what missions have you accomplished before?
Good question. For a start, there's the time when I met Homura...
Seems those two have already become best friends. They've all but formed a sisterly bond.
I mean, what's wrong with that? Someone's gotta look after that big baby.
On another topic, we've been on the move for a long-ass while now and haven't seen any land, never mind any friendlies.
No, but this is the direction the light that took Fubuki came from. All we can do is keep moving forward.
The rescue party Akatsuki spoke of is surely heading there, too.
Finally, other students – assuming there are more – should be heading to where the light came from if they saw it as well.
I was talking to 'em right before we got sent here. There's a high chance Yumi's somewhere around here.
Ah. Then we'd better find her soon...
Do you know any simple ninjutsu you could demonstrate to me? Pretty please!
Sure, if basic capture ninjutsu will do. Give me your hand for a sec. Okay, now, let's take this rope aaand...
Whoa! I can't move one inch, let alone untie myself!
And now if I do this...
Ow! Oww! Owwwww!
I hope Akatsuki is okay. She has been unreachable for some time now since she went on her patrol...
Wait... Isn't that her over there? And she's been tied up...
Someone has to save her... But if it comes to a fight, I doubt I can fend the attackers off by myself...
Ow! Oww! Owwwww!
Oh no! They're hurting her! ...Y-you there! Let go of Akatsuki right now!
KABOOOM!
We're under attack! Spread out, quickly!
Blast it! The Sirens are out here, too! We're caught in a pincer attack!
Akatsuki, take command! The rest of us don't know how to deal with Sirens! You know how we shinobis fight, don't you?
What? Uh, I mean... Okay, I'll try...
...Hang on! That's Kashino! Friendly, friendly! The lady is on our side! Hail, Kashino!
Huh? She's coming this way and waving at me... I fear they're using her as a human shield.
And just on the horizon... Oh, dear! They have reinforcements coming!
KABOOOM!
Kashinooo! Friendly fire! These girls are friendlies! Please stop shooting them! Dang it... She can't hear me!
No kidding – you can't hear a damn thing over all this cannon fire!
She's not even the biggest pest – these monsters are! Do something, Akatsuki! Use your shinobi arts to get us out of this!
But I can't just... *sob*... Somebody, save us...
KABOOOM!
An attack... from above?
Fighter squadrons, bomber squadrons, repel the Sirens!
KABOOOM!
So you saw a falling star during your compulsory patrol, and went to check it out... Akatsuki, please. Acting on your own accord goes against protocol.
I am indebted to you, Implacable...
And Kashino, you must not jump to conclusions. I hope you understand now why rash decisions only complicate things.
Yes. I'm sorry...
Good. Now, as for you ladies... Judging by your appearances, I presume you're from somewhere else.
And that's the long and short of it.
Interesting... This is exactly like cases perpetrated by Sirens in the past.
I would call for Akashi, but it seems we're in a newly formed Mirror Sea, so that's not an option.
I've contacted the port, but they won't be able to do much until we've dealt with the Sirens behind this.
So, let me ask you this, visitors from foreign lands...
Our goal is the same – to solve this problem at its core – so why don't we work on it together?
What do you mean by, "core"?
The Sirens must have some motive for kidnapping your friend, no?
That being the case, rescuing her is the most surefire way to nip whatever scheme they have in the bud.
We can worry about what comes next after that.
Sooo... Basically, saving Fubuki is our number one priority? If so, there's no doubt in my mind!
Then we have a plan. Let's move out at once. Time is short.
...Why, exactly, are you so willing to cooperate?
Things will go more smoothly on our end once we get in touch with Fubuki, sure...
But you know this world and how it runs. You could easily be trying to deceive us.
And we, completely in the dark about your world, are a burden, if anything... Frankly, I think we'll only be a hindrance to you.
To answer your question – it's because it's a nun's duty to extend her hand to people in need♪
You dress like that and call yourself a nun? You gotta be kidding me...
Mirror Sea - Desolate island
...That's how a Mirror Sea is artificially created! And sometimes, people from other worlds appear in them.
Oftentimes, they have unique powers or abilities, and that's why the Sirens are so interested in them.
Yeah. I've seen riggings do amazing stuff, like combine with others or transform. Don't get many of those outside Iron Blood.
...Combine and transform?
Hahah, yeah... Anyway, just think of this world as a place where magical stuff happens.
"Magical" really is the word. We're speaking to ladies who dart across the sea, donning machinery the likes of which I've never seen before.
I could doubt you until the cows come home, but that's meaningless. Instead, I will trust you.
Moreover, we know nothing about this world, and you are our only hope of resolving this situation and getting us back home.
I humbly beseech you – please, help us and our friend who we've yet to find.
Wait, there's more of you?
Yes. Someone else was transported to this world alongside us. I can sense her...
Her? Oh boy, let me guess...
Indeed – it's Fubuki. If she is here, then Asuka and others must surely have come as well.
I think you're right... I can't imagine Asuka wouldn't be here... Not when this has happened.
So you have, like, a person sensor? A sixth sense? Or do you have superhuman powers?
Whatever it is, I think we can assume there are others here.
Believe it or not, we lost contact with someone in this place, too... It's why we're here. To look for her.
So, you'll be searching for your missing friends and a way to get home, while we'll be searching for our lost comrade.
Sounds like killing three birds with one stone to me!
Although, we're not the only ones searchin', so someone else might find 'em and bring 'em to us.
Whatever the case... we are in your hands.
Hey, girls! Come here for a sec!
Can't say I'm surprised. This is how they do it in most cases.
Business as usual with the Sirens, I suppose...
What am I looking at here?
Riggings. I'm about 90% sure they're for you. Whenever peeps get transported here, it's not long before they get outfitted with riggings.
How do I put it? I guess you could say the Sirens are generous. Either that, or this is another ploy of theirs.
Will be able to... traverse the sea with these? This feels a bit like... getting special gear in a video game...
For the record, regular people can't equip riggings. You're special 'cause you're from another world or whatever, and the Sirens made these just for you.
You'll be able to move on water, of course, but you'll be able to join us in battles, too. Riggings pack hefty firepower and sturdy defenses.
Granted, you'll need to familiarize yourselves with 'em. Should be a cakewalk for ninjas like you girls, though.
I-I'll give my best shot.
Wow, shinobis learn fast! You've already figured out the basics of your riggings, and now it's time to set off. So, Reno, where are we going?
Kashino's team should be in the area by now, so if we're gonna regroup with anyone, it should be them.
Yumi, can you sense where Fubuki is?
I felt her presence in that direction earlier. Now, it's... well...
Umm... Can we talk about the elephant in the room? You do see that very suspicious place over there, don't you?
I do. It's where Fubuki's presence is coming from.
I think we're all subconsciously looking the other way, 'cause that place is so suspicious it hurts. Or something like that.
I just hope there's a bed with a cushy pillow. *yaaawn*... Reno, lead the way, will you?
What, are you gonna catch some Z's en route? You're one impressive napaholic... Girls, follow me!

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Fun & Play Holiday</size>

scripts.say: Port - Harbor
Man, I envy you girls.
Envy us? How so? Is this about the food again?
Because you really gushed about the sashimi the Commander treated you to yesterday.
What? Oh, yeah, that was amazing. So fresh, so piquant, so... Wait, that's not what I was thinking about!
True, I do envy the food you girls get here, but it was something else...
Right! The sea! Opening my window and hearing the waves! The smell of the ocean when I go outside to grab a bite!
Leaving the dorm and feeling the cool breeze! Walking just a short distance and seeing the beautiful coast!
And finally, a body of water being just a short walk away when I wanna swim! I envy you because it's all so great.
Well, sure, there's fun to be had at sea, but the sea basically means exercises and expeditions for us.
We also get in a more somber mindset once we put our riggings on.
While it's nice being so close to the sea, it's more convenient for going on missions than it is for enjoying yourself.
Oh, really? Huh. But I've seen girls wearing both swimsuits AND riggings when they disembark.
Were they going on some sort of special mission?
You mean the submarines, right? They fight under the water, so they wear swimsuits optimized for diving.
Now that you mention it, though, I could also fight in a swimsuit if I wanted!
Really?! Well, I can't... I tried a swimsuit the other day and couldn't equip my rigging for some reason.
Maybe you need a special swimsuit designed for rigging use.
Or one made with special fabric...
What are you girls chatting about, nya?
Akashi? Where'd the HECK did you come from?
You appeared out of nowhere, almost like a ninja!
Heh. My methods are a trade secret, nya.
Anyway, I'm dropping by to deliver Asuka's new swimsuit, nya. The Commander requested one, and it's finally done, nya. Just sign here, nya.
Sign where? The dotted line?
Yep, nya. My work here is done, and I've got places to be, so... toodles, nya!
Gone just as quickly as she came... Is this swimsuit what I think it is?
Wow, perfect timing on the Commander's part! Now you can go into battle wearing a swimsuit!
Heck yeah! That sounds like it'd be a bucketload of fun! I so wanna try that.
You do? Then go for it. I'll call some people and we'll organize a mock battle!
Just for little ol' me? Aww, thank you so much!
Ahahah! Wasn't expectin' this when I woke up today. It's cool, though – just so happens my schedule's empty!
Look at us, all wearing swimsuits. Heehee. What a magnificent sight.
Whoooa! You look so good! Like you came straight out of a TV show!
Seriously! I'm not exaggerating when I say you look like models! You're gorgeous, you're sex bombs, you're... so much prettier than me!
Don't say that. You're a real bombshell yourself!
Y-you think so? Heehee. You're just saying that!
I would argue all you shinobis are slim to perfection and have curves that could kill, though.
Take Fubuki, for one. She's drop-dead sexy.
That's true! She is one pretty lady...
Oh, Yumi, too! How she sparkles like falling snowflakes... She's got such a mystical vibe!
Guess who's ready! Heehee! How do I look?
Cute as all heck!
Thanks! So, let's all do some stretches, then get this mock battle started, shall we?
The Commander got us these swimsuits, so let's put on a cute battle as thanks!
Okay!

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Trainers Training Trainees - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Gymnasium
The shinobis were undergoing intensive training...
Gotcha!
I'm afraid not! That is only an illusion!
BONK!
Owwww... You pulled a fast one on me!
You've got a lot of training to do if you're falling for simple tricks like that, mecha-ninja.
"Mecha-ninja"... Wonder which game you got that name from– Oof!
To get distracted during training is to underestimate your teacher. It's time for punishment!
W-wait! I'm sorry! I'll take this seriously from now o– Aaahhh!
Scoring a point only for this to happen... Cramming all night clearly backfired on you.
Yeah, sorry...
You must watch the battle carefully and make the right decisions accordingly. Taking all-or-nothing risks is the worst thing shinobis can do.
They should be able to determine if what they see is real or an illusion, a commitment or a feint.
I know that, it's just... How do I put this... Your way of teaching is pretty punishing.
Pfft!
What?
Your draconian nature is showing!
Meanwhile, outside the gymnasium...
How I envy them...
Speaking to them was so easy during the mission, but now, back at the port, I feel too shy...
Asking a genuine ninja for their teachings is so, so discourteous!
Akatsuki? Whatcha doin' in there?
Hibiki?! Oh, it's you, Bremerton... Please don't scare me so.
Uh, sorry. So, why aren't you training with the others?
Are you hiding here as part of some special training or whatever?
No, I'm just... Well...
...And that's essentially it.
Ahh... I mean, you fought the Sirens side-by-side with 'em. It makes no sense to be afraid now.
You know what? You've got a problem, and I'm gonna help you solve it!
What? No, wait! Wait a second!
Hey! Sorry to interrupt!
I just was wondering if you could instruct Akatsuki on her training. You folks got the time?
Huh? No, I don't, I'm busy. Really busy with something. Haven't been this busy in aaages.
Ohhh, I see. You can't just walk up and ask an evil ninja for something.
KA-CLICK!
Whoa, whoa! Easy! What's the deal with the huge cannon all of a sudden?!
C'mon, you've got time. At least enough to help Akatsuki out.
Okay, okay! I'll do it, just put that thing away!
Great! Be nice to her now, 'kay?

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Trainers Training Trainees - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: Port - Gymnasium
Phew... So, we doing this?
Yes. I'm ready.
Come on! You can't fall for such a simple feint! Use your judgment to determine when an attack is fake or real!
S-sorry! I'll try!
And don't just stand there when your opponent activates a spell! Block or dodge!
You've gotta develop a habit of reacting in time to when they start casting!
That's really difficult... The path of a shinobi is harsh and unforgiving...
You're leagues and bounds more draconian than I am, Homura! Are you okay, Akatsuki?
*whimper*... As they say, spare the rod and spoil the child...
She's so overwhelmed she's lost her senses. Give her some water and let her rest for a bit.
You don't think you could, y'know, go a little easier on her?
You kidding? Nothing's gonna stick if I'm not strict with her. But... Hmm, lemme think.
Is that a "fine" I hear? Akatsuki, you can take five. We'll also go ahead and–
A real fight is the best kind of practice. Ikaruga, you're gonna help out. Same with the rest of you.
We're doing a mock battle. Several of you against one of us. If you're still standing by the end of it, your training's done for the day.
...Are you serious?
No, please! Let's just stick to regular training!
It's do or die, Akatsuki!
Sometime later...
Yo, Akatsuki, you good? You still breathin'?
...Yeah, nah. She's totally out cold.
Hmm... I'll compromise and say she passed, if just barely.
Did it make you happy, seeing her last until the end? Heehee. Just admit it.
Shut up!
You all did a stellar job today. Someone, please carry Akatsuki to her dorm room.
Thanks for taking the time to teach us your ninjutsu. I've learned so much from you.
Zzzzz...
Witness my ultimate technique... Destroyer ninjutsu... Torpedo Blitz... Zzzzz...
Hah! Sounds like she's still training in her dreams.

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Teenage High School Ninja Girls - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Break Room
Hey, tell me about your school. What's Gessen Girls' Academy like?
Oh? Why do you ask?
We've got an academy of our own, so I figured it's something to talk about.
Plus, I'm a little curious about what an academy for ninjas is actually like.
I'm afraid you'll find the answer rather boring.
For a start, the Shijuku Gessen Girls' Academy is a school specializing in raising shinobis.
It's a bit different to ordinary schools. The curriculum is mainly centered around practicing ninjutsu.
Which is to say... Well, it's not much different from the training we do on a daily basis here.
In the case of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group, it may be a misnomer to even call us a "school."
Tengu Group... From the name alone, it sounds like you'd reside up in the mountains, and not in a school building within a town.
Yes, the Hidden Village is something quite different. I suppose you could call it a school for shinobi that has existed in Japan since ancient times.
What about Asuka's school? Isn't Hanzō National Academy fairly normal?
If nothing else, it does present itself as being ordinary.
Do you study general subjects there? Y'know, math, history...
All the standard subjects are important parts of our school's curriculum as well, actually.
I would assume you shipgirls learn the same things about society as us. Shinobis need to blend into the world, after all.
Yep, we learn all kinds of stuff at the academy! Not much teacher variety, though – it's always the same shipgirl...
There are lectures, combat training, and tests, of course. The only we don't really have is a uniform.
Oh, yeah. I'd almost forgotten that.
You... don't have a uniform?
Nope. It's fair game to wear clothes resembling a uniform, or you could wear your regular fit if you want. Commander says both are fine.
Honestly, sometimes it feels like the students are straight-up cosplaying at school.
As long as it's cute, I don't mind what people wear!
Looking cute is not what's important with uniforms...
To be fair, even in our case, I feel like many regard our respective shinobi attires as their true uniforms.
Oh, I'm not saying we don't like the uniforms we wear every day. It is an essential part of blending in with society.
But there are also some who take it off at the first chance.
That is true. Oftentimes, they also get torn in unavoidable circumstances. Despite them being made of strong fabric...

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Teenage High School Ninja Girls - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: Speaking of schools, any decent one's gotta have seasonal events, too. With all kinds of attractions.
While I wouldn't call it a school trip, we also sometimes go on trips together with the Commander.
I don't think journeys thousands of kilometers from home can be called "trips"...
Ahahah... So, events. Do you have sports days, and stuff?
We have something similar – competitive events where we demonstrate the fruits of all our training.
Those are important to help us gauge the skills of other schools.
They are also a way for us to measure how strong we ourselves are.
This topic turned into something much bigger than school events...
You got some kind of system where teams get points based on their placing in the competitions?
With the top team being given exposure, of course.
Hmm... I think we have something similar.
Ours involves one person taking out the most enemies they can and being awarded points accordingly. Does that count?
Wait... Enemies? As in, enemies-enemies?
Yes. Exactly that.
Geesh. Brutal...
I think a few of the categories may also be replicable here.
Obviously, the scale and rules will need to be changed somewhat, but the idea should stay largely the same.
Would you shipgirls like to participate as well?
Yes, please. It would provide invaluable experience for the future.
A cross-worlds sports competition, eh? Could be fun.
I'll let girls from all the other factions know they're welcome as well!
It's an opportunity to learn new things. I'll fill out an event application form to the Commander.
Great. Then I'll call my fellow shinobis and start setting everything up.
The following day, in the gymnasium...
Holy smokes! Ayanami's team really brought their A-game today.
As expected, we couldn't replicate the competition to a T. Still, this is more or less what it's like.
By the way, Baltimore – you mentioned yesterday that you have sports days. What are those like?
Please don't tell me you play catch with depth charges, or shoot clay pigeons out of the air...
Obviously, we don't do anything THAT dangerous.
We can show you what a sports day is like. We've still got time to spare!
Sometime later...
Gosh, this looks like a lot of fun! I wish we had something like this at our schools.
You know, after seeing this for myself, I've been thinking...
Is their idea of a "sports day" not more normal than ours?
I've read books on everyday life before which describe a sports day very much like this, so...
Yumi, you mean...?
Let's discuss it with our fellow shinobi when we get back home.

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Start the Training - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Training Area Campsite
Akatsukiii!
I'm gonna climb that rock over there for training's sake. You wanna come with me?
Of course! I would love to accompany you!
I see! This is what you'd call a random event!
Finishing it should award you with a significant amount of affection.
There they go, doing stuff for no reason again. Oh well, it's nice to see Akatsuki in such high spirits for once.
It's a problem when they get carried away. While being active is good, it's important to rest up after intense exercise.
Hey, girls! Who wants a cold bottle of milk?
...By the way, where's Murasaki? Shouldn't she be here?
Nah. If I had to guess, she's probably playing video games in her room again.
Meanwhile, in a dark corner of the island...
This was a mistake... I fell for the sound of people having fun... Going outside was a horrible mistake...
I'd much rather be somewhere dark and quiet where I can relax by myself...
Why does it have to be so sunny... I feel like I'm going to faint...
Almost there... Almost at the campsite... Fishy, I need your encouragement right now...
Umm...Aren't you...?
Eep!
Who's there?!Eek!
Oh... S-sorry. I didn't expect to see people here at this time of day.
I-I'll be out of your hair soon... Just give me a minute...
Heheh... Heheheheh...
EEEEEEEEK!
AAAAAAHHHHH!
Y-you nearly scared me to death... You don't have to scream so loud...
I-in case you didn't know... I've been here since the start...
You have? Oh... Sorry. I didn't realize when I first got here.
L-like I said, I'll be out of here before you know it... I-I won't be long...
What's going on here? Some kind of party?
AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!
So, basically, you wanna participate in the exercise, but you lack the courage to show up.
Now you're all meeting up here with others who aren't participating either. Is that right?
Not exactly... It's not like... we all agreed to meet here or anything.
Ah. So you independently opted for a place where there's few people, then?
Correct...
You don't like dealing with people, I suppose...
Oh! That gives me an idea! Heheh!

sequence:
The Ninja Scrolls: At Your Leisure

<size=45>Start the Training - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: Training Area - Somewhere else
So... What's the point in forcing us to come here, exactly?
That's a lot of mass-produced training ships...
A-and their guns are trained on US!
Is this... what I think it is?
Yup! Since you can't handle groups of people, I got you some non-people opponents!
Take your time getting used to practicing with these and you'll be ready to try the real deal with the rest of us!
(Heheh. I'm a genius.)
St-starting mission... I'll go underwater...
Also, there's swarms of mass-produced subs waiting under the surface. There's nowhere to run!
N-nowhere to run? Umm...
Don't worry! You've got me for backup!~
I'll handle the small stuff so you can focus on the bigger picture. Plus, we'll get buddy-buddy faster if we fight side by side.
If you don't wanna get KO'd, you've either gotta evade or KO the enemy first. Either way, don't just stand there! Go, go, go!
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
G-god... That was insane...
Oopsie... I might've gone too far in a few places.
WAY too far...
I can't move a muscle... Fishy, help me...
Heheh... Heheheh... Heheheheh...
Murasaki! Are you okay?
We're here to rescu– Whoa. Check out the numbers on their report sheet!
I can't believe my eyes! Look how many foes they defeated!
Here I thought they'd need a hand. Looks like we came for nothing.
Oh, if you girls haven't had enough, I'll call in some more ships.
*whimper*...
All this fighting has left them exhausted. I think this is a good time to call it for today.
Are you sure? But you just got here to help us out.
You saying you wanna fight some more? 'Cause I'm up for it.
Nuh-uh, no way... I'm done...
Alright, then that's enough training for today! Let's all go swimming now!
Did you not swim, like, several kilometers just a minute ago?!
Yeah, but that's different! It's not the same as swimming with these girls!
No time to waste! I'll see you there!
I'm down for a swim!
I-I will join you, then!
Well... That worked out surprisingly well in the end.
In the heat of battle, all you think about is what your teammates will do, when to dodge, and what enemy to sink...
There's no time to waste thinking about your own little troubles. Isn't that nice?
Yes, but the thing is, my friends have told me that before...
I went into the battle already knowing about that...
Wait, you did? So in the end, you didn't need me to do anything for you?
No. You can be a bit of a hothead sometimes... Does anyone tell you that?
Still, even if this wasn't necessary, it showed that you care for us... Thank you for that.
I need to work on becoming more confident...
White sands and blue waves – I'm coming for you!
...But to reach her level of confidence is going to take years.

sequence: Scapa Flow Anchorage - Mirror Sea "Camelot"
Royal Navy Defense Fleet

scripts.say: KABOOOM!
Camelot – the hub for the Gate of Avalon, a transference device controlled by the Royal Navy.
The gateway was used to make first contact with two META shipgirls, as well as to seek out a cure for Hood. However, it also drew the attention of the terrifying and mysterious Bon Homme Richard.
And now, the Gate of Avalon has become besieged from all sides, artillery fire raining down upon what once was a fairytale paradise.
Sis, these ghostly, formless enemies...
Don't they look just like things Bon Homme Richard sent at us that other time?
Yes, that's what they remind me of, too.
Assuming they're the same... it didn't take long for that monster to find us.
The question is, how did they get inside this place?
They seemingly appeared out of thin air from within the Mirror Sea.
Repulse, the only way in and out of Camelot is through the gateway, is it not?
If you don't know, I sure as hell don't.
Hmm... I guess that's true.
By the way, is everything going well on your end?
Yeah, I'm cleaning up right now. They're pretty weak, but... they sure make up for it with sheer numbers.
Just holding our ground isn't enough to count as a win. We need to figure out where all these enemies came from, or the situation's only going to keep getting worse.
The longer this drags out, the worse shape we're going to be in. Also, has Queen Elizabeth responded to you yet?
I sent out an SOS, but I haven't heard anything back. I bet it's because their equipment is too primitive. I've been saying, they really should upgrade to Ashes-grade stuff.
And do you know how to make Ashes-grade equipment?
Do you? 'Cause if you don't know, I sure as hell don't.
Hmm... I guess that's true.
KABOOOM!
The cavalry has arrived! Renown, Repulse, we've got your backs!
Sorry to have kept you waiting.
Better late than never, as they say! What's the current situation?
Y-Your Majesty!
Umm, to what do we owe the pleasure? Why did you come in person?
To see what's going on, obviously.
I received word that something was wrong with the gate, and then all communications went down right after that.
As the most knowledgeable person about this gate, if I don't do something about it, then who will?
In any case, I didn't realise the situation was this bad until I arrived here.
...Yes, I'm glad you at least didn't come alone this time.
But of course. The Gate of Avalon is of critical importance, so we would spare no expense to ensure it continues running smoothly.
In fact, I would've brought more people if I could. Alas, this is all I could muster on such short notice.
But first, what exactly is going on here?
The invaders themselves aren't particularly dangerous, but we don't know where they're coming from, or why they're attacking.
Judging by their appearances, they very much may be harbingers of that monster in the form of Bon Homme Richard.
Yes, I suspect the same.
For better or worse, there's no sign of that black tornado we saw during our last encounter.
This might mean that she herself can't get to us so easily. Some external conditions may need to be met first.
Regardless – all ships, hurry to the gate!
We'll turn off the teleporter and put this Mirror Sea on lockdown. Be prepared to fall back and hold the castle, if need be.
In the event that Bon Homme Richard truly is attacking us, we must stop her here before she gets any farther.
Your Majesty, a patch of sea fog has appeared in front of us, and it's rapidly expanding!
Sea fog...?
KABOOOM!
Who's there?!
Eek! Pl-please don't shoot! I'm on your side!
Teehee~ Royal Oak makes a great distraction for sneaking around and getting a backstab crit~
Argus is present and prepared! Your Majesty, I'm glad to see you.
As am I. Our whole fleet is here and ready to assist, Your Majesty.
Just say the word, and I'll deliver judgment to our foes.
Implacable? Argus? And all the rest?
What is the meaning of this? How did you get here?
Last I heard, you were finishing up your investigation of the basilicas on the Kerguelen Islands!
Well, we were, until we received your distress signal. You said you needed backup.
As for this sea fog... It's actually a microlayer transference device left behind by Compiler, so that's how we were able to come straight here.
...Wait, back up! What do you mean by "distress signal"? I only just got here!
Then, there's the microlayer thing... How did you conveniently get your hands on Siren technology, and figure out how to use it so quickly?
In other words, who told you all this? Who helped you get here?
Who? Um...
You did, Your Majesty.

sequence: Somewhere in Eastern Europa
Northern Parliament - Armored Train
Sovetsky Soyuz

scripts.say: The dull, rhythmic clunking of cold steel against the rail tracks lulled the train's passengers to sleep.
Among them, Sovetsky Soyuz. She closed her tired eyes and her consciousness slipped into darkness.
A black sun, quietly burning in the dusky sky.
Where... am I? Is this a dream?
Wasn't I reading documents aboard the train just a moment ago?
Yes. I must've rested my eyes for a moment and fallen asleep.
There was no one to answer Soyuz's questions. Only the black sun, burning silently overhead.
What a peculiar sun. I don't feel its warmth on my face.
If anything... its light feels like a cold, forlorn wind.
What IS this place?
Who's there? Is that you, comrade Rossiya?
I didn't quite catch that. Could you say that again?
SCREEECH!
Its brakes flipped, the train ground to a shrill halt, pulling Soyuz from her dream.
The burning black sun and Rossiya, trying to tell me something... What a strange dream.
Did they show up in my dream because I have too much on my mind?
Whatever the case, I need to focus on the task in front of me. The sooner I can head back, the better...
Sovetsky Soyuz put away the documents she was perusing, and prepared to get off the train.
So far, Operation Frostfall, the Northern Parliament's coalition operation, had been progressing smoothly.
This major assault centered around employing feint attacks on Siren positions, pushing the frontlines forward while searching for Omitter's critical weakness – her mainframe.

However, the situation changed when Clemenceau, the Tribunal's liaison with who Soyuz had secretly been in correspondence, provided an urgent update on the status of the ongoing blueprint ship project.
One of the Northern Parliament's shipyards involved in researching prototype armaments for this project had encountered unexpected delays, potentially jeopardizing the success of the entire project.
As a result, Soyuz passed the role of operation commander to her trusted comrade, and left to tackle this urgent problem herself.
Blueprint ship Champagne... You are a greatness waiting to be born.
Comrade Sovetsky Soyuz, we have arrived at your destination. Please ensure you have all your documents and personal belongings with you.
Kronshtadt from the Intelligence Bureau is waiting for you.
...The solution will present itself, in due time.

sequence: A few days before the World Expo's closing
Saint Helena Island - Secret Tribunal Stronghold

scripts.say: Days had passed since the Crown of the Holy See was lost. Richelieu was reviewing documents at her desk when she heard a knock at the door.
Come in.
I do hope I'm not interrupting you, Cardinal.
Ah, Le Terrible. Please have a seat. Have any news for me?
Yes. The first stage of repairs on the stronghold has been completed.
In broad strokes, it went smoothly. If you'd like the finer details, I've prepared a written report for you.
Thank you. I commend your tireless efforts.
I'm only doing my duty. Incidentally, you look much more alive now, Cardinal. Did that dubious Tribunal medicine actually work?
It did. My dreams have been completely free of the black sun ever since I took that medicine.
You, on the other hand, don't look so well. Is there something I should know?
Oh, don't worry about me. I just haven't been getting enough rest.
Have you been staying up late analyzing the things the Tribunal left behind? Please, take your time. They're not going anywhere.
And I suppose neither will we, for some time. You're right, Cardinal. I'll take your advice to heart.
Speaking of the Tribunal's assets, I've also prepared an inventory list of what I've found so far if–
*knock knock*
Come in.
Lady Richelieu! Got a report to make!
Lady Clemenceau has gone to Sardegna to attend the World Expo!
With her gone, the Tribunal's the most vulnerable it's ever gonna be. So, now's the time to act if you wanna spring that Gali double agent plan into action!
You're still thinking about that? Sounds to me like taking an inventory is simply too demanding for you.
Hey! What's that supposed to mean?!
Filling out paperwork is sooo not my thing, alright? I'm tired of sitting around on my ass all day!
You don't really need me around here lifting boxes, right? Then, put me to good use and let me go do what I do best!
Or, hear me out here – you can just stay put.
We're almost finished here. After that, we'll go look for the Crown.
Le Terrible, you still haven't told me about how exactly we're going to locate the Crown.
I was just getting to that. You see, the Tribunal prepared a contingency plan in the event the Crown was stolen.
They developed a device that is capable of tracking down the Crown's location, and hid it somewhere on this island.
This device will be key to our ability to retrieve the Crown. Or... so the document I read says.
All that remains... is for us to wait around until the opportunity presents itself.
Huh? Wait around? Wouldn't the logical next step be to search for this device?
Uhh... We're people of faith, right?
I'm sure if we just keep waiting here, something good will happen~
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Cardinal Richelieu, the Eagle Union's fleet has docked at Saint Helena Island.
Additionally, Saint Louis is accompanying them. She sends her greetings.
Ah... Saint Louis, blueprint ship and holy knight. It's delightful to hear that another dependable ally joins our ranks.
Le Terrible, La Galissonnière, I'm sorry to cut our conversation short, but I must go and speak to the Eagle Union's representatives.
Richelieu left the room in a hurry, a multitude of important thoughts jostling around her head.
That Saint Louis is a powerful sword to have by our side.
Say, La Galissonnière, why don't you have a few training sessions with her? You did say you had nothing better to do, right?
Yeeeah... No. I've sparred with a blueprint ship before. Let's just say... it's a really bad memory.
Thanks for the concern, but I'll find another way of passing the time.
Come on. Surely it wasn't THAT bad.
Have you never met Gascogne before? You know how she can get...
Y'know, "Language processor cannot grasp meaning of 'reconcile.'"
Something-something, "Analysis: action deemed unnecessary."
That sort of stuff sticks with you for life.
Hmm... I see. That must've been quite hard on you.
By the way, do you still have some medicine left? I could use another phial.
Another? What happened to the extra one I gave you "just in case?"
Have you been dreaming about the black sun or something?
That... would be a secret.

sequence: A few days before the World Expo's closing
World Expo - Cathedral Pavilion

scripts.say: Inside the breakroom, the Vichya Dominion shipgirl Foch was diligently mopping the floor.
Sitting by a window not far from her was Joffre, engrossed in a book and completely indifferent to the girl trying to get her attention.
Hey, Joffre?
Joffre? Are you listening?
*sigh*... Miss Virtuous and Honorable Angel, if I may be so forward, would you please give me a hand?
Lady Clemenceau is staying here for the closing ceremony, you know. We really should tidy up the place for her.
I would argue it's tidy enough as it is.
Besides, there's no guarantee she'll actually come.
Therefore, we shouldn't bother? Are you implying you've heard something through the Tribunal's grapevine?
I'm not. I'm simply speculating based on recent events.
Do you know where Lady Clemenceau is right now, Foch?
Last I heard, she's on a sightseeing tour in Sardegna.
And, in two days, she's expected to appear for the Expo's closing ceremony.
Mhm. Do you know when Kersaint will arrive?
Kersaint? Yeah.
She'll be here tomorrow. I've heard she's gonna help us with a couple of closing ceremony arrangements.
Meaning, she's coming by herself. That fact strikes me as odd.
Really? I don't know too much about her, so... Why do you think it's odd?
Why? Because she's Lady Clemenceau's right-hand woman. She never acts alone under normal circumstances.
Unless...
Unless...?
It has happened before. The last time was when she acted alone in Toulon, a few years ago.
What's more, Lady Jean Bart also traveled to Toulon a few days prior at Lady Clemenceau's request.
Huh. Yeah, that's an eyebrow-raiser... So, armed with this information, what do you want me to do?
Firstly, please stop mopping. It's a waste of time.
Secondly...
Attendre et espérer.
Yes. Wait and hope.
NA Ocean - Secure Sea Passage
Since the downfall of Compiler, the waters of the NA Ocean had become considerably safer.
Apparently, a few old sea lanes even reopened for traffic while I was assisting on the Reality Lens project.
With my part finished in the development of the Type II rigging, I finally had the opportunity to attend the World Expo...
But unfortunately, the airspace above the NA Ocean was still not sufficiently safe for passenger aircraft. I had to go by sea, accompanied by a sizable escort fleet.
This weather is perfect for a cruise. Calm seas, clear skies, and a fair breeze.
But wow, I can hardly believe how quickly time flies. The World Expo is almost over...
It's a bummer we couldn't make it for its opening, but at least we'll get to enjoy the closing ceremony.
Commander, how do you feel abo– Hey! Put those away!
Helena, come here and take this paperwork away from the Commander!
This is supposed to be a holiday, for you and all of us. No work outside of your allotted hours!
...Working on a holiday at all is weird to begin with.
I know. Tell it to the Commander and see what response you get.
You don't have to work all the time, Commander. Can't you set your job aside for at least a few days?
"But, the new work doesn't care if I'm on vacation or not. It's not going to stop coming in."
"The more time I take off, the more my backlog grows."
And that's why a limited-work-hours compromise is the best I could get from the Commander.
That's... rough. You have an unenviable job, Commander.
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Hello, hello! This is battleship New Jersey!
I'm in charge of the escort fleet that'll guide you through the NA Ocean.
Meaning, you've got nothing to worry about! You'll be in good hands the whole way there!
Long time no see, New Jersey.
How long has it been? Since around Compiler's defeat, maybe? How have you been?
I've been great! Thanks for asking.
Well, I guess I've been a little bored – haven't seen any action for a while.
By the way, I've got good news, honey.
Ahem... This is a public channel. Please be professional.
Right, uh... Commander, good news.
Our patrols haven't spotted a single mass-produced Siren ship lately!
That's 10 – I repeat – 10 consecutive days without a single Siren in sight!
They used to be everywhere when Compiler was still around. Now that she's gone, it really feels like they went the way of the dodo!
"You make them sound like an endangered species, rather than a pressing existential threat."
Yeah, except it's a good thing!
Things are so peaceful that my day job now is just reading reports, patrolling, and gazing at the sea.
Makes me envy Enterprise, honestly. I wanna kick some Siren ass too!
Isn't peace what we're all fighting for? We should look forward to the day we don't have to fight anymore.
The peace we're enjoying right now is how things should be.
Besides, it's not like there's NOTHING to do. There are still pockets of Siren activity in the NA Ocean.
Then there's that fleet of Sirens that attacked the Royal Navy during their ceremony at Scapa Flow. Did we ever figure out where they came from?
You can always trust Memphis to get to the heart of any topic.
To answer your question – no clue!
After the Royal Navy repelled 'em, they just vanished into thin air.
In any case, we don't want a repeat of that. That's why I'm out here, patrolling.
If they ever come into my waters, I'm chasing them back to their stronghold and wiping them out for good!
"It was good to catch up with you, New Jersey, but I have to hang up now."
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Greetings, Commander. This is King George V of the Royal Navy.
We will accompany you on your trip to Sardegna.
You will enjoy not just the Eagle Union's protection on this journey, but the Royal Navy's as well.

options.content: "Thank you. It's reassuring to have you with us."

scripts.say: Don't mention it. You're headed to Europa, where it is the Royal Navy's duty to assist you.
Additionally, I have a message to you from Her Majesty.
She said the Royal Navy's pavilion will stay up for a while after the World Expo's closing.
However, it won't be open to the general public. Rather, Her Majesty has reserved a time slot just for you to visit.
Lastly, she will unfortunately not be able to attend the closing ceremony due to official business coming up last minute.
For all questions about our pavilion, speak to Illustrious. She handles the on-site side of things.
"Good lord. First she misses the opening ceremony due to that Mirror Sea incident, and now she's going to miss the closing ceremony too?"
"I thought she wouldn't miss the World Expo for... well, the world."
Believe me, she really wanted to attend. She prepared extensively for it, but it was sadly all for naught.
At any rate, Her Majesty hopes you have a wonderful time at the Expo.
Me too! Praying you have a great holiday, Commander!
"You don't need to hype this vacation up so much. Still, thank you."
"Hyping it up"? You've earned this. I can't even remember the last time you got some time off!
While I'm on the line – I should mention that I've heard reports of stray Sirens in the waters around Sardegna.
You can expect those parts to be a lot, lot more dangerous than here.
So, just to be safe, why don't I escort you all the way to the Expo?
Wouldn't want to be ambushed during the last leg of the journey, right?
I'm sure there's no ulterior motive behind this idea...
There's no need, New Jersey.
Once you pass the Strait of Gibraltar, Warspite will escort you to the Sardegnian mainland. After that, Illustrious will accompany the Commander to the Expo.
Between those two points, the Royal Navy shall ensure the Commander's safety in the Mediterranean Sea.
And besides, we have Essex with us. You just focus on keeping the NA Ocean safe.
Aww... Fiiiine, have it your way.
Somewhere, near the African east coast, a Sardegnian destroyer was heading home after an extended visit to Iron Blood's Floating Fortress.
Geesh. These waters are always crawling with Sirens.
At least I should be in the clear at this point...
Looking back at it now, I learned a lot during my stay.
About technology, about the Floating Fortress, about Sakura Empire rituals and folklore...
In fact, this could make an excellent travel story if you cut out the boring bits.
I can already picture da Recco's and the girls' excited faces when I tell them all about it!
I'll have to make a good show out of it. Maximize the return, and so on...
But before I do any of that, I'm going to really rest up when I get home.
It's been too long since I had a bath in the thermae, slept in a soft bed, and tasted authentic pizza...
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
A call? From Lady Littorio?
Oh! I bet she has a new mission for me!
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Right... Ahem!
This is Carabiniere speaking! I hope you've been well, Lady Littorio!
I have, thank you. How has your home trip been?
Well, I've encountered a couple of Siren fleets, but nothing particularly dangerous!
No injuries sustained! Although they did deplete my ammo reserves a bit.
That's good to hear. I want to apologize for calling you back so suddenly – especially considering you're out there alone.
It's a small wonder you're safe and sound, but I'm glad for it. I'm setting up a welcome-back banquet for you, so look forward to that.
What?! Please, don't be absurd! I've only done my duty!
I haven't done anything to earn a banquet, big or small!
I think you have. You've been away from home a long time. Don't you miss our cuisine?
Well, I do. If you insist, then I'll gladly accept!
Great. I haven't worked out the details of the banquet yet – I'll start on those after I return to Rome. I'm in Venice right now.
Of course! Please take care of whatever business you have first.
...Wait, why are you in Venice?
I've heard the World Expo needs extra staff for the closing ceremony, so I assumed you'd be in Rome...
You see, the Expo was originally to be held in Venice.
However, that plan changed after Veneto and I came across a suspicious discovery.
You probably haven't heard, but our Senate has been quietly routing historical artifacts through Venice.
Not just before the Expo, but even during it as well.
Veneto and I launched an investigation, and we discovered that the artifacts have all ended up in Marco Polo's possession.
What's more, she has been sending some of them to places all over the Mediterranean.
Some were sent to the Expo to be put on display. Or at least, that's what we thought.
Because we've been unable to locate them. They aren't in our pavilion, or in the storage room beneath the Colosseum. Nobody knows where they've gone.
This is theft on a massive scale, but done in such a weird way, wouldn't you say?
Yes, it does smell very fishy...
Maybe Marco Polo has her reasons for it. Have you asked her about it?
Of course I have. She wouldn't tell me anything more than that it's part of a secret operation planned by the Senate's higher-ups.
That's why I'm in Venice – to personally find out what's going on.
I see... Now, I assume that since you told me all this, you want me to help with your investigation, correct?
What? No. This has nothing to do with you. I simply got sidetracked.
I have something else in mind for you. Instead of going to the Expo, I'd like you to go to the Suez Canal and ensure the exit lane's safety.
Oh, and one more thing...
If you happen to catch sight of anyone from the Dragon Empery, do let me know.
They left the Expo fairly early, saying they had to rush back home. It's only a gut feeling, but...
They might not have gone very far at all. Call me if you see them.
Understood!
Supposing I do run into them, what then? Should I avoid contact with them?
Not at all. Say hello, be polite, flatter them, the entire Sardegnian special.
Heck, try to spend some extra time with them if at all possible.
I want to know why they left the Expo, yet decided to linger in Europa's waters.
Flatter them, you say...? Um, will do!
Thanks, Carabiniere.
Call me when you have something to report. Good luck.
A dream. A dream of one possible future. Its dreamer – Shinano.
A wind chime rang. Then, the sound of overlapping waves.
The sky was dark as soot. Beneath it, a long column of torii dyed a vivid red.
The line between illusion and reality, the interstices between dreams...
A place seldom seen, as the dream usually presents itself immediately...
Nevertheless... This one has been here before, a few times...
The torii split the world into two halves. From opposite sides, the winds brought crashing waves into each other, in defiance of the laws of nature.
The realm of illusion can be calm at some times, chaotic at others...
Tonight... It appears particularly at unrest...
An ill omen, that is... My dream shan't be a pleasant one...
In her dream, Shinano saw a scene from the "past."
