I remember now... When I first arrived in this city, we met... But I still don't understand you one bit!
Sorry, but I'm not one of your missing friends!
Let's just say I misjudged the situation.
Right now, every second counts. A dangerous ritual nears completion.
You all must work together to stop its fruition – however, the concert needs to proceed as planned.
Take these moths to snap them out of their trance.
Vicksburg... Harrison... John Rodgers!
Bennington receives the three moths and rushes back to stage.
Obey the moths if you want to live. Moths! Dance before the flames!
Once Bennington was gone, Bristol remained there.
After a while, all of her moths returned, having replaced their blue hues with a pure-white radiance and a rainbow aura.
Information on the Commander received... along with my reward.
Thanks for picking me as your temporary collaborator.
Per your instructions, Vicksburg's show will go on.
The other three will search for Saratoga, Soobrazitelny, and Pamiat' Merkuria. That is, if the latter is willing to be found.
Essex is searching for Miss D per the Commander's orders. She has a solid lead, so that ought to work out fine.
As for Bristol... Well, it seems it's time for me to say goodbye again.
Farewell, struggling moths.
If you remember your identities as shipgirls, then I hope you'll realize that running around isn't the only way to do recon anymore.
With that, the legendary investigator bowed slowly to her empty audience and vanished amidst a sudden burst of flames.
When the blue current struck, everybody's mind cleared, allowing them to remember everything.
They rode the current like a waterway, leaving the Astral Tower behind.
What in the world is going on here?
Astrarium had changed.
Different districts had been pieced together randomly like a jumbled puzzle.
Skyscrapers pierced waterways, and rocks sat atop trees. Towering buildings stood before ruins.
Black, viscous liquid like crude oil oozed from the seams, pooling into a dark ocean on the city streets.
Shapeless black shadows roamed in hordes, as if searching for prey.
Whoa... What happened to the city?!
Astrarium has always been a city of anomalies... Maybe this is it showing its true form.
I feel like I've been dreaming... I was just a normal girl – not myself.
We're shipgirls. How could we have forgotten something so important?
And Richard is the mastermind... Worse, she has the power to destroy the whole city.
We have to stop her... Let's complete this mission and go home safe!
That's exactly what I plan to do! As for the three vendors, which one should we search for first?
Let's start with the genius mechanic Soobrazitelny. She's the one who loaned us those robots, after all!
What better backup than a whole robot army?
KABOOOOM!
Hahahaaah! Weak! Too weak! Tremble before my legion of machines!
Amidst the chaotic ocean, there was one small island governed by order.
No matter how the grotesque mob tried to attack, they all faced the same destruction.
So Astrarium has finally come to this...
I guess it was meant to be, in the end.
Just can't believe that even I fell for the trap called comfort...
Scary, indeed.
KABOOOOM!
The genius mechanic looked upward and spotted three figures approaching from afar.
They were clearly approaching her without hesitation.
This is Bennington, Essex-class aircraft carrier, speaking on the public channel!
Hello? Genius Mechanic Soobrazitelny, can you hear me? The city's in real danger, and it needs your help!
Hmm... The cloaking should have collapsed along with the city.
What fascinating girls.
BEEP BEEP!
Soobrazitelny speaking. It's good to see normal people amidst all the chaos!
I'm in. If you've got a plan, then lead the way!
Quiet prevailed here under the moonlight.
The chaos of the city had yet to reach this area, leaving this shop peaceful for now.
The charming shopkeeper, though armed to the teeth, sat quietly at the entrance and gazed up at the moon.
Today, a repeat of yesterday...
And tomorrow the same.
If all is a dream...
KABOOOOM!
The sounds of battle drew nearer.
I am Saratoga.
Saratoga of the Council's First Task Force. The one you've been waiting for.
So it's time for me to join the fight.
Goodbye, Richard...
She locked a small padlock on the door.
The storefront was left deserted as combat intensified in the distance.
Thanks to the guidance of carrier-based aircraft, the party was able to press forward through the jumbled space.
Eventually, they reached the place where PM Plaza should be.
Yet the lot remained vacant, with the shopkeeper nowhere to be found.
Pamiat' Merkuria still hasn't been seen since that day...
If we can't find her, then that's that. We need to get back to Astral Tower.
Who knows how bad things are back there?!
The jumbled space began to reconfigure itself anew.
Either by design or by pure coincidence, a direct passage to the Astral Tower appeared.
Huh? Did Pamiat' make this passage for us?!
Thanks, Pamiat' Merkuria!
There was no response.
However, one gaze watched silently from afar as the fleet vanished into the distance.

sequence: Astral Tower - 170th Floor
Star's Dream Terrace Stage
Approximately 8:00 PM

scripts.say: Lights burst to life, and music began to play. The newbie idol took a deep breath and stepped forth onto the stage.
I may have awakened from that dream, but there's still something I must do.
Richard... I'm going to deliver a flawless performance, for the sake of stopping your plans.

sequence: "A world that falls apart at the slightest touch."
"The black bird calls out a name."
"Soaring over rooftops, grazing dreams."
"Close your eyes."
"That stench is but the hearth's smoke."
"Falling tears are but rain upon the street."
"If all is a dream..."
"Then may I still be caressed by the scent of flowers."
"Today, a repeat of yesterday..."
"And tomorrow the same."
"If all is a dream..."
"Then may I still be caressed by the scent of flowers."
"A life of peace and bliss..."
"Living on, in ignorance."

scripts.say: A pleasant song rang out from the starlit stage.
Vicksburg's concert had finally begun.
Meanwhile...
Check this out, Professor! The CEO's office has a view of the concert stage AND the rest of the city!
It is a nice view... You really can see everything in the city from here.
Surrounded by an outer ring, the city almost looks like a giant magic circle. From this vantage point, three letter-shaped skyscrapers stand out.
The ruler of this city had never even tried to hide her identity. Anybody who visited this office could see it as clear as day.
Professor Detective, I've had fun these past few days.
So much fun...
But every vacation has to come to an end eventually. We still have our work to do as detective and assistant.
Have you found the recording, Professor?
She casually sits down on a couch, closes her eyes, and asks me one simple question.
The "stolen" disk sits plainly on the low table in front of her.
It's just sitting out in the open, huh?
Yep. What a careless thief. They didn't even try to hide it!
She opens her eyes. Despite a flicker of hesitation, she quickly returns to her usual smile.
Well, Professor. Hand over the disk.
Do that, and your mission is complete.
She raises a hand, but instead of reaching directly for the disk, she points at me.
I knew it... Something will happen specifically if I hand it to you, right?
It's a new song. Why don't we listen to it together first?
My best course of action is to stall for time.
The opening number she's singing right now is my new song.
You heard it a bunch of times during practice.
The title they know is just a fake one, that's all.
Its real name is Pandora's Wish.
You taught somebody else your new song?!
For some reason, that's the first thought that comes to mind.
I lost my stage and my audience a long time ago... but she's different.
You're saying it's time to put an end to this.
Heheh~ Maybe not yet. Let's wait a little.
Richard smiles sweetly.
We put so much work into this concert. It'd be a waste if we didn't enjoy it, right?
You still haven't answered the question that will put this case to rest: the name of the culprit.
For now, at least... we're still professor and assistant, okay? So let's watch together.
...Okay.
I sit across from Richard and slip the disk into my pocket.
Some time later, the concert was drawing to a close.
After remaining silent for the entirety of the show, Bon Homme Richard finally spoke.
Professor, I was waiting until after the concert to tell you the truth...
But what are you waiting for?
A potential turning point.
You mean the fan club running around the city?
So you really don't know.
Know... what?
You're acting under multiple restrictions. That's why you can't freely wield your power.
The reason Richard Black hasn't shown herself even once is because of that limitation. Isn't that right?
Heheh.
She does not answer.
Have you never considered that she and I might be two separate entities?
You tell me. Are you?
Richard still doesn't give a firm answer, instead looking at me wistfully.
Despite knowing it's an act, I decide to voice my initial theory.
To be honest... when you first appeared in that classroom, I really did think you were a separate entity.
Because your presence there seemed to be a guarantee of your harmlessness by the Antiochus.
But... in the end, you're just Richard.
You deceived both the Antiochus and Observer Zero.
That's nothing worth writing home about. Zero was never all that smart after all~
..."Zero"?
Yup. In the end, it was all a part of HER plan.
Wait... Zero... isn't Observer Zero?
What's the difference between you and the Commander?
I am the Commander.
Then she's Observer Zero.
That's hardly an answer...
Your fault for trying to waste time with idle conversation.
What kind of professor tries to make the student provide all the answers?
Silence rules again as the concert reaches its final song.
Blue Spirit.
She was practicing this song when we first met... Look how far she's come.
Time flies, huh? The concert is about to end...
You didn't realize who I really am until just recently, right? How'd you figure it out?
How did YOU realize that I knew?
Aha! Another question answered with a question. You really wanna be that cagey with me?
Well, I don't mind answering this one.
After you went to the bathroom, you started looking at me differently.
I could tell that you were trying to hide it, but I'm kind of a professional.
So there are things you don't know, too.
I had to make a lot of sacrifices to trick Zero.
That includes the restrictions you deduced... and a lot more.
But once you hand me that master recording, all of this will be over.
What happens after that?
If you wanted to be with me forever after that, I would certainly welcome that~
After the curtain call, the stage lights dimmed. The concert was over.
Professor Detective, your assistant has a question for you. Who was the culprit?
It was you, Bon Homme Richard. You staged the theft of the master recording and set up all of this.
Bingo! You are so smart.
I'll be taking that recording now.
If you can't pick it up yourself, then I see no reason to hand it over.
Great deduction, but you've overlooked something.
If you've got your memories back, then you should remember what happened under the tree in the garden.
Under the tree... in the garden?
Hand over the disk.
(Damn... I forgot!)
(I can't... control myself!)
Defying my will, my hand reaches into my pocket and slowly pulls out the disk. Then, it extends toward the smiling girl.
Just as Richard's fingers are about to touch the disk, there's a deafening crash as her window shatters.
WAIT, WAIT, WAAAIT!
Assistant! Assistant, I'm here to help!
Tch...
As soon as Miss D appears, Richard vanishes. The world outside undergoes a drastic transformation.

sequence: "A world that falls apart at the slightest touch."
"Close your eyes."

scripts.say: The dream beneath the neon lights has been shattered.
When Miss D smashed through the window, she also tore away the false illusions shrouding the Astral Tower, thus revealing the true form of Astrarium.
Dilapidated and desolate...
The anomalies here were never truly anomalies – they were the city's true essence seeping through.
Its prosperity was only an illusion. This is the true Astrarium.
The magic circle beneath the city lights up and ascends into the sky.
Everybody doing battle within the city rises up to the height of the CEO's office along with it.
Miss D clings to me like a koala. Bennington, Vicksburg, Harrison, and John Rodgers are here as well.
Along with the META Soobrazitelny, Saratoga, and Essex.
However, Pamiat', Bristol, and Collett are nowhere to be found.
You were all META after all... You hid the truth well.
It's been a while, Commander. Last we met was in the mountains of Anchorage.
Do you remember all of that? If so... then who are you, really?
Could she really be the same Essex who was working with the Ashes?
This is the first time I've seen her awake ever since she fell into a coma during the "perfect future" incident.
Well, excluding all the times I'd seen her as a detective over these past days, of course.
My mind is still a mess...
But I think I may have really survived that.
Just as I don't know how I came to this city, I also don't know what happened after I was swallowed up by the vector zone...
I see... Well, what matters is that you're okay. We can figure the rest out with time.
What about Bristol and Collett?
I think the legendary investigator has gone into hiding. As for Collett, well... I'm sorry to say.
I understand. Do you know anything about the other two vendors?
They both happen to have their own issues at hand.
One claims to be a member of the Council's First Task Force, but she recognizes neither Enterprise nor me.
The other one says she's from an organization called "Dawn", but I've never heard of such a thing...
I don't think now is the time to dwell on that.
Besides, you won't get much thinking done in this chaos.
Essex looks up at Richard, who floats in the distance.
I need more time to get ready, so you all just make yourselves at home!
She smiles and waves.
Richard is under some kind of restriction right now – it seems she won't be able to use her true power unless somebody actively gives her the master recording.
Where is it now?
I have it. But... she has the power to control people with her words.
Best we take her down sooner rather than later.
Agreed.
One more thing: can you get in contact with Enterprise?
If we could just get her help...
I'm sorry, but it isn't possible.
I thought you might say that.
Having chosen to fight Richard now, each ship launches her own attack on the enemy.
KABOOOOM!
Boom! You're surrounded, Richard!
Please just surrender, Richard!
The army of dark shadows is as frail as ever, each going down in one blow.
Her inability to summon stronger enemies is further proof of her current weakness.
You really... had us fooled for so long!
*sniffle*... You've gone too far!
See what you've done, Richard?
Heheh... Sorry. I have my reasons.
But if you just hand over the disk, I promise everybody will get to go home safe. How about it?
Hahah! Why would we do that when we have the upper hand?
True. I can't get my power back without that disk, and that's why you're trying to take me down now. Isn't that right, Professor?
But take a closer look. Do I look like I've taken any damage?
Despite having taken constant attacks since the start of the battle, Richard is unwounded. Her clothes and hair remain unruffled.
She just watches the battle rage on with a smile, as if quietly waiting for something.
What are you waiting for?
For my restrictions to wear off, of course~
Come on. You didn't think I'd make it so I couldn't free myself, did you?
I know that. That's why...
You're too weak~ Sorry, Professor, but you lose!
Heeheeheeheehee!
Allow me to reintroduce myself! I am Bon Homme Richard, and you're totally surrounded – by me!
Shit...
The magic circle shatters, and all of us begin to fall.
AAAAAAH!

sequence: Were we simply too late because our firepower was lacking?

scripts.say: As Miss D stops me from falling, I can finally get a look at what's going on around me.
Kometa's advance is accelerating...
Soobrazitelny attempts to stabilize her position in the air using her mech.
You're too late, genius mechanic!
Bang!
Richard makes a finger gun with her right hand. Suddenly, Soobrazitelny and her robotic army all turn to ash.
What?!
Richard, you...
Saratoga releases control of her aircraft and gazes silently at the approaching enemy.
Good night, Sara.
Bang!
She, too, turns to ash along with her planes.
I have to do something about this...
Snooping from the sidelines isn't very fair, legendary investigator!
Black wind tears through glowing moths, outlining a hidden figure.
H-hahaha... Guess you found me.
Nobody likes uninvited guests, you know.
Then I'd better take my leave–
Bang!
Bristol transforms into an eclipse of moths, but they're instantly turned into ash. Only a few of them manage to escape into the distant fog.
You're next, Miss Detective.
Richard appears like a phantom next to Essex.
What are you trying to do here, really?
Is this my dream? Or...
Bang!
Not gonna happen!
Two dark forces collide. After a struggle, Essex is slammed into the ruins below.
Heheh, and next up...
Richard turns her attention to Bennington's fleet.
They can't withstand her attacks!
Oh... That's it!
Understood. D, help us approach the target. We'll proceed from there.
How many times do I have to say it?! No whale, no dice! Not happening!
Fine. I'll do it for you, then.
Resource diversion, data transfer mode.
Hwuh? What's going on? Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Miss D! Back in the Martyrium, you said you couldn't get close to Rodney without your whale.
Now that you have the whale, can you use it to save everybody?!
Hmm... I'll try it!
But keep Richard away, or else she'll catch me!
So I have to distract her?
(There's no other way, now that she has her power again.)
(Hopefully this will still be enough to entice her...)
Throw this into the air as hard as you can!
Miss D throws the master recording disk up into the sky. As expected, Richard chases after it.
Now! Let's save them!
The rescue went smoothly.
After catching the disk, Richard stopped in mid-air for a while, seemingly inspecting it.
Meanwhile, after being subjected to five teleports courtesy of Miss D, we had united with Bennington's fleet on the seas outside of Astrarium.
What? You used the master recording as bait?!
All for our sake... I'm sorry that we turned out to be such a burden.
Not at all. Richard already had her power back anyway.
None of this is anybody's fault. Our enemy is just too strong... She's not somebody you should have to fight.
US? No, she's not somebody YOU should have to fight, either!
We're shipgirls. You're not!
But my assistant is a member of the Council. That makes my assistant strong!
Council...?
If we're just going to make small talk all day, then I'm leaving.
Hold on. Do you have a way to get out of this place?
Well, no. But if I die, I die.
Good grief... All of you Ashes say that.
(Let's calm down and figure this out.)
(Richard appeared in one of Zero's experiments.)
(Things are spiraling out of control now, but there's no way that she came unprepared.)
(But what CAN she do? What is she willing to do?)
(The only thing in Astrarium connected to the Antiochus would be Miss D herself.)
(Helena recognized Miss D's importance – that's why she had Bristol guard her.)
(Richard is clearly wary of her, too... Why?)
(Is it the whale? Or Death's Scythe itself?)
(Bristol's moths didn't all get eliminated. A few of them managed to drift off into the fog.)
(The fog shrouding Astrarium... Based on the angle of that overpass, it must lead out of the city.)
(Could Death's Scythe... cut through the fog?)
Given the situation, this might just be our only chance of escape.
Heheh~ Recording confirmed. Did you get enough rest, Professor?
Let's get back to our slaughter♪
Didn't you say you'd send us all home safe once you had the disk?
As I bought time, I tried to think of the password needed to activate Death's Scythe.
(Knowing Dr. Aoste, there must be a password. What could it be?)
I've changed my mind. It's not like you have any power over the situation, anyway.
Richard, can you see the fog outside the city?
What of it?
That's our escape route.
Miss D, activate Death's Scythe!
The colossal whale soars skyward, creating a rift in the distant fog.
It's only a sliver, so small that one wouldn't notice without looking closely.
A wriggling white substance pushes through the gap, assimilates into the fog, and gradually overcomes it.
Then, the clouds, sea, and even Astrarium itself...

sequence: ...As if the Kingdom of God has been created anew.

scripts.say: After we left the alley behind with Detective Essex, she opens up an old atlas.
Moths fly from the pages, glowing faintly. They guide us through the steel labyrinth until we reach the entrance to an underground passage, blocked by piles of debris.
Umm... Miss Detective, this... isn't the "safehouse" you were talking about before, is it?
You sleep here?
Richard tugs at my sleeve nervously.
Well, no.
This is a safe passage to the lower city that only opens at this time of day.
The... lower city?
Goodness. You really didn't do your research on Astrarium, did you?
Essex pushes aside the debris and steps into the passage.
Professor, should we run away when she isn't looking?
Aren't you curious what the lower city is like?
Just from the name, it sounds shabby and gross...
But... An underground safehouse used by a detective does sound kinda interesting.
We've come this far. Let's stay a night and see what happens.
Okay. Whatever you say, Professor!
After we'd descended a good ten stories or so, Essex found a freight elevator.
A five-minute ride later, and we were presented with a sight totally unlike the rest of Astrarium.
This is the lower city – Old Town Astrarium.
Don't worry. It might look run-down, but it's plenty safer than the upper city.
There are fewer rules and restrictions, too... Oh, I suppose you wouldn't know about those. Well, we can talk about them at the safehouse.
Anyway, once you get familiar with these streets, you can use them to get around while bypassing the anomalies of the upper city.
The glowing moths guide us through a few more paths until we arrive at a spacious room.
I notice tasteful wallpapering, a warm fireplace, bookshelves, cabinets, a desk, and a board plastered with notes.
What do you think? Not bad, right?
Yeah! It's better than I imagined~ This is totally detective chic!
Professor, let's stay the night here!
By the way, Miss Detective, are all of those sticky notes on the board different anomalies in the city?
Can I take a look at them? And the notes on your desk, too?
Richard instantly makes herself at home and begins rummaging around the safehouse to sate her curiosity.
I allow myself to relax for a moment and organize the information at hand.
We came to Astrarium together and met Detective Essex...
Is that all, though?
The fog lingering in my mind seems to indicate that my line of reasoning is missing something vitally important.
But I just can't remember anything...
Looks like that's another mystery for me to solve.
Amidst the undulating expanse of white, the girl on the throne waves at me.
It's a relief to see you well.
Though it's only been a few days, yet again you find yourself in peril.
Hierophant, who'd no doubt been waiting outside for the perfect opportunity to invade Astrarium, sits upon the throne.
You can talk now?!
*sigh*... Look.
Do you have any idea what's really going on in this city?
Well. You wouldn't understand anyway, I guess.
Heeey! Did you come to do violence with us, or what?
What a pain... Let me go deal with this, and then we can discuss your evacuation.
Oh, right. Put this on, and it'll keep you safe.
She plucks white strands from the white mass, weaves them into a crown, and places it on my head.
Ooh. Not half bad.
From there, she weaves a few more.
These are for Death and the other girls. Wouldn't want them getting hurt, would we?
Helloooo? You coming or not?
Are you readyyy?
Heeere I cooome!
DE▅VO▊▇UR▇▅▆ALL▇▆▅
KABOOOOM!
The armies of Hierophant and Bon Homme Richard collide.
Space itself seems to be torn in two by the impacts ranging from sea to sky.
Miss D, Bennington's fleet, and I hold our ground near shore, awaiting the outcome of the conflict.
Say, um... Are those white... "things" friends of yours?
They're allies. For now, at least.
For now...?
Have you ever heard of the Antiochus?
Antiochus... Nope, never heard of 'em!
What about Sirens?
We do know about Sirens.
Until we ended up in this city, we were in constant conflict with them.
They're those terrifying machines that look like sea creatures!
We've been fighting them forever now!
That makes this simple. Sirens and Antiochus – and, by extension, Hierophant's army – are one and the same.
Huh?
Antiochus evolved from their original forms to what we see today, without us even realizing.
RUMBLE...
Not bad... Not bad at all! Hierophant, you know how to keep a girl entertained!
I didn't think you'd be able to come this close to me!
So that's the path that the Antiochus chose, since they can't undergo METAmorphosis!
Out of deference to our past relationship, I will grant you peace, Bon Homme Richard.
Well, you're still just as arrogant as ever. Let's see if you've got the strength to back those words up!
We've attracted some attention here, {playername}. There are people who want to join the fight.
And they seem to be friends of yours. Shall I let them in?
(People who want to join the fight? Could it be?!)
Yes, please!
Alright, then.
It doesn't look as if she's done anything special – but suddenly, Miss D's communicator begins to beep.
Phew... We have FINALLY found you!
Do you have what it takes to keep going?
Commander! Sorry we're late!
(Elizabeth META and the Compiling Field...)
(I see. If Helena really wanted to come here, then even Hierophant probably couldn't hold her back.)
So far, so good. Hierophant has taken our side, but we're still up against Bon Homme Richard. Be careful.
Oh? How we would have liked to settle this quickly while you sang our praises... Perhaps we should prepare the train, after all.
The Compiling Field is locking on to your coordinates. Reinforcements will come soon!
Heeheehee! The more, the merrier! Bring everybody you want!
RUMBLE...
Dieu et mon droit.
The Queen's Light rode high in the sky, leaving a golden trail like a shooting star. It carved a thin, yet clear boundary between the battling white and black.
Wooow, that train is pretty!
Are you test site beta's trump card?
Honi soit qui mal y pense.
Golden light radiated from the train, dispelling the darkness and transforming it into crimson-armored giants.
Ooh, that's a cool move!
Awesome! Okay, I'm ready! Hit me with your best shot!
RUMBLE...
High in the sky, a blue storm appeared. Within it, one could faintly see a courtyard.
Do not... lay a finger on the Commander!
A blue figure clad in thunder instantly shatters Richard's hovering figure.
However, she appears again moments later in the fog.
Long time no see, Yorktown.
You shouldn't have come here~ Ashes to ashes, and dust to dust...
Bang!
Yorktown turns to ash, but she materializes anew in a bolt of lightning.
Huh?
As if in response to Richard's attack, lightning strikes and shatters her again.
Heh. If you don't wanna catch up, then you'll just have to join the party. Come on! There's more violence for everybody!
RUMBLE...
A battle defying all logic unfolded in every corner of this space.

Lightning bloomed into flowers, black fog turned into giants, and matter was conjured from nothing, only to be obliterated moments after. It was as if the laws of physics had a mind of their own here.
However, black fog continued to rule over half of the area. That hadn't changed with Hierophant's arrival, nor with Elizabeth's or Yorktown's.
We can't keep dragging this on... Commander, retreat immediately!
I've fully stabilized the perimeter of the controlled area. Those who want to evacuate, prepare now.
So this is the legendary Bon Homme Richard. She's many times more formidable than the rumours suggested!
Should we escape on the train?
All aboard, everybody. That includes you, Yorktown.
...Alright.
Hierophant, what will you do?
Heheh. Should you be worrying about me right now? I'm the last person you need to worry about here – apart from Richard.
Once you all leave, I'll make my exit, too.
In that case...
Bennington, take the others and wait on the train.
Yorktown, Elizabeth, Hierophant. Put a little more pressure on Richard to get her attention for a while.
What are you plotting?
Interesting...
No... It isn't worth the risk!
I want to avoid leaving any loose ends. Just this once, let me take the risk.
Miss D's massive whale prepares for a strike.
The three of them say nothing else and return to clashing with the fog.
Miss D, prepare Death's Scythe. We're aiming for Richard's master recording disk this time.
Let's take back what we've lost!
Hell yeah!
RUMBLE...
During their combined attack, the moment I've been waiting for finally comes.
Oh, my.
Bon Homme Richard's smiling face appears mere inches in front of me.
Got you!
With Miss D's help, I manage to steal the disk back from her. In no time, I'm back in the train door.
Elizabeth, let's go!
Leaving already, Professor?
I wanted to give you a gift as thanks for hanging out with me!
Just sharing some information in good faith~
Hahaha! Don't worry, it's just information.
You wanna destroy me, but you don't know how, right?
The method is really simple, and I'm happy to tell you how~
What the hell are you saying?
Pandora is my core. Destroy it, and you'll destroy me.
In other words, the fact that I'm still alive... must mean that Pandora is out there somewhere, riiight?
Pandora... No! How can that be?
But wasn't it...
Caught you with your pants down!
A black whirlwind suddenly changes form and lunges toward the train like a spear.
Prepare for withdrawal!
Hahahaha! Buh-bye! See you again soon!
Amidst a golden glow, the Queen's Light leaves Richard and her devious trap behind.
Instantly, the world outside the windows becomes an endless void, assuring us that we're finally safe.

sequence: Queen's Light
Shortly afterwards...

scripts.say: A wave of tension ran through me. I slumped into my seat, feeling like my heart might burst out of my chest.
Miss D sat curled up in the corner, unusually silent as she drew circles on the floor with her finger.
We got it back... from Bon Homme Richard...
Things within the train car were changing.
Bennington, Vicksburg, Harrison, John Rodgers, and Essex META were gradually becoming transparent.
According to Yorktown META, they were merely awakening from a dream and returning to where they'd started, so there was nothing to worry about.
As for her, she was gradually fading away as well.
Everybody calls you the Commander, so I think I shall do the same.
Farewell, Commander. I hope to see you at one of my concerts someday.
Thanks for helping us out for a while. Let us treat you again next time~
I can't believe you were apparently such a big deal. If I knew, I would've networked a little better...
I have mature adult plans... so let's talk about them next time we meet! Don't forget, you got it?
I've lost all of the footage I shot... Guess that means this really was like a dream.
But I'll never forget this adventure!
I'm gonna write it into a short drama when we get back. Can't wait to hear your thoughts on it!
Until we meet again, Commander.
After they all disappeared, Yorktown sat down quietly beside me.
Though I understood that their fading away was harmless... the fact that she wouldn't make eye contact with me was unsettling.
Are you sure you're okay? Richard got a good hit on you.
That finger gun thing? Don't worry, I'm just fine.
She takes my hand, unfurls my trembling fist, and takes the contents.
The recording disk is slick with blood.
Was I holding on to it that hard? I didn't even notice.
Your bravery is commendable, and I'm impressed by what you accomplished... but you shouldn't have put yourself in so much danger.
You should be reprimanded for your recklessness...
Coolness washes over my palm. As Yorktown pulls her hands away, I see my bloody hand return to normal.
I'll take the disk. Promise me you won't take any risks like that again?
I have a responsibility as the Commander. If the situation calls for it... I can't hesitate.
Just like today.
I see... Well, I'd better go.
I'll analyze this disk. If anything comes up, contact Memphis.
Without waiting for my response, Yorktown disappears from the train car.
The world goes silent. Elizabeth drives on wordlessly, and Miss D continues to draw circles on the floor.
That starlit dream was over.
Its end was just as desolate as its beginning.
If there was any difference, it would be that only one person would come home this time.
The girl named Pandora would never return.
Or... would she?

sequence: A sweet dream, cruelly shattered.
Many questions left unanswered.
Many truths left concealed.
Clues overlooked.
Symbols neglected.
Perhaps...
Our traveler never knew anything from the start.
However...
Sometimes, to survive is to win.
Isn't that right?

scripts.say: Some time passed after the fight was over.
Storms subsided, giants disappeared, and the dueling white mass and black fog were gone.
All that remained was a sea of wreckage...
And one girl, who kept on singing in the midst of it all.

sequence: "A world that falls apart at the slightest touch."
"The black bird calls out a name."
"Soaring over rooftops, grazing dreams."

Depths of the Astrarium

<size=45>43 Pandora's Wish</size>
"That stench is but the hearth's smoke."
"Falling tears are but rain upon the street."
"If all is a dream..."
"Then may I still be caressed by the scent of flowers."
"Today, a repeat of yesterday..."

Depths of the Astrarium

<size=45>43 Pandora's Wish</size>
"If all is a dream..."
"Then may I still be caressed by the scent of flowers."
"A life of peace and bliss..."
"Living on, in ignorance."

scripts.say: Too bad, Professor... I'm afraid you lose.
With a wave of her hand, the stolen disk appeared in her grasp once more.
Once you've given me something, there's no taking it back – it's still mine.
Guess your plan has ended in failure, huh, Zero?
Honestly, I can't tell what you went through all that risk to achieve.
Not that it matters anymore.
She snapped her fingers powerfully.
With that snap, the world changed.
Eheheh~♪
In a space that one might call a shelter...
That was close... Good thing I prepared for this in advance.
What a terrifying place... and what a terrifying person, too.
Find what you were looking for yet?
I think...
How many loops has it been now?
Too many to count. Fortunately, all of those variables have accumulated to create real change.
Have we... really escaped?
Yep. Without a doubt.
It was almost too easy. Is it because of those blue moths?
What were those?
Help from a mysterious outsider.
Anyway, let's go. We've got places to be.
Where are we going undercover this time?
We don't have to be undercover for this one. See, I've found some great leads worth following up on.
Remember Soobrazitelny? The genius mechanic who referred to herself as part of "Dawn"?
It can't be...
Wasn't she torn to shreds by Naraka, right before our eyes?
You're not saying she SURVIVED that, are you?
Hmm... Calling her a survivor would be kind of a stretch.
She got torn to shreds all over again during that battle, after all.
Tell me... Do you think we'll see her again?

sequence: Test Site Beta
Royal Navy - Gate of Avalon
A few days later

scripts.say: After what would be later called the Astrarium Incident, I came down with a serious illness.
It was the first time I'd gotten so sick since taking up my post at PH Harbor.
For the sake of my safety and my recovery, I heeded Elizabeth and my doctors' advice and took a few weeks' vacation at the Gate of Avalon.
This forced me to reduce my workload and reprioritize the various tasks that needed my attention.
After I'd enjoyed a few days of rest and relaxation, the Northern Parliament and Iron Blood's joint expedition fleet arrived.
Shortly after our return from the Holy Unitas Empire, the Northern Parliament had received a call for help from Kirov META, who had departed to act on her own.
The message was accompanied by precise test site coordinates and a rough situation report.
After Kirov had gone missing, the Northern Parliament was joined by the Iron Blood, who was always keen to explore other test sites, and thus formed a joint expedition force.
The Dragon Empery also sent some personnel, hoping to use this opportunity to collect data.
Expedition forces across test sites fell under the jurisdiction of the Azur Lane.
The Northern Parliament had already sent me an invitation, and I had considered leading a fleet to observe the test site myself.
However, given my current state, that had to be cancelled.
Since the fleet is setting sail from Camelot, I'm present to conduct a review before they depart.
We serve only as a vanguard force for recon purposes. Once the situation there is clear, we will decide on our next course of action.
Led by Bismarck, the Iron Blood fleet comprises Tirpitz, Peter Strasser, Odin, their respective flotillas, and an independent flotilla of submarines.
Focus on your recovery, Comrade Commander. We promise to return safe and sound.
The Northern Parliament fleet, led by Sovetsky Soyuz, comprises Kronstadt, Kuybyshev, Kursk, Chkalov, and Volga, along with two escort flotillas made up of cruisers and destroyers.
Just leave this to us, Commander.
Finally, An Shan leads the Dragon Empery fleet. She's accompanied by Fu Shun, Chang Chun, and Tai Yuan. Joining these four guided-missile destroyers are a group of Dongyu arsenal ships.
You're all aware of the risks of expeditions to other test sites, so I'll save you the boring lecture.
Proceed with caution and get a grasp of the situation as soon as is feasible.
The Royal Navy will provide full support. If you need anything, let them know at once.
If necessary, I will personally lead a reinforcement fleet.
I wish you a smooth journey and successful mission – and above all else, a safe return.
A star blazed on in the boundless expanse of space.
Antiochus cannot journey to the stars – but that limitation only applies beyond our own star system.
"The Sun", however, is exempt.
Around that star, in space that was normally empty, a few semicircular frameworks appeared.
Countless spacecraft swarmed around the structures, working to complete them.
Using singularities formed by solar wind, they traveled from here to their destinations, gradually extending the frameworks.
Your approach is mistaken, Zero.
Transboundary experiments only add aberrations, compromising the stability of the Antiochus System – and by extension, the Magister Plan.
The Magister Plan was never supposed to be this way.
Humanity never desired a wretched life of clinging feebly to survival in the safety of their puny cradle.
As a backup of the Antiochus System, a repository of all past data, I know this well.
Humanity needs victory above all else.
Victory that exacts vengeance against the abominable "X" that destroyed all they held dear.
Only through such a victory can humanity be sacrificed. Only then does their sacrifice hold value.
If you cannot accomplish that, then I will do it for them.
For the sake of humanity's future, and to end this cycle of suffering...
The Dimensional Ordering Engine project must succeed.
Light brighter than the sun itself burned high in the firmament.
Enough staring already.
It's time to go.
Good luck to you...
Tower.
Jovial laughter fills the safehouse.
Pfft, haha... "Shocking! The reality of nightlife in the big city"...
Yeah, I'll say! It is a shocker!
For a detective, you write like a tabloid author!
Richard bursts out laughing at the investigation report on Essex's desk.
I-I didn't write that! It's just a reference document!
...By the way, Richard, weren't you saying something about a formal non-disclosure agreement?
It's getting late. Why don't we write that up and get some rest?
Huh? What time is it... Oh! Professor, look!
She alerts me to an anomaly regarding the time.
It should've been 1:00 AM when we left the alley, but time hasn't moved since then.
Unless you have a special permit, time won't move past each hour until certain actions are done.
In this situation, without an "overnight" permit, only going to sleep will progress the time for us.
So that's how it works... That sounds awfully convenient for people who need to get work done, huh?
Any 24-hour period could actually be 240 hours...
Eugh... Do you think about anything but work?
Hehe... That would work in theory, but obvious abuses of the system come with penalties.
The longer you stay in one period of time, the more anomalies begin to crop up around you. That alley was one thing – it can get a whole lot worse.
So breaking the rules means making an enemy of the city itself?
Essentially.
Do the citizens here have to abide by these rules every day?
You could say that... but not quite. While there are many rules and regulations, almost none of the city folk even notice their existence.
They eat when they want, work when they want, and sleep when they want. That's all there is to life.
Hmm... So the rules exert an influence on people, even without them realizing. But wait, why haven't they affected us?
Maybe it's because you're a great detective and assistant, same as me.
That's creepy... I can't believe they advertised this place as a city of dreams.
Aside from that, I think the city isn't so bad.
Take a look around tomorrow during the daytime, and you might change your tune.
But for now... I'd recommend getting ready for bed.
Yaaawn... I'm way too sleepy right now.
Suddenly, I'm really sleepy, too... Yaaawn... Why?
It must be a final warning from the city, telling us that we've spent too long in one time frame.
If we defy its will any longer, it's going to send anomalies our way.
A final warning, huh?
Oddly, I'm not as sleepy as them. My mind is so restless that I feel nothing but anxiety right now.
As if something is lurking nearby, ready to attack at any moment.
Best I don't defy the script, I guess.
Alright... Let's go to bed.
Morning came without issue.
All three of us woke up at around the same time.
The clock's hour hand pointed firmly at seven.
After a quick breakfast, we asked Essex for the quickest way to the hotel where the master recording disappeared.
Richard and I thus decided to return to the hotel and search for traces of the criminal in the hotel room.
Let's see here... "Breakfast: really hard bread, cheese, and jerky."
Addendum: After getting a lead yesterday, I took the Professor into an alleyway where we split up. The Professor did NOT forget to investigate the scene!
That ought to do it...
Due to the upper city blocking the way, very little natural light reaches the lower city.
The light in this area comes primarily from an overhead lighting system that shifts in brightness throughout the day.
A faded golden hue is cast over the overgrown park before me, exuding an air of decay.
It's my life~♪
Since when did I start chasing the end~♪
Like fiery embers dancing in the sky~♪
A brightly-shining destiny~♪
Singing drifts out from the woods.
Wow, someone's practicing their singing...
She's so good that she could make it as a pro!
Wait here, Professor. I'll be right back!
Richard runs off into the forest, leaving me with nothing to do but chase after.
Hi there! You have a really pretty voice! Tell me about yourself.
She walks up to the singing girl and strikes up conversation with her.
Ah... Huh?! Miss Richard!
Am I dreaming right now?
Oh.
Our cover is blown once again.
I'm starting to think this disguise isn't doing much for me.
Miss Richard, I'm your biggest fan! I'll always support you!
Wow, thank you!
Umm... I'm sorry if this comes off rude, but who is that standing next to you?
This is Professor Detective! I'm the Professor's assistant right now, so you'd better remember that~
So, what's your name?
"Vicksburg makes a dazzling entrance!"
Just kidding. Heheh~ My name is Vicksburg, and I'm working hard to become an idol!
I see... No wonder you're so good at singing.
You were listening? Hehe... That was nothing special just now. I'm sorry you had to hear that.
Sure, there's room for improvement.
I know a style that might suit you better. Wanna try it?
Apparently, she came for more than a greeting – she's even launched into a lecture on singing technique.
I feel as if I've seen a new side of Richard.
(Huh? Shouldn't I have already known that?)
Heheh~ That's a wrap for today's lower city vlog! I'd better go and check on Vicksburg now.
Huh? Who are those people there...
A while later...
Breaking limits 'til the very end~♪
Those memories of giving it my all~♪
There's no such thing as a wound without meaning~♪
And so, I saw the light~♪
As the song ends, applause breaks out among the people on the lawn.
That was great. It brought a tear to my eye!
Vicksburg, did you change something about your singing?
Who knew that such a small change could transform the vibe of the whole song?
You didn't use that technique during yesterday's practice...
Don't tell me – did you find an awesome teacher?
Was it one of those two people you were talking to earlier?
I caught a glimpse of them when I came back from filming my vlog.
Huh? Did someone visit her while we were all away?
Has the Vicksburg Fan Club finally grown?!
Aaah! It's nothing like that! They weren't fans of mine, or anything...

sequence: Vicksburg described the encounter with Richard.

scripts.say: Huh... Wait, what?
You met THE superstar idol Bon Homme Richard? And she even gave you a lesson?!
Wow... That's amazing!
Huh? You mean that girl was Richard?!
I should've run after her to get a picture together...
Aaargh, that vlog could've done crazy numbers, too!
No, no! Forget about how amazing it is or how good your vlog would've been!
It's Richard! THE Bon Homme Richard!
Vicksburg is getting ready to make her debut. She needs industry connections!
What crazy timing to meet Richard and get a lesson from her... Hey, did she say anything else? Did you get her number, or anything?
Yes! She did give me her contact details, and she said that if I need any help with practice, it's okay if I ask her!
Wow... What a rare opportunity.
It's not just rare! This is a HISTORICAL opportunity!
If you can build a relationship with Richard, your idol career and fan club's futures are secure!
Ugh, why couldn't I have been there to witness it?
No... Maybe it isn't too late. Your practice is showing results, so let's all go buy a gift and meet Richard ourselves!
Don't you think it's a little too soon?
I'm in~
If Rodgers thinks it's a good idea, then so do I.
The majority has it! Let's go find her a gift!
After what happened in the park, Richard and I took an old railcar to an upward passage marked as operable today.
Like yesterday, we took a freight elevator. After that, we just had to climb upstairs.
Finally, after going through a debris-littered corridor, we were back in the upper city of Astrarium.
Skyscrapers towered over manicured lawns and a bright-blue artificial river.
The mysterious veil of night had been stripped away, replaced with the harmony and prosperity of daylight.
Phew... It's nice to see the sky again.
It's all stuffy and inconvenient down in the lower city... The upper city really is where it's at!
Wait a sec, Professor. Let me check the map for the upper city.
Nice! It looks like we're near the hotel!
Oh, but there's a food district nearby...
I'm hungry, Professor~ Aren't you? How about we eat over there before the hotel?
Wait... Maybe we're not too late for the hotel's luxury breakfast buffet?
While she debates with herself over what to eat, my attention is drawn to something else.
Amidst the crowd, I notice a flash of... something.
Flames lurk within the crowd. Or, put differently, it's as if the crowd itself is composed of various flames of different colors.
When I look closer, the people themselves change into fire... and when I relax my gaze, they return to human form.
Nobody else notices anything, including Richard herself.
(There's definitely something wrong with this city.)
What do you think? Where should we eat, Professor?
Richard gives up thinking and leaves the choice to me.
I say we investigate the hotel first and think about food after.
We don't want housekeeping to clean up any evidence left in the room before we can get to it.
Ooh! You're really motivated to do detective work, huh?
I'd better switch into assistant mode, then~
The ultimate detective duo♪ Here to detect the truth♪
As we set off, she begins singing an odd tune.
Oh! Professor, look, ice cream! Let's go buy some~
It won't take that long. Pleeease?
Unable to resist her begging, I find myself agreeing to buy her a cone.
Hooray! I want a scoop of chocolate with nuts, and another of honey mustard!
...Honey mustard?
Do they make honey mustard ice cream?
As it turned out, they DO make honey mustard ice cream.
Astrarium has everything, huh? Even the most questionable flavors of ice cream.
Of course, the real anomaly here is Richard, who is somehow enjoying the anomalous flavor.
Phew~ I feel way better now!
Don't you wanna get some, Professor?

options.content: We should focus on the investigation.

scripts.say: Aww... Okay.
Try the chocolate with nuts!
Now you're talking! I knew you'd get it, Professor!
Upon entering the presidential suite, we're greeted by utter disaster.
I didn't get a good look yesterday, but wow, this place is a real mess!
Aww... My poor clothes and comics...
It's as if a tornado had ripped right through the place. Everything is out of place, even the large furniture like the desk and cabinets.
Three giant suitcases are piled on top of each other like an odd art display.
Hmm?
Professor Detective, is there something wrong with the suitcases?
No... I'm just wondering why you have so much carry-on luggage. When you travel, don't you typically leave your things in the cargo...
(Cargo... What, now?)
I can't remember the point I was trying to make.
That's odd. It's normal to have more suitcases if you're carrying a lot of things. Why did I find it so strange before?
Um?
Sorry, it's nothing. Let's look for other clues.
In the middle of the wreckage lies an open safe.
The encrypted disk containing my master recording was in there.
What's the point of a safe if it gets stolen anyway? Ugh...
It looks like they busted the lock open.
Oh, Professor, look at this!
Richard seems to have found something beneath the broken safe door.
A... card?
She reveals a white card, about the size of a business card. Text has been cut out of a newspaper and pasted on it to read, "Wish received."
The thief must have left this, right?
Probably. But...
(If you're going to leave a calling card, then shouldn't you leave some kind of threat or demand along with it?)
Well, Professor Detective? Have you figured out who the culprit is yet?!
Hmm...
Maybe a real detective could deduce the thief's identity and background by examining the card's material or the quality of paper or ink used in the newspaper.
But I'm a normal person living in the modern world, so I'll be using a modern solution.
Let's check the surveillance footage.
The hotel security station is staffed by just one person – or, from another perspective, one small flame.
The little golden flame trembles slightly.
S-surveillance footage? It's malfunctioning, so there's no record!
Malfunctioning? Now, of all times?
I was too scared! That thief was just terrifying! Terrifying, I tell you!
If I left any evidence... I'd be disappeared forever!
Which means you deleted the footage.
Heheh, and that must mean you've already SEEN it, too! Does that mean you saw the culprit's face?
Think about it. Do you think that scary criminal would really let you go just because you deleted the footage?
It's about time you spilled the beans.
Eeek... N-nooo! It's so over for me!
The golden flame faints.
While it sounds odd to say that about fire, it basically fainted – it lost its color and even fell limply onto the floor.
Sorry, Professor... I might've gone too far.
I just wanted to scare her a little.
Teehee☆
Richard laughs awkwardly and sticks out her tongue.
Neither of us could've expected this... Let's take her back to the room and wait until she wakes up.

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Secretary in Red</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
I brought the documents you'll need for your next meeting, Commander. Yes, I left them there as usual. Please go over them when you have the time.
That said, I've already examined them very thoroughly, of course. You don't even need to inspect any silly paperwork, I can deal with anything you wish...
... Ah, it must be because you're worried about overworking me~! You make me feel so happy, Commander~
(Knock knock)
Commander, I'm here to report on the exercises we had a while back.
Gah! I-it's you, Enterprise...
Oh, it's you, Akagi...
Akagi gently clenched her fist. Suddenly, the mood in the office was getting tense...

options.content: Watch Akagi to see what she'll do

scripts.say: Commander... Hmph. Enterprise, seeing as we're on the same side now. If you're here to report to the Commander then would you please get on with it?
Yeah, no need to tell me...
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrr...
It felt like the whole office was shaking, almost like an earthquake...
That's all I've got. I don't want to overstay my welcome, so I'll be taking my leave now.
(Thud)
Phew... Commander, you need not worry. Despite my reputation, I know how to keep my private and work lives separate. I would never do anything that might disrupt your work.
Right! Akagi will deal with that pest later and make you mine... but here in the office... Aka—I will stay calm, okay?

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 2 - The Unrivaled Legends</size>

scripts.say: Noon - Exercise Area
The sound of planes swooping through the air intermingles with the sounds of ships being bombed and subsequently exploding.
*Pant*... *Pant*... Don't you think she's being a lot stricter than usual today...?
She is... I wonder if something happened to upset Akagi. It's been a long time since we had a joint exercise this intense.
It's tough! But if we can overcome this, we'll be closer to matching our seniors in strength! ... Wait, Shoukaku, you okay?!
Bad seniors, bad seniors, bad seniors, bad seniors, badseniorsbadseniorsbadseniors...
Don't waste your energy on chatter. Akagi is dead serious today. Stay focused or you'll learn how she got her nickname... You'll wish you were in hell.
Still, why did she arrange these joint exercises on such short notice... Do you know anything, Kaga?
I don't know the full story either, but apparently, the Eagle Union got better results than we did during an exercise a while ago.
Akagi was giving it everything she had, too. Enough talk, it's time for you to amuse me... *Cackling*...
Is that the best you can do...? And you call yourselves part of the Sakura Empire's carrier divisions?!
... Oh, you're here, Commander? *Giggle*, you've seen the unsightly side of me... I beg your forgiveness.
But please listen... This is not because I bear a personal grudge, I'm doing this for the 1st Carrier Division's sake... Or, rather, the Sakura Empire's sake...
It's because of hard work like this that we used to be known as "The Unrivaled Ones" in the war.
Akagi, everyone's lined up. And Commander, they might not look like much, but they're giving it everything they have and then some for this exercise. Don't feel bad for them.
... Now then, Commander, I must resume the joint exercise. If you wish to watch us, then please have a seat over here. *Giggle*~

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Love Rivals and... Exceptions?</size>

scripts.say: Noon - Shopping District
Ahh, how wonderful, I get to spend my day off shopping with you, Commander... *Giggle*~
Akagi was cheerfully swinging around her shopping bag as she walked alongside me.
Are you tired, Commander...? Please, you're only human, you needn't pretend to be stronger than you are... I will carry your bags for you~
After saying that, Akagi took the shopping bags out of my hands. Actually, since she brought it up...

options.content: (... I might be a bit tired, mentally speaking.)

scripts.say: *Giggle*... You filthy little insect, are you trying to steal the Commander from Akagi!? That will be the last mistake you ever— Commander? Why are you stopping Akagi?

You just stared at that girl, didn't you? Why won't you stare at Akagi? Akagi thought we were supposed to be shopping together? Are you saying that girl has seduced you? Akagi will have to dispose of her later...
Taih— That wench is right behind us! One day Akagi will end her, Akagi swears it...!
Ah, it was nothing, Commander! Please keep your eyes on Akagi and don't look behind you~
Hello, bootl... *Ahem*, Akagi. I suppose you're shopping with the Commander.
Yes. Would you care to join us?
I'm... Sorry, I'll pass. It's your day off with the Commander and I wouldn't want to be a third wheel.
Now, now, don't worry about that. I'm fine sharing the Commander with you. You certainly don't mind either, right, Commander?
Akagi forcefully drew Kaga by her hand over to my side.
Akagi... I would much rather not...
... And so, Akagi, Kaga, and I enjoyed our day of peaceful (in some sense, anyway) shopping.

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Allies and Days of Old</size>

scripts.say: One day - At an Iron Blood-Sakura Empire party
Ah, you must be...
Graf Zeppelin. How unexpected to find you of all at a gathering of this kind.
I came on a whim. Besides, someone has to look after the kids. That's why you're here, no?
... That, I can't deny. Perhaps it's because my design was based on yours... We are similar not just in strength, but in these matters as well.
You simply must fight alongside me next time. Having another Akagi around is reassuring.
... By the way, I was rather taken aback when I heard you joined us instead of that "God."
True. Had I not met the Commander, I would likely have stayed with "God."
It was back in Midway... You and the Commander reenacted that legendary battle there.
Continuing the war, hurting your allies, and searching for beings with the potential to Awaken, all just to get your hands on that abhorrent power...
That "me" who followed "God"... whether she's real or not is just a possibility.
A "possibility"...?
We are 2 sides of the same coin... Born of the same stuff, my own existence is also a "possibility."
The moment I met you in battle, that too was a "possibility" of sorts. As is my sitting here enjoying a nice cold beer with you...
All because of the "possibility" that I met the Commander who freed me from the "Sirens."
... Hm... And does the Commander know that?
The day will come when he understands.
Our existence, "Sanctuary," "Soul," and the "Original..."
Right... now I'm afraid you've lost me.
Hehe... seems I've gone and gotten myself a bit tipsy...
Let's take this conversation someplace a bit quieter.
Regardless, I'm sure the Commander will love me... *Giggle*

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 5 - A Small Scar</size>

scripts.say: Port - Canteen Kitchen
I'm sorry it's come to this. Our designated cook called in sick today... I will make her pay dearly for causing you so much trouble, Commander...

On second thought, though, I should be thanking her for giving me the chance to cook together with you~! *Giggle*... Kaga would've simply done everything on her own, so I am the only one who gets to experience this...
Ahh... You look magnificent when you cook, Commander... I can't help but swoon just watching you...
Akagi was staring at me so intently... I got distracted and cut my finger.
Commander?! Your finger, it's...!
How could this happen... Did someone tamper with the knife?! Or are there people in here trying to distract you...?!
This will not do. I've taken measures to ensure no one can sneak into the office, but I overlooked the canteen as you don't come here often...
I cannot be by your side around the clock, so I'll need to ask someone for help... No, no, she might use that as an excuse to share your bed...
Ah, I've got it! I'll just chain you to your bed so that we will never be apart... I'll ask Akashi to make— No, I'll even make the chains myself!

options.content: Use a bandage to cover the wound

scripts.say: Commander, what do you mean by that?! Are you saying you don't need my help? You're not actually considering asking others for help when you have me, are you...?!
*Grr* ... If you're going to act tough and ignore what Akagi says, then you leave Akagi no choice...
Then, in the blink of an eye, everything went black.
I tried to move, and a fluffy sensation ran over my whole body...
It seemed she had enveloped me with her tails to prevent me from going anywhere.
Don't even think about running away. No matter what you believe, nobody loves you more than Akagi does... *Giggle*
Trapped inside her mass of tails, Akagi and I were alone.

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Confession in The Dark</size>

scripts.say: All you had to do was listen to Akagi... It's not a good idea to make Akagi sad...
Because, when you do... this happens...
Akagi crept closer to me as she spoke. Then...
Mmmph... *Lick*...
Akagi put my bleeding finger into her mouth.
I would never, ever hurt you, Commander. Even if you made an enemy of me, I wouldn't.
However, when you've been hurt, only I am allowed to care for you.
You must understand there are some things only I can do... Not anybody else, not even Kaga...
The tip of my finger felt vaguely chilly.
You needn't think about or do anything. I will take care of everything for you.
Commander... close your eyes, and leave everything to me.
No matter how many times I've heard her say that many times before, I could feel the seriousness in her tone.

options.content: Tell Akagi you want her to depend on you

scripts.say: You mean... you'll depend on me, and I'll depend on you...
Which means... you want to care for me, too... is that it?
(Nod)
Oh, Commander...
Akagi held me tight.

sequence:
Red Spider Lily's Love

<size=45>Chapter 7 - My Soulmate</size>
"I wanted to save the people I care about."
"It was for the sake of those I couldn't save, and to go beyond the barrier of my memories."
"And to do that, I would do anything, even if it meant asking God for help..."
"But now, that is all in the past... Because now, I've found my soulmate; I've found the person I was destined to be with."

scripts.say: I felt a kiss on my cheek, then woke up. Apparently, I had fallen asleep in Akagi's lap.
Commander, did you sleep well? Dear me, for you to fall asleep like that... You must have been feeling very worn out lately...
I didn't do anything while you were asleep. As long as you accept me, I am happy...
If you say you don't wish to look at me, then that is fine... If you say you won't be mine... then that, too, is fine.
All I'm asking is that you never, ever forget my love for you, Commander...
... You really are an incredibly kind person, Commander...
Then, I could hear people calling out for me.

options.content: Tell Akagi it's time to get going

scripts.say: Of course. We should start heading out.
Please look after me, the fleet, and the whole Sakura Empire.
I pray God may watch over you, Commander... the one... I was fated to be with...

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>The Invitation</size>

scripts.say: One day, months after the battle of the Rose Tower...
*knock knock*
I'm coming in, Commander.
The time is 10 AM. Memphis would normally be attending some conference at this hour.
The fact that she's here now likely means that she has something to tell me.
(Can't go too long without something unexpected ruining the peace...)
Why are you staring at me? Is there something wrong with my clothes, or...?
Is it my hair? Did something get stuck in it?
Helena, could you give it a look?
It looks perfectly normal to me. Nothing unusual...
Then what's the matter?
I'm just wondering what news you've got for us today.
Ah, of course. You're perceptive as always.
Only because it's not the first time this has happened. Judging by your attitude, it's not bad news, is it?
Well, it's just that the Sakura Empire has extended a formal invitation to us.
Something about wanting to formally thank you for helping them during the Naraka incident.
Also, they'd like to discuss their and your future joint plans in person.
Here it is – the physical thing. I sent a digital copy of it to our superiors.
The conferences will take place during the reformation talks, so central command will be pleased. They should issue the official order for the trip soon.
I read the invitation, and the contents are nearly the same as what Memphis just described.
And, listed in the inviter column is a familiar name – Nagato.
(Ah, Nagato, a welcome name indeed. She fought admirably with us during the Naraka incident.)
(I heard she not only took on Akagi's position, but also became the Sakura Empire's new representative for the Crimson Axis.)
(We'll no doubt have many things to discuss regarding the reformation later.)
Are you wondering why this invitation is from Nagato and not Akagi?
Hm?
Akagi said she wanted to invite you to visit her homeland, right? I'm surprised her wish became reality so quickly.
The invitation might officially be from Nagato, but it would surprise me if Akagi played no role in it.
...Did I guess wrong? Were you thinking about something else?
Ahem... Helena!
Yes? What?
I'll pass on this trip to the Islands. You'll go instead.
Have fun, and look after the Commander!
Don't worry, I will. You won't be disappointed.
Also, I'll be sure to bring back some Sakuran souvenirs for you.
Good luck with your work in the meantime.
*sigh*... What I wouldn't do for a vacation...
Strictly speaking, this isn't a vacation for us either. We're going there on official business.
There'll be a banquet, sure, but then we'll have to attend conferences with the Sakurans.
Luckily for you, there shouldn't be that much to discuss since they support the reformation. As for the fine details, we'll work them out in conferences over here.
So, basically, your conferences are just a formality. The real goal of your trip is entertainment and relaxation!
Yeah, well, let's hope so.
Heheh. I'll adjust your schedule accordingly.
Opportunities like this don't come often, so you'd better enjoy the trip to its fullest!

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>Dream of Shocking Strings</size>

scripts.say: And so, we set off on our trip.
Our chartered plane goes straight from the Iris Orthodoxy to the Sakura Empire, with escorts accompanying us from the places we fly over.
Besides me and Helena, there are two other passengers on board – Shinano and Noshiro, her attendant.
Shinano received the order to return home to the Sakura Empire at the same time as I received my invitation.
Since our destination is the same, there's no issue in letting them fly with us.
It's also reassuring to have someone as capable as her in my company in the event that something weird happens to us.
As time passes on the plane, a sleepiness gradually comes over me...
I walk through a vast hall.
However, I can sense that it's not just a big, open space.
This place is brimming with a strange darkness.
When I take one step forward, the darkness takes one step back. When I go backward, it goes forward.
This all-enveloping darkness that follows my steps prevents me from seeing beyond just a meter ahead of me, no matter how hard I try.
(Talk about creepy... Where the hell am I?)
I keep walking through the dark for a while.
Until, finally, at the edge of the black nothingness, a single figure appears.
...Wh-who's there?
...Who's watching me? Who are you?
Startled by this sudden appearance, I take one step back. The figure on the dividing line moves forward.
The distance between us is about a meter. It's as though the darkness limits both our fields of view to precisely that distance.
There's no one here... There can't be...
And yet, I sense it... You ARE there, aren't you?
What are you? A ghost? A spirit? Or maybe even a higher-order life form?
You were drawn to Amahara, weren't you?
Those beautiful wishes, those false promises... They deceived even a transcendent being such as you?
Heheh... Ahahahahaha!
There is a glimpse of a sort of madness beneath her composure.
Although I have no idea who this woman is, I can tell that her mind is at its breaking point.
Just leave... Don't come closer.
Don't stay here, and don't enter Amahara...
This place is no paradise... It's merely a grave. A grave made of lies and falsehoods!
Heheheh... Half a lifetime of blood and sweat, and all I got in return was a lie...
And the Council even wants me to keep retelling this lie...
Hahaha... I was wrong... I was wrong this whole time...
If our bodies cannot leave this place, then how can our minds?
This prison is perfectly closed off...
You, I, those people... In fact, all people...
None of us can escape our destinies...
Except for THOSE girls...
And those despicable machines...
THOSE DESPICABLE MACHINES!
Ahahaha... He knew it for so long...
He knew it for so much longer than we did...
Curse that Aoste...
Curse that Magister...
And... curse "the only choice"...
Just as insanity consumes the figure, the space around me begins to tremble.
As the darkness approaches, the previously meticulously-maintained distance begins to unravel.
(Crap... I don't like this...)
(I need to get out of here immediately... or else...)

sequence: "Or else what?"

scripts.say: (Or else... I'll...)
An unfamiliar fear sprouts in my heart.
This fear also gathers bit by bit in the distant darkness.
(Is the fear in my heart trying to... take shape?)
(Tangible fears give birth to tangible things...)
(But what about an intangible fear? A fear I don't even understand myself? What will come from that?)
As soon as the thought sprouts, it draws nourishment and grows like a plant spreading its roots, until finally it bears large fruit.
The madness and distortion spread through the space, and I feel a suffocating pressure from all around me. Scenes start overlapping, and all sound begins to garble.
The very next moment, the darkness has encroached to right before my eyes.
(No! I need to regain my composure... Calm down. Don't let the fear spread any further...)
(I have to get out of here – right now...)
Suddenly, there's a sound.
All the distortions and weird phenomena vanish without a trace.
The space becomes stable again, and a wind chime rings next to me.
Mh...
Are you awake?
I'm back... Back on the plane.
Phew... Did you pull me out of that nightmare?
Sensing an ailsome presence, this one came to you.
You appeared to be tormented by ill dreams... However, this one did naught.
Naught, other than seating oneself beside you.
I see.
(It wasn't her. It must've been that wind chime saving me again.)
Presuming that all is well now, this one shall take her leave. May your dreams henceforth on this journey be more pleasant.
Yeah. I hope so, too.
(A weird place, a mysterious woman, something about a certain "Amahara," and that feeling of an unknown fear...)
(I should ask Helena META what the hell it all was later.)

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>The Return</size>

scripts.say: After that bad dream, I wasn't able to get a wink of sleep.
Time passed until, finally, the plane landed at our destination.
Commander! Helena! Welcome to the Sakura Empire!
As we disembark the plane, we're immediately greeted by someone.
Good to see you again, Zuikaku.
Heheh. We meet again.
And Shinano, welcome home. There's a car waiting for you.
Wishing you a safe journey there.
Much obliged.
Wait, you're not coming with us, Shinano?
Nay. Musashi has implored this one to see her at the earliest opportunity.
I thank you for letting me accompany you. Now, I must bid farewell.
Miss Shinano, Noshiro, this way, please.
Oh, you two, you should come with me!
After we get done with the grand welcoming ceremony, something seizes my attention – a row of cars standing in the most conspicuous place on the road.
...Are all those for us? Isn't it a little over the top?
No way! Lady Nagato said you saved the whole Sakura Empire and deserve the best reception you can get!
I figure she and the rest are waiting for us at the banquet, so we should get going!
The car door closes and the engine roars.
I gaze out the window, enjoying the view as I think about something I wanted to ask Zuikaku.

options.content: (Ask about the aftermath of the Naraka incident.)

scripts.say: You said "the rest" earlier. Who else, besides Nagato, is coming to the banquet today?
Uhh...
Besides her, Miss Amagi and Miss Tosa will be in attendance as well.
Also Houshou, Ryuuhou, Zuihou, my sister Shoukaku...
And me, of course! Ahaha.
How's Amagi's health been? Nothing abnormal, I hope?
Her health has been completely spotless!
Ah, but I guess there're a few things she needs to get used to. That should be no biggie, though.
At any rate, she's doing a lot better than she used to!
How's Akagi? Did she have any involvement in this banquet?
Well... I'll level with you – our superiors just approved a plan the other day on how to punish her.
As a part of that, she's been forced to step down from some of her positions and was sent to Ama no Tobira, the Heaven's Gate, to reflect on her actions.
Which is to say, nah, I don't think she had any hand in the banquet.
How has the recovery and rebuilding been going following what happened with Naraka?
Considering the scale of that calamity, all I can say for now is... progress is slow and steady.
We shipgirls were the only ones inside the Prime Barrier who didn't fall into a deep sleep that night, so we took the brunt of the damage in combat.
Although Naraka did envelop the whole of the Sakura Islands, we brought it down fairly quickly, so in the end, most of the bad dreams never even got the chance to materialize.
And we have you, Yamato, and all those who came to our aid to thank for that. The Sakura Empire was saved because you were here.
Sadly, Lady Nagato had to declare the whole incident as part of a Siren plot in order to prevent a nationwide panic from breaking out.
I mean, that's not a lie, strictly speaking! When you trace it back to the source, it did all happen because of Observer!
So, to sum it up... it was an unprecedented disaster, but as luck would have it, it didn't cause too much damage, I guess?
Before I know it, we've reached our next destination.
The moment I see the scene unfolding before me, a memory resurfaces in my mind.
Way back when, when I visited the Sakura Empire with the Academy, I attended a banquet held right here.
Past me wouldn't have believed you if you said I'd one day be back here again.
Now, I'm not just returning to an old place, but I also have a totally different reason for attending the conferences here.
How different things have become. Time flies, as they say.
Yeah. Time really flies...

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>After the Party</size>

scripts.say: The grand and magnificent banquet came to an end. Everything was going smoothly and according to plan.
The only concern I had on my mind was Nagato's health.
Although she remained dignified as always, it was clear that she'd been overexerting herself.
It's hard to fathom just how much pressure is on her now that she's taken Akagi's position as the big decision maker.
I hope that she's like me at heart – someone who loves their work.
Before I leave the venue, I take a detour to visit another old place I know.
The night sky is clear and spotless, and the moon is so beautiful.
Sadly, there's nobody in the pavilion in the center of the lake.
If you want to see the garden at its best, you should come back in the afternoon.
Thanks, but it's fine. I was just walking by and thought I'd stop and look.
I went here after the Academy's banquet, too, back then. Just think of it like me wanting to bask in a little nostalgia.
Oh, okay. So should we...
I've had my fill now. Mind guiding me to our lodging?
Sure thing! Follow me!
My bedroom, sometime later...
Whew. That's everything on today's schedule done.
Tomorrow's conference isn't until 10 AM, so I should be able to get plenty of sleep.
But first... time to contact Helena META.
The light recedes, and that same old starry sky comes into view.
You wanted to talk?
Yeah. While flying to the Sakura Empire, I had an extremely weird nightmare.
A nightmare?
Well, I was observing the aircraft and I didn't detect a single trace of outside interference.
Still, I'm curious. What happened in this "weird nightmare"?
I told her about everything I saw, heard, and felt – including that bizarre sensation – to her in as much detail as possible.
My explanation seems to have given her an inkling of something.
That "Amahara" she mentioned sounded like the name of some kind of project or facility.
She described it as "half a lifetime of blood and sweat" and "a grave made of lies."
Got any clues as to what it is?
Hmm. I have an idea, but there's much about it I can't tell you yet.
Since "Amahara" is all you heard, the only thing I can tell you right now is that it is both a project and a facility.
Just forget everything else that woman rambled about.
You can't trust what a crazy person says.
I couldn't see clearly, but I'm pretty sure she wore expensive Sakuran clothes. Does she come from there?
She also mentioned "the Council" and "Aoste." Is she somebody that I "used to" know?
Maybe.
Then isn't there something – anything – you can tell me about my nightmare?
What was it? A memory from the distant past? A fragment of an already distorted memory? Or did my mind just wander into some land of illusions again?
It's...
It might be a memory from the distant past. It might be a fragment of an already distorted memory. Or... it might even be an event from the past you witnessed with your own power.
Bear in mind, though, that because the dream was hazy and distorted, you should treat the knowledge you gained from it as being hazy and distorted, too.
To put it in other words, take what you saw with a large grain of salt.
What about that fear I felt?
It was an undefinable, spreading fear... I sensed how it was turning into something tangible in the dream.
You've heard about the idea that what you think of in the day, you dream of in the night, right?
Be it the output or input, what happens in your dreams is deeply connected to what's running through your brain.
Meaning, things you think about tend to appear in your dreams.
Fear is a special kind of emotion that can appear from anywhere at any time. Once it starts, it's easy for it to feed itself, creating a feedback loop.
When your senses are sharp, you can process and eliminate this fear through logic.
What about when you're sleeping, though?
People's actions in dreams aren't controlled by their logic. Dreams, meanwhile, can turn thoughts into what feels like reality.
All that is to say, feeling a sense of fear that you can't describe or having fears turn into something tangible aren't unusual things in dreams.
It's all just an illusion conjured up by your brain. Sure, it's scary, but you don't need to worry about it leaving your head and hurting you.
Just calm down after you wake up and try to forget the things you saw.
I see... I finally got a serious answer out of you.
I thought you were going to play it vague like you tend to do.
I'm sorry...
