It's just that you've been learning so much information by accident lately. Far more than it's safe for you to know at this stage.
If I feed you any more information, your very existence will be put in danger. That's why I can't afford to risk it.
So, you're saying you can only supplement the information that's clear cut...
While you can't give me any details directly on the information that's more vague. Is that right?
Correct.
That's what weasel words and metaphors are for...
Because the information they relay is equivocal, they allow you to get around certain restrictions and say things that you normally couldn't without suffering consequences.
Marco Polo must be an expert when it comes to that, huh?
How is she doing? Is her consciousness still in a dream?
She's fairly stable. Why do you ask?
I was hoping I could talk to her, like how Shinano did that one time in Europa.
I've got questions for her about the Sardegnia League and Hierophant.
Got it. It'll take some time to prepare, though. Can we do it another day?
Sure. I'll leave you to it.
Alright. Then I pray you'll have sweet dreams tonight.

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>The Mystery That Deepens</size>

scripts.say: Today's conference was held in a fancy pagoda in the garden.
Just as Memphis predicted, the topics were mostly things that had already been covered.
It was done in just under 30 minutes. After that, the Sakurans served us lunch and even shared a tour plan for the afternoon with us.
So... It seems our work here is done.
Yep. It was a wrap once they gave us that schedule.
The conference didn't even take half an hour. I guess we're free to enjoy our vacation now.
I think so, yeah. Gosh knows we need a break.
Ain't that the truth. What do you say we start with a look around the garden?
Sure. Hang on, I'll go get a map. Be right back.
Following the map, Helena and I go on a walk, checking out the worthwhile spots around the garden.
From what I heard, this garden used to be Akagi's, but it was handed over. Nagato is the current owner.
It's such a huge place, too... That explains why there's nobody around.
Hahaha! Going further back, Nagato once gifted this garden to Amagi as a place to bolster her health.
It was relinquished to Akagi later on. Now it has merely come back into its original owner's hands.
Just as I point out the lack of other people, we run into a fellow person admiring the scenery just around the corner.
Mikasa? Hi.
Aye, it is I. Greetings, Commander.
I'm pleased by your character. You conduct yourself with the appropriate dignity of one known far and wide.
Hahaha. Don't pile the praise too high, now. Didn't think we'd run into you here, but I'm glad we did.
A chance encounter amongst beautiful scenery! This place is ideal for a trip together, wouldn't you agree?
Absolutely. Just wondering – you weren't at the banquet last night, were you? I didn't see you at the conference earlier this morning, either, so...
You're not suffering from some after-effects of the Naraka incident, are you?
Ahahaha! Your thoughtfulness is much appreciated. No, I was quite alright thanks to Yamato.
That being said, I've stepped down from all my official posts. For that reason, I wasn't in attendance on either of those occasions.
Wait, you've stepped down?
That I have. We all must atone for our mistakes, no?
The world should be led by young folks such as you. I'm actually quite enjoying this relaxing life, having been freed of my former obligations.
On a different note, something very interesting happened just the other day. Would you care to know what?
Very interesting, huh? I'd love to hear it.
Then let us first find a better place for conversation. Come along.
Helena and I follow Mikasa to a building detached from the garden.
This is my temporary residence. Make yourselves at home.
Starting to feel like this is going to be pretty important.
Hear what I have to say first, then you can judge for yourself how important it is. I can assure you, however, that it will be fascinating.
Now, have you ever had a near-death experience before?
Just to be clear, are we talking about the feeling you get right before death comes knocking?
Slightly after that. I speak of the time up to when your consciousness completely vanishes as you approach death.
Then I haven't. Did you experience that during the Naraka incident?
Aye. In the midst of that very battle.
As I was on the verge of death, for but a brief moment, I had something akin to a near-death experience.
There was light, and the world suddenly expanded before me.
It expanded on and on until it finally transformed into a boundless white void.
In that endless expanse, I felt as though a thousand thoughts in my mind had become clearer, like the final piece of a puzzle had fallen into place.
It felt like I had become an omniscient being in that instant. Faced with this white void, I knew everything there was to know.
A blink of the eyes later, I awoke in a sickroom.
The boundless white void collapsed instantaneously, and I was removed from the then-finished puzzle.
My mind was again left in a cluttered state. Even the things I'd already grasped had come undone, reverting to being indecipherable.
Quite the fascinating experience, aye, {playername}?
Never heard anything like it before, that's for sure. However... I know this "endless white void" you're talking about.
Oh?
It's a higher-dimensional plane that might have something to do with Wisdom Cubes.
Seeing that place as you're on the verge of death, feeling like some fragment returned to the whole... Now that's very interesting.
Did something similar to your experience happen to anyone else, among those who got drawn into Naraka and experienced the ritual?
Nay. A shame.
That being said, I'm not well-acquainted with otherworldly things of this nature.
Had it been Musashi who experienced this, she would no doubt be able to describe it in better detail and remember more than I did.
Wait, "remember"? Didn't you say everything you grasped reverted to being indecipherable?
That I did. Not only could I grasp them no longer, but I forgot all that I had grasped instantly. Much like I had a dream that vanished tracelessly upon my awakening.
Even so, I daresay I have a rather good memory. I am certain beyond a doubt that I experienced something unusual whilst at death's door.
How can I be sure? Because, although I forgot all else, one mystery remains, and I remember it as clear as day.
One might call it the singular fruit that this bizarre journey yielded.
Mystery? What is it?
It is you, {playername}, Commander of the Azur Lane – you are that giant mystery.
When and where were you born? Who are your parents? Do you have any other kin?
Where did you study? When was your aptitude for Wisdom Cubes recognized? And finally, when did you enroll in the Azur Lane Academy?
Well, this is weird. You have the resources to easily look all of that up. What's such a "giant mystery" about any of that?
That is the thing. I've searched and searched, yet found nothing.
To be precise, some information pertaining to you is completely unfindable, as though it exists not in this world. Meanwhile, the things I HAVE found do not align with my own memories.
For instance, the Azur Lane Academy taking the place of a world-renowned Wisdom Cube research institute.
Such was also the case with the well-known Wisdom Cube Aptitude Test. Gone, like it never existed to begin with.
You surely remember what Akagi said: "Nobody can even notice the discrepancy until someone points it out."
Trace the line back and think deeply about it. Do you not sense that something is wrong?
The Azur Lane Academy took the place of a Cube research institute?
Are you saying the Academy I studied at once used to be a famous research center?
Because that's completely new to me. I've never read anything like that before.
The Wisdom Cube Aptitude Test, though... I do remember that.
It was pretty widely reported on at the time.
It was in NY Harbor, where...
Where I... met... Anzeel...
Was it really in NY Harbor, {playername}? Not in Europa? And who is this "Anzeel"?
...What?
Hey... Why were we talking about NY Harbor and Anzeel?
No, wait, it wasn't NY Harbor – it was Europa. I'm sure of it.
There it is. We've only scratched the surface of the iceberg, and yet the mystery grows deeper still.
Now that I've stepped down, I have all the time in the world. I can look into leads as small as this one.
Will you assist me?
(Magician did say there are lies and fabrications mixed in with my memories...)
(I thought she referred to the experiments I'd been a part of that Observer created.)
(Clearly... there's more to it than just that.)
(Is it not just me? Could all of test site beta also be hiding some sort of enormous secret?)
Alright. I'll help.
We'll find the truth behind this one way or another!

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>Mystery Beckons More Mystery</size>

scripts.say: Later that night, I returned to my lodgings and contacted Helena META.
Not to speak with her, though – but rather with Observer.
As the overseer of all projects across test bite beta, no one knows it better than her.
To answer your two questions: Yes, I did both.
When you trace it back, the root cause lies in you.
You caught my attention by displaying an unprecedented number during the Aptitude Test. That's when I began the subsequent experiment projects.
I turned the Wisdom Cube research institute into the Academy, swept everything about the Aptitude Test under the rug, and altered the records. It was all just a part of dealing with the aftermath.
Funny, isn't it – how truly nobody can tell the future? In the end, you claimed victory over me.
You altering the records would explain a lot of things.
Did it really start with that test, though? You're telling me you didn't interfere with my memories at all before that point?
Of course not. Do you know how many people there are in the world? I had my hands full as it was. Do you think I had the time to observe you, specifically, for who knows how long?
If you say so. Also, when conducting experiments, do you have a manual or something like that that all members need to follow? Or does it vary from test site to test site?
Take the Wisdom Cube Aptitude Test, for instance. Does that exist across all test sites?
Probably? I'm not privy to all the details since I can't get in touch with a different Observer.
Make that "probably" a "yes." The WCAT wasn't something exclusive to your test site.
There you have it. She knows better than I do about this stuff.
To me, this is simply standard experimental procedure.
Where did I take the test? Was it Europa after all?
That's right.
Something inside me just feels wrong when I try to remember it.
The memories that resurface immediately are all from NY Harbor, not Europa.
That can't be. It just can't.
...NY Harbor?
Yeah. Why? Does that ring a bell?
Oh, uh, no.
I haven't been in this test site for very long. Observer should know much more about it than I do.
Since you're so skeptical, allow me to pull up the old data for you.
I wasn't paying that close attention to you back then, but the records must be there regardless. It shouldn't be hard to put together something with a bit of filtering and analysis.
Hm?
That... doesn't make any sense.
What doesn't?
There are no records. None. Everything concerning your past is gone.
Strange... I'm sure I did keep records of it. I even had a closer look at them when I realized how special you were.
An error? In YOUR database? That shouldn't be possible.
You're right. It shouldn't. My mainframe has never been destroyed, and there's no bug in the data itself either.
But maybe...
Maybe what?
Maybe... that data was erased when I connected to my mainframe?
My mainframe is the only thing that can read, alter, or remove records without my knowledge.
Wait, you mean Observer Zero specifically tweaked your mainframe to delete records about my past?
That's the most plausible explanation at the moment, yes.
And we only learned about it because I asked about it... Things are getting more serious at an alarming rate.
Is there any way we can rule out the possibility that Zero herself did this?
I'll have a chat with Tester, Compiler, and Omitter. Those records should still be in their mainframes.
If this wasn't Zero's handiwork, the data must exist intact on one of them.
What about Purifier?
Well... Purifier encountered a teensy-weensy issue during her recovery process.
Her mainframe was rebuilt quite some time ago, but for some reason, it's never been able to properly boot up, and her AI personality hasn't activated.
Is that a common occurrence?
No. We don't know what's causing it or how to fix it. We're still working to troubleshoot the issue.
Sorry to hear that. Let me know if there are any updates.
Will do.
(Helena had a clear reaction to NY Harbor being brought up earlier... I'm guessing my past self took the Aptitude Test there instead.)
(Only, that was in the alpha timeline, not test site beta.)
(Could it be that the Aptitude Test from the alpha timeline is the source of it across all test sites?)
(And maybe... Anzeel and I were acquainted during this first test?)

sequence:
Summons From the Sakura Empire

<size=45>Another Invitation</size>

scripts.say: It's now my third day in the Sakura Empire.
During today's conference, the Sakurans put forth a surprising proposal – inviting Helena and me to visit Ama no Tobira.
This invitation was extended to us by none other than the highly-regarded and rarely-seen Yamato herself.
It made me wonder if their real reason for bringing us here was to give us this invitation.
As for the Ama no Tobira itself, its very existence is wrapped in mystery. Even Nagato has never set foot there.
Naturally, the opportunity to visit it sounded very alluring to me.
However, just to be safe, I decided to ask Helena META about it before giving them my answer.
And so, I returned to my lodgings and went back to that familiar view of space.
We've met more in these past three days than we did in the last three weeks.
The Sakura Empire must be a wonderful place.
Ahaha... More like a really mysterious place.
I suppose. So, did you come to ask about Ama no Tobira?
Yeah. I'm really curious to see what it's about.
Then feel free to act on that curiosity.
It's an isolated artificial Singularity, so it's not an especially dangerous place.
Fortunately, the Arbiters have been busy with so-called cross-border experiments lately, so many of them – Magician included – have been reassigned to that.
This means that I have more than enough firepower to protect you at the moment.
You'll be safe no matter what, even if you end up in danger, so don't be hesitant to go.
Wait, "cross-border experiments"?
Mhm. I suppose they're exactly what they sound like – experiments involving crossing borders of some kind.
You're being vague again. I guess you can't tell me.
Still, I assume it's something important if they mobilized so many Arbiters for it. Will their experiments affect us in the future somehow?
I'm working on determining that. Worrying now will do you no good.
By the way, we made some progress yesterday during our investigation.
It's not just Observer's mainframe. The data had been wiped from the other experimentation division members as well.
We can be pretty damn sure it was Zero's doing, then.
Let's not jump to conclusions.
Observer is no expert on Arbiters. There are several other Arbiters who could hack into a mainframe like theirs.
What we should do now is pinpoint the exact time when the data was erased. Once we know that, we can narrow down our search.
For instance, if the data disappeared while Observer was connected to her mainframe, that leaves Zero as the most likely suspect.
Because, as far as I know, the Tower is the only one who can modify data without Zero finding out.
On the other hand, if the data got wiped while Observer WASN'T connected, our list of suspects grows quite big.
It could be Magician, who's already appeared in test site beta. Or it could be The Hanged Man, or Wheel of Fortune, or even The World.
And our list grows even bigger if the data wipe happened while Observer was busy dealing with Pamiat' Merkuria META when she invaded Antarctica...
In that instance, Temperance could've done it.
Wheel of Fortune? The World? Arbiters, I assume?
Yes. X and XXI. They're both bad news, so I hope we can avoid them as much as possible.
Anyway, I'll handle the legwork! You just focus on relaxing and enjoying your vacation in the Sakura Empire to its fullest.
Right... I'd almost forgotten what it even feels like to relax.
Just gotta focus on that.
Exactly. Just relax.
Ahh...
That's the spirit. Anyway, good night, Commander.
Good night, Helena.

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>The Nervous Black Cat</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
*Knock knock*
That knocking must mean... the commission team is back now.
It seems like Hatsuharu was tasked with giving me the report this time.
A-a commission has been completed...
The sound of complete silence enveloped the office.
... The conversation won't go anywhere at this rate.
Wah?! *Whimper*...
I-I-I'm so sorry, Commander!
<size=30>I practiced so hard, y-yet I still can't do it...</size>
<size=30>I-I should've known this would be impossible for me!</size>
Then, before I could say anything else, Hatsuharu hastily ran out of the office.
I'll have someone else check on the commission team later.
... But right now, Hatsuharu is on my mind.

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>Advice From a Friend</size>

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Empire Dormitory
*Whimper*... I thought this would happen... I should've never accepted the task...
I practiced it so much on my way to the office, but I just can't say the words in front of the Commander...
Yo, Hatsuharu!
*Eek*?! *Whimper*... H-hello, Hiyou...
Oh, did I spook you there? Sorry.
I gave the report on your behalf, so don't fret over it. If you were so scared of giving the report, you should've just asked me to do it...
Um, t-thank you... I'm just...
... You're still anxious about it, aren't you?
Mhm... I wanted to try to get over my social anxiety...
... B-but as soon as I stepped into the office, I forgot everything I had p-practiced on the way there...
I see... So that's how it is. Sounds to me like your problem is a lack of confidence.
(Hatsuharu nodded in agreement.)
Let's see, something to boost your confidence... Aha! I've got it!
This should help!
... An... eyepatch...?
Uh-huh. If you hide your eye, people won't be able to sense the weakness within you. Put it on, give it a try. Oh yeah, you need an imposing sword as well. Wanna borrow mine?
T-thanks, but no thanks...
Don't say that. If you give up now, you'll never get over your social anxiety.
... Maybe we need to take more drastic measures. Hatsuharu, let's head out, right now! You have the power within you to conquer the high seas, the Commander, and even your social anxiety!
*Whimper*... I don't think I...
Hey, Hatsuharu~ So, I was thinking we could go on a patrol together later.
Whoa, Hatsuharu! You look pretty cool!
*Whimper*... I-I can't do thiiiiis!
And so, Hiyou's plans of conquering the high seas never left the drawing board.

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>You Can Do It, Hatsuharu!</size>

scripts.say: A while later, in the Sakura Empire Dormitory
Who does Hiyou think she is, trying to involve you in some weird scheme... If we hadn't shown up, I bet she would've turned you into a pirate or something.
*Whimper*... I-I just wanted to be more confident so I could help people more... I'm sure she just misunderstood what I wanted...
You wanna be confident, huh... You can hardly hold a conversation with anyone but us, isn't that right?
It's okay, Hatsuharu! Social anxiety and self-esteem issues can be overcome, you just have to keep at it!
W-Wakaba?! W-when did you get here...?!
Just now! I only overheard a portion of what you guys were talking about.
Well, th... thank you... I'll keep trying...
Oh, look at that pretty butterfly! I'm gonna go catch it!
Don't run or else you'll trip, Wakaba!
I caught it! I caught... Whoaaahh?!
Wakaba! A-are you okay?!
*Giggle*~ I'm okay! I might have tripped, but I tripped with style! Oh yeah, anyway...
How come you can talk to us just fine, but you struggle so much when talking to other people?
Isn't it because she knows us, so she doesn't feel anxious around us?
A-actually, yeah... that sounds about right...
If that's all, shouldn't you try just talking a lot to other people until you feel as comfortable around them as you do with us?
T-that's true, it's all about feeling comfortable... But... I don't get many opportunities to talk to the Commander...
Request to become the Commander's secretary. If you become the secretary, you'll get to talk to each other every day, even if you hate it. The position is open, so go for it.
B-become the Commander's secretary?! That's impossible, I can't...
Don't say that. If you give up now, you'll never get over your social anxiety.
... N-no, I have to try!
You can do it, Hatsuharu!

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>Hatsuharu, The Secretary!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
P-p-please, let me be your secretary!
... I didn't expect to see this today.
I-I'm, umm, socially anxious, but... I-I'll try my best to be a g-good secretary!
I-I want to be someone that people can rely on!
Don't be so surprised, Commander~ *Phew*, it's a good thing I came along... You see, Commander...
Wakaba explained the situation.
Now I understand. Hatsuharu wants to cure her social anxiety.
Is... i-is that... g-good?
You did it! Now just give it all you've got, Hatsuharu! I'll leave now so I won't get in your way! See ya!
Uh, um, okay! I-I promise to give it my all!
It's good to see that she's enthusiastic, but it remains to be seen how far that will get her.
You there, Sakura Empire girl, could you tell me what the schedule is for tomorrow's exercises?
*Eek*?! W-what did you ask?! I-I'm not...
Whoa there, what's with the apology? I'm not trying to steal your lunch money, little girl.
Has the †Area† for the †Exercises† of the morrow been prepared yet?
P... pardon me?
So you do not comprehend me... Clear as day it is to me: you are no wielder of the †Force†...
*Whimper*... I'm sorry that I can't help!
This doesn't appear to be going very well...
I-I'm sorry! I-I'm just... no good at t-talking to people...
*Sob*... T-thank you...
... You'll be my conversation partner?! You'll help me practice so I can get better at it?!
... A-are you sure you don't mind?! Thank you so much!
I doubt Hatsuharu realizes she just managed to converse really well.
Now the question is: where do we start...

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>Fruitless Efforts?</size>

scripts.say: One day at the Practice Area
I saw you nab that MVP like nobody's business, Ayanami! That's my sister!
I would say you did fairly well too.
Hey, you don't have to be so modest~ And Hatsuharu, you did great too~ Good luck with your secretary work! See ya~
T-thank you! Y-you did great too! See you!
... I really didn't do all that great...
(I can give it my all in a real battle, but when I'm training with Fubuki and the rest, I can't maneuver as well as they do...)
(Practicing with the Commander has really improved my sociability, and I've slowly gotten better at doing secretary work, yet I still can't do well in combat with people I don't know...)
(This really is just impossible for me...)
Maybe all my hard work has been in vain... If so, I probably don't need to force myself to be the Commander's secretary anymore...
Yo, Hatsuharu!
*Eek*?! ... It's you, Hiyou? Please stop s-scaring me like that!
Oh, sorry... I saw you standing over here, alone, and I was just wondering: did something bad happen?
N-no, nothing at all! I'm just a little t-tired...
Something's obviously happened. It's written all over your face.
W-what?! N-no, I'm just...
*Sigh*... I wasn't trying to eavesdrop, but I overheard your little monologue. Are you really gonna resign from being the secretary?
W-well...
Listen. Confidence isn't about being able to have a smooth conversation, it's about having the courage to face and overcome your own shortcomings.
You don't want all your efforts up to this point to have been for nothing, do you?
If you give up now, you'll never muster the courage to try again.
B-but I...
She's right, you know. You won't solve your problems by running away from them.
Don't give up, Hatsuharu! I'll support you the whole way!
Hatsushimo... Wakaba... Why are you here...?
Because a certain someone was worried about you and went looking for you. Isn't that right, Commander?
C-Commander?!

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>Hatsuharu's Determination</size>

scripts.say: C-Commander, why are you here...?

options.content: Because I was worried about you, just like Hatsushimo said.

scripts.say: *Whimper*... Thank you for caring so much about me, Commander...
But that doesn't change the fact... that I'm subpar, both as a secretary and as a soldier... All I do is get in people's ways...
I can't even overcome my social anxiety...
... I've... changed...
... Since the first time we talked...?
I went to report the results of a commission, but once I stood in front of you I forgot everything I was going to say and ran away...
Then I became your secretary, you helped me become better at talking, and I somehow managed to hold a conversation with strangers...
And now I can actually talk to you, and... W-wait... I'm actually able to... hold a conversation with you...?
So you finally realized it. You've always been slow to catch on~
The Commander helped me so much... I don't understand how I didn't realize it sooner...
Well, that's just like you, Hatsuharu!
*Sob*... The Commander was always cheering me up... And somehow I didn't even realize it...

options.content: Tell Hatsuharu what you plan to talk about tomorrow

scripts.say: O-okay! That sounds good!
Hah, looks like my work here is done.
Thank you so much... Hiyou, Hatsushimo, Wakaba, and you too, Commander... I'll keep at it! One day I'll be anxiety-free!
Hatsuharu's eyes were twinkling with determination.

sequence:
The Timid Black Cat

<size=45>The Black Cat's Daily Life</size>

scripts.say: A while later...
Aww, you mean you can't do it?
I-I'm fairly sure, yes! Those funds are necessary to expand the fleet...!
So my plan to buy new games in the name of cultural research has failed?!
Dang... So be it... Thanks for your time, Hatsuharu...
*Pant*... *pant*... I'm sorry, Long Island...!
So she wanted to use our funds to buy games, huh... Nice try...
Long Island's schemes aside... Slowly but surely, Hatsuharu has been getting better at conversing with people.
Next, we have to work out the practice schedule... and plan for the research tasks...
Hey, Hatsuharu!
Wakaba?! C-could you not hug me from behind out of nowhere?!
But I wanted to see you!
Didn't you see me just yesterday...
It's always great to see sister ships getting along this well.
Oh yeah, I was wondering something! When are you gonna confess to the Commander?
W-when am I what?!
Huh?!
<size=67.5>W-w-what are you talking about, Wakaba?!</size>
Just the other day you were wondering to yourself when the best time to "confess to the Commander" is! *Giggle*, I'm sure you 2 would make a great coup-
Whuah?!
H-how in the world did you hear that?!
*Giggle*~ My ears are sharper than you might think~
Speaking of which, there was one time when Hatsuharu was hoping that you-
<size=67.5>D-don't say any more!</size>
It seems our rowdy days will continue for some time.

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>1. The Dragon Empery Estate</size>

scripts.say: Port - Nearing the Spring Festival
Tadaaaaah~! Our Dragon Empery-style estate is all finished! From the interior to the courtyard, everything's... absolutely... perfect!
"In the riverside garden of apricot trees, flowers bloom overnight in the spring breeze. A myriad of colors blend, reflected in ripples of green."
Such a splendid scenery was made possible due to Miss Yat Sen's proposal, the hard work of all our friends, and the generous support of the Commander.
Next up... is to make our paradise open to the public!
I'm really looking forward to seeing the reactions on everyone's faces! I bet they're gonna love it!
Naturally. But lest we put the cart before the horse, we'll have to find ways of attracting more people to visit.
Precisely. We'll need to devise a stratagem to quickly increase our name recognition.
Hmm... Maybe we could get up on stage and start banging gongs and drums?
A plausible idea in theory, but if we don't make enough noise, people won't be able to hear us.
On the other hand, if we make too much noise... we're going to end up being a public nuisance. Maybe the drums aren't such a great idea after all...
Ugh, you have a point, but... simply handing out flyers feels way too boring, y'know?
I suppose something too pedestrian wouldn't get the point across. This is supposed to be a major celebration after all.
Let's try going about this differently. In your opinion, what do you think is the most appealing aspect of our Dragon Empery estate?
...It's huge!
Well, yes, but so are a lot of other things... Don't you mean, the scenery?
Indeed, Chen Hai is absolutely correct. What we can offer is a breathtaking view you can't get elsewhere.
If we can capture the very best views and publicize them properly, we'll be able to give everyone a glimpse of the scenery they'll be able to witness here.
Hrmmmm... That makes sense.
That's fine and all, but promoting the "scenery" alone may not do justice to the sights we have to offer.
Since time immemorial, aesthetes have paired the most beautiful scenery nature has to offer with the most beautiful women. But how do we go about finding these beautiful women...?
How about the three of us? I reckon we're good enough!
*cough*... I appreciate the sentiment, but I can hardly be considered "beautiful"...
But I guess if we just need models, we should be able to grab some of our friends from the Dragon Empery.
Just from the Dragon Empery? Since our purpose is to have as many people visit as possible, wouldn't it make more sense to cooperate with our friends from all over the world?

Let them don the most spectacular garments of the Dragon Empery so we may take pictures of them throughout our little paradise. That way, they can become beauties that truly represent the union of heaven and earth.
And in the process, we'll also be promoting the peerless beauty of the Dragon Empery's traditional attire! Hehehe...
Finally, we can use the photoshoot to create lots of promotional materials to get even more people to come visit us!
Through this fortuitous cycle of events, our reputation will spread far and wide~
Oh, so basically, "throwing bricks to attract jade!"
Nobody would consider the precious photos of their friends to be "bricks," would they?
Hai Chi, it's not like we're running a pyramid scheme here...
Well, whatever. As for its name, why don't we go with "Spring Festival Paradise Photoshoot?"
Paradise, huh? That has a nice ring to it. I like it!
Chen Hai, who do you think our first model should be?
I'll be glad to tell you, if you don't mind running a little errand for me~
Ooh, pick me! What do you need me to do?

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>2. A Chemical Concoction?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Estate
(The first photoshoot was of Miss U-73 from the Iron Blood, and if I recall, she was supposed to be in the study near the entrance...)
(Oh my, what is this wonderful herbal aroma...?)
Happy Lunar New Year, Miss Chen Hai!
Happy Lunar New Year to you too. May I ask what you're doing with this entire set, Miss U-73?
A classical backdrop coupled with modern scientific instruments – a marriage of tradition and modernity!
Oh right, Hai Chi told me earlier, you were planning on taking some photos for promotional purposes, right? So, I moved some stuff around in the room.
I must say, you've arranged the scenery and props in a refreshingly novel way.
Heh heh, who said this was a prop? This labware's actually the real deal~
Then, this herbal aroma filling the room is also...
My sister's carefully-crafted, Lunar New Year special concoction!
Mm... It certainly has a rather "modern" scent to it.
I can assure you, this aroma meets all our specifications. As for the taste... yeah, it should be fine too.
I did add in some herbs, but this formula doesn't include any artificial additives.
After we're done with our photoshoot, everyone should give this special tea a try!
Hehe. I'm looking forward to it.
If you like how it tastes, think you could put in a good word for my chemis-tea?
Miss U-73, we're done setting up the equipment! Ready whenever you are!
I'll be done in a sec! Now then, let's do that photoshoot~♪

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>3. The Flying General Approaches!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Estate
(Some snow was shovelled into the courtyard for use as part of a prop set.)
(My, what's that sound...?)
(Hoofsteps? They're getting closer too.)
You over there! Identify yourself!
I am Chen Hai, strategist to the Dragon Empery. It is an honor to meet the Flying General of the Keystone State in person.
......Uhh, come again?
I didn't expect you to give me an answer like that with a straight face. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to say, haha.
Today's photoshoot set is quite a faithful reproduction, if I must say so myself.
"The north wind blows, the fountaingrass folds. In the eighth month falls winter's cold." ...Though, we'll be leaving winter behind soon.
How do you like the set that Hai Chi and I put together?
I suppose this is "the spring breeze arriving on the dancing snow." I wonder if this set is supposed to represent the White Gate Tower.
Oh, speaking of the Flying General...
The White Gate Tower? What's that?
Oh, don't worry about it. The White Gate Tower marked the winter of the Dragon Empery's Flying General, but your outfit seems inspired by another brave general 300 years prior.
I see. You learn something new every day! But I have no doubts that both of those Flying Generals were heroic and fierce!
But uh, this is the place I was supposed to come for the photoshoot, right? And the lines I was supposed to memorize went something like...
"Pennsylvania, the Keystone General, has arrived!"
––Thank you very much! That was a fantastic shot!
A fierce general painting her legacy onto a pristine, snow-white landscape... This concept will surely win over hearts and minds.
Yup! We'll have to make sure to thank Akashi later for providing a snow machine and the horse!
Wait... Akashi... did all that for free?
That must be a saga for the ages. You must tell me more about it later.

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>4. Wandering Beyond the Boundaries</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Estate
Miss Chen Hai, is th-th-this spot okay?
I, umm... I think I'm p-p-perfectly relaxed now!
(She says that, but she looks about as relaxed as a coiled spring...)
(If anything, telling her to relax is only going to end up being counterproductive. In that case...)
Miss Bristol, I heard you have a knack for adventuring. Do you think you'd be able to picture some place you'd like to explore?
Picture... an adventure?
Anything will do. The sky's the limit.
Hmm... That's an interesting proposal. Bristol, have you ever heard the tale of Carefree Wandering?
Ah, yes. Now, Bristol, please close your eyes and listen to the story I'm about to tell you.
Um, okay! I'll give it a try!
Bristol closed her eyes, and Hai Tien began to tell her an ancient tale from the Dragon Empery.
"In the northern deeps lived the Kun, its length several thousand li immeasurable."
Once upon a time in the waters of the North, there lived a fish of mythical proportions called the Kun.
It was said to have been thousands of li in length, a veritable living island.
You land upon the Kun's back as it drifts across the ocean, seemingly without purpose.
Woahh... I can already picture how epic that is...
"Into a Peng it transforms, its length several thousand li immeasurable. When it takes flight, its wings are clouds that blanket the skies."
Suddenly, the island beneath your feet begins to tremble. When you look around you, the fish has turned into a massive bird that then takes off to the skies.
The water that splashes from its wings when it takes flight rains down from the skies, its huge wings like clouds that descend over the land.
You cling to its body desperately as to not be thrown from its back––
Woaaah!! I'm gonna fall!!
You do not know how long it has been, but the bird finally stops its ascension and begins to glide serenely across the sky.
You finally let go and begin to relax. Small birds chirp and gather at your sides, clamoring to play with you.
You reach into your pocket for a straw, and start to blow colorful little bubbles for them.
Fwooh...
––Now that's a photo-worthy expression! Thank you very much!
Yes, excellently done. Bristol, you can now open your eyes.
Wait... I can see something in the clouds...
Oh? What might you be seeing?
There's some kind of rainbow-colored cone coming out of the clouds... It seems to be rising up about ten feet, with a diameter about that wide as well...
A rainbow-colored cone... Wait, hold on a sec!
I... I can't look away from it!
The cone seems to be covered with strange, uneven scales of some sort...
At the top of the cone, there's four retractable organs... W-woah, that looks like some kind of evil creature!
Let's go, giant Kun! Let's go fight it together!
You can come back to reality now, Miss Bristol. Our time's almost up~
And thus, another photoshoot was completed successfully.

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>5. Poetry in the Park</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Estate
There's plenty of time until the next photoshoot, so maybe I'll take a stroll around the park.
Who's that in the pavilion at the center of the pond?
...Yesterday's snow has made this pavilion even more picturesque.
But alas... the snow here has already thinned out significantly.
Hey, Hai Chi, bring the snow machine over here for a bit––
Sure, sure! One snowstorm, coming right up!
Great~ That looks much better!
Ahh, the sparse remnants of autumn leaves in the white snow make this scenery feel all that much more poetic...
*Achoo!* Um, Hai Chi, please don't point the snow machine directly at me!
Ehehe, I thought you wanted to know what it felt like to be in the middle of a snowstorm!
Just the general mood is good enough! Jeez, you're going to blow all the leaves away! Just a thin layer of snow is sufficient.
Fiiiiine...
Hai Tien paced back and forth in the artificial snow, her lips curled into a slight frown.
Let's see, the first verse... "One paces amidst the park's sleet and snow, the last traces of fall reflected in the pond."
That sounds pretty good. Now for the next verse...
Good afternoon, everyone.
Hello, hello! We're here to play!
Hope we're not bothering you.
Oh my, it's good to see the three of you. Welcome to my little pavilion. How do you like the view here?
It's quite nice. I like the wintery feel.
Let's have a snowball fight! Hai Chi, Hai Tien, wanna join in?
Let's do it!
I'm trying to compose a poem for the occasion. Apologies, but I'm afraid I must decline.
Hope you find the right words soon!
I see. I was wondering if something was bothering you from the way you were pacing back and forth, but you were just trying to come up with some poetry.
Would you mind sharing what you've come up with so far?
Sure. I'm only about halfway through, but it goes like this– "One paces amidst the park's sleet and snow, the last traces of fall reflected in the pond."
I'm not sure how to continue from here though.
Hmm... It seems to convey a sense of sorrow and loss.
That's usually the kind of mood you're going for in a wintry setting like this.
Look, do you notice something about the tips of these branches?
The branches...? Oh, you're talking about the plum trees...
Oh, I get it now. I was so fixated at looking down at the water that I didn't notice what was above me.
To me, the plum tree branches represent what this place will soon become – brimming with new life once our friends come to visit.
Don't you think this wintry pavilion is just as suitable for enjoying the company of friends while appreciating the plum blossoms and sipping tea?
Ah, you're right! And you've given me the perfect idea!
Continuing on... "At the lonesome branches of winter's end, from rosy buds spring life anew."
Wow, that has a nice ring to it!
Hehe, and that's another wonderful picture taken!
Though it's not very nice to do take pictures of someone without their permission, the scenery here is simply so splendid that I'll have to ask for forgiveness later.

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>6. At Home?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Estate
Miss Chen Hai, how does this look?
Oh my, Miss Charybdis... What a daring look you're sporting.
Hm? Did you not request that I wear something capturing the spirit of being "at home?"
To me, that means something that conveys a sense of peace and comfort, something that soothes your spirits the moment you walk through the door no matter how tired you might be. Isn't that right?
You're right. Did you have a particular pose in mind?
I did, actually. How about getting ready to clean the Com– I mean, the Master's ears?
After a long day of work, the Master returns home exhausted, but finds sanctuary in my lap~
Mm, that's quite interesting. Combining our culture with the Royal Maids' spirit of service.
If you don't mind, I'd like to take the picture now.
Not at all. Thank you very much.
We're all done with the photoshoot. Thank you so much for coming, Miss Charybdis.
Good job, nya~
You're very welcome. The Royal Maids are here to help after all~♪
By the way, Akashi, what brings you here?
It's nothing major, nya. Akashi simply came by to check the site of another potential store branch.
I see... By the way, can I take these props back with me? I think I might actually want to try servicing the Master a little bit~
That's fine by me.
Thank you very much! If you don't need anything else from me, I shall take my leave~

sequence:
The Great Lunar New Year Photoshoot

<size=45>7. A Gathering of Guests</size>

scripts.say: On the day of the Grand Opening––
Welcome to the Dragon Empery Estate, nya! Please make sure to schedule your sightseeing tour here, nya!
Akashi's souvenir shop is also open as well, nya! Enjoy a 5% discount on all purchases, today only, so come on by for some great deals, nya!
Dragon Empery Estate - Windscreen Bridge
So, Bristol, this is where you did your photoshoot? It's freakin' gorgeous here!
Hehe~ I can make that same pose too!
Hold that pose! I'll take your picture too, and we can compare 'em later!
Dragon Empery Estate - Snowy Plains
You over there! Identify yourself!
I am the successor to the crown, Valiant! I challenge you to glorious combat!
Edinburgh, get me my horse!
Where is Akashi getting all these horses...?
Hehe... This fine steed was hand-picked from Her Majesty's Royal Stables!
Come! Test your mettle!
Dragon Empery Estate - Chemistry Lab?
What a wonderful aroma...
Welcome to U-73's Chemis-Tea Lab! Would you like to try a cup?
Y-yes, please!
Alright, coming right up! Just give me a sec.
Dragon Empery Estate - Pavilion in the Pond
Woah... Look how many people there are! Our plan worked perfectly!
Yes, everyone looks like they're having a great time.
Now that our strategy has been set in motion, all that remains is to see things through to the end.
I wanna go have fun with everyone else!
Sure, but we need to finish our work here first.
As the organizers of this event, we're in charge of making sure everything here continues to run smoothly. And I trust more work will be on its way.
Oh, there you girls are!
Hehe. Right on schedule.
Did you need us for something, Ying Swei?
Umm, I know you've been busy setting up over here, but do you think you could lend me a hand in finishing the Spring Festival banquet preparations?
Of course. That was on the schedule anyway.
All right, everyone. Let's make this Lunar New Year the most memorable one ever~
Loading modules...
Reading map data...
Entering final phase...

sequence: <size=45>Generating world...</size>

scripts.say: What's this? Are you girls simulating some experiment?
Ah, Commander. You came at the perfect time.
This is the inn simulation game I told you about before. It's designed specifically so you don't have to endure the burden of farm life and grow potatoes the hard way.
Naturally, this project couldn't have been brought from proposal to completion without the Dragon Empery's help.
Well, the passion and drive you all had were quite impressive as well.
Player connected...

sequence: <size=45>…………loading…………</size>

scripts.say: Whoa, your outfits all changed. This is incredible tech.
Heheh. Do you think you'll join us on this first test, Commander?
Our inn is already prepped and ready to accept a new manager.
Sure thing. Sounds fun.
Um, if I may butt in...
Bogatyr, could you please include my prized recipes in the game? They've all been tried and tested.
If I were to follow those recipes, could I cook delicious food for the Commander?
Uh... You don't need to push the edge of the envelope.
Scanning... Recipe data registered.

sequence: <size=45>…………loading…………</size>

scripts.say: Seems we need to wait a little longer.
Which is just fine. Let me take this opportunity to reintroduce the goal behind this project.
We wanted to build an automated information system for economic management, using Comrade Bogatyr's computational and logical abilities at its core.
The result, this inn management simulator, will help with our data gathering.
Also, the test will focus on the two most important aspects of managing an inn: Dining and lodging.
Moskva's and Chen Hai's explanation is suddenly interrupted by a resounding warning from Bogatyr.
Warning: Unidentified data package detected... It's forcing itself to load.
Heehee! If you're making a game, you definitely need some of my original ideas!
This addition makes it so that staff have a chance to be flung into a fantasy world while serving, and they've gotta defeat the King of Evil before the food goes cold!
Warning: Data is incompatible... Expansion pack failed to load.
Failed?! Why?! I just tested it and it worked fine!
Initial parameters verified...

sequence: <size=45>…………loading…………</size>

scripts.say: What's the matter, Bogatyr?
Nothing. I set some time aside for any issues that may crop up.
Resuming generation... Non-interruptive error detected: A large number of characters have entered...
Generating environmental data... Progress: 100%.
Deploying characters... Progress: 100%.
Initiate... Springtide Inn Online!
The sun had set, and the lanterns decorating the garden pavilion were lit.
That lazy, urging voice still rang in my ears as I followed the path, until I found Perseus lying on her side. She seemed exhausted after a day of play, too tired to lift a finger.
Didn't expect you so soon, Manager.
As you can probably tell, this bed is a mess, and I can't sleep.
The sheet is crumpled, and the pillows are on the floor. You're capable – you can tidy it up, can't you?
I was gonna ask how this happened to begin with, but alright.
Deciding not to probe further, I pick up the pillows and smooth out the soft bedsheet while she watches me.
Once in a while, she moves her body just a little to facilitate my work. Beyond that, though, she just tracks my every move with her eyes like a cat observing their owner.
Left... Yeah, like that. It was lumped up and making me super uncomfortable.
Can you fluff up the pillows a little more? As fluffy as a cloud would be great.
Hm... Yeah, I guess I can lie decently comfortably now.
By the way... the wind ruffled up my hair. There's a comb in the box by the bed. You know how to untangle hair, don't you?
Slowly, she turns to lie on her stomach, letting her long hair sprawl across the bed. Her fair arms and the lines of her shoulders lie completely exposed.
Taking the comb out of the box, I sit down on the bed. I hold her hair and start gently running the comb through it.
As the rhythmic rustling of the comb running through her hair continues, she all of a sudden leans into my arms.
Your heart is beating awfully loudly, considering you're just combing my hair...
Ba-dump, ba-dump... Like a bird hard at work.
Her whisper is so low that it almost fades into the evening breeze.
I run the comb through her hair again. The tips of my fingers brush against her earlobe, which has suddenly become delicate.
She shrinks in my arms, a small shudder shaking her.
Put... Put the comb down for a second.
Do it again... Touch that part again...
Yeah... Right there...
Mgghh... Tickles...
My ear? No... My heart?
Could it be that... some hardworking bird has flown right into my heart?
She turns to face me and clings to my body. Her warm breath blows on my face.
Well, uh... You made my bed and combed my hair...
Think you're gonna... stay the night here?
If you want me to stay, then I'll stay.
The flickering lanternlight reflects in her eyes. She looks up and takes my hand, guiding it to the gap where her hair and neck meet.
Her breathing turns into panting, and her cool skin gradually takes on warmth.
You won't get blinded by the bright moonlight in here... And the bed is really comfy...
So tonight... You're staying here. Don't go anywhere...
Manager, fetch me a cup of warm wine and a bunch of meat!
A deliberately raised voice rings out from above. I look around for its source, and it turns out to be Ozornoy on the roof.
You sure took your sweet time, Manager!
A pleasant evening breeze blows through, rocking the lanterns suspended from the roof. Ozornoy, standing on the ridge beam with her arms crossed, grimaces at me.
If I were a bad-mannered customer, I'd wreck the place over how slow you are!
If by any chance I wasn't on duty, how would you deal with that, huh?
As the inn's guard, she's training me on how to respond to unexpected situations. Right now, she's playing the role of a miscreant who's dining and dashing.
Something-something, "The teaching is more effective if you act it out," according to her.
Even the worst-mannered of customers wouldn't think to climb up on a rooftop, much less bark out orders from up there.
Well, THIS terrible customer is also trained in martial arts! That makes them even more dangerous!
I'll give you an example! Watch closely and take notes!
Without even waiting for my response, she takes a step forward, grabs my arm, and trips me.
Thrown off balance, I cry out in surprise and immediately hit the ground. I feel her entire body weight on top of me.
Hey! Why... Why are you making that look?!
Although she blushes for a moment, she quickly regains her composure.
Let me make this clear! I'm just playing the role of an unreasonable customer here! This is part of the act! Let's continue!
Now that I get a better look at you, you're pretty good-looking, Manager!
I know what to do! I'm taking you with me!
Now, hold on – you sure you're really a troublesome customer and not a plain old kidnapper?
Bad people act on impulses! You just have terrible safety awareness!
But seriously, now's when you fight back! You're not just gonna let me haul you away, are you?
Now let me thoroughly teach you how you're supposed to resist!
Saying that, she takes my hand and uses it to launch me forward. We roll around twice on the roof, after which our positions are suddenly reversed.
Yeah! Good! That's it!
She lies sprawled out on the roof, slightly out of breath, and her cheeks faintly flushed.
Now you need to completely subdue the troublemaker. Like this...
With those words, she folds her arms around my waist and applies some force.
Now brought closer, I can see myself clearly reflected in her eyes.
O-okay... This is maybe a little TOO close...
She mutters something under her breath and averts her gaze.
Alright, that's the end of my demonstration... Now you do it!
If you don't manage to convince me, I'm gonna whoop you with everything I have!
...What the–? Your moves are so smooth... How'd you learn them this quickly?!
I suppose you really were listening... Wait, what?
She instinctively tries to struggle, but ends up in a position even harder to break free from than in the demonstration she just gave me.
W-wait... You can't... You can't do this!
This isn't what I taught you!
It seems Ozornoy and I still have a lot of one-on-one self-defense training to go...
This warehouse, ostensibly used to store goods, actually has a second purpose.
Truthfully, this place is Bogatyr's server room, the beating heart of this test.
She sits down in a very relaxed pose, her still body leaning against the central server plugged in with a large number of cables.
Guess you dozed off while doing maintenance on the server.
My question dissolves into silence. Only the sound of the server fans spinning echoes in the vast warehouse.
I wrap my arms around her, intent on carrying her somewhere more comfortable.
The moment I touch her body, however, she goes completely limp and falls toward me.
Her head lands on the base of my neck, her breath brushing against my skin. She leans her entire body weight on me without any reserve.
Mmh... Commander?
A quiet murmur comes from between my arms.
Looking down, I see Bogatyr slowly opening her light-blue eyes.
Her long eyelashes flutter, and the lenses in the back of her pupils dilate and contract a bit before finally focusing on my face.
What happened to you?
Nothing... I'm fine...
I'm currently performing regular maintenance on the server for Springtide Inn Online...
Server data update progress: 75%...
Since it costs a lot of computational resources, I need to reduce the power consumption of most other modules...
Warning: Forcibly moving my body at this stage incurs a risk of data loss.
Commander, just keep me where I am... Don't move.
She gives me no chance to ask questions before clinging even closer, seemingly trying to find the most stable posture.
The warehouse falls silent again. All I can sense clearly is the weight and warmth of her body.
Time passes. Maybe it's just 10 seconds, maybe it's several minutes...
...Bogatyr?
No response. All I hear is her breathing and the beating of her heart.
Then, suddenly, she trembles slightly.
Server data update progress: 100%. Update complete.
Commander...
Thank you for helping me stabilize the parameters. You allowed me to successfully complete the update.
Although, my own system isn't yet fully operational again...
Her eyes are open again, but the rest of her body is unresponsive.
Ugh... An ever-growing amount of unreadable and abnormal data is appearing in my system...
Overload... Warning: Overload... C-Commander...
Her cheeks turn faintly red, and her eyes waver. After hesitating for a while, she finally meets my gaze.
I'd like to analyze this data now...
So please, stay with me a little longer... Let's both find out what's causing this abnormal data...
As our group sat on the terrace together one evening, we heard unusually lively sounds coming from the kitchen.
Sitting outside the kitchen for once, Lung Wu was restless. Her big tail swished back and forth constantly.
Wh-what do I do...
I'm so worried that I can't even think straight...
Sit down and take a break. Everything will be okay.
You worked hard today. Everyone just wants to make it up to you with a nice meal.
Yeah! Relax and watch the fireworks with us!
But the kitchen is a dangerous place, you know. Mishandling ingredients and ruining a meal would be the least of our worries...
What if a pot caught fire, or someone cut their hand? It could be disastrous.
Just the thought of it drives me crazy...
I'd better go check on them!
Not gonna happen. We all agreed that it's high time you get some rest.
But... Oh, Fei Yuen went into the kitchen!
And I see Fu Shun! She's going that way too, isn't she?!
Imagine if they play a prank in the kitchen!
Oh, what do we do...
Huh? More people are coming, too? Wait... Chi An?! Sh-she's going in there?!
NO! I can't let this happen!
We've come this far. Why not just have faith in our friends for now?
We stare fixedly at the curtain leading into the kitchen as Chi An gracefully enters.
And then, she's promptly escorted out. The sight of that makes us breathe a collective sigh of relief.
See? Everything's fine. Don't be so nervous.
Now take a look at this.
I take two glistening candied fruits out of a box on the table and offer her one.
Sweets will make you feel better. But first... how about we play a game together?
Huh? A game?
Rock-paper-scissors. If you win, you can have this candied fruit that I made myself.
You mean it? Okay... I'll play. Bring it on, Manager!
Oh, we both threw rock! I guess it's a tie.
There... Oh! I win!
Aww, I lost!
Don't worry too much about the result. I made it as a reward for you anyway. Try it.
Thank you... Mm... The candy coating is crispy, but not too thick... The fruit inside is so sweet and sour, too. It's delicious!
If everyone were as skilled as you, I could rest easy...
Practice makes perfect. What's the harm in letting them get some more experience in the kitchen?
I suppose you're right... Oh, the food is coming!
Fei Yuen and Fu Shun laugh and joke together as they deliver piping-hot dishes. The food looks surprisingly appetizing.
Lung Wu tentatively places a piece in her mouth and chews slowly.
It's... actually not bad. I can tell that everyone worked really hard on it.
You should try some, too.
Sharing this meal with you and everyone else... might make it the best food I've ever had.
Fireworks fly up and burst, painting the night sky.
Although there's still some liveliness lingering in the lobby, the chairs and tables have been neatly put away. It's time to close up shop.
Whew. What a fulfilling day.
Mhm. And now it's coming to an end.
Jolly good job, my hardworking squirrel. I've got steaming hot soup buns to share with you!
Om, nom... Delicious!
Om, nom... Tasty!
Thanks, Thes– Wait, Theseus?
That's my name, don't wear it out! I worked a lot today and even got loads of compliments for my work.
Well, I appreciate it, but if memory serves me right, aren't you supposed to be a guest?
Heehee. Now that you mention it, yeah.
Still, I had a bite, then helped out around the inn, and fulfilled my duty as a good guest.
All's fine, the way I see it!
Is it, though? Really?
I mean, that's not what's important here.
What's important is that you've not yet rewarded me for all the hard work I put in today, Manager!
You mean like a wage? I'd have to do some math...
No, no. Wages are for stable employees. I'm just a guest who helped a bit.
Ergo, I don't expect to get money, but something else.
Heheh... Let's see, what could I ask for...
I've got it! These soup dumplings!
I feed you, and you feed me!
Come on, Manager. Open wide!
Nicely done. You were like a cute fledgling waiting for food from its mum!
Alright, now it's your turn to feed me.
I pick up a soup dumpling and bring it to Theseus' mouth. Like a small bird, she takes little nibbles out of it. One bite, another bite...
As soon as she's done eating, she suddenly takes my finger and sticks it in her mouth.
The soft, warm sensation lingers for a while. It's almost like she's savoring something better than a dessert.
Mmh... Delicious. Thanks for that!
Aww, there's only one dumpling left.
In that case... We'll just split it!
She holds the dumpling in her mouth and leans in closer to me with a smile.
Before I can even react, a soft touch grazes my lips, accompanied by a faintly warm feeling.
This is yummier than I thought...
Wanna... have some more?
Heheh, alright. We're gonna really dig in tonight...♪
Chi An and I walked together, our surroundings unusually quiet. Not that I minded the silence, except...
Manager... Manager, you listening?
Oh, I'm sorry. Just thinking to myself.
You look worried. If you're ready to talk, I'm ready to listen.
I was just thinking that, while the environment around the pond is lovely, it isn't much to look at...
Really? I'd be happy to handle that for you. Hehe... Just you wait and see.
A few nights later, I finish my work for the day and step out of the inn. I'm immediately greeted by a sea of dazzling lights atop the pond.
Lanterns shaped like animals shimmer beautifully, moving as if they have a life of their own.
Welcome! Do you like tonight's special lantern show?
The look on your face tells me yes. I prepared a tour boat for us to ride together. Just come with me!
As we stand together at the bow, she takes my hand. The small boat slowly drifts into the lantern-lit world.
The night is a little chilly, but Chi An's body heat warms me up like the lights before us.
It must've taken a lot of work to set all of this up.
A small price to pay, as long as you enjoy it.
Look ahead. Do you see the lanterns everyone set on the water? They're flowing like a beautiful river of lights.
If you make a wish and let it ride on the current, it might just come true next year...
I have lanterns on this boat, too. Why don't we write down our wishes and let them set sail?
She brings me a pen and paper. Smiling, she settles into my arms and spreads her sheet of paper on her lap.
I want to write with you... Is that okay, Commander?
When I agree, she carefully considers what to write on hers.
She seems so much more mature and gentle in full dress, relaxing so comfortably in my arms.
Hmm, what should I write? Honestly, I can already feel my dream coming true, heehee.
Do you have any wishes, Commander?
Oh, let's do this. I'll close my eyes, and you hold my hand and write one down for me.
Once you're done, I'll try to guess what you wrote. Hehe, doesn't that sound fun?
I gently take her hand and move my pen slowly across the sheet of paper on her lap.
As our heartbeats intertwine, she giggles to herself, perhaps tickled by the feeling of my writing.
Hmm, I think I know your wish, Commander.
I'll help you... Together, we'll make it come true.
We light the lantern and set it atop the water. Its candlelight flickers above the waves as it joins the river of light.
It's like a dream to behold...
I have one more special present for you, Commander.
This ship has a cabin. Let's go... check it out together.
Amidst the flickering lights, our shadows nestle together on the window of the cabin.
It's midday, and the restaurant is packed full. Every now and then, you can hear guests praising the menu's breadth of options and the food's taste.
Is the Manager here? Oh, awesome!
Hearing a familiar voice, everyone turns toward the entrance.
I'll foot the bill for everyone in here today as a gesture of friendship! And please, witness the cooking battle between me and Springtide Inn!
Everyone's eyes open wide at this unbelievable declaration, and then the hall erupts with commotion.
What's going on here, Harbin?
To put it simply, I'm issuing you a challenge!
I've got nothin' better to do, so I figured I'd open a new inn next to yours.
And if I win this cooking battle, I'm gonna hang a sign outside the inn that says, "Our food is better than theirs!"
You down? Or are you chicken?
Why would I be? We've got Lung Wu on our side.
Since you're so eager for a battle, I'll give you a good one. Let's start prepping under the audience's impartial eyes.
Kitchen counters and stoves have been set up in the center of the hall, silently waiting for the two chefs to take their places.
I often say the kitchen is a battlefield... I think it might literally be one this time.
Sure looks like you mean business. Then it's your turn to step in, my head chef!
Following Harbin's declaration, a stupendously curvaceous woman appears before us all.
Hello! It's me!
...Seriously?
Hahaha! Don't be so shocked! Think about it for a sec. You think I'd pick any run-of-the-mill chef to face you?
Lemme ask you again. You chicken? Now's your last chance if you wanna throw in the towel!
We're not giving up just like that, especially when you're handing us the victory on a silver platter.
After finishing, I give Lung Wu a signal with my gaze. She sneakily acknowledges with a nod.
Ozornoy, in the interest of safety... Ahem. Set up a keep-out line around the chefs so nobody can disrupt them.
Got it!
Harbin, besides you and me, we should have one more referee to ensure fair judgment. Let's go with someone from the audience.
Good idea. Who to pick, who to pick... I'm thinkin' you!
M-me, as a referee? I-I'd love to!
Perfect. Cygnet, come to the referee table! Alright, everything's set. Time for the battle tooooo... start!
While Chi An is still staring curiously at the ingredients before her, Lung Wu has already gotten started.
Suddenly, a flash of blue lightning zooms past... and all the ingredients on the table have been prepared!
What... the hell just happened? Did Chi An just prep all that stuff in the blink of an eye?
Don't ask me – I didn't catch a thing...
As the cooking battle intensifies, a look of confusion takes shape on Chi An's face.
She picks up a scoopful of salt, which turns to oil when she pours it in. She had a basket full of vegetables, which instead turns into minced garlic when she adds it to the pan.
What's more, the stove she'd set to max heat had been turned down without anyone noticing.
Oh my goodness... Have my cooking skills finally ascended to the realm of the non-self?!
*pant*... This is hard work... W-wait, weren't you making stir-fried vegetables? Where'd you get those purple sweet potatoes from?! Why did you add them?!
Lung Wu signals at me with her eyes, and I immediately know what's up.
Ahem! Chefs, you have one minute left! Please try to finish your dishes within the allotted time!
Huh? It's almost over already?
A chef needs to be able to cook not just well, but also quickly.
Ahh. Fair point.
Hearing that time is running out, Chi An reluctantly puts her masterful idea to rest. The finishing bell rings, and both dishes are presented to the referees.
Lung Wu's dish tastes really lovely, but it'd be even better if it were fish and chips. Chi An's also has great flavour, but it'd taste even better if it were fish and chips!
Chef Lung Wu's food is amazingly tasty as always, but Chi Ain's ain't bad either! It's a bit soggy, though. Maybe the heat was slightly off?
I think the same as you, Harbin. Which means...
The winner of this battle is Lung Wu!
It's unfortunate that I lost, but it was wonderful to get to stand in the kitchen for once!
Hm? Lung Wu, why do you look so exhausted?
...This was a one-off favor.
Ahahaha! I definitely learned a bunch from this battle. I'll be back again after digesting it for a bit!
As promised, I'll foot today's entire bill! Lemme know the total! {playername}, and everybody else, see you later!
My turn? Alright...
I discard the one-character tile.
I immediately play the tile I drew. The player to my right, Ozornoy, squints and quickly scans the discard pile.
Not good... The Manager hasn't played many dot tiles at all...
Krasny, if you're gonna play any of those, you better be careful.
Krasny, sitting opposite me, responds with a nod. She turns her head aside, rubbing a tile with her fingers.
Say, Manager... Could it be that you're waiting for this seven dots tile?

options.content: Yeah. That's the one I need.

scripts.say: I've heard the Dragon Empery's military strategy is to appear weak when strong, and appear strong when weak...
If deception is the game you're playing, I've already seen through you.
Playing cautiously, I see... Ironically, that confirms my hunch.
In that case, I'll let this seven-dot tile determine the truth!
The moment she plays that tile, I reveal my hand.
I win. Pure suit hand.
Nooo! I knew it! I TOLD you to be careful!
Like a deflated balloon, Ozornoy sinks into a slump over the table's edge, her puffed-up cheek pressing against its surface.
No two ways around it – you beat me.
Well, a deal's a deal... You get to punish me.
With a swift maneuver, she hops onto the mahjong table and hunches forward, holding the seven-dot tile in her hand.
Okay...
She takes the cold tile and pushes it against her nape before then slowly slipping it into a gap in her clothes.
The chilly sensation makes her shudder hard. A small moan escapes her throat.
Agh! Mmgh... So cold... But...
Wh-what are you doing?! Get off of there! People are staring!
Ozornoy leaps up like a frightened cat, her face instantly dyed a deep red.
She looks around her in a panic, pulls off the tablecloth from a nearby table, and uses it to cover up Krasny.
At least conceal yourself a little!
Mmh... Yes, I suppose it's fine to cover myself...
Thanks, Ozornoy!
...What?
While Ozornoy is dazed, the covered-up Krasny all of a sudden leaps at me and seizes my wrist.
Her momentum knocks me to the ground. The heavy tablecloth envelops both of us.
What suddenly becomes a dark, narrow space is filled with her warmth and scent, her heated breath bearing down on me.
Give it to me... Right now, while everyone's watching...
Give me my punishment in secret under this tablecloth... Ahh... I want it so badly...
A-A-ARE YOU INSANE, SAYING THAT OUT LOUD?!
Ozornoy yells out in shock and reaches in under the tablecloth. Through some miracle, she manages to grab hold of my arm.
Come out of there, you moronic Manager! You too, you freak! Get your hands off the Manager!
What's the deal with you two?! Seriously!
Meanwhile, at an adjacent table behind a folding screen, Vampire placed the final tile on the mahjong table.
Heheh! A clean hand with a self-drawn tile, and four tiles of one suit! It seemeth that victory is–
The next moment, Vampire's triumphant expression froze in place.
The other three players at the table weren't gazing eyes wide at their own table, but rather at the one behind them.
Wh-where'd the Manager go? I could've sworn...
There's something weird going on over there... Is that some new kind of machine?
I dunno... It looks like two people wrestling under a tablecloth.
The four of them all turned their attention to the brilliantly colored cloth wriggling on the floor. Then, Ozornoy reached in from the side and tried to pull something out.
A moment later, a nine-dot tile flew out from the tablecloth and landed on the floor.
Oh my gosh... Did that thing just...
Devour the Manager?!
In that moment, Ozornoy realized that she had become the object of everyone's attention.
Why are you all just sitting there?! Get over here and help me get the Manager out!
As the renovation may incur additional expenses, Chen Hai left the room to calculate what they might be.
She went into the courtyard, where she saw several unassuming, low-flying drones buzzing overhead.
Hm? Aren't those Fargo's drones? Judging by their flight path, they must be delivering newly checked-in customers' baggage.
No, wait... Drones shouldn't exist in the setting of this game. What are they doing here?
Someone should go and stop them... Hmm. I'll follow them and have a look.
I just hope they won't influence this test.
One drone stopped outside a certain room. Chen Hai lightly knocked on the door, to which a lazy voice inside responded, "Come in."
She went inside and discovered that this room had seemingly been refashioned to suit the tastes of a Europan aristocrat. The scents of wine and high-quality wood hung in the air.
You've made quite a few renovations to this place, I see.
Hmph. It was too ordinary to be worthy of hosting me and {playername} for the night.
I see. You must care a great deal about ambiance.
Heheh. To make memories that last, you naturally need a suitably memorable environment, no?
Ägir took a sip from her wine glass, her expression somewhere between frowning and smiling. Taking the hint, Chen Hai bowed lightly and left.
Chen Hai followed another drone to a second room, and she knocked on the door again. The guest – Victorious – swiftly opened and let her inside.
Her room had instead been remodeled to resemble the Commander's office, including replica transmission equipment on the desk.
How does it look? Isn't it fair to argue that I've perfectly replicated the Commander's office?
Yes... It looks like the real thing at a glance.
Heheh! Yes, when the Commander returns to the office in reality, it will no doubt bring back fond memories of our night spent together here!
I dare say this plan of mine is truly ingenious. Wouldn't you?
...It's quite creative, that's for certain. Have a pleasant stay.
Seeing Victorious' proud smile, brimming with anticipation, Chen Hai bows with a meek expression and courteously leaves the room, closing the door behind her.
Just as Chen Hai was about to knock on the third door, she suddenly heard laughter coming from inside the room.
After gaining the occupant's permission, she went inside and was greeted by a tidy, warm, and exceedingly normal guest room.
Chang Feng, donning an apron, was giving cleaning orders to Fei Yuen and Fu Po. In a corner of the room sat a conspicuous cardboard box that had been left open.
What brings you here, Chen Hai?
Oh, nothing, I'm just checking with our guests to see if they're comfortable. I see you're quite particular about the room's cleanliness.
Yes! I felt that this place should be nice and relaxing if {playername} ever finds the time to come here someday.
There's also some delicious food ready and waiting...
Chang Feng bit her lip out of shyness, and her gaze unconsciously drifted toward the open cardboard box.
Chen Hai, likewise, looked at it, and caught a glimpse of some of the labels on the items inside.
There was eel, sea cucumber, potatoes, soft-shelled turtle...
Is something the matter? You look a little pale.
No, not at all. I just remembered I have something to do. Don't worry about me. Good luck with the cleaning.
Back in the corridor, Chen Hai let out a relieved sigh. She realized she was now fanning herself with her folding fan.
It appears our guests are all... remodeling their rooms in uniquely personal ways.
Are they trying to catch the Manager's attention? Heheh. Well, it certainly saves us some budget on interior decorations.
She suddenly closed her folding fan and gently smacked it against her other palm.
Seeing as everyone's working so hard, I'd better put in a little work as well!
*sniff sniff*... Yup, thiiis way is it. Probably.
You think the legendary lucky koi is in this pond?
Yep. It's riiight here.
Then let's get to work. We've got to be the first to catch the koi, then we...
Before U-47 could finish speaking, her attention was pulled to a nearby pond, where Chao Ho and Ying Swei were splashing around.
Ying Swei! Found anything? Did you catch the lucky koi?
I've sadly not even seen the shadow of it, much less caught it.
Dang... Oh, hang on, I've caught something! This could be it!
Chao Ho firmly grabbed the object in the water and pulled with all her might! The next second, U-47 burst out of the water.
...Oh. Sorry. It's my instinct to sneak up on people.
Raaawr!
Whuah?! Figures... Hey, are you girls looking for the lucky koi, too?
Did you perhaps hear the same tale as Chao Ho did about being blessed with a year of luck, were you to touch it?
Yep. I reeeally wanna touch the lucky koi.
The thing is, can't only ONE person be the first to touch it?
Only one?!
Chao Ho and U-110 exchanged a glance and saw the fiery determination burning in each other's eyes.
Ying Swei, we've grown as people! We're NOT about to lose to them!
Sharkie tiiime! I'm on the huuunt!
You sure are motivated.
They certainly are. Oh, Chao Ho! Be careful!
After a fruitless hunt that lasted a while, the group gathered again in the same place.
It's because of me... The koi must be scared of sharks...
*pant*... *pant*... O-okay, time-out! We really should come up with a strategy together on how to catch it!
Then allow me to pose a question. Is the lucky koi even in this pond to begin with?
Of course it is! It has to be. Probably. I think...
It's here.
Masséna, humming a tune as she passed by, chimed in.
I passed a bridge just earlier, and lots of gold and red fish swam around me. They were so cute.
Huh? WHAT?!
Raaawr! Amazing!
Um, Masséna, can I ask you a favor?
Per U-110's and Chao Ho's request, Masséna went and brought the koi back with her.
This allowed the former two the opportunity to touch one. Their luck for the coming year would improve to some extent... or so one would hope.
The lobby of the inn is lit with bright lights, and people frolic and smile.
Matches for sale! Matches for sale here!
Looking for baozi! Is anyone selling baozi?
No, Ping Hai! You got it wrong again.
Two suspicious sisters waded through the crowd outside the inn, matches in their pockets and steamed buns on their minds, and then slipped out to the back of the inn.
We finally made it! Ping Hai, do you remember this place? It's the unlucky inn we opened that went out of business!
Yeah, and now it's totally thriving. I doubt they'll fail anytime soon.
They apparently hired a new, really skilled manager just a while ago. I wonder if it's true.
Whatever the case, we need to infiltrate the inn and uncover the secret to their business success!
To that end, I've planned three routes. One: Disguise as customers and go through the main entrance. Two: Sneak in through the kitchen's back door. The last one is–
Sis, see that window there? I think it's open.
...That's our third route, then! Let's go!
With a rustling sound, the two sneak into the kitchen, landing on the floor with a thud shortly followed by another.
We're inside... Whoa, holy cow! Look at all those steaming baskets!
Stay focused. First, we have to find their ledger.
Oh, I know where the ledger is! Want me to show you to it?
That'd be a huge– Whuah?! Who are you?!
A girl with a staff in hand leaned imposingly against the kitchen door. Her sharp gaze was fixed on the two sisters.
I'm Ozornoy – guard of the inn.
Haven't seen you before. You don't work here, do you?
We, uhh... We've come to see how this business is run!
Yeah! We're here to learn!
Right. Learn. By sneaking in through the kitchen and looking for our ledger.
Now's your chance to tell the truth! Who do you work for, and who taught you?
Either you give it up here and now willingly... or I'll bring you to the Manager! You crooks will get what's–
Just as Ozornoy was about to finish lecturing them, Ning Hai and Ping Hai both reacted like a pair of students scared of having their parents called to school.
Ping Hai, run for it!
I'll cover you, Sis!
The two immediately made a break for the lobby.
I wasn't finished yet! Get back here!
The inn has been open for quite some time now, and thanks to Moskva's and Chen Hai's oversight, everything has come together bit by bit.
Moskva and I just finished poring over the latest business data. I left the room to help out at the storefront.
That was when, suddenly...
We'd better split up here, Ping Hai! Meet me outside!
Got it!
Thud... Something slams into me from the front.
Another thud... This time, from behind.
Oww, my head...
I-I said we were gonna split up! How'd we run into each other again?!
What's with all the commotion this late at night?
Manager, I caught these two sneaking around, and they took off as soon as I saw them!
No, we didn't! We're just...
Here to learn... what your secret is.
Yeah, exa– No, not that! We're just two sisters who sell matches! Don't think you can pick on us just 'cause your business is bigger!
You "just" sell matches. Yeah, right.
From what I know, the Springtide Inn was previously jointly managed by two girls.
Apparently, they ultimately ran off after the inn went bankrupt due to a lack of business.
Nooo! Enough! I've heard enough!
Okay, truth aside, we are serious about wanting to learn what the secret behind your success is.
