Alright, then starting right from tomorrow, you can look at anything you want – the lobby, the kitchen, even the ledger.
But not for free. See, we're going to expand the business's scope, but we need more staff. I want you two to help.
S-seriously?! Sounds too good to be true!
Is food included?
You bet. Just don't go in through the window again.
Woohoo! Then we have a deal!
Hey, I haven't said "yes" yet. But, if we DO have a deal, you better not go back on your word!
I know my sis won't admit it, but she's actually over the moon right now.
N-no! Am NOT!
Over heeere!
I've got it figured out! This must be where Chang Feng and An Shan last appeared!
In other words... the two of them just disappeared into thin air?
Huh? In an empty place like this? Surely that's not possible.
What if a gh-gh-ghost is behind this?! When they came here, it snuck up behind them without a sound, and then... Aaaah!
Aaah! I-I-I can't handle ghosts! Somebody heeelp!
It all began a few hours prior...
Everyone, remember this rock arrangement. We'll be doing our sketches around here, so prepare to gather at six o'clock sharp.
Oooh, it's so big! Let's see who can climb it the fastest!"
Fu Shuuun!
Ack! I-I was just kidding! Hahaha...
Quit playing around, please... We're here for the drawing assignment, remember? I'll be checking your work tonight!
If anyone's sketchbook is empty, or they clearly didn't put effort into it... Hmph. Let's just say, you won't be happy with what happens next!
Oh man, oh crap... I lost track of time! I've only got ten minutes now. Fu Po, save me!
Huh?! I'm not much better off than you! If I turn in this chicken scratch, Chang Feng is gonna lecture me again...
Th-then... Chang Chun? Tai Yuan? If either of you are done, can you show us your work?
Hehe, I knew you wouldn't finish in time, so I drew a picture you'd never be able to copy! Behold!
Huh?! Is that a drawing of me and Fu Po playing red light, green light?!
Wait... If An Shan and Chang Feng see that...
We're gonna get in trouble!
Fu Shun... Fu Po...
Aaaah! We're sorry!
I-it's just me... Hey, am I the only one who noticed that Chang Feng and An Shan are missing?
Huh? They are?
Now that you mention it, I think they were going AWAY from the rock arrangement...
It struck me as strange, too... Let's go look for them!
D-did you find anything?
See this undisturbed patch of ground? It must be where they were sitting...
Look over here! There's a glowing mark on this tree trunk that looks like a claw print. What if a monster attacked them?!
Our sisters got kidnapped by a monster?! W-we'd better go back and ask the Manager for help!
Yeah... S-surely it's not a monster though, right? Of all things...
I think you're right. There are no signs of a struggle, and their footprints are orderly. It doesn't look like a monster snatched them up.
Amidst their heated discussion, Chang Chun noticed something unusual.
Hey, look at those leaves falling down... Is it just me, or are they freezing in midair at times?
Huh? Let me see... Whoa, they are! Those leaves are falling in a weird way!
Wait a sec. Are they all flying in the same direction?
The moment the words left her mouth, all of the leaves suddenly froze in place. Then, bright light burst from their midst.
AAAAH! GHOOOST!
Fu Shuuun!
Whoa?! The ghost turned into An Shan!
We're no ghosts. Hahaha, I think an explanation is in order.
Once Chang Feng had explained everything, they all remembered that they were in a game world. She and An Shan had encountered some server connection issues and went offline for a period of time.
Thanks to this experience, however, Fu Po and Fu Shun had a stroke of inspiration and quickly completed their assignment.
And all lived happily ever after.
With the help of Ning Hai and Ping Hai, the inn is running smoother than ever.
However, the peaceful atmosphere is disrupted by the arrival of Clarence K. Bronson.
If you're not testing things properly, then you're wasting your valuable test phase.
Hmm... The paper and printing quality are solid, and there's no fading. I'm impressed by the binding, too. This passes.
E-excuse me... Are you ready to order? I can't help but notice you seem to be fascinated by the menu.
One fried rice, please.
Okay, one fried rice, coming right up! May I interest you in any sides or soups? The bao buns are to die for.
No, thank you. Just the fried rice will do. My test... ahem, my meal, is best left simple.
Before long, Ping Hai brings a piping-hot bowl of fried rice.
One fried rice. Enjoy!
Hmm... It looks good. No issues with scent, not burned.
Not bad. May I order something else, please?
Hmm? Oh, you want another dish?
Not quite. I'd like "negative one" fried rice, please.
Negative...?
Something wrong, girls?
Oh, Manager, you're just in time! Can you help me figure out what this customer here wants?
Ning Hai recounts their previous conversation.
I think she wants to return the order of rice...?
No, no. My request is very literally negative one fried rice.
Got it.
After looking at her face to confirm that she's serious, I take away the bowl of rice.
Negative one fried rice. Enjoy.
Correct. Okay... I'd like negative one cup of amazake.
Then, I'd like two to the thirty-second power bowls of fried rice.
Three cups of chicken rice.
Also, Q@HWN cups of fried rice.
And then...
After a gauntlet of test orders, she finally smiles in satisfaction.
You pass. Excellent, I must say.
Will our professional tester finally have a bowl of fried rice? It's on the house.
Why, thank you.
The bell chimes, and another customer walks in.
After that odd moment, the inn enjoyed another peaceful day.
It's around noon, and the lobby is bustling with guests. The air is filled with casual conversation intermingled with the gentle clashing of cutlery.
Ning Hai and Ping Hai stand at the register, checking the revenue, while they take in the sight before them.
To think we used to call this place the unlucky inn... They've really turned things around.
Yeah. I remember how, not long ago, you'd stare at the ledger in the run-down lobby and sigh, saying we couldn't even afford oil for the lanterns.
After welcoming Kearsarge to the inn, I overhear the two sisters' conversation.
You know, the location for this inn is great. The surrounding scenery's really nice.
How come you never got any customers, anyway?
It's a long story.
It goes back all the way to when we were born...
Well, I'm listening.
Kearsarge, have a look at the backend log text for me.
Kearsarge nods and uses her fingers to interface with something invisible. It's like she's checking thin air.
Analyzing the game's backend event logs...
Analysis complete. No errors detected in any modules since the inn system was initiated.
However, comparing them to deeper-level log data reveals an abnormality: There's a recorded state described as, "Select all and ignore."
...At least now we've moved on from our past as bankrupt innkeepers and officially become a part of this promising new inn!
Oh, yeah. I'm still listening.
That's it. We've told our whole story.
Ning Hai, Ping Hai, do me a favor and pass on a message to Lung Wu in the kitchen for me.
Tell her you can have all the meat buns you want. It's my treat.
Wow! You're the best manager ever!
After seeing the two sisters off, I turn my attention to Kearsarge.
Call Moskva over. We're gonna go speak to this game's "designer."
Despite its name, this warehouse is outfitted with tables and chairs, almost like a guest room at a hotel.
Over in the innermost corner, a figure sits in solitude among cables and machinery that don't feel like they fit the surroundings at all.
...So basically, it was a hidden bug?
Correct. When the inn's funds remain at their lowest point for a long period, this triggers the "doomed business" state, which in turn blocks all interactive functions.
This was likely the reason behind Ning Hai's and Ping Hai's bankruptcy.
Hmm. Excellent judgment and efficiency, Comrade Manager and Comrade Bogatyr.
What shall we do with this information?
I'll work on fixing the issue now. Give me a second... Okay, it's done.
THAT was fast.
Not quite. The work was completed 0.1 seconds slower than projected.
To celebrate the inn's roaring success, Moskva and Chen Hai hold a banquet for all of the staff.
On the way there, my path is unexpectedly blocked.
Hindenburg and I have prepared a... special present to celebrate the occasion.
You'll have to come and accept it yourself~
Out of thin air, I hear a comforting string melody.
Implacable and Hindenburg circle the stage's central pillar, showing off their supple figures.
Will you admire from afar, or will you approach and experience this blessing for yourself? The choice is yours.
On this moonlit night, replete with the color of spring... Allow us to take the stage and entertain you.
Watch carefully, Contract Binder.
As the girls onstage focus their attention on me, my eyes are drawn to them in turn, as if being pulled by powerful magic.
Finally, amidst the rapid strumming of the pipa, they stop – and, as if possessed, I begin walking toward the stage.
How was it? Was this gift... to your liking?
Heehee... Your eyes are transfixed on us.
It was incredible. I'll never forget this.
Then I hope it isn't unreasonable to ask that you have a drink with us?
The party has only just begun, Contract Binder... Who knows what other fun is in store?
As I linger in the aftermath of the show, the girls sidle over and stand on either side of me.
Amidst laughter and mirth, the party rages on. And what a beautiful sight it is.
Elsewhere...
A three-flavor spring roll, huh? ...Bleh, spicy.
I brushed a layer of chili oil on them. If we're celebrating our growing success, then our dishes should be just as vibrant!
Lung Wu, you should really be considerate of those of us who can't handle spice...
Don't worry. There's plenty of lobster and roast duck to go around, and they're not spicy at all. Just wait 'til you see how they look, too!
Such a generous budget... Great job, {playername}!
Being able to witness this place grow step by step from its start as a tiny inn... It's been incredible!
Agreed. The system has passed countless stability tests, too, and its performance is exemplary. Fantastic work.
Due to ingestion of alcohol... dexterity is rapidly deteriorating...
This party's really heating up. The victory you won today is worthy of commendation, Comrade Manager.
I'd say this round of tests can be called a success.
Still, if you're in the mood, we can extend this game for as long as you'd like.
What do you think, Comrade Manager?

options.content: The test may be over, but our story isn't.
Let's have fun for a little longer before we go back to work.

scripts.say: Heheh, I thought so. We were just here for the test at first, but... it's a good excuse to relax and have some fun.
In that case, my dear friend, may you have a wonderful time in this inn.
Let's have another round of drinks!
Late at night, the lights were still on in Moskva's room.
When I opened the door, I saw her sitting in front of a familiar wooden Go board, chin resting on one hand. Her free hand suspended a piece in midair.
I've been waiting for you, dear friend. Spare a moment of your time?
She keeps her gaze fixed on the board. Lamplight gently illuminates her focused profile.
Have you been studying our game all night?
That's right. I've been thinking of that move you pulled off earlier. There would seem to be countless counter moves, but all are within your calculations.
Can we play another game? This time, I won't be distracted.
Her ice-blue eyes burn with calm determination.
Go pieces clatter onto the board. Moskva places them quickly at first, but her pace noticeably slows.
I had Bogatyr review the inn's revenue of late.
Thanks to her administrative work, our business strategy iteration efficiency has increased by 12.7%.
Sounds like the tests are going well.
Data only shows the surface level. The system's optimal solutions unfortunately overlook the variable known as humans. Just like this game...
After picking up a white piece, she taps it on the edge of the board a few times.
I can calculate every common-sense move that you might make on your next turn, but calculation alone won't predict what you'll really do.
I suppose even the closest of friends have to keep some surprises in store for each other.
Surprises, eh? Well, I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I can already see the trap you're laying for me this time.
Heehee, already?
Maybe you know me a lot better than I realize.
As our game continues, the board seems to crackle with an invisible pressure.
I pick up a black piece. Before I can place it in a position that would both solidify my advantage and force her into a difficult defense... I hesitate.
Moskva places her hand on mine. Her warmth caresses me like a gentle spring breeze.
You look like you need to cool your head, Commander.
Let me guess... You hesitated just now because you didn't want to corner me. Is that it?
She guides my hand to a different position – one that gives me an even greater probability of winning.
Then, instead of withdrawing her hand, she wriggles her fingers in between mine, intertwining them.
You mustn't let your kindness become a weakness in games of strategy.
I want you to face me with a focused mind, unclouded by doubt.
And outside of the game, too...
Tightening her grip on me slightly, she presses her palm to mine.
Leave it all to me, my friend.
After I nod, she turns her attention back to the board. The faintest smile plays on her lips.
Flickering lamplight casts our shadows as one on the game board.
Let's continue. Our game has just begun.
Following the instructions in the mysterious note Hindenburg left behind, I went to a loft located deep inside the inn. Pushing the door open with a sharp creak, I stepped inside.
It appears that she's doing calisthenics, and faces me as soon as she hears the door open, a strangely dangerous smile on her face.
Good timing, Manager. I've just finished my warm-up exercises.
But, don't you prefer to be called "Contract Binder"? Heehee.
She waves to beckon me closer without getting down from the stage, staying there to speak to me from the high ground.
Contract Binder, have you heard of a thing called "the Dance of Control"?
It's a dance that makes you submit to your desires – and also give up everything.
Fortunately for you, you now have the chance to view this dance from up close.
Bending down and stopping just inches from me, she exhales – her breath, warm from physical activity, brushes against my cheeks.
Today's invitation is also a test for you, my dear Contract Binder. A test to determine how strong your will is.
The rules are simple: Keep your eyes on me and me alone.
If you avert your gaze before I'm finished dancing, or if you cave in to temptation and approach me...
She uses her fingers to draw a big X symbol on my chest, then lets out a giggle and returns to the stage.
Then you lose, and you surrender everything and submit to my full control.
And if I win?
Win? Heehee. Supposing you do win... Well, you can do whatever you want with me. Sounds fair, no? Good.
Although there's no music, she simply snaps her fingers, and the mood in the loft instantly changes.
She slowly tilts her head back, her neck forming a graceful arc that her fingertips run down. The plumpness and softness of her body are on full display.
The dance goes on. Her veil flutters as she turns, brushing against my arm and leaving behind a faint aroma and sense of touch.

Sometimes she comes closer, and sometimes she backs off. I see her in full clarity – from the trembling of her eyelashes and the tiny beads of sweat dripping from her collarbone, to how stunningly flexible her body looks under the mingling light and shadows.
Her eyes have been fixated on me from the very start. They're like those of a wolf excitedly eyeing its prey.
You've managed to keep your focus... I hear your heart beating like a drum.
Gradually, her moves become increasingly bold. She kneels down, almost throwing herself at me, but stopping right at the last moment.
Prepare yourself. Stay put... and don't move.
She places her fingers on my shoulders, and she leans in very closely to examine me up and down with a mocking gaze.
Is watching me making you thirsty? Heehee. I'm only getting started.
The vibe of her dance is changing, going from seductive twirls to intense moves meant to control and bind me.
Her fingertips trace my collar, tugging on the edge of it, while her toes graze my calves and brazenly step on my feet.
The semi-transparent flap sways with every motion, outlining her voluptuous form.
I wonder... Is the rest of your body as obedient as your eyes are, hmm?
She suddenly moves closer, lifting my hand up to her waist level and holding it there with the tiniest gap between the two.
Hold. If you touch me, you lose.
She continues her dangerous dance. The soft skin of her abdomen flashes from under her thin, black cloth. Accompanying it are a scent and a warmth I can feel even through the empty space between us.
It feels like her moves are synchronized with the beats of my heart. One, two, one, two... Then, without even realizing it, I extend my hand...
In that moment, her toes gently touch the top of my feet. I return to my senses and freeze, but it's already too late.
You took a step forward and touched me. What a disgraceful defeat for you.
She smiles with the look of triumph of a winner, wipes the sweat on her forehead with her finger, then rubs it on my lips.
According to the rules, you've lost everything, including your right to defy me tonight. Which means...
Leaning into whispering range, she makes a sensual declaration...
I'm going to command you to do something more enjoyable♥
Once the inn's lobby had finally quieted down, I returned to my room, hoping to get some well-earned rest.
However, what I found was not rest, but Implacable in a Dragon Empery dress, stretched languidly across a table.
*sigh*... I waited all day for you.
Implacable? What's the matter? Is your room somehow lacking?
Lacking? That would be an apt word... You see, I just happened to get my hands on some fine wine.
And the moon is just so pretty tonight...
According to an Empery friend of mine, the best luxury of all is spending a lovely night drinking with someone you care about.
It made me wonder... If you came back to your room alone, wouldn't you feel the loneliness of not having anyone to talk to?
She lifts the wine with her slender fingers. A stream of red liquid shines as it's poured into a cup.
The sound of it hitting glass is clear in the silence.
So I took the liberty of preparing a night of... companionship, for your sake. And for mine, too.
It's just such a wonderful night. Wouldn't it be such a waste to go to bed early, all alone?
Come... Take this first glass, this blessing. May all of your worries drift away into the night.
She hands me a full cup before pouring wine for herself.
But at the same time, simply drinking and talking would be a little bit bland.
Have you heard of a certain traditional drinking ritual from the Empery?
You mean the wedding toast?
Exactly. I see we think alike.
She wraps her arm around mine. As the distance between us shrinks, her wine-tinged breath tickles my ear.
Chilly wine spills down my throat, transforming into a warm current that spreads from my stomach to my limbs. Implacable's flask suddenly lurches...
A few drops of shiny wine spill onto her feet, making wet spots on her black stockings.
Oh, my... I've stained them.
She traces her fingers on the spreading wet spots, but her gaze never parts from me.
Would you like to help me clean them? Or...
Shall we finish the rest of the wine first?
I quietly take the wine from her. Putting my lips in the same place that hers were, I drink the remainder directly.
Heehee... You're greedy tonight.
She takes my hand and guides my fingers to that warm, damp spot on her stockings.
Do you feel my warmth... and the stain that you caused, Commander?
I want you to feel all of me...
Tossing aside the empty wine container, she wraps both arms around my neck.
Let me handle all of your worries and stresses...
Instead of letting it all build up... allow me to help you release every last bit of it.
Implacable removes her hairpin, allowing her beautiful hair to cascade like a golden waterfall. It seems to trap us in our own little world.
In the flickering candlelight, she reveals all before me without reservation.
Rather than a short night's tipsiness... there's something else I'd much rather give to you.
Leave it all to me...
In this moment, I'm the only one who can bless you. And all you have to do... is relish in me. Heehee...
Upon receiving an invitation from Krasny Kavkaz, I came to visit a private room. The plaque on it read Sparrow's Song.
When I open it, she hears my entrance and turns to face me. Her cheeks look flushed in the light.
You're here... Umm, before we begin, I need to cover my eyes.
Could you put this on for me, please?
She tilts her head back and holds her breath, eyelashes fluttering slightly with excitement.
I place the blindfold over her eyes and stretch the strap behind her ears. Along the way, my fingers brush against the hot skin beneath her hair.
She shudders just slightly, tensing up. Her lips part subconsciously, letting a gasp slip out. With that, the blindfold is attached.
F-for my first exercise... I'd like you to pick a mahjong tile and put it somewhere on my body.
I must try to guess which piece it is within a minute, using only my sense of touch.
As instructed, I choose a tile at random and press it on the side of her exposed neck.
When the chilly tile touches her skin, she suddenly flinches and gasps again.
Brr! Chilly... B-but this pattern is...
Amidst Krasny's moans, an entire minute passes in no time. It's almost time for round two.
My gaze falls to her toned stomach. I place the second tile there.
As I rub the tile against the thin fabric, I feel the warmth and softness beneath.
Hnngh?!
She arches her back and tightens her stomach, pressing it straight into my palm.
Aaah... The contours of the tiles rubbing against my stomach are all... cool and tingly...
I can practically hear the writhing in her voice as she wriggles about, causing the fabric on her skin to rub against the tile even more intensely.
Aaaah...♡
*pant*... My first training exercise may have failed, but... It's okay. I have another in mind...
Put it between my toes next, please...
And then... I want you to write the name of the tile, using your finger, on the sole of my foot...
She claims this is a higher-level training. As soon as I touch her sole, though, she pulls her foot away as if she's just been jolted by lightning.
Eep?!
I couldn't hold it in place... I'm a lot more sensitive than I thought. Try again, please...
Okay... Th-that's a horizontal stroke... Huh? Wait... That tickles... Hehehe...
Her second attempt ends with the mahjong tile falling once again.
The third time, I hold her toes together to keep it from falling and use my other hand to quickly write the name of the tile on her foot.
Nnh, wait... Too fast... Pfft... Hehehe... I can't! I can't take any more of... S-stooop!
Many rounds of training pass in similar failure. It isn't until I very slowly, very lightly write the name of the tile that she manages to guess it right.
Krasny's breathing is ragged, as if she's exhausted all of her strength. It takes some time before she removes the blindfold.
Her teary eyes turn to me, lips curled up in satisfaction.
Today's mental training was wonderful... I remember every last sensation vividly.

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>1 The New Year Auction</size>

scripts.say: Come one, come all! Try our tanghulu made with a secret recipe!
Although the New Year's auction hosted by the Dragon Empery was still several days away, the venue was already lit by lanterns and bustling with people.
Near the entrance, a teahouse stood with a conspicuous sign that read, "Dragon Empery Tanghulu with a Secret Recipe."
*slurp*... Sweet, sour, and so yummy! *slurp*... It gets Lady Yuen's highest recommendation!
Psst, hey! You've eaten most of the tanghulu! Chang Feng will be livid if she finds out!
Well, uh... I'm just doing quality control to make sure the customers get the best taste they can!
Fu Po, one hawthorn tanghulu, please!
I want some, too! One hawthorn and strawberry each, thanks!
Here you go!
Tanghulu... I've never heard of that before.
There are so many girls from the Empery gathered in front of the store... It's so hard to be heard over them all.
Man... They look like they can't get enough of it. I need to muster my courage and do something to help these girls...
Hey, excuse me!
Yeah? What kind of tanghulu do you want? There's hawthorn, strawberry, blueberry, grape, orange, pineapple, star fruit, mango... A whole bunch! Pick whichever you want!
Gosh, that's TOO many! I think... Uhh... They'd...
N-never mind! I can't do this!
What?! Hey, Fu Po, you scared off a customer!
All I did was list all the options! Did I speak too fast or something?
Hmm... Seems not everyone's been sold on tanghulu's sweetness just yet.
And how! It's such a wonderful treat! We've got to make it known in every corner of the port!
If it were more popular, we could open more branches, and then we could build a tanghulu business network, and ultimately become the world's leading tanghulu chain store...
Then we'll be the queens of tanghulu! We'll earn lots of money and buy presents for the Commander and Chang Feng, and then she'll tell us we've made her proud! Heheh...
Oh! Lady Yuen just got the best idea ever! Let's set out on an adventure to teach the world the wonders of tanghulu!
Yeah, but to do that, we'd need an elaborate strategy. Our adventure also needs a perfect plan to go with it...
I've already got a plan. First, we cause a huge ruckus that riles everyone up, then we swoop in and solve the problem, and that'll naturally make us the center of attention!
I'm with you so far, but how do we cause a ruckus?
Maybe by transforming into a nian beast that invades the port?
How about sending out tons of red envelopes as a prank?
Ooor... we could make a colossal firework!
As they passionately shared their ideas, two figures began to approach from a nearby avenue...
Someone's coming! Hide!
Yes... It certainly is an exquisite piece. One that must be handled with care.
Hai Chou, have a look at this.
Hmm... The jade is warm and impeccable, yet also smooth and delicate. This quality is very hard to come by.
Furthermore, it was evidently carved by an expert hand.
Its lines flow like clouds and rivers, breathing life into the entire jade. This truly is a masterwork that combines form and spirit.
This is one of your very finest yet, Chang Wu.
I have no doubt that such a treasure will generate a lot of noise when it appears at the auction.
On the subject, actually... Are you certain you wish to part with it?
Well, I have a shameful truth to admit. I lately found a number of high-quality rough stones that I intend to carve into jade for the Commander...
Sadly, I'm somewhat short on coin at the moment.
That's why I leave this jade pendant in your care, and ask you to find a collector who truly appreciates it and will keep it safe.
Very well. In truth, however...
The two figures continued their hushed conversation as they walked toward the auction venue.
RUSTLE RUSTLE...
Girls, did you hear that?
Yeah! Loud and clear!

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fei Yuen & Fu Po
scripts.say: Treasuuure!
Imagine it! "The crown jewel of the auction has vanished, and that's when the Tanghulu Adventure Team enters the picture!"
"They solve the theft in record time, then their reputation shoots through the roof!"
Sure, it SOUNDS easy... How do we actually DO it, though?
All we need to do is fiddle a bit with some devices at the venue. I think.
I've got it! If we make the treasure disappear when it should be there, then suddenly reappear again later, then we'll have achieved our goal!
Okay then, should we come up with a catchphrase for when we swoop in?
Uhh... Later. First, we've gotta figure out a way past all the security. Knowing Ting An, it's bound to be pretty tightly guarded.
Lady Yuen will help you come up with a plan! We might've failed last year, but this time, we're gonna make it work!
All in the name of teaching people to love tanghulu!
Now, let the Awesome Auction Adventure begin!

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>2 Once-in-a-Lifetime Find</size>

scripts.say: 24 hours before the New Year's auction begins...
Better make the most of this fine weather and get to work!
First, I should check the final list of newly submitted auction items. Maybe there's a treasure somewhere in there.
Hmm... A newly made, limited-edition perfume by Hai Chou? Not bad. Approved.
Next... A fish? Caught by none other than Huan Ch'ang?
I mean, it still has a price tag from the fish market on it. I think everyone agrees that's a no.
What else... Huh? A full-size statue of the Commander, carved by Raffaello?!
Hmm...
Maybe I should pull some strings and call in some favors for this one.
Ting An went through the auction items list carefully, separating the photos of the items into two different piles.
Only a small handful of items had been approved, while the pile of rejections was growing bigger and bigger.
Something's missing here... We need some sort of item that really grabs your attention.
She continued, checking the items one by one until she'd finally reached the last page.
This is the last thing on the list.
Consigner: Chang Wu. Name of item...
Wait... Oh my goodness!
Ting An felt an exceptional sense of awe and surprise just from looking at the photo of the item.
The quality of this item... It's genuinely a once-in-a-lifetime find!
That's it! This will be the centerpiece of the auction!

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>3 Commence the Plan!</size>

scripts.say: 16 hours before the New Year's auction begins...
Comrades, we've reached the warehouse!
Our task here is to escort the items to be shown at this year's New Year's auction. Take extra care not to damage anything.
I know, I know! I've already optimized our route and security arrangements three times ahead of time. Everything will be smooth sailing!
Under Gangut's precise command, the transfer of the auction items proceeded swiftly and smoothly.
Alright, this is the last one! Outstanding work, comrades!
Hmm... This item is decorated differently from the rest. Why is that?
An item covered by understated yet high-class red velvet caught Gangut's eyes. Spurred by curiosity, she took a look at her transport list.
Item D-07... Consigned by Chang Wu. Let's see the attached image...
Whoa! That's a stunning jade pendant!
How much do you think it's worth?
There's a value estimate listed on the slip.
Let me have a look! Expected auction value of... Holy smokes!
Sheesh... My hands are trembling all of a sudden...
Okay, we've moved all the auction items! Our work here is done.
Great work, everyone! I say we go and have ourselves some drinks! It's on me!
Sweet!
The disorderly footsteps gradually grew more distant, and a door closed behind them with a heavy thud. The warehouse fell into silence.
A while later, Kursk emerged from the shadows in a corner.
We really ought to install some security cameras in here.
Warehouse interior is all clear.
Auction items are intact. They've finished moving everything.
Kursk left just as quietly as she had come – without making a sound.

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fei Yuen & Fu Po
scripts.say: Huff... Whuahhh!
Three little figures came crawling out of a container in a panic.
*pant*... *pant*... Lady Yuen was THIS close to choking to death!
*pant*... *pant*... Why was someone else besides us hiding in the warehouse?!
*pant*... *pant*... If I hadn't shut both your mouths, they would've caught us!
On the bright side, there's got to be something really valuable hidden here since the security's so tight! Now let's get to work!
Heheh! Treasure hunting adventure time!
I set the timer on the transport device for the centerpiece item! Ahaha – I didn't expect things to go THIS smoothly!
So the centerpiece really is Chang Wu's jade pendant. It's sooo pretty! It even smells nice.
Our task is complete, so let's get out of here now!
The three ran up to the warehouse's door and pulled on the handle with all their might...
The door, however, didn't even budge.
W-wait... Don't tell me...
The door's locked... from outside?

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fei Yuen & Fu Po
scripts.say: WE'RE TRAPPED IN HERE?!

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>4 Trouble Swoops Down</size>

scripts.say: 8 hours before the New Year's auction begins...
Carabiniere reporting! All is clear in patrol area B-2!
Fwee-fwee! Noice! To the next area we go!
Nobody will disrupt the auction venue's peace under our watch!
Whew... Everything's looking good so far. Let's take a quick break, Carabiniere.
Oh yeah, I've been thinking a bit about your hat. It really looks banging on you!
You think so? It's really basic equipment for escorts. Speaking of hats, though, you have quite a unique one yourself.
Heheh! What do you say to a trade, then? A hat I like for a hat you like!
I've always wanted to wear a wide-brimmed hat like the one you've got!
You know, only the captain of the Port Guards gets to wear this! Looks marvellous, doesn't it?
Let's not get ahead of ourselves... We're still on duty, remember?
BANG...
...What was that? Did you hear that?
Yeah... Sounded like it came from the ceiling.
RUSTLE RUSTLE... RUSTLE RUSTLE!
Security pup, you're up! Find where that sound's coming from!
The two followed the security pup, running to the end of the corridor, which was right below a ventilation duct...
There! The sound's coming from inside the vents!
Whoever you are, you'd better surrender now while you–
BANG! CLANG!
Whuah! Look out! Something fell down!
Blimey!
...And that concludes our report!
At the end, all I saw were three white things falling out of the vents, and that's the last thing I remember!
When I woke up later, that's when I saw you.
Ting An, reckon the auction needs additional security?
That won't be necessary. I made preparations before the items to be auctioned were even transferred to the warehouse.
Also... I noticed that you've been grinning with exasperation for a little while now.
You don't happen to know who's behind this, do you?
You bet I do.
As prior incidents link together in my head, the answer presents itself easily.
Heheh. That's exactly what I thought, too.
At that moment, Chang Wu gently pushes the door open and enters the room, carrying a box of pastries.
I heard someone had been injured, so I brought some get-well snacks.
Oh? Commander and Ting An. Just who I was looking for.
Commander, may I have a moment of your time?
There's something I want to ask you about.
Sure thing. Ting An, I'll be leaving.
Of course. I shall look after Carabiniere and Gallant.
By the way, Commander – we may have an unexpected surprise at the auction. You'll certainly want to keep your eyes peeled for it.

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>5 Auction Time!</size>

scripts.say: As the crowd looks on eagerly, the New Year's auction finally begins.
Miss Le Malin, going once, going twice...
Going thrice! Sold! Congratulations, Miss Le Malin! The Supreme Emperor Mattress is yours!
The bidding was... exhausting... I'm going to sleep now...
Dang... I really wanted it for myself. Why do these things always exceed my budget?
The hall is filled with bid after bid as one luxurious item after the next is revealed. The excitement reaches its highest point.
And now, allow me to introduce the most eye-catching item of tonight.
This item is not only a top-of-the-line collector's piece, but also a work of art that took meticulous effort to make.
This is the Gentleman's Fine Pendant, a jade ornament personally carved by Chang Wu, a jade carver from the Dragon Empery!
A giant screen behind Ting An lit up and displayed the jade pendant from various close-up angles on a rotating turntable, revealing every little bit of its texture.
The carving really is sublime, and that jade must be of top quality.
Amazed by the jade pendant's exquisiteness, I can't help but admire it aloud. All of a sudden, several keen gazes turn to me.
Oh?
Heehee...
Now, the starting price of this pendant is–
People start placing bid after bid before the price has even been unveiled. It's like everyone in here hopes to get their hands on this pendant.
The bidding escalates rapidly, and after just a few rounds, only two bidders remain, both vying for it fiercely.
This pendant will be mine!
Only if you manage to outbid me!
Then, as everyone seems certain that the pendant will go to one of these two, someone plainly raises their bidding paddle from a corner of the venue.
A new bid! This puts the new price at– Wait, what?!
The screen updates to a new number – one so high that it's nigh impossible to count.
Every gaze in the room instantly converges on the person who placed this bid.
The bidder is... You, Chang Wu?
Yes.
Is that discourteous of me?
Well... It should be no issue. Let's just think of it as a grand way to celebrate the New Year. Please, tell us what made you place this bid!
Ah. Ahem... I'm the one who carved this jade pendant.
I poured a considerable amount of passion into it – into everything from my choice of material to the carving and polishing process.
After thinking it through, I've realized that I'm unwilling to part with it.
In addition, I must give my thanks to the Commander. For always trusting me.
She lowers her head and softens her voice. Then, hoping to convince everyone that she's made up her mind, she turns to me and whispers into my ear.
I never break a promise. I swear I'll pay you back as soon as I can for the advance you gave me to purchase those raw jades.
Next month?
Ah, um... Perhaps in the third quarter?
At the very least, I promise I won't delay it until next year.
Please, trust me. In the event I go bankrupt, I'll sell off some of my jades to pay you back.
Well, seeing as you're sure about this, I'll choose to accept your bid.
Going once... Twice... Thrice... Sold to Chang Wu!
Congratulations on getting your desired item back.
Now, if I may have your attention, please admire this beautiful jade!
As Ting An finishes, there's a mechanical creak as a display case should come into view... but nothing happens up on the stage.
Huh? My apologies. There seems to be something wrong with the machine. Let me have a look.
And at that moment, three small figures step forward!
Haha! Having a bit of trouble there?
Scenes like this are happening all over the port, right now!
You could be next!
That is, unless you make the most important decision of your life...

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fei Yuen & Fu Po
scripts.say: By trusting the Tanghulu Adventure Team!
There's supposed to be inspirational music playing... Crap, did the music player break?
Anyway! We are the Tanghulu Adventure Team, lovers of candied hawthorn! And we have a message for you!

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fei Yuen & Fu Po
scripts.say: We will prove to you that we have the courage to pursue justice and truth!
We will become the legends...
And the inheritors...
And the heroes of tanghulu, dedicated to making miracles happen!
Wow... Talk about a rousing ad for tanghulu.
Now, turn your attention to the display area! As you'll see, the Tanghulu Adventure Team has already retrieved the missing treasure!
Behooold! ...Huh? Where's the treasure?
Just as before, nothing happens up on the stage.

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>6 Tracking by Aroma</size>

scripts.say: Just as before, nothing happens up on the stage.
Um, why isn't it working?!
Uh-oh...
"Uh-oh" what?
I think we might've broken the machine!
OH NO!
Then, a display case covered in red velvet is finally mechanically pushed out to the front of the stage. As everyone looks on with anticipation, the velvet cover falls off...
...What?
My Gentleman's Fine Pendant...
It's... gone?
*sniff*... We're sorry...
*sniff*... We're so sorry...
*sniff*... We're so, so sorry...
Having heard the three troublemakers' explanation, Ting An assumes a brooding expression.
It sounds like the pendant mistakenly fell somewhere else when the machine jammed mid-transport.
Thank goodness I took precautions against this. Let's just hope the pendant didn't break...
Do we expand our search range, then?
That won't be necessary.
You can find the pendant if you just follow... its aroma.
Sorry? Its aroma?
While Ting An and I were discussing security, we considered a myriad of possibilities.
One of them being the special mechanism under your seat.
It's designed to immediately evacuate you in the event of any "dangerous" incidents.
Evacuate me where?
Why, that's obvious...
She leans in, bringing her face close to me, then lowers her voice so that nobody else can hear.
To my room. Heehee.
As this is a matter of security, I can't elaborate further.
Anyway, let us get back on track. While I was tallying the auction items, Ting An asked me to install a special tracker on each of them.
These trackers all have a unique identifier – each one has a distinct aroma.
Ohh. And, since the other auction items are still in the storage...
Yes. The sweet, refined aroma in the air serves as our best guidepost.
Soon after, Ting An escorts me to the adjacent tea room, where Hai Chou is. She has already found the missing jade pendant.
I followed the aroma's trail, which led me to a crack in the stage where it had fallen.
Chang Wu had a look, and it hadn't suffered as much as a scratch.
I was pretty worried there for a while. Glad we could recover it fully intact.
Ahh... Now I can finally breathe easy.
Chang Wu carefully picks up the translucent Gentleman's Fine Pendant and holds it up in front of me.
This pendant means a lot to me, and we managed to retrieve it thanks to everyone's help.
Fortunately, your praise for this pendant remained untarnished as a result.
Commander, I've thought about it, and...
I'd like you to have this pendant.
I hope you'll cherish this rare blessing of fate.
Now that we've retrieved the jade pendant, shall we discuss how to "reward" tanghulu's greatest champions for what they did?
Reward? Heheh! Lady Yuen needs no reward. Everything I do comes from the sincere bottom of my heart, where...
W-wait... By "reward," you mean the opposite, don't you?
I've got it. As thanks for their "hard work," the heroes of tanghulu will get–
W-we don't need it! We'll make up for our mistakes! I promise!

sequence:
Spring Auction Adventure

<size=45>7 Payback is a Sweet and Sour Dessert</size>

scripts.say: Three days later, in the kitchen...
Ugh... I'm at my limit...
Fei Yuen stands at the kitchen counter, her small arms trembling as she tries to hold up a strawberry skewer freshly coated in sugar syrup.
My arms feel sooo heavy... I can't lift the tanghulu skewer... Can I take a break, Commander?
Go ahead.
Yay! You're the best!
10 minutes, then it's back to work.
B-but I don't wanna!
You said you'd make tanghulu for everyone at the port to make up for your little auction adventure, didn't you?
Heck, you proudly declared that you would. I'm gonna hold you to your word.
Bweh... Don't be a slave-driver, Commander...
Make way, make way! The extra ingredients have arrived!
Careful, Fu Shun! You're gonna spill the skewers!
The kitchen door swings open, and Fu Shun and Fu Po come rushing in, each panting heavily and pushing a cart full of ingredients.
Did your shopping go well?
About that, Commander! When we went to the store and said we're making tanghulu for everyone at the port, they thought we were joking and wouldn't sell us the ingredients at first...
Yeah, but thanks to my amazing negotiating skills and the shopping list you put together, we managed to accomplish our shopping mission in the end!
Yep! So, we can go now since we've got all the ingredients and did our part, right?
Alright, if you'll excuse us...
See you later!
Fu Shun and Fu Po make a mad dash for the door before they've even finished speaking.
You jerks! You said we'd all share the burden!
You can do it, Fei Yuen! I'll never forget your hard work in the service of tanghulu! Farewell!
You're in an awful rush. Where do you think you're going?
Appearing out of nowhere, An Shan stands in front of the kitchen door with her arms folded, blocking their escape.
Oh crap! A-An Shan! When'd you get here?! Err... Nice weather we're having today, right?
We only just got here, and we've already run into two naughty children trying to flee. What a coincidence!
Chang Feng! Um, we definitely weren't trying to run away! No way, nuh-uh!
Chang Feng, An Shan! You've come to help... Lady Yuen is saved!
Right then, another set of light footsteps ring out from past the door.
Good job, little ones. We'd also like to give you a hand!
*sniff sniff*... Yes, this syrup is quite fragrant. Just as I'd hoped.
Such a clear color... These tanghulu, soon to be delivered all throughout the port, certainly live up to their reputation.
Alright, the gang's all here.
Before we get back to work, let's have a little taste of Fei Yuan's tanghulu.
W-wait! Just a second!
That "little taste" IS included in the total amount of tanghulu I have to make, right? Right?!

sequence: The End

scripts.say: You helped Shiranui out at her store! Collect 100 Coins!
You found treasure buried in the sea around the port! Collect 1,000 Coins!
You won first prize from a game at Akashi's store! Collect 2,000 Coins!
You found materials wrapped in paper inside your storage! Collect 10 Oil!
You received supplies from a ship you sent on a commission! Collect 50 Oil!
You won first prize in an eating competition at the Canteen! Collect 100 Oil!
You found cookies made by Howe left on your desk! Collect 10 Cognitive Chips!
You helped Honolulu pick out a dress for a special occasion! Collect 50 Cognitive Chips!
You brought Shinano a really fluffy cushion, and she loved it! Collect 150 Cognitive Chips!
You found a Meowfficer hiding under a box! Collect 1 Elite Cat Box!
You gave snacks to a bunch of Meowfficers playing outside during a festival! Collect 5 Elite Cat Boxes!
You got a warm hug from a cutesy Meowfficer! Collect 1 Super Rare Cat Box!
You discovered parts that had been washed ashore! Collect 2 T3 Parts!
You helped Suruga adjust her equipment! Collect 8 T3 Parts!
You got a surprise visit from the Prototype Bulin MKII! Collect 20 T3 Parts!
You discovered blueprints that nobody has claimed! Collect 3 Elite Gear Blueprints!
You found a forgotten file of Blueprints! Collect 6 Elite Gear Blueprints!
You achieved excellent results during naval training! Collect 10 Elite Gear Blueprints!
You scored the highest on one of Amazon's tests! Collect 2 Super Rare Gear Blueprints!
You hung out with Yuubari as she made improvements to new equipment! Collect 4 Super Rare Gear Blueprints!
You got a surprise visit from the Specialized Bulin Custom MKIII! Collect 6 Super Rare Gear Blueprints!
You found a souvenir while inspecting the docks! Collect 1 Quick Finisher!
You got a day off work to rest! Move forward!
Hey! Commander.
There's something this port is sorely lacking. Do you know what?
"Sorely lacking"?
Yeah! It lacks modernity. We're lagging behind the times!
Humanity has invented virtual reality, artificial intelligence, big data...
But you won't find any of those anywhere around this port!
We have at least one of those. Remember TB?
Okay, lemme correct myself: Those inventions are nowhere to be seen EXCEPT in your office!
You mean the problem is there isn't enough of it?
Uh... Yeah! That's what I meant!
In that case, I suppose you have a point.
I knew you'd agree, which is why I assembled a group of like-minded people before even bringing this up!
Together, we worked overtime to create THIS. Have a look!
The upbeat Fu Shun trembles slightly with excitement as she places a thick stack of papers on my desk.
"The Port Virtual Reality Project," eh...
The planning committee consists of... You, Ayanami, Ikazuchi, Inazuma, Long Island, Friedrich Carl, Pamiat' Merkuria, Bristol, Royal Fortune...
Wow, it goes on to the next page.
Clemenceau, Valiant, Prinz Eugen, Marco Polo, Casablanca, Hai Tien, Leonardo da Vinci, Ingraham, Yuubari...
Akashi, and... TB? Even she's involved with this?
They have a real all-star crew, but I instinctively feel like there's a catch to this.
Okay, and where are you–
So anyway! Akashi has already agreed to finance the whole project!
All you gotta do is put your stamp of approval riiight here!
You don't have any reason NOT to approve it! It won't cost you a dime!
Wait... You said Akashi is going to finance ALL of it?
This combination of words is simply so beyond my expectations that my neurons short circuit.
Fu Shun is really keen on this, and it won't cost me anything...
To hell with it. I'll approve the project.
Two weeks later...
A giant machine stood like a metal sentinel in the academy plaza.
Many others like it – hundreds, even – had been installed all around the port, forming a massive network.
Nyahaha...
I've waited so long for this day, nya.
I spent an eye-watering sum to make this a reality, nya...
No longer will our tabletop games be played with props, nya! We've upgraded to a virtual reality adventure, nya!
I just need to seize control of this platform and this'll become a money printer, nya!
Nyahahahaha!
The green little cat laughed with immense joy thinking about all the money she would soon be raking in...
But more importantly, the first party to experience the VR adventure had gathered.
Let me say it for the record one last time! My job is the hero, and you two are my clerics!
Got it memorized? 'Cause I don't wanna hear any confusion about our jobs later on!
Yeah, I've got it! I like being a cleric anyway. The outfit's really cute!
Although... Do we really need TWO clerics? Isn't that redundant?
Not really? I used my dev privileges to give us all sets of powerful gear. You just gotta keep me healed while I dish out the damage!
Okay. I'll do my best to keep you at full health!
That's what I like to hear! I'll be counting on you out there!
Hey! Akashi! Ms. Smirking Cat! Are we good to go, or do we still have to wait?
Nyahahaha... Oh! Yeah, the system's up and running, nya! Go ahead, nya!
Alright, final check. Are you ready to set off to a world of fantasy?
Just a sec! Let's see... Makeup's good, clothes are good, phone camera's good... Yeah! I'm ready!
Umm... Is it just going to be us three?
Shouldn't we talk to the Commander before we set off?
And ruin the surprise? Why would we wanna do that?
I've already seen the Commander's schedule and made arrangements accordingly. In secret, of course.
I'll spare you the details, just know this – the Commander WILL be there! Or else my name isn't Queen of Adventure!
Okay... Then I'm ready, too!
Great! Heheh... I've waited to say this for so long.
With a swift motion, the girl pointed her finger at the sky and opened her mouth to proudly exclaim the slogan she had come up with.
Onward – to adventure!
The party set forth on their journey...
At the same time, I suddenly found myself in a simple stone hall. In the distance, there is a celestial globe, glowing with a curious light.
What the hell...?
I was just in the conference room, hearing a report from Carl...
Now all of a sudden, I'm here. Is this some secret place nobody ever told me about?
Hail, adventurer from afar, nya. Welcome to Manjuu Temple, nya.
I turn around and see a throne on the other end of the hall. Akashi is sitting on it.
...Akashi? What the hell is going on?
Akashi? You're mistaken, nya! I'm the goddess of luck and riches, nya!
Nyahaha. You must be very confused, nya.
As I said, this is Manjuu Temple, the home of the goddesses that bridge countless realms, nya.
Every now and then, these goddesses pick a lucky dead person to get sent to another world to live out a new life, nya.
And this goddess chose you, nya. That's all you need to know, nya!
It really is a shame that you died so young, nya...
But don't fret, nya! I'm going to give you a shot at a new life, nya!
Oh my god! I'm fricking dead!
All those years of working overtime must've finally caught up to me...
But... But what about my deadlines? I have a report due today! And what will happen to my schedule for tomorrow?
Everyone back at the port still needs me!
Send me back! I have too much work to die!
N-nya?! Nyanyanya?!
Sheesh... You've had a really rough life, nya...
At least you're already in character, nya...
Hang on... Is this that port VR project Fu Shun told me about a couple of weeks back?
I remember Carl was on the planning committee, and I was about to talk to her before I got transported here.
I bet she was in on this!
Nya? In on what, nya?
We just want to show you the fruits of the project now that it's done, nya.
So I was right. You have created a VR game of unprecedented scale.
Though, given the roster of talent you had, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
Yup-yup, nya. And if you wanna add more content in the future, we're open to investors, nya.
At least let me see what it's like before you tell me to invest...
Heheh. Sounds like I've already got you on the hook, nya.
Here, take this – it's your character build card, nya.
You'll need it on your adventure, nya. Get out there and enjoy yourself, nya!
Wait, my build is predetermined?
I thought I'd get to pick where I reincarnate and what broken skills I get. Isn't that usually how these things go?
...That's a pretty good idea, nya!
We'll think about adding that later as DLC, nya!
Now... Brave reborn adventurer, I pray that your journey in this new world shall be most exciting, nya.
Deep in the Endless Woods - Great Mage's Napping Place
Zzz... Mmgh... Zzzzz...
Zzzzz...
She's fallen asleep again.
Given how long she's been cursed, she's probably having a nightmare right now...
Not for long! I'm gonna break your curse, Laffey!
The Flute of Time plays a beautiful sound, causing a dark matter to evaporate from Laffey's body.
The strands of matter combine in the air and swell like a balloon. Then the mass explodes, blanketing the clearing instantly.
I THINK that lifted the curse, but what's happening now?!
...Big brother! Something bad is coming!
I'll put up a barrier just to be safe!
Dammit! The power of the curse is manifesting itself as several monsters!
Be on your guard! We're about to face things that have literally lived for a thousand years!
One by one, the dark presence materializes into human-looking monsters. Moments later, we are deeply surrounded.
What the heck?! These monsters are suppressing my sword's power!
Maybe it's not as strong or legendary as you thought...
I think Bristol was right. She said she'd seen over a hundred like it in a week.
That can't be true! Even if it is, I don't wanna hear it now!
I need a hero's pluck now more than ever!
You know, it's not very herolike to doubt yourself and cower before a battle.
A true hero faces even the mightiest of enemies with courage!
Yes. You have nothing to be afraid of, heroes of the new era. We will help you.
Thank you for lifting the curse on Laffey. Let's deal with these monsters together!
*yawn*... I cast the ultimate explosion spell – Explosion.
Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick!
300% charged! I use Mountain-Splitting Cleave!
Hero's blade, show your true power! Endless Slash!
With the help of the legendary party, the battle was over in a flash.
Sheesh! I knew you were strong, but THIS strong?!
That we are, yes. Keep the praise coming.
Hey, uh, aren't you kind of... fading away?
Fading away?
Ah, you mean this. We're merely phantoms from the past, brought back temporarily by the Flute of Time.
Soon, we'll be gone altogether since we've used up all our strength.
Huh? But Laffey is fading away, too!
Mhm, that's because she's also a phantom.
Planet Bunnyians don't live for thousands of years.
She's only stuck around for so long because of the Demon King's curse, I think.
Now that her curse has been lifted, she's gonna go to heaven with the rest of us.
I can't wait to have sweet dreams again.
Thank you, all of you, for lifting the curse.
But... But you're finally free of the curse, and now you're just... *sob*...
(This must be what Arkhangelsk didn't tell us. She knew this was going to happen.)
Don't cry. I'll give you something as thanks for all you've done...
There. I fully refilled the Flute of Time's mana.
If you're ever in a tight spot, use the flute again to summon us.
This isn't our last meeting. Promise.
Okay...
Oh, new hero! One thing before I go.
It was pretty weird how the monsters suppressed your sword's power. Do you know why?
Because my "hero's" sword is fake?
Yup! It's just an imitation. THIS is the real hero's sword!
Are you serious?! That sword just looks like a big fish!
It sure does!
I'll bet people born after us all thought it looked way too goofy to be a legendary weapon.
That's probably why they made imitations of it look more... normal, like yours.
Oh, but your sword is still a good sword, even if it's not legendary.
But it's only a fake... It's no hero's sword...
Don't think of it like that!
It's not the sword that makes the hero, it's the hero that makes the sword!
Yours will become the new hero's sword if you slay the Demon King with it!
You're right... Yeah, you're totally right!
Thank you, legendary hero Javelin!
Heehee! Glad I could help!
Farewell, new heroes. We will meet again.
Hey, wait! Let me at least get a picture! Smile for the camera!
Perfect! Okay, see you later, legendary heroes!
A gust of wind sends the legendary party back to the heavens. The forest returns to silence.
What a wild turn of events...
Our plan to recruit the great mage has failed spectacularly.
At least we got a legendary item for our troubles.
That flute is sure to keep us safe on our journey!
I guess so.
This was a pretty emotional quest...
But it was also our only lead. What do we do now?
KABOOOM!
Hm? Hey! I hear fighting coming from the south!
Sounds like it's a clash of armies!
Oh no... Is the Demon King Army attacking?!
That can't be! The great wall should keep them out!
Let's go see what's happening!
A violent battle unfolds on the road toward Sentinel Bastion.
CHIIIRP!
Out of the way!
Your Holiness, look out!
Freezing Chains, bind them!
Thank you for the assistance!
Your Holiness, we are lightly armed and our foes are many. We will not last in a protracted battle!
I'm aware. Still, we cannot abandon these villagers.
I shall draw the monsters' attention. You two protect the villagers and retreat!
No! You can't, Your Holiness!
It is the only way. Please do as I say!
Meanwhile, across the battlefield...
Those Dark Slimejuu Knights ordered the attack...
This is bad. The Demon King Army is attacking AND it's their airborne hunters division!
Who's that fighting over there? The Royal Army?
Yes, that's– Wait, is that the Saint herself?!
What's the Saint doing this far from the Royal Capital?!
Big brother, this is serious!
The Royal Army probably won't hold out for long!
Everyone, get ready for battle! We're going to help them!
KABOOOM!
Phew... That was the last one.
Thank you for coming to our aid, adventurers.
We would have suffered major casualties were it not for you.
Don't mention it! Helping those in need is just what heroes do!
Your Holiness, why'd you fight the Demon King Army with such a small force?!
Well... I didn't want to fight any monsters today.
I simply saw these villagers being attacked whilst en route to Sentinel Bastion, and I helped them.
It's very alarming that the Demon King Army is now attacking settlements even this close to the Bastion...
I fear that the situation on the frontlines is getting worse.
Adventurers, may I beseech you something?
Sure! What do you need?
Our great wall is protected by many goddesses, including the goddess of light and justice. Even the Demon King cannot break through it so easily.
However, her army tore a hole through it during a major battle a few days ago.
I left the Royal Capital specifically to help repair the hole. Alas, I did not anticipate the Demon King Army would attack a settlement so close to it.
I believe the Demon King means to exploit this gap in our defenses to make a move.
So, I want to travel to the Bastion and reinforce it, but I cannot just leave these poor villagers to fend for themselves.
They are all evacuees from Friede, a village that sits close to the hole.
It's safe to assume that monsters are laying waste to their homes as we speak.
Which brings me to my request – would you please clear the village of monsters?
Adventurers! Please save our village!
Killing monsters and saving a village? Sounds exactly like a quest fit for a hero!
What do you say, Commander?

options.content: Only if the reward is right.

scripts.say: There you have it! The Commander said so!
Uh, of course... We'll give you a heap of rewards if you do it!
That is, if you survive...
Alright, the hero's party is on the case!
Thank you! May the goddess of peace and protection be with you!
Friede Village – it gets its name from the word Frieden, which means "peace."
A rather ironic name since it is now engulfed in the flames of war.
Half the buildings have been burned to the ground...
Weird. There isn't a villager or monster in sight.
Halt! You there! Identify yourselves!
You look like bandits raring to loot the ruins! Not on my watch!
Who are YOU calling a bandit?!
I am the hero, and this is my party! We're on a journey to defeat the Demon King! Now who are you?
Ah... Adventurers.
Apologies for suspecting you.
I am Vanguard, knight banneret and guardswoman from the west wall.
I came after receiving word that Friede was under attack.
Don't worry. We've already eliminated every last monster.
That's what you came here to do, I presume.
Yes, and... now you've kind of left us with nothing to do.
No rewards for this side quest, I guess.
You know what that means, Commander. Back to the main quest.
Hang on. This quest isn't finished yet.
Huh? It's not?
Vanguard, you said you're a guardswoman from the west wall.
I've heard that a battle just a while ago tore a hole through it. Is that right?
That's strictly confidential information. Who told you that?
Doesn't matter. What I wanted to ask is – was it really a good idea to take your troops and leave the west wall unguarded?
Who's defending the hole now?
If it's nobody, the Demon King Army is probably going to target it.
Urgh! You've got a good point...
I need to get back to the wall right away!
KABOOOM!
Sounds like another battle!
This time it's coming from over by the wall!
Son of a...
Soldiers, regroup! Return to the wall immediately!
We'll back you up!
Many thanks!
Swarms of flying monsters hang in the sky like dark clouds. They descend upon the wall with the force of a squall.
Swords and magic and machinery and armor clashed and collided with one another.
By the time we arrive, there is already a heated battle unfolding in the air above the wall.
They've sent in flying monsters AND an undead battalion... They're going all-out.
This is going to be a fierce battle...
Let them come! We are knights of the Royal Army! We shall not falter!
Hold the line! Let not a single monster through!
Behold the light of my royal sabre!
Hey! Sorry I'm late!
What a superb attack!
You came not a moment too soon, Vanguard.
Had you taken any longer, there would've been no monsters left for you.
So... How's the village?
We cleared it of monsters. All the villagers got out safely.
That's great news.
Still, I was careless to fall for the Demon King's diversion. I should've known better.
Known better and done what, exactly?
The wall's entire raison d'etre is to protect our people against the Demon King Army.
Coming to their aid is nothing to be ashamed of. Leaving them to fend for themselves – that would be.
Yes... You're right.
At any rate, that problem has been dealt with. Now it's time to deal with this one.
Tell me, what are we up against?
Their army is attacking on all fronts. It makes our battle a few days ago look like a tavern fight.
Their forces are led by a general of their army – Dragonlord Blücher.
The Dragonlord? Heh, I like a challenge.
Heed my words, knight of darkness. You will suffer the pain that you've inflicted upon our people twofold!
Mwahahahaha☆
Buuurn! Turn to ashes!
Ahah! Their positions are in tatters! Milord has proved once again what a brilliant strategist she is!
Crushing these humans is gonna be child's–
Hey! You! Are you the Dragonlord?
That title is bigger than you are!
I know what you're doing! You're trying to hide how small your force actually is!
I'm gonna knock you off that dragon and bring you down to earth!
Oh? An adventurer?
Mwaha☆ They're so desperate, they're relying on adventurers to defend their wall now!
Hmph! Since you clearly don't understand the disadvantage you're at, I'll show you!
Did you hear that? Blücher took the bait!
Hah! This is gonna be such an easy win!
Indeed. Even the strongest army will lose if its general is compromised.
Now we wait for our chance to shoot her down.
Roger! I've been waiting for an excuse to draw my sword!
O goddess of light and justice, give us thy blessed light and let our brave warriors be victorious...
O goddess of steel and dragons, unleash thy fury upon our foes!
What the... The Holy Church and the Church of Steel are here!
Everyone! Hold firm in your belief of victory!
Reinforcements have arrived! Let us smite these monsters together!
KABOOOM!
Ugh! Seriously?!
Don't assume you've won already!
Revenge WILL be mine!
I'll be back, and then– Whoa, whooooaaaa! Mind the turbulence, dragooooon!
Blücher is dragged along helplessly by her dragon. The two disappear like shooting stars among the distant dark clouds.
Dang. The dragon's scales were too thick and it got away.
Perhaps so, but this is still a major victory for us.
With their general out of the picture, it's only a matter of time before their rank and file collapses.
And to think you did this by provoking her, then taking her out with flawless teamwork...
You truly are an exceptional strategist, Commander.
One day, you and your party may just defeat the Demon King and restore peace to the world.

options.content: We will, and that's a promise!

scripts.say: Heehee. Your confidence brings me hope.
I look forward to the day I'll hear about how your group took the Demon King out.
It's not like we've defeated their whole army yet. Save the praise and medals for when it's warranted.
Yes, I suppose. We mustn't let our guard down.
Then let us speak again come the victory celebration.
After the battle ended, we were formally invited to partake in the victory celebration at Sentinel Bastion.
This place serves as the center of operations for the wall's defenders. Yet, once upon a time, it was no more than an unremarkable little village.
That changed when the Demon King Army assaulted the walls of the old castle, decimating it.
Following its destruction, the heads of the last royal family of the old dynasty beseeched the goddesses for help. With their aid, this great wall was built, dividing the land in two.
It was thanks to this wall that the kingdom of humanity survived, narrowly escaping ruination at the hands of the Demon King Army.
Then, the Royal Capital was rebuilt, and the kingdom managed to prosper once more.
Little by little, this place – the beating heart of the great wall – became a second capital, growing into what is now known as Sentinel Bastion.
This brings us to today, where the streets are littered with colorful decor and the people cheer loudly.
To celebrate humanity's victory in an important battle.
Sentinel Bastion - Banquet Hall
Incredible. You actually managed to lift the curse on the great mage...
And not only that, you even spoke to the old heroes! I almost can't believe it.
You should! I haven't even told you the most shocking detail yet...
You know the legendary hero's sword? All this time, it was actually shaped like a fish!
Shaped like a fish? Come on, nobody's gonna believe that! You're just making it up!
Am not! You think I would lie about something so lame?
Alright, settle down. Whether it's the truth or not doesn't really matter.
Now lookie here and pose for the camera!
Bleh... What the heck is this jiggly stuff?
It's my favourite and speciality – eel jelly! I think it's the perfect for a victory banquet.
Though, full disclosure: I couldn't find any eels, so I used Eel Slimejuu meat instead. It's pretty similar in texture!
Come on, don't be shy. Try it!
Slimejuu meat? Are you serious? You just stuffed a monster into your food!
Th-thanks, kind adventurer, but I'm not hungry. I'll have to pass on this one.
I'm sure your cooking would be lovely after a drink or–
Did somebody say drink? I've got just the thing for you!
...Huh?
Excuse me, what's this? It's pitch black, yet it's somehow glowing...
It's a very special drink, made by yours truly.
Drinking it will make all your fatigue from fighting go away, just like that!
I somehow don't believe that! Besides, a knight like me doesn't tire after one mere day of combat!
I appreciate the thought, but please find someone else to give your drink.
Come ooon, I made it just for the banquet! At least have a small sip! Please?
NO! I will NOT drink it!
A fun and friendly atmosphere hangs in the banquet air.
Prim and proper knights mingle and chat with laid-back adventurers, all having a good time.
And then there's me and the thought in the back of my mind that prevents me from really enjoying myself.
That general of the undead army dropped this golden coin after we defeated her...
My Info Analysis skill says this coin was produced back in the age of the old kingdom.
Why did a general of the Demon King Army have a coin like this?
It almost makes me think the old kingdom, the undead army, and even the Demon King are all somehow connected...
But in what way, I have no idea. Too little to work with.
This lore stuff is pretty fascinating. Really tickles your imagination.
Masteeer!
Commandeeer!
It seems if I can't find fun at the banquet, the fun will find me.
*sob*... Nobody wants to eat the food I made!
*sob*... And nobody wants to drink my special potion either!
Please, pleeease eat it!
Please, pleeease drink it!
(I DO have an SSS-rank Curse Resistance. My gut should be able to handle this.)
Of course, uh...
Urgh... What happened?
I must've passed out...
I feel something warm and soft against my head.
Something smells nice, too...
Oh... You're awake.
I scolded Liverpool and Nubian for what they did.
It's like as soon as I'm not here, they start feeding you weird stuff...
Did you look after me while I was out cold? Thanks for that.
Heehee... How do you feel now?
Fine. I'm right as rain.
Turns out that Poison Resistance really came in clutch.
You won't kill the Demon King anytime soon if you're getting knocked out even at a party.
Yeah. Imagine if I died not in a battle, but at a banquet attended by healers, angels, and clerics...
I'd be a laughing stock for the rest of time.
I sense subtle mockery in your words...
At any rate, it's good that you're safe. I have something important to discuss, so I'll go and gather your party members.
Sometime later, in Sentinel Bastion's assembly room...
...In light of these achievements, Her Majesty has decided not to hold you accountable for the destruction of her audience hall.
Additionally, your party shall be granted permits to freely pass through Sentinel Bastion.
Naturally, you will need equipment and supplies to brave the Wasteland. The Royal Army shall provide you with those.
Later, you may also visit our armory and pick any weapons you'd like.
Wait, what was that about permits?
Do you need a PERMIT to go off and kill the Demon King?
Of course you do.
The Wasteland is dangerous, and our kingdom needs every warrior it can get. We cannot simply let people wander toward pointless deaths.
Oh... Good thing we decided to help defend the wall.
Our journey to slay the Demon King would've been over without those permits.
You would also have been seized by the guards and brought back to the castle to answer for your crimes.
Ahahahaha...
Ahem... On behalf of Her Majesty, I would like to thank you all for your bravery in that battle.
Furthermore, I, personally, have a special reward to give you, Commander. For your outstanding contributions.
A special reward? What is it?
Joffre, go ahead.
Yes, ma'am.
Commander, given your numerous successes already, it has been determined that you have the latent ability to lead the party that shall slay the Demon King.
In the name of the goddess of light and justice, I hereby grant you the Blessing of Light.
I hope that it will help you on your way to the Demon King.
Joffre the Fighting Angel offers a prayer, and a golden light illuminates the surroundings.
"Notification: You have obtained the skill Blessing of Light. Rank: SSS."
Now you carry the blessing with you.
Thus, the ceremony has concluded, and my work for the night is done.
You may return to the banquet hall and enjoy the rest of your evening.
I hope you have a pleasant time.
Sentinel Bastion - Guest Room
It's late in the night, and a woman stands alone in a pitch-black room.
She awarded that blessing...
That's mean of you, Saint. Stealing the honor like that.
But while the Blessing of Light protects your mind, it won't be enough for the party to defeat the Demon King.
Doing that will require my Blessing of Steel, which protects the flesh.
...Oh, seems my spell didn't completely put you to sleep, little one.
Heehee, though it doesn't look like you'll be fully waking up soon either.
Until then, I want you to take my love.
You should feel stronger once you wake up.
And this – just think of it like a sweet dream on your quest to kill the Demon King.
Nighty night, my dear little one.
Following the battle, our party stayed at Sentinel Bastion for three days to rest and recover.
We upgraded our gear and stocked up on supplies, then read up on the Demon King Army as much as we could.
Then, finally, we passed through the main gates, officially taking our first step into the monster-occupied Wasteland.
We followed the established road leading away from Sentinel Bastion, but it wasn't long before it abruptly stopped.
We kept going in the same direction and eventually ended up in a thick forest stuffy with fog.
The trees all around us look twisted and mad, their desiccated branches reaching for the sky like broken arms.
Big brother, this place is creepy...
I think we've entered what my skills call the Withered Woods.
Correct. These are the Withered Woods.
A figure appears from the mist – it's Jeanne d'Arc, the saint of the Holy Church.
I've been waiting for you.
I wish to join you. I believe my assistance will bring about the Demon King's defeat just a bit sooner.
That is, if you'll let me. Will you?
Of course. Welcome to the team.
Heehee. Thank you. You won't regret this.
Ah, so you've already deduced why I'm here.
Indeed, I've been waiting for you here so I could join you on your quest.
I believe that coming with you should bring about the Demon King's defeat sooner, even if only slightly.
As I was about to say... This is the Wasteland, dubbed so for obvious reasons.
This dramatic change is the result of a curse that was placed on it. A spell simply known as the Demon King's Curse.
Long ago, before even the great wall was built, these woods were actually an extension of the Endless Woods.
But now, this place has been reduced to a restricted area, its fauna withering and lava streams raging.
To the best of our knowledge, the Demon King and her army have established three bases on this side of the wall.
These are the fortresses to the west, east, and center of the Wasteland.
The Demon King Army has been applying pressure on our great wall through these bases.
We have embarked on holy expeditions before in attempts to purify the Wasteland... but all were unsuccessful.
Even if you purify one area, there are still the three bases that propagate the curse.
You can bless the purified land to keep it pristine for a while, but once the blessing wears off, the curse will reclaim it.
So it's not that purification doesn't work, it's that those bases undo its effects.
If we can neutralize the bases, the land won't be ruined again, right? Even without blessing it.
Indeed, but it should be noted that you CAN bless the land, Commander.
You carry the blessing of the goddess of light and justice in your heart. It can purify the land if you just destroy those bases.
What? The Commander can do that?!
What about ME?
When will it be MY time to shine?
Umm... I suppose your glorious duty is to slay the monsters and capture the bases.
...Good point!
You're right! It IS my duty to slay the monsters!
So, what are we waiting for? Let's find a base and clear it out!
Shhh! Quiet!
My master told me this place is inhabited by ferocious monsters that–
CHIRP CHIRP CHIRP!
Bugger, they know we're here...
Oh, fiddlesticks!
Change formation! Prepare for battle!
CHIIIRP CHIRP!
CHIRP! CHIRP!
There are too many of them! Too many even for me to handle!
I'm out of MP...
Yeah, same...
Take these MP recovery potions! I've got healing potions left, too, so I'll cover you!
Commander, we will be overwhelmed if this continues!
The monsters on this side of the wall are something else entirely...
We should avoid head-on confrontations with them until we know their weaknesses.
At least someone among you has a working brain.
That said, if you were truly smart, you never would've come here to begin with.
I've deployed a smokescreen to distract them. Recover now while you can.
What a party you have...
A hero, two clerics, a potion maker, a commander, and...
Well, if it isn't the Royal Army's saint.
You look familiar... Are you... a vampire hunter?
They say you're a resistance group that fights the Demon King Army from this side of the wall.
I thought the stories about you were just that – stories.
It's better for us if some people believe that.
Well met, Your Holiness. I'm Sheffield, a vampire hunter, as you surmised.
I'm curious, what are you doing out here? Did you leave the safety of your castle to go on an adventure?
I took you for a coward, hiding behind that wall whilst sending adventurers to their deaths in the land you abandoned.
I do not take kindly to insults directed at the soldiers of the Royal Army!
We fight day in and day out to defeat the Demon King!
Furthermore, we support those brave souls who venture into the Wasteland and treat them with the utmost respect!
Defeat the Demon King, you say?
Do you know how much time has passed since your last holy expedition?
Has even a single one been carried out since you were born?
Well... I...
Now this is getting interesting. You snuck out without telling anyone, didn't you, Ms. Saint?
Wait, you didn't tell anyone?!
Sooo... we're suspects in helping her escape now...
If the army captures us, they will DEFINITELY throw us in jail this time!
That...
That won't happen, I assure you. I did this entirely on my own.
Whatever consequences arise from this, I shall bear myself. I will not let them punish you.
I know you won't.
...You knew that I snuck out, didn't you, Commander? And let me into your party nevertheless?

options.content: We'll need all the manpower we can get.
I just thought holding you hostage would be fun.

scripts.say: That is true. The more people on your side against the Demon King, the better.
Nobody will mind that you snuck out if you and the rest of us defeat the Demon King, either.
I suppose that's– Wait, you thought even that far head?
H-holding me hostage?!
Big brother...
Sorry, sorry. It was just a joke.
Heh. Your party sounds like a fun bunch.
Even if you weren't, the vampire hunters welcome anyone who ventures to this side of the wall.
Now, is everyone topped off on health?
