Of course, if you simply wanted to have a little chat with me... I wouldn't mind that either.
Your range of interests is simply remarkable. I didn't expect you to be so well-versed both in strategy and in crafts.
Well-versed? I wouldn't go that far. I've only picked it up recently, and am still learning.
There's much I'd like to learn from you too still, so you're always welcome to come here and keep me company.
Of course, that offer extends far beyond topics such as Go and embroidery. Heehee~
Oh, you're curious about my little piece of embroidery here?
It might be a bit too soon to tell you, but...
Hmm, let me think about the best way to convey this...
Since I'm sure you're interested in this piece in my hands right now...
I suppose you could call it a present I was making for you, Commander.
In the pursuit of more intricate designs and patterns, I've employed a special technique known as "Three-Azures Embroidery".
The style is clean and elegant, and uses soft tones... The very same technique can be seen on the clothes that I am wearing now.
Every stitch is careful and deliberate, filled with my intent to convey my feelings towards you.
Once I am done with this piece of work, I do hope that you will find it to your liking.
Of course. I'm really looking forward to it.
I'm glad to hear that... But right now, since we're already here together...
Chen Hai suddenly sets down her handiwork on the stone table, and picks up the instrument lying right now to her.
Her long, slender fingers dance across the strings, the notes spreading forth like a gentle breeze across a placid lake.
Her music is graceful and melodious, yet still imbued with her unique poise and calmness. Slowly, gradually, it fills up this quiet world.
If you don't mind, why not stay here a bit longer?
There's plenty I'd still like to share with you... Whether it's my experiences learning embroidery, or my knowledge of Go.
Though, if you'd like to take a nap, I'll also be more than glad to keep you company, continuing to work on my embroidery until you wake up again.
Whatever the case, I hope we can continue to cherish our wonderful time together.
The girl's sweet giggles flow into my ears along with her music.

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>Ooshio the Secretary</size>

scripts.say: It was an ordinary morning. The cool sea breeze was blowing, the sun was gently rising, and the port was wrapped in silence.
In the distance one could see the silhouette of a young girl walking with a cheerful gait, heading towards the Commander's office.
Port - Office
I opened the door to my office and—
What the...?
This place was a mess when I went home yesterday, but someone had thoroughly cleaned it up. It almost looked like a newly built apartment ready for an occupant.
Even the air smelled fresher than it usually did because all the furniture had been polished to a mirror sheen.
And in the center of the room was a young girl, silently standing around.
Mornin', Commander~ My name's Ooshio, I'm here to serve as yer secretary~
As she greeted me, she left her broom on a shelf nearby.
*Giggle*, I know ya never asked me to clean the office, but I'm glad ya like its new look~
Now just sit down 'n relax, Commander~
I sat down in my chair as Ooshio served me coffee and some biscuits.
Ya oughta keep yer sugar intake low in order to stay healthy~
Whatcha want for breakfast? Bacon 'n eggs? Ya sure ya oughta have both?
It seemed like Ooshio was going to spoil me rotten before I could even start working.
I reckon we'll be spendin' a lotta time together from now on♪ Hope I can be of use to ya~

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>Do Ya Like Girls?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Coast
Ooshio and I observed the fleet as they were training.
Hot as heck today, don'tcha think... We oughta get in the shade of that tree, else we might be riskin' a heatstroke.
...Honestly, nobody should even be out trainin' in this sizzlin' heat...
We decided to stand in the shade of the tree together. The pleasant sea breeze blew against our bodies and cooled them down.
Hehe, hehehe♪
Commander, don'tcha think hardworkin' girls are mighty cute? Hehehe♪
Just watchin' 'em exertin' themselves and workin' up a sweat makes my heart go thump thump~
Ah, I don't mean I get a kick outta watchin' people hurt! I'm just sayin' I love cute girls, that's all~
The day of training was over.
As I was making sure everyone was heading back to the dormitory, Ooshio proposed we "take a short walk together."
Gosh, what a pretty sunset~ Ya think the seagulls like watchin' the sun settin' over the ocean too?
Ah, also, since everyone's worked their butts off today, I was hopin' I could convince ya to treat 'em with some snow cones... Whaddya say, Commander?
Hehe♪ Then I'mma go on ahead 'n get the word out~
As soon as Ooshio heard my reply, she ran off to talk to all the girls who had finished training.
Just another quiet day at the base.

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>Fate or Miracle?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
I finished my work for the morning and was taking some sweet time to relax.
I done made some handmade sweets for ya, Commander~ Hope you'll like 'em~
They've got less sugar in 'em since I'm conscious 'bout yer health~
Ooshio left a small box right in front of me. Opening it revealed appetizing biscuits and cookies in various shapes, all lined up nicely inside.
Oh, almost forgot to say: ya only get half of 'em. Be nice 'n leave the rest, will ya?
Only half of it?
Who's gettin' the rest? Hehehe, come along 'n you'll find out who~
Being curious, I decided to follow Ooshio.
We're here, Commander~
Howdy, Shigure, it's me~
The place Ooshio had taken me to was a room in the Sakura Empire's dormitory.
Oh, it's you! Hehe, I was gonna show you my new nails today, and... Huh, looks like the Commander's here too.
Yup♪ Told me, "I'm curious who's getting these snacks," so we went here together~
Huh, I see. Yuudachi's still sleeping, though.
Still sleepin', huh? Then I reckon I oughta show ya my secret trick for wakin' someone up~
Yuudachi was sleeping soundly on her futon. Ooshio opened the box and took out a biscuit which she put on Yuudachi's nose.
*Sniff, sniff*... Woof! I smell snacks! Where?! Where are the snacks?!
Μornin', Yuudachi~ I done gotten you some snacks~
W-wait, you mean...?!
Your handmade snacks! Awoooo! I'm as awake as a Pillar Man! Gimme those snacks, right now!
Yuudachi was as excited as a dog seeing its owner come home when she started munching on Ooshio's snacks.
Ya don't gotta eat it all at once~ There's still plenty left~
Those two share some kind of strange fate... But I'm sure that's nothing you need to worry about, Commander.
Hey now, Shigure, don't say that kinda misleadin' stuff to the Commander~

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>The Trusted Press Corps</size>

scripts.say: Port - Pier
Ooshio and I were patrolling around the base.
*Sigh*... If I don't get some new material, my job as a reporter will be over...
I wonder if something headline-worthy has happened anywhere recently...
Aoba was in dire straits.
...Maybe I should MAKE something happen?
Hey, is that Aoba sittin' over there? Must have somethin' on her mind... Wait here just a sec, Commander~
Ooshio went over to greet Aoba.
Ya havin' trouble findin' new stuff to write 'bout again?
Oh, hey, Ooshio. You know anything I could use? Like something big that even I haven't heard about?
Hehehe♪ I reckon I do~
Ooshio whispered something into Aoba's ear.
Holy crap! Y-you're giving me a scoop this big?! You might have it in you to be a reporter!
Shhhh! Don't go shoutin'!
Oh crap! The Commander's staring at us! Okay, please come back and give me some details later when the Commander's not around!
After Aoba saw me, she panicked and tried her hardest to act normal.
What in the world was that about?
Ya curious what we were talkin' 'bout? Hehehe♪ It's a secret between girls that I can't letcha in on~

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>Time for Overtime!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Though it was now late into the night, I still had a big pile of work to do.
There's just no end in sight...
Commander, the deadline for these docs is tomorrow mornin', so ya can't rest till ya gone through 'em...
I'll stay here 'n help ya out, so just keep on truckin'...
Ooshio brought me a glass of milk.
How 'bout some milk? It's gettin' late, so I reckon ya could use somethin' warm to drink.
As I was sipping my hot milk, I looked at the mountainous pile of paperwork left. I let out a sigh and continued working.
Guess I won't be getting any sleep tonight...
...Commander? Are ya awake?
Ooshio woke me up. I guess I ended up falling asleep in my office.
G'mornin', Commander. Guess ya ended up fallin' asleep in yer office...
I done prepared ya some food. Once yer ready, gimme a call 'n I'll heat it up for ya.
That's when I noticed that my coat was hanging on my shoulders, like a blanket. Ooshio must've covered me with it while I was sleeping.
Sorry for havin' to tell ya this when ya just woke up, but...
Ooshio placed her hand on a stack of papers. The mountain of paperwork from yesterday was now only a fraction as big.
Thanks to yer hard work, ya almost done achieved yer goal~ Reckon ya can manage the final stretch?

options.content: Promise Ooshio it'll be a cinch

scripts.say: Haha♪ I knew I could count on ya~
It felt like I got done with the remaining work in the blink of an eye.

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>Catgirl Tea Party</size>

scripts.say: Port - Near the Sakura Empire Dormitory
Ooshio invited me to a tea party with the girls from Destroyer Division 8 on my day off.
Asashio, Ooshio, Michishio, and Arashio were under a big cherry tree, sitting on a picnic blanket and having an enjoyable time.
Look, the Commander showed up~
Hey, over here~
Ooshio guided me to a place to sit on the blanket.
Welcome, Commander, to Destroyer Division 8's tea party.
Have all the snacks ya want♪ If yer outta tea then let me know~
Hmm hm~♪ We get to enjoy this nice weather thanks to you, Commander~
Yeah... I hope you'll enjoy our tea party.
*Giggle*~ Now let's enjoy some tea~
I took a sip from my small cup of tea then examined the destroyer sitting next to me.
Asashio was sitting on the side of the blanket and munching on a bear-shaped cookie.
*Nom nom nom*...
Aahhh~ Yer so cute when yer eatin', Asashio~ I just gotta stroke them ears~
Ooshio started delicately stroking Asashio's ears.
Stop... that tickles...
Oh noo~♪ A leaf fell into my teacup...
Ooshio, please... Oh, is there not enough room on your side of the blanket, Commander? Please, use this extra one we brought with us.
So, Commander, how ya like our tea party~?
Allow me to pour you some tea, Commander. Ah, and for you too, Asashio~
Sitting under this cherry tree makes me want to sing~ Laa laa laaa~♪
It felt like I was sitting in a bubble where time itself was moving slowly. A soothing bubble...
[Ooshio and her sisters soothed the Commander!]

sequence:
Gentle and Sweet Ooshio!

<size=45>See Ya Next Time~</size>

scripts.say: The tea party seemed like it was about to end.
But then an anxious thought suddenly crossed my mind: have I actually just been a nuisance all along?
Maybe I shouldn't have come to the tea party in the first place...?
Commander, somethin' on yer mind...?
As if she could read my mind, Ooshio started smiling.
I reckon yer worryin' 'bout whether yer just botherin' us, right~?
Yer overthinkin' it, Commander~ Yer our friend... Heck, yer like family to us♪
Am I right or am I right, ya'll~?
The rest of the Division 8 destroyers joined in.
She's right. You don't need to worry about feeling like a nuisance to us, Commander.
You'll still join us for our next tea party, won't you?
It felt like I was being gently pulled back...
I will prepare more snacks for you and Ooshio next time, so please...
Be our honorable guest once more.
Arashio turned to me and lightly nodded.
If you liked the flowers and my singing, feel free to have a chat with me whenever you'd like~
*Giggle*~ See, what'd I tell ya~
Seeing their dazzling smiles made all my doubts vanish completely.
We hope to see you next time, Commander~

sequence:
Swept Away in the Moment

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Ready, Ladies!</size>

scripts.say: One day - Commander's Office
Listen, you lowly animal! Let us throw a party!
... I'm getting some serious deja vu right now.
Why? Because that dwarf of a queen said that "the Royal Navy hosts the most luxurious and dazzling parties, and no others can compare" ...?
That girl has some nerve to pretend like the Iron Blood doesn't exist!
And you will help plan the party! That's right, even a lowly animal such as you can have a moment in the limelight. You should feel honored!
And so it was decided that Iron Blood would be hosting the next party.
Sorry for making you put up with my sister, Commander... But, thanks to you, the venue does look pretty nice.
For such a lowly animal, you've done fine work! Ahahaha! Hey, dwarf queen, wouldn't you say the Iron Blood knows how to throw a fine party?
Grrr... How insolent, taunting the Queen like this... But I will admit that the party does look decent, thanks to the aid of my servant!
I must give my sincerest thanks to all the people of the Royal Navy that offered to help.
Furthermore, I would like to add that I'm honoured to be the head of the security team for the party venue.
Ark Royal deserves special praise for her willingness to volunteer, thus saving us a lot of trouble.
Ark Royal...?
Ahh... destroyers in cute dresses... No, I can't let my mind wander! For now, I must focus on my security duties...!
A-anyway! Do enjoy yourselves at our party today!

sequence:
Swept Away in the Moment

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Prost!</size>

scripts.say: Now, as for the ways to enjoy oneself at this party...
Hehehe... I've been saving all these drinks just for this occasion. Today, I can drink as much as I please.
Eugen, isn't that a little overboard? Soon you'll make a habit of drinking yourself senseless...
My sisters did say ya like to drink a whole bunch, but wow...
Didn't really believe it till I saw it, I suppose~
What's the big deal? I'd also rather have as much as I want than be tied down by some arbitrary code of conduct and not even be able to enjoy a glass.
Honestly, I like how sensible the Iron Blood is when it comes to this kinda stuff.
Haha, I'm delighted that we're in agreement. Say, would you be interested in some of this?
The Vichya Dominion makes fine liquor, but it wouldn't hurt to try what the Iron Blood has to offer.
And you... Ooshio, was it? How about a drink?
Good point. I wouldn't mind a taste.
I'd be right happy to~
Hm... I must say, I never imagined I would feel at home in a situation like this.
That is, drinking with good company simply to have a good time, rather than to be polite...
Oh, Tirpitz, what are you saying? Stop sweating the small stuff and just knock back a glass.
Hm... You're right. I'll try not to think too much.

sequence:
Swept Away in the Moment

<size=45>Other Ways To Have Fun</size>

scripts.say: Of course, drinking wasn't the only way to enjoy oneself at the party...
Meat! Yummy yummy meat! Om nom nom nom! Ahhh, I'm in carnivore heaven!
... *Sigh*, when Yuudachi sees meat, not even her shadow can keep up with her...
And where might Taihou have gone off to? Everybody's just concerned with themselves today...
I've spotted a lone U-47!
Why are you sitting here alone, U-47? I know you didn't volunteer to help set up the party, but shouldn't you at least be celebrating together with everyone else?
... Don't wanna socialize, so I'll pass. You can have fun without me.
What?! Haven't you heard the phrase "the more, the merrier"? C'mon, let's head to the buffet tables and get something good to eat!
Good idea! And let's say hello to a few guests from the other factions along the way!
*Sigh*... I was perfectly fine with just staying here...
Don't be like that! C'mon!
It really is wonderful that we can have such a heartwarming party and have such fun together...
But... it doesn't feel quite thrilling enough...
Ey, Roon, what's up? You look, like, soooo bored, like you haven't had any fun all day.
I mean, your own peeps are hosting this time, so isn't it fine to just kick it?
... Oh, hello, Seattle and Ibuki. How lovely to see you here~
H-hello, Miss Roon... Forgive me, this is my first time attending one of these "parties..."
Don't you worry about that, Ibuki! All you need to know is: parties are for partying!
So, like, don't overthink things and just do what you wanna do!
You're right, Seattle~ Everyone has their way of enjoying a party. Say, could I ask you to give me a tour around the venue to see what's here?

sequence:
Swept Away in the Moment

<size=45>Classic Conclusion</size>

scripts.say: Although there are a few who were reluctant to join in, what matters is that everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
Ahahahaha! What's the matter, dwarf queen? Are you left speechless by how perfect our party was?
You dare call me a dwarf?! Quite ironic, considering that you are hardly taller than a destroyer!
What did you just say?!
It was astounding how they took such a petty quarrel so seriously.
Deutschland! Don't start a fight with her!
It is moving to see that you are on such amicable terms with one another.
"Amicable?" Hah!
It doesn't seem this quarrel will end on its own... I suppose it's time to send off the night.
What?!
Whiiiiiish... ba-boom!
Are those...?
... Ahahahahahaha! How's *that*? Do you see the dazzling fireworks my servant prepared?
Well... Not bad, but compared to the Royal Navy's fireworks, they're not any... Wait a moment, I recognize these from the summer festival!
Blast it! The jig is up!
Good thing they let me have some of the leftovers from the fireworks workshop. I'll need to stop by Akashi's shop later to say my thanks.
Looks like liquor tastes even better when watching fireworks.
Et tu, Iron Blood... But, guess everyone's gotta be flashy when it matters.
Too loud... Although the fireworks aren't shabby...
If only I could make the battlefield "light up" as beautifully as these fireworks do~
Ahaha, aha... What, like, literally?
Shoukaku! Om nom... Look, fireworks!
Yuudachi, please... don't talk with your mouth full.
The dazzling sight of the fireworks was a fitting end to such a delightful party. Indeed, I hoped every party could be so invigorating.

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 1: A Christmas Conundrum</size>

scripts.say: This dress might be good, but... Actually, on second thought...
No, a dress wouldn't nearly suffice for Her Majesty. Besides, the dress I've chosen clearly lacks class...
... I'm at a loss. I haven't the slightest clue what Her Majesty wants for Christmas!
Sigh, what should I do...
Hm? Who is... Oh, it's you, Cygnet. Sorry for not noticing you.
Eep! G-greetings, Warspite... I-I'm sorry for disturbing you...
Not at all. I was just pondering what presents to get for the people of the Royal Navy.
Speaking of which, didn't you help prepare everyone's presents last year, Cygnet?
I-I did! But I'm fairly sure that I only helped by going shopping for food and snacks...
Food and snacks... Not quite what I had in mind. Still, thank you for the input.
B-b-but I haven't even given any input worth a thank-you!
Um... If you'd like, I could help you with your presents! I'm not sure how to help, but I'll find a way...
Don't be like that. Two heads are always better than one. And with two heads, let's go a-head and head to the store!
Of course! ... Wait, we're leaving already?! I-I'll get my coat...!

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Gift for Everyone</size>

scripts.say: Hold yer horses, Urakaze~! I'm not done yet!
My patience has run out! How on Earth can you spend over two hours picking out presents?!
I done told you, I got a lotta people to give to! 'sides, weren't you the one who talked 'bout givin' presents to everyone?
Grrr... F-fine. I'll be generous and give you another hour!
Hm? Good day, Sakura Empire destroyers. What seems to be the matter?
Why, if it ain't Warspite 'n Cygnet~ What're y'all here for?
To pick out some presents. Although we haven't decided on what to get yet.
G-greetings...
Aw heck, we can't have you cute girls in trouble, can we... If there's anythin' we can help ya with, just say the word.
No, please don't say the word! Ooshio's not even done picking presents for her own friends!
In that case, we'll leave you to it. But if you don't mind my asking... Are those outfits you're wearing this year's Christmas costumes?
It is. This is my handmade Warring States-style yuletide uniform. Hohoh, no need to tell me it looks good. I know it does~
Mine's handmade too! This here's my reindeer costume for deliverin' Christmas presents~ Ain't it brimmin' with holiday spirit?
I see... A handmade costume would be perfect for Christmas. The time required to make it is an issue, though...
W-we don't have time to make enough Christmas costumes for everybody!
... Gah, we won't get anywhere if we can't even decide what presents to get!
Maybe we should simply ask everyone what they want...
B-but then it won't be a surprise when they open their present...!
Then what do you suggest?
Maybe we could ask somebody from the Eagle Union...? Enterprise might have an idea, since she was Santa last year...
Ask someone else, eh? Well, we don't have any better ideas at the moment, so let's try it... Ladies, if you'll excuse us. Have a Merry Christmas!
You have one, too~ See ya 'round, Warspite~

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Shadow over Christmas, Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Eagle Union Dormitory
Ah, it's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! Although thinking of Christmas gives me chilling flashbacks to Enty's Santa costume last year...
I don't mind getting presents, but I'd be anxious about having her as our Santa again...
Heh heh heh! Personally, I quite liked her costume! But I say it's time for Sara to take on the role this year and–
No, Sara. No mischief during Christmas. We can't have you causing a ruckus on such a beloved holiday, can we?
Enterprise is away from port on a mission at the moment. It's a little lonely here without her...
Thank gosh for that! I can't for the life of me keep a straight face and accept a present from Santaprise. Let's pick a new Santa, while she's–
(Knock knock)
Aw, heck! She's not back already, is she?
Greetings, my Eagle Union friends! We were hoping to ask Enterprise a question. Do you know where she is?
Hello there, Warspite. Sadly, Enterprise isn't here. She's out on a mission and hasn't returned yet.
Oh. Well... we wanted to ask her what would make a good present for our friends, since she has experience with being Santa...
Did I hear someone say 'presents'? Sara knows just the girl for you to talk to!
She should be in her room right now. I'll take you to her!
She's also from Eagle Union, I take it? Very well, show us the way!
Is it fine to just ask her directly like that...?
Of course! The Eagle Union is built on openness and freedom! Come on, follow me!

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 4: The Shadow over Christmas, Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: Saratoga led the two before the door to a room.
Louis~! Sara's brought you visitors! They want your advi– Oh, oops...
Eeeeek! K-knock before you enter someone else's room!
What are you wearing?! Are you going to offer yourself as a kinky present to the Commander?!
It's not what you think! Th-this is a... you know, that thing people do... A cosplay! That's the word!
You couldn't be more wrong if you think I was going to hide in a box wearing this reindeer outfit then pop out and say "I'll be your present!" when the Commander opens it!
Yikes, didn't even need to say it myself... It's okay, Lulu, Sara will just pretend this never even happened!
You'd better! And don't speak a word of this to anyone!
Saratoga took the Royal Navy girls and quickly left the room.
Getting in a box and giving yourself as a present to the Commander... That's an interesting, if unusual idea.
Warspite, please! It's too bizarre to be worth considering!
Personally, I also think it'd be a little... weird if you do that, Warspite.
Ah, I see... Then we still don't have any good ideas. Hmm, we're running short on time...
(Fwoosh)
Merry Christmas! Santa's brought presents for you nice girls!
Enty! You're back!
Welcome back, Enterprise~
No, no. In this moment, I'm not Enterprise, I'm Santa Claus! ... Oh, I see the Royal Navy is paying us a visit.
Sorry, I didn't intend to show myself to you like this.
Not at all, you actually came at the perfect time! We need your help!

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 5: Warspite's Wish</size>

scripts.say: You see, I'm struggling to come up with good presents for my Royal Navy friends.
(My word, that's a large bag of presents she's got...)
And it takes quite some time to pick out presents for that many people. Unfortunately, time is a luxury we don't have...
That's not an issue. It should hardly take any time to go to the store and purchase things.
It takes you hardly any time?! Do you plan out what to buy before you even leave the dorm?! Please, tell me your secret!
Plan out? Secret? Maybe I didn't make myself clear, but I'm not that selective when it comes to buying presents.
Then how do you find the present that's just right for someone?
You don't need to fuss over finding the right present. They'll probably be happy just to receive a present in the first place, because it's the thought that counts.
Ah, the thought behind it... I see now. It's not about the item itself, but the feelings it represents!
Exactly. Hey... this conversation gave me an idea. You should be Santa this year, Warspite.
Do you have a Christmas costume ready?
If it's the thought that counts, surely a costume wouldn't be necessary?
W-Warspite, you could... use the Christmas costume my sisters and I made, if you'd like...
It's a spare one, so we would be delighted to see it put to use!
I can't turn down an offer like that. Thank you, Cygnet! I feel the thought behind your offer loud and clear!
All right, let us head to the store to buy some presents!
P-please, don't put it that way... You're making it sound weird...
The Royal Navy will surely have an interesting Christmas with Santa Clauspite around. Hahahah!

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 6: Onwards, To Christmas Day!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Nighttime
Phew, we've almost finished getting presents for everyone! Saint Nick would tip his fluffy hat to us if he saw how swift we were!
Now all that remains is Her Majesty's special present!
Didn't Enterprise say we don't need to fuss over giving people the "perfect present"...?
It's fine, I know exactly what she wants. I noticed how she had her gaze fixated on a particular stuffed animal when I was out shopping earlier.
Well... then I'm sure Her Majesty will adore it!
This is unfortunate... We purchased too many presents to carry by ourselves...
I'm sorry... I shouldn't have bought so many snacks...
Blast it... Our Christmas is doomed...!
Ho ho ho, you seem to be in a frozen pickle there! But worry not, Santaprise is here!
Enterprise! Thank goodness! Ah, and Nicholas too?
Looks like you could use some help transporting those presents. If you want, you could place them on my eagle sleigh.
Hop aboard, it'll be fun... You have Saint Nicholas's word for it...
You're lifesavers! Err, Christmas-savers, rather. You both have my gratitude!
Thank you so much! Please take us to the Royal Navy dormitory!

sequence:
Operation: Christmas!

<size=45>Chapter 7: Commence Operation: Christmas!</size>

scripts.say: Marvelous! We've gotten all the presents in one place!
*Pant*... *Pant*... Now I understand what they mean by holiday fatigue... But I'm glad I was able to help...
All that is left is to hand them out! It's time for the old lady to get to work!
I-I think I need to rest for a bit...
Whew, almost done. Now just to deliver this stuffed toy to Her Majesty...
Warspite...! You've brought me a present?!
Yes, Your Majesty! Merry Christmas! I sincerely hope this humble gift will be to Your Majesty's liking!
... N-no, I'm not very fond of it! In fact, it's not to my liking whatsoever!
If that is so, then I shall see to it that it is immediately disposed of, Your Majesty!
Halt! Place it over there for the time being. It would be a waste to simply throw it away... Especially after you just gave it to me...
As you command, Your Majesty!
Now all presents have been delivered. I hope everyone's having a merry Christmas...
... Hm? What's with this leftover box...?
What in the–?! It's making noise!
Good morning... Huh...? Where am I...?
Nicholas?! How did you get in there? Aha, were you... wrapped up in the hustle and bustle of Christmas?
No puns first thing after I wake up, please... I think I fell into the box when you got on the sleigh... then fell asleep cause it's so comfy in here...
I-I see... Well, this certainly was a surprise for both of us...
Hey, sorry for barging in! Warspite, have you seen Nicholas? She was with me just earlier...
... Funny you say that, Enterprise! She's right here. Think of her as my present to you!
Huhhh? I'm a present now...? I guess that's fine... I don't mind being Enterprise's present...
Let's just say you're a... gifted girl, Nicholas. To you, and to all, Merry Christmas!

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 1: A Secretary Ship's Duty (?) - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Was it this document my Commander needed? I know it was, naturally.
I hadn't yet said a word when Taihou was already handing me the paper I was about to ask for.
Tea for my Commander♡
... Just as I was starting to feel thirsty, Taihou brought me a cup of tea.
Is my Commander feeling tense? Come, let Taihou rub your shoulders~
... It's like she was able to sense the soreness in my shoulders.
Hmm♪ hmm hmm♪
I could feel Taihou's penetrating gaze...
Don't mind me, my Commander. Just focus on your work~

options.content: Ask why she's staring at me.

scripts.say: Why, because you're so magnanimously stunning, my Commander~
And how else am I supposed to learn more about you?
Only by keeping my eyes on you 24/7 can I understand your needs well enough to service them at any time.
That's part of a secretary ship's duty, after all.
Somehow, it seemed like a reasonable explanation at the time.
If there's anything you'd ever like to do, my Commander, you're free to do it. Leave the busywork to Taihou~
(Whispering) Hehehe... Of course, Taihou is the only one my Commander will ever need...
... I heard something I was probably not supposed to hear.

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Secretary Ship's Duty (?) - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: ... A thick, pungent, and powerfully sweet smell hung heavy in the air.
Hehehe... You're so cute when you sleep.
... Delightful...
Good morning, my Commander~ I was just panicking about how to properly wake you.
Quickly taking in my surroundings, I was sure I was in my own quarters.
Hehe, I've already prepared a delicious breakfast for you. Now let's get you cleaned up first~
I wasn't sure how Taihou had gotten into my room, but I decided to deal with it after brushing my teeth.
You're having a Sakura-style breakfast this morning, my Commander. I hope you enjoy it~
Taihou looked at me with anticipation. She really wanted me to taste her cooking.
My Commander is so worldly! You know our Sakura Empire customs so well~
By the way, I went ahead and cleaned up for you while you were sleeping, my Commander.
(Whispering) Too bad I didn't find anything good...
I thought I heard Taihou say something.

options.content: Ask Taihou how she got in.

scripts.say: It's obvious, isn't it? You always lock your door, so I copied the key.
It's like I said, you're free to do anything you want. Just leave the busywork to Taihou~
Anytime, anyplace, all day, every day, rain or shine, I will do anything and everything for you, my Commander~
That is what a secretary ship's should do, after all.
I got the feeling I was going to have to get used to this lifestyle.

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 3: Taihou's Nemesis(?)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
I'm here to serve as your eternally devoted secretary once again, my Commander. You need only focus on–
Surpriiiiiiise!
Aaaaaieeeeeee! A-A-A-Albacore?!
Ahahahahahaa! I got'cha good, didn't I?
I was a lot more afraid of Taihou's reaction than I was of Albacore's surprise.
What are you doing here?!
Ahaha! I just came by to see you, Taihou. How you doing?
Thanks to you, I'm a little on edge right now.
Yeah, right, so anyway, I came across this new game. If you've got time today, how about we try it out?
I have very important secretary ship duties today, duties that involve staying forever by my Commander's side. I don't have time to play with you–
Uhh... Duh~ Just bring the Commander along with us! C'mon, c'mon!
(This little urchin acts all sweet and innocent to manipulate my Commander...!)
Fine! I'll think about it.
Hehee. Yay! Then I'll come back to get you later. Bye bye, Taihou, Commander!
... They were getting along better than I expected.
Getting along? With that child? I hope not.
Every time she comes around I get dragged off to something...
And this time she's roped you into it... I can't imagine what she's planning!
It was unusual to see Taihou so ruffled. Could it be that Albacore was her "nemesis?"

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 4: A New Alliance(?)</size>

scripts.say: While out for a stroll on my day off, I came across Taihou having a chat.
Hehe, you're a difficult lady to find, Taihou.
I rather like staying alone in my room, except of course when I can be with my Commander~
Somehow I knew you'd say that.
It was Shoukaku she was with.
But you know, sitting here with you, I actually find you pretty easy to talk to.
Unlike certain aircraft carriers giving off that "get the hell away from me" vibe. Hehehe♪
You're... You're talking about Akagi, aren't– Huh? This scent... my Commander?
Scent...? Oh, Commander!
Oooh, my Commander! Hehehe... did you come here just to see me? I'm. Touched~
Before long, the three of us were having tea together.
So you can recognize the Commander by scent alone? You're really something, Taihou...
Ahaha! There's no one alive who can match Taihou's love of my Commander. Not even Akagi.
Now fighting strength is a different story. Akagi has a lot more battlefield experience than I do. Hrrm...
Hehe. Now what do you say to... an alliance?
Alliance?
If we joined forces, we'd definitely be more than a match for Akagi, don't you think?
Am I right, Commander?
While I was a little worried about Shoukaku's ulterior motives, I figured it was best to let them handle this for themselves.
Well, if even my Commander agrees, then I guess–
Excellent. This marks the birth of the "Anti-Akagi Alliance". And that makes us official allies.
(Whispering) Hehehe, let's see Akagi try to steal my Commander now!
I saw a side of Taihou I hadn't seen in my secretary ship. It was sneakier, craftier, maybe happier?
I couldn't for the life of me tell why she was in such a good mood.

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 5: A Mighty(?) Clash</size>

scripts.say: I was out patrolling the base with my secretary ship Taihou.
Oh, hello, Akagi, Kaga.
Hm. Taihou. Making the rounds with the Commander? How diligent.
Commaaaanderrr~ And Taihou? Tch.
Aha! Ahahaha! Ahahahahahaaa! I look away for how long, and the Commander's already covered in pesky little vermin?
Looks like it's time for yet another round of "pest control."
Crimson flames started to lick upward from Akagi's body... Until,
(Smush)... I felt an incredible softness enveloping my arm. It was Taihou?
Isn't it a shame, Akagi, that it's me, Taihou, at my Commander's side? Hmm?
Oh but don't you worry. I'm doing a fine job in your place, Akagi. I've checked every inch of my Commander's body for "vermin." I've licked clean every~ nook~ and~ cranny~
Why you little... You're the one who copied the Commander's key! It's you who's been sneaking into that room every night to do heaven knows what...
Hehehe. Wasn't it you who threatened Akashi into letting you replace all my Commander's lunches with your own "special ingredients"?
The tension between the two of them was palpable, and Taihou's grip on my arm was getting tighter and tighter. I had completely lost my forearm to the softness.
Ummm, Commander...?
At least Kaga was looking out for me.
Ahahahaa! To get to walk like this arm in arm with my Commander...
I am truly the happiest girl alive!
She certainly seemed jovial.
To serve as your secretary, to give you the freedom to do whatever you want,
I'm sure this is the way to earn our just rewards, for you and I both, my Commander.
And that's how we ensure something like what happened back then, that will never happen again...
It turned out this secretary ship job had a very special meaning for Taihou.

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 6: Taihou's Disappearance(?) - Part 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Little by little, I'd been getting used to Taihou.
I've prepared all your documents for the day right here, my Commander~
These are the urgent ones, the lower priority ones are down here, and the ones unworthy of my Commander's attention are in the trash.
Please let me know if there's anything else I can do for you.
My Commander's been working so hard. Please have some tea.
I went ahead and added that spice you were talking about with Yukikaze to your dinner.
I also drew a bath for you. And if your shoulders are sore I hope you'll let me rub them for you♪
... What's wrong, my Commander? Could it be you...
... want to taste me? Want to bathe with me? Or maaaaybee~ You want to do some filthy, depraved things with me~?
I'd even gotten used to her saying stuff like that.
She would cross the line from time to time, but even so Taihou was an objectively dedicated secretary who took her job seriously. Still...
I worried she was neglecting her own health for my sake...
I decided it would probably be a good idea for Taihou to take a day off.
... My Commander...
I saw a new emotion welling up inside Taihou, overpowering her. It was loneliness.
The next day, Taihou disappeared.

sequence:
Taihou, Body and Soul

<size=45>Chapter 7: Taihou's Disappearance(?) - Part 2</size>

scripts.say: There was no breakfast waiting for me when I woke up the next morning.
... Taihou?
Commander, you don't look so good. What happened?
Taihou? ... I haven't seen her. Isn't she always with you?
I went to the office, but there was still no sign of her...
Commander! Thank goodness you're here! You gotta come quick! It's Taihou! She–
I'm sorry. It's all my fault. I was just joking around with her. I said she was being too clingy and she was just gonna end up pushing you away.
I really didn't think anything of it. I never thought she'd lock herself away in her room like this...
You're the only one she'll listen to, Commander... So, it's gotta be you. Please get Taihou to come out of her room!
Taihou's door was closed tight.

options.content: Knock on the door and announce yourself.

scripts.say: Is that my Commander...?
Taihou sounded weaker than I'd ever heard her before.
I always thought everything I was doing was for your sake, my Commander. But I never for a second thought about how you felt.
When Albacore said that to me yesterday, I suddenly realized how clingy I'd been. How awful I'd been.
But I'm in love with my Commander. All I ever think about is my Commander. When I close my eyes, all I see is my Commander. You're my whole world...
... You don't think I interfere with your life too much?
You don't think I'm greedy for wanting to know everything about you at all times? You won't feel annoyed?
You won't pretend to like me to my face, only to turn around and hate me behind my back?
Taihou sobbed out her questions.
... true?
You really don't hate me? You're really not just tolerating me? You really love me?
I didn't even have time to answer before she threw open the door.
<size=45>My Commanderrrrrrr!!!</size>
Taihou pulled me close and buried me in her chest. It seems she already knew.
She knew the only answer I could give her... was "yes."

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>1 Wellspring of Inspiration</size>

scripts.say: At noon on a clear and sunny day...
Commander, you've got to test out my latest invention!
Leonardo da Vinci, the inventor with seemingly endless vitality, comes through my office doors carrying some strange contraption.
Check it out! I call it the Stiffy Shoulder Massaginator! It'll make your shoulder stiffness go away faster than you can say "ow, that's smart!"
I figure you'll benefit from it a lot since you're strapped to your desk all the time. Come on, try it!
It's true – I've had to file a lot of paperwork lately, and that has taken its toll on me. It can't hurt to try.
"Well..."
"On one hand, it does its job exactly as advertised. On the other..."
"It's really loud. Can't you make it quieter somehow?"
WHAT? DID YOU SAY SOMETHING? I CAN'T HEAR YOU!
"I said it's too loud!"
*click*
It's impossible to have a conversation over the noise from her invention, so I decide to switch it off.
I see. So the noise is a problem.
To be fair, I only designed it to give you a great shoulder massage, not to be quiet or anything!
So if it makes a little noise, that's fine!
It's a minor detail, don't worry about it! It works, that's what matters. By the way, do you have any more problems other than stiff shoulders?
Big or small, I wanna know! Heck, the more the better!
"Let me guess – you came to my office expressly to find inspiration again, didn't you?"
Uh... Ahahah... Guilty as charged.
Yeah, my idea well has been pretty dry for a while now.
So I thought, "hey, you have a vast range of knowledge, so you must have a good idea or two I can work with."
"I'm happy to give you that. After I finish my work."
Awesome! Thanks, Commander!
In fact, let me help you with the work! It'll be quicker that way, plus I want to make up for dropping in unannounced!
Since da Vinci wants this work done and over as quickly as possible, I thought she'd prioritize efficiency above all else.
However, that presumption proved wrong – she reads through the request forms, sent in by shipgirls, meticulously and slowly.
Geesh... All these needs I never knew about...
This gives me loads of ideas for new inventions, actually...
She smacks the table with both her hands and stands up, as if she just figured something out.
I've got it!
Commander, I'm going to be your secretary starting tomorrow!
These request forms provide excellent inspo! And working as your secretary, I'll get to read them all day!
"If you want to, be my guest. Just don't forget to perform the actual duties of a secretary."
Well, of course! I'll chew through those papers while savoring the sweet taste of inspiration.
Heck, I can get the job done in a flash if I really want to!
Let me do this and I promise you won't be disappointed♪
And so, I welcomed da Vinci aboard as my secretary.

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>2 Inventing an Invention to Invent Inventions</size>

scripts.say: Since then, da Vinci has been working hard every day as my secretary, just as she said she would.
After she finishes the day's work, she sits down and looks through her paperwork with a fine comb, searching for inspiration.
...Huh. Le Malin wants to establish a lounge which provides snacks and oxy-cola for all.
Sounds like more hassle than it's worth, though. You'd still have to walk there yourself.
I've got a better idea – building custom drones that can airdrop snacks directly to people.
You could make it so you just wave your hand at a drone in the air and it'll fetch the goods for you in a minute or two!
"The snacks would be fine, but cola is a volatile substance and doesn't react well to being shaken."
Dang, you're right... There needs to be a balance between stability and convenience...
I can almost hear the gears in her head turning at max RPM.
Wait, I've got it! Need a pen and paper! I've got to sketch this out right now!
At the end of a day's work, da Vinci will typically have drawn three to four blueprints and sketched out five or more concepts.
M'kay... This'll do as a rough outline.
Commander, could you come here and have a look?
As always, she's curious to hear what I have to say about her latest ideas.
I examine the blueprint for a while, trying to understand what it is. The only way I could describe it is, 'an electric fan standing on bird legs.'
So, if I had to guess, it's...
Uhh... No. That's not a fan on top, it's a propeller!
And that on the bottom is the landing gear. It's inspired by how birds' feet move when they land.
Kind of – it's an aircraft. Or, well, a bird-like drone, I guess you could say.
That on top is the propeller, and that on the bottom is the landing gear. It's inspired by how birds' feet move when they land.
The real highlight, however, is this part right here!
With twinkling eyes, she points to a compartment at the machine's center, painted black.
My specially-engineered storage space!
See this? That's where you store the cola, and this is where the snacks go!
By adding a buckle, you can ensure the cola doesn't roll around during transport without any complicated systems.
Pretty smart, if I say so myself! What do you think?
"Even with the explanation, I can't make heads or tails of anything in your sketch."
Oh... Well, I drew it in a hurry, so it's probably hard to grasp.
What can I say? My pen can't move as fast as the flashes of my inspiration.
Which is a problem when I try to introduce my ideas to others...
"Maybe you could invent something that solves that problem?"
You mean... make an invention that makes it easier to make inventions?
Wait, that's ingenious!
Thanks for the idea! Expect good news soon!
The next day...
Commander! I managed to build it overnight!
I've dubbed it... the Fully Automatic Blueprint Drafter!
Quite simply, this little baby helps me sketch out a design quickly, accurately, and in an easily-readable format.
Now you won't have to scratch your head trying to understand my blueprints anymore.
"That sounds extremely promising. Could I get a demonstration?"
Sure thing!
Alright, let's start by drawing a tire here...
Actually, no. Gotta start with the frame.
...What the heck is this? That takes up way too much space! The cockpit will get pressurized if you draw it like that!
Hang on, maybe I can fix it if I move the cockpit to the other side...
...No! You can't put the engine there!
Initially, the machine is able to keep up with her instructions, making an accurate blueprint at stunning speed. However...
Her instructions quickly become too much for it to follow. Pushed past its limits, the machine lets out a screech and overheats.
Bah! I'll just do it on my own!
She gives up on her new invention and goes back to drawing her designs by hand, like she normally does.
I should've known better... Words just can't compete with the speed of electric signals in your brain.
This just confirmed my hunch – drawing blueprints myself is the quickest!
Da Vinci has no real use for this machine. She's faster than it.
But, it may one day see use in someone else's hands.
Perhaps not for the purpose of drawing blueprints, as she envisioned, but for filling out paperwork, it could be quite the powerhouse.

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>3 Look Around You</size>

scripts.say: Outside, on a sunny holiday...
Huh. There are some things in this world you'll only notice if you have a close look...
As I'm walking around the stadium, I catch sight of da Vinci. She's standing by the hurdles, muttering to herself.
Oh, Commander! Morning.
"What are you up to?"
I'm coming up with inventions that could improve the equipment around here.
After all, technology should get better with the passage of time!
Take these hurdles, for instance. Whenever you want to use them, you have to carry and put them in place, right?
Now imagine a machine that could do it for us.
"I see where you're coming from. That would be convenient."
"Did somebody ask you to do this, by any chance?"
Nope. I'm doing it because I want to.
By the way, I'm gonna go around looking for inspo in a bit. You wanna come with me?
"Sure, why not? I was just on a walk anyway."
Port - Café
Poor staff. It always gets super busy here during holidays.
Maybe I could invent a robot that makes coffee exactly the way you tell it to. That'd lighten the baristas' workload!

options.content: "I pray it won't be deafeningly loud."
"You should ask for the staff's opinion first."

scripts.say: It won't be! A café has got to have a chill atmosphere, and I can account for that in my designs!
Why'd you even bring that up? Don't tell me it's something to do with my Massaginator...
Obviously. I'm not just going to push an invention on them without hearing them out.
But, on the contrary... with some people, it's best if you don't ask.
Port - Swimming Pool
You know what sucks about getting out of the pool?
You're soaking wet. And if it's windy while you're wet, it's chilly as heck and you'll probably catch a cold.
But, imagine if you had swimwear that automatically warmed you up! Then you could get up without fear of freezing your butt off.
I know, right?
I shall name it... the Swimmy Warmy Swimwear. Once it's finished, we should both wear one and go for a swim!
Oh, right! You'd get shocked! Well, everyone would...
Hmm... Yeah, I'd better use a chemical heating agent instead.
Port - Classroom
Every now and then, you've got to clean the blackboard. Not only is that a chore, but you're also at risk of inhaling unhealthy chalk powder.
That's the problem the Automatic Anti-Specky Blackboard Eraser aims to solve!
Just press a button and the powered air intakes will clear all traces of chalk as well as suck up any powder residue on the blackboard's rim!

options.content: "It's so easy that anyone could use it."
"But what if you press it by mistake?"

scripts.say: Heh! Exactly! And if you want, I could give you one for the blackboard in your office!
Then again... That blackboard hasn't seen any use since you had the new monitor installed...
Then it'll erase everything on the blackboard whether you want it or not.
...Without a two-step confirmation mechanism, anyway. I'll be sure to add that.
Together, we toured many more places across the port. It was a joy to see her get so fired up when she found inspiration.
Now, we're back in my office.
Heehee♪ I definitely didn't expect to find this much inspiration all around me.
If I had to point at what was so different, it's that you were with me the whole day.
When you're with me, I get good ideas left and right. Plus you point out things I would've never noticed myself!
So, I have to ask you a favor – will you tag along from now on whenever I need some inspo?
Thanks! I really appreciate it.
You sure as heck don't♪

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>4 One Man's Trash...</size>

scripts.say: In the office, after a long day...
I'm searching around for da Vinci's contraption, and it's nowhere to be found.
Whatcha looking for? The Stiffy Shoulder Massaginator?
You won't find it here. I threw it in the depot.
"Why? Did you give up on it altogether?"
You said it was too loud, so I assumed you didn't like it.
"The massage itself was excellent, though. If you can make it quieter, it'll be perfect."
But with the current design, the two are linked. You can't make it quieter without making the massage worse.
"Really? That's a shame. It was a promising concept."
You think so?
I think it was kinda counterproductive. How could you enjoy its raison d'être with all that noise?
You basically said it yourself. A massage is supposed to be relaxing, and you can't relax when it's THAT loud.
"So just fix the noise problem."
I told you! Doing that will only make the massage worse!
Even if the gain outweighs the loss, it completely deviates from my original vision!
And that's something I refuse to compromise on. What use is an invention that fails at what it was meant to do?
There is none. I know it feels like a waste, but it's best just to forget about it!
So she deems any invention that doesn't live up to her original vision as a failure.
This brilliant mind has standards too high for her own good, I suppose.
Hey... If you really want to see it again, I can show you where I left it in the depot.
Don't worry, it's still in one piece. Just because it's a failure doesn't mean I scrapped it or anything.
Da Vinci leads me to the depot, where her failed invention lies.
Her discarded creations extend as far as I can see from the entrance, big and small, stowed away in every corner.
This may be a pile of garbage to her, but to an average person like me, it's a treasure trove.
Look, Commander! It's the Self-Propelled Swooshy Piano I made ages ago! You can play it while making your way downtown!
Its problem was that it didn't sound so great when played in the open...
That, and playing a piano on the move isn't exactly safe, so here is where it rests now.
"You could just travel short distances with it, like indoors. You could do that with it right now, without changing anything."
"As for the safety issue, you could lay down a track. That way you can drive safely while still putting on a theatric performance."
Sure, you could do that...
But my original vision was a piano you could take outdoors and play anywhere, anytime!
Anything that deviates from that is a failure by definition!
Her definition of "failure" really leaves no room for compromise.
Shrugging and scanning my surroundings, I find the Stiffy Shoulder Massaginator resting on a shelf.
I'm telling you, it's a failure. Why do you want to keep it?
"One man's trash is another man's treasure."
Picking up the contraption, I turn on my heel and head back to my office.
(Why is the Commander so attached to it? It's obviously a failure...)
(One man's trash is another man's treasure, huh...)
(So the Commander thinks of it as treasure...)
(...Why am I thinking about this?)
(Am I that concerned about how the Commander views my inventions?)
(Weird... Just weird...)

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>5 Testing a Hypothesis</size>

scripts.say: The moment I give birth to an invention, it's out of my hands.
It's up to the user how they give it meaning.
That's simple. I've known that all along.
So I've never paid any mind to what others think of my inventions.
I'm always just inventing to turn every flash of inspiration into a real, tangible thing.
Even when I'm inventing something to solve others' problems, I'm still the one conceptualizing and designing it.
I'd always thought that, the instant an invention deviated from my concept, it became a failure.
That's how I've always rolled. The thought that I might be wrong never even occurred to me.
So why...
When the Commander treated my failures like they were treasures...
Why did my heart flutter?
I don't know... I can't make heads or tails of it.
That just means... it's time for an experiment!
Port - Office
Commander, I finished my secretary work for the day!
Just need you to look over these request forms for me.
Oh, but I've already checked them out, and they're good. All you really need to do is stamp and sign them.
(That's usually how this works. Why is she so emphatic about it this time? ...Something's up.)
I decide to read them more thoroughly this time.
Sure enough, one of the request forms mixed in is da Vinci's.
Ahaha... I should've guessed you'd figure me out, Commander.
Not that I was going to keep it from you forever. I was totally going to tell you all about it.

options.content: "As in, when you couldn't hide it any longer?"

scripts.say: I-I didn't mean it like that!
Ahem. There's no use hiding it anymore! You read the request form, didn't you?
What do you think? Personally, I think it stands up to scrutiny...
"'Da Vinci's Duds and Doodads Exhibition'? What is it?"
It's what it says on the tin! I want to show everyone all the failures I left in the depot!
Remember when you said that one inventor's failure might be one user's treasure?
Call this an experiment to test your hypothesis.
If you're right, then that means... I've been working under a serious misunderstanding.
Don't approve it for me; approve it for the sake of the Stiffy Shoulder Massaginator!
"How can I say no to that?"
(Not that I was planning to say no to begin with.)
(This exhibition could bring new life to the useful inventions that da Vinci judged as failures.)
(And maybe, if all goes well, it might change her perspective toward her failures.)
Thanks, Commander!
You'd better come and check it out!

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>6 The Duds and Doodads Exhibition</size>

scripts.say: After taking some time to prepare, the Da Vinci's Duds and Doodads Exhibition successfully begins.
Da Vinci's Duds and Doodads Exhibition... Just hearing the name lights a fire in my journalist soul!
Scenery-Spiffifying Telescope... Sure, it sounds okay for looking at the stars.
But what if I could use this during regular patrols...
What is this... One-Shot Anesthesia-Launching Wristwatch?!
It might not help in battle, but during exploration? Imagine the potential...!
A Fizzy-Cola Fountain Pen that uses cola instead of ink... Ooh! Maybe with this...
I could have cans of cola all over my desk, and nobody would complain!
Word spreads like wildfire, bringing droves of visitors to the exhibition.
(I'm glad I switched to a bigger venue like the Commander suggested...)
(To think, so many people came for my failures...)
Whoa... This place is packed...
(Sneaky... Stealthy...)
Hey, Torricelli! Thanks for coming!
O-oh, no problem...
(That sure didn't work out...)
Don't mind me... I'm just looking around. Actually, just forget I exist...
I'll leave as soon as I'm done...
Sure, sure. Send any comments, opinions, and questions later for me!
O-okay...
Even Torricelli came... If that doesn't show how successful this exhibition is, I don't know what would.
No, the number of visitors isn't what matters. I need to perform my experiment!
Time to go and ask for everyone's thoughts!
Like over there, near that crowd. I think that was where I'd put my Infinite Tissue Works invention.
The concept was just to output infinite tissues, but you have to refill it eventually. That defeats the point of it being "infinite," so I called it a failure and scrapped it.
But Suffolk didn't mind that limitation and said it was convenient. Everyone else agreed with her.
Why is that? Hmmm...
Let's keep looking around.
Da Vinci, this automatic pet feeder is magnificent!
...Automatic pet feeder?
Oh, you mean my failed Potato Chip Delivery Bot?
Whoa, is that what it's called?! My mistake!
Okay, so it's a machine that spits out potato chips automatically? That's cool, but I think you'd be able to use its features better as an automatic pet feeder!
Really...? Okay, then you should take it!
Can I really?! Much obliged, da Vinci!
No problem! ...Alright, back to scoping things out.
After some time...
Weird. I've gotten so many opinions from everyone, but...
None of them really shook my heart like before.
Maybe I really don't care that much about what other people think of my inventions.
If that's true, was I just imagining how I felt when the Commander said that?
Hmmngh... Oh, speak of the devil! Finally free from work, Commander?
Come over here!
Commander, I was waiting ages for you!
The moment I enter the venue, da Vinci appears out of nowhere and stops me.

options.content: "How did you know I was here?"

scripts.say: Sure is! I'm getting heaps of new and unique inspo!
Some people liked my failures, so I just donated them to whoever wanted them.
Heheh, how else? One of my inventions!
Whenever you enter a 500-meter radius, it reacts and even lets me track where you are!
"...You can do that?!"
Ahahaha! Did you really believe that?
I was just checking the security cameras, so I saw when you came in.
You're a little late, but it's less packed now that people are leaving, so maybe it's for the best.
I'll be your personal tour guide through what remains of the exhibition!
Da Vinci shows me around, introducing all of her strange and unusual failed inventions.
My eyes are drawn to a grey umbrella.
It's my Portable Rain's-Bane Fortress.
It can withstand rain AND winds up to fifty knots!
Say goodbye to getting wet on rainy days!
"It works that well? Doesn't sound like a failure to me..."
Weeell... I focused so much on the wind-resistant part that I ended up making it way too heavy to hold.
It can't fold shut, either, and the special coating on the canopy can't be printed on. It's stuck being a boring grey, on top of being unwieldy...
It's a failed invention, through and through.
"You may think so."
"But forget portability. Set it up on a park bench, or something, and it'll make a great shelter."
"The plain color also means it can blend in without disturbing the natural scenery of the park."
"Do you disagree?"
*gasp*
(There it is! That's the feeling of my heart fluttering again!)
Y-you might be right!
It's all yours, Commander. Try putting your hypothesis into practice!
(It's only the Commander's opinions that make me feel this way...)
(I still think that inventions that deviate from their concept are failures, but...)
(I can't neglect the new inspiration that transcends the original concept!)
(That inspiration... is my love for the Commander!)

sequence:
Your Dear Inventor

<size=45>7 Inspired by You</size>

scripts.say: Many days after the expedition...
*stare*...
(I can't help but notice da Vinci sneaking glances at me.)
No. That's not it.
Nah. I'm fine.
Why do you ask?
"Because you're staring."
I've been thinking up this really awesome invention for a while now.
Well, it's less of an invention, and more of an existing idea.
It's better called an improvement... Hmm, or a customization?
But no matter how much I rack my brain, I can't visualize its final form. It's getting on my nerves.
"I think I get the situation... though that doesn't explain why you were staring at me."
"Besides, if you want someone to help you implement an idea, I'd think Torricelli would be better."
It's you, not Torricelli!
"Come again?"
We'll call it... the Da Vinci Inspirifier!
Look at you, making the perfect invention when I wasn't even looking... You're a foxy one, Commander.
"I get it... Except, I don't actually get it at all."
It's okay! You don't have to understand!
Anyway, I'll be needing that Massaginator!
Without explaining a thing, da Vinci leaves with the massage device.
The next day...
Tadaaa! I fixed it up!
I call it the Stiffy Shoulder Massaginator Junior!
So, we did lose some of the massage functionality, buuut...
Da Vinci flips the switch. It turns on, but I don't hear the loud noise from before.
After the starting beep, there's so little noise that I can't even hear it unless I listen carefully for it.
Cool, right? I improved it based on your feedback.
Are you satisfied with this iteration?
Heheh! Glad to hear it!
Yeah... Really glad.
"I'm surprised you bothered to try again after you called the first Massaginator a failure."
The thing is... my way of thinking has undergone some changes.
"Because of everyone's feedback during the exhibition?"
Well, that helped, but...
Eureka! You had your own reasons for letting me hold the exhibition, didn't you?
You were hoping I'd see people complimenting my failures, and change my attitude toward them, right?
"You got me."
Heh. Your mistake for thinking you could hide anything from ol' da Vinci!
The moment I give birth to an invention, it's out of my hands.
It's up to the user how they give it meaning.
I can't change what other people think, and really, I don't think I care.
"In that case..."
Why did I revise this invention instead of moving on to a new one?
Isn't it obvious? I did it for you♪
Also, there's a reason that I decided to change my concept for once.
Do you know what I'm trying to say, Commander?
Da Vinci's eyes bear a glint of determination.
I did it all to make you happy, Commander!
In other words, your wishes were incorporated into the concept itself!
And I'm going to keep on doing that until I satisfy all of your needs!
Heheh. That look on your face tells me you already understand.
The existing idea I had my mind on...
The customized invention I made... Are the pieces coming together?
"They are. I think I get it now..."
The great Da Vinci Inspirifier, a device that inspires inventions for the sake of people you care about.
Its blueprint lies square in her heart.
Now, Commander, tell me all of your needs.
I'll invent whatever it takes to make you happy!
You helped Shiranui out at her store! Collect 100 Coins!
You found treasure buried in the sea around the port! Collect 1000 Coins!
You won a prize from a game at Akashi's store! Collect 2000 Coins!
You found materials wrapped in paper inside your storage! Collect 10 Oil!
You received supplies from a ship you sent on a commission! Collect 50 Oil!
You won first prize in an eating competition at the Canteen! Collect 100 Oil!
You discovered San Diego buried in the sand by the beach! Collect 5 Boiled Dumplings!
You found Shiratsuyu when she'd gotten lost! Collect 10 Boiled Dumplings!
Your act at a party was very well received! Collect 5 Royal Gourmet!
You gave a nifty item you found at the market to Shiranui! Collect 1 T3 Tech Box!
You attended daily training. Collect 5 Elite Cat Boxes!
You found a wooden chest floating in the water and opened it! Collect 1 T4 Tech Box!
You discovered Parts that had been washed ashore! Collect 2 T3 Parts!
You helped Washington adjust her equipment! Collect 8 T3 Parts!
You found one of the Base's 7 Wonders - the Strange Purple Being! Collect 20 T3 Parts!
You discovered Blueprints that nobody has claimed! Collect 3 Blueprints (4 ☆)!
You found a forgotten file of Blueprints! Collect 6 Blueprints (4 ☆)!
You achieved excellent results during naval training! Collect 10 Blueprints (4 ☆)!
You got the highest score on one of Amazon's tests! Collect 2 Blueprints (5 ☆)!
You hung out with Yuubari as she made improvements to new equipment! Collect 4 Blueprints (5 ☆)!
You found one of the Base's 7 Wonders - the Strange Golden Being! Collect 6 Blueprints (5 ☆)!
You found a souvenir while inspecting the docks! Collect 1 Quick Finisher!
Glowworm headbutted you from behind... Move forward 1 tile!
You got caught in a line of Fletchers... Move forward 2 tiles!
You saw Akagi and Taihou in a bad mood, so you ran away in panic... Move forward 3 tiles!

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>1 Bright and Bubbly</size>

scripts.say: Port—Office
Today, the new secretary ship is supposed to stop by.
If I remember correctly, she should be...
Yo, Commander, were you waiting for me? I'll be in charge of secretarial duties starting today!
Oh shoot... Should I have knocked first?
I was a bit surprised by this greeting, but I shrugged it off and told her it was fine.
Hahaha, I've already learned how to do a secretary's duties, so feel free to rely on me for just about everything~!
...Just as she said, Hornet went about doing tasks with just as much vigor as her greeting from earlier.
Even when she came across something she wasn't familiar with, once I taught her, she got it pretty quickly.
At this rate, we should be done with today's work in no time.
Haha, here's some mail! Commander, catch!
She didn't even wait for my response, a piece of paper soon flying across the room and landing on the floor.
Ah... Sorry, sorry. I thought you'd be able to catch it no problem.
Picking up the letter, she calmly handed it to me.
Nice!
Seeing me catch the letter she tossed at me, she gave me a thumbs up with a smile.
Whew... And that's a wrap to my first day as a secretary! Cheers, Commander~!

options.content: "You certainly lived up to your reputation as a Yorktown-class ship!"

scripts.say: I'm the youngest member of the Yorktown-class. I can't sully their honor, you know, hahaha~♪

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>2 Silent Friend</size>

scripts.say: Port—Office
Northampton, it's your turn, you know!
Yeah, I'm just thinking about what to do next...
Hornet and Northampton were playing a board game in the office.
How did this happen, you ask...?
By the way Commander, since we're just about done with work, want to play a game together?
I happened to invite my friend who's a bit quiet, but reliable~
Commander...? Anyone there? Stop zoning out, it's your turn!
There was Hornet, who had been lively since starting the game, and Northampton, who was deep in thought without letting out as much as a single peep.
After thinking for a moment, I skipped my turn.
Hehe~ So you thought pretty hard, didn't you. Well, then it's my turn! Let me move this here... and this piece over there... Done~!
Oh, I'm feeling a bit thirsty... I guess I'll go buy some drinks.
Northampton, you'll be having the usual right? What about you, Commander?
...Roger! I'll be back in a bit!
The moment Hornet left, silence fell over the office.
Um...
The one that broke the silence was Hornet's silent friend.
When Hornet said that you were going to show up, I thought it was a joke...
Hornet's currently on duty as the secretary ship, right...? Is she causing any trouble for you?
I told her how Hornet was handling her job at the office.
I see. I wonder if I was worrying over nothing.
Since she was here, I figured I'd ask Hornet's best friend, Northampton, about a few things.
Hornet is a bright and free soul. I don't know how accurate it is, but my mental image of her is that of a cowboy.

But I wonder if she's really fine. Isn't she concerned with her place among her sisters? ...I don't really know how to phrase this properly, but it might be related to her pride, or be some kind of complex...
Speaking of sisters... she did talk about not wanting to sully their honor.
I should ask what the person in question thinks when I have the chance.
I'm back! Pretty quick, wasn't I~?
Here, have a sip~ and then it's right back to the game!

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>3 The Topic of Sisters</size>

scripts.say: Port—Office
Once we finish putting this together, we'll be done... Mm~
Commander, I'm done on this side! How are you doing?
Yay~ Another day's work, completed!
Hmm... but it's a bit early to be excited... and it's no good for a secretary ship to be wandering about outside on a weekday... I wonder what I should do...
Commander, would you like to chat for a bit? How about our interests? That should make working together a lot easier.
She wants to chat, huh... What should we talk about...
Then, how about talking about my distinguished sisters in the Yorktown class?
Don't worry, I get it. I know that you've been pretty interested in Yorktown and Enty.
...I'd be lying if I denied it...
Hehe, I hit the bullseye, didn't I~
Hehehe, there's no need to be embarrassed. It's understandable to be taken in by my sisters.
So, which one are you interested in the most, Commander? As the youngest sister, I'm willing to provide you with some special insider info~
Yorktown, huh... She's the gentlest one out of us all.
But from time to time, she has a pained expression... and even I'm not sure of the reason why...
Commander, I hope you're able to make her smi... err, happy!
Going after Enty... You've got discerning eyes, Commander.
Having an aura that radiates strength, but not haughty. Always willing to do her best, and respected not only by the other ships in the Union but also by her rivals...
Well, she does push herself too hard at times... Do something about that side of her first, and then we can talk!
Hornet, huh... Let's see...
Wait a second, Hornet? You're talking about me!
Heh~♪ Unfortunately for you, information about the great Hornet is off limits~
Ehehe, is there anything else you were curious about? I'm willing to talk about anything I know about.
"I'm curious how you feel about your sisters."
Well, they're my dear sisters who I respect, but from time to time, I do get jealous of them.
Especially since Enty is unbelievably famous, and I've become famous by association.
I get called "Enterprise's sister" a lot... It sure is hard having a sister that famous, you know.
For just a moment, I was able to see the discontent that lay underneath her normally bubbly exterior.

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>4 The Appearance of a Rival?!</size>

scripts.say: Port—Office
Commander, it's terrible!
A flustered Hornet came flying into the office.
Gasp... You see...
The Commander and I are both on extended vacation, and I'm not scheduled to participate in any practice exercises! Hehehe, that means it's time to play to my heart's content~!
Hey, the Union ship over there! If I remember correctly, you're Enterprise's sister... the Yorktown class's... Hornet!
Yes? You're... the Sakura Empire's Zuikaku?
Perfect timing! Do you know where that "Grey Ghost"... basically, I was looking for your sister. Do you know where she is?
Oh, Enterprise should be out on an emergency commission. She'll be back tomorrow night.
Is that so... We were planning on having a bout today... I guess it'll have to wait for next time...
Hehe, if you're looking for a practice partner, I'm here, you know? I'm free for the next few days anyway, I don't mind sparring with you!
Is what I said in the heat of the moment... but I didn't think she would actually take me up on the offer.
It seems that she's due for a 1-on-1 exercise... and she wants to know if there's a practice area that's free to use.
That's part of it, but, what's more important is that...
Are you worried... that you might lose?
No! There's nothing bad about losing during practice, and I'm usually not one who cares about winning or losing anyway...
And I've always wanted to take on the Sakura Empire's Zuikaku as well...
But even so! I'm going in place of Enterprise.
If I were to lose... nothing good would come from that...
So, Commander! Please give me some advice for how to win!
Ehehe, I knew you'd be up to help me!
I'm closer to you since I'm currently the secretary ship, so I'm first in line! Please, Commander!

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>5 Enty's Sister</size>

scripts.say: Port—Office, Nighttime
I see... Hornet is set to spar with Zuikaku in my place.
Well, it's not exactly in my place. We both fight differently, and if Zuikaku didn't accept her on her own merits, she wouldn't be sparring with her in the first place.
But even so, Hornet's worrying to that degree... Hm...
Yeah, I know. Leave the training to me.
Practice Area—Noon, the Following Day
E-Enty?! Weren't you supposed to come back tonight?!
I hurried back as soon as I heard you were sparring with Zuikaku.
Even if you hurried back, I can't believe you'd be back half a day early... You're amazing as always, Enty...
Oh. If you're back, you should spar with Zuikaku yourself—
No. You're the one who's supposed to be sparring with her today. And since she's accepted your invitation, it'd be rude to change at the last minute.
And since I rushed back here, I'd like to rest for a bit as well, haha.
Enty...
The Commander's advice to you was "special training." Well, let's get on with it then.
Zuikaku's the type who won't take any opponent lightly. Unless you focus, you're going to be tuckered out for the rest of your vacation.
...Got it, Enty!
Whew, it's already this late...
Zuikaku might be strong, but you're probably so much stronger! With these measures under my belt, tomorrow should be a piece of cake.
You shouldn't underestimate your opponent. She's probably preparing for the bout tomorrow just as you are right now.
You might start off strong with these measures, but you'll need to adapt to the battle with your own strength to close it out.
That should be it for now. I'll be in the dormitory, waiting to hear good news from you.
Yeah! Make sure to get some rest!
After seeing Enterprise off, Hornet stared off into the horizon.
Sigh... I went through so much special training today. I just hope it sticks...
In the end, I had to rely on Enty...
With a bitter smile on her face, Hornet lowered her head and pulled her hat down to hide her face.
And, as if she remembered something, she raised her head and turned to look behind her.
The reason Enty came back early has to be because I talked to the Commander about my bout with Zuikaku, right?
I wonder what the special training the Commander had in mind was...
She looked as if she was thinking that in the end, she was only Enterprise's replacement.
It was an expression I was seeing for the first time since having come to know her.
My advice for Hornet, who was troubled by the weight of being called Enterprise's sister, was...
It looked as if there was nothing to do but to tell her directly.

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>6 Be Yourself</size>

scripts.say: Next day at the Practice Area
The practice area at the port. After a few exercises, Hornet and Zuikaku stood there, waiting.
And soon, the signal flare signifying the start of the match was shot up.
Immediately, the two began to move. The practice had started.
Haa... Haa... She really is a tough cookie to beat...!
Looks like you've got a grasp of the things Enterprise has taught you. It seems you've trained hard for this tday!
But, the same goes for me! I've trained hard so that I can beat you, and the Grey Ghost herself!
Just as Enterprise had predicted, Hornet had the upper hand early on, but as Zuikaku adapted to the battle, Hornet was slowly being driven into a corner.
Did you really think you could beat me by just copying Enterprise's fighting style?
Hmph... If you think I'm just copying Enty, you're sorely mistaken...!
Of course there are parts I've copied, trying to catch up to her...
But I'm not just copying her while following in her footsteps! I'm my own person! I'm the youngest of the Yorktown-class, the dashing, brilliant Hornet!
...That's the spirit! Now, show me what you're made of!
After deploying her main air force, Hornet sped directly toward Zuikaku.
No matter how many times you try the same trick, you won't succeed!
Lightning. Dodging Zuikaku's attack by a hair's breadth, Hornet instantly changed her stance and slipped into Zuikaku's reach...
Wh...at?!
Wow!!
Hornet, who managed to score a direct hit on Zuikaku, ended the practice just like that.
Ahaha~ I did it! What a success!
"Pretend to copy Enty's tricks, and then mix things up."
That's why you had me train with Enty...
It just might work on her, seeing how obsessed she is with my sister...
I see... You didn't have Enty train me just because I was her sister...
"Copying your sister isn't bad, but don't just copy her. Use her power as a basis for your own skills and show off your own strength."
I see.. You should've told me earlier! Even if you're the type to speak in a roundabout way like that, I'm not!
I might have been a bit down earlier, but pretend you didn't see anything! You didn't, right? Ugh... This is so embarrassing!
Pretending to use Enterprise's tricks to fool me... I guess I lost because I was too focused on them.
You got me good. You got the best of me with that move.
But this isn't the end! I won't fall for such a trick twice!
Really now~ Maybe when you can distinguish between my original moves and my sister's...!
What did you say?!
That's a fighting style that only I have the privilege of being able to pull off, as Enty's sister. Hehehe~ Isn't that neat?
Then, until we can fight with our strength instead of relying on tricks! Now, come at me, Hornet!
Yep, just what I wanted!
Hornet and Zuikaku continued to spar...

sequence:
Duelling Sunshine!

<size=45>7 I Love You!</size>

scripts.say: The day after Hornet and Zuikaku's bout...
Commander! You're free, right? Let's go on a date!
Huh?!
Oh, I was being a bit too loud, sorry...
