<size=45>Chapter 5: The Truth, Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Gneisenau's Room
I somehow managed to drag Deutschland out of her room and decided to ask her Iron Blood comrades about the situation.
I had a feeling this would happen eventually, and it seems my hunch was correct.
I'm sorry, Deutschland. But please believe me when I say nobody meant to hurt you.
You expect me to believe that?
Oh, right... You don't know the story behind all this, Commander.
That being the case, I'll call over the girls relevant to this discussion and tell them about this. You and Deutschland can sit in the next room over and listen.
Port - Dormitory Salon
Thank you for coming, Eugen, Spee, Tirpitz, and Z1. I have something to tell you.
It's about... Deutschland, isn't it?
Correct. A long time ago, we all entered an agreement to go along with her egotistic tendencies so she could live a happy life.
I'm sure you all remember this, yes?
They what?! I can't just sit here and listen to this...!

options.content: Hold Deutschland back before she storms out of the room.

scripts.say: Let go of me!
... She bit my arm.
Stop it, you insubordinate, lowly animal...!
Mrgh... Gah...!
Yeah, I remember that... I've grown used to her attitude by now, so I don't really need to be bound by that agreement anymore.
I know it's for her sake, but it's a fact that what we've done isn't right.
Indeed. It's also caused trouble for other people. Furthermore, Deutschland knows about it now, and she feels really hurt by it.
That is why I've called you here - so we can discuss what to do next.
They'll just keep making a fool of me. I know they will.
(Whispering) Slave... what should I do...?

sequence:
The Cloudy Mask

<size=45>Chapter 6: The Truth, Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: It's all because of that name... "Lützow."
Indeed. I don't know how it came to be, but she isn't just Deutschland of the Iron Blood, she was also born as Lützow of the Northern Parliament.
Huh?! How do they know that...?!
And not the Lützow who fought in the Great War, the one the Northern Parliament refloated...
Her history haunts her. So she tried desperately to make herself out as the ideal image of Iron Blood so we'd accept her.
... Why would she bring this up now...
Sure, she had a thing with the Northern Parliament, but she's still Deutschland. She's one of us.
And we wanted to make her feel like a part of the team, but since she's kinda sensitive, we agreed to be nice to her.
So basically, they were simply doing their best not to hurt or upset her.
Which is why we kept this a secret from her and accepted her into the Iron Blood.
That's right. Above all else, she is one of us. But ironically, all our cautiousness and special treatment wound up hurting her in the end...
I think she's fine the way she is right now... but I guess she should come to terms with herself, at least a little.
It might leave her feeling blue for a while, but maybe we should tell her the truth?
I say we do. It's a shame to lose the arrogant Deutschland we know, but it's time she accepts herself for who she is.
So... they pretty much admit they lied to me...
Deutschland whispers while her shoulders tremble. Her voice lacks its signature impactful tone, instead sounding frail.
... Slave, let me go.
In conclusion, we should tell Deutschland the truth.
But how do we go about telling her that...
We don't need to do anything. Right, Gneisenau?
I let go of Deutschland. She walks over to open the door, then steps into the salon.
... Ah, so you knew she was listening, Eugen.
Heheh, of course I knew. So, what do you plan to do with us, Deutschland?
After a brief silence, the girl raises her voice and speaks her mind.
You will pay dearly for deceiving me for so long.
But... I also want to say...
Thank you... for accepting me.

sequence:
The Cloudy Mask

<size=45>Chapter 7: Some Things Never Change</size>

scripts.say: It's been some time after the truth about Deutschland came to light...
Port - Exercise Area
Aaaand I win again! Hah!
Ready to accept your loss yet, Deutschland?
Grr... No! It's not over yet!
Hah, that's the spirit! Your gear is one thing, but what you need is experience. And if you wanna scuffle with the best, you'll have to train like the rest!
Tsk! I know that, stop repeating it!
Port - Office
Here, slave. This is how you write a formal document, right?
There are a few minor errors here and there, but I can clearly see she worked hard to make it.
Tsk. Why should I accept the praises of a miserable slave...
But, I suppose if it's error-free, that's fine.
Port - Plaza
Do you have another name, Deutschland?
... I do. My other name is "Lützow."
That sounds cool! Can I call you that?
But Mikazuki, I think she doesn't wanna be called that...
Hmph, address me however you want.
Regardless of what people call me, I will always be me.
Some time after the truth came to light, Deutschland went back to her normal self.
But once you talk to her for a while, you'll be surprised by how honest with herself and mature she's now become.
I know that look on your face! It's got "Wow, you're so much more honest with yourself" written all over it!
Either that, or your depraved animal mind is having lecherous thoughts again!
Listen, slave! Your duty is to serve me, and you must work hard to be worthy of it!
One thing hasn't changed, though: she still treats me like her slave...
So stop staring into space and play a game with me! I order you to amuse me~
But I guess that's fine.

sequence: <size=51>「The dreamwaker sees the light of the Dawning Ceremony...」</size>
<size=51>「...Crimson-dyed intrigue. Otherworldly explosions. The house of faith, sundered by a charred blade.」</size>
<size=51>「The dreamwaker sees her valiant comrades, stemming back the tides of chaos to complete the ceremony.」</size>
<size=51>「At last, drifting within the vast sea between worlds, the dreamwaker stirs.」</size>

scripts.say: Long has this one watched the world from a distance, only now given an opportunity to touch it. But...
Diffuse are the expectations of mankind, and frail is the crystallization of their beliefs.
Such a thing should never have come to pass...
Has the trajectory of fate been thrown into disarray... or is this its true alignment?
But alas, these things are no longer important... What matter is not this one's body, but rather the future of the Sakura Empire.
In this world, the Great Fox's tree withers, the Diadem burns, and the crimson shadow heralds the coming of destruction.
And the realm of dreams... cracks before the harbinger of crimson and black.
What this one sees is finality... the sign of an inevitable fate yet to come.
But even the powerless... should at least try to save what is important to them...
Even if the tides of calamity cannot be averted... should this one combine visions of the "truth" with her powers...
No matter how small, how ephemeral, this fleeting sliver of a dream may be...
If they are slowly pieced together, then surely...
Her eyes opened, and a familiar scenery spread out before her. Upon the ceremonial site of the Diadem of Light she stood.
"My head hurts... Was that... a dream...?"
Lady Shinano...?! You're finally awake!!!
(...Did I not awake long ago? What is there to be so surprised... about...)
"Kasumi, what date is it?"
Ah, um... We're currently in the middle of the ritual, and Watatsumi is about to be brought forth...
"The ritual... That means that Nagato, Mikasa, and Akagi are all here...?"
Um... Lady Nagato does not seem to be here... Um, yes, Foo said the same thing.
(That... can't be right, can it...?)
——KABOOM!!
Watch out, Lady Shinano!!
(...An airstrike? Isn't the ceremony still in progress?)
Ah, um! Lady Shinano, I was so excited to see that you had awakened that... Um, I forgot to explain...
Um, so, the Sirens covered the entire island with a Mirror Sea and has been launching attacks at us. We've been caught completely off guard.
But... Lady Akagi and Mikasa should have taken care of all the enemies, so... where did that attack come from...?
It's still too dangerous to go outside, though. Foo said that it's better to wait here until we can get a battle report... Um, Lady Shinano?!
In the night, gossamer sheets of blue silk fluttered towards the flames burning upon the ocean's surface.
(...They're going to take Watatsumi... No, their goal is to destroy it...)
(...The one who goes by "Ember"...)
L-Lady Shinano?!
(Kashino... Chitose, and Chiyoda...? My dreams did not show them as being present at the ritual...)
(Has reality began to bleed into the Dreamworld?)
"What are you doing here?"
We originally came to deliver supplies for the ceremony, but we didn't expect to get attacked by Sirens before we left...
Yeah, and just as soon as we managed to mop up the Sirens, a brand new enemy showed up!
I have no idea if it's some new Siren weapon, but it looks different than anything we've faced before...
The others are trying to hold them back, but enemies keep pouring at us...
"Will you return to lend them your aid...?"
Um, Lady Shinano, there appears to be some misunderstanding. We didn't retreat from the front lines.
Mikasa surmised that the enemy's objective was to completely sever the ceremony by destroying Watatsumi, so we were ordered to take Watatsumi to a safe place.
(If Ember is interested in Watatsumi, the sacred relic of the Sakura Empire... then what is the nature of my existence...?)
"...This one shall hold back the enemy. See to it that Watatsumi is kept safe."
Very well. Good luck, Lady Shinano.
Huh? Lady Shinano herself is going to fight by herself...?
Hehe, now we'll be able to turn the tides! Lady Shinano, show our enemies the power of the Sakura Empire's mightiest carrier~!
"...Very well."
Damn it... Is this the best we can do...?!
What the hell is this power...?!
I'm so sorry... Lady Shinano...
Mass-produced battleships... sundered in but a single slash. Coastal installations, ruined in one shot. Destroyers, light cruisers, light carriers... Nothing could withstand even a single blow.
This could not even be called a battle. Yet, the last, fragile line of defense still clung on.
We can't even lay a finger on the enemy... Mikasa, we're going to get annihilated at this rate!
Hang on... just a bit longer! Shoukaku, has there been any response to our request for aid?
The support fleet is on its way, but it'll take some time before they can reach us all the way out here!
Judging from our current situation, I hope it'll be enough... All we can do is continue to stall for time.
Akagi, do you have any ideas?
...Akagi?
*cough*... Now you've done it... I'll have to use this!
Behold, ye cruel gods... this is the power of my love! I shall bring ruin to everything!!
...Out of my way.
Akagi! Watch out!!
Immense powers collided, and the resultant burst of light engulfed both assailant and protector alike.
Despite the assailant's tremendous power, she fell to her knees, and the battle was decided.
Mi...kasa?
*cough* *cough*... Damn, I'm not as limber as I used to be...
...Akagi?
What's wrong—?
Aha... Ahaha.... AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!
Even now, are you just going to watch us from the sidelines? Shinano!!
Akagi turned around. Floating above her palm was a black box, glowing with a sinister light.
The manifestation of humanity's dreams and hopes, the Wisdom Cube... But there are special ones among them.
Instead of squandering such power on the likes of you...
Akagi... What are you saying...?
Even should this body sink to the bottom of the seas... or be forever wreathed in flames... I... I...
I won't permit... anyone... to get in the way of my love!!
(That black light... that black box...... Is calamity itself...)
"Akagi... Stop..."
...So you finally decided to show up, Shinano.
Shinano?! Milady, you've finally awakened?!
"Akagi, what you hold in your hand is calamity itself. The Sakura Empire has no need for such dark power... You must discard it."
Ahahaha!! ...Even you're trying to lecture me? You've been hiding away all this time, sleeping away in your safe haven. What do you know?!
"...It was not this one's decision to slumber while the world burned."
(...Akagi thinks more of the Sakura Empire than anyone else...)
(...Yet this great passion also spawns great danger...)
(Watching peril befall the Sakura Empire from within the empty void, powerless to stop it... Such was not my desire...)
(Do I have the ability to stop Akagi...?)
(But alas... all I have are these... fragments...)
(....The light that comes to return all to the void... This fragment will come to an end soon...)
(I awoke because of my desire to save the Sakura Empire and my comrades...)
(...from the dream of ruination that I saw—)
(I can hear the sound of the waves... But the ocean...)
(...stings with the stench of rust, and the frigid wind bites at my skin... This nightmare...)
(...nay, this world, is unlike any I have known...)
Shinano, we're about to assemble.
Woah, is that the entire fleet that's going to participate in this operation?
Yes, every last bit of the Sakura Empire's naval power. A might this world has never seen.
But not just us. The Eagle Union, the Royal Navy, and the Iron Blood have all joined forces.
The decisive battle is upon is... Hopefully it is enough to turn this situation around.
Yeah, that's what Lady Shinano foresaw in her dreams. Isn't that right?
Hmm? What's the matter, Lady Shinano?
Well, we've been fighting all the way here. It'd be weirder if she wasn't a bit tired after all that.
Yeah, don't worry 'bout it! Things will turn around after this battle, so let's give it one last push!
Let's not keep the Eagle Union waiting!
"Your rigging is damaged... Can it not be repaired anymore...?"
That's the way it is. We're out of materials, so there's nothing we can do about it.
I've given it some elbow grease, but I'll just have to make do.
(...Their rigging is worn, weathered. As if they haven't been repaired for ages... Just what is going on...?)
Chitose!!
Chiyoda, thank goodness you're safe... You should go resupply right now.
Supplies are finally here?! It's about damn time!
Did the other fleets have to fight their way here like we did?
Yeah, same situation all around. Just as our intel suggested, most of this area has fallen under the enemy's control.
Is that... our trump card over there?
Equipment infused with the technology of the Northern Parliament. Those transport ships are carrying the special cores.
(The munition ships... are our trump card...?)
Pretty impressive, isn't it? But that's nothing compared to the secret weapon that Kashino brought us, powered by Watatsumi.
If I remember properly, Lady Shinano was one of the architects behind this plan.
"...Indeed..."
(A weapon...? Made from Watatsumi...?)
(Wisdom cubes, the vessels that collect and shape thought... combined with cognitive chips to empower this body...)
(What makes me... any different from that weapon?)
BEEP————
This is Enterprise. It's time to begin the operation. Is the Sakura Empire fleet ready?
We've finished assembling our forces. Now, we're just making some final adjustments to our equipment. How about on your end?
Our task forces have been proceeding relatively smoothly. We haven't seen any enemy movements in the target area.
Excellent. If our plan succeeds, we may be able to crush the enemy in one fell swoop.
Let's hurry up and start already! I'm itching for a fight!
Hehe, Yuudachi's all fired up today. Guess I can't afford to fall behind either~
Enterprise, are we missing anybody?
No, but Antiochus has not rallied their forces yet.
Strange. How unlike them to drop the ball at a time like this.
In any case, they're just a reserve force. It should be fine as long as they can catch up later.
Let's finalize our plans then. Shinano, you're in charge over here.
(Anti... ochus... Who...?)
Ready to assist at any time.
Good. Sakura Empire fleet, the operation begins now! Set sail!
We haven't encountered a whole lot of enemies so far.
We're near the middle of the fleet formation. Even if enemies tried to approach us, the other squads will make quick work of them.
...Don't get cocky. You never know when the enemy may strike, or where they'll attack from.
Duh. It's not like this is my first time fighting~
Mm... I'm a little nervous, but I'm sure we'll be fine!
Yeah. It's fine to be vigilant, but don't let your nerves get the better of you.
Would you like some herbal tea? ...Unfortunately, there's not much of a selection left...
That'd be great! How about you, Lady Shinano?
"...Indeed. That sounds lovely..."
Voices ring out across the water. They are all trying to drown out the sense of anxiety and urgency from the imminent decisive battle.
The enemy vanguard fleet is approaching.
I've lost contact with several of the Eagle Union fleets. Trying to confirm the situation.
Stay alert, and don't let your guard down.
Do you feel that? It's giving me the chills... The enemy's main fleet will be coming soon.
"...A Mirror Sea..."
What the heck is a Mirror-C?
Is that what you're talking about? We occasionally spot strange weather phenomena right before these enemies appear.
Ohh, so that's what you mean by Mirror Sea, huh?
(...This "enemy"... Is it not the Sirens?)
(Then... who is this "Antiochus?" Could it be...)
Damn... I've completely lost contact with the Eagle Union fleet.
Shit... Forget about the Eagle Union, we're even losing contact with our own perimeter fleets one after another!
"...We still haven't even reached... the enemy's main fleet..."
Seems like it. We've been fighting off their recon forces, but their main fleet is still further ahead.
But you'd never know it based upon how big these fleets are...
"...It's as if they're trying to burn us out..."
...As long we keep things under control, we won't burn out.
"...Indeed. Those who burn out will become but embers and ash..."
...No. We will not. Even if we burn out, we must continue to protect the light of humanity.
Takao...
Be it through the flames of my cannon or the light of hope, I shall illuminate the darkness! Even if I burn through my life, I refuse to become dying embers in the wind!
(Ember... and Ash...?)
(...Could this dream be... of their creation...?)
Lady Shinano, I'm entrusting you with activating our "trump card" when the time comes.
"......Very well."
The enemy swelled like the tide itself.
(These dreams... are not clearly revealing everything to me...)
(All I know is their strength... and this abject terror...)
She saw the Leviathan that transcended the very oceans. From its wake grew a calamitous storm that could overwhelm all existence on this planet.
(This is... the enemy...?)
She saw a colossus that could rend the sky, its body rippling like a crucible of cold steel, grinding the land into nothingness.
Lady Shinano! The escort fleet has been breached!
No way...! How'd the enemy get over here?!
They're aiming for Watatsumi! Lady Shinano, prepare yourself...!
(My duty... is to protect the Sakura Empire... and all her peoples!)
(Nay... It is not just my duty... It is my conviction...)
(I shall fight... Until my soul is spent...!)
Diadem of Light
No... I can't approve of this plan.
But, this decision was made by the leadership. And besides, even Lady Shinano isn't opposed to it.
Indeed. ..Now that this one has awakened, it is only natural to attend to the affairs of the main island.
That isn't the issue. Lady Shinano just woke up from a deep slumber and isn't fully aware of everything that has happened in the outside world...
Hurriedly setting sail in this state, while leaving us devoted retainers behind on the island... is simply incomprehensible.
Nay... This one has seen... Both the state of this world, and the internal affairs of the Sakura Empire.
Besides, didn't the leadership specifically dispatch a fleet to escort Lady Shinano? I think you're worrying too much.
Kii is the leader of the fleet. Despite her rather, uh... strong will, rest assured that her strength is first-class.
But, but... Forget it, I've made up my mind! This time, I'll accompany Lady Shinano.
What?!
...We'll have to request permission to change our deployment formation. I don't think there's going to be enough time for that.
If Lady Shinano gives us her blessings, we can act first and apologize later. Surely there won't be an issue with that!
...Nnh... Hmm... If you insist...
This one shall accept your offer...
Thank you, Lady Shinano!
(knock, knock)

This is an Arbiter? She's a lot shabbier than what I imagined.
How would you like to die? Crushed by waves, or drowned by storms?
Woahh, why don't we put that menacing aura away? Real dangerous fella we've got here.

The primary points of interest are "Code G" and "Ember." Our purpose is to reduce confounding variables within the experiment site and to increase calculation accuracy. Avoid excess noise in the data.
Observation is impossible without knowing the time and space due to delicate nature of energy fluctuations.
In other words, they won't be able to see our footprints even if we go back and forth on this timeline?
Spooky.
Arbiters function on a different program from ours, and "Zero" is on a lower-level program, so there's no need to share information among all of us.
They are almost exclusively concerned with "Code G," which means they probably won't interfere with us.
Basically, we can let the Arbiters handle the crappy jobs, and run whatever experiments we'd like? Ahahaha!
(Why does Zero prohibit observers from exchanging information across multiple timelines? ...After all, I'm sure Zero is investing a lot of resources here.)
(More and more uncertainties appear in this timeline. And then, there is the "Commander.")
(At long last... the Creator and Magister may get to see their vision come to fruition. Ahahaha!)
(Did I... fall asleep...?) "Others... approach..."
Lady Shinano, is your perception so keen even when you're asleep? Indeed, there's another Sakura Empire fleet in front of us.
Let me confirm! It seems to be the munition ship, Kashino, being escorted back to the main island by Chitose and Chiyoda's group.
"Munition ship... Kashino..."
Hmm... I don't remember hearing anything about a transport operation. It's unusual that a munition ship would be sailing with a sortieing fleet.
I wonder what she's carrying with her!
Kashino's been in charge of carrying stuff for Yamato-class guns, right? I know there weren't any Yamato-class ships planned after Lady Shinano, but do you think that...
Curiosity kills the cat, Kumano. Weren't you specifically prohibited from talking about this stuff?
Suzutsuki is right. It seems that Zuikaku and Shoukaku learned something that put them at odds with Akagi. I remember how thick the tension was between them at the last festival...
Spooky, spooky... Guess I really should leave this stuff alone~
But, at least we're headed in the same direction. If we work together, we'll all be safer along the way.
Will you order them to join us, Lady Shinano?
(Does such a weakly individual as myself truly deserve to be surrounded by so many retainers...?)
"...They have a much more important duty to accomplish than escorting one such as myself."
"It would be best to not force the convergence of different commands."
Yeah, exactly! ...Hey, Suzutsuki, the heck is she talking about...?
I think she's trying to say that because our missions are different, there's no need for them to accompany us.
So, we're gonna pass each other by then?
Kii, we're receiving an incoming communication from the other fleet. Will you respond?
Sure, put me through. Even if we're not working together, we at least shouldn't forget common courtesy on the high seas as fellow members of the Sakura Empire.
This is Chitose. We are currently carrying out a transport mission to the main island. It's a pleasure to see you.
This is Kii, also currently on the back to the main island. We appreciate your hard work in escorting our transport ships.
There's an aircraft carrier among their formation... Eh?! Is that Lady Shinano?!
Woahh! How lucky, are we witnessing Lady Shinano's maiden voyage?!
"Long has it been since we last met... It is good to see you all..."
Since we last...? Have we met before, Lady Shinano?
"Nay, those events... were not of this world... This would be our first meeting."
Hehe, this would be my first time seeing you awake! Pleased to meet you, Lady Shinano. I am Kashino, munition ship, currently carrying out a transport mission.
By the way, I heard you just awakened not long ago? Do you feel alright? Is there anything you're having trouble with?
"Just now... This one felt a flicker of strength from within... Kashino, thank you for your contribution to this one's rebirth."
Hehe~ It's all part of my job. No need to thank me.
In any case, Lady Shinano, we won't delay you any further. It is an honor to meet you, and I hope that the rest of your journey is smooth.
Mm... May the gods watch over you and ferry you safely to your destination.
...Watch out, everyone. I see enemies!
That sudden disturbance... We've already entered a Mirror Sea.
How can that be?! It's been ages since Sirens have entered these waters, and besides, Chiyoda and Chitose passed through a moment ago without any issues!!
By the looks of things, were they waiting for us... We've been ambushed!
The Sirens must be after... Lady Shinano, the Sirens will surely be targeting you! Please do not leave my side!
"...Very well. This one shall do whatever she can."
Those bastards! They're trying to take advantage of Lady Shinano when she's most vulnerable...!
Don't let their little plan succeed. Enter battle formation around Lady Shinano and prepare to engage!
Be careful! A huge enemy fleet is appearing in front of us!
Damnit, there are "huge fleets" coming at us any direction you look!
No, I mean, this one's even bigger than the rest! I'm also picking up their leader here, and it seems to be Tester!
You managed to locate Tester? Good work.
But damn... we're not exactly in the best condition to take a head-on fight against Tester in a Mirror Sea...
First and foremost, defend Lady Shinano with your life, and try to find a way out of here!
Things aren't looking good...! Kii, let me break out of the Mirror Sea alone. Chitose's fleet can't have gone far! I'll find them and have them turn back!
We're also not far from the Diadem of Light. If you can send out an SOS signal, the fleet there can also come to our aid!
No! There's too many of them! You won't be able to make it out alone!
Besides, we haven't located the way out yet. Even if you can stave off the enemies for a while, how are you going to get back to us?
But...!
They haven't made their move yet, but based upon their numbers, Tester doesn't plan to let us leave without a fight.
We only have one option. We're going to have to focus all our attacks on a single point! If we can break Tester's command module, we'll be able to create an opening to get out of here!
Going straight for the jugular, huh? Hmm... If it's just Tester, we might be able to pull it off with our numbers... But throw in some escorts, and we've got a problem on our hands.
"Focus on the escort fleet...... This one... shall take care of Tester."
Wait, but, Lady Shinano... Your powers haven't come back yet...
"...Worry not. This one has her own methods."
(Many times has this one fought them within the Nightmare. Even in this state... victory is possible...)
(Through all those sad and cruel dreams... To protect the Sakura Empire, to bring glory and hope to her people... has always been the unyielding purpose of this one's life.)
...I understand. Fight to your heart's content then, Lady Shinano. We shall clear the way forward for you!
"Why... This body should be capable of so much more...!"
How dull... Is this really all that the mighty "Shinano" is capable of?
Converted Yamato-class hull, armored aircraft carrier Shinano. You were built to represent the hope of the Sakura Empire, but your actual performance...
"Tester... This one has faced you countless times..."
Is that so? That was supposed to be my line.
Real experiments require reliable data, rigorous modeling, and a large amount of calculations. What you rely upon is nothing but a fantasy.
Lady Shinano, you're overextending! Get back into formation, quickly!
(Nay... This is the correct way. Only this way will Tester let her guard down and reveal her vulnerability!)
Hm? Is this what you're aiming for?
I've confirmed that Tester's main battery has been damaged, and her attack frequency has decreased!
(Next, the energy supply module... If I remember properly...)
KABOOM——!!
(Submarines?! Impossible... When did they... Where...)
Reenactment concluded. I'm glad you came here, Shinano, but know this. Your actions alone will never change the fate of the Sakura Empire.
...Data entry complete. And upon this timeline... nothing will change.
(What... It can't be... I...)
(I saw the dreams many times... what was going to happen... I had awoken...)
(How could this life amount to so little...)
(This fate... is too cruel.........)

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>Crisis Looms</size>

scripts.say: Library
This afternoon, the library was so quiet that one could practically hear dust settling.
Just as I was about to put down my heavy planning materials and take a break, I noticed an unexpected figure by a bookshelf.
Hmm...
Ting An furrowed her brow at a particularly thick book. Beside her was a stack of books almost half her height.
Beyond the Fissure: Why the Commercial Behemoth Sunk...?
I'm surprised that you're interested in that.
C-Commander?! Why are you here?
I ran into some problems planning the port's new commercial development zone, so I came to learn more.
And yourself? You look awfully tense.

options.content: Have you found yourself facing a business rival?

scripts.say: Have you found yourself facing a business rival?
No, no, I'm just confronting some personal difficulties.
Something troubling you? Or maybe you're just a little tired?
I'm not tired... I just have a personal problem.
I hope this doesn't sound arrogant...
But as you know, I've been very successful in the fields of commerce and investing. That only worries me more.
Worries you how?
Well, they often say that comfort breeds complacency.
I've always been secure in my finances. That in itself may be the greatest risk of all.
I get it. You're here to study how others have failed.
Precisely! In this moment of weakness, I believe that knowing how to avoid failure is more valuable than pursuing further success.
What have you learned?
Quite a bit! For example, a film studio had discovered a disruptive digital technology. Instead of utilizing it, they shelved it in order to protect their outdated film business.
With her eyes focused, she traces her fingertips over a chart in her book.
Some people call this phenomenon the innovator's dilemma. Past successes can become the greatest hindrance to embracing the future.
Like empiricists in military fields.
Yes, those are included among the case studies I've read. But... The more I read, the stranger it seems.
Whether it's about business giants or rising tech startups, they all read to me as mere accident reports of others.
Perhaps book knowledge isn't enough. I need more tangible experience.
Such as?
Such as... directly observing struggling or failed businesspeople? That would hardly be polite, though.
I happen to have business in the commercial district tomorrow. Wanna come with me? New shops constantly come and go, so I think it's the perfect real-world study for you.
Huh? With you, Commander? Are you sure I won't interfere with your work?
Don't worry about it. Understanding the world of business will help me plan the new zone, too.
Besides... I'd have you as my research partner. Sounds like a winning investment to me.
Heehee. If you insist, then I'll get right to work preparing for tomorrow's research.

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>Who to Investigate?</size>

scripts.say: Commercial District - Afternoon
Ting An and I spent the whole morning on her field research.
Hmm... Commander, what were your impressions of the shops we visited this morning?
I guess the word would be "dynamic." They left a much bigger impression than the ones in your book.
So you found it strange, too. I must've made a mistake in my selection process.
I had no idea the all-you-can-eat barbecue restaurant would be emptied of its stock so quickly.
They advertised their willingness to satisfy even the hungriest of girls, but they couldn't even last through one morning.
And the sweets shop that claims to be sugar-free and good for you... It was sugarless, yes, but flavorless to match.
They couldn't sell a thing. Quite the stark contrast with the barbecue restaurant next door.
I guess they rushed into opening a store without finding a target demographic.
Ting An opens her notebook. It's full of observations, but her brow only furrows further.
Commander, I've discovered a problem. I understand the reason for each of their failures, but...
I fail to understand why they made incorrect decisions in the first place.
What were they thinking? What subtle omens did they overlook?
Hmm. I think analyzing as an observer is a completely different thing from real lived experience.
Very true! To go from knowing something to understanding it, you require the bridge known as experience. I think... that I, too, must experience failure.
Now that sounds risky.
What if I didn't experience it alone, though? Commander, this may sound like an odd suggestion to you...
Go on.
If I funded it, would you... open a shop that was guaranteed to fail alongside me?
Then, I'll experience the entire process from planning to failure!
It would be so much more direct than studying other people's cases!
What should I do, then? Just help you run it?
No, you can leave the management to me as well. Just stay by my side, and I won't worry even if I'm losing money.
Together, we will record our findings, analyze the process, and maximize the value of this learning experience!
Using controllable costs to buy practical experience, huh? That sounds like your investment style.
C-Commander, do you think I'm being reckless?
A little bit. But I think it's an interesting idea.
Commander!
She excitedly takes my hand. I feel warmth and softness through her palm.
I'm touched that you would accompany me on such a... such a wasteful investment!
Shall we spend the rest of the day discussing our investment plan?
Gladly! Let's go to that café right over there. We can discuss the best way to lose money together!

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>Guaranteed Loss!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Restaurant
After several days of preparation, the big day approaches. It's almost time to open the guaranteed-failure shop that Ting An has dreamed of.
Thank you for coming, Commander! I just finished getting everything ready.
Wow... It looks like a serious restaurant in here.
Of course! Fresh ingredients, professional equipment, and a clean environment are the fundamental signs of respect one should show to a business.
Respect, eh? I see. You haven't told me how you plan to turn a loss, though.
Don't worry. My concept is clear: the once-in-a-lifetime noodle life cycle restaurant.
Our selling point is allowing customers to witness and even take part in the journey from wheat to noodle bowl.
W-wheat? Er, shouldn't we have started with a farm, or...?
Oh, my! How did you know I was planning to rent a farm later?
Customers will plant the seeds themselves and make a bowl of noodles that is entirely their own!
That sounds... time-consuming.
That's part of the experience! Now, Commander, I'd like you to be my first customer. Come take a seat by the window.
We will begin the journey of the noodle life cycle now. First, put on this authentic farmer's hat to connect with the land.
This is no ordinary meal – it's a once-in-a-lifetime journey that involves your own effort!
When I put on the hat, she brings me a small plate of unprocessed wheat.
I bought this ordinary wheat for our use. Use tweezers and a magnifying glass to pick out the bad grains.
You mean... I do it?
Of course. I'll help, naturally, but your effort will have a direct effect on the quality of the final product.
I follow her instructions and begin the work. Once I'm done, she pours the final grains onto a small millstone.
We'll grind the wheat at a speed of fifteen revolutions per minute.
If you'd like, you can put your hand on mine and experience the whole process of grinding wheat into flour.
This is a special service just for our very first customer!
Thirty minutes later, I can't help but smile at the sloppily-ground flour before me.
Now that we have flour, we'll knead the dough first, and then let it rest...
My hands mechanically follow Ting An's instructions while my thoughts drift away amidst the restaurant's music.
When I come back to my senses, two hours have passed, and I'm greeted by a bowl of noodles that is surprisingly normal in color and fragrance.
There's no beef or even green onion in it.
Thank you for waiting. This is the bowl of noodles that we've put our hearts and souls into making.
The once-in-a-lifetime limited-edition noodles!
So those last two hours...
Yes, Commander. We've finally completed this ritual of culinary art.
The result is a bowl of noodles that is low in cost and mediocre in flavor, but... very audacious in both experience and pricing.
Somehow, this extremely average bowl of noodles in front of us took a full two hours of work and stress to create.
When the warm broth first runs down my throat, my weary heart feels strangely soothed.
Before I knew it, I'd eaten the whole bowl. Meanwhile, Ting An rests her chin in her hand and fantasizes over the thought of how much money she'll lose.
This is it! Theoretically, almost nobody should be willing to pay for such a long and bizarre experience! At this rate...
We're sure to go bankrupt!

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>The Secret to Profit</size>

scripts.say: Port - Restaurant
Work has had me tied up, so I haven't been able to visit the restaurant in days.
When it comes into view, though, I don't see the quiet I expected. Far from it, there's a long line winding out of the small building. Through the front window, I can see that the inside is packed.
Ting An busily rushes between tables, serving wheat to the customers.
Umm... Congratulations on the successful opening?
Commander, you're here! Do you see it? It's beyond my wildest dreams...
Yeah, this is one hell of a success. How did you do it?
Her eyes dart about. Nervously, she takes out a mobile phone and holds it in front of me.
This is the cause... A certain someone filmed our entire process, and... everyone thinks this restaurant is an immersive noodle-making experience now!
Someone? Isn't that your hand in the video, though?
I-I just happened to film it, and for some reason, it went viral...
So what you're telling me is... this place is making money.
Umm... From a raw numbers perspective, yes. It's a considerable profit, at that.
R-right, Commander! Would you like a bowl? I happen to have broth and noodles at the ready, so I can make it right away!
Ting An awkwardly changes the subject. Feeling a little bad for her, I accept her offer. I was just in the mood to taste those noodles again.
She ties her apron and heads back into the kitchen. In less than ten minutes, I'm presented with a steaming-hot bowl of noodles.
Please enjoy!
When I take a sip and slurp up some noodles... I don't find that same refreshing feeling. It's just a normal bowl of noodles now.
Very ordinary.
Right? Our core product isn't particularly competitive, after all.
Yet business is booming, despite our expectations.
That's right. Revenue is exceeding projections.
Business is booming, but you don't seem happy about it.
Not quite. As a businesswoman, I'm more than satisfied.
Remind me, Commander. Why did you and I start this business?
She gazes at me. Her usually sparkling eyes are clouded by confusion.
Because you wanted a guaranteed loss, so that you could experience failure firsthand.
*sigh*...
It's a short sigh. She rests her forehead on the open ledger for a moment.
Yes. I wanted to lose money. But here I am, turning a massive profit out of nowhere...
I've utterly failed at losing money, Commander.

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>The Big Loss Plan 2.0</size>

scripts.say: Port - Alleyway
It sure is quiet here... Are there really shops this way?
Ting An walks to the side and pushes open an old, wooden door.
But of course. Welcome to our new shop – a secondhand shop that's REALLY guaranteed to lose money!
A secondhand shop? Well, it does sound like a losing investment...
That's not all. This time, I'm going for an even more direct route to failure: buy high, sell low!
I'll use profits from the noodle shop to buy niche, overpriced, and slow-moving goods. Then, in the name of "inventory management," I'll clear them out at dirt-cheap prices!
Talk about direct. If you wanted to be any more straightforward about losing money, you'd just start giving money away.
As partners, let us launch the grand opening of our secondhand shop!
But first, I want you to close your eyes. This will help you experience the unique atmosphere and products we provide.
Without waiting for my response, she covers my eyes with her hand. Deprived of my sight, the mixture of her scent and that of the old, wooden building becomes even clearer.
Now, Commander, have faith in me.
I'll guide you to each item in our collection and place your hand on it. Tell me how much you think it's worth, based purely on what you feel.
Taking my hand, she leads me forward. The first thing I touch is some kind of cold, metal object with intricate carvings.
Take special note of its texture for me. What do you think it is?
Well, it is complex... A pocket watch, maybe? Or some kind of decorative case?
This is a Rococo-style silver case, and it was very expensive. What do you think it should be priced at?
Ten percent of its value?
Oh? You'd put it that low?
Aren't we trying to lose money?
*sigh*... If you say so, then I'll put this at a 90%-off clearance price.
With that, Ting An guides me to another item. This one is warm, smooth, and has elegant curves.
What of this one? Its surface is very smooth, right? Touch it.
Is it porcelain? It feels nice, but also dangerously fragile.
That's right. It's a blue and white porcelain decoration. While its quality is excellent, it's hard to store due to its fragility.
Should we set another insanely low price?
Urk... I will leave that up to you. Our goal is to lose money, after all.
The darkness sharpens my senses. Her hand hesitates for a moment, and she seems to close the distance between us just a little.
The next item... may require more careful evaluation.
Instead of putting my hand directly on the object, she gently lifts and opens my hand.
Then, she places her hand in mine. Her fingers are slightly chilly, but her palm is warm.
What do you think? Would you like to... hold onto it forever?
Her question is direct – perhaps even challenging in its seriousness. As if she's waiting for a real appraisal.
Of course... This is a one-of-a-kind treasure.
I give her a firm answer. She pauses for a moment, then gently removes the hand covering my eyes.
When I open them, she's standing in front of me with flushed cheeks.
Ahem... There are other items that need your appraisal. We'd best get back to work.
This time, I just know we'll succeed at failing!
She picks up her ledger and puts pen to paper. Never once does she let go of my hand after that.

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>What Did We Sell?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Secondhand Shop
After happily seeing off our last customer, Ting An puts up a "Sold Out" sign on the door.
Well, we sold everything.
And on the first day of business...
That's right. Thanks to you, all of the goods I carefully prepared for this day are gone.
Surely we lost a ton of money this time... right?
She opens the ledger and does some quick math.
Yes, it's a wonderful success. At this rate, we'll deplete our entire monthly budget in just three days.
This has gone beyond even my most optimistic expectations.
Finally, we can fail as planned.
But Commander... Don't you think this failure could be even more perfect?
Like how?
Well, don't you think it's strange that this shop on the verge of bankruptcy has such a hard-working and attentive owner?
I think that's wrong. A failed owner should be far less competent than this.

options.content: Are you planning to slack off?
You mean you wanna have a bad attitude?

scripts.say: Are you planning to slack off?
Exactly! That should make the image of losing money more realistic and believable.
You mean you wanna have a bad attitude and ignore your customers?
Exactly! We should do nothing but man the registers – or better yet, we could force the customers to do it themselves!
Meanwhile, you and I can nap the day away.
Surely that's going too...
Before I can finish speaking, she pulls me into the chair beside her... and guides my head onto her soft lap.
Relax, Commander. This is all part of the experience... Close your eyes, please.
I do as instructed. The scent of ink tickles my nostrils, and I'm touched by her warmth as her fingers stroke my hair.
In this unexpected moment of peace and quiet, a wave of fatigue washes over me and entices me to sleep.
A few hours later...
When I wake from a dreamless sleep, evening sunlight dyes the shop in gold. Ting An has left me, but I'm covered by a coat that bears her scent.
I sit up and look around. She sits behind the counter alone, staring at some documents.
Ting An? What's the matter?
Commander... I think we may have made a minor mistake.
How? We sold out. Surely you've lost plenty by now...
Yes, we did sell out of our inventory... but I forgot to factor in the storefront itself.
Is this... a notice for demolition compensation? From my office, at that.
As it turns out, the port's new commercial development zone... includes this very address.
The compensation is more than enough to cover the cost of all the goods.
It was personally stamped by you just a few days ago.
I totally forgot.
Twilight engulfs the shop. The two of us are at a loss for words; we can only stare blankly at the notice.

sequence:
A Disastrous Investment

<size=45>True Profit</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Two things lay on my desk: the demolition notice for the planned commercial development zone, and a generous compensation check.
The notice bore two signatures: one mine, and the other... also mine, as it turns out.
I might have done something ridiculous without even realizing it.
A knock on the door interrupts my train of thought.
Commander, I see you've received the settlement statement.
Great timing, Ting An. Half of this check rightfully belongs to you.
Thank you, Commander. This money is the final and most important part of my plan.
My business of losing money isn't over yet.
Wait, you're still on that?
First, I'd like to formally apologize to you.
My single-minded focus on failure has forced you into a series of, frankly, ridiculous antics at my behest.
Don't be like that. I know your business acumen – even if you tried to lose money, I knew you'd find a way to make a profit.
That's part of why I agreed to your proposal.
Thank you... However, I was the one to propose this business, so I must be the one to bring it to a close.
This check is exactly how I'll accomplish that.
Go on...?
I'd like to share this unexpected windfall as a dividend with you, my partner. Rather, I want to exchange it for something...
Specifically, time alone with you. No interruptions, nobody else.
For all this money?
That's right! My initial goal was to lose money, remember? I think this purchase aligns perfectly with my needs.
Have you heard?
Plenty of people would pay incredible sums just to eat lunch with legendary figures.
And to me, that is exactly who you are.
Being in a warm room with you, having your undivided attention...
That's the best return on investment I can imagine.
Ting An circles behind me and wraps her arms around me. Her weight and warmth are palpable through my back.
Aha... So this was your real goal all along.
That's right! My plan has failed once again, because no matter how you calculate it, I'm about to win big.
Now, as you've accepted my dividend payout...
It's time for you to fulfill your end and indulge me... by "wasting" this special moment with me.
The weight on my shoulders rises and falls in tune with her gentle breathing.
In the sunlight, our shadows mingle into one. Time seems to slow down.
I abandon all thought and surrender myself to the tenderness that Ting An so thoughtfully prepared.
The static, ringing sound swirling chaotically in my head gradually orders itself.
When I open my eyes again–
I find myself surrounded by tall buildings and busy traffic.
Clusters of high-rises dot the skyline, blurry-faced passers-by surge back and forth around me.
Before my astonishment fades, my thoughts begin to orient themselves.
Where am I? I have to get my bearings straight first.
Yes, there was an emergency in the Sea of Stars... I should've been in the process of evacuating with Helena.
But... What happened? Why am I here?
Where's Helena? No, of course she wouldn't be here right now.
...I can't make any sense of how I got here. My head feels fuzzy.
It feels like I'm forgetting something but can't quite put my finger on it, as if I had just woken from a dream.
I look around, and my memories seem to overlap with the strange sights flooding my eyes. Everything seems so alien, yet also intensely familiar.
It feels as if I know this place, but how? There are tall buildings all around me, yet my eyes refuse to focus on their blurry names.
Flickering holograms and countless lights fill the air, blurring the line between day and night.
It almost seems like a lifelike fantasy taken right from the set of a science fiction movie.
But, everything around me seems to run with such regularity, a hyper-realism that borders on uncanny.
For a moment, I am convinced that I've been transported into the future.
...But, that's not possible, is it?

Things start to fall into place bit by bit. The nebulous, blurred-out faces of the people around me. The impossible-to-read signs on the buildings. These were the same products of the Reality Lens' replication function.
If so, is everything around me somehow related to the abnormality that occurred in the Sea of Stars before the emergency evacuation?
And most importantly – what am I supposed to do here?
Ring ring~♪
A buzzing is coming from the pocket of my clothes, accompanied by the sound of something resembling a ringtone.
I fumble around inside my pocket, and my fingers brush against a slender, rectangular object.
Is this... a cellphone?
I don't remember bringing my phone with me into the Reality Lens...
Rather, I don't even recognize the clothes I'm wearing.
It seems to be... a lab coat worn by researchers.
Ring ring~♪
I fumble around to pull the strange phone out of my pocket. The ringing has already stopped, but a prompt lingers on the screen, asking me if I want to hear the message.

options.content: Slide your finger towards the green button.
Slide your finger towards the red button.

scripts.say: I start to play back the message, and hear a familiar voice coming from the other side.
...A voice inside me is telling me that nothing will begin unless I take this first step.
It seems to be compelling me to listen to this message.
Hello, Professor. This is Memphis.
I've been trying to reach you for the last few days, but haven't been able to get through. I figure you're still busy on your trip, so I'll just leave this message here for you.
So, at the time of this message, Dr. Anzeel and Yorktown have just arrived safely.
She originally planned to pick you up and take you to the university herself, but...
But, uh... Her flight got delayed.
In any case, she was a bit short on time as a result, so she had to head there first to get ready for the presentation.
But don't worry, Northampton will be there to pick you up instead.
Anyways, I'll see you soon at the usual place.
The message comes to an end, and the screen goes dark.
The device somewhat resembles the smartphones I'm used to but is even more lightweight and elegant in design. I slide it back into my pocket.
But... why did Memphis call me "Professor?"
I had used the Reality Lens to merge my consciousness with Anchorage's hull, which resulted in an amalgamation of our imagery, memories, and data.
If that's the case, whose consciousness is this? Who exactly is Dr. Anzeel, and what is this university?
And why did I receive a message from Memphis when I was not actively focusing my thoughts on her?
...Maybe some of my questions will be answered when I meet with Northampton.
Come to think of it... what's "the usual place?"
As I walk down the street, some unmistakable landmarks come into view.
That would explain the sense of deja vu I felt earlier. This place was clearly based upon NY City.
Had the buildings around me not been covered with holographic displays, I probably would've made the connection much sooner.
The question still remains: is this actually a scene from the future, or merely the figment of someone's imagination?
The closest thing I've ever seen to something like this was the City of Light inside the Arcana Sanctum... But who would be able to reproduce something like that with such fidelity– ...Hmm?
While I was lost in my thoughts, a car had just pulled up to me.
Hey there. You wandered off to a pretty interesting place. The fact that I even found you means we really are two peas in a pod, huh?
Sorry 'bout that. Did I keep you waiting?
Though her attire is a lot more modern-looking, the girl in front of me still appears to be the same Northampton I know.
First Memphis, now Northampton; both appearing inside the simulation without my conscious input.
What's the matter? Got an upset stomach or something?
Northampton gets out of the car and approaches me. She seems worried that I didn't respond to her greeting.
...Until I have a better grasp of the situation, I don't want to draw too much attention to myself. So, I should try to act natural–

options.content: "I'm fine. Just a little tired, that's all."

scripts.say: Ahaha... Don't blame you. Coming all the way over here must've been a pretty long drive, huh?
Just hang in there a bit longer, alright? We still need to head over to the university and meet up with Dr. Anzeel.
"Is Dr. Anzeel... over there right now?"
Yup, that's what Memphis said. Apparently, her flight was delayed so she went straight over to prepare for the presentation.
Though, by the time we get there, the presentation will probably already be over.
"Alright. Let's get going then."
Sounds good. Hop on in, I'll take you there.

sequence: "This is the captain. I'm addressing every man aboard this ship"
"In the last few hours, many things have happened."
"I believe what we have stumbled across is not man-made, but a phenomenon of nature."
"One that can't be explained."
"This storm has some effect on time as far as we know."
"It created a portal, a door into another era."
"We're about to fight a battle that was lost..."
"Before most of you were born."
"But this time, with our efforts, it's going to be different."
"The established past will be rewritten."
"––May God watch over us."

scripts.say: In the midst of the exercise...
Meager as our forces are, I still split them up into three groups.
I assign Northampton to Hornet, have Hammann and Yorktown pair up, and keep Langley with me by the command vessel.
Tons of enemy aircraft, incoming! Looks like they're from the carrier strike team! Memphis is finally putting her cards on the table!
Langley, give me a sitrep, ASAP!
I'm working on it! Just two more seconds...
Sent! The carrier strike team has several AA-focused corvettes as escorts! Be careful!
I'm still working on designating their command ships. Hold off your assault until I'm finished!
Roger!
Commander, Hornet's group is hanging in there, for now.
Unfortunately, things aren't looking very good. The enemy's strength is simply dumbfounding.
In addition to aircraft and drones, they've also deployed a lot of submersibles and mini-submarines.
While we do have the advantage in one-on-one fights, their swarms of expendable weaponry are starting to overwhelm us.
Anzeel gave me a report the night before which outlined the Type II rigging's construction and the functions it improved upon.
Chief among them are a general combat effectiveness increase, jamming countermeasures, and built-in electronic warfare capabilities.
Special mentions should also be given to the enhanced communications and information processing systems.
These allow shipgirls on the field to directly share info with each other via data links, and draw much more potential out of a shipgirl's hull.
This technology is the result of a production process that consumes additional Wisdom Cubes...
And research that, according to Anzeel, I played a significant role in.
"We have the upper hand when it comes to information sharing. We have to use it to our advantage."
You mean the data link? I guess so... The increased data processing power is one of the major selling points of the new rigging type.
This makes it possible to analyze data instantaneously and relay the results to shipgirls on the field in almost real-time.
It allows us to act as one, based on the orders you issue us.
Your terminal should be relaying information received from our end as well, right? It's an astronomical improvement over the back-and-forth radioing of the past.
"So, aircraft can be much better coordinated when they all have access to the same information, right?"
Correct! That's one of the features you helped develop.

You can also hand over control of certain reconnaissance equipment, something I took advantage of at the beginning of the exercise to continue gathering data while letting the others focus on the fight.
"Does the same apply to other carrier-based aircraft? Isn't it possible for carriers to share each other's air wings?"
Um, let me see... Oh, you can! I can't believe I overlooked that.
I'm glad you're here, Commander. You have a better grasp of the situation than we do individually.
The truth is, however... I don't know any more about this new rigging than they do. Maybe even less. They say I helped develop it, but I have no recollection of that at all.
"Yorktown, can you hear me?"
Yes, Commander?
"How's the situation on your end? Have you been able to cover the anti-submarine warfare?"
We've managed to deal with the underwater threat for now...
But, the air situation is still not looking too good. While I'm fighting for some airspace control, Hammann has to worry about both anti-ship and anti-submarine combat.
Sorry, but I won't be able to help the other two groups right now.
"Don't worry. In fact, I'm here to lend you a hand."
"Your recon planes aren't much use in a dogfight. Let Langley take control of them so she can pinpoint the location of the enemy command ships."
Give control to Langley? Okay, let me just... There, they're hers now.
Look out, Yorktown! We've got more mini-subs incoming!
Shoot, what terrifying numbers... Memphis really is going all-out this time.
"Hang in there a bit longer. We'll have our chance to turn things around soon enough."
Understood! I'll fight with all I've got!
"Langley, use all the recon aircraft at your disposal to mark those command ships."
"As soon as you do that, I'll give the order to have everyone focus fire on them."
"Then, while chaos spreads among the mass-produced ships, we'll deal a devastating blow to Memphis' main fleet and seize victory."
Roger!
KABOOOM!
All designated command ships have been successfully eliminated! The enemy line is in shambles!
I'll be damned... You actually did it, Commander!
Now that the enemy's been crippled, we'll ride the momentum and push forward as one, right?
"That's the plan. We'll still need to take out enemies sequentially, according to their relative levels of risk. I'll re-assess the situation from that point."
Yorktown! How did I do?
You were outstanding, Hammann. You managed to hold your own against enemy ships and subs, and bought me enough time to mount our counterattack.
Heehee~ Thank you!!
Hehe, piece of cake. Is that all those souped-up tin cans have to show?
Far from it. The battle isn't over yet.
I know, I know. I'm not as naive as I used to be.
As far as I can tell from the data links, Memphis' main fleet has been completely destroyed.
And yet, she's not said a word to us over the radio.
That's a bad omen. She's got to be planning a comeback.
If I was able to figure out her fleet's weakness, she's surely figured out mine as well.
That being, our carriers have an immense presence, but their protection is critically lacking.
I have successfully divided up her forces. However...
If she regroups outside our recon range, then launches a focused assault on us, we'll be in serious trouble.
Status update. The blue team's main fleet has been destroyed. While our shipgirls have sustained no damage, we have lost 40% of our aircraft.
Memphis has yet to make a clear move. What shall we do?
"For now, regroup in anticipation of an enemy ambush. Afterwards, we'll reorganize our groups."
"Hammann, Langley, you'll swap places and turn on your electronic warfare gear."
"Langley, I need you to send out a duplicate of Hammann's signal near Yorktown, while Hammann turns her signal off altogether."
I've read all the materials about the Type II that I could get my hands on, and I'm still not sure if my proposal is actually doable...
Understood. I can do that.
What are you planning, Commander? This sounds like it'll make you look unprotected...
Wait... Don't tell me you're going to use yourself as bait!
"Correct. It will lure Memphis into attacking me while giving your group more fighting power."
"It's a risky plan, but it's worth a shot."
As you say... I'll scramble my planes as soon as anything happens. Just be careful!
Looking at the radar, it seems we have a bite already. She's sending her reserve fleet this way.
Her RESERVE fleet? She really was waiting for an opportunity like this!
"Our aircraft will make short work of them before they get here, and she must know that. This reeks of a distraction to me..."
Later in the exercise...
The girls are doing a good job holding back the reserve fleet, but there are so many enemies to deal with that they can't focus on anything else.
Everyone is fighting hard, except for Hammann, who's with me on the command ship's deck.
She's pacing around anxiously, keeping an eye on my device for updates on the battle.
Why am I sitting around while everyone else is fighting for dear life?
The Commander clearly made the wrong call here...
"What's wrong, Hammann? Do you have a problem with my deployments?"
Huh? I guess. I just wish I was doing something to help. I'm not mad at you or anything...
They're handling themselves well, but that doesn't change the fact...
...Wait! A blip just appeared on our sonar! An enemy is nearby!
A big one, too. It must be a big submarine... No, it's the size of a battleship!
Heads up! It's resurfacing!
The seas rumble, and a massive, silver-clad vessel emerges from the depths.
Just as I anticipated, Memphis' reserve fleet is only a diversion. This mega-submarine is the real threat to us.
"Interesting exterior. It looks a lot like the submarine Belorussiya's crew used when I went to the Northern Parliament."
This is no Northern Parliament vessel. She's the Epimetheus, a Federation mega-submarine for deep-sea exploration.
She's outfitted with a range of sensors and supercomputers that processes data from the ocean floor just as well as the battlefield.
And not only that, her cannons pack more than enough firepower to blow your command ship to kingdom come!
Heheh... Sounds like you're lost for words.
They let you have a submarine that can dive out of our sonar range?!
How is that fair?! That's literally cheating!
Cry about it. Even if you scramble your planes, it's too late.
I'm so sorry, Commander. I had no clue she'd made it right next to us...
"It's okay. She should have no idea YOU'RE here either. Strike now while she's unaware!"
Got it! I'll show her what happens when you mess with us!
KABOOOM!
Memphis' mega-submarine is a very different beast to an ordinary mass-produced ship, but still, it's not designed specifically for combat.
A shipgirl should easily prove a fair fight for it.
"You're not the only one with a trump card. You might want to–"
Back down? I don't think so!
Didn't you hear me? This baby has supercomputers and advanced sensors onboard!
I knew Hammann was with you from the moment I reached the surface!
That's why I resurfaced from a distance – to lure her away from you while I do... THIS!
Target: deck of the command ship at twelve-o'-clock!
Activate escape pod! Bail out!
KABOOOM!
An oval-shaped object shoots out of her mega-submarine, coming straight towards me.
It lands just nearby on the deck, then burst open to reveal Memphis, rigging at the ready.
Checkmate, Commander.
While you did display excellent knowledge of tactics and mastery of the Type II rigging's functions, you did not anticipate me boarding you.
You did well, but I was one step ahead.
Sure, I didn't anticipate a tactical use of her escape pod, but I DID plan for something similar.
Thank you. I contemplated a thousand different ways to beat you, and eventually arrived at this one.
"I see. You deserve a promotion. The battle isn't over yet, though."
It will be once I neutralize you. Without someone to command your team, it will... Huh?
Wait... What are those planes?
"My contingency plan in case you were to board my command vessel through some means."
"Open fire!"
Grab on to something, Commander!
KABOOOM!
Blue team's flagship has been destroyed. The exercise is over. Red team has won.
Wow... I applaud you, Commander. I thought I planned for everything, and still you were one step ahead.
Holy smokes, what a finale! I was on the edge of my seat there.
You really deserve a round of applause, Commander. I get why everyone adores you now.
Both sides, great job. This was truly a spectacular test. Expect a juicy reward for all your efforts later.
It better be good! We worked our asses off today, and with minimal time to prepare!
Yeah... Sorry 'bout that. On the bright side, we have the next few days off while the team analyzes the exercise data.
Heck, we can take my plane and go on a short vacation somewhere! The Commander would probably like that.
An actual vacation? Really?
Aww hell yeah! Commander, Dr. Anzeel, you're the best!
Hang on, someone's calling... Oh, it's Aoste. Just a minute.
...Anzeel speaking. What's up?
...I mean, what do you think? The test went perfectly.
...Yeah, I guess it was a given, with the Commander at the helm.
...You did that? That totally explains why the blue team was overpowered in quantity AND quality.
...Come again?
...You know me too well. Data will take a few days to process, so yeah, might as well take some time off.
...You're serious? Okay. I dig the sound of that.
...Yeah, I'll try to explain it to the Commander. Talk to you later.
What was that about, Dr. Anzeel?
Nothing important. We just talked about vacation destinations.
He told me about a pretty sweet place, actually. Ever heard of Samos Island?
Sea of Stars Research Base - Core Area, Sector X
Overflow resolved. Reality Lens data analysis program functioning normally.
Maintaining crisis response. Temporal regulator restored to 95% functionality.
Subjective time ratio has been restored to 67%.
Thank goodness... We were seconds from disaster.
We've regained control of the temporal regulator, so I think we're well on our way to saving the Commander.
Helena, can you release the safety lock?
Understood. Releasing emergency safety lock... And done!
TB, disconnect the Commander and restore consciousness.
Orders received. Proceeding with emergency rescue sequence—
Warning: Unable to restore connection with the Commander's consciousness.
Warning: Unable to confirm Commander's presence in Virtual Space 3.
Warning: Unable to monitor virtual space.
Conclusion: The Commander does not currently exist in the virtual space constructed from Anchorage's hull data.
Does not currently exist...? Umm, are you saying the Commander is not in her dream?
...In other words, the Commander is no longer inside the Reality Lens?!
TB, please! Tell us what's happened!
Apologies, I am unable to disclose that information through my language programs.
The Commander's body exists within the Reality Lens. The connection between the Commander's consciousness and the Reality Lens is stable.
However, I am unable to locate the Commander's consciousness, and therefore cannot monitor the virtual space.
Hypothesis: The Commander's consciousness has been transferred to an inaccessible space.
An inaccessible virtual space? TB, aren't you the administrator of the Reality Lens?
I've never heard of any areas in your own mainframe that you don't have the power to monitor.
Per protocol, I am not authorized to disclose this information. Insufficient clearance.
Everyone, just calm down! TB, I need you to tell me one thing. Is the Commander's consciousness safe?
Query received. Currently attempting to trace the Commander's consciousness–
The Commander is still connected to the Reality Lens. Therefore, it must still exist.
That doesn't tell us much... Okay. Let's try this.
The Commander's body and mind are still here in the Reality Lens.
If we give the order to shut down the device, the Reality Lens should automatically disconnect from the Commander as a safety precaution.
It might result in some confusion once this is over, but if nothing else, it should save the Commander.
Think it'll work, TB?
In theory, it should be possible.
Alright, let's try it. Shut down the Reality Lens and bring the Commander's mind back.
Orders received. Shutting down the Reality Lens.
Shutdown program halted. Administrative permissions required.
Wait, what's going on? I thought you had the highest level of administrative privileges!
The authorizations required to use the shutdown program have changed. I do not have access to this function.
I will need to be granted permission or a temporary authorization code to complete this action.
The authorizations... have changed? We didn't do anything of the sort...
Did someone secretly modify the authorization requirements after the experiments started? But how...?
Memphis! Now isn't the time to worry about that.
We need to focus on what we can do for the time being!
Y-yeah. You're right... Helena, can you continue monitoring the situation?
Will you... help us again...?
Helena? What's going on?
Perhaps you, of all people... could successfully hack into the Sea of Stars.
Can I... trust you?
Can I trust you... "Helena?"
Helena, who are you talking to?
Emergency control code: 47741 30130 30146. Authorizing agent: "Helena."
I know how we can save the Commander.
Huh...?
TB, transfer control of the Tower to "Helena."
Orders received. Transferring control now.
Emergency access code confirmed. Permissions transfer complete.
Please input coordinates from the Core Area.
Orders received. Please input next set of coordinates.
Now, please grant me permission to track the virtual space.
Understood. It's up to you now, Helena...
Helena murmured, seemingly to herself, and typed a code into the control apparatus.
Orders received. Tracking virtual space.
Helena, what did you just do?
I didn't know TB... heck, the entire Sea of Stars had this function.
How did you do all that? And who were you talking to just now...?
S-sorry, it's a bit complicated...
If you bear with me, I'll try to explain after we rescue the Commander...
[Reality Lens Replicated Space] [Location: Chartered plane WFH 'n' Chill Mk. 1] [Cognitive merging data unknown]
As soon as we get our luggage sorted, Anzeel plops down on a plush couch inside her jet's cabin and gazes out the window.
Ooh, that's nice... I tell ya, there's no place like home.
I did a full day's work. Finally, time to kick back and relax...
"Speaking of home, I've been wondering about this plane's name."
Hm? You got a problem with the name I gave it?
"...Never mind, actually."
What's with that look on your face? C'mon, grab a coffee and take it easy.
I accept the cup of hot coffee Anzeel hands me. She goes right back to flipping through some documents.
Not exactly my idea of "taking it easy."
Or maybe, reading something is just a way for her to clear her head.
I've probably been overthinking this too much. I'm not going to get more information about this world if I don't ask her.
Last night was a bit too hectic to even make small talk, but this is a good opportunity.
What are you staring at me for?
Oh, I get it. You're part of the tea faction, aren't you?
Where should I even begin...?
The one where the fleet travels through time?
Pretty crazy how Bonnie got the lead role in that movie, huh?
I already knew though, since I got to sit in on their internal screenings.
Y'know, I would've at least liked to be one of the extras...
But it just didn't mesh with my schedule, so I couldn't.
Oh, right. You wanted to ask me about something, huh? Maybe time travel?
I'm the kind of person who'd try to change the past, no doubt about it.
Sure, it might cause the preordained future to unravel, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
If anything, doesn't that mean there's a chance to create a better future?
In the end, isn't that what humans are always trying to do, with or without time travel?
For the sake of creating a better future, I think changing the past is perfectly reasonable. Maybe even morally correct.
But, Aoste probably wouldn't agree with me on that one.
"Speaking of Aoste, what has he been up to recently?"
That guy... What doesn't he research? His team has gotten so big these days that he has his hands in every cookie jar at once.
After all, he's now our prized Renaissance man, master-of-all-trades.
I think he's been focusing on AI research these days though.
I think you've already met his favorite. Does "Zero" ring a bell?
She's part of Project ANTI-X. They seem to be next-generation humanoid weapons.
...Zero?
Suddenly, Yorktown comes up to us, holding a tray of pastries.
Oh, Yorktown. Need something?
Doctor, Commander. Would you like some sweets?
The new instant mechanical confectioner is working very well.
Sweets, huh? Wait, come again? An instant mechanical confectioner?
I said I'd pay for souvenirs, not whatever that is!
Spill the beans, Yorktown! Who did the deed?! You? Hornet? Or maybe the Commander?
Hornet bought it. Erm, she said it seemed like fun to make sweets in a chartered plane...
And she got you hooked, huh?
I get it. What's done is done, and if it tastes good, maybe it's not all bad...
Despite her grumbling, she gets up and makes her way to the mechanical confectioner.
"The facilities and furniture in this charter plane are too nice to be just a private plane, aren't they?"
The military provided this plane for the doctor.
As I recall, some corporate alliance from the Union used cutting-edge Energy Cube technology to make it. It can fly smoothly in any weather.
Heehee. This is my first time riding, too, Commander.
Commander, this mechanical confectioner is awesome!
It looks like Yorktown's going to tell me something, but Anzeel interrupts with her shouting from the hallway.
It's seriously so cool! You gotta try it out! I mean, it can make anything!
Shall we, Commander?
Anzeel's charter plane lands at the Samos Island airport and we disembark.
Before I go, let me leave you with a gift. You'll want to pay a visit to Samos Island.
All I can say is that you'll find something of intrigue there.
"Something of intrigue, huh. That's so vague I'm not sure what to think of it."
If I knew what it is, I would tell you a little more. Sadly, I don't.
Friedrich has mentioned Samos Island, too...
But will I really find that thing of intrigue here? In this virtual space?
Bright sunlight, sandy beach... Now that's a vacation island for you.
It's like an island resort!
Right? I told you we were gonna party.
You also said this place had a secret military research facility. I don't see anything like that, though...
Should they be letting tourists get so close to a military facility in the first place?
I forgot that this was your first time here. This is how some secret research facilities are.
It's not the facility that needs to be hidden; it's the research.
You never know. Maybe that university had a lab where they conduct secret experiments right under the café!
Anyway, it's not like this facility isn't hidden.
Outsiders think it's just the Samos Marine Research Institute, though.
A long time ago, they actually used to research marine life here.
One day the military took over, and it became Dr. Aoste's research facility.
I think he had his reasons for picking this place.
But hey, it's a tourist destination. Maybe he just picked it so he could hang out on the beach when he feels lazy.
Ooh! Commander, did everyone bring swimsuits?
Umm... I didn't.
Me, neither. I'm sorry, Commander...
That goes to show just how few of us seriously see this as a vacation.
You heard them, Commander. You'd better go get some swimsuits!
"We didn't come here just to have fun, did we?"
Forget about that for now! Right now, we gotta think of how to get these girls ready to swim!
Oh, but don't worry about buying swimsuits for everyone.
Aoste has facilities that can make gear for each individual guard on demand, so I bet there's something here that can make swimsuits and other clothes!
Maybe it even spits out certain designs on demand!
"Would he really have equipment like that?"
Should we be wasting time on the beach...?
Don't worry about it! You came all this way to help, so we gotta let you indulge yourselves a little!
As long as it's okay...
The facility's just through these woods. Make sure you keep up! We don't want anyone getting lost.
After a walk through the woods, we reach an aging facility.
Authenticating access, aaand... Done.
Heheh. Open sesame!
Welcome, one and all, to Aoste's own research center: the Samos Marine Research Institute!
Th-thanks...
Geez, temper your excitement. This is THE secret research facility! Aren't you excited at all?
It's kinda plain. Like, it's just... a research facility, like you'd expect.
If you're gonna camouflage your secret research facility, then go all the way! That's basically Aoste's motto.
Is that... a room full of fish tanks?
Yep! That's a remnant of when this place actually performed marine research.
Wow, and it's so well-maintained. They've even got fish in there... Now I'm hungry.
Is fish the main course at the cafeteria here?!
Poultry is, actually. But they do serve fish.
This one time back at university, Aoste and I visited the aquarium together.
The exhibits were, well, okay. But their restaurant's specialty was grilled squid!
So you'd see squids in the exhibits, and then you'd have to eat their relatives...
Let me tell you, I remember crying while I put lemon on it more than I remember the aquarium itself!
Yorktown, you ought to take the Commander and Enterprise out on a date there sometime!
Eugh... They didn't cook the squids from the exhibits, did they...?
Of course they did! They had other stuff like that, too~
Now that I think about it, maybe Aoste chose this Marine Research Institute because of the trauma...
Anyway, the boring building up ahead is our destination.
You'd never know what kind of research is going on here unless you went in there!
Me and the others set foot inside the building's main hall. Then, something unexpected happens.
There's a panel next to the entrance. It glows and starts projecting a hologram.
The hologram looks familiar. Is that...?
Welcome back, Dr. Anzeel.
TB?!
Lookin' cute as ever, Zero. Is Aoste in?
