Even I know this isn't the right time to be barging in.
...Huh?
Yeah, not the best look.
You're such a blockhead, Hornet!
Wha?! What'd I do?
Now, now. It's okay.
Yorktown, the Fighting Lady, has returned to you once more.
Bathed in the resplendent dawn of happiness born from the darkest night...
I am here to fight alongside you, my friends.
We are waiting for our orders. Hammann seems to have found a strange ice cream machine with a variety of zany flavors, which has attracted the attention of the others.
Everyone except Anzeel, that is, who remains in place as if deep in contemplation.
Has she noticed my strange behavior?

options.content: "You're not going to take a look at the ice cream machine?"

scripts.say: Did you know that it didn't always use to be a self-serve? You used to have to wait for people to bring out your ice cream.
But, that's one thing I don't miss about this place. Those flavors aren't something you come back for.
Like, pepperoni and jalapeno. Who came up with that anyway?
"I don't know about you, but that sounds like it could work."
Are you serious? It's your funeral.
At any rate, only kids would get fired up over an ice cream machine. Do I look like a kid to you?
...Or, should I ask, how does the current "you" perceive me?
Sure enough, she has noticed.
You've been acting odd this whole time. Something about you just doesn't sit right with me.
Maybe you're just having a bad day. Maybe I'M just having a bad day. Or maybe...
You've been replaced by aliens.
"Aliens? Calling that far-fetched would be an understatement."
It's a non-zero possibility, so it could theoretically happen. Heck, it'd take an alien to enjoy pepperoni and jalapeno ice cream.
So... Let's have a little pop quiz just to see if you're an alien imposter or not~
"...Are you serious, or are you just messing with me?"
Do I look like I'm messing with you? C'mon, just take a seat right over there~!
I don't have much of a choice.
All of a sudden, I feel the hairs on my back standing on end, as if an electric current just ran down my spine.
The words coming out of my mouth seem to bypass my brain.
It's as if I subconsciously have always been used to these kinds of interactions with Anzeel.
First question. Who am I?
"You're Dr. Anzeel. You discovered Wisdom Cubes and pioneered their application, and now lead the Oceanic Federation's Wisdom Cube Research Team..."
Uhh... I said I wasn't messing with you, but you also don't need to recite my whole CV...
The words seem to flow right out of my mind, as if I had known this information my whole life.
Next question. What am I currently researching?
"Practical applications of Wisdom Cubes, and the effect of nurture on KAN-SEN."
What's the reason I came back to my alma mater?
"To test the effect of Type II hull-fusion rigging on KAN-SEN combat capabilities."
Right... Who's the general I talked about earlier?
"The vice-admiral of the Eagle Union Navy, head of Division 13 and supervisor of Cube weaponization research."
Finally, who is Dr. Aoste?
"Your colleague at the university, a leading expert in the fields of Energy Cubes and artificial intelligence, as well as head of the 'Antiochus' project."
Hahaha! You actually answered everything!
"Am I in the clear now?"
Hmm... Actually, I have one more question, but my gut tells me it's not a good idea to ask it right now.
...Forget I said that. You're in the clear.
I can safely say that you have not been abducted by aliens. We all have those rough days, huh?
...How in the world did I manage to answer those questions?
The Oceanic Federation, Division 13... I have seen some of those terms before, during my adventures in the Northern Parliament as well as at the Sea of Stars.
But, I couldn't even guess as to how they were related, nor did I know how I tied together all those threads of information into something coherent.
It left me with a bizarre feeling I couldn't quite put my finger on.
Almost as if some memories locked away deep inside me had been awakened at just the right time.
But how is any of this happening...?
Guess who's back with ice cream!
We got something for each of you as well!
(She's really gonna do it?)
(If Yorktown said it's fine, no harm to it, right?)
(Oh boy... I suppose it'll be fun to see how they react.)
Starting with the one I chose~!
The colors on those cones... Ugh, those are nasty flavors.
Allow me to tell you your choices!
The one with the yellow cone is yogurt beef flavor.
And the red cone, that's pepperoni flavor!
Pepperoni? Wow, that's the Professor's favorite!
I-it is? Okay, it's yours!
Anzeel forces the pepperoni-flavored ice cream on me before I have a chance to respond.
Come on, chow down! Don't let perfectly good food go to waste!
[Reality Lens Replicated Space] [Location: Café Granate] [Cognitive merging data unknown]
Phew... This paella's to die for, just like I remember it!
And let me tell you, I've been all over searching for comparable stuff, but no other shop comes anywhere close!
Mmhmm. My chorizo-cheese paella was pretty awesome too.
I didn't know that the cheese and pork in my pub fries were imported. Quite an innovative, upscale take on a classic comfort food.
I just did some research, and apparently, this shop sources locally as well as imports fine foods from overseas.
There's something on the menu for everyone. I'm quite impressed by how they manage to maintain such a broad menu.
That's right! You girls should try Basque cheesecake sometime! I had the real deal once when I went abroad to another research academy.
Ohh, I can still taste it if I focus on that memory.
...Come to think of it, you shipgirls still don't get to leave the base much, do you?
Hey... Think you could pull some strings so I can bring a few friends with me on my next business trip?
I could use the extra help to find souvenirs for those who stay home. There's a long list, you know.
...Are you sure you're allowed to use your private jet for that?
What's wrong with that? Bonnie does it all the time, and nobody seems to care.
Random question, Doctor, but I just looked up the name of this café.
Apparently, it comes from granatum, the pomegranate flower. Do you think that has any special significance?
I mean, the meaning of a flower changes from country to country, so it depends on who you're asking.
That said, I have heard the granate symbolizes "yearning for happiness" and "a chance about to be missed."
It also symbolizes abundance and the blessings of life. Put that together, and you probably have something like "a hearty meal not to be missed out on."
It's been around for a long while, and their food is the best for miles around.
Then again, I can't remember the last time I ate at any other café or restaurant in this area...
...Hang on, I'm getting a call.
Sorry, this one's work-related. I'll be right back.
Anzeel takes out her phone and walks out of the room, her light-hearted mood instantly vanishing beneath a serious, focused demeanor.
But, nobody else seems to think much of it. It mustn't be that serious then...
With Anzeel out of the room, I feel everyone's gaze turn onto me.
Hey, do you all remember the Professor's lectures on the history of modern warfare?
Of course. Because they were so clear and easy-to-digest, I have a solid grasp of just about every page in the textbook.
The tactical classes really clicked with me.
I might not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but I still use the Professor's lessons to adapt to the changing battlefield.
Don't let it get to your head, Professor. I'm an educator just like you now, and the path of learning never ends!
Huh? Who is teaching the Professor then?
Dr. Anzeel, of course. The Professor isn't just our teacher, but also Dr. Anzeel's assistant as well.
I bet you've been involved in all sorts of confidential projects lately, haven't you?
My skin begins to tingle again when I hear those words, but unlike when I was interrogated by Anzeel, no words appear in my mind.
With nothing to work with, I can only handwave the question.
I see... Sorry, I shouldn't be asking about confidential information in the first place.
I'm back. Sorry that took so long.
"Let me guess. Big news?"
Yup. Change of plans – General Garfield is going on an urgent mission tonight, so our meeting has to happen now.
Now? But we're not done eating yet...
I know, but there's nothing I can do. It's an emergency situation.
Must be pretty serious too, because he sounded like he was in a pretty bad mood.
Professor, I was originally planning on bringing you along. But I don't think I should put you in front of the general's fury while you're still... "not fully awake."
I'll deal with him myself. In return, keep these girls busy, will you?
Oh, and take my credit card. Take them on a shopping trip and go watch a movie or something.
I'll go take care of the bill first. Enjoy your day off, girls~!
We leave the café, and head for the shopping district around the campus.
Before I know it, we'd already crossed over from the campus into the bustling downtown area.
The doctor is quite the busy bee, isn't she?
Always has been. She comes and goes at the drop of a hat.
Thankfully, we have the Professor here, or our day off would've been cut short.
Haha, it's much more than a day off now. It's a group date with the Professor now!
Let's not call it that. Professor, is there any place you wanna visit?
Northampton passes me a device that projects a blow-up version of the surrounding area, casually navigating it with swipes of her finger.
If this world was a simulation and we could go anywhere within it, the scale and fidelity of the area around me alone would instantly exhaust the Sea of Stars' computational capacity.
Therefore, somebody else's data must have been incorporated into this replication. But whose? I want to explore every nook and cranny of this world.
That isn't possible before the time Anzeel comes back, but I at least have an idea of where I want to start.
Sounds good to me!
While we're at it, we can buy some souvenirs for our friends.
Hell yeah. Let's buy a literal boatload of stuff with Anzeel's money.
I'm going to veto that. The doctor's going to have our heads if we max out her credit card.
Don't worry. I know just the perfect way to plan out a great date on a budget.
I know what you're thinking. You may NOT use your aircraft to get a better view.
C'mon! I might've thought about it, but I wasn't gonna do it for real.
What are we going to do downtown?
Don't worry, I'll handle this. Drones are legal, even if your planes aren't.
Northampton suddenly takes out a small white drone from her bag, and it ascends into the air.
It's more sleek and elegant than anything I've seen before, a faint blue light pulsing from its center.
Pretty cool, right? It's one of the newest models.
The doctor let me borrow it. Said it ought to give us a better view of the city.
Lemme have a look... Dayum! That is a stunning view.
There's a neat souvenir place just down that way. Whaddya say we go there first?
After a period of walking, we enter the souvenir shop.
Wow, they have a lot of stuff you don't see every day.
Yeah, like this! The collector's edition of A Fistful of Molars! I've been dying to get my hands on this ever since...
These cat-ear headphones are pretty cute.
It sounds like everyone's having a whale of a time.
What do you have there, Yorktown? A shopping list?
Yes. We need to buy souvenirs for Enterprise, Memphis, and Dr. Anzeel.
And something for the Professor, of course.
*gasp*... I think I just overheard something juicy!
Yorktown's gonna buy something for the Professor, eh? Hehe...
Hey, come over here for a sec!
So, anything you've been wanting to get your hands on lately? Asking for a friend.
Hornet! *sigh*... It was meant to be a surprise!
Whew, what a haul! So, where are we heading next?
I wanna look around the pet store!
Let's do that. We can't spend too much money after all.
As we walk to the pet store, we see a movie advertisement playing from a giant screen on the side of a tall building.
Hey, everyone! It's me, Bon Homme Richard. The Final Countdown is in theaters now!
I had a lot of fun in the starring role. Be sure to check it out!
Welcome to the paradox of time, where past and present become one and history is actually changed! The Final Countdown... now in a theater near you.
Buy a ticket today and you have the chance to win a three-day guided tour of...
Did you see that? That was Bonnie up there!
She's really featuring in a movie?
Apparently! I asked her what she's been up to the other day, and she said she's involved in a top-secret project...
Guess this is what that was.
I wish I was a cultural ambassador like her. She's got it easy.
It's harder than it looks. Having the eyes of the world on you comes with a lot of pressure.
Imagine having to choose your every word carefully. I really don't think any of us are cut out for that.
And while we're enjoying ourselves as tourists, she's probably rehearsing for her next public appearance.
You got a point. I didn't think about that.
Whaddya say we buy her a souvenir too, while we're here?
Wait, first, let's take a group selfie! Northampton, you do the honor with your drone.
Make sure you get all of us, Bonnie included, in the frame.
Y'know, she'd probably be livid if she learned we went on a date with the Professor without her...
But if her face is in the picture, you can at least say she was there in spirit, right?
How does that sound, Professor? Over here, you can stand in the middle. Hammann, Langley, scoot over a bit. Yorktown, you can stand right beside the Professor.
And I'll be riiight here. Everyone ready? Say "cheese" on three. One, two...
Yup, looks good.
Thanks! Send it to me. I wanna show it to Bonnie right away.
Oh, I just got an idea. Why don't we go watch that movie she's in? She did tell us to check it out.
I know you wanna. Especially you, Professor.
That name, Bon Homme Richard... It's come up before, in some files from the Northern Parliament and the Royal Navy. None of it seemed good, but I'm very curious to learn more.
"Sounds like a plan. Let's do it."
Sweet. Yorktown, go ahead book some tickets for us.
Two hours later...
I can't believe they really got Bonnie to play the captain. The movie was surprisingly gripping, too.
I read that the troops, warships, and locations featured were also real. Apparently, the movie was produced in collaboration with the Oceanic Federation.
Even the mass-produced ships were real. I recognize 'em from a previous naval exercise. They must've pulled them in for filming right after.
The ending was a bit of a letdown though. Just as it seemed like something major was about to happen, they just got pulled back to their original timeline...
I suppose that's just the nature of the genre. Time travel is one of the hardest things to pull off convincingly in literature, with time paradoxes and all that stuff.
Wasn't the whole premise of the movie going back in time to prevent disaster? The screenwriters should've done a better job if you ask me!
Well, at least Bonnie got some awesome lines. "We're about to fight a battle that was lost before most of you were born."
I'll bet you, if Enterprise were in that same situation, she'd have been all like, "the enemy's in range. Strike first and wipe them out."
If you ask me, the folks in the movie were way too hesitant to do anything that might've influenced the past.
It's an understandable concern, as you could inadvertently erase yourself from ever having existed.
As for me, I'd be happy enough to just sit on the sidelines and watch history unfold. That alone is a golden opportunity we don't get in real life.
In any case, the stakes are way too high, and there are some decisions you can't make on impulse.
Hrmmm... Fair enough. How about you, Yorktown? What'd you think about the movie?
I've been thinking about it since the ending, and I'm still not sure.
Changing the past means changing everything that happens after it.
The past shaped us into who we are today. Changing it would change us as well.
That's not even mentioning the fact that the future we know may not exist anymore when we return to it.
And much like the butterfly effect, our actions may not result in the outcome we wanted.
Doing what feels like the right thing at the moment may lead to greater problems down the line.
Of course, changing the past could create a better future, or a worse one, as could doing nothing.
All that is to say... I don't know what I'd do.
"I don't know" means someone else has to decide. People's lives would be at stake.
I know. I suppose I'd do what the captain did and take it step by step.
If you can't predict the future even when you can influence its course, the best thing to do is minimize the potential repercussions.
You know... That answer fits you, actually.
In the end, that decision isn't even for us to make. Professor, if you had a chance to go back in time, what would you choose to change?
Hornet's right. I am the one whose decisions so often influence the fate of my friends and companions.
"If I could have it my way, I'd rather create a better future than rewrite history."
"But, supposing I traveled back in time, like in the movie..."

options.content: "I'd take it one step at a time, like a minefield."

scripts.say: "When you get the chance to fix past mistakes, there's no reason not to take it."
Exactly! I mean, who wouldn't jump at the opportunity for a do-over, right?
"However much pain the past caused us, the present we live in is built on it."
"To rewrite history would be to invite an uncertain future. The best intentions don't always yield positive outcomes."
A rational judgment, Professor. If you can't predict the future, leaving the past unchanged is the right decision.
"When you really think about it, going back in time in and of itself causes the past to branch off."
"Whether or not you do anything in the past, the future you came from will invariably not be the same."
"That being the case, you can't fall prey to overanalysis. You have to clear your mind, focus on what's right in front of you, and solve problems one at a time."
Which is exactly what I am doing right at that moment, unbeknownst to them.
I agree. Not making decisions you might regret is what's important.
When you don't know what you're supposed to do, do what you feel is right.
Yorktown! There's a toy store over there with some really adorable stuffed animals!
You still haven't bought souvenirs for everyone, right? Let's go check it out!
Oh, thanks, Hammann. What do you say, Professor?
"We still have plenty of time, so sure."
That evening, at the university...
Aww, maaan. It's dark already.
Time flies like a fighter jet when you're having fun, I guess.
True. Dr. Anzeel should be back any minute now.
We DID have a lot of fun and bought all the gifts we wanted to. I'd say we made excellent use of our time.
Yeah, I'm just worried about being addicted to shopping now.
Don't think I didn't see you stowing it all away inside your rigging.
Hey, it's not a crime if you don't fully deploy it.
That's not the problem, it's that your bags aren't in your hands! You can't call it shopping if you're not flaunting your loot.
I mean, just look at the rest of us! We're walking around like queens!
Yes, and you stand out more than you would with your rigging deployed...
Won't hear me complaining. It's all part of the experience, baby!
Oh dear, which bag did I put the food in...?
I'll help with your bags!
There... Hey, Yorktown, do you want some donut holes? Say "ahh!"
Not fair! I wanna feed her too!
Hornet, for goodness' sake... We're not kids anymore.
No, but the Professor's totally raring to do it as well!
*sigh*... Woe is me, the lady with too much to carry and nobody who'll help.
I got you, lemme just... Wait, when'd you get here, Dr. Anzeel?
Like, a minute ago? The same as you all.
I'm here, too, finally free from the layer of hell that is my job.
What did you girls get? Please tell me you bought food. Memphis and I are starving!
Hammann, Hornet, don't you try to hide anything. Bags and hands where I can see 'em!
Whew... I'm stuffed like a turkey. That was delish.
"I take it your meeting with the general went well."
Eh, as good as it could've gone. Turns out he was stressed out because of pressure from his superiors, not anything I did.
When you're someone of his rank, the problems of everyday people stop fazing you. But having that said, the impact of said problems always has a way of trickling down to us.
That pressure on him forced me to make drastic changes to my plans.
Particularly those surrounding the Type II rigging test scheduled for tomorrow.
There's also the naval exercise. The Reality Le– I mean, the reality of the situation is that we'll need you to assist.
"Wait, what?"
Uhh... What I meant was, you'll be playing the role of the commander for the red team in tomorrow's rigging test
I will play the role of your opponent, leading a fleet of Federation mass-produced ships.
Yo, rewind! What naval exercise? Nobody said anything about that!
Indeed. That wasn't exactly part of the plans we received.
That's putting it mildly. It totally came out of left field.
They turned what was supposed to be a simple benchmark test and target practice into a full-blown naval exercise, completely unannounced.
Whoever green-lit the decision also deliberately omitted a combat script, saying that the exercise's scope depends on actual combat performance.

In other words, we don't know a damn thing. Nothing about what enemies we're going to be up against, what equipment they're going to have, what "unexpected situations" we'll need to prepare for, nada.
Apparently, they're also installing equipment to simulate certain combat environments, and we can expect state-of-the-art weaponry to be in play.
Given the scale of the exercise, expect it to be unlike anything you've ever seen before.
Mm... I get the feeling that there are gonna be a lot of unknown variables and unpleasant surprises thrown in.
I wonder why they're in such a hurry to push out all this new equipment that hasn't even been listed on the registries yet. It must be a really big deal to them.
The cutting-edge Type-II hull-fusion rigging hasn't been perfected yet, but it's apparently able to draw out a lot more power than before even in an unfinished state.
Therefore, it makes sense to want to get a benchmark of our new power as soon as possible so they have some ballpark numbers they can reference.
Now that's music to my ears. It's been a while since I've gotten to flex my muscles.
Plus, I really want to see what I'm capable of after all that sweat, blood, tears... and new gear!
Agreed. This is a good opportunity to challenge ourselves and test our mettle.
Knowing your strength on paper is good. Knowing your strength in practice is even better.
Heh. I had a feeling you'd all be on board.
Oh right, Doctor. Did you say something about the Professor participating in this exercise as well?
Well, naturally. Since the whole timetable got pushed up, that also necessitates some staffing changes.
After all, can you name a single person more fit to be a commander than my assistant here?
I see! Thanks, Dr. Anzeel, that works out perfectly then!
Heheh. You can repay me by putting on a stunning performance, then. Who knows, maybe you'll get to participate in more projects in the future as well!
If you impress the evaluators, maybe you'll get to spend more time working with the Professor here as well~
Work hard to get more work, huh? Sounds like a bad deal, but I'm in.
Agreed. I've never had a reason to doubt the Professor's knowledge or experience.
Alright then. Since we're all on the same page, I guess we'll be calling you Commander from now on~
Haha, I like the sound of that! Maybe I'll have to jump on the bandwagon as well~
What do you say to that, my assistant?

options.content: "Just couldn't resist saying it again, huh..."

scripts.say: Commander. That is the title most familiar to me, after all.
"Commander" it is. We'll go through the exercise in greater detail later. For now, we've got another hour to ourselves before it's time to head to our accommodations for tonight.
Where are we staying? The university?
If only. I can pull strings and bend rules during daylight hours, but accommodations are outside my jurisdiction.
Sadly, we'll be staying at a base near the exercise area.
Darn. Oh well, that doesn't sound too bad.
Just with one tiny caveat. All their bedrooms are double rooms.
Wait, how do you know that?
Hehehe... I expected something like this might happen, so I did a bit of research.
Oh boy. So that means...
We'll all share a room with someone else, I suppose?
Bingo. Which leads us to the inevitable question–
Who gets to share a room with the Commander?
I know people who'd kill for that chance! Maybe it'll be me... Or maybe it'll be you.
Wh-why are you looking at me like that?!
You don't wanna? 'Kay, we can exclude Hammann~
Hang on! I didn't say anything I didn't want to–
Then you've still got a chance!
*sigh*... Hornet, please. You're making things hard for the Commander.
This is important. We have to work it out one way or another.
But hey, you could be the roomie arbitrator if you have a sound proposal.
Well... If the Commander doesn't mind, I'd–
Seriously? I leave for five seconds, and you all start arguing about who'll sleep with who?
Sorry to burst your bubble, but the Commander and I are staying in separate staff rooms in another building. We have an exercise to plan, y'know.
Laaame!
Do you have a problem with that? Would you rather take my place and spend all night planning?
You KNOW I can't do that! Fiiine. We'll discuss room sharing among ourselves.
Thought so. You have one hour before it's time to go. Decide before then.
Ooh, look! Street food! I used to visit the stands here all the time, and it looks like they've only gotten better since then!
Come with me, Commander. You've GOT to try some of this stuff!
Anzeel drags me right back outside to the street vendors. By the looks of things, this night is only just getting started...
The next day, at the exercise site...
The skies are calm today over the exercise site. As I wait aboard the command vessel, Yorktown and the other shipgirls are finalizing their preparations.
Though everyone's morale is initially high on the surface, that quickly takes a nosedive as I read off the information sent over by Memphis.
The enemy forces consist of everything from old and new mass-produced ships, to combat drones and unmanned carrier-based aircraft.
Not only that, their armaments and formations were specifically formulated to combat shipgirls.
By the looks of things, our opponents are far better prepared for this than any of us could have predicted...
I don't say this very often, but what the hell is going on? Their equipment is all cutting-edge stuff.
They have frigates with anti-air weaponry capable of shooting down entire waves of aircraft, and corvettes providing formidable close-range defenses...
That's not even mentioning their long-range anti-surface missiles that can track moving targets, their high-end radars, or their numerous jamming devices.
This is not a force of comparable strength. It's more like...
They're trying to gauge how we'd do in case of an alien invasion?
I can handle being the underdog, but this is ridiculous! What do they expect from us?!
This is gonna be so one-sided... Those weapons are straight out of science fiction!
One-sided is an understatement. That huge modern fleet, against three carriers, a destroyer, and a heavy cruiser.
Plus the Commander's unarmed command vessel, if you want to be generous...
As if we weren't already at a huge disadvantage, they've even got Memphis in command. Talk about "lured in by the dark side"...
Jeez, she could've at least told us where her forces are deployed before she swore to secrecy.
Unless she never meant to make it easy for us, and was just pretending to be all friendly yesterday...
That would explain why she showed up so late – she was perfecting her evil master plan!
Dr. Anzeel was with her, so she must've had SOME clue of what Memphis was up to.
I think she purposely told us nothing because she has faith in us and the Commander.
Plus, Memphis hasn't gotten the Type II upgrade, so she might not be able to join our side even if she wanted to.
At the end of the day, the purpose of this exercise is to test OUR abilities.
Regardless of which side achieves victory, we'll demonstrate our full capabilities.
It makes sense to over-tune the enemy as well, considering what we do know about the trajectory of the Revolutionary Front's E-Cube research.
Everyone, just have faith in yourself, and we'll be just fine.
Confidence ain't the problem here. Fairness is.
"Hornet has a point. The odds are heavily stacked against us in every meaningful metric."
"However, that does not mean that we don't have options."
"Let's think about frigates, first of all. They form a sturdy anti-air screen, but these mass-produced vessels must be controlled finely to achieve maximum effectiveness."
"Memphis can't possibly control them all by herself, meaning there have to be command ships that relay commands as intermediaries."
"Neutralize those, and the mass-produced ships will be thrown into disarray. They'll be sitting ducks."

"This will create an opening for us to focus an assault on the enemy line and take out their chain of command. Speedy elimination of key targets is one of the major advantages shipgirls have over conventional warships."
Basically, you're saying we may be outgunned, but have a huge tactical advantage?
"Yes. Your individual power trumps that of any mass-produced ship. If we're able to concentrate that power, we can turn the battle in our favor."
"Issuing the orders that lead us to victory – that will be my job."
The Commander is right. As long as we stay calm and seize whatever advantages we can get, victory isn't out of the question.
Studying modern and past warfare isn't enough. We have to look ahead at how warfare might be conducted in the future as well. The Commander has much to teach us about that.
"Please. I'm just speaking from experience."
Experience that I've accumulated over countless battles against the Sirens, leading shipgirls just like them.
Morning. Have you all finished strategizing?
Oh, you bet. You'll see soon.
Don't expect us to hold anything back with the Commander leading us.
You'd be wise not to underestimate us.
Of course not. I know that the Commander is extremely capable.
As for me, I'm good to go. This is no simulation, and I'm not gonna mess around.
Huh? Did you and the Commander run some sort of simulated exercise in preparation for this?
What? No, I meant... Mental simulations. Planning for your enemy's actions, that stuff.
While this is my first field exercise, I've done hundreds and hundreds of simulated ones before.
Woah, is that what you're doing all day in your room? And here I thought you were...
I'm starting to get nervous now...
Don't worry. Just keep your wits about you, and don't let the enemy get into your head.
Are we done chatting yet?
Dr. Anzeel?! Where were you this morning?
What do you think? Over at HQ, looking for a first-row seat and popcorn.
Let's quickly go over the rules one last time.
The red team's flagship is Yorktown, the blue team's is Memphis. First team to sink or effectively neutralize the other's flagship wins.
Simple enough. Everyone got that?
Understood.
Great. Then, let the Type II hull-fusion rigging test naval exercise commence!

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Start of a New Adventure!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Dorm
It's Lunar New Year! I wish you all an auspicious and Happy New Year as one big family! Heheh!
How was that? That was a proper New Year's greeting, right?
No, don't add "heheh" at the end! Greetings are serious business!
So the greeting itself was fine, then! Alright, let's head out to play some games!
Hold it! People are busy with their preparations, and I'm not letting you go out and cause trouble for them!
Tsk. Lame~ Oh, I know! Can I go help hang up the lanterns?
I'm not letting you sneak away when nobody's looking! ...Tai Yuan, keep an eye on Fu Shun and make sure she doesn't go anywhere.
Okay, I will. But... keeping a close eye on Fu Shun can be pretty difficult...
An Shan, we'd like to ask for your help in the kitchen.
I-it's so weird... I followed the recipe almost to a T...
But we've clearly created some kind of Frankenstein dish...
I-I guess I just thought I'd innovate on the recipe a little... Please, An Shan, help us~!
Okay! I'll come help right away!
Things are so hectic now that everyone has their hands full... Fu Shun, Tai Yuan, go help those who need it!
You got it~ Good luck in the kitchen, An Shan!
Now then, Fu Shun, should we go get the lanterns?
Heheh, truth is, those have already been hung up! And now that An Shan's left, I can finally go have some fun!
Why don't you come with me? I just thought of something SUPER fun we could do!
Come with you?! B-but An Shan told us to...
Don't worry about it, nobody will notice. We're just going to check if there's any gunpowder lying around the base to make firecrackers with~
F-firecrackers?! B-but that's dangerous... We shouldn't play with...
What's a Lunar New Year without firecrackers? Come on, do as your big sister says and let's go for a quick lookie. It'll be fun!
But... Umm, please let go of my hand, Fu Shun... At least let me walk on my own...

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Old Warehouse, New Discovery</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy Plaza
Ugh... Where are we even supposed to find gunpowder...?
Ahahah... To be honest, I'm not really sure either! Let's start by asking around!
We can ask, but if they don't know either, then... Hey, who's that over there?
Yo! It's Ayanami! And Laffey, too! Who's your new friend?
This is Yuugure. I don't believe you've met before.
Ah... Nice to meet you. I'm Yuugure. I hope we can be friends.
Nice meeting you~ Hey, aren't you guys wearing new clothes? That's gotta be Dragon Empery-style!
Ayanami, Laffey, and Yuugure in new clothes... You look so cute in them...
We worked on them together.
Yeah, we did... We spent a long time making them.
Longer than we'd expected to, yes... But it's fine since we made in time for the Lunar New Year.
Wow, that's really nice~ Oh right, I was gonna ask you guys something!
We're doing something special for Lunar New Year and we're looking for some gunpowder to make firecrackers. Do you know where we could find some?
...Yes, there should be some that we previously used to make fireworks with in the old warehouse.
Oh, really? In the old warehouse? Heheheh, I didn't think we'd be able to find some this quickly~
Oh, I love firecrackers!
They're really fun. They're even better when you make them yourself, though. Then you won't know quite what to expect!
That sounds like it might be fun... I wanna make some too...
Firecrackers are dangerous... But, when used responsibly... in sober mind... they can be quite fun.
T-to the old warehouse? I-I think I'll have to pass... My sister Ariake is waiting for me, and the old warehouse is just a little too dark and scary for me...
Okay. Take care on the way back, Yuugure.
Port - Old Warehouse
...I found it. Over here.
Hehehehe~! So we've got the gunpowder, now we'll just...
I found this thing... oh it's Momopoly...
I found something as well. It's called a sugoroku board... I think?
You found something? Lemme see!
Oh, this thing's called Shengguan Tu... Actually, I'm pretty sure they call it "Momopoly" in the Eagle Union, and "sugoroku" in the Sakura Empire, right?
…I have an idea…
Instead of making firecrackers, how about we just play...
Then it's settled. After we've made firecrackers, we'll play some of this! Heheh, I'll have you know I'm really good at games like these!
Wow, that's cool.
W-wait, what about my idea...

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - An Explosive New Year!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dragon Empery Garden
...This thing... then put this here...
Alright, the firecracker is finished! I'm so good at crafting stuff!
F-Fu Shun, isn't that firecracker a little too big...?
That's no problem! The larger they are, the more fun they are! Okay, guys, step back a bit, I'll light the fuse!
Woohoo! Now witness the might of my specially made, extra large New Year's firecracker!
BOOOM!
W-what was that noise?! Was it you, Fu Shun?! I know you're up to something again!
Oh, crap, An Shan's here... Yikes, guys! I guess we shouldn't have used a whole barrel of gunpowder, ahaha...
Owww... Your firecrackers are scary, Fu Shun! ...I'm sorry, An Shan, I just couldn't stop her...
...Fu Shun! Get over here right now!
Owch... My head is spinning...
"Bang bang"... That sounded more like a bomb...
What's going on? Are we under attack?!
I heard a really loud bang so I came running here... Is everyone okay?
Huh? Laffey, what are you doing here? And what the hell was that noise?
The bang-bang firecracker Fu Shun made turned out to be a lot more powerful than we thought...
I'm so sorry, Enterprise and Lexington. My little sister must've alarmed you terribly... Fu Shun! Apologize with me, right now!
Sob... I'm sorry...
I'm just glad you weren't hurt... But still, a firecracker, huh... Usually, we only light those in celebration of a holiday...

Indeed, firecrackers are quite common during Lunar New Year... We have a legend about a monster named Nian Shou that's driven away by the sound of firecrackers. Although anyone could agree Fu Shun tried too hard...
I see, it's to drive away a monster, huh. Dragon Empery culture sounds pretty interesting.
Since Kimberly and Mullany just came here to learn how to cook, and you're here now too... why don't you stay and enjoy some of the food we made, as an apology of sorts...?
Oh, and if you'll wait a little, the commander and some others are gonna come too~
Uh, I don't think it warrants an apology. But... I'm curious what your cuisine is like, and it would be rude to refuse. What about you, Lexington?
I wouldn't mind either. We've never tried your cuisine before, so if anything you'll have to pardon us if we unknowingly do anything impolite.

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Peaceful Game</size>

scripts.say: Oh, I landed on Community Chest! "Bank error in your favor. Collect 200 bucks."
Geesh... Your luck is out of this world, Fu Shun...
Fu Shun... is OP...
She's unstoppable now...
Heheheh, I win! This sugoroku... Momopoly... Shengguan Tu... whatever it is, sure is fun!
An Shan made some tea for you guys. Here you go~
Thank you. Also, I've been thinking: we all celebrate New Year, but it seems like the Lunar New Year is much more leisurely.
Yep, it's true~ You get to eat lots of yummy food and nobody has work so you get to relax all day~
You don't have to work and you can relax... B-but there's much more to the Lunar New Year than just that!
Like hanging up lanterns, decorating with couplets... Oh, that reminds me, we haven't done that yet...
Then may we help with that? We have to repay you for the lovely tea you made for us.
Definitely. I'd love to get to return your hospitality.
Port - Plaza
Master graciously offered me this elegant dress, however, I'm afraid that wearing it is rather...
Embarrassing, isn't it...
If the people of the Dragon Empery celebrate Lunar New Year in these clothes, then we should not be ashamed of wearing them either.
While I do agree with what Monarch is saying, I believe we should proceed to the Dragon Empery dorm to deliver these goods our Master requested.
I concur.
Miss Chaser, Miss Centaur, Miss Monarch, I must thank you for your cooperation.
Not at all, it is an honour to be of service to you!
Hmph, no need to thank me.
Ahahah, I'll come with you. I was just thinking of having a nice chat with some girls from the Dragon Empery♪
...What a truly fascinating holiday the Lunar New Year is.

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Celebrating Together (Part 1)</size>

scripts.say: *Knock knock*
I'll get it! ...Ah, it's the Royal Navy! Please, come on in.
I hope you are having a pleasant evening. I am Belfast of the Royal Maid Fleet, and these are my companions. We have come to deliver goods as per the commander's request.
Thank you so much! We're really glad you could deliver these for us!
Hehehe~ Happy New Year! Oh wow, look at your Dragon Empery-style clothes~ You're all so pretty!
It was the commander's suggestion. We were told to experience the Lunar New Year mood. I must say I enjoy how elegant and stylish these clothes are.
Good evening~ Ahh, finally a warm house to come into. The Dragon Empery's dorm and garden have such a heartwarming atmosphere.
Ah, the Royal Navy is here as well?
Miss Lexington, Miss Enterprise, it is pleasant to see you again. What is that you're...?
They're helping us hang up the couplets!
Oh, it's the Royal Navy girls! It's been a while.
Oh, they're wearing traditional Dragon Empery clothing as well.
That's right. Let me guess: you're also wearing them because the commander asked you to...
I bought mine from Akashi out of my own pocket. Believe it or not. I have quite a few connections to the Dragon Empery. Ahaha~
And we in the Maid Fleet made our own. Our Master occasionally wishes to see us wearing clothes from another country.
I see. As for mine, Laffey and Victorious made it.
And mine is a theatrical dress. What do you think of this new direction Lady Lex is going in? Ahaha~
Since everyone's here, why don't we have a nian ye fan... Er, I mean New Year's Eve meal together?
A New Year's party, in other words? I believe that too is one of the Lunar New Year customs the commander spoke of.
The goods we delivered also contain enough food for all of the guests. As recompense for having us, please allow us to assist you with the preparations.
Please, you don't need to. A good host shouldn't let their guests help them like this.
Are you sure you don't want us to do anything to help?
Maybe we could help prepare some of this food...
An Shaaaan! Yat Sen's asking for help bringing out the food!
I can help with that too!

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Celebrating Together (Part 2)</size>

scripts.say: Now then, my dear guests, I hope you'll enjoy the food! We have seconds if you want more!
Let's dig in! But everything looks yummy, what should I start with first...
Hehehe~ I can't wait to dig into this hong shao yu, it smells delish~
Calm down, Fu Shun, you don't need to get up on the table!
When there's this much food on the table, it becomes hard to choose which to eat first... Ah, something on your mind, Enterprise?
...Oh, I just thinking about how nice it is that we're all here in one place... All around the same table, having such a good time.
Aha, festivities like these make me want to sing~ But perhaps today, the food matters more.
Nom... Dragon Empery food is so yummy...
Laffey, you're supposed to hold the chopsticks like this, then pick up the food with it.
There are quite a few foods here that I think could easily be added to the Royal Navy menu to help give it a little variety.
...It doesn't look like the commander made it in time to eat with us...
That's okay! There's more enough left for one person! We can deliver it once we're done!
Besides, we have the commander to thank for being able to enjoy this feast together.
I shall personally see to it our Master also gets to savour this delicious food, so please allow me to make the delivery.
Whew, I'm stuffed! Yat Sen's homemade food deserves 5 stars! Now it's time for... Heheheh...
I'm totally stuffed... and when I get stuffed, I get sleepy...
If everyone's had their fill, what do you say we have a Momopoly showdown, Royal ladies? Maybe we should give you a handicap too, since this game was made in the Union?
Are you challenging me? Then come! My unrivalled excellence shall be proven to you on this board!
Sounds interesting. May I play as well?
Eek! T-the lights just went off...
Wah! Someone turned off the lights... I haven't even finished eating yet...
GRRRRAAAAWWWHHH!
That noise...
Is that... the Nian Shou...?
No, that can't be, it's just a myth...

sequence:
Lunar New Year!

<size=45>Chapter 7 - A Lively, Happy New Year</size>

scripts.say: Unf... Flipping the light switch doesn't do anything... I think the breaker has tripped.
It's pitch black... I'm just gonna sleep. Night night...
I hear something...! I believe there is something down the hallway, drawing closer.
I think there is something at the end of the hallway...
C-could it really be...
(Mwahaha, my plan's going smoothly! Now I just need to use my Custom-Made Firecracker Machine MKII, and the excitement should reach its climax, just as planned...!)
Goooo! ...Wait, did something just...?
The firecracker hit one of the walls in the corridor and bounced back, landing right at Fu Shun's feet.
Oh my gooooosh! Stop, don't explode!
BWHOOOOOOOM!
The lights came back on at the same time as the firecracker went off.
Agh... How could I fail at the very, very end... This sucks...
F-Fu Shun?! Are you hurt?!
*Cough, cough*... Not again, Fu Shun! You'd better be prepared for your punishment after trying to do something this stupid! ...Wait, huh?
She's covered in soot...
Despite the failure... that was still a really intricate practical joke she came up with. Hahah.
Oh dear, you've been very naughty, Fu Shun. But it was still surprisingly good entertainment.
Whoa, that was scary... I had no idea how that'd go... Uh, what's everyone looking at? Is there something on my face?
...Yes, you should look in the mirror.
Aha, ahahaha... I'm a mess...
Geesh... Go to the washroom and clean your face already!
This is a rather amusing turn of events, ahaha~
Kay, I'm done washing my face~
Now then, I will take my leave to deliver this food to our Master.
Yeah, go ahead. It's all thanks to the commander that we got to have this nice night together. We have to express our thanks.
Hey, An Shan, we should go visit the commander too!
Yes, Laffey and I think we should go too.
Ahaha, then may I suggest we have an afterparty in the commander's office?
Yeah!
Well, look at that... There's still an extra firecracker left behind... Heheh, let's just light the fu...
Fu Shuuuuuuun!

sequence: <size=51>“...I thought... by defeating all of my enemies... I’d finally get some peace.”</size>
<size=51>“But... this world's future has betrayed us.”</size>
<size=51>“Even if my wings break, my guns melt, and the steel of my body creaks, this war will not end
<size=51>“The faces of the friends who stood beside me disappear one by one... until I can no longer remember them.”</size>
<size=51>“...Let us sally forth once more”</size>
<size=51>“...The stars are mesmerizing tonight.”</size>
<size=51>——Mission Codename: Fallen Wings</size>

scripts.say: This is the area indicated by that mysterious signal... Seems like we were too late.
How terrible. Everything's been reduced to rubble.
Who exactly... has the capacity to wipe out a Mirror Sea, the Sirens' testing grounds?
You reckon the Sakura Empire's "Reborn Combined Fleet" is behind this?
Doubt it. The traces left behind point to the Eagle Union's own weapons rather than anything from the Sakura Empire or Royal Navy.
Damn it! What the hell's the meaning of this?!
...Well, whoever it is, they spared us the trouble of having to mop up the enemy ourselves. I'll make sure to buy 'em a drink if we ever get a chance to meet.
In any case, let's take a look around and see if we can gather any useful intel.
This is the area indicated by that mysterious signal... Seems like we were too late.
How terrible. Everything's been reduced to rubble.
Who exactly... has the capacity to wipe out a Mirror Sea, the Sirens' testing grounds?
You reckon the Sakura Empire's "Reborn Combined Fleet" is behind this?
Doubt it. The traces left behind point to the Eagle Union's own weapons rather than anything from the Sakura Empire or Royal Navy.
Damn it! What the hell's the meaning of this?!
...Well, whoever it is, they spared us the trouble of having to mop up the enemy ourselves. I'll make sure to buy 'em a drink if we ever get a chance to meet.
In any case, let's take a look around and see if we can gather any useful intel.
Is this... the new Siren prototype we encountered the other day?
Interesting stuff, huh? An experimental site with a brand new Siren prototype gets completely destroyed. Almost sounds like a conspiracy if you ask me.
Whatever's going on, we have to seize the initiative and reveal the Sirens' objectives – ASAP.
A humanoid Siren is approaching us rapidly! Everyone, prepare for battle!
Hah, trying to get the jump on us, huh? That ain't gonna work!
The new Sirens seem to be mimicking our combat strategies.
Perfect! We'll show them just how big the difference is between true Eagle Union technique and their flimsy imitation!
The special observation target, "Code G," hasn't been captured yet... And now, an Eagle Union task force has come to crash the party.
It seems that the signal secretly sent out by Code G has attracted some unintended guests...
In that case, I'll move my Executors as well. They're rather outdated and don't have much going for them in the personality department, but they should be more than a match for them.
"Should be?" A concept as amorphous as that should not exist within our program.
Don't underestimate them. For now, locating Code G is our top priority.
As for those Eagle Union cowgirls... they can be used for our new combat test... two birds with one stone, as they like to say.
Understood. Diverting system resources accordingly.
Code G... How should I lure you out this time? Heehee...
What, did I break your little toys already? Tell me you brought some tougher opponents for me to smash!
Washington, now's not the time for that. Remember, we haven't finished our mission yet.
I've been running my wide-range scan as far as it'll go, but it's not registering anything other than Sirens!
Heeeey! Whoever you are that defeated the Sirens! Come out already if you can hear me!
Wait, hold on... More Sirens are rapidly closing in on us.
Again? There's just no end to these gadflies, is there?
Bring it on!! My 16-inch cannons are gonna reduce you to steel slag!
Log_AtX15.00252.5.142——Start Recording
Congratulations~ You've defeated all the enemies, which makes you the winner of this round~
As expected of you, Code G. Once again, you've saved the world with hardly a hitch. Heehe.
...Are you mocking me?
We wouldn't dare. After all, you are the connection node to the "wedge" of history ordained by the Creator–
After all, we are all more or less molded from your "factor." To treat our prototype with disrespect would be unbecoming.
Now, as per our agreement, we shall reset the board and allow you to play another round of this "game." What will your decision be?
Continue...
I will keep going... Now matter how many times it takes...
Until I find that person––
I wonder... if all the stars in the night sky are the lights of different civilizations, just as you said...
Could they be just like us... Laughing and crying together the same way humans do?
That's right. We're not so alone in the universe after all.
...I see. Then, do you think I'll ever get a chance to meet them? There are so many things I'd like to ask.
One day, you will. I'm sure of it.
Just like the name given to you suggests, we humans will always keep forging ahead, no matter how tough the going gets. That's what it means to be enterprising.
Speaking of which, I don't think I've ever asked you, but... Enterprise, do you like your name?
Yes, of course.
Then...
How about we make a promise?
Memory module playback has been interrupted. Attempt to restart?
I've just received a strange encrypted communication via friendly channels! I can't determine who it originated from, but... I can decypher it!
A message from our allies, here of all places? Are you sure it's not a trap?
I see something about... Falling? Fallen?
What does that even mean...?
First, hide and seek, and now, riddles? Looks like our mystery person over here likes to play games.
My 16-inchers know exactly how to deal with someone who can't give us a straight answer. Isn't that right?
...Let's not worry about that for now. Why don't we report back on what we've found so far? I'm not too keen on fighting any more of these new enemies...
Don't worry. I've already contacted HQ.
Heehee. As reliable as ever, Helena~
Now then, let's find the source of the signal. You don't have a problem with that, do you, Washington?
Warning. Warning—— The 5th defensive line has been breached—— Warning. Warning.
Warning. Warning—— Destruction of combat-operational units in excess of 82%—— Warning. Warning.
I wanted this world to be kinder, but in the end, that was my greatest folly... Even this power was no match for Them...
In that case... For the sake of survival, I must make this world cruel. Cruel enough so that we can adapt, mutate, and survive.
Under constant selective pressure, we will continue to evolve until finally, a specimen with the power to defeat Them is created.
Countless lives will be lost in the process, but...
Do you see it now? That is the price that must be paid because of human weakness.
Warning. Warning—— A fire has broken out in the second data center—— Warning. Warning.
Warning. Warning—— Observation system front-end has been irreversibly damaged—— Warning. Warning
Looks like this is it for me...
My dear Zero...
I’m here.
Carry out the plan.
The future... No...
Humanity's past... is now in your hands.
Mission accepted.
––Magister.
Hah... At least, let me enjoy the fireworks to my curtain call––
Shoot... We're rapidly being surrounded by Siren forces! At this rate...
Wait, we're already completely boxed in!
When did the Sirens get so good at reading our moves? I've never seen them coordinating so flawlessly before...
Goddamnit... If only South Dakota were here...
Urgh, that doesn't matter right now. We're gonna smash our way out – I sure as hell don't plan on becomin' cannon fodder here!
Everyone, take aim at the large Siren battleship straight ahead of us! All guns, open fire!
KABOOM–––!!
Wh-what just happened?!
What in the world was that...?
The signals from the Sirens around us... are disappearing one after another!
What's going on? I only shot at the ship right in front of us...
My anti-air radar is going off like crazy! I'm detecting large numbers of unidentified aircraft!
Um, you guys...
Who’s there! How did you get behind us?
Aim all cannons, fire!
A new Siren?!
NOBODY sneaks up on me! Take this––!
Wait, Washington! Stop!
The reading I'm getting from this unit matches the previous encrypted messages, but...
(My SG radar isn't picking up anything at all! Is this a malfunction of some sort...?)
...Heh, so you're the one who made mincemeat out of the Sirens? You've certainly got style – I dig that.
We're the Eagle Union’s 16th Task Force, and we came here to investigate after picking up your encrypted communication. Now, state your affiliation and intent.
I just want to confirm something with you.
You're just gonna ignore my question like that?!
Tell me... the name of your Commander.
Sorry, that's classified information. We're under no obligation to share that information with you until you identify yourself.
...So be it. I'll confirm it myself then.
Were you the one who destroyed the Siren base, alone? Just who are you...?
(Wait, that cloak, where have I seen it before... Could it be...?)
Enterprise?!
...You've got the wrong person.

<size=51>“We humans are so small, so fragile.”</size>
<size=51>“But even these small bodies can harbor vast, boundless dreams.”</size>
<size=51>“We work hard, study hard, and keep moving forward so that one day, we can become our ideal selves.”</size>
<size=51>“And if we cannot become our ideal selves, we entrust our dreams to those who are molded after us, and through them, our pride carries on.”</size>
<size=51>“That, is how humanity remains on the correct path. That, is the meaning of your name.”</size>
<size=51>“But, if one day, humanity casts aside its pride and chooses a path that is the exact opposite of our noble ideals...”</size>
<size=51>“Would you be willing....</size>
<size=51>To help us correct the wrongdoings of the future?”</size>

scripts.say: Code G has escaped from the Mirror Sea area. Her signal has been lost.
What a troublesome glitch in the system. Her behavioral patterns defy all principles.
What‘s more, she keeps targeting this specific timespace, just like us.
But perhaps this is due to us being created from the same "factor." In the end, she will come to choose us once again.
It is as the humans like to say–
"The strongest people have the loneliest souls."
Code G... Revel in your strength, now and forevermore. Heehee, hahaha!
My SG radar is picking up on something! Adding unidentified Siren hull type to the database!
Is this... a transport vessel?
Hmm? Do Sirens also have transports? Ahahaha! How convenient for us then!
The transport is trying to flee from this area at high speeds!
Now that we've found it, we can't afford to let this opportunity slip away from us! Helena, have all our forces surround and capture that transport vessel!
As expected... That thing's got some crazy speed. We're not going to be able to corral it in with warning shots...
Luckily, we just happened to get some new toys from Akashi... Take a look at these influence mines.
Influence mines...?
That's right. By laying these, we can block off the enemy's escape route and force it into our waiting arms.
Now that sounds more like it! What's a hunt without some excitement?
Shoot... We're rapidly being surrounded by Siren forces! At this rate...
Wait, we're already completely boxed in!
When did the Sirens get so good at reading our moves? I've never seen them coordinating so flawlessly before...
Goddamnit... If only South Dakota were here...
Urgh, that doesn't matter right now. We're gonna smash our way out – I sure as hell don't plan on becomin' cannon fodder here!
Everyone, take aim at the large Siren battleship straight ahead of us! All guns, open fire!
I'm seeing more enemy readings on my SG radar! Their ranks seem to only be growing!
How in the world did so many Sirens make their way here...?!
Looks like they're trying to overwhelm us with sheer numbers.
They're not gonna give us an easy opportunity to break through their defensive line either...
To hell with it! Let's send as many of these Sirens as we can to the bottom of the sea before we run out of ammo!!
Hold on! The enemy readings are rapidly decreasing one after another!
I see it too! I'm getting a large number of readings from my anti-air radar! ...But, whose planes are those?!
Wh-what?!
...What just happened?
What's going on?! I only just started firing at the enemy in front of me...
...All the Sirens in the area have completely been annihilated. Helena, do you know what's going on?
No clue. I'm not seeing any signatures remaining on my SG radar either.
Wait, there's still someone watching us.
Hey, whoever you are! I know you've been sneaking around this whole time! Come out here and fight us fair and square! I already have you in my sights!
Don't think I'll let you get away! Main battery––!
Stop! Washington!
The reading I'm getting from this unit matches the previous encrypted messages, but...
(My SG radar isn't picking up anything at all! Is this a malfunction of some sort...?)
...Heh, so you're the one who made mincemeat out of the Sirens? You've certainly got style – I dig that.

I just want to confirm something with you.
You're just gonna ignore my question like that?!
Tell me... the name of your Commander.
Sorry, that's classified information. We're under no obligation to share that information with you until you identify yourself.
...So be it. I'll confirm it myself then.
Were you the one who destroyed the Siren base, alone? Just who are you...?
(Wait, that cloak, where have I seen it before... Could it be...?)
Enterprise?!
...You've got the wrong person.

scripts.say: “To them, the Great One spake: 'I saw Lucifer fall, like a bolt of lightning descending from the sky.”
“Those who followed in rebellion were warped and twisted, but it is said that their fallen wings were not torn off.”
“That is because the Great One could not bear to see His most beloved work sullied, and thus allowed them to glow even from the depths of the Underworld.”
Humans really do write the quaintest stories.
But, Tester and Purifier... Indeed, these lower-level terminals do not have the ability to hold her back.
In that case... I must ask you to descend into the "Underworld" to call forth those children.
...My "Arbiters."

sequence:
Winter Pathfinder

<size=45>1 Situation Abnormal</size>

scripts.say: Port - Northern Parliament Lounge
Everyone, I've returned.
Oh, nobody's here?
Kuybyshev, a cruiser of the Northern Parliament, turned her gaze down to a sheet of paper on the salon table.
"Fairy Magic"?
Caught your interest, Kuybyshev?
(That's an odd look on her face. It must be a code name for a major mission.)
(Belorussiya is here, too... It's certain to be important.)
Rossiya, Belorussiya. Would you mind telling me what's going on?
Have we been given a new mission?
Actually, Kuybyshev, it concerns you more than it does us.
Ahem!
Ah, my apologies. I've said too much already.
May I offer you this coin as a token of apology, Rossiya?
Oh, I'll gladly take it. Thanks.
(Isn't that coin from Akashi's shop? What's going on...?)
Now, allow me to pass on the orders handed down by the Northern Parliament.
(I just got back from one mission, and now they have another for me? Work never ceases...)
Yes, Comrade. If there's anything I can do to further our goals—
You are to obtain Akashi's coins and find the fairies' treasure hidden within this port.
See it done, Pathfinder.
What was that all about? Is there no mission?
(Maybe it's some sort of code... No, that has to be it!)
"Fairy Magic," hm?
Right. It looks to be code. And if these are Akashi's coins...
My, are you... Theseus of the Royal Navy?
That would be me, the fleet's dearest Little Witch!
Little Witch... Could this be code, as well? You are floating, after all.
Knowing that Akashi's involved in this, I wouldn't be surprised if she had some way for you to float.
It's much simpler than that. Witches fly! Ergo, not surprising that I would fly.
So? Searching for the fairies' treasure, are you?
I suppose. What about you, Theseus?
Same! The treasure does tickle the imagination, does it not?
(Everyone's acting strange, but maybe that's because of the mission?)
Either way, you'd better get your hands on it if you want to help your friends, Pathfinder of the Northern Parliament.
But it's a treasure, which means everyone wants a piece of it. Don't think I'll let it go that easy!
Eyes open, got it? ♪
I see. You mean to say that the Royal Navy has their hands in this mission, as well.
But my only clue is that it's a treasure... This looks to be a difficult quandary.
Yet I must do it! For the Commander, and for the others.
It falls to Kuybyshev to crack this case!

sequence:
Winter Pathfinder

<size=45>2 Friends Block Your Path</size>

scripts.say: Port - Main Plaza Set
With binoculars in hand, Kuybyshev decided to go over the information she'd found in her investigation so far.
I thought that structure in the plaza to be one of Akashi's sets, but it's plausible that it might be connected to this mission.
Based on Avrora and the Commander's movements, it seems reaching the center of it is their objective.
Oh? You're...
Pamiat' Merkuria?
Pssh, whoever could that be?
I am the great Grand Magus, and my companion here is the slightly-less-impressive Warlock!
More code words? Or are these codenames for the mission?
...Know me as Pathfinder. Step aside.
Bwuh?
Am I misunderstanding something here... "Grand Magus, slightly less impressive than the Warlock"?
H-How dare you...
Wait there a second!
Apparently frazzled for some reason, Pamiat' pulled Gangut away by her sleeve and whispered madly at her.
(You heard that, right?! Kuybyshev mixed us up!)
(Or did she intentionally mix us up as a joke? Does Kuybyshev "do" jokes?!)
(Everything's all wrong! Whose stupid idea was this in the first place?!)
(What do you want me to do about it?! If we invited her normally, she'd be too considerate to accept!)
(Nrrrrgh...)
(Very well. We let Kuybyshev through for now. Is that acceptable, Gangut?)
(I suppose? But what do we do after that?)
(What do you wanna do? Go drinking until the event starts, maybe?)
(Now you're talking, Pamiat'! I'm in.)
(Then it's decided! All we need to do is get her to leave us alone!)
Erm... Have you finished your discussion?
Ahem. Thank you for graciously waiting, Pathfinder. We've settled our matters.
Upon much reflection, we have realized that we don't particularly care about this treasure.
As such, we entrust these coins to you, representative of the youth.
The Fairy Coins I bequeath to you are necessary items to find the treasure you seek.
Only one person, the one holding the most coins, can obtain the treasure.
And when you find that treasure...
My only desire is to let my comrades feel the warmth of victory. The treasure doesn't really matter to me.
A-anyway, just go to the center of the set! Go there, and you'll understand!
Now, Kuy—ahem! Our job here is done. Accept this coin and this wand.
Right! Take my hat and coin as well, Comrade Pathfinder!
There you go! Okay, you're free to pass now.
Don't get distracted, now. Have fun!
I pray for your success, Pathfinder!
Pamiat' Merkuria and Gangut forced Kuybyshev to take the coins and then rushed away from the scene.
...This seems to be more serious than I'd once thought.
Regardless of whatever this "treasure" might entail, the shipgirls are all too focused on it to hold their own in a fight as things are.
I'd best wrap up this mission quickly.
It sounds like there are others trying to collect coins here, as well...
Kuybyshev gazed in confusion at the hat and wand that had been foisted upon her. Were they meant to be a disguise?
I don't like it much, but I suppose there's little choice.
Perhaps disguising myself as a member of staff rather than a participant will make things smoother.
Pamiat' and Gangut seemed awfully serious about it, so it's surely worth trying.
I'll put on a robe and wizard hat, and I'll hold this wand... Okay. This should do it!

sequence:
Winter Pathfinder

<size=45>3 Intermezzol</size>

scripts.say: Main Plaza - Rest Area
Avrora showed me to the set's break room, where the staff was already buzzing with excitement.
Slrrrp... Aah. You have my thanks for bringing refreshments, Avrora.
Hm? Pamiat' and Gangut?
It seems you've had your coins taken by an invitee.
You could say that.
Kuybyshev didn't hesitate for a moment. She got us good, so we had to give her our coins.
We totally didn't give them away because we wanted to come and drink vodka, okay?
That would be why I gave mine away, actually.
"Seems like the mission is proceeding exactly as planned."

options.content: "Do you think Kuybyshev is having fun?"

scripts.say: Hmm, I dunno. I did see her watching this set with binoculars before...
She may see it as more of a mission than an event to have fun at.
But who knows? Maybe that's fun for her.
So this is where the fairies have gathered!
For some reason, one of the invitees—Theseus of the Royal Navy—came into the break room.
Impressive of you to find this place, Little Witch.
Given your appearance, I presume you've collected nearly all of the necessary coins.
I sure have. After all, my magic lets me fly! Might as well put it to good use.
I decided to play along with the Commander and liven things up with some fantasy vibes.
That is appreciated. You will join us in the battle for the summit, won't you?
On that note, there's something I'd like to try during this final showdown...

sequence:
Winter Pathfinder

<size=45>4 Battle for the Summitl</size>

scripts.say: Port - Main Plaza Set
These must be Akashi's coins. They don't seem particularly special, though.
Supposedly, I can find the fairies' treasure once I have enough. And then...
Oh? A box?
She noticed a box right in the middle of the road before her.
Aah, aah... Ahem. The chosen one who is prophesied to obtain the fairies' treasure will soon appear.
But do not lose hope. This is the final prophecy.
If you can hear this message, you should listen well to the fairies' words.
You must take the fairies' final gift and do battle with the chosen Little Witch.
Take it as one final ray of hope in your quest for the treasure.
This will be your final battle. Only the victor may cross the threshold of truth.
Have faith in miracles, in magic, and in the light of dawn...
And walk onward toward ultimate victory!
The fairies' final gift... Would that be this box?
Kuybyshev turned the box over and found two of Akashi's coins affixed to the bottom.
If that message was correct, then these should be the last ones I need.
I still have no idea what's going on, but if the others are involved, then it's up to me to help them.
As for doing battle with the Little Witch...
That means Theseus will be my opponent.
She should be with the treasure already. Forget the investigation; I should defeat her and end this mission as soon as possible.
Okay... Let's go!
Main Plaza - Rest Area
"It took some doing, but it looks like we've succeeded in drawing our new allies to the final stage."
Thank you for trusting in my plan, Commander.
If we'd let her keep up her search, she might have found this rest area like Theseus had.
And wouldn't that be a mess!
So it's about time we wrap this up and put on a good show before everyone gets too tired...
Port - Main Plaza Set
In the plaza adorned by Akashi's set, the two chosen invitees were drawn together by fate.
One was Kuybyshev, of the Northern Parliament. As for the other...
I had a feeling you would be my final opponent, Theseus.
That's right! I'm the Chosen One, the Little Witch!
I hear you've nearly won this little coin-collecting contest. Well done.
Heheh, thanks for the compliment!
So how about you hand over the last of the coins, eh?
I wanna get the fairies' treasure and go on a date with the Knight who protects this port!
There's a Knight now, too...? Well, my apologies, but I won't hand them over that easily.
We may be comrades of the same port, but I fight for the Northern Parliament today, Little Wizard.
It's Little WITCH! Grrr!
Anyway, the whole plan was to have a mock battle here, so have at you!
Open those eyes, everyone! I'm about to WIN this!
I'll be careful not to destroy this lovely set.
It's time to uncover the fairies' treasure... To solve the mystery of Fairy Magic!

sequence:
Winter Pathfinder

<size=45>5 Welcome Party</size>

scripts.say: Port - Main Plaza Set  Mock Battlefield
A battle began to unfold between Theseus, who used her broom-like rigging to fire off planes, and Kuybyshev who fought them off.
Though they couldn't put their full power on display in the port, their masterful technique allowed the battle to unfold like a glorious dance.
But eventually, a victor emerged.
Ack... Okay, I give up! You win.
Congrats, Kuybyshev! You did great!
It looks like we have a winner!
Hooray! Gangut, Kuybyshev won!
Comrade Kuybyshev, beautifully done! You've given them a real taste of the Northern Parliament's power!
Oookay...?
Um, are you telling me...
Congratulations. You've won the Fairy Coin Collecting Contest with aplomb!
As for the fairies' treasure... You've won a ticket good for one day with the Commander!
Come, Commander. You must give the victor her prize, no?
Wait, but...
Err... So this was never a mission or an exercise? It was mere play?
"Exactly."
*sigh*... I had a feeling, you know, but it's embarrassing to hear it outright.
Frankly, all I wanted was to find out why everyone was acting so strange. Now I've made a fool of myself.
But thanks to you all—especially Theseus—I'm in a much more festive mood now. I've forgotten all about my investigation.
Either way, I'm glad that I could assist you all without causing any undue trouble.
Yeah! Congrats again for winning, Kuybyshev.
I had a lot of fun thanks to you, too!
You're too kind. I'm overjoyed to have both achieved this heated victory and livened up the event.
Never will I forget this day. Thank you all.
It may not be the best way to show my gratitude, but why don't I go back to the dorm and make some piping-hot borscht—
But before Kuybyshev could go out of her way to be so kind to us, we announced the beginning of today's main event.
A few days later, Kuybyshev visited me in my office.
There were two documents on my desk. One concerned the Fairy Magic event. As for the other...
Consider the first one a report on my own impressions of the event.
Thanks to you all, I've come face to face with some of my own inadequacies.
My foolhardiness in trying to solve problems all alone, my thickheadedness in refusing to notice my comrades' goodwill...
As for the other... It's an investigation into your holding a welcome party for us without prior approval.
You've made a mistake, Commander, in indulging us without first deferring to the rules of the port.
After giving me a token scolding, Kuybyshev placed a certain ticket on my desk. And then...
You'll have to explain yourself during our date today, Commander. Heehee!
Our guiding light Kuybyshev bashfully extended her hand.
(A promise is a promise. It looks like I'll be spending the rest of the day with her.)
My honourable {dorm3d}, may I ask you a question?
Have you had any favourite foods lately? I was thinking I should... practice and get better at cooking.
Wait... By asking so directly, I've surrendered the opportunity to surprise you...
Umm... Please forget I asked anything.
Do you like the scent I've chosen today, my honourable {dorm3d}?
This aroma is meant to provide you with the most fulfilling sleep possible.
Won't you please stay here a little longer?
I wish to be by your side and serve you.
主人，您身为指挥官，因为工作方面的需要也游历过许多国家……
可以告诉Sirius，您眼中最美丽的风景在哪里吗？
Sirius会想办法让这里接近您记忆中的风景，这样您每次来也会觉得更惬意一些。
比起这个，我更好奇Sirius眼中最美的风景是什么？
是与您相处的每天，每个时刻。
只要您出现在Sirius的视线范围内，那对Sirius而言就是最美丽的风景。
Sirius……也有这么“肉麻”的时刻啊。
Sirius只是将心中的答案如实地传达给了您哦。
无论何时何地，只要您出现，您耀眼的光芒就会成为Sirius眼中最美丽也是最极致的风景。
请让我一直看着这样的风景和光芒……
也请让我永远永远，陪在您的身边——我骄傲的主人。
Are you interested in sword maintenance?

options.content: I might be interested in hearing about it.

scripts.say: Hmm... You probably won't get it if I explain everything with words. I'll show you how it's done next time.
The sharper the blade, the more care it needs.
If you treat your sword well, your sword will treat you well when it really matters.
It's kind of like... how you are to me...
You look quite happy today, my honourable {dorm3d}. Did something auspicious happen?

options.content: Yeah. I got to see you.

scripts.say: Oh gosh...
Nothing fills my day with joy more than getting to see you, too.
You mean this magazine?
It's the latest volume of Port Vogue, which is like a fashion mag...
I mean, we're not at the Academy anymore. Sometimes, I want to figure out my own personal style, y'know?
I bet you'll like it, too, honey.
Phew! I win so much more often when I game with you, honey.
Since you block their attacks so well, I can hit 'em with all I've got!
I never could've stood a chance without you!
Hm? Whatcha got there, honey?
You asked me for it recently, didn't you?
Oh! You mean the mixed fruit juice I loved back at the Academy?
Thank you so much!
You're so cool for remembering.
Let's drink the first glass together! Cheers to our memories!
Phew...
(Open the curtain.)
Urk... Too bright!
Enough pretending you're still asleep.
Hehe, caught me, huh? I've been waiting this whole time for you, honey!
*sigh*... I'm so tired. Honey, can we go to the cafeteria?
Sure. It's about time for lunch.
I wonder who's on duty today!
Do you ever end up on cooking duty?
Not normally... If you want me to, though, I could think about it.
Honey, there's something I want you to do for me.
Yeah?
What is it?
There's this scene in a movie I saw... Near the end, the girl runs up and hugs the boy by the window after school. I wanna try it.
Just imagine it...
Hehe, did it excite you as much as it does me?
What the...
Why'd you bring the drill plans over, honey?
Basically...
Aww, that's rough~ The indomitable Black Dragon will help you, though! Next time, bring something more fun!
Or else even I'll get mad at you...
{dorm3d}，{dorm3d}？
Hm...? You shouldn't be sleeping right now.
You came to hang out in my room, so no falling asleep alone!
Just looking at you is making me all... sleepy, too... *yaaawn*...
Oh, this coat? Hehe, pretty cool, right?
But it's no ordinary coat. Get this...
Back at the Academy, honor students would wear this baby up to the podium to give speeches.
I've always thought it was so cool since then.
Yeah, you're just as cool as back then... No, you're like 200% cooler now!
Wanna try my home cooking? Even when it comes to food, the Black Dragon is supreme!
I can even make Iris cuisine! It's just that cleaning up after kinda sucks...
Sounds like even the great Black Dragon has a weakness after all.
A weakness... Don't be silly! Either way, I know you'll take care of it for me!
Hey there, honey! You're just in time! Wanna watch a movie?
I just hit the climax of this thriller.
If you get scared, just snuggle up to my shoulder, and you'll be fine.
The indomitable Black Dragon will protect you!
Snacks? Heheh, you've asked just the girl!
I get it. It's nice to have a snack when you're watching TV or playing games, right?
If you can't spare a free hand, I'll feed you!
Open up. I just know you'll get addicted to my special buttered popcorn!
Honey, have you had enough water today?
Juice and coffee alone aren't enough!
Huh... You mean I have to drink as well? I'm kinda fine, though.
Ugh... Okay, if that's what it takes to get you to hydrate...
I'm honestly embarrassed that you're the one looking after me now.
Add a little cream here... Some raspberries to balance the flavor...
What are you making?
Perfect timing! Taste this for me, honey.
It's, uh... dizzyingly sweet...
I bet! This is my original recipe for... Honey? Honey?!
You're looking a little pale.
That's enough work for today. Let's grab some popcorn and watch a movie together!
Like they say, all work and no play makes me a dull girl!
It's okay. If there are any problems at work, we can think about them together!
Honey, help me cut this... Ack!
Show me your hand! Geez, you need to be more careful...
We gotta treat this, and fast! Actually, maybe we should go straight to the medical team?
It's just a scrape. Regular first aid will do just fine.
Are you sure? Ugh, I feel like I'm about to have a heart attack. Are you SURE you're okay?!
If you wanna hold hands, don't hesitate to try...
Here. My hand is available any time!
Is my palm hot?
Pssh... I think you're just imagining that... Haha.
Come to think of it, we don't talk about this much.
But for me, it's gotta be gangster flicks. Heheh, does that surprise you?
Bam! Right through your heart. Isn't that the coolest?
One, two... Jump!
Wow! Good thing you were here... I could've taken a bad tumble.
These new dance moves are a little hard, but I promise I'll master them for your sake!
*yaaawn*... I-I'm not sleeping!
I thought I'd get more time with you today if I got all the work done last night, so...
*sigh*... Let me just hold you for a while. I might doze off a little... Zzz...
Phew, I'm beat!
Honey, don't you think it's about time I get a reward?
Like, saaay... A date outside the port?
Hehe... I already know where I wanna go. You're gonna love it!
Where do I want to go?
There are lots of places, but... none of them are better than here.
This bustling port, the person I love...
That's the real Black Dragon's treasure!
Oh, you want to see that sapling we brought back a while back?
