One leaf... and a three-leaf clover...
Make a four-leaf clover! We get to have... four times the happiness!
Near {dorm3d}... Anchorage can hear your heartbeat!
Thump thump, thump thump... When we're close, I can hear it really well!
{dorm3d}... It just got faster! Thump thump!
Anchorage is thump thumping, too...! Listen, {dorm3d}!
Anchorage loves rainbows...! All sparkly... like a big bridge!
A biiig bridge... Anchorage on one side, {dorm3d} on the other...
{dorm3d} is sparkly, too!
When I want to see you... will you come from the other side of the rainbow?
If you're busy... Anchorage will come to you!
Anchorage couldn't make desserts before... but I learned how this time!
I'll make you some! What do you like, {dorm3d}...?
Macarons, Mont Blanc... lemon tarts, Napoleon cake...
Oh... Anchorage can't make those! The recipes are too hard... but Anchorage can bake cookies!
Hard cookies...! Try some, {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d}... Anchorage wants a secret base!
One that nobody can find... where we can talk lots!
Where would be good? Under my bed... A tent...?
Hmm... Let's make a big treehouse!
Where we can do anything we want... without anyone knowing! Hehe...
Anchorage... wants to go to the amusement park!
High up on the Ferris wheel... Looking at the port from the very top!
And then, and then... A haunted house... {dorm3d}, you're not scared, right?
Anchorage will hold your hand tight... So it won't scare me!
{dorm3d} and the amusement park... So much fun!
Anchorage did something bad... I got paint on {dorm3d}'s papers...
Anchorage is bad... Punish me, {dorm3d}...
Are you going to slap my hands? Or...?
I'll take my punishment...! And I'll do better next time...!
My back itches... Anchorage's hands can't reach... {dorm3d}, help!
{dorm3d}, rub my back...!
Anchorage learned a new word...! It's... ex-er-shun.
Learning from books is only half of it... You need to do something yourself to learn better.
{dorm3d}, come do ex-er-shun with Anchorage... to learn together!
*pant* *pant*... Tired... Oh! {dorm3d}!
Anchorage is filling up balloons today! I'm trying hard... but they won't get big...
I blew them up, but they just keep getting smaller...
Hmm, this is hard...

options.content: Did you forget to tie them?

scripts.say: I don't know... I'm tired...
But there's still... a lot of time in the day for us!
{dorm3d}, are there flower fields around here?
Anchorage wants to make a wreath! And give it... to you!
What kind of flowers would suit you? Something that smells... warm and fresh?
Or... some other smell... Anchorage doesn't know...
It's okay! There must be a special flower... perfect for {dorm3d}!
Chocolate sauce tastes good! Sweet and a little bitter... but delicious!
It gets all over me... but I wanna eat it!
Cleaning is hard... {dorm3d}, help Anchorage!
Anchorage... likes happy songs!
Singing is happy! {dorm3d}... happy, too!
When {dorm3d} is sad... Anchorage will sing for you!
{dorm3d}... What makes you happy? Or sad?
Where do you eat? How do you feel...?
Anchorage wants to know... more! More about Teacher...
Anchorage... has decided! To be corrupted... and evil!
Anchorage heard it from a friend! When you become an evil guy... you look cooler!
But... can my hair stay the way it is?
Anchorage knows! I share good things with everyone! And everyone... likes Anchorage!
I don't want to share {dorm3d}... but I know you're everyone's {dorm3d}...
Anchorage is a good girl...!
But... Anchorage wants you to like me more than the other girls...
{dorm3d}, has Anchorage changed? Have I grown?
When you drink lots of milk... you get big and strong! Anchorage will drink lots!
When I'm big and strong, you'll be happy... right?
Anchorage... is still growing!
Anchorage... bought a rubber ducky!
In the tub, it swims and floats around... and quacks! Like a real ducky!
Baths are fun! {dorm3d}, come play with Anchorage...!
{dorm3d} is spacing out... Noted...
{dorm3d} is speaking to Anchorage... Noted...
I'm writing down everything {dorm3d} does! Anchorage doesn't want to forget anything about you!
Your birthday, what you like... Everything you teach me is important! Notes! No forgetting!
But... what if I forget to write it down?
One {dorm3d}... One Anchorage...
Anchorage... is counting!
There's one {dorm3d}, and there's one Anchorage...
So if you put them together... The answer is...
Together forever!
Hehe~ Anchorage counted... Did I get it right?
{dorm3d}... Is today your day off work...? Yay!
You're always so busy! Play with Anchorage on your day off!
Sometimes you work so late... I get worried...
Anchorage likes days off! And your smile!
Hot springs feel good! {dorm3d}, let's go to one!
Don't worry about the season... They're good any time!
Warm and fun... And outside, you can see the stars!
{dorm3d} taught Anchorage about the stars... The Summer... Triangle! Polaris!
All with Anchorage! Hehe!
Anchorage has been... learning to do gymnastics! {dorm3d}, do you want to learn?
The first pose is, umm...
Hmm... I forgot...
But it's okay! I remember... the last one!
It's giving {dorm3d}... a big hug!
{dorm3d}, do you think Anchorage is dumb...?
Do I... get in your way...?
But I'll do my best... for you!
As long as you're here... Anchorage can do anything...!
Paper bunny! I gave you one... as a present before!
Anchorage can fold other animals, too... Like sheep and ponies!
Hm...? {dorm3d} wants a robot? ...Gunboy?
What's that...? I don't know... but I'll try!
{dorm3d}... Are you busy today?
If not... spend all day with Anchorage...!
Yay... Anchorage is so happy...!
In my storybooks... I read about a hero...
If Anchorage was with the hero... what would I be?
A mage... cleric... warrior? That all sounds too hard for me...
Hm...? Anchorage can't join the hero...?
Oh! I get it...! {dorm3d} is the hero!
{dorm3d}... will save Anchorage! Yay! Hehe...
{dorm3d}! Tomorrow... can Anchorage see you again?
And the day after tomorrow... And the day after that? And then that day's tomorrow...?
{dorm3d}, Anchorage wants... promise...
No... Not that you'll come every day...
{dorm3d}... even if you don't come, I'll be waiting for you! That's... my promise!
{dorm3d}, you got hurt earlier... Anchorage can help!
It's okay. I already treated the wound.
I know... a special way to treat it! Like this...
*blooow*... Pain, pain, go awaaay...! *blooow*... Pain, pain, go awaaay...!
Do you feel better now, {dorm3d}?
{dorm3d}, from now on... Anchorage will help you work!
You taught me... really well!
First, sort papers... then classify them... Is Anchorage doing it right?
Hehe, I did it! Anchorage is doing good...! {dorm3d} praised me!
Anchorage loves picture books! So... I want to draw a new one!
The story will have {dorm3d}, and... a very smart Anchorage in it!
But I don't know what it should be about yet...
If I start now... I'll have time! For more wonderful things to happen...!
More stories of Anchorage and {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d}... Let's go take a walk... on the beach!
Anchorage wants to play... in the water with you...
Yay! {dorm3d}... Hand!
Let's hold hands... so we don't get separated...
{dorm3d}... Camping on the beach...
Anchorage wants to try it!
Hehe~ At night... We can look at the stars...
Anchorage will protect you, too... Yeah!
{dorm3d}... Anchorage is hungry!
I'll go catch some fish... and make seafood!

options.content: Then how about we go get tools together?

scripts.say: Okay...! With {dorm3d}, hehe...
Anchorage is happy...!
{dorm3d}... Morning... Run together!
You wanna go for a jog with me?
Yeah...! Running together with {dorm3d}!
If you get tired... I'll carry you piggyback... and keep going!
{dorm3d}... I heard there are starfish here...! Let's look together...!
Anchorage... will try hard to find them... as a present for you!
A surprise for {dorm3d}...!
Aww... I said it... Now it's not a surprise anymore...
I heard a rainbow appeared after it rained yesterday, but I was cleaning my quarters at the time and didn't get a chance to see it...
My acquaintances have told me that if you make a wish to a rainbow, it'll probably come true. What a shame I missed it...
Maybe making a wish to a PICTURE of a rainbow works the same. Wanna try it?
Yes, please! I wish for you and I to...
Oh, wait, my wish won't come true if I say it out loud... Apologies, but I'll have to keep my wish a secret.
On the topic of photographs, I've noticed you take quite a lot of pictures of me.
If you don't mind, I'd like to take a lot of you as well.
I want to build a vast collection of pictures of you, my dear, precious {dorm3d}...
Then I will treasure them forever and ever.
While Sirius and I are chatting away, I carelessly let a yawn slip through.
Do you wish to lie down, {dorm3d}? Please don't be hesitant to inform me whenever you do.
You'll be greeted by fresh linen sheets, soft pillows... and a maid fully ready for you!
And, of course, if you need help falling asleep, I can read you a story or clean your ears. I can also...
Huh? You don't need any of that? I-I shouldn't have made such hasty assumptions...
Do you want to go outside?
I will gladly accompany you, my honourable {dorm3d}! You aren't, um... feeling bored, are you?

options.content: No, I just want to get some fresh air with you.
I just want to spend some time outdoors with you.

scripts.say: So what you're requesting then is... a date? Understood. I will do my best to give you an unforgettable experience❤
Do you have a favorite music genre?
No. In fact, I don't really get much time to sit down and listen to music.
Therefore, I don't have any particular likes or dislikes when it comes to music.
Or, rather, I should say that my favourite kind of music is the sound of your voice when you want to know more about me!
I've been reading books on subjects other than cooking lately.

options.content: Subjects other than cooking? Like what?

scripts.say: Well, almost solely romance magazines and novels.
While I am content with simply serving as your maid... I'm selfish, and I wish to read more about this subject.
I hope you will soon bear witness to my personal growth, my honourable {dorm3d}.
Hmm-hm-hmm♪
I am. My heart is racing now that we're alone with each other. In fact, I was thinking we could–
Huh? You're not in the mood for that?
If it gets any colder, it's going to be a struggle to get out of bed and get to work...
Oh. It appears that you're suffering from a kind of hypersomnia that manifests as the temperature drops, {dorm3d}.
The next time you experience the symptoms, please allow me to be by your side for the whole night!
Then, should you oversleep, I will be there to wake you up.
Do you feel like going for a hot spring bath?
Hm? Are you planning on going to a spa, my honourable {dorm3d}?
Then I'd better not waste any time!
Since you came up with this idea, I will come with you right away!
(Sirius hasn't asked for anything for a while now. I should ask about that.)

options.content: Is there anything you could use?

scripts.say: I truly, truly appreciate your consideration, my honourable {dorm3d}. However, I don't need anything at the moment.
I am content simply to live here and have the privilege of serving you.
Oh? What is that comb for, {dorm3d}? Are you going to graciously comb my hair?
Judging by your expression... was my reaction to that a bit too surprising?
Well, um... I've heard some stories about combing hair from my friends in the Dragon Empery, and...
N-never mind! Please go ahead and comb my hair, my honourable {dorm3d}!
My honourable {dorm3d}, please hold still.
You have such beautiful eyes.
And your pupils, your gaze... I find myself getting lost in them.
Please close your eyes and let me mark the start of a new day with a small gesture.
I feel the grace of a gentle kiss on my cheek.
I used to be an ordinary maid, happy with just being by your side and serving you...
Now, though, as our relationship deepens... I'm becoming increasingly selfish.
Thank you, my honourable {dorm3d} – for changing me.
Was it a good change, though?
I'm not sure, myself... However, I do know that I can no longer be without you.
{dorm3d}, you appear to be feeling hot. Shall I help you bring down your temperature?
How?
First, I'll need to take off your clothes, then I will dry your body with an ice cube wrapped in a towel.

options.content: Won't I catch a cold from that?

scripts.say: Not at all! If you're worried about a cold, don't be. If you catch one, I will keep your body warm with my own!
Liverpool asked me earlier what would happen if you couldn't find me after you tried to contact me, seeing as I don't use my cellphone much.
I thought about it for a bit, and I came to the conclusion that there will never be a time when I'm not there for you.
In fact, if you'll let me, I can be by your side around the clock! I will never let you feel lonely for even an instant!
When did I start harbouring affection toward you, you ask?
To tell the truth, it started the moment I first laid eyes on you.
What about you, {dorm3d}? How long have you felt this way about me?

options.content: It just dawned on me one day.

scripts.say: I wasn't expecting to hear an answer... I am truly overjoyed, my honourable {dorm3d}.
{dorm3d}, I've given the carpet a thorough cleaning. It should be comfortable to sit and relax on from time to time.
N-naturally, if you ever wish to do it with me on the carpet... I certainly wouldn't mind!
My honourable {dorm3d}...
What's the matter?
Oh! My apologies! My inner thoughts leaked out while I was looking at you...
I've been serving you for such a long time, and yet, I still yearn for your attention...
I don't know whether to call myself selfish, or profess how profoundly happy I am...
I found a few detective novels on the bookcase whilst I was cleaning your office the other day.
The cases sound interesting, but I'm afraid I haven't really read much from this genre.

options.content: I could read one of them to you.

scripts.say: In that case, perhaps we could make a habit out of reading a detective novel before bedtime?
Then you won't turn down my request again, will you? Heehee.
My honourable {dorm3d}, is there anywhere you'd like to go on holiday when you're done with your work one day?
I don't know what to say... I'm truly happy to hear those words from you, {dorm3d}.
Even if that day may never come, I will remain by your side forever and ever.
The Dragon Empery has a dish called "duo jiao yu tou," which is fish head with chopped peppers, and the Royal Islands are traditionally a nation that loves fish...
So what I want to try is to incorporate the flavour of chopped peppers into stargazy pie. What do you think of that idea?
That it does... However, I will still try my best!
R-really? Of course – I can always count on you to support me, {dorm3d}!
{dorm3d}, out of all the places you've been, which did you think was the most beautiful?
I will do everything I can to make this place look as close as possible to what that was. This should make it more pleasant for you every time you visit me.
Forget about me – what's the most beautiful place YOU'VE been to?
That place is a moment in time – every moment of every day spent by your side.
No matter the time, no matter the place, your light makes everything look like the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
My honourable {dorm3d}, your face is flushed... Are you suffering from sunburn?
Please, you need to protect against the sun!
I will accompany you around holding this parasol! Also, allow me to apply suncream to you.
Let me take care of your body for you!
Would you like to go surfing with me, {dorm3d}?
It's okay if you're not the best at it. I'm not very good, myself. What matters is that we both have fun!
This way, we can be together more...
And perhaps we can even get a little physical...
{dorm3d}, would you like to have a nighttime barbeque?
I saw you were interested in the idea, so I went and got some ingredients!
Let me help you with those.
That won't be necessary. Allow me to handle it while you rest and relax.
I've worked hard to improve my cooking! I'm sure it will go fine!
Look, {dorm3d}. I made this necklace out of the seashells we gathered.

options.content: Are you going to wear it?
Are you going to start a necklace collection?

scripts.say: Oh, um... I was actually thinking about displaying it as a decoration in my quarters.
Just seeing it will remind me of the time we spent gathering all these seashells today.
{dorm3d}, it's sweltering today. Shall we have some ice cream to cool off?
I like the sound of that.
Excellent. Would you like me to feed the ice cream to you?
Or... would you rather share a single ice cream with me?
You look tired, my honourable Master.
While I am proud of you for withstanding fatigue...
I must ask that you not force yourself so.
Take a moment and come to me, if you please.
You may rest peacefully in my lap, Master.
My honourable Master, would you like coffee? I'll prepare a cup at once.
Hmm. My spare coffee beans were over here... Oh? The pantry is empty.
I'm so sorry! I must be out of coffee beans.
Master... I-if it does not offend, may I offer you canned coffee...?
I'll heat it carefully so that you don't have to suffer the cold!
Greetings, my honourable Master.
Hm? You look tired... Allow me to remedy this.
I've already brewed a pot of coffee to help refresh you. I was simply waiting for you to say the word...
Eh? You want to rest with me for a moment first?
Understood, Master. Is there anything I can do to help make it more restful for you? Anything at all...
I humbly await your orders, my honourable Master!
What music would you like to listen to, Master?
I have everything from classical to top hits. All of my records are brand-new, too.
That's odd... Why isn't it making any sound? Oh, no... Malfunctioning now, of all times?
I-if it would please you... I could sing you a song, perhaps?
Huh? You'd like to join me? I-I will do my best not to hold you back, my honourable Master!
I take it you're aware of the stereotype that everyone from the Royal Islands loves tea parties.
Do YOU like them?
If I had to say, I think I like being the security at a tea party more than the tea party itself.
I want to be the one who protects the tranquility and calm of moments such as those.
Master, I prepared... Well, truth be told, I asked the kitchen to prepare refreshments for you.
Please partake while they're hot. Cookies are best when freshly baked.
Do you want some, too?
M-may I? If only you would feed me by hand, I... Ah!
I-I must apologize! What a ridiculous thing I've said.
I'd be happy to.
...You have my heartfelt gratitude, my honourable Master.
{dorm3d}, I've taken up practicing flower arrangement. If you don't mind, could you give me some feedback on my work later?
It is a maid's duty to provide a pleasant, beautiful environment. As such, flower arrangement could certainly be argued to be a compulsory subject.
An ungainly maid though I may be, I believe I can at least arrange flowers well!
这间宿舍的感觉怎么样……？
很好哦……因为和您的见面频率和独处时间都大大增加了，所以Sirius觉得很幸福。
不过还是有一点不太方便呢。
就是……夜间想要侍奉主人的话……（小声）
……不，好像没什么不方便的，是Sirius没想明白。
……呵呵。
化妆的方面，Sirius好像没有天赋呢……

options.content: 你无论什么时候都很漂亮

scripts.say: 不，我的主人，还请允许Sirius在这件事上反驳您。
身为女仆，在憧憬的主人面前，不仅举止要合乎礼仪，仪表也很重要。
不过……尽管练习了很多次，我的化妆技术却一直没有精进呢。
而且在您的面前，Sirius还是想要尽可能地……再美丽一些。
如果可以的话，希望您能陪Sirius一起练习。
就从……涂口红开始，可以吗？
主人，您为什么一直在看着Sirius？

options.content: 想更了解Sirius的喜好，比如喜欢的音乐之类的

scripts.say: Sirius仔细回想了一下，过去似乎没有什么好好聆听音乐的机会……
所以在音乐这方面，也没有什么可以称得上“喜欢”或是“不喜欢”的内容。
Sirius感到很抱歉，我的主人……
因为主人想要更了解Sirius的喜好，但Sirius完全没有这方面的认知。所以……

options.content: 还没找到喜好也不要紧

scripts.say: 其实……！
Sirius最喜欢的永远是您，我骄傲的主人啊。
最近……Sirius也有在看除了食谱以外的书了。
是和恋爱话题有关的杂志和小说……
虽然作为女仆侍奉在主人身边就很幸福了，但Sirius最近变得越来越贪心了。
想要在这方面再好好钻研一下呢。
请您好好见证Sirius未来的蜕变吧，我的主人。
哼哼♪~
是的，因为主人您来和Sirius见面了。
这是Sirius最为期待，也是最为开心的时刻。
和我骄傲的主人独处一室，实在是令Sirius心潮澎湃……
接下来的时间，不如就……
欸、欸？难道您还没有这方面的想法吗？
抱歉……我的主人，是Sirius太心急了。
（虽然最近天气渐渐热起来了，但总觉得Sirius这里格外热啊……）
欸？是主人您比较怕热吗？
抱歉！是Sirius的疏忽……还请您原谅我的冒失。
不过，Sirius之前从其他人那里听来了一个降温的技巧。
就是——如果觉得热的话，就立刻去洗热水澡。
洗完的瞬间就会觉得十分凉爽哦！
那么，就由Sirius来伺候主人沐浴吧。
还请您不要乱动，Sirius要来为您脱下身上的制服了哦~
说起来，入住宿舍以后……有些事情朝着更好的方向发展了呢。
感谢您让Sirius入住这里，我骄傲的主人。
比如能够像与主人像这样长时间的近距离接触……
而且无论主人要做什么，Sirius都能够在第一时间给予回应。
这些对于Sirius来说，就是朝着更好的方向发展了哦。
Sirius希望，这种幸福的时光能够长长久久的持续下去。
I've heard that people from the Eagle Union sometimes make tea using water boiled in the microwave...
Have you wanted to try that? You mustn't! Heating water in the microwave is wrong!
It will affect the tea's flavour! You may be my {dorm3d}, but even I won't tolerate you doing such a thing!
Sirius最近在尝试将皇家的传统美食与东煌的特色风味融合，做一道特殊的融合料理。
是的。Sirius听说东煌有一道叫做“剁椒鱼头”的料理，而皇家也有吃鱼的传统……
Sirius就在尝试将“剁椒”这种风味，融入仰望星空派。
（好可怕的尝试……）
主人？您的脸色突然变得有些差劲……
我没事，只是有点好奇这道……“剁椒星空派”，目前的研发进度是？
唔，还停留在制作仰望星空派的部分。

“这是一幅描绘了小镇居民正在进行节日采购的油画。”
“面包店前已排起长队，人群聚集在这里，等待着列巴与伏特加。“
这个画面倒是有些熟悉呢……
是啊……不过近两年随着海运的打通与战况的好转。
现在的粮食供应愈发充足，这种景象已经越来越少看到了。
“这是一幅描绘了审判会场的油画。”
“被审判的人是一名试图指挥军舰冲向圣彼得伯格的海军军官。”
指挥军舰冲向圣彼得伯格……看来这场审判的结果已经注定了。
……画面描绘的，依然是未曾听说过的事件。
是军舰不是舰船……有点摸不透这张作品的创作时期与背景呢。
“这是一幅依照古怪风格重绘的抽象艺术画。”
“画面中以凌乱线条组成的北方联合代表，与用整齐线条绘制的人群形成鲜明对比。”
用了这样的艺术展现方式啊。
不得不说，真是抽象得恰到好处……
“这是一幅简笔画，内容似乎是某个建筑上的旗帜在夜幕中缓缓降下。”
“由于是儿童绘制，细节并不清晰，但仍能令人感受到其中蕴含的肃穆。”
……这什么啊，怎么连儿童画也能放到画廊里展示了。
虽然看不清内容，但是看到这幅画，让我有些说不出的不舒服……
同感，看到就有股无名火！

Good morning, nya. Good news, nya!

I see. Is this the "important" thing you had to discuss?

Conveniently, there was a disused factory that Ingraham demolished a while ago, nya. That has cleared up plenty of space, nya.
Wait, you're going to construct new buildings? I thought this was limited in scope to a renovation.
No, we're building from the ground up, nya. It's more profitable, nya.
(She's not even trying to hide her intentions.)
My vision is to create a place where shipgirls can be more comfortable than ever and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life, nya.
Combat and work both take a toll, nya. With a place to better rest and recover, they'll perform better than ever before, nya!
You have to agree it's a pretty good idea, nya.
Can't deny that. It'll help them work and fight with renewed vigor.
Exactly, nya. That's why each home should also be decorated to suit the occupant, nya.~
Each room is going to be tailor-made according to the inhabitant's tastes, nya!~
So basically, occupants can move in without packing their bags or anything.
That's precisely what I'm thinking, nya.
We CAN also build a private space exclusively for you if you want, nya.

It can start right away, nya! Although, there's a catch, nya.
Given the port's resource stockpiles and technology, finishing the actual construction won't take very long...
But, relocating everyone at once isn't feasible, nya.
How come?
Designing and furnishing a home takes time, nya. Everyone could move in at the same time if we were making cookie-cutter homes, nya.
But we aren't, nya! I've already promised to provide every person with a unique residence, nya!
So, the girls will just have to wait for their turn and move in one at a time, nya.
Not ideal, but I suppose that's how it is.

I've already picked someone, nya! One of the Royal Maids, nya.

The office door opens, and a familiar face walks in.
Good afternoon, my honourable Master.
As your humble servant, I am truly honoured to be the first resident of the new dormitory.

..."Experience sublimity surrounded by nature"... "Enjoy some of the local ghost stories"...
..."The elusive Youkai Troupe, which remains a legend"...
"Youkai Troupe," eh... The ad touts it as real, but it's obviously just a shtick to lure in tourists.
It suddenly becomes palpable how silent it is in the office. Everyone's gaze is transfixed on the flyer in Hatsuzuki's hands.
Oh well. I'll go ahead and dispose of it as...
...Wh-why are you all looking at me?
That's the one!
It is?
Of course it is! Summer is the season of testing your courage, and ghost stories!
It sure gets my vote if it means I get to see some sick youkai!
Like from Sakuran legends? Hell yeah, I'm in!
Y-you know youkai aren't real, right? They're just stories!
I say we go for something else, like–
Shinano, what do you think?
Washing away one's stress and fatigue in an onsen... A splendid proposal...
As it also sits on a remote Sakuran isle, we could further invite other factions to experience our hospitality...
Hatsuzuki's objections are drowned in a sea of discussion in favor of the idea.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: Hmm? Because the youkai asked us to.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: The onsen resort gets a looot of customers, but nobody plays with them. So the play and the outfits are like a way to draw them closer.
What are you implying...? That a real Youkai Troupe exists beyond the boundary of the torii gate...?

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: Pretty much. The barrier's entrance is starting to crumble, and it needs people to maintain it, so...
So what seemed like an act of greed on Akashi's part was actually for the greater good... I am sure the guests will adore the youkai...
"Chief"... I have an idea that may benefit everyone...

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Youkai, Spirits, and...</size>

scripts.say: This is a small story from before the Youkai Troupe performed their play...
The Sakuran girls had finished tidying up and returned to their rooms to rest for a while.
Little did they know that something strange was already in motion.
Onsen Resort - Inn Main Building
Is it just me, or does the resort look... wrong all of a sudden?
Yeah... It's almost like it was sent into a bizarro dimension...
It may have something to do with that rumble a moment ago... I'll go see Shinano.
Wait, Noshiro. It's a bad idea to split up. We should all stick together.

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: Hey, Yura... Am I seein' things, or is that cup some new hi-tech thing I haven't heard about?

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: It's kinda... moving on its own.
You're right! It's moving! Oh god, it's FLOATING!
What's going on?! Is there a ghost here?!
Leeeave... Leeeave this place...
You are not welcome heeere...
Eek! The rumors about youkai are true! They do exist!
Leeeave! Turn back and leeeeave! Go awaaaay!
The voice is getting louder!
...I know where it's coming from.
"Silence."
Yura's other Self reached out and grasped something. Somehow, that made the ominous voice disappear.
...A will-o'-the-wisp, hmm?
What? Where? Did you catch something? I don't see anything!
It's too weak to assume physical form, so it's no wonder you can't see it.
Now, what shall we do with you, little one? Something tells me you'll stir up trouble if I let you be...
BEEP BEEP!
Hm? A call from Shinano?

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Run Like a Rabbit</size>

scripts.say: This is a small story from before the Youkai Troupe performed their play...
Onsen Resort - ???
Aha! I knew I wasn't imagining what I saw!
Suruga! Look! Right there!
...Suruga? Where did you go? Surugaaa!
Shimakaze looked all around, but Suruga was nowhere to be found.
Oh no! I must've became so engrossed in chasing that thing that I left Suruga behind!
So busy, so busy... Oh! Miss Rabbit!
Whatcha doing here? The show's about to begin.
Hm? Are you talking to me?
No, I meant the other rabbit beside you. Yes, I'm talking to you!
C'mon, hurry off and let Kappa know the play is starting!
Now, excuse me, there's a ton of other people I've gotta notify!
Whoa! How is it so fast?!
Hmm... You may be fast, but nobody is faster than me!
Full steam ahead!

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Cure Her Social Anxiety
scripts.say: O-okay... I'll be on my way...

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Cure Her Social Anxiety
scripts.say: If you could... tell Yuki-Onna as well, that would be great...
Yuki-Onna, you say? Got it! I'll find them in a jiffy!
Full steam ahead once again!

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: Why, thank you for letting me know, little bunbun.

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: I hate to ask, but could you go and tell Tengu as well?
Full steam ahead once again!

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Who do you take me for? A granny? Hmph. Go and tell–
Roger! Full steam ahead, no breaks!

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Wait! I haven't even told you her name yet! Come back here!
*pant*... *pant*... That was the last one.
Interesting how the youkai are organizing a play... I can hardly sit still just thinking about it!
Come to think of it, I feel like I've forgotten something... What was I doing again?
Oh, right! I was supposed to look for Suruga and I completely forgot!
BEEP BEEP!
Hey, Shimakaze, do you hear me?
Whoa! Speak of the devil! I'm so glad to hear you're okay!
...Okay?
I'm gonna assume something happened while I was gone. What was it?
Nothing! Nothing happened whatsoever!
Oookay then. If you say so.
Anyway, I'm in the theater's reception room with Shinano and the Youkai Troupe. They're in the middle of a meeting.
Think you can make it here?
Oh, has she already gained control over the Youkai Troupe? That's amazing!
Uh... No. They're workshopping a surprise for the Commander's group when they arrive.
Just come here and we'll tell you the rest.
Working together with youkai to create a fantastic surprise... That sounds so much fun!
I just know the guests are going to love whatever they come up with!
I'll be there in a second!
The girls at the time had no idea what their plan would turn into.
Because what began as an innocent surprise would go on to become a major incident...

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Calm at the Onsen Resort</size>

scripts.say: Onsen Resort - Inn Main Building
I've finished airing out all the futons... Now they're nice and soft.
And I finished cleaning the rooms. You won't find one speck of dust in there!

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: Snacks and refreshments're lookin' good, and I just got done setting up my stall. This is gonna be one profitable vacay for me♪
Don't you think it's odd that Akashi just... lets you run a stand?
It's her resort, and I can't think of any good reason why she'd be fine with others earning money she could be making.

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: I mean, she straight-up told me she's busy with somethin' else and she's got no choice but to let me have her biz.
I take it the preparations are proceeding smoothly, Noshiro?
Yes. I just received the final confirmation letter, in fact.
Our visitors will have unrestricted access to the resort, the island, and the surrounding waters during their stay.
I've put in the requests for everything you outlined, so all should be in order.
I'm confident that we, as the hosts, will be able to provide the best possible experience for the Commander as well as all our other guests.
That is excellent to hear...
Incidentally, where are Shimakaze and Suruga? This one hasn't seen them...
Shimakaze asked to look around the resort, so she's on a patrol at the moment. As for Suruga... she went after her to keep an eye on her.
Shall I summon them here?
Nay... Let them continue their patrol...
Onsen Resort - City Streets
Hrmh... Eerie...
Suruga! This place is eerie to the extreme!
Uh-huh? Like how?
It's daytime, yet the lanterns are lit!
It's not "daytime," it's evening. It makes sense to start lighting them now.
So you say, but I've not seen anybody actually lighting the flames!
Because this place is mostly automated. The lanterns turn themselves on when it's time. Noshiro told me.
Oh! That explains that...
But it doesn't explain THAT! See? Something about that torii gate feels mighty eerie to me!
And what is that "something," huh? Fine, it's eerie. So what?
It doesn't matter. It's nearly dinnertime, so let's head back or we'll be late.
Oh! Suruga! Did you see that?!
Ugh. What is this time?
Something definitely flew out from behind that torii gate!
I must look into this! Stay here while I go investigate!
We'll miss dinner if we don't... Hey! Wait, Shimakaze!
Meanwhile, inside the inn's main building...

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Okay, let us move. We wouldn't want to keep the audience waiting.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Cure Her Social Anxiety
scripts.say: I-I can't wait... to see everyone's reactions...

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: *sigh*... Don't go too far with the pranks now, okay?
You needn't tell me twice. I know how to moderate myself♪
Are you... youkai...?
Hey! Who's there?!
How can you see us? How did you even get here?
I sensed a barrier in the vicinity of the resort...
I went to investigate... Of course, an encounter with the Youkai Troupe is not what I expected...
This ain't good, chief! We've been exposed 'fore the show even started!

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Our only option is to subdue her here and now! Do not let the cat out of the bag!
Subdue, you say...?

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Gaahhh! Such power!

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Cure Her Social Anxiety
scripts.say: We don't stand a chance, wearing these costumes...
Aye... Even I am forced to raise the white flag.
Screw it, chief! We need to bail, nya!
"Nya"? Might your true form be...?

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: Quiet. Everybody, quiet.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: I'm... *yawn*... the dream-eater baku, also known as the chief. The Youkai Troupe bids you welcome.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: First of all... Let me make it up to you for how rude the others were.
As you say...

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: Great. I knew you'd be willing to talk it out.

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: *yawn*... So, our troupe has been entertaining the resort for a looong time, and we've never hurt a soul...

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Turn Into a Statue
scripts.say: So, be nice and pretend you didn't see us, alright?

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Spirited Away</size>

scripts.say: Onsen Resort - 2 days later...
Commander, we're almost there!
Commander, we're almost there!
...Why are you parroting me?
I'm just so excited I couldn't think of anything else to say!
Although, it's weird how empty this place is. Shouldn't there be people in the lobby?
The first group that went said they'd come out and meet us...
It IS weird. Stranger yet, Comrade Commander, I haven't received any word from Shinano since we disembarked.
She would never leave us hanging under normal circumstances.
Unless...
Heheheh... This just screams "mystery" to me!
(Something is wrong here. We should head to the main building and investigate.)
Onsen Resort - Inn Main Building
Shinano made the place really tidy... I'd stay here any day of the week.
There are lots of fresh and tasty ingredients in the kitchen too...
I suppose this tea was going to be our welcoming drink... Curiously, the kettle is still warm.
Someone must've been here recently. But who? And where are they now?
This feels eerie... It's almost as if everyone was spirited away!
Commander! Look at this!
Fu Shun gestures toward the dining table, on top of which there's a card radiating an abnormal energy.
And on top of the black and red card, there's a slip of paper with letters in various fonts cut out from magazines. To be frank, it looks extremely creepy.
Wow! Let me read it aloud.
"Dear Commander, ever the wise and brave one..."
"We wish to make you and your fleetmates feel welcome, and have planned the most wonderful play in the world for you."
"Please head through the entrance of the amphitheater. Your companions are waiting for you."
"We cannot wait to see you. Yours truly..."
"...The Youkai Troupe."
Look! It really says "Youkai Troupe" on it!
The same troupe that that flyer mentioned! Incredible! The Youkai Troupe actually exists!
It'd be false advertising if it DIDN'T exist! That doesn't mean they're real youkai, though...
It sounds to me like these "Youkai Troupe" people kidnapped the group that arrived before us.
This goes beyond some little prank. This is dead serious, Comrade Commander.
Well...
Sure, the first group is nowhere to be seen, but I think it's jumping the gun to assume that they've been kidnapped.
You know what this means, Commander. Let us investigate what's happened!
You heard me! Between me, Fu Shun, Kasumi, and Hatsuzuki, we've got just enough people to form an investigation team.
Trust us, we've got this. Let the four of us investigate!
Hold on! Why am I automatically a part of this?
Because it's customary for an investigation team to consist of four people, duh!
Uh-huh... "Customary."
I'm feeling apprehensive about this, Comrade Commander. Should we radio the port and request backup?
I mean, other groups coming to the resort after finishing their respective tasks was our original plan.
While calling in backup feels excessive, I believe we should inform the groups arriving after us about this Youkai Troupe in advance.
Until everyone has arrived, I say we let Bristol and her team conduct the investigation.
Hooray! We'll have this case solved in no time, I promise!

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Entrance to the Dark World</size>

scripts.say: Onsen Resort - Near the eerie torii gate
Foo says this place feels eerie...
Foo? Who's that? And what exactly about it is so eerie?
Foo is just Foo...
Hmm... My investigation lantern is getting brighter and brighter. I think there's a new investigation point just behind this torii gate.
It does match the description that was in the note... The amphitheater must be up these stairs.
Look ooout! Out of the waaay!
A voice cries out from the treeline and is followed by a thud.
Owww...
Fu Shun? I was wondering where you'd gone.
What were you doing in that tree?
Owch... I wanted to get to a vantage point to see if I could find the kidnappers and the first group, but my new booster rocket completely failed...
You could just, you know, ask Saratoga to launch her recon planes for you.
But that's cheating! It wouldn't feel like I'M doing the investigating! Oww...
At least the gang is all together now. All clues point past the torii gate, so I think that's where we'll find the Youkai Troupe's base or something like that!
Come on, team! Let's get in there and investigate!
What?! We're going in just like that?
Let's go, Foo.
Hold up! Let me at least radio the Commander before we–
Hurry along, Hatsuzuki! You're gonna get left behind!
...Okay, okay! Wait for me!
Onsen Resort - ???
Um, just for the record, monsters and ghosts don't scare me! Not in the slightest!
I'm only staying so close because I don't want any of you running into danger, okay?
Sure, I'll believe that~
Good... A-also, haven't we been walking for quite some time now?
It feels like we've been wading through this fog for ages... Do torii gates always lead to stairs this long?
They don't. We should be way past the resort by now.
What?!
But Foo said the fog will come to an end very soon. Our friends are waiting for us.
Friends? Are we finally gonna come face-to-face with the Youkai Troupe?
I dunno... I wouldn't call them "friends," and I'm not too keen to meet them...
Let's just turn back and report this to the Commander!

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: It's too late to turn back now...
PANG! PANG!
Firecrackers panged and popped while multicolored ribbons rained from the ceiling.
Welcome to the amphitheater, y'all!

scripts.factiontag: Wants to Cure Her Social Anxiety
scripts.say: W-welcome...
EEEEEEEK!
Settle down, li'l lassie. Us youkai mean you no harm.
The name's Umibouzu. I'm the vice-chief o' this here troupe, and this here is our youkai theater. Welcome!
And I am Tanuki, the manager.
Wow! You're real! The Youkai Troupe is real!
So you're all youkai, huh? Makes sense why you look completely different to us!
(extremely quiet whisper) Thank god they're youkai and not ghosts...
Was it you who left the calling card in the inn?

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: ...What calling card?

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: We left you an invitation, and no more than that.
You call that an "invitation"?!

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Yes...? Our chief and your leader spoke about this. We are working on a play to amuse the guests.

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: And since we are short on hands, your leader has relocated her staff from the inn to help with rehearsals and preparations.
"Leader"? Do you mean... Shinano?
That explains a lot! The first group just wanted to surprise us!
(extremely quiet whisper) More like scare the life out of us...
The show is about to get started. Just hang on a minute.
I can tell you right now that you're gonna love it!
Awesome! I for one can't wait to see this play!
Foo looks forward to it too.
Wait, what? The play is starting now? But...
But we still haven't radioed the Commander!
As the white mist cleared, the travelers suddenly found 'emselves in a hella snowy mountain landscape!
Wh-where did all this snow come from?!
Achoo! Talk about a scene transition!
Brrr! It's freezing cold... Is this real snow?!
The wind was all, like, super cold, drainin' the travelers of energy and making 'em shudder.
Geesh, y'all really screwed the pooch here. No sane person travels up a snowy mountain in this season.
We didn't exactly WANT to come here! Don't force dumb backstories on us!
I know that's you, by the way, Owari. What's going on here?
I ain't Owari, I'm the narrator!
And you four are, like, travelers. You're a part of the play!
Ohhh. This is "the show" they mentioned just earlier!
I thought we'd sit down in a theater or something. It's even cooler that we get to play a role ourselves!
Immersive storytelling... I like it!
Cool. Then let's carry on.
So... The travelers kept wadin' through the insano blizzard. It was rough.
They were at their breaking point. Freezing, exhausted, and boutta pass out.
But then – bum-bum-buuum – they spotted a hut in the wilderness!
Hooray! We won't have to freeze our butts off out here!
Thank god. Let's go inside, quickly.
The travelers forced the hut's door open with their cold, shaking hands and went in.
God must've felt bad for 'em or something, 'cause the hut was full of divine surprises. There was tons of food and firewood, and the hut's walls were thick and durable!
Phew... We can use the wood to start a fire and warm up!
There's food, too, so we won't go hungry.
Although... doesn't it feel wrong to break into someone's hut and eat all their food?
It's fiiine. This is an emergency, so I'm sure they won't mind!
Let's roast some meat over the fire until nice and crispy. Aaand... done!
Frankly, I'm starving, so I'm gonna dig in right now!
The travelers, free of the freezing temperatures and harsh snow outside, sat around the fire and chewed the fat – and their food.
But then, the door flung open with a thud, and a snowy gust blew into the room!
Brrrr! Someone close the door, quick!
We can't let the wind blow out the fire!
It took a lotta work, but the travelers managed to shut the door. The cabin was quiet once more.
Or so they thought! The realization hit 'em like a cold breeze – someone else was here!

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: Get out.
Huh? Bristol, did you hear that?
No? I didn't hear anything.

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: Get out of here!

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: Foolish mortals! You are not welcome inside my hut! I shall turn you to ice as punishment for your intrusion!
Eek! I-it's another youkai!
Take it easy! Miss Ghost, do you have any way to prove this is your home?

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: I am Yuki-Onna – the snow lady – and I've roamed this mountain for ages upon ages. Everything around you belongs to me!
Everything? Do you have the landowner documentation? What about the hut's construction permit? If you don't, how can you claim it belongs to you?

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: L-landowner documentation? I, uh...
At that moment – slam! – the door swung open, and another snowy gust blew into the hut!
Not again! Close the door!
Stupid mortals! Who gave you permission to enter my hut? I'm gonna turn you into a popsicle as punishment♪
Sakawa?
I'll only say this once, dummy! I am not Sakawa, I am Yuki-Onna!
No, it's painfully obvious you're Sakawa!
I am Yuki-Onna – the snow lady – and I've roamed this mountain for ages upon ages. Everything around you belongs to me!
This is getting out of hand... Now there are two of them!
No! There is only one of me! Now, tremble in fear! Your shipgirl powers do not work here. You are fully at my–
Okay, pause! Which one of you is the real deal?

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: ...What?
She's the impostor! I am the real one!
(whisper) It's in the script, y'know.

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: That's news to me. As far as I know, you're the fake and I'm the real one.
Sooo... there were, like, two Yuki-Onnas in the hut.
But then! The door swung open with a loud thud!
That's the third time now! I'm gonna shut the door tightly this time!
M-mortals... Who said you could go into my hut? You've made me mad, so I'm g-gonna... Umm...
...Turn us into ice?
Right, yeah... I'm gonna turn you into ice...
Seriously, Miyuki?
I-I'm not Miyuki, I'm Yuki-Onna...
Alright, alright, you wanna turn us into ice. Let's be polite and get in line.
There are two more Yuki-Onnas waiting to do the same.
T-two more? But... But I'm the real one...
That's exactly what an impostor would say!

scripts.factiontag: This is Her Acting Master Plan
scripts.say: You're right about that much. I am the real one, after all.
No, no, no! I – me – I'M the real one!
(What a farce. This is gonna go on forever.)
Hmm... Okay, I've figured it out!
She's the real one. The one who's tired of this.
What? You're saying I'm a poser?
How... How do you know it's her?
Come on. It's obvious even at a glance.
Sakawa, Miyuki, you two keep insisting you're the real deal, but you don't look like it at all!
Meanwhile, she's actually dressed to look the part! She's the real Yuki-Onna!
Whoa! That makes total sense!
As the white mist cleared, the travelers suddenly found 'emselves aboard a big-ass wooden boat!
...What does that mean? Is this the second act?
Ding-ding-ding! Correctamundo.
But we were just in a hut in a snowstorm... What a strange transition.
Rain was pourin' down, the wind was howling, and the seas were rockin' like crazy. The travelers were starting to get some mad seasickness.
Are we? I feel perfectly fine.
Yeah, it makes no sense for shipgirls to get seasick.
That so? Ahem... Rain was pourin' down, the wind was howling, and the seas were rockin' like crazy. Despite that, the travelers looked right as rain!
Clearly, they were badasses – badasses, but they were tiny compared to the ocean.
Especially compared to the colossal beast of the sea. Yes, an Umibouzu towered above them and their teensy fishing boats!
Aye. I demand tribute. Tribute for the Umibouzu!
Your food, your valuables... Give them all to me!
Yikes... I've heard about this. It's an extortion tactic where criminals demand protection money, I think.
Hippity hoppity... Such is life, I'm afraid.
You need to appease the Umibouzu, or else the storm will never let up.
And if the storm never lets up, I won't be able to fish. Then I'll go out of business!
That's so mean to the poor fisherwoman! I say we gang up on the big baddy and take it down!
Agreed. It doesn't matter if it's a powerful youkai – our cannons will make short work of it!
Exactly. We need to stand up to our oppressors!
I worked like a dog for this haul! Why should I stand and watch while some youkai steals the fruits of my labor?
Goodness... Please, brave lady, simmer down!
It's infuriating, I know, but we are compelled – destined, even – to offer tribute to the youkai!
Really? Well, I've had enough of this! On this day, I'm going to defy destiny and teach this cruel monster a lesson!
Oookay... The brave fisherwoman took up a harpoon and leaped out of her boat, hell-bent on taking down the Umibouzu.
But! Just a moment later, a giant wave rose from the turbulent sea, and swallowed the unfortunate fisherwoman!
*sigh*... See? I tried to warn you!
The rest of you! I suggest you stay in your boat!
So the waves will sweep us away if we get out... Yeah, I guess we can't use our riggings then.
We could sail closer, acting like we're going to offer tribute... then beat it up.
Something tells me there's no way to advance without giving it something for realsies.
Look! That fisherwoman chucked something into the sea!
O mighty Umibouzu, I offer you this tribute! Please give me your blessings so I may go unnoticed and nothing bad will happen to me!
Brazen human... You think this paltry tribute will appease me?
Uh-oh. Looks like that wasn't enough for the Umibouzu. It sent a huge wave after the fisherwoman and sank her boat!
Oh geesh, oh man... I doubt what little we have will be nearly enough to satisfy the Umibouzu!
We're damned if we do, damned if we don't!
So offering goods won't work, and shooting it won't either... Then what are we supposed to do?
First of all, let's search the ships for anything left of value.
We'll distract the Umibouzu with as many goods as we can, then knock its lights out.
That's brilliant! You're a genius!
(Isn't that essentially what Kasumi proposed, though?)
The travelers took tributes from all the surroundin' boats and gathered them in one place. The Umibouzu looked at all of it with greedy eyes!
The last of the goods, that be. Now offer them to me!
The Umibouzu closed in on the heap of treasure as it bellowed an order.
Okay, it's on the hook!
Hatsuzuki, throw a few tributes into the water! Get it just a bit closer!
Alright, got it!
This should do it. One, two, three... EEEEEK!
Wh-wh-wh-what the heck is this?! That is NOT a fish!
That's uh, lemme see... That's a will-o'-the-wisp.
W-w-will-o'-the-wisp?! Why is it moving?! WHY IS IT MOVING?!
Uhh... One of the travelers was so utterly filled with fear that it gave her the strength to perform a small miracle.
Like a frog juiced up on energy drinks, she jumped through the air onto another fishing boat! But, there was another surprise awaiting her there...
OH MY GOD! THERE'S A WHOLE SWARM OF THEM HERE! EEEEEEK!
Shoutin' and shriekin', she leaped from boat to boat until eventually, she was face-to-face with the Umibouzu!
Impressive... Fancy that herculean acrobatic feat as tribute, do you?
*lets out an ungodly scream as she swings her katana*
The Umibouzu was slain. Calm returned to the seas and the fishers were finally able to resume their peaceful lives.
And everyone lived happily ever after.
What? That's it?
THAT'S how the story ends?!

sequence:
The Spiriting-Away Incident?

<size=45>Assemble the Fleet!</size>

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Well, it's time for the intermission.

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Travelers, was our play to your liking?
- It was great. - I'll have nightmares about this!
- I can't wait for more! - Show us the next act already!
Wait, there's more?! God, have mercy on me...

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Ah. That's great to hear.

scripts.factiontag: Wants You to Respect Your Elders
scripts.say: Now, let us continue to the–
BOOOM!
...What was that?
BOOOM!
Zoinks! Is that an earthquake?!
Naw, girl, that's definitely no earthquake!
This ain't good, folks! Someone's attacking the barrier!

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: Attacking it?

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: Oh boy... Lemme guess, y'all forgot to tell the Commander you were goin' here, didn'tcha?
Oh! Right! I knew we'd forgotten something!
Uh-oh! We need to stop the attack immediately!

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: *sigh*... Just what we needed...

scripts.factiontag: Nice and Simple Kind of Gal
scripts.say: Shimakaze, you're the quickest – scoot over there 'n tell the Commander to stop! We'll take things from here!
Roger-dodger! I'm on my way!
Meanwhile, outside the strange torii gate...
Comrade Commander, we've finished blockading the waters around the island. Entry will be possible once the barrier has been destroyed.
I've got the skies under complete lockdown, too. Not a single bird or ghost is getting out!
Excellent. Nagato, how are things on your end?
Expected to finish in ten minutes.
Yamashiro, Musashi, focus fire. Coordinate your attacks on the talisman with me.
Understood, Lady Nagato!
Shinano and the girls' safety hinges on us. I will hold nothing back.
Nagato, Yamashiro, and Musashi are bombarding the barrier. A group of shipgirls from all factions stood just behind them, ready to run in.
The talisman will be destroyed in ten minutes. All ships, prepare for battle!
Roger!
Wait, wait! Please wait, Commander!
A familiar voice calls out to me from nowhere. Then, Shimakaze appears seemingly out of thin air from beyond the torii gate.
More follow a few moments later. Owari, Hatsuzuki, and Bristol with the rest of her team.
Geesh, you guys gathered a small army here...
See? I TOLD you we should've called the Commander before we went in!
This is all a big misunderstanding, Commander! Please allow me a minute to explain!
Shimakaze, in her panic, blew way past a summary and dove into a convoluted explanation...
Fortunately, Shinano had come along, and she provided me with a brief overview of what had happened.
All we intended for was an unforgettable summer experience... We are truly sorry...
This one suspected the invitation of poor messaging... A mistake most unfortunate...
I understand now. You wanted to make it look like a spiriting-away case as part of the play.
Instead, it made your intentions all the more fuzzy.
Such a misunderstanding is nobody's fault. Let it not bother you.
I'll admit, it DID result in an unforgettable experience.
It was certainly the last way I expected that flyer to keep its word.
I wondered what form this Youkai Troupe would take, and I was not disappointed.
Speaking of them, is that where we'll meet the troupe? Just past the barrier under the torii gate?
Yes... They cannot leave the barrier in their current forms...
Did you hear that? We'll get to see some real youkai! Let's go!
(Well... I suppose the crisis is over now.)
(Everyone's safe, and I don't want to undermine the efforts Shinano and the Youkai Troupe put into all this.)
(Let's head in and see what this play is like.)
It was a fervid summer day... The skies were clear, and the sun hung high in the sky...
Hey! They got a new narrator!
And new actors, too. The Commander's the lead now, and it's our turn to watch the play.
We should be quiet then! Like audience members are supposed to!
Ahem... As this one was saying...
An army marched the path through the woodlands. Their general – the Commander – was resting inside a sedan chair, carried by the troops...
Wait, a sedan chair? Is this story set during the Warring States period?
Indeed... The Commander's sedan chair was large and highly ornate, filled with curiosities and antiques – more than one could count...
It IS pretty spacious in here. It could do without all the boxes and bottles, though...
And this uniform... it's very different to my usual one. I look like some sort of Edo-period magistrate.
Safe to assume, I must be playing an extremely wealthy person.
I-I bring you a report, Milord! Our battle on the front is unfolding smoothly!
Milord's vanguard has already seized two castles with all the ease of a walk through the grasslands! Victory shall surely be yours soon!
Hahahah! Of course! Our great army's victory is inevitable, particularly with Milord at the helm!
Our foes would be wise to surrender, and instead they struggle like imbeciles! They must be taught a lesson!
I-I think you should calm yourself... It's hot today, and you risk a heatstroke if your anger overboils.
Milord! A large group of villagers have gathered on the road ahead of us!
They knew of Milord's coming and are offering alcohol and rations to thank Milord's army!
So the commoners embrace the tides of change. Milord, shall we halt and savor a moment's respite?
I support this idea. It's sweltering, and the villagers are extending their goodwill. Let us stop and rest.
As for where... Yes, I think the flat plain by the side of the mountain shall do. It's not the most spacious, but it's adequate to set up camp.
Hmm...
The army set up camp by the mountain, gorged themselves on the offerings of the villagers, and enjoyed their break...
Can we really stop and nonchalantly put down camp by the roadside? Aren't we marching for war?
(The location is suspect. It's a long way away from our other units, and the enemy may ambush us from over the mountain...)
The army set up camp by the mountain, gorged themselves on the offerings of the villagers, and enjoyed their break...
What? I thought I as the general would decide!
(I suppose not... Something tells me I don't get a say in this story.)
Moments later, the scene changes to a massive encampment.
A feast of delectable dishes is lined up before me. I look around me and see swords, books, treasures... and even exotic animals around the camp.
The flyer wasn't lying about taking you from one magic place to the next.
Why would a marching army be hauling these things around, though?
Oh, my General, why are you all alone in here? Everyone outside is enjoying their drinks~
Perhaps it's because... you really wanted to see us? Heehee♪
There's no one else here but you, me, and her... You can do aaanything you want with us♥
Good point! The only question is – WHAT would you do, hmm? Heehee♥
...Excuse me, why won't you look at me?! My script says I'm the attractive dancer!
Come on, say it~ Aren't I attractive?
Um... Yeah.
The lovely mood was suddenly disrupted by the rumble of lightning...
In mere moments, a rainstorm had swept over the camp...
That sure came out of nowhere.
I feel like I've forgotten something really important...

options.content: Umbrella! I need to find an umbrella!

scripts.say: ...Well, I do, but more importantly – where even am I?
We are in Okehazama, Milord!
It's shocking how quickly rain came upon us, when the skies were clear just moments ago... An unfortunate change of weather.
I see. So we're in Okehazama...
It's been a really hot day, rain and thunder came suddenly...
And I'm playing a general in the Warring States period... Oh no!
We must prepare for battle, posthaste!
Meanwhile, under the cover of the thunderstorm, a cavalry unit had gathered in an attacking position atop the mountain...
We are in position. Awaiting orders to commence the attack.
Heehee. Imagine a sudden rainstorm whipping up to our benefit. The heavens are on our side.
Indeed. Milord's unyielding determination to attack has resulted in the perfect opportunity for us.
Heehee~ Keep the praise coming~♪
D-do we really need to fight?
Yes. There is no room for personal feelings on the battlefield.
Milord, give us the order, and the cavalry will charge. We shall return to you victorious.
I am on the brink of keeling over from boredom. Let's begin, shall we?
Hmm...

options.content: Cavalry? But some aren't even riding horses!
Really? They all count as cavalry?

scripts.say: Apologies, but we lacked the resources for a complete cavalry unit...
Some say that a soldier atop any vehicle of war may be considered cavalry...
Ahem. Unfortunately, we did not have sufficient time to provide uniform equipment for the cavalry unit...
Regardless, they all exhibit a burning fighting spirit under their lord's leadership...
My Owner's waiting for us down there~♪
Troops, hear me! Go get 'em!
Your target is my Owner, and my Owner alone!
My troops camped nearby won't be able to make it here in time due to the rainstorm...
This is bad. Very bad. My camp is isolated and exposed...
I can already hear rallying cries calling out from outside my tent.
Then, the opposing lord lifts the flap and comes running into my tent!
So this is the end...
Owneeeeer! There's no escaping your fate!
Come heeeere!
She lunges at me like a cat, arms outstretched... without a weapon!
The battle was over, and peace was restored to the lands...
And so, the curtains fall on this act...
Owneeer! *squeeze* *cuddle* *sniff*
It's over now. You can stop hugging the Commander to death...
I'm not letting go of my Owner even if it's over! ...Hey, when did you get here, Memphis?
I've been here this whole time!
Well, I suppose that's the end...
Several days have passed since the incident, and the onsen resort is back in holiday mode.
Plays are held daily at night, and they've become a hugely popular attraction with the guests.
I'm still on vacation now, and this morning, I received a report on the so-called "Spirited-Away Incident" slid in under my door.
"The Onsen Resort Spiriting-Away Incident - By investigator Bristol."
"...We live on an isolated island, completely unaware that the Great One is already in our midst."
"...I saw that in the shadow of that violent storm, the white snow ceased to be snow."
"...I saw that in the grimy ocean water, an indescribable beast was madly devouring its own twisted kind."
"...I saw that when the rain gave way, the sky bared a foreboding smile. The dark shadows twisted and danced madly, blotting out the light of the lone flame."
"...Human logic, human laws, they are meaningless here."
"...I should not have dove deeper. I should have turned back. Yet, I keep moving deeper and deeper even now, searching for more..."
"...For the forbidden miracles that are a mixture of unfathomable beings and mystery."
"By the way, we've also attached copies of the other investigation team members' reports. Signed, Kirov and Saratoga."

options.content: Feels like I lost some sanity just from reading this...

scripts.say: Hehehe... The onsen resort, the Youkai Troupe, even the spiriting away... they earned me a pretty penny, nya♪

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>1 An Invitation from Watarase</size>

scripts.say: Sakura Garden - Terrace
The warm afternoon sun filters through layers of cherry blossoms, casting intricate shadows onto the stone below.
Watarase sits on her knees beside an elegant tea table, carefully embroidering golden patterns onto deep-blue fabric.
A shishi-odoshi bamboo rocker rhythmically clunks against the rock. At the same time, she notices my presence, and her focused gaze softens into a smile.
Oh, Commander, you're here. I was just brewing gyokuro tea. Would you like some while it's still warm?
She offers a cup of tea that emanates a wonderful aroma.
Mmm... Just smelling it is relaxing.
I'm glad you like it. You know... I asked you to come today because I wanted to discuss a stage play being held by the Sakura Empire.
Hm? I'm fairly sure I approved the relevant permits already.
Yes, and we're procuring costumes and preparing the stage thanks to that. But...
Are you having trouble?
No... I have a personal request. I'd like to try my hand at performing on stage this time...
Not as a behind-the-scenes helper, but as a performer. Wearing a costume I made with my own hands, experiencing the feeling of being on stage.
Okay. Do you have a performance in mind?
Yes, actually. I'd like to write a script based on the story of Princess Shirataki.
Exact details are still in the works, though.
Princess Shirataki? Designing costumes for that must be a lot of work.
Hehe, you don't need to worry about that. I'm taking care of it.
But what makes the story of Princess Shirataki really moving isn't the clothes.
Commander... May I ask you to perform with me?
Hmm. I wouldn't mind an extracurricular activity or two, but wouldn't that double your workload?
You still have daily sword training, and if you're going to sew a costume for me, I'm not sure if you'll ever have time to rest.
Commander.
She smiles softly and strokes the fabric. That fresh embroidery shines beautifully in the light.
Look at this pattern, please. With colored thread as the weft, I used special techniques to make this gorgeous design. When the light hits it, it reveals its complex yet elegant beauty.
Like me... When I am needed, I will take up my blade to protect the port and the people I love as a warrior.
But now, as someone who wields needle and thread, I simply want to create a costume for you with all my love.
Be it brewing tea, sewing costumes, or wielding a sword... All of these things are part of my life. They might as well be rest.
A gentle breeze blows, lifting the deep-blue fabric. It gently drapes over the scabbard at her feet.
She gingerly lifts both fabric and sword alike.
I've kept this fabric for a long time, actually.
At first, I planned to make a waistcoat, of sorts, to wear under your uniform as a reliable extra layer of protection.
But I decided, what if I go all-out and use this to make a stage costume for you, instead?
Umm... With me, that is...
Then I'd be happy to.
Uh, I will need you to help me out with rehearsing, though. And the script, of course.
Heehee... I promise, I'll weave my feelings into a one-of-a-kind costume for you.
I look forward to that.
And I'm happy to hear that. But first, come with me. We have preparations to make.

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>2 Unmeasurable Distance</size>

scripts.say: Sakura Garden - Workshop
The setting sun shines through wooden lattice windows, warming a room full of hanging fabrics. The mingled scents of cotton and dye fill the space.
Is this where you've been sewing?
That's right. All of my tools are here.
Come this way, Commander. Sit here for me.
She picks up a tape measure and shows me to a well-lit spot in the room.
Then, she kneels down and places the chilly tape measure along my ankle. Her long, open sleeves cascade onto the floor around her.
Relax and stand upright for me, okay?
The tape measure moves upward along the seam of my pants. Her fingertips gingerly grasp the scale, occasionally brushing along my leg.
I can't help but focus on how the atmosphere has changed.
I'm sorry, Commander. The costume has to fit you like water, so my measurements have to be perfectly precise.
Take a deep breath in for me, please.
There. Now slowly exhale.
Phew... I'm surprised you're being this particular.
Heehee, the costume is for you, so I insist.
Plus, you're performing in a play. You wouldn't want to go out there with clothes that don't fit.
Fair enough.
Let's do your shoulders next.
She circles behind me, wraps her arms around, and puts the tape measure around my shoulders.
Her warm breath tickles my neck, sending a shudder down my back.
That... tickles a little.
I'm sorry. How about now?
This time, her fingers barely touch my shoulder blades.
You don't have to hold your breath. That just surprised me, that's all. I'll get used to it.
At those words, she leans in a little closer. The tape measure touches the bottom of my neck, and I feel its cold against my heartbeat.
Excuse me... Can you lift your chin a little? Ah... Was I too forceful?
No, it's okay. You don't have to worry so much.
Okay. Sorry if this doesn't make sense, but making clothes is like sharpening a blade. You need to be fastidious over the details.
For example...
She gives my collar a slight tug, and even that small adjustment makes my throat feel sort of constricted.
If a collar is too cramped, it'll get caught with every turn you make. That gets in the way of a performance.
Princess Shirataki wouldn't let her beloved go on stage in ill-fitting clothes. Isn't that right, Commander?
I get it. Details matter.
Yeah. I'll take this seriously.
If we want the audience to be immersed in the world we create, then we need every aspect to be perfect.
It's the little things that make or break a performance, even if they don't seem critical at first.
Immersion in the role is fundamental for an actor, yes, but to immerse the audience as well is no easy feat.
The tiniest flaw on stage can divert their attention at any time.
Even if they can't explain why, they will notice that something FEELS wrong.
Watarase finishes measuring me throughout our conversation, jots down the numbers with her pen, and returns the tape measure.
Her eyes shine in the warm afterglow. A roll of crimson silk falls from a shelf above, covering our overlapping shadows like a robe.

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>3 Woven Emotion</size>

scripts.say: Sakura Garden - Workshop
As twilight begins its reign over the sky outside, lights turn on one after another in the workshop.
Watarase stashes away her notebook and opens a camphorwood cabinet behind her.
Fabrics of all colors practically cascade out and cover the long table – plain white velvet, light-grey silk, pale-blue chiffon, and more.
Her fingers glide over the layers of fabric as a smile spreads over her lips.
Commander, are you satisfied with the fabric I was preparing earlier?
I'm happy to let you decide.
Hehe. Then next comes the lining. I'll need to touch you directly for this one.
She spreads out a roll of ivory-white cotton and presses it gently to my inner forearm. It feels like a warm cloud on my skin.
How is it?
Hmm... Very soft.
This is cotton cloth. It's absorbent and breathable, so it works well for high-action scenes. It also works quite well with the outer layer we chose.
Now... How about this one?
This time, she places the light-blue silk against my wrist. It feels chilly on my skin.
It's chilly and smooth... Maybe a little too thin, though?
Don't worry about that. I plan to line it with layers. Like this, for example...
She folds the fabric over a few times and holds it together while pressing it to my skin again.
Now what do you think?
Hmm... It's kind of warm. I like this.
Heehee. Okay, then this layer will be the one that touches your skin.
It will need a magic touch before it can fit perfectly to your skin, though... Can I borrow you again for a while?
Of course. What should I do?
After I prepare the fabric, stand up straight here for me. That's all you need to do.
Watarase spreads the previously chosen dark-blue fabric over the large cutting table and uses a piece of tailor's chalk to draw smooth arcs on it.
Then, she cuts it with left-handed scissors. They make a satisfying slicing sound as they glide like a boat over water.
Carefully taking the pieces she has just cut, she checks the shape against me and pins them with sewing pins.
We'll need to support specific areas to really draw out your figure.
This time, she fits the lining to the back of the main fabric pieces. With a delicate needle in hand, she starts to sew. Her eyelashes cast shadows under the warm lighting.
The trim will be dark blue to complement the rest, and as for the seam... What do you think would be best, Commander?
Well, how about ash grey? It should tie the whole color scheme together.
I think that's a great match. Would you grab the second spool over there for me, please?
Well, how about making it dark blue, too? Let it blend with the fabric to make it look literally seamless.
That's a lovely idea. Would you grab the third spool over there for me, please?
Gladly. I'm surprised I got the chance to help you, even if it is just picking up some thread for you.
You advised me on the color, too. Hehehe, I'll have you know that you've been a big help.
Only through the interweaving of warp and weft can something beautiful be made. It's a lot like human cooperation.
As light casts our two shadows onto the fabric, the golden needle and silver scissors gleam in her fingertips. In this night, a silent bond seems to be woven between us.

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>4 Warmth in Fabric</size>

scripts.say: Sakura Garden - Workshop
A dark-blue garment lies flat on the work table. Its collar and sleeves are adorned with golden vine patterns that shine in the morning light.
Watarase's fingers gently trace the inner lining, where intricate, hidden patterns are embroidered in ash-grey silk. It's a secret warmth, meant only for the skin to feel.
I hope you're ready to try it on?
A costume is akin to an actor's second layer of skin. When you put it on, you feel the life in the stage.
I feel the weight of the costume, watching it rise and fall on my chest in time with my breathing.
It might be... a little tight in the shoulders?
I see... Your shoulder muscles will flex when you swing your sword, so we'll need a little bit of slack there. Don't worry – I'll fix it up right away.
Okay, stand straight for me. The light will hit you from above onstage.
If you slouch even a little, your shadow will appear much shorter.
She puts a hand on my waist and steps in front of me, fastening a shakudo copper brooch to my collar. It's cold against my neck.
This position should be perfect for the shape of your collar. Try moving your neck for me... Is it uncomfortable?
Perfectly fine with me.
Good. Except... I noticed your heart is beating unusually fast.
Is the costume too heavy? Or... are you just imagining the two of us performing onstage together?

options.content: I might be a little nervous.

scripts.say: You're right. It's very comfortable, but it is heavy.
Is that so? You said it was chilly before, so I added an extra layer of lining. I'll remove that later.
You're right. The thought of going onstage is a little nerve-wracking.
Hehe, don't worry. I'll be with you, and whatever happens, we can just call it part of the show.
Thanks for that.
She retrieves a leather belt, crouches down, and wraps it around my waist. Her long, black dress spreads across the floor like an inky blossom.
Once the buckle is fastened, I reflexively tense up.
Aww, don't be so tense. This is just to help support you, not to torture you.
When I try relaxing my shoulders, I'm amazed to find that the belt doesn't feel tight anymore. It really feels like it's supporting me.
Hmm... I should tighten the waist a little so that it can provide better core support.
The tightening of the buckle will focus your mind, like using a sword's sheath to bolster its momentum when you draw it.
She hands me a wooden sword along with the simile.
Why do you have this here...?
Heehee, it's my workshop. When I'm tired of sewing, I like to swing it around a little to take my mind off things.
That's how you relax?
It may sound odd to you, but it's just a way of refocusing myself. Likewise, when I'm tired of training, I make clothes to take my mind off of that.
Could you try swinging it for me? See if the cuffs feel too tight when you do.
I accept the sword and swing it downward. My costume dances from the force, drawing a golden arc in the morning light.
At the same time, I feel it being tugged back a little by my upper arm.
Right here... About from my underarm to my shoulder, it feels a little hard to move.
Okay, then I'll need to widen the sleeves a little. Stage movements have to be more dramatic for the audience to see, so we can't have you feeling restrained.
The bottom half seems to be just right, though. It moved beautifully with your sword swing, so I'd call that a success.
The blade shines in the light, and you move the costume... Now we begin to see how a dynamic performance is built.
Morning sunlight casts our shadows onto a wall of fabric. The warmth of her hands passes through the costume and to my skin, transforming into quiet affection and protection.

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>5 Princess Shirataki</size>

scripts.say: Theater - Backstage
Faint morning light filters through the curtains, lighting up the dust wafting throughout the stage.
Watarase hands me the play script she just finished. Between the neatly printed lines of text, handwritten notes are scattered like inky butterflies.
I understand the part about conveying emotion through songs, but what's this about imprisonment and elopement, exactly?
And swordfighting scenes during their escape, too... I don't think this stuff was in the original story.
The original story lacks a certain... ebb and flow to the action. It's a little too quiet for a modern stage production.
This is our one chance to stand onstage together. I want to really liven up the story by escalating its conflict and putting the two of us into it.
I think that's the best way to make this a memorable performance.
...Is that how it works?
Hehehe, relax. This may be my first script, but I've consulted with the port's most accomplished authors in the field of adventure.
They happened to like it, too.

options.content: Why do I feel like this has happened before?

scripts.say: Who would they happen to be?
Oh... I think I know who you mean.
Well, if they really liked it, I guess...
Oh, my. Do you happen to have qualms with my script?
No. I think your ideas are good.
But this scene where I fight our pursuers alone? I don't know if I can handle that much action.
I try swinging the prop sword. I'd call myself an okay swordsman, but compared to the others at port, I'm far too much of a novice.
Watarase suddenly charges toward me with her script in hand. The smell of her soap tickles my nose as she taps an annotation in the margin.
Read it again – Princess Shirataki fights off the pursuers alone, not you. This is a fight for the person she loves.
All you have to do is give the signal, and I'll handle the rest.
She hands me her sword, sheath and all, and places her hand over mine.
Then, she guides my arm to a proper sword swing. Her giggling is backed by the sound of bamboo clunking onto the floor.
See? One swing, and the story is set into motion.
Stories are like plain cloth: beautiful, but they won't truly shine without a touch of golden embroidery.
The comfort of a peaceful conclusion would not feel nearly as precious without the threat of enemy arrows along the way.
You don't think the audience will find it... cliché?
They might, but when the princess fights off a hail of arrows for the sake of her beloved...
That moment of heart-pounding tension is my goal. That's the fabric of something more meaningful than mere story.
She mimes a swordsman parrying arrows, stepping in front of me protectively. Her drooping sleeves are like wings spread in the sunlight.

sequence:
A Bond Woven by Thread

<size=45>6 Far from Seamless</size>

scripts.say: Theater - Stage
I sing as I approach center stage amidst the spotlights shining the color of moonlight. My dark-blue costume ripples with every step.
Commander... You were incredible. We only rehearsed a few times, but your breathing, your eye movements, and even the arcs traced by your fingers were all perfect.

options.content: All thanks to your patient teaching.
Only because my princess was kind enough to instruct me.

scripts.say: Heehee...
Now... would you like to take the final act's hidden mechanism for a spin? I designed it myself.
You can make those, too?
Hehehe, a few. Pitfalls, raining arrows, and some little contrivances behind the scenes... So? Ready to give it a try?
I look around at the floor, the beams, and beneath the curtains, but I don't see any of her mechanisms.
Did you really? I don't see any.
They're hidden, so I'm quite glad that you can't see them.
Don't worry. Just follow my...
CLICK!
Before she can finish speaking, I hear a distinct click somewhere above us.
Oh. That was an experimental one.
Just follow behind me, Commander.
A hidden compartment opens up above, and arrows shower down around us.
Commander, duck!
When I promptly crouch down to evade them, a white figure rushes by.
In the blink of an eye, she deflects all of the arrows.
Three steps to the right now!
