The rumors were true, Cesare. Sardegnia Island wasn't obliterated – it was just hidden by God!
What a hideous sight... It's as though a war took place here.
Andrea, I've sighted a cluster of remarkably intact buildings. There's some writing that I can't read. Mind taking a look?
Sure. Let me see.
It says... "Conceptual and META Bidirectional Interference Experiment Laboratory"?
A laboratory? In this place?
Hey, is it just me... or have you also not been able to sense the power of faith since we came in here? It should be able to be felt from anywhere.
Yes, now that you mention it...
There must be earthshaking secrets lying in this hidden battleground...
We have to scour this place thoroughly!
As it has this whole time, the statue maintains its silence.
...That's why test site ES-13161 is home to so many METAs.
They took advantage of the Sirens' abandoned facilities and willingly underwent METAmorphosis.
So there exists technology that can induce controlled METAmorphosis... Assuming it really can be controlled, that is.
Another door appears.
Restructuring of the security system is complete.
I have also created 255 sub-options to meet the various needs of your experiments.
The buttons for options 1 through 255 are all here. Don't touch anything besides these.
Also refrain from touching buttons 251 through 255. They initiate emergency backup plans I set up for you.
Finally, I've positioned one of my own MECHArbitrators here.
Don't say anything about it not being enough. One MECHArbitrator can endure more punishment than a combined fleet can dish out in over a thousand years.
I'm going to be busy for a few days now while I write a manual for you. When that's done, I'm not coming back here ever again.
While I'd love to see the experiment's results, I'm not going to sit around for centuries waiting for them.
Let me know when the results are in.
As it has this whole time, the statue maintains its silence.
I wait for a minute or two, but no other doors appear.
What I gathered from that is that Chariot constructed the defense system of test site ES-131618 and only you can control it.
But, since you're in your... current state, the defense system is working automatically.
The fiercest part of the system is a MECHArbiter, and apparently, it would be impossible to take down even if the whole test site worked together.
Therefore, the one and only way they could survive was if you used Marco Polo to bring you down to earth, right?
Did you nudge her in the direction of the Sardegnia Island Mirror Sea in order to minimize potential collateral damage caused by the ritual?
Seeing as it's under the control of Andrea's side, they should be able to keep collateral fairly low.
Now I understand everything that's happened so far. Marco Polo and that world face a potential apocalypse.
I'm not sure how well Marco Polo will be able to control the collateral of the ritual, either...
You still have yet to tell me – what exactly do you want my help with?
Is there anything that isn't going exactly how you planned it?
Silence. The statue offers no answers, and my voice echoes hollowly in this horizonless stretch of white nothingness.
Sardegna Ecclesia·Capital
sequence: Sardegna Ecclesia - Capital
Cathedral - Somewhere underground

scripts.say: After witnessing the same series of visions as the Commander did, Marco Polo fell into deep thought.
(If those visions are true... that means Sardegnia Island was not destroyed by Paradise Lost, merely concealed by a Mirror Sea.)
(Andrea has long known this secret, and she captured the island and that META research laboratory in secret.)
(The cornerstone of this branch's security system is a massive mech known as MECHArbiter: The Chariot.)
(Hmm... So did God just give me a divine revelation to use the light of Heaven to get rid of that steel beast?)
She went through the bits of information in her head, then reached a conclusion.
(The revelation is clear. That being the case, I should stick to the plan.)
(Said plan being divided into two steps: Luring out the enemy, then annihilating it.)
(The latter isn't that much of a problem. However powerful it is, it should be fine as long as I can fully materialize the Kingdom of God and throw an army of Gazers at it.)
(So luring it out will be the tricky part. This MECHArbiter hasn't as much as shown a glimpse of itself yet!)
(The Sirens are still preserving their forces... I need to make them escalate.)
(We could use my Kingdom of God ritual as bait, but setting it up will take time, and forget about catching them by surprise if we're too conspicuous...)
(What else is there? Ah, right, Raffaello is good at these things. I'll ask her.)
BEEP!
Hmm... A way to make the Sirens escalate...
How about making it look like we're gonna blow Rome to bits?
Like, what if we took that mutual destruction plan Andrea had and turned it up to eleven?
The Sirens want you and the METAs to be at each other's throats, right? It's their goal, methinks.
So what if it seemed like the METAs were about to destroy the capital before that goal was achieved?
A magnificent idea! That's ideal for Andrea to transfer the core node of the Domain of Eternal Night to Sardegnia Island.
Not only will it draw out the enemy, but also it will make them turn their their sights to that island. A textbook example of baiting the enemy!
Andrea at once to– No, focus on manifesting the Mechanicus Harbingers! I will personally go and speak to Andrea.
Once the MECHArbiter is defeated, all that will remain are disordered small fry!
Ohohoho! What an ingenious plan!

sequence: Unknown location
Unknown time

scripts.say: I watched through the statue's eyes as Marco Polo traveled to Sardegnia Island in a great hurry.
So that's what you were planning...
Judging by her reaction, though, she didn't see records as they were – rather, you showed her doctored visions, didn't you?
While the statue remains silent, I feel like it's silently confirming my suspicions. If Marco Polo had seen the same things as I, she wouldn't have reacted to Hierophant.
Let me guess. You aren't presenting yourself to her as "God" on purpose, but the time to clear up that misunderstanding has passed, and now you're simply going along with it – right?
That amusing possibility crosses my mind.
Somehow, I get the feeling that the statue averted its gaze for but a moment.
...Can Marco Polo really deal with the MECHArbiter with the information you've given her?
Chariot said something about her MECHArbiter having the strength to rival the entire test site all at once, didn't she?
Although a statue cannot express emotions, it feels like it just looked away anxiously.
I'm starting to figure out why you dragged me into this.
Marco Polo and her subjects wield the collective power of the mind, while Andrea and her supporters have the corrosive might of METAmorphosis on their side.
"Bring the other down with them." "Neutralization phenomenon between polar opposites." The powers you gave them will be the key to victory against your army in this world.
In the branch I come from, we did something similar for dealing with the protective barriers of Tester, Purifier, and Omitter.
Tell me, Hierophant. Does the MECHArbiter have an adaptive barrier of its own?
Just a stone's throw away, another door appears.
I reach out to touch it, and everything changes abruptly.
Yes.
I'm then returned to the white expanse again.
Only silence from the statue answers me.
Once the barrier adapts too much in one direction, it becomes hard for it to pivot in another direction. That property can be exploited.
It's like heating steel to high temperatures, then rapidly cooling it to make it brittle. You just have to "quench" the barrier.
When the MECHArbiter appears, Andrea's group will begin by attacking the barrier with the power of the Domain of Eternal Night. They'll be the figurative fire that heats the steel.
Meanwhile, the Sardegnia League will raise the Banner of the Eternal Night over as many nodes as possible, amplifying the strength of META corrosion.
Marco Polo will set up the ritual on Sardegnia Island, halt it at the last moment before the Kingdom of God materializes, then wait for the right time.
That's when they'll spring their bait plan into action, drawing out as much of the MECHArbiter's power as possible while luring it inside the center of where the Kingdom of God will appear.
If all goes well, the barrier will be firing on all pistons to counter against META corrosion. That will be the opportune time to annihilate it.
Marco Polo finishes the ritual, locks the enemy in place, and unleashes all conceptual power at once to deal a devastating blow.
This plan is their best shot at victory.
Hierophant, relay this plan to her.
At the same time, inside the Sardegnia League's new joint headquarters on Sardegnia Island, Andrea was having familiar apprehensions.
So, the killing-blow part of this plan... Isn't it a bit crude?
What if, for example, all our combined strength still isn't enough to beat God's weapon?
I know there's very little intel on our enemy, but we should be prepared for the worst-case scenario.
Yes, I understand your concern, just... hold on. I'll ask for a revelation.
Ask for one? Do revelations really come simply when you ask for them?
Heh. Interesting.
Ignoring the doubtful looks around her, Marco Polo closed her eyes, opening them again just a short while later.
I've got it!
That was quick. Did your God tell you anything?
God hath spoken – we shall quench it!
We'll exploit a property of the Siren's barrier and pummel it with attacks of two opposing natures within a short span. This will allow us to break through the limits of its defense.
Um... What?
Is... Is that the revelation you received?
Well, yes? The figure in my vision said so. Are you doubting me?
This "God" of yours sure is something else...
Heheh. Right? I couldn't agree more!
Now that we have a plan, we just have to iron out the details!
Once the plan was set in stone, the shipgirls all sprung into action.
In the truest sense, the Sardegnia League had united as one for the first time ever. They had become something worthy of the title of "league."
HQ issued orders one after the next while the shipgirls intercepted the three separate fleets of Sirens.
What's more, the core node hosting the Domain of Eternal Night on the island was very clearly signaling an intention to destroy Rome.
This borderline provocation naturally drew the attention and fire of the Sirens' defense system.

The three Siren fleets were dead in their tracks, but then, a fourth one suddenly emerged right in the middle of the sea. A figure matching the description of the MECHArbiter was clearly visible in their midst.
According to Her Grace, several fleets of so-called "mass-produced" ships and "Enforcers" have appeared.
The Genoan Republic's and the Dukedom of Milan's fleets are keeping the first Siren fleet in check, while the Republic of Venice's and the Sardegnia Ecclesia's fleets are tackling the second one.
As for the third fleet, the Kingdom of Sicily's fleet is implementing its plan to grind them to a halt.
Each of our fleets is doing its utmost to stop the enemy's advance and isolate the fourth fleet of Sirens.
While they do that, our forces will be the key to destroying the MECHArbiter's fleet.
The enemy in question is on a straight course toward Sardegnia Island. We will be within its range in approximately 30 minutes.
The Republic of Florence will take care of its mass-produced ships. The Enforcers will be dealt with by our mixed fleet that hasn't yet participated in battle.
As part of our "quenching" tactic, we cannot expect assistance in the form of the Mechanicus Harbingers or the strength amplifier in the Lattice of God's Light.
The only assistance we can expect is aerial support from da Vinci's and Alfredo's fleet of airships.
Finally, Her Grace is performing the ritual and setting up the bait and extermination parts of our plan...
...Which means that you are the only ones who can handle the MECHArbiter.
I am a knight of the Sardegnia League and I will perform my duty no matter what.
It's us against God's most powerful weapon...
I pictured countless ways that this war could end. I would not in a thousand years have guessed this is how it would end.
Every state in the League coming together in unity in pursuit of victory... It's a wonderful thing to see.
Agreed. It's the best thing I could've ever hoped for.
Only if we win will it be so, Andrea.
Yes, that is true...
Our final opponent stands before us. So does the hope we've fostered for so long.
We will break free of our cage, whatever the cost may be!
KABOOOM!
Andrea, I am presently engaging the Enforcers.
Their strength is so far beyond expectations that a quick fight is out of the question. I'll do all I can to hold them back.
Understood.
Things are going super well for our airship fleet, luckily!
Doesn't look like the enemy's equipped to deal with aerial attacks, so we've already reduced their mass-produced fleet to scraps!
Heck, we kinda have forces to spare, so how about we send some your way?
No, let's stick to the plan.
You're the boss.
KABOOOM!
Andrea! Our attacks aren't getting through! In fact, the Domain of Eternal Night isn't having any observable effect on them!
Then we don't have enough output. Carducci, we have to capture every node as soon as possible!
We're engaged on all fronts, but I'll try to hurry things along.
Is it time to employ our backup plan?
Not yet. Launch one more offensive.
KABOOOM!
As Trento said, our attacks really are ineffective.
If nothing changes soon, they'll be threatening the core node within an hour.
Andrea, Her Grace just informed me that the ritual has been set up!
The enemy is already within strike range, so the Kingdom of God can be deployed at any time.
It's too soon. Too many nodes aren't connected yet. The Domain hasn't even reached half of its predicted output.
We need more to put sufficient pressure on the enemy.
Keep capturing nodes and raising the Banner of Eternal Night.
Meanwhile, I suppose... it's time to carry out the backup plan.
Overclock the laboratory's system and push the META corrosion up to a new threshold!
Are you sure that's a good idea?
I'm sure. We've always been ready for this if it's what it takes to break free of our cage.
It's nothing too serious. It will just give us more strength at the cost of our health.
That's definitely not all it does, based on Her Grace's reaction to your plan...
Hmph. I always have wanted to break past that meaningless safety protocol.
I'm on it.
Carducci, don't flip the extermination switch just yet. Stick to the plan and focus on expanding the Domain.
We only have one shot at this, so remember...
No matter how hard the fighting gets, don't relent until you're given the signal.
KABOOOM!
ROOOAAAR!
Shrouded in thick fog, the huge machine was firing in all directions, not a single blind spot out of range of its cannons.
Andrea, 90% of all the nodes have been captured now.
Then we should be good. Overclock the system and encase the enemy completely in the Domain of Eternal Night!
The fog thickened, and streaks of blood-red light rushed through it.
It was like the Domain of Eternal Night had converged into a single entity – like a giant had risen from its slumber.
Andrea's group coordinated so closely that it was almost like they were an extension of this giant.
KABOOOM!
ROOOOAAAAAR!
Cannons covered in fog struck the MECHArbiter's sturdy barrier as blinding beams of light burst forth.
Andrea, the enemy's attacks are getting duller and its barrier is growing darker!
Looks like it worked.
The moment has finally come... Marco Polo!
I know! Commencing the final step of the plan now!
O God, I call for you! Manifest your heavenly kingdom upon this earth!
...What?!
It doesn't seem like anything happened... Did the ritual work?
...God just told me to "hang on a minute"!
Did I hear that right? God wants you to wait?
Seems we have no other choice... I'll use the final card in our hand.
What are you talking about?! The cursed thing's barrier is completely attuned to your attacks!
I'll destroy all our equipment. The core node, the laboratory, and everything else on Sardegnia Island.
They contain a tremendous source of energy. Destroying them all at the same time will generate a massive shock wave.
What consequences will that have?
It won't be possible to rebuild the laboratory. No new METAs will come to be if we destroy all that machinery.
No more METAs? An acceptable price to pay. We don't NEED them.
Can you ensure the safety of your comrades, though?
No need to worry about that.
Magnificent! Do it, then!
In the endless white expanse, I witnessed all of the shipgirls' conversations and the changes in the battle through the eyes of the statue.
An energy source that creates METAs... Is she talking about a special Wisdom Cube? Origin Cubes, to be specific?
They're not seriously considering detonating them, are they?!
The image of a black tornado destroying everything in its path flashes in my mind.
Hierophant, you have to stop them! Nobody will be able to withstand the damage if those Cubes go off!
In response to my plea, another door appears not far from me.
...What does that mean? That the plan will work out just fine?
What are you trying to tell me?
I reach out to touch it, and everything changes abruptly.
Well, Dr. Aoste, my experiment was a success.
You discovered a way to blow up Energy Cubes, you mean?
I see Dr. Aoste and Colette conversing inside a strangely familiar laboratory.
Hey, it's a serious research project. Don't paint me like some kid experimenting with firecrackers.
My peers can be as biased against it as they want, but I still believe the explosive-propulsion engine is a promising subject.
It was widely believed that it was impossible for E-Cubes to release an explosion of energy in a short time, despite the enormous amount of energy they contain.
And yet, Wisdom Cubes – particularly ones that have undergone METAmorphosis – are reliably able to cause a destructive shock wave in response to stimulus.
And what's true for Wisdom Cubes is true for Energy Cubes as well.
If a Wisdom Cube can undergo METAmorphosis, there's no reason why E-Cubes shouldn't be able to in theory.
Isn't it natural, then, to change our way of thinking and try to work out how METAmorphosis works for Energy Cubes?
"In theory" is not the same as "in practice." Energy Cubes are far more stable than Wisdom Cubes. How on earth did you make it turn META?
Sorry, OXS trade secret. If you want to use our technique, we can discuss a business contract later.
No, see, what I'm concerned about is the safety.
Talk about being a worrywart. Do you remember that Wisdom Cube power output monitor and limiter you showed me before?
My team used that as a template for our own version made for META Energy Cubes. I've named it the M-type limiter – subject to change.
A META Energy Cube with the limiter installed exhibits completely different behaviors based on whether the desired output exceeds the value needed for an explosion or not.
If it's below the value, the limiter ensures not a single iota of energy will be released, preventing the expression of its META characteristics. Basically, it's just a brick then.
But, if the value exceeds the detonation threshold... Kaboom.
The limiter is immediately disabled, and the violent energy surge is then released as a shock wave.
Since this simultaneously destroys the Cube's casing, there's also zero risk of a secondary hazard.
Come to think of it, I haven't come up with a name for these unique E-Cubes yet.
META Energy Cube... MEC for short. Actually, how about M-Type Energy Cube? M-TEC.
The statue's eyes stare back at me inside the endless white space.
An Energy Cube with META properties...
Not just that – a Cube that can be detonated...
...That's what they are?!
Amidst ceaseless explosions, the great beast of condensed red and black fog launched a relentless attack on the prey trapped within it.
ROOOAAAR!
Marco Polo!
Once again! Commencing the final quenching stage of the plan!
location: Sardegnia Island - Marco Polo's Ritual Area

scripts.say: Carducci, send out the following commands to every node: Immediately remove the Banner of the Eternal Night and restart the Lattice of God's Light!
As you command!
Raffaello, send the Mechanicus Harbingers to the front!
Oh yeah! Let's wreck some stuff! Go and give them hell, my masterworks!
And Baracca – lead the Holy See Guard Fleet into battle!
I've been waiting for this. We're ready to go!
Magnificent! And finally...
O God! Give me your strength and bring to us your kingdom!
Thus, the red and black fog that embodied the Eternal Night vanished in an instant.
The world lit up with the light of faith, and a sacred silence filled the air from horizon to horizon.
In the midst of the pure white, the chorus resounded.
"I am Marco Polo, the Apostle."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL
"O Army of God, heed my command."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL, V HYTF VM NVK, OLLK TF JVTTHUK
"Smite this evil with your blade."
P HT THYJV WVSV, AOL HWVZASL, V HYTF VM NVK, OLLK TF JVTTHUK, ZTPAL AOPZ LCPS DPAO FVBY ISHKL
KABOOOM!
Marco Polo! I'm in position!
Holy moly! The fighting here is so intense!
This is the Kingdom of God... And that's the Army of God...
This is such good inspo! I've gotta draw this right now!
Ahem. Mechanicus Harbingers, go forth!
Save your drawing for AFTER we've won!
KABOOOM!
The Holy See Guard Fleet has arrived!
Reinforcements, Your Grace.
Excellent timing! Are the nodes done being changed?
About half of all nodes suffered damage that cannot be repaired. Besides those, all others have been converted and connected to the Lattice of God's Light.
Magnificent! I'll give you a small boost before you go in.
There! Now go! Crush them until there's nothing left!
KABOOM!
With Marco Polo commanding from atop her throne, the offense struck like an unstoppable tsunami.
The MECHArbiter's barrier was completely destroyed after a coordinated volley, so the shipgirls mercilessly bombarded its exposed armor with their cannons.
ROOOOAAAAR!
Phew... We've finally broken through that stupidly thick barrier!
Now to pierce the armor. Continue the attack! Strip away everything it has!
In the endless expanse of white, I watch as the barrier disintegrates through the statue's eyes.
A strange light flashes in the statue's eyes.
Then, the next moment, it and I are both sucked into a vortex that appeared out of nowhere.
After a bumpy ride, Marco Polo and her aides arrived at their destination.
Exiting their car, they found that their escort – Maggiore Baracca – was already waiting for them in front of the church.
Cannons! Ready for a salute!
KABOOOM!
Your Grace, welcome to the Armory of God.
I am Maggiore Baracca, your bodyguard. How was your journey?
With a courteous bow, Maggiore Baracca introduced herself to Marco Polo.
Faced with such a grand and splendid reception, Marco Polo was overcome with emotion.
(Hmph... Veneto, Littorio, and Clemenceau always get special treatment just like this...)
(But in this place, I'M the important one! Ohohoho!)
My journey went fine, thanks. I trust you'll keep us safe, Baracca.
Incidentally, what is this church? Is this Armory of God 9, the one I'm going to open?
Although the building before her certainly was impressive, it didn't quite fit with her image of an Armory of God.
It's just a facade to hide the entrance, Your Grace. The real Armory is underneath the church.
Hmm... I suppose that makes sense. If you want to hide a big structure, put it underwater or underground.
Once upon a time, I did– Actually, never mind.
Sensing the inquisitive eyes of onlookers, she cut herself short and looked around with a hint of awkwardness.
Turning her gaze upward, she caught sight of two figures who she recognized.
Hmm... Yeah, this angle's good!
SNAP!
Gotta snap a few more photos to record this historic moment!
Hey, da Vinci! Try to hold a little more steady! We're going off course!
I'm doing the best I can, alright?!
(Alfredo and da Vinci! Did they get sent here, too?)
(No, wait... Calm down! They could be natives to this test site for all I know!)
That is the Ecclesia's famous journalist Alfredo Oriani, and that is the genius inventor Leonardo da Vinci. They were asked to record this historic moment.
They were, however, NOT asked to board a flying machine and take pictures from the air...
They are an independent party. If they're an annoyance to you, Your Grace, I can tell them to leave at once.
Carducci noticed that Marco Polo was staring at them, so she issued an explanation.
Interesting... Has it been long since they were materialized?
Yes. They're trustworthy allies who've served the Ecclesia for quite some time now.
(No issue, then. I've been in a good mood lately, and I'd hate for my test site beta origins to be exposed.)
Magnificent. The more people to photograph my splendor, the better, I say!
Let's leave them be for now and get down to business, shall we?
Sure. This way, Your Grace.
Maggiore Baracca escorted the Apostle and her aides underground and went through a tunnel hidden behind a secret passage.
At the end of the tunnel, the walls around them turned metal. The lighting and general structure, too, were radically different from what they saw before.
At some point, Raffaello had also overtaken Baracca as the one walking at the front.
We're finally at the outer periphery of the 9th Armory and just about to pass through the first checkpoint!
Whatever you do, don't go in front of me until the safety check is finished!
Raffaello went straight forward, approaching a high-security gate.
(A gate made of an unknown metal, and a strange automated security system... It's far beyond the Sardegnia League's technological standard.)
(Yet this white color scheme doesn't feel like any Siren structure I've seen... No, don't jump to conclusions. This could be clever camouflage employed by the Sirens!)
Okay, check's done! We can go through.
While thoughts rushed through Marco Polo's head, Raffaello completed the first checkpoint's verification process.
The heavy gate slowly opened, and as soon as the path forward appeared, a realization dawned upon Marco Polo.
Raffaello... Didn't you say I was the only one who could open this door?
How come you did it with such little difficulty?
Good question... 'Cause I'm just that awesome, I guess?
I'm kidding. I can only get us through the outer checkpoints. Opening the gate to the Armory proper – only you can do that!
But it's still part of the same facility... Isn't that strange to you?
*sigh*... It seems I must once again explain matters.
As you should know by now, the Ecclesia has been carrying out a several-year-long plan – to create a shipgirl capable of opening the Armories of God.
As such, your materialization had some different processes from the rest of us. Raffaello's art was one of them.
In fact, Raffaello herself was materialized in the very step of the plan preceding yours. Thus, her situation is also a little different.
With the help of a Relic of God, she was born with some unique powers.
One is being able to condense the power of belief through the act of drawing. The other is being able to pass some verification steps in God's facilities.
She can "condense the power of belief"?
Ahh, so even the little things you doodle contain a safeguarding, sacred power, do they?
They're also capable of performing miracles, I take it?
I wouldn't go THAT far. I guess you could say the effect depends on how well I can conceptualize something or how compatible with God's machines I am.
Let's say I don't know what you mean by "conceptualize something" and "how compatible with God's machines you are." How would you explain it?
Well, the "conceptualize" part is straightforward – literally how well I can conceive something in my mind.
Everyone in the Holy See – like Carducci, for example – likes calling it "power of belief," but da Vinci and I both think calling it "brain power" is more accurate.
It's not like it's an ability exclusive to those of strong faith. Heck, even casual believers and atheists more or less have the same thing. It's also not really linked to the divine either, so...
It's a figure of speech. Also, random people can't simply "conceptualize" a physical thing that authenticates them with God's machines, can they?
See, that's why it's so weird that the Holy See calls it the "power of belief."
The source of power is the same, so why is "belief" the only thing they allow to convert into something else, while the rest isn't–
Ahem!
Oh! Sorry.
Raffaello remembered the importance of not slandering the Holy See right in front of the Apostle.
She made an awkward expression, then looked anxiously in Marco Polo's direction.
The Apostle was not stirred in the least. Indeed, she looked indifferent, like her mind was somewhere else entirely.
(So she can use her conceptual ability through art, but she must obey the Holy See's rules... Don't I make the rules, though? I'm the Apostle, for heaven's sake!)
(Perhaps I could get her to conceive of and materialize a thousand powerful weapons!)
(Yes! That's what I'll do! After all, the Apostle should at least possess a fleet devoted to her!)
(I'll get Queen Elizabeth, and Clemenceau, and Friedrich der Große... and even the Commander... and have them all work for me!)
Heh... Heheh... OHOHOHOHO!
Uhh... Your Grace? Is everything alright?
Oh man... She wants my head on a spike, doesn't she...
Hah... Hahah... Anything but! It's just that an amusing thought struck me!
Raffaello, when you paint for me next time, could you provide me with some more... creative designs?
Creative designs? Like what?
Oh, a holy lance, for instance. Or four pairs of wings. Perhaps even a divine, armored mech?
Ooh! So you have a taste for that sort of stuff! If that's what you want, I'll gladly oblige, Your Grace!
Am I free to draw other things, too? Would you like to have a mythical creature as a pet?
Ah... You are an ingenious artist! You know just what I like!
And you're the most unique, open-minded client I've ever had!
Ohohohoho! You and I will be excellent collaborators!
Took the words right out of my mouth!
When my vision returns to me, I find myself looking at...
...A Siren mainframe?
Beneath a false sky and a hollow sea, the city of steel towers silently.
The statue still won't say a word, but it does envelop me in pure white and carry me through the city.
We pass a nameless street, cross through a plaza, and snake through an alleyway before finally arriving at the colossal tower in the center.
Still encased in the whiteness, I'm escorted up several stories of the structure.
Then, we stop inside a hall.
There, a hologram of MECHArbiter: The Chariot VII stands silently.
At the same time, I realize that there is a panel hosting hundreds of buttons not far from the hologram.
Oh my god... Is that the panel for the security system that Chariot created?
I approach to get a closer look. The buttons are labeled 1 through 255, and the panel looks almost antiquated compared to its surroundings. It stands out.
...Yep, this is it.
These 255 buttons must be the sub-options for the security system that Chariot said she installed.
And beyond those...
Next to all these smaller buttons, in a clearly sectioned-off area, there sits a single big, red button.
Looking closely, I can see small writing under it: "Security system emergency shutdown button. Do not press outside of emergencies."
While they did manage to strip the MECHArbiter of its barrier, that alone won't be enough to defeat it.
To do that, it has to be weakened sufficiently for you to interfere with it.
Basically, if I understand correctly... you want me to push this button, right?
Despite not receiving an answer, I can intuit what the statue wants.
The lights in the hall go out one by one, and the hologram of the MECHArbiter also gradually grows fainter before disappearing altogether.
Phew... That should do it.
BEEP BEEP!
...My communicator is ringing?
Despite me not pressing the answer button on it, my communicator keeps ringing for a while, then automatically connects.
Huh? Why did you push that button?
What did you screw up this time, Hierophant?
A dizzying wave washes over me, painting everything a pure white color again.

sequence: Unknown location
Unknown time

scripts.say: In the endless expanse of white, the statue and I stare at one another.
That caller... It was Hierophant herself, wasn't it?
The statue is as silent as it has been the whole time, and yet, it looks as though there's a little more life inside it.
Right as that thought forms, the white space collapses in but the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, the Sardegnians were celebrating with vigor.
We did it!
We did it!
We won!
They stood in front of the wreckage of the MECHArbiter. Everyone was cheering, hooting, and hollering.
Target has been completely destroyed! Mission complete!
I can't believe the barrier was that strong, but it was so squishy underneath...
Heheh. Guess it was a paper tiger after all.
It was nerve-racking, but we succeeded in the end.
We actually won? I'm not dreaming here, am I?
You aren't. I'm hearing good news from all over the League. All other Siren forces fell silent practically the moment that the MECHArbiter was defeated. Victory is undoubtedly ours.
The cage has been broken... We've finally done it.
From now on, we can race across the sea free and unrestrained...
By the way, Marco Polo... What will you do with the Kingdom of God?
Put your concerns to rest. Now that the threat has passed, it's obvious what I'm going to do with it.
The aftermath and changes to come after this battle can be discussed once we've had our celebration.
Now that the string-pullers of the world's fate have been defeated, I'm sure just by talking it out, we can always reach an agreement that sits right with everyone!
But before that, let's discuss the details of my grand celebratory–
Marco Polo suddenly stopped mid-sentence, and a puzzling light flashed in her eyes.
Your Grace?
Sorry. The plan has changed.
God is calling for me, so it's up to you to discuss the celebratory banquet among yourselves!
What?! Are you serious?!
*sob*... You'll always be our one and only Apostle, Your Grace! Forever!
I'll create a masterpiece for us all to remember you by!
Enough with the histrionics!
Sure, I said that like I'm going to perish, but that is not the case!
Huh? You didn't mean you're giving up the ghost?
Obviously not! Cast your mind back to my anointment ceremony. You do remember that I said I'm not from this world, yes?
I'm simply going back whence I came!
Oohhh. So you weren't joking about that?
Of course I wasn't!
There, I clarified – now stop making that face at me. It's not like I'm never coming back.
You better paint that masterpiece for me. I want to see it one day.
Yeah! I promise I will!
I never expected that our farewell would come this abruptly.
You came to us so suddenly and now you leave equally suddenly... like a gust of wind. Heehee.
Sorry, that's just how I operate!
Now, then, I entrust the aftermath to you.
Don't worry, it's in safe hands. We will work with the Ecclesia and restore order to the Sardegnia League.
And then, we will move toward a free and beautiful future together.
I look forward to seeing that.
Now... It's time for me to leave.
With a slightly pained look in her eyes, Marco Polo bid farewell to her friends.
Until we meet again.
Marco Polo closed her eyes and silently lay down in the water.
A fading light illuminated her face, calm and serene, like she was dreaming a wonderful dream.
From up on high, she silently gazed down on herself, sleeping soundly and surrounded by everyone she knew.
A smile formed on her lips, then she finally turned around and left.
Although Marco Polo the shipgirl may have left the Sardegnia League, Marco Polo the Apostle will forever be with them.

sequence: Paradiso of Shackled Light - The End

scripts.say: Inside NA Ocean Central Singularity
sequence: Inside NA Ocean Central Singularity
Tribunal Special Fleet
Cabin below deck

scripts.say: The next thing I knew, I'd returned to the very moment when I was going to open the door to Marco Polo's cabin.
Am I... Am I back?
What time is–
The second hand on my pocket watch has only advanced a handful of ticks.
Just a short distance away, Miss Hat – Marco Polo – is still in a deep sleep.
Still sleeping, huh...
Safe to assume the bond between her and Hierophant grew deeper after all of this. Only time will tell whether that's for better or for worse...
BEEP BEEP!
Commander, have you finished logging that entry?
Yeah. I'm done. Miss Hat is still asleep. I'll hand her over to you.
Roger. We'll go there now.
Oh, could you pass on a word to Helena for me?
Tell her to call me as soon as this business is done with, and that I have something important to discuss with her.
Will do.
There is no knowing what may happen inside the Singularity, Commander. Please return as quickly as possible.

sequence: Unknown location
Unknown time

scripts.say: An endless stretch of pure white. A space where time and space were meaningless. It was through here that Marco Polo wandered.
Ugh... This is horrible!
Wherever I look, it's all the same... How am I supposed to find my way home?
I'm exhausted... I miss my Apostle's throne.
She muttered to herself, then sat down on a throne.
You know, I think I'd like a more lavish throne!
She muttered again, and this time, sat down on a throne more lavish than the last.
Wh-what in the world?!
Whoooa! That's a real lavish throne you got, Marco!
Raffaello?! What are you doing here?!
Uhh... I had too much to drink at the banquet, so I just...
What is this place, anyway?
Hmm...
An excellent question...
I haven't the faintest clue!
Iris Orthodoxy - Capital
sequence: Iris Orthodoxy - Capital
Commander's office
Several days later

scripts.say: Several days have passed since the incident, and my life is fully back to the usual.
I told Helena about my run-in with Hierophant and said I wanted to run some tests, but she didn't get back to me about that.
As for our plans to deal with what Sirens linger in the world, each of them is progressing steadily.
The one closest to completion is our plan to clean up the NA Ocean. It's comparatively easy work since it's the area where Compiler fell.
It will be led jointly by the Royal Navy, Iris Orthodoxy, Iron Blood, and Northern Parliament.
KNOCK KNOCK!
Commander, Bismarck has extended an invitation to you. She wants you to attend a diplomatic dinner tomorrow.
An invitation from Bismarck? Those don't come every day.
Hm? Hang on a second...
I accept the invitation. An emblem on the front, consisting of windmills and tulips, catches my attention.
The Kingdom of Tulipa...
(I see... That's why Bismarck is taking the initiative.)
(What are we going to discuss? That Lower Countries Treaty that they're drafting in Europa?)
(Or maybe it will be about Tulipan shipgirls?)
(Either way, color me intrigued.)
Tell her that I'll absolutely be there.
In fact, I want you to come with me.
Really? Sure!
There may be a lot of work we'll have to discuss.
Oh... Naturally.
In an endless sea of stars, a long-lasting pursuit was finally about to reach its end.
KABOOOM!
Thief! Thief! Thiiieeef!
Gimme back my whale!
A stubborn pest, this one... Regardless, her end is near.
Keep it up! She's at her limit, so hit her harder!
KABOOOM!
Gah... You don't give up, huh?
Well, I got some good data, so if you want it so badly, fine!
Just know that I'm letting you have this! You didn't beat me!
I'll be back for round two!
KABOOOM!
Devil's vessel was blown to bits in a plume of fire. Just like that, the battle was over at last.
Heehee!
Whale, whale, whale! My whale is finally back!
Thanks for the help, Sheffield!
If you hadn't come, who knows how much longer we would've had to chase her around!
My arrival was but a coincidence and I thought I should assist. You need not sing my praises.
It should be Her Majesty's determination and tenacity that you thank for this victory.
Good point. Thanks, Elizabeth!
Save your thanks for later. Now that your whale is back, do you sense anything different?
Hmm...
Hmmmmm...
Maybe...
Guh...
What is it?
I forgot...
I can't remember how I'm supposed to use the whale!
You bloody what?
Do YOU know how to use it?!
Well... We have at least secured the whale now. Sooner or later, its method of usage becomes clear!
Since most of test site beta's new coordinates have been calculated, a more detailed inspection will have to wait until we get back home!
Awww... Fine...
Wait, how do we bring the whale back?
By packing it up. Worry not, the Queen's Light will have no trouble fitting a single whale!
...Your Majesty, something doesn't feel quite right.
Yes, you're right... Something tiresome is coming our way.
Blast it... We should have recovered the train cars before departure.
What's wrong, Elizabeth?
Trouble is coming, that's what.
Once you and Sheffield have retrieved the whale, stay inside the train.
...We shall deal with this trouble ourselves.
The blinding light fades, and I find myself inside a well-lit classroom.
(This place again... Did Madam M summon me again?)
(Of course this happens right when Helena is looking for me all over out there.)
I look out the window. The weather is as calm as can be, with a gentle breeze blowing and sunshine pouring in.
Inside the classroom, however...
...Where is Madam M?
And why the heck did she bring me here?
I take a walk around the classroom. I move some chairs and desks and knock on the podium, but still, Madam M is nowhere to be seen.
Weird...
Gathering my courage, I grip the door to slide it aside and take a look outside, but right then...
KNOCK KNOCK!
Um, hello...
I was told my classes will be held here today...
The person who knocked is someone I've seen before.
Hey, everyone! It's me, Bon Homme Richard. The Final Countdown is in theaters now!
I had a lot of fun in the starring role. Be sure to check it out!
Welcome to the paradox of time, where past and present become one and history is actually changed! The Final Countdown... now in a theater near you.
Buy a ticket today and you have the chance to win a three-day guided tour of...
That voice, that tornado... Is that Bon Homme Richard?
There's no mistaking it! But how did she get here?
Bon Homme Richard? Who is she?
She's a shipgirl from our branch, and the only person in existence that the head of Antiochus – Zero – cannot write into her mainframe.
Even with the endless information from the past Zero has access to, she cannot reconstruct Richard.
Moreover, Richard has never been seen in any other branch as far as we know.
This is the first time we've laid eyes on her since her namesake incident.
Is she after you? Why?
You...
All of a sudden, everything rapidly breaks down before my eyes.
Right before I completely black out, it looks as though there's a momentary hint of confusion in Bon Homme Richard's eyes.
The night is silent. I'm in bed. The ceiling greets me.
What... What was that?
Was it just... a dream?
While Marco Polo and Raffaello laughed and laughed, the group had reached their final destination.
location: 9th Armory of God - Gate of the Chosen One

scripts.say: That over there – that's the gate even I can't get open. The Holy See calls it "the Gate of the Chosen One."
Rumors say that God's most powerful weapons and a clue to getting even greater power lie beyond. Anyway, Your Grace, it's your time to shine!
Heh. Child's play. Eyes peeled, now!
With a confident strut, Marco Polo walked up to the Gate of the Chosen One.
She remembered the important things Raffaello told her at the previous checkpoint – she recited a prayer and pushed against the alloyed part of the gate with both hands.
Then, she felt a jolt of energy travel from her head to her toes, as though that was the sign her identity had been verified.
The jolt dissipated, and at the same time, the gate slowly opened before her.
(Tsk... Just like that? I was expecting there to be more fanfare, more glittering lights, or something...)
Congrats, Your Grace! The Sardegna Ecclesia has grown mightier today thanks to you!
(Yes! And I may yet grow mightier, too!)
Ahem. Let us not celebrate so soon. Come along now! It's time to see what's in there!
On the other side of the massive gate was a mindbogglingly large space.
location: Gate of the Chosen One - Inside

scripts.say: Mountains, rivers... even a sky? Whoa... I wasn't expecting there to be a Sacred Domain here of all things!
This is the second ever Domain the Ecclesia has found – the first being the Garden of God beneath the Cathedral!
(This is blatantly a Mirror Sea! The probability of secret Siren involvement just rose significantly!)
Ahem... Pray tell, what exactly is a Sacred Domain?
Well... This. Just look at it. We're underground, yet there's somehow a sky over our heads.
A Sacred Domain is what the Holy See calls a space that constitutes its own world. It's considered a Sacrament of the highest caliber.
Based on my and da Vinci's research, this place and rigging technology should have pretty similar roots.
Of course – riggings, shipgirls, this – the Holy See refers to all of 'em as Sacraments, so yeah.
I guess you could say it's, uhh... an impeccable self-contained system?
Ahem!
Oh, sorry. I'm rambling again! Teehee☆
It's fine. I don't let every little thing get on my nerves. Moreover, some parts of your musings are interesting.
Now, seeing as you need the chosen one to enter this place, I seriously doubt there are any traps or such out to harm us.
What do you say we split up to cover more ground, hmm?
A most prudent proposal, Your Grace.
Magnificent – then let's go! Remember: If you find any strange machines, do NOT touch them! And should anything happen, call me at once! We'll regroup here in three hours!
After the group scattered in every direction, Marco Polo went the way that had caught her eye since she first entered the Mirror Sea.
Over her many years studying Mirror Seas, she had developed an intuition – that if she kept going, she was bound to find an important structure.
This intuition was, in fact, correct.
Her attention was drawn by a facility buried in a mountain range not that far from there.
She went inside and conducted a basic search and found something that proved her suspicion more than anything else up to this point.
A storehouse for the Mirror Sea's mass-produced fleet and Pawns, and massive defensive installations unlike anything I've seen before... These must be the rumored "powerful weapons."
As for the means to even greater power... A Siren production line, perhaps?
I'm sure of it now... While their appearances don't match anything I've seen, this "Armory of God" is in fact a SIREN armory!
Wait a moment...
Then that means the "God" who the Sardegnia League has been worshipping for centuries... is the Sirens.
The Ecclesia and the Holy See are merely puppets under the Sirens' beck and call...
And I am their Apostle... so I'm a puppet leader?
Oh no... Am I being controlled yet again?!
No, wait, that doesn't add up!
If the Sirens are this test site's God, doesn't that mean I was CHOSEN by the Sirens?
That can't be right... When I was in that white space, I could feel His presence...
But I do have control over these Siren facilities...
What's strangest of all is that I'm at what appears to be the heart of this place, yet I've seen not a single elite Siren thus far!
If Observer or her kin WERE here, shouldn't they come and speak to me at this point? Since they haven't, what do they expect me as a puppet to do?
...That proves it! I am NOT under anyone's control!
Yes – I'm not a puppet! I truly am the chosen one.
It wasn't the Sirens who summoned me, no – it was God. He saw the blasphemous state of the world and sent me to correct it!
That has to be it!
Three hours passed in the blink of an eye while Marco Polo racked her brains. It was time to rendezvous and go back.
Your Grace, I've recorded all our findings over this expedition.
As was written in the ancient texts, this is indeed an Armory of God.
Mhm...
Once again, congrats to you, Your Grace.
Mhm...
As far as I can tell, all the facilities are in sleep mode, yeah?
Your Grace, what do you say we boot 'em up?
Sure... Wait, no!
Is something the matter, Your Grace?
(She wants to just fire up a Siren production line? Is she insane?!)
Well, um... You see, the situation is more complicated than I anticipated.
(If you wake the small fry, fine, not the end of the world – but what if you wake the sleeping giants? Do you think you can take on someone the likes of Observer, huh?)
It would be unwise to make a hasty decision, given the importance of this place. We should evaluate our options and... Yes! We must think things through carefully!
(Ideally, I can figure out a way to blow this all to kingdom come later!)
This is my final verdict as the Apostle. Let us debate whether or not to initiate the facilities another time. For now, we're going home!
(This place is dangerous... I must get away posthaste!)
And so, it was over. The new Apostle had completed her opening and inspection of the 9th Armory of God.

sequence: Republic of Florence - Capital
City Street

scripts.say: On this pleasantly sunny day, the streets of Florence were as lively as ever.
A girl in red spoke with one distant comrade in a less conspicuous, shadowy corner of the capital.
Andrea, how are preparations at the rear proceeding?
We've finished negotiations.
The Venetian and Genoan Republics will join us in turn. As for the Dukedom of Milan, they will remain neutral given their allyship with the Ecclesia.
Our only direct opposition is the Republic of Florence – the most convenient outcome we could've hoped for.
Florence...
The girl in red cast a glance upon the lively streets, but she stopped herself and shook her head.
Everything is going smoothly. It's a good start.
We've spent countless years working toward this day. One decrepit theocracy can't stop us, nor can their false god.
We will be the ones to pen the end of this long tale.
Don't worry. My infiltration is a success so far. Everyone should think that I'm still in Rome with the Republic of Venice's delegation.
Even the Lattice of God's Light can't penetrate the pall of eternal night.
The time has come for us to break out of our confines.
So it has, and so we shall.

sequence: Unknown location
Unknown time

scripts.say: (Eutopia Savoy and Dr. Aoste's Project H...)
After my return from Naraka, while I tried to deliver the sleeping Marco Polo to the Ashes, I was warped to this "gate."
A recording had played before leaving me in a world of endless white. The only notable thing here was the constant feeling of being watched.
I looked in the direction where it seemed to come from, and amidst the white expanse, I noticed a barely perceptible change.
(There's something over there.)
(Some kind of... silhouette?)
Immediately as I perceive it, a thin path seems to appear in the empty space.
A single door stands quietly at the end of it.
(Hmm. Is that how this place works? Something only begins to physically exist as you perceive and attempt to observe it?)
(That must mean... that this isn't just an empty white space. It could be full of things, only invisible because I've yet to observe them.)
While I ponder it, I walk slowly toward the new door.
I reach out to touch it, and everything changes abruptly.
Specks of blue light flicker like stars amidst a sea of black.
They appear, move, and fade, all in regular intervals.
Throughout this repeating cycle, a few clusters of stars form four figures of varying clarity.
Connectivity test... Success.
Spatial structure stable. Data exchange normal. Flow is stable, perception is clear, and reactions are acute.
Now commencing the 114th Project Arbiter Artificial Mind Briefing.
Present members: War Protocol Fortress, War Protocol Moon, War Protocol Scythe, and Project H.
Commencing information exchange.
What a dry and formulaic intro. As usual, I guess.
I have five topics for discussion. Let me start.
Hold it, hold it. I want to speak with Project H first, particularly regarding the abnormality that occurred during yesterday's equipment prototype testing.
Your report mentioned... unusual visual changes that exceeded sensors' detection radius, was it?
You know, Project H, we can see each other's structures in our most fundamental forms here.
How about you bring back the equipment you were testing and try to replicate the issue?
Maybe we can see the problem for ourselves.
After the investigation of the 9th Armory of God, Marco Polo stayed locked up in her office, putting all of her energy into devising a plan.
However, she did not neglect her work as Apostle.
A week passed by in what seemed like seconds.
While she had yet to complete her secret plans, the mountain of work she owed to the Holy See had been dealt with.
KNOCK KNOCK!
You called for me, Your Grace?
Ah... Carducci, I see. I've finished all of the work at hand. That is everything, yes?
I must apologize... We have no more at this moment.
Ugh... It's not enough. Nowhere near enough. I need more work, I need more data, I need more information!
My knowledge of this world is still all too lacking.
At this rate, my brilliant plan could never come to fruition!
Hey, Carducci? Is it just me, or has Her Grace gone cuckoo from overwork?
You'll hold your tongue if you know what's good for you.
Hm? You didn't disagree, though. That means you must agree!
That's enough. I have nothing but respect for Her Grace and her impeccable work ethic–
You know I can hear everything you're saying, right?!
Your Grace, we think you may be overburdened. Have you considered more frequent rest?
A new church has just been completed in Florence. It would be a lovely change of pace to pay them a visit, I'm sure.
Ooh, that one? They put up a gallery of my newest collection of paintings, too!
(A whole collection of church murals? Hmm... Yes, that does sound perfect!)
(Wait, a church?! This isn't some kind of dangerous house of horrors built under Siren orders, is it?)
(If it IS, then that's all the more reason that I need to see it!)
What do you think, Your Grace?
Very well! A brilliant idea, and one that I was just pondering myself. Prepare to leave at once!
Amidst the rhythmic shaking of the train, the party proceeded onward to Florence.
Marco Polo checked on each of her subordinates one by one.
Giosuè Carducci quietly composed a poem. Meanwhile, Raffaello gazed at the scenery outside, no doubt envisioning her next work.
Their escort, Maggiore Baracca, was in the midst of a spirited debate with two uninvited guests, the journalist Alfredo Oriani and famous inventor Leonardo da Vinci.
These familiar voices finally eased Marco Polo's mental tension from the past week.
The excitement of being chosen, the loneliness of a new world, the fear of a Siren conspiracy, the exhaustion of many days' hard work...
So much had pressed her lately, but in this moment, she managed to fall into a deep sleep.
In the morning light, a well-regulated army received their leader's inspection.
Your Grace, the Crusaders await your review.
The parade commemorating a hundred years of your rule has been in the works for a long time. We won't disappoint!
Very good! Well done, Veneto and Littorio!
Just a shame that the weather is a little too chilly for my liking.
Your cloak, Your Grace.
Good! And my scepter?
I have your scepter here, Your Grace.
Ohohohoho!
SNAP!
Delete that one, Alfredo! I wasn't posing. We'll need to take it again!
Haha! As you wish, Your Grace!
Raffaello and da Vinci, I trust you're carefully considering the composition of my portrait?
You can trust us, Your Grace Marco Polo the Great!
Rest assured, Your Grace!
Your Grace, it's almost time to begin the procession.
As I recall... Richelieu is to lead the first troop, yes?
That is correct.
Heheh... Good. And who goes after her? Actually, read all of the formations out to me.
As you wish. The second will be led by Queen Elizabeth, the third by Bismarck, and the fourth by Roma...
...The fifth by Sovetsky Soyuz, the sixth by Iowa, the seventh by Yamato, and the eighth by Yat Sen.
Finally, the ninth to thirteenth formations will be headed by your Five Archangels.
Good... Wait, come again? Five Archangels?
Yes, Your Grace. The Five Archangels who descended by God's will and now serve as your loyal subordinates.
The Archangel of Insight, the Archangel of Ordeals, the Archangel of Cleansing, the Archangel of Annihilation, and the Archangel of Construction.
Wait a second... Observer, Tester, Purifier, Omitter, and Compiler?!
Even they obey me?
No, Your Grace Marco Polo the Great, they only serve God as His messengers.
Oh... God? Then what does that make me?
Your Grace? Surely you must know yourself better than anyone?
NO! I'm not their puppet!
Whatever sham god those Sirens worship, it's not real! To call them angels is a damn lie!
Your Grace, the Archangels are listening. You must calm yourself!
I'M God's messenger! I'M the chosen one!
Your Grace! Marco Polo!
God, give me the strength to smite my foes!
Nnnh...
Your Grace? Did you have a nightmare?
N-nightmare? It started off as a good dream...
Don't worry about me. I just haven't been sleeping well. Guess even my dreams are stressed out...
Hey, why is the train stopped?
We're already there. The others are checking station safety. Once they're done, you may alight.
We've got some stuff to do, so we're out! Thanks for letting us hitch a ride!
Buh-bye! See ya!
Do they not need to wait?
Nobody can scratch the Great da Vinci, or so she claims. And apparently, they find it strange for shipgirls to be stuck waiting for safety checks on a train.
...I happen to agree. Why do we have to wait?
According to Baracca, this is Holy See tradition.
But I AM a shipgirl. Forget the tradition – let's just go to the church already.
Are you certain, Your Grace?
Who knows what the enemy might be scheming while we waste our time? We have to act fast.
Plus, that dream of mine just now gave me a brilliant idea that might get us the upper hand...
Sorry... I don't understand what you're talking about whatsoever.
Forget it! What matters is that we take action now instead of dawdling! Let's go!

sequence: Unknown location
Unknown time

scripts.say: When I return from the recorded memory beyond the door, the distant silhouette I saw feels like it becomes just a little clearer.
(Project H... And something about an artificial mind? Must be referring to an AI.)
As thoughts float through my head like clouds, a new door reveals itself ahead on the path.
I reach out to touch it, and everything changes abruptly.
A fleet proceeds at high speed across a silvery-white sea.
Hierophant, we will arrive at the distress signal's point of origin in three minutes.
Currently, no signs of life have been detected.
...Yes, I know. The interference is so strong that my search results aren't reliable.
KABOOOM!
Warning: Mimic beasts detected in distress signal's area. Looks like they're lying in ambush.
Warning: Mimic beast interference across all ship systems detected. That confirms it – this is a trap.
Employing experimental Rod of Hierophant.
Hierophant, the interference is getting weaker.
Yes, I detected that the source of it disappeared at the same time.
Experimental Rod of Hierophant usage complete. Data collection complete. Tunguska meteorite sample status is normal.
Employing experimental Rod of Hierophant.
Disintegration characteristics: Pure white. Observation successful.
Strike effect detected. Airborne and waterborne mimic entity vector zones are collapsing.
Experimental Rod of Hierophant usage complete. Data collection complete. Tunguska meteorite sample status is normal.
Hierophant, coordinates for the next area of operation have arrived. Revising course.
A strange sense of unease gripping her, Marco Polo headed straight to the destination with her aides.
At first, that is. Then the free and lively mood of Florence lured her into taking a pleasant stroll through the streets.
They enjoyed a relaxing field trip detour before eventually arriving at the church.
There, Marco Polo laid eyes on the murals Raffaello had painted, taking away the last dregs of unease in her mind.
Now, she lay sideways on a lounge chair in a garden, thinking about another important matter.
Look, Raffaello. How do I look holding this sword?
A ceremonial sword in hand, Marco Polo struck a graceful pose while Raffaello painstakingly committed her majesty to canvas paper.
Looking good, Your Grace! You look perfect with a sword, fighting back evil, and seizing victory!
Magnificent! Then I shall name this sword, "Blade of the Preeminent"!
Make it so the grip is furnished with gold and inlaid with sapphires, and make the blade of meteoric steel blessed with good fortune...
Be sure to add angel wings, the Eye of Truth, and an inscription that says, "Marco Polo, the Chosen One"!
Let me be clear – this sword I'm holding is only a visual reference. What I just described is how you should paint it!
Yeah, I got it! I'm a pro, remember?
Heheh... Of course. I trust your expertise.
But I must ask... You've started drawing, so why is it that your art doesn't grant me the things and powers you depict me with?
Your guess is as good as mine...
Maybe it's not complete enough, or something? It's only at the initial sketch stage, so yeah.
Ah, that would make sense. Continue, then!
Baracca, bring me my staff!
A while later, Marco Polo held her staff high and proud.
I will call this "the Brilliant One's Staff"!
The principal material should be narwhal horns, decorated with gold. Oh, and inscribe it with "Marco Polo, the Chosen One"!
You got it! Anything else?
Add a big ruby at its very end. Be sure to also include a decoration consisting of angel wings and the Eye of Truth!
Sure thing. Do you want anything else?
That will be all for now. Although, this pose isn't quite doing it for me. Come up with a few variations, would you? I'll pick the one I like most.
Oh. Sure.
Let's give the orb a try next.
Baracca, the globus cruciger! Fetch it for me!
Sometime later, Marco Polo raised an orb with a cross haughtily toward the heavens.
Okay, what'll it be this time? I need deets!
Ahem... I name this orb and cross, "the Orb of the Grandest One"!
Roger-dodger. Decorated with gold, furnished with angel wings and the Eye of Truth, and inscribed with the words, "Marco Polo, the Chosen One" – right?
What gemstone do you want?
A large topaz at the very top, surrounded by small diamonds and agates. I want to see some amber, too!
Noted. How many different poses do you want?
One will do. What do you think of this one?
Are you, uhh... about to throw the orb like a shot put ball?
"First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin. Then, shalt thou count to three. No more. No less."
"Three shalt be the number thou shalt count. Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out."
"Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then, lobbest thou thy Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch towards thy foe."
Uh... What?
Oh, you don't get it? Must be ahead of this world's time, I suppose...
Any pose will do then. Present whichever you like. The more variants, the better!
Oookay...
*sigh*...
Marco Polo had Raffaello paint her in all kinds of ways, and yet none of them gave her any sort of power.
While that pursuit yielded no fruit, it was an entertaining and relaxing afternoon for her.
Come the evening, she received news from Giosuè Carducci, who had gone off to do something else.
She told her that the church's facilities were ready for inspection.

sequence: <size=51>Every Light Must Cast a Shadow</size>
<size=51>In the thousands of years in which our civilization has blossomed and wilted, within the light of every Golden Age has lurked the shadow of war.</size>
<size=51>From Hastings, to Trafalgar, to Waterloo...</size>
<size=51>From the most primitive stone knife to the thunderous roar of a ship's cannons...</size>
<size=51>One cannot spark the flames of lofty ideals...</size>
<size=51>without also casting the shadow of fear and sacrifice across the lands.</size>
<size=51>But it is only from within the shadows that the light of hope can be clearly seen.</size>
<size=51>That is why those who sacrifice everything for freedom are forever engraved in the annals of history.</size>
<size=51>That is the foundation of our glory, and of our faith.</size>
<size=51>That is my will, and the banner that I fly as I press forward.</size>
<size=51>And thus, I lay down my life...</size>
<size=51>In the name of the light of liberty.</size>
<size=63>"Iris of Light and Dark"</size>

scripts.say: "Méditerranée." the world's largest land-bound sea, boasts a particular climate not frequently found elsewhere in the world - a scorching, dry summer and a warm, rainy winter.
It is also the cradle for some of humanity's most ancient civilizations. Today, over twenty countries share its borders.
Throughout its thousands of years of human history, countless civilizations have risen and fallen here.
And now, a storm once again brews...
On the calm sea, three battleships and an aircraft carrier can be seen, accompanied by over a dozen escorts.
Reporting! All calm on the sea today. Our fleet is rapidly approaching Mers-el-Kébir.
So it's come to this... even if they used to be our mortal enemies for generations, we've fought on the same side for a while now. I didn't think we'd get an order like this...
I'm sure Headquarters has their reasons. Once a country has been taken over by the Iron Blood, they can no longer be considered our allies.
That's a pity... but...
The Vichya Dominion now commands the fourth largest navy in the world. They've become the greatest immediate threat to the Royal Navy.
In order to not repeat the mistakes of the Iris Orthodoxy, we must strip them of their fangs before the Iron Blood turns them upon our homeland.
Hood...
You don't need to have such a grave expression. We're not going to sink them, you know? Let's just say, we'll be giving them a chance to elect a new government.
Nobody wants a repeat of what happened a hundred years ago at Trafalgar, right?
I've detected Siren signals! I believe they belong to the new Executor-class!
All members of the H Fleet, attention! Be on alert, and prepare for battle! Siren fleet detected at 12 o'clock!
According to the scouting report, there are four battleships, one light carrier, and six destroyers stationed at port, but none of them seem to be operational.
However, it appears that the Siren forces are blockading them. If we are to enter the port, we have to break through their lines first.
The Templar Knights have fallen in with the Sirens...? 'tis a sad day indeed...
Curiously, two of the important battleships that we were targeting are missing.
That might work to our advantage. It would be a much harder fight with those two here.
The purpose of our operation today is to issue a warning, and to perhaps convince them to choose a different path... We want to avoid unnecessary bloodshed.
But let's set that aside for later... Now, let's break through the Siren blockade!
I've been expecting you, dear guests from the Royal Navy.
Good day. I am Hood, flagship of the Royal Navy's H Fleet. We've come to offer our warm regards.
Hood picked up the hem of her skirt and offered an elegant curtsy as was customary of the Royal Navy.
I am Battlecruiser Dunkerque. May the Heavenly Father, Son, and Holy Spirit bless you.
Dunkerque, the dashing knight from the Vichya Dominion, drew a cross across her chest while speaking.
I do hope that you understand the reason we are here today. The Royal Navy would like your cooperation in halting the advances of Iron Blood.
The Templar Knights will not bow to any foreign power.
In that case, I shall give you four options.
First: Leave with us right now, and enlist in the Royal Navy in our fight against Iron Blood and the Crimson Axis.
Second: Completely disarm. In return, the Royal Navy shall offer safe harbor for all of you.
Third: Allow us to escort you to the Eagle Union, where they shall disarm you.
Or, the final option we would rather not see: Sink right here and now.
... Is this your ultimatum? And what if all your options are unacceptable to us?
Then I hope you won't take it personally when we simply follow the orders we were given... and disarm you forcefully.
I cannot tell you what it is you need to do for your country, but... as a warrior, it should be your duty to fight for your homeland. I hope that you can reconsider and join our fight.
I decline your offer.
Dunkerque brandished her saber at Hood with determination in her eyes.
The Templar Knights are loyal to our Cardinal and to our faith. We will not take orders from anyone else.
And that includes the Iron Blood as well as the Empire. We shall never allow ourselves to become the instruments of their aggression.
Well then, I hope you can back up your words by disarming right now.
It is clear to me how cynical your "alliance" is.
Ever since Operation Dynamo, we've completely lost contact with your group.
And now that even the Sirens have taken an interest in you, we no longer can trust your choices. Hopefully, you can understand where we're coming from.
These Sirens are mass-produced models funded by the Iron Blood, used to monitor our movements.
We do owe you our gratitude for clearing out the blockade for us.
We must take our leave now, but... we do hope to hear your official response soon.
Our official response is this: "The Royal Navy is not trustworthy. We will fight until our last breath."
Is that so...
It's about to rain...
Confirming combat results... Dunkerque - heavily damaged. Provence - heavily damaged. Bretagne - sunk...
What about Strasbourg?
She managed to get through the naval mines and escaped during the night.
I suppose... that too is fine...
In all my years of service, I never thought that I would have to turn my guns upon my allies...
It's not your fault. We don't have a choice as things currently stand.
We were made to follow orders, from both Commander and Headquarters... as weapons...
It'd be much easier if we were only weapons...
Hood...
My apologies. I allowed my emotions to get the best of me.
Hood removed her hat and bowed slightly, apologizing to Ark Royal.
We... we're receiving an area-wide broadcast!
This is from... Richelieu?!
We've been searching for her all this time, so why is she...
Please track down the source of the signal!
The signal is coming from...
... the Royal Navy
... Brothers and sisters, awaken to my call!
Our country has been shattered. Overnight, we became a puppet of the Crimson Axis.
"Put down your weapons, and do not resist." This was the order that we were given.
Iris's proud Templar Knights, tasked with preserving the teachings of the Orthodoxy, were declared defeated without even having an opportunity to fight.
Just decades ago, our predecessors made countless sacrifices to reclaim the lands that were rightfully ours.
But now, our country has once again been betrayed, sold off by those who have turned against the Scriptures!
Due to their fear, they have thrown away their dignity and condemned us to slavery.
Is there any greater humiliation than watching the Iron Blood tread all over our beloved Arc de Triomphe and Champ de Mars? No, there is not!
Our immortal souls may patiently await salvation in Heaven, but our mortal country must be protected here and now, at all costs!
From this moment forth, I declare the formation of Iris Libre!
This standard was once flown by the Holy Virgin during the Hundred Years' War, and is a symbol for freedom and sacrifice. It shall once again fly in these lands.
Brothers and sisters, awaken to my call! For the sake of our country's future, gather underneath this banner!
Our country faces a grave peril, but we are not alone, nor are we helpless!
Brothers and sisters, great power still dwells within you. It is time to awaken that power!
In doing so, we will push back our enemies and emerge victorious. When that comes, we shall regain our lost glory!
Remember, the light of God illuminates our path! Be steadfast in your convictions, and never lose hope!
No matter what happens, the flames of liberty will never be extinguished!
To all my brothers and sisters...
May you all be blessed by Father, Son, and the Holy Spirit.
Quite the stirring speech. So that's the girl who has become the new Cardinal...
By the looks of things, the world order is about to shift once again.
Yes... I fear that the storm will grow even more.
So, you're saying that humanity created us in order to counter the Veneto-class?
Hm? Well, that's certainly true on paper.
If that is the case, then we were made to be nothing more than instruments of death.
I wouldn't say that. See, no matter what era it is, humans always cling to heroes to maintain their faith. They can't survive without it.
In other words, we're supposed to be their heroes?
Not yet, anyway. At least not until you're able to move... Heehee~
Richelieu! You're mocking me again! But just you wait... I'm going to surpass you soon enough!
I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, do you know what our names mean?
Huh?
Yes, the name that we inherited from a warship. It represents the great expectations that humanity has for us.
Hmm... what was my name based upon again?
Seems like... a mighty pirate ship... Suits you well, doesn't it?
Huuh?! You're mocking me again! I won't let you get away with it a third time!
All right, all right. But remember... whether you will be a glorious hero who protects the land, or an instrument of death and destruction... is a decision only you can make.
Don't do anything that will tarnish your noble name...
Another dream... How laughable.
So what if the strongest battleship on the seas, the loftiest Templar Knight, has had to rely on the powers of others... Hmph.
... And just what exactly is wrong with that? Foolish sister...
Greetings, Allied Fleet. I'm Renown, from the Royal Navy. I've come to join you.
Task Force 34 Aircraft Carrier, Ranger. It's a pleasure to have you with us.
Hello, hello! So you're the legendary Renown, huh? It's a relief to have someone as reliable as you here!
Nay, I am honored to be here. Thank you for your cooperation. I intend to fully support this fleet's operations as well.
This will be a joint operation between the Royal Navy and the Eagle Union. Our objective is to secure the coastal landing for our ground forces.

If we are able to establish a foothold and expand a new front to the south of the Mediterranean, we would be able to reduce the risk that the Crimson Axis poses to both the Royal Navy and the Northern Parliament.
In other words, we'd be diverting their attention!
That's one way of looking at it, but this operation has much more strategic importance behind it. It's also important to our alliance.
In any case, everyone, please welcome Renown to the fleet.
So, who are we gonna be fighting?
Apart from the Sirens that will be blocking our advance, there is only one possible enemy.
The Vichya Dominion...
That's correct. It's impossible to determine what the current situation is, but I would expect heavy resistance.
If they dare to aim their guns at us, we will teach them a painful lesson!
Here is a summary of the operation. We will commence in 60 minutes, but...
Before that, we'll have to take out the Sirens that are approaching us!
WARNING: Large numbers of enemy hostiles detected. All hands prepare for combat.
WARNING: Large numbers of enemy hostiles detected. All hands prepare for combat.
You've come at last! "The storm brewing over the ocean..." I've waited two long years for you!
Tell me, Richelieu, is this the outcome that you wished for?
Cavaliers of the Vichya Dominion, our crusade begins now!
Two years ago, our homeland was vandalized by invaders.
They would resort to any unscrupulous means in order to seize our glorious navy!
They lack any concept of chivalry, in the same way they lack any concept of faith.
The only things they know are deception and betrayal!
Dunkerque, Provence, Bretagne, we will always remember your names, as well as the humiliation we endured on that day!
On that day, we did not stand and deliver.
On that day, we chose to turn the other cheek.
Does that mean that the true will of the Iris Orthodoxy, Vichya Dominion, is afraid of those who have made bargains with an outside enemy?
Certainly not!
On that day, we were indeed defeated. However, we were able to painfully learn the true nature of this world better than anyone else.
The enemy was strong then. But we too have grown. We are no longer the same Vichya Dominion that we were before.
Those evildoers were able to evade divine retribution once...
And now they come for our homeland once more!
They claim to want to "liberate us," to "give us the right to choose freely." Their platitudes are nothing more than honey laced with poison.
"Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's."
Freedom is not something that can be obtained as someone else's prisoner! It can only be given by God!
With the new powers that we possess, we are now unstoppable!
Once again, Cavaliers of the Vichya Dominion, our crusade begins now!
We shall now prove to the world that we are the true Iris Orthodoxy! Glory shall smile upon us!
Que Dieu vous bénisse tous.
All fleet members, take aim... and fiiiiiire!!
V-V-Vichya warships are firing at us!
The landing force has sustained significant damage! Requesting backup!
I repeat! The landing force has sustained significant damage! Requesting backup!
I knew it wouldn't be that easy...
All air and sea forces, the mission has changed.
Prioritize suppressing all shore defenses near Casablanca and begin landing operations there.
So, looks like we've ended up fighting after all... Though, I won't get to show off if the enemy doesn't have any planes...
Wooaaahhh! We're getting bombed by Siren planes?!
Don't let your guard down! I'll leave the air defense here to you! I'm going to find that Siren carrier and smash it to pieces!
These... err, zealots... have a pretty extreme fighting style...
This shell... was fired from a large-caliber cannon. Is it her?
What's her name again... Jean... Jean Ball?
It's Jean Bart.
Interesting. This battle might be a bit more worthwhile with her around.
Massachusetts, don't forget your duties as flagship of the Task Force.
Neutralize the enemy threat while minimizing the damage we sustain... Got it.
I'll be off now.
I'm also good to go over here!
Hey, wait up!
I... I'll escort you!
Hold up, all of you...
Ahh, jeez... why does nobody bother thinking before they act?!
Air squadrons, provide support for our forces!
So you've finally returned, invaders!
We're just here to recover what was taken by the Crimson Axis! We don't have to fight!
We won't be deceived again by your hypocritical little "alliance." We shall be the ones to protect our homeland!
Look, I'm telling you! Nobody here is trying to occupy your lands!
Shush. There's no point trying to reason with these brainwashed zealots.
You, that battleship over there... South Dakota-class, huh? Heard you're the strongest battleship on that side of the ocean.
Flagship of Task Force 34 and 3rd ship of the South Dakota-class, Massachusetts.
It is always an honor when my foes recognize me. Unfortunately, that doesn't change the fact that I'll have to sink you.
Those girls in the landing force... That was your doing...
Mere riffraff without a shred of faith or conviction. Got a problem with that?
Riffraff...? Faith? The only faith that matters is the absolute firepower that I'm about to beat your miserable face to a pulp with!
Hmph. This is but an opportunity from God. If I defeat "the world's strongest," then perhaps Richelieu...
Come at me! Jean Bart, second ship of the Richelieu-class battleships, shall face you!
