Show me what you've got, "the Ocean's strongest battleship!"
Dauntless, press the attack!
That's enough. She already... can't fight anymore.
Move! Move!! I said, move!!
Why?! Why was my construction never finished?!
Why was Richelieu the only one...?!
You never fired your second battery. Were you holding back on me?
Richelieu, I heard that we're all going to be moved to another dock. Is that true?!
Indeed. Due to... the situation changing on the battlefield. For the sake of safety...
Doesn't that mean that you're telling us to flee?! How do you expect us to do something so cowardly?
Headquarters might have some long-term plans. For the time being, since you aren't able to move, we'll have to move you to somewhere safe.
Let me fight! With our combined strength, my one gun is enough to drive back these pagans from our lands!
Don't tell me... you're with those other powers...
The world is not such a simple place... Just do as you've been told. When your fitting is completed, seek me out again. I'll always be waiting for you.
Fine. Mark my words though! One day, I will surpass you!
Maybe... they never planned to finish building me in the first place.
Perhaps the Crimson Axis thought that having yet another battleship would be like having a puppet. Perhaps that was what they were thinking all along.
I had hoped that the power of the Sirens would allow me to assume a completed form, but in that end, that too was futile.
Heh, how ironic. The country split apart because I was trying to protect it.
I tried so hard to catch up to the person most dear to me that I ended up betraying her... How laughable...
We've received an emergency communication from Headquarters!
"An Iron Blood Carrier Battle Group is quickly approaching from the north! Prepare for combat." Could they have picked a worse time...?
Don't worry. They're not coming for you.
Our Templar Knights are scattered throughout various ports in the Méditerranée. Perhaps...
"Attention, all members of the Vichya fleet. This is an important message from Headquarters."
"As of now, the Vichya Dominion has been dissolved. All former Vichya ships are to join the Azur Lane Alliance Fleet, effective immediately."
"May you all be blessed by Father, Son, and the Holy Spirit."
Aha... ahahahahahahaha!!
Lay down your arms, and come with us...
Silence, blasphemers! I will not allow a repeat of what happened to Dunkerque and others at Kébir.
Ugh...! Jean Bart, flagship of the rightful Vichya Dominion, decrees to all ships in the Méditerranée...
Casablanca has fallen! The pagans now bare their fangs at the heart of our motherland!
The Iron Blood seeks to violate our lands, and the so-called Allies seek to drink our blood.
Even the traitors at the Headquarters seek to sell out Vichya Dominion for cheap trinkets!
While I draw breath, I will never permit this to pass!
Remember what happened at Kébir! The Azur Lane already made their intentions clear to us with what they did to Dunkerque and the others.
While I draw breath, I will never allow us to bow before such hypocrites!
The Vichya Dominion is about to draw its last breath, surrounded by vultures ready to devour us. But what of it?
The proud Templar Knights shall never bow their heads! So that we may never become puppets, I hereby order all of you to sink!
All things mortal must come to an end, but there is no need for sorrow. This is the cycle of life, and we shall become one without lies or hypocrisy.
Perhaps in a distant dawn, I shall wake up once more in a different form.
Despite that, blessed be God's name. Thank you for granting me a life in service of this splendid country.
Thank you for granting me a life of happiness.
And thank you for welcoming me into the seas of Heaven.
Blessed be the successors of the true Iris Orthodoxy.
The Vichya Dominion represents the justice, passion, and love of the Iris Orthodoxy.
May you all be blessed by Heavenly Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
Second flagship of the Vichya... no, of Iris... Jean Bart...
How could you do such a thing?
With this... I was able to honor the pact that we made with the Royal Navy in the past... to not be used by the Iron Blood, to not become a hue in the Crimson Axis...
Jean Bart...
Honestly, I envy you. You have such a strong country, capable of producing such strong cannons and hulls...
If I could also... be like that... one day...
I'll be looking forward to it.
When the war is over, you'll surely be completed. We'll settle our score then.
Even a rotten Eagle like you can speak with some chivalry, eh...
Is that so? We call that talkin' like a cowboy.
(Unexpectedly... there's one more person who I want to overcome... We're surprisingly similar...)
Sure. I'm also looking forward to that day... Until then... let me rest a while...
You've earned it. The Iris Orthodoxy, the Iron Blood, and now the Imperium of Sardegna...
Now it's our turn to settle things.
By the way, did you ever figure out what our names mean?
Huh?
Yes, the name that we inherited from a warship. It represents the great expectations that humanity has for us.
Remember, don't do anything that will tarnish your noble name...
The tragedy of Casablanca and Touraine has passed... In order to carry out their beliefs, the Templar Knights chose to sacrifice themselves.
Great were their sacrifices, and great was their freedom.
In the face of an overwhelming Goliath, they said this: "You may come at us with spears and swords,"
"But we are armed with the protection of the Lord."
In a new era, the power of liberty has awakened.
The just shall once again gather underneath a holy banner.
The time to reclaim our glory has come once again.
Upon this name that was bestowed upon me by the Cardinal, and upon this mantle that I now wear, I swear to protect the freedom in this world.
In the name of the Heavenly Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
Let us honor our comrades who sacrificed themselves so that we may be free.
We've detected a light fleet from the Imperium of Sardegna! Requesting orders from the flagship!
This kind of work is perfect for us Le Fantasque-class destroyers. Just give me the order!
The enemy has entered our range. Let's drop the hammer already!
Haah... haah... Sorry for lagging behind, you're all so much faster than me...
I, flagship of Iris Libre's Second Strike Force Fleet, Jeanne d'Arc, shall now assume command!
In the name of liberty, all ships, commence attack!

sequence:

scripts.say: Port shopping district - Right before Lunar New Year
Oh. Hi, Commander. Happy Lunar New Year!
Fancy meeting you here. I was just about to visit your office.
What brings you here? Are you patrolling the port, perchance?
Always working tirelessly, even with holidays around the corner... You poor thing.

options.content: "I'm just on a leisurely stroll, actually."
"I don't have TOO much work at the moment."

scripts.say: Ah. That's good to hear.
Say, I could use your help with something. Do you have a moment?
Ah. So you have time for other things, I presume?
See, I was hoping you could help me with something. Would you mind?
"It depends. Tell me more."
Sure. I'm planning to expand the firework workshop for the festival.
The Spring Festival is a time for everyone to get together and have a blast.
And what better way to do that than with some stunning fireworks, right?
Unfortunately, in its current state, the workshop can't produce fireworks that are quite up to snuff.
But, that can be fixed with an expansion. We could make new and exciting kinds of fireworks! What do you say, Commander?
I had a similar idea earlier while I was strolling through the port and noticed how quiet it is.
And you can't have Lunar New Year without ear-splitting firecrackers and dazzling fireworks.
"I'm in favor of it. Also, I'm a bit surprised you of all brought up the idea. I didn't think a quiet girl like you would like fireworks."
Heehee. One shouldn't judge a book by its cover. I actually love big, exciting events.
Seeing as you're on board, shall we get right to it?

sequence:
Spring Blossoms in the Sky

<size=45>2 Flowers Bloom in the Sky</size>

scripts.say: Whew... That's almost all the materials we'll need.
I tried my hand at making a firework earlier, and it was easier than I expected. Let's launch it and see how it performs.
Hwah Jah lights the fuze, and the firework takes off to the sky, bursting into thousands of little glimmers that fade into the night.
Whoa... That was beautiful. It came out perfectly!
Commandeeer! Hwah Jaaah!
I look over my shoulder and respond...
Mhm. Happy Lunar New Year to you both.
I saw that firework from way over there! It was gorgeous. Did you two make it?
I give Ting An a quick rundown of what's going on.
I think it's great that you're expanding the fireworks workshop. In fact, I'd love to help!
The more, the merrier, right? Or at least, it'll get done quicker that way. I'll ask around if anyone else can give a hand!
Oh, I almost forgot – here, I brought you some snacks. Have a break and recharge your batteries♪
Now, just wait here. I'll be right back with some volunteers!
Wait, before you–
Go... *sigh*... She made off like the wind.
We open the small ornamental box Ting An gave us and find an assortment of premium rice cakes, crisp candies, and buns filled with red bean paste and custard.
Ooh. They look and smell absolutely delicious.
I say we do as she suggested and help ourselves while we wait for her to come back.

sequence:
Spring Blossoms in the Sky

<size=45>3 The Unsleeping Night of Wonders</size>

scripts.say: Some time later, with the expansion well underway...
Commander, the main structure is complete. We await your inspection and approval.
Thanks to people from all factions lending a hand, work on the expansion has finished way ahead of everyone's expectations.
See, Comrade Commander? This is what strength through unity can accomplish!
I took the liberty of redesigning the building. If you ever want to expand it again in the future, it should be easy peasy~
Excellent work, everyone. Why don't we take a break with some desserts?
Lovely idea. I have freshly made kuzu-manjuus, if anyone wants.
I do!
Me! Me! Me!
Hey, girls, watch this! I can do magic just like Opie! I cast Crackly Fire!
Don't be silly, Tem – that's just running around with a lit firework!
I get it! Clearly it has to be bigger and flashier to be truly magical!
I've got just the thing... My mega firework bazooka! Let's give this bad boy a shot.
Holy smokes! I wanna try it myself!
Fuuuu Shuuuun!
Yikes! Heeeelp! An Shan's going to eat meeee!
Hey, don't run away! I wanna see the bazooka in action!
Gosh, she's quick on her feet... Um, Commander, An Shan and I will go make sure Fu Shun doesn't get up to no good.
Look at this! I've made a firework based on my idol image!
If this won't leave you all dazzled, nothing will♪
Wow! We've built up a real mountain of fireworks here. Great job, everyone.
I can hardly wait to see them go off!
Firework after firework rockets off into the sky, illuminating it in a stunning display. Many – me included – can't help but gasp in wonder.
My word... It's beautiful.
May all these thoughts and feelings given luminous form be seen for miles and miles around.

"As sun, moon, and stars in the firmaments above; as fireworks and falling snow on the ocean below." The only thing we're missing to complete this magnificent winter night's scenery is some light snow.
Hwah Jah, I will be the first to say you have our gratitude for proposing the workshop expansion.
It's seldom we all get the opportunity to get together as one big family, and your suggestion helped make this an unforgettable gathering.
You flatter me. All I wanted was to make our Lunar New Year as lively as it should be.
Oh, right... Commander, if you could make a wish for the new year, what would it be?
"Good question. I'd say..."
"I wish for nothing more than another year full of laughter and joy with all of you."
Sunny weather, gentle winds, and excellent visibility. Perfect weather for setting sail.
Indeed. Then, as we discussed, Her Majesty will join us and personally lead the fleet within a few days.
She's welcome any time! By the way, how's she doing? I haven't seen her in a while.
I can assure you that Her Majesty's state of health is splendid, as per the normal.
Ms. Wales, all the necessary preparations have been made. We shall depart on your command.
Excellent. Friends of the Eagle Union, I would like to thank you for your hospitality and your kindness.
Don't stress it, Wales! The people of NY City would love to have you around again!
I'm glad to hear that. Now, Enterprise, would you lead the way for us?
Absolutely. It's over here.
Have a safe trip home, everyone~!
Have a safe trip home, everyone~!
So, the STAR assessment is zero? Pleasantly calm, for a change.
I must express my gratitude to you for setting up this joint exercise area for us. The girls all wanted a little practice.
Of course, that includes me as well. I have heard many a tale about your heroic deeds, Enterprise, and I was hoping to test your skill for myself.
You don't need to be so flattering, Wales. The Eagle Union stands with its allies, and we're happy to have the opportunity to practice with you.
To tell the truth, I've been waiting for a chance to polish up my skills, too.
Very well, then let's tone down the formalities from here on. The Royal Navy will fight with all it's got, and we hope you will, too.
Let's find out if the Eagle Union's carrier fleet is as amazing as they say!
That's more like it. Eagle Union fleet, let's get ready! Hooyah!
Now THAT was a battle! We admit defeat.
It definitely was. You predicted our attacking fleet's position and countered like it was nothing. Now I can see why you've earned the nickname "Big E."
I'm honored, but I alone don't deserve all the credit. I couldn't have done it without the rest of the fleet.
... By the way, we've been saying goodbye for quite some time now. You should probably get going soon. Hopefully, we'll get another chance to fight like this in the future.
I'm sure it won't be long until it comes, at least if this war with the Sirens continues.
Funny you mention that. I was just gonna offer you an escort through the higher-risk waters. Lots of Sirens in some places.
Thanks, but we'll be fine. If any show up, they'll serve as morale-boosting victories after our defeat against you.
Moreover, ensuring the safety of NY City should be your highest priority. You don't need to worry about us.
It is my honour and duty to clean up any pests that impede our travels. Please, allow me to take care of it.
All right, if you say so. Good luck, everyone!
Likewise. May Lady Luck smile upon the Eagle Union.
... I know this ill-boding feeling all too well...
Attention, everyone! We must head home and report to Her Majesty immediately!

Eagle Union coastal waters 
	Siren Threat Assessment Rating: 0
Escortin' ships all daaaay~♪ Gotta clear out the waaaaay~♪
Oh! Is that them over there, Enty? The merchant ships we gotta escort?
That's them. Just so happened our routes and schedules aligned, so they gave us the job of escorting them to port.
A job's a job, but... why? Isn't this area supposed to be safe?
It is, if your deck's packed with cannons and you're trained in naval combat. If you're a merchant ship, not so much.
That's why the threat evaluation for this place differs between naval and civilian nautical maps. When you're unarmed, it's better to be safe than sorry.
Makes sense... I mean, "safe" is relative in the first place, but still.
You'll learn a lotta stuff if you pay close attention, and not just in combat. You don't wanna end up like Monty and get tunnel vision.
... Speaking of which, watch where you're going! There's sea mines here!
Whoops! Aye-aye, ma'am!
Phew... We all made it in one piece...
That you did. Job well done getting those ships back to port.
Memphis? I thought you were preparing for a meeting?
Among other things... I've got goods to relocate, strategic documents to draft, and messages to relay... Basically, up to my neck in paperwork.
Note to self: never tempt fate again by telling people about your weekend vacation plans... Oh, did I say that out loud?
Sounds stressful. Wouldn't want to be in your shoes...
Have to get through it somehow. Anyway, you three are going to group up with Cleveland's fleet and head out on a mission, right?
Eyup! Groupin' up and headin' out, that's the plan!
What she said. Why do you ask? Did something happen?
Actually, yes: your AO has changed. The higher-ups have ordered you to go on a special mission instead.
A special mission...?
I've already informed the Commander about it, so consider that done.
Here, this mission briefing outlines your orders. Read it later when you have time.
The mission is in Siren-occupied waters, so prepare yourselves accordingly. If you need to, contact me by radio...
Gotta say, I'm really impressed by your dedication today.
Dedication? That's just the coffee doing the talking...
Either that, or all this paperwork is driving me crazy and I'm just ecstatic to catch a break from it. Dunno really.
Anyway... that should be everything you need to know. Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to move on to the next task at hand.
Thanks, Memphis. Hope your work goes well.
Let's see... Recon mission in an AO with a STAR rating of 4... Interesting...
All right, everyone. Inspect your gear and restock on supplies and ammo. Soon as everyone's done, we'll sortie.
Gotcha, Enty! I'll just need to find a gift for Cleve real quick!
There's that gift shop we went by earlier. Might be worth a look...
Heh heh heh... Let's hope you have a "pleasant" voyage...

Eagle Union coastal waters 
	Siren Threat Assessment Rating: 1
Man, wasn't expecting to see this many Sirens 'round here...!
Just a bunch of stragglers. We could zoom by without bothering to mop 'em up...
... is what I'd like to say, but we can't group up with Cleve until we get rid of 'em.
Don't underestimate the enemy. You never know what'll happen when Sirens are involved!
All units, prepare to engage! Don't get cocky!
This is Enterprise. Fleet has arrived safely at the rendezvous point. Good work, everyone.
Cleve! We missed you!
Yo, Denver! Good to see you again!
As you probably saw, these Sirens don't fight so good, but they do have numbers on their side. Clearing all of 'em out is gonna take some time.
So, time to head to the AO, right?
Yeah, but there's been a change of plans. Higher-ups gave us a special mission; we'll be doing reconnaissance in Siren territory.
They said they already informed the Commander about it, so everything should be in order.
Sounds good to me! Besides, we'd surely grow rusty if we just fight these scrub Sirens all day.
Cleve! I brought you extra supplies! Oh, and a gift from Denver as well!
Really? Nice! I was just feeling a bit hungry, actually. Cheers! Om nom nom...
All right, let's do this! With the combined power of Enterprise and the Knights of the Sea, we're unstoppable!
Hooyah!

Eagle Union coastal waters 
	Siren Threat Assessment Rating: 3
Well, this isn't quite what I expected...
Weird that this place is rated STAR 3. I don't see enough Sirens to warrant it...
According to our intel, the Sirens' sphere of influence is rapidly shrinking in this area...
So, they're skipping town, pretty much?
Maybe, maybe not. As per usual, HQ can't really figure out what the Sirens are planning.
Well, if it results in this area being less dangerous, it's a good thing.
No, it's not. The more territory we control, the more thinly spread out our defenses get.
... I've got a bad feeling about this.
This mission is partly about uncovering what the Sirens are up to. All ships, keep your guards up as we advance.

Hostile territory perimeter 
	Siren Threat Assessment Rating: 4
They didn't stage anything even resembling an organized attack...
Have we gotten really good, or did the Sirens just stop trying?
Don't make me keep saying it. Keep your guard up while we're in hostile territory.
But they're giving us the chance to take back territory they stole from us... Maybe that was always part of the plan, and that's why we prepared so much?
Uh, guys? My transceiver's bugging out on me... Anyone else getting a signal?
KRRRRRRRRRHHHHHHH...
Nope... Nothing but static.
Hang on, lemme check... Oh, I knew it! Someone or something is jamming our comms!
Dammit! They must've lured us into a trap!
Enterprise, what do we do? Do we keep going, or pull out?
... We're pulling out. Our orders are not to take unnecessary risks, and to keep going forward would be one.
All ships, 180-degree turn! We're heading back to NY City!

Eagle Union coastal waters 
	Siren Threat Assessment Rating: 0
We made it out! Now our comms should... Hey, they're still being jammed!
I can't get in touch with the coastal defense fleet either... Hey, Enterprise? Think you could launch some scout planes? I'm worried about an attack on NY City.
Uh, Cleve... has this area always been prone to waves this big?
Waves...? Oh, God! Enterprise, the sea has totally changed! This is lookin' really bad!
This can only mean one thing: we've entered a Mirror Sea! All ships, prepare for combat!
A Mirror Sea?! This close to home?!
This is just like that report said! "One moment everything's normal, then the next you're in a Mirror Sea!"
Picking up signals from unidentified vessels!
It's a massive Siren fleet! They're coming at us from every direction!
"And then, bam! Before you know it, you're completely surrounded by Sirens"! It's exactly the same!
Everyone, turn around and maintain your distance to each other! We'll trace our route back to get out of here!
You heard the lady! Follow her and be careful, guys!
We somehow made it out unscathed...
Look, the weather's back to normal! We can finally breathe easy...
Thank God you were with us, Enterprise! If you weren't, we'd never have left that place alive...
Where the heck did those Sirens even come from?
No clue... Maybe the ones we spotted way earlier just disappeared and then reappeared in there...
Cleve, I'm getting a transmission! Let's hear what it... Oh my God...
... It's... an unencoded message... from NY City...! Enterprise... there has been an attack...

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>1 The Lost Purse</size>

scripts.say: In order to strengthen the fleet's operational abilities, I decided to build another supply depot in port.
While pacing around thinking about where to best build it, I saw a drawstring purse lying on the ground.
I picked up the purse and shook it around, the ringing of coins coming from within. Who had dropped it?
Um, Milord...
Oh! That's the purse I dropped earlier... Where did you find it?
I handed the purse over to her, explaining that I had just found it on the side of the road.
Oh, thank goodness... I was afraid it had fallen into a gutter.
It is truly a blessing that the kindhearted commander was able to find it.
Perhaps this is a sign that my daily prayers are being answered. Hehe~
There's no way that dropping your purse could be considered good luck, right...?
By the way, Milord, what are you doing all the way out here?
...I see. You're looking for a place to build a new supply depot.
There might be a plot of land spacious enough by the shrine that Yamashiro and I attend to.
Hmm... Now that she mentioned it, I did recall seeing an empty plot of land around the shrine...
I would be glad to show you around, should you wish me to.
After seeing her gentle smile, there was no way I'd be able to turn down her generous offer.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>2 Shopping for Sweets</size>

scripts.say: Curiosity overtook me, and I asked Fusou what she had planned on doing with the money.
Actually... I was headed to the store to buy some sweets for the girls who help out at the shrine every day.
Would you like to accompany me, Milord?
There's a shop just ahead that sells daifuki mochi stuffed richly with red bean paste.
When we arrived at the shop, we ran into Michishio, who had come at about the same time as us.
Oh, hi there, Commander~ And Miss Fusou as well! Did the two of you also come to buy some sweets?
Indeed. I wanted to prepare a treat for everyone at the shrine... Oh, is there only one daifuku left?
Ehh? You're also here for the daifuku?!
Ugh... They're my favorite, but... I can't just put myself over all the girls helping out at the shrine...
It's alright, Michishio. I'll just buy the ingredients for dango instead and make them by hand.
Huh? S-seriously? Are you sure?
Don't worry about it. Please enjoy your treats~
Thanks, Fusou, you're the best! Ahh, I love daifuku~♪
Michishio happily bounced out of the store with the purchased daifuku in hand.
...Very good. We have everything we need to prepare some dango.
Milord, you're more than welcome to stop by if you'd like. As a special token of my appreciation for finding my purse...
I'd be glad to feed you~
I wasn't sure if Fusou was joking or not, but she was giggling lightheartedly.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>3 Bad At Writing Mail?</size>

scripts.say: The day after my shopping trip with Fusou, I received an e-mail.
"Any spare time?"
That was the entire content of the message. I didn't recognize the sender... Almost immediately afterwards, I received the next message.
"Be there soon."
Was someone supposed to be coming to the office? ...I still had no idea who the sender was, so I wrote a response asking for their name.
"In front of the fountain."
"In the building."
From the emails that were arriving in rapid succession, I could tell that the sender was gradually approaching.
I started to wonder if I'd get a message that said "I'm right behind you" like in one of those scary movies. That's when I got another message.
"In front of you."
As soon as I had read the message, someone knocked on the door to the office.
I approached the door cautiously and opened it...
...E-excuse me, Milord... I wanted to discuss the lot for the supply depot with you, but... typing is hard for me...
I am still getting the hang of smartphones... I'm not sure why it keeps entering "Privacy Mode" when I'm sending e-mails though...
I have always struggled to deal with electronic devices... Um, did something happen, Commander? You look relieved...
Fusou looked at me with a quizzical expression.
Um, in any case... I'd like to show you to the vacant lot. Would you happen to have time?
You do, right? Please follow me then.
I left the office and followed Fusou, feeling both relieved and a bit silly at the same time.
For my sake, I really needed to teach her how to send e-mail.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>4 Promise</size>

scripts.say: "I am bringing Milord over to the vacant lot." Is that better, Milord?
I gave Fusou some general tips while we headed towards the vacant lot, and at least she managed to write complete sentences.
I shall go ahead and send this message to Yamashiro then. Mm, I think it went through. Probably.
I am sorry that I inconvenienced you with my carelessness earlier, Milord.
If there is anything I can do for you to make up for it...
Fusou's words suddenly trailed off as she stopped and looked into the distance.
I followed her gaze into the distance – In the mountains behind the shrine, cherry blossoms bloomed in profusion like a sea of pink clouds.
By the way, this is the time of the year when the cherry blossoms come into full bloom.
That's one of the best places to take a stroll. Being able to walk beneath the swirling cherry blossoms is a rare experience.
Time seemed to fly as we talked, and we soon arrived at the empty lot. The torii gates marking the entrance of the shrine were just a stone's throw away.
Is this place suitable for the depot you wished to build?
If the location is suitable, then let us hold a prayer so that the construction may be completed safely.
And, um, Milord, if you'd like...
After we finish the ritual, would you like to head to the mountains together to see the cherry blossoms?
I wasn't expecting the sudden date invitiation... but excitement crept through me and I could only nod slowly.
Ehehe, thank you. I'll bring your dango at that time then.
Oh, it's you, Commander. And Fusou as well, huh?
Good day, Ryuuhou. Did you come to help out at the shrine today?
That I did. By the way, what are the two of you doing at this empty lot...
*ring* *ring* *ring*
Eep!
Fusou suddenly clung to me, perhaps surprised by the sudden noise from my phone.
I-I'm so sorry, Milord, I'm not sure what came over me...
That really scared me... I keep getting reminded that I'm not good with electronic devices...
Um, Fusou... I think you should consider unhanding the commander soon...
Huh? Ah, um... I'm really sorry for clinging to you...
Fusou, whose body had been closely stuck to mine, started to pull away gently. It seemed as if her ears were red.
In any case, Milord, we will hold our ceremony tomorrow. I hope to see you there.
With those words, Fusou passed through the torii gate with Ryuuhou.
I wanted the moment to last a bit longer, but all I could think about was getting to see her again tomorrow.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>5 Smiling Faces</size>

scripts.say: The next day, I headed out for the vacant lot again. The ritual was about to begin.
Milord, Harutsuki and Yoizuki will be carrying out the ceremony. Please watch them from here.
(Gods, please watch over me...)
Harutsuki, you won't be able to wave your staff around properly if you keep your eyes shut.
...I see that Harutsuki has yet to overcome her nerves.
I know she's more than capable of following what I taught her, it's just a matter of getting her to calm down... And that will take time and experience.
Ah, um... Next, bow twice... Wait, huh? Was it, two or three...?
What's with you, Harutsuki? Get back here already.
Y-Yoizuki... I can't seem to remember... What do I dooo?
...Bow twice, then clap twice. Then one final bow.
In the end, Harutsuki managed to get through the ritual with Yoizuki's help.
Well done, you two. Please rest while I prepare the tea.
Ugh... I botched the whole thing...
That's not true. You did commendably for your first time, and the ritual was completed just fine.
B-but...
Besides, take a look at your tea~
Ah! The tea stalk is floating upright!
The gods are pleased by your efforts, and this auspicious omen is proof of that~
How grateful I am to thee, O Great Gods!
Um, is it okay for me to show this to Yamashiro?
Of course.
After seeing off the reinvigorated Harutsuki, Fusou turned back towards me.
About that... Of course, I prepared it so that Harutsuki would feel better.
Besides, it's an undeniable fact that she gave it her all to carry out this ritual. More important is that she gains the confidence to succeed next time.
An act of kindness, you say? Hehe. I'm happy as long as I can see a smile on everyone's faces.
I could tell that Fusou genuinely believed this from the bottom of her heart. Her kindness was reflected upon her gentle expression.
Now that the ritual is over, are you still in the mood for our little tour tomorrow?
Just as Fusou opened her mouth, I heard the roar of thunder from the sky.
When I looked towards the sky, the sun was beginning to be covered with dark clouds.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>6 Rain of Disappointment</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Come evening, the port had been completely engulfed by a storm. Rain pelted down rhythmically against the office's windows.
At this rate, I'm not sure we'll be able to go on our trip tomorrow...
Coming through, Commander~
I heard the sound of knocking at the office's doors, and Mogami soon let herself in.
I've printed out the current weather map. Apparently, the storm's going to be sitting right over the port for the next few days.
What's wrong, Mogami?
Maybe this ended up happening because I went to look up the data...
There's no way you had anything to do with this. Besides, this data is very helpful for us. Thank you, Mogami.
{namecode:78}……
Um, is it okay if I stop by the shrine next time?
Mm, if you'd like. Though, I don't think it's really necessary.
I see. Well, I wanted to at least get it out there. Sorry for taking up your time then. Wouldn't want to keep Mikuma waiting.
After Mogami left, Fusou exhaled as if something was weighing heavily upon her.
Do you think that... all the cherry blossoms are going to get scattered by this storm?
I've never missed my prayers or broken my strict practices, and yet... misfortunes continue to befall me...
If only I wasn't so unlucky...
Before she finished her words, Fusou shook her head around vigorously and smiled as if warding off her anxiety.
Right, I was supposed to finish making those dango. They'd go great with this tea.
I originally intended to share them with Harutsuki and the others, but you can help yourself if you'd like.
Here, open your mouth. Say "ahhn"~
Though caught off guard by Fusou's embarrassing request, I opened my mouth obediently and chewed on the tasty dango as instructed.
Hehe... Even though we weren't able to view the cherry blossoms together, just being able to have this moment together is enough for me...
Maybe I truly am blessed after all...
I thought I heard a quiver in her voice, but it might have just been the timbre of the rain coming down around us.

sequence:
After the Flowers Bloomed

<size=45>7 A Small Blessing</size>

scripts.say: A few days after the storm passed...
As expected, all the cherry blossoms had been ripped from the branches, muddied and strewn across the ground.
Commander, will you be staying here today as well?
Fusou is currently away from the shrine on official duties. Would you like to wait for her?
I told Ryuuhou that I'd come back later, and went by myself to the trail where Fusou and I were supposed to go on our date.
The cherry grove had been hit just as hard as the trail leading to it. The road was covered with broken branches and twigs.
Commander, what are you doing at a place like this?
As you can see, this trail is now closed to visitors. I'm cleaning up around here, so maybe you can come back next time.
...Hm? Sure, you can have the cherry tree branch, but what for?
An idea came to mind as I looked over the cherry tree branch in my hand, and I rushed back towards the office.
Days later...
(I've been too embarrassed to face the commander, but I never expected to be summoned by e-mail...)
(We haven't seen each other since the day of the storm, but... I can't keep moping about it forever.)
Excuse me, Milord...
Fusou quietly slipped into the office after knocking.
Milord, I apologize for not being present sooner. The mission took a bit longer than expected...
That vase... Commander, are those cherry tree branches?
Fusou stared blankly at the branches I had stuck into the vase.
While cleaning, Yoizuki had found some branches with buds that had not yet bloomed.
I figured that if I watered them quickly enough, there was a chance that they might still bloom. My bet had paid off, and fresh cherry blossoms were now gracing the office.
Did you... do all this for me?
You knew how much I wanted to go see the cherry blossoms...
Fusou clutched her chest, her eyes fixated on the beautiful cherry blossoms.
I have no words to express my gratitude, Milord...
I never thought I'd feel this much happiness...
Even if I am unlucky, the time I spend with you is like a bunch of small blessings...
And that alone makes me realize... that I must be more lucky than anyone else.
I reached out and took Fusou's hands, unable to look away from her gentle, moist eyes.
Whatever misfortunes awaited us in the future, I still wanted to see Fusou smile, rain or shine.
Every little moment of happiness, no matter how insignificant... I wanted to share it all with her.

sequence:
Fu Shun's Great Adventure

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Old Warehouse Treasure Hunt</size>

scripts.say: So this is the place you were talking about? Hehehe, I'm sure there's plenty of nice stuff in here!
Umm... Should we really go inside without the commander's permission...?
It's fine! The padlock is all rusted up anyway, so I'm sure nobody will care!
I think it's just been worn down over time...
Look, the warehouse needs to be cleaned regularly, right? We're just doing some "cleaning" on the commander's behalf! Besides, we might find some good books in there!
I mean, you love books, don't you?
Good... books?! W-well, it's not like I'm NOT interested...
Then let's go treasure hunting! I'll look around here, you go search over there!
Oh geez... Sorry, warehouse! We're just cleaning, that's all!
*Cough, cough!* ...It's so dusty in here...
*Cough, cough!* ...I found a bunch of hard-to-read books...
Yeah... I found piles of components, dunno what they're used for...
Oh, Tai Yuan! Come here! Look what I found!
I-isn't that a...

sequence:
Fu Shun's Great Adventure

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Can You Fix It?</size>

scripts.say: Chang Chun, look at this!
Oh wow... You actually went to that old warehouse, huh...
Hm? Did you say something?
No, nothing! ...So, what did you find?
Alright, don't be shocked, now... Ta-dah!
Isn't that a... handheld game console?
I knew you'd recognize it!
Looks pretty ancient, though... And it's... Huh? It won't open.
Aw... But don't you think it's cool? I wonder what games you can play on it!
Not really...
You don't think it's cool?!
But I know a certain gamer you can ask about what games it has!
Isn't that a... handheld?
Chang Chun said you could tell me more about it!
Heheheh... I'm not used to being complimented in that sorta way...
Really though, what is this thing... I've never seen anything like this before...
This is pretty hipster even for a hardcore gamer like me... It might actually be homemade...
What?! You don't know what it is either?!
Sorry to say, but you'll need to call in a pro for this one...

sequence:
Fu Shun's Great Adventure

<size=45>Chapter 3 - The Hero's Journey Begins</size>

scripts.say: Welcome, nya~ Oh? What brings you here, nya? Shopping for supplies, nya?
So this is the legendary Shop... There are a lot of interesting-looking things!
...Wait, no no no, I'm not here for supplies! Akashi, could you examine this for me?
A game console, nya?
Yeah, apparently! Long Island said you're the best at repairs, ever!
F-fine, nya... Just this one time I'll examine it for free, nya.
Unya... This is a pretty old model, nya... First we'll fix this... then replace this...
Whoa...!
Phew... It's fixed, nya!
Awesome! You're amazing, Akashi!
It took some time to replace the old parts, but now it should be fine, nya~
I knew I could count on you!
Chang Chun~ I got the handheld fixed~ Wanna play some games?
You actually managed to get it fixed...
I know, right! Now let's power it up!
Let's see... Right, enter name... I'll go with... F-u-s-h-u-n...
You're one of those people that use their real name...?
Yep! I guess it's more immersive that way, you know?
Here we go! The hero, Fu Shun, has set off on her journey to save the world!

sequence:
Fu Shun's Great Adventure

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Then the World was at Peace...</size>

scripts.say: Get that guy! Attack him!
I know! Here, have a taste of THIIIIIS!
Whoooa!
Woohoo! The world has been saved!
The graphics and the controls are as retro as you'd expect... but it's surprisingly fun to play...
Hey, what's this? A scoreboard?
Huh? There's another name there besides yours...
I think it says... A-n-s-h-a...
D-do you think that's...
There you are, Fu Shun! You've been going around causing trouble again, haven't you?!
Oh crap! An Shan?!
Not only did you break the padlock to the warehouse, you even made a big mess inside!
Yikes, let's get outta-
You're not going anywhere! And you, Chang Chun! You coaxed her into doing it, didn't you?!
*Gulp*...
Stay right where you are! You're going to get a severe...
...Hm? Wait, i-isn't this that old...?!
We found it in the warehouse. It was broken, but Akashi fixed it for me!
S-she fixed it...
That other name we saw on the scoreboard... wasn't that...
BE QUIET! As I was saying: you're both going to get a severe scolding today!
Eeek... An Shan's scarier than the final boss when she gets mad...
What was that?!
N-nothing! I didn't say anything!
Also, I'll be seizing this console!
Whaaaat?!
Ahh, so nostalgic... I'm amazed someone was able to find it...
It even has my save data from back then... Hehehehe...
I knew it, that console was yours all along.
Waahh! Chang Chun?!
Well what do you know~ An Shan is a gamer~
You too?! How long have you been here?!
Aww, look at An Shan... She's adorable...
ALL of you are here?! Uhh... Look, um, it's not what you...
Hey, it's fine, we were all kids once! Usually, people grow out of their old toys though, right, An Shan?♪
Heheheh~ Wouldn't it be more fun if we all play it together?
W-well, it can't be helped now... I guess we could...
And so, the world was at peace again! And everyone lived happily ever after!
Hey! Don't try to wrap the story up like that!

scripts.actorName: Tai Yuan & Fu Shun & Chang Chun
scripts.say: Hahahahaha...

sequence:
Mysteries and Danger!

<size=45>1 Where's the Hidden Passage?!</size>

scripts.say: (As I recall, my new secretary ship starting today was...)
Commander! Destroyer Fu Shun, reporting for her first day of secretary work!
An energetic voice fills my office. I can already tell that today's going to be a hectic day.
Right, so... The first thing a new secretary ship does is... check your schedule? Let's see what you've got... Hmm, yep...
You have a meeting at noon, so you should understand the important parts in advance, right? I'll go print the materials!
Commander, are you thirsty? Do you want coffee or juice? Oh, or maybe tea after all?
Commander, you need to sign this report. I'll leave it on your desk!
Commander...
I'd expected things to be more chaotic with her here, so it surprises me how seriously she takes the job.
It seems safe to delegate work to her, so I can head to the meeting with peace of mind.
It's almost time for the meeting. I'll leave this work to you, Fu Shun.
Got it! Rest assured, your work is in capable hands!
After a while, Fu Shun stops working.
Oookay, that's enough work for one day! Now it's time for... Investigation! Adventure!
Oh, hidden passage, where are yooou~♪ It's gotta be behind that bookshelf~♪
After my meeting, I open the door to my office—
There, I find my bookshelf moved out of place, books and documents scattered all over the floor, and one panicked Fu Shun.
Huh? Commander? You're back early... Th-the meeting is over? That was too fast!
Taking advantage of your absence to do mischief? Pssh, who, me? Never! This is just... Yeah, an investigation! Yep! I'm investigating stuff!
Investigating?
I'm seeing if there are any hidden passages leading out of your office! Moving the bookshelf and books were just to check for traps!
I should hope there aren't any hidden passages, let alone traps. There... aren't, right?
Hey, there's no need to jump to conclusions! Maybe you just never noticed, right?
I already started the job. Let's search together!
My secretary work and stuff? I already finished it while you were out at your meeting! Let's use the rest of the day to investigate!
(Should I correct her attitude toward work here? No, I'd feel bad stopping her now...)
(Ah, whatever. She took her job seriously in the morning. I'll manage the afternoon work myself.)
I manage to weave through the piles of books on the carpet, sit at my desk, and get to work.

sequence:
Mysteries and Danger!

<size=45>2 Day in the Life of a Secretary Ship</size>

scripts.say: As the sun sets and another day of work comes to an end, there's a knock at the office door.
Commander, it's An Shan and Tai Yuan. May we come in?
Be my guest... Oh.
Thank you. Coming in—Hm? The door won't move... at all, in fact.
Hngh... It's like something is blocking it... We can't open it from here.
Comiiing! Wait, An Shan?!
H-hold on a second! I-I'm cleaning up!
After some confusion, Fu Shun cleans the books off of the floor, and An Shan and Tai Yuan finally get to enter.
Fu Shun, what are you doing?! This map is supposed to be on that wall there! Why'd you take it off and throw it on the floor?
Also, why is the carpet all flipped up?
A-An Shan, be careful! You're going to knock down that pile of books...!
Fu Shuuun! I knew I shouldn't have let you be a secretary ship! You're troubling the Commander with all your mischief!
Aaaah, An Shan, don't get mad! I-I promise, I'm doing my job! Right now, I'm just, um, investigating stuff...
Investigating WHAT, exactly?
Like... whether or not there's a hidden passage in this office...?
That's why all this stuff is all around, y'know... Hehe!
It's okay, An Shan. I could've stopped her, and I didn't.
Yeah! The Commander didn't stop me!
Fu Shuuun!
Ack! I'm sorry, An Shan! I'll get this office spick and span on the double!
Really... Commander, you mustn't spoil her. It's a secretary ship's job to help you work.
As her older sister, I must apologize on her behalf. I'm truly sorry, Commander.
I won't let her go until your office is back to normal! Of course, I'll help, too.
I would like it back in its usual state, but...
You have an exercise tonight, don't you? Are you sure you should be here, An Shan?
Urk... I'm sure if we try hard, I'll make it in time... Hopefully.
Don't worry, An Shan! Even if we don't finish in time, I'll be here. You can go to your exercise while I finish the job!
I-I'll help, too!

sequence:
Mysteries and Danger!

<size=45>3 The Mystery of the Mysterious Abandoned Factory</size>

scripts.say: Fu Shun's destructive power exceeds expectations. Even when moonlight begins to shine through the window, the cleanup effort is still incomplete.
An Shan leaves on time to get to her nighttime exercise, but she urges Fu Shun to get everything back to normal before running out of my office.
After a little longer...
Okay, Tai Yuan! Let's go, too!
Huh? A-aren't we supposed to finish cleaning before we go? We haven't put all the books back yet...
Commander! Can we go home now? I'll be back to clean up tomorrow! Pretty please! I'll never ask you for anything again!
You have cleaned up most of it, so I don't really mind. But didn't you promise An Shan you wouldn't leave until it was all done?
Did something important come up?
Heheheh, weeell, there's a mystery of the port that I just gotta bag!
Chang Chun told me there's a rumor about a weird, shady figure showing up at the abandoned factory at night, and I wanna investigate it!
It's the perfect time. Tai Yuan, come with me!
D-do I have to go, too? Aww, I don't want to... I'd rather stay here and pick up the books...
(Knowing Tai Yuan, I doubt she wants to go investigate mysteries this late at night...)
(But that doesn't mean I want to make her clean up all on her own.)
Tai Yuan, you go back to your room and get some rest.
Fu Shun... I worry too much to let you check it out alone.
I'll come with you.
Hmph. Why do I feel like you don't trust me... Not that it matters! Let's go!
Fu Shun leads me to the abandoned factory far from the center of the port.
The factory, overgrown with plants, is wrapped in the dark of night. We peek inside, but the moonlight isn't enough for us to see anything.
I think I remember this factory was abandoned after we relocated...
It does feel like a place where strange things would happen.
Heheh. You think so, too? I knew it...
W-wait! Commander, don't just go in!
It's an old building, and there's no light. We have to be ready before we go in!
Fortunately, I happened to bring a flashlight! Tadaaa!
What will we find inside? A lost monster? A wandering spirit? Ooor...
I appreciate you trying to liven up the search...
But can you stop shining the flashlight up at your face while you do it?
Heheh! Did I scare you?

sequence:
Mysteries and Danger!

<size=45>4 Ghost Spotted!</size>

scripts.say: With only the flashlight to guide us, Fu Shun and I walk through the factory.
Heeey! Anyone theeere?
Whoa, this place is big. Did you hear that echo?
You think if someone was here, they'd be too scared of all my yelling to come out?
Mmm, would they be that cowardly...?
Besides, don't you think it's more fun if we openly announce our presence?
*sigh*... All this walking, though, and not a single ghost or monster... There aren't any hallways or rooms, either.
Hmm... Should we search the office? Maybe we'll find something saucy, like an abandoned safe!
Don't rush so much. Watch your step!
I can hardly get the words out before Fu Shun staggers and loses her balance.
Whoa?! I-I just felt a mysterious force! ...And it almost made me fall flat on my face!
Something mysterious is going on here!
C-could it be... it's trying to stop me from learning too much? Is it WARNING me?!
Have we already stepped into the danger zone?!

options.content: I think your shoelaces are just loose.
Maybe you tripped over a cord.

scripts.say: Come ON, Commander. You should learn when to play along.
Anyway, let's get to the next area!
(Fu Shun sure is enjoying herself... Maybe I should try to have fun, too.)
Fu Shun and I go to the area where the office is.
Aww, it's more plain than I expected... I thought maybe there'd at least be wooden stairs...
Not maintained for years, so worn out that they crack and break when you step on them... That would at least add to the mood!
Well, no. Abandoned or not, this is still a port facility, so it's not going to be that delicate.
Fair... That's a shame. But there should still be value in investigating it!
Ooh, look at those safety regulations on the wall! And next to it... Oh! The factory floor plan! It looks like we're on the first floor, huh?
Let's see... There's a reference room on the third floor. Want to go?
Of course! A reference room must be a whole treasure trove of secrets.
It looks like the stairs are at the end of the hallway! Let's go!
Careful, now...
The overeager Fu Shun ignores my warning and charges forward, armed with only a flashlight.
*rip!* I hear the sound of clothes tearing, followed by Fu Shun's screams.
Whoa?! C-Commander, I can't move!
When Fu Shun struggles to escape what's holding her back, there's a clicking sound.
Wait... A hidden passage...?
The wall in front of me slowly moves aside, revealing an unknown corridor.
A hidden passage! It was real!

sequence:
Mysteries and Danger!

<size=45>5 A Mystery Unveiled!</size>

scripts.say: The two of us proceed through the hidden corridor together.
Huh? Is it just me, or are the temperature and humidity changing...?
Commander, I think we're going underground.
Agreed. But what do you think this passage is connected to?
*beep beep!*
Commander, do you hear something?
Fu Shun whispers to me. I find myself tensing up a little.
Do we need to whisper?
Ahem... I mean, it's a real hidden passage. Even I'm gonna get a little nervous...
Wait! Th-this is bad! Something's rushing at us from up ahead!
Green... eyes?! Aaah... Is it a ghost?!
Who... Who's there?
There's a trembling voice in the darkness—Ingraham's voice.
Oh... The green-eyed thing was just Ingraham's little helper robot.
Phew... It's just Fu Shun and the Commander. I thought YOU were scary ghosts.
(Looks like we scared each other.)
After a moment, everyone calms down, and Ingraham questions us.
Why did the two of you come to the factory's underground warehouse?
So late at night, at that...
Well, to us, you're the mysterious one for walking around this factory all alone in the middle of the night.
I just came to look for any materials that were forgotten during the move. They're planning to demolish the building, after all.
Taking inventory at this time of night won't get in anyone's way.
So they're finally planning to clear this plot of land?
Yep. Tomorrow, I'll be supervising the blasting process.
I get it now... You've been here taking inventory every night, and that's why Chang Chun thought you were the mystery of the abandoned factory...
Mystery of the abandoned factory? Come again?
Nothing. Don't worry about it! Heheh!
Oookay, that marks the end of our search! The mystery is unveiled to be none other than Ingraham!
Aren't you disappointed that the mystery was all a big misunderstanding?
Nope! Quite the opposite, in fact! Today was a ton of fun!
Having fun exploring is what satisfies me! The results and truth don't matter one bit!
An abandoned factory, mysteries and legends, walking through the darkness with just a flashlight... That's where the real fun lies!
(So the adventure matters more than the destination? Maybe that's why she can always get so fired up over mysteries?)
Speaking of, my work here is very nearly done. Do you have any more business here?
If not, let's go back together.
Okay! Heheh~ It's the perfect time at night for me to share some of my own stories of the port's mysteries!
What do you say? Want to hear some crazy true stories about the port?
W-well, not really... Let's keep quiet and watch our steps, instead...
Thus, the three of us quietly proceed through the passage...
...Until we hear an odd sound on the other end.
What was that?
You heard that, too, Commander? It was like a click, and then... nothing?
Did my robot malfunction? No... That sound was unfamiliar.
C-could it be... one of those mysteries you were talking about?!
Fu Shun, let's not investigate this one, okay?
I look to Fu Shun. For some reason, she's looking down and fiddling with her phone.
Fu Shun? Are you sending a message, or...?
Hm? Oh, did you say something?
That was just a random noise. Nothing to worry about!
Okay, everyone! Let's go home already! There's nothing to investigate here!
Commander, Ingraham! Let's get going!
(She was having fun before. Why has she lost all interest in this factory now? Something's off...)
(Hmm... I'll keep a close eye on Fu Shun for a while.)
The adventure of the mystery of the abandoned factory ends confusingly and unsatisfactorily.
Is that just the nature of a mystery—that sometimes, some questions simply go unanswered?
Early the next morning, I enter my office as usual.
All of the books that had been left on the floor last night have been put back, and the carpet and map are in their rightful places. And...
Commander, good morning!
Oh? You look confused. Are you wondering why I'm here instead of Fu Shun?
You read my mind. Isn't she my secretary ship for today?
Maybe she went off somewhere? Heheh, I don't really know~
By the way, you went to the abandoned factory together, right? How'd it go?
Did you find the truth of one of the mysteries of the port?
We did. The shady figure appearing there lately was Ingraham.
Oh, I see! Everyone must have been surprised when you ran into each other, I'd bet.
Yes...?
(Why does she sound like she knows all this?)
Before I can ask her, there's a loud noise outside. It's so intense that it rattles the windows.
Hmm... Was the factory demolition supposed to be this early?
Ingraham probably scheduled such an early time so she wouldn't cause any trouble for people.
I was so surprised when I learned it was getting destroyed! Well, not that it matters, since it sounds like it's done.
Phew, okay! Everything's all cleaned up! Bye bye, Commander~
Thanks for your help. Take the rest of the day to rest, okay?
As I look upon my restored office, I remember the question that Chang Chun had brushed off.
Now, where is Fu Shun?
After a while, Fu Shun finally comes in to work late.
Commander! Sorry, sorry! I totally forgot I had secretary work today!
I smell like smoke? Uhh, well, I went to the demolition site!
Here, I'll open a window and get some fresh air in! Huh, wait...
You finished cleaning up?
Did you do it all yourself, Commander? Aww, I'm really sorry...!
Not quite. I was planning to...
But Chang Chun got here before me, finished it up, and went home.
Wow... Chang Chun did it, huh?
Hm? Are you saying you didn't ask her to do it?
No? It's not like I told her to come in for me. Like I said, I forgot all about my secretary duty today...
*whispering* If she came here, she must have been worried about that...
Hm?
Nothing! Anyway, let's start today's work, Commander!
Later the same day, Ingraham comes to visit my office.
I'm here to bring the report on today's demolition of the abandoned factory. I'll leave it on your desk.
Oh, Ingraham! That explosion was awesome! One big bang, and the building is gone!
It's such a shame I forgot to bring fireworks! If I launched them when you detonated the building, that would've been a real sight to see!
I wouldn't let you! That's dangerous.
Anyway, the demolition was completed without issue.
And one more thing...
That odd sound from last night has been on my mind, so I went to check on it one more time first thing in the morning.
In doing so, I found evidence that there was a fourth person there—someone other than you, Fu Shun, and I.
I don't know who they were, why they were there, or if they were even there at the same time as us...
But I made an evacuation announcement before the demolition, and I confirmed nobody was inside, so they couldn't have been crushed.
My investigation on the fourth person is included in the report. Commander, take a look at it some time.
Th-there couldn't have been a fourth person! It must have been a ghost, or something, ahaha...
I know! Your investigation must have been flawed, Ingraham! Yeah, there's NO way anyone else was there.
(Fu Shun... Could you be any more suspicious if you tried?)
(Chang Chun in my office first thing in the morning, those odd remarks, Fu Shun's weird reaction... I think I know who that fourth person is already.)
(Fu Shun knows, too. That's why she's trying her hardest to cover up for her sister ship.)
(I guess even a troublemaker like her can be a caring sister.)
Even later that day...
I'm sorry, Commander... I'm just here to check up on Fu Shun. I've been worried sick about her.
Fu Shun. You haven't done anything to trouble the Commander today, have you?
Not at all! I did every last bit of my secretary ship work!
And you mean that?
She did. Fu Shun's been a big help today. I think she does a great job as secretary.
Commander, if she's causing trouble, I want you to tell me without hesitation. I hear she dragged you to the abandoned factory late last night.
She didn't do anything weird there, I hope?
It's okay. Fu Shun may be mischievous, but she's not that absurd. She has a good head on her shoulders, and she's reliable when she needs to be.
And she's a good sister, too. You should have more faith in her.
Wh-whoooa... Is it just me, or were those compliments?
Phew... If you say so, Commander, that is a relief.
But don't you get carried away, Fu Shun!
You take your job seriously until the end of the day and fulfill all of your secretary duties! Understood?
Y-Yes, An Shan!
After An Shan's visit, Fu Shun works diligently throughout the day. Before I realize it, our work day is over.
You can go home now, Fu Shun.
Whuh? It's already dark out? Closing time, closing time!
By the way, Commander, do you have plans? I want to take you to a cool place!
Is this another mystery of the port?
Hm? Are you interested in the great mysteries of the port too?
Anyway, that's not it this time! Actually... Well, you'll know when we get there!
I follow Fu Shun to an unfamiliar place.
There are piles of things as far as the eye can see. Some of them are rusty and faded, but they still emit a soft luster.
I can tell that everything here is well cared for.
Tadaaa! It's my secret base! Awesome, isn't it?
I didn't just bring you here on a whim, though... And I'm not plotting anything, either!
After a whole lot of thought, I decided to share my secret with you!
I mean, you and I already share one secret after yesterday and today, right?
Hm? Do you mean Chang—
Before I can speak Chang Chun's name, Fu Shun puts a finger on my lips.
Shh! Secrets are secrets because we can't blab about them.
Only you and I know about this secret base!
You can come any time you want and store your treasures here! I'll protect them for you!
When we go on adventures again, we'll hold strategy meetings here! Hehe, just the thought of it is exciting!
Fu Shun excitedly runs around her little secret base before coming back to me again.
Secrets only you know, secrets I can only share with you... Heheh, you're like a member of my family now♪
It feels as if she's added me to her collection of treasures.
Taranto Harbor
So if I understand this right... you're offering to give our fleet a tour around one of your bases?
Correct. As part of our agreement of cooperation and information sharing, we would love to have the Eternal Flagship as our esteemed guest.
Why? This invitation comes very much out of nowhere.
Does it? We just thought you could use a brief respite from your routine work. I'm sure it will prove a nice change of pace.
Hmm, this location you've chosen... It was formerly occupied by Sirens. How did you manage to recapture it?
Let's leave that as a surprise for when we get there.
I see... Putting aside whether or not I can actually get permission from Veneto, you put forth an interesting proposal.
However, the Eternal Flagship and I cannot leave the Méditerranée. We are needed here for important business.
I hope you understand that Friedrich really wishes to meet the Eternal Flagship and her associates.
Then how about a compromise? I can readily send someone to represent us.
The person I have in mind is close to us, and very diligent, too.
That will be fine. But you must be sure that the person you're sending can be trusted, as the research we're conducting at the base is top-secret.
Do not worry, I know for a fact that my candidate wouldn't speak a word of it to anyone else.
Perfect. Tell me when you're ready to depart. I'll be relaxing in the guest room meanwhile.
Carabiniere, reporting for duty!
You said you had orders for me, Lady Littorio?
That, I do. Listen closely, Carabiniere. I have an important task for you.

scripts.say: Open ocean - Unknown coordinates
Fog appearing out of nowhere in an unremarkable part of the ocean and engulfing our fleet. Sounds quite familiar, does it not?
Without any idea of our heading, we'll get lost in no time... Wait, maybe our other instruments still work?
Considering how abruptly that fog appeared, I believe we should expect to run into more anomalies shortly.
I'll bet you anything that this is a Mirror Sea we're dealing with...
A Mirror Sea?! Are you sure?
I'm all but certain. The first thing we should try to do is find and destroy the Mirror Sea control unit to break free from it.
There is another, simpler way: to keep sailing straight in one direction until we've broken past its boundary zone.
True. That's what we've been doing up to now anyway.
Gosh, it's almost like we were sent straight here to do Akagi's and Kaga's dirty work. They could've at least told us what we were getting into...
I bet they sent us the long way because they wanted to hog all the honors for themselves...
You know, we can use this path as an escape route in case things go awry!
Ah yes, an escape route with a Siren-occupied zone smack-dab in the middle of it. How strange nobody discovered it until we did! I'm sure it's all a coincidence.
Enough chatting. I've finished checking on the equipment.…………………
Well, someone had to find it sooner or later! Better us than someone far less prepared for battle.
Hmm, yes, my instruments are starting to go haywire. This is definitely a Mirror Sea.
This is not my lucky day. Not lucky at all...
That makes two of us. Okay, Zuikaku, before we–
KABOOOOM!
And like clockwork, here come the Sirens! It seems simply sailing out of here is not an option if they have anything to say about it!
That leaves us with little choice but to fight! Get ready, folks!
Floating Fortress - Area between D11 and D12 defense lines
Z46, Heinrich.. The time is now. We will commence training.
We just have to defeat the Pawns' Sakura Empire and Iron Blood fleets, right?
That's right. However, such meager forces as you faced before would hardly classify as training, so I threw in some extra Pawns.
Heh, keep 'em coming! I'll knock down whatever you throw at me!
Brave words. We'll maintain the same formation we had this morning. Heinrich and Z46 in the Vanguard Fleet, Weser and I will be air support.
Aye!
There's one more thing you should be mindful of.
Because I haven't been able to ascertain the exact cause of the communication failure, I've raised the security level of the research facility just in case.
Therefore, all defense areas beyond D12 are off limits.
So, we shouldn't enter them even to pursue a training target?
Don't make me repeat myself. Besides, past D13, even the mass-produced ships there are equipped with live ammunition. Anything that makes it through will quickly get turned to fine dust.
I'm going to maintain these security measures at least until I can determine the source of the communication abnormality.
Live ammunition...? Are they programmed to attack all intruders indiscriminately?
Woah, isn't that overkill? What if an allied fleet happens to wander into the wrong neighborhood?
I have no plans to be anywhere near there, and I've already notified any relevant allies. In case someone does end up getting caught up, I trust you'll be able to clear out the mass-produced ships.
A true maestro of the battlefield! You've already thought everything out!
This is perfectly normal. Observers from the outside will see this as another Siren "Mirror Sea." If anything, it would be abnormal for them not to encounter any resistance.
Good point. Well, how about we get the show on the road then with this next exercise?
Can you try not being hyperactive for once?
...C'mon, we've wasted enough time here. Let's hurry it up!
KABOOOOM!
That's the Akagi Pawn down!
The Jintsuu Pawn has been successfully eliminated.
Good. I've also eliminated the Sakura Pawns in this area. Shall we move to the next location?
...Wait, there are still more Sakura planes inbound.
If we've destroyed all the carrier Pawns, there shouldn't still be any operational aircraft. Did we miss something?
That shouldn't be possible... Wait, huh...?!
What happened?
That's not one of the Pawns that I set. It's using a live ammunition loader rather than training rounds!
I don't think any of the settings were wrong. Could the equipment in the Floating Fortress be malfunctioning?
Either a malfunction, or... No, that shouldn't be possible...
Strasser, you okay over there? Somehow, there's more Sakura aircraft...
The communication line is open.
For some reason, Pawns and mass-produced fleets are being deployed outside of D13. They're using live ammunition.
Ehh?! How the heck did that happen?
It shouldn't be possible, but our eyes aren't deceiving us. Not even Bismarck had an absolute understanding of Siren technology.
For the time being, these look just like the mass-produced ships being kept around the perimeter as anti-intruder countermeasures.
I see... So, what's the plan now?
We'll join up first. For the time being, we have to find this carrier Pawn and take care of it before it can damage the facility.
Don't forget to swap out the training rounds for live ammunition.
Understood. Ending communication.
Yo, Eisen! We're gonna have a real battle on our hands! You ready for this?
The Sakura aircraft broke formation and retreated. Did the routine module of the Pawn malfunction as well?
It's impossible to track down all of them. Weser, were you able to locate the carrier?
I found an entire mass-produced Sakura fleet placed in an unplanned area, but there were no carriers present. Apparently, we're dealing with more than one device failure...

W-what is this...?! Waaah!!!
Cancelling anchoring of frame. Powering up movement module to 30%.
I-I told you I won't let you get away!!! ...Ugh, these tentacles are in my way!
Heinrich, you can fall back now.
Leave the offensive to us now.
Roger that!!!
KABOOOOM!
Ahaha! How many shots can that barrier of yours withstand? Smash it to pieces!!
KABOOOOM!
Peter and Weser's carrier-planes are here! And so are the supporting aircraft made in the research facility!
I'm here to make a joint attack with the attack aircraft! Have a taste of the my Crimson Hellfire!
And stay down...! W-wait, that rigging is so massive that we can't get through it...!
Soldati-class destroyer, Carabiniere, joining the battle!
Heinrich, we're here to help!
The barrier looks like it's about to crumble! Everyone, just a bit more!
Floating Fortress - Platform B3
Now, as you all know, the Fortress' airfield facility received an upgrade just today. We will conduct a test of its functions, and carry out routine anti-air training.
The upgrade will not only make the training grounds more realistic, but also make the simulated enemy aircraft more like the Pawns they're based on.
Additionally, we will be fighting Pawns modeled after ships from every major faction.
I've got a question. May I?
Go ahead.
Just want to make sure: in addition to the mass-produced Sirens, we'll be fighting doppelgangers of ships from Iron Blood, the Sakura Empire, and Sardegna?
That is correct.
Wait, we are?! Err, I mean... Yeah, we are! Even I knew that!
You sure about this, though? It feels kinda wrong to use the data we have on our allies to create Pawns...
A live test using the latest available data is the most logical way to gauge how much better the upgrade made the airfield.
You would know this if you'd actually read the briefing. I don't have the time to explain it in detail just for you.
Okay, that's fair...
Great that you understand. Any other questions?

- Nope.
- None from me.
Good. Your objective for this training – or should I say, exercise – is simple: destroy all the targets in the area through any means.
It's worth noting that I've increased the ammo impact parameter by 15% to better prepare you for the real deal. Keep that in mind.
Talk about Spartan training...
A hit suffered during practice may hurt, but better that than losing your life in a real battle.
We have already been through a multitude of realistic combat scenarios. This is simply another on the long list of them.
Well, if you say so, Z46... So! When are we starting? I'm raring to show off the fruits of my personal training!
It's lovely that you're so motivated, Heinrich. Then without further ado, our test of the facility starts–
Time to shine, Eisen! Let's show these Pawns what we're made of!
...now.
Always off before the starting shot, that girl.
KABOOOOM!
The barrier's been destroyed!
The time for your destruction has come, Compiler!
Emergency detected. Rebooting shield.
Huh?! The barrier's coming back?!
Even after all that trouble we just went through...?
And the main body is still unscathed... How...?
My friends, it seems like you need a bit of extra firepower!
It's too early to give up, guys! We'll back you up with our firepower!
It would be a stain upon our honor if we just helped ourselves to your supplies while ignoring you in your time of need.
I'll help out too!
KABOOOOM!
The barrier's down! Now's our chance!
Eisen! Don't hold back! Fire!!!
Movement module at max. Underwater mode—
HUUUH?! Um, I mean, WHAAAAAT?!!!
What happened, Heinrich! We can't detect Compiler's location anymore!
Compiler, uh... she went under water just like a submarine!
Are you saying she has rigging for both surface combat and underwater mobility?!
Farewell.
We'll lose track of her at this rate!
U-37, looks like the rest is up to you. Do you think you can stop her in her tracks?
I'm already in position! Heheh~ Time to show off what a deep-sea hunter is capable of!
Stop right there, Compiler! It's time for a showdown, you and me!
...An ambush.
Never thought that you'd be able to move so quickly with that giant rigging of yours...
But do you think you can outrun my torpedo?
Armor is incapable of withstanding a direct hit.
Oooh, I think you've been had, you subprogram, you~!
Don't listen in on the emergency channel.
Ah, don't be such a buzzkill, you! Just so you know, I'm here at Observer's behest to come get you. Were you able to get your hands on the sample?
Yes. It was very troublesome to do so.
One heck of a job you did there~ You can leave the rest to me, all right?
I'm tired. Thanks for delivering the sample for me.
Wait, you little!
It's fragile, so be careful.
Hmph! I can't believe I don't get to fight, ever!
KABOOOOM!
Huhhh?! The Siren exploded...?!
But I didn't even get to land a single torpedo yet, damnit!
Daaaaamn it———!!!
Floating Fortress E2 - A few days later
Alright, and that's it! That concludes today's tactics meeting! Thanks for having us, Strasser!

You do know it's only been 15 minutes since I've started to talk, don't you? I took time out of my precious schedule to go over this information with you. I won't let you escape until I'm done going over every... single... point.
But it feels like it's been 15 hours already... Why am I here, just to suffer...?
Eugen, please come save me, before it's too late...
Eugen's in the classified facility. Besides, Eugen wouldn't be dumb enough to ask me to let you go anyway.
Et tu, Eugen?
I have to say though, I'm thoroughly disappointed with your attitude. Just when I was about to make you a focal part of the Iron Blood's main fleet, considering you potential.
Is it wrong to just want to fight? Why sweat the small details anyway!
As representatives of the Iron Blood, calling the enemies "octopus" and "cockroach" in front of our close allies stains our name.
Though generous as I am, know that I have no problem taking time out of my busy schedule to... educate you. I'll have you know that my stern lectures are just as "informative" as Z23's.
Noooo! Never! Anything but that!! Reading boring books makes me all sleepy and stuff...
At least give me something cool and action-packed!
I see. This must indeed be too easy for someone of your caliber. How about something on Graf Zeppelin's world view? It's a bit philosophical in nature, but...
I don't even know what you're talking about anymore!!!!!!
Taranto Harbor
Over. That's the end of my report of my observations during my stay with the Iron Blood, Lady Littorio.
Good work. You've been a great help.
Lady Littorio, concerning the demonstration of the Iron Blood's new weapons and technology. How would you like for me to respond to their request for me to stay a bit longer to see them?
If they're going to that length to show us what they've accomplished, it'd be rude to turn them down. Sorry, but would you mind staying there a bit longer?
Yes ma'am! For the glory of the Sardegna Empire, I will undertake any mission!
(The facility that was built in the Mirror Sea was attacked by the Sirens... Hmm)
(I'm really curious to hear about the incident in person, but... I'm rather in shock over how overwhelming the Iron Blood's strength actually is.)
(Mmmn... As the guiding voice of the Sardegna Empire, what should I do about this situation...)
Littorio, the delegation has arrived. Which one of you will head out to greet them?
I'll head out. Make sure to let Veneto know as well.
Understood.
(Well, whatever. I can think about the more troublesome issues later.)
(After all, today's a promising day. I'll have to greet the guest from far away properly.)
Floating Fortress - Day of the Siren attack
It's the Iron Blood fleet... The communication we received was from Prinz Eugen, wasn't it?
This isn't a Pawn, is it? This entire zone is full of Pawns flying the colors of just about every faction, I can't tell who's real.
I think it's the real deal this time...!
Heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen... right?
That's right. And you're Zuikaku of the Sakura Empire's 5th CarDiv, am I right?
That you are.
Was the Iron Blood caught up in the Mirror Sea like we were?
I suppose you could say that. To be exact, it wasn't our fleet that got caught up by the Mirror Sea, but rather our facility.
What a hassle... While we were sailing, some mysterious fog suddenly appeared, and by the time we knew it, we were stuck in the Mirror Sea.
And even though we were right next to each other, it became harder and harder to contact each other. It was so hard for us to move anywhere...
I'm aware. I also wasn't able to get in touch with anyone until I got this new communicator.
Isn't there something bothering you about this whole situation?
Naturally. Up until now, we've been able to contact each other at this distance with no issues. It's as if they were jamming our signals on purpose in order to make us fight each other.
...Make us fight each other...? How would they pull that off?
It's simple. Make a lot of Pawns of various shapes and sizes, and make it so that we can't contact each other from tactical distances.

So basically, what you're saying is, they made it so we couldn't tell if the thing approaching us was an ally or a Pawn. The more cautious both sides are, the less receptive they would be of communication from the other side.
In short, they wanted us to take each other out in a massive bout of "accidental" friendly fire... What a despicable plan!
Fortunately for us, we still had an additional way to communicate despite their best efforts.
If you use this, we can make sure we don't attack each other. The real problem is finding out the mastermind behind this plot.
We've got a plan to find out who it is, but would you mind working with us to solve the mystery?
Our goal's the same, so our answer should be obvious! Let's beat up the Sirens and get out of here already!
Good. Thank you for your cooperation.
First, there's someone in the Sakura Empire who I'd like you to give this communicator to——
Right, Friedrich. You used to play chess with Strasser quite often, isn't that right?
That's why you were able to recognize right away that it was her plan. I know I wouldn't have been able to.
I can't believe she tried to capture a Siren by using a Mirror Sea. Though, in the end, it was your plan to get rid of that Mirror Sea.
Don't be like that~ You're the one in the enviable position here. Not having to get your hands dirty, while being free to dream without any disturbances.
Oh by the way, did you want a souvenir? I'll have 556 or Tirpitz bring you something next time.
There's one thing I forgot to ask about. It's about the Sirens... no, rather, about the cubes. I just figured you'd be the most knowledgeable one on the subject.
What do you know about "META?"
Heinrich, do you copy?
Loud and clear!
The enemy aircraft have changed their attack pattern. Are you en route to the airfield?
Yep-yep! Headed there to take out some stray enemies!
Hold. Before you enter battle, first check the Stronghold's Control status so you don't get blindsided by enemy aircraft.
Roger-dodger!
I've spotted the enemy's ambush fleet. It seems our primary target this time is the humanoid-type Conductor.
Gosh, they're just popping up all over the place this time. That upgrade really took our training to the next level, Strasser!
Yes, like the briefing said. If only you'd read it... Anyway, Weser and I will engage the aircraft. You go deal with the Conductor.
Okey-dokey! I'm gonna whoop her into Siren bratwurst!
...Actually, quick question, what was the Conductor's gimmick, again?
You... You absolute scatterbrain! You don't know what the Conductor does?!
Hey, it's not my fault these Sirens have been total pushovers up till now! I sink 'em before they can even villainously introduce themselves!
Anyway, uh... could I at least get a visual description?
*sigh*... Fine. The Siren with a 6-pronged rigging that makes it look a bit like an octopus? That's a Conductor.
Now shoo, attack them already. I will not tolerate you wasting any more time than you already have.
Smasher, Scavenger, Conductor... Their names are all too similar! Can't we just change her entry in the database to "Octopus" and be done with it?
NO, YOU HALFWIT. Mein Gott... I'm closing the comms channel.
No need to get angry at me! Geez... Come on, Eisen! Time to turn that Siren into seafood!
Floating Fortress - Platform B7, maintenance area
I'm baaack! That's those Sirens dealt with.
