Her voice is sweet and carries an emotion that pierces straight to the heart.
Alright. I'll help you.
Thank you! Now come here, traveler. Just a little closer.
As I come close and touch her tailfin, a weird and slimy chill runs through my fingers.
At the same time, a question surfaces in my mind.
Hang on. Something you said just doesn't sit right with me.
If you're able to purify the sea, why would you seal yourself away rather than confront it directly?
Let's suppose that everything you told me is true...
Then maybe the reason you can't undo the seal is because the disaster has already gotten to you.
I think your powers of purification created the seal and only they can undo it.
Hmph. You're sharp, I'll give you that.
Not that it matters. You'll undo the seal whether you like it or not.
What?
Right as I try to swim back, I realize that my body is no longer listening to me.
The mermaid's singing is moving me like a puppet on invisible strings, instructing it to undo her restraints.
Heheh. Wondering why your body won't obey you? That's because it desires me!
Err... In the sense that it wants to sacrifice itself and become one with me.
Her black tailfin coils around me and jerks, pulling me right into her bosom.
She looks at me again, a bright smile on her face.
That's the smile of a predator – a predator that has finally caught her prey.

sequence:
Sails and Spooks

<size=45>6 A Game of Chase</size>

scripts.say: I stand on a rooftop at night. The thief I've cornered turns around and cracks a slightly stiff smile at me.
Well, shoot. Seems there's nowhere left to go!
Of course, that's not true. This is where the battle really starts.
Go on, master detective – follow me if you have the guts!
The thief leaps backward off the roof, numerous tentacles sprouting from her back while she falls through the fog.
She is no ordinary thief, and she is no ordinary human – she is a manmade monster known as Frankenstein.
No one knows who she is or where she came from. All that's known is that she's an expert thief, based on the many treasures that have gone missing across the city.
And I, the detective who has been on her trail, have become caught up in an endless game of cat and mouse with her.
What?!
Ahaha! I win again. How boring. Here, I'll return the treasure.
I wonder – will I break into pieces if I fall from this height, hmm?
She cracks a joke even as she's falling, and tosses the treasure to me.
Her mocking laugh still rings in my ear as her red silhouette vanishes into the fog.
I catch the treasure and fearlessly jump after her.
The rushing wind rages loudly, and an unpleasant feeling of weightlessness makes my stomach churn.
But I gave back the treasure! Why are you still pursuing me?

options.content: To bring an evildoer to justice!

scripts.say: Arrest me? Ooh, you're sooo scary.
Oh, I'm evil now? Being arrested sounds sooo scary.
Her sarcasm is so thick it could float on top of water. In fact, she grins at the idea of being arrested.
You're really pursuing me to protect me, aren't you?
Aww, you don't want to see me turn into a red splotch, is that it?
...I just can't let anything happen to a perpetrator I'm trying to arrest.
The wind blows ever louder, and our fall is finally about to come to an end.
I aim my grappling hook gun at a suitable target and reach out to Amity.
If you don't want to end up as a pancake, take my hand!
Ahahahaha! It was worth it making you go through all this trouble.
There is a sparkle in her eyes, as though she has laid eyes upon the most valuable thing in the world.
Now there's REALLY nowhere left to go for me!
She extends her hand and grasps mine.
Silly detective. The treasure I was after this whole time was you.
Her tentacles grab onto a ledge on the building, forcibly halting our fall.
Then, she provocatively pulls herself toward me.
You chose this, I'll have you know. Heehee.
Now give it up and be mine, "master detective."

sequence:
Sails and Spooks

<size=45>7 A Deal with the Devil</size>

scripts.say: I awaken to a cold tile floor under me.
My attention jumps right to a beautiful woman sitting on a throne in the middle of this big hall.
Ah, finally awake, visitor?
Her looks and her voice alike are the definition of gorgeous, and yet, she exudes an intidimating aura.
Hey, ya don't gotta be so on edge. I'm the boss of this place. Just call me Owari.
Saw you lyin' on the side of the road, so I brought you here.
Speaking of, where're you from? Looked mighty battered when I found ya.
Her horn ornaments – hornaments, if you will – sway as she speaks. Her tone suggests that she's genuinely concerned.
Even knowing that she isn't human, I can't help but feel affection for her.
(Let's see... I was hurt badly by a beast while on the road, and I dragged myself over here, then...)
Wait... Where did my wounds go?
Your wounds? Yeah, you were beat up real bad, so I healed ya.
Pretty based of me, wouldn'tcha say?
She flashes a bright smile and nods proudly, seemingly waiting for me to praise her.
Yeah, you did an amazing job.
Thing is, I didn't do it outta the kindness of my heart.
(What? Oh boy...)
A story I'd heard suddenly comes to mind – that demons trick humans into making "deals of equivalent exchange" with them.
So... what do you want from me?
Will you make me command your demon army and invade enemy territory, or...?
What? Ya lost me there.
A look of confusion forms on her face and she idly tugs on her clothes.
You're not? I thought you'd make me offer something of equal value.
Oh, right! Yeah, that's the one!
Ahem... You owe your life to me. You must give me something worth more than that.
Here, take this!
She reaches behind her throne and pulls out a hoe of gold, then throws it to me.
She then corrects her posture and assumes her regal looks again before continuing.
I take it you know what this is, yes?
...I sure do.

options.content: It's a weapon imbued with powerful magic!
It's a tool to dig the graves of your enemies!

scripts.say: Using a farming tool to slay your foes and humble them at the same time... How ingeniously devilish!
I can use this to bury those who oppose you... How ingeniously devilish!
Actually... That sounds like a pretty inefficient way of doing it.
Yo! Don't go usin' my precious tools for none of that!
She puffs her cheeks up in anger and wags her finger at me.
Listen up! Here's how you're gonna repay me: by hittin' the farms and workin' the soil with me!
Chest held high, she looks very content with her own proclamation.
I saved your life, so you gotta give some life back!
You were bleedin' like a stuck pig, remember? It took a buttload of demon carrots to stop it!
Rising from her throne, she slowly walks over to me.
You'll be staying right here, helpin' the greens grow, and you ain't leaving 'til then!
She places the golden hoe in my hands.
Her fingertips are warm and soft, and her eyes are brimming with kindness and a longing for new life.
Heehee! C'mon, visitor!
Let's go bring new life into this world!

sequence:
Sails and Spooks

<size=45>8 Wolf on a Full Moon's Night</size>

scripts.say: Guided by the moonlight, I arrive at the village I once lived in long ago.
My return was spurred on by, of course, my desire to meet with Atago, who's spoiled me and was always there for me since I was young.
Standing at the entrance of the village, I look at the moonlit buildings and notice something – how quiet it is.
A bad feeling comes over me and confusion settles in. Right then, I hear a voice coming from the roof.
Wicked beasts! Begone!
This is where I and my soulmate made countless memories... I will NOT let you ruin it!
I look up and see that there's a person on the roof.
While she does have the physique of a woman, she also has a pair of animal ears that flap gently in the wind.
What's more, she has a wolf's paws in place of human hands.
(Wait a second... That voice... Could it be...?)
Is that you–
GRRRRR!
A pack of beasts cuts me off and surrounds me before I can finish speaking.
Of course... You won't just back down.
Fine, then I'll just have to teach you a lesson!
Although her voice is cold and intimidating, it's all the confirmation I need.
Atago?
She is momentarily stumped, then the look of confusion in her eyes changes to a look of sadness.
After letting out a howl and scaring the beasts off, she extends a hand and pulls me up to the roof.
Why now... Why did you decide to come back NOW?
Everyone else fled long ago, when the beasts first started attacking the village...
What about you? What happened to you?
Did you get... cursed?
No. This isn't some curse...
She stops, seemingly at a loss for words.
It looks like she wants to come closer, but doubt holds her back. Her tail wags around anxiously.
With a sigh, she accepts reality for what it is, and gathers her courage before she starts explaining things.
The thing is... I've always been a werewolf.
I never told you because you were still young when you lived here, and I didn't wanna scare you...
If I had a choice, you would've never had to see me like this...
She bites her lip and her tail hangs like it's lost all strength. Gone is the ruthless mask she wore for those beasts.
Do you... fear me? Do you hate me?
I shake my head and grab her hand.
Although it's more of a fluffy paw now than a hand, its warmth is the exact same as I remember.
I wrap my arms around her in a tight embrace, trying to impart courage and comfort to her.
She trembles in my arms – her fluffy tail, too, begins to shake.
I don't care how you look. I'll never hate or fear you.
Because inside, you'll always be the person I've–
GRRRRR!
Right before I can get another word in, the same beasts that she drove off earlier come back, only more numerous this time.
They gather around us, using each other as stepping stones to try to get on top of the roof.
Thank you...
Tears well in her eyes. Tears of happiness. She holds them back.
Don't worry. I'll take care of this.
I'll keep you safe. Not just tonight, but forevermore.
Holding my hands, she leaps far into the sky – toward the moon – where the beasts can't touch us.

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>1 Call of the Creeping Embrace</size>

scripts.say: I was forced to pause my hike up the mountain due to a sudden rainstorm. As there happened to be a mansion nearby, I decided to seek shelter there.
If only I'd known what was in there...
Feeble mortal. You are disturbing the Ancient Ruler's slumber.
A bunch of massive tentacles squirm inside a dark pond. Sitting there upon a crooked throne, a girl slowly opens her eyes.
I am Queen Anne's Revenge, an ineffable supreme being.
Wherewith whose permission do you, mortal, set foot upon this sacred ground?
The tentacles move only slightly, but it feels like they're approaching with staggering might.
Well... It would be a bit of a shame to just devour you right here and now.
Saved by the bell. She seems to have changed her mind.
Given how large and how daunting my sanctuary is to clean, I shall make a special exception for you.
I will allow you to remain here as my retainer and serve me for the rest of your life.
Make your choice. Will you submit, or will you be devoured?

options.content: Sounds like there's only one real option...

scripts.say: Heheh. A wise decision.
Nonexistent. Refuse, and you'll be swiftly eaten whole.
The tentacles bring me up to her, and then hand two things to me.
Uh... A towel and soap?
This is your first task – clean my noble body.
Remember this well: You will from now on be cleaning my tentacles thoroughly.
All of them, down to the last sucker. Make sure you don't miss a spot!
She flaunts a haughty attitude as she lifts her head, all but commanding me to accept her orders.
Why are you just standing there? Get to it already.
I do as I'm told, and begin carefully wiping down her body. Her look of displeasure gradually dissolves into a relaxed expression. She sometimes gives me a small nod to show satisfaction.
Mhh... Aahh...
Ohh... To make even a supreme being such as I feel this pleasure... Your technique is impeccable.
Marvellous work, my diligent retainer.
As a reward, I will permit you to partake in the supreme ritual of this god.
Before I can even respond, several tentacles suddenly drag me into her bosom.
I feel the warmth of her body through her thin clothes. Compared to the cold, damp tentacles, she's strangely hotter than I expected.
You should be honoured to not just get to witness, but also be a part of this grand moment, mortal.
You will now set aside all your worldly thoughts and surrender your soul to the Ancient Ruler.
A growing number of tentacles begin to envelop us until, finally, they fill in the last bit of space between us.
*pant*... *pant*...
Soon, the Supreme One shall descend to us...
Are you ready, my retainer, to fall into my abyss of nothingness?

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>2 The Forbidden Slurp</size>

scripts.say: The wine cellar's door is kicked open with a loud bang, blowing a cloud of dust into the air.
I am a legendary investigator tracking down a wicked occult society. My pursuit has been an exceedingly long one, spanning several continents.
I found this hidden, underground wine cellar after receiving a tip from my informant. Rumors say that the occult society has been conducting experiments on a forbidden being down here.
I was prepared for a firefight to unfold in this place, but now that I'm here, I don't see even a single person with a gun drawn.
Instead, what I find is a dainty girl covered in some sticky liquid.
Wuh... Uhh? H-hello...
The innocent girl looks at me and slurs out a greeting with her index finger in her mouth.
Who are you?
Royal... James. I'm Royal James!
That's the one and only thing I know!
Hey? Hey! Are you listening?
Where am I? Who are you? Also, what am I?
Her clueless barrage of questions interrupts my train of thought. All of a sudden, she crawls up right next to me.
There is a massive tentacle behind her that wags around like a tail. It catches my eye.
...I get it now. You must be the forbidden being I got a tip about.
Forbidden... being?
I'm... a forbidden being!
Judging by her reaction of immense joy, she seems to really like this "title."
Heheh – I'm starting to like you a bit!
You're a really interesting person! But why? Why are you more interesting than me?
How are we different? What exactly sets us apart?
Please tell me everything you know!
I'm an investigator, and I'm looking into a wicked occult society. You are a forbidden being that they created.
I... I don't know what that means! But it sounds really interesting!
I'm an investigator, and I created an assistant through forbidden means to be my perfect partner in stopping a wicked occult society. That assistant is you.
I'm your... perfect... assistant? I love that! It sounds so fascinating!
Sorry to say, but I don't know jack squat either. Hell, what is this place? Who are you? Who am I, for that matter?
Huh? Whuh? Who is this place? Where are you? What am I?
The tentacle behind her starts to move around happily.
Wait... I can move this tentacle however I want?!
This is so much fun! I want to try some things!
Ahaha! Look at me! I'm flying!
Let me try changing directions! Whoa, hahaha! That was close, but I'm having so much fun!
This is sooo cool!
Whew... That was a lot. Now I want to do something even funner.
First, though, I need to land!
Taking advantage of her momentum, she leaps at me before I can even react. She places all her weight on my chest.
Her arms wrap around me, and her soft hair touches my neck, sending a tickling sensation throughout my body.
Ever since I woke up, everything's seemed really fresh and interesting...
But you! You're the most interesting thing of all!
And I think you're keeping something from me. Heehee. Something really fun.
I want to see every part of you!

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>3 The Doubtful Madam of the Castle</size>

scripts.say: The night is wearing on, and an old castle in a remote wilderness enters my view.
I open the front door, which produces an ancient creaking sound. My breath held, I carefully begin exploring this mysterious building.
KRR-BOOM!
Thunder roars. Its light illuminates the dark hall, and I spot a girl standing in front of a fountain of wine.
A safe castle and a party no one knows of. This safe house is getting better and better.
Wait... Huh?! Eeek! H-how did you get in here?!
Sorry if I'm disturbing you this late. See...
I'm a lost adventurer, and I came here in search of a safe place to spend the night – I tell her that.
L-lies! I planted traps everywhere outside the castle! You're saying you just avoided all of them, are you?
No ordinary adventurer would have the skill for something like that!
There is a look of nervousness and doubt on her face. The situation is gradually heading in a bad direction.
Or what, did you just so happen to stumble upon my safe castle, then luck your way past all the traps?
And moreover, then you accidentally made your way into this secret hall?
You expect me to take your word for it when you're some intruder sneaking around?
A-ha! I've figured you out. Someone as skilled as you could only be an assassin!
Then Adventure's castle is no longer safe...
Now I'm feeling uneasy... Extremely uneasy...
I try really hard to explain that I'm telling the truth, and ask her to believe me.
In addition, I open the bag I'm carrying and show it to her.
Her gaze is fixated on my every move, and she looks curious yet vigilant. Unconsciously, she leans forward.
You... don't have any weapons?
But if this was a planned assassination, you'd obviously bring a weapon...
No. That's not enough. It doesn't prove your innocence!
I might believe you if you'll let me do a full-body search!
Who's to say you aren't hiding weapons on your person, right?
She suddenly comes close. I am not at all ready for this "full body search" out of the blue.
Nothing here... Nor here...
You really don't have any weapons... Are you telling me it truly was all a big coincidence?
Fine. I'll believe you for now.
Okay, then–
Not so fast. Stay where you are.
I said I believe you, not that I'll let you leave.
There is a loud thud, and the door to the entrance is completely shut.
Oh? Not one to panic, but to analyse the situation instead, hmm?
So you stay calm, despite the trouble you're in now...
Only a battle-hardened adventurer would be able to pull that off.
Heh. I'll be frank – you've greatly piqued my interest!
You will remain here, and you're going to amuse me with your adventure tales!
Oh, but there's no rush. We'll have all the time in the world to ourselves here.

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>4 Fallen Angel in the Dark Castle</size>

scripts.say: After a long journey, having overcome many difficulties along the way, I've finally made it to the deepest parts of the Dark Lord's castle jail, where her army has imprisoned my guardian angel.
Is it you? Are you my benevolent saviour?
Amidst faintly swaying lights, the angel's white wings are bound tightly by chains, greatly limiting her range of motion.
She sees me, having just sneaked into the room. Her expression is curiously not one of relief that she'll be saved – rather, it looks more as though she's carefully examining something.
So you've infiltrated the Dark Lord's dangerous castle all by yourself to save your beloved angel...
Your bravery is truly a touching thing.
I'm here to save you! Come on, let's get out of here!
Oh, hero – my dear hero – you say you're here to "save me," but it's only you who thinks I need saving.
Just the thought of leaving this wonderful place sends a throbbing pain through my heart.
Say, why don't you come closer and feel how my heart aches?
Ah, what is it, my hero? Why have you fallen silent?
Are you perhaps enamored with the way I look now?
Yearning for the visage of a pure angel, yet being unable to turn away from the titillating sight before you...
I imagine there must be some quite fun things happening in your inner mind.
She spreads her arms widely, and unfolds the wings behind her.
She is beckoning me into her embrace, inviting me to a divine land overflowing with passion and lust.
Heehee... You grasp it now, don't you?
I've lost the goddess' blessings. I will never again be your guardian angel.
Yet, even knowing this, you still look at me with those same gentle eyes, brimming with love... It tears me apart, hero.
Perhaps, if you stay by my side, I may still be saved one day.
When that day comes, maybe then the angel you know so well will return to you.
As she smiles, her body twitches. A purple liquid with a sweet aroma catches the light, with little sparkles reflecting off of it.
Oh, are you curious as to what this is, my dear hero?
Why, it's quite a rare charming potion. I accidentally spilled a little of it just now. Would you please come and help me "collect" it?
Naturally, you may even lick it off me if you so please.
Her breath brushes against my face, carrying with it a really odd yet appealing scent.
Heehee... It seems even my dear hero can't defy the call of temptation.
That being the case, I will go all out.
These chains, this black lingerie, these little pearls... I prepared them all just for you.
Their purpose? To allow you to fully unleash your instincts♥
Come... Discard your mask of heroism – and of humanity♥
Here, we are just creatures of love, seeking only to endlessly lick and bite one another...
Please, remain here... by my side. Forever and ever♥

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>5 The Cursed Investigator</size>

scripts.say: A few days ago, Kronshtadt and I came to this abandoned village to investigate an inexplicable curse that affects this place.
However, she hasn't yet shown up at the time we agreed to meet today. Concerned, I decided to go and check on her.
I knock on the door.
Wh-who is it? Judging by the intensity of those knocks... Is it you, Comrade?
Sorry, it's just... My attire. But I understand you'll be worried if you don't see me, so...
Okay. I'm ready. Come in!
I enter the room, and I'm met with Kronshtadt, but something is seriously wrong with her.
The most eye-catching things are the black horns sprouting from her head, as well as the black tail behind her, wagging anxiously.
As you can tell, this happened completely out of nowhere.
I simply woke up, and then I looked like this...
I couldn't make any sense of the situation, so I didn't dare just rush out... So sorry for keeping you waiting!
Nothing happened in all the prior days during our investigation, and now, all of a sudden... this.
Don't tell me it's what I think it is...
Are you thinking that this is what's devastated the place?
That it's a curse that turned all the people into animals? Our intel said nothing about that. In fact, it sounds like something out of a kids' ghost story.
Well, our intel also said nothing about... this irresistible, primal urge I'm getting...
She bites her lip, as though she's frantically trying to keep something within herself.
Her gaze tells it like it is, however. Even as we speak, her eyes keep turning to the giant milk barrel in a corner of the room.
Hey, um, Comrade... Could you bring me the straw that's over there?
Wait, no! Never mind I said that! Forget it!
I just suddenly felt something weird... Like my chest swelled a bit...
Apropos of nothing, this curse should only affect your outside appearance, right?
Because if so, that's no big deal at all for a seasoned investigator like myself! Right?!
Don't worry. I won't leave you.
Yeah. As long as I've got you, it won't take long to get used to looking like this.
Ugh... But I really need to... No! I can't! I can't allow myself to let you down!
She firmly grips the fence in front of her, seemingly to calm herself down. The look in her eyes is that of someone pleading for help.
O-on a related note, I've heard that distracting yourself can relieve mental stress.
Since I doubt I'll be able to investigate for a while, why don't we just... talk about something?
Great! I knew I could count on you! Only problem is, I'm not sure what we could discuss.
Incidentally, are you thirsty? Do you want some milk?
No, wait! I can't believe I just said that... I'm thinking this curse might affect your mind, too!
When viewed another way, though, if you want to beat magic, you have to fight fire with fire, so...
O-okay, this is just a theory, but what if these things happening to me aren't interference on the curse's part, but rather the solution to it?
It's about not being bound by form, learning to unleash your instincts, and being true to yourself...
Yeah... That's it! It's got to be!
She nods along as she mutters to herself, before finally taking a deep breath.
If I'm wrong about this, then I'll accept that. Here goes...
Comrade, would you like some fresh milk?!

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>6 Tail-Stirred Cocktail</size>

scripts.say: It's now day two of my investigation into this nightclub.
According to my leads, the bartender here serves a special kind of cocktail. Anyone who drinks it supposedly becomes a rabid fan of hers.
However you cut it, there has to be some foul play going on here.
My investigation yesterday yielded nothing, so tonight, I'm going to be infiltrating under the guise of a lost customer.
Hmph. Found you, you sneaky little rat.
Whuh?!
BANG!
As I slowly shake off this dizziness, my eyes open to a strangely familiar ceiling.
A... detached room in the nightclub?
You awake?
A beautiful lady sitting in a gorgeous chair addresses me in a deep voice.
There is a crystal glass in her hand. She gently runs her slender fingers around it while tapping the chair's leather surface with her tail.
You're the one who went sniffing around the club last night, aren't you?
You caught me off guard, and you got away once. Here you are again, except you've gotten further this time.
Curiosity killed the cat, Investigator. You should know better.
That said, I respect your bravery.
I'll reward you with a little info. I am Izumo, the bartender you're so curious about.
Now tell me – who hired you? I'll give you twice whatever they're paying if you tell me everything.
(I'm not only in the dark on the situation, but also her captive now... I'll just have to improvise.)

options.content: (Tell her you came by your own volition.)

scripts.say: I'm not working for anybody. I'm doing this investigation of my own volition.
Are you? Hah. Interesting.
Her eyes narrow and she smiles, as though she just remembered something pleasant.
"Your own volition." You really don't know how this works at all.
I'm sure you know what you're in for now that I've sniffed you out.
Well, I'll level with you – I used to solve things with violence, but now I prefer to talk it out over drinks.
After all, why wouldn't you want a friend like me, eh?
Here's what we'll do. If you're still sober after you've drunk my cocktail, I'll let you leave, and even tell you the secret behind this glass.
You've got one chance, so make it count. What do you say?
Heh – alright. This was your decision. I didn't force you.
Let's get started.
Wow, you've had a lot. You can really hold your liquor compared to the average person.
Hm? Now do as I promised?
Hah. I'm surprised you still remember.
Of course. A promise is a promise, and I'm a woman of her word.
You want to know the secret of what's in this cocktail? It's this...
She lifts her tail, and reveals an injection hole at the tip of it, from which a slimy, pink liquid slowly oozes out.
Got it? That's the secret.
I can feel it – your heart is racing, and your breathing is getting rough.
You want it, don't you? You're like someone who's found an oasis in the middle of a desert. Don't deny yourself.
The ceiling light starts to dim little by little. I feel an odd sensation on my lips.
There's more if you want it. That's right. Keep drinking.
Stop your pointless struggle. I'll give you what you want, and free you from everything.

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>7 Broken Through the Mind's Defenses</size>

scripts.say: Hmph. Here to try to break my will again? Nothing new is going to happen. I will not yield!
Lying down in a dark, metallic cage, Lyme musters the strength to lift her head.
Her hands are bound behind her back, and from the gleam in her eyes, it looks like whatever sanity she has left is giving way to pure fury.
How will you try to break me this time?
Lying out a pack of coloured pencils neatly, then purposefully turning one upside down, like last time?
Or will it be like the time before that, when you placed a pile of asymmetrical clothes in front of me?
Do you really think that these petty annoyances are going to break me?
Because you will NOT have your way with me!
The golden glimmer in her eyes intensifies, and the belt restricting her movement squeaks.
However, the angrier she becomes, the deeper she realizes that she is powerless to escape this cage.
This is the sight that greets me. Following a piece of intel, I've come to the Dark Lord army's secret chamber to rescue Lyme, who's been captured by this corrupting trap.
Wait... Are you... the Commander?
Hmph. Your brute-force measures weren't working, so now you've resorted to disguises. What a shrewd trick.
...I'm safe now? No, you don't understand! You don't know what I've experienced!
Curse your Dark Lord and your vile army...
Once I break out of here, I will round you all up and put you in the ground!
Her anger has reached its peak. Maybe it'll get her to calm down if I undo her restraints.
Spurred on by that thought, I pry open the cage's lock and step inside...
W-wait, that familiar aura... Is it really you?!
Just as I'm about to nod, her joyful expression suddenly takes a dark turn.
She twists her body furiously in disregard of her own well-being to get closer to me.
You need to get away, Commander! The state I'm in now is extremely dangerous to you!
The trap that snared me was imbued with some sort of special, evil power!
At this point, I'm no longer fully able to control myself!
Urgh... Agh... I think I'm at my limit!
Aah! Aaaggghhh!
This feeling... It's awful... Commander!
I need to release this power... That's the only way!
All of a sudden, in a display of superhuman strength, she simply rips through her restraints.
Through the dust cloud that comes after, she stares at me, and slowly walks forward.
I tried to warn you, Commander.
There is no one but you and me in this chamber now.
Which means... you're not getting away.

sequence:
Sails and Spooks II

<size=45>8 The Alchemist's Whispered Feelings</size>

scripts.say: I am a modest alchemist, and I'm a little different from others.
In truth, an alchemical experiment of mine went awry, and for some reason, it sent me to a strange new land.
Um, Professor! Look! I finished my first alchemical assignment without a hitch!
So cute... I didn't think ghosts would like this sort of thing.
This is my disciple, who I recently took on. She used to be a "shrine maiden," whatever that is.
Under my guidance, she has made slow but steady strides toward becoming an excellent alchemist.
Ah, I can't wait...
Professor, is it true that the cute ghosties are drawn to this gel?
Y-you said they are, and I believe you, of course! I've just never seen it before, and I'm excited to get to do it.
Did you never see any ghosts when you were a shrine maiden?
Well, I diiid...
But I don't think the ghosts I saw back then were the same as what you're talking about.
By that, I mean the ghosties you've told me about sound adorable just from the name alone.
She gives me an awkward smile. Just as I reach out to pat her head, the flames of the candles standing on the table suddenly flicker.
Eek!
Everything goes dark for a moment, only to return to normal just a blink of the eye later.
She releases her embrace around me, her cheeks red and flushed. Out of sheer embarrassment, she turns her back to me.
...Oh! W-wait! Professor!
L-l-look! They actually showed up!
It's them! Actual ghosties!
Translucent creatures with adorable looks hover near the door, staring at us while looking slightly afraid.
Harutsuki grasps my fingers, her eyes glowing with excitement.
Sensing that we mean them no harm, the ghostly creatures slowly approach us.
One ghostie, two ghosties, three...
That's a lot of them! Um, Professor, do you think they'll like the gel I made for them?
If they don't really like it, do you think they'll just... leave?
Th-that won't happen, right?
We made the gel together, so it SHOULD be perfectly good! Just as you said!
I'm feeling confident now, if only just a little! Heehee.
Oh! Th-they just ate some of the gel!
I was having so much fun chatting with you that I almost missed it.
Heehee – they look like they really enjoy the taste of it!
I've learned so much since I came under your tutelage, Professor. Words can't express how grateful I am to you.
You're always so considerate with regard to my growth, and I want to return your goodwill somehow!
Oh, um, since we happen to have a hot bath running...
Would you... have a soak?
Y-you mean it? In that case, leave the cleansing! I've been practicing for this for– No, I mean, I've been thinking about it for quite some time!
O-okay, now please turn your back to me. I'll make sure to clean it thoroughly!
Like this...

sequence:
Escape from the Port?

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Where Are We?</size>

scripts.say: Once upon a time, there were several brave little heroes of steel. This is their Epic...
Port - Warehouse
That's why I'm telling you, we were kidnapped for sure!
Hmph...! That dumb "commander" must have taken advantage of me when I wasn't paying attention! Unforgivable! I'll have to prepare some punishment!
You think so too, right? Hiei!
R-really...? C-Commander kidnapped us...? But why...?
Zeppy, you've never even seen the commander's face, have you...?
That doesn't matter! What kind of perps show their face to the victims anyway?
Uhh... I thought we were summoned to lend aid to Commander, so how did this end up happening...
But, I was supposed to be meant for a much more accomplished person... Ahh!
Could it be that Commander kidnapped us to keep us on base?!
Hm, hmm... I didn't think of that possibility...! Excellent! You finally understand the situation that we're in!
So that's the gist of things! Let's get out of here and return to the Iron Blood! Hiei, you're welcome to come with us!
But I'm from the Sakura Empire...
... Formalities, formalities! The most important thing right now is to escape from port! Let's get moving!
If what the weird cat ship said is true, we only need to go straight from here, and we'll be out on the open sea!
Zeppy... don't leave me here!
Hmph! Now, you shall all bear witness to the might of the Iron Blood's first carrier, Graf Zepp... Owww!
What the heck! That wall just came out of nowhere and punched me! That stupid cat was trying to trick me all along...!!
Zeppy! Are you okay?
... Looks like it will take a while to find our way...

sequence:
Escape from the Port?

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Spy Operation!</size>

scripts.say: There's a shadow around this corner... Taste my- urrrkk!
Zeppy, stop! You can't use your rigging to beat people up!
Jeez... if you knocked them out, then we wouldn't be able to ask for directions!
Ahem! You do have a point. Let's have them show us the way out.
That won't work either!
Huh...?
My pride as an "imperial" ship will not allow it! Zeppy, if you also represent the pride of the Iron Blood, then there's no way you could drag such a small destroyer into this!
O-ohh... Then, what should we do? How do you think we should get out of here?
Let's follow her quietly, and take note of our path... In other words, this is going to be a spy operation!
So that's how it goes... I understand. I'll show you that I'm sneakier than a U-boat...!
H-Hiei... won't lose either!
(Approximately one hour later...)
Haaah... haaah...
So tired... can't move my legs...
Zeppy, we lost sight of them so many times... or should I say, you got curious and wandered off to look at other things?
There was shiny stuff everywhere so I couldn't help it, okay! Besides, I practically had to pull you out of the kitchen!
Aww... A-anyways, did you figure out which way it is to the sea? I'm still all confused...
Heh. Heheheh... The answer should be obvious...
What do we do...?
Do you require assistance?
You... you're...?!

sequence:
Escape from the Port?

<size=45>Chapter 3 - An Angel's Aid?!</size>

scripts.say: Good day. I am the Edinburg-class light cruiser and maid-in-training, Belfast.
But everyone calls me Bel, or Little Bel.
P-pleased to meet you. I am Hiei, a battlecruiser of the Sakura Empire.
You gaze upon the first aircraft carrier of the Iron Blood, Graf Zeppelin!
Um, do you require assistance?
We were kidnapped by the commander, and want to find out how to escape from here!
Kid... napped? Did Master also summon you two here, just like me?
That's hard to say... but in any case, we'd like to see the ocean. Could you show us the way?
Understood! Allow me to guide you.
This is the academy. Right now, classes are in session, so everyone is in class.
Heyyo, if it isn't Little Bel! Are those your friends behind you?
Y-yes!
(Everyone attending classes together... how peaceful...)
(Huh...? Where is Zeppy rushing off to?)
If we keep going straight here, we'll see the Sakura shrine. People go there to pray during the New Year.
Good morning. Are you here to sit in on the lecture?
Ohhh! Keep up the good work, Little Bel! You're the best tour guide!
*sniff* *sniff*... smells like Hiei...
Didn't you just run into her in the kitchen? Surely you must be mistaken. Let's go, shall we?
(Are all the people here "friends?" ... and there are even people from the Iron Blood here... I wonder if I can also...)
(Huh? Hiei is shaking... why?)
Ahhh, I'm beat...
We just followed the same route as before and went in a big circle...
Hmm? Didn't your port visit start at the docks?

sequence:
Escape from the Port?

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Final Destination!</size>

scripts.say: And here is the pier. Everyone gathers here before going on sortie or commission.
This is.. the pier...
A-ahem! Yes, you, Little Bel or whatever! Thank you!
If you have any other requests, please call upon me at any time. *curtsies*
Ah... um, Little Bel?
Yes, can I help you?
It looks like you're the same as us. Your body is quite small compared to your rigging.
Perhaps you were also kidnapped by the commander...
Let us disappear from this place and sail the azur waves together!
Of course. If necessary, I have no objections to sailing with you. However...
My master is here. As well as Her Majesty, and my sisters. This is the place where I belong.
Above all, I am very happy to be here with everyone.
Little Bel...
Wh-what...!
But will you two be all right? Miss Zeppy, Miss Hiei, you two seemed to have a hard time with the directions.
Would you be able to navigate your way home?
Erm...
Phew...
So that's the situation, huh.
Hmph. What a bunch of troublemakers.
There's no need for that. After all, it's finally time for the adults to make their debut.
That's right, nya! I couldn't find them by myself, nya!
Those people are...?!

sequence:
Escape from the Port?

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Mission Failed...?</size>

scripts.say: In other words, your high-energy laser experiment went awry, and accidentally created these kids?
Even though they share the same "history" as us, humanity's will often takes on different forms...
In other words, they are us, but in a younger state?
That is the best way to understand things, nya... It seems that Hiei-chan and Zeppy only have a portion of their "history," nya...
So Little Bel is just like them...
Because they were not aware of their purpose, they only could assume that they were "kidnapped."
So I was the one who was wrong... I hate... being so immature...!
What's going to happen to us now...?
That's right! What are we going to do with these kids, nya?
The Sakura Fleet would be more than glad to take care of Hiei-chan. I'm sure Mikasa will be overjoyed.
Leave this one to me, then. Although our personalities are different, she's still me after all, so I won't treat her poorly.
I guess that's settled then. Akashi, isn't it time you sealed away that strange device? If something like this ever happens again... surely you are aware of the consequences?
G-got it, nya! I'm sorry, nya!
Zeppy, Hiei-chan! I'm so relieved!
A grown up version of me... I'm sure she's even more amazing at cooking...
Zep...py?
Impossible... Even though I'm supposed to be the first carrier of the Iron Blood... there are actually two...?
Well then, everyone, let's show our new friends to the dorms. Little Bel, please tell Commander that the three of you have arrived safely.
Understood!
I suppose that's one thing taken care of... But moving forward, I don't know if I'll be able to fit in...
Hmmmmm...
Zeppy?
I feel like we've been forgetting about someone since the very beginning...
How could that be? All right you two, let's get going now.
Yes, you too... Ahaha...
Of course, ahaha...

sequence: Realm of the Neversetting Sun - Nile Governor-General's District
Old Capital Palace

scripts.say: The Nile Delta belt. A prosperous, wealthy, and peaceful region.
In this place, the new capital of Cairo and the old capital of Memphis echoed each other, much like two different pearls on the same crown.
In contrast to Cairo, which had undergone modernization, the rich cultural heritage of this land was still present everywhere in Memphis.
Take for example the giant galley with a thousand-year history, still silently moored in its waters.
At its bow, a golden winged lion sculpture was hoisted high, signifying the equally lofty standing of its owner.
Miss Governor, your tea is ready.
It's rather hot today, so please be mindful of heatstrokes.
On a balcony of the palace in the old capital, the Governor of the Nile looked out across her territory, accompanied by her pet and a Royal Maid.
It's not that hot. In fact, it's a perfect day to sail. Incidentally, are the preparations in order?
Adjustments to the Mesektet were made last night. The manager said that it is in peak condition and ready to sail at a moment's notice.
Please be on the lookout for smaller ships in the river. The final supplies are being loaded onto the Mesektet as we speak.
Everything should be ready by lunchtime.
Slower than I'd prefer. Peace makes men grow weak. Hmph.
Oi, Cleopatra! The tea!
Ah, my apologies, Miss Governor! I-I'll tidy up at once!
The Royal Maid was so focused on answering the governor's question that she didn't notice that she was still pouring tea.
After a brief but chaotic episode, the maid finally managed to get the expanding mess of spilled tea, broken plates, and stained carpets under control.
The pet lion lying nearby took a passing glance at her before going back to sleep, as if accustomed to this sight.
*sigh*... And to think I took you for a level-headed, capable maid at first glance.
Little did I know how clumsy you could be. I cannot fathom why the Royal Maids assigned you to me.
No matter. You cleaned up, and that's sufficient. Sit down and rest.
Ahaha... My sincerest apologies, Miss Governor.
However, with all due respect, it wouldn't have been so easy to move forward with many of your plans if I hadn't been here.
Be that as it may, this mission has the approval of both Houses.
It's evident that they took advantage of the fact that you weren't present.
I can simply refuse. Nobody can force me.
But, I have reasons to go. While our nation's radiance covers every corner of the world, the enfeebling that comes with peace is also spreading across the world.
Furthermore, I did not create an artificial Singularity only for it to gather dust.
An opportunity such as this to explore without being prodded from behind is exactly what I've been wishing for.
Come to think of it, I should be thanking you, Cleopatra. For picking and choosing the information to give them.
You're welcome. Your district is also our district, Governor – as such, this is just a part of my job.
For a moment, the Royal Maid assumes a capable and calm exterior, as though she's become someone else entirely.
Soon, though, she realizes that she has been pouring tea for a long time.
Oh dear! I'm truly sorry! I'll clean this up at once!
Forget it. Just replace the carpet later.
Ahaha... Very well. I will buy a new one.
Hmh. Who's that by the riverside? Trafalgar?
She should be at the station, making preparations. What is she doing over there?
Hmm. Perhaps she's expressing an interest in our solar barque?
You've always kept her away from your artificial Singularity facility, so she may view this voyage with the Mesektet as a rare opportunity.
Shall I politely ask her to leave?
No need. She is a representative from the Royal Knights and the Mediterranean fleet and has come to support me. I am grateful to her.
She will board the Mesektet sooner or later, regardless. Just don't let her close to the Lighthouse.
As you wish.
Um, if I may... I've been wondering about something for a while.
While I do understand the reasoning behind naming the Singularity's fixed module "Miracle Recreation - Lighthouse of Alexandria," as it has a nice meaning...
Is there a particular reason why the separation module was named "Mesektet"?
It seems a little... inauspicious to give that name to a ship that living people take.
That is precisely why it's called that.
We will ride this ship through a Singularity and explore a vast and unknown new world.
Although there will be hardships, the journey is eternally splendorous and grand.
Carrying hope and living for the journey to death – isn't that Mesektet in a nutshell?

sequence: "Thus, I issued the order to commence an expedition."
"Could this be a ploy? It is possible, but I care not."
"My power over the Nile territory is unrivalled and uncontested."
"My technological prowess that brought the Mesektet into being is also unparalleled."
"Thus, it makes sense to go on a journey beyond home."
"Our world is a small one. We are trapped on a tiny planet."
"The possibilities of the worlds out there are endlessly vast."
"The tide of a new age begins to rise."
"At its forefront shall be I – Lion."
2nd combat sector - Anti-air defense zone
Queen's Light - 4th car

scripts.say: Queen Elizabeth META and company took the Queen's Light in order to reach their destination as soon as possible.
Lion's group, save for Cleopatra who stayed behind to stand guard on the Mesektet in the sky, also boarded the train.
Glorious META was brought into the control cabin to lead the way, while all remaining members went into the fourth car to rest.
Whew. What a pleasant train. It feels like being back home again.
Using mobile space-expansion technology for a train lounge... How exorbitantly luxurious.
It really is. Even on the Mesektet, we only use it in the area where all the critical equipment is concentrated.
Hah! You haven't seen anything yet. That technology is but a small part of what makes up these Mirror Rails.
That's incredible. Incidentally, there's something I've been meaning to ask you ever since we met.
It may be rude, but I simply need to know.
Go ahead. I've got questions of my own.
By all means. First question: Are you really Queen Elizabeth?
What kind of question is that? Your version of me may be gone, but surely you still have pictures of her?
The only times you appear in the history books are as a name.
Yup. I haven't seen an illustration or anything.
I've been to many test sites, and this is the first I've heard of something like this. What do you mean?
Does your world draw a difference between the concepts of "warship" and "human"?
Look around you. Could you not ask such basic questions?
Well, you see... In our world, Queen Elizabeth sank in the fight against the Sirens not as a human, but as a warship.
Those Sirens are truly despicable...
Indeed.
So then, the Sirens were enemies in your world, and you fought them?
Was that the case in yours?
More or less.
And yet, Glorious said that the Sirens were their allies in this world. How is that possible?
It depends on the test site. To elaborate would require a long-winded explanation of what the Sirens truly are, so I won't.
That's fine. We already defeated them anyway.
You defeated them. Interesting.
So? What became of your world?
If I'm not there to lead you, I presume King George V took my place.
No... King George V, the warship, was also sunk by the Sirens.
Those bastards. Excuse me, I should say, my condolences.
Then what happened? With neither me nor George around, I presume our Parliament is in charge, then?
Correct. Our Realm is run by the two houses of Parliament. That being said, the two aren't as powerful as you think.
Alright. Let me make a guess.
You introduced yourself as "the governor of the Nile." Do you rule in a separatist manner?
Hahahah. "Separatist." How libelous. I would simply say that my authority is amply respected.
Oh, I'm sure. Respected. What's your next question?
Hmm. That would be...
Ah, actually, wait. I'm curious about something.
What became of Warspite and Valiant? What about Hood, Illustrious, and Vanguard? Or Duke of York and Prince of Wales?
Also, who's the current head of the Royal Maids? Who commands the Royal Knights?
That's a lot that you're curious about.
From my perspective, this is like looking at the world after I died. You must understand.
Wales is the Realm Prime Minister, Hood is the Minister of the House of Lords, and Vanguard is the commander of the Palace Guards.
I'm surprised Vanguard's position stayed the same.
Hearing about myself from a parallel world is a rather... strange experience.
Hahah. The kind of experience you can only get by leaving your home.

Duke of York is the Governor-General of the Maple Monarchy, Warspite is the Governor-General of the Pacific Ocean, and Illustrious is the Governor-General of the Mediterranean Sea – as well as the direct supervisor of Trafalgar.
Governor-generals, eh... I have considered that before. Seems you were the ones to implement it.
So Trafalgar works under Illustrious, does she? Is she on this mission with you, then?
No. However, this mission was supported by both the Imperial Prime Minister and both houses of Parliament.

On the day this expedition was voted on, I happened to be absent, and it was decided that I would be the one to lead it. It was also decided that the Imperial Centre and signing governors would provide me with a certain amount of support.
It sounds to me like they conspired against you.
Hah. Had I been present, I personally would've volunteered for the task. I will go down in history for this grand expedition.
I see. You'll earn quite a lot of fame if it's successful.
Heh. Precisely. By the way, Newcastle is the head of the Royal Maids, while Royal Oak is the commander of the Royal Knights.
Finally, there's Valiant. She is the Governor-General of Terra Australis and the Solomon Islands. I've heard she's pursuing a third governor-generalship.
Goodness gracious... That's so like her.
What about Bel?
Sank by the Sirens as a warship.
Thus, this is my first time seeing you, Belfast.
I had an inkling of that when you said that Newcastle holds my would-be position.
Since Her Majesty is no longer with you, it makes sense that I am neither – for the sake of the Sirens' script.
May I ask a question now?
Of course.
Alright – were you both together with Elizabeth META?
Are there two Elizabeths in your world?
No. She comes from another test site.
I can probably guess why you asked that question. Sadly, the answer is: It's not possible.
How unfortunate. What about the other METAs?
You have enough of them for an entire fleet.
They each have their own story, likely similar to that of Glorious. If you want to know more, you'll have to ask them yourself.
I see. If the opportunity arises, I will.
Ding, ding, ding! Baaang! Boom, boom, boom!
Attention! We're almost there! Get ready to disembark!
Boom, boom, boom! Ding, ding, ding! Baaang! Boom, boom, boom!
What an... eccentric announcer.
Did she change it to Miss D's bloody voice pack?!
Ugh... Forget it. Just think of it as some weird sound clips.
Come on. Let's get off.
The group disembarked the luxurious train, stepping back into the desolate world.
The ground beneath them wasn't much different from what they'd seen so far, but up in the ashen sky, something new caught their eyes.
It was a collection of pupae surrounded by winding, sepal-like metallic structures. Each one silently hovered in the air, as if suspended by invisible strings.
What... are those?
They don't appear to be extradimensionals. Glorious, are they some weapon of yours?
Not quite. They are what we call the "Buds of the Full Moon."
They showed up around the time of the meteor shower long ago and appear exclusively on the Royal Islands.
They appear and disappear with no apparent regularity, and when they return, there's always more of them.
Initially, there were just a handful. Now, I think there are around... 300?
We scanned them with the train. Those sepal-like casings are likely a safety mechanism, and we have no idea what's inside them.
Have you ever tried to destroy them?
The Sirens tried and failed to destroy even a single one.
However, the attempt did cause a devastating explosion that not only obliterated the Sirens' safety bunker, but also flattened the entire anchorage of Scapa Flow.
As you might expect, nobody dared touch them after that.
Despite their intimidating appearances, they simply float there, doing nothing.
Putting them aside, over there is where the device is located – this is the Fifth Wireless Communications Laboratory.
Glorious META gestured toward a large building not far from there.
Wireless Communications Laboratory? That's a good cover name.
Her Majesty perhaps thought it was amusing.
Now that I think about it, one could say that I managed to make contact with you thanks to a kind of wireless communication.
The Laboratory is in a rather poor state of maintenance, so it would take a lot of work to search through it.
For that reason, I mobilised some heavy obstacle-clearing machines from a force nearby when we departed.
But, for better or worse, the train got here so fast that the machines haven't had time to do their work. Please wait for them.
When we departed... Wait, where is the Mesektet?!
Lion was sure she had ordered the Mesektet to follow the train after departure, and yet, it was nowhere to be seen now that she had arrived.
It fell behind because it's just too slow.
Don't panic. I see it on the onboard radar and it's fine. It'll arrive sooner or later.
Hah. So we got here quickly only to have to wait for the machines to finish.
We can do more than just wait. We shall perform a scan from the outside.
Elizabeth META activated the train's scanner. Seeing the results, she made a gloomy expression.
You look ill. Lady Elizabeth, have you discovered something unfortunate?
We found the device. It's in the Laboratory's underground section.
The section is in good structural condition. Why, even some of the security systems are still operating.
However... its two most important components are missing: The tracking indicator, and the inaccuracy synchroniser.
Missing? Did someone damage the device?
Yes, and whoever did so knew exactly what they were doing.
Those components were sealed inside the device when it was completed. Only its makers would be able to take them out without breaking the exterior.
And yet, the exterior is perfectly intact, and the internals are gone.
It's little wonder this world's Elizabeth couldn't fix it. She couldn't have anticipated such a confounding issue.
So the world's hope was destroyed by human hands...
Who could have done this?! Can you locate the perpetrator?!
...We shall try.
In that instant, time stopped.
Begin examination.
All the surroundings expanded in different directions, forming countless overlapping images.
Elizabeth META hunched forward and began looking for the exact moment the crucial change happened.
Hrmh.
Alright, there it is.
Let us see who committed this horrific deed.
Her examination continued, but looking around, she saw only nothingness.
...What?

sequence: Test Site Beta - Royal Navy
Gate of Avalon - Silver Mirror Lake

scripts.say: Four hours after the departure of the Queen's Light, Helena META and Memphis META arrived at the Gate of Avalon on schedule.
There, they boarded a car of the train left behind by Queen Elizabeth META and dove into the Silver Mirror Lake alongside Miss D.
The train door slowly opens, amidst Miss D's yelling and the announcements using her voice data.
location: Silver Mirror Lake - Inside the whale

scripts.say: After Helena and Memphis exit first to confirm it's safe, I walk out alongside Miss D and take my first steps into the mysterious whale.
Assistant! Assistant, look, look! This is my whale!
It's big, huh?! WAY bigger than Elizabeth's dumb train!
As soon as we've alighted, Miss D turns to me proudly. She acts as if she knows everything about the whale, but I know that isn't true.
Go play with Death's Shadow, okay? I need to look around with the METAs.
Okay! Let's go, stalker! My assistant has important work to do!
After calming her down, I start by surveying my surroundings.
My first impression of the whale's interior is that it's a space of raw chaos.
This space, designated by Elizabeth as a safe place to search, is approximately 300 meters in length and 200 meters in width.
The highest point is nearly 100 meters high, but some spots only have two meters of vertical space.
Most striking of all, though, is that all of the structures and machines in here hang down from the ceiling.
So? Any thoughts?
My first reaction... is that it certainly wasn't made for human use.
Clearly not.
Is there anything else, though? Any sense that you've seen it before, or any memories it might bring back?
Not at all. It's like I'm seeing a tourist attraction for the first time.
Hmm.
Commander, I pulled up a part of the floor and found a control panel. Can you try authenticating?
You... pulled up the floor?
Ahem... I did it safely after a sound structural analysis. I'll put it back when we're done, I promise!
I follow her to the exposed control panel.
Nothing changes on the panel.
...Nothing happened?
My Antiochus system credentials have always come in handy when I needed them, but this time, they've failed me.
Sorry, Helena, but I don't think this lead will get us anywhere. Have you found anything?
I've been trying to hack into the system here since we arrived.
I have found... one thing. When Devil seized this place, she added a bunch of things to the security layer.
I'll have to remove them one by one.
Elizabeth told me that Devil's been trying to take total control of the whale.
Does that mean that she left pitfalls to stop others from catching up while she's hacking it?
Devilish, isn't it?
Honestly, yeah.
Commander! I've uncovered another control panel. Can you try again?
Shh. Keep this up, and Miss D's going to notice. Belay digging around for now and wait for Helena to work her magic.
Yes, Commander.
RRRUMBLE...
Hmm? Do you all hear that?
It's like an earthquake...
GAAAH! This is bad! The whale's escaping again!
Escaping? Are you saying that the whale is turning on?
Yeah, yeah! Who turned my whale on?! Out with it!
Something is terribly wrong. Commander, we must retreat at once.
Oooh, yeah. We gotta get outta here, or else the whale's gonna take us with it!
RRRUMBLE...
Its struggles quickens, as if it's desperately trying to set sail for new worlds.
As it rumbles, Helena, Memphis, and even the Queen's Light's cars begin to blur as the whale tries to expel them.
She's got us. Memphis, stay by me.
Protect the Commander!
Trust me, I was already planning to... Go, Compiler.
A blue current rushes forth, and Compiler appears, equipped with her rigging.
Orders received: Protect the Commander at all costs.
Don't leave your post until you hear from me.
Helena!
Commander, don't leave Compiler's side. I'm going to find you ASAP.
The shaking intensifies further until the METAs disappear. I can barely feel the presence of Compiler and Miss D...
And then, everything goes silent.
The world turns a pure white.

sequence: Test Site ??? - Royal Navy
5th combat sector
Near target ruins

scripts.say: When Elizabeth META began her examination, the world underwent great change.
The Buds of the Full Moon, which typically only flickered in or out of existence, began to glow one after another.
Extradimensionals that lay dormant across the world suddenly turned violent. Glorious received countless alerts from more than twenty combat sectors, all at once.
Everyone, the situation is rapidly deteriorating. Extradimensional hordes have awakened – the likelihood of a Beastly Tide has dramatically increased.
It's too dangerous to remain here. We must return to the Rose Tower and plan countermeasures.
Rapidly deteriorating, you say? Is it related to the pupae suddenly glowing?
I can't be certain about anything yet. Your Majesty, we must ready the train for departure.
...Miss Elizabeth?
Elizabeth META did not respond to her address.
This is bad... Your Majesty, she can't hear us!
It was then that everyone noticed something off about her.
Her eyes were closed tight, and she didn't react to anyone's calls. It was as if she'd fallen into a deep sleep while still standing.
Even I've never seen something like this. Sheffy, what's wrong with her?
Her Majesty is in a very distant place. Her consciousness may be temporarily absent.
There must be a big secret behind the destruction of the synchronization device.
Lion, Glorious. The other Elizabeth is busy examining the destruction of the device, so she won't be able to act for the time being.
Let's split up into two groups. Sheffield, lead the METAs to protect this place until she completes her examination.
Everyone else will board the Mesektet and return to the Rose Tower. I trust you'll allow us to board, dear governor?
I'd be offended if you didn't!
You'll leave her alone here? Perhaps she could be transported to the Mesektet and brought back to the tower?
You mustn't remove her. Do not worry – we will keep her safe.
Oh... Then I'll dispatch some Pawns to protect her.
Sounds like a plan. Chop-chop, Cleopatra. Land the Mesektet.
Yes, Miss Governor. Descending now!
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Tower...
Position indication jammed again. It must be Magician.
Tch... I should have kept watch here and had Memphis take Vestal with her instead.
Stay calm, Helena.
If this is her doing, then the Commander's life shouldn't be endangered.
Even still, that doesn't mean that there's no danger whatsoever.
That insane woman's directly picking a fight with me.
No... She activated that trap the instant I left. The timing is too convenient.
Devil may not need the whale anymore thanks to her, but that doesn't mean she'll readily give it away to anyone who wants it.
But Magician's direct interference would change things. I see... That's why Devil kept the inside of the whale under such scrutiny once it was in Elizabeth's hands.
Is she working with Devil, or is she simply using her? I don't know yet, but...
Ugh... I've been blind. Even if Devil no longer needs it, she isn't the only one who would have a use for it.
Magician isn't just after the whale. She's after the Commander, too...
But why?
This is awful. I can't sit idly by any longer.
I just hope that this expedition can supplement the data missing from the Tower's database...
...I'll need to pass more information on to the Ashes.
Once the light fades, I find myself in a wasteland I've never seen before.
The dark-blue whale has turned a yellowish black and shrunk to about two meters in size. It floats a few centimeters above the ground, making it look like an amusement park ride for children.
Heeey! Assistant, look! I can ride it!
I can even fly around on it!
My stalker's gone, too! This trip turned out pretty rad!
Woohoo! Whale flying, whale flying!
Miss D gleefully rides the whale. She apparently sees this terrifying situation as a fun little trip.
Meanwhile, Compiler...
You already built a command center?!
Your compiling speed is jaw-dropping.
Not especially. Confirming information on our environs.
According to the topographical map, we are currently in the Vale of Glamorgan in southern Wales.
Analysis of the land composition yields traces of fierce combat in the past. However, there have been no major battles here in the past three years.
I've also detected a signal left by me – by Compiler.
However, there is no mainframe or similar vessel nearby.
Hypothesis: This is a test site, but the experimentation division has been destroyed.
You learned all of that just now? Impressive.
Not especially. Continuing situation analysis. Recommendation: Go to the nearby building to rest.
No, thank you. I don't get to see you work often, so I'd like to observe.
Do as you please.
Even throughout our conversation, she doesn't stop her analysis.
A flock of microdrones flies out of her rigging. Some go up into the sky, some dig underground, and yet others fly toward the ocean.
What are you doing now?
I am only able to use local resources at this moment. Without my mainframe, my capacity is limited.
Thus, I am searching for repairable and dormant facilities in order to bolster my resources.
If possible, I prefer to build a new mainframe as soon as possible.
...There.
I've found an integrated coastal military module nearby that is worthy of repair. Think of it as a modular base that has not yet been assembled.
...Good. The defense module and mass-production module are both intact.
We can construct a mass-produced escort fleet to defend ourselves.

options.content: Wow. You Sirens are incredibly efficient.
It's like you're born for war.

scripts.say: Not especially.
I was, so yes.
As for a means of travel...
Whale!
Ride my whale! Get on!
Miss D's pleas fall on deaf ears, as Compiler transforms part of her rigging into a sort of hovering armored vehicle.
Whale, or truck?
It's no whale, but your thing's pretty cool, too!
Wise decision. Let us go.
Woohoo! Let's go, whale rider!
Elizabeth META wandered through the empty void.
Did we fall into a trap, or did the real perpetrator leave traces when destroying the device?
Narrowing her eyes, she squinted at the nothingness.
Then, she crashed into the earth like a meteorite.
After that, she and the extradimensionals went on a rampage.
They crushed the resistance of everyone in their path – the warships, the shipgirls, and the Sirens.
The world was enveloped in deathly silence, and the space reverted into a void.
...This isn't it.
Must focus harder... Must find the moment the inaccuracy synchroniser disappeared...
One more time, she sharpened her focus and fixated on the nothingness.
In response, the nothingness began to assume a new appearance.
It became the interior of a building with advanced technology. Lights shone brightly and the air was abuzz with voices.
There. We've found it.
Elizabeth walked through the crowds and the walls, heading for the room where the synchronizer was stored.
Then, she saw something – or somebody – standing in front of the device.
It was you who broke it?
What in the world are you?!
Blast it... We need insight!
A ruined wasteland. The extradimensionals formed a horde, and the Buds of the Full Moon were squirming.
The monsters were approaching frighteningly fast, while Elizabeth META was asleep at the device. A team of META shipgirls was the only thing holding the front line.
RUVD FVBY WSHJL (KNOW YOUR PLACE)
A voice from a higher dimension broke Elizabeth's concentration, making the world fall apart for an instant.
...The Star Beast?
Heh. What do you have to do with what we just saw?
NV IHJR (GO BACK)
...Who do you think you are, giving us orders?
Continuing with the insight.
The ruined wasteland again. The Buds of the Full Moon unfolded their sepals.
Cities and the hinterlands, earth, mountains, and rivers – the surfaces of the sepals reflected many landscapes.
(Is... each bud its own artificial Singularity?)
(Did they activate hundreds of Singularities in one world all at the same time?)
(Wait... What is that golden shine? Camelot? And a META Vampire is there?)
(Is that the other Elizabeth's world?)
(And that world, with the radiant lighthouse... Is that where Lion is from?)
(What is this? Do these connect to the worlds of all those who've come here?)
(No, that cannot be true!)
AOL SPNOA VM H MPYLMSF (THE LIGHT OF A FIREFLY)
JHUUVA JVTWHYL AV AOL YHKPHUJL VM AOL ZAHYZ (CANNOT COMPARE TO THE RADIANCE OF THE STARS)
NV IHJR (GO BACK)
The pressure from the higher dimension pushed on her again.
(...The situation demands it. We must see the rest.)
(We must take a risk.)
LCLU H DLHR MPYLMSF (EVEN A WEAK FIREFLY)
JHU WBYZBL AOL SPNOA (CAN PURSUE THE LIGHT)
PUZPNOA (INSIGHT)
Desolation and ruination. Countless wrecks were piled up beneath the Buds of the Full Moon.
The horde of extradimensionals rushed incessantly toward the pupae, only to be torn to ribbons by the entrances of the Singularities.
(They can't pass through the Singularities?)
There was no end to the horde, and their corpses kept piling. This shell of a world was turning into a graveyard for beasts.
P HT AOL ZAHY ILHZA (I AM THE STAR BEAST)
ZOBA BW DPAO FVB (SHUT UP WITH YOU)
PUZPNOA (INSIGHT)
At last, the wasteland had morphed into a world of corpses.
Even the sea was turned white with their remains.
Time passed, and eventually, something changed.
A new adversary was born amidst the wreckages.
It rose from the heap of extradimensional corpses and charged at the Buds of the New Moon.
This time, it passed through in one piece.
One by one, the many scenes reflected in the buds were reduced to silent, dead barrens.
(What is that? Some sort of new mimic entity?)
(A mimic entity... was born from the wreckages of extradimensionals?!)
(Is this the future that awaits this world?)
(Was its fate sealed the moment that the synchroniser was destroyed?!)
(X, it's... No... Could it be?!)
PUZPNOA (INSIGHT)
The world vanished in an instant into the void.
Elizabeth could neither think nor feel. Her very presence began to fade, each moment of time stretching on for an eternity.
JBYZLZ... (CURSES...)
YLABYU AV AOL XBLLU'Z SPNOA (RETURN TO THE QUEEN'S LIGHT)
Elizabeth suddenly collapsed during her examination.
location: 5th combat sector - Near the Queen's Light

scripts.say: Your Majesty! What happened?! You look dreadful!
Forgive me, I should not have used that word!
Get... Get us out of here...
Take the train... to the Rose Tower...
We arrived at the "repairable and dormant facility" that Compiler spoke of.
On the surface, it looked like a coastal factory that was destroyed years ago.
Compiler commanded her swarm of drones to pick apart the wreckages, then, after leveling the area, new sections began appearing one by one, coming together to form an expanding territory.
First she established a factory, then an airport, a regular port, a radar site, strong defenses with massive cannons, and many more buildings I can't name.
The factory got to work and started churning out small robots.
They joined the swarm taking apart the wreckages, built pipes extending deep underground, and erected embankments and formed rivers.
Finally, she built a tall control tower at the base's center which rose high above.
(The pipes are probably for replenishing resources. The tower, then, should be used to control the Mirror Sea.)
(I'm guessing she's going to use the Mirror Sea as a protective shield for her base.)
While my guess wasn't necessarily wrong, what happened next showed that I'd underestimated Compiler.
After the first control tower was complete, Compiler built a second one.
She encased the Mirror Sea inside another Mirror Sea, then also added a mist consisting of a microlayer medley in between the two. Once that was done, she finally stopped and nodded faintly.
Ah. Commander, I've fortified and camouflaged our temporary base.

Bearing in mind practical access to resource supply and computing resources, I launched five Type II mass-production lines and two Type II Enforcer series production lines. This ensures basic combat capabilities.
For now, we're safe.

options.content: What's your goal here? To buy time, or conquer the world?

scripts.say: Thanks for the compliment.
A weird question. Buying time, obviously.
Most of my resources are currently going toward rebuilding my mainframe.
Hang on, you've even started rebuilding that?!
Its core will be operational in about 72 hours. It can be restarted at 10% of its original capacity.
I have recovered some files about this test site from my surviving mainframe database. Filtering down to the parts that should be interesting to you.
Appreciate it. If there's one thing I need now, it's intel.
So, did you find anything?
I did. The serial number of this test site is SQ-4577486.
The destruction of this site's Compiler was due to an attack by a horde of extradimensionals.
Wait, a horde of extradimensionals?!
I surmise that they already possess the strength to fully take over the world.
Are there any other survivors?
Yes. I've detected signs of a lost mass-produced patrol fleet unaffiliated with the Sirens.
Must be a resistance force, like the one Fritz Rumey led.
Can you pinpoint where their trails converge?
I'm not yet able to perform a worldwide scan. Within my current sensor range, however, they converge upon the port of LD.
...What's this? Commander, something has changed.
The extradimensionals are gathering into large groups. It's likely they're preparing a large-scale attack.
Can you protect against it?
As long as we do not attack first, they are physically unable to detect us.
When will our connection with Helena be back online?
Impossible to estimate.
Then doesn't that put LD in serious danger?
Most likely. Detecting several swarms approaching it. Fighting has already broken out at the outer periphery.
Then we should go and help them.
My orders are to protect you at all costs. This takes precedence.
I still want you to help.
If you insist on sending me to help them, wait until after the 72 hours have elapsed.
Even with only 10% of my original capacity, I'll be able to deploy more powerful weapons and create a path straight from here to LD.
That's too long. The survivors might not hold out for that long, and even if they do, they'll suffer heavy losses in the process.
We have to go to LD and rebuild the line of defense.
The transport process is very risky. I do not recommend it.
What's that? You're not gonna listen to the assistant? Who do you think's in charge here, huh?!
Assistant, if the albino fabricator here won't take you there, my whale and I will do it!
I'll take you wherever you wanna go!
Albino fabricator...
Yeah, that's right!
If you're going to do it no matter what, fine.
At least wait two hours, though. I need that long to prepare the transport.
Alright. Thank you.
No need. I'm only doing what I must.

sequence: Port of LD - Rose Tower

scripts.say: Lion's group arrived back at the Rose Tower with the Mesektet. Glorious ran straight for the war room and began commanding the counterattack across all combat sectors.
It reminded Elizabeth and Lion alike that the Royal Navy of this world was completely different from the one they knew.
Factories hidden in the mountains, river after river dug out in the plains...
By Jove, there are even purposefully flooded sections to speed up the mobilisation of Pawns and mass-produced ships.
They've torn the country to shreds.
Even so, we keep fighting.
Our glory would be tarnished if we let them run amok in our own homeland.
Miss Elizabeth, I've spotted a large group of enemies in the direction of the Fifth Wireless Communications Laboratory.
Are you still unable to reach your META counterpart? Shall I send reinforcements her way?
I still can't reach her.
Fear not, however. Her escorts are the finest there are. It may seem like they're being pushed back, but they're simply being cautious out of a lack of information on the enemy.
Send your forces to the sectors that need them the most.
If we can help in any way, just say it. It's why we came here in the first place.
I concur. Don't walk on eggshells for our sake.
Whilst the enemy is numerous, it is readily apparent that they're uncoordinated.
If they're going to attack the Rose Tower, we may as well meet them outside.
Understood. In all honesty, something odd is currently transpiring in the Wales sector, and I don't know what to do about it.
The Royal Islands are presently divided into 12 combat sectors. Most of my forces are concentrated in areas one through six – the ones surrounding the Rose Tower.
The Wales sector is number nine, and I am frankly at a loss as to handle the situation there.
Say no more. We'll deal with it.
Would you happen to know anything about what's happening there?
Shortly after the extradimensionals appeared, I detected signs that a Siren fleet had come back online in the area.
Wait, a Siren fleet? Didn't they completely vanish from this world over 100 years ago?
Correct. However, I am sure that it is them – I caught footage of swarm drones repairing one of their former factories.
My latest intel shows that they've formed a fleet and are currently cutting through the horde of extradimensionals.
They've entered the flooded region through the Bristol Channel, and I believe they're heading toward the Rose Tower.
If they're the Sirens from your world, doesn't that make them allies?
Most likely, yes, since despite them having sighted my monitoring stations en route, they did not destroy them.
Here. These are pictures that my hidden cameras took.
Glorious brought up numerous photographs on the war room's screen.
Hm... Yeah, those are Sirens for sure.
Judging by their make, they're mass-produced ships and Enforcers of the Type II variety.
What the–?! Is that a baby whale among them? It's adorable!
...Did you say, "A baby whale"?
Your Majesty... doesn't it greatly resemble the stuffed whale that Miss D has?
Also, while the picture is rather blurry, isn't that outline of Miss D herself, riding the whale?
What... in the...
...This is bad news.
Lion, start the Mesektet at once! We must go to support them immediately!
Hm? First time I've seen you this stressed.
Is that little whale an acquaintance of yours, Lady Elizabeth?
I'll explain on the way. There is no time to waste.
Alright, alright.
Um, your destination is in an active combat zone. Are you sure you want to take the Mesektet?
I'll set it down in the water before we get there. If we're going to fight, we'll do it on our home turf.
A wise decision.
Cleopatra, ready the ship! We're setting off!
Understood!
Compiler's transport plan proved a lot simpler than I anticipated.
That being – after two hours of prepping as best as she could, she'd take the shortest route to the port of LD, charging through enemies on the way.
As expected, or perhaps as not expected, our fleet has ended up in a stalemate with an army of extraterrestrials in the Bristol Channel.
Hey, albino fabricator! Why have we not moved an inch after all that fighting?!
Do something about this!
The enemy has grouped up, making them stronger than the sum of their parts.
Calculating the relation between size of force and combat capabilities now.
Enemy is more numerous than predicted. We must slow down for safety's sake and wait for more production lines to come online.
Then why are you building a fort here?!
It is necessary to preserve our momentum.
Urgh... Too slow! TOO SLOW!
Who knows when we're gonna get there at THIS speed?!
Arrival within the next 72 hours is guaranteed.
That's just as long as you said before!
Negative. The previous 72-hour plan did not account for travel time. The current plan assures arrival within the next 72 hours.
UUURRRGGGHHH!
(Her going with a tactic like this is pretty consistent with her modus operandi.)
(We can't afford to take our sweet time, though.)
