But aren't you curious about Marco Polo's speech at the upper senate, and all?
It's late. I'm sure they're done by now, anyway.
Even if communications were restored, we wouldn't be able to hear it live.
I'm still curious. You don't know for sure, anyway, Andrea.
Geez... Look, we'll receive word tomorrow.
Assuming the facility hasn't been buried in sand, that is.
Not being able to join my comrades at such an important time... I don't know if this is good or bad luck.
Now, now. Attilio and I are here, too.
We can't help the sandstorm. No matter how much you rush it, it's not going to hurry on your account.
Get some rest and check in the morning. Okay?
Fine... I'll go wash up and get ready for bed.
Good. I'll take care of Attilio.
After Andrea's lecturing, Gorizia relented and left the break room.
Phew... I'll just take Attilio to her room...
*static crackling*
In the quiet room, the radio suddenly began making noise.
...Within...
...His Kingdom...
...He hath...
...already come...
*click*
Andrea returned to the break room and yanked the radio's electric cord from the wall.
(I don't know what they're doing, but I can't let the children get involved in this.)
(Marco Polo... Don't lose yourself.)
Reflections of the Oasis
The End?
Port - Office
Commander, it's time to bring back a classic, nya! We're doing another Muse System test, nya!
The last two were great successes. Everyone is raring to have a go at it a third time.
Even Le Malin has gotten fired up about it. That alone makes me interested.
Nyahaha! Of course she is – everyone loves to perform on the stage, nya!
Another round of testing, huh? Not surprised to hear the news from Akashi's mouth...
I look at Mikasa, then Clemenceau, then Marco Polo, who's standing by the door outside my office.
But why are the rest of you here?
Why am I here? Because this is a big event. Sardegna does not sit out on such things.
You need a stage for the performers, nya. And to run a stage, you need stagehands, nya.
That is why they're here – and totally not because I rounded them up as soon as I saw an opportunity to make a big buck, nya.
Ignoring the money-grubbing cat, I turn my attention to the list of new Muse talent.
"Alizarin" and "Cyanidin" are the new units this time, eh.
Aha. That gives me an idea.
An idea? What do you mean?
They're both pigments. Red and blue, respectively... Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
I sure am.
Nya?
Great, you share a telepathic connection. Now can you explain your idea to us mere mortals?
Simply put, I want to see these sides compete with each other.
Isn't that what they've been doing this whole time?
Sort of. The Muse competitions have been rather limited in scope thus far.
The Commander is talking about something bigger – pitting two sides, red and blue, against each other and involving as many girls as possible.
What she said. Girls without Muse Systems were part of it last time, and everyone loved it.
Since we're doing this again, I say let's change the rules a bit and give as many people as possible the chance to be part of the show.
Ideally, everyone should have their moment in the limelight.
Ahh, I see now. By framing it like a competition, it'll bring the whole port community together.
Indeed. It won't just be individual units competing against each other, but rather entire groups.
That means who you choose to recruit will make a big difference.
Then the recruiter must have a discerning eye! Someone like me would be perfect for–
Sorry, but no. The girls in each unit will pick their members.
Akashi, go explain the rules to the new units. I and the others will stay here and work out the details.
Will do, nya.
The green cat disappears down the corridor. Mikasa waits until she's gone, then approaches me.
Before we discuss that, I posit that we come up with a name for the project.
Right. Every good project needs a good name.
Seeing as the Muse System is at its strongest when you sing with your whole heart... Yes, I've got it. The name is going to be...
Port - Office
Guess who!
I'm processing paperwork when all of a sudden someone covers my eyes from behind.
Jacinto? Are you on bring-me-paperwork duty today?
I say her name, and she uncovers my eyes.
You're no fun! You're supposed to guess it wrong at least a few times first!
But yes, you're right. It's my turn to deliver documents today.
I have a report on both teams' use of the port's facilities. Would you like to read that first?
I'll read it after I've finished the list of potential hosts.
Hosts? Multiple? Isn't Akashi running the show alone, as usual?
No, we'll need multiple this time since both teams are getting their own stage.
Let me have a look... Ah, Harbin will host for the red team, and the blue team will get Saratoga.
Looks like you've already made up your mind. That's a shame, because I was hoping I'd get the chance to host.
Really? You'd like to be a host?
Kind of. Not for the job itself, but because it'd let me spend more time with you!
Oh, on another note, I think there's a loophole in the competition's rules.
The rules this time are: each unit will appear on stage, deliver a performance, and be graded accordingly.
Therefore, the team whose units score the highest on average will win the competition.
But, if for some reason a unit is unable to appear on stage...
Then the competition is as good as over then and there.
Listen, Eugen. We will not resort to such unsportsmanlike tactics.
No, I'm not saying we should sabotage the other team.
I'm just telling you that this loophole exists. I told them, too.
Also, there's no guarantee their team won't exploit it even if we won't. I guess we just have to trust them.
There may be a loophole, but actually using it would be very dishonorable.
Yeah! The reason the rules were changed in the first place was to bring us all together!
Winning isn't as important as everyone having fun!
I agree. The Commander wants us to win fair and square.
Even I treat my opponents with respect up until the moment I crush them like insects.
There are ways to sabotage them, but this just feels wrong.
The last thing we will do is make my Commander sad!
Port - Muse System Test Area
It's time for what you've been waiting for – the idol concerts are back, nya! I'm Akashi, your main master of ceremonies, nya!
That's right, main, nya! This time, there are two other people hosting this event alongside me, nya!
Two is the name of the game today, nya! Two teams, two stages, two more hosts, nya!
Let's hear a word from the lovely ladies who are with me here today, nya!
Hiii! It's me, Sara! I'm hosting for the blue team!
And I'm Harbin, the non-singing voice of the red team!
We're both so excited to be hosting this event today!
Without further ado, let's introduce the faces both new and old who'll be performing!
Starting with the red team! Give it up for Alizarin!
(This is what I practiced my stage face for – so I could be at the centre of the team!)
(Heehee. You sound like you're having fun.)
(I certainly am. I've been waiting to flaunt my charm on stage in front of an audience!)
(You have the confidence to take center stage, but don't forget about the teamwork.)
(Yes, yes, I know!)
And now for the blue team! A round of applause for Cyanidin!
Oh gosh! I knew we were going big, just not THIS big!
(Téméraire! You're the center, so please act with due elegance!)
(Oops! Sorry! I'll focus! Boise, how are you holding up?)
(Huff... Puff... I-I'm trying to imagine the audience in their underwear!)
These are the new units participating in this Muse System test, nya! There's powerful shipgirls on both sides, nya!
That's not all, nya! Some familiar faces will be performing today as well, nya!
First up, the powerhouse unit Polaris and the beautiful but dangerous Verheerender, nya!
Then there's the graceful yet slothful Lumière, and the shining stars of Astrum, nya! This sing-off is bound to be the most exciting yet, nya!
And last, but not least – the many, many idols without Muse Systems who are also participating!
Oh yes! Let me hear you clap first for the Empery's reps, the Dragon Sisters!
Hey! I was gonna introduce them!
It just feels right for me to do the honors! Let me be a little biased toward my countrymen!
Uh-oh, we're running a little short on time, nya! Let's get everyone up on stage right now!
A brief flurry occurred as the shipgirls got up on stage, all donning idol attire.
There was the temporary duo of Z23 and Fubuki, and Queen Elizabeth, Laffey, Unicorn, and Hammann, too.
There you have it, nya! As per the rules, both teams will perform on stage at the same time, nya!
They'll then be rated based on the quality of their performance and their appeal, nya!
Good luck, girls!
It's showtime!
Whew... Performing simultaneously with your opponent is much more tiring than I thought.
Maintaining the audience's attention is not at all an easy task.
You could say that again. But while it's hard, it really gets you fired up!
Increased activity detected in Gascogne's emotion module.
Hypothesis: I love being on stage!
Seriously? There's nothing to love about this charade. Well, other than getting to put Eugen in her place. Otherwise I wouldn't be here.
One thing is clear – we cannot let the red team win.
Polaris will surely sing their hearts out, and I expect the rest of you to do the same.
You say that like I plan to deliver a lukewarm performance. Nobody shall have my Commander's eyes but me.
We just need to wipe out– Sorry, I mean outperform them.
You all did great out there.
Having said that, the other team is putting up a really good fight, too.
So what? They might be good, but OUR performance knocked the crowds' socks off!
She's right. The crowd went wild for us out there.
Is that so? I guess I did get pretty worked up on the stage. Our scores should be fine.
I felt that, too. Thinking about my beloved Master allowed me to give the performance 120%!
Heehee. At any rate, we have done our part.
Now it's up to the other units to prove their mettle.
And that's it from Polaris and Astrum! They really put on some incredible performances!
True that. They were both so good, I couldn't take my eyes off either one.
This whole "two groups performing at the same time" thing is a new feature, right?
It sure is! It has posed a very unique and interesting challenge for the idols singing today.
I can see that. Both sides are vying for attention, so it becomes a test of how good they are at captivating the audience.
If you can't keep up, that's game over for you!
Exactly. That's why they all need to bring their A-game!
Speaking of A-games, I think it's time for the next units to get up on stage.
Meanwhile, in the dressing room...
Goodness gracious. Even Illustrious' unit is having stiff competition.
It'll be fine. We've all rehearsed as much as anyone possibly could.
Serious effort never goes unacknowledged.
Sounds like someone's tense. I'll gladly take center if you want.
I'm absolutely certain I can outperform Hipper, or anyone in their unit, for that matter.
I'm not tense! And I don't doubt that I can outperform them either!
If anything, I'd like to ask you to please try to keep pace with ME!
I'm feeling nervous... I hope my song will reach big brother's heart...
They will witness my beauty and charm and bend the knee to me!
I'm done. I can finally sleep now...
Z23, you sure our unit doesn't need a name?
I mean... Coming up with a good name isn't so easy.
Okay, Ping! One more time from the top before we go on stage!
You got it!
I'll give this 100% now so I can give everything else 0% later!
This is taking so long! Let me perform for the Commander already!
Sounds like everyone's fired up! In their own way.
Kongou, you look tense. Loosen up and smile! Positive energy is our bread and butter!
Huff... Puff... Sh-she's right. Let's all try to show our best sides.
*sigh*... Yes, you're both right. Thank you.
Let's take a deep breath... then go out on stage and deliver the best performance of our lives!
Oh, look! I think the teams are ready!
Alright, everyone! Let's give a round of applause for the next units!
Huh. Looks like we've got a teensy tiny issue.
What? Lemme see!
Nyahaha! Both teams have put on some incredible performances so far, nya! Now it's time to announce their current scores, nya!
...Nya? Unbelievable, nya! They're perfectly tied, nya!
It's anyone's game now, nya! The final two units will determine the outcome of the whole competition, nya!
The question is – who'll win, nya?
Will it be the determined, passionate, and powerful Alizarin?
Or will Cyanidin clutch the win with their fresh vibes and beaming energy?
Stay tuned until the end to find out, nya!
(I can only hope I'm expressing the emotion in this song well...)
(Be sure to focus on the rhythm for this part. Stick to the plan and everything will go smoothly.)
(I've got a good reason to want to win. Tell you what – I'll perform just a bit harder, heehee.)
(I wanna win just as much as anyone!)
(Huff... This is what it feels like to be up on stage...)
(Come on, ladies! Let's show the crowd what charming and elegant idols we are!)
Whoa, whoa, whoa! I've never seen anything like this, nya!
Both their scores and Muse System output are off the charts, nya! The scoreboard's gonna overflow, nya!
Unleash the wellspring of emotion inside you and let it flow through your song!
This moment matters more than anything else! Even more than being a well-mannered lady!
(Commander, this is my whole, unfiltered being! I hope these feelings reach you!)
Yes, that's it. Don't look away – keep your eyes on me.
My song, my dance, my performance... It's all for you!
It's still not enough! More, harder, louder!
My song has to carry these feelings straight into your heart!
Great Scott, nya! Alizarin's readings suddenly just shot through the roof, nya!
I've rehearsed plenty... I'm not afraid anymore!
I've got to deliver a flawless performance!
Heehee! The hype is at an all-time high! Commander, I hope you're watching!
I'm gonna pour my all into this and show you the best, most dreamy performance ever!
We're past the point of needing to joke about the reason why I became an idol.
The real reason was that I did it for you, Commander! All so you could see me at my best!
Nyanyanyaaa! Now it's happening with Cyanidin as well, nya!
Stop, stop, stooop, nya! Any more and the stages are gonna explode, nyaaa!
KABOOOM!
The stages went boom, turning to scrap all the data instruments and equipment installed on and around them.
Commander... How are we gonna determine a victor now?
They made the scoreboard explode... It's impossible to say which side performed best.
You can't decide arbitrarily, but at the same time, there will be an outrage if you call it a draw.

options.content: Plan B. Bring out the time machine.

scripts.say: This is a delicate situation and I need to weigh my options first.
I just need to go back to before the boom and stop them!
What are you talking about? Did the explosion give you a concussion or something?
I was just trying to lift the mood with a joke. Forget it.
Hang on, what did both teams' Muse data say before the scoreboard blew up?
I don't know whose is whose, nya! They're both identical, nya!
I have a theory. Both teams pushed each other until it caused a resonance loop between their Muse Systems.
Then the resonance amplified their output so much that it overloaded the scoreboard and made it explode.
If so, it's impossible to crown the victor based on maximum utilization.
(But maybe there's no need to. Maybe both sides can be winners.)
(I'm fine with paying a bit out of pocket if it'll make everyone happy. The only thing preventing us from giving wishes to both sides was our budget, anyway.)
Akashi, apropos nothing, what's the budget difference between first and second place?
Nya? Uh, well...
Allow me to answer. I relieved her of the task of budgeting much earlier.
First and second place both have ludicrously lavish budgets thanks to the omni-factional sponsorships.
A devious smile forms on Clemenceau's lips. I suddenly realize that I'm bracing for impact.
It's 9,999,999,999,999,999 coins for first place, and 999,999,999,999,999 coins for second place. That's one 9 less.
Simply put, both budgets are practically infinite and capable of granting almost literally any wish.
Wait, WHAT?!
So... I have to make EVERYONE'S wishes come true?!
Port - Office
Hello, Commander.
H-hi.
I've compiled a report on this Muse System test from the perspective of Alizarin.
And I've got one from Cyanidin's perspective.
Thanks. You've saved me a lot of work.
Don't mention it. I-it's part of our official duties anyway. Huff...
Yes, it's just what's expected of us.
How are your other members doing? Are they still resting?
Not all of them. Illustrious said she'll give Formidable a stern lecture on manners, and Eugen is looking into the resonance phenomenon.
It really fr-freaked me out when that happened...
(We're three tests deep into the Muse System, and there is still so much we don't know about it. More than we even realized.)
(One thing is clear – more tests need to be run in the future.)
Also, why are you still working, Commander? I think you have more pressing things to do.
Excuse me?
If memory serves me right, you're supposed to grant Akagi's and Taihou's wishes today.
Then Eugen's after that, then Roon, followed by Unicorn and Hammann.
And then Illustrious, then me.
D-don't forget about Boise. And I think Téméraire and Kongou have their turn later tonight.

options.content: I feel a headache coming on...

scripts.say: I know there's no running away from my duty...
But please, let's talk about anything else right now!
As much as I like making others happy, hearing all those names makes my head hurt.
So... I have to make EVERYONE'S wishes come true?!
That's right. It's not as bad as it sounds – the organizing committee can handle some of the legwork for you.
Some of it?
Mhm. Although, if all their wishes personally involve you, then you're out of luck. Heehee.
(EVERYONE'S wishes involved me in one way or another...)
(Well, except for Laffey who wanted a memory foam pillow, and Le Malin who wanted a year free of all work.)
Heehee... Commander, I'm here to pick you up!
Surely you haven't forgotten about our date!
Not so fast! It hasn't been decided which of us is going first!
It has now. I got here first.
So what? Do you think I'll just happily accept that? The Commander is MINE!
A bitter argument breaks out in my office as both of the red-dressed ladies fight over who gets me first.
(I guess it's up to me to determine their order... My work day isn't over quite yet.)
Commander! My Commander!
I've got it! Let's just all go on a date together!
Ugh...

layout: Third Muse System Test - The Port's Grand Performance

scripts.say: Based on what Akashi said, the rules for this Muse System test will be a bit different from the last.
We have to organize into teams, red and blue, and choose our own members then compete with each other.
And we're on the red team. I like it. Better red than blue.
It's a game of who can make the most friends. What a childish competition.
I think they just want us all to become closer.
*sigh*... I can't think of a nice way to say this... Screw it, I'll just say it.
You two are completely missing the point of this whole thing.
"Missing the point"? I think we both summarised it fairly well – this is about making friends.
I think so, too. What do you believe "the point" is, Eugen?
Remember the previous Muse System test? They built a stage for the girls to perform on.
Stages don't build themselves. There was a sponsor funding it.
And when you're funding a project, you have the power to bend the rules.
Last time, it was Queen Elizabeth. Who do you think it is now?
Hang on, what does that have to do with anything?
I think I see what Eugen is hinting at.
She's saying the sponsor will be biased toward people from their own faction. If we find out who, and choose members from said faction, we'll have an advantage.
Bingo.
What a cynical take! Making empty friendships just to win? Do you think that's what the Commander had in mind?
She's right. The Commander wouldn't want that.
Let's forget that angle and focus on rehearsing. Without talent, we won't convince anyone to join us.
Meanwhile...
Apologies for summoning you on such short notice. I would like to discuss our strategy moving forward.
Strategy? Oh! You mean the rules Akashi talked about!
Precisely. It stands to reason that there must be a motivation behind this rule change.
Huff... I-I doubt it's an important motivation.
I think they just want more people to enjoy the event.
Yeah! I think so, too!
Don't overthink it, Kongou! Let's concentrate on finding people to add to our team!
There's bound to be loads of people who'll be happy to join if they'll get to perform up on stage!
Mhm.
Hmm... Well, if you say so, then I won't let it nag me.
(When recruiting for a competition like this, talent matters above all else.)
(And in terms of talent, that red fox is a great first candidate.)
Thanks, but no thanks.
Not interested? You seemed to enjoy yourself quite a lot during the last Muse System test, Ms. Akagi.
That was a unique case. Also, would you stop calling me "Ms."?
I don't like being referred to like some old school teacher just because I took part in a Muse System test some time ago.
As you wish. Then let me ask you this – what would it take for you to help us?
Hmm...
Are you absolutely certain you don't wish to join our team?
Heehee. I do want to join you, just not right now.
I understand why you'd want to recruit me. I have experience with the Muse System, after all.
But to my understanding, the point of this event is to let new people experience it.
I know that, but still...
I'm not saying "no." Come and see me again if you really can't find anyone else.
Ahem. Testing, one, two, three...
Sorry for butting in, nya. I've been asked to tell everyone to gather at the dock, nya.
There are a few more things about the Muse System I need to explain, nya.
That's the message, nya. See you there, nya.
What a pain in the bum... I'm off to the dock.
Language! Remember your manners.
Of course, of course.
Port - Dock
Thank you all for coming here.
I'm sure you have some questions, like "why do we have to split into groups and compete?" or "who is the sponsor?"
We hope to answer those now.
Ahahah! Akashi forgot to mention something important to you when she explained the rules.
Important indeed. To make things more exciting, the sponsor will grant everyone on the winning team one wish.
Think of the things you could wish for! For a start, there's–
Ahem! Let's let the participants decide for themselves how to use their wishes.
Grant one wish? Heehee, now things are getting interesting.
Hmm...
If hearing that got you fired up, just wait until you hear who the sponsor is, nya!
It is none other thaaan... the Commander, nya!
If I were you, I'd think long and hard about what I'd use my wish for, nya.
Wait... the Commander is the sponsor? And I can wish for anything?
Hehehe... Hahahaha! Kongou, I've changed my mind! I'll join you!
Whoa! Talk about a quick wardrobe change!
I shall participate in this event as well!
Oh boy... This news will really change the course of this competition.
Port - Office
Sometime before the announcement...
The Royal Navy sponsored the last test, and I think we could try a rotation system with a different faction sponsoring it each time from now on.
No objections here.
In fact, I propose that Sardegna be the sponsor this time around!
Aye, 'tis a good idea... but it'll be a long, long while before everyone has had their turn.
In that case, how about every faction chips in for now? We've already changed the rules, and the extra funds would allow us to construct a spectacular stage.
Good idea.
Then we have a plan. I'll notify all the faction leaders.
I suppose that settles the sponsor question. What shall be done about the prize, though?
Prize, prize... Does anyone have any ideas?
I think letting the winners choose for themselves makes the most sense.
In practice, that means something like... letting them make a wish, perhaps?
I like that. I support this idea.
A predetermined prize, no matter what it is, won't please everyone.
Letting the victors decide for themselves has universal appeal and gives us more flexibility.
Agreed. The increased budget has room for even lavish wishes, too.
Hang on. Letting the winning team wish for anything is good and all, but what about the losing team?
What remains of the budget can dictate what they'll get. Simple.
Fair enough. Akashi, I'll leave the budgeting in your capable hands... or paws.
You got it, nya! I'll make the most of every last penny, nya.
Oh, one more thing – what do we formally call this joint sponsorship? Do we just say "sponsored by all factions"?
Think of it this way: a joint sponsorship is the product of all factions coming together. Who unites all the factions? You, Commander. You are the sponsor.
If nothing else, "the Commander" rolls off the tongue a lot better.
What? I think you're making a leap of logic.
You think so? Sounds perfectly fine to me. You should just accept the honor.
Exactly, nya. Now put your signature here, nya.
I shrug and go with the flow, signing all the relevant paperwork.
Port - Dock
Back to the present...
A wave of enthusiasm swept through the port practically the minute Akashi announced who the sponsor was.
Ahh... The Commander will make the winners' wishes come true. What a fabulous prize...
When I win, I'm going to wish for... No, no, no! It's wrong of me to think this way! But at the same time...
I'd really like that wish... I can't afford to hold anything back.
Ladies, please! It's lovely that you're enthusiastic and all, but aren't you getting a little ahead of yourselves?
If we want to win, we're going to need a lot of practice.
What's wrong with them being so fired up? The more competitive they get, the better.
Huff... Puff... Hearing about this reward has really turbocharged them.
It's gonna be easy peasy to recruit members now!
Let's hope so...
Port - Dragon Empery Dorm
Sis, I heard the news! I think it's time for us to make a comeback!
You got that right! Let's do what the Dragon Sisters do best and burn the competition!
But first, we should get Huan Ch'ang to read our fortunes.
She's already on her way, and I've got sweet dumplings ready for her.
Wow, you're always one step ahead of the rest.
Sometime later, Huan Ch'ang dropped by as promised.
Ah. So you want to know who'll be the victor in this competition between red and blue.
I shall tell you who– Hey! Whoever's eavesdropping over there, show yourself!
Just as she was about to divine, she caught a glimpse of somebody peeping from in front of the kitchen.
A spy?!
Take it easy! It's me, Chi An! I was just going to the kitchen since I figured it would be empty at this time of day.
You thought you could practice cooking again, didn't you?
Wait, "again"? What do you mean by that?
Oof!
(Huan, please don't bring up the kitchen thing in front of them...)
S-so, what's your business with her? Did you want her to read your fortune?
Yup! We're going to enter the performance competition and want to know if the red or blue team is going to win.
Won't knowing the answer spoil the fun, though?
True. It would. Knowing what is to come will ruin the fun along the way.
That being the case, I say go with your gut.
Laaame...
Huff... Um, hello.
I heard you girls might want to join the blue team, so...
Sis, what do we say?
Fate must be trying to tell us something. Let's join the blue team!
At the same time, others were also running to and fro to recruit new members.
Ugh... Do you really think I want to waste precious energy on that?
No thanks. You should ask somebody else.
Aww, really? You don't want to have a wish granted if you win?
You could wish to sleep in all you want or say goodbye to work forever, but you do you.
Okay, I'm in!
Port - Royal Navy Dorm
Really? You would all like to join team red?
I was just asked to help out. I don't care much about getting a wish granted.
And I will do anything not to disappoint my Master! I want to get up on stage once more and shine like a star!
Heh, you all sound mighty fired up!
I'm just surprised Astrum is getting the chance to perform on stage again.
Ain't that the truth. I'll even be able to perform more like an idol since I've grown since the last time!
Heehee. Thank you all for agreeing to help.
Illustrious, you didn't round up all this talent just to extend a helping hand to me, did you?
Well, I did, but there's more to it.
In all honesty, I have a wish I'd like to come true.
Oh really?
Port - Sakura Empire Dorm
It seems that the red team has already secured the talented Astrum unit for themselves...
While we did successfully recruit the Dragon Sisters, we still must make haste and recruit additional talent.
Are you seriously worried that we're lagging behind?
Don't be. Victory is all but guaranteed with me on your team.
Oh? Have you secured us an advantage?
Of course I have. I convinced the entirety of Polaris to team up with us.
This may be rude of me to ask, but you didn't "convince" them by force, did you?
It should go without saying that I didn't. If you don't believe me, just ask Gascogne.
Akagi has not made any threats toward me.
I have simply gained new insight into the meaning of the word "idol," and I joined the blue team to demonstrate it to my Master.
I... see... I apologize, Akagi. I shouldn't be so suspicious of you.
Apology accepted. To bring us back on topic, I also spoke to another unit.
I'm not very keen on allying with old rivals of mine... but I won't shy away from it if that's what it takes to win.
Verheerender, you're late. Why is that?
I'm really sorry. I was rehearsing, then I thought about the ways I was going to crush my enemies and I lost track of time.
Tsk... I'm only doing this for my Commander. Otherwise I wouldn't be caught dead helping you.
If and when I win, I will spend my wish on my Commander, and then... Hehehehe...
Oh, you're saying that to my face and think I'll let it slip? The only love that will appease the Commander is MY love!
Heehee. Looks like I've made new enemies today.
*sigh*...
Please get a room, you three.
Port - Office
And that sums it up for how both teams' recruiting efforts are going.
I'll let you know right away if there are any membership changes.
Alright. Appreciate it, Memphis.
That blue team, though... They have Akagi, Taihou, AND Roon.
*sigh*... I hope my fears about them prove unfounded.
I breathe a weary sigh, then spot a shadowy figure quietly entering my office.
Well, making two rivals join up is no easy feat, even if it's in their shared interest.
Think of it this way – them being on the same team is proof that they're getting along.
I sure hope they are.
On a similar subject... There have been rumors going around.
They're saying there have been more... unusual attempts to recruit people, beyond reaching out.
Like what? Threats? Bribery?
Oh?
Things like enticing Laffey with a memory foam pillow, or Queen Elizabeth using her royal authority to forbid her subjects from joining the blue team.
Some are willing to play dirty if it means they'll win that wish, I suppose.
Now I'm starting to feel tempted to pick a side, too.
Heehee, I'm only kidding. Don't be so alarmed.
Besides, the recruitment deadline is drawing near.
So, have you all decided which team you're gonna join?
I haven't yet.
Right back at you, Javelin. Have you decided?
Nope... That's why I'm asking.
I've been losing sleep because of Tem from the blue team. She kept telling me to join...
She has? Has she also tried to tempt you with a memory foam pillow?
Nope. But I do want one of those...
I caved in and said I'd join just so I could get some sleep.
If that was the price for sleep, I'd pay it, too.
That's fair.
Laffey, you shouldn't have said yes so casually. You should've told her to stop bothering you first.
Just for that, I'm joining team red. When I win, I'll make her apologize for disturbing your sleep.
Huh? Is joining them just to spite the other team really such a good idea?
That's not such a big deal. I wouldn't worry about it.
Okay, 30 minutes on skincare after waking up...
After that, 30 minutes of warmup exercises and 10 minutes of finger stretches...
Then comes the exercises to cover for each other's flaws, and don't forget to practice your stage face...
Noshiro? What are you doing here?
Shouldn't you be out looking for new members with Eugen and Formidable?
I considered it, but I'm just not very good at persuading people.
We talked about it and decided that they'll do recruitment while I schedule our rehearsals.
Besides, it takes more than just recruiting people to win. We need to hone our performance skills, too.
Taking full advantage of the Muse System takes practice, practice, practice.
I knew you'd say that. You know what? Let me and Agano help you out on the recruitment side of things!
Finally, the deadline for recruiting new members passed.
At the end of it all, the blue team had secured Polaris, Verheerender, and the Dragon Sisters.
They also had Unicorn and Laffey, who joined as solo acts.
The red team, meanwhile, had the talented units Lumière and Astrum.
Their ranks also included individual idols like Fubuki, Queen Elizabeth, Z23, and Hammann.
The blue team may have us beat in the membership department...
But our team has more units than they do!
That's an issue, Your Majesty! There must be an equal number of units for the competition to even happen!
Making one unit leave is definitely off the table. I think we'll need to merge multiple units.
Seems so. It wouldn't be fair otherwise.
It's our only option.
Hmph! I want to demonstrate my greatness on my own terms! I will NOT team up with anybody!
I want to sing solo, too! A-and not because I only want the Commander to see my performance, not at all!
Z23, you wanna team up and make a temporary unit with me?
Sure. And if others move around a bit, we should end up with an equal number of units!
Once everyone has been assigned, each unit should give a demonstration of their performance.
The two most important things in a performance are character and passion. The songs we go with should reflect that.
Yes, the previous tests proved that pretty well. The best kind of performance is one that lets you fully express your feelings.
Remember, ladies – we are all one unit now, so let's not get on each other's nerves, alright?
I've created learning and rehearsal schedules. I'd like us all to stick to them as much as possible.
You heard her, folks. You'll have to really give it your all if you want to get your wish.
Not that it matters, because I'm not letting anyone else have it.
I told you already! All you need is passion!
Your idea of a performance is too violent! The other team will use that against you!
Zzz... I'm going to sleep...
Boise, do you want a baozi? It's fresh out of the oven!
Huff... Puff... Y-yes please.
How did we get to this point? We were just discussing performances and tactics...
You are all severely lacking in grace!
What's wrong with it? They're creating a lively atmosphere! That's what idols are supposed to do!
In that way, I suppose you're right.
Exactly! In fact, I think building hype is our team's greatest strength!
It's just like the kind of energy Cyanidin brings – cheerful, fun, and full of aspiration!
Then again, maybe not all of us are like that. Ahaha...
But that's okay! Being yourself is the most important trait an idol can have!

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>1 Admission</size>

scripts.say: On the afternoon of my day off, I decided to go to the amusement park for some much-needed downtime.
But as I walk by, my eyes are drawn to an unfamiliar building.
A dilapidated wooden sign stands by the entrance, and it reads:
"White Night Manor: A Horror Spot Where Ghosts from Across Time Gather! Super Thrilling, Super Scary Times Ahead!"
Huh... is this a brand-new haunted mansion?
Heeehehehe♪ It's no ordinary haunted mansion~
Until today, people didn't know the true horror of ghost stories... But this is different!
With these large premises, an extravagant budget, and my unrivaled understanding of horror stories...
We've created this massive, horror-themed escape room! Upon these hallowed grounds, all manner of legendary ghouls and forgotten phantasms shall make their chilling return!
...Or, well, they will when it's open to the public. We're currently testing the attraction♪
What say you, Commander? Want to give it a try?
Such a special horror experience comes only once in a lifetime! Heeehehehe♪
Thanks to Prinz Moritz's impassioned sales pitch, I am somewhat interested in seeing this escape room.
(...There's no harm in trying it.)
Heeehehehe♪ I can see it in your eyes, Commander♪ Come with me!
(I didn't even say anything... She was dead set on having me go in the whole time...)
Prinz Moritz leads me by the hand into the building. It has the decor of a small clinic.
Under the dim lighting, she pushes a sickbed right next to me.
Whenever you're ready, please put on this eye mask and lie down♪
And then, prepare for your visit to the legendary White Night Manor Hospital...
Do your best to make it out alive!
It's been some time now since I was thrown into the darkness, and I have absolutely no idea where I am now.
I then hear the creaking of the door, followed by the clacking of two sets of heels approaching me from both sides.
Director Superb, we have a new inpatient!
My eye mask comes off, and after a few seconds of squinting to adjust to the light, my sight finally returns...
Is this our new patient?
More accurately, this will be our newest test subject.
Ah... Please give me a moment to prepare.
You came sooner than I expected, so I haven't had time to get dressed for the occasion...
Superb swiftly pulls the curtains shut. I hear rustling fabric for a few moments, and then the curtains open again.
My... You don't look too different.
No, I think it is a little different...
Heheheh♪ Commander, that look on your face.. I think you don't quite understand your position.
You are our super-rare specimen... And from the moment you set foot here, you're all mine...
Come what may, you're going to stay here forever.
I hope you've made your peace with the fact you'll be spending the rest of your worldly existence here♪
But don't worry, we're all going to take such good care of you.
Welcome to the White Night Manor, Commander.

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>No Entry</size>

scripts.say: It took a while... But after satisfying Ganj-i-Sawai, I got her to tell me the location of the entrance and gathered the others.
We descend the aged secret staircase and set foot in the basement at the depths of the White Night Manor.
A heavy hatch sits beneath what few specks of light trickle in from above.
I spot a note on the map, which says we should be able to escape the hospital through here. The light of freedom at the end of this tunnel is almost at hand...
...I'm not letting you escape that easily.
The source of the familiar voice is none other than Superb. She emerges from the darkness, lancet and scissors in hand, barring our way to the exit.
Ganj-i-Sawai wasn't able to stall you for long... Not unexpected, but disappointing.
But that doesn't matter... You coming here saved me the trouble of finding you.
I'll be taking all of you back to the operating room.
I guess we can't expect to clear the game without beating the final boss.
There's no escape anymore... Now, don't resist and fall to me.
Superb throws a few lancets at us to block our way out, and then rushes us with great speed.
She's fast. But...
We're in the age of modern warfare now.
Eat my machine gun's lead!
And my flamethrower...!
F-fire in the hole! Please be careful!
Why do they pack so much firepower...?!
Our concentrated barrage easily takes Superb down.
The script never mentioned this...
Nyahaha! We cleared the game!
We defeated the final obstacle. Commander, let's hurry for the exit.
I step forward and reach for the hatch's handle. With everyone's eyes on me, I pull the rusted door open...
Huh?
Huh??
Huh???
Huh????
On the other side of the door we find not a path to freedom, nor do we find more underground corridors... Only a thick, impenetrable wall.
Wait, what's going on? Isn't this the exit? Scenery team? Is anyone here?
Yes, Raffaello from the scenery team here☆
You mean the exit hatch in the basement? That's just a decoration~ We weren't going to go to the trouble of actually digging a tunnel for the duct.
Wait... Is this another trap you set? And the real escape route is somewhere else...
That can't be right! The script says that's the way out, and the whole flow of the game leads to everything ending there!
Hm? But the script I read says the Commander escapes in an ambulance.
Ambulance? No, it's supposed to be a submarine.
No, they ski their way out.
W-wait... Can you show me your scripts?
White Night Manor ver. 155.1... ver. 185.5b... ver. 287.2... They're all different versions!
The bulletin board has the latest version number. Stay tuned for updates!
I updated my version just last night...
A new one came out this morning.
Why does Moritz have to keep changing the script?!
How did we even work together all this time...?
Ugh, and we were so close...
*crackle*
A radio? Wait, who's transmitting at a time like this?!
Uhh, can you hear me?
C-Commander?!

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>Conquering the White Night</size>

scripts.say: Ten minutes earlier...
Why... is there a wall behind the exit?
Waaahhhh... This was all for nothing! How are we supposed to get out of here now?!
No, there's still a way.
And not just one way... Our options are countless.
Commander...?
If we can't use any of the established escape routes...
We just have to get creative and find a way out no one could expect.
Anything that'll let us escape can be our escape route.
Now, the first thing that comes to mind is – when you're trapped, the best way out is to call someone on the outside and wait for rescue.
And this radio... is the channel connecting us to the outside world.
*crackle*

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Office of Paranormal Affairs Chief Z13 speaking~ Do you have any supernatural problems that need solving?
All right! She sounds like a pro, too.
Help us! We're stuck inside the White Night Manor, there are scary nurses and monsters in every corner! Please, come help us!

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Okay~ Consider your call for help accepted~
If you're a proper institution, is there any way you could send out a helicopter to pick us up?

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: A helicopter...? O-of course! Sending out a helicopter during emergencies is the bare minimum as far as solutions go!

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: We'll arrive at the rooftop of the adjacent building right away! Let's meet there!
All right. We'll get moving right away.

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Okay! All staff, report to the dressing room stat! Get changed and ready to go! The finale needs a thrilling chase scene!
Careful! The radio's still on!

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Huh?! Oh, you're right...
Oh, there's no need to rush~ The night's just getting started...
I found you... You mustn't leave this place...
Where do you think you're going? ♡
More monsters are crawling out of the woodwork!
Let's hurry! This way!
...You shall... not pass...
We're not letting you through. Leave your milk here and turn back!
Zombies and vampires I understand, but why are there aliens and cowgirls here?
You have sharks here, so zombies, vampires, aliens and cowgirls are all the same, right?
...I put on... whatever costume I found in the room...
I kick the door open, only to be greeted by a gust of powerful wind.
A blinding search light shines down on us as Z13's helicopter hovers overhead.

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Everyone, good job hanging on so far! We'll drop the rope ladder right away!
I'm getting a really bad feeling about this... Using a helicopter in a zombie story is risky!
Suddenly, the helicopter tilts.

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Awawawa?! What?! What's with all the shaking?!
There's trouble! The control panel is throwing up alerts!
Fu Po, come here! What does this red one mean?!
Don't rush me, I'm trying to read the manual... Uh, page one has the safety precautions...
Who has time to start from page one?! Just find the section on emergency landings!
The helicopter rapidly loses altitude as it goes into a tailspin and soon crashes, becoming nothing more than a burning wreck spewing thick black smoke.
Oh no... They crashed!
We're never getting out of here...

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: Survivors, we're sorry... The OPA is finished...
No, we still have a way out.
I point at the starry sky stretching out beyond the edge of the roof.
You're not suggesting we fly there, are you? I dunno about everyone else, but I sure can't fly!
No. Look closely.
Uh... Wait. There's something shining in the sky...?
In the night sky, we see a streak of silver stretching from the rooftop's edge to the other bank of a distant river.
Is that... the suspension wire device we used before?!

scripts.factiontag: Chief of the Office of Paranormal Affairs
scripts.say: I was just about to introduce it! Our Special One-Way Aerial Suspension Device!
Just then, the rooftop door bursts open with a massive crash, and monsters spill out into the night.
Now! Grab the zip line and jump!
And so, cornered by the horde, the survivors used the zip line to descend to the opposite side of the river.
Leaving behind the eerie manor, the twisted experiments, and the ravenous monsters clawing after them...
With the darkness finally fading into the distance... hope grows ever brighter.
Urgh...
Phew, it's finally over!
The Commander and the others escaped safely!
Let's go back and pop open that champagne! This time we really did it!
...Huh? What's with all the noise?
And why hasn't the Commander shown up after all this time? Was the Manor too challenging?
I'd go outside and look, but if I leave early, all the traps will get reset...
Do I go out or wait a bit longer...? Ugh! I don't know what to do...!

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>12 Epilogue</size>

scripts.say: Aaah, blast it all!
The audio, the lights, the props were all perfect, and I even prepared a massive indoor free-fall machine employing VR effects for my Mega Ultra Super Scary Horror Story!
And no one even played the game right! It's not fair!
But despite everything we all ended up clearing the game, so it's the best result after all!
Yes... Broadly speaking, it was a lot of fun.
Heheheh, of course it was. Any escape room plotted by a horror pro with my eye for detail and creativity is bound to be perfect.
Yeah! The part where the shark jumped out of the water left the deepest impression on me! I thought I was gonna get a heart attack!
Y-yeah... And the zombies and aliens popping out at the end there did come out of the blue...
Mm? Shark? Zombies? Aliens?
Was that in the script? Did you guys really play my White Night Manor escape room?
Erm...
Erm...
Erm...
But, well... What matters is that you had fun.
I know...! I'll put everything into the sequel, White Night Cruise! Heeehehehe♪
But that's not enough... Let's throw in mountain spirits and sea monsters and huge dinosaurs!
You're making a sequel?
With you in the lead role, "Authentic Horror Story: Escape the White Night Manor!" is getting rave reviews. And profits are through the roof!
So we've already secured a budget for the sequel.
And I have the script for it written too!
A bigger budget means a bigger scale than just the White Night Manor, more gorgeous effects and crazier twists! And above all else, more horror!
Heeehehehe♪ Look forward to it, Commander!

sequence: Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor! – The End

Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>2 Escape the Hospital!</size>

scripts.say: I'll go and finish the admission paperwork. Head Nurse Plymouth, please keep a close eye on the Commander until I'm done♪
I hear Superb walking away, leaving me and Plymouth alone in the room.
I'll be your personal nurse then, Commander.
(I have to get out of here while I can... My situation will only be much worse when Superb gets back.)
With my limbs tied up with tape, all I can do is move my head to look around the room.
Are you looking for something, Commander? If you require anything, you can just ask me for it.
...I'm a bit thirsty. Can you get me some water?
Understood, Commander. I will fulfill all of your very reasonable requests.
Plymouth makes to go fetch me water, but then turns around and regards me with a frown.
But how am I going to have you drink when your hands are tied up...?
Mm... Oh, I know!
Plymouth's eyes light up as she comes up with an idea.
She suddenly takes a swig of water and approaches me. And before I can even react...
She passes the cold water from her lips and into my mouth.
Mmfh–?! ...Gulp, gulp...
You didn't choke on it, did you, Commander?
My apologies. I was meant to provide you with the ideal environment to grant your wishes, but I made such a blunder...
We must give you a full body check to ensure your good health!
Plymouth straddles me.
She quickly unbuttons my shirt and presses her ear against my chest.
Your temperature is... elevated. Your pulse is heightened... Goodness, you require first aid.
First aid?
Commander, please settle down. I will immediately... put you at ease...
Still sitting on top of me, Plymouth brings her hands to my body and starts massaging me.
As her pleasant touch continues, my physical unease melts away, and I feel absolutely refreshed and relaxed in both mind and body.
After a while, Plymouth's hands stop moving over me.
Commander, do you still feel unwell?
If you require anything, anything at all, please do not hesitate to let me know. I shall provide you with anything I can.
Being taped up like this... really hurts.
My, it would, wouldn't it...? You can't stretch your limbs like this...
Could you loosen it up a little?
I'll do you one better. I'll take it all off right now.
That went better than expected. Plymouth obediently bends over and undoes all the tape.
That feels much better. Thank you, Plymouth.
I'm glad to have been of service. But in place of the tape tying you up... Let me stay by your side and watch over you.
All right, let's move together, then.

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>3 Endless Corridor</size>

scripts.say: With Plymouth's help, I make it out of the hospital room.
The sky is dark, and the dim corridor is illuminated only by what faint light leaks from the sickrooms.
Are there other patients here?
Yes, they're all on Director Superb's surgery list.
The more people are on our side, the better. Let's save them.
Plymouth unlocks the sickrooms, and I hear hurried footsteps from inside.
Waaaah! I don't want to get modified! There's still so much gossip I haven't heard yet! Help meeee!
The moment the door swings open, Santa Fe bursts out of the sickroom and bumps into my chest.
Ugh... Owie... Ah, Commander! You came to save me? Yay!
Hold on one darn minute... What's the scary head nurse doing with you?! Don't tell me... They already modified you, and now you're one of them?!
Don't worry, she's on our side.
I will follow whatever order the Commander gives to the best of my ability.
Huh?! For real?!
Wh-what happened...?
Do you require assistance?
Patients in the other sickrooms notice the commotion and apprehensively peek out their heads.
I gather everyone and sum up what we know about the situation.
Nyahaha~ I signed up for the trial run because Moritz said this place has crazy good gossip...
She didn't tell me it'd be so freakin' scary though!
I-I'm only here because I bumped into Moritz and she asked for my help with something...
A-and I can't say no when people ask me like that... So she had me put on a blindfold and brought me here...
So Moritz asked all three of you to playtest this place?
Well, I'm not one of the players...
Three years ago, I was hospitalized here, at White Night Manor Hospital. It all started on one stormy night...
A few hours later...
...And ever since, no one has ever left the White Night Manor alive... Blah blah, so on and so forth...
Yaaaawn... Huh? Wait, what time is it?
Zzz...
I never knew the White Night Manor hid such dark secrets...

options.content: That was an impressive info dump.
I can't wrap my head around it all...

scripts.say: Should I tell the story one more time?
H-Huh?! N-no, we're good...!
(I think Surrey is playing the part of a tutorial NPC for the escape room. She doesn't seem to mean us any harm, so let's take her out of here, too. She could be useful for something.)
Let's hurry. We're going to escape the White Night Manor, together!
Set sail!
Commander... Is it just me, or did the atmosphere change all of a sudden?
This corridor just goes on and on and on... We've been walking forever and it doesn't end.
I walk sandwiched between Santa Fe and Z11, who each cling to one of my arms, with Plymouth hugging my shoulders from behind...
We walk down the hall in this strange formation.
That room ahead of us... Is that a bathroom?
Didn't we pass this door by before?
Oh, no... Are we trapped in here?!
Come to think of it, I did hear a ghost story to that effect from a friend of a friend of mine...
One time, a patient neglected to wash up on time, so she snuck out of her room after lights out and went to the bathroom...
The corridor stretched on and on like it never ends, and no matter how much she walked, she could never reach the bathroom. When she did eventually find it, it was already the dead of night...
She breathed a sigh of relief, entered the bathroom, then turned on the faucet. And then... a horrible scream tore through White Night Manor!
No one has seen that patient ever since...
Around the same time Surrey finishes her story, a bell tolls, its heavy ringing reverberating through the hospital.
An endless corridor... and a bathroom... It's all just like Surrey's story.
Does that mean we'll be fine as long as we don't turn on the faucet?
R-right...! We'll be fine so long as we keep our hands off the faucets! When you put it like that, it's not that scary...
(Whoosh––!)
Just then, we hear the rumble of running water coming from the bathroom. For some reason, Surrey was meticulously scrubbing her face at the sink.
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAH! Why did you do that?! You're the one who said we shouldn't turn on the faucet!
The director always says we have to stay hygienic and sterilized. I always make it a point to wash my face when I'm near a sink.
GRAAAAH!!!
No sooner than she says that, a massive shadow emerges from the bathroom window and swipes its massive claws, grabbing Surrey and dragging her out.
Waaah! Surrey!
M-m-m-m-m-monster! Outside the window! Run!
Before we can make sense of the situation, I get pulled along by everyone else and we plunge into the darkness.
C-Commander... I can't run anymore...
That monster's still after us.
Waaah... It got Surrey, and now we're all next on the chopping block...
This is weird...
Look at this. The monster is getting further away from us.
We all stop in our tracks and look at the "monster" behind us.
The monster pursues us with little, unsteady steps.
...It's not just me, right? It's getting slower.
The monster's steps sway even harder, and it looks like it's about to fall over...

scripts.actorName: Fu Shun & Fu Po & Fei Yuen
scripts.say: Wawawa...!
With a heavy thud, the "monster" falls over, and a trio of petite figures crawl out of it.
I can't keep going... Too heavy...
The monster fell apart...
Are those... Fu Po, Fei Yuen and Fu Shun?
Th-they spotted us! Run!
The trio disappears down the dark corridor, dragging their monster costume along.

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>4 Behind the Scenes</size>

scripts.say: Oh no, oh no, oh no, the Commander totally saw us!
I-I can't take anymore...! Having to carry you both on my shoulders and have that heavy costume on...! I'm beyond done!
Hey, being on top was hard, too...! Lady Yuen had to hold onto the wire the whole time we were waiting by the window! It made my hands go numb...
That's why I said that having us do gymnastics like that out of the blue is unreasonable...!
Now, everyone, calm down! We had no other option.
It was supposed to be a powerful performance done with just one actor acting alongside a drone's projection...
But all our drones got sent out to help with Prinz Moritz's Mega Ultra Super Scary Horror Story.
That's the first I've heard of that... Is that really on the script?
I don't blame you for not knowing about it, we just heard about it this morning. I bet she came up with it on the spot...
Heeehehehe♪ All the tricks for my Mega Ultra Super Scary Horror Story are complete! Things are going to be fun!
All that's left is to wait for the Commander to progress in the game and get to the ICU stage♪
But with Moritz gone, I guess we have to keep going with the escape room in this scuffed state...
No need to feel down, friends! Think back! What's the one tenet we all adhere to at the White Night Manor?
Uh... Going all the way to scare the players?
Wrong! Dead wrong! If we scare them senseless and they can't escape the room, the game would never end!
Then do we turn off all the tricks and let the players escape? That'll be faster!
Kind of feels like an easy out, doesn't it?
I know! Let's adjust the difficulty so it's just hard enough to be challenging but just easy enough to be able to barely clear!
The players will get absorbed in the game, and that'll make them satisfied and like... motivated to keep going? You know, like when you beat a really strong enemy!
Right! And if they can achieve that goal...
They won't care no matter what crazy stuff happens on the way there!
Even if that something crazy was seeing us after the monster costume fell apart...?
They won't sweat the details!
Z13 is right! We just need to put out all the stops to make this fun! Let's do this!
Let's do this!
Good stuff! Let's ride this trend and set up the next stage!
Hmm. The script says that next, the players will be looking through the hospital to find the key to the gate...
Hold on, Z13.
I spotted an irregularity in the security cameras. The players already left the hospital, they're in the outdoor area.
Huh?! How did they manage that?!

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>5 Cross the River</size>

scripts.say: We finally made it out, Commander!
location: Ten Minutes Ago – Near the White Night Manor

scripts.say: I can't believe the nurses used mirrors to hide the exit! It's not fair!
Tricks using mirrors are highly effective in dim settings...
It's a good thing you picked up on it so soon, Commander. We'd still be going around in circles in there if you didn't!
But still, the Manor's gate is locked with really complex security. On top of a fingerprint scanner and a keypad, they even have a retina scanner...
I think we'll need to collect a bunch of items to open it. Are you sure sneaking out a window like this was the right idea?
We're fine, we're fine~ See, the window next to the gate wasn't shut at all, right? Everyone was able to climb over and escape with no issue.
If they wanted to get any more clear than that, they'd have to plant a neon sign screaming "EXIT THIS WAY"! I bet the gate's just for show~♪
WHO DID THIS?! THE WINDOWS ARE SUPPOSED TO STAY SHUT!
Superb told me to open the windows... She said hospitals have to stay ventilated...
Arghhh... and now all the patients have gotten away...
All that hard work we put into those trials, and they just break out...
Ah, umm... D-does this mean big brother has cleared the game...?
Heheh, calm down everyone, calm down! They may have escaped the building, but that doesn't mean they cleared the game! The outside's way harder, after all!
We follow the only way near the Manor, and emerge at a river.
The wooden bridge that should have been over the river is in pieces, with a few of the remaining planks floating on the water.
We'll have to find some other way to cross to the other side.
This happens pretty often in horror stories...
Look at how heavy this fog is. Who knows what might be lurking out there!
Let's calm down and assess the situation. There's something moored to the riverbank over there, see?
A boat? If we could take a ferry to the other side, we could get out of here.
Plymouth points in the direction of a boat. And there's a familiar figure standing next to it...
Heh, heh... For a reasonable fee, I can take you to the other side...
Surrey?! D-didn't you get snatched away by a monster...?
You're mistaking me for someone else.
I am a ferrywoman from afar, here to carry those who need help to the other side of the river.
No, you're totally Surrey! You're even still in the same hospital getup!
Uh...
Z13, what am I supposed to say...?
Just calm down and repeat after me,
My name is Yerrus.
My name is Yerrus.
You must be confusing me with my long lost, identical younger sister~
You must be confusing me with my long lost, identical younger sister~
You're not expecting us to take that seriously, are you?
You're not expecting us to take that seriously, are you?
I'm not the one you're supposed to be repeating after.
Uh...
This is a waste of time. If we have a ferry, let's cross it and move on.
We get on Surrey's ferry and head across the river.
All right! At this rate, we'll clear the game in no time!
A thick mist suddenly settles over the river.
Come to think of it, a friend of a friend of mine told me a ghost story about this river...
Once upon a time, a patient tried to swim across this river and escape the White Night Manor. But she sank halfway across and never surfaced...
That seems vaguely familiar...
Now I have a bad feeling about this.
I'm curious about the rest... but we could turn back now.
And ever since, whenever someone tried to escape through this river, they encounter a shadow wandering in the fog...
RAWR!!!
Suddenly, a black shadow surfaces in the river, and drags Yerrus the ferrywoman into the water!
Aaaah! The ghost of the drowned patient is out for revenge...!
Am noooot! I'm a shaaaark, not a ghooost!
A sh-shark?!
Why is a shark swimming in a river?
Cuz I feel like iiiit. Aren't you going to ruuuun?
U-110 raises her head high and headbutts the side of our boat!
The wooden boat gets split cleanly in two, and I get swallowed up by the river...
A shark lurking in the river... That's amazing! Things are getting spicy!
If Lady Yuen's memory serves, shouldn't this scene's monster be a ghost?
And Surrey's still dressed in her last scene's outfit...
Uh, well, you see... There's a perfectly good reason for that...
Originally they were supposed to gather a number of keys inside the hospital and use them to unlock the gate... But the Commander ended up skipping all of that.
Oh, I see! So the girl who should have been the ghost was supposed to be the ghost in the hospital room too, and she couldn't make it to the river in time...
So I had to get someone else to fill in for her last minute! And U-110 happened to be free...
But I mean, a shark does the trick, right? I'm sure Moritz won't complain.
Heeehehehe♪ I don't care what the story is leading up to me. So long as the Commander gets to experience my masterpiece, the Mega Ultra Super Scary Horror Story...
That said... Why isn't the Commander here yet?

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>6 Suspicious Door</size>

scripts.say: I manage to swim to the other bank of the river, after somehow managing to brave U-110's shark attack.
...I guess any escape room game Moritz made won't be easy to clear.
Doing it alone will be hard... For now, I have to meet up with the others who went missing.
I walk along the riverbank, and spot something unexpected by the trees.
Is this... an underground shelter?
Between the trees and the rocks, I find a concrete tunnel.
At the end of the tunnel is a heavy metal door, open just wide enough for one to slip through.
Did Santa Fe and the others open it?
I'll have to go in and check.
Past the metallic door is a long, narrow corridor.
There's assorted items stacked on the sides of the corridor, like used set piece panels, tangled cables and machine parts of unknown purpose.
What's this doing so close to the hospital?
With question marks over my head, I walk deeper in, looking for traces of my friends.
Eventually, I reach another half-open door at the end of the hall.
Plymouth, Santa Fe, Z11! Are you here?!
My call echoes through the spacious room, but no one answers me.
There are surveillance monitors all over the room, showing footage from all over the Manor's interior.
So much surveillance equipment... Is this the hospital's monitoring room?
But it doesn't look like Santa Fe and the others are here...
As I look around, I spot something on the table.
A radio? Do the nurses use it for communication?
This could be useful, so I should take it along... I gotta move on. I don't think I'll find any clues here.
The door closes again, and the monitoring room fills with silence.
What's the Commander doing backstage?!
I don't know! This place is supposed to be a secret! No one should be able to find this place...
L-let's get out of here! It's too cramped in here...!
A locker in the room's corner opens with a loud clatter, and a few girls stuffed inside fall out.
Either way, we can't let the Commander get any deeper inside!
Right! Griffin, change into your costume and go stall the Commander. We'll call for backup in the meanwhile!
Huh?! Me?!
First I need to put my head in here... Then my arms... Then button up...
All right, so far so good! I have to go faster, though... Whoa?!
The button popped off! And look at the hems!
As I walk down the hall, I find a door with the words "Staff Only" on it, and hear a girl squealing from inside.
Z13, this costume isn't my size!
Opening the door, I spot a very flustered Griffin.
Whoaaaa?! Commander, when did you get here?! I-I'm not done changing yet!

options.content: You look like you could use a hand.

scripts.say: Wow, Commander, you're so nice... Wait, no, don't go!
A hand? Uh... Ah! Y-yes!
I really really need your help, Commander!
Just give me a few minutes of your time...! Won't you help me change?
...Sure, I don't mind.
Griffin heaves a sigh of relief and turns her back to me, and starts fixing her stockings.
This outfit, though...
I approach Griffin, and upon seeing her fixing... Or rather, pretending to fix her stockings, I gently grab her.
Griffin, you're one of Superb's nurses, aren't you?
Huh? O-of course, I'm...
Griffin stiffens for a moment, but upon realizing my intentions, flushes over and shakes her head.
N-no, I don't work for Director Superb!
Really?
I pull on her squishy flanks, eliciting a nervous gasp from her.
Oooh, C-Commander, please stop...
I-I'm... just an ordinary nurse changing clothes, I wasn't trying to lead on someone as strong as you...
Her story does sound terribly forced, but given how flustered she is, I doubt she means any ill.
...Speaking of, is this a hospital changing room? Why are all the clothes here so strange?
I reach for a few clearly suspicious outfits hanging on a nearby clothes rack.
This white cloth... Is this a ghost costume?
Gh-ghost? O-of course not! It's just uh...! A sheet! A clean sheet, for the sickrooms!
Then what's with the bandages? It looks like a mummy costume...
Th-those are just used medical bandages!
As I try to press her for details, an arm reaches out from behind and grabs me. The tables instantly turn.
I see you're enjoying your allocated "outing time", Commander...
But you know what they say about curiosity and cats, and all your wandering around is veeeery catlike.
Because this right here is my secret experimentation laboratory...
And naughty patients who sneak out of bed, loiter about the hospital, and enter off-limits areas...
Need to be taken back and put through strict re-disciplining♪

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>7 The Evil Hospital Director</size>

scripts.say: An unfamiliar ceiling...
Looking up, I'm greeted by the cold gaze of a surgical lamp.
I realize I can't move, since I'm strapped onto an operating chair with soft leather belts.
Heheh, you're finally awake, my dear test subject.
While you were asleep, I took the liberty of giving you a thorough oral examination.
After all, an adult who abides by manners should not behave like a candy-craving child.
I look in the direction of the voice, and see Superb dressed in a white coat standing next to my chair, surgical tools in hand.
...Going straight to surgery? Aren't we skipping a few steps here?
Heheheh. Don't worry, I'll make sure it's not painful.
I just want to make you rely on me forever... completely docile and obedient...
Superb suddenly trails off and drops her gaze to my collar.
Hold on a second, I'll fix your collar.
That's no good. You have to look your finest for my surgery.
Superb puts the tools away and leans down in front of me, bringing her face closer. I feel her hot breath blowing on my neck.
She unbuttons my crooked collar and traces her finger over my collarbone before pausing.
Mm... Very carefully, button up the shirt, set the collar symmetrically, and make sure the shoulder line is straight...
Superb carefully adjusts my collar, her hands smelling faintly of disinfectant mingled with the subtle fragrance of roses.
She then traces the line of my shoulders, her fingers slowly sliding down my arms.
...I'll roll up your sleeves a little.
Superb's fingers creep into my sleeves, and I feel a cold sensation on my wrists.
Each time she folds my sleeves, her willowy fingers graze my skin.
Your pulse is heightened. Is my touch making you nervous, or...?
Maybe you're... en-joy-ing this? Heheh...
But either way, it gets in the way of the procedure, so I need you to relax...
Saying this, Superb kisses me gently.
She kisses me a few more times, forcing me to taste her warm sweetness.
Her tongue traces my lips, slowly, probingly, before delving deep into my mouth. It takes quite some time before she pulls away, satisfied.
Heheheh, did you like my special pre-operation tranquilizer?
Her breath a bit taxed, Superb gets up and drops her gaze to my shirt again.
Now it's all wrinkly... I have to fix it...
...There. All better♪
Ah... Your pulse is still elevated, Commander. Why did the tranquilizer wear off so soon, I wonder?
Her eyes are burning with a smoldering, sultry flame.
In that case... I'll just have to give you another dose of my special tranquilizer~ Hehehe...
She seals my lips again. My consciousness hazes over once more, and I find myself drowning in her sweetness...

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>8 Reunion and Hope</size>

scripts.say: Cuffs, all good. Buttons, all in place.
You look perfect, Commander. Now it's finally time for your modification...!
CLANG––!!
Superb's surgical instruments draw closer and closer to me, when suddenly the door swings open!
A familiar nurse rushes into the room, pushing a sickbed.
H-hello, Director Superb...!
(Is that Z11?)
U-uh... I, uhm, brought another patient...!
I'm done foooor! I'm gonna get modified toooo! I'll never escaaaaape!
(I don't think she's winning any awards for her acting...)
Well done.
But why did you come in now?
W-well... There was some trouble outside...
Head Nurse Plymouth said she's going to blow up the gate to save the Commander... And I couldn't stop her...!
The only way is for you to go and do something about it...!
...What? Goodness, how troublesome... I'll go take a look.
Z11, you keep an eye on the Commander.
After saying that, Superb turns around and walks out of the operating room. Her footsteps grow distant and eventually fade into the corridor..
Phew... That was scary...
Commander~ It's been so long! We're here to save you! Nyahahaha!
Santa Fe, who was writhing on the bed until just now, hops up nimbly and removes the belts holding me in place.
Let's get out of here while Plymouth keeps Superb busy!
Leaning on the old saying that it's darkest under the lamp post, we run out of the operating room and take cover in the nearby examination room.
Plymouth joins in a short time later, and we all regroup safely.
The Commander rescue operation was a dazzling success!
Finally, we can breathe easy...
What happened on your side? Z11, where did you get that nurse outfit?
Well, you see...
After we got separated, we found this strange underground bunker by the river. Santa Fe was sure there's some secret there.
So you were the ones who opened that door first.
But when we went inside, we ran into Director Superb again...
So we ducked into a small hidden room, and found lots of weird stuff in there...
Among the stuff was this nurse uniform, so I put it on to fool the Director!
After that, we saw Superb carrying you away, so we tailed you~
Aside from the nurse uniform, there were a lot of other useful things inside that room.
Plymouth places the large bag she's carrying on the table and opens it.
A chainsaw, a shotgun, machine guns and bombs~
...Was the room you found an armory or something?
Among the pile of weapons, I find a folded piece of paper.
This is... a map of the White Night Manor.
I open the map and observe the place's structure carefully.
The layout shows that there's an exhaust duct leading out of the Manor.
Assuming this information is true... That duct may be our way out.
Oh...? They all went to our prop room?
Well, that's fine, I guess. It's not going according to the script, but we wanted to guide the Commander to the exhaust duct anyway.
And that's where the game's final stage is!
So they're that close to clearing the game?
All right! I'll go call everyone over! Let's celebrate!
Woohoo! Let's get champagne♪

sequence:
Authentic Horror Story: Escape from White Night Manor!

<size=45>9 Craving for Truth</size>

scripts.say: The entrance to the duct should be right below the radiology department, but the map doesn't specify exactly where it is.
Left with no choice, we enter the radiology department and split up to look for the entrance.
I enter the only sickroom with lights on, where I'm greeted by the fragrance of spices mingled with the ever-present smell of disinfectant.
Hmm... It's a bit hard to see from this angle.
In the lit room, Ganj-i-Sawai looks up at me, cradling a piece of equipment in her arms.
Oh, finally, a reliable doctor shows up.
Hmm... You give off a nostalgic air. It reminds me of myself...
You must be in the same predicament as me... What brings you here?
Despite the baffling situation, Ganj-i-Sawai looks very relaxed and non-hostile.
I'm looking for an entrance underground. I've heard it's somewhere around here.
Oh, if that's true, I might know where the entrance is.
Buut, everything comes with a price, you know? If you want me to tell you, you'll have to give me something in return.
What do you want?
Oh, no need to get nervous... See what I'm holding?
Ganj-i-Sawai pats the screen of the device she's holding. This makes her collar come loose, showing off her pale collarbone.
I've heard this device can reflect my true self... But no matter how I look into this, I can't find anything special about it.
If you'll investigate this machine and help me find what's wrong with my body...
I'll tell you where the entrance is!
A good deal, don't you think?
I nod along to her sweet voice, and Ganj-i-Sawai grins and pats at the spot beside her.
As soon as I sit down, she clings her body to me while still holding the device. Her silky hair gently brushes against me.
Well? With this device right here... You can see my condition well, right?
...Huh? The monitor really changed.
It changed the moment I ran into you... And I think I have a good idea what happened~
I feel her breath blowing against my ear, and its fragrance fills my nostrils. Oddly enough, it smells of spices.
I feel Ganj-i-Sawai's body heat against me, and look down to see her hand gripping mine.
Now that we know the cause... Next, I want you to inspect me more deeply~
Don't you want to get a better look, from up close? Let's get this bulky device out of the way, shall we?
Ganj-i-Sawai giggles and pushes away the device, and then she reaches out and brings her fingers to my top's buttons.
But if you're going to inspect me closely, the closer the better, right?
And besides... You saw what goes on in my heart, so now it's my time to get a good look at you♪
I never agreed to go that far...
Oh, really? Well, it's not too late to make that promise, is it?
If you really want to know where the entrance is... You'd do well to satisfy me.
From how you look... To how your heart races... I so look forward to learning more about you.
Why waste your time in that dank, dim basement when you can spend it here with me?
I promise you. It'll be more fun than you could ever expect♥

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>1.A Secretary of Many Talents</size>

scripts.say: It's past noon, and Guam is enjoying her lunch, having just finished a hectic shoot.
The "lunch" in question is some fast food she bought on her way to my office, and she has almost already wolfed it down.

options.content: What's the rush? Take your time eating it.

scripts.say: Nobody will kill you for taking a few minutes extra on your lunch break.
Nom... Nah... Om nom... I'm almost done. My afternoon work is too important to delay even a few minutes.
Guam is my current secretary, and apparently is also able to devour food with a speed I've never seen before.
In addition to her secretary duties, she also has obligations as a personality and a presenter.
Why DID you volunteer to serve as my secretary when your schedule is already so packed?
Why? 'Cause I wanna help you out, obviously! Full disclosure, though: I also want the experience that comes with it.
Phew... I really murdered that meal. Alright, Commander, what work are we starting with?
Our stunning, multitalented news anchor is psyched up and raring to go.

options.content: You can rest a bit longer if you want, you know.

scripts.say: Oh, please. What are you, a nurse? I'll be fiiine. I've got energy to spare!
Besides, this girl's gotta catch up on the secretary tasks she wasn't here for in the morning!
She cracks her knuckles and starts working through the afternoon tasks waiting for her.
The raw motivation she displays alone deserves praise.
Although, she does have some... difficulties when it comes to processing documents.
Oh boy, I don't like the way you're looking at me all of a sudden...
Do I really have to... you know... be thorough? Can't I just half-ass this paperwork?
Sadly, her motivation is fickle, it comes as quickly as it goes away.
After but one glance at the papers, her willpower has evaporated like water in a frying pan.
Good idea. Maybe I'll half-ass your vacation application as well.
Okay, forget I said that! No more messing around! I'm gonna process these papers like my life depends on it!
Like I said – it comes as quickly as it goes away.
Seeing her motivation rekindled like this reminds me of when she had just started out as my secretary.

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>2.Work Efficiency: Zero</size>
