scripts.say: (Oh boy... There's so much. I'll have to pull an all-nighter.)
Looking at the files stacked high on my desk, I can't help but feel despondent.
Commander? You're still here? Shouldn't you get ready to leave?
My secretary as of a few days ago, Guam, raises this question.
I got the impression that she was a truly first-rate secretary when, on day one, she did half of my paperwork for the day all by herself.
However, when I examined her work, I discovered that I would need to redo a whopping 90% of it.
I thought it was just a starting-out thing. It was her first day on the job, after all. Unfortunately, days two and three went largely the same.
It is now day four. I have procrastinated on some things as well, leaving me with this absurd amount of work to do.
Oh, uh... There's just one last thing I have to do. Don't worry about me, you're free to leave.
(Her workplace morale is important. Improving her performance is important, too, but... I guess I'll do that step by step.)
Really? Aren't you gonna have dinner?
I'm not hungry yet. I'll eat once I'm finished.
Well, if you say so. Hang in there!
I breathe a deep sigh as I watch my supportive secretary leave.
Alright, let's prioritize the stuff I left on the backburner...
I'll think about dinner once I have some room to breathe.
The late-night silence is broken by a knocking on my door.
(Who could that be at THIS hour?)
Come in.
Good evening! Your beautiful secretary has come to pay you a late visit! Aren't you happy to see me?
What brings you here this late?
Call it an itch. An itch to see if you've actually had dinner yet or not!
And my gut tells me YOUR gut is as empty as Omaha's snack drawer. I knew you'd forget to eat, which is why I've brought you this!
She places the plastic bag in her hand on my desk. An appetizing steam rises from the bag's opening.
I got you that Sakuran bento thingy everyone's been raving about! It's so exclusive, you basically need to be an influencer to get one!
Which I kind of am, I guess? There was a huge line at the store after I finished filming, but I managed to nab one somehow!
Come with me and let's eat! I'm telling you, this stuff hits different at night.
She is just about to drag me out of my seat, but as she extends her hand to me, she notices the pile of papers on my desk.
Hey, what's this?
The time to cover it up has passed. She picks up the document I was just going through.
Hang on a sec... Didn't I do this one earlier today?
Same with this... And this one's from yesterday!
Is this entire pile made up of documents I worked on?!
So... It's all my fault that you've been working so late these past few days?
You shoulda told me sooner! This is no joke, Commander! I thought it was fine to wing it and write whatever seemed right!
Because, like... Come on, isn't paperwork just a thing adults do to kill time?
Uh...
It's definitely not, but you're not entirely off the mark either.
Look, what I'm trying to say is – I'm so, so sorry for making you work more! I'll start over right here and now!
She picks up a stack of papers before she has even finished speaking, sits down at her desk, and gets to work immediately.
Hang on a second!

options.content: Do you know what to do?

scripts.say: Oh, right! I totally forgot in the middle of all that.
The papers aren't going anywhere, but the food won't stay hot forever, sooo... Can I eat first, then work, please?
Of course... not. Please enlighten me!
My sleepless night continues...

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>3.Interview Intermission</size>

scripts.say: Morning, everybody! This is Eagle Union CB-2, Guam, bringing you another report!
Have a look at this! The battle is at its fiercest yet! But who will come out on top?
Oh! Cleveland is gearing up to finish this! She's lining up aaand... Bam! What a shot! Up next...
Whoa, the winning team has arrived!
That was a wonderful match today! Do you have any words for the viewers at home?
Hm? What's this? A post-game interview?
Just tell us your thoughts. Don't think about it too hard!
Ahahah. Well, I went with the flow, saw my chance, and went for it...
There's our presenter.
Hey, Commander! Whatcha doing here on your day off? Were you watching the exercise?
Both the teams that fought today were pretty damn awesome, if I say so myself.
Oh, I know! You're a professional and know tactics and stuff, so what are your thoughts on the match?
Guam, wasting not one moment, thrusts the microphone right in front of me to speak into.
Uh, is this an interview? I thought the broadcast was over?
You're right, it is! But I need material for my evening broadcast, too!
Don't be afraid to get long-winded. I'll need to edit the clips later anyway.
Also, the viewers are gonna go wild when they see you on camera, so if you could say something to them, that'd be perfect!
Okay. To start with...
Wow. I had no idea they put THAT much thought into their choice of tactics.
Alright, thanks a bunch for your valuable time! I've now got all I need to make a fantastic episode!
I remark on how Guam feels different when she's in front of the camera.
Heheh, well, yeah! That's cause I'm in reporter mode.
And I'm not gonna slack on my secretary work later! Once I finish my program, I'm heading straight home to study how to file paperwork!
Ahah, I know that look. You're worried about me, aren't you?
I appreciate the sentiment, but you should know this multitalented hottie is more capable than you think!
I can deal with anything with a big smile even when my schedule's packed tighter than a nun's behind!
Anyhow, I've gotta interview more people now. Cameramanjuu crew, follow me!
And if you've got the time, be sure to tune in to the show tonight!
I'll see you on the other side of the TV!

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>4.Commentary</size>

scripts.say: "Huh? I get to answer? Umm, the answer is... Aw, shoot! Time's up!"
A familiar voice flows through the computer speakers in my office.
On the screen, I see Guam in her studio, smiling an exaggerated grin.
Commander! You watching my show?
Ah, this part! Yeah, it was hilarious to record. A very rare sight of Essex laughing her ass off, too.
Guam, in the flesh, walks in through my door whilst laughing to herself.
What do you think? Did you like it?

options.content: You put on a great show.

scripts.say: You mean it? Thanks! I'm relieved to hear you say that.
Also, why were you watching it here all by yourself? You should've totally watched it with me.
It's more fun that way! 'Cause then I can point at dumb stuff I said and laugh about it with you.
It's like a commentary track, you know?
Won't that take even more time out of your already busy schedule?
To borrow an expression, wind up a pocket watch too much and the spring will break.
Oh no! Without the spring, we'd only have 3 seasons a year!
...Are we playing the straight man and the fool now?
Heh. I just felt like it'd be funny to say. I'm always looking for new material for my show.

options.content: It is funny, but as I was saying...

scripts.say: True, true. Come to think of it, my schedule HAS been pretty tight lately.
I have no idea how you manage it. You can apply for a vacation if you feel overwhelmed, you know.
Hahah, yeah... How DO I do it? I guess my passion gets me through the worst of it.
Being a presenter, a personality, and a secretary all at once isn't easy...
But I do it because I like it. I don't want to quit.
"What about the physical toll," you ask? I'm always full of energy, so I wouldn't worry about it!
Now, where's that afternoon work? Lemme at 'em, coach!
Vrrroom! I'm comin' in hot!
She extends her arms and imitates a bomber plane as she charges at the pile of paperwork, announcing the start of her afternoon shift.
Now we're entering the domain of theatrics...
Heehee... I do appreciate your concern, Commander, and I hear you.
I'll try to ease up my schedule, take breaks, and still do my job as a secretary. Is that good enough?
She takes a seat and immediately buries her head in documents.
I get the feeling this is going to be a lively afternoon.

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>5.Secret Plans</size>

scripts.say: Phew! I've finished everything now. Just need you to review it, Commander.
Just before she clocks out, Guam hands me a thick stack of documents with a smug look.
I pick a few papers at random and scrutinize them thoroughly. While there are some faults, I can't find anything I would call outright incorrect. It seems her efforts to improve have paid off.
You've gotten a lot better, and that deserves a reward. You're free this Sunday, aren't you?
Hang on, are you asking me on a date? Because hell yeah, I'm game!
Sunday, though... Gaaahhh! Why Sunday of all days?!
Her expression lights up like a midsummer day, but then the rain clouds come.
Do you have something else planned for that day?
Yeah... I can't reschedule for it...
It's fine, it's out of your control. How about next Sunday, then?
That works!
Oh, on a random note, can I ask you a favor?
I'd like to use your office this Sunday.
Use... my office? What for?
I'm gonna record something for my show! That's all I can say, 'cause the rest is top secret. You'll see for yourself when it airs.
Don't worry, I won't make a mess of the place! Promise!
(Frankly, I have big concerns about this, but she did turn down my offer in favor of whatever she has planned, so...)
For the sake of argument, let's say I don't let you use it.
Then you'll be free on Sunday, and we can hit the city together.
I... guess that's reasoning is airtight. You cunning demon, you!
I'm just messing with you. You're free to use the office.
Shweet! You're awesome, Commander!
She throws her hands into the air and exclaims in joy. The clouds dimming her expression give way in a heartbeat, and she smiles brightly as the sun again.
But remember, no peeking on Sunday! Got it?
Promise on your life and honor! No peeking!
Guam casually submits a formal application to use the office before she wraps up her day's work.
She's even submitting forms now. It's great to see that she's developing a secretary's mindset.
I'd better start filling out the schedule for next week...

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>6.Break Day and Date Day</size>

scripts.say: Weekend, one week later - Port commercial district
Lookie, Commander! That bunny-bun looks just like Laffey! Well, actually, it looks more like Benson...
But either way, isn't it so cute you just wanna eat it up? Let's get one!
Guam points at a round, stuffed bunny inside the claw game. She lights up like a Christmas tree, beaming with excitement.
Oh! They're selling ice cream over there! I want some!
But I also wanna watch a movie, so... Hmm...
I've got it! Let's go to the clothing store!
Uh...

options.content: Weren't we going to get ice cream?
You changed your mind about the movie?

scripts.say: I hate having to choose, so let's just do them all!
What that means is – first, we'll buy the movie tickets, then get the ice cream, then after we've watched the movie, we'll nab the plushie then return to this spot!
Perfect plan, right? I'm such a genius.
Come on, let's hurry, or we're gonna miss the start of the movie!
Just like that, she scurries off and gets in line at the ticket booth.
The movie was about love and separation.
Once we emerge from the movie theater, Guam has tears dripping down her cheeks.
*sob*... Why did it end on such a heartbreaking note?
Why couldn't they have a happy ending? A couple in love should be allowed to live together happily, dammit!
*sniffle*... I should never have listened to Albacore! "The best film to watch on a date with the Commander," my ass!
I cried so much, my makeup is ruined... *sob*... I need to powder my nose...
That's... That's the spitting-image-of-Benson plushie I said I wanted!
But wait, how'd you get it? You were in the theater with me the whole time...
Did you use, dare I say... magic?
Let's just say I pulled some strings. The movie made you pretty sad, and I thought this would cheer you up.
Also, fun fact – this bunny isn't based on Laffey or Benson, but rather the moon rabbit, which symbolizes a happy reunion in Dragon Empery culture.
The symbolism isn't a perfect fit for this occasion, but you still want it, don't you?
You bet! It represents reunions, eh... This little cutie is getting a spot on my bed!
Because reunion is a much better thing than separation to remember this day by! Heehee.
She's back to her normal, cheerful self again.
Aw, crap! Look how late it is!
My show's gonna start real soon... Dang it, we'll just have to find a place to sit down!
Like... The park! Let's go, double time!
What? But–
She grabs me by the arm and leads me off to the park before I can even ask any questions.
We've been out and about the whole day, and she still has energy to spare... Guam really is something else.

sequence:
Personality, Presenter, Secretary

<size=45>7.Double the Truth</size>

scripts.say: Guam spreads out a picnic blanket on the grass in the park before immediately sitting down and turning on her phone.
Laughter pours out of her phone's speaker. That means her show has officially started.
Port - Office
C-Commander, we've got a big problem, nya!
Whoa, Akashi, take a deep breath. What's wrong?
The harbor is jam-packed with ships bringing supplies, nya!
Right. I was expecting a delivery today.
Yeah, but there are so many, nya! There are 150 ships, nya!
One-hundred and fifty?! THAT many?! What are they bringing?
I think it's all stuff intended for a major operation, nya!
What operation? I'm the Commander here, and I haven't heard anything about that.
They're calling it, "Operation Cleanup," nya...
Oh, Operation Cleanup! Now I know what it's about!
...Go on.
I was filling out a document a few days ago and thought the name sounded cool, so I went with it.
It being an operation, I figured you'd need supplies. And the more supplies, the better, right?
So you've figured out logistics... I can't believe how fast you learn.
Heehee, yeah. I've got a good noggin on me!
Paperwork is just adult busywork, you know? You can half-ass it and nobody's really gonna care!
Commander, I'm here with what you asked for. The roomba that cleans at 80 meters a second is done!
...80 meters a second? It moves at 288 kilometers an hour?
That'll break someone's legs if it crashes into them! Why'd you make it so fast?!
Oh... That's REALLY fast... I think I made a mistake in my calculations. Oopsies! Math is hard!
You do know calculators exist, right? Why don't you use one?
Because using them is the hard part! Besides, this is fine! Now we have the world's fastest roomba, and that's sick!
Guaaam!
Either Essex is a really good actor, or that yell was her genuine reaction.

options.content: So this is what you needed my office for last week, huh?

scripts.say: Bingo. I got inspired by my complete paperwork blunder the other week.
I decided I'd turn it into this little comedy skit!
Firstly, it's my apology to you. Secondly, it's a bit of self-admonition. Thirdly, it's a PSA to tell others to take the work of a secretary seriously!
So it's kind of like edutainment, in a way.
That's one way to put it! Granted, I didn't put THAT much thought into it.
The way I'd describe it is, I just learned a bunch of things on the job and wanted others to get something from it.
It's kind of a self-report that reflects badly on you, though... You're not mad at me for putting this on TV, are you, Commander?
Far from it. In fact...

options.content: I think it's a great skit.
Next time, you should let me play myself.

scripts.say: I'm glad to hear you like it!
Whoa! Okay, you've got it!
Before I know it, we're on the last few minutes of the show.
Guam, in the show, has finally caught on to her numerous mistakes and makes efforts to better herself, ultimately culminating in her becoming an excellent secretary.
The same is true for the real-world Guam. She has found time in her busy schedule to learn and improve, and she is now as good a secretary as any.
You really put your all into your pursuits, don't you?
Not really? I just do whatever feels right. It's spontaneous, and that's how I like it.
And what I feel is right is getting better and better until I'm as good a secretary as I am in the show!
Come on, you're just saying that. I've obviously still got A LOT to learn.
Which is to say, please let me keep working as your secretary so I can prove myself!
I want to become the number one secretary in your heart, and I'm gonna practice my butt off until then!
So, if tomorrow you see some room for improvement, don't be afraid to let me know!

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Secret Spot</size>

scripts.say: While taking a stroll through the port in the nice, warm sunshine, I noticed Illustrious up ahead of me.
Though I was wondering if she was going to head to the Royal Navy's dorms, I instead saw her pass it by and head somewhere else.
Curious about her destination, I decided to follow her.
Walking up along a narrow path, I arrived at a breathtaking place that offered a panoramic view of the port.
Oh my. Commander?
You must have followed me here without my noticing. It would have been nice if you had called out to me...
"Sorry... I followed you without thinking."
I found this place a few days ago. It's my new favourite secret spot.
I'm sure that you already know that Her Highness, myself, and the others partake in tea parties from time to time.
I was thinking that I'd really like to hold the next tea party at this beautiful location.
"That's a great idea," I told her. Upon hearing this, she gave me a cute smile.
Hearing you say that makes me very happy. Well then, I suppose I should start making preparations for it!
Saying that, she turned to head off. However, I spotted a tree root sticking out right where her foot was.

options.content: Rush to her side before she hurts herself.

scripts.say: *boing*
Th-thank you, Commander. I'm kind of a klutz, so this happens a lot...
While her body was still glued to mine, Illustrious gave me an inquisitive look.
...Commander?
Because I knew I couldn't stay like this forever, I calmed my beating heart and let her go.
It'll be lunchtime soon. Shall we return? The others might be wondering where we are.
Differently from how we arrived, the two of us left her secret spot together, descending the slope in a single-file line.

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Consultation</size>

scripts.say: When I exited the office after finishing up all of my work, Illustrious was waiting for me at the door.
Good afternoon, Commander.
I believe I told you about my desire to hold a tea party at the secret spot we visited together yesterday.
Won't you come join us, Commander?
Gladly accepting her proposal, I asked if there was anything I could help out with.
I'd be overjoyed to have you help me, but... wouldn't it be a hassle for you?
I told her it wouldn't be a problem. That settled, we started to look for things we'd need for the tea party.
Though we struggled for a bit, in the end, we were able to bring a white table and some chairs up the slope to the secret spot.
This was more back-breaking work than I had thought. Exhausted, the two of us both leaned back into the chairs we had brought.
It seemed like Illustrious was deep in thought.
Oh, I'm sorry... It's just that, a while ago, Ms. Littorio sent me a letter inviting me to dinner.
However, I was very busy at that time, so I forgot to send her a response. I'm worried about what I should do now...

options.content: Why don't you invite her to the tea party?

scripts.say: Invite her to the tea party...? Oh, why, that's a wonderful idea!
Ah, the letter also said that she wished to speak with Formidable as well, so I relayed the message to her, but...
"I appreciate the invitation, but on that day, I have plans to rock in my– Err, enjoy some music."
...Is the reason she said she couldn't be in attendance.
I really wanted her to come to the tea party, but... I'm sure she really likes the new craze. That's why I think it'll be really hard to get her to come...
I told Illustrious that I'd help her write a response to Littorio and try to convince Formidable to attend.
Hehe. You're a really nice person, Commander.
Well, if you'd be so kind...
Illustrious seemed to feel more relaxed as she pulled her chair up next to mine. My heart started to pound as I noticed that Illustrious was so close that our shoulders were about to touch.
For my letter to Ms. Littorio, I should start off by apologising for my late response... right?
While praying fervently that she couldn't hear my heart exploding in my chest, I thought about how Illustrious should respond.

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 3 - An Unexpected Disaster?</size>

scripts.say: After finishing writing the letters, I escorted Illustrious back to the Royal Navy's dorms.
A member of the Royal Maids will be setting the tableware for the tea party. Is there anything else we need to do?
G-good afternoon! What are you two talking about...?
Unicorn, who had just been passing by, came up to us with a curious look on her face.
Oh! I'd love to get your thoughts too, Unicorn.
Illustrious told Unicorn about how she was planning a tea party to be held at her beautiful secret spot.
Preparing for a tea party? I want to help out too...
Oh, come to think of it. We didn't bring a parasol to block out the sun.
I think I saw one at the storehouse earlier!
Unicorn guided us to the storehouse. Inside were a variety of parasols with different designs, all stored away.
The table and chairs we're going to be using are all white, so let's look for a white one.
Everyone split up to look for a white parasol.
All of these don't fit well enough... It'd be nice if there was a high-quality one...
Eek!
When I turned toward the source of the noise, Unicorn was swaying unsteadily on top of a ladder propped in front a shelf.
Unicorn! When did you manage to get up so high?!
Nobody had been watching out for each other. It was probably because everyone was so absorbed in their search.
The moment Illustrious and I rushed over to help her, Unicorn lost her balance and fell off the ladder.
...Nooo!
...Y-you caught me...?
Fortunately, I caught Unicorn just in the nick of time as she fell off the ladder. I breathed a sigh of relief.
Illustrious had supported the falling ladder so it didn't crash into the floor, and thus, we somehow made it.
Are you alright, Unicorn?
I-I'm sorry, you two... There was a really nice parasol up at the top...
No, it's our fault for not being careful. But make sure you're not reckless like this next time, you hear?
Illustrious stroked Unicorn's hair gently.
Her expression was full of affection, as if Unicorn were her real sister.

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Heart-pounding Intimacy?!</size>

scripts.say: The parasol Unicorn had spotted was indeed a very fancy one. We should hurry up and put it to use.
Umm, can I help out?
It seemed safe enough, so I decided to let her help out.
We did it!
After successfully setting the parasol inside the table, Unicorn sat down on a chair next to her.
She must be happy that she was able to help out. She's quite the reserved one, but I could tell that much.
Hehe, Unicorn seems very happy. It's almost like she hadn't been feeling downhearted at all just a bit earlier.
Illustrious looked at Unicorn gleefully, then sat down next to me.
She's such a lovely child. Sometimes it feels like she's my real sister. Though, I do worry that I'm not a very good sister to her...
As long as I can cover for her shortcomings while she's still a young girl, that's enough for me...
Even so, I'm sure that Unicorn trusts you and depends on you.
You're always so nice, Commander. Heehee~
Illustrious showed me a dazzling, pure smile. Staring at it made me a bit embarrassed, so I turned away from her.
What else was there to do... Right, we need to make sure to prepare some cups as well...
...Commander?
When Illustrious saw me stretching my arms, she looked down at the ground with dejection.
...Of course you'd be exhausted, after carrying so many heavy things all day.
Um, would you like it if I gave a light massage?
Acceding to my pounding heart, I accepted Illustrious's unexpected proposal.
Then, if you don't mind, please come over here.
Though I was immensely nervous when I felt the sensation of Illustrious's fingers intertwined with mine, I let go of her hand slowly,
I let go of her hand and sat down. Just then, I felt Illustrious place her hands on my shoulders.
This is my first time massaging someone's shoulders, so it may not feel that good...
As she doesn't have her rigging equipped, she may not be able to put as much strength into her massage as she hoped.
Here we go... Mmn... How does it feel?
Honestly, my brain didn't even register that as a massage.
The only sensation I felt was that of something soft hitting my back, over and over again...
Mgh... Ahh... Hrmh... Commander, am I using the right amount of force...?
Fearing her massage would energize me in the wrong way if this continued, I decided to hastily excuse myself.

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Little Sister's Opinion</size>

scripts.say: It's been a bit since Illustrious went to the Royal Maids' headquarters to give them the cups they would use during the tea party...
Just as I was getting bored out of my mind, I heard someone's voice from near the foot of the hill.
I see, so this is where you're planning on holding your tea party~
Standing next to Illustrious was her little sister, Victorious.
Hello there, Commander. My sister just told me about this place and it sounded interesting, so I had her bring me over.
How is it, Victorious? Don't you think I've found quite the spectacular place?
Well, it certainly has a nice view, but... aren't the two of you forgetting about something veeery important?
Something important? What could that be...?
You're forgetting that the road that leads to a beautiful place should be beautiful as well!
The road to this hill just won't do. It's hard to walk up here because it's covered with branches and fallen leaves.
Now that you mention it...
I always lose my balance when I look down, so I never look at the ground...
Don't brag about how big your knockers are!
Brag... about my... knockers...?
Ugh... You really are something else!
Commander, keep an eye on my sister, would you? Make sure she doesn't fall over when cleaning and such!
Commander, I apologise, but... Would you mind helping me just a bit more?
Of course I had no intention of turning her down. I extended my hand toward her to show my willingness, but...
Commander...?
I was trying to express that we should hurry because the day was getting dark, but she didn't seem to understand that, and looked at my hand with perplexment.
As I was wondering if what I did was really that strange, Illustrious suddenly spoke.
...Okay. Thank you.
Illustrious hesitantly reached for my hand, and wrapped her thin, soft fingers around mine.
Everything was almost ready for the tea party. Knowing that this would soon end, I felt a bit regretful...

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Holding Hands, Once More</size>

scripts.say: Quite some time had passed since we started cleaning...
Commander, look at that! There's such a beautiful sunset.
It was as Illustrious had said. Looking out from the secret spot, the sunset was brilliantly painting the port a bright red.
We had to return to port before it got too dark. There wasn't time to waste.
...And with this, the cleaning is done.
Commander, thank you so much for staying with me all day today.
I'm sure this tea party will be the best there ever was. Really, I'm so grateful for all you've done.
Illustrious feels a bit weird, just like earlier... Kind of like she's restraining herself...
Well, let us return now.
When Illustrious declared that and started to walk, her foot got caught by the same tree root she was caught by yesterday...
Ah...
Having lost her balance completely, she broke into a trot.
"Commander, make sure you take good care of my sister. Make sure she doesn't fall over when cleaning and such!"
I need to make it... Worrying about Illustrious, I flew over to where Illustrious was.
*boing*
Commander?!
Because I had focused only on bolting to her side, I ended up holding Illustrious in a tighter embrace than the previous day.
Th-thank you...
Tripping not just once, but twice on it... It'd be good to take care of that tree root...
Illustriously softly broke free from my grasp. Her cheeks were dyed a deep red from the sunset.
...No, I wonder if they really were dyed from the sunset.
Commander, um...
Since it's evening, the shadows cast by the trees are going to make it hard to see what's on the ground.
If it's alright with you... can we hold hands like earlier...?
Without even thinking for a moment about saying no, I gave her my hand. Illustrious, who seemed to be a bit embarrassed, grabbed it gently.
Slowly matching her pace, I continued to escort her down the hill.

sequence:
A Lady's Modest Proposal

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Our Special Spot</size>

scripts.say: It was the day of the tea party.
While there were many troubles along the way, we were able to successfully host a tea party at the secret spot Illustrious found.
I'm enthralled to be invited to an elegant tea party like this by a beautiful signorina such as yourself. The scenery here is truly wonderful.
Hehe... Hood just complimented me on finding this parasol. I'm so happy.
Seriously, I'm still impressed by how beautiful the port looks from up here.
I mean, the path's been cleared up and all. I think we should continue to have tea parties here from time to time in the future. How about it?
The secret spot Illustrious had found received a storm of positive reactions.
The black tea and neatly lined-up sweets were all tasty as well. It was satisfying to see everyone enjoying themselves.
It felt as if I had just completed a big task. Wanting to be alone for a bit, I separated from the group.
While I was looking down at the wide view of the port, Illustrious came to my side.
There's no wind today and the sea looks so calm.
It's wonderful weather, without even a single cloud. The transparent, azure sea is so still... I had never thought that the weather would be this great on the day of the tea party.
This is the image of peace, that which I love the most.
I can hear the relaxing sound of waves from the sea, sparkling beneath the sun's rays.
Commander...
Our gazes meet. Neither of us say a word, we simply grasp each other's hands.
Commander, you always grasp my hands so gently. And... you're always so warm...
Um... If you don't mind, could you spare some time to come to this place with me again? Just the two of us...
This time, it won't be to prepare for a tea party. I'd like you... to tell me more about yourself.
Saying that, Illustrious graced me with an angelic smile.
Hehe. Let's talk about other things too. I... have many things about myself that I wish to tell you.
I'm sure... If it's the two of us, we'll have so much to talk about that we won't have enough time for it all.
And that means we'll have to revisit this place, time and time again.
This beautiful and peaceful place. Our secret spot...

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Her Name is Glorious</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Royal Navy aircraft carrier Glorious, reporting in. I have been assigned to serve as your secretary ship!
Commander, I will do everything in my power to meet your expectations. I await your orders!
I won't make the same mistake I did before. I will not let my guard down this time!
一A Short Time Later——
Let's see what's on the schedule for this afternoon... Y-... Yes, of course! Exercises! I'll be participating as well!
The supplementary materiel... Should have been delivered. I had Ardent go and confirm for me everything is in order... Hmm... I'm unsure...
Yes, I've already put all of these documents in order! Indeed, yes, they're all here! ...The report from the Narvik operation? Um, er, I can't quite remember, I think it's done...
(whispering) Come on, Glorious, get it together. Show some of that Royal Navy glory...! You're the most storied ship of all...!
No, no I'm not nervous! ...Here, I found it! The Narvik report!
The report was clearly complete, why didn't she remember it...?
You've clearly mistaken me for the Glorious from that fateful operation. While I understand your concern, I—
I am that Glorious, and at the same time, she is not me.
For the glory of the Royal Navy, I have been reborn as a new Glorious, and likewise, I will earn the greatest glory for you, Commander!
*sparkle*
Glorious seemed to shine with her own radiant glory.

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Maritime Exercises</size>

scripts.say: Home Waters - Exercise Field
All right, once again, today's exercise is an Eagle Union versus Royal Navy aircraft carrier practical exercise. The object is to strike all the Manjuu-piloted targets.
Roger! You Eagle Union ships are so well-versed in the practical uses of the aircraft carrier. I'm looking forward to learning from you!
You got it! Let Saratoga show you just what it means to be an aircraft carrier ♪
Hehehe, Professor Saratoga's class is in session~
First send out some reconnaissance planes to locate the... Glorious?!
While I may have fewer planes, I'll simply bring my 15-inch guns to bear on the... Oh? I'm an aircraft carrier...
Aie, what am I doing out front by myself?!
Glorious, you've rushed out too quickly!
Several Hours Later
All planes recovered! How about that? Saratoga does it again! Let's see you call me "Drydock Idol" now!
Huh... Are you okay, Glorious?
F- I'm fine! I've finally sunk all the targets!
A bit touch and go there, wasn't it...
Apologies, I didn't mean to be a bother...
By the way, did Ark Royal ever show? She told me she'd be coming a little late today...

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 3 - The Queen Incident Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Sorry to bother you, Commander. I'm just worried about Ark Royal...
... Oh, there she is!!
I'm innocent, Commander! I was only concerned for the welfare of the little destroyer sisters going out on commission, so of course I sneaked off to escort them. I certainly wasn't stalking Warspite!
I believe her, Ark Royal wouldn't do something so ignoble...
Silence! I saw it! Your sick smile. You were skulking around right behind Warspite!
I'm telling you, it had nothing to do with Warspite, I was after... I was escorting the destroyers behind her!
If Your Majesty would permit a maid's suggestion, I believe we might investigate Ark Royal's pretext and determine its veracity...
There is no need! This is circumstantial evidence! Not to mention your typical unseemly conduct, I cannot let this stand!
Commander! This, this isn't right! You must see!
What troublesome thing had we stumbled upon...

options.content: Maintain a safe distance and continue watching.

scripts.say: ... Your Majesty, please!
Glorious?!
I can prove Ark Royal is innocent!

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 4 - The Queen Incident Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: As for how I intend to prove Ark Royal's innocence, my case stands on three legs——
First: Ark Royal originally intended to join our aircraft carrier exercises, and found herself sharing the path with the recently returned commission team, making it trivial for her to escort them.
Second: Had Ark Royal truly intended to tail Lady Warspite, there is no way the Grand Old Lady would not have been able to perceive her actions.
Lastly we have the question of motive... I firmly believe Ark Royal is a straightforward and upright individual, without a wicked bone in her body!
Huh.
Huh.
Huh.
Huuh?!
Glorious... You...
I know what it's like to have little ones you care about, like little sisters to— No, they're even more important to me than a little sister.
So I fully understand Ark Royal's impulse to cherish and protect the destroyers as one would a precious flower!
“Complete the Mission and Leave No Man Behind”— Such is the duty of the battle fleet, and our core virtue in the Royal Navy!
No doubt Ark Royal also keeps to these lofty ideals, and in this case she must have strove to spare Lady Warspite's pride from harm!
Hrm, hmph! Very well! Considering the lack of evidence, I suppose I'll let you off today! Get out of my sight, Ark Royal!
Bless Your Majesty's wisdom.
Haha! I can't thank you enough, Glorious!
Think nothing of it! Only a trifle. ... It was my pleasure to see you get off, Ark Royal.
It was the beginning of a beautiful friendship (?).

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Destroyers</size>

scripts.say: Port - Workshop
We received a request from Akashi to go to the workshop and sort through the stockpiled materiel and equipment.
Acasta, quit slacking off and come help! We promised to help Glorious, didn't we?!
Uuuughhh... I'm doing it... it's just really dusty over here...
Hold up, I'll clean over there myself. Ardent and Acasta, you check these items against the manifest please.
I feel like Glorious is just doing everything herself... We came here to help, but is this helping...?
Don't worry about it. This place was always very dusty, I'll take care of it. And of course, the Commander will help me.
You sure you'll be okay, Glorious? There's a lot to do here.

options.content: Glorious and I can handle it ourselves.
Why don't you two stay and help.

scripts.say: We're fine. Listen to the Commander.
But...
Just let the Commander take care of it. Ardent, finish that up and let's head back.
Commander, they have things to do. We can take care of this ourselves...
It's fine! We came here to help you to begin with, Glorious...
Over here, Ardent... (whispering) ... Sure, we'll go take care of that.
Thank you very much. ... All right, Commander, let's get to work!

While the work itself wasn't terribly difficult, it did involve a lot of pieces of big equipment. It was a bit much even for an aircraft carrier like Glorious. ...I had a feeling there really wasn't much the destroyers could do.
Rrrrghh... S-so heavy... Ahh... Aaahhh...
Are you okay, Glorious...?

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 6 - The Glory She's Named For Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Haah... Now that that's done with...
We had reached about the halfway point when an exhausted Glorious leaned against a huge rig to catch her breath.

options.content: Thanks for your hard work, Glorious.
Wordlessly offer her a cup of coolant.

scripts.say: Th-thank you! Sorry I'm not being very helpful...
Huh? Are you trying to tell me you think you should have asked more people to help?
You can't do that! Everyone's busy preparing for battle. That's so much more important!
In fact, I didn't even want Ardent or Acasta coming to help. Not that they listen to me...
Of course, I'm not forcing anything...
I seem tired to you? Hm... Well, what can I say...?
As the Royal Navy's Glorious aircraft carrier, the one everyone has come to rely on, such is my burden to bear, is it not?!
Glorious was doing everything she could to put on a brave face. But—
Aye! Glorious, awaiting orders, Commander! Without hesitation, I execute your will!
“Stop fronting”...? That's... an order, Commander? ... But...
... I've always been so clumsy, I'm totally useless in battle, it's all I can do to make sure I'm not holding everyone else back!
But if that's an order, Commander... Then...!

sequence:
A Glorious Interlude

<size=45>Chapter 7 - The Glory She's Named For Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: As she saw it, the most important thing was for her to be the bringer of victory, the "Glorious" that everyone could depend on. But—
“At least stop fronting when I'm alone with the Commander.” You mean...
You think I can't become your pride, your glory, then...?
That's not what I said.
Then... What should I do...?
I shine my glory before the others, but when I'm with you, I don't have to...?
... Woah...
I took her hand and pulled her to the seat next to me.
The truth was, I had sent a message off to the others that they should come over to help out once they finished their meeting.
That means, when I'm with the Commander, I can be weak, I can be vulnerable, I can be unreliable, I can pout—
This way, I can keep shining my glory before all the others—
Can a clumsy and careless Glorious still be the Commander's glory?
There was a trembling in Glorious's voice.
I understand. It is an order from the Commander, after all—
She relaxed her grip on my hand and on my shoulder I felt the weight of a young girl.
Orders received, Commander. ... As your glory, I-I'm going to indulge myself for a bit.
Do you mind... if I take a little rest... Before the others get here?
The soft sounds of her peaceful sleep echoed throughout the empty workshop…
Alabama, turn just a little more outward for me... Yeah, that's it!
Ready, Takao? Then let's see your most confident, stylish look!
Ooh... Looking good! This will do great!
Everyone, your attention, please! The photoshoot for the Commander's exclusive and private fashion mag has officially started!
Niiice! Great poses all around, folks.
I step into the photo studio, where I catch sight of Alfredo hurriedly issuing commands while rapidly changing camera angles.
Hmm... Something's missing. I dunno what, considering every minute detail should be perfect...
Chien Wu, standing beside her, furrows her brow with contemplation.
Have a look over there. That's the missing element.
Not interrupting your photoshoot, am I?
Oh! Commander! Amazing timing! Have a look-see at the pics I took!
Being the port's top journalist, I have no doubt in my ability to take incredible photos... Still, something feels off about 'em.
Yes. It's unlikely that the composition or poses are the issue...
What do you think it could be, Commander?
Alfredo hands me her camera, so I look at her pictures. The models look fantastic under the lights, and each one is brimming with natural and distinctive grace.
Oh... Commander. I think I've figured it out.
Of what do you speak?
Since this is goin' into a private mag, shouldn't we show what's beneath, too?
Hot diggety! That's it! When you're too focused on the looks, it's easy to miss what you were supposed to capture in the first place!
By "what's beneath," surely you don't mean to suggest...
Need a hand?
Ah!
Takao softly bites her lip. Bracing herself, she grabs the rim of her shirt and quickly lifts it up.
Impressed by her swiftness, I press the camera shutter and snap a picture.
Nice one!
C-Commander?! I did not expect you to photograph me... Heavens above, I am embarrassed...
Don't say that. You look great.
Let's hear it from the designer herself! Would you agree that the Commander's photo is perfect?
Chien Wu casts her gaze on the picture. Her lips curve into a knowing smile.
This should easily be the magazine's cover image.
Heheh! I think we all agree this is what we were looking for!
You must've been a photographer in your past life, Commander! You captured the perfect moment.
I just took the picture when I felt it was right.
No need to be so humble! It takes a keen sense to get the absolute perfect timing.
Heck, you should be the one holding the camera! The rest of the photoshoot is yours!
Not a bad idea. I'll prepare all the outfits in advance, and... Wait, are you sure you're up for this, Commander?
On one hand, it's more meaningful for you to take the photos yourself, since this magazine is meant just for you. On the other hand...
Don't sweat it – I'm happy to help. Just wondering, though, why'd you decide on this particular theme?
Well, a certain someone has been selling this type of fashion lately, and I got my hands on an order form with some reference pictures.
To be blunt, none of the designs I saw could be considered passable.
So, as a designer, I felt it necessary to let my own work speak for itself, and also to present you with some actually worthy outfits.
Interesting...
Right, then! Let's take some more pics, Commander!
I just know you'll have no problem bringing out the best in all these models!
Meanwhile, unbeknownst to everyone there, the infamous green cat was eavesdropping on the conversation through a gap in the photo studio door.
Nyahaha... This is going even better than I imagined, nya...
This whole special magazine was just an excuse to pin down the Commander's tastes, and now the person in question is personally taking the photos, nya!
Now they just have to place orders based on the special-edition designs, and then...
I'm gonna be swimming in money, nya! Fortune, come to mama, nya!
A few days later, Chien Wu hands me the completed photo collection.
The coated paper beautifully displays everybody's pictures.
Take a look, Commander. Every photo you took is documented in here.
They run the gamut from complex elegance to perfect simplicity. Which one tugs at your heartstrings the most?
As I flip through the pages, an answer forms in my mind.
They're all wonderful, but I can't pick a single one. It's not the product, but every little moment that went into making them.
Because there's beauty in the raw, genuine feelings behind each one.
It's the resonance between designer and model that drives pure beauty.
In short, instead of obsessing over the perfect design, it's better to find the best way to show off each combination.
Hehe. Thanks to you, Commander, I've learned a valuable lesson today.
Outside the window, the setting sun casts a veil of gold across the port.
Thus ends my photographic journey for now, but Chien Wu's exploration of fashion design has only just begun.
Meanwhile, in Akashi's warehouse...
This can't be... I can't believe this is happening, nya!
Why aren't they selling at all, nya?!
It's supposed to be an untapped market, nya! I did so much research all over the port, and I promoted everybody's designs, nya...
And the Commander even photographed them, nya!
Why? Why haven't I sold a single outfit, nya?
Could it be... that the demand just isn't there, nya?
...The waters of my mind are calming.
So you really are here, Commander.
You have my thanks for personally coming to my photo session.
Francesco Caracciolo, sitting idly in front of the couch, slowly turns to face me. Her soft skin under the lamplight radiates a faint glow.
I've heard that a picture lies bare one's true self...
One thing I do wonder is how I reflect in the lens of your eye.
However... This is my first time doing a photoshoot such as this.
Can I ask of you to guide me through it?
Don't stress over it – you'll be fine. Let's start with a few test pictures, shall we?
Of course... What should I do?
We could try a different pose. Just sit on the floor and lean against the couch... Yeah, that's it.
Now tilt your head a little further to the left... Oh, that's too much. Go back a little.
Is this... adequate?
Yeah. That's a great angle.
Through the camera's viewfinder, I place Francesco in the center of the frame. Her taut clothes follow the contours of her body, outlining her soft curves.
Ah... Having your gaze upon me... It makes my heart throb harder than I'd thought...
Try to relax. Imagine that it's a regular, quiet afternoon, and we're just having a chat as usual.
Relax your muscles and try to find the most comfortable pose for you.
Despite the jitter of hesitation in her eyes, she does as I ask and slowly stretches out her legs. The tips of her round toes gently touch me.
As usual...
May I... be open with you, Commander?
I think I understand what you're saying.
She gives me a knowing nod, and I raise my camera in readiness to capture her relaxed, natural self.
Before I can do that, though, something happens that throws me for a loop.
She slowly raises the hem of her sweater. Bit by bit, the soft fabric slips away from her waist, revealing her delicate skin.
Commander... I wish for you to see it...
My truer self...
As the fabric rustles, she raises the hem again until eventually the cloth is all piled up on her chest.
Although her cheeks are red, her gaze is unwavering as she stares right at me.
Commander... Do you see my true feelings now?
Snap goes the shutter. My fingers act on instinct and take the picture.
Through this angle, through this pose...
I wish to convey my feelings that words fail to.
Are they reaching you, I wonder?
If they do... then could you take some pictures closer up?
Shall I... assume a more intimate pose?
I want to leave a deeper imprint upon your heart.
Before the curtain of night falls... allow me to offer you the pure, untainted truth.
Ooohohoho! You've finally come, dearest Commander!
Your personal model has been waiting for you!
Like a butterfly gracefully fluttering past, Alberto leads me into her own little world.
Welcome to my studio! I took this dressing room and redecorated it a little. Heheh – it's quite marvelous, wouldn't you agree?
I have a challenge worthy of an expert such as yourself – can you capture the endless possibilities within this limited space and lighting?
Naturally, a fantastic reward awaits you, should you accept this challenge.
Now, kindly direct your attention to these! My secret weapons, carefully chosen to stir a throbbing in your heart!
She points at a collection of various garments neatly hung on the clothes rack.
Their delicate lacing outlines their refined silhouettes, and their see-through chiffons offer a suitable amount of glamour.
Today, I shall don an outfit so alluring that you'll be unable to take your eyes off me, and you shall photograph me!
Ah, but before we do that, may I propose a little wager between us?
The wager is this: I bet that I will make your heart throb today!
If I win, you must follow me anywhere I go tomorrow as my personal attendant.
And if I win?
In that event... Yours truly, graceful and charming, shall accompany you through a perfect day by anyone's metric!
Isn't that basically the same thing?
No, not at all! There is a world of difference between leading and following! The loser is obliged to politely fulfill all the wishes of the winner, you see.
She twirls on her toes, picks out two pieces of clothing, and holds them up to her chest, looking at me with an impish glint.
Pray tell, what do you think of these two? The blue makes my skin look brighter and further highlights my grace, doesn't it?
Or perhaps your heart sings more at the sight of the purple one?
Heehee... You're already picturing how I'd look in each, aren't you?
The choice is yours, dearest Commander. Which one do you most wish to see me wear?
She stares at me with a broad smile. A smile more full of light and love than even she herself realizes.
Subconsciously, I raise my camera to capture her – and this heart-throbbing moment – through the lens.
CLICK!
Pardon? Are we photographing already? You haven't even given me an answer yet!
They both look wonderful. I can't pick one over the other.
As wonderful as they both are, the thing I love the most is your smile.
M-my smile? Oh...
You silly goose, you! I suppose I'll forgive your surprise picture in light of that.
However, your heart just throbbed a little, did it not? It must have!
Ooohohoho! In other words, I am the winner of this wager!
For the entirety of tomorrow, you are to obey my every command!
Heheh... Would you mind assisting me with tidying up this photography equipment? Kindly think of it as practice for tomorrow!
Or... perhaps you'd rather make a wager to see who can tidy up first?
She walks up to me and whispers in an enchanting tone.
Let's say the winner gets to tell the loser to do any one thing they wish for. Yes, I mean ANYTHING. How's that, hmm?
I arrive at the set prepared for Ugolino. It's a room that has been decorated warmly.
At the center of it, several eye-catching claw machines have been set up, each one filled with various stuffed animals.
Ugolino stands in front of one of them, her hands gently placed on the glass as she stares intently inside.
Which one do you want? I'll get it for you.
Eep! C-Commander...
No, I couldn't ask you to... I just kind of... Um... Sh-should we start the photo session?
Although she brushes off my offer, I can see her eyes are fixated on a pink stuffed rabbit.
It's no biggie. Besides, I wanna test if I've got the skill to get one.
Well, in that case... Please try to be careful. This machine doesn't look too healthy.
Guessing you mean it's prone to breaking. Don't worry, I'll be gentle.
I insert a coin, operate the control stick, and then push the button. The claw descends right on target, firmly grasping the pink bunny... only to drop it as it rises back up.
Aww! So close!
It's not over yet. One more try.
A second attempt, a third attempt... a tenth attempt – every time, it drops it right at the last moment.
Ugolino's expression gradually turns more and more dour, with little wrinkles forming on her brow.
Commander, I'm convinced that the claw is sick. Allow me to examine it.
She takes out her stethoscope, skillfully opens the machine's unlocked door, and carefully slips into the pile of stuffed animals.
You could just... do that?
It's an examination, I assure you! Hmm... Yes, it really does seem to be sick. I need to treat it at once.
Let's see... There's an issue with the arm's joint. That must be why it couldn't get a good grip on the cute little bunny.
There, all better now!
Commander, can you give it another try?
I press the button again. The claw slowly descends again and grasps not a stuffed animal, but Ugolino's left hand.
Huh? Wh-why did it grab me?
Gently, the claw rises, carrying her wrist with it.
Unlike last time, however, the claw refuses to let go.
C-Commander, what's going on?
Are you saying that... it was actually me you wanted to get?
Yeah. Looks like your treatment worked like a charm.
It's a spectacular sight – as the claw holds her wrist in the air, she has a look of confusion in her eyes, and her cheeks are faintly flushed.
I raise my camera and press the shutter before she has time to process anything.
This isn't a great time for pictures, Commander!
Immediately after the click of the shutter, the claw loosens its grip and lets go of her.
Before I even look at the photo, I rush over to her. As she falls into my arms, she looks up at the swaying claw in a puzzled manner.
Um, thank you?
It felt kind of like... you captured me just now, and...
It did spook me a little on one hand, but on the other...
It also made me vaguely happy. Heehee.
In truth, I've always wanted that... For you to "catch" me.
I want to mean something special to you... To be that unique person in your camera lens.
If I ever do become that... my heart will be filled with joy♪
Takao strikes a pose in front of a plain background in the photo studio.
Ready to get started?
Understood. I am ready.
As soon as I raise the camera and turn the lights on, she gets straight into character.
With each snap of the shutter, she deftly changes poses. In one moment, she crosses her arms; in the next, she faces away with a defiant turn of the neck. However...
Takao, stop for a moment.
Commander? Are my poses lacking?
You're doing great, but I feel like you're pushing yourself.
...So you realized. I sprained my ankle during this morning's practice, but it shouldn't affect the photo shoot...
Let's continue. My training is not over yet.
...You think maintaining my health is part of training? Hmm. There is some logic to that...
Takao hesitates for a moment, but then she sits down.
If you don't mind... Commander, would you please check on my ankle?
Ah! Commander, your fingers...
I-it's nothing. It just... feels odd... being touched through my tights as such.
Hyah! N-not there... Nkh...
I-I'm sorry for yelping all of a sudden! An obvious issue of self-control...
All you're doing is massaging me, but for some reason... my breath is suddenly ragged...
Ah... Y-you're rubbing my foot so forcefully...
It's tingling... all the way up my calves... I-I've never experienced such training...
Ah! I-I'm sorry, Commander! My ineptitude has troubled you far too much!
But I do feel much better now...
Wanna rest a little longer?
D-do not worry for me. I can continue the shoot now.
No. Rest a little longer. I just had a great idea.
She happens to be sitting right in front of the snow-white background. There's an unusually soft look on her flushed face.
*snap!*
Commander! You didn't tell me how to pose...
It's okay. I wanted to capture your real charms.
I turn the camera toward Takao, showing her natural and gentle expression.
Is this... how I look when I'm relaxed?
That's enough training for today. When you get home, take a well-earned break.
Yes, Commander. Say...
If it's no trouble... would you help me train tomorrow, too?
When I go into Alabama's studio, I find her carefully adjusting the lights.
Hmm... Maybe a little closer to the camera would make it feel softer...
She takes a step back. When her back bumps into me, she suddenly stops.
Commander?
Great timing. Can you help me check the lighting?
It looks great to me. A little more soft lighting on the right, and I think it would be perfect.
Gotcha.
She nods. Then, for some reason, she hooks a finger around her stockings and begins pulling them down.
Why are you stripping now, exactly?
I figure... these stockings aren't exactly the focus of this shoot... There.
Let's do one with them on first. They might help guide the eyes better.
You think so?
She tilts her head in thought.
After pulling the half-removed stockings back up, she smooths out the wrinkles.
So what you're saying is... guiding the viewer's eyes with them would help highlight the main attraction?
Alabama turns slightly to let the light hit the patterns on the fabric.
Mm... The light's nice and warm. Feels like my stockings could melt right off.
Do you need me to slide closer so you can get a better look, Commander?
You're fine just as you are.
She poses naturally under the soft light. With each move, I quietly click the shutter.
Before long, the sun sets. Alabama stretches and lets out a sigh.
Phew... It's hot in here. Lend me a hand, Commander?
I put my hand on hers. With my support, she takes a step forward.
The distance between us suddenly closes so much that I can feel her body heat.
Commander... Is this angle better?
Would I be out of focus? Okay... How about this?
Before I can answer, she places the camera on the tripod, sets a timer, takes my hand, and guides me into the light.
Stay still, Commander. Let's take one together.
Following her lead, I place my hand on her waist.
She lifts her leg slightly and peels her stockings down once more.
It's a two-shot, so you and I are the focus now.
No need to guide the viewer's eyes, no need for emphasis... Just you and me...
With her stockings pulled past her knees, she leans into my arms.
Mind taking them off for me, Commander?
This photo's all about you and me, in each other's embrace...
I arrive at Chien Wu's studio. The door is slightly ajar, giving me a glimpse of her hunched over her desk.
Her pencil glides softly across paper, sketching out perfect curves.
Come here instead of staring blankly at the door. I already know you're there.
Did you bring the coffee I asked for? Oh... I suppose there are more important matters at hand.
She stands up, seizes me by the wrist, and leads me under the soft overhead lighting of the studio.
To design the perfect garment, I need timely and frank feedback.
Behold my latest creation... I call it Shadow of Light Carved.
She raises her hands, showing me the design of her perfectly form-fitting outfit.
Pay extra attention to how the curves guide your eyes, highlighting the model's figure while preserving a sense of mystery.
I'd like you to rate it on a scale from one to ten.
It's such an incredible design that I struggle to rate it. Can you show me more... details?
Oh? Hehe... I see.
No worries. Look all you want... At the design, or at me.
Chien Wu twists to the side, stretching the fabric alongside her to outline her curves.
Her lips curl into a meaningful smile.
By the way, Commander, do you know the three most important elements of clothing design?
Form, color, and... material?
Wrong. The correct answer would be model, model, and finally, model.
She punctuates this incredible revelation with a slow sip of coffee.
Truly great fashion is more than just decoration. It must awaken the wearer's unique temperament, charm, and at times... desire, as well.
However, this all requires that it be worn by the perfect model.
Do you understand what I mean?
What you're saying is, my rating should be influenced by your appearance?
As a smug look creeps onto her face...
*snap!*
Well done. You now understand the true essence of design, Commander.
I hereby dub this photo "The Designer and the Three Elements."
Not bad. In return...
Chien Wu takes a single step closer to me and gleefully observes my reaction.
Now, I'd like you to observe this design from another angle.
I need more comprehensive feedback, after all... Perhaps your thoughts on the fabric's texture, too?
Wait, you want me to touch you?
Of course.
As a photographer, your job is more than just to observe. You have to truly immerse yourself in your subject.
Now, feel the texture of the fabric... Its elasticity... The heat beneath, as well.
What's your score, Commander?
There's no need to rush your conclusion. Take as much time as you need, and then give me your final answer.
Tripod stability and optical calibration confirmed. Equipment in optimal condition...
All that's left is to verify that the shooting is done.
But only the Commander can do that...
You called?
Nakhimov's cables perk up. She spins around to face me, nearly dropping the tools in her hands.
Oh... Commander.
Shall we begin?
Yeah. Let's decide on a composition first.
I was practicing some placements and poses based on my past photo shoot experience.
She stands in front of the backdrop and clasps her hands in front of her, taking a rather stiff pose.
I click the shutter. When the flash goes off, she flinches slightly.
The flash... is a little bright.
I'm fine, though. Continue.
Mm... Sorry, my pose is off again...
Ah. Did I blink? Okay... I'll try not to this time.
Every time the flash goes off, Nakhimov squints and recoils away from it. It's getting difficult to make much headway.
How about a quick break?
Is my performance not up to snuff? Or does the equipment need to be tuned?
You're doing fine, and the equipment is fine.
I just want to help you in case you're nervous. Don't worry.
I head over to the equipment rack and take out a photography guide.
What is this?
The Thirty-Six Stratagems of Photography. Let's give it a try together.
First, the cat... Er, the model should look slightly away from the camera, rather than directly into it.
She nods and turns her head slightly to the side. However, her eyes remain fixed on me.
Like this?
Next... Using a toy to attract the model's attention.
A toy?
I take a feather toy out and wave it around. Her eyes are naturally drawn to it.
Commander... I feel weird...
It's hard to focus... Mmm... Meooow...
Let's try this one, too: keeping the environment quiet and avoiding sudden noises.
Okay... Quiet is more calming.
Suddenly, the photo shoot proceeds as smoothly as butter. Nakhimov's expressions become more natural and relaxed, as well.
When I click the shutter, I capture a perfect moment.
Nice. That'll do it.
Are we done already?
She gazes at me almost sadly. Her eyes then fall on the cover of the guidebook.
Thirty-Six Stratagems of... Cat Photography?
Whoops. Yeah, you got me. It worked, though! Wanna see how the photos came out?
I hand her the camera. Despite her embarrassment, she peeks at the screen.
Oh... They do look good.
Next time... A normal guide would be nice...
Though... Since it's you... I guess I don't mind this special treatment.
After finishing the morning's shoots, I go into the dressing room for a break.
When I reach over to turn the light on, someone suddenly approaches me from behind and pushes me against the wall.
Commandeeer... I finally found yooou...
Mogador presses up against me, wearing nothing but a thin towel.
You promised me... You're gonna take pictures of me today, aren't you?
Er, weren't our plans for this afternoon?
I couldn't bear to wait like a good girl in the studio... All I could hear were machines being prepared for the shoot...
Just imagining you taking pictures of me got me all hot and bothered... I couldn't stop myself from coming to see you.
Plus...
I know what a talented, brilliant photographer like you wants most of all...
No pretense, no artificiality...
Just the most authentic, most attractive moment...
That's the Mogador you want to see, isn't it, Commander?
Her hot breath pours over me as she presses herself even closer to me.
Soft curves stand out beneath her towel, intertwining with her sweet scent and heat.
Come on, Commander... Is your camera ready?
I'm so hot, I can hardly take it anymore...
Mid-sentence, she pinches her towel and slowly peels it away.
Come ooon, Commander...
Take me with that camera of yours... Make this moment yours, all yours...
The white towel slips down the contours of her body. Just before it can reveal something truly intimate, it catches on her arm.
Reflexively, I raise the camera and click the shutter.
*snap!*
The very instant that she reveals everything is burned into the screen of the camera.
Wait... A swimsuit?
That's right! It's our private little gravure shoot... It's sweat-proof, too...
You really thought this through.
Every moment and every angle...
You really do understand me more than anybody else, Commander.
Still... I feel so cramped in this swimsuit...
And our photo shoot is over... Hehe, hehehe...
Mogador reaches behind her back, fumbling for the hooks of her top in hopes of escaping this last restraint. However..
Hmm? Something's stuck...
Every failed attempt only makes her breathing more feverish.
I can't get it off on my own, Commander...
*pant*... *pant*... Sooo hot...
Hehehe... I need your help. Please... Won't you help me?
Yeah... Right there, right there...

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>1 Freeze!</size>

scripts.say: I was back in my office, having just wrapped up a strategy meeting with the Sakura Empire. Upon opening the door, I felt a light breeze brush against my cheek.
The curtains by my desk flapped in the wind. Evidently, I'd forgotten to close the window before I left.
Right after I shut the window, there was a knock-knock on the door.
Do you have a moment, Commander? There was something I forgot to tell you at the meeting.
Kinu entered before I could answer the knocks. I turned around to face her, and that's when I had the life scared out of me.
...Stay still. Hold it right there and don't move a muscle.
Do as I say, or I can't guarantee your safety.
Her face was wrinkled into a ghastly look. Intimidated by her commanding tone, I froze in place almost instinctively.
Good. Now stay right there until I give you the go-ahead.
You're not in danger, it's just there's a wasp resting on your– Hey! I said hold still!
Keep calm and listen to me. I will now walk over to the window. Do not move until I give you permission to.
Beads of cold sweat ran down my body, whereas Kinu was the spitting image of calmness. She came over and quietly threw open the window.
Here is a fact about wasps: if you swing at them, they will perceive you as a threat. But stay still, and they'll do you no harm.
The fact you still moved means you are either a timid lamb, or a tortoise with nerves of steel.
While I did my best statue impression, she gently put a hand to my collar and allowed the wasp to walk onto it.
Now I'm going to send it out through the window. Go on, shoo!
There. All done... It worries me to think a little wasp could get the better of someone in your position.
I mean it when I say this: you need to get stronger. Otherwise, how do you expect to control a demon such as I?
I had to admit she was right. As the commander of a fleet of shipgirls, I must be strong and resolute.

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>2 Differences in Skill</size>

scripts.say: Hah. I didn't expect you'd be on board with the idea right away. How fortunate.
I've yet to do my daily sword practice, which I suspect would be a good starting point for building both your muscle and discipline.
Here we are. First off: do a thousand swings.
...What's with that look? Are you let down because you expected something much more involved?
Worry not. There is more training to be had afterward. Now take this bamboo sword and get started.
Don't tell me you've exhausted yourself already?
My joints were burning with pain after swinging so much. Kinu, meanwhile, was maintaining her form and spacing her breaths well. She hadn't even broke a sweat.
It seems I overestimated your strength. If you can't handle a thousand swings, you definitely can't keep up with the exercises that follow.
...You want to try anyway? Very well. Then let us do a bit of light sparring. En garde!
After taking a minute to catch my breath, I brandished my bamboo sword, mustered all my strength, and engaged Kinu in a duel.
It went just as poorly as one would expect. She either dodged or intercepted almost every strike I made at her.
Hahahah! You lack the skill of a warrior, but you do have the mettle of one. That deserves praise, if nothing else.
...What? You keep staring at me. To what end?
You're... captivated by how pretty I look, maintaining my form and not even breaking a sweat?
Fl-flatter me all you want, but I won't go easy on you just because of it.
I caught a brief glimpse of a blush on her face before she turned around and resumed her sword practice.

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>3 Demons and Men</size>

scripts.say: Kinu told me to meet her at a waterfall just by the mountain situated behind the port. She said it's a good place to meditate.
Meditating beneath a waterfall is a superb way to work up the composure needed to remain unperturbed in the face of any battle.
Oh. Hey there.
Abukuma? What are you doing out here?
What's it look like? Fishing. You're not going under the waterfall, are you, Commander? The water's cold as ice today.
Oh, about that, actually...
Kinu leaned in to whisper into Abukuma's ear. That felt suspicious to me, but nevertheless, I stepped forth and went barefoot into the water.
Listen, Commander: no matter what happens, you musn't be distracted. You cannot allow a repeat of the wasp incident.
Steeling my resolve, I went in beneath the waterfall. The water was freezing cold and crashed into me like a ceaseless tsunami.
Now hold that pose and stay there. Endure the pain, soldier through the cold, and nothing will be able to shake your spirit.
Let me stress this: no matter what happens! Understood?
Kinu emphasizing that specific part made it sound as though she was planning something, which made me raise an eyebrow.
Just don't overdo it, all right, Commander? Also, sorry ahead of time for this.
Hush, Abukuma. Not another word of that.
All right, then... Aw, shucks, I think I've got something big on the hook.
For whatever reason, Abukuma started speaking with a very deadpan tone.
Oh nooo. This is a biiiig big fish. So big I can't reel it in.
Stay focused, Commander.
Heeeelp, Commandeeeer. It's pulling me iiiiin... Here goes.
Abukuma fell into the river. Or rather, it looked more like she jumped in by her own volition. Her "Here goes" sounded especially suspect.
However, I had to do something on the odd chance she wasn't faking it. Stepping out of the waterfall, I waded through the river to help Abukuma.
Wow, uh... I didn't think the commander would fall for that.
Your willingness to come to the rescue of an ally is certainly a virtue. But on the battlefield, it is a weakness that will only make matters worse.
I stood right next to her as she fell in the river. You should've ordered me to jump to her rescue, not do it yourself.
As long as you learn from your mistake, it's no harm done. On a more immediate note: you failed! Start over from the beginning!
(Interesting... I suppose one need not BE a demon to CONTROL a demon...)
Despite the stern look Kinu gave me as she ordered me to start over, I felt she was strangely pleased with my judgment call to help Abukuma.

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>4 One of a Kind</size>

scripts.say: Hmm...
It had been a while since the waterfall training. Every now and then, I would catch Kinu seemingly deep in thought.
One day, I was overcome with curiosity over what she might be thinking about, and I glanced a little too long.
What are you staring at me for, Commander?
She called me out on it. I promptly averted my gaze, but it was too late. She had noticed.
...Oh, I see how it is.
Don't be shy, feast your eyes. What you see is quality. It was made to be gazed at and admired.

options.content: "All right, I'll admit it. I can't take my eyes off–"

scripts.say: My cloak? Yes. It's tailor-made to suit my needs. Come, have a closer look.
See the fabric, the exquisite color, and the little ornaments adorning it? They're all at no cost to practicality or comfort.
Of course, it isn't a full mantle, which makes it ill-suited for cold weather, but that's a small price to pay for this one-of-a-kind masterpiece.
All this is to say: you think it looks cool, don't you?
Her intuition was completely off the mark.
At first, I considered going with it anyway, but decided against it.
I had a feeling she could gush about her cloak for quite some time, so rather than indulge her, I pointed out the need for me to finish my work.
Huh? Oh, of course...
Forgive me, I got carried away there. Ahem...
Just out of curiosity: have you ever considered wearing a cloak? Naturally, you wouldn't look as good in one as I do, but still.
If there is one thing I took away from this exchange, it's that Kinu is strangely talkative when it comes to cloaks...

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>5 Ghosts & Demons</size>

scripts.say: Your swings are starting to shape up. Well done.
However, your spirit is still a far cry from serene... On the other hand, that is one of your strong points as a commander.
At any rate, you've made significant progress since we started. Maybe it's time we put your courage to the test...
Oh... Hey, Kinu. And you too, Commander...
What's wrong, Isuzu? You look as though you've seen a ghost.
You wouldn't believe me even if I told you...
Try me. Whatever has frightened you, I will take care of it.
Well... The thing is, I DID see a ghost...
You did? Where?
In the dorm... I was just dusting the dressing room when a ghost jumped at me out of nowhere...
Which is to say, someone or something has infiltrated our dormitory? This warrants an investigation.
Kinu and I went to the dressing room Isuzu spoke of. It was a large room filled with shelves and closets for storing outfits and garments fit for all occasions.
Someone has turned off the lights... Be on your guard, Commander. The invader may still be around.
I took out and turned on the flashlight we picked up on the way here. Kinu forged forward with resolute steps.
Invader! I know you're in here! Come out where I can see you!
...Hmm. Maybe they've already left.
Kinu turned to me, and the very next moment, an inconspicious white sheet hanging opposite us began to move, as though it had waited for the chance.
Commander? What are you–
Swiftly, I got in front of Kinu to protect her from whatever was hiding under that sheet.
Then, the sheet just harmlessly fell to the ground, like a discarded wrapper. It was no more than an ordinary white cloak.
Whoopee!
...What?
Beneath the sheet was Uranami. We had found our "ghost."
Uranami? What the hell are you doing here?
Just looking for cuties to add to my collection. Hoping to find one to the tune of a wubby-dubby chonker.
And all you found was this – admittedly, cool – cloak, huh? You should keep it and wear it regularly. I know I wo–
Ahem! I'm getting sidetracked. Commander, you surprised me with your quick thinking. Let me just say...
...Actually, never mind. What matters is: you've definitely proven your courage today.
Kinu gave me a pleased look, as though she was proud of me.

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>6 Her Pokerface</size>

scripts.say: Port - An empty classroom in the academy
Right on time, Commander.
Thanks for taking the time to come here. I didn't think I'd ever wear something like this, but the situation calls for something special...
I can tell you're ogling me. I'm going to ask you nicely to stop it. We aren't here to do anything risqué.
...My posture looks off, that's all? Oh, I see...
Kinu asked me to help her accustom to an outfit she would wear while working at the refreshments stand at the academy.
I didn't know exactly how I could help, but I had to do something, so I proposed an activity we could do together.
A game of cards? That's not a half-bad idea.
Let's keep it simple. Ten rounds, no bets. You'd be adviced not to underestimate a demon's skill over her outfit.
Now go on, show me what you're made of.
Well? Do we keep playing, or do you give up?
She flashed a cocky smile at me. She had won every single round so far.
Your inability to read my pokerface is your crippling flaw. Meanwhile, yours is so easy to read it's like your cards are written on your face.
...Does emotion ever show on my face? Of course. The real question is: will you ever get to see it?
Could've sworn I heard people chatting in this room... Is there actually anyone inside?
Oh no!
Kinu's pokerface vanished in an instant. It turned out the answer to that question was: yes.
Listen, could we take a quick break? I need to–
K-Kinu?! Gosh, what is that outfit?!
Nagara threw open the door. She promptly froze in surprise when she laid eyes on Kinu.
Wait, Nagara! Let me explain, it's not what you–
Oh my god, you look sooo cute in it! Did the commander pick it out for you? I'm so happy for you! I'm so happy I just NEED to hug you!
Don't let emotion overtake you like that! A shipgirl needs to keep a level head in face of– MMMPHH!
Nagara embraced the unwilling Kinu, unwittingly smothering her in her bosom. Kinu fidgeted around, ashamed out of her mind.
For being sisters, their personalities were polar opposites. Now I understood why Kinu has trouble dealing with Nagara.
That was an unmitigated disaster...
Just to make it clear: I don't HATE Nagara, I simply can't stand how touchy-feely she is with me.
Would you do me a favor and forget the face I pulled back there? It won't happen ever again, I assure you.
After Nagara left, Kinu regained her composure. She now had the same collected look like she always does.
She really should learn to respect people's breathing room. Nobody appreciates an unsolicited motorboating.
Although, that flaw aside, she IS a good sister... Yes, let's leave it at that.
Surprisingly, right after saying she wouldn't let it happen again, a ray of emotion shone through her face.

sequence:
As Cool As A Demon

<size=45>7 The Element of Surprise</size>

scripts.say: There you are. I thought you'd show up.
I'd come to the sports building to practice sword swings with Kinu again, as was her routine.
It's time for another test. I want to see the fruits of your training.
Are you ready? Then take up your sword and show me your stance.
As she instructed, I grabbed a wooden sword, struck a fighting stance, and poured all my focus into a perfect strike.
Hah! Clear face, straight back. Not bad, compared to when you started... But it's still far from perfect!
She drew her own wooden sword, and for a moment, the air all around her seemed to whip outward.
Now come at me. I challenge you to land even one hit on me.
Accepting her challenge, I brandished my sword at her. It was that moment I decided to go all-out on her.
Well, well!
You've grown, and it shows.
