She gracefully struck a low pose with her sword held in both hands. Her moves were as beautiful as ever.
There is something I must know. I can guess where you get your courage from when we lock swords...
But from where, pray tell, do you get your confidence?
"It comes from what I've learned in our time training together."
"It comes from knowing your strengths, your weaknesses... and the lovable look you hide from everyone else."
Wh-what?!
It was a risky tactic, but it was more than enough to make her lower her guard.
While she stood dumbfounded, I went in for the decisive strike.
I knew Kinu, and that is what gave me the confidence to face her. The self-proclaimed demon isn't so daunting once you see her human side.
You did it. You landed a hit.
Now I understand... It took me this long, but I finally realize what it is inside you that I cannot control.
Then... Let me make you an offer.
She looked at me head-on and gave her offer loud and clear.
You may make this demon your secretary.
This proposition came out of nowhere, but I had no reason to turn it down.
Splendid. Then I will devote my all to you, Commander.
Use my abilities as you see fit.
She faced me with a beauty, a composure, a coolness like no other shipgirl I know.
Zzzzz...
Ugh... It's pitch dark... Did I fall asleep?
*Yawn*... What time is it...?
I've been so busy though... with work, and with Her Majesty's tea party... I think I've earned myself some rest...
The Commander probably is slacking off too... And if anything happens, I'm sure Bel will wake me up...
Maybe I'll sleep in a bit more...
Four respondents randomly select one option in a questionnaire with three options: A, B, and C. What's the probability that A, B, and C all appear in the responses?
Any takers? Who wants to take a crack at this question?
That voice... is so grating...
Edinburgh...! Edinburgh...! Are you sleeping in class again?
Wow...
Hehe. I like the free-spirited type, but you missed the part where you're not supposed to get caught by the teacher~
Stop shaking me around... I don't wanna get up...
Edinburgh! How many times have I told you not to sleep in class?!
...*yaaaawn*... Wh-where am I...?
In class, silly. Now, once again, please answer the question on the board.
Four respondents randomly select one option in a questionnaire with three options: A, B, and C. What's the probability that A, B, and C all appear in the responses?
She... got it right?!
(Eh? I did?! Phew...)
Psst... Edinburgh, pick B!
Uh... B! The answer is B!
Psst... Edinburgh, pick B!
Uh... B! The answer is B!
Psst... Edinburgh, pick B!
Uh... B! The answer is B!
Psst... Edinburgh, pick B!
Uh... B! The answer is B!
Ahem! That's right. Even if you stayed up late studying, try to manage your time better so you don't keep falling asleep in class. You can sit back down.
Now let's move on to the next lesson...

sequence: Ugh... Another long day of classes...
Compared to my smart and hard-working classmates, I'm just...
...Are classes really that interesting for them?
...And what in the world was I doing last night? I'm still so sleepy...
Can't even remember a thing... But, whatever... Might as well go back to sleep...
<size=51>「Zzz…………」</size>
<size=51>「……」</size>

scripts.say: So laaaame. We're being left out of the fun.
I want to head out and have some fun, too!
Well, can't really do anything about that. We can't fight, so we'd just be putting ourselves in danger.
Akane, is there really nothing you can do over here?
Sad, but true.
But... Purity. Are you really a Siren?
Am I a Siren just because you think I'm one~?
Seriously though, I never knew I did all those bad things in the past...
Okay stoooop. This isn't your pity party. Anyway, as I was saying...
If you're really one of the Sirens' higher-ups, you can do what the Sirens promised they could do, right~?
Probably~♪
Wait, Akane! You can't be serious––
Hehehe, this is about to get a whole lot more interesting~
This way, we should be able to fight as well. Right~?
Show me what you can do with this special rigging, won't you? Miss Purity~
School—Auditorium
I've finished making my rounds! I think we've found all the shipgirls at this school.
I can't believe... that I was fooled by the Sirens...
You're on the disciplinary committee, and I'm a delinquent... This setting makes no sense...
I was in the occult club... the only members were Foo and me... and the club was on the verge of being disbanded...
I was a nurse in the clinic... It felt a bit weird, because I didn't have my maid clothes. Hehe.
Huh? Thinking back, you weren't at the clinic when we were there, were you, Hermione?
I was busy evacuating with Spee. She must be looking for a way to get in touch with the port.
Those damn Sirens made up so many weird character settings... I was even falling asleep in the middle of class!
In your case, weren't you just doing what you normally would have done?
There's no way in heck that's true!!!
This is as good a time as any! Bel's not around, so it's the perfect time for me to change my image!
Sure, we'll leave you to it. As for the others who ended up in this world...
I'm Chise Asukagawa! It's nice to meet you!
You're the girl we ran into earlier.
Or, more precisely, she's the girl I ran into when I was looking for Hiryuu.
So that's how they set it up... the Sirens are terrifying.
That's how they set it up? What? Why are you treating them differently from me! What's up with that?!
Hehehe. You did it, Purifier.
Ta-daaah! This guy here is Alexis Crisis! Isn't he amazing~!!!
Purity designed him based on the information I gave her~
You're amazing, Purity~!
Ahah! Yes, praise me more! Do it!
Sorry for doing my own thing... But even if the current situation has nothing to do with us, I don't want to sit around like a caged songbird, relying on others to protect me.
It's not like our combat force is massive, so I wanted to join the fight on my own terms...
That's why I gave Purity the designs for Dyna Wing and Dyna Rex... but, I never thought she'd really be able to pull it off.
Don't underestimate the power of Miss Purity!

Hass, Namiko, and I didn't really have an image in mind when we talked to Miss Purity, so we left it to her. I was glad that they came out better than we had hoped. Gridman... You sure bring back memories.
Rikka told me that mine was designed after Max and Samurai?
And mine looks like Borr and Vit or something! ...Not that I know what that is!
So cool!
Super cool!
Weird... Even if you are a Siren, how are you able to reproduce things you've never seen with such fidelity, just from hearing descriptions of them?
Uhh...
Hehehe. There must be a model for them somewhere, no? Tell me the truth already~
Hol'up! I'll tell you, so don't shove me in your rigging's mouth!
To tell you the truth, I don't know how, but I had access to some kind of database... and I used that data to create these riggings.
What an amazing power you have~ Why don't you tell us what else you can see?
Things like the location of the Mirror Sea's control mechanism, and the structure of this town––
You will tell me, yes?
Y-yes...
Town - Northeast Sector
Everyone's gone, huh.
When I was walking to school this morning, the town was still full of people... What happened...?
The Sirens probably decided that it's not worth the effort to keep up the illusions anymore.
And, that "Mujina" person is out there somewhere.
Oh! That reminds me, I saw a familiar face on my way over here!
Who do you think it was?
Mujina?
Eh? How'd you know?!
I guess you were pretty far away when the kaiju appeared.
Oh, so that was the kaiju you defeated earlier?
But, I saw her before all that happened! And, she was wearing some kind of weird gear... Now that I think about it, it looked kinda like the rigging we have on now!
She was rushing towards the beach... and she looked pretty agitated.
If you asked me, it didn't look like she was off to dominate some kaiju...
In other words, the Sirens "promised" her something, just like with Akane... They must've made her rigging as well.
But we won't know for sure until we ask her in person...
Until Purifier gets her memories back, we can only pray for more information about who the mastermind behind all this is.
On the other hand, we can't just leave the situation as it is, particularly when someone from another world is involved.
Ugh, I'm getting exhausted just from thinking about all this...
You're welcome to take a nap on my rigging if you're tired~
That's alright... After all, today's gonna be the day I prove my worth to Bel!
Town - East Sector
The illusion of the town is disappearing... It's gradually reverting into a regular old island.
I guess the Sirens decided they don't need to keep up the guise anymore.
These Sirens are an awfully pragmatic bunch, huh? Masks off the moment they get discovered.
I've never seen anything like this though. With the disguise peeled back, it feels like we're actually stepping into cyberspace...
The fact that the school is still staying intact makes it seem all that much more surreal...
It's like I'm getting a glimpse into the "reality" of this world...
Hold on, don't just go around touching things randomly!
Huh? Isn't this just a normal brick wall?
You never know when it comes to the Sirens. Even ordinary things can be inlaid with alien dangers.
...I see. You did say you've been fighting against the Sirens for a long, long time.
Kind of? They kinda showed up out of nowhere in our world as well.
So they just appeared suddenly and started attacking with no rhyme or reason? That... sounds a lot like the kaiju.
Oh, Ryuujou, is that an airplane that's been flying around above us?
Yup, that's a carrier-based aircraft, designed specifically for use by aircraft carriers. Some cruisers are able to launch seaplanes, and that's a different class of–
So, does that mean I get to use them too?
Hmm... It seems that the rigging Purifier made for you has no ability to launch carrier-based aircraft.
I see... I guess I have to get used to fighting on the surface then.
What if... Hey, Ryuujou, do you think you'd be able to give me a ride on one of your planes?
No way!
Town - Northwest Sector
Souryuu-senpai! Hiryuu-senpai! Where are we headed next?
Hmm, let's see... Let's head down to the beach while surveying our surroundings.
Since that giant kaiju emerged from the sea and then vanished back into the sea, it has to be hiding somewhere.
That makes sense! You really are super smart, Souryuu-senpai!
I wouldn't say that. This was just some basic deductive reasoning.
No, no, you've been amazing this whole time, Souryuu-senpai! All this tactics and strategy stuff goes straight over my head!
Also, Hiryuu-senpai's able to do so many cool maneuvers with her planes! I've only seen formations like that in movies!
Ahaha, thank you!
So, what's with this "senpai" thing you've been calling us?
Back where I'm from, it's a title used for someone older than you who you look up to. You saved me when I was in a pinch, and there's so much I can learn from you. Does it bother you?
I suppose that makes sense...
Don't sweat it. Didn't I see you grinning with delight just a moment ago, Souryuu?
{namecode:94}————
So... Chise. You used to fight battles back in your own world, right? What kind of battles were they?
Well, you see... At first, I rode on Dyna Soldier in order to fight, but that didn't work out very well...
And then I went through some intensive training. Now, I fight with my buddy, Goldburn!
Goldburn? Are you talking about your rigging?
Well you see, this is just a replica of him that Purity made based on my instructions.
The real deal is a lot bigger, stronger, and cooler!
I see... since you said there aren't Sirens or shipgirls in your world, is he a type of kaiju...?
So, some kaiju are your enemies, but not all of them?
Goldburn isn't just any old kaiju. He has a heart, and we can understand each other... He's my buddy who fights by my side.
He's even saved Yume in the past.
He has a heart? I suppose that makes him different from the other kaiju...
...I want to see the real Goldburn again...
Sorry, look at me getting all sentimental over here! Let's get back to searching for the others!
So laaaame. We're being left out of the fun.
I want to head out and have some fun, too!
You said the same thing last time.
That's right. Exactly why I'm extra pissed!
Last time, we were left out because we weren't part of the combat force, but we have our riggings now!
Don't you want to go and like, have some fun rampaging around?
I want to test its performance...
Fighting on the front lines may be nice, but supporting your allies from the back lines is just as important.
Oh, would you like some refreshments? We have some tea and coffee... though I'm afraid that they're instant.
Please enjoy, if you'd like.
Woah, thank you!
Thanks! Are you a maid, Miss Hermione? That's amazing... I've never seen a real maid before.
What does a shipgirl who's a maid do? Cleaning's not all you do, right?
At the port, I help out with the work at the office, help manage the fleet, and do special jobs for Her Highness and the Commander.
Hold up, don't leave the juicy details out. What kind of "special jobs" are we talking about here?
Tell us as much as you can~!
Huh? There isn't anything particularly strange that I'm leaving out, though...?
So you're already so intimate that it's nothing particularly strange! Wow, wow~
I'm... curious too...
I'd like to know what these special jobs are!
You stay quiet, Purifier...
Why me! Everyone else is saying the same thing!
I've even built scouts for us that will automatically alert us when a large foe is spotted!
If there's any enemy movement, we'll be the first ones to know! This way, we won't have to waste time wandering around aimlessly!
Purifier, you're talented... This school isn't disappearing, unlike the rest of the town...
I'm not really sure why that's the case either.
But it's fine, isn't it? As long as we can make it out of here safely.
(Alarm blaring) .........!!
Look, something's coming! It's not a large kaiju this time, but some Sirens were spotted at the nearby sea!
Let Spee know so she can tell everyone else...!
Southwest Sector - Nearby Waters
Doesn't feel like there's any sentience coming from that formation over there. Must be a bunch of mass-produced tin cans.
I don't think Mujina's taken notice of us either... Alright everyone, now's our chance!
So, we're gonna seize victory in a single fell swoop?
Wait, let's slow down a sec. If we were sent here by the Sirens, shouldn't we at least try to talk things through?
And what if the other side doesn't feel like talking?
Then we launch a surprise attack?
Then it wouldn't be a surprise attack. We might even get intercepted by those mass-produced ships.
You're right... The most important thing is getting everyone back safely...
Yup. That's why we've got to defeat these mass-produced ships right now.
Try not to overextend, Roon! Let's make sure to clear out all the small fry first.
You don't need to tell me that. After all, you should always hamstring your prey before going in for the kill~
Sounds like a plan~ I've been itching to test out Alexis Crisis's performance~
Go get 'em, Alexis!
KABOOM––!!
Alright, stop running and I'll make this painless~
Woohoo! You're doing great, Alexis!
Mujina, we have you completely surrounded! Give it up already!
I never thought this would be where we'd meet again... Wait, huh? Where's the giant kaiju that was with you?
Wait. I'm not here to fight you.
That kaiju you just mentioned... I cannot control it. That's why I'm searching for it.
I see. At least it seems you're not sided with the Sirens...
What were you doing around that kaiju then? Were you going to use that "domination" power of yours?
Yes, but even with this special rigging, I wasn't able to control it.
But if you were able to control it, what would you do? ...Would you use it to attack us?
I... haven't thought about that yet.
I dunno if we can trust you... Souryuu-senpai, Hiryuu-senpai, we should be careful around her!
First, we need to determine whether you're with the Sirens. What did the Sirens offer you?
How did you know about that? ...Yes, the Sirens invited me to come to a world where I could control as many kaiju as my heart so desired.
And then, they gave me this special rigging.
But once I came here, even after I learned how to use the special rigging they made for me, I was still unable to control the kaiju here.
And without the rigging, I would not even be able to detect the presence of any kaiju... It does seem that I've been made the fool.
A clear and concise explanation. It's just as you suspected, Mujina.
In other words, finding that kaiju seems to be the only key to leaving this place... That being the case, there's no reason for us to fight each other.
The Sirens are our common enemy. How about it? Shall we forge an alliance for now?
How much do you know about those Sirens?
There's a lot I can tell you. After all, we've been fighting them for a long, loooong time.
I see... Then let us work together.
Nearby Waters
Are you sure we're going the right way...?
Yeah. This is the place it always goes to hide.
That's the same reading that your favorite teacher here got!
...That Siren ability to control mass-produced ships really comes in handy, huh...
That it does, but it doesn't seem to always work. There's much I still do not understand about this power.
Luckily enough, there's an entire buffet of Siren ships in front of us for you to test your powers on~
We just have to get closer first to see exactly how many there are. This should be a great opportunity to vent a bit~
(Alarm blaring) .........!!
There's something massive approaching us... What is that...?
From beyond the horizon, the sea was covered by a steel shadow.

Not only was it as menacing as a dragon ready to strike, but various parts of its body were equipped with heavy artillery, endowing it with enough firepower to defeat any enemy while still maintaining a dignified appearance.
There could be no doubt – this was the kaiju.
No way... it's even bigger than it was before?
Quite the formidable foe... but I wouldn't have it any other way~
Wait, hold on! We need to get out of here! We can't fight that thing!
Oh my, is the mighty Purifier going to run with her tail tucked between her legs?
Fear has nothing to do with it! That thing... isn't normal!
We can't defeat it! As a matter of fact, we'll be totally crushed! We need to get out of here!
...You say that, but that thing's already headed straight towards us. Since we have the numbers advantage, why don't we send some planes at it to see how tough it really is?
I like the sound of that. Souryuu, let's get ready to send our planes out to get a feel for how this thing fights!
Senpaiiii!! I can help too!
KABOOM––!!
The shipgirls deployed their aircraft to engage the massive kaiju.
...However, neither gun nor bomb could leave even a scratch on the kaiju's body.
The attacks seemed to bounce harmlessly of its body, as if protected by some kind of invisible shield.
Whaaaat? It didn't work?!
It's different from before. It seems to have gained some kind of defensive mechanism.
It's not just bigger. It's also gotten stronger.
I don't like the way it's looking at us... Uhh, isn't this pretty bad?
Ugh! I'll admit, that thing DOES pack a punch!
Didn't I already tell you before? Let's hurry up and get out of here, dunces!
I'm not done yet! Raaaaargh!!
Roon! Get back here...!
She's not listening! Crap, we're getting separated by the kaiju's attacks...!
What would the Commander do in this situation? Ugh, but the flagship should be the one to make that call...
Is that really important right now?!
Y-you're right... but Roon's really scary, and the Commander isn't here... What would Bel do if she was here..?
Don't worry about her, Edinburgh! Just do what you think is right!
The massive enemy began charging its massive beam, and the party could only gulp as they prepared to face the incoming crisis.
I'll take care of things over here, so make sure you go and get the other shipgirls!
Tsk... Those defenses are really keeping me from having my fun...
That's enough! Roon, everyone, regroup and retreat at once!
Edinburgh!!
Hurry, let's go!
Despite the kaiju's withering firepower, the party was able to retreat back to the school without any injuries.
The plan was to retreat further up into the mountains to buy more time, but the kaiju appeared to stop pursuing them.
While the Siren fleet re-established their blockade in the waters, they also did not take any further actions.
School - Classroom
That kaiju must be the key to leaving the Mirror Sea. The enemy knows this as well, which is why they're set up around it.
Sharp observation. As such, it's impossible for us to attack them head-on.
So what's the plan? Think we can brute force our way through with sheer numbers? We haven't been able to reestablish contact with the Port though...
I can try to procure some more mass-produced Siren ships.
That sounds like a good idea! Not only will we be able to get stronger, we'll also be draining the enemy's forces!
Rejected! That takes way too long! I've got a better idea!
Purity? You've been acting kind of strange...
Really? Hasn't Purifier always been like this?
Huh? Have I always been such a genius?! Lightbulbs are going off in my head like crazy!
Yeah, I'm pretty awesome, aren't I...
Let's stay on topic.
Okay, okay. So during that last battle, I couldn't help but notice that the kaiju kept looking at me.
Huh? Was it?
Kasumi... noticed that too...
I suppose that's plausible. Was that the reason you were in a rush to get everyone to retreat?
Uh, yeah! The moment I made eye contact with it, I immediately "understood" its structure.
...I don't have any specific details, but all kinds of blueprints and weapon designs flashed through my head.
Like looking at a status screen?
A what...?
Yeah, yeah! Just like that! And I could tell that our level gap was too great, or something like that.
I also could see that it considered me the greatest threat out of all of you!
So, it was trying to take you out first?
Who would its second priority be then? Mujina?
Yeah, you get it! Did you see it too?
No, but I have a pretty good idea of how the Sirens operate. After all, that kaiju was created by the Sirens.
It would be safe to assume that Purifier, who is a Siren herself, and Mujina, who has the ability to control Sirens, are seen as prime targets.
That makes sense... They're more worried about getting sabotaged from the inside than about an external attack.
I guess I'd be third on that list then? Hehe~
Dunno who comes after that, but it does feel pretty scary having a huge monster like that coming after you.
I just wanted to be an ordinary schoolteacher~ I never expected something like this to happen to me~
...You're an elite Siren yourself!
Am I? If I really was this "Purifier," there's no way I wouldn't be able to handle an enemy like that, right?
I can't even fight. All I can do is use the school's facilities to help others resupply, and make riggings. Does that sound like a high-ranking elite to you?
In other words... This is just my conjecture, but this Mirror Sea is currently sealing away my true powers.
If I was to regain my powers, maybe I'd be able to defeat that huge kaiju?
Besides, if everyone's beloved Miss Purity was able to regain control of this Mirror Sea... Maybe I'd even do you a favor and send you back home~
Working with her is too risky...
But we don't really have a choice. We can't break through the enemy lines ourselves.
If we really could help Purifier regain her powers, that'd be the best shot we have.
Absolutely! That's an honor student for you!
Nonsense. The first thing you'd do when you regain your powers would be to attack us.
Even if we managed to defeat that kaiju, we'd stand no chance against you after you regain control of the entire Mirror Sea.
What are you talking about? That kaiju was clearly trying to take us all out! What happened to our united alliance?
We'll need something to hold you to your word.
Hass, Namiko, Kasumi, and I will make sure she doesn't try anything funny.
We'll let everyone know right away if she makes any suspicious moves.
Sounds like a plan then... I'm glad the Royal Maids are a reliable bunch.
Now that you have your plan, let's get started! I'll tell you where this Mirror Sea's control device is, so let's begin our recapture strategy from there!
Ding–– Dong–– Ding–– Dong––
Go and enjoy lunch, everyone. Don't eat too much and pass out during the afternoon classes though~
Thanks, Miss Purity!
Phew, finally some fresh air... Edinburgh, are you alright? You seemed kinda out of it earlier.
Oh, um, I was just spacing out.
Why'd you stay up so late when we barely even had any homework? Wait, a new game?!
Ugh... Busted again...
Haha, you're so easy to read, Edinburgh. Hehe, was it so addicting you couldn't sleep all night?
Not really? To be honest, I can't exactly remember... Oh, shoot! I forgot to pack my lunch!
Seriously? How many times does that make it now?
If you forgot your lunch, you're always welcome to have some of mine~ I packed enough to share~♪
Woah, you're a lifesaver, Roon!
Don't mention it! That's what friends are for~ Here, this is for you. Why don't we go eat with the Com––
What's wrong, Roon?
...Huh, that's weird. What was I doing just now...?
I'm forgetting something very important... Something I was always doing at lunch... Was I supposed to meet someone? ...Who?
Huh? Don't we always eat lunch together?
No, no... NO! What the hell is this feeling...?!
Are you feeling sick? Should I take you to the nurse's office?
Woah, she ran off. Should we go after her...?
Yeah, I'm a bit worried... Be right back, I'll go check on her!
Akane...
Wait, Akane? Sorry to bail on you, but I'm going after her as well!
And there she goes as well...
Wonder if she got an upset stomach... Well, whatever. Let's enjoy some lunch while there's still time!
Working hard in class has gotten me all peckish––
More like, working hard to fall asleep in class.
Hey, it's not my fault that showing up to class drains my stamina! Not everyone is a natural student like you, Memphis.
Yeah... Kicking back during break time definitely beats sitting in class...
Town - Waters near East Sector
The Royal Maids... are supposed to be reliable, huh...
Even though I'm a Royal Maid myself... I almost never get complimented like that...
I heard you have a little sister who's made quite the name for herself... Belfast, was it?
She's the Head Maid. There's nothing she can't do, and she's earned everyone's trust and praise.
Then... there's me. *Sigh*...
It must be really hard living in her shadow... I mean, I can imagine people always comparing the two of you...
Yeah, totally! I want others to see me for who I am as well...
Well, your sister isn't here this time, so now's your chance, right?
That's also what I thought at first, but... this whole thing has gone bottoms up.
If you ask me, I think you've already proven yourself. Earlier, when you made the call to retreat, that was a good showing.
Because Purity interjected earlier, we never decided who would be flagship. I think it's your time to shine.
Me...? I'm not sure I...
I'm sure you'll be fine. After all, a remarkable little sister... must've looked up to a remarkable big sister! It all starts with believing in yourself!
.........You're right. Edinburgh's not gonna get done in by whatever that thing is!
Thanks for the advice, Yume. I'll go talk to the others!
You're welcome. Do your best, and give your little sister another thing to be proud of!
The Sirens have started to move. Guess they weren't going to wait around forever for us to make our move.
They must be on full alert now that they know we're after the control devices.
Quite likely, especially after seeing that oversized Purifier over there.
With only two control devices back under my control, I can already do thiiiiis! Muahahahahaha!!
Tremble, insects! Behold Purity's maaaaaaajesty!
I wonder if there's some unwritten law about getting bigger and becoming more of a megalomaniac...
You're too damn cool, Purity! Say another supervillain line!
You. You're a woman of culture!
Heh. I'll crush these worms with a flick of my wrist! Hehe!
Ahh, I'm going to fall in love~! More, give me more~!
...Uh, gimme a moment to come up with something else.
Ugh, Akane... We're in the middle of an important mission right now.
Sorry, sorry! Anyway, let's just follow the plan~ (Continues to ogle Purity)
...By the way, Akane... If we follow the plan, we're going to have to go recapture the other control devices.
Huuuh?! Does that mean I can't stay here?
*Sigh*...
Oh well~ Let's go, Alexis! You'll get to rampage to your heart's content when we fight the boss!
Don't get yourself killed before we get all the control devices back, Purity!
As if! Even right now, I'm more than capable of going toe-to-toe with that fella...
But that doesn't mean that you should just take your sweet time either!
The two massive figures could be seen approaching each other from a great distance, the very atmosphere tingling in anticipation of their imminent clash.
There you are, kaiju!
Oh? You're approaching me? ...Instead of running away, you're coming right to me?
Then come as close as you like... I can't beat the shit out of you without getting closer...
I can't tell who's the real bad guy here...
Honestly... Let's just say they both are...?
The noise coming through the communication channels is really annoying... I'm just going to turn it off for now.
How's everything going? Were you able to get the control devices?
Yes, we've wrapped things up over here. Thanks to your guidance, the Sirens were no match for us. What about on your end?
Uh, we're not quite there yet.... but we'll have this area under control soon enough!
I didn't expect this plan to work so smoothly...
Color me surprised, Edinburgh. You certainly rose to the occasion, and then exceeded it.
Ehehe, I'm flattered... All right then, let's finish mopping up these mass-produced ships!
Then... we'll help Purity defeat that giant kaiju!
The battle rages on––
Keep laying down the fire support! Don't stop shooting!
Even with all the control devices, we still aren't able to take down that kaiju...
The mass-produced Sirens are converging on this location as well... Looks like they're serious about this showdown as well.
I'll handle them. My rigging is perfect for dealing with enemies that try to swarm us with sheer numbers.
Hehe. I'll come with you then. I want to take a better look at this splendid scenery from a distance~
I bet that'd make for a terrific photo op! Let me come with you too!
If Hass is going, then count me in as well~
I'll pass. Someone's got to stay behind and keep up the fire support.
...Also am I going crazy, or does nobody here have any sense of urgency?
What a killjoy~
I guess it's because Purity is doing most of the hard work, not us.
I heard that, you know!! Hurry up and give me more backup––!!
Alright, you heard her. Let's go take out that Siren trash!
Woah...! What the heck was that attack?!
It feels like the entire world is vibrating, water and air alike...!
We've encountered other Mirror Seas like this before! I think it's a special combination attack that's also causing anomalous weather, Souryuu!
Indeed. My electronic devices have been completely disabled...!
Purifier! Are you okay? Do you need to retreat first?
Huh? Retreat? I barely even felt that!
Did your rigging not get affected by that electromagnetic attack?
Don't think so? I might be immune to stuff like that!
Wow... If the kaiju's attack didn't work on Purity, then–
Purity, listen to me! Pretend you've been disabled by that attack!
Lure the kaiju into thinking it can finish you off, then blow it to pieces when it's lowered its guard!
Huh? Oh, I see! ...Blargh! Curses! I'm done foooooor––!
Due to Purity's strange behavior, the rampaging kaiju finally paused its attack.
Shipgirls and Sirens were littered around the water, rendered motionless by the prior attack. The massive Purity seemed weakened and vulnerable as well.
As if satisfied by the apparent incapacitation of the elite Siren, the kaiju momentarily took its aim off from Purity.
Now's your chance, Purity! Hit it hard!
Hell yeah! You've activated my trap card! Take this!!!!
Look at me – it's the last thing you'll ever see, loser......!
Huh? What's wrong with me today? Surely I could've come up with a better insult than that...
NOW'S NOT THE TIME FOR THAT!! HURRY UP AND SHOOT!!
Pull out a Something Beam, anything! Hurry up, or that kaiju's going to get you!
Let a girl enjoy her two seconds in the spotlight, jeez! Target, locked on! Whatchamacallit Something Beam... FIIIIIIIIIIIRE!!
Town - Waters near East Sector, after the battle
The kaiju... The kaiju's gone!
It turned into light...
That's because it wasn't a real kaiju, just a replica made by the Sirens...
So, now that we've defeated the kaiju and regained control of the Mirror Sea... does that mean we can go home?
I thought some kind of door or portal would open up after we defeated the kaiju... Is it not going to be that simple?
*sigh*... Even after all that fighting, we're still going to have to find a way back home...
The road back is littered with hardship––
Are you breaking out into poetry now?!
Is that something we learned in class...?
Nah, it's something I saw on my socials the other day. I thought it sounded really deep, so I wanted to try using it.
Wasn't it pretty relatable just now...?
What do you think, Miss Purity?
Wait, she's gone?!
Wait... where did she go?! How'd such a huge thing disappear into thin air?
That's not the only thing that's disappearing. The school, the town, all of it is...
What's going on now?
When we defeated the kaiju, Purifier must've regained full control of this Mirror Sea. And now, as her name implies... She's purifying it.
No way... Does this mean I'm not even going to get a chance to say goodbye to her?
I wonder if Purity's okay...
She's a high-ranking elite Siren, after all. I doubt anything bad happened to her. Probably.
In the end, we never managed to find out if Purifier and Purity are actually one and the same...
Fair point. But I don't think that's anything you need to worry about.
I think it's for the best. If we had to bring her back to the Port, I can't imagine how the Commander would react...
Maybe her disappearing along with the Mirror Sea really is the best outcome we can hope for...
As for our friends from another world, don't you fret. I'm sure we'll be able to figure out a solution once we get back to the Port.
I'm sure Akashi... is used to dealing with things like this by now.
This Port you're talking about is where all your friends are, right? I'd hate to impose...
We're not the type to turn our backs on people in need! I'll go inform the Commander myself!
Let's head back to the Port then, everyone! Set sail!
Ehehe, it's almost as if I'm the flagship~♪
I can understand your enthusiasm, but do you even know how to get back from where we are now?
Uhh, well, let me check that real quick!
Ahaha... That's just like you, Edinburgh.
J-just give me a minute over here! We'll be back home in no time, where Belfast and the Commander will be waiting for us!
Hahaha~!
Under a clear blue sky, upon the tranquil blue sea, a journey full of twists and turns draws to an end.

sequence: "This is Admiral Graf Spee. I've managed to make contact with the others. They appear to all be safe."
"Yes, Belfast. I'll now escort them back to the Port."
"They're accompanied by visitors from another world. They all appear to be good people."
"Yes, please contact Akashi and the Commander."
"Hmm? What about Edinburgh?"
"She's al– Mm, actually, I think you should ask her yourself once she gets back."
"...you won't believe what I just did, Bel––"

scripts.say: Ding–– Dong–– Ding–– Dong––
Akane and Roon still haven't come back yet?
They're not responding to my text messages either... Ugh, I'm going to go look for them!
Just what do you take Miss Purity for? Get back in your seats right now!
Kids these days... Showing up to class only when they want to, and thinking they can leave whenever they want!
Miss Purity, I think that's a bit harsh...
Oh... You do have a point, but that's also besides the point! Class is in session, NOW!
(Miss Purity is certainly unique for a teacher... I wonder how she even ended up teaching...)
(Ugh... I'm getting all sleepy again...)
Just as she closed her eyes and went to lay down on the desk, she was jolted awake by the vibrating of her phone.
A message from... Hiryuu? Isn't she supposed to be in the middle of P.E.?
...What? I never expected Hiryuu to be the type to cut class...
...Wooooah?! What in the world––!!
Do you have something to share with the class, Miss Edinburgh?
Y-yeah, just look at this picture!
Don't play on your phone during class!
I'm not playing around! Look!
The picture was taken from the side of the schoolyard facing the ocean, the water clearly visible. But within it––
What the hell is that? From that distance, it must be the size of a skyscraper!!
It's kinda blurry from here, but... is that the silhouette of a dinosaur?
There's no way that's real, right? Do huge creatures like that even exist?
What are those smaller things around it? I... I've never seen anything like it...
That... has to be some kind of kaiju.
Kaiju? What's that?
Um... How do I explain this...
(The kaiju have appeared again...!)
We can't see it from here! Let's head outside to take a look!
Hold on, that's dangerous!
If these kaiju things are real, it's going to be more dangerous to stay inside!
––At that time, the emergency sirens began to blare.
An emergency has occurred! Everyone in the school, please evacuate to the gymnasium as quickly as possible!
Once again, an emergency has occurred! Everyone in the school, please evacuate to the gymnasium as quickly as possible!
Come on, teach! You heard them, it's dangerous to stay here!
Ugh... Fine, fine! Everyone, follow me in an orderly fashion and evacuate to the gym!
Rikka, Yume! Get back here! Don't go running off during an emergency!!
The group hurried down the hallway toward the gym.
That's strange... No matter how hard I look for it, I can't find it! I know I had it this morning...
Yume, what are looking for?
Dyna, err... I mean, I dropped something earlier...
(If I can't find it, I won't be able to fight the kaiju...)
What? Fight...? I think you should just leave that to the pros.
She's right! The people in the town will be able to think up some countermeasures! In the meantime, we should hurry up and evacuate!
You're not wrong, but if there's anything I can do to help...
Look, who's that person out there...?
Huh, no way! Who'd be outside at a time like this?!
Someone from the next town over?
I don't think so... Now that I'm looking closely... is that person walking towards us WITH the kaiju?!
I'm going to grab my phone and zoom in for a closer look! ...Wow, you're right, there really is someone there!
Wait... is that... Mujina?!
Someone you know?
Uh... Kind of, we've got some history between us...
So, Mujina and the kaiju show up at the same time... Are the Kaiju Eugenicists up to something again?
Kaiju Eugenicists...?
It's a bit hard to describe, but... to put it simply, they're people who want to let kaiju run rampant, or something along those lines.
W-what kind of evil organization is that? Almost sounds like something right out of those shows Ryuujou watches...
Yeah, that's a natural reaction to have...
What are you loitering around for?! Let's hurry on up to the evacuation site already! The giant kaiju is just around the corner!
You too, Rikka! Hurry up, or we're going to leave you behind!
But... Akane still hasn't come back...
I'm sure she's already made it somewhere safe. It'd be impossible not to hear the blaring sirens after all.
Why would a kaiju appear right here though? I thought we already defeated them all the last time...
...Last time?
Defeated the what? Are kids these days still into that roleplaying stuff even at your age?
Why don't you try calling Akane? We're not in the middle of class right now, so we can use our phones, right?
You were already using your phone during class earlier! Why bother asking for permission now?!
You're right. Hold on for a second, let me call her—
Oh, it went through.
Hello? Akane? Where are you?
Rikka? Don't worry~ I've got the kaiju in check.
In check... What does she mean by that?
Huh? What do you mean? I don't get you at all.
The kaiju was headed towards the school, so I stopped it in its tracks~ But wow, I never thought I'd be able to see such an amazing kaiju, hehe.
Did you know? Roon's rigging is super awesome!
Roon? Rigging...?
Are you listening~? Her main battery's ready to fire, she's about to blow!
Um, as I was saying, what exactly a...
BOOOOOOM!!!
Wha?! What was that sound?!
So, did you hear it~? Front row seats to a concerto of cannonfire!
She's right! The kaiju's stopped moving!
Ahahahaha! Anyone who gets in my way... will be torn apart!!
Is that... Roon? Did she really manage to stop that thing?
Yup. She made some kaiju-esque "rigging" or something appear, and it packs an insane punch! It also seems to be automated!
People change when they're thrust into battle. It's sooooo fascinating!
Anyway, like I said, there's no need for you to worry about me~ I'll wrap things up over here.
Just head to some place safe and wait for me there, okay?
Kay, well, I'm hanging up now. Hey, Roon! Can you do that one more time?
She hung up... I have no idea what's going on, but she seems to be doing... just fine?
School — Schoolyard
Roon... It's you, right?
What's with that iron dragon...? Huh, a kaiju? Rigging...? Did you use the rigging to fight the kaiju?
(There are various types of kaiju, so... I wonder if there are kaiju that can become our partners...?)
Roon, did you partner up with a kaiju?
Of course not. This is just my rigging.
I had a feeling something was wrong. You've all forgotten something important... and the fact that you don't even recognize my rigging confirms that.
Does it jog your memory when I say the word, "shipgirls?"
Ship... girls? Like, sailors?
Like, warships...?
Guess that wasn't enough. Then, how about "Port," and "Commander"?
Port? Commander? Hrmm...
Commander... THE Commander! Oh!
Hehehe, I guess "Commander" carries a lot of power.
We aren't a group of schoolgirls. We're shipgirls, born to fight against the Sirens.
Edinburgh, light cruiser of the Royal Navy, and Memphis, light cruiser of the Eagle Union.
...That's right! How did we forget something so important...?!
So that's why I couldn't remember anything about the game I played last night! How were you able to figure all this out, Roon?
I wonder... Earlier today, during lunch... I felt that there was a hole in my heart, and that hole only continued to grow.
I came to realize that what I had been missing so sorely... was the Commander. After I remembered that, the other pieces quickly fell back into place.
We were in the process of investigating a Mirror Sea, and then before we knew it... we ended up here.
I wish Bel was here... I can't even make heads or tails of this situation.
Well, there's no need to panic. Let's put our heads together and figure out how to get out of this mess.
Hehehe... So I'm not good enough?
I'm glad you're here too R-Roon! Let's do our best!
Umm... Is there something I'm missing out on here? What's this Mirror Sea and shipgirl stuff you've been talking about?
Are we not just ordinary classmates?
You should ask your friend over there. She's the one who can tell you what's really going on~
Akane...? Is there something you haven't been telling us? What's going on?
I guess there is, but I've somewhat been duped myself. So, it all began when I got a proposal––
So it went like this... a few days ago while we were on break, I was sleeping at home. If I remember correctly, Rikka...
Ahh, I remember now! I went to the plaza, and then...
When I came to, I was in class as usual... So why were we...
I can't quite remember... It feels like there are holes in my memory...
Now that you mention it... My head's felt a bit foggy lately...
A few days? Everything feels like it's happened within the last day for me... But I guess that's all relative.
We're from different worlds after all. It's not unthinkable that time might pass differently for us~
So Akane, is this world your doing?
Sadly, nope. But unlike the rest of you, who were pulled in without your knowledge, I was invited here.
...By who?
Uhh... Some people who had all this super cool giant mecha gear?
Wait, that sounds just like... the Sirens?!
Oh yeah, that! That's what they called themselves. Seemed like they aren't living beings, but rather some kind of AI?
Those Sirens created this entire space. It reminds me a bit of how I used to create kaijus back then.
So basically, I have nothing to do with whoever made this world, nor am I some kind of god here.
Even so, I came here of my own accord. I wanted to be a normal human, living out a normal life.
Oh, woe... They weren't even able to make my dreams come true...
Whatever this "proposal" was, they clearly weren't forthcoming with Akane either.
Yeah! This isn't the normal life I was promised at all!
Yep. Just as you would expect from the Sirens.
Umm, I think I get the gist of what's going on.
But if that's the case, why is Mujina here? Did she also get an invitation from these Sirens?
I could see them offering her something like "a world where kaiju still exist," or something like that...
I thought kaijus were the enemies in your world though? But I guess there are always people out there who like having enemies around...
That's... the opposite of what the Kaiju Eugenicists believe...
Sorry, but I can only speak for myself. Wouldn't be able to tell you what's going on with her.
If she was invited here by the Sirens just like me, then she's most likely being deceived as well.
Well, anything is possible with the Sirens, so... Ahh, w-wait a minute! The teacher in our class was... was...
Miss Purity?
Yes, her! She's actually Purifier, one of the Sirens' higher-ups! I knew it, they've had someone watching us this whole time!
Wait, Akane, if you knew all that, why didn't you just tell us?
Because it's more fun that way, heehee~
Uhh...
Purifier should be at the gym right now! Let's hurry there and reassess the situation!
While we're checking on Purifier, we should also find the other shipgirls around the school and let them know what's going on.
And our friends from another world as well~♪
School—Clinic
Aaand welcome to the clinic~! We made it through the crisis unharmed. Hooray!
Say cheese! Let's snap a quick pic of this touching reunion!
Hass! Namiko! You guys are here too?
Did you hit your head, Rikka? We were with you this morning!
Well, we're not in the same class, but still. We went to the plaza together before we came to school!
Now that you mention it... Wait, how is that possible? I'm so confused...
There's no need to rush, Rikka! Now that we're onto the Sirens' tricks, we just need some time to sort out our memories.
At least, I'm glad that I remember all my friends from the Port!
I can't believe I let myself get fooled by these cheap illusions though... Who knows what would've happened to me if you girls weren't here!
By the way, why are the two of you at the clinic? Did you get hurt?
Nothin' but a scratch! It's all Hass's fault, too. She was throwing a fit, saying she was HAD to go take some pictures of the kaiju.
Well yeah, who'd pass up a chance like that?!
Just... don't push your luck like that. Next time, safety first. Got it?
My bad, my bad~
And then you ran into Ryuujou?
Yep. She brought us over to the clinic.

Ryuujou's sense of justice really comes from her soul, huh? She went out of her way to look after you two and brought you to the clinic while not even realizing that she's a shipgirl. That's incredible.
Protecting the weak is the duty of a warrior such as I!
Thanks to Ryuujou, we were able to make it here safely. After getting patched up, we were just about to leave, and that's when all of you showed up.
Yup. And after hearing Akane tell me what's going on, my memories started to come back as well.
Oh, right. The Purifier that's calling herself Miss Purity? She's being held over here.
What?! You managed to capture a Siren?
It's a long story, but basically...
Clinic
Students these days are the worst! I can't believe they'd lock their teacher up!
Ugh! You dare do this to your teacher just because we had a bit of an incident? And what do you plan on doing next now that I can't do anything about it?
...The sheer indignity of it all!
What in the world is going on...? Why's she talking like her memories still haven't come back?
How strange... Can Sirens be fooled by their own illusions?
Mentioning the Commander helped us regain our memories, but what would stir a Siren's memory?
God knows what. Besides, what if she already got her memories back?
It's possible... but this Purifier is nothing like the vicious beast that we know.
I've got an idea. Memphis, why don't you feed her a bit of our knowledge?
Starting from the time the Sirens first appeared in our world...
So, Sirens are the bad guys?
That's right! That's why we're keeping you on a leash, Purifier!
Now, tell us how to escape from this Mirror Sea already!
...I kind of have a liiiiittle inkling in the back of my mind, but it's really faint still~
Putting that aside, isn't your enemy Purifier? What does that have to do with me?
She might have a point. The Purifier you were talking about and the Purity in front of us sound pretty different.
That's certainly plausible...
Or, maybe she's acting. Hehe.
There's no way she's not acting. She sucks at it too.
But see, if I'm really as awesome and powerful as this Purifier person you keep talking about, do you think I'd still be sitting here helplessly?
Hrmmm...
What do you think, Rikka?
Hmm... At least, I don't think she's lying. Maybe she's just a lookalike?
She doesn't seem to pose any threat to us right now. Wouldn't it be fine to leave her alone...?
Oh, I just got a message from Chise.
"I saw that there was an explosion at the school. Is everyone okay?"
Wait a sec, that means Chise's here too...?
Is she one of your friends?
Yeah. My guess is that she was roped into this situation, just like us.
There are probably more people who were roped into this situation. Let's hurry up and find them!

sequence:
Dynamic Days

<size=45>1 Shopping Around</size>

scripts.say: Port - Akashi's Store
Geesh. This place is a lot bigger than you'd expect from the exterior...
Welcome, nya! How can I help you, nya?
Yeah, hi. I'm working on a kaiju figurine and need some sculpting clay. Do you have any?
A what now, nya? I don't sell any– Actually, let me have a look, nya...
You sure about this place, Akane? The shopkeeper seems a bit sus.
Kinda, but it's said they sell EVERYTHING here, soooo...
It just took me a second to remember I have it, nya. Let me get it for you, nya.
We have a few figurine enthusiasts here at port, so it pays to keep sculpting supplies stocked, nya.
Oh, speaking of figurine enthusiasts... nya.
Heya, I'm looking to buy a new figurine~ Got anything new in stock, Akashi~?
Do you have to ask every week, nya? Sigh... Lucky for you, it so happens I got a shipment of new ones today, nya. Look around, see if you find anything you like, nya!
Uhh, shopkeep? The sculpting clay?
Sorry, nya. Check the aisle over there for figurine stuff, nya.
You looking for figurine stuff too~? What a coincidence~! If it's clay you need, I can help you find that no problem~
Cool. Chop-chop, then.
Heheh... Thanks for the free labor, nya...
Here's the place~ I'm no clay expert or anything, but I hope you find what you need~
Damn, there's so many to choose from! Which is a good thing.
You didn't need to memorize my entire store layout, nya. Don't you ever wanna get lost and find an unexpected bargain, nya?
And spend ages searching? No thanks... Why do you spread your goods out so far, anyway?
It's designed to make customers walk further, stay longer, and spend more money, nya! It's the same principle YKEA is built on, nya!
She should try putting herself in the customer's shoes and see how she'd like it...
Or her employees' shoes. Stocking these shelves and keeping inventory must be a nightmare...
While chatting among themselves, the girls came across an aisle packed with second-hand computers and televisions.
If you can name it, they sell it here, huh?
Apparently~! Why do you keep these around, Akashi? I bet they don't even work anymore!
That's where you're wrong, nya. These may be old, but there's life in them yet, nya!
Akashi flipped a switch on the wall, bringing all the electronics to buzzing life. Screens of all shapes and sizes turned on, lighting a path that stretched on quite some distance.
Wow... They do still work.
Heheh! With some spare parts and elbow grease, you can make any old tech work again!
Except this TV, apparently. It's not turning on.
Huh?! But... it's plugged in and everything, nya! Why isn't it working, nya?
Hmm... Do you mind if I try something? I've fixed something similar before.
You have, nya? Then by all means, go ahead, nya!
All right, just give me a second. Stand back.
Rikka held her fist high in the air then gave the TV a great thump.
Unbelievably, the TV screen came on with a quiet whirr.
Holy poggers, it worked~! You're the MVP, Rikka!
Phew... I thought you'd broken it for a minute there, nya!
I'm telling you, this usually works with the stuff I'm used to. A small whack won't break anything.
At least not with Rikka's surgical precision.
Well, tell you what: I'll give you 20% off for your help, nya! One time only, nya.
You... You're serious? Oh wow, that's really generous of you!
Do I get a discount too?
For doing what, nya? Writing off my valuable products as junk, nya? You wish, nya.
RIP me...
And so, after encountering some pleasant people and surprises, Rikka and Akane left the store with wares in hand.

sequence:
Dynamic Days

<size=45>2 On-Location Shoot</size>

scripts.say: What's going on, guys! I'm Namiko, and this is Hass. Hass, would you tell 'em where we are today?
Hey. So, we're at a naval port, and we're gonna talk to some people.
Uh-huh! We'll be interviewing some of the brave shipgirls who fight for humanity and learn what their talents are.
Awesome. These are the shipgirls joining us today. Say hello to...
Hiiiii! It's me, San Diego! Everyone's number one favorite idol!
My name is Suruga, and... I just happened to be in the area.
Hello. Call me Spee.
I'm sleepy...
Nice, what a colorful cast. We're glad to have you here.
So without further ado, tell us about your strengths and talents.
Oh, I've got a buttload of talents! But if I have to choose just one, it's easily singing!
A sweet, happy-go-lucky idol with a knack for singing! I'm sure tons of people would subscribe to that.
I don't have any real strengths...
Sure you do, Spee. You've got a cute fashion sense. You dress to match your personality, too.
I'm just wearing what my friends suggested... They deserve the credit.
In my case... I...
Oh, Laffey knows how to build suspense. Go on, tell us! What's your greatest talent?
The ability to... fall asleep anywhere, anytime...
Goodnight... Zzzzz...
Wow, what a unique talent. Complete with a demonstration, too!
Oh, man. I'd kill to say goodbye to sleepless nights forever.
(Why are they commentating like show hosts? What is this? Low-budget reality TV?)
Thanks for the performance, Laffey. Now last, but not least... Suruga! Would you tell us your greatest strength?
St-strength...? Uhh...
Suruga has a photographic memory! All she needs is one glance to perfectly memorize anything!
Don't answer on my behalf! Where'd you come from, anyway?!
Wow, we have a surprise guest! I wonder what she has to say about her friend Suruga?
A photographic memory is a bit TOO great, don't you think? Got anything more ordinary?
Well, she can cut her nails really quickly! I saw it for myself the other day when she–
Oh dear, she must've really set off Suruga. She's trying to grapple Shimakaze like she's– Oops! Shimakaze ran away!
Look at her run... Does she have rocket boosters or something...?
That's going in the blooper reel... Psst, Namiko, we've gotta wrap things up.
Err, right... Thanks for watching, guys! That's almost it for today, but before we go, let's hear a song from San Diego. Sandy, take it from here!
You got it! A-one and a-two and a-I am number one!
And that's everything we recorded. What did you want edited out, Suruga?
All the footage I'm in, thank you very much! Every second of it!
Welp. That's a bummer, but if you say so...
This deleted footage ended up nearly being leaked to the public. How that happened, though, is a story for another time...

sequence:
Dynamic Days

<size=45>3 A Joy Cruise</size>

scripts.say: Clear blue skies, vivid azure seas. Two black and red figures darted along the surface, like sharks on the hunt.
I'mma crank up the speed! Hang on tight, Yume!
Geesh, this is fast...
Sprays of water gushed after U-37 as she accelerated.
Hey, U-37! Don't forget we still have to do the thing!
Yeah, yeah, I remember!
Wait, what thing? I thought we were just going for a cruise?
Don't worry, it won't take long! U-37 was just hoping you'd play a little game with us. Right?
Uhh, yeah, that's all!
If it's just a little game, then sure... Playing out on the open sea might be fun.
Hell yeah it is! All right, y'know the rules of Red Light, Green Light, right?
Who doesn't? But I've never done it in water before. Is the game some kind of regional variant of it, or...?
Not really, it's the same thing as every kid's played before! Also, you won't exactly be "in water." Look up ahead and you'll see what I mean!
The girls arrived at a small island poking above the water with a lighthouse on top. Yume set foot on the island while the other two swam some distance away.
Yumeeee! If ya can hear me, just say it when you're ready!
Man, I can barely see them over there...
Guess I'll have to shout... READYYYY! FIIIIVE! FOOOOUR!
Perfect! Time to get a move on!
Heheh, yeah!
ONE! ...Huh? Guys?
Yume turned around to find the two submarines were completely gone. All there was left of them were their ripples.
Okay then... I guess we're playing hide-and-seek instead.
Either that, or they left me stranded... That would be a bit rude, kind of.
Oh wait, I've still got my rigging. Just need to go back the same way we... came...
Right... Too bad I have no idea where we came from.
The only things around her were the featureless skies and seas. She was all alone, without any landmarks to guide her.
Dying out here would kind of suck... Wish I had the Dyna Wing right now.
While Yume stood, pondering her options, U-37 and U-73 suddenly resurfaced. They presented to her a box in a vivid array of colors.
Check it out! Sweet box, right? We stuffed a buncha colorful fish into this thing.
Plus some pretty clams, shells, and coral!
Wow... They're really nice.
We saw you kept a ton of sea-themed plushes in your room, which gave us the idea to gift this to you.
That explains a few things... I was spooked when you vanished on me like that, though.
Heh, sorry 'bout that! Anyway, ya like the gift?
That goes without saying. Thanks a ton. Say, could we go for another cruise? A normal one.
Hahah, sure! If by "normal" you mean "high-speed"! I know you love going fast.
Don't we all! Hop on and we'll go for a ride!
Nice! Let's see what stuff is out there.
Amid the gently washing waves and calm winds, one could hear their laughter for seemingly miles.

sequence:
Dynamic Days

<size=45>4 Band Together</size>

scripts.say: It was a tranquil afternoon. Chise was out on a casual stroll.
Oh man, Dunkerque sure makes some amazing pastries! Eating 'em really fills you with joy.
Just down the street, Urakaze and Isokaze were standing next to some instruments, handing out flyers. Chise laid eyes on them.
You got a band thing going on or somethin'? Not too weird for this port though, I guess.
Dang, that's some high-end equipment... Cool stuff you got!
Thanks. We are the Sengokus. We strive to unify the port under one band... Ours, of course.
Mhm! We're looking for new members. Interested, Chise?
Eh... I dunno if I'm good enough.
Even at a glance, I can tell you have potential. Come on, we could use someone of your caliber.
Aww, shucks, you flatter me...
Oh, all right! If you're fine with havin' me, then I'll give it my best shot!
Splendid! See, Isokaze? I told you we'd eventually get a new member, given enough perseverance!
Wahoo! Now help yourself to any instrument you want, Chise!
By the way, there's a voucher for a fancy patisserie on the back of your flyer.
Whoa, I didn't notice! What a "sweet" sign-up bonus.
Urakaze and Isokaze kept on handing out flyers while Chise familiarized herself with her instrument. The two Sengokus had now become three.
You're forming a band? How charming.
Yep, and we're looking for more members. Would you like to join, Mujina?
I do appreciate the offer, but I'm afraid I can't play an instrument.
It's never too late to start learning. Who knows? There may be untapped talent within you.
Thanks, but no. I'll come and watch, but...
Mujina meant to decline, but experienced a sudden change of heart when Urakaze and Isokaze surrounded her with instruments.
Well... On second thought...
Hella persuasive, aren't they? It can't hurt to give it a shot at least. C'mon, let's hear it!
*looks of anticipation*
Fine... I'll see how this one plays...
Mujina picked up a drumstick and gave the drums a soft hit.
Hmm... Not bad.
She hit it a second time, this time with a bit more force.
Such devastatingly powerful sound... I could get into this, actually.
Oh snap! I don't think she's being sarcastic with us.
You're free to try all the instruments if you want, Mujina.
You're free to join the band too! Just so you know!
She knows, Isokaze. Don't pester her.
Chise kept on familiarizing herself, and Mujina tested other instruments while Urakaze and Isokaze watched. They became engrossed in the world of music and forgot all about the flyers.
The four members of the Sengokus performed for hours and hours, the sun even setting before they were done.

sequence: In an infinite cycle of rebirth, time has lost its meaning.
Where the probable and improbable collide,
all ephemerals are swept up in flames...
If it wasn't for that lone encounter,
might there be an alternate ending.
Is that you, my Creator?
if I may so ask?
O, my Creator?
Visitors Dyed in Red

scripts.say: The storm is too strong! We'll be annihilated if we try to ride it out!
We're committed now, we can't just give up! Trust me, we will break through this storm soon enough!
Unknown enemy detected, bearing 150 degrees! Initiate evasive maneuvers...
An unknown enemy, in a storm like this? Tell me its coordinates!
Answer me, Shoukaku! What are its coordinates?!
... Get... out of… here…
Crap, we're losing radio contact... This isn't looking good...
Damn it... I still haven't had the chance to fight the Grey Ghost...
... Wait, what's...? What's that light...?
Oh god!
... Where... am I?
Hey... I'm still in one piece! I made it!
Ow! My head hurts, though... And I don't remember what happened...
Damn... I can't radio Shoukaku... Now things really aren't looking good...
No, get it together! I finally made it, after all...
I made it here! To the Sanctuary!
I surrender, you win... Even with the power granted to me by the Creator, I couldn't defeat you... *Sob*...
... You were holding back, weren't you?
N-no I wasn't! And I'm not going to tell you that they locked Shoukaku away within the deepest part of the Sanctuary! It's super secret!
Thanks. I'll be taking my leave now.
Wait!
What is it now?
Please... save our future... Those girls aren't all bad...
Okay, I will!
Our brave little bird seems to be heading to the Sculpture Room. How annoying...
How many times must they meddle in things that aren't their concern? Why do they not realize the magnificence of the Creator's plans?
My sister, please, control yourself. As long as the Original does not awaken, all will be well. Sculpting it should not take long.
Then let's send out a rabbit to stall the little bird. She's been waiting for her tea party long enough...
Let's send that child over there to stall her.
The target seems... awfully strong... I thought they know I'm not the type to engage in face to face combat...
Sorry, Nowaki, I don't have time to play games. Shoukaku's in danger, so I want to finish this quick.
You're strong... but I'm also strong...
I've fought carriers before... I can do this... probably...
Ouch... I'm not such a lucky ship... after all...
You are lucky. You just picked a bad opponent.
... Now tell me everything you know.
Well, I got lost and wandered into this place... then I met some strange people.
They've been researching the technology their "Creator" gave them in hopes of turning the tide of war around...
That's just as the intel said. Looks like they weren't lying after all.
Come with me, Nowaki. I need to save Shoukaku, and the more support I have, the better.
But I can't go against their will...
Even if this "Creator" of theirs is nothing but a lie?
They gave us hope... Even if I'm going down the wrong path, I can't...
I see... Good luck, then.
All planes, take off! Target the enemy carrier: Lexington!
You should leave some planes behind! Don't underestimate the enemy!
Those Eagle Union newbies don't stand a chance against my Rei planes! This'll be a quick and easy victory!
... Enemy spotted! Recon planes, scramble! Don't let them get close!
H-how can that be?!
Go take cover in the storm! I'll draw the enemy's attention!
But sis...!
There's no time! We've already lost Shouhou, we can't afford to lose more people!
I will always protect you. But next time, don't underestimate the enemy...
Shoukaku...! I'll never, ever let that happen to you again...!
Sis! Thank god you're o...
Not you too...
... Why are you doing this?
An exquisite sacrifice is needed so that the Creator will continue gracing us with his blessings.
This is all for the sake of the Sakura Empire's future.
... "The Sakura Empire's future"... How many times do you think you can fool people with those words?!
And it doesn't stop at lying! Now you've dragged our people in your twisted experiments!
That cursed power is no gift from the gods! It won't deliver us our future!
I knew it... I knew all along that what you two were doing was crazy.
And by forcing my sister into your dirty little schemes, you've made me really, REALLY mad!
*Giggle*~ Have you thought about how you're going to defeat the enemy in front of you?
We've already offered her soul to the Creator. And now we will turn you into an empty husk as well!
Of course this is all a Pawn would be capable of... It's over. Come here!
Your soul is mine!
Gah...! I can't... move...!
What...?! Sho... Shoukaku?!
I promised... I would always... protect you...!
Sis, you're...
The Pawn defied us? How?!
She saved her sister from danger. Interesting...
(So even a Pawn will rush to protect those they love...)
This must be an Awakening Response... Brought on by remembering something important from the depths of her mind at just the right time...
Kaga, let's retreat. Our priority right now is to report to the Creator that a Pawn has Awakened.
Understood.
Hey, wait!
Argh... is that you... Zuikaku?
Sis?! Yeah, it's me! But more importantly, what did Akagi do to you?
I don't know... It... it feels like I just woke up from a long dream.
And don't worry, I feel fine.
In fact, I should apologize. For making you worry about your fool of a big sister.
Sis... I'm sorry... I haven't matured one bit... I'm still so reckless and shortsighted...
As long as you're safe and well, there is still hope... You are the only one who can defeat the enemy that is upon us...
I will always be by your side... always protecting you...
Always look forward, confidently... and stay true to our goals...
Sis...
Now go, chase after Akagi and Kaga... We cannot let them sully the Sakura Empire's future...
All logs have been submitted to the Creator. Now we wait for the arrival of our superiors.
... It seems that imbecile is chasing after us. What should we do about her?
We were given orders, and we successfully carried them out. It won't hurt to play a little with our pursuer.
I should've expected you to say that...
I thought you already sank in Midway... Just what are you people?!
We are what you see. In this Sanctuary bestowed upon us by the Creator, we wield unlimited power.
That is, as long as we continue sacrificing exquisite souls... *Giggle*...
No true "god" would demand sacrifices!
You'll never defeat the Grey Ghost with this twisted power that you've gained from betraying your own people! Never!
Silence! Don't you dare utter that name in my presence!
There's no future for you if you cannot face the Grey Ghost! Believe me, you still have a chance if you turn back now...
Enough! It drives me crazy to hear that despicable name repeated! Over and over! I will destroy her... I WILL DESTROY HER MYSELF! AAAGGHHH!
Akagi! ... Words will not save you, Zuikaku! Fight, and prove whether you are weak or strong!
Ahh... The glorious light born from clashing souls... O, Creator, please grace us with your attention... for this is the light of the Awakening you desire...
So beautiful, yet so frail... I can't help but want to crush it in my grasp... Ahahaha, ahahaha...
I thought this would happen... Very well. It seems this is where our plans come to an end.
Is that so...? How regrettable~ Then let us depart... *Giggle*... We shall find ourselves a new Sanctuary...
Hey... W-wait! I'm not finished with you...!
ERADICATION SEQUENCE INITIATED. PLEASE EVACUATE THE AREA IMMEDIATELY.
ERADICATION SEQUENCE INITIATED. PLEASE EVACUATE THE AREA IMMEDIATELY.
ERADICATION SEQUENCE INITIATED. PLEASE EVACUATE THE AREA IMMEDIATELY.
My sister, everything in this world has its cause and effect. We must always look for another possibility through this infinite cycle of death and rebirth...
That is why we conduct experiments in this Sanctuary.
One day you will understand the reason why we do what we do...
May all the gods watch over you...
The simulation at Test Site Gamma has concluded.
Hm? Let me see... Test Site Gamma...? Oh, that insignificant zoo of a test site...
Well, this is interesting. The copy created in the Sculpture Room experienced what looks like an Awakening.
Yes, that one. Hmm, "resists attempts at control and unleashes latent power to save her friends"... This is beyond our expectations.
Interesting... By deviating from their predetermined destiny, they've managed to break free from the shackles of fate... I thought we were in control of everything, but perhaps that was all a lie...
In either case, the question is if this is a true Awakening. It doesn't meet the right conditions.
Who knows. Ultimately, these intangible "emotions" are nothing more than electric signals in their processing centers.
Nevertheless, this is superb data. It seems the Creator has taken a liking to these girls.
Hmph! It's no more than the Creator's way of playing a joke on us.
The data shows... they need more experience. At the very least... we can't let them face each other yet.
Resetting all Pawns. Clearing all data. Increasing all parameters by 5%... Releasing the key... And so, the next round of testing begins...
The storm is too strong! We'll be annihilated if we try to ride it out!
We're committed now, we can't just give up! Trust me, we will break through this storm soon enough!
Unknown enemy detected, bearing 150 degrees! Initiate evasive maneuvers...
An unknown enemy, in a storm like this? Tell me its coordinates!
Answer me, Shoukaku! What are its coordinates?!
... Get... out of… here…
Crap, we're losing radio contact... This isn't looking good...
Damn it... I still haven't had the chance to fight the Grey Ghost...
... Wait, what's...? What's that light...?
Oh god!
... Where... am I?
Hey... I'm still in one piece! I made it!
Ow! My head hurts, though... And I don't remember what happened...
Damn... I can't radio Shoukaku... Now things really aren't looking good...
No, get it together! I finally made it, after all...
I made it here! To the Sanctuary!
What a sight to behold... The sea is entirely encompassed by the storm...
This looks like a graveyard for those who sought out the Sanctuary... Had I not been so lucky, this would have been my final resting place, too...
... Anyway, I need to establish radio contact with Shoukaku. This place is giving me the creeps...
These damn mass-produced piles of junk just keep coming... Bring it on! I'll take you all down if I have to!
Is that you, Akatsuki?! Good timing! I was worried about you ever since we got separated in the storm, but I'm glad to see you're okay!
Help me finish off these mindless drones so we can talk!
MISSION... DESTROY...
What the hell?! Watch where you're shooting! Hey, friendly fire! I'm not an enemy!
... Don't tell me you're...
EXTERMINATE... EXTERMINATE...
Son of a... They've made a Pawn out of Akatsuki...
It seems I was too late... Don't worry! I'll free you from this curse!
Rei planes, take off!
Hmph. So the 5th Carrier Division is on our tail.
That idiot has taken the bait. All systems normal.
The Sanctuary system check returned normal values. I suppose there is nothing to worry about.
Ah, the little one from the 5th Carrier Division? So persistent, yet so naïve...
Those who dare oppose the Creator shall pay for their ignorance with their lives.
Let's give them a little surprise. This is a perfect opportunity to test the new weapon the Creator gave us...
Those who dare stand between the Creator and me must be punished...
Dammit, one imposter after the next... If only I hadn't lost so many planes to that storm...
Huh? Is that a distress signal...? It could be Shoukaku!
Wait for me, sis! I won't lose you again...!
Ise... Hyuuga... So you two were the source of the signal, huh... Don't tell me you've...
Seems somebody's safe from being turned into a Pawn...
I figured as much... If it's a battle you want, then a battle you'll get!
Sis, check it out! This is the key to the Sanctuary!
The key... But how did you find it?
Heheh, that would be thanks to Akatsuki's intel! Surely you believe me this time, right?
If it really is the key, then we have to act now... Have everyone mobilize immediately!
This time we'll expose their plan for what it really is!
Now that I think about it, maybe this trap was also part of their plan...
Damn...! They tricked us, again!
I can't let you go any further, Zuikaku!
Yamashiro?! Surely they didn't get to you, too...
Of course not! I am who I've always been! I'm Yamashiro!
I'm here because I was ordered to prevent you from causing any ruckus in the Sanctuary...
So... could you please lay down your arms and surrender? Pretty please!
If you really are who you claim to be, then tell me: where is Shoukaku?
You'll have to defeat me if you want to know!
... This is ridiculous! Why do all my superiors have to be such a pain to deal with?!
Fine, have it your way! If a battle is what it takes to get an answer, then a battle it is!
I have to warn you: when I was being retrofitted, they installed some weird equipment on me... Apparently, I'm now an aviation battleship!
They worked hard on it, and I'm really, really strong now! I can even launch aircr- Ow, that hurt! Please let me finish before you start attacking!
Woah! Commander, hold it right there!

options.content: "I didn't think we’d run into the enemy so soon."

scripts.say: Hehe, long time no see, Commander~
After all, we were warned that Siren Pawns were on the move, and an exercise was staged as a countermeasure.
Ahahaha! So you've seen through me! ...Wait, hold on, that was a bad joke! I'm the real Hornet!
...Anyway, here’s the deal. There’s been a lot of weird weather conditions around these parts, most likely due to Siren activity in these waters.
I don't need to be lecturing you about how the Pawns created by the Mirror Seas sometimes fight just like us, so the point of the exercise is to get us familiar with that...
And I, Hornet, will be your opponent. How about it, Commander? Ready for some action?
Orders received. Simply approach Hornet’s fleet to begin the exercise.
Woah~ You sure don't beat around the bush, Commander! But now, it’s my turn!
Objective identified: repel Hornet in this exercise.
I've confirmed that you've scored a direct hit on Hornet with a dummy round.
You really came prepared, Commander! Good on ya!
You should've already been briefed on this, but there’s been a new Siren spotted during pre-operation scouting.
If you encounter a particularly tough battle, don't be afraid to withdraw.
For example, if you encounter something... like this~!
Warning: Based on an analysis of the incoming practice rounds, we are at a disadvantage. I would recommend withdrawing.

options.content: ....“All right, let’s stick to that plan and withdraw!”

scripts.say: Orders received. Currently reassembling the fleet.
Good job out there, Commander. And you too, Cutie-B.
...All right. Now that we're done with the exercise, it’s time to get the A-team together!
And if I'm not mistaken, the Royal Navy is ready as well... Let’s hurry to NY City Port and join up with them!~
Naval exercise complete.
Course has been plotted to NY City. Please enter the port there and assemble your fleet.
Orders received. We are now entering NY City’s waters.
The port is located that way. Please move the fleet towards the destination.
Tutorial commencing. Transferring data...
Data transfer complete. I will now explain my tactical assistance features.
First, we have the fundamental navigation system. This will display a basic visual overview of a chosen sector or zone on your screen.
"Does it also show me where enemies and resource nodes are?" – That is correct. Said features are all accessible through this menu.
Special orders to the fleet can also be issued using my intermediary relay module. This will invariably ensure the message reaches its addressee.
...Orders received. Commencing test of order function.
Scan complete. Now displaying results of zone reconnaissance on screen.
Orders received. Commencing test of Scanning Mode.
Scattered Siren hostiles have been detected.
Scanning Mode has been calibrated. Scanning Mode can now be used on hostile fleets and points of interest such as item nodes.
Transferring data... Scanning the yellow tile host to an item node is recommended.
Scanning Mode can provide you with both detailed and general information on enemies, resource nodes, item caches, and more. Making frequent use of it is recommended.
Orders received. Select a target to scan.
Should you need assistance with navigation, it can be found here on your screen at any time.
Plot a course to NY City to inspect its logistics facilities.
You can manage your Operation Siren fleet from the NY City port.
This, of course, includes changing your fleet composition.
While docked in port, you are also able to buy items in the store, or repair any damaged ships in your fleet.
Here you may also view and undertake any special missions issued by naval headquarters.
Next, let us go over the item retrieval tutorial.
An item container has been located. To commence recovery of it, simply move your fleet onto it.
Commencing inventory tutorial.
Here you can view all the various items you have gathered throughout Operation Siren, such as repair items, exchange shop currencies, and the like.
Materials used in the Gear Lab and R&D are stored on the Materials tab.
It is believed that we will procure additional resources and design blueprints throughout the course of Operation Siren.
Filters can be used to only display things such as designs that may be developed.
