Now, though, the wind is gentle and brushes against the white sands and azure waves, signaling the beach area's full restoration.
Haha, wow! This is the spitting image of a golden beach!
Swimsuits and waves! Now this is what a vacay looks like!
This exciting achievement calls for a grand concert.
All who wish to participate, please report to me.
My music shall be outdone by none.
We fighting with beats now? Hahah! You're getting me fired up!
Heehee. This may be an opportunity to steal my Commander's eyes... An opportunity I must seize before anyone else.
(Things are heating up here... I should lay low and find somewhere else to go.)
For some reason, I've come to the docks. There is also some kind of event being held here.
A fishing competition? Hmm. Yes, I think this vacation would feel a little lacking without one.
How curious... Holding this fishing rod puts me in the mood to perform an iai slash.
Fishing as an activity is often underestimated. Those who plan ahead, however, are more likely to be rewarded with good luck.
What are your thoughts, Commander?

options.content: I'm confident you'll catch a ton of fish.
Here's hoping that you don't finish emptyhanded.

scripts.say: Heh. What you say is true. Tempering your character through fishing is how you learn to adapt to changing situations.
Whether you reel in a big catch or come up empty, it's all determined in one blink of destiny.
Despite her talk of destiny, her dignity as a supposed "professional" won't allow her to get sloppy.
Can't wait to see you in action, my fishing buddy.
I will do everything in my power, then wait for destiny's hand.
As I'm about to say goodbye to Huan Ch'ang amidst her ever-increasing enthusiasm, Memphis comes to speak to me.
Commander, work on the beach area is more or less done.
Up next, the finale of our reconstruction project – the lighthouse area.
Based on the footage the recon planes sent, the lights atop the lighthouse have suffered extensive damage and can no longer perform their duty of guiding ships.
We'll have to go through the forest behind the villa to reach the lighthouse and complete the work.
Perfect. All the outdoor equipment we set up the other day is gonna come in handy!
Again, this is the last part of the reconstruction project. Once the lighthouse area is finished, we can all fully enjoy this vacation!
Let's set off right now, then. To the lighthouse area!
And so, reconstruction work on the lighthouse area officially began.

sequence:
Midsummer Returns: The Villa Reconstruction

<size=45>7 Let the Miracle Shine</size>

scripts.say: *sniff sniff*... Still smells a bit humid in here.
*huff*... Mystery is silently waiting for us in the airborne dust.
Great Scott...
Scattered whispers seep out from the deepest dark and, like strands of cold spider silk, tightly link my mind to a forgotten tragic past...
Though I've yet to lay eyes on this shapeless terror, its ominous secrets already have my heart in a tight, unrelenting grip...
This marks the beginning of...
The adventure of the murder at the snow-covered lighthouse!
The adventure of the cursed light and the invisible ghost!
The adventure of the nameless disappearance in the cellar... Hey, how come your names sound cooler than mine?!
...My lamp just glimmered. Was it reacting to something over there? Is that a sign that a secret route just unlocked?
I see! You're kinda spoiling the B-story, though!
————————BACK TO THE MAIN PLOT————————
As usual, nothing they say ever makes sense...
Well, that's that. The lighthouse area has been rebuilt. Outstanding work, Commander.
It's now time for the completion ceremony we prepared for you, Commander.
Come, servant! By my side! You organised this great undertaking, and that qualifies you to receive this honour!
The morning glow dyes the sea a warm orange color, casting a shimmer like flowing champagne over the newly rebuilt lighthouse.
The girls lead me to the activation switch for the lighthouse, which has a colorful ribbon tied to its front.
Now, you just need to cut the ribbon and activate the lighthouse.
Here, scissors. I prepared them specifically for you.
Nagato produces a pair of scissors with unique ornamental mizuhiki knots tied to the handles.
Accept our congratulations and blessings.
Thank you.
Belfast hands me the scissors on Nagato's behalf, and I cut the ribbon.
A quick and clean cut.
I was expecting there to be a speech first.
Getting straight to the point suits the Commander just as well.
With so many expectant eyes upon me, I start expressing my sincere feelings without any polish or planning.
I'm proud of what you've all achieved over the past few days.
I honestly had no idea things would turn out like this when I started planning the vacation.
Still, having you by my side makes everything more fun.
And that's all I wanted to say.
Not wanting to drag things out, I cut the ribbon.
Now our vacation can really begin!
Well, then...
Once again, the reconstruction of the lighthouse – no, I should say the whole island resort – is now complete!
Get out there and enjoy your villa vacation, everyone!

sequence:
Midsummer Returns: The Villa Reconstruction

<size=45>8 All Is Done and It's Time to Party!</size>

scripts.say: In the underground game room, neon lights flicker and illuminate the figures of the guests.
Among the crowds, Hatsuzuki, wearing her beloved dress, gently shakes her glass with a strange, mischievous grin.
Heehee. Your attention, please!
There's only one rule to the game party tonight – have as much fun as you can!
You, too, Commander! Have a good time!
You don't want to leave because I'm by your side, isn't that right, my Commander?
Wrong. You're having fun because you're here with me, correct, Commander?
Heehee... So you're issuing a declaration of war, I see.
Hm? Say, Commander, why don't we forget about all the humdrum interpersonal relationships and have some strawberry cake? Here!
Why, you... Heehee. It goes without saying that my cherry cake is better. Please open your mouth, my Commander!
(What to do? Should I just run for it?)
Commander? Hellooo? Why are you just standing there?
I'm waiting for you to have a taste, my Commander!
(I appreciate what they're trying to do, but there's only one of me.)
Sorry for butting in, but I've got drinks for you!
Hatsuzuki comes along, pushing a cart. She is my salvation in this moment of desperation.
Heehee. Why are you making that face?
Don't worry, I'm rooting for you in my heart!
I'm not going to save you, though. I know how to pick my fights!
Um, excuse me, Hatsuzuki... Could you bring us some juice?
Sure thing!
So... I can't take both feet off the ground at the same time?
Ugh, this is so hard... Need to stay balanced, or I'll fall over!
I'll keep you stable. Just breathe and take the shot.
There! ...I-I did it! It went in.
Ahem... Yes, it sure did.
The cue ball, that is.
I'm afraid that's a foul, Janus.
A... A foul?!
Hey! I've got the juice you asked for.
Hatsuzuki! We need you for a sec!
Gallant and some friends are enthusiastically playing a board game. They raise their hands toward Hatsuzuki.
I'll be right there!
You certainly look busy. Perhaps you need the help of a gorgeous lady like me, hmm?
I'm willing to lend a hand, but first, you must praise the beauty of the Royal Navy!
Miss Victorious, here is the wine that you ordered.
Actually, I withdraw my offer. Helping people just doesn't work to accentuate my beauty.
What?! Nooo! Why'd I have to draw the go-to-jail card?!
Me, of all people! The captain of the Guards! The protector of justice and order! The designer of our barriers and gates!
And now I'm being thrown into jail?!
Have no fear! Captain Pompey will save you!
With this card, I'll... Hm? "Swap"? My character swaps statuses with the player ahead of me?
Well... It's just a game! A trifling matter like this could never perturb the almighty Captain Pompey!
Urgh... My stomach hurts all of a sudden... Can I leave my seat for five minu– Actually, until the end of the round?
Oh, a property purchase card! It's for the... Wait, it's for the haunted hotel?! Oh hell yeah!
So, owning this property means you can actually make everyone who passes by cough up a hefty sightseeing fee?!
Phew! Good thing I landed in prison. Hahaha!
NOOOOOO!
Did you say... "haunted"?
The very next moment, Fei Yuen's piece rushes toward the haunted hotel without a hint of hesitation.
Heheh! Lady Yuen's time has come!
Onward at full speed! This is our vacation adventure!
Just as her piece lands on the haunted hotel, Janus finally sinks a red ball into the pocket.
After an intense feeding battle, Taihou and Formidable, in a synchronized move, launch their next offensive...
Amidst cheers and laughter, all my fatigue melts into pleasant memories. Our hard work has paid off.
This never-ending villa vacation has only just begun.

sequence: Midsummer Returns: The Villa Reconstruction - The End

scripts.say: Mmh! Sho good! I want seconds!
Hrmh... Does this have black pepper in it? I want something sweeter...
Lacking in presentation, but the flavour gets a pass. I cannot argue it isn't authentic, since this stew is your local dish, after all, Liverpool.
Heheh. I don't usually make it since I've had it so much that I've grown right bored of it. I gave it my all for this cooking competition, though!
Despite being one of the judges, quite frankly, I still do not see the point in this competition.
Some Empery girls suggested it. Heard whoever wins gets the honour of being the villa's head chef, and that's why I signed up!
BOOM! BANG!
Whuah?! What was that?
It came from the kitchen. We should take a look.
*cough cough*... All the seasonings...
*cough cough*... It seems an aprone alone isn't enough. I'll need to wear sleeve covers as well.
What're you doing in here?! Trying to blow up the kitchen?!
There's chilli sauce covering everything up to the shelves... Are you making some nouveau chilli sauce-based graffiti art?
No! We're seriously cooking here! We just made a small mistake.
Amagi, are you okay?
*cough cough*... Stand back, Mutsuki. You wouldn't want to get hit with flying hot oil.
Miss Amagi, you just can't just drop a still-wet fish into hot oil. It'll go everywhere as soon as it hits the pan!
Well, I can safely say I know what score they'll get for this.
Hey, they still have a chance! It's rude to both the chef and the food to grade it before it's even been plated!
Wait, what happened to the pressure cooker?! It's pitch black! Who did this?!
It's been carbonised through and through. I'm afraid it's destined for the rubbish heap.
But my stew isn't done... I-is there a spare pressure cooker?
Sadly, no. Maybe try with another dish? Like sushi, maybe.
I do have rice for sushi, but no fish. I'd never dare to use half-fried fish as a topping.
I've got loads of sardines left, at least! You can use 'em for your sushi if you want!
Sardines? Those might just work.
What dish will you make, Cheshire? I cannot for the life of me determine what it is you're cooking.
Heheh, come on, it's obvious. I'm making my speciality – the famous dish in all of the Royal Isla–
*sigh*... You're making fish and chips. I see. I truly shouldn't have gotten my hopes up.
A while later, the food was done. The girls decided to start with the sardine sushi.
Yeah, it works. Would probably taste better if they weren't so cold.
Om, nom... It tastes like home! Nom, nom!
This sushi has been delicately made and its presentation is excellent. The flavour, on the other hand... It's simply alright.
Heehee. I'm just glad that you like it.
Alright, then it's Cheshire's fish and chips next.
I don't have high hopes for this, but... Hrmh?! This flavour isn't what I expected!
Sweet fishies!
(Huh?! Sweet?! No way! Don't tell me I mixed up the sugar and salt!)
And these fries – so spicy!
(Spicy?! Did I use chilli sauce in place of tomatoes?)
Hmm. I'm surprised by how filling this is. I thought it was a snack food.
The sweet fish and spicy chips come together well, like they were dipped in a sweet and spicy sauce. This is a surprisingly good combination.
I admit I was too quick to judge. You're a more capable cook than I gave you credit for, Cheshire.
I-I am? Really?
Really. Now let's announce the results. The winner of this cooking competition is–
Hello!
The one who must not be allowed to cook suddenly appears before the girls.
Whew, finally. You're having a cooking competition, right? I'd like to participate!
M-miss Chi An?! Uh, well, sorry to say, but the competition just wrapped up.
Aww. That's fine, though! Even if I can't be the head chef, I'm happy with just getting to share my cooking with all of you! I'll start right–
No! Don't let her into the kitchen!
The panel and the participants all rushed toward Chi An at once. They feared that an unexpected disaster would come out of the kitchen sooner than an unexpected hit.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Onwards to a Royal Fortune</size>

scripts.say: It's a brilliant summer day. The still blue seas reflect the sun's rays like a mirror, sharing its cozy warmth with us.
Gosh, it sure is hot today! As much as I love the sun, I feel like I'm gonna melt~
Perfect weather for a nap... Zzzzz...
I brought ice cream from the freezer. Who wants some?
Me, please.
Here you go. And one for you, Commander.
I take a bite out of the ice cream Z23 handed me. A lovely blend of chocolate and cream fills my mouth.
A leisurely day in clear skies, warm waters, and cool winds. What more could one want?
Still no sign of that treasure... Where on earth could it be?
We've been sailing for quite some time now. It should be around here, yes.
Meaning, we should find it any minute now!
Guess I'll be on the lookout... Zzzzz...
Indeed, the real reason we're out at sea isn't to enjoy the weather, but to find treasure.
As for how we learned there was treasure out here to begin with, it's a long story...
Port - Office
By the way, Commander, a strange letter just arrived.
It's from Royal Fortune, whom I'm sure you remember as...

options.content: "The girl who held me captive last Halloween?"

scripts.say: The very same. She's a real piece of work, that one...
The letter's marked "For the Commander's eyes only," but we decided to check it before you opened it.
Just as a safety precaution to ensure there's nothing dangerous inside. You know the drill.
Anyway, here.
The back of the thick envelope was embellished with a wax stamp featuring a pirate motif.
Opening it, I found a map and a sheet of old parchment paper with some sort of poem written on it.
"The easterly wind calls on ye, with courage and pluck, to a land o' gold beyond the sea..."
"There lies a treasure for which kings will kill, pirate blood will spill, and many search for still..."
"Hearken! If this treasure ye crave, then embark on this hunt, and prove ye are brave!"
"The winds be with ye, Commander."
What is this? A treasure map?
"Knowing Royal Fortune, it's got to be."
Hello, hello, Commander!
We've worked out a vacation plan and came to discuss it with...
Oh, what's that? A treasure map?
"Embark on this hunt, and prove ye are brave..." Where did you get this, Commander?
Yeah, I wanna know too...
I quickly told them about Royal Fortune and how I got this map.
Interesting... Yes, we'll be right back.
Huh? Weren't you going to discuss your vacation plan?
Well, in light of the situation, our plans have changed.
Yeah! We're gonna go on a treasure hunt instead!
Seize the day... And the booty...
Will you come with us, Commander?
It was clear they were all raring to go.
Since I didn't have anything planned for my vacation, I thought, "Why not?"
And so, we embarked together in search of treasure.
What do you think this treasure is, anyway?
Since we got this map from a self-proclaimed pirate, maybe it's a chest full of gold coins and jewels?
I think it's an ancient relic with potent magical powers.
I'm hoping it's a fluffy pillow...
A pillow is hardly worth being called pirate treasure.
I guess so... A fluffy pillow made of diamonds, then...
A pillow like that would be the literal opposite of fluffy.
Come on, don't be such a wet blanket...
Yes. Anything is possible in a video game.
A video game? Seriously?
That's just wishful thinking. We don't live in a video game.

options.content: "We don't?! My whole life is a lie!"

scripts.say: See? The Commander agrees. Let's at least try to take this seriously.
Commander, please don't enable them.
I'll be right back. I'm going to restock on ice elementals.
It's called "ice cream"... Also, don't eat too much.
Their treasure talk does make me wonder what we'll find.
That's of course assuming the treasure exists in the first place.
It could be gold, it could be precious gems... Even a soft diamond pillow isn't entirely impossible.
But to me, this adventure is as good as any real treasure there is.
The waves gently crash against the bow of our vessel as we continue sailing onwards to unexplored lands.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Turtle Sanctuary</size>

scripts.say: After a while of strolling along the coast, I realize I've ended up in the north corner of the island.
The beach is beautiful, with shells of various colors dotting the sand.
A few turtles lie in the open, silently sunbathing. And, what's more...
Zzzzz...
Resting atop a reef circled by the turtles, is Laffey, fast asleep.
The waves splash against the reef gently, leaving behind junk and bits of driftwood in its wake.
It seems this is a place of convergence for sea currents.
I attempt to tiptoe my way over to Laffey, but the sound of my feet walking on the sand wakes her up.
*yaaawn*... Good morning, Commander...
The sunshine is so cozy here, so warming...
I was cleaning up beach trash for the turtles, and I guess I took a nap at some point...
"Can't blame you. Warm, glorious sunlight plus a cooling breeze is a recipe for an irresistible siesta."
"Maybe we should build a beach hut and turn this into a rest area."
A place to sit and watch the turtles sound comfy... I think people would like that...
But at the same time, this is the turtles' home... We don't wanna disrupt it...
"You're right. Living in harmony with nature matters more than a beach hut."
"Establishing a rest area somewhere else is an option, but all this trash littering the beach will be an eyesore."
"I say we do the turtles a favor and help clean up this place thoroughly."
Good idea. We don't want them choking on bits of plastic...
I'll help. That nap topped off my batteries...
And so, Laffey and I cleared the turtles' natural habitat of all that junk.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Fishing Friends</size>

scripts.say: Just a while away from here is a sea bird habitat where schools of fish congregate.
There were only flocks of birds there on my last visit, but now even from quite some distance, I can hear a group of girls laughing.
Ahah! Got another one!
Check it out! It's got to be the biggest we've caught today!
I caught a pretty large one too.
At this rate, we'll be set for a quán yú yàn tonight!
Huh? A what?
It means, "whole fish feast." It's a full-course meal consisting of fish dishes.
I can hardly wait. Yat Sen said she'll go all-out tonight with tonight's dinner if we bring her enough fish.
Looks like the girls are all catching fish.
A flock of seagulls off to the side seems to be observing them with curiosity.
They must be wondering how on earth they're getting so many fish when they can't even fly.
There'll be a lot of us, so I think we should catch extra.
Oh, that reminds me... I want to try the trick Laffey taught me.
Ayanami bends down and whispers something to a seagull.
After which, it seems to nod its head and take off into the air.
"You've got to be kidding me..."
Hi, Commander. Here to fish?

options.content: "First of all, what was that about?"

scripts.say: Well, Laffey told me the seagulls on this island are super friendly.
So I told Squawkey that he can sit at the dinner table tonight if he brings some fish.
"Squawkey? Who's that?"
The seagull. He squawks, so I named him Squawkey.
Oh, look. He's back.
Squawk! Squawk!
The seagull Ayanami spoke to returns to her side and drops off the fish held in its beak.
Squawk! Squaaawk!
It lets out a cheerful cry, as though it's eagerly anticipating tonight's dinner, then flies off again.
It seems we'll have to prepare a chair to seat a seagull.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Coconut Desserts</size>

scripts.say: Back when I'd looked around the island before, I noticed a palm forest to the east.
When I hear that the Royal Maids were collecting ingredients for dessert there, I decide to go there myself.
La la la la laaaa~♪
Ooh! Are you here for ingredients, too, Master?
You're not? You just came to watch us work?
Okaaay... But I'm happy to see you, Master!
Oh, yeah! How about you taste-test the fresh-baked sweets me and the others made?
Not far from Manchester, I spot the food truck the maids use for cooking on-the-go.
On the counter sits a drink that glows red for some reason and a dessert served in a coconut shell.
("Me and the others"? That must mean one of those ISN'T made by Manchester!)
Overindulging on sweets is bad for you, so pick just one, Master!
Noticing my gaze, she brings both of the items over to me.
(Manchester's food is so dangerous that she's usually forbidden from cooking. In that case...)
(It might look terrifying, but maybe the trick is that it's actually the safer one to consume.)
(...Nope! Absolutely wrong!)
Heheh! I mixed chili powder and turmeric powder into the coconut milk to make a special flavor that really packs the heat of summer!
Do you like it, Master?
(Chili powder AND turmeric powder)
(It'll be a while before I recover from this trauma...)
(That glowing red drink looks life-threatening, so it probably IS life-threatening.)
(The sweets sampler looks much more normal in comparison.)
(White coconut oil, blue nata de coco, tasty-looking whipped cream.)
(At least it looks safe...)
"Let's see how it tastes... Hm? I don't actually taste anything."
"The mouthfeel is what you'd expect, but I don't taste anything. Not even sweetness..."
Oh, Sirius made this one!
She didn't want it to be all sugary and unhealthy, so she revised the recipe a little!
Do you like it, Master?
(It'll be a while before I recover from this trauma...)

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Valley of the Hot Spring</size>

scripts.say: I decide to take a stroll through the forest near the provisional camp.
Ugh... Fubuki, where did you go?
Commander, have you seen Fubuki around?
Oh... So you haven't, either...
We were just gathering mushrooms together, and the moment we look away from her...
What if some shipgirl-eating monster in the forest got her?
Oh, no... Commander, what do we do?
"Even if there was a monster in this forest, I'm sure Fubuki could hold her own against it."
"And as long as she wasn't ambushed, you'd hear a struggle, right?"
R-right... I do feel a little better...
Heeey! Who'd you say got eaten by a monster?
Actually, forget that. I found this really cool place! Get over here! You're gonna be amazed!
We follow Fubuki's directions and meet up with her at the foot of a mountain.
The valley has a naturally-occurring hot spring formed by geothermal vents, emitting hot water vapor.
C-could this be...?
A hot spring...?
That's right! It's a volcanic hot spring, at that!
If we develop it just right, we can help our friends relax when they come to the island!
"A natural hot spring, of all things. I agree; building a resort is the ideal move here."
Hehehe~ Commander, I'm just the cat for the job, nya~ Leave it all to me, nya!
A-Akashi?! You really do pop up out of nowhere when you smell a way to get rich quick...
Where there are customers, there is business to be done, nya!
Whaddya say, Commander? Can I get to work on this new venture, nya?
Can I, nya? No complaints, nya?
I guarantee you that my capable paws will make this the finest hot spring resort you've ever seen, nya!
Overcome by Akashi's strong willpower—or maybe greed—I allow her to begin building a hot spring resort on the deserted island.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Safety...First?</size>

scripts.say: Our scouting and development of the island continue without issue.
In the seas around the island...
Our northern patrols are complete. Nothing out of the ordinary.
East's all good, too!
The west is safe, as well. Our recon is proceeding outward in the same direction.
At present, nothing unusual has been spotted to the south. Everyone, continue as planned.
Cardinal, we've been at it for so long now. How about we just call it safe?
That won't do. We know nothing about this island.
And we plan to turn it into a resort, don't we? We should take safety seriously.
Instead of complaining, La Galissonnière, focus on your work.
Yeah, yeah.
I'm EVEN willing to dive and search underwater if it means making sure the coast is clear for the Commander and our friends.
No worries! I've already checked underwater with my mass-produced ships~ We didn't find anything, of course.
I-I was just kidding, geez!
(Hahaha! It seems there's nothing to worry about at this time.)
(But something tells me this island is a little bit too bountiful...)
Regardless, it must be thanks to the blessing of the Iris that we were able to happen upon such natural riches.
We'll leave the next round of patrols to the mass-produced ships. As for us, it's about time we help develop the island.
Roger!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Get It While It's Hot</size>

scripts.say: The island's development is going swimmingly thanks to everyone's hard work.
The sun sets in the west, and the night sky begins lighting up with glittering stars.
As I arrive back at the camp, a massive steel object erected on the beach catches my eye.
It takes me a second to figure out what it is...
Look! A barbecue grill!
I mean... Yeah, by all appearances, it's a barbecue grill...
But look how HUGE it is! Why would you ever need one THIS big?
Capacity. Not only can you grill way much more food at once, but you also keep that smoky flavor.
That is the purpose of the Grillinator Mk II, designed by none other than Iron Blood's corps of engineers.~
Needless to say, we're making enough barbecue to feed an army tonight!
Well... How are we going to get enough ingredients for such a huge grill, though?
Hey, we're back. We caught a lot of good game out there.
I'm eating good tonight! Throw some meat on that barbecue!
Now, now, we can also grill fish and vegetables.~
I want some fish and carrots...
Yes. Kombu with scallops is worth trying as well.
Let's not forget about some fruits! I picked a bunch out in the forest!
I even found some coconuts. Can you grill those?
Should work, wunnit?
...Eugen, seeing as everyone has brought so many ingredients, I think we should set up a self-serve area.
Not a bad idea. Wait right here, I'll fetch some tools.
Mmm-mmh! This is gonna be delicious!
But those skewers look even tastier. I might just start with those!
Few things in life can compare to a barbecue party at sunset on a tropical island~~
...Hm? What's up, Shoukaku? Not hungry?
I just want to enjoy the sight of the setting sun and the first stars of the night a while longer. The food can wait.
Don't wait for me. Dig in if you'd like.
What she's really saying is that if she starts now, she won't know when to stop, so she'll put on a few kilos.
Shush with you!
Whether due to the giant grill or the scent of barbecue, the beach has attracted a crowd of curious girls from all factions.
The lonely island in the middle of the ocean is enveloped in a lively atmosphere, becoming a harbor of warmth.
It's been a while since we had a get-together this big.
Oh, and Bismarck, can't you try to relax your poker face for once?
Everyone else is having a lovely time, so the least you can do is smile.
Like... this?
Close, but no cigar. Look here and say "cheese"!
With a flash from Eugen's phone camera, another happy moment is captured forever.
Why don't you have a seat, Commander? I'll bring you a plate of barbecue.
Would you like a little borscht as well? Volga made it.
But we won't have any room for barbecue if we stuff ourselves on borscht!
As much as I wanna eat both, my stomach doesn't have that kind of capacity...
I suppose so. Too much of a good thing, as they say...
Then how about a toast, Commander? I don't believe anyone has made one yet.~
She's right. A toast will cap off this incredible evening.

options.content: "A toast! To a fun-packed vacation on this island!"
"To a banquet like this every day moving forward! Cheers!"

scripts.say: Cheers!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Tea by the Sea</size>

scripts.say: Beneath a clear blue sky, a lively tea party is taking place.
Yum! Nobody makes blueberry pudding like our Belfast!
It tastes like summer – sour-sweet♪
And let's not forget these fluffy pastries. They're simply divine.
You must share your secrets after this, Belfast.
You flatter me so. I'm delighted to hear it is to your taste.
Fresh coconut juice and a sea breeze to cool the body... It's so reinvigorating.
I've prepared a wide variety of desserts today. You may pick and choose your favourites.
Master, if I may, I'd like you to try my chef d'oeuvre.
"Thanks, Belfast."
We've earned this break after all that legwork. But, we need to make the most of it, as our work is far from over!
Just look at the hot spring. It's nowhere near finished.
Furthermore, there's untapped potential everywhere across this island!
We could build a water park, holiday houses, and a food court serving cuisines from all corners of the world!
The possibilities are endless, wouldn't you say?

options.content: "This will be the ultimate island resort!"
"We need to think about the environment, too."

scripts.say: Exactly! However, we must pick up the pace, lest the Sakura Empire steal the show with their hot spring.
You say that like I haven't already, servant!
Now that the pier is finished, it'll be quicker to transport goods around the island.
Aye. Z23 commands praise for finding such an ideal location.
Speaking of goods, me and a couple others placed an order for something special.
I reckon it'll arrive in a few days.
Betcha wonder what it is? That's a secret!
Now I'm curious! Err... By which I mean, you are not ordinarily the secret-keeping type.
This is a special occasion. Think of it as a surprise.
This island resort project is materializing rapidly thanks to everyone's hard work.
Aside from the fact I haven't seen Royal Fortune for a while, everything is going swimmingly.
But, I feel as though I've forgotten something amidst all this hustle and bustle...
The question is, what?
Say, the weather is perfect for sunbathing. Anyone interested?
I have plenty of sunscreen to go around, so that's no issue.
Sounds lovely. Will you be joining us, Commander?
Throw in a beachside barbecue and I'm in!
Let's go, Commander! Bring your swimming gear!
New Jersey drags me out of my seat, and that's when I remember it.
The reason we came here to begin with was to look for treasure.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Titillating Sunbathing Time</size>

scripts.say: A golden beach under the brilliant sun. White waves caress the shore, their sound like music to my ears.
But, that sound is all but drowned out by my racing heart.
Hi, honey~ Seeing as I've got your attention, wanna sunbathe with me?
Ahh... Chilling on a sunny beach while sipping a nice tropical drink. This is what summer's all about!
Here, honey – enjoy~
Wait, lemme have a sip first! ...Yeah, you're gonna love this. Try it!
With some hesitation, I accept the glass she's already had a sip from, and drink it.
What's up, honey? You're blushing. Sun too much for you?
Ooor, is it the fact we had an indirect kiss? That's no big deal, if you ask me~
Oh, I know. In exchange for the drink, can you apply sunscreen on me?
I love lying in the sunshine as much as the next girl, but I can do without getting sunburned.
...Whatcha looking at, hmm? My eyes are up here, honey.
Checking out my swimsuit? So you DO love it♪

options.content: "What can I say? It looks great on you."
"It's a bit... TOO sexy for my liking."

scripts.say: Of course it does. You're the one who picked it out♪
So you say, but you chose it.
Hahaha! You're blushing again~ You've got "New Jersey has stolen my heart" written all over your face♪
...Whuah! That's cold!
Getting back at me using the glass, huh? Fair enough. Now apply the sunscreen, will you?
Ooh, that's the ticket. Nice and slippery...
So, whatcha wanna do next, honey?
No? Hahaha! I know exactly what you're thinking.
If it's too embarrassing to say out loud then don't. But don't play stupid either.
Oh, honey~ You're so cute when you blush♪
Now get comfy next to me and let's sunbathe♥

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>The Dark Dragon's Invitation</size>

scripts.say: You. What do you think you're doing?
While I'm walking along the coast of the marina, Regensburg abruptly calls out to me.
Don't act like you don't recognize me just because I'm wearing new attire.
I can read you like an open book. Obviously, you're floored by my swimsuit.
...I'm wrong, you say?
Tsk. Fine, deny it all you want, but you cannot hide the desires that urge your body onwards.
Stop putting on airs. Tell me how you really– Eep! H-hands off my tail, you dog!
Hmph. Don't give me that smug look. Misreading you is bad enough without you rubbing salt in the wound...
Ahem... That's enough beating around the bush.
Since you're here, why don't we do something relaxing?
You're supposed to be on vacation, yet all you think about is developing the island. Forget about all that for a while, will you?
If it's yacht races you fancy, you can spectate them from here. And if it's hands-on action you want, I'll fill the entry form for you.
Or, if you simply want to lie down and relax, that's fine too. The sand on this beach is lovely.
...Come again? You want to go someplace quiet to be alone with me?
Okay then... If it's what you want, I suppose I can do that.
Just to be clear, I'm agreeing to this out of my own will – not out of obedience to you...
So, don't you dare say you've subjugated the dragon!
She covers my mouth with her hand, like she's too embarrassed to hear anything from me.
Look, I know. Don't talk – let your actions speak for you.
Now come on. Take me wherever you want to go!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Exploring the Forest</size>

scripts.say: Near the island's center, a team of girls wade through a forest, pushing through dead branches and bushes as they go.
The sun shines through the gaps between the leaves, casting fuzzy shadows of the people walking through.
Hmm...
Huh?
Hey, um, Rossiya?
Was there always a fork in the road here? It's not marked on the map.
Because it's a rough map. Our job is to fill in the details such as this.
Let's see... There, I've updated the topography.
This is sooo boring... There's only trees, trees, and more trees!
I hoped there'd be a groundbreaking discovery waiting in this vast place, but nope...
I have machines to be working on, but instead, I'm surveying a regular old forest!
Oh, I know! Why don't we just chop down all the trees?
Then we won't need to map out the forest at all!
...*whack!*
Owww! You hit me, Grozny!
This forest is the animals' home. It should be protected.
Cutting a forest down because you don't wanna survey it is pretty extreme, don't you think?
It is. While it would net us a lot of lumber, that's not what we're here for.
The task at hand is to catalog the local ecosystem, locate areas suited for construction and resource-gathering, and mark boundaries for expansion.
Additionally, we must completely clear the forest of potential dangers.
Although we have been thorough thus far, it's possible we've missed something.
Be wary around bushes and other hiding places, where threats may lie in wait.
"Threats"? What kind of threats?
Poisonous insects and snakes and the like. You won't find those with an aerial survey.
An even greater danger lurks here according to those I've spoken to, that being the–
Whuah?! Wh-what the hell is this?!
Soobrazitelny stepped on a snare trap hidden among the leaves, leaving her hanging from the tree upside-down.
...That being the vine plants that ensnare their prey.
As demonstrated by our subject Soobrazitelny here.
Save the explanation for later! Get me down from here!
*cough cough cough*... Damn tentacle plant...
Just you wait. I'm gonna make a bunch of flamethrower bots and sic 'em on you...
They'll find and burn every last of your kind to a crisp... Hehehehe...
Soobrazitelny's turning into a mad scientist. I'm scared.
Ahahah... I dig your inspiration, but remember, be careful about forest fires.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Stranded... and That's Okay!</size>

scripts.say: Right before our eyes, the tranquil seas turn tempestuous and a storm whips up.
Fierce gales rattle the rails, a downpour showers the deck, and the windstorm threatens to tear our hull in two.
Oh my gosh! We've sailed right into a storm!
"The weather is a fickle mistress. However, our vessel should withstand anything this storm throws at us."
I'm not so sure! The navigation system is on the fritz, and our comms equipment is down after that thunderstrike!
I'm trying to change course, but it's impossible to fight the storm! The propulsion system is starting to fail as well!
CRAAASH!
Uh-oh... Commander, we just hit a rock...
Things go from bad to worse. I fear the worst – that we'll run aground. But to run aground, there must be land nearby.
Oh! I can see something that wasn't visible prior to the storm... Over there!
Look, Commander! An island!
Yes. It must be the mythical island that only appears during a storm, where the treasure is hidden.
We'll be in deep-sea trouble if we lose our ship... Let's go to that island and wait out the storm!
"Doesn't look like we have much other choice right now. To that island we go!"
Phew, we made it in one piece... Not dry, though! I'm soaked through!
Yes, but the rain is waning. The skies will hopefully clear soon.
No need to go looking for shelter...
A few minutes later, the sun pokes through the grey clouds above. Not long after that, the storm vanishes into thin air.
Then, we see the island clearly, in all its verdant glory. We disembark on the beach and step down onto the golden sand.
Beyond these shores is a lush forest, and then a large volcano rising over the treeline in the distance.
This is probably the most picturesque vacation island anyone has ever seen.
...But, it's not exactly the kind of place you'd want to be shipwrecked in.
The good news is, we're not experiencing any Mirror Sea jamming. The bad news is... we still can't contact the port.
The storm likely hasn't entirely subsided yet. Don't worry, we'll probably be fine, we just need to wait.
"I suppose we'll just have to survive on this island until rescue arrives."
Shouldn't be that hard, since we made it out alright!
Setting off in search of treasure, getting stranded on a deserted island, and being forced to survive in the wilderness...
It's so cliché, but it's so good.
Typically, this is the point where we explore and gather materials needed for survival.
This place looks pretty big, so there should be plenty to forage.
It seems today is the day your game knowledge might end up saving our lives...
I endorse Ayanami's idea. To survive, we'll need to learn our surroundings and erect a provisional camp.
So, I suggest we all spread out until evening and search the island for materials to build a shelter with.
We've officially respecced as explorers...
Sounds good to me! I've been feeling too comfortable back at the port and could use a little adventure!
Oh, to be as carefree as you three... Commander, what do you think?
I, too, could use a little adventure.
Who's to say you can't make something fun out of being shipwrecked? They all seem to think so.
"Let's have a look around and see what we can find."

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>We Want Fresh Vegetables</size>

scripts.say: Hmm... The taste is a bit of a letdown.
The problem with shipping vegetables to the island is that they lose some of their flavor inside the freezer containers.
Then we have to find fresh veggies, 'cause I need your tasty veggie baozis to live!
You won't die without them... Anyway, fresh veggies are precisely what we're here to look for.
In a flat area to the northwest of the camp, I bump into Ning Hai and Ping Hai having a discussion.
Commander!
Perfect timing, Commander! See, we just came up with a good idea.
Namely, setting up a vegetable garden right here.
If we grow vegetables on the island, we can make fresh meals for everyone every day!
Mhm! What do you think, Commander?
"The soil is high-quality and workable. Not only that, but it's also close to a water source."
"This looks like a solid place for a vegetable garden, alright."
So we have your permission? Perfect.
I need some veggie baozis now! I don't have much longer!
I can't make any just yet! Hang in there.
First, we're going to have to level the ground out. After that...
We plant carrots, lettuce, celtuce, you mai cai... and broccoli!
Precisely. Once the groundwork has been laid, I'll tell Chen Hai to send us some seeds.
Woohoo!
It sounds like the island's menu is about to get even better.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Early Access</size>

scripts.say: I visit the natural hot spring Fubuki found for the first time in a while. There, I find that someone's put up a sign.
"Under construction! Do not enter, nya!"
It even has Akashi's likeness on it. So the hot spring resort still isn't ready yet.
My, do we have a customer trying to be the first to enjoy the hot spring?
When I turn to leave, I hear a familiar voice behind me.
Unfortunately, it's not ready yet.
Heehee, but you don't have to leave so soon. It's okay, Commander♡
Before I can react, Akagi sidles over with a beaming smile.
Customers as important as you deserve the VIP treatment, Commander.
If you'd like, just come with me!♪
She acts like it's up to me, but she wraps her arm around mine like she won't take no for an answer.
"I guess I have no choice..."
Akagi and I walk arm-in-arm through the dim corridor.
"Hm... Something smells sweet."
Heehee, we're almost there, Commander.
We continue a little further until the space opens up and a steamy hot spring comes into view.
"So this spot alone is finished?"
Pink petals float on the crystal-clear water, and the elaborate decorations around it add to the elegance of it all.
This must be the VIP treatment Akagi was referring to.
How do you feel, Commander?
(I think incense in the air is making me heat up somehow...)
"Is that scent what I think it is?"
Heehee. Why don't you go ahead and get undressed?
Are you having trouble keeping up? You did come to take a dip in the hot spring, didn't you?
Akagi leans in. Her sweet smell makes me go dizzy, making it even more difficult to calmly analyze the situation.
Aww. Do you need my help?♡
Inside... Here...?
Our intel... Has to be it...
Of course, nya... I paid the fee, too...
In my daze, I hear chatter from the other end of the corridor.
Tch. And after I sent them off to collect materials...
"Those first voices... Were they Zuikaku and Shoukaku?"
"And that third one is very obviously a certain cat."
Ooh! Commander, so you were here!
Heheheh. Akagi, what exactly do you think you're doing?
"...Well, this doesn't seem good."
What a waste of this perfect mood.
I thought I'd finally get to be alone with you... Such a shame.
*sigh*... Well, you see our conundrum. What should we do, Commander?
I'm sorry for this. Next time, I'll pick a better place so we can be alone and undisturbed... Heehee, heeheehee!♥
Huh? Whaaaat?!
What a quick wit. That's the Commander for you!♪
If that's what you want, Commander... I suppose I don't mind sharing once in a while.
Fifth Carrier Division, I presume you won't put the Commander's kindness to waste?
Thus, we spend an unforgettable time together in the steamy hot spring.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>A Ruinous Adventure</size>

scripts.say: Island - Northern Mountain Region
The time has finally come to explore the ruins.
I've been curious about this place ever since we first arrived.
Maybe this is where that treasure lies that Royal Fortune talked about.
Let's head right in and see what we find!
Not so fast. Commander, we'll go in first.
Don't come in until we've made sure the ruins are safe, no matter what.
Adventure, here I come...
I want to follow them, but they decide against it on account of the risk of traps and other dangers.
"Good luck, you four. I'll be here, waiting for you."
"The pirate life takes you wherever the wind blows. However, sometimes, pirates set up temporary camps on uninhabited islands."
"It's not uncommon that they hide their ill-gotten gains in ruins and task the most vicious monsters with guarding their loot."
"To seize their treasure, one must be brave."
That's the gist of the letters I hid under their pillows last night.
So she's the one behind their sudden urge to investigate the ruins...
"I haven't seen you for days. Where did you even come from?"
Appearing and disappearing without a trace is key to a pirate's survival. Sorry, it's a trade secret!
I wasn't lying about there being treasure on this island, by the way. They WILL find something, at least.
"I'm more concerned about their well-being than some promise of treasure."
They'll be alright! Like I said, I'd never do anything to hurt you. Or those close to you.
Besides, if you wanna explore the whole island, you'll end up in the ruins sooner or later.
And isn't finding treasure the reason you set out on this adventure to begin with?
"Well, I suppose I can't argue with that."
"Are you sure they'll be fine, though?"
Totally, yeah! It'll just be like an obstacle course.
Oh, hey, I just got a cracking idea!
I know a secret shortcut to the treasure chamber. You wanna come with me?
"But Z23 told me not to go in no matter what."
C'mon, live a little! You'll be juuust fine. Follow me!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Not-So-Dangerous Ruins</size>

scripts.say: The four girls continue deeper inside the abandoned ruins.
Royal Fortune was right! These DO look like pirate ruins!
That means we're gonna find treasure... and a monster!
This place is even more dilapidated than I expected. I doubt there's anything of value left here.
We should look for a passage leading underground.
You expect there to be one?
Yes. It's a common trope to have vast dungeons beneath ancient ruins.
This isn't a fantasy story...
While we're at it, we should also look for items and mechanisms that open doors.
Keep an eye out for things like strange keys, statues, stone discs, and unusually-shaped gems.
Oh, wait... Any keys might have rusted away, and those mechanisms may not work anymore.
If so, we'll have to find a big pot or dynamite.
Or just blow a hole with our riggings...
Yes. Using our cannons is another way.
Smart thinking, Laffey.
Wait, are we allowed to just start blasting?
Only as a last resort. Ideally, we won't have to destroy anything.
Okay then... I suggest we split up and look for out-of-place things.
Yes. Be careful inside side-corridors.
You never know if the pirates set up traps to–
CLICK!
A clicking sound is heard as a trap on a wall is triggered.
It shoots out a net meant to capture invaders, but time has weakened the mechanisms behind the trap, and the net completely misses the girls.
I was just going to say...
Z23! Are you okay?
I'm fine! Just spooked...
Seems stepping on this tile is what activated the trap.
We need to be on our toes...
There must be something worth guarding for them to have set up traps.
Be careful, everyone. Let's go.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Treasure?</size>

scripts.say: Island Ruins - Underground Dungeon
"Countless serpentine corridors combine to form an enormous underground dungeon."
"In every corner and every room are devious traps."
"The rumbling coming from the belly of the dungeon signals the existence of a menacing beast."
"To press forward is to inch ever closer to certain death."
Or so you'd think; nothing like that actually happened.
Y'know... There's only one path here, and it's more boring than I expected.
We're just walking down a normal path...
B-but there were traps!
They scared the heck out of us, too!
Yeah, they did, but that's all they did. They didn't even get our clothes dirty...
Are we sure there's treasure in these ruins?
Something's... off.
Have you all noticed it? This wasn't originally a single corridor.
Someone may have dealt with all of the traps before we entered.
So you're saying... Someone came in here before us?!
They're gonna steal the treasure...
Let's hurry!
*pant*... *pant*... We made it to the end of the ruins.
There's a big door up ahead. If there's treasure, it must be in the room beyond.
Hold on a second, Ayanami! Didn't Royal Fortune say there was a monster guarding the treasure?
The most dangerous sea monster... I'll fight, too...
But it hasn't felt like that so far, has it? What if it's just a lie meant to keep people away from the treasure?
That may be. Regardless, I'll try to figure out how to open this door...
The four shipgirls approach the large door.
Hmm...
I don't see a lock. No slot to fit anything into the door, either.
Maybe it's the kind that opens through a nearby device or requires some special incantation...?
Let's try giving it a nudge—
The door slowly opens a bit, rumbling loudly all the while.
It opened...
Huh?
It did?! Just from Laffey pushing it a little?!
Yeah. It's not locked...
Ah! Could this be the Empty Fort Strategy, 32nd of the 36 Stratagems?!
What an incredible stratagem. It had us fooled!
Ahoy, heroes! Ye did well to make it this far!
I've been waiting for ye here!
Hm? YOU'RE the final boss of this dungeon, the sea monster who protects the pirates' treasure?
Hahahah, that'd be me! Final boss, sea monster, and all!
No, you're clearly—
If she's a monster, then we have no choice... Everyone, get ready to fight. We're taking her down.
Avast! Ye heroes who have conquered the ruins, I yield! The treasure be yours, as long as ye spare me!
...Hwuh?
Thank you, sea monster.
Again, you're clearly just Royal Fortune! Anyone can tell!
And Commander! Why are you here?!
"Well, the thing is..."
I'm impressed. You're always one step ahead, Commander.
Hey... This is just cheating, isn't it, Royal Fortune?!
Here I was planning to disable the traps before the Commander came in... Oh! Are you actually the ones who dealt with the other traps?
"What other traps?"
Ah-ah-ah! Forget all that small stuff!
The treasure you're after is right here!
Ooh...
Crystals, jewels... Even gold?!
Whoa! This all looks really valuable, Commander!
(The treasure might fetch a high price, but to me, the girls' smiles and fun are much more valuable treasures.)
Heheh. You get it, Commander!
I'm not reading your mind. It's written all over your face!
Heave-ho... Once we've got it all packed up, let's go back!
Phew... This marks the end of our adventure. I'm going back to the guild's bar to celebrate.
I'm not sleepy... Not one bit...
Right... Let's collect our spoils and get back to the surface~
When I'm not close to the four adventurers, Royal Fortune suddenly approaches me from behind.
She hands me a golden compass adorned with a single jewel.
This compass is the real treasure. You get it for overcoming the trial of the ruins.
Heheh, though I'm the one who handled the trial!
Either way, it'll help you out someday. Keep it safe!
Anyway, we'll be right behind you before long~
I try to ask her what she means, but before I know it, she's disappeared... like usual.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>The Great Deserted Island Yacht Race</size>

scripts.say: It's another pleasant day.
While making my way to the pier, I hear the voice of a certain self-styled journalist.
Agh, the sunlight was so warm and nice that I overslept... I'll just change clothes after I get to the venue...
Alfredo's running as fast as she can, cradling something in her arms. She's looking straight down.
Ouch... Ack! My draft!
It's okay, no worries! My bad for not watching where I was going!
Whoa, I'm out of time! Commander, help me pick up my draft! If I don't hurry, I'll be late!
I gotta report on the Great Deserted Island Yacht Race!
"...The Great Deserted Island Yacht Race? I think Regensburg mentioned that."
Hm? You don't know about it, Commander?
Aw, man... If you wanna watch, go to the pier! I gotta go!
Nooo, it's already starting without me!
After Alfredo Oriani snatches up her draft at lightning speed, she speeds off and disappears into the wharf.
(Now that I'm thinking about it, New Jersey did say something about a surprise...)
(I guess I'll go check it out.)
Miss Memphis! Congratulations on securing the top spot of group A! Do you have any remarks for our viewers?
Remarks? Umm, w-well...
Ack, there's no time! Save the speech for later. Right now, I gotta snap a pic!
"Who will be the ace of the yacht race? Our top picks!" Yeah, that's a solid headline!
O-okay...
I go to the pier where the others are watching. The air is full of excitement for this spectator sport.
Oh! Commander, you came!
"Are you competing in the next race, Enterprise? And the girls over there..."
Yeah, we're the group B contestants. Our race is right about to start.
"It looks like Hanazuki and Royal Fortune are joining in, huh?"
Yep. They're warming up right now.
"Then the boats in the water over there..."
You mean Ning Hai and Ping Hai? They're not competing; I guess they're just out having fun.
Once I'm done racing, do you want to ride a yacht together?
Heheh, don't get too carried away. You've got a race to focus on!
Keep your eyes on what's in front of you~
I spend all day every day wrestling the raging seas! There's no way you'll beat me!
Hahaha! Well, I guess I won't know until I try.
Umm... I'll do my best, too, Commander!
Royal Fortune, don't count me out yet!
Heheh. Instead of running away, you're coming right to face me?
You've got guts! Bring it on!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Progress Update</size>

scripts.say: Over in the camp's conference room, a small discussion is taking place.
The topic – a progress update on the island's state of development.
Well, we've established a cargo route between us and the port.
Work on the island's main infrastructure is done too. And the pier can be considered complete.
The hot spring is finished too, nya. Drop in whenever you want, nya.
Heehee... I'll be waiting for you there, Commander♡
On the mineral and lumber extraction front, things are going quite well.
They're currently configured to operate for two hours a day. We also plan to develop them into scenic industrial spots eventually.
With assistance from Hanazuki, Ning Hai and Ping Hai have got their flower garden set up.
I'm sure they'd love it if you came to have a look, Commander.
"Flower garden? Last time I spoke to them, they said they wanted to establish a VEGETABLE garden."
"Wonder what changed their minds... I'll look into it later."
It sounds like our work on the island is done, so–
Not so fast! You've forgotten one very, very important thing!
You're some of the brightest minds I know, so how could you not notice?
There's an important facility that we've all forgotten about? That can't be possible.
But it is! And I shall tell you what it is... another time!
Worry not, I will personally see to its construction. Just wait and see.
Hehehehehehe♪
I don't like that she's making this needlessly mysterious...
(Whatever she's planning, I hope it isn't a nasty last-minute surprise.)
...Iron Blood will assist with the construction. We're free at the moment.
Ahem. As I was going to say!
It sounds like our work on the island is ALMOST done!
Which I think calls for a grand celebration!

options.content: "But Marco said to wait and see."

scripts.say: I knew you'd agree, servant! Nothing says "job well done" quite like a banquet.
Be quiet, servant! Let me finish.
We'll host it on the beach near the camp.
I've already been there. It has the best scenery anywhere on the island.
As for the food, the Royal Maids will provide it.
Your Majesty, since this is a banquet for everyone who's helped develop the island, don't you think everyone should be involved in making the food as well?
You have a point... Apologies. The Royal Maids will take a more supporting role instead so we can all bring our best dishes to the table.
Sounds sweet! Now you've got me excited!
If it's not too much to ask, I'd like Sardegna to be in charge of preparing any and all pizza dishes.
Heehee. It seems I'll be quite busy soon.
Suddenly, I remember that I haven't seen a trace of Royal Fortune since the yacht race.
In fact, nobody has seen her for the past few days.
I hope she'll turn up soon so she can partake in the banquet.
After all, she deserves recognition for leading us to this island in the first place.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Learning How to Swim</size>

scripts.say: The beach near the pier. The water is so clear you can see straight to the bottom. Rays of sunlight bounce off the sparkling waves, scattering in all directions.
It is here where a slightly odd swimming lesson is taking place.
No, "swimming lesson" is not the right phrase. "Date" might be more accurate.
Hmgh... There. Teacher, is Anchorage doing it right?
This is how you swim, right? Heehee~
I've never swam before, so I'm a little scared of drowning...
But, you're right here if I need help, so I feel safe!
Your way of teaching is so... umm... gentle! Yeah, gentle! I like it.
I feel like I can do anything as long as I have you.
Anchorage gives me a heartwarming smile from atop her inflatable orca.
Heehee~ Your hand feels so warm.
Even though it's super sunny, your hand feels warm in a good way. I love it.
Teacher thinks I'm doing great... That makes me so happy! Heehee~
But, it's not good enough. I need to do much better than just "great."
So we can both swim together...
Teacher, come closer.
I do just that, and she tries to change directions.
However, she can't control her orca, and nearly falls into the water.
Acting quickly, I grab hold of her to stabilize her. Her wet body feels warm to the touch.
Her cheeks seem to redden, possibly because she's overexerted herself.
Ugh... I was this close to falling off...
I really need to practice with you more...
But I like being taught by you, so that's okay! I'm gonna give this another try!

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Poolside Beauty</size>

scripts.say: I decide to pay a visit to the island's indoor pool.
Bismarck is there. She comes up after a quick swim and sits by the poolside. She is drenched – and looking gorgeous.
Whew... My hair keeps getting caught on my body. I should've tied it up before going in.
Fancy seeing you here, Commander. The water is perfect – neither too hot nor cold.
A splendid pool is among the last things I thought we could build on this remote island.
It's a great place to swim, but leaves much desired as a date spot... But never mind that. What do you think about the pool?
Frankly, the main reason I'm here is because she invited me to swim with her.
Not just to burn calories, of course, but also to enjoy some time together. Go on a date, in other words.
"I noticed that we're alone in here."
Yes. That's because I reserved it.
We all want to be left undisturbed sometimes. Especially now, when... You know what I mean, don't you?
Incidentally, I chose this swimsuit myself. I thought you might like it.
It strikes a good balance between form and function.
In truth, I did ask Eugen for suggestions, but all the swimsuits she picked out were...
The kinds that draw undesirable attention. Let's just say that...
Bismarck is not usually one to mince her words. Through squinted eyes, I notice that she's blushing ever so faintly.
Ahem... I see you've done your warmups. Aren't you going in the pool?
...Together? Someone's impatient... I just got up a minute ago.
Oh, never mind. We're alone here – there's no point fussing over appearances.
Go on in. I'll join you in a second.
Care for a challenge? Let's see who's the best swimmer. I'm not going to go easy on you.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Marco Polo's Grand Ambition</size>

scripts.say: A group of girls are industriously scaling the volcano. They are halfway to the summit.
Aside from the leader, Marco Polo, all the girls bear looks of reluctance.
*pant*... Help... I can't keep climbing... I'm too tired...
We're almost at the summit... Hang in there... *pant*...
It seems they're a mountaineering team made up of both Sardegnian and Iron Blood girls.
The team eventually reaches the mouth of the volcano. Marco Polo led them there under the pretense that the climb is "a pleasurable hike through nature."
I climbed all this way, and for what? There's nothing to report on up here...
Is overcoming challenges and finding scoops in dangerous places not the job of a journalist?
Don't tell me you're giving up already.
You insisted that we tag along, that's the only reason we're here...
But... Bismarck said this is an important mission...
Just... Just hang in there, ladies...
Yes, exactly. The summit isn't far now!
You must be present for this historic moment!
What "historic moment"?
The moment that I, the great Marco Polo, conquer this island!
I don't think merely reaching the island's highest point grants you ownership of it...
Of course not. There's more to it than that. Da Vinci, is everything ready on your end?
Ready as can be! Appreciate the huge grant, by the way.
Magnificent. I'm not afraid to splurge if it means achieving my goals.
Now let's see... Yes, over there will do just fine.
Marco Polo scans her surroundings. After weighing her options for a second, she points to a flat stretch of land on the summit.
That over there? Got it! Da Vinci Express is on the way!
The sound of a colossal drone booms through the air, and a large shadow is cast upon the spot Marco Polo designated.
Oh my god...
A giant monument lands on the summit with a loud rumble.
At the top of the monument is a statue of Marco Polo.
Yes! THIS is a monument befitting the Sardegnian Conqueror of Islands!
Whoooa! It's really well-made!
*clap clap clap*... (I couldn't care less.)
Hoooly cannoli! This is a picturesque statue if I ever saw one!
I take back what I said. It WAS worth it to climb up here!
I expect you to turn this into front-page news, with a long article to go with it.
Oh, you bet! I've got a million things to say about this already!
None of which have any substance, I'm sure...
Ahem. Da Vinci, would you please use your drone to take us back down?

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Living Off the Land</size>

scripts.say: The forest covering the island is both beautiful and bountiful.
There's sure to be plenty of things to forage here.
Then, just as I'm about to start, I run into Javelin, who seemingly had the same idea.
Oh, are you going into the woods too?
Me? I'm going to gather branches so we can get a fire started.
A camp without a campfire is like fish without chips, after all!
And also because I'd like to dry my clothes after that storm...
"We'll cover more ground if we work together. Come on, let's get searching."
The air is filled by the chirps of birds of paradise. Sunlight breaks through the leaves, creating scattered light dots on the grassy ground below.
Hmm-hm-hmm♪
Javelin hums a peppy tune while collecting dead branches off the ground. She doesn't seem the least concerned over being shipwrecked.
Hey, we're safe and sound, and that's what matters. There's no point crying over spilt milk!
Thinking about how to establish our camp is a much better use of our energy.
Besides, look around – this is a gorgeous place to be stranded.
A crystal-clear coast, a vast golden beach, and a truly massive forest!
Frankly, the only thing this place needs is some nice accommodations!
"That's not a bad idea. I could see myself sunbathing here on a holiday, tropical drink in hand."
Heehee~ Then think of this as the laying-the-groundwork phase of making this place into a vacation spot!
Alright, this should be plenty to keep a fire going.
Oh! Look, Commander! There's a whole colony of mushrooms growing under that tree!
Mhm! Let's bring these back to camp!
Don't worry, I know which ones are safe. Leave this to me!
And so, we walk back to camp with a hefty haul of firewood and mushrooms.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Revisiting the Hot Spring</size>

scripts.say: The entrance to the hot spring resort, modeled after a torii gate, is adorned with decorations celebrating its grand opening.
With the red envelope of a letter of invitation in hand, I return to the place where I spent a steamy time with Akagi.
When I pass through the hot spring curtain, I'm greeted by a familiar, elegant figure.
Welcome, Commander. I'm so glad you stuck to your promise.
I enter the completed facility. There's a faint sulfur smell as hot spring water is diverted to several indoor baths.
There's a different aroma from the last time I came here, too.
The warmth of the hot spring, the aromatic scent, and the charming decorations give the place a refined air.
*sigh*... I wanted you to be the only one invited today, Commander...
Unfortunately, circumstances have forced me to welcome everyone.
(Tch... Foiled again.)
Enjoy a dip in the hot spring, and once you're done, I'll show you where to rest and get dressed.
(That is how you normally do hot springs, yes, but that's not what I'd expect from Akagi... I can see why she's so down.)
Akagi shows me to the biggest bath.
I get in the bathtub, sink down to my shoulders, and heave a sigh.
The hot water clouds my thoughts, and my consciousness begins to melt into the rising steam...
I suddenly notice someone approaching.
Commander~ Did you get invited here, too~?
The water temperature is perfect~ I'm used to the Northern Parliament's climate, but it's so nice to be all warm once in a while, right~?
Phew... I can feel my body and mind stretching~
Sorry to intrude on your hot bath, Commander! Wanna give my new massage technique a go?
Hot springs boost your circulation, so a massage would go perfect with that!
One wishes to partake of sweets with you...
Yokan and manjuu... If it suits you, please give them a try...
If you desire tranquility after your bath... You may lay your head to sleep alongside me...
The shipgirls and I have a lovely time together.
The hot spring and massage take all of my fatigue and stiffness away, and I fill my stomach with exquisite sweets.
Tempted to sleep by Shinano's gentle whisperings and the sweet scent of incense, my eyelids grow heavy...
Finally, melting in the warmth of everyone's kindness, I doze off.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Fishing Competition</size>

scripts.say: On a nearby beach, a sign has been erected with a drawing of a fishing rod and a line of text on it.
"Come watch the island fishing competition!"
(Sounds like fun. Might as well check it out.)
Good day, folks! I'm Aoba, reporter on the scene for our first-ever fishing competition!
We're bringing you this exciting event live!
I've got one... Now!
Z23 raises her fishing rod and reels in a large fish.
Ooh! There's Z23 with her signature technique! She's on a roll today!
It's not over yet...
Why, it looks like Ayanami also has something on the hook! Will she bring it in, or will it squelch its way free?
Hoy!
Ayanami wrestles her fishing rod and pulls a big, white fish out of the water.
Wow! That's big!
Hold on a minute... A seagull just deposited a fish into Ayanami's bucket!
Was this planned, or a lucky coincidence?
Thank you, Squawkey.
I'm not giving up without a fight...
Blanc, Noir, I'm counting on you...
At first glance, it seems like Laffey won't catch any fish.
A few seconds later, though, two fish land in her bucket, caught and carried by her seagull friends.
She's catching fish without relying on a fishing rod! That's crazy!
Three heads are better than one...
Wait, is that legal?!
No, can't let myself get distracted... There! Caught another one!
Z23 keeps her head in the game and manages to catch another big fish.
Look at that! Rather than intimidate Z23, it seems this sudden turn of events only bolstered her fighting spirit!
You won't win so easily!
Keep it up, Squawkey!
Blanc, Noir, and now Gris, give it your all...
It looks like the competition is nearing its climactic finish! Who will take home the gold?
Once again, I'm Aoba, reporting to you live! Don't switch the channel – we'll be right back after a commercial break!
...This whole thing sure is quite the sight.
The odd fishing competition continues against the backdrop of white waves washing ashore.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>A Moment in the Flower Garden</size>

scripts.say: The smell of flowers wafts in from somewhere nearby.
Strange. The scent wasn't this strong when I passed by just the other day.
Which reminds me... Ning Hai and Ping Hai originally planned to make a vegetable garden around here.
I wonder what made them change their minds. I'll go have a look.
The once-empty clearing is now overrun with wonderfully fragrant flowers.
Their petals bloom in various colors that complement each other.
We couldn't have made this garden so beautiful without your help.
Aww, thank you. I'm glad I could be of use.
It smells so good! Makes me wanna plant a few around the camp!
Oh, I suggest using species native to this island if you want to do that.
See, this garden contains not just flowers picked from the island, but also ones imported from afar.
There are quite a few native species to choose from, including morning glories, daisies, dandelions, daffodils...
Essentially, you can pick anything you'd like, as long as it's not from this garden.
...Oh, Commander! When did you get here?
Forgive me. Once I start talking about flowers, it's so hard to stop...
Good timing, Commander. We wanted to show you our garden.
What do you think? Aren't these flowers really pretty?
I'm quite proud of them, myself.
Being surrounded by gorgeous flowers seems to make their smile even brighter than usual.
"They are. I'm curious, though, what made you change plans from a vegetable garden to a flower garden?"
It takes a long time before vegetables can be harvested. We realized that once we got the seeds.
There are vegetables that grow quickly, of course, but apparently the soil in this area isn't suited for them.
So we figured, "Why not plant flowers instead?"
Because hey, the island is already rich in flowers. Transplanting some wouldn't be too much work.
As nice as it would be to have locally-sourced fresh vegetables, I prefer having a flower garden I can admire all year round.
It sucks I won't get to eat freshly-picked veggies...
But a beautiful flower garden kind of makes up for it!
Mhm. And I offered to help once I heard about their new plan.
It so happened I needed a place to plant some flowers I'd brought along, so really, it was two birds with one stone.
"That explains it."
"I saw a lot of flowers while exploring this island, but I never realized there were THIS many different species."
"Looking at them now all in the same place, this island really has a beautiful ecosystem."
Indeed. I couldn't have found them all by myself, though. A lot of finds were made by those exploring the island.
By the way, I made a pot of herbal tea just a minute ago, Commander.
If you have the time, won't you sit down and take in the flowers for a while?

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Beachside Banquet</size>

scripts.say: It's another wonderful day. A banquet is taking place on the golden beach, with cheers and shouting filling the air.
I've got you nooow!
Hahah! Direct hit!
Someone's getting cheeky... It's payback time...
Heh! You'll need to aim better if you hope to hit me~
You make me feel like a fish in a barrel...
If that's how you want it, I'm going to have to get serious!
Just graze her shots. Easy game.
I'm going to use my secret skill – akimbo style!
Throwing down the gauntlet, eh? Don't expect me to go easy on you!
A cup of lemon tea, anyone? It tastes sublime with a little sugar and jasmine leaves.
Yo, the pizza's done! Who wants a slice?
Whoa, smells good! Don't mind if I do!
I'll have some of that tea, but I'll pass on the pizza...
Pizza is overrated. Have some schweinshaxe and sauerkraut instead.
And drink it down with a cup of carbonated coffee. Raaawr!
Where's the ice cream? You can't have a beachside picnic without ice cream!
What the hell, Aoba?! This was MY scoop you reported on!
And this headline – "The Commander's UNBELIEVABLE Hot Spring Affair" – it's SO sensationalist!
It's called, "being a better journalist than you."
Don't like it? Then be quicker on the draw next time. Toodles!
I'm not done with you! Get back here!
Let me join the journo club! Nobody covers the topic that is Sara better than me!
The festivities continue as white waves wash ashore while a salty breeze blows.
"A warm wind tells a tale of gold. Though its time has passed, traces of it may be found amidst the sunlit ruins."
I hear a familiar voice ring out from somewhere nearby.
Sure is! Surprised to see me?
You shouldn't be. I couldn't call myself a pirate if I skipped out on such a grand party.
"How did you know we were having a party today?"
I dunno. Instinct? My gut leads me to where the fun is.
"Enigmatic as ever. What have you been doing these past few days?"
That's a secret. Mystery and Tempesta go hand-in-hand, matey.
Ooh! Tell you what, I'll talk to you later!
I've got to grab some Hawaiian pizza and barbecue before they're all gobbled up!
She draws her cutlass and charges toward the dinner table, as if she's going to plunder it.
I feel my lips curve. Her smile is contagious.
I'll save the questions for later. For now, I'll just enjoy the moment with everyone else.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Epilogue</size>

scripts.say: Evening has come, and the sun is setting on the golden beach.
With the party over, the girls clean up and retreat from the shore.
While I'm admiring the sunset's beautiful glow, I suddenly realize that Royal Fortune is right here.
Ahoy! Fun was had by all today, eh?
Crazy to think how quickly this remote island turned into a real resort.
Hat's off to you, Commander!
"What brings you here? Come to admire the sunset?"
I guess you could say that. But it's not the only reason, of course.
"Then enjoy the view and stay as long as you want. I won't charge you anything."
Charge? You're gonna start CHARGING for this place?
Never took you for the money-grubbing type, Commander.
...Pfft.
Don't worry. I know you're kidding.
Let's be serious for a sec. You already know what I'm here to tell you.
"That it's time for you to leave again?"
Sort of...
"Before you go, I want to know – was this all part of your plan? Or was it really meant to be a simple treasure hunt?"
Heehee~ In a way, yeah.
The treasure map was authentic, and this island was the real treasure all along.
Think about it. The bumpy ride here, the adventure in the ruins, the compass...
The wonders of nature, the sun fading over the horizon, the warm beach, and all the fun activities we got up to over the past few days...
The memories we've made are worth more than any old pile of doubloons.
"You're right. But which of those things was your treasure map meant to lead me to?"
You mean, what did I WANT you to find? Good question!
I could tell you, but I think you already know the answer after everything leading up to now.
In other words, there's no point in me spelling it out~
Ah, it's getting late... The ideal moment for goodbyes arrives with the evening winds.
It's getting cold, too. I think we should say bye-bye now while we're ahead.
After taking a few bouncy steps along the beach, the barefoot Royal Fortune turns around and smiles warmly to me.
This really is farewell for now. It could be a long, long time before we meet again.

options.content: "I have a feeling we'll see each other soon."

scripts.say: Not forever! I'll be back eventually!
You know what, I think so too~
Ahaha! Not quite THAT soon, I'm afraid.
As much as I wish I could stay, the girls in Tempesta need me.
We have our rules, and we all have to follow them...
A brief look of gloom appears on her face at the use of the word "rules."
Don't worry. I'll write you while I'm gone.
May the winds be with you, Commander.
A sudden, salty gust blows along the beach, and she is now gone.
Gone with the wind. And hopefully, she will soon return with the wind.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>Gifts from the Gulls</size>

scripts.say: I trace the coastline to the east, searching for things we could use.
Turning my gaze skywards, I spot a flock of seagulls circling a stone's throw away.
Where there are seagulls, there's likely to be fish.
After cutting through a beachside grove, I reach an open area.
Dozens of seagulls saunter about the white beach as though it were their garden. And, at the center of them all...
Zzzzz...
Zzz... Zzzzz...
She's sleeping like a baby.
Then, upon realizing there's an uninvited guest in their midst, the seagulls all spread their wings and fly off to the skies.
They call as they take off, incidentally awakening the Sleeping Beauty.
Mmhh... That was refreshing.
Oh... Commander. Did you come to nap?
"Not quite. I'm searching for things we could use at camp."
"Also, while I admire your courage for sleeping out here, you might catch a cold."
I'll be fine. The sun and the sand keep me warm.
I sat down to rest and dozed off just like that.
"You weren't here expressly to sleep? What were you doing, then?"
Gathering ingredients for dinner.
Fishing, specifically... Do you want fish tonight?
"Fish sounds great, but you won't find any on the beach."
"You need to go into the water if you want a catch."
Not really. Fish fall from the sky here...
Look. Here comes another.
She points up at a seagull, holding a fish in its beak.
It pays no attention to me, stood right next to Laffey, and drops the fish right into her hands.
Thanks, Blanc.
"Blanc?"
Mhm. She's a white bird, so...
It's my nickname for her.
Not only are these seagulls not afraid of Laffey in the least, but they also seem to treat her as their own chick.
Try it, Commander. Wave to Blanc.
I shrug, deciding to give it a shot, and wave to the friendly seagull.
It flaps its wings cheerfully in response, then takes flight.
She said she's happy to have guests on the island, and that you can have all the fish you want.
"I didn't know you were fluent in seagullese..."
And then, me and Laffey return to camp with a handful of fish.

sequence:
Uncharted Summer

<size=45>A Place to Dock</size>

scripts.say: I got a message from Z23, telling me to meet her at a certain spot.
Good news, Commander. We've managed to survey most of the island.
It's even larger than I thought, and strangely, it doesn't appear in any writings or on any maps.
I'm starting to think we're the first to discover and explore it.
"It only appears during a storm, yet isn't part of a Mirror Sea..."
"Maybe Royal Fortune's mysterious treasure map is the real deal after all."
Perhaps so. That aside, what do you think about this area?
I'm standing on a beach flanking a bay, surrounded by cliffs on two sides and a flat plain on the north-facing side.
One thing immediately comes to mind.

options.content: "This is an ideal location for a harbor."
"This is the perfect spot to build a factory."

scripts.say: Yes! I wholly agree!
A... factory? To make what, exactly?
Sure, there's a forest nearby, and you have ready access to water, but the question is...
"You don't need to evaluate it in earnest. I was just kidding."
Oh, you were joking? Like Ayanami was earlier with her video game talk...
I'd like you both to take being shipwrecked a little more seriously, please.
See, what I thought is that this would make the perfect place to build a harbor.
It's just the thing we need to transport and store what goods we find.
