scripts.say: Port - Shopping District
I arrive at the shopping district at the agreed-upon time and find Howe, standing outside the supermarket.
Lovely that you could come, Commander.
The gorgeous lady greets me with a bright smile.
I wanted to arrive sooner, but you beat me to the punch. Have you been waiting for long?
No, not long at all. I just happened to come a little early.
The thought of spending the entire day with you made me so giddy I could hardly sleep.
So I woke up early, got dressed and prettied up, then when I arrived I realised there was quite a while to go until you'd be here.
You wouldn't have had to wait if I'd just gotten here sooner.
Well, if it bothers you so, you could make up for it in a minute when we go shopping.
She gives me a soft smile, then casually takes my hand.
The entrance is over there. Let's go.
Over the course of our pleasant shopping trip, the shopping basket has gotten very heavy.
Butter, powdered sugar, pastry flour... That should be all, I think.
She rummages through the basket while looking around for the next item on the list.
Let's see...
There it is! The cookie cutter section.
I follow her into the section. A wide range of cookie cutters in all shapes and sizes jump out at me.
Aww, these anchor-shaped ones are so cute...
These cat ones are lovely as well...
Wow! They even have ones shaped like naval caps.
Which do you think would be the best, Commander?
She presents the three different kinds of cutters to me.
Hmm... If you ask me...
But I can't get them all! If you can't decide, let me pick one.
Examining the options in her hands, she ponders her choice earnestly.
This one. It suits you the best!
She puts the naval cap cookie cutter into the basket, then looks around for more cutters to buy.
This bat-shaped one fits York, while this teacup one will be for Wales...
And George will get... this one.
Alright, that should be enough. I might use these the next time I'm baking cookies for everyone.
("Next time"?)
You mean you're not making any today?
No, only that I'm making cookies for you today.
This is our special day together, so it's obviously going to be about us.
If we're going to make cookies together, they should be just for us, don't you think?
Before I can get a word in, she starts walking onward.
A few steps down the aisle, she looks back and shoots me a faintly shy wink.
Come along. Let's go to the checkout.

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>2 Free Hands Hold Together</size>

scripts.say: Howe and I leave the supermarket after paying for our items, carrying hefty bags filled to the brim.
As we walk side by side, the distance between us shrinks step by step.
Then, she looks at the bags in my hands before moving her gaze to meet my eyes.
What is it?
I could store your bags inside my rigging, if you want.
Using your rigging costs oil, so that's pretty unwise from an economic standpoint, no?
That is true... Let me carry them, then.
They don't weigh a ton or anything. I can handle it.
She shakes her head and reaches out, gripping the handle of my bag.
Silly. How am I supposed to hold your hand if it's busy carrying a bag?
Just leave it to me.
Her eyes shine, full of anticipation and eagerness.
I let go of the handle, letting her take the bag. She then transfers it to her other hand.
Next, she takes her free hand and grasps mine. It feels warm and soft to the touch.
Although her cheeks are flushed, her gaze is right on me. She squeezes my hand tightly.
I've wanted to do this for so long.
Walking with you, holding hands, talking about things.
Just like that, until...
Never mind.
All of a sudden, she hangs her head in thought.
Until what?
Until the end of the universe? The end of time?
Forget I said it. It's too cheesy for me.
What I'm trying to say is, I want to hold your hand for as long as possible.
With a slightly awkward smile, she dodges out of saying anything more.
We walk forward, hands bobbing up and down, while the golden evening sun shines warmly on us.

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>3 Don't Forget the Apron</size>

scripts.say: Howe's Quarters - Kitchen
I place the ingredients on the counter, and just as I'm about to start on the next step, Howe stops me all of a sudden.
Before you do that, take a seat. Let's get comfortable first.
I'll get you some iced tea♪
She brings the iced tea over, but does not sit down at the counter. Instead, she starts processing the ingredients.
Huh? Aren't you going to sit down?
No, I'm not feeling very tired. If anything, I'm restless and raring to do something.
You just sit there and relax while I work on this.
After checking that she has all the ingredients and tools ready, she takes out two aprons.
Here. Put this on.
We don't want you to get butter or flour on your clothes, do we?

options.content: (Ask her to do it for you.)

scripts.say: Taking the apron, I hang it around my neck and fiddle around the back to tie a knot.
Let me help. It's pretty tricky to do when you can't see.
She steps forward, getting behind me and using her hands to skillfully tie a knot.
I can't see behind me, so... give me a hand?
Hm? Oh, sure.
She first walks up and tiptoes to reach up and place the apron around my neck.
Then she wraps her hands behind my back and skillfully ties a knot.
All while practically hugging me with how close she is.
What's the matter? Is it too tight?
No, it's perfect. Thanks.
Lovely! I was wondering if I went too hard with it.
While she says that, she takes the other apron and gets ready to put her head through it.
Let me give you a hand this time.
Huh? Oh, by all means.
Before anything else, I hold up her hair so it won't get caught on anything.
A blush briefly turns her ears pink before going away.
Once I finish tying her apron, I back off. She places her hands on her fair cheeks.
She smiles a charming and sweet yet slightly embarrassed smile.
Whew... Standing so close to you really gets my heart beating.
As much as I'd love to just do that all day... there are still things to do before that.
As she says that, she hands me a bowl and a stick of butter.
Come on, love. It's time to make cookies!

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>4 Mistakes Into Smiles</size>

scripts.say: Howe and I start working on the cookie dough.
Once you've thoroughly mixed the sugar, butter, and egg mix, add some pastry flour and keep stirring until uniform in consistency.
As she instructs, I add the flour to the bowl and give it a good stir.
Oh, by the way, do you know the trick for making cookie dough?

options.content: If it's too watery, add more flour!
If it's too floury, add more water!

scripts.say: Well, yes, that's true...
But the actual trick is this – don't stir the dough too hard. If it gets too glutenous, the cookies won't be crispy.
Oh, I see.
Keeping her advice in mind, I try to stir with just enough force so I don't mess up my very first batch. She smiles and examines my face.
Heehee. You've got flour on your face.
Hold still. I'll take care of it.
She presses her soft finger on my face and rubs it, spreading on more flour.
Yes, spreading the flour, not wiping it off.
Oh! Sorry, love.
I didn't realise I had flour on my hands... I only made it worse.
Although, you do look a little cute with flour on your face. Heehee.
She apologizes for the little oopsie, but still can't suppress a snicker even with her hand to her mouth.
As a result, she leaves a handprint of flour across her mouth and cheeks. It looks almost like she has a cat's whiskers.
Do I, now? It looks twice as cute on you.
"It"? What do you mean?
You got flour on your face just now when you covered your mouth.
Hey, you got flour on your face when you put your hand on there.
D-did I?
She is stumped for just a moment, then she breaks into a big smile.
Well, then we have matching makeup, love!

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>5 Time to Rest</size>

scripts.say: After we both wipe the flour off our faces, we resume our cookie-making.
Howe sticks the tray filled with dollops of dough inside the oven, then comes to me and leads me by the hand to sit down.
This will take about 20 minutes, so in the meantime...
Can I give you an arm massage?
Why an arm massage?
Because you stirred for a long time, didn't you? Even if you feel fine now, your arms might start hurting tomorrow.
My arms are used to making cookies by now, but yours aren't.
So come on, allow me to massage your arms until the cookies are done.
The direct look in her eyes signals that there is no room to argue.
Alright. Go ahead.
Great! Here we go.
I extend my arms for her. She rolls my sleeves back up to my upper arms.
Her warm and supple fingers then touch my skin. Using neither too much nor too little strength, she starts massaging me.
Beneath her long eyelashes are intent eyes that glitter.
All that stirring did make my muscles a little stiff, and this massage really is helping them loosen up.
The room is silent, save for the sound of our beating hearts...
There. That should be good.
She finishes the massage, then courteously straightens out my sleeves.
DING!
Conveniently, at the same time, the oven makes a noise to signal that the cookies are done.
Perfect timing. Let's see how the cookies turned out.

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>6 Burning Hot</size>

scripts.say: We open the oven, and a sugary aroma instantly fills the room.
Mmm! That smells so good! These came out lovely.
Let me put on my mittens and get the tray–
No need. You've been doing all the heavy lifting, so I'll handle this.
Putting on the mittens, I reach into the oven and grab the tray.
However, the tray is far hotter than I anticipated, and the heat seeps right through the mittens.
Frantically, I put the tray down somewhere. Howe then pulls off my mittens and checks my hands for burns.
Are you okay?!
The parts that touched the tray have turned a little red.
Grave look in her eyes, she hurries me over to the sink and runs water over my hands.
Stay here and keep them cool. I'll bring some ointment in just a sec!
She takes this very seriously, like she was treating a serious wound. It's cute.
I'm fine. They just went a little red. Letting them cool under the water is enough.
Really?
Yeah. If it makes you really anxious, you can check on them whenever you want.
If you're sure. *sigh*...
She breathes a small sigh, then examines the mittens with great scrutiny.
Oh... Sorry, love.
I think they've lost their insulative effect after all the baking I've done with them.
Don't apologize. It's not your fault.
You're right. The mittens are to blame for not being cool at all.
Uh... "Cool"?
She affirms with a nod.
Yes. Mittens don't warm up when exposed to heat, which makes them pretty cool.
(I don't get it. Is she cracking a joke?)
So... pun intended?
What? You thought I was making a pun?
Actually, yes... I was hoping you would.
I thought about that one quite a bit...
Well, yes.
Although it was impossible to tell if she was joking, I appreciate the sentiment.
She was worried about me and just wanted to make me smile.
I get it, but you really don't need to worry. I'm fine.
Now, what do you say to some tea?
I dry my hands then give her a pat on the head to reassure her.
It seems to do the trick, and her usual warm smile graces her face again.
Sure!

sequence:
Our Sweet Cookies

<size=45>7 Our Sweet Cookies</size>

scripts.say: We load the kitchen trolley with cookies, tea, and napkins, and bring it out into the yard.
Having secured a table and chairs, Howe tells me to take it easy, even if I strictly speaking didn't get burned.
While I do that, she sets the table for us both.
Alright, that should do. Now, love, it's finally time for Royal Navy-style afternoon tea!
She shows me to my seat. I sit down, as does she.
So, which do we start with?
There are two kinds of cookies in the box sitting on the table.
The first, regular cookies. The second, the naval cap-shaped ones I made with her guidance – with dried fruit inside.
That's obvious! With your first-ever batch!
She picks up a cookie and takes a bite out of it.
Almost immediately, her eyes light up with joy like a pair of sapphires.
It's so good! Have a bite!
Reaching across the table, she brings the cookie up to my mouth.
I chomp a piece out of the cookie.
(Sure, it's pretty good for a first attempt... but it's not really eye-openingly good, is it?)
You don't think I was overreacting, do you?
Well, if you weren't, let's hear your objective analysis.
I mean... It's very delicious. I really think that.
I only just taught you how to make cookies, and you've already made one that tastes better than any I've ever had before.
It's probably because YOU made it. That must be why it tastes so good.
So bright is her smile that it's almost like looking at the sun.
With those first bites, our wonderful tea party begins. Aromatic tea fills our cups while our plates are lined with crisp cookies.
Later, after we've eaten the cookies...
Would you like a refill?
She looks at me and waits for an answer.
Oh, you have cookie crumbs on your face, love.
Gosh, what a messy eater you are.
Despite ostensibly sounding rude, she still has that same gentle smile on her lips.
Where?
Confused, I wipe my face using the palm of my hand.
However, there are no crumbs on my face. The only thing on anyone's face is the teasing smirk on hers, growing wider.
They're still there. You know what? Let me do it for you.
See? Your hands are clean. Proof that you didn't get the crumbs.
Saying that, she leans in.
She graces my cheek using her delicate fingers.
Our gazes meet. I feel her warmth, and she feels mine. The space between us is ever shrinking.
Until finally, her tender lips kiss mine.
She pulls away after a moment and looks right at me.
In her eyes, I see so many things – kindness, shyness, incredible happiness, and an immovable will.
This may be rather sudden, but...
Making these cookies with you, spending some quiet time together... It makes me happy like you wouldn't believe.
And... I hope we'll be together like this more from now on.
呀 好像被困住了 用另一个舰队尝试找找能破解障碍的机关吧
这里是假入口
这里是机关，会破坏掉障碍
这是宝箱
被你发现了

sequence:
The Graceful Banquet

<size=45>1 The Teahouse</size>

scripts.say: "The moon shines on streams among swaying pines – rising mist flanks the dew-rich apricot trees."
Mmh... This tea is so fragrant.
Is this the place? It matches the description...
Oh, seems someone left the door open.
Welcome to the Dragon Empery Teahouse! Are you visiting alone?
Yep, it's just me.
Right this way then, please!
Howe entered the old-fashioned teahouse and Hai Chi showed her to a seat.
Welcome, Howe.
Thanks. I hope you don't mind having me here.
Not at all, we're honored to. Hai Chi, would you get her some tea?
Sure! Here you go.
Thanks. I've brought homemade cookies. Would you like some?
My, Howe, you're too generous for a guest.
Don't be shy. We're all friends here.
Look, sis! This cookie's shape spells out "good fortune!"
And this one looks like a garden lantern! These are so cool, Howe!
Yes, I went for some Dragon Empery design elements, since I'm visiting you all today. I hope you like them.
Hey, did someone say cookies? Save some for us!
Fu Shun entered the teahouse with Grozny in tow, the scent of cookies seemingly having attracted them.
Wow! These are almost too pretty to eat... I mean, right, Grozny?
Yeah. But I still wanna eat.
Then by all means, eat. I've made lots in preparation for this evening's banquet.
Hehehe. So, the reason I brought Grozny along is she said she wants to try Dragon Empery tea. I'm not stepping on anyone's toes here, am I?
Not at all. In fact, that's very kind of you. Hai Chi, please get some tea for Grozny as well.
Is this a teapot? Then I can pour for myself.
Grozny poured the contents of the teapot into her trusty canteen, then chugged the hot tea all in one go.
Goodness gracious...! Didn't that burn?
...*burp*. Nope, I'm good.
You can't do that, Grozny! You're supposed to take your time with tea, you know? Also, you should be drinking from a teacup instead!
Fu Shun snatched the canteen from Grozny and put a teacup on the table in its place.
That's tiny. What's the point if I can't chug?
It's the prime experience! Watch, I'll show you how to drink it like An Shan taught me.
Heehee, how lovely. Hosting a tea party was the right decision indeed.

sequence:
The Graceful Banquet

<size=45>2 The Garden</size>

scripts.say: Meanwhile, at a set designed after a Dragon Empery garden...
Look this way, Chitose. Yes, hold that pose... *click*
Hmm... It came out nicely, but I don't quite feel like it's "the one."
Snapping the perfect photo is tricky... Ow, my hair!
Just as Chitose stood up, her hair got caught on a tree branch.
Oh dear. Let me help you with that. Hold still, please.
Ugh... Sorry, and please do...
The calm and collected Chen Hai carefully disentangled Chitose's hair without incident.
That should do it. You've got such gorgeous hair, and I'm truly relieved it wasn't damaged just now.
Thanks... Chiyoda deserves the credit for my hair, though. She's the one who puts in all the work.
This photoshoot was her idea, actually.
She said it'd be a shame not to take a photo after all the effort of dressing me up and styling my hair.
I find it wonderful how close you two are. Next time, why not invite her to take pictures together with us?
That would be nice...
Oh, I just had a flash of inspiration. Could you stay for just one more photograph?
Sure, I guess. What do you want me to do?
Could you gently hang your hair on the branch back there?
Huh? But it got caught on it just a second ago.
I know, hence my use of the word "gently." Would you mind doing that for me?
Uh, sure... I-is this good enough?
*click*
Heehee, now this is a wonderful picture. I think I'll call it, "Beauty Among the Branches."
After she and Chitose parted ways, Chen Hai heard some sort of loud noise, which she decided to go investigate.
Nice and easy. Try not to push down too hard.
Okay... Nice and easy... Oh. Aww...
I broke it... Ugh, I just can't do it right...
Please don't fret, Miss Boise. You just need a little practice.
It's true you punctured the paper, but your calligraphy itself is excellent. Try again, but relax your hand a bit and I'm sure it'll go better.
Well, all right! I'll give it another shot...
Boise laid out a new sheet of paper, then picked up the writing brush with a determined look.
Please take your time. I know you have it in you, Miss Boise.
Huff... Puff... Deep breaths... Huff... Puff... Okay!
...I did it!
And you did it very well. See? I knew you could pull it off.
*click*
Heehee. This one I will call, "Bitterness Passes, Sweetness Lingers."

sequence:
The Graceful Banquet

<size=45>3 The Music Room</size>

scripts.say: Over in the music room, Roon was pouring her soul into a piano performance.
Tirpitz and Yat Sen were listening, taking in her beautiful notes like the whispers of a stream.
She concluded her melody and turned to ask them a question.
How was it this time around?
My. You have improved so much I can hardly believe what I just heard.
Agreed. You'll unquestioningly steal the show at the banquet with this performance.
I'm glad to hear it~ It means I'm one step closer to my goal of giving the Commander a private recital.
Having said that, I feel my musical repertoire is lacking.
Practice makes perfect. Don't be too hasty, instead focus on mastering the piano little by little.
Of course. For now, I must focus on nailing my performance at the banquet tonight.
I'm dedicating it to the Commander, so I cannot afford to make any mistakes.
Now let's do it one more time, from the top. Yat Sen, would you mind listening again?
Gladly. I'd love to offer my input after hearing how much better you've become.
Roon, upon further consideration, I'm willing to do a duet with you.
Heehee. You've finally made up your mind?
I cannot deny I feel the urge to perform in front of the Commander.
Besides, I can't just sit back after hearing that melody of yours.
It's time I took the plunge.
In that case, you're free to join in.
But, allow me to say this upfront – I will not hold my performance back just to make yours look better.
Neither will I. You're not the only one who's been practicing.
Yat Sen, I take it you'll be listening to us quite a lot before the actual show.
So would you mind giving me your input as well?
Of course, I'd be happy to. I'm certain your duet will take the banquet to the next level.
Now then, let's get to it, shall we?
A melody filled the room. The notes of Roon's piano and Tirpitz's flute came together harmoniously.

sequence:
The Graceful Banquet

<size=45>4 The Banquet</size>

scripts.say: Port - Banquet Hall
The time's finally come, huh...
(I've been training my ass off. I SHOULD be able to crack a natural smile now...)
(Take it easy, Washington. Just enjoy the banquet like everyone else and you'll be fine!)
N-nice to meet you!
(Man, she's tense, just like me! Pretty sure she's... Le Mars, from the Vichya Dominion?)
Ahem, um... G-good evening, Miss Washington!
You're worked up like crazy, aren'tcha?
Pardon?! H-how could you tell?!
I mean, it's written all over your face.
So it's that obvious... Apologies for my embarrassing display.
(Geesh... Somehow seeing someone more stressed than me is helping me ease up considerably...)
This your first time at a banquet?
It is! I've been on guard duty by the entrance numerous times, but never been here as a guest before...
Not only that, I have to wear a dress and pay attention to so many little things... It's so much all at once... Ugh...
You don't gotta worry so much. We all know each other here – no point stressing over being prim and proper.
In fact, you'll probably struggle to hold a conversation if you act so stiff.
Actually, now that you mention it, that's true!
Right? Try smiling like me, and I'm sure you'll feel more comfortable too.
...You're right! It's helping quite a lot!
Thank you so much, Miss Washington! I feel I'm getting used to this already!
Good to hear it. Go on and enjoy yourself now. I'm gonna hit the dinner table and help myself to some grub.
(She didn't comment on my smile at all... Do I take that to mean she thought it was natural?)
(Hell yeah! Actually, hang on... How'd the muscles in my face move to pull that off...)
(Consarnit! Need to remember now, before I forget!)
Washington solved someone's problem only to quickly end up with one of her own.
Some time later, after the banquet had begun...
I've brought freshly baked cookies. If anyone wants one, don't be shy.
Lemme have that one shaped like a garden lantern... Nom.
I think I'll have... this one that looks like a folding fan.
Thanks, Howe... I'll take the one that looks like a Dragon Empery character...
Whew... I suppose it's time to perform in front of a big audience.
Are you still nervous?
No, I'm fine. What I'm feeling could be better described as exhilaration.
Heehee. That's just what I like to hear.
Pour that feeling into your performance, and let's give them a passionate duet.
*click*
"A gathering of lovely guest seats – a banquet more pleasant than words can describe. A reverberating duet of wind and string instruments – a melody so wondrous in the air."
This one I shall title, "The Graceful Banquet."
I think that's enough photographs for today. The banquet is underway, and now it's time to focus on having a good time.
Speaking of which... Commander, would you like to join me for a dance?
All around me are those familiar walls, that familiar ceiling
Not long ago it was bustling in here, but now I am the only one here
My mind knows I must search for my missing friends and get a hold of the situation
But my body trembles with fear, my instincts warning me that this place is dangerous
I need to compose myself...
Calm down! Calm! Yourself! Down!
BOOOOOM!
I can't! I can't do it! How's anyone supposed to calm down with this going on around them?!
Mio? Is that you there?!
Fubuki?! Thank the algorithm you're okay!
We need to get out of here. Mass-produced Siren ships are coming our way!
Si... rens?
Hold on... They sound like destroyers, based on those explosions. It's probably just a vanguard fleet. The main fleet must be behind them.
You're... keeping your cool surprisingly well... Wait, what did you say? A fleet? Whaddya mean "fleet"?
Calm down, Mio. There are Siren fleets around us as far as the eye can see...
I'm surmising that, for whatever reason, we and the rest of the Hololive Server got transported to the world of Azur Lane. Smack-dab in the middle of a battle, too...
So by Sirens, you mean... Those time-travelers that invaded the world of Azur Lane?!
Never mind that, we've been sent to another world! How the heck do we get back?!
Dammit... If I only had my own fleet with me, this would be a piece of cake!
If only Kawakaze and Zuikaku were here...
How did you get here, Javelin?
We were on our way back from a commission when suddenly this fog appeared out of nowhere, and suddenly we found ourselves inside a Mirror Sea...
Were there any others in your fleet?
Yeah, there were. Ayanami, Laffey, and Z23 were with me.
We'd better go looking for them then...
Fubuki! Mio! I'm so relieved to see you're okay!
Likewiiiise. I don't know what I would've pooooossibly done if you'd gotten huuuurt. God forbiiiid.
Let me introduce you to my new friend: Javelin!
Are you a Hololive character too?
Yup. I'm Hololive's pure and innocent highschool girl – Natsuiro Matsuri!
And you're Kawakaze, aren't you? I've heard about you before! Listen, I've got a bucket list to check off, so would you mind if I stroked your tail? And could I get a hug? Can we go on a date after?
... If you're from the same place as this Shirakami Fubuki, where did you get your rigging from?
Oh, you mean my shooty bang bang stuff? I got it from Purity!
Purity? Who's that?
She's this nice girl in spats who rescued me and Aqua when we were in trouble. She even made us some gear to defend ourselves with!
Purity... A girl in spats... Wait, it can't be...
You know what "can't be"? How pretty she is! You should see her!
She and Aqua stayed behind at the Resistance base to strengthen its defenses while Javelin and I went out to look for people.
Matsuri's mostly right, but there's a bit more to it... We should probably go back to the base for now.
See that building over there made of sparkling obsidian? That's our base.
How'd you get artillery up there?! This is way beyond the definition of "base," it's a straight-up fort...
Actually, everything above ground is just a decoy, the real base is hidden underwater. You can only enter through a secret entrance, so follow me.
The structure above ground draws attention away from the true fortification below ground... Now I see why you call it a secret base.
I'm honestly amazed that Aqua's and Matsuri's base would come in handy one day. As that one guy said, life's like a box of chocolates.
Alright everyone, take a deep breath and follow me~
Captain, we're home~ How're things going?
Hey, Matsuri! You were gone for so long I was starting to worry. Nice to see Fubuki and Mio made it in one piece!
Look at that, Matsuri's back! Good timing, we just finished testing Aqua's rigging. Oh, guessing you brought some friends with you?
Sure did! This here's Shirakami Fubuki, and this is Ookami Mio.
And then the girls who got them out of a tight situation: Kawakaze and Zuikaku. The Resistance grows stronger!
Welcome aboard, folks! We've got fun and games!
You... I remember you, Purifier!
I can take your head in the blink of an eye at this range!
Wait, wait, WAIT! Calm down, you two!
What, Javelin?
Purifier's... lost her memories?
Yeah. I was pretty shocked too when she came in and blew up all the mass-produced Sirens attacking us...
Then I went and saved Aqua and Matsuri and brought them here.
... You're not pretending to be on our side, are you?
She's a Siren. After all the Sirens have done, I'm not going to simply take her word for it.
You have to believe us! Purity would never hurt anyone! You must be confusing her for someone else who looks like her!
I couldn't believe it at first either, but Purifi– I mean, Purity really did save us, and she's on our side...
Uhh, have I horribly wronged some of you in the past? I mean, if you want us to prove our allegiance, I can go out back and commit double suicide with Tessy. We can always get new bodies.
Who's "Tessy"? Wait... Tester's here too?!
Yup... Anyway, we need to come up with a plan for what to do next.
I'll stay with Purifi– Purity, and keep an eye on her.
Thank you, Kawakaze!
These are abnormal circumstances, and I'm willing to accept abnormal things within reason. But don't get careless, Javelin.
Phew, you had me spooked for a second there, Kawakaze... So, all friends here, yeah?
No, this is merely a ceasefire. I'm– Hey, stop that! Why are you measuring them, Purifier?!
Uh, so I can make them some rigging too? Surely getting more people equipped to search for their friends is more important than keeping their 3 measurements a secret?
Search for their friends? There are more than just Fubuki, Mio, Aqua, and Matsuri?
We still haven't found Ayame, Shion, or Miss Sora yet. Wherever they are, I hope they're okay.
Ayame has her demon powers and Shion can use magic, so they're probably fine. Miss Sora, on the other hand... Well, it's Miss Sora, I'm sure she can manage!
Maybe they can, but we're not gonna just leave them to fend for themselves out there.
Sounds like a plan! You girls with riggings go out and look for the last three while yours truly stays behind. Somebody's gotta kit out Fubuki and Mio, after all.
This could end up becoming a drawn-out battle, so we should probably try to collect resources when we can...
Gathering resources is my middle name! Leave it to Lady Aqua~
You girls should take a break, and I'll prepare you some hefty lunches in the meanwhile.
Aww, you're so sweet, Javelin. You'll make a lovely wife one day...
(Once we're back home, I'd better get the rest of the gang to play AL. For now though, time to rest...)
Wow, this rigging is amazing! I never expected weapons this powerful to be so easy to control!
With OP gear like this, even a pure and delicate girl like me can become a ganking queen at the drop of a hat!
(The rigging Purity made doesn't function the same way as ours...)
(Even then, you can't simply equip a ship's rigging and master its use immediately. The Mirror Sea must be affecting her somehow.)
Anyway, now I have the power to protect my friends! Hooray!
Oh yeah, why can't we just get riggings for everyone then face the Sirens head-on?
They might have numbers, but we're way stronger. We'd beat them in the blink of an eye.
There is some truth to that, but reality isn't so simple.
Besides... a world where any random person can pick up arms and go to war is destined to fall to ruin.
Wowie! Kawakaze: cute on the outside, cool on the inside! There's an audience for characters like that, you know!
I can't pull that off, though. I don't know much about your world, and I'm not much of a fighter either, so sorry if I say anything that sounds weird!
You don't know how to fight? I thought you're part of the Resistance?
I've fought a few times before! Just not, you know, like this. Ahahaha~
What a strange place you come from...
Aww, don't be like that! Experience is still experience!
That white building is the Holomart. We store all our tools and stuff in there, so it's the best place to start if we wanna get resources.
Actually, I have a question about these supplies...
Whoopsie, I never formally introduced myself!
It's nice to meet you (again.) I'm Minato Aqua, Hololive's local virtual maid!
But just because I'm maid doesn't mean I'm good at housekeeping, that's a stereotype! Video games, however, you bet I am!!!!!
Not much makes sense in this world I've been thrust into, but I can tell you what I DO know!

We kept water, food, and medicine stockpiled in our hideout back in the Hololive Server, which have all carried over, but for some reason we've also got ammunition that conveniently works with our riggings just lying around!
That, and blocks of TNT. They work slightly differently compared to back on the Hololive Server, but they still explode just as well!
Back then I figured I'd need them at some point, so I hid stores of them all over the place, although I'm not sure if they're still there...
Anyhoo, this place you call a "Mirror Sea" seems to be similar to the Hololive Server in a lot of ways!
And since blocks of TNT are the most powerful item available on the Hololive Server, I suggest you collect as much of it as you can!!!!!!!
From what I understand based on Fubuki's explanation, Hololive is a talent agency that recruits and oversees "Vtubers," as she called them.
So, if you are performers of some sort, why do you have massive amounts of TNT lying around?
"Talent agency"... I mean...
Don't worry about the TNT too much, just think of it as an everyday item! We need it to construct buildings, you see.
You build houses out of dynamite...? What a peaceful world you come from if explosives make the foundations of your buildings...
Uhh... sure! Let's not worry about the details and just focus on the big picture!
But, if we're to collect this TNT as we supposedly should, we'll need to clear out the Sirens in the area first.
That's easy peasy~ Let's rev up our engines and do it!
Hold, Matsuri. I'm receiving a message from Zuikaku.
Siren aircraft are bombing "a giant wooden castle." Target is believed to be one of the Hololivers. Heading there to provide support.
... End of transmission. Seems we've located one of your friends.
Giant wooden castle...? Wait, that sounds like... Nakiri Castle! Ayame should be there! We'd better go help her!
On the horizon – across the many islands scattered about the Mirror Sea – sits an isolated castle. Its structure wooden, its surroundings silent.
Its purpose, unclear. Perhaps to defend a strategic position, or symbolize its owner's control over the area.
Regardless, the Sirens have their destructive eyes fixated upon it.
And soon, it might fall to ruin by their hand.
I thought we'd be safe in your castle, but it seems I've been proven wrong...
Ay only come to this server to build things! Why must such wanton destruction befall my creations?!
The Sirens are behind this...
Sirens...? You mean the ones from that game Fubuki plays?
Are you saying that this is a video game world?!
We need to get out of here! Ayame, why would you make a castle this big without constructing a secret escape route?!
Twas designed with everyday activities in mind! 'Tis for raising animals, growing crops, and lounging around!
Ay never suspected a siege to happen, much less there be a need for a hidden passage!
Welp... We're screwed, then.
It's okay. I can take care of the Sirens.
Excuse me?! You two against an army?
Well said! Ay shall join them! These "Sirens" shall learn the sharpness of my blades!
It's too dangerous for you. You don't have any rigging.
Shion, Ayame, you're not trained to fight. Ayanami and I can do it.
B-but...
You don't need to worry. We're experienced with fighting them.
Dunno why, but they have a lot of carriers... That works in our favor.
Yes. If we can launch a surprise attack on them, it will be easy!
Is that... Ayanami and Laffey?
Are they your friends?
In essence.
Then you've got awesome friends! Look at them fighting carriers many times their size without any hesitation!
I've never seen a Siren fleet composed only of carriers and no backup. This Mirror Sea is making them behave differently...
No matter, we must take care of them. Matsuri, I'll need your support.
You can count on me!
Waaaaahhhh! Thank the sorcery gods you're here, Matsuri...
*Sob*... I was so scaaaaaaared!
Aww, don't cry, Shion. Everything's fine now. You were really brave, weren't you...
We wouldn't have made it here were it not for your help, Ayanami and Laffey. You have my gratitude.
Don't thank us. We couldn't stand by and do nothing.
The Sirens are our enemy...
Now that we've found you two, only one left to find is Miss Sora.
Let us not forget Z23. I hope they're both unharmed out there.
I sure hope so...
Despicable Sirens, how dare they do this to my castle...
Don't be sad, Ayame! Once the fighting's over, we can build a new one, with blackjack and booze! We have the technology!
We shall! And this time, Ay will make sure to build a hidden passage!
Why are you doing this?!
My condolences, Z23 from Azur Lane, but you must die.
Hold on a second, Aqua, I think you may have things backwards!
I'm pretty sure Fubuki once told me those Sirens behind you are the enemy in Azur Lane, not this girl.
You're mistaken, Miss Sora. I will explain everything after I've dealt with this one.
We'll be surrounded before long! Sora, we should flee immediately!
(Javelin... Laffey... Ayanami... Wherever you are, I hope you're okay...!)

<size=51>The longing for the future</size>
<size=51>The reflection that is there, but always out of reach</size>

<size=51>Its outcome, as expected</size>
<size=51>What is real? What is false?</size>
<size=51>All that remains is a small mystery</size>
<size=51>So let the tale be told</size>
<size=51>Will you, perhaps, solve the mystery?</size>

scripts.say: Noon - Within the Route Escort Fleet
Another commission completed without a hitch!
Nice breeze, calm waves, nice weather all around. I can't wait to get home and take a nap in the sun!
Something wrong, Kawakaze? You're being awfully quiet.
Oh, it's nothing... I was just thinking about my sword. It'll surely start rusting if they continue giving us nothing but escort missions.
I don't mind getting a break from the action. Plus, it's an important job, and someone's gotta do it.
Speaking of breaks, you need to start letting up that poker face if you hope to make friends. Come on, let's see a smile!
Uh, Zuikaku, look ahead...
... What the heck is that...?
It appears to be fog... but there's more to it than that.
My gauges indicate the humidity levels and water temperature in the area are changing rapidly. There also seems to be an island coming into view in the distance.
All signs point toward this being a Mirror Sea. Come on, Sirens! Can't you at least once let us return home in peace?
Detecting numerous mass-produced Siren vessels heading in our direction.
Kawakaze, you watch the front. I'll scramble my planes in the meanwhile so we can take out the Sirens!
... It sounds like Kawakaze has managed to group up with Nakiri and Shion.
Great to hear! Though we still don't know where Miss Sora is...
I'm just wondering: is she particularly famous? You don't seem to address anyone else in your group with "Miss," so...
That's because she was one of the first members of Hololive! And since we joined later and she always looks after us, we give her that bit of extra respect.
Like how I respect my sister Shoukaku... Although she can be kind of mean from time to time.
Hm? My recon planes have found a familiar face! Let's see...
Z23, and... Huh? Aqua?
It's found me?
Apparently. At least someone who looks like you. There's someone else there with brown hair!
That has to be Sora! But why am I there? That's impossible!!!
Hmm, isn't this Shirakami Shrine, a.k.a. Fubuki's place? Ah, there she is! I see her!
Sora, over here!
Huh? Aqua? But you're over here, and over there... why are there multiple Aquas?
Sora, look out! That maid is an imposter created by the Sirens!
Nuh-uh, she's the imposter! Look, Sora, I'm the real one!
Wh-whaaat?
The Sirens have already made a copy of Aqua?!
A... copy?
The Sirens can make clones out of anyone that enters waters they control, like a mirror reflection of them. That's why they're called Mirror Seas.
But the clones only LOOK like someone else, and still follow the Sirens' orders. Just knock 'em down like bowling pins!
Zuikaku, there's more to it! That Aqua clone is different!
What...?
Hahahah... My name is Yamada Hermione. I have awaited your arrival, as per orders of my master, the ruler of time and space.
"Ruler of time and space"? What the heck?!
Who's that? Is it the Siren that messed this place up?!
Perhaps, perhaps not... Ahahah, you need not know who it is.
Now remain still as I do as my master instructed and end your lives.
Stop it, Aqua!
Please do not interfere, Miss Sora. It is my duty to kill these people.
Aqua would never say something crazy like that!
Would she not...? You're mistaken, because...
I'm Aqua, too!!!
... This is why the Sirens' pawns are such a pain. Aqua, if you can't fight someone who looks just like you, I can take care of her.
"Yamada Hermione"?! You cheeky Siren bastard! I'm a battle-hardened combat maid who's played through more hardcore games than you can even imagine! Don't you dare make fun of me!
You're going DOWN! Let's beat the everliving crap out of this literal nobody!!!
After eliminating the imposter spawned by the Mirror Sea, all the members of Hololive and Azur Lane safely managed to regroup.
They brought with them the supplies they had gathered to the Resistance hideout, and spent the rest of their day there.
Inside the Hololive Resistance Base
So when you defeated the Aqua clone, she instantly turned to light and vanished?
Hang on... Doesn't that sound like she used the teleport command we have on the server?
Oh, you're kidding... You mean Tessy's assumed direct control of the server?
Tessy? Ah, that girl who looked like Tester...
Yeah. She's behaving really weird, just like Purifier. But unlike her, Tester is still evil...
That means there's a high chance that Tester is that alleged "ruler of time and space"... Oh, right, how are you Hololivers doing? Everything all right?
We're A-OK! Ayame and Shion didn't seem keen on fighting at first, but they're pretty eager now that they've gotten the hang of it!
Th-they're the enemy, Matsuri! Of course Ay will fight them with all Ay have!
Y-you said it! Aqua's enjoying herself too, so what's the big deal?
Ah, classic Gammadion Gang. Like three peas in a pod.
About the Sirens... Do you fight them all the time in this world?
Correct. They are our enemies and threaten the safety of our sea lanes.
We were created for the purpose of fighting the Sirens and driving them back.
Although I have another duty: to protect Nagato, the shrine maiden of the Sakura Empire.
Sorry. I didn't intend to make the conversation so serious.
Anyway, I suspect the Sirens will extract the data from your riggings to create more of their pawns. Your riggings were made here, after all.
You should expect to have to fight more enemies that look like one of your own.
Ahahahah, all we need to do is smack 'em down and put an end to whatever scheme the Sirens are trying to pull!
Then we'll find Tester– sorry, Tessy, and solve the mystery behind the Hololive Server. Then we'll get you Hololivers home!
But that's for tomorrow! Right now, we need to all get some sleep.
Even knowing they're just copycats, fighting enemies that look like your allies takes its toll on you. I would know.
But for them, it's even worse. This place their home, and this base looks just like one they put so much effort into making.
Which is why I feel guilty about making them go to battle amidst all this.
I don't like doing it, but we're all in this together. Our mutual trust will help us get through it. Right, Kawakaze?
If you're concerned about them, just ask how they're faring.
Mmhh... Laffey... Zuikaku... Mio...
Stay outta trouble... Zzzz...
Zzzzz...
Late at night - Outside the Resistance Base
Whew... I've gotta say, the sea breeze feels nice~
If we meet that Aqua clone again...
I guess we've got no choice but to fight her...
But... can I actually do it? Can I fight someone who looks like her, even knowing she's the enemy? What if they make clones out of everyone...
Will I... be able to do anything?
Miss Sora... You're so kind...
The following day
Now, let's continue from the last strategy discussion we held.
Go ahead, teacher!
Go ahead, teacher!
I'm not a teacher, just a facilitator! *Sigh*... Let's start with Purifi– excuse me, Purity, who has something to say.
So yeah, everyone's been talking about "solving the mystery of the Mirror Sea" and stuff. If you wanna do that, just get to the foundation of it.
Its "foundation"?
You heard me. I don't mean foundation as in the bottom of this ocean sector or whatever, but the foundation behind the very concept of the Mirror Sea. Don't ask why, I just know.
Meaning, we'll find a way to turn the Mirror Sea back to normal when we get to the foundation of the Hololive Server?
Hmm... The foundation of the Hololive Server... Maybe she means the Hololive Headquarters? Would make sense, as we're all part of Hololive.
Actually... Zuikaku sent her recon planes to scout the area, and didn't find any building that appears to be a headquarters.
We did find a massive maze that wasn't there yesterday, though.
Massive maze? You mean the labyrinth I made?
Sounds to me like we might find something there!
Let's do it! We might find some sort of clue in there!
Or walk haphazardly into a hazard... but it's better than having no leads to follow. Zuikaku, I suggest we explore the maze.
Seems to be our only choice... Hololivers, I'd like you to handle communications and base defense, and we'll explore the–
I appreciate the courtesy, but I want to go into battle too.
Yes, but...
And I wanna go with Fubuki! Besides, I made the labyrinth in the first place and know where all the traps are. I'll be your guide!
True, your familiarity with it would be good to have.
Okay, then I'm going–
We can't ALL sortie. Someone must remain here and keep an eye on the base and keep it functional.
Aww, I was just going to swear on my name that I'd find the headquarters building before anyone else.
Now, now, it's equally important to keep everything running, Aqua.
Ayanami, Javelin, stay here and watch the base.
Okay, we will.
Can I go? Please! Pretty please!
You're staying behind, Purity. Owing to your memory loss, we can't fully trust you.
Bawww...
All right, let's get to our respective tasks! We'll break free of this Mirror Sea together!
Yeeeeah!
Three hours later
... Sorry, everyone, I was wrong.
I thought the labyrinth had only gotten bigger, but somebody's added new traps and ambush areas. What was originally the safe way through has become littered with traps...
And it's all made from the ocean... If only we could simply swim beneath it. Go down where it's wetter, down where it's better.
Whoever remodeled the labyrinth must be familiar with how it was originally like...
That leaves few candidates as to who it might be.
A clone of Mio, I suppose... Would make sense if she was the keeper of this place.
But if someone went through all the trouble of changing the labyrinth, that might mean we're on the right track.
If the key to solving the mystery of the Mirror Sea really does lie in here, then the enemy must be ready to protect it fiercely. Stay on your guards.
You got it. I'm pumped up and ready to take on this chump of a pawn!
Don't tempt fate with one-liners like that, Mio...
Two hours later
Heh, okay, we've gotta go right at the next junction.
Wait here. The path marked with a platter is the right one.
I'm surprised we're making so much progress...
That's thanks to Z23's idea! "If you were to remodel the labyrinth, how would you do it?"
Everything falls into place when I view it from the perspective of what my clone would do.
We'll get to the end of this maze in no time at this rate!
It's just as the cards said... They'll get here no matter what I do to try to stop them.
I bid you welcome. I am the fortuneteller Miokawa Iiyo, otherwise known as Intelligence Mionnu.
Hang on, I recognize her... That's Mio's character from when we were playing tabletop RPGs!
Ay had a feeling things would turn out this way when Ay saw that platter symbol...
Surrender while you still can! You have no chance of winning when there are this many of us.
I would certainly like to, but...
I have my orders from the ruler of time and space, and I cannot simply surrender...
Listen, I'm really sorry, but I just have to defeat you.
Then try it...!
Before the Mio clone could even move a muscle, Kawakaze came lunging at her.
The glint of her sword forms a beautiful arch, and just as her blade was about to bisect the imposter...
(You're mine...!)
SMASH!
I'm afraid that won't work...…
She stopped Kawakaze's attack by breaking a platter?!
She's a fortuneteller, so she can do things like that.
Hrmh! If that's how you want it!
Realizing her first attack failed, Kawakaze pulls back and launches her torpedoes. However...
Oh come on! She can stop torpedoes with them too?!
Considering she has 75 points invested in her Throwing stat, yeah...
Mio, why'd you even allocate her stats in such a weird way?
She only appeared in like, one game! I didn't expect her to show up again in the future!
Kawakaze, look out!
BOOOOOM!
Kawakaze is entirely focused on Iiyo, and doesn't notice the attack coming at her from the shadows.
Not on my watch!
Miss Sora!
Sora knocks Kawakaze out of the way and the blocks the shell with her rigging.
It's... it's fine! The rigging Purity made is sturdier than you'd think... Looks like that came in handy!
I owe you my thanks...
Listen, clones! I'm in charge of protecting these people, and I'm not letting you lay a finger on them!
Hmph. So you blocked it.
Thanks for showing up, Nakiri.
Ohohohoh! Well met, my otherworldly adversaries! My name is Kakitsubata Nakiri. As you can see, Ay am but a simple highschool girl with a noble upbringing.
Don't let her appearance fool you! She might look dainty, but she's built like a muscle mountain and has 70 points in her Punching stat!
Ay haven't the faintest idea what it is you're talking about, dear.
Tallyho, Iiyo. It is time to show them what we are made of.
Guess we never stood a chance...
Oh, blast it...
They did it again! They used the teleport command!
And they did so at the last possible moment... Is this some sort of automatic safety feature the server has?
Hrm... I know they're just clones the Sirens made, but it's still hard to get myself to fight them.
That said, I might be able to go all out if always get teleported away right before their HP hits 0. I'm not about to let an imposter beat me.
Hmh, as someone once said: a faker will never be anything more than a faker...
But it's annoying that we can't reduce their numbers. They'll wear us down over time if they simply retreat, heal, and come back to fight us again.
We need only take out their stronghold before it comes to that.
(Sora seems a lot more resolute than she was yesterday... That's reassuring.)
I'm done being hesitant. From now on, my mind is set: we'll put a stop to the Sirens' schemes and end this whole ordeal.
I'm getting fed up with fighting all these clones...
I understand. Fighting clones of yourself is one thing, but it's rather distressing to fight those of your close friends.
The Sirens have always played dirty like that. Once we get back, Purity's getting an earful from me!
From me too...
I can hear you, ya know!
Whuah?! Why are you contacting us all of a sudden, Purity?
Zed, how is it going on your end?
We walked into an ambush, but we dealt with the Sirens and were just going to resume our search. What about the base, everything fine there?
The base is functioning as normal.
While the base is fine, there's this black veil that suddenly appeared out of nowhere! I think it's expanding, and coming from the labyrinth, actually...
What?!
Look up, everyone!
Just as Javelin said, there's a veil floating in the air above the labyrinth.
Or rather, it's in the sky. It spans across the ocean, enveloping everything in its path.
That's not a veil, it's a barrier! And unbelievably strong one, at that! I hit it with everything I have, yet it didn't as much as cut a hole into it!
This is obviously an impassable wall the GM made that we can't pass through without permission...
We can't go forward like this...
It seems we have no choice but to fall back for the time being...
Say, if we can't go by air or by sea...
Then I might have a good solution to the problem...

sequence: <size=51>"... Molds." "... Emotions." "... Intimations."</size>
<size=51>And...</size>
<size=51>   ……</size>
<size=51>"... Falsehood." "... Greatness." "... Gates."</size>
<size=51>And finally...</size>

scripts.say: And with this, the Resistance will have their hands tied behind their backs. Well done, Fubu– I mean, my "Advisor."
Don't worry. Those fools have no way to break the barriers created by your energy generator.
However, this Mirror Sea's control unit has a tendency to disobey me.
Is that because... full authorization has not been granted yet?
Look there. This device has not fully acknowledged me. Me, Tester, the manipulator of space and time! The one who rules these seas!
This must be the result of a prior faulty experiment. If you activate more of its functions, surely authorization will be restored.
Most likely. In that case, I will leave the defense of the perimeters to you, "Advisor."
After teaming up to defeat the fake Ookami Mio, Azur Lane and the Hololive members found themselves hindered again by some sort of barrier.
At that time, Hololive's Natsuiro Matsuri proposed a completely unprecedented strategy.
We'll just go underneath it!
Huh? That's impossible! Aqua won't be able to go through the route that the other Mio told us about because of her submarine equipment!
There's no way we'll be able to get through the water! The barrier also extends underneath the surface, so it's a dead end!
I wonder if this extends all the way to the bottom of the sea...
That's why we're not going underwater. We're going to be going underground.
Underground? Do you plan to dig a tunnel?
Wait, what... No way... You're kidding, right?
Aqua, Shion, what will you two do?
If you dig over there, you'll probably just end up in "the cemetery"...
The cemetery...?
Ahem! ... That's just how Shion describes it! Its actual name is "Dark Hololive." It's a secret base filled with all sorts of traps.
But it's a haunted mansion!!
(Ignore)
... In any case, according to the new intel we've collected, the Mirror Sea built from "Holoserver" is much larger than the original.
That's right. The earth and the sky... This place is a lot bigger than the Holoserver we know.
In other words, if we use the secret passageway that was originally located underneath the seabed, we should be able to pass through the barrier!
Hmm, if it's the Tessy that I know... No, she wouldn't extend the barrier all the way into the lava.
I suppose this is the best bet we have right now. It's worth a try.
That settles it! Our objective is to get to Dark Hololive! Let's begin the operation!
After a few quick skirmishes, the Sirens' reinforcements ceased coming, and the sea turned still once more.
As the two searched for a way to exit the Mirror Sea, the fog before their eyes cleared up almost as quickly as when it formed.
It's almost like the fog itself is a part of the abnormal weather within the Mirror Sea.
What in the world...?!
Looks like we aren't out of the Mirror Sea yet...
Countless islands appeared before them, and massive artificial structures rose high up above in the far distance.
Upon closer inspection, the islands' flora and the structures appear to be made out of innumerable blocks.
It all looks like a poor replica of the real world in their eyes.
The Sirens' technology never ceases to amaze...
Zuikaku, the weather around us just changed again. It's looking like we'll need to explore the area to find a way out.
I mean, that was pretty obvious to me from the moment we wandered in here.
... You're not afraid of what might happen?
It's fine, we'll get outta here sooner or later. We don't achieve anything by worrying about what we don't know.
And while we're here, might as well investigate to see what the Sirens are planning!
With everyone's hard work, the huge diamond cross marking the base's entrance was quickly located.
After much deliberation, Aqua and Shion remained inside the base while the others split up into a forward group and support group.
Mirror Sea - Underground Pass
... Why'd you bring me along...
Purifier, don't ditch.
I wasn't going to ditch~ There's other stuff I could be doing, like expanding the base's defences or reinforcing the walls, right?
You guys like keeping me behind the scenes, right?
... Thanks to you, the Resistance base's defenses are so strong that nobody can even touch it anymore...
Motion-sensing attack automata, a labyrinth of traps, and the TNT block cannon generated by those green villagers... Ahh, it's all so exciting!
We made the right decision to bring her with us...
Even if you're not able to help out here, don't think you're dead weight.
Anyways, let's start by exploring. Purifier, help out as well.
But, I'm a Siren, you know? Who knows what I might do if things get a little chaotic here~
We want you to help precisely because you're a Siren! Experience withstanding, it's always more efficient to use boss characters whenever you get the chance!
If you wish to get under Tessy's skin as well then you may certainly join us, Purity.
That decides it. We'll have you help, even if you don't want to.
Well, I was getting tired of sitting around crafting stuff anyway. If you're going to say that much, it wouldn't kill me to help out.
(This girl's such a simpleton...)
"Are you sure about this?" "I don't think you're going to make it." "Hell lies just ahead, all right?"
What's up with these signs...?
It's a totally different atmosphere with everyone together~~
Wait a sec... the signs I made should have said "You still can make it!" and "There's always next time!"...
Does that mean...
Natsuiro Matsuri, answer me! Among the Hololive girls, who do you love the most?
Who is it?!
Is that... a Matsuri imposter?!
Imposter? If you're the real deal, then you should be able to answer this question. Now, answer me! Among the Hololive girls, who do you love the most?
Um...
You can't answer, can you? Matsuri, you know what that means...
Well, if you suddenly ask me something like that... my answer is this!
Gyahh?!
Woah, she pulled out her rigging and started firing?!
I was... deceived...? Impossible!!
I could have said "I love them all," or "I can't decide," but... actions speak louder than words!

Zuikaku, let's help them set up the TNT too!
Oka~y, now set the TNT around the building, because Aqua is going to press the explosion switch~
Hmm~ you guys are going to blow it up after all. Is that really okay? Doesn't the Sakura Empire want Siren technology for themselves?
Siren technology is dangerous. You should know that the best.
Our path is something that we'll carve out with our own hands!
Hm~ Well that's fine. Aight, I'll help out a bit as well!
Finally, the last moments have arrived.
Well then, please listen to my response!
On this day, at this time, feeling the advent of spring
I, Minato Aqua, was able to head toward graduation without issue.
Those who were always by me since arriving in the world of Azur Lane: Fubuki, Matsuri, Mio, Ayame, Shion, Sora
Those who always fought together with us: Kawakaze, Zuikaku, Laffey, Ayanami, Javelin, Z23, Purity
Along with Yamada Hermione, Miokawa Iiyo, Kakitsubata Nakiri, Ma Tsu Ri, Shi O N, Super Sadist Sora, Great Detective Fubuki, Dark Fox Blizzard
And, the one who didn't make a single appearance from start to finish, Tester
Friend or Foe, I truly thank you for everything.
If I think about it, just a little bit ago, my chest was full of unease and fear as I entered through the gate of the Mirror Sea.
Since that day, I was able to make countless memories with everyone.
In a group together with everyone, I was able to increase my skills in battle. From a battle between maids, to planning and clearing a huge labyrinth, to a Shadow Duel...
The fear of being thrust into crisis after crisis, the joy of collecting items
I was able to learn many things spending everyday life as a ship girl.
Even if I graduate, I will never forget the lessons I have learned here.
Everyone, I thank you for taking care of me up to now!
While this ends with that, as a member of Hololive, I would like to offer everyone a prayer for their lives after this event.
Graduating Student Representative, Minato Aqua
Well then, Hololive Resistance, we're good to go! Let's start this show!
Five, four, three, two, one...
Explosion!!!
*Pant*... *Pant*... Fubuki, just leave me... I can't take another step…
No, Mio! Don't stop there, you'll–
AAAAAHHH!
... get shot by the Sirens...
You've gotta come up with something and help! I don't wanna die here!
We're outnumbered and outgunned... This is looking bleak.
Focus, Fubuki! We can't just give up!
The Sirens' aircraft release their payloads over the fleeing girls.
Mio, I'm glad I at least get to spend my final moments with–
Nobody's dying on my watch! I'll take care of them, so just stay out of danger!
The headquarters building has been completely blown up, it seems. Was that laugh Aqua's voice?
I guess I'll congratulate you, in a way. How utterly ridiculous.
Have some consideration for this body's sound reception part, gosh. Ugh, and her voice is so loud.
... My conscience is slowly fading.
"Purifier. Welcome back♪"
Ugh, this annoying voice, it's them. The amount of data that's flowing it, there's no way I'm mistaken.
I wonder if my personality program malfunctioned due to being connected to that strange Mirror Sea?
Tester as well. Tessy? The ruler of time and space? Lame. It wasn't that Purifier, and it wasn't a poem.
... Okay, cleanup starting up, personality program reinstalling, checking all files, and synchronizing data.
"*Sigh*, well, since the termination of that abnormal Mirror Sea, the Siren network has been restored, so I should start returning to the repository."
"It was fun fighting alongside you."
"I won't say something like that. There. The next time we meet, we'll definitely be enemies, so go back to home base and go write reports to your death or something."
"With that said, peace."
... Well, I guess that's it. I guess I'll start to be overwritten by my previous personality program.
..... So in the end, am I a "machine body," or am I a "piece"...
It's a pain to think about... Sigh... I'm... tired...
Purifier went and disappeared at some point.
I wonder if it's really all over this time...
Even if it was a Siren with abnormal circumstances, it really was a good chance to get to know the enemy... It would have been nice if I could have gamed some more at the Resistance base.
Mm, jeez. It's unusual for me, but I've gotta agree with you... Well, you're right in that if all Sirens were like that, we wouldn't have to fight them.
Because they were a comrade who fought alongside us. Even if it's another Siren, if they're a good guy, they you should be friends with them.
Once we leave this area, we'll need to find a way back.
If it's that, the Commander and Akashi back at home base might know of some way of helping you guys out.
Beep Beep Beep!
I'm getting a reaction from the transmission machine! Communications have been restored!
Zuikaku? Zuikaku, are you alright?
It's Shoukaku!
That's good! Your communications must have finally been restored! Is everyone in the fleet alright?
Gosh, being stuck in this Mirror Sea for several made me feel super lonely!
For several days? What do you mean?
Umm, while we were on convoy duty while returning from a commission mission, we got sucked up into the Mirror Sea that suddenly popped up.
After searching around the Mirror Sea for several days, we were just now able to destroy the equipment responsible for the area and finally recovered our communications.
Is that so...? Has it really been that long since we've lost contact with you...?
E-Eh?
Is it possible that this phenomenon resulted in a different flow of time inside the Mirror Sea compared to outside of it?
That's impossible, nya. The laws of space would be broken, nya.
Either way, it seems like it really happened... It seems that I really do need to study this Mirror Sea incident.
Come to think of it, the people around you are...
Ah, these girls are members of an organization called Hololive... Anyway, these girls are comrades who came from the other world that got entangled with ours and arrived here.
Comrades who arrived from another world - isn't this a common trope, nya?
Well, if you mumble about the Siren equipment that was left in the area the Mirror Sea appeared in, it'll work out somehow!
Guys, hurry up and come back~ Everyone's worried about you, you know?
Ah, and one more thing...
You guys did a great job. And, welcome to our world~
Were either of you hurt?
Oh... Oh my God! It's you! It's really you, Kawakaze!
Look, Mio! It's the real Kawakaze!
... What? I don't even get what just happened... But I guess we're saved now?
Squeeee! Look! Those cool eyes, that slender body, that fluffy tail! It's Kawakaze, in the flesh!
Calm down, Fubuki. You're making her uncomfortable.
So here you were. Glad to see you're both all right.
You're here too, Zuikaku?!
Sorry, where are my manners... Ahem, thank you for saving us when we were in danger.
You don't have any rigging from what I can see... But you've got cat ears and know our names... Are you from the Sakura Empire, by any chance?
Cat ears?! Excuse me, can't you see my tail? I'm a fox!
Oh, a fox? S-sorry!
It's no biggie. Anyway... I'm Shirakami Fubuki, the white-haired, animal-eared high-schooler working with Hololive. Many people mistake me for a cat, but I'm 100% a fox!
As for the reason why I know your names, well, that's a long story...
And I'm Ookami Mio, I also work with Hololive. I'm one of the Hologamers, if you want to be specific. Just call me Mio.
"Hololive"? Sounds like an organization, I guess...
I'm Zuikaku, Shoukaku-class aircraft carrier. And this is Kawakaze, Shiratsuyu-class destroyer.
Mhm, I know all about you. I made oaths with both of you, so how could I forget~
... I don't understand what you're talking about.
Seeing as you're unarmed, I assume you're civilians? Did you get caught in the bad weather?
This area's turned into a Mirror Sea and become infested with Sirens. It's really dangerous here, so you should stay close to us.
I honestly don't know how or why we ended up here... But I can say this place looks familiar.
As far as I can tell, this is the Hololive Server, or at least it was made to closely resemble it.
Hololive... server...?
Basically, it's like a secret base of ours. We often bring our friends here to build stuff or hang out.
A secret base? But there was never anything in this area prior to this...
We were just building stuff like usual, then this blinding light appeared outta nowhere... Next thing we know, a Siren fleet is attacking us, and our friends are nowhere to be seen...
... That sounds familiar.
I don't watch much TV, but isn't this like that "isekai anime" trope Ikazuchi mentioned before?
You know about that?!
Meh, wouldn't be the first time it's happened, so I get the gist of it.
Since you know our names, I can only assume we knew each other in the world you came from.
Hah-hah! I know a lot about Azur Lane, in fact!
This is giving me deja vu.
So from what I gather, the Sirens took us all to this place, which for some reason resembles your hideout before they took you here. Right?
Yeah, I guess so.
Fubuki, this'll take ages to explain, so how about we head to the safe house for now?
Safe house? What?
The place where we hid before we got taken here. Follow us and we'll take you there!
The what? The "Hololive Resistance Base"?
You heard right! It's a place we made before we got transported here, and it somehow carried over. We've got plenty of items stocked, and might be able to resupply you with ammo and stuff!
In other words, there's a high chance this place is a recreation of the world you came from?
Yup, yup. You can see everything from here, including the Hololive headquarters and most other Hololive Server facilities.
Company headquarters, resistance bases... It's starting to sound like you come from a pretty brutal world.
"In a world where a tyrannical company rules over everyone... One group of Hololivers risk everything in their fight against evil... They are... the Resistance!" ... Something like that?
Wherever they're from, it sounds like they're fighting a war.
Uh... not really? I mean, you're not completely wrong, but...
Let's just give them a straight answer, Fubuki.
Basically, one of our friends made this place to get back at our managers. Hololive is just a fun group of people, we're not at war with anyone!
Okay, so if I got it right: you're from a world called Hololive, and live in a place called the Hololive Server, and you like to screw with your kind-of-evil managers?
More or less.
Now that I look closer... This entire sector of the ocean has become part of the Hololive Server, but the original area has been spread out across all these islands.
Luckily, most of the buildings are intact, so we'll surely find the Resistance base if we follow them.
All right, Hololive Guide, lead the way. We can start hatching a plan once we've made it to your base.
(Guide...? Excuse me?)
I see traces of a battle took that place in this area.
Siren wrecks littering the place... I guess we're not the only ones fighting them.
There are signs that both torpedoes and cannons were used. Zuikaku, what do you suggest we do?
Our goal is to get these Hololive girls to a safe place, though that would be easier if we can group up with some allies... I think the answer's obvious.
Okay. We'll follow the tracks and investigate.
Hey, Javelin, let's go on a date once all the fighting is over!
Matsuri, you silly~ I'm not falling for a pickup line like that!
Turned down without a moment's delay... But that's what's so attractive about you!
Oh gosh~! Your flexible preferences in girls is starting to scare me~!
I see Javelin over there. Someone's with her...
Let me guess, it's Lady Thirstsalot...
Do you know her?
I wish I could say I don't. She's, uhh... unusual.
Man, I don't get what goes through Fubuki's mind. Whatever, let's go help them out!
You got it! Come on, Kawakaze!

sequence:
Looking Glass of Fact and Fiction - Funsies

<size=45>Chapter 1: Same Face</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dormitory
Hear me out, Fubuki. Kawakaze is way too cute, right? But the real-life version is a hundred times cuter!
Matsuri, are you trying to hit on me again...
I'm not just saying that because she looks like you, really! I mean it in a completely pure way. Kawakaze is totally cute, like in general.
Oh my, she sounds kind of hot...
W-wait, don't be deceived, Aqua! If it's a matter of sounding manly, Kuro can pull off the same thing!
Why are you using someone else to compete for you?!
Ehehe, what belongs to Kuro, also belongs to me~
Hmm... speaking of similarities, there is also a ship who bears my likeness.
Eh? Really?!
Indeed. Just wait a moment and I'll show you.
Ayame, you said that there's gonna be something delicious, right?
Mmhmm. We are just chatting, so do feel free to partake of some snacks with us~
Waooo! How generous of you!!
Good afternoon everyone, it's Tokino Sora~ Oh, look at all the cuties here! My, doesn't she look a bit like Ayame?
Sora, don't you think they look like a pair of puppy dogs? See, they totally do!
Yuudachi is no dog!
Ay am not a dog!
Ahaha, sorry, sorry. You're both very cute girls~
Hmm... Dog or not, this girl does resemble Ayame in many ways.
Right, right~? Ay encountered Yuudachi while out for a walk, so she is the first friend that I have made here!
That's right! She's a nice person who gave me something to eat right away!
... It definitely was not because she reminded me of a puppy, understood?!
Ahaha... When you brought up the topic of look-a-likes, I thought for sure you'd mention Izumo, but it turned out to be Yuudachi~

Izumo is an Oni just like Ayame! Ooh...! I totally wanted to see you two co-starring in some kind of show or collaboration... But, but, just seeing the two of you stand next to each other is good enough~!
Ayame! Weren't we just talking about a training regimen to improve your physical endurance? Why'd you suddenly run off?!
Bleh...! Even Ay do not wish to be put through that hellish training!
But first, Ay must beat a hasty retreat! See you lateroni~☆
Hey, wait! Get back here!
Woah. Look at how fast those two are running.
Things sure are energetic here at this port~
Actually, there are plenty of girls who I'd like you all to meet!
They might not look like me... but they have the same awesome Matsuri energy!
Ehh? Really?
It's true! Hold on, I'll go get them~
The same energy...? Crap, did she meet that girl...?!
Leader, this is the device! You should already know how to use it.
Muahahaha! Ahahaha! The fact that you've crossed through such treacherous waters to come here is proof of the spark of rebellion inside of you, waiting to be lit! Behold!
The sea of TNT that stretches out before our eyes! Should we join hands, not just the Hololive Headquarters, but even the Commander's Office will...
TNT? Commander's Office? What are you talking about?
Haaaaaaah! Soraaaaaaa! Ah, ummmm, this is.. um......
She seems to have something unconscionable related to arson...
We're doing this again?!
Well, since we're all here, let's get going. A new adventure is waiting for us! Fubuki, are you coming?
All right, um, in any case, Commander... I hope all of us will be able to get along, both Hololive and Azur Lane.
