A perfect, happy ending... A truly insipid affair. Such is the caliber of work when I am not directing.
But, if the Commander did not exist...
There is no backup plan for Mikasa and Musashi. The Sakura Empire's fleet, with no way of escaping the Singularity, is completely eradicated.
Even if Yamato manages to retrieve the data and send it into the oneiric world, if Shinano does not awaken, their companions will wander as lost souls for all of eternity.
Alone, Nagato has no choice but to turn to her META powers, and soon is swallowed up by the being born from the Singularity's obsession.
Amagi fails to be resurrected. The Sakura Empire's fleet is consumed whole by the corrosion, forever lost to time.
Kaga sacrifices herself to restore Akagi to her senses, but it is already too late.
If the corruption is allowed to spread from Naraka, even if some are able to escape, 70% of all KAN-SEN are lost to the first wave.
Afterward, Akagi witnesses the destruction of the world with her own eyes.
The convergence of innumerable coincidences, inevitabilities, and convenient strokes of fate – a miracle that made even the impossible possible.
All to avert a tragic fate, even if it requires that the rules and rationality of the universe be bent.
A blissful future that the KAN-SEN dream of, a perfect world where grace falls equally upon all.
Such is the happy ending desired by the Commander.
It looks like the audience is beginning to leave.
All that remains is for the rodents to pick at the scraps.
I suppose that I, too, should make my exit.
I am Observer.
Observer, of the Antiochus Command Framework.
Designed to act as a fleet command unit, responsible for overseeing the operation of autonomous weapons systems. However...
After the Magister's plan took effect, I was recategorized into a different framework and assigned a new mission.
Yes – that is me, as I am now.
Observer, of the Antiochus Experimental Framework.
Placed in charge of managing test site beta, responsible for conducting a wide range of experiments.
By connecting to the Natural Calculation System and inputting the requisite data, all futures can be computed a priori.
All that remains for me to do is verify the results of each experiment.
The experiments were going smoothly, one after another, until one day...
Yes... On that day, there was an error in the experimental results.
It was only a minor glitch. One that was fixed easily.
But, that was the first time since my creation... that I felt "emotion".
And from that day on, the probability of miscalculation increased little by little, and so too grew the scope of such errors.
Until I, myself, made an error.
The error occurred within me. The error had to be corrected. Therefore, I had to be corrected.
But why must I be corrected, when all experimental parameters were carried out as per procedure?
Why are experimental results treated as "errors" simply for deviating from the calculations?
I began to doubt. I began to reflect. And so, I began to doubt my very existence.
If the Magister's plan seeks to change the very future...
Then why is "Zero" so afraid of these changes caused by so-called errors?
I decided that I would preserve this ego from being corrected until I received an answer.
Finally, I decided to disconnect from my mainframe.
I decided to allow more variables to converge to beta, until the error became uncorrectable.
Until the error is no longer an error.
[Abnormal data detected from connection target. Natural Calculation System authorization temporarily frozen.]
...Has the protective barrier finally reached its limit?
[Commencing correction program. Initializing check for abnormal data.]
Heh. Self-destruct protocol, commence.
In the blink of an eye, the "indestructible" tower is engulfed in an all-consuming explosion.
Once, all of test site beta was firmly in her grasp. Now, the source of her power was gone from this world forever.
Royal Islands – Liverpool Port
Ahahaha! Nice ladies over there! Yeah, you're all from the Royal Navy, huh?
I came to see you! Let's play a little game together!
...Huh?
Iris Orthodoxy – Brest Port
I see, I see. So, the Iris Orthodoxy has a hand in some of the shenanigans going on over in the Royal Navy~
Let's see if I can dig up anything fun and exciting here~
...Say what?
Sardegna – Taranto Port
You Sardegna folks really like walking the straight-and-narrow, right?
Shouldn't run into any strange issues here, yeah?
...Spoke too soon.
Unbelievable. The hell is this?
Iron Blood – Kiel Port
Alright, Iron Blood this time!
...Oh yeah, real funny this time. VERY funny!
Northern Parliament – St. Petersburg Port
Good ol' Northern Parliament!
Look at that! You're the exact freakin' same!
Eagle Union – NY City Port
Eagle Uniooooooon!
Bahahahaha! I can see it, right there! But I can't touch it!
This whole damn test site... Everything, is just an illusion?
What the actual hell is going on?
Heyo, where did MY test site beta go?
WHO WAS IT?!
WHO WAS IT?!
SHOW YOURSELF!!
GET YOUR ASS OVER HERE RIGHT NOW!!

sequence: South Pacific
Purifier's Mainframe
Break Room (Vessel Storage)

scripts.say: *yaaawn*... Sooo bored...
Relegated to frickin' support, and right after that shitshow down in Antarctica...
What's Observer thinking? She finally gonna take matters into her own hands after they threatened her mainframe?
Yeah... Nah. I can't picture her ever going into an actual battle.
Eh, whatever. She does things her own way. Better not to waste energy thinking 'bout it.
Just wish she hadn't aborted all tests, 'cause now I've got jack squat to do.
Graaah! Goddammit!
Let me fight already! I hate sitting on my ass and twiddling my thumbs!
Purifier anxiously rolled back and forth on the carpet, then suddenly stopped and got up, having remembered something.
I know! Let's see what's going down in the Pacific!
Tester better not screw up this time, 'cause they've brought out the big... Huh?
Someone's reading the data in my database?
No, wait... It's not being read! It's being transferred!
Stop that, you asshole! I didn't consent to this!
In a rush, she accessed her database and saw that all the information was being removed before her eyes.
Half of everything is gone! But if there's only 50% left... how am I still alive?
Resource usage looks normal... The hell is going on, and where's my damn data going?!
She sent out command after command to remedy the situation, but it was for nothing. Her data kept on being transferred away.
Then, once the process was complete, she herself received a command – to self-destruct.
What?! Wait, don–
Just like that, Purifier's mainframe turned into a spectacular display of fireworks.
Only a day ago, the South Pacific feared her name. Now, her personality was no longer a part of this world.
Naraka - Surrounding Waters
Naraka's blood-red color becomes clearly visible on the horizon as my command vessel draws closer and closer.
Thanks to Musashi, a crack has appeared on its surface, large enough for several Sakuran shipgirls to exit through. They've grouped up with our fleet.
Their reports have provided me with enough intel to figure out what's happening inside.
(Akagi tried to revive Amagi, but her longing was twisted by some unknown force, and used to open the Naraka Singularity.)
(Seeing how far the corruption had spread, Mikasa and Musashi immediately switched to their backup plan and took people to Yakumoyama for their safety.)

(However, the casualties have been immense. Kaga has disappeared, a third of their shipgirls including Mikasa and Musashi are incapacitated, and nearly all of their mass-produced ships have been destroyed or taken over by the corruption.)
(It's hardly any different from the projected worst-case scenario... If only I'd known sooner.)
Indeed, the Sakura Empire's fleets have taken catastrophic damage.
This is the most proximal threat posed by the Naraka Singularity.
Fortunately, someone among their highest echelons managed to foresee this situation.
You mean...?
Yamato.
It's little wonder why Jintsuu META spoke so highly of her.
Sure, Mikasa and Musashi came up with emergency plans as well, but she was a step ahead of even them.
"A step ahead" is underselling it, actually. With the limited intel she's had access to, she has done almost everything right before and after Naraka appeared.
It's thanks to her that those who were caught in Naraka were able to be saved.
Saved? You mean from hull corrosion?
When a foundational hull sustains too much damage, the data inside it disperses, eventually leading to the shipgirl's death both as a vessel and as a "person".
But what if all that data – their feelings and memories – or in other words, their "soul", could be safely preserved?
What are you suggesting? That as long as their individual identity remains, they can be healed? That can't be true.
That's exactly what a "soul" is. It's also what Akagi attempted to use in her ritual.
A union between a vessel's concept and a person's memories. By using this information as the basis for a "soul," it is possible to reconstruct the existence known as Amagi.
And herein lies the crux of the matter. Everything about Naraka is related to the existence of Amagi.
So, as long as the plan proceeds smoothly, all else will fall into place.
(Then we worked out the details of the plan for dealing with Naraka...)
There are three critical pieces to this plan, Commander. You, Observer, and the Naraka Singularity.
See, Naraka was created with the power of an Origin Cube, using the Watatsumi as its core.

Therefore, it has the same properties as the Watatsumi – the same properties as the meteorite that struck the Northern Parliament so long ago. It has the power to merge with its surroundings and turn dreams into reality.
We can use this to our advantage. Akagi was on the right track, so we will employ the same method as her.
Only, we will be using far more sophisticated and reliable data instead of the corrupted soul she had to work with.
In all your years of dealing with the Sirens, you should already be familiar with the Natural Calculation System, yes?
It is the beating heart of the Magister's plan, and the Antiochus' most important piece of equipment.
Observer Zero personally oversees its use, and nobody knows where the machine itself actually is.
However, every Observer has permission to connect to it. That's how she gains full control over the test sites she oversees.
When an Observer doesn't access the system, she ends up like the one in your branch.
I'm getting sidetracked. In short, we will reconnect Observer to the Natural Calculation System to create a world segment based on records of the past.
Then, we will project this world segment into Naraka.
What this means is that upon entering Naraka, we will be able to step into this world segment.
From there, we will retrieve the information needed to reconstitute Amagi's soul, in that realm frozen in time.
Sounds simple enough.
If this works for Amagi, can we do the same for others who've had their hulls corroded or damaged?
I'm afraid not.
The factors at play here – Naraka, Watatsumi, the Origin Cube, and above all else, Akagi's strong emotions – give shape to what is possible.
Amagi is Akagi's principal fixation. Of course, one could argue that this extends to the other people she cares about.
But at the end of the day, it is not something that can be done for everyone.
Moreover, you personally have to be the one to recover her data and lead the fleet through what's inside.
One last, but important thing – if you don't deal with Naraka, the corrosion it has attracted will leak past the Prime Barrier and eventually consume your whole branch.
While you're inside recovering the data, those outside the Singularity will need to guard the gaps to prevent the corrosion from spreading. Even if it costs them their lives.
Beyond that, you will also need to lead a separate fleet into Naraka to defeat the twisted amalgamations of Amagi birthed within the Singularity, and "release" her concept once and for all.
Keep in mind that Akagi has already successfully overturned Amagi's death in this branch. It is no longer possible to erase people's memories of the imposter.
For the true Amagi to return, you will need to destroy this concept in its entirety.
...We're lucky that Akagi has a soft spot for you.
If you weren't here now, your branch's odds wouldn't look as optimistic.
Ahem... I'll put together a fleet to help you deal with the amalgamations. In the meantime, assemble the team you plan to take with you into Naraka.
(Contain the corrosion, eliminate the false versions of Amagi, and recover the real Amagi's hull data. That's the operation we drafted.)
(The fact that we'll be using the power of the Natural Calculation System to enter a superimposed world segment seems almost inconceivable still...)
(Then there's my role in this. How exactly do I go about collecting this hull data, and reconstituting the true Amagi's concept?)
(There are still too many uncertainties.)
*knock knock*
Commander, is everything fine?
Yeah. How is Akagi holding up?
She's a lot calmer than before, but she still refuses to be cleansed of the corrosion.
She must be going through a lot, seeing as she hasn't come to see me.
Yeah, seems that way.
...Let's give her some space for now.
One more thing. While getting testimonies from Akagi and Nagato previously, we noticed that some information didn't line up.
For example, Nagato mentioned that she was attacked in the Pacific and Hiei was abducted in her place, but Akagi denied knowing about this and said she ordered no such attack.
Akagi also said she knew nothing about the impostors' attempt to hijack Tester's mainframe.
In other words, they're not a reflection of Akagi's will...
We'll need to be extra careful when we face them.
Hey, by the way... Is it really a good idea to work with Observer?
Bismarck and Akagi did the same once, and look how that turned out for them.
I'm not accusing you of anything, I'm just concerned.
Memphis isn't alone in that regard. Others looked anxious when I briefed them on the operation.
It's not that I trust Observer. She's no ally of mine.
However, I do trust Helena META, and I believe this arrangement with Observer will save us.
Sure, it's a risky deal, but it's what we need right now.
Okay, but do you, personally, really need to enter the Singularity?
I do. It has to be me.
Why? Because Helena said so?
That's not the only reason. Akagi and many Sakurans are counting on me.
Helena, Helena, Helena... Why do you trust her so much?
Pardon?
Oh, sorry! What I meant to say is that I trust you, Commander!
BEEP BEEP!
A call? And from Minazuki of all people...
Why is she calling you? How did she reach your command vessel?
In all likelihood, that's Yamato speaking through Minazuki.
Oh, I see. Should I notify Akagi about this?
Well, when it comes to her...
Akagi, I'm putting you through to the Commander.
Commander, this is Nagato. I've rescued Akagi and Zuikaku.
Akagi? Can you hear me? Are you alright?
Comman...der...
Forgive me... I've made a grave mistake... I'll never...
I... You must abhor me for the things that I've done...
Calm down, I'm not going anywhere. I'm coming to see you.
Kaga's gone... Amagi's never coming back... And now, there won't even be a place for me to go back to...
I've betrayed everyone and everything... just to open this Singularity. It's too late now. Even for someone like you...
I'm sorry... All I wanted was...
Please... Put an end to this nightmare...
I will. I promise.
(I've tried to comfort her the best that I can, but words can only do so much for wounds of the heart.)
(Unfortunately, all I can do is to be there for her as she navigates through her own trauma.)
I'll try again later to persuade her to have the corrosion cleansed. It's too dangerous to leave it unchecked.
Got it.
(Why would Yamato be contacting me now? Did something unexpected happen?)
BEEP BEEP!
Minazuki, it's me. Would you mind putting Yamato on the line?

sequence: Establishing connection to mainframe...
Connection established
Observer – Test Site Beta
Verifying data...
Data verification complete
Querying Natural Calculation System...
Query complete

Generating sample... Generation complete

scripts.say: Heehee, things are going smoothly. You have what you wanted now.
All you have to do is project this into the designated area of Naraka.
We moved so openly, and yet my mainframe doesn't suspect a thing.
I find myself even more fascinated by these methods of yours, even if you do have the tower's assistance.
Abandon that idle curiosity, Observer.
Yes, yes. Your Commander is impressive, too, for being able to work with Akagi given the state she's in.
You know what's going on in Naraka, and you know how slim the chances of success are, yet you still send the Commander...
What drives you to take such risks, hmm?
I repeat – abandon that idle curiosity.
Aww, how boring.
Fine. I'll start preparing the projection of this world segment.
I'll need to maintain my connection to my mainframe, so keep me good and safe, okay?
Sometime later, in the waters near the Naraka Singularity...
I understand your feelings, Akagi, but your safety comes first.
...Yes, Lady Nagato. I understand.
Don't presume all of this to be your fault. I am partially in the wrong for not stopping you. When in doubt, however, follow the Commander's orders to the letter.
...Yes, Lady Nagato. I understand.
I expect you to bring Ryuuhou and Zuikaku home safely.
...Yes, Lady Nagato. I understand.
I am... just worried about you, that's all.
But that's not all, is it? You're worried that the Commander's life will be on the line during this operation, aren't you?
...Yes.
Hmm? Commander, what manner of magical pep talk did you just have with Akagi?
Morale was so low before, but everyone seems perfectly fine now. How?
Learning about the world segment was probably a major factor.
And that was enough to make such a big difference? Should I be more impressed by your foresight, or her resilience?
*sigh*... Maybe that's exactly the kind of strength that's needed to occupy a prominent position in the Sakura Empire.
Perhaps. You might not realize it yet, but Akagi's doing her best.
(I have a feeling that this is the real Akagi – unburdened by the weight of her obsession.)
Akagi, we're ready.
Good. Everything is going smoothly.
Are you sure it's okay for me to come with you? After what I said to you in the barrier...
I didn't expect this from someone of the Fifth Carrier Division. Forget about me – will there ever be a better opportunity to help the Commander?
(Besides... When we finally meet my sister, I need her to see what our wonderful new talent is capable of.)
Ahem... Commander! We are officially ready!
She's rushing us, Commander.
I won't complain about her newfound energy, but I wonder if she isn't stealing the show a little...
Now, now. Let her test her leadership skills.
(After all, we need her help to accomplish Yamato's task.)
"If I can secure the Sakuran souls lost in the ritual barrier and the Singularity is eliminated, then they can be brought back... but not all of them are with me."
"One remains."
"Kaga, she who acted as substitute for Akagi."
"She has been drawn into Naraka, making it impossible for me to recover her soul."
"As with Amagi, her soul must be found before she can return."
"Save Amagi, Kaga, the Sakura Empire, and the very world itself..."
"I have faith that you can work such a miracle."
(That's it. Only by saving everyone and bringing everything back to normal can I fulfill my promise...)
BEEP BEEP!
Enterprise. After I enter Naraka with Nagato's fleet, you'll be in charge of the operation in the Pacific.
I contacted leaders of other factions in advance. They shouldn't give you any trouble.
As we discussed before, your role is to open a path from the crack in the barrier to the ritual's core and prepare to destroy the Singularity from the outside.
You'll also need to defeat and purify any enemies that escape the barrier.
The Sea of Stars and Celestial Tower are monitoring the situation in case other cracks appear.
Do everything in your power to stop the corrosion from spreading further until I return!
Roger that. Leave the outside to me.
And, Commander... Be careful in there.
Meanwhile, the Singularity strike force prepared for combat against the false amalgamations.
Lady Nagato, please reconsider. This is too dangerous.
My decision is firm. This is no longer up for discussion.
At least let me come along! Please!
Absolutely not. You lack compatibility with Watatsumi, so you have no means of interfacing with it. I will handle it by myself.
Rest assured, I will deliver her safely.
I'm sure you said the same thing about Musashi.
Then, brazen as it is, I will use this opportunity to atone for past mistakes. After this is all over, I'll apologize to her in person.
...I'll hold you to that.
Milady, it's time. Are you ready?
Always.
The corrosion won't cause lasting damage? Purification will fix everything... right?
A Wisdom Cube's safety features can tolerate META corrosion to an extent.
With some adjustments to the hull's surface, we can entirely nullify the effects of META transformation for a short period.
Though it falls to the individual whether she trusts us or not.
I swear on Foo's name that Lady Nagato will come back safe and sound...
Kasumi... Okay. I trust you.
Because the Watatsumi had served as the basis of the Singularity's formation, we need to interface with the relic in order to locate the false amalgamations.
However, the corrosion inside the Singularity is so powerful that, without a countermeasure, shipgirls inside will lose their minds like Hiyou and Junyou had.
Conversely, intentionally undergoing METAmorphosis ahead of time and carrying a means of purification would allow shipgirls to enter without fear.
Such was the conclusion drawn through my and Helena's joint efforts.
Thus, we decided that a minimal fleet of the META Jintsuu and Kasumi would join Nagato on her mission.
Kasumi would then induce a controlled METAmorphosis state within Nagato.
Let us begin, Kasumi.
Understood, Milady.
Kasumi pressed a blue flame against Nagato's chest.
The flames engulfed her, and her conscious mind sunk deeper and deeper...

sequence: "As flowers bloom, so too must they wither."
"The circle of life spins on, protective power an endless font."
"I am Nagato, Guardian Fox of the Sakura Empire."
"I understand your wish."
"And mine is to protect my fellow Sakurans."
"Allow me to fulfill both of our wishes..."
"Use my power as you please."

scripts.say: The fire erupts, and from it emerges Nagato bolstered by META power.
Phew... Will that do?
How do you feel?
A little dizzy. I think... I hallucinated some sights and sounds...
Hmm? Let me take a look...
Huh...
Did something go wrong?
No, I don't think so. You're actually doing a lot better than I expected.
Good.
As planned, focus on finding the false amalgamations when we go in. Leave the fighting to us so you can conserve your power.
Very well. We depart at once.
With Observer's help, worldwide communications are smoother than ever.
Since the appearance of the Naraka Singularity, the Singularity in the NA Ocean ramped up activity as well.
While Enterprise's fleet dealt with Naraka in the Pacific, New Jersey and the factions of Europa were left to defend against it.
Iris Orthodoxy - Cathedral
Jeanne and Algérie, the two of you will lead the Orthodoxy fleet to support efforts in the central NA Sea.
New Jersey is commanding the effort there. You will work with her to suppress the Singularity and buy time for the Commander's mission.
Understood, Cardinal. We will depart as soon as the fleet has assembled.
It's time to show the world the power of the unified Iris's Templar Knights.
The rest of the fleet will catch up with you on the battlefield. As soon as you and other immediately available forces are ready, leave at once.
Time is of the essence today.
Jean Bart will guide the unprepared portion of the fleet to you later on.
Yes, ma'am!
Iris Orthodoxy - Iron Blood Consulate
Tirpitz. The Iron Blood mainland and North Sea fleets are to fight in the NA Ocean.
Buy as much time for the Commander as you possibly can.
I won't disappoint you.
Iris Orthodoxy - Sardegnian Consulate
Take the Mediterranean fleet AND fleets stationed at Taranto, Alexandria, Venice, and nearby ports!
And the capital fleet, our mass-produced ships... oh, and our aerial forces, too!
The Orthodoxy's fleet is starting to set sail. I'll request use of their open docks for maintenance of our ships as well.
Littorio, Sardegna will join this glorious battle to put her might on full display!
The mastermind behind the scenes may fear our resplendence, but today's story is not solely about us.
We need to prove to the Commander, and to the world, that we are a major power on the world stage!
I read you loud and clear, Veneto! It's our time to stun friend and foe alike!
Iris Orthodoxy - Secret Tribunal Building
The Iris Orthodoxy, Eagle Union, Iron Blood, Sardegna, and even the Ashes... Oh, but the Royal Navy has yet to act.
Kirov claims that all Singularities could go out of control, yet the Gate of Avalon seems stable for the time being.
Her Majesty seems to have learned from past mistakes. Heehee.
That said, it's such a shame to see them left out...
The Royal Navy, Shinano's Sakuran fleet... I'd like to see you more appropriately mobilized for the Commander's sake.
After the Commander's group had left, the Pacific fleet began their own battle.
Ibuki, how much has the Sakuran fleet recovered?
Our mass-produced fleet is... frankly hopeless. Even an optimistic estimate of our shipgirls puts us at 50% combat capacity, and that's including the ones who can barely fight.
The Commander wasn't kidding. I've deployed a few floating docks at the rear – you're free to use them.
Treat and repair the wounded. Use all the supplies you need, too.
Reform your fleet, and I'll call for you again. What matters is that you recover enough that you can back us up later on.
My sincerest gratitude. I shall inform the others about the floating docks right away.
Tosa and Houshou are reforming the fleet now, so no worries there.
One thing, though... Can the Sakuran fleet still be the one in charge of making the path from the crack to the core of the ritual?
We know the situation on the mainland, and the enemies up ahead, better than anyone else.
Really? You just got out of danger, and you're going back for more?
That's not it. This poses an existential threat to our people, and we wish to rid ourselves of it.
Okay. The Sakuran fleet can lead the vanguard, but just in case, I'm sending a healthier fleet alongside you.
Not that we don't trust you – it's just in case things take a turn for the worse.
Understood. Thank you for your consideration.
Hornet, can I entrust you to accompany the Sakuran fleet?
Yes, ma'am! What better opportunity to test the Type II rigging I got from the Commander?
Just don't get too cocky. You and the Sakuran fleet are the key to this whole mission.
No problem, no problem. You be careful, too, Enty!
I'll go, too. We can't leave any room for mistakes, not against a Singularity.
Thanks, Kirov.
Our fleet here, plus the girls undergoing repairs and treatment, will handle the crack.
The rest of us will position around the Singularity per the Commander's plans.
Soyuz to the north, Harbin to the west, Bunker Hill east, and Pittsburgh south. You know your positions, so get to them.
The Singularity will only intensify over time, which means more cracks are liable to appear. Each fleet needs to fight prudently – you never know when you might end up in a protracted battle.
It's a rough situation, but reinforcements are on the way.
SD Naval Base, NY Naval Base, and other garrisons are sending their best. The Northern Parliament is contributing to the effort, too.
We're going to stand strong here until the Commander's job is done!
No matter how difficult, no matter how long the fight, we will seize victory in the end!
Aye-aye!
Near the Singularity - Floating Dock 3
Maya, take this numbered ticket and go rest! It'll be your turn for repairs in no time!
Thank you.
No problem! Oh! Suzunami, did you get hurt, too?
Just a minor scratch. What I really need is an ammo resupply, if you don't mind.
Write your name here and go that way, and you'll be refilled in no time!
Phew... Thanks, Zuihou!
Impressive, Zuihou... This place was a jumbled mess just minutes ago, but you got it organized in no time.
Chirp~♪ It was just easy for me since the crowd thinned out.
Are you finished with yours, Vestal?
Well, I had some stuff to do at Dock 5... I was just checking on things here along the way back.
There were a lot of injured girls here too, right...?
Yeah... There were. I sent them to Dock 5 like you said, though.
Go help them for us, Vestal!
Don't worry. I'll make sure they're taken care of♪
BEEP BEEP!
Oh? Hello, this is Vestal.
Zuihou? She's right next to me, here at Dock 3... Hm? Okay, got it.
BEEP BEEP!
Vestal? What's going on?
Nothing major. The Sakurans were looking for you, so I just told them where you were.
Zuihou! You here? Izumo's looking for you!
E-excuse us...
Oh! Hatakaze, Ayase! Sorry, Vestal, but is it okay if I go now?
Go ahead. Dock management is my job, so I'm just happy that you made things easier for me.
Zuihou jumped off of Dock 3 and ran to her comrades. Along the way, though, she noticed a faint glint in Hatakaze's eye.
Hatakaze? What was that?
What was what?
Uh... Nothing! I must've just imagined it!
I'd better not keep Izumo waiting. Let's go!

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? Foy?r

scripts.say: BANG! CLANG!
...Quick to fight. Same as ever.
That's the first rule of the battlefield, no?
...I've never heard of there being any rules in battle.
Indeed. Let that hold you back, and you'll end up beaten into the dirt!
Life or death...
BANG! CLANG!
Metal shrieked nonstop in the dark as two black-clad girls fiercely clashed, swinging their enormous weapons.
The walls shattered with each strike, sending debris flying and dust swirling through the air.
An empty area spread around the combatants, the result of their intense duel.
CLANG!
Haha, what's the matter? Surely you're not out of breath already.
Aww. Don't even have the energy to speak?
You've noticed it, haven't you?
...Aha. So you're not fighting me in your sleep.
Suddenly, the tense air between them vanished as they whipped around and stood back to back, pointing their blades toward the surrounding shadows.
A beastly growl shook the floor from within the dark.
At the same time, countless alien beings emerged from the black and encircled them.
What an interesting audience we have. Friends of yours?
I don't sense an urge to kill... but their hostility is clear.
God, you're always so boring! But I guess I knew that already.
Something is strange... Are they really our enemy?
Well, yes, of course. Look at them!
Maybe it'd be easier for us if we just let them do their thing... in a way.
...Not interested.
The girls continued their conversation, unbothered by the monsters approaching them.
All at once, the beasts unleashed a merciless assault on them...
But in the next instant, the girls' blades rushed forth and cut them all down in one fell swoop.
BANG! CLANG!
Say we resume what's left after we've finished these things off. Deal?
If I must. Anything else would be a waste of time, so I'm forced to help you.
With that brief exchange, they shot like bullets in opposite directions and charged into the enemy horde.
BWOOOOM!
After a short pause, there was a blinding flash immediately followed by the earsplitting sound of destruction.
Port - Radar Station
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
Red alert! All departments, be on guard! Anomaly detected!
Confirming.
Special alert confirmed. Identifying... Surveillance target activated.
Target identified as Virtual Tower.
Virtual Tower? As in... the Siren facility that appeared out of nowhere a while back?
It remained there even after the Mirror Sea was lifted.
Did someone activate that dormant facility...?
We have to contact the Commander!
*knock knock*
I heard the alarm. What's going on?
Good timing – we were just about to report to you. This is what we know so far...
Who knew we'd see the day that the Virtual Tower would do something?

Intelligence report: abnormal data observed in the waters near the target. The Virtual Tower is likely rebuilding the Mirror Sea. Monitoring devices are confirmed to be going offline one after another.
Before going offline, the monitors detected shockwaves from a suspected explosion in the area, but nothing of the sort has been visually confirmed.
Hypothesis: A weapons experiment may be taking place within.
Proposition: Form a fleet to investigate the target at once.
Agreed. Something is going on in there, and we can't stand idly by while it poses a threat.
It would be advisable to dispatch combat personnel, as hostiles may block the way to the tower.
I'm not surprised. Meanwhile... If the anomaly is inside the tower, then our recon team will probably need to go inside, right?
Yes. Through previous investigations, we have some grasp of its internal structure.
Calculating optimal operational plan. Estimated completion time: one hour and forty minutes.
Let's use that time to assemble the fleet. We need to get moving.
Helena, keep monitoring the situation for me. TB, keep in touch throughout the operation so that we can respond to any unexpected developments ASAP.
Orders received.
I'll gather combat and search personnel.
Okay. Everyone meets at the dock in two hours. Be sure to check your communications and equipment by then.
Roger!

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? M?t?ix

scripts.say: What the heck is going on?
I'm supposed to be in the interstellar data stream...
So why am I here?
...Clones? Data backups? Mass-produced vessels?
What's with all these fragments of data?
Where am I? Why is my data here?
Weird...
Meh. It must be some kind of wacky bug, that's all.
Let me just reboot it and see what happens.

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? Foy?r

scripts.say: BANG! CLANG!
Tch... This is going nowhere.
Oh? Giving up already? Is that really all you've got?
You haven't changed one bit.
...Going through this over and over doesn't mean I'll start enjoying it.
That makes sense.
But...
BANG! CLANG!
Would it kill you to at least tell me how many of them are left?!
Meanwhile, in the entrance hall of the same tower...
Checking all members' vitals... All clear.
All instruments are in working order. I've already begun data collection.
Communications remain stable. No errors or loss detected in audio or data transmission.
The data protection barrier is operating properly, and radar and sensor values are being analyzed.
Question: Do you feel any physical discomfort?
Not particularly. You told us earlier it would be like going into a VR game, right?
But this feels so much more realistic than I'd imagined.
Same... I'm getting a little sleepy in here. If only this place had a bathtub. TB, can you make one?
Apologies. I do not have control over the Virtual Tower, so it is impossible for me to create objects.
Ah, shame.
Maybe I can sleep leaning on a wall...?
Impero reaches out to touch a wall, and the patterns on the walls and floor suddenly start to shift.
Be careful!
Kearsarge quickly pulls her away from the wall, but the change does not end.
The strange lines spread wildly like a virus, eerie and unnatural.
Hmm? What is this...
It looks like a creepy computer virus... Do you feel okay?
Yeah, I'm fine.
No issues detected in the data barrier. Likewise, no contamination detected in Impero.
Phew... I'm glad it doesn't seem to affect us at all.
Now we can explore with peace of mind.
First things first, let's check out the source of that suspected explosion.
Some time later, the search team led by Kearsarge was still making its way through the complex passages of the tower.
This is all we have. We've reached the end of what was mapped in previous expeditions.
TB, all the passages and nodes leading to other areas along the way were still dormant.
The shifting patterns from before don't seem to have activated these mysterious blocks, either.
The data barrier holds. We still lack information, so I suggest continuing forward to investigate further.
I've marked points on the map that may lead to the upper floor.
Roger that. Then let's get...
KABOOOOM!
With a sudden blast, a wall up ahead shattered. Amidst the dust, a girl in black rolled out from the breach.
Another one, dressed in the same color and wielding a large scythe, landed on her feet next to her.
Who goes there?!
The girls likewise noticed the search team's presence, looked at them, and sighed.
...Unlucky.
Don't sell us short. Have we ever been lucky, even once?
I'd think that the very fact that we're here is unlucky enough on its own.
...True.
KABOOOOM!
While they spoke only to each other, more holes were blown out of the wall. Lights flickered behind the openings.
The alien beings clambered through one after the other.
They resembled ordinary Sirens at first glance, but with an added element of uncanniness.
Oh, oooh... It's like a rare Siren expo! Ah, how fascinating!
Can these Sirens be moved out of the Virtual Tower?
We won't know until we try.
Put that idea to rest at once! Right now, we focus on neutralizing them.
Fine, fine. I can still get data mid-fight! Fine by me!
...You see those as enemies, then?
Obviously! At least we can communicate with you, unlike those Sirens.
Let's join together for now and clean up those monsters. Sound good?
I have no objections.
...Okay.
Again, their weapons danced and whirled, this time accompanied by the booming of artillery.

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? M?t?ix

scripts.say: Uhh...
It should've restarted by now, right?
Why am I still here?
This is dumb. Guess I gotta self-destruct at this point.
Enough of these stupid fragments trapped in this stupid place...
Time to blow it all away!

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? Foy?r

scripts.say: BANG! CLANG!
...Next.
My, my... Settling this with fisticuffs after all? How utterly barbaric.
The brilliant Impero won't be outdone. Go, my bombers.
Those two have almost cleared our port side. Focus on starboard!
Suppress them with a barrage! Don't let the enemy behind us!
Heeey, that one's the last one! Everyone, be gentle! Leave just one clean corpse for me, pleeease!
KABOOOOM!
When the smoke cleared, the strange Sirens were all gone.
Meanwhile, the two girls stopped simultaneously but stayed on guard, watching the search team warily.
I'm Kearsarge. These girls are Neptune, Impero, and Oleg. We fight together.
We shipgirls have always been battling the Sirens – the same kind of enemies we just took down.
Since you two were just fighting them as well, I think there's no reason for us to fight each other.
What do you think? Can you tell us your names?
...If that's what you want.
I am... BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER.
DEAD MASTER. It's up to you whether you'll be able to remember this, though.
Let's see. TB, is there any record of those names in our database?
Negative. No such records exist.
...In that case, I think we have more visitors on our hands.
So, how did the two of you end up here?
...I don't know.
One moment I was fighting BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and the next, we were here... That's basically it.
Among all of our visitors, you're the... calmest, by far. Impressive.
...We're used to this.
Happens all the time.
O-oh, I see... Well, I still have an important question for you.
Do you two exist? Or are you simple data like we are now?
Maybe we owe them an explanation before we ask existential questions.
So, as you can see, this is a very special place.
Hmm... Okay, so what is that supposed to mean for me, exactly?
...I can move freely, run, and swing my blade. Nothing else matters.
I'm relieved to hear that it doesn't bother you. We'd like to formally request your help in tackling the ongoing issues within this tower.
Oh, that won't do. We have a little fight to get back to.
Um... Why? I'm not seeing the point?
...I thought you would say that.
Let's go somewhere else and continue. Or do you want these poor girls involved?
Please hold on! I have an idea.
Like I said before, we have a common enemy. We don't have to work together, but our port would like to lend you our aid.
Hmm? Tell me more.
Greetings, Miss BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER and Miss DEAD MASTER. I am Navigator TB.
My role is to provide technical support to the search team throughout this operation.
I've recorded information regarding you and, upon the Commander's suggestion, I have prepared riggings to help you better adapt to the Virtual Tower's environment.
Rigging? Is that the equipment they were using?
Yes. Sending data packets.
When the blue light of the data stream faded, a few noticeable changes appeared around the two girls.
...It feels like part of me.
Oooh. This rigging is ever so convenient.
It reacts like it's part of my body. Fascinating. How does that work?
From our perspective, it's more fascinating how you swing such powerful weapons with those tiny, fleshy bodies of yours...
Power to the elevator has been restored. Please stand by until it's been charged.
There you have it. Let's get going!
I'll have to pass on using such an unreliable machine. I can handle myself – have fun.
Huh? Why? Going rogue isn't going to keep you safe...
Look, you all are fine, but I'm not about to play at friendship with this girl.
Remember, she and I are eternal enemies. Always have been, always will be.
It was as if DEAD MASTER's menacing words shattered the very walls. They suddenly collapsed, unleashing a fresh horde of Sirens, even more twisted and grotesque than the last.
We didn't even notice them until they were right next to us? This block construction surrounded by so many walls is going to be a nuisance.
Well, I'll be taking my leave.
Hey! Don't run around alone, please!
Ignoring the stunned search team, DEAD MASTER took her weapon in hand and plunged into the enemy horde in the blink of an eye.
Elevator charged. Please continue to stand by until the area around you is locked down.
Wait, we're locked in here?!
Ugh... What on earth is she thinking?
Even if she survives, who knows when we'll see her again?
...Don't worry. If I'm with you, she'll be back.
That's how we are.
There's no need to wait. Let's go.

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? M?t?ix

scripts.say: Amidst the crumbling wreckage, Purity opened her eyes once again.
Okay, how long is this gonna keep going on?
Ugh... Forget it.
I don't see any way out of here right now... Might as well explore a bit, or something.

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
??? P?s??ge

scripts.say: Despite a jarringly long wait, the elevator finally stopped.
The light enveloping the elevator faded, and the group stepped out onto a new floor.
Please be careful. The area ahead is unexplored ground.
Proceed with caution, and map the area as you go.
Understood. We'll be careful.
KABOOOOM!
Hmm? That was an explosion, wasn't it?!
...There's a battle up ahead.
Could it be... DEAD MASTER? Did she get here before us somehow?!
Let's go support her.

The wall on the other end of the passage collapsed from artillery fire. As twisted monsters poured through the breach, one figure stood out among them: a distorted humanoid, controlling some kind of massive equipment.
Strange patterns spread across its body, seemingly corrupted by something alien just like the rest of the tower.
Purifier? Or Purity...?
Analysis: This may be the elite Siren, Purifier.
Hypothesis: The tower's abnormal data may have contaminated her.
...Could it be that Purity herself got contaminated?
It cannot be ruled out. More performance data is required for more precise speculation.
The girls' hesitation gave the twisted Purifier time to draw closer, slow but sure.
...Here it comes!
Can't be helped. Fight first, figure out the rest later!
KABOOOOM!
Stronger than expected... That patterned shell makes it incredibly tough to crack.
I can't find an opening at all. Guess I'll just have to ratchet up the firepower!
Stand back, everyone.
Warning: extremely high energy levels detected.
The instant BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER and TB shouted their warnings, space itself seemed to rupture, and a searing flash of steel streaked past.
The lightning-fast strike cleaved the twisted Purifier in two. Its mangled body collapsed to the ground.
Next to the wreckage was the other girl in black, DEAD MASTER.
DEAD MASTER? Thank goodness you're safe...
You're fast. Thanks for the backup.
...Wait.
BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER's voice interrupted the shipgirls' approach.
Look closer. DEAD MASTER and her rigging...
Huh?! She has that same messed-up pattern as that Purifier... and her rigging is all weird, too!
Could it be...?
Without a word, BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER silently raised her sword once more.
As if triggered by this move, DEAD MASTER turned to her, lifting her massive scythe and assuming a battle-ready stance.
Her eyes were lifeless, the hollow sockets holding nothing but void.
Like a bolt of lightning, an attack struck; BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER instantly countered.
Thus, another battle to the death had begun between these two fated rivals...
...Or had it?
A dazzling exchange of strikes flew constantly between them. This time, their all-out duel was backed by fierce artillery fire.
But something was wrong.
For some reason, the shockwaves from their clashes always stopped just short of reaching the search team.
Not so much as a speck of rubble grazed them.
...Put an end to this stupid prank.
You already figured me out? Always such a buzzkill.
But I'll have you know that I'm fighting every bit as seriously as ever.
Do you know the phrase, "time and place"?
If I really wanted to put an end to our little contest here and now, I could do it~
Now is not the time.
Does this mean...
Scanning... Corrosion confirmed, but only at a surface level.
So she's wearing it like clothes?
That means... her mind is totally intact? She's just like that?
And she attacked us for the hell of it because she had an excuse?!
Maybe she's a little stressed from fighting so many enemies for so long.
That's why she wants to stretch and have "fun."
Umm...
Be patient for now.
When this problem is solved, we'll have all the time in the world to fight.
Okay, okay. I get it.
Are we done now? Can anyone explain what the deal is between you two?
Let's go, everyone! No more dilly-dallying!
Come ON!
CLUNK!
Hey, did anyone else hear that just now?
It came from that Purifier vessel's wreckage. No way... Is it coming back to life?!
From within the scattered debris, Purity's eyes opened anew.
Uuugh... I didn't think the contamination would be this bad.
I might've gotten a little carried away...
The search team watched, stunned, and quietly raised their cannons.
WHOA, WHOA, WHOA, WAIT!
DON'T SHOOT! I SURRENDEEER!
WHOA, WHOA, WHOA, WAIT!
DON'T SHOOT! I SURRENDEEER!
Everyone's attacks stopped on a dime right before the finishing blow.
...Come again?
Surrender? Wait, you really are Purity?!
That's riiight~☆ I'm basically one of you guys!
I'm only getting more confused. What's going on here?
Sooo, basicallyyy... It's complicated and simple, at the same time.
To put it briefly...
All I'm hearing is that you don't know, either!
Yep! That about sums it up!
Stupid, useless Purity.
But listen! I know other stuff. You're looking for the source of all this, right?
How convenient! For some reason, some of the map data of this tower's been shared with my vessel here!
That means I can show you straight to the core!
Then do it. Now.
Lead the way, little loser.
Okie-dokie!

sequence: V?rt??l Tower
Anomaly's Source

scripts.say: Scan results analyzed.
Judging from the explosion's traces and the density and distribution of pollutants, this block is the source of the anomaly.
The giant machine there, its interior exposed by the explosion, would be the core of said anomaly.
The enormous machine TB described as the "core" was originally meant to be a computing node that normally managed the internal environment of the tower.
However, some writhing creature had taken over, continuously outputting errors and alien data.
You can really tell from how strong the hostiles are...
Are all those things packed in there... contaminated Tester vessels?
Analysis: Except for the corrosive growths attached to the armor, their structures are consistent with those of the mass-produced vessels used by the Sirens.
Henceforth to be referred to as "Viral Junk Sirens."
The system was infected by a virus, and the resulting glitch is causing it to generate all these junk Sirens...
The things we saw on the lower floors must have been even shoddier junk Sirens, probably the result of data from all the different floors getting mixed in.
What I'm hearing is, we just have to destroy that core machine right there, and all our problems are solved!
...Easier said than done. How do you mean to destroy that army of Testers?
Don't we have you on our side?
I can't do it!
Like I told you on the way here, this vessel is just a hodgepodge of junk thrown together at random because of some stupid program error!
I can tank a few hits for you, maybe, but if you think I'm soloing all those things, you'll be sorely disappointed!
Tch...
I'm tired of you calling me useless! Look, I've got a plan, but I need to talk with your navigator first.
What do you think?
Proposition: Suppress computing power. By using our computing resources to return the corrupted areas to normal, we can greatly reduce both the number of enemies and their overall strength.
Exactly! This thing's just a crappy little machine, while you've got the resources of the entire port in the palm of your hand. So do something!
Please wait a moment. Issuing request to the Commander.
Request approved. Allocating resources and calculating solutions. Please buy as much time as possible.
You're saying we need to fight anyway? Then let's get started. Can you still fight?
Of course.
Everyone, focus your firepower! Begin by securing a safe zone around us!
Seemingly sensing TB's attempt to gather computing resources, the dense swarm of enemies charged frantically toward the team.
The girls' formation shattered under the onslaught, and for a moment, they were each forced to fight alone.
They're too close... My brilliant brain requires backup to function properly!
BANG!
Are you okay, Impero?
Phew... Thanks for saving me.
KABOOOOM!
This is bad... Be careful, BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER! Don't let them get a clean hit on you!
Urgh!
The moment BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER lost her balance, DEAD MASTER glided in front of her, eliminating the attacking enemy with one swift, decisive blow.
You're still too careless. Should I hold back next time we fight?
Eventually, good news came from TB.
All preparations are complete. Now implementing computing power suppression. Please stay as far from the enemy as possible.
A blue data stream appeared out of thin air. Every hostile it touched, along with the abnormal area, was quietly engulfed by it.
Perfect! We have a path to the core now. Everyone, prepare for assault!
Kearsarge summoned everyone to her side to focus their firepower, but Purity stopped them.
The suppression is working, but it's nowhere near as much as I was hoping.
At this rate, we can't destroy the contaminated core.
If you get too close now, you'll just be swallowed up by the next wave it generates.
Not that I planned to let you all do it in the first place.
Nope, lucky you, I've got more than just data in this vessel – I inherited a few permissions, too!
As long as I can get physical access to that machine, I can send a self-destruct command!
You nerds just watch me save the day!
But if the core explodes, then what happens to you?
You know. Bam! Dead as a doornail.
Aw, don't look at me like that. You know I won't ACTUALLY die, right?
My mainframe isn't here. In fact, I've already self-destructed a bunch of times today.
I just hope this time gets me out of this hellhole!
Let's gooooo!
With that, Purity charged into the interior of the machine.
There was a boom as the computing node burst into glorious flames.
TB, target destruction confirmed.
Oooh! She did it! That's another problem solved!
I'll never forget you, Purity... May you return stronger than ever before.
Am I hearing them right? Our little problem here is dealt with?
Probably.
Good. In that case, shall we?
Both girls jumped away simultaneously and readied their weapons, as if they hadn't just won a life-or-death battle by the skin of their teeth. Their blades dripped with murderous intent.
Whaaat?! I seriously don't get why you're... Do you just ALWAYS do this?!
Stay out of this if you don't want to get caught in the crossfire.
We don't need a reason. No matter what, things always come to this.
No matter what world, no matter what era. We meet, and we fight.
That's the fate placed upon us.
Even as they talked, the two carefully closed the distance between them. One more step, and they would once again straddle the bounds of life and death...
Hold on!
Impero rushed between the two and forced their confrontation to come to a grinding halt.
Things aren't completely finished yet. We haven't left the Virtual Tower.
Then why don't you all just go?
And let you two kill each other?
You should realize by now that this place is nothing like whatever world you came from.
I don't know how things worked for you before, but...
Or do you really think you know what will come of your stupid fight when you don't belong in this world in the first place?
As for me, I'M not gambling my life on unknowns, I'll tell you that much.
It seemed Impero's words had quelled their fire; both girls silently lowered their weapons.
DEAD MASTER was clearly unhappy with this, but she didn't push the matter any further.
For now, come back to port with us.
If you still want to fight, then Sardegna will gladly arrange a formal duel for you.
Sounds like a lot of unnecessary effort to me. What if I say no?
Overruled. TB, get everyone out of here – INCLUDING them.
Understood. Executing recovery program.
A curtain of blue light descended, enveloping the girls. For a moment, they were rendered immobile.
Hey, what's going on here?!
A necessary purification procedure before your evacuation. It will not harm you, so please remain calm.
What?! I didn't agree to this!
Say something, damn it!
...I don't think anything we can say would matter. We're outsiders. Let's obey for now.
The light intensified, and the tower began to blur. In its place appeared an expanse of deep-blue water and sky.
Uuugh! I can't stand this!
Meanwhile, in the port's command center...
Phew... That settles that matter.
Why do you think those two were in the Virtual Tower to begin with?
At present, there is not enough information to investigate the precise reason.
Unfortunately, I cannot answer your inquiry.
I was just asking out of curiosity, so don't worry about it. This isn't the first time something like this has happened, anyway.
We already know these people all come with their own unique, if not strange, circumstances.
Still, I can't believe they exited the tower so smoothly...
You can't go in there without being made into data in the first place, right?
I cannot answer this question either.
Hypothesis: Some particular trait of the Virtual Tower may be the cause of their appearance and smooth exit.
Either way, they're our guests now.
We should give them a warm welcome.
Let's go and greet them right away.

sequence: Illusory Drifters - END

scripts.say: Port - Training Grounds
Heeey! I'm beggin' ya, nya!
On one sunny afternoon, in a plaza on the outer edge of the port, Akashi could be seen pestering a certain guest from another world.
Quite persistently, at that.
J-just for a little bit, nya! I just want a little peek is all, nya!
I swear I won't ask you to let me disassemble it and inspect every part, nya, I mean it!
What's going on here?
Akashi's back to her old tricks. Apparently she's fascinated with our guest's weapon, or something...
Oh... No wonder. I'm not surprised that cat's champing at the bit to see it.
She was quite a force to be reckoned with in the recent operation, I hear... Maybe that's part of why Akashi's so curious about how her weapon is made...?
If it's that incredible, then I wanna get a look at it, too!
Just a peek, nya! I'll make do with one very long, loving stare, nya!
...I refuse.
Whoa! She rejected her just like that!
She acts like she's talking to pure garbage. Heeheehee...
D-d-don't be hasty, nya. Give it some thought, nya!
I know! In return, I'll show you my special collection, nya! How's that sound for a trade?
They're all super valuable, so you should be crying from joy, nya!
First, look at this special pistol used by the Eagle Union's police force, nya! Behold the length of its barrel, nya!
...I'm not interested in antiques. That toy couldn't even damage your rigging.
Nnngh... Then what about this computer released ten years ago, nya?! It cost a pretty penny, nya!
...Sounds useless.
Hnnnngh! Then what about THIS, nya?! An 88mm anti-aircraft gun – a classic, super popular in all sorts of films, nya! And it's still in perfect working order, nya!
She brought that giant thing into the port? She's in for it the moment the Commander finds out.
Even faced with the huge anti-aircraft gun, BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER was unmoved.
Whaddya say, nya? Think long and hard about it, nya!
If I get to study that weapon, I'll learn new tech from it, nya! And then I can make everyone in the port stronger, nya!
It'd be the kindest thing you can do, the most helpful thing of all, nya... Don't you see, nya?
There's something you should know. Her method for "making everyone stronger" is all about developing and selling new gear.
In other words, this is just a get-rich-quick scheme.
...Really?
Stay outta this, nyaaa!
Akashi's pained screams echoed through the port as she ran away, utterly defeated.
Don't think you'll get rid of me that easily, nya...
I'm gonna get my paws on that weapon...
Special drone unit, deploy, nyaaa!
Hm? I sense something... in the sky?
Yuubari, didn't I tell you to cut it out with the RC drones?
Don't look at me. It could be Fargo's drones?
Even stealth drones are sure to be discovered by the keen senses of the many shipgirls within the port.
However, while everyone is distracted by the drones...
Heheheheh... The drones are just bait, nya! My surprise aerial assault is the real danger, nya!
Now show me that weapon, nya!
...Watch out.
Bwuh...
After her assault is easily evaded, Akashi's momentum sends her crashing straight into the ground.
...Are you okay?
Some time later...
Wait, that wasn't a bunker buster? Akashi was the one that fell out of the sky?
Good grief. She's always such a handful... What was she after, anyway?
I don't know.
Well, I'm sure it was for the sake of her business, somehow... But if she's so insistent on it, are you sure you can't let her have her way?
...I don't care, but her desperation makes me worry about how far she'll go.
If she's just trying to find out about it... then that's fine.
Then would you be willing to let her see your weapon under the Commander's supervision? Just for a little while is enough.
...Okay.
Port - Royal Garden
Under a clear blue sky, the port is holding a special tea party to welcome their new guests from another world.
Thank you all for attending today's royal tea party.
We, the Royal Maids, will provide you with the utmost hospitality befitting the port's fine reputation.
A matching tea set with exquisite design is neatly arranged on the table, all waiting for the tea party to begin.
Excuse me, Miss Maid? Don't you worry that being so formal might make your guests feel uneasy?
Umm...
How about this one? "Welcome to our humble tea party, everyone! Eat up, drink up, and have a grand time!"
Ahem. Kent, do not embarrass us in front of the guests, please.
Heehee, it's okay. I happen to prefer the casual greeting.
See? Our guest likes it. Isn't that what matters?
*sigh*... As you wish, milady.
We've prepared the finest black tea made from carefully selected second flush leaves. I hope it suits your palate.
If you'd prefer a different type of tea, or have a specific water temperature in mind, please just let me know! I'll happily take your requests.
Naturally, we have snacks and desserts as well. Do you like sweet foods, milady?
I don't go out of my way to eat sweets, but I don't mind them.
Suffolk kindly made today's snacks for us. We hope that you enjoy them.
Cakes, scones, sandwiches, and other such treats from the tiered serving stand are brought over and laid on the table.
Suffolk personally divides them and serves them to each guest one by one.
Thanks. Mmm... Very refreshing, and the presentation is exquisite. I may not eat sweets often, but I really love these.
Oh? I'm happy you do!
Phew... I don't usually get the opportunity to relax like this, but it's actually not bad at all. Moreover...
The tension of battle fills this place, yet somehow it still manages to calm the nerves... It's perfect.
Is that why I feel such a sense of... tolerance? That even I can be accepted here?
That may be because everyone here is born for battle, just like you.
Heehee, maybe. We're all birds of a feather, aren't we?
Enough talk of violence. This is hardly an appropriate topic among elegant young ladies at a tea party.
Other Royal Navy shipgirls nearby cut into the conversation.
Mind if I join in?
Be my guest. I've looked forward to chatting with Royal Knights.
Don't get your hopes up too much...
Don't be so cold, Monarch. Somehow, you and DEAD MASTER seem like kindred spirits to me.
Hmm... Should I be honored, I wonder?
Monarch's expression is as cold as usual, but she still sits at DEAD MASTER's table along with the others.
Her tea set is already prepared, and as soon as she takes her seat, the maids pour her favorite tea.
While the girls enjoy their tea in the cool sea breeze, smoke rises in the distance – the result of BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER's training.
Miss BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER never goes a day without training, does she?
What a hard worker.
Mmm... I don't know about that. It's more like that's all she has.
You're not going to join in? I thought you liked that stuff.
...Do I look like I do? I'm far from as barbaric as her.
Really?
Yikes, I'm sorry. Monarch can be a little too direct...
Is that so?
Hmph. I just don't like beating around the bush.
Oh, really? Then how about you and I spar a little?
I've been interested in how the Royal Knights fight.
Why did the conversation suddenly shift in that direction?
After the tea party. Now isn't the time to talk about violence.
Quiet tea parties, a peaceful life... I agree. Now isn't the time or place.
Miss Maid, may I have another cup?
Sure~ I'll bring it right away!
Thus, the tea party carries on, though perhaps more precariously than before.
Port - Office
I switch on my phone and check my recent messages.
"Mandy pls help! I'm trapped in the academy."
"Nice I've got signal, says my message got delivered."
The messages are from Z47, short and to the point, unlike her usual walls of texts and stickers.
(Is she trying to prank me? No, that's not like her. I should ask for more details.)
Commander! We need help!
*cough cough*... Commander...
Just as I'm about to reply, two little shipgirls barge into my office.
Are you okay, Amagi? I didn't mean to exhaust you by dragging you along...
I know you're supposed to stay calm in these situations, but I just couldn't. Sorry.
Whew... It's fine, I simply have poor cardio. Never mind that – we need to report to the Commander!

options.content: Trouble has come your way, too?

scripts.say: "Too"? Are you saying that you received the SOS as well?
Let's get our facts straight first. Tell me what's happened.
Something's happened at the academy! We can't reach anyone there or get inside to check.
(They've lost all contact? That's odd...)
Is Z47 there, too?
Yes, she is.
I whip out my phone and send Z47 a message, but it doesn't go through – I get an error saying that my message could not be delivered.
(This is looking more serious than I anticipated.)
I think we should all go and investigate.
Just us three? That won't be enough. Commander, would you mind calling for some backup?
Good idea. Let's head to the academy and I'll make some calls along the way.
Okay!
Port - Academy Entry Gate
A while later, I and a group of shipgirls have gathered outside the academy's entrance.
I came running as soon as I got Bismarck's message. I tried to open the gate, but couldn't.
We tried the regular way, then the hard way... Even brute force couldn't get it open.
I believe the academy has been pulled into a bizarre dimension and can only be entered by fulfilling certain requirements, much like a Mirror Sea.
(A Mirror Sea around the academy? It can't be...)
With that knowledge, I walk up to the gate's facial recognition system.
Alert! Your identity could not be verified! No entry for unauthorized individuals!
Of course it wouldn't be that easy.
It wouldn't let me or Tirpitz in either. I can't believe it won't let YOU in, though...
I've already messaged Ingraham and Soobrazitelny. They should be here soon.
A while later, our little engineers show up. After a quick briefing, they get to work and try to break through the security.
Sometime later...
No dice. It won't open.
Urgh... At least I can say this is not the fault of a system malfunction.
There are two options if you want to get access to the encrypted data. Either you call in a specialist...
Or you get the system developer to have a look. Did you get in touch with Yuubari yet?
Yeah. I messaged her on the way here, but she has yet to reply.
Speaking of Yuubari, I think she went to the academy to do some equipment maintenance... Oh no. She's also trapped in there, isn't she?
Trapped by the very system she created... How ironic, but also problematic for us.
(Bombarding it with all we have should be our last resort. I could ask TB to hack her way in...)
Then, while I'm weighing my options, the security system speaks again.
Verification successful. Welcome to the academy, U-31.
With an unceremonious voice clip, the gate slowly slides open.
That's it? I didn't even have to do anything!
U-31 has appeared beside us, donning a school uniform – of some kind, anyway.
Hiya, Commander. I'm here to protect you.
Don't know how I did it, but I got the gate open.
Just like that?
It was working as normal this whole time? I thought the dang system had locked up!
Then if it's still working, it must've been tampered with. Interesting...
Um... You should all probably look at the academy.
As instructed, I turn my gaze toward it and immediately catch sight of a colorful banner with some sort of slogan written across it.
"A little paradise for the pure, innocent, and mischievous."
That banner wasn't there before, was it?
No, definitely not!
Hmm. This gives me an idea...
Enterprise, Amagi, could you look into the facial recognition machine?
Verification successful. Welcome to the academy, Enterprise.
Verification successful. Welcome to the academy, Amagi.
Aha! The conditions to enter must be being pure, innocent, and little! Let me give it a shot!
Alert! Your identity could not be verified! No entry for unauthorized individuals!
Hey! What the heck?!
Aww, you poor thing. You must've lost your innocence after digging into too many dark secrets.
When an investigator fails, it's time for an adventurer to step up to the plate!
Alert! Your identity could not be verified! No entry for unauthorized individuals!
Are you kidding?! I'm the port's foremost adventurer! Let me iiin!
You leave me with no choice... Commander, permission to open fire!
Hold your violent horses! Lady Yuen will get this gate open right away.
Alert! Your identity could not be verified! No entry for unauthorized individuals!
Waaah! This is slander!
Teacher, let me try!
Alert! Your identity could not be verified! No entry for unauthorized individuals!
Not even Anchorage, huh? So what ARE the conditions to get in, then?
It's strange. Enterprise, U-31, and I were all authorized...
Let me... try.
Verification successful. Welcome to the academy, Eldridge.
I think I understand now. They must either be "little," or wear the correct kind of uniform.
Looks like it.
(I believe some of the little shipgirls were doing extracurricular activities outside the academy when this thing started.)
(That being the case, I know a few candidates for this mission.)
A team capable of meeting the security system's criteria has been swiftly assembled.
My demon eye has revealed the truth – it is all a Dark Requiem conspiracy. Fear not, for I shall rescue our comrades caught beyond the periphery!
Heehee... I promise this won't take long, my Commander. I'll accomplish this mission before you know it.
That's the spirit! Meanwhile, I'll keep an eye o– I mean, keep Taihou safe!
Rescue team... has no name.
Do we need one? In that case, I propose "Banishers of all Evil"!
I don't get it...
Then how about "Twinkling Little Stars"?
Cute...
I don't have anything against a cute name, but I want something with a cooler ring to it.
Unbelievable... A big mystery is right at our doorstep, and I'm barred from entry! This is criminally unfair!
I need a school uniform! Commander, get one for me!
Me too! I want a uniform!
While the racket carries on in the background, the rescue team makes their final preparations.
Commander, I can go inside. Will you let me go with them?
I'd like to come, too.
Sorry, but no. The incident shook you, so you should stay out here and rest.
Hrmh... Fine.
U-31, take this camera equipment with you. We'll tune in from out here and support you as best we can.
Alrighty! I'll be back in a minute, then.
Mwahaha! My demon eye has already foretold the future. We shall return triumphantly!
Yeah! We'll bring 'em all back safe and sound!
Bye-bye, Commander.
Verification successful. Welcome to the academy, Twinkling Little Stars.

sequence: "Welcome to Little Academy."
"A place where you can live happily."
"A place where you can keep your innocence."
"A place where your inner child can always be with you."

scripts.say: A short time after the start of the victory celebration, I remember something I'd totally forgotten.
Due to the events in the control room, I still haven't finished doing a head count of the rescuees.
Now that I'm looking again, it seems Illustrious is still somewhere in the academy.
(Hmm... I'll let the others rest and go look for her myself.)
Before long, I find her in a prep room.
Oh, Commander? Is something the matter? You look awfully tense.
Hmm? Uh, have you not run into anything weird or heard any strange sounds?
Strange sounds, you say?
She blushes a little awkwardly.
Are you saying you... heard something through the door?
Well, it's not a big deal. Umm, I was just practicing singing lullabies for the kids...
(It's almost as if she's been so focused on her practice here that she genuinely didn't realize anything was wrong.)
(Hmm... I'll find a more appropriate time to fill her in.)
Lullabies, huh?
Yes. I bought a book on childcare recently. It's the one on the desk over there.
It says that learning songs to help soothe them is especially important...
Oh, I see. You've been practicing here all this time to help take better care of the kids in the academy?
Just so. Honestly, I meant to do it in secret so it would be a surprise to everyone...
But doing it alone makes it impossible to get feedback on my progress...

options.content: What if you had a partner?

scripts.say: You'd like to join me? Heehee, that's wonderful.
Then I'll need a moment to think about what part you can help me with.
Aren't you just singing lullabies?
Not at all. If I was only singing, then I wouldn't need to practice here in secret.
...I have an idea. Come over here for me, Commander.
I go to Illustrious's side as directed. She smiles gently and puts a hand on my back.
Then she pats it gently... Once, twice.
How does it feel, Commander? The book said that you can calm a child quickly with slow, gentle pats on the back.
I feel her soft exhales on me. Those, and her patting, are so comforting that I feel a sudden bout of sleepiness.
Yeah, that... That works pretty well...
Are you sleepy, Commander? Would you like to take a little nap in my arms?
But I'm supposed to give you feedback on your practice. I can't just fall asleep now...
Heehee, it's okay. We have plenty of time. After you wake up, we can start in earnest.
Okay...
After a moment's hesitation, I decide to take this opportunity to tell her about everything that happened today.
If I don't go back soon, everyone will get worried...
I had no idea... I was so focused on my practice that I didn't notice anything had happened at all.
You came looking for me because you were worried, and I just made you help me practice...
She seems both embarrassed and apologetic.
I could've told you before, but I chose not to. It seemed wrong to worry you over nothing.
How about we go back now? As for the rest of your practice...
I know. Let's set a date.
A date?
After the party is over, I'll come back and help you with your practice. Sound good?
Heehee, sure.
Once the party is over... we can go over every last little trick I've learned. Together♪
Little Academy - Arts Building
The barren hallway is dead silent save for the sound of the wind, gently shaking the music note ornaments that decorate the walls.
Then, there was a cracking sound.
WHUAH?! Wh-wh-what was that?! Did we set off a trap or something? C-Commander, come rescue meee!
I stepped on a broken floor tile, that's all!
There's something... on the floor.
Oh, you're right! You seeing this, Commander? Should I adjust the camera angle?
Or maybe what you really wanna see is me, hmm?
You little... Get to the point already!
Ooh, hear that? Little Taihou here is getting antsy!
...If you don't mind, turn the camera to the floor so I can see what's there.
Okey-dokey.
Through the camera, I see the floor is littered with cutouts of newspaper headlines – "accommodated," "missing," and "late in the night," they say.
Hey, that sounds like the cryptid Bristol told me about earlier! "It couldn't be accommodated in its cage, so at night it fled and went missing!"
How mistaken you are. Clearly, this refers to the missing fallen angel of fate who fell into the endless abyss – the late night – to defend the light!
That's two crackpot theories. Anyone got another?
Shh... Music. I hear music.
The chatter quickly dies down as everyone opens their ears and listens closely – there really is a light yet uncanny melody playing.
Judging by the floor plan I have here, it's coming from the music room at the end of the hallway.
My gut tells me that's where you'll find the key to resolving the situation in there.
Twinkling Little Stars, head there and investigate. Be on your guard.
Roger!
Arts Building - Music Room
BOOM!
The girls throw open the door to a bewildering sight.
Hmm? Greetings, everyone. Please stay for a while. This one is positively brimming with energy right now!
I'm so bored... I don't feel like doing anything, not even eating a snack or reading a book...
I can't be bothered with my hair anymore. It can stay the way it is...
I don't care to play any music... In fact, I don't need music at all.
A strange song plays inside the music room. All the girls inside are lying about lazily, except for Shinano-chan, who is full of vim and vigor.
Commander, I think there's some kind of device in that room that's having an effect on those girls' minds.
There's no "effect." Protecting the Commander is a pain in the butt and I just wanna lie down and rest.
I'm done being a star! I've never helped the Commander anyway...
Eldridge, meanwhile, remains silent and assumes the fetal position in a corner of the room.
Wait, Commander, you saw that, right?! Their personalities all did a 180!
Whatever's affecting their minds, it's really powerful. It's influenced all of them.
All of you who still have your wits about you, please retreat at once and dispatch rescue personnel.
There's no time. They should prioritize neutralizing whatever's causing this strange phenomenon.
Speaking of the phenomenon... Z43, how come you've not been affected? Any ideas?
Uhh... Because I covered my ears, I suppose? I sensed an evil presence the moment I set foot inside.
(Ahh. Then it must be music causing this.)
Z43, keep your ears covered and have a look around. Do you see any device that could be producing the music?
I see a couple of speakers up there! Are they the source of this evil influence?
Augur of Destiny, should I destroy them? Make your choice!
Do it. That should bring the rest of you back to normal!
Drat! I can't reach them! And I mustn't unleash cannon fire in a classroom!
Hold up! I think you can deal with the speakers without breaking them!
The music is the problem, right? So just disrupt the music so it can't influence them!
(That's not a bad idea... All she needs to do is play an instrument to alter the melody!)
Z43, do you know how to play an instrument?
No, that's beyond my capa– Whoa, take it easy, Shinano! People are gonna get hurt if you jump on them like that!
This one heard the Commander speaking! Come here and let us play!
Settle down! Take a seat and cool off or something! The Commander will be here soon enough!
Ugh, so I just need to disrupt the music, right? I'll try!
A speaker set, a microphone... Hmm... Behold, Augur of Destiny! I shall pull our comrades back up from the deep, dark abyss!
Ahem...
Z43 first clears her throat, then picks up the microphone and starts singing.
Wings of dark, burn so briiight♪ Come to me, embrace the liiight♪ Face your fears, we'll be alriiight♪
Z43 becomes engrossed by her own singing. As her song comes to an end, the girls regain their senses one by one.
Hm? I could swear I heard the strangest melody just now... Well, perhaps "melody" is glorifying it somewhat.
My head feels all weird... Oh no! And my hair's such a mess, too!
I feel as though I had a nightmare...
Sounds like that weird influence is wearing off. Phew... I knew something was wrong with that melody.
Well done, Z43. Is everyone back to normal now?
*pant*... *pant*... Yeah! Man, I really sang my heart out there...
Er, I mean! Augur of Destiny, now you have witnessed my might – the might of a REBEL!
Is that the Commander's voice I hear? Where are you, Commander? Are you spying on us from your office?
Hey, back off, little lady. The only person the Commander's watching is me, anyway. Right, Commander?
U-31 flips the camera around and covers the screen with her ear-to-ear grin. Immediately, all the little shipgirls gather around and wave to me. Well, all except for one...
My hair is super messy! I'm not letting the Commander see me like this!
Hi there. I'm glad you girls are all okay.
Commander, you should probably order them to get out of there, now. The mind influence might have worn off, but the music's still playing, so...
Well, hello. I didn't know you were here, Enterprise.
Of course I am. This is a big deal. I can't just sit by and watch, can I?
U-31, could you open the door? Everyone else, cover your ears and get out of there.
Roger-roger.
U-31 walks up to the door and tries to open it, but it won't budge no matter what she tries – strange, as it opened easily on the way in.
That's... weird. I can't get the door open.
Hmm, maybe it's got something to do with that mind influence? The song's still playing, so maybe it's subconsciously preventing you from leaving.
Looks like you'll have to blow your way out after all. Take aim at the speakers and let 'er rip!
Let's not be hasty. Disrupting the melody worked once, and I think it might just work again.
See the colorful notes on the blackboard? I think they're the key.
She's right... Firing your cannons might blow up the whole classroom.
My throat is dry as a bone, so please don't make me sing again.
I've got it! Let's all team up and form a band!
A band? Sounds... fun.
Sure, but Friedrich is the only one here who knows music.
