And even then, she's more about conducting it than playing it...
I could teach you basic music theory, but I don't think we have time for that.
Music is all about soul.
Friedrich... er, grown Friedrich is right. Just play with your heart and it'll be fine.
Yippee! It's time for music! I call dibs on the drums!
What kind of song should we play, though?
Simple. A song befitting a rebel such as I – a heavy metal song!
Pass. That stuff makes my ears hurt.
Heavy metal... exhausting. Pick something else.
Unable to reach any kind of consensus, the girls turned to the camera and asked us for advice.
You should play whatever kind of song you want. Metal, a nursery rhyme, folk, pop, whatever.
What matters is that you have fun. Remember: it just has to disrupt the melody!
Exactly. It doesn't have to be perfect.
BZZT... CULTIVATING INTERESTS... BZZT... HAVING FUN ABOVE ALL... BZZT...
Hey, did you hear that voice? I think someone's monitoring us!
Any guesses as to who it is?
No idea. They've applied a filter, making it impossible to infer anything.
What the...? Whuah?! Where'd all these things come from?!
Meow!
Meow-meow!
Meow meow meeeow!
They superficially resemble Meowfficers, but these bust creatures are clearly something else entirely.
Is this that cat's handiwork again? Akashi, come here!
Y-yes, nya?
Have you something to do with this?
No, nya! I swear on my shop's name I don't know anything, nya!
Meow meow meeeow!
Now they're... waving instruments around.
I think they want to challenge us to a play-off.
Oh yeah? The Twinkling Little Stars are gonna rock their world!
Together, now! Let us play!
As the music dies down, the speakers cease playing that strange melody. Stranger yet, the odd Meowfficers all stop moving at the same time as well.
Whaddya think, Commander? Am I cut out to be an idol?
Please, if anyone's cut out for that, it's me! I know the Commander agrees.
Mwahaha! With rock as the medium, my power has been unleashed!
Whew... I think we all played pretty well.
Goodness...
The fiery hot emotion packed into every beat... There was frankly too much of it for my tastes.
At any rate, you're safe now. What happened to those Meowfficer busts?
I think they... went bust. But seriously, they turned back into normal statues.
Hmm. I think that weird melody and those busts are connected, I'm just not sure how yet.
Regardless, there's no time to waste. I propose you split up – one team can investigate those Meowfficers, the other can move forward with the rescue mission.
Good idea. We've found and rescued a few people, so splitting up here would be more efficient.
Twinkling Little Stars, check the arts building for anyone else that needs rescue, then head to the main school building and continue the mission.
Everyone else, see if you can find out anything about those strange Meowfficers.
Rogery-dodgery-doo!
Worry not, my child. We shall handle it.
Hang on a sec! You girls haven't got a team name yet! You HAVE to have one!
Why? What do we need a name for?
I think it'd be nice to have. It'll make us feel more like a team.
You may decide the name. Meanwhilst, this one shall sleep... Zzz...
Ooh, I've got a good one!
What, pray tell?
"The Sparkly Kitties!"
Can we veto that?
Nuh-uh! Your name's set in stone now!
Okay, let's move, girls! Last team to finish their mission is a bunch of rotten eggs!
Also, the Commander's probably gonna shower the winning team with rewards!
R-rewards? Okay! The Sparkly Kitties WILL win!
(Why is this a competition now? And why am I obliged to reward the winner?)
(Well, if it motivates them...)
After reminding them numerous times to be careful, I order both teams to set upon their respective tasks.
The Twinkling Little Stars went straight for the school building and started looking around. In the end, they only found anomalous activity in one classroom.
Now they stand at the firmly shut door. Something on the other side is making an eerie scratching noise.
Those damned Dark Requiem conspirators are employing the Abyssal Noise! However, they are sorely mistaken if they think that will scare me again!
Heh. "Again"? So it has scared you before.
H-hey! "Scared" is a strong word! I was only mildly perturbed! Come on, let us head in!
Settle down, Z43. Stay in formation and move in carefully.
U-31 cautiously opens the door. Inside the classroom, there is a massive stack of wooden blocks, so tall it even towers above the girls.
At the top stands a lone Meowfficer bust, writing something on the blackboard. This is the source of that eerie scratching sound.
Meow! Mreow!
As soon as the Meowfficer becomes aware of the girls, it jumps inside the heap of wooden blocks and hides.
Commander! Found another one of those Meowfficer busts!
Go after it!
Try as you might, evil spirit! My demon eye has already seen where you went in this blazing sea of endless nothingness!
Yeah, we all know where it is – in the block pile. Can we start looking now?
Oh. Right...
The team climbs onto the pile and starts looking for the sneaky Meowfficer.
Dowsing rod... No response.
I've got something! Feels soft to the touch... It's gotta be the Meowfficer's hat!
Li'l Sandy pulled out the thing under the blocks with such force that she lost her balance and fell flat on her butt.
Please don't pull on my apron! I don't want it to tear!
Oh, it's Little Bel! Not the catch I was expecting, but I'll take it.
Long... Silky... Tail?
Eldridge, meanwhile, uproots something else as well.
My word! Don't pull on a lady's hair – it's so uncouth!
I feel something firm! Those Meowfficer busts look pretty hard, so this has GOT to be the one!
U-31 pulls out the object from among the wooden blocks.
Sorry. That's just my iron claw.
While they failed to find the Meowfficer, they did manage to find Little Bel, Little Formidable, and Little Spee.
After a short break, the girls all attempt to leave the classroom. Much like last time, though, the door has fused itself shut with the walls.
Well, we're doing this again. The key to getting out should be somewhere in here.
Commander, I'll take the camera for a tour around the room. Tell me if you see anything interesting.
(Hmm... As far as clues go, all we really have are the wooden blocks and the writing the Meowfficer left on the blackboard.)
The blackboard says, "Building with blocks," and there's a drawing of them stacked atop each other.
Supposing that you must satisfy a condition before you may leave, perhaps we should start by arranging the blocks as shown in the drawing.
(They didn't need to follow a template in the music room, they just played whatever they wanted.)
(If this follows the same rule, shouldn't they just stack the blocks however they want?)
First, I want to try something. All of you, go ahead and arrange the blocks however you like.
However we like, huh?
Blocks... Like... Commander...
We like the Commander more than anyone else, so...
Let's build a wooden block Commander!
I must admit, I do like the Commander more than my wings of dark...
Wooow. You hear that, my Commander? You're adored by all!
I'm behind this idea. I will make a great wooden block statue to demonstrate my love!
(Ruh-roh. Sounds like I'll need to "keep a close eye" on the Commander for the near future...)
(But right now, it's building time. Gotta be quick so I can be where I'm needed – by the Commander's side!)
The little shipgirls quickly got to work. It quickly dawned on them how fun the act of stacking blocks actually was.
Now to put a heart in the Commander's hands...
I say, this pose is somewhat lacking in grace. The hands should be more like... this! Even a statue should be well-mannered.
I've found you, long-lost wing! I shall now return you to where you belong – on the Commander's back!
Wait, the hair's going the wrong way! This bit should go left, and this part goes right.
With much merry collaboration, the girls finish their blocky statue of me.
Aaand done! Look and be amazed, Commander! We made a mega version of you!
Whoa! That Mega-Mander is peak art!
I never knew you put any points into art appreciation.
I mean, just look at that warped orb in the Commander's hands! It's a metaphor for the forbidden knowledge endowed to our supremely wise leader!
Uhh... that's a heart.
Wh-what? A... heart?
Then explain those peculiar ornaments on the statue's back! What arcane unknowns do they represent?
Those are angel wings...
A-angel wings... Ahaha...
Is THIS really how you all view me?
More or less! Looks pretty cute, doesn't it?
There's still one block left... What should we do with it?
It LOOKS Like a Meowfficer, so we could put it on the shoulder like a pet.
Little Spee puts down the final "block" – which then comes to life.
Hey! That's no block, that's the Meowfficer bust!
BZZT... PLAY LIKE INNOCENT CHILDREN... BZZT... FIND YOUR OWN HOBBY...
Meow! Mreow!
Let's fight it using blocks!
*rumble*...
Mega Commander shatters the Meowfficer busts' Mega-Meowfficer stack with a powerful tackle.
With that, the classroom door opens, and the Meowfficer busts turn back into lifeless stone.
Heheh! The Twinkling Little Stars can't be beaten!
The school building rescue mission is a success! Next up...
*rumble*...
A-an earthquake?
Oh, no... What's happening? I can't maintain... proper Royal Lady... posture?!
There's a loud rumble as the video feed shakes violently, as if an earthquake is really occurring.
Nothing is happening in the makeshift command center outside the academy.
(Could it be... something's happening inside the school building?)
Everyone, get out of that classroom and take shelter in an open space!
The rumbling and shaking in the camera feed still hasn't stopped.
It's even worse on the athletic field! Commander, what do we do?
Above all else, stay calm. Once you've secured your own safety, confirm that there's nothing around you that could trigger anything worse–
AAAAH! HELP MEEE!
Is that... Z47?
Renown, Zeppelin, and Cleveland, too...?
U-31, spin the camera toward them for me.
Roger-dodger!
On the other end of the field, Z47 is running desperately on a moving track reminiscent of a treadmill.
On the inside of the track are Little Renown, Zeppy, and Clevelad. They're surprised and relieved to see the Twinkling Little Stars.
(The track on the field is moving... This must be what caused the earthquake.)
(Based on how we've solved the other problems so far, there must be some condition we need to meet in order to stop it.)
A rebel would never abandon her imprisoned comrades! I'm on my way!
Hey, wait!
U-31's cries fall on deaf ears. Z43 runs onto the track thoughtlessly... and gets stuck running on it just like Z47.
Aaaagh! Heeelp!
*sigh*... Things are just getting worse...
But one destined to be a Solomon Knight mustn't be afraid of a moving track! Allow me to–
Clevelad tries to run in, too, but Zeppy and Little Renown manage to stop her after seeing the horrors that Z43 fell into.
Idiot! If you go, you'll just be the third one stuck on it!
Th-that doesn't mean I can stand idly by and let it happen...
We have no other choice. Let's blow this field to smithereens with our cannons!
Our friends are stuck on that track! Ever heard the words "friendly fire"?
Just use small-caliber cannons!
Ooh. Now we're cooking with gas!
No, you are NOT!
...I have an idea!
What is it?
Zeppy grabs Clevelad by the waist and lifts her up high above.
Eep! Wh-what are you doing?
Now...
Then, she starts spinning Clevelad around at incredible speed!
Huh? W-wait...
Take thiiis!
KABOOOOM!
After being fired like a missile, Clevelad strikes Z47 and Z43. The momentum throws all three of them off the track.
Phew... That's another one solved!
Hmm... Creative, to be sure.
At least tell me first... Ouchies.
So, did you all come here to check out the situation at the academy? While relaying everything to the outside with that camera?
Commandeeer! Can you hear meee?
Yeah, I can hear you. What in the world happened before the investigation team came in?
Well... We don't really know, either!
The classroom door suddenly wouldn't open, and weird Meowfficers started running through the halls...
When we finally got the door open and came to check out the field, the track started moving out of nowhere...
And you saw how that turned out.
If we don't do something about this track, the whole campus could get destroyed by the earthquakes...
Agreed. We have to stop that track ASAP.
Commander, there's nobody left on it. Let's fire–
FU SHUN!
Okay, sorry... Ow, I said I'm sorry! Ow, ouch! H-have mercy on my ear!
BZZT... HAPPY AND ENERGETIC... BZZT... TREASURE YOUR YOUTH...
Meow! Mreow!
Hahah! I get it. It's a track-and-field competition they want!
Let's show them just how athletic we can be!
After 105 games, the Meowfficer busts have suffered a total defeat.
The failed Meowfficers returned to stone busts, and the track finally stopped moving.
*pant*... *pant*... Now do you see the power of a future Solomon Knight?
I would never lose a fair contest!
Woohoo! We are number one!
So next would be...
You all must be tired after all that running. Take a break before you continue your investigation.
Ahaha♡ You're too sweet, Commander! I thought you might say that~
The shipgirls enjoy a moment's respite on the field.
Though, of course, not all of them are happy to just relax. The little shipgirls quickly tire of sitting around and resort to playing together.
(Things haven't been resolved yet, but... there's nothing wrong with taking a nice break.)
I change my communication line from the public channel to a private channel, so as not to disturb their rest.
While her friends all enjoy the many play facilities near the track, Z47 sits on the seesaw alone and plays with her phone.
Z47? You don't want to play with them?
If you want me to, Mandy... I'll put my phone away...
But I don't know what to talk about with them... You're not here, either.
I may not be there, but thanks to our communication lines, it's like I am.
Your calls for help also helped resolve the situation before it could take a turn for the worse.
Do you mean that? I thought you left me on read, even if it was just because of the stuff going on...
But my message really helped...
Can I have a reward?
Sure. Want me to play some phone games with you? Or I could join you on the seesaw when this is all over.
Alone with you here, when it's all over...
Sure. It's a promise.
Okay. When the time comes, you better not act like you forgot.
I switch back to the public channel and reevaluate the situation.
(The academy gate, classrooms, and field tracks are all basic infrastructure that any school should have.)
(All of the occurrences so far have been related to innocence and fun. Save for the gate, every area where they happened have had Meowfficer busts present.)
As I unravel things, I recall a request I'd approved several days ago.
(The Academy Companion System development plan... Who requested that? It was Yuubari.)
(Yuubari was also on the missing persons list.)
(Did that companion system cause everything that's happening right now?)
Rest time ends, and the shipgirls resume the rescue operation.
The girls speculate that there might be more little shipgirls trapped in the office building.
In order to increase the efficiency of the search, we decide they should split into two groups again.
The Twinkling Little Stars infiltrate from the main entrance, while the others form a team called Sparkling Knight and circle around the back of the admin building.
Admin Building
The investigation team's chit-chat dies down over time, probably either because it's dark or because they're tired from the search.
During a moment of silence, footsteps can be heard from the dark hallway.
Is that sound...
Eeeek! I-it's Dark Requiem!
You'd better keep your distance! I'm a REBEL, you know!
Before the footsteps can round the corner, Z43 leaps to the front of the group.
Her scream echoes through the halls, prompting U-31 and the little ships to rush over. Alvitr and Duke of York come into view of the camera.
We came here because we heard voices. I had no idea it would be you...
Sorry for scaring you.
I guess we weren't cautious enough. We really didn't mean to give you such a fright.
Honestly, Z43's screaming was what really scared us...
So, why are you all here? What's the situation like outside?
Allow me to explain.
I see. A lot has happened in so little time.
What about things on your end? Is the admin building safe?
Well, we've run into our fair share of troubles here.
Follow me to the staff office. I think you'll be able to see the problem there.
Office Building - Staff Office
Meow meow meeeow!
Alvitr opens the door to the staff office, revealing a Meowfficer bust playground.
Wh-what's going on here?
See for yourself. These pipsqueaks appeared out of nowhere and took over the office.
They don't seem malicious... but I also doubt they plan to leave any time soon.
Alvitr's right. The Meowfficers are holding up signs with questions on them and running around the room in a line.
On closer inspection, there are more signs piled up in the corner of the room.
Is this their way of holding a test, or...?
Well... I did say they're not malicious, but for some reason, they really want to quiz us.
As for the ones in the corner, we answered those already since we were bored and annoyed...
Meow meow meeeow!
They're... quizzing us...
I get it! So they want us to answer their questions, too!
Li'l Sandy accepts a quiz sheet, takes a look at it, and immediately hands it to Z43.
Easy stuff! This isn't even worth wasting the leader's time! My Twinkling Little Stars can handle this.
Huh? M-me...? Hmph! My demon eye has already divined the answer... For the sake of fairness, I'd best not participate!
Eldridge! I leave this great responsibility in your capable hands!
If you don't want to do it, I'll do it. The Commander is watching, after all.
...No. This is easy...
Done.
Eldridge answers the quiz with awesome speed, hands it in to the Meowfficer bust, and has it check her work.
Meow meow!
It leaps into the air happily... and splits in two!
They multiplied!
No wonder there are so many... It's like they're doing mitosis.
The two new Meowfficers bring in new quiz sheets.
More of them? At this rate, we'll never finish!
I'm starting to think that answering their questions will just lead to more questions.
Hmm... Okay, so solving the questions as they're given to us isn't enough.
Rather... Perhaps giving the correct answers is the wrong idea in itself?
Are you saying we should give incorrect answers on purpose?
Good idea. Leave it to me~
U-31 takes a quiz sheet, draws a turtle on it instead of writing an answer, and gives it back to the Meowfficer bust.
MREEEOW!
Infuriated, the Meowfficer jumps up and headbutts her. When it lands, it splits into two just like it would've if she'd answered correctly.
Rrrgh... That hurt!
Ugh! If it doesn't matter whether we're right or wrong, how about we just ignore them?
They seem harmless, and you were able to get out of this room without bothering with them, so...
U-31 tries to open the door to prove it, but unlike when they came in, it won't budge an inch no matter how she tries.
Huh... That's weird. Alvitr was able to get out just fine!
(I knew it. We need to solve the problem here before we can leave, too.)
(Stopping them from cloning themselves... It must be related to innocence and fun.)
(Whether they answer right has no relation to those things. And the result is effectively the same if you get them wrong on purpose...)
Hmph, what a bother this all is. They ask you questions – is it not reasonable to assume you must ANSWER them?
Why don't we just burn all of these sheets at this rate?
That makes sense... I was totally blind to that.
Oh? So you agree, Commander? Taihou-chan, ready a fire.
Hold it, hold it! That's not what I meant!
I was saying that it's not about just answering the questions. JUST answering the questions isn't enough.
All work and no play makes you a dull shipgirl. Get what I mean?
All work and no play...
Heheh, I understand.
Thanks to someone, the work is done. Now all that's left is to play, is that it?
Exactly. That's enough work. Relax and play, girls!
While the girls play, almost every Meowfficer in the staff room turns back into busts.
But a few of them continue to hold their signs up.
(The Twinkling Little Stars have played plenty by now, but there are still Meowfficers. Have we overlooked something?)
Meow... Meow!
Ugh, these things are so annoying. Are they mad, or what?
Huh? They STILL want us to answer questions?
All work makes one a dull shipgirl, yes, but that doesn't mean we can be all play either.
But if we keep answering questions, the Meowfficers will multiply again. That'll put all of our work playing to waste.
How about a more simple method? Every problem until now, the Meowfficers hid or kept you away from them.
But all of the Meowfficers causing the problem in the staff room are IN the staff room. Blow them up, and you might have your way out.
Melee combat with special gear oughta keep the damages to the facility to a minimum.
Enty, are you serious about this? Those Meowfficers are kinda cute, so...
They're ripe for research, too, nya!
We need to prioritize rescuing the girls who are still trapped. Commander, it's time for swift decision-making.
Hmm...

options.content: No other choice. Let's try to solve this with violence.
Wait. Just let me think for a minute.

scripts.say: Woohoo! Violence! Twinkling Little Stars, kick some ass!
Alvitr, Duke of York. Are there any clues relating to innocence and fun in the admin building?
There are, actually. Just a second.
Alvitr takes out a school newspaper and shows two headlines to the camera.
"The Meowfficer who went missing at night"?
"Cherish your innocence! Give everyone a mischievous and fun little paradise!"
Huh? I thought it was a cryptid that went missing during the night, because it couldn't fit in its cage?
That isn't a missing fallen angel of fate who fell into the endless abyss – the late night – to defend the light, either!
Both of you are obviously wrong!
(Cherish your innocence, and give everyone a mischievous and fun little paradise... Hmm. Everyone?)
I know what we have to do. The Twinkling Little Stars can't have all the fun. The teachers have to have fun, too.
Us, too?
Of course. This is a world for EVERYONE to have fun in, so everyone has to join in.
Alvitr and Duke of York agree and join in with everyone's games.
BZZT... WORK AND PLAY... EVERYONE FIND THE PERFECT BALANCE... BZZT...
MEOW! MREEEOW!
Eventually, the team managed to solve the problem in the admin building.
Commander, we've finished investigating all of the main facilities in the academy now. Next–
Sorry to interrupt. Commander, I have an urgent report.
The Academy Companion System terminal has been found inside the campus control room.
Yuubari should be there, too.
(The control room... It seems likely that's where this all began.)
Contact the two investigation teams and have them meet up there.
Roger~
Little Academy - Control Room
In the control room, there's a giant screen flickering with colorful static while it displays the same slogan as the banner at the gate.
"A little paradise for the pure, innocent, and mischievous."
In front of the control panel, a giant Meowfficer bust stands with an intimidating blue gleam in its eyes.
And the one facing that Meowfficer...
It's Yuubari! Commander, we found her!
Thank goodness... You're all here!
Yuubari. How's the situation in there?
It's still a stalemate... But with your help, we can get through this danger, no problem.
Wary of the giant Meowfficer bust, she briefly explains the situation.
Today is routine maintenance of the Academy Companion System. When she shut it down to perform said maintenance, everything went haywire.
When it should've shut down, the system began an abnormal startup and started producing endless Meowfficer busts.
When Yuubari was forced to focus on the production issue, something took advantage of the opening to steal her toolbox.
Then, the anomaly appeared and covered the entire academy. That was when we at the port learned about it.
It's evident that the Meowfficer right there is the one that stole your toolbox and made a mess of everything.
Yeah. By the time I realized it, it was too late...
But the Companion System has one final safety feature.
She gestures at the lever she's holding tightly in one hand.
When I pull this lever, unless the correct sequence of buttons is pressed in five seconds, the Companion System's power source will be forcibly cut off.
Alternatively, if it tries to overload the Companion System to expand this special space, I'll need to pull this lever in order to nullify the overload.
So... As you can see, whoever acts first loses in this state.
MREEEEOW!
Heheh, I see~
So basically, it's up to our interference to break the stalemate!
Mission objective: defeat the crazy Meowfficer bust.
If we take that thing down, we can all go home!
At home... Soft, comfy bed, and the Commander...
Let's go for it, everyone!
When the first, final, and most powerful Meowfficer bust is defeated, the Mirror Sea loses its core and collapses.
Yuubari manages to safely shut down the Academy Companion System, too.
Some time after, at Little Academy...
Great work, Commander. You solved the school's problems in the blink of an eye!
Heheh~ I think you all have the makings of adventurers!
Tiiired... I wanna lie down and scroll on my phone for hours now.
I can finally go back to guarding the Commander. Heheh~ I need a whiff so bad right now~
Stay away from the Commander, you!
While everyone rejoices over our victory, their promised reward is brought to them.
Thank you all for waiting. The Commander ordered this dessert be made to celebrate your triumphant return.
Exquisitely decorated cakes and macarons are given to the shipgirls.
Mmm! I wanna eat tasty cake every day!
Ugh... I'd put on so much weight, but... It's too good! Commander, eat with me!
Eat slowly, now. You don't want to choke. Enterprise and the others went to get drinks, so make sure you all get one.
Okaaay♪
Thus, we begin a simple victory celebration on the academy campus.
Meanwhile, in the control room...
Yuubari is hard at work on the Academy Companion System.
Man... I can't believe a little bit of erroneous code in the companion module drove the whole system crazy.
It forced missions on them all, and it even made Meowfficer busts to supervise them...
A program meant to guide people and help them enjoy their academy life became overly emotional and forced them to do things they didn't want to do...
Count your lucky stars that nobody got hurt.
Ugh... Maintenance, updates... Too much to do.
Soft sunlight filters in through the window, followed by the voices and giggles of the little shipgirls.
It doesn't matter how much work it takes.
I hope you haven't forgotten the point of this system.
Yuubari recalls how the little shipgirls visited her workshop not long ago.
Yuubari, can I ask you a favor?
What is it? I'm no good at brushing others' hair.
The Commander and older shipgirls said they'd come to the academy when they could make time.
Yuubari, can you make a guidance system that'll show them how fun our school can be?
It's here to help make their every day as happy and fun as can be, after all.

sequence: END

scripts.say: West of SP Island - Afternoon
Something wrong, Princeton? You look like you're in a bad mood.
Cleveland, don't you think our current operation... is a bit too conservative?
We know SP Island has already been occupied, but all we're doing is staking out over here waiting for the Sakura Empire to strike first...
With our current strength, we can make a decisive preemptive strike!
Cleve, I also think we should make the first move.
I get how both of you feel. I don't think it'd be a bad idea either, but...
It's been a few days since we last got a report from our submarine fleet, so the Sakura Empire's fleet should already be nearby.
...Given the situation, the Naval HQ decided that the best thing to do is play it safe and stick to defense. It's best not to underestimate the enemy, right?
Until we get a clearer grasp of where the enemy is, I agree that sticking to defense is the safer bet.
We may have more submarines and surface ships, but we could still lose if we get ambushed. Let's just play it safe.
I see... That's a good point...
What would Saratoga do... at a time like this...?
It seems that you all have an opinion on this mission.
Hm? Enterprise, were you listening in?
Yeah. Honestly, I'd like to make a move as well. We've been winning battle after battle, so we're probably all being influence by the high morale going around.
However, the more drunk you are on victory, the harder it is to keep track of your surroundings. That's why we should be extra vigilant at this moment.
Otherwise, even a single misstep can ruin everything we've built up to this point.
Indeed... It's just as you said.
...However, there's no need for us to follow every instruction to the letter.
Our objective may be to just focus on protecting this area, but simply sticking to defense isn't the way our fleet does things.
As the command ship, I cannot leave this area, but... I'd like to send a fleet to the surrounding islands to establish air superiority and clear out potential obstacles to our operation.
Princeton, can I entrust you with this mission?
Ah?! Y-yes! Please leave it to me!
Alright. Next, I'll be assigning the escorts. Reno, Cleveland... I'd like one ship from each of your ship classes.
Cleve, would it be okay for me to go on this mission?
Hmm... I think... Birmingham should do it this time.
Huh?!
You can be a little impulsive, so I'd like you to stick with me and back me up. I'll leave the anti-air to you!
Birmingham is a bit more cautious, so she'd probably be a good fit as an escort. Think you're up for it?
If you say so... I don't have a problem with it.
Alright, then it's decided. Princeton, Reno, Birmingham. Your mission is to neutralize the air forces of the Sakura Empire in the perimeter of the area.
If you encounter the enemy's main fleet, report back here. Don't push yourselves, and remember that we've got your backs.
Alright!
(Neutralizing the enemy's air forces... it's a small mission, but it's time to focus!)
Damnit, Enterprise! ...Ugh, is it impossible to take down the Eagle Union's Task Force?
Zuikaku, calm down... *cough* *cough*... Let's withdraw for now and come up with a plan...
I can't believe I let my guard down like that... just after Taihou took a torpedo hit as well...
Damn it...!
...All right, Shoukaku, let's go...!
Princeton, have you wrapped things up on your end?
I appreciate the backup. Thanks to you, we were able to demolish the enemy's attack forces.
Not quite. We were able to focus on the enemy carriers because of the role you played in thinning their airpower. This battle was just the culmination of that hard work.
Thank goodness. I'm glad things worked out this time.
Also, I heard that our subs landed another hit on a different enemy carrier. That the enemy's attack forces haven't returned must be a sign that the enemy's in disorder.
I guess that means we can finally catch our breath for the time being... Well done, everyone~
I wonder if we'll get an order to pursue the enemy fleet...
Perhaps. No matter how many ships they might have left, with our strength, we should be able to overwhelm them with few issues.
However, it seems that the Naval HQ wants to switch to another operation and move us over to a new front.
I wish Saratoga was here to see my performance today...
Why don't you just tell her about it directly next time?
Not just about the battle, but how you were shining brilliantly on the battlefield as you took down dozens of enemy planes! Ehehe.
...Hehe, maybe I'll do just that.
(Though I'm still inexperienced, if I keep striving to learn everything I can from the battlefield, then...)
...Maybe someday, I can be just like her...
It's not a goal you'll be able to reach easily, but I'll be cheering you on.
Enterprise... Yeah! Thanks, I'll do my best!
Yeah, I'll be cheering you on too!
(Hehe, it looks like we both have capable rookies following our footsteps, Saratoga.)
Saratoga... I'll definitely catch up to you someday.
May we fight together in the near future, once again.
A small number of Sakura Empire ships spotted up ahead. I wonder if they're the island's defense fleet.
What should we do, Princeton? Shall we engage?
There are no other ships in the vicinity, and no signs of the Sakura Empire flagship either... Alright, let's go!
Roger. Birmingham, ready for combat.
Alright, let's get to work!
Princeton, you looked really cool out there!
...Hm? Really...?
You landed some great direct hits, and your timing was perfect as well! I was blown away!
That's because... I had a good teacher.
A good teacher...?
Yes. She's another carrier from the Union. Someone I admire - Saratoga.
The way of fighting you were praising was also something I learned from her.
Saratoga's fighting style might be far more stylish than mine... And it might be hard to see her influence if you only saw my performance...
Though she can be a bit mischievous at times, her grasp of the flow of battle is unparalleled. Also...
I've never seen anyone else command their planes as flawlessly as she does...
All of the Eagle Union's twelve carriers are amazing in their own right, but Saratoga is just...
(...How am I supposed to butt in?) A-ahem!
Ah! I'm sorry... I get really excited every time I start talking about Saratoga without even realizing it...
Don't sweat it~ I'm glad I now know how much you respect Saratoga!
To be able to fight alongside someone you admire, and to be able to learn from them... I'm sure that's a great feeling!
I'm so glad you understand!
Princeton... You and Montpelier seem to have some things in common.
We do...?？
Yeah, that really deep admiration of someone. Wait... I'm getting a message from my sister...
...Shoot! It's an enemy air raid! Everyone, prepare for combat!
West of SP Island — Eagle Union's Main Fleet
So, the Sakura Empire's fleet is finally launching its attack...
Just what we were waiting for! Everyone, prepare for combat!
Enterprise, I've already relayed the information to Princeton and co. They said they'd be coming to join up with us once they finish taking care of the enemy's remnants.
Got it. The enemy's air forces shouldn't be as strong as they were before, but... don't let your guard down. We're engaging the enemy, full force!
Ready over here too. Don't let the enemy get close!
I'm not planning on letting any through... But if any do make it past me, I'll leave that to you.
Sure thing! Hehe, let's take care of them in one fell swoop!
I've wrapped things up here as well. We should head back and rejoin the main fleet...
Huh? What's this signal?!
Princeton, what's wrong?
We've been discovered by their planes! Everyone, prepare to intercept them!
No way... Could there be an enemy carrier nearby?
Princeton! Birmingham! They're coming!
Ahahaha... How shall I break you all...?.
The enemy's attack force has retreated. Now leaving combat.
Judging from the scale of that attack... Was it just one ship? Either way...
Judging from that squad's combat power, we're probably not dealing with their main fleet. Maybe their forces are split up right now, or their airpower could just be lower than we expected.
Sakura Empire's main fleet seems to be a separate force heading towards SP Island. I wonder if Cleve and the others are okay...
We have seven carriers as well as a massive convoy here. I'm sure they'll be fine.
Most importantly, Enterprise is there too, so everything in the sky is going to be-
Well, basically, if we can neutralize the enemy's airpower, we'll be able to establish air superiority.
And without air control, the enemy will not be able to stop our advance no matter how many big guns they have...
The side that controls the sky controls the flow of battle.
Yeah. I'm sure the Sakura Empire understands too. That's probably why they're contesting right now.
Reno, Princeton. I've received a message from the others.
Apparently, a friendly submarine has landed a hit on a powerful Sakura Empire carrier.
A friendly submarine... If I recall correctly, I think Albacore and Cavalla were around in these waters.
Hopefully, this will sow some chaos among the enemy fleet.
(Even though the submarine got a good hit on their carrier, I doubt a Sakura Empire carrier would sink just from that. Even Saratoga has taken plenty of hits.)
(But now, the enemy will have to be more vigilant in their lookout for submarines... right?)
(Things don't seem to be going badly at all. Let's hurry and group up with the main fleet.)
Zuikaku, Taihou seems to have been hit by a torpedo.
How'd an Eagle Union submarine find its way here? Shoukaku, tell the destroyers to be on high alert. Let's find out who attacked us!
Indeed. With such a large strike force, we'll have to make proper use of it.
That's right! I'll have to teach them not to underestimate the strength of the Sakura Empire's Air Fleet!
Hehehe, I wonder if it's time to play a requiem with this flute~
West of SP Island - Princeton's Fleet
Birmingham, what were you saying earlier about me and Montpelier?
Oh... I was just making a little remark. Don't worry about it~
That's not what I meant. You know how originally the Independence class was designed to be Cleveland-class ships?
I really wanted to get to know all of you a bit better, like Biloxi and the others... but I never really had the opportunity to do so.
Sisters, huh. I don't know them as well as the Columbia-class girls, but if that's fine, then...
First should be Cleveland. She's always confident and a moodmaker. She's everyone's cool big sis.
No wonder you look up to her.
Next would be Columbia. She's really friendly with Cleve... Maybe it's just her teasing her, though.
And then would be Montpelier and Denver. They both admire Cleve and aim to be like her, but they're working towards that in different ways.
Then, there's...
(Montpelier has Cleveland's back... It's like me with Saratoga...)
(Hehe, I might get along with her.)
We've spotted more squadrons of planes from the Sakura Empire. There are more this time around.
They're not going to let us join up with the main fleet that easily...
No... What if they've made us their primary targets rather than going after our main fleet?
(There's no way they'd half-heartedly send a squad of this size to attack Enterprise and our main fleet... Could this squadron be coming from a different enemy force?)
Do you know what's happening on their side?
"See what someone is thinking, and you can see their future." That's what Saratoga (as a prankster) told me.
In any case, I don't think I'll be able to handle these numbers by myself. I'll have to get some anti-air support.
Contact Enterprise. We'll guide their interceptors to neutralize the enemy air squadrons.
And... we'll hold out until they arrive. Reno, Birmingham. Please cover me!

Leave it to me!
Roger.
There's too many of them... At this rate, we're going to be in trouble!
Everyone, be careful! New, unknown planes are approaching us from over there!
Are they seriously pulling out all the stops to attack us...?
Aren't we lucky? We're getting the VIP treatment today...
That means this is going to be a battle of will and endurance...!
Wait, I'm getting a visual on the unknown planes! They're from the Eagle Union fleet!
Those must be Enterprise's interceptors then!
Phew, you scared us~ ...Oh, Cleveland, you and others are here too!
Sorry we're late. Reno, Birmingham, Princeton, are you all okay?
Enterprise not only sent the interceptor squadron, but also asked me to bring support as well.
That means the enemies were focusing on us after all? Is Enterprise going to be alright?
Hehe, no need for you to worry! We've already taken care of that already!
That's why we've come here to help you out! Okay, let's go and wrap things up!
Roger! Everyone, get in anti-air formation and repel the enemy!

sequence:
Spring Fashion Festa

<size=45>1 Stolen Treasure</size>

scripts.say: Port - Park
Fei Yuen, Fu Po! Caught you! You're it now!
Shh! Pipe down!
Forget about being it! Look over there!
I think I've caught wind of some super-duper secret project!
Wait, for real?!
Hide, quick! It's over if they see you!
Fei Yuen and Fu Po pulled Fu Shun into the bushes and hid. They concentrated on the group of people walking in the distance.
Hmm... All our stuff is over at Chien Wu's place...
Getting them took so much work...
Well, whining about it won't help... Something so precious... Only she has that...
It seems all we can do is wait for the show...
Yeah, let's go back... Still so much to do...
With long faces, they turned around and left the scene.
Ugh... Lady Yuen couldn't hear a word of what they said! Let's get closer!
No! Any closer and they'll see you! Their guard is up!
Fiiine... Did you see how they were sneaking around? That's suspicious! I bet they're hiding something!
They said something about getting stuff, and it was all over at Chien Wu's place...
They must've been talking about some kind of treasure...
Fu Shun adopted a serious expression while she watched the group of girls leave.
Hmm... I get it. That's how it is...
WHOOSH!
Caring little about the dry grass caught in her hair, Fu Shun leaped like a tiger out of the bushes.
The dastardly supervillain Chien Wu must've stolen their treasure!
We've got to defeat her and take all the treasure back!
Really? That sounds like fun!
Err, I mean... Agreed! We must reclaim that which has been stolen!
Right! And they said something about a show...
A show... Maybe they meant the port fashion show that's in two days?
Then time must somehow be a factor in this...
Oh no... Is the stolen treasure going to fully become her property when the fashion show starts?!
If so, there's no time to waste! We've got to take action now!
Hold your horses!
Fu Po slowly stood up and thoughtfully put her hand under her chin.
Ahem... In vain does the archer shoot his arrow before he aims – something-something success, the rest doesn't matter!
Huh?
What? What does archery have to do with anything?
Of course a layman doesn't get it. What I'm saying is: If you want to succeed, you have to think ahead!
That is to say, we must plan out this mission and not just rush in blindly!
Ooh! Lady Yuen agrees!
Hang on! If we're going on a mission, then there's something even more important than the plan itself!
First of all, this mission needs a name!
Hmm. True! Every good mission deserves an epithet.
Then I dub thee...
The Great Adventure Where We Topple Chien Wu and Take Back the Treasure!
Hooray! An adventure!
Yeah! Adventuuure!
Who decided that it's an adventure now? Bah, doesn't matter.
I'm going to hatch a plan now! I'll call you when I'm finished!
Good luck, our mastermind!

sequence:
Spring Fashion Festa

<size=45>2 Phase 1: Sneak and Search</size>

scripts.say: Nighttime - On a wall enclosing the port's fashion show venue
Hngh! Hnngghh!
Come on, you can do it! Just a teeny bit more and you'll be over the wall!
You're shaking like a newborn baby deer!
*pant*... *pant*... I made it over... Oh! Nooooo!
Port - Inside the fashion show venue
The group of adventurers snuck around the corridor, covered from head to toe in dust.
What a rough start... From now on, we'll stick strictly to the plan! Find the treasure before anything else!
I mean, when you think about it, it was all your fault. It was you who couldn't climb the wall and you who fell right on us!
You need to adventure more and build some muscle!
Ugh... I'm a strategist, okay? A strategist! I don't belong in the thick of the battle!
EEEEEEEK!
AAAAAHHHHHH!
What's wrong?!
Lady Yuen doesn't know!
I only screamed because her scream scared me!
S-s-s-something just ran by! I-I saw it myself!
It was pale white! With long hair! And went that way!
Whoa! I saw it! That was a ghost!
R-really? A ghost?
That's what I said! My adventurer's eyes are never wrong!
Lady Yuen saw it, too! Let's chase after it!
H-h-hey, wait! Don't be hasty! And don't leave me behind!
Fu Shun took the lead, with Fei Yuen in the middle and Fu Po bringing up the rear. Their pursuit of the ghost led them onto the runway.
It was dark, and there were sparse human figures standing on the runway.
S-surely those aren't all ghosts, right?
They're just mannequins, silly. Heheh, if you're scared, get behind me and Lady Yuen will protect you!
Hey, I'm not scared...
Shh! Quiet! I just heard something!
There was a tap-tap-tap, like the sound of footsteps...
S-someone's moving?! But the runway is empty... IS there a ghost here after all?!
Well, yeah, duh!
There's got to be not just one ghost, but a whole team of them. Almost like they were put here to guard something...
If so, it's gotta be the treasure!
Yeah! Let's split up and look around!
I-I'll go with Yuen! There will be things that only my keen senses will notice!
The three fumbled through the dark in search of anything at the venue – but they found nothing.
Damn that Chien Wu! Nobody should be this cautious!
Without any clues, I don't think we're going to find anything.
What do we do? Our adventure's going to end in failure at this rate!
I think what we need to do is start over from square one.
Clearly, the treasure is exceptionally well hidden. There are ghosts guarding it, too.
Seeing as my plan isn't going as I'd hoped, the odds that we'll find the treasure tonight are extremely low.
So you mean...
The clouds grow dark – it's time to skedaddle!
Meanwhile, backstage at the fashion show venue...
Guam, did you just do a sound test? Did something go wrong?
Sure did. It played a footsteps sound effect for some reason!
Boy, am I glad I ran that test. It'd be so embarrassing if that happened during the actual show!
Yes, it would be. Also, have you inspected the security camera feeds?
Is every area of the fashion show covered?
I'm checking that right now! Mogador's helping out by making a lap around the whole place.
Right now she's aaat... checkpoint number 28!
Huh? Why does she have a white towel wrapped around her?
Oh, that? Ahaha. Because it's dark in the venue at night, that makes her more visible on the feed.
I see... Wait, what's this? There are people on the runway at checkpoint 2...
Fu Po, Fei Yuen, and Fu Shun? What are they doing here?
Last time I checked, they weren't staff members.
They're probably just on another one of their wacky adventures. Knowing them, I think they're up to some harmless pranks!
Good point... Still, I don't want any accidents to happen. I'll tell Chien Wu about this.

sequence:
Spring Fashion Festa

<size=45>3 Phase 2: Ambush</size>

scripts.say: The following night, the three adventurers snuck into the venue once more, eager for redemption.
12 o'clock... Clear!
Left and right... Clear!
Whew... No ghosts tonight. Thank god.
With Fu Shun and Fei Yuen as her shields, Fu Po marched onward. After carefully surveying her surroundings again, she chose a particular spot.
Hmm... The end of the runway is the best place. We'll put the devices here!
Heheh... Hiding the devices right under the runway – what an ingenious plan.
Even the dastardly Chien Wu won't see this coming.
Yeah! This is gonna be exciting!
After much heavy lifting, the adventurers managed to move their mysterious devices into place.
Fu Shun and Fei Yuen sat on the floor, exhausted from their labor, while Fu Po ascended the runway and gazed down at them.
There's no time to rest!
The mission isn't over! Remember version 2.0 of the Great Adventure Where We Topple– Ugh! You know the rest!
Uhh... First we haul in the devices, then we... What was the next part?
That's the part when our great adventure begins! I think!
WRONG!
Ugh... Fine. I'll explain my brilliant plan to you again!
First, let me introduce these two devices that da Vinci lent to us.
This is the Biggy Blowy Bubble Machine. It blows a huge stream of bubbles, making the floor slippery and impossible to stand on!
Ooh! That's going to stop the evil Chien Wu so she can't chase us, right?
Correct! And this other contraption is the Burny Brighty Firework Launcher! You just press this button to launch every firework at once! It will send Chien Wu's cohorts into a panic.
- Yeah, cohorts like An Shan! - Yup, cohorts like Chang Feng!
Precisely! As long as we can draw their attention away, they'll never catch wind of our plan! Heheh!
So, now we simply have to place the devices as planned and set timers so they activate at just the right moment. Then, when Chien Wu gets up on the runway tomorrow...
Vrrr! Ka-bang! Boom! The fireworks go off and the bubbles spray everywhere at the same time! Then that's slam-bang slam-dunk victory for us!
It's going to get really chaotic, and we'll exploit that commotion to take back the treasure!
We're gonna teach Chien Wu that being evil never pays off!
Yeah! Let's show her what it's like to be stolen from!
That's the spirit! Now come on, set the devices up like in the diagrams!
Okay! ...Wait, Lady Yuen can't make any dang sense of this diagram!
You're holding it upside down... Here. Get it now?
I still can't make heads or tails of it... What's this supposed to be? An octopus?
No, that's ME!
For the love of... I'll just instruct you directly.
After Fu Po painstakingly explained what to do using hand gestures and mimes, Fei Yuen and Fu Shun finally managed to set up the devices according to the diagrams.
There... That's the last one. It's finally over...
Now we– Whuaahhh! I slipped!
Fu Po not only slipped, she ran into the fireworks launcher – and even worse yet, she slammed the button to launch the fireworks.
BANG! CRACKLE! POP! BOOM!
Oh no! H-how do I stop it?!
What happened?! Why's the machine launching fireworks?!
I... I simply wanted to test the Burny Brighty Firework Launcher's capabilities!
Seeing just how powerful it is, I know now that it's absolutely going to shock everyone tomorrow!
Ohh! Good thinking!
Not really! Chien Wu will know something's up because of all this noise!
If she catches us, all our hard work will be for nothing!
Uh, true! I'd better make it stop! Uhh, where is the off button?
Should I just use my flying kick to make it stop?
No! Don't break it! We're borrowing it, remember?!
Lady Yuen thinks pressing the power button will do the trick. Hmm... It should be this red button!
Hey, wait, just because it's red doesn't mean it's–
Fu Po's words fell on deaf ears – Fei Yuen is too adventurous for such warnings. She pressed the red button.
BANG! BOOM! BOOM! KABOOM!
Uh-oh! That just made it launch even more!
Fei Yuen, you numbskull!
Who's there?!
Crap! Someone's here!
They're onto us... Time for plan B!
And what's plan B?
As the Thirty-Six Stratagems say... If all else fails, retreat!

sequence:
Spring Fashion Festa

<size=45>4 Expecting the Unexpected</size>

scripts.say: After finishing all my side-tasks, I went to the fashion show venue to do some final checks with Chien Wu before it kicks off tomorrow.
Then, while looking around the entrance on the outside, I suddenly heard footsteps rushing toward me.
Faster, faster! Please don't tell me anyone's after us!
No, we're clear!
*pant*... *pant*... How are you so fast?! Wait for me!
We're not fast, you're just too slow!
Hang on, isn't that...
Oh! It's the Commander?!
Wait, what?! Look ooout!
Fu Shun and Fei Yuen dodge left and right without effort, but Fu Po is too tired and reacts too late. She's running right toward me.
In the blink of an eye, I extend my arms and catch Fu Po.
Whoa, that was awesome!
Whew... Thanks, Commander!
Instinctively, I get out of danger's way.
Nice dodge, Commander!
Whew... I finally stopped. And nobody got hurt!

options.content: What's going on? Is someone chasing you?

scripts.say: What? Uh, no! Why would there be?
Right as rain!
Uhh... Why are you here, Commander?
To talk to Chien Wu and discuss how the preparations for tomorrow's fashion show are going.
What about you three? Why are you out this late?
Um...
Err...
Well...
The destroyers take a step back, huddle together, and start whispering amongst themselves.
Should we spill the beans?
The Commander's here to see Chien Wu and will appear at the fashion show tomorrow. Under threat from Chien Wu, maybe?
I think Chien Wu may already have brainwashed the Commander!
Everything will be ruined if our plan gets out, so the smartest move is to be quiet about it for now!
Dang it... I'll have to figure out how to break the Commander free from Chien Wu's evil spell!
(I heard every word of that, but I'll keep that to myself...)
After a little while, they gather their thoughts.
Okay, Commander! We were on an adventure in–
No, we weren't! We were racing each other! Uh, probably! Right, Fu Po?
Right, yeah! Racing! Each other!
Uh-huh...
*yaaawn*! Gosh, I'm so tired! Let's go home and go to bed!
See you later, Commander!
Toodles!
Uh-huh...
(Alright then. I'll go talk to Chien Wu.)
A few minutes later, in the venue's waiting room...
Look! The Commander's here!
Good evening, everyone.
Good evening to you.
Good evening, everyone.
How good of you to come. I shall put on some tea. Actually, since it's so late, would you perhaps prefer warm milk instead?
Miss Daisen, I can go warm the milk right now.
No need, really. I know you have work to do, so don't mind me.
Do you know where Chien Wu is? I'm looking for her.
She's over there, doing some final checks. I'll take you to her.
Hai Yung leads me to the design and tailoring area. Not far away, I catch sight of Chien Wu focused on perfecting the final details of a new outfit.
Chien Wu, the Commander's here.
Good evening.
Impeccable timing. Come here and try on this outfit. It's easier to adjust if I see how they fit with my own eyes.
Come again? I thought I was only going to attend as a guest.
That's correct, but even guests need new outfits, don't they?
True, but this is also the first time I've heard of this.
Is this something special you planned in secret?
More or less. There were some twists and turns along the way of making it happen.
Twists and turns?
Uhh, let me explain.
When we first discussed this, opinions were split and we couldn't decide on a final look for the outfit.
In the end, we decided to split into six groups and each make an outfit based on our own ideas.
Wait, will I have to try out six different outfits tomorrow?
No, just one.
Huh? So did you pick out the best one of the bunch?
Nope. All six outfits were rejected.
What? How?
Cleveland's group wanted to make an outfit out of spider silk. They had a hard time procuring it and literally poked a hornets' nest along the way.
New Jersey's group wanted to make theirs out of black cloth that glows like the rainbow. They succeeded with the first bit, but not the second.
Formidable's, Marco Polo's, da Vinci's, and Shimakaze's groups similarly ran into troubles of their own.
Ultimately, not a single group managed to complete an outfit.
Even da Vinci couldn't do it?
No. Unless you'd call a steam-powered suit of armor "an outfit."
Since they failed, Chien Wu went back to the initial plan and made a better outfit using the materials the others gathered.
That can't have been easy. Good job, Chien Wu.
Don't mention it. I did it because I personally enjoyed it.
(Those were some twists and turns, alright... They all had their own adventure along the way.)
(...Wait, why did I suddenly think of the word "adventure"?)
(Oh, right...)
On another subject, I ran into Fu Po and her friends outside the venue just earlier. Are they part of your staff?
Ah, them. Heehee.
Rest assured, we know everything that they're up to.
Mostly, they just make a racket. Sometimes, though, they come up with some clever ideas.
Clever ideas?
For instance, they left some interesting machines under the runway. Da Vinci is already on the way to check them out.
Heh... They have no idea that da Vinci is on our side and that we've been watching them ever since they borrowed her inventions.
Whatever their plan is, I guarantee you they won't cause any trouble.
Since you have them under control, I have nothing to worry about.
Indeed. Was there anything else?
If you don't have any more questions, I'd like you to try this outfit on.
You want me to get changed right now?
Yes, there's still time to adjust the details if it doesn't fit you well.
The changing room is over here. It's a bit tricky to put on, so I'll help you out.

sequence:
Spring Fashion Festa

<size=45>5 Phase 3: Curtain Call</size>

scripts.say: Day of the port fashion show - Venue
In a dark corner that the spotlights could not reach, three shadowy figures were skulking about the audience seats.
Phew! We just made it in time!
I blame Fu Po for slowing us down! Chang Feng nearly found us!
Look, I had to check on the devices! We would have been in way more trouble if they caught us during last night's commotion!
Nobody's found them yet. Everything is working as it should...
Shh! Be quiet or people will hear you!
Fu Po covered her mouth with her own hands and nodded apologetically.
At that same moment, the runway lit up brightly with blinking neon lights, drawing the whole audience's attention.
Then, one by one, the models started to walk out.
Hellooo! New Jersey is in the house!
Pretty lively here. Not bad.
Good evening, dear audience! Let us together weave a wonderful poem tonight!
*sniffle*... All their outfits are so pretty... I'll have to ask Chien Wu how to make Empery-style clothing later...
Pretty clothes... Anchorage likes them!
Whoooa! Lady Yuen wants to wear something like that too!
Focus, Yuen! Now is not the time for that!
Our priority right now is to rescue the Commander and take back all the stolen treasure!
Now that you mention it, where IS the Commander? Not in the audience, that's for sure...
Fu Shun made a confuddled look, and at the same time, the lights in the venue went out and fancy music began playing through the speakers.
Now it's time for the most electrifying moment of the night! Let's welcome the Commander and Chien Wu to showcase the most premium and beautiful work!
What?! The Commander's going on stage with the treasure?!
Then that means... the Commander's also gonna get freaked out by the fireworks and bubbles!
Damn you, Chien Wu! How dare you use the Commander as a shield!
Grr... This is leaps and bounds more difficult than extracting the Commander from the audience!
Our only option now is to enact plan C!
What's plan C?
Splitting up! I'll whip up a distraction and lead the Commander to safety! You two take care of the treasure!
Roger!
Now it's time for the most electrifying moment of the night! Let's welcome the Commander and Chien Wu to showcase the most premium and beautiful work!
In time with Guam's announcement, the platform under my feet ascends to the runway, bringing me into the spotlight.
Just as I'm about to start speaking, a little girl bursts onto the stage out of nowhere.
Quick, Commander! Come with me!
She looks tense. I answer her with an appropriately serious look.
Why? What is it?
No time to explain! Chien Wu stole everyone's most precious treasure! She's also trying to use you to protect herself!
Fu Shun! Fei Yuen! Hurry and find the treasure!
- The Queen of Adventure is on the scene! - Don't forget about Lady Yuen!
Two more figures jump onto the stage. Everything looks to be going according to Fu Po's plan.
Fu Shuuun! I will not stand by while you stir up trouble again!
Crap, it's An Shan! Girls, please write good things about me in my obituary...
Fu Po, Fei Yuen, might I ask what you're trying to do?
Uh-oh! Chang Feng! I haven't done anything wrong! Commander, help meee!
Well, this is also exactly as Chien Wu and the others predicted.
Listen, Chang Feng! We were only trying to reclaim the treasure that this supervillain stole!
Come again? Treasure? Supervillain?
I look over at Chien Wu. She cracks a mysteriously knowing smile and nods.
There she is! The supervillain!
She's finally shown herself!
Wow... You've sure spun up some story in your heads.
Just let me explain what's actually going on.
Hai Yung explains to the three little adventurers what she told me yesterday.
Wait, what? Chien Wu was just making clothes?
And the Commander's outfit was the treasure?
Yup. That outfit is the crystallization of our hard work. Well, I say "our," but Chien Wu did most of it.
How in the world did you three even jump to that conclusion?
We're so sorry...
Well, talk about a big misunderstanding, huh? Haha...
W-wait... It's happening!
What is?
KABOOOM!
PEW! BOOM! BOOM! KABOOM! BANG!
Da Vinci's Biggy Blowy Bubble Machine and Burny Brighty Firework Launcher both power up at the same time.
Look out, Comma– Huh?
What's going on?
How'd the firework launcher end up in the corner over there?
And why is the bubble machine blowing so few bubbles? It's not making the runway slippery in the least...
Because I reconfigured them last night, of course!
If you're going to use them on the runway, safety comes first!
No... Don't tell me... you knew about our plan?
Yeah? Obviously.
Our grand plan... All for nothing!
While it failed to disrupt the show, it succeeded in creating some fancy stage effects.
Brilliant fireworks blossom in the air while the bubbles glisten like pearls. It's like a scene out of a dream.
Coupled with the Empery-style attire the models are wearing, the stage takes on a fantastical feel.
Wooow... So our adventure wasn't a total flop then, right?
Yeah, I guess?
The Great Adventure Where We Topple Chien... I mean, Where We Celebrate the Port Fashion Show – was a huge success!
You're not off the hook just because you changed the name, young lady.
Ahahaha...
Fu Po, Fei Yuen, we're going to have a long talk later.
No! This is all a big misunderstanding! You have to believe me!
Lady Yuen had no idea what we were doing! Honest!
Commander! Girls! Look this way and say "cheese"!
SNAP!
And so, the fashion show comes to a wrap amidst joyous laughter.

sequence: Spring Fashion Festa - The End

scripts.say: I'll plan things through next time, I swear...
Actually, no...
No more plans! I'm never doing this ever again!

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 1  A Gift from a Flower</size>

scripts.say: One day at the Office...
Just as I catch the fragrant scent of flowers, Hanazuki's delicate figure suddenly appears in my vision.
Good day, Commander. The afternoon sunlight is quite warm and pleasant, isn't it?
I've brought you a present. Please consider it a token of my appreciation for your continued support and guidance. Heehee~
Hanazuki places a small pot of moon-white jasmine flowers on my desk.
Its fragrance is light and rustic, and I thought it'd be perfect for you during your long hours of work in front of a desk.
You're welcome. Please try to remember to water it even if you're busy, and take good care of it.
Oh, umm... Next time, I'll bring some flowers to decorate the windowsill, okay?
Which would you prefer, some purple moth orchids, or red and yellow moss roses?

options.content: "I think I'll go with the moss roses."

scripts.say: Purple moth orchids resting on a pristine, white windowsill...
When the wind blows, it'll look as if butterflies are dancing in the breeze. Quite a lovely sight.
That's a good idea... Moss roses prefer a sunny, open area.
Their bright colors are sure to liven up your office.
Recently, Hanazuki has been decorating my office with all sorts of different flowers.
I can see her spirits soar day by day as she goes about her arrangements.
Spring has arrived, and new flowers are blooming every single day.
Even if you're feeling down in the dumps, the sight of new life blossoming forth will surely uplift you.
"I'm always impressed by how knowledgeable you are about all these flowers. But where are you getting all of them from? Akashi's?"
No, I actually grow most of them myself.
There's a sunny vacant lot behind the Sakura Dorms, and I set up a small garden room back there.
"That must be a spectacular sight once all the flowers are in full bloom."
Yes, it's my perfect little sanctuary.
If you'd like to see it, why don't you drop by over the weekend?
(That'll give me plenty of time to prepare a wonderful reception for you...)
And so, Hanazuki and I plan to go flower-viewing in her garden room over the weekend. What kind of wonderful sceneries await me?

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 2 Embraced by Flowers </size>

scripts.say: On the day of the flower viewing...
As soon as I turn the corner, I can already smell the incredible fragrance from the garden room sitting amidst flowers.
Hanazuki is already there watering the plants, but her brow is wrinkled as if she is worried about something.
Should I put jasmine here, or lilac? Ugh, I just can't decide...
If I go with jasmine, I'd be able to use that as a segway to offer Commander some tea during the tour...
But, the scent of lilac provides just the right atmosphere for flower-viewing that it would be a shame to go without it...
I hope I'm not putting too much emphasis in the aroma aspect of the flower-viewing experience... But if I were to leave out the jasmine flowers, that would also reduce the variety...
Urgh, I just can't make up my mind... Maybe I should just take apart this entire arrangement... B-but then we'd be left with only roses, and that would be...
*gasp*! C-Commander, when did you get here?!
Oh, um, in any case, I'm glad you could make it! Please have a seat over here while I go make tea for you!
"Were you just watering the jasmines?"
Jasmines? Oh my... Did you overhear me talking to myself too?
To be honest, I still can't make up my mind... Which of the two do you prefer, Commander?
As much as I'd like to say "I trust your judgment," a response like that is only going to deepen her worries.
"Hanazuki, I think you should display..."
I'm also quite fond of jasmine flowers myself. They have a simple yet refreshing fragrance. But, it'd be a pity to leave out the enchanting scent of the lilacs.
They have a wonderful fragrance and are beautiful to look at, but I'm afraid they might be too flashy to place right at the entrance...
R-roses?! Ah, um, I was just talking to myself! P-please pretend you didn't hear that!
Jeez, Commander, don't tease me like that...
"Since you're having so much trouble deciding, why don't we plant them together?"
Plant them together? I thought we were going to go flower-viewing today...
"There's always next time. Besides, I get the feeling I'll be spending more and more time here. I want to see those flowers grow up nice and healthy."
Y-you'll keep coming back here?! I'm so glad that you, um... are interested in growing flowers as well!
In that case, please give me a minute. I'll go fetch the seeds.

options.content: "I'm not going anywhere, Hanazuki. You don't need to run."
"Umm... Do you need any help with the tea?"

scripts.say: Okay, I'll be right back! Just wait for me right over there!
Oh... Huh? (Oh no, which one am I supposed to get first, the seeds or the tea?) G-give me just a moment, I'll bring the tea out to you first!

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 3 Secretly Sprouting Sentiments</size>

scripts.say: One sunny afternoon...
As I make my way to the garden room once more, I am greeted again by the sight of the same flowers, droplets of falling water splitting the sunlight into a beautiful rainbow.
Tickweed, rosa chinensis, cape dandelion, fairy primrose. As I spent more time with Hanazuki, I came to know the names of more and more flowers.
However, the one thing prominently missing today is... Hanazuki herself. She still doesn't seem to be here yet.
Zzz... zzz...
I hear some soft sounds coming from the back of the garden room, so I head inside to see what's going on.
I feel a sense of relief as I see her peacefully sleeping face. This is a perfect opportunity to...

options.content: Tidy up around the garden room.

scripts.say: After that, as I bend over to pick up a gardening trowel and a watering can that had been left on the ground, I can hear a faint mumbling come from behind me.
Ehehe... Commander... in the language of flowers, this one means... zzz...
Mmgh... I can't tell you after all... Zzz...
She's talking in her sleep, huh... But, I wonder what she means by "the language of flowers."
*Yaawn*... The afternoon sunlight felt so nice that it put me to sleep...
Huh?! C-Commander? When did you get here?

options.content: "When a certain someone was peacefully napping away."

scripts.say: Ahh... No way, I hope I wasn't drooling in my sleep...
"Don't worry. You looked as serene and happy as could be."
Oh... Is that so... I guess that's fine then...
I couldn't help but think to myself... Her sleeping figure felt like it blended right in with all the other lovely flowers here.
Um, Commander, please don't make fun of me for this...
Also, I didn't say anything weird when I was napping, did I...?

options.content: "You mentioned something about the language of flowers."

scripts.say: Phew... Thank goodness...
Huh? Did I really? Um, can you just pretend like you didn't hear anything?
Ugh... I thought I'd get a chance to spend some time chatting with you, but I ended up falling asleep and losing half the afternoon... What a shame...
Commander, um, I feel really bad about this... But could you at least bring this back to your office?
Even if I can't be your secretary ship right now, I hope these flowers will remind you of me every time you see them... Ehehe...
Hanazuki hands me another pot filled with yellow and white daisies. A faint fragrance wafts from the flowers.
Commander... Will you come see me again?

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 4 A Maiden's True Feelings</size>

scripts.say: Now that I think about it, I originally planned to keep visiting the garden room because I was curious about how the flowers I planted were faring.
I find myself heading back once more, both for that purpose and to uphold the promise I made with Hanazuki last time.
As the gentle fragrance of flowers once again caresses my cheeks, I can hear Hanazuki's softly-singing voice in my ears.
Flowers, o flowers~ How the world changes~
In the three days since we last met~
Oh, Commander! Are you here to see how the flowers are growing?
We're all glad to see you again. Not only me, but all the flowers as well!
There are a lot more flowers here now than the last time you were here. Want to go take a look?
Oh my... *blushes*
Umm... Thank you very much for your concern...
I go on a stroll with Hanazuki through the sea of flowers, surrounded by warm sunlight and a fragrant breeze.
Commander, the jasmine and lilacs you planted are growing well.
Hanazuki points to a number of lush, green plants. Of course, it's still too early for flowers to bloom.
Thanks to you, these children were born into this world...
Even though flowers are different from us in many ways, they can also be quite similar to us.
Some grow up and bloom in the blink of an eye, whereas others look plain but actually have incredible potential to shine.
When the right time comes, each and every one will blossom beautifully.

options.content: "You weren't just talking about flowers, right?"

scripts.say: Heehee. You get what I'm trying to say, right?
Heehee. I'll leave that to your imagination, Commander.
By the way, would you like something to drink? I have some floral tea for you today. It's great for helping you unwind and relax.
...Oh, umm, but before that...
Hanazuki holds out a single beautiful tickseed sunflower. Its petals, illuminated beneath the sun's rays, seem to shine even brighter than usual.
Come to think about it, she mentioned something about the "language of flowers" the other day.
I looked into it a bit, and this one in particular should mean...

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 5 I'm Glad I Met You</size>

scripts.say: Commander, thanks for helping me out today. With this, we've managed to replant all the roses...
I'm not exaggerating when I say you have quite the knack for gardening.
Before I knew it, my visits to Hanazuki's garden room had become a habitual occurrence. I started passing by whenever I had nothing to do.
I completely lost track of time today after I started working, and the sky has already started to darken.
Just as I prepare to wrap up my work for the day, droplets of rain start to appear on the ground around me.
C-Commander, come inside! It's starting to rain!
You might catch a cold if your clothes get soaked, so let's stay inside until the rain stops!
Despite her words, there isn't a hint of panic or worry in her voice. Instead, Hanazuki sounds somewhat... relieved.
The two of us sit shoulder-to-shoulder beneath the eaves, sipping warm tea while listening to the almost-musical pattering of raindrops.
I really like the scent of the earth that wafts up after it rains...
Oh, um... Sorry for being the only one talking... Would you like me to make you some floral tea?

options.content: What were we drinking just now then?

scripts.say: When I look over at the clear teapot sitting on the table, there seems to be more than enough to spare her the trouble of brewing a new batch...
I'm not sure if Hanazuki is trying to tell me something, but I can understand if she wants to change the mood a bit.
A short while later, Hanazuki returns with a new teapot in her hands.
Thank you for your patience... Wait, umm... Commander, what's that teapot next to you...
...Oh no! I'm so sorry, Commander. I got myself all confused...
Huh? Oh, um... W-well, that one's lukewarm by now, so let me make a new batch for you!
A short while later, Hanazuki returns with a new teapot in her hands.
We continue to make some small talk while waiting for the rain to pass.
After finishing the last bit of tea, I go to set my teacup down on the tray when I suddenly feel a warmth against the back of my hand.
Ah, s-sorry! I was just about to put away your teacup...
Her cheeks flare up brightly but she seems frozen in place, unable to move her hand.
(Lets out a deep breath.)
Hanazuki is also trying to act like nothing happened, but her cheeks are dyed a bright, rosy red.
Um, Commander, I...
The moment she turns towards me, the sun's rays once again spread out around us as if finally breaking through the rainclouds.
The rain... seems to have stopped...
She suddenly changes the topic, as if trying her hardest to conceal her nervousness.
I, I'm really sorry... I don't think I can say it after all...
...Um, but, before I get, could you at least take this? I think it'd make a wonderful decoration for your bookshelf back at the office!
All of a sudden, Hanazuki takes out a wreath of red geranium and hands it to me.
Red geranium – "I'm glad I met you."
Thank you for spending the day with me, Commander... If you don't mind, would you come see me again?

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 6 Two Footsteps, Approaching Happiness</size>

scripts.say: Time would always fly by whenever we spent the day together at the garden room.
Sometimes colorful, sometimes lively. Sometimes gloomy, sometimes extravagant. The scenery was never the same on any two visits.
Looking back to the days of enjoying the flowers that bloomed across the four seasons, those times seemed to both last forever, yet also pass in the blink of an eye.
Primrose, winter plum, or Christmas roses... Commander, which do you think would serve as the best base for a bouquet to give to your friends?
Ugh... Another party is coming up soon, but I'm having trouble deciding once again...
Um, Commander? Are you alright? You seem to be pretty out of it today...
"Oh, sorry. I was just thinking about all the time I've spent with you."
Mm. Yeah, I think about that too. I cherish every moment I spend with you, Commander, but it feels like it goes by way too quickly...
But because it feels like that, I'm always reminded... that I have to live in the present, and appreciate each and every moment that much more.
In any case... I think a white rose would make a great base. It's gorgeous and symbolizes good fortune, but... Hmm, maybe the color is a bit too light...
Adding some winter plum flowers should really liven up the colors, but I still need to give some extra consideration to the aroma...
The primrose should balance the color and fragrance out nicely, but then the question is, which flower will end up taking center stage in the display...
I can't decide after all... Commander, please come help me!
Thank you, Commander! Let's go with your suggestion then.
Wow, that really came out great! I'm really impressed by how knowledgeable you've become about flowers!
Oh, look how late it is. Let's get dressed and head to the party.
And before we go, don't forget about this!
Hanazuki holds up a bouquet of red moth orchids.
This is a special bouquet I prepared just for you, Commander! Heehee~ You're the only person I'm doing this for!
I put quite a lot of time putting it together, so I hope you enjoy it!
That's right! They're the ones we planted in the garden room. I'm glad you even remember what they look like.
C-Commander... Ehehe...
Umm... Actually, I have one more request...
Would you stay after the party to watch the fireworks with me? There's something I want to tell you then...

sequence:
The Language of the Flowers

<size=45>Chapter 7 Flowers of Happiness, Blossoming in the Sky</size>

scripts.say: At the party, Hanazuki's bouquet receives rich praise from everyone who sees it.
Wow, it's so beautiful! Thank you very much!
What a pure fragrance... It reminds me of throwing open the windows on the first day of spring.
Heehee, I'm glad you two like it! Actually, Commander helped me pick out there right flowers to use, since I couldn't decide myself...
Phew... I guess we're all done over here... I'm so glad everyone liked my present.
Oh, it's almost time for the fireworks... Um, Commander, this way please!
The fireworks streak radiantly, blending into the night sky before erupting into twinkling stars on a pitch-dark canvas.
The fireworks... look just like beautiful flowers blossoming in the sky...
"That they do... But they don't smell anywhere as nice."
Haha, I guess that's true. If you try to smell them, you'd just catch a big whiff of gunpowder~
But still, they warm the hearts of everyone who sees them, just like real flowers.
...And, umm, they're even more amazing when I'm with you...
Um, Commander...

options.content: (Wait for Hanazuki to finish her thought.)
"I want to be with you forever, Hanazuki."

scripts.say: Beneath the luminescence of the fireworks, I can see her lovely, faintly-blushing face.
Would you, umm... go flower-viewing with me again?
Not just tomorrow, but next week, next year... Forever and ever...
Would you stay by my side, always, just like you are right now?
It feels as if I've been waiting for her to ask me this for a long, long time. And, I've had my answer decided for a long, long time.
Ehehe... Thank you so much, Commander!
Look over there! They're about to launch even more fireworks!
Wait, um... Does that mean, from now on, the two of us are...? Oh my...
For a few moments, Hanazuki seems unable to process the situation. But soon, she blushes hard, like a teapot about to boil over.
Commander, um... I've been waiting to say this for a long, long time––
I wanted to be the first one to say those words, but it seems that you beat me to it...
B-but more importantly, I also want to let you know how I really feel...
Commander, thank you so much... I'm so glad you want to stay by my side forever! I've never been happier!
With the beautiful fireworks blossoming behind us, Hanazuki presses a single flower into my hands.
Please accept this flower... In the language of flowers, it means...
I smile at her softly. Yes, after all the time I spent with her, I already know what it means––
"May our happiness last forever."

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>1 The First Sabbatical</size>
