scripts.say: With the reformation of the Azur Lane, the world had stepped into a new era. Along with it, the heavy veil that had long been draped over the hearts of humanity was finally beginning to be lifted.
Originally, I was planning on returning to PH Harbor for another round of fleet training.
But, Lexington had something else in mind for me.
Due to pressures from a number of different sources, I had to revise my future plans.
What began as a quick trip to PH Harbor had turned into a bit of a sabbatical.

sequence: Azur Lane Territory
Somewhere in the Pacific Ocean...

scripts.say: Clear skies, a deep blue sea, and a pristine white beach that seemed to stretch out forever in front of me.
This is the first time I've been on one of the higher-ups' islands for non-military reasons.
Actually, the renovation work here only began recently.
With the situation around the globe calming down, I suppose it wouldn't make sense to remain under a wartime system indefinitely.
One can only get stretched so thin before breaking, right?
Right. Which is why I agreed to come here for a three to four day vacation.
...Three to four days?
Err, not days. I meant, three to four weeks!
Heehee. Just what I was thinking.
Hey folks! Just finished inspecting the villa. You're good to move on in!
I brought all the keys, but, umm... which one... is the key to the office?
Shall I hold onto them for you?
Thank you very much!
...Office keys?
Teehee~♪
By the way, Memphis, have you taken care of our supplies?
You bet. I've got everything handled.
The cargo plane arrived before we did. It'll be bringing a steady stream of supplies to the island on a daily basis.
Excellent, I knew I could count on you.
Now then, Commander, shall we go take a look at the villa?
Sure. Let's go.
And so, my long-awaited sabbatical – a real vacation, had finally begun.
Nothing to worry about. Just soaking in the good vibes, and basking in the beautiful scenery—

sequence: "And so, the first day of my sabbatical came to an end."
"Today's key word is—"

scripts.say: —"Chill".

sequence: "And, that's the second day checked off."
"Today's key word is—"

scripts.say: —"Seaspray".

sequence: "That's all for the third day."
"Today's key word is—"

scripts.say: —"Party".

sequence: The fourth day...

scripts.say: When I opened my eyes amidst a dream, a bright, sunny academy unfolded before me.
...I guess nothing surprises me anymore.
As expected, things never go that smoothly.
If I'm working in my dreams, can it really be said that I'm on vacation?
Hmm, there's probably a philosophical discussion to be had in that.

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>2 Hidden in Plain Sight</size>

scripts.say: (I'm on vacation while I'm awake, but it's back to work again in my sleep...)
(Guess I just have to deal with the reality of things...)
I swallowed the conflicting feelings in my chest and started exploring the academy grounds.
This place seemed completely cut off from the passage of time. The school grounds were always bright, as if in an eternal spring.
(What is this place? ...And why do I keep getting whisked over here?)
(First, it was Madam M. Then, Lady E.)
(There were a few unrelated "trips" as well, though I don't know which category this visit falls under...)
Oh my. Long time no see.
Next to Lady E was a girl in white who looked just like Zero.
The two had materialized right next to me without my notice.
Doesn't feel like it's been that long. Didn't we just meet at test site theta?
Mm... Well, let's not worry about that right now.
I came to see the principal today. We were hoping to stop a dangerous chemistry experiment, but haven't been able to get in touch with the person in charge, Lady H.
I was hoping the principal could help me find her. But since you're here, would you like to accompany me to the principal's office?
The principal's office, huh...
Until now, all the buildings except the entrance to the classrooms had been locked.
But, Lady E spoke of going to the principal's office. Has her level of access increased?
I suppose I...
Just as I was about to accept the invitation, my attention was drawn to the girl in white.
She only shook her head briefly before burying her face into her stuffed doll.
...On second thought, maybe next time. I'm on sabbatical, so I'm supposed to be enjoying my vacation.
Hm, how unusual. Maybe I asked at a bad time.
That's fine, though. Do enjoy your vacation~
A white light flooded my vision. A vision that I was being whisked away from the academy, back to my own dreams.
Just before my consciousness faded, I realized something—
Come to think of it, the girl at the academy seemed a bit different from Zero. Could there be two of them?
I mean, she wasn't identical to Zero to begin with, but there was definitely something Zero-like about her...
Though, that description already fits someone else as well...
From TB to Zero...
From Zero to Observer Zero...
TB and Zero look almost identical... and Zero was the prototype of Observer Zero...
This whole time... have I been overlooking the connection between TB and Observer Zero?

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>3 Within the Fog</size>

scripts.say: Early in the morning, I summoned Lexington and the others for an emergency meeting.
What's up, Commander? Did something happen?
The others who I had gotten in touch with – including Memphis and Helena – entered the room one after another.
I'll get started once everyone is here. For now, just find somewhere to sit.
Those inside the Sea of Stars – TB, Saratoga, Enterprise, and New Jersey – connected in remotely as well.
Can you hear me, TB?
Present and accounted for. Your orders, Commander?
Just hold that pose for a moment. Everyone, I'd like you all to take a close look at TB. Does she remind you of someone?
...Does she remind me of someone?
For example, a certain Observer Zero?
A moment of silence falls over the conference room.
Commander, the Naval HQ has never been able to acquire video footage of Observer Zero. Even if you say that, there's no way we could...
No video footage? Now that I think of it... has "Zero" ever shown herself to anyone in person?
All my past interactions with her were either through projections, or illusions...
Lexington, among the memories you've regained, do any of them pertain to Zero?
Negative. There are no records of Zero anywhere between NY City and Anchorage... What's gotten into you all of a sudden, Commander?
Sorry, guess I got ahead of myself. How about you, Enterprise?
When you saw Enterprise META previously, did you see any flashbacks related to her memories?
Right. There was one episode where she was angry at this Zero.
But, strangely... I have no recollection of what Zero looks like.
Even when I try to recall her appearance, I can't even begin piecing her face together, as if her entire being is shrouded in fog.
Completely blurry, huh? Then, how about you, New Jersey? When you were caught up in the recorded space previously, did you cross paths with Zero?
Sorry, I got nothing for ya...
In other words, nobody in this room has seen Zero in any form other than myself and Enterprise?
And Enterprise can't remember any details either...
Moreover, had I not brought it up, you probably wouldn't recall having that memory at all, right?
Indeed. I wouldn't have had a reason to even think about it if you didn't say something...
At least I understand the situation now.
There's likely some sort of interference going on.
Zero does not remain in your memory, even if you manage to see her in some form. What else could that be but interference?
Even for someone like me, who does know what Zero looks like, I was never consciously able to connect her appearance's similarity to TB.
Alright. Let's wrap things up for today.
Sorry for dragging you all into this unproductive meeting. This just happened to pique my curiosity, so it's something I would like to look into.
(Everyone in the Compiling Field, including the other Observers and the Ashes remaining in the NA Ocean, must have seen Zero.)
(There has to be a lead out there somewhere...)
All I can say is, finally noticing the link between TB and Zero lit an unquenchable fire within me to seek the truth.
Lexington was looking at me with concerned eyes. The others slowly began to filter out of the room.
Once I was the only person left in the room, I reached out to "Yorktown" using the method we had agreed on beforehand.
The world around me changed in an instant.
After the lights went out, a starry sky unfolded all around me.
You came, Commander. Glad to see the new comms working smoothly.
The first person who showed up after establishing the link was not Yorktown, but rather the other Memphis.
Hey there, Memphis. How've things been on your end?
Hrmm... So-so, I guess?
Since the subauthorization that Helena gave me previously is still working, I can continue carrying out normal missions via the Tower.
As for the parts that aren't working anymore, we're teaming up to come up with a solution.
Err, but scratch that for now... Yorktown's currently busy with an observation experiment and can't talk right now.
You must be here for a reason though. Is it anything I can help you with?
There's something I'd like you to help me confirm, Memphis. Could you gather all the members of the Compiling Field and the reconstituted experimentation division?
...This seems like a fairly important "something".
It's a simple question. Do you think Observer Zero and TB... look alike?

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>4 Premonition</size>

scripts.say: The results were as expected. Be it Memphis, Vestal, Observer, or Compiler...
Even though all of them had reconstructed Observer Zero's appearance in a simulation space...
None of them could see the resemblance between TB and Observer Zero.
In a sense, this outcome is the most logical thing in the world. If the connection was so obvious, someone would have said something the moment they saw Navigator TB.
And yet, neither the members of the Compiling Field nor the experimentation division suspected anything.
(...This has to be some cosmic-level cognitive interference.)
(The Sea of Stars was created under the guidance of the other Helena. Does that also mean that she had a hand both in Zero's simulation and in TB's creation?)
(If anyone knows anything, it has to be her...)
(I guess I'm on my own for this one...)
(In any case, the question I should be focusing on shouldn't be why nobody can see the connection between the two.)
(What's more important is... why did I suddenly become aware of it?)
(What exactly happened? What exactly changed?)
While lost in thought, I suddenly realized that the landscape around me had changed into a vast, expansive sky and a sea of flowers.
At the same time, Yorktown was also there in front of me, as if she had been there this entire time.
...It's good to see you again, Commander.
This time, she seemed to be shrouded in a hazy, dream-like aura.
It's hard to describe the feeling. It's almost as if she only exists within my field of view, from my perspective only.
I just spoke with Memphis and the others. I heard you were busy with some work?
Yes, but I can certainly set aside some time now that you're here.
Though, your timing couldn't be better. I actually wanted to ask for your help.
Huh?
Actually, it's about Marco Polo...
Commander, you're the only one with a connection to the Hierophant, right? As such, you are the only person who can handle this matter.
Another issue with Marco Polo, huh? Let's see it.
Please come with me, Commander.
Yorktown guided me through an ever-changing space, and we finally arrived at what appeared to be a quarantined-off area.
Right in front of me, two completely different worlds coexisted, separated only by a thin, transparent barrier.
What is this?
I looked over at the gray space beyond the barrier.
As you can see...
This was once an ordinary resting area, with no quarantine barrier.
But last night, Marco Polo suddenly started warping the space around her, and we had no choice but to seal her off.
I continued listening to Yorktown's words while carefully observing the space beyond the barrier.
On the other sided of the barrier, both sky and earth seemed to be shrouded in a faded gray.
But even within this sombre space, various shades and hues existed, with some areas even appearing pure-white.
And floating within the source of that pure white was Marco Polo herself.
Commander, this space itself is harmless, so you need not be alarmed.
However, thing you must be wary of is that "voice". Can you hear it?
Yorktown seemed to tinker with the specifications of the barrier – and suddenly, I could hear the faint sound of singing.
That voice... Oh, I can hear some words.
I continued to listen intently, mouthing the words that echo in unison.

sequence: "The netherworld comes, heralding the end."
"The fat of the land shall turn fallow."
"The sturdiest walls shall crumble to dust."
"Together we walk through the lightless morn."
"Together we walk beneath the grave chill."

scripts.say: "AOL ULAOLYDVYSK JVTLZ OLYHSKPUN AOL LUK"
...So you can understand the choir after all.
Given the Hierophant's personality, this might be her way of conveying an omen of some sorts to you.
A land turning fallow, walls crumbling down, a lightless morn, and a grave chill... the netherworld comes.
What exactly is this "netherworld"?
...It's my first time hearing of it. Give me some time to look into it.
I'll also pass the message onto Elizabeth META. In the meantime, please keep those four key phrases in mind.
Let me know if you find anything. If this is an omen of sorts, there might be another clue waiting for us.
I'll begin investigating right away.
Thanks, Yorktown. I'll be in touch.
Indeed. I look forward to meeting with you again, Commander.
The light vanishes, and soon I find myself back in the villa's conference room.
Alright. Now to contact the relevant people and see if I can find any clues... Hmm?
Right at that moment, it suddenly struck me.
I finally got to meet with the other Yorktown again... but I completely forgot to ask her...

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>5 White Marble</size>

scripts.say: I spent some time compiling the information I had, as well as my interpretation on what it could mean, and drafted a letter to the higher-ups. Then, I made a separate copy addresed to the other Elizabeth.
But before I could finalize everything, an invitation for an online meeting popped up in front of me.
Organized by... Clemenceau? With Bismarck and Soyuz in attendance?
I had no reason to decline the invitation, so I decided to hop into the meeting.
I've received your report, Commander. You're looking into clues that could give insight into a certain omen?
That's right. Do you have any idea what it might be about?
The three other participants exchange some quick words with one another, but it is ultimately Clemeanceau who takes charge of the response.
...Two anomalies were detected during an exploration of a polar bunker a day prior.
The first: Gneisenau META witnessed a vision pertaining to the fate of the Arctic.
What she saw seems to match up with the "fallow land" and "crumbled walls" that you described.
The second: Kirov META witnessed a similar vision beneath the ice of the Antarctic.
She claims to have seen desolate ruins, matching the descriptions of the "lightless morning" and "grave chill" you described.
These visions did not last long, but their occurrences were almost simultaneously.
Strange events simultaneously occurring at opposite sides of the planet, lining up with what I saw in the omen...
(Could moving forward with the Polar Bunker project actually pose some sort of danger?)
In the "brighter world" envisioned by the Tower, all the Polar Bunker projects were successful.
Everything was made possible in that world due to the elimination of all external interferences.
(But what if there IS external interference during the project?)
(Might this be what the Hierophant's omen is about?)
I chewed on these questions for a bit longer, then made up my mind.
Let's put the Polar Bunker project on hold until we've identified and eliminated these potential dangers.
We are in agreement, Comrade Commander.
We all settled on the same conclusion without much fanfare.
As for those visions you mentioned earlier, are you able to map them to any real-world locations?
We've already managed to find a castle that fits the descriptions.
The Tribunal recently upgraded the Black Sun device, the conceptual symbol of the Tribunal itself, and used that to recreate the visions Gneisenau saw in her memories.
We were able to match the location with a castle near the city of Regensburg, in Iron Blood territory.
Near Regensburg, huh... What about the ruins that Kirov META saw in her vision?
About that...
Comrade Commander, that Kirov is gone.
She only had this to say: "Heading out for personal reasons. I'll be back when things are settled."
We do not know when or how she left, or where she went.
If I had to guess, it's likely related to the vision she saw.
But, the fact remains that we won't be able to use the Black Sun device if Kirov isn't here.
(Did Kirov decide to travel to another world line because of her vision?)
(Does that mean the omen is unrelated to test site beta? Or rather, does it concern more world lines than just our own?)
(If that is true, this might be much more than just an omen. It might point to Hierophant preparing to make her own move...)
(Each of the Arbiters presides over their own test site. The Hierophant should be no different in this regard.)
(Previously, in test site theta, the Star was preparing to conduct a transboundary experiment...)
(What exactly is the Hierophant up to?)
Let's set that aside for now. Did you manage to uncover anything else while investigating this castle?
We're still conducting additional investigations but have not found anything else so far. Naturally, I plan to contact you should that change.
Hold on, were you waiting until I came back from vacation?
Since the Hierophant is involved in this matter, I might be the only one who can follow up with some of these leads. Let me be a part of the investigation team as well.
As for the whole vacation thing...
Sorry for wasting the opportunity, Lexington, but it looks like we'll have to put that on pause.

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>6 Preparations</size>
Private Tribunal Aircraft – Cabin
A few days later...

scripts.say: After cutting my vacation short, I flew over to the capital of the Iris Orthodoxy and met briefly with Richelieu.
Afterwards, Clemenceau had me board a private Tribunal aircraft and flew me to the Iron Blood city of Regensburg.
It's been a while since we've last been able to enjoy each other's company.
That's... probably for the best.
Haha, I suppose that's true.
Are you curious why I had you transferred to a private Tribunal aircraft?
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't.
By any chance, did you find the plane a bit cramped despite its size?
...What did you pack inside it?
Supplies, weapons, a security system, and... everything needed to create a miniature second-generation Black Sun.
Just to be sure... this is still an investigation, correct? Not a surprise invasion of Iron Blood?
Of course not, I wouldn't dare. This is just a precaution, in case something goes amiss.
I even brought Algérie and Galissonnière along as an added layer of security.
...You're expecting something to go wrong during the investigation, aren't you?
Have you already forgotten about what happened previously when Marco Polo and the Hierophant made their move?

How could I ever forget? It's just... at the time, I had no way of understanding Hierophant, so I tried to convey what information I could with best intentions. Yet that led to an uncontrollable situation.
Though, that's not the sole reason why you went out of your way to make such precautions, is it?
Nothing gets past you, I see...
Over the last few days, I've been perusing every last detail of the castlein the vision.
The more I looked into it, the more I felt an unease creep over me. It's hard to put that feeling into words...
First of all, the terrain around the castle doesn't match what we have in reality. More accurately, it looks as if it's straight out of the past.
A version of Regensburg from the past, huh... What else was noteworthy?
There was something disconcerting about the sky as well. It felt like a malevolent gaze was lingering over me.
Could the vision have been of another test site rather than our own?
There's no way to confirm that for sure, but there is the possibility that this is alluding to another superimposition event.
That definitely would be an ill omen.
Of course, there's always the possibility that I'm simply overpreparing due to my penchant for the dramatic, yes?
Nothing would please me more, my lady.
Oh, right. Did we just gloss over what you said about having made a second-generation Black Sun device?
Where did you even get that kind of technology to begin with?
It came from two sources; the first being Marco Polo, and the second being the results of the research conducted on "conceptual symbolism" at the Siren experimental site.
So it's related to the Hierophant and her experimental mechanisms, huh... Then, I suppose one can't call call it completely alien tech.
Would you like to give it a try?
I'm sure you've seen all sorts of visions and entered plenty of complex, illusory realms in the past, yes?
The technology of the Black Sun device could allow us to delve deeper into your mind for more in-depth research.
I think I'll pass on that. Whenever I get involved with this sort of tech, something always ends up going wrong...
Even if all the numbers suggest it's safe, things always go sideways on the real run.
Whether it's the Sea of Stars, or the Sky Realm of Amahara...
Having all that said, I can think of one good use for it.
Do you reckon we'd be able to use it on Marco Polo?
If we could visualize whatever is going on inside her consciousness, don't you think that could help us make sense of this omen?
Indeed, that is a promising idea... Let's set some time aside to put that into action.
They say time flies like an airplane, and I soon found myself touching down in Regensburg City.
As soon as I stepped off the plane, Prinz Eugen, Z2, and Mainz were there to receive me on behalf of Iron Blood.
Welcome to Iron Blood, Commander~
Hope I didn't keep all of you waiting too long.
That's right. She was called in for a meeting with Soyuz. Apparently, they're discussing joint operation plans.
So, I got brought in last-minute to serve as her replacement... Uhh, I mean, I was given this immense honor and responsibility~♪
...Joint operation plans, in this day and age? Against who?
Beats me. Maybe you could give her a call later and ask for the details yourself?
Ahahaha! I thought you'd ask that. I kept her away specifically to spare her from your crusty sense of humor~♪
Thank you~♪
Now then, shall we get going? The castle ruins aren't far from here. It won't be a long drive.
What about the plans to transport my special-use aircraft?
Not to worry. We'll have a trailer to tow it over to the base camp after we leave.
...Wait, so do you just plan to drag the plane along with wherever you go?
As I said, it's just an extra precaution. Shall we get going, Commander?

sequence:
Dust-Specked Omen

<size=45>7 Harmony</size>
Holy Unitas Empire
Brandenburg City
Imperial Comitium

scripts.say: Brandenburg. The capital and beating heart of the Holy Unitas Empire.
The Comitium was once overflowing with people. It was the epicenter of countless decrees that would reach every corner of the empire.
But today, less than a third of the Comitium's seats were filled. Even the towering throne remained vacant.
A grim atmosphere still lingered over the place, as if silently anticipating a rain of blades.
After a while, a voice finally came from one of the seven seats closest to the throne.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Yesterday, the forces of Archbishop of Mainz were wiped out in battle in the north.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: The Archbishop herself was martyred.
A lone voice echoed through the hall.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: By the decree of the Hagiobull, should the empire ever face an existential threat, the electors' succession system shall be determined based on the warship's rank.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Therefore, I propose that the current Archbishop of Regensburg exercises the authority of elector, as successor to the Archbishop of Mainz.
The hall was enveloped in silence, but discussion soon began to sprout until the forum was filled with a mixture of agreement and disagreement.
The motion passed without much fanfare, and soon, a person steps up from beneath to take the seat next to Köln.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: The situation is urgent, so I'll skip the formalities.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: The tragedy of the Archbishop of Mainz was not the only bad news from yesterday.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: I have discovered the cause of the sudden surge in pressure from the northwestern frontier. It is because Albion has been wholly consumed by the nether.
What was silence but a moment ago quickly turned into an uproar.

sequence: "Albion has fallen?! What of our allies in the Royal Tripartum?"
"Rumors have it that a small fleet of ships carrying survivors have arrived in Calais, but their numbers are terribly few."
"First, the Kamal Union. Now, the Albion Alliance..."
"Our allies are being swallowed up one after another!"
"The situation in the Iris Orthodoxy seem dire as well. Apparently, Paris has already fallen..."
"First Rome, then Paris... What's left?"
"We must take action now!"
"We barely even have the ability to protect ourselves! Wake up to reality!"
"...What even is reality?"

scripts.say: Suddenly, a clear voice rang out. Though it did not come from one of the seven seats, it was still enough to silence the hall.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Just now. Someone asked what reality is.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Indeed, the Archbishop of Mainz sacrificed her life, and the Kamal Union has fallen. However, the northern borders of the empire are still in the hands of the realmwardens. That is the reality.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: The Albion Alliance is no more, and the Iris Orthodoxy has lost their capital. Nevertheless, they have built a defensive line from Calais to Reims and continue to fight even as we speak.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: To the south, imperial forces have stabilized the situation in the entire swath stretching from Genoa to Florence and Venice.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: As for the eastern front... do you not see this empty seat? The Bohemian King crushed the onslaught of the Sin Shadows once more, just three days ago. Surely you have not forgotten so soon?
No one had anything to say in retort.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Now you understand, yes? The reality is far from hopeless. Do not lose yourselves to panic!

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: If today's "discussion" amounts to nothing more than this senseless prattle, then I shall take my leave.
Königsberg turned her back and marched straight towards the door.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: One moment please, Königsberg.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: You are correct in saying that the situation has been stabilized for now. Yet, everyone knows that this stability cannot last.

scripts.factiontag: Realmwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: All the more reason for us to come together and take action rather than wasting time engaging in empty rhetoric, no?

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Precisely. But even were we to take action, under whose banner would it be?

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: We are the Holy Unitas Empire, the rightful successors of Romulus. Yet nobody has stepped forth to claim our crown.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Moreover, the throne has remained vacant for far too long... do you not agree?

scripts.factiontag: Meerwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: What, are you proposing we elect a new imperator?

scripts.factiontag: Meerwarden of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Though, how are we supposed to coronate an imperator now that the Holy See has been lost?

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Well said. In fact, that brings us to the true reason why today's session has been convened.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Everyone, do you remember the ancient rituals as described in the Hagiobull?

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Now then, we must make our choice. For the sake of the empire. For the sake of this era.
The arguments once again intensified. When Königsberg sat down again, she smiled at Köln as if everything was according to plan.

scripts.factiontag: Archbishop of the Holy Unitas Empire
scripts.say: Now then, everyone. Let us cast our votes—

sequence: Iron Blood - Regensburg City
Castle Ruins
Shortly afterwards...

scripts.say: Guided by Prinz Eugen, our group soon arrived at the ruins of a castle on the outskirts of Regensburg.
As I looked down across the ruins, the scenery around me began to change without my notice.
(Huh?! Are the bricks of the castle suddenly becoming new again?)
Woah, do you see that?! The weeds look like they're getting absorbed back into the ground!
The stone walls are also being restored, little by little...
Everyone could notice the anomalous changes taking place right away.
We've been investigating this place closely for god knows how long now... but of course, the clues lay themselves bare as soon as you show up, Commander... Heehee.
...Maybe it would be better if we withdrew for now?
Beams of light began to erupt from the ancient rock formations one after another, illuminating the ruins with an otherworldly brightness.
Not good! Everyone, with me!
Algérie, Galissonnière, you two head towards the plane while escorting the Commander!
As soon as the hatch closed, my entire world was enveloped in pure white—

sequence: <size=45><color=#000000>"The netherworld comes, heralding the end."</color></size>
<size=45><color=#000000>"The fat of the land shall turn fallow."</color></size>

Ceremonial Gala

<size=45>Chapter 1: Essex's Troubles</size>

scripts.say: Port - Lecture Hall
Suffolk, would you kindly put Cleveland's bonsais over there for me? Yes, right by the door.
Kent, let's start with six sets of Her Majesty's china. And Sheffy, you'll be hanging chandeliers.
Can I put this box here?
Madam Essex? Oh yes, right here would be lovely.
Phew... Little by little, the auditorium here is turning into something really overwhelming.
It's all part of our responsibilities in preparing the party. We have to give everyone the true Royal Navy experience if we don't want to rouse Her Majesty's ire.
Madam Essex, you've been so very helpful these past few days. Allow me to once again express my gratitude.
Oh, it was nothing. I'm happy to help.
Was it really nothing, though? You've spent all of the last couple days with us.
But in any case, since you're new here, I would hope you can find some joy in the event itself, Madam Essex.
I appreciate the thought, Miss Belfast, but I'm really a-okay.
The fleet's been through so much. They fought for the right to kick back here with some good food and fun. But me? What did I do to deserve a party?
If I wasn't here helping, I'd probably just be out training somewhere anyway...
You have some marvelous ideas, Madam Essex.
But I'm afraid there's not much more to do here... I think we're about to put you out of a job.
Really? Well, it's not like I have anywhere else to go. I guess I'll just head back to–
I wouldn't worry about that.
That voice! It must be...
Ah, welcome, Madam Enterprise.
So this is where we're hosting the party? ... You've already got it looking great.
Hehe, it's an honor to earn such praise from you, Madam Enterprise.
And you've taken such good care of Essex. I owe you one. Next time, just pawn her off on me.
E-Enterprise, what did you mean by...
I heard what you were just saying. It's obvious you look up to me, so how could I leave a cute little girl like you all alone?
Now if hoity-toity stuff like this isn't your speed, what would you say to a little rumble with me?
A rumble? What's this flyer?
... "The First Annual Port Martial Arts Tournament. Want to test your strength? Want to face down the greatest the other camps have to offer? Join us!"
You'll wanna read this part.
"Aircraft Carrier Group Guest of Honor: Enterprise. The winner earns the right to challenge Enterprise herself."
Well? What do you think? You in?

sequence:
Ceremonial Gala

<size=45>Chapter 2: Albacore's Stroll</size>

scripts.say: Port - Plaza (now a Stage)
La~ Lala~ Gala tiime~ Lala- Huh? What's that~?
Come on, Ise, let's make this interesting.
Interesting? What do you mean?
Let's see who can set up their stuff the quickest. Loser buys the drinks!!
Hah hah ha! Like I'm gonna lose to you? Hope you brought plenty of cash.
Wowee! Are you two gonna get that whole stage set up in just one day? That's wild!
Hah! You bet your scantily clad ass we are!
I don't get it... There's a celebration on and you're here working all day?
Not that you'd know, but there's a reason we're putting up the stage.
Yea, idols are our Sakura culture. We gotta get this stage going so we can show the world.
"We got the idols! Right here on our purpose-built stage!" Get it?
Ohhh!
Hah! Now, we got a lotta work to do, so you run along. This isn't a place for kids to play. Come back when the concert's on.
Okaaaay.
But like... Where do I go? Commander's busy with whatever. Who am I supposed to play with?
Not to mention everybody's all caught up on the gala tonight. There's nobody to prank...
Hey, what's that box over by Akashi's shop? There's something written on it...
"Akashi's Fabulous Variety Show. Leave 50 Gems on the carpet, nya!"
Hehehe.
All set. Here we go.
Nya?! A Gem!
Boom！
*Cough*! *Cough*! Who's there, nya?! Was that a Gem-shaped smoke bomb, nya?!
Show yourself, coward! I'll double my prices, nya!
*Snort* ... Ahahahaha! Got 'em!
Boy, did Akashi grab that Gem crazy quick. I barely saw her move...
Ah, nothing beats a good prank! Now, what to do next... I guess I could go check out the Lecture Hall...
Oh, I know! I'll see what Taihou's up to!

sequence:
Ceremonial Gala

<size=45>Chapter 3: Taihou and Albacore</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dormitory
I have my materials and my tools. Almost ready to start sewing.
Now, how about the Manjuus I borrowed from Akashi...
The Manjuus gathered up their assigned tools, eager to begin.
Yes, let's get started! We have to finish putting together the perfect outfit before the party!
Ahahaha! When I think of my darling Commander getting seduced by my ravishing outfit oh... Oh! OH! How I LOVE it!
Need a hand?
Aaah! A-A-A-A-Albacore?!
Uuuuuuughhh...
... Oops. I just wanted to scare you. Didn't mean to konk you out.
Heyyy, Taihou. Wakey waaakeeeyyy!
30 Minutes Later
... Where, where am I...? I had this terrible dream about Albacore in my room...
Oh, that wasn't a dream. I'm really here~
Uuuuuuughhh...
Hey, don't go back to sleep. Manjuus, do me a favor and grab a glass of water.
What are you doing here? Get out of my room!
No special reason. I just thought I'd come by and hang out for a bit.
... Hang out? Since when are we friends? Since when do we not hate each other?
Look, we're in the same fleet from here on out, like it or not. We gotta try to get along.
... Fine. Whatever. I really couldn't care less. The past is the past. Water under the bridge.
Really? Great! Now I can play with the Commander without worrying about you–
Don't you dare pester my Commander, unless you want your throat sl–
Heyyyy now! Didn't we just agree to be friends?!
This has nothing to do with back then. This is about protecting my dear, sweet, beloved Commander...
Make trouble for my Commander and I'll end you.
Okay okay! I get it! I won't steal away the Commander!
Call back your planes already! You're scaring the Manjuus.
Phew... You gave me a heart attack.
Anyway, Taihou, you wanna go out to the festival with me?
On my way over here I saw some kind of aircraft carrier competition going on.
And you know at a big event like that, there's a pretty good chance of running into the Commander~
Oh... i-is that right? I might be able to stand going with you...
Yaaaaay~

sequence:
Ceremonial Gala

<size=45>Chapter 4: The Festival</size>

scripts.say: So this is for the big cooking competition. It's tomorrow, but they got it all set up already.
And over here's... Some kinda... "Swimsuit Competition"? Reeaally?
You sure seem to know a lot for someone who only just joined the fleet.
Ehehee. I'm just making sure I'm gonna have a good time at this festival. Of course, I did my homework~
You see how sad it is you've cooped yourself up in your room like that, Taihou?
I have only one goal for this festival: To wear a handmade dress to the party and share a beautiful evening with my Commander! Nothing else matters.
Oh, what's that sound?
I think it's... music? Oh! It's Fubuki and U-81! I almost didn't recognize them in those outfits... Hey, Fubuki!!
Achoo! ... Did somebody call me?
Over heeeeere!
Oh, she's from the submarine squadron! Come on, Fubuki!
Hey, wait up! I'm hauling this huge tuba, I can't run that fa–
What the heck is that thing, Fubuki?
Oh, it's a tuba. Amazon's been putting together an orchestra to play at the party. It sounded fun, so here I am.
(Heh heh, an orchestra, huh? Perfect. A beautiful symphony will provide accompaniment to the union of Taihou and her Commander.)
Huh? You know how to play the tuba?
Nope!
... Errrm but I've been practicing a lot! Don't look at me like that!
Um... Oh! There's some kind of Martial Arts Tournament thingy that's about to start! Let's go watch!
Hrmph, you keep wasting the time I should be using to prepare my dress for my Commander. Not to mention... Hey! Wait for me!
... Why are those two together?
And that's the end!! While Zuikaku made a good showing and looked like she was set to take the crown, the grand champ herself, Enterprise, came in and crushed her dreams!
The crowd's going wild... Looks like we're late.
My Commander? Hmph... No. Not here. I know my Commander's scent (sniff) and it's not here.
Toot toot!! Yeaaah! Victory tubaaaaa!
Oww... Can you chill with the tuba, Fubuki? I couldn't even hear who won.
Wait... is that... Essex?

sequence:
Ceremonial Gala

<size=45>Chapter 5: Essex and Enterprise</size>

scripts.say: ... I guess I still can't beat you.
Don't tell me you're giving up?
Enterprise...
Did you really think you'd just brute force it? Roll on through the tournament right up to me and push me over?
... I never thought it'd be easy, but I definitely thought I'd at least make it to the end...
Life is a highway. Along the way, you'll meet all kinds of people, learn all kinds of things you never knew.
Just look at our fleet. You've got so many different personalities, abilities, and experiences all around you.
I've been here this long and even I can't say for sure that I'm stronger than everyone else.
My point is, I want you to interact with your peers more. Get to know everyone, from every angle.
Enterprise is so dang cool!
Huh? What are you all doing here?
For the competition, of course! We Iron Bloods can learn so much from observation alone!
I was just watching Zuikaku. I didn't think the Sakura Empire would have so many aircraft carriers here.
(Hmph. To think she's so friendly with that Grey Ghost...) None of my business...
But your "state-of-the-art armored carrier" Taihou didn't participate? What a shame.
Seemed boring to me.
(Who would've thought colleagues from different camps could just talk to each other like this... wild...)
I understand. You mean that if I want to surpass you, Enterprise, I have to find my place in this fleet, and draw strength from my peers... right?
Yeah... I think you got it.
But like, making friends and whatever, that's kind of...
Hey! Don't be so high strung! It's a festival!
Huh?
But of course! Everyone worked so hard on this festival, you've got to dive in and enjoy yourself. Isn't that right, Taihou?
Wait a minute! Don't you get me mixed up in this!
Where's the harm? The more the merrier!
... I get it. I'm supposed to go out and have fun with everyone today!
... Hmph. Yeah, sure, whatever.
Gotcha, nya! You're the one who left that smoke bomb, nya!
Aiee! Akashi caught up to me!
She looks furious! What the heck did you do?
No time to explain! Skedaddle!
Whaaaaa?!?!
And so the raucous festival continued...

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>1 Singularity on the Horizon</size>

scripts.say: Illusions swept across the world, trapping those within their range in a powerful dream. Meanwhile, in the Sakura Empire, Akagi had created a Singularity known as Naraka.
With some help from the Eagle Union, the Dragon Empery vanquished the Storm that had long barred them from the sea. With their objectives accomplished, they rendezvoused with Nagato's fleet.
Now, nearly all illusions across the world had been dealt with, but the Naraka Singularity posed a new problem. It covered the entirety of the Sakura Empire.
Commander, I recognize the Singularity's shape... It looks like the Prime Barrier that protects our country.
The Singularity must have appeared within the barrier and the barrier kept it from expanding beyond its boundary.
That being the case, the Prime Barrier is in all likelihood still being sustained.
This means that the worst-case scenario has yet to befall our country. Or so I hope.
I hate to do this, but I must take my fleet with me and return back home.
I will accompany you, Lady Nagato.
Good.
No. We must stick together. You might think this is an issue for you and your countrymen to deal with, but it isn't. It concerns all of us.
You cooperated well with Enterprise's fleet when you dealt with that illusion before. She's still here, and now, I am, too.
The crisis is not over yet, so we should all try to move as one.
I see your point. If you insist, then I will comply.
Indiana, I want you to take your fleet and give support to the Commander and the Sakurans.
Alright.
I'll come with you.
You? You're with the Northern Parliament?
You could say that. I'm Kirov META. I've been a guest with them for a while now.
I want to see this Naraka Singularity up close. Do you mind if I come along?
Soyuz, what do you think?
If neither you nor Nagato have any objections, then I am fine with it.
Furthermore, I'm willing to take my fleet and accompany you on your mission.
Is that okay with you, Nagato?
The more support we have, the better. Thank you, Soyuz and Kirov.
Then we've got a solid force to bring to bear.
The Northern Pariament's fleet, Indiana's fleet, and Nagato's fleet will head for the Sakura Empire. The rest will stay here and continue analyzing the locked Mirror Sea. Be on your guard.
This Singularity is a serious threat. Be on the lookout for enemies along the way to the Sakuran mainland.
Sometime later, aboard the Commander's vessel...
The Empery's computing power has risen again and the Sea of Stars has adjusted the projected completion time accordingly once more.
At the rate it's going, it should be done in six hours.
It'll go even faster if the Empery provides us with yet more computational resources.
Wow, that's amazing.
I'm curious why their computing power increases gradually like this. Why not use the maximum available from the start, like the Sea of Stars does?
Hmm. Beats me.
Maybe their supercomputer doesn't run around the clock, so it needs to warm up?
Whatever the case, it lets us finally catch a breather. You should rest up while you have the chance.
If anything happens, I'll let you know right away.
So much has happened in so little time. First the Orthodoxy's joint exercise, then Operation Wind-Crushing Ice Dragon, then dealing with the illusions across the Pacific...
I'd love to polish up our plan for this Singularity, but dreamland is calling for me. I need a nap.
A vast galaxy dotted with thousands of stars unfolds before me.
Sorry for disturbing your sleep like this.

options.content: How are you going to make it up to me?

scripts.say: I assume this must be something important if you're contacting me out of nowhere.
Oh yes. It is VERY important.
Hmm... How about with a little surprise?
Take a look at who's here.
Compiler?! What's she–
I know you've got questions, but now is not the time.
The reason I contacted you is because I have something very important to tell you.
I need you to attend a meeting down in Antarctica.
This meeting could help turn your situation around just like that.
What? Antarctica? You mean now?
Relax. It won't interfere with your ability to command your current battle.
Who am I meeting, then?
Observer.

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>2 Where Camelot Has Gone</size>

scripts.say: Scapa Flow - Underground
With Queen Elizabeth's role in dispelling the illusions complete, she returned to Scapa Flow, where she spent half a day.
Vanguard and her team were still missing and she hadn't heard a word from Camelot.
Then, after pursuing the likely culprits behind what could have caused the gate to malfunction...
...It was no malfunction. The gate's safety mechanism was activated.
That's it. That's the only explanation.
My META counterpart set it up to activate only if an outside threat invades test site beta, or if someone from test site beta enters the Singularity...
I have no way of verifying if the former is the case or not, but perhaps it's the other one – someone from this branch invaded Camelot.
Could that really be? Did one of those illusions sneak its way inside?
Then the safety should've been disengaged now that the illusions have been disposed of...
Yet it has not.
At the same time, there is no way my META self installed a faulty system. Queen Elizabeth does not make mistakes!
Then, by process of elimination, there's only one interpretation left...
An external threat has infiltrated test site beta.
And of course – my META counterpart is off hunting for that bloody whale when our branch is in danger! Ugh!
This can't wait any longer. I need to call her at once!
The queen anxiously closed her eyes and activated the communication device her META counterpart left for her.
The next thing she felt, it was like her mind was beamed from Scapa Flow into the Queen's Light.
Bloody hell... That's impressive.
Oi! Other Elizabeth! Where are you? I need to talk to you!
Whuah! It's you! The test site beta queen!
How'd you get here?!
Never mind that. Where is she? My gate's safety mechanism activated and I must ask her about it.
Oh, she's in the driver's cabin! I'll go get her!
...The safety mechanism was triggered? Yes, that is quite bad.
Did you enter the gate and see what's happening on the other side?
If I could've done that, I wouldn't have come to you for help!
Well, this is bad timing... We decided on this hunting trip on short notice, and it's going to take quite some time.
Even worse, we couldn't finish the safe mode communication device before we left.
So what are you saying? That even YOU cannot contact Vanguard's team while the gate is in safe mode?
Quite the opposite! Not only could we contact them, we could warp straight to them!
Get back here and do that, then!
Nuh-uh! She's helping me catch my whale!
I am NOT letting her turn this train around now that we've finally caught up with it!
You just need to talk to people there, right? I know a way to do that!
Well, why didn't you say so sooner? Spit it out!
Just use the dingdong ring-ring I gave you!
The... The what?
She means the stuffed whale you received.
Excuse me? THAT can reach them?
Sure can! I placed it in your room before I left through the gate!
All you've gotta do is pick it up and dial beep boop ding ding!
The people on the other side should pick up when they hear you!
What do you MEAN by "dial beep whatever-you-said"?
That's the stuffed animal she left on the other side of the gate.
Excuse me? THAT can reach them?
Is that all? Then hang up so we can focus! We're trying to catch a whale here!
Elizabeth's mind returned to her body. She opened her eyes and found herself back underground.
Good thing I held on to that stuffed whale.
Let's see... I just push this, right?
BEEP BEEP BEEP!
BOOP BOOP BOOP!
DING DING DING!
What's going on? Why is Miss D's plushie making those noises?
Hang on... Was that a ringtone?
Vanguard! Do you hear me?
Huh?! Is that you, Your Majesty?
Yes, it's me! I'm in the corridor just outside the entry to the gate!
Go to the controls and follow my instructions precisely!
I must know what's happened to the gate at once!

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>3 Higher-Level Aberration</size>

scripts.say: NA Ocean - Central Sector
Once, these waters were rife with danger. However, Siren activity in the area fell off following the defeat of Compiler, and some calm returned to the sea.
Even the tempestuous Singularity at its heart was evaluated as less dangerous following that monumental battle.
However, after the events in the Pacific and the appearance of the Naraka singularity, shipgirls were once more gathering en masse in the area.
Seems the storm's threat readings have increased, even though the storm itself looks no different.
Have each fleet report their measurements every five minutes. Also, nobody is allowed to enter the storm without permission!
I've already notified them all, so don't worry about that.
Man, it's bad enough with the phenomena happening across the globe...
Now the NA Ocean storm is becoming unstable. At the worst possible time.
New Jersey! Two shipgirls were just detected exiting the storm! They're moving toward our position!
What? But I don't see anything on the radar.
Oh, wait! It's THEM!
You mean... Ashes?
Let 'em through. If they got here through the storm, they probably know what's happening.
In fact, let's ready some supplies for them.
Okay. On it.
Following the conclusion of Operation Siren, Hiryuu and Ark Royal META had been keeping a close eye on the NA Ocean Singularity.
They had aided this world not just in Operation Siren, but also during the near-superimposition event, and people's views of them had improved accordingly.
So much so that the Commander ordered the fleet garrisoned in the area to provide the two Ashes with supplies, should they need them.
All in all, the Eagle Union's attitude toward them had done a complete 180.
The two Ashes readily accepted the Commander's goodwill and took the supplies offered to them with no qualms.
Both sides shared not only resources, but meals as well, and even exchanged information.
They started out hostile to one another – now, it was like they were neighbors in the NA Ocean, on mutually good terms.
Seeing as so many of you are here, I'm going to assume you already know what's happening inside the Singularity.
Let's say we don't. Could you tell us what's going on?
Sure thing. In fact, telling you was one of our reasons for coming here.
Unfortunately, I have two pieces of bad news.
First – the abnormality did not happen spontaneously.
Some sort of higher-level aberration is trying to enter the Singularity and invade test site beta.
Second – the Arbiters Hermit, Strength, and Temperance have reappeared inside the storm.
I suspect they're going after your test site soon.
While these are both bad, I do have one bit of good news.
Let me guess – the Arbiters and this "aberration" have begun fighting each other, right?
Correct. The Arbiters identified it as a danger to entire branches, so eliminating it became their number one priority.
So... the storm is acting up all of a sudden because those two are fighting?
Yeah.
The enemy of my enemy and all that, but aren't we in serious trouble regardless of which side wins?
You are. That's why I'd suggest closing the Singularity as soon as possible.
If we knew HOW to close it, we would've done so ages ago...
Hey, didn't your Enterprise make this Singularity in the first place? Can't you ask her for help?
I would, but I cannot get in touch with her.
I fear she might even have forgotten about me since it's been so long since I left for this branch.
Hiryuu, come on.
I know what you're going to say. Listen to me – it's OUR time to ask for help from THEM this time.
No offense, but I'm surprised you Ashes have managed to survive this long when you're so loosely organized.
Our members are powerful, that's why. Enterprise especially so. Her power is greater than any one of us.
We've also developed a keen sixth sense for danger, and we've learned that working as a unit actually makes it harder for us to adapt to a situation.
Say what you will about our individual members, but Ashes itself is not a cold and uncaring organization.
Others will come to our rescue if we end up smack-dab in the middle of this ordeal.
(Well, probably...)
(The only one we can count on is Helena.)
Anyway, panicking won't help anyone. For now, we can only wait and see how the battle unfolds and improvise accordingly.
True. Better that than rushing out a plan.
To wind back a bit, you said earlier that, "telling us was one of your reasons for coming here." Are there more reasons?
How observant of you. The other reason is – we saw the writing on the wall and got out while we could.

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>4 Hope</size>

scripts.say: Over in the Orthodoxy's capital, Shinano retired to her room for the night, having accomplished her mission.
In her hand was the Watatsumi fragment that awoke her from her illusion. She stared at it, and a strange feeling suddenly welled in her.
A feeling so familiar, so old.
It was the feeling of slipping into a dream again.
A blood moon shone on a world wrapped in dark mist. Countless red spider lilies bloomed all around.
The Sanzu River... Spider lilies...
Some sort of ritual is taking place...
She looked up at the sky and knew intuitively that power was flowing into that massive, dead tree at the center of the world.
A withered sakura tree... Is it a Sacred Sakura?
Nay... Connected to the Watatsumi though it may be, its essence is different...
Could this be an entity... CREATED by the Watatsumi?
Sensing a strange energy coursing through the skies and lands, she tried to extract information from the dream.
Then, a streak of purple crossed her mind in this deep red world.
...Musashi?
There, in the sea of spider lilies, a figure stood out – Shinano could sense that it was Musashi.
Good... I drew the attention of all the enemies. None should stand in Zuikaku's way now.
My only goal was to destroy the protective barrier around the ritual, and I never knew she was following me...This adds another variable to consider.
Musashi... Your body, it's... What did you do?
Musashi did not answer. In fact, she seemed wholly unaware of Shinano's existence as she began to use the power of her secret weapon again.
Musashi!
Shinano tried to grab her shoulder, but her hand slipped right through Musashi's body, like she were a ghost.
*cough cough*... Even just maintaining this state is draining all my energy... I need to move, fast...
Musashi looked behind her at the great tree at the world's center and began moving once more.
Pouring her very life essence into her "trump card," Musashi walked forward through the ritual's barrier.
Though the black mist attacked her again and again, she struck it down each time, sending it flying in all directions.
This back and forth of attacking and defending continued for an eternity, until finally, Musashi's soul was on the brink of extinguishing.
Not so much as a sound.
So easily neutralizing a wave of demons that blanketed the sea...
Jintsuu wasn't exaggerating. And this trump card isn't even fully completed yet...
But such a weapon is beyond any individual's control.
It's fortunate that I was at the core this time.
Shinano wouldn't... have...
Musashi...
If only I had faced my own strength sooner and shook off my doubt, I could've helped you...
Nay. It isn't too late!
If the Yamato class' strength truly is tied to the Watatsumi, then surely this one can help you...
There must be a way... Somehow...
Think, think... I need something now!
That moment, Shinano saw a smile form on Musashi's face.
She knew Musashi wasn't smiling at her, and yet, it shook her core all the same.
That this end would come was only natural. I have regrets, but I will not fear...
All that lives must die. In this world, ships and humans alike are but fleeting phantasms.
Heehee...
No...
May this final blow bring the light of hope into this desolation...
Wait, Musashi... There must be another way...
"Sever the pall of eternity, that I may become a leaf floating to the other side."
NOOOOO!
"Steel... clash!"
Abruptly, a swarm of golden butterflies glowing like the morning sun surrounded Shinano. They lit up the sea and the dark sky.
The light receded, and she found herself in a place she had seen so many times before.
The boundary line between the waking and the sleeping world... The fragmentary space that connects dreams...
Finally... I'm finally back here...
The two waves endlessly lapping at each other. The boundless realm. The no man's land she sees only in her dreams.
Looking up, she saw something she had never seen here before – golden butterflies, grouping together and flying into the distance.
In that distance – red torii gates. The gates that connect fragmented dreams.
The butterflies connected the gates through many glittering lines, seemingly guiding Shinano to the next dream.

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>5 Thawing the Winter's Crown</size>

scripts.say: The Arctic - Winter's Crown Singularity
I brought a fleet here as soon as I received your message, Kursk. Are there any updates on the Winter's Crown?
It's not looking great. The Crown's readings are still rising.
How can that be? As far as I know, Code G attempted to activate the Singularity once, but she did not succeed.
I don't know either. All I know is it seems bad.
I'll contact Chkalov. Perhaps she knows something we don't.
Meanwhile, I'll get ready to recapture it.
Alright. Our plan to reinforce the Pacific will have to wait.
Chkalov, do you copy? This is Sovetskaya Rossiya.
BZZZT... BZZZT...
Jamming? Where is–
She could not finish her sentence, because the next thing she saw left her in awe.
The Crown, it's glowing!
What is going on?!
The shipgirls' gazes all converged on the glowing Winter's Crown. Its light only grew brighter.
Half the electronics I brought have started malfunctioning.
All units, get away from the Crown! We're evacuating the area now!
I don't know how, but the Crown has probably been activated!
Yeah, that's right! Run away with your tails between your legs!
Better run away as far as you can!
A completely unexpected voice burst onto the comms channel.
Omitter! That's her!
You haven't shown yourself since we beat you in Operation Frostfall. Finally mustered the courage to show yourself again, huh?
What's that? You think I've been SCARED of you sorry assholes?
That what you think, huh? That what you're saying?!
Forget it! Just stand back while I show you my REAL strength!
With those words, a wave of sheer cold swept across the ocean.
A ripple shot out from the Winter's Crown, freezing all the water in its path and changing even the clouds in the sky.
Without any warning, heavy snow, rain, and hail all began to fall while thunder boomed and gales blew. Even short-lived tornadoes raged across the frozen surface.
These forces of nature did not target the shipgirls, however – they targeted the Winter's Crown.
Is she... attacking the Crown?
Looks like it. That initial freeze was probably the most effective attack, though.
All the other weather changes – I doubt they'll do much to it.
Then why do that? Is she just showing off?
As the last tornado vanished, the orchestra of abnormal weather finally ceased.
The Winter's Crown answered the provocation by lighting up and releasing a shockwave that instantly shattered the ice around it, as if to mock Omitter.
Then, the next moment...
The world turned white.
Right before all went blank, the Northern Parliament girls saw a beam of light appear from the sky and shoot through the Winter's Crown.
When they could see again, everything was gone – Omitter, the light beam, even the Winter's Crown.
All that remained was a pool of nearly boiling water.

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>6 Upheaval</size>

scripts.say: Pacific Ocean - Waters Near Sakura Empire
The Prime Barrier had turned dark red, and rather than protecting the Sakura Empire, it now isolated it. It gave off an ominous pressure.
How could this happen to the barrier...
Shimanto, you and I will commence a purification ritual.
We must get inside somehow, even if through a narrow gap!
Understood.
While the two Sakurans began the ritual, the others backed off and stood by on alert.
Perhaps in its current state, the Prime Barrier can be viewed as a kind of locked Mirror Sea.
It's quite unusual for a Mirror Sea, though. The protective barrier is so strong that it can be seen with the naked eye. Not only that, it is physically tangible.
That's because its boundary line is a Singularity, not a regular old Mirror Sea.
Judging by how it was formed, "Naraka" – as you call it – has some pretty darn unique properties.
What makes you say that? Do you know anything about it?
Yeah. I've seen a similar Singularity before.
It was made to stop the Sirens from resetting their test site.
Truth be told, it did the job – in a twisted way.
What do you mean, "twisted way"?
After it was deployed, the universe began to literally break down around them.
In the end, the Singularity swallowed absolutely everything in that test site, save for its creators.
And by everything, I mean the Sirens as well.
Without Sirens, there was no way for their test site to be reset. So, in that way, it worked.
What?!
Do you believe... that Naraka will do the same?
No. The Singularity itself isn't what's dangerous.
TB labeled it as a "cataclysmic threat," but as far as I can tell, it's not large or strong enough to cause THAT level of destruction.
Having that said, that thing showing up means that the higher-level aberration connected to your test site is different. I wonder if it's...
Wait! The Winter's Crown! That Singularity still exists!
Comrade Soyuz, order your troops there to monitor the situation!
Monitor the Winter's Crown? But...
I know. I just want them to keep an eye on it and prepare for a battle, just in case.
There are other Singularities in this world, yes?
It doesn't matter if they're natural, manmade, or even active or not...
I want them all destroyed immediately if it's at all possible!
If outright destruction isn't feasible, they must instead be contained and have guards posted at them!
What are you saying? Do you believe that all Singularities could be dangerous?
Yes! They are!
They caught my branch by surprise once, and it cost us dearly...
I don't want the same thing to happen to yours!
I understand. I'll contact Comrade Commander and mobilize the other factions.
BEEP BEEP!
Looks like the Commander contacted YOU first.
Hello, Comrade Commander. I have something important to discuss.
I'm aware. It's about Naraka and its effects, no?
I already know the details and I have a plan to deal with it. You don't need to worry about that.
If Nagato's there, I'd like to talk to her.
She is committing her full attention to completing a purification ritual. If you couldn't reach her earlier, that might be why.
Well, please put her on the line. It's important.
O-of course! Right away!
What is it, Commander?
Hate to interrupt you, but I have to ask – how do you feel about Akagi's attempt to revive Amagi?
I will hold her accountable for it. This whole calamity traces back to her.
Having said that, I know her desire to revive Amagi is genuine. For that, I do not blame her.
What if I told you that everything will be fine if Amagi is successfully brought back?
What? But that's impossi–
KABOOOM!
A rumble shook the sea, and an enormous crack appeared on the outside of the Prime Barrier.
Lady Nagato! Someone is trying to physically destroy the barrier from the inside!
With brute force?!
Nagato, I know the situation is dire, but there's still time to turn everything around.
Will you let me handle this?
...Very well. While I have my reservations, I will place my trust in you.
You have seen many battles. You are a strong leader. You rescued Zuikaku, among many others...
Admittedly, you also have a wider perspective on things than I do at times.
So, what would you have me do?
It's simple. Allow Amagi to be revived and resolve this crisis.
To do that, you'll need your fleet – and above all else, Akagi's cooperation.
Use whatever means necessary to find her! When you do, talk to her and keep her calm!

sequence:
Whence the Dust Settles

<size=45>7 Plans and Goals</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere, in an unknown location...
An exquisite garden sat in the middle of an otherwise barren place.
*sigh*...
That's your 26th sigh, Memphis.
*siiigh*...
27th.
I haven't heard a word from Helena since she left us with this mission.
Why? I don't get it.
The Commander is in so much danger, so why won't she come to the rescue?
She must have her reasons for it, I'm sure. Besides, didn't Yorktown sign off on the idea?
Hey, aren't you bothered by the fact that Helena chose Kasumi for this mission, even though you and she are both suited for it?
I'm starting to think she wants to keep the Commander all to herself.
*sigh*...
Oh, hey, Kasumi. Setting off so soon?
Look after yourself – and the Commander as well.
Mhm. I will.
Kasumi vanished from the garden in a burst of blue light.
No... I can't stop worrying about it...
Jintsuu's still online. I'm going to go and give her some advice!
The ostensible danger may not be the real danger.
No matter what happens, I will protect you with all my might...
Be on your guard... Commander.
Test Site Beta - Arbiters' Defensive Line, Central Layer
The Lovers and Empress constructed this defensive line to ward off the X in the event of an attack.
Then came Bon Homme Richard. Ever since her assault began, Lovers' defense force expanded to several times its original size.
This fierce pushback prevented Bon Homme Richard from gaining any ground for a week.
Then, a new day came...
What's this? Your forces aren't pushing back like they used to.
Are you taking your fleet and retreating?
You asked for a battle of attrition, and now you're just giving up?
Ahahahahahaha!
I'd be ashamed if I ran off after bragging like you did.
Ooh, lookie here. Fun stuff is happening over in test site beta.
Not gonna stop me, Lovers? Because I WILL pay them a visit.
She expected to hear Lovers' familiar voice, but there was no response.
She really did pack up... Alrighty then, I'm off to test site beta!
The dead silence continued.
Okay, here we go!
Test site beta, here I come!

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 1 - An Easily Flustered Girl's Day</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
My secretary, Honolulu, was standing in front of a bookcase and sorting documents.
Hey, uh... Could you not stare at me so much? I can't work properly when you do that...
...... (The Commander silently stopped observing Honolulu.)
*Sigh*... So, will these documents be all you need?
...... (The Commander silently nodded in agreement.)
Are you gonna inspect my gear? Fine, as long as you don't do anything weird...
...... (The Commander silently got ready to inspect Honolulu's equipment.)
Hey, are you even paying attention? ... A commission's been completed.
...... (The Commander silently confirmed the results of the commission.)
It's been some time since Honolulu started working as my secretary, and to a point, we've begun to understand each other's ways of doing things. However...
While she does her work just as you'd expect, for some reason, she always seems to be in a bad mood. I feel like she's hard to initiate a conversation with.
D-don't touch me from behind without asking! You need to learn how to be more delicate... So, what do you want?
... No, I'm not angry, but maybe there's something that's bothering me.
... I'm not trying to say that I hate you... I've just always had a temper like this.
If you don't like it then maybe you should get someone else to do the job...
<size=33>(Whispering) ... I bet you just chose me because of my bust...</size>
I can only conclude that Honolulu isn't upset at me in particular.
If I had to guess, she's just not very good at communicating her feelings...
... That actually made me a little curious about her.

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 2 - She Doesn't Have Many Friends?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy Courtyard
What did you want, Louis?
*Giggle*~ What? You mean we can't chat if I don't need something from you?
Well, I guess we could chat... Not like I have anything better to do.
... But why is the Commander here, too?
Ah, is this what you might call a lucky coincidence?
W-what's so lucky about this...?
Well, you hardly talk to anyone but Helena and me, no?
So why don't you try getting to know the Commander? You have the chance now that you're the secretary.
*Ugh*... That's none of your business, is it? And you, Commander, stay out of this!
It IS my business. We're friends, aren't we?
*Sigh*... You just want me to make a fool of myself again, don't you?
Sure, if that's what you want to call it then let's go with that.
I have a hunch that St. Louis can see straight through Honolulu's charade.
Putting that aside... What are your thoughts on these clothes?
What clo...?! W-w-what's your problem, displaying embarrassing stuff like this in public?! You're the only person on the planet who likes this stuff!
Well, I think they'd look great on you... Why not try them on just once?
I bet the Commander is curious as to how you'd look, too.
Whatever, do as you like... Don't be upset if it looks awful on me, cause I don't give a hoot...
I'll take that as an "OK"~ Then what about these...
*Sigh*...
Their conversation, if one could call it that, went on for surprisingly long.
I feel like I've come to understand Honolulu's character now.

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 3 - You've Got a Friend in Me!</size>

scripts.say: Honolulu, Leander, and I went to a café that I frequent.
Thanks for inviting me, Leander.
Not at all, it's my pleasure.
... But why are YOU here, Commander?

options.content: Say hello, this time with more energy

scripts.say: *Sigh*... Whatever, I can't muster the energy to care anymore...

Well, I first asked the Commander about us going here together, then the Commander told me "I really want to sit next to Honolulu," and since I too wish to get to know you better, I decided to invite you both.
... (Whispering) Yeah, there is...
Honolulu averted her gaze from me. She seemed displeased.
Um... I ordered a slice of cake for each of us. I hope you'll find it delectable.
The 3 of us sat down and enjoyed some good cake and afternoon tea.
... Ah, that reminds me: it seems you don't socialize much with other girls, Honolulu. Is there a reason for that?
... Yeah. It's because that's just the way I am.
Leander's question seemed to make Honolulu a little unhappy.
That's rather unfortunate... You're such a beautiful and wonderful person. You shouldn't be ashamed of who you are.
B-beautiful...? Me...?
Yes! Even your service record is something to admire. I've always wanted to get to know you better.
I'm certain that other people too would come to understand your splendor if you'd sit down and have a chat with them like this.
You are so splendid, in fact, that I would honestly say it makes me a little jealous.
...... T-thank you...
Hearing that, Honolulu's expression turned bright red and she began acting fidgety. Maybe nobody has ever praised her so much before.
I knew it was a good idea to invite Honolulu.
... W-why are you looking at me like you just made some kind of breakthrough...
Stupid jerk...
Honolulu averted her gaze from me again. This time she seemed embarrassed.

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Honolulu's Concerned?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Courtyard
I came across Honolulu and Helena as they were hanging out.
*Sigh*...
What's the matter, Helena?
Hm...? Oh, nothing, really.
Nothing, huh... Good...
Hey, uh...
Yeah? What is it?
... No, never mind. What did you have for lunch today?
Huh? Just the usual... And you?
R-right... Me, well... I guess the usual, too?
Sounds nice...
Hey, sorry, Cleveland's waiting for me, so I've gotta go.
Oh, okay. See you later.
I failed to start a conversation, again... *Sigh*...
I'm such a big and total moron...
How long have you been spying on us... *Sigh*... Whatever. It's hardly surprising to see you show up out of nowhere...
Honolulu drew a heavy sigh.
... I'm worried about Helena. And yet... I can't even properly ask her if she's okay. I'm such a helpless, stupid idiot...
Why should I have to take advice from you of all people...
Honolulu averted her gaze from me yet again. This time, however, while she seemed embarrassed, she didn't seem displeased.
But... as strange as it is... you might be able to understand my situation...
So... could you share some of your advice... with me?

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Honolulu's Bothered</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Honolulu took a seat in the office sofa and, after a few minutes, finally began talking.
... I'm easily flustered, and I'm not honest with people. I don't really get mad at people, but I can't speak my mind to them either...
That's me, in a nutshell. And you've put up with me the whole time...
Honolulu suddenly went silent. A short while later, she started talking again, with a hint of hesitation in her voice.
... A-as I was saying... I'm not bold like Louis, and I'm not elegant like Leander.
I can't imagine myself ever cheerfully smiling like some other girls do, either...

options.content: Assure her that it's all okay
Say you like her just the way she is

scripts.say: You're a strange one, you know that? ... *H-hmph*... *Ugh*...
Honolulu sighed, got off of the sofa, then walked behind me and started gently massaging my shoulders.
Listen, I don't act grumpy like this because I want to...
I wish I could hold a friendly conversation like Louis, or sit down and enjoy a refined cup of afternoon tea like Leander...
I want to smile and make friends, I want to express my concern and offer my comfort to Helena when she seems down...
Everyone else can do it with no effort, but I just can't manage.
Commander, you have to tell me what I should do...
Honolulu exposed her weak side to me, something she's never done before.

options.content: Propose going on a date together
Clarify that it's to buy a present for Helena

scripts.say: S-sure... I-I guess we can do that.
And so, I got Honolulu to agree to a "date" with me.

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 6 - A Date With Honolulu (Part 1)</size>

scripts.say: You're late, Commander.
I "seem to be in a good mood"? W-why does that matter...
I recognize those clothes... Lou showed me a picture of them in a magazine once.
They do look pretty nice, after all... *A-ahem*! Okay, that's enough window shopping! ... Come on, let's head to the next store.
... Honolulu seemed like she couldn't let up and relax.
Hey, that's a pretty cute teddy bear...
L-look, I didn't mean it like that ... I was just wondering if Helena might like it! C-c'mon, let's get a move on...
... I won't be able to have a conversation with her like this.
Sweets? ... I'm not in the mood... Let's just get something small to eat.
... What's the problem with that? Girls have to be mindful of their calorie intake!
We went around and checked every store in the district, and the present we ended up with was...
A cushion made to look like an SG radar.
I'm not sure if Helena will actually like it or not.
Excuse me, I'm pretty sure I know what Helena would like.
Honolulu glared at me.
Okay... I'll give this to her next time we meet. It should make her happy... probably...
I thought to myself that if Honolulu is convinced it'll work, then it was good enough.
Though she might not have realized it herself, right then the expression on her face wasn't one of displeasure, but of sincere kindness.
Wait, you bought something, too...? Judging by the wrapping, it must be expensive...
Mind if I ask... who it's for?

sequence:
An Easily Flustered Girl's Story

<size=45>Chapter 7 - A Date With Honolulu (Part 2)</size>

scripts.say: Honolulu was curiously ogling the present I had bought.
... Huh? It's for... me?
I hope for your sake this isn't a jack-in-the-box or something...
Honolulu left the bag containing the SG radar cushion on the floor and opened the large present I'd given her.
Wait... Isn't this... that teddy bear I saw earlier...?!
You went back and bought this just for me...?
... T-thank you...
Honolulu seemed to relax as she hugged the large teddy bear I'd given her.
She then took a deep breath, and it seemed like she was determined to say something...
I didn't tell you this during our chat the other day, but...
To tell you the truth, I thought you were just nice to me because you liked my big melons since I don't have any other attractive features or character traits...
But, as you began helping me solve my problems... I started thinking that, e-even if that is all you care about...
Honolulu was blushing. Her expression turned as deep red as her hair.
... That I might actually... like you...
Honolulu hid her face behind her teddy bear. Maybe she'd mustered every last bit of her courage to say of all that.
... W-wha...?! Geesh... N-next time, tell me before you do that...
... Thank you, Commander...

sequence:
Wallflower in the Corner

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Fateful Encounter</size>

scripts.say: One day at the Academy...
School is... pretty nice.
I can quietly stay in this corner and mind my own business...
Also... I can see a completely different side of people, hehe...
... Say your prayers!
Huh? That's...
Say your prayers! Today is the day that I finally teach you a lesson, Iroha!
Let's see you try, heh! But when I'm through with you, you'd better not run away crying and tattle to Yorktown!
Hmph! I will defeat you myself!
Ahaha, keep your boasting to your dreams! See that tree over there? Whoever tags it first wins, got it?
Hmph! Let's do it then!
Ready, get set–
Hammann, Iroha, what are you two doing?
Eek! Big sister Yorktown! Why are you here?
Today's missions ended early, so I just wanted to swing by to check on you.
Hehe, I see you're energetic as ever, Iroha.
H-h-h-h-hello there!
Hehe... There's no need to be nervous. We're all friends now~
Hammann hasn't been causing you any trouble, has she?
(shifts eyes)
N-not at all! As a matter of fact, we're g-good friends!
Aww, you two are friends now? I'm overjoyed to hear that~
However, Hammann has a bit of an attitude, so you'll have to forgive her for that...
Who has an attitude?!
