Oh, my. Impatient to eat my cooking again, Commander?
Before I could ask her what she'd made, she dragged me to her room, promising a surprise.
Port - Chi An's Room
Her thorough preparations are evident as she's even closed her curtains, leaving the room too dark to see anything.
My inability to see makes her warm breath against my ear stand out even more.
Are you ready for my surprise, Commander?
Heehee. Here it comes...
When she flips on the lights, I see several dishes under plate covers.
Chi An smiles and gently lifts the covers, revealing food that looks as good as it smells.
(Hmm... Well, it doesn't LOOK bad.)
A sight for sore eyes, isn't it, Commander?
It definitely looks a lot better than the last time.
(I'd just about call this a miracle.)
Compliment me all you like. Heehee.
After I taste-test it, sure.
Heehee, you're a tough customer. Then without further ado...
I accept the utensils from her and glance at the dishes before me. I'm stricken by incredible emotion.
This is the ultimate result of so much time and effort. Of so many trials overcome.
I have total faith that it won't betray my expectations.
*gasp*
A flavor beyond the reach of human language fills my mouth.
My senses of sight and taste send contradictory signals, leading to an intense debate between my brain and tongue.
I struggle to swallow it. If my stomach had a mouth, it would scream.
C-Commander, are you okay?
*cough*... *hack*... Give me a second...
I'm bearing the weight of her expectations. How could I tell her the truth? I can't.
Mmm... Well. It's hard to express how it tastes.
It's juicy... and very rich, I'll give you that.
Personally, I consider it... not bad.
Heehee. Of course.
Why are you laughing?
Because you're too kind to me.
You said it's "not bad," but that's not the truth, is it?
You're desperately trying to hide it, but your eyes don't lie.
You've indulged me so much and supported me unwaveringly when I was about to give up.
As someone who usually listens to other's troubles, it means so much to me that you've gone to such lengths to solve my own problem.
She leans in close and holds my face in both hands.
It may not taste as good as we'd hoped... but you've eaten the food that I put all my heart into.
Now, it's my turn.
To say what I couldn't say last night...
She unbuttons my shirt starting from the collar down, and the rest of her words fade between our lips.
The only therapy I need... is you♡

sequence:
Planning the Villa Vacation

<size=45>1 Strategic Investment Briefing</size>
"The Akashi Island Resort!"
"Summer, sunshine, the beach!"
"Get away from work and all the hustle and bustle!"
"Bring your beloved along..."
"And have a break in paradise."

scripts.say: Port - Office (Formerly)
Port - Executive Strategic Investment Briefing Room (Currently)
As soon as I enter my office, I'm greeted by the sight of a sign with some bizarre writing on it. Akashi is there, too.
Great, nya! Now everyone is here, nya.
Shiranui, escort our esteemed guests to the VIP seats, nya. The executive strategic investment briefing is starting, nya!
Clap, clap, clap.
Now, now, everyone settle down, nya.
Akashi shoots an ardent gaze at the "VIP seats," which only seat me.
First of all, I have a question for our kind and charitable guests, nya.
Would you like to go on a luxury vacation with your beloved, nya?
"Oh yeah, totally. I so wanna go on a vacation. Absolutely."
Nyahaha – I hear you loud and clear, nya!
In that case, please direct your attention to the screen, nya!
Introducing: The Akashi Island Resort, nya!
Summer, sunshine, the beach!

options.content: I've had plenty of all that.
So, got anything for me besides the marketing talk?

scripts.say: Ahem. In summary, this is the top-tier offering we've prepared specifically for big-time elite investors like you, nya!
Clap, clap, clap.
(They didn't even hire shills to clap along...)
(The direction this is going, though... Surely not...)
Nui, you can't just clap! Say your lines, nya!
Oh. Allow me to tell you about this island.
Its location is within a region specially selected by Akashi for its picturesque scenery.
Here, you'll find a grand villa representing state-of-the-art luxury and style.
It comes with all indoor and outdoor facilities – including space to host a hundred guests for drinks, and areas large enough to accommodate a thousand for activities.
Connections to the port are also excellent. Reachable within a day of travel.
It is truly an ultra-luxurious resort – a slice of paradise, a piece of heaven itself.
Bring your loved ones and treat them to the experience of a lifetime – to an unforgettable, perfect vacation.
"Whoa... That sounds amazing. I'm sold already."
"I wish I could live in such an amazing villa with my sweetheart."
The reservation is limited to just one person – only the finest for our distinguished VIPs, nya! Act now while you have the chance!
Akashi, are you really trying to sell me on real estate?
Heheheh – who do you take me for, nya?
If this was just any regular old plot of land, I wouldn't have prepared such an elaborate show, nya!
This is the cream of the crop – a top-tier property that passed both Shiranui's and my rigorous assessment, nya!
Even the nitpickiest of nitpickers will praise this as the ideal island, nya! And it looks even better in person, nya!
What sets this island apart from the port?
A beautiful beach and ocean view, nya?
Again, what sets it apart?
Uhh... It's fully furnished, nya? And it can hold 1,000 people, nya?
Still not seeing what makes it any special.
Err, umm... The luxury villa where you can live with your beloved, nya?
I'll ask one last time – what sets it apart from the port?
There's also an office on the island so you can work in a completely new environment, nya!
Okay, I'm sold!
I knew you'd be charitable, nya!
Heheh... Command– I mean, esteemed client, you've made an exceptionally wise decision, nya!
Now, please have a look at this exclusive vacation plan we've prepared for you, nya.
Buy it as a package deal to receive a whole 5% off, nya!

sequence:
Planning the Villa Vacation

<size=45>2 Negotiation Strategy</size>

scripts.say: After a lot of thinking, I came to the conclusion that having our yearly vacation on an island resort wasn't such a bad idea.
This brings us to today, in my office...
...And that's the long and short of it. What do you all think?
An island resort...? Heehee, that sounds like a pretty solid vacation spot.
Yeah. It's a good pick.
Um, Enterprise, I get the feeling she's picturing something completely different...
Honey, as long as you think it's good, I'm totally on board! Plus, we've never been to an island resort before.
I'm just as fine with staying at the port and taking it easy... Zzz...
Nothing's stopping you from sleeping on the island, too, you know.
Then I'm fine with either one... Zzz...
I think it could be interesting.
It even seems to have separate indoor and outdoor entertainment areas. You can tell they really made it with enjoyment as a top priority.
Yes, they've even got all the latest game consoles. They thought of the gamers amongst us, too.
But look at the price tag... It does make you think, doesn't it?
That asking price is... quite a number.
Assuming meals are free, you can eat all the baozi you want!
That's nice and all, but it doesn't even come close to justifying the cost.
I'll bet Akashi hiked this vacation's price as high as she could!
Yeah, I don't think we should let her rip us off like this.
I have an idea! We should all grill her about it!
Come on, I know how badly you all wanna go, it's written all over your faces!
But, in the eyes of that shrewd business cat, this looks exactly like an open invitation to set any price she pleases!
We're not just gonna sit here and let her scam us, are we?
Heck no!
Exactly! So basically, find as many flaws in this plan as you can so we can bring this price down!
Now things are getting interesting...
Ooh, ooh, lemme help!
Trust me, finding faults is my specialty. If we all work together, making that scam-cat cave in will be easy as pie!
Heheh! Now go and nitpick this thing to heck! For our wallets!

options.content: Is all this enthusiasm really warranted?
We don't really need to haggle...

scripts.say: Commander, sometimes you just have to take the bull by the horns. Or the cat.
Come on, people! Let's give this our all!
YEAH!
Sometime later...
Commander, I'm here, nya. Finished your inspection yet, nya?
...Nya? What do you mean you found 2,743 issues, nya?!
I... I have to respond to ALL of them, nya?!
Uhh... C-can we settle this with a 10% discount instead, nya?
Commander, I think it's best to go through all the issues in painstaking detail.
...How about 15%, nya?
Gang, we should just go on a different cruise this year. I'll pay.
I'll give you 20%, nya!
I wonder how the construction of new buildings on Seabreeze Island is progressing.
Another option we have is to renovate Dream Park instead.
Okay, 30%, nya!!!
Listen, Akashi. I will admit that I adore your slogan – "Bring your beloved along and have a break in paradise."
I also really want to go on this vacation, so this is your final chance – what's your price?
40%! A 40% discount, nya! I can't afford to go any lower, nya!
(Maybe just a teensy bit lower...)
*sob*... *sniff*... Nya...
Alright, alright, that'll do.
So we have an agreement now, right, nya?! No backsies, nya!
And no regrets or cancelations, nya! Thank you for your patronyage!
Then, Akashi bolted out at breakneck speed, and our vacation destination was officially set in stone.

sequence:
Planning the Villa Vacation

<size=45>3 Pre-Vacation Shopping</size>

scripts.say: The next day...
As soon as our vacation plan was confirmed, my desk was flooded with documents related to the preparations.
Well, not just documents – some other stuff snuck in there, too.
Like this. It's... one of Anchorage's drawings?
"Things Anchorage wanna do with the teacher on vacation"...
Looks like even she's excited about this vacation.
I'd better start preparing for this thing in earnest.
Speaking of which, I think Akashi said she'd provide everything from day-to-day items to luxury goods.
What did she call it again? Her "premium lavish vacation package deal," was it?
I wouldn't call it a "deal," but I digress. Let's see what it includes.
I dig the list out from the pile of papers, and a quick scan tells me this "lavish package" costs a good 30% more than buying all the items separately!
Man. She could've just ripped me off without saying anything, yet she still ends it with a "thank you."
I'll have Akagi deal with her later.
KNOCK KNOCK!
How's that paperwork going, Commander? Wanna visit the shopping district with us?
It's quite... bustling today.
Sounds like everyone's fired up. Are you two going shopping as well?
Yeah. As a treat. Wanna come with?
You know what? Since you asked, sure.
Even from a distance, it's clear the shopping district is packed today, much more so than usual.
Canned food, emergency rations, bandages, a first-aid kit... Alright, that's everything.
I know this is a vacation and all, but it doesn't hurt to be ready for an adventure along the way.
You're a pro survivalist alright – more concerned with safety than thrills.
Doing what it takes to survive is arguably much more exciting than run-of-the-mill "thrills."
Yup. I'll do anything to get caterpillar paste off my menu.
Eugh... That punishment sounds too extreme even for me.
We're all going there, and you poor things are getting left behind...
Alright... I'll bring you along on the vacation!
(That's so sweet of her, even if she's talking to a bunch of lobsters in a tank.)
Why are they squirming so desperately – for freedom?! Sis, just give up. They obviously aren't interested in going on vacation.
No, look back there. Don't you see the special price tag hanging by the fish tank?
Don't say another word. I know what to do now.
Kitty Kabam Punch charged and ready!
Wow, look! They're giving away samples of that new candy!
M-Mutsuki, don't run so fast. The candy's not going anywhere.
It's always candy with you kiddies. I came to the snacks section to find something more interesting. Like depth charges.
Ooh, "Manjuu-elly beans in all flavors – a different happy taste in each one"!
That sounds yummy! I want that!
Nom, nom... Wait, I know this flavor!
It tastes like the Comainder!
Really? L-let me have a taste of it!
Umm, I'll try it... Huh? This one just tastes like fruit...
There's a real energy here today. Everyone's so enthusiastic.
Which area should we visit first, Commander?
Let me guess – you're going to say the office supplies, right?
I heard there's an office space on the island. You were gonna secretly work during our vacation, weren't you?
...I like to think of it as a workcation.
Fine, we're going to the snacks area first!
I want this to be a FUN shopping trip!
Come on, Commander and Helena!

sequence:
Planning the Villa Vacation

<size=45>4 Swimsuits and the Wind</size>

scripts.say: The day of the voyage is approaching.
Thanks to the port's excellent logistics and Akagi's outstanding "negotiation" skills, all the vacation supplies had been neatly stacked by the docks, waiting to be loaded up.
Meanwhile, the passengers are moving on to a more... "private" part of their preparations.
When it comes to island vacations...
The most anticipated thing is going to the beach!
And if you're going to the beach, you need swimsuits and beachwear. Heehee.
Which means what clothes we pick here will be an important surprise.
We did invite you to come along for it, but there will be absolutely no peeking – understood?
The girls all run off, and I sit alone in the waiting area, starting to think about my plans for the near future.
Just then, though, a hand reaches out from behind the curtain right ahead and gestures for me to come closer.
...Yoohoo! Come here, Commander!
I need you to be my personal fashion advisor. Don't worry, this place is safe!
I go in, and Pamiat' Merkuria, holding a garment in each hand, beams and gives a little twirl.
Which do you think's cutest?
I could put 'em on and show you, maybe♪
Come ooon, I prepared this well in advance!
Don't worry about what the other girls will think. Let them take what time they need.
...It'll ruin the surprise if I do? Heheh, good news for you: I have many more surprises up my sleeve!
For instance...
Which one makes your heart race – the black one, or the white one?
At the same time, on an island in the port's vicinity...
*pant*... *pant*... There!
Just need to pass this bend and I'll have finished my quota for today!
Gosh, I've worked up such a sweat... I suppose I'll do some stretches while letting the sea breeze cool me off.
...Hm? Is that a sort of reddish-purple I'm seeing in the sunset glow? That's an unusual sight...
Reddish-purple sunset... Purple... I feel like I've read about that somewhere. I think the Commander showed it to me...
Dang it, I can't remember!
Haha, I thought I'd learned something new, but I guess I just imagined it.
...That's odd. Why does the breeze feel stuffy and not cool in the least?
Meh, it's nothing! Time to head back!

sequence:
Planning the Villa Vacation

<size=45>5 Putting the Ow in Meow</size>

scripts.say: Over on the horizon, a surging thunderstorm engulfed the last rays of sunlight.
The clouds massing over the sea were as grey as lead, swirling like immense, boiling waves.
The wind howled ever louder, rain hammering down as nature unleashed its most primitive fury.
Then, a deafening thunderclap ripped the sky in two. That was when the cold reality of the situation chilled their hopeful hearts.
G-God, please listen, nya!
If I've done anything wrong, then I'm the only one who should be punished for it, nya!
Please just leave my most precious belongings alone, nya!
My island! My villa!
My money! My geeems!

sequence: All of this began in the early hours of the morning...

scripts.say: Early Morning - Office
There you are, Commander!
Yeah. I saw Nakhimov open the emergency line. What's the situation?
Sorry for bothering you this early.
While Fargo and I were monitoring today's route, we... We discovered something terrible concerning the island resort.
Nya?! What has happened to my island resort, nya?!
Our instruments are picking up some worrying signs around the island: the water temperature's exceeded 27℃, sea surface salinity has plunged, and vortices are starting to develop at low altitudes.
Also, thunderclouds are gathering in the sky, and the pressure at their center is rapidly decreasing.
Commander, we are dealing with a hurricane.
It is on a direct course toward our villa.
DIRECT COURSE, NYA?!
No, no, let's stay calm, nya... I took measures against hurricanes while designing the villa, nya!
Hurricanes at this time of year aren't typically too strong, nya. It'll knock over some outdoor tables at worst, nya!
The hurricane isn't the only problem. Around the same time it was detected, we also recorded a significant burst of seabed activity.
Fargo and I believe there was an eruption from an underwater volcano in the area around the island.
An... An underwater volcanic eruption, nya?
Furthermore, the violent seafloor activity caused a series of earthquakes.
E-earthquakes, nya?!
There was also a tsunami.
Tsunami... Tsunami, nya?!
A hurricane, an underwater eruption, earthquakes, and even a tsunami...
Is the island going to be okay, Akashi?
It's done for... My dream island resort that was gonna make me a fortune is done for, nya...
G-God, please listen, nya!
If I've done anything wrong, then I'm the only one who should be punished for it, nya!
Please just leave my most precious belongings alone, nya!
My island! My villa!
My money! My geeems!
How could this all be happening... So this is what they mean by "even the best-laid plans can go awry"?
Commander, I think we should reconsider the vacation now.
It's over, nya... It's all over, nya...
Hmm. I suppose we could find a different location?
But then again, the whole port was so excited about this island vacation, and Akashi poured a ton of work into it.
I'd hate to tell them that the island plan is off all of a sudden.
In that case, I have a proposal. Everyone, may I please have your attention?
Please go on.
Commander, as I recall it, you haven't yet officially signed the sales contract of the island.
In light of what's occurred, I believe the sum that you agreed upon needs to be revised.
Actually, "revise" isn't the right word. I believe it's better to render the contract null and void, given the circumstances.
Wouldn't you agree, Akashi?
Nyaaa...
As it so happens, I've carefully inspected the specifics of that island villa over the past few days.
Honestly, I must say that Akashi has an excellent eye for assets.
If we put aside this exceedingly rare and unfortunate incident, this private resort is indeed of the utmost quality.
Therefore, my suggestion is this: How about proceeding with the purchase at a rock-bottom price?
We should still buy the villa? ...And you're saying a rock-bottom price?!
Yes. Everyone does seem quite enthusiastic about this vacation, after all.
It should be more than possible to repair the villa if we all work together.
I'd say that this is an excellent opportunity to get a top-notch asset at a bargain price – wouldn't you agree?
Y-you vulture, nya!
It's either that or canceling the contract altogether.
You may of course do the repairs yourself, although I suspect that the cost would be astronomical.
Hmph... There's no denying that, nya...
Fine, how about a 50% discount, nya?
Make it 99%.
NYINETY-NYINE?!
If you won't accept that, then the deal is off.
You don't want this to be a complete loss, do you?
Fine, nya... We have a deal, nya...
Great, then we can write the contract right now. A pleasure doing business with you.
Nya...
Akashi and Ting An soon leave the room with haste.
I never knew Ting An could be so unrelenting.
I suppose this is quite the plot twist, huh?
Which means...
Our island resort vacation is still on! We can't let Akashi down!
Although, we'll have to change the plan a little bit.
Roger. I'll draft a reconstruction plan and start allocating resources.
Ahh... This one-of-a-kind villa vacation is going to be amazing.
Right, Commander~?

sequence: To Be Continued
<size=51>A fated new encounter</size>
<size=51>An unknown ordeal, on the horizon</size>
<size=51>Venuses from a faraway land have arrived</size>
<size=51>How will the girls of the azure sea face them?</size>
<size=51>Go forth! Dance! Seek the ultimate beauty!</size>
<size=51>Soon shall Vacation Island manifest itself,</size>
<size=51>and the special Venus Festival will commence with it</size>

scripts.say: One day, a strange letter turned up on my desk in the office.
Ahaha, I don't know what to make of this... not at all.
Like you said, I don't get what this is supposed to be at all.
An advance notice of a crime...?
But it doesn't feel like there's any ill intent. If anything, it feels like a broadcast announcement...?
Is it just a prank? I'm not sure there's any point in thinking about it...
Commander, I have a report for you. Would you... like to read it?
Oh right, you were in the middle of working! I got distracted by this weird letter...
Huh? There's a new island in the vicinity of the port?
Is that the "Vacation Island" that the letter talked about...?
It looks like it wasn't just a prank...
Seems like there's no point thinking about it... Commander! We'll go ahead and take a look!
We will?
She's right. It's best if we just go ahead and check it out for ourselves.
All right! Z23, Ayanami, Laffey, we're heading out!
Woo~!
H-hold on a minute! This should be treated as the mission it is! We're not just going there to play around!
The Venus Festival... For some reason, I get the feeling that this is going to end up being a huge mess...
Tired of waiting, nya? It's time to commence the third round, nya!
Introducing: the red team, with a bond of friendship as strong as sisters, nya! It's Marie Rose and Honoka!
Our tag team is the strongest under the sun!
Hehehe! Let's give this our best shot, Marie!
The blue team, with a bond strengthened over many years, it's Her Majesty's ardent supporters: Warspite and Belfast, nya!
Bel! Show them the elegant grace of the Royal Maids!
Warspite, show them the Royal Navy's glory! Especially to that pink one... What's with her size, anyway?! Urghghh... Prove to her that flat is justice!
S-surely you jest?!
Y-Your Majesty, please, calm down...!
Geez, stop bothering Honoka... But you know, I'm super excited to get this show on the road! Let's have some fun, Maid Lady!
Hehe, then I hope my sincerity will reach you as I battle to my utmost.
Somehow, I'm compelled to cheer for Warspite's side... Ahem! Anyway then, let the next round begin, nya!
Honoka, look out!
Right! *boing*
Ugh... So bouncy...
Have yourselves a taste of this!
...Hah! *boing*
Oh my, nya!
This is our chance! Honoka, with me!
Hiyah! *boooing*
Not so fast, ladies!
Oh dear, oh dear... The Commander seems to have suffered a nosebleed...
It's a featured fight... in many ways...
A-and there you have it! That was a battle that you couldn't take your eyes off of, nya... But I think I've had enough melons for one summer, nya...
Akashi?!
Wow... You really gave us a run for our money, Maid Lady!
I'm quite impressed with you two. Your teamwork was truly impeccable.
Hehe, Marie and I are besties~ You two fought well, too! It was like... you perfectly understood each other, even without saying a single world!
I-it seems like our match was the focus of today for a certain reason, but... it was quite a fun battle regardless! Thank you for the game!
Geez, you're making me blush~
Get a hold of yourself, Akashi... A professional MC can't be shaken up this easily, nya! Okay, um, we'll continue with the final round after this short break!
Hmm... The progress is still listed at 85%, and I still can't trace the source of the signal, nya...
There's not much we can do. It's probably one of you-know-who's plans anyway... For now, let's just work on getting it to 100%.
On that note, looks like the final round will feature...
Nyotengu, nya... She's a literal legend among us from the Sakura Empire...
Hmm... Who should I put up against her...
If you're unsure, why not ask your elders for advice?
Nya?! You surprised me there, Mikasa...
I was shocked to see the demon of legends. Even more so when she turned out to be exceedingly kind.
Hehehe. Strangely, Mikasa and I think much alike.
Speak of the devil, nya! Or should I say "tengu," nya...
Did I scare you, little green kitty?
I have a name, you know, nya! I'm Akashi, not just "green kitty," nya!
As they say: when in doubt, turn to people with more expertise.

options.content: "Who do you think I should choose, Mikasa?"

scripts.say: When faced with an age-old adversary, who else could prove a better match than some unpredictable young'uns?

Some young'uns? I know not what you mean, but trifling beings as yourselves need not hold anything back. It need not be a one-on-one match, either. I'll allow multiple opponents, just allow me to have fun, dear Commander~
The "young'uns," eh...
We've had a wonderful show so far, haven't we, nya? Now it's time to close it off... with the final round, nya!
It's unfortunate that the show is almost over, but all good things must come to an end, nya...
Anyway! Allow me to introduce the last contestants, nya!
The red team! The demon of legend, Nyotengu!
Hehehe, I've been waiting for this moment.
The blue team, chosen by the Commander, is none other than... Oh my, nya! The rising stars of the Sakura Empire, Shoukaku and Zuikaku, of the 5th Carrier Divison!
Shoukaku, Zuikaku, this is your moment!
Oh, nice! So this is the demon of legend, Nyotengu... Nothing we can't handle, though! It's nice to meet you, Miss Nyotengu!
Hoh, what a lively one. Let us see if you live up to my expectations, hehehe.
Shame that we're not the ones on stage, but we'll leave it to you. Don't let us down, 5th.
To think I was passed over for them... Oh, Commander, you can be such a prankster sometimes~ Expect lots and lots of love and cuddles as my form of payback.
Hah! I promise we won't let you down, great and honorable Akagi~
Hehehe. The sight of you Sakura Empire lasses brings me such nostalgia. Perhaps there is a bond that connects us. Now, entertain me!
Let's go!
Oh boy... Um, final round, start, nya!
Hehehe, that's not enough! That much won't do!
The legends of her power were true after all... And she still isn't going all-out on us...
Maybe not, but we haven't exhausted our bag of tricks just yet!
Ooh, majestic... Just as Mikasa said, you young'uns don't disappoint!
Hiii-yaaaaaahhhhh!
Aaand, stop!
Hehe, you two did well. That battle made my heart dance with joy!
I feel as though I'm about to keel over and die... Ugh...
Ahaha, yeah, I'm dead tired. But... somehow, that felt refreshing.
Nyotengu appears content, and Shoukaku and Zuikaku seem to have learned something from this battle. I'll have to thank Mikasa for her great advice.
And that marks the end of our Special Venus Festival, nya! Everyone, great work, nya!
Commander! There's a new message on the terminal!
"All Missions complete. A teleportation device is being sent to Vacation Island at Coordinates (XXX,XXX)"
Following the terminal's coordinates, we were able to find the teleportation device on Vacation Island.
Even though there was nothing here before... This really must have only just appeared, nya...
A new message flashes on the terminal.
"Will you activate the teleportation device? <YES> <NO>"
Looks like it's time for us all to part ways.
Waaah! Marie... Everyone... Please take careeee!
Aww... Even though it's been a short stay, I had a really fun time with you all!
Come on, Marie. The time for farewells is the time to put on your biggest smile. You're even making me... *sob*...
Thank you for all your help! Without you, we wouldn't be able to go back. I don't know how we can thank you enough...
Commander, everyone... I'd love to invite you all to the Venus Islands to show our gratitude, but...
I'd accept it in a heartbeat.
*stare*...
I'm joking, of course.
Akashi... Everyone... really, thank you so much for taking such good care of us! You too, Commander! ...Really, we owe you, bigtime!
Even though you've taken a lot of impure glances at Misaki... you worked hard for our sake, so... I'll forgive you, just this once... you silly dog.
Everyone must part ways some day, but our bond shall remain strong. Undoubtedly, we shall meet again sometime, hehehe.
She's right, as sad as it is. We all must part ways some day...
The teleporter activates and glows brightly. Right after, an elliptical portal appears in front of the girls.
No matter how unwilling I was, I knew that we would have to say goodbye one day. And that day had come.
I can't be gloomy now. Time to see them off with a smile.
Hmm, what's this? Commander, the terminal has a new message, nya!
"Teleporter activation complete. The teleporter will be active for a period of 7 hours every 168 hours. Note that only certain entities are able to travel through this portal."
It can work on its own?!
"Mission complete. Terminal deactivating. Have a pleasant vacation."
Oh... the terminal stopped working...
Umm, then that means... we can come here anytime, right?
Yep! I'm so happy that our farewell doesn't have to be forever...!
Heheh, looks like I have plenty of pleasant chats with the Sakura Empire girls to look forward to!
And I've still yet to make some high-stakes bets with all of you~♪
Isn't this great, sis?
I-I don't really care...! But, well, if you're happy, then I'm happy too.
Hehehe. It would seem we still have much fun ahead of us.
Through some stroke of luck, our vacation with our new friends just received a new lease on life.
Hahah, we've gotten the data we need for now.
I must ask... Do we really get any meaningful data out of playing around like this?
Contact with different beings will inevitably cause some kind of change. Who knows, perhaps we will discover something interesting this way.
Hey, has anyone seen my mind? I think I lost it somewhere while waiting for some action. All data collection and no play makes Purifier a dull girl.
So what did we learn? Beach volleyball? Is it really that fun?
Care to give it a try?
...Never mind I asked. I think I'll stick to twiddling my thumbs for fun.
...Target spotted! So that's the island that was mentioned in Akashi's report!
It's so close to the port... How did we not notice it until now?
Something spotted right in front of us... Is it an inflatable boat?
An enemy...? Should we prepare for combat?
It looks like they aren't armed... oh, they've noticed us!
It doesn't look like they want to fight. Let's check their status first.
Thank god you guys noticed us...! My name is Kasumi. Are you all... from the nearby island?
Kasumi...? Hi, my name is Z23. I am a shipgirl here on a mission to investigate this area. This is Ayanami, Laffey, and Javelin.
Ship...girl? Come to think of it, you're floating on the water... Almost as if aided by some kind of ninjutsu...
Ninjutsu? Sounds like something our Sakura Empire friends would say.
I'm... not using ninjutsu.
I can't believe they wouldn't know what we are...
Is this the "new meeting" the letter foretold...? Kasumi, did you come here from that island over there?
Yes, it's a bit hard to explain, but... when I woke up, I was here, along with everyone else...
Oh. Might you all be... the "Friends of the Green Catgirl"...?
Are you... talking about Akashi?
Eh? Are you acquainted with Akashi?
...It really is just as was written in the letter... Um, won't you come over to where we've set up camp for now? Once there, I can explain a bit more.
Oh, Kasumi, were you out until now? Welcome back!
Thanks, Marie. I'm back, everyone.
Hmm? It looks like more people have joined our entourage...
Let me introduce these guys, the group of people I just made contact with – Z23, Javelin, Ayanami, and Laffey.
And the people over there are my friends... The ones who came from the Venus Islands with me.
My name is Marie Rose! But you can just call me Marie.
It's nice to meet you. I'm Honoka! Um... let's be friends!
Hey there! I'm Misaki. Nice to meet you!
Hello there. I'm Nagisa, Misaki's big sister. I'm not sure how to feel about this sudden meeting, but... it's nice to meet you all.
I'm the dealer, Monica! ...Well, dealer-in-training, to be specific. It's nice to meet you all, heheh.
Nyotengu is my name. What an interesting presence you all possess...
Some time later...
Now I see. You are shipgirls, are you? And the things you're donning are... riggings, intended for use against Sirens. How very interesting.
So you received a request from the Commander, which resulted in your meeting with Kasumi.
All we know about you is that you all are participating in an event called the Venus Festival. We received an advance notice a few days ago...
At that time, we were quite shocked! ...But we had food and a place to stay, so it wasn't too bad.
There was even a pool and a court for beach volleyball... I thought they were quite similar to the Venus Islands.
Also, we found this strange letter while looking around...
It's the same as the one that the Commander received...
It looks like we were both set up by someone... I wonder by whom...
This is... some kind of communication device?
There's a screen, so it feels sort of like a tablet.
Ooh! It looks like something's written on it!
"Venuses who have arrived from far away, welcome to Vacation Island!"
"Have no fear. During your pleasant stay at the Vacation Islands, if you complete the missions that are bestowed upon you, the road back home will reveal itself."
"Main Mission: Participate in this world's Special Venus Festival, and show off your exquisite selves in a competition against the girls of the azure sea."
"Secondary mission: Seek the joyful company of the friends of the green cat (Complete)"
Joyful company of the friends...
Huh... I feel like I'm completely out of the loop.
Hahaha... And there ended up being an inflatable boat around here, so I figured I'd check out the surroundings... And that's when I met with you guys.
Hmm? It looks like we've received another message.
"Secondary mission: Head to the port, and acquire the power of riggings from the green cat."
I'm getting serious deja vu here...
F-for now... Denizens of the... Venus Islands? Please come to the port! We'll need to report the ongoing events to the Commander as well.
A few days later, at a nearby ocean area...
So this is a rigging...? I'm getting a very peculiar feeling from these things.
Woah! I'm really floating on the surface of the sea! Ahahah, this is fun~
Marie, be careful... If you fall into the water, you'll be in trouble.
Misaki, are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?
I'm fine, don't worry! With this, we can travel on water! I've got to admit, it's pretty exciting!
The breeze feels so nice~ Heheh, I'll have to make sure to thank Akashi later~
What ingenious craftsmanship... That green catgirl is more capable than meets the eye.
Ahem... I'm glad that you all seem to be pleased with the results, nya! This rigging is the result of all of my hard work, and I poured my heart and soul into making it, nya. Be careful with it, nya.
Well then, what shall we do now?
For now, all that's left is to prepare for the Special Venus Festival that's coming up, nya. Try to get as used to the riggings as you can, nya!
I really can't believe that the Special Venus Festival is going to happen just like this...
Commander, the guests have arrived! I think they've also been looking around for Akashi!
Hmm? I see the residents of that island, nya. Do they need anything from me, nya?

It's nice to meet you. From what I've heard, you're the Commander, right? And this must be the green cat... um, I mean, Akashi... right? I'm Kasumi. These are the people I know from the Venus Islands.
...And that's how we ended up bringing them back to the port.
Hmm... So this is the communication terminal, nya? Show it to me, nya... The green catgirl... how rude of them, nya.
Not only were Akashi and the rigging mentioned in the terminal, but there was also some other interesting bits written on it.

options.content: "Could someone explain this Venus Festival thing to me?"

scripts.say: I'll go ahead and answer that! Seeing that I work part-time as festival staff, and all~

The Venus Festival is a huge festival that occurs in the Venus Islands, where summer never ends. The girls the island's Owner enters into the festival are called Venuses, and the goal is to make them shine as brightly as they can! There's also the goal of trying to earn a lot of money, so we can turn the island into a huge resort.
Interesting...
Commander, you're starting to smile creepily...
*stare*...
Oops. How careless of me.
These "girls of the azure sea"... That's us, right? We're going to compete too?
"A battle between worlds"... surely that doesn't mean we have to...
...Do battle?
If we are, then I won't go down without a fight...
Mm... It looks like this terminal can only receive signals, with no way to... Nya? A new message came through, nya.
"Main Mission: Use the power of the rigging to participate in an exercise in the Special Venus Festival, and show off your exquisite selves with the girls of the azure sea (Mission Progress: 0%)"
An exercise... If I recall correctly, there was one planned to happen soon...

options.content: "Akashi, seeing as you're the technology expert here..."

scripts.say: Hm? The next mission... you want me to figure out who the sender is too, nya? I guess we must complete this mission to get newer ones, nya... I got it! Leave the preparations to me, nya!
Ooh... as expected of Akashi!
You guys need to help out too! I'm going to make your lives hell, nya~!
Ahaha, I don't really get it, but... we'll help out, too!
I've placed the training ship in the ocean nearby, nya! Use that to practice against for the time being, nya!
Okay~!
Now that the preparations are complete, the long-awaited festival finally begins.
Hehe~ I made sure to make this quite the show! The special training exercise, Special Venus Festival, starts now, nya! Leave the casting to me, the annyauncer!
In this exercise, the red team of Venuses will compete against the blue team under the Commander, nya! Win or lose, show us your exquisite forms in this battle, nya!
By the way, you're using special ammo, so nobody will be hurt in this battle, nya!
Now let's begin, nya! First, we'll introduce the red team!
The beauty who tells fortunes in her free time, Kasumi, and the dealer-in-training, Monica! Nya!
Heheh, we're up first, it seems! Let's go get 'em!
Kasumi! Monica! We're all cheering you on, so do your best~!
Oh? The enemy appears to be... a group of super cute girls!
Next up is the blue team, nya! The one with the wooden sword is Takao, and the beaut with overflowing passion, that's Atago, nya!
It's an honor to be relied upon by the Commander, but... why are we in swimsuits?!
That's because it's the Special Venus Festival! Don't you think swimsuits fit the atmosphere better? Hehehe~
Takao, your swimsuit is way too cute!
Ugh... Th-thank you...
Well, let's get started! Best of luck to you!
Indeed... May the best duelist win!
Well then... Begin, nya!
I wasn't expecting an easy fight against a renowned shipgirl... but I refuse to lose! Now's my chance to deliver the decisive strike!
Not so fast! Hi-yaaaaah!
The crowd breaks into a cheer at the display of perfect offense and defense.
Aaaand stop! Both teams put on an equally stunning performance, nya!
Simply amazing! I would've never expected you two to be so powerful, Kasumi and Monica... It looks as if I still have a long way to go.
Heheh, you're pretty good too! Not only are you super cute, but you've also got some serious skill to boot~
N-no, you flatter me...
Heheh~ How about participating in the Venus Festival along with us, Takao?
P-pardon?!
No, I mean it! Come on, how about playing us in a serious match of beach volleyball?
Sounds like a great idea~
That about does it for the first round, nya! Everyone, we're going into an intermission! I'll see you all for round two, nya!
Commander, there's a change in the terminal, nya!
It said 0% progress before, but now it's at 28.5%. How is it keeping track of what's happening?
Who knows... I still haven't pinpointed the originator, nya...
It looks like we'll just have to keep an eye on it as we proceed.
Aaaand we're back, nya! The second battle will begin in just a moment, nya!
This time, it'll be a battle of sisters, nya! Representing the red team, we have Misaki and Nagisa, and fighting for the blue team, Admiral Hipper and Prinz Eugen, nya!
Fighting dressed up like this... I'm not really sure what I'm supposed to be doing here, but... I'm excited to be battling side-by-side with you, big sis. Let's do our best!
Misaki... I don't want you to get hurt. Be careful, okay?
I'll be fine~ Akashi told us that we're using special ammo, remember?
I know, but... don't let your guard down. You're my precious little sister... I'll protect you, so make sure to stay behind me at all times!
You really don't need to... I'd like to shoot some rounds, too...
Would you look at that. Sisters versus sisters. The Commander must have a kink for that sort of stuff, heheh.
Quit being snarky and focus, Eugen! Are you ready or what?
Ooh, feeling nervous because the Commander has high hopes for you, "big" sis?
Me? Nervous? Hah! You're just imagining things!
Right. My overactive imagination is the only explanation for why your hands are shaking.
I-it's called shivering! I'm feeling a bit cold, that's all!
That girl with the silver hair looks pretty formidable... So she's the little sister on their side, huh?
You think so? All I know is I wanna chat 'em up!
Well, what a coincidence. I was thinking much the same. We could talk about... sisterhood, and such.
Sure! We could totally hang out!
Wh-whatever, just focus on the exercise!
Misaki, are you ready?
Are you done there yet, nya? Good! Then the second round staaaarts... now, nya!
Misaki, to your left!
Got it! Hiyah!
Not on my watch!
Ooh. Nice save, "big" sis.
Their cooperation is flawless. Just what you'd expect from sisters.
Aaand stop! Both sides displayed incredible teamwork, nya! Almost makes me wish I had my own sister, nya.
Whew... Well, that wasn't bad. Are you all right, Misaki?
Geez, you're such a worrywart... Look at me, I'm perfectly fine. There's not even a single scratch on me~
Hehe. Seems we're both blessed with good sisters.
Ahahah, looks like it~
Though, I do wish she'd work on her flattitude problems.
Excuse me?! That's not even a word!
Ahaha... she really is quite the formidable little sister, isn't she...
That makes two of us!
Two as in... you too?
As the two sides enjoy their postgame chitchat, a third party enters the picture.
Did someone say "little sister"?! Here is your complimentary Indy merch as a symbol of our newfound friendship! Now let us praise Indy together!
Portland, please, this is embarrassing... Sorry, everyone, my sister can be a serious annoyance sometimes...
W-wait a sec! I haven't even gotten to preach Indy's greatness yet! I just need one minuuuute!
I-I guess... sisters really do come in all shapes and sizes...
Think of them as flavors. There's one out there for everyone.
W-well then, the second round is finished! Once again, we'll go into an intermission! Look forward to the next round, nya!
With that chance encounter came exciting new vibes to the port. Now that the Venus girls have time for a vacation, how will they spend it?

sequence:
Vacation Lane - Cozy Days

<size=45>1 Care for a Crepe?</size>

scripts.say: Come one, come all to Akashi's Crepe Stand! We've got more flavors than you can shake a stick at! You name it, we have it!
Woo, we're really raking in the money today, nya!
Heck yeah we are! I didn't expect them to be such a smash hit.
Well, it was, and you came up with it, nya. You've got the makings of an entrepreneur, nya!
Hehehe~ Please, it was just a stroke of luck~
Oh, we have another customer! Welcome, nya!
Hey! What can I ge– Oh, hi, big sis! And the Commander, too! Fancy seeing you two together.
W-we just... ran into each other, that's all! Nothing more to it!
Here I am, with Nagisa, at her sister's crepe stand. You're probably wondering how I ended up in this situation.
Hey, why don't we go for some crepes?
Why crepes, in particular?
Well... Akashi opened a crepe stand, remember? And Misaki is working there, part-time...
A-anyway! I'm in the mood for one! So, do you want to go, or not? I don't have all day... silly dog.
Ah, so she wants to check on Misaki. What a considerate big sister she has.
...And the rest is history.
Lucky for you, we have a special offer for you today! Buy one crepe, get one free, nya~
Whichever you order, I promise they're all delicious! My personal favorite might be the mango vanilla, though~
That sounds pretty good, actually.
Well, if you think it's good, then I guess...
We pretty much have to go for it.

options.content: We'll have two mango vanilla crepes.

scripts.say: Coming right up! ...Hey, something you wanna say, big sis? Is there something on my face?
N-no, it's nothing! But on another note: it was your idea to set up a crepe stand, wasn't it?
Yup! I wanted to share these tasty treats with the whole world! Oh, and big sis, I'm sure you and the Commander will find your crepes are tastier if you eat them together~
I told you! We simply ran into each other... Come here now, silly dog. We're leaving.
Thank you for your patronyage~
Nagisa and I bid farewell to them and go for a brief walk.
Listen... I was so worried if Misaki would be okay when we first arrived here...
But now that I know she's safe and doing perfectly fine, my worries have eased up a little.
...What? What are you grinning for, you silly dog?!
Ah, what a considerate big sister she is.

sequence:
Vacation Lane - Cozy Days

<size=45>2 Sandcastle Showdown</size>

scripts.say: Hey, Honoka! We're building a sandcastle! Come on!
Sounds good to me! Let's get to it!
Fetching sandcastle blueprints from database. Proceeding to construction phase.
Now 'tis time to prove myself! I mustn't let my training have been for naught!
Fancy ourselves beachside architects, do we? Well, I shall be waiting to see your finalized creations.
Ooh, are we all making sandcastles? That sounds like fun!
We need a judge to determine whose is best, though... Oh, I know! Let's have the Commander decide!
Seemingly out of the blue, a competition to see who can build the best sandcastle began.
After a lot of digging, sculpting, and molding, everyone's sandcastles were finally complete.
What did we make? Well, have a look... Ta-daaaah!
Marie and Honoka's creation is a giant sphere, donned with a necktie and a navy cap. It looks a lot like...
Hmm. Nice and round, almost like a delectable manjuu~ Though, it bears more resemblance to a cat.
It appears to be a massive... Meowfficer? Charming, I must confess... However! Mine has its own merits!
Ah, this is a traditional Sakura Empire castle, is it not? We mayhaps share aesthetic tastes, you and I.
Whoooaa! That's amazing, Takao!
Let's see what our resident champion, Gascogne, came up with.
Oh my gosh... It's some kind of arch with fancy patterns etched into it!
Why, it looks like it came straight out of a museum!
Analysis: this sandcastle was constructed in the likeness of the Arc de Triomphe.
Ah-haha! This certainly is beyond my expectations! Fantastic!
So, Commander, which do you think is the best? You're the judge!
Whichever it is you like the most, you can only choose one!
Let your heart guide your choice, Commander.
Requesting Master's assessment.
It's not easy to choose when they're all so good... Hmm...

sequence:
Vacation Lane - Cozy Days

<size=45>3 Luck of the Draw</size>

scripts.say: Monica asked me to come with her, saying she had something she wanted to do together.
What could it be? Poker? Roulette? Or something else entirely?
Thank you for letting me have some of your precious time!
I'm working on one of my important dealer skills, and I need someone to assist. The stakes are higher than ever! Or, I wish I could say that, but just pretend a lot is on the line, okay?
Now, have a look here. There is one ace of hearts, and one joker card. You see them, right?
Good! There's only one rule: if you pick out the ace of hearts, you win!
I guess I just need to get lucky. It's a fifty-fifty chance.
Okay, now I will shuffle the cards. Would you mind closing your eyes, Commander? And no peeking!
I do as she asks and cover up my eyes.
All right, you can open your eyes now.
When I open my eyes, I see Monica has one of the cards held between her fingers.
Where's the other? Did she hide it somewhere?
The other? Heheh, why, it's right HERE!
Gulp...
She has the other card between her breasts.
Well~? Which card do you choose, Commander~?
I reach for the card between her breasts, take it out, and flip it over... It's the joker card.
Hehe~ You lose, Commander.
Tsk-tsk, Commander. You shouldn't let your base instincts take over like that.
I pull out the card between her fingers and reveal its face... It's the ace of hearts.
Hehe~ You win, Commander~
Dang, I was sure that trick was gonna work on you... Oh well!
That's all for now! We'll see each other sooner or later, I promise~

sequence:
Vacation Lane - Cozy Days

<size=45>4 Tales from the Sakura Empire</size>

scripts.say: Holy smokes, the legends were real after all! We're talking to a real-life greater tengu!
Shh, Zuikaku. I share your amazement, but it's rude to address someone like that.
I do not mind. I've lived for far too long to fuss over inconsequential details such as that.
I must say, so much of the Sakura Empire feels so pleasantly familiar to the place that I'm from.
I even ran into some girls who claimed to be ninjas! It was so much fun chatting with them.
Hahah. I'm pleased to hear you are enjoying your stay here.
I've brought some tea. Would anyone like a cup?
I do not mind. I've lived for far too long to fuss over inconsequential details such as that.
They have temples where they worship the gods, and shrine maidens that tend to them. Where, I wonder, do the similarities end?
Not there, at least. I heard Honoka learned this world's customary shrine maiden dance from the girls at one of the temples.
Always eager to learn new things, that lass. Ah-haha.
Truly, this place is teeming with novel and fascinating things. Not least of all, these "riggings" as they call them.
You seemed to adapt to them quickly, almost as though battling comes second nature to you.
You could say that again... Nyotengu was THIS close to beating us!
Ah-haha. You put up a fierce fight, though. I had my share of fun.
Hahaha! I taught you juniors well! Clearly, you've not yet met your match.
When we first arrived here, I was really worried about how we'd fare... But it turns out I got worked up over nothing. We've all had so much fun already!
The hot springs weren't so bad either.
It might be time I visit one again soon... My shoulders have been aching terribly of late.
Oh, they have? Want me to give you a massage?
Hehe. It's heartwarming, seeing everyone get along like this.
Well, I am pining for a hot spring visit. Will you any of you join me? Your company would be more amusing than that of some wild simians~
The port's newest recruits bring not only their skills to the table, but a smile to everyone's face. And so, the Venus girls' vacation continues.
The long-awaited cruise ship is finally finished.
Harbin cuts the ribbon with a pair of scissors, then breaks a bottle of champagne against the bow. The ship has been launched and is ready to cruise.
As I marvel at the luxurious vessel before me, I suddenly remember something very important.

(All sorts of wild proposals had been flooding in, and I'm pretty sure Long Island was randomly rubber-stamping things on a whim... I need to double-check what actually made it into the final proposal.)
I carefully go through all the ship's facilities and their layouts one at a time.
A mall, a nightclub, an arcade... Hmm, these are all fine.
But did we NEED an aquarium, a garden, an ammo depot, and a cat lodge?
Don't tell me EVERYTHING ended up getting approved...
It was I who approved the cat lodge. It felt pertinent to have a place for people to wind down.
As for all the rest, there is a logical reason behind each one of them.
Indeed. It was all planned out based on logic, dear human.
Emden joins the conversation just as Richelieu starts explaining the logic behind the layout.
"Emden shall guide you to the heart of the ship. Come along now."
(The heart? Guess she means the bridge. It won't hurt to check where the ship is headed.)
Alright. Lead the way.
Richelieu bids me goodbye with a quick bow, then I head to the bridge with Emden.
As I peer out from the bridge's window, the land gradually recedes until I am surrounded by a vast, boundless blue.
Here you can see where the ship is going, my darling human. "You must have yearned for a cruise such as this, human. Heehee."
Hmm... Are we going to Seabreeze Island first? The place from last year?
That's correct. Seabreeze Island shall be our first destination; then we will do a tour of the tropics before returning to port.
"This itinerary was created to maximize your leisure and comfort. You should be grateful to Emden."
In other words, you haven't decided on where exactly we're going afterwards?
I suppose that is so. Do you prefer having everything planned out for you?
If you so wish, Emden can alter the plan for you, my darling human. "If that's what you want, then beg for it."
Well... The essence of a vacation is being able to kick back and relax without having to worry about anything.
So yeah, I don't mind going with the flow.
Heehee. If you say so. "Emden has no objections."
(Come to think of it, we didn't run into any kooky visitors or get any strange letters all the way from construction to launch.)
(As it stands, the cruise is on a surprisingly smooth course.)
(That makes me think we won't get stranded by a tempest and be forced to survive on a desert island this time.)
You seem to be brooding, my darling human. You have nothing to worry about.
We've planned for every possible scenario during this cruise. "Set aside your concerns and simply enjoy your vacation."
Yeah, you're right... What could go wrong?
I set aside my unfounded fears and again gaze out the window at the boundless sea.
I'm sure it'll be smooth sailing from here on out!
RING RING RING! RING RING RING!
There's that ringtone again. It's Memphis.
Good morning, Commander. I was tasked with briefing you today. Shall we meet at your workstation again?
Cruise Ship - Workspace
The ship has arrived at our destination. However, at this time of year, the South Pole experiences polar night. Please pay special attention to your circadian rhythm.
We plan to begin our trip to port tomorrow, so there are no particular events planned for today.
Tomorrow already, huh... It feels like we left on this vacation just yesterday.
Agreed. That just goes to show that time flies when you're having fun.
Treasure today while you still can, Commander! I'm doing the same, so I'm leaving now!
Thanks. I'll follow your lead.
With that, she leaves my workspace. After cleaning up some odds and ends, I grab my hat and step out onto the deck.
I'm instantly faced with a sky the likes of which I'd never seen before. The aurora hangs down from above as curtains of light, covering the sky and stars.
(Going with the flow is one thing, but I never expected our vacation to end this way.)
(Along the way, everyone had all sorts of fun in their own ways. That's enough to make me happy.)
Yo, Commander! You're finally here.
I was just chatting with everyone. A lot happened during this trip, but we've all had fun.
How about you? Did you enjoy it?
A lot really has happened, but I can't think of any of it that wasn't fun. I know I'm satisfied.
Ahaha, that's great! Going through the work to make this a thing was worth it, then.
Take a look over there, Commander. Everyone's got a few words for you.
Harbin pats me on the shoulder. I turn around and see everyone waving at me.
We won't bother asking if you had fun! How can one not have fun when Queen Elizabeth herself is involved?
Hehe! You just loved your vacation with Sister Sara, didn't you?
Make no mistake, Commander, your presence was a key factor in everyone having such a wonderful time.
That's right. Commander, you're our axis and our core alike. Don't forget to relax and enjoy yourself, though.
Whoa... There's something about that smile that makes me shudder.
Uh, anyway, that's not important! I'm here to thank you for helping us investigate the mysteries of the cruise, Commander!
Sooner or later, you're sure to become a legendary investigator... I gotta work harder so I can keep up with you!
Heheh. Basically, honey, everyone thinks you're the best!♪
We all got to enjoy our time together thanks to you!
Teacher... Anchorage had lots of fun! I want... to go on more and more vacations with you!
I think I speak for all of us when I say this vacation was like a dream come true, Commander. I'll cherish these memories forever.
Spending time with the Commander AND seeing all these pretty sights? Heheh, when you remember the aurora, you'd better think of me!
Seeing the beautiful aurora made the whole trip worthwhile~ But I still don't have the most important part of my collection. Commander, I'm waiting for you with open arms~♡
*yaaawn*... I don't like all the effort, but if it means getting to be with you... I can handle a little, I guess...
(Everyone really felt this way?)
Know what? I say we should end this vacation with a feast. Who's with me?
You want to start putting together a banquet now? Surely we won't make it in time.
We must let Dunkerque and the others rest, too. Would we be able to swing it without them?
Easy-peasy! We can just have a barbecue on deck.
Barbecue? Y-you want to start another bonfire...?
Don't worry! If you're that scared, then let's just barbecue over charcoal! Hell, let everyone barbecue their own food, and we won't have to ask the chefs for help.
You do have a point... Shall we go with her idea?
Yeah. Let's do it!
Alright, everyone! Let's gather on the cruise ship's garden! It's spacious enough to be perfect for a barbecue!
Everyone scampers off to prepare for the barbecue at once.
(We're going to savor this last day under the aurora, I swear it.)
Human, my darling human, it's time to wake up~ "Are you just begging for Emden's punishment?"
Morning, Emden.
In the morning, Emden comes to my bedside. By now, I've gotten wholly used to the sight of this.
Heehee♡ The cruise ship is already on its way back. But... "A new variable has appeared, human."
A variable?
(As in, a chance occurrence? To be fair, a lot of unexpected things have happened so far, but now of all times?)
Emden did promise to spirit you off to blissful paradise...
And if you so desired, it would be trivial for Emden to take the ship on just the slightest detour...
"But Emden did not cause this trouble. See for yourself, human."
I make myself presentable and step out on deck.
For some reason, Tempesta are still there. I remember they claimed that they planned to go home after we all saw the aurora together.
Well hello there, Commander~ As you can see, we won't be able to go back to our base for a while...
Surely we won't be stuck here forever, right?
I wouldn't mind... Things are less of a bother here, and I get better sleep.
Can't you just call forth another tempest and go through there? Like you did when you came here?
Commander, have you ever seen a storm near the South Pole?
Yes...?
*cough!* *cough!* Well, uh, OUR tempests can only show up when on blue seas under blue skies!
(Very well thought out excuse... Well, I'm happy to let them stay here as long as they want.)
Shame. In that case, try to withstand your homesickness and hang out with us for a few more–
WOOHOO!
After appeasing the pirates of Tempesta, I decide to make my way to the wheelhouse.
There, Emden awaits.
She's in the middle of writing something in her little notepad again.
Heehee. What did you think, my darling human? Did you find your answer?
The white Emden closes her notepad a little, tucks her hair behind her ear, and smiles...
Are the Tempesta shipgirls the only other conspirators?
Heehee, good question. "Probing for an answer now would be boorish, human."
"Just enjoy your vacation and all of its surprises♥" Emden's darling human♡
Outside the window, the aurora still dazzles in the sky.

sequence: Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure THE END

scripts.say: After a late-night call from Bristol, I come to the so-called "mystery room" at the ship's stern.
A holiday cruise, a vacation paradise.
Luxury, comfort, leisure, highlights of our time together.
But light always casts a shadow!
Bang, bang! Clap, clap! Dadadadadum!
I received a revelation within a dream. When the stars align...
Seven mysteries will come to light on this ship!
Everyone is destined to be affected! Including YOU, dear listener!
You will! Unless you make the perfect decisions at every turn, that is!
Prove to all of us that you have the sagacity and bravery to pursue the truth!
Now, join the Investigation Committee!
Come, be the detective you were born to be!

options.content: ...You woke all of us up for this?
Can I go back to bed now?

scripts.say: I knew you would, Commander!
I hereby declare the official formation of the Cruise Mystery-Solving Investigation Committee!
C-Commander, wait! We're just getting to the good stuff!
Ahem! I hereby declare the official formation of the Cruise Mystery-Solving Investigation Committee!
C-Commander, wait! We're just getting to the good stuff!
Ahem! I hereby declare the official formation of the Cruise Mystery-Solving Investigation Committee!
Naturally, I will be the captain and investigator numero uno! Codename: Lamplight Scholar!
Fu Shun, investigator number two, reporting in! Codename: Overlord of Adventure!
Wherever the news goes, I follow! Investigator three, Alfredo Oriani, the Turbo Journo!
Ugh, so this is why you called us all here...
Let them have their fun. Commander, let's go.
Hey, wait a sec! I really need a scribe for this one! Please!
Uuugh...
Heheh, we got ourselves a scribe for the Turbo Journo! Let's see, your codename can be...
I don't want one.
Okay, Scribe it is. Alsace, your turn!
Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, guardian of the Holy See, sword of the Commander – Alsace, Cold-Blooded Killing Machine, joins the fray!
Commander, let's pursue the mysteries of this ship and corner the truth!

options.content: Wait, run that last nickname by me again?

scripts.say: Heheh. I will have my fill of combat during this investigation, so Bristol gave me the nickname. One has no objections. It's a cool name!
Bristol, what did you say to convince her?
I just told her you were coming. That wasn't a lie!
So, Commander, you're investigator four! Codename: Mysterious Assistant!
Do you like it? Exciting, isn't it? Thrilling, even?!
(Honestly, I had a feeling this would happen the moment I saw Bristol and Fu Shun.)
(Mysterious Assistant, huh? It's okay for a codename, I guess. But...)
Do you actually expect crazy mysteries on a brand-new cruise ship?
Yes, yes! They'll be wild!
Help us investigate, Commander! It'll be fun!
Your involvement will make it a whole lot likelier that mysteries will pop up, too.
Come again?
A-ahem! That's just how, uh, awesome you are!
By the way, where are Fei Yuen and Albacore? You'd think they would be all over something like this...
Hush! They're in the middle of an undercover investigation!
Undercover?
They blend into crowds, listen in to conversations for any clues, and provide a compiled list of leads to us investigators.
So they're informants.
Now, I hereby declare the first Special Investigation Committee meeting a success!
Commander, keep an eye out for anything weird on the cruise starting tomorrow!
We'll let you know if we hear anything. K.I.T. – keep in touch!
Thus, the investigation of the cruise's seven mysteries began.
Forget seven, though – would there be any mysteries to investigate?
Bristol gave us the order to assemble, so I go back to the mystery room.
Coolly analyzing the situation, deftly navigating the scene, elegantly unveiling the truth – Detective Essex has formally joined the investigation team!
Hehe... I figured collaborating with a team would be better than working all alone.
Thank you! Together, we will seize the truth!
Hmm... Just "Detective," I guess? If that's too plain, then you can call me the Private Eye of Justice!
Now, back on topic. I'd like to reveal the clues I've collected so far.
Essex starts sticking notes she'd written on various mysteries onto the whiteboard.
Hmm... So many mysteries, in just two days.
There are even some that happened a little while ago!
Yes, and even some that I experienced firsthand. Now, as you can see, I've divided them into two groups based on time and type.
First, let's look at the mystery of the strange note.
Thanks to the tireless work of our investigators, we have three clues.
Clue the first: a note under the tray. A wet note was found under a tray in the maid café. The only legible words on it were "come" and "afar."
Clue the second: the crushed bushes. Something left a roughly 30 centimeter big imprint on a bush in the onboard garden.
Clue the third: noise in the gym. Strange sounds like a heavy object being dragged have been heard in various places around the gym.
That is all. What do you think of the incident so far, Commander?

options.content: This might sound like it's out of left field, but...

scripts.say: If we want to solve this, we'll need to investigate further.
Well said, Commander. I like your firm and precise decision-making.
The note happened to end up under the tray. Everything else is coincidence and can be explained with logic.
Oh, REALLY? I think I smell a cover-up!
Could it be a giant squid monster that can write and move at supersonic speed?
...C-come again?
Whoa... That's an awesome idea! I'm voting for the Commander's hypothesis!
Ahem. Now, the second mystery from tonight – food has been disappearing.
We've collected three clues for this one, too.
Clue the first: the stolen stuffing. A container full of freshly-cut meat stuffing vanished in the blink of an eye from the kitchen.
Clue the second: the ransacked fridge. The food storage in the banquet hall was looted. Primarily food that contains meat was stolen.
Clue the third: the untouched warehouse. The warehouse, despite having more food than anywhere else on the ship, has gone completely unscathed.
Umm... Does the third one count as a clue?
We wouldn't have enough if we didn't include it, so yes!
A-ahem. Commander, a penny for your thoughts?

options.content: This might sound like it's out of left field, but...

scripts.say: This still isn't enough. We need further investigation.
Again...? Surely you're being too careful.
Someone was watching too much food porn and couldn't handle the hunger pangs anymore.
Um... The meat stuffing was raw, Commander. Would any of us eat that?
Were they hankering for steak tartare? Understandable... But one must object to stealing food!
Are you serious?
What if it's a giant squid monster? But like, one that hates veggies and can hack security cameras?
A giant squid monster...?
That's an incredible conclusion, Commander. I gotta write an article about this!
Thank you for your opinions. That concludes our meeting for today!
Everyone, return to your duties and keep up the good work!
Cruise Ship - Warehouse
Commander, Fu Shun, Essex, Alfredo, Ema, Alsace... and me, Bristol. Yep, the gang's all here.
Yeah! So? Out with it! What do we do now, Captain?
Naturally... it's time to review our third mystery!
Then why did we gather here in the warehouse instead of the mystery room?
I think we'll have a freer range of motion here. Don't worry, Commander. I'll explain everything.
We still have time before we get started, so let's review the third case: the ghost of the cabin quarter.
Once again, we have exactly three clues.
Clue the first: footsteps in the night. Mysterious footsteps can be heard from a corridor near the cabins late at night.
Clue the second: spirit photography. Alfredo Oriani got a picture of a ghost in one corridor.
Clue the third: the inescapable corridor. In one corridor, a thick fog appears and disorients people passing through.
As usual, Commander, I'd like to hear your thoughts.

options.content: All of these have logical explanations.
I have an idea who the culprit is.
Okay, bear with me here. No – SQUID with me here.

scripts.say: Well, all of this can be explained with science. There isn't even a mystery here. It's all just dumb rumors.
Yeah! And that means that this series of events was all artificially set up!
We've already identified the suspect, too!
Water vapor, sea fog, ghosts... Tempesta has to be behind this.
Incredible, Commander... You reached that conclusion this quickly? It took us hours of discussion to figure it out.
Because the ghost might just be a giant squid monster that can disappear and spew sea fog at will.
*sigh*... Commander, now isn't the time for jokes.
I think we can all agree that Tempesta must be the culprits behind this series of events.
I've found it strange ever since the ship was attacked.
Tempesta has to pass through a storm to come to our world. Don't you find it a little convenient that they'd appear at the perfect place and time to get in our way?
This leads us naturally to one answer: Tempesta sent informants onto the cruise ship ahead of time. They coordinated the ambush.
The sounds of dragging things, strange noises, disappearing food, water vapor, and sea fog... All of it is evidence that someone with Tempesta is on board.
The clue we found while investigating the ghost is the most damning of all. Tempesta just happens to have one shipgirl who can turn invisible, does it not?
And what do you know, that same girl didn't appear during the attack today!
It's Mary Celeste!
Exactly! She's the culprit behind everything that's been happening!
Mary definitely does seem to be the likely culprit.
So, we know who the mastermind is. I still don't understand why we assembled in the warehouse today.
To catch her red-handed, of course! Heheh, Essex set a brilliant trap. Our prey should take the bait any minute now!
A trap?
Earlier, feigning small talk, I told Mary Celeste at the wharf that you would be coming to take inventory in the warehouse tonight. Alone.
She was visibly disturbed. By then, I already knew that I had her in my grasp.
Shh. Everyone but the Commander, hide. The pressure sensor I set up just went off – someone's coming.
The sound of footsteps suddenly becomes audible in the seemingly empty warehouse.
When the sound stops, suddenly, something soft presses against my back.
(Phew... I can finally be alone with the Commander...)
(Something's really wrong with this cruise ship. I can go invisible, and it's still so darn hard to get close to you!)
Ahem. Don't move! Yarrr, I be a pirate!
A silhouette emerges out of thin air. It's Mary Celeste.
Our hypothesis from before was right on the money. Mary Celeste and her pet, the giant squid(?) monster Argo, are the ones behind all of these mysteries.
*snap!*
Heheh, got my evidence!
Finally, the adventure reaches its climax!
The truth of the seven mysteries will now be unveiled!
There can only be one truth: Mary Celeste, you are the culprit!
Cold-Hearted Killing Machine, entering extermination mode!
W-wait, wait, wait! You don't have to go that far!
Hahaha... I can't believe you got me that fast. And you even set a trap... Not bad, not bad at all.
I admit defeat. You got me. What are you gonna do to me, Commander?
Hmm... Illegal boarding, food theft, attempted kidnapping...
H-huh? You're actually planning to punish me?!
I'm kidding. But it is true that your flippant actions have caused trouble for everyone else on the cruise. How do you plan to make up for that?
Heheh, easy! I've already got a plan.
A late-night bonfire party at Tempesta HQ. All are invited! How's that sound?
According to our informants, Albacore and Fei Yuen, more mysteries have cropped up all over the cruise ship.
The aquarium, classroom, ammunition depot, and more have been affected.
Thus, the Cruise Mystery-Solving Investigation Committee holds an emergency meeting.
Ahem! Thank you all for coming on such short notice!
I trust you were all briefed on the reason for this emergency meeting on your way here!
One admits utmost surprise... How could it happen again?
Heheh. I knew we solved those last three too easily. There had to be more to it!
After all, it's supposed to be SEVEN mysteries. Three is less than seven!
Now, suspect number one, we'd like your testimony. Do you have anything to say about this?
You have the right to remain silent. Anything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law.
I didn't do anything this time! I swear on my afterlife!
This cruise has already been hijacked by Tempesta, right? We did what we came here for. Why would I have anything left to hide?
Besides, you got me on my pranks already. I'm not stupid enough to keep trying.
Hmm... You do have a point.
In that case... Is this one a real mystery?!
Or could there be another mastermind lurking in the shadows?
(I had a feeling already. This seems to confirm it.)
I'd like to confirm a few things about the chance of someone else pulling the strings.

options.content: The first thing I want to ask is...

scripts.say: Mary, have you heard the rumors of an inescapable corridor?
Inescapable corridor... Nope. First I've heard of it.
During our previous investigation, we discovered a certain corridor in the cabin quarters where thick sea fog caused people to lose their sense of direction. Did you set that up?
Hmm... Nah, doubt that's me.
I went through plenty of corridors when I was looking for food, and I didn't make any fog to throw people off. Never needed to.
I thought so.

options.content: Next, I want to ask you...

scripts.say: Essex, if you had to choose between joining me for a drink at the open bar or continuing your work as a detective, which would you choose?
I don't even have to think! I'd choose going to the bar with you, of course!
Hmm... Okay.
(Now... We can't answer the last question here.)
(It's about the very first mystery – that note that said "come" and "afar.")
(No... I might just have my guess already.)
(But I lack evidence. I'd better observe for a little longer.)
On the final night before our return, Detective Essex summons me one last time. This time, we meet on the unloading deck.
You finally arrive, Commander. Are you ready to begin our final investigation?
"Essex" smiles, waiting for my reply.
The final of the seven mysteries, of course...
...Whether Detective Essex is real or fake.
Go on, Mysterious Assistant. Tell me your hypothesis.
Confessing already? That makes things easier for me.
The real Essex did, of course, assist in the investigations. But there's no doubt that there was a fake in our midst at times.
More specifically, the Essex that came to meetings was real, while the one there for investigations was an impostor.
As for the real identity of the fake Essex...
Heheheh♪ Not bad! You didn't just arrive at the truth – you discerned everything at every step of the way.
I noticed something was off ever since we met in the gym.
When I invited you to the bar, you refused and said you wanted to keep investigating.
The real Essex would never refuse that offer.
But it was clever how you used Mary as a scapegoat.
This is a big ship, and a lot has happened. You knew that I don't have the time and energy to verify everything.
You used that fact to your advantage. There were several times when I had my doubts, but every time, my attention was diverted somewhere else.
I only realized it after we'd apprehended Mary and I was able to look back to the first night when the mysteries started cropping up.
Last night was when I first became certain that it was you – and that you'd have no reason to hide it anymore.
And so you predicted that I would summon you tonight?
Yeah. You maneuvered so I would, too, didn't you?
Heehee. I see, I see~ Why don't you call your friends for help, then?
Do you want me to do that?
Why do you think I wouldn't?
Heehee. I admit that I blundered when you invited me to the bar. I could've never imagined that was how you got me.
I'll be more careful next time.
Next time? Are you going to do this again?
Don't you want me to?
Your Observer, come from afar, bids you farewell. I had so much fun... this round.
When I arrive at the banquet, I find that Harbin is already there, waiting for me.
Great of you to show, Commander! Been waiting for you.
C'mere, don't just stand there. Hey, everyone! The Commander's arrived! Open 'er up!
A beautiful sight unfolds – the banquet is filled with people laughing, chatting, and generally having a good time.
There are tables lined from end to end with various cuisines. There is even an ornate dessert stand atop one of them.
Whaddya think? Really gets the stomach grumbling, doesn't it? Have a seat and chow down!
For sure! Tons of good grub livens up any party.
I had crates and crates of ingredients shipped in from the Empery to give everyone a taste of our home.
Of course, I couldn't have done it alone. All the folks who helped are the party's real MVPs! Ahahah!
The chefs 'mong us are flexing their cooking muscles in the kitchen, so all you gotta do is enjoy their food!
Hmph. I hoped to flaunt the Royal Islands' traditional cuisine, but the plebeians all insisted we keep it strictly to tea and desserts...
"They're so delicious we can't get them out of our mind," they said. Bollocks! Suit yourselves, then!
(She's complaining, but she's happy in spite of that. Thank god I won't have to eat Royal cuisine this time.)
*sigh*... And I wanted to display my cooking skills as well, but the Security Committee stopped me.
I've been practicing really hard, I promise! I just wanted you to taste how far I've come, Commander...
Even YOU don't believe me? *sob*... I'm hurt...
No, I mean that there's more than enough food as it is and I'd hate to see it go to waste. You can cook just for me another time.
Don't be sad. There's always next time.
The cruise only just started. You'll get your chance to cook soon! For now, just enjoy the party.
You mean it? You have to promise you'll eat what I make, then!
As the celebrations continue, I see Richelieu leisurely walk up to the center of the hall, wine glass in hand.
My dear friends, thank you for gathering here today to celebrate this voyage.
She will surely carry us on many luxurious pleasure cruises. Though she was built through all our efforts, none of those efforts would've been possible without the Commander's support.
I'd like to call the Commander up to give us a few words.
(Wait, what? Nobody said I'd have to deliver a speech!)
Sensing my hesitation, Bismarck in the seat next to me chimes in to encourage me.
This is your responsibility as a leader. It's okay if it's off the cuff.
I know you can handle yourself.
No backing off when the spotlight calls your name, huh?
I push my chair back a bit, pick up a wine glass, and rise to my feet.
Thank you, everyone, for creating and gathering at this place. Without you, this cruise ship would've never gotten off the ground.
I don't have anything profound to say, only this – I hope you have a relaxing, pleasant cruise.
Cheers to us all!
Cheers!
Cheers.
You too, servant. Cheers!
Cheers to us all!
Cheers!
Cheers♡
It warms my heart to see every last one of us gathered in one place.
I raise this toast for you in particular, Comrade Commander.
