Don't we all? Together with you, Commander, we're all headed for a better tomorrow.
Amids clattering glasses and jubilant toasts, the party reaches its climax.
I've had my fill, so it's time to get up and have a walk around the ship.
I arrive at the water park at the appointed time.
There you are, honey! I've been waiting for you!
Sara will give you the rules rundown. I've got to prepare the ace up my sleeve meanwhile.
The indomitable Black Dragon has something amazing in store for you. You'll see what soon!
Without another word, New Jersey runs off in a hurry.
Hiii! Your favorite dazzling idol is here to explain the rules for you!
This time there won't be any teams – it'll be a free-for-all. That means everyone needs to try their hardest to win!
Now, normally, you'd use paintballs and score by the number of hits, buuut washing off paint is a huge pain. I was at a loss...
Until I suggested using custom-made Tribunal water guns with sensors.
Clemenceau joins the conversation, smiling and wearing sports attire.
When the gun hits a target, it will be automatically recorded on the score screen. No mess, no cleanup required.
What she said! Her idea saved me a huuuge headache.
Since it'll be a battle royale-style match, we've also set the time limit to just 30 minutes to make it interesting.
When the time is up, whoever got hit the most has to do a water-based trust fall as punishment.
Heehee. An interesting punishment. I can't wait to see how you'll do, Commander.
Wait, don't tell me... YOU'RE participating too?
Oh, no. Jean Bart is, though. She's quick on the draw, which gives her much better odds of winning than I.
Good luck, Commander. You'll need it to survive the siege that is to come.
Don't expect me to hold back on you! Heehee!
(This place is going to be a battlefield... but I'm not going down without a fight!)
My best efforts to find cover were for nothing. In less than five minutes, I'd been shot from all directions by practically everyone.
Many people pursued me recklessly, even to the point where they'd blatantly expose themselves just to get a shot at me.
(In these scenarios, I need to pick the time when I move carefully...)
Where are you looking? I'm right over here!
Uh-oh!
Move, Commander! I'll cover you!
Hey, this is a free-for-all! You're not allowed to form teams!
While Enterprise is busy drawing Saratoga's attention, New Jersey sees an opening and sneaks up behind me.
I've got you now, honey!
Pew, pew!
Even though New Jersey landed a hit on me, it could've been much worse – Enterprise's covering fire allowed me to get out of there.
On one side, Marco Polo is chasing Memphis around. On the other, Roon and Akagi are engaged in a fierce battle to the death. Rhetorically speaking.
Meanwhile, Bismarck has seized the high ground. She's picking off everyone who tries to come and get her.
Looks like I've found your hiding spot, Comrade Commander.
Ack!
Soyuz has her water gun out, but I squeeze the trigger first. My beam of water hits her hand, scoring a hit.
The fight rages on and I manage to make it to new cover, only to find that it's already occupied...
Ugh... It's just you. Don't worry, I won't shoot.
You're more than welcome to shoot me, though. Then I can call it quits and just sleep.
D-don't look at me like that! I just happened to still be here when the match started, so I guess they count me as an active participant.
Fighting is tiring, you know? So I thought I'd wait it out here. Can you please get it over with and shoot me already?
Well, if that's what you want...
I aim my water gun and casually take the shot.
Thanks. One bit of advice before I go – watch your back.
What's that supposed to– Aw, crap!
Got you!
Left at Jean Bart's mercy with nowhere to run, it should be no surprise that I received the most hits out of anyone.
As decided, I'm made to stand by the poolside and perform a trust fall.
I lost, so I'm just going to accept my fate!
I lean back and fall. Just as I think I'm about to land with a splash, the girls all stop my fall.
I've got you!
Heehee. I'd never betray your trust, honey!
Can you feel my warm love seeping through you, Commander?
Joyful laughter erupts beneath the clear, blue sky, and my heart beats with happiness.
I had a great time with the girls, then changed into a dry set of clothes.
There's still a long while to go before bed, so let's have another look around.
I've verified that there's nothing left to help with on the ship, so I've decided to make landfall on Seabreeze Island.
(This place brings back fond memories.)
(It started with a treasure hunt, and ended with all of us building vacation infrastructure here.)
(And let's not forget my exchanges with Royal Fortune. Ahh, how time flies.)
(If I remember right, this is where the turtles have made their– Huh?)
Heeelp! Laffey is drowniiing! Somebody heeelp!
She's drowning?! Hang on, I'm coming!
I run like the wind to where Javelin is pointing and find Laffey floating face-up in the water.
Help her! Quick!
(Wait... did I imagine it, or is she moving around?)

options.content: (Come closer and have a better look.)

scripts.say: Javelin, shhh. Try to keep quiet.
(Oh, okay!)
Phew... She was just sleeping on the back of a big turtle. I was really worried there for a minute.
Let's wake her up. The turtle is heading into deep water, which actually puts her at risk of drowning.
In the midst of our exchange, Laffey opens her eyes.
Mmgh... It's you two... Did you have to wake me up?
I'm still sleepy... I'm going back to bed... Zzz...
No, Laffey! If you wanna sleep, find a safer place to do it!
I don't wanna get up... I'm not going anywhere...
(If she won't get up and do it, I'll just have to carry her there.)
Javelin and I carry Laffey away from the water and to a safer place. After that, I resume my walk.
Sometime later, I find myself near the vegetable garden.
Hey, is that...? It's the Commander.
Good day, Commander.
Hi! Do you wanna make a wreath with us? Hanazuki is really good at it!
Hanazuki, Ning Hai, and Ping Hai wave at me from the garden.
Another time, maybe! I'm on a walk right now.
I understand. Still, would you mind waiting here just a minute?
Ning, Ping, I'd like to make a big wreath as a gift for the Commander. Will you help?
- Yeah! - Let's do it!
The three of them made a beautiful wreath for me. I put it on my head then start walking again.
(I should be getting near the volcano now... Hm? Is that Marco Polo? What's she doing here?)
Volcano! It is I, Marco Polo! I have returned!
Magnificent! The monument I left to commemorate Sardegna's conquering of the island is still there!
Please don't tell me you're thinking about moving it...
That is exactly what I'm thinking! It's what you're here for! Take this monument and load it on the ship back to the port, where it may better spread my name!
Oh, you're here, Commander. You must agree that taking the monument home is a good idea, no?
She spots me and catches me off guard with a question.
Uhh...
(That thing is massively heavy. Our ship is already loaded with cargo and we'll sink dangerously low if we overburden it.)
(And if that wasn't an issue, where would you even fit it in the port?)
Marco, I have a good idea what to do with the statue.
(Where'd Clemenceau come from? I never knew she was here.)
Do you, now? Let's hear this idea of yours.
If it's prestige you want, leaving it here is the way to go.
The next time someone reaches this summit, they'll see the monument and know that you, Marco Polo, conquered this volcano long ago.
And if you want something to commemorate our visit, why not build a new statue on the ship?
It'll be light enough to transport and more meaningful than this old statue. Think about it – there was no statue on the ship before we set off, was there?
Good point... Yes, that idea has merit! Da Vinci, come with me! We must look for the perfect place to put that statue!
Come on! Chop-chop!
What? Hey! Wait!
Marco Polo and da Vinci quietly leave the volcano. Only I and Clemenceau are left.
Bravo, mastermind of the Tribunal. You found an opening and nipped the problem in the bud.
I think it only went so well because I know how what makes Marco tick.
She's actually quite easy to get along with. You know that, don't you?
I suppose so.
Anyway, enough beating around the bush. I've got a message for you.
Z23's group finished their assigned work from last time. They're doing the final checks right now.
The island's infrastructure should be almost entirely finished now.
It'll soon begin operations, producing material and serving as a supply stockpile.
Okay, and where is the paperwork? Do I need to go and find Z23?
No need. She will pass on the paperwork to Memphis, post-review. All you need to do is relax and enjoy yourself.
Clemenceau and I part ways, after which I go to a seagull roosting spot on the island.
(Ayanami isn't here, nor are there any birds. I'll just go somewhere else, then.)
An hour or two later, we all start walking back to the cruise ship.
After killing some time on the island, it's time to get back on board.
My first night aboard was great. It was the first time in a long while that I got to sleep without having to worry about the ever-looming specter of work.
Man, how great it felt to not be woken up by an alarm clock, but rather by the warm rays of sunlight on my cheeks.
(Wait a sec... I'm pretty sure I closed the curtains before I went to sleep. Why is there sunlight shining on me...?)
My eyes pop open as if seeking an answer to that question – and then, I see Emden's mischievous face right next to mine.
She's just sitting there in bed, looking down at me.
E-Emden?!
Heehee. Good morning, my darling human. "We kept watch while you were asleep. You should be grateful."
Now that you're awake, please get changed and come with me to your workstation. I would like to brief you on our navigational status.
I do as asked, quickly showering and getting changed before heading over to the workstation.
As soon as I open the door, I'm immediately awestruck by an uncanny wave of familiarity.
Surprised? We perfectly recreated your office one-to-one so you would feel at home.
Wow. It really is a perfect copy.
It even comes with the same feeling of mounting dread as mountains of work loom before me...
I wish you could see the look on your face right now, my darling human. "Heehee. It makes me want to coddle you."
But, before there can be coddling, Emden needs to formally report how the cruise is going.
Everything aboard the ship is functioning well. As for the sea, visibility is excellent and the waters are as calm as can be. Unless we run into bad weather, we'll reach Seabreeze Island on schedule.
There will be a party later to celebrate the ship's virgin voyage. Your attendance would be appreciated.
Also, since the ship requires maintenance, the task of giving you reports and schedule updates will be carried out in shifts.
Shifts? Wait, so you're not the only one responsible for that task?
"Your wording implies you can't imagine being without Emden, hmm?" As much as we'd like to have you all to ourselves, that's just how it is.
You should expect to receive reports from Memphis and Long Island later.
Today is your first day of receiving reports, so Emden will take a little longer than the rest. "It's out of concern for you, human."
Moving forward, our reports will be more brief and to the point.
Alright. It's good to know I have a whole team to keep me in the loop.
It is. There are also events planned for specific hours of the day, and we'll remind you of them as we give you our morning reports.
"In other words, you can spend your time however you see fit outside of those events." There are all kinds of leisure facilities onboard for you to try in that time.
Emdeeen! You're taking too long! I told you, you should just do like me and keep it to a quick phone call!
A familiar voice rings out as Long Island barges into my workspace.
(Is she straight-up admitting she'll half-ass it? Suddenly, I'm not sure Long Island is suited for this job.)
...Why are you giving me that look? I hope you're not doubting my competence!
I'm doing my job right now! My job is to lead you to the maiden voyage party!
Ugh... Fiiine, I admit it! I'm only in here so I don't have to answer the phone.
Don't judge me! It's been ringing all day and stopping me from focusing on my video games!
That's very on-brand for you.
Well, cat's out of the bag now... Anyway, your next destination iiis... the banquet hall!
Do I have to leave right now?
Nah, there's time. Just give me a holler when you're good to go!
You'll be on time as long as you leave before 12. That's all for my report. Now, if you need me, I'll be back here, playing games.
Emden should get ready for the party as well, so if you'll excuse us... "Give Emden a call if you need someone to talk to, human."
Long Island and Emden both leave my workspace. Alone with my thoughts, I start wondering what to do now.
(I suppose I could have a look around while I wait for the party to start.)
I've come to the ammo storage, as the schedule dictates.
As the most powerful naval organization in history, our each and every battle is equally important.
The lights switch on with a click, and Sheffield steps forth from between the shadows and the light.
Even a minor mistake can prove fatal. Therefore, we must always be alert and aware of everything on the battlefield.
Next, Sheffield and Nevada also come forth.
That makes it one maid-slash-undercover-agent, one cowgirl, and one plainclothed hacker.
Of the three, only Nevada and Sheffield are carrying weapons. This motley crew really doesn't really scream, "powerful naval organization."
Ahem. I know what you're thinking. You shouldn't judge a book by its cover.
Hahah! Damn right. Just 'cause I'm dressed for the Wild West doesn't mean I can't fight!
Master, I hope you aren't harbouring doubts about our ability as soldiers.
You've more than proven your ability just by undertaking this mission.
But I'll put them on hold. You'll demonstrate your ability to me another time.
By the way, do you have any gear I can use? Relying solely on others for protection isn't ideal.
(I don't know about Memphis and Nevada, but Sheffield really likes these drills. Let's see if she'll indulge me.)
I do not. However, if you would like to have some, you are free to try to steal it from the enemy.
Good idea! Now you got me fired up.
While we've been talking, Memphis has been tapping away at the tablet in her hands.
The signal has been isolated. Area ahead, all clear.
Unit 141, commencing escort mission. Master, we will now pass through an active fire zone. Please don't stray too far from us.

options.content: Got it. Or should I say, roger, pardner!

scripts.say: Hah! You're gettin' it, young'un!
It was smooth sailing to the next safehouse after Memphis blocked the signal from Soyuz. Or so I thought...
You are surrounded! Lay down your arms and surrender!
Tsk. They've already sniffed us out...
Memphis, can't you do somethin' with them fancy-schmancy hacking skills?
They don't have any equipment hooked up to the 'net. There's nothing TO hack.
All I can do is shut down their comms channel. That'll at least slow them down.
(For Kronshtadt to do that, it can only mean one of two things...)
(One – they're bluffing and waiting for us to make a move before they launch an all-out attack.)
(Or two – they really do have us surrounded and they want to arrest all of us in one one fell swoop.)
(Whatever the case, I know one thing for certain – they still don't know exactly where we are.)
(If we can exploit that and find out where exactly THEY are, we can turn the tables on them with an ambush...)
Memphis, can you seize control of the ammo depot's security cameras?
I can, but TB will catch on to me in no time. At most we'll get 30 seconds.
That's all I need!
Using the cameras, I manage to pinpoint Kronshtadt's location. I give Sheffield and Nevada the signal to move.
Understood.
Comin' right up!
Nevada provides covering fire while Sheffield runs faster than the eye can see, getting right behind Kronshtadt.
Now! Do it!
CLACK CLACK!
I hear the distinct sound of heels hitting the ground amidst the gunfire.
Didn't you hear, Comrade Commander? You're surrounded.
(It's time for my little friend!)
I take out the stuffed Arctic hare I bought before the drill and throw it at Soyuz.
Oh!
Oh my god! It's so adorable!
THAT'S what you meant by "secret weapon"?
Well, butter my butt and call me a biscuit...
If it works, it works. Let's get out of here while we have the chance.
And so, the security drill ended with a surprising twist.
While in truth it didn't have much to do with security, everyone enjoyed it. That's what matters to me.
Time for a short break, then I'll go somewhere else on the ship.
It's time for the masquerade ball. I've come to the nightclub, wearing my usual attire.
To make the place look the part for a ball, they've adjusted the layout, replaced the ornaments, and even rolled out a red carpet.
Good evening, Master.
Scylla lifts the rims of her evening gown and gives me a gracious bow.
You chose an... interesting outfit. I can see the thought behind it.
Anyway, allow me to show you inside.
Shortly after we step inside, Hermione calls for Scylla's help, so she has to leave my side.
I decide to hide away in a corner so I can get a good look at everyone's costumes.
(Since we didn't decide on a theme, some are wearing actual costumes while others are wearing more casual party dresses.)
After a while, my phone suddenly rings. It's Kursk.
Commander, are you at the ball?
Yeah. Since you're asking about it, I'm assuming you're here, too.
I'm not. Although, I am wearing an Empery dress in the spirit of the event.
I can't stand crowded parties, simple as that. Besides, an experienced hunter prefers to create their own environment so they can approach their prey sneakily.
I'm sure you know what I mean. Bye now.
She hangs up before I can get another word in.
(Sounds like she's telling me to come find her later.)
Just as I fall deep in thought, I suddenly hear a familiar laugh.
"Ahahaha! I've finally found you, Master! I've been waiting so, sooo long for you to return..."
Well, what do you think? My costume looks pretty smart, doesn't it?
Adventure Galley comes and speaks to me, casually placing her giant cleaver on the ground and smiling.
There you are, my darling! I've been looking aaall over for you~
Not long after, many more Tempestas gather – Golden Hind, São Martinho, and even Royal Fortune.
Sooo... why are you wearing your regular uniform to a masquerade?
It's almost like you aren't wearing a costume at all.
I beg to differ. Wearing your regular outfit is like dressing up as yourself. That's what the Commander is doing~
So it's, like, the same, but different? You're saying the Commander IS wearing a costume?
Exactly. And we'll have to get real close to get a good look at it~
Don't mind if I do.
With all the surprise of the Grim Reaper, Mary Celeste appears and puts her prop scythe behind my neck.
She then pulls it toward her, dragging me closer.
Oh my! Mary made the first move... Well, now it's MY turn to get closer~
Oh yes, I'm going to wrap you up like a gift and make you squishy with love~
I had a dance with all the members of Tempesta, save for Whydah who stuck to a corner of the club and played video games.
(Phew... All that dancing was exhausting. I need a break.)
But before I can even find a place to sit down, something else happens.
Hoho! This is where we demonstrate our powers! Old man, let them behold! "This spectacle will leave them speechless!"
A small whirlwind whips up around Natori, lifting her feet off the ground.
The wine glasses, they're floating away! Oh no... One fell and shattered... I messed up yet again...
(Oh boy... I need to stop Natori before this gets any worse.)
I manage to bring Natori down to earth again. Edinburgh and Hermione then arrive to clean up the fragments on the floor and rebuild the wine glass tower.
While they do that, I join Épée in her little hidey-hole and sit down next to her.
It's all my fault, Commander... I can't do anything right and I only ruin things for people... *sob*...
It's not your fault at all. You did all you could to save the glasses. Only one broke, and many more would have if not for you.
Y-you mean it? It's not my fault? You really think I did all I could?
Absolutely. You're a good girl who's always trying her best.
Th-thank you... I'll keep trying my best so I can always be with you!
I comfort the sobbing Épée, putting a wrap on everything that commotion caused.
(I feel rested now. Time to get up and check out other people's costumes.)
Heehee. Not wearing a costume to a costume party is naughty, you know, Commander.
As I'm ogling the desserts at the table, Jade dressed in a witch's outfit approaches from behind and pokes me in the back.
But, if you'll dance with a good girl – i.e., me – then I might just turn a blind eye.

options.content: Technically, this is a costume. I'm dressed as a naval commander.

scripts.say: That's what I wanted to hear. Heehee.
Come on, who do you think you're fooling with that? You'll never be like me if you always make excuses.
Hippity hoppity! There you are, Commander! Please dance with me!
Ugh. Looks like Shimakaze brought a whole crowd of eager dancers...
Pl-please dance with me, too... Er, or don't. You probably already have way better dance partners in mind...
Roleplay mode engaged. "Urgh. Step aside, you mopey babies. I saw the Commander first."
My, my. Doesn't look like I can just stand by and await orders. Be quick, Commander – decide how this is going to go♥
I know you'll want to dance with me more than anyone else. Right, my Commander?

options.content: Form a queue, ladies. I'll dance with you all.

scripts.say: As I conclude my final dance, the masquerade ball, too, reaches its end.
The gentle melody gradually fades into silence, and the spotlights go out one after the next until it's all dark.
I leave the nightclub and watch as the girls retire to their cabins.
All the beautiful things that transpired tonight will linger in my mind for a long time.
Emden leads me to the maid café, where a scheduled event is taking place.
Welcome, Commander. This is where the maid competition is being hosted.
Following Clemenceau's introduction, I look around the café.
There is Shimanto, Felix Schultz, Boise, Marco Polo, and several others from each and every faction.

options.content: You're sure this is a proper maid café?
It doesn't look like any of them are proper maids.

scripts.say: Yes. This is a competition to see who makes the best maid. Letting actual maids participate is unfair and defeats the point.
Some, like Marco Polo, are even confident that they could out-maid a real maid.
Precisely! I will show them what a Sardegnian maid can truly do.
But before that, I should give my thanks to Clemenceau for telling me about this competition.
Huh?
Heehee. Never you mind that. Allow me to explain the rules.
They're quite simple. The first maid who can make you go "ahh" is the winner.
What do you mean, "ahh"? That's awfully vague for a victory condition.
Have you heard of the Sakuran idea of "moe moe kyun magic," my dear human? "It's famous for making omelet rice taste divine."
So... the goal is really to make the best omelet rice, then?
Not entirely. It's about who wields the moe moe kyun magic with the greatest proficiency.
Thus, whoever's omelet rice makes you go "ahh" will be crowned the winner.
Emden will sit by the sidelines and observe. "Your fallible human reactions prove quite amusing."
Now then, ladies! Let the competition begin!
Clemenceau flashes a knowing smirk as she declares the competition's start, then retreats to the side.
The contestants roll up their sleeves and get to work.
O moe moe kyun magic, by your power, make this omelet rice delicious! Yeees, now just a sprinkle of this stuff...
Here you are, Commander. Savor this omelet rice topped with a little love potion. Say "ahh"!
...H-hey! What's the security doing here? Let go of meeee!
Felix Schultz has been disqualified for spiking the food!
Moe moe kyun, bless this food of mine! Huff... As a bonus, I'll warm it with my Dragon God's breath.
Oops... I blew too hard and overcooked the eggs...
That looks more like egg fried rice now... I should've known my technique wasn't sufficiently polished.
Shimanto has been disqualified for overcooking her eggs!
Huff... Puff... All that's left is to add the ketchup and recite the incantation.
Ah! I'm sorry, Commander! I didn't mean to spray the ketchup on you! Hang on, I'll wipe it off...
Boise has been disqualified for obvious reasons!
Up next was Bismarck, who simply could not bring herself to say the words, "moe moe kyun magic."
Up next was Kashino, who somehow tripped and dropped her food. And so on, and so forth, until a promising challenger stepped forth.
Hah! The time has come to show you all how it's REALLY done!
Moe moe kyun magic, imprint your deliciousness upon this dish!
Marco Polo's gestures flow like water and her exaggerated tone and phrasing hit a sweet spot. She must have practiced hard to get this good.
Heheh. So impressed, you're at a loss for words, are you? I say it's safe to declare me the winner already.
She forms a heart with her hands... while a smug grin covers her face. I doubt anyone is more pleased with her performance than herself.
Wh-what's with that look? I'm OBVIOUSLY the winner! I mean, I am, right?
(I still don't know what Clemenceau meant by "making me go 'ahh.'")
(I assume I don't literally have to say that. I'll just earnestly acknowledge how impressed I am with Marco.)
I'd say so. You win.
Really? Well, if you're sure. We have a clear winner – it's Marco Polo.
I'm surprised you're giving her the win so graciously, dear human.
Do like Marco to win. Need to write that down...
So you need only put on an exaggerated performance to distract the Commander, and in the meantime... Heehee.
Following the victor's crowning, I ate up all the omelet rice the other participants made... except for Felix Schultz's.
After that, I say goodbye to the girls and leave the maid café.
That was a lot of food... I should go on a walk to get some exercise in.
The arcade is booming with video game sounds coming from home consoles, to portables, to arcade cabinets.
This can mean only one thing – it's game night.
Of course, video games aren't the only thing the arcade has. There is analog games and entertainment, too.
Table tennis, pool, card games, you name it. It's all here, and it's easy to find someone who'll play with you tonight.
Oh, you're here, Commander! If you're looking for the gamers, they're sparring with each other to warm up. Why don't you play a card game with me meanwhile?
I won't cheat with any Sacraments. Pinky promise.
Sure!
Fleuret wins faster than my mind can properly process.
Wooow, I didn't think you'd lose THAT fast. Wanna try again?
Thanks, but no. I'm not cut out for these games.
Another time. I need to get in the right mindset first.
Alrighty then. I'll be right here if you wanna play again!
I turn my back on Fleuret and walk over to the arcade cabinet section.
Commaaander! I saw that. You got completely whooped by Fleuret!
How about you enter our tournament? It's a chance to repair your tarnished pride.
Ahahaha! You barely got started before you lost! Sorry to say, but you don't stand a shadow of a chance of beating us.
Yes. I will win at any cost.
Before I decide anything, can you at least tell me what genre of game you're playing?
*yaaawn*... A fighting game, obviously? That's, like, the go-to tournament genre.
If Milord will enter, I shall pull out all the stops!
All the cabinets here are one-on-one games. How about we play each other in teams?
I approve! I propose you, I, and Pamiat' Merkuria make up one team.
So... *yaaawn*... that means me, Long Island, and Ayanami are on the other team. What prize does the winner get?
Hmm... How abooout... the winning team gets to be the first to play Shadow of the Silvertree? I know we're all hyped about it.
Heh, sounds good to me. Let's run with that.
Also, I want to put a personal wager between you and me on this match, Commander.
Let me guess – it's work-related, right?
Bingo! If I win, will you give me the next few days off?
What's in it for me if I win?
Ugh... If you win, I'll actually go to work in person and NOT slack on the job.
Sounds good. Bring it on.
Then we have a deal! Don't expect me to hold anything back!
Thus, our fierce tournament with much on the line began. Both teams nominate one player each per match.
Shortly after the first round, I managed to knock out Haguro, one of their best players.
However, Long Island and Ayanami made a swift comeback, defeating both Pamiat' and Ryuujou.
Just like that, our one-point lead became a one-point disadvantage.
(I can't let Long Island win. That's what matters.)
Round 4, let's go! I've got a hadouken with your name on it, Commander!
(Boy, she's A LOT better at fighting games than I thought... I need an opener to punish her.)
She combos my character to the edge of the screen, and she lowers her guard, thinking her victory is guaranteed.
1 HP is all you need!
Nooo! I was THIS close! THIS close!
It's okay. I will avenge you.
You've got to be kidding me...
I mashed my heart out against Long Island and my fingers cramped up. To the surprise of nobody, Ayanami beat me.
That's okay, though. While Ayanami beat me, I at least beat Long Island.
Maaan... You beat me fair and square, so I'll do some real work for once...

options.content: I WILL make sure you're true to your word.

scripts.say: Waaahhh! This ghost got totally busted! Goodbye, video games – goodbye, slack time...
(I'm starting to feel bad for the poor girl... You know what? I won't be so strict.)
Fine. No days off, but you can keep "working" like you have until now.
You mean... hardly working at all? Yippee! I love you, Commander!
Let's celebrate with some more gaming!
With the conclusion of our tournament, calm returns to the once rowdy corner of the arcade.
The gamer girls aren't ready to retire yet, so they decide to stay there.
I, on the other hand, walk out of the arcade to the backdrop of Kursk teaching her pool technique to Belorussiya and Hunter.
Before I can fully exit, however, Fleuret walks up and asks me to walk her to her cabin.
(Once I've done that, I'll visit some other part of the ship.)
The sky above the ocean is a deep ink black.
It's strange, because looking at the clock, it's still daytime. And yet, night hangs overhead.
Amid the darkness, though, lights with striking colors dance across the sky.
There is no better place on board to watch the aurora than the garden. As soon as I set foot there, I can't help but stop and marvel at its magnificence.
(Cooking barbecue under such a beautiful sight is not on my bucket list, but now I feel like it should be.)
Pardon me, Commander! Please step aside! I need to get these fresh ingredients to Chef Lung Wu!
Oops, sorry. The aurora distracted me.
Vestal comes carrying a stainless steel soup pot, only it's not filled with soup, but an assortment of vegetables.
Let me help you with that. Also, is there any reason you've started calling her "Chef"?
Ah, that's just an inside joke. See, a bunch of us have made teams specifically for making barbecue.
Ours includes me, Roon, Lung Wu, and Hu Pen. I do the vegetables, and Roon prepares the meat.
Lung Wu is our cook, of course, and Hu Pen is her assistant. Since Lung Wu is so gifted, we naturally started calling her "Chef."
As she explains all that, she leads me to where Roon does her part.
Using a shiny knife, she slices and dices the slab of meat on her cutting board into fitting sizes.
I'd love to stay here and let loose with you, but I'm afraid that'll have to wait until after the barbecue, Commander.
Chopping meat is, to me, a kind of stress relief. Heehee.
I'll come see you a while later. Don't worry about letting me into your cabin – I already found a way to bypass the security♪
(Wait... that security breach was HER?)
Breaching attempt into your cabin's security system has been detected. Anomaly detected in ship's engine room.
(That makes so much sense. So it's her fault the ship nearly collided with an iceberg.)
Oh, would you mind taking the meat I'm done chopping to Chef Lung Wu?
Uh... Sure.
I collect Roon's diced meat, follow Vestal to where Lung Wu is, and drop it off. Then I decide to wander around a bit.
As Vestal alluded to earlier, there are quite a few teams here, all neatly preparing and grilling their ingredients.
Well, not all. Some are better cooks than others...
Ehhh... Can't we grill the eel more, you know, normally?
I think it'll be more interesting if we put a slice of cheese and some chocolate sauce on top!
I'm not sure either way... Brennus, what do you think?
If you want my opinion...
Hearing her name called, Brennus stops doing her hair and ponders the question deeply for a moment before answering.
However great the present may be, one must not neglect the pursuit of new knowledge.
The mind is particularly prone to laziness when food and drink overindulged in.
For this reason, I believe we should cover the eel with neither chocolate sauce nor cheese.
Rather, we should soak it in an energy drink!
This energy drink will not only make it delectable, it will also preserve our concentration.
Are you having a laugh? That will just make it minging!
(...I should be on my way. If they make me taste that eel, my tastebuds will never recover.)
After much ecstatic preparation, the barbecue party officially begins at last.
Here, honey! Say "ahh"!
New Jersey holds up a fork with a slice of steak. I take a bite.
Mmm. Delicious!
Heehee, of course it is! Delicious is the only kind of steak the indomitable Black Dragon can make!
Hahah! You're a damn good chef – even better than I expected! I'm no glutton, and even I can't put down my chopsticks.
Hmm... It appears to me that pouring your love into your food elevates it to a whole new level.
That does explain why the Commander is so delighted by it. It also makes me wonder what I could grill to do the same...
Meanwhile, Emanuele Pessagno and Perseus are sitting just behind us. Emanuele peers through her telescope, looking up at the aurora.
You know, to the naked eye, it looks like a balloon filled with light just burst.
Talk about a contrived analogy...
What about you, Commander? What do you see?
Ahem... Scientifically speaking, an aurora is the product of solar winds causing interference in the Earth's magnetosphere. It takes a few days for the winds to travel all that way.
Ooh! I like to think of it as the winds making that several-day-long journey just for us to enjoy this beautiful sight♪
Don't reckon the solar wind has much say in it, but that's a romantic take!
Heehee. I think we all feel mesmerized, seeing this sky right beside the Commander.
We chat the hours away until slowly but surely, the barbecue party wraps up.
(It's time to pack up. Before we start heading home, I should check if there's anything left to do.)
I decide to pay a visit to the ship's gym.
(Huh, so it's divided into two sections. It makes sense that they'd include space for track events.)
Oh, Commander. Fancy seeing you here.
I'm just passing by. Don't mind me.
Too late for that. Hey, are you busy right now?
Not really. Why?
Heehee. Well, since you're here, let's do something fun.
Just wait here and I'll be right back.
Eugen turns on her heel and goes to the indoor part of the gym. Marseillaise is there, and Eugen whispers something to her.
Marseillaise then gets up and starts talking to everyone else inside the gym.
A short while later, a small crowd has gathered – Eugen, Marseillaise, Z46, Brünhilde, Kersaint, and Suffren.
...I am the Fighting Angel. Defeat is not an option for me.
I answer your call, Commander, and I'll bring you victory.
Sorry, what?
Did you forget what I said? We're going to do something fun.
The girls and I talked, and we settled on a three-versus-three game of beach volleyball. I wanted you to join us... but you can't have everything.
If you were playing, the team you're not on might be hesitant to go all out.
So, what am I supposed to do? Spectate?
Not quite. We'd like you to keep score for us.
Yeah. You don't have a horse in this race, so you'll tally points fair and square! That's why I'm gonna give it 100%!
For fun we play, for prize we fight. Like leopards we'll move, seize victory proud and bright.
If I j-just pray for victory, maybe, just maybe...
Hear that? They're all fired up. We're just waiting for your answer, Commander.
(There's no way this is a casual match, considering the motivation on display here...)
Let me guess... you promised something to the winners, didn't you?
Dang, the jig is up. I only promised the winning team would get to have dinner with you, that's all.
You're not going to turn them down now that we're all here, are you?
Eugen's expression screams, "I have you exactly where I want you." Admittedly, she does look brilliant in the sunlight.
With a nod, the curtains rise on a fervent game of beach volleyball.
Marseillaise leaps up into the air, hitting the ball with all her might.
With a whoosh, it flies straight toward the floor, but Z46 intercepts the ball just before it lands.
Brünhilde makes a brilliant feint, followed by Eugen jumping up high, smacking the ball with full force.
It's on course toward Kersaint, who panics and trips, thus giving a point to Iron Blood's team.
That's one point to us! Keep at it and we'll win!
The ball shall fly like a star through the sky.
I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
Don't be like that! The game has only just begun!
The Commander is watching. We must give this our all!
The motivation flowing through the players burns even brighter.
(This is getting intense. I really wonder who'll win in the end.)
Marseillaise and Suffren fought tooth and nail and finally ended the match with a draw. That means I'll have dinner with both teams.
There's still a while to go until then. I'll take the time to check out something else meanwhile.
I decide to have a tour of the onboard aquarium.
(It's funny when you think about it. There's a sea not just outside the ship, but inside it, too. Sort of.)
C-Commander? Did you come to look at the fish?
Well, hello! Good morning, Commander.
Oh! Would you like to go in the aquarium with us?
I was only planning to have a casual look around. Now I've run into an unexpected trio.
I accept their offer and follow them, leisurely walking through the aquarium.
Do you know why they put an aquarium of all things aboard the ship?
Hint: it's not just because Flasher suggested it!
I mean, what more is there to it?
Is it that we don't get to see fish often? I've heard not even the submarines see them much.
Umm... Is it because we all agree that fishies are cute?
Bzzzt. Wrong-o.
It's because aquariums are popular dating spots! They're nice and quiet, and the lighting is all romantic.
When you go vacationing, you need at least ONE place to go on a date.
That's why? Then it's no wonder they okayed my idea right away.
That can't be the only reason. You're just teasing us, aren't you, Jacinto?
Dang. Foiled again, and so quickly!
While the girls chat away, I gaze up at a big fish tank.
The fish are swimming around a coral reef... with the occasional shark or whale passing by.
(It IS a pretty sight, but what's going to happen with these fish when we get back to the port?)
(You can't just set them free in the ocean. One option is to transfer them to our on-land aquarium.)
Hmm...
Something on your mind, Commander? Are you thinking about what to do with the fish when we're back home?
Then I have good news. Flasher has already thought about that!
I-I have! I'll take them in and look after them. I don't want anything to happen to the fishies!
If you'll look after them, I'd like to help.
Y-you will? *sniffle*... Sorry, I can't... I'm just so, so happy...

options.content: (Give Flasher a pat on the back.)

scripts.say: *sniffle*... Thanks... Thank you, Commander!
Heehee... I appreciate it, Commander... *sniffle*...
You really are a nice person, Commander.
I was joking about the aquarium as a date spot thing, but you know...
San Jacinto grabs my hand.
She runs her slim fingers around in my palm, then locks them between mine.
The mood here IS perfect for a date. Let's go on one, Commander.
I casually toured the aquarium with the three girls.
When I return outside, the sun has started to set. It's too early for bedtime, though, so I should check out someplace else.
I'm walking near the ship's classroom, and I can hear a familiar voice pleading for mercy.
Pleeease, An Shan! I've memorized it all, I promise! Let me leeeave...
(Fu Shun and An Shan? I should go in and have a look.)
In the classroom I find not just the two aforementioned, but also Hai Tien, Fei Yuen, and Anchorage.
Oh, great timing, Commander! Have you come to observe the lecture?
Teacher is gonna study with Anchorage! Hooray! Heehee...
Commander, look, look! Miss Hai Tien and Miss An Shan are teaching me and Anchorage how to paint!
Fei Yuen jogs up to me, holding a picture of what looks like one big haphazard scribble.
Yuen, drawing is like writing – you need a steady hand and a steady mind.
I understand being excited to show your work to the Commander, but... well...
Aww... I just wanted the Commander to see my art...
Let's not bother the Commander more, okay? You just need to practice and improve.
Your drawing is very, uhh... Keep practicing and it'll no doubt spark a new art movement!
You mean it?!
Don't get too excited, Yuen. You have much learning to do.
I know, I know.
In contrast to Yuen's eagerness for praise, Anchorage is solemnly taking in the tips An Shan has for her.
How do you draw... this part? I'm confuzzled...
Like this. Watch closely.
Fu Shun, meanwhile, has been quiet as a mouse. From a blind spot in An Shan's line of sight, she winks at me as hard as she can.
When she sees me look her way, she holds up her notebook in the air for me to read.
"I want to go adventuring! Get me out of here, Commander!"
Fuuu Shuuun!
WHY'D YOU READ IT OUT LOUD?! Nooo, don't make me stand in the corner!
You're going on an adventure? Then Lady Yuen is coming, too!
Teacher! Take Anchorage on an ad-ven-chur!
Now, now, you've still got classes. Your adventure will have to wait until schooltime is over.
An Shan and Hai Tien are working really hard to teach you. Don't let their efforts be in vain.
Hrmh... You're right. Fine, Lady Yuen will stay put!
Anchorage will listen to you, Teacher! When class is over, it's ad-ven-chur time!
Thanks for calming them down, Commander. Fu Shun, come here!
I-it's over... I'm sorry for nearly instigating a rebellion...
(I didn't like doing this to her, but education is important. She'll just have to hang in there.)
(I'll probably distract from their lessons if I stick around any longer. I'd better get going.)
I leave the classroom the same way as I entered it – to the sound of Fu Shun's chagrin.
On my walk, I happen upon the cabin area.
Hiii, everyone! This is the beautiful and talented Eagle Union CB-2, Guam, coming at you live!
And I'm Charybdis of the Royal Navy. I'm honoured to be here as a guest interviewer.
(Is that Guam I hear? Charybdis, too? What are they doing together?)
While I'm pondering various reasons, I suddenly realize that their voices are just around the corner.
Before I can respond, a large black object suddenly appears in my field of vision – a microphone, held by Guam.
Look at that! We've got a surprise guest! It's none other than the Commander!
What are you two up to? Interviewing people on their holiday?
Ooh, you almost got it right on the first try! I think we'll let our guest interviewer handle this question.
Pow, pow! Over to you, Charybdis!
Good evening, Master. To answer your question, Guam is doing a survey to measure passenger satisfaction.
Originally, a different Royal Maid was going to be the guest interviewer, but she had to cancel due to urgent business and the task fell on me.
Speaking of the Royal Maids, we're actually responsible for all the service onboard the ship. Our motto is, "Any task – anywhere."
I hope that answers your question. By the way, Master, what brings you to the cabin area?
I believe your personal cabin is on another deck entirely.
I was just walking around, then I heard you two and I came to check.
Whoa, so it's just like I said! You really ARE a surprise guest!
You're also a golden goose for news and I need an egg! You'll be our first interviewee!
Admit it, you're curious to hear what questions we've got!
Well, Master? Would you please answer a few questions?
Sure. If it helps.
Whew... Okay, let's begin.
Have you slept well the past two days? Was your bed neither too soft nor too hard? Are you satisfied with your selection of pillows?
Wow, listen to you go! Alright, my camera's prepped and ready to capture the Commander's answers!
Well, uh, I've been sleeping well and my bed was perfect. I've only tried one type of pillow so far, but it fits my neck well and feels nice.
Thank you. Your praise honours all of us. Next question – how was your experience with your room cleaning?
Even if I leave my bed a total mess, it looks as good as new when I come back.
In a word, every day feels as fresh as the first.
Heehee. Your cabin matters the most to us, so we strive to meet the highest possible standards for it.
Now, let's put the questions on hold and instead demonstrate the Royal Maids' capabilities both to you and the viewers.
Master, Miss Guam, would you please come with me into the next cabin? I'd like to show you our SOP.
"SOP"? You make it sound so technical. Although, you do need procedures when cleaning so many cabins.
Indeed. Belfast calls it the SPOCC, short for, "standards and procedures of cabin cleaning."
Charybdis escorts me and Guam to the door to a cabin.
This cabin is being cleaned right now. Miss Guam, I trust you to handle the camerawork.
No problemo. Recordiiing... now! Action!
As Charybdis opens the door, a loud gunshot rings out.
The firearm has a silencer equipped, but it does little to stifle the noise at such close range.
You have nowhere left to run.
Inside the cabin, Sheffield has her gun trained on a small creature crawling along the floor at high speed.
This isn't quite what I expected, but that won't be a problem. Hi-yah!
Gloucester swings gallantly, smashing a striking stain on the floor with her clenched fist.
Oh dear! Wrong room.
Charybdis maintains a professional smile as she swiftly closes the door.
(Well, uh... What should I even say here?)
Chary–
Miss Guam.
Guam gulps.
Y-yes?
Do you think you could send this part to the cutting room floor?
And, Master, if you'd be so kind, please try to obliterate all memory of this.
Uh... Consider it done.
Charybdis switches off the camera immediately and makes absolutely sure the recording has been wiped. Only then does she let me and Guam go.
I have plans to visit the water park soon, so I should go there now.
I helped Akashi sort out the cargo unloading warehouse and now I've come to the garden for a break.
Most of the guests on the ship have already left for Seabreeze Island, making it feel a little empty onboard.
Commander? You're still here?
Constellation sounds just a bit surprised.
Not yet. I just helped Akashi in the warehouse and I wanted to take a break before I get off. How about you?
Suddenly, I notice that she's holding a variety of mechanical parts.
As you can see, I'm setting up some astronomy equipment.
I'm going to get on land after I'm finished... Oh, uh, if you have the time, could you help me out?
Sure thing. This will save you time setting things up when night rolls around, I assume?
Yeah. Preparing my equipment in advance will let me see the beautiful stars that much sooner.
The lat and long here are perfect for stargazing. The weather's also been great lately, with barely any cloud coverage.
All in all, this will get me a spectacular view of the stars.
Wow, that's stellar. Anyway, let me help.
A while later, we're done setting up all her astronomical equipment.
You can't adjust the lens during daytime, so I put a protective covering on it.
You remember the little things, huh? Heehee.
I appreciate all your help. I would give you something as thanks, but, well...
She broods for a moment, then takes a sudden step forward.
Coming closer, she exudes a subtle fragrance and gives my cheek a warm and soft touch.
I wasn't expecting to run into you here, so I don't have anything on hand. Sorry.
She lowers her voice to a whisper, feeling either anxious or embarrassed.
A faint tremble runs through her words as she says...
If you're free later tonight, you should stop by.
I hope we can gaze at the stars together.
I stay in the garden, resting for a while longer, then see Constellation off as she disembarks.
It's time I do the same to check what people are up to on Seabreeze Island.
RING RING RING! RING RING RING!
The call chime rings two times, then immediately connects to my cabin.
Good morning, Commander. I hope you slept well.
I'll be reporting to you today. I'm waiting for you in your workspace.
I hang up, have a shower, and get dressed, then head for my workspace.
Cruise Ship - Workspace
Good morning again. I take it you're fully awake? Then allow me to give you today's report.
The ship is on course and everything is running well. We should arrive at Seabreeze Island tomorrow morning.
There's an event planned today – a water fight at the water park. It will be held from 2 PM to 6 PM.
You can stop by whenever it's convenient for you. No pressure.
Bear in mind, though, that the main part of the event won't start until you're there, so don't forget to come.
Got it.
That's all I have to report. Hope you enjoy your free time aboard the ship.
Memphis brings her stack of documents to a separate table and takes a seat.
Wait, you're going to WORK? On our holiday?
You just told me to enjoy my free time. I think you should follow your own advice.
Don't worry about me. I know how to balance my work and private life.
Also, I'm doing this now so I won't have to do it later. I'm looking to participate in the evening events.
I'll be fine. You just concentrate on enjoying yourself! Go on, shoo!
Memphis walks over and pushes me out the door.
My feet hit the deck with a stumble. A cool, salty breeze and the cry of a bald eagle bid me welcome outside.
(That eagle, circling in the air... I think I've seen it before.)
I turn my gaze ahead and spot Enterprise, dressed in casual clothes and leaning against a handrail. She's marveling at the ocean.
(It must be Grimmy, her pet eagle.)
Ah, Commander. Here to enjoy the view, too?
Sort of. I was just walking around before I stumbled upon you.
Are you here by yourself? I thought you'd follow your sisters around.
I did, for a while. Hornet has been like an excited dog without a leash ever since we boarded. As soon as she woke up this morning, she dragged me and Yorktown all around the ship.
When we got here, I told her I wanted to feel the breeze for a minute, and she let me go.
Ahh, I see.
Sometimes, you just want to stop and smell the roses on a vacation. You can't always be moving.
Maybe you think otherwise, Commander?
No, I agree. Feeling the wind in your hair, taking in the vastness of the ocean – that's the most relaxing thing I could ask for.
Sounds like you've changed. What happened to the girl who struggles to unwind on a vacation?
Ahem... She took your advice to heart. "Everyone needs breaks in order to work better."
Enterprise gives me a relaxed look.
Are you free right now? If so, do you wanna stay and watch the waves with me for a while?
Don't mind if I do.
Sometime later, while Enterprise and I are still basking in the briny breezes...
Enterprise! And my honey, too! I finally found you!
"Finally"? You've been looking for us?
Of course I have! Did you forget you're one of the main hosts of the water fight happening today?
I ran across your sisters a minute ago and they pointed me here when I asked about you.
Wasn't expecting to see YOU here, though, honey!
Wait, I thought the water fight started at 2 PM? Why do you need to start getting ready this early?
Isn't that obvious? Well, maybe not, I guess.
Basically, we need to style our hair and put on makeup that won't get utterly ruined when we get splashed with water. That takes time.
I don't HAVE to do that, do I?
I'm not exactly an expert at makeup and styling, so...
Yes, you do, if you want to play with honey here! And don't worry – I'll do it for you!
Oh. Uh... Well then, Commander, I guess she and I will go get ourselves ready.
I want you looking your best too, honey. Remember that!
Anyway, time for us to go. See you later!
I wave the two goodbye as they leave.
(It's too bad I didn't pack any water-resistant makeup or equipment to style my hair with, I guess...)
(I'll just show up looking like I always do.)
(Anyway, there's still plenty of time before the water fight starts. I'll have a look around the ship in the meantime.)
I've come to the ship's cargo unloading station. For some reason, there's a huge fish tank sitting here.
(You could fit a whale in there. Odd that it's empty.)
As I start to wonder how it got here, I suddenly hear Huan Ch'ang speaking.
Th-this can't be right! Or my divination would be wrong...
Harbin got me such a large tank, and yet...
Her eyes are on the floor as she walks toward me, muttering something under her breath.
C-Commander?!
No, I can't accept this...
What's up, Huan? Why can't you catch any fish?
Albacore happens to pass by and overhear our conversation. She waltzes over to us with marked interest.
*sigh*...
Don't fret! I'll give you a hand! Start up the fish catchamatron!
The what now?
You don't know? This has been on the ship the whole time! You just put a submarine in there and send 'er down to catch some fish.
Tsk, tsk, always so concerned with the details. It doesn't matter!
Gears and chains start to rattle, then Albacore boards the "fish catchamatron."
Oh, I forgot to mention – someone needs to steer it from up here. Otherwise you can't determine the angle to plunge it into the sea.
That someone will be you, Commander!
Alright then.
Doing as she asks, I get in front of the control panel and operate the chain swing.
All I need to do is decide on the angle and the device will send Albacore down into the sea.
After fiddling with the controls a few times, we get a bite.
I got one! Now pull me back up!
The winch fires up and reels in the chain. The catch comes into view, and it's revealed that Albacore caught... a blobfish.
(I'll be damned. She caught a blobfish at–)
(Hang on! Blobfish don't even swim up to these depths!)
I was passing by and noticed how Huan Ch'ang looked upset that there are no fish to put in the tank.
I can help with that. Yes, as long as any kind of fish will do.
That's very kind of you, but you see...
Before Huan Ch'ang can even finish, Ayanami takes a few steps forward and blows a whistle.
Moments later, a seagull flies over from the garden and squawks a couple of times. It and Ayanami must have some sort of deal.

options.content: What's the deal with that bird?

scripts.say: He's a friend I made long ago on Seabreeze Island. He came to meet us as soon as we anchored.
Yes! I'm surprised you remembered his name. He came flying to meet us as soon as we made landfall.
(Ahh. So that's why I didn't see Ayanami or any birds when I went to check on the roosting spot on the island. They'd already gone back to the ship.)
Right then, some things fall from the sky and land on the deck with a flop.
It's a couple of fish. Squawkey dove down from the skies and caught them underwater with his beak.
Don't feel sad, Huan. Now you have lots of fish.
I can't believe this... I'm losing to a bird!
Huan Ch'ang makes a sad expression and mumbles something.
No, actually... Thanks... I need to go and be alone for a bit...
With a wave of her hand, she leaves the scene.
(She looked pretty shocked about that.)
Afterward, I, Ayanami, and Albacore put the fish inside the tank.
I'll quickly clean up the place a bit then go have a look somewhere else.
I followed a sweet smell hanging in the air and ended up at the door to the kitchen.
It's closed shut, but I can still smell that sweet aroma through the gaps. This has to be where it's coming from.
(Might as well have a look inside.)
So you see, you ought to pay close attention to the oven temperature. Even I struggled to bake a whole batch of macarons properly once upon a time.
That's how you do it... Thank you for showing me! I'll try to make some myself later.
Sounds like Dunkerque is teaching Lung Wu how to make macarons.
As soon as they notice I'm here, they both turn their heads to face me at the same time.
Ah, Commander. Are you feeling hungry?
Hungry? Well, I just came up with a dessert that's Empery-Orthodoxy fusion cuisine! Would you like to try it?

options.content: Wait, you've fused Empery and Orthodoxy cuisine?

scripts.say: Exactly! While I usually adhere to more conventional recipes, I've been hearing a lot of different food takes aboard the ship.
It made me want to challenge myself to fuse cuisines from different countries based on some of the suggestions I heard.
Mhm. I think it's a fun idea.
Incidentally, is the dessert based on macarons? You were just talking about them, so...
Not quite. It's... Well, you'll see soon when it's done baking!
The oven rings with a ding, and Lung Wu takes out a green cake-looking thing from it.
It smells similar to what led me here to begin with, but there's something... else mixed in there.
The color is a bit odd... Then again, we have similar-looking desserts made with ground pistachio nuts.
Did you use matcha for this?
Nope. I put in two kinds of spices often used to add aroma to our cuisine. I think that's what turned it green.
It's an experiment, because we were trying new things.
We weren't expecting you to come here, but now you'll be the first to taste it.
Lung Wu looks at me expectantly. I cut a slice using a knife, then have a bite of the dessert.
An explosion fills my mouth with flavors I'm not sure how to describe...
The smell and bitterness overlap with each other, and there's a dash of sweetness among the spiciness. It's a shocking taste that sends you skyward.
Well? How is it?

options.content: You're probably better suited for conventional recipes.
I-it's great... Others n-need to try this...

scripts.say: What? Oh... Are you saying adding coriander and chameleon plant was actually a bad idea?
You mean it? Is it really so good it's making you cry and stutter?
That doesn't seem right... Let me try it, too. I got so engrossed in making the batter earlier that I completely forgot to taste test it then.
She acts quicker than I can stop her, cutting a slice and putting a spoonful in her mouth.
Immediately, without a moment's hesitation, she throws the rest of the cake in the garbage.
On second thought... I'll stick to conventional recipes.
To "soothe the trauma I suffered," Lung Wu cooked up a feast of tasty dishes for me.
After having my fill and giving her my thanks, I leave the kitchen with a box of Dunkerque's macarons.
I approach the cargo unloading area and see a group of people gathered around Eldridge, holding a dowsing rod.
It moved! So that means there's treasure under the water, right?
Mhm.
Pirates DID live here once, so I wouldn't be too shocked to find treasure here.
If I can be a skeptic for a second, how can a dowsing rod even detect treasure in the first place?
By being an intricately designed invention of yours truly!
I like to call it the Handy Landy Treasure Findy! The only problem with it is that its range of targets is limited solely to treasure.
But, as it so happens, that's exactly what we need right now!
Hey, Commander! Do you want to go treasure-hunting with us? There's loot to be found in these waters!
Are you sure that's not stepping on Tempesta's toes? We should talk to them first.
I called up Tempesta and had a word. They gave us permission to search to our heart's content.
That's all sorted. Now we have to decide who'll do the diving.
Eldridge can't... Emits sparks.
That's true. We don't want to electrocute a whole school of fish.
If we need someone to go underwater, maybe we should ask Jean Bart.
She's associated with pirates, so she'd know where a pirate would hide their treasure!
Why not send da Vinci down? I mean, she's a submarine.
No can do! I have to stay on land to verify how well my invention works.
Jean it is, then! I'll go find her!
Sometime later, Javelin returns with Jean Bart... who has changed into a swimsuit.
I get the feeling there has been a misunderstanding.
I pull her aside and explain the situation.
...You what? I thought I'd be searchin' the shipwrecks nearby, and now ya want me to go DIVING?
You've got a submarine right here! The hell do ya need me for?
Well, we need someone to help me.
Don't kid yourself. It's dangerous down there. Sit your ass down and I'll do it myself.
I didn't mean it like that. There's a thing on the ship that can lower you into the water. Albacore used it the other day.
With some modifications, I'm sure you could use it to hunt for treasure.
Oh! That's a great idea! Let me cook something up and I'll be right back!
Da Vinci finishes her ingenious modifications to the machine, and Jean Beart and I step inside.
It was designed with submarines in mind, so it's still cramped even after the changes.
This forces me and Jean to be practically shoulder to shoulder. At any rate, the chain drops us and into the water we go.
Target... sighted.
You're right next to the treasure!
Got it.
Hey, Jean...
Yeah?
I was just going to nod at her to tell her to proceed, but she turns to face me instinctively after hearing her name.
Since we're right up against each other, my lips accidentally brush up against her cheek.
Wha–?!
Her cheeks turn a shade of pink, if for just a moment.
I-I'm going out!
She puts on a da Vinci-brand diving oxygen mask and exits the machine after some fidgeting.
I shortly follow suit. Amongst the sand on the ocean floor, I dig out an old pocket watch.
A picture of a cat is engraved on the corroded lid. The watch itself, sadly, is made not of gold but ordinary metal.
"Treasure" in hand, me and Jean return to the machine.
What a piece of junk. This what ya call treasure?
In a sense. I want to give it to them as a gift, even if it's not worth much.
To me, though, the real treasure was the time I spent with you.
Ugh, you're so corny. You tryin' to flatter me? I don't like it.
So she says, but the next thing she does is walk up and give me a kiss just to the side of my lips.
There. That's my idea of real treasure. Don't forget it.
I radio da Vinci and she hoists us back up to land.
After taking off my diving suit, I present the old pocket watch to the aspiring treasure hunters. Jean Bart, meanwhile, turns and walks away.
I leave the scene to the backdrop of da Vinci shouting, "This gives me an idea"!
There is still time until the dress party starts. I'll go and get myself ready.
I suddenly feel apprehensive of icebergs, so I head to the bridge.
TB, report.
Orders received. The number of ice floes is increasing. An iceberg has been spotted ahead.
At the current speed and bearing, probability of collision is extremely low. It can be easily maneuvered around.
Alright...
(When you think you're safe, THAT'S when accidents happen.)
Almost as if to prop up my fears, the interior of the ship makes a sudden, loud bang.
Breaching attempt into your cabin's security system has been detected. Anomaly detected in ship's engine room.
Wait, what?
Unable to correct course at ship's current speed. Probability of iceberg collision has increased to 100%.
(The breaching attempt will have to wait...)
(We'll hit the iceberg in no time at this rate. This would be a cause for panic for a normal cruise ship.)
(It's a good thing this is no NORMAL cruise ship.)
TB, patch me in to the lookouts.
Orders received.
Lookouts, disembark at once and get in combat formation. Sink that iceberg!
The ship remains on course, heading straight for the iceberg.
On my mark. Five, four, three, two, one... Fire!
On my command, flames burst from the guns of New Jersey's squadron.
The iceberg is pummeled by the might of the battleships' main batteries, decimating the section of it that would have hit the ship.
Just as I expected, the iceberg's integrity is quite poor, and its two halves will split easily thanks to the bombardment.
Status updated. Emergency alert rescinded. Excellent work, Commander.
Phew. Now I can breathe easy... Hey, who's that on the deck?
I look out the window and see Harbin and some Empery and Parliament girls, eyes turned to the relatively intact ice floats and talking among themselves.
(Might as well go talk to them.)
Hahah! This is a rare opportunity to show you one of my skills!
Ever heard of the Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival? It's this big exhibit of ice sculptures from carvers 'round the world.
C'mere and gimme a hand, Commander! We're gonna make an ice cruise ship!
With Harbin's guidance, our group – and more, as others join later – carve a collection of impressive ice sculptures.
That ought to do it for my sculpture. I should see what the others made.
During my walk, I stop by the cat lodge.
Commander! Look how adorable all these widdle kitties are~!
Algérie greets me, holding an orange tabby cat in her arms. It's purring, and its eyes are narrowed happily.
I look around the room. Kent and Richelieu are there, too, as if it's the most normal thing in the world.
Commander, would you like to feel how soft their fur is? It's ever so soothing.
Ayanami's having Squawkey catch fresh fish for them, so these babies are all in perfect condition!
Kent pushes a tuxedo cat into my arms. Said cat has a belly full of fish and is currently taking a tongue-bath.
Seeing how the kitty relaxes in my arms, I can't help but pet the little guy.
Soothing, for sure... I can tell why you all love these cats so much.
Heehee. Just hearing them purr is enough to drain your fatigue away.
Yeah~ Commander, if you get tired, you can come pet these babies any time.
Apparently tired of me petting the same spot on its head over and over, the tuxedo cat suddenly jumps out of my arms.
Then, it finds a doorknob within reach, stands up and puts its front paws on it, and then uses its body weight to push the door open a little.
Oh no... When did you get so smart, little guy?
Shouldn't we stop it from getting out?
Hold on a second. Cats are extremely sensitive beings. We must be very quiet and careful in our approach, so as to keep it from getting stressed out.
We slowly approach the door and try to snag it up close, but the cat manages to escape the cat lodge.
Some places on the ship aren't very safe for kitties... We must hurry and bring it back.
I have a plan. Kent and I will go search for it. Algérie, stay here and try to calm down the others.
Okay~ Let's do it!
Commander, what will you do? Will you search alongside us, or will you stay here with Algérie?
Let's look for that cat together. Algérie, can you handle comforting the cats on your own?
Yep. Leave it to me.
(A lost cat is sure to end up with her, I bet...)
Wait, I have an idea. There's one place we can go that might make this easy as can be.
Umm? Commander, do you know where that kitty's going?
Well, it's just a prediction... but I think it's worth looking there first.
When I get to Jean Bart's room, I find the tuxedo cat there just as expected. Jean Bart herself is at her door, squatting down to eye level with the cat.
(I knew it... That's our cat magnet for you.)
After convincing Jean Bart to act as bait, I manage to bring the tuxedo cat back to the cat lodge.
I spend a little more time in the cat lodge. Once I'm thoroughly soothed, I say goodbye to the girls there.
It's still too early for bed. Let's see what other adventures await.
When I reach the mall, I find Hwah Jah apparently lost in thought.
Hwah Jah, what's wrong? Worried about something?
Oh, Commander. There's a big sale going on today, and I'm trying to figure out what to buy on discount to save the most money.
Did you come for the sales, too? We could discount shop together.
(Big sales, maximizing savings, cashback... I don't like seeing all of these buzzwords together.)
Do you know who owns this mall? This smells like something Akashi would do.
Hmm... Ting An was the one who proposed investing in and constructing a shopping mall first, so I'm sure she must be a major shareholder.
She did ask me to help recruit shareholders, though. As I recall, Roma and the St. Louis were the primary buyers...
Friedrich der Große of the Iron Blood, too... But I didn't get a good look at the list of names, so I can't remember if Akashi was involved.
If you're worried, we could try calculating the discounts while we shop. Would that help?
Yeah. Let's do that.
Hwah Jah and I look around the shops together.
We eventually reach a store selling daily necessities.
Master, Miss Hwah Jah. Good day to both of you. Have you two come to partake in the sales campaign today?
Yeah, just about.
Commander~ Let us come shopping with you for once~
Commander, umm... Can you push the cart for me? I'm tired of moving...
Heehee. May we join the two of you, Master and Miss?
Sure. The more, the merrier.
Fine with me, too.
Before long, everyone has gathered varying quantities of spoils.
Master, is there nothing you want?
Whoa, you're not kidding. We all bought so much stuff, but the Commander's hands are empty.
Yeah... The Commander even paid for all of our things. Now I feel really bad...
Commander, are you tired?
There wasn't anything I wanted, really.
But when I was paying, I couldn't help but notice – these discounts are no joke.
Does that make you feel at ease, Commander? Heehee.
(Phew... Finally, a place that Akashi hasn't gotten her demonic paws on.)
Huh? Speaking of, look at the tags. All of our stuff came from the same exact manufacturer.
Yes. I've already confirmed that every product bears the inscription, "Made in Akashi Workshop."
Umm... Commander, do you think...
After confirming our customer support concerns with Ting An, I see the girls back to their rooms.
Now that I'm free again, I might as well check out some other places.
While I walk through the cabin quarter, I notice a certain door has been left wide open.
A pink figure lies on the floor in front of the room.
Hm...? Laffey?
Zzz... Commander, why are you in my dream...
You're not dreaming. Take my hand, and let's get you to bed.
Bed... Oh, I just remembered... Come with Laffey...
Laffey stands up, grabs me by the wrist, and pulls me into her room.
Commander? *yaaawn*... Laffey was gone for so long, I figured she was off trying to get you to join our pajama party...

options.content: No, actually, she was sleeping in the hallway.
You just woke up, and you're already going to sleep again?
Why are you having a pajama party in the middle of the day?

scripts.say: I fell asleep on my way to find the Commander, yep... Zzz...
There's no law that says you can't do that... Isn't that right, Le Malin?
Yep yep. Sleep is best when it's daytime, too...
This one asked the same question, and yet...
Ugh, you've got it all wrong... You're supposed to ask what's so wrong with sleeping just because it's daytime.
When I'm confronted by the pajama party attendees, I realize that I'M the one with the screwed up work-life balance.
Okay, so how does this party work? Do you play games, or...?
Laffey wanted to ask Shinano... to use her power to give everyone sweet dreams...
*sigh*... We've just slept so much that it's hard to sleep any more...
Phew... That's why I suggested we should have a pillow fight.
Throwing pillows around really helps tire you out, after all!
But Shinano's so hesitant to join us...
Hm? Shinano, do you dislike pillow fights?
I wouldn't say I dislike them... However, this one's constitution poses a problem...
(Is that what she's worried about?)
Don't worry about it. I'm here, so have all the fun you want.
If you say so... then I shall...
They started pillow fighting, but before long, Laffey decided to lie down, clutching her pillow tight.
Laffey too tired... Sleepy...
Me, too... But opportunities like this don't come every day. Commander, can you tell us a story?
Sure, but what kind?
Mm, just whatever you can tell engagingly.
Agreed~ The story itself doesn't matter. We just want to hear your voice...
Shinano?
I turn around and find that Shinano's already drifted off to dreams. Her soft, fluffy tail has stretched over and wrapped around me.
By the time I've told them a decidedly average fairy tale, Laffey, Le Malin, Nicholas, and Whydah have all fallen asleep.
I gently free myself from Shinano's fluffy restraint and put a blanket over the group.
After I've closed the blackout curtains, I quietly leave the cabin, careful not to wake them.
(Man, now I'm a little tired... I'll walk around a little, get some fresh air, and hopefully clear my mind.)
At a rather late time, I return to my office space.
(Hm? Normally, everyone's having a barbecue at this time of night. Why's my office light on?)
When I open the door, Memphis is there.
Despite the fact that we're on this cruise to have fun, Memphis takes her secretary work seriously. She's been putting her whole heart into her work lately.
Leave the rest to me, okay, Memphis?
Our vacation's almost over. We get back to port tomorrow... Let's enjoy what's left of it while we can.
You're one to talk, Commander...
But if I do that, you'll have to waste more of your own time and energy to finish the work, won't you?
Y'know, it might be a group vacation, but I have my own needs...
Specifically the need to see you properly enjoying YOUR vacation, Commander.
I'm more than happy now that I've seen you get away from your desk and have fun with everyone.
The aurora shines beautifully outside the window, reflecting in Memphis's verdant eyes.
So I'm just fine, Commander.
In that case, can you at least let me help you with the rest? Call it a reward for all your hard work.
Once it's all over, let's go to the garden on deck. I'll cook you a nice midnight meal. What do you say?
You mean it?!
Ahem... Well, that sounds lovely.
But if we're to have a late night meal, considering your work-life balance and your health... we'd better get this work done quick.
Try not to hold me back, Commander♪
Memphis winks playfully at me and hands over a bundle of documents.
Alright. Let's get 'er done.
I use my communicator to ask Belfast to leave the grill and some ingredients behind. Then, Memphis and I complete our work at record pace.
After that, we enjoy a midnight meal on the deck.
I take Memphis back to her room, but I don't go back to my own.
Because there's one last thing I need to do before our return to port tomorrow.

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>38 The Cat in the Magic Hat</size>

scripts.say: During some light drinking at the cruise ship bar, I enjoy the gentle sea breeze.
Suddenly, a flock of white pigeons flies my way and lands right in front of me.
(Hm? Why are there pigeons out on the sea?)
While I wonder where they came from, they suddenly turn to smoke with a bang.
A girl's silhouette emerges – and then lunges at me.
Owneeer! Your personal magician, Cheshire, has arrived! Heehee, cuddles~♡
Wasn't my entrance just awesome?
It must've taken a lot of effort to put that together.
Heehee... For YOU, I'd learn how to do anything!
Ninjas tend to appear from smokescreens, right? More than magicians, at least.
Yeah, sure! Then next time, I'll make my big entrance like a ninja for you!
You don't know how long I've been holding that in, waiting to surprise you with it!
Is that why I didn't see you all day today?
Heheh♡ You were looking for me the whole day, weren't you? I'm so moved~
But when you're making an entrance, timing is everything! It took all my willpower to stop myself from jumping out and cuddling you on the spot!
Timing?
Heheh, you'll understand soon.
Anyway, Owner, let's play a game! I want you to see your dearest's magician's best side♪
Sure. What should I do?
As soon as I respond, Cheshire sidles closer to me.
She was close already before, but she's basically glued to me now.
Fiiirst... Pick a card, Owner. Any card~
Cheshire whispers into my ear and produces a deck of cards out of seemingly nowhere.
I obediently draw a card.
Good~ Now, put the card in my hat, if you'd please!
Hm?
You're not going to have me hide the card so you can guess which one it is?
Owner, everyone and their mother can do that!
I'm not like other magicians♪
She takes off her silk hat and smoothly takes my card-bearing hand.
Her fingertips are a little chilly, perhaps from the cool sea breeze.
Heheh... Good! Now, Owner, put the card in my hat!
Cheshire's hand guides mine to the hat, where I drop the playing card. When I do, a rabbit jumps out from inside.
Where'd that rabbit come from?
I'm not done yet♪ Watch closely, now!
With a bang, the rabbit turns into a puff of smoke like before.
Following that, there's a light in the night sky.
A pigeon... A rabbit... And the suit of the card I pulled!
Heheh~ This is the magic I really wanted you to see, Owner!
Incredible... How did you do this?
A good magician never reveals her secrets!
Do you like it, Owner?
Then my efforts weren't in vain!
A surprise for you to celebrate your cruise trip...
Fireworks and the sea make for a good pair. Just like the two of us!
This time, the fireworks up above burst in the shape of Cheshire herself with perfect timing.
Heheh, my plan was originally to stop with the card suit, but I just had to put myself into the performance!
Now there are more Cheshires to celebrate with you!
The fireworks faded in the night sky, but the light in Cheshire's eyes replaced them.
May you have a wonderful cruise, Owner. With me, I hope...
Have a wonderful, unforgettable vacation full of surprises...
Heheh, Owner♡ Don't you think I deserve a reward for all I did?
What would you like?
Hmm... Let me think about it, okay?
Stargazing with you, feeling the sea breeze, eating good food at the restaurant together...
Nuh-uh! Those are all too normal! Let me really, REALLY think about it.
Her voice, and her wishes, are carried far off by the sea breeze.
Far into the realm of dreams.

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>39 Heat-Beating Summer Sacrament</size>

scripts.say: (The ship's pool is supposed to be around here, I think...)
La la la la laaa~♪
Alsaaace~ The fleet's aaace~♪
Fearless fighter, here with the Commander~
I spot Alsace, soaking in the pool and singing an odd song to herself while she sucks on a popsicle.
Either her senses are dulled by the heat, or she's so relaxed that she's not paying attention...
Whichever it is, she doesn't seem to realize that I'm here.
Ahem...
Alsace?
C-Commander?! If you're coming in, wait a sec! I'm looking for something right now...
When she notices me, Alsace suddenly panics. In the commotion, she drops her sunglasses into the pool.
I-I can't find it... My Commander brainwave interceptor!
(She had her sunglasses on until just now... Did she not notice?)
I get into the pool and pick up her sunglasses for her.
Commander brainwave interceptor... Would those happen to be these sunglasses?
Y-y-y-yeah... Thanks, Commander.
She accepts them and puts them back on her face, still a little flustered.
Ahem! Status, fully recovered. Temperatures normal.
Awaiting your orders, Commander.
(She's making a big show of being fine...)
I just came here to swim, and I happened to find you here. Kick back and relax, okay?
Emotion module is being liquid-cooled.
Due to a likelihood of prolonged contact with the Commander, this one has been liquid-cooling my module to avoid overheating...
