If you stay in the water forever, you won't get to join in the festivities inside.
Wanna walk around with me?
Commander, are you inviting me on a date...?
Ah... Aah... Whoa...
Hearing my affirmative answer, Alsace suddenly starts trembling.
(Is it just me, or is the pool getting hot awfully fast?)
Alsace? You okay there?
Commander brainwave interceptor... malfunctioning... I-I'm losing control...
The liquid-cooling was supposed to outpace my emotion module... No, no, no, no!
O-oooh, the Commander's getting even closer...
Visual module malfunctioning! Thought module connection going haywire!
I-I'm going to explode!
Alsace panics more and more. Her sunglasses fall off again at some point, too.
I don't know if it's because of her higher body temperature or pure embarrassment...
...But her fair skin visibly turns a shade of pink.
I-I'm losing my ability to move...
Alsace goes limp and collapses right into my arms.
I-I might need a more efficient liquid-cooling method...
Oh, humaaan. My darling humaaan. It's time to wake uuup!
In the middle of my slumber, a familiar voice calls out to me.
"It doesn't look like being gentle works. Perhaps our human would rather be told to wake up, or else."
...Emden?
Now that you're awake, it's time for your daily report, my darling human. "You'd be wise to listen closely."
The ship will arrive at Seabreeze Island in less than an hour. After that, we will drop anchor and then disembark.
For today's main event, we will go on the island and give our thanks to everyone who came to the island to help.
"There will, of course, be ample time for you to look around the island, human. You've missed it, no?"
Heehee. While we would love to stay, I'm afraid we need to prepare to make landfall.
You may use your free time however you see fit. Now, if you'll excuse us... "Use your time well."
After Emden leaves, I get dressed and leave my cabin. I walk up to the blast door – which needs a keycard to open – when I realize something.
(Wait a second...)
(I'm the only one with clearance to open the blast door. Beyond me, the only ones with even temporary permission to enter are the Royal Maids, and that's only at specific times to clean the cabin.)
(The only way Memphis could wake me up was by calling me...)
(So how the hell did Emden find her way to my bedside?!)
I quickly realize, however, that thinking or asking them about this clearly will not get me anywhere.
(Eh. Better not think too hard about it.)
I get up on the deck to find a big crowd has already gathered, necks craned as they watch the island draw nearer and nearer.
Even from afar, I can hear Z23, Javelin, Laffey, and Ayanami talking about the island.
Oh, I'm so excited! We'll get to meet our friends and all those weird animals again!
Zzzzz...
Don't doze off on us, Laffey! At least stay up until we've touched grass!
It'll be fine. Me and Z23 will carry her if we have to.
*sigh*... Which we probably will.
Remember what we're here for. We're not just messing around, we're meeting up with our friends who helped build up the island so we can all enjoy this vacation.
Hey! Commander! Whatcha standing over there for? Come here and chat with us!
Pamiat' appears out of the blue and pushes me into the heart of the crowd.
You can tell how much the island has changed, even from all the way over here!
It took a looot of people to make it into what it is now, y'know. Don't forget to thank all the hardworking girls who built it over countless shifts!
Ah, that reminds me – I wanted to ask you something, Commander.
As you know, we'll be delivering supplies and materials for the next group that will manage the island.
Since we won't anchor for long, we'll want to work fast to have as much time and space as possible.
As efficiency is our primary concern, do you think we could improve how and where we store our cargo?
(That is an important question... It also reminds me that the ship has a dedicated facility for cargo.)
I have an idea. Since we're going to dock, we could open the ship's cargo unloading area and let the machinery deliver what materials Akashi has finished packing.
You mean... let Akashi handle it all?
She's an expert in logistics. She knows how to categorize cargo and put it in neat and efficient stacks.
Also, we can separate our machinery into two groups and have them work turn by turn, then unload cargo based on the category they belong to.
All in all, this should cut a full 24-hour task down to just 20 hours.
That also saves time spent sorting cargo in the island's warehouse... A clever and practical idea. I'll make some calls.
Right. Hope it goes well.
Yo, Commander!
The moment my conversation with Bismarck ends, a voice brimming with energy calls out to me.
Just wanted to ask ya something'!
Do I get your permish to harvest whatever fresh veggies are on the island?
You're asking if you're allowed to forage?
Yeah, that! What you said!
I know what you're thinkin' – "we got tons of veggies onboard, and the folks on the island ain't strapped for food either."
But that's not it! I'm talkin' about finding new species that could go in a pot, stew, soup, whatever! There's gotta be tons of plants like that!
(Owari knows her plants, so I doubt she'll bring anything poisonous.)
Yeah, sure. Just be careful if you go up into the mountains. Steer clear of cliffs, too.
What's so dangerous 'bout cliffs?
...You do not want to underestimate the mountains. Trust me.
Well, if ya say so, alright. I'll check myself before I wreck myself.
With a smile, she goes off to recruit some foraging buddies.
Commaaander! It's-a me!
You wanna come watch me play beach volleyball later?
Hold it! The Commander's coming with me to investigate mysteries on the island! Right, Commander?
Teacher... Come with Anchorage to the beach. And read to me!
If there's one thing the girls aren't lacking, it's enthusiasm.
Maybe the excitement of traveling and the simple joy of being with others are the real pleasures of a vacation.
The ship drops anchor near the shore, and the girls all return to their cabins to prepare to disembark.
(There's no rush to get off the ship. First, I'll ask around and see if anyone needs help with anything.)

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>40 Locker Room Lechery</size>

scripts.say: I was supposed to get in the pool with Mogador around this time.
But at this time, I don't see–
Aha♥ Commandeeer♥ Wanna give me a hand?
I finally bump into her in the locker room. She has a big bath towel on, and she's wriggling excitedly.
I just can't get this swimsuit on by myself!
Heehee♥ So I waited until you came in here so I could get your help♥ Otherwise, we can't swim together, can we?
Mogador slowly takes off the bath towel and walks over to the locker room door.
She then squats down and puts the towel down by the door. But then, I hear the door lock.
Huh?
Haha♥ Sorry, Commander...
If everyone knew I didn't know how to put on a swimsuit, they'd all tease me.
Sooo... I had to lock it♥
Don't you daaare open it until I finally have it on.
Now without her towel, Mogador turns back to me.
Dark-purple fabric digs tightly into her fair, smooth skin.
Her purple eyes, normally hidden by her long bangs, shine brightly in the light of the dressing room.
Now... Commander, I want you to slooowly, bit by bit, fix my swimsuit for me.
I shake off dirty thoughts and check the fit of her swimsuit.
At a glance, it looks like she's wearing it right, but it's fastened so wrong that you'd almost think it was on purpose.
Merely getting in the water would probably cause it to fall apart.
Mogador, have you ever tried this swimsuit on?
Of course~ I wouldn't buy it if I hadn't...
Do you remember how you wore it then?
Really, even I can't figure out how to fix the straps...
Heehee♥ I'll just have to teach you, then...
First, press this down with your finger... Then take this♥
You did iiit! Perfect positioning. Wow, Commander, you're so good at this~
With Mogador's instruction, I manage to fix her swimsuit.
Phew...
Good enough?
Yep, it's perfect♥
(You definitely could've done that on your own...)
What's wrong? You've got such a passionate look in your eyes, Commandeeer♥
Mogador, you clearly know how to wear it right.
Heehee♥ Guess my silly excuses won't get through you.
I just wanted to be alone with you♥
Mogador's breathing gets faster and rougher.
Every time she twists and wriggles, a sweet scent spreads through the room.
Haha... I think the AC in here is broken...
I'm sooo hot right now.
Yeah. This is no good.

options.content: Society needs AC to function in the summer!
I'll go call the maintenance staff!

scripts.say: Heehee♥ What are you talking about, Commander?
I heard your body cools down when you sweat...
So what we need isn't to fix the AC.
Just... get hotter and hotter with me~♥
Mogador opens her arms in apparent anticipation.
Commandeeer♥ Your thoughts?♥
The gleam in her eyes, peeking out from between her bangs, tells me that I won't be sleeping tonight...

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>41 An Afternoon on the Lido Deck</size>

scripts.say: I rush over to the pool, where St. Louis is relaxing on a swim ring.
Sorry I'm late. Some sudden work came up.
Don't be so worried about it, Commander.
Heheh, I can have plenty of fun on my own... but I am happier to have you around.
Sorry for making you wait.
Stop apologizing, silly. I'm not mad at you, or anything.
If you really want to make it up to me, though...
How about you help me put on a fresh layer of sunscreen?
A fresh layer?
Sunscreen loses effectiveness after a couple hours. I think mine's just about to wear off.
I don't wanna get sunburned. Won't you please, Commander?
Don't miss a single spot, okay?♪
I accept the sunscreen and start applying it as directed.
Heehee... Yeah, right there.
Gentle and careful fingers, please.
Heehee, you're adorable when you're so focused, Commander.
Mm... Ah, can you just move my swimsuit aside there?
It's hard to reach myself, so you'll have to do it.
Yeah, right there. A little more, please.
Heehee. I won't complain if you go further.
With St. Louis's patient guidance, I manage to get her covered in sunscreen again.
Phew... Quick sip of a nice, cold drink... Perfect. Now I can really bask.
Want a sip, Commander? As a reward for helping me out♪
It'll cool you right down.
But the straw...
You're bothered that there's only one? Heehee, well, do you expect me to get two when I'm drinking it myself?
Come on. Keep waiting, and the ice will melt. Drink up!
The cold drink flows through the straw and into my throat. Heat seems to drain out of me all at once.
I glance at St. Louis. She's changed into a comfy position to lie on her floatie.
Now that you've finished putting my sunscreen on, do you wanna sunbathe with me?
Nice rays, a sea breeze... It's just right.
Your swim ring... Hmm, going to get it seems like unnecessary effort. Just come join me on mine.
It might be a little cramped... but if we snuggle tight, we'll fit just fine.
Besides... I think it might be more fun that way.
I do as she says and try getting on the floatie.
She smiles coquettishly at me.
Heehee, now... Let's have fun together...
Commander♥

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>42 A Glimpse of Greatness</size>

scripts.say: I walk around in search of Tosa. In the private bath, I finally manage to find her.
Commander? Shouldn't you be preparing for the dance?
Actually...
Oh. So you noticed I was gone and came here to take me back to the venue?
That was the plan, but I've given up on that by now.
I think you left because you're not interested in joining the dance. So now I'm just here to check on you personally.
Hmm, really? I thought I'd be able to wait out the storm here, but I guess not.
So, how did you figure out I was here?
How? I guess... intuition?
You don't take to trivial tasks... so I figured you must have gone somewhere looking for a change of scenery.
*sigh*... Nothing gets past you.
Oh, whatever. Your intuition was correct, so I guess that means you and I think alike, in a way.
Well, we've known each other for a long time now.
Heehee. Let's go with that.
Well, you've successfully checked up on me. Care to join me?
You can't do much but watch if you just stand there, no?
You wouldn't have said all that if you couldn't do it. Quit being indecisive and just get in.
I step into the bath and enjoy a moment's peace with Tosa.
Through the steam, I can see the stars dotting the night sky.
So are you sure you don't want to join the dance?
...If I feel like it, I might.
Upon saying so, she languidly pushes up her robe.
For now, enjoy the scenery before your eyes.
The cruise ship might be big, but it's noisy to match. You don't get many opportunities to quietly gaze at the night sky.
The stars seem to move in time with the cruise ship.
The moon's reflection dances on the waves, glowing under the ship's lights.
It's an uncanny blue, reminiscent of her hair accessory.
Taking myself away from the hustle and bustle and immersing myself in the sights makes me feel so much better.
Were you unhappy before, then?
Not at all. I was just... a little bored.
But even the beauty of the night sky isn't quite enough to excite me.

options.content: If you'd like me to help...

scripts.say: Hmm... Good idea.
"The heart is a reflecting pool, the moon's reflection mirrors your emotions. When one moves, the other dances in turn."
Mesmerizing beauty is one thing... but having you by my side is much more important to me.
Care to stay a little longer, Commander?
With you around, I think I can do something a little more exciting... a little more satisfying.
I wouldn't want to put such a beautiful night to waste. Would you?

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>43 Set Sail for Summer Treasure</size>

scripts.say: My legs take on a mind of their own and bring me to the lido pool.
Hey, if it isn't the Commander!
Didja get up early to take in some sun? The rays feel great at this time of day.
Get over here! Lie down with me and bask for a while.
We bathe in the sun's gentle rays, and I reminisce on the past few days of the cruise.
This cruise was more than just a surprise. It went far beyond what I expected.
This is awfully sudden. What's on your mind?
Nothing much. It just occurred to me, is all.
Hahaha! Well, I am a member of the Construction Committee. Since you brought it up, maybe you should pay us a compliment or two!
Okay... Well, the restaurant is incredible, the cabins are comfortable, and I'm enjoying the wide array of leisure facilities.
The pool is very tasteful, too, and the water temperature is perfect. It's convenient how you set up a rest area and drink bar right next to it, too.
Well said! Actually, I'm a big fan of the deck, myself.
It's made of quality materials with slip-resistant treatment, so it's great to walk on.
I knew it was a great idea to build a new ship outright instead of buying a prebuilt one.
Hey, that gave me a great idea!
Oh?
Ahaha! Tell me, Commander. What do you NOT like about the ship?
What I don't like? This is starting to sound like some kind of post-purchase survey...
Hahaha! Call it that, if you want. It's related to that thing I just came up with, though.
I mean, the ship's already built, right? Its strengths and flaws are already set in stone.
But the next cruise ship is a bundle of infinite possibilities.
The next one?
Yeah. We're gonna expand on the parts you like, and we'll fix up those flaws...
And then, how about I give you the end result as a gift? Free of charge!
But we have a cruise ship already.
Hahaha! Every cruise ship is unique in its own way, y'know.
The one we're on right now is here for you to enjoy a vacation with all your friends.
As for the next one... That one can be just for the two of us.
With a hearty laugh, Harbin immediately focuses herself on the prospect of a new ship.
With a ship just for you and me, we could go anywhere we wanted, hang out any time we wanted! Call that a win-win!
A sweet little journey on the sea, just the two of us...
Are you getting excited, Commander? Because I sure am!
Alright, it's decided! When we get back, I'll get to work on that right away!
It's gonna take some time, but just you wait!

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>44 Bathroom Slip-Up</size>

scripts.say: Prinz Adalbert invites me to her cabin, and I naturally take her up on that.
As soon as I enter, the first thing I see is...
Oof, ouch...
...The bathroom door, wide open.
Soap suds are practically flooding out of there, soaking the cabin carpet.
Prinz Adalbert herself is a veritable mountain of bubbles. When she fell, her towel slipped right off.
(I'm curious how she ended up this way, but first, I'd better help her up.)
I decide to go in there and help the poor girl.
Oh, Commander! Be careful. It's slippery in here. You don't want to end up on your butt like I just did...
Wow, you've got good balance. Could you bring me that shampoo while you're at it?
Okay.
When I turn around to get the shampoo, I step on a bar of soap concealed by the bubbles.
And then...
Whoa! Careful, Commander!
Oh, no... Down goes another.
Are you okay? Hmm... Should I be the one to help you up? I can crawl over.
No, no, I'm fine. I don't want you falling a second time.
Oh... Riiight. Okay, I'll stay right here. Good luck, Commander. I'm counting on you!
I manage to peel my upper half off of the slick floor and turn to face Adalbert, who's still sitting the way she was before.
Question. Why is the bathroom covered in suds?
Oooh, well, it's a funny story.
When I saw that iceberg sinking earlier, I had a great idea. What if I could apply that same concept to my kickboxing?
Like, whoosh whoosh, bam!
I thought it'd be fun to spar with you, so I called and invited you over.
Then I got bored waiting for you, so I got in the bath...
But JUST bathing is boring, too, so I started looking for a way to have fun. You get how I feel, don't you?
I just... didn't think it'd lead to so many bubbles.
Adalbert awkwardly dries her hair with the towel that's been sitting on her head.
Umm... Okay. You didn't get hurt, though?
Nope. I'm fine as can be.
You really look concerned. Were you that worried about me?
Of course I was.
Heheh... Thanks. I'm fine, though. C'mon, let's play in the bubbles together.
Before I can comprehend her offer, she grabs a nearby clump of bubbles...
...And she throws them at me.
Direct hit! One point to Prinz Adalbert!
Seeing her joy infects me and rouses my playful side in turn.
Take this!
The bathroom becomes an even bigger mess of bubbles.
Phew... Not bad, Commander.
Aww, nice. You finally smiled!
Hm?
You've been taking things so seriously today. I realized I haven't seen you smile much.
So it's a relief to see those pearly whites now.
Is that the whole reason you invited me here? You wanted to spar with me and... make me smile?
Hmm... You're right about making you smile, but I was never actually going to kickbox with you.
Uh, what was I trying to do, again...? Eh, forget it. I got the smile I wanted anyway.
And look. You're all soaked now, Commander. Guess we gotta take a bath together!
I'll wash that back good and clean for you.

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>45 The Sprite's Snapshot</size>

scripts.say: Today, I decide to go to the cruise arcade.
It has apparently just been cleaned in preparation for tonight's game night.
But more eye-catching than all the arcade cabinets is Tashkent, who's sitting languidly on the lounge sofa.
She's still dressed in her costume from yesterday's costume party.
Dear comrade, you finally came...
Hm? Were you waiting for me, or something?
I sure was.
I wanted to give you a biiig hug... Mmph.
When I approach, I finally notice a soft haze in her eyes.
Add that to the wine glass on the low table next to her...

options.content: Do you think maybe you drank a little too much?

scripts.say: Nah. That would never happen to me... Mmph.
Maybe consider having a nap? Call it a pajama party.
Pajama party? I dunno. I'm not interested.
Besides, I'm not even tired...
She picks up the wine glass and gulps down the rest of its contents.
The ice sprite's throat bobs with each little gulp.
...Mmph.
Wanna drink some, dear comrade? It's just soda.
Tashkent pats the couch next to her, urging me to join her.
I sit down as directed. She refills her emptied glass and then hands it to me.
Traces of Tashkent's lip balm are present on the rim.
Use my glass. I don't mind.
I accept and take a sip.
It really is just soda...
Yeah♪ See? I told no lies.
I remembered you told me you liked this outfit when we were drinking at the bar, so I changed clothes and came here.
You're joining the game night, aren't you? So...
So you waited here for that?
Tashkent nods silently.
Either from the heat of the arcade, or for some other reason, her cheeks are a little flushed.
First you get here late, then you accuse me of drinking too much...
I'm sorry. That wasn't nice of me.
Oh, it's okay if you apologize, but I wasn't trying to get you to.
Tashkent visibly pouts... She's a lot more candid than usual.
You need to be punished, dear comrade...
Punished?
I know... I'll punish you by putting your head in my lap and cleaning your ears for you.

options.content: You're going to punish me in a way that's good for me...?

scripts.say: If I say it is, then it is.
Oh, you mean you like that? I see...
(Now that I really think about it, she's not exactly in a state to be going near any of my orifices.)
Could you pick something else, actually? Maybe after you sober up a little...
Oh. Then I'm going to play on the arcade cabinets. Come help me practice.
Now, goooo... Mmph.
Tashkent jumps onto her feet, but before she can take so much as three steps, she starts to lose balance.
I rush to catch her before she falls.
Mmph... Dear comrade... I love you.
She closes her eyes and blushes all the way to her ears and neck.
(Yeah, she's too drunk.)
Left with no other choice, I pick her up and carry her off to her cabin.

sequence:
Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure

<size=45>46 Duet of Guiding Stars</size>

scripts.say: On the balcony, I feel the gentle sea breeze caress my cheeks. Memories of the trip so far reverberate in my mind.
Phew...
Why do you sigh, my darling human? "Is it an expectant sigh, perhaps?"
At some point, Emden – the cruise receptionists – had appeared to me without my notice.
Emden? Shouldn't you be busy managing the cruise?
Such trivial tasks are easy for Emden♪ "We completed our duties long ago, human."
More importantly, you've yet to answer our question.
It's almost time to go back to port. Our vacation is almost over.
I was just getting a little emotional...
Aww... Do you wish this trip could go on forever, my darling human? "We could make that happen."
Hey, how did you know I was here?
We're the receptionists, so we know everything that happens on this cruise. "Isn't that obvious?"
Naturally, we know every little thing you do every second of the day. Heehee♡
...That aside, as this vacation draws to a close, we would love to hear your thoughts on the voyage so far.
"Tell Emden everything. Without reservation♥"
Is this a survey, or what?
We just want to record your frank thoughts, my darling human... "Yes, that is Emden's privilege alone."
Alright.
As I share my thoughts, they begin writing something in their notebook.
Umm, can I see what you're writing...?
Heehee... "Of course not."
"Everything in here is top-secret♥" They're all just boring notes and records, really♡
Their blue eyes have a mischievous glint.
If you simply must know, then Emden would be happy to tell you.
"That's right, human. All you have to do is beg♥"
Wait, you don't mean...
Have you figured it out? Yes, these are all notes painstakingly recorded to plan the perfect, most loving vacation for you, my darling human.
"A journey of love, just for you and Emden. A trip to paradise. You must be getting excited for it, heehee♥"
Are you planning another trip right after this one?
No. Emden still has much to think about. "We have collected much information, but our process has been inefficient..."
As such, we're going to change our information-gathering method♡ "Asking you directly is so much faster than observation and recording, after all♥"
Wh-what does that entail...?
My adorable human, if you have any other plans tonight... you'd best cancel them now.
"You belong to Emden for the rest of today♥" Yes, Emden and Emden alone♡
Never will you have to sigh again... "For Emden will guide you to pure paradise♥"
I open my eyes. It is dead quiet inside my cabin.
There is no Emden sitting beside my bed, nor is there any call from Memphis.
(Rise and shine... If neither of those are here to wake me, that leaves only one option.)
Just as I'm thinking, a ringtone plays in my cabin.
Hiii. It's your favorite ghost calling. You awake yet, Commander? If not, go wash your face and come out!
I'm gonna give you your report over the phone. If you're still half-asleep and forget something, don't go blaming it on me!
(She's literally phoning it in... Then again, she IS on vacation, so I'll let it pass.)
Okay, I'm awake. Continue your report.
You got it. The ship has departed from Seabreeze Island and everything is running as normal onboard.
We're on course tooo... uh, I don't know, actually. Reading notes takes effort. You'll know when we get there!
There's also a... right, a security drill in the ammo storage later today! Remember that, 'cause you're participating. That's my report! Buh-bye!
Wait, what was that about a security drill?
No response. She really hung up just like that.
(Eh, it's no big deal since I got the gist of it. Let's head out and see what's up.)
I put on new clothes and leave my cabin, stepping out onto the deck.
Right away, I stumble upon a group of Northern Parliament girls earnestly discussing something.
...The last thing I want to see is a rush B-scenario. The defenders have their plan, and we have ours. Carry it out in an orderly manner.
Moreover, do NOT use cluster charges if it risks the hostage's safety, or your breaching attempt will blow up a lot more than just a wall.
Yes, that is something we must be aware of. Is there anything else we should bear in mind?
Yeah. We're fighting a mixed Royal Navy-Eagle Union force this time, so in the name of simulating a realistic scenario, don't be afraid to use shields to push the defenders around if need be.
B-but that's so violent! Can't I make the enemy surrender by giving Comrade Commander a biiig hug?
This is a battlefield, not a sleepover! Huggin' ain't gonna do anything!
Maybe it will? All that matters is that we capture Comrade Commander.
Then we could surprise the enemy with an aggressive assault, putting them in disarray while we capture Comrade Commander... Yes, that could work.
Oh, speak of the devil. How long have you been here, Comrade Commander?
What? Comrade Commander, shouldn't you be at the ammo storage, getting ready? You're the VIP.
(So by "participating," Long Island meant I'd be playing a hostage, huh...)
Judging by your reaction, there has been a miscommunication somewhere. We'll find out where it happened sometime later.
To make it clear, this drill was designed to prepare us in case you are ever kidnapped or if your safety is threatened.
In this case, our side is the one trying to kidnap you.
As the VIP, you need to be part of the drill both for realism and to learn how to act in emergency situations.
Let's see... The schedule says that you should go and talk to Memphis now.
We'll handle any future drills ourselves, so don't worry about that. You just need to be familiar with how the process works.
Alright then.
All that said... I think we need to formulate a plan B.
Yeah. Comrade Commander just overheard everything, so we need to start from scratch...
I leave the deck and bump into Memphis, who's been looking for me.
There you are, Commander. Long Island told you about the drill, didn't she?
Technically, yes, but I didn't get any details until just a minute ago. I've got the general idea.
Wait, what? Did she not give you the notes I wrote for you?
All she gave me was a call this morning. She skipped over most of the important things, I think.
You've got to be kidding me! She could've omitted crucial things you need to know about! Ugh... I'll just give you the report next time.
Oh, by the way, I saw Soyuz is on the attacking team. I'm going to get a secret weapon.
A what now? Forget I asked. Just please be at the drill on time! I've got a lot to do, so excuse me.
But, before she runs off to the lower decks, Memphis explains the gist of the drill one more time.
(As long as I can get that secret weapon, I'll have nothing to worry about. I'll roam around the ship a bit until it's time.)
As I'm drifting off to sleep, warning alarms suddenly start blaring, immediately putting me on alert.
(Something's clearly wrong, so why has nobody called me yet?)
(I'd better get to the bridge quick and find out what's happening.)
I rush out of bed, throw some clothes on, and leave my cabin.
Meanwhile, somewhere else...
Cruise Ship - On the Deck
An alarmed crowd had already gathered on the deck, their brows furrowed at the storm that appeared so suddenly.
Geryon, keep a watchful eye on the sea. Report anything unusual.
At Bismarck's command, the steel beast flew into the sky.
This is unfortunate. I wonder what will happen next? "If someone means us harm, we will crush them."
It's strange... I spoke to Huan Ch'ang before we set off, and even she couldn't foretell the coming of any storm.
The storm has made it hard to reach the Commander, too... We'll just have to wait here until we get orders.
Yes, I wonder what the Commander is doing... Until we're told otherwise, we'll just have to do what we can.
Cruise Ship - Bridge
Commander, a storm of indeterminate origin has appeared. I am analyzing it but as of yet unable to explain it.
A hologram of TB appears above the table.
A simple system backup of TB was performed on the ship so TB, too, could enjoy the cruise.
Normally, she wouldn't have to take any action, since all the work on the ship is done by shipgirls coordinating with each other.
This, needless to say, is not a normal circumstance.
TB, were there any errors in our observation records?
Processing order... There were no errors. This storm appeared spontaneously.
Based on latest observations, there is a high probability that a large octopod known as a "kraken" is present in the storm.
Really? A high probability?
Yes. By comparing its appearance with that of similar entities in my database, the most likely match was determined to be this legendary creature.
It is worth noting that the thermal imager and radar are not malfunctioning. A new course has been calculated and may be initiated at any time.
Additionally, defensive measures have been planned out, incorporating the firepower of the shipgirls aboard.
If necessary, the vessel is prepared to enter combat.
Just keep your eyes on the situation for now. There's something I want to check.
Orders received.
Meanwhile, on the deck...
Geryon says tentacles are emerging from the storm. Strangely, though, the tentacles show no sign of aggression.
They aren't hostile to us?
CREEEAK!
The ship rocked fiercely. A rally of tentacles extended from the storm, gently wrapping themselves around the ship.
I... think these tentacles may belong to someone from Tempesta.
I refuse to believe a sea creature of this size is anyone's pet. Furthermore, they are clearly targeting the ship.
If it IS Tempesta, it's all the more suspicious! They're clearly after something, seeing as they aren't attacking!
We're talking about pirates. They could be after one thing.
No, you don't mean...?
The Commander!
(I knew it...)
As the tentacles shake the ship's hull, they creep along the railings and slither their way from the bridge onto the deck.
Brace for the storm, everyone!
The winds grow in fury as the rain pours down. As thunderbolts strike without pause, a few shadowy figures appear deep within the storm.
The dire situation gets even worse when we realize that a fleet has surrounded the ship, cutting off all escape routes.
Heheh. By sailing in these seas, you've already signed a pact to surrender everything you have!
Have you heard the tale? "When a sudden storm brews up and black sails flutter in the wind, that is when the great captains shall return."
For the uninitiated–
That means us evil, evil pirates have you completely surrounded♡
Oi! You stole my line, Hind!
Forgive me, dear. I just couldn't resist the urge to finish your sentence. Go on, say the rest, Fortune.
Ahem... Listen up, people! We can do this the easy way, or the hard way! Either way, you and your ship are coming with us!
(Seems I was wrong. We did run into a tempest after all.)
(I'm surprised Tempesta are actually practicing piracy. Not that it's off-brand for them... I suppose I'll play along for now.)
Goddamn pirates! Of all the hands we'd fall into, I can't believe it's yours!
You're going to abduct us, huh? Then what are you going to do to us?
That's obvious. You're all gonna walk the pla– I mean, we're gonna ransom you off!
And who's going to pay you the ransom if you've already made a hostage of everyone who could do so?
You... can't pay the ransom? Fine, then we'll liquidate that posh ship you've– No, that won't work either! You'll just have to pay with your BODY, Commander!
Well, well, you've let the cat out of the bag now, Fortune!
Aw, shoot... Hey, wipe that grin off your face! I couldn't help myself, alright?
*yaaawn*... I'm shleepy. Can we get this over with?
How did you find us?
Uhh, we...
We really, really missed you, my darling! I looked all over for you, and now I've finally found you.
And my, looks like we caught you on a vacation. If you don't have anywhere else to be, why don't you come visit us?
I DO like the sound of that... but first, I should hear what everyone else thinks.
The answer is unanimous – they all want to visit Tempesta's secret retreat. And so, it becomes our next destination.
The giant tentacles let go of the vessel, and the pirates graciously adjust our course.
Our ship and theirs cruise onward, to the center of the storm that still bursts with flashes and lightning.
Grab something and hold on tight, now!
Ahoy! The door to the New World will open any second now!
Our ship thrusts straight into the storm's center as Royal Fortune boisterously laughs.
Soon after we weather the storm, an unfamiliar port comes into view.
Is this... Tempesta's new base of operations?
Why, naturally. It'd be difficult to conduct business around these parts if we didn't have some sort of springboard, so we decided to relocate after a little cost-benefit analysis~
As for what kind of business... You should already be quite familiar with that, so let's not worry about this matter any longer~
(I guess that stuff comes part and parcel with being a pirate. It might be better not to pry after all...)
(Now that I think about it, though, we've welcomed quite a few guests from other worlds before. Funny that the shoe's on the other foot this time.)
After dropping anchors and mooring the ship, our crew officially sets foot onto this unknown land.
The Tempesta members barely have a chance to introduce the situation with the new secret retreat before a lively conversation breaks out.
Oh yeah, what were you guys planning to do anyway if you hadn't run into us?
Oh, umm... I think we were planning t-to take a trip around the tropics...
But, things are way more fun when they don't go as planned, right? Heehee~
A trip around the tropics, huh? Sounds pretty nice to me~ Might even be a good opportunity to find something special for my collection.
Having that said, as nice as the tropical scenery might be, there's nothing unique or special about it.
In other words, you're chiefly interested in seeking out something unforgettable?
Yeah, more or less~
...I'm not sure that's something you can count on.
I guess you've got a point. Well, we can always save this discussion for later.
Mmh. If it's unforgettable sights you seek, you'll not want to miss out on the auroras.
Auroras?
Yes, magnificent bands of light that hang down like curtains from the skies.
Such dazzling, vivid colors... These phenomena can be observed from both poles, and it's said that a single glance at their spectacular nightglow will burn the scenery into your memory forever.
Of course, it'll be very cold, but you'll forget all about that the moment you see the aurora.
Woah, I'm getting fired up just from hearing about it! That sounds like one of those adventures worth putting your life on the line for!
I'm sure a photo of the aurora would make an excellent addition to my collection~♪
I'll handle the photography! I'll make sure to capture every breathtaking moment!
Hrm? Are you sure your phone will work in the sheer cold? The electronics might freeze over or something.
*gasp*... You're right! I'll ask Ingraham if she can do something about it...
Well, since we've all been talking about the same thing for a while now, why don't we formally set course for the polar south?
The Tempesta crew seems to be on board as well, and opportunities to hang out and try something new don't come around too often. Let's all head down there together, yeah?
Alrighty then! Let's vote on it, pirate-style! If everyone agrees on the same thing, we'll ask Commander to change course!
Now then, can I see a show of hands? All in favour–
Everyone present raises their hands. Royal Fortune and Golden Hind turn to me triumphantly.
(Okay, there are no logistical issues. We're fully resupplied from Seabreeze Island, so... we've got ourselves our next destination.)

options.content: Set sail for the polar south!

scripts.say: Booyah! You're the best, Commander!
H-hey, easy there, Royal Fortune! No need to glomp me!
Just as the merry discussion is starting to wrap up, I suddenly hear someone's stomach growling.
So hungry... Time to tap into my emergency supply of crisps and cola... Be right back, running to my room real quick...
I don't think that potato chips and cola counts as a proper meal... Why not head back to the cruise ship? There's plenty of food on board.
It'd be a pity to turn back around as soon as we got here. How about we whip up something to eat here?
Hmm... That sounds pretty promising. How does a bonfire barbecue sound?
You know, a setting where everyone can sit around the bonfire, chat freely, and get to know each other while eating. It sure beats a stuffy dinner banquet – right, Commander?
I'm fine with that, but isn't it a bit early for that?
What? Did anyone ever make a rule that you can't have a bonfire barbecue in broad daylight? Besides, it's the will of the people~
A barbecue sounds nice... but I could do without the bonfire...
Sorry, but that's not an option~ You'll be joining us as well, Mary, and I can't have you disappearing on us~
Eep! Commander, save meeeee!
Despite it being way too early in the day, our "Big Bonfire Barbecue Bonanza" kicked off without a hitch.
Under the direction of Royal Fortune, Lung Wu and the rest of the cooking crew begin bringing out the meat.
Littorio, Sovetsky Soyuz, and Adventure Galley supply the drinks.
The high-quality ham that São Martinho brought over is sliced thinly, then paired together with Owari's freshly-farmed melons for a light and savory snack.
Laughter fills the air around this strange port, and everyone quickly comes to deepen their understanding of each other.
Before I realize it, the barbecue bonanza is already winding down, and someone signals its end by sticking a sword into the bonfire.
I am most satisfied with the success of this bonfire barbecue, but there's still something lacking to truly make this day spectacular.
That's right! To truly elevate today's atmosphere... we require a ballroom dancing corner!
Yes, yes. Let's make our preparations in the main hall! Bel, gather the Royal Maids and have them decorate the main hall accordingly!
As you wish, Your Majesty.
Wasn't into ballroom dancin' back then. Still ain't now.
Excuse me? Does this Iris swashbuckler have any better ideas? If not, do as I say!
Ballroom dancing is THE symbol of elegance and high class. Us piratey types don't mesh well with that, you know.
If you really want to dance that badly, why not opt for something like a masquerade ball?
Yeah, that could work~ If anything, a masquerade ball would allow us to accentuate our pirate-ness~
Uhhh... both options are equally a pain in the bum.
I'm also in favour of a masquerade ball.
Woah, that's a basically a costume party, right? I need to go grab my explorer's outfit and robo hunting hound that I put together the other day!
Hold it right there. We still haven't decided on a theme for the masquerade ball, right?
If everyone decides to show up in whatever they feel like, that'd be way too chaotic!
That sounds perfectly fine to me. Let's not go with a theme, and let people come in whatever costume suits them.

options.content: I think Golden Hind's got the right idea.

scripts.say: More people can participate in whatever capacity they're comfortable with if we have fewer restrictions.
Et tu, my servant? ...I suppose I don't mind going along with that idea! Now then, my maids shall see to it that the venue is set up properly!
Looks like it's your time to shine, Old Man. "Damn straight!"
And so, the bonfire barbecue comes to a close amidst the joyous din of chatter and laughter.
In addition to the Royal Maids, a lot of the other shipgirls volunteer to help staff the masquerade ball.
(Let's see if there's anything I can do to help.)
I am resting in my room when I'm suddenly woken up by the sound of my phone ringing.
(Is Long Island slacking off again or something...)
Commander, are you awake? Can you open the door?
Royal Fortune?
The one and only! I have something important to tell you, so please open the door!
Gotcha. I'll be right there–
I throw on my clothes as quickly as possible and go to meet Royal Fortune at the door.
I've come to inform you that the cruise ship's destination has been updated, and we are now heading for the polar south!
We'll need to get through one more storm before we can leave this area though, so I'm just giving you a heads-up in advance!
I can handle a little turbulence. More importantly, how come nobody told me that we'd be leaving today?
Well, uhh, you've technically been abducted by Tempesta, right? So, of course we get to call the shots.
I guess that's true. Nobody's ever heard of the abductee getting to decide what to do and where to go.
But, surely you didn't come all the way here just to tell me that?
Is there something else you need my help with?
One sec, let me check for you... Oh, it's from Emden... A mysterious event of some sort is going to be held at the café during lunchtime. It says, "please come check it out, Commander."
And that concludes the morning news from the high seas!
After Royal Fortune leaves, I decide to head out and take a walk around the cruise ship.
When I arrive on the deck, the cruise ship is in the midst of heading to the storm's core.
A storm that manifests out of nowhere... That's worth researching. Assuming it even can be measured.
How it works in principle is beyond me, nya. I can't even get usable footage of it because of this awful interference, nya.
The ship weathers the storm without rocking too hard, then returns to the regular, tranquil seas.
While it's uncertain how much the storm affected the ship's course, what is clear is that we're in polar waters now.
As we sail further, more and more drifting ice floes become visible all around us.
Woo! Didn't expect going through a storm to be so thrilling! It was like being on a rollercoaster. Though, rollercoasters are better.
Yeah, it's completely different to speeding along with your rigging! It's fun, even if it made me a little dizzy.
It would be nice if we could have a similar attraction back at the port! Just saying!
Heroes who braved the storm, engrave this memory upon your minds. A monument shall be erected to immortalize this brave feat of ours.
I also want an attraction like that... i-if it's not too much work for the Commander, I mean...
Heheheh... Let's not forget to put the seats reeeal close together so we can rub shoulders with the Commander.
R-rub shoulders? You mean... No, no, no, no! Dirty thoughts, get out of my mind!
Oopsies. Alsace is overheating again.
Closing my eyes to that tomfoolery, I start earnestly thinking about how to build such an attraction.
I've been thinking about expanding the amusement park, and we could use another attraction or two.
I'll add it to my to-do list. Obviously, hammering out the details will have to come after we're home again.
Yippee!
While they all excitedly discuss the amusement park's expansion, the ice floats are getting more and more frequent.
At the same time, I can see the outline of an iceberg on the horizon.
(A cruise through polar waters, and an iceberg... Uh-oh.)
(No, I'm probably overthinking it. With specs like this ship has, a collision isn't even a one-in-a-million possibility.)
(Plus, we're cruising as normal and TB hasn't sounded any alarm. I'll just find something to do and forget about this.)
The phone in my cabin won't stop ringing.
I put on my shirt, button up, then pick up the receiver.
Hiii! Ghostie here, ready to give you your schedule for today.
The ship is cruising on just as planned. Assuming nothing happens, we'll reach our destination by tomorrow.
By the way, I WAS going to give you my report in-person today, buuut...
But...?
But tonight is finally game night! I want to start practicing right away to find my flow!
Get real! You just want to play games all day!
What was that? I can't hear you! The reception is really bad here at the North Pole!
Oh, also, you should come to the arcade if you wanna participate in the game night! That's all – bye-bye!
She hangs up right on the spot.
(Ugh... Typical Long Island. Nobody told me about a "game night" until now, though. Maybe I'll check it out later.)
I exit my cabin and get on the deck. Unsurprisingly, many from the Northern Parliament are here.
(Yup. Not the least surprised to see them out here right now.)
On one side, I see Avrora, Kirov and Pamiat' surrounded by empty, rolled-over bottles. On the other, Kursk is standing alone, gazing at the ice field.
Try not to have too much or you'll be too drunk for the event later tonight.
Ah... Achoo! Someone pour me a glass!
Bleh... I brought my warmest blanket, and I'm still freezin' my ass off here! Achoo!
Have you considered going back to the cabin area to warm up?
Hell no! I can handle a little co– Achoo!
Fine. If you won't listen to me, maybe you'll listen to the Commander.
You heard the lady. Let's get you back to your cabin.
Or would you rather catch a cold and be stuck indoors for the rest of the trip?
H-h-hey! Give me room to breathe!
Okay, okay! I'll go back to my damn cabin!
Svirepy retires indoors with her blanket, after which I turn around and address all the Northern Parliament girls.
You're all out here awfully early. Have you missed the ice and the snow?
Partly, yes, but I'm also secretly hoping we'll run into new animals of some kind. Are you not hoping the same, Comrade Commander?
Yes, our motherland lies in the Arctic Circle, but this is the ANTARCTIC circle, Comrade Commander. It's a completely different experience for us.
It is amazing that life persists out here. It's a representation of nature's indomitable spirit.
Yes. Just think of the round and fluffy penguins with comparatively small feet that live here.
My heart races just imagining such strange and adorable creatures walking around!
Also, I think it's worth stating that we aren't the only ones gathered here.
All of us are here on this ship, and we've all shared such wonderful times. Most of all, it couldn't have happened without you, Comrade Commander.
I'll drink to that. Thanks for everything, Comrade Commander!
I raise this toast to you, Comrade Commander!
Where's your glass? Go get one and I'll pour you a drink!
Thanks, but I'm good. I'll just have water.
Very well. Then once again, comrades, let's give a toast to Comrade Commander! Uraaa!
Uraaa!
More of our friends gather one after another, drawn by the lively mood.
This extraordinary morning passes by in a flash as we all chat excitedly about our expectations for the destination and the aurora waiting there for us.

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>1 The Cold Secretary</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Hello, Commander. I am J-class destroyer Jervis. I will be serving as your secretary starting today.
I'm pleased to see you're on time. Keeping one's secretary waiting is a faux pas, after all.
I arrived at my office and saw Jervis, my new secretary, was already there.
Now then, Commander, I propose we start on today's work right away.
First on the programme: filing paperwork.
Please start with this stack here. It's high-priority.
I accepted the documents and began reading through the first sheet.
...You're too close to the paper.
That's bad for your eyesight. Please correct your posture.
Good habits correlate with increased productivity. Try to remember that.
A troubling paragraph caught my eye. I read through it carefully.
...Commander. Posture. While I know it's tiring to maintain it, you must try if you want to see some change. May I?
She ran a gentle hand along my back. It seemed I had subconsciously hunched forward again.
There we are. Much better.
On another note, your desk is quite messy. I must ask you to refrain from haphazardly leaving things about.
A cluttered workspace harms productivity, making you fall behind on your tasks.
To use an analogy, it's like letting an illness go untreated. By the time it gets unmanageable, it's too late.
She kindly lectured me while promptly organizing my paperwork.
Although at first glance you'd think she's laid-back, she was actually diligent and very responsible.
Are you taking my advice to heart, Commander?
Because if not, you're sorely mistaken if you think I'll do everything for you regardless.
I felt drawn to her and wanted to get to know her better.

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>2 The Meticulous Secretary</size>

scripts.say: It had been a few days since Jervis became my secretary and I'd become fairly familiar with her.
*sigh*... Didn't I ask you to keep the window open for the sake of better circulation? You need to be more considerate of your health.
She opened the window and a gust of cool, fresh air breezed inside.
Refreshing, isn't it? If you start feeling cold, please put this on.
You mustn't fall ill, or the whole port will grind to a halt and I will need to painstakingly nurse you back to health.
We don't want that to happen, so have this warming cup of tea.
No need to thank me. This is all part of a secretary's responsibilities.
While she sounded a bit grumpy, her strong sense of duty shone through her words.
Not only had she beautifully completed the work I assigned her, but she'd also tidied up the whole office.
Incidentally, I've replaced your inkwell. The one on your desk was running low, so I fetched a new one from the depot.
Please take care not to spill any ink. It's a royal pain to clean up.
Don't mention it. I'm only doing what's expected of me.
Speaking of the depot, I made a list of our inventory while I was there. Here you are.
I've also shredded all the old documents due for disposal.
In addition...
My productivity had shot through the roof thanks to Jervis' impeccable assistance.
"Let's keep this momentum going and steamroll through today's work."
You have the right attitude, but taking breaks is important too. Making sure you do so is also part of my job.
On that note, now would be a good time for a break, wouldn't you say?

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>3 A Papercut</size>

scripts.say: Jervis was insistent on maintaining a healthy work-life balance and forcibly added a couple of breaktimes to my daily schedule.
That's enough for now. It's time for an intermission.
I protested and tried to keep working, but she wouldn't budge on her stance. Her iron will made my every attempt end in failure.
Eventually I gave in and put my documents in order.
Then, just as I was getting out of my chair, I felt a sting on my finger.
...Don't move. Give me your hand and I'll tend to it right away.
First, antiseptic... then a plaster... and we're done. We're lucky I brought my first-aid kit.
Give it a few days and it should have healed.
You need to be more careful, Commander. A responsible adult doesn't get papercuts.
A sheet of paper may be soft, but its edges are sharp.
Antiseptic hurts, doesn't it? Please take care moving forward so I won't need to use it.
As I've said before, no need to thank me. This is what a secretary should do.
While a cut is no big deal, it would be a headache for me if you get hurt while on a sortie or the like.
If you become bedridden for months, I will need to change vocation from secretary to dial-in nurse.
Do you understand what I'm saying, Commander?
"You have a unique way of showing concern for others, but I understand."
*sigh*... For the record, I mean it. If you get that badly hurt, I WILL need to nurse you back to health.
Frankly, I cannot imagine a bigger burden...
I sensed a hint of enthusiasm in her voice as she said that. Maybe she secretly wanted to be in that position?

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>4 Jervis and Janus</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
*knock knock*
I-I'm coming in!
A visitor came to my office. It was Janus, one of Jervis' sister ships.
Janus? Are you here to talk to the Commander?
Um, uh, y-yes!
Calm down. Take a deep breath.
Huff...
Better?
Mhm. That helped!
Umm, I'm here to turn in my naval exercise application!
I have the document right here. Please pass it on to the Commander...
Very well. I will let you know when and where it's taking place if the Commander accepts your entry.
Thank you. I-I'll be taking my leave now! I've got to practice for the exercise!
Good luck with your work, you two!
After Janus had left, I felt Jervis seemed uncharacteristically tense.
I surmised it had something to do with her sister's plan to participate in the exercise.
Oh. Is it that obvious?
Yes. I'm concerned about her.
She's a kind and polite girl, but she's very withdrawn around strangers.
Communication is vital in everyday life. In an exercise, all the more so...
An idea popped into my head...

options.content: "Then let's be there and watch over her."

scripts.say: P-pardon?

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>5 To the Exercise</size>

scripts.say: Port - Exercise Area
The day of the exercise had come. Jervis and I were headed for the scene.
I just hope she'll be okay...
Well... Yes.
But this is her choice, and I support it.
All I can do now is pray that she'll finish without getting hurt...
Jervis showed a side of herself I don't see much – the candidly considerate side.
Phew... It's finally over.
Seeing the exercise concluded without incident, Jervis breathed a sigh of relief.
She had been dead quiet up to that moment, spectating the fighting on the edge of her seat.
Though she won't admit it, I knew she was ready to run right in with her first-aid kit and care for Janus if she had an accident.
Well, seeing as the exercise is over, let's head back and wrap up our work for the day.
Your coming here has thrown the programme completely off. First order of business is...
Oh, if it isn't... the Commander and Jervis!

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>6 Reading Between the Lines</size>

scripts.say: When Jervis and I were about to leave, Janus ran over to us after just having finished the exercise.
Did... Did you come to see the results?
Um, yes. Exactly.
Huh? Th-thank you...
B-but I can do better.
I'm just glad you didn't get hurt. Try to play it safe in all future exercises as well, okay?
I know, I will. Thanks for looking out for me.
Also, don't forget to submit an after-action report.
The Commander spectated the whole thing, yes, but you still need to make one.
I wish the Commander HADN'T come here... Now we need to restructure today's programme from the ground up...
Finishing on time today will be tight, I bet...
Commander, please don't make a habit of suddenly changing plans. It complicates my job.
While, yes, I'd get more work as a consequence of this, it was worth it to see the relieved look on Jervis' face.
I'd just be a little busy for a bit. That was no big deal.
Umm, Commander...
Jervis isn't, uh, having a go at you. She's just expressing concern for your well-being.
Janus! Don't say that!
I know she cares a lot about you! It's why she said that just now – she doesn't want you to become overburdened with work!
M-my point is: please don't take what she said in a bad way!
That's enough, Janus!
Commander, wait here for just a moment. I'll be right back.
Jervis took Janus and led her away.
It seemed like Janus was looking after Jervis in her own special way.

sequence:
Nursing Honesty

<size=45>7 Tell Me Directly</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Jervis entered my office and sat down where she always does without saying a word.
Please don't overthink what Janus said. She simply wanted to clarify what I meant, in case you misunderstood...
She can be kind to a fault, which sometimes causes me a bit of inconvenience, I suppose you could say...
Just please, don't think badly of her for it.

options.content: "I didn't take any offense. Don't worry."

scripts.say: I see. That's good to hear.
A-also, I'd like to make a couple of things clear between us.
Ahem... There have been a few times I've felt things that baffle even me.
For instance, I've felt excitement when thinking about the idea of nursing you if you were to become really ill...
Even more strangely, these nonsensical feelings only seem to grow stronger the more time I spend with you.
It's made me realise what a greedy person I really am at heart.
...Having said all that, do you understand what I'm talking about?
I had an idea of what she meant. She'd become considerably more open since I first met her.
But I still wasn't entirely sure I was right...
I-idiot... Think before you blurt stuff out...
...Y-you really want to know, do you?
Very well. To put it succinctly... Um...
I... like you, I suppose...
There, I said it! Are you happy?!
We've wasted enough time! It's time to get back to work, you prat!

sequence: A light that illuminates the way from up above. A star.
Sometimes referred to as St. Elmo's fire, other times as Stella Maris, and even as an unnamed guiding light...
According to legends passed down from yore, stars were beings of light or flame, ones that took ships and travelers alike under their protection.
<size=51>In return, people would pray and convey their feelings to the stars, raising songs of praise to the heavens above, in hopes they would reach their benefactors.</size>
<size=51>This image of stars, bolstered by the imagination of people, elevated them to beloved, admired guides of light. They were idols to be revered, shining brightly, high up in the sky.</size>
Many stars besides Polaris shine brightly upon the sea. What kinds of hopes and dreams do these stars carry?
<size=51>Listen closely, my child. For your story is about to unfold...</size>

scripts.say: To think that it's already that time of year again! The long-awaited live competition, right here in our port! This is Akashi, and I'll be your host for tonight, nya!
This time, not only are new idol groups participating, but there will also be multiple units fitted with the Muse System, nya!
There's no doubt that this will be a bigger, more exciting show than last year, nya! Here come the contestants, nya!
The powerhouse from last year, expert users of the Muse System! Here's Polaris, nya!
Failed to process purpose of introduction. Requesting elaboration.
There's no real meaning behind it, so just ignore it!
A newly formed idol duo, featuring the recent trend of animal-eared girls?! Here's Eldrige and Hammann, nya!
... (Her tuft of hair made a V shape)
Ugh, it's so embarrassing... d-don't take pictures, you perverts!
A new trio of devils who can sing, dance, and crack codes with their demonic eyes. Here's U-110, Z35, and Z36!
We're not cute, we're scary, roar~
I'm the singing and dancing Z35~ roar~♪
I am the one who dared to summon the shark of the abyss, Z36 of the demonic eye, roar~!

The big guns sponsoring the competition are making an emergency appearance as contestants?! I'd like to award them with victory right now, but I'm not a host who's swayed by money, nya! Iiit's Queen Elizabeth and Warspite, nya!
(It'd be better to just let Her Majesty introduce herself.)
My faithful servants, watch my performance with all of your attention!
Aaaand now, a storm of destruction formed by love that's too suffocating! Muse System unit, Taihou and Roon are here, nya!!
Please, don't look only at the stage. Make sure to focus on the target ship when it gets blown into pieces, okay~?
My Commander, are you watching me...?
From the domain of faith descends an idol of light! Le Malin, equipped with the Muse System, makes an appearance as Lumière!
Sister, do your best!!!
...Hmph.
And last, the unit composed of the Royal Navy, Eagle Union, and Northern Parliament. Let's welcome the stars who will light up the stage, Astrum, nya!
Everyone, how are you all doing!!!
And that's it for rules and introductions, nya! We'll be starting in just a minute. In the meantime, if you'd like to purchase some merchandise, please come over to the store, nya~
Unicorn, will you be all right by yourself?
Mhm, I'll be fine. Do your best too, okay?
Yes, let's all do our best.
Wasn't that introduction too full of spirit?
That's what makes it fun, after all!
Everyone, it's almost time to get ready.
Yeah. Let's go!
Competition Area
All right. So far, so good.
I was able to complete that lesson without a problem...!
(If I can keep this up until the end, I can be useful to Master...!)
Don't you think we'll be facing a formidable foe next?
Why...?
Mm, take a look at the set over there. It looks like they were really serious about it.
Ooh! It seems that Astrum will face Le Malin next, nya! This will be the first live battle featuring two groups of Muse System users, nya!
Cameramanjuu! Pan over to the scene, nya!
(Whenever I saw her during a lesson, she was always lazing around, so I never got to see her practicing once during a lesson.)
(Albacore said she thinks it would be a formidable foe. But won't this be an easy victory?)
SHWIIING!
I am an illusion that races among the waves. An idol that shall light up the sea. I am Le Malin.
My heart is the heart of Iris. My song is the love of Iris. My desire is the wish to grant salvation.
Now, I shall purify thy souls with this song of prayer!
SHWIIING!
...What a brilliant light...!
Everyone, be careful. This Le Malin is different from usual...!
Understood...!
SHWIIING!
Holy smokes! Le Malin is practically gleaming, and not just thanks to the stage lighting!
To think she could produce such a dazzling performance if she just sets her mind to it...
You said it. We underestimated her, bigtime.
Her theme, her moves, heck, even her rigging were like elegance itself given physical form. It all came together so seamlessly.
Not only that, her soothing vocals clearly conveyed just how much effort she is exerting.
Her expression reminded me of Sirius' when she's giving it her all.
We'll just have to match her with an encore. It's an endurance competition now!
Uuughh, I'm exhausteeeed... I'm done. Just let me lie down...
Oh dear! Malin!
I didn't wish for you to wear yourself out... I apologize for pushing you too hard, sister.
Please, Triomphant, I'll be fine...
It seems Le Malin is at the end of her rope... As they say: the flame that burns twice as bright burns half as long.
...No, not yet. The flame within me has not yet spent all its fuel.
(Just for you, sister, I shall push myself to keep going.)
Hohoho! We present you with this brilliant stage dressing, made possible by the lavish props assembled by Warspite!
Thank you, Your Majesty. It is a brilliant stage indeed.
I am indebted to you both. Thank you for assisting us.
It is all in the name of making this competition more entertaining, but you're welcome nevertheless.
Hmm. This might not be such a good idea...
What makes you say that, Algérie?
If they force an encore, it's only a matter of time before Le Malin runs out of stamina.
It seems we have no choice. We need to use our trump card already.
Malin! Just one more song, and you'll be done! We have a box of Dunkerque's pastries waiting for you!
*pant*... *pant*... I think... this is it for me... Oof!
So it would seem.
Splendid work, everyone! We made a spectacular comeback!
Yeah, somehow... Le Malin put up a hell of a fight. I thought with how lazy she normally is, she'd be a pushover!
Guess the Muse System really can work miracles, huh?
It was almost as though she'd been possessed... until she fell over, at least.
This was no case of possession, Dido. Le Malin was simply performing with all her body and soul. The Muse System was amplified by her passion.
If passion equals power, then I guess that means we were nearly out-passioned by her. That's not exactly encouraging.
(Could that be why I was underperforming? Have I been trying too hard and lacked heartfelt passion as a result?)
(They're all doing it for our dear comrade, or for some other personal reason, while I just...)
Maybe, but what if some of the teams just got more powerful riggings than others? What if we drew the short straw?
Muse System does not function as proposed. Posited theory has no logical basis.
Assessment: the Muse System is a military instrument that converts emotion into weaponized energy. As "passion" is an unquantifiable property, its utilization by the Muse System is impossible.
Huh? Wait a minute, aren't you...?
(The Muse System is fueled by one's emotions, is it?)
(If that is true, then this grants me unparalleled power! Nobody, and I mean nobody has more passionate feelings for my Commander than I do!)
(Yes, I am truly in a league of my own! Oh, my Commander, come my time to perform, I shall prove it to you!)
Welcome back, nya! We now return to our Muse System test run and conveniently coinciding idol showdown, nya!
The crowd's excitement is through the roof after the dazzling show our participants have put on so far, nya! Let's have a closer look, nya!
On one side we have the imposing Verheerender duo, nya! If it's one thing they've shown they don't have, it's mercy, nya!
And on the other, we have the troupes of Astrum and Polaris who just ran into one another, nya! It could end in a victory for either side, nya!
Port - Exercise Area
Well, we're not exactly pro idols either. We just have more experience with the Muse System than you guys, that's all.
Oh, by the way, try not to think of this whole thing as "serious idol business." Have fun with it and you'll perform better, trust me.
Indeed. I view this as an elaborate form of vermin extermination. Both my performance and enjoyment went up after I adopted such a mindset.
I'm afraid I don't quite understand what that means, Sheffy...
Look, they're saying "just be yourself." Oh, and teamwork makes the dream work, yadda yadda yadda.
As long as you're all on the same page, your choreography and singing will flow nicely together.
Sounds like something we'd better commit to memory. Right, Tashkent?
Oh, I see. Will do.
(Nobody's quipping at me for once... Feels pretty weird when you're as used to it as I am.)
Also, full disclose: we also explained all this to Lumière and Verheerender earlier when we ran into them. Just so you know.
Thus, everyone knows. The Master does not wish for any one team to have an advantage over another, you see.
Assessment: this information is instrumental to utilizing the Muse System to its fullest potential.
We really appreciate it. All we knew was just guesswork until you guys came along.
Now, however, we have another problem: expressing our feelings through song does seem a difficult task...
It might seem hard, but it's actually quite easy.
It is? Would you please elaborate, Akagi?
If you want an example, just look at Le Malin, Roon, and Taihou. The source of their passion is clear as day.
The former: the bond she shares with her sister, not to mention the strength of the bond itself.
The latter: their unwavering will to fight for the one they love more than anything else.
(And wouldn't you know it, Akagi has both of those connections...)
What about you, Astrum? What passion drives you?
Emotion. The thread that creates a song sung for one's family. The bond between lifelong friends.
This thread does not need a weaver, for the heart produces it naturally, spool after spool, simply through contact with others.
And these girls' hearts, though brought together under artificial circumstances, keep on forging bonds as genuine as any other.
The idol biz, huh? Yeah, no offense, but I can't really picture you as an idol.
I can do it, but I think I'm lacking in the cuteness department. Do you think I'd stick out in a bad way because of it?
Well, let's see... Okay, so, you definitely can't mimic Sara's "lookie, I'm a pink, sparkly idol!" shtick. It wouldn't suit you. Like, at all.
But Sara's not the only idol around. You know her sister, Lexington? You could market yourself as more mature and womanly, like her. Either way, I guess you'll figure something out.
If you ever need someone to give feedback on your image, I'll be here! Hey, wait, the Commander might be better, actually... Be right back!
W-wait, you're telling me to practice with the Commander?! I said wait!
You will be undertaking "idol duties"? I see. Anyone could see how that would make one feel anxious.
But please, rest assured, Dido. As fellow Royal Maids, we shall support you in any way we can. You need only ask for our assistance.
Belfast, if I may: I think we should give her a crash course on the topic.
A... crash course? is there such intricacy to being an idol?
(What worries me is that I will need to relegate my maid responsibilities to others, thus allowing me fewer interactions with Master...)
(But... Master assigned me these duties because they are important! If I abscond from them, I... Oh dear, I don't know what to do...)
Do you fear not being allowed to see Master, Dido? If you wish, I could care of your kitchen responsibilities.
I, too, can help in the kitchen. If you want, that is...
Oh, you're too kind, Hermione! And Sirius, thanks, but... no thanks.
Wow! Despite how advanced the choreography is, you completely nailed it, Tashkent. You're gifted.
To me it is clear as day: dancing on the stage, that is your forte.
Not really. Anyone can do it with enough practice. Tashkent just learns slightly quicker than most people.
All right, but... shouldn't you let the others know? That you've been practicing, solo?
Once I've mastered it, then I will teach it to them. Tashkent can't be the only good dancer in the troupe.
Besides, it's hardly a secret. They already found out that I've been practicing.
...Ah, a message from our dear comrade. Heheh, if you'll excuse me...
♪ Our connected voices will surely bring forth the next miracleeee ♪
(Like the light, my song needs to reach all corners of the world... Or should I say, it needs to reach the Commander's heart.)
Sara, how would you grade my singing, as it is now?
About an 8 out of 10? I want to give you a higher score, but you're not quite, umm, reaching peak vocal softness, I guess?
Aha, then strive for greater vocal softness I shall, Mentor Sara. Hehe~
Have you tired of making yourself at home in my room yet? I have a very important date to ask my Commander out on.
Almost, just letting my first impression of these lyrics form...
Anyway, Taihou, why'd you team up with Roon? I thought you were the solo type. You never hang out with anyone.
To win my Commander's affection with the most stellar performance possible, why else? Why, even that wench Akagi has done the same.
And you, I thought you desired people's ire more so than their adoration, what with all your "pranks." Speaking of, this stage you're working on is far too elaborate. You know that, right?
Hmm... Yeah, you're right. Too setup-reliant, not gonna work. That's tunnel vision for ya!
Welp, before I go, I got one hot tip for improving your choreography: to keep your balance, mind your melons!
You ready to do this, then?
Sure am! This is where the fun begins, guys.
We're ready. Let's get this show on the road.
For Master, and my fellow troupe members, I shall perform with all my heart!
High Muse System power output confirmed. Advancing to next ordnance test phase.
Meh. You're only half as strong as Verheerender, and that's being generous.
I see. Well, we just went easy on you! Wouldn't wanna rock you into the next dimension, you know!
(Yeah, that's a good quip. That should ease our dear comrade's mind...)
You think your feelings can surpass my infinite love? How very amusing.
We shall stand our ground, if that is what you're asking.
I'll tell you this much: I'm getting into the swing of this! Round 2, anyone?
You betcha. This concert is only just getting started!
Attention: emotion inhibition module deactivated.
I will sing with as much feeling as possible! For Master's sake!
Now this is more like it! No holds barred, let's go!
Port - Among the crowd
Whoa! Look, sis! They're singing on a whole new level than before!
They really are... Guess they're getting fired up. Good for them.
Ah. With the trammel of the heart removed, their songs have attained an unprecedented level of groove.
What? Did you just say "camel of the heart?"
Trammel. 'Tis a shackle that keeps the heart under lock and key, denying the very soul its uninhibited emotional liberty.
Ridding oneself of it is the wish of all idols. I have yet to do, however, and find myself upon the endless staircase of recital.
...Ayanami, do you get what she's trying to say? Because I don't.
I get the gist, yes. I sometimes unshackle my heart too if the situation calls for it.
Sounds like Z36's been giving you all weird ideas...
The megaconcert – can we just call it megaconcert, by the way? – is approaching its climax, nya!
Which of our troupes will remain dazzling at the end of the night, nya?
Will it be the exceptionally elegant solo unit Lumière, led by Le Malin?
Maybe it will be smash hit, fan-favorite from last time, Polaris?
Perhaps the all-star team composed of Baltimore, Illustrious, Dido, Albacore, and Tashkent, the amicable Astrum!
Or will it be Roon and Taihou, the Verheerender duo, who have already made it to the end and await new challengers?
Let us find out, nyaaaaaa!

sequence: <size=51>I am a warship, brought to life for the purpose of sinking those that stand in my way</size>
<size=51>A warship I am, brought into this world for the purpose of reaping my own kin</size>
<size=51>Permit me to express my feelings for you, and I shall not kill in the name of it</size>
<size=51>If you permit me to find a greater purpose, then I shall not deprive that of another</size>
<size=51>What I desire is someone to love, to revere, to make me whole</size>
<size=51>And everyone else may as well burn to cinders</size>

scripts.say: There you are at last, Astrum.
Ahahaha... Time draws near for the crescendo, wouldn't you agree?
Taihou! Heyooooo!
(No reaction? Weird. She usually gets all worked up when she sees me.)
This is quite the ominous theme... Is that the type of image you wish Verheerender to have?
Don't let them pressure you. We'll do our best with our own themes.
You don't scare Tashkent!
Let me guess... You ran into Polaris, didn't you? Why, they must have told you all about us and our plans. With the power of the Muse System, the Commander shall be ours alone.
You... intend to kidnap Master?!
And using the very thing you were entrusted to test?! That's just dirty!
Call it whatever you may, I don't care. If it weren't for the incredible power these devices grant, I would've never partaken in this to begin with.
Everyone might make them out to be musical instruments, but at the end of the day, they are weapons. We're simply using them the way we see fit.
The way you see fit... What is it that you wish to express with your songs? Destruction? Chaos?
You're mistaken. Our desires are completely detached from our music and from these instruments.
Indeed. What I want is someone to make me whole. Someone who doesn't mind my... shall we say, little impulses.
And I desire someone to love. Someone to be mine, and I, be theirs.
Everything else is meaningless and serves only to interfere. So we destroy it.
Yes. Only one thing awaits whatever or whoever stands in our way...
DESTRUCTION!
*knock knock*
Office - Some time prior to the second Muse System trial
Cluttering my desk were papers relating to the implementation of a massive port-funded concert. Or, as it's formally known, a second Muse System trial.
Before the trial was announced, I arranged for the same model of rigging to be sent out to each of the participating members.
Given the theme of the event, it should come as little surprise that I requisitioned that Muse System riggings also be distributed among all the factions.
My plan was simple: encourage a friendly intercultural exchange while also testing a new weapons system.
But for reasons I've yet to understand, all the participants ended up with different rigging modules, which made assigning the members into groups a major issue.
You called for us, Commander?
Is everything all right? You look as though there's something on your mind...
I suppose it's high time I explain the situation to them.
Port - Concert Venue
Oh no, nya... The mood in here has done a complete μ-turn, nya! Verheerender look like they're about to start shooting everything in sight!
And I don't wanna get caught in the crossfire, nya... I need to get out of here...
O-oh! Never mind, false alarm, nya! They really had me for a second there, nya...
You clearly misunderstood our intentions. The winner is the one who shines the brightest, both in theater and war. It was all part of our performance, you see.
If we were to actually destroy everything, there would be nobody around to witness our brilliance, would there?
Exactly! Did we scare you~?
(You're one to talk about scaring people, Roon!)
Halfway to death, geesh... Don't do that again.
You might've frightened us good, but we're not running away anytime soon. We've still got a score to settle and a show to finish.
Am I right, folks?
Quite so! The light of our songs must reach more of the world's hearts.
Yeah! Our dear comrade is watching, so we can't quit now!
Master is watching... I must not disappoint! Not now!
Sorry, Taihou, but we've got this in the bag! We can still team up after we beat you, though!
No! Not now, not ever! Now onto the final stage!
Port - Exercise Area
Great, everyone's here. I'll use this moment to brief you all on our next mission.
You might have an idea of what it's about from the title alone. "Operation: Muse System."
As you already know, the Muse rigging is powered by musical energy. Its effectiveness was confirmed in the previous operation, in which the idol unit Polaris tested it out.
This time around, the higher-ups wanted to set up multiple units of ships from different factions, all using the aforementioned rigging.
Each team will perform acclimation exercises on their own, but there will be a competition... or rather, a joint exercise, afterward. The goal is to review the effectiveness of the new rigging.
Basically, there will be other teams using the same... no, it's possible that other teams may have more powerful equipment than us.
...Of course, there will also be units that do not utilize the Muse System.
