...They might ordinarily be our close friends, but for the moment, they are our worthy rivals. I'd like for all of you to make proper preparations so we can tackle this challenge head-on.

These girls were about to take on an unprecedented operation. Tension rises as sparks fly through the air, as the hour of battle nears... Or so it should be, yet these girls do not appear to be affected at all.
Baltimore, you're way too stiff! You don't have the vibe of an idol at all!
She's right. It says "Operation: Muse System" on paper, but this is just an excuse to do idol stuff, right? I don't think there's really any need to be so worked up about it.
I-I guess you're right... ahaha. Sorry, I guess I was a bit too nervous.
Akashi said much the same. That the flyers paint it as a military operation, but you're meant to read between the lines and take it as an opportunity to gather and perform.
What I was told was, this is a huge event at the port, in which many people, us included, will be participating...
I heard the same from our head maid.
Sounds about the same as what I heard. It's just I got my info from Sara.
Everyone's pretty hyped up because it's supposed to be on a much larger scale compared to last time.
So I've heard, too. I assume that the Sakura Empire, Iron Blood, Iris Libre, and Sardegna Empire must have received the same information then.
Then I suppose everyone's on the same page. But then, what was with Baltimore's explanation...?
I tried so hard to write it down as it was relayed... Well, whatever form it may take, it's still a mission from the higher-ups. If we do it half-heartedly, we're bound to fail spectacularly.
Let's leave it at that, then... The reason I called you all together today was because I wanted all of us to do a basic check of our equipment, as well as conduct a simple exercise.
So, we're going to equip Muse riggings and participate in a simple combat exercise?
Correct! Now that we've assembled, this'll be a good way to introduce ourselves to each other!~
The rules of the competition state that we'll need to sing while fighting, so unless we can do both properly while on the stage, we're gonna be knocked out super early!
What a wonderful proposal. But, who shall be our opponents...?
What about some mass-produced ships? After we take on those, we could all use our new rigging to participate in the exercise.
By the way, the head maid has already obtained Her Majesty's permission to use the mass-produced ships.
Her majesty is a sponsor for this live performance, after all.
So that's why these practice holo targets were pulled out...
Holo targets?
Yeah. Holograms that look like us. While they aren't enemies that we can properly battle against, they'll be good opponents for exercises with our Muse rigging.
So I guess they're opponents that will help us get used to the stage.
That's right. You can not only perform drills for mock battles with them, but you can also play some music and have them perform.
I guess if we get outperformed by them, our pride will surely take a huge hit...
I-I think I'd receive orders to be scuttled for that...
So that's why these practice holo targets were pulled out...
...Well, I don't think there's any need to worry that much this early.
That's right! Everyone, let's head over to the exercise area!
All right. Everyone, please follow me.
Port - Concert Venue
It looks like Verheerende and Astrum are perfectly evenly matched, nya! Will we need to declare a tie, nya?
...Hang on, nya! A message just came in! Seems all participants are back in the game for this last match, nya!
We're ending with a bang to compensate for the subpar conclusion of the last trial, nya! Everyone that's still in the exercise area: rush on over to the stage if you want one last chance, nya!
Thou insist on as explosive a finish as this? Very well, then.
I've got to go and support Illustrious! She needs all the help she can get!
Are thou, now? Why, that I do wish to see for myself. Go!
So be it; let us see what the fates have in store. My friends, I call upon you once more.
Raaawr. Lord of Sharkness reporting iiiin.
Wait a sec, 46! We still haven't heard back from 36!
I just got here, sorry! 23 was giving me an earful back there...
Imply you, my friend, that she controls the key to the trammel of the ear?
The... The what? Camel of the ear?
I am forever in your debt, Your Highness and Miss Warspite. This would not be possible without your kind assistance.
There's no need to thank us. I must say though, I am quite surprised that Le Malin has the energy to get back on stage already.
Where she draws her power from is a mystery. In any case, it's delightful to see her back in business.
Now don't forget the conditions under which we lease you our props and equipment, you hear?!
Certainly not, Your Highness. You shall stand right next to Le Malin during the performance, this I guarantee you.
*sigh*... Look at the fancy stuff everyone's wearing! And we're stuck with this...
Hey, it's the best we have, Crescent! Don't be so negative about it!
Umm... C-could we not argue? Please?
Why do I have to go up on stage? This is so humiliating I could just die!
But... cat idol... cute.
C-class sisters outfits... also cute.
R-really? Well, if you insist, I guess we just have to give it a try then! Come on, let's go.
Wow, uh, there's a big crowd of people gathering...
Not surprising when they just announced that we're ending with a free-for-all!
There's no doubt it will be fun for everyone involved. Though personally, I would've preferred a little more... bloodshed, I suppose.
Must everything you say sound so threatening? It scares even me sometimes...
Does it? Aren't you quite similar in that regard?
Everyone together now! Let's sing for all the world to hear!
Let's do it!
Port - Academy
Hey, Illustrious, you seen Tashkent and Albacore around?
Tashkent I believe is in class at the moment, but I'm afraid I don't know where Albacore could be.
Oh, all right. Just wanted to hear if she was gonna continue working as an idol. I had someone ask me about it, so.
You were? It so happens I was asked the same.
What do you know. Apparently, tons of people wanna have a shot at it.
So I've heard. What about you, Baltimore? Will you continue as an idol?
I've got some catching up to do on my hero side-gig, so I'll sleep on it for a bit before I decide.
Ah, I understand. It's not a decision made lightly, after all.
You're kidding! You're seriously done being an idol forever unless the Commander or Le Triomphant beg you for it?
Yes, I've had enough of it. Just thinking about it makes me tired. Ugh...
You know, it's funny, 'cause Taihou and Tashkent both said pretty much the same thing.
(Although unlike them, I guess you REALLY don't wanna do it.)
*knock knock*
Commander? I've finished up the report you asked for. Please, do give it a look.
Oh, by the way, perhaps we could come up with a better title for it? Leaving it as "That One Test" will surely cause unneeded confusion in the future...
What do I propose? Well, something to do with music, stars, and everyone dancing on the stage together. Not quite sure yet...
Roon has a point. We should brainstorm a title with a nice ring to it.
Location unknown - Time unknown
Data compilation complete. And so, another legacy has been documented.
Only took us like a million years. Sure, it's a task from the depths of the repository, but does it really take that much computing power?
There's more to art than the final product, you know. Reproducibility is an important element as well.
Or are you saying that there's some error within our database?
Ugh, I forgot how pointless it is to argue with you. Whatever, forget I said anything.
Oh, you're dropping the topic? Shame. I was hoping to hear about your little vacation.
My what now?
Conductor saw you. Said you were really enjoying yourself. You thought we wouldn't find out?
Would you look at the time, I need to get back to work. Don't worry, I'll keep your little misbehavior a secret. I've nothing to gain from reporting it.
...Uh-huh. Got it.
Port - Exercise Area
(So this is the Muse rigging... Equipment that utilizes the power of music and feelings... A precious item Master gave to me.)
(I want to work hard so I can be useful to Master, but... will I be able to be a proper idol...? Oh no...)
(If I were to fail, Master would no doubt abandon me...)
What's wrong, Dido? You look like you've been fretting over something for quite some time now.
I-it's nothing, really.…
It's just that, it's both amazing and terrifying that a mere maid like me is going to be an idol...
Is that so. The maid corps must have it hard, having to worry about things like that.
...Perhaps I'm simply overthinking it.
Whatever it is, if you're going to take part in it anyway, you just have to go with the flow. It's best not to worry too much about it.
Though we're taking part in idol activities, in the end, it's just to test the Muse rigging. It might be better to just think of this like any other mission...
You're not the only one without any idea of what you're doing. I took a look at a video of Lexington's group's performance earlier to help me prepare, and it made me feel a bit uneasy...
You know, wondering if it was possible for me to be as cute as they were, and all.
That said, this is a chance that was given to me. If I'm going to participate anyway, I'll give it my best.
Yes, that's right. As idols, we've received a wonderful chance to spread love and peace to the world through song.
Even Unicorn was looking forward to this, hehe.~
Is Unicorn participating as well?
Yes. She seemed nervous about being alone, so I asked Vampire to help her out for a bit.
...So how many people from the different factions will be participating? The Northern Parliament wasn't on last time, so I'm not really sure what the situation is.
Are you the only one from the Northern Parliament?
Yup. Also, the Iris Libre told me that they'd like for me to work extra hard on their behalf, and that they'd be participating individually.
Grr...
Aren't you curious? About the other factions, and the teams, and such.
Of course I'm curious, but this isn't the time to be worrying about that stuff.
All right, I'm all ready, let's get started. Muse System exercise, begin!
Whew... So that's what it feels like.
Good job, everyone.
How about we take a break for some biscuits? It so happens I brought some with me.
Whoa, thanks a bunch! Tashkent, you want some? Or can I cop myself a second helping?
I-I'm going to have some too!
All right! Everyone, let's take a short break.
It sure was a good idea to check out the rigging first.
It really was... Though we had no issues using the equipment, um...
I guess the problem is really the "idol" part.
The "idol" part...?
Yeah. Earlier, I was watching one of Polaris' previous concerts. With the way our coordination is right now, there's no way we'll be able to reach their level any time soon.
Here's a drink for you, Miss Illustrious, and one for you, Miss Baltimore.
Thank you. Oh, Dido. Can I ask you something?
And what might that be?
I know that Sheffield was part of the previous Muse System unit, so I was wondering: do you know what kinds of lessons they took to prepare for their performance?
Well, from what I've heard...
I see. It's almost nothing like what I expected.
I see. It's pretty much exactly what I expected.
Gah?! Albacore, when did you get here?
I've been here the whole time, though? I was curious what you grownups were talking about.~
Me, I'm not interested in it at all.
Are you reaaally gonna be like that? Anyway, well? What do you want us to do, Baltimore?
If we want to catch up, we're going to need to pinpoint our strengths and weaknesses.
That sounds like a good idea. We need to look for places we struggle, both in and out of battle.
Well, I guess we have a plan now. Let's practice, er... rehearse, some more！
(I think I've figured it out. The problems each member has.)
(Baltimore worries that she's out of place, because she's not cute enough to be an idol.)
(Illustrious isn't particularly good at dancing, and doesn't get what being an idol entails.)
(Albacore... It's too hard for everyone else to keep up with her brain's RPM.)
(And Dido... has no confidence in herself, whatsoever.)
And Tashkent is so focused on work, she's not having any fun~
Wah?!
Oops. Sorry, I wasn't trying to surprise you... So, you're taking notes on all of us, I see?
I thought they'd be useful for our lessons. I was planning on sharing them with Baltimore as well.
All righty then. Think I could ask you a favor?
...A favor?
Yep! I was wondering if you could look into lesson plans and into other units for me.
Can't you do that yourself? Everyone knows your specialty lies in sneaky information-gathering.
And that's exactly why everyone is on guard whenever I'm around.
Is that so...
Just so you know, gathering intel is fine and dandy, but don't you go around pulling pranks on others.
I see that you're a worrywart. Fret not, of course I know that much.
No, it's more because sometimes, Albacore messes with others without ever being found out...
If it wouldn't be a bother, would you mind if I helped out as well?
I can help ask around with the Royal Navy girls as well.
Thanks, you'd both be doing us a huge service. All right, let's head out!
The girls have begun preparing for the competition, also called the Muse System joint exercise...
(First, the lessons. Not only do I have to get used to this new equipment, but I also need to learn the various skills an idol must have.)
Here you go! You were looking for "Saratoga's Special Video Sessions: Vocal Lessons Vol. 1-15," right? Please watch them together with everyone.
Yeah, thanks. My unit's performance depends on it, after all.
It'd be great if you could spread the word of Saratoga's greatness while you're at it, too!
Are you trying to learn the way Saratoga fights as well, Baltimore...?
(I feel like there's a misunderstanding brewing...)
Here. Try dancing like this.
Hm... like... this?
Um, it's actually... like this.
Hm, these steps are a bit...
(Miss Illustrious, I can sympathise... You're top-heavy, so these movements are bound to be difficult...)
(Oh my, will I be able to stand out more than Miss Illustrious? Although I'm a bit capable at times, I don't know if...)
It's perfectly fine for you to stay just like that, Signorina. Your clumsiness can be your strength as an idol.
Um... Is that so...?
I agree~ Unicorn and Illustrious are super cute due to their clumsiness~
Wha?!
Whew...
D-do your best, Illustrious...!
I think 'space' might be a fitting theme for the upcoming performance~
Huh?
Hm? It's because of the equipment, you know? Wouldn't it be great if the performance was bright and sparkly, just like our equipment?
Is that so. It's one thing to say so, but... is there any reason to push ourselves that much?
Not really? But I think it'd be more interesting and exciting that way! Don't you think so too?
(I-I don't know how to respond...!)
I see, so there are three Muse System units participating in the competition. Besides us, there's a unit with Taihou and Roon, and a unit from the Iris Libre.
Are they teaming up because they're comfortable with each other...?
There's no way to know for sure.
It seems that Miss Littorio also wanted to apply, but Miss Veneto stopped her.
(I wonder what Miss Veneto meant by "impure motives"...?)
And so, the girls made slow but steady progress towards their first live performance.
The song, choreography, stage directions, and costumes... I guess this should be enough for now.
If you keep worrying, we'll never be able to start! Let's give this practice another go!
Sounds good. If we've decided on our course of action, all that's left is to take our lessons and practice during rehearsal.
Miss Illustrious, could you be the center of our unit?
...Yes! If you're fine with me being the center, please leave it to me!
All right! Let's practice one more time.
Whewie... I never expected the choreography I came up with to be this tiring...
It might be a good idea to revise it a bit...
Grr...
It's okay, it's a given that we'll run into problems as we practice.
The Polaris girls went through the same ordeals. It's not something we can avoid.
That's right. Also, we haven't run into any major issues yet. That must mean we're at least on the right track.
That's quite true. If we're able to continue with our lessons in this manner, even our current issues won't be problematic for us in the future.
Even the performance on stage shouldn't be an issue if we keep it up.
If we perform better on stage than we do during practice, that'd mean we're overselling our equipment's performance. Make sure you don't forget the objective of our operation.
There's still something I don't get about our equipment, though.
Something about our equipment...?
Cleveland's Muse System had a mechanism where the more excited the crowd got, the more power it could output.
Think about it. There are plenty of people without the Muse System participating, right?
So, I just don't get why they'd deliberately split up people with the Muse System into different teams.
I wonder... why that's the case.
So you suspect the Muse System's power output depends on who wields it?
Last time, there was only one unit, Polaris. But this time, there are multiple units. That's a bit strange, I think.
For instance, if the Sakura Empire and Iron Blood duo achieve a higher performance with the Muse System, that would mean that they're stronger than us.
In other words, people will think there's a power imbalance between the factions... But I wonder if we're reading too deeply into this.
We'll never find out unless we participate in the competition~
All we can do now is focus on the lesson at hand.
That's right. Come on everyone, once more!
Become a star, and sing a song of love and peace~
...All right! Break time, folks!
Yaay~ *highfive*
Yay. *highfive*
Miss Illustrious, you did great...!
Really, fantastic job. Thanks to you, everyone maintained their positions well.
You give me too much credit. It's thanks to your great leadership that we were able to come this far.
It wasn't just me, it was thanks to everyone's cooperation.
This light should be aimed there... Come on, let's get going! I'll be giving the directions to the manjuus.
Aaand this prop. It matches me just fine, but as I thought, it really won't match Illustrious and the others at all~
This precious commodity that Miss Victorious entrusted to me... I'll use it to make the ultimate costume!
Oh, Sirius, you don't need to help out with that. Please, help me with something else!
I see, so the current fad is idols with animal ears...
Grozny, you've gotten hold of some great intel...
All right, there's only a bit more left for today. Let's finish up and head back to the dorms.
And tomorrow... let's give it our all!
Yeah!
While Baltimore and the others were preparing for the competition...
Polaris, Astrum, Lumière... To think that there were this many units with the Muse System.
And here I thought that the only unit to be cautious of was the group with the little girl from the Eagle Union.
This new Muse System turns feelings into power... As long as I can feed it my feelings, even that little girl will be toast.
So long as I can win against her, the one shining brightest on the stage will undoubtedly be...
Hehe~ Me, of course. The one and only Taihou♡
Oh, my dear Commander. How sinful you are, showing my perfect, idol self to others... Even though you were supposed to be the only one allowed to see me like this...
Taihou, I get how you feel, but I'd like if you could hold yourself back a bit~
Of course, the Commander will be watching the stage along with the others. If your performance is bad due to your focus on other people, it's not going to fly with me...
In other words, if you want the Commander to be your captive audience, you're going to need to put in more effort.
...It's just as you say. All I'll need to do is focus solely on the Commander, and my performance will be flawless.
You mean, *our* performance.
Yeah, that's right. Our performance, powered by the Muse System... Hehehe♡
Man raises acclaim, while the beloved, God's idol be.
Hehehe. How is our diva doing?
Great, there's nothing to worry about.
Hmm...
Sister, please show everyone the majestic elegance of Iris.
On the ice of the snow-covered northern sea, a mass-produced supply fleet led by an icebreaker pushed forth as a line.
Though the war in the Polar North raged on, such a large-scale fleet was a truly rare sight.
The communicator buzzed with static, heralding a certain woman's voice—she who would give the final orders before battle.
This is Sovetsky Soyuz, to all ships participating in this operation.
The purpose of this operation is to expand our sphere of influence in the Polar North, taking advantage of Compiler's destruction and Omitter's loss of foreign support.
Furthermore, we are to thwart the Sirens' growth and establish a bridgehead to retake the Arctic.
As for concrete objectives, we mean to assault Omitter's defensive stronghold within this region.
We will remove the electromagnetic jamming and meteorological anomalies present here.
Afterward, we will destroy the mass-production facilities and weapons development facilities as we proceed to the research station.
Upon our arrival, we will infiltrate the fortress at the Polar North, where we expect to find Omitter's mainframe.
For us to achieve these objectives, it is of vital importance that every single vessel here does her very best to fight and cooperate with her sisters.
Before we begin this operation, I will announce the plans for each combat unit.
First unit, code-name Lancet. You will begin your charge from the archipelago to the west.
Kuybyshev, as flagship, your job is to seize the fortress closest to the Union in order to remove the electromagnetic jamming in this area.
Da-s. The Lancet unit stands ready.
Second unit, Fist. Begin your assault from the archipelago to the north.
You will perform a reconnaissance operation on the Siren stronghold at the Polar North, where you will scout out their forces and confirm their deployment status.
The flagship of this unit will be Sovetskaya Rossiya, should you accept this task.
Understood. The Fist unit will see it done!
Third unit, Lightning. You will join the operation from the continent to the south.
Retake the research station to the north and suppress the Siren forces in your vicinity.
Tallinn, you will lead this unit.
The Lightning unit will do all in our power to see your orders satisfied.
Fourth unit, Weasel. Advance through the eastern path.
Your objective is to conquer Omitter's stronghold, where we believe the core device causing the anomalous weather is contained.
Kirov. I entrust you with the leadership of this unit.
Right. Leave it to us Weasels.
Fifth unit, Hammer. Travel northward along the polar route to the designated destination.
While the other units still fight, you will launch an attack on the Crown in order to contain Siren forces there.
And, if possible... Try to draw Omitter's attention.
Sovetskaya Belorussiya, you will command them.
You can rest easy with the Hammer unit in my hands.
This operation must succeed, for the sake of achieving the Northern Parliament's great goals and for the sake of a better future.
For those who could not join in this battle, allow me to offer my sincerest gratitude to every ship who has gathered here today.
Operation Frostfall will begin at 0100 hours.
Move to your positions swiftly and stand by for battle.
That is all, comrades. Good luck.

sequence: Weasel Unit
Flagship: Kirov
Objective: Destroy the weather control device

scripts.say: In the midst of the artificial snowstorm, the Weasel unit fought off the Siren fleet and pushed toward the fortress where the weather control device lay.
I'm... at my limit...
The Siren fleet isn't too strong, but... The snow is just too much!
Comrade Kirov, do something about this!
It seems now is the time to activate the device.
Now! Portable Weather Stabilizers, activate! Mass-produced ships, deploy energy amplifiers!
When Kirov issued the order, several mass-produced ships deployed odd-looking devices that resembled masts.
The snowstorm from moments ago became a light breeze, and perhaps thanks to the devices' heat generation, the place felt just a touch warm.
The device had literally snuffed out the abnormal weather, as if it had taken them to another world.
The snow stopped...? And the ice is melting, too?
Ura! Now we can actually make progress!
Damn right! The Siren defensive line has fallen back, too; it seems even they know they're outmatched.
Heh. Soyuz's expectations were right on the money.
Without the effects of that weather, their defenses are weak, making it easy to fell these Sirens! Soon, we'll be able to destroy that device!
All comrades, full speed ahead! We'll ride this momentum and obliterate the Sirens' defensive line!
To arms, comrades!

sequence: Hammer Unit
Flagship: Sovetskaya Belorussiya
Objective: Contain the Sirens' main force at the Crown

scripts.say: Not long after the start of the mission, aurora spread out in the sky above the shipgirls.
It's daytime... There shouldn't be an aurora at this time of day, right?
The Sirens' weather control device really is extraordinary...
Making an aurora would be connected to the weather control, jamming device, and magnetic fields...
In that case...
Chkalov? Do you have any ideas?
Tell me, do you know the phrase "geomagnetic reversal?"
I only have cursory knowledge of it...
That would be when the northern and southern poles of a planet weaken in magnetism and ultimately reverse polarity, correct?
Is that related to the Sirens... and to this aurora?
That's more or less right. This planet's magnetic extremity actually isn't at the Polar North. Observation has revealed that it is actually slowly moving towards it by the day.

As such, you can calculate where it is moving to an extent, allowing you to predict some things about the protons and electrons... That is, er, the aurora. Namely, you can predict where and when it will appear, along with its strength.
The problem is that it's outright impossible for an aurora to appear in this location, unless it is an illusion created by the Sirens.
Moreover, if there is a Siren base at the Polar North... Well, that's an issue.
Because if this aurora is real, it's likely that the Sirens are controlling the entire planet's magnetic field. That's what I'm getting at.
If you'll allow me to be frank, it all sounds absurd.
Just checking... You didn't join the operation just to investigate this, did you?
Hah! Of course not.
I don't like taking on problems until I've witnessed them with my own two eyes. It's just that seeing it for myself helped me make a hypothesis.
Sorry to trouble you, Comrade Belorussiya.
Not a problem. So? What are your thoughts now that you've entered your first official battle?
Nothing has changed. It's just another battlefield where I work to earn my keep. I'd say they're all the same.
Anyway, rest assured. I'm very prepared.
Comrades, the Crown is in sight!
In the distance stood the icy, crown-like singularity.
The countless hunks of ice floating at its tips cast shadows from beyond the clouds, making for an uncanny sight.
The Crown... A singularity opened by Code G of the Ashes...
Hearing that the Sirens had conquered it was one thing, but now that I can get such a close-up look at it...
I'm so curious to find out what's happened to the inside.
Would it be like the NA Ocean the Commander described, or would it connect to a different Mirror Sea like the Tower of Midgard?
If I ever get the chance, I'd die to check it out...
Unfortunately, the dying will have to wait, Chkalov.
While investigating the Crown is a long-term priority, our current objective is to attract Omitter's attention.
That will mean taking the brunt of their enormous forces. We don't have the luxury of fantasizing about anything else. Comrades! Do you still believe that you can rise above this challenge?
No problems here. No matter how strong the enemy is, I will fight. And I will win.
Hahahahaha! That's the spirit!
I fought here once before the Crown opened! Of course I can win!
It's my first time out on the front lines, but it seems like I'm on the winning side. I'll help out where I can.
By the way, I am a blueprint ship, so I bet I could even throw Omitter for a loop.
Good. Let us charge for the Crown and drag Omitter out of hiding!

sequence: Hammer Unit
Flagship: Sovetskaya Belorussiya
Objective: Contain the Sirens' main force at the Crown

scripts.say: BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
What's the matter, Sirens?! Is that all you've got?!
Enemy reinforcements spotted ahead! They're approaching!
I don't care! Send all the reinforcements you want, it won't matter!
I feel my blood boiling! Finally, I'm in battle again!
Sorry, but you're not the only one in this battle, Gangut~
Before Gangut could fire her main cannon once more, Chkalov's carrier-borne craft mowed down the Siren reinforcements with explosions.
Very well! Watch my back, Comrade Chkalov!
Don't expect too much from me, but that wave was little more than a warm-up.
This is a hell of a violent reception here...
But if we cause enough havoc, she won't be able to sit idly by and let the Crown be taken from her—
—Don't push your luck, fools!
Is every one of you both blind and deaf?
Do you believe your power is so great that you can outwit Omitter?!
Or did you think your idiotic all-out attack would overcome my genius?!
...Seems like we've found the main body.
That I am! I've seen through your whole goddamned strategy!
I'm almost impressed by how you go through the same pointless struggle time and time again!
It's time for you to learn once and for all that your efforts are in vain!
Hold it! I don't know if I believe you.
If you know the entirety of our strategy, then enlighten us. We'd all love to hear your opinion.
You're trying to buy time now?!
The whole point of your struggle here is to detain my forces and allow your stupid friends to move as they like through my domain!
Well, here I am! Just like you asked! But now it's my turn!
I'll slaughter you all in seconds, and then, I'll do the same to the other units!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Hahahahaha! That's big talk, for someone who's about to get hers!
We're not here to detain you—we're here to DEFEAT you, Omitter!
Take this! Spacetime-Devouring Big Bang Destruction Cannon!
Dazzling light emitted from the optical weapon swept across the water's surface, vaporizing mass-produced ships and the ice itself instantly.
Hot, hot!
She's gone straight for a powerful attack! ...Don't run away! You need to get in close to her!
Show me all of your new tricks, Omitteeer!
Wait, the wind is weakening... Jamming and abnormal weather indicators are rapidly falling!
Fantastic work, Lancet and Lightning units!
Tch... If Compiler were here, I could overcome you trash with mass-produced ships alone...
This is the first time... I've been made such a fool of...
You'll pay for this! I'll torture every last one of you to the bitter end!
Consider this an honor! You will be the first to witness the true strength of my fleet!
The mass-produced ships are recovering? Ah, so you're the new command unit...
Hah! A fight's no fun without a trick or ten up your sleeve!
Enough talk! I'll personally send you to the ocean floor!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
You're the only one who's going down there, Omitter!
I've had enough talk, too. Comrades! Continue your offensive!
At the base of the Crown, the heroic Northern Parliament warriors challenged the evil master of the Polar North.
The cacophony of booms, flashes of light, and steel wings unfurling in the sky continued on and on...

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: Some time had passed since the beginning of the operation. All five shipgirl units had charged into the snowy region of ocean.
In a sea route separated from the main battlefield, an unannounced sixth unit stole undetected along the waters.
Code name Wolf was led by a single woman, one who truly was a fitting choice for a lone wolf.
Hahahahah! So all of the other units are feints, and we're the real stars!
Right.
Rejoice, Kursk! You have been designated as she who will lead our revolution!
Right.
...Cold. Are you no good at talking or something, Comrade Kursk?
Right.
...Yes. As you said, I'm not much of a communicator. I'm used to working alone, after all.
I see, I see! Well... No worries! You'll open up in no time, I'm sure!
Mm.
Aahahahah... By the way! I brought something fun!
We're not in the Sirens' sphere of influence yet, so we might as well partake just a little...
Let's see, where are you...
...Hm? Where did my special supplies go?
No drinking on the job. I left it back at our point of departure.
Noooo!
It's not like I'm Gangut! I drink wine, not vodka! Wine is made for celebrating victories!
We celebrate victories after the battle is over. There's no reason for you to have it with you during the battle, now, is there?
...Sevastopol, you can drink to your heart's content after the battle.
Sound good to you, Kursk?
Right.
Two versus one. Seems like this argument is settled.
Hey, nobody said we were keeping score! This is for the sake of a revolution, so what's wrong with a few sips?!
Right.
SEE?! Now you're in the minority this time, Voroshilov!
Then why don't you go back and get it? Time is ticking, and the mission has already started.
...Fiiine. I give up.
It was then that a white owl emerged from the curtain of snow and approached the group.
The bird, seemingly unaffected by the Sirens' severe weather , shook the snow off of its wings and quietly landed on Kursk's shoulder.
We're almost in Siren territory. My recon drone tells me that there is nothing abnormal on our route.
Recon drone? You mean that little owl...?
No, this is just an owl. My recon drone is beyond our current field of vision.
Okay, but that's an easy mistake to make, right? Like, c'mon.
Sevastopol shot a glance at the owl. It turned its head around 180 degrees to face her, and apparently sensing her confusion...
It closed its eyes in silence.
...Heheh. It's a lot like you, Kursk.
Disagreed. Regardless, the snow is getting stronger. Don't stray away.
Heh. Don't you worry about me!

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: The region up ahead is extremely dangerous. Stop for a moment.
Layers and layers of dark clouds covered the sky, blotting out the sun and heralding the arrival of a great snowstorm.
On the horizon, just as far as the eyes could see, was a structure that looked to be a Siren facility.
The Sirens' floating fortress, one of the pillars of Omitter's Polar North defenses.
Intelligence has confirmed that the weather control device, the cause of the frequent abnormal weather in this polar sea, is there.
Kirov is handling that one?
Yep. According to the plan, Kirov's Weasel unit should be attacking that fortress.
So the battle has yet to begin.
They must be fighting some Siren patrols they ran into along the way.
Unlike us, they have tons of mass-produced ships. They're not exactly going to be stealthy.
I was hoping to slip through in the confusion of battle. Shame.
Voroshilov, activate the Light of Dawn. We'll adjust our route.
Got it. Activating now!
Wait... Our objective's coordinates changed?
They changed?
Are we sure this device is working?
It was made based on the documents Comrade Commander recovered, so it should be more reliable than most of the toys we get from the higher-ups.
Either our objective has changed coordinates, its relative position to us has changed, or another abnormal wavelength has been detected nearby.
The device only detects the flow of energy, so it's kind of natural that it's not the most reliable thing.
So our only course forward is to thoroughly check every anomalous coordinate?
Yeah. That just goes to show how hard it is to proactively investigate Siren secrets.
Honestly, I'm happy just to have a device that leads us to any possible clues.
Understood.
So? It seems like the closest coordinates aren't those of the floating fortress. Should we start there?
Yep. As planned, we'll investigate any unusual wavelengths that the device finds.
Changing course. Let's go.

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: Remember what Soyuz said? "Focus your investigation on places where you can observe the aurora."
The aurora is really clear here, so we must be close to our goal, right?!
Now, I wonder what we're gonna find...
Finding Omitter's main body would be kind of boring... At least let us find a new Siren weapon, or something.
...Not here, either.
What? How do you know?
The aurora is weakening.
I don't like this... Voroshilov, what are the coordinates of our objective now?
I'll check right away.
Device is functioning normally. But the wavelength detection... seems to be a problem.
It's displaying the faraway one we first detected when we entered this area.
The abnormal wavelength closer to the aurora has disappeared.
It disappeared?!
Did the Sirens hide it somehow?
Possible, but there are two pieces of evidence that contradict that.
Two? So you think they're not setting a trap for us?
If they wanted to lure us in, they wouldn't need to use the aurora. Also...
Intuition. That abnormal wavelength didn't have the stench of Sirens on it.
A hunter's intuition, huh?
That makes sense. We haven't even run into any Siren patrols here, let alone gotten into any battles.
But we are still able to trace abnormal wavelengths, so it doesn't seem like the device is malfunctioning...
What if the thing we're pursuing is actually moving?
There's only one way to find out. Let's give chase.

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: The operation as a whole was going well, but only thanks to the progress of the other units. The Wolf unit was not finding much success.
Kuybyshev's Lancet unit destroyed the jamming device, so we've been receiving constant reports from the other units.
Kirov's Weasel unit stopped the weather control device, so the snow has calmed down here.
But the Wolf unit...
It would be a lie to say things are going well.
The wavelengths we follow are constantly moving and disappearing.
I'm observing changes in coordinates every ten minutes, but I can't find any regularity in those movements. There's no way for me to figure out what's going on.
At this rate, we're gonna run straight into the Crown or the Polar North stronghold.
They're on to us.
On to us? You mean the Sirens are?
I don't know.
Either Siren scouts happened to see us, or someone else is in this region.
Either way, there's intent in those changes in coordinates.
If it's the Sirens, then they'd send forces to attack or distract us, right?
Omitter's main force and the Polar North stronghold defenses may be focused on dealing with other units, but it's outright odd that we haven't run into anything at all.
Right. Which is what leads me to believe that someone else is present.
It seems we aren't the only hunters here.
So you mean... Someone other than us is searching for Siren secrets?
That would be ideal. We would still have an opportunity to outfox them.
We'll have to lead them astray while we hasten our own search.
You said the coordinates move every ten minutes?
What are the new coordinates?
The most recent wavelength appeared near the Polar North stronghold.
Just in case, I'll change the scanning frequency to every five minutes.
It'll mean pushing the device to its limits, but we'll need as up-to-date information as we can get.
...Hopefully, we can settle this before the wavelength disappears this time.

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: Stop. Something's happening up ahead.
Huh?! What, and where?!
I see wreckage up ahead. An enormous amount of it.
...Mass-produced Sirens. The whole mob of them was destroyed.
Hmm. More of your hunter's intuition?
No. My recon drones found it.
The unit cautiously pressed on, entering the area full of Siren wreckage.
It seemed a fierce battle had taken place here before their arrival.
They're all mass-produced Sirens... Rossiya's unit really kicked butt, huh?
Not necessarily. Most of them don't seem to have been destroyed by our weapons.
And if the smell of smoke is anything to go by, this fight was awfully recent...
If Rossiya's unit had come through here, then they would have said something over comms. The fact that they haven't means...
This must be... one of those META shipgirls.
Mmgh. If only Comrade Commander had given us a META detector.
The best-laid plans of mice and men often go awry.
Besides... There's an easier way to tell.
Uh-huh? What is it?
You'll know when you see it.
Voroshilov, has the abnormal wavelength moved?
Not yet. But it's right about time...
We'll make it in time. I made sure of that.
Kursk, what will we do if it really is a META?
Do we fight? Try to reason with them? Or do we try to gather the other units now?
...Wait and watch. First, we need to see what move they make.
There's no need to pursue prey beyond your capabilities. Escape is always an option.
They may try to attack us. Brace yourselves for anything.

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: Halt.
I smell a beast... No, that's the stench of raw malice.
Yeah...! That aura's almost as strong as Gangut's vodka!
Up above! Dodge!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Did someone just launch carrier-borne craft at me?! Geez, that scared me!
A carrier?! But that wave of attacks was too uncoordinated...
I see. Different forces ahead and behind us.
We're surrounded?
Two enemies total. One in front. One behind.
Hiryuu of the Sakura Empire... But she's only a Pawn.
The other feels... odd. That must be a META.
Recon drones would only be shot down. I'll use Flea this time.
F-Flea...?
A small submarine used for scouting. Perfect for intelligence operations.
You sure have a lot of crazy tricks up your sleeve...
But ol' battleship Sevastopol is still the real firepower of this operation!♪
...Sorry for not explaining ahead of time.
Forget all that. Why is a META working with a Pawn?
And Pawns shouldn't be able to slip through our radar undetected, right?
I'm afraid I don't know...
A second wave is coming! Watch out!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
She's strong... My attacks aren't even working.
At least the Pawn is like any other Pawn we know.
She might be a little durable, but she's a weakling otherwise!
Kursk, can we deal with this Pawn first?
I wouldn't. It smells like a trap.
More intuition, I'm guessing...
Right. Unlike you two, I have an especially keen intuition.
That would probably be why Soyuz allowed me to lead this unit. If that is a problem, I'm sor—
Don't apologize. You're our flagship, right?
Yeah! We'll do whatever it takes to help a friend of the revolution! Now, do we have any way to defeat them?
Absolutely not. We retreat.
Roger that! Wait... Retreat? Even though we finally caught them?!
I'll explain later. You said you'd help, right?
O-of course!

sequence: Wolf Unit
Flagship: Kursk
Objective: Scout the region

scripts.say: We should be safe here.
Now, we should hide and trail them from a far enough distance that they don't detect us.
I think I see how you're thinking now!
Whatever this anomalous wavelength we're looking for is, it must be something important to the Sirens.
And if that META keeps on wreaking havoc after what she did to those Siren ships, they're sure to come and try to stop her.
Which means if we back off, we can let the META weaken the Sirens first!
You are correct. We pit the META and Sirens against each other.
The other units are doing well. We have time.
Has the anomalous wavelength moved?
It hasn't moved yet. Maybe she's already fighting Sirens?
Good. We don't know how much of a fight the Sirens will put up against her...
But let's wait and watch for now. I'll have Flea continue to monitor them.
*bzzzzzt*...
...Hm? I can't make out what's being said.
The jamming device should be destroyed by now... Is the communicator broken?
Here. Let me try this really smart method Soobrazitelny taught me.
*pow!* *bang!* *crash!*
Soyuz... Read me...
Mm... Still not fixed, huh? At least we can kinda hear people now...
I can't believe it...
Current situation... We are... Fully...
Must terminate... Mission at once...
Whole fleet... Assemble at... I repeat...
*bzzzzzt*...
Wh-what's going on?
I couldn't hear that well, but she said we're terminating the mission, right?!
I'll contact Soyuz. We need to figure out what's happening.
...No answer.
What about the port and dock?
Likewise. No Western Europa base is picking up.
There's no choice. We need to contact Comrade Commander!
I tried that, too... Still no luck.
Wolf unit, can you hear me?! Answer at once!
This is the Fist unit. The operation has been terminated! Break radio silence and respond immediately!
This is Voroshilov of the Wolf unit! We can hear you!
Oh...! Thank goodness you're safe!
Did you hear Soyuz's broadcast message?
Yes, though intermittently, due to interference. What in the world is going on?
We don't have a full grasp of the situation, either.
However, we've confirmed that we have lost all contact with Western Europa.
However, it seems we can communicate with other units and patrols in the region without issue.
For the time being, we are to gather at the operation's advance base in the archipelago.
If there are any Siren pursuers, do not panic; fight them off with cool heads.
Once everyone has evacuated from the danger zone and gathered at the rendezvous point, we will gather information and consider our next moves.
Understood... I suppose this is our only choice for now.
Unfortunately, that seems to be the case. Anyway, I'll see you at the base.
Right. See you there.

sequence: It seemed as though the storm raging over the Polar North had ceased for the moment.
However, they were oblivious to the greater threat that approached––

scripts.say: Far from the Frostfall operational area...
The pre-battle operation briefing ended, but another monitor lit up before Soyuz's eyes.
We've been building up our strength for so long. Now, it's finally time...
Yes.
Have you decided not to involve the Commander after all?
This is an extremely difficult operation. We can't begin to fathom what Omitter might do when cornered.
We alone must bear the risks involved in this operation.
Besides, the Commander has been busy conducting research with the Eagle Union for some time now. Why not give our good Commander a moment to unwind at the World Expo?
By the way, how is the situation over there?
All is well. The venue is the very picture of peace. Honestly, I almost find myself bored by how little has happened.
Though, news that the Commander would come has caused more than a little bit of commotion~
Hahaha! I can imagine.
And what of the Dragon Empery? I'd heard that they planned to leave, but I imagine the news must have changed their plans.
Well... Actually, they already left before the news broke.
It's too late to turn back the clock, though it really is a shame.
But for now, Soyuz, please focus on the impending battle.
Right. I suppose that's enough small talk.
I'll be praying for your victory from here in Sardegna, Comrade Soyuz.
The screen flickered and turned off, bringing silence to the room once more.
After a moment of quiet thought, Soyuz checked the time and connected to the mission command network.
Outside the building, the polar snowstorm raged yet harder.

sequence: Lancet Unit
Flagship: Kuybyshev
Objective: Destroy the electromagnetic jamming device

scripts.say: Under the light of dawn, a fleet sailed slowly through the gaps between ice floes.
So sleepy... Urgh, I messed up...
Did you stay up all night again? Here... Warm yourself up with a cup of hot chocolate.
Mm. I'll take you up on that.
I meant to just skim through those files, but before I knew it, it was morning...
Some for you, too, Tashkent.
Oh, thanks. *gulp, gulp*...
Do you feel nice and warm now?
Mm, that's right. Nice and warm... Thanks.
I'm in peak condition now!
Oops. I almost forgot to spot-check the mass-produced fleet!
Don't worry about it. I just checked them, and everything looks normal.
Not a single problem, in this harsh environment?
Heh! The mass-produced models were specially improved just for this operation.
On top of being able to resist Siren interference, they also come with tons of "special mods."
Was that in those files, too? I didn't get to finish them last night...
Did you already read through them all, Tashkent?
Nope. I was just flipping through, and that happened to catch my eye.
It just happened to, huh? You know, I saw you trying to hide a yawn a minute ago.
Liar! I am ALWAYS in peak condition, got it?!
Hmm... Okay. Mm, then that's all.
But what makes those "special mods" so special?
They didn't look too different to me...
I dunno. Maybe they added some weird parts.
If that so-called mechanical mastermind Soobrazitelny was here, she'd tell you all about it.
Mechanical mastermind...
Not convinced, Gremyashchy?
That's not it. It's just that, when it comes to the Sirens, our stuff always breaks at a pivotal moment. So forgive me if I don't expect much.
...Can't argue with that.
When that time comes, focus on keeping yourself safe. Don't you dare do anything stupid.
I'll find a way to see the mission through.
That just means you're gonna try to carry the mission on your shoulders and get hurt in the process, right?
I don't want that.
All we can do is pray that things work out. Mm, that's all.
There was a moment of silence. The gap in the ice floes widened, gradually improving visibility.
That's it... The Eagle Union supply fleet.
Right on time. I was worried they wouldn't come...
The Eagle Union always makes good on their promises.
But it doesn't look like they brought the firepower to support us in battle. This one's up to the Northern Parliament.
We shouldn't dawdle here. Once we've resupplied, let's hurry to our objective, okay?

sequence: Lancet Unit
Flagship: Kuybyshev
Objective: Destroy the electromagnetic jamming device

scripts.say: The Lancet unit sailed forth, circling around the sea region currently under Siren control.
Strange... We haven't run into any real enemy forces yet.
That may be because the other units have drawn their attention.
Even the Sirens don't have inexhaustible forces. The Commander's fighting has proven that much.
There is some danger involved in dividing our units as we have, but it's perfect for finding Omitter's weaknesses.
The aurora got brighter...
According to the files, the brighter the aurora is, the stronger the Sirens' jamming is.
Are the mass-produced ships okay?
For now, they're fine. They really put a lot of effort into those upgrades.
We should get them into position. The Siren fortress is up ahead, so let's prepare for battle before we arrive.
Gotcha. I'll mobilize the mass-produced ships into firing position.
Good! Let's join the battle!
Kuybyshev's acceleration froze the water below her, blowing about crystals of ice that melted into a drizzle when subjected to the heat of her engine, before finally being blown away by cannonfire.
Mass-produced fleet, begin firing!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Their concentrated bombardment flew toward the target zone like black hailstones raining down upon the Sirens' heads.
As if awakened all at once, the fortress spewed countless mass-produced Sirens who moved to attack Kuybyshev's Lancet unit.
Is that so? If it's a fight you want... then behold our power!
Ura!
Something's coming out!
Is that Omitter...? I thought she was supposed to be in the Crown!
She seems different. Like Compiler, this must be one of her vessels.
Gremyashchy?
...It's been fifteen seconds, and she still hasn't hacked into our comms.
That's definitely one of Omitter's vessels. Yep, that's all.
Hmm, that is an interesting method of telling them apart. I'll remember that.
A vessel, huh? Boring... Watch me tear it apart!
Destroying her vessel won't do anything; it can just come back as long as Omitter is alive. We gotta focus on destroying the electromagnetic jamming device here.
I'll have the mass-produced ships buy us time. Let's hurry on.
Mass-produced ships can't win against a vessel. If we don't beat Omitter now, she might catch up and attack us from behind.
Then allow me to draw her attention. Tashkent and Gremyashchy, you destroy the jamming device.
No!
Before the battle, Soyuz told us to work together!
Yeah. We won't let you fight alone.
...Then we have no choice. Let's defeat Omitter's vessel, and then we'll search for the device.
That's how our Pathfinder should be. Yep, that's all!
Throughout their battle with Omitter's vessel and the Siren fleet, the unit gradually approached the fortress facility.
Let's destroy it and Omitter in one fell swoop! Ura!
The walls of the fortress and surrounding icebergs were already full of holes from the Northern Parliament's ferocious assault.
Tashkent and the mass-produced ships trained their sights on Omitter. They fired, ready to deal the final blow.
Kuybyshev, Omitter has entered the firing point! Hurry and get out of the way!
Understood!
Skillfully handling her enormous rigging, Kuybyshev whipped around and got away from Omitter.
The moment she turned her back to the enemy, countless shells closed in on Omitter and landed all at once, engulfing the area in smoke.
When the smoke finally cleared, Omitter was gone.
Destroyed her without so much as a trace. Heheh, this is what happens when you try to stop the Northern Parliament's fleet!
The jamming has weakened, too... Yep. That's all!
Could it be that the tower destroyed alongside Omitter contained the jamming device?
Really? We're pretty lucky!
Heehee. Sometimes, luck can turn the tides of battle.
With their command unit defeated, the Sirens are scattering. Does that mean we completed our mission?
That's right. Now, I'll contact reinforcements, call the occupying force, and have the facility seized.
*drip*...
This is the first unit, Lancet. We've successfully conquered the Sirens' fortress. Once we've met with the occupying force, we will move to the next phase of the operation.
These radio waves would surely overcome the fierce polar winds and bring welcome news to their comrades.
However, the operation in the polar region had only just begun.

sequence: Fist Unit
Flagship: Sovetskaya Rossiya
Objective: Scout the Polar North Stronghold

scripts.say: Shells fired by mass-produced Siren ships struck the ice ahead, sending forth a shower of shattered ice that obstructed the unit's view.
Ah! Another Siren patrol... Should we avoid this one, too?
Affirmative. Our course of action remains as it was: until we arrive at the enemy stronghold in the Polar North, we avoid every confrontation we possibly can.
Supply Point - Polar North Outpost
It's not following us. Does that mean those don't leave their patrol area, or something?
It must be a patrolling force from the Crown.
Or maybe from the research base? Our route takes us through a zone controlled by both of them.
Can you tell which one it is, Volga?
Given its direction of travel, perhaps it is from the research base...
B-but Kronshtadt and I only went there once. I hope the unit tasked with the research base is doing okay...
Do you think it didn't chase us because they're already fighting out there?
I just didn't think we'd encounter Sirens that close to the supply point...
Can the supply fleet survive in these conditions?
That doesn't merit concern at this moment, Minsk.
Due to the difficulty of supplying our unit's efforts, autonomous submarines will provide us with supplies.
They're deep under the surface right now and will only show themselves when I've sent an encrypted signal at the designated point.
S-special submarines are supplying us this time?! This is way too luxurious a use for them!
That should inform you of how vital and difficult the coming operation will be.
The Polar North stronghold is under Omitter's strict security. Worse, we have little intelligence on it.
On top of the Siren mainframe, it is probable that other secrets are hidden there. That is why we need to perform careful reconnaissance before the assault proper.
Compared to that, passing through overlapping Siren defenses and coming home safe sound like easy pickings.
Soyuz entrusted this side of the operation to us because she recognizes our abilities.
...However, nothing would be gained by our charging in alone. Our mission objective would be impossible without the cooperation of our fellow units.
What is the status of the mass-produced ships' damages and ammunition reserves?
We've lost about thirty percent of our mass-produced fleet. But we have plenty of ammunition left over!
...The damages are greater than I expected.
When you advance this far into Siren territory, their jamming can make normal mass-produced ships into little more than a liability. And our special models are limited in number...
I just hope Kuybyshev's unit completes their objective soon...
That would be ideal, but in war, things rarely go according to plan.
We should press on while the other units distract Siren defenses.
If we delay too much, the enemy will regroup and surround us.
This is our only chance. We mustn't let it go to waste.
We must be prepared for the worst case: that we must complete the mission even in an environment with full electromagnetic interference.
To that end, it's necessary that we minimize losses and preserve our forces for when we need them.
Hmm... We're almost at the supply point. I'll send the order for the submarines to surface.
All ships, be alert and resupply as quickly as possible!
Roger!

sequence: Fist Unit
Flagship: Sovetskaya Rossiya
Objective: Scout the Polar North Stronghold

scripts.say: The weather is getting really bad...
It only gets worse as we approach the Polar North.
This shouldn't be a Mirror Sea, but that meteorological anomaly weapon is just as troublesome. How does it even work...?
S-someone that looks like Omitter has been spotted to the northeast!
Did she use the snow and jamming to hide her approach?!
We're almost at the Polar North stronghold. There's no point in forcing ourselves to remain unseen anymore.
Concentrate your firepower and smash her to bits!
Confirmed the destruction of high-ranking Siren, Omitter! Ura!
She didn't fight like a high-ranking Siren. Was that one of those vessels I've heard about?
And the mass-produced Sirens here are a type I've never seen before. Rossiya, do you know them?
No... But I do know that these are much stronger than any other mass-produced ships we've fought.
Despite our defeating the elite humanoid enemy, their fleet has yet to fall into chaos. That must mean that the Command unit—
Another Omitter came out! This one doesn't seem like the real one, either!
Rossiya, our mass-produced ships have taken more losses than planned. Should we regroup first?
Not yet. We need to get a little closer to the stronghold! Ideally, we'd even draw the real Omitter to this battlefield!
If we're going to retreat, then it should wait until we have a better idea of their mass-produced ships' features! Hold on a little longer!
While distancing themselves from the enemy, the Fist unit attacked Omitter's vessel and gathered information on the hostile mass-produced ships.
Suddenly, there was a strong gust of wind that seemed to darken the sky all at once.
Is it just me, or is it darker now?
There was a biting chill as the blizzard intensified. In its midst appeared a figure darker than the sky itself.
A Sakura Empire carrier...?
For just an instant, Volga felt as though she'd been spirited away.
Her senses left the battlefield, returning to the Suliko that slept in the depths of the Arctic.
Shards of meteorite, the sample analysis device shining with an odd glow...
When her senses returned to the present, both the figure and the device had disappeared.
The communicator set up for this mission only buzzed, its signal blocked out by the interference of the raging blizzard.
Volga stumbled. Just as she was about to fall, somebody caught her and helped her back up.
Volga, are you okay?!
Did a Siren attack hit you?!
I-I'm fine! I was just a little distracted... Did you see that person just now?
A person? What do you mean?
All I know is that the sudden intensification of the snowstorm separated us from the rest of our unit and mass-produced ships.
Anyway, we shouldn't do anything crazy. I've set what few mass-produced ships we still have to patrol mode.
Who knows if they'll help, though? I just hope they can buy us some time...
The fleet is all separated... Oh, what do we do?
Watch out!
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
A shell fired from behind landed dangerously close to the pair.
It came from behind us. Are we surrounded...?
D-did our mass-produced ships mistake us for the enemy?!
Umm... We're in danger, right?
Can't blame them... The Siren jamming is so strong, and this weather definitely isn't helping.
Rendezvous point... Contact... Coordinates...
That was Rossiya's voice! Thank goodness the communicator is working...
Phew... Oh! It's cool that the communicator is fixed, but look. The snow is thinning out, too.
Maybe the Weasel unit cleared their objective! Ugh, thank the stars for that...
This is Minsk. Volga and I have joined up again, and our communication line seems to be recovering! Please give us the coordinates of the rendezvous point!
This is Sovetskaya Rossiya. I've sent the coordinates.
Perhaps due to the weakening interference, Omitter's vessel has retreated for the time being.
We will continue the mission. Once we've all regathered, we resume our march toward the Polar North stronghold.
Roger that!
Everyone's okay!
Yeah! Let's go meet them right away!

sequence: Lightning Unit
Flagship: Tallinn
Objective: Recapture the research base

scripts.say: Ah, ah... Achoooo!
You're running out of tissues, right? Here you go~
Thanks, Murmansk! But don't worry too much about me.
Soobrazitelny, when was the last time you took a break?
The day before... I mean, uh, last night!
Hmm... It sounded to me like you were about to say "the day before yesterday."
I ordered you to get proper sleep before the mission. Did you stay up all night?
This mechanical mastermind doesn't need breaks!
...Yeah, you don't believe that. But still, this mission is important. I had to make sure my modified mass-produced ships were in tip-top shape!
Ooh. I knew I hadn't seen you around! So you were modifying all of those ships~
I was doing other stuff, too! I just can't tell you much yet, but...
Hah hah haaah! You'll be amazed when you see them! They're all incredible creations based on the files the Commander found!
Yeah, yeah. Thanks for your work on the mass-produced ships.
Now, great mechanical mastermind, I'd like to ask about something I noticed during my pre-departure spot checks.
While I'm hardly a professional, I do happen to know some things from my time with the Iron Blood.
So let's just say my intuition is a little more reliable than your average shipgirl's.
All this to say, well... Tell me, do your "special modifications" follow proper safety protocol?
You know what they say! Protocol is made to be broken.
A-as long as they don't explode, I'm sure everything will be fine~
Surely they won't explode... Right?
Th-they won't! I solved that problem by the third round of prototypes! They're as safe as can be!
In other words, the first and second prototypes did explode...
As I understand it, we would be better off positioning our mass-produced ships further away for this operation.
Hey, you might not trust me, but at least trust Chkalov's engineering abilities!
I only let them be this close to us because I trust her!
C'moooooon!

sequence: Lightning Unit
Flagship: Tallinn
Objective: Recapture the research base

scripts.say: On the horizon appeared a spire – the remains of the abandoned Northern Parliament research base.
Oh, research base! Your mechanical mastermind, Soobrazitelny, has returned to you! Mommy's home!
...It hasn't really changed much though, has it?
I'm not about to talk about Sirens' aesthetic choices, but do they normally leave conquered buildings intact?
While the exterior may be different, it's likely that they've completely overhauled the interior.
More importantly, our real objective here is Omitter's mass-production base that was discovered nearby.
If we can conquer that, the other units will have fewer enemies in their way, and future fights in this area will be easier.
We don't even have to kill them all, either. Our attack will draw plenty of Siren attention.
That'll make things quicker for the units destroying the jamming device and weather control device.
We've been fighting a defensive war for so long. It's out time the Northern Parliament shows Omitter its stuff!
That's right. I fully agree.
Ah! Everyone, the Siren's fortress defense fleet has appeared.
One, two, three... Yep, they're approaching from three directions~
Hah hah haaah! In that case...!
While the Lightning unit carefully adjusted their formation, Soobrazitelny suddenly sent a command to the mass-produced ship fleet.
When she did, the usually-slow larger ships rushed forward out of nowhere and formed up before the Sirens could reach their attacking positions.
What in the... Mechanic, what have you done?
I've set their engines to overdrive! It won't last long, but it packs a punch while it lasts!
While they're active, we'll break through the Sirens' defensive line, destroy the production facility, and stop them from sending any reinforcements!
Wait. What happens when overdrive wears off?
They'll charge into the Siren line, and BOOM! You get free damage as a side bonus!
...Do the other units know about this overdrive feature?
Nope. I only installed it on our unit's ships, after all!
It's still in the combat testing stage, but if it works well, I'll report it to the higher-ups and push to get it installed on every mass-produced sheep in our fleet!
Impressive that you thought of such a feature... Perhaps I should inform Soyuz of your genius?
...I think she knows already.
It's, um... It's written in the extra notes at the bottom of page 1,873 of our report!
Anyway, let's focus on the battle! Focus!
We gotta take back the research base and accomplish our duty!

sequence: Weasel Unit
Flagship: Kirov
Objective: Destroy the weather control device

scripts.say: Shortly after departing from the mission starting position, the calm weather abruptly changed into a violent blizzard.
Ever since Rossiya's unit took down that Siren fortress, the weather in this area has been so unstable...
Maybe Omitter had some kind of crazy back-up plan!
If so, that would reveal that we've attacked at a time when her defenses are incomplete. There will be no better time than now.
*hic*... So she back hired?
Haha! Her plan backfired, you mean.
Okay. So we fight the bad guys, destroy the device, and that'll fix the weather.
That will actually fix the weather, right...?
We can't be certain. But given the scale and our intelligence, we have good reason to believe that the main device is in the fortress we are targeting now.
Then let's hurry—Aaaah! The wind...!
Gromky held her hat down and tried her hardest to fight the wind, but the wild blizzard seemed unwilling to allow the fleet's advance.
We can't stop the snow unless we reach the fortress, but we can't get there in this blizzard...
Don't worry. I have a way to deal with this.
Huh? Like a secret weapon?
That's right. Though only for a short time, this device will allow us to resist the Sirens' extreme weather.
The Portable Weather Stabilizer... When activated, it should reduce the impact of this extreme weather on us somewhat.
Portable... Whuh?
I don't know its inner workings myself, but according to Voroshilov, it seems to be made to "modify the climate of a permafrost environment to make it livable"...
Modify the... Bwuh?
Kronshtadt simplified it as such: "an easy-to-use weapon for the Northern Parliament to level the playing field a little bit."
That said, due to their size, they can only be installed on mass-produced ships. Their energy usage means that we can't use them for long, as well.
I will decide when to activate them. When I do, we charge through all at once.
Unfortunately, we will have to weather the storm for the rest of the way.
Consider it a trial that tests our will to pursue victory. Let them know that the Northern Parliament's charge cannot be stopped, with or without this device!
On this day, we will show the Sirens our true strength!
Yeeeah! I'll do my best to hold out!
Ura! Me, too!

sequence: "When strife befalls our home, I shall hoist our proud flag high."
"The point of my sword shall lead me forward."
"Through the Arc I leave for war, and through the Arc I shall return victorious."
"Give me protection now, as I sortie once more."
"Give me guidance now, as my cannons take aim."

scripts.say: Vichya Dominion - Naval Port
It seems Sardegna has become part of the Crimson Axis... In line with what we expected.
The battlefield is always changing, and an ally of yesterday may become your enemy tomorrow...
They say man is bound to unknowingly repeat history forever. Maybe they're not entirely wrong.
I wish they'd at least keep up the pretense of neutrality. We don't want to get into an all-out war...
What can you do? What's done is done.
What's up with you lately anyway, Algérie? I rarely see you this serious.
As opposed to what? Do I normally come across as a jokester?
Haha, of course not. I guess I'm just used to seeing you always be elegant and composed, in control of any situation.
Don't tease me like that. Given the importance of this operation, I think it deserves at least a little gravitas.
Can't argue with that. On that note, can you guess why I'm here?
I don't know, can I?
Knowing you, I'm sure you already have a hunch.
How about... HQ has decided to respond to Sardegna's sudden fall to the Crimson Axis with a show of force?
And you're part of the group tasked with staging an assault on them?
Dang, it's scary how on-point that guess is... Nothing gets past you, huh?
It's not hard to figure out the broad strokes when you're involved. But what, exactly, are you going to do?
It's very simple. We're going to bombard an important port.
We've pinpointed one of their naval arteries based on the movements of their capital ships. That's the one we'll strike.
The plan is to cut off their supply lines and render their strongest ships inoperable. Fairly waterproof, if you ask me.
Do we have the Royal Navy backing us?
Nope. I can summarize the message they sent us.
What did they say?
"Based upon the current situation, we do not have the ability to commit our forces to unplanned operations before the arrival of additional support."
"Please consider your operation plans carefully and do not act hastily."
I see. And what of our intel?
I know this plan's fairly urgent, but surely they didn't have to send a strategist like you to the front lines...
Haha, it's best to not overthink things. The top brass operates in mysterious ways, and a lot of that is going to be beyond us.
...Fair enough. I guess it really is up to us.
We'll be fine! After all, we're the best out there when it comes to taking care of business!
Approach danger with a cool head, and lead cautiously! We've got a formula for success, and just have to follow through with it!
As a strategist, I tried to put together a plan with the greatest chance for success...
But ultimately, an operation like this isn't something a single person can come up with.
And besides–– maybe I prefer slugging it out rather than planning from behind the scenes~?
All right. So, when do we begin?
We'll set sail in the evening, and attack under the cover of darkness. We'll be gone before they know what hit them.
Understood. I'm looking forward to seeing what you're capable of, Miss Strategist. Hehe~
Haha, you're gonna make me blush...
If you like it so much, maybe I'll call you that instead of Foch from now on~
Uhh, I think I'll pass on that!
The light from the flames of the burning port grew dimmer and dimmer as the Vichya ships made their retreat.
By the time the first rays of light illuminated the surrounding waters, the fleet had already vanished.
Phew... We made it back in one piece.
A fleet of capital ships doesn't exactly make for the most agile hunters.
Yeah, and it's also good that we were able to disable the port's defenses. It would've been awful if they cut off our retreat.
Just when the two Vichya ships sighed a breath of relief, a sole Sardegnian battleship appeared before them.
Is it customary for the esteemed Templar Knights to be sneaking around without saying hello first?
Battleship Littorio...?!
They sent two fleets...? Was the first one just to lure us into a false sense of security...?
Who knows? There's no way a lumbering main fleet would be able to catch up to you, no matter how hard it tried.
So that was a bluff to flush us out of the port...!
That's right. Nobody said that there was only a single fleet chasing after you.
It would be my honor to exchange fire with you right here, Littorio, but why don't we try to resolve this without violence?
A bit rich considering what you just did, but... it's not like you actually accomplished anything.
I can consider taking you up on that offer... but don't think that means I'll just let you go.
First, you'll answer a few of my questions––
That's not on the table, Littorio.
You already know what the Templar Knights' Code dictates.
(Do we really have to fight? I'm not sure I like the odds...)
(Considering it's Littorio we're up against...)
(I know there are some battles that you shouldn't take, but... Sometimes, you don't have a choice and just have to leave things to fate, right?)
I see. Is that a part of your plan as well?
Considering what you did to Trento and Zara last night, it would be unbecoming of me not to return the courtesy.
Littorio, Vittorio Veneto-class battleship of Sardegna...
...will now test your mettle, Templar Knights!
The ships continued to exchange fire as the sun took its place in the morning sky.
As expected, we're simply no match for Littorio...
How unfortunate. If only I hadn't used up so much ammo during our operation...
Foch, I'll hold Littorio back. Take advantage of the opportunity to get out of here.
As long as one of us makes it back to the Vichya, then the operation––
Steeling her resolve, Algérie adjusted her rigging and prepared to face Littorio in close combat.
However, Foch rushed forward to block her advance.
Wait, calm down first, Algérie.
Anyone can play the hero, but very few sacrifices are worth it. Unnecessary sacrifices only endanger us down the road.
No matter what the operation plan calls for, I want you to think things through.
I understand. But I vowed to lay down my life.
And if the Vichya needs me to make that sacrifice, then...
Sure, sure, but I don't recall "fight until you sink" being a part of our orders.
That being the case, isn't returning home safely a higher priority?
...That sounds like an unreasonable request.
How are we to achieve that when we're facing Littorio?
Goodness, sometimes you're so stubborn that you can't even see what's in front of you.
Foch?
If Littorio was going all-out with the intention of destroying us, how would we still be alive to have this conversation?
Remember what Littorio said just before engaging us?
...that she'd test our mettle.
In other words, even if she has her orders, she's trying to avoid going all-out for whatever reason!
Now that you mention it, that does make sense...
Sardegna is known to be very careful with preserving their forces.
Littorio's orders probably also were to return home in one piece. The risk of her being injured here is probably too great a risk for them.
...Because of the incident with the Cardinal?
See, aren't you glad that I'm here?
Littorio has given us a bit of breathing room, but let's settle this situation and go home!
Let's offer up our mass-produced ships so we can get away!
Avoiding further direct confrontation, Algérie and Foch used their remaining mass-produced ships to create space for them to exit Littorio's firing range.
Heh. Looks like they finally saw through me.
No matter how seasoned the hunter, the prey will always find a way to escape from a half-hearted hunt.
Suddenly, a dagger flew at Littorio from over the horizon.
Littorio instinctively moved to block it, the blade lodging itself into her rigging.
When she turned to inspect it, she could see a hilt of Iris design.
If I recall properly... Foch was carrying this.
Is this a declaration of her fighting spirit...
...or just a parting gift for Sardegna?
With dagger now in hand, Littorio contemplated the true meaning of Foch's action.
A finely-crafted piece. Its owner clearly took good care of it.
I see.
The mass-produced ships were not the only presents those two left for us.
How curious. It seems like there are some good people left in the Vichya after all.
If I bring this back, it'll prove that I managed to subdue a powerful Vichya ship.
...I suppose I'll head back before Veneto starts to worry about me again.
However, the "theatre" that their HQ has put on will not end with this battle.
...I do hope that you survive their machinations, Knights of Vichya.
Phew... Littorio stopped chasing us...
Dang, that was more excitement than I bargained for... I never thought I'd have to go against Littorio in person.
Oh, Foch, what happened to your dagger?
Oh, that? Uhh... I think I lost it during the scuffle.
Foch took out her empty scabbard and waved it in front of Algérie.
How unlike you. I thought that dagger was really important to you.
Haha, I suppose so. It's gonna be a pain to get it back.
Reckon it's now one of Littorio's spoils of war?
Maybe. We'll find out soon enough if it ends up on the newspapers, haha~
Heh, that we will.
Are you sure you're going to be okay though?
Well, it does hurt a bit... but it's a small price to pay for our lives.
Mm. I guess we'll have to win it back next time.
Jeez, Algérie, I really can't get used to seeing you all serious like this.
Oh, are you telling me that this clever strategist hasn't already made plans three steps ahead?
Who knows~ Anyway, let's worry about getting home first.
We can think about how to get that dagger back from Littorio later.
It's a promise then. I swear upon my reputation as a Templar Knight that I'll return that dagger of yours to its rightful owner~
I... I don't need a promise like that from you!
No matter how precious it might've been, it's just an object. You know what... aren't you just teasing me at this point?
Maybe we can go to a cat café next time to help you go back to normal.
Hehe, now that's a promise I can get behind. I'll hold you to your word then.
Ah, wait, I never said it was a promise...
Let's just make it a Knight's Oath then?
That's overdoing it even more!
Hahaha~

sequence: "May our flag fly victoriously over every battlefield."
"May our might bring peace to the land."
"Even should we be engulfed in flames..."
"We will continue to tread forth dauntlessly."

scripts.say: With the sun setting behind them, the fleet departed for their target.
I do wonder how Sardegna will respond... If we're lucky, they won't even get the chance to.
Mhm. Fingers crossed they don't catch on to us, or we'll lose the element of surprise.
In any case, as long as we can disrupt their operations, the mission will at least be a partial success.
What must we do for total success, then?
Do as much damage a possible.
Of course, that won't be possible unless we get there unnoticed.
Until then, we'd better stay on our guards. Lead the way, Algérie!
Oh dear... Foch! Enemy fleet, incoming!
What?! A Sardegnian fleet?
Oh man... Just our luck, running into a patrol here of all places!
Calm down. Our cover hasn't been blown just yet.
