scripts.say: Sorry to keep you waiting. You're all safe under my wing now.
W-we're saved!
Though their planes were individually weak, there were just so many of them...
That was just like swatting flies for me, though~ Did the two of you get hurt at all?
I'm perfectly fine. Morrison, how about you?
I'm fine as well... The planes weren't a big deal...
Just seeing so many of them coming at us was a bit scary...
No kidding. Luckily, their accuracy was pretty laughable, so it was easy to take countermeasures.
I wonder if these planes came from a Siren Pawn...
That's the impression I'm getting as well.
Maybe if we follow where the planes came from, we'll be able to find the commander as well!
Hmm, good thinking! The planes have to return to their source eventually.
In other words...
Yeah, if we can trace the planes back to the carriers, we'll be able to catch out the attacking Siren fleet!
And hopefully, that gives us a clue as to where the commander is.
I see. In that case, you shouldn't waste any more time here!
Mhm! I'll be counting on you, Ty!
Hmm... Now this is interesting.
What is it, Ty? Found the Sirens' main force?
Not quite, I'm still tracking the enemy aircraft.
It's getting pretty far away from us... I don't think I can keep up with it.
Not quite, I'm still tracking the enemy aircraft.
But there is good news. I've got a pretty good clue as to who our enemy is.
You do, huh? Are we facing the actual Sakura Empire or just another Siren Pawn?
We haven't been able to tell so far by looking at the planes; they've simply been too weak.
So, what about the good news? I'm not exactly the greatest at putting things together.
The sea fog itself. When the fog is this dense, the easiest way to find where ships are is to observe where the fog dissipates.
It actually ended up being better for us once the planes left. From what I can see, the trails in the fog indicate that we're after only a single ship.
Do you think it's a Pawn?
That's the most likely scenario. It seems extremely unlikely that the Sakura Empire, knowing that this sea fog is a Siren weapon, would send a single ship by itself.
Perhaps these Pawns are instrumental for moving the Sirens' Reenactments along?
Reenactment... I see, so that's why they attacked the AF base...
I was not too convinced by what you said earlier, but the pieces are starting to fall into place for me.
Nobody would have a good reason to launch an attack on the AF base... except the Sirens.
First, they strike at us using Pawns that resemble the Sakura fleet to provoke us into retaliating against the actual Sakura fleet.
The more successful their Reenactment is, the more the Sirens would be empowered.
As for the "script" they're using... We are all quite familiar with that.
The question is, what's the ultimate purpose of their Reenactments?
The thing that has been bothering me is... why would the Sirens go out of their way to remove the commander from the board?
There are too many things we don't understand about the Sirens. We can only speculate at this point.
Ahhh, all this thinking is making my head hurt after all. I wish the commander was here!
(Yeah, playing detective really isn't my strong suit. Trap or otherwise, we'll break through it all and rescue the commander.)
(During the last Reenactment, our fleet managed to break through the Siren attack even when exhausted.)
(We're much stronger and better equipped now than we were back then...)
(A reenactment of the AF campaign? Not on my watch. New Jersey isn't some pawn on anyone's chessboard!)
Much time had passed, and we still had not found any way to leave the bridge. We did occasionally receive other new messages through the communicator, but...
Commander, I've tried sending a message from the communicator, but it doesn't seem to be working.
What should we do now?
Yo, Archerfish, why are you wiggling your butt around over there?
Shush! I'm trying to hear if there are any engine noises coming from this ship~
I see, submarines do have a better sense of hearing after all~
Unfortunately... I don't hear a peep.
Huh. If I didn't know better, I'd say we're anchored somewhere.
How long have we been stuck here? I'm bored out of my mind.
Another message just showed up on the communicator!
Lemme see...!
"Hiryuu, reporting in. The first bombing attack on AF was a success."
"Operation objectives have not yet been accomplished. A second wave of attacks is required."
It seems to be an update from the first series of messages...
Another attack on the AF base? That doesn't seem to match up with what Allen told us...
I had my suspicions as well. We weren't able to use the communicator, but it seemed to be feeding us a certain narrative.

"I've seen too many of the Sirens' dirty tricks. Communication abnormalities caused by the sea fog. Robotic, inorganic voices from the communication equipment. The Sakura fleet is being set up... But why?"
Are these creepy recordings also a part of the Sirens' Reenactment?
Yeah, that tells us nothing about why they trapped us here.
Do you think this is their way of tauntin' us? Giving us first-class seats to watch them carry out their Reenactment?
We don't need that kind of charity from the Sirens though. Ain't that right, Puddin'?
If the Sirens are using such sophisticated methods to try to deceive us, this plan must be very important to them, and we certainly won't just be fighting against some Pawns.
You have a point, but... why are the Sirens able to mimic the Sakura Empire's communications so convincingly?

options.content: "Perhaps because of the nature of their Faustian bargain?"
"The eyes and ears of the Sirens could be anywhere for all we know."

scripts.say: Unlike the Eagle Union and the Royal Navy, the Crimson Axis is known to dabble with Siren technology.
Maybe the Sirens in turn know far more about them as well.
Given their technology, I wouldn't be surprised if they can easily compromise all our existing forms of communication.
The most frustrating thing is, we don't even know if we've discovered one of their secrets, or if they're just toying with us.

Hmm, I suppose that's a good way for the Sirens to kill two birds with one stone. We'd sustain damage from the attack, while the fallout would further deteriorate the relationships we have with the Sakura Empire.
Well, there's no way they'd fool us with something that blatant.
You know what they say about the enemy of my enemy, though. It's hard to tell what kind of relationship the Sakura Empire has with the Sirens if they're considered this disposable.
Right. The worst thing to do at this critical time would be to dredge up old conflicts by doubting each other... The more we fight amongst ourselves, the worse our position is.
I don't like complicated stuff like this... Hold me, Puddin'~!
However... Whether these messages are fabricated or not, we have to take their contents at face value for the time being.
In other words... They're going to launch another attack on AF if this Reenactment continues—
Wait, hold on, Puddin'!
Everything we've just talked about assumes that the Sirens intended for us to receive these messages, right? After all, we're still stuck on the bridge of some Sakura Empire ship!
It's pissing me off that I have no idea what to believe at this point!
Commander, the communicator seems to also be able to relay information between Pawns...
Wait, seriously? Since we're stuck in here anyway, why not try to mess around with their little game?
(The more I think about it though... What if we're meant to be key players in the Sirens' game, rather than mere pawns?)
New Jersey Fleet
I've been following the trail for a while now, but still haven't actually seen this Pawn we're after yet...
We're still keeping up with the aircraft for the time being, but—
What's wrong, Ty?
Wait, hold on... Something's shooting at the aircraft!
Are those our colors? What's going on?
Eagle Union planes? Do we have any other ships deployed here?
Not that I'm aware of... Ticonderoga should be the only carrier deployed here...
"We're still hanging in there, but AF's runways got torn up pretty badly by the first wave of airstrikes. In any case, don't expect any air support from us~"
"If this really is a Reenactment as you said, New Jersey, the Sirens sure are pulling out all the stops..."
If the attack didn't come from a "real" allied plane, then...
Maybe there are Eagle Union Pawns out there as well...?
The planes are heading in the same direction as that "Sakura Empire" plane...
Are there any other planes that you're able to track?
Unfortunately, no. The ones I was tracking have all been shot down.
Welp, change in plans then. Let's track those Eagle Union planes instead... and oh, be mindful of the altitude.
Boise, Morrison, please continue to take up the vanguard. I have no idea what's going on right now, but we're gonna have to charge right into that sea fog!
KABOOM——!!
Another airstrike?!
New Jersey, we're coming under attack again! We're under heavier fire than before and can't break through!
What the hell's going on? Are they finally springing their trap on us?
I can't say for sure, but the enemy aircraft are much stronger than the ones we encountered before!
Could this be the real Sakura Empire fleet? Did they mistake us for the Siren Pawns?
But didn't we establish that it was impossible for them to have sailed their entire fleet into the sea fog...?
Wait... Now, there are more Eagle Union planes intercepting the ones attacking us...
This makes no sense... Are the Sirens attacking themselves?
I'm starting to get a pretty good idea of where the Siren ships are from tracking the direction and timing the planes are coming from!
Do you think the commander has a hand in why these Pawns are behaving strangely?
N-New Jersey! We're receiving a message on the communicator!
A message? Is there a ship capable of breaking through the interference here?
I don't think so... I remember this channel being in use during the AF Reenactment, but...
I have no idea what you're trying to say, Boise. Let's hear the message first.
"Damnit, there's way too many fighters escorting the target, and we can't hit it with our torp bombers! We're so close...!"
"Sorry, I haven't been able to score any hits from my torpedo bombers either."
"The enemy seems to have scrambled their air wings as well, so our positions may have been compromised by our attack."
"Don't be discouraged! We still have the initiative for the time being!"
"Let's coordinate our attacks then! We'll break through with a frontal attack!"
"Look alive, everyone! This is our counterattack!"
Hornet, Enterprise, and Yorktown...? Why am I hearing their voices now?
Mr. Bear told me a message was coming in on a certain channel...
Did the three of them come to help us...?
That's impossible... We know that Yorktown was heavily damaged during the previous operation...
Right. Enterprise should be with the Naval HQ at NY City, and Hornet is participating in Operation Siren...
This about confirms my suspicions. The Sirens' Reenactment includes a full clash between the Eagle Union and Sakura Empire Pawns.
And what about this message?
Maybe something fabricated sent between the Pawns?
Yeah, that's what I think so as well. Saratoga was the one leading Operation AF, so a conversation like this wouldn't have happened in the first place...
How much information do the Sirens have on us...?
It's not really something I want to think about. We've been fighting them for years, but the Sirens are still a complete enigma.
So, to sum things up, the Sirens are reenacting a battle between the Eagle Union and the Sakura Empire here...
Do you think they're collecting data from the results of the battle?
Data collection...? Will they use it to get stronger, like Mr. Bear?
Wait, do you think they used the data from yesterday's attack to make these new-and-improved planes...?
(Crap... It's definitely a possibility... If they keep running this Reenactment over and over and mass produce stronger and stronger enemies, there's no way we'll be able to stop them!)
Ty, gather up your recons and focus on securing air superiority first.
Morrison, keep using Mr. Bear to monitor the communication channels and let me know as soon as something happens.
We still need to find the commander, and we'll beat it out of them if we have to.
If the Sirens think they can fool us with their petty tricks, they'll soon be answering to my Mk7's!
"Our fighters have intercepted a group of Eagle Union aircraft. We've shot them down while sustaining minimal damage."
Woah, who's a smart little Pawn~
"I don't understand what you just said... Anyway, I've confirmed the location of the enemy carriers. Should we attack?"
Hmm... An Eagle Union Pawn, huh? ...Yeah, go ahead and continue with that.
"Acknowledged. We'll now prioritize neutrallizing the enemy carrier fleet. The ground objective squadron will be reorganized."
I see, I see. Make it fast though, you might get caught off guard while changing your equipment~
"We will now re-equip our aircraft from anti-installation equipment to anti-ship equipment."
Yes, do as I say! I, your commander, would never make a wrong move!
"Understood."
What the hell are you doing...
Ahaha~ Can't you tell? I was bored as hell, so I tried butting in on the conversation~
Wait, seriously? Lemme give it a try next time~
Sure thing~
"Why do you make light... of the lives on the line...?"
Huh? Who? Where's that voice coming from...?
A distant, dreamlike voice floated from the communicator. It was nothing like the synthetic voices of the Siren Pawns.
Who are you? Show yourself!
Your reactions... are different from what I have seen in my dreams...
Ships of the Eagle Union, I have met you countless times... but you have yet to meet me...
I am but a drifter, a wanderer through the mirror of dreams... though, I know not what effects my dreams may have on your world...
This sword is resonating...? Are you... Shinano?
Shinano? The mythical aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire?
D-does someone like that really exist...?
Hey Puddin', have you ever heard of her before?

(Aircraft Carrier Shinano... a name that has been whispered for quite some time now. Legend has it that she was enshrined in a deep slumber within the Sakura Empire, and rumors abounded that she had finally been awakened after some recent events...)
(But why would she be here? She should not be a part of the Sirens' Reenactment...)
The light you give off... What are you doing on the bridge of a Sakura Empire flagship...?
(Wait, whaat?! This isn't some bubble dimension the Sirens created to trap us?!)
That's what we wanna know. We were sailing along, minding our own business, before we suddenly found ourselves trapped here!
Then, you are like this one... A prisoner shackled by her past...
A prisoner forced to watch Reenactment after Reenactment...
(Crap, I can't deal with people like her... She speaks entirely in riddles...!)
Within my dreams, I have seen all realities... Yet I cannot influence my own reality...
But the fact that both of us have wandered into the same dream... must surely be fate as well...
So, I don't really get what you're saying, but I assume you're talking to us because you're hoping we can bust you out of your dream or whatever...
After all, we're both stuck here for some reason... Right?
Mm... Thank you for your understanding... I, I am not very good with words...
What the hell? How can you understand a word this chick is saying?!
As for you over there, "Commander"... There is so much I would like to discuss with you, as pitiful of a state that I am in now...
Do we know each other...?
This is the first time we've met like this... But in my dreams, there is much we have shared together... To you, I am deeply indebted...
I had no idea what she was talking about, but she certainly did not seem hostile.
Please disregard my rambling... I have simply seen too many things, and sometimes must indulge in some selfishness...
But I want you to know... You are not my enemy. Please understand that I wish to coexist, to become friends, to become human...
There are so many things I'd like to share with you... And time is so ephemeral...
I learned from Shinano that she drifts between possible realities in the form of "dreams," and has a limited ability to "project" herself into reality.

Her words were certainly hard to believe, and her unique vocabulary only compounded that problem. With the help of Archerfish's "translations," however, I gradually started to make some sense of what she was saying.
However, she was often a bystander in her own dreams, powerless to actually change anything in reality...
Shinano, girl, you'd definitely benefit from some exercise and Vitamin D. Trust me, if you spend all day in bed, your muscles definitely will tell you that you're powerless.
Mm... My consciousness may travel between realities... but my actual body is unable to move...
Translator? Where you at?
Hmm... I guess she has significant downsides to her abilities. Like being able to see a bunch of dreams but not able to influence any of them...
I apologize... Again and again, the endless cycles consume my consciousness...
You'll get nowhere if you allow yourself to get stuck on every little thing though, right? Even if your power's also a bit of a curse, you've already made it this far!
That... may well be the case... Thank you for your advice...
Yet I have tried to change my fate before... Time and time again, it fails to bear any fruit.
That's no reason to get depressed! When life knocks you down, you have to keep getting back up! I can tell that you'll be able to overcome your situation, little by little!
I see...
S-sorry, I'm not trying to lecture you or anything... I'm usually not the kind of girl you'd want to take advice from anyway~
No, I appreciate your honesty. Your words carry truth within them...
Hehe, Albacore would probably be bullying the heck out of you if she was here! I dunno what it is, but I feel like I have some kind of special connection with you~♪
Seeing the two of them talk so frankly filled my heart with warmth.
"Sorry for the delay since my last report. This is Hiryuu."
"While we were changing equipment, our carrier force was ambushed by the Eagle Union. Akagi, Kaga, and Souryuu have all been..."
"I am still standing though. I will now begin the counterattack."
"I will avenge my comrades!"
Commander! The Sakura Empire Pawns are moving!
Are we in danger here?
"But... Why did you give me those orders...?"
Commander, what do I say? Our cover's gonna get blown!
Through the dense fog outside the porthole, the flash of lights could be seen in the night sky.
I knew it was a bad idea for San Francisco to stick her head into an in-progress Reenactment, but...
"Why... Am I supposed to flee with my tail between my legs...? Why...?!"
[Adjusting Reenactment parameters. Lifting maximum combat power of the Sakura Empire fleet. Conditions for defeating Aircraft Carrier "YORKTOWN" now met——]
Wait, what? The Pawns are scaling their combat power autonomously...?
[After modulation, change production capabilities to match new specifications.]
[Resetting and reinitializing Reenactment.]
So tragic... These lost souls... Doomed to suffer and burn in the flames of the past for all of eternity...
Shinano... Is there no way to stop them...?!
This one cannot even break free of her own fetters...
(The Mirror Sea is nothing more than a Siren research facility, and the "Pawns" here are but puppets...)
(Each "Pawn" is carved from the history that gives us form, but torn from the cycle of causation... They are suspended only within the past...)
(Akagi must have known this... How much of our past is now serving as fuel for the Sirens...?)
Involution... a spiral that wrings out all hope from our past to serve as weapons of war... An experiment I am powerless to stop...
Do we have no choice but to let this cruel cycle play out to its end?
Indeed... It is the fate that has been inscribed within our hulls long ago...

sequence: "Enterprise, Hornet, please don't worry about me."
"Even if the two of you come, we would still be heavily outnumbered, and victory still be unlikely."
"Don't worry... The two of you have hit me harder during our training sessions..."
"Besides, Enterprise, didn't you used to say that you'll never be able to win if you're always scared of death?"
"Hehe... I always thought that was a bit morbid, but we'll both need to make it back if you want to rub it in my face."
"Give me three days, just three days and I'll show you how tough I am."
"Because I cherish the two of you, my precious little sisters, I have to keep you safe."
"What's the matter? You look just like Hammann with that pout on your face."
"Are you still worried about me? I told you, I'm doing just fine~"
"Hehe~ Besides, aren't there more pressing issues for you to be worried about?"
"That's right, you can't spend your entire life on the front lines."
"As the hero leading everyone forward, you sometimes have to stay in the back to help give others a little push~"
"Aircraft launched. I'm going to scout out the enemy's carrier task force."
"We'll be at a disadvantage in a shelling battle... I have to do something to give us the advantage from the air."
"The enemy thinks that they've pulled one over us by attacking AF... But that overconfidence will be their downfall."
"This... is a battle I cannot afford to lose."

scripts.say: Within the Mirror Sea...
Um, I hope we're heading in the right direction... The radar's not beeping at all, but Mr. Bear says...
I can't believe... we're trusting your stuffed animal over our navigational equipment...
Don't worry... Mr. Bear is almost always right, except if we get too far away...
Um, Mr. Bear... Can you try to calibrate your sensors again towards the direction the communication signals came from?
Oh... If you find a Pawn fleet, don't let Mr. Bear engage them on his own...
Of course! I'll be sure to consult with New Jersey first—
Wait, we're picking something up!
Did you find them...?
Hammann?
No, it can't be... That's a Siren Pawn!
Get a hold of New Jersey! We're going to chase after it!

sequence: "To mirror the status quo, or to accept the chaos and possibilities of mutation."
"Two spirals that are intricately connected, linked yet never converging."
"But when the mirror shatters and their trajectory becomes unbound,"
"What remains of the broken equilibrium?"
"To mirror the status quo..."
"Or to rewrite the rules of the system?"

scripts.say: KABOOM——!!
The Sirens are getting stronger and stronger with each cycle of the Reenactment! We can't let this continue any longer!
If mass-produced models of this caliber spill out of this Mirror Sea, everything we've worked for will have been for naught!
Don'tcha start panicking on me! We still haven't found the commander yet, and my hunch is telling me that we'll also find the Mirror Sea generator there as well.
Two birds with one stone - that's how I like doing things! But first, we've gotta clear out the small fry here!
"We've neutralized the aerial presence of the Sakura Empire fleet. Victory will soon be ours."
"However, Yorktown was gravely wounded by Hiryuu's final counterattack..."
"Please, it's just a scratch. Stop blowing things out of proportion~"
"Blowing things out of proportion? No, we've got to get you back to port immediately!"
"Hammann!"
"I know! I'll protect her with my life...!"
New Jersey, did you hear that just now...?
Something about Yorktown... and Hammann being the next part of the Reenactment?
Hold up, didn't we already see "Hammann" on our way over here?
Mmhmm... I tried to track her, but as soon as she entered the sea fog, she dropped off the radar...
Did you notice anything unusual about this Hammann's behavior?
No, she just passed right by us... But she definitely wasn't escorting anyone...
That about confirms that this is an ongoing part of the Reenactment.
(Not that we needed any more confirmation. Nobody's going to be wandering around alone in a Mirror Sea like that...)
(No matter how much you read about the Mirror Seas in reports, aiming your guns at someone who looks like your allies is truly a terrible experience...)
Ah, um... Should we chase after her? She couldn't have gotten far...
Yes, we give chase. Judging from her movements, she's not behaving any differently from the Pawns we've fought up to this point.
We don't know exactly how these Reenactments function, but following her is our best bet of finding out. Don'tcha agree, Ty?
Yup. Since we don't appear to be a part of this Reenactment, we should have some degree of autonomy.
Let's clean up the leftover Pawns and then chase after Hammann!
A solid plan. Boise, Morrison, please continue to scout ahead for us!
"We've sustained too much damage! We won't be able to continue fighting at this rate!"
"Where's the backup fleet?! We need reinforcements now!"
Another message...!
Does this mean that the Eagle Union Pawns are being defeated by the Sakura Empire Pawns?
They're completely ignoring us...
Haah... I suppose this is better than having to do the dirty work ourselves. Even if they're fakes, having to attack your friends is terribly depressing...
In any case, we're making pretty good progress towards the coordinates I mapped out.
Hold on a sec~ Do you want to try something real quick?
...Try what?
I'm sure you've been thinking this as well - what if we're supposed to do something with these messages? Maybe if I...
Ahem... Hey, Hornet, do you copy? This is New Jersey.
(...What are you doing?!)
(Shh...! I'm trying to determine if we're supposed to play a role in their Reenactment, or if they'll act like we don't even exist.)
"New Jersey? Thank goodness, we need the help badly!"
(Holy crap, she actually answered?! Calm down and think, New Jersey!)
Ah, um, yeah! But I'm going to need your coordinates, pronto!
"I've lost most of my aircraft already, and Enterprise is in a similar situation. How many ships did you bring with you?"
I can help, but I'm going to need your coordinates! Even a flare gun works, gimme something to work with!
(Is this seriously going to work...?)
"I've lost most of my aircraft already, and Enterprise is in a similar situation. How many ships did you bring with you?"
...I guess not. Deviate from the script, and it seems like she's talking right past me.
Hey, Hornet, what are your plans for dinner tonight? I'm craving some steak right about now.
"We've sustained too much damage! We won't be able to continue fighting at this rate!"
Hornet, if you don't speak up, I'm gonna order your steak well done~ Unless that's actually what you prefer~
"I've confirmed the next wave of attacks from enemy aircraft. Requesting modulation of anti-air parameters."
I guess it's true. She doesn't seem to be hearing a thing you're saying.
I'm starting to understand what's going on.
These messages are a part of the Reenactment to some extent, but there's some wiggle room so they're not strictly recordings.
Like exchanging preset messages, huh?
Yup. That's why the messages might sound half-convincing if you didn't know better, but are utter nonsense if you try talking about something else.
As we don't fit into their Reenactment, this "Hornet" was completely unable to respond to my question about steaks.
I would've been more surprised if she suddenly started talking to you about steaks...
In short, while these Pawns might be a bit stronger from what we're used to, they're still low-tier programs incapable of thoughts or rationality.
Up to this point, I haven't seen any Siren command units either... Who knows, this Mirror Sea might be rather special...
Whatever the case might be, Commander, please hold out a bit longer...
PH Harbor - Temporary Command Post
At the remote island base, a temporary office had been established for me to conduct my operations.
Interestingly enough, the interior was decorated in largely the same way as my own office back home.
Whoever prepared this for me apparently knew me. Very well, at that.
Hehe, don'tcha just love the feeling of being right at home?
I took the liberty of looking into you a bit, but judging from your expression, I'd say I did a pretty darn good job setting this place up~
Oh, by the way, the name's New Jersey. Iowa-class battleship.
Apparently, this energetic battleship was the one responsible for my new office.
But if that's not catchy enough for you to remember, I'm also called the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! Hahaha~♪
Ahem... In any case, I'm now under your command. It's a pleasure to meetcha, Commander!
The girl clad in futuristic-looking military attire saluted me ceremoniously.
By the way, Commander, do you have any questions for me?

options.content: "Give me a moment to get situated..."

scripts.say: Oh, right. You haven't been fully briefed yet, huh?
Due to the recent Reenactment and resurgence of Siren activities, Saratoga gave out emergency mobilization orders.
During that sortie, Yorktown suffered heavy damage, so she's been pulled from the front lines and now is now recovering under the watch of the Naval HQ.
Anything you'd like me to do in the meantime? It's too bad I couldn't help Saratoga out in that Reenactment incident...
Well, no point dwelling on the past. It's my time to shine now, and I trust you'll be able to make full use of my capabilities?
Thinking things through, if an Iowa-class battleship like New Jersey had been deployed, the situation must be dire.
The fighting around here's been pretty rough the last few days, so it's good that you showed up, Commander.
"Seems like there's trouble wherever I go."
Woah, maybe you're like some bad omen for when the Sirens are going to show up!
Or maybe... everything that's happened so far has been a trap to lure you out! That seems like a possibility!
Wouldn't that be even worse...?
Hehe, I suppose so... But enough messing around. If you don't have any other plans, I'll take the patrol fleet and survey the nearby waters.
Anyway, I'll be off now unless there's something else you'd like to ask.
"Oh yeah, why were you in the office to begin with?"
Huh? Is that something that requires explaining?
"Normally not, but I'm a bit curious..."
"What were you doing under the desk when I walked in?"
Uh, looking for something?
"...In an empty office?"
Ummm... I left some briefing-related materials in here while setting up...
"Did you manage to find it, or should I help you out?"
Err... There was also an anime disk mixed in with the files...
"Sorry, what? What kind of disk?"
"Actually, whatever it is, wouldn't it be faster if the two of us looked for it together?"
(Nooo, I can't let the commander know about my power level...)
*knock* *knock*...
Hello, Commander. Have you met New Jersey yet? Wonder where that girl's gotten herself to...
I'm over here, Ty! Hey, come help me out over here...
New Jersey stuck her head out from under the desk as she begged the newly-arrived ship for help.
All right, I'll be right there. Sorry for the late introduction, but my name is Ticonderoga, an Essex-class carrier. Pleased to meet you, Commander.
You know, this desk isn't in the right spot after all. Would you mind giving us a few minutes to fix it?
"Hmm, if you say so. Want me to wait outside?"
Hehe, I'd appreciate it~
"Reporting combat situation from the front lines. The Eagle Union's carriers have sustained significant damage and are now retreating."
This voice... belongs to Jintsuu...
"Hiryuu has been incapacitated and is no longer able to sail. Requesting emergency rescue operation..."
Is the Reenactment about to come to an end...?
"Recapping operation objectives: Capture AF Base and sink the enemy carrier task force. Status: Failed."
"Test Name: Operation AF. Communication playback log finished."
O... vengeful fate through which we were given form... Please sleep peacefully beneath the waves...
"Uploading data... Preparing initialization of next Reenactment."
Is it finally over? Are the Pawns going to be disposed of?
This one cannot say... The realities I have seen may differ from what you know to be true... Yet there is some information I can offer you...
I seek to gather the fragments of hope and find a different future... One that avoids that ruination that befalls every dream I see...
That's, uh, very commendable of you... But is there anything that can help us make sense of this mess?
My apologies, but... that is not something that I can tell you right now... or even the Commander...
The light cast by the fragments is false, ever-branching and misleading...
I'm sure you have your own reasons, so I won't press you for details right now.
...All that's left, is how to leave this place...
That's what we wanted to know in the first place! It sucks being stuck here, unable to do anything!
Shinano, you brought this topic up because you have an idea on how to escape, right?
The reason you were brought here, and why you have been trapped...
...is not something I currently understand. Yet I sense... that the answers you seek are near...
...Yes, our meeting has been made possible by the power hidden here.
Archerfish, Shinano, Commander, and even "me."
Who are you, to also be able to sense this one's presence...?
The more you observe us, the more we also know about you.
My physical form does not exist in this dream... Only those with a strong connection to me should be able to see me...
I know nothing about your "dreams." But due to the influence of this place, your existence is clear to me.
What do you see? Why do all you people talk so funny?
And who the heck are you? Why do people keep popping up outta thin air?!
I am but another shadow—
Okay, stop right there! I've had it with you all you people talking in riddles!
...Riddles?
Yeah, with all this mystical mumbo jumbo about "existence" and alternate realities! Can't we talk like normal people here?!
...Maybe that's due to your own ignorance...
Look, I know I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed, but I'm not exactly in the best headspace right now!
...Commander... If that is really you... Do you still know my name...?
You don't have to answer her, Commander! I don't trust her one bit, and if she's up to no good, she'll have to answer to my trust ol' bat!
Her appearance and her demeanor reminded me of——
Not quite... Commander, it seems that you are not yet ready for the truth...
But more importantly, back to the task at hand... You wish to know how to leave this place, yes?
Of course. We still have an important mission to accomplish.
"Oh, thank you so much for saving us"~ Tch, like hell I'd believe something that convenient!
Before we go any further, answer me this: Are you friend or foe?
Consider me a friend.
(Huh... She actually answered that without hesitation... Maybe she really is here to help?)
Helena... You understand, right?
Huh? Me...? Why, all of a sudden...
If you know how we can get out of here, let's hear it already.
You'd better not try anything funny, or the back of your head's gonna be saying hello to my bat~
Mirror hacking protocol - spatial unlock.
You are now free to leave.
Mirror Sea - Pawn Rally Point
Hehe~ It feels real good to finally let these cannons roar! These Pawns don't feel like anything special though...
So many mass-produced ships gathering in one place... but I don't see anything leading them.
Sorry... I still need some time to rest up...
I hear you... There's no way we can check all these ships in such a short time though.
C'mon, is nobody going to say anything about how I cleaned up the rest of those Pawns in one fell swoop?
Dunno about the rest of you, but I feel like I can take on the world right now! That's the power of the indomitable Black Dragon~♪
Haha... I'm glad you're all fired up, but try not to rush out so far ahead of us next time, okay?
Don't worry, I got this!
(She's right though, I still need to conserve my strength for when we have to fight through the Sakura Empire Pawns as well...)
Ty, we're getting close to the place where the Sakura Empire Pawns are gathering, right?
Yup. If my calculations from the intercepted communications are correct, we'll be at the right coordinates shortly.
Hmm... It seems strange to me that we haven't even run into any Siren patrols.
There's a pretty conspicuous absence of mass-produced ships as well.
If the Reenactment has already ended, the Sirens should be reorganizing their forces accordingly even if the Mirror Sea is still in effect. That's not what we're seeing at all though.
It's as if...
They're still trying to lure us in?
(Damnit, we don't even know if the commander is still here or not...!)
(There's something wrong with this Mirror Sea... I just can't put my finger on it...)
Of course... Most of the normal functionalities of a Mirror Sea have been stripped down.
Huh? Who are you...?!
That was the only warning shot you'll get. Drop that disguise, or the next shot isn't going to miss.
You're no Siren at all...
Such tremendous firepower... No hesitation at all to aim at your own allies... What is your name...?
New Jersey, Iowa-class battleship of the Eagle Union. Those who try to deceive us by imitating our friends... are no allies of ours!
Why are you here... New Jersey?
She... looks just like Helena! I didn't see anything on my radar though!
You're not a Siren, and yet you can't be detected by radar... You're one of the Ashes...
Boise, help me with manual aiming. We're done talking here.
Wait, please... I am loyal to the commander...
How dare you...! What have you done with the commander?!
Please calm down... I am here to guide you to the commander's whereabouts...
I would not have exposed myself to you like this if I was intent on attacking you...
Please, believe me...
...Ty, what do you think?
She has a point. She easily could've utilized this sea fog to ambush us if that was her intent.
Even if she's one of the Ashes, Commander once said there might be a way to find common ground...
I don't trust you, Ashes. But I do trust the commander.
So, where's the commander? You'd better not be trying to trick us.
...Thank you. But first, we must defeat our pursuers.
Pursuers? I didn't see any Sirens following us...
Let me just tell you this - until the commander is back safe and sound, don't think you've earned an ounce of our trust.
There's no use turning around...
Our pursuers have already surrounded us.
You may not be able to see it on your radar, but they are already all around us.
I have hacked into this Mirror Sea, but it is only a matter of time until its automated defenses find us.
Just as your eyes can be deceived by the fog, so too can your equipment.
What are you saying? You did what to the Mirror Sea...?
What I make... the Sirens can also unmake.
What you see... is only what the Sirens wish for you to see.
Mirror hacking protocol - disable stealth system.
Now, look closely at your radars.
Are these dots... all Sirens?! How are there so many of them?!
You led us into this ambush!
The protocol I put into place has temporarily increased the sensitivity of your equipment.
Wait, so a lot of these are ghost signals? Are you the reason why Essex, back then...
I will deconstruct the Sirens' systems. Please eliminate the real enemies in the vicinity.
We will not be able to reach the commander's location with all these Sirens in the way...
Three, two, one... Shutdown...!
With the help of the mysterious girl, I was able to escape from the mass-produced ship along with my allies.
We followed the sporadic lights of battle that cut through the fog, soon arriving at an area in the sea where Sakura Empire Pawns were gathering.
The Reenactment has ended, and what now remains is a moment frozen in time...
The flames, the smoke, and the scars of war... Will all be swallowed up by the sea until they return to nothingness...
This is my first time witnessing something like this...
All the Sirens we've been fighting are disappearing one by one, but the Mirror Sea isn't going away!
This place gives me the creeps, but it's also pretty inspiring. Puddin', do ya think I can make a movie script out of this?
A Mirror Sea where Pawns are fated to fight and sink, again and again... It's rather saddening...
Wait, a battlefield... frozen in time...?!
Frozen... in time... What I had seen at the Northern Parliament wasn't a dream after all...
San Francisco, look at that carrier over there!
That Hiryuu Pawn has seen better days, huh? ...This one's totally frozen as well. They aren't responding to us at all.
The ones over here aren't either...
The Reenactment had ended, suspending the participants inside, but the images that flashed through my head did not stop.
I saw the war continue, except with shipgirls instead of Pawns.
Each time we fought against the Sirens, we were throwing our shipgirls into their engine of war...
The conflict between the Azur Lane and the Crimson Axis... what is our conflict to the Sirens than another chessboard, fought with flesh and blood instead of pieces?
My determination flared stronger than ever at that moment... I had to put an end to the war.
...But nothing would change as long as I continued to be trapped within this Mirror Sea.
Commander, I've never seen a Sakura Empire carrier up close like this before!
And look how lifelike it looks! It'd be hard to tell the difference in an actual battle~
Woah, look at this spinny thing above the flight deck of this carrier...
Huh, it almost looks like it's reacting to you, Puddin'!
You're so lucky you basically get to be a movie protagonist~
Despite the danger we were in, it was refreshing to see the girls still in such high spirits.
Now, I just had to wait for "Helena" to make contact with us...
I apologize for the delay... Disabling the Sirens' defense systems proved more difficult than expected...
Um, Shinano, I have to ask you something first. What do you think of the commander?
Commander... is the only one who understands what I've experienced...
Then, hold tightly onto the fragments of this dream when you awaken. And never forget what happened here.
I see... This dream, too, is about to come to an end...
Yes... I am about to rewrite the very core of this Mirror Sea.
I do not understand the principle behind your power, but... the aftershocks from what I am about to do will likely erase the fleeting changes you've been able to effect in this world.
That... is when your dream will come to an end.
Very well... Our meeting has been brief, but I will remember it forever... I wish you the best of luck...
(whispers) ...I'm sorry.
Do not stray from your path. Become the light in the darkness to guide your friends.
Three, two, one...
With a wave of the mysterious girl's hands, an explosion suddenly engulfed the fog-smothered emptiness in front of them.
As the Mirror Sea trembled, a gaping rift seemed to appear out of thin air.
Where's this strong wind coming from?! It's burning hot...!
Did you crack open the Mirror Sea?!
Wait, what's on the other side of that rift? I see the outline of some ship...
Is that where Commander was taken?
So this is what the Siren transference devices do...?
Thank goodness it worked... The way... is now open...
Haah... I'm not sure how you did it, but...
We'll be able to find the commander now, right?
Yes... But look around us... We don't have much time...
Let's hurry up then. Didn't you say you'd take us to the commander?
Yes...
We're heading into that thing then?
What do you see within that rift?
It looks a bit like hell on the other side, to be honest.
Am I supposed to believe that they pulled the commander to some other world?
Even the Sirens are incapable of something like that...
What you're seeing is a large-scale transference device, but the true nature of this place has been well-concealed by the sea fog.
Visual impairment, electronic jamming. Stealth devices, and sensory interference.
This is the true nature of the sea fog... A way of concealing Compiler's large-scale weapon.
And over there... is the site of the Reenactment you saw.
The graveyard of the Sakura Empire Pawns.
The place where the commander is waiting for us—
No... Waiting... for you.
Wh-wh-what's going on?! An earthquake out at sea?!
Naw, nobody knows earthquakes like me! Um, rather, it's more like a massive shockwave, like if a shell landed right next to you!
My radar is picking something up! The signal's from... the Eagle Union fleet!
When the mysterious girl's countdown reached zero, a huge shockwave ripped through the Reenactment site.
After the rumbling stopped, a familiar voice erupted over the speakers of the communicator—
Fear not! The indomitable Black Dragon is here!
When I saw the figures of the ships behind her, I could only think to myself, "what a sight for sore eyes."
Don'tcha just love flashy entrances, Commander? Ahaha~♪
I can't have you disappearing on me within a day of me leaving port!
Well, not like this is your fault though. The Sirens must be truly foolish if they think they can get away with kidnapping you!
While I couldn't really do anything about this situation, it felt embarrassing to be the one being rescued instead of the other way around.
As you can see, I'm not the only one here. The whole fleet's here to back you up!
Ticonderoga, Boise, Morrison, and even the other "Helena" who I had only spoken with through the communicator—
Without their help... and Shinano's, my friends and I might have been confined to that bridge forever.
...Sorry to interrupt your reunion, but the battle isn't over yet.
You won't be able to destroy this Mirror Sea without finding the control device first.
I won't be able to keep the defense system disabled forever...
I thought the Reenactment had ended... Are you the reason why everything shut down?
Yes... The Pawns in this experimental site will continue to reenact the events of that war, perhaps forever.
Operation AF...
But, should the safety of the experimental site be threatened, these weapons will be integrated into the defense system.
Right, and she said she won't be able to keep the defense system disabled...
Yes... This will stop being a Reenactment site... and turn into a machine of war—
And the first thing they're going to do is to try to purge the outsiders...
Allow me to fight with you...
From now on, Commander, the four ships of the New Jersey fleet are yours to lead!
Now, teach those Sirens why your name is to be feared!
Ahaha! It feels real good to take out the trash like this! Come at me, scumbags!
I was worried for a sec if we could fight all of the Sirens at once, but turns out they're no match for us~
The combat power of the Pawns seems to have reverted to their original state...?
Original state...?
Yeah, we fought several waves of Sirens along the way. As the Reenactment progressed, the Pawns kept getting stronger and stronger until we could barely handle 'em.
If I had to give a gut estimate, I'd say these Sirens feel about the same as they were before we entered the sea fog.
...We'll have to carefully investigate why the Sirens suddenly had an explosive increase in combat power.
Don't let your guard down yet... Until we've destroyed the Mirror Sea, expect Siren resistance to grow more intense.
We continued fighting our way through the sea fog along with "Helena." As she said, the incoming Siren forces attacked with ever-growing ferocity.
Do you think the control device is being guarded?
Perhaps... The enemy aerial presence is becoming oppressive...
We may be drawing close to the ship that is defending this Mirror Sea...
Did you just say... ship?!
Yes. One that has lost sight of her very existence, unlike me...
One who used to fight for hope, but was overwhelmed by the grief etched into her hull by history...
But in your world... You may yet be able to save her...
I would like you to save her... Because she deserves it, just like the others...
Who are you talking about...?
...Watch out. More enemy aircraft are coming at us.
What?! I'm not seeing anything on my radar!
The number of planes coming at us is unreal! Are all the carrier Pawns converging on us at once?!
None of our detection equipment is working again... Is the Siren stealth system back online?
I don't think so... Let me try again!
Hold on, it should still be disabled... This can only mean...
This must be "her" doing... If that is the case, can you see her now?
Oh, I'm starting to see something over there! Wait, it's just a single ship?!
Yes... This is the true form of the Wisdom Cube... once it has been touched by the infinite potential of the "META" phenomenon.
The furor of the battlefield seemed to become silent as I racked my brain for answers. "META"... Where have I heard that before?
The word felt so unfamiliar to me, yet also so intimately connected as to stir a sense of panic within me.
What was this "true form" of the Wisdom Cube that "Helena" spoke of?
It is the course of nature for all Wisdom Cubes. To undergo metamorphosis, to metastasize.
It is the forbidden curse that this world has sealed within them.
The otherworldly power of the Ashes... Is this because of "META?"
The ones of us who fall and burn out... become Ashes.
...I see. So that's what you meant earlier when you said that you weren't with the Ashes.
...Yes.
(It makes sense now... The enemy that Baltimore and Enterprise fought also did not appear on their radars.)
(There was that other incident at the Diadem of Light that Commander reported... Where apparently another Ashes member attacked without anyone's notice... Is this a common power shared among them?)
(That would also explain why "Helena" has the ability to dispel their disguises...)
Why are you going out of your way to tell us all this? Are you looking for someone?
I cannot answer that question yet...
Fine. I don't like how you're pulling us around, but it's probably not wise to get on your bad side.
You did mention that you were loyal to the commander though. Was that just to get us to trust you?
...No. I am loyal to the commander. Now and forever...
Hmm... Why don't you come with us then? If there's something bothering you, I'm sure the commander would be more than glad to help you out!
It's... no longer possible...
You've done plenty of "impossible" things by our standards, but THAT'S impossible?
But, I suppose I'll leave you to your own devices. To get outta here, we just need to defeat "her," right?
Yes, this much I can guarantee...
You'll be fighting with us, right? I'm looking forward to seeing how you stack up to our Helena here~
...Very well.
Is that Souryuu? Wait, there's something different about her... Is she also one of the "META?"
What a terrifying aura... I can feel a deathly chill even from this distance.
She is the one who now controls this Mirror Sea.
(Too bad they aren't all as cooperative as "Helena"... I'm not sure we'll be able to talk our way out of this one...)
(But unlike the Siren Pawns, these Ashes ships really don't seem any different from us... Maybe there is a chance.)
Souryuu...
Don't worry. Commander and I are here. We'll try to talk things through with her first.
It's... probably too late...
Why's that?
Her expression seemed to waver.
That is not the same Souryuu as the one you know.
After she has undergone metamorphosis, her descent into Ashes is irreversible.
So don't worry about anything else... and fight for your lives.
"Helena" gave off a pained expression, as if she had failed a friend.
Miss Anzeel... Dr. Aoste...
These names... Where have I heard them before...?
The Creator, and the Magister. Do you know about them, Commander?
Perhaps not. Enterprise seems to have been very protective of you...
Don't worry. Perhaps one day, their names will disappear too, like a bad nightmare.

options.content: "Let's focus on getting out of here alive first."

scripts.say: ...She's coming at us! Everyone, watch out!
What the heck is with that firepower?! She's even tougher than the strongest Sirens we've fought!
If Albacore was here, she'd say something like "If you can't out-fight 'em, outsmart 'em!"—
Archerfish, it's too dangerous to go up there!
Ahaha~! I prefer doing things from behind~!
She actually stopped because of the torpedo attacks...?!
Well done, Archerfish. Now, it's my turn!
I am the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! Don't ever forget the sound of my roaring cannons! All guns, FIIIIIRE!!
PH Harbor - Temporary Office, Hours Later
Hey there, Puddin'! Your new office is looking hella spiffy~
After sending New Jersey and Ticonderoga off on their patrol mission, I started to head back to the office to finish organizing the documents I brought with me.
Just when I was about to sit back down, I noticed someone on the sofa in front of me.
Oh, did Ticonderoga already hook you up with the goods?
This new girl was waving around the documents I had painstakingly sorted as if they were cheap magazines.
Jeez, that girl sure moves fast, huh... What the heck's with this handwriting? Look at these hearts and curlicues!
"I'm not sure what the problem is... Doesn't everyone have their little quirks when it comes to handwriting?"
That's only barely scratching the surface, I tell you. If you know how to interpret these things, there's a whole bunch of hints from the way these papers are ordered to how the pages are folded.
"Sounds impressive, but overly complicated."
Haha, you're way too dense, Puddin'~ But that's part of what makes you so delicious~♪
"By the way, when you say 'pudding,' are you referring... to me?"
A girl's gotta make her mark, yeah? Tell ya what, hang out with me for a while, and I'll teach you how to become popular!
This girl was completely beyond my grasp...
Ahaha! I can't believe you'd fall for that! All these documents were typed up to begin with!
So this was the San Francisco I had heard so much about... a fun-loving girl who tries to live it up every waking moment of her life.
Anyway, if these documents are straight from the Naval HQ, is the Crimson Axis somehow involved?
"The Crimson Axis... Nominally, an organization that serves as our geopolitical enemies..."
"Regardless of the feelings and sentiments of the various shipgirls, the politics between our two major organizations have always been opaque and inscrutable."
Do you think it's because the Sakura Empire's fleet also appeared during the last Reenactment?
Commander, I've received a message from NY City.
"Naval HQ, huh? Put them through."
Sister Sara is soooooo worried about you, Commander! Is everything okay?
The excessively lively voice of Saratoga, the fleet idol, bubbled over from the other side of the communicator.
Actually, there's a little something that I need your advice on~~
So, this is actually pretty far from where you are, but I've gotten information that suggests the Sakura Empire is amassing a large fleet.
We don't know who's leading it, or what their purpose is.
But the fact that they're doing it now of all times has the Naval HQ on edge.
Woah, speak of the devil...
Weren't we supposed to be working together in staving off the Sirens, though?
Yeah! That's why I'd like to remind you to avoid hostilities with them if possible...
Just saying, be careful out there! You never know what kind of craziness might happen if you get thrown into another Reenactment!
"Understood. I'll keep that in mind."
Anyway, that's all from Sister Sara! Be careful out there, Commander~ Mwah!
I have a bad feeling about this...
"Me too. Too much is happening at once..."
That's not what I'm talking about... Why's that girl– Well, whatever, I'm not gonna let it keep me up at night!
Catch ya later, Puddin'~ Keep me posted if anything new happens!

options.content: "Wait, San Francisco, why are you taking the documents with you?"

scripts.say: Forgot to mention it, but I'm also in charge of looking after your health while you're here, Commander. No overtime while I'm here, got it?
If you want these back so badly, you'll have to follow me back to the bedroom~♪ Ahaha!
Oh yeah, forgot to mention it, but I'm also in charge of looking after your health while you're here, Commander. There won't be any overtime under my watch!
When I woke up the next day...
I learned that we had lost contact with the AF base.
Holy smokes... There's hardly a scratch on her even after taking a direct hit! I'm getting a real bad feeling about this...
The difference between your specifications is too vast... Even an attack like that couldn't penetrate her armor.
Oh, right! You've been able to hack into this Mirror Sea, right? Can you use it to even the playing field for us?
I see... Even though she's not part of the Reenactment, as the "controller" of the Mirror Sea, it might just work...
(This has to work... Otherwise...)
Mirror hacking protocol... Yes, it's working!
I'll be borrowing the power of the Mirror Sea!
Commander, order an all-out assault!
Please, lead us to victory!!
All ships, full speed ahead! Hit her with everything we've got!
We'll blast open a path to the future!

The Eagle Union ships, along with their mysterious helper, continued to tap into the powers of the Mirror Sea to whittle away at their fearsome enemy. Little by little, damage was starting to accumulate on her rigging.
Though the attacks were nowhere close to bringing the ashen ship to her knees, the movement of her aircraft became slower and more predictable.
With each passing moment, hope grew that she would eventually show a decisive weak point.
You're mine!!
Roar forth! Black... Dragon... Buster!!!
Woah... I can't believe I actually yelled it out... But I've never been able to muster that kind of firepower before!
Did I actually turn her to dust in a single shot...?!
No, you didn't...
She got away...
That's fine and all, but what about the Mirror Sea control device? I don't wanna be stuck here for the rest of my life!
Wait, that's it? I poured my heart and soul into that last shot! I even embarrassed myself in front of everyone!
Everyone, calm down... I know you're all still excited, but we've sustained some pretty serious injuries. At least, I'm not sure I can still keep up...
What do we do now...?
Hold on, I'm picking up a new signal on my radar! It's coming from an Eagle Union airraft!
New Jersey! Boise! Morrison! Don't shoot at me!
Look, those are the ships we've been searching for!
Appreciate it, whoever you are!
As waves of planes soared overhead, they layered the now-empty Mirror Sea with explosions.
Shockwaves ripped through the area just as before, and the whole world seemed to convulse.
After what seemed lke an eternity, the blood-red sky of the battlefield turned back into a familiar blue color, the sun shining gently over calm, clear waters.
Woah... There was another transference device nestled within the first one?
Why are you acting all surprised? Aren't you the one who shot it to pieces?
Everything's fine now. The Mirror Sea is finally dissipating.
You went straight for the transference device rather than looking for the control device, huh?
I've had it with this teleporting and dimension-travelling thing... I need a hug...
(The question remains... How did Souryuu take control of the Mirror Sea? I'll have to look deeper into it.)
(...and why did the commander get wrapped up in all of this?)
I guess this is where we part ways...
.........There are some things you are not yet meant to know.
Just as there are many things I still do not know about you.
As much as I wanted to press her for more information, I don't think I could force anything out of her.
And with the arrival of these new planes, I could only assume that her "comrades" were also looking for her.
...Enjoy the time you have with Commander, and try to be happy... the other "me."
...Eh? Are you talking to me?
...Goodbye.
Just like that, huh? I'm still not sure who you are, but thanks for everything. I hope we'll be able to fight together again one day.
...Mm, perhaps we will, someday...
After saying her parting words, "Helena" turned around and followed the other aircraft, soon disappearing into the horizon.
We're really just going to let her go like that? She might've helped us out a whole bunch, but she's still connected to the Ashes!
The enigmatic entity known as "Ashes," and the mysterious META phenomenon... I had too many questions, but I first had to think carefully about how to treat them.
I bet you're thinking about how to befriend them, Commander~ Ahaha, that's totally something you'd do~♪
Since you seemed positively smitten with that girl, I'm sure you wouldn't mind handling the entire post-operation report all by yourself, right? Don't die of overwork, okay~♪
Days Later - Unknown Eagle Union Facility
The relationship between Ashes and the META phenomenon, huh? ...Yeah, I can start looking into that.
I already combed through the navigational records and came up empty.
As for the relationship between Operation AF and the Reenactment, I already knew there was a Mirror Sea there.
Oh, here's a report about the battle with a ship that looked just like Souryuu. That's exactly what I'm looking for...
Why don't you just ask me for more information?
We'll have plenty of time to talk about it later. For the time being, I want to put together everyone's reports.
As for the Ashes, it seems like their internal affairs are not as monolithic as we originally assumed.
Some of them are keenly interested in the commander, while others seem pretty indifferent.
For now, it is too risky to continue interacting with them.
(Commander, you seem to be at the heart of so many different plans and conspiracies... The Northern Parliament seemed fine putting you in grave danger to further their goals...)
(But are we really much better? We sent you to the front lines during this operation... and look what happened as a result...)
(Regardless of what they say about your "compatibility" with Wisdom Cubes, what I know is... nobody is better at protecting this world than you are.)
(We, no, this entire world, would be lost without you... That's why...)
(We have to do a better job at keeping you safe.)
Whatever they're planning, Sister Sara has to get stronger to rise to the occasion!
Yeah. I'll protect you too, Commander. No matter what!
Hey, this isn't some kind of competition! Your rigging's too big for you to be at Commander's side anyway!
Anyway, let's take a look at the next investigation... "Operation Dawn?"
I can't shake the feeling that they are being used by the Sirens.
...And, I'm sorry I didn't notice the other layer within the Mirror Sea.
Lift your head. Everyone makes mistakes.
Commander has already started investigating the Ashes.
...Helena, do you hate them?
I... don't want to hear about them anymore.
...You don't have to force yourself.
...I know...
After all, we've both agreed to not dig around in each others' pasts.
The past holds nothing of value.
The past contains only fodder for the endless, seething penitence of the Ashes.
The Sirens cling blindly to the past, hoping to find their future there.
...Yes, we have spent far too long shackled by our past.
All of us are the same in that regard. Each time we gaze down at our reflections in the mirror that is the sea, we see an endless spiral towards involution.
But...... Commander is not like that...
.........Indeed. The Commander is different...
By the way, how is your health? Are you still having flashbacks?
I've seen better days. But more importantly, about Souryuu...
At this rate, she will be lost to us...
I'll handle it.
Please be careful, my dear. If that was to happen to you as well...
That past is no longer a part of me.
Have you found Code... Rather, have you found Enterprise yet?
No, I haven't the slightest clue...
But, because of what she's done, we'll be safe from the eyes of the Arbiters for a while.
...Then, the two of us will continue to wander...
The ships under my command had gathered in the temporary command post.
We still haven't been able to reestablish contact with the AF base!
We've been losing our recon planes halfway through the flight as well...
Are they being shot down, or getting lost in a Mirror Sea?
You got it, boss. Everyone's working as fast as they can.
At least from what we can tell, this isn't a simple case of mechanical failure.
When's the last time we had communication with them?
The last message I see was sent at midnight.
Considering the distance between us, that message should've gone through instantaneously.
Actually... I'm picking up on some scattered signals right now... Let me try to piece them together...
What the hell's this?!
———Sakura Empire———attacking——emergency———
———requesting assistance——heavy damage——unable to hold on——
I'm sorry, this was all I was able to decrypt...
It sounds like they were either attacked by the Sakura Empire... or by someone pretending to be them.
In any case, we have to go back them up as quickly as possible!
Wait, didn't Saratoga say something yesterday about a large Sakura Empire fleet gathering?
Seems pretty sus that the AF base would come under attack shortly after that...
"It doesn't make any sense for the Sakura Empire to attack AF..."
Do you think that Siren Pawns are behind this, then?
Hard to say. From everything we know about Pawns, they're pretty easy to defeat, or at least to disengage from.
...Hm, what about the Ashes? Wasn't there something on record about an enemy that looked like Hiryuu?
"It's a possibility... But why AF? It doesn't seem like something they'd do..."
"Whatever the reason might be, we can't ignore an ally's cries for help."
"Furthermore, we can only assume that the Sirens are somehow involved since we keep losing our recons."
"Everyone, set sail for AF Atoll!"
Patrol Fleet
The AF base came under attack and we've lost contact with them?
I step away from the base for a second and this happens... So, what's the commander's response?
Um, a rescue fleet was formed and is now on its way to AF.
And is the commander with them?
Looks that way.
All righty, looks like I'll finally be seeing some action!
Huh?
Round up the patrol fleet. We're heading to AF as well!
From everything you've told me, it's pretty clear that the Sirens are involved, don'tcha think?
That's why you've gotta bring the firepower for the job!
Hehe, seems like you're all fired up~
That's right! Besides, don'tcha think the commander would've done the same thing?
The indomitable Black Dragon isn't some hotel that sits on the sideline while her friends are in trouble!
Ticonderoga, put me through to the other girls.
Listen up, everyone. You've all heard the news right? We're gonna go back up the commander!
O-okay...! I hear you, loud and clear...!
Understood.
That's the spirit! Reverse course, everyone! We're headed for AF Atoll!
New Jersey Fleet - Hours Later
Wait, what?!
Now we've lost contact with the commander as well?
It appears so. We lost contact shortly after the fleet left PH Harbor.
Speaking of which, we can't even contact the harbor either.
Was it attacked? Or...
We have no way of knowing right now.
However, there are reports of sea fog occurring in the area where we lost contact with the commander. Aerial reconnaissance has not been possible there either.
What about the other ships with the commander?
Helena, Archerfish, and San Francisco?
Even Helena, huh? ...Ty, if I'm not mistaken, there's been information about this sea fog in our records, right?
Like when Baltimore went missing at the canal stronghold.
Yes, a similar sea fog appeared before the fleet disappeared into a Mirror Sea.
Even someone like Enterprise got caught up in the Sirens' machinations...
Right, right! Helena was there too.
...Ty, I have an idea. Can you put me through with Baltimore to see if she knows anything about the current situation?
I could try, at least...
But what are we supposed to tell the others? The commander going missing isn't something we can take lightly.
As with the case with Baltimore's fleet, we should regroup first and figure out how to send reinforcements.
Hm, I guess that is an important consideration... Let's tell Saratoga at least, so we—
Don't you fret! I already know what's going on!
I'll get in touch with the others, so just focus on finding the commander first!
If we don't bring the commander back, both of our bases will be vulnerable to Siren attacks!
That makes things easier for us. Just leave it to Big J!
...Wait, how long have you been listening in on us, Saratoga?
Huh? I just popped in because Ticonderoga said it was urgent~
Ahaha... I already reached out to Sara while we were talking.
Ah, no problem. It's better to do things efficiently.
Sister Sara will deal with the Naval HQ over here, so just focus your attention on rescuing the commander!
All of this... is making me think back to the previous Reenactment...
Mm... You weren't able to fight back then.
The commander wasn't there either, so it was a completely different situation.
Sorry, but there's something I need to look into right now. I'll get back to you later, okay? Do your best~!
There she goes again...
Well, I'm glad Saratoga is handling the complicated stuff. Let's just focus on doing whatever we can here.
Commander's fleet should have no trouble fighting off some Sirens, but let's not waste any more time!
I was on the bridge of a ship, but it was no longer one that I recognized.
It was different from anything I'd seen at the Eagle Union, Royal Navy, or Northern Parliament.
I looked around some more... The chrysanthemum patterns that I saw left no doubt in my mind. This was one of the Sakura Empire's mass-produced ships.
Oh, Puddin', you look so delicious... I could just eat you up...
What kind of pranks... should I play with Albacore next... Zzz...
The shipgirls beside me were mumbling in their sleep, as if trapped in their dreams.
They didn't appear injured, but their rigging was nowhere to be seen.
...Does anyone remember what happened?
We were making our way towards AF Atoll, when all of a sudden we were sent somewhere else.
Indeed...
There's no way I'm dreaming this up, right?
This is way too spooky! I'm not made for this!
Maybe we got pulled into the twilight zone? Dudududu~ dudududu~
This must be the Sirens' new weapon! We've been kidnapped!
Despite the utter inconceivability of the situation we were in, the girls seemed rather light-hearted.
I had to stay calm, though. I had to figure out what was going on.
We entered the sea fog, didn't we?
Something like this happened back when I was in Baltimore's fleet at the canal stronghold. When we passed through the sea fog, we were suddenly in a different place.
"This could well be that same weapon."
I think so too. Back then, we encountered one of the Ashes and were able to fight our way out.
So, are we stuck inside a Mirror Sea now?
I'd say something funny if this wasn't dead serious... First thing's first, we'll have to check what's wrong with our rigging.
Just gotta... Huh? Why can't I summon my rigging? Helloooo? Riggerino?
No luck... Is it just my rigging that's hiding from me?
Let me try... Wow, I can't do it either. That's not good...
San Francisco reached for the lever of the watertight door.
What the heck, I can't even open this door... Are we totally trapped in here?
Helena, do you see anything on the other side of the window?
SG... What do I do without my SG... Urk...
Woah, easy there, Helena...
Huh? Um, oh... I can't see anything through the fog...
Wait, what's that? It's just a faint outline, but it looks like some kind of ship...
Is it a Siren ship or one of our own? Does anyone have a working communicator?
I usually use my rigging for that. Also didn't bring my cellphone because we're on a mission.
The commander wouldn't bring one either, so we're going to have to find some way out of here first...
Something like a crowbar... or a stick of dynamite...
Dynamite?!
Look here! I found something that might function as a communicator!
Nice going, Helena!
But... I'm not sure something like this— Whoa, what? It's working?!
"Reporting from the front lines."
"Our air squadrons have begun bombarding the enemy base."
"Our recon planes have not yet discovered Eagle Union forces. Requesting additional recon support."
"Prioritize disabling the enemy base. One wave of airstrikes may not be enough to finish the job."
"Prepare to launch the next wave of attacks."
A recorded message from the Sakura fleet? Something feels off about this...
I assume they were talking about attacking the harbor... Do you think we've been put onto one of their mass-produced ships?
That doesn't make any sense... This ship isn't moving at all, and I don't see any signs of the rest of the fleet!
The fact that this message has been recorded here means that this ship is part of that fleet, doesn't it?
I'm not sure what purpose that message serves, but it's our only clue on how to get out right now.
Keep your eyes peeled and listen closely.
New Jersey Fleet
So these are the coordinates where the commander was last seen?
Yes. The communication log suggests the same thing.
The lingering fog here matches the descriptions from the intel reports.
We're not too far from the island right now, so even if we get attacked, we should be able to turn back.
"...We were suddenly swallowed up by the sea fog, and before we knew what was going on, we had already been transported to a totally different place."
"It's hard to believe, but the coordinates where you went missing does differ from where you later escaped."
"While Mirror Seas are known to mess with navigational equipment, that alone could not explain such a drastic difference."
"Therefore, the Naval HQ has concluded that the purpose of the 'sea fog' is to serve as a weapon that facilitates mass displacement."
If this is what we're dealing with, I wonder if everyone at AF is okay...
This is Boise... We finally managed to connect to AF... They seem to be fine for now!
Thank goodness! What about Allen? Have you been able to speak with her?
Yes! Morrison arrived at the base ahead of us.
Finally, some good news... I'll go ahead and contact Allen directly then.
Allen, can you hear me?
Loud and clear~! Sorry if there's some background noise, we're busy trying to defend the base over here!
Yesterday evening, a sea fog suddenly appeared around the base, and then Sakura Empire carriers started bombarding us...
That's when you sent the emergency request to PH Harbor, huh?
Yup. We sent the message in the evening, but for whatever reason, it didn't arrive until the next morning...
Have you verified that we're going up against the real Sakura Empire?
Hard to say... The planes definitely look like they're the real deal, though...
We're no experts on the subject, but those insignias are pretty unmistakable...
Got some photographic evidence on Mr. Bear's built-in camera too if you want to see for yourself.
The weather's nice and sunny around the base itself, but the sea fog is still heavy around the waters to the northwest.
New Jersey, you should head over there and investigate if you want to figure out what's going on.
Got it. Ty and I will head over there right now.
Boise, Morrison, I'd like the two of you to join us. Allen can take care of defending the base.
Easy peasy!
(Good, at least we now know that AF is safe... One fewer thing to worry about.)
(Next, I have to find the commander and investigate this Mirror Sea.)
(Honestly, I'm not too confident about our prospects given this small fleet, but I can't afford to wait for reinforcements with Commander's safety on the line.)
(Commander, hold out a bit longer!)
KABOOOOM!
An enemy airstrike?! Phew... I owe you one, Morrison!
It spooked me too... Thankfully, Mr. Bear was equipped with some air defense weapons...
What the heck have you added to Mr. Bear since last time...?
Hehehe... Just a few little tweaks to make him more perfect...
Morrison, watch out! There's more coming!
More planes? There's just no end to them!
That's why we need to hurry up and join with Ticonderoga!
Port - Office
Wait a second. Is today...
That's right, nya! It's that time of year again, nya!
Commander, get a load of my promo video, nya!

scripts.say: Nya...? I-I mixed up the files, nya!
[Overhead view of city. Music dramatically surges]

Urgh, my head is spinning... I might've had a little too much to drink.
Good thing we're dubbing over it in post. If I can just lip sync my lines right, I'm good.
Don't look at the camera, speak as naturally as possible...
Ms. Chkalov, tell me again how you got those goodies for such a discount!
Where in the world can I get an awesome deal like that?
These are all from Akashi's big promotional sale. The drinks are practically a steal... You should TOTALLY check them out!
[Luxury car enters scene. Camera zooms]
Wooow, honey, look! I rule the road now!
Just ignore the fact that it's closed for filming, so I'm the only person who gets to drive on it anyway!
AHEM. New Jersey, your lines?

Let's go check it out later!
That was ad-libbed, wasn't it? You don't... actually think these are good deals, do you?
Huh? You don't think so?!
But she has daily giveaways!
I will admit, that is one tradition that I appreciate.
You heard right, nya!
This year, we're trimming all the fat and delivering all the savings straight to YOU yet again, nya!
