See you on the day of the sale, nya!
[Camera pans up to the blue sky. End]

options.content: It was... memorable, I'll give you that.
That was novel. Maybe not in a good way.

scripts.say: I'll go grab the right files right now, nya!
Make sure you read the flyers again, nya! Or else you might miss the opportunity of a lifetime, nya!
After leaving a bundle of flyers, she bolts out of my office like a flash of green lightning.
Turning my office into an ad space again, I see...
Well, I guess it is a special occasion.
After work, I'll go check it out.
Port - Office
It's now year three since my big sale started... and I've discovered a critical problem, nya.
A... critical problem?
Yeah, nya! It's that it's completely missing the VIBE of a big sale, nya. I've been agonizing over how to solve that, nya.
After thinking about it for a looong time, I've finally got it – I'm gonna start a livestream shopping program to boost my sales, nya!
Businesses need to adapt to the shifting sands of time or get left in the dust, nya!
Check out what I've got so far, nya.
Akashi turns on the television, showing a video of Kearsarge who for some reason is surrounded by piles of products.
Hey, everyone. I'm Kearsarge, the sales ambassador for this occasion.
Left parenthesis, try to sound happy and excited, nya, right parenthesis.
I'm going to show you several truly jaw-dropping bargains you can get during this sale. Dash.
Including an amazing limited bundle deal, exclamation mark, exclamation mark, exclamation mark.
Left parenthesis, make sure to really sell this one because it's my bread and butter, nya, right parenthesis.
This bundle contains several things too good to pass on, such as–
Akashi presses the TV's off button, terminating the feed of Kearsarge's deadpan reading of the script.
Oh boy, nya... When I told her to "read the script," I wasn't expecting her to take it THIS literally, nya!
But hey, it's okay, nya! This mistake taught me a lot, nya! Tomorrow's stream is gonna go much better, nya!
Now, I'm gonna take my leave, nya. I need to make a few tweaks to improve the show, nya!
...She's doing this again tomorrow?
Port - Office
I'm back, nya~ I've given the show the tweaks it needed, nya!
Most notably, I had my ambassador memorize the script, nya. I guarantee you orders are gonna come flooding in this time, nya!
Time to find out, nya... Turn on the TV, nya!
Today's exclusive deal is this parts bundle. It's packed with items that substantially improve your battlefield performance. I even use it myself.
That's not all, though. Look at this Iron Blood-developed rigging maintenance kit.
Whether your rigging is bionic, mechanical, or even a shikigami, this kit makes every step of maintaining it easy as pie.
Does rigging maintenance still cause you unnecessary headaches?
Then come to Iron Blood and we'll do everything for you. Our techniques guarantee peace of mind for you and your rig–
Akashi turns off the television, cutting short Regensburg's off-the-script self-promotion.
That was all wrong, nya! I didn't put any Iron Blood kit in my product lineup, nya!
God dangit, nya... When I told her "ad-libbing is okay," I wasn't expecting her to promote OTHER people's stuff, nya!
But hey, it's fine, nya! I made a mistake, and I've learned from it, nya! Tomorrow's stream won't be like this one, nya!
On that note, I'd better be off, nya. I'm gonna change a couple of things to make the show better, nya!
...Again?
Port - Office
It's the time of day Akashi usually shows up, yet she's nowhere to be seen.
Turning on the TV shows that her livestream isn't on, either. Did our stubborn sales-cat finally give up?
BEEP BEEP!
Heheheh. Starting to miss me, nya?
If you wanna see me, come to Seashore Avenue now, nya! I'm waiting for you here, nya~
Is she high on catnip? Her voice sure sounded like it.
Now I'm getting worried... I'd better check on her.
Port - Seashore Avenue
My biggest sale of the year officially starts... now, nya!
There's so much to choose from, from tons of limited-time skins making a comeback, to bundle deals with unbelievable savings, nya!
The more you buy, the bigger the discount, nya~ Better buy now, nya~
But I'm not done yet, nya! Even if all you do is come and window-shop, you'll get a gift bag ABSOLUTELY FREE, nya!
These prices are so low that you'd need a greatsword to slash them more, nya! Any lower would be illegal, really, nya!
The moment I set foot on Seashore Avenue, I spot Akashi with a microphone in hand – or paw, who knows? – working hard to lure in customers.
She and three other shipgirls are up on a stage packed with products. They strike eye-catching poses and hype the place up.
Next to the sea and the beach, under white clouds and blue skies, the shipgirls holler and hoot on Seashore Avenue.
Akashi has finally found the sales strategy that suits her most.
First of all, I want to say...

options.content: Pay up for reserving the venue.

scripts.say: I couldn't have done it without you, Commander, nya~
Here's today's free gift bag, nya. I want you to have it, nya~
Hehehehe... And while you're here, why not check out my wares and buy something you like, nya?
Giving out freebies one second and telling you to buy something the next... Yep, that's the Akashi I know.
NYA?! What are you talking about, nya?! I assumed this place was free for anyone to use, nya!
...Shiranui! Keep the sales coming in, nya! I've got urgent business I need to attend to, nya!
What? Wait...
After dumping her microphone in Shiranui's hands, Akashi scurries away in a flash.

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Getting Work Done!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
To supervise a whole fleet, a method of communication to transmit and receive messages and materials throughout the port's many departments is of utmost importance.
Just as there are times where one phone call is sufficient, there are times where just a single slip of paper has to be delivered by a messenger.
It's times like the latter when she – my secretary – is a huge help.
Commander!
I've delivered the documents to the provisions manager!
Also, I've got something for you!
This! Your regularly scheduled inventory report! I asked for one just like you told me to!
Anything else you want me to do?

options.content: Give Cavalla some time to rest

scripts.say: Okey-dokey, I will!
Whoopee♪
I got three tasks done for the commander today! I went to the research lab, school, and the depot...
Way to go, me!
Cavalla looked pleased with herself.
Heheh~ You couldn't manage without me, could you~
I wouldn't say I couldn't make do without her, but I'm still grateful because she's such a big help.
Bah... Don't treat me like a baby, Commander!
She doesn't seem to like it when I pat her on the head.
Let's call it here for today and ask for her help again later tomorrow.

I'm Not A Baby!

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Justice Is Served!</size>

scripts.say: A few hours ago...
Commander, something bad's happened, nya! There's been a catastrophe in the depot, and we need help, nya!
What's that, nya?! You're too busy and can't spare the time, nya?! C-can't you help in some way, nya...?
... Your secretary can give us a hand, nya? That'd be great, nya!
It's now been several hours since Akashi took my secretary and left.
With no one around to help, I've been out and about the port, doing things on my own.
Come to think of it, that thing Akashi said about the depot–
I'm back!
... Cavalla came back sooner than I expected.
I did just as you instructed, and I even managed to get some friends to help out in the depot!
Justice has been served!
... Huh? Nobody told you what happened? Okay, let me explain...
Cavalla gave me a detailed account of the events that had unfolded.
In short, Akashi had made a mistake which put the inventory in disorder, and they helped reorganize it.
The "friends" she mentioned refers to the Little Beavers. She'd crossed paths with them by happenstance on her way to the depot.
Apparently, they weren't very sure about what had caused the inventory mixup. I will have to investigate later...
"Justice will always prevail!" That's what the captain of the Little Beavers said!
What a cool catchphrase!
I wanna be a partner of justice too!
Cavalla's eyes were gleaming with enthusiasm.

sequence:
I'm Not A Baby!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Prepare To Strike!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Exercise Area
An exercise focusing on Gato-class submarines was being held.
Darn, can't find any good targets...
Yeah! I'm gonna be super disappointed if we have to head back without firing even a single torp!
You said it! We'll be the laughing stock of the other subs if we return empty-handed!
Sadly, U-81's team has already sunk the primary target, and I dunno how but I-26's team also got points for sinking something. We're in a real herringed pickle...
... Huh?
*Yawn*...
Heheh...
Guys, you see how tired Laffey is looking over there...? It's the perfect opportunity for an ambush!
Huh?! Are you serious?! Laffey's a destroyer!
I know, which is why I've thought up a plan~
Cavalla, you act as bait to lure her attention, then Dace and I will wait for an opening to strike.
Sounds like a plan! Let's do it!
All right! Over here, Dace!
So tired... I definitely don't wanna go sleep in my room... Nope, not at all...
... What the...?
(That's it, Cavalla! You have her on the hook!)
WRAAAGH!
... Huh?
Have a taste of my cannons!
You're trying to fight on the surface, even though you're a submarine...? Don't underestimate me...
What the?! She evaded my attacks?!
(What the heck is Cavalla doing?!)
Deactivating self-imposed limiter...
Destroyers don't scare m– Oh, God! That nearly hit me!
Dace! Do it!
Take this! Total torpedo turmoil attaaaack!
An attack from beneath...!
Laffey was (in this exercise scenario) sunk.
You got me...
Hooray! Mission successful!
... Okay, I DID tell you to act as bait, but you didn't need to do crazy things like that!
Still, I'm sure Cavalla's actions gave the commander quite a surprise...
Eheheheh!

I'm Not A Baby!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Mistakes Were Made!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Nearby Waters
Pwah! Heck yeah, first place!
Dangit... Welp, I'm clearly not performing at my best today~
... Oh, hey, Commander!
... What we're doing? Just a friendly competition between us subs. Loser has to buy Oxy-cola for everyone else.
And it's looking like Cavalla's the loser this time.
You think she lost cause she's been skipping out on training in favor of her secretary work?
That'd make the Commander feel bad about it and make her resign. Now then, Cavalla, you owe us some...~
... drinks? Hey, where's Cavalla?
Wasn't she right behind you?
No? Maybe she just kept going past the buoys that indicate the extent of the exercise area?
(Whispering) Oops. I probably shouldn't have moved those around to confuse people...
If she did then she'll end up where the Sakura Empire is conducting an exercise...
That'd be big trouble! C'mon, Commander, we gotta find her!
Exercise Area
Bah! You win!
Victory is mine♪
It's not fair to pull a sneak attack like that, sis!
*Giggle*, it's your fault for not realizing one was coming. You won't be able to defeat me if you don't concentrate~
Furthermore, you should expect to see sneak attacks utilized in a real battle, since–
Pwah!
Huh?!
I made it here first! Heheh, Albacore, Dace, you know what that means! It's time to buy me some Ox... y... cola...?
I know you...!
Sis, this time, I will protect you! Stay back, pesky sub!
W-wait, where am I?
I-I'm so confused!
I see... So Cavalla went beyond the boundary buoys and ended up here.
I made such a stupid mistake...
I'm so sorry!
*Giggle*, it's fine. My little sister shouldn't have reacted the way she did, either.
Y-yeah, I shouldn't have... Sorry, Cavalla!
As punishment, you will give the Commander and these submarines half of your tempura ration today♪
Yippee!
And when did you all show up?!
Later that day, we all savored Shoukaku's delicious handmade tempura.

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Tell Me A Story!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
All done!
Well, Commander? Aren't I amazing~?
With Cavalla's help, I managed to finish all the work for today.
Dace and friends didn't show up earlier, and all the other subs seem busy...
*Sigh*... I bet I'll end up spending the afternoon just sitting on my butt...
Oh, I've got an idea! Let's have a storytelling contest, Commander!
I'm presuming the idea is that we'll each take turns telling a story and then decide whose is the best.
You go first, Commander!
Right, what kind of story should I tell her?

options.content: A story about a hero who sacrifices himself to save the world
A story about a king who abdicates to be with his sweetheart
A story about a detective who uses his wits to track down a criminal

scripts.say: Why did the hero have to die?
There's gotta be a way to save the world without sacrificing yourself! Boo!
Cavalla seemed really upset with my story.
Why did he need to... "abbey-cate"... to be with his sweetheart?
I don't get it!
... It seems Cavalla is too young to enjoy the story.
Zzzzzzzzz……
H-huh? Is the story over?
I must've fallen asleep... Sorry!
It seems Cavalla thought my story was rather dull.
Okay, now it's my turn!
Heheh! I'm sure my story will be much more exciting!
She told me a story centered around her own service record.
Well? Aren't I the best? No one else would ever understand the richness of Cavalla's personal story!
Hey! You're treating me like a baby again!
That does it! Next time I'm gonna make it clear to you that I'm not a baby anymore!
I sensed an unusual flash of determination in her words.

So far it's been a normal day without any–

And it makes me mad!
So, go on a date with me! Then, I'll show you a part of me you've never seen before!
... Please?
I'm not leaving until you say "yes"!
Great!

Let's get going right now!

Thank you for your patronyage~
