All we can do is keep fighting, then. Luckily, the New World backup isn't far.
There is a gap in our world history, where a war took place.
Even if most people don't know about it, there will always be those who remember it.
It's time, my darling~
I launch the signal flare Golden Hind entrusted me with.
Well, well. You're always full of surprises.
Mhm. It's a communication tool I found in the New World~
Let's see if my friend is as well-connected as she claims...
PSSHH!
Oh, my. They're already all here~
A flare shoots up into the sky, illuminating a fleet that has appeared out of thin air.
What a pain... Hey, Whydah here.
Good to see you again, girls from Thalasso...
You brought new snacks with you from back home, right?
Is that your friend? Is she bringing the reinforcements?
To be precise, SHE is the reinforcement~
...What?
Her? This little girl?
You heard me. She is far, far richer than me~
What, don't you have any friends with lots of cash to splash?
Okay, that's nip this in the bud! She's a friend of a friend, which makes her my friend, too! Boy, my rich friends are so awesome!
Good. Remember to tell her the same later.
Hey, Whydah! Over here~
You'll get your snacks, just cover our retreat for now~
Woohoo! Snack time!
Okay, I've got you.
I'll get you out safely!
The Echo Fleet quickly lost their momentum thanks to Whydah's pincer attack, forcing them to retreat.
The girls were initially doubtful of Whydah's fleet, having appeared from nowhere. Their misgivings vanished as soon as they saw the little girl herself.
She – "Whydah the Magnificent," as Golden Hind put it – is a pirate shipgirl who has made it big in the New World.
Thank you for coming to our aid.
I must say, though... You are very small.
Hahahah! Look at 'er! Isn't she a cute little lass?
H-hey... Put me down!
I can't see anything with my hat covering my eyes!
Oh, boy...
Golden Hind, are you serious about the "magnificence" of this girl?
Yes, I am~
Golden Hind smiles a strangely proud smile.
A bit of fussing later...
A-alright, listen! I'm Whydah! I answered your call!
So, if I got this right, you want to throw a wrench into the Echo Fleet's plans, yeah?
First, things get busy in the New World, then, the Echo Fleet starts causing trouble...
I won't be able to sleep at night if things get any worse. Ugh, what a pain...
Then why don't you come with us and fix those problems?
Don't worry, little one, we'll keep you safe~
Y-yikes...!
Mary squats down in front of Whydah, who hops to the top of a nearby box.
N-no! Keep your cold, pale hands off of me!
Seems she finds a ghost ship more frightening than the Echo Fleet.
Thanks for the insightful comment...
Ahem. I'm still surprised the Echo Fleet just gave up like that.
Last time we fought, we had to sink 70% of their fleet before they legged it.
Bet they went home and cried to mommy and daddy!
That's no way to speak about a tough adversary, Royal Fortune~
Huh...?
Oh...
What's the matter? Why'd ya go quiet all of a sudden?
...Over there? What's there that I'm not–
Oh, god! We've got trouble!
Golden Hind raised a tentacle and pointed into the distance towards a colossal shadow on the horizon.
Slowly, the silhouette of the giant thing grows bigger and bigger, dyeing the sea fog around it a foreboding black.
It is larger than any warship in the world. Even the largest vessels in Thalasso seem tiny by comparison.
Geeeesh... We chased off the small ones, and now they're bringing in the big guns!
Something tells me it won't leave without a fight.
São Martinho, can you defeat it?
I will try.
Meaning, you're not sure you'll win...
Which is fair, really. I wouldn't be confident about beating a ship many times bigger than a galleon either.
We've got li'l Whydah here, so why don't we just flee before it reaches us?
Did you just call me "little"?
I'll have you know that I'm a reliable pirate leader, no matter my stature!
They don't call me "the Magnificent" for nothing! I can deal with anyone, even that monster of a ship.
She digs through the pockets of her greatly oversized coat and pulls out an antique yet ornate little box.
This isn't the time for a snack, y'know.
It's not a snack box! Stupid... I'm taking this seriously.
Okay, let's see... This will take a little while to set up.
You'll need to defend me until I'm done.
I'll tell you once I've finished.
Holding on to her hat many sizes too large for her head, Whydah vanishes over the sea, small box in hand.
Thinks herself a pirate leader, eh... Hahahah.
Let's make the kid's dream come true. Commander, you take point.
Alright, here we go!
For Whydah's dream.
For Whydah's dream!
After ten minutes of keeping the colossal Echo Fleet ship at bay, Whydah suddenly returns.
That was a pain... I'm done, by the way.
Commander, can I borrow you for a sec?
Terminal says it needs you to do its job.
Yup. It's an ancient grimoire capable of performing magic.
She hands me a board-like object made of black metal.
(Hang on... Is this a tablet computer?)
I thought it looked extremely familiar. Sure enough, it is a tablet.
Is that what you were keeping inside your snack box?
I told you! It's not a dang snack box!
Ugh... Terminal, are you there?
Greetings, Whydah the Magnificent. I am on standby and awaiting orders.
What in tarnation?! It can talk?
It sure can. But it's not JUST a talking grimoire.
Okay, let's run the... authentication protocol thingy, right?
...Please follow the instructions shown and place your right hand on the center of the screen.
The familiar voice makes my muscle memory kick in.
Authentication protocol complete.
Sweet. Now it's showtime.
Whydah spoke, and at the same time, a sound like distant rumbling came from the sky.
The night sky is lit up by what looks like shimmering falling stars that converge upon a single point.
Traveling faster than the speed of sound, the objects strike the gigantic warship. A moment later follows an ear-shattering sonic boom and explosion.
KABOOM!
KABOOOOOM!
The massive vessel capsizes instantly, and the many steel cannons lining its broadside fall into the ocean one after the next.
The enemy has sunk.
What was THAT? Shooting stars?
Unbelievable... She sunk that great beast in the twinkle of an eye. Such frightening power.
My, my. The power of that ancient artifact hasn't declined one bit~
Riiight?
I'll be damned! You did it, li'l girl!
Eep! L-let go of my hat!
I've got something important to say... Lemme goooo!
Oh. Then let's hear it.
Mary puts Whydah back down after holding her high in the air like a baby.
Ugh... So, you're all looking for the Fountain of Youth, yeah?
How'd you know?
Terminal told me. Said there's a fleet investigating a legend of the New World.
It said A legend, but it was pretty obvious which one. I figured it was probably you as soon as Golden Hind called for me.
The... grimoire told you?
Yup. It's really smart and knows everything.
It also said the Fountain is where it originally came from.
So yeah, I'm considering coming along with you to check it out.
Aww, that's so brave of our little indoor pirate~
You should know this is a pretty dangerous journey, though. Even more dangerous than the storm you ran into that one time~
Ugh... Yeah, I know.
And while I do prefer the indoors, I've built up SOME resistance to the outdoors.
While we're at it, can I make a suggestion?
I know where Adventure Galley is spending her retirement. The journey will be a lot smoother if we can convince her to join the fleet.
Adventure Galley? Isn't she the girl who...?
Yeah. She's had it rough...
But I think she recovered from her gloomy phase a while ago, at least.
She knows more about maritime legends than anyone, and we'll need her wisdom if we're gonna actually find the Fountain of Youth.
Hmm... I don't see why not~
What do you think, my darling?

options.content: I'm all in favor of expanding the crew.

scripts.say: Great. Yippieee.
Great. Yippieee.
Noooo! Not again! Let me doooown!
Trailing the coastline, we make for the place where the shipgirl Adventure Galley has retired to.
While we've been sailing for several days straight now, life aboard the ship hasn't changed much – there's always something happening.
From Royal Fortune making a racket when there's trouble, to Whydah playing solo hide-and-seek to avoid doing any work, the days are always full of character.
Greetings, Commander.
The girls are bathing on deck, and one of them shoots a playful splash of water at me. São Martinho effortlessly blocks it with her wing, then sits down in one of the water-filled barrels.
Thanks. I nearly got drenched there.
Don't mention it.
I must say, you are a fascinating person.
You have a presence that alters the mind. The New World, bustling as it is, feels just like a calm Thalasso port when you're around.
She draws a curious comparison, her eyes tracking Mary Celeste and Whydah as the former chases the latter around the deck.

options.content: That's a philosophical way of putting it.

scripts.say: Philosophy exists in all things.
...I've wanted to formally invite you to my fleet. I give up on that now.
Your comrades would surely object, and I doubt you're much interested to begin with.
But, I have another idea...
Gotcha!
The wild chase around the deck has resulted in a winner.
L-lemme doooown!
Let me have this, and I'll double your snacks for today.
D-double...? You mean it?

options.content: Don't overdo it, or you'll get cavities!

scripts.say: I know, okay?! I'm not a little kid!
Ahahahahah!
What's so funny?
Fine, if you'll really give me extra snacks, I'll let you hold me for just a while...
Aaaahhhh! Stop shaking meeeeee!

options.content: Sorry, what were you going to say?

scripts.say: Oh. Nothing too important.
It might be too soon to bring it up, actually... My capacity for interpersonal relationships leaves much to be desired.
My idea was to build a new maritime order. The time isn't ripe for it yet, however.
I will need to study the matter further.

options.content: I hope you learn everything you need.

scripts.say: Thank you.
Now, I'd better get back to my patrol. Farewell.
The Great Royal Fortune sails onward, carrying the dreams of all those aboard.
New World - Secret waters - Shipwreck Point
The crew of the Great Royal Fortune leans against her railings, looking at their surroundings with curious and tense expressions.
As they should. This region of the sea is known as Shipwreck Point, and it is here where Adventure Galley has retired to.
Whether the rumors that have earned this place its name hold any truth or not, we must proceed forward with caution.
While the waters are tranquil for now, that could change at any moment.
This place is known for frequent shipwrecks, eh? It feels kinda standing on the edge of the world.
Adventure Galley sure didn't choose a normal, boring place to retire to.
Yeah. On the plus side, it's not as eerie as I expected.
If anything, it's a nice place. The sea is calm, the land is covered in greenery, and there's even flowers growing all over.
All we know about Shipwreck Point comes from legends.
It could simply be that ships that sink in the Windless Sea are brought here by the currents.
So all those stories about sea monsters and ghost ships were made up.
Then I got the heebie-jeebies over nothing. We might as well just ask Adventure Galley to show herself!
Before anyone else can get a word in, Royal Fortune cups her hands around her mouth and starts shouting.
HELLOOO!
ADVENTURE GALLEEEY! ARE YOU HEEERE?
Shhh! Don't be so loud!
You don't know who or what is out there!
So? What's it matter?
We just established that the rumours about this place are false.
Because this place is more than meets the eye.
Sure, the shipwreck part is false, but there HAVE been sightings of monsters and spooky ships.
Oh, okay. What a magical place the New World is.
Still, no spooky ship has shown up so far, nor has Adventure Galley.
Yeah, but... Hrmm...
You'd think she'd notice that we sailed in here.
Maybe she's trying to nap so she's pretending to be away?
Sounds like something out of your playbook.
I only do that to recharge my energy!
Maybe her hands are tied with other business~
Isn't there some other way you can contact her, Whydah?
Hmm. I guess we try a signal flare?
Although, that'll DEFINITELY alert the monsters in the area... What a pain.
My darling, what do you propose?

options.content: That we prepare in the event of a battle.

scripts.say: You got it! Tempesta is on it.
Good ide– Wait, what's "Tempesta"?
The name of our fleet! Isn't it brilliant? I came up with it on the spot.
Think about it. Mary and São Martinho both have connections to storms.
The Commander arrived in this world via a storm, too.
We've got a storm theme going, so Tempesta makes sense! It'll be our lucky name!
It's got a nice ring to it.
Since we've got a name, shouldn't have a flag to fly as well?
Of course!
And we're gonna be world-famous as the crew that finally found the Fountain of Youth!
It's the best debut achievement you can ask for!
I'm glad to see you're having fun with this~
So, let's do as the Commander suggested and get ready for battle, then Whydah will fire the flare and hopefully get Galley's attention~
If any beasties appear, it's you ladies' job to deal with them~
Roger dodger!
Tempesta, weigh anchor!
Thalassopolis - Barren beach
Mmm... Yummy...
Roast meat on a skewer...
Wait, roast meat?
The aspiring great pirate I "know" so well opens her eyes. Almost instinctually, her eyes fixate on the barbacoa placed next to her.
Then, she looks at me...
That uniform...
You're... an officer from the Admiralty?!
What's the navy doing here?!
And where'd ya get this barbacoa? Don't lie and say YOU made it!
I don't trust you one bit! En garde!
This is the last way I expected her to react!
Nice try, Admiralty lapdog!
(Oh boy... She refuses to listen.)
(No two ways about it. I need to knock some sense into her first.)
(Phew. It's over.)
(I managed to beat her, if only barely.)
How'd this happen?!
I can't believe I actually lost...
She gets bummed out over her defeat.
I do my best to console and calm her down...
So you already know who I am...
What's more, you aren't with the Admiralty, AND you supposedly came from another world?
And it was because of some golden compass? Hmm... Never heard a second thing about that...
But whatever, I'll believe you!
Nobody who makes barbacoa this tasty would ever lie to me like that♪
You said you ended up here after sailing through a storm, right? That sounds like something out of a pirate legend.
It also sounds like something I wanna do someday. Sail through the mist of night, arrive in another world, and then dig into a great feast~
Those kinds of tales were all the rage in Thalassopolis long ago. Nowadays, everyone only cares about venturing out to the New World.
Yeah. It's a landmass that was discovered this last century! Just sail to the end of the world and you'll get there.
It's way larger than the island cluster that is Thalassopolis, because it's a whole continent!
Uh, right where we're standing? Some people call it the Old World.
It's an island cluster, if you didn't know. There are theories that this place used to be one big continent, but nobody's found proof of that yet.
While it's rich in resources, there is hardly anything left to discover.
Unlike the New World, which is a whole continent ripe for adventure!
And it calls for me! I want to go to the New World!
I've already got a clipper, which will get me there in just about a month!
...Speaking of my ship, where is she?

options.content: (Gesture towards the planks in the water.)

scripts.say: What? Are ya saying you made it out of the storm thanks to my ship?
Well, you're welcome...
Oh, who am I kidding!
My poor ship! All that's left of her is a few planks!
I just built her, too! Her maiden voyage wasn't even that long ago!

options.content: There, there. It's not the end of the world.

scripts.say: I know, I know... No use crying over spilt milk.
I'm not giving up on my great adventure so easily. I still need to go to the New World.
To do that, I'm going to need a new ship.
Once I have one, you're coming with me!
Don't you worry – the strings of fate tie us together, so I won't mistreat you!
And if we find a heap of treasure, we'll upgrade to a warship made of gold!
With shared ownership, of course. Fifty-fifty.
Then, after that...
Royal Fortune continues rambling on for a long time.
A long, long, long time...
The calm sea begins bursting with activity as soon as the signal flare goes off.
One by one, wreckages infested with tentacles rise to the surface and set their sights on our vessel.
But, Mary Celeste puts a swift stop to them using what one could only call her "rigging."
What the heck is that?
Argo. She's my companion and rigging.
Oookay then...
That's gotta be the biggest deep-sea creature I've ever seen.
You shoulda told us earlier you had this ace up your sleeve!
Ahahah! I was worried you wouldn't accept her.
So what do the rest of us do now? Sit back and watch while you do the fighting?
What a world we live in...
No, we cannot be complacent. These beasts are no ordinary haunted ships.
See how they've recovered from the damage Mary inflicted?
I can see it, too.
Wherever Argo leaves a cut, they fill the gap and heal back up.
Why, it's almost as if these ships are alive~
More like, aquatic life has made its home inside the ships.
Oh! Like how a hermit crab does?
Probably! Crabs don't usually have razor-sharp tentacles, though.
At any rate, it'll never end if they keep healing like this! We need to find a way to stop or slow down their regeneration!
I know one thing that works on all living things – fire! I'll blast 'em till my cannons glow red!
F-fire? You're gonna fight them with fire?
I'll, uh, stand back a little...
"A little"? You just went to the opposite end of the ship!
I believe Mary may have a fear of fire.
Really? Is that true?
N-no! It's not a phobia or anything like that!
It's for practical reasons! I'm a ghost ship, remember?
I need to stay out of the light to go invisible!
Heheh. Fair enough.
Do you girls think the flesh of these monsters is edible? I sure hope so.
Ooh, I've got an idea! Let's make barbacoa after the fighting's over!
Mary, you're gonna love the– Huh? Where'd Mary go?
She likely vanished again. Never mind her – focus on wiping out these creatures.
Okay! Let's turn these bastards to calamari!
Fire! Fireee!
KABOOOM!
Before Royal Fortune's guns could hit their target, a barrage flew in from the opposite direction and struck the monster.
Columns of water shoot up, briefly obscuring the half-destroyed wreckage. The creature that calls it home has been nicely grilled.
You smell that? It's already crisp and ready to eat!
But how? Who else fired besides me?
Look! It was Adventure Galley! She's coming towards us!
There ya are, Whydah! Why's she coming after us?
Y-you think I'd know?
While Royal Fortune pulls a puzzled expression, a roar rings out from somewhere in the sea.
A purple shadow jumps out of the water, leaving a great spray of brine in her wake.
Her eyes, filled with bitterness, glare at us. Adventure Galley has sighted us.
Those claws, and that vibrant purple hair...
That's it! It's Adventure Galley! She's just how I imagined her!
Galley's gaze slowly moves towards Royal Fortune, the one who called her name.
Hmm?
So it's you lot that ruined my slumber.
Heehee... Hahahahahah!
Having identified the person behind all the noise, Galley's expression warps into something grim.
Uh-oh! UH-OH!
She is FUMING! I think we angered her by waking her up!
Uhh...
Galley lets out a furious roar from having her peaceful sleep disturbed.
THIS IS MY DOMAIN!
YOU WILL PAY DEARLY FOR YOUR RACKET!
Brandishing her great steel claws, she starts charging straight towards the Great Royal Fortune.
...I, São Martinho, shall be your opponent.
You...
Hahahahah! I know you! You're the Invincible Crown!
Perfect! Absolutely perfect!
I couldn't ask for a more worthy opponent!
Surprisingly, Adventure Galley does not commit to a fierce attack, despite her indignant posturing with her claws.
Her and São Martinho's engagement is half exchanges of blows, half angry stare-downs. This seems to have an effect on Shipbreak Point, turning the mood grimmer and grimmer.
The sea life, meanwhile, retreats beneath the surface, leaving the shipgirls to their duel.
After testing each other several times, both sides simultaneously prepare their finishing attacks.
...You are defeated.
São Martinho points the tip of her lance right before Galley's eyes.
Okay, that's enough fighting!
We have a winner! Let's be cordial about this!
...You beat me. You've proven your strength.
I'll let you off the hook for disturbing my slumber.
However, I will not be coming along on your little adventure.
Huh? Why not?
Don't ya wanna find the Fountain of Youth?
The Fountain of Youth? Ah. I know that one well.
A lost ancient artifact, coveted by many an ambitious person.
No. I've learned the cost of such pursuits.
But Galley, we're on this adventure for the sake of the future~
The Echo Fleet has come back, you see...
If they reach the Fountain of Youth before us, who knows what disaster might befall the world?
The Echo Fleet is back? That's news to me.
Even if what you're saying is right, can any of you even prove it?
Perhaps Whydah can. Bring her here and I'll hear her out.
If you can get her to lift a finger for something, I'll believe this is no laughing matter.
Ahahahah!
What?
I'm right here! You think I'm a shut-in or something?
You? Outside? I can't believe it!
Also, what is a "shut-in"?
It's like... someone who stays inside their cabin or base and doesn't like to touch grass...
As I said, I'm no shut-in! I like touching grass and feeling sunlight on my body!
Anyway, we're getting sidetracked... Just be quiet and I'll explain everything.
...And there you have it. Whew, that was a pain...
Now I see the whole picture.
Great, so are you gonna help us?
If Whydah needs help, then help I will give.
She aided me once, so I will return the favour.
Not like I did anything to write home about, but okay...
Oh, right. Let me introduce you... This is the Commander.
The brains of our crew, and a gifted tactician.

options.content: I hope we can get along.

scripts.say: Heh... Get along. Sure.
So, could you show us to the Fountain of Youth?
Yes. Right now, if you so need.
However, the path to it isn't a physical place, but rather an idea.
A portal, if you will. Whenever it manifests in our world, it generally assumes the form of a storm.
In other words, to reach the Fountain of Youth, find the storm that leads to it.
Of course, that's easier said than done. There are legends of an artifact that can bring the storm to you, but...
Hey, doesn't that sound familiar, Commander? Isn't it how you wound up here?
Bingo! I'm sure if we sail into a storm with that thing out, it'll...
...What's it doing? Why's it glowing all of a sudden?
Something's happening! Look out!
Without warning, the dark clouds begin to swirl around Shipwreck Point, and a portal-like hole appears at the heart of it.
While everyone is distracted by the foreboding change of weather, an unwelcome sight emerges from the portal.
(A Siren... Tester is here?!)
Heehee! Perfect!
You saved me the effort of looking for you.
Who the hell are you?!
You want my name, do you? Sure, I'll extend you that little courtesy.
I am Tester, the one who'll bring the world to its end! Remember this name!
I'll be taking your dear Commander now!
A colossal wave surged forth from the portal, all but swallowing the Great Royal Fortune whole.
A bumpy and nauseating journey is upon us...
Mirror Sea - Heart of the Fountain of Youth
Once I regain my footing from that stomach-churning spin, it dawns on me that we're no longer in Shipwreck Point.
The sea is still, the Great Royal Fortune resting in it. Aboard her, our adversary stares us down.

options.content: That was the roughest greeting I've gotten in a while...

scripts.say: How rude. In this sea, a storm's beckoning is the greatest invitation.
This vessel of mine activated at the wrong time, but I've always believed this was it setting me up to do the right thing.
Now that I've found you, I'm fully convinced of it.
Hah! Who would've thought the Black Wolves' flag and a stupid myth would lead you right to me?
That's the providence of fate for you! Ahahahahah!
It was you. You created the Black Wolves, didn't you?
How astute of you. I did.
That bunch of overly curious adventurers served me well.
If they hadn't hoarded all those artifacts from the past, this vessel separated from her mainframe may never have known about her important duty.
And now, I have you. The final piece.
You're the key to obtaining the wisdom fate has in store for me.
The wisdom that'll elevate me to the status of Creator – to the status of God over this world.
(This vessel has lost connection to her mainframe... That means she's operating without any external reference points or regulators.)
(She must've soaked up this world's culture like a sponge. It would explain her uncharacteristic way of speaking.)
(I might be able to take advantage of that...)

options.content: I'm going to stop your insane plan.

scripts.say: With what? That pathetic fleet of yours?
There is nothing they can do to harm me.
Tester scoffs and reaches for the activation lever of the Pawn creator next to her.
Outta my way!
KABOOOM!
Mary – who was also transported here – fires her cannons as she charges towards us.
Aha. Now I get why you sent the Echo Fleet after Mary.
She can pass through storms just fine, so she must be a real obstacle to your plan.
She is. It would've been annoying to deal with that ability of hers.
But not anymore. It doesn't matter now.
Nor does it matter how much you struggle, for it's all in vain.
All will perish once I complete the instruction nested in the deepest parts of me.
Listen carefully. Do you hear it? The grinding of misaligned gears.
That's the sound of war... The sound of the experiments commencing anew!
...What are you laughing for?
Considering you've completely lost your memory, you're not doing half-bad.
Trying to play cool, are you? Be a dear and hold still while I wipe that smug grin off your face, "Commander."

options.content: It's too bad your formation has a glaring flaw.

scripts.say: ...What are you talking about?
ALERT. PRIMARY LINE OF DEFENSE HAS BEEN BREACHED.
WHAT?!
Fifteen minutes prior - Outside the Fountain of Youth
After passing through the storm, the rest of the girls found themselves in the waters surrounding the Fountain of Youth.
An endless cyclone blew before them, and they were surrounded by black, mechanical trees reaching for the clouds. They gave off an unsettling aura.
This is it.
So... that black cyclone is the Fountain of Youth?
Looks bloody dangerous for a fountain...
The Echo Fleet is here, too. Are they the supposed Black Wolves?
The ships all fly their banner.
So, if you put two and two together...
The suddenly revived Black Wolves were just a part of the Echo Fleet.
Or, the Black Wolves were always the Echo Fleet in disguise...
The Fountain of Youth is also not a wellspring, but an ancient ruin.
However, I think it's more apt to call it the Echo Fleet's home base~
Hang on! Wasn't it the Black Wolves who spread the rumours about the Fountain?
So that was an outright lie! What they really wanted was to lure unsuspecting people like us into gathering artifacts for them...
It's the worst possible ending! I have no words for my disappointment!
You should've curbed your expectations to begin with.
Now, come on. We need to find Mary and the Commander and get out of here.
Okay, but how?
There's not enough ammunition between us to take out all the Echo Fleet ships.
If we can't beat 'em, let's just charge right through!
What, just like that?
They're packed together like sardines, so if we rush in at full speed and disrupt their firing lines, we can break through.
...That's what the Commander told me. I'm basically second in command.
Hmm... It could work.
Just not with so few of us.
São Martinho raised her lance skywards, and after a moment, her galleon manifests from thin air in the water.
Hey... isn't that your ship?
It is. It took a while to get her to catch up. Luckily, she made it in time.
I hope I'm not the only one who brought her vessel?
Let's just say I run a small business~
As Golden Hind finished speaking, a fleet consisting of mass-produced vessels emerged from the mist on the horizon.
Whydah, why don't you show your hand already?
I highly doubt an esteemed New World pirate would venture out without a fleet at the ready~
Heheh. So you noticed...
Okay, I'm tired of playing pretend... Truth be told, my fleet is already here.
On Whydah's command, her ships rose from the sea once after the next, banners raised.
In but the blink of an eye, a great fleet had assembled. Though the Echo Fleet outnumbered them, the girls' fleet had superior deployment.
Huh?
W-well, I'll constitute a fleet by myself if I have to!
You don't NEED to get involved.
Hey, now, I did bring backup! Behold! The best ships money can buy... Ahaha...
Royal Fortune gestured towards a pathetic group of mass-produced ships. Behind her forced smile, she was on the verge of tears.
It's okay. Instead, you can be our commanding officer.
Show us what wisdom the Commander imparted to you.
Not long after the fighting broke out, all of Tester's confidence evaporated away.
Having been cut off from her mainframe for so long, she lacks even the most basic tactical knowledge even if her hardware is impressive.
ALERT. DAMAGE INCURRED DUE TO DROP INACCURACY.
Dammit...
1st and 3rd defense units, spread out left and right!
2nd unit, don't crumble yet!
EXECUTING... ERROR. CANNOT EXECUTE. RISK OF COLLISSION DUE TO UNIT PROXIMITY TOO HIGH.
ALERT. SERIOUS DAMAGE SUSTAINED.
Not only are her warships with big cannons rubbing shoulders, but her many bombing ships are, too.
This shortsighted positioning backfires – friendly fire sets off a series of explosions, and a good part of her forces are wiped out in an instant.
No! Nooo! My fleet!
What did you do?!
Spit it out, "Commander"! What did you DO to my fleet?!
ALERT. FINAL LINE OF DEFENSE HAS BEEN BREACHED.
Hey, you! The scallywag on the big ship!
Lay down your arms and surrender!
If you don't, we'll blast you to kingdom come!
Hah! You wish, you little brat!
Stay there so I can end you!
Tester leaps off the side of her ship, summons her rigging, and goes into battle...
Leaving behind the device she used to monitor the battlefield right where she sat.
The booming of cannon fire is drawing closer as the shipgirls tighten the noose around Tester.
At the center of the encirclement, Mary Celeste is running circles around the Siren, vanishing and reappearing nonstop.
Damned little rat, darting from place to place!
How are the scanners I've collected unable to track you?!
Your little gadgets can't offset a skill I've practiced for many years.
We've arrived, Mary... Hmm? Is she the Black Wolves' leader?
Sure is. The person behind their lies, and the master of the Echo Fleet.
Then we've found the perpetrator of the attacks on Thalassopolis.
Now has come the time for repentance.
You... The Invincible Crown...
Seeing the approaching shipgirls, Tester's eyes become filled with agitation and fear.
The crew is all here.
Now it's our turn to go on the offensive.
Time to start coming up with a plea for your life, Tester!
While Mary Celeste and São Martinho engage Tester in battle, the rest of the girls board the ship she's keeping me on.
Royal Fortune sees that I'm okay, and immediately runs over to hug me.

options.content: Okay, okay... Give me some breathing space.

scripts.say: Oh! Sorry, sorry!
I was just so glad I couldn't help myself! Thank god you're alright!
And to think you were so down just a minute ago~
Shut up! I'm Tempesta's leader. We'd be screwed if I lost my cool.
Whoa...
Um... Thank you...
Alright, that's enough of a heartfelt reunion. Let's go back up Mary and São.
Assuming they haven't already won, anyway...
Surrender. You have nowhere left to flee.
Heheh... Hahahaha!
If this is how it ends, I'm taking you with me!
What's she doing?
...Trying to summon a storm. A really, really big one!
Then we must stop her!
She must be getting a great amount of power from somewhere...
It's gotta be the Fountain of Youth!
That big machine tower is the source!
Let's just destroy that, then!
How? It's humongous!
Think, think... Oh, I know! Whydah, can you use your grimoire to summon more meteors?
Uhh, let me ask!
Terminal, you still with me?
Affirmative, Whydah the Magnificent.
Do not worry. I will support you as best as I can.
Enabling autonomous targeting mode. Target acquired. Red Oak M2 selected... Retrieving armory status.
Transporter erector launchers available... 0. Underwater launch platforms available... 0.
Missile silos available... 1. High-explosive warhead. Ready to fire. Awaiting final confirmation.
Firing command received.
It... actually worked!
What is that...?
No! This can't be! That treasure belongs to ME!
Now! Keep up the pressure!
Tester tries her best to protect herself against the attacks while the "meteors" break through the storm and impact the Fountain of Youth.
Then, just like that, the storm dissipates.
With her power source annihilated, Tester squirms a final few times before she sinks beneath the waves.
Is it over?
Yes. It's over.
Looks like it is.
Yeah! Get in there! We're having a victory banquet tonight!
Galley, can we host it at Shipwreck Point? We haven't tried the seafood we left there!
Seafood? You mean the creature inside that ship?
You know what? Knock yourselves out...
And so, our adventure reaches its conclusion.
But our story, that has only just begun...
New World - Shipwreck Point - Evening
The feast to celebrate our victory has ended, and stillness has returned to the sea.
A storm – the gateway between worlds – is approaching. It's almost time for me to say goodbye.
Whaddya think? I'd say my barbacoa is just as good as yours!
This meat is one of a kind, too. Throw these tentacles on the grill, and you've got yourself a chewy treat.

options.content: It's no wonder, since they could withstand cannonballs.

scripts.say: Oh, yeah, true!
Yeah... Makes sense...
...Are you really leaving?
Mary spent way too long looking for the storm Singularity for me to go, "Actually, forget about it" now.
Aww. I see...
Hey, it's better to leave on a high note than to drag your feet, right?
Here. This is for you.
Really? Shouldn't you hold on to it?
I'm sure it'll serve you well one day.
Now, I think it's time I be on my way.
Okay. May the winds of fortune carry your sails.
I'll never forget about you, Commander!
I'll write you, I promise!
We'll meet again sometime!
Royal Fortune's voice grows more and more distant as my ship sails into the storm.
My heart feels heavy to part ways like this...
But then I think to myself, "We WILL meet again," and the weight lessens a little.
With the compass now in her hands, a bridge has been forged between the past and the present.
All that remains is to take the first step towards an unknown future.
The End...?
Somewhere in Thalassopolis...
The news about the Echo Fleet has already spread far and wide. In light of the situation, I suspect the cities will create a new union.
The darkness we never knew surrounded us has become apparent. The people must adapt and make changes.
Unfortunately, they already struggle to cope with the recent surge in natural disasters.
I do not believe this is a coincidence, but an orchestrated effort by some nefarious party.
Could be. For all we know, that Tester woman may only have been one of many unknowns in the world.
I'm sure the people of Thalasso will find a way through the darkness.
Alas, that sort of life is not for me.
So you say, and yet, here you are right now.
You've changed. How come?
Well... Back in my swashbuckling days, I was told a prophecy.
That one day, I would be visited by a strange bunch, and their leader would reveal the truth about the world.
And then, I would find a place to call home.
What does that mean?
A port? A house? Spiritual fulfilment? Could be anything.
I used to dismiss it as dumb rubbish, but now I've started believing in it.
We need the Commander's strength.
So I decided to join Tempesta and work with Royal Fortune as a Star Wayfinder, exploring storms.
Ah, that project to find other branches using storms?
I've heard Royal Fortune has succeeded a couple of times.
I've also heard that it's extremely dangerous on the other side of the storm.
No venture is without perils. The New World had them, too. She knows the risks.
But, we are explorers in a vast sea, and must always carry the spirit of curiosity in our hearts.
Indeed.
When the time comes, we'll be ready...
The End
I follow Royal Fortune, and the two of us arrive at a high place with a great view over the surrounding area.
Hey, see that clipper?
No, not by the dock. The one over there!
She points her finger towards a ship anchored behind a building.
It looks like a corvette, with quite powerful armaments.
(Why would the captain anchor her in such an out-of-sight place?)
That'll do! She'll be our new ship!
I'll betcha the owner won't even care if we commandeer her for ourselves! Heheh!
I've already got a new name for her. It's going to be... the Royal Fortune!

options.content: Okay... So how do we do this?

scripts.say: All we have to do is sneak aboard, grab the steering wheel, and sail out like it's nobody's business. Easy.
Sail out? Just the two of us?
Yeah. Unless you were planning on bringing friends.
I can even do it myself if you're not up to the task.
...Oh, I get it. You think that's a pre-Naval Code vessel, don'tcha?
As long as you have a core, you can operate these new warships with just one crew member.
Hell, you don't even need to keep your hands on the actual steering wheel.
Huh? Techno-what?
I'll just assume that's what you call warships in your world.
Autumn-nation...?
You mean automatons? Like those tin men in children's stories?
What I'M talking about are warships built according to the Naval Code that was discovered.
See, long ago–
DIIING! DOOONG!
The clangs of a big bell suddenly echo through the air.
The sounds are accompanied by the quieter but quicker rings of a smaller bell.
They've sounded the city centre bell?
Is someone attacking this city? That can't be right... Nobody's bold enough for that.
Lend me your telescope! I need to see what flag the church has hoisted!
Found it! That one means... What?! The Echo Fleet is attacking!
The Echo Fleet? What's that?
A mechanical fleet that roams the seas. It attacks any ship along its course, yet it never plunders anything.
Scholars say it's a remnant from ancient times, but not even they know where it actually came from.
(That sounds awfully familiar...)

options.content: Do you know what the Sirens are?

scripts.say: Sirens? Those monster-women of the sea, right?
...No? That's not what you mean?
Look, let's save the sailor stories for later!
Right now, we've got to seize that warship!
Come on! I know a secret way around!
Gently, the clipper emerges from the shadow of the dock and sails out to the side of the port.
I look at the fire rising from the city, and my heart begins to wave just like the flames.
It looks like the attackers caught the defense fleet completely off guard.
That's not surprising. The Echo Fleet has never raided a city directly before.
I doubt the navy is going to hold up much longer before they're crushed.
What to do... We could try to help, but how?
Come on, quick! Help me come up with a plan!
Aren't you a pirate? What do you stand to gain from helping them?
There's no rule against pirates helping others! This is a special case!
What's the alternative? Leave everyone to die? Hell no!
I have friends in the city! Friends who turn to the church for their bread!
...What are ya smiling at? It's not funny!
No, you're right.
I know how to organize an offensive. We'll charge straight into the middle of their formation.
If they don't have a command unit, that's the most effective way to defeat Sirens... I mean, the Echo Fleet.
Charge in? We can't do that with only ONE ship!
Ugh! Fine!
Full speed ahead! Whatever happens, happens!
The clipper breaches the Sirens' formation with unbelievable speed and gets out just as quickly.
Standing on the ship's quarterdeck, a breeze brushes my face while explosions go off behind me.
Some of the fire and the flames come from the impromptly christened Royal Fortune's cannons...
Most of it, however, is Siren-on-Siren friendly fire.
Whoa! I can't believe that worked! We're going toe-to-toe with a whole fleet!
...Wait, this is bad! They've started spreading out from our port and starboard!
We'll be right in their firing lines once they've created some distance, then we'll be at a crushing disadvantage!
KABOOOM!
They hit our port side! We need damage control or something!
No need to freak out. It's almost time.
Time? For what?
For the cavalry to arrive.
Right on cue, a whistle rings out in the distance.
Goddess, give these brave warriors your blessings!
Hoist sails! Follow the flagship!
The Thalasso defense fleet sails forth, after many minutes of readying its vessels under Siren fire.
The victor has already been determined.
The battle has concluded.
While Thalasso's forces clean up the battlefield in the background, a surprise guest comes aboard the Royal Fortune.
(She's a Tempesta, just like Royal Fortune – but this one's cut from a very different cloth.)
Sensing my gaze, the guest bows forward slightly and lifts the rim of her dress.
Greetings~
Oh, my little ones can be rather slimy, but pay them no mind~
Holy smokes...
Aren't you...?
Do you know her?
Who doesn't? She's like, world-famous! Both here and in the New World!
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Golden Hind.
Now, which of you is the captain of this fine ship?
Couldn't be me! THIS person's the captain!
Me? Uh...
Ahem. Well met, Golden Hind. I assume it was you who commanded the city's defense fleet?
Heehee, yes. Though, I'm afraid I'm quite a novice.
You, on the other hand, fought expertly, my darling Commander.
I've never seen anyone take on the Echo Fleet with the brilliance you displayed. Oh, and is "Commander" too formal?
What should I call you?
Then "Commander" it is, my darling.
Excuse me...?
Oh, you quick-witted joker, you. Heehee~ My fondness of you only grows.
As for me, just call me Golden Hind.
Let's find a place to sit before we continue. Follow me~
Fifteen minutes later, in the city's church...
Well, well... Pretty nice place you picked.
It's the quietest place you can find at the moment~
The walls outside have ears, and I want to speak in private.
That's not exactly what caught my attention.
What I meant is, it's my first time here, and...
You're worried the Goddess won't welcome you, is that it?
The avatar of storms and the sea, as well as the virtuous symbol of Thalasso's faith.
She protects those who make their livings at sea, so all churches across Thalasso need shrines to give her offerings.
Like I said, though, she's virtuous. Us pirates aren't much for virtue, so...
You don't have to worry about that.
Our beneficent goddess welcomes and protects all who believe in the sky and sea equally. Even you.
You're saying she'll send good winds my way if I pray to her?
What happens if everyone prays for winds in opposite directions, then?
You can't have a tailwind AND a headwind at the same time.
Who knows what happens? I've never thought about it. I'd assume the strongest prayer wins out.
That is a good question, though. It's true – you think of things most others wouldn't, Royal Fortune.
You've heard about me before?
Yes. You're more famous than you think. They call you the rising star, finding her own way to the New World.
Oh, is that nervousness on your face? Don't be. I'm but a humble businesswoman.
Besides, I don't think there is any conflict between our respective "businesses"~
Here, have my business card~
Indeed. I'm the director~
I've also got a company sign, approved by the Thalasso government. Alas, I have no place to hang it~
Now, the reason why I brought you here... Would you be interested in an investment from me?
I'm offering a full commission fee, upfront, plus a top-grade loan with zero interest. How does that sound~?
Commission fee? Ya wanna hire us?
Sounds like a lot of money... Too sweet a deal to be anything straightforward.
What do you actually want us to do?
You see, there's a reason why the Echo Fleet launched an attack on the city~
Have you heard about the Fountain of Youth, perchance?
One hour later...
After hearing Golden Hind's briefing, we returned to our clipper – the now-officially rechristened Great Royal Fortune.
So, basically, the city found a treasure map that proves the existence of the Fountain of Youth while searching shipwrecks around Thalasso.
The map belonged to a group called the Black Wolves, a gang of treasure hunters searching for the loot that was lost in the Great Collapse.

options.content: "Great Collapse"? And what was that about loot?

scripts.say: Some people call 'em "last world relics."
They're supposedly artifacts that spread all over the world when the civilisation that made them, the Ancients, fell during the Great Collapse.
The Black Wolves bring in the artifacts to scholars, who need 'em to study the past.
They've not gotten far with that, though. Their history is so short that even I can recite it in full.
Yup. They look for the treasure that was scattered across the globe when a civilisation called the Ancients went under.
Between all the discoveries our modern civilisation has made about the Ancients, the Black Wolves had a hand in most of them.
A lot of adventurers say they're just a myth, though, because treasure-hunting is an extremely risky venture.
The thing about the Black Wolves is that they've all been "dead" for decades, so how are they back all of a sudden?
I dunno about you, but I don't buy the idea that this secret club just decided to come back to life one day.
Furthermore, why would the Echo Fleet be gunning for the Black Wolves' treasures?
They even broke their own rules and attacked a city. It doesn't make any sense.
Like, what would they want with the Fountain of Youth? They're made of steel. Steel doesn't age like a living being...
Royal Fortune's ship of thought has sailed into rough, unknown waters.
(So many questions, and so little information to speculate on...)
(I think this calls for a change of subject.)

options.content: What can you tell me about the Echo Fleet?
What do you think about the Great Royal Fortune?

scripts.say: Hm? Oh, they've got firepower in spades, but they can't coordinate a single thing.
Probably because they don't have even a half-decent commander at the helm.
Their ships are strong on paper, sure, but ours isn't very far behind.
You mean the clipper and not me, right?
Good question. If it's an evaluation you're asking for...
She strikes the perfect balance between firepower, speed, and protection.
I still can't believe she's actually ours now.
I've no idea how Golden Hind convinced the prior owner to relinquish her. Though, her rep as a renowned New World pir– Err, businesswoman, surely helped.

options.content: Don't you prefer your own ship over her?

scripts.say: No! I like all good ships equally!
Well, except ghost ships. They hold a special place in my heart.
If I get to captain a legendary ghost ship one day, I can die without regrets~

options.content: The "ghost" part doesn't put you off?
So you're not afraid of the curses associated with them?

scripts.say: The opposite, in fact! Ghost ships are just one of the many maritime legends.
I won't become a great explorer if spooky stuff gets under my skin!
Curses? Please, those are just sailor stories.
When you're as sweet, strong, and lucky as me, ghost ships aren't anything to be afraid of!
In fact, a legendary ship like that is only fitting for a legendary pirate, wouldn't you say?
All that said, I'm still happy with the ship we have now.
That's what matters at the end of the day~
You are like a monk without a want in the world, compared to me and my collection fervor.
And that's why you were the perfect choice~
Choice? For what?
Nothing, nothing. Just thinking aloud~
Even though this ship was produced years ago, she remains the best vessel for sailing on the new lanes.
Sadly, all the cities capable of producing ships like her have gone into decline. Be careful with her, okay?
Because she's not just a regular ship – she's near and dear to me.
Wait... Are ya suggesting she belonged to YOU?
Her, and every other vessel docked in this harbour, yes.
Sooo... We almost stole from you...
It's okay. Might makes right in this world.
I couldn't have produced the amazing results you did if I'd been at the helm~
Really, you two are most suited to be her owners.
I've found something of greater value than this ship anyway~♡
Wow... Cheers! I didn't know you were so generous.
You're welcome~ Be sure to stock up on supplies before your grand cruise~
R-right, I'll go check on that! You watch the deck, Commander!
With a remarkable urgency in her gait, Royal Fortune leaves the scene.
Now she has started calling me "Commander" as well.
How fascinating~
You two display a level of trust I envy, despite having just met each other.
Oh, my darling Commander, did I tell you about the legend circulating in Thalasso's churches?
You didn't. What is it?
The story of an adventurer beating impossible odds.
They say a ship was sailing for the New World, when it stumbled into a place called Windless Sea.
It's exactly what it sounds like – a death trap for ships that rely on their sails.
Nobody can explain why the wind doesn't blow there. It defies the laws of nature... and all you can do is pray you avoid it.
The adventurer, now stuck and unable to get out on their own, prayed to the Goddess for the wind to blow, but nothing happened.
But, just as all hope seemed lost, a miraculous storm appeared out of nowhere.
This storm pushed the adventurer's vessel to the shores of the New World, where they found a map to navigate around the Windless Sea.
With a safe path to the New World discovered, people hailed this event as the will of the Goddess.
But the story doesn't end there. Do you know what happened yesterday?
Just like in the story, a miraculous storm suddenly whipped up.
Thank you for listening.
On the open ocean, the waves and the storms carry the Goddess' blessings.
May the winds of fortune carry your sails, my darling Commander.
Golden Hind turns around and gazes out at the harbor.
Off in the distance, Royal Fortune sings a cheerful tune.
Hoist all sails and anchor aweigh♪
The Goddess smiles, for we sail today♪
It wasn't long after our adventure on Seabreeze Island before I found myself in this other world.
It started when Royal Fortune gave me a treasure map to follow, leading us to the resource-rich yet uninhabited isle.
We built a resort there, explored old ruins, and found treasure in the form of crystals and ores at the end.
Then, Royal Fortune appeared again and gave me a golden compass, saying it was the real treasure...
This compass is the real treasure. You get it for overcoming the trial of the ruins.
Heheh, though I'm the one who handled the trial!
Either way, it'll help you out someday. Keep it safe!
Anyway, we'll be right behind you before long~
Oi! Earth to Commander!
Whatcha doing?
No? Well, not really.
I just thought I should check on you.
Ya think I can't handle this ship by myself?
If anything, YOU look like you need some help.
Do I really look that bothered?
More like you have something on your mind. My legendary pirate sense tells me so.
You thinking about the fabled Treasure Coast? Or anxious about the cursed Black Reef?
C'mon, share it with the class♪

options.content: If you really want to know...

scripts.say: ...You feel like we set off too soon? I mean, it's what Golden Hind asked us to do.
She doesn't want to draw attention, so we have to sail alone... which, I'll admit, makes this a pretty tiny expedition team.
But, I already collected our fee, and we're in no position to question her decisions.
I'm glad just to be sailing the sea, feeling the breeze in my hair.
Let's also not forget that if this gamble pays off, we might become aristocrats! There's a chance we can win big!
There are no winners or losers in gambling, only likely and unlikely outcomes.
Furthermore, Lady Luck is a fickle mistress. You should know that better than me.
Touché...
Why are you looking at me like that? It's not like I'm such a poor gambler I need church handouts!
Look, I'll take your words to heart!
You're right – we are underprepared. I'll go talk to Golden Hind about it.
You called?
Sorry for butting in, but it seems we have a bit of a problem.
See the ship over yonder?
That? Isn't it just a sloop?
Oh, you mean the OTHER direction!
That's a large galleon! Armed, too!
Are they naval staff from another city?
...Don't look at me! I have no clue who they are!
Oh dear... You don't know who São Martinho is.
She commands the strongest fleet. There isn't a soul from Crownpolis to the New World who hasn't heard of her.
That name rings a vague bell, actually...
Oh, right! She's the one they call the Invincible Crown!

options.content: Why do they call her that?

scripts.say: Because her fleet is unstoppable – invincible!
There's no hope of beating her without an intervention by Mother Nature.
Why does she have her sights on us?! Golden Hind! I thought ya were a reputable businesswoman!
Well... Business wars can get heated~
In these trying times, I suppose the threat of violence is a part of doing business.
This can't be a coincidence, though. They must be trying to find the Fountain of Youth as well.
While the cities in Thalassopolis have non-conflict agreements, they can't do much to stop someone with more guns.
Yeah, yeah, yeah! What matters is, she's come to steal our business from us, hasn't she?
Then she's no different from us pirates!
The naval galleon draws closer while we struggle to figure out a response to the situation.
A woman with angel-like wings leaps up from the ship's side and lands on the water between our ship and the other vessel.
Hail, ship to our front. Halt and submit to an inspection.
Your ship matches the description of a wanted vessel.
Your understanding and cooperation are appreciated.
Ya think I'm stupid? You'll just come and nick everything that's not nailed down!
Hoist sails! Let's show this navy git some pain!
The Great Royal Fortune sails as quickly as she can, fighting the headwind.
But it's not enough – São Martinho is still hot on our tail.
I didn't think she could go this fast!
She's gonna catch up with us eventually at this rate!
Turn portside! We've got to catch the tailwind!
Portside? But that's in uncharted waters! We might end up in the Windless Sea!
It's our only choice! I don't know for sure which city in Thalasso sent her after us, but I have a hunch!
Come on, do it! We need to escape her, no matter the cost!
So we're screwed either way!
Fine, whatever! Commander, grab on to something!
And so, the Great Royal Fortune changes to an unsafe course.
Despite the danger to both parties, the chase continues...

sequence: Mar del Demonios - ???
Aboard the Vengeful Queen

scripts.say: "Go past Mar del Demonios, and let the stars guide you."
Then, we should be...
Oh! Look! Land! There really are isles off in the distance!
Looks like the treasure map was the real deal after all!
Heheh. I knew it. This treasure map wasn't going to lead us wrong.
Everything's going just as I expected.
You say that, but you don't know where you got that map.
You don't even remember when it got into your chest...
Oh, shut it. I've got a bloody billion chests. It'd be impossible to keep track of them all.
What matters is that these isles don't appear on any regular maps and that there's no sign of inhabitants.
In other words, we're the first people to discover them.
You're forgetting about whoever made the map to begin with.
And that's not even mentioning the old ruins on the isles. Someone left those there.
You said it yourself – old ruins. Whoever made them became worm food ages ago. Same with the map.
That means WE discovered these isles. So, first order of business is to name and lay claim to them.
Then, ladies, we dig for treasure among the ruins. Heehee...
I was the first one who saw them, so I want to name them the Royal James Is–
No.
I was just kidding! Heheh! Seriously, though, since we all aboard the Vengeful Queen found it, how about naming them the Vengeful Queen Isles?
Or maybe "the Treasure Isles"? The map does claim that there are loads of buried treasure there, after all.
No to both of those. I've already got a name.
As captain of the Vengeful Queen, and based on the isles' proximity to Mar del Demonios, I hereby name them...
Islas de Libertád!
While the treasure hunters were sailing at full speed toward their destination, Tempesta was busy at Islas de Libertád...
Darn... I don't sense any super-big treasures on this islet, so it's not this one either!
Dolphin scribbled a contour of the islet and drew a cross over it.
21st is a bust too, then. On to the 22nd!
Let's go!
After taking the evening to rest, they got up the following morning, split into two groups, and went their separate ways on Islas de Libertád.
Golden Hind and Mary Celeste went off to deepen their friendship with the Vengeful Queen's crew, while Royal Fortune and Dolphin set out to investigate all the islets.
With the experience of the Fountain of Youth and the Sleeping Sea under her belt, even Royal Fortune could tell with just a glance how impressive the ruins in this place were.
Even so...
The Commander knows this stuff better than anyone, and Terminal would have a pretty good clue, and we've got neither one with us...
I can't believe we're going on an actual treasure hunt, and we're solely reliant on Dolphin's ability to find anything!
UGGGHHH!
From the 1st to the 20th, and from the 20th to the 40th.
It took the two the whole day, and they just barely managed to finish exploring one-fifth of all the islets before supper.
Let's have a toast! To the captain's and Dolphin's hard work!
Sitting in a tavern the crew of the Vengeful Queen had built, the members of Tempesta enjoyed a lavish meal together.
It was hard work alright! It's been an exhausting day!
Bwuh... My ears and head hurt...
Well, help yourselves to lots of delicious food! Goodness knows you've earned it.
Incidentally, Captain, did you learn anything during your search?
Yeah! That there really is treasure amid these ruins.
There's even some in the mostly destroyed ruins on the small islands. Just imagining what riches are hidden on the larger five islands gives me shivers!
Oh my. They're that valuable, huh? We'll be making a killing in this endeavour, then!
Have you picked out an island to get from Anne yet? I'd love to see it for myself.
Not yet, no.
We checked about a fifth of the islets today. Sure, there is treasure on every one, but Dolphin couldn't sense a bona fide treasure trove on any of them.
That's why we've decided we'll pick one only after we've searched them all!
Yeppers! We're the first crew to arrive here, so we should pick the best one there is!
Urgh... If only not for this dang headache...
Captain, I'll bring Dolphin to her room.
Alright! Get some good rest! We'll try again tomorrow!
Okay. I promise we'll find something amazing!
After having supper, Golden Hind escorted Dolphin to her room. Meanwhile, Royal Fortune and Mary Celeste decided to wander around the main island.
As soon as they got there, they heard a commotion coming from the pier.
See that? Is that a ship entering the harbor?
Oh! Other ships have shown up at last! Let's go have a look-see!
The two reached the harbor, where they saw a ship firmly anchored, as well as Queen Anne's Revenge having an ardent chat with the visitors of the night.
I'm Queen Anne's Revenge, captain of the Vengeful Queen Fleet. Welcome to Islas de Libertád, renowned treasure hunters.
Name's Portsmouth Adventure, and this 'ere's Amity. We got an invitation from ya.
Bloody hell, though, it was a nightmare gettin' 'ere! Just about managed to carve a path through hordes of sea monsters!
Sea monsters? You actually ran into such things?
Sure as hellfire we did! Even brought a couple of wrecks with us as trophies. Have a gander!
Portsmouth Adventure steered her ship and unfolded a net, in which innumerable wreckage skelebeast parts lay.
Whoooa! Honest-to-gosh sea monsters!
I've never seen this variety of them before either!
Let me get this straight – you two fought sea monsters the whole way here?
Not quite. Mostly just for the past half day. It seems they don't chase you once you get within range of this night sky.
These creatures are known as "wreckage skelebeasts." We encountered a lot of them long ago in the Sleeping Sea.
On another note, this island isn't as bustling as I expected. Is that on account of the sea monsters as well?
Probably, sadly.
Ya tellin' me we're the first to arrive?
Second, actually. Tempesta's fleet made it here just before you.
Tempesta?! They're 'ere too, eh? Things're gettin' RIGHT interesting now!
After exchanging a few more words, Queen Anne's Revenge told them that she would gift them an island. The treasure hunters were elated, just as Tempesta were.
Afterward, they went back to their ship and settled on choosing an island the next day once they had rested up.
Royal Fortune and Mary Celeste decided to come forth and also say hello to their friends.
Several months had passed since their adventure into the Sleeping Sea, and they were certainly not expecting to meet the treasure hunters again on these islands.
During their chat, Portsmouth Adventure recounted their adventures with the otherworldly visitors and the port's fleet. Upon hearing this, Royal Fortune seemed to ponder something.
(Otherworldly visitors, eh... Maybe that's how the Commander sees us as well.)
(And that mysterious DOS... She sounds powerful.)
(With the storms getting more frequent, I'm expecting more and more ruins to come to light, and for weird things to keep happening.)
(It's like there's some sort of force that's bringing change to the world. Could it be... them?)
It was Tempesta's fifth day on Islas de Libertád.
A few other decently sized fleets had arrived on the islands, and the crew of the Vengeful Queen Fleet welcomed them with open arms.
Tempesta, however, cared little for the commotion taking place at the harbor.
After spending the last four days searching all the islets, Dolphin had reached a conclusion...
There's not even a single mindblowing treasure on any of the over 200 islets!
The group was disappointed, but settled for the islet with the largest size and most extensive ruins. They picked this islet and named it Tempesta Island.
Following this, they got in touch with Anne's crew and invited them to search through the comparatively large ruins together.
Odds are really good that there's a super-duper cool treasure hidden in the 3rd islet's lighthouse!
Agreed! While these islands are nice, it's also awfully dark and gloomy here. That really brings down the mood!
So, even if we don't find any treasure, we can at least turn on the lighthouse for a morale boost! Let's go!
They arrived at the great lighthouse on the third islet, where they were greeted by a member of Anne's crew whom they hadn't met.
N-nice to meet you! I'm Adventure, a member of the Vengeful Queen Fleet. I'll be leading you through the lighthouse.
Top of the hour to you, Adventure! How come we didn't meet sooner?
Because I've been searching the islands this whole time while setting up a new safe house!
Since I'm done with that now, I've finally got the privilege of adventuring with you all.
Wait, five whole days setting up a safe house?
Didn't you find these islands three months ago? What were you doing that whole time? Surely not cooped up in a shelter or something?
I was! The outside world is a dangerous place!
So... you're afraid of danger, yet you wanted to come along on this adventure into the ruins?
That's right. You can't find new safe houses if you don't venture out!
Staying in one place for too long is also dangerous!
Uh... I guess I see the logic in that.
You need the treasure map to open the lighthouse's defensive walls, so stick close to me!
The group passed through several bulky gates, and then finally arrived at the base of the lighthouse.
I'm still not sure how you plan to climb up this lighthouse. There's no entranceway, and holding up the treasure map does a whole lot of nothing.
Anne said we should look around and see if there's any other way inside.
Ooh! Gotcha.
Let's see here...
Looks to be... over 600 feet tall? And yeah, no entrance on the surface from what I can tell.
No doors, not even any windows. Exterior is smooth as glass, but maybe...
Nope, no way of climbing that!
Dolphin, have you found anything?
Well, I know we're not supposed to destroy the ruins, but listen...
What if you loaded me into a cannon, shot me to the top of the lighthouse, then I dropped a rope for you to climb? Wouldn't that get us inside?
Stone me, that's genius!
I'll go look for a cannon!
Then I'll fetch a rope!
DONG DONG DONG DONG!
What? Bell ringing? Did someone sound an alarm?
Oh no... I knew this would be dangerous!
We can do the lighthouse later! For now, just get back to my safe house!
Don't you think it's odd, though? We're in range of the night sky, so why would there be enemies here?
Unless... A group of skelebeasts are invading.
This is big trouble if so! We've got to hurry!
When Tempesta reached the sea – with Adventure forcibly in tow – they came upon a confrontation between the Vengeful Queen Fleet and another fleet that radiated a vibrant light.
Is that... a Nebula Guardian?
I should've known they'd turn up...
Attention, fleet to our bow! I am Lyme, captain of the Third Nebula Guardian Fleet.

Based on the laws of the Federation of Polises, all islands that appear on the seven seas are deemed as belonging to it. Until the Federation decides on a course of action for these islands, no entity is allowed to privately occupy them.
Queen Anne's Revenge, your one-sided claim is wholly void and, furthermore, illegal!
As such, you are to take all your followers and leave these islands immediately. Surrender them peacefully to the Nebula Guardians, and we will overlook your crime.
Heh. Tell me, what exactly do YOUR laws have to do with OUR Islas de Libertád?
If the Vengeful Queen Fleet, or any free fleet, for that matter, was willing to submit to your corrupt and arrogant Federation, then it wouldn't have been put together in the first place.
Do you really think you, alone, can represent the will of the Nebula Guardians and the Federation?
And here you are, threatening me with a handful of tatty old ships you brought. You must have a burning death wish.
Enough!
KABOOOM!
Lyme's anger reached its tipping point, and she fired a warning shot.
Although the shot hit the water, the situation was a powder keg.
A number of ships appeared from the surrounding islands and joined the Vengeful Queen Fleet's ranks.
Uh-oh. Her crappy intimidation attempt only made her fleet even bolder...
I've met that Lyme once. I was doing business when our paths crossed.

She's fought monsters for many years in the Sea of Death, has a strong sense of justice, and hates evil from the bottom of her heart. Worse yet, she has a short fuse, and tends to be rather pushy when dealing with things.
Her fleet is going to sustain heavy losses if this turns into a fight...
Lyme... I told you not to let your feelings take control.
Laws exist to be followed. I will not meet a bunch of vile outlaws halfway.
That may be true of the monsters you've fought for many years, but their fleet is not a bunch of monsters. You cannot treat them the same.
Allow me to handle this.
Well, well... Want to see who has the bigger cannons, do you?
Try this on for size, then.
KABOOOM!
The artillery situated in the ruins on the main island fired a volley, its impact creating enormous waves in the water.
...It is as you say. We do not have the final say in what is to be done with these islands.
The purpose of our excursion here is to, as Nebula Guardians, explore the ruins upon these newfound islands, and evaluate what threats may lurk within them.
I believe you've issued a great number of invitations. Would it therefore be possible for us to join your search team as well?
You're more reasonable than the last one, I'll give you that. However, my answer is "no."
You may go on to claim you have an invitation, but I have no recollection of ever inviting you.
So, be good little uninvited guests and leave.
...There is nothing more to be said. São Martinho, prepare for battle.
Hey, is it just me, or is Martinho sending us a signal?
Seems she was unable to stop it on her own.
Oh... Heheh! Well, looks like Tempesta's gonna have to intervene!
Let's give 'em a hand! It'll be good for nobody if a fight really does break out!
Thanks to Tempesta's intervention and explanation, the Nebula Guardians backed off from the islands, and the Vengeful Queen Fleet didn't pursue them.
Later, in the dead of night, Royal Fortune and São Martinho met up on a small and inconspicuous island.
Phew... Things got real dodgy earlier today. What were you lot thinking back there?! Were you seriously going to invade Islas de Libertád with such a tiny force?!
For your information, that coastal battery up there is not just for show! It still works!
Our main force is still behind the lines. Lyme was worried about the ruins, so she left in a hurry.
I did tell Dolphin that we'd be making a move. I didn't expect you all to be here as well.
Well, isn't it jolly good that we were? I think we can both guess what would've happened if we weren't.
That is true...
Alright, so what was that about Lyme? What do you mean she was "worried about the ruins"?
You surely heard the rumors about sea monsters when you went to Limestone Island.
Yeah. Even saw the remains of some that Portsmouth Adventure brought along a few days ago.
I had a gander at 'em. Wreckage skelebeasts.
Yes. With the discovery of Islas de Libertád, skelebeasts suddenly began appearing in Mar del Demonios – a place where they shouldn't live. Moreover, their numbers grow by the day.
We believe all of it links back to these ruins. Someone on the islands may be controlling the monsters, using them as a barrier to protect Islas de Libertád.
Uhh... That's probably not the case.
I've been here for quite a while now, and I've not seen a single thing that looks connected to those monsters.
Anne and her crew have even said that the more people come here, the better.
Hell, if anything, she's fuming that they're standing in the way of the islands.
I see. Well, I have a theory, though it's only a theory.
Queen Anne's Revenge is plotting something. This much I can say with certainty.
She made a big deal out of gathering this many people. It simply does not follow that she did it just to share treasure with others.
For this reason, you should all exercise caution.
The Federation of Polises puts great importance on this place. If things do not go well, it's only a matter of time before an army is sent here.
I've heard that the Church of the Goddess has dispatched a fleet to this place as well.
Lyme is considering working with them, though she does not yet know where they are.
I wish to stress one thing: Do not lower your guard while there is still much we do not know.
I will leave now. I'll contact you again if anything comes up.
Oh boy... This treasure hunt is getting a lot more complicated than I hoped.
Thank gosh I prepped so thoroughly before setting off.
Anyway, got it! I'll keep an eye out!
And so, two days passed, and as São Martinho had said, a fleet belonging to the Church of the Goddess arrived on the islands.
Goddess's blessings be with you! To think fate would bring us together in such a vast ocean as this.
I am Pearl, servant of the Church. This is Ganj-i-Sawai, a friend of mine.
Miss Anne, would you please allow us to bring the Goddess's light to these free islands?
You lot... Well, you know your manners better than the Nebula Guardians.
But sorry, the answer's no. Islas de Libertád only welcome those who seek liberty. I said it clear as day in the invitation.
That descriptor clearly doesn't fit you, so go away.
I see... How unfortunate that we must return home with nothing to show.
A shame, truly. I suppose we'll head home.
Farewell, Anne. May you and your followers have a wonderful day!
The Church's fleet departed with no fanfare or fuss, leaving them with some words of blessing.
Queen Anne's Revenge breathed a relieved sigh. Royal Fortune, however, felt something different after this brief exchange.
Hold up, Anne. Something here smells fishy.
Fishy? What is?
You may or may not know it, but the Church of the Goddess is utterly obsessed with ancient ruins.
They also collect huge amounts of old relics. They've got so many, just picturing it makes me shudder.
So basically, what you just did was say "no" to two total fanatics, and they simply politely turned around and left.
Their reaction was even milder than the Nebula Guardians'. That just can't be right.
Also, I've run into Ganj-i-Sawai in the past. She's... way, way more calculating than she lets on.
I refuse to believe she'd give up just like that. You all really should be on high alert for the next few days.
So that's the deal with them...
Ta for telling me. I'll inform the others at once.
The warning from Anne made the Vengeful Queen Fleet highly vigilant. Other fleets who'd set up on their islets even joined their patrols spontaneously.
It was evening that day, and rain had begun pouring.
The weather got even worse when night came as strong winds blew and fierce waves churned.
Yet, despite the storm around them, the people on the islands spent the night on the lookout.
Contrary to their expectations, the day ended peacefully. Too peacefully, perhaps.
As morning rolled around, a patrolling fleet came upon a shocking find.
Look, look! Look what we found!
There are loads of wrecks washing ashore!
...The planks are made in different styles. They must belong to indie sailors or other fleet members.
There's also some coating that only naval forces use. Those must be from the Nebula Guardians.
I see how it is... They were refused entry, so they're waiting outside the islands to ambush the people I invited!
Now they've really gone and bloody done it!
Captain, we should sail out there now and give those Nebula Guardians a beating!
That's exactly what we'll do. Those sods will learn what happens when you pick a fight with us!
Whoa, Anne, let's take it easy!
If the Nebula Guardians did this, then they're probably working with the Church.
For all we know, they could've laid a trap and are just waiting for us to walk into it!
I know the Nebula Guardians are heavy-handed and cruel, but I don't think they'd go quite THIS far.
I mean, there's got to be an explanation for this.
It just so happens that we – Tempesta – have dealt with both the Guardians and the Church in the past. We can go there and see what's up!
Take us with ya!
We went through the Sleepin' Sea together, so there's no way they'll make things hard for us!
*sigh*... Whatever. Do as you wish.
I'll tell the other fleets to get ready for battle... and wait for news from you.
Tempesta and the treasure hunters departed from the harbor and followed the bread crumb trail of drifting wreckage amid the storm.
As soon as they left Islas de Libertád, however, they came under attack by a group of skelebeasts.
The skelebeasts have gotten THIS close now?
Damn... Those bastards really are here!
At least that means it's possible THEY'RE responsible for the wrecks washing up!
C'mon! Let's work together and break through the siege!
After smashing through several waves of skelebeasts, the girls reached the heart of all the fighting.
Damned monsters... I know your habits like the back of my hand. Nothing you do can surprise me.
You never stop... You know neither fear nor fatigue...
Then so be it! I will give you the fight you so want!
Perish!
Lyme, the fleet can't take any more! I'm coming to support you!
Watch your back!
Don't worry about me. No monster like this will ever catch me off guard.
You take care of the fleet. I will deal with these things myself!
That's the Nebula Guardians, and the Church, and ships from Islas de Libertád... I knew it! They weren't responsible for the wreckages!
Hell, they're the ones holding back the horde of skelebeasts!
We gotta help them!
KABOOOM!
While a fierce battle unfolded between the girls and the tide of skelebeasts, a red signal flare suddenly shot up from Islas de Libertád.
Hey, isn't that an emergency rendezvous flare?
Perhaps something has happened back at the islands... Let's hope it's not another skelebeast attack!
São Martinho, Ganj-i-Sawai, there's no end to these monsters! Just because we can handle them doesn't mean the other ships can!
We need to fall back to the islands!
They've got the coastal battery, plus favourable geography for defence!
While I like the idea, those ladies did just chase us off, so...
Look, there are too many enemies! Islas de Libertád must be under attack, too!
Anne will at least be somewhat receptive to your plight, unlike these monsters that you can't reason with!
I'll tell her to listen! Trust me!
My, what a magnanimous young lady you are, Royal Fortune. May the Goddess grace you with her blessings.
You have a point. Given the circumstances, it's the most optimal solution. We're in your debt!
Lyme, remember what we came here for!
...Okay. We'll do as she says.
Thus, the fleets of Tempesta, the treasure hunters, the Nebula Guardians, the Church, and the new sailors seeking freedom retreated to Islas de Libertád.
In light of the situation and Royal Fortune's assurances, Queen Anne's Revenge allowed them all to enter the islands.
However, a condition was given to the Nebula Guardians and the Church – they were to leave as soon as this was over.
There was not a single voice of opposition to Anne's decision.
Following this, she activated the defensive barriers, forcing all the skelebeasts into places beyond the islands.
This, coupled with the ceaseless barrages from the coastal battery, got them through the crisis. They could breathe easy.
A while had passed since the fleets entered the islands' territory.
Thanks to the safety and assurance afforded by the ancient yet operational defenses, a sense of relaxation swept over everyone.
Or rather, everyone except for Royal Fortune.
She had had a growing suspicion about Ganj-i-Sawai ever since she reflected on their adventure in the Sleeping Sea. She never did learn why the Commander disappeared so suddenly.
After that, coupled with the sudden attack of the skelebeasts, she was unable to suppress the doubt inside of her, and she decided to ask Ganj-i-Sawai directly.
Aww. It hurts my heart that you doubt me so.
location: Church of the Goddess's Temporary Base

scripts.say: You would too if you were me. Hey, did you know Porty actually ran into the Commander's fleet sometime after that?
From what she told me, the Commander didn't have a choice in leaving, but was forced to. Care to confirm or deny?
Well... Do you know what happened on the day the Commander left?
Obviously I do! I just want to hear you say it. I need to be sure that you're not lying!
Heh...
As you already know, I held a feast on that day, and I invited the Commander to join me.
But, to my shock, in the middle of our meal, the Commander just vanished into thin air.
I take it you're better acquainted with that phenomenon than I am, no?
Of course I do!
So... That's it? You were eating, then the Commander disappeared, and nothing happened after?
