Somewhere deep in my heart, this has always been bothering me...
Even if we're all in the same fleet, would it really be so easy for things to return to how they used to be...?
Le Triomphant's expression was full of sorrow.
That's why when I saw Erebus and Terror, Lexington and Saratoga, I felt a little jealous...
I hope that one day, I'll be able to return to those days where I can get along with my sisters again...
But as things are right now, even if I was to meet them, I don't know what I should do...
Commander, can you tell me what I'm supposed to do?
Her sorrowful voice quivered with helplessness.

sequence:
The Melancholy of a Princess Chevalier

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Feuding Sisters</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Commander, I've come to deliver the resources that came in earlier!
You're here too, Le Triomphant? Congratulations on your secretaryship!
Ehehe. It's no big deal~
Good timing. I'd like to ask you something about you and Le Mars.
About me and Le Mars?
C-Commander?!
I had no idea... Le Triomphant is always brimming with confidence, even with so many things to worry about...
If you ask me though... I'd say that she's overthinking things.
Huh...?
I heard Forbin calling for me! Huh? Le Triomphant too?
Good day, Miss Le Mars.
Um, so it's like this... Commander is asking us for advice about when your sister ship is in an opposing faction.
That's the issue, huh? Well, it's perfectly normal for siblings to fight, right?
Really?
Le Mars is a blockhead, so that's the only method you can use to get to her anyway.
I've actually tried it a bunch of times in combat. Using practice equipment, anyway.
Anyway, all you gotta do is hit 'em with your feelings! Use words for stuff that can be conveyed with words. Use your fists for all the stuff that can't!
Sigh... that's why you're a blockhead...
Who the heck are you callin' a blockhead?
W-well, I'm glad you two get along... but I wonder if I can have this kind of relationship with my sisters...
You have a point. There's no guarantee with this kind of stuff, but don't you think it's better to express yourself than to keep your emotions bottled up?
They're your sister ships after all. I'm sure they'll understand if you talk to them. Someone as smart as you can figure that out, right?
My sister ships...
Miss Forbin, Miss Le Mars, thank you both for your advice. I think I understand a bit better.
It seemed like Le Triomphant's heart was finally beginning to thaw.

sequence:
The Melancholy of a Princess Chevalier

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Le Triomphant of Iris Libre</size>

scripts.say: After seeing off Forbin and Le Mars...
Commander, I think... I understand what I have to do now.
Up until now, I've always been trapped by my memories of the past, afraid of opening old wounds.
I've decided that I won't run from my past anymore...
But I can't do that as I am now.
Le Triomphant made a fist, gentle but filled with determination.
As Forbin said, I can't just keep my emotions bottled up.
No matter what it takes, I have to make my sisters understand my feelings.
Perhaps my sisters would get angry at me, but even then...
I... I want to get along with my sisters again!
Thank you so much, Commander. This is only possible because of you...
I won't get jealous of others anymore... because surely, I'll be able to have fun with my own sisters again.
From now on, I won't run away from what needs to be done. As my name suggests, I'll be triumphant in reforging my relationship with my sisters!

options.content: You are still cute, though, even if you do decide to run.

scripts.say: Upon hearing my words, Le Triomphant turned a deep shade of red.
Wh-what are you saying? C-calling me c-cute...
Uuu... F-fine... Then, the next time I'm worried about something, you'd better be there to hear me out...
Since you're the person I trust the most, you won't mind if I rely on you a bit more, right?

sequence: <size=45>The first autumn winds have come and gone, and a new school term has begun.</size>
<size=45>Under the sakura blossoms, Spring Festival’s “Opening School Ceremony”, has begun!</size>

School Day Celebrations

<size=45> I　「Being Late!」</size>

scripts.say: Woaaaa! I am late, I am late!!
Whining... so many sisters, but none of them cared to wake me up!!
Hmmm～～ As a bully girl, I should skip my classes without feeling ashamed, right?
Ahh... That's a terrible idea, big sis will be angry again.
B-but, without bully girls, there would be no taskmaster girls!
Eh?
Ouch!
Who’s there! Don’t you look where you’re walking?
It hurts... S-sorry...
So, it's {namecode:2}... Why are you in such a hurry?
B-because I'm late — — Eh? {namecode:94}? Are you {namecode:94}? You look like a...
B-bully girl?!
Heeheehee. Impressed? Looks like the real deal, right? My sister will be surprised — —
{namecode:94}～～～!!!
Woaaa! She's coming this way!
{namecode:63} entrusted me to be a taskmaster girl. I shall not fail her. Sister or not, I'll teach you a lesson!
Whining — —
What? {namecode:2}, what are you doing here?
Ah, there’s no time left...A-anyways, let’s head to school first! We are late...
{namecode:94}! We are not done, I'll deal with you later!
Fine...

sequence:
School Day Celebrations

<size=45> II　「Troublemakers on the Playground」</size>

scripts.say: From sports to studies, Z1-sama is always zee N0.1!
Anyone who disagrees with me can duel with me!
Whether it’s running, baseball or fighting, Z1-sama is undefeatable!
Woah...haha, boldly said～
You...the one from the Sakura Empire — —
I never back down! Not from duels!
Then let's have one!
Woaaa～～The show is starting～
Craven cannot decide which side should she cheer for...
L-let's cheer for both sides then! {namecode:94} you can do it! Z1～Fight!
Z～～1～～Senpai!
{namecode:94}～～～！
Whining — —
How many times have we talked about it? No provoking others in school!
Tsk tsk — —
You don't take school seriously! I keep getting complaints about you!
I didn't break any classroom rules! It’s just that the teacher is too boring. I recommend to everyone that I should teach the class...
Hahaha
Why’re you laughing? You’re no better!
B-but, she started it — —
You made it worse by taking her nonsense seriously! And you Craven! They are nothing but troublemakers, why did you follow them?!

sequence:

<size=45>1 Touching Fingertips</size>

scripts.say: (Yesterday, I was notified that I was to assume the role of secretary.)
(Even though it's my first day on the job, I still find myself in disbelief as I head to the office. Me, secretary?)
(I was hand-picked by the commander... but why would someone like me be chosen in the first place?)
(I suppose this means that my "down-to-earth work ethic" has been recognized, but...)
*knock* *knock*
Reporting in. I am Casablanca, and I will now be assisting you as secretary.
I will give it my all to make sure that my duties are completed, from official affairs to miscellaneous chores. I look forward to working with you.
Now if you'll excuse me, let's begin today's work. Shall I start by organizing your documents?
(I'll follow the commander's instructions and organize all the documents into their respective files.)
(If I can finish this quickly, I'll have enough time left over to help with the paperwork as well.)
Thank you for your praise. I try to be efficient.
But judging from your expression, Commander, you seem to have taken stock of my abilities beforehand.
I am quite proficient at rear support on the battlefield, so if you think about things that way, it makes sense that I would seem suitable for the role of secretary.
In any case...
(What was that sound...? The commander's pen just fell onto the ground?)
Commander, something fell just now...
(I lean down to pick up the fallen object, and that was when...)
(My fingertips brush against those of the commander, who had reached out at the same time!)
(I draw my hand back in a hurry, thinking of how to apologize.)
...Sorry about that. I'll get back to work now.
(And like that, I began my first day as secretary, struggling to manage the appropriate distance between me and the commander.)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>2 Too Many Appointments</size>

scripts.say: (Compared to when I first began my secretary work, the location of the supplies and documents in the office had become almost second nature to me.)
Commander, speaking of the report that we submitted to the Naval HQ a few days ago...
*knock* *knock*
Oh, it seems that we have guests. Who is it?
Dagnabbit, Commander! You were here all along!
Ah, I knew it! I can tell from your dopey expression that you forgot all about it! You did this last time, and the time before as well! Forgetting all about me because of your work!
P-please calm down. What's the matter?
We were supposed to get lunch together today, Commander! How could you be so forgetful...
I'm very sorry, but we've had a mountain of work to get through today...
I know... Can't do anything about that, but— Commander, please make sure you remember next time!
(A few hours after that...)
Commander, I noticed something about the last delivery of supplies that arrived a few days ago...
*knock* *knock*
We seem to have a lot of guests today. Who is it?
Com~man~der~!! Why'd you stand me up? You're clearly right here~!
...You too, huh?
You promised that we'd have an epic gaming session today! This ghost won't forgive oathbreakers~!
I'm very sorry. As the secretary ship, please allow me to offer my apologies instead. I hope it will be enough for you to calm down?
*sigh*... If you're going to say that much, I can't exactly stay mad...
...*sigh*. Finally, she's gone. Commander, you seem to have some issues with keeping your schedule in order.
While it is certainly admirable that you've won the admiration of so many here at port, reneging on your agreements, and repeatedly too, is simply unacceptable.
I'm sorry, Commander.
(I've decided... I'm going to make this right.)
From now on, I will manage everything on your schedule. This is also for the sake of our future work.
A-anyway, do you understand how serious this is?
(I suppose my assertiveness left Commander lost for words...)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>3 Her Serious Side</size>

scripts.say: Commander, today was a ton of fun. I hope you'll remember to keep your promises in the future, just like today.
Commander, that game was a ton of fun~! If you have free time some other day, just let me know~
Coming up soon on your calendar, you'll have baseball practice with Bogue early tomorrow morning, followed by a tour of Langley's tactical class the following day.
Hm? My schedule management has been very helpful?
...I'm glad to receive your praise, but keep in mind that I place greater emphasis on your work arrangements than on your social ones. You'll be getting busy again soon.
Naturally, I'll also be supporting you to the best of my abilities.
(I was surprised to see Commander nodding off...)
(Actually, why was it so hard for me to just say something nice back, like "you've been doing a great job"...?)
(No, this is also necessary. You can't lead this port without making some sacrifices.)
Now then, that's all the work finished for the day. Commander, you'll have an early start tomorrow morning, so make sure you go to bed on time.
Phew... I rarely get to finish work early like this, so maybe I should unwind by watching a nice movie.
It should be somewhere on this shelf— Ah, here it is.
Need to turn off the lights too... Maybe I should grab myself a drink while I'm at it——
(It's been about an hour and a half since I started watching the movie alone in my room, and it's about to reach the climax scene—)
Ah... it's so tragic... Even though she knows how important that person is to her, she still—
*knock* *knock*
...Huh? Who the heck is coming at this hour? And I was just getting to the most important scene too...!
Come in, the door's not locked—
...Huh?
C-Commander?! P-please give me a moment!!
Ugh...
(Ahhh! So embarrassing! I was practically shaking...!)
(Why would Commander be here? Wait, was it because I said something about watching a movie...?)
Oh, I left something behind at the office? I see... thank you. I was careless.
Huh? Yes, I'm watching a movie...
B-but it's nothing special. You probably wouldn't like it...
(...It's so embarrassing! Even though I've been so strict with Commander, I can't just say I have a hobby like this...)
(There's no way I can tell anyone that I'm into sappy romance movies...!)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>4 Hard to Explain</size>

scripts.say: (Sigh... the heroine from the movie I watched last time... Why did she choose to say goodbye to the one she loved? I can't stand it...)
(I understand that she did it out of consideration for her partner's position, but... surely there's a way to pull through as long as there's love...)
*Sigh*...
Look, Princeton. Is that Casablanca over there?
Yup. She looks awfully lost in thought.
That reminds me, I heard that she recently became the secretary ship. Maybe she has a lot of stuff to think about.
(And she never even confessed... kind of like me and Commander...)
How are you doing, Casablanca?
Hwah?!
Woah, what happened?!
Huh...? Oh, um, my apologies. I wasn't watching where I was going.
Something must really be bothering you... Whatever it is, I'll be glad to lend an ear!
(Maybe Bataan would be able to understand...)
(About my hobbies... and about me and Commander...)
(Wait, huh?! ...Just what's gotten into me?)
Um, it's alright, it's nothing serious...
You're not acting your normal self, Casablanca. It's like you're pushing yourself way too hard or something.
Th-that's not really the case... If anything, it's that...
What is it then?
(There's no way I can tell them that I was just comparing myself to the heroine of a romance movie... Gosh, that'd be so embarrassing...)
Well, um, let's just say that there hypothetically were two shipgirls.
(Yeah, I'll try to cover it up by comparing it to some hierarchical relationship in the fleet!)
—So that's the gist of things. Two people who've concealed their status from each other. Once those facts get revealed, there's no way they'd go back to the way things were before, right?
For two people who are in an equal relationship, wouldn't it be way too ridiculous to introduce some inequality between them that would split them apart?
Uhh... Do we have any notions of status here at port? I mean, even if you're reassigned somewhere, you'll still run into everyone at some point during battles.
Huh? Oh... Good point...
Besides, knowing that one person is the boss while the other is a subordinate... isn't that more conducive to the flow of combat?
Th-that's not exactly the case... It's more like being unable to go back to having the same relationship as before, and the "sorrow" that comes from that...
What does "sorrow" have to do anything?
Uhhhh... I, I didn't mean it like that! It's just that...
(How do I even explain this...)
(The relationship between the commander and the secretary ship should be one of boss and subordinate, and yet... because Commander keeps listening to me, it's as if...)
(Ugh... Why am I overthinking this in the first place...)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>5 Advice From Friends</size>

scripts.say: Commander, do you have any plans after this? —Huh? We'll have more visitors?
I don't recall seeing anything like that on the schedule— Oh, it was a last-minute decision from the Naval HQ?
I understand. There's enough room in the schedule to accommodate a little change. So, who are these visitors?
It's me and Bataan.
Hi there, Casablanca. It's nice to see you again.
Oh, it's you guys...
(They're checking on me... Did I make them worried about me because of last time?)
By the way, did you need something from the commander?
Nothing major. The two of us are conducting a mock exercise, and Commander is in charge of the planning operations.
Don't worry, we won't take too much of your time— Come on, Commander, let's talk business.
(Their plan was missing a crucial step, and they weren't able to come to any decisions. Time continued to pass.)
We're not getting anywhere like this... Let's call it a day for now, and try to reconvene some other time.
Then, I'll record the issues we've discussed so far. I'll gather any other materials needed for our next meeting as well.
(Originally, this was supposed to be a discussion between Commander, Princeton, and Bataan... As secretary, I don't have the time to be getting involved like this...)
We appreciate the help, but are you sure it's fine? We ended up using a bunch of your time after all... so you don't have to force yourself.
Yeah. Just because you're the secretary doesn't mean that you have to take on every little thing.
It's fine, I can handle this. Commander, mind if I stay after to get some extra work done?
Commander, Casablanca takes her work extremely seriously, to the point of forgetting to eat. You'd better not be taking advantage of that!
That's right! She was sighing and saying something about feeling "sorrow" earlier—
*cough* Ahhh! Ahem! I already said I'm totally fine! There's nothing to worry about!
(I was able to help plan out the strategy for the mock exercise, but...)
(Considering my status as shipgirl, that isn't something I should be doing in the first place...)
(Argh, just what kind of relation do I want to have with Commander anyway?)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>6 Passionate Thoughts</size>

scripts.say: (I was helping Commander record down the things that had been discussed, based on our reference materials. Before I knew it, it was already late at night.)
(That took a long time... But if possible, I'd still like to look for some even more helpful materials.)
Um, Commander, make sure you remember to check if the records I made are complete.
(Commander often has difficulty keeping track of everything due to the sheer amount of work, so that's why I have to be firm.)
(I clenched my hands into fists to psych myself up...)
(And that's when I saw the fountain pen in Commander's hand.)
(A fountain pen, huh... There was one just like it in that movie I watched before. Actually, that was the starting point for an entire love story. What a masterpiece.)
(Now that I think of it... my hand also bumped into Commander's on that first day I came into the office... That was so heart-throbbing—)
(W-wait, what's gotten into my all of a sudden? I have to stay focused so we can finish up with work as soon as possible.)
(I'm trying to shake the thoughts out of my head, but my heart is still racing from just thinking about it...)
(In that movie, the person who helped the heroine in the movie left his pen behind as he left, and that was the beginning of their whirlwind romance...)
(When they later met again, and that was when she realized that he was out of her league, he even gently put a coat over her when got soaked in the rain...)
(Commander is also out my league, my superior... But, Commander's gentleness is the same, just like in the movie...... Oh gosh, what am I fantasizing about——)
(I guess I ended up dozing off while thinking about Commander because I had been working so hard...)
This won't do... I'm still at work...
Ugh... It's all because I let myself get those weird idle thoughts that I ended up drowsy...
(Huh... What's this odd feeling on my back?)
...A c-coat? When did this get here? ...And, this is... Commander's?
(I stood up while muttering to myself and turned around. Commander, who had noticed me getting up, slowly stood up as well.)
I'm so sorry, Commander! I completely fell asleep! How embarrassing of me to even make you lend me your coat... I'll get back to work right away...
Thud!
Ahh!
(In my panic, I spun around and caught my foot on something, and I felt myself going down– Suddenly... I felt myself being tightly hugged in Commander's arms!)
Eek! I, I'm so sorry, Commander...
(Our faces are so close... We're so close that I feel like I can't even breathe...)
(As soon as our eyes met, Commander promptly let go of me.)
(My heart was pounding like crazy and it just wouldn't stop... This was just like a scene out of a romance movie, except with Commander...)
(In that movie, the heroine...)
Um, Commander, actually...!
Huh? ...I should head back for the night and get some rest? Y-you're right...
(The words were caught in my throat. I could only leave the office obediently and head back to get some sleep.)
(But that was when I made a single wish to myself, from the bottom of my heart.)

sequence:
A Whirlwind Romance

<size=45>7 Premonitions of Romance</size>

scripts.say: (And thus, it was my last day of secretary ship duties.)
Um... By the way, do you have any free time today?
You've been working so hard this whole time, Commander, so I'd like to treat you to dinner. Plus, I owe you for lending me your coat that other time.
(I decided to myself, I would say everything I wanted to say during our dinner.)
(Today, I have to tell Commander...!)
Commander, I'd like to ask you again... Why'd you decide to make me the secretary?
Huh? Because you thought it'd be nice to have a dependable person around? Wh-what, because of my serious personality?
In other words, you've had a positive opinion of me? ...Err, um, don't worry about it! I was just curious!
(Commander is the same as always... That's why today, I have to–)
...By the way, we've been working so hard this whole time that we haven't had a chance to chat like this. We should've done this sooner.
In any case, I really feel comfortable working with you. I hope that we can get to know each other even better as time passes.
And I hope that you'll also get to know me better, little by little.
...If you'd like, how about we watch a movie together?
"What kind of movie?" Um, well... Actually, um... there's this one genre that I'm really into...
Um, it's a little embarrassing to just say it straight up, but I'll give you a little hint. It has this line–
(I tapped my glass with Commander's, and our eyes met again.)
"Here's looking at you, kid." Ehehe~

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>1 Neatly, Efficiently</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
On Richelieu's recommendation, I appointed Clemenceau as my secretary ship.
I couldn't imagine that the puppeteer and cardinal of the Iris would be very used to secretary work, but...
Upon looking at the documents she'd handed me, I realize that I was dead wrong.
My, Commander, you've been staring down those papers for a while. It makes me wonder if I did something wrong.
If there's anything you don't understand, I'm happy to explain it to you.
That won't be necessary. Actually, your work is so much better than I expected. I'm just amazed.
Heehee. I'll take that as a compliment.
I'll have you know that Clemenceau's paperwork skills are even greater than mine.
I'm only able to work through the Iris's countless daily affairs because of her help.
Please, Cardinal. I'm just a worrisome sister who wants to help you out here and there.
Don't be so humble, Clemenceau. You're an excellent worker, and that's exactly why I recommended you for this position.
Serve the Commander well and bring glory to the name of the Iris.
Of course. Don't worry about me.
After a quick check-in with us, Richelieu leaves my office, and Clemenceau returns to her seat to resume her work.
The occasional grins that flash onto her face, the little tunes she hums... They make me wonder.
(Clemenceau, is it just me, or are you in a good mood...?)
*knock* *knock*
Can I come in, Commander?
Jean Bart?
Come in. What's the matter?
As soon as she enters the room, Jean Bart makes a weird face. Her body is faced toward me, but her eyes keep drifting over to Clemenceau.
Oh? Did someone come to visit me?
No! Dunkerque made sweets, so... Richelieu wanted me to bring some over.
When you two break for lunch, have some sweets after your meal.
(Richelieu? But she just left the office. Why did she send Jean Bart...?)
Really, now~ Yes, the Commander and I will enjoy Dunkerque's kindness to our hearts' content.
Yeah, have fun. ...I'm gonna go now.
(Jean Bart is acting weird...)
(Clemenceau, too.)
(She was the same as usual when we started our morning work...)
(But she's in such a good mood after Richelieu and Jean Bart's little visits.)
(Could it be?)
Did your sisters worrying about you put you in such a good mood?
Oh, come now. I have no idea what you could possibly mean, Commander.
Mm, don't they smell so appetizing? Commander, have you ever eaten Dunkerque's sweets before?
Hers taste a little lighter than traditional Iris sweets.
One meager taste, and their refreshing elegance lingers in your memory forever.
You might just find yourself bored of sweets that do nothing but heap on sugar!
Heehee, don't you agree, Commander?
(It feels as if she's changed the subject while still somehow answering my question...)
Ah, yes. Sorry, Commander, but it seems those little interruptions have put us behind on work.
We'll have to work harder if we want to make it in time for lunch!

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>2 Gently, Minutely</size>

scripts.say: Port - Hallway Outside Office
Due to an urgent meeting today, I arrive at my office a little late.
Clemenceau has been working as my secretary ship for a while now. Her excellent work has been a huge help, to the point that we even leave work early sometimes.
(But I still don't feel comfortable leaving her alone in my office. I hope nothing bad has happened in my absence...)
Port - Office
Clemenceau, do you think crème brûlée and macarons are a good combination for the party? Or would Mont Blanc and chocolate muffins be better?
Cream cake and mousse cake are a timeless combo, too... Oh, but what about madeleines and chocolate truffles?
Hmm... They're all so delicious that I can't even begin to choose.
Have you considered picking a pair that matches the drink selection?
Black tea and green tea would demand a sweeter array of pastries...
If it's to go with coffee, then you'd want to base it on the type and recipe of the coffee.
Either way, knowing the number of participants, there are going to be a wide range of preferences. Don't you think you'd be better off preparing multiple combinations?
Yeah... Thank you, Clemenceau. I'll go work on it right away.
Lady Clemenceau, what sorts of spells would be best for the party?
Nothing explosive, please. We don't want to turn the tea party into a fireworks show, now, do we?
No explosions, check! Well, as long as nobody touches my props...
Oh, my... You should ask Akashi if she has anything safer.
I'll help decorate the venue, too! ...Is there anything I can do, though?
Just sit there quietly. No pranks.
I won't play any pranks! I really wanna help!
Hmm. In that case... Help Le Malin and the others prepare drinks, would you?
Don't forget to have cold water for more sensitive tongues like Le Terrible's.
Okay! Oh, should we have wine for Cardinal Richelieu, too?
Ah, yes... Richelieu may not come given her busy schedule, but having one ready couldn't possibly hurt.
Got it! Leave those drinks to me!
When I enter my office, I find Clemenceau surrounded by other Iris girls.
Even when the crowd lobs question after question at her, she answers without slowing her paperwork.
Well, if it isn't the Commander. Flatter me all you want, but you'll receive no gifts.
Oh, but outside working hours, we could...
Heehee, I'm kidding. This is trivial, really, so it doesn't affect my secretary ship work.
Besides, it's an honor to get to solve our comrades' cute little worries.
Worries such as...?
I mean preparing for the coming party. Little worries regarding the sweets, drinks, and entertainment... Don't you find it adorable to worry about such things?
Now that you mention it, I guess...
We have an important joint exercise in just a few days. It would be a problem if people couldn't perform to their potential just because they were troubled by such silly things.
I care quite a bit about whether the Iris can win, you know.
You're surprisingly competitive when it comes to this stuff...
Oh, not really. I'm just excited.
Commander, may I trouble you to attend the exercise's opening ceremony with me?

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>3 Unexpectedly Competitive</size>

scripts.say: The goal of this joint exercise is to improve both the breadth and depth of inter-faction cooperation.
I would like you all to simulate the most realistic battle possible in order to yield data that will serve us in the future.
Commander, I'd love your input.
As Clemenceau said, we want you all to put your abilities on full display today.
We look forward to a great fight.
In the evening, the joint exercise ends without issue.
Clemenceau compiles a report and hands it off to me.
Already finished your report? Impressive.
(Hmm. Every faction did their very best, so I'd call this a roaring success.)
(But Clemenceau still has a lot of ideas to improve it for next time.)
(This line about the Iris fleet is probably the most biting criticism of all of them.)
Too indecisive, lacking resolution, too conservative a strategy while also not having a backup plan...
Unable to rally themselves back once they were at a disadvantage, ultimately leading to failure...
(What is this pressure I've been feeling ever since we got back to the office?)

options.content: Are you unhappy because of the Iris fleet's defeat?

scripts.say: Not especially.
The results don't really matter, but... I don't like the naivete of the strategy they employed.
That makes sense. It is just an exercise, so I can see why they'd hold back.
Exactly. They're in for a rude awakening if they try this on a real battlefield.
Being able to seize opportunities means more than just victory. It means making it more likely that you make it out alive.
If they won't take these exercises seriously, then they'll be in danger on the battlefield.
If you've learned that much about them, then it sounds like the exercise was worthwhile.
Yes, Commander, you're right. I just...
...I should have the Tribunal girls participate after all.
Even leaving aside the question of mental readiness, I see that they've been without training for too long. I must discuss this with Richelieu and see it fixed.
(Seems like she DOES care about if they win or lose...)
*knock* *knock*
Lady Clemenceau, the party preparations are complete. Will the Commander be joining us today?
But of course. We'll be there soon, so pass on my thanks and congratulations to everyone.
I can't wait for the show today~
Clemenceau flashes a gentle smile, causing L'Opiniâtre to stiffen up like she'd just seen a ghost.
After replying that she'd "d-do her best," she turns and runs out of the office.
Clemenceau changed her attitude so fast that I had to wonder where her competitive spirit from before had gone.
I'm sure anyone but you would have missed that, Commander.
But it is true that I'm not genuinely worried about the result.
I have some opinions about their training, of course, but that doesn't mean I deny the effort they're putting in.
They fought their hardest. They deserve rest.
How's that for work-life balance?
Of course, rest must be earned through hard work. That means that you and I can't rest yet.
Heehee, bear with me just a little longer for the sake of the party. Okay, Commander?

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>4 Rest After Hard Work</size>

scripts.say: After our work in the office, Clemenceau and I head to the party venue together.
Along the way, she hands me a letter of invitation that she'd pulled out of seemingly nowhere.
Unlike the informal oral invitation, this one is in an envelope bearing the Iris's seal.
Which should mean that said party is a rather formal affair.
If you're to be invited, Commander, even the most informal party must see proper etiquette observed.
Oh, or were you looking forward to a dance party?
Unfortunately, it's just a party to treat the girls. Don't worry; I'll make it up to you next time.
Shush, now. We're almost there. We can talk about it when we're alone again♪
Now, allow me to show you a miracle that you WON'T find in the sacraments... Huh? Wha?!
Wh-why isn't it working...?
Clemenceau, Commander. How do you like this round of handmade sweets?
They're delicious. You never cease to improve your skills, Dunkerque.
The tea... is very hot...
Ack! Sorry, Le Terrible! This is yours! See, it's lukewarm!
Too hot... *pant* *pant*... It's still too hot...
Umm... Opie, is this thing not working?
Oh? Let me take a look...
*cough* *cough*!
*cough* *cough*... Why did it explode...?
Vauquelin, don't tell me you did this...
I didn't do anything this time! Dunkerque and I prepped everything together!
Vauquelin was with me the whole time, so I can vouch for her. She didn't do anything wrong.
Then these props must be defective...
Ugh... I'll ask Akashi about it tomorrow.
By the way, Lady Clemenceau, it doesn't look like Jean Bart and Lady Richelieu are coming to the party...
I understand. I'll pass the wine on later.
The party is chaotic, but the laughter of friends fills the venue. It seems like everyone is enjoying the light mood.
That's a strange look on your face. Did you eat something odd?
No, no. All the food here is delicious. But...
Surprised by the atmosphere of the party?
Heehee, we Iris love to party, too. If rarely.
We have so many unique members, after all.
Besides, you can only truly begin a new training regimen by healing your fatigue and putting yourself in top condition.
Isn't that right, Commander? Heehee!

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>5 A Sharp Glare</size>

scripts.say: On one day off, I go to the bookstore with Clemenceau.
Clemenceau?
Oh, Commander, I'm sorry. I was so absorbed in this book.
The book she's reading is called "On the Structure and Deconstruction of Drama."
I'm a little surprised that she's interested in theater.
Heehee, what's the matter? Do I look like I wouldn't be interested in fine arts?
That's not it, but...
From what I've seen of you, you don't seem the time to watch theater or opera.
Because you've only seen me busy. But of course, as someone who always preaches to the girls about the importance of rest...
Sometimes, I need to be a good example.
And you do that by watching plays?
Exactly. If you'd like, you should come with me next time.
But let's leave talk of the future for later. For now, let's enjoy... this one.
Clemenceau smiles and takes a new book off the shelf.
A mystery novel?
Yes. I like to pick a mystery novel, read only half of it, organize character relationships in my mind, and try to guess the culprit and their motive.
Once I'm done, I read the rest and check whether I'm right...
This is how I relax in my spare time.
Well, that's unique. In that case...
It means my mind is still sharp, and I've gotten value from my relaxation.
In that case, either the author is inexperienced at setting up satisfying puzzles, or...
Heehee. I'm just kidding.
Whether it's theater or deduction, really, there's no functional difference.
What satisfies me is new information stimulating my brain and feeling my mind sharpened.
It's fun, and sometimes, it brings inspiration.
Inspiration?
Hmm, I think we'd be here for a long time if I tried to explain. First, why don't we just pick out our books?
...I know. I choose this one. How about you, Commander?
(Oops. I was so busy chatting with Clemenceau that I didn't pick a book...)
Still not sure, hm? Heehee.
Then why don't I presumptuously take the liberty of recommending one to you?
Clemenceau smirks and takes another book from the shelf.
("Death on the Nile." That's a famous one, isn't it?)
(Okay, so she wants me to try relaxing like she does. Is that it?)
Thanks. I'll give it a read.
Good! I look forward to your thoughts, heehee♪

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>6 Cats and the Hunter</size>

scripts.say: Thanks to Clemenceau, we once again finish work early.
While I'm walking through the woods, I hear girls' voices up ahead.
C'mon... You're really just gonna stand there and not help me out?
Oh, did you need help? You sounded so excited, I thought you were having fun with those kitties.
Argh...!
Oh, Jean Bart, don't move. You'll make that poor little tabby fall.
Yeah, yeah...
Even when they're about to fall off, they keep trying to climb you... Heehee, these kitties really love you.
You might just be as exciting as catnip to them! Haha, I'm jealous~
Gonna have to disagree there...
Being loved by cute little animals is a blessing from the Iris. You should be grateful.
Richelieu, please...!
I follow the voices and find Jean Bart, covered in cats like some kind of cat tower.
Richelieu waves a cat toy around next to her...
...And Clemenceau looks on from the sidelines with a smile.
Good day, Commander.
Commander! Get over here and get these things off me!
We didn't leave the office together for once, and yet we run into each other again. Heehee!
"For once"...?
Enjoying a stroll, Commander?
I was just walking around, is all... Anyway, what are you punishing Jean Bart for?
I can't imagine this is anything but a cruel punishment, especially knowing how bad Jean Bart is with small animals.
Oh, please~ Richelieu simply said that she wanted to search for the lost kitty from the cat café.
We had Jean Bart join in the search.
Thanks to her help, we found the lost kitty. And we had such a good time in the process...
So you used Jean Bart's innate characteristics to attract the cat... That's a clever strategy.
Aww, thank you.
But now that you've found it, surely you could release her...?
That is true... But I think she has some willpower left in her, so we're going to put her to work to keep Richelieu smiling!♪

sequence:
Veiled in White

<size=45>7 Veiled in White</size>

scripts.say: Eventually, Clemenceau used a cat toy to lure them all away from poor Jean Bart.
After that, Richelieu took them back to the cat café, and Jean Bart's sister ships got her to go back to the Iris dorm.
Do you like cats, Clemenceau? You look like you're good at handling them...
I wouldn't say I especially "like" them. I'm not the best person to keep a pet.
Why do you say that?
Well, I don't like having to share the things I care about...
If I have a pet, it must be all mine.
It can't beg others for affection, and I don't want anyone touching it.
After all, if I'm to give it all of my love, then I want that in return.
(Though of course, even I know that I couldn't monopolize you if you were to become my pet...)
Heehee, anyway, that's enough talk of pets.
It's getting dark. Shall we get dinner?
Is your schedule free for once?
Of course. Even if I had plans, I'd drop them the moment you invited me out.
I already have a reservation at a restaurant with wonderful reviews. I've wanted to go there with you.
When did you...?
I'll never tell♪
After dinner, Clemenceau and I watch a play together.
When we leave the theater, the sky is already full of shining stars.
Despite the influx of work lately, I've been able to relax outside of work hours. That's all thanks to Clemenceau.
Maybe I'm finally experiencing that "work-life balance" that she mentioned.
Looking for books at the bookstore, watching plays at the theater, going to cat cafés and shopping, and...
Now that I think about it, I've spent all of my extra free time with her...
Oh? You finally figured it out, didn't you?
I didn't pick that mystery novel out for you just to help you relax.
I've kept a strict hold on your schedule in order to take advantage of my secretary ship position, adjust your plans, and make time just for us...
You know, it takes a lot of ingenuity to keep one Commander all to myself in a port practically bursting with girls.
Before I can comment on how perfectly she'd caught me in her trap, Clemenceau comes closer and pulls me into a hug.
I've already taken care of almost all of tomorrow's work, too.
The night is young... Where will it take us next~?

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Sudden Invitation</size>

scripts.say: I received a sudden invitation from my secretary...
Commander, you wanna join my team for a basketball game?

options.content: Yeah, Clevebro, I sure as hell do!

scripts.say: Stop calling me Clevebro already! ... Also, I'm not asking if you wanna play, I'm asking if you wanna be our coach!
Why, you may wonder? Hehe, you see, Akashi suggested it as a way to bolster relations between the Eagle Union and Sakura Empire. Although, we somehow ended up picking a competitive sport for it.
The format's 3x3... Basically, each team consists of 4 players against another team of 4! And since we'll be playing, I thought I'd ask you to be our coach!
There's a prize involved, of course! The winner receives — and get this — a money tree!
Well, it's not really a tree, it's a plant, but that means I can make a bonsai out of it! That's two birds with one stone! Anyway, please, Commander! Be our coach!
I knew that money doesn't actually grow on the plant she was referring to, despite its nickname... But I decided not to mention that and went along with becoming their coach.
... You'll do it? Sweet! I knew I could count on you!
Oh, right, we still have work to do! A lot of it, too. C'mon, let's get a move on!
I'll gather all the team members once we're done! Heheh, I haven't been this fired up in ages!
Sorry, getting sidetracked! For now, let's focus on this paperwork! Here, please stamp this thing.
Putting a pin in the basketball conversation for later, Cleveland got right back to work. It's just like her to be reliable like that.
But still, why did they choose a basketball tournament out of all things...?

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Knights, Group Up!</size>

scripts.say: Evening - In the gymnasium
Alright, everyone's in one place! And by everyone, I mean my little sisters, but... *Ahem*! Knights of The Sea, are you motivated?
Yeeaah!
……Yeeaah!
It looked like Cleveland had already assembled a team with 3 of her sister ships.
Okay, so, we'll be tackling a basketball tournament all as one team. For support, we'll have the Commander as our coach! Add some elbow grease and we have all the ingredients to win this thing!
Let's begin with a rundown of the tournament's rules! If you didn't catch anything, just tell me.
... Understood. Give me the order, and I'll wipe out every opposing team by myself if I have to.
No, no, Monty! We're not shooting anyone, we're playing basketball!
Oh, I get it. A basketball tournament will promote the spirit of teamwork while at the same clearing out some friction between us! You're a genius, sis!
Um, I didn't plan all THAT, but okay... *Sigh*... Columbia, you get the idea, right?
The gist of it, I guess... You basically wanted an excuse to show off to the Commander, right?
... W-wha?!
Cleveland blushed up to her ears.
NOW I get it! If you can form a bond with the Commander, the fleet will grow stronger for sure! Okay! If it makes everyone happy, then I'll do all in my power to help!

That makes sense... Listen here, Cleveland's gone out of her way to captivate you. From this moment onwards, you'll need to always stay within 16 feet of her. Pay attention to everything she says and does and don't forget any of it.
No, you guys have it all wrong! Listen to me, for crying out loud!

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Make It Grain!</size>

scripts.say: A few days later - At the gymnasium
*Pant*... *Pant*... Sorry I'm late!
While everyone was training hard for the basketball tournament, something rather unusual happened: Cleveland arrived late.
Phew... Sorry, guys! I had some business I had to take care of! — Oh, water? Thanks, Commander!
*Glug*... *Gug*... Ahhh! Just what I needed! Okay, okay, I'm late because I was just about done with my shift and...

... And I was like, "What?! San Diego's responsible for a forest of wheat growing in the lawn behind the dorm?" ... But, like, what's wrong with that? Why don't they get you can make food with the wheat...
And they're tellin' me, "If we just leave the wheat, the Fletchers are gonna play around in there.." But, like, there's not enough room for nearly 180 people back there; they like to play together...

Then they're all like, "Well the trees you gave away have been buried under all the wheat!" Well, I gave them away, so I don't really mind! But NOW they're all goin' on about these trees and trying to guilt me into caring about them and stuff...
But I, like, gotta go, you know, so I just said, "Okay, fine! I've got stuff to do, so we'll just have to harvest all that wheat super quickly! And stop calling me Clevebro!..."
In short, some of the girls from the Eagle Union dorm asked me to help... I'm really sorry I wasn't on time!
Cleveland apologized a few times before she settled down. She's been a part of my fleet for a long time, so I'd gotten pretty used to her doing that.
Let's get straight to the training! ... Actually, just a sec... Heeey! Guuuys! I brought some lunch boxes Helena put together! Let's eat later once we're done!
Thanks, sis! I owe you one!
Oh, sis, when will you learn? Helena's are great, don't get me wrong, but sometimes you just wanna eat one of Cleveland's lunches. Y'know what I mean, Commander?
H-huh, really? Then maybe I'll ask Helena about it next time... But only because you said you want it, Commander!

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Game Day</size>

scripts.say: Day of the basketball tournament - Assembly hall
Finally, the day has come... We're all ready, Commander! We'll be counting on your instructions during the match!
Good luck, Cleveland! If you win, I'll have Helena make more lunches for you!
H-hey! Don't make promises like that without my say!
Ahahahah... Yep, that's just like her. But that aside, let's discuss our strategy one more time! Time's money... you know the drill~
The first round was against the Justice Beavers.
Well met, friends! I'm afraid you stand no chance against our righteousness! Little Beavers, let's go! ... Wait, guys...?
Ugh, too bothersome for me... I'm sitting this one out.
Ahahaha! Spence looks like she's gonna trip again! ... Oh, shoot, we're gonna collide!
Oh no, oh no! Look out, we're gonna collide!
This is our chance! Let's alley-oop for the slam-dunk!
Cleveland's team won easily, making all the efforts of the Justice Beavers' coach, Downes, in vain.
Nice, we're off to a good start! If we keep this up, we'll win the finals! ... But the next one might not be so easy, heheh~
Thanks! Keep a watchful eye on us, Commander! We'll give it everything we have today!

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 5 - A Tough Team</size>

scripts.say: Cleveland's team went on winning match after match until it was time for the final round.
Next, we're up against... Wait, seriously?! Sendai, Agano, and Myoukou?!
Hmph, whatever. We'll mop the floor with them. Right, sis?
I doubt it'll be that easy... They're probably already working out a counter to our positioning... For this match, we've gotta be cautious.
Hooyah!
You're pretty tough after all... Guess that's why you're the flagship of Destroyer Division 3!
Not bad, you've managed to keep up with me... But this ain't gonna be a repeat of last time we met!
I don't care if you're a heavy cruiser... I'm not gonna let you win!
Come at me! I've trained long and hard for this, and I'm not planning on losing to you lot!
It's come down to a 1 on 1 for each of us...! They're using that strategy from way back then!
Are you displeased with my choice of tactics? *Giggle*, then say it to my face~
Cleveland's team was struggling with the strategy the opposing team was employing.
Dammit... I'm sorry, guys... It's all my fault for being such a poor leader...
We made it all the way to the finals... And if we lose here, all will have been for nothing...!
Then came the final half time. Though the match wasn't over yet, the Sakura Empire team had a pretty big point lead. Cleveland felt down, something she rarely does.

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 6 - From The Brink</size>

scripts.say: Cleveland's team went to cool down in the break room. They weren't exactly grumbling, but their faces showed signs of distress.
Thanks for trying to cheer me up, but this is all my fault... As the team leader, I'm trying to think of how to face everyone when we worked so hard to get here...
Especially since I was the one who dragged you all into this thing in the first place...
"I don't like seeing you depressed, Clevebro"?! ... Why do you keep calling me Clevebro?! Especially right now when I'm not feeling too great!
"If you don't want me to call you Clevebro, then get your act together and be the dependable bro the team needs"...?
Dammit, you're right! Let's rock and roll this thing! — Later, I'll make you regret calling me that!
Once Cleveland started getting fired up, the rest of the team followed shortly.
C'mon! We're not out of the game yet! We'll show 'em what the Knights of The Sea are truly made of!
Hooyah!
(Whispering) Thanks, Commander~
They're going to break through! Stop them from passing the ball, no matter what!
Crap! Now that they've formed up, our strategy ain't gonna work...!
For the team... and for the Commander... this victory is OOOOUUUURS!
HWEEEEEEE!
Just as the whistle marking the game's end sounded, Cleveland landed a powerful dunk through the opposing team's basket.
WE DID IT! WE WOOOON!
Immediately after scoring the winning goal, Cleveland came running over and threw herself at me.
Thank you, Commander! I love you!
Though she was exhausted from the match, her joy and excitement could be felt through her tight grip around me.

sequence:
Knights & Awards

<size=45>Chapter 7 - The Best Prize</size>

scripts.say: Port - Gymnasium
Cleveland was in high spirits as she was holding the prize — the "money plant" — over her head.
First place, baby! The prize isn't what I was expecting, but it's still worth growing!
So, let's... Huh? Commander, where's the team gone off to? I wanted to show them this thing, but I guess they left...
Oh, and uh... Sorry, Commander... I heard money grows on this thing... so I wanted to win and give it to you, so you'd have a bit more money on your hands...
Huh?! You knew all along money doesn't grow on it?! ... Then why didn't you stop me back when... Wait, did you WANT to do this...?
Cleveland blushed up to her ears again.
Even putting the money stuff aside, this was a good chance to look cool in front of you, but I failed to capitalize on it...
And in the end, you had to pick me up when I was feeling down... Oh well... All in all, how did I do during the tournament?
I put my hand on Cleveland's head and gently ruffled her hair.
"As Cleveland, the team captain, you really weren't all that cool"... I mean, we've already established that much...
"But as Clevebro, my secretary, you were hella cute"...
Huh?
Y-y-y-y-you think I was c-c-c-cute?!
U-uh, uh... Um... C-cute, m-me...? Ahh... Oh, man... I...
— H-hey, I told you to stop calling me Clevebro already!
Then, Cleveland — fidgety, but with tears of joy in her eyes — and I left the gymnasium together.

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Charge, Kent! </size>

scripts.say: ...... *Knock knock*.
Excuse me! Commander, thanks for―
Kent throws open the door like the bundle of energy she is, while still somehow managing to deliver the proper polite pleasantries.
...What’s that? I should relax and be myself? Ahahaha... I guess I am a bit nervous...
I’m so glad you chose me to be your secretary, Commander! I’ll worker harder than you ever thought possible!
As soon as Kent finishes speaking, she dives straight into her work.
I was a little worried at first, unsure if she could handle both maid and secretarial work, but...
Hey! Commander, don’t just stand there gawking, you’ve got work to do too! Come on!
Sure enough... I hurry to my seat and start planning the next day’s exercises—
Any trouble with your work, Commander?
While taking the tea she brewed for me, I realize that I have indeed been working very focused for some time now...
You’ve really been going at it for while. You’ve earned a rest!
Kent flashes a dazzling smile. A quick look behind her reveals that my office turned sparkly clean at some point.
Even the paperwork on the table is well organized. I guess you’d expect as much from one of the maids...
Heh heh~ I am a proper maid, you know! And I’m not even a little bit tired. Just tell me what to do next!
It seems like she’s having no trouble at all handling both her secretary and maid duties. But just as I’m pondering leaving everything in her capable hands...
...I hear a rustling!
Ah! Look out! Commander, there’s a bug!
By the time the words have left her mouth, Kent is already dashing after the bug crawling across the floor. And in that moment...
CRASH!!!!
Aww...! I just swept the floor...
Kent looks wistfully at the bucket of water she just knocked over while chasing the bug.
What can I say, Commander...? Ahaha.
R-right! I thought I’d have to mop the floor again, so I put the bucket there, and, well...
She starts looking for the missing bug as she speaks.
Alright! Just let me take care of this first and I’ll get right back to the floor. It’ll only take a moment! Now where is the little devil?!
...How do I put this? I guess I finally see the Kent I’m used to?
She’s reckless, and a bit brash, but that’s just the rough around her edges. It’s that positive attitude she brings to every situation that’s truly inspiring.

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Kent the Unbeatable! </size>

scripts.say: The first day may have seen a couple reckless accidents, but since then Kent has been handling her secretarial duties just fine.
And honestly, with all the work to be done around here, she does make things easier.
Done with my maid work! Time for secretary business!
Kent strides into the office with the same bright smile she always has. If only I could seize a share of that boundless energy...
Wait! Commander!
Just as I’m putting my papers back on the shelf, a loud shout from Kent stops me.
Let me see your sleeve?
I extend my arm, as requested... and Kent takes a moment to observe my sleeve—
Hmmm... So this button is misaligned.
Righto, Commander. Have a seat.
Kent takes out a sewing kit from her apron, sits strikingly close to me, and starts in with her needle.
I started carrying the sewing kit to fix all the buttons Suffolk loses while she works. Lucky, that~
Almost done. Don’t move...
Kent pulls my arm right up against her chest, and I keep my eyes locked firmly on her practiced technique...
Gulp...
I, erm... suddenly feel like my eyes are wandering.
You think I’m wearing too little? Oh... But if my clothes are too heavy, it’s a pain to get around...
We’ll come back to that one, Commander, I can’t sew with you that far from me! Get over here! C’mon! Right up against me!
With my resistance faltering and me very nearly smushing into her, Kent finally finishes sewing the button.
Stay still~ done! Lovely, that!
And Bob’s your uncle! Mmhmm. What a fine job I did!
Without even checking her work, she hurries to her feet.
Oh? What’s the matter, Commander? You seemed a tad off just now?
Oh, never mind! We’ve got way too much to do today! Call me if you need my help!
Kent flashes a carefree smile.
Seeing that smile makes me banish the thought of calling out her carelessness.
But I still file it away to bring up with her someday, gently...

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Feelings of Gratitude!</size>

scripts.say: Kent is later than usual today. Maybe she had a lot of maid business to take care of...?
―Sorry, Commander! I had a lot of maid business to take care of, that’s why I’m late!
I’ll have your tea in a moment― Oh, where’s the kettle? I thought I left it in the cupboard―
Seeing Kent scurrying around all flustered, I get up and shake my head.
You don’t want tea...? Hm? I’ll make mistakes when I’m too anxious...?
C-come on! Commander, I... Well, you’re not wrong...
Inhaaale... Exhaaale...
...Okay! Hehe, I’m nice and calm now.
After finishing her thought, Kent pats at her chest and sits down.
Anyway,Anyway, you really know me well, eh, Commander? I feel like you can see right through me!
I’d say there are still a lot of things I’d like to ask Kent—
Why do I talk like this? And why do I call myself Contestant Kent...? Ahaha, that’s what you’re wondering about?
Kent flashes a wonderful smile, balls her hands into fists, and raises them to the ceiling.
For absolutely no particular reason whatsoever!
I just think that if you put a lot of energy into your words, you’ll get other people excited along with you!
She’s downplaying a bit, sure, but her explanation still shows how she cares for the people around her.
Oh! How about this! Let’s have you give it a try, Commander! Come out and say something just like I would! Anything!
She rattles me with her sudden challenge, but——

options.content: Thank you, you really mean a lot to me.

scripts.say: ...I express my heartfelt gratitude to Kent.
L-let’s call it a day here! Commander... You, you can’t be so direct with these things... Oh my! I’m thirsty! I’ll make some tea!
After watching Kent rocket to her feet and hurry off to hide her embarrassment, I stand up to go after her.
She’s sure to be careless in her heightened emotional state, and all my teaware is in danger—

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Just Happened To! </size>

scripts.say: With my work done, for the time being, I stretch and peer out the window to find a beautiful, sunny day.
Lovely... Commander. Heading out for a walk on such a nice day would hit the spot, eh?
And after being cooped up in the office so much lately...
She’s right. I’ve been so busy with work, I haven’t seen much of the sun.
A walk every now and then is fine. I’ll head out with Kent.
Port - Outside the Office
That’s about enough! Back to the office th— Hm? Is that... Bismarck... and Prince of Wales?
Following Kent’s pointer finger, I see two figures standing under a large tree.
If it isn’t the Commander and... Kent, is it...?
"An unusual pairing"v...? No, we just bump into each other here from time to time.
You just happen to, eh? So what do you do here?
Suddenly, I hear a faint mewling sound overhead.
Is that... a cat?
Oh, there you are.
Bismarck lifts the brim of her hat and gestures with her eyes toward the top of the tree.
Following her gaze, I see a kitten clinging tightly to a high branch.
It seems its curiosity spurred it upwards, and now it can no longer get down.
Wales looks at the kitten, her tone revealing her concern. Bismarck seems to share that, but...
Getting the cat down will be no easy feat. We could get a ladder or something from Akashi...
Hey! You can leave this to Contestant Kent!
Kent makes her bold declaration without hesitation.
I have more than just physical strength! My competitive spirit is unrivaled among the Royal Maids!
Climbing a tree is a piece of cake for this Kent! Watch me get that kitty right down!

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Kent's Secret! (?)</size>

scripts.say: Up the tree I go! One~ Two~ Oof!
Kent grabs a thick branch with both hands and flips herself up the tree.
Before I can be moved by her feat, she’s already climbed even higher.
Stay right there, kitty~ Kent’s gonna save you. Just a little longer...
She’s so nimble... But couldn’t she stand to be a bit more ladylike?
True... with her climbing that tree in her dress, I’m back to my wandering eye problem... and such idle thoughts occupy my mind—
Creaaak...
Oh no! The kitten’s branch is about to break...
The sound draws our attention and we look to see the slowly bending branch giving way under the weight of the kitten.
Don’t worry! I’ve almost got you! I’ll be there in a second, don’t be scared―
The same instant Kent stretches out her hand, the branch buckles and snaps off.
Aaahh!
I throw out my arms to the falling kitten...
Just in the nick of time. It plops right into my hands.
Nice! Great job, Commander!
Kent’s happy voice calls down from overhead, and the kitten in my arms meows softly, with apparent relief.
Phew... I wasn’t sure what would happen there.
Bismarck and Prince of Wales share similar expressions of relief, and quickly turn around as if to leave.
As the little on is unharmed, I’ll be on my way, Commander.
Be sure to take the kitten somewhere safe, Commander. I’m off too—
The two who were once so concerned for a tiny kitten now beat a hasty retreat.
Oh, those two really can’t be honest with themselves. They obviously love cats.
The threads of fate tied the both of them together with cats... didn’t they?
Kent smiles and strokes the kitten. Could the same fate have cats for her too?
What? Did the threads of fate tie me up with cats just like those two?
Truth be told, I do have a thing for felines, but I’m more of a tiger girl than a housecat one!
Tigers... I guess I shouldn’t be surprised she’d go for the big cats.
Speaking of, I should probably head home. It’s been a long time since I slept with that one. He’s probably getting pretty lonely.
Yep, we’ll talk about tigers later!
Huh...? Don’t tell me Kent’s keeping a tiger as a pet.

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 6 - A Light in the Darkness! </size>

scripts.say: Here in the dead of night, just before the clock ticks over to the new day, I come to the very last of my reports.
As I’m about to clear it, I suddenly realize I’m missing a page... I think I know what happened...
Then I’ll be off, if you insist! You’ve also been working very hard today, Commander!
Oh! I already filed all the papers just the way you asked me to! Good night!
...The missing page must be in with those documents she filed earlier.
A quick rummage through the filing cabinets didn’t turn up what I was looking for.
But I need this done today... I guess I have to go ask her.
―We’ll talk about tigers later!
Kent’s words after the kitten rescue suddenly flash through my head.
There’s no way she’s actually got a pet tiger... right? With some apprehension, I drag myself to Kent’s door.
I knock lightly.
...No answer. I try turning the handle, not expecting it to so easily swing open.
She needs to be more careful... I try calling out to her from the entryway...
―Huh...? Commander?
Her sleepy voice calls back from the inside room. Relieved, I walk in and try to find her.
...What is it? I didn’t expect you so late... Yawn...
I grope around for the light switch while explaining the situation, to no avail.
Oh, the only light in the room is my bedside lamp over here. Just a second...
The small lamp flickering on punctuates her sentence―
Woah...?!
Wow! C-Commander, why the scream? !
The glow of the lamp reveals course fur, huge fangs, and a pair of deadly sharp pupils.
No matter which way you look at it, that’s a tiger!
Wait! Stay calm! Kent’s here!
Huh? A wild animal...? Oh! You don’t mean this guy? !
Kent finally puts it together and peeks out from behind her terrifying “tiger” to explain.
...It’s a stuffed animal I used to sleep with.
I guess it’s pretty realistic. With the lights out and all, I could see how he’d give you a fright... Haha...
The room’s gloomy environs only make the “tiger” that much more lifelike...
My work’s still not done, and I’m already exhausted...

sequence:
Unbridled Positivity

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Together Forever!</size>

scripts.say: Kent has been my secretary ship for quite some time now.
We have a much deeper understanding of each other than we did on that first day.
So I know when I tell her this, she’ll definitely say—
—Wonderful! I can hardly contain myself! Oh... sorry, Commander! I have to go see!
She’s still reckless as she ever was. She’s already rushing off “somewhere”.
Well, I might as well go with.
Kent catches sight of me, having been there a while already. She waves her arms excitedly with a big smile on her face.
HEY! Commander! Is this the new office?
It is. We’re moving my office to a new building.
The general layout hasn’t changed, but the new office has a dedicated seat for Kent, as well as a kitchen and sewing equipment.
Also... her little tiger friend.
Now this is a place I could spend all day! What do you think, Commander?
Will you want to stay with me?

options.content: I want to stay by your infinitely energetic side.

scripts.say: Heh heh... When you come out and say it like that, how could I refuse?
I share a good laugh with Kent... I think it’s going to be another busy, joyous day.
You’re with Kent forever now, Commander!

sequence: SOS received from the Floating Fortress.
Support fleet assembly in progress.
Designated Flagship: KMS Bismarck
Some time after the defeat of the high-level Siren program, Compiler...

scripts.say: Correct heading, clear visibility... But looks like we have some rough weather on the horizon.
But that's nothing you and I can't overcome, Lord Bismarck!
Heehee... You know, I'm so glad I get to sortie with you once more.
I can't wait to get out there and do some good work!
Just don't be reckless. Both of us might be a bit rusty after all this time.
Got it. I'll be careful!
Because if I go down, who else is gonna cover you?
Heh, that's true. You are my steadfast little Parzival, after all.
I'll be careful as well.
Not everyone has the fortune of getting a second chance like me.
I've already had my fair share of tempting fate... and there are so many people counting on me.
Lord Bismarck...
Forgive me for bringing up such a heavy topic.
I'll make it up to you by taking you to a concert after we get back.
No, no, I'm fine. All that matters is that you're safe and sound, Lord Bismarck.
And I swear, I'll lay down my life for you if anyone tries to hurt you ever again!
Haha. You're too diligent for your own good, but I appreciate it.
Alrighty then, I'll scout ahead for now! Please follow my lead!
(You've already more than fulfilled your promise, my friend. This time, I'll be the one to protect you...)
(I'll use my new strength to that end...)
U-556 sailed ahead of her eagerly, sometimes looking around, other times dipping into the ocean before leaping out like a dolphin.
This small girl had once ferried her corrupted hull away from the brink of destruction.
She followed behind her friend's frolicking figure, inexplicable feelings swirling around her chest.
...What's this? An urgent message?
It's from Scapa Flow. The gate is acting up, it seems.
I must see what's wrong with it. It's time we said goodbye for today.
In the meantime, don't use the Tower of Midgard under any circumstances. Is that clear?
The very world depends on it. Goodbye.
(Our teleporter began to act up around the same time the Royal Navy's did...)
(Worse yet, we've lost all contact with the Floating Fortress that houses it at around the same time the Royal Navy reported their issues.)
(The possibility of a Siren attack is high, but with Peter Strasser and Ulrich von Hutten stationed there, combat prowess should be the least of our concerns.)
(One thing is clear– we can't afford to let our guard down.)
(If they have the capacity to launch a multi-pronged attack like this... we may well be dealing with a META or Ashes enemy.)
(Whatever the case, time is of the essence.)
Fortress Support Fleet - Rendezvous point
Dark clouds covered the seas, with distant thunder rumbling now and then.
Amidst the rain, two girls made their way to the rendezvous point to meet with Bismarck.
What terrible weather... How am I supposed to scout anything out with this awful visibility?
Just deal with it. You can't exactly reschedule for better weather when there's an emergency.
It'd take too long to send a fleet from back home, so we're the only ones who can respond in time, along with Bismarck herself.
You're not going to let a little storm get in the way of your duties, are you?
It's not the rain I'm concerned about. You know how high-ranking Sirens and abnormal weather tend to go hand-in-hand.
Sure, but what are you afraid of? We already took down Compiler.
That's ONE. How many more are out there? Purifier and Omitter, just to name a couple.
...Hold on, I'm seeing a strange silhouette to our twelve.
H-huh?! It's not a Siren, is it?
Long hair, big guns, and rigging that looks like it has a life of its own...
PLEASE tell me one of our colleagues forgot to RSVP, and that's not a Purifier right ahead of us...
Ugh! Let's get out of here for the time being, and apologize to Bismarck later.
It miiiight be a tad late for that. Look, it's approaching us at high speed~
Dammit... Then, then... Make a break for it while I cover you!
Get some backup while I keep the elite at bay!
...Huh?
Aircraft carriers are more important to the Iron Blood fleet than destroyers, so... You have to get out of here safely!
Wait, sorry, I took the joke too far... I was just kidding!
Look, you don't have to console me. I've already come to terms with my greater purpose...
I'll hold 'em back. You go and tell Bismarck–
Would you stop and use your eyes? They're an ally!
Horns, long hair, and a wing-like cape...
Oh, uhh... During the mission briefings... There was something about meeting up with a "rigging tamer," right?
Wait, were they talking about Regensburg?
Now you're finally using your head.
What the hell! Why didn't you say anything earlier?
I mean, you had the right answer... before your mind went on a magical journey, anyway.
...What's the matter with you two?
Frightened by my Regina? Upset stomachs, perhaps?
It's... nothing. We've been waiting for you.
You okay? Encounter anything on the way here?
A handful of stray Sirens. They made a decent meal for my Regina.
Where's Bismarck? Has she not arrived yet?
More like, we haven't. We're not at the rendezvous point just yet.
Then what are we standing around for? Chop-chop!
I've waited long enough to fight side by side with Bismarck as it is!
Yes, yes, whatever you say...
Okay, I get it! Stop pushing me!

sequence: "Friedrich, how are you feeling?"
"The performers have gathered, and I am ready to conduct."
"I'll ask you one last time– are you sure about this?"
"Of course. For power to serve as a deterrent, it must be displayed."
"The symphony must be played to its conclusion."
"Very well. Carry out the plan then."
"We're ready when you are, Enterprise."
"Good."
"Begin the mission."

scripts.say: ...Take me with you.
No, I need you to stay here.
But, I'm already familiar with what your plan is. I can–
Enough. This symphony has no more room for revision.
Focus, Ulrich. You still have your part to play.
Within a dream, Ulrich was reunited with a friend she had been separated from.
She was once a conductor of the battlefield who played music as effortlessly as she played her foes. Now, she lay on the ground, powerless.
This can't be the ending you wanted, Friedrich.
Alone, surrounded by fire and destruction, with neither friends nor foes for company.
Hmph... So much for the High Seas Fleet you had such hopes for.
If only you had trusted me... This wouldn't have happened to you...
Who did this to you?
If you're still alive, answer me! Answer me!!
Only the strident death throes of metallic beasts answered her cries.
Even had you managed to get the Eagle Union and Sakura Empire on the same page, would they have listened to you?
You can't change anything... Not Bismarck, not you.
Click, clack... Footsteps were drawing closer.
In this place where she did battle against an Arbiter and lost, she was no longer alone.
...Is this the nightmare that haunts your heart, Ulrich?
...Bismarck. You abandoned Iron Blood when it needed you most... Why are you showing your face again now?
It's over, Bismarck. We've already lost the war.
Look around. Our counterattack was a failure. Everyone we know is dead, and for what? The Arbiter still lives.
So why even come here? What the hell do you want?!
I know what happened.
Friedrich liberated us from forever being slaves to the Sirens' Reenactments.
But, you. You sought the power of the Black Cube. You would've had us dancing in the palms of their hands.
You charged ahead without saying anything to us. You left us behind to fend for ourselves!
I know what happened.
What do you know?! You've done jack shit for us!
Friedrich and Eugen worked their asses off while you lay in a sickbed!
And now, after it's all over, you finally decide to show your face?!
I know what happened.
Why aren't you defending yourself? Why aren't you saying anything?
How? Why? Are you a coward? Have we been led by a coward this whole damn time?!
I have nothing to say. What you said is true.
Thank you for being honest with me, Ulrich.
It's true that I've made mistakes, and that I've let down my country and my friends. But, allow me to correct one thing–
Iron Blood has not fallen.
ROOOAAAR!
I see... So, it was all a dream after all...
You knew?
Like a vague itch in the back of my mind. I somehow knew it wasn't real, but didn't want to snap out of it either.
Perhaps because it reflected my heart's deepest desires, just as you said...
All I wanted... was to fight by Friedrich's side.
I know what happened.
And, I wanted to look for someone to blame.
Yes... I know.
Iron Blood's survival was thrown into jeopardy because of my actions.
And in my absence, you received immense pressure from all sides. From the other factions, from the Sirens, even from the Naval HQ.
Despite that, and despite the toll it took on you, you and many others worked selflessly to protect Iron Blood.
I won't say I know how hard it was for you, but I will say this – thank you.
Thank you for your commitment to Iron Blood, Ulrich von Hutten.
You have some nerve. I feel like punching you.
Of course, I won't. You are our leader, after all.
If you really did do it, I wouldn't hold it against you.
Do you still feel like you're dreaming? It's almost time to go.
Yeah. There's still something in my head, screaming a whole lot of nonsense...
Am I... going to turn META?
Not necessarily. While I detect the corruption taking hold in your hull, it can still be stopped.
I understand what you're going through, to feel like you're being crushed beneath overwhelming despair.
But, you've managed to hold on to your sanity. That is already remarkable and worthy of hope.
I thought METAmorphosis was irreversible? Isn't it only a matter of time?
Normally, yes. But, Queen Elizabeth and the Commander gave us an invaluable hint.
While existing corrosion cannot be reversed, externally-induced cases such as yours...
Can be baited out with a more suitable "host."
Geryon let out a mighty roar, and the nightmare surrounding Bismarck and Ulrich shattered into pieces.
But even as the fragments of illusion fell away, the attack did not end there.
As if responding to the situation, a black-and-red haze gushed out from Ulrich's body and began to lurch towards Bismarck.
The shadowy substance climbed up her body and rigging like a ravenous beast, shaking wildly as if reveling in a successful hunt.
It seemed as if she would become its next victim.
Interesting. So this is the same energy as the shockwaves given off by the black tornado from the Northern Parliament's data files.
A risky gambit, but well worth the effort.
Geryon, devour it.
ROOOAAAR!
The voice... It's gone?
(It's as if her rigging completely dispelled the haze... But how is it possible to do something like that?)
You said something about a "host"...
The nightmare you experienced is a conceptual attack on the very thing that makes up our being – the Wisdom Cube.
Our riggings share this same concept, and essentially are extensions of our hulls with the same properties.
By temporarily strengthening the concept of the hull within a powerful, autonomous being, Geryon became the strongest "concept" of a shipgirl here.
Furthermore, I've already experienced a severe degree of corruption in the past, and am better equipped to deal with it.
Alright, alright, I get it. I'm too tired to listen to your technobabble right now.
Hah. There's the Ulrich I know.
Yeah. Feels pretty damn good now that my head's finally clear for the first time in forever.
Wait, hold on a sec... What happens next now that your rigging went and absorbed all that nasty gunk?
You've taken on the corruption, but what are you going to do if you can't get rid of it?
You should already know how dangerous this is. Why would you, the leader of Iron Blood, shoulder this risk for me?
Because things will change this time, Ulrich. I sincerely believe it. But more importantly...
Because you, Gneisenau, and U-556...
You're more than just my subordinates. You're my friends, my family.
Bismarck offered her hand out to Ulrich, who hesitated for a moment before finally accepting it.
Ulrich, we need you. Not just me or Iron Blood, but all of us.
Together, we can forge a brighter future.
Yeah. I'm with you.
Ulrich straightened herself out before turning to face Bismarck. No longer was there any doubt or loneliness in her eyes.
Glad to have you back. Let's go get the others.
Mirror Sea - α phase, inside the tower
Thank goodness the two of you are fine!
Ulrich looks like she's doing a whole lot better too.
Would you look at that. Everything turned out okay in the end.
Yeah. Doubt that nightmare's ever coming back to haunt me.
I still feel a little out of it, but I'll be back to normal before you know it.
Did anything happen while I was inside the control center?
Actually, yes. As ordered, we stood on standby at the end of the corridor.
At first, everything was normal, but then something rather strange happened.
We all felt a palpable sense of danger in the air, and then saw a strange black mist seeping out from the doorway...
Gneisenau was about to rush in to check on you, but that oppressive feeling dissipated as quickly as it had come on.
That pretty much brings us to where we're at now.
What was that thing?
That energy is strong enough to corrode a shipgirl's hull. There's no way something like that could just vanish into thin air.
What did you do, Bismarck?
I took a little gamble, that's all. Thanks to Queen Elizabeth and the Commander's findings, we have more insight into how Wisdom Cubes manifest their power.
Combined with Scharnhorst's research, we now have the technology to temporarily redirect this corrosive energy into our riggings and neutralize it to a certain extent.
It doesn't address the root of the problem, but at least it'll provide us some resistance to META corruption from external sources.
In other words... We won't have to worry about getting knocked out by that black energy or getting trapped inside a nightmare?
That's great news. We'll have a fighting chance against whatever it was that got its hands on U-556, right?
I see... You've found a way to stem the corruption.
I was right to place my trust in you, Bismarck.

Bismarck! U-556! Are you alright?
Where... am I...?

U-556 and Bismarck regained their footing and listened to the META girls' conversation.
Arizona... You...

And Helena? Where is she?

CRACK...

*cough, cough*! Urgh...

Nngh...
She's finally back to normal!
Whoa, hey! I'm soaking wet right now! Hugging me just feels icky!
Give her some space. She needs to recover.
Right. My bad...
You had me worried sick, you know... I thought you'd never be the same again.
Well, now I am, so it's all good!
Seems everything turned out fine in the end.
I sent you the data. I trust you to take care of the aftermath.
Yes... It's all here. I'll take care of it.

Yes. I got what I was looking for.
All you need to do now is activate the Tower of Midgard's gate one last time, and you should be sent back home.

I'm guessing you're not thinking about coming with us.

Destroy it? Are you serious?

Yes, I do.
