Leave it intact, and one day, the corrosion will come flooding through the gate and spread through your whole world.
If you don't want that to happen, you must destroy it.
...Very well. I swear the Tower of Midgard will be destroyed as soon as possible.
Good. You should get moving now, while the Arbiters have their eyes on me.
At the Mirror Sea's heart, the open gate shone with a bright blue light.
The massive machine rumbled and roared, presenting the girls with a way home.
Vestal, thank you for everythiiing!
With a final goodbye from U-556, the Iron Blood girls' long excursion was finally over.
I'm sure our paths will cross again.
A while after Vestal watched the group disappear in the light, the communicator in her hand started beeping.
...I wondered when you were going to call me.
...So, tell me, The Tower XVI...
What will you do now?
Floating Fortress - Area A1
Whew... It's good to be home again.
I wonder if Queen Elizabeth solved her Singularity issue.
Might as well call her and ask.
Bismarck opened up a communication channel.
She called up the queen, but the only thing on the other end was white noise.
Huh? That's strange...
Confused, she then attempted to get in touch with her comrades on the Iron Blood mainland, as well as those attending the World Expo.
But, again, the only thing she heard was white noise.
Is the Mirror Sea's jamming field still active? That's really odd...
Bismarck, I've finished my inspection.
How are the others holding up?
Just fine. They're all still sleeping like babies.
...Anything else that's wrong with them?
There's nothing wrong with them, medically speaking.
They're just sleeping. That's all.
Very well. Continue monitoring them.
As you say.
Bismarck gazed through the window in her office. The Tower of Midgard's light was fading.
They had promptly shut off the gate and deactivated the facility as soon as they got back.
It's supposed to be over. Everything should be back to normal, and yet...
Destroying the Tower of Midgard really is the only way, it seems.
She observed the silent tower whilst weighing its pros and cons in her head.
Ulrich, do you hear me?
Loud and clear. What's up?
Are you done inspecting the tower?
Still working on it. It's gonna take a lot of time if you want me to be thorough.

– Bismarck... – Ulrich...
Ahah. We both had the same thought, huh?
...Are we really going to destroy it?
...Yes.
It has served its purpose. If Friedrich were here, she would agree that destroying it is the correct move.

Make backups of all the project files on it as well. Once that's done, demolish it.
Got it. I'm on it.
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
A sea dyed deep red. This battlefield had become a grave shipyard – the final resting place for dozens of smoking wreckages.
Friedrich lay on her back in the water, gazing silently into the distance.
Although her rigging had suffered terrible damage, the light of determination still glimmered in her eyes.
KABOOOM!
The Hermit fell to her knees, Enterprise META having dealt the final blow.
...You did good, keeping her busy.
No need to thank me.

This space has been successfully sealed. The Hermit cannot get help from other Arbiters.

As for Temperance, she's started evacuating.
As has Strength. They must be pretty freaked out over The Hermit's disappearance.
This was an insanely risky gamble. I can't believe this fool's errand worked.

Time to check on our prey.
We meet again.
...What are you going to do?

That's it? That's your plan?
Should've figured. You Ashes have absolutely no idea what you're doing.
Do yourselves a favor and give up already.
We have you by the neck, yet you still act like you have the upper hand.
"You can't do anything without Zero's express permission." That's what you're thinking.
What if I told you I have an emergency identification code from the Creator?
What?! No, you're lying! No such thing exists!
Oh, but Anzeel showed it to me once.
It so happens I remember it.
You can't threaten me, Code G. Zero will know the instant you use that.

All you'll do is create one more thing that wants you dead.
We'll see if that's true, once we've made a few changes to your mainframe.
What?! What are you going to do to it?!
Stop it with your fake human reactions. You calculated that this would happen long ago.
Thinking about blowing yourself up? Not gonna work.
This space was made specifically to contain you.
You know you've lost connection to your mainframe. Don't kid yourself.
Where... Where did you get the technology to sever me from it?
In a distant place long ago, Antiochus.
When Anzeel requested help with testing your kind.
You've sat on this trump card for ages, yet never used it before? You're bluffing.
I never cared about your equipment.
But, that was then. I've changed my mind.
It's sinking in now, isn't it? You've lost.
Once I find where your mainframe is, you're going to–
The very atmosphere seemed to vibrate violently–
...What was that?
Enterprise! There's some huge thing coming right towards us!
What?!
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
A young girl dressed in black stood in front of a control device, making changes of some sort.
Then, she heard footsteps from behind her. Someone entered the room.
Devil, got a moment?
Didn't catch you at a bad time, did I?
Oh, it's you. Surprised to see you here.
I'M the one who's surprised.
Where have you been? I couldn't trace you.
What are you doing inside Hermit?
Ugh, give me a break...
Look, we have a lot in common, don't we?
So tell you what. I'll give up peacefully. Happy?
I'll let you off the hook this time, but you still have to repay me for breaking my lens.
Oh, for... That's your fault for letting rats inside.
They're chinchillas.
Same difference.
I've got important stuff to do, so let's just pretend we didn't see each other. Deal?
That depends on your answer to this next question.
Who's that behind you?
Somewhere in the ocean...
The moonlight splashed across the ocean, only blemished by a solitary figure crossing beneath it.
But suddenly, she slows her steps.
You've entered the Vichya Dominion's territorial waters. State your name, affiliation, and purpose.
Come on out already, Algérie~
You noticed?
You've gone soft, my dear~♪
Want to test me? ...Hmm?
Nah, I'll pass for today. I don't mind taking an L here or there.
...Wait, you're wounded.
It's just a scratch. Once I head home and sleep it off, I'll be fine in no time.
How's everything going at the Tribunal?
Not sure what to say... It feels like everyone's sneaking off doing their own things.
So, it's not too late for me to come back?
Oh, and hear anything from Clemenceau?
Yes, but I'll only tell you after you come back to base.
You'd best take care of those wounds, after all.
A woman's voice echoed across the chamber of a cathedral.
"Listen! Everyone has gathered at the same place."
"There are those from Sardegna, who would pick up stone and mortar, some who would become lost."
"There are those from the Royal Navy, who would erect a white castle; and those from the Iron Blood, who would build a tower to reach the heavens."
"O, Awe-inspiring Avalon, Magnificent Midgard!"
"This is why they gather – to spread their own glory!"
O, Heavenly Father–
Will you not cast your judgment upon these sinners?
Shortly afterwards...
...Um, are you done yet?

Well, that makes no freakin' sense! Is that supposed to be some kind of prophecy?
So, let me tell you what I saw instead...
Splendrous victory! Ahahahahahahaha!
Mirror Sea - α phase
In a place where time and space seemed to blur together, only the brightly-shining Tower of Midgard provided any sense of direction.
Woah... So pretty. It's like we're walking on the Milky Way!
And what do you think those giant cubes floating in the distance are?
Right, sorry! Now's not the time for sightseeing!
So, uh... Where the heck are we?

Correct. We came under attack, and everyone else except us fell into a coma.
I know that– I went to check out the situation... But that doesn't explain why the Tower of Midgard is still here even after we went through the gate!
I thought it was supposed to be a doorway to a different Mirror Sea, but does it actually function as a teleporter? Or, is this a different tower altogether?
When it comes to traveling across branches, there may be some variance in where you appear.
Do you think you can use it to teleport to a certain location if given precise coordinates, like the Royal Navy's gate?
Put that aside for now. Notice anything unusual about this place?
Look at the surface of the water. It doesn't properly reflect what's in the sky.
Oh, you're right! The positions of the stars don't match at all, and I don't see the moon at all!

By carefully observing my surroundings, rather than prancing around like a little kid.

You can ask her yourself once we find her.
Let's hope she hasn't wandered too far from here.
Yeah. Let's get a move on!
Err... Yeah, I should probably search for her with my planes first...
I'm on it! Just a sec!
Mirror Sea - α phase
It did not take long for Zuikaku's eyes in the sky to spot Ulrich von Hutten.

Just... a little more...
We finally found you, Ulrich!
...Ulrich? Are you okay?
Don't you recognize me? What's wrong?
Ulrich did not respond in any way, simply continuing to shuffle forward.
Her eyes were empty, and though she muttered to herself, it seemed as though her consciousness had detached from her body.
Ulrich! Snap out of it!

Stop. She might be trapped in a nightmare, and we don't know what the risks are of forcefully rousing her.
Trapped in a nightmare...?
Wait, hold on! I think I've seen something like this before!

When and where?

Do you think Ulrich might be affected the same way?

Do you have any idea what caused those hallucinations?
At the time, we were all bumbling around in the fog, plus there was so much confusion...

Hmm... I thought as much.
Do you know anything about her?

And I still have a score to settle.

Mirror Sea - α phase, inside the tower

How in the world does she know her way around? Isn't she basically sleepwalking?
Plus, this place's layout is nothing like what it looks like on the outside!
There's no way in hell this place is the actual Tower of Midgard!
Agreed. While I'm no expert on the tower's interiors, it definitely wasn't this convoluted.
(Ulrich's moving around like a puppet pulled by strings. If my gut instincts are correct...)
Zuikaku! We're getting closer to the source of her nightmares!
We need to knock Ulrich out of it right now, even if we have to rough her up a bit.
On it! Wait, hold on, she's coming to a stop in front of a dome of some sort...
What is that thing...?

Friedrich...
Woah, do you see that, Gneisenau?

DAMN IT!!

Get a hold of yourself, Ulrich! Urgh–!!
Zuikaku! Get behind me!

All readings look normal. Seems we made it safely.
Yeah, we made it. But, we have no idea where we are or what this place is.
Heehee. Elbe will be so jealous when she finds out I've seen the other side of a Singularity~
*sniff, sniff*... Wow, even the air around here smells totally different.
So this is what it's like to travel to a different world!
This isn't right...

Do you think it's some kind of alchemy circle?

Whoa! So like, we're on an alien planet?

Any signs of Ulrich or the other missing people, Jade?

No Sirens either, I take it?

Alright. Let's move ahead to investigate the tower. Jade, keep your planes out and let me know if you find anything.
We'll need to examine those strange cubes as well as the "boundary" around this area, but those things are lower priority.
We need to locate Ulrich first.
U-556, submerge and keep your eyes open. Report to me if you spot anything.
Got it! Parzival of the Seas won't let anything slip by undetected!
What a reliable knight. Now, let's go.
Lord Bismarck! Something's rising to the surface!
KABOOOM!

What incredible power... We would've been done for if we got caught in that.
Jade! What's the status?

There's a ton of enemies surfacing from beneath the waters!

Seems we've walked into an ambush... Enemies are starting to close in on us from all directions!

The same model Ulrich fought when she made contact with the METAs, right?
Not only are they extremely dangerous, but they can also continue posing a serious threat even without a command unit!
There's no way we can handle those numbers all by ourselves!
This is bad. REALLY bad!
KABOOOM!

What the...?
Bismarck...?
What's going on?

Geryon, become an iron temple! Do not allow harm to befall our friends!
ROOOAAAR!

Yeah! Show 'em how it's done, Geryon!
"Geryon"? Is that what your new rigging is called?
Why so surprised? I'm far from the first to name my rigging.
Don't get me wrong, I like the name. But how in the world did you–
We'll talk about it later. A third barrage is coming.
KABOOOM!
Bismarck once more pivoted into a defensive stance, protecting her allies while they took evasive maneuvers.
Explosions once again filled the sky, but even the few shells that appeared on target did nothing more than reflect off Bismarck's rigging.
What would have otherwise been certain destruction was turned into little more than a fireworks show beneath the massive iron wings.
Wooooah... What is that magnificent rigging?
I've never seen anything like it before...
I... I'm totally speechless...
Ahem... Let's, uh, first get back into formation.

We finally get to witness Lord Bismarck's TRUE power!
The power of the Type Zwei!
You knew she had it all along?
Well, duh!

And now that you all know, you also have to keep it a secret for now!
Yes. It's experimental and has hardly been tested, so I'd appreciate it if you'd keep quiet about it.
So this is the absolute power of a superior being... I've seen the light...
Lord Bismarck, let's launch our counterattack!
Whatever happens, I'll fight with you until the very–

A moment later, she staggered, letting out a scream as if her whole body had been wracked by an electric shock.
U-556? What's wrong?!
A black mist crept up from the water beneath U-556 and started to coil around her body rapidly.
KABOOOM!
A FOURTH volley?! Why haven't they given up already?
Damnit... Geryon! To me!
ROOOAAAR!
Lord Bismarck... don't worry... about me...
Protect... the others...

Towards the one she vowed to protect – the one she admired so – the one she had already saved in the past, and was now trying to save once more.

Bismarck's display of overwhelming power rallied her allies and neutralized the threat of what should have been a deadly enemy.

What happened to U-556?
Why did she suddenly... get swallowed up by that black mist?

When I sank following the battle with the Royal Navy long ago, she dove into the water to save me.

Her close proximity to me must've caused some erosion to her Wisdom Cube, though not to the same extent.
What we just witnessed... might be related to that.
Just like an old wound opening back up, huh?

How did you get better? Can't you give her a brand new rigging like yours?
It's hard to say. Her recovery seemed on-track with standard medical treatment, and there are still limitations with the rigging technology...

This is my fault for underestimating the extent of the Black Cube's corruption...
Just then, the vivid imagery of U-556 just before she disappeared beneath the waves flashed through Bismarck's mind.

(I didn't notice it during the battle, but that must've been what caused U-556 to relapse.)

Sadly, I can't see much of anything right now other than Sirens in the distance.

Everyone, follow me. We're going after the Siren fleets.
Full speed ahead to the tower!
A deep red sky, a murky, jet-black sea.
Burning wreckages smashing together before disappearing beneath the waves.
This place is...
Yes, I remember now...
My hunting grounds... and my grave...
KABOOOM!
Gneisenau's cannons rang out, tearing the smoldering husks around her into fine dust that was carried away on the wind.

Her existence had become nothing more than wandering this vast, boundless ocean, destroying everything in sight.
Yes... That is the sole purpose I have left.
I don't need to think or feel. I need only destroy my enemies.

The acceleration of a torpedo that should not exist. A foe that was not of Siren origin.
New... reinforcements?

*SPLASH!!*

How are you here? And what became of you...?!
You're... just like me now! A cursed husk of your former self!
Need to hurry... I need to go back...
U-556 ignored Gneisenau. She dove beneath the waves once more, heading straight towards a light in the distance.
The Tower of Midgard? That can't be... It doesn't exist in my branch...
No, I see... I understand now...
This is just a dream. A hallucination drawn from my memories.
I've already rediscovered my reason to fight... So I don't have time to waste on these illusions!
...How could I have been careless enough to fall prey to the Arbiter's hallucinations?
I must've fallen unconscious after that shockwave back in the control room...
Right... Ulrich, Zuikaku, and the control room...
She looked around and saw she was on the tower's outer ring.
And not far from her, there was another shipgirl, lying unconscious on the ground.
Looks like I'll have to make some noise to wake her up...
I really should bring some blanks next time.
KABOOOM!
Mirror Sea - α phase, inside the tower
That sounded like cannon fire!
I heard it too! Someone must be fighting!
It's coming from the outer ring platform. Jade, send some planes there to see what's happening.
On it!
Quickly now, everyone! We have quite some distance to cover!
Mirror Sea - α phase, tower outer ring
*pant*... *pant*... I've found the target!
I had a hunch it was you all when I saw those Iron Blood aircraft.
I see you've learned to use the Type Zwei rigging, Bismarck.
Ah, I've never shown it to you before, have I?
I owe you and the Commander thanks for helping me stand once more. You have my gratitude.
Don't mention it. I only did what needed to be done.
Zuikaku, I'm glad you're safe.
Y-yeah, I'm fine! Hope I didn't make you worry!
(Is that really Bismarck? I'm still a bit woozy after waking up...)
(Her rigging seems completely different, both in looks and size!)
Sorry for asking, but... is that rigging yours?
Indeed. This is the Type Zwei rigging, a collaborative effort with my life on the line, quite literally.
But, you can just call him "Geryon."
I didn't mean to hide his existence from you, but this technology is still highly experimental.
Had we not encountered an emergency situation, I would've preferred to not bring him into combat.
After we get back, I'll be glad to answer any questions you have. Before that, however, I'm afraid we need to talk business first–
Why was the Tower of Midgard activated, and where is Ulrich?
It's a bit complicated, but let me explain–
So, this began as a conceptual attack that placed everyone from Iron Blood into a deep sleep. Ulrich was manipulated through these hallucinations to activate the Tower of Midgard.
It's at least a relief to know that their lives are not in any imminent danger.
Thank you, both of you, for explaining the situation and for coming to aid Ulrich.
I mean, I haven't done anything worthy of thanks yet...
Just curious, did you guys not sense the shockwave that knocked me and Gneisenau out?
Uhh, don't think so? We had our hands full with the Sirens.
If it even reached us, it probably had already fizzled out to the point of not being noticeable.
I didn't sense anything of the sort either.
If it had the same effect on us, the Sirens would've turned us into mincemeat.
Didn't notice anything here. Regina says the same thing.
That makes sense... Energy does dissipate as it travels, after all.
But, if none of you felt anything... What happened to U-556?
If I had to speculate, I'd say she started undergoing METAmorphosis.
METAmorphosis? You really think so?
What makes you say that?
I was actually trapped in a hallucination myself during that time frame. I only was able to snap out of it because U-556 attacked me.
I clearly remember, she looked very similar to how I look now.
I see... Where is she now?
She likely went inside the Tower of Midgard.
Before I managed to completely shrug off the influence of the hallucination, I saw a pillar of light in the distance.
That's a signal that someone activated the gate.
...I need you two to come with me.
We must head for the control center and see if Ulrich is there.
Mirror Sea - α phase, inside the tower
There she is!
Ulrich!
No! Stay away!
Bismarck, you feel it too, don't you? The aura coming from the control room is making my stomach turn.
Going in unprepared is dangerous. We should find another way.
I know that feeling. Her hull is undergoing corrosion as we speak, but it might not be too late if we act now.
Gneisenau, take the others away from the door.
Wait outside the door. No, just to be safe, at the end of the corridor. I'll handle this.
You can't be serious, Bismarck! You already know the risks of being exposed to further corruption–
Don't worry about me. I'll be fine.
Stick together. I'll call you once I'm done.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>1 Soulless Art</size>

scripts.say: Port – Office
As I focus on work, from the corner of my eye I see something whir by the window.
I look up and my gaze meets someone hiding behind the windowsill.
Eep...!
Her emerald hair sways as she hides skittishly like a tiny animal.
...Raffaello?
...Meow, meow!
Are you trying to fool me by pretending to be a cat?
Ehehehe... You got me~☆
Raffaello peeks out her head and enters my office confidently, her usual sketchbook in hand.
What were you observing today? The ants crawling across windowsill? The birds flying by?
Oh, no no no. I'm here to draw on my favorite source of inspiration! But...
Raffaello uncharacteristically trails off and hesitates, her expression becoming somewhat stiff.
But?
She sits on the sofa, fidgeting, and flips her sketchbook open.
Look, Commander, this is what I've been drawing recently.
She hands me the sketchbook, and all its sketches are of a figure working, napping, dining...
They're all drawings of... me?
That's right! Over the last few days, I've been observing you in various locations and from different angles.
The dining hall, the office, when you were walking across the port... Because right now, you're my most important observation subject~♪
...I never even noticed.
Heheh, that's the bread-and-butter of every good observer~ But here's the problem...
Raffaello points at her sketchbook.
See? This! I drew your profile while you were sorting documents; the lines are accurate, the shading is precise...
But this sketch doesn't have one iota of the real thing's charm... No matter how similar it might appear superficially, it'll never be more than a soulless drawing!
You've spent days working on this?
Yeah! I want to draw you with more emotion, Commander!
I don't want to just capture what's on the surface. That spark in your eyes when you're focused, the way your eyelashes droop when you're tired, the way your lips curl when you smile...
I can see it all, but I just can't put it down onto paper... I can't capture what's hidden beneath the surface...
I'm so stumped! Commander, come up with a solution~☆
I'm no artist, so I'm not sure I can give you anything useful off the cuff...
There are a lot more drawings, so could you come to my room to take a look? I think you'll understand what I mean when you see them.
Right now?
Of course♪ It's about time you take a break, too! And the drawings I have in my room are much more... substantial than the ones in this sketchbook.
Substantial?
Well, you'll see when we get there~☆
Raffaello pulls me along half-forcibly, her figure running just ahead, bathed in sunlight.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>2 What She Needs</size>

scripts.say: The sight behind the door to her room is as overwhelming as ever...
The desk and floor are littered with art supplies, as if a tornado had just swept through the room.
Your room's vibes are always so... impactful.
Ahaha~ that's an artist's life for you~☆
Raffaello takes out her sketches and spreads them out on the floor one by one. Before long, the whole area is covered in drawings.
Wait... it's all me?
Always has been~♪ I've made sure to depict you in various situations, from different angles, and with different lighting!
Seeing so many pictures of myself was admittedly spectacular... but it also left me with an indescribable feeling.
So, what's the substantial part, exactly?
Well, these are like the sketches I showed you earlier, works that have no problem technically speaking. Buuut...
As soon as I finish drawing, I start to ask myself... What is the Commander thinking inside the drawing? Are you happy? Are you a bit tired?
But, I can never come up with an answer... I'm always watching you so I can draw you better, but everything keeps coming out unfinished!
Hmm...
Raffaello stares at my face. At first I think she might be discouraged, but then she regards me earnestly.
Commander, what are you thinking right now?
Huh?
You frowned and sighed when you saw me earlier. Like, in a way that looked both caring and heart-wrenching.
Do you feel bad for me?
I don't know... What can I do to help you, Raffaello?
Yeah... I think that sums it up.
THAT'S IT! That look of yours, brimming with expressiveness!
Raffaello leans so close to my face that I instinctively pull back.
What's gotten into you?
She whips her sketchbook out and starts rapidly scribbling inside it, then squats down to search for something on the floor.
I should pick a warmer color tone for this moment... Your eyes had this kind, amber radiance to them...
Did that stir your inspiration?
No... It's still not quite right.
Raffaello snaps her sketchbook shut and topples backwards, throwing herself over the sketches littering the floor.
There's still such a wide gap between what I feel and what I end up drawing...
When you looked at me earlier, my heart skipped a beat. But when I tried to sketch it, what came out felt like some lifeless emotion.
So the problem isn't that the art isn't coming out right?
No... What's wrong is that it's not capturing that "heart-throbbing" feeling I got from looking at you earlier.
The room settles into silence, save for the occasional rustling of pages caressed by the wind blowing in through the window.
I see...! I get it now! I really am a genius~☆
After a few seconds, Raffaello suddenly shoots to her feet, her eyes sparkling.
No wonder I can't draw it! All I've been doing is observing you, but I never actually experienced what it's like to be with you!
If I experience more of these heart-throbbing moments with you...
If I spend more time with you and immerse myself deeper in these emotions, that'll solve my problem!
So what, exactly, are we going to do?
You and I are going to go out and have fun, so I experience more feelings with you♪ So my heart skips a beat lots of times♪
You said you'd help me out earlier, so no backsies!
Raffaello holds my hand tightly and pulls me along.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>3 An Indirect Kiss?</size>

scripts.say: We come to a small sweets store in the port's shopping district.
They have chocolates covered in gold leaves, cupcakes shaped like roses and unique sweets designed like paint on a color palette on sale.
Tadah! This is one of my secret bases, the Dessert Gallery!
These are desserts?
No, no, it's edible art! Look at this...
Raffaello points at a color palette cake in the display case.
The white part is cream cheese, the red is strawberry jam, the purple is blueberry jam, the yellow is mango...
Each "paint" tastes different! It's a palette that makes you choose the right color to taste!
I think I'm starting to understand why you brought me here...
That's right! To make sure my heart skips a beat like I want, I have to bring you to my favorite places!
I watch Raffaello taste the cake, a sight that's all the more brilliant under the sunlight.
...You know, I always eat these desserts, so why do they taste and look extra good today?
Hm?
Raffaello lifts a piece of the blue cake on her fork and holds it up to the sun.
Doesn't this blue look a lot like today's sky? It's such a pretty azure, but it has this milky white glow when the light hits it...
Blue's supposed to feel cool, but it looks so warm...
Maybe because it's a nice day?
No, that's not why! It feels warmer because I'm with you, dummy!
But this isn't enough. My heart didn't throb the right way yet! Hmmm... how do I make it happen again...?
Where do I come in to this?
Feed me please~☆
Faced with her direct demand, I have no option but to feed her the blue cake.
She takes a bite, puffing up her cheeks with a satisfied smile as she tastes the cake.
Mmm, delish! I've been drawing for so long I've gotten pretty hungry!
You don't have to eat it so fast.
As soon as she's finished eating, I go to pick up another piece, only for Raffaello to snatch the fork out of my hand and point it at me.
I can't be eating everything, you know. Here, have some too, Commander! Say "ahhhn"~
Ahhhn...
Beneath the sheer weight of her expectant gaze, I obediently open wide.
How is it?
Hmm... nice and sweet.
Ehehehe♪
Raffaello grins contentedly and shifts her attention to the red cake this time.
Mmhhh, scrumptious! You give it a try too, Commander!
It's sooo delicious! Here, don't keep me waiting! Open wide~
Her smile is so innocent and pure-hearted that the thought of refusing never once crosses my mind.
Mm... You're right. It really is good.
See? I told you~♪
Suddenly, Raffaello's satisfied smile turns into a bright red blush. She covers her face with her hands and peeks at me through her fingers.
...What's wrong? Why are you acting bashful all of a sudden?
Uuuuu! My heart just skipped a beat! A real badump!
Do you still want some?
Hmm... Let me keep feeding you for now... I want to savor this feeling a little longer!
Raffaello gently offers me more cake.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>4 Unusual Scenery</size>

scripts.say: After we take turns feeding each other cake, Raffaello and I both start blushing awkwardly, but we don't stop.
Ahhh... That was yummy.
We ate the whole thing.
Commander...
Yeah?
I wanna draw.
Draw what?
This cake... Or rather, us eating that cake!
Raffaello swiftly takes out her sketchbook but her hands stop, and she stares at the empty plate fixedly.
That's strange...
What's wrong?
Whenever I drew until now, I always focused on things like perfect composition or exact lighting and shading, or on being cautious of the perspective...
But now, the only thing on my mind is images of how I fed you and you fed me...
Raffaello's pencil starts sliding over the page. It looks like it's sliding more smoothly than usual, like she's relishing the memories.
After a while, she puts away the pencil and hands me the sketchbook.
There!
Drawn in the sketchbook is the empty plate, and a few cake crumbs scattered around it.
But looking at it conjures images of the sunlight we basked in, the cake we ate, the way we sat across from each other and fed each other.
It feels... warm.
Really?
Yes. The plate is empty, but you can tell someone ate from it.
Finally, I was able to put a bit of my feelings into the drawing. It's not technique, it's really... the feeling of my heart skipping a beat!
So, this worked?
Hmm... Well, halfway there?
Just halfway?
The reason you could tell my feelings in my drawing of the plate is because you experienced eating the cake with me.
But that's not enough if I want to draw you.
So, what do we do?
Go on more dates, that's what♪
Experiences are meant to be mutual~ I won't be able to draw a perfect picture of you if we don't understand each other!
You're setting a pretty lofty goal here.
Ehehe, I'm working on a masterpiece, after all!
Now, let's go and find places that make my heart skip a beat☆

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>5 In Search of Heart-Throbbing Moments</size>

scripts.say: Raffaello pulls me along to the shopping district, the beach and the dorms. Finally, we end up at the library.
How about here?
The library?
Yes! Look at it from this angle. The sunlight shines in from the high window, and the whole place is awash with light.
It is pretty, for sure.
Stay right there, Commander.
Raffaello takes a few steps back and holds up her fingers like a camera lens, watching me through it with squinting eyes.
Hmm... What's on your mind right now, Commander?
I'm wondering how long I'm going to have to stand like this.
No, bad answer! You're thinking too much like a commander!
Then what answer are you fishing for?
Well, something like... "I was just thinking of you, standing there in this gorgeous light!"
Doesn't that sound a bit forced?
I don't think so at all. Because, you're the only thing I've been thinking about this whooole time~
Woah...
...Oh! Commander, did your heart just skip a beat?
It did.
Really? But then again, that heart throb was because of what I said, not because of this place.
Not really...
Don't lie~♪ I know it did. Don't worry, that heart throb was because of what I said, not because of this place.
So... Let's go to the next spot!
As Raffaello and I stroll around the port, she suddenly pulls me to the water's edge and runs into the waves, laughing when she sees me recoil from the cold water.
At the park, she picks a small flower and pins it to my lapel, and then observes her impromptu work of art.
The stars then emerge, and silence settles around us.
Commander, are you tired after all that walking?
I'm good.
Are you having fun?
Yeah.
Did I make your heart throb even more?
It did.
Great~♪ I really got to experience so many rich emotions today!
It's a shame, though... We went to so many places and experienced so many things, but that itch to draw just isn't coming.
Why not?
I think... It's because I'm there, part of the scenery?
Me dragging you into the water, or pinning that flower on you... They were beautiful scenes, but I feel like the composition doesn't work with my face in it!
If I'm there, that means it's a picture of us, right? But what I want to draw is just you~
I understand... So you need a situation that doesn't involve you?
No, that makes it sound like I'm in the way or something!
But isn't that what you said?
I mean, that's part of it, but it's just a matter of love!
But you're right, what I want to draw is you, unaffected by my actions and presence.
Then... Do we go back?
Back where?
To the office. I think that's where you'll find the image of me working without you.
Okay~♪
Raffaello and I hold hands and walk back under the warm glow of street lamps.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>6 Searching for Your Most Natural Visage</size>

scripts.say: As we open the door to the office, we're greeted by a scene of complete familiarity.
Finally back to home turf~♪
Are you going to draw here?
Yep! Walking around today has made me realize that this place feels the most like you, Commander!
Raffaello sets up her art supplies with practiced hands and starts mixing paint. She then looks up, and when her gaze meets mine, she freezes up.
...Commander.
Why are you sitting all straightened like that?
Huh? I thought you wanted me to model for you.
I do, but that posture... It's like you're a photo of a statue. It doesn't feel like you at all!
Then how am I supposed to sit?
Hmm, same as usual? Sit the way you always do!
Like I always do? Well, usually... I sit like this and do my paperwork...
Then do your paperwork!
But I don't have any paperwork to do right now...
Raffaello picks up a large stack of paperwork from another desk and plops it down in front of me.
What are you saying, Commander? You've got paperwork right there.
But this is tomorrow's share of the work...
It's today! Today's share of the work!
Seriously...?
Of course♪ Just pretend I'm not here and focus on work!
All right.
A bit baffled, I pick up the first document from the pile and start skimming through it.
How about this?
Hey, stay still! Yes, like that! I'm just a fly on the wall, okay?!
That's a bit of a tall ask when you're staring right at me like that...
So, how about you think of me as a painting on the wall? Or like a breathing lamp?
Lamps can breathe?
You've got a breathing lamp right here♪
Raffaello laughs at her own joke and takes a step closer, looking at me.
Are you nervous, Commander?
A little.
She reaches out and pats my shoulders, which is oddly relaxing.
Relax. I'm right here with you.
Raffaello suddenly snatches a pen and with a few swift strokes draws her name on the back of my hand.
See, with this, it's not just a drawing of you. It's both of us now♪
She then goes quiet and returns to her easel. The only sounds in the office are the rustling of my pages and the soft scratch of her brush against the canvas.
I look up a few times, glancing at the back of my hand, and see Raffaello's name drawn on it in ink like a silent promise.

sequence:
What the Heart Draws

<size=45>7 To Her Heart's Content</size>

scripts.say: Phew... Finally done.
I put my pen away and mutter to myself, satisfied with a job well done.
That was a pretty good pace for work.
I end up being completely absorbed in work before I know it and forget Raffaello is there.
Raffaello?
She doesn't answer me. She's still facing the easel with the same posture, her brush dancing along the canvas.
I rise from my chair and approach Raffaello. She doesn't seem to notice I'm walking over to her.
Raffaello?
She still doesn't respond to my voice. Completely focused, Raffaello's gaze is fixed solely on the canvas.
I step behind her and peer into the canvas... only for my breath to be taken away.
Drawn there is me, my brows furrowed as I write into a document, my gaze focused and hand firmly gripping the pen.
Details I wouldn't normally notice about myself are put to the canvas, and the painting looks like it could come to life at any second.
This is... me?
Ah, Commander, when did you get here?
You were so concentrated you didn't hear me calling for you.
Well, I couldn't help myself, I was really in the zone!
Raffaello moves the canvas so as to offer me a better view.
Well? Care to give me your impression?
...Is that how you usually see me?
That's right♪ You didn't notice? You're really lovely when you focus on work♪
...You really are always observing me, huh?
Of course~♪ I'm a pro when it comes to observing people! Do you have any more feedback?
It warms the heart... I look so serious in the painting, the lighting isn't particularly bright, and the background is just my office...
But looking at it, it makes me feel exactly how I felt when I was working earlier.
And how did you feel, exactly?
It was the sense of ease of looking after someone, while knowing they're looking after you too...
...So you noticed.
Hm?
When I drew this painting, I kept thinking about all the times my heart skipped a beat today.
And no matter where it happened.... the feeling was the same. So I decided to include it in the painting.
She speaks, then quietly slides her hand into mine. There's a little paint on her palm, and I hold it tight.
I'm really so lucky to have met you, Commander.
I feel the same way about you.
Today, I learned how important it is to have someone's gentle, attentive gaze on me.
Oh, right!
What's up?
All I've done is draw you while you're working! I need to draw more of you!
You're going to draw more?
Yeah! I'll draw you while you're eating and walking and laughing...! I'll watch you in every situation!
How many more paintings are you going to draw until you're satisfied?
Bold of you to assume my urge to draw can ever be satisfied♪ I'm going to draw you in all sorts of settings!
Maybe I should start charging you for using my likeness.
Awww! Can I pay you in drawings?
You want to pay for my likeness with drawings of my likeness?
Hmmm... Yeah, that does sound kind of wrong♪ But it's all good. Either way, I'm going to keep drawing forever!
Raffaello lets go of my hand, returns to the canvas and picks up the brush again.
Break's over! Time to keep drawing!
Alright, I'll keep you company to your heart's content.
As moonlight illuminates the office, the sounds of a brush running along canvas and the occasional turning of pages entwine into the gentlest nocturne.
Kala was drifting off to sleep on a dark night like any other.
However, this night would soon turn out to be anything but normal.
FWIIISH!
Urgh... What is all that racket? I'm trying to...
Wait... What in the...?
Kala opened her eyes. In front of her was not the usually familiar scenery she expected, but rather a small island filled with strange buildings, surrounded by a vast, endless ocean.
Have I been... transported to another world?
Hmm... I do hope this is a figment of me still being half-asleep. Because if not, it would mean I now find myself in quite a conundrum...
These buildings are made of a material I do not recognize. Similarly, their architecture is foreign to me as well...
Did I perhaps... get spirited away by some alchemist?
No, that's preposterous. I doubt any alchemist has the skill to transport me across worlds without me noticing.
Hmm... Perhaps the place I chose to rest just so happened to be a door between realms?
KABOOOM!
That was an explosion. Not far from here, either... It must've come from that island over yonder!
Across the water, a battle was unfolding between two forces. On the surface, odd-looking ships of war – in the air, massive, mechanical birds.
That's right, newcomer! You've come to the wrong place for a vacation, because there's nothin' but fire-and-brimstone around these parts!
Only reason you're not getting blown to bits right now is 'cause I predicted where you'd warp in and set up defenses ahead of time! Pretty smart, ain't I?
You, who fell from a mechanical beast in the sky... Who are you? Some kind of Elemental?
What? No! I'm Purity, the hero who traverses the galaxies, leading the resistance to upend the Sirens' plans!
...So, are you going to show me your appreciation for saving you? C'mon now, tell me how great I am!
Oho. Save me? I think you mean "dragged me into a battle I have no part of."
Oof... This girl's a sharp one...
Okay, it's not like I had NOTHING to do with you ending up here... but 99% of it is Tester's darn fault!
All I did was fiddle around with your arrival schedule a little bit! And the point of that was to ruin Tester's plan!
I was just trying to wrap this fight up before y'all showed up, but you arrived ahead of the rest for whatever reason. So, that last 1% is on me.
Hrm. Judging from the state of this battlefield, you don't seem to be lying. I will trust you for now.
As far as I can tell, however, both sides of this fight seem to bear striking similarities. Is this "Tester" you mentioned one of your kind?
Uhh, technically, we're both Sirens, but we're not exactly chums... Look, it's complicated, so I'll fill you in later.
Very well. A different question, then. You mentioned "the rest" a moment ago. Do I take that to mean there are others you've involved in this situation besides myself?
Hey, didn't I just say it's only 1% my fault? But yeah, there are five others on the way. According to the database, their names are, uh... Ryza, Klaudia, Patricia, Lila, and Serri.
What are the odds...! Good grief. Even in my dreams, I would've never imagined I'd get caught up in an adventure – or rather, a dilemma – with all of them.
Why do you sound more annoyed than scared? Most people dropped in the middle of a war zone would be having a panic attack by now.
You are speaking to Kala Ideas, chief of the Wave Tuner clan for countless generations. I have seen more than my fair share of battles.
Now... You said my arrival here was not intended. That being the case, may I simply return whence I came?
Sure... but that's easier said than done. First, you aren't going anywhere until we clear out Tester's forces. Second, the other folks will be in a whole lot more trouble without you.
But listen, you can expedite the whole going-home process if you join my resistance and fight with me. You did say you've seen your fair share of battles, right?
Urgh... Seems like I do not have much of a choice then. I suppose I can treat this as an unplanned adventure and lend you my strength.
However, I will not be joining your resistance. I have my own duties and obligations to see to once this matter is settled.
Fair enough. I respect that.
Okay, first things first – hop on my rigging. I'm gonna take you to my base and get you kitted out. You don't stand a ghost's chance against the Sirens without some gear.

sequence: O travelers from far-off lands, heed these words I impart to thee
Thou art in the Land of Beginnings, thy luminous guidepost it shall be
Westwards lay the Underworld Grove, an illusion born from memories
Eastwards lay the Castle of Strife, where the brutal truth lay buried
Southwards lay the Desolate Capital, abound in treasure among loam
Northwards lay the Central Foundation, thy way of returning home
Gather the hidden recipes, and great power shall thee find
Then, breach the towering barrier with four keys combined
Leverage thy wits, and upon thee shall be conferred a prize
Disregard my words, and all that awaits is thy demise
"...These are meant to be hints? They read as no more than a lunatic's ravings to me."
"Ravings? I worked real hard on that exercise in wordsmithery!"

scripts.say: Mirror Sea - In the past
Up next, the Castle of Strife! Whaddya say we turn the ruins Tester left behind into a fortified city?
Why not leave the ruins as exactly that – ruins? There is no need to alter them.
Don't fix it if it ain't broke, huh... Guess that works. It's like they say, "don't tamper with natural beauty."
Alright, that was easy. Let's head to the next island while the Enforcers do their thing.
Wait. What are these humanoid creatures doing? I thought you said you'd leave this site alone?
They're just tidying up the place. Can't exactly leave it COMPLETELY untouched, can I?
There are weapons, energy systems, contaminants, and bombs littering the whole place. That's a lot to clean up.
If I don't, the next people who come through here are gonna meet one gruesome fate or another.
Oho. How considerate of you. What of the boxes scattered about the site, then? Are they part of the cleanup as well?
Nah, those are treasure chests. 'Cause what are ruins without hidden treasure to find?
Nothing, that's what. That's a sin that I, as the designer of this place, will not tolerate.
I suppose you're right about that.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
Well, the synthesis was a success... at least as far as I can tell. Serri, Lila, what do you think?
This will be good to have in a fight. Thanks, Ryza. I'll treasure this gift.
It feels like a set of armor and a weapon in one, yet it doesn't weigh me down whatsoever, almost as though it's an extension of my body.
Having said that, I will need practice to master its use.
This is starting to feel like a real adventure! We're equipping gear we just found and instantly becoming stronger.
Yeah, you're right! We're even exploring ruins and finding treasure. This is why I love going on adventures!
If only I had a rigging, maybe I could fight with you...
Hm? Did you say something, Klaudia?
Oh, no, nothing! Anyway, I guess we're going looking for the third key next?
Yup. There's still that castle to the east to check out, and I wager that's where we'll find it.
We're heading to the Castle of Strife, where "the brutal truth lay buried?" Heck yeah!
Finding out the truth is what I do! And I have a feeling it's gonna make a helluva scoop!
Hey! Finding out the truth is an investigator's job! If anything, it's MY time to shine now!
Oh yeah? You wanna throw down the gauntlet and see who is better at it?
Bring it on! First to learn the truth is the winner!
If you're making it a competition, may I be part of it as well?
Why? You're neither a journalist nor an investigator. Do you have some secret skill I don't know about?
Yes – my speed! The faster you are, the faster you can finish an investigation!
Ah, like a sleuth who's in and out of the field in a flash. You're on! Let's see what you can do, detective Shimakaze!
Thank you! I won't go easy on you!
You should know I'm no slouch either when it comes to scouring old ruins and uncovering buried truths!
Which is to say, can I join your competition too, please?
Heheh. Now the seasoned alchemist throws her hat into the ring as well... This will be interesting!
You're in! Let's keep the first round simple: whoever reaches the Castle of Strife first wins!
Roger! Full speed ahead!
Let's goooooo!
Wait a sec! There could be traps along the... Ugh, why do I even bother...
Heehee. Shall we head after them?
Mirror Sea Ruins - Castle of Strife
Hey, is it just me, or does the sky look... off?
It was blue just a minute ago, and now it's ash-gray all of a sudden!
Woah, you're right... Wait, even the water is turning gray!
It's almost like someone put a black-and-white filter over the world... Let me go back a bit and see what happens.
...Holy moly! All the colors came back!
Really? I want to see for myself.
Me too...
Whoa, you weren't lying. It looks like crossing this bridge is what changes the colors.
How does that work? Is there a magic barrier of some sort?
My guess is that the Sirens set up a device that changes the air's composition, or something like that.
Why they'd do that, I can't imagine. Whatever their reasons, the fact remains that Siren ruins are rife with danger.
Excellent point, Suruga! Since we're in a dangerous place, we should be swift and complete our investigation posthaste! Right?
(No! I've been saying we should proceed more carefully this whole time!)
Err, well... I suppose? Find whatever you're supposed to find quickly so we can wrap up this silly competition and get away from here.
This place is unlike any forest I've seen before.
The ruins and wrecks here are quite old, too. They may even be as old as the entire region itself.
Yeah... These buildings and shipwrecks look unfamiliar. They're cut from a different cloth than the rest we've seen thus far.
Familiar or not, they're still mass-produced Siren wrecks, just without the Philuscha elements. The buildings are definitely Siren make, too.
What's interesting is just how much damage they've sustained. Someone REALLY wanted to raze this place.
What a ghastly sight. Battles in your world must be brutal.
That they are. Engagements with the Sirens always end in devastation.
Having said that, it's always us who dish out the devastation, rather than receive it.
Tangents aside, something's odd about this. We've never been here before, so who caused all this destruction?
Oh! That's part of the puzzle! This is where the brutal truth lay buried!
Now we know what we're looking for... Well, time for round two! Everyone, split up and investigate! First to establish a theory wins!
Okay!
Ugh... Just please remember to look for the key and recipe as well.
Yeah, we know! Ready... set... Go!
Mirror Sea Ruins - Castle of Strife
KABOOOM!
Whuah?! *cough cough*!
Hey, you okay?
I'm fine, just got a little smoke in my lungs!
Ugh! What is with the treasure chests in this castle?! Each and every one of them has been rigged with a trap!
Traps are just as much a part of exploring ruins as treasure is.
I would say we should explore at a slow and steady pace, but given the sheer number of treasure chests... yeah.
This is a real headache even for me, and I've been on a lot of wild adventures.
It doesn't help that this whole place is booby-trapped!
KABOOOM!
Shimakaze!
*cough cough*... I'm okay! It's just another smoke trap!
...Try to be more careful. You didn't get hurt this time, but there's no guarantee you'll be as lucky next time.
But we must find the key, and it's bound to be in one of these chests. We have to go through them all one by one...
Yeah, that's a problem. This would be easier if we just had more time...
Heheheh... Looks like the journalist, the detective, and even the alchemist are all on their last legs!
I suggest you give up and let the professional investigator handle this!
So... what? Do you have an easy solution to this?
Funny you should ask! Introducing: Data 857, my robot assistant!
Data here only has to scan a chest to decisively determine if it contains treasure or a trap.
Created by Ingraham, this capable little bot has accompanied me on hundreds of missions. You can count on him to get the job done.
Well, that's convenient. I'm in favor of letting Bristol deal with the treasure chests while the rest take a break. What do you all think?
Heck no! Nobody's fully uncovered the truth yet, and I'm not about to throw in the towel!
What she said! I'm gonna go look around the surrounding area for clues!
Oh, I'll come with you then.
Thanks for offering to help, but it's too dangerous for you to come along without a rigging. A wreck could blow up for all we know. You should stay behind with Patty.
...Oh, I forgot. You're right.
Serri and I will stand guard so the rest of you can rest with peace of mind.
Thank you, and please be careful, both of you. While it's true you've become stronger, I have reason to suspect our enemies have as well.
Good news! Thanks to Data 857's hard work, the third key is now in our hands!
Item obtained: Castle of Strife Key
Nice! Hats off to Ingraham's engineering!
Hey, where's my praise? I did something too!
We found something as well. Have a look, Ryza.
This... looks like a new rigging recipe. Yeah, I think it's for Patty.
Huh? They really made one for me? Now I'm curious to see how it looks.
Wait, where'd you find that recipe? Nothing like that turned up on any of Data 857's scans.
Ever since we arrived here, Serri and I have sensed the traces of Oren presence. We decided to follow the trail they'd left behind.
It led us to a comparatively typical garden, and that's where we found the recipe. It wasn't hidden in a chest, it was just lying there.
You think the Oren have something to do with these ruins? Like maybe they made contact with the Sirens long, long ago?
I seriously doubt that. Serri and I have never been here before, and neither has anyone else of our kind as far as we know.
Perhaps, when the Sirens recreated this place, they also incorporated data from the Oren in some way.
After all, they did model areas after your birthplaces, and create mass-produced ships with elements of the Philuscha.
Sounds like we have another mystery to solve.
Ahahah... I mean, nobody ever said we'd figure out ALL the ruins' mysteries in the end.
Quite the opposite, Alfredo – this is the final piece of the puzzle! Ace investigator Bristol has found the answer that explains everything!
What? You've really figured it out with that little info to go on? That's amazing.
By all means, let us hear the truth you've unearthed, Bristol!
Heheh! Hear it you shall! Lend me your ears, everyone.
I'm listening.
You see, a long time ago, the Sirens occupied this very sea and built a base. There they schemed, concocting evil plans...
That is, until one day... when a meteorite came crashing down from the sky!
A... A meteorite?
Yes, a meteor! This colossal hunk of space debris leveled their entire base, undoing all their efforts in an instant!
They had no way of defending themselves and were all wiped out. That is why their wrecks litter the whole area.
If a meteorite impact caused all this, shouldn't there be a crater where it struck?
The monument mentioned a Desolate Capital, remember? The text implies there was once an island to the south. Now, however, we can't see any trace of such a thing. The reason being...
The meteorite impact completely obliterated it!
That's an extremely contrived theory... but all the pieces are there.
If we assume you're correct, then where do the Oren fit into the picture?
Why, I'm glad you asked! That's the most interesting part.
The meteorite impact caused a huge energy discharge from one of the Sirens' experimental machines on the site. By some freak accident, that discharge opened a portal to another dimension!
And it's through that portal that the Oren were forcibly warped here!
Obviously, the Oren were furious about having been thrown into a foreign world, and they took out their rage on whatever Sirens survived the impact.
Since we know they don't like alchemists, they scattered the recipes all over the place, erected a monument, and then went back to their home world!
And that, ladies and younger ladies, is the truth that was buried here!
I can see where you're coming from, but without riggings, I seriously doubt even the Oren could simply wipe out a fleet of Sirens armed to the teeth.
The monument and alchemy recipe don't sit well with me, either. Even presuming that the Oren left them behind, who in the world could have prepared them beforehand?
Urk… Okay, so my deductions are a little rough around the edges. Just let me think a little longer!

While we've put this conversation aside for this moment, why don't we return to the Land of Beginnings for the time being? This was a battlefield, so there's no telling what might explode at any given time. It would be dangerous to remain here.
Agreed! Let's go back and take a break! I need brain food and energy before I can put my thinking cap on!
Sounds like a good time to eat. I've still got plenty of fish left over from alchemy. Cook it, broil it, the sky's the limit!
Hooray! Broiled fish, broiled fish!
Mirror Sea - In the past
Under Purity's command, countless small flying units circled around a forest of skyscrapers.
Throw a few laser turrets here, add in a shield generator or two... Ooh, and I'll have to grab a good number of kinetic weapons.
You confuse me. What is the point of "cleaning things up" for them if you're planning to add real weapons?
Heheh! These aren't for the adventurers. They're to protect the central hub.
We don't want something going WAY wrong and destroying the transporter before the others get here. That'd be catastrophic.
Plus, it's a good bluff. Having a bunch of defensive weapons around helps keep them from wandering in before they get the keycard.
Make it look scary as hell, and there isn't an idiot in the world who would make this their first destination.
Hrmmm... I doubt it will have the intended effect.
Say what?! You're not saying this stuff wouldn't scare them, are you? Then... Fine! I'm doubling the firepower!
I was kind enough to leave instructions for them. If they wanna break the rules and try to break into the final destination...
Then let's see if they can make it through Purity's super-strong, no-holds-barred fortifications! Aaahahahah!
You're starting to sound like a villain now.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
Okay, so we found our third key. But, uh... We still don't know where the "Desolate Capital" is, do we? How will we find the last one?
I've been meaning to ask about that. Do we actually need to follow the monument word for word?
If "breaching the towering barrier" means opening some kind of door, then that means we can open three out of four doors now, yeah? That just leaves one.
And if the Mirror Sea belongs to the Sirens, why do we have to be nice and use a key for every single door? I bet we could blow that last one away with cannon fire.
Ooh, good idea! We've got added firepower in the form of Ryza, Patricia, Serri, and Lila's riggings, after all!
With these forces, we could give those Sirens a real walloping!
True... Our search has hit a dead end. Why not try brute force once in a while, right?
Are you sure about this, Ryza?
Don't you worry, Klaudia. Even if we run into strong enemies, I know we can win if we just work together!
She's right. I happen to be in just the mood to use my newly-obtained power, so I would appreciate a strong foe right about now.
You have my approval as well. It irks me to be toyed with by Sirens. I say it's high time we mount our own offensive.
(Do we have the numbers to attack the Sirens' central hub head-on? I have my doubts.)
(But it's not like the battles so far have been really hard... Maybe we shouldn't assume this Mirror Sea follows the rules of common sense.)
(Forget that. Everyone's ready and raring to go! Let's ride this momentum and give it a shot!)
What's wrong, Suruga? Something on your mind?
You could say that... But we don't have any other leads. I will take the vanguard; let us investigate the Siren island to the north!
Mirror Sea Ruins - Near the Central Foundation
Everyone, be careful. My recon plane was immediately shot down after it flew through the barrier up ahead.
It sounds safe to assume they have automated defenses that intercept anything or anyone that comes close enough.
Hmm...
Is there something the matter, Ryza?
I'm thinking about the, well, "door" over there. It doesn't look like any old door you just open with a key, more like a big obstacle.
We've come this far – I see no reason to worry about any barrier! All we need to do is circle around it.
Miss Ryza, we will soon be in range of the Sirens' defences. Please keep your guard up.
...Alright, I guess this is the only way! Let's get in there!
KABOOOM!
The girls launched an assault on the island, but hardly made any headway in the face of the Siren defenses.
Even though their goal was within sight, they came under increasingly withering fire with each step they advanced.
A sense of dread filled the air as they realized that they were up against a formation more dangerous than anything they had encountered before.
What the heck IS this?! I haven't seen an encampment THIS heavily fortified since... ever!
Miss Formidable, Miss Ryza, let's retreat! It would be suicide to keep moving forward.
She's right. There's no way we'll make it through under fire THIS heavy.
Yeah, I agree. Knowing when to back off is crucial to surviving an adventure!
Formidable and I will cover the rear. Everyone else, keep shooting while you retreat, and don't let them see your back!
Got it!
Having successfully retreated, the girls returned to the Land of Beginnings.
Phew... That was a pretty thrilling attack, wasn't it? Right, Suruga?
Guess so. But don't be so reckless next time!
Agreed! I shall make that my motto. By the way, are you alright? You look pretty pale...
Don't worry about me, I'm just tired. If anyone deserves a look at, it's Ryza and her friends.
Let's not forget they're still learning to use their riggings, and they don't have the tools to repair them. If they sustain damage, they're in trouble.
Will do!
*sigh*... I'll have to find a remote place where I can patch myself up...
So you WERE injured after all. Sent her away so you could lick your wounds in private, huh?
Alright, you caught me. Yes, I got a little scratched up, but please keep it a secret from the others.
It's nothing serious, and I don't want to make the others worried.
My lips are sealed. But, don't forget that we're all in this together. There's nothing wrong with occasionally asking for help from your allies.
Of course I know that. I've always tried to keep my head down as much as I can.
It's just that... as the person with the greatest firepower here, I have to keep morale up. You understand how that feels, don't you?
Hmm, I suspected you'd say as much. You have a true warrior's spirit. By the way, show me where you got hurt.
Look, I'll be fine. Your rigging getting scratched up isn't the same as breaking an arm. I can patch myself up.
Show me anyway. If I'm to survive our upcoming battles, knowing how to repair riggings is a skill I'm going to need.
Well, if you insist... You can have my tools and try your hand at it.
Thanks. Now, let's take a look.
Under the Mirror Sea - In the past
Ooh, I just got an idea!
Oho? What would that be?
So, the rational thing would be to put the core device in the Central Foundation control room, right?
I suppose so, yes.
Well, why allow yourself to be tied down by conventions when you can do something new, right? I'm considering leaving the device in this hole I just made. How's that sound?
I could keep it on the southernmost part of these waters and this baby would still run just fine!
Think about it. The place looks like a bunch of ruins from afar. Nobody would EVER guess that the core device was hidden here.
Going to the trouble of making a massive control center, only to subvert expectations by placing its beating heart elsewhere... Interesting.
On the other hand, these undersea ruins are meant to be explored, no? They may stumble across the core by luck and destroy it before they know its significance.
Hrmm... You've got a point. The portal's as good as done if they destroy the core before making it to the Central Foundation.
I could hide it better, but... Wait, I know! Building a dungeon here would solve everything!
The thing about dungeons is, people always leave after scooping up all the loot. They'll never think to delve deeper than that.
Clever. Even you have your moments of brilliance.
Whaddya mean "moments?" I'm brilliant round the clock, thank you very much! Well, whatever... I'll build a dungeon, leave a map, and resurface our submarine so they can use it. And that's a wrap.
And how are we supposed to get back to the surface without the submarine?
Don't you worry, my rigging blows that submarine outta the water. You wanna do a bit of undersea surfing while we're at it?
Land of Beginnings - Provisional Atelier
Hello? Do you read me? This is Investigator Bristol, reporting in from the south sector, over!
This is HQ. I hear you loud and clear. Over!
I've found an unmanned submarine in seemingly good condition. Approaching it now.
I have reason to believe it could be a key item needed to explore this sector.
Roger that! Proceed with caution. We're heading to you right now!
South Sector - Inside the submarine
After a quick inspection, I can say that the submarine is fit for service. All the systems are in working order as well.
Also, I found a map of the ocean floor's topography. It seems to suggest that there are ruins of a large structure straight down from here.
My investigator's intuition was right all along! There IS a sunken city to the south!
There should be a crater somewhere, too. Do you see one?
I do not, I'm afraid. In fact, the topography suggests that the ruins were built right on the ocean floor.
Hmm. That's another mystery for me to solve...
Bristol, I really think it's high time you put your initial hypothesis to rest.
So... we're gonna go inside this boat that goes underwater and explore some ruins. Did I get that right?
Indeed. This submarine is our only option for exploration, as we have no submarine shipgirl among us, and our riggings aren't suited for diving.
Oh, I see! Good that we have another option, since none of us brought any Air Drops.
What are "Air Drops"?
They're candies that let you breathe underwater.
My word. Alchemy really is like magic.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Desolate Capital
The girls took the submarine deeper and deeper beneath the surface. Soon, a large cluster of ruins appeared in front of them.
The submarine slowly cruised towards a place to anchor, seemingly following a predetermined route on autopilot.
Upon reaching its destination, the submarine came to a stop and opened its hatch, revealing a passageway leading into the ruins.
It's astounding how well these ruins have resisted the seawater's corrosion.
They look terribly weathered from the outside, but the interior is still in pristine condition. The Sirens ought to give up villainy and go into the construction business.
They certainly wouldn't have trouble finding clients when they can create marvels like this.
For sure. I'd love to have builders like them in my caravan.
Suruga! I've found a map of the ruins!
Oh, nice job! I have no idea how we'd even begin to explore this dungeon without one.
This will make the search a lot quicker. Everyone, let's find all there is to find then get out of here.
I'll make copies of the map and send them to you. Split up and look for the key!
A while later...
Ugh, dammit! This map is completely worthless.
Sure, it's detailed, but detail doesn't help when you can't tell what's what.
Yeah... A two-dimensional map won't do you any good in a three-dimensional dungeon.
Even when you know there's a connecting path, that knowledge is useless without knowing what floor it's on or how to get there in the first place!
*pant* *pant*... Ugh... I can't feel my feet anymore...
Ahahah... I had a feeling this would happen when I compared the map with the actual layout earlier. I hoped I was wrong...
Oh, I know! Formidable, can I catch a ride on one of your aircraft?
Wait, what? Shipgirls can ride aircraft?
Please tell me you're joking, Alfredo. We cannot mount aircraft. Surely you already knew that?
Obviously I know that, but I'm talking about using something to suspend myself from the plane. It could carry me, no problem, right?
Give me some planes made from unobtainium and I'm sure they'd be durable enough to hold your weight.
In other words, you'll do it if I can find that whatever-that-is?
That's... not what I meant. What I'm saying is, you really should consider more practical alternatives.
Hey, Ryza! Think you could synthesize a really, really tough rope?
Hmm... With the right materials, probably!
My name is Reisalin Stout, but everyone calls me Ryza. I'm the ordinary daughter of an ordinary farmer.
I come from the ordinary village of Rasenboden, on an ordinary island called Kurken Island.
And I once had an extraordinary adventure.
An adventure no one has experienced before, and nobody else knew about. An adventure that was just for us.
Three years passed since then. I'd returned to my ordinary days, and another summer was just about to begin...
That was when I ended up going on another adventure in a huge, bustling metropolis.
After many new encounters, and many sad goodbyes...
I decided to return to my former ordinary days once again.
Then, one day, I got caught up in another extraordinary occurrence.
Just as always, I took a boat out to our secret hideout.
But no matter how long I sailed, I never seemed to get any closer...
...When I regained my senses, I found myself here, washed up on a shore I've never seen before.
Woah... You've really experienced a lifetime of adventure!
This smells like a huge scoop... But before I go off the rails – what do you make of this, Investigator Bristol?
Sticking to a familiar course, yet somehow ending up in a distant, foreign land... This sounds like a classic spirited away case at sea!
And, while I can't make conclusions prior to a full investigation, I know who's most likely responsible here...
Oh yeah? Who?
- It has to be the Sirens! - It has to be Cthulhu!
Come on, Alfredo! The Sirens-did-it thing has been done to death. We need a new, more interesting culprit.
Uh, what? I'm a journalist – my job is to report the truth, not to suspect squid monsters from space.
Also, don't make this any worse! It's scary enough waiting for the sun to set while sitting inside a roofless old shack in the middle of an uncharted sea!
...Um, you said something about "Sirens?' Are they the people responsible for all the weird stuff that has been happening?
Let me, uh, explain things one at a time. First of all, the Sirens aren't people. Just think of them as living machines.
Secondly, we don't know for SURE that they did it yet. But going off my experiences, I'm like, 80 or 90 percent sure that they're behind this!
Living machines? Are they like dolls made using alchemy?
Alche-what now? This isn't a fantasy novel. The Sirens are not dolls or anything cute like that. They're like deep-sea horrors with big frickin' guns and torpedoes.
Oh, I see... Also, alchemy is no fantasy! As a matter of fact, I'm a real, honest-to-goodness alchemist!
Whoa, are you serious?! So does that mean you can, like, create the philosopher's stone or turn stone into gold?
Uhh... That's a tricky question...
I CAN turn one metal into another, that much I can tell you.
As for philosopher's stones, I can probably make those too, assuming we're talking about the same thing here.
Holy cow... Did you hear that, Alfredo? We're in the presence of a real-life alchemist!
Well, assuming she's telling the truth, then we're once again dealing with someone from another world. The stone monument did say something about "travelers from far-off lands," so...
If that's true, we can safely assume that the Sirens are behind this. It would explain why we suddenly steered off course and lost contact with the port.
All that is to say... getting out of here is gonna be a whole lot harder than I first thought.
While the girls were speculating inside the abandoned shack, a voice suddenly called out to them.
Ryza! Is that really you?
Klaudia! How'd you get here?
I don't know. I was writing out a cargo list in my room when I suddenly got really sleepy... Next thing I know, I woke up on the coast.
How did YOU end up here? And do you have any idea where we are?
I got here pretty much the same way you did. I don't know how it happened, or where in the world we are either...
But luckily, these girls who work for something called the "Azur Lane" think they might have a clue.
Azur Lane? Shimakaze said something about that just earlier. Are they her friends?
Indeed they are! That over there is Bristol from the Eagle Union, and beside her is Alfredo Oriani from Sardegna.
Oh. It's nice to meet you. My name is Klaudia Valentz. Thank you all for helping me find Ryza amid all this confusion!
You're welcome. We're all trapped here 'cause of the Sirens, so we'll need to stick together and work as a team!
Oh, it seems we're not alone. Greetings, everyone. The young lady behind me seems to be lost, so I led her here.
Hello, I'm Patricia Abelheim. I'm the daughter of a noble residing in the royal cap– Wait... Miss Ryza and Miss Klaudia?! You two are here as well?!
F-forgive me, I lost my composure... Ahem. Allow me to thank you all for rescuing me.
Please, I only did what anyone would do.
Can't believe even Patricia's ended up in the same boat as us.
Are you okay, Miss Patricia? Were you hurt on the way here?
No, I'm fine, thanks to Miss Formidable. I suddenly found myself on this beach after losing consciousness in my room, and she came to my aid right away.
If I may ask, how did you two arrive here?
More or less the same way you did... Heck, I said that to Klaudia just a minute ago.
It wasn't that long ago when we parted ways in the capital, and now, here we all are again... under bizarre circumstances.
Yes. It's as wonderful as it is confusing... Incidentally, does anyone know what is going on here?
These girls think we were all transported to another world because of a group called the "Sirens," who are apparently living machines.
Transported? Sirens? Living machines? Wait, slow down, please. This is too much information to take in at once...
KABOOOM!
*gasp*! Was that... an explosion?! Did someone detonate a bomb not far from here?
Either that, or they're fighting using explosives! If so, we might not be the only ones who were sent here!
Actually, that was the sound of Suruga's cannons! I'd recognize that sound anywhere! What's more, it definitely came from the direction she went to investigate!
I would speculate she has encountered a Siren ambush. Bristol, stay behind and protect these young ladies. Alfredo and Shimakaze, let's provide backup for Suruga!
Roger that! Follow me, girls! I'll lead you someplace safe!
Hang on a sec! Is there anything we can do to help?
More of our friends might still be out there! Besides, I think we should all put our heads together to figure out how to get out of this mess.
I appreciate the sentiment, but... are you even capable of fighting?
I think we can handle ourselves. We've been on a handful of adventures together and even defeated a crazy powerful monster called the Ravaging Queen.
Yeah. I've grown a lot over my adventures with Ryza and our friends. I promise I can be useful in battle!
Likewise. You helped me, so it's only natural for me to return the favor.
Well... If you're quite certain, then we would be much obliged. Bristol, lead the young ladies atop the mass-produced ships. The rest of you, come with me!
Another while later...
Voila! This rope should be tough enough to keep you suspended under a plane.
Sweet! Everything's ready for me to take off!
I wanna fly too!
As do I! Please let me come along!
Not so fast, Shimakaze! Ryza, this is more than a little crazy. Are you sure this will work?
I'm pretty sure, at least. There's only one way to find out, though.
...I think I'll stay on the ground, personally.
Likewise. The daredevils can try if they want.
Could I try it too, Ryza?
Oh, you interested?
I'm afraid you can't, Miss Klaudia. You won't be able to withstand the strong air pressure without a rigging.
I see... That's unfortunate. What about you, Ryza?
I, uh... Ahahah, I think I'll leave the flying to the risk-takers.
Okay then! Hit it, Formidable!
Let's take this investigation to the skies!
*sigh*... Alright, I'll do a slow takeoff. Please don't do anything reckless, like firing your cannons from the air.
Come evening, the girls had returned from their search at the bottom of the sea, bringing with them plenty of spoils.
Item obtained: Desolate Capital Key
The fourth key, a rigging recipe for Klaudia, and a whole load of ingredients to boot. What a haul!
It feels like they let us have all the supplies we could ask for before our final battle!
There must be a reason they're giving us all these handy items... We must be headed to an extremely tough final fight!
You betcha. At least now that we have all the keys, our next goal is clear - take the Central Foundation.
Maybe this time their defenses won't shoot at us.
Hmm... Something tells me that it's not smooth sailing from here on just because we got all the keys.
Take the barrier, for instance. Where are we even supposed to stick these keys to disable it?
I wouldn't be surprised if we had to use the keys to make something completely new.
Actually, I'll go back to my atelier and think it over for a bit. Oh, and synthesize Klaudia's rigging, of course.
You girls can stay here and rest for the time being. You deserve it.
Gotcha. I'll just kick back for a while then start making dinner!
Wonderful! I propose making use of Suruga's rations and cooking up some Sakura Empire cuisine tonight!
Great work today, Miss Ryza. I can't wait to see what Miss Klaudia's rigging looks like.
You won't have to wait for long!
A short while later, at the beach...
How does the rigging feel, Klaudia? Anything look wrong with it?
Not at all, it's beautiful through and through! Almost like a piece of art. Thanks for making it for me.
Heheh. The others deserve credit too for finding the recipe.
As does whoever made these recipes. My hat's off to the person who came up with equipment that has both stellar form and function.
I agree, it's– Hey, is that a plane?!
WRRRRRR!
Heh-heh, yes it is. Since you have your own rigging now, I went and asked Formidable if we could borrow one of her planes.
Ryza, I... Wow.
Tell you the truth, after seeing Alfredo and Bristol having a great time, I wanna give it a try. Want to fly with me?
Yes! I'd love to!
Awesome! Alright, Formidable, we're good to go.
Ahem... This is Captain Formidable of Royal Navy Airlines speaking. The airplane will take off momentarily. Please fasten your ropes and enjoy your flight through the golden evening sky.
Mirror Sea - In the past
Here's the teleporter. Use this, and it'll plop you right back where you came from.
And shazam, everything that happened here will seem like it was just a dream.
You might even forget everything the second you wake up.
Also, you can't take anything from this world with you once you leave, not even your rigging. Orrrrrr...
If you decide to join forces with the great and generous Purity, then you'll be able to keep your current powers.
Whaddya say? You get this sweet resistance badge, and we can destroy all of Tester's stupid experiments together. Sweet deal, dont'cha think?
The sensation of a dream, with all its ephemerality...
But the principle behind all this has nothing to do with dreams, correct?
