You have only spirited our consciousnesses, or perhaps our souls, or... something, into this world. As such, we can bring nothing physical home with us. Is that accurate?
Look, explaining it all would take ages. Besides, this is important Siren technology we're talking about. I can't share any secrets.
...Buuut, I could consider telling you if you agreed to be my partner.
Haha! You are a pleasant companion, but I'm afraid I have my own duties to tend to. Besides… now seems an apt time to awaken from this dream.
Still, I find myself interested in this badge of yours.
Huh? Kinda sounds like you're implying something here... But even the mighty Purity can't send you home with a badge.
Though... If you just want proof of your adventure here, I can make it so you don't forget everything entirely.
I can make it juuust so that, randomly, you might find yourself starting to remember something.
A treasure remaining in my memories, hm? That doesn't sound bad at all.
Okay, it's a deal!
But I do have one question. Was it true when you said that the flow of time here differs from that of my own world?
Yep! It's been a few days here, but I think only a few seconds or minutes have passed in your world.
How mysterious...
So, a girl's got stuff to do, but weren't you in a hurry to get home? I can send you back first.
If you're busy, then tend to your own matters first. I'd like to take another look around before I leave.
Really? Well, be my guest! I've activated the teleporter, and I left how-to instructions on the pedestal there. It's easy, so do it yourself if you wanna.
Right. Then I suppose this is goodbye. I pray that you will have the willpower and the good fortune to see your goals through.
...Wh-why are you being all nice now?! Makes my skin crawl... Y-you too, okay?! Good luck, or whatever!
Land of Beginnings - The following day
Miss Ryza, did you learn anything new about the keys?
Heheh. Yeah, I figured out what to do with them. I made this!
Item obtained: Central Foundation Key
A... keycard, I presume?
You mean you synthesized that by combining the four keys?
That's right! This might be just the ticket to getting us across that barrier with no keyholes.
I've seen you perform alchemy several times over the past few days, but even now, you never fail to amaze me...
If we've gathered all the items we need, I'll let everyone know so we can move out.
...So all that's left to do now is reach the control center, then we'll be able to go home?
If everything goes well and the monument is to be believed, yes. Though, I thought you'd be more thrilled about the prospects of being able to go home...
You know, this might be the last thing I synthesize from this temporary atelier. It's a rather bittersweet feeling...
I thought this cauldron looked pretty dark and sinister at first, but it sure has come in handy.
If you've grown that attached to it, why not bring it with you?
Huh? I can't lug something that heavy with me, can I? Even if I found some way to carry it, I'd basically just be lumbering around the battlefield...
L-lumbering, you say? Well... Uhh, it's only natural you haven't mastered your rigging yet.
It's true that your riggings were synthesized through alchemy and have somewhat different properties than ours, but I suspect they should also have similar non-combat functionalities.
For example, there should be ample room to carry something the size of this cauldron.
Allow me to show you...
Whoa, I had no idea a rigging could do that! It's like having your own pocket dimension!
So, wait, is this how you stored the supplies for that tea party earlier, and where you pulled those mass-produced ships from?
Right you are. A rigging is not just a weapon, but also comes in handy in all sorts of occasions.
Woah, this is totally wild... Just imagine all the materials I'd be able to bring with me on my adventures if I had something like this!
Heehee. Now that your cauldron and other possessions are packed, shall we leave for the Central Foundation?
Yeah, let's go! Onwards to the mysterious final destination!

The girls inserted the keycard into a device on the barrier's door, causing all Siren defenses in the area to halt operation. On the other side, a long path across the surface of the water revealed itself.
Phew... I'm glad that worked. This should be a cakewalk from here on♪
Don't take that for granted. Even if their mind-blowingly strong defenses shut down, I guarantee you there's a Siren hiding in ambush somewhere.
They'll know we breached the barrier any second now, so we should seize this opportunity while we can!
Agreed. Let's hurry and find the control device and dispel this Mirror Sea.
No! I was talking about finding all the hidden treasure chests before the Sirens catch on to us!
Think about it. This is the most important place we've been yet, 'cause it's the heart of their base.
So there's GOT to be treasure somewhere around here! The clock is ticking, so let's focus on finding some hidden branching paths!
Hoho! Our brilliant investigator here's got the right idea.
There's only one way forward, but I can see a bunch of big buildings in the distance. There's bound to be stuff to find there, so I second what Bristol said!
We've made it this far, and we may never come back to this place again, so...
Yeah, let's keep exploring to the very end! Treat every adventure like it's your last!
I mean... I suppose there aren't many Mirror Seas as fun as this one.
We're all in this together, and if you want to go exploring, then I guess we could take a brief detour.
(Even though we're fricking guaranteed to run into an ambush precisely by going on a detour! Ugh!)
KABOOOM!
Alfredo, I've discovered a branching path! Unfortunately... there's nothing here either, except for enemies!
Dammit! Did they actually store all their treasure everywhere BUT here?
Navigating a confusing maze isn't rewarding in the slightest when all you get are enemy encounters!
The final dungeon being nothing but a monster mash is such a letdown...
(Maybe this place used to be a factory where they made weapons and mass-produced ships, ergo it wasn't meant as a dungeon...)
Hmm... Considering what we've found so far, I'm pretty sure all paths just lead to enemies. I'd say it's time to turn back.
My word! Look out, everyone! Something big is descending from the sky!
Oh boy, more enemies? I've had enough already.
...This one looks a lot stronger than the rest.
Wings and white armor... Wait, is that the Legendary Monarch of the Philuscha?!
It even has a Siren supercannon and massive claws... It has become even more fearsome than the first time we fought it.
In other words, it's a Siren creation based on data they read on the leader of all Philuscha.
So that's the guardian of this place. I think it's safe to say THIS is our final boss!
Don't mess around with that thing. Its aura is unlike anything we've fought so far.
Oh shoot, it's coming straight for us! Ready, everyone?
Already?! I don't even get to say anything cool before the fight!
SHREEEE!
It's down! We beat it!
Whew... That was a tough fight. The transformation partway through really gave me a shock.
That was by far the strongest opponent we've fought here.
We've become quite the coordinated team, haven't we, Miss Ryza?
Heheh, you betcha! That's what happens when you adventure together!
Oh! There's a teleporter up ahead! I think that's how we'll send you home!
Probably, yes, if our past experiences are anything to go on.
One final hurdle, then we can go home...
Conveniently, someone wrote down instructions for how to operate it! I will boot it up right away!
...What? That didn't work?
Let me try again, just to make sure...
I had a feeling it wouldn't be so easy. Do you think it's broken?
Whaaaaat?! Broken? Does that mean all our hard work was all for nothing?!
We were just one step away...
When you're only one step away from the finish line, take that step! I've handled plenty of ancient relics before, so let me take a look at that!
I see... I think I can fix this, but I'll need a lot more information about the Sirens and their tech.
If that's all you need, you could come back with us to our port. You'll find all the information on the Sirens you could ever want in our archives.
Now that the Mirror Sea's guardian has been defeated, our communications with the port have been restored. We'll at least be able to leave this place.
You shouldn't have to worry about the gateway disappearing either. Even after the Mirror Sea is lifted, the physical facilities should still remain since we never destroyed the control device.
Really? You're inviting me back to your port? I've been wanting to check it out ever since Alfredo mentioned it!
Are you sure it's okay for us to just drop in unannounced though?
I'm more than sure. In fact, I can promise you that our friends will welcome you with open arms.
I'm sure our local technical geniuses like Ingraham, Akashi, and da Vinci will be happy to help, too! The teleporter will be good as new in no time.
Wow. Sounds like you've got some great friends back at port.
...Girls, what do you think?
Everything happens for a reason. A stay at a friendly port could be nice.
It's also the only way we'll get back home, so I support the idea.
I may learn something important by seeing what plants grow there, so...
Heehee. I'm fine with postponing our goodbyes for a while.
So it's unanimous. Alright, we're going on yet another adventure, this time to Azur Lane's home port!

sequence: "And so, the story of the archipelago of secrets draws to an end."
"But, our adventure across this new land has only just begun."
"What things will we experience, and who will we meet at the port?"
"There's only one way to find out... and I can't wait!"

scripts.say: Mirror Sea - In the past
Hum-dee-dum~♫ Dum-du-duuum~♫ Mm-hmmm~♫
A good final area needs traps, crazy gimmicks, and of course, a super-strong guardian!
For all the noise you made about making this place safe, these ruins are anything but.
You hafta raise the difficulty at some point, or else winning won't feel good at all!
It's fiiiine, just trust me. I'll leave riggings behind for them, just like the kind I made for you.
They can use their new power to the fullest and enjoy an action-packed ruin-scavenging adventure to their hearts' content!
As for how to get the stuff into their hands... Oh, I know! I'll just reference the so-called "Alchemy" thingy I saw in the database!
How 'bout we split the riggings into several parts, turn the blueprint into an alchemy recipe, and hide everything throughout the ruins?
Hrmmm... But these riggings don't seem like something that can be made through alchemy, do they?
I thought you believed that nothing is impossible with alchemy!
Hm? Are you that well-versed in alchemy already?
Heehee! Creating a rigging takes more than a Wisdom Cube – you need special supplementary items, too, so they're quite similar in a sense.
I'll just make it look like a cauldron so nobody can tell the difference... Mweheheh...
Once I'm done, I'll need you to divide the recipe and materials for five people's worth of riggings, then find places to hide them.
After all... What's an adventure without treasure?
Mirror Sea - In the past
Inside Purity's temporary command post...
Heh heh! So whaddya think? This baby oughta raise your combat capabilities by at least 300%!
So this is a "rigging," as you called it... Yes, I do feel stronger.
Hrm... How does one attack with it? Do I simply aim straight ahead of me and fire?
Yeah, that's the– Whoa, you trying to kill me?! Point that thing AWAY from me!
If you want some target practice, shoot at Tester's mass-produced mooks outside instead.
Refine my skills through live combat, you say? A wise suggestion. And you? What will you be doing in the meanwhile?
Me? I just pinpointed the location of the Mirror Sea's control center. That's where I'm gonna find Tester.
Take my fleet and attack head-on. While she's distracted, I'll sneak in behind the lines and end her sorry existence with one blow!
...But if we fail, it's gonna come down to a war of attrition, and we ain't winning one of those.
Oho. And you're sure that you'll be able to defeat her in a one-on-one?
Hell yeah I will! One-on-one fights are my specialty!
I see. You Sirens do remind me of the Philuscha somewhat, your kind having both clearly defined roles and unique abilities.
Knowing that, I leave Tester to your capable hands. In the meantime, I shall lead your fleet.
Heheh... It will be interesting to see what destruction I can cause with this rigging in tandem with my natural powers.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
KABOOOM!
That ought to be the last one! Are you two okay?!
We're fine... Thank you.
No problems here. Suruga, you're one tough fighter. I've felled my fair share of behemoths, but it's as if the sea is your playground...
Suruga, I've come to your aid—h-hey, is it just me, or is the fight already over?!
That is our Suruga for you, ever at home on the battlefield. I presume your acquaintances here are more of Ryza's friends?
Lila, Serri! You ended up here, too?!
It has been so long, Miss Lila and Miss Serri.
Have you two been well?
Ryza, Claudia, even Patricia... What a place to run into you girls.
Hey, Ryza... It's been a while. Are we in another world, or something?
Seems like it. So you've already figured things out, Serri?
No... I just sensed that the flow of the air here is nothing like what I'm used to.
Guess that means I'm right.
We just learned about it a little while ago, but basically...
Azur Lane, shipgirls, the Mirror Sea, Sirens... I've never heard of any of this.
But thanks. I'm starting to understand the mess we've gotten into now.
If this really is another land... then Formidable, you'd better be careful. Those enemies had the aura of Philuscha on them...
The Philuscha may have been brought here alongside us.
These so-called "Philuscha," I presume, are lifelong enemies you've fought in your own world?
I don't know about lifelong... but sure, kind of.
Then the Philuscha you know are not machines, but living beings?
Yeah. They hate water by nature, and... Huh. Come to think of it, those enemies were off.
Interesting that you should mention that. While everyone was talking, I took the liberty of searching the enemies' remains.
Based on my investigation, I believe that those were mass-produced models made from Sirens' knowledge of the Philuscha you know.
I base this off of the fact that our enemies' remains were all mechanical. It seems that the Philuscha of your world were not truly brought here.
Guess not... Well, at least that's some good news.
Welp, we've finally got a moment of peace. Say, everyone! It's all dark out, and I don't wanna stay in such a messy place...
Most of all, you've all gotta be tired. How about we eat and rest at my mass-produced ship?
Trading scoops is a lot more efficient when you've got a full belly and a rested body!
I concur with Alfredo! Honestly, I'm famished...
Oh boy, otherworldly delicious foods?! I'm so in! C'mon, let's go! I'm hungry for both food and knowledge!
Hehehe! I've been taking notes this whole time. Let's solve some mysteries over a big meal!
There you have it. Please lead the way, Alfredo.
Roger that! Come, everyone: to the mass-produced model of Sardegna's own Oriani-class destroyer!
Our Sardegnian cuisine is so good, it'll make you forget you're smack-dab in the middle of a battlefield! Now get those butts into gear and follow my lead!
Mirror Sea - In the past
Hum-dee-dum~♫
You're in awfully high spirits.
Duh, I'm in an awesome mood! 'Cause I just smoked Tester, and now this place's resources are all mine!
I just gotta make the salvage program handle the rest... There! Now, we can kick back until the recycling process is all done.
Then is my job here done? I expect you to make up for your "1% of the blame" and send me back from whence I came.
Yeah, yeah, cool it. I'm gonna have to work my magic on this sea so it'll be safer for your five buddies.
Might as well take a look at Tester's database. Let's see here… What did she prepare for this experiment?
Ruins, Philuscha, another world, alchemy... Huh?
Heheh... I've got a heck of an idea. Since we have to recycle this whole place regardless, why not just turn everything into a bunch of ruins?
...I have to wonder what train of thought led to that.
I mean, your buddies were gonna run into Tester's stupid traps. But we broke 'em all, right?
So if we leave without doing anything, they're just gonna arrive at an empty patch of water with a portal sitting in the middle.
That's too boring! They're going to another world, for goodness' sake!
So I'm thinking, how about we make some safe ruins for them to explore before sending them off?
Fortunately, we just happen to have kicked a whole lot of butt around here. There's plenty of destruction and remains to go around. Pretty sick idea, right?
...I've watched the finest of buildings succumb to ruin with the passage of time, but never have I witnessed someone attempting to create ruins themselves.
Incidentally, what would you do if I were to refuse?
That would just mean you're too lame to recognize the genius of the great Purity's plans!
Besides, making these ruins isn't just for fun. It'll be proof that we fought side by side and had an awesome adventure together!
Proof of our adventure, hm? That makes sense. I suppose I have no reason to stop you.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
Now fed and rested, the girls set out to gather information about the place they found themselves in.
My aerial survey is finished. It would appear we are on an archipelago made up of four large islands.

Unfortunately, I couldn't get a closer look on the northern island as it's home to strong Siren defences. I have more details on the remaining three, however. This island we're on is littered with the ruins of stone buildings...
The island to the west is shrouded in purple woodlands, and the last island to the east seems to be dotted with metallic city ruins. Miss Ryza, have you managed to decipher that stone monument?
I've figured out the gist of it. It looks pretty ancient, but the text is just barely legible.
Basically, there are five islands in this archipelago, and the island we're on lies in the center. There's also a few hints that tell us what we have to do.
First, we have to find hidden recipes, presumably alchemy recipes, spread out across the islands. Apparently we'll get new powers if we do that.
There are also four keys we have to gather. It says they'll be needed to break through a barrier somewhere.
Finally, there's one island to the north called the "Central Foundation," which apparently is our way back home.
That's good to– Hey, there's a key right under the monument! We get a freebie!
Item obtained: Land of Beginnings Key
Also, Formidable, are you SURE you surveyed everything? You said there are four islands, while the monument says there are five, according to Ryza.
That is strange, yes, but I can assure you I was thorough. If I had to hazard a guess, the fifth island is likely concealed by some Siren technology.
Hmm... Based on your description, I think that's where the "Desolate Capital" is. There's treasure there, so why else would they hide it?
I say we head there and try to find it. I'm dying to investigate some ruins!
Hold your horses! I wanna check out the Castle of Strife first. Doesn't that "where the brutal truth lay buried" part sound interesting?
Are you kidding me? Treasure sounds way more interesting!
The truth matters more than riches!
We have a conflict of opinions, I see...
Bristol, Alfredo, let's all calm down here! After all, isn't the prospect of seeing real-life alchemy the most exciting thing of all?
Hey, that reminds me... Ryza mentioned something about alchemy when we met her, and she used some weird bombs in that last battle.
I made those myself using alchemy. It's what I do, 'cause I'm a real, honest-to-goodness alchemist!
...Right, I said that earlier. I guess it does sound ridiculous if you haven't seen it with your own eyes...
Then why don't you give them a demonstration with the cauldron we found?
Well, I'd totally love to, but I don't have any materials on me.
In that case, just tell us what you need and we'll help you find them!
You will? Awesome! Having that said, this place is completely foreign to me, so I also have no idea what kind of alchemy materials we can find here. Could you all take a look around first?
Of course, anything to help a friend. I, too, would like to see this alchemy in action.
Thanks! Okay, let's see what there is to find in this "Land of Beginnings!"
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
What is it, Miss Ryza? Have you found something noteworthy?
This plant caught my eye. What do you think about it?
I mean... it looks like a bunch of weeds. What about it?
Hmm... That sounds just like what I need. Let's take it with us!
Ryza! There are some odd pillars over here!
Whoa, looks like the ruins of a building. I'll see if I can break 'em with my staff.
Hey, Bristol! Mind gathering that rubble next to you? I could probably use that stuff as material.
But it's just a pile of rocks... Wait, let me guess – they're infused with magic? Wait, no, they probably contain some extremely rare ore!
Uhh... Actually, they're just normal rocks.
Heheheh... I've totally figured out how it works! Voila! I caught this spider. You can use it as an ingredient, right?
Eek, a bug! P-please don't bring it near me!
Ahah... Yup, Patty's still scared of bugs.
You're probably right about it being a usable material though. Spiderwebs can be pretty useful as well, so try to grab a handful of those too.
Seems like this island is sitting in freshwater. You can directly drink the water.
Woah, you're right! I assumed we were in the middle of the ocean, so I never even bothered to try!
I suppose that means we're not in a Mirror Sea... but rather, a Mirror Lake.
(Wow, she's really jumping to conclusions here! Obviously, the Sirens just turned salt water into fresh water. I don't know WHY they'd do that, but...)
That means getting drinking water won't be a problem! Plus, I can even use it to synthesize stuff.
Even something as plain as water is useful in alchemy?
So it seems. It has quite a number of uses, too.
Normally, there's no need to collect water by hand when you can buy it from a vendor.

Buying things IS more convenient, but nothing beats exploring new places and searching for your own materials. Oh, also, we'll be able to catch fish if I can make myself a fishing rod! Then we'll have something to eat, as well as another material to use for alchemy!
Later, once the girls had gathered plenty of ingredients, they went back to the stone monument. They sat and caught their breaths while Ryza started adding materials to her cauldron.
There we go! Now we mix it all together~♪
Hehe, I can just tell how high-quality the ingredients we gathered are, so what comes out at the end is sure to be ridiculously useful!
...Okay, this is coming together nicely. Let me stir one more time...
Voila! I've made a high-quality neutralizer!
Item obtained: Red Neutralizer
This is how alchemy works? How did you manage to create that from an assortment of completely different things?
Whoooa! Now THIS is something I've never seen before! A magic craft from another dimension!
That weird-looking liquid even came out of the cauldron pre-bottled... That's just wack!
And a photo op! I've got to immortalize this miraculous moment of actual alchemy being performed! Teach and Torricelli are gonna want to see this later!
So, uh, I was thinking about this "rigging" recipe Klaudia found while exploring...
I'm pretty sure this is one of those power-granting recipes the monument talked about. The item it synthesizes should make us able to fight alongside the rest of you.
Really?! I'm glad I was able to help.
Oh boy! I'm extremely curious to see what kind of rigging you'll synthesize.
Moreover, it'll be a groundbreaking discovery if you're able to create a rigging using alchemy!
Ahem. I hate to rain on your parade, but doesn't this entire thing seem a bit TOO convenient to anyone else?
There so happens to be a cauldron fit for alchemy, a stone monument telling us what to do to get back home, and that's only the start of it...
Then all the necessary materials are just lying around, same with the keys we need, and to top it all off, a recipe to make a rigging from scratch.
That recipe is ESPECIALLY suspicious! We found it and the list of required ingredients, written in all capital letters, inside a box!
Granted, I don't understand how alchemy works, but I seriously doubt it can simply poof a rigging into existence. Even if it can, can we really trust this cauldron to work as Ryza expects?
In short, my point is this – the Sirens obviously left all this stuff for us!
Oh goodness... The Sirens did it? ...I did not realize how charitable they were this whole time!
That's NOT the conclusion you're supposed to draw. However you cut it, this is clearly a trap!
Is it? Well, uh... Don't be mad, Suruga, but I just synthesized whatever this "rigging" thing is!
Right as Ryza finished speaking, the cauldron erupted with a blinding light. The next thing everyone knew, an alchemized rigging had appeared around Ryza.
Whoa! So THIS is what a rigging is like! I feel a strange power coursing through me!
...Well, what's done is done. I suppose we could conduct a performance test. Just please, try to be careful.
Mirror Sea - In the past
I take it you're working on what you call the "Land of Beginnings," yes?
Yup! This island's gonna be packed with machines, ruins based on some stuff in the database, and a little bit of my original flavor.
Whaddya think about the hints on the monument, by the way? Pretty good, right?
...These are meant to be hints? They read as no more than a lunatic's ravings to me.
Ravings? I worked real hard on that exercise in wordsmithery!
A real tough customer, aren't you... Well, in any case, what are we gonna do with this next area?
Hmm... Up to you.
C'mon, don't be like that. I could make it look like the place you're from. Whaddya say to that?
I read the database. I saw what happened to your home – how it was ruined and desecrated.
I could restore it back to its lush, green state for you. How's about a trip down memory lane, huh?
I do appreciate the sentiment, but all things created in this place are fakes, are they not?
They're not fakes! They're highly faithful replicas!
Regardless, it would be no more than a fleeting illusion to me. I was cast into this realm amid a slumber, and I have no desire to enter a dream within a dream.
You sure you don't wanna see it? It'd be a piece of cake for me.
I do not care. If you absolutely must create a forest, then keep what you have now. This has more atmosphere.
Sounds good to me! Now the question is, what kind of monsters do I plop down? You need at least a LITTLE challenge for it to be a real adventure.
Wait, I know... How 'bout I base them on the Philuscha?
In case you didn't know, the Philuscha are repelled by water.
For crying out loud... Screw it! I'm going for something brand new – mass-produced ships INSPIRED by the Philuscha.
Philuscha turning into vessels and overcoming their weakness of water... The thought of such an adversary terrifies me.
Mirror Sea Ruins - Land of Beginnings
Rigging test, check! Synthesized a whole bunch of ammo, check! Now, it's time for the real show!
Let's get back to the matter at hand. Which island should we check out next?
Well, why don't we just split up and check all of them?
Not just yet. There are too many unknowns, and it would be risky to scatter our forces.
Suruga is right. When you're investigating unknown ruins, the wisest course of action is to move as one.
However, we do not yet know where this "Desolate Capital" lies. I presume the "Central Foundation" should wait until we've collected the keys, as well...
That leaves us with two options: the "Underworld Grove" and "Castle of Strife."
How about we go for the grove first? If that's the Underworld we know, then it ought to be familiar.
Familiar? Whoa, are you saying you and your friends have been to the underworld?!
Yep! It's a long story, but that was kind of like traveling to another dimension as well.
Let's walk and talk! I'm dying to hear all about your adventures!
Sure, I'd love to share some stories!
Off we go on another adventure, Ryza. I'm just amazed that this is how it starts.
Right?! We've got new friends along for the ride, too. But it's more like searching for a way home instead of exploring uncharted lands.
Heheh, ruins are always teeming with secrets. Getting you back home is important, but don't forget the pleasure of adventure!
Ooh, yeah! You're so right!
Everyone, let's set sail for the western island's Underworld Grove! It's the start of an all-new adventure!
Mirror Sea Ruins - Underworld Grove
Whoooa, no, this forest is too scary for me. I can practically smell the danger and desolation...
Miss Serri and Miss Lila, did you seriously live in a place like this?
You said it yourselves, and I still can't imagine it.
This place does remind me of home.
Basically, Lila and Serri are Oren people. Their home is the Underworld. It used to be such a beautiful place overflowing with greenery.
But long ago, some bad alchemists found out how to go to the Underworld and started stealing away all of its precious resources.
After they stole everything, these monsters called Philuscha started attacking the Underworld. They sucked up all of the land's power and turned it into a wasteland.
They ruined people's homes... That's downright evil!
If alchemists destroyed their homeland... The Oren people must really hate alchemists because of that. D-do they hate you, too, Ryza?
It's no surprise that you would think so. But just as there are good people and bad, one cannot call all alchemists evil. In the end, technology is but a tool; what matters is the wielder.
...Ryza isn't like them. She helped us in our time of need. She uses alchemy the way it was meant to be.
That is why Ryza has my full trust.
Wow, Ryza, you're too cool! You sound like the main character of a grand adventure story!
Hehe... All I'm doing is using alchemy where it feels right, y'know?
KABOOOM!
Ack! What was that?!
Watch yourselves! Enemies are approaching fast!
Enemies? Do you mean the Philuscha-like mass-produced ships from before?
Yes! There are new ones among them, too. Everyone, prepare for battle!
KABOOOM!
Aha! The killing blow is mine!
Incredible... Your stature is similar to mine, but your swordsmanship is on a whole different level... Clearly I still have a long way to go.
If you want to hone your skills, Miss Patricia, I'd be glad to spar with you whenever you want!
Although, you would need a rigging to move on the water. Don't worry, I'm sure we'll find another recipe that lets you equip a rigging just like mine!
You mean I'll get to use something like what Miss Ryza received? I'm... definitely looking forward to that!
By the way, Shimakaze, you can simply call me Patty.
Really? As you say, Miss Patty!
Um... I meant that you can omit the "Miss" as well...
Huh? Oh! Right, sorry!
Hey, Shimakaze, did you notice anything about those enemies?
Hmm... They were just a bit stronger than Mark III's. I'd speculate that they're upgraded variants.
Agreed. I think the Sirens applied the same method they use to make upgraded Enforcers – they added improvements based on external data. In this case, the Philuscha.
Mark III's? Enforcers? Is that what you call the Sirens we just engaged?
It's a long explanation, but basically what you need to know is...
...I see. So Sirens are categorized by the purpose they serve. In that regard, they're somewhat similar to the Philuscha.
Eliminate their commander, and their army weakens. Eliminate their queen, and their army falls apart...
I wonder if the Sirens discovered this shared trait from analyzing the Philuscha and decided to attempt a fusion with them.
That's an interesting theory. It's possible we have a huge Siren plot on our hands! I'll write that down and investigate later.
Uh, let's focus on more immediate things first. The plot can wait.
First of all, there's the second key and rigging recipe. If the monument is correct, it should be somewhere in this forest.
Mirror Sea - Underworld Grove
Serri, what are you doing in the grass?
I'm examining the flora present in this forest.
Huh? Are you a botanist or something?
Serri's part of the Green Plume clan of the Oren. They can figure out plants' traits just by looking at them.
Whoa, that's amazing! All she needs is a glance to identify the species and the genus?
I don't think her ability extends quite THAT far, but it's close.
Also, she's been on a long search for a plant with special purifying properties. How's that going, Serri? Found anything good?
...No. A closer look confirmed my suspicions.
These plants are only replicas. I don't feel anything from them. No life, no growth. It's hard to even call them plants.
Wait, really? I guess the Sirens fabricated 'em somehow. They ARE masters of making fakes.
Hey, let me have a look.
Hang on a sec... Yeah, I can use this as an ingredient!
You serious?! Even fake plants have their uses in the cauldron?
Heheh...
I suppose our local alchemist always finds a way to use the resources at her disposal, even if they're fake.
It takes some improvisation, but yeah. Let's go ahead and gather some more stuff we can use later.
Some time later...
Suruga, Formidable, Ryza! I see a shiny treasure chest under that tree over there!
Wait here, I'll go and see what's–
No, don't go rushing in! It could be booby-trapped!
Second key acquired! See, Suruga? It was just an ordinary treasure chest! You worry too much.
Item obtained: Underworld Grove Key
(Have I been wrong all along about how dangerous these ruins actually are...?)
There was a recipe inside the chest as well! Do you think you can use this to synthesize something, Ryza?
Yeah, this looks like an alchemy recipe to me. Seems similar to the last rigging recipe we found, too. Based on the dimensions, I think this'll result in riggings for Serri and Lila.
I have to say, it's really convenient that they wrote down all the items we need again.
We're missing a few ingredients, but we can just grab those on our way back to the Land of Beginnings. Luckily, I memorized all the gathering points.
What you're saying is, we need only gather everything on that list to make riggings for Miss Serri and Miss Lila, yes?
Probably, yeah! Let's just get the stuff we need while we retrace our steps. Once we get back, it's alchemy time!

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>1 Hot Spring Race</size>

scripts.say: This story takes place after the trouble in the Mirror Sea. It was an ordinary day like any other...
Somewhere in a place some distance away from the port...
Hehehe. The rumors are true, nya! There IS a nice hot spring hidden among the rocks here, nya.
I just have to set up an inn, and I'll make a pretty penny off of...
...Huh? Oh shoot, someone's coming, nya!
Come here, quick, Ema! I've found it!
Hmm... Yeah, I think you're right. You couldn't ask for better conditions for a hot spring.
With a bit of work, you could make this place into something special.
Heheheh! I can see the headlines already – "Sardegna reveals plans to construct a new hot spring"!
There's a problem, though... These rocks are extremely sturdy. We'd need a literal ton of explosives to break through.
That's true... Oh, I know! We'll just ask Ryza to help out! She's like, the leading expert in the field of making bombs with alchemy, isn't she?
Hey, yeah... She might be able to put together something for us if we ask nicely.
Sounds like a plan! Then Operation Hot Spring is a go!
God dangit, nya! I thought nobody else knew about this place, nya!
Lesson learned – never underestimate a journalist's info-gathering skills, nya...
But luckily, they need assistance to make up for their lack of budget, nya... Mwahaha! My budget is infinite, nya!
That doesn't mean this'll be a walk in the park though, nya. I'll probably run into Sirens going to and from this place, nya. I'll need to hire bodyguards, nya...
It's now a race to claim the hot spring for yourself, nya... I need to get a move on, nya!

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>2 Amazing Alchemy</size>

scripts.say: Port - Ryza's (Temporary) Atelier
Now that that rollercoaster of an adventure is over, peace and quiet has slowly but surely returned to port.
I guess it'll be a while before we'll have the portal device back to our world up and running again...
But until then, at least we have roofs over our heads and three meals a day, courtesy of the port cafeteria and the Commander!
I've gotten used to not having to worry about rent and the like, and I'm just glad that's not about to change.
Aaanyway, let's see what we can synthesize today!
*knock knock*
Hmm? Customers? Come in, it's unlocked!
Heyo, Ryza! Good seeing you!
Hope we don't come at a bad time!
Welcome to my (temporary) atelier, Alfredo! I don't think I've met your friends before. Are they your fellow Sardegnians?
Bingo! I'm Leonardo da Vinci, and this here is Torricelli.
Hehe, hehehe... Nice meeting you, Ryza...
Nice meeting you too! ...Whoa, are you okay?
You look like you haven't slept for days, and you're staggering about the place...
Hehehe... Don't worry about it... It's just how I look...
Besides, we've got work to do, Miss Alchemist...
Work? What work?
The bombs, remember? Didn't Alfredo tell you yesterday?
Me?! I thought you were gonna tell her, Teach!
It's no wonder Ryza doesn't know... Hehehe... See, we wanted to ask you for a favor...
Hmm, I see. So you need some really powerful bombs to clear some rocks and build a hot spring.
Yup. The rocks are apparently stupidly sturdy, so we need a big boom to get rid of 'em.
Makes sense. I think I know just the synthesis recipe to make something like that.
Besides, I've wanted to make something out of the heaps of new ingredients I've discovered since I arrived here... So that's what I'm gonna do!
Let's see here... Ingredients to make powerful bombs...
Ryza places a sheet of paper on her desk and starts writing on it.
Whoa, did you see that? That's how an alchemist comes up with a recipe!
This is crazy... Looks almost like some sort of magic incantation.
So... the things you wrote down can make bombs if they resonate with each other...?
Probably!
Only problem is, I don't have any ingredients yet since I just set up my atelier. On that note, wanna come with me and look for some?
While I haven't memorized all the names you use for them yet, I'm sure we'll find most ingredients based on descriptions and stuff!
Sure, we'll come along. You're doing us a favor, after all.
And if you need a guide, I'm your girl! Nobody knows the port's secret spots like I do!
This is a good chance to make Torricelli catch some sunlight, too. Why don't we head out right away?
Ugh... All my sacrifices are in the name of learning alchemy...
After a lot of hard work, the girls manage to gather the ingredients needed to – hopefully – make bombs.
*pant pant*... I hate going outside...
Nice work, everyone! Now it's finally time to do alchemy!
Ryza puts all the ingredients in her huge cauldron and starts mixing them together.
Hehe, hehehehehe... So this is the secret to alchemy...
Get back, Torricelli! I've got a feeling this is not gonna work out the way we hope!
Oh yeah! I know this vibe! This synthesis is gonna be a good one!
Then, with a bang, the cauldron releases a bewildering light.
Bingo! It's done!
Geesh. That looked like it was gonna end in disaster...
You took a bunch of random ingredients and combined them into something else entirely... Alchemy is like witchcraft to me...
Heheh! Yup, you can use it to make anything! Okay, maybe not literally anything, but it's pretty close.
So, do you reckon this is all the bombs you'll need?
Hmm... They look strong enough, but we could use some more just to be safe. Wait here, I'll get some more ingredients!

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>3 Learning the Ropes</size>

scripts.say: Port - Training Area
So this is the area of the sea where they all train. It's every bit as vast as I've heard.
...Hm? Who is that over there?
Okay, Takao. The targets are ready for you.
I see. Then I shall begin now... Swift death unto evil!
KABOOOM!
You took out both the close and the distant targets in one fell swoop. Very impressive.
It's nothing worthy of... Oh, I haven't met you before. Could you be Miss Lila Decyrus, one of the new arrivals at port?
I am. Just call me Lila.
Very well. I am Takao of the Sakura Empire. This is Choukai, one of my sister ships.
It's nice to meet you. Did you come to train as well, Miss Lila?
Yeah. I'm still learning the ropes of my "rigging" as you call it. I had some spare time, so I thought I'd use it to practice.
Having just seen what you're capable of, I feel like the skill gap between me and everyone else has only widened.
I would've never thought you could fight at close quarters whilst firing a volley with such grace...
If you'd like some advice, I suggest not treating your rigging as a niche weapon, but rather as an extension of your body.
Use it with your mind, not your strength, and it will move as if it were a part of you.
Then you will realize that your cannons are more than just cannons, like how a sword is more than just a long blade.
Additionally, your firepower is strongest when you unleash your full volley. However, you can fire individual shots when the situation calls for it.
As for swinging a melee weapon without disrupting your aim, it is possible, albeit difficult.
You'll likely want to practice that, Miss Lila, since your claws and your main cannons appear to be interconnected.
You're right, I should. Would you two be willing to spar with me?
Absolutely. Takao has been training all day, though, so she should take a break. Let's start with just you and me.
If you insist. Remember, while she may not have mastered her rigging yet, she is indisputably a seasoned warrior. Do not underestimate her.
I won't!
Well then, Choukai... Show me what you've got.
Let's see how you handle THIS!
KABOOOM!
Phew... That was close. You're a skilled fighter, Miss Lila. Do you feel you're getting the hang of your rigging now?
I'm getting better with each fight, though I still can't compare to you.
(That said, it is surprisingly fun to be learning under someone.)
Nice fighting there, nya.
Akashi? You're a rare sight around these parts. Have you come to hone your skills?
"Skills" like what, nya? My ability to perform repairs while under fire, nya?
I didn't think of that, but that would be worth practicing, yes.
Ahahaha... I was joking, nya. I'm just here to deliver your lunch, nya. It's on that transport ship over there, nya.
Go on and grab your food, nya. I'll just be over here with Lila for a bit, nya.
Lunch? Why, thank you! Are you sure you don't want to eat with us?
I've got business with her, nya. We'll join you after we're done talking, nya.
What do you want, Akashi? It must be important if it's in private.
Ahem... See, I discovered a hot spring on an island not far from here, nya.
The problem is, some mass-produced Sirens like to hang out around there, nya. I need someone to take care of 'em, nya.
A hot spring? I'm intrigued.
(Moreover, some real battles would be the best way to rack up rigging experience.)
Alright. I'll do it.
Great, nya! I knew I could count on you, nya.
Let's set off at once, nya! I'll explain why you had to leave to them later, nya.

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>4 A Royal Tea Party</size>

scripts.say: Port - Royal Navy dormitory
We are honoured to have you at our tea party today, Miss Patricia.
Please, I'm just honored to have been invited.
All the more so considering you're said to be a very high-class lady, Miss Illustrious.
Hehehe. You needn't be so modest. We are all friends here at port.
Would you like some tea, Miss Patricia?
Yes, please. Thank you.
Patricia takes a sip from her cup of tea.
Oh!
(It's hard to find tea this sublime even in the Royal Capital... These ladies know their stuff.)
(I can also tell it was intricately brewed based on this rich fragrance... That maid is definitely no ordinary housekeeper.)
What do you think? I hope it is to your taste.
It's delicious. I feel incredibly privileged to get to drink something this wonderful!
Hehe. It relieves me to know that you like it.
By the way, Miss Illustrious, you are free to call me "Patty" instead.
In that case, you're also free to simply call me "Illustrious." On another subject, do you feel like you've grown accustomed to life here at port?
Yes, I do. I've settled in quite well, thanks to the Commander and so many others.
That is good to hear. If you ever need guidance, you may come talk to me whenever you like.
I've brought biscuits. Would you like some, Miss Patricia?
Why, yes, I would. Thank you.
The elegant and courtly tea party continues. Then, the still mood is disrupted by shouting.
Illustrious! We've returned from our expedition! You're not going to believe what we saw... out...
Oh...
Ahem. Good day to you, Miss Patricia. We appreciate that you could be our guest at this tea party.
Huh? Um... Thank you for having me.
I presume you've already met Formidable. She is one of my sisters, as is this other lady. Her name is Indomitable.
I have one more sister, Victorious, who unfortunately can't join us today as she is on a mission. I'd have loved to introduce her to you.
Ah, I see... It's a pleasure to meet you, Miss Indomitable. I'm Patricia, one of the new residents here at port. If I may ask, what was Formidable about to say?
N-nothing important, I'm sure! If you'll excuse me and her, we'll go and get changed now. Please do carry on with your conversation.
Okay...?
Apropos of nothing, Miss Ryza told me that Sardegna plans to open a hot spring. Have you ladies heard about that?
That we have. We've already made plans for after the hot spring has been excavated.
There's also been talks of erecting a building where one can relax after they've finished bathing.
Yes. Her Majesty has announced that the Royal Navy will supply the food and beverages as well.
Interesting. That being the case, I'd like to ask for a favor...
Would you let me assist in the hot spring's development? I want to help people out as much as I can.
Of course you can! As a matter of fact, we've yet to reach an agreement with Sardegna regarding the decorations around the hot spring.
I'd like you to handle that detail, if you feel up to the task.
Yes, I'd love to!
And so, the tea party became enriched with an air of enthusiasm.

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>5 Teamwork Makes the Dream Work</size>

scripts.say: Area near the port - Hot spring island
Okay! The time has finally come to use these bad boy bombs!
Alfredo sets fire to the fuse and quickly runs behind cover.
Fssshhhh...
BOOOOM!
KABOOOOOOM!
Heck yeah! Ryza's bombs did just the trick!
I dunno, I think that blast was way overkill... Also, why were there TWO explosions?
Once the smoke clears, the Sardegnian girls lay eyes on a hot spring bigger than their wildest expectations. They then catch sight of a familiar figure...
*cough cough*... That scared the life out of me, nya! What the heck was that, nya?!
Hey, it's Akashi! And Shiranui! How'd you get here? I made sure that nobody else was here, like, a minute ago...
We're excavating a hot spring and were just about to set off the TNT we'd put down, nya.
Then we heard a huge boom when neither of us had touched the detonator, so we came to investigate, nya!
Since you are all here, I think I can guess what happened...
If your guess is that we are also excavating a hot spring, you'd be correct! We found and claimed this place in Sardegna's name!
Not quite... I think we discovered two separate hot springs, but those huge explosions made them merge into one...
Wait, seriously? Uh, in that case, how about we work together to establish one single huge hot spring inn? The bigger, the better for everyone!
Hmm... I guess that's the only realistic option at this point, nya.
A bigger inn also equals bigger earnings... so you know what, I'm in, nya!
As am I. There remains the issue that the supplies we prepared will not suffice for a much larger inn, however. We will need additional manpower.
Heheh, I think I can help with that!
Klaudia? How'd you find this place, nya?
I heard about it through Ryza, then I thought helping you all out would be a way to repay you for all your help.
I should be able to procure supplies for you. I've got all kinds of experience working in business.
That expertise would be amazing to have, nya! Thanks, nya!
You're welcome. Having said that, I don't think my help alone will be enough. We'll need some more people to get all the additional supplies...
Heheh! That's where I come in! When you're in a tight spot, Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers has you covered!
The Knights of the Sea, a.k.a. the Cleveland class is here too! Hope you don't mind us helping out with your cool project!
Cleve looks super hyped... I've gotta give this my all.
Huh? What's brought you all here?
Same thing as you. We heard someone's working on a hot spring and wanted to check it out.
Hey, don't forget about us! We're the ones who found this spot in the first place!
Heheh, don't worry, we hear you. Now we should have all the help we're going to need!
Okay, it's time to get to work, everyone!
Woohoo! Let's get this hot spring inn built, nya!

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>6 Flowers</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outskirts
I've never seen a plant like this before... Nor this one...
I suppose it's to be expected that different worlds have different vegetation...
Um, hello. Are you looking for some flowers?
Yes, in fact. Who are you?
Oh, I should've introduced myself first! I'm Hanazuki from the Sakura Empire. If I remember correctly, you're... Miss Serri, right?
Yes. Nice to meet you.
Actually... Earlier while I was looking for seeds, I remember hearing about a girl around port who's especially fond of flowers. I don't suppose that's you they were talking about?
I'm humbled that you've heard of me.
Picking flowers is the reason I came out here, in fact. I'm working on a floral arrangement, but I'm struggling to decide on which species to use since there are so many...
Seeing as you're here as well, are flowers your hobby by any chance, Miss Serri?
Not exactly, but you're pretty close. I'm specifically looking for a flower with potent purifying properties.
Do you know any flowers like that, Hanazuki?
Purifying properties? Umm, do you mean something akin to an air freshener?
Then I would suggest this one, a species of aloe. You can leave it in a vase to freshen up the air in a room.
So this is what you call "aloe"... Interesting.
Serri inquisitively touches the flower, then softly shakes her head.
You're right, it probably would purify the air. However, that's not the kind of purifying I'm after.
Oh, I see... Well, you might find what you need not far from here.
I really doubt I will. Ryza and I have only found a single flower with the right properties after we searched countless places.
That's... unfortunate.
We went through a lot in order to find that flower... Now, however, I look back fondly on our adventures.
Oh, that reminds me. You said you can't decide on a flower to use, right? How about this one?
While it hasn't fully bloomed yet, touching it fills me with a kind of warmth. I think it represents warm feelings of love and affection.
Ah, that flower is called a "carnation." You know, I think that's quite a nice suggestion. I'll use this one.
Incidentally, how do you know about one of its symbolisms? Do carnations exist in your world, too?
It's an ability I have as a member of the Green Plume clan. We can figure out most things about plants by just looking at them.
...It's easier to show than to explain. Do you have some plant seeds on you?
I do, in fact. Here you go.
Hanazuki takes out a couple of seeds and hands them to Serri. She makes guess after guess at what they grow into and, miraculously, is correct every time.
Wow, that's incredible! I wish I had an ability like that...
I'd say you're already immensely knowledgeable about flowers even without my ability.
Aww, thank you. If I learn anything about a plant like what you're looking for, I'll be sure to tell you as soon as possible.
Thanks. I appreciate it.
Hey, there you are, Hanazuki! I've been looking for you!
Suzutsuki? What's the matter?
Akashi and a whole bunch of people are building a new hot spring inn. They need someone who knows flowers, and I thought who'd be better for the job than you, right?
So, if you've got some time, could you give us a hand?
Of course. I'll pick some flowers right now and bring them with me!
Oh, and Miss Serri, would you mind accompanying me? I think I could do an even better job if I could ask for your wisdom.
Sure. Ryza told me about the project, and I want to help you all in any way I can.
Perfect! Follow me, then!

sequence:
The Alchemist and the Archipelago of Secrets - Peaceful Port Days

<size=45>7 All in a Day's Work</size>

scripts.say: Now, after all that labor, the hot spring inn is finally complete.
Okay, I say let's raise a toast to everyone's hard work!
To everyone's hard work!
Whew. It makes me happy to see people's efforts pay off.
And what a great hot spring we made. I knew all that labor was worth it after my quick dip which totally cleared my mind.
Yeah, I also never thought my business knowledge would be useful in the creation of an inn.
Although, I was pretty nervous about having to suddenly coordinate that many people.
You did it well, Klaudia. And for all your hard work, you geeet... yummy boiled eggs! Have a bite!
Nom... Hmm, did you boil these in hot spring water?
Yup! Some Sakura Empire girls taught me how. They said they're a great pre-breakfast snack. Pretty good, aren't they?
Yeah, really good! You should try one yourself.
*sigh*...
Is something the matter, Patricia?
Oh, no, it's nothing. I was just thinking about how nice everyone here is.
Some Royal Navy ladies invited me to a tea party the other day, and they were also really kind to me. The tea and biscuits they served were lovely, too.
That's nice. Speaking of their tea, I wonder if the Royal Navy's tea leaves are locally sourced. If not, do they have to import them from far away?
You could come with me to their next tea party and ask if you'd like, Miss Serri. I'm sure Miss Illustrious would be happy to have you.
...I could, yes. Staying here for a while longer sounds nice.
Sorry to interrupt, nya!
Hey, Akashi! Want a drink?
Thanks, but I have something to... Huh? What's the pink stuff in that teacup you've got, nya? I've never seen anything like it, nya!
This? It's what we call nectar! I synthesized it using alchemy.
Not only is it yummy, but it's also a solid revival potion.
Ooh... I smell money to be made, nya...
Wait, I'm supposed to deliver a message, nya! The Commander wanted me to tell you that dinner is ready, nya!
Come with me, nya. The party is only getting started, nya!

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>1 The Angel of War and the Judge</size>
Not long ago, before the existence of the Crimson Axis and the Vichya Dominion,
those who bowed in prayer before the Iris' radiance marched under the same banner.
On land and at sea, they coexisted peacefully, united by their faith.
This is a small story from that time.

scripts.say: Somewhere in the Iris Orthodoxy...
A church bell clanged, and little birds resting atop the building's roof took to the skies.
Oh, how the time flies.
I suppose I should start on my work.
Joffre offered a prayer before turning to leave the cathedral. A familiar figure approached her, heading in the opposite direction.
Look at you, prayin' at this time of the day. You're devout, I'll give you that much!
I had some time to kill, that's all. More importantly... What brings you here, La Galissonnière? Surely you didn't come here to pray––
Hahaha! Nah, I was just gonna take the secret passage beneath the cathedral.
Are you sure you should be saying things like that so cavalierly?
It'll be fiiine. You and I are the only ones here at this hour.
I wouldn't be so sure about that.
Overconfidence is a sin, La Galissonnière.
Aw shit! It's Le Terrible!
Hang on, where the heck did you even come from?
I just checked around and didn't see anyone but Joffre here!
I'm sure you can guess. May I ask why you're here, La Galissonnière? Were you accompanying Joffre?
No. She simply came here on a whim, as she usually does.
And now she made a fool of herself in front of the Holy Iris. I say we make her atone with some prayer.
Naturally, the more, the better. I wholeheartedly agree.
I don't! Respect my right to pray on my own terms!
It's always prayer this, atonement that with you two, I swear...
Listen to this though. Apparently, the Tribunal discovered a handful of our relics being smuggled out recently... And guess what?
It seems that the Iron Blood's bigwigs are involved!
Relics? What manner of relics are we talking about?
The sacred kind. Stuff that should be in a cathedral or a palace.
Got your attention? You wanna come with me and see what that's all about?
I'd be lying if I said no, but I have other, more immediate business to tend to. I'm afraid I cannot accompany you on this informal investigation.
Meh, what a stick in the mud... What about you, Joffre? You said you had work, right?
Unfortunately, yes. We're hosting a party for the Royal Navy, which I expect to take up most of my day.
That's today? Bummer...
Guess Detective Gali is goin' solo. Enjoy your "work" and all.
A short while later, Joffre found herself alone in the cathedral once more.
She shot glances in the different directions La Galissonnière and Le Terrible had left, then gave a parting prayer to the Iris sculpture.

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>2 The Knight-Princess and Her Sisters</size>

scripts.say: The party venue is just up ahead. Judging from how extravagant this place looks, there must be some really important people showing up.
Joffre stepped into a park near the building the party was being held in.
As she walked through the greenery, she heard a set of voices coming from around a corner ahead of her.
This is not the place for that. Can't you at least hang in until we get to the waiting room?
No, I can't move a muscle... I'm too exhausted...
I need you to rub me down here... We're the only ones around, so nobody has to know.
Come on, please. Do it for your big sister.
Well... If you insist, then fine. Just relax.
Mmmm~ Oh, that feels so good~
What... the...
What in the world are they doing out in this park?
A little peek can't hurt, right...
Ohhh... Oww... It hurts... It hurts so good...!
Up here, please. Here, too... Yeah, rub 'em good~
Your arms? As you say...
You know, I think this is excessive for a break. You should consider improving your physique and endurance.
Ehh...? I'm just keeping an eye on my energy expenditure though. Wouldn't want to run out of juice when you're on the battlefield, right?
Oh, I see! That makes perfect sense!
Le Triomphant, let's both help her conserve her energy!
Sorry, but no. Spoiling her any more than we already do would set a bad precedent.
Could we please get going now? We must report to Lady Clemenceau as soon as possible.
I know, but I'm seriously too tired to take one more step...
Look, I'll do the hard part of the report if you just let me enjoy my massage for another five minutes.
Well, I suppose I can't blame you for being exhausted... You worked harder than anyone else during this mission, after all.
Your calves look quite tense. Allow me to massage them.
Ah... I'm truly blessed to have sisters as great as you two...
So that's all it is... The Knight-Princess and her sisters have just come back from a mission.
Hard work does not excuse sloth, for sloth is a deadly sin. If others heard of this, it could very well cancel out the merit she just earned.
However, seeing as nobody else is around...
I think it'll be fine to turn a blind eye this time.

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>3 The Cardinal and the Privateer</size>

scripts.say: Joffre arrived at the waiting room and quickly realized she wasn't the only one there.
She was about to knock on the door when she heard a pair of voices debating on the other side.
That sounds like Cardinal Richelieu and Jean Bart...
The two kept on talking, unaware that Joffre was just on the other side of the door.
And that is all that was discussed at the assembly. From questions about the Iris Orthodoxy's future, to the operations to take place across Europa...
The talks were in line with what we expected. Everything went smoothly... Maybe even too smoothly.
It leads me to suspect that Bismarck is up to something... Or perhaps, that our own higher-ups are planning something.
I asked Clemenceau this same question, but... what do you think about all this?
Since you're askin', I'll get straight to the point.
Bismarck's a shark that smells blood in the water. And one way or another, we're gonna be the ones made to bleed.
Recovering and reverse-engineering Siren technology, turning their own tools against them... It all sounds grand and marvelous, doesn't it?
But you've heard the rumors too, haven't you? About what's on the horizon...
I don't know how much the Templar Knights know, but I do know we've got to start preparing for what's comin'. The losses will be unimaginable if we don't.
Someone needs to get the Tribunal and the Orthodoxy's higher-ups to start gathering intel.
Yes. Clemenceau said the same thing.
However, we must not make hasty decisions. It would only cause friction between the factions.
The Iris' future shall never be threatened for as long as our homeland and the Basilica remain ours. Not even Iron Blood can challenge that fact.
Yeah, true, but that's betting a lot on the Orthodoxy doing as we hope. Maybe I'm being paranoid, but still...
It's alright. I've asked the Tribunal and Le Terrible to look into it. It's no use for us to fret over this issue.
Let us not forget Queen Elizabeth also has her plans. All we can do for now is...
...Oh dear. This was not meant for my ears.
No, this is definitely not something a regular shipgirl like me should know. I will do my best to forget it.
I'll bid the Cardinal good day another time. For now, I'd better hurry to the main hall.
Joffre pushed this forbidden knowledge out of her mind, then turned around and ran off to the party venue.

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>4 The Templar Knight and the Attendants</size>

scripts.say: Party Venue - Entrance Corridor
For the last time! Thou art not allowed inside!
Tem, let's just go home. We're not getting in without our invitations...
We have them, we just forgot them! Please, Maillé! You know we can be trusted!
Hmph! When I say no, I mean NO! The Cardinal herself personally entrusted me with this post! Today is the one day I will make no exceptions!
If you truly got invitations, then why can't you head back to your rooms and fetch them?
Well... the thing is, I don't want to miss out on the pastries they're serving just for this party!
It's a long way back to the dormitory, you know? The pastries will be gone by the time we're back!
They're not even meant for you, Tem. They're for the Royal Navy guests...
If it's pastries you want, just ask Dunkerque to make some for you later and I'm sure she'll oblige.
I know that, but they invited us too, remember? So we're guests too! And besides, I want pastries NOW!
Hey, I know! If you let us in, we'll act as little cultural ambassadors for the Royal Navy girls! We'll tell them what the pastries are named and how good they are and so on!
I mean, what if you turn us away, suddenly become short-staffed, and then can't treat your dear guests properly? That'd be terrible!
D-don't go around making up increasingly fantastical scenarios!
The Cardinal gave me explicit orders – any who wish to enter must present an invitation! So do you have an invitation or not, Le Téméraire?
I don't, but I promise I can give the guests the party of their lives! Please, you have to let me in!
Thou shalt not pass! If you insist on passing, you'll have to get through me! Heh heh~!
Ugh, you leave us no choice... C'mon, Opie, we're gonna make a break for it!
...What in the world are you people doing? Are you trying to make us look bad?
If you want pastries so badly, I'll save some for you. Now hurry back and grab your invitations.
Thanks, Joffre! You're so sweet!
Sorry for bothering you, Maillé! C'mon, Opie, let's be quick!
Gluttony is a sin, but in light of your service to–
...Oh. They're gone.
Thanks for getting them out of my hair, Joffre!
That said, had Le Téméraire tried to sprint past me, I would simply have subdued her by force if necessary!
While your devotion to your duty is exemplary, think about the sheer chaos that would've broken out if the two of you really started fighting out here.
Ugh, I didn't even think of that... I'm sorry...
Don't worry about it. I'm not here to get you in trouble.
By the way, has the Royal Navy arrived?
Not yet, but they should be here shortly.
Very well, then I will wait for them inside. Here is my invitation.
Splendid – everything checks out! Welcome in!

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>5 The Saint and the Mastermind</size>

scripts.say: Party Venue - Entrance Corridor
Were you the one who settled the commotion going on outside? Blessed be you and the Holy Iris.
It was no big deal. Could you hear them from all the way in here?
Of course. Those two girls don't exactly have indoor voices.
Algérie was about this close to bringing a tray of pastries out there herself.
I see, I must've come at a good time then. The Holy Iris guides us in all we do.
You were a great help, Joffre. Otherwise, I would've had to order another batch of pastries before the Royal Navy showed up.
Has the Cardinal not arrived yet?
She should be speaking with Jean Bart in the waiting room.
I see. Hopefully things went well, as we need our Royal Navy allies more than ever now.
Jeanne and I are going to take another lap around the venue to make sure everything is in order, so I'll leave you to check in our guests.
Howe of the Royal Knights, Newcastle of the Southampton class...
King George V's little sister, and the former head of the Royal Maids too...
That's a star-studded lineup we've got here. The Royal Navy apparently sees this as a very serious occasion as well.
Will the words that have been spoken behind closed doors remain the same before the Queen's presence?
As someone who only can "judge," that is well beyond my control.
Joffre, they've arrived.
Alright. I trust you'll be looking after them well.
Indeed, just as we agreed on.
I'm ready as well. Let us begin this party.

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>6 The Party</size>

scripts.say: Thank you for coming all this way to be with us, my esteemed guests of the Royal Navy.
We are honored to greet you on behalf of Cardinal Richelieu.
We are aware that it may be difficult to find room in your hearts for merriment after the grueling war against the Sirens...
But today only, we urge you to set that aside and enjoy the hospitality the Iris Orthodoxy has to offer so that we may strengthen the bonds between us.
Once again, let us toast to our continuing friendship.
May the Holy Iris guide us. Glory to Her Majesty the Queen.
After the toast, the participants at the venue started to chat cordially to the backdrop of light music.
Not a bad selection of music here. They've got some favourites from the Royal Islands in addition to the classical.
Yes, they definitely rolled out the red carpet for us.
The selection of music not only helps us relax, but also provides a sense of familiarity and being back home.
As far as the food goes, though, the main emphasis is definitely Iris cuisine.
That's fine, isn't it? Its refined, delicate taste perfectly suits an occasion like this.
Now that I think about it, we sometimes prefer to serve Iris cuisine even when hosting our own parties, no?
That's true. These dishes reflect the kind of peace that we strive towards – a perfect selection, if you ask me.
Having said that, as a member of the Royal Maids, I do have immense pride in our desserts.
Right, maybe you can see if you can help out in the kitchen. Heehee, I'm sure nobody will object to having more delicious food.
I'll do just that. Enterprise, let's head over right now.
Understood. I'll be right there.
Oh my... If I'm not mistaken, you're the Iris Orthodoxy's... Miss Joffre?
I am Howe of the King George V class. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Would you like to try some of our sweets?
Oh, thanks.
(This sweet fragrance... It must be a freshly-baked cookie.)
There aren't any cookies on today's menu, are there?
Correct. But our hardworking Royal Maids aren't used to sitting back and relaxing, so they went to help out in the kitchen.
It never hurts to have more delicious food to satisfy more people, right?
I see... So the Royal Maids made this...
Allow me to have a taste.
Joffre savored the cookie she was given, then noticed Howe was staring at her.
Did I get something stuck on my face... Um, Miss Howe?
Ah, no... I apologise for my rudeness!
I was just a bit surprised by the wings of light that appeared from your back.
They make you look like an angel.
You flatter me, Miss Howe.
Though, now that you mention the word "angel"... Some shipgirls in the Iris Orthodoxy are indeed given that name.
Even though it's more a description of functionality, it is still an extraordinary honor for me to hold one of the Iris Orthodoxy's sacraments...
You even have the humility to boot. Maybe you are a bona fide angel~
Y-you're going to make me blush...
The wings on her back fluttered slightly, as if in reaction to Joffre's emotions.
*gasp*...! Um, may I... please touch your wings?
It's not strictly forbidden, but allowing someone to touch the sacraments is...
Never mind, I'll allow it. Consider it a fair trade for that delicious cookie you gave me.
Thank you very much! Now, don't mind if I do...
Oh? My, oh my... They seem illusory but still have a nice, feathery feel...
Ahh, thanks, that was amazing. Anyway, I'm quite good at baking cookies as well. My friends have no shortage of good things to say about them~
I just arrived today so I'm still getting settled in, but I can try to have some for you tomorrow if you'd like.
I'm sure you'd like to try some of my fluffy, freshly-made cookies, right? Hehe~♪
...Oh! I hope I'm not bothering you with all my rambling!
Um, sure, if you aren't busy tomorrow.
Alright then! I'll be waiting tomorrow at the mansion we're staying at.
Meanwhile, Algérie was watching the two of them chatting away.
There's not much time left before Joffre has to give her speech...
But, it's rare for that girl to get opportunities like this, especially considering her line of "work."
I suppose I should also enjoy the party. Maybe I'll take a look at what kinds of sweets the Royal Maids are making.

sequence:
Angel of the Iris

<size=45>7 The End of the Day</size>

scripts.say: Once the party came to a close, the Royal Navy guests headed for the mansion they'd be staying at. Joffre, meanwhile, was about to leave for the Iris dormitory.
It's gotten late. I will walk you to the dorm.
I do appreciate the thought, but I can walk there myself.
This is the Iris Orthodoxy. Few places in the world are as safe as here.
Even if I ran into some miscreants, we both know how that would end.
Shouldn't you be heading back as well? Or were you tasked with standing guard here?
Not exactly. I'm just wrapping something up.
Or was. I'm having no success, so I'll just leave now.
...Did you drop something, by any chance?
Yes, actually! How did you figure that out?
Heehee. Call it my intuition. You'll likely find it somewhere in the grass around here.
Out of curiosity, what was it you dropped?
My hairband.
The left or the right one?
Um... The right one.
Hmm... Considering where Le Malin laid and where you sat while massaging her...
There we are. Is this it?
Joffre picked up the hairband from the grass and showed it to L'Indomptable.
THAT was fast! Yes, that's the one!
You have the eyes of an eagle! It's no wonder you're on the Tribunal.
Thank you very much!
Oh please, it was nothing.
You mentioned me massaging Le Malin... You saw that disgraceful sight earlier today, did you?
Who says I saw anything, hmm? Now that you've found your hairband, it's time you go home and get some well-earned rest.
If you say so... You should do the same.
Back at the dormitory, a girl kneeled in a room bathed in moonlight.
Praised be the Holy Iris' light. May it always guide us.
I must visit Howe at the mansion tomorrow. I'll go there after I've said my prayers.
I'm curious to see what her homemade cookies taste like.
...Ah. I see La Galissonnière has stopped by.
She saw that a note had been lazily left on her pillow.
"The Tribunal's meeting is tomorrow! You're expected to be there!"
"P.S.: I said a prayer like you told me to earlier!"
A meeting, I see... That must mean there's more "work" to do. I'll have to save the cookies for after that.
O, Holy Iris, we thank you for watching over us today. I pray we will have your protection tomorrow and the day after as well.
Please grace us with your blessings so we may live in peace forever more.
Grasping the note tightly in her hands, she offered another prayer in the moonlight.

sequence:
Paradise Opens for Business

<size=45>1 The Idea That Started It All</size>

scripts.say: Port - Pier
So, I'd like to present and hold a vote on various plans today.
That is, plans regarding the refurbishing and expansion of the port amusement park.
After adjusting the microphone to a better height, I explained why I'd gathered everyone here.
Now, Memphis and I have helped the Commander narrow it down to just a few proposals.
But even after we took out the obviously ridiculous ones, there are still... a lot.
We'll be here forever if we have to go through all of those...
Aw, who cares? It's not like we have anywhere better to be, right?
True, but I think the Commander mainly held this meeting to avoid making a solo decision.
Hmm... But if the Commander won't decide, who will?
Well, it's everyone's amusement park, so everyone should have a voice. Isn't that it?
Exactly right, Napoli.
I see... Well, Commander, I have some concerns.
The success of an oral presentation hinges largely on the speaker's eloquence.
Meanwhile, words alone are limited in effectiveness. Or do you expect us to imagine everything based on simple explanations?
Laffey's no good at this stuff... Zzzzz...
I don't think I can imagine things that easily, either...
Hmm...
Nya~ In that case, I've got just the idea for you, nya~
(If Akashi has an idea, it's sure to cost a fortune.)
(I'll just pretend I heard nothing... Yeah, that's a good idea.)
I know exactly what you're thinking, nya. This time, it's free, nya!
You mean it? Okay, let's hear it.
Do you remember the fantasy adventure game we played before, nya?
Ever since then, I've been tinkering with my machine to make some improvements, nya.
The green cat took out a helmet-like item and raised it proudly overhead.
Turn everyone's ideas into game demos, and your problem's solved, nya!
Ooh. You know, experiencing the proposals would make it easier to give impartial votes.
Wait a second. You already made devices for everyone?
Of course I have... not, nya!
I only have a few I can provide for free, nya. So I want you to experience them first and pick who gets to see them, nya.
So you'll let a few of us wear these devices and enter a virtual amusement park... Am I understanding this correctly?
In a way, it's like a shared dream.
I see the similarity there.
But you forget dreams shortly after you wake up. I doubt that's the same here...
Oh, but Shinano's powers aren't that different...
A dream you don't forget even after you wake up... Heehee...
Amagi giggles meaningfully, but she quickly conceals her excitement.
As for who gets to go in... I don't know how you expect me to up and choose. Do we have any volunteers?
Oh? You get the chance of a lifetime, and you're just giving it up?
I want to prioritize your opinions over my own.
Is that so? If I may offer some advice...
I would first choose a girl who both understands the fun of an amusement park AND has a level of childlike innocence. Have her give a totally subjective appraisal.
Then, I would balance things by picking a second who can offer a logical, unbiased opinion on it.
Someone who gets amusement parks... That's me, right?
You just want to go on a park adventure all on your own!
Aaah! Don't expose my evil motives!
Uh-muse-ment park? That's where mommies and daddies take good girls to play, isn't it?
I bet there's lots of candy there! I wanna go, I wanna go!
The little destroyers are shoo-in when it comes to innocence.
The devices should be safe, but... Nuh-uh. I'm still too worried about it!
(If I'm to follow Clemenceau's advice, then Mutsuki really is the perfect girl for the job. But...)
Okay, I've decided. The girls who get the sneak peek will be Mutsuki and Ark Royal.
Huh?! Why me?! I-I mean, understood! As you wish, Commander!
Akashi, can you get us a few more of those headsets?
I want the people who proposed each idea to be able to join in and show off what makes their proposals special.
Of course, nya! I'll go grab as many as I can, nya.
After deciding on the candidates and the experiment process, I give Akashi my final plan.
Once the demos are ready, I'll have you all gather in my office. Sound good?
Yes, Commander!
And with that, the first messy page of the amusement park chronicle came to a close.

sequence:
Paradise Opens for Business

<size=45>2 Random Superpowers</size>

scripts.say: I-it's finally done, nya... Thanks to Dupleix and Memphis's help, nya...
In my office, the green cat Akashi adjusted the machine. She had bags under her eyes.
Ark Royal, Mutsuki. How do you two feel?
In perfect condition, Commander!
I'm okay as long as I get candy! Hehe~
By the way, Akashi, whose proposal are you starting with?
The one that me, Essex, San Diego, and Hornet came up with~
Reno charged into the office, plopped down onto the couch, and watched Akashi tinker.
Satisfaction guaranteed!
Oh, yeah? How's it going, Akashi?
Systems normal... Okay, nya!
I nodded back and signaled the start of the exercise.
Have fun in there, everyone.
After feeling temporary numbness at the top of their heads, the girls' vision began to blur.
They felt an odd sense of weightlessness, neither floating nor falling.
Eventually, the odd sensation faded, and...
Is this... an arcade?
Yep! This is the lynchpin of our proposal!
Arr-kayd? Is that a kind of animal?
No, it's for games! Try using the gachapon machine there in the middle!
On Reno's urging, the girls try spinning the dial...
What happened just now?
Huh? My clothes...
Mine changed, too!
Yep! You two are superheroes now!
When you spin the random superpower gacha, you get REAL... virtual superpowers!
You get hero outfits to match, too, and then you get warped to the real amusement park!
Goodness. So my power is...
Uhhh... Sloppy Shooter? I can make a gun out of thin air, and I have infinite bullets, but I always miss?
I got Ultimate Reindeer Tamer! When I sit down, I get a sleigh and reindeer!
Reno, these superpowers... are just a little bit useless.
Uhh, ahem... If you want to be a respected hero, you'll need to learn to use those powers!
