I'll show you to the superhero labyrinth escape room right away! You'll understand when we get there!
After showing them to the labyrinth's entrance, Reno explained the rules of the escape room.
Okay, there you go! Use those powers to the fullest!
After she ran off, the labyrinth walls shuddered and shook, blocking the path forward.
There's a red thing over there! A candy apple...?
Hm? You mean that button there?
Stand back, Mutsuki! I'll try pressing it by firing at it!
Okay! But can you hit it?
Even if I'm cursed to miss, I'll hit it eventually if I just fire at random!
Ark Royal aimed her gun in the opposite direction from the button and pulled the trigger.
The bullet took an abrupt U-turn and flew straight for the red button.
Huh?! It worked?!
It hit the button, pressing it and causing the walls to move again.
And not just the walls – the floor at their feet changed, too!
Hehe, this is fun! It's like a tram-puh-leen!
The floor suddenly turned elastic. Struggling to keep her balance, Ark Royal tried to approach her partner.
M-Mutsuki, try sitting down!
Hm? Wanna play with the reindeer? Okay! That sounds like extra fun... There!
The two of them sat down in a sleigh – after much struggling on Ark Royal's part – and the reindeer pulling it began bouncing forth.
This allowed them to avoid many traps and gimmicks. Eventually, they arrived at a passage blocked by a wall.
More red things! Three... buttons? Is that what they're called?
Yes, those are indeed buttons.
Pressing them all at once seems unlikely. But with my superpower...
She pulled the trigger once more. Miraculously, the bullet bounced and struck all three buttons.
...But not without hitting a few dozen trap-triggering switches in the process!
The labyrinth began to morph wildly.
Once the changes had settled, the two of them realized that they were right in front of the exit.
Oooh! Congrats on your victory!
Heheh, how'd you like it? Did the superpowers help?
They were a little too ridiculous, but... sure. They helped.
After they'd experienced a few kinds of attractions, the three of them logged out of their terminals.
How was it?
It was fun! When I sat down, reindeer appeared!
Hmm... I did enjoy it, but I struggle to see how it can be implemented in real life.
I mean, getting random superpowers from a gachapon machine and using them to conquer the attractions isn't exactly realistic to begin with.
R-right... That's the whole point of superpowers, huh? They're not real...
What a silly, obvious mistake we made...
Sorry, but I think I'll have to deny this one.
Everyone's tired, so let's call it for today. You two can try the next one tomorrow.
- Roger! - Okaaay!

sequence:
Paradise Opens for Business

<size=45>3 Vying Melodies</size>

scripts.say: An unexpected visitor came to my office.
Strasbourg?
Aww, are you that surprised to see me?
I get it. The original plan was for Friedrich Carl and West Virginia to present their plan...
But when I expressed my desire to use Akashi's device, they let me do it.
She sidles over to me and whispers into my ear.
It's just such a shame you're not part of the experiment...
I was so very interested in what melodies you'd play at the attractions.
But there will be more opportunities... won't there?
After flashing a mischievous grin, she leaves me.
Strasbourg! Over here, nya~ I'll put your headset on for you, nya~
Upon the cat's beckoning, she goes and sits next to Ark Royal and Mutsuki.
If it feels like ants are crawling on your head, that's normal, nya~ Known issue, nya!
Hmm? I didn't feel anything like that last time I wore one.
Look, I had to turn that giant machine into a portable headset, nya! There are gonna be bugs, nya!
Final adjustments done, nya~ Turn it on when you're ready, nya!
Mutsuki and I are ready.
Likewise.
Okay. Now starting round two of the amusement park demo.
One bout of numbness and weightlessness later...
When the girls opened their eyes, they were in another world.
There are lines in the sky... and tadpoles?
Those are musical staffs and notes.
More importantly, take a look at yourselves.
Hmm...? When did I change clothes?
I look like I'm going to a festival!
That's right. Our amusement park idea is themed after music.
So I had you changed into outfits that matched your personal tastes and the amusement park theme.
The specifications were left vague. I'm amazed that they made such a detailed world out of them...
Music? Notes? I don't really get it...
Strasbourg, this park feels a tad inaccessible to the layman.
You'll understand when you try it. Come with me.
They proceeded through the park overflowing with music and arrived at a giant attraction.
So many toy cars!
They're not exactly toys, Mutsuki – they're bumper cars.
That's right. Each of them represents a musical instrument.
Fittingly, this attraction is called the Bumper Symphony.
When the cars bump into each other, they play sounds. Said sounds compose a song via the attraction's control system.
Wow! Can it play "The Wheels on the Bumper Car"?
Um... P-probably not...?
Go on. Pick the car instrument that suits your fancy.
Okay... I'll go for the harp car. Mutsuki?
I want that long one with the head and tail!
You mean the violin?
Yeah! It looks like a stretched-out candy apple! I wanna ride that one!
By the way, if you go into the golden area on the edge of the lot, the song will reach its high point.
The girls got into their cars. On Strasbourg's signal, they began playing.
Ark Royal's harp car struck a wall, and a lovely harp chord played.
Me, too!
When she heard it, Mutsuki spun her steering wheel and rammed her violin car into Ark Royal's harp car.
The two instruments played a beautiful melody.
Good stuff, Mutsuki! Keep it up!
Really? Okay, here I go again!
The violin car drifted... and the sudden rotation sent it careening into the unmanned drum car.
A powerful, rhythmic drum beat played... but it failed to mesh with the violin's dulcet tones.
Aww... That sucked!
Mutsuki let go of the steering wheel.
The violin and harp cars collided again. Then they struck the sax, horn, triangle, and so on...
The whole lot was full of a mad cacophony of random instruments.
I-it's okay! Let's do it again! If we can get into the golden area, we might just save this!
While other cars kept on bouncing and making random sounds, the two manned cars entered the golden area at the same time, forcing the song to its climax.
It made a melody that was light yet rich, profound yet uncanny.
Yeah... We might need Strasbourg's help for this.
When Strasbourg stopped the attraction's control system, the two of them hastily got out of their bumper cars.
I'm sorry. I feel like I just stepped into musical hell...
Don't worry. It wasn't so messy... In fact, it was bellicoso, in a way.
However, that did prove some of the flaws in our design.
I'll have the Commander deny this proposal.
The girls woke up and took off their headset terminals.
Commander, I must apologize. You can deny our proposal.
If there's another opportunity, we'll correct its flaws and devise a more perfect plan.
There was a smile on her face, but her voice had an air of disappointment to it.
Don't brood over it too much. If you have any good ideas, come to me whenever.
Now you've said it... Keep that up, and I'll just want to monopolize you more and more.
Hmm?
Just talking to myself. Everyone seems tired, so shall we consider ourselves done for the day?
Sure. You two get some rest, and I'll see you tomorrow.

sequence:
Paradise Opens for Business

<size=45>4 The Sweetest Roller Coaster!</size>

scripts.say: My office is even livelier than usual compared to the past few days.
Whaaat?! Let ME go, An Shan! I'm the one who improved on the proposal!
Besides, I have experience using those headsets, so I'm the best candidate for the job!
Absolutely not! If you go in there, you'll cause nothing but trouble!
Then what if we sent Vestal?
Huh? Me? I think someone more... energetic and lively should go.
Then... should this tiger go?
Hu Pen timidly raised her hand.
Aww... I wanted to play with the headsets again...
Fu Shun! I knew you were up to no good!
Nyahaha! When I update these bad boys and officially launch, you'll be the first to know!
Sold! Can't wait!
Fu Shun swiftly preordered her own headset, and Akashi gleefully adjusted the device.
So many skilled chefs under one roof... I have to assume this proposal is related to cooking?
Heheh~ You'll get the answer to that when you go inside!
With everyone ready, I announced the start of the third demonstration.
(Food and adventure, huh? Now even I'm starting to feel the FOMO.)
Another wave of now-familiar numbness and weightlessness...
...And the three of them were faced with a giant refrigerator.
Uh, ahaha... The whole "entrance is a refrigerator" thing was Lung Wu's idea. Little unique, huh...
Whoa! When did we all change clothes?
Hmm? Isn't that how your amusement park works?
I had no idea... Maybe Fu Shun added that when she was improving the plan?
Ah, who cares! Tigers don't fuss over details. Let's get in there!
When they went into the refrigerator, a very unusual roller coaster appeared before them.
The rails split into several different colors, with decorations modeled after various vegetables and seasonings set up near them.
At first, we just wanted to add a space to eat tasty food in the amusement park...
But since we were designing a whole park, Fu Shun said we should build a place for adventure!
After incorporating and adjusting everyone's ideas, we came up with this roller coaster!
It sure looks interesting, but I wonder if it isn't too dangerous for little Mutsuki here.
Ngh... True! But it's just a virtual coaster, so it's fine, I think!
Anyway, just get on! Umm... I think it was called the Roller Coaster of Flavor?
Yaaay! I wanna ride!
After the two had sat down and secured themselves, the coaster rushed forth at incredible speed, as if it had rockets attached to it.
Aaaaaah!
I-I can't handle thiiiiis!
Ark Royal's cries echoed through the virtual sky.
Wheeeee! This is even more fun than the toy caaaars!
The coaster took a turn. Suddenly, they smelled – and TASTED – something sweet!
We can actually taste it?!
It's tanghulu! Mmm, tasty!
Smell aside, how in the world are you feeding it to the people on board?
While Ark Royal thought about it, the coaster reached its next turn.
*sniff*... I know that smell.
Is that the Dragon Empery's legendary aged vinegar?
Uuurgh...
Mutsuki grimaced at the pungent stench.
Yet the roller coaster's inexorable march continued on.
Waaaaah, it's bitter... Eeeew!
Watch out! The next one is... Huh?!
The flavor coaster journey ended with Ark Royal red-faced, and Mutsuki crying from the sheer spiciness.
Sorry! I didn't think it'd be that bad...
Aww, I really messed up... L-let's just leave...
All of them logged out in short order.
How was it?! Did you LOVE it?
Of course you did! After all, the queen of adventure, Fu Shun herself, was the mastermind behind it!
I thought the food lounge idea was better, honestly...
Whaaat?! A negative opinion?!
After seeing off the dejected Fu Shun and her poor friends, I sat at my desk and thought to myself.
(Hmm... Doing this one by one is too inefficient.)
Akashi, can you collect the remaining ideas for me?
I CAN, nya, but...
Actually, forget it. I see only unmitigated chaos in that situation.
Let's do this. First, create one big amusement park.
Partition each idea off in its own section. Don't let any section interfere with the others' operation.
Nya~ Now that's doable, nya!
Then let's do it. This time, I'll join in – that should improve efficiency, too.
Nice! I'd love to tour the park with you, Commander!
I wanna play house while we explore!
Ahaha... Anyway, let's leave the rest to Akashi. You two, go home and rest.
I'll call you when her work is done.
The girls spotted a castle with a pointed roof, the kind you'd only see in fairy tales.
Sunlight reflected off the watchtower and lit up the park with dreamy lighting.
A light, cheerful melody played, and the park air was full of the smell of sweet cotton candy.
Huh? It just started, just like that?
We didn't change clothes this time! And the park is so big!
We really didn't... Where's the Commander? Already in the park?
I dunno, either! But I wanna play right away!
Then let's both search for the Commander AND have fun!
Okaaay!
Thus, the two of them scoured the new amusement park.
They're all normal attractions, but so high-end...
Spinny teacups! I wanna ride those!
Wait, Mutsuki. How in the world do you get these to run...?
The seats are such high quality. I wonder how comfortable they are...
Heehee. Why don't the two of you just sit down? I'll operate the ride for you.
They heard a gentle voice behind them.
Amagi...? Are you in charge of introducing this park today?
Well yes, but actually no.
The red figure approached them with a meaningful look on her face.
This is your...no, all the port's image of the ideal park.
You could even call it your dream.
Dream...?
I don't get it...
Do the two of you remember how you got here?
Huh? We, uh... umm...
I can't remember.
How DID I get here?
I was taking a nap, and I ended up here!
You were asleep? Oh... Now that you mention it, I remember falling asleep, too...
Does that mean we really are dreaming?
It feels too real, though...
Heehee. That is the wonder of dreams... but also a little experiment of mine.
Consider it a sweet dream, relax, and enjoy yourselves.
Will we remember what happened here when we wake up?
If you do...
No, no. Isn't it normal for dreams to be forgotten upon waking?
Forget the trivial details. Enjoy the paradise of your dreams to your hearts' content.
*snap!*
Amagi snapped her fingers. Ark Royal and Mutsuki were bathed in warm light.
This isn't quite like me, but it's fun to shake things up once in a while.
Huh?
Whoa. Did you just change our clothes?
In the paradise of your dreams, should you not have a trick that dresses you effortlessly?
Her fox tail swayed slightly behind her, adding a cunning air to her narrowed eyes.
Now, I'd best be going. Have a lovely time.
Where are you going?
I'm off to meet the person you were searching for.
The Commander, of course. Heehee.
With one last smile, Amagi disappeared into a sudden flurry of petals.

sequence:
Paradise Opens for Business

<size=45>An Encounter in a Dream</size>

An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>1 Another Day, Another Prank</size>

scripts.say: (knock knock)
Oh, that's gotta be Lex!
Which means I'd better skedaddle now. Remember: play along, Commander!
Outside my open window, Saratoga's voice fades into the distance.
She rigged my door with some kind of contraption before she left. I wonder what that's about.
Commander, was that Sara I just– Aahh!
Seems I got my answer. She was here indeed...
Lexington set off the contraption, showering her in colorful party ribbons. They make her look like an ornate Christmas tree.
It's a warm welcome in Saratoga's book of mischief.
Thanks, but I'll be fine.
Oh, you have a blow dryer ready? Okay, then on second thought, by all means.
Please do. Sara's pranks must be relentless for you to keep a blow dryer lying around the office...
After a few long minutes, I finally manage to dig Lexington out from the mound of ribbons.
I understand her love for pranks. I just wish they weren't always so excessive...
You'll have to forgive her for this mess, Commander. I'll clean it up at once.
...Hm? Are you sure?
So she set this prank up for me, not for you... I see.
Knowing her, she must've thought I'm bummed out and she wanted to cheer me up. She worries too much.

options.content: "Changing subjects... How about tea later this afternoon?"

scripts.say: Why the sudden invitation? Don't tell me you're worried about me as well. Nothing's wrong, honestly.
...You insist that I come? Well, I've never tried your tea before, so...
Alright, we'll have tea later.

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>2 Tea and Personal Problems</size>

scripts.say: Office - Balcony
A parasol, a table, and two chairs. Everything is set for our little tea party... yet something feels out of the ordinary today.
Thanks, Commander.
Mmh, it smells lovely. You've practiced tea-making, haven't you?
"Now and then, in my spare time. Say, have you ever wanted to swap roles with Saratoga? As in, be the little sister instead?"
Be the little sister? Did she tell you to ask that?
Hmm... I have wondered what it's like to be the younger one, yes.
She's not known for being subtle, is she?
To answer your question, I'm happy being everyone's big sister figure.
Besides, you can't pick if you're the big or little sister. It's something you're born as.
"True. It was a silly question. I just thought it might take your mind off things."
Heehee. Well, we may not be related, but I see you as my own little sibling.
I suppose I can always pretend. Pretend not to be everyone's big sister.
Listen, something's been bothering me for a while... Will you hear me out?
I'm... I'm planning my next concert, and I don't know what kind of performance it should be.
"Can't you use statistics and focus groups?" you may ask, and yes, I can. They're an easy way to figure out audience expectations.
But I don't want to base everything on numbers, or I feel like it'll cease to be my concert, my music.
The crowds might love it, but I agree with Sara: there's no soul in it.
That's when it hit me. Without knowing it, I've been treating my concerts as a means to gather data, rather than a way to bring joy to people.
And in the process, I've squandered the hard work people put into making my concerts happen.
This problem of hers is very specific, but I understand why it bothers her. Being an idol is more than a job to her.
Luckily, I know someone who can do the number-crunching for her. It would also do her some good to take a day off and clear her mind.
You think that'll solve it? Hmm... If it doesn't work out, at least we'll spend a day together.
Let's give it a try. I knew I could count on you, Commander~

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>3 Data Isn't Everything</size>

scripts.say: Port - Princeton's Room
After a moment's hesitation, Lexington knocks on the door leading to a quiet room.
Come in. I wasn't expecting visitors today, so I don't have– Oh! Commander and Lexington! Hi there.
Don't see you two together every day... Uhh, my room's a bit of a mess. Please try to ignore that.
That's fine. We are dropping by unannounced, after all.
What's that on your whiteboard? One big equation?
There is a very long equation on her whiteboard, so long it could make a loop around Princeton's room if you laid it out on a single row.
Yeah, it's the proof to Bulschwartz's nil-point problem. I'm nearly finished with it.
I... see...
Oh, pardon my math jargon. It's fine if you don't understand. Anyway, you two came at the perfect time.
...What's the matter, Lexington? If something's on your mind, tell me.
Thank you. But do I really look THAT under the weather?
Well, it's more like... Saratoga told me something has been bothering you lately.
Although, she didn't give me specifics, so I just assumed you coming here has something to do with your problem.
Hmm. Where to begin...
Lexington explained her worries to Princeton.
That is a tricky one... I've never even thought about that before, I've just enjoyed your and Saratoga's music.
I daresay I have a knack for math and statistics. The question is, how can I put that to use...
...I've got it! Commander, read this.
Princeton quickly jots down something on her notepad, then rips the sheet off and folds it up before handing it to me.
This may well help solve Lexington's problem.
Huh? Am I not allowed to read it?
It's, uh, best if it's kept a surprise for you. You know, like how your concerts always end with a surprise.
I'm not sure I get it, but alright.
I'll say this: data is useful, but it's not everything. It only tells you the probability of things.
This insight is all I can give you. The Commander and other people will need to do the rest. Sorry.
Don't be. I appreciate your help.
Confiding in Princeton seems to have helped as Lexington's expression brightens quite a bit.
I unfold the note and start reading it...

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>4 Man vs. Machine</size>

scripts.say: Lexington and I take a stroll down the port's main road.
She's seemed strangely absent-minded since we left Princeton's room. I wonder why.
I again check the note I received, then weigh our options on what to do next.
You know, I think Princeton is right about what she said about data.
It's only a probability, not a guarantee that people will like it. But I don't feel like that's fully solved my problem...
All of a sudden, I notice that the sun has set.
Oh. Yes, it has. Time flies...
Goodness, I took up your whole day, didn't I? Sorry, Commander.
...Dinner, you say? I could use a light meal, actually. Let's go.
Well, I suppose we're not finding the answer today, so we might as well.
Besides, I could go for something to eat. Lead the way, Commander.
We go into the canteen to sate our hunger.
As soon as we step through the door, we're greeted by a strange sight.
Please stop, Fu Shun... Leave it be...
Get out of the way! That cursed machine needs to be destroyed! It has no place in the canteen!
Um... Excuse me, what's on the menu tonight?
I hope it's nothing offensive and that's what you're fighting over...
Nah, this is about something much bigger than a menu item!
It's that damn cooking machine! It's a crime against humanity!
Aren't you being dramatic? It makes Yat Sen's job easier, simple as that.
But WE should be helping her cook! Having a machine do it is so boring! And I need an excuse to get up to kitchen hijinks, but that's unrelated.
We could rework it into a homework-solving machine. Processed papers beat processed food.
The canteen has to feed a lot of people, so isn't machine labor perfect in this scenario?
Hah. You're starting to sound like An Shan.
Sure, it lightens the burden on our cooks, but letting a machine make our food just feels... soulless. At least in my opinion.
Anyway, since we're at an impasse right now, there's not much on the menu to choose from. Here, and bon appetit.
Thanks. Incidentally, did the machine prepare it?
Who knows. Human or machine, it should taste the same, no?
Looks like this debate in the canteen won't end any time soon.
All of a sudden, I notice that the sun has set.
Mhm. I suppose they feel things made by a machine have no "soul."
But the food does taste the same... So what actually matters...
Slowly but steadily, Lexington is getting closer to the answer she's looking for.

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>5 Always There for You</size>

scripts.say: After dinner, I accompany Lexington to the concert rehearsal room to help tidy it up.
Here we are, Commander.
With your help, this will be done in a flash.
She opens the door, and to the surprise of us both...
Huh? It's already been tidied up?
But why? I said I'd do it myself...
Not only is all the recording equipment neatly organized, but the floor has also been polished to a mirror sheen, reflecting moonlight coming in through the window.

options.content: "When was the last time anyone was here?"

scripts.say: A decent while ago. It feels like it's been ages since I last went on stage.
I mainly do background work these days. It makes everyone else's job easier.
Since they're the ones doing the hard work of creating a wonderful performance, it's only fair that I take care of the little things.
Clearly, someone wanted to take on extra work, though.
Hm? I don't remember this being here...
There is a small box placed on her personal shelf. Whoever cleaned the room must've left it for her.
She opens the box, and an upbeat tune starts playing.
Surpriiiiise! Got you pretty good, didn't I?
You mustn't work yourself too hard, Lexington. Take a well-earned break. We'll all be on stage together again soon!
Ugh, do I really have to say this? Fine... Ahem! We'll take care of the small stuff. You just focus on enjoying yourself! Got it?
Heya, Lex! Seriously, take a break, alright? You'll burn yourself out if you force yourself to keep working. Don't you worry, the rest of us'll pick up the slack.
And if I catch you lifting one finger, you bet your butt you're gonna get pranked! I'm already super-duper upset with you for not listening.
I'll only forgive you if you do two things – lay off the work, and bring the Commander to the concert!
The little box, like a voiced greeting card, finishes playing its message.
We look inside it and find two concert tickets taped to the bottom.
I'm... I'm glad I have friends who look out for me.
With a serious gaze and tender smile, she eyes the box and the tickets.

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>6 The Answer is in Your Heart</size>

scripts.say: Lexington and I leave the rehearsal room, find a place to sit, and stargaze.
What am I supposed to do, Commander?
"Nobody can deny how hard you work every day, helping people in the way only a big sister can."
"It's also clear that you take being an idol very seriously. But, you have a problem – that you shoulder too many burdens for one person."
You think I've bitten off more than I can chew?
"Yes. It doesn't matter if you take a shortcut or two as long as people love your concert."
"I'm not the most well-versed when it comes to idol work, but you shouldn't be afraid to ask others for help. That's what friends are for."
So it's about the big picture, not the details... Like the food in the canteen. Who or what made it isn't important, sharing it with your friends is.
I think I understand now. Thank you, Commander.
It's about overcoming obstacles alongside other people and celebrating it together.
I can't shoulder everyone's burdens on my own. That's just impossible on every level.
It's no wonder people have been saying they're concerned about me...
I need to rely on others more. Together, we can overcome any challenge we face.
That's the solution to my problem, isn't it?
Thank you, Commander, for spending the day with me and helping me realize this.
I'll make a habit of asking for a helping hand whenever I can.
"Well, seeing as you've solved your problem..."

options.content: "Let's stay and enjoy our date a while longer."

scripts.say: This is a date?! Has it been one, all along?
I suppose, in a way, it is. Darn, I should've realized sooner and said it myself.
Hey, I'm in a singing mood right now. Will you stay and listen?
Think of it like a special concert, just for you, Commander.

sequence:
An Ode to the Sea

<size=45>7 A Song for the Azure Seas</size>

scripts.say: Ever since that day, Lexington has been preparing something big.
Tonight, it's finally time for the concert I agreed to come to.
Port - Concert Venue
Although we're only attending as audience members, Lexington is exceptionally fired up.
Have a glow stick, Commander~
Why wouldn't I be? I'm with you!
Plus, I've got a surprise prepared for you. I think you're going to like it.
Ah, Sara's going on stage. I need to get ready!
Everyone, it's time for a special feature with someone close to my heart! With who, you wonder? Good question! Can you guess?
What's that? Nobody has any ideas?
Alright, I'll just show you then!
With a snap of Saratoga's fingers, the spotlights shine down on Lexington, standing right beside me.
It's what you've been asking for! A duet featuring both Lexington sisters!
The audience bursts into applause.
Heehee. This will be the best concert of your life.
Weren't expecting this, were you? Heehee~
You're going to love this performance, Commander.
I'll see you after the show♪
She faces the crowd and throws her hands in the air. She is answered with booming cheering.
The excitement of two big time idols appearing on stage together is nothing short of incredible.
There you have it! Our surprise for you is a comeback performance with my sister! Hope you're all as excited as I am!
Thank you all for your heartfelt support! Now, Sara, let us sing!
We dedicate this song to our love and passion for the azure seas!
Lexington gracefully steps onto the stage.
Tonight, it's not the spotlights lighting up the stage, but rather her luminous presence.
Northern Parliament Base, Location Unknown
It's been a while, Pamiat' Merkuria. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed~
Oh, hey Avrora! I'm glad to be back!
Ugh, I'm totally beat... But being able to move our plans forward is quite fulfilling.
Will you be joining the upcoming operation as well?
Certainly. Even I long to prove my worth on the battlefield every now and then, hehe.
Having that said... Isn't it weird that old-timers like us with our rickety rigging have to participate in such a dangerous operation?
What was that about my age...?
Err, that's not what I mean... Y'know, even if we've been modernized, our designs are what they are.
A little modernization goes a long way. It's certainly better than nothing.
Well, yeah. I'm definitely stronger than I was before, even if I'm not some brand-new, completely different ship.
Unlike usual retrofits, where certain rigging components are swapped out for new ones, this retrofit was more of a complete overhaul.
For better or for worse, we've incorporated some pretty sketchy technology into our riggings.
Speaking of retrofits, the other factions have been pursuing similar projects, have they not?
Yeah... Seems like the tech made its way around the other major factions a while ago.
That may well be the case, but we seem to have gotten left out of the loop. The technology they've given us is rather rudimentary.
Well, we've found our own ways by now, right? After we explored the Arctic Stronghold and the Arcana Sanctum~
But, whether or not we incorporate that technology depends on the higher-ups, as well as the compatibility of our riggings.
So you were one of the lucky ones, huh? I guess I'll be counting on you to protect little ol' me~
Stop being such a tease! You're stronger than me anyway!
After all, during the last Great War, you were the only reason the Azur Lane––
You're not about to just casually spill our most closely-kept secret, are you?
Fiiiiine, though I don't see why it matters since there's nobody else around... Well, let's move on then!
Besides, it's not like I know the details either. When'd you find out about the Cubes anyway?
Who knows? When it comes to knowledge and intel, more isn't always better.
You really don't plan on telling me anything, huh? Well, fine, I didn't want to know anyway!
Mm, that's better. We're about to get to business soon anyway~
Beep––––
Good day, comrades. I assume that after reading the contents of our next operation, some doubts may linger on your mind.
Due to the importance of the situation, some details could not be adequately put down into text, hence the purpose of this call. If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
Ooh, pick me!
So according to the operation packet, we're supposedly carrying out a raid on a Siren facility in Iron Blood-controlled waters.
Now that the ceasefire agreement has been signed over the situation in the NA Ocean, wouldn't this operation land us in hot water?
That is not a concern. Few people know about this hidden Siren facility. Should a firefight break out, your activities would be covered up by the Mirror Sea itself.
Alright... If that's the case, how do we know so much about this facility?
Let's just say, we have a trustworthy informant.
Huh... I wonder who that could be...
Besides, countermeasures against the Siren menace are a common goal shared across all factions. Even should we be found out, we have plausible deniability.
That makes sense. I'll leave the complicated political stuff to you then, Soyuz.
Haha, that was the plan to begin with. Just keep your wits about you, and there shouldn't be any problems.
All right, will do!
Right, I've got another question. If we're attacking a Siren facility, will we have enough firepower with just me and Avrora?
The Siren activity in that area has all but ceased now. There won't be a battle.
Did you also learn this from your trustworthy informant?
Yes, and you can trust this information.
Hmm... Well, that's good enough for me.
Soyuz, I've seen a "retrieval target" mentioned in this operation packet, but nothing about what it specifically is.
Frankly... We don't know exactly what "it" is either.
...You don't know? What do you mean by that?
For the lack of a better description, it is something not bound by the laws of this world. By definition, we won't know of its nature until we see it.
That's where you come in. If you find anything that might fit that description, whatever it may be, retrieve it.
A quest for unobtanium, huh? Reeks of a fool's errand to me, if I may be honest.
Unfortunately, that's the best information we're going to get. We have neither the time nor luxury to conduct a thorough investigation beforehand.
Now that the defenses in the Iron Blood-controlled areas are thin and the Sirens are reeling from their defeat in the NA Ocean, this is our best time to strike.
I can't stress enough the importance of this mission. That's why I've entrusted this operation to you and Pamiat'.
Very well. We'll get you your results.
Good luck. I'll be ending the communication then.
I don't think I've ever seen Soyuz look unsure of herself before. Guess there's a first for everything.
...Unsure, huh.
What's the matter, Avrora?
Oh, it's nothing. I was thinking the same thing as you.
(How long has it been since I last saw her make that expression? ...We'd better prepare for all contingencies.)
Near the Siren Facility
Looks like the intel we got was accurate - there's hardly been a peep from the Sirens here! That "trustworthy informant" sure is something else!
I'm glad to see you in high spirits today, Pamiat'~
Naw, it's just another normal day for me! Though, I guess seeing all this is like a walk through memory lane?
Hm? From back when you fought with the Iron Blood?
Mm, well, I guess so. Even back then, the Iron Blood was... how do I put it...
Mavericks? Always saw the world a bit differently from the other factions.
Yeah, yeah! You've got a way with words, you know~
Back when the Sirens appeared, the Iron Blood was the only one of the four major factions that just charged headlong into the unknown foe.
And they sustained heavy losses because of it. After that, the major factions came together and fought under the banner of the Azur Lane.
I suppose I don't need to speak too much about them forming the Crimson Axis and turning against us after that––
Outside of their Reenactments, they'll still work with us to fight against the Sirens––
But at the same time, I can't make any sense of their decisions at all. Like, why they attacked Scapa Flow.
I was just thinking, is the enemy of our enemy really a friend? It's really frustrating to think about. We didn't understand them back then, and we still don't understand them now.
The strings that hold our alliances together are thin and fragile indeed. They may snap, or weave into different forms altogether.
You get what I'm saying, right?
Some of the comrades I fought with back then have retired. Others have been sunk, decommissioned, or scrapped. It seems like fewer and fewer of us remember the feeling of fighting together.
Those who came later... Know only of a world where the Azur Lane has fractured.
I sometimes wonder if we're being manipulated. Can we really come together again to defeat the Sirens for good? ...Avrora?
I'm not sure. But, as long as we come together, it doesn't matter if we're a mixture or a solution as long as we work towards the same goal.
Even if we live in a fractured world, there is hope as long as we can put aside our differences.
Conversely, if we come together but everyone has their separate motives––
...What are you trying to imply?
Oh, nothing at all~
As far as I'm concerned, we don't need to worry about the complicated stuff and just do what we believe to be right – and everything will be okay.
...Oh my.
Avrora?
The "Mikoyan"... The icebreaker belonging to the Polar Expedition Fleet...
For whatever reason, a huge gantry crane was sticking out of the water in the middle of the area surrounded by Siren ruins.
It's that ship! What in the world is it doing here?
This has to be the ship that disappeared during the Polar expedition a long time ago, right?
I have no idea why it's here either, but... the reality is right in front of us.
Soyuz did mention for us to keep an eye out for things "not bound by the laws of this world." I'd say that this ship appearing here would count as that.
Weird... It doesn't seem to have taken much damage from battle either...
Oh! Do you think the Sirens got their tentacles on it?
That's strange, isn't it? The ship that went missing all that time ago somehow showed up again over here...
We can't just leave it here. There might be important data stored on its sensors and equipment.
So, what's the plan?
Sorry, I got a bit excited there. Hmm... Let's deploy our mass-produced ships and tow it back into our territory first.
After that, we need to investigate it thoroughly before the higher-ups get their hands on it!
Sounds good to me! We need to find out what happened during that operation!
All right, Mikoyan, it's time to come home!
The icebreaker, escorted by Pamiat' Merkuria and Avrora, was safely brought back to one of the Northern Parliament's ports.
Pamiat', how much do you know about that "failed" Polar Expedition?
Probably nothing that you don't already know. Even after all our hard work, we went home empty-handed.
If I remember, that was around the time the Crown first appeared. We were so confident that we'd be able to push deeper into the Polar region's unknown depths with our new powers.
Things seemed to be going so well, but before I knew it, the Mikoyan had disappeared, along with all the research outposts we had set up.
Just like that, we lost everything. The fleet, the experimental submarine, even the massive base and outposts we had.
Indeed... There's a bit more to it from my end though.
At first, all the communications we were receiving from the base were normal. Then suddenly, we got a distress signal.
But when we tracked down the signal, we couldn't find any trace of the ship that had sent it. No signs of movement, no wreckage, nothing.
By the time we got there, all we saw was an empty sea of ice.
We searched around, but couldn't find any traces of the base.
Eventually, the search was called off and the operation was deemed a failure.
Of course, we suspected the possibility of a Mirror Sea and assembled several fleets to search the area near the operation site.
Even Soyuz herself joined the search efforts, but to no avail.
And that was the first time you ever saw Soyuz lose her cool, huh? It's crazy that something like that happened...
But, I think I can understand how she felt. She personally saw that fleet off too, didn't she?
Yes... It must've been a serious blow for her...
After that, between the Singularity and the Arctic Stronghold, their persistent attacks thinned out our resources. We were never able to conduct a follow-up expedition.
Since then, that expedition has remained buried under a mountain of documents as a "failed" operation. Only recently has it been dug back out.
After replaying the situation again and again, the only plausible explanation I could come up with is – the actual location of the base might not have been where we thought it to be.
The base, as well as the Mikoyan, must have traveled through a Mirror Sea and "moved" to another location.
So, in other words, our base might've been built on top of a Mirror Sea site from the very beginning?
Yeah, that does make sense! Anomalies can occur inside a Mirror Sea even in the absence of Sirens, and...
The fact that we found the Mikoyan at a Siren facility supports that hypothesis!
Right, and I have one other piece of evidence.
The SOS signal we received in the first place might've been fake.
Fake?
During the time of the Arcana Sanctum exploration, we received some information from Belorussiya and the Commander regarding the Sirens' transmission frequency.
After we repaired the radar, we started receiving a mysterious ping from an unknown location.
At first, we wrote it off as background noise, but one day, we realized that it was actually an encrypted communication with a deactivated password.
The contents read, "We are under attack, requesting support immediately," which matched up perfectly with the SOS signal we responded to.
Wait a minute, doesn't that mean that whatever device sending the junk signal is still in operation somewhere?
Yes, and we reached the same conclusion as well. The appearance of the Mikoyan here may well confirm our suspicions.
Ugh... That seems way too convenient, almost like someone WANTED us to find it.
I agree. In any case, Soyuz seemed to have some inkling about all these things happening. We were just sent to retrieve the proof.
Whoever our "trustworthy informant" is must be really formidable.
Yeah... And hopefully we'll learn more once the analysis on the Mikoyan finishes running.
If we're lucky, we might even find out about that base's disappearance.
Even if this is a trap, we must find out how it works in order to secure the safety of our waters.
(And in all likelihood, what Soyuz truly wants to know––)
Somewhere in the Northern Parliament
Inside a dimly-lit room, Sovetsky Soyuz repeatedly looked over the report from Avrora and Pamiat'.
The Mikoyan, huh...
An unexpectedly major find.
Indeed. I'm glad to see that you're pleased with our "work."
A robotic-sounding female voice came out of a communicator that had been planted somewhere without anyone's knowledge.
Treat this as compensation for the losses incurred during the previous "incident," and for our continued cooperation.
Where are they...?
Unfortunately, I didn't have time to collect that information.
If you want to find out what happened, you'll have to do the rest of the work yourself.
I see. It must've been difficult for you to procure this.
However, this "compensation" won't be enough. Information alone won't satisfy me.
Prolonged loss of our shipping routes. Constant encroachment into our territory.
As long as the Naval HQ does not cease their actions, an agreement between ships only carries so much weight.
Soyuz, you won't get anything out of guilt-tripping me.
But, there is something we can do. Not through Reenactments, but through our power. And the Commander's power.
Yes. As you know, "Reenactments" will only lead to the Iron Blood's ruin.
There is no future for that Iron Blood. One built on Bismarck's power––
Bismarck? Are you taunting me, or praising me?
Take it as praise. Bismarck was a respectable leader, and the two of us shared the will and vision to create change.
...Then, I trust we will be able to continue our fruitful relationship, Soyuz.
With the final "Key" retrieved from the Arcana Sanctum and the Commander's power, the Northern Parliament will also be freed from the shackles of the past.
Let us both move towards a new future. Hehe.
After the communication ended, Soyuz remained silent for a few seconds... then dozens of seconds.
Regret. Defeat. Accomplishment. Hope. And the future –– A number of words coalesced into a storm of chaotic emotions.
In that silent space, she sifted through the chaos, ordering it with her icy will and rationality, unifying that which had branched.
...The time had come. Opening up a dedicated line of communication, Soyuz began to send a new message––
...Based on the information and physical evidence obtained from the Siren facility, we believe that the Polar Expedition Fleet is likely to be alive.
...Therefore, from the perspective of retrieving Siren technology as well as providing relief efforts, our fleet proposes the following operation in consideration of our current strength:
"Form a rescue team, rescue the Polar expedition fleet, and collect information and materials related to the Sirens."
"Let the responsibility for the tasks aforementioned fall upon Sovetsky Soyuz."

signDate: Murmansk, Arctic Circle - Northern Parliament Territory

scripts.say: It is my pleasure to inform you that we've successfully completed the first part of Her Majesty's supply delivery.
The second convoy is expected to arrive later this day. Please make the necessary preparations for its arrival.
We greatly appreciate your support. These supplies will surely be a great help in our battle against the Crimson Axis.
Please inform Her Majesty that she has our gratitude and our blessings. God Save the Queen.
Certainly. We are eagerly awaiting your future participation in the war. God Save the Queen!
Thank goodness... We've finally finished our last convoy mission... Now we can go home...
Just the thought of getting to drink Belfast's tea again is helping me warm up inside~!
We cannot let our guard down just yet. We may still encounter danger on our way back.
Be it these freezing temperatures, or threats lurking beneath the surface...
Sheffield, is something the matter? You haven't spoken much for some time now.
That girl, Avrora... her smile didn't seem sincere to me.
I don't believe we should trust the Northern Parliament.
You're overthinking the matter. We have formed an alliance with them so we have every reason to mutually trust one another.
Do you not agree that it is our duty as Royal Maids to have faith in Her Majesty's and the Commander's judgement?
... Let's hope I'm simply being paranoid.
... Now, according to our intel, there is a chance that we will encounter moderate Siren opposition on our way home, therefore I urge everyone to remain vigilant! Now, let us set sail!
(My sister once sailed across this same ocean... It must have been just as freezing back then...)
... Vessels of an unknown identification signal detected at 12 o'clock. They are rapidly approaching.
T-they're enemies we've never encounter before?
They must be the new models the Eagle Union warned us about. They indiscriminately open fire on any passing vessel... They are extremely troublesome, indeed.
With the second convoy en route, we cannot simply ignore this threat.
All units, enter battle formations! Let us show our enemies the courage of the Royal Navy!
... Roger that!
Glory to the Royal Family, and demise to all those that opposite it. God Save the Queen!
Your performance was splendid, everyone. It seems they were not so troublesome after all.
Thank goodness... Those new Siren models aren't all that scary. Or maybe we're just really strong...?
Anyway, now we should hopefully be able to go home...
Wait just a moment, please, Norfolk. I'm receiving an urgent message from headquarters...
... It seems we will have to take a detour.
We just received a message informing us that the second convoy has been attacked by Iron Blood forces.
We had already anticipated this, and it would seem that we have a shark on the hook.
One of the "ugly" ones?
Correct. We have fought her in the past, but it seems this time we'll be able to settle things for good.
But we don't stand a chance if we go up against a battleship with our firepower...
There is no need to worry. Headquarters has already taken precautions against the enemy. Duke of York should be en route to provide support.
Our mission is simply to pursue and pester the supporting Iron Blood forces until Duke of York has arrived.
Matchless, Musketeer, may I ask you to provide reconnaissance?
Of course!
Now then, ladies... It's time to reel in the catch!
We meet again, my Royal adversaries. Or should I call you a royal pain in my ass?
I am Belfast, chief of the Royal Maids. The pleasure is all mine.
Had it not been for your fleet's sudden visit, I could have been in Scapa Flow by now, brewing the afternoon tea for the young mistress...
If you'll pardon my request, would you kindly scuttle yourself to make this easier for all parties involved?
Just as full of yourselves as ever, huh... I knew this battle would come one day.
Good timing, too! My cannons have been aching for some target practice to warm up in this freezing weather!
En garde, you pompous, tea-swigging bastards!
Eek! My radar and engine have been hit... I can't continue fighting... I'm sorry...
Tsk... I don't have time for you little worms! I have more important things to do!
Starboard, 150 degrees! Full speed retreat!
Oh, are you going to run away once more? How unfortunate, I had just started enjoying myself...
Sheffield, what's your current status? Will you be able to pursue her?
I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with my engine... I won't be able to pursue at maximum speed.
Understood. But, I would wager that she's bluffing and will turn to attack the convoy soon enough. How soon do you think you can affect repairs?
A reasonable assumption. But if we can't repair quickly, you're intent upon going after her... alone?
Those sisters have caused the Royal Navy far too much trouble... We have been given a chance to make them pay, and I will not let it slip by!
You saw through my trick, huh... What do you think you, a lone light cruiser, can do to a battleship like me?
I am prepared to fight tooth and nail for Her Majesty's and the Royal Family's glory and reputation.
All guns, train sights on the enemy! Prepare to fire!
I was wrong to call you pompous. If you're going all out, then I too will treat you with respect and fight you with all my strength.
Come at me! I hope you're prepared to be chewed into pieces!
... Gah!
Pretty good, for a maid. But I can tell you don't have much strength left, and soon the sharks will be nibbling at your feet...
I will grant you a soldier's demise. All guns, train sights on...
... What the?! Anton's been hit...?! Who did that?! Who the hell did that?! Who's the slimy little crumpet-munching island ape bastard out there who just signed her own death warrant?!
... I know very well that my 6-inch guns cannot penetrate your armour. However...
My mission was simply to create a more favourable situation for my allies...
Even if I were to perish here, I have already assured our victory... I hope you will enjoy having the Duke for company...
My Majesty... I'm afraid it seems... I will no longer be able to brew tea for you... Ugh...
Sorry, but it is not thy time yet, housekeeper. The shark shall be mine to hunt.
Destroyers, protect Belfast and evacuate right now!
Roger! Deploying smokescreen!
Looks like the damn cavalry has arrived... You little rats managed to sneak up on me...
That maid knew she couldn't pierce my armor, so she went for my radar, huh...
Hmph. I guess this is it for me.
Heheh, my sincerest apologies for interrupting thy duel. But now, thine opponent is me.
Warm regards from the fifth ship of the George V-class, Duke of York.
Fiiiiire!!
Command, this is Scharnhorst! I will fight on until the last shell is fired!
Caesar! Lock sights on Duke of York!
Thou tires me with thy prattle. Thy role here is over... Sink!
... Ahahaha... My sister and I caused so much havoc in the North Sea that people started calling us "the Ugly Sisters"...
Countless times I've managed to flee from danger, and yet, this is where it ends for me...
By the hand of a bunch of arrogant Royal Navy ships, no less...
But that's what's so charming about you...
... Auf Wiedersehen, servants of the Royal Family.
Though her struggle was futile from the beginning, she was a warrior who fought until the very end.
Sisters of the Royal Navy! The battle against Scharnhorst has ended in victory for us! However...
I hope that any of thee who are ever called upon to fight against an opponent many times superior, will fight as gallantly as Scharnhorst fought today!
All right, girls. 'tis time to go home... There are still combat operations to be carried out.
I'm no longer receiving Scharnhorst's identification signal from the testing area.
Hmm, so it's just like back then with the Z Fleet... Giving her even more power doesn't affect the outcome.
But there's one thing that caught my interest.
The second Royal Navy convoy heading for the Northern Parliament was sunk by planes.
On the current settings, Iron Blood shouldn't have the strength to launch an aerial attack... So how could this happen...
According to the script... Next up, the Royal Navy should be the ones launching a large-scale aerial attack.
In light of this information, we will have to observe them even more closely.
We're leaving the North Sea in your hands, Purifier.
Ahahahaha! Yay, it's finally my turn!
And if "she" gets in the way... Ahaha, well, you already know what to do.
Of course! Oh, I'm going to have so much fun out there! Ahahahahahaha!
Special Task Force One has arrived at the objective. Rendezvous complete.
Victorious of the Royal Navy has arrived!
Thou have cometh from far away. Dost thou still remember the Northern Sea?
I may have always been fighting on the other side of the world, but... how could I possibly forget my birthplace and its nostalgic sea breeze?
Oh, right, I've brought some fighter planes with me from the Eagle Union!
Is that so?
Have a look! This little darling is known as a "Corsair"! It has specs comparable to our Seafires! And you wouldn't believe how many bombs it can carry!
The Eagle Union's fighters are just so marvelous! And look at this, this is a Wildcat! It can...
Ahem... Returning to the topic at hand, what of the target?
Ah, you'll have to excuse me. I can't help myself when I get excited...
Ahem! My recon planes have already spotted the target. She hasn't moved an inch. Perhaps she can't even move at all?
The lone wolf of the north... Though struck by X-boats, she managed to survive. Truly, a defence most formidable.
In any case, this is an opportunity for the Royal Navy to solve the threat in the Northern Sea once and for all.
Indeed. As soon as this fog has cleared up, I'll send out my little darlings to attack!
...How reliable. Well then, all ships participating in this operation, standby! "Operation Tungsten" shall begin in one hour's time as planned!
Our prey is Tirpitz! What meaningless resistance will she be able to mount? Fleet-
What?! An attack from a new enemy? Report the damages, hurry!
Is the ocean... falling apart...?!
N-no, it's something else... The ocean itself is being sucked up into the sky!
Ahahaha~! What an interesting choice to create a singularity here!
Accursed Sirens, is this thy witchcraft?
Huh? How exactly am I supposed to create a singularity of this size?
We have an emergency situation. Adjusting strategic operations. Prepare all forces for combat!
Target the Siren! Fire at will!
Hey! Didn't your momma teach you about listening to what people have to say? ...Fine, have it your way. Let's have some fun!
Report to Headquarters: "30 minutes ago, Special Task Force One encountered the Siren and an unidentified superweapon... Our formation was broken."
"Though we have managed to regroup, our fleet has already sustained over 40% damage. There is significant risk in continuing 'Operation Tungsten.'"
"Requesting additional mission directives..."
Bastards... the communications are jammed!
I can't connect either... The situation is the same as in the Mirror Sea... We'll need to make do on our own...
Fortunately, thanks to my armour, my little darlings went mostly unscathed.
As expected of the Royal Navy's armoured carriers. Does this mean that combat can continue?
It does. We've already gotten this far, so we should pay a visit to this "Lone Queen in the North."
I've even prepared something special, just for her.
That's odd... Little Ms. Sunshine created such a massive singularity here, yet she's nowhere to be seen...
Shame, I've always wanted to meet a Prototype, at least once~
Oh well. I'd better send a message to the Observer~!
Attention, members of Special Task Force One. Though we may have suffered a setback and lost communication with headquarters...
The attack from the unidentified superweapon has parted the fog of war, the biggest uncertainty factor in our operation so far. Make use of this opportunity and attack!
From here, we shall continue "Operation Tungsten!"
Mobilise all usable carrier-based aircraft, and prepare to launch in 20 minutes time!
Why, hello! There you are, Tirpitz!
It's been long since anyone last came here. Especially someone as garish as you...
First I hear a strange explosion, now a Royal Navy carrier has appeared before me...
I am the armoured carrier Victorious, assigned to Special Task Force One. Greetings!
You might be delighted to know that you're rather famous even on the other side of the world!
And how long I've anticipated this mission! It's my chance to fight the Lone Queen in the North!
Have a look at this souvenir from the Eagle Union! It's a specially constructed 1,600 lb armour-piercing bomb!
..."Lone Queen in the North," huh... I like the sound of that.
I've lost count of how many battles I've had like this... But I will still fight with everything I have!
... Was that all...? It seems the only thing special about that bomb was its name.
You've nearly been bombed to pieces, yet you won't surrender?! You're going to sink if you let this continue!
So you want me to surrender, huh...
... Sorry, that's not happening. As a battleship, it's my wish to continue fighting till the very end.
Just how obstinate can you Iron Blood ships be?! Your sister said the same thing!
Bismarck...?! You've... met my sister...?
I have! We had almost the entire Royal Navy fighting your sister, me included. All I did was monitor her from a long distance with my planes, though...
Still, it's true, Bismarck said those very same words!
... I see... Thank you.
Huh? Thanks for what...?
She upheld her own beliefs, even till the very end, and sunk with the greatest service record ever seen.
Even in our world, her name will long remain in the memory of many people...
To us Iron Blood battleships, there's nothing more tragic than leaving your fate in the hands of others and being forgotten, having achieved nothing...
And I have you to thank for coming here and giving me one more chance to fire my cannons...
If I must trade my existence for one last honorable battle... then that's fine.
What are you saying?! This is no honourable way to go!
What are you, the Drama Queen in the North?! Or do you just want to look cool?! I'm offering you the chance to live, and you refuse...?!
You're making ME out to be the villain here...
... Fine. I give up. Task Force One, we're pulling out. Turn 180 degrees and advance at half speed.
... You're leaving? This is your chance to earn glory, your chance to make glorious history...
Of course honour and glory are appealing... But I can't stand to earn them this way...
W-what I mean is... my planes are out of fuel, that's all! ...My word, how lucky for you! Hmph!
Message to flagship Duke of York...
"The 'Queen in the North' has been seriously damaged, but could not be sunk. Operation Tungsten has ended in failure..."
... What an unpredictable lady...
... I doubt we will ever meet again...
I wonder how far your compassion will get you... I hope to one day find out...
Members of Special Task Force One, we have inflicted devastating damage upon Tirpitz. Our combat objectives have nearly been accomplished.
Due to the intervention of the Sirens, "Operation Tungsten" will conclude prematurely out of safety considerations. All members, prepare to return!
However, for her to not sink despite all that... is her armour impenetrable?
Thou need not be so depressed. We miscalculated the strength of the enemy, but there will still be other opportunities in the future.
Alert! We've shot down enemy fighters! We're detecting something at 3 o'clock!
3 o'clock...! That must be the "singularity" that the Sirens mentioned?
Yes! I haven't confirmed the enemy's position yet, but I've ordered my recon planes to investigate...
Allowing the Sirens to run rampant in our waters is a disgrace to the Queen's name.
Attention, all members of Special Task Force One! There has been a change in plans. Investigate these unknown waters and prepare for a Siren attack!
By the way, Victorious...
Yes?
The shape of that "singularity..."
Does it not resemble the shape of a Queen's crown?
Aha, I knew from the very beginning that this is where you'd be~!
You've caused a lot of trouble for us, you know~ What are even you hoping to achieve, Ms. Prototype? ...Or should I say "Code G"?
... This has nothing to do with you.
Now now, don't go anywhere! I just did the calculations, and if this massive singularity were to collapse, half of the entire Northern Parliament would go poof!
And should that happen, it'd REALLY throw a wrench into our plans for this time period! So... could you be nice and just stop?
...  (The mysterious character silently turned her head the other way.)
If you insist on continuing anyway... then I will use all the tools I have available to me as a subprogram to stop you!
Target confirmed! All hands, continue to fire!
Ahahaha! I knew you'd come here!
Barracuda Unit, spread your wings! Target that powerful Siren...
Wait, what's this other identification signal? She hasn't even appeared on the radar yet!
Corsair Unit, change target! Go for the unidentified enemy unit!
She... shot down all my Corsairs?!
With her own Corsairs, at that?! ...Who are you?!
... So it's you, Victorious...
Um... have we met before? More importantly: are you friend or foe?
Seems there was an error in our calculations...
Purifier, go tell your damned computer terminal to never drag uninvolved people into your experiments again.
Wow, that was easy~ I should've just called on these guys to stop you instead of trying it myself!
... Victorious...
Y-yes?
I'm glad I got to see you again.
You might not believe it, but... in the future... you were an outstanding warrior.
Uhh... thanks?
Wait... Hold on! Are you just going to run away after telling me that random nonsense?!
Ahaha~ Calm down, lady. There's no point chasing after her anyway. And in case you forgot: I'm your opponent here!
Still, I have you guys to thank for fixing that little problem for me~
To reward you, I'll beam you full of energy with my little toy here!
Those are... lasers?! Everyone, watch out!
Hahahahaha~! It's been ages since I've had this much fun! The sky really is the limit for the potential of your Wisdom Cubes!
Listen here! We, the Sirens, are your enemy! We are the big bad meanies who take your oceans as our own! We are the ones who cause all the wars in the world! And don't you forget it!
Next time we meet, I'll have an even more powerful weapon for you guys! Until then, stay alive and get stronger for me! Hahahaha~!
By the glory of the Royal Family, spill thy blood before us! Return to the icy abyss that you crawled from!
Phew... We did it... Our connection to HQ has been restored, so the ocean should soon return to normal, too...
Good grief, I never expected such a situation to develop...
But luckily, we managed to seize an unexpected victory as well as gather valuable intelligence on the Sirens.
O valiant one, thy performance was pivotal to our outcome today. Victorious, it was an honour to fight at thy side.
Why, thank you!
There's another communication from headquarters. They suggested to leave Tirpitz to the base's air squadron.
That settles it then. We can go home now!
So the Queen in the North has been deprived of her crown... But I suppose that's what she wanted...
... Oh, dear me, I'm getting distracted again...
So you had Victorious' planes shot down to lure her in... Well planned.
It was my only choice for dealing with Code G. Fortunately, it didn't cause a major discrepancy in the end.
And our only loss was a single Purifier model. Wouldn't you agree this was the best possible outcome?
I suppose... So, have you gotten used to your new body yet, Purifier?
Pheeew! I had the time of my life! I even gained tons of combat experience!
Those Royal Navy girls should experience their awakening soon, so the North Sea should be good for a while.
Anyway, c'mon, send me out on my next mission already~
Ah, yes, your next mission...
How would you like to see cherry trees in full bloom?
Enemy Mass-Produced fleets are running rampant everywhere in the ocean!
With their leader out of the picture, they no longer pose a threat, and your fleet can automatically destroy them when in a tile adjacent to them!
Additionally, you can acquire Cleanup Points by destroying these fleets! You will then be rewarded with an amount of Queen's Medals based on how many Cleanup Points you get!
However, you don't have much time, so your fleet can only make 3 moves in total...
So get close to the biggest groups of enemies you can and make the most of your moves!

sequence:
Convergence of Hearts

<size=45>1 Starting Point of Trust</size>

scripts.say: It's been a little while since TB arrived in this virtual town in her current... size.
(She's awfully quiet and always carries that plushie around.)
Hey, TB, what is your plushie supposed to be?
What's a... "plushie"?
Sounds like she doesn't know the concept of a plushie yet. Time to rephrase.
What's that in your hands?
It's... my old friend. Hugging it makes me sleepy.
Not the kind of answer I was anticipating!
(Talking with a young child isn't exactly easy.)
It's a lot... like you.
Is it? Does it look like me?
No... but you both make me feel safe.
She takes her plushie's ear and puts it in my hand.
Safe... and relaxed.
She starts to yawn, as though affected by some strange energy.
*yawn*...
(Oh, okay. It's for making her feel at ease.)
(If I'm "a lot like it," that means she trusts me. That's great to hear.)

sequence:
Convergence of Hearts

<size=45>2 The Power of Wishing</size>

scripts.say: Hm-hmm-hm-hmm♪
TB?
Oh... You heard me.
TB's language and reasoning skills have slowly improved, in no small part thanks to her interaction with the outside world.
She has reached the point of relative fluency by now.
Were you... looking for me? Do you need something?
Just wanted to ask you something. Has any of the stuff we've done been difficult for you?
What does "difficult" mean?
It means "hard to do." Basically, is there anything you don't want to do if you don't have to?
No...
Alright. I heard you practicing your singing a moment ago. Was that hard for you?
Nuh-uh.
I also do more things...
You practice other things, too?
Mhm.
But those aren't hard.
Practicing is... full feeling.
It makes me and you full feeling.
I think she's trying to say "fulfilling."
TB was cut off from her database prior to her entry into this virtual town, but it seems she carried something with her...
Her wish to develop a personality. It's still somewhere inside her.
Take it slow and easy now, okay?
Mhm.
I will... as long as you're here.

sequence:
Convergence of Hearts

<size=45>3 Your Story</size>

scripts.say: Tell me a story.
TB has started developing an interest in the stories in picture books.
I read a story to her once a day, but only when it's time for bed.
But it's not even close to bedtime yet.
Pleeease...
(Fine. It's not every day she asks for something with a "please.")
I come back with a handful of books I've read to her lately. She doesn't seem very interested, though.
Not like these...
You already told these stories.
Do you want to hear a new one, then?
Yeah! Tell me a new story!
(Oh, boy. What type of story should I tell her? That's the question...)
Do you want to hear a story about a battle?
(She flat-out said no!)
(Okay, need to choose a different story.)
(That should work. I'll make up a story based on her.)
But where to start...
(I've got it. The story will be about TB's pursuit of a personality.)
As the story went on, TB slowly but surely slipped off into slumberland.
I'm like... a navigator...
And brave...
She mutters something in her half-asleep state.
Yes you are, TB. You're so brave.
*yawn*... Zzz...

sequence:
Convergence of Hearts

<size=45>4 The Value of Feelings</size>

scripts.say: What's the matter, TB?
She looks under the weather.
...I did a thing I wanted to do, but it went wrong.
Is this what it means to be "unsuccessful"?
Yup. It didn't go like you hoped it would, did it?
No.
That means you've grown, and that's something to celebrate. Let's get something good to eat for dinner tonight!
But why?
Why celebrate something that went badly?
Because you've learned to express your feelings at last.
Anger, sadness – those are feelings too, you know.
Don't they often say that you're behind the other students at school?
...Yeah. My teacher says I've never shown any emotion.
And you just did. You felt sad about something. I know it sounds weird, but that is something to celebrate.
I think you're making excuses and just want yummy food.
I'm really not. I'm just stating facts.
Gaining emotions and expressing them. TB has taken the first step on her journey to finding her personality.
Come on. Don't you want to go out and get something tasty?
...I do.

scripts.say: I've drawn up a list of activities for TB based on her wishes.
Truth be told, I'm not sure which of these you'll like...
Actually, I like everything on the list.
Without any sound or warning, TB appears before my eyes.
Oh. Can you tell me why you like them?
Why? Because I feel they're right.
Liking something and thinking something is right are very different things...
There are things that people like doing even if they know it's wrong. Like eating candy before dinner, for example.
...That's so complicated.
I want you to do something for me. Can you clear your head and not think of anything?
What then?
Then think of the most fun thing you know.
Hearing you tell me stories.
Got it. You like stories, then.
No, it's not the stories themselves.
When you read to me before bedtime, that's what I like.
It makes me feel warm... and safe.
(That hasn't changed since she was little.)
I'll read you a story before bed tonight if you want!
Sure.
If you wanna do it every night... that's fine, too.

Convergence of Hearts

<size=45>6 Each Other's Wishes I</size>

scripts.say: ...You're very selfless, aren't you?
She throws me a surprising question out of the blue.
Come again?
Even when you're neck-deep in work, you still come with me to do the things I like.
All the time. You don't need to go out of your way for me like that.
She looks a bit peevish. It's best to go with a safe answer here.
Hey, I'm just doing my duty as your guardian.
Then at least let me fulfill YOUR wish every now and then.
Oh. So that's why you're upset.
I'm not upset, really. I just said what came to mind.
If there's nothing you want to do, that's fine. Pretend I never mentioned it.
She heads for the door, her head hanging a little low.
Hold up. There is one thing, actually...
What?
I haven't told you a good bedtime story ever since you grew out of them, have I?
You used to love them so much, you'd beg me to tell you more.
Did not. I would never beg for that.
But, I'm assuming that's what you want – to tell me one last bedtime story.
Yup.
I guess that's fine.
I'm... curious what story it's going to be. Just a little.
I will criticize your story if it's bad, though. Ruthlessly so.

scripts.say: Uh, there's something I'd like to talk about...
Hm?
Oh, it's nothing serious or anything. I was just wondering if you had an unfulfilled wish,{playername}.
You've been granting mine for as long as I can remember...
So I'd like to return the favor for once!
She looks very serious about this, and almost afraid of me saying no to her.
Hey, I'm just doing my duty as your guardian.
No need to fuss over "returning favors."
I won't take that for an answer! Tell me your wish, or else I'll...
Uh... I'll run away from home!
She pauses for a moment to think before making a threat, in an extremely uncharacteristic manner.
Did... Did I mishear, or did you say, "Run away from home"?
You heard me correctly! If you don't tell me, I will run away from home right now!
Okay, okay. Let me think...
Don't be modest! I'll do anything to make your wish come true, no matter what it is!
I haven't told you a good bedtime story ever since you grew out of them, have I?
You used to love them so much, you'd beg me to tell you more.
Huh? What's this about all of a sudden?
I'm saying that's my wish. I want to tell you another bedtime story.
That's it? Heehee. Very well.
Then I look forward to hearing it.
By the way... This is my wish, too.
