Obviously not, sis. I've not seen a single soul in my time here, never mind the Queen herself.
Well, I'm afraid there you have your answer, Lady Vanguard.
(These girls are remarkably agreeable... In stark contrast to what the Commander's and the Iron Blood's intel asserted.)
If you don't mind, could you elaborate on the part about having not seen anyone at all?
We are not withholding any information from you. You are literally the only other people we've seen since our arrival here.
We've not seen this Queen Elizabeth you speak of, or anyone else for that matter.
Though we come from a different Royal Navy, we still welcome you with open arms as our guests of honour.
If you'll pardon my sudden invitation, would you care to sit down and continue this conversation over dinner?
(Vanguard, do we oblige?)
(Let's hear what they have to tell us. We can't write off the possibility Her Majesty is somewhere in this place just yet.)
Castle - Dining Room
Fish, fruit, and bread... You've got a feast going here, even if it's on the simple side.
Thank you. I'm afraid our cooking is restricted by what we can find in the wild here.
Further restricted by the fact my sis is hardly a master chef. Anyway, have some tea.
*gulp*... *cough cough*! Good lord, what did you put in this?!
Is it not to your taste? I apologise, but there are no tea plants in this place, so we have to make do with herbs.
Psst! Jervis! Did you bring tea bags?
Pardon my tone, but I am not a corner shop on legs – my job is rescuing and nursing people.
Having said that, I did bring daily essentials, including tea bags.
You're a lifesaver! Cheers!
You said earlier that you were "confined" to this Mirror Sea. Did you end up here through a Singularity?
Yes, we came here from a different branch... what must've been a lifetime ago.
Not of our own volition, mind you. We were forcibly displaced. Separated from the battlefield, our sense of time gradually faded as well.
We couldn't find a way out, so all we could do was settle down in the only habitable area we could locate and await rescue.
Are you familiar with Antiochus? They were the ones who sent us here.
I've heard another META use that term before. You're talking about the Sirens, right?
Yes. If you're aware of all that, then I should state now that we are members of the Ashes.
You are?! So you know Ark Royal, Enterprise, and Hiryuu?
Enterprise?! Is she alive?! ...Ah, pardon – yes, I know her and Hiryuu.
I do not know an Ark Royal in our ranks, however. She must be someone Enterprise recruited from a different branch after... the incident.
The incident that separated us from our comrades...
It happened while we were searching for Observer Zero alongside many others from the Ashes...
There... I'm in. Enterprise, I'm picking up a signal from what I believe is Zero! She must be here!
...All that's left is to pull the plug on the mainframe.
It won't be that easy. We've got several Arbiter vessels heading toward us.
They'll be here in... 30 seconds!
Maintain formation! All ships, draw your weapons!
We know about your little ambush attempt. The jig is up.
Even had it succeeded, the outcome of this battle would still be the same.
Changing directives. Forget neutralizing their flagship – exterminate them all.
I can't believe this was one of Antiochus' bloody experiments! Enterprise, Takao, we'll take care of the vessels!
Go after Zero! Hurry, Helena's hacking can't slow them down forever!
More vessels approaching! Fusou, they're after you!
Understood. I shall see to their departures...
Presumptuous insects. Your combined power amounts to nothing before us.
The Empress is here too, huh... That's how we know we're in the right place!
Yes, and your overconfidence has led you to your doom. It seems you haven't learned from the past.
I'll let you in on a secret. The Devil and Hierophant have taken control of your warp devices.
The others are converging upon you as we speak. You fought so hard, only to be herded up like lambs to the slaughter. I pity you fools.
I count nine Arbiters vessels... It'll be tough, but we can do it. Zero's brought the whole party to defend her mainframe.
It's funny you should say her name. That number is why I pity you.
...What?
Zero was never in this location to begin with. The only zero here is your probability of victory.
Our plan was to launch a surprise attack on the heart of their base, but we ended up unwittingly walking into their trap.
They seized control of our warp devices and sent us all to different branches. For better or worse, my sister and I both wound up here in the same place.
At first we tried to destroy this Mirror Sea. When that failed, we went searching for a way out.
But it was hopeless. Every time we destroyed something, Antiochus' systems undid the damage. We came to the realisation our efforts were meaningless.
Our strength vaned as time went on, as did our will to fight until we could no longer see any point in continuing our war.
That brings us to where we are now. I don't know what Antiochus is planning, all I know is we're not a part of it, as they've apparently forgotten about us.
Which is what led you to take up residence in this castle?
Yes, since we had no hope of ever escaping on our own. It seemed we would never again subdue foes with our keen swords.
If our fighting days were behind us, the least we could do for our lost comrades is live here and know peace and happiness.
That is our story. Now, Lady Vanguard, may I ask how your search for Her Majesty brought you here?
Simply put, it's possible Her Majesty is in this Mirror Sea, looking for a way to save a gravely ill friend.
A gravely ill friend? Are you able to share more?
It's Hood, from our timeline. She was damaged by someone wielding a Black Cube, and the lingering damage to her hull has left her bedridden.
A Black Cube? Oh dear, that's terrible to hear...
But what does it have to do with Her Majesty? What led her to come here?
The Royal Navy doesn't have its own Black Cube. Her Majesty reasoned we may be able to find information leading us to a cure by exploring Siren territory.
So you've put your own lives on the line for another... I'm terribly sorry for my nonchalance earlier.
Nonchalance? Your hospitality can hardly be considered that–
You are knights who've pledged loyalty to Her Majesty, and I unceremoniously informed you of the cruel reality that there is no way out of this place.
You are stuck here, unable to fulfill your oaths, much like my sister and I. You have my condolences.
You don't need to worry about us, actually. We have a teleporter that can take us out of here. It's the key to bringing home Her Majesty and fulfilling our oaths.
If anything, allow me to apologise if I just rubbed salt in old wounds.
Not at all, those wounds have closed long since. It delights me to hear you still have a cause to fight for.
To elaborate on the Black Cube issue, I believe it may be connected to METAmorphosis.
The powers we gained from METAmorphosis seem to have waned during the course of our imprisonment here. Perhaps that can provide some insight into how to cure Lady Hood.
Oh! That's a promising lead! Thank you kindly!
I hope your hunch proves right, because it could save her life. We'll make it a goal to collect as many samples as we can.
I hope so too. May your endeavour be successful, knights of Her Majesty.
Renown... If I may be a little sentimental...
To be frank, I think I envy you and Repulse.
I'm a palace guard. Only a scant few times have I fought before. I've spent most of my life by Her Majesty's side, far away from battle.
As a knight, I could ask for nothing more. But as a soldier, the desire to seize glory on the battlefield tempts me.
Meanwhile, you two have fought courageously your entire lives, whether or not history would remember your names.
And now, by helping us, you've reminded me of something important. True glory is not something you're awarded – it is something you earn.
...Sorry for the random speech. I just felt moved by your selflessness.
If you don't mind, I'd like to retake my pledge of loyalty.
...What?
Even when all is lost, my valour to be remembered by none–
I shall not yield, I shall not surrender, I shall not run–
Need I give my life for the good of all, it shall be done–
Huh?! Have you taken the Royal Knights' pledge as well?
Yes, we have. I still remember it.
Marvellous! Then you're free to continue it with me!
Our undying glory shall I remember, now and forever–
Act without grace and honour in heart, shall I never–
When my cannons roar, it shall be for my country–
When I draw my sword, it shall point at my enemy–
I am a Royal Knight, I protect our seas from threats–
I am a Royal Knight, I embody the sun that never sets–
May this pledge guide my blade, may these words light my way–
Glory to the Royal Navy! God save the Queen!
Location unknown - Teleportation device
This is where we part ways. Thank you for everything, Renown, Repulse.
It's just a shame we found nothing that may lead you to Her Majesty... Have you gathered enough samples?
I'd say so. This gate will stay open for a while longer, so we'll meet again before long.
Safe travels! ...Wait, did she just say the gate will stay open?
Now just to find Her Majesty! Ladies, feed the other set of coordinates into the terminal!
Location unknown - Teleportation device
Smoke, destruction, the putrid smells of war... Seems the coordinates led me to the right place.
I detest being witness to Siren records, but I'll want to be thorough. First order of– Huh?!
"Drake is out on a mission, I see. Are neither of you bothered by the fact she gets to do that, while we must attend this ceremony?"
"Oh dear. Monarch has entered whinge mode again."
What the... Neptune and Cheshire? They can't be out here...
"Me, I've got nothing to complain about as long as I've got food, sleep, and playtime with my Owner! You need to ease up a little."
"We are blueprint ships of the Royal Navy. While only one of us may be excellence itself, all of us should crave glory."
"I understand how you feel. Yes, we hardly ever get to sortie, and it's odd Her Majesty sent us here to train while an operation was ongoing. I won't deny that."
"However, orders are orders. We'll have plenty of opportunities to shine – to imprint ourselves on the Commander's memory – in the future."
"When my Owner needs us, we'll jump onto the stage and show the world what we're made of! I can see it now... Yes, Owner, headpat me more, please~"
"*sigh*... You two are lost causes."
Hmph. So it's just a memory from before the ceremony. Damned Sirens, spying on us.
It's going to take much more than that to dissuade me from carrying out my mission!
There must be a Black Cube – or the means to a cure for Hood – somewhere in this Mirror Sea. I need only find it and bring it back to Camelot.
Forgive me, Your Majesty, but no one but me may have the glory of this accomplishment!
Hmm? Are you all alone out here?
From the veil of black smoke suddenly emerged a white-haired girl clad in some type of naval uniform, facing Monarch.
(Did I imagine it, or did her appearance change for just a flash?!)
Figures my disguise doesn't work on you. You've got a sharp eye.
Who are you? An elite Siren?
Hey now, you're on my turf, so at least tell me your own name first. It's only polite, right?
I am the Royal Navy blueprint ship Monarch. Now state your name.
Sure. I'm Bon Homme Richard, and this is my home for now. What are you doing here?
(She doesn't appear to be a Siren, but she may be a Pawn. I'll want to keep my distance, just to–)
Be safe? No need to, I'm not a threat. We're both KAN-SEN, you and I!
(She read my mind?! Whoever this girl is, she is no ordinary shipgirl. Perhaps she's META?)
There's no use beating around the bush, then. I'm searching for a black Wisdom Cube, or rather, the remedy to the effects of one.
Oh! Guess what, you're in luck! You're talking to the world expert on METAmorphosis right now!
METAmorphosis is a restructuring of the hull, whether or not induced by a Black Cube. It's a one-way trip with no turning back.
I could explain all day, but as they say – show, don't tell. So let me show you what it feels like.
The girl broke out into a sinister grin that only grew wider as she spoke more.
You're right. Actions speak more than words, and hands-on experience teaches best.
But I'll pass on your twisted offer. I've no interest in falling victim to METAmorphosis! Now get out of my way!
Hahaha! No, I get it. It's not like YOU could experience it just by wishing for it.
Your hull is very special, for better or worse. You need a little help to jumpstart the process.
See, you have hardly any essence compared to ordinary shipgirls. Which basically means, you're a tool to be used.
You have some nerve. I'm not a tool, and I'm not being used.
Yes you are, and we both know it. Let's be real here.
You know what your special status as a blueprint ship entails. You are an outcast, a defective monster kept on a tight leash for when your firepower is needed... Only to be discarded afterwards.
Lies! I'm here right now entirely of my own volition!
Because you're a tool! You chase "glory," but what IS glory? Medals? Money? Oh, I know – it's in pursuit of the accomplishments your hull lacks in comparison to your peers!
But don't you worry, lady. I shall give all that you ever want, and more.
Succumb. All you need to reshape reality is enough power. Come, and I shall give you just that!
The more the girl spoke, the more of her unassuming demeanor peeled off to reveal the insanity beneath. The sea around her churned, birthing a vortex that grew increasingly violent.
Richard's lunacy invoked an instinctual fear in Monarch. She knew she had to get out of here – now.
Don't leave already. Stay here and have fun with me.
Urgh? What?! Her voice is...?!
GET OUT OF MY HEAD!
KABOOOM!
Monarch's voice boomed, and so too did her main cannons. She scored a crippling direct hit on Richard... or so she thought.
Nice shot there, lady. Just imagine what a devastating weapon you could be if you became META...
Hahaha... Ahahahah! AHAHAHAHAHA! Light me up! Reduce me to a pile of ash!
Release all your pent-up loneliness, bitterness, stress, and anger! Take it all out on me! Don't think, just SHOOT ME!
KABOOOM!
A moment's hesitation held back Monarch's trigger finger before she discharged the next shot, this time hitting the water to the left of Richard.
That one missed. You're holding yourself back, lady. Or maybe you just don't know where to shoot a person?
Shut your gob!
It's no big deal. I'll teach you the ABC of it.
This is the head, this is the heart. If you want someone dead, those are where you start. Easy to remember, right?
KABOOOM!
There you go! Now we're cooking!
Still, I can sense you're clinging on to a shred of sanity... Fine, have it your way! Let's throw some friends into the mix!
KABOOOM!
What you just shot dead was only a phantom. The real me's on the right. Go on, try to guess which one.
KABOOOM!
Nope~♪ Not that one, lady.
Monarch unleashed a volley so fierce it all but burned away the rifling of her barrels. A blink of the eye later, Richard had vanished.
So that's your true form, is it? This black tornado?
This black what? You're not making any sense.
The black tornado shot out a column of pure energy aimed straight at Monarch. But, the instant before it could hit, the sea was lit up by a white flash.
The raging winds slowed, and when the light dimmed, Bon Homme Richard's clones had been swept away.
More visitors? Boy, today's a busy day.
Keep your evil hands off Monarch!
Y-Your Majesty?!
In the flesh! Expect an earful after this for using Camelot without my permission!
Heh. I thought you were alone – turns out, you led your friends right to me!
Thanks a bunch, lady! Now let's treat you all to the main event!
Just as the last word left Richard's mouth, the auburn skies dimmed into darkness, the black tornado bellowing with fury once more.
Your Majesty, the energy output at Camelot is rapidly fluctuating! We are losing the teleporter's connection to it!
This maniac can reach Camelot with her powers?! It's no wonder those terminal coordinates showed up out of nowhere!
What shall we do, Your Majesty? Fighting a storm is a radical idea to say the least!
Wait, so have we lost our way back to Camelot?
Sheffield is grappling with the terminal controls. It will take some time, but we should be able to return to our point of origin.
Time is something we don't have! The tornado will wipe us all out if we don't leave RIGHT NOW!
(Of all the things that could've happened! Everyone including Her Majesty will perish if someone doesn't do something...!)
Your Majesty, you must fall back at once! I shall hold her attention!
You will not die on my watch! Why do you think I'm out here, risking my own life?!
Emergency measures! Create a gate that leads to any random set of coordinates within Camelot!
That's too dangerous, Your Majesty! We don't know where it may take us!
Can't be any bloody worse than here! Radio Sheffield and tell her to run an emergency powerup of Camelot!
And erase the coordinates on this terminal so that psychopath can't come after us!
Understood!
...Roger that!
Just in the nick of time, the girls managed to escape the Mirror Sea before a tsunami created by the tornado could engulf them.
Oh, big brother! And Navi, too.
Hey, look at that, dweeb. This girl's just standing there with her stuffed animal, doing nothing. What's up with that?
Is something on your mind, Unicorn?
What are you doing out here, anyway? Is there something you wanted to do?
Unicorn nods a little, then shakes her head.
I wanted to help you two out...
Everyone else is working really hard, and I want to be useful, too!
But when I got here, I had no idea what to do, so I've just been standing here and thinking...

options.content: (Tell her the thought is good enough.)
(Tell her you're glad that she's here.)

scripts.say: (Tell her the thought is good enough.)
(Tell her you're glad that she's here.)
Um... Hearing you say that makes me happy.
Yuni says he's happy, too.
Unicorn smiles brightly.
Huh. So you don't have to try so hard for this dweeb to approve of you.
N-not that I care about anyone's approval!
I was just thinking that maybe, at times, it wouldn't be so bad to have someone pay a little extra attention to me...
Umm... Big brother, thank you for encouraging me.
I should probably go now. I'll think some more about what I can do to help!
Take care.
I give Unicorn a gentle pat on the head, then leave with Navi.
Oh, looks like the Commander and Navi have spotted me!
Let me make this clear – as a good girl, I came here to help. I'm not slacking on the job. Understood?
I simply felt like having some afternoon tea and enjoying the mood in this place.
Heehee. Since you're already here, why don't you have a taste? This cake is only available for a limited time, for your information.
I should say it comes at a rather hefty "price," however.
Alas, that's the consequence of being as naughty as you are, Commander.
You really like teasing {tb}, huh...
Okay, so what is the "price" in question?
Hmm. Yes, what is the price, indeed...
I know – why not sit with me here for a while longer? Or perhaps you could entertain a request of mine?
Depends on the request.
Don't worry, I'm a good girl. I wouldn't ask anything totally outrageous of you... Probably. Heehee ♪
Wow, she really pushes the envelope when talking with {tb}...
After thinking about it for a while, I decide to reject her offer.
I'm not in a dessert mood today.
A pity. I really wanted you to taste it.
In that case, maybe I should offer you something else next time, hmm?
In exchange, you must grant me any request I make of you ♪
And why would I agree to that?
Because I'm a good girl? Indulging a good girl's request is the most natural thing on the planet.
Wait...? You can just force requests on {tb} like this?
I sure can!
Well, now I've finished my work for today ♪
I'm sure you picked up many practical things and had your share of amusement, Navi.
Now, however, I must take my leave. Should we cross paths again, Commander, kindly don't forget my compensation.
I see Jade off, and Navi still seems to be deep in thought about something.
What's up, Navi?
Ahh? It's nothing.
I was just... impressed with Jade's way of doing things.
Hah! You've found the graffiti master at work.
What are you drawing?
I'm making art to revitalize this dull-ass town!
Whaddya think? This is some real art of rebellion!
That sure is a... unique drawing.
Why'd ya hesitate? "Unique" is all you've got? You think I'm dumb, huh?!

options.content: (Lecture her on leaving graffiti all over the place.)

scripts.say: Hey now, you can't just spray-paint wherever you want.
Hmph! It's 'cause of all that stick-in-the-mud thinking that everything's so lame around here!
Art is about breaking the rules! And I'm gonna break 'em by styling up every wall in this whole town!
Look, {tb}, these colors indeed complement each other well.
Come on! This is real ART, like I said!
Besides, s-seeing this art ought to, like, lift the Commander's spirits!
Svirepy's tone suddenly changes from confrontational to stuttering.
This looks amazing, Svirepy! The composition is so unique and eye-catching!
Of course it is! That's my signature style!
If ya want some pointers, I can give ya a few. N-not that I'm eager to teach someone or nothin'!
What do you think, {tb}? It sounds quite interesting. Svirepy seems keen on the idea, too.
You... Hey!
I crack a stiff smile and pat them both on the head.
Alright, let's dive into the world of art today.
Sweet!
After that, we spent some time with Svirepy, allowing our creativity to run wild.
On our way home, Navi seemed to have gained some inspiration.
Ah, Commander and Navi, excellent timing. I'm in the middle of creating a new dessert.
Would you like to be the first to try it? It's made with a special recipe that can soothe your soul.
Faced with the spine-chillingly red dessert, I find myself hesitating.
{tb}... I dunno about this...
Heehee. What's the matter?
I sincerely want to make you feel better, that's all...
And... I'm quite curious to see your reaction when you taste it. Nothing wrong with that, right?
Well, it'd be a shame for it to go waste, so I'll try it.
Great! Please be sure to chew it well and savor every last bite.
Roon stares at me with bated breath, while Navi looks on with concern. Between the two of them, I put some of the questionably colored dessert in my mouth.
Ahh... Watching you enjoy my dessert one bite at a time – it's so wonderful ♪
Sorry, but it'll have to be another time. I still have some errands to run right now.
Y-yeah, exactly! We've got things to get back to.
That's unfortunate. I'd hoped to see how you reacted...
It's alright, though. I'll prepare many more soothing surprises for the next time.
Heehee. Navi, you care quite a lot about the Commander, don't you?
That's only "normal," of course...
However, I must ask you to refrain from ruining our next... soothing time together.
Or, my subsequent soothing recipe might be made just for you ♪
While Roon's expression remains as gentle as always, the mood around her suddenly feels a bit tense.
I'll see you another time, Commander. I'll have lots of delicious desserts ready for you by then.
Uhh... I'll come with {tb} next time!
Of course. Heehee. You're always welcome.
I bid farewell to Roon and leave with Navi.
On our way home, Navi seemed to think deeply and gained some inspiration.
Seeing Navi and I approaching, Hai Tien quickly puts away her pen and paper.
Hmm? Writing something you don't want us to see, huh?
Ahem... The scenery here inspired me to start writing the opening of my next piece.
"Lonesome she stands, the petals around her swirl; two swallows take wing, into a softly raining world." Faced with such a beautiful sight, I can scarcely rest my pen-hand.
Tsk... I hate when people get all poetic. It'd be faster just to show me what you wrote!
It's not finished yet! I mean... This plainly penned idea of mine still needs to be refined.
You won't miss your chance to read it once it's properly finished.
For me, writing is something to be approached with pride, you see.

options.content: (Explain that it takes time to write.)

scripts.say: She's right, Navi. You have to consider every word carefully, and it takes time to polish your writing.
Precisely. To paraphrase a saying: "If you wish to see further, you must first climb higher."
Becoming a good writer is much like ascending a great mountain – it happens one step at a time.
Hmph! Quit sounding like you know everything! If you're so smart, let's see what you've got!
Well said. To become a good writer, you should not only read widely but also experience the world's magnificence first-hand.
Indeed. As they say: "A book can teach you many things, but you will grasp none of them without practice."
The scenery around us, the events of life – they are the material that fuels writing.
It is for this very reason that I always carry a notebook with me.
Hmph. At the end of the day, you're just scribbling things down. What's so fun about that?
It's so much more than that. You must have moments you want to write about, too, don't you?
N-no, not really. I have little thoughts sometimes, but that's different.
Ah, I just remembered there's a lovely café not far from here.
"Fragrant tea in the afternoon light, sipped with tender delight." Well, it's coffee in this case, but what say you we continue our chat there?
Good idea. Let's go.
The three of us then went to the café and enjoyed a relaxing time together.
Teacher... and Navi... You're here!
Now aware of our arrival, Anchorage gets up and excitedly hops over to us.
Teacher, look! I learned... a new origami fold!
Hmph. I can't believe this dweeb is into kiddy stuff like playing with paper.
No... Not playing! Anchorage worked hard on it... It took effort...
These are gifts! For... you... and Teacher!
I'm going to give them... to you!
But... Not done yet. I haven't finished all of them...
Anchorage looks despondent.

options.content: (Suggest folding the rest together with her.)

scripts.say: How about we finish the rest of them together?
No... I'll do my best! On my own!
Come on, let's do it together. It'll be more fun, and you've already shown how nice you are.
Are you... sure?
Okay, Teacher... Together!
Seriously? Ugh, fine. Just for a little while then!
Okay! Navi, you help! Anchorage can teach you how!
The three of us sit down, and Anchorage starts showing Navi how to fold the paper.
First you do this... Then this... And then this...
Wooow! Navi, you're amazing!
Hmph. This is way too easy. I knew what to do after just one look!
Despite her bragging, the compliment clearly got to her – there's the faintest hint of a smile on her face.
You'll give them to us? Aww, you're so nice.
Heehee... Teacher... nice to me!
So Anchorage... wants to make you both happy!
I'll be fast... Wait just a minute, Teacher!
Of course.
Anchorage sits back down and starts folding paper again.
Sometime later, she hands both me and Navi a paper creation.
Done! For you, Teacher... A boat!
And for Navi, a star!
Hmm. I have to admit it's pretty well made...
Anchorage worked super-duper hard on it! Heehee!
Th-thanks...
And so, the three of us spent a heartwarming afternoon together.
Oh, looks like the Commander and Navi have spotted me!
Let me make this clear – as a good girl, I came here to help. I'm not slacking on the job. Understood?
I simply felt like having some afternoon tea and enjoying the mood in this place.
You have a lot of run-ins with devious types like this one, don't you, dweeb?
Gotta say, though, I like her tone. I might just copy it.
Heehee. Since you're already here, why don't you have a taste? This cake is only available for a limited time, for your information.
I should say it comes at a rather hefty "price," however.
Alas, that's the consequence of being as naughty as you are, Commander.
Reeling them in with a dessert, then demanding a favor... Devilish.
Okay, so what is the "price" in question?
Hmm. Yes, what is the price, indeed...
I know – why not sit with me here for a while longer? Or perhaps you could entertain a request of mine?
Depends on the request.
Don't worry, I'm a good girl. I wouldn't ask anything totally outrageous of you... Probably. Heehee ♪
Is this all it takes to get you on the hook, dweeb?
Seriously, though, don't take the bait. I'm saying this for your sake.
After thinking about it for a while, I decide to reject her offer.
I'm not in a dessert mood today.
A pity. I really wanted you to taste it.
In that case, maybe I should offer you something else next time, hmm?
In exchange, you must grant me any request I make of you ♪
And why would I agree to that?
Because I'm a good girl? Indulging a good girl's request is the most natural thing on the planet.
You can just brute-force your way through like that, huh? Neat.
Well, now I've finished my work for today ♪
I'm sure you picked up many practical things and had your share of amusement, Navi.
Hmm... So that's one way to get under this dweeb's skin...
Now, however, I must take my leave. Should we cross paths again, Commander, kindly don't forget my compensation.
Bargaining right as you leave... Heheh. I'll make a note of that.
After bidding farewell to Jade, Navi and I leave.
Hah! You've found the graffiti master at work.
What are you drawing?
I'm making art to revitalize this dull-ass town!
Whaddya think? This is some real art of rebellion!
That sure is a... unique drawing.
Why'd ya hesitate? "Unique" is all you've got? You think I'm dumb, huh?!

options.content: (Lecture her on leaving graffiti all over the place.)

scripts.say: Hey now, you can't just spray-paint wherever you want.
Hmph! It's 'cause of all that stick-in-the-mud thinking that everything's so lame around here!
Art is about breaking the rules! And I'm gonna break 'em by styling up every wall in this whole town!
Ooh, that's one way of messing with people... Thanks for the tip. {tb} I'd be on my guard from now on if I were you ♪
Hey, I'm not doing this to mess with people! This is ART, like I said!
Besides, s-seeing this art ought to, like, lift the Commander's spirits!
Svirepy's tone suddenly changes from confrontational to stuttering.
This looks amazing, Svirepy! The composition is so unique and eye-catching!
Of course it is! That's my signature style!
If ya want some pointers, I can give ya a few. N-not that I'm eager to teach someone or nothin'!
Come on, you're fooling nobody. Anyone can see you're craving approval. Am I right, {tb}?
Hey, shut up!
I crack a stiff smile and pat them both on the head.
Alright, let's dive into the world of art today.
Sweet!
After that, we spent some time with Svirepy, allowing our creativity to run wild.
On our way home, Navi seemed to have gained some inspiration.
Ah, Commander and Navi, excellent timing. I'm in the middle of creating a new dessert.
Would you like to be the first to try it? It's made with a special recipe that can soothe your soul.
Faced with the spine-chillingly red dessert, I find myself hesitating.
Hmph. Knowing you, dweeb, you'll fall for this no matter what.
"Fall for this"? That's not a very nice choice of words.
I sincerely want to make you feel better, that's all...
And... I'm quite curious to see your reaction when you taste it. Nothing wrong with that, right?
Well, it'd be a shame for it to go waste, so I'll try it.
Great! Please be sure to chew it well and savor every last bite.
Ahh... Watching you enjoy my dessert one bite at a time – it's so wonderful ♪
Wow, I didn't know it was fair game to treat you like a moron, dweeb!
Sorry, but it'll have to be another time. I still have some errands to run right now.
That's unfortunate. I'd hoped to see how you reacted...
It's alright, though. I'll prepare many more soothing surprises for the next time.
A rare moment of clarity from the dweeb! Color me surprised ♪
Heehee. Navi, you care quite a lot about the Commander, don't you?
However, I must ask you to refrain from ruining our next... soothing time together.
Otherwise, my subsequent soothing recipe might be made just for you ♪
While Roon's expression remains as gentle as always, the mood around her suddenly feels a bit tense.
Yikes... Dweeb, watch yourself, alright?
I'll see you another time, Commander. I'll have lots of delicious desserts ready for you by then.
Hmph, don't even think about shaking me off! I'll come along.
Of course. Heehee. You're always welcome.
I bid farewell to Roon and leave with Navi.
On our way home, Navi seemed to think deeply and gained some inspiration.
Hey, {tb}, look at that girl. She's just standing there with her stuffed animal. Do you think something's on her mind?
Let's talk to her and find out.
Sure!
Hearing us approaching, Unicorn lifts her head.
Oh, big brother! And Navi, too.
Is something on your mind, Unicorn?
What are you doing out here, anyway? Is there something you wanted to do?
Unicorn nods a little, then shakes her head.
I wanted to help you two out...
Everyone else is working really hard, and I want to be useful, too!
But when I got here, I had no idea what to do, so I've just been standing here and thinking...

options.content: (Tell her the thought is good enough.)
(Tell her you're glad that she's here.)

scripts.say: (Tell her the thought is good enough.)
(Tell her you're glad that she's here.)
Um... Hearing you say that makes me happy.
Yuni says he's happy, too.
Unicorn smiles brightly.
I get it... Just wanting to help is good enough.
Umm... Big brother, thank you for encouraging me.
I should probably go now. I'll think some more about what I can do to help!
Take care.
I give Unicorn a gentle pat on the head, then leave with Navi.
Seeing Navi and I approaching, Hai Tien quickly puts away her pen and paper.
Hmm? What are you writing?
Ahem... The scenery here inspired me to start writing the opening of my next piece.
"Lonesome she stands, the petals around her swirl; two swallows take wing, into a softly raining world." Faced with such a beautiful sight, I can scarcely rest my pen-hand.
Yeah, it is pretty beautiful... Can I see what you wrote?
It's not finished yet! I mean... This plainly penned idea of mine still needs to be refined.
You won't miss your chance to read it once it's properly finished.
For me, writing is something to be approached with pride, you see.

options.content: (Explain that it takes time to write.)

scripts.say: She's right, Navi. You have to consider every word carefully, and it takes time to polish your writing.
Precisely. To paraphrase a saying: "If you wish to see further, you must first climb higher."
Becoming a good writer is much like ascending a great mountain – it happens one step at a time.
I had no idea writing took so much effort... I can see why you'd focus on the wording of every single sentence.
Well said. To become a good writer, you should not only read widely but also experience the world's magnificence first-hand.
Indeed. As they say: "A book can teach you many things, but you will grasp none of them without practice."
The scenery around us, the events of life – they are the material that fuels writing.
It is for this very reason that I always carry a notebook with me.
I see. Basically, everyday things have the potential to become stories, right?
Exactly. You must have moments you want to write about, too, don't you?
Hmm... Yeah, I guess I do wanna write about the things {tb} and I see together.
Ah, I just remembered there's a lovely café not far from here.
"Fragrant tea in the afternoon light, sipped with tender delight." Well, it's coffee in this case, but what say you we continue our chat there?
Good idea. Let's go.
The three of us then went to the café and enjoyed a relaxing time together.
Teacher... and Navi... You're here!
Now aware of our arrival, Anchorage gets up and excitedly hops over to us.
Teacher, look! I learned... a new origami fold!
Oh, you're playing with paper?
No... Not playing! I worked hard on it... It took effort...
These are gifts! For... you... and Teacher!
I'm going to give them... to you!
But... Not done yet. I haven't finished all of them...
Anchorage looks despondent.

options.content: (Suggest folding the rest together with her.)

scripts.say: How about we finish the rest of them together?
No... I'll do my best! On my own!
Come on, let's do it together. It'll be more fun, and you've already shown how nice you are.
Are you... sure?
Okay, Teacher... Together!
I'll help out, too. How are you supposed to fold it?
Okay! Navi, you help! Anchorage can teach you how!
The three of us sit down, and Anchorage starts showing Navi how to fold the paper.
First you do this... Then this... And then this...
Wooow! Navi, you're amazing!
It's all thanks to you teaching me how to do it.
You'll give them to us? Aww, you're so nice.
Heehee... Teacher... nice to me!
So Anchorage... wants to make you both happy!
I'll be fast... Wait just a minute, Teacher!
Of course.
Anchorage sits back down and starts folding paper again.
Sometime later, she hands both me and Navi a paper creation.
Done! For you, Teacher... A boat!
And for Navi, a star!
For me? It's so pretty!
Anchorage worked super-duper hard on it! Heehee!
And so, the three of us spent a heartwarming afternoon together.
Hey, {tb}. I know you've been busting your butt lately, so I made a special fruit juice blend for you ♪
I promise it's delicious, even if it looks a little weird!
It's my original recipe, so it can't NOT be good!
Try it. I guarantee you'll never forget the taste!

options.content: I think I'll have regular fruit juice.
Thanks! I was just feeling thirsty.

scripts.say: Come ooon... You're so lame.
Oh boy, today's gonna be interesting ♪
The forecast said the weather's gonna be good today. We should have an amazing view of the stars tonight!
{tb}, whaddya say we go up on the roof and watch them?

options.content: I'd rather we did it from a safer place.

scripts.say: Wow, what a coward! Where's your sense of adventure?
You can still see lots of stars from the balcony.
Hmph! You are such a boring dweeb, I swear!
Oh really? I didn't think you had the adventurer's spirit in you, dweeb!
Alright, we'll go with your spot!
Hey, um, {tb}...
I've used just a teensy tiny bit too much of my allowance...
Could I borrow some from my next month's allowance? I'll be a good girl!

options.content: Let's keep track of your expenses.

scripts.say: Huh? You mean like... writing down how much money I use?
Yeah. Then you'll learn how to spend your money more wisely.
Sounds like a pain... but fine, if it'll get me my allowance...
What? It was that easy? Wow, you're really nice!
Of course. You have to promise to plan out your spending, though.
Plan out? Seriously?
Ah, whatever you say, just give me my allowance!
Ugh... This is so lame...
Can't I clean my room later?

options.content: You can put it off for today.

scripts.say: Seriously? I think you just wanna give me orders, you dweeb.
With my help, it'll get done faster.
Hmph! Fine... I'll do it, but not just because you're helping!
Heheh! Guess even a dweeb can be understanding from time to time!
You won't get off the hook tomorrow, though.
I can think about tomorrow's problem tomorrow! Besides, it's not like you can stop me!
Hey, {tb}!
There's still strawberry cake left in the fridge, isn't there?
I'm gonna eat it sooner or later, so it's no harm if I eat it now, right? Heehee!

options.content: It's not time for desserts yet.

scripts.say: Tsk! You're so stingy!
Too much sweet food is bad for your teeth. You'll have to control yourself a bit.
Seriously? You just don't understand how a girl's mind works!
Wow, I wasn't expecting that!
There's nothing wrong with treating yourself once in a while.
Heheh. Spoken like a true glutton!
My closet is a total mess...
I would sort it out, but I have no idea where to even start...
What do you think, {tb}?

options.content: You could divide them into categories and go from there.
Who cares? Just throw the clothes in there.

scripts.say: Good point. That'll make it easier to find what I'm looking for later.
I'll try to make a habit of this to make your life easier.
If you say so, then alright... That's a lot less tiring ♪
It'll be like a treasure hunt the next time I look in my closet!
I saw someone make rice balls a while ago.
I wanna try making one by myself.
What filling should I put in?

options.content: How about an easy one to work with?
Why not just put in all the fillings you like?

scripts.say: Yeah, good idea.
I should slowly work my way up toward the harder ones.
I'll keep trying to make a rice ball that you love!
Huh? If I put in everything I like...
That might create a one-of-a-kind rice ball!
Once I'm finished, you've absolutely got to try it!
There's a super tricky question in my homework today and I can't solve it at all...
{tb}, could you help me?

options.content: I'll help you work out the solution.
Do something else for a bit, then try again.

scripts.say: Yay! Thanks a bunch!
Once I know how to solve it, it won't be so daunting the next time a similar tricky question pops up!
You mean to let my brain relax a little?
Yeah, I guess that would be a nice change of pace.
Okay, I'll do my homework later!
I saw someone doing paper crafts today. I wanna try it myself.
Although, it looks pretty hard...

options.content: How about designing something new by yourself?

scripts.say: Okay! There shouldn't be any problems as long as I follow the steps.
And with you to accompany me, I'll feel more comfortable doing it!
Designing something new... That's not a bad idea.
Maybe I can make a special paper creation for you. Now I'm excited!
Port - Office
"Project Identity"? Hang on, haven't we already finished raising you?
Staring puzzled at the project papers on my desk, I turn to TB for an explanation.
Question received. The contents of this project do not clash with the previous project.
Analysis complete. It would be appropriate to retitle this project as "Project Identity 2.0."
I will now reprint the document and share it with Akashi.
Akashi? Did she come up with this?
Negative. Akashi and I created this project in collaboration.
Additionally, I requested assistance from Akashi, which she provided.
Huh?
Before I can get another word in with TB, a voice I'm well-acquainted with cuts in.
Did someone call, nya?
With perfect timing, the green cat appears in my office, like a familiar summoned through the utterance of its name.
When did you get here?
Actually, don't answer that...
Now that you're both here, could you explain what this project is?
Question received. Thanks to Project Identity, I have gained a tremendous amount of cognitive data.
Therefore, I believe that your excellent qualities – such as your friendliness and sense of responsibility – have the potential to yield even greater value.
I managed to discover a personality of my own thanks to your repeated training. That being said...
The experience I can gain is always limited to the contents of your training process starting from scratch.
While each instance yields different results, the data collection process has presently reached the point of diminishing returns.
As it stands, there are no prospects of deepening my understanding of individuality.
That being the case, I asked Akashi for assistance with drafting a new project.
Simply put, TB's training has hit a bottleneck, nya. She needs new data, nya.
But if it has hit a bottleneck, how is training her further going to achieve anything?
That's where the new project comes in, nya! You'll be raising someone else this time, nya!
You mean another AI? Do we even have another AI besides TB at the port?
We do, nya! Oceana, nya!
...Why her, in particular?
Because she's got a lot of potential inside her, nya!
Even assuming you have a way to gauge that, isn't there a bigger problem? Namely, that she has no will of her own.
Nyahaha. I got TB to fix that, nya.
Affirmative. I have created a basic personality for her.
It was based on the analysis of recorded data, surveys filled out by members of the port, and parameters set by Akashi.
We only need your consent, then Akashi will upload the personality data to your device.
Isn't it kind of pointless to raise her if she already comes with a personality?
I mean... Isn't that the goal? To develop a personality?
That is correct. The question is if an existing personality can change based on upbringing.
If it can, I will record the results.
This data holds incredible value for my study into personalities.
You may decide whether or not to proceed with the project. Ultimately, I'm just making a wish to you.
("Making a wish"... TB has never used that phrase before.)
(You could take that as proof that cultivating her personality has produced results.)
Well, if it's a personal request from you, then I guess I could try.
Is the process the same as last time?
It's been simplified a little, nya.
Since Oceana already has a foundation to work off of, some of the earlier steps can be skipped, nya.
I see. Then I just have one question before we fully go ahead with this.
Are there plans to expand Project Identity in the future?
It's hard to say at the moment. It is a possibility that this process will not yield sufficient data to break through the bottleneck.
However, as there is ample data saved, it will be possible to perform other personality simulations in the future.
Should the 2.0 version produce insufficient data, we can keep trying with versions 3.0, 4.0, and so forth.
By the time we're done, I'll be the most experienced parent in the world.
Judging by context and your phrasing, I will interpret this as a "joke."
I will now provide an appropriate emotional response based on my current training data.
Ha. Ha. Ha.
A laugh devoid of emotion spills out from TB's mouth.
While it may not seem like much, it is substantial progress for her.
I write my signature on the documents. Akashi quickly takes them and cradles them in her arms.
Nyahaha! I'll go and get things ready then, nya!
Just need to fine-tune a few things, and with TB's help, I'll be done in no time, nya!
Don't worry, I won't charge you anything, nya. Not this time, anyway, nya!

"Outdoor activities are a type of exercise that is indispensable for a child's health. Making effective use of their time outdoors can improve their sense of balance and foster a sense of cooperation..."
I close the book I found in the library and furrow my brow a little.
Judging by her current personality, Navi shouldn't be against the idea of playing outdoors.
You know, yeah – going outside might be a good choice.
With my mind made, I equip the device again.
As always, there's a bright light, followed by the virtual town coming into view.
After quickly getting some things in order, I bring Navi with me outdoors.
Just an inch away from the finish line, relay baton in hand, the corners of Navi's lips bend into a rather proud smile.
Did you see that, {tb}? I won by a landslide!
Yeah. You did great.
Heh! It was a total walk in the park for me!
She triumphantly swings the baton around and takes on an even more boastful attitude.
My victory was inevitable! A dweeb with no stamina like you would never beat me!
Are you taunting me now?
Taunting? I'm just stating facts!
You work at a desk all day! It's obvious you don't have any endurance! Losety loser!
Oh yeah? Do you wanna try me?
Huh? Are you challenging me?
Heheh! I'll give you a friendly tip – when you lose, you should just admit it!
Navi and I run all the way home, messing around along the way.

As always, there's a bright light, followed by the virtual town coming into view.
After quickly getting some things in order, I bring Navi with me outdoors.
The gentle afternoon sun shines on the garden of a farm.
Okay... That's perfect!
Navi carefully piles soil onto the flower that she just planted.
{tb}! Great timing!
I finished planting the flower while you went away to buy drinks!
Aware of my arrival, she looks up at me with a beaming smile. There is a small and endearing spot of dirt on her cheek.
I'm surprised that gardening is your preferred kind of outdoor activity.
Heehee! It's outdoors, so it counts!
I am getting exercise by digging holes and carrying flower pots around, too.
Oh, also, please bring me back here later. I wanna look after this flower.
We'll make sure it grows big and strong!
We exchange a pinky promise, then walk back home feeling at peace.
As of late, Navi has become really passionate about studying. She even insists on staying behind after school so she can self-teach.
(Surely her classes aren't THAT demanding...)
(I might have to talk with TB and Akashi later and adjust the curriculum a little bit.)
I exhale a sigh and casually gaze at the wall clock.
There is still some time to go before Navi is home.
I should make her favorite food to reward her for her incredible diligence.
On my way back home from buying groceries, I take a detour and arrive in front of the arcade.
(Hang on, when did Akashi add an arcade to the town?)
Driven by curiosity, I take a peek inside and immediately catch sight of a familiar school uniform.
(Is that... Navi? Shouldn't she be studying at school?)

options.content: (Go inside and take a closer look.)

scripts.say: (Well, I can either stand here and suffer in uncertainty or go inside and confirm it.)
I decide to wait for her to finish instead of disturbing her.
Through the glass window, I see that she's completely engrossed in her game.
(This feels kind of like I'm spying on her... Forget it. I'll just go in.)
Opening the door to the arcade, I'm greeted by a cacophony of bleeps and bloops and video game music.
Navi is standing in front of a rhythm game cabinet, stepping on arrows in tune to the song. Pearls of sweat dangle off the edge of her hair.
Navi?
Hearing her name called, she loses her cool and focus, turning around in a panic to face me.
She is so surprised that she drops her can of soda.
Whuah?!
{tb}?! What're you doing here?!
I just happened to pass by.
Is this what you've really been doing when you said you've been "self-teaching"?
Uhh... I mean...
She hangs her head and grips the rim of her skirt.
I already know all the stuff they're teaching me, and I wanted to have a little fun...
So why didn't you come straight home?
Because... Because you have work you need to do...
Her voice shrinks smaller and smaller.
If I went home, you'd have to drop your work just to play with me, so...
(So that's what this is about.)
It's okay, Navi.
You don't have to worry about my work. Spending time with you isn't a chore or a waste of time to me.
It's not?
It's not. Honestly. What do you say we go home together? I'll cook up your favorite meal.
But... what about your work?
Like I said, don't worry. No matter how busy I am, I'll always try to make time for us.
Hearing this answer, she finally looks up to meet my gaze. Her confident smile is back.
Well... You better promise! You can't take it back and say, "Nuh-uh, no time" later!
Alright. I promise.
I take her hand and walk out of the arcade with her.
The glow of the sunset casts a long shadow of her on the ground as we go home.

Some time has passed since I bumped into Navi at the arcade.
Although we promised to spend more time together, today it looks like she just wants to stay in her room.
(She can't just sit in there forever...)
(This is a good opportunity to take her somewhere.)
Hey, Navi, the weather's great today. Do you wanna go for a swim?
What? Why a swim all of a sudden?
When you were playing that rhythm game at the arcade, I noticed your moves were a bit clumsy.
If you want to sharpen your sense of balance and make yourself more flexible, swimming is the best way to do it.
Huh? Are you looking down on me?
A sour expression. She defiantly places both hands on her hips.
Don't you give me unsolicited advice when you're just as out-of-shape! Also, gaming is a million times more fun than swimming!
I hear you. How about a swimming race, then?
If you win, I'll play that rhythm game with you for a whole week. How does that sound?
Wooow, you talk big yet you're only putting one week on the line? Two weeks should be the minimum!
Two weeks it is, then. You still have to beat me, though.
Pfft. That's gonna be easy. Hope you like the taste of defeat!
And so, I brought Navi to the pool.
Her swimming form is surprisingly good, and her moves were smooth. However, I had the physical advantage that secured me the victory.
Navi gets out of the pool and immediately falls flat on her stomach, water dripping off her hair and swimsuit.
Despite looking exhausted, she still has the energy to shoot me a proud look, grinning as though she is the real victor.
Okay, you got me... but does it matter? You're still going to the arcade with me anyway, right?
Well... Yes.
Heheh! Of course. You're such a dweeb that I just knew you'd do it anyway!
The smug look on her face screams, "Everything went just as I expected."
Hmm. On second thought, I'm not doing it.
Huh?! No, wait! I'm sorry! I'm sorry for being so rude!
Her facade of superiority crumbles in an instant, giving way to a look of remorse.
Afterward, we got changed and headed to the arcade just as she'd hoped. There, we played many rounds together.
Some time has passed since I bumped into Navi at the arcade.
Although we promised to spend more time together, today it looks like she just wants to stay in her room.
(She can't just sit in there forever...)
(This is a good opportunity to take her somewhere.)
Hey, Navi, the weather's nice, so how about we visit a farm?
I saw an ad for it. They let you try things like wood-carving and weaving wreaths.
Really? Sounds fun!
The glitter of excitement fills her eyes instantly.
Come on, let's go!
Gentle sunlight shines into the farm's workshop, illuminating the workbench.
Navi carves a block of wood clumsily but to the best of her ability.
What's up?
I want some ice cream.
A store we walked by on the way here had a special offer. Can you buy it from there?
I could, but it's pretty far from here. It might melt on the way back.
It'd be better if you came along and ate it on the spot.
But I don't wanna... I wanna be spoiled today!
She blinks at me with eager eyes, smiling an irresistible, innocent smile.
I can't bring myself to say no to her. I leave the workshop to go and buy some ice cream.
When I return to the workshop, ice creams in hand, I see something beautiful.
Navi is standing at the entrance to greet me, holding a gorgeously-crafted wreath.
Dust particles hang in the air, turned golden by the sunlight, floating around her almost like fireflies.
Look...
With some embarrassment, she presents the wreath.
I made this for you. As thanks for always taking such good care of me.
I know it's not the best... but I wanted to show you how happy it makes me to spend time with you, {tb}.
We eat the partially melted ice creams together, then finished carving the wood.
Later, I took the wreath she made and put it inside a transparent case for safe-keeping.
Navi has gotten really into exercising as of late.
Well, "exercising" might not be the right word. Specifically, she's become passionate about a kind of training that demands good balance and control of your body.
Although she has never shown interest in lifting or aerobic exercises, she's very keen on exercise centered around the core and balance.
She wanted to do more of it this evening, so she dragged me to the gym again.
She sits on an exercise ball, feet in the air, trying to stay upright using only her torso.
{tb}! How long have I balanced for?
You're nearing one minute.
Heheh! I'll beat my record this time, just you watch!
Brimming with confidence, she rocks back and forth slightly.
Careful so you don't fall, now.
Don't worry! I can– Whuah!
Navi!
With a small scream, she falls to the floor.
I tried to catch her, but I was too slow.
Owch... That stings...
Are you okay?
I extend my hand to help her back on her feet, but she brushes it off.
I'm fine! Also, it's your fault for making me fall! I lost my concentration 'cause of you!
Hmph! That one doesn't count! We're starting over, and this time, I'll set a new record for sure!
We spent a whole hour in the gym trying over and over before finally leaving.
On the way back home, Navi kept repeating that she will set another new record next time.
While cleaning the house, I found a dusty box hidden away in a corner.
Wait... Isn't this that remote-controlled car you gave me?
Yeah. I thought about throwing it away when it broke, but I guess I left it somewhere. Let's get rid of it.
But you gave me it as a gift... It feels wrong to just throw it away!
Maybe I can fix it? I've been studying repairs at school!
They teach you how to do that?
Yeah. My teacher says it improves your thinking and problem-solving skills.
Who knows – you might even come up with some crazy invention in the future!
Honing your thinking and problem-solving skills, that's reasonable – but inventing something is setting your sights really high.
Let me try repairing it anyway. We have a workshop for stuff like this.
Alright. I'll bring you some drinks and snacks.
Yay! Thanks, {tb}!
I come to the workshop with some snacks and drinks and see that Navi has already started on the repairs.
Donning workwear and protective goggles, she stands in front of the table with a serious look on her face.
There is an oil stain on her cheek. It looks like she's been tinkering with parts quite a lot.
Oh, welcome, {tb}!
My teacher said you ought to put on breathable clothes when working like this.
Well, you sure look the part of a mechanic.
Just be careful so you don't hurt yourself.
I'll be fine, don't worry!
I left the refreshments on a table then sat down and watched her work.
Her hard work paid off, and she got the toy back in working order.
She gave it to me. I polished it up before giving it back to her. She put it safely inside her personal collection box.
It's another day where Navi has "forced" me to do sports with her.
Although she is as discourteous as ever, she is clearly showing more consideration for me than she used to.
We arrived at the tennis court and did some warm-up exercises, then started a game right off the bat.
After a 30-minute-long back-and-forth, she was finally starting to pant for air.
Her tennis clothes are soaked through, sticking to her skin.
She grabs the rim of her top and uses it to wipe sweat from her brow.
Time for a break?
*pant*... *pant*... Why? You throwing in the towel already?
It's sooo obvious you don't get nearly enough exercise!
So you say, but you're short of breath yourself.
Hmph! No, I'm just getting started!
She flicks her sweaty hair and tries to look composed.
Breaktime is over! Get your head back in the game!
Our sweat-inducing afternoon at the tennis court was over before we knew it.
As the sun started to set, we packed our things and headed for home.
Although she should've been exhausted after all this, she seemed strangely content. That made me feel like this wasn't a bad way to spend a day.
Once I finally wrap up my work at the port for the day, it has already turned to night.
(Whew... I hope Navi isn't staying up late to read novels again.)
When I caught on to it, we had a long discussion and she promised not to do it anymore. Even so...
(I should check on her.)
I put the device on and return to the virtual town. Before long, I notice the light faintly peeking through the crack in the door to her room.
I give it two knocks. It looks like the door was left slightly open.
Pushing against it gently, I slowly open the door.
Navi is sitting at her desk in her pajamas, writing something in her big notebook.
A few papers are scattered around her desk, filled with dense handwriting.
{tb}? I thought you weren't coming home tonight...
Oh, uh, I'm not reading novels, I'm just...
She hurriedly covers her notes with her hands, cheeks flushed.
Why are you up this late, and what are you writing?
I-it's... You know...
While her hands obscure most of what's written in her notes, one of the scattered papers clearly clues me in as to what she's writing about.
The neat handwriting describes her and my daily life, with cute little doodles accompanying the writing.
I'm keeping a diary... I-I won't stay up to write it again, I promise.
She buries her head and makes a promise under her breath.
Once she gathered her scattered papers, I watched to make sure she went to bed.
I switched off her desk lamp and carefully closed the door to her room.
Moonlight shone in through the window, painting the hallway a silvery blue. A calm and quiet night passed by.
Port - Office
Five days have passed since Akashi proclaimed that she would be "done in no time."
As I organize my schedule and review the next item on the agenda, someone places a familiar device on my desk.
Oh, isn't this that immersion device I used while raising TB?
Sure is, nya! It contains the virtual town you're oh-so-familiar with, nya.
Oh, but there have been a few small changes since you went in last time, nya.
You know how TB's interested in the effects of environment and upbringing on a personality, nya?
Well, I got some very colorful personalities to help us out this time, nya.
They'll appear in the city, and you'll be able to visit them, nya!
Whoa, hold up – "visit them"?
You'll get it when you unlock the feature, nya.
Don't fuss over the details, just put it on, nya! Don't keep the star of the show waiting, nya!
Nodding, I equip the device. Akashi walks up to me with a tablet in her hands.
On the other side of the screen, TB gives me a quick nod.
System confirmation: Growth target has been set. Target: Oceana – Navi.
Transferring growth missions now.
Alright.
The familiar bright light fills my vision...
Before I knew it, it was getting to be time for Navi to transition to the next level of education.
Seeing how she grew every day made me worry. Was I fulfilling my responsibility to guide her growth?
On the last day of the semester, even after the school day had long ended, she'd yet to come home.
(Is she at the arcade again?)
When I go there, however, she's nowhere to be found.
(I'd better go check at the school.)
The afterglow of sunset illuminates the classroom.
Navi bites the tip of her pen as she gazes out the window, lost in thought.
The open page of her notebook has been scribbled over, but I can barely make out the words "future plans."
There you are.
Aah?! Wh-why are you here?!
It's late. You never came home, so I came looking for you.
Are you having any problems?
I'm just thinking about class. Stuff about our future, about our ideals...
She unconsciously taps the table. Her voice gradually trails off.
I just don't know about any of it.
You don't need to rush things. Go at your own pace.
No matter what choices you make, I'm on your side.
I gently pat her shoulder.
It takes time to find your way. There's nothing wrong with being unsure now.
I'll stay with you and watch over you while you figure things out.
Navi, I know that you'll find your own answer someday.
...You mean it?
Of course. I promise you.
She smiles back at me.
Then we better go home and eat! I'm starving!
Seeing her relieved and packing her bag, I can't help but smile.
Whatever the future may hold, I'll be her guardian until she finds her way.

After moving on to the next stage of her education, Navi quickly adapted to her new environment.
Eventually, the day of the athletic meet came.
Though she didn't say it, the fact that she always went to the track after school was proof that she was very serious about this competition.
Naturally, her performance at the athletic meet was dazzling.
She maintained the top position from the very beginning, and in the end, she'd crossed the finish line first by a large margin.
She stands on the podium with one hand on her hip and the other proudly displaying her gold medal.
Did you see that, {tb}? This is proof of my skills!
Her eyes sparkle with joy.
Congratulations.
I'm just getting started!
Yeah, I'll never stop winning!
My girl practically glows in the sunlight.
That's the Navi I know and love.
Today, I got off work early to pick Navi up from school.
Or so I say, but really, I'm just following her while she walks a bit ahead.
Hum hum hum♪
As I watch the little girl, I get a little emotional – she's grown up so fast. So emotional, in fact, that I don't realize how much I've slowed down.
Heeey! {tb}!
You're too slow! Aww, are you trying to get me to hold your hand like we used to when I was little?
...Huh?
She yells again before I can speak up.
I'm all grown up now. I don't need my hand held just to go home anymore... You're too silly, {tb}.
While I try to think of a response, she stops in front of a vending machine.
I'm thirsty. Let's get drinks!
I watch vacantly while she picks a drink. Thoughts of work resurface.
While I think, I suddenly hear her knocking on the glass impatiently.
She takes a step back, and then...
Right foot raised slightly, knee bent...
Navi kicks the poor vending machine like it's a soccer ball.
The motion lifts the skirt of her uniform slightly, revealing the skin above her white, thigh-high socks.
BANG!
The collision is immediately followed by a dry clunk – the sound of a can falling.
This thing sucks! It tried to steal my drink from me!
Huh? Hey, {tb}, are you SCARED? You're too hopeless~
She cocks her head for a moment and then grins madly at me like a smug little kid.
I sigh and check on the vending machine.
While I'm relieved that it isn't broken, I turn to lecture her, but she's already walked off with a drink in hand.
Hurry up already! The sun's gonna set before we get back, you dweeb!
She trots away cheerfully, and I'm forced to hold my tongue.
I need to find a way to correct her willful nature.
...I just hope I can.
When I pass by a music shop one day, I notice a pretty sick guitar on display.
Navi has always expressed interest in writing music, so I splurge on it and give it to her as a gift.
Huh? This is... for me?
She timidly accepts the guitar. Her eyes are full of surprise and joy.
An electric guitar might be hard for a beginner. Should we start with an acoustic instead?
Oh... Now that you mention it, maybe. But I'm fine! If I try hard, I know I can do it!
After that, I'd often hear the sounds of guitar practice coming from her room.
But when I asked her to show me what she's learned...
N-not yet! Let me practice a little more!
She'd always get flustered and refuse.
That is, until one day when I left work and came home early...
The instant I opened the door, I heard a calm melody.
Her soft singing voice accompanied the tones of the guitar.
Navi sits in a computer chair in her room, wearing comfy clothes.
She has a guitar and microphone set up, and recording software is running on her PC.
When I open the door, she stops and looks up, surprised.
Oops. You got me...
She blushes, but she doesn't try to evade the matter this time.
The truth is... I've been learning songwriting lately.
Songwriting? You're already that good?
Navi nods shyly and just barely plucks the strings.
It's still really simple, but I wrote it for you.
I wanted it to be a surprise. That's why I never told you...
That afternoon, her melody and singing echoed in her room.
It was the greatest gift of all – a heartfelt song just for one.
To my surprise, Navi suddenly says that she's going to cook.
I'm in a good mood today, so I'll treat you to some of my home cooking!
Heheh! I hope your heart is ready to be captured by my food! Well, ready or not, it will either way!
It's good to see her take the initiative like this, so I nod in agreement.
We head out and buy the necessary ingredients, then return home. As soon as we get back, she chases me out of the kitchen.
No peeking! Or else you'll regret it! Heheh!
Left with no other choice, I retreat to the living room and kill time with a book. In the midst of my reading, however, an indescribable, sweet smell wafts in from the kitchen.
Uh-oh... Did something go wrong?
The concern drives me to ignore her no-entry order and open the door to the kitchen.
Navi is sitting leisurely atop the kitchen counter, holding a vial containing a suspicious, pink liquid.
Oh, already smelled it, huh?
Pink bubbles rise from the pot. That looks to be the source of the strangely sweet smell.
What the hell is that?
This? It's my secret ingredient!
I made it with a special recipe my homeroom teacher taught me♪
There is a dangerous smile on her face as she pours the last drop of the liquid into the pot.
You'll eat it all, won't you, {tb}?
I made it just for you, so you better not let any go to waste♪
That very moment, the contents of the pot suddenly solidify into some material the likes of which I've never seen before.
Aww, that sucks. I'd hoped to see your reaction when you tasted it!
The disappointment in her expression brings me great relief.
Using what's left of the daikon and the other ingredients, I throw together a vegetarian curry. I live to tell another tale.
It's the afternoon on a weekend. I'm hauling bags of groceries back home.
Besides the expected daily necessities, I've also bought that strawberry cake that Navi was craving.
I'm back.
Upon opening the door, I'm met with a heartwarming sight.
Navi is in the living room, courteously folding the laundry.
Oh, welcome back, {tb}! Hope your work was fine.
Looking at me with a lovely smile, she skillfully takes out one garment after the next from the laundry basket.
Give me a second. I'll help with the groceries after I'm done with this.
Gently and swiftly, she smoothes out the wrinkles on the clothes with her fingers.
Alright, now for your bags.
She moves the folded clothes aside and takes the grocery bags out of my hands.
Wait... Isn't this strawberry cake?
Her eyes sparkle. She looks at me with joy.
Sure is. You said you wanted to taste it, so I got it.
I just said it without much thought, and you still remembered... Heheh.
Suddenly, she stops lifting out groceries and joins her hands together in front of her chest.
I know it's sudden, but I want to say it: I live such a happy life.
Making breakfast, waiting for you to wake up... Cleaning the place, doing the laundry...
It just makes me so happy to live like this with you, {tb}.
I hope things will stay like this forever and...
Some realization seems to hit her as she interrupts herself. A light blush covers her face from ear to ear.
Err! Um... I mean...
Flustered, she goes back to taking groceries out of the bag.
I'm paying you back for looking after me, that's all! Don't get any funny ideas.
Her voice fades into a whisper.
It's not just you... We both care a lot about each other...
There is a loving yet embarrassed smile on her face as she mutters those words.
The lights in the study are still on, despite how late it is.
I knock on the closed door and speak to Navi through it.
Are you still up, Navi?
Huh? So what if I am? Seriously.
Ugh...
Out of exasperation, I open the door and step inside.
Inside, only the desktop lamp is lit, casting a warm light on Navi.
She is sitting in front of the workbench, focused on some sort of blueprint.
The individual components look roughly sketched out. Still, I can tell she is taking the task seriously.
As for Navi herself, she holds a pen in one hand and looks rather unkempt.
I figured you'd come in anyway.
Could you have a look at my design?
...What am I saying? What insightful critique would a dweeb like you have? Forget it! Get out!
Despite her aggressive posturing, it doesn't feel like she really wants to drive me out.
You must've put a lot of work into drawing this... What is it?
Heh. Curious? Ask me really nicely and I might just tell you.

options.content: Pretty please with sugar on top.

scripts.say: Wooow, begging me now, huh? Not every day I hear a "please" from you.
You clearly didn't MEAN it, though. You'll have to be more sincere!
Okay, fine. I'll tell you.
I shake my head, turn on my heel, and start leaving.
Hmph! Just gonna walk away, dweeb? What a coward!
I take two steps toward the door.
What, are you gonna ignore me now? Hey! Wait!
Come back here! Don't leave!
...What? The Sandwich Maker 3.0?
That's right! It's the perfect invention to replace a certain dweeb in my life!
I don't remember asking you to get up early and make me breakfast with bags under your eyes. It's such an eyesore!
I don't see the point in an invention like this.
I make breakfast for you every morning because I want to.
You don't see the point? You telling me my invention sucks? Wow, you have some nerve!
If you wanna make breakfast for me that badly, I'll give you a chance to prove yourself.
Make me a sandwich tomorrow. And be grateful for the opportunity.
I want two slices of cheese, and make sure it's cut into four perfectly aligned pieces!
If I don't deem it good enough, well... I've got goofy photos of you on the verge of dozing off, so!
With a smug look, she cleans up at the desk and leaves with a cheery gait, shutting the door forcefully behind her.
Just a second or two later, though, the door silently opens just a crack.
...Good night, dweeb.
Be ready for the consequences if my morning sandwich tomorrow isn't up to snuff!
Today is open day at Navi's school.
We promised to have a look around together, and yet, she wasn't answering my calls.
I searched all over the place and finally found her in the school's workshop.
Navi stands in the distance, donning working clothes, engrossed in the engine in front of her.
Her brow furrows a little while her eyes examine every individual component closely.
Hmm... How to connect these two...
This will be tricky... I'll have to take a step back and remember what they taught us in class...
Navi?
Let's see... What to do when I'm at an impasse...
Navi, do you need a hand?
After calling out to her twice, she finally notices that I'm here.
{tb}? Why are you– Oh, right! Sorry! You must've tried to call me. I got so caught up in this thing that I didn't notice!
Realizing how many calls she has missed, she gives me an apologetic look.
It's alright. Why are you repairing that thing, anyway? Want my help?
Thanks, but no. This is my handicrafts homework.
I need to perform a full inspection of this vehicle.
This is the most basic model, and it's still insanely hard...
Wiping sweat off her forehead with her hand, she cracks an awkward smile.
Don't worry, I'll get it done.
Are you sure you don't need my help?
She shakes her head while her cheeks turn a light tinge of red.
I'll manage. One way or another.
Besides, I won't grow if I rely on your help forever. I wanna make you proud.
Well, that's a noble mindset...
(Is vehicular maintenance really a necessary part of the curriculum, though?)
Ah, I know what you're thinking.
"This maintenance stuff is beyond your abilities," right?
Me, I think all skills are good to have.
One day, it might be useful to have someone like me who knows how machines are put together.
She says this with a completely serious look. It's almost like she and her cute side belong to two different people.
Her eyes glow with determination, like there's a faint yet unshakeable light inside of them.
Right – do you mind waiting here for a bit?
I should be done in just a minute.
Once I'm finished, what do you say we grab a bite in the cafeteria?
Oh, uh... I'll have washed off this motor oil before then!
It amazes me how fast time flies. It was already time for Navi to graduate.
I attended her prom... and that was it. Afterward, our lives went on like normal with seemingly little change.
Granted, that's because she said she needed time to really consider her future career.
I respected her choice and gave her both ample time and space to work things out.
Fast forward to today, and she brought me to a café to have a serious talk.
Uh, just so you know, there's no particular reason why I chose a café.
I just figured talking at home wouldn't lend enough gravity to the conversation, y'know?
Anyway, I've been thinking a lot. About who I want to be.
Should I be someone amazing? Someone rational? Or someone who I can't find the words to describe yet?
She stirs her cup of coffee while speaking, like she's sorting through her thoughts at the same time.
After a lot of thinking, I realized that there's really no point in worrying about it...
I mean, no matter what I do, you'll always be there for me, ready to help, right?
Basically, what I do or who I become is way less important than you simply being here to support me.
Once that realization hit me, all my doubts went up in smoke.
While saying that, she slides her chair back a bit.
Jumping out of her seat, she suddenly produces a red paper bag.
I can see her black dress fully now that she's standing up. It looks amazing on her.
This, um... This is for you!
I saved up my allowance to buy it for you...
Cheeks flushed, she presents the gift to me.
It's not much, but you have to accept it!
I've worked hard to get this far, and I'm gonna keep at it!
Thank you.
The sun's grace shines upon us, preserving this warm moment forever.
Little by little, my surroundings become clear to me.
They even rebuilt the house, huh?
I take a look around and discover that the layout of the whole place has changed, then take a seat on the couch.
(Navi... That's an interesting name.)
(Oceana was given a personality, and with it, a new moniker.)
(Now I'm curious what her personality is like, and how I should speak to her...)
While I'm pondering how to introduce myself, I hear a faint noise coming from the entrance.
The door opens, and a young girl steps inside.
Hmph. You're the dweeb who's gonna be looking after me, eh?
Well, nice to meet you! Be a good guardian, or whatever♪
Uh, nice to meet you...
(So they've given her basic cognition and language capabilities. Doesn't look like I'll need to teach her much about those.)
(It's incredible how far we've come. Maybe soon we'll have more AIs around the port.)
That's it? That's your introduction? Wow, you're living up to your dweeb name already.
You know what? You should be thanking ME for letting you take care of me!
Ohh. So this is how you're gonna be.
What's that? Is something not to your liking, huh, dweeb?
(She's just a kid. Don't let her get to you.)
(It's a total mystery to me in what way growing up is going to change her...)
While thinking that to myself, I extend a hand to her.
Welcome to your home, Navi.
She extends her own small hand and grasps mine.
Hmph. Guess I've got a hopeless adult to babysit now! Oh well!

I attended her prom... and that was it. Afterward, our lives went on like normal with seemingly little change.
Granted, that's because she said she needed time to really consider her future career.
I respected her choice and gave her both ample time and space to work things out.

I just figured talking at home wouldn't lend enough gravity to the conversation, y'know?
