Phew... Thank goodness the cherries didn't get crushed...
I'd rather the cherries get bruised than you, but all's well that ends well.
It's starting to get late, so why don't we head back now?
Okay! I'll make lots of delicious food once we get back!

sequence:
From Farm to Fork!

<size=45>5 Showers and Surprises</size>

scripts.say: As soon as we get back to where we're staying, Lung Wu immediately heads to the outdoor kitchen in the backyard to start cooking.
Lung Wu, do you need my help?
I'm fine, thanks. You must be tired too after a whole day of following me around, so just relax!
I didn't find it tiring at all...
More importantly, Commander, the kitchen is a battlefield! It is not a place you should step into unless you've steeled yourself!
Just then, a few cold raindrops strike my cheek; moments later, it turns into a full downpour.
Oh no! Why's it raining all of a sudden?!
Lung Wu turns toward the various food ingredients still spread out in front of her, while the rain grows heavier by the moment.
Commander! Can you help me move everything inside?! Hurry, or the ingredients will go to waste!
As Lung Wu starts gathering the ingredients, I jump in to help without missing a beat.
As soon as everything has been taken inside, we get a call from Akashi and Owari.
My sincerest apawlogies! I thought that an outdoor kitchen would create a more romantic atmosphere, nya...
I guess in the future we get to put a roof over the backyard, and set up an indoor kitchen too!
Do you need some food right now...?
Umm... Don't worry about it...
Lung Wu notices a brazier in the corner of the living room.
Akashi, Owari, do you mind if I use the brazier in the living room as a grill?
- Go for it, nya! - Good idea!
Lung Wu removes the grate from the barbecue grill outside and places it on top of the charcoal-burning brazier.
She then puts a tea kettle on the grate and goes back to prepping the ingredients.
...The heat is low, so the fish will need to cook slowly... In that case, cut it into small pieces, season it, then wrap it in tin foil and slow-roast it to give it a texture similar to dry-frying...
Mussels get tough when grilled over an open flame, so I'll dice them up and stew them with fresh bamboo shoots...
Okay. I can do this. With these fresh ingredients, even simple dishes will turn out delicious!
Now, for the sauces... Hmm, I don't have a whole lot of seasonings here, but thankfully, I brought some five-spice powder and chu hou sauce...
Lung Wu looks like she's about to overheat from processing too many things at once, so I once again offer to help her.
Lung Wu, are you sure there's nothing I can help you with?
Umm... If you insist, let me see...
Could you wash those fruits for me? We can have them after dinner.
Sure thing.

sequence:
From Farm to Fork!

<size=45>6 Tea and Hearth</size>

scripts.say: As the rain continues to fall outside, tendrils of cold drift into the room.
The heat from the glowing coals sends steam rising from the kettle on the grate, and the aroma of tea gently wafts around us.
The light fragrance of the tea is soon joined by a deeper, richer aroma – that of mussels boiling away in a clay pot.
The sound of tin foil being peeled back is followed by an explosion of garlicky, buttery goodness. The skin of the mandarin fish she's been cooking looks perfectly crispy and delicious.
Mmmmh... that smells so good! It turned out really well!
Lung Wu places a slice of the fish on a small plate, gently blows on it to cool it down, then sets it in front of me.
Commander, this is for you! Please enjoy!
I excitedly take a bite of the freshly cooked fish.
The flesh has just the right amount of firmness while also melting in my mouth. The garlic and butter accentuate the fish's natural flavor perfectly without overpowering it.
Commander, how's the taste?

options.content: Excellent! As one would expect from Master Chef Lung Wu!

scripts.say: It's so delicious that I can't help but to beam at Lung Wu and give her a thumbs up.
The taste might be a bit different from what you're used to since it wasn't cooked in the traditional manner. But with such great ingredients, I think it turned out pretty okay!
Now, please try the mussel soup!
Lung Wu ladles a bowl of soup for me, and the aroma of bamboo shoots and mussels immediately wafts up, tickling my nose.
Mmm, I can't wait!
We enjoy the rest of our rustic dinner while listening to the pitter-patter of the rain outside the window.
Fresh ingredients really are the best, aren't they? Next time, I want to invite everyone to try this!
Sounds like a plan!
If the weather's better tomorrow, let's get everyone here together.
Wow, really? That'd be amazing!
I should probably cover the expenses, then...
No worries. If we talk to Akashi and Owari and explain it can be a great opportunity for promotion, I'm sure they'll be able to cover the cost.
Okay! I'll go send out the invites!

sequence:
From Farm to Fork!

<size=45>7 Sharing and Friendship</size>

scripts.say: Just as we hoped, the next day dawns bright and clear with no rainclouds in sight. All our friends have gathered here at Farmlandia.
Commander! The mighty tiger has cooooooome! Ah, shoot! Almost crashed into the well...
What an amazing view... Umm, are you sure we don't have to pay for this...?
Yup. Don't worry about it – it's totally free.
Where's Lung Wu, by the way? Is she already in the kitchen?
That's right. Lung Wu is already busy cooking. She's probably so focused that she hasn't even noticed everyone's arrived...
Honourable Master, please allow Liverpool and me to help Lung Wu. It would also be an opportunity for us to hone our culinary skills...
That's right, Master! We can't let Lung Wu cook for this many people all by herself!
Um, I don't think that's a good idea... It'll be good enough if just I go help her out...
Ya should know how she can get at times. Lung Wu in the kitchen is a whole different person!
Is that so? But Lung Wu normally seems like such a kind soul to me...
Heehee, I don't think she's that scary at all. Let's go together!
Wait, hold on—
Before I can finish, Sirius and Liverpool are already making their way toward the backyard kitchen.
But it doesn't take long for the two to come back utterly defeated. Five minutes, to be exact.
Lung Wu can be so intimidating...
I don't want to set foot in a kitchen ever again!
I've seen how intense Lung Wu can get when she's in her kitchen-crafting mode... But I can't believe even Liverpool couldn't handle it.
I can't do much either.
The kitchen is Lung Wu's domain. There, everyone is the same...
In any case, let's, uh, take a look around Farmlandia until the food is ready!
I picked some tasty fruit on the way here. Let's all enjoy it together!
While we were strolling around Farmlandia, munching on the fruit Ning Hai had picked, Hu Pen caught up to us with good news.
Everyone, it's time to eat!

When we arrive at the table, a colorful and fragrant kaleidoscope of flavors unfolds before us: deep-fried mandarin fish with sweet-and-sour sauce; golden, jiggling steamed egg and clams drizzled with savory sauce; shrimp and tofu stew; fiery peppercorn chicken...
I made a little bit of everything today, to take into consideration everyone's different tastes.
The kind and caring Lung Wu is back!
Please dig in before the food goes cold!
Just one sec! With so many delicious, gorgeous dishes in front of us, you just HAVE to take a picture first!
...Fine, but please make it quick. The food won't be as good if it cools down.
Got it! Everyone, gather 'round! Let's get a quick group photo with all the food!
Miss Lung Wu, please come stand here in the middle along with our Honourable Master!
The girls let me have the center-most spot in the group photo.
Ehehe, look at the camera on the count of three ♪
Everyone, smile☆
Even after taking the group photo, Lung Wu still has that genuine smile on her face.
I'm so glad I got to cook for you and our friends, Commander! It really was so much fun!
She then turns to the crowd of friends gathered around—
It's time to eat, everyone!

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 1: Debut! Light Carrier from the Land of the Rising Sun</size>

scripts.say: The shipgirls are warriors born from the will of humanity, given bodies of steel.
With the power of Wisdom Cubes, the spirits of vessels that fought during the Great War were given human forms.
Now, they aid humanity against their greatest enemies - the Sirens!
Port - Warehouse
The commander, face darkened with dust and grime, is digging through the back of the warehouse in search of rare equipment...
Clang! Bang! Ba-boom!
... but doesn't seem to be having much luck.
Commander looked about ready to collapse underneath the mountain of materials and equipment.
...Watch out!
In a flash of light, talismans flew forth as if cutting through the thick, stagnant air of the warehouse. And then-
They swerved upward, catching the crate of materials that was about to fall onto the commander.
The skies and the seas are crying for help! The people of this land are crying for help! And now, milord, you too are crying for help!
I am the ranger from the Land of the Rising Sun! Light cruiser, Ryuujou, moving out!
... that is all!
She beamed with light, as if she was an anime character making her grand debut.
(But what about the explosion special effects? ... Nevermind, let's forget about it)
Milord! Are you injured? I'm coming to help!
As the secretary ship, I'm doing my best to protect you, Commander!

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 2: Training! Hard work is the tenet of the Sakura Empire!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Training Grounds
Phew... I'm totally beat... I can't even lift my arms anymore...
Haah... haah... I don't think... I can keep going...
We're not done yet. Is this the best that the carriers of the Sakura Fleet can do?
Our seniors are being more strict than usual, eh... Ah, wait, Shoukaku! Wait until afterwards to complain!
Jeez, I didn't even say anything yet...
A-anyway, since we're all worn out and stuff, cut me some slack...
So that's all you can handle, huh? Well then, let's call it a day...
I can still keep going!
Hmm, you can still move? Not bad.
It's just as Kaga said before! This is nothing for a carrier of the Sakura Empire!
Crying and begging are useless on the battlefield! True warriors must work hard and settle things with their skills!
Hehe, as expected of the former First Carrier Division. Such inspirational perseverance! Kaga, let's continue training!
But...
So, the little girl who followed Houshou and us around the seas thinks she has grown up... Well, let us see how much you've improved!
Understood.
Well then! Everyone, let's keep at it! Let's muster our fighting spirits and work harder!
Whaaaat....?!
In the end, everyone got a double dose of training.

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 3: Focus! Don't stop until you've reached your goal!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Warehouse Workshop
At the workshop, two people are inspecting the materials brought back from commissions.
I've just cross-checked with the commission report. The coin and skill book counts are all consistent, and so is the fuel expenditure.
... Want to know something else? Commander used to be an insomniac. Junyou always stayed by their side at night, so she knows~
Good for you. Anyway, next!
Along with the supplies, we've also received a mental unit from Headquarters... The prior year, Commander also took Junyou on a "personal vacation~"
Good for you. Look over this as well.
The number of aviation parts is correct... Ahh... that's right, Commander also promised to marry me after the war ended... I wonder when that'll be...
Mhm. Two more things to look over... I think this commission was a Great Success!
Ahh, I'm so happy! I'll be the first to let Commander know, since I'm the childhood friend and all!
Appreciate it. Wait... isn't that your job in the first place as secretary?
At last, the two of them finished their work.
Hey, Ryuujou? I have a date coming up with Commander~ Where do you think we should go?
I don't recall seeing any plans like that in Milord's schedule. All right, that wraps up today's work.
Junyou, I'll be frank. We're very busy, so we can't have you dragging Commander off to a date.
Tsk... Well, I'll excuse myself then. I suppose you should report to Commander yourself then~
... A date, with Milord...
... I wonder what that would feel like...

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 4: Danger! A Girl's Mysterious Appeal!</size>

scripts.say: Days later - Port
That concludes our exercise. I have no idea why Ryuujou left early all by herself - it's quite unlike her.
So, Ryuujou went missing? How troublesome...
I haven't even seen her today... so I'm not sure I can help...
Since it's around this time, do you think she might have went to the canteen first?
With that said, we took Houshou's advice and headed to the canteen...
When we got there, an unbelievable scene unfolded before our eyes...!
*Om nom nom*... ...Delicious!!
An army marches on its stomach... Ahh, a hearty meal after a tough victory is what life is all about!
It's not as good as the food that Milord cooks for me, but this is still great!
Ahh, it's not satisfying unless I eat until I'm stuffed!! *munch munch*
Ryuujou, please mind your etiquette when eating.
Ryuujou, the food isn't going anywhere. You can afford to slow down.
You wouldn't want Commander to see you like this, would you?
No need to worry about that... Milord will be in the training area for a while longer! *munch munch*
Ah, Commander! Were you looking for Ryuujou?
Oh dear...
M-milord! I apologize deeply for showing you such unsightly behavior!
C-could you p-please f-forgive... waaaaah...!!!
The chopsticks fell from Ryuujou's trembling hands as tears began to stream down her face.
Though everyone was a bit baffled by her exaggerated reaction, they still managed to calm her down with their kind words. It just took them a good half hour.

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 5: Worries! What's going on with me lately?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Dorm
I-I'm still full of regret from letting Milord see such rudeness... what a shameful thing for a ranger...!
Ugh...! This thing has been bugging me for so long now...!
On her day off, the restless Ryuujou was pacing around in her room.
If this keeps up, I won't even be able to do my normal military work, let alone serve as the secretary ship.
Though it was her day off, Ryuujou hadn't stepped outside her room even a single time.
Before she noticed, she had already cleaned the floor three times, spent two hours organizing things, and hid away all the dolls in her room. When all was said and done, the morning was already over.
Aww, I didn't even have a chance to play the game that Ayanami recommended...!
Now that I think about it, I've been a bit off recently...
I-I'm sorry! I forgot the information you told me yesterday...!
You've come, Grey Ghost! As a former member of the First Carrier Division, I will have my vengeance!
(This will be a great opportunity to redeem myself in front of Milord... Come to think of it, where is...)
O-ow!! ..I-I've been hit?! No way!
Illustrious, even though it was me who suggested to go shopping for cute outfits that Milord would like...
N-no matter how you look at it, there's no way I could wear such... breezy clothing...!
Just what in the world is wrong with me...
In order to soothe the worries eating away at her, Ryuujou dug a Manjuu plushie out from the closet she had stuffed it in just hours earlier...
And squeezed it tightly while rolling around in bed for the rest of the day.

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 6: Enemies! The identity of the legendary idol is...?!</size>

scripts.say: I wonder what Milord is doing right now...
Ta-da! Carrier-based aircraft surprise attack!
Haah...
U-um... Ryuujou? Your reaction today was so lame...
Saratoga... I'm not really in the mood for your pranks today, sorry.
Is that so...? Well, Saratoga knows just the thing to cheer you up!
Y-you musn't! You're a carrier of the Eagle Union and I'm...
Even though we're all in the same fleet now, it's not so easy to just open my heart!
But now that I think about it, I heard that you gave tickets to Milord for Lexington's live concert!
As the secretary ship, I can't condone such an egregious attempt to rob Milord of precious working time!
In other words, Saratoga, you're my rival!
I see, I see. You're lovesick.
Eh?
I understand now. In other words, Ryuujou wants to show off her appeal to Commander.
Wha?!
I heard about what happened~ While it may have been a bit of a faux pas, Commander is not so close-minded!
Therefore, instead of canning all your worries inside, why not tell Commander how you really feel?
I-I don't need to do such a thing...
It'll be fineee! Miss Sara wants to see love blossom for everyone~♪
Saratoga...

sequence:
Light Carrier Ryuujou, Moving Out!

<size=45>Chapter 7: Bravery! Commander, I love you!</size>

scripts.say: Academy - Behind the School
After I finished work, Ryuujou called me to meet her behind the school, saying "Milord, I have something important to tell you."
But she's the secretary ship, so why can't she just say it in the office...?
The awkward atmosphere grew thicker.
Uh... uh... um...! Th-thank you for taking time outside your business hours to see me!
A-actually, there is something that's been on my mind for a long time that I've wanted to discuss with you!
Milord, I would like you to make miso soup for me every day!
Ryuujou, blushing from ear to ear, fumbled over her words as she hastily tried to explain what she meant.
A-anyway, ever since you saw me at the cafeteria, I've been worried about that day and night!
So, Saratoga told me that... um... as long as I express my feelings... Milord would surely understand...

To be honest, Saratoga told me "If you confess behind the school building, Commander will slam you into the wall and all your worries will be washed away by the pounding of your hearts," so that's how this ended up happening...
Haah... haah... this kind of stuff... between a man and a woman... I can't deal with it after all...
Even though there was so much that I wanted to shake my head at, her true feelings were undeniable.
Truthfully... I just wanted you to think better of me... so you would turn around and look at me...
That's why... please accept my feelings! Milord, this humble Ryuujou will gladly face any challenge for your sake!
Commander, I love you!
Will you accept my confession...?
Enterprise, I'm sooo bored~ Why don't we go grab Minneapolis and then head to shore for a barbecue?
Saratoga, don't be too relaxed. Our mission isn't to be taken lightly.
Got it, I was just joking~ This air base is really important, isn't it? I may like to play around, but I wouldn't forget that!
Our enemies won't sit by idly while we occupy this place. Our recon planes have already confirmed that the Sakura Fleet is moving.
To make matters worse, Wasp had to head south to resupply. It's up to the two of us to make a difference here.
Come to think of it, I'm fortunate to have only gotten scratches from the last battle... Although if we were there at Savo, perhaps...
Meh, it's not your fault, Enty~ The decision was made by the top brass, wasn't it?
Though I'm upset that Astoria and the others were hurt, just being mad won't accomplish anything... We simply have to do what we have to do.
I know, but...
That's enough for now! Enterprise, I know just how stressed you've been lately~!
The battle isn't over yet. If you don't keep calm, you might make a mistake at a crucial moment. Relax, relax~
You're right... I understand.
Sorry, Sara. I know you're still coping with Lexington, you don't have to worry about me.
It's fine, it's fine! Something like this is a walk in the park for me!
I'm sure that my sister would want me to keep my spirits up and get a punch in for her sake~
You're exactly right, I should learn from your example. I have to get back at the Sakura Fleet for my sister's sake as well.
All righty, that decides it~! So, wanna grab barbecue?
Hah... I suppose I'll take you up on that offer.
Ugh... so this is... all I could do...
I suppose... even in defeat... I was able to be of some use to everyone...
But next time... I definitely won't lose...
Is it over...?
The Sakura ships have begun to withdraw!
Portland, are you all right?
Um... I think so. That was close~
That's good then. Next, we should check in to see how Saratoga is doing-
So in the end, they took out Ryuujou...
Curse them! If only we were there to fight them directly...!
Zuikaku, orders are orders. All we can do is make sure that her sacrifices are not in vain.
By landing a hit on that Grey Ghost, I suppose we've also partially avenged our unreliable seniors. Next, it's our turn to...
Shoukaku, wait! I've just been alerted that Jintsuu's division has been intercepted by the enemy!
What?!
Hehehe~ too naive! Did you think we'd fall for your little decoy?
Saratoga... just what are you doing...
Hehe, let Miss Sara break it down for you~
If the Sakura Fleet plans to retake this island, there surely must also be an accompanying supply line...
But Shoukaku and Zuikaku were nowhere to be found, and neither were Hiei and Kirishima. That could only mean...
I see... there's a separate force escorting the transport fleet...
Bingo~! As expected of my brightest pupil! Miss Sara is very proud of you!
I contacted our allies to search the surrounding waters while Portland and the others tied Ryuujou down.
And with that, I was able to capture their transport ships! If they were using a decoy in the first place, they were bound to be planning something like this.
Impressive. You managed to think that far ahead even while fighting the enemy?
Hehe~ it's fine to praise me more~♪
Having that all said though, Enterprise was the one who drew the enemy's fire and gave us the time to develop this plan...
From this standpoint, you share the same credit for successfully stopping our enemies in their tracks!
Thank you. If that is the case, then these wounds are well-earned.
Don't say that... your injuries are quite severe...
Since the Sakura Fleet has already withdrawn, you should return to port and get some emergency repairs.
Wasp and I will handle the rest, so don't worry!
Sorry for causing you trouble... I'll leave the rest to you then.
Although we managed to win a battle, the war isn't over yet, and the next battle will be even more difficult. We've got to keep our spirits up!
That's right... as long as both sides refuse to budge, this war will continue to rage on...
Ah... looks like the barbecue's going to have to wait. We've found the enemy!
Hardly, consider this a celebratory victory meal. What's the enemy's position?
...to the north!
Well then...
W-wait... the opponent... is a single light carrier? Is that... Ryuujou?
Huh... the direction seems to be correct, but according to the reports, we should be expecting Shoukaku and Zuikaku...
I understand the situation... Portland, can you bring Atlanta and Minneapolis along with you and scout ahead?
Indy, why'd you have to go to the Aleutians... I miss you so much, waah~
Ack! I-I know!
Understood! Leave it to me!
Let's go!
Portland never changes, does she...
What's the harm? I'd be happy if my sister always doted on me! Although... having her around would make it hard for me to play pranks...
Good grief... forget it, I can't picture that happening at all.
Anyway, since the enemy has appeared, let's be sure to give them the old Union-style greeting. Prepare to sortie!
Atlanta, I'm telling you, my cute little Indy-
Hold your horses. Look over there...
I've been expecting you all.
One battleship, one heavy cruiser, one light cruiser, and a few destroyers... are you mocking us?
Hehe, it looks like we have no choice but to demonstrate our power.
That's right!
They're full of killing intent.
Heh, it's nothing compared to my killing intent from being separated from Indy!
Then, let's break our way through here!
We've received warnings of incoming airstrikes from the air base. This must be Ryuujou's attack squadron. Sara, what should we do?
There's no use panicking~ The base's anti-air defenses should be able to hold them at bay. My fighters should be more than enough to clean up.
More importantly, we must focus on locating Shoukaku and Zuikaku with our recon planes... They must be nearby.
You have a point.... Such a direct attack like this makes me think that this is a decoy. Surely... it's not a repeat of that time at the Coral Sea...
Who knows? Maybe they ended up in the same situation as we were in, and were commanded to retreat...
Hmm... I suppose there's no point speculating. But this strategy is undeniably effective.
We have no choice but to defend this island. We can't let them bomb us freely...
But if we overcommit to staving off the airstrikes, we will be vulnerable to attack... And if we are to fall, the entire island will follow suit.
So, we've got to work together to get out of this...
However, considering how many carriers they lost at Midway, they'd use another one as bait?
I'm not sure whether to commend their bravery or their stupidity...
They're trying to catch us off guard, but we won't be had so easily... Wait, what's that?
So they're here. Zuikaku and Shoukaku's air group...
We have no choice... let's get through this!
Haah...
Portland, since we've started the mission, you've looked at Indianapolis's photo 105 times and sighed 115 times...
She's just out on another mission, and that much is enough to send you spiralling down into despair?
But Indy is just thaaat cute! Atlanta, you're also a big sister, right? Don't you also know about the cuteness of little sisters?
Cuteness is of no concern to me. In the first place, one is a dork and the other is a crybaby...
But I suppose I'll admit, they're both cute...
You see? Don't you feel lonely when you can't be with them?
Dunno. I actually like being able to hear myself think when San Diego isn't orbiting around me.
Of course, I'd prefer to be with them, but there's no getting around the fact that everyone has a job to do.
And that job is to protect the home that everyone can reunite to.
Hehe, in order to protect Indy, I won't be harmed by anything! Even if I do get hurt, I'd still claw my way to her side!
If there's one thing I can count on, it's your unhealthy obsession with your sister... Jeez, compared to you, I can't even consider myself a big sister...
Ah... a message from Saratoga...
What does it say?
... Ryuujou is a decoy, and the real attack from Shoukaku and Zuikaku is coming!
What?!
My anti-air capabilities are quite strong, so I'll head back to support Saratoga. Portland, take the others and continue on.
No, Saratoga said that she and Enterprise will be able to handle it, and that your abilities will be needed here.
I see... got it. Let's move forward then!
That girl is...
Why am I so much slower than Hiei and Kirishima even though we're all battleships?
Why does Ryuujou have to act as a decoy anyway?
Arghh... if only Nagato was here...
... Even though she doesn't compare to Indy, what a virtuous little sister!
... And you're going to hold back because of it?
Don't worry! No matter how many cute and virtuous little sisters are out there, the only one that matters in my heart is Indy!
Good grief...
Meanwhile, on the other front...
Enterprise!
Enterprise! Are you okay?!
I'm fine, don't worry about me. I can... *cough* *cough*... keep going!
Unforgivable! Ignoring me to focus all their firepower on Enterprise...!
Heh... after what happened at Midway... if those two are Akagi and Kaga's successors, then their fixation on me is not that unexpected.
Get behind me already, Enterprise! I'll take care of the rest!
Will you be fine on your own?
Heheh, don't you forget! Saratoga is the big senior of the Union carriers!
Just now, my recon planes located Shoukaku and Zuikaku, and more importantly...
*cough* What is it?
Heheh~ I'll tell you in just a moment~
Every time you laugh like that, someone always finds themselves on the receiving end of one of your nasty pranks...
Thaaat's right~ I'll make sure they regret picking a fight with Miss Sara!
Haah... I wonder what Indy is doing right now~
I wonder if she's eating and sleeping well, and brushing her teeth on time every day~
Ah! What if she's getting bullied because she's the quiet type?!
You're worrying too much... For how much you dote on her, you really ought to believe in her a bit more. She's not that weak, you know.
Ahh!! Does that mean she's grown up enough to fly away on her own? Indy, don't leave meee! Stay with your big sister forever~!
That's not even what I said... Ah, forget it. Every time I'm around you, I can't seem to stay serious... Portland, do you not get nervous at all?
Nervous? Sure I am. It's extremely important for us to maintain control of this strategic naval route. Even I understand that much.
Only by controlling this island and its surrounding waters can we ensure the safety of our supply lines and the establishment of our forward operating base.
We can't let this place fall no matter what, so of course I am nervous.
Words of such logic and clarity are flowing from Portland's mouth... pinch me...
But! In the face of my love for Indy, such nervousness is nothing more than dust in the wind!
Sigh... I thought you'd say that sooner or later...
Hehehe, my love for Indy is boundless!
Yes, yes. Boundless indeed. Let's keep moving forward - we're already approaching our target.
So, you've finally come.
You've already called back all your planes in preparation for our attack...
Hey, you know that you've been left for dead, right? And despite knowing that you're a decoy, you still have the will to fight?
Do you think you can shake my resolve with those words? Laughable. I knew about this long ago.
If my sacrifice can bring victory to all my comrades, I will gladly go through hell for their sake!
... So this is the determination of the Sakura Empire.
Hmph! What's so impressive about that? If it's for Indy's sake, I would gladly set this entire world on fire!
... Can it, Portland...
I heard that the Union was a country of weaklings, but it seems that there are those who have true resolve.
...Wait, why are you two suddenly bonding over this?!
But!
Even if I am abandoned, you will find that I am not so easily beaten!
Listen up, warriors from the land of the free! I am Ryuujou, a ranger from the land of the rising sun!
You'll have to beat me first before you can call me a decoy!
Virtuous dragons, devour the enemies before us! Advance!
Oh yeah, it's all coming together! Really feeling like I could take on the world right now! Thanks for everything, Commander!
Y'know, I've been thinkin' it's time to get everyone together and throw the most hype party ever!
Buuut... Feels like we're not 100% done, y'know? Like we've still got some potential left in me to wring out.
So let's put that party to end all parties on hold for now and just have ourselves a medium-sized one instead.
I'll do the prep, and you go give that Fate Simulation thing a look, Commander!
Hahaha! I knew you could do it, Commander! Thanks to you, I'm stronger than I ever imagined I could be!
Let's split a cola to commemorate this moment!
But it doesn't end here. We've got so much more to do, so much more to overcome.
I'll keep using my huge guns to blow your enemies to pieces. Let's do it, you and me together, yeah?
Anchorage... feels full of power...! Teacher... thank you so much...!
With this new power... I'll protect you... my friends... and everyone else!
Don't be scared... of the bad guys... Teacher, there's nothing to be afraid of...
Anchorage will... protect everyone... It's a promise, Teacher!
Anchorage.. and Teacher... will always be together...!
Oooh... Cursed power wells within me! It tastes even sweeter than blood.
Heheh! You've done well, my dear servant!
I've decided to give you an opportunity to exercise a rare privilege.
Make any request, and I will see it granted. Heheh, think carefully about it.
Hmm... Yeah, I'm feeling a little more awake now.
I'm ready to sortie for you any time. Even if I need a nap... I'll do my best to stay awake for you, Commander.
With this power and resolve, I should be able to stay with you longer... *yawn*...
But when we win... you'll have to let me take a nap...
It looks like we've finally finished the first chapter of our journey. I'll be counting on you a lot more moving forward. All right, Commander?
Did you think it was already over? We are still just beginning our new journey~
Hee hee. Does hearing that make you disappointed? Or maybe, excited?
By the way, I'm a bit excited too. So, let's write the next chapter of our story together~♪
Commander, I want to express my gratitude for the determination and dedication you've shown to me thus far.
Thinking back, I've realized that, all along, you were the person who offered me hope and gave meaning to my life.
I'm growing powerful to the point where I, too, may live up to your expectations.
To summarize my thoughts... I will never forget all that you've done for me. I also wish to say... thank you.
The war still hasn't ended, though. Are you willing to accompany me once more into the unknown, Commander?
Meeeooow! I'm so full of energy!
It's all thanks to our perfect and indestructible bond that we've come this far!
There's still stuff we've gotta do, but whatever life throws at us, we'll overcome it together! Right?
No need to answer, I already know what you wanna say! Let's keep doing our best! Now come here, Owner! Glomp! Cuddle~♡
Hehehe. Somehow, this feels even more satisfying than finding treasure...
It's all thanks to you that we'll be able to partake in more exciting adventures!
Okay, it's time to set sail! Hurry up, there's no time to waste!
Let us keep searching for greater treasures while enjoying our majestic voyage together!
Rejoice, Commander, for I have become stronger, just as you desired.
My main cannons stand ready. Do you have any instructions for me?
Hmm? My cannons won't be needed...? What would you have me do instead then? Just know that there is nothing I wouldn't do for your sake.
Yes, Commander, please be uplifted and rejoice.
Milord, you've already done so much for me up to this point...
I've now become a worthy vessel who will not fall short of anyone else, but...
I feel that... I can still become stronger.
If you can help me push beyond my current limits, I'll be sure to be of even greater use to you.
Therefore, Milord, would you continue to support me?
Hmph, it just dawned on me that we've known each other for such a long time.
All the while, you've steadily gotten more reliable. And it's thanks to you that my blade is so mighty.
However, there's power within both me and my blade which we've yet to unlock.
Commander, won't you join me so we can explore our new limits?
Mmhmm, I've come a long way since our first meeting. I owe it all to you, Commander.
I can now easily handle any task given to me, whether battle or commission.
But, I want to become stronger and do more for everyone's sake.
That is a goal that I cannot achieve alone...
Commander... Will you continue to guide me as I embark upon this Fate Simulation?
Thank you, Commander. I owe you so much after all you've done for me.~
I'm both honored and delighted that you've been with me on every step of this journey.
Now a new journey beckons us... I hope you'll accompany me on this one, too.
As long as you're happy with me, I will remain by your side, through thick and thin.
So this is my new power, huh? Not bad, Commander.
Hmm. Allow me to offer you my praise first – as deserved of the person I have chosen to walk by my side.
No matter what trials and tribulations await us in the future, there is no obstacle that I, Hakuryuu, cannot overcome!
Now then, Commander, allow me to show you what it truly means to trample our enemies underfoot!
Know that none may stand in our way!
Aha, so this is how you make me stronger.
However, because my power grows, it's only natural that your offerings to the Dragon God double as well.
To receive, you have to give. Surely you understand this principle, Commander?
What I'm saying is... Offer the Dragon God more snacks, and make the contents of the snacks better!
I can finally, fully control my powers!
There's no need for me to hold back anymore in future battles.
“Releasing anchors... Even in the most perilous of battles, I'll keep you safe.
I hope you're as excited for our future together as I am.
Commander, I must thank you for giving me the chance to see the many interesting sights of this world.
However... I still want more. There's something I've always been after... Something that can fill the void in my heart...
The longer I go without it, the more things I must stuff inside the void to make do... But they aren't enough, not even close...
Commander, could you help me to finally fill this void forever? You're not going to just decline, are you?
And thus concludes another movement of our grand symphony, my child.
As of this moment, the numerous melodies of the past – joyous and sorrowful, resolute and bewildered – all fall silent.
But, the opus we are about to perform is even more exhilarating than what came before.
Carry out my Fate Simulation, my child. Assist me in properly tuning myself to play this new score.
All of the hard work you've put in merits praise. You've done well, Commander.
There's no need to be so flustered. If you've done something that's praiseworthy, it's only right that you're praised for it. Wouldn't you agree?
...Ahem. No need to tarry any longer than we need to.
Here. Have a cup of coffee, and let's keep up the good work. All of the praise and glory in the world await us.
I see the plan came to fruition, step by step. Exactly as forethought.
However, our journey is long, and far from over. We must march onward.
Do not be discouraged. I will continue my duties as your assistant.
You've given me new strength. I will use it to make your dream a reality.
Strength means victory, conquest, and control.
You do not have the faintest chance of subjugating me. Your struggling serves but one purpose – to amuse me.
However, there still remains one thing to be dealt with before I decisively dominate, subdue, and defeat you.
Yes – our shared enemy. These meddlesome beings will understand what it means to face the Unhulde. Hehehehe...
Huh? What's your deal? Oh, did you finally realize how great I am? See, you can't do a thing without me after all~
What? It's because I begged you for this...? H-hmph! Not my problem! You were the one who signed off on it!
And besides, given how strong and capable I am... it's only natural that I look after pitiful little you, right?
S-so hurry up and admit that you belong to me already! Otherwise I'm not gonna do everything you want me to!
Oh, is this how you plan to seduce me? I suppose I must commend you for sensibility~♪
(At long last... Is the Commander finally going to take me? Ahaha...) Hmm? What's on my mind right now, you ask? ...Ahem, well, um, that's nothing you need to concern yourself over!
In any case, the fact that you'd convey your feelings to me in such a manner means that you're deeply smitten with me, no?
Heehee. There's no point trying to deny it. It's too late to try to pull out now, Com~man~der~♪
There's not a thing in the world better than that feeling of getting stronger! Don't you agree, Commander?
Damn straight! Since I'm in such a good mood today, let's go out and eat to our hearts' content! My treat!
While we're at it, I wanna knock down some of the good stuff! C'mon, it'd be a shame not to celebrate such a fine day!
Anyway, I promise to protect you matter what from now on out! If you're gonna make me stronger, you'd better rely on me more and more!
What, are you simply going to watch while I grow stronger? You should remember I could usurp you.
I'd never try to steal your position, you say? Heheheh! Oh, you really are a curious individual.
I've reached a magnificent conclusion! I, as a matter of fact, need your support, your ambition, to realize my goals!
Greater power begets greater ambitions. So let us embark together and accomplish ever greater feats!
Aaand, verified! I just devised a new formula for evolution.
Behold your new super honor student Vittorio Cuniberti, who can solve any problem, meow!
Ahem! Whether it be combat or academics, I'll find the optimal solution to make you happy.
I just... hope this helps solve the puzzle of love...
I see... After experiencing it for myself, I finally understand this "Fate Simulation" system.
Significantly improved equipment efficiency and adaptability, better information processing when combatting enemies.
Having that said, feelings are subjective, and no substitute for empirical data from field tests.
Now then, shall we go on a sortie? Surely you don't mind if I explore this system inside out, right? Hehehe~♪
Yoohoo! It's me, Dmitri Donskoi, now stronger and more popular than ever~
Hehe, now that I've powered up, what kind of reward do you have for me?
In return, I'll make you a promise – no matter what difficulties are ahead of us, I'll be right there with you!
As long as I'm around, your life will be happy and problem-free! Let's keep charging forward together!
I thank you sincerely for your guidance, Commander. Because of you, I have gained the power to overcome any tribulation.
But even now, I feel that my path continues further onward, beckoning me to even greater power...
... Surely, this is a gift from God.
If I could receive that blessing, then I would be able to serve you even better.
Now, let us walk forward on this new path.
The fruits have ripened, and the time has come. Yonder bird continues to soar higher and higher.
All this, the culmination of thy endeavors.
For thy brilliance, thy warmth, thy affection—I shall watch over, as I do serve.
The path ahead of Champagne and the Commander, stretches forth for eternity.
This, I swear upon my will... and my base desires.
The simple bard who chronicles the Champion's epic is now under the very Champion's protection...
Such a marvelous turn of events deserves an entire chapter of praise and adulation~
As long as you continue to move forward, my Champion, I will always remain by your side. Let us weave our tale into the annals of history, together.
After all, this paean now sings the story of a Champion and bard's journey together.
That I've overcome this trial is solely thanks to you, Commander.
A knight's path is long and treacherous. You are the only person I consider worthy to guide my way.
As long as you are by my side, I can face any trial, tribulation, or hardship.
Now and forever... as your knight, I vow to protect you to the bitter end.
Attention: parameters of Gascogne's current abilities have reached their maximum values. Emotion and combat capabilities have been fully unlocked.
Searching memory database for "gestures of appreciation" recorded among fellow fleet members.
Result: a "hug" is deemed most appropriate.
I-I hope... this is to your liking, Master...
Attention: Gascogne's abilities can be further improved through the process of Fate Simulation.
Requesting Master's continued assistance in improvement of Gascogne's abilities.
Ah, this warmth... This power will allow me to execute Your orders more impeccably.
What? You want me to feel free of all constraints and simply do what I want to do?
So You say, but the thing I want most is to serve You in perpetuity, always by Your side...
I beseech You, please grant this request of mine.

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>1 Lützow the Undersleeper</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Reviewing today's schedule inside my head, I open the door to my office.
What I see on the other side leaves me dumbstruck and frozen in place.
Lützow always sleeps in and only shows up at the last minute – yet, today, she's sitting upright in the chair, looking out the window with distant eyes.
Lützow? How come you're here so early?
Only when I call out to her does she notice my presence. She turns around and gives me a weak smile.
Oh. G'morning, Commander... *sigh*...
(A sigh. Something must be on her mind.)
You okay?
*yaaawn*... Eh, truth be told, I didn't get much sleep last night.
You, of all people, undersleeping?
Hard to believe, I know. Even I'm surprised.
I typically doze off as soon as I shut my eyes. Insomnia? Never heard of her.
Not even a bad time or place can stop me from sleeping. And yet, something did this time.
Maybe you're ill? Have you been to the infirmary?
Seeing how worn-out she looks, I can't help but worry. I place my hand on her forehead to check her temperature.
Doesn't feel like you have a fever. Still, you should go in for a check with Perseus, just to be sure.
It's fine. I already went. They said I'm not sick, and even they had no good guesses as to what kept me up.
Anyhow, since I'm here, how about putting me to work?
In your current state?
Although she's showing initiative for once, I can't make her do work when she's clearly beat.
Heheh. That's an interesting look you're making.
Let me guess – you like it when I work hard, don'tcha?
You'll have to do some work before you can claim to be a hard worker.
Wow, talk about strict. Fine, let me at it already.
Although, my head's still spinning and I'm struggling to remember what a secretary's supposed to do.
Which is to say – precise orders, please.
Are you sure you're up to the task?
Hmm... Only one way to find out, methinks.
She picks up some random paperwork and slowly starts flipping through the pages.
Better this than just sitting on my butt like usual, right?
Besides, hanging around you is more calming than rolling around in bed like some kind of sausage.
Why are you curbing my enthusiasm now anyway when I for once have the urge to work?
You know what you should do? You should stop worrying and tell me what to do.
If you don't, I'm feeding all these papers to the shredder.
And what work will there be left to do if you turn it all into ribbons, pray tell?
It was just a joke. So, what're you gonna have me do?
I'd appreciate it if you could quickly sort my documents according to priority and deadline.
Make me a cup of coffee, thanks. Double espresso.
You got it. Them's the orders, and the orders I will gladly fulfill.
Just don't overwork yourself. Tell me right away if you feel ill.
Yeah, yeah, I know. Silly worrywart.
Despite her grumbling, she looks at me with her same old smile.
It's a load off my back to see she's recovering her energy.
(That said, I can't relax just yet. I'll keep an eye on her to see how she fares.)

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>2 Lützow the Lightheaded</size>

scripts.say: Sometime later...
Done with these documents. I'll just leave 'em here.
Man... The office sure looks blurry all of a sudden...
Also kinda... wobbly...
All of a sudden, Lützow starts to stagger. She looks like she's going to collapse, documents still in her hands.
She worked hard to sort those papers. She'll have to do it all over again if they scatter everywhere...
No, what am I thinking? Catching her is obviously way more important!
Careful!
I extend an arm to support her at once, only for her to still fall – into my arms.
*yawn*... Thanks, Commander. Quick reflexes you got...
You've been watching me this whole time, haven't you?
In spite of her weariness, she gives me her typical listless yet mischievous smile.
I can't let you work like this. First of all, we have to solve your sleeping problem.
C'mooon, I'm fine...
Don't try to pretend like you're not exhausted.
Taking my words to heart, she pauses for a moment to think.
Heh. It's really hard to argue with that super-serious look in your eyes.
Alright, alright. I'll do what you say.
What's your plan, then? For fixing this sleeping problem of mine.

options.content: Might I suggest a cup of hot chocolate?
Lying on the couch would be a good start.

scripts.say: Well, I'm not about to say no to some hot choccy...
But you don't REALLY think hot chocolate is the magic cure to insomnia, do you?
Not at all. It's just for calming your nerves.
Here. Come lie on the couch.
Don't mind if I do.
But surely you don't think I just need to lie down and I'll be on the express to dreamland, right?
I know, just do it. I'll put on some hot chocolate for you. We'll think of a solution together.
Wow... You're being extra nice today.
She casually twirls the end of her hair, then gently taps on my chest with her fingers.
*yaaawn*... You're treating me like a princess here. It's actually kinda making me feel embarrassed...
Well, embarrassed, but I'm also so dizzy I can't move...
Seems we have no choice – you'll just have to CARRY me like a princess over to the couch!

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>3 The Cure for Insomnia</size>

scripts.say: After carrying Lützow to the couch and putting on some hot chocolate, it's time to dive into the question of her sleeping problem.
What's causing it? Yeah, I'd like to know, myself.
She lies on her side on the couch, looking like a cat basking in the sun.
Between sips from her cup of hot chocolate, she lazily carries on the conversation.
Hey, how about you tell me a story? Who knows – it might help me fall asleep.
Are my stories really so boring they literally put you to sleep?
No, no, I didn't mean it like that!
I'm saying your voice is soothing, so hearing it makes me sleepy.
If that's true, wouldn't you have been sleepy while we were working earlier?
Oh, right. Guess that's not gonna work.
Ugh. All I want is to sleep like a baby like I normally do...
While her tone of voice is the same as it's always been, her eyes are dull with the color of exhaustion.
Normally? Wait, that's it! This isn't normal. That's why you can't sleep.
Your sleep schedule has been turned on its head because you sleep during the day, which makes you wide-awake at night.
*yaaawn*... There's a kernel of truth to that, but it doesn't explain why I'm struggling to sleep now when I never have been before this.
Something, something, it's finally caught up to you. At any rate, try not to sleep during the day after this.
The more you do it, the harder it will be for your body to readjust.
Fiiine. I guess I SHOULDN'T try to sleep now, then.
Wait... So do I have to keep my eyes open and stare at you until night comes?
Guess that's actually not so bad. Can't sleep, and I'm in no state to work either, so I'll busy myself with watching you do your thing.
I said "after this." In other words, not starting today.
On another note, how about we go out and get some sunlight?
Sunlight inhibits the production of melatonin – the thing that makes you sleepy. It'll also help realign your circadian rhythm.
Appreciate the biology lesson and all, but does that apply to a shipgirl?
If nothing else, we can just go for a walk. A bit of mild exercise might help make you sleepy.
I mean, true, but I'm drained...
I don't imagine it's very nice to walk with someone who has zero energy.
There's also the chance I'll almost pass out like I did earlier...
I'll faceplant the pavement! And you'll leave me behind!
Relax. I won't let you pass out, and I'm definitely not going to leave you behind.
Also, it being "nice" or not isn't important here. This is your well-being we're talking about.
If you really do pass out, I'll carry you back to the infirmary. And yes, like a princess.
Hearing those words dispels her doubt and lights her cheeks a faint tinge of red.
There is one risk, I'll admit – that people will misconstrue it as the port's foremost slacker finally doing the unimaginable and falling asleep in the middle of the street.
Hmph. I don't like the label "slacker." I'm simply someone who saves her energy for when it hits the fan so I can tackle it head on.
I wouldn't call it "sleeping," I'd call it "strategic rest."
I'm a real heavyweight when I get serious, I'll have you know!
If you say so, slugger. So, do you wanna go outside or not?
Hmm. Lemme think about it for a minute.

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>4 Along the Green Road</size>

scripts.say: Port - Park
Sunlight rains down on us through the leaves overhead, casting hazy shadows on the ground.
As I walk with Lützow without any particular place in mind, the early afternoon breeze whispers a tune that makes me feel vaguely tired.
Whew... This sunlight is divine. I picked a good spot – to nobody's surprise!
I usually only come here to skip work and stuff. Taking a walk through here is pretty nice.
With a comfortable sigh, she stretches her arms skyward.
Well? Feeling tired yet?
Meh. Although I'm not feeling dizzy anymore thanks to this fresh air.
Our walk continues. A short while later, I feel a tug on my sleeve.
Hey, uh, Commander...
I'm not a burden to you, am I?
You mean with regard to today's work?
No, it's no big deal. I can make up for lost time with some elbow grease when I get back later.
I don't mean just today... You know how much I slack off. Working is basically the exception, not the rule for me.
So, you know... I'm just worried that I'm more trouble than I'm worth because I'm so lazy.
Ah. So that's what's on your mind.
Yes, you do skip out on work quite a lot – but when you get the drive, you get things done.
That laid-back, do-it-my-way attitude is what I like about you.
You mean it? You actually view my laziness in a positive light?
Not to say I'm not happy to hear it, but you sure have a unique taste in girls.
Should I take that as a compliment?
The best compliment I can muster with my lack of energy, I guess.
She lets out a yawn and brushes off the tears of tiredness welling in the corners of her eyes.
Tired now? We can head back if so.
Nah. Let's walk and talk a li'l longer.
I've got an idea – you should tell me something.
The mood here is just so relaxing, so hearing your voice might just be the push that gets me to doze off.
Hmm. Alright, I've got one.

options.content: I was trying to haggle at a store, and then...
I did overtime, which resulted in me getting more work, and then...

scripts.say: Wow... That sounds like a super boring story. Bet it'll give me nightmares!
You know what? I'll tell YOU something instead.
About the coolest dream I've had in recent memory.
Sure. Let's hear it.
Heheh. So, in the dream, you were a big seal. You were swimming through the sea, all carefree.
And guess what? I was a shark.
I chased after you, and I was right behind you the whooole time.
Basically, you were gunning for dinner, am I right?
Hey, lemme finish. Heheh.
Wouldn't you know it – you and I were just marveling at the sea all around us as we went.
Oh, also, you were sooo cute as a seal!
The rays of the setting sun embrace us gently as always.
It feels like time has stopped as I look at her, relaxing without a care in the world.

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>5 Back at Home</size>

scripts.say: Port - Lützow's Quarters
The sun has set, night has come, and I'm back at Lützow's home to see her off.
Ahh... This was an exceptionally relaxing and fulfilling day.
I really thought we'd wrap it up after just a walk – then we went to the city and played the claw machine together.
You even showed me how surprisingly good you are at nabbing those plushies.
She gestures toward the spoils – the two plastic bags she just put on the floor, stuffed with stuffed animals.
Oh, right, check this seal plushie out.
See that? Doesn't it look just like you?
Did you get that plushie just because of that dream you had?
Moreover – and I've been wondering this the whole time – how am I like a seal?
Just in terms of looks. Vaguely. You're also both gentle and lovable.
She holds the plushie in front of her again, as if to lend weight to her argument.
I think you should have it.
Hug it when you go to sleep and you might even dream of the sea just like me.
Hmm. Then it's only fair that I give you something, too.
I excavate a pillow from under the pile of stuffed animals.
It's a shark pillow, looking like it's soundly asleep.
Whoa! When did you get that? I'm pretty sure that wasn't in any of the claw machines we played.
I got it while you went off to exchange for tokens.
Then I hid it under the other plushies so I could surprise you.
Aww, you're so sweet. Thanks.
She stuffs the stuffed seal into my arms, then with joy accepts my shark pillow.
Rubbing her cheek against its fluffy surface, she gently runs her finger along its sleepy eyes.
A soft little shark that likes to sleep... That's kinda like me.
*yaaawn*... You know what? This sleep talk has actually made me eepy for realsies.
I could fetch some stuff that'll turbocharge your urge to sleep. Want me to do that?
Sure. Thanks a bunch.
A cup of hot chocolate, some sleep-promoting scented candles, a speaker playing white noise...
Yep, that should be everything.
After confirming all is in order, I quietly open the door to her bedroom.
Lüt–
Alas, there she is – in bed, eyes already closed, softly snoring.
And hugging her shark pillow with a small smile on her face.
(All that prep was for nothing, but that's fine. She finally managed to fall asleep. I'll just stay a little while longer.)
(Ah, wait, I should go and fetch my unfinished work.)
Without making a sound, I leave her bedroom and walk out of her home.

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>6 Night Watch</size>

scripts.say: Port - Lützow's Bedroom
Lützow seemed to be sleeping like a log – until she opened her eyes.
Dang. That didn't work...
I had to pretend to be asleep so the Commander wouldn't worry over nothing.
Hmm. Maybe I have to try a little harder.
After their midday stroll and some effort on her part, she finally began to drift off.
In her half-awake state, she could swear she heard the door quietly open.
It felt like a familiar figure snuggled up beside her, but maybe that was just a figment of her tired mind.
She opened her eyes once more.
*sigh*... Figures. Like that would happen.
That had to be a dream... The Commander's already left.
Man... Maybe I should've asked the Commander to stay with me instead of pretending to be asleep.
It'd sure beat being alone right now...
As she daydreamed with the shark pillow in her arms, she suddenly realized there was light peeking through the crack in the door.
Huh? Why's the light on?
With curiosity and a tinge of hope in her heart, she got up and left her bedroom.
As soon as she opened the door, her mouth was left agape at the sight before her.
(C-Commander?)
Indeed – there was the Commander, head resting on the table, illuminated by the soft glow of a desk lamp and surrounded by a pile of paperwork.
Although a dash of fatigue could be seen on that usually-clear expression, Lützow felt strangely at ease.
(So I wasn't just dreaming...)
(You were worried I still couldn't sleep, so you brought your paperwork here and stood at the ready...)
(All those papers... It's my insomnia's fault that the work has piled up like this.)
Hmm... Looks like it's my turn to take care of you. Heheh.
She took her napping blanket from her couch and placed it on the Commander.
Then, carefully, so as to not make any noise, she grabbed the unfinished documents and began working on them.
I gotta make myself look good once in a while – can't be lazy all the time. I'll do these for you.
Under the light cast by the desk lamp, Lützow smiled a small smile that even she wasn't aware of.

sequence:
Sweet Dreams, Come Back to Me

<size=45>7 Good Night, Lützow</size>

scripts.say: Port - Lützow's Quarters
As I awake from my slumber, it takes me a hot second to grasp where I am.
Ahah! Good evening, Commander.
I got all your papers done. You can go back to sleep if you wanna.
The lamp on her desk paints her in a soft, orange glow.
Evening... Wait, why aren't you asleep?
Ah, did the light keep you up because I forgot to turn it off? Sorry about that.
Nuh-uh, nothing like that. I was just pretending to be asleep.
You were pretending?
Yup. You spent the whole day trying to fix my insomnia, and I didn't want you to leave thinking that you failed.
But hey, let's forget about that. I'm not tired anyway, so I might as well help with your papers, right?
Besides, this is what a secretary's supposed to do to begin with. Sorry for making you work overtime.
It's alright.
I should be saying sorry. I mean, I fell asleep before you after trying to help with your sleeping problem...
*grumble*...
Our stomachs both grumble at the same time.
Ahaha. Sounds like someone's hungry.
Makes sense. I went straight to bed when I got home, and I assume you haven't eaten anything either, right?
Nope. I went to get my paperwork as soon as I saw that you'd gone to sleep.
And after that, I just started chipping away at these.
That's two of us who've gone without dinner, then.
There's stuff in the kitchen. I'll make us something to eat.
You can't sleep on an empty stomach, and a snack might be just the thing to make you tired.
Alright, then I'll help with–
No, you can rest in your room and wait. You already worked through so many of these papers for me.
I also need to pay you back for the blanket.
By the time the food is done and I return, I find Lützow is already asleep on the couch, wrapped under her blanket.
She looks so at rest, her eyelashes moving faintly in rhythm to her breathing.
(Looks like she's getting her beauty sleep – for real this time.)
Good night, Lützow.
Port - Lützow's Quarters
Light crept through the curtains, painting thin shadows on the floor.
Lützow slowly opened her eyes. She then realized that she was in her bed, under bedsheets as opposed to her blanket.
Mmh... Wait, when'd I move to the bed?
Pretty sure I fell asleep on the couch...
A glass of still-slightly-warm milk stood on the table beside her bed.
On the glass, there was a post-it note attached.
"I've rescheduled your work for today. You can come in later. Remember to drink your milk."
Unbeknownst even to herself, her lips curved into a tender smile.
*sigh*... Well, you're the boss...
Back to sleep I go!
After downing the whole glass of milk, she tightly hugged her shark pillow and dove in under the sheets.
I'll come to help when I wake up. I promise I won't slack off this time...
Saying a warm promise under her breath, she once again drifted off into a comfortable slumber.
Her insomnia was finally cured thanks to the Commander's kind and snuggly efforts.
As to the cause of it, who can say...
Perhaps this bout of restlessness came from a place of love – a place even she can't describe with words.

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>1 Guess Who!</size>

scripts.say: It was a sunny day. The port was enveloped in a pleasant warmth.
*yawn*... Man, I always get so sleepy when it's warm. Almost makes me wanna go tan.
Especially when I've got nothing else to do... Hang on, is that the commander? All alone in here?
Well, well... I just found the cure to my boredom!
Heyo, Commander! Guess who!
Someone approached me from behind and covered my eyes with her hands, then prompted me to guess her name.
C'mon, timer's ticking away. Get it right, and you might just win a prize, or whatevs!
...Richmond? Er-err, wrong. You're not completely off the mark, though!
San Diego? No. Hint: I'm not a redhead. 5 seconds left to get it right! 4... 3... 2... 1... Sorry, time's up!
The disappointment is real. How come you don't remember the trendiest girl in port? That's, like, punishable in my book.
Marblehead pouted at me, then softly poked my left hand with her index finger.
So, I hereby sentence you to a manicure, performed by me, personally!
Memphis might be the queen of nails, but I can still do a solid job. Now gimme your hand, and we'll get those nails lookin' worthy of a Juustagram header.
...You've got paperwork to do? Should've thought about that before you forgot my name, sweetie!
She grabbed my hand, but then suddenly paused as though her train of thought just changed tracks.
Tell you what! If a manicure's too much, why don't we instead go outside for like, a short walk?
...You've gotta plan something important? All the more reason to get some fresh air!
C'mon. You won't get any work done by staying glued to your desk. A quick breather will do you good!
She was very insistent on this, so I yielded and agreed to go outside with her.

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>2 Smile for the Camera</size>

scripts.say: Right as we set foot outdoors, I was greeted by the sun's warming light, contrasted by cooling breezes of wind. It felt wonderful.
Whew! While we're blowing away them cobwebs anyhoo, we might as well get something done. Question is: what?
...Oh! Here comes the answer! Wassup?
Marblehead? And the commander, too. Good evening. What are you two up to?
Like, nothing, pretty much. What about you?
Just enjoying a stroll on my day off, taking some photos of the occasional picturesque places at port. Nothing much.
Niiice. Speakin' of photos, I've got just the perfect subject for you.
And what would that be?
Not what, but whom! Me and the commander here! Eyes ahead and give the camera a big smile, Commander!
I should've figured... Sure, I suppose. Just stand close to each other, and I'll snap a picture.
You heard the camerawoman! C'mon then, next to me. Ready? Say cheese!
The shutter clicked with a quaint sound. Moments later, the camera began producing a photograph.
We're lucky I brought my instant camera today. Just give it a minute while the picture develops.
Memphis flapped the forming photo through the air to speed the process up. After that was done, she handed it to Marblehead.
Sweet! Now to fancy it up a li'l with some cutesy symbols! Got a marker pen, Commander?
Cool, thanks. Just gimme a sec... There! Whaddya think? Doesn't it look real nice?
Marblehead drew on a myriad of ribbons, stars, and other decor. They added a strangely endearing quality to the photo.
I really like how this one came out. It's totes getting a slot in my photo album.
Anyhoo, feeling like you cleared your head, Commander? Good. I've gotta run now, but I'll catch you later! And don't forget my name next time!
Wait, before you go– And she's off already... If I were you, Commander, I'd feel like I'd almost just been manipulated.
Although, I suppose her dragging you out of the office did give you a warranted break.
Indeed it did. That day, Marblehead taught me the benefits of stopping to take a breather.

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>3 Girl Talk</size>

scripts.say: Later - Port Canteen
Heya, Marblehead. Been hearing you and the commander snapped a group photo. What's that all about?
Word gets around quick, huh? I've got it right here. Came out real good, if I say so myself!
Lemme have a look... Huh, it's a lot tamer than I expected. I figured you'd be kissing or something.
Puh-lease. You take me for a girl who forces herself onto the commander? If it's not solicited, I'm not doing it.
Plenty of girls here who do just that, though? If you wanna hit it up with the commander, you gotta get physical.
Deadass? Memphis, you reckon I'm being too passive?
I wouldn't know. What I can tell you is the commander did appreciate being taken outside for a brief break.
Wait, what?! Legit surprised right now. Here I thought I'd just gotten in the commander's way!
Hmm... Maybe this all means the commander likes girls who take the lead. I'm gonna need to do some asking around.
Well, based on my experience, sudden hugs are a no-go. Seen some girls wrap their arm around the commander's when they're going for a stroll, though.
This is probably my inner shy girl speaking, but that's like, way outta my comfort zone. The arm-wrapping thing, I mean.
Anyway, I'll come up with something and make a real advance next time.
Good luck with that. I'll be rooting for you, I guess. From the sidelines.
Thanks, "I guess"...
Still, I'll take all the positive energy I can get. Here's hoping I'll get the chance to take the commander along again sometime soon.
I had overheard most of the girls' conversation from a few tables away. I wasn't sure what to make of it...

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>4 Sweet Tooth</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy
Oh, Marblehead! Come here for a sec! I've got something for you!
Sup, Omaha? Whatcha got– Oh my god! How much damn chocolate is this?!
A lot! I've been stockpiling it for a long time. Thing is, though... I'm gonna go on a diet.
I feel soooo bad about parting ways with my sweet sweeties, but it's a necessary sacrifice to lose weight. So I'm giving it all to you!
Again? You gave in once before, last I remember. You sure you wanna give it all away?
This time, I'm gonna stick to it! Look, just take it, I won't eat it anyway!
Yeah, but– Welp, Omaha's left the building. Guess this chocolate's mine now. But I can't eat it all either, so I should probs give some to Concord.
...Oh! Commander! Over here!
As I was passing by, Marblehead called out to me.
...Wait, crap, I ruined my chance to do another "Guess who"!
Really? Aight. All's good as long as you remember me. Anyhoo, as I was saying, you see this mound of chocolate?
I love choccy as much as the next girl, but this? It's just too much to eat alone. So, wanna have some?
Whew... I'm stuffed. My tongue's totes coated in chocolate.
Premium chocolate, at that. Omaha do be living up to her name as a chocolate gourmand.
Oh yeah, forgot to ask before we started chowing down: why're you out and about today, Commander?
"No reason in particular. I was just on a walk to the beach, and that's when I ran into you."
Ah, I see! Then mind if I join you? Hell, why not make a date out of it?
...Kinda sudden? Yeah, but we've gotta burn some of those calories we just gorged ourselves on.
So like, please? Can we take a stroll together, then go on a little date?
She was being pushy again, but it didn't bother me much – it's fun hanging with her, so ultimately, I agreed to it.

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>5 Seashells by the Seashore</size>

scripts.say: Taken by an urge to listen to the sound of the sea, I brought Marblehead to the beachside.
Check it out, Commander! The beach is littered with all these colorful seashells!
Most of the seashells washing up on this shore come in stunning shades of pink. Cute, right?
Speaking of which, I just found a real banger! And guess what? I'm gonna gift it to you!
She handed me a seashell with an exquisite shape. I put it to my ear and listened to the sound coming from inside.
Whatcha doing?
...Listening to the sound inside? Ah, I getcha. The technical term for it is "pink noise," fittingly enough.
The seashell's helix structure captures ambient noise, which then resonates inside. As a result, the noise is amplified, making it...
She began explaining the process in great detail. I was astonished by her almost scholarly level of knowledge.
...which isn't always the case, but pink noise possesses a fractal frequency, and that's why...
Err, what I'm getting at is...
Y'know, like, that's just what I heard? I'm not, like, an expert or anything.
Cutting herself off, she awkwardly took the seashell out of my hand, then took the conversation in another direction.
A-anyway! I just noticed this seashell's got the same color as the pink gradient of my hair. Ain't that nifty?
Changing the subject? Am not! Just thought it looked pretty, is all!
What I'm saying is: it reminds you of me, right? So I want you to treasure it like you'd treasure me.
Hands cupped around the seashell, she returned it to me with a slow, deliberate motion.
Just kidding, obviously. Sorry if that was cringe, haha.
She laughed it off, dismissing it as a joke. Despite that, though, I felt she'd meant it.

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>6 Sunlit Backstory</size>

scripts.say: Marblehead and I continued our stroll around the port until we noticed the sun had begun to set. We made way to higher ground to watch it.
Man, I'll never tire of seeing the sun set.
Especially here, where the view's just stunning. Am I right, Commander?
...My eyes are up here, y'know. Or are you just curious 'bout this photo?
The photograph attached to her uniform by a clip had caught my eye. She took it off and showed it to me.
This is me. Used to be me, anyway. I was a lame, nerdy girl who stuffed her head with useless knowledge, like that pink noise stuff. Kinda just slipped out of me.
Anyway, I'm happy with the way I am now. I don't wanna go back to the old me, not at all.
I mean, like, old me wouldn't have the courage to go on a date with you! Not in a million years!
Then, she flashed a smile at me. The cutest smile I'd ever seen, enhanced by the glow of the setting sun.
Wow, you look captivated~ Really dig my smile, eh?
Listen, Commander, I'd be happy to hang out with you anytime you've got too much work on your plate and need a break.
You can't devote your whole life to work or studies or whatever, it'd be a total crap life. I'd know, trust me. Promise you'll give me a call sometime?
She extended her pinky towards me. I obliged and hooked mine around hers.
Good! This pinky promise is like, legally binding, yeah? Hehe~
Today was a boatload of fun! Let's do it again sometime! Now, if you don't mind, I've gotta head off and complete some missions.
Looking forward to hanging out with you again soon, Commander! Buh-bye for now!

sequence:
Light Up My Day

<size=45>7 Toward a New Tomorrow</size>

scripts.say: It was the start of a new day. I was just about to start working, but then a certain someone covered my eyes from behind.
Guess who?
...Omaha or Concord? Now you're just messing with me. You know who I am! C'mon, tell me the real answer.
Marblehead? You're technically correct, but you're forgetting something important, ain'tcha?
The answer in full is: I'm Marblehead, your peppy right-hand girl slash secretary!
Gotta say, I'm still surprised you like, appointed me as your secretary. Surprised in a good way, 'course.
"The idea came to me after our date on that sunny day."
"I thought, 'Your smile always brightens up my day.' Just seeing it makes me more productive. And boosting productivity is exactly what an ideal secretary should do."
Hehe~ Glad to know I'm the best fit for the job.
On another note... I've gotta get something off my chest. I'm really into you, Commander. Like, REALLY into you.
This came out of nowhere. My surprise clearly showed on my face.
Haha! That's just the reaction I was hoping to see! Thanks~
For real though, I mean it. You're just perfect in my eyes. But what about you? Are you into me, too?
...Hehe! I knew it~
Her cheeks reddened slightly while a smile as bright as the sun took shape on her lips.
All right, it's time we got to work. If you're wonderin' something, just holler. Despite my getup, I dare say I'm smarter than most girls~
Whatever challenges were ahead of me, I felt confident I'd be able to overcome them with Marblehead by my side.
Just as the sun lights up the world, her presence lights up my own world. She is my ray of sunshine.

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>1 The Guardian Fox's Departure</size>
Sakura Islands
Mikasa's Mansion
July 23rd

scripts.say: Prior to the widespread chaos in the Pacific, Nagato and her escorts visited Mikasa's mansion.
It was a busy scene, with supplies being hauled back and forth.
Be careful not to bump into anything. Wrap your goods, then take them straight to the pier. Make sure EVERYTHING is there!
Harutsuki, how are the preparations going? This will be a long journey.
They're going w-well! The ship Lady Musashi sent has arrived and is docked at the pier!
Great. Thanks.
THAT was fast, considering how urgently we're leaving.
Perhaps the powers that be planned for that, though.
Hellooo? Lady Nagato!
Hey, Kawakaze, any idea where she is?
She is in the mansion, preparing for the journey. Do you have business with her?
Yeah, you could say that. I'll be quick, I promise!
Mikasa's Mansion - Nagato's Room
*knock knock*
Lady Nagato! It's me, Zuikaku!
Zuikaku? Come in.
Is there something wrong with the supplies? I assume that is why you've come to me unannounced.
Oh, uh, no! I had a quick look around the pier and everything seemed to be in order and on schedule.
That's good. Well? Why are you here, then?
It's about the journey itself... Doesn't it smell fishy to you? It came completely out of left field.
It's business as usual in the Pacific, yet Mikasa is sending you and a large fleet to the Solomon Islands with heaps of supplies.
Unless this is her idea of a vacation, I don't understand why she'd do this.
Yes, I do find it strange. Alas, all that she told me was that, "something has happened in the Solomons," and that she wanted me to investigate immediately.
The "immediately" part of that is pretty weird, too!
What if she knows something is going to happen on the mainland and she's intentionally sending you away?
Akagi did that once, so it wouldn't be the first time.
Then there's the time we went to Europa and she made up an excuse for me to take a long detour along the Cape of Good Hope.
Had these orders come from Musashi, I would share your suspicions. However, Mikasa would never misdirect us like this.
Still, you may be right that something big will happen in our homeland. Something which I am in the dark about.
Right? That's why I'd like to stay here and look into it!
That is a tall ask.
I mean, Mikasa is basically sending away her own bodyguards. Who will protect her if we're all away?
Hmm...
Plus, I can report straight to you immediately if I see anything suspicious happen!
Please! I promise I won't slack off for even a minute!
...Very well. Then I have a request to ask of you.
Mutsu has not been feeling well lately. Go and visit her on my behalf before we set off.
Huh? Uh, okay!
I just have one question...
Does Mutsu herself know that she's ill?
She will when you come to visit. If she does not, use the right words until she gets the hint.
If that is all, then you should go.
Understood! I will not disappoint you!
The tree yearns for stillness, but the wind does not let up...
Great Veteran, I will leave now.
Please... do not do anything foolish.

sequence: "The bud of a beautiful dream blossoms."
"Points become lines, the lines become a mask."
"Tonight, you shall don it and enter the dream."

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>10 Scattering Thunder</size>

scripts.say: Deep in the barrier, at the Dragon Palace...
Musashi collapsed onto the calm waters.
Not so much as a sound.
So easily neutralizing a wave of demons that blanketed the sea...
Jintsuu wasn't exaggerating. And this trump card isn't even fully completed yet...
But such a weapon is beyond any individual's control.
It's fortunate that I was at the core this time.
Shinano wouldn't... have...
As her strength left her and her vision began to cloud, Musashi felt the passage of time slow.
(Thinking that it would help her, I lent Akagi my strength and urged her to lead this empire.)
(My respect for her human desires led me to foolishly try to grant them.)
(But I was wholly unaware that madness had taken her.)
(No... I will make no excuses.)
(That this end would come was only natural. I have regrets, but I will not fear...)
(All that lives must die. In this world, ships and humans alike are but fleeting phantasms.)
Heehee...
May this final blow bring the light of hope into this desolation...
"Sever the pall of eternity, that I may become a leaf floating to the other side."
"Steel... clash!"
The fading armored behemoth unleashes one last blow.
Its sword splits the red moon and sky alike, creating a great rift in the barrier protecting the ritual grounds.
This... is all I can do now...
Mikasa, Akagi, Nagato... I leave the rest to you...
Oh, what a long day it's been...
I'm exhausted... Just a moment's... rest...
With eyes closed and a gentle smile, Musashi lay her head on the cold waters.
