In that moment, a kaleidoscope of brilliant golden butterflies lit up the world around her.
And then, just as quickly as they'd come, the butterflies disappeared along with the sleeping warrior.

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>11 Entrusted Will</size>

scripts.say: At Yakumoyama, the enemy's assault was ceaseless.
KABOOOM!
Izumo, everyone has reached the mountain. Close the barrier!
I can't! It's impossible to seal it when it's under such a dense assault!
Then I'll go. Your job will be easier if I draw their attention, right?
Great Veteran... Well, yes. A reduced density of attacks will let me seal the barrier in about 15 minutes.
Roger that!
Kinu, Hatakaze, Matsukaze, Oite. Come with me!
Mikasa's group charged down the mountain path, piercing through the horde of black mist entities like a spear.
KABOOOM!
What strange enemies... They look like they came right out of a youkai compendium!
Foxes, rabbits, fish, ducks, even horned demons...
Heh. At least there aren't any bugs.
Good. If there were bugs of such size... Urgh, just thinking about it makes me shudder!
(They're all just making jokes. Am I the only serious person here?)
This takes me back. How long has it been since the last time we all fought together?
Getting emotional just shows your age, Mikasa.
Besides, we fought together during Musashi's game, remember?
That doesn't count. Matsukaze and Oite weren't there.
Ahaha... Fair enough.
(If this many enemies are attacking Yakumoyama...)
(That must mean that Musashi's done her part.)
Sometime later...
Great Veteran, the sealing ritual is almost complete. Return at once!
Got it! I'll go stop Akagi, I swear!
Gah... Finally over, huh? They may be weak, but fighting such sheer numbers is no easy feat!
The next wave is coming. Great Veteran, let's beat a hasty retreat.
You're all too injured to move at full speed. Go on ahead.
I'll stay here and cover you.
M-Mikasa, do you hear yourself right now?!
That's an order! Or do you want to see all of us sunk here and now?
Mikasa cast a glance back at her injured friends, then returned her focus to the enemy.
Then, with a fearless grin, she plunged into the dark torrent.
Cannon fire and explosions flew through the battlefield, blowing away the black mist.
Mikasa couldn't even count the wounds on her body and rigging by now.
She continued to fight, driven only by her willpower and instincts, disrupting the enemy army as best she could.
(A desperate battle. The disparity between our forces and theirs is simply mad.)
(The last time I felt like this... was my first time fighting Sirens.)
(Guess the shoe's on the other foot now, after all the times I managed to get one over on them...)
(I had so many opportunities to stop Akagi by force, and plenty of chances to persuade Musashi...)
(But I didn't take action. Because I wanted to see things done my way.)
(To be the veteran who supported the Sakura Empire's next generation of leaders from afar.)
(My biggest regret of all was losing you, Amagi.)
(I want to see you again, hear your strategize, and play games against you...)
(I understand now. That's why I didn't stop Akagi...)
(Hahaha... I guess this was the natural end of things, after all.)
(Yakumoyama's barrier is sealed now. The Sakura Empire's combat forces have been preserved as much as anyone could hope for.)
(Nagato... Sorry for being such a selfish role model.)
(The rest... is all up to you.)
Before her vision could be overwhelmed by darkness, Mikasa saw a group of butterflies that shone like the morning sun.

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>12 Fallen Petals</size>

scripts.say: At the very center of the barrier, by the roots of the withering tree, the corroding ritual continued on.
Not enough... It's not enough...
They still won't bloom...
I need more nourishment for her soul.
No, this ritual isn't over yet. I mustn't let it end.
Even if things go completely out of hand...
Dear sister... I know you'll be able to bring everything back under control.
I couldn't lead the Sakura Empire myself, but I know you can!
You were meant to lead the Empire. To lead me...
When you're around, everything works out for the best.
Even if everything burned down tomorrow... you'd make everything better. Isn't that right, dear sister?
Of course it is! You can do ANYTHING!
So I'll bring you back, no matter what it takes.
I'm so close... So very close... I can practically feel you!
But why? Why, why is the last step so...
Kaga... You know her just as well as I do. That's why we're the perfect exchange for the final fragment of her soul...
You must understand. As soon as this is over, Amagi will come back to us.
So...
Just come with me, okay?
...Okay.
Let's go, Akagi.
To the final stage of this ritual.
In front of the great tree, Kaga took off her mask and smiled at Akagi.
"From Naraka, down to the netherworld."
A dead branch pierced Kaga's chest. Blood dripped from her mouth, painting it a vivid crimson.
Urgh... I thought I was ready for this...
But it really... hurts... *cough*...
Kaga?!
Why... Why do I have the ornament that Amagi gave you?
You never let this out of your sight... Why is it on me now?!
Why... Why did you protect me?!
You're leaving me alone?! Didn't we promise we'd go together?!
I'm... enough on my own...
It's only natural... for me to return what your sister gave me...
Consider it... her protecting you one more time...
And now... I've done it...
And please take care of my sister – Akagi...
I fulfilled my promise... dear sister...
Akagi... I can't protect you anymore.
Only you can undo the karma you wrought...
Someone important... that you've long forgotten...
From now on... You'll be alone... in...
Buds opened one after another, yielding blood-red blooms.
With the ritual completed, the dead branches came back to life. And as Kaga disappeared into the tree's canopy...
Crimson cherry blossoms came into full bloom.

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>13 Our Commander</size>

scripts.say: After the ritual ended, the gap between the material world and eternity was meant to be bridged.
But the expected revival, the awaited reunion, had not come to pass.
"When the cherry blossoms come into bloom, Amagi will emerge from the sea of flowers anew."
Heh. Heheh... Ahahaha...
Hahahahahaha!
Nothing happened... Nothing at all.
I thought I was ready for anything, but this? This I hadn't imagined...
All I revived was this damn tree, instead of my sister?
Oh, what horror... Heheh, hehahahah...
She clenched her fist around the ornament that Kaga had left behind, so hard that her hand bled.
Now I remember... Even back in the battle at AF, Amagi protected me...
That's why mine is gone... and Kaga's is still here...
Saved by my sister yet again...
Losing the last thing that she left behind for me...
Ahaha... Amagi's gone for good. I'll never see her again.
Amagi's gone, Kaga's gone, they're all gone...
Nobody will protect me anymore...
Nobody...
Ahaha... Ahahaha...
Kaga... You were such a foolish girl.
I was going insane. Why didn't you try to stop me?
I wouldn't have even suspected you. If you wanted to stop me...
It would've... It would've been so easy...
Kaga... Oh, Kaga...
Why did this have to happen?
A wave of black mist monsters undulated on the horizon.
...I get it. You have no more use for me, so you've come to take out the trash.
Fine. If I can't see them again in this world...
Kaga, Amagi... I'll come and see you on the other side.
KABOOOM!
What...? Carrier-based planes?!
Akagi... Akagiii! Can you hear me?!
The corrosion is all over the place! This ritual isn't going to go the way you want it to! Hurry and stop it!
Zuikaku? But Musashi helped her escape. Why is she–
KABOOOM!
Zuikaku's planes weren't the only ones there. Even more closed in from the distance.
When Akagi looked carefully at the angle they came from, it became clear that they were flooding in from the rift Musashi had created.
Akagi! I brought a fleet to come and rescue you! Say something, Akagi!
Ryuuhou?!
BEEP BEEP!
Ryuuhou! What have you come back for?!
Oh, thank goodness you're safe!
Lady Nagato is here. And reinforcements from abroad, too!
Nagato? And others?
Yeah! She came back with fleets from all over!
It's not too late! If we destroy the ritual circle, we can still fix this!
Fix? Hahaha... No, it's too late... What is there to fix now?
All my planning, all my scheming, all my preparation... for what, exactly?
I betrayed my country and my friends... What is there left for me?!
"What's left"? Everything! Or what, are you going to give up on the living now, too?!
Silence, both of you! You mustn't destroy the ritual circle!
Lady Nagato?!
Now that the ritual has been completed, the Singularity Naraka has already manifested.
Destroying the circle now will just make it impossible to fix!
Akagi, you are not wrong. Whether you were in your right mind or not, you have hurt the Sakura Empire, your friends, and most of all, yourself.
You were overwhelmed by obsession, yes, but it was your love that left one final path for you.
Take that path, and you may be able to do more than save Amagi.
You might just be able to undo the damage you have done, and the sacrifices you have made.
You mean... my... love?
Of course. I speak no lies.
And the one who revealed this possibility to us was none other than...
{playername}. Our Commander.

sequence: At the ritual's end, the Singularity Naraka appeared in the mortal world.
Her dreams and desires were quashed by despair.
But one hope shone on the bloodied horizon.
Hope that effort may be rewarded.
Hope that what was sown may finally be reaped.
War, salvation, and atonement continue on in an endless cycle.
And that distant sound continues to echo among the stars.
To Be Continued

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>2 Trailing the Mountains</size>

scripts.say: Nagato and her fleet left for the Solomon Islands on a sudden redeployment.
Right before that, though, Zuikaku paid a visit to Mutsu, and she suddenly "fell ill."
With the guardian fox's sister in need of a caretaker, Zuikaku was allowed to remain on the mainland.
Somewhere, in the Sakura Islands...
Whew... Now that Lady Nagato has set off, Akagi and her co-conspirators must've lowered their guard.
This gives me some time to work unimpeded.
Finally, I have the golden opportunity to properly investigate what they've been scheming!
...Huh? Is that... Musashi and her massive transport fleet? And Mikasa is with them?
I knew staking out this place was the right call.
Alright. If I follow them, I should find out where they're heading!
Sakura Islands - Yakumoyama
Yakumoyama has long since been famous as a sightseeing area.
However, it has been fenced off ever since it was declared a holy site following the last Great War.
Zuikaku trailed Musashi and Mikasa along the mountain path as they passed several checkpoints along the way.
Then, she could do little but watch as their figures faded into the distance.
Hardly anyone has been here since this place was declared sacred...
What reason do they have to be here? Especially with such a huge convoy...
There are too many guards. I can't follow them any further without getting spotted. I guess I'll have to stop here...
Chirp, chirp! You, hiding in the forest! Come out! I know you're there!
(Crap! It's Zuihou.)
(I was so focused on the convoy that I forgot to pay any attention to what's behind me...)
Did you hear me? Come out now or I'm gonna call the guards! You have ten seconds!
(Dammit... I'm BOUND to get in trouble if she keeps yelling like this!)
(Ah, screw it. She's already seen me anyway.)
(I can just make up some excuse for Zuihou. If I'm lucky, she might even help with the investigation.)
Shhh! Keep your voice down!
I'm not anyone suspicious! It's me, Zuikaku!
Chirp? Zuikaku?
Why were you hiding in the bushes?
Did you find something fun back there?
There's nothing fun in the bushes, kid. But I AM on a fun mission. Wanna hear about it?
Ooh! A fun mission! Tell me!
Heh. Well, long story short...
Ohh, I get it! You're here to do sightseeing around the mountain!
It's not "sightseeing," it's an investigation!
I'm trailing Musashi and Mikasa and trying to stay out of sight. Sounds pretty fun, doesn't it?
Uh-huh! It does!
That's why you were hiding in the bushes, right? Because you couldn't get into the mountain?
Mhm. But you're smart and everyone loves you, Zuihou. You must know a way in, right?
I do! Shiranui gave me a note that lets me through all the checkpoints since I'm here to see her!
If you wanna come with me, hide in the wagon. I'll bring you in in secret!
You'll do that for me? Thanks so much!
Heehee! You're welcome!
Thanks to that slip of paper, trailing Mikasa and Musashi got much easier for Zuikaku.
After she and Zuihou followed the mountain path to its end, they came across a modest yet majestic wooden building.
If Musashi and Mikasa are here to talk, they're probably doing it in that place over there.
I've gotta go see Shiranui now, so it's time for you to get off.
Meet me here again when you wanna leave! I'll bring you back down the mountain!
Following the path Zuihou pointed out, Zuikaku quickly found her way to the side of the building.
Dang. I can hardly make out a word because the walls are soundproofed.
Those are definitely Mikasa's and Musashi's voices, though...
If they just wanted to talk, why would they come all the way out to such a remote location?
Hm? Is there someone else in there?
Is that... Izumo?
What did she say? "Work together"? On what?
Ugh, I can't hear them... I wish I could sneak inside!
Don't think I don't see you eavesdropping!
Without any warning, Zuikaku's eyes were covered by someone behind her.
Gueeess who!
Zuihou! Cut it out!
Chirp! You actually got it on the first try!
Shhh! Be quiet! And don't freak me out like that...
It's okay! They can't hear us from the inside.
How'd your investigation go? Did you find anything?
I found SOMETHING, but I can't talk about it here. Why? Are you leaving the mountain already?
Yep! Shiranui said something came up so she couldn't play with me. Are you gonna stay?
Nah, I think I'll leave as well. Let's go.
Sometime later...
Izumo? The blueprint lady?
I don't think it's THAT weird that she's here.
You don't?
I heard she attends religious ceremonies, and this is a holy mountain, so...
Hmm. Maybe she just happens to be here by chance.
I wouldn't go that far. She's probably the mountain's guardian, or she works here.
Because Musashi and Mikasa wouldn't come all the way out here if she didn't.
They could just call her, or tell Izumo to visit them instead, you know?
True. If a phone call was out of the question, those two have such high standing they could just make Izumo come to them instead.
But, if Izumo can't leave the mountain for some reason, then what does she have to do with whatever they're planning?
Shh! More wagons are coming!
Zuihou signaled for Zuikaku to hide, then quickly ran off to talk to the driver at the head of the line.
Zuikaku watched as the wagons drove by, and noticed the small flags flying above their headlights.
They were blue and featured a peculiar emblem – Tosa's emblem.
Okay, I'm back.
Did you see those flags? That was Tosa's motorcade, wasn't it?
Mhm! This sure is a busy evening.
What about it? You're not thinking about going back and eavesdropping again, are you?
No, no way. That'd raise too much suspicion.
It's getting dark. Let's get out of here!

sequence: "Upon a horizonless field of crimson, drifting phantoms clump together."
"Images of lost friends and old tales flood the mind."
"Amagi, my dear sister... You never really left, did you?"

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>3 The Prime Barrier</size>

scripts.say: As the sun set on the horizon, Zuikaku and Zuihou left the holy mountain's periphery.
Okay, you're in the clear now.
I hope you enjoyed touring the holy mountain!
Uh, yeah, ahaha... Thanks for everything!
Nighttime is coming soon so I'm gonna go home. What about you?
Umm, I'm gonna...
(I can't just go back to Mikasa's place now since I snuck out of Mutsu's house.)
(Going home would also raise suspicions, since Shoukaku is on a sortie in the Solomons.)
(There's no port near here, either. Even if there was, I have no excuse for being all the way out here!)
(Is sleeping outside my only option? Do I really have to spend the night in the middle of nowhere?)
Zuikaku's expression grows increasingly nervous. Zuihou notices and flashes a sweet smile.
Hey, how come you're still on the mainland, anyway? Didn't Lady Nagato's fleet leave earlier?
Did you sneak off and now you've realized there's nowhere for you to go?
No, I didn't sneak off, honest! It's just that Mutsu fell ill and I was tasked with looking after her.
Ohh, she fell ill?
Zuihou looked in the general direction of Mutsu's house.
Anyway, that doesn't matter!
I know! How about you stay at my house?
Really? You'll let me do that?
Chirp, chirp! Yeah! Houshou gave me a house, and it's really, really big!
It has lots of empty rooms which my friends use when we have sleepovers. You can stay, no problem!
You're a lifesaver. Please show the way!
The moon shone brightly overhead as the two arrived at the house. Already from just the door, it was clear this was a majestic building.
Here we are!
THIS is what your place looks like?! It's basically as big as Mikasa's mansion!
Heehee. Houshou insisted that it had to be this big.
Chirp! Look at the time. Let's go inside.
I'll make dinner for you! I can't let any guest of mine go hungry!
While Zuihou cooked in the kitchen, Zuikaku took a stroll around the garden.
(This garden is well cared for. Look at all these flowers...)
(Wait... Why have so many of them withered? I thought these varieties bloom during the summer?)
(That's weird... The garden looks tip top, but the flowers don't...)
Dinner is ready! How do you like my flowers? Aren't they pretty?
I think they look pretty good both in the sunlight AND the moonlight!
Uh, I don't know if you noticed, but...
What?! What happened to my flowers? They were blooming just yesterday!
Can flowers even wither that quickly? They can't, right?
That reminds me – I saw a lot of withered plants back at the mountain.
I didn't think much of it then. Now, though... Something's clearly up here.
So it's not just my flowers... I wonder if something happened to the Prime Barrier.
The what? What's the "Prime Barrier"?
It's the great, eternal barrier that covers the Sakura Islands and protects us!
Huh. I might've heard about it from Lady Nagato, but I'm not sure.
Chirp. I guess you have selective attention, but that's fine.
The Prime Barrier covers the entirety of the country, protecting it from outside threats.
I've heard you can adjust it to change the weather, block out storms, and even make it rain.
Basically, it's a super-duper important barrier!
I had no idea that existed! Is it top-secret or something?
Hmm... I dunno. I'm pretty sure Yamashiro and others of her rank know about it, though.
Uh-huh... So how come you know about it?
Yamashiro told me!
Thought so...
Hang on, does that barrier have anything to do with the rituals Lady Nagato performs with the Sacred Sakura?
Yup. She IS the guardian fox, you know. Officially, though, Yamato is in charge of maintaining the Prime Barrier.
Officially?
Well, in practice, Musashi is the one who handles the barrier, because Yamato can't.
Yamato lives in seclusion in Heaven's Gate, and the Sacred Sakura that maintain the Prime Barrier are all located OUTSIDE Heaven's Gate!
Okay, so let's wind this back... You're saying you think the flowers withered because the Prime Barrier malfunctioned?
Mhm! It should be back in working order soon, so it's nothing to worry about.
I feel bad for the poor flowers, though... This was their time to bloom... Chirp...
*knock knock*
Zuihou, are you home? I have come to hang out!
Oh, I think that's Ryuujou.
You're not supposed to be here, right, Zuikaku? You should go hide.
Zuikaku answered with a quiet nod, then slid the sliding door aside and hid in the room next to the kitchen.
I'm home! Just a minute!
Finally, you're back, Zuihou! I waited the whole day for you.
Did you have fun visiting Yakumoyama?
It was beautiful! Though it wasn't really that fun.
...Wait, you waited the whole day for me?
Didn't you say you had a mission today? Something about special training out at sea?
I did... The mission was canceled at the last minute. I was only told that I was not to set sail.
I thought it strange, so I asked around. Apparently, it wasn't just us shipgirls that were forbidden from sailing – civilian ships were, too.
So, I went straight to you to ask if you knew anything!
Incidentally, has Zuikaku paid you a visit?
Z-Zuikaku? Um, err...
I'm only asking because I saw her accompanying you inside. Is she still here, by any chance?
Wh-what? So when you said you waited for me the whole day, you meant you waited right outside my house?
Precisely! I hid behind the bushes and awaited your return!
Zuikaku is, uhh... making dinner. Come inside and we'll talk over some food!
Also, you must not tell anyone that Zuikaku was here!
Understood!
With her cover blown, Zuikaku had no choice but to come out.
The three sat down around the dinner table and discussed what they saw today while they ate.
Nobody was allowed to leave, eh... I can see why the Prime Barrier malfunctioning would lead to that.
But the barrier has been running for ages, and any minor problems with it were fixed right away.
It's never resulted in all ships being prohibited from sailing out to sea.
Then perhaps it was not a minor malfunction, but rather a major one?
I have no idea...
Is there any way to determine what's going on?
I think the fastest way would be to go there ourselves and see what's up.
Sure... The problem is, I don't have access to the Prime Barrier.
Buuut... Yamashiro does!
She lives nearby, and she probably won't tell us no if we all ask her together!
(Hmm... Yeah, if anyone knows about barriers, it's got to be Yamashiro.)
(Although, there's the risk that she'll let it slip to Akagi that I stayed behind on the mainland...)
Zuikaku? Is something wrong?
No, it's nothing. Let's talk to Yamashiro tomorrow since it's so late now.
Sure!
Then I suppose we have the night all to ourselves!
If we can't visit Yamashiro, we can still play games.
Zuihou, shall I call over Hiyou and Junyou to join us?
I believe they're sitting idle at the moment, and the more the merrier, right?
Good idea! Wait... Are you okay with that, Zuikaku?
I don't mind. When we visit Yamashiro tomorrow, the cat will be out of the bag anyway.
Plus, I might need their help with my investigation later. Now's a good time to befriend them!
Pardon? What do you mean, "the cat will be out of the bag"?
It's nothing important! Go ahead and invite them over. I'll pick out a game for us to play meanwhile.
Very well! I shall be right back!

sequence: "Starting from the core of the Sacred Sakura..."
"The waking and the sleeping world will reverse."
"Amagi, let us expand our world to new horizons."

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>4 Ink-Stained Dream</size>

scripts.say: A while later, Ryuujou returned to Zuihou's house with Hiyou and Junyou in tow.
They played games late into the night, then retired to their bedrooms.
Zuikaku opened her eyes to an ink-stained scene of steel. She was back at the Sacred Sakura when she was trying to awaken Nagato.
Halt! Who are you?!
We're the Sakura Empire's Reborn Combined Fleet, and we're here to have a look at the girl in the Sacred Sakura...
(Huh? Why am I here?)
...Leave this place. None shall disturb the guardian fox's slumber.
Kawakaze... So you serve Amagi.
We must speak with her. Won't you let us through?
(Wait... Speak to Amagi? Not Lady Nagato?)
The guardian fox already carries a burden too great.
I gave her my word that I would let no one disturb her slumber!
No one! Not even our fellow countrymen.
There's such a thing as being TOO stubborn... What if we insisted on seeing her?
If you'd push forward despite my warnings, you'd best prepare for a battle!
(Something feels so wrong... But what?)
Zuikaku, focus! She's coming to attack us!
KABOOOM!
I see now why you're decorated and revered...
You're a skilled fighter yourself. I'd expect as much from Amagi's aide.
*cough cough*... Zuikaku, hurry!
Over my dead body!
Shoukaku! Great Veteran!
(No, wait... This isn't how it went!)
KABOOOM!
Kawakaze, step down.
You've done well as my guardian, but I never asked you to repel guests with such ferocity.
My sincere apologies to all of you. Kawakaze should have restrained herself better so as to not injure you.
Please come to my mansion just up ahead and tend to your wounds.
You're... You're Amagi, aren't you?
Is that really you?
Yes, it is me. I hope I've not slept in the Sacred Sakura for so long that I've been all but forgotten.
Okay, uhh... Nice to meet you, I suppose?
Sorry, I can't shake this feeling that something is wrong...
Wrong? Yes, now that you mention it, something does feel off to me as well.
What, precisely, do you feel is wrong?
It's... Who is the guardian fox...
And... who was sealed away in a slumber here...
...ake up...
Hey! Wake up!
You're finally up, sleepyhead!
Huh? Whuh? Zuihou?
Man, I just had the weirdest dream ever... Thanks for waking me up.
If only the dreams were the only weird thing happening right now...
Look out the window! Everything is all messed up!
Messed up?
Zuikaku focused her gaze on the window. Zuihou had already pulled aside the curtains.
Looking outside, she could clearly see what was happening.
The trees had shrunk and all the old buildings on the street looked brand new, almost like time had reversed.
I'm... not still dreaming, am I? Why does everything look like we went back in time?
I don't know, but it's not a dream! Ryuujou, Hiyou, and Junyou went out to see what had happened, and it's exactly like you just said!
What about your house? Did it go back in time, too?
Luckily not, because mine's protected by one of Yamato's barriers.
You see, the house had just been finished, and Ibuki came by to bless it with–
Ahem.
Oh, anyway, I got a message from Musashi earlier!
This is apparently an illusion, and it happened because someone infiltrated the Prime Barrier.
She said everything will go back to normal soon, and when it does, we have to sortie and locate the infiltrator!
(Ohh! This is why Mikasa sent Lady Nagato so far away from the mainland!)
(I need to gather intel quickly and relay the situation to her!)

sequence: "The wedge has been driven in and the concept has been anchored."
"The circle is finished and ready for the ritual to commence."
"Soon, my dear sister. Soon."

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>5 Misfortune Arriveth</size>

scripts.say: Sakura Islands - Yakumoyama
A brilliantly moonlit night – that is what tonight was expected to be.
Instead, thick clouds had gathered in the sky, blotting out all but a few streaks of moonlight.
If you looked carefully, you could see the shadow of a tree's branches in the light.
The ritual has begun...
BEEP BEEP!
Just as we expected, the corruption is taking shape as the ritual proceeds.
The Shadow of Corruption's embodiment is beginning to attack. We must intercept.
I know.
Musashi hung up the line and issued orders to the shipgirls under her command.
(I told them not the truth about where this enemy is from.)
(Although, it matters not. All they need do is be in position and annihilate them. Where the enemy comes from is unimportant.)
(Let's just hope there won't be any more of them tonight...)
She exhaled a sigh and looked up at the sky.
There was a full, crimson moon and the branches and leaves of the Sacred Sakura, reaching toward the stars.
Sometime later...
BEEP BEEP!
Musashi, people are reporting visual and auditory hallucinations one after the next.
Due to the likelihood of this causing unforeseen problems, I sent them all back to the harbor. Awaiting further orders.
I know the situation. Bolster the harbor's defenses and remain on alert.
Yes, ma'am!
(This is unexpected... Hallucinations should not be occurring whilst the corruption remains formless...)
BEEP BEEP!
Musashi, the enemy is multiplying. The situation does not look optimistic for us.
My fleet has ceased attacking. We're working with fortifications and preparing for a defensive battle.
In addition, those hallucinations Kii described earlier – my fleet is experiencing them, too.
How long are you going to keep stalling, Musashi?
...Another hour.
BEEP BEEP!
I have bad news to report, Musashi!
Me and Zuihou's fleet were going to sortie together, but they never called me back despite my repeated attempts, so I sent out recon planes to investigate...
Sure enough, I saw them locked in a battle with a META! She came out of nowhere!
A META, you say?
Forward their coordinates to me. I will send in backup!
Roger! Coordinates are on the way!
Looks like you won't need to wait an hour after all.
So it seems...
After quickly summarizing what was happening, Musashi opened a comms channel with Akagi.
As you can clearly see, the situation is getting out of control.
This cannot be done, Akagi.
It's time to stop.
Please, you must be kidding me.
The Shadow of Corruption attacking and that META appearing only happened because the corrosion values are slightly higher than anticipated.
The METAmorphosis is only temporary. We can use our barrier to purify and reverse it.
Furthermore, the ritual circle is working. We are so close to completing the ritual. It's too late to stop now.
Even if it wasn't, I wouldn't.
All will be fine as long as Amagi's revival is a success.
All you have to do is hold out until then.
If you cannot hold out... then run away.
BEEP BEEP!
Akagi hung up the line. A look of deep sadness swept across Musashi's face.
I should've known this would happen.
Jintsuu, is our decisive weapon ready?
It can be used for a while, assuming that the core is reliable.
Are you sure you want to do this?
Akagi's flame burns so brightly only because I gave her my assistance.
Therefore, it is my duty to bring the situation back under control.
Perform final checks.
As you say...
I wish you luck, Musashi.

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>6 Obsession Rooted in the Past</size>

scripts.say: KABOOOM!
Zuihou, are you okay?!
Great Veteran! We're just fine over here. Please, go help Hiyou and Junyou!
Kh... I'm losing my mind here. I wanna cut something!
The world is burning... Ahahaha! Yeah, let it all burn!
Hold on a second! Zuihou, Zuikaku!
Are you saying those META ships are this branch's... OUR Hiyou and Junyou?
Mghh... Y-yeah... Basically–
When we got your orders, we immediately set sail to meet up with Katsuragi.
But as soon as we left the coast, Hiyou and Junyou took a turn for the worse.
They said they were hearing voices, and then they saw strange figures...
When Zuihou tried to give them a checkup, this black fog suddenly surrounded them, and then... THAT happened.
I saw the same thing happen to U-556 once when I accompanied Iron Blood on a mission...
There must be something in the water here that corrodes shipgirls and turns them META!
Great Veteran, we have to get them back to dry land!
Agreed there, but... Why are you here instead of with Nagato?
Aaaah! Umm, Lady Mutsu is sick, so Lady Nagato ordered me to–
I get it, I get it! Alright, I'll go inform everyone to retreat!
Great Veteran... Thank you!
I have one more report, too!
The corrosion here isn't as strong as it was the first time I saw it. They aren't as far gone as U-556 was!
If we can neutralize the two of them and purify the corrosion, then we should be able to bring them to their senses!
The Royal Navy and Orthodoxy have both succeeded at this before. I know we can do it!
That's great. But if we want to neutralize them...
I have a great idea!
Yamashiro gave me this paralyzing agent... Uhh, let's see...
There! If we use this, we can temporarily suppress them! Then, we use the opportunity to rush in and go for the K.O.!
Good stuff, Zuihou!
But who's going to purify them once they've been neutralized, and where?
Well...
BEEP BEEP!
Hey, everyone! Sorry, I was eavesdropping a little!
My mansion has a defensive barrier set up around it. We should be able to purify them there!
Please! Just get them to me, and I'll handle the rest!
Yamashiro... Thanks!
Don't mention it. I'm just doing what's right.
There you have it, everyone. Let's ground those two!
Sometime later, at Yamashiro's mansion...
The gang managed to drag Hiyou and Junyou to the mansion, where they quickly set upon the purification ritual.
As Zuikaku theorized, their META corrosion hadn't advanced far enough to block their recovery.
Hey, are you two okay? Still feeling bad?
Ugh... I feel like I just woke up from a nightmare.
A nightmare full of someone else's memories and emotions...
Forcing their way into my mind, trying to fuse until they've taken over me...
That was just the worst!
Yeah. It really was... I feel reborn now that I've been purified.
I wouldn't wish that experience on any of you.
Oooh, I'm so happy you're okay!
But look to the sky. Things are only getting worse out there.
A withered tree amidst blood-red clouds... It's like an upside-down world up above our own.
A distortion in space... Does this mean the Prime Barrier was corroded?
Probably. Where is Mikasa?
She went to see Musashi as soon as we got back. I guess they're still talking.
Really? Well, I'm feeling great now! More people have evacuated back to land, so I'm gonna go help them!
Me, too!
A warrior mustn't rest when people are in need! I shall join you!
Yamashiro already went, too! Let's go help her out!
May we join you as well?
Houshou and Jintsuu?! You're here, too?
Musashi designated this as our gathering point. All of our mobile forces should gather here before long, and that includes us.
But before we all leave to help the evacuees, I think I should explain things.
Yeah. "Distortion" doesn't really tell the whole story... Jintsuu, you mind doing the honors?
Gladly. Everyone, do you know what that distortion in the sky is?
Is it an illusion made by the contaminated Prime Barrier?
No. That very tree IS the core of the barrier.
The Shadow of Corruption may have appeared in the sea, but the Prime Barrier has yet to be corroded.
However, the barrier's camouflage has been stripped away, revealing its true form.
Its true form...?
This is going to take us back... rather far in the past.
When Akagi was still a battlecruiser, she and her sister Amagi...
I-I had no idea all of that happened...
If I'm understanding right... this Shadow of Corruption thing isn't an attack from the outside...
It's the result of Akagi going mad?
Perhaps so. At any rate, we discovered that the impurity stemming from Watatsumi exists even in the sacred tree where Amagi sleeps.
The Great Sage Unzen, Lady Nagato, and Musashi have twice combated this corrosion...
Zuihou, I believe you saw the second battle with your own two eyes.
Yeah... It was really scary. Nobody but Unzen could stand up to the corrosion...
Back to the matter at hand... I believe Akagi's original intention was to use the Watatsumi's power to repair hulls.
But, unfortunately, it seems that linking herself to the sacred tree has led to her ego being overwhelmed by the corroding impurity.
Is Akagi that hell-bent on trying to bring her sister back? That she'd give up her own self?
That's right. And the plan has already spiraled out of her control.
The impurity in the ocean, the hallucinations, the corrosion that turns people META... It's all proof that Amagi has been corroded.
Akagi must have known this would happen...
But based on what she did, it seems to me that she fell to her own obsession.
(Has Akagi really lost her mind?)
(Putting the whole Sakura Empire in peril just to save something that might not even be her sister anymore... That's the furthest thing from sanity!)
(Was what she did to Shoukaku at the holy site related to this, too?)
(No. If that was true, why'd she give up on us so easily? Why did she participate in Musashi's game? And the reformation proposed by the Commander...)
(Why didn't Kaga stop her?)
(Akagi, you said you would lead the Sakura Empire...)
(I thought better of her after what happened at the holy site... I thought she was worthy of respect.)
(Hold your horses, Zuikaku. I know it pisses you off, but put yourself in her shoes for a second!)
(If it was Shoukaku...)
(If Shoukaku had been taken from us, and not Amagi...)
(And if I led the Sakura Empire, and someone offered to help me get her back...)
(I don't know what I'd do, but...)
(If I was in Akagi's shoes, I wouldn't sacrifice the Sakura Empire... I wouldn't put my friends' lives on the line!)
(Shoukaku wouldn't want that, either. Surely Amagi doesn't...)
(Yeah! Amagi trusts her sister. She wouldn't want this to happen!)
(We need to stop her before she does something that can't be taken back!)
I understand this is a lot to take in right now.
We'll go ahead for now. Take your time and–
Houshou, do you know where Mikasa and Musashi are meeting right now?
Yes. What are you planning?
Aargh! Zuikaku, are you going to eavesdrop AGAIN?!

sequence:
Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>7 Planning Interference</size>

scripts.say: The meeting in the reception room approached its end.
The barrier in the mansion is reaching critical levels, and META corrosion is only intensifying.
I understand your feelings, Great Veteran, but we have no time left to prepare a backup plan.
Perhaps not, but...
The Prime Barrier will prevent any entry as long as the ritual is in progress. We – no, our whole country – will be completely isolated.
No external help can come unless we open a seam from the inside.
Akagi's ritual circle has moved from the Prime Sakura to my sphere of influence in the Dragon Palace.
Using the connection between the Watatsumi and the Yamato class, I can travel directly into the circle.
Mikasa, I trust you to look after our comrades.
Ideally, I will be able to stop Akagi's ritual myself...
But, in the event that I fail, I will zap a hole in the barrier. That will be the time for you to execute your plan.
For now, wait patiently and save your strength.
No matter what happens to me, you have Lady Nagato, Shinano, and many other capable allies. The Sakura Empire's future will not be lost today.
That will be all.
Musashi unilaterally made her decision, stood up, and left.
Meanwhile, outside...
So Musashi was on Akagi's side, but I guess she isn't the one who caused this...
And now she wants to stop Akagi's rampage all on her own?
...Huh? Is someone leaving the room?
Aw, crap!
Umm... Hi, Musashi...
You did well today. Keep up the good work.
Of course! Thank you!
After that, Musashi left without another word.
Aah! My mind went blank when she came out... I forgot I needed to stop her!
The impure power must be most potent in the ritual circle... I can't let her go into that alone!
I know! I'll go tell everyone and think of a plan!
Zuikaku ran out of the hallway and found Zuihou keeping watch over an area of the mansion.
Upon hearing the scoop, even the bubbly bird began racking her brain.
Anyway, we need to go to that Dragon Palace and stop Musashi...
Chirp... Akagi's circle is there, right?
Oh! Shinano gave me a miniature model of the palace this one time! I hope it'll help somehow.
Also, Musashi said that only the Yamato class can teleport there because they have a connection with Watatsumi, right?
I heard Lady Nagato and Shimanto could do the same thing, though...
Oh, I know! Just a while back, I asked Shimanto how to teleport in the sacred tree's domain, and she gave me this token!
She said it's really precious, because it's made of a Watatsumi fragment... Maybe you could use this to do the same thing!
Chirp! Good thing I took such good care of it. Now I can really help you out!
Here you go, Zuikaku! Use this, and go catch her!
Aww, thanks! Except... there's one problem.
Just running in empty-handed sounds like a bad plan. I mean, that place is full of nasty stuff. There might even be enemies.
I figure I need to be ready. Weapons, gear, talismans, that kind of stuff...
Plus, that'll make it more likely that I win if I have to face Akagi in a fight!
Chirp! Leave that to me!
Let's see... This one's from Unzen...
I got this one from Ibuki...
Mikasa gave me this one... This one was Lady Nagato... And Yamato, and Musashi...
This one's from Akagi... One from Kaga, one from Tosa... Houshou...
Hmm... Hrmm...
One by one, Zuihou takes out various odds and ends and clutters the table with them.
(I-is there anyone in the country who hasn't given her something?)
(Zuihou is a force to be reckoned with!)

sequence: "Truth. Falsehood."
"That which resembles in form. That which is alike in spirit."
"Just one more step..."

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>8 Decisive Weapon</size>

scripts.say: *cough cough*... My head is spinning...
Is teleporting into the sacred tree's domain always this bad? *cough*...
It looks like... this must be the circle at the core of the ritual.
The sky was a dark red, and a sea of red spider lilies covered the earth.
The mountain stream was as the Sanzu River, with faint, spectral blue flames dancing upon it.
Palpable energy flowed through the air and into the great, withered tree.
Eerie... I'd better go find Musashi, and fast!
Zuikaku promptly sent out recon planes. Amidst the bed of lilies, she spotted Musashi.
*pant*... *pant*... Musashi, let me come with you!
...Zuikaku? I didn't think you would come here, nor so quickly.
How did you do it?
With this token made from a Watatsumi fragment! Zuihou says Shimanto gave it to her.
I had no idea such a thing remained on the mainland...
Seeing that faint golden aura about you, you must have what Yamato once gave her, as well.
Golden aura...?
Zuikaku finally realized that her whole body was emitting golden light.
That token can only be used once. Now that you've used it to come here, you won't be going home so easily.
I'm sure you're here to stay my hand, but I won't be leaving you alone for the sake of my return.
Let's stop Akagi together!
I don't know what danger awaits, but I know someone has to do something!
...Very well. With you here, my chances of success have increased.
What do we do now?
There are two ways to stop the ritual.
Either we defeat Akagi at the core of the circle...
...Or we break its protective barrier and open it up to the outside world.
That was the approach I was going to take – originally.
Huh? You weren't going to stop Akagi?
The ritual has gathered immense power. If we don't stop it, then her power will only grow as we approach the core.
Forget defeating her – just approaching her will take enormous strength.
While breaking the defensive barrier will not in itself prevent the ritual, it will open up a new course of action.
The ritual barrier has fused with the Prime Barrier that protects the Sakura Empire.
In breaking it, we will essentially create a route to the outside.
That will allow us to join forces with our allies on the outside, but that's not all.
It can also be used as an escape route if needs must.
Then let me help you fight, Musashi!
...No. You must go to Akagi.
Huh? But didn't you just say she'd be stronger there? And it would be really hard just to get there?
Only if she can bring all to bear against you.
When I'm busy ripping holes into her barrier, she'll be forced to focus her attention on me.
Use that opportunity to approach her.
With what Yamato and the others have given you, the corrosion should be negligible for a time.
Got it! I'll go stop Akagi, I swear!
Heheh. That's the spirit.
"With this strike, I clear thy path forward."
Purple electricity surged from Musashi.
It formed a helmet, arms, a torso – until it had become a giant, yet empty suit of armor, perhaps a hundred meters tall.
What's that?!
...Ahem. Consider this the trump card I've prepared for today.
Now, Zuikaku, brace yourself.
"Thunderhead on lake's reflection, by my heavenly blade, unleash thy lightning."
"Cleave!"
The suit of armor swung its sword toward the sky, cleaving the barrier like heaven and earth.
Countless demons emerged from the horizon in response to Musashi's strike.
The horde of monsters descended from sky and sea alike, a wave of sheer chaos.
Uh, what are those?!
...They're here to stop you from approaching Akagi.
Allow me to strike once more and clear a path for you.
"Thousand thunderbolts that pierce the stars, by my heavenly blade, purify the heavens."
"Cleave!"
Her slash cleaved the wave of demons in twain, cutting a path big enough for a shipgirl to proceed.
*cough cough*... Urgh!
Musashi? Are you okay?!
Forget me! You must hurry to Akagi!
...Okay! Good luck, Musashi!

sequence: "Sanzu River, blooming spider lilies."
"Draw in the eternal, and burn the heavens."
"Sister... It's finally time..."

Whence Flowers Bear No Fruit

<size=45>9 Retreat</size>

scripts.say: Meanwhile, on the Sakura Empire mainland, black mist-borne hostiles began appearing on the streets.
KABOOOM!
Stay calm! Don't leave your post!
We aren't suited to combat on land, but neither are they!
All they have are sheer numbers. They're neither rational nor organized!
They're just beasts, in the end. Fight calmly, and we can pick them off one by one!
You're not wrong, but war is a numbers game. We won't last forever against an endless flood of them.
And even if we can hold out, the same won't be true of Yamashiro's mansion and the barrier.
You saw how Hiyou and Junyou turned into METAs.
If the barrier is broken... we're in for a bad time.
You're right in that we can't stay on the defensive forever... but if we're going to retreat, I'm not sure where–
KABOOOM!
Huh? Who's fighting over there?
And what the hell is that golden light?
Sometime later, at Yamashiro's mansion...
Good day, everyone. I have come with Kitakaze and the Mutsuki-class shipgirls to support you.
Ibuki! Great timing.
As you can see, the corrosive power is just getting stronger. Our barrier is on its last legs.
Ibuki, can you and the Mutsuki-class girls do something about the barrier?
Yes, and no...
The corrosion strengthens as the ritual progresses. Continuing to protect this place is no long-term plan.
Great Veteran, I propose a strategic withdrawal to Yakumoyama before it's too late.
Yakumoyama's barrier was set up by Yamato herself. With Izumo's shrine, it may even be stronger than Heaven's Gate.
The only road leading in or out is a single steep mountain path. Perfect for defense.
Yakumoyama, huh... I told Izumo I'd go there someday. But now isn't the time, especially under these circumstances...
Great Veteran, we must keep up with the situation at hand. Overcome this crisis, and then we can think about the rest.
...You're right. Do we have a way to move outside the barrier without being corroded, though?
No worries. I already made preparations for that.
Mutsuki-class ships, form up!
On Ibuki's signal, the Mutsuki-class shipgirls stood in formation with ritual items in hand, creating a circular area that would fend off the corrosion.
The inside of the area glowed brightly. Countless golden butterflies flew around inside.
"All of a world in this magic circle."
Great Veteran, gather everyone in here! We're retreating to Yakumoyama!
Commander, Commander! You busy, nya? Actually, stop even if you're busy, nya!
I need ya to see my latest masterpiece, nya!
Just as I happen to get a moment to breathe amidst my afternoon work, Akashi comes in bearing a suspicious device.
No means no. I still have work to do.
You gotta take a little break sooner or later, nya!
What did you bring in here this time?
This is my newest full-immersion VR game: Vagabond City!
Is this one of those massive role-playing games?
It's no mere game, nya! I've positioned you as the Commander of the Thorn City Counterintelligence Team, nya!
You can investigate anyone in the city, arrest whoever you feel like... How's that sound, nya?
That sounds like a big promise, but I confess, I am intrigued.
Urged on by curiosity, I accept the device and flip the switch.
Okay... Link start, nya!
My brain seems to switch gears all at once as a vivid current of data rushes before me.

sequence: Consciousness synchronization complete.
Counterintelligence Team - Commander
Location: Commercial center
Sensory synchronization... 100%
Welcome to Thorn City.
Prepare to carve your own destiny.

scripts.say: As the darkness recedes, all of my senses are bombarded. When I open my eyes again, I'm on the roof of a skyscraper.
I see you've finally logged in.
Goodness, you kept me waiting. When this job is over, I expect you to make things up to me.
I hear a familiar voice, as clear and gentle as rippling water.
Unryuu? You're the guide for this beta test? No, wait... An NPC?
NPC? Hahaha! You're such a card. I'm the one and only ace of the Thorn City Counterintelligence Team, in the flesh – your adjutant...
And your experienced senior, who you ought to address with respect.
Heheh, I don't mind the sound of that... Er, ahem. That aside, your mission is a simple one. Someone stole the municipal management system's operational data, and we need to retrieve it.

sequence: Municipal Management System: Mission Updated. Objective: Recover the stolen data. A suggested route has been set.
Municipal Management System: Mission Updated. Objective: Recover the stolen data. A suggested route has been set.
Municipal Management System: Mission Updated. Objective: Recover the stolen data. A suggested route has been set.
Municipal Management System: Mission Updated. Objective: Recover the stolen data. A suggested route has been set.

scripts.say: A translucent mission interface unfolds in my periphery, displaying a map with markers and a detailed route.
The role you were assigned is awfully convenient. I wish I could get such detailed info.
Role?
Your abilities, basically. As long as you have your title of Commander, you'll be given detailed intel support.
That's how this city works. We follow the rules based on our assigned roles, and we do the missions we're given by the system.
Huh. Then per the original plan, you'll be infiltrating while I monitor you and provide backup.
Yes, yes. You're the Commander, after all.
She turns around to face the neon abyss sprawling all around us. Gradually, her body turns to water.
Let's get this mission started, then.
Inside the backup safehouse at the dock, Nayoro emerges from the shadows without a sound.
I've deployed a layer of electronic camouflage. For now, we can consider ourselves safe.
But you never know when things might change, with Thorn City in this state...
We don't have much time, Commander. Have you made progress recruiting the other Vagabonds?
I personally met with everyone on L'Indomptable's list.
Oh? Only the ones on the list?
What about the ones not on the list, then? You don't intend to contact them?
For example, the person who's been with you all along... Little old me?
She gazes at me expectantly. Is she the key to victory, or is she an unpredictable risk?
You were never an outsider to me, Nayoro.
Welcome to the team.
There's my Commander. I always knew you'd make the right choice.
No wonder you're so popular, even in this game.
Unryuu, synchronize our intel. It's time to make our final decision.
You can join the team another time. Right now, I need something from you.
Now, you say?
Yeah. Get me the shift schedules of the municipal management building's security staff.
With that, our future activities will be guaranteed safe.
Is this a test for me? Alright, Commander... I'll see you again soon.
She exits the safehouse, leaving me alone... with Unryuu, who has been watching our exchange from the shadows.
Commander... You sent her away deliberately, didn't you?
It was a precaution. Synchronize our intel for me, please.
Unryuu activates the command desk's holographic system, projecting a 3D model of Thorn City.
Based on the intel we've collected, there are a few things we can be certain of.
The broadcast tower is on the top level of the management building. Players have gathered there, but with enough help, I believe we can lure them elsewhere.
Also, regarding the Protocol Zero key obtained from Gorizia's data chip...
The coastal laboratory isn't far from here. It should only take a few people to divert players on the route, but we have no grasp of the situation inside... nor of what we may encounter.
Of course... Waiting patiently for a better opportunity is always an option.
The decision is yours. No matter what, I'll be right by your side.
Intel, comrades, trump cards... and our options. All of the preparations we've made await my final decision.
Municipal Management System: Your choice will determine the outcome of this story.

options.content: (Stand by and wait for an opportunity.)

scripts.say: With Nayoro's help, I manage to breach the management building.
Even as I confidently walk into the lobby, there is no blaring alarm. Far from it, the lights in the corridor light up in tune with my steps, as if welcoming me.
Heheheh. You're just as bold as I thought, Commander!
That voice... Long Island? Did you hijack the entire system?!
I didn't just hijack it – this is a total takeover!
Tell me, Commander. Did you have fun in this unscripted game?
If you play it again, try making some different choices!

sequence: Ending Log: 01 – It Begins As It Ends
Calculating score...
Play time: 7.12 hours
Overall rating: C
The curtain has fallen before the audience could be seated.
Vagabond City closed beta test terminated.

scripts.say: A feeling of detachment washes over me and recedes again in no time. Before I can open my eyes, I hear Akashi scream.
Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A... Aw crap, nya! Long Island cracked my server admin override codes, nya!
And she even sent me a rude message about it, nya!
Commander! Help me, nya... She locked me out of my own server, nya...
Vagabond City is all hers now, nya...
Desperate times call for desperate measures.
Akashi, unplug the server.
Got it, nya! ...Wait, nya?!
Commander! We can't unplug it, nya! I'll lose all my valuable test data, nya!
Do you have any better ideas?
N-no, nya... I don't know where she might be hiding either, nya...
Then that's our one option.
She may be invisible in the gaming world, but not out here.
Nya! Then I'll go unplug it right away, nya!

sequence: The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan - The End

scripts.say: As the night wears on, the Vagabonds scattered across the city take their positions. On my command, they spring into action.
Alarms blare across the city all at once. Unryuu and I use the opportunity to infiltrate the laboratory.
The device for inputting the Protocol Zero key is within sight.
We successfully reset the system. With no fanfare or explosions, the whole city goes dark at once. Instantly after, it lights up again, as if given new life.

sequence: Municipal Management System:
Low-level format complete
Purging all improper control protocols and derivative data.
Restarting municipal management system core...
Initializing citizen profiles and roles...
Order restoration protocol complete.

scripts.say: The wanted notice disappears, and frozen privileges are gradually restored, bringing order back to Thorn City.
It worked... We've done it, Commander! You're getting rewarded handsomely later!
Yeah... It's all over.

sequence: Ending Log: 03 – Order Rebuilt
Calculating score...
Play time: 57.32 hours
Overall rating: A
In the name of order, we rebuild.
Vagabond City closed beta test terminated.

scripts.say: As expected, I'm hit by an intense feeling of detachment. When I open my eyes, I'm back in my office at the port.
Commander! Are you okay, nya?!
There was a sudden fluctuation in the data stream, and it forced my test server to reboot, nya!
I freed it from Long Island's control. It was all thanks to the Protocol Zero key you left for me.
Thank goodness, nya... That could've been really bad, nya!
But... All of my test data got totally scrubbed, nya! There goes a month of my hard work... This sucks, nya!
Isn't a reformatting preferable to letting Long Island keep control over your system?
Yeah... I GUESS, nya...
Long Island's got some nerve, nya...
Taking my game away from me, nya? I'm gonna find her and make her pay me back by being my new QA tester, nya!

sequence: The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan - The End

scripts.say: As the night wears on, the vagabonds scattered across the city take their positions. On my command, they spring into action.
Alarms blare across the city all at once. Unryuu, Nayoro, and I use the opportunity to infiltrate the laboratory.
The device for inputting the Protocol Zero key is within sight.
And now, Commander... It's time for the little surprise I prepared for you.
Suddenly, Nayoro steps in front of me and shoves Unryuu away.
Commander, stop her!
It's already too late. A heavy shutter slams down, cutting off her cries.
Heehee, you look so cute when you're surprised.
"What could she be planning?" Is that what you're thinking right now?
The answer couldn't be simpler.
Ever since I first realized that this would be the perfect way to seize you for myself...
Your fate was already sealed.
If the script continues as written, the story will end right here.
Her electrified tail smashes the control panel, forever destroying any chance of success.
And you know I can't have that. I still want to toy with you until I'm satisfied...
So... I say it's time you and I start a new game.
Then we can be together... forever and ever.
Forever...
And ever...

sequence: Ending Log: 05 – Obsession Unbound
Calculating score...
Play time: 58.10 hours
Overall rating: B
In the name of love, I seize you.
Vagabond City closed beta test reset.
The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan - The End

scripts.say: The Thorn City municipal management building – the heart of its rules and orders – silently stands tall in the darkness.
We must cause a diversion big enough to lure away the security staff, then seize the opening to attack the broadcasting center on the top floor.
Our goal is to free everyone from the system's control. Call everybody and tell them to follow the plan.
The hour hand strikes midnight, and chaos erupts across the city all at once.
The traffic signal system gets jammed, turning all the lights red on the main street. Streetlights suddenly go out in several blocks, casting surveillance feeds into darkness.
Unryuu transforms into a surging torrent of water, covering me while I rush toward the management building.
She decimates all of the automated defenses before guiding me through the last security gate. Finally, we reach the citywide broadcasting center.
Commander, the analogue radio isn't under the system's control. We have one minute to ourselves!
That's plenty.
Unryuu overwrites the broadcasting privileges, then simultaneously sends me the go-ahead signal and turns up the volume slider.
To everyone who hears this broadcast: Somebody has seized control of the city's management system.
My voice travels on the radio waves across Thorn City's night sky.
The missions that have been forced on you, the unlawful arrest warrants – they're merely the work of a hacker doing it for a laugh.
So please, ignore any missions the system may assign to you.
Even if the system declares you a rulebreaker, just shrug and let it do it.
Every one of us has the freedom to choose, just as you have the freedom to play this game!
Commander, the security officers have stopped in their tracks!
It worked... You actually did it! You can expect a generous reward from me later.
Nice. Well... I guess it's over now.
Wait... Calling on all players to resist the system?! Talk about a simple yet effective strategy.
Hmph. Only you can work this kind of magic on people, Commander. I'll concede that you won – this time!

sequence: Ending Log: 04 – A Call for Freedom
Calculating score...
Play time: 59.34 hours
Overall rating: A
Rules can be rejected.
Vagabond City closed beta test concluded.

scripts.say: Feeling the gravity of the real world weighing on me, I breathe a sigh of relief.
Wow! Using the broadcasting system to tell all the players to reject their missions – what a move, nya!
That was peak entertainment, nya! I'm gonna use this as the foundation for the official release trailer, nya!
Sounds like you've got a new idea.
You bet, nya! This "bug" in the game has given me loads of new ideas, nya!
Now just to deal with Long Island, nya! Once I get my hands on her, I'm gonna make her work overtime as my QA tester, nya!

sequence: The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan - The End

scripts.say: The Thorn City municipal management building – the heart of its rules and orders – silently stands tall in the darkness.
External jamming initiated and security staff redeployed. Commander, I've secured a path to the broadcasting center.
Our goal is to free everyone from the system's control. Call everybody and tell them to follow the plan.
The hour hand strikes midnight, and chaos erupts across the city all at once. The traffic signal system locks up, and surveillance cameras stop functioning. Everything seems to be going as we hoped.
Security level outside the building has fallen to the minimum level. We're clear to go inside, Commander.
That was easy. TOO easy...
We break into the heart of the management building and push open the door to the broadcasting center. There's a massive, round screen displaying the night-shrouded city streets.
The control panel stands silent and ready, as though it had expected our coming.
Commander, the analogue radio isn't under the system's control. We have one minute to ourselves!
There's no time to think. I bring the microphone up to my mouth and push up the volume slider.
To everyone who hears this broadcast: Somebody has–
Then, all the lights in the broadcasting center go out at once. The only lighting left is the faint, red emergency lights.
Sorry, Commander, but I can't let you continue.
Suddenly, Nayoro weaves between the two of us and shoves Unryuu away.
Commander, stop her!
It's already too late. A heavy shutter slams down, cutting off her cries.
Heehee, you look so cute when you're surprised.
"What could she be planning?" Is that what you're thinking right now?
The answer couldn't be simpler.
Ever since I first realized that this would be the perfect way to seize you for myself...
Your fate was already sealed.
Her electrified tail smashes the control panel, forever destroying any chance of success.
What's the point in waking everyone up anyway? THIS is the best ending you could ask for!
Become a Vagabond with me... and let me be by your side forever.
Forever...
And ever...

sequence: Ending Log: 06 – Silent Betrayal
Calculating score...

Overall rating: B
Together forever.
Vagabond City closed beta test terminated.

scripts.say: Day after day passed, but a good opportunity never came to us.
Quite the opposite, even – our tactics panel, which was empty just a few days ago, is now lit up like a Christmas tree with the signals of players who've tracked us down.
Why is there suddenly such a large number of players?
Commander, I'm detecting large groups of moving players in the east and west sectors. To make matters worse, the highway has been sealed off.
This doesn't seem like a search... More like a siege.
As if to emphasize those words, dozens of footsteps sound from outside the safehouse before the door slides open.
Ahh... Fooound you, Commander♥

sequence: Special Event Announcement:
Limited-Time Festival: Caught You, Commander♡
Location: Old Town Safehouse
Reward: Autographed Commander-Sized Body Pillow
Event Reminder: Please bear safety in mind and capture the target in an orderly manner.
Event Planners: Akashi & Long Island

scripts.say: As the system announcement gets released, the commotion outside the window grows even louder.
Wow! This game's really lively! It wouldn't be the same if I weren't here!
Target spotted. Commencing hunt!
I'm only here to ensure that others don't get rough with you, my honourable Master...
It seems they prepared a grand celebration just for you, Commander.

sequence: Ending Log: 00 – A Loving Siege
Calculating score...
Play time: 83.52 hours
Overall rating: S
With love from the whole playerbase.
Vagabond City closed beta test – perfect ending.

scripts.say: My mind is pulled back into reality, and I'm greeted not by the lingering sound of the game, but rather by a crisp notification.
50,000... 100,000... 150,000, nya! Another Tracker's Pack sold, nya!
Yeah, I saw! People snatched up every last new digital collectible in three seconds flat!
Care to explain what's going on, Akashi?
Nya?! Wh-when'd you wake up, nya? Err, I mean, thanks for beta-testing, nya!
Let me guess – this city-wide manhunt was a paid test event that you and Long Island had planned from the very start, am I right?
Well, not from the VERY start, nya...
I'm expecting royalties for using my likeness on those body pillows.
Of course, nya! You know me – I'm a trustworthy merchant, nya!

sequence: The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan - The End

scripts.say: There are only a couple of dots representing allies on the holographic map inside the safehouse. They're utterly tiny compared to the vast map.
Commander... We have extremely few on our side. It'll be nigh-impossible to cause widespread confusion as we've planned.
We're out of time. With every passing minute, Long Island's grip on the system grows stronger.
Change of plan. We'll focus on a single point to cause an extensive circuit overload.
Our plan began at the darkest time of the night. We overloaded a transformer substation, sending out dazzling blue arcs of lightning that tore through the sky.
Seizing the opportunity, Unryuu and I left the safehouse behind.
Unfortunately, just three minutes later...
Well, well! What're you two doing this late? Taking a walk?
A live feed of Long Island appears on a giant screen by the coast. Her one hand supports her chin, while the other holds a controller.
Long Island...
Playtime is over, Commander!
Next test, you really should invite more people to join you on your quest. It'll be more fun that way!
She snaps her fingers. Unryuu's body as well as mine begins to gradually disintegrate into little fragments of data that vanish in the game.

sequence: Ending Log: 02 – Insufficient Numbers
Calculating score...

Overall rating: B
No one can truly be a lone wolf in this city.
Vagabond City closed beta test terminated.

Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A... Aw crap, nya! Long Island cracked my server admin override codes, nya!
And she even sent me a rude message about it, nya!
Commander! Help me, nya... She locked me out of my own server, nya...
Vagabond City is all hers now, nya...
Desperate times call for desperate measures.
Akashi, unplug the server.
Got it, nya! ...Wait, nya?!
Commander! We can't unplug it, nya! I'll lose all my valuable test data, nya!
Do you have any better ideas?
N-no, nya... I don't know where she might be hiding either, nya...
Then that's our one option.
She may be invisible in the gaming world, but not out here.
Nya! Then I'll go unplug it right away, nya!

scripts.say: Unryuu throws herself backward. City lights shine through her waters, making her glow like a kaleidoscope.
A great flower blooms in the night sky, before dissolving into the deep darkness.
Unryuu, situation report.
As water, she easily slips through door cracks and ventilation ducts. Nothing can halt her advance, and indeed, she reaches her target in no time.
So far, so good. I've successfully followed the route to my destination.
Stay vigilant. Once you have the data, get out of there.
Commander... Something feels wrong. There's nobody here.
It isn't just that floor, either – the entire building is empty.
Is this a trap?
I don't know, but my intuition is rarely off...
Get out of there! Hurry!
I make an instant decision, but it's already too late.
KABOOOOM!
A deafening explosion roars below. The building's glass walls shatter into a rain of shards.
Commander... Hurry... You have to run...
As flames billow up from the level below, I hear a grating noise through my communicator.

sequence: <size=45>Municipal Management System:</size>
<size=45>Warning! Dangerous attack detected!</size>
<size=45>High probability of severe threat to public security.</size>
<size=45>Freezing all roles in accordance with municipal law.</size>
<size=45>Cease all actions and await investigation.</size>

scripts.say: The crimson system alert fills my vision. Just as I'm trying to grasp the situation, I hear a voice.
What an exciting opening, huh, Commander... Hey, wait a second... This gameplay is so last decade...
But... Hehehe. Now that I've hacked myself some admin permissions... I'll show off my skills as a gamer!
The world before me flickers harshly. Red lights shine eerily from the neon abyss.
What did you do?
Hehe, from now on, you're the city's hottest easter egg!
Have fun with the new event this ghostie prepared for you, Commander~

sequence: Interference detected from unknown permissions... Player role information overwritten... ERROR. ERROR.
A player has been found to have endangered Thorn City security and stolen municipal property.
Automatically issuing municipality-wide wanted notice.
Revoking player role.
Loading new role: Vagabond.

scripts.say: The whir of propellers fills the air, and the blinding beams of searchlights converge on the rooftop like a cage of light.
I wrench open the grate below me and follow the water's flow, eventually finding an access hatch that I jump from to land in a dark alleyway.
But suddenly, a black car drifts in front of me and squeals to a stop.
That's enough hide-and-seek, Commander.
The door opens, and Nayoro emerges, pointing a stun gun at me.
Wow, you're in rough shape. I have to say, though, I'm impressed that you lived long enough to meet me.
Her role and other information appear on a panel in my periphery.

sequence: Identifier: Nayoro
Affiliation: Thorn City Intelligence Bureau
Role: Counterintelligence Chief
Status: Role Revoked
New Role: Vagabond

scripts.say: You're the counterintelligence chief? But how...
Shush. More precisely, I'm the FORMER chief. And you're the Counterintelligence Team's former Commander...
Three minutes ago, the system determined that I was under suspicion of illegally aiding the target of a mission. It revoked my role and turned me into a Vagabond.
But I'm quick on my feet, if I may say so myself. Before it could take away my privileges, I redirected all of this area's security in the opposite direction.
Now... Will you stay here, or will you come with me?
As I close the door, Nayoro slams on the gas pedal. Her car rushes out of the alley and down onto the main street.
Just then, our terminals both emit harsh beeps.

sequence: Municipal management system:
URGENT municipal security mission
Mission type: Capture
Objective: Former Commander of the Counterintelligence Team
Reward: Ownership of the Commander
Recipient: All players

scripts.say: Fasten your seatbelt, Commander.
Things are about to get a little bumpy.
The car takes a sharp turn down a narrow alley, narrowly evading a temporary barricade set up on the main street.
What's this about "ownership" in the message we got?
Exactly what it says. This is all just in the game, but...
According to the plotline, I was to take you in after you lost your role, making you my property.
Unfortunately, someone dug that privilege out from the system's core and made it into a reward that can be obtained by anyone.
Umm, what would have happened in the original plotline?
After I framed you, you'd lose the role and wander the streets until I found you.
That doesn't sound very different from what's happening now.
But it is! The privilege that should've been mine has been taken and used as a mission reward.
What would you call this, Commander? Theft? Or a challenge?
So, basically... An unexpected mishap happened during this test, and someone managed to hijack control of the system?
You catch on quickly. There's just one question, though.
Where will you go, Commander?
Shall we go to my safe house, or... are you ready to go to the municipal management building to turn yourself in?
Think carefully about your answer. It could influence the course of this game.
There's a moment of silence between us, dotted only by the crackling of electricity on Nayoro's tail.
If they want me that badly, then they can have me.
You're walking straight into a trap if you do that, Commander.
I know. But sometimes, the decisive move isn't made directly on the game board.
You never cease to amaze me... Still, I have to confess that I'm a little disappointed.
Let's go to your safe house to prepare first. If the management system is malfunctioning, then we need to tell everyone not to obey it.
How decisive! I happen to know a way we can tell everyone, too.
There's a broadcasting tower on top of the management building. It's independent, so it doesn't receive orders from the system. We can use that to communicate with all players in the city.
However... That tower has tip-top security. You won't be able to get into that building alone, you know...
In that case, we'll need more information on the Vagabonds.
If I can't do it alone, then we'll just have to find more people like us.
The Vagabonds, eh? I know a trustworthy information broker. She might be able to help us out.
In the innermost booth of an unassuming corner café, our coffee gets cold as we wait.
Unryuu, are you sure you're okay after that explosion?
A silly little explosion isn't enough to hurt me. Rather than dwell on that, would you like me to go check our surroundings?
Our rendezvous time passed ages ago. I'm worried that something went wrong.
True... Can I ask you to keep an eye out? If anything seems amiss, we'll run.
Thanks to Nayoro, we had plans to meet with the information broker L'Indomptable here, but she still hasn't shown herself.
Commander, it seems she's here... I'll keep watch outside. Please, be careful.
The bell on the café door rings, and a girl enters. She heads straight toward my booth and sits down across from me.
You shouldn't have come here.
I know that, but I need information.
I might not have the information you need... I've lost my role as information broker.
L'Indomptable picks up her coffee and takes a sip. After shooting a cautious glance to the side, she speaks to me quietly.
After all that happened last night, it got revoked.
Without it, I can't even open my basic information interface. I've lost my means of gathering intel.
The only system message I've gotten since was the one saying to capture you.
There are a whole lot of people after you.
Even your role was revoked? They must be trying to get rid of anyone who could pose a threat to them.
Are you implying that it wasn't the system that revoked my role?
It was the system, sure, but it sounds like someone's controlling it behind the scenes.
In the middle of last night's explosion, I heard someone's voice... That must be the person pulling the strings.
A voice, you say? No wonder this whole thing has felt so fishy.
That arbitrary accusation, the special mission given to the whole city... If you're right about this and someone is behind it all, then all the pieces fit.
I need to find the other Vagabonds in this city. They're not enemies, but potential allies.
If we want to fight the mastermind, we need to work together.
She falls silent for a moment. Then, she types something on her terminal and sends me an encrypted data package.
This is the list I put together before I lost my privileges.
It has all the other people who suddenly lost their roles, along with where they were last seen.
I'm going to keep investigating in my own way. If you need something, contact me... You know how, right?
As the Message Received notification pops onto my terminal, L'Indomptable stands up, holding her hat close to her brow.
The rest is up to you, Commander of Counterintelligence... No – Commander of the Vagabonds.
Following the list given to me by L'Indomptable, I arrive at a factory in the coastal industrial area.
(According to her intel, Gorizia carried out her final mission here before her role was revoked.)
Just as I go to look inside, I hear a faint rustling nearby.
Mm... Mngh...
When I look that way, I spot a figure in the corner of the factory floor, bound by ropes.
Gorizia, is that you?
When she hears my voice, she struggles to lift her head.
C-Commander!
What happened to you?
As you can see... I'm a failure of an agent who stumbled right into a trap! A clueless victim!
She tries to project an air of helplessness, but it's so obviously theatric that it falls flat.
If you save me, I swear I'll repay you... I'll do anything you want me to!
Hmm? But those ropes sure look like you tied them yourself.
Ah...! You're sharp, Commander. I'm impressed.
Now that you've figured me out, there's only one thing I can do!
She tries to push herself upright, but the momentum is too much. The rope digs into her clothes and skin, eliciting a sharp cry.
Huh? Wh-why can't I untie it? It worked when I practiced...
Despite her struggles, the knots only become more tangled.
Umm... So, why is this happening?
The plan was that I would pretend to be trapped. When you came to help me, worried, I would suddenly... Ahem... Ugh, it's so tight.
Gorizia gives up and confesses to her scheme.
As soon as I finished investigating this place, the system revoked my agent status...
Then, I got a new mission. It made me wonder, what if I could be the one to capture you?
But I tied the knot wrong... and now I can't untie it... Hngh...
M-my dear Commander, umm... Can you help me? At this rate, I'll be trapped forever...
She desperately writhes amidst the ropes.
You really are stuck now? Then will you give me something in exchange for untying you?
I've been investigating this place for a long time, so I have a lot of data. I'll hand it over to you! It's right here...
Struggling to twist her body, she thrusts her chest my way. A small data chip sticks out from its hiding place.
I-it's stuck... Hnngh...
I step forward, my fingertips gently taking hold of the chip.
She tenses up for a moment, and her breathing becomes ragged.
Nnh... B-be gentle...
As I slowly remove it, she breathes a sigh of relief. However, there seems to be a hint of disappointment in her eyes.
I insert the chip into my device to find various bits of information about this industrial area. However, none of it seems useful.
Just as I'm about to close it, however, the screen suddenly flickers. An encrypted file called "Protocol Zero Key" appears in my file directory.
C-Commander... someone's activated... the system's admin privileges, nya...
Protocol Zero... at the coast's laboratory... Use the key... reinitialize...
Akashi's message is cut off by a sudden jamming signal.
Protocol Zero? Does it reinitialize the system from within? That's one way to go about it...
Freed from the ropes, Gorizia stands up and rubs her wrists. However, she doesn't leave – she just gazes at me with expectant eyes.
Commander... What will you do now? As for me...
I didn't just fail my mission... I'm left without a role now, too.
Should I take her along, potentially gaining a useful ally? Or should I continue to act alone for the sake of secrecy?
I could use help. Care to join me?
R-really?! You mean you need me–
She's cut off by a jarring noise outside the factory. I hear footsteps rushing our way.
Players must have come here for the mission!
Commander... There's a hidden passage on the east side! Follow me!
She takes my hand and sprints deep into the factory with surprising agility.
Rather than linger, I use my planned route to escape and vanish into the night.
Gorizia remained alone in the silent factory. Only after the sound of footsteps had faded did she turn and slip into a hidden passage.
Commander, we're about to enter the airspace above the central skyscraper area.
