Stay on your toes. Taking a helicopter draws a lot of attention.
Relax. I "borrowed" this helicopter. Nobody will know we're taking it for a short spin.
Below the window stretches the neon sea of Thorn City.
I cast my gaze at a distant high-rise building. According to our intel, the phantom thief Choukai will appear there tonight.
Oh! Look – there's someone on top of that building.
Let's get a closer look.
We fly closer to the skyscraper and see a figure calmly standing at the top, arms folded and her silver hair fluttering in the night breeze.
Who would've thought... Right as I, Maya, am in the midst of finding my prey, it delivers itself right to me.
Maya... That name wasn't on L'Indomptable's list.
Were you drawn here by the mission?
Yeah. What about you? Here to witness me becoming the city's best assassin?
That would be a real sight, but it's not happening tonight.
Very well...
Then, as the ironclad rule dictates, when an assassin is discovered by their target...
We'll finish it here and now!
Light glimmers off of her blade. The helicopter suffers a calculated strike and rocks hard in the air.
Commander!
Accept your– Huh?!
The moment she tries to catch me, I dodge to the side and grab her wrist, exploiting her momentum to pull her backward.
Thrown off balance, she faceplants into my chest. Using my free hand, I lock her in a hold.
Son of a– Let go! Wh-what the hell are you doing?!
You got yourself into this by boarding our helicopter.
Urgh... Let GO, dammit! My blade – my pride and honor – won't stand for this!
Hold still. You could fall.
A tremble shakes her body. Although she stops struggling, she won't stop squirming out of shame and resentment.
Listen. That mission you accepted wasn't authentic. Someone's been tampering with the system.
Oh... And you're trying to find out who, right?
Yeah. I'm gonna uncover the truth for us all.
She firmly grasps the grip of her sword.
Alright. Then tell me, Commander, what should I do?
Every choice has consequences in this virtual city where danger lurks around every corner. What to choose...
I've got a plan, and I'm recruiting Vagabonds across the city. Wanna join me, Maya?
Of course! Then from now on, I entrust you with my strength and my blade.
We're standing in the eye of the storm. Things are about to get dangerous. You shouldn't come along.
Okay. Even if I'm not with you, I'll watch your back from the shadows.
The night is as dark as ink. I've snuck into the luxurious penthouse at the top of the high-rise with one goal – finding someone.
According to L'Indomptable, the phantom thief Choukai is planning to steal something from this place tonight.
I push open the ventilation duct's grille and land in the penthouse without a sound. It's dead quiet, save for the rhythm of my own breathing.
There's not even a single guard here.
Did Choukai already do the deed and make it out?
Just then, I hear a noise from the art gallery – grumbling intermixed with chagrin.
Ugh... My back hurts... How long must I hold this pose?
I follow the sound of the noise and open the heavy, wooden door.
Eek! How could this even happen? I was sure I broke most of the infrared sensors...
This is looking like another failed mission...
Choukai is locked in a pretty physically straining pose, surrounded by crisscrossing lasers.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, she instinctively turns and locks eyes with me.
...Looks like you're in the middle of something.
Huh?! C-Commander?! What are you doing he– Actually, how'd you even get in here?!
Oh no... Don't tell me you're on guard duty tonight and you've come to arrest me!
A tremble causes her arm to connect with a laser beam, but the alarm does not sound.
What? Strange... The alarm didn't trip.
I turned off the security system before I went in.
Like a puppet on strings suddenly cut loose, she collapses from fatigue and falls into my arms.
Th-thank you... If you hadn't come, this might have truly been it for me...
I feel the warmth of her body through the thin cloth of her phantom thief outfit.
The back of her neck is as red as a cherry, and her animal ears twitch with shyness.
Didn't think you'd get caught by something this basic, considering your track record of smooth escapes. What went wrong?
Well... There were simply too many lasers. Just as I dodged one from the front, two came up from behind, and before I knew it, I was completely cornered.
If it's already hard, why'd you make things even harder for yourself by sending out a calling card?
I have no choice. It's a mandatory requirement of my mission.
Hang on... Aren't you on the wanted list, Commander?!
My mission objective was to capture you! Granted, you're the one who's captured me now, but still...
Wait, so the system didn't strip you of your role and turn you into a Vagabond?
Come again? "Vagabond"?
Oh, right... You probably lost your role because you couldn't complete even a single one of your missions as a phantom thief.
*sob*... Y-you've hit the nail on the head... I really am pathetic.
Saying that, she looks up at me with eyes brimming with anticipation.
Hey, how about changing gears from being a failed thief to becoming a Vagabond with me?
B-but... Do you really need me, despite the fact that I can't even infiltrate properly?
Of course I do. I need all the allies I can get right now.
W-well... In that case, I'll come with you! Whatever it takes, I'll carry out my mission for you!
There is the buzz of helicopter blades outside the window. It seems other players have caught on to what's happening at the penthouse.
Seems our audience got here sooner than expected.
Oh no! Wh-what do we do?!
We're taking another route. Stay close to me.
O-okay! Lead the way!
(I really can't drag any more uninvolved people into this.)
Guess we're lucky your role didn't get tampered with. You'd better get out of here before any guards show up.
With those words, I leap off the balcony and vanish into the city's darkness.
1:11 AM. I've come to a coast on the outskirts of Thorn City to meet up with Seydlitz.
She is the last Vagabond on the list, as well as an agent of the Counterintelligence Team.
(She's no doubt gotten that mission to capture me as well, but if the intel is correct, her role should've already been taken from her.)
(Let's see if I can manage to recruit her.)
I emerge from the shadows and show myself to Seydlitz, who's standing next to her parked motorcycle at our meeting spot.
She leans against her machine, a gun casually held in her right hand.
Freeze! Tell me the code phrase. "I give my all..."
"To be my Commandant's sharpest blade."
...Correct.
Her expression relaxes for but a moment before she assumes a sharp alertness. While her gun isn't pointed at me, her aura is still intimidating.
Not one step closer. Stop five meters away, take off your coat, and turn around in place.
Feeling strict, are we?
I'm sure you know why. Yesterday, I received two messages on my device.
The first said that my role had been permanently revoked. The second tasked me with a high-priority, citywide mission to capture you, Commandant.
So you're here to capture me, then?
Dropping her hostile attitude, she returns her gun to its thigh holster and leans back against her motorcycle again.
Don't be silly. This is just a bug, isn't it?
Not a bug, per se, more like someone took over the system and made it untrustworthy.
Sounds like something a hacker would do in a movie... I believe you, Commandant.
She puts her unwavering trust in me. The call has come for me to decide how to respond to that.
Hear me out – I need you on my side. Not as a subordinate the system gave me, but as a comrade I can trust.
After staying silent for a while, she adjusts her position.
As I just said, I believe you.
That being said, can I inquire about your plan? For instance, how–
Her words are cut off by the blaring of distant sirens. Blinking blue and red lights approach at breakneck speed from the road ahead.
Hop on, Commandant! Let's get out of here!
You don't need to make a choice at once. Staying silent and looking out for yourself is the best you can do right now.
After watching her ride off into the distance, I turn around and slip back into the dark.
Having returned to my safehouse, I breathe an overdue sigh of relief. Unryuu and Nayoro aren't back yet, and the only sound in the base is the low humming of machinery.
As I'm focusing on the monitors, I suddenly hear noises coming from the air vents above me.
I pull up security camera footage from inside the ventilation duct, which shows an infiltrator wearing a black suit making her way forward.
I've found it at last... This must be the safehouse where the Commander is hiding.
But this corner – it's completely unlike what the blueprints showed... Ugh... I-I've gotten myself stuck...
As she tries to adjust her posture, her leg carelessly touches the inside of the duct.
BWEEE!
A laser beam suddenly shoots out from the side, grazing her shoulder. Her suit instantaneously dissolves, exposing her bare skin.
Eek! Wh-what was that?!
Why would anyone have such an offense-oriented security system in their air ducts?!
Kizu frantically dodges beam after beam as they switch on, only to ultimately hit the metal plate at the end of the duct with her back.
Left with nowhere to go, she's struck by more lasers.
Her black suit burns off of her legs, revealing the supple thighs underneath. The toolbag at her waist and the holster on her thigh dissolve one after the next.
Wait... My equipment! Even my clothes! Nooo!
Before she can even catch her breath, a thick cluster of lasers comes darting toward her.
Curses... I can't possibly avoid that!
In her moment of desperation, she throws herself against the vent grille behind her, breaking through it and falling backward into the monitoring room.
Her suit, torn to shreds, is now little more than a few scraps and straps barely clinging to her body. Most of her skin is exposed.
*pant*... *pant*...
Wh-what kind of lasers are these?! My suit and equipment have been dissolved... I can't finish my mission like this!
Ah! D-don't look! Not when I'm like this!
Sitting on the floor, she desperately tries to cover herself up with her arms. Her face is deep red with shame.
Kizu? Talk about a... bold way to greet me.
Ugh... D-don't think for a second that I'll yield to you!
It seems she's also on a mission to capture me. Should I recruit her while I have the chance?
Agent Kizu, your gear – along with most of your weapons – has been neutralized by my security system.
You've failed your mission, so I'll offer you a suggestion. How about joining my side?
What? Th-the whole reason I'm here is to capture you! You think I would join forces with you?!
It'd be a good chance to work together. What's the problem as long as you finish your mission eventually?
She bites her lip, inner turmoil ravaging her.
A-alright! I shall aid you! First, though, I demand new clothing!
Right at that moment, I hear the sound of approaching helicopters coming from outside the base.
Guess we can't stick around.
Huh?! B-but my clothes!
With no hesitation, I place my coat on her shoulders.
We've gotta move! Change on the go! The exit's over there!
It's not your fault you failed your mission. My security system was just too good.
I take out a spare coat from the equipment closet and gently put it on the shivering girl.
Without waiting for her response, I swiftly slip through a secret door across the room and disappear into the night.

sequence: <size=51>Don't you think snow is such a strange thing?</size>
<size=51>The snow may melt, and it may freeze. It may become soft, like flowing water, or hard, like adamant ice.</size>
<size=51>But no matter what form it takes...</size>
<size=51>Its very essence does not change.</size>
<size=51>Our sacred ideals have always persisted, a bastion of power within the frigid seas.</size>
<size=51>Once, there was a time where we fought alongside the rest of the world to push back the Siren threat for the sake of humanity.</size>
<size=51>But as the war ground to a halt, massive Siren structures resembling icebergs began to form in our waters.</size>
<size=51>As our forces were stretched thin to deal with these threats, we drifted apart from Azur Lane.</size>
<size=51>War-torn, weary, and unable to join in the operations of Azur Lane, our name would soon be associated with these words...</size>
<size=51>"The Northern Parliament's fleet is weak."</size>
<size=51>...That is what the world came to believe.</size>

scripts.say: Has the battle finally begun...?
Ahahaha! I can't contain my excitement any longer!
In any case... Well, I hope that commander can make things worth our while.
Hehe~ I'm looking forward to meeting that person~
My lovely кролик is excited too.
Hehe, it's great to see everyone in high spirits, but first, you all have some work to first take care of in the North.
Until then, let us handle the hospitality! Isn't that right, Avrora?
Haha, you're in a pretty good mood too, Pamiat.
Of course I am! I'm all fired up too! Anyway, let's get going~!
All right, we should be safe here. Just gotta deal with the ones that're coming after us!
Heads up: more Sirens approaching from the southeast. Most of the ones we alerted have stopped moving, so we can take care of them easy peasy.
Man, these Eagle Union guys pack some amazing firepower for not even using Siren tech...
Is it because of the Commander's leadership skills? Is the Commander *that* big-brained? I've gotta look into this...
...Big-brained?
I could've sworn I just heard someone talking about me...
Oh, um, ahaha! Just thinking out loud!
A humanoid Siren is coming our way!
Oh, I know her all right! I've got a bomb with her name on it!
Once this enemy has been dealt with, we'll finally have some time to rest.
...Huh? What's that light coming from the Siren?!
Oh crap! Look out, Commander!
The Siren's weapon glowed. Its sights are aimed at me.
You shall harm NO ONE!
A burst of entwining flame and electricity rushed towards me. South Dakota rushed in front, blocking the attack with her shield.
That was close, it nearly hit the Commander... Pamiat, are you okay?
Oww... I'm fine, minus the back pain...
It seems Pamiat Merkuria, too, tried to protect me from the Siren's attack.
South Dakota looks like she took the hit well, but had it hit Pamiat instead, she could have suffered major damage...
Oh, and I'm expecting a "thank you" later, got it?
You deserve my thanks as well. Had you not alerted me to it, I wouldn't have been able to block it so well.
What did I miss? Oh gosh, are you okay, South Dakota?!
My rigging took only minor damage, but my radar and fire control are malfunctioning. I'd be hard-pressed to fight in my current state...
Malfunctioning?! Have the Sirens pulled out a new weapon on us?!
It would seem so. I was never expecting to encounter a weapon that targets our electronics, not in these waters...
This about confirms that the Sirens in the Bering Sea are not like what we've fought before.

options.content: South Dakota, I want you to fall back for now.

scripts.say: This about confirms that the Sirens in the Bering Sea are not like what we've fought before.

options.content: Everyone, steer clear of this new weapon at all costs!

scripts.say: Son of a... Now we've also gotta keep an eye out for that new weapon they have.
Doesn't seem to affect my planes, at least. Anyone else reckon the Sirens use this place as a testing ground for their new technology?
We won't know until we investigate further. What do you suggest, Commander?
If they keep hitting us with that weapon, we'll be in deep trouble. In that case...
Now what...

options.content: We'll take them out using torpedoes!
Saratoga, target them with your airstrikes!
Bombarding them from afar will make short work of them!

scripts.say: That is a great plan, but there is the risk that they'll surround us before we get within range...
Roger! Give 'em hell, bombers!
Let me handle it, Commander! My fire control just came back online!
Turrets 1 through 3 are locked and loaded!
Mark 6 guns, take aim and fire!
South Dakota's volleys land a direct hit on the Siren wielding the strange new weapon while also tearing the enemy line to shreds. Fire and smoke envelop the waters where the Sirens stood.
Wha... What the hell?!
The ship is rocking! What's going on?!
"Urgh! *cough*! Crazy Sirens... Now you've really gone and done it!"
"You leave me no choice! Sorry for this, but it's gotta be done!"
All of a sudden, I feel my consciousness begin to fade.
Rapidly... until everything goes black...
Waters around Siren stronghold - Eagle Union Task Force
*cough*... What just happened?
Cleve! Look!
Is this a... giant iceberg?! Hey, is everyone okay?
Dizzy, but okay... And confused! Where'd this thing come from?
Straight outta nowhere, that's where... Wait, where's the Commander?!
The Commander should be with the Northern Parliament ships on the other side!
Columbia, can you reach them?
No... I can't get a line through to either of them...
I know! My planes can find where th– Whuah?!
BOOOOM!
They've even stationed artillery on the iceberg?!
That isn't just some iceberg! It's one of the stronghold's defense mechanisms!
We're in biiig trouble!
First things first, get the hell out of its range! Those cannons will shoot us to bits if we stay here!
Dammit... We have no choice! Let us pray the Commander is safe!
Meanwhile, on the other side of the iceberg...
Wake up! C'mon, wake up, Commander!
Mrgh...
WAKE! UP! WE NEED YOU!
Hagh!
There you are, sleepyhead! Hope my wake-up call did you good.
Wake-up call...? Never mind, where are the others?
What a thoughtful commander you are. Sorry to say, but your Eagle Union buddies are on the other side of this wall of ice.
Also, I've got some good news, and some bad news for you.
The bad news are: this whole region became a Mirror Sea after that iceberg showed up, and we can't establish contact with the Eagle Union girls.
BOOOOM!
The good news will have to wait, it seems. First we must get out of harm's way of the enemy's attacks.
We need someone to command us, so... Do your thing!
Our battle with the Sirens continues...
Eep! Stay away, I can't handle it when combat gets too close for comfort!
Avrora, any update on where our backup is?
They're not far! We just need to hold on a little longer!
(Update? How can they still communicate over radio in a Mirror Sea?)
(Seeing how big this iceberg is, it's going to take some time before we can link back up with Saratoga's team...)
I'll try! But I'm nearly out of– Ah! There they are!
Thank goodness, they've finally come for us.
The backup is not what I had expected.
From beyond the horizon, through the icy winds blowing across the frozen ocean, a group of girls clad in white winter uniforms appear.
Their ranks are composed of destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.
Though their silhouettes are unmistakably human, their auras are anything but; they move like a majestic wave of steel. Their presence reassures the mind.
The riggings they don give off an extraordinary air, one much different to that of Pamiat's or Avrora's.
The weight and ruggedness of their equipment seemed to channel the biting cold of the Arctic North, an otherworldly blue light occasionally seeping out from the gaps between their black iron plates.
There was something almost "primal" about their appearance...
Almost as if... they were Sirens...
What I saw was not reinforcements from the Eagle Union...
But rather the full might of the Northern Parliament which had long been locked in conflict with the Sirens.
How's that for a timely entrance!
Heh. See, figures you wouldn't be able to do it without us. I suppose we can bail you out.
Ahahaha! A new type of Siren! Now this is what makes life worth living!
кролик is also raring for a fight...
Avrora, Pamiat, sorry we took so long to get here. It seems like we made it in the knick of time though.
I've grasped the situation. Just leave the rest to us.
Sorry for butting in all of a sudden. Anyway, you can just sit back and let us handle the enemies.
I'll do just that. I'm bushed...
Leave it to us... Comrades of the Northern Parliament, break their ranks!!
Ура！
Press forward! Beat them back!
I'll crush you all underfoot! Take this!
Ahahahaha! That's right! Let me see you struggle! Push me to the brink!
I'm not really feeling it, but... I'll do it if I must! Ура!
кролик... Let's wipe them out so we can go home sooner...
Whew! I'm getting a flash of inspiration! Take this!
The concentrated fire of the Northern Parliament quickly swallowed the Siren forces.
Здравствуй, comrade! The name's Kirov! Is this your first time seeing our fleet in action?
If you were surprised by what you saw, don't be shy and just give it to us straight! After all, you're no longer in the Eagle Union, comrade! We'd be glad to listen to anything you have to say!
But before that, let's get you acquainted with everyone here. The one who should do the honors is... the leader of the fleet!
Ah, that is but a formality. Commander, I am Soveskaya Rossiya, leader of the fleet. Pleased to meet you.
Having that said, that title is just provisional in nature. In actuality, we do not observe rank or status in our command structure.
First of all is Kirov. Her participation in this operation will be limited, but I'd at least like you to remember her face.
That's right. We'll get to fight together next time though.
...This is Chapayev. She's mastered her equipment better than any of us have. Also... I'd advise you to not get on her bad side.
I brought my bridle with me just in case. Anyway, let's get along~
Over here is Gangut. She acts hot-blooded and headstrong, but she's actually quite caring.
Hahaha! Comrade, let us fight for the safety of these azure lanes!
This is Tashkent. She was born in Sardegna, but she is one of our irreplaceable friends.
Hmph. I'll show you how strong I really am, dear comrade.
Dear...?
Haha... Don't read too much into it, all right?
This is Grozny. I'd advise you to stay away from her Кроли.
Clo...ri...?
Yes... This is my кроли убийца... It's a cute bunny that kills things...
Finally, this is Minsk. Her imagination can be a bit whimsical, but also helpful at times. Hopefully she can offer you some new insights.
Ehehe, pleased to meet you, Commander!
I assume I don't need to introduce Avrora and Pamiat Merkuria...
So this... is the Northern Parliament...
Before I saw them in action today, I always had been led to believe that they were a collection of peculiar personalities that couldn't hold their own compared to the other major factions.
...But only half of that statement held true. Their abilities were far beyond anything I had expected.
Under the provisions of our joint operation, the fleet of the Northern Parliament is now yours to command, comrade.
That's correct, comrade. This operation is not over yet. I hope you will wield our power effectively.
Kill confirmed! None may stand before the might of the Northern Parliament!
I'll beat you all to a pulp!
We'll kick out anything that trespasses upon our home, vermin or Siren...!
Haha! What do you think, Commander? Pretty good coordination on the fly, right?
Remarkably, despite not having a determined command structure, the members of the Northern Parliament all fought on the same page, as if linked by their strong sense of unity.
I know you like what you see, but it's best not to stare too much, Commander~
I felt a warm breath tickle my ear. Chapayev had snuck up behind me.
Here's the report on the current status of our positioning, supplies, and damages. Please look it over before everyone gets back.
Whether you choose to attack the Siren stronghold or rejoin with the Eagle Union forces, we'll likely encounter more enemies.
So, what will your orders be, Commander? I'll do anything you say~
What we should do now is...

options.content: Join up with the Eagle Union fleet.

scripts.say: I'm worried about my friends. But, now that our communications have been disrupted by the Mirror Sea, what should we do next...
This is solely based upon anecdotal evidence, but we believe that the "nucleus" must be destroyed in order to escape from the influence of the Mirror Sea.
From the information we've been able to analyze, we believe that then nucleus is located within the Siren stronghold.
In other words, it is necessary for us to capture the Siren stronghold in order to achieve your goal - and perhaps the Eagle Union has realized that as well.
дa. It is very likely that the Eagle Union is also en route to the stronghold.
Of course they are! Where else would they be headed to in this Mirror Sea?
Aha! I get it! If we just capture the stronghold, all we have to do is wait for the others to show up!
You mixed up our objectives, but... that thought process isn't wrong.
Wouldn't it be better to focus our attention on the common objective instead of expending valuable time and resources searching around blindly?
It's decided then. I'll be counting on you~
Let's trust our friends' judgment.
Perhaps because of the efforts lead by Saratoga's group, fewer Sirens were coming at us than expected.
Ideally, we'd be able to join forces before launching our main offensive against the Siren stronghold...
Hopefully that wouldn't be too optimistic...
Comrade, you ought to take a break and eat. After all, "a healthy body houses a healthy mind."
Our offerings may not be as sumptuous as the Royal Navy or the Sakura Empire, but it should be enough to fill the stomach.
Laid out in front of me was karavai bread, canned tushonka, caviar, and...
Commander, would you like some borscht?
Hot borscht kept in an insulated container, and a chocolate milk blend on the side.
What about this meal wasn't sumptuous?
I see you have quite the appetite~ Commander, I think you'd fit in great here.
Take this time to get some rest before the upcoming battle.
That's right. It's hard to stay warm in this cold weather, so please drink up.
Could this be...
It's a classic. Nothing beats vodka for staving off the cold. Of course, you're welcome to have something else if you don't drink.
"It's part of the fun of the Northern Parliament," or something along those lines.
...What an eccentric bunch.
(Staaaaare...)
For some unknown reason, Tashkent had been glaring at me intently for some time now.
(Staaaaare...)
Speaking of which, this girl seems to have been rather grumpy ever since we met...
Not really? Do you have some objection to me looking at you, dear comrade?
Well then, I'll keep looking at you since you're fine with it anyway.
...Hey, want to hear me out on something?
Why was she calling me "dear?" Had we met before? ...But I suppose that would have to wait for later.
You've been all over the place, right?
So you'd... know a thing or two about Sardegna, right?
I see. Well, I'll have to pick your brains a bit when I get the chance.
I see. Should Tashkent teach you about Sardegna then?
You see, everyone treats me pretty well, but I don't really have anyone to talk with.
...Then, come talk to me next time.
As the fleet approached the Aleutian defense line, the clouds which had blocked the skies for months suddenly parted, the water shimmering under the sun's bright glow.
According to the Naval Headquarters, the clement weather would only last for a few short hours, but from our perspective, it was as if the Bering Sea was welcoming us.
Hopefully, this upcoming battle would go as smoothly as planned... but the temperature was dropping sharply as we sailed north...
Heyy~ Commander, you're wide open~!!
Suddenly, several planes darted past my ship, blasting the deck with frigid air and a spray of sea water.
I didn't even need to guess to figure out what happened. It was another one of Saratoga's pranks...
Commander, now's not the time to be spacing out! We're about to head into battle, you know? There's a massive Siren stronghold waiting for us just ahead!

options.content: 「I heard that this stronghold never launches any attacks, so we should be fine for now.」
「It's because I trust you to keep me safe no matter what happens.」
I couldn't help but to appreciate how serene the seas looked...

scripts.say: Hmph! You know what they say, the calmer things appear on the outside, the bigger the conspiracy within!
Hmph! Your sweet talking won't get you anywhere with Sister Sara!！
Silly Commander... There's no way the Sirens wouldn't have detected us at this point. Since you're in charge of this fleet, you should remain vigilant at all times!
But, this is a bit unusual. We're practically knocking at their front door...
Looks like we got a good tip from the Northern Parliament. This Siren hideout *is* a good target~!
After what happened at NY Harbor, the Naval HQ now prioritizes eradicating small and medium-scale Siren bases within its jurisdiction.
Heh. After the misery they put us through, it's only fair for us to return the favor by crashing their party.
The next step of our major operation will be stalled until we can further reduce the Sirens' ability to project power across the seas.
We can't change the past. There are still many of us who are frustrated about what happened back then... So what we need now is to score an inspiring victory!
But what I did not expect... is that the Northern Parliament would ask us to conduct a joint operation.
The situation out here seems stable, and this Siren stronghold doesn't seem particularly threatening... so why hasn't the Northern Parliament taken this objective for themselves? Makes you wonder...
I was wondering about that too, so Sister Sara carried out a little investigation. Turns out... this place isn't as stable as you might think.
What do you mean?
This area actually falls under the jurisdictions of both the San Diego Naval HQ and the Karaginsky Naval Command. As such, it would be too sensitive to conduct any operation unilaterally.
Furthermore, based upon the records of joint operations conducted in the past, neither side has been particularly keen on deploying a main fleet to an area of such low strategic interest.
And since the Sirens never launched any attacks from this location, talks about conducting an operation here didn't amount to anything...
That makes sense... But right now, we can't afford to overlook any potential Siren threats, no matter how small they might seem!
That's why we're here right now~ Well, us, and a few others. Cleveland's group left a while before us, and we haven't heard from the Northern Parliament fleet in a while.
Commander, we must seize victory here!
Near the Siren stronghold - Eagle Union fleet
Hmm? The Sirens' attacks aren't as intense as they were before.
Oh no! They must be diverting their forces to pursue the Commander!
I can't imagine that being the case... but due to the interference of the Mirror Sea, we still can't get in touch with Avrora and the others.
Then, we have to find some way of shutting down the Mirror Sea first. It'll be too hard for us to get around that iceberg.
In other words, we'll have to take down that Siren stronghold?
Yeah, that's the quickest way to get things done. We should act quickly while their forces are diverted.
I agree. How about you, Saratoga?
We don't have any other choice... Let's hurry up and get going!
Ahahaha! Behold the glory of our revolyutsiya!
Gangut, an unidentified fleet is approaching you!
Is that one of the Sirens' "Pieces?" Ahaha!
Wait, Gangut, hold on!
BOOOOM!!
Did I miss my first salvo? Well, try this on for size!
Hold your fire! That's the Commander and the Eagle Union fleet!
Оченьхорошо! Let's hurry and send the signal to join up!
Hey, what the heck was with that salvo?! You could've hit us with that!
Gyaahh! I was about to betray the Azur Lane! ...Unforgivable!
...Anyway, I'm Kirov from the Northern Parliament, and these two are Minsk and Gangut.
As you're probably well aware, the Sirens' "Pieces" are made in the image of us and our allies. That was the quickest way of determining whether or not you were real.
I get that it's better to be safe than sorry, but did you really have to fire live ammunition? Do you guys often fire at each other here?
I guess you have a point... We don't do that...
Gaaahhh!!
Ahem... In any case, our main fleet has joined up with your commander, so we were instructed to find your fleet and regroup with you.
Currently, the commander is also advancing upon the Siren stronghold.
That means Commander is safe then? What a relief!
Indeed. But that means, in the commander's absence, the one leading this fleet was...
Yeah, we have a veteran here in Saratoga!
You're looking at her right now!
I'm the one who has been leading the Eagle Union's fleet in Commander's absence.
Eh? You're a carrier? How come you're so much smaller than Hornet over there?
.........Ruuuuude!!
Why are you saying that like you're proud of it?!
Seriously, I'm sorry!!
Ahahaha! That's the spirit, Eagle Union carrier! Today's a fine day for getting a good workout!
I still don't like the way you talk, but at least you have some real firepower to back it up.
In any case, we've mopped up the last of the enemies here. Let's keep pressing forward towards the stronghold.
We've got to hurry and join back up with the Commander!
All right! With my inspiration and the technical expertise of the Northern Parliament, we'll be out of here in no time!
Minsk managed to re-establish a link with the commander's fleet just now, and is confirming our route!
Give me a second... we'll go here, and here...
(They managed to break through the Mirror Sea's jamming?! What kind of black magic does the Northern Parliament have...?!)
(Furthermore, I still can't shake the feeling that their rigging resembles the Sirens... I can't help but to be suspicious.)
Got it! Oh, wait...
What is it, Kirov?
The Sirens found out about our anti-jamming and is intensifying their disruption. You're going to have to give me the coordinates by hand.
Here you go! As long as we have the coordinates, we'll still be able to join up with the rest of our comrades!
Later, at the Siren stronghold
Little could impede the progress of the Northern Parliament's fleet as it plunged deeper into the Siren stronghold.
As was suspected earlier, the stronghold was linked to the defensive structures on the surrounding icebergs.
Light reflected off the jagged spires of ice, revealing the countless defensive structures and artillery mounts encased within.
This was the true nature of the stronghold.
I didn't expect all of this to be dwelling just beneath us...
We should have addressed this threat long ago...
Well, the Northern Parliament's anti-Siren capacities are concentrated along our sea routes, coastal areas, and in the Arctic region.
We did not have the ability to reach a remote location like this one.
Like Azur Lane, we're trying to first re-establish control over our sailing routes.
As was with the case in NY City, it can be difficult to justify mobilizing forces to areas that have not presented a clear threat.
I hope you understand the circumstances.
Our general principle is to use whatever resources are at our disposal, but...
Admittedly, we didn't give much consideration to the idea of taking this stronghold for ourselves.
...We may not have done the proper amount of research in this case.
Either way, since we've already come this far, we can't leave empty-handed.
Right, our objective is still the same. We just have to take down this stronghold.
We are under your command, comrade.
...Understood. Our rendezvous coordinates are...
There's a message from Kirov. She's successfully joined up with the Eagle Union fleet and is making her way here.
Communication technology in the Mirror Seas? We're going to have look into this.

options.content: Does the Northern Parliament have a way to bypass the Mirror Sea's jamming effect?

scripts.say: Oh? Are you interested in that? Does the Eagle Union perchance not have that technology?
From Prometheus to Goemon, your lives are nasty, brutish, and short.
Who's there?!
An unfamiliar, alien voice rose from the transmission.
I don't remember inviting you barbarous louts to my estate. Crass creatures, stupid beyond comprehension.
I'll say this in a way you idiots will understand. Get the hell out of here!
Overzealous ignoramuses! Boundless greed and avarice!
Yes, begone, thieves in the night! Plunderers! Face destruction and sink by my hand!
The ice walls are closing in around us!
Shoot...! I don't like the looks of this! Everyone, retreat, hurry!
The stronghold stirred like a behemoth given life by the mysterious Siren voice, rough winds and waves forming as sheets of ice deformed and convulsed.
No, the very stronghold - and the entire Mirror Sea - was beginning to move.
We've lost contact with Kirov! These damn Sirens...!
All the Siren forces are congregating around us! Commander, at this rate...

options.content: Our only option is to meet up with the Eagle Union fleet!
Our only option is to fight back right now!

scripts.say: A courageous choice. Heh, in that case, we'll have to muster up the courage to match you!
A calculated decision, Commander. As expected, you've taken stock of the situation quickly.
...Comrades, we have no choice but to fight!
Our lives are in your hands, Commander!
Commander spotted! Saratoga's making her grand entrance!
Gangut, Kirov, Minsk, it's great to see you!
Heh, there's a ton of enemies...! Can you still do this, Gangut?
Don't underestimate me, Kirov! Our souls burn most brilliantly only in the face of adversity!
Heheh, we've managed to join with the others thanks to my inspiration!
I'm so glad you're safe, Commander! And these are the girls from the Northern Parliament?
Indeed, are you ready to fight with us?
The combined coalition of Eagle Union and Northern Parliament ships will intercept the Siren fleet.
Oh, that's right! During that call we had earlier, an unknown enemy suddenly showed up...
We saw her too... But right now, our main priority is to defeat the enemy.
That's right! This is the last battle, so we've gotta make the ground run red with blood!
кролик is ready too...
Follow us to glory, Eagle Union!
Northern Parliament Combined Fleet, prepare for battle! Give these Sirens a taste of our true power!

options.content: Let's head towards the deepest part of the stronghold!

scripts.say: Let's go!!
The enemies have come to challenge me... and these insects have embraced evil... How ignorant, how foolish!
What they shall find at the core, Deus ex Machina, shall put an end to their journey!
Give yourself to fear, for the end is nigh!!
...Is that so? The hell are you talking about? Are you trying to sound cool?
Come out already. That script you're reading from is lame.
Tashkent, do you know what she's talking about?
Don't just skulk about in the shadows, Siren! Come out and give us a fair fight!
Gahaha... You asked for it!
(CREEAAAAAKKKK...!!)
What the heck is that...
The ice walls cracked and split apart as a massive mechanical device began to stir, changing into a different form.
A giant dome rose over the icy waters and blocked out the light...
What in the world... is this...?!
"The king dons his Crown, the flowers are in full bloom, and the souls return to the seas. Thus begins the Overture of the End!"
Every finale gives way to a new overture, as destruction gives way to new life. I am "Omitter."
I am the one who rules over these seas!
The Siren who masterminds these Mirror Seas has appeared before us.
...I don't recognize her rigging...! Is she in the Eagle Union's database?!
Good, it isn't a proper finale without a high-ranking boss!
If we defeat her, we can get rid of this Mirror Sea...
(There's something different about her compared to the other Sirens we've fought before...)
Ahahaha! I like the looks of your faces! Yes, that's the performance that They desire!
Let's see what it says next... "My name shall be carved into your souls as you spend the rest of eternity trembling at the bottom of the abyss!"
That's so lame, it's cool! Ahahahaha!
What a cheeky brat. Can I beat her up, dear comrade?
Unfortunately, your idle threats mean nothing to the Northern Parliament!
What?! Impossible...!!
You assholes!! You won't even play along with me for a few minutes!! Unforgivable!!!!
She's coming at us!
Everyone, be on your guard!
Futile, futile, futile! I built this stronghold, and I won't let you beat me in my own castle!
Ahahaha! That's it, that's it! I feel like my potential is limitless! Is this the excitement that Tester is so drawn to?!
Come at me, yes, come, come! Struggle! Suffer!
That attack of hers... it's not just interfering with our fire control, but also obstructing our vision!
Our rigging isn't working! I can't land a hit at all!
If we can't aim, then we might as well stop trying!
...Huh?
We have an absolute advantage in terms of firepower! Keep focusing your fire at a general area, and we're bound to hit!
Haha! That's right! Get a load of how we fight here in the Northern Parliament!
Release suppressive fire!
In other words, quantity over quality! That's fine by me, I have all the ammunition you could ever want!
That's right! Keep pummeling away at this stronghold!
They're still fighting back...?!
However, the horn of the apocalypse has sounded, and the wheel of fate continues to turn...
You cannot escape your demise! I will be back...!
Omitter pointed her finger to the sky, and disappeared in a flash of light.
Welp, I guess that's that. After spending all that time blathering nonsense...
You're right. It's our victory, Commander.
(RUMBLE...!!!)
The entire stronghold is starting to collapse! We need to get out of here!
...In a thunderous roar, the stronghold crumbled and sank beneath the waves.
Shortly afterwards, the Mirror Sea began to dissipate. The storms stopped, and the warm light of the winter sun spilled through the clouds once more.
This sea really is beautiful...
Indeed. This is what it ought to look like.
The calm that spread before my eyes was reminescent of the first time I saw it, but something was also different.
Not only did you get to fight with the Northern Parliament's main fleet, but you even got to fight a new high-ranking Siren...
She was right. A lot had happened in a short amount of time, and I felt like I had changed.
Finally, we would be able to return home to port.
At least, that's what I thought...
Comrade, could I ask you to stay with the Northern Parliament for a bit longer?
Years ago, in the Northern Parliament...
Heave... ho... Phew, that should do it...
We've seen a lot of fighting, but some things seem to never change.
Avrora, a first-generation ship who was born in this era, looked around.
We've arrived, comrades...
...at the place which will give rise to a new world...
Here is the "cube" that is capable of storing human emotion...
...Let's begin, for the future of the Northern Parliament.
After sailing a bit further, the fleet reached the naval base at the Aleutian defense line.
Commander, and my friends from the Eagle Union, welcome to the Aleutian defense line.
ЗДравствуйте, Commander. It's been a while~
Huh? Avrora? Weren't you in charge of securing aid and supplies between the Royal Navy?
Hehe, I assume that this is your first time visiting the Northern Parliament. I thought it'd be appropriate for me to greet you here.
After all, I will be supporting your forces in the upcoming operation.
Ahaha! We're going to need all the good help we can get for a large operation like this!
That's right~ Now, I'd like to introduce Pamiat Merkuria, one of the fellow members of the Northern Parliament.
This is my first time meeting all of you, right? I'm the light cruiser, Pamiat Merkuria. Nice to meet you~!
Huh? Oooh~ So you're the legendary commander who led the defense of NY Harbor? Mmm~ hmm~ Not bad, not bad.
I heard that last time, you were viciously attacked as soon as you arrived at port and didn't even have a chance to catch a breath. How awful of them, hehe~
But don't worry, that won't happen here. That snowy stronghold over there won't attack until we get within a certain distance, so there's no chance of them launching an offensive here.

options.content: How can you be sure that they won't take the initiative?
Has the stronghold been here for a while?

scripts.say: Well, we've never observed any attacks from the stronghold outside of a certain range. That's why it's largely been overlooked as a low-threat target.
As long as I can remember. It appeared shortly after the end of that war, and has remained here since then.

Even though we've tried our hand at attacking it in the past, we've never been able to spare enough forces to actually make a dent. Regrettably, we are quite ashamed about how little progress we've been able to make...
Don't worry about it! See, you have backup now~!
Yo, Commander! I'm glad you finally made it. I've been getting bored!
Slowpokes...
I've gotta say, the view here is pretty nice. A bit cold for my tastes though, hehe~
Oops, sorry about that~ You see, this commander was spacing out on the way here!
Eh...? It's my fault?
Haha... Seeing as how everyone is here, why don't we discuss the battle plan?
Umm... Are you two the only ones here from the Northern Parliament?
Ahaha... It's a bit embarrassing to admit, but the others are still tied up by some unfinished business in the Arctics...
Since the stronghold won't initiate any external attacks, we'll join you for the first phase of this operation.
Our other comrades will link up with us after they get here.
You know... nothing creeps me out more than when the Sirens are sitting there *not* doing anything...
Somewhere in the Northern Parliament...
I'm glad you decided to stay with us for a bit longer.
Hehe... Commander, it's cold outside, but warm in here. Want some hot chocolate?
It really is cold here in the Northern Parliament...
We might not have as much variety as you do in the Eagle Union, but I can assure you, the taste is unbeatable~
What are you fantasizing about? Of course it wasn't I who made this for you~♪
The food here was undoubtedly delicious.
Indeed. The fight against the Sirens is only going to escalate and get drawn out from here, so we'll continue to request aid from the other factions.
The war between the Sirens and the Northern Parliament continues. Nevertheless...
This is where Tashkent and company go to relax.
Pretty nice scenery, right? ...Right. Come on, take a seat. Let's have a chat, shall we?
I was guided to the roof of a khrushchyovka, a tall building overlooking the city.
The members of the Northern Parliament introduced me to a variety of different places.
The whole experience was different from what I had experienced anywhere else.
And today, Sovetskaya Rossiya would take me to meet a certain "important person"...
"We've received your reports and data."
"Wisdom cube compatibility, commanding ability, personality, political assessment... everything has been reviewed..."
"Are they here?"
Comrade, this way please.
Light poured into the room from the window.
When my eyes adjusted, I saw a woman clad in white standing inside the room, her garb resembling that of the other members of the Northern Parliament fleet.
The deliberate and dignified words she spoke seemed to echo directly into my mind.
"Commander, would you join the Northern Parliament?"
Days later, NY City
You're going to stay with the Northern Parliament? What's the meaning of this?
It's just a visit, nothing more to it. What did you think was going to happen?
I guess so. Well, it's not like the commander is beholden to the Eagle Union, and I'm sure all the other factions feel the same way.
More importantly, look at all these photos I managed to get. What do you think?
I was quite surprised. I've never seen anything like it before... the riggin that the Northern Parliament fleet was equipped with, that is...
They seem to be making more progress on their wisdom cube research.
I suspect that rigging is a product of some breakthrough they made.
Any possibility that it might have been captured or discarded Siren technology?
There's a possibility, but we can't know for sure.
Siren technology, huh... Are they also going down that path...?
...the commander has headed north...
...the final overture...
...has begun to play...
Enterprise, did you say something?
No... (What was that... just now?)
...It's too quiet. There's nothing wrong with my SK-2 radar... but undeniably, the enemy stronghold is right in front of us. Seeing a battlefield this calm is giving me goosebumps...
We're still at a safe distance for the time being~
Woah... these Sirens must be sleeping or something. My recon planes are flying over them without drawing a response...
Hehe~ If that's the case, let's settle this with some ultra long-range bombing!
Long-range attacks from carriers, huh... We've never tried something like that before.
Nice thinking, Hornet! But thinking isn't as fun as doing! Sister Sara, scrambling bombers!
Saratoga issued her orders, and a squadron of bombers immediately began to fly towards the Siren stronghold.
Even without protection from fighters, the bombers reached their target successfully and dropped a payload directly on top of the stronghold!
Heheh! A direct hit!!

Just as Saratoga began to cheer, the stronghold's defenses came to life. The bombs that had been dropped were repelled by shields that materialized out of nowhere, and Saratoga's bombers were mercilessly mowed down by withering anti-air fire.
What... the... heck?!
The target is responding to threats accordingly. The stronghold's anti-air capacities are stronger than expected. We can't even begin to speculate what their full capabilities might be.
Good, I was afraid things would be too boring! Let's kick down their front door, smash through that carapace, and tear down their defenses!
Be careful, everyone! We're about to enter their defensive perimeter!
The enemy's response has stopped for now, so we can catch our breath now~
You were right... As soon as we entered their range, all those dormant enemy suddenly started charging on us. I've never seen anything like it before...
Eh? Is it over already? I haven't even finished warming up yet! How were they able to push you back so many times before with such a puny amount of firepower?
Ahaha... The closer you get, the stronger their defenses. Consider what we just saw the appetizers.
...Attrition warfare? If we take control of all the surrounding territory, all the defenses in the world aren't going to do them any good... What a pointless strategy.
Indeed, but it's hard to know what the Sirens are thinking. What we do know is that we were met with an overwhelming defense the last time we tried to make a push.
After that, we realized that the strength of the Northern Parliament alone would not be enough to tackle this issue. That's why we reached out to the Eagle Union.
In other words, your excursions so far have only revealed the tip of the iceberg?
That's the gist of it. We weren't able to draw out the full power of the Siren stronghold in the first place.
Well, everything should be fine now that we're here. The commander's no slouch when it comes to mustering up the firepower we need.

options.content: We'll be prepared for anything they throw at us.

scripts.say: Now that's what I want to hear!
Let's do this! No matter how strong their defenses are, all we have to do is keep beating them back!
The Eagle Union task force is steadily making its way towards the Siren stronghold.
Though the Sirens' counterattacks slowly grow stronger, they still pose no actual threat to the Eagle Union's ships.
Wow, we've made some astonishing progress. When we first decided to investigate the stronghold, we never got *this* close.
I'm guessing that's because the Sirens here are considerably tougher to deal with.
But we still have the upper hand when it comes to firepower and durability. Let our fleet handle things from here on out.
Ooh, do I hear an offer to clear the path for us?
Because if so, I'll gladly take it! My gear's from a bygone time, so I'd struggle to keep up anyway~
We really appreciate your assistance. The rest of our forces seem to always be busy with some other mission...
No need to thank us. You've got Sirens on your doorstep to deal with, so if anything we should be thanking you for coming with us.
Your number one priority is to take care of the Singularity. We know that too, of course.
For decades, the Northern Parliament has been engaged in a battle with the Sirens over the Bering Sea.
They may have experience, but their supplies are dwindling, and apparently they need support from other factions to hold the line...
Now if you don't mind, I shall join the Commander's convoy. Vanguard fleet, please be on your guards.
Hey, you know what that thing is? The purple glowing one?
Nope. I've never seen any intel on anything like that before.
What is that, Avrora...?
Is it some sort of undiscovered Northern Parliament wildlife?
I don't... believe so, no...
Did you forget your glasses at home? That's obviously a Siren!
...Wait, let me guess, you were being sarcastic?
The Sirens must've kept this secret weapon in their stronghold... Be careful, everyone! We don't know what to expect!
That looks like the last of them. Good job, folks!
Heheh! We sent them crawling back to mama!
You never cease to amaze me, Eagle Union.
This new enemy was tough, but nothing we can't handle.
"New" might not be the right word, you know? They might've kept it in store for decades for all we know...
Maybe. But in any case, its combat ability is nothing to scoff at. If many more of them show up, this could get difficult.
If more show up, we'll just take them all out!
Besides, the more we fight them, the more intel on them we get. Sara thinks we should keep moving forward!
What she said. I mean, you've not had any trouble fighting what we've seen so far.
Ain't that right! We can always fall back later if they turn out to be too much!

Be it the Royal Navy's tale of Dagda's inexhaustible cauldron or the Sakura Empire's legend of the Dragon King's bottomless rice bag, from all around the world there are stories of objects which produce endless quantities of things.
Similarly, one could describe the number of Sirens emerging from within and around the stronghold as endless.
The Eagle Union forces felt confident after their initial series of easy victories, but the tides of battle have begun turning on them.
Now, they are locked in a stalemate, fighting neck and neck with the Sirens.
Geesh, who would've thought there so many of them... Sara might've underestimated them a bit.
We've still got reign over the skies so things are still in my favor, but what about the rest of you?
I've not taken incapacitating damage, but I'm concerned about my ammo reserves.
Denver's team still has a decent amount of ammo left, but we shouldn't linger here for too long!
Commander, you don't happen to have a plan, do you?
Should it come down to it, we cannot win a war of attrition with the Sirens. It's likely that if we keep pushing, we'll be quickly surrounded even if we do make it to the stronghold.
The best we can do is wait here and hold the line until our backup arrives...
That, or we could retreat beyond the Sirens' range for a while. Then we'd just need to take out the few that come chasing us.
Whichever you decide, I'll follow your orders, Commander.

options.content: Your reinforcements, when are they coming?
First, we have to take out the Sirens encircling us!

scripts.say: They told us they're making their way here as fast as they can.
But that's not to say they'll be here any second now.
Then I guess retreating to a safer area is our only choice.
Well look at you, aren't you a real strategizer!
Guess I'll rev up the ol' engine and help too. I can't promise you I'll kick much Siren butt at all, but it's better than me doing nothing, right?
Comrade, welcome to the Intelligence Division of the Northern Parliament! Hehe, it's a super fun place to be!
Actually, this is where we decrypt all the intel you've collected. We send the results straight to the top brass.
In short, the more intelligence points you collect, the more rewards you'll be able to earn!
Come on, let's hurry up and get to work! If you need any more help, tap the "Help" button for a more detailed explanation!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>The Witch's Pact</size>

scripts.say: Port - Coast
As the sun sets, the evening breeze sweeps away sea mist, casting a splotch of pink over the horizon.
With the day's work done, I leave my office. Immediately, I'm drawn to the sound of a very distinctive pair of footsteps.
Commandeeer! Finally, I've found you!
A figure rushes at me from the dusk. Bright-green leaves cling to the hem of her fluttering skirt.
Mecklenburg? What brings you here so late?
Hah! Late? For the Nachthexe, who controls the very night, the moment when all things slumber is precisely when miracles awaken!
She takes a step forward and jerks her chin upward, as if trying to look down on me. Her mismatched eyes shine with excitement.
Heed my words, Commander! In this moment, on my name as Nachthexe, I declare...
My Ultimate Flying Machine, forged by my blood and sweat, has crossed the threshold of creation before the descent of the blood moon!
Ultimate Flying Machine, you say?
Indeed! It is the vehicle of my dreams, capable of shaking off the shackles of gravity to traverse beyond the sea of stars above!
HOWEVER!
Theatrically drawing out her words, she raises a finger and waggles it in front of her lips.
Did you expect me to unveil such a magnificent creation so easily?
The blood moon hangs in the sky above... This is the very moment in which the Nachthexe's power is at its zenith!
As such, I have decided... Tonight, we shall hold the Ritual of the Pact!
Sounds very dramatic.
Heh heh! This ritual is a wellspring of magical power! And you, dear Commander, are an essential element!
Who, me?
Of course! You shall be appointed the Imperator of Eternal Night's Pact, the one who will share in my power and destiny!
Imperator, huh? Does that help you somehow?
Immeasurably so!
Per the ancient grimoires, the ultimate power that soars through darkest night can only be awakened when the majesty of the Imperator resonates with the witch's path.
What is your answer, Commander?
She reaches her hand out to me. In her eyes, I see boundless anticipation and the faintest hint of nervousness.
It sounds like fun. Let's do it.
I'd be honored to be chosen by such a powerful witch.
Th-that'd be great!
Mecklenburg seizes my outstretched hand, but quickly calms herself and relaxes her grip.
I knew you'd live up to my expectations, Imperator! Your decisiveness is awe-inspiring!
For the first step of the pact, you and I shall make for the forgotten ritual grounds!
Don't get lost in the depths of night, Imperator of mine!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>Whispers in the Dark Forest</size>

scripts.say: Port - Forest Path
Mecklenburg guided me to the woods at the back of port. Moonlight spilled through the gaps between clouds, casting an ethereal glow over the area.
With brisk steps, she urges me deeper into the woods.
You've been preparing this for a long time, haven't you?
That's right. I made the flying machine for this moment, and I rehearsed the ritual countless times. It must be flawless!
Did you rehearse this walk, too?
Of course! Behold the Witch's Luminous Heart, a concentration of my raw magic!
She proudly holds up a lantern. Warm light leaks through the intricate pattern on its shade, leaving a dancing patch of amber light on her face.
This is a safe passage through this forest's mists and dark magick!
Take care not to stray from my side!
Alright, alright. Just watch your step, okay?
Noticing my flat response, she narrows her eyes and leans in closer to me.
Ah... Let me tell you a little secret, Commander...
As her breath tickles my ears, her hushed voice carrying a tinge of smugness.
This forest... is home to the Night's Kindred.
If not for my protection, they wouldn't let a passing traveler such as yourself get this far.
Mecklenburg holds my hand tighter and continues down a forest path with confident steps.
What are the Night's Kindred? They sound dangerous.
You see...
They're the forest sprites darting between your feet... or the lost spirits wandering about.
Some of them can be dangerous. If a witch doesn't let her guard down, why... she might just fall into a fog of terror!
(Does she mean things like squirrels or the shadows of trees when the wind blows?)
S-so...
Upon hearing a sound, she comes to a sudden stop. The forest begins rustling all around us.
Gaaaaaah?!
The witch clings to my arm and hides behind me, peeking around to see what's happening.
Wh-what was that just now?
Um... I think you stepped on a shrub?
She falls uncharacteristically silent.
Hmph... I-I knew it. It was a spatial fluctuation caused by your latent powers.
Goodness... Keep wielding your power as such, and we may get lost in the darkness!
Her grip on my sleeve only tightens, betraying her worry.
I can't see her face since she's behind me, but she's so close to me that I can feel her heartbeat.
There's no other choice... With my magic in such disarray, you will have to take the lead.
Um... Are you just telling me to walk straight ahead?
P-precisely! But fear not. I will be behind you to give you directions. Consider this... necessary assistance in forming the pact.
Mecklenburg squeezes my arm again. Her heat stands out amidst the chill of the night.
We continue on the winding path, our route illuminated by the lanternlight.
We're almost at the point of the ancient witch's departure! It's the perfect ritual site that I searched for days to discover!
Commander... No – Imperator, this will be the most unforgettable night of your life!
It's just up ahead!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>Hall of Intersecting Stars</size>

scripts.say: Ancient Castle - Hall
As we pass through the final stretch of woods, the silhouette of the castle emerges from the haze of night.
The inside is surprisingly spacious. Mecklenburg guides me confidently through until we arrive at a hall with a towering dome above.
Behold, commander. This is the chamber where we'll carry out the first stage of the ritual, the Rite of Celestial Alignment!
There's a fissure in the decrepit dome above, allowing starlight to filter into the hall like a skylight.
Are you saying we're supposed to look at the stars here?
We aren't just looking.
She takes my hand and guides me into the center of the hall, where she positions herself back-to-back with me.
Here, we shall perform the rites of identification, connection, and proclamation!
Then, she points a finger up at the night sky.
Do you see that brightest star in the sky, shining crimson? That is the Witch's Crimson Luminary, my eternal seat within the constellations.
(Is that... Mars?)
Look next to it now, at the one bathed in blue... That is the Imperator's Eternal Night, your destined star.
(Definitely Venus. I see... There's a rare conjunction tonight.)
Now, my fated Imperator, join me in connecting the tracks of the two stars!
Mecklenburg chants some kind of incantation. After a moment, the two planets almost look like they're slowly approaching each other.
Behold! The trajectories of the Luminary and Eternal Night have become one in this moment!
Never has the Rite of Celestial Alignment been completed on this planet – until now!
She turns to me and takes my hands.
From this moment forth, our destinies will be just as the stars: forever intertwined, to share a single course throughout the boundless night!
Her mismatched eyes gaze into mine expectantly, passion burning within them.
Do you feel it, Imperator?
The quaking melody of destiny, resonating throughout all the heavens?

options.content: I can feel an invisible connection...

scripts.say: Hmm... The colors of the stars are blue and red. Just like your eyes, Mecklenburg.
You noticed?
She looks up at me with a bashful smile.
You have a good eye. A witch's eyes always reflect the celestial bodies most important to her.
You know... I can feel an invisible connection between us. It's a strange feeling.
Heheh, see?
She squeezes my hands gently.
That's the sensation of a bond forming, of magic beginning to flow...
It's hard to put into words, but it feels like this has really left a mark on my heart.
A mark on your heart...
Heheh~ I knew I was right to choose you, Commander – No, Imperator. You're special.
The ritual was a success. Now you've awakened your latent power.
You can tell it worked?
My witchy powers have guided me to this truth!
Witchy powers, eh? How magical.
Instead of correcting her about Mars and Venus, I decide to just play along.
Will your witchy powers guide us to our next destination?
Ahem... The resonant stars will lead us henceforth.
Let us continue to the next ritual chamber now.
Imperator, stay close to your destined witch!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>Imbibe the Spiritual Elixir</size>

scripts.say: Ancient Castle - Abandoned Laboratory
After we leave the first ritual hall, Mecklenburg opens a half-ajar wooden door and beckons me inside.
Decaying wooden shelves and dusty glassware are scattered about. In the middle of it all is a conspicuously clean pedestal.
Welcome to my temporary potion atelier!
Here, we shall carry out step two of our pact... The Communion of Souls!
Communion... of Souls?
Yes! Look here!
She gives a wink and then produces two wine glasses, which she places atop the pedestal.
After that, she takes out a few small vials swirling with red, amber, deep blue, and other colors.
What are those?
These are the ingredients required to make the Elixir of the Eternal Covenant.
And where exactly did you get these...?
Oh, you don't know? There's a witch's cache at the port. For the right price, you can get your hands on gifts left by the gods of eld!
The price is money, right? Tell me it's money.
Of course! Imperator, I'm quite impressed that you've managed to see through the secrets of the witch's cache so quickly!
(I think she just bought juice from a vending machine and poured it into vials. Okay... Should be safe to drink, then.)
Ahem... I will now begin brewing the elixir! Behold this secret technique passed down through generations of witches!
She pours them into the glasses one after another. Red and amber mix, while the deep-sea blue sinks as a cloud to the bottom.
The Elixir of the Eternal Covenant... is complete!
She lifts a glass and offers it to me.
Here, Imperator.
The ancient pact dictates that those who share power and destiny must imbibe this elixir together.
I accept the glass, but I hesitate to drink from the sea of stars swirling within.
To ensure the pact's effectiveness... you must not leave a drop behind.
Alright.
I'll drink alongside you.
Mecklenburg raises her glass, and we intertwine our arms at the elbows.
At this close proximity, I can smell her sweet scent.
With this elixir, we forge the covenant of eternal night...
My path shall intersect with thine, and my magic shall resonate with thee.
We drink in unison.
(Urgh...)
Sweet-sour liquid rushes down my throat, and bubbles burst on my tongue, filling my mouth with excessive sweetness. I'd be lying if I said it tasted good.
*cough* *cough*... The pact... isn't as easy as it seemed...
She chokes a few times, holding a hand over her mouth. As she looks up at me, I can see tears in the corners of her eyes.
Imperator, do you feel anything? A surge of magic, or the tremble of your soul, perhaps?
Or maybe... Your vision has grown clear enough to pierce through the darkness before you?
Umm... It tastes special, for sure. It's kind of hot, too... like it's awakening the spirit.
I knew it – I felt the very same! Our souls must be resonating, there's no mistaking it!
The next rite will be the most critical of all.
Esteemed Imperator, follow me to the chamber of the shackles of binding!
A night breeze sweeps through, jostling her bangs ever so slightly. Clasping my hand, she begins walking to the door at the back of the room.

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>The Shackles that Bind</size>

scripts.say: Ancient Castle - Chamber of the Arcane
When we arrive at the deepest portion of the castle. Scarlet moonlight pours through the high windows.
Upon the floor is something that resembles an intricate magic circle. However, the lines are a mess, so it's hard to discern its intended shape.
What's this?
This is the ritual spell for the Binding Shackles of Love! It took me three days to draw!
The two wings represent me, while the sword in between represents you, Commander. Impressive, don't you think?
It's very well drawn. I didn't know you had a talent for art.
You have a good taste. It's very eye-catching.
All of this symbolizes the fact that, as long as you bear the blessing of my wings, your sword can pierce the very heavens!
We step into the center of the magic circle together. Moonlight casts shadows behind us, overlapping perfectly upon the wing and sword patterns.
This is an important ritual, so we cannot afford any mistakes.
It is... the ultimate proof of our pact.
Mecklenburg sucks in a deep breath and gazes at me with flushed cheeks.
Now, Imperator. Please take out the shackles.
She places a velvet box into the palm of my hand. Inside is an intricate necklace.
When your witch's power surges at its peak, you must place this on her neck...
The witch averts her eyes, as if embarrassed. Her voice shrinks to a quiver.
...I see.
I take the necklace out and reach around to the nape of her neck to put it on.
As she pliantly tilts her head toward me. Her hair droops downward, giving occasional glimpses of her flushed ears and fair neck.
With the blood moon as our witness...
Guided by the paths of the stars...
On my name Mecklenburg, the Nachthexe...
I declare that I will link my voyage, my night, and my very essence to this Imperator in Eternal Night's Pact.
Scarlet moonlight washes over her cheeks, glistening eyes, and slightly parted lips.
Mecklenburg...
Despite her clear bashfulness, she manages to raise her voice.
The pact is sealed... From now on, we walk together as Nachthexe and Imperator!
Now is the time to unveil our pact-bound wings under this blood moon!
She takes my hand and rushes out the door, dragging me along.
Through corridors and spiral staircases, her skirt hem bounces in graceful arcs.
The night wind rages.
A sleek aircraft shines with a metallic luster under the moonlight. Its wings are folded close to its sides, making it look like a bird at rest.
Behold, Imperator!
This is my newest flying machine!
It's incredible... Can it fly now?
Of course. The pact is sealed. Now, these wings belong to just the two of us.
Come... Take the helm, Imperator!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>Soar Beneath the Blood Moon</size>

scripts.say: Beneath the starry sky...
When Mecklenburg turns the machine on, the back of our seat slowly lurches forward, securing us firmly within.
Hold on to me, Imperator, or you won't be able to pass your pre-flight check!
...Yes, Nachthexe.
I slightly adjust my posture and wrap my arms around her waist as directed.
How's this?
Aah... Th-that will do!
She deftly operates the touch screen.
Pre-flight safety checks complete! It's time for our blood moon flight...
Let the party begin!
When she presses the button, the wings suddenly flare out, and the engine's thrusters let out a low hum.
Hold on tight, my dear Imperator!
Powerful g-force pins me against the seat as the flying machine takes flight from the terrace.
Nngh!
Ahahaha! Our maiden voyage is a roaring success!
I feel a moment of weightlessness, but the machine quickly levels out, and together, we surge into the endless night sky.
The castle shrinks in the viewport. The forest below begins to resemble a vast carpet. We slowly approach the clouds – and then pierce straight through them.
Look, Commander...

Hearing a voice quiet enough to nearly be drowned out by the engine, I follow her line of sight. The blood moon floats in the dead center of our viewpoint, so close that it feels like I can reach out and touch it.
It's beautiful.
I've seen sights like this so many times... but tonight, it feels all too new.
I can hear both the wind and your breath... at my back, I feel your presence. And...
Mecklenburg turns her head back toward me. The eyes beneath those quivering lashes reflect me amidst the starry sky.
This is the power of our pact... Even the exact same scenery can create totally different memories.
As the flying machine climbs ever higher, the starlight begins to feel so close.
The only sound we hear is each other's heartbeats.
Commander, over there...
The Witch's Crimson Luminary and Imperator's Eternal Night... will be in conjunction soon!
Shall we fly closer for a better look?
W-we're going even higher?
Of course! Have you forgotten? We shared a draught of my spiritual elixir!
I've witnessed your bravery for myself, Imperator!
From now on, no matter what happens...
You've no choice but to see it through to the end!

sequence:
The Eternal Night's Oath Under the Blood Moon

<size=45>Eternal Night's Companion</size>

scripts.say: Above the clouds...
When our view of the sky finally clears, Mecklenburg and I are amidst a sea of tranquility.
My dear Imperator, welcome to the Nachthexe's secret hideout.
You're the first person to ever be invited. An honor, isn't it?
Secret hideout...?
That's what I said!
She holds out both of her arms and twirls them about.
Behold the Royal Court of Silence seated atop the clouds...
I look down and see clouds covering the world below. The forest and the lights of the port have all sunk beneath a silver-white sea of clouds.
After a pause, Mecklenburg murmurs softly to me.
It's just you and me now.
She gazes at me silently and then smiles.
At this sacred moment, when our stars converge, we will carry out the final step of our pact.
The final step?
Yes. It's about authority over this flying machine.
She reaches out and rests her hand atop mine.
In this moment, the Nachthexe's flight and the Imperator's authority will be forever united.
Highest authority, authentication... Confirmed.
With a quick beep, the interface turns blue, signifying her success.
Fingerprint and identity of the Imperator of Eternal Night's Pact registered.
I hereby name this craft the Eternal Night's Companion.
Henceforth, it will respond to both of our commands at any given moment...
Mecklenburg leans closer.
Which means... you can pilot this craft whenever and wherever you please, and take me to all the places you want to go.
Anywhere?
Anywhere.
A mischievous smile plays on her lips.
My dear Imperator... the night has only just begun in earnest.
Beneath the sky, above the clouds...
In this domain for just the two of us, for only the Nachthexe and her Imperator...
Nobody can disturb us.
The aircraft surges forth into the darkness, carrying the whispers of the night.
The weightlessness of each descent and the suffocation of each ascent make for an experience more thrilling than I could've ever imagined.
Our trajectories have finally converged. In this moment, the two "stars" shining in the night sky are more vivid than anything else.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>1 Moonlit Guide</size>

scripts.say: Amidst the monotony of our daily lives, we find ourselves smoothing away our rough edges. Some call this growth.
Yet some dreams, though forgotten, wait to be opened once more like a dusty storybook.
Can you hear that, beloved Commander? A story calls to us – that dreamlike circus awaits.
Dreams buried by the passage of time and people we'd once dismissed all emit the faintest of glimmers in the darkness...
Come with me, and let us set sail for a storybook world full of surprises!
In that dream, I saw colors that I hadn't glimpsed in years.
Not the grey asphalt of roads or the walls of office buildings, but vivid colors that I couldn't even name.
When I opened my eyes... I found myself carrying a warm lunchbox again, walking along the same path I always did.
Another day of the same old.
That is... until a flock of doves flew into my field of vision.
Behold! An incredible magic show is about to begin! You there, lucky audience member! I think you'll be my assistant today~
Amidst the sound of fluttering wings, a young magician turns her attention to me.
You might've had your mind on work before, but it's time to keep those peepers on me.
She tosses her silk hat up into the air and catches it. When she waves it about, more doves fly out of it.
Fly, my lovelies, fly!
Let everyone know that I've found "that person."
And then...
With a smile and a wink, she stuffs her hand into the hat.
Now, I'll pull a rabbit out of my... Huh, that's no rabbit. It's a card!
Let's put that back... Lucky audience member, can you come closer for me, please?
Before I can react, she comes to me and gazes into my eyes.
Hmm? I just hit something hard.
Ooh, it's just my hat!
Anyway, back to the show!
After that flurry of activity, a cute white rabbit hops out of the hat and into my arms.
Take this as a memento of our magical encounter tonight!
Take good care of him, okay?
Um... What?
When I look up again, she's gone. The rabbit in my arms nuzzles gently against me.
Is this some kind of practical joke, or...?
{playername}? Wake up! It's time to wake uuup!
...Hmm?
Finally, you're up! It's time for us to get going~
Wait... You're that magician. What's going on?
There's no time to explain. Just come with me, okay?
It'll all come back to you the moment you see, I'm sure.
Now come with me to that moonlit plain, beneath a shimmering sea of stars!
A performance just for you is ready and waiting.
The magician holds out her hand and guides me into the moonlight. There, I see...
Colorful flags fluttering, neon lights ablaze, straight out of a dream – an enormous circus tent.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>2 Guardian of Dreams</size>

scripts.say: When I approach the ticket booth, nobody is there.
I turn around to ask why, but I find that the girl who brought me here is gone.
This must be a practical joke.
Hello? Is anybody there?
Oh, my... I fell asleep...
Hmm? Is our guest already here? Wait just a second~ I have to put my costume back on... and then we can play♪
A girl tries to stand up, holding her mascot costume from falling apart, but she quickly falls to the side.
Whoa!
I try to catch her, but before I know it, I'm pinned beneath her.
Her warmth and softness weigh on me.
Far from trying to get up, though, she smiles down at me mischievously.
Welcome to my circus of illusions.
Heehee! Isn't this a lot more exciting than any old greeting?
She sizes me up, as if looking at a freshly unwrapped gift.
Hmm... Your reaction is more interesting than I expected.
Stuck under such a cute girl in such a cute bear costume, and yet you keep your cool...
Or are you this calm because something similar has happened between the two of us before?
...Huh?
Nothiiing. Just testing you, that's all.
The girl slowly stands up and offers a hand to help me up. However, once I'm on my feet, she doesn't let go.
Dearest guest, you now have permission to enter and exit any performance area as you please.
I'm sure every performance will exceed your wildest dreams.
Once you've experienced them all, you may decide whether you'd like to stay or leave.
But I still haven't bought a ticket.
Actually, how did the circus just appear in a place like this? Did anyone get a permit for this?
Oh my, look how earnest you are~ Heheheh!
Today is a special day. Any guests who come to the circus get to enjoy all of our attractions without a ticket.
She steps closer and lightly traces a circle on my chest with her finger.
Memories can be such fascinating things. Some things you thought you'd forgotten might actually have been here all along.
