You just need someone to unlock that door for you.
I happen to enjoy doing that for people.
What is that supposed to mean?
It means...
The girl suddenly leans closer and whispers into my ear with a gentle sigh.
Have fun, {playername}.
I'll be here waiting for your answer.
After that, she lies down next to me and closes her eyes to sleep. Her hair cascades down into a pool, shimmering in the light with a seductive luster.
*yaaawn*... I'm tired. Let me sleep a little longer...
Knowing I won't be able to get any more answers out of her, I leave the ticket booth and head toward the nearest performance venue.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>3 Feet on Fire</size>

scripts.say: As soon as I step into the tent, a wave of heat washes over me.
Massive iron rings engulfed in flames stand in the center, distorting the air around them.
A girl stands beside those rings–
Hah!
With a leap, she gracefully slips through the flaming rings, flips twice in midair, and lands perfectly on her feet.
Oooh, perfect!
She turns to the doorway where I'm standing, as if she knew I'd be here all along.
{playername}! You finally came!
With a big smile, the girl runs over and takes me by the hand.
How did you like my performance? It was awesome, right?
It sure was.
I'm actually an animal trainer! I prepared a special performance just for you.
She points at a group of owls standing neatly in line. Their round eyes all turn toward us at once.
Noticing that we're looking back at them, they all tilt their heads slightly in greeting.
They're my partners. Come on, everyone. Let's show our guest what we can do!
Watch closely, now. Three, two, one!
She whistles, prompting the owls to begin a performance involving aerial spins, somersaults, flying in formation, and more.
Bravo.
Hehehe, they're such good friends that they act in perfect sync!
Plus, they're smart enough that they know exactly who I love the most!
She leans in closer and looks up at me.
Oh, by the way–
The growling of her stomach interrupts her.
She blushes and smiles awkwardly as she puts a hand on it.
Umm... Do you have anything I could eat? I'm a little hungry...
Her eyes are drawn to my hands.
I just so happen to be holding a bag with a warm lunch inside.
Wow. Did I learn magic tricks along the way, too?
Before I can try to comprehend what has happened, she excitedly closes in on me.
Ooh! You really did bring food!
She accepts the bag and reaches in for the lunchbox.
After she quickly pulls it open, her eyes light up.
Oooh! Th-this meat, and such a perfect side dish...
They're all my favorites! You really remembered!
Remembered...? Have we met before?
Of course we have! *munch*... Mmm, delicious~
She replies while stuffing her face with food.
The lunchbox is emptied in no time. Satisfied, the girl pats her belly adorably and smiles at me.
Phew, I feel reborn! Thanks for the meal!
No problem. You said we've met before, though – remind me where?
Well...
She stands up, comes closer, and pokes my cheek.
I can't tell you yet.
There are more people waiting for you. You'll have to find the answer for yourself~
Still...
I was really happy that you came to see me again.
If you need any help later, feel free to come back!
With a mischievous wink, she pats me lightly on the shoulder.
Go on. It's time for you to get moving~
There are even more exciting performances up ahead, and you don't wanna keep the others waiting.
Good luck, {playername}. Go say hi to everyone!
Though she said those words so naturally, something about them caused ripples deep inside my heart.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>4 Escape Magic</size>

scripts.say: I step into another brightly-colored circus tent. A huge box stands out atop the stage.
You've finally arrived, {playername}... Or should I say, you've fallen into my clutches!
The box opens, and a girl emerges, throwing a bouquet of flowers into the air. They transform into a whirlwind of butterflies – and with a snap of her fingers, they disappear.
Tell me. Was my opening trick... enough to take you by surprise?
Heehee, the show has only just begun.
Are you ready? I will show you a real illusion!
First, I will have you step inside this box...
Then, in the blink of an eye, you'll disappear without a trace!
What do you say? Want to give it a try?
Sure, I'll try it.
Heheh... Well said! Your courage in the face of unknown challenges is laudable, indeed!
This smells like a trap...
Oh, please. I'm a professional magician. You could stand to trust me a little more.
Despite my hesitation, I lie down in the box. However, I'm immediately caught off guard as the so-called magician also slips inside and closes the lid.
Taking advantage of the chaos, I grab the tip of her tail and stuff it into the latch.
*click!*
Suddenly, everything is enveloped in darkness.
Is this your magic?
That's right, and it went perfectly. Now I've succeeded in trapping you by my side.
Honestly, it seems more like both of us are trapped now...
That's hardly fair. This is a special moment for just the two of us.
She presses close to me in the darkness, noticeably pushing her chest against mine.
If the tomorrow outside is just going to be a repetition of today, then is there any need to hurry back, really?
Maybe not, but we have to get there eventually.
I push upward on the lid of the box. It opens with ease.
At this moment, she finally realizes the trick I pulled earlier.
My plan... was foiled so easily?
Hmph. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
(Why is she acting like this has happened before?)
Anyway, it's getting late. I have work tomorrow, so I'd like to head home. Where is the circus exit?
You want to go home? Heheh, you clearly don't understand yet.
She takes my hand and leads me to the tent's exit. The previously open gate is now tightly shut.
On either side of it stand a bust of a heavily armored knight and a sleeping lion.
You may have escaped me, but you'll never escape the circus.
Wait... Are you saying I'm trapped in this place?
Again, you don't have to use such a harsh word!
The outside world is boring. Let us conquer this circus together, and then we may proceed to wider worlds.
You're the most crucial piece in our plan. Besides, without you, I just can't muster the energy.
Honestly, conquering the world sounds more exhausting than the overtime I'm already doing.
Isn't life more fun as it is now?
...Tch.
Her smug look deflates into a soft blush.
Ugh! It was the perfect moment, and now, you've ruined it!
After turning around and muttering something under her breath, she straightens up and resumes her domineering air.
Forget it! You're suave, I'll give you that. Just this once, you may go!
But heed my words, {playername}! This circus has a rule: nobody may leave until they've seen all the performances!
Keep moving forward and enjoy yourself until the end!
No matter what decision you make, I'll be waiting here for you!

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>5 Inventor on the Swing</size>

scripts.say: As I approach the third tent, I hear joyful humming within.
Inside, I see the spotlight shining on one girl hanging from a swing in mid-air.
Oh, {playername}! Great timing!
She deftly flips off the swing and nearly lunges into me.
But then, she spins around, takes my hand, and leads me back to the swing.
After urging me to sit on it, she turns as nimbly as a cat and sits right on my lap.
Let the test begin! Gooo!
Whoooa! We're so high up! It feels like we're flying!
Ack?!
When I notice her begin to sway backward, I quickly hold her by the waist.
In response, she leans closer.
Hehehe, you saved me!
Hmm, swinging together is pretty fun... Oh! Eureka!
I'll turn this swing into the Swinging Instant Teleporter!
You're going to teleport... with a swing?
Yeah! When you get to the top, whoosh, you're teleported anywhere in the world!
That sounds like a good idea. Could we even use it to escape the circus?
Escape? Why would you want to do that?
The swing comes to a slow stop. Though we're able to alight, she turns around and wraps her legs around me.
This is the dream world you made for us, {playername}!
I made this place? For all of you?
Yeah! Our touring circus accepts all those who have been rejected by the world, embracing those without homes...
When the world rejected my brilliant ideas, you took me by the hand and brought me to this place where my creativity is appreciated.
Now I can spread my wings, free from restraint or judgment!
All of it is thanks to you.
The ringmaster of our circus, the person who found us... That's you.
There's sincerity in her eyes as she gently holds my hand.
It's not just me. Everyone feels the same.
It's okay if you don't remember now. As long as you're here, we can help you find your memories again.
Her gaze fixes on me, and she gently strokes the back of my hand, as if trying to communicate her heartfelt love.
So please... Stay with us! Keep on performing alongside us.
If you stay, then we can do experiments every day, swing together as we think about new possibilities, and maybe...
...Maybe invent secrets for just the two of us...
An odd sense of déjà vu builds up within me, but I can't find the words to say when I look into her expectant eyes.
(Stay, or leave... Are those really my only options?)
I understand. I'll try to remember everything, and then I'll make my decision.
The next performance is sure to give me another new clue.
Aw, so I can't keep you here after all... Let me leave you with this, though.
She kisses me on the cheek.
There's a little inspiration for you! Now go. Someone's waiting for you in the next tent.
Whatever decision you make, I'll support you.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>6 Paintbrush of Dreams</size>

scripts.say: Vibrant paintings adorn the tent, each telling a different story.
Among these beautiful works, the most eye-catching is the lifelike portrait of a girl.
I lock eyes with the portrait – and she leans forth from the painting with a beaming smile.
Hmm~ Do you like my paintings? Aren't they impressive?
They're beautiful, really.
Heheh, I had a feeling you'd say that☆
She smiles, picks up her palette, dips her fingertips in the paint, and trots toward me.
Now... It's your turn~
Huh?
You're my most important source of inspo. Without you, my paintings wouldn't exist... Heck, I wouldn't exist.
Her fingers trace my cheeks, leaving vivid trails of color behind them.
Still damp with paint, they slowly trail down my neck.
Don't move... I want a richer color here.
She smells like a mixture of paint and flowers. My heart skips a beat as her warm breath tickles my ear.
We're mere inches from each other.
Did you know? Some colors... can only be mixed by special people.
For example, the yellow light cast by a desk lamp, the faded white of paper after countless revisions, and the blue of ink on one's hand...
The words are strikingly nostalgic, as if they've touched long-lost memories.
I feel like I've seen those colors before...
Of course you have. You know them better than anyone.
That person who always dreamed, who dedicated countless nights to imagination... and to us.
She stands on her tiptoes until her lips are practically touching my earlobe. Her voice is low and soft.
My heart quakes ever so slightly as heartwarming memories surface one after another.
Memories of countless wonderful performances continuing deep into the night...
This circus and everyone in it are all in your care.
It's because of the life you breathed into us that we've been reunited with you.
She takes my hand and presses it to her heart.
Can you feel it? My heartbeat is thanks to you, too.
You could stay with us and live in this world of dreams...
Or, of course, you could also leave and return to your plain yet real world.
Her fingertips drift down to my chest, stopping at my heart.
As for me... I'd rather you get to see the outside world. I want you to experience more interesting things.
No matter how beautiful a painting may be, it's no match for what you can touch with your own hands☆
She traces a heart on my chest.
So go, already! The others are waiting for you!
Whatever path you choose, we'll always be with you! Because you're our ringmaster forever☆

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>7 Love's Arrow Strikes True</size>

scripts.say: The instant I step into the next tent, an arrow whizzes past my cheek and embeds itself in a wooden stake behind me.
Whoa, {playername}! Sorry, sorry! I didn't hit you, did I?
Following that voice, I find a girl doing a handstand while balancing on a rolling cylinder.
Her legs are arched, holding a bow like one usually would with their arms.
It's okay. You just missed me.
Ugh... It must be because I haven't found my perfect balance yet...
I know! Come over and help me, just like you used to!
Like I used to?
Yeah, yeah! With your help, I just know I can find a new pose and the perfect balance in no time!
She spins nimbly atop the cylinder and looses another arrow. It rips through the air and strikes a perfect bullseye.
See? Just like that!
With another spin, she comes to a gentle landing before lunging at me.
Here I cooome! Hah!
Surprisingly, the impact isn't as bad as I expected.
As soon as she touches me, she reins in her superhuman strength and pulls me into a sweet hug.
Hehehe! Did you like the show? It was perfect, right?
Yeah, it was incredible.
The praise makes her smile even brighter. But instantly after, she tightens her grip on me.
You know... I wasn't always this confident.
Once upon a time, everybody else was scared to get close to me. I couldn't control my strength, so I ended up breaking things all the time.
All I wanted was to help out, but I just scared people.
She leans gently against my shoulder, her voice tinged with uncertainty.
One day, the circus came to the town I lived in.
Their ringmaster said to me, "Your power isn't a curse – it's a gift from above. Instead of cowering in the shadows, come stand in the spotlight!"
Would that person happen to be me?
Yep! Ever since that day, I've followed you.
As long as you're here, I know I can overcome anything! I can stand up to any trial or enemy!
She wraps her arm around mine and squeezes ever so slightly, as if seeking reassurance.
I feel her warmth through her clothes, conveying the passion deep inside her heart.
Have you decided what you're going to do yet?
She looks up at me, a mixture of anticipation and fear in her eyes.
Clutching the hem of my top tightly. As if afraid that I might vanish in an instant.
This is the final stop on your journey... If you're going to leave, you have to decide now.
A difficult decision lies before me. However, my mind is focused on something else.
I don't want to cast aside the past or leave all on my own.
Come with me.
Huh?
Let's go to the gate. We'll bring everyone.
Everyone...?
Yeah. And then...
All of us will leave together.

sequence:
Miracle by Midnight

<size=45>8 The Final Companion</size>

scripts.say: I stand before the circus's tightly-shut gate, facing the knight and lion statues before me.
We're here, Commander! Everyone came.
I don't know what will happen if we leave together... but if this is what you want, then I will see it through to the end.
Hehehe, how inspired! Breaking through obstacles together as a team... You've really got an inventor's spirit!
Let's face it together! No matter what, I refuse to be separated from my ringmaster again♡
Yeah! Whatever choice you make, {playername}, I'll be there with you!
As if sensing our intent, the lion statue twitches its ears, and the knight statue's eye gleams.
From their shadows emerge two figures.
Oho. What a nice little troupe you brought.
So you've made your final decision. Do you plan to leave with everyone?
Yeah. It's a beautiful dream, but I don't want it all to go away when I wake up.
It's time to make it a reality.
That's a brave decision, but how will you deal with the obstacles before you?
Right on cue, the lion and knight statues come to life and stand to block the gate.
Whoa... Is it me, or is that lion way bigger than it is during our shows?
So that knight statue was no mere decoration, after all...
Leave it to me! Sometimes, paintings can be more real than real life!
She swings her paintbrush, sketching a small figure into existence.
More precisely, it's... a girl holding a bottle of milk.
Huh... Whaaat?! Is it my turn already? Ahem!
The girl quickly wipes the milk off of her mouth and hides the bottle behind her back, trying to give off a threatening air.
Peureux, give me my arms! Your job is done here, so you may go! Hurry off!
The great knight statue pauses and then vanishes along with the girl.
Alright, then I'll handle this big ol' lion!
Hehehe, no lion can beat the allure of my specially roasted meat! Come on, let's go eat some tasty food!
She waves the meat in front of the lion, which is instantly captivated. It thus follows her, happily sniffing along the way.
Hehe, our beast tamer is as skilled as ever.
Surely this gate couldn't survive, say... the almighty power of an acrobat, or a particularly dangerous device made by a certain inventor?
Great idea! I happen to have a crazy explosive on hand!
Or I could just smash it open with Marteau?
Actually, I know of a secret passage that we can use to escape.
Huh?
Why didn't you tell us sooner?
I-I was saving it up as a last resort! If I had no other choice, I would have used it to escape with {playername}!
But that won't be necessary now. Hmph.
I see... Well. Congratulations, {playername}. You've reached the boundary between dream and reality.
You've done well. Pass through this door, and you may leave this dream and take your troupe to the real world.
Despite that, I don't move yet. I stay there and keep my eyes fixed on her.
Heehee, what are you waiting for? Are you scared that there's a trap? Don't worry, this–
We're taking you with us.
This has been bothering me from the start. You knew so much about the circus that I knew you weren't just a ticket seller.
Somebody must have taken charge of this circus while my memories were lost.
It was you, wasn't it?
Oh, my. You're getting exposed, Deputy Ringmaster.
Gosh... Every choice you make reveals new possibilities I'd never even imagined.
Very well. If it's an order, then I will obey.
Same here!
They approach and take my hands.
This time... You won't forget us, will you? Heehee.
Now, everyone, are you ready for our next show?
The circus gate slowly opens, bathing us all in sunlight.
Everyone who had only existed in this story before... steps forth, ready to begin a new life.
It's another ordinary day, just like any other.
The sunlight warms my eyes, cheeks, and hands.
The dark of night caresses my hair, shoulders, and fingertips.
This is the life I've chosen. They all chose it, too.
Our happiness lies somewhere in the calm of everyday life.
Hey, {playername}! Quit your daydreaming!
A familiar voice calls out from behind me.
When I turn around, I spy Marco Polo running toward me and waving. The others are behind her.
Heehee, the project was a success. Let's call it a day, everyone!
Woohoo! It's time to pig out!
Heeey, Commander, get a move on! L'Intrépide is already waiting for us!
Our group walks down the street until we arrive at a familiar restaurant.
When I open the door, L'Intrépide waves at us enthusiastically from behind the counter. She's wearing an apron.
Ooh, welcome, Commander! Glad you made it! Come on in, please!
I saved seats for all of you. Order whatever you'd like – it's on the house today!
Another duo shuffles up behind us.
Oooh~ Looks like we came just in time!
Hehehe! Raffaello and I happened to run into each other, so we came together.
Everyone sits around the table and orders a veritable feast.
Some of us share silly stories from work, others just zone out while eating, and a certain someone sneakily holds my hand under the table.
Bathed in the restaurant's warm, bright light, I look out the window toward the city.
Life goes on – and this time, we're all together.
Happiness is ours.
Everyone, a round of applause for the creator of our story: Flandre!
Flandre! Flandre!
Don't be shy. Come on out~
U-umm... Thank you so much, everybody!
When I first decided to do this... I hoped that lots of people would read it.
Though I did worry that people would find it lacking in imagination or style...
That's why I asked you all to help me bring it to life and help me refine the little details over time.
All of this could only be a reality because of you! Thank you all so much.
I have to offer special thanks to Cherbourg for her illusions... They were wonderful. At times, I couldn't tell the difference between reality and fiction!
If that's true, then that goes to show how immersive it was! I had a lot of fun, too. Heehee!
Everyone is going to love this story.
I had fun, too! Summoning Le Hardi at the end to deal with the knight statue was a stroke of genius!
Hehe! I had to do a lot of begging to get that scene added.
Thanks to you all, the story is finally ready.
I can finally work up the confidence to submit it to Juu Port Updates!

options.content: I think it's a great story.
Tell me if you need any help, okay?

scripts.say: Hehe... Thank you, Commander! As soon as the submission is accepted, you'll be the first to know!
We'll be waiting for the good news, too!
Mhm! Thank you all again! I mean it!

sequence: Miracle by Midnight - The End

Halloween Chaos!

<size=45>Chapter 1: Everything According to Plan</size>

scripts.say: I've compiled all of the food, supplies, and other materials we'll be needing onto this list. Please take it to Akashi, we need it filled post haste.
Thank you, Gneisenau. You've been a great help.
Don't mention it. It's my pleasure to be of assistance to one such as yourself, Memphis.
Oh my! You do go on!
Alright, now we're almost done with everything we need for the Halloween party. All that's left is...
Aye! Halloween candy! You can let yours truly take care of that.
Oh! Yes! Thank you very much for volunteering, Edinburgh. We've got a lot of kids running around here who certainly can't go without their candy.
Edinburgh, you're dressed as... a witch?
Hehehe... what do you think? I designed it myself. When I finished it ahead of time, I figured I might as well put it on.
(Let's not talk about how Bel actually put it together for me.)
Heh~ You have good taste.
Right? Hmph, if only Bel could see. She said she's too busy with her Head Maid duties to join us... is it really so hard to make some time for me?
Seems like there are several problems here...
I'd like to celebrate a holiday with my sister, you know. It's not like they come around often~
(I understand where she's coming from though...)
A costume party, is it? Maybe I should look into it...
Oh? You like this sort of thing, Gneisenau? I had no idea...
Ah, if you'd like, I could ask the Maid Team to prepare an outfit for you.
Oh, thank you very much, but no. I have an idea of my own...
... You do?
Under Memphis's expert direction, the preparations proceeded apace. But unbeknownst to the team, a dark shadow was about to descend upon their Halloween party...
Hee hee hee... Halloween candy, huh? ... I think things are going to get interesting...!

sequence:
Halloween Chaos!

<size=45>Chapter 2: Smalley's Delivery Service</size>

scripts.say: Never fear, Little Beavers, my allies of justice, for I, Charles Ausburne, am here! What wrongs shall I right today?
Please, Ausburne, be more careful. You're going to knock someone over throwing open doors like that.
That's just Ausburne being herself. You can't tell her not to...
Phew... Oof...
Hey! Smalley! What are you doing over there?
Huh? Ausburne? ... With Fletcher and Thatcher.
I am not Smalley. At present. I am a Witch of the Halloween Delivery Service.
What's a Halloween Delivery Service...?
And so...
Right... You're delivering candy for Edinburgh.
Yes. That is the function of the Halloween Delivery Service.
You carry on your back the hopes and dreams of children everywhere! Such an act of pure justice! We must offer our aid to a fellow hero!
Sigh... She's roped us into a whole 'nother thing... Just part of being a Fletcher, I guess. Might as well lend a hand.
Oh? You want to join the Halloween Delivery Service!
Hahaha. Smalley looks so pleased with herself. Yes, dear, we'd love to join the Halloween Delivery Service, wouldn't we, girls?
Yeah!
Yes! Oh my. How do we deliver this?
The newly reconstituted Halloween Delivery Service found themselves face to face with a colossal pumpkin.

sequence:
Halloween Chaos!

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Same Old Prank</size>

scripts.say: This looks like a giant candy pumpkin. How are we going to move it though...?
KABOOM!!
Whaaaa?!
The p-pumpkin exploded?!
You thought it was a pumpkin. BUT IT WAS ME, ABERCROMBIE! Ahahaha! Gotcha, didn't I?
Aagh! The candy's everywhere! Look, Abercrombie, I love pranks too but there's a time and a place...
Sorry! Hey, Smalley, are you alright?
Yes. But I lost the candy and my delivery service is ruined.
I'll help... with the candy.
Thank... you?
Hip~ Hop~ Here. The Candy.
Ahahaha! Mikazuki's a jiangshi! Great costume!
Yes. Mikazuki is a jiangshi. Hip~ Hop~ Give me taiyaki.
You've all gotten into the Halloween spirit.
Okay now, everyone pitch in and pick up some candy please.
Eheehee! Sorry! I'll help!
Damn right you're helping, Abercrombie! This is all your fault to begin with!
Let's not bicker needlessly about who did what!
Candy collection complete. Halloween Delivery Service. Resuming operation...!
No taiyaki here... Mikazuki will return to the Mutsukis... Goodbye... Hip~ Hop~
I'm out too. Cheers~
Abercrombie's almost as fast as a Little Beaver!
What do you say, Smalley?
Yes. The Halloween Delivery Service rides again!
Yeah!
Hehehe... Infiltration successful...

sequence:
Halloween Chaos!

<size=45>Chapter 4: Suiting Up</size>

scripts.say: I finished getting dressed... Erebus...?
Erebus?
Yes, but... Must we go to this party...?
Please...? I really want to go with you, Erebus...
... Right, but... Just give me a moment.
How do I look?
Ooh... Erebus, you make a great witch...
I'm so happy I get to go to the party with you, Erebus...
If you're happy, Terror, that's good enough for me.
You really won't go with me?
Damn right! What's the point of some namby-pamby frou-frou dress up party? Call me when they got a pumpkin-smashing gunnery competition or something worth my time!
... Of course.
And what's this goblin getup you're in? Doesn't leave much to the imagination! ... They're gonna remember you, that's for sure.
Hip~ Hop~ The Halloween party should be...
Sniff... I smell candy! It's coming from that way! But... there's another smell mixed in here...
Heeheehee! It's almost time! Time for me to be crowned this year's Queen of Pranks!
Abercrombie... I don't like the look of that smile. You'd better not be planning any pranks! Does someone want another lecture from Hood?
Auntie Hood?! ... Phew, she's not here. I almost had a heart attack...
Whatever their feelings about the party, everyone was about to experience Halloween Chaos!

sequence:
Halloween Chaos!

<size=45>Chapter 5: Party Chaos</size>

scripts.say: I want to thank everyone for your help in making this Halloween party run smoothly. You all did great!
That's all I have to say. Please enjoy yourselves. Help yourself to some pumpkin pie. And don't go too wild with the pranks!
Those of you who want candy, or want to help hand it out, please see Edinburgh.
That's right! I'm tonight's master of candy. Step right up!
Yeaaah!
Trick or treat.
Here you are! And thanks so much for your help, Smalley.
It was nothing. Thank the Halloween Delivery Service.
Hip~ Hop~ Trick or treat. Mikazuki craves taiyaki.
Ahaha! I'm afraid I've only candy, dear.
Oh... I can give candy to Mutsuki.
Can I have some candy as well?
Alright. You want to help hand it out to the kids? Here, I'll give you a bag... G- Gneisenau?!
Hm... Judging by your reaction, I think I chose my costume well.
It's... It's quite something, it is... You're a succubus, are you?
It's always witch this, witch that on Halloween. I certainly didn't want to be just another witch.
Well... I'm afraid I don't know how to respond to that...
While the two of them enjoyed a friendly chat, something awful was brewing elsewhere...
Th- this is what the destroyers' candy tastes like...? I can feel something building inside of me. It's a powerful explosive force... Nnngg...
Um... Ark Royal? Ark Royal? Is she dead...? Will she be a jiangshi too?
This candy, it smells a little different... There's something else mixed in? Hmm...
Uuaaaaggghhh...
Her anguished cries echoed back and forth across the party.
Wh- what happened? Did the candy go bad? I prepared it myself, it couldn't have...
I suspect the candy has been adulterated with some foreign substance.
Ahahahaaa! AHAHAHAHA! My ultimate Halloween prank is a roaring success! Is everyone enjoying Abercrombie's Apocalyptic Wasabi Candy?!
Heeheehee! I've been planning this caper since the very beginning and it feels fantastic to see it pulled off without a hitch! You may call me the Queen of Halloween Pranks from now on! Ahahaha!
From our very first meeting...!
Precisely! Now I bid you all a delightfully chaotic Halloween as I think it's time I made my daring escape! Toodle-oo!
Oh, what a crafty little dickens you are, "Queen of Halloween Pranks."
Oh no... It can't be...
Auntie Hood?!
... How many times have I told you? Don't. Call. Me. Auntie. Hood!!
My deepest apologies to you all, I'm afraid this girl needs a more "thorough education" in how to behave.
Nooo! I swear I won't do it again, Aunt- err, Sister Hood! Please let go of my ear! It's gonna fall off! You're tearing it!!
And so we draw the curtain on our story of Halloween chaos. Thus end the wails of terror and grief. Happy Halloween. Happy Halloween?

sequence:
Dreamy Day in Dream Park

<size=45>1 At the Dream's Entrance</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
My desk is filled to the brim with redesign proposals for the port's amusement park. They seem to glitter under the light of my desk lamp.
Need to memorize all these ideas before Akashi puts them all together...
I rub my tired eyes and try to focus on the next document.
That's when, out of nowhere, I smell a floral aroma.
What's that smell?
I look up and scan my surroundings. There isn't anything that could plausibly be the source of the scent.
At the same time, my eyelids start feeling really heavy.
I slap my cheeks to try to wake myself up.
It's no use, however. The drowsiness is too strong.
*yaaawn*... A few minutes' sleep, then I'll get back to it...
In the distance, I see a castle like something out of a fairy tale, with spires and all.
The light reflecting off of them gives this amusement park a very dreamlike vibe.
A lighthearted and pleasant melody plays, while the faint smell of cotton candy hangs in the air.
(Crap. I must've slept until noon...)
(Wait, no. Isn't this Akashi's device at work? When did she sneak that onto my person?)
Amidst my confusion, a familiar voice addresses me.
Welcome to Dream Park, Commander.
Amagi?
Turning around, I see Amagi, standing there with a sweet yet implicative smile.
Dream Park?
(This reminds me of that theory that dreams consist of what you experience during the day.)
(I discussed dreams with Amagi earlier and reviewed redesigns for the amusement park, so my brain must've mashed those two ideas together.)
Heehee. While, yes, this is a dream, allow me to tell you that I am very real.
Moreover, this amusement park does not merely exist in your dreams.
As though she read my mind, she explains the situation with a smile.
So what is this place, then?
You could say that it's the sum total of all our anticipation and hopes for the amusement park.
I've seen how hard you're working on the redesign of our amusement park, so I took it upon myself to build this dream.
You BUILT a dream? You can do that?
I didn't do it alone, mind you. Unzen and Shinano both lent me a hand.
On another note... Have you heard of the theory that dreams are windows into the heart?
I answer with a nod, and she continues her explanation.
While your brain processes designs rationally, your heart reflects ideas in their purest form.
I get it now. All you did was provide the foundation for this dream.
The rest was on us. All the buildings, rides, and so on in this amusement park are made from our ideas and preconceptions, right?
Succinctly put.
I would add one thing, though. It's not just the building and the rides that are a part of the dream, but the people as well.
Are you saying people might appear here not just as guests, but as members of staff as well?
Indeed.
Having to work in a dream sounds pretty bad...
One question – if I redesign the port's amusement park to look like this, won't the surprise factor be completely gone, then?
Firstly, don't worry about the work part. The dream places no burden on your body or your mind.
Secondly, with the exception of you and I, everyone will gradually forget everything that happens in this place.
Which is to say, no, it will still be a surprise to them all.
I see.
Heehee. As much as I'd love to share in the amusement with you, I think you should first have a look around for yourself.
Vacations don't come every day for you, so I hope you'll enjoy yourself thoroughly.
When you wish to see me, kindly head to the castle over there. Until then...
Suddenly, a whirlwind of flower petals envelops Amagi, and she disappears.
Wait!
I reach out to try to stop her from leaving, but the only thing my hand catches is a single red petal.
Her kind voice, however, lingers.
I wish you a pleasant stay. I'll be waiting for you at the castle.
My gaze goes straight to the entrance to the amusement park of dreams.
Well, she said to enjoy myself, so that's what I'll do.
I open the door to the haunted house. A spherical object radiating a strange light in the dark immediately catches my attention.
The sphere rises and falls as though it were breathing, then the light dims and the silhouette of a person appears inside the sphere.
Is that... Akagi?
Oh dear. It looks like she wandered into the nightmare as well.
I don't see her. Where is she?
I point at the floating sphere. Bristol shoots me a confused look in response.
What? There's nothing there except a maze.
Do you see Akagi, Fu Shun?
Nope. Also, that's no maze, that's a kitchen.
A kitchen? We're all seeing completely different things here.
The nightmare is causing this. Perhaps what you see are your deepest fears.
Of course, I'm only speculating here.
Well, I don't know where Akagi is, but I sure think we should hurry up and save her.
Yeah, but how?
How, indeed...
There are two ways to deal with a nightmare, Commander. Do you know them?
Waking up Akagi, or turning this into a sweet dream, right?
As we talk, a small orb of light appears ahead of us, then flies off somewhere inside the building.
What was that?
That was the fragment of a sweet dream.
So if I got that right, a person's sweet dreams will turn into fragments the longer they're stuck in the nightmare.
Which is to say, wake her up, and those sweet dreams will be gone.
Yes. Yes. Our only option is to break up the nightmare.
Everything should work out if we just collect all the fragments and bring them to her.
The nightmare should vanish by itself once her dreams turn pleasant again.
Doing so will also make the park go back to normal.
However, I must admit manipulating dreams isn't my strong suit, and my conjecture could be wrong.
Well, it's the best we've got right now.
Dreams this, dreams that – all we need to do is gather more of that spooky thing we saw, right?
Hey, it wasn't spooky! She just said those are fragments of a sweet dream!
Right. Let's go, but keep your eyes open.
Our search begins in earnest, and we soon find out that neither Fu Shun nor Bristol are affected by what they're each seeing.
That totally looked like a dead end, but I could phase right through it!
It was exciting, not knowing if I'd slam into it or not. Honestly, this is pretty fun!
We're literally in a nightmare, and you're treating it like an adventure?
Duh! There are adventures everywhere for those with the eyes to see!
While Fu Shun explains with glee, a glowing object appears from a corner of the house.
The object slowly floats through the air, landing in Fu Shun's hand.
Ah, it seems the fragments respond to positive emotions. Commander, are you thinking what I'm thinking?
Sure am. Let's give it a shot.
We take this hint and try all kinds of things to bring out positive feelings.
We recall fond memories, we whistle gentle songs, and more. One after another, the fragments respond, drifting toward us.
I know these fragments... This is from when Akagi ate dango with the Commander, when they watched the flowers bloom, when they went to a banquet... When they had tea, when they laughed together...
A sweet dream, to her, must be recalling those precious memories.
Let's give them back to her now.
Once all the fragments have been collected, I ask Bristol and Fu Shun to wait at the entrance while Amagi and I head to our destination.
Amagi holds up the fragments with her hand, and they quickly float toward the sphere of light that Akagi is trapped inside.
The fragments all hover in the air in unison, then fade away into nothingness.
Freed from the sphere, Akagi comes falling down. I immediately spread my arms to catch her.
Ah... Commander...?
She slowly opens her eyes in my arms, a look of confusion on her face.
A second later, she seems to remember something and frowns.
Ugh... I came to the haunted house for a fun time, and somehow, I blacked out...
And then, I had this strange dream...
It's alright. The nightmare is gone now.
How, indeed...
She responds needily, squeezing my hand tightly with hers and not letting go.
I pat her on the head, trying to get her to relax.
As soon as I stop, she squeezes my hand tightly with hers and not letting go.
Ahem.
A-Amagi?!
Realizing that her sister is here, she promptly lets go of my hand.
She then straightens her clothes out quickly and asks about what is happening at the port.
Well...
(The only ones aware that this is a dream are me, Amagi, Bristol, and Fu Shun.)
(I don't know if I should tell her the truth...)
Amagi senses that I'm hesitant to answer. She leans in to whisper into my ear.
Don't worry. It's okay for her to know.
She explains the situation on my behalf. Once that's over, we turn around to regroup with the other two.
As we're walking, Amagi leans in again to whisper to me.
It doesn't matter who finds out that this is a dream. Everyone but you and me will forget about it.
Oh. I'm guessing that's why you didn't stop me when I explained it to Bristol and Fu Shun.
I worried for nothing, then.
Heehee. That you did.
Look! They're back!
Great, there's more of you...
Whatever. I'll deal with it until this nightmare business is over.
So, that's that for the nightmare in this area, right?
Yes. We should start heading to the next one.
Alrighty! Off we go!
Almost as soon as we enter the area and pass by a stall, I spot an ominous tunnel in the middle of nowhere.
Now THAT'S an eerie phenomenon if I ever saw one!
A tunnel into the darkness, so dark it won't even let light through! And in that darkness, an unspeakable terror lies in wait!
Each step forward – one step closer to everlasting insanity!
Gah! Speak not of such frightening things!
Waaahhh! I don't wanna be here! I wanna go hooome!
Now, now, don't be afraid! Bristol is just running her mouth. She is, right, Commander?
Yeah. She's just saying things.
B-but... Nagato and some others went in earlier...
And they still haven't come back...
What? Nagato went in? Why did she do that?
Let me explain. Before it went dark, I brought a bunch of destroyers here to ride the miniature railway.
We ran into Nagato and her friends, who were going to do the same.
Then, the bell rang, and this tunnel suddenly appeared right in front of the train.
They said it looked dreadfully suspicious, and rode the train inside to investigate. So I was left here to guard the little destroyers.
With perfect timing, the speakers suddenly play the sound of a train whistle, and the miniature train emerges from the tunnel.
Are... Are they back?
No... There's no one on the train.
I'd wager that there's another nightmare in that tunnel, like what got Akagi.
Ark Royal, you stay here and watch the destroyers. The rest of you, come with me.
I'm going to have to say no. I'm coming with. Resolving this situation comes before anything else.
If you need someone to look after the little destroyers, well...
Mmh... While I may teeechnically be a destroyer myself, I could definitely look after them for you.
After leaving the destroyers in Mogador's care, I board the tiny train with Ark Royal.
The whistle blows again, and the train chugs along into the dark tunnel.
Once we're inside, the lights that run parallel to the train tracks suddenly go dark.
Everything instantly goes pitch black and the train slows down significantly, like a person groping around in the dark.
Whoa, it's as dark as anything! You know what this mood is perfect for? A ghost story!
Bristol lights her lantern and shines the light up right below her face.
It was a dark, dreary night, and the old floorboards creaked with a spine-chilling sound...
Stop! No more!
Why? Scared?
N-no! I just think we should focus on fixing this nightmare problem!
Fair enough. Commander, should we get off?
The lantern in Bristol's hand swayed slightly as she moved. It wasn't the only thing that swayed.
Huh? Did the train just shake a little?
Yes, I could feel it.
(Strange... The train swayed at the same time as her lantern. Maybe it's a coincidence, or maybe...)
Bristol, turn your lantern the other way.
Oh, sure!
She faces her lantern in a direction, and sure enough, the locomotive changes angles accordingly.
I knew it wasn't a coincidence.
I wonder if the light's brightness affects the train's speed. That would explain why it's going so slow right now.
Illuminating the tunnel may perhaps even deconstruct the nightmare and solve everything.
All of a sudden, the train comes to a stop.
The door slides open without a sound. Heavy, cold air rushes in from the tunnel.
Let's get off.
Relying solely on Bristol's lantern, we move through the darkness and find Nagato's group, lighting the way forward by burning shikigami.
It's you. We've learned some things...
Nagato proceeds to explain her findings and theories about the tunnel.
If we want to investigate deeper – or escape, for that matter – we'll have to either get the train moving or light up the whole tunnel.
And if we don't get the train moving, getting out is going to be a tall order.
We haven't found a way out, but we DID find a really special place while searching around!
That, we did. We haven't been able to light it up, despite trying everything.
All we can make out of it is a faint, round contour.
Come with me, Commander. I think you'll get it when you see it.
Lead the way.
Shimanto guides me to the strange place they've been unable to illuminate no matter what they did.
There's a sphere enveloped in a strange light, flickering. Inside it, the faint silhouette of a fox-eared girl.
Looks like it's Kaga this time.
Come again? You can see through this darkness?
I quickly explain the situation to them, then set about trying to free Kaga from the nightmare.
Oh, it's this again. All we gotta do is bring out positive emotions and the fragments will come to us.
Is it really that simple? If so, I'll start thinking positive thoughts right away!
Yeah! Adventuring is so fun! I love going on adventures!
...Where are the fragments? Was I not positive enough or something?
The tunnel remains as dark as ever, with no sign of any sweet dream fragments appearing.
Oookay then. It's not the same as with Akagi.
Seems so...
Well, if that's off the table, I'll just have to wake her up.
Kaga's eyes are firmly shut and her brow furrowed. She's clearly having a nightmare.
What's more, the light around her begins to flicker even more intensely and rapidly.
The tunnel, meanwhile, is only getting darker and darker.
This reminds me... While I couldn't make out the words, I heard a voice speak to me while I was asleep.
Maybe she can hear what we're saying right this moment.
Then I know a way to wake her up.
I ask everyone else to stand back, then I slowly approach the nightmare sphere.
Kaga, do you remember the time when...
I recite a series of happy memories to her. Her expression becomes notably more relaxed.
At the same time, the darkness surrounding the tunnel fades away. Once the light of the setting sun shines in, Kaga slowly opens her eyes.
I just had a terrible dream...
But, just as it was getting to me, I heard your voice. It calmed me.
Thanks to that, my dream went back to good again.
The soft sunlight caresses her cheek, and her lips curve into a faint smile.
With Kaga freed from her nightmare, our "detective team" has grown quite big now.
There's one final aberration. This should be it.
The Ferris wheel. Its paint is flaking off and its metal frame has rusted to a horrendous degree.
The cabins, faded and discolored, sway dangerously, like they'll detach and fall down any minute now.
(I knew something was wrong with the Ferris wheel ever since the haunted house.)
(It ended up last on our list, though, because Fu Shun and Bristol led the team.)
It's like eating strawberry cake and being unable to decide whether to eat the strawberry or the cake first.
Me, personally, I start with the cake!
Oh, hello. Are you here to ride the Ferris wheel?
I'm sorry to say, but I don't think it's in a rideable state.
It was normal just a minute ago, then it changed to look like... this.
Say, Akagi, why don't you ride it first?
You JUST said it doesn't even look rideable.
Aww. I thought you were going to prove me wrong. I expected too much!
Just as Akagi is about to hit back with a retort, Yuubari appears out of nowhere.
Hmm... This isn't quite working out.
What are you doing, Yuubari? Trying to fix the Ferris wheel?
Whuah! You startled me, Master... Good timing, though!
Yes, I'm trying to get it up and running again. Tosa is still on it, you see.
She exhales a sigh and points to the cabin at the very top of the wheel.
I look up and can just about make out the figure of a person inside it.
It's Tosa who's having a nightmare this time, eh.
No, not quite.
She isn't sleeping, she's simply stuck up there.
Hey! You down there!
How long are the repairs going to take?
Tosa's voice is only barely audible.
(Seeing as she's wide awake, someone else must be afflicted by the nightmares, then.)
(But who?)
As I ponder the question, a blue butterfly flies toward me.
It circles in the air for a while, then lands on my nose.
To be in a dream is no different than being trapped in a dream...
My hint is this: "only the one who tied the tiger's bell may untie it."
Shinano's voice echoes from somewhere, though she herself is nowhere to be seen.
After giving me her hint, the blue butterfly takes off from my nose and flies away.
(Untie the tiger's bell... No different than being trapped in a dream...)
I've figured it out.
If I may ask, why have you been staring at me this whole time?
The Ferris wheel is like this because of you. You're the one having a nightmare.
Me?
You, dear sister?
Oh! Here it comes! My second most favorite part – explaining the mystery!
And what's your number one?
The adventuring part, obviously!
I don't know what I was expecting...
Ahem.
I clear my throat to stop the conversation from derailing any further.
Amagi, you created this dream, and you're aware that you're dreaming.
If you couldn't fall asleep in your own dream, the nightmares wouldn't have occurred to begin with.
We know there's an aberration here, but we don't know who's being affected by the nightmares.
Therefore, it stands to reason that you've been subconsciously influenced by the nightmares all this time.
So that's how it is... I had no idea I was being influenced.
Come to think of it, something has been unnerving me ever since twilight set in... I didn't expect it to influence the dream on this scale.
At least now we know what's causing the nightmares...
Amagi smiles and holds my and Akagi's hands.
She bows to everyone gathered, thanking and apologizing to them at the same time.
Commander, Akagi, Kaga, and all the rest of you...
Thank you for being here for me. It puts me at ease.
The time you share with me is the most precious thing I could ask for.
Let us rid ourselves of the nightmares and restore this beautiful place to what it once was.
As the final words leave her mouth, the rusted and busted Ferris wheel regains its luster and starts moving again.
The ominous smoke around the park vanishes, and everything becomes clear again.
A minute later, the Ferris wheel completes its cycle, and Tosa safely exits.
I feared I'd be stuck up there forever, heh. Glad to be back on the ground.
Heehee. Perhaps you'll ride it again, though.
What does that mean?
Just like that, a cabin massive enough to fit everyone standing here appears on the Ferris wheel.
Seeing as we're all here, why don't we ride it together?
Hmm. From an architectural engineering point of view, this attraction should never be able to support such a cabin...
But what does it matter? This is a dream.
The huge cabin finally reaches the peak of the wheel.
The bell tolls, signaling the start of night. One by one, the lamps around the park light up.
Whoooa! Look at that view!
Look, Nagato! Over there!
Aye, I see it. Truly a spectacular view.
Hey, remind me – why are we on the Ferris wheel, again?
Yeah. It feels like we got dragged aboard for the sake of a climax or something.
Who cares about the why and how? Just enjoy the amusement park for what it is!
Thanks for all this, Amagi.
Heehee. I should be the one thanking you. I'm so happy to have been here with you and everyone else.
With the nightmares all gone, the amusement park is filled with voices of jubilation.
The dreamy days in Dream Park are sure to continue for a long time.
As I'm walking around the amusement park, I come across Kashino, selling milk at a stall.
G-good morning, Commander.
She bids me good morning, holding a sign and wearing airy clothes.
Can I interest you in some milk?
It's cold, delicious, and freshly squeezed just this morning. Try it!
Don't mind if I do.
She puts down her sign and picks up an empty bottle.
Ahh! Ow, oww...
But, just as she starts filling it, she hits her foot on something.
She recoils from the pain, and milk spills everywhere.
As she frantically tries to salvage the situation, she loses her balance and seems on the verge of falling over.
I run over and wrap my arm around her waist, stopping her fall.
While she staggers, I quickly reach out to catch her.
Her body feels supple in my hands, and her skin feels warm from the sunlight.
She leans on me to steady herself then looks up at me.
Caught off guard by this sudden contact, she has a deep red blush spanning from ear to ear.
Th-thanks for helping me...
The stall is pretty small, and my view gets blocked often. It's easy to knock things over...

options.content: You need to be more careful.

scripts.say: Thanks to you! If not for you, I really would've fallen over.
Carelessness like that will get you hurt, and we don't want that.
You'e right... I'll try to be more careful!
*sigh*... Now I need to clean up this spilled milk.
Still blushing, she steps away and takes out a cloth to start cleaning the stall.
Need any help with that?
Oh, thanks, but I can do it myself! No need to go out of your way for me.
Not taking no for an answer, I pick up a cloth of my own and help her clean up anyway.
Once the stall is tidy again, Kashino produces a new bottle and pours fresh milk into it.
She ties a cute little ribbon around the bottle's neck, then gives it to me.
That's everything♪
Here you go, Commander. I hope you enjoy it!
I take the bottle and chug her milk in a matter of seconds. It really drives the summer heat away.
You weren't kidding. It IS delicious.
Whew. I'm glad you like it!
A satisfied smile appears on her lips. She has forgotten all about the stress and embarrassment of her accident just a minute ago.
If you need a break from the amusement park, or if you just feel thirsty, please feel free to come back♪
After stepping inside a castle at the amusement park, I'm drawn to a particular door by the floral aroma coming from the other side.
I open the door and walk down a long corridor, candles on the side igniting with each increment forward, lighting up the dark room.
Welcome, Commander. I've been awaiting you.
The candlelight shines on a throne at the opposite end. Upon it, Amagi sits.
Before you begin your investigation, I'd like you to come here and rest for a while.
She takes her scepter and softly taps on the floor with it.
Out of thin air, this produces a table lined with comfortable-looking chairs and an assortment of tea and treats.
Well, I'm not one to refuse another's hospitality.
I take a seat and help myself to the refreshments she's offering. Then, a while later...
Heehee. Have you had your fill? Are you going to start your investigation now?
Yeah.
Hearing my answer, she smiles contentedly.
Very well.
CLICK!
A door in the room just locked.
Huh?
This is your first investigation – how to unlock the door and leave.
I'll give you a clue – the key is on my person. Won't you come closer and investigate?
Doing as she asks, I approach her. I examine her beguiling smile while I ponder where the key might be.
It isn't. Are you not just pining for a tail to fluff?
(So it's not in her tails. In that case...)
How could it be, when there is scarcely any clothes to hide it under? No, it is not.
(So it's not under her clothes. In that case...)
Heehee. Well, why don't you take it and check for yourself?
Assuming that means I have permission, I place my hand on the scepter and try to take it, but she won't let me.
I am the lord of this castle. I will not simply GIVE it to you.
There is suddenly a sharpness to her gaze. She holds the scepter firmly to prevent me from snatching it.
The silent struggle between us continues, her scepter brushing against her tidy clothes and creating wrinkles all over.
As we keep going, she starts panting and her cheeks turn red.
Commander...
CLING!
Our miniature tug-of-war is interrupted by the sound of metal hitting the floor.
Wait... Was that the key?
It seems I accidentally pressed the scepter's key release mechanism amidst our little scuffle.
Heehee. As you surmised, it was indeed hidden inside the scepter. You just had to press in the right spot and the gem at the top would come loose, letting the key out.
Now that you have the key, the next step to continuing your investigation is to leave this place with me.
Rising from her throne, she brushes her fluffy tails against the flowers decorating the room.
An intense floral aroma forces its way into my nostrils, making me rub my nose with my hand.
What's the matter? Are you feeling cold?
No, it's just the flowers. They have a strong scent.
I'm sorry about that. I'll use less flowers in the future.
It's fine. Also, now that you mention it, it DOES feel a bit cold in here.
Heehee. Fortunately, I know just the thing to warm you up.
She enacts her plan, folding her arm around mine and pressing up against me, sharing her body heat.
Let's stick close, Commander.
It'll be much warmer this way.
Leaving the water park, I return to the break area.
There, I find the impeccable and fashionable head maid, Belfast, who has been waiting for me.
Welcome back, Master.
There is an iced beverage ready, if you'd like to cool down. Please wait just one moment and I'll get it for you.
She gracefully brushes her hair up, then brings out the cold drink.
But then, in an uncharacteristic fashion for the maid prepared for anything, a bothered look forms on her face.
Well... This is troublesome.
What's the problem?
You see, Miss Hyuuga asked to borrow my opener earlier, and I obliged.
She should have given it back by now, but it seems she forgot to.
I'm afraid that if I go to reclaim it now, it's going to take quite some time. This will undoubtedly change the beverage's texture.
Therefore, I am left with no choice but to open the bottle through some other means.
"Other means"?
Yes. Master, would you mind standing back a bit?
As she asks, I take a few steps back.
She strikes some sort of ready pose, then with a lightning-quick maneuver...
POP! FSSHHH!
The bottlecap flies off, and a sweet aroma fills the air.
A splash of liquid hits her dazzlingly fair skin, leaving a faint red trace on it.
Please enjoy, Master.

options.content: How in the world did you do that?

scripts.say: You're welcome. This is only a maid's job.
Heehee. I'm pleased to see you were surprised.
Let's not get hung up on bottle-opening techniques. Please have a taste.
I walk back up and accept the bottle from her. That's when I notice that she's faintly blushing.
The sunlight coming in from the glass ceiling shines on her, highlighting every little bead of sweat on her skin.
(Ah... This place is scorching. Now I feel sorry for keeping her waiting so long.)
Hey, why don't you have a drink, too? It's pretty hot in here.
Not giving her the chance to be humble, I take a glass, fill it, and offer it to her.
Also, you could probably use a break.
Heehee. I appreciate it, Master, but I am not tired. Waiting for her master is but one of a maid's many duties.
Of course, I do understand your concern. Thank you kindly.
She takes the glass. I extend mine to offer her a toast, and she reciprocates.
Cheers. I sincerely hope you'll have a wonderful day at the amusement park.
Then, later on, in the event that you feel tired...
The well-spoken Belfast suddenly trails off before looking at me with a slightly cheeky smile.
Then we may discuss having a break. Heehee.
BANG! BANG!
Following the sound of gunshots, I end up at a shooting gallery stall.
There, I find Musashi with a water gun, scoring every single hit on a series of moving targets.
Ah, it's you. Splendid timing.
Next to her, there are two entire piles of stuffed animals she has won as prizes.
I step closer, and she addresses me again.
The children said they wanted these, so I'm giving them what they desire.
What about you? Are there any prizes that you want?
Not really. If you win any more, just give it to them.
I see. Then this is enough target practice for one day.
(She looks a bit disappointed all of a sudden. Hmm...)
While I'm not after any prize, I wouldn't mind a little competition with you.
A good idea. However, it would be rather dull to compete merely over who gets the most points.
As this is a rare opportunity, what say you we make a wager?
What kind of wager?
The loser must do any one thing that the winner demands of them.
Alright. I can do that.
I want some time to get used to this gun's handling, so how about you go first?
Heehee. Very well. The first move is mine, then.
Our first round was a tie, so we ran again... and again, and again. Our scores are now evenly tied once more.
A series of shots from our respective guns knock down every target, save for one last one.
All I need to do is hit this final target to win.
Make your shot count, Commander.
Aligning my sights with the target, I squeeze the trigger. A beam of water knocks the target down. Victory is mine.
Congratulations. You were a worthy opponent.
As promised, I will agree to any request of yours.
Whatever you wish, I shall make it happen.
(Nothing really comes to mind... Oh, I know – I'll let her decide.)
Alright. I want you to ask ME to do something.
Whatever you wish, I shall make it happen.
She briefly raises an eyebrow in modest surprise, then regains her gentle smile.
Interesting... Very well. I know what to ask of you.
The water beam misses the target. Musashi wins our wager with only a one-point advantage.
Dang. You won.
Her gaze moves from the target onto me, and she gives me a gentle smile.
Though that was some outstanding shooting, you ceded the final target to me.
I'll say, you completely subverted my expectations. Heehee.
Even though you wanted me to win, I still accept my victory.
So, that leaves us with my request.
I'm all ears.
Either the merry mood of the amusement park must have gotten to her, or seeing the stuffed animals stirred something inside her...
At any rate, she flashes a distinct smile. A smile like that of an innocent child.
It's simple. You will accompany me and have a jolly good time in the amusement park.
Bunny, don't go. We'll play after I've gotten cha– Whuh?
C-Commander! Wh-what're you doing... Oh! Is it time already?
On the other side of the door, Ayase is clearly flustered.
Yeah. We're supposed to meet now.
S-sorry, but you'll have to wait! I-I haven't changed into my banquet dress yet!
Oh gosh... I just remembered I also forgot to lock the door...
The way i-it's going now, I'm guaranteed to be late... *sigh*...
I'm so darn forgetful... a-and I can't get into these clothes...

options.content: It's not the end of the world.

scripts.say: Take it easy. Go at your own pace.
Okay... B-but even if I do, I don't have any idea how to put this on anymore...
D-do you think you could help me?
That is, if you want me to.
Yes, please... I don't even know how I'm supposed to put this on anymore...
C-come in and help me, please...
With her permission, I step inside and start examining how this banquet dress is supposed to come together.
Umm... Is it confusing?
I've tried everything, and I still can't get it on...
She hides behind a curtain so thin I can still partly see through it. She is red from head to toe from nervousness.
It's a bit tricky, but I think I can help.
Put this on first, then affix it with a ribbon.
Okay... Y-you mean, put the ribbon around my chest? Umm... Is this right?
Eek! I-it came loose again!
Th-this is hopeless...
You need to make sure it's on tight first before you put on the ribbon.
Umm... I-I'll try...
Mmgh... Mmhh! No, it's no good... Please help me...
It's okay. Let's see if I can do it.
Oh no... I'm sorry to have to bother you like this...
After some difficulties, Ayase has finally overcome the trial known as putting on a dress.
But, when I assume we're ready to leave, she stops in her tracks and stares at the floor, gripping the rim of her dress.
Do you... Do you think this looks good on me?
It doesn't look... w-weird, does it? I'm just wondering b-because...
It doesn't look weird. In fact, it looks great on you.
Don't be so nervous. I promise you'd look cute in anything.
My encouragement blows away her nervousness, and she gives me a bright smile.
Courageously, she takes my hand and holds it tight, then gathers herself with a deep breath.
Okay! Let's go then, Commander! I... I can't wait to dance with you!
I've finally found you, Commander.
A set of wheels screeches to a stop, and I hear a female voice from behind me.
Turning around, I see a pumpkin carriage built with transparent materials pulled by a horse, with a smiling Watarase in the cabin.

options.content: Watarase? What are you doing here?
Great timing. Want to watch the fireworks together?

scripts.say: Why, to watch the fireworks with you, of course.
I do. In fact, that's what I came here to do.
It's fortunate that I ran into you here. If I hadn't, I would have no one to share such a gorgeous sight with.
Incidentally, are you here for the same reason? To watch the fireworks?
Nope. I'm honestly just here by chance.
This place is a bit remote, but the view is great.
You're quite lucky then, Commander.
Let's get comfortable before we talk more. Would you like to join me in my carriage?
Well, that's a question of how more than anything else. How do you get in it?
If you wish for it, it can be done. That's how dreams work.
Come. There's a thin tatami cushion in here. It's quite comfortable. I have drinks ready as well.
Alright.
I approach the transparent pumpkin carriage. Watarase extends a hand to me.
Take my hand and come inside.
I climb inside the carriage and she moves aside to make space for me.
Mmh... This is a bit cramped... Please try to bear with it.
I'll be sure to pay closer attention to the size of the cabin's interior next time.
It's okay. Nothing I can't handle.
I sit down on the space she cleared out for me. Only now does it hit me that it's so cramped that we are quite literally rubbing shoulders in here.
Whew... This is a bit embarrassing.
She drinks down the red contents of her glass, then wraps her arm around mine, with some difficulty.
I'm feeling a bit tipsy... Would you mind lending me your shoulder?
Her voice sounds slightly muffled somehow, perhaps because she drank it all in one go.
As the spectacle to go with her wine, fireworks shoot into the sky and explode in dazzling colors. Her smile, too, is of the dazzling variety.
Being all alone with you, watching these beautiful fireworks together... Truly, this is a dream come true.
How wonderful it would be to never... wake up from it...
Her voice shrinks into a whisper. I can hear her breaths slowing down, becoming calmer.
Sweet dreams... Commander... Zzzzz...
Whew...
Having spent the whole day at the amusement park, I fall into bed like a tree toppling over.
While I'm still barely awake, I suddenly sense that something isn't quite right.
Heheh! Good morning, Commander!
My bed creaks, and suddenly I feel the weight of a woman's body on me.
How'd you get in here?
You were out and about the whole day, and I figured you could use a massage.
So I walked in, just like that. You're totally defenseless when you're exhausted!
Uh-huh...
Hey, don't worry 'bout the details. Do you want a massage or not?
It's too early for "good morning," don't you think? It's still the very EARLY morning.
Early morning is still morning, so good morning it is!
You've gotta be exhausted after wanderin' around the amusement park all day. That's why I'mma give you a real good massage!
Sure. Go ahead.
Ahaha! You're gonna love this!
I think I'd prefer to just sleep instead.
You're sleepy, I get it, but you NEED a massage or those muscles're gonna be aching like hell tomorrow.
Just close your eyes and relax. I'll handle everything else!
First up, let's get some essential oil on you. Ooh, this smells good! Just gonna warm this up with my hands aaand...
She spreads the warm oil over my back and shoulders. Its light aroma fills my nostrils.
Then the massage begins. It's neither too rough, nor too gentle – it's just perfect.
God, your whole body's stiff as a board. I've gotta soften you up good.
Today must've been a REAL workout for you. Your muscles feel like rubber.
Speakin' of, did you enjoy yourself at the amusement park? Call me curious.

options.content: Yeah. I rode all kinds of fun attractions.
Sure did. I had a blast.

scripts.say: Same! Shoutouts to my favorites – the roller coaster and the Ferris wheel. We should totally ride those together sometime!
I bet! You haven't had a chance to let loose for a long while now!
Between our chit-chat and the rhythmic massage I'm getting, I can feel the sleepiness creeping up on me.
Commander? Hellooo? Mind if I press on this spot?
Uh-huh...
I'll take your silence as a yes!
Uh-huh...
Straddling the line between dreams and reality, I hear Bremerton grumble something under her breath.
Maaan... Just falling asleep on a girl when she's massaging you like this...
If that's how it's gonna be, fine...
The bed jiggles faintly, and a moment later, I feel a warm kiss on my cheek.
G'night, Commander.
Sleep tight♪
Leaving Kashino's milk stall behind, I resume my walk around the park.
Then, a delicious smell wafts by my nose.
Hm? What's that?
Not that far from the milk stall, I see a group of girls setting up their own stands.
Oh, hello, Commander. I have freshly made pastries. Care to try one?
Dunkerque smiles at me, holding a tray lined with all kinds of finely-decorated pastries.
Try these, too! They're my special-made fried noodles!
The petite Lung Wu stands on a chair, working a spatula while dishing up a plate of Empery cuisine.
C'mon, Lung! You can't feed the Commander fried noodles for breakfast!
If you're gonna serve Empery breakfast, make it baozi!
Yeah! On that note – here, Commander. Fresh baozi.
Ping Hai walks up to me holding a plate of steaming hot baozi. The savory smell they give off fills my nose in an instant.
(Ah, the food stalls. If I remember right, these were Lung Wu's and Hu Pen's plan before Fu Shun's radical revisions.)
(Looks like they unanimously agreed to bring the plan back down to earth.)
(The pragmatist in me is happy, but the idealist in me is sad that Fu Shun's version didn't make it into the dream.)
What's the matter, Commander? The food will go cold if you just stare at it.
Yeah! Breakfast is the most important meal of the day, so you gotta eat big in the morning!
Owneeer! I've got morning tea just for you!
I made it with lots and lots of love, and you'll definitely taste it!
Geesh. If I'd known this would happen, I'd have made more food.
That's fine, though! There's always room for dessert, honey!
Once you've had your fill, come here and try my handmade ice cream!
It's not long before I'm surrounded by shipgirls, all offering their food to me.
(You can't put on weight in a dream. Time to eat it all!)
After chowing down all that food, I decide to move to the next area of the amusement park.
But then, I hear a scream.
Aaahhh! Somebody help meee!
(Huh? Was that Sakawa?)
(Is she in danger? But there shouldn't BE any danger in an idealized place like this...)
My feet move quicker than my doubts, rushing me to the source of the scream.
No! Anything but that, pleeease!
Just hold your nose and it'll be fiiine. Trust me, it's good.
C'mon, it's fried canned herring with fermented bean curd! It's my masterpiece!
I spot Sakawa and Herring off in a side alley along the food stall district.
With fermented bean curd? Oh boy...
Well, well, fancy meeting you here, Commander. Care to try some of my and Herring's innovative cuisine?
One bite, and I promise you'll want more.
Their food gives off a smell that I cannot put into words. Its intensity makes me reflexively back away.
Whatever you do, do NOT eat that stuff!
Even the mischievous Sakawa is trying to pull me away by the hem, a serious expression on her face. That's how you know it's bad.
Now, now, don't be shy! I'll even feed you. Say "ahh"!
Uh... Thanks, but I just had breakfast and I'm full.
If your stomach can't fit it, just a lick is good enough!
As I rack my brains thinking of a way to excuse myself, Sakawa tugs on my clothes again.
I'll count down from three. When I reach zero, grab my hand and hold on tight!
I nod in acknowledgment, even though I have no idea what she's going to do.
Okay. Three... two... one...
As soon as she reaches zero, she takes my hand and runs away with me.
Yo, wait! Where're you going?!
Is my cooking really that bad? *sniffle*...
Hearing their shouting, Sakawa kicks into fifth gear and runs even faster.
We run and run, only stopping when we reach the castle near the center of the amusement park.
Phew... I think we shook them off.
I was just going from stall to stall, then those two weirdos cornered me.
If you hadn't come by, I'd be a rotten herring by now. Heehee♪
So you were going around on your own?
Yes? Oh, let me guess – you're wondering where Agano and Noshiro are, riiight?
Heheh. I'll let you in on a secret. I'm here alone so I can have you all to myself.
You break my heart, Commander. You have a sweetie like me by your side, and you're still thinking about other girls...
As punishment, you're going to come with me for a little walk! Heehee!
Sakawa and I go on a stroll for a while. After she lets me go, my attention drifts back to the castle at the heart of the park.
(Before she left, Amagi said she'd be waiting for me there.)
(I think it's time to pay her a visit.)
While walking up the stairs of the castle on my way to the banquet hall, a strong wind suddenly blows open the door to a corridor.
Out of it, Suzunami steps out, wearing a fashionable dress.
I was hoping you could, umm... check if I'm wearing this dress correctly or not.
It's hard to do it on my own, so...
Don't be so unsure! You look amazing!
Even my bunny is impressed you managed to put that on all by yourself!
Ditto what she said. You're wearing it right, and it looks great on you.
That's good to know...
The banquet is starting soon, so... can I come with you?
Sure!
You two go ahead without me. I'm first gonna check on the other girls and see how their preparations are going.
O-okay! *sigh*... I doubt anyone had as much trouble getting ready as I did...
Alright then. See you later.
Talk to you soon.
The girls and I part ways. I decide to look around and see how the other partygoers are doing.
As I walk down the corridor, a large bell suddenly rings, signaling the start of a new hour.
Just as that happens, the space around me seems to distort for just a moment before returning back to normal.
What was that?
Suzunami and Ayase should still be nearby. I'd better ask them about it.
I turn back to where I came from and shout their names. No reply.
Stranger yet, I follow where they went and can't find any sign that they were here.
Commander?
What's happened, Amagi? Ayase and Suzunami just disappeared.
Kindly follow me. You will understand soon enough.
I do as told and follow Amagi. We leave the castle and return to the park's central area.
What in the world...?
The surroundings are changing back and forth nonstop.
One second, it's the colorful amusement park I know. The next, it's a gloomy, abandoned ruin.
It's... It's cycling between a dream and a nightmare.
You are correct.
So that bell I heard earlier...
Do you know what time it is now?
Based on how many times it rang and how dark the sky is... Twilight. A time the Sakurans commonly associate with misfortune.
She says nothing, only nodding.
Didn't you say you built this dream, though? Why is turning into a nightmare?
Good and bad dreams cycle from one to the other, just as day and night do.
What about Ayase and Suzunami, then? Did the nightmare take them?
"Take" isn't quite the right word. More precisely, you could say that they stumbled into the world of nightmares.
They have gone to another world, which naturally means that they aren't in this dream anymore.
Seems this dream's destabilizing because of it. Just look at how everything's changing.
Yes, that is why we should look for them only after the dream has stabilized again.
(While they're gripped by nightmares...)
Are you worried about how the nightmares may effect them?
Don't be. While the nightmares may be draining, those two will forget all about them when they wake up. The nightmares cannot harm them either, of course.
Although, I doubt knowing that is enough to ease your concerns. You want to bring them back to our dream, don't you?
Yeah. I want them to enjoy their dreams as much as the rest of us.
I understand. Then let us look for a solution together.
While we talk, our surroundings seem to finally settle on one thing.
Not necessarily a good thing. Smoke rises from the ground, enveloping several of the attractions.
The smoke grows thicker and thicker, eventually covering the whole amusement park. Distant buildings are rendered outright impossible to see.
As I watch the place take on such an ominous look, a thought suddenly floats to the top of my mind.
Something tells me you-know-who is gonna show up any second now.
Pardon? Who?
As if to answer her question, an ecstatic voice suddenly calls out from the smoke.
Dusk descends upon the land! The boundary between worlds grows thinner! It couldn't be any clearer – there is an outbreak of mysteries to be solved!
Holy smokes – pun intended – this is way more adventury than I imagined!
The adventures will have to wait. To solve this myriad of mysteries, we first need to figure out what's happening!
See? Right on cue.
Heheh! I know exactly what you're thinking, Commander!
"It's a mystery in and of itself how she always shows up when there are mysteries abound." Am I right?
Ahem. You two came at the perfect time.
Amagi and I were just talking about how to resolve this problem and bring the amusement park back to normal.
Oh, okay! We'd better get going right now, then!
Wait. While I'm just as excited to solve a mystery together with the Commander...
There is one thing I need to check before anything else.
Bristol reaches into her pocket and digs around, looking for something.
Found it!
What's that? A spinning top?
Bingo! Now watch how it spins.
Huh... Is a top supposed to do that?
A top shouldn't spin for long as it burns through its kinetic energy. And yet, this one kept spinning indefinitely, as though nothing could stop it.
That confirms it! This is a dream. How are we here, Commander?
It's a long story. Let me explain...
Ahh! I understand completely.
So basically, we gotta deal with the nightmare and bring those two back to the amusement park, yeah?
Correct.
Then I've got the perfect name for this investigation. "Fu Shun and Friends' Great Nightmare Adventure"! Now let's–
Hey! I'M supposed to name the investigation! That one sounds lame!
Heehee. You two sure are a rowdy duo.
They sure are. Best to get used to it sooner rather than later.
And so, the four of us set off to investigate the nightmarish attractions.
The nightmare has been dispelled and Dream Park returns to normal.
All of a sudden, the lights come on, giving a fairy-tale-like vibe to the amusement park.
So 'tis already night.
Time flies when you're having fun, as they say.
That it does...
But you don't want the fun to end yet, do you?
Ahem... You are assuming things. I implied no such thing.
Nagato faces away with a blush on her face. Looks like I was spot on.
Heehee. There is still time to enjoy yourselves some more before the park closes.
Very well... Then so I will. Commander, have you any attractions you want to go to?
None that immediately come to mind, no. Even if I did, I want you to decide for yourselves.
If you're unsure what to ride, we could follow the park map and do a tour around the amusement park.
Then, when an attraction catches your eye, go for it.
A-are you sure? Wouldn't be taking up your precious time?
Not at all. As long as you're all having fun, I don't mind giving up a bit of my time.
Oh, Commander...
Still, our time left IS limited. Shall we get going?
Okay!
Dream Park - Night - Water Area
Oh, it was YOU who set everything right?
Good job and all that. Now stay here and spend some time with me!
I've been waiting all day for you, you know...
It's unbelievable that you couldn't find me until now! Your only way to atone is to keep me company!
Well, well...
Commander, you should know it's dangerous to swim in the pool at night. Come, let's go somewhere else.
Hey! Buzz off!
It's not that dangerous when others are around.
If you just want me to go on a ride with you, I promise we'll do that later.
Heehee... Alright. I'll be patient for the time being, then♡
Listen, Rupprecht...
I know. You want to say you're sorry, isn't that right?
Fine! You're forgiven!
Ahem... I've never really played in a pool at night, let alone done so at an amusement park.
Commander, won't you join us?
I, for one, am curious to try this "Meandering Megamanjuu Dragon Slide."
Well, Commander? Both Amagi and Nagato want to try something here.
Going with the flow, I get changed with the rest and give the giant slide a try.
After having a blast at the water area, I dry my hair and change back into my regular clothes.
So, what ride shall we go on next?
The slide and the water fight were rather vigorous. I say we ride something more relaxing, like the merry-go-round.
Conveniently, it's just up ahead as well.
Everyone gives their opinions, and we collectively settle on the merry-go-round.
The carousel spins along to the music at a moderate pace. Atop one of the wooden horses, a captivating figure sits.
Gloucester? Hey.
