I try to stop her, but it's no use. Inhuman strength courses through her in this moment.
Thanks to your thoughtfulness, I don't feel cold at all...
If anything, I feel hot. My body is so warm, and my head is spinning...♥
She takes my hand and shakes it side to side. I feel the soft, warm touch of her fingers...
I'll bet you feel the same...♥
Just so unbearably hot, not able to think...
That's an early sign you're coming down with a cold, you know...
I'll need to make you feel relaxed and real good tonight...♥

sequence:
Warmth in the Storm

<size=45>After a Shower</size>

scripts.say: Showering really is something special.
After a nice hot shower, it feels like my fatigue from today has all vanished.
As I step out of the shower room, I see Mogador standing there, holding a clean towel in her hands.
You've been so nice to me today, so I want to repay the favor somehow...
Will you let me dry your hair?
I think I can do that myself.
Just as I turn her down, she seizes my hand.
Heheheh... You don't get to say no. You and I are the only ones here♥
She makes me sit on a chair, after which she gets behind me and starts drying my hair with the towel.
(What kind of shampoo the Commander used... I'm curious...♥)
She comes closer and closer to me...
(*sniiiff*... What a unique smell. It's so good... *pant pant*...♥)
Until eventually, she leans on me with her whole body!
A warm, tickling sensation rubs the back of my neck, and her labored breaths strike my ears.
*sniiiff*... *sniiiff*... You smell so good♥ God, I'm getting hooked on this...
(Heheheh... Since we're all by ourselves, we might as well... get on with the–)
RING RING RING!
Huh? Wait... You have signal again?
Mogador remains in her embrace from behind, suddenly with a dumbfounded expression on her face.
The hair... Are you done?
Err, I suppose... G-go on, radio the port!
They tell me that a rescue fleet won't be able to arrive until tomorrow at noon – due to the storm and how late it is.
In other words, we'll just have to spend the night here.
(There's only one bed, so that means we'll...)
You take the bed. I'm fine with sleeping on the floor.
No way! I'll lie on the floor and you should have the bed...
(Because once you fall asleep, it doesn't matter whether you're in bed or on the floor. Heheheh...♥)
Since I'm not hearing any disagreement, let's go to sleep now. You must be exhausted!
As she says that, she quickly starts laying out the sheets on the floor.
Okay, since you insist...

sequence:
Warmth in the Storm

<size=45>There Is Only One Bed</size>

scripts.say: It's the dead of night. Barely conscious, I feel something slide in under the sheets with me.
Remember the third rule...
"If there is a shower room and only a single bed, you must sleep together."
...It didn't say that.
It did! I'm a judge with a keen eye, and we have to follow the rules. Heheheh...♥
You're not going to kick me out of the bed, are you?
...As long as you sleep like normal, I won't.
Heheh... Don't worry, I'll be normal...
Mogador and I lie side by side in bed, listening as the storm raging outside the window gradually dies down.
I almost can't believe we're lying in bed like normal... It's so strange...
The voice of the usually energetic girl beside me is softer now, as though she's settling down along with the storm outside.
Strange? You're the one who snuck under my sheets.
Heheheh... I mean, think about this situation as a whole... Isn't it strange?
I guess you're not wrong.
Strange means unique, and if I'm part of that uniqueness, that gives me a special place in your heart...
What are you talking about...?
You know, we're in the same room, in the same bed, just sleeping like perfectly normal people...
Get up to anything funny and I'm going straight to the floor.
I won't... I promise I'll behave tonight...
Thank you.
While drowsiness is half-overtaking my mind, our silly little conversation continues.
When you said you'd take me on a vacation earlier, did you really mean it?
Of course. I don't make promises I don't intend to keep.
So... it'll be just you and me on the beachside, lying together on our backs...
I hope it'll be sunny then...
And that the sea breeze will be filled with your scent...♥
She mutters under her breath, slowly but surely falling asleep.
I look at her as she quietly lies there, and I too feel the blanket of sleepiness finally wrapping around me.

sequence:
Warmth in the Storm

<size=45>She Seems Dependable, But...</size>

scripts.say: Perhaps because of yesterday's exhaustion, I indulged in a rare sleep-in today.
By the time I wake up, Mogador has already done her morning routine and is sitting down, engrossed in something.
*yaaawn*... Good morning, Commander.
She stretches with a small grunt.
Didn't sleep well last night?
I slept like a baby for a good few hours, but then I had a nightmare about eerie sounds, like in the ghost story...
Speaking of which, we still haven't figured out the source of those strange noises near the generator.
No worries. I already went and investigated that. *yaaawn*...
She stretches once more and throws the notebook in her hands toward me.
Oh. Your night patrol log?
Mhm. I couldn't really sleep after that dream, feeling like there might be danger lurking nearby...
Take a look at the last page.
According to her notes, she went on a solo patrol at around 4 in the morning.
And when she went to the generator room, she found something interesting...
A tape recorder?
Yup. It was hidden way out of view in a corner, and it had been set up to automatically start playing sounds when the generator was fired up.
...Do you know who might have done it?
Sure do. Since our signal came back last evening, I looked into who had been here previously.
Can you guess who it was?

options.content: It wasn't Fu Shun, was it?
Was it actually Bristol after all?

scripts.say: Sadly, no. It was Bristol. She led the team at the time.
Ding-ding-ding. Correct!
I didn't think we'd solve that mystery overnight. My hat's off to you, Mogador. You're dependable.
Heheh... I've always been dependable. You know that.
If you really think I did good, well, I'd love some kind of reward...
As she says that, she returns to bed and tries to wriggle her way under the sheets again.
Put on your cloak before anything else!
But I'm tiiired... I wanna go back to sleep...
I spent the whole night on patrol, you know...
Besides, you're still sleepy yourself, aren't you?
Our rescue won't arrive until noon, so...♥
We still have plenty of time all to ourselves... Heheheh♥
Let's not waste this opportunity...♥
Sleep with me, Commander... Heheheh...♥
Why did our mission have to be in a place like this?!
C'mon, Z21, give us a smile~
We're in a blizzard...
No complaining, Z21. This is the target location, and you're our flagship. Please go over the mission again.
I'm so cold... Can't you do it...?
*Sigh*, this battle is one phase of Operation Weserübung. Our objective is to occupy Narvik.
For this operation, Z21 serves as flagship, leading Z2, Z9, Z11, Z12, Z17, Z13, Z18, Z19, and Z22, for a combined strength of ten destroyers.
Any questions?
I have one! Can you tell us about the enemy, Z2?
Narvik has remained neutral, and as such has limited defensive strength. We should have no problem overpowering them.
So we're in for an easy mission?
Taking the port won't be a problem, but after that... Well, let's take this one step at a time.
However, Z18, our intelligence reports there is a fort on the other side of the fjord. You and Z22 should investigate, just in case.
kay~
The rest of you, sortie with Z21.
*Sigh*. That's all of it. Why couldn't Z2 just be the flagship?
Don't be ridiculous.
Sure enough, they caught us in the end...
Sure enough? Aren't you a bold bunch?
Not bold enough. We didn't bag the big one.
Take care not to be too bold, or you just might find yourself eaten by your would-be prey.
You never know if you don't try...
Indeed. We still don't know if you can beat us now, do we?!
Well then, let's find out.
It's over!
Too bad.
Hardy!
Ahhhh!
Hunter!!
Damn... Is that their reinforcements?! F-Fall back——
Phew. Truly worthy opponents. Without reinforcements, we would have been in serious trouble...
Aren't we chasing them, Z2?
The ones just coming back from outside the fjord are going to need to resupply. Not to mention us, after that battle.
Sorry. It's all my fault...
It's not, Z18. You made the right decision. Saving your strength was worth more than foolish bravery.
They escaped, and now they know our strength.
Barring a miracle, the enemy's second attack will be coming. We need to head back and prepare.
But...
Z19, listen to Z2. Let's go take care of Z21.
Um... Okay. But they won't get away next time!
...Where am I?
Thank goodness, Hunter, you're finally awake!
We're on a beach outside Ofotfjord. I burned all my fuel dragging you here.
Oh.
Sorry, Hunter. I wasn't careful enough. You got hurt so badly trying to protect me.
It's fine.
I've sent a distress signal to the rear. They're on their way to rescue us, so...
Hardy...
Wh-What?
The snow.
The snow...
Isn't it... pretty?
I-I'm not sure, but... it's like a white void. Totally empty. It looks... serene.
Doesn't it? If we get a chance sometime, let's get everyone to come here and see the aurora, eh?
Yes. It's a date.
Then... could I take a quick nap?
Yes. I'll watch over you. Sleep well.
I'm back!
Phew, I'm beat. There's nothing on that side of the fjord though...
Intel was wrong...? Thanks anyway.
Z2, we're finished digging in here.
Good. Well done.
Z2's icy as ever. You'd think she'd be happier about completing the mission.
I'm not Z1. And anyway this is no time to relax.
Why not? We successfully occupied Narvik, didn't we?
Like I said, the hard part comes after. Only one of our two scheduled supply ships arrived. We don't have enough to get us back. Also...
The Royal Navy won't just let us hold on to Narvik.
Right. They want this string of ports, just like us. The Scharnhorst Sisters fought Renown yesterday, and the day before that, Hipper got pushed back by a Royal destroyer.
They're... coming.
Hmph, let them come. We'll show them the might of the Iron Blood destroyers!
Okay, save it for the Royal Navy.
Our supply ship can only resupply two ships at a time. You'll all have to take turns getting resupplied.
Aye!
The Arctic Circle... a vast expanse of pure white snow...
But I can't say I wouldn't like to take a hunting trip across the endless ice fields.
What are you talking about, Hunter? We're on a mission. We have no time for you to go playing with polar bears.
Calm down, Hardy. I'm well aware...
Oh... Sorry. I'm just a bit nervous thinking about the H-class going into battle together.
Yes, Hardy, you're always so high-strung.
Yes, but! I think it's important to keep your nerves nice and focused in battle!
Sure...
Ahem, anyway, Havock, Hostile, and Hotspur are in position. I'll go over our objectives one more time.

Intelligence reports that the Iron Blood have beaten us to Narvik. Our mission is to penetrate into the harbour and ascertain the enemy's positioning, while making the best strike against them that we can.

As you all know, Glowworm encountered Admiral Hipper the day before yesterday, discovering the enemy fleet bound for Narvik. And we, together with Renown, did battle with the Scharnhorst Sisters near Narvik just yesterday... This may be a very challenging mission
It won't be. Glowworm inflicted heavy damage upon Admiral Hipper. And the Scharnhorst Sisters were not bound for Narvik after our battle.
Iron Blood has few capital ships. They probably wouldn't commit their full strength to this...
You mean we're up against destroyers?
Yes, indeed... Glowworm encountered two Iron Blood destroyers before engaging Admiral Hipper. I'm afraid we will face them too. Thank you, Hunter, your analysis has put me at ease!
A hunter must understand her prey... And, I cannot be certain.
No matter. This inductive reasoning is quite enough.
Now then. During the battle with Admiral Hipper, Glowworm bought the enemy retreat at a heavy cost to herself.
I hope every one of you will act as she did. Exhibit the Royal Navy's tradition of bravery, no matter what you may face, do not shrink from the challenge.
Glowworm... may not have put that much thought into it...
But is her sacrifice not worthy of our respect?
Right. I will thank her when we get back home.
Right then. Pack away that dispirited look of yours, Hunter.
Dead ahead lies Ofotfjord. The Iron Blood know we're coming, and they'll be ready.
Okay.
That's more like it. Now make for Narvik before first light. H-class, move out!
Aye!
It's a good job we've got this heavy snow. Lets us slip right by the enemy's patrol destroyers.
Yes. Lucky.
Right, But... with guards this close, it seems Iron Blood really has taken Narvik... Damn.
Relax. Soften them up with a coastal bombardment and we should be good.
You know, Hunter, you always say I'm easily riled, but every now and then you say some pretty excitable things yourself.
Patience and perseverance are critical to the hunt.
I-Is that right...?
Well then, we've successfully evaded the enemy patrols and made it into the fjord. Now that we have the initiative, let's gather some intelligence.
Hey, Z2, is that you? Weren't me and Z18 getting resupplied next?
We're out of options. It's time to strike!
How did you get in here?!
That would be a question for your patrols!
Halt!
Hardy, the snow limits visibility. We should seize the chance.
Now!
Gah, I can't see anything in this snow!
We're in trouble. We don't have enough supplies, and the enemy came at us too fast. We're totally unprepared...
Come, Z18, let's get after them!
Slow down, Z19.
If the enemy wants to hide in this snow, when we're undersupplied, we definitely won't catch them.
But if the Royal Navy is here, they must be planning to attack the port!
Then we should go to the port, shouldn't we?
We gotta warn Z21 and Z2. They have to prepare, and Z2 needs to bring help.
You're right.
Phew... but it's gonna be really hard for us to get back to fighting strength.
Hmph, if the Royal Navy hadn't gotten the drop on us——
Ahahaha, there's no way they could know our supply situation. We just got unlucky.
But we can still help out. Leave the fighting to Z21, and we'll protect the supply ship. Otherwise everybody will have trouble getting home.
Okay, yeah.
Now that's enough of those eyebrows. Gimme a smile~
Through the heavy snow, I can only make out a faint glow on the coast...
We've already broken through their first line of defense. Narvik Port is dead ahead.
Say, Hardy, you know what?
What?
Narvik...
Don't tell me you have some critical intelligence?
I've heard you can see the aurora from here between January and March.
What?
Too bad it's already April. We missed it.
Hunter... the enemy is right in front of us.
Only a thought. Do you really have no interest in the aurora?
Well, I... I don't know. I've never seen it. Have you?
I haven't. But I've heard it's beautiful, enchanting even. When I heard we were going to the Arctic, I'd gotten my hopes up.
But seeing so much snow is also nice. It never snows like this back home.
Really? I think it just gets in the way.
It does get in the way of battle. But otherwise, it's quite lovely.
I don't follow.
I am Hunter, and as such I attach special significance to my natural environment.
Say, Hardy, how would you like to enjoy the snow with me after this mission?
Now's not the time to think about such things. We are here to attack Narvik. Afterwards...
And afterwards I don't expect to have much time to dawdle either. There will be another mission waiting for us.
Just for a bit?
We'll talk again when the mission's done.
We have to protect the supply ship. No wandering off. Z2 and the girls went out on patrol and we don't know when they'll be back...
Aren't Z18 and Z19 back yet...? They better hurry up...
Oh, speak of the devil. There's a transmission from Z18... Heh heh. She must want to go play with me too! Let's see here...
The Royal Navy has infiltrated the fjord. They are currently steaming toward Narvik... Um...
WhatdoIdo?! WhatdoIdo?! WhatdoIdo?! Z2 will still need time to get back here even after I call her... Looks like it's all up to me!
...Oh they're already right here!
Gah. Just you wait. Z2 and the girls will come get me!
She fainted...
A little tricker than the other two.
But still nothing compared to the unified strength of the H-class.
So... what now?
What's the situation on the coast?
Coastal defenses are in position. They will take some time to handle with our firepower alone.
And considering we've already alerted the enemy, reinforcements are certainly inbound.
Should we retreat? We are burning more fuel in this weather than normal.
No. If we can't occupy Narvik, we must at least evaluate the scale of the enemy defenses.
And we'll have to make some trouble for the Iron Bloods. Those cargo ships over there should do the trick.
But... that's risky.
I know. So you all head back. I can take care of it.
Dunce.
Ouch. Don't suddenly whop me with a torpedo!
We're a team... And five guns are better than one.
Very well. Thank you.
Now then, let's cause as much destruction as possible!
Hardy, I just received an emergency report. Enemy reinforcements sighted.
Already...? That was fast. How many?
It's too hard to tell with the heavy snow. Radar isn't working either. But at least we know there are a lot more of them than us.
As much as I'd like to keep bruising the enemy, I think this is as much as we can do——
Right. It's best if we can make a smooth retreat.
They must have already figured out our target, and moved to intercept us.
I think that was clear from the beginning?
At this point, Hunter, no matter what you may fear, we will pull through.
Right then... Shall we?
Yes. Start withdrawing.
Say, Hunter...? The snow... is it that lovely...?
It is. When your mind is clear, you'll find... it's truly gorgeous.
Oh? I never saw anything like it back home...
I'm looking forward to it. That snow you promised me.
Yes. It's a date.
It is! Let's be off then!

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>1.Because I Expect Great Things From You!</size>

scripts.say: Port — Pier
It's been a while since I've been sent that far off on a mission.
What kind of dolt would stand me up on the very day I make my triumphant return?
The gall of that person... making me deliver my report by hand...
Port — Office
Commander!!!
While absorbed in the never-ending pile of paperwork, I hadn't noticed Nelson's presence growing closer and closer to me.
Hmph. In case you're about to ask me "what's wrong,"... Well, for your information, I just came back from my long mission. I'm here to make my report.
You seem absolutely swamped with paperwork. Is this why you didn't come meet me at the pier?
For some reason, she seems to be in a sour mood... Should I push the paperwork back for later and listen to her report first...?
Hey, you're not planning on pushing the paperwork back for later, are you?
Make sure to take care of the stuff that's been building up. Someone of your caliber should be able to finish everything by tonight, right?
As much as I enjoy being praised, there was no way I'd have this mountain of paperwork done by tonight.
I don't say this often, so listen up. I expect great things from you, and don't you forget it.
In any case, I'll be back later tonight.
Nelson left the office, slamming the door loudly behind her.
...Seeing that she's gone and said that much, there's no choice but to get to it, I suppose. Looking at the tall pile of papers and letting out a loud sigh, I tiredly got back to work.

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>2.Stop Seeing Right Through Me!</size>

scripts.say: The day after Nelson returned from her mission...
(I've never seen the commander this worn-out before, but I guess all the paperwork is done...)
(Well, it's not like there's any point for me to waste any pity on that dolt, but perhaps some words of encouragement would be appropriate...)
Nelson, it's dangerous to walk around while lost in thought~
Huh?!... R-Rodney?! Right back at you! It's dangerous to randomly yell at people if they're lost in thought!
Nothing random about it. I'm just heading back after reporting on our successful operation~
Is, is that so... to the commander, huh...
Yup~ Commander looked awfully in need of a gentle massage, so I was more than happy to oblige~
A massage...?
Yup, nice and slow around the shoulders~
(Phew... I, I guess it's fine if it was a normal massage...)
Well, if the commander can't even handle that quantity of work, we're going to have serious issues.
It's the commander's responsibility to work tirelessly for the well-being of the port. I won't permit any derelictions of those duties!
Teehee~
Wh-what are you giggling about?
You're so easy to read, it's adorable. I bet you're like this because you can't get the commander off your mind~
Wh-what are you blathering on about?!
A-anyways, we've been idling about for way too long! I've got things to do, so I'll be off now! Cheers, Rodney!
Without even waiting for a reply, Nelson rushed off, leaving Rodney behind.
(...Geez! Rodney looks so meek, but she's actually ironclad—I can't even control the flow of my own conversation!)
(She's the opposite of me... It irritates me to no end to admit it, but that's probably why she's easy to talk to.)
Sigh... maybe I should make an effort to praise the commander next time I'm at the office...

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>3.Don't Make Me Repeat Myself!</size>

scripts.say: ...It's not like I wanted to come here or anything... I just couldn't control my feet.
(It might be a sudden visit, but there's nothing unusual about it at all. I bet the commander's falling apart without my help after all...)
H-hmph! Commander! I'm coming in–!
Commander, if you're in here, at least say something!
(There's a stack of papers just pushed aside here... Did the commander fall asleep on the job?)
Sigh... I heard from Rodney that you were pretty worn out, but you really shouldn't just fall asleep in the midde of work.
(...But, I guess I can allow it this time. Be grateful that I'm such a compassionate person...)
Woah! C-Commander?!
I seem to have unexpectedly passed out... Was the fatigue finally getting to me...?
From the looks of things, Nelson decided to stop by my office while I was sleeping... But why does she look so flustered?
Ah, uh, umm... You know.
L-look how hopeless you are, Commander! How could you just fall asleep during the middle of work hours!
G-good grief. And you still have so much work left to do...
That's enough beauty sleep for now! Get back to work, and make it snappy!
After being goaded along by Nelson, I hurriedly rubbed my sleepy eyes before returning to the paperwork once more.
(Why did I end up saying all that other stuff... Ugh, I'm the hopeless one here!)
Hmm...?
S-stop trying to dissect every little thing I say! Don't you know it's uncouth to stare so much?!
If you have time to worry about me, you also have time to work! Shut your mouth and stay on task!
As I made my pen fly across the page in accordance with her words, Nelson slowly left the side of my desk.
But... for some reason, Nelson brought over a chair, sat down by my side, and started to talk.
...Hey, let me know which things I can help you with.
D-don't make me repeat myself! I won't say it twice!
I have no idea why she continued to get angry with me, but I did manage to pass some of my workload over to her as requested.
Eventually, we were able to finish all the paperwork without any major issues.

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>4.We're Done Talking Here!</size>

scripts.say: One beautiful, sunny day...
Oh my, Commander, to think I'd run into you here~
...Why are you here? Weren't you supposed to be holed up in the office today?
Oh, right. You did say your presence was required for a different mission today.
Hehe~ I see you remembered what Commander told you~
S-stop it with the unnecessary nonsense!
When I asked where the two of them were headed, they told me they were heading to the Eagle Union dorms to hold a meeting on an upcoming mission.
We're conducting a joint mission with the Big Seven representatives from the Eagle Union. Speaking of which, weren't you the one in charge of leading the mission?
We were about to hash out the finer details of the mission. If you're not too busy, we'd greatly appreciate your input~
Even though I had just come back from doing much the same, I couldn't really turn down an invitation to a meeting concerning a mission I personally was involved with.
Are you coming or not? Well, not that I think you'd turn the invitation down, though.
If you've made up your mind, let's hurry on over to the Eagle Union dorms. It's way too hot over here...
Commander, you've really been working yourself to the bone recently, haven't you?
I'll be making some iced tea before the meeting starts. You should use that time to relax and rest up~
Rodney, this is a formal, mission-related discussion. How could you even think of compromising the commander's mental state?
...B-but, I suppose it is true that the commander has been working very hard as of late... So, um, I guess I can overlook it...
Ahem! It's decided! We're done talking here!
Nelson picked up her pace after hurriedly cutting off the conversation.
Though the Eagle Union dorms are located a fair distance away, I would've arrived in no time had I decided to match her blistering pace...

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>5.Say Something Already!</size>

scripts.say: Nelson, Rodney, and I finally arrived at the Eagle Union dorms.
Wow, the two of you are early. Color me surprised, I was afraid the Royal Navy's Big Seven would demand a special procession before entering our humble abode.
You even brought the commander with you, huh? Good stuff.
Umm, we brought some tea leaves over from our dormitory. Should I prepare some iced tea for everyone?
Sounds good. It's blistering hot out today, and I'm thirsty to boot!
Rodney was guided to the kitchen, while everyone else headed to the conference room.
It's a bit straight to the point, but I'd like to start discussing about how we can work together in the upcoming practice exercise.
A bit blunt, but... I don't mind people being a bit more efficiency-minded.
I agree. If anything, it might be something that we, Colorado-class sisters, are proficient at.
It seems we're on the same page. Now then, let's continue our discussion.
The discussion between the four quickly heated up from the onset.
By the time Rodney brought the iced tea over, the discussion seemed to already have boiled over.
...While I will accept that this mission is relatively safe, there is no guarantee that we will not encounter the enemy.
In the unlikely event that we're forced to engage with the enemy, we're likely to be outnumbered. We must be prepared to face such a situation.
If we encounter the enemy... We'll hit their weak point, then split up to flank them from the sides, cutting off their reinforcements while chipping them down piecemeal.
...Hmm. That's not a bad plan. What do you think, Commander?
It's true that in a case where the enemy outnumbers you and you can't make a surprise attack to gain the initiative, you need to think of another plan. Nelson's plan is so daring, it might just work.
I'm glad you have your wits about you, Commander.
I need to give a name to the tactical maneuver, so I'll ask Nelson if she has any ideas.
Of course I've thought of a name. It's...
...*Poke*.
What do you think about, "The Nelson Touch"?
Hey! Say something already! It's not every day that I come up with something innovative like this!
"The Nelson Touch," huh? Then that's what we'll do if we encounter enemies.
While rubbing my cheek at the location Nelson had poked at, I nodded at West Virginia's words. Indeed, I might have been zoning out for a bit.
Maybe I wasn't hydrated enough. Feeling thirsty, I started to sip slowly at the iced tea that Rodney made.

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>6.There's Something I Wanted to Tell You</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
After parting ways with Nelson and the others, I returned to the office to sum up what we had just discussed.
Ever since the meeting, however, my head's been feeling a bit heavy...
Hey, Commander! There was something I forgot to tell you about the mission earlier...
I heard Nelson's voice reverberating from the hallway outside the office, but... I felt so dizzy that words wouldn't leave my lips...
...Good grief! At least respond when someone calls out to you... Wait, Commander? What's wrong?
My vision blurred, and all I could think of was her voice echoing inside my head, over and over again...
...mmander!!! Hey, are you alright?! Answer me!!!
And just like that, everything went black...
...Have you come to?
When I came back to my senses, I was lying down on bed, and I could see Nelson's figure sitting by my side.
Good grief... Do you know how unbecoming it is for someone of your stature to pass out because of work?
...Don't you know? There's nothing more important than taking care of your condition. Don't disappoint me like this.
There certainly was merit in what she said. I sincerely apologized for all the trouble I had caused.
As long as you know, it's fine. Hmph.
But... for today, make sure you take it easy and get some sleep.
If, by any chance, you do the same thing in the future, I will never forgive you. Got it?
Saying that, Nelson got up to leave the room.
By the way... there's something I have to say. Or rather, it's more like... there's something I've always wanted to tell you.
G... Good job, on everything so far...
W-wait, that's not what I wanted to say at all!
Nelson left, slamming the door shut in her wake. Was she blushing though, or was I just imagining things...?

sequence:
The Virtue of Being Earnest

<size=45>7.I've Always Expected Great Things From You!</size>

scripts.say: Ever since that day I felt groggy from overwork...
My condition returned to normal, and I showed up to watch Nelson's joint exercise.
Commander, are you feeling better?!
As soon as she saw me, Nelson signaled to the others and broke formation in order to come see me.
Why did I come over? Isn't it obvious that I came because I was worried sick about your condition?
Look, you collapsed the other day because you were in bad shape, right? Didn't you promise to take care of yourself?
Wasn't she there with me when I recovered...?
Wh-what's the matter? Stop looking at me like I'm not acting like myself...
Even so, how could I not worry about you?! I went way overboard with what I said to you... And I'm worried that I might be part of the reason why you ended up like that in the first place!
I-In the first place, you don't always look chipper, so I just... N-No, that's not... what I'm here to talk about...
While looking at her looking frustrated that she wasn't able to say what she wanted to say...
B-besides, I've always expected great things from you. Nobody could ever replace you and the things you do...
As Nelson said those words, embarrassment rose all the way up her face to the tip of her ears.
That's why you need to become a more steadfast commander, one that I won't have to worry about!
I know you can do it... because, that's why I feel this way in the first place...
Maybe it was due to her incredible pride, but she was unable to earnestly put her thoughts in to words, instead brushing me aside with her usual cheeky attitude.
Though I found her attitude bewildering at first, the better I got to know her, the more I realized how compassionate and kind she actually is.
Well, I'll be heading off then, Commander!
Having said that, Nelson's face clearly looked brighter. It seemed that she felt somewhat relieved at having come closer to the virtue of being earnest..

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>1 Gettin' Home on Time</size>

scripts.say: I arrived at the office on a crisp morning.
I can still feel the exhaustion of yesterday's late-night work weighing on me.
And yet, there is still so much more work to get through...
Just as the pile of paperwork begins to bring my mood down, I hear a knock at the door.
Before I can respond, the door flies open and a shipgirl confidently saunters right in.
Howdy there, young'un. Mighty fine day, ain't it?
It was the ever-energetic Nevada, who I had recently appointed as my secretary.
That's the spirit. Let's work our butts off today!
What's the matter, young'un? It's barely mornin', and you're pooped already? C'mon, buck up!
Nevada had worked late into the night alongside me, but she still seems to be astonishingly energetic.
Hahaha! I won't lose to those younger ships. You too, young'un - get a hold o' yourself!
Now, on to today's paperwork... Hoowee, it's another biggun.
I reckon I shoulda brought this up before, but have you thought about makin' a secretary squad?
It oughta be easier for all of us if we divvy up the work.
You wouldn't have to whip yourself to exhaustion all the time. Heck, ya might even finish early once in a while. Imagine: paid vacation!
"A secretary... squad?"

options.content: "Too many cooks might spoil the broth."

scripts.say: Ain't it? Hire more secretaries, and the office will be nice and lively, too.
You've got a point there, but we have plenty o' good talent around this port here. Find the right ones, and we'll be good to go in no time!
But, I reckon that can wait. For today, all we've got is each other.
Pass me whatever paperwork you want. No need to be shy about it!
Slowly but surely, the pile of paperwork on my desk shrunk.
Watching Nevada power through the work filled me with the willpower to press on.
Say... Now that I'm your secretary, should I call you Commander instead of young'un?
"There's no rule that says you have to, but I am the Commander, after all..."
"Still, I want to let everyone's individual personality shine."
"Call me 'Commander' in formal settings, but anywhere else, you can call me whatever you feel like."
Hahaha! Now that's the young'un I put my trust in!
Just a little more work today! Let's buck up and hop to it! We might just get home on time for once!

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>2 Quick Draw in the Twilight</size>

scripts.say: A formal secretary squad was still a question for the future, but for now, we brought in Oklahoma to help with secretary work.
"Today's the third day in a row that I get to leave on time, huh?"
Nevada and Oklahoma left ahead of me. After tidying up, I leave the office as well.
The port is bathed in the evening's golden light.
How long has it been since I'd last gotten to enjoy gazing at this scenery? Too long.
While I was immersed in these emotions, I hear the rumbling of a machine from the exercise area.
The first thing that catches my eye is Nevada's figure, dyed by the golden light of the setting sun.
Howdy, young'un. Came for a li'l trainin'?
"Not quite... A Commander using the ships' training ground is a little too crazy, even for me."
Haha! Don't be silly.
There's all kinds of trainin' out there. I reckon even you can handle firearm training, young'un.
Nevada showed me the gun in her hand.
Don't you worry. It ain't rigging - it's just an ordinary gun.
More a... personal hobby, than for use on the high seas.
"I didn't even know you could use this here."
Course I can! Y'know, the other girls love it. Lots of 'em join in when they've got time to spare.
I ain't surprised you don't know, given how busy you are.
"Maybe so. I don't usually pay this place much mind."
"How do you have so much energy, Nevada? Is there a trick to it?"
A trick? I dunno if I'd call it that, but have you tried takin' regular breaks?
Let loose when ya can. For example... like this!
*gasp*
Nevada fired her revolver with lightning speed. All six rounds struck the target in almost the exact same place at the exact same time.
She then twirled the gun around her finger once and ended the display by blowing smoke away from the barrel.
How'd ya like it? Not bad, eh?
A cowboy, huh? Hahaha! Funny comparison, there!
Shootin' my gun in the twilight... Reckon that does sound like a Western cowboy flick.
Still... A cowboy, huh?
You interested in horses, young'un?
You heard me. Horses!
Good to hear it. I didn't peg you as the sorta fella to get so excited over 'em, though.
Cowboys are all about six shooters and broncs!
Work's movin' along smoothly these days. Why don't you try and take a vacation?
"I'm having trouble following the conversation here..."
Yeehaw! No answer means okay, I say!
I'll get things ready in a jiffy! Don't you worry your pretty little head; it's a secretary's job to get your schedule straight, young'un!
Leave the rest to me. Just you wait!

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>3 Packin' Up</size>

scripts.say: After work the next day, Nevada and I went to the store.
"You keep saying we're getting ready to leave, but what exactly do you have planned?"
Akashi! Akashi you around?
I-I'm right here, nya! Oh? Commander and Nevada, nya?
Are you here to pick up the things you ordered yesterday, nya?
You bet. Didja manage to wrangle all the things in my list?
Every last item, nya! I left them all in the back, nya.
Shoot, you're a daisy! Much obliged!
Hold your praise, nya. The key to fruitful business is good service, nya.
Helmets, kneepads, gloves, scarves...
As I watched Nevada check each and every item, my curiosity grew. What was all of this equipment for?
You look real interested. Haha, why bother hidin' it? We're gonna go ridin' horses!
"R-riding?"
I'd guessed as much based on what she'd ordered, but actually hearing it came as a shock.
That explains it, nya. Riding with the Commander... Saddles weren't on the list, nya. Is this enough, nya?
Findin' a comfy saddle is real tough. If you pick one that don't fit, ya might get hurt.
I'll let the Commander use my saddle. It's broken in, so it oughta be way softer and comfier than any new one.
That's fine, nya... It's just a shame I won't get to show off the saddle I found, nya.
"What was that at the end? I didn't hear."
N-Nothing, nya! If you're satisfied with your purchase, then I'll go organize our stock, nya!
Yeah, much obliged! Don't just stand there, young'un. Pick a scarf!
Nevada shows me two scarves.
You and I have the same taste. Good on ya, young'un.
You want this one? Awright, then I'll take the brown.
Now, let's mosey on home and get some shut-eye. Tomorrow, we ride early.
"Huh? Does that mean I'm taking tomorrow off? There's still work—"
Settle down, now. I've got all that straightened out. Oklahoma and the others can handle it for two or three days.
"What if something requires my presence? Or if there's an emergency..."
It'll be the same as any other day off. We can burn that bridge when we get to it!
Y'know, they've got this spiffy new thing they call "remote work." I reckon you can do that if there's any real emergency.
You've been workin' your butt off, so it's high time you empty your mind and have a rootin'-tootin' good time!
As such, I am forced to take a vacation with Nevada.

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>4 Off to a Cowboy Vacation!</size>

scripts.say: We traveled together to the badlands.
When I look around, I see parched grass growing along the riverside. Shrubs dot the landscape, but they all appear yellow and withered.
You look disappointed, young'un.
"I always thought you rode horses in meadows and the like."
Hahaha! Y'ain't wrong, but that ain't how cowboys work.
Besides, there's a reason I picked this spot.
The ground here is dryer and harder than in rainy places. It's a right perfect place for a horse.
"Huh... You sure know a lot about horseback riding, Nevada."
That's another hobby of mine. Along with shootin', of course.
C'mon. They don't call me a cowboy for nothin'!
Nevada's refined handiwork as she prepared the horse and riding gear was a real sight to see.
"But aren't the horses the most important part? As far as I can see, you've only brought one."
Ridin' ain't easy enough for a beginner to do alone.
You'll ride with me 'til you're used to it.
With a practiced motion, Nevada straddles the horse and reaches a hand out to me.
Awright. Lean back against me and hold those reins tight so you don't fall! Let's ride!
Awright. Hold on to my waist and keep those legs firmly on the horse! Let's ride!
Nevada was careful not to go too fast, so I was able to relax and enjoy both the gentle wind and the scenery.
How d'ya like it, young'un? Feel good? We're gonna really scoot now, so hold on tight!
Yeehaw!
The clip-clops of the horse's hooves grow in frequency, and the scenery around us accelerates.
Nevada's horse practically seems like an extension of her own body.

options.content: "Aren't we going a little too fast?"

scripts.say: Think so? This is pretty comfy for me.
But if you wanna sightsee, I reckon I oughta slow things down a bit.
Damn straight, young'un! That's the spice of life for a cowboy ridin' through the badlands!
Stay focused, now! Our ride has only just begun!

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>5 Break Time for the Bronco Buster</size>

scripts.say: Moved by the sight of the badlands lit by the golden evening light, I let out an emotional sigh.
My body, weary and aching from all the desk work, has difficulty adjusting to the bumpy horseback ride. However, that doesn't stop the joy of being surrounded by nature from resounding within me.
I lean on the balcony handrail next to Nevada and savor the sensation of the wind and the scent of dry grass emanating from the badlands.
How'd you like your first ride, young'un?
"It's not bad... But honestly, it might've been a little too rough for my liking."
Hahaha! Like ridin' a boat, ya just have to get used to it over time. Experience is the only way to grow and overcome it.
By the way, do you know where the name cowboy comes from?
Correct! You got a good head on those shoulders, Commander.
"It's strange, if you really think about it. You're a cowboy, but you ride horses?"
"Why not call them horseboys?"
Well, 'tain't about what ya ride. Cowboys herded cows, so they called 'em cowboys.
Okay. Wanna visit the stable with me?
Ya gotta get to know broncs if you wanna ride broncs, right?
I follow Nevada to the stable. The best way to get along with these horses would be...
Now there's a good idea. They can choke if you give it to 'em as-is, though, so I suggest cutting the carrots.
Nevada cuts the carrots, and I give the pieces to a horse.
It eats them happily. Before I knew it, it has cleaned them out of my palm.
She loves ya. Keep it up!
Brushin' their manes is a good way to make horses like ya. Be gentle, now. Easy does it... Pretend you're brushin' a cute li'l lady's hair.
Nevada gives me a brush, which I use to slowly brush along the horse's mane.
The horse snorts happily.
Good work! Horses love it when you brush their manes. Keep it up!
That sounds a little tough, but I'm always in for a laugh.
I use the methods Nevada taught me to handle the horse and wash its body and hooves.
The horse stamps unhappily a few times, but luckily, it is patient enough to let me wash it without any violence.
The horses ain't real fans of it, but when it's all over, I wager you'll be closer than ever.
Phew... I reckon that oughta do it.
How's about you try ridin' alone now, young'un? Don't worry; I'll be right there. Once ya get the hang of it, that's where the fun really begins!

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>6 Twilight in the Outback</size>

scripts.say: When I wake up and check the time the following day, I see that it's already past noon.
The night before, I'd done some miscellaneous port administration work before throwing myself into bed. Seems like I slept in pretty late.
I saw you weren't wakin' up, so I turned it off for ya. It's your vacation, dang it! I gotta let ya rest.
Whoops, sorry. I didn't just barge in, promise. You didn't answer when I knocked, so I got worried and came to check on ya.
Since your alarm was goin' off nonstop, and you were snoozin' so peacefully... Well, I felt a little bad wakin' ya up.
So? Did ya sleep good?
"My body is heavy, but my mind does feel really refreshed."
Yeah? They say exercise cures the body and mind.
If your mind is refreshed, then my plan went off without a hitch. Hahaha!
"Is that the whole reason you brought me out here?"
Yeah! Besides, the air's real nice, and you get the lovely company of adorable horses. Two birds with one stone, I reckon. And ya seem relaxed.
I made ya breakfast. Or lunch by now, I guess. After you chow down, I'll take ya somewhere nice.
On horseback, 'course!
Orange-crimson light falls upon two horses coursing through the badlands.
Behold! Twilight in the outback. Can't see sights like this back at port, can ya?
The red sun is just beginning to dip into the horizon.
It glistens upon the grand river stretching into the distance, making the water's surface shine like the most beautiful of jewels.
Ridin' together throughout the wastes at sunset...
Nevada pulls the gun from her hip and fires a blank toward the sun.
As if in response, the light shining upon her seems to turn even redder and more beautiful.
How do you feel, young'un? There's somethin' about a ride like this once in a while, right?
"You're totally right, Nevada. Riding around in the wilderness drained all of my mental fatigue in no time."
Heh. I like that look on your face.
Y'know what they say: time flies when you're havin' fun. It's about time we mosey on home.
Let me know if you ever fancy comin' back.
I thanked Nevada as we turned home, all the while anticipating my next vacation.

sequence:
Song of Nevada

<size=45>7 The Stuff of... Legends?</size>

scripts.say: Nevada, tell us more about your cowboy adventures with the Commander!
*sigh* Didn't I just tell you that story?
Maybe, but you haven't covered EVERYTHING!
Yeah, yeah! Tell us about the treasure you found, or the scary gangs you trounced!
Or how you wrestled a hippopotamus in the river and rode off into the sunset with a herd of horses!
Fiiine, fine. I'll tell ya, so sit your butts down...
"Why do I not remember any of this happening?"
Look, young'un. You gotta stretch these kinds of stories with little exaggerations. That's what adventures are made of.
Rumors about you are gonna spread far and wide through the port. They'll become legends, and then...
All the details of what actually happened there will be our own little secret. Now that's some spicy drama, ain't it, partner?
What do ya say?
"Hide the truth with exaggerations? I guess that's...kind of logical?"
She isn't wrong. By exaggerating certain parts of stories, you can make everyday occurrences a bit more colorful, a bit more exciting.
Besides, work has just calmed down for the moment. Why not listen in on "our" heroic adventures for a while?

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 1 - A Wormhole To Another Dimension</size>

scripts.say: Look, I found something! Come here, Noire, there's some kind of hole over here!
It's just as Histoire said in her message. It appears to be a wormhole that's bending space itself... But why has it popped into existence here of all places?
Hey, do you think this could be, like, connected some other dimension or something?
Don't be ridiculous. You've just got manga and light novels on the brain.

You just don't get it, do you? Nothing fun's ever gonna happen if all we do is say that and move on! There's gotta be a wonderful new world waiting for us on the other end of this hole! Or, that's what it looks like.
There you go with your insane rambling again. Let's just check it out really quick and report back to Hist...
A CPU must be brave and bold! I'm going straight into that thing!Check out my super cool double cannonball!
What are you doing?! Stop!
Nep nep?!
Noiiiiiiiiire?!
SPLASSSSSHHHHH!
Blub blub blub... Gasp! W-Where the heck are we? Is this the ocean?! I mean, it doesn't look like a swimming pool!
Where the heck indeed. There's water in every direction. Don't tell me we actually ended up in another dimension...
*Gasp* Blub... I can't swim! I'm gonna drown! Help me, Noire!
Stop, let go of me! It's hard enough just to keep myself afloat! Wait... I've got an idea.
We can just turn into CPUs and fly to safety.
Whoa! You're so smart, Noire! Alright, I guess I'd better... transform!
Phew... This will have to do, for now.
Okay, back to the matter at hand. What is this place? I believe when we began examining that wormhole, it sucked us in here...
Incorrect. You said that it would be fun to jump into the wormhole. I tried to stop you but you just dragged me into it. We were hardly sucked into it.
Black Heart, I do believe it's time we leave the past behind us. I've already forgotten what happened.
Typical Purple Heart. Always getting amnesia when it's most convenient for you.
But seriously... where are we? This place reminds me of Gamindustri, but I know we've gone somewhere else entirely. Hm... I can barely feel the power of shares here...
Additionally, I can see wrecked ships littering the ocean. Are they... battleships?
There are collapsed buildings on the ocean floor and some strange debris floating around. Could this place have been a battlefield? One thing fought another, and then they...
Black Heart, look out!
KA-BAAAANG!
Phew, we really dodged a bullet there. Thank you, Purple Heart.
It's too early to thank me. Look over there.
What the?!
Is that... Are they... Us?
No, we're over here. They're obviously just doppelgangers.
First they impersonate us, then they attack us? Hah, I suppose imitation is the sincerest form of flattery... Let's give them a taste of their own medicine!
Hold up, Noire. I think it's best we retreat for the time being.
What the hell are you saying?! I'm not joking around here! They came straight out of nowhere and challenged us to a fight!
Calm down. We can't beat them, not like we are now.
That attack we dodged... It was as powerful as the combined power of both of us if we mustered every single bit of strength we have.
What's more... Remember what you said earlier? That you can barely feel any share influence in this world? ...As it is now, we don't stand a single chance against those two.
Our lack of shares is the problem...?! I hate to admit it, but I suppose you're right!
Now that you understand, we should retreat to fight another day.
I suppose we have no choice... Listen here, you fakes! Next time we meet, I won't be as nice to you!
...And that's the gist of it. We were in some serious trouble!
I see... Serious trouble, huh...

We couldn't muster any strength even after transforming into CPUs, then we went some random direction, then we wandered across the ocean, then we headed this direction... And finally, we made it here, somehow!
Then we spotted villager number one! The first person we found was you, Laffey!
Umm... Are you sure you don't mean that you were caught by me...?
I know how it feels to want to correct Neptune all the time.

Man, we were soooo exhausted going around the whole night! It was an all night wander-athon! Oh yeah, Laffey, where are we? What's this world like? Also, is this a school? Is it some kind of school where people with superpowers gather or something? Or is it an academy for pretty girls?
Uhh, well... This is an academy, we come here often...

Aha! I knew it was an academy! So like, you got a cafeteria with good food? Or an infirmary that doubles as a kitchen? Or a place that's like, "BAM, this is what we're known for!", you know? Like a drive-in movie theater where guys can take their gals out on a clichéd date...
Uhh... Um, I'm sorry...
Nep?! Sorry for what, Laffey?
Get a clue, Neptune... When you ask question after question at machine gun RPM, nobody's going to be able to answer you.
Yeah... I can only process data so fast, and I can't keep up.
Oh. Oops. Sorry... 'Kay, I'll speak more slowly then. What should I ask first...
Okay. But... I'm not very talkative... I don't know if I could help...
I see. Then is there anyone else around here who could answer our questions?
One of my friends could...
What's up, Laffey? ...Hm? Who are these people?
There seems to be a lot of commotion going on over here... Were you two just assigned here?
Yawn... You can take over from here...
Take over? What do you want me to take over?!
It's likely that she's referring to those people she was just talking to. Who are you two, and where did you come from...?
Oh right, we haven't introduced ourselves yet! The name's Neptune, and this lass here's my buddy...
WEEEEEH! WEEEEEH! WEEEEEH!
Nep?! Is that a siren I hear?! What's it for?
The emergency attack siren? There's... an enemy raid incoming?!
So this is where you all were... I was looking for you.
I have an emergency telegram from HQ. A Mirror Sea has appeared in the vicinity of the academy's shore... A fleet must be dispatched to scout the area immediately. They're counting on us, Z23.
Understood! I will attack at once!
Hold on a sec, Z23! I'll go with you!
If you're all going... Then I guess I'll go too...
...Welp, they all went to fight whatever, I guess.
A Mirror Sea... Those words caught my attention.
That might serve as a clue for figuring out what kind of world we've come to... We should hurry and catch up to those girls.
Sure. I'd be bored out of my mind just standing here and waiting for them anyway... Wait for us, guys!
...Just when I thought we'd caught up to them, they disappear... Sigh, can't I just catch a break for once?
I am fairly certain that as long as those two are involved, there will be breaks to catch for nobody.

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 2 - What You Need Is A CPU!</size>

scripts.say: ...I see. So in short, you came here from another dimension, correct?
Yup, that's right! I'm Neptune, nice to meet you! Some people call me Nep-Nep, others call me Neppy, but you can call me whatever you want!
Okay then, let's go with Nep-Nep. It sounds cute.
Oooh, I see you're a woman of culture! Also, we came from this place called Gamindustri, and I'm the CPU of a country we call Planeptune!
A CPU...? You don't look like a machine to me, though... Do you have any proof of that?
You want proof? Fiiiiine, guess I'll just have to prove it. Just stay on the line while I... TRANSFOOOORM!
...Phew. Having no shares makes it really difficult to remain in this form.
Whoa! She actually transformed...!
Hold on, aren't you one of the enemies from the Mirror Sea we just fought?!
So we just fought... Nep-Nep?
No, let me explain. What you fought were imposters pretending to be us.

...No need to stay in CPU form now that I've proven myself! Anyway, we also fought those imposters earlier, but we don't have enough shares, so we couldn't use our powers like normal and we had to do the ole run for our lives act. Think you could help us out?
You're asking me like I'd even know how to help...

She's right. We won't get anywhere asking about something they know nothing about. We'll just confuse them... Oh, pardon, my name is Noire. I'm the CPU of Lastation. You'll have to excuse my pink-haired friend here.
We should introduce ourselves as well... I'm Z23. You don't need to be so formal with me.
I'm Javelin! Nice to meet you!
I'm Ayanami... It's a pleasure.
We're sorry for being such a nuisance... We only just arrived in this world and we don't even know which way's left or right...
No, no, not at all. I'm certain that you have been equally inconvenienced.
So you came from another dimension, huh... I see that all the time in anime, so I think I understand.
Ayanami, you do know anime is just fiction, right...?
Sounds like something you'd hear Neptune say...

Anyway... Could you tell me more about this world? We know that while there aren't many shares in this world, they do exist, so I think there has to be some kind of connection between this world and Gamindustri.
Those imposters of us that appeared, and the many mysteries surrounding Mirror Seas... Do you think they might have something to do with why we were sent to this world?
...If possible, we'd like to find that out as well.
For now, I sent a request to the commander regarding your housing and stay at the academy. I received his approval just a while ago so you should have nothing to worry about.
Wowzers! Does it include room service and 3 meals a day?! Tonight, we dine in heaven, Noire! Thanks a ton, Z23!
We're not gonna need any room service, you know... That aside, thank you, Z23. We both owe you for this.
Not at all, it was my pleasure. Incidentally, would you two happen to be hungry?
You can't fight on an empty stomach, as they say. We have some food if you'd like to eat.
Ah, thank you. I haven't had anything to eat ever since we came to this world. I could eat a horse, downloadable armor and all.
I thought you'd never ask! What's on the menu?
Oh my, aren't we all enjoying ourselves? Would you mind if I joined in on the fun?
Finally, there you are... If only you'd looked for us as much as we looked for you...
Nep-Nep?! Is that who I think it is...?
Vert? And Blanc? How in this world did you end up here?!
Are you both in good health?
I knew it, Vert and Blanc are here too! Let me guess: you guys had no idea where the academy was and you were floating around in the ocean up until now?
Our names don't start with "N" and end with "eptune" so no, that's not the case.
We were worried about you so we came out to meet you here.
Wow! A friend in need is a friend indeed! What you need is a CPU!
We're not here to rescue you guys or anything like that... Hey! Let go of me! I'm not a tissue for you to cry and blow your nose into!
So, is it just you two? What about Histoire?
Gamindustri is currently experiencing a CPU shortage, so she decided to stay behind.
Apparently she wanted us to go investigate this world then report back...
She told us to come here and thoroughly investigate the wormhole as well as what, if any, connection this world has to Gamindustri.
It looks like Noire and Neptune's got some company!
Now there are 4 of them, and 4 of us...
Ahahaha... I think things are going to get busy around here.
Yawn... You guys take over from here... I'm gonna rest... Zzzzz...

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 3 - Cross-Cultural Contact</size>

scripts.say: Everyone together now, let's make some noise! I'll nep up your face~♪
I'll nep up your face~♪
I'll nep up your face~♪
I'll nep up your face~♪
No, no! You gotta hold the torpedoes like glow sticks then swing them like you're hitting an invisible anvil above you while you show me your dance moves! Yeah, that's it! That's the way!
Hold on, Neptune! What in the world are you teaching these poor little kids?! It's really worrying to see them do stuff like this!

Relax, they're just replicas! I'm working on the lyrics and choreography for this new song I've named "Nep-Nep Style"! All we need is small breakout performance and these destroyers are gonna smash everything else on the charts!
That's not what I was talking about... Ah, screw it.
Is she ignoring the fact there are carriers and light cruisers here too...?
It has the kind of rhythm that seems like it'll be popular even among battleships and heavy cruisers before long.
Dear god... You don't have a clue what this world is like, yet you go around acting all nonchalant like you already know everything, Neptune.
Hmm... I guess it's true I've got no clue about this place, but come on, it's fine! It's not like anyone's getting hurt! Besides, you know what they say: a rising tide lifts all boats.
That optimism of yours is truly enviable. But I suppose Histoire did tell us to investigate this world, so we should hurry up and find out more.

Uggghh, you're always so serious, Noire. We can leave that to our future selves to handle. Let's just have fun with everyone instead! Okay, guys, what should we do next? Since everyone's here, how about kick the can or tag?
Let's go with kick the can. We can use this in place of a can!
You can't kick a torpedo around! Don't you understand that's dangerous?!
It's fine, we've removed the fuse from it...
I-I don't think that's the problem here...
Fiiiine, let's do tag then! I'll be it for the first round!
I see! You're so considerate, Nep-Nep! Okay everyone, let's ctrl+esc out of here, before she tags us!
...I will follow you. "Of the thirty-six stratagems, fleeing is best," as they say...
Yeehaw! I'm gonna hide somewhere exciting!
Commence Operation Retreat! Run away and hide!
Sigh... They've already turned into mini-Neptunes. Some other girls are getting into it as well... I don't think I can keep up with these guys anymore.
That said... Everyone's enjoying themselves and having fun.
I don't believe that there's anything wrong with this either.
...Well, I guess. To be honest, I don't hate it either.
Oh yeah, Vert and Blanc... Uh, those 2 that arrived here after we did, where are they? They should've received temporary housing and permission to stay here as well...
Ah, Vert and Blanc? If you're wondering what they're up to, then...
Oh dear... Have I died and gone to CPU heaven?
Veeeeert, could I have more candy?
It's unfair if she gets all of it... I want some too, please...
Me, me! Me too! I want even more candy than they do!
Don't worry, there's enough to go around for everyone~! I've got candy, marshmallows, chocolate... I don't have any lollipops, but I have everything else you could imagine, and lots of it~!
Yaaaay! You have so much candy I've never tasted before!
I like this chocolate...
Mmmm, these marshmallows are so fluffy!
Hahah... I never would've thought this box of candy I happened to bring with me would come in handy... You never know what's going to happen. Okay, children, come sit on Vert's lap~!
Grrrrr... How DARE you lure these cute little kids in with candy... I've never been so angry yet so jealous at the same time!
...Next time, I'll just copy your strategy!
...Something like that. I saw her playing games with some of the children.
Didn't you mention someone that should set off stranger danger alarms for anyone?
If you're talking about Ark Royal then that's just her modus operandi...
Huh, I see... So what about Blanc?
Blanc expressed an interest in this world's books, so I told her where our library is located. I'll go take a look at how she's doing later.
Everyone's enjoying their time in this world in their own way, I guess... Perhaps I should let myself have a look around the academy as well.
If so, I could be your guide, if you'd like.
Yes please, Ayanami. Well then, after you.

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 4 - A Room, Two Gamers, And I</size>

scripts.say: This should be the place... Ah, you've got such a wonderful gaming PC!
This room is just the right size, it's just messy enough, the only source of light is the PC monitor, and there's always snacks and drinks just within arm's reach...
It's pretty much perfect... This is what I'd call a room fit for a gamer.
Come on iiiin. Welcome to the Gamer Girl Grotto.

This is a place of relaxation for those who have been freed of their duties, a place where they can spend some time as social rejects and indulge in their love of games and degeneracy... You are welcome here!
Indeed it is. A place such as this is absolutely indispensable for us gamers... I totally know that feel...
When we play games, we don't want to be interrupted by anyone, we want to be free and, how should I say it... We need a place to soothe our minds. An isolated, quiet, peaceful place...
Hum hum, that is the deepest thing I've heard all month... You are a pro, aren't you?
Ayanami told me about you, but I never thought we'd be so in sync with each other... You're a TRUE gamer, aren't you, Miss?
Ohoho, I am honored by your words of praise... However, I have only just gotten started.
I will now give you a lecture on what it really means to be a TRUE gamer!
...CLACK CLACK CLACK CLACK CLACK... KA-CLICK!
Oh my god... She only goes for headshots! And she never misses!
And she plays hunting games solo and without any gear... Then completes it without even taking any damage! How?!
Nobody can beat her at simulators either! She always walks away at the top of the scoreboard!
She tried land, sea, and air combat... She played every military sim there is, and she conquered them all!
Her gaming skills are elder god tier...! And whenever she has the chance, she sips some cola...!
Then she immediately reaches for a bag of chips... I've never seen such a fearsome playstyle before!
...CLACK CLACK CLACK CLACK CLACK... KA-CLICK!
...Phew, that wasn't too bad.
Miss... You're a god among peasants! A gaming god! All I can say is: wow...
I, too, admire you! You are the very god of gaming itself... You have descended from the heavens to grace us with your presence...!
Ohoho, don't be silly, now... I am a god, and a gamer, and a gaming god... But we are known as CPUs!
I am number one! And nobody can beat me!
Our god is a great god...! Let me bow before you!
Well, that's enough fooling around for now... Games are to be treasured, so now let's pick something we can play with several people. I'll give you some useful protips!
You're the boss, boss! I'll pick out something we can play with several people at once.
Hum hum, if that's the plan, then it would be nice if we had a few more players...
So this is the Gamer Girl Grotto where commoners gather to play video games, I see!
You'll have to excuse us. Her Majesty wished to see what this place is about...
...Oh, I guess we just got a few more players.
The Queen herself is here in person, so you'd better entertain me with a game worth my time! Preferably something highly enjoyable that I can win every round of!
...I'm sorry, but can I ask you to go easy on Her Majesty for just the first few rounds?
Sure, come on in~! We don't get visitors every day, so we'll have tons of fun. Let's all be social rejects together~!
That's what I was hoping to hear! I will make it known to the whole world that The Queen always wins! Now pick any game you want and I shall beat you at it!
I think there's a fallacy in there somewhere, but... Are you sure?
Oh my, oh my... It seems two adorable little girls have come my way... Maybe I should go all out, just for you~?
Who are you calling "little"?!
I will not forgive you for calling me "little"...
Hey... That sounds exactly like something Ark Royal would say!
Let's just move on to the games now~! I'm looking forward to having some multiplayer fun with you all~!
Indeed... As you said, you don't get a chance like this every day, so we should enjoy it to the fullest.

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 5 - Keep Quiet In The Library</size>

scripts.say: ...This must be the academy's library... It's huge. This many books is something worth getting excited about.
What do you think of the library, Blanc? Do you find it to be to your liking?
Oh, hi, Z23... Yeah, I like this place. I think I'll be able to make good progress on my investigation.
That's all that matters. I take it you're interested in Mirror Seas and such?
...That too, but after reading about this world's history and the way it came into existence... I think I've started to understand the connection this world has with Gamindustri...
I see... You must be a very enlightened individual, Blanc.
...Don't compare Neptune or Vert to me. They have the intellectual capacity of a rock.
Ahaha... Well then, would you mind if I assisted you? If there happens to be any documents you skimmed past then you can tell me and I will go look for them.
Sure, I'd love some help. Thanks, Z23...!
W-wait, what is this...?!
Is something the matter, Blanc? ...Ah, that would appear to be the manga and novellas that Long Island and Ayanami bought on the internet.
Although I do believe they refer to the novellas as "light novels"...
...You'd never find genres, titles, plots, or art like this back in Gamindustri...!
...I-I want to read them! All of them! From start to finish! I want them as references for my next book...! I don't care if I'll have to pull an all-nighter...
...Um, excuse me, but... Are you feeling okay, Blanc?
Oh, hello, Z23. What are you doing here?
Good day, Miss Ranger. I should be the one asking you! What are you doing here?
Hmm? Ah, you know, I was wondering if there might be any books I could use to teach the commander about leadership, so I went here to search for some... Ah, oh no!
BA-THUMP, THUMP, THUMP!
...Hey, you dropped your books. Let's see... "Sixty Shades of Grey"?
And these are... "An Echo on the Phone"? "Seduced by a Commander"?
I-it's not what it looks like! I was just... sorting some books and I happened to have these on me!
...These are all romance stories...
...Miss Ranger?
D-don't look at me like that! ...I'm a teacher! I would never read a romance story! The thought of being together with the commander and doing stuff like this... h-has never even cross my mind!
Good day, Miss Ranger. Is there a problem?
K-Künne?!
You seem to be in possession of quite the number of books... If you don't mind, would you like me to help you carry them?
I-it's fine... I can carry them on my own... You should go look for the ones you came for...
Not at all, I would like to help! I can't simply stand aside and watch you struggle with this many books!
I'll carry these for you, will that be okay? By the way, what kind of subject are these textbooks intended for?
Umm, you see, they're not for any subject in…
The Devil Wears Nada and "Sax and the City"...? Your reference materials have some quite interesting titles!
Ahhh... Blanc, Z23, could you stop grinning at me and back me up here?!
...Sorry. I couldn't help but find this situation funny.
Somehow I feel like I've seen a side of you very different from your usual self.
Why, for being a library, it's awfully lively in here... What did I miss?
...We were just having fun teasing Ranger a little.
Blanc, please, have some mercy...
Are you here to borrow some books as well, Souryuu?
I am. I was thinking that I probably have to study a bit.

A Teacher's Tips For Making Your Students Understand Better... "10 Tricks To Improve Your Students' Grades"... "How To Make Even Idiots Pay Attention In Class"... These reference materials are all intended for teachers...
So... does that make you Miss Souryuu?
What are you saying now, Ranger? ...Sigh, at this rate I'm actually going to become established as a teacher character...
...Sure are a lot of teachers at this academy, huh?
You may be right... On that note, I too was once a teacher.

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 6 - Game Night With The Girls!</size>

scripts.say: And now I'd like to announce the first Annual Gaming Party as having officially begun!
HOORAAAAAAAY! DA-DA-DADA
We bring you a hyperdimensional fusion of materials provided by Akashi, technical know-how provided by Yuubari, and game discs Noire brought with her from Gamindustri!
We bring you... A hyperdimensional event! For the whole day, the academy will be one giant arcade! Now come, everyone! Play and enjoy yourselves to your heart's content!
HOORAAAAAAAY! DA-DA-DADA
I didn't provide anything for free, nya. I will get my share of the profits you earn from this event down to the last cent. Capiche?

Hum hum, I'd never come across gaming technology from another dimension before... But now that I have, I can say it was an invigorating experience! Could I use these as reference for designing some new equipment?
W-well, it's only natural a CPU from Gamindustri would have some spare games on her... Ahahahaha... (Now I can't go and tell them I just happened to bring them with me...)
It's all thanks to Noire that we'll be able to have so much fun today!
You heard it, folks! This lady here who brought tons of the latest and greatest games is our MVP! A round of applause for the wonderful Noire! Clap clap clap!
HOORAAAAAAAY! DA-DA-DADA!
Um, well, you know... Hahaha, this is just, um, how I roll as a CPU! Go on, enjoy yourselves today! It's all on me!
It's amazing they're able to hold an event as big as this... I see! Noire really knows her stuff! This must be why they call it "item management"!
I am amazed as well... After all, planning something is easy, but to realize it is not.
Well, Neptune was the one who proposed it, but halfway in she got bored and left everything to me. Who knows how poorly things could have gone if I wasn't here to take over...
But still, I'm glad I get to make everyone happy.
...I haven't seen you smile in a long time, Noire.
Did you say something, Blanc?
...No, nothing... Now, Ranger and Künne, come along and I'll teach you the true joy of visual novels...
...The literary nature of visual novels, how to read and analyze a story, how to make the right choices... I'll teach you everything there is to know...
We will follow your lead, Miss Blanc!
We are as always thankful for your guidance, Miss Blanc!
Miss Blanc...? What have you been teaching them...?
...Just some stuff from the library.
BANG! BANG BANG! POW! BA-BOOOOM!
Firefight, firepower, firefight, firepower... Ahh, I don't have enough ammo!
Ayanami! You've gotta bring me some ammo, otherwise we're gonna lose!
You'll have to do something about that on your own... Things are only getting worse for me over here as well!
Ohoho... I see you have much to learn. You're both newbies, aren't you? Did you really think you could beat me in a tactical shooter?
...I guess you're really good at this after all, Vert...!
It's a 2v1, we're supposed to have the advantage, so how come we're losing~?
...Truth is, I've been on Vert's side all along.
As have I!
What?! No wonder your team's got better stats than we do! But that makes this a 3v2!
That's not fair! You play dirty, Vert...!
Hohoho... There are no rules in war. Also, deceiving the enemy could be thought of as a tactic. Perhaps you've learned something today.
I see... Then we will call for some reinforcements as well!
Indeed! Only a coward with no morals would stand by and watch! I will assist Ayanami and Long Island!
What's more, now's the time to use the ace up our sleeves!
KABOOOOOOOM!
Eeeeek?! They've turned the tables on us, Vert!
Now they have the same stas as us, and they made it a 3v3...
Oh dear, and in the blink of an eye we're not winning anymore. We're most likely going to lose.
But... Some people play games precisely because they want a challenge, you know?
I see! So at this corner you do a four-wheel drift!
That was good, Ikazuchi. It seems you picked a model with good steering.
What the heck! I picked the fastest car there is, so why can't I win?!
I think it's because you can't handle all that speed.
In racing games, how well you can control your vehicle, how many shortcuts you can take, and going as fast as possible without going off course are more important than just going the fastest...
And all you were doing was putting the pedal to the metal and crashing into things.
Then I'll turn at the curve properly this... Nep?! I totaled my car again!
And while Nep-Nep's busy with that, I'm gonna slamdunk that finish line! It's victory lap time!
Bravo, Ikazuchi... I'm just behind you... It seems we will never lose first and second place. I think it's time for some victory champagne...
You got me... But let's play one more round! Just one more! Come on, man
You can try again all you want but you're just gonna lose every time.
Nuh-uh, no way! I will win eventually as long as I keep trying!
If you're gonna be that way then fine. I guess I'll give you as much advice as I can, too.
You seem to be having quite the time! I permit you to accept me as a team member! Now let us play a game that will appease me!
Sure thing, Lizzy! Whaddya wanna play?
A game brimming with elegance fit for a queen as myself, of course! And you will prepare the very best that will satisfy me! Understood?!
Her Majesty seems to have become interested in games as of late... If you don't mind, may I ask you to let us play with you?
No probs, you guys are welcome any time. Whaddya wanna play, O Spite of War?
Spite of War...? Well, whatever... Hmm, let's see... I'd like to try a war game. As in, a game teeming with violence in a battle to the death... Do you have anything like that?
Then maybe what you want is a fighting game or action game? They're pretty realistic.
You do? In that case... I would love to try one of those!
Hahaha... This is my chance to show you the tricks I've learned at the Gamer Club! Warspite, fetch me a bottle of soda and a bag of crisps at once!
Your Majesty, those are not required in order to play video games...

sequence: <size=45>Chapter 7 - Well Then, Buh-Bye!</size>

scripts.say: ...Now then, while I totally didn't expect you all to just sit around and play games all day, it seems you did investigate as I told you to. You have done well.

Thanks to your investigation I was able to understand the gist of what the connection is between Gamindustri and this other world. From now on you should be able to access this world whenever you want.
Woo-hoo! I knew you could do it, Histy! So then... can we just stay here forever?
...What are you on about? We obviously can't do that.
She's right. Gamindustri won't last very long without us CPUs to watch over it.
Vert is correct. You can all return here whenever you want, so please, all of you come back to Gamindustri at once. And that includes you, Neptune.
Sigh Being a big-shot CPU loved by everyone sure is tough... Fiiiine, I'll come back home.
For a while I had no idea how we'd manage in this world... But we did, somehow. We couldn't have done it alone though. Thank you for helping us out so much, everyone.
Yeah! Thank you, Laffey, Javelin, Ayanami, Z23... And everyone else here at the academy! We owe you, big time!
Also... It was tons of fun hanging out with you guys!
Yeah... It was really fun.
I had a great time too. I'd love to have another exciting discussion about games with you, Nep-Nep.
Oh, you wanna do that? Stay up all night talking about games, again?
...We don't have time for that. We gotta get going.
Leaving Gamindustri without CPUs for too long isn't very good.
Though it pains us all... I suppose you must leave now...
Just after we'd all become such close friends... It's a shame.
Yeah, I don't want to leave either... But I've got Lastation to take care of, and I promise we'll meet again.
Thank you, Z23 and Ayanami. I'm glad I got the chance to meet you.
Come on, guys... Let's just stay one more night while we're still here! I've gotten hooked on Oxy-Cola and Torpedo Tempura... And I need my daily dose!
Oh, right! I packed some lunch for you, Nep-Nep. I filled it with Torpedo Tempura just for you. I hope you'll like it!
Wowzers! Thanks, Javelin! Holy moley, there's like a dozen Oxy-colas in here! We could all have 3 each!
Uh, yeah... You can have mine, Neptune.
You can't quite drink them, I see... They're intended for consumption by shipgirls only, not even our commander can handle drinking them.
...But I remember Nep-Nep downing a whole bottle. Maybe she has the same taste as we do?
Now then, CPUs, please line up in front of the wormhole and prepare to jump into it.
I can't simply leave an inter-dimensional wormhole open here, so once you're done saying goodbye, I will close it for the time being.
When you have business in this world, I can open it again, so you don't need to worry about that.
Yeah, I guess you're right... Z23, Ayanami, thank you once again. We all had our ups and downs, but I enjoyed myself too.
I couldn't agree more. There are no words to express my gratitude. Thank you for everything, Noire.
I had fun too. Sayonara, Noire.
Mutsuki, Kisaragi, Uzuki... I'll be back before you know it! And I'll bring you girls more candy than you could ever dream of!
Okay, Vert! I'm gonna dream of tons of candy while you're gone!
We'll be waiting... Bye bye, Vert!
Bye byyyyeee!
Ahhh... You're all so lovely! I wish I didn't have to return home!
Sigh... I don't either, I've barely even started on reading the books from this world... I could never get bored of talking with Künne either...
We'll wait for you as long as it takes, Miss Blanc...!
