I will patiently wait for your glorious return, Miss Blanc!
It seems we all got to know each other and now nobody wants you to leave....
Haha, yeah, it seems so... For better or worse, you've helped us increase our shares as well, so we should be able to remain active in this world unhindered.
You deserve my thanks too, Laffey and Javelin! I promise we'll be back, in one way or another! Let's meet again sometime!
Hey, don't say anything that'll make them expect too much.
This journey of ours was quite an extraordinary experience...
...Hearing that raises a bunch of warning flags in my head.
Yeah... I'll be waiting for your return, Nep-Nep.
As will I! I hope you'll still have fun back home in Gamindustri...!
I will. Thanks! I'm always finding ways to have fun no matter where I am, so don't worry! And I promise I'll be back to have even more fun with you guys... So just wait for me until then!
Well then, buh-bye!

sequence: <size=45>"Odd-Colored Seas - BLACK"</size>

scripts.say: Oh my... what kind of signal is this?
I'm detecting interference from beyond this dimension... Could this be an anomaly??
I never thought there would be visitors from a different dimension other than us.
Ehehe... unexpected things keep occurring one after another. How interesting.
Is this also a demonstration of the myriad possibilities that the future holds? As an observer, this development piques my curiosity. Perhaps this shall serve as the next test specimen.
However, I would prefer not to show my face just yet.
Ehehe... If I utilize the Mirror Seas, perhaps I can conduct a most interesting experiment.
Now, what kind of fruit shall this experiment bear? I shall wait and see.
Finally home... can't take it anymore... going to sleep...
Wait, Laffey, don't fall asleep just yet! The reconnaissance mission doesn't end until we're back in port!
Our original mission was just to scout the Mirror Sea. I didn't think we'd be found and have to fight. It's understandable to be tired.
Ahhh... I can't do it! I had no idea fighting those full-powered CPU clones would be so tiring...
The one that looked like Noire was so strong...
Why would the enemy have someone who looks exactly like Noire in her CPU form?
... My apologies. Even though that wasn't me, it seems that whatever took on my form has caused trouble for everyone.
Mhm... it's not Noire's fault. Surely it's the doing of the Mirror Sea...
Those attacks from the fake Black Heart are only possible when a CPU has full share power... I wonder if our data was somehow taken...
It'll be fine! We managed to chase them off and all, so everything will be okay!
That's true... Even though those fakes indeed had our powers, they were like puppets that fought without knowledge or experience. They should be straightforward to defeat.
Yup yup! As long as we work together, we can wrap this up!
Well... without enough share power, we won't be of much help.
... That's right... Perhaps this fatigue is also due to a lack of shares...
Because of that, we certainly had it rough as well.
Nep?! Blanc and Vert? You guys are here too?
Just the two of you don't instill a whole lot of confidence, so I decided to check in.
Histoire is currently investigating a way of getting home. There shouldn't be anything to worry about.
We encountered them during another reconnaissance mission... so we brought them over.
Thank you, Ayanami. Did you also run into your own clones?
Yes... With everyone's aid... we somehow managed to fight them back...
Frankly speaking, there's no way of utilizing our full power without shares.
Come to think of it, Akashi was looking for Nep-Nep and the others.
I've been listening, nya. It seems like the CPUs aren't able to wield their powers here, nya.
Akashi, did you find a solution?
It's quite simple, nya. When in Rome, do as the Romans do. All we need to do is to equip you CPUs with your own ship rigging!
This way, everyone can sortie together!
Wooah! Shiny new equipment! Gimme Gimme!
To think that something like this could be done... Akashi, can we equip these right now?
Hmm... I don't think I can make it tonight. Why don't you all get some rest, nya?
Akashi will have it done by the morning. Look forward to it, nya!

sequence: <size=45>"Odd-Colored Seas - GREEN"</size>

scripts.say: Here you have it... the fruits of Akashi's hard work last night, nya!
pouts... Don't act like I didn't hear that. I helped with the technical stuff...
Whew! Brand spankin' new equipment! And what's more - it's super epic and exclusive to us!
Akashi, Yuubari, thank you very much. I'll be sure to treasure it!
Wooahh! Badass! Is this a cannon? Ah this thing shoots torpedoes too! I can't wait to unload all these explosives into someone's face!
Nya nya nya! Don't point those at other people!
Sorry, sorry! I'll be more careful!
Your ship rigging can be controlled freely with just your thoughts. As long as you don't space out, there shouldn't be any risk of misfiring... Woah, don't point those guns over here!
Mine seems to be different from Neptune's, with these main turrets. This one focuses on heavy firepower, doesn't it? The color also matches, not bad!
This rigging fits my image nicely... it has a nice white theme. Looks like it focuses on launching torpedoes...
Are these carrier aircraft? And this rigging lets you launch them? What's more, these planes are adorable. It's a perfect fit for me!
... Say, is it possible to make these planes into cute girls?
There would be an additional charge, nya.
Vert, you're the same as ever, even over here.
Then, then, can I turn my torpedoes into cute dolphins?
You can purchase these exclusive equipment skin boxes. The pricing goes something like this...
Save that discussion for later! Our first priority should be to take care of those clones.
In short, we can all fight together now! Onwards to the Mirror Sea!
We don't quite understand the circumstances, but they have not been able to draw out their full power. There still appear to be possibilities that remain hidden from our understanding.
Next, we must adapt to this dimension, and attain new power as well.
Hehehe... Things have gotten more interesting than I originally imagined.
I want to further witness the possibilities these girls contain... Let us observe them a bit longer...
... Beep beep! Beep beep! Beep beep!
We've received communication signals on an unregistered frequency. This is...
Ah... testing, testing. Everyone, can you hear me?
Hmm... I can hear you, but can't see you. What are you, the air or something?
Who are you calling air? It's me, Histoire!
Histoire, is that you? Does that mean you've managed to establish communication?
Yes, I somehow managed to get through. I should be able to establish a way back to Gamindustri soon.
...Then, we can go home soon?
It's too difficult to do right now... I'm going to need quite a bit of time. Everyone, please wait a while longer.
Of course things wouldn't go that smoothly... and we still have to deal with the clones in this dimension. Looks like we will have our hands full for a while.
Ah... so those things appeared after all? They may be related to this...
Histoire, do you know something about those fakes?
Actually, your data was probably collected when you all passed through that wormhole.
... and then someone used our data to make those clones?
It would appear that is the case.
In any case, I will do my best to re-open the wormhole. Everyone, make sure to be careful.
We also heard the communication over here. It seems that we're getting closer to unveiling whoever is behind this incident.
Surely... it's the work of the Sirens...
So those fakes were made using the data of Nep Nep and her friends?
Sirens? I don't really get it, but they sure sound like an insidious bunch. But to think they could create a full-power CPU...
Sirens... always cheat...
Don't sweat it! There's no way we can lose. We'll definitely win!
Ohh, what amazing, baseless confidence!
... Don't take her too seriously. There's no proof.
Aww, don't be a party pooper, Blanc. Has the real thing ever lost to the fake before? Since we're the real deal, there's no way we'd lose! Checkmate!
Neptune really is quite the optimistic genius.
Eheh! Praise me more! Neppy here is a girl who grows with more praise!

sequence: <size=45>"Odd-Colored Seas - WHITE"</size>

scripts.say: Stage 2 cleared, easy breezy! Looks like we'll have this situation under control in no time!
On the contrary. As if things would be that simple.
Nep?! It's Histy's voice!
It's too early to celebrate. Don't you still have something to do?
But didn't we already eliminate those clones from the Mirror Sea?
That may be the case but... what if, that alone isn't enough?
Mm, correct. We still need a lot more data.
... Do we not have enough data on this part of the Mirror Sea?
That's also a problem, but... in order to re-open the wormholes, we need to collect data from the CPU clones.
Perhaps that has something to do with Blanc and me coming here.
That's correct. For the time being, please continue to investigate the Mirror Seas and suppress any CPU clones you encounter. Well then, until later.
... She just says whatever she wants to say, and then cuts off the line...
It's fine, it's fine! Histy's always like that.
She just drops the important details and then is all like "I'll leave the rest with you," before bouncing.
... She's a bit like our commander.
Mmhmm. After the fleet formation is set up, we just get a "do your best, everyone," or something like that.
Somehow, I feel like I'm also being roasted...
... In any case, we've all got to do our best.
That's right. We have no other choice. Let's all get through this together.
Yup! Before busting our butts though, gotta take a break!
... It appears that someone from that other dimension is interfering as well.
To think that they would be able to not only destroy the Firewall, but also investigate the existence of the Mirror Seas...
... They are a force to be reckoned with, perhaps on the same level as us... No, maybe even greater?
Hehe... Well then, let us determine just who the superior one is...
Hell yeah! This should be the last of these idiots!
Blanc sure is energetic... pummeling away at those clones even though they look just like her.
Hmph... isn't that obvious? These frickin' clones are creepy as hell.
We have to mop them up as fast as we can... Come to think of it, Vert, you didn't hold back against your clone either in the previous zone.
How do I put it... it's like hatred towards your relatives? My power kept welling up.
Somehow... that makes a lot of sense.
We've also been fighting off clones of ourselves here... Somehow, I'm not even sure if this is being caused by someone else...
There's too much we don't know about the Mirror Seas...
It seems like this situation won't be resolved so easily...
Good work, everyone. I've managed to gather some new data.
However, it's not quite enough. Please collect a bit more data from the Mirror Seas.
Huuh? You've gotta be kidding me. We've been at it for ages!
Almost, I just need a little bit more! To put it concretely, around one stage's worth? I should be able to finish with that.
There you have it. Thank you for your consideration, everyone.
Ah! What the hell? Don't you dare disconnect just yet!
You said to investigate the Mirror Space, but we've already 100%'d this zone! The hell are we supposed to do? Hey! Histoire! Damn it, respond!
Oh my, looks like we have no choice. We'll simply have to wait here elegantly until the next Mirror Space opens up.
Good grief... You sure are calm though, Vert, for not being able to go home still.
Indeed... I'm not in any particular rush to get back home. (Squeeze!)
Eh...? Why is Vert hugging Laffey?
U-um... Vert, what kind of hug is this...?
There are so many cute girls here... Aaahh, I wouldn't mind being stuck here forever!
... There it is again. You could call it Vert's mental illness... I don't even want to say anything.

sequence: <size=45>"Odd-Colored Seas - PURPLE"</size>

scripts.say: ... In the last episode, Histy threw Blanc and the others for a loop yesterday.
And now in today's exciting installment - a new Mirror Sea has spawned!
For them to appear back-to-back like this... how unusual.
This would probably be the first time this has happened, right?
This is also an effect of my Protagonist Aura! Let's go mop up some quests and farm some rare ships!
Just what are you rambling about? Neptune, our priority is to investigate the Mirror Sea. The only things we should be mopping up are our clones, got it?
Loosen up, Noire, I know~♪ After all, the commander here is sure to burn all their fuel farming this Mirror Sea. Right, Laffey?
Wait, shouldn't you be taking the commander's side?
Ah... our commander isn't like that... Though there are some who not only burn all their fuel, but also run everyone's morale into red...
I can see a bleak future of overwork ahead of us... I'm asking to be paid for overtime...
Jeez, I'm surrounded by black-hearted people.
Even though Noire has the most black heart here~
The color just suits me well! I'm not black-hearted at all!
Now now, everyone, let's not be so serious. It'll ruin your cute faces. Let's lighten up, shall we?
... Go home, Vert, you're drunk.
Don't wanna~ Being surrounded by all these cute girls... this is the heaven I wanted... ehehe... (Squeeze!)
Awawa?! Vert, what are you doing all of a sudden?
Urk... so this is the strength... of a carrier's embrace...
Vert, you're just like Neptune. Whether in war or peace, you two never change.
Come on, everyone. Let's all strengthen our teamwork and head out to the new Mirror Sea!
Stage 4 cleared flawlessly! The Neptune Crew is invincible wherever we go!
Just who are you calling the Neptune Crew? Don't just lump us in with your weird fantasies!
... Is it finally over now?
If what Histoire said is correct, then this should be the last zone...
Yes. Well done, everyone.
Histy?!  Well then... is this really the last stage?
Indeed, that is the case. The data from the Mirror Seas, and the data from your clones... I've managed to collect it all.
With this, I will be able to re-open a wormhole connecting Gamindustri to this world. You will be able to return at any time.
Woo hoo! Game cleared! Congratulations!!
That was quite troublesome, but at least it's over now.
Phew... we can finally go home.
This was certainly quite the novel experience... But, it looks like it's time for us to go...
Nep-Nep, do you all really have to go?
You don't need to be in such a hurry... it's fine to stay at the academy a bit longer...
Sorry, everyone. As CPUs, we can't be away from Gamindustri for too long.
Waaaah! Don't wanna, don't wanna, don't wanna! I'm not ready to leave yet! I want to stay here and play with everyone a bit longer! Let's change the departure date. Maybe three months out.
Like hell we could stay for that long. I said we're going so we're going!
If you all are leaving, we'll also be a bit lonely...
That's right! Shouldn't we at least rest for a day or three?
Indeed... I wouldn't mind staying with everyone a bit longer...
Vert, you're saying stuff like that too?! Histoire, tell them that we gotta get going!
Yes, please come back as soon as possible.
However, that being said, you are able to travel back to this dimension whenever you want, you know?
──EHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH?!
Because of the remarkable affinity between Gamindustri and this world, I am able to open the wormhole at any time.
Therefore, it's "see you later," not "goodbye." If you wanted to come back tomorrow, you would be able to. As such, do not worry too much about not being able to see each other.
Y-yaaay! We'll be able to be together forever!
... Mm... Nep-Nep, come play with us every day, okay...?
Mmhmm! I'll make sure to come every day!
Hey! Don't be too shameless! You'll be a nuisance to the people in this world!
No, no, don't hesitate to come at any time. We'll always welcome you.
If that's the case, your big sister is going to come see you cuties every day!
... Vert's really going end up stuck here, so it's best to not be too courteous to her.
... Mm, I'll be waiting for everyone to come.
When that time comes, will you all fight alongside Javelin again?
That's right, since we had this exclusive rigging built for us, we've got to fight too!
As just an observer, I never expected yet another anomalous occurence
Those visitors from another dimension... might actually settle in this world? And they will lend their strength to those who oppose us...
Is this yet another facet... of the myriad possibilities of the future that we are pursuing?
... Hehehe, this kind of development... isn't all bad.
... Then, let us continue...observing them...
Patiently... ...

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その一　ある日の綾波</size>

scripts.say: 母港・ある日
指揮官,大変や！綾波,綾波がーー
綾波が壊れたんや！
数日前から部屋に引きこもって,いくら呼んでも応えへん！
パソコンのモニターに見入ってて一歩も動かんのや！
んで,今日は――
「リアルなんてクソゲー,です！」
「愛が足りない,です！」
「出撃したら負け,です！」
――と,疲れた顔で変な話しばっかりしとるで！

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その二　弾幕が薄い！？</size>

scripts.say: 数分後・綾波の部屋
（トントン）
（モニターを見て）あ,新着動画,おお…こっちも――
（トントン）
うぅ…誰ですか…綾波の休憩時間に……
（トントン）
今行くのですよーー指揮官ですか…
綾波,大事なことをやっている最中です。指揮官はテキトウに座っていいです。
ーーこれですか？「ニコニコドウガ」ですよ。
友達から勧められたのです。
見た目はシンプルですけど,面白い放送が一杯あるのです。
友達と「弾幕」で話し合って……楽しいです…
キシンの弾幕,味わうが良い…！――

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その三　干物同盟！？</size>

scripts.say: 「アヤナミ」凄いな…まさか幽霊さんとここまでやりあえるなんて～
「L・I」が本気を出せば,綾波は勝てないはず…
フッフッフッ,「アヤナミ」の成長を楽しみにしてるよ～
で,これから何するのかな？うーん生放送巡り？新番アニメチェック？むむむ悩ましいの…
ふぅ……
（トントン）
うん,この音,指揮官ですね…今行くのです
やはり指揮官です…うん？部屋に誰も居ないのです……
「ニコ生」で知り合ったトモダチです。
お出かけ…ですか？えっと,この動画を見てから考えるのです――

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その四　綾波更生計画・上</size>

scripts.say: こ,このままだと綾波が「ハイジン」になっちゃうで！
指揮官お願い！綾波を部屋から連れ出すんや！
にゃにゃ♪この明石にはいい案があるにゃ！実は最近新しい食料を開発したにゃ。電子の海に溺れるコドモたちを引き上げるチョ～オイシイ,明石謹製エナジーチーズケーキにゃ！
名付けて――『ゲキウマ大作戦』にゃ！
おおお！なんか強そうに聞こえるんやで！
材料費は…指揮官に負担してもらうにゃ！

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その五　綾波更生計画・中</size>

scripts.say: 綾波～明石がめっちゃすぺしゃるなケーキを作ったで！指揮官,ケーキ券を二枚くれたんやけど――
部屋に引きこもらんでうちと一緒にケーキを食べに行かへん？
うっ…ケーキ…
だが断る,です！
今日の新着動画……まだチェックが終わっていない,です……
んな！……やっぱケーキじゃアカンっちゅうことか……
『ゲキウマ大作戦』,失敗したで……
なるほどね！「きたかぜとたいよう」にすればいいよ！
「きたかぜとたいよう」？
そう！えっとね,「きたかぜとたいよう」っていうのは,同じことをずっとやらせると,いつか絶対飽きるってことだよ！うんうん,暁はそう言ってた！
そ,そうやな……

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その六　綾波更生計画・下</size>

scripts.say: キシン流奥義…！終わりです！
うわ！さすがは「アヤナミ」…少し手加減したとは言え,一週間でこの幽霊さんから白星を一回奪うとは……
で,これからはどうするの？もう一回やる？あ,積みゲーの実況とかでもいいのよー？いやーまったく一日24時間って本当に足りないもんねー……「アヤナミ」？
すみません…AFKです……
うん？「アヤナミ」もう寝落ちなの？まあ特別な訓練を受けなければこの幽霊さんのように持たないもんね～起きたらまた枠取ろ？
（電源OFF）身体機能より,精神のほうが……（パタン）

sequence:
最近,綾波の様子が…？

<size=45>その七　アヤナミ,出撃です！</size>

scripts.say: 指揮官,祥鳳,おはようです。
綾波！？雷ちゃんの作戦が成功した！？
はい,長時間の作戦行動はやっぱり新兵には厳しいと判断したのです。
それに,指揮官と祥鳳も綾波のことを心配してくれているのです……
ケーキも…興味が無いわけじゃ……ない,です…
うわああああん！綾波戻ってきたんや！！
祥鳳が泣くと…綾波,困るのです…
うぅ……せやけど,どういう表情せりゃええんの？
……「笑えばいい」と思うのです。

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Interim Head Maid</size>

scripts.say: Listen closely, Belfast and I will be leaving our posts today!
During our absence, secretary duties will be passed to Newcastle!
...There's nothing to worry about. Before Belfast became the head maid, Newcastle was responsible for coordinating the whole maid team.
She might be rather boring, but... she shouldn't have any trouble supporting my servant.
Commander, is something amiss?
I was pulled back to my senses by the sound of Newcastle's voice.
This is the report of the previous joint exercise. Please look over it.
Newcastle handed me a neatly-organized report.
Commander, would you like anything to drink?
Coffee? Roasted tea? Or perhaps pale ale?
I would personally recommend the tea, but if you'd prefer something else, I'd be glad to prepare it.
As you wish.
Before I could blink, a tray with a tea set appeared upon my desk. The fragrance and warmth of the black tea wrapped around my senses.
Though I cannot hold a candle to Belfast, I formerly directed the Royal Maids. I will strive to serve you to the best of my abilities.
From her demeanor as a maid to her experience with secretary work, there was nothing "former" about her.
If Belfast could be described as "perfect," she would almost be better described as an excellence that transcended perfection.

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Perfection and Peace</size>

scripts.say: *knock* *knock*
While working with Newcastle in the office, I heard a knock at the door.
Master, sincerest apologies for interrupting your work.
Newcastle, there's something I would like your help with...
Is it about that warehouse?
Indeed.
It should be fine as long you clean it up afterwards. You should take care of the rest as you see fit.
Understood. Thank you.
After exchanging a few pleasantries, Sheffield bowed politely and left the office.
There's a slight issue with one of the old warehouses.
Nobody had time to clean it, so Sheffield and I suggested to Belfast that we might take care of it.
As for Belfast... Well, if the Head Maid was to handle it, nobody would be leaving until every single item in the warehouse were inventoried and listed.
Even if all the Royal Maids were to help out, we'd struggle to complete a project of that scope.
But with just Sheffield and me, the two of us would be enough to get things to a satisfactory state.
That Belfast will settle for nothing less than perfection, anything else be damned.
However, there are situations in which the pursuit of perfection is not the best way to get things done.
Oh, pardon me. I apologize for boring you with my personal matters.
What I now pursue is not "perfection," but rather "peace."

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Lunch Break</size>

scripts.say: After we had our lunch, I instructed Newcastle to take an hour off. ...And she was gone in the blink of an eye.
Even though lunch wasn't quite over yet, I was a bit curious as to what she did during her spare time, so I decided to look for her.
Do you need something? You're looking for Newcastle?
Erm... Sorry, but little old Kent hasn't seen anything...
Huh...? That cloud over there looks like... Gah! I wasn't daydreaming! I swear, I was working!
...Umm, where did Newcastle go? I don't know either...
Haven't seen her... Sorry.
Newcastle? If she's not with Sheffield, then she's probably somewhere reading by herself!
Anyway, I don't know where she is... but she has been helping out with maid duties, so I'd guess maybe she's off doing something like that?
Why not try looking in that empty lot behind the Royal Navy's dorms? That's where we usually dry out the laundry...
Finally, I found her in the lot Edinburgh mentioned, hidden behind a white sheet that was fluttering in the wind.
She was sitting on a stool next to the clothes rack with a half-opened book in her lap, drowsiness weighing upon her eyelids.
As if she sensed me approaching, she raised her head serenely, a gentle smile forming upon her lips.

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Prank Time?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
I was quietly working with Newcastle, who was seated on the couch.
She might be rather boring, but... she shouldn't have any trouble supporting my servant.
Why did Queen Elizabeth describe her as "boring"...?

options.content: Steal a furtive glance at Newcastle
Don't do anything, like a wimp

scripts.say: Newcastle was silently flipping through operation reports.
Phew...
In the silence of the office, I could hear every gentle breath that escaped from her lips.

options.content: Try playing a prank on her

scripts.say: Terribly curious as to how she would react, I decided to play a little prank on Newcastle.
I tore a small piece off the eraser in my hand and flicked it in front of her.
Newcastle paused for a moment, but then resumed looking over her documents as if nothing even happened.
Unsatisfied, I decided to try again, but she shrugged off that attempt as well. I tried to get her attention in a variety of other ways, but failed each time.
Fine... Drastic times call for drastic measures...

options.content: Let's not do this after all...

scripts.say: I sneakily made my way behind the sofa and extended my fingers towards Newcastle's nape...
KABOOM!!
The sound of a loud explosion from the R&D Department tore through the office, sending me to my knees as my vision went black.
Commander, are you all right?
When I came to my senses, I found myself on top of Newcastle, my body pressed against hers.
I could feel a warm sensation pressing against my face...
Now, was this a happy little accident... or was this what you were aiming for all along?
You may stay there as long as you want... but you'll have to make up for it with overtime afterwards.
Her words were kind and mellow as always.

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Outing</size>

scripts.say: I headed to town with Newcastle and Sheffield to help them out with some shopping.
Now then, I have other business to attend to.
Thank you for your help, Sheffy.
The pleasure is mine. I'll leave Master in your capable hands.
She left as if she were handing off an unruly child to the other parent...
Hmm, let's see. There are a few more stores I'd like to visit.
The purpose of this trip was partly to buy some items that Akashi doesn't stock, and wouldn't be worth ordering.
Since we're here, why don't we renew my insurance as well?
Your... insurance?
Indeed, my insurance.
We may be ships, but our bodies and minds are human in many respects.
For us, falling in battle is just another unfortunate part of life. In order to avoid leaving behind any regrets, we have to make sure to prepare beforehand.
Travel insurance, disaster insurance, fire insurance, accident insurance... you never know when these things might come in handy.
I have Gneisenau to thank for showing me this truth.
Newcastle opened up the umbrella she usually carried on her as she continued to talk.
It's not just for me. I've also purchased insurance for Her Majesty, as well as the other Royal Maids.
Newcastle gradually approached me, covering me underneath her umbrella.
After all, my quiet and peaceful life is only possible thanks to all my precious friends who fight so hard to protect me...

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Sunset</size>

scripts.say: After making our rounds, we managed to purchase everything we came out for.
We still have some free time before we're supposed to meet up with Sheffield.
Commander, why don't we rest for a bit?
In accordance to Newcastle's suggestion, we sat down on a bench at the street corner.

options.content: Strike up a conversation with Newcastle

scripts.say: I rarely get to shop with anyone but the Royal Maids.
Ever since I accepted Her Majesty's appointment, I've pretty much done everything with the other maids. Even afterwards, when I returned to the Royal Islands, I was always with Glasgow...
I'm sorry, I hope it doesn't sound like I'm brooding...
Don't worry about me. I'll be able to adapt, no matter where I am.
She pulled a book out of hammerspace and placed it upon her thighs.
Whether in times of war or times of peace, whether I'm serving as a maid or as a secretary, I can be myself as long as I'm surrounded by those dear to me.
This is what "peace" means to me. As for my dreams, those are but trivial matters.
Her Majesty might disapprove of my viewpoint, but...
She did once tell me, verbatim, "You should hold onto your dreams".

sequence:
A Paean for Peace

<size=45>Her Desires</size>

scripts.say: Queen Elizabeth said that Newcastle should hold onto her own dreams.
However, she had already found the "peace" that made her life satisfying.
"As for my dreams, those are but trivial matters."
But somehow...
Hmm? You'd like to... realize your dreams?
If I can really be of assistance with that, I'd be glad to help you.
Just let me know what I can do.
Newcastle treasures her friends greatly, and they reciprocate that feeling.
Thus, in order to protect her own "peace," she cannot disregard the "peace" of her friends.
Commander, are you just trying to protect your own "peace" just like me?
You are someone who is precious to me, so it'd only make sense for you to want to protect me...
Newcastle quietly closed her book.
Thank you very much, Commander.
I feel like I better understand those words that Her Majesty imparted to me now.
I heard something in her voice that was never there before - a hint of nervousness.
She inched her body towards mine, her eyes fixed on my own...
Singing the wordless paean of the peace which she desired from the bottom of her heart...
Commander, would you treasure me?

sequence:
战斗！皇家女仆队！

<size=45>一　作战开始</size>

scripts.say: 听好了，贝尔法斯特，这次任务只许成功，不许失败！
宴会虽然取得了成功，但是这里是舰队，实力才是最重要的。
是时候向所有人展现我们皇家海军的威名了！
是，如您所愿。
但是女王陛下，如果我们成功的话，不就意味着指挥官要失败了吗？
那、那就，不许输，也不许赢！
如您所愿。
为了这次，我还特意从皇家请来了额外的帮手哦！
帮手…难道是……
演习海域
看来陛下看得很重呢…既然如此，我们也要再加把劲才行呢
贝尔法斯特，我们这边的防线已经布置好了哦~
肯特……呼，呼……你跑的，太快了啦……
辛苦两位了
我这边也准备就绪，所有弹药都替换成了训练用的，武装也没有问题。
呵呵，不愧是谢菲呢
啊，贝法，指挥官的部队已经抵达这片海域了。
是吗…各位，本次演习作战，我们皇家女仆组将扮演占领据点的假想敌，抵御来自指挥官所率领的舰队的进攻。
我和爱丁堡负责正面防守，萨福克和肯特负责北方，谢菲负责南方。
这虽然只是一次演习，但也是展现各位身为皇家女仆风采的时机，更是为女王陛下在指挥官面前赢得尊重的大好机会。
所以，各自务必把这次演习当做实战来看待，明白了吗？
是！
那么，就让指挥官稍微尝些苦头吧~
我离开之后的皇家女仆队……有些期待呢，呵呵~

<size=45>二　侧翼的两人</size>

scripts.say: 演习海域——北方侧翼防线
呼，总算是守住了这一波。
累死我啦！
虽然贝尔法斯特她们在正面一定更加辛苦，不过侧翼的攻势也很汹涌呢。
大家的战斗技巧和火力都好厉害呢……
不过能守到现在的我们也很厉害就是了！
啊哈哈，不过，果然和同伴交手即使是演习也会很紧张呢……
欸？我觉得其实还蛮开心的耶，而且我们现在是假想敌，还能说些平时不好意思说的台词。
比如，“拿出你们的全力吧！”“Come on，你们的实力不止这一点吧？”什么的~
肯特，你回去后肯定要被大家修理的啦……
啊哈哈，肯特选手才不会怕~
哈啊…真羡慕你呢，哎，好想看看云，摸摸鱼什么的呀…
偷懒可不是皇家女仆所为哦，萨福克。
哎呀，好疼！谁弹我的头！咦，你是…
啊，纽卡斯尔！你怎么会在这里？
陛下怕你们人手不足，所以特地让我过来助阵。
虽然我也不知道我能不能派上用场就是了。
纽卡斯尔~！
哎呀，这就抱过来了，萨福克还是老样子呢。
因为贝尔法斯特虽然很可靠，但是好亲近这点还是纽卡斯尔你最好亲近嘛～
啊，好狡猾，我也要！
嗯……是纽卡斯尔的味道……
嘻嘻，真是的，不要说这种让人害羞的话呀——
不过，这样能让你安心下来了吗？
……嗯，汲取到了动力呢。
呵呵，那就加油吧，我还要去后方看看。之后，再好好聊聊吧~

sequence:
战斗！皇家女仆队！

<size=45>三　闪耀的谢菲</size>

scripts.say: 演习海域——南方侧翼防线
嗯……这样的话，这边的武装就已经全部都擦洗过一遍了。
敌人的攻势看来开始朝中央集中了
我们这边把战力也集中在中央那边似乎比较好也说不定……
谢菲，一个人在这边有些寂寞了吗？
？！…原来是纽卡斯尔姐姐，好久不见。
原来您就是贝尔法斯特所说的帮手吗。
呵呵，是的，好久不见呢。
我刚去看了下萨福克那边。谢菲你这边看来还好呢
暂时还可以勉强撑下来。不管怎么说，能见到姐姐实在是太好了。
呵呵，这种表情一点不动的感觉，谢菲还是老样子呢。
请不要总把我当小孩子，我也是有所成长的，姐姐
成长呢……说起来，谢菲知道为什么陛下这次坚持要由女仆组来作演习对象吗？
原因的话，难道不是为了向同伴夸耀吗？
陛下加入舰队后，和其他阵营的同伴们，比如重樱的{namecode:82}，白鹰的企业姐妹等等都建立了良好的关系。
……虽然陛下嘴上不承认，心里其实已经把那几位当成好朋友了。
殿下只不过是想向朋友们夸耀一下自己的阵营，和自己引以为豪的女仆队而已
原来如此……谢菲你呢？和陛下一样在舰队里过得高兴吗？
……虽然指挥官不是很可靠，不过能和大家一起生活，一起战斗，不用去想不好的事情……
呵呵，看来过得还不错呢，真是太好了。
嗯…时间也差不多了，我要回去正面防线了，叙旧就等到之后再说吧~
是，姐姐。

scripts.say: 演习海域——正面防线
不愧是指挥官，北方防线已经被攻破，南方防线也岌岌可危了吗。
贝法，我们快要输掉了欸，为什么你看起来反而很高兴啊？！
呵呵呵，这不是理所当然的吗？
站在对立的立场上，我们才能更直观地体会到我们的同伴，我们所选择的人已经变得多么强大
这难道不值得高兴吗~？
呜呜呜，这样的话，等大家到我们这里的时候，我们就随便应付一下就好了？
我都要累死了啦…
这可不行，陛下把这次演习看得十分重要。
（小声）陛下其实只是想在其他阵营面前炫耀而已吧……
这正说明了陛下已经越来越融入舰队了不是吗？过去的陛下可是不会这么想的。
看到殿下逐渐往好的方向转变，身为女仆的我们应该更加去支持才是
为了这样的陛下，我们应该拿出我们的全力。
贝法，没想到你心里这么关心陛下的啊。
……好吧，我知道啦，反正我总是说不过你啦。
呵呵，而且，好不容易女仆队全体参加的活动，姐姐你不努力一下我也没法尽兴呢
真的吗？那、那就没办法了呢！我也难得当一次姐姐吧！
那我这个前辈也不能给大家丢脸了呢。
纽卡斯尔，你回来了。见到其他人了吗？
大家一会就会集中到这边来了吧，到这条最终防线上……
那么，不知道姐姐意下如何呢？
当然没问题了。我也是女仆队的一员嘛
好吧，指挥官的部队也应该集结完毕了……
那就，让我们开始最后的抵抗吧。

战斗！皇家女仆队！

scripts.say: 港口
作战顺利结束，大家都回到了港区。
不愧是指挥官和女王陛下，真是出色的作战，是我们输了。
嗯哼，女仆组虽然输了，但是让整个舰队看到了我们皇家的风采。
做得很好，贝尔法斯特！
不胜惶恐。
然后，你呢，纽卡斯尔？
本王本来想说就拉你来当一时的帮手——
但是仔细想想，你还是在女仆队里更合适嘛！
原本，我觉得悠闲的生活可能更加适合我一点…
不过，像这样被陛下叫出来，见到了许多旧识，看到大家在这里过得这么开心…
让我的想法也稍微有些改变了呢~
纽卡斯尔露出了笑容。
能让大家过得这么开心的地方，我当然是愿意加入的，从今往后也请多多指教了。
太好了~
yeah~
不过唔唔，感觉又要多一个人管我了……
是最好的结果了呢
陛下，我有一个提议，今晚举行一场宴会吧。
作为作战成功的庆功宴，还有纽卡斯尔姐姐的欢迎仪式。
很好，就这么办吧！
遵命，那么，女仆组的各位，各自休整一下，三十分钟后，在厨房集合。
呵呵，接下来就是女仆该做的事了
那么，指挥官，我也先行告退了。
啊，对了，殿下和女仆队一直以来劳您费心了，从今往后，也要请您多多指教了~
就这样，演习顺利结束，舰队也迎来了新的伙伴，可喜可贺，可喜可贺
In a space engulfed by darkness, Friedrich der Große – blueprint ship, and the executor of Bismarck's will – sat and quietly mulled over the reports of her peers.
Since we secured Scapa Flow from the Royal Navy, none of the other factions have made any major moves.
Across the NA Ocean and in the Bermudas, we are cooperating in joint operations and research ventures as instructed.
From what circumstantial evidence we've gathered, the leaders of the other factions are still unaware of our purpose for doing so.
...This concludes my report. We will continue to "stand by."
The connection with Tirpitz was cut off, and another incoming call took its place on the display.
Friedrich der Große tapped the panel lightly––
It's U-47. Oh, yeah... About that Arbiter investigation... No progress yet.
I ran into one of their vessels, but we weren't able to squeeze any information out of it.
I'll keep doing what I can.
She listened to each report in absolute silence. None of them were worth a response.
She simply let the tides of information flow around her, drawing from them what she needed – just as Bismarck did.
The resources and combat forces required for the Tower of Midgard have already been shipped out.
The active camouflage is operational, and there are no signs of interference from enemies. These are the best possible work conditions.
That being the case, what is the judgment of this plan's chessmaster?
Start assembling your forces. I'll send your next instructions soon.
Understood.
She absorbed the information flowing around her, processed it, and issued commands that would lead to her desired outcomes. Exacting fidelity, like a maestro conducting a symphony.
But there was another maestro as well... the person advising her.
So, all the pieces are finally starting to fall into place. Are you sure you don't need me out there?
I cannot afford to waste a single point of our limited resources.
Should you fail, Bismarck's will would not be fully enacted.
Is that really such a big deal? ...It's not like everything would be for naught, right?
What do you think?
......Well, I'll trust in your plan.
I wonder if we can give our dear clients in the Sakura Empire a glimpse of the future.
I don't mind. However, just know that I cannot guarantee the stability of the transmission.
Of course. The fact that this IS a risky operation only makes me want to show off more.
Considering how important our findings are to them, I'm sure they won't complain even if we do run into some technical difficulties.
Exercise your best judgment.
Best of luck to you too. Signing off.
For a brief moment, a tinge of melancholy flashed across Friedrich's face. But almost as quickly as it had come, her lips curled into their usual smile as she connected her next call.
"Royal Navy" and "Northern Parliament." She reached for the panels bearing the insignias of the two factions.
––The Naval HQ's instructions were for the Crimson Axis and Azur Lane to remain at war.
As soon as Friedrich finished her conversations with the representatives of the other factions, she turned her attention to a new call that had unexpectedly cut in.
Thank you for your kind invitation, Friedrich der Große.
Marco Polo of Sardegna. You arrived earlier than planned.
So? Who cares if I'm a few minutes early or late? I'm also busy here, so let's not sweat the small details.
......Wait, so I really am too early?
Yes. And this channel is for emergency communications only.
Eh?! My, I'm terribly sorry for that!
Let's not sweat the small details.
Friedrich smiled wryly at the two panels that had been closed just moments before the Sardegnian ship's interjection. A narrowly averted disaster.
Anyway, I'm looking forward to seeing the results of your operation.
But you'd probably have to give me the details after the fact though. I can't really find the time to follow things as they unfold.
How unfortunate. I would've liked you to come witness it in person.
I appreciate the sentiment, but we've got our hands full with the Vichya right now.
I have little to offer you in support right now, but... may you take their power and spread the glory of Sardegna.
"As it stands, Sardegna seems to have their interests elsewhere and will not be participating in the operation."
Friedrich wrote a brief reminder for herself before directing her attention towards the final contact – the one in charge of carrying out the operation.
Only two panels remained to shed light across the dark space.
The time has finally come for the operation to be set into motion.
The stage has been set, and the actors are in place. All that remains is to lift the curtains.
Let us relish in the sights and sounds of the show to come––

sequence: The Iron Blood has given much to reverse engineer Siren technology.
Investigating Siren capabilities, conducting Reenactments. Usurping facilities, integrating their technologies into special armaments.
And finally, a "Singularity Deconstruction" expedition to shed light onto the mystery of the Sirens' very existence.
A project that was not possible at any point in the past due to technological limitations.

But at last, after an experiment conducted on a floating fortress, after contact with the Sakura Empire, and after a counter-offensive operation in the NA Ocean, the doorway into the realm of the impossible revealed a crack.
The Tower of Midgard, and the core of that project...
Bifröst, a bridge that connected the singular existence of this world to the Singularities of other dimensions.
Something that would elevate humanity's understanding of the Sirens.
The operation would test the things that the Iron Blood prided themselves in– their technology, their combat prowess...
And above all else––
Their audacity to transcend God.

1.say: Woo! Yeah! Watch 'em drop like flies!

2.say: That takes care of the last of them. We're in the clear now.

3.say: So, what the hell were those things? Couldn't have been cannonfire – shells don't fly like that.

4.say: But I can't think of anythin' else...

5.say: If I had to guess, they were long-range rockets or something similar.

6.say: Rockets... Rockets! That reminds me! Haven't our scientists developed a weapon that functions similar to a rocket?

7.say: Those have to be launched on land, though. I suppose there could be a small island not far from here...

8.say: I doubt it. If there was one, you would already have spotted it with your planes.

9.say: It's more likely that was the might of a META ship.

10.say: Uh-oh... I see two figures in the distance! They've got, uh, strange riggings!

11.say: Strange riggings? Who in the world could that be?

12.say: No clue! I'll just have to get a closer look!

13.say: Fingers crossed they won't start shooting at me...

14.say: "Strange riggings," she says... Might be what fired those shots.

15.say: We'll head there to investigate. Remember, don't fight unless you have to.

16.say: I am An Shan – Dragon Empery missile destroyer, pennant number 101. And this is my sister Chang Chun, number 103.

17.say: What are Dragon Empery destroyers doing in a Singularity?

18.say: And... what the hell is a missile?

19.say: Maybe it's what blew up that Siren fleet just earlier?

20.say: Greetings. I'm Ulrich von Hutten. I'm commanding the Iron Blood's Singularity survey fleet.

21.say: Oh, you're Iron Blood ships? Phew...

22.say: It's such a relief finding an ally in a Singularity as rife with Sirens as this. A happy coincidence indeed.

23.say: For a while there, I wasn't sure whose side you were on.

24.say: ...I do believe our respective factions are at war.

25.say: That is true, but that isn't what I meant. The fact is that we shipgirls are all allies in the war against the Sirens.

26.say: And us meeting here is just random chance – is that really what you're saying?

27.say: Yes, it's as simple as that. Coincidences do happen.

28.say: Yup. We're doing recon here as per the Commander's orders, and by dumb luck I guess we both opened portals to the same Singularity!

30.say: Oops. Me and my big mouth!

31.say: Ugh... Now might I ask: what are you doing in this Singularity?

34.say: Then my answer is the same.

36.say: I have a proposition. Why don't we put allegiances aside and work together for the time being?

37.say: Sadly, we cannot. We have our reasons, and they aren't... Well, they're not ALL to do with allegiances.

38.say: However, I will offer you a piece of advice...

39.say: You probably shouldn't use mass-produced ships in this place.

40.say: Why? Because a bigger fleet draws more attention?

41.say: Partly, yes, but mainly because bringing big mass-produced ships into a Singularity seems to trigger a reciprocal response from the Sirens. Keep that in mind.

42.say: The Dragon Empery girls waved farewell at the Iron Blood fleet, then swiftly sailed away.

43.say: Ulrich considered the option of following them, but decided not to out of trust for the Commander, and for her fellow shipgirls.

44.say: ...Man, those missile things they got are crazy stuff.

45.say: Here I thought they were some superweapon only the Sirens could use... I hope we'll be able to utilize those someday.

46.say: Soooo... How did the Dragon Empery figure out how to open a Singularity?

47.say: Who knows. Their technology differs from ours. I'm not going to make blind conjectures.

48.say: Who knows? Not the kind of phrase I was expecting out of you.

49.say: I can't construct a hypothesis without more information. It's as simple as that.

50.say: However, I can be sure their actions won't impede our progress. The Commander wouldn't allow that.

51.say: What do we do 'bout the mass-produced ships? Do as they said and dump 'em?

52.say: Moor them here. We will not scuttle a valuable asset.

53.say: They'll serve as a landmark for when it's time to leave.

54.say: All righty. What do we do now, then?

55.say: The same as before – we head for those wrecks Elbe sighted.

56.say: We cannot leave the Singularity empty-handed. We have to make some sort of discovery...

57.say: The Iron Blood fleet set sail once more, traveling in the direction opposite where the Dragon Empery girls went.

58.say: If we steer clear of those Dragon Empery girls, any traces of a recent battle we find should indicate a META shipgirl is nearby.

59.say: They anchored their fleet of mass-produced ships and left them behind.

60.say: However, they were hardly prepared for what they would encounter ahead–

scripts.say: Inside the Singularity
Hey, pretty sure a battle took place here recently.
Over here, over here! I was gonna have a look around but bumped into something special!
The hell's that? What's so interesting about a bunch of scrap metal?
Something's different about this thing! Not sure exactly what it is, but my gut wouldn't lie to me...
How do I know what your gut's telling you? Think harder, will ya?
That's right! This... reminds me of some kind of device! There might be a switch around here if you feel around a bit... Hrmm...
Hmm...?
Look, this might sound weird, but I know you can turn this thing on. Just not sure exactly how.
It looks just like all the other debris lying around, right? But it's clearly been modified...
I'm not seeing a button anywhere, but I know it has to turn on somehow!
I see, that makes perfect sense. You spent too much time with Ulrich and totally lost your marbles.
Yeah! Wait, no! It's way more obvious seeing it underwater! It's no ordinary wreckage! It's some sort of device!
You say that like we can just take our riggings off and follow you...
Oh, I know! Elbe, are you seeing anything from the air?
Huh? It's just wreckage as far as the eye can see from up here.
And plus, there's like smoke all over the place from the previous battle. If I try to fly my planes any higher, that's all I'd see.
(This may be a Siren domain, but the feeling I'm getting is much more visceral...)
(The stench of endless destruction and decay lingers here, as if this place isn't meant for the living.)
(A fundamental rejection of shipgirls... No, all living things. That is what it feels like to me.)
(This is a place that all would do well to avoid.)
...Is this place a graveyard, or an empty void?
Yo, Ulrich, there's something weird over here too.
Ugh, how ugly... Is this even a ship? It looks more like some sort of monster...
Ulrich grimly continued her task of surveying the destruction around her.
I, I found something!
There's probably still a battle going on around here! Just look at all the fresh wreckage!
Right-o! Over here, everyone! Wait, what the heck, is there even more rubble and debris than before?
Of course! That's the proof that we're getting closer to the middle of the action!
Think we'll run into an actual monster?
Th-there's no such thing as monsters!
Then what is it, Elbe?
Well, whatever it is, it's not showing up on my radars, it's fighting against the Sirens, and it's freakin' powerful!
That can only mean one thing...
META is here...
The Iron Blood fleet followed the trail of charred mass-produced Siren husks. Their broken forms were piled into something resembling a grotesque shrine of twisted metal.
It was clear that whoever did this... had done so recently.
The shrine was almost like a dark invitation... from a fateful host that the Iron Blood ships had never met before.
Hmm... Do you think this was done by one of the Ashes...?
This place is giving me the creeps. I feel like I'm being watched...
I feel it too... It doesn't seem hostile so far, but it's definitely sizing us up!
Wait, is that... Gneisenau?!
She does look like her... but she's giving off a completely different vibe!
So that's one of the "META" we've been hearing so much about.
From looks alone, she seems to be Iron Blood. But just as Elbe said, the similarities end there.
According to our intel, the Ashes prefer to avoid contact. If that's the case, then our chance of convincing her to join our cause is...
Well, how do you propose we start to make our case?
By waiting. We don't know if she can be reasoned with just yet... Let me handle this.
Ulrich, what do you plan on doing?
Ulrich von Hutten instructed the fleet to prepare for battle. She then fired up her engines and carefully made her way towards the META.
Unusual. A Pawn that doesn't attack like a mindless beast.
I'm no pawn. I'm a shipgirl, just like you.
Impossible. There's no way for a shipgirl to enter this place.
Yes, it should be impossible. But the Iron Blood made it a reality.
Reality, huh. This dying, burnt-out world is my only reality.
...I want to be clear here. We do not want to fight you.
Quite the opposite. Our benefactor, Friedrich der Große, wishes for you to take up arms for the Iron Blood once more.
The Iron Blood, huh... Hollow, meaningless words.
I have always been here fighting. Forever, for all of time.
Subordinates. Superiors. Companions. Even the Iron Blood. Even when they all ceased to be, I still continued to fight.
For what, if not the Iron Blood?
We are not so presumptuous as to pry into your past. However––
Silence. The Iron Blood I know has nobody with your name, or this "Friedrich der Große."
I have no data to prove that you aren't just a shadow created by the Sirens.
Even if you really are from this "Iron Blood" that you speak of, my battle does not end.
Yes, it will continue forever, for all of time.
This world has ended. Whatever you are looking for, you will not find it here.
And I will continue to be its warden forevermore. Call me a fool. Call me mad. Call me a lost soul. It matters not to me.
Now begone!
...How about we cool it and talk things through.
While avoiding the bombardment from the META ship, Gneisenau, Ulrich racked her brain for answers.
(Her powers are immense, but nothing beyond what we predicted.)
Even though the Iron Blood fleet was outgunned, they continued to establish a positional advantage using their superior numbers.
(But, our objective here is not to subdue the META ship, much less sink her.)
(In the first place, it seems inconceivable that a META ship would be able to be subdued through numbers alone...)
Ulrich once again focused her attention on observing Gneisenau's movements.
Or rather, the lack thereof. While Gneisenau's firepower was indeed formidable, she made little effort to avoid incoming shells, hardly moving from her spot.
(Is she... injured?)
(If so, that would explain why she doesn't match up to the caliber of the "META" ships mentioned in the briefings...)
(She also mentioned that she knows the Iron Blood, but has never heard of me or Friedrich.)
(In that case, it is useless to mention the specific circumstances around our particular Iron Blood, and the same applies to the subject of the Commander.)
(.........But, I happen to be in a betting mood today.)
With determination flaring in her eyes, Ulrich called off the attack and relayed her instructions to the rest of the fleet.
This is Ulrich. Lower your weapons and pull back to a safe distance.
Once again, lower your weapons and pull back to a safe distance. You've done enough here.
Huh? Wait, why?!
Ulrich, you can't be serious... You're going to fight the META alone?
I know I haven't been able to help much at this range, but still...!
Heyyyy, Ulrich! What's going on? Care for an explanation?
Her sudden instructions left her companions flabbergasted, but no instructions would follow. Ulrich simply continued to mutter to herself calmly as if nothing had happened.
Leave the two of us alone... Just me and that META.
...We've got a lot of things to talk about.
What's the meaning of this?
Seeing the rest of the Iron Blood fleet retreat out of firing range, Gneisenau also lowered her weapons and turned to face the approaching Ulrich.
Both ships were still on their guard, but the smell of blood and iron in the air seemed to thin out somewhat.
I already told you. My subordinates, my superiors, my companions. They're all gone.
If it's a duel you want, you can continue with your attack as before.
There is little point to crushing you alone, but if that is what you want, so be it––
That's not why I'm here.
Then why are you here? What could you possibly gain by talking to a crazed weapon of war?
You're mistaken. You're not mad.
And you... You're no different. KAN-SEN are nothing more than weapons of war, and you too will become–
...Shut up.
Read this. I may be a stranger to you, but you must recognize the person who wrote this.
Ulrich reached inside her coat and produced a roll of paper with an ornate wax seal. She handed it to Gneisenau.
...Are those your written orders?
Didn't you hear me? I've never heard of this "Friedrich" you spoke of.
What are you trying to prove? As far as I'm concerned, this is just a slip of paper with meaningless words written on it.
Shut up and just read it. Friedrich didn't write this – it was someone who you'll recognize.
You... You mean...?
Gneisenau, for the first time, showed a lapse in her cold exterior. Ulrich immediately knew that she had won her wager.
Our circumstances may differ, but if you remember what you felt for your allies, you should understand what I'm trying to tell you.
META ships come from other worlds. Therefore we cannot judge them through the lens of our own world.
One thing is clear, though – they are not our enemy. Some may not act logically for one reason or another, but they are all shipgirls, like us.
They share our humanity, they have people near and dear to them. Or at the very least, they did at one point.
Gneisenau's gaze reached the final paragraph. When she read it, her expression changed dramatically.
B-Bis... Bismarck...
That name – one she had spoken countless times before – brought back something from the depths of her mind.
Her emotions had been fragmented across countless aeons of combat. But that name alone pulled those shards back together, piece by piece.
She remembered her leader's conviction, her loneliness, the pain of being forever separated from her. Then she remembered her times with all her other Iron Blood compatriots.
Then the day she knew she'd never see them again. The day they vanished forever. The day she became the only one left.
The cold, hard reality she was forced to confront. The eternal punishment she'd been sentenced to.
Bismarck's sin was trying to lead the Iron Blood into a better future... A sin she was punished for...
If there exists a past different from the one you know, then a different future must exist as well.
Whether it will be your salvation, or a slow decline ending in death, I cannot say.
Gneisenau fell silent and obsessively read and reread the words on the paper.
It's Bismarck's handwriting... But... That's impossible... Based on what I saw... Based on my calculations...
No... There's no way... She can't have done this!
She... She used it... She used the Cube to...!
Regardless of what your Bismarck did, I know for a fact our Bismarck made her choice and fought in the name of Iron Blood.
That is what I wanted you to know.
She may not be the Bismarck you're familiar with, but she would still see you as her ally.
You understand the hefty price she paid for using the Black Cube's power, don't you?
I do. I've seen what happened to her. That's why Friedrich took over for her.
Once more, the handwritten letter brought back memories of those Gneisenau held dear.
Images flashed before her eyes – images of the Iron Blood's flag, of friends new and old, of their self-respecting leader, and of a person trying to bring all factions together.
The Bismarck of this world, though not exactly the same, is still the Bismarck she knew – and she's reaching out to Gneisenau.
This does not signify the end of her ceaseless war, but it does signify something else...
I thought I'd never fight for the Iron Blood again...
But now... Bismarck, I... I'm just so...
...Say no more. Welcome back, Gneisenau.
You... You do know the way out of here, I presume?
Yes. The Singularity's exit is still open.
...Will you let me see Bismarck?
Of course I will. How could I turn down a friend?
But, as you know, the situation back home isn't great. We can't show any signs of weakness to Naval HQ.
I'm aware, and I understand.
Good. Then come with us and we'll take you back to our world.
I hate to ask you to fight, given your injuries, but we'll need your help. The Sirens here are too much for our mass-produced ships.
Heheh. Remember, I am still one of the Ugly Sisters – a few scratches won't hamper my ability to fight.
That's the spirit. I suppose it's us who'll have to keep up with you.
Listen up, team! We're heading back, bringing with us a new ally and the path to a new future!
The Iron Blood fleet set sail once again, this time for their point of origin – the Tower.
Inside the Singularity
So we're done here, then? Time to head back where we came from?
Yup. We just finished the hard part of the mission, so.
Thank effin' god. Feels like we got lucky, but I'm not complainin'.
A pile of wrecks leading to us making a new ally... What a crazy yet wonderful turn of events.
And in only half the time before the deadline, too!
Now all that's left is a leisurely cruise back to the Tower... is what I'd like to say, but it won't be so leisurely.
Mhm. Gneisenau's hurt, so we've gotta get her out of here fast!
You said it. First we have to travel back to our mass-produced fleet, and then we head straight for the exit.
I wonder if this is really a good idea...
What is? Going back? I mean, what else is there to do?
No, not that! I'm talking about Gneisenau!
U-1206 threw an uneasy look over at Ulrich and Gneisenau, who were at the very end of the formation.
Ulrich said it's okay, so I'd just take her word for it.
It doesn't seem fishy to you? She was cold to us the whole time, then did a 180 and went "Yeah, I'll join you, sure!"
Yeah, I know Ulrich said she needs to sort out her feelings and all, but still.
It's a bit strange, but not to the extent I feel it's worth bringing up, I guess.
Besides, I doubt we'd get an answer if we did ask. She'd probably tell us to mind our own biz. Then again, it can't hurt to ask.
Hmm... Might be best not to ask... Wait, I just figured it out!
Figured what out?
The reason she joined us! Ulrich figured out her weakness!
Ohh! That seems plausible.
Something like... "If you don't want the whole world knowing your secret, you'd better come with us."
Whatever that weakness is, I hope it's not a crippling flaw, since she'll be working with us now...
It's GOT to be a crippling flaw if she got a META ship to obey her!
Ya really think Ulrich's such a good judge of character she can figure out someone's weakness within minutes of meeting them?
Uhh... I mean... META or not, she's still Gneisenau, so maybe her weakness is the same as hers?
Actually, does our world's Gneisenau even have a crippling weakness?
Welp, scratch that explanation then.
Ulrich, I would advise you to stay on your toes.
Why? Is something the matter?
It's just... I have a bad feeling about this place.
How come? My recon planes don't see anything out of the ordinary.
Look closer and you'll see what I mean.
Bring your planes down a bit, Elbe... Are you talking about those shipwrecks, Gneisenau?
Yes, it's those. I didn't sink these ships.
And they're not the same ones we passed by earlier...
That means none of us are responsible for destroying those Sirens...
You don't remember seein' anyone else come through here?
Well... I don't like thinking much about it.
I've fought in these waters, all alone, for what feels like an eternity. You are the only people I've seen in a long time.
Only us? You didn't see a Dragon Empery fleet?
No, I can't say I have.
If they came here at nearly the same time as you, we might have simply gone around each other.
All because they went in the opposite direction. Imagine that.
In any event, I speak the truth when I say you are the first people I've run into.
Furthermore, those Dragon Empery girls couldn't have left wrecks looking like this either if they use those "missiles" you mentioned just earlier.
Right, right! There must be somebody else here other than us!
They're not showing up on the radar either, and by the looks of things, they must be pretty close to us!
Another META...?
This Singularity appears to be quite lively today.
Seems so. Your presence here might've attracted them.
Huh...? Isn't that Scharnhorst?!
One of your friends?
No, she's not the one I remember... The Iron Blood I knew is long gone.
...Right. Forgive me.
Well, whoever she is, she's headed this way!
If she's in the mood to talk, that works in our favor. Let's go meet her.
Another Scharnhorst emerged from the horizon, approaching the area the Iron Blood fleet was anchored.
As with Gneisenau, Ulrich once again ordered the rest of the fleet to stand guard from a safe distance, approaching the figure alone.
I am Ulrich von Hutten, from the Iron Blood's Singularity Expedition Fleet. State your name and affiliation.
Scharnhorst... But you can call me whatever you want.
...Scharnhorst is just fine then. Allow me to ask, why have you approached us?
To caution you. You're travelling with something dangerous.
If you came to talk, point your guns away from me first.
Very well.
I shall be the first to state our intentions then. On behalf of the Iron Blood, I would like to welcome you into our fleet as one of our partners.
I appreciate the sentiment, but no thank you.
I have my own "partners" now, and I do not intend on betraying them.
...The Ashes, huh? So, what are you here for?
Ulrich von Hutten, I would have you release my "sister," Gneisenau.
...She told us she doesn't know "you."
Is that so? How much do you know about her then, considering you only just met?
It doesn't matter who knows her better. What matters is that she chose to stand with us.
...How foolish. Do you have any idea what disasters you're inviting upon yourselves?
We appreciate your concern, but we shall judge for ourselves how "dangerous" she is.
Only with the Ashes can she learn to control her powers. She belongs with us.
...And what if I refuse?
I would love to demonstrate to you the difference in our abilities, but I don't have the time for that.
Time, huh... That makes two of us.
Let me meet "Gneisenau." Tell me what your terms are.
Let's not make this more painful than it needs be.
If you just want to talk, then no other terms are necessary... As long as I have your word that you will not harm us or our friends.
...Accepted. You have my assurance that I will not harm Gneisenau or your ships.
Depending on her answer, I might also tell you about "time."
Very well. Then let us see whose argument is more persuasive to her. We did not coerce her, and we expect you to uphold that as well.
Fine. I'll agree to those terms.
Let's go then.
Come to the Ashes with me, Gneisenau.
(When's the last time others have shown so much interest in me...?)
(A desperate operation to buy more time... Allies who threw themselves into the line of enemy fire... But, why would they step foot into this endless battlefield?)
(The KAN-SEN's "Metamorphosis." When the Cube corrupts the Hull... the erratic emotions caused by the withdrawal symptoms of cognitive awakening...)
(The day I lost Scharnhorst, my own sister, right in front of my eyes... I had to kill my own heart to continue fighting––)
Who... are you?
Scharnhorst, former Iron Blood battlecruiser, now a member of the Ashes.
You may look like her, but you are not the "Scharnhorst" I know.
The same applies to all the other ships from different branches. You may not know any of them.
Gneisenau, there is nothing for you to be loyal to. All that remains are illusions of the past.
...I don't want to hear those words from your lips...
I... Even if they are just illusions, I will continue to chase after them. I will continue to fight, forever...
Just when it seemed that the two "sisters" were about to reach an impasse in their discussion, new signals suddenly appeared on the radar.
Wait, are all of those Siren signals, even though we've been trying to cover our tracks?! We're going to be surrounded from all sides!
And there are new Siren types I've never seen before...! Ulrich, should we move to intercept them?
Hold. Don't panic. Can you identify the enemy command unit?
No clue! But I am seeing humanoid Sirens, so maybe if we can defeat them...
Seems like things are getting pretty heated on your end too.
Unsurprising. The Sirens are hostile to the METAs as well.
Are those two arguing with each other? Should I try to break 'em up?
Doesn't matter what the circumstances are. If the enemy is coming, we stand and fight.
And we'll use whatever we have at our disposal. Friend, foe, or META.
KABOOM––––––!!
Damn, they're here already... We've wasted too much time.
They're approaching from all directions. They're trying to surround us.
So what will you do? Fight with your new friends from another branch?
Yes. There's someone I must meet.
You won't be able to handle that many Sirens in your current state.
Nonsense. I am META. I have faced enemies of that magnitude time and time again––
Until now. But underestimate them at your own peril.
Do you recognize that humanoid enemy?
I don't remember the faces of scrap metal.
...Don't be too hasty now. That's an Enforcer, one who carries out the will of the high-ranking Arbiters.
The fact that an Enforcer is here means that the Arbiters have their eyes on this place.
That means nothing to me. But I suppose those are the names of the enemies I have to defeat...?
Yes. You may feel confident in your abilities because you've defeated so many mass-produced ships.
But you have yet to see the true terrors of the Sirens. You are not prepared for them.
Many more lie in wait. You would do well to remain cautious.
You've changed... Scharnhorst.
Yes. And you must change too, Gneisenau.
.........Are you done? I... must support my new allies.
Do as you will. I will see you at the end.
I would've liked to hear your bluster and bravado one more time... Scharnhorst.
Casting one last glance back at what she had lost, Gneisenau resumed her engines and turned towards her new allies.
Scharnhorst's unmoving figure became fainter, dimmer... until it finally disappeared like a wisp beyond the horizon.
Operation Area - Morning
The sun rose over the horizon and cast its light on an enormous Iron Blood fleet.
Their numbers were truly staggering, as if every Iron Blood ship in existence was partaking in this massive operation.
Across the sea from them, situated in the middle of the ocean, a group of structures stood arranged into the shape of a ring.
That's the Tower of Midgard, huh? I'm frankly astonished they managed to complete it this fast.
And man, it's a marvel to behold! Now our job's to get in there and wreak some havoc.
Resurfacing! Steer clear!
U-1206, having just finished a patrol of the area, emerged from the sea. She gazed on inquisitively at the structure in the distance.
No enemies in the area! Let's keep our fingers crossed and hope it stays that way!
Well, if anyone foolish enough comes along to challenge us, they're in for the beating of a lifetime.
Heh, yeah. It'd be suicide tryin' to stop us now.
It looks like everyone's here. Good. I'm Peter Strasser. I'll be overseeing the Towers for this operation.
Ah, Strasser! Always right on time!
Your team never ceases to amaze. First you built the flying fortress, and now this!
Anyone can accomplish great feats if they don't fall for distractions and just focus on their job.
Now, you should know a few things before you enter the Singularity. I'll be brief.
What you see before you is the Tower of Midgard. Let us not waste time pointing out how it does not resemble a tower.
You sayin' these structures collectively make up the Tower of Midgard?
Correct. They were first built inside the flying fortress, then assembled on-site here.
Of course, these "building blocks" on their own are each already the size of a small island.
But transporting them was not difficult. We have the Sirens' tech to thank for that.
Now that you mention it, those structures do resemble the flying fortress a bit.
Correct. They're essentially derived from the same technology.
We're able to conceal them using an active camouflage system to ensure neither Naval HQ nor the other factions find out about them.
This same system can also be used to create hologram fleets, like in our last Reenactment with the Royal Navy. Quite nifty, I'll say.
Now... Your group will spearhead the attack on the Singularity. Ulrich will be your leader. Ulrich?
...Ulrich, that's your cue.
Ugh...
Ah. Thank you for gracing us with... some sort of response.
Yeah, yeah. Sorry for not being very chatty.
Let's just say the Tower has me speechless. Starstruck.
Anyway... I'm Ulrich von Hutten. I'll serve as your field commander for this operation.
Excellent. One minute while I grant you access to the Tower's systems and control over the mass-produced ships.
Thanks. Just one question: after the Tower is activated, will we be able to create hologram fleets and the like?
Well, there's no guaranteeing you'll be able.
So it's not a no. Good enough.
More or less. Creating a Singularity takes immense amounts of energy. It's unlikely we'll have much left to spare for creating holograms.
Got it. We'll just have to see for ourselves what we can do once we're inside.
That about does it for the briefing. See you on the other side.
Sending you coordinates for the anchor point right now. Strasser out.
KABOOM–––––!!
Good thing we had data on these new Sirens. Having to go into a fight blind royally sucks.
I never thought our leftover mass-produced ships would come in handy like that. Sorry, homies!
Anyway, it's freakin' annoying how the Sirens keep powering up each time!
I landed a clean shot, didn't I? But it's just like nothing happened at all...
Are you sure about that? It looks to me like you missed.
Huh? You're just messing with me, aren't you? You're the one who completely whiffed...
We're not actually thinning out the enemies at all! You two need to take this seriously already!
I am! And that last attack totally hit!
We seem to be dealing with some sort of optical illusion. Elbe, did it look like my shots just now landed?
Nope. Some looked pretty close, but none of them actually hit their marks.
I thought as much. From our vantage point, it looks like all our attacks should be hitting.
Well, that's not much of a big deal. They can't dodge us if we go in for a good hand-to-hand beatdown.
Even I'm not down for something like that...
Ready or not, here I–– Woooah...?!
Adalbert! Watch out below you!
Thanks to U-1206's timely warning, Prinz Adalbert barely managed to evade an attack from a Siren submarine.
Phew, thanks for the heads up!
Submarines too...?
They're really trying to pin us in from all directions!
They keep diving too whenever I try to dive to track them down! There's no way to tell exactly how many enemies we're dealing with!
Ulrich continued to lead the increasingly desperate defense against the Siren onslaught when suddenly, a barrage of cannonfire erupted from behind to pummel the advancing enemies.
This must be... Gneisenau's supporting fire!
But Scharnhorst decided not to come with her after all, huh...
The threads of diplomacy are tenuous here. Things will take time to fall into place.
Besides, Scharnhorst's aid isn't necessary for us to mop up the Sirens here.
...Ulrich! The enemies are shifting their attention towards Gneisenau!
The groaning of metal echoed through the air as the Siren ships directed their bows at Gneisenau.
All the underwater enemies are surfacing as well!
The enemies that were staying behind are advancing as well! They're really trying to overwhelm us with numbers!
Is this some kind of joke?! I'm seeing more humanoid-type Sirens than mass-produced ones!
The supporting fire continued to tear through the Sirens' ranks.
...However, the Sirens continued to push forward, each ship pushing past its fallen allies in a cold, impassive march towards Gneisenau.
The enemies surged forth like a shadowy wave collapsing in from all directions, threatening to engulf the "island" of wreckage atop which Gneisenau stood.
We can't push them back quickly enough! Gneisenau's going to get overrun at this rate!
Ulrich, we need to group back up with Gneisenau right now!
Yeah, beating up on Sirens is fine and all, but gotta keep our eyes on the prize!
Besides, what's up with those creepy Sirens? We've been fighting against them for so long, but I'm getting chills just from looking at whatever those things are...
Those enemies are the Enforcers of Arbiter VI.
We Ashes are far more accustomed to fighting them than you. I shall hold them back here.
I am not done negotiating with Gneisenau just yet, and I don't plan on letting her fall to the Sirens.
Join with Gneisenau, and defeat the Enforcers through maneuver warfare!
Now, tremble before our Ashen might!
You two really know how to win hearts and minds... Both you, and the other Scharnhorst.
Only a few hours remain until the Singularity maintenance limit––
Thanks to Scharnhorst's covering fire, the Iron Blood fleet managed to restore their formation and somehow hold back the Siren onslaught.
The combination of Iron Blood sensors and META firepower was able to sink Siren after Siren with remarkable efficiency.
After just short of 20 minutes of fighting, it was clear who was the victor.
Geesh, METAs really are true veterans of combat...
The Sirens are falling back!
I'm fine with letting them go... But you don't suppose they'll be back for another round, right?!
All ships, damage report, now.
Just a few bruises. Still got ammo left, too. Gneisenau's not looking too hot, though...
I'm fine. Don't worry about me.
But we should and will worry about you. You're our ally now – a part of the fleet.
Very well. As long as you don't try to coerce me to use more emotional language, I don't mind that.
Of course not. I know you tend to be very analytical by nature.
Thank you. I'll try to work on it, but old habits die hard.
Take your time. Also, Scharnhorst, thanks for the covering fire.
Yeah. As I told Gneisenau earlier, the Sirens are even stronger than you can imagine.
...That is true. They always have new surprises for us.
Those Enforcers might seem tough, but they're just grunts. And the Arbiters? They're not even their real leaders.
Even at your best, you don't stand the shadow of a chance against them.
...Neither did we. We were all so weak, and we couldn't protect those close to us, nor get away from our true enemy.
It's only after losing everything we had that we were able to realize our own full potential.
I'll say this again, Gneisenau – join the Ashes. You'll learn not only how to use your powers, but also how to get vengeance for what you lost.
(Vengeance? Is retribution the only thing that motivates the Ashes? Surely not. Unless she means...)
You seek revenge, and you'll get it by defeating the Sirens, am I right?
...Don't run your mouth if you don't know a damn thing. The Sirens aren't just some pest you can exterminate.
It was a genuine question. You lost the battle with the Sirens in your world. All of the Ashes did. Did you not vow to take vengeance on them?
Then would you explain what your goals are? As it stands, I simply don't understand why you're doing this.
We're at war with the Sirens back in our world too. I'm sure you're already aware of that.
Our motives may differ, but aren't both our goals ultimately one and the same? To bring an end to the Sirens?
We believe Gneisenau can help us in our war against the Sirens. She could help liberate our world from the Siren menace.
In the end, what she wants to do is her decision, and I'll respect it. But, if you insist on having her join you instead, I expect you to tell us what your goals are.
...It's clear you know nothing about us.
That's because we've had fairly few encounters with you thus far.
We have met Enterprise, Takao, and Ark Royal, but I've yet to find any rhyme or reason to your actions based on what they said.
And from our point of view, the Singularities you create aren't much less disruptive than the Mirror Seas that Sirens create.
Despite that, however... The Commander and the Iron Blood still see you as allies, and would welcome you to join us.
Scharnhorst was silent for a moment, as if in surprise at Ulrich's last few words.
That's terribly bold of you. You do know the implications of what you're saying, right?
You'll pay a steep price for your arrogance one day.
I'll gladly pay it when the day comes. The Iron Blood and my allies are worth more than my own life.
...Listen. The Ashes' goal isn't to eradicate the Sirens themselves.
It's their mastermind who we want. The one that oversees all the world branches. Observer Zero.
She is the one orchestrating their plan, warping the pasts of different timelines, experimenting on entire worlds.
It's impossible to quantify the misery and suffering she has brought about in her search for "perfection."
Our lives are worth less than nothing to her. She brought all our worlds to extinction without a second thought.
And that's why we've been jumping between worlds, searching all this time.
Searching for what? A way to stop or disrupt the Sirens' plan?
"For who?" is the question. The answer is the two people who created the Sirens' plan – the Creator, and the Magister.
I see. The "Creator" of the Sirens, and the "Magister" who weighs the fate of worlds. Will your battle end when you find them?
The thing is, it's impossible. We've reverse-engineered their branch-jumping technology and explored countless pasts, only to find despair.
The Creator and the Magister don't exist in any of the pasts we can travel to.
Maybe they're in a past inaccessible to us, or they're in a future we can't get reach with Siren tech... Whatever the case, we're at an impasse.
Until we find a solution, the best we can do is fight off the Sirens and try to save other branches from a desolate future.
If a world has already fallen, we invite the survivors to join us, giving them new purpose and bolstering our ranks.
Now I understand your motives better.
But then why do you come to our world? There's nobody there for you to recruit.
...Because you have the Commander.
That confirms my suspicion... The Commander is an exceedingly special person to you Ashes.
You had an opportunity to collapse the Winter's Crown. But... Enterprise held back out of concern for the Commander.
Nonsense. Someone had already gotten to the world fragments buried there––
But don't push your luck. I've said all I'm going to.
Very well. I never expected you to divulge absolutely everything to begin with.
They haven't said a word for a while now...
But the look in Scharnhorst's eyes makes me think she's said more than she should have.
(Knowing her, she accidentally told Ulrich something specific about the Ashes.)
(She may try to act cool and composed, but at the end of the day, she's still Scharnhorst.)
She's not gonna like, attack us outta the blue, is she?
Probably won't, since you're here, but I think ya shoulda just given her a hard "no" earlier when you could.
When push comes to shove, we'll just shove back, if that's what she wants.
But I don't wanna fight her...
Why not? Are you afraid?
Yes, I'm afraid!
Not because she's super powerful, but I'm afraid of hurting someone who could've been an ally...
(Ah, right. They aren't yet numb to the feeling of fighting.)
(They haven't felt the despair of fighting an endless, futile war...)
We'll be fine. Worst-case scenario we can always just run away.
Run away, you say... Hmm...
Scharnhorst META and the Iron Blood fleet were locked in a staredown, neither side uttering a word.
That is, until a call from one of Scharnhorst's allies broke the silence.
Time is running out. How did it go?
Sorry, I'm a bit behind schedule.
Because of the Singularity energy fluctuations we detected earlier?
Yeah. An Iron Blood fleet from one of the branches created a way into the Singularity and reached Gneisenau before me.
What? They created their own entrance?
Mhm. It's the branch with the Commander. I... I told them about the Crown by mistake.
Forgive me. I can sink them all if you need me to.
No need to. They would've found out about it sooner or later.
As for Gneisenau, it's up to her whether she joins us or not. Whatever her decision, respect it.
Lastly, beware that The Lovers knows you're there. Get out of there before things take a turn for the worse.
...Roger.
Scharnhorst hung up, then ground to a halt and lowered her weapons.
Had a change of heart, Scharnhorst?
Not quite. An Arbiter vessel has appeared. We should both leave this place at once.
So that's what you meant when you said we "have no time."
Yep. I tried to warn you.
I see. Not even the Ashes want to stick around to challenge an Arbiter.
Hell no. And of all the Arbiters, I've heard The Lovers is a particularly big pain in the ass.
Is she, now? Then she should be a goldmine of intel.
What?! Have you lost your goddamned mind?!
One of our goals with this mission is to gather intel inside the Singularity. This is the perfect opportunity to do so.
I know what you're thinking. We're not going to throw ourselves blindly at her.
I've read about how vicious Arbiter vessels are. The Commander's warned us about how they should be treated with utmost caution.
We're prepared for this. Furthermore, we're not far from our escape route.
The conditions are ideal for it, eh...
Furthermore, your Ashes stealth camouflage may be excellent for sneaking by us, but it's little use against Sirens, particularly Arbiters.
That is true. Jumping to another branch also takes time, and I can't bet on reinforcements either.
Precisely. And if nothing else, you can use our plan as a diversion to buy yourself some time.
All you must do is lure the Arbiter close to the Singularity's exit. Then we can easily call for reinforcements, or flee back to our world as a last resort.
We have a huge fleet waiting just past that portal. If the Arbiter insisted on pursuing us, it'd be the last thing she does.
Like leading a mouse into a trap... The problem is, there's no way Enterprise would agree to this idea of yours.
Sell her on it, then. You're the one who has to fight, not her.
That's so easy for you to say...
If she disapproves of it, that's her problem, not mine.
Fine. But there's no guarantee this is going to work.
I'm aware. In any case, we'll wait at the exit for as long as we can.
Very well. Then this is where we go our separate ways. Either we'll see each other again soon... or this is farewell forever.
Inside the Singularity - Near the Tower
I've got a message from Peter! She wants us to decide whether we want the reserve team to back us up or not!
Got it. Thanks for coming to the Singularity with us.
Not a problem at all! It's my job.
I'm heeeeeere! And now I'm there!
