This is the story of a resonating passion and an anthem of hope—

scripts.say: One day, in the waters around the port...
The situation looks pretty bad from the air, huh?
Yes. The ship that passed through here is being attacked by a "hologram."
Damnit, why now of all times...?!
Why indeed. It can't be pure coincidence that this incident occurred just before the concert was slated to begin.
So, what are our options? Contacting Akagi's group is a given, but there has to be something we can do here...
I shall not allow anything to interfere with my Master's concert. We'll make our stand here—
Sheffy, what the heck is that? Wait, are you kidding me?!
Guh...! Emergency retreat, quickly!
Port - Temporary Office, at approximately the same time
The idols who arrived at our base are none other than... these girls, nya!
Y-yes! I'm Haruka Amami, an idol from 765 Production! Pleased to meet you!
Saaaame! By the way, the name's Mami Futami!
And I'm Ami Futami! Nice to meetcha~!
Wait, you're already giving formal introductions? My goodness!
Seriously! Akashi, what are you making them say?
Now, now, there's nothing wrong with some common courtesy. Let's not get panicked here...
Azusa's right. Panicking won't do us any good, so we should try to get a grasp of the situation first.
First of all, we should get to know each other. Right?
Agreed. Imagine my surprise when such a big, happy family showed up out of nowhere~
Indeed... Though this wouldn't be the first time something like this has happened...
This is the home port of Azur Lane, and I'm Z23, a shipgirl.
Am I correct in assuming that all of you are idols from 765 Production?
That you are. My name is Chihaya Kisaragi.
And these are my colleagues, Iori, Asuza, and Ritsuko. We're all from the same agency.
Before I ended up here, I was just taking some photos to use as film references when suddenly~ Bam! My vision went white!
Then we found ourselves here. Or something like that.
I see. Unfortunately, Commander isn't here right now... Wait, actually, maybe it's fortunate that Commander isn't here yet...
Sis... Err, I mean, Akagi, what's gotten into you?
Why, nothing at all! Akashi, did you notice anything unusual when these ladies showed up?
Unusual? What do you mean, nya?
A sudden energy fluctuation. It's happened before, right?
Oh, nyow that you mentioned it! Um, you see, I was just so excited about the new office...
There was a little blip in the energy readings, nya... and it was getting weaker and weaker...
Oh, it's gone, nya.
Excuse me, but, what does that mean?
There have been occurrences of people suddenly "appearing" here before, and it's usually accompanied by a large energy reaction.
It sometimes lets us see where you came from, and by taking advantage of it, we might be able to send you back home.
Well, that doesn't seem to be the case this time.
Before you say that, you might want to come over here first.
Oh, it's my dear sister~
They've sure made a mess out of this "Concert Sea Area."
Port - Wharf
Oh, please leave that box in the temporary office instead of on the deck. Also, be careful, because it's fragile.
Roger that!
Yes, ma'am!
The equipment checklist is looking pretty good... So far, we've been staying right on schedule.
It's all thanks to you, Z23! Your diligent planning has been keeping everyone on track!
No, no... I don't have any experience with management, but the tips you've given me have been a great help.
Woaaaahh! I can't see in front of me!! Help me, Mami... Eek!
Ahaha... Looks like we're going to have to help each other out a whole lot.
Azusa, do you prefer sweet or spicy?
Hmm, let's see... To be honest, I'm not too good with spicy food, but I'm sure there are plenty of people who are fine with it...
I wonder which we should go with...
By the way, Akagi, do you cook often?
Not particularly. However, I must say that it's more enjoyable cooking for others.
My, my~ I'm sure you'll make a wonderful bride, Akagi~
Hwuh...?!
Hum hum~♪
Lady Chihaya, Lady Iori has invited you to a tea party.
A what? Tea party...?
Indeed. Lady Iori is having a tea party with Her Majesty and would like you to join her.
I see. Um, is it really fine for me to show up in an outfit like this?
You needn't worry about that. There is one thing I'd like to apologize for, however.
What's the matter...?
For Lady Chihaya, a tea party is a frivolous matter compared to the importance of your practice.
For this, I apologize for demanding your time.
It's not a big deal, really... If anything, thank you for inviting me. Spending time with friends is just as important to me.
I must say, I did not expect to find fellow enjoyers of Royal Navy tea from another world.
Well, I suppose I am a rather well-traveled idol.
Hehe. If only that lousy servant of mine was as discerning as you~♪
Servant?
Of course. My servant is my servant.
Uh, I see. F-forget I asked...
Harukaaaa! Let's go down to the festival tonight!
Huh? Festival?
Yup, we hold a festival right here in port about this time every summer. There's gonna be a ton of fun things to do!
Laffey... is already in festival mode.
Woah... Summer festivals are a thing in this world too? Sounds awesome~♪ Can I let the others know as well so we can all go?
Of course! We'd love to have all of you!
Port - Concert Sea Area
This is the moment we've been preparing for... Kaga, how goes the monitoring?
The energy signatures are abnormal, but at least stable.
Mhm, mhm... Yeah, I totally get it! So, uh... we basically just rush right on in and get on-stage!
Blow up any mass-produced ships that get in our way, take out those clones, and then throw the best performance ever on that huge stage!
After that, we'll use our secret technique to blow open a portal to take us back home!
We're going home as heroes! I can already see our glorious victory~♪
Don't count your chickens before they hatch, Ami. We're not going anywhere if we don't take out that clone in front of us first.
Confirming hologram energy mass. Initiating performance preparations.
We'll take care of the small fry. You girls should save your stamina for the final concert.
Thanks for covering us~ Today's going to be a pretty long day, huh?
Yes, and most importantly, my Commander shall be observing all our performances today. Despite that, we'll get burned out if we go all-out from the beginning.
Wait, since when?!
(Maybe it's a good source of inspiration for them...)
Taihou, don't tamper with the broadcasting feed without permission, nya! This isn't the Commander's office; you're messing up the connection with the port's repeater, nya!
Sigh...
Haha... Well, it is true that it takes passion to become a true idol.
Port - Concert Sea Area Center Stage
It's finally time for us to make our debut!
Your clones appear to already be in position. They also seem to have already decided on their program.
This feels quite like a boss fight. Can we head up on stage now?
Yes, I'm continuing to monitor the energy signatures, but you'll have to defeat those clones first.
If the portal stays open, we'll be able to send you back to your original world.
Don't let your guard down until we can get you through, though. Do your best out there.
This whole thing feels so weird... almost like rehearsing in front of a mirror.
Because our clones are standing right across from us?
That's not all. They even seem to have our mannerisms!
But you can tell that they're not real...
Don't think too much about it, or you won't be able to stay focused. Direct all your focus on the performance.
What Iori says is right. We are who we are—
The energy signature is spiking, nya!
I'm getting a bad feeling about this... Hey, Sheffy, do you think this is...
Indeed... It reminds me of the day the idols arrived.
What do you mean by that? Are we going to have a repeat of the thing that happened when we arrived?
There's no telling what might happen. Gather Javelin and the other escort ships and have them meet up with us here.
Are you sure? I thought our escorts were drawing the mass-produced ships away...
Ships that aren't equipped with the Muse System can't provide you with any assistance on-stage.
That's why when it's your time to shine, you've gotta give it your all!
Port - Concert Sea Area Center Stage
With the power of the Muse System, there's not a soul out there that can put on a better show than Ami!
Yeah! We're not gonna lose to anyone, let alone some dumb clone~♪
Now, let's light up this world!
And not just this world, let's illuminate the universe!
Offstage
Akagi, everyone... Big trouble, nya!
What... is the meaning of this?!
It's bad news, nya! The energy signature is spiking through the roof, nya!
Calm down, Akashi. Tell us what exactly is going on, and what we need to do.
I'm not so sure myself, nya...
Ever since the concert started, the energy signature has been increasing steadily, nya.
Monitor module output: energy reading is coming from atop the stage.
Gascogne, you too? ...So, what's going to happen now?
If the energy overloads, it's going to spill over to all the machinery set up here, nya...
And if that happens... not just the stage, but the entire port's going to get blown to smithereens, nya!
So, that means we need to stop the concert immediately...!
At the pace it's increasing, we'd be too late even if we stopped the concert right now, nya!
Proposing a manner to reduce the risk of energy overload:
—All ships equipped with the Muse System are to join the concert and counteract the energy overflow by operating the gear at maximum output.
In other words... You want to use the energy from the Muse System to block the incoming overflow?
A simple and straightforward solution. I'm glad we rehearsed together in case of contingencies.
What should we do?
Follow the original plan. Thanks to you girls, this concert's just about to get a lot more interesting.
I guess so... See, that just goes to show that hard work is never wasted!
So, we're all going to get on stage together for the next part of the concert?
Mm... Otherwise, we're all going to go kaboom.
Kaboom? Whaddya mean?
Isn't that some kind of special effect?
Actually, not quite... So, um, this is the situation...
...We did not mean to get you involved in all of this. Um...
I'm so sorry... This is all because we decided to bring you here...
What are you saying? You have nothing to apologize for.
Miss Iori...?
We had the Muse rigging made for us, and we didn't end up here by mistake.
That's right. We chose to be here.
We've already been through so much together, so we might as well see things through, right?
If we succeed, we can save this world from destruction, then truly go back home as heroes! Everyone's happy!
Yeah, yeah! I'll say it again, we aren't losing to some crappy clones!
If our song will make a difference, we'll sing our hearts out!
Exactly. Plus, there are people here looking forward to our performance, so I won't let this place be destroyed!
Girls...
That's why... we're going to put on the best show ever, together!
This is the last performance we're putting on in this world, so shine like you've never shone before!
This is the story of a rainbow-colored ocean in which battles come again and again.
Of a stage that shines brilliantly to protect the world's peace.
Of a resonating passion and an anthem of hope.
This is the story of what it means to be an idol in this world.
The girls continued to sing and sing as the holographic images of their fans from worlds both near and far illuminated the stage.
Is everyone getting pumped up——!!
You're not alone! We're here too!
What an elegant glow... So this is Vampire's... Err, rather, the Azur Lane's brightly-shining idols!
May our songs reach your heart!
Port - Temporary Office
Akashi, how's the output from the Muse System looking?
It's going up, nya! At this rate, we might actually be able to...
No, it's not enough. Look, the energy on the other side is accelerating as well, as if it's matching us...
S-seriously, nya?! Are we really going to go kaboom, nya?!
If nothing changes, that actually might happen. Now, how are we going to get out of this mess...
It might have just been because our opponents were too strong, but the act of singing itself is not enough to convey the feelings that can move one's heart.
Ahaha... Looks like we're going to have to help each other out a whole lot.
If our songs and dances can make a difference... we want to do everything we can to help!
It's only natural to want to protect your friends!
If we succeed, we can save this world from destruction, then truly go back home as heroes! That way, everyone's happy!
We aren't losing to some crappy clones!
I think this is a great opportunity for everyone to come out on stage and deliver a dazzling performance!
(This concert is not mine alone. It is all of ours.)
(Not just us, but also the shipgirls performing with us.)
(No, it's not just them. All of the shipgirls here, as well as the fans who are watching. We're all excited about this concert!)
(And, finally, all of my friends "over there" who are still waiting for us...)
Unlike last time, there's something different about the stage...
From the looks of things, the nightmare scenario has been averted.
Look, Akashi, the energy readings are changing as well.
It's true, nya! The energy signature is starting to turn around, nya! We're pushing it back, nya!
Ami's just getting started, so don't you dare go anywhere!
Encore, encore! We're not gonna stop!
Is everyone still hanging in there?
You bet!
All right! Let's give it our all, until the curtains fall!
The Muse System is a weapon that is able to bring out the power within feelings and songs.
A third concert festival was to be held at the port to further tap into its potential.

But before that could happen, the joint performance featuring the idols of 765 Production as well as the shipgirls generated an unbelievable amount of excitement, and was said to have captured the hearts of countless fans across the world.
Afterward...
Jeez, are we sure that things are going to be fine this time? My heart's not going to be able to handle a repeat of the last time...
My, my~ Since when have you been such a worrywart, Ritsuko~
I'm still amazed that we managed to cancel out that huge energy surge with our own.
When the energy dissipated, all the mass-produced ships in the area shut down as well.
Wh-what?! Doesn't that mean we can't go home ever again?! Even after all that...
Actually, it seems that the actual location of the portal was in the office rather than at the concert venue.
Don't scare me like that, jeez...
Next time, do some proper research before sending us on a dangerous wild goose chase...
I'm so sorry, nya. This is all Akashi's fault, nya. Please forgive me, nya...
Don't worry. All's well that ends well, right~ Besides, if we had to search for the portal ourselves, who knows how long it would've taken?
Indeed, you have my word this time. You should be able to return home through here.
(After our performance, the energy from the Muse System canceled out the abnormal energy.)
(That apparently sealed off the portal that we arrived in this world through...)
(After all that, I'm not sure why we got pulled into this world in the first place, but I'm glad we get to go home~)
We've finished stowing away the Muse riggings.
Thanks for everything! It was so nice to meet you all!
Laffey... won't ever forget...
Let's play games together again some day.
Sure, but I'm not gonna lose when we have our rematch! Right, Mami?
Jeez, Ami, you're the only one who lost!
Ah, I really can't wait to see you all again!
...What are you looking at me for? Well, I guess I haven't been able to perform like that in a long time. And it was kinda fun, and um...
Portal status is stable. Confirming intent to depart.
Regrettably, 'tis time for us to part.
...Thanks again, for everything you've done for us here.
Your hospitality truly was spectacular. Our time together was a ton of fun, hehe~
Yeah, the concert at the end wasn't the only highlight!
Mhm! Ami also had a ton of fun!
The time I spent here was truly unforgettable. Thank you, everyone!
Try not to get too lonely without me around!
Let's hang out again some time in the future!
All right, now for the next person!
Wow, I guess we really are back...
I feel totally worn out...
Ahhhh, me too! Good night~
Seems like we ended up back home in a flash! But... it also feels like we spent a lot of time over there.
C'mon, we don't have time to sleep on the job. Let's continue the photoshoot! Haruka, you're next!
Ah, right, now that you reminded me...
All right, next person, come take your picture—
Hi, pleased to meet you!
"An invader from afar threatened the peace of the azur lanes."
"Brave warships arose once more from the iron depths to face them."
"This is the song sung by idols, an anthem to support the heroes who protect this world."
This is our path, our song. Our conviction, and our hope—
Port - Concert Sea Area
Cleveland here. Did you get the video I sent you?
There's a city on the ocean?!
It's so pretty...
Wow, it even says "765 Production" in huge letters...
Just to make sure, there's no 765 Production in your world, right?
Of course not, nya. This is the first time I've ever heard of it, nya.
D-does this mean we really got spirited away?
*gulp* ....Wait, actually, I think we got reincarnated in another world!
It's too early to say. And what the heck do you mean by that?
Um, well, how do I explain this...
There's no point concealing the truth. I shall explain.
Err, well, I was thinking about holding a big concert for the port, so I started assembling a venue here.
When I say assembling, I pretty much mean just setting up the main stage. The rest are just holographic generators to create a certain environment.
And what you see right now are the holograms...
So... you created the whole city that's on the ocean?
That's about the gist of it. We even decided to incorporate a logo that you might find familiar.
So, the phenomena related to our visitors from another world occurred in a place completely unrelated to them...
Excuse me, but if there's any chance we can find some clues about how to get back home...
I know. Sheffield, please let us know if you find out anything new.
Naturally. I shall have things squared away by the time my Master returns.
Port - Concert Sea Area
Confirming "enemy" sighting. Requesting "concert" preparations.
Figures that these things would pop out if we change the area to resemble the place the girls came from.
It's a bit blurry looking from here, but that definitely looks like Iori...
Are those things... our clones?
Close enough. Consider them as fakes made from your data.
Those holograms were originally meant for use during concerts, but now they're acting as guardians for the machine?
...It's hard to believe, even after seeing it.
Yeah... When I first heard about it, I was like, "how the heck is that possible?"
But if we don't fight and win, we won't be able to get through this area.
Wait, fight...? Does that mean we have to shoot at Iori with our cannons...?
Nay, only the Muse system is capable of defeating our opponents... with the power of music.
I'm totally lost here...
It's a special rigging we've been equipped with. It allows us to increase our performance power as we fight.
Oh right, we did tell you that this sea area was originally a concert venue, right?
In other words, instead of using conventional warfare, we fight by seeing who can put on the best concert.
...But it's such a pain in the ass! If not for that idiot, who would even come up with an idea like this...
Woah, hold on, our opponents have already begun their performance! Hold tight for a hot second, I'm going to go and gather some more info!
Incredible...!
That's insane... What kind of performance was that...?
In terms of Vocals, Dance, and Visuals— the opponent's performance is superior in every aspect.
What do we do, Akagi? We're not going to be able to get through here.
...Retreat. It pains me to say this, but we've been thoroughly defeated.
We really lost, huh...
I apologize for my unsightly performance.
D-don't give up! It might be frustrating, but at least nobody got hurt, and we can come back as many times as needed.
That's true... If you undergo special training and prepare thoroughly, you can always face them again later.
It wasn't Akashi's plan to have everything be settled through concerts, nya~
Nobody knows exactly why it happened. Akashi, you should focus on analyzing how that city came into being in the first place.
I won't let those clones get away with this!
I feel bad that you have to go through all of this because of us...
(The Azur Lane girls are putting on a pretty good show, but...)
...it feels like they don't know who they're singing for...
Chihaya? Why are you mumbling to yourself...?
Huh? I what? Oh, err, I guess I was thinking about the impression I got from the concert out loud...
It might've simply been because our opponents were too strong, but simply singing is not enough to convey the feelings that can move one's heart.
While I don't believe that there are winners or losers when it comes to concerts, I'd say this is the main reason for our "defeat."
The potential is definitely there, but what you currently lack is professionalism.
I'm not saying you all have to become professional idols, but you're going to need a certain level of pro finesse if you want to keep moving forward.
I have heard the lamentations of my subjects!
Your Majesty...!
Queen Elizabeth of the Royal Navy has arrived! And what a marvelous suggestion I just heard!
Nya?! One of our sponsors has arrived, nya!
If you are unable to defeat those clones, then you must undergo special training and try again! Also, do deploy the other Muse units!
Can we also count on the cooperation of the idols of 765 Production?
*gasp*...!
Oh my...
What are you saying all of a sudden...? These girls aren't a part of Azur Lane. They're just ordinary people who've been blown here from their world.
I agree! Your Majesty, please consider...
I know, I know! However, if we don't investigate that location, there's no way to get these girls back home, correct?
Most importantly, the Royal Navy is an official sponsor! It would reflect poorly upon us to leave the venue in its current condition!
Hmm, I see. If there's anything we can do to help...
Now, this is something I can get behind. We're all in!
We can be idols spanning across worlds... Nihihi, I like the sound of that!
Thank you. We appreciate your cooperation.
It's decided then. But, umm...
We're gonna be working together now! Isn't that great?
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it! Let's give it our all, everyone!
Hehehe...
Professional idols... I can already smell a new business opportunity, nya...
Calm down, Akashi... They're just going to be advising us.
They'll basically only be helping out with rehearsals and lessons, so don't go cooking up any weird plans.
Um, if I'm remembering correctly, Akashi and Z23, yes?
Miss Ritsuko? Did you need something?
Actually, I was a bit concerned about the rigging that the fake Iori was wearing...
Port - Temporary Office
Heave, ho... All righty, I'll leave this over here~
Great! Thanks a ton!
Laffey is out of energy... Going back to sleep...
Laffey, please don't fall asleep on the equipment!
Then, the sofa...
Jeez, Laffey, come help out a bit more! It's not easy setting up all the equipment in the office!
I thought we were just doing a test run, but I guess we ended up doing a full-scale setup.
I suppose this is part of being a pro idol, huh... I remember Saratoga saying the same thing.
Hehe. You've got to look the part first, after all~
Indeed. I can see that being a full-time idol isn't an emphasis for the shipgirls here, so in addition to the normal lessons...
Haruka suggested that it's important for you to get a taste of what it's like to live as an actual idol.
Queen Elizabeth was wise enough to adopt this plan.
Ahaha...
No problem. Naturally, you'll be helping us with our training, yes?
All right, turn your arm just like this~
Woah, don't start practicing your dance steps before warming up first!
Ugh... A performance that my Commander has never seen before... I'll have to consult Roon and have this recorded.
*gasp* *gasp*... No more... I'm not built for this...
Art thou not being too draconian?
Not at all. You'll never become a real idol if you can't even get through this!
Hehehe~ Not that I disagree with that sentiment~♪
Are you not going to practice?
Oh, that reminds me! 'tis necessary for me to procure beverages, so I shall take my leave thusly!
...Good grief, some of the girls here really are quite something...
Keep up the good work, everyone! Just like that!
Woah, I'm not sure I'd be able to handle that...
Zzzzzz………
If you can't be perfect during practice, how are you going to be perfect on-stage?
We'll also be joining the lessons, so keep hanging in there!
That's right. We can't neglect our idol training either just because we're stuck here.
Everyone, the mass-produced ships are ready!
Sorry to keep you waiting—
It's time to head down to the venue!
Port - Concert Sea Area
Can you hear me...?
We're good! Loud and clear!
According to Akashi, there's an abnormal energy reading in the waters ahead of you, so be careful.
Got it! You too, Javelin, keep your eyes peeled!
We'll help keep watch from aboard this ship!
Sure, it's our job to escort you there safely! By the way, these mass-produced ships look a little weird...
By mass-produced, do you mean the ships we're riding on right now?
They're basically ordinary vessels that don't need to be directly manned, right?
Correct. As a matter of fact, shortly before the anomaly, we spotted mass-produced ships with logos of your production company.
While they didn't attack us, I knew their presence couldn't bode well.
As long as they're in the way, we won't be able to get through...
Do we have any countermeasures to get them to move out of the way?
Not yet, but... The strange energy reaction here probably is the root cause.
We'll fight to make sure you girls can go back home, as well as to secure the safety of these waters!
So you can rest easy and watch our performance from af— ...Hwuh?!
Javelin, what's happening?
N-nothing major! I was just surprised when a building suddenly popped up in front of me!
Huh...? Isn't that a hologram...?
Th-that's right! It might well be! Phew... Scared the heck outta me...
Look, Chihaya! It's the stage!
Yeah, that's the stage that this entire area is built around.
Woah, look over there! Are those clones of me and Azusa?
They don't seem to be moving... Is it okay for us to get a little closer?
...Be careful, Haruka. Even though the shipgirls are protecting us...
The energy readings are shooting through the roof! Everyone, get out of there, hurry!
M-mass produced ships are swarming us all of a sudden?!
Protect our guests at all costs! Everyone, prepare for battle!
Incredible...! It's just like a movie...!
Even though those mass-produced ships are approaching the girls, they don't seem to show any intent on attacking the ships they're on.
Javelin's group has been able to take advantage of this to lead them away for now... Phew...
But there are still ships coming towards us... Are those the clones of me and Ritsuko?
Look, they even have little stages underneath them! Are they trying to put on a show?
So what's the plan? I'm also ready to get on deck and perform, but...
It might be hard since we haven't had time to warm up yet...
We might not even be able to get on stage if we don't get that ship out of the way first.
Even if we do that, if that ship calls for additional reinforcements, we won't even be able to return to port.
(In case things get too out of hand, we could return to more conventional combat, but... Haruka and the others are still over there, and we can't risk that... Ugh...)
Muse System Task Force, Ami Futami, reporting for duty!
And make it double! Mami Futami is here to save the day!
The twins?!
Nihihi! Behold, the power of the Muse System!
You just can't beat the real deal! Get a load of this!
St-stand back, everyone!
Iori, you too? Are you seriously going to fight the enemy?
Of course! If we don't win, we won't be able to move forwards or backwards, isn't that right?
Any of you girls not in possession of the Muse rigging, evacuate according to my instructions! All other ships, support Iori and the others!
Got it! Understood, yes!
Port - Concert Sea Area
I'm on my way back! Is everyone okay?!
Not a scratch on us. Thank you very much.
That was quite a shocking experience...
Nihihi! We came in clutch, isn't that right?
Yeah, that was the perfect time to unveil our brand new Muse System rigging!
Bringing new friends in and getting new powers— that's the perfect way to wrap up a training arc after a bitter defeat!
Jeez, I hope you two realize how much danger you put yourselves in...
Actually, there wasn't anything to worry about. I had already been tracking their signals.
If there was any real threat of danger, I was ready to step in.
See, there's no problem! By the way, as you can see, this rigging is a submarine-type! That means...
We've been trailing the mass-produced ships without you knowing it, Harurun!
Wait, so you two can dive now?! The level of technology here is pretty wild...
It wasn't developed overnight, but Akashi managed to pull through, yes.
Plus, don'tcha think this outfit suits us perfectly~♪
Ritsuko has some big news for us, right~♪
Um... What is this...?
Ritsuko went to ask that Akashi girl about the rigging that my clone had equipped.
Apparently, "those ships were equipped with rigging very similar to our Muse System."
That gave her the idea to see if we could also equip the Muse System rigging.
I was just curious, but I had no idea she'd actually go and make it...
But it worked out, because now we're totally able to fight!
Yup yup! We can't just be relying on others the whole time we're here!
I see, that makes sense~
We're grateful that you have the will to fight alongside us, but remember, don't push yourselves too hard.
To be honest, I was a bit surprised when Ayanami, Ami, and Mami popped up out of nowhere. Let's make sure we support each other properly.
My apologies...
There's nothing to apologize for. It's only natural to want to protect your friends!
And in case things go south, just remember that I've got your back!
All right then, let's finish scouting out the venue before we head back!
Port - Temporary Office
I, I'm not sure about this...
Ooooh...
Chihaya, that looks super, duper amazing on you!
It's terrifying how Akashi can make perfect outfits for everyone without even taking our measurements...
It's a part of my job, nya~ But, you're welcome to praise me more, nya~♪
So, my rigging type is that of a heavy cruiser? Haruka is a light cruiser, and Ritsuko is a munitions ship? My, I feel like you've even matched our personalities~
Really? I guess I'm a battleship then, and Chihaya is...
An aircraft carrier.
Are our riggings to your satisfaction, ladies? If so, let's discuss our strategy moving forward.
Right, we have to do something about that stage in the Concert Sea Area.
Precisely. From the scouting we've done, we can be fairly certain that the anomalous energy signatures are coming from that stage.
Based on our prior experiences, there might be a tunnel leading back to your original world, nya.
We'll be able to go home then?
Plus, with our new equipment, we'll be able to wallop all of those clones blocking our way.
Ah, um, I do have a question though...
Do speak your mind.
Last time, our clones performed on a small ship stage, right? But we're going to be on the main stage this time?
I think this is a great opportunity for everyone to come out on stage and deliver a dazzling performance!
That sounds fine, but are you absolutely sure?
I know you girls have rigging now, but you don't have to force yourselves to fight...
I don't see it as forcing ourselves. Please let us perform as well.
If our songs and dances can make a difference... we want to do everything we can to help!
Preach it! Besides, there are plenty of dangers out there even when we're not on the stage performing~
I promise not to play any more submarine tag for the time being~
I swear I won't do anything to endanger myself either. So please, let us join your performance!
Very well then! Let us begin our preparations!
Hooray!
Singing and dancing lessons, rehearsals, syncing our choreography with the shipgirls, and designing the perfect set...
We're going to have our hands full, aren't we~?
Hehe... Now this gets my blood pumping~♪

scripts.say: Port - Boardwalk
Hehe~ Being able to take leisurely strolls along the shore is great, isn't it~
Definitely. Plus, there are so many things here we'd never get to see back home, so you'd never get tired of the view. By the way, doesn't it feel like there are more people here than usual?
Oh, now that you mention it... I wonder if there's something going on?
Who knows? Everyone seems to be heading to the central courtyard though...
Oh hey, Azusa and Chihaya! What are you two doing?
Good morning, Javelin. We were just out for a stroll. By the way, is there something going on at the courtyard? I couldn't help but to notice all the people.
About that... Today, our local idols are holding a special concert!
The Muse girls are going to be performing?
Err, not quite... They're normal idols, just like the ones from your world.
There are regular idols in this world as well, huh?
That's definitely something I'd like to experience while I'm here~
In that case, I'll show you to the venue! Looks like ticketing has already started, so we'll need to hurry up!
Port - Courtyard Concert Venue
Phew~ We made it just in time! I'm glad we were able to get seats!
So many people... Are we watching someone famous?
Look, someone's coming out on stage~
Woooohoo! Everyone, thanks for coming to see me~!!
I'm the port's number one idol, San Diego, and I'll be starting things off today~!
Things are gonna get pretty wild around here, so make sure you keep your eyes on me until the very end~!
All righty, let's start the music! It's time to pump things up~!
"Next up, it's the one and only Sister Sara~! Huh? You can't see me? Ehehe~ I wonder, where could I be hiding?"
"...Eh? You're giving up just like that? Fiiine~"
"The correct answer is..."
Tadaaaah~! Right here in the audience~!
How'd you like Sister Sara's surprise present? Did it make your heart skip a beat~?
Welp, time to head back to the stage~! The show must go on~♪
Huh? A special idol concert...?!
And you didn't invite Benson, the cutest, prettiest girl in the whole galaxy?!
I'm gonna bunny hop right in! I'll show you just how a charming the cutest idol from Planet Bunny really is! Buuuuunny Bomber!!
What is going on...
Oh my...
W-well, our concerts are known to be a little unpredictable... Ahahaha!
I've never seen a concert as free-form as this before, but it looks like both the idols and the audience are having a great time.
Hehe~ It's making me want to go up on stage as well~
Ahaha... As long as you're having fun, right?
Chihaya, by the way, you've had a really stern face for quite some time now...
(They're pulling the audience in with their flashy performance, and even making them a part of the show...)
(It seems sloppy and unprofessional at first, but this might actually be the next frontier of music. I'll have to look into this some more...)

scripts.say: Port - Courtyard
My name is Javelin, and I'll be showing you around the port. I hope we can become good friends!
Nice to meet you, Javelin! It's kind of exciting getting to know everyone~♪
So you'll be taking us on a tour, I take it? I wonder what kind of place this is...
Let's get going...
First of, this is our... Hey, Miss Veneto! When'd you put a miniature Colosseum in here...?!
Woah...
So they also have a Colosseum in this world, but... I'm frankly blown away...
Hehe~ You can't help but to marvel at the symbol of Sardegna's majesty, right?
There's even a stack of promotional pamphlets in the corner... Just what kind of place is this?
Why, this is the place I've prepared to let everyone learn about the glory of Sardegna. By the way, would you be interested in some more information?
(It's just our normal visitors' center!) ...Umm, I think we're good! I'm just showing everyone around the port today!
I see, in that case... why not show them to one of our famous locations, like our canteen or the shrine behind the mountains? They're both nice spots.
Thanks for the suggestions! The shrine is a bit out of the way, so we should save that for the end... Why don't we head to the canteen first?
Excuse me, is it okay to take a look in this place?
This isn't one of the port's buildings, but... it's probably okay to take a look...
Port - Canteen
Canteen's right here... This is where you eat... More importantly, the place you go to drink is...
(Woah, this place gives off totally mature vibes... Should we even be in here...?)
Hm? Ahh... Visitors from another world. Tallinn, would you mind serving our guests a glass?
Ehh?! Um, we're still underage, so we can't...
Don't worry, it's just fruit juice.
...Ah, um, then I suppose I'll try a bit... Woah! Apple juice? ...It's so crisp and refreshing!
Ohhhh, it's deliciously sweet with just the right amount of sour...
Did you make these from super expensive apples or something?
Consider this a token of our hospitality. I'm glad you're all enjoying it.
Thank you very much! That sure hit the spot~♪
It's getting pretty late... But there's one last place for us to go. After we head up these stairs, we'll get to meet Fusou and see the shrine!
(There's a ton of fun stuff to do here, and everyone seems super nice, but it really is a much different world here compared to back home...)
Let's keep going.
Port - Shrine
Woah... Such pretty lights...
Oh, visitors at this hour? Good evening~
You're the idols from another world, right? I've been wanting to meet you all sooo badly~!
They have huge shrines in this world too, huh...
Hehe, it's nice to know that we have so much in common~
Mhm, I feel the same way!
I'm so glad I got to see all these amazing places around the port today!
All these familiar sights and sounds are finally letting me calm down... Hehe~

scripts.say: Port - Office
A great performance is only made possible by the hours of practice that go into it... so first, we'll need to plan out the lessons.
Today, we're joined by Ritsuko and Iori, idol advising specialists. It's great to have the two of you here!
Feel free to ask me anything. As a top-tier idol, there's no question I won't be able to answer! Hehe~
I'm a fairly experienced idol as well, so I'll be glad to help however I can!
Great, let's dive right in then. When drafting a lesson plan, we have to first think about the areas that need the most improvement.
Just as a point of reference, what do the two of you think are the most important things that idols should get from the lessons?
Let's see... Well, you can't put on a show unless the singing and dancing are on lock.
I think expressiveness is also important. It's a big part of singing and dancing, but also carries over to a variety of other aspects.
That's true. Without all three of those things, you can't even be an idol.
All right. Let's make a lesson plan that revolves around these three things: singing, dancing, and expressiveness.
However... I do think it's important to say that right now, I feel like I'm trying to plan without a specific goal in mind.
Of course the end goal is to be able to put on a higher-quality performance, but that's rather vague and doesn't tell us what we need to do to get there.
Yeah~ It's definitely hard to see that when you first are starting out.
Some say that training without a purpose is no better than not training at all.
But how should we go about setting those tangible goals?
Why not start with something short-term first?
Short-term, huh...
That's right. Break down the things you want to achieve into small, realistic chunks that build up towards the final goal.
For example, if your final goal is to become a top idol, your short-term goals would be to make each and every performance memorable.
That also gives us an idea of how we want to structure our lessons for each performance, so we always have something to work towards.
Why don't you try setting some short-term goals and start from there?
(As expected from Ritsuko. Her advice is always so insightful!)
That seems manageable enough.
If we treat the performance and the lessons as a package... Then, how about we schedule a concert two months out? I'll plan out the lessons with that timetable in mind.
(She skipped straight to the scheduling?!)
In that case... Let's start by making sure everyone has the songs memorized and the choreography ready to go.
Huh? W-wait, Ritsuko?
(Wait, why are you acting like you're a part of this?!)
I see now. After that, we'll be able to adjust the choreography and figure out how to improve on the singing.
Then, we'll need to have group lessons that focus on piecing together everyone's individual parts, in addition to the solo lessons.
That's precisely right!
(At this rate...)
(This conversation is going bottoms up...!!)
Also, when we get to that point, there's another thing we need to be careful about when it comes to lessons...
Alright, t-time out, you two!!
Stop talking for a minute, and take a few steps back!
Yeah! You can't just "schedule" a concert out of nowhere! That wasn't part of our plans at all!
Hmm... I thought that was the right timeframe to optimize our lessons...
That might be true, but that's also not the issue here...!
Let's see if the commander would be willing to help us come up with a tentative plan then.
Alright, Ritsuko, the next thing on the agenda is...
Like... I... Said!! Don't just go planning things without getting permission first!!

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Empire Dorms
Hiyah! Yaargh! Gaah! Not yet—!!
Too naive. Jump. Left hook. Activate skill.
Aaaahhhh!! Why are you attacking me?!
Nihihi~! The three of you seem to be forgetting about someone! Finishing move...! Ultraaa... Burning... Punch!!
Ahhhhh——!!
Hooray! It's Ami's win~!
Ugh... I can't believe I lost... I must say, the two of you are quite good at this game, yes.
We played a whole lot of games back home as well~♪ But, I'm glad that there are a lot of fun games here that we can all play together~!
Yeah, we love having new friends to play together with too! So, which game do you want to try next?
Hmm... How about this one?
This is a rhythm game that just came out recently... But, it's only for two players.
Don't give up just like that! ......Tadah~!
Four disposable chopsticks? ...What are we doing with those?
Drawing lots, of course! Let's have a team battle! Best of three takes the whole thing!
That sounds interesting. Let's draw our lots quickly then.
Everyone got theirs? Alrighty, let's see what we got! One... two...
Team A!
Team B!
All right, Booky, we're partners! Let's kick some butt!
I'm pretty confident in my rhythm game skills. Victory will be ours for sure!
That's what I want to hear! Of course, we don't plan on losing either! Right, Nommy~?
Of course. Don't underestimate my gamer skills... I'll take the first round.
You're on! Mami Futami from Team B will be your opponent! Let's get started!
Right... Left... Crap, right again? Ugh... My combo...
Right... Right... Left~♪ Hehe, this is a pretty catchy song~
...And that's the end of the round. The winner is... Mami!
That's one point to Team B! Get us over the finish line, Booky!
I apologize... It's in your hands, Ami.
Just leave it to me~! I wonder if I'll be able to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat~
Let's see if you can stop me! All right then, let's start the second round!
Up~ Down~♪ Piece of cake! I've even got bonus time! Dadadada~♪
Up, down, left... H-huh? Where'd that note come from? Argh, I can't keep up at all...!
...The second round goes to Ami.
I thought I was ready for anything... So, uhh, does this mean it's a draw?
Idols really do have a better sense of rhythm, considering they're trying this for the first time...
That's a difference in experience! But I must say, Nommy, you're a really great gamer! Our scores were really close!
Yeah, totally~♪ Also, Booky, you did great too! It was like we were dancing together~!
Yup, yup! Hey, hey, Booky~ How about playing against me next?
Ah, I want to play with you too, Nommy! ...So how about a tiebreaker?
Challenge accepted! That first time was just the warm-up! I won't make the same mistake twice!
My pride is on the line, and I won't lose again.
Nihihi~! We'll see about that~!
Ancient legends spoke of sea monsters that sang enchanting songs to lure ships to their watery graves.
They were named "Sirens," and they threatened the safety of the seas by dragging people to their demise.
A number of people developed countermeasures in order to deal with these monsters.
Orpheus, companion of the Argonauts, offset the Sirens' song with the melodies of his lyre.
During the Great Era of Discovery, sailors sang to the figurehead of their ship to quell the fear within their hearts and pray for a safe voyage.
These decorative figureheads, or idols, were so important to the peoples who would later become Iris Libre and the Sardegna Empire, that they were seen as pieces of art or even symbols of faith.
These traditions have evolved and taken many different forms as they were passed down the ages...
Indeed, the connection between music and sailing has remained strong in modernity, as evidenced by the naval bands of the Royal Navy, Iron Blood, and Eagle Union.

When these idols made their way from West to East, they took on a completely different form within the unique culture of the Sakura Empire - a combination of mystery and glamor that would take the world by storm.
And now, the fight against the Sirens continues to evolve, in the form of an experimental rigging that reflects the time-hallowed tethers between music and sailing...
Azur Lane's new weapon to counter the encroaching Siren threat. Its name is...
The µ-rigging, also known as the "Muse System."
The experimental Muse System is about to enter its final stage of testing...
...So, that's a pretty convincing backstory, nya. Right?
Experimental Testing Facility (?)
Nya nya, testing, one... two...!
Thanks to everyone who could make it to the our experimental armament final trial concert, nya!
Here to guide you through this final data-collection live concert will be me, your master of ceremonies, Akashi nya! Thank you, thank you, nya!
First, some of you might be wondering what the Muse System is, nya! Akashi will kindly explain the details, nya!
In short, the Muse System began as a proposal from the higher-ups to incorporate the power of music into our armaments, nya.
I'm not sure why music was chosen as the theme to develop equipment around, but today's trial concert is aimed at gauging its performance, nya.
What's the point of a concert, you say? Well, how should I put it, nya...
You have music, nya! You have a bunch of cute girls, nya! There's only one logical thing to do, nya!
And what you'll be seeing today are the results of everyone's enthusiasm, nya!
Also, Yuubari said that she's "seen this concept plenty of times in anime so it probably works," nya.
You might think that this was simply an idea to capitalize on a popular, successful genre, but you'd be wrong, nya! I'm not lying, nya!
So, in other words, "Polaris" is a randomly selected group of girls who are equipped with the Muse System, and you'd like them to conduct test battles against the rest of the fleet?
I'm finally going to have some competition! I'm getting all fired up!
I'm not sure how you go about mixing music and fighting... but it seems like idol culture is already quite popular around here.
That's right~ You could feel everyone's excitement when we announced that there would be an idol concert event...
Good grief... What's going to happen here?
All right! Experimental Muse System testing unit, "Polaris," let's make sure to do our best!
Activating experimental armament testing protocol. Running directives to test the combat performance of Muse System.
*sigh*... I hope this doesn't take long...
(So this is the final trial run... I wonder if all the effort that's been put into this project will prove worthwhile...)
This unit did not look very promising at first. It took a lot of practice to even muster a semblance of team unity.
W-well... None of us have done something like this before... Anyway, Gascogne, we'll follow your lead!
Acknowledged. Operation, begin.
Experimental Armament Testing Grounds
Polaris handily defeated the fearsome duo of Z23 and Ayanami, even though they were guided by Saratoga, nya! Can anyone stop their advance, nya?!
We're quickly approaching the halfway point of our tests, but who will be next to face Polaris?
I would have loved to reveal today's challenger in advance, but her sister put me under a strict NDA!
Now, for the surprise you've all been waiting for, nya! For everyone watching from back home at the port, don't change the channel!
Mm, I'm pretty sure I know who it's going to be...
If you're referring to Miss Portland and Miss Indianapolis, they're back at the port.
Ehh?! I could've sworn it would be those two based on that description. Does someone else fit the bill?
Who knows? I'm not positive, but at least we can rule out the Portland sisters.
Then, who is it? Think, Cleveland, think...
What good does it do worrying about that? Come on, let's get going.
(It... it's probably that girl... Gah, I feel too ashamed to tell them though...)
Ehh?! Funf isn't allowed to participate?
Yeah... Akashi said that she wasn't looking for people who already have prior on-stage experience...
Is this the fate of those who bear the cursed eye...?! Gahh, it's so frustrating!
Um, I reckon that since this is a port-wide event, they wanted to make it so those with no idol experience could participate on a level playing field.
But don't you think it's a pity to ignore all the time and effort we've put into accumulating on-stage experience?
That's right~ What a waste of Funf's talent, the singing and dancing idol! Just kidding~♪
Hmm, in that case, why don't we lend our expertise to those girls? Polaris has the Commander backing them up, but I'm sure the others could use some guidance.
Yeah! That's a great idea!
I have no objections to that! I'm going to go support Javelin!
In that case, I'll go cheer on Zed!
(Gascogne's emotion module... might be a good starting point.)
(But how was that caused by this new equipment? The Muse System has not made such a dramatic difference upon my current state.)
(I'm going to need more information...)
N-no way?!
Oh? What are you looking at?
The Iron Blood's social media feed... Hey, who gave you permission to look over my shoulder?!
Ah, sorry 'bout that! I didn't see anything! Come to think of it, Juustagram has been blowing up recently, hasn't it?
Miss Saratoga advised the idols to pay more attention to their advertising, so this is likely a product of that.
Disclosure of personal information in a publicly visible setting cannot be determined as invalid.
It's not that big of a deal, honestly. All you have to do is post some daily thoughts that aren't related to private or combat-related information.
Gascogne, Akagi, have you two considered making Juustagram accounts? I'll show you how to use it.
I'll consider your offer.
Gascogne's... "daily thoughts..."
Ahahahaha! Come forth, my sister! Bring the world to its knees with your transcendent cuteness!
D-Deutschland...
Sh-she's here! The idol who's out to prove that Iron Blood cutengineering is the finest in the world, World's♡Cutest!
Admiral Graf Spee will face off against Polaris next, nya!
That idol name is way too embarrassing... Plus, this isn't even a real battle, just a trial run for some new equipment, right?
I feel you. It must be hard with that sister of yours...
Deutschland absolutely insisted that I participate in this event... Hipper, did you volunteer for this?
Hell no! Who'd want to do something embarrassing like this?! *sigh*... I just wish this would hurry up and end already...
Ahaha... But you know, now that I'm doing this, I'm actually enjoying myself. You looked like you were having a great time earlier, too.
Who the hell could have a great time doing this crap?!
You know, it wouldn't hurt to be more honest with yourself... But anyhow, I'm your next opponent, right? Ready to do this?
Ahaha, turns out I'm no match for you...
To be honest, I never thought you'd come back after everything that happened.
I'll take that as a compliment. You know what surprised me? I never would have expected Gascogne to participate in Polaris...
Um, well, I always thought that Gascogne and I had a lot in common.
When I first arrived at port, I was prickly and on edge, always looking for a fight.
Of course, the purpose of us Kansen is to fight, and I knew that very well.
But there's more to life than fighting. If I never realized that, and kept being my old emotionless self, I wouldn't have been able to enjoy this event with everyone else.
That's why it was a huge relief to see Gascogne enjoying herself alongside the rest of Polaris.
Thanks to you, I was able to fight and sing harder than I ever thought was possible.
I wonder if I was able to push the limits of your new rigging, even by just a little...?
That's true. The one thing that everyone has had in common today... is that they all had a good time.
We hold exercises like these every day, and the fighting isn't really much different, but there's something about these concerts that changes the whole experience.
Anyway, we've already come this far. Let's see things through to the end. Everyone's fine with that, I hope!
Requesting directives on how to "be more honest."
If you're trying to express your emotions to the Master in the most straightforward manner possible, there is someone here who is exceptionally adept at that.
Did I hear something?
Ahaha...
Rest Area
Good work, Gascogne! Your performance today was magnificent!
Gascogne's functions are stable. Further combat is possible.
Err, that's not it, didn't you hear from Richelieu? She's worried that you're pushing yourself too hard, and wanted to make sure that you're getting enough rest!
Hwuh? Did I say something I wasn't supposed to...? Well, here, Dunkerque made some refreshments for you!
Receiving refreshments with gratitude.
Even though everything is fine right now, everyone back home is looking forward to hearing your emotion-filled singing.
Reviewing feasibility of proposal.
That's not to say that your singing right now is lacking in emotion, though. However, how do I put it...
Assessment: Relevance of "emotion" in armament testing cannot be determined.
As for the determination of whether or not to activate the emotion module during the test...
Um, I think it's fine not to worry about that right now. You're doing fine just the way you are.
Isn't it better to just take everything in and enjoy yourself? I'm sure everyone else feels the same way, so you should try to show it!
Come on, Le Téméraire, let's not bother Gascogne...
Hwuh? S-sorry!
Cannot determine necessity of apology.
It's better to... enjoy myself...?
Experimental Armament Testing Grounds
Come, come! Our concert-battles are about to come to an explosive finale, nya! We will soon be finished with the test runs for the Muse System, nya!
Did everyone have a chance to pick up some merchandise during the downtime, nya? How about refilling your supplies, nya? If you want to step out for some fresh air, this would be the time do it, nya!
We're ready!!
All right, let's get on with the latter part of the show! Next, I'll be introducing your rival for this round, nya!
I'm the Special-Type Idol that's taking the world by snowstorm - Fubuki! My energetic performances will ring out more brilliantly than anyone else's!
Wow, look at all the Special-type destroyers who've come out to cheer for me! Heyyy, Ayanami~! Inazuma, Ikazuchi~! I'll do my best~!
By the way, Akatsuki! Remind Hibiki to buy an extra copy of my photo portrait for me~!
Thanks for promoting my services, but you still need to finish your introduction, nya! But we're out of time! Next up is...
Eldridge and the kitties... are in Idol Mode...
Nya?! This is going to be the most exciting match yet! I can't wait for the next round to start, nya!
Eldridge...! Looks like we'll be facing another formidable opponent!
There are only two battles left. All we have to do is hold out a bit longer.
Indeed. I expect that our equipment will be nearing its limit soon.
Hmph. That's exactly what we want!
Affirmative!
Eldridge's idol outfit... isn't bunny-like at all...
Argh... Our plan to spread the gospel of Planet Bunny...
...There's no way we can change everything to Planet Kitty... has anyone even heard of that before...? Ugh, what should we do...
Benson?
It's nothing, I'm just venting to myself! All right, we just have to bite the bullet and get behind this "Kitty Idol!"
I'll let the whole world know the pedigree of the super-cute top-tier idol trainer, Benson!
Gascogne! What are you doing...?
Yes, Gascogne used to believe that the purpose of this event was to conduct armament trials.
But I was mistaken. The purpose of this was not just to fight, but for everyone to have fun...!
That's what... I have to also release my emotions, and enjoy myself with all my might!
...I am pleased to hear your decision.
Booyah! Let's keep smiling and laughing until the very end!
Come on, Polaris! You're facing the Special-type Idol, Fubuki, and the Railgun Idol, Eldridge!
Eldridge... is a kitty idol... not a railgun idol...
Eh...? Our idol names won't match up then...
Fubuki... snow idol...?
Snow is fine and good, but what does that have to do with kitties? Gah... we've got to come up with something...
Meow meow... Fubuki, you can be the cluck cluck idol...
What...? That actually doesn't sound too bad... actually, that sounds terrible! I'm not doing that ever again!
Haah... What are you two going on about...
Their teamwork seems about as off as ours was at first.
Scanning for fowl elements in Fubuki's outfit. Results: 0% match.
Well, it's a long story that you weren't around for...
Fubuki, hurry up and pick a name already. Otherwise, we can't get started.
I'm very sorry! ? Let's try this again then...
Come on, Polaris! You're facing the Special-type Idol, Fubuki, and the Kitty Idol, Eldridge!
Polaris, commencing testing protocol... Live battle, begin!
You got me good...!
... (Eldridge's antenna-hair seemed to curl into a thumbs-up shape)
Phew... We managed to squeeze out another win!
By the looks of things, we've pushed our Muse System to their limits.
Fubuki, the Sakura Empire is proud of your effort today. I'm sure the other Special-Type girls will be overjoyed.
Ehehe! Even though I lost, it doesn't feel half bad~
Gascogne... did you have fun?
Affirmative! I mean, yes... I did!
I don't feel like just another warship setting off for battle. Being able to prepare for this performance with everyone, and then...
Being able to bring smiles to everyone's faces through our songs and dances... makes me really happy as well!
...Gascogne, you seem a bit different. Well, nothing wrong with that, right? We're about done with our testing as well.
Looking at it from another angle, that must mean that our final opponent must be the toughest of them all!
Yes, but we will see things through to the end. With our Muse System, as Polaris...
The climactic finale that you've all been waiting for is finally here!!
That's right, the next battle will be a challenge to see if we can surpass the limitations of the Muse System. It'll be a performance you can't afford to miss, nya!
Heheh, some of you must be wondering why we haven't announced the last round's participants yet, nya.
The reason is simple - Polaris won't be facing off against any new opponents...
Instead, we're calling everyone from the previous rounds back onto the stage, nya!!
The final round will be an all-out battle with everyone on stage, nya!
Look sharp, Polaris, are you ready, nya?
Just how far can we push the Muse System? The battle to find out begins right meow!
Let's kick off the first day of Passion Fes, nya!
Um, while the main goal of this event is to benchmark the performance of the Muse System compared to the other factions...
There are two other data points that we are interested in collecting, nya!
First, the equipment amplifies in power depending on the number of enemies defeated during a sortie. Hopefully we'll see how far we are able to push this functionality, nya!
I've dubbed this the "Combo System," nya!
In other words, the more victories you rack up in a row, the higher combo you'll be able to achieve, nya.
Conversely, if we're defeated even once, our combo count will reset, right?
That's exactly right, nya! The next thing is fighting through song, nya!
The Muse System is equipped with a special module that uses a lead's vocal feedback to affect a broad area, nya!
A what? Lead's vocals?
I was just talking about it, nya. You'll be singing while you fight. That's why it's the lead role, nya.
Indeed. Although it is my wish that the spotlight shines only upon me, no matter where the stage is, there are some things that I cannot control.
Since this is for also for the sake of our alliance, I'll wait until the end of this experiment.
Huh? If you wanted the role so badly, why not just go for it?
That would not be productive for testing the Muse System's functionalities.
Analysis: This event is also an opportunity to perform in front of Master.
In any case... Let's resolve this by selecting a different lead for different areas!
Who's up first?
Fine, fine! In that case, I'll volunteer for it! Akashi, is that fine with you?
Anyone will do, nya! Anyway, let's begin testing the rigging's performance right meow!
I think I understand the power behind this equipment.
Hmm? Did you only realize it just now? ...To be honest, this equipment doesn't even feel like a significant upgrade compared to what we normally use.
Indeed. Although there are some slight differences in performance, there is no point in changing the fundamental framework of our equipment.
Well, there are only so many changes that can be made at one time. Our hulls somewhat limit what is possible...
Your observations are both correct and incorrect.
So far, we've used the Muse System for two primary purposes...
First, we've used it as a "weapon" during tests and simulations.
Second, we've used it like we did today, to spread joy through music.
Comparing these two side by side, the second use has demonstrated significantly better performance, which means...
That's right. The Muse System was not meant to be used by "warships," but rather by us as people. "Humans."
...Plausibility of Akagi's hypothesis: High.

Historical analysis shows that the Muse System was developed not to defeat Sirens, but rather to counteract the Sirens's song. Therefore, its functionality is not to serve as a weapon, but as an instrument.
Anthropological analysis shows that playing musical instruments and enjoying music with good company are hallmarks of human emotion.
Therefore, one can infer that that the strength of Muse System scales directly with the strength of one's emotions.
Akagi, this concludes the analysis...!
Gascogne...
That's fine and all, but... What are we going to do next? You know that all the other girls will be going all out during the final battle.
Yeah, I think we've already established that. Right?
Indeed. To be frank, while we may describe these activities as "battles," there are no winners or losers because in the end, this is just an armament trial run.
Similarly, there are no allies or enemies either.
Affirmative. We participated in this event as Polaris, a group of warships.
But as "people" who experience emotions, we should not leave behind any regrets...
Therefore, let us fight with all our might, and have fun at the same time!
The Dragon Sisters are back! After studying everyone's battles, we're no longer amateurs to the scene!
I'm supercharged with the food that our fans gave us! I feel like I can do anything!
Do your best, Ning Hai, Ping Hai~!
Win or lose, remember to give me your autographs~!
Polaris... is crazy strong, but...
We've also become stronger.
Yeah! If we all stick together, there's no way Polaris can beat all of us!
Saratoga and Funf also took the time to offer me their guidance. I won't let their efforts go to waste during the finale!
You go, girl! Professionals never stop giving it their all 'til the curtains fall!
I won't permit anyone to bully my precious Spee!!
Deutschland... it's just a concert...
I can relate with her though. I want all the other Special-Type destroyers to win as well!
Fubuki... you're the only one participating though...?
Hmph! We're not scared of you at all just because you have the numbers advantage!
All those who would dare interrupt my performance... Ahahahaha~!
Wow, this is really shaping up to be a proper final battle! Gascogne, are you ready to go?
Directives confirmed! Optimizing singing output...!
Give me more! This can't be all that the Muse System is capable of!
Their new riggings are still active!
I can still... keep singing!
All right, let's take this to the encore then!
Mhm! Everyone is still cheering us on from back at the port!
Don't count Javelin out just yet!
Laffey... is feeling a little more motivated...
I wouldn't have it any other way!
We've reached the Muse System's limit...! Singing protocol powering down...
*gasp*... You're right... I don't think... I can go any further...
They're burning out...
Phew... that was enough thrill for a lifetime!
...Nya?
Unyaaaaa! The whole venue is exploding in applause, nya!!
The two sides seem to be evenly matched, and I'm not sure we can crown a winner just yet, nya!
Hm? There's no need to crown a winner in the first place, nya? I just remembered, nya!
It's not like I was trying to drum up drama on purpose, nya! This whole thing was an armament test in the first place, so it's just the battle format, nya!
Ahem! We've finished collecting data on the Muse System, nya! We'll send everything over to the Naval Headquarters after a few days, nya!
As for the performances... everyone's probably burnt out right now, so we'll save the reports until later... Sounds good, nya?
However, any participants who want to continue their idol activities after today will be permitted to do so, nya!
Yayyyy!!
This way, we'll be able to enjoy everyone's cute outfits and wonderful music for a few more days, nya! Thanks for everything, nya!
Hopefully one day, we'll have an event featuring all of our existing idols as well, nya! Look forward to it, nya!
Thanks again for making this possible, nya!!
Testing on the Muse System will probably still continue for a while.
Indeed. Akagi, if you will it so, I can request a change in the testing personnel.
That won't be necessary, Kaga.
Akagi...?
The Muse System has shown reliability in a live combat setting. Don't you think it would be a waste to not implement it?
Besides, after I went through all this effort to get dolled up, it would be a shame if the Commander did not get to gaze upon me a bit longer... right?
R-right...
But, more importantly...
I had a good time, Polaris. Hehe~
"Orpheus played his lyre, and the Sirens were so engrossed with the beautiful melodies that they forgot to sing."
What a heartwarming tale.
In order to protect their beloved Argo from the Sirens, the human bravely overcame their hardships with the power of music...
But of course, it was not the ship that was threatened by the Sirens' song, just the sailors on the ship.
If they really cared about protecting the ship, wouldn't it have been better to tie themselves down, just like Odysseus?
What would one expect of human resolve though?
This story is just a tiny fragment, unrelated to the greater war. Nothing more than an insignificant little fragment.
If you don't mind, could I ask you to continue to watch over them?
It's finally time for us to make our grand debut! All right, slow and easy...
Sis, I'm hungry... Can I grab something to eat first?
Hey, hang in there a bit longer! If our concert goes well, I'll let you have as many pork buns as you can stomach!
As many as I can stomach...?! All right, I'll do it!
That's the spirit! We have to blow everyone away with our performance...!
(We're representing the entire Dragon Empery! We can't afford to put on an unsightly performance that would cause everyone back home to lose face!)
Sis, Polaris is here!
If I'm not mistaken... Umm, you two are the Dragon Sisters, right?
Well met, Polaris! We challenge you to a battle!
All right, all right, let's get to work...
Show us what you're made of, Dragon Sisters!
I'll show you what happens when you underestimate our power!
Laffey... is shleepy... I wanna go home...
Ehh?! But we're only getting started! Get your act together, Laffey!
Ah! Look, our opponents are over there!
The Muse System... packs a bigger punch than I expected...
Hang in there, sis...!
Ugh... that new experimental rigging seems really powerful...
But, Javelin didn't come here to lose! I'll always shine the brightest, no matter on the battlefield or on stage!
Well said, Javelin!
Ehehe, thanks for the support~! Come on, Laffey, you too!
Fine... I'll say the line...
Laffey came from Usamin... Everyone, please give me lots of support... Actually, just a little support is fine...
Laffey, you're supposed to speak up when giving your self-introduction! Commander will be watching us as well~!
Laffey... will do her best...! Let's get motivated...!
I do think there's something charming about a complete inability to get motivated though.
Ning Hai and I will be cheering for all of you!
Polaris, let's dazzle the crowd!
All righty! Hehe, let's not hold anything back!
Meanwhile, in the stands...
Woah, Ning Hai and Ping Hai totally blew my mind~ I've never seen such an exciting concert before! Am I dreaming? Someone pinch me~
Who knows, but that's a fairly normal reaction to a concert~
They might not have said much, but you can tell how hard those two worked to get up on stage today.
Chang Chun, should I grab the signing boards? They're gonna be worth good money after those two get rich and famous, hehe!
I don't think you should count your chickens before they hatch...
Besides, getting signatures just so you can scalp them is kind of scummy...
Fine, I'll shelf the idea until they actually get famous! Besides, I know Ning Hai wouldn't pass up an opportunity to sell these things!
I never thought I'd see the day when the Dragon Empery stands on the same stage as all the other global powers...
Yat Sen...?
Rather than fighting as warships, they're standing on stage as brightly-shining idols, capturing everyone's hearts...
It's like a dream come true...
Concluding joint armament and singing testing protocols.
Hehe, that felt great! However, we're the ones who will be taking home the gold!
The first round was full of excitement from the get-go, nya!
I could feel the entire ocean sizzling with your passion, nya!
Even though we lost, at least we got to show Commander and the others how hard we worked!
Tactical victory pose...
Look, sis, An Shan and the others came out to see us!
They really did...!
Meanwhile, after the first test concert, Akagi stood alone, silently looking at her Muse System.
("The power of ideals..." So, this is the Muse System...)
Akagi? Did something happen?
Nothing in particular. Let's head to the next venue.
"Ideals"... Everyone's "emotions"...
Experimental Armament Testing Grounds
I heard the concert went on for quite some time. Is everyone all rested and resupplied, nya?
No matter how excited you are about the performances, remember that you're here to test the new rigging, nya!
For the next phase, I'll have someone help explain... Saratoga from the Eagle Union, nya!
The magical girl idol, Sister Sara, has arrived!
Whether on the battlefield or on stage, I'll bewitch you with my magic! Good to see you, everyone~♪
To be honest, I wanted to bring my sister along, but unleashing the forbidden Sara Double Trouble against your experimental rigging would be overkill!
In other words, I'll be putting on a solo performance today...
Just kidding! Joining me will be Zed, from the Iron Blood, and Ayanami, from the Sakura Empire!
Sister Sara will be carefully checking the power of your new armaments, so look forward to it~♪
Oh, Lexington! I'm glad you could make it, even if it's just as a spectator~♪
Professionals are truly terrifying! Her every movement and mannerism is perfect, nya!
Heheh, isn't it about time we got this show on the road?
All right, let's start the music!
Recalibration based upon Saratoga's speech: Significant motivation differential detected between opponent and Polaris.
Didn't I say that pros shouldn't be allowed at this event...? Combat effectiveness aside, there's no way we can compete with her stage presence.
Correct. However, combat effectiveness and performing skills are not the only things that matter.
Sheffield...?
Do we have some alternate win condition...?
What should we do then?
We will take advantage of the moment the enemy's advantage seems insurmountable and...
Sheffield pulled her microphone cable taut.
If you can't muster your own momentum, then you'll have to turn the enemy's against them.
Polaris, Saratoga, do your best!
Dewey, your skirt!
Eek! S-sorry, I got a bit too excited there...
Don't worry, it's fine. We've all got to do our best to cheer everyone on, right?
Yeah...! When I see Lexington cheering alongside us, it's as if energy keeps welling up from within me!
Ahh... I want to be able to dance on that stage too...
Come to think of it, I've been wondering ever since our practice sessions began, but why did we get chosen for Polaris?
Hm? What do you mean by that?
Aren't there several proper idols in the fleet? Many of them have ample musical experience, yet they chose a complete amateur like me.
That's a good point... but didn't Akashi say they chose at random?
Gascogne is equipped with modular protocols, allowing change of modes depending on the conditions. Assessment: Gascogne is very suitable for experimental armament trials.

Furthermore, regarding vocals: It is possible to adjust external appearance and vocal range by fine-tuning the keel structure, which is beneficial to testing the relationship between ship structure and music.
...I'm happy for you and I'm going to let you finish, but I don't think the rest of us can do stuff like that.
Anyways, I'm not an expert on these matters like Bismarck, so I'm just speculating.
Let's leave it at that. There's no point staying on this subject.
Though some of us in the Sakura Empire were involved with the development of the Muse System, we had no control over the selection process.
I have a feeling that the Muse System isn't the only thing being tested. We, as Polaris, are as well.
In short, we just have to keep things as they are.
That's right. Let's focus on finishing our test run first, shall we?
(That's right... This will determine whether or not the Muse System can be used on our ships...)
Ayanami, we're over here!
Akagi, and Polaris... We're not going to lose to you.
Miss Hipper! W-well met! L-let's do our best to successfully carry out this rigging test!
Zed, your stage introduction...
Ah, that's right! Ahem! Here I go...
"I'm the hardworking idol, Ayanami. I'm 120% energetic and cute, so keep your eyes on me!" ...Yes.
"My song is the Messiah, and my dance is the Undine. I am the idol, Z23, and I shall capture your adoration for all of eternity..."
...Who taught you that? Was it Z35 or Z36?
Ack?!
Miss Saratoga... the operation has failed due to cringe.
...It looks like we won't even have to do anything. The venue's excitement level has already dropped three bars.
Calm down, Zed! You're too nervous! You can't allow yourself to get caught up in your opponent's pace while you're on stage!
I'm sorry...
Don't worry, Zed.
Well, at least the nerves seem to have eased up on both sides. We won't have to worry about that stuff now.
From here on out, we'll be getting to the actual performance and testing phase! Hehe, if you think we're still struggling to use our new equipment, you'll be in for a surprise!
Mhm! We'll do everything we can to ensure the trial run is as successful as possible!
Long Island and I didn't pull an all-nighter studying idol performances for nothing... I'll show you the fruits of our research!
We lost, but... it was still fun.
Even if we ignore the Muse System, fighting while taking the stage performance aspect into consideration a departure from what we're used to.
I felt like we were actually having fun with each other rather than battling as warships. As a result, I was able to push my limits further than usual.
Heheh! You have Sister Sara's special training to thank for that!
Yes. Considering we were just two destroyers, we put up a very good fight.
Ayanami, let's go join up with Javelin and the others?
Ah, everyone in Polaris, don't worry about us! Keep moving on to your next test!
Observation: In live combat, the performance of Muse System differs from default specifications.
Yeah, there's no doubt that fighting with the Muse System feels different. I'd say that it's a bit easier to use...
Agreed. There should be virtually no substantial differences in how our equipment handles.
Gascogne's combat operation patterns do not differ from specifications in trials and simulations.
Hmm, in other words, you haven't changed the way you fight, but you can still tell that the equipment handles differently?
Affirmative.
What Gascogne said is convincing... This Muse System is fundamentally different from the regular equipment we use.
(As I expected... As Kansen, our equipment does not vary significantly as long as it's constrained by our hull and core structure.)
(Until today, the Muse System did not perform much differently from our normal equipment...)
(That means that whatever phenomenon triggered this was not present before.)
(In that case, what is the reason behind this phenomenon...? What was different about today?)
The following information is highly speculative and may not be worthy of reference:
When carrying out anti-Siren combat protocols, Gascogne's emotion module is often suppressed as much as possible in order to stabilize combat efficacy.
In the previous test battle, the emotion module was suppressed as part of normal combat protocol.
However, activity in emotion module was still significantly higher than normal.
Sorry, but I didn't catch any of that...
In other words, you were having fun, right?
You're way too roundabout with how you talk...
Offering apologies for my explanation method. "I'm sorry."
However, in the event that activation of Gascogne's emotion module is necessary for the equipment testing...
Please issue the command.

sequence:
One day, with Polaris...

<size=45>One day, at rehearsal...</size>

scripts.say: This is a story of Polaris, not long after they were formed...
Let's get today's practice session underway!
Yeah!
Why do I only hear Cleveland? Where are the rest of you?!
Query: What is the purpose of crying out in this situation?
Sigh... I'm afraid without my Commander here, I simply can't arouse my passions...
Forgive me. I find it too humiliating.
Aaaagh! You're all impossible! How did I get stuck with you lot?!
...and that's the story nya! We're gonna need you to do some proper music band rehearsing type stuff nya!
Brand new band, Polaris, doing their first group rehearsal nya! Got a real ring to it nya! Break a leg nya! Commander's rooting for you too nya!
When I agreed to do testing on new experimental equipment, I never thought it meant joining a band.
I certainly never thought they would put us together in such a... motley crew.
