scripts.say: When I talk to King George V, I sometimes feel like she is the de facto leader of the Royal Navy.
During a sortie...
Interesting attack you have there!
Stay calm! Make no mistakes. I shall ensure both victory and the safety of all my comrades!
Even on the battlefield, she often leads the forces of the Royal Navy.
Port - Harbor Entrance
Let's get this shipment over to Warehouse #3.
Also, make sure to let the Eagle Union representative know that our joint exercise is still on for next week. Even though Her Majesty will be out, I'll take charge in her stead.
She even takes care of many of the responsibilities normally handled by Queen Elizabeth...
Port - Main Plaza
Norfolk, is everything all right? Did you have a bad dream?
Uhh... Don't think so...
If there's something on your mind, let's hear it. Maybe I might be able to help.
...Sure!
Even during her leisure time, she still helps others work out their problems or conflicts.
Port - Royal Navy Dorms
Are you saying that King George V acts more like Her Majesty than, well, Her Majesty?
While dining with some members of the Royal Navy, I candidly offered my observations from the last few days to Hood.

options.content: That isn't what I was trying to get at...

scripts.say: Perhaps she should be more aware of her boundaries. What say you, George?
No, Commander, thank you for being frank with your observations. If those were the conclusions you made, then we indeed have a problem.
I see... That may not have been my intention at all, but if the Commander made that observation, then surely others must have as well.
As she said this, she emerged from the kitchen with plates of freshly-prepared food in her hands.

sequence:
Another Leader?

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Let's get this shipment over to Warehouse.</size>

scripts.say: Don't you agree, George? If you shine too brightly, you may find yourself eclipsing Her Majesty.
Having that said, the Royal Navy is full of unique personalities, like Wales and Duke of York...
Being strong in both body and personality is a good thing indeed.
But your charismatic personality is particularly problematic. You'll cause trouble for Her Majesty if you aren't careful.
Are you trying to say that I'd cause...
That's right. If you think from the perspective of others such as the Commander...
Your character overlaps too much with Her Majesty's...
The temperature in the room seemed to drop by a few degrees.
Within the Royal Navy, we all know what kind of person you are. You do not act out of lofty ambitions, but rather because you were born with a big heart and a sense of duty.
But what if you were another leader, such as Nagato, Bismarck, Avrora, or even the Commander?
What would they think when they see you vying for power with Her Majesty, and how would they react to that?
...That sounds a bit terrifying, if you phrase it like that...
(Wow, I didn't even think it was that serious...)
Haha, I merely jest. However, the problem that the Commander posed is very real, and in order to resolve that–
Hood stood from her seat and walked between King George V and myself, pointing us towards each other before giving an elegant curtsy.
You must let the Commander learn more about you, George.
But not as friends, nor as commander and secretary. What you two need is a much deeper bond.
Hmm... I think I understand.
Heheh~ George, you'll have to show some of your "soft side" to the Commander.
Come again...?
Huh? King George V has a "soft side?"
Commander, why don't you try cooking for her?

sequence:
Another Leader?

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Tonight's Supper</size>

scripts.say: As a result of Hood's proposal, I suddenly found myself trying to cook for King George V.
Commander, do you know how to cook?

options.content: I've poured myself a bowl of cereal before.
I wouldn't get my hopes up.

scripts.say: Heh. Let's see what you're capable of then.
I see. Well, in any case, this is a good opportunity to learn a useful skill.
You can always grab one of the Maids to help you.
With that, the kitchen became a much livelier place.
I started with the basics, such as learning how to handle vegetables and eggs.
Then I prepared them on the skillet...
... and finally, plated my freshly-made omelet!
I carried my creation over to King George V.

options.content: I'd like you to try this.

scripts.say: This is... scrambled eggs?
She poked at the dish in front of her with curiosity before lifting some to her lips.
Hmm... Commander, it'll take a lot more practice before you can hope to satisfy my palate.
(Well, that was to be expected. This person is capable of crafting dishes fit for a Queen, so of course she'd be on a completely different level from me...)
However...
The fact that you prepared this dish especially for me... is quite the delicious seasoning.
King George V smiled at me warmly, almost as if...
... the person in front of me was not my secretary ship, a Knight Commander, or one of the most charismatic leaders in the Royal Navy — but rather, just an ordinary girl who enjoyed cooking.
And with that, I caught a glimpse of her "soft side."
I turned back towards the kitchen to continue my training.
One day, I would make something that she would acknowledge as truly delicious.

sequence:
Another Leader?

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Heart's Desire</size>

scripts.say: Port - Royal Navy Dorms
One day, King George V asked me to prepare supper at the Royal Navy dorms — my biggest test yet since I started to learn how to cook for her sake.
So this supper is the culmination of the Commander's hard work? Let's give it a try.
Hood sized up my cooking, before bringing a bite to her mouth elegantly.
Not bad at all, Commander. I can taste the effort that you've put into this.
Hood, I must offer you my gratitude.
Oh? For what, may I ask?
This whole thing. Starting from the Commander's misconception, no... the fact that you recognized that I was overstepping my boundaries.
Heehee. I don't recall doing any such thing~
Although the Commander was the one who put in the effort, all of this is possible today because of the advice you gave.
This method of yours — getting to know each other better by sharing your soft side — really worked out well.
Yes, it's well suited for you.
Indeed, it wasn't only our relationship that improved. When word spread that I had been cooking for her, she seemed much more approachable and relatable in the eyes of the other factions.
Hahaha! I can't deny that!
While joking merrily with Hood, she turned her face towards me and smiled.
In any case, thank you as well for doing all of this for me, Commander.
There's a saying that "the quickest way to one's heart is through their stomach." In my case though, you've managed to win over both at once... Hahaha...
Oh my...
Ahh, um, sorry. I didn't mean to spring that upon you all of a sudden. I'll try to read the mood better next time...
I'm not as easygoing as Wales, nor am I as forceful as Duke of York.
But I'm not good at letting go of people who manage to earn my trust.
She may have grown quite a lot through our time together, but some things never change. Her straightforward and earnest confession was charismatic and irresistible.
I smiled at her, looking forward to the many culinary adventures that we would have together.

sequence: Pristine Leaves, Rich Warmth

scripts.say: Early in the morning, I arrive at a garden per Yat Sen's invitation.
There she is, brewing tea amidst the budding greenery of late spring, the delicate aroma from the tea leaves swirling around her.
Welcome, Commander.
Please take a seat. I'll have the tea ready for you in just a moment.
Hm? Did you notice the aroma of the tea leaves on your way here? That means you're about to enjoy a particularly high-quality batch~
Heehee, there's no need to rush. Patience is necessary to fully bring out the essence in these leaves.
Once submerged, the tea leaves slowly unfold as they are embraced by the dew of time, and thus their essence gradually dissolves into the warm water.
Though we won't have to wait too long, shall we talk about something to pass the time?

options.content: "Can you tell me more about this tea?"
"How long does it take to brew this tea?"

scripts.say: Indeed. Whenever I have time to myself, I enjoy brewing tea by myself and enjoying the tranquility of nature.
If I were to borrow the words of my ancestors... "Invite the moon at night for company, face alone the twilight before sunrise," or something like that?
Of course, I've been refining my tea-brewing techniques ever since I invited you here.
Since you've taken time out of your busy schedule to be with me, I hope I will be able to show you proper hospitality with the best tea.
This is called Longjing tea.
The flavor is subtle, with an orchid-like dignity and a refreshing aroma that uplifts your heart. It is my favorite.
If you would, Commander– "A cup filled, with no reason in mind; presented to those who love tea."
It is a most wonderful place. It is peaceful and elegant, and when the sun shines warmly in the sky, it makes your heart sing.
Is it to your liking as well, Commander? I'm glad to hear that. You're welcome to visit me whenever you'd like.
Whether it's enjoying tea, reading poetry, or taking in the night scenery together, I'm always willing to keep you company.
It takes a while to draw out the aroma, but one must be careful not to brew for too long.
If the tea leaves are steeped for too long, the color will become dull, the fragrance will fade due to oxidation, and the essence of the tea will be lost.
And, of course, the taste will turn bitter. As they say, all things in moderation.
While some people enjoy this kind of taste, do be careful to watch the time carefully if you wish to fully appreciate the aroma.
A similar principle applies in how you treat your friends. Though, I'm sure you're already well-versed in that, heehee.
I am handed a glass-colored teacup filled with the completed tea– the hot water, replete with the tea's essence, produces a rich white steam that wafts through the air.
It's ready now, Commander. Please enjoy.

Hang on, CAN you even beat this thing? Seems a little unfair to the players!
CLICK...
Hold on, someone from the host booth just... Wait, could it be? Supervisor Ryu Lion has joined the battle!
Holy cow, look how fast she is! She's clearing all the obstacles! They don't even have the chance to start up!
Heck, she's too fast for my commentary to keep up! She's made it to the final boss in a blink!
Now in the skies of the distant forest... Luminous Wind!
KABOOOM!
Nyaaa! My attractiooon, nyaaa!
Thank you, Ryu! We had so much fun! The boss felt a bit cheaty, but the rest of it was really exciting!
Please, I didn't do anything to deserve such thanks.
Moreover, this dungeon didn't...
She held the crystal medal in her hand, and gazed at the girls excitedly taking on the dungeon.
...Contain any real enemies.

sequence: Iris Orthodoxy - Holy Capital
Azur Lane Temporary Command Center
A few weeks after the World Expo incident

scripts.say: Ample space, fancy furnishings, a fluffy carpet, and fresh pastries...
The place looks more like the salon of a top-tier hotel than any kind of command center.
Since the reunion of the Iris Orthodoxy, the question of how they will rejoin the Azur Lane has been put on the agenda.
Richelieu has invited me to aid with the inter-faction negotiations.
I've been staying in Europa for quite some time now, serving as a representative of the Azur Lane.
Although, calling them "negotiations" is stretching the word. It's mostly lip service.
It feels more like I'm on vacation than on the job, really.
In fact, it reminds me of another time when I had it similarly cushy.
It was back at the Academy, when I was taking some time off.
I was with New Jersey and Saratoga, and it was something like...

sequence: Europa - Elsewhere
Azur Lane Special Naval Academy
In the past

scripts.say: And that's it for the introduction to the modules of riggings and aircraft! Though, we still have some time left before the class ends, so...
Okay! Flip to chapter 7 in your classbooks.
Before I explain the auxiliary equipment for aircraft carrier combat, I wanna first introduce how carriers fight in a formation.
Now, we'll only be touching on this briefly today, so don't forget to read further during the holidays!
"Aircraft carriers are ships that deliver firepower not with large-caliber cannons, but rather with their namesake aircraft..."
"The arrival of the aircraft carrier officially signaled the end of the Sirens' dominion of the skies over our seas..."
"One characteristic about their usage is that they are often deployed not alone, but concentrated in one place together with several other carriers..."
"Combining an escort fleet with a task force centered around aircraft carriers allows one to better leverage their advantages and increase their force multiplier..."
Indeed... This represents quite a paradigm shift in naval strategy.
Heheh! You have a discerning eye, Commander.
Aircraft carriers are the future!
I wouldn't count on it. Battleships will get thicker armor, and they'll be able to equip bigger guns.
Meanwhile, a single hit to the flight deck prevents a carrier from recovering her aircraft.
That's without even mentioning how hard it is to restock the aircraft and how ineffective they are at piercing thick Siren armor. Battleships are just better.
It sounds like you weren't paying attention to my lesson at all, New Jersey!
Go back and read the introduction and foreword again!
Hmph! If your rigging wasn't in the middle of an upgrade, I'd take you to the exercise area and teach you a thing or two!
Funny you mention that, because the upgrade in question is for my armor and firepower.
Besides, what point is there in studying carrier tactics? When am I ever gonna use this knowledge?
When you're commanding your own fleet!
This IS a course on tactics and commanding. Don't forget why you came here!
It's not like I want to be here in the first place. Missouri made me...
Then why don't I call and tell her you're arguing with me?
Anything but that! I'll pay attention during class, promise!
Thought as much... What a waste of class time. As I was going to say–
The bell rings, signaling the end of the school term.
Oh! That's the bell! Can we go home now?
Fine, fine. That's it for this term, then.
Clean up at your desks before you go. Enjoy your holidays, everyone.
*knock knock*
Sara, are you finished yet?
Hi, Lex! Yeah, I just got done! Let's go!
By the way, I booked a table at a nice restaurant. Might as well enjoy our last day in Europa before we go home, right?
Sounds great! Will we be fine on time, though? I don't wanna miss the plane.
Don't worry, it won't take off until we've all boarded. That's the convenience of a chartered flight for you.
You even arranged for that? You're the best! Now let's get going!
Saratoga was so much more like a teacher back then.
The battle in the Coral Sea really changed her.
The Type II rigging was able to stop the corrosion of Yorktown's hull, but sadly it didn't work out for Lexington after what happened in that Reenactment.
Our efforts to popularize the Type II haven't exactly bore fruit, either.
Meanwhile, Lexington is still stuck inside that life-support system...
I can only hope that the new research they're doing at the Sea of Stars will go smoothly.
Hang in there, Lexington. I will save you...
Inside the Camelot Mirror Sea...
Arches one through three have all been reinforced.
Now let's see the new area extensions.
Your Majesty, don't you think you should step outside for a while? You have such a large backlog of letters of invitation that even your desk cannot accommodate any more.
Then just get another desk!
This is more important than attending some trifling gatherings!
I am going nowhere until every risk with the gate has been eliminated!
Nowhere, I say! Nowhere! Is that clear?
Now, where was I? Oh, yes, the Red Rose Block, the White Rose Block, and the Thistle Block, where we are to establish defence systems...
Say, Vanguard, how long has Elizabeth been like this?
Since she returned from the Iris' reunification ceremony. Although, she was already showing signs during the Hood incident.
Oi! I'm not "showing signs" of anything, Vanguard!
But if I was, blame Clemenceau!
*sigh*... Forget it. Up next, the new central structure to replace the castle – The Queen's Crown.
Once everything is complete, the gate's defences will be flawless.
Warspite, if you've nothing better to do, you may go home.
And Valiant, there is much work that needs doing, I'm sure. You may deal with that.
Heheheh! Well, you leave me with no choice but to comply, Your Majesty!
Very well... I will be back again tomorrow, Your Majesty.
This is quite an interesting defensive device you've built.
Are you sure it's such a good idea to speak? My attendants only just left.
It's alright. They can't hear us, only you can.
We must say, you are impressive, other Elizabeth. In just the span of a few weeks, you've already come this far.
That being said, what you have now won't be nearly sufficient for the disaster you are soon to face.
It's shocking that what happened in the Mediterranean happened at all, considering how scientifically primitive your branch is.
The light released by that multilayering event was so intense that we could detect it even in our branch.
It's for that reason we can confidently say your world is being targeted by a danger of even greater magnitude.
Ordinarily, the Sirens would have initiated the branch reset process by now, but they haven't. That concerns us.
Perhaps their lack of response isn't a fluke. Perhaps they've decided that your branch is beyond saving.
Let us remind you that we have the ability to relocate your branch's Royal Navy and all its allies, associates, and resources to a new, safe branch.
If we were you, we'd stop wasting our time and work out an evacuation plan.
I will not.
A queen does not give up without a fight. I will defend this world to my last breath.
If you want to form an alliance with us then come to my world and lend me your bloody strength!
Excuse us? It was you who wanted an alliance, not we.
Me? Really, now?
Sakura Empire - Musashi's Residence
Akagi, I've heard the Prime Sakura incident has been resolved.
The Great Sage regained her hull as Unzen and purged the Shadow of Corruption within the Sakura. Then, a phantom of Amagi appeared.
Not only did we avoid the worst-case scenario, but also you could argue it was a blessing in disguise.
The entire ordeal placed great strain on Lady Nagato, and she will not be able to intervene in our plans for some time.
After Unzen solidified into her own entity, she has been severed from the concept of the Great Sage, and can no longer tap into Watatsumi's conceptual framework.
In other words, with Shinano away in Europa, there is nobody controlling the Watatsumi framework, making it ripe for the picking.
...So you're committed to this.
Unzen and Shinano were both born with a strong connection to Watatsumi, and therefore have an innate power...
What you're trying to do, Akagi, is to forcefully change Watatsumi's nature through your acquired power. That is simply too dangerous.
If you insist that there is no other way, then at least let us, the Yamato class, do it. The spirit of the Sacred Sakura breathes through us.
No, Musashi. This is something only I can do.
Buried beneath the great tree's shade, Amagi's soul has at least been able to remain in this world due to the connection between the Sacred Sakura and Watatsumi.
While it couldn't fix the faults in her hull, it did work as a desperate measure to keep her in this world. You could even call it a move made in anticipation of the current situation.
This is all to say, it has to be me. Only I can do it.
Tell me, what is really on your mind, Musashi? Are you just worried you won't be able to birth your superweapon without Watatsumi?
Don't play dumb with me. Nothing happens without me hearing about it, not even in a Mirror Sea, and especially not in the Sanctuary.
But be that way if you want. It's a good thing if the decisive superweapon you've pinned your hopes on DOES get made.
Just remember this one important thing – your weapon is going to need a core.
...I cannot rely on the Great Sage's power anymore now that the Watatsumi's concept has changed. I am obviously not going to use it on my allies.
Of course. If you say so.
That leaves you with few options. If, in the end, all my efforts come to nothing, I myself shall become the core you need.
That is the last thing I want to happen.
Things will happen whether you like it or not. Even you, in all your wisdom, can't predict what will become of all this.
Once the pieces start moving, there is no stopping them. Whatever happens, happens.
...That's everything I wanted to say.
By now, Amagi's prior soul should have drawn plenty of sustenance from the Sacred Sakura.
It's time to take my plan to the next stage.
...Very well. I hope it goes as you hope.
Interesting. So Akagi's faith in the path she chose is unyielding.
Her choice can be considered the best of the countless ones we've evaluated over the years.
Do you have any misgivings with it, Jintsuu?
With the plan itself? No, none whatsoever.
My only question is if this "Amagi," whose hull you wish to restore to full health, is truly Amagi as you know her.
Bear in mind that what's resting by the Sacred Sakura is only a fragment of her.
The seal on the Shadow of Corruption was broken, and the Watatsumi's essence has undergone change. The fragment of Amagi could not have gone unaffected through all that.
Now, I do understand that the Watatsumi is connected to the Sacred Sakura and that it is analogous to a Wisdom Cube in that it's a manifestation of your collective wishes...
That does not, however, clarify if what you wish for is Amagi herself, or the concept of Amagi.
...Regardless, Akagi is not going to stop.
Indeed, she won't. In the worst case, you'll at least get your core.
Jintsuu, stop. You are not to speak of that.
Forgive me. I won't bring it up again.
...Are you moving forward with your superweapon plan?
That is the idea.
Very well. Then what comes next will be of great importance.
Sakura Empire - Mikasa's Residence
*ka-dunk ka-dunk*
Carts hauling their luggage rattled by outside the building.
...Kawakaze. What is the meaning of this?
It would seem these are Lady Mutsu's carts.
I believe she has come to visit you, Lady Nagato.
Mutsu is visiting? How did she know my whereabouts?
Hmph. Elder Mikasa surely told her.
Yuppers! I'd have had to look for ages if she hadn't told me!
Mutsu, for heavens' sake! I told you and my other associates not to visit! I said I would return in a few days once I feel better!
Elder Mikasa being meddlesome is one thing, but I didn't expect you to come barging in!
Come on, you know it's not right to keep secrets!
You're not just down with a simple cold! You're bedridden because you're constantly overworking yourself!
You need to take six months off to rest!
No, scratch that, a whole year!
In fact, you should go to the Sacred Sakura to get the best rest possible. Then you'll heal faster, and...
Um... Lady Nagato? Is everything okay?
...Minazuki?
Did Mutsu bring you along?
Nah. Well, kind of, but not really.
I met her on the way here. She said she was going to meet you, so we came together.
*sigh*... Mutsu, go and wait in the parlor. Minazuki and I have something to discuss.
You're just looking for an excuse to dismiss me, aren't you?
No! You are right, and I will consider an extended rest later. For now, though, won't you give us a moment?
Okay! Tell me when you're done!
"Well met, Lady Nagato. I applaud how you handled the Sacred Divine."
I did only my duty as the Guardian Fox, Yamato. How fares Unzen?
"She has lost all connection to the Great Sage's concept. She is Unzen the shipgirl once more."
"On the one hand, she has been freed of her duty as keeper of the Watatsumi's seal and may now wander. On the other, it has become impossible for her to connect to the Watatsumi."
I feared as much... Then what comes next?
"Fear not. I have already summoned her to join me."
So she will be staying with you? Good. This puts the mind at ease.
"Heaven's Door will be opened. I beseech you to join us, if possible, Lady Nagato."
I cannot, sadly. There is still something here I must do. I will not flee this time.
You said Heaven's Door will open... Is the situation truly so dire?
What have you seen, Yamato?
"...Lady Nagato."
"Recall Zuikaku posthaste, and keep Shimanto close by your side."
"A fire that will scorch the world is coming."

sequence: Secret Tribunal Building
Somewhere in the New Iris Orthodoxy
Underground - Several meters below the surface

scripts.say: How are you feeling, Trento?
Ahahah... Your consideration is appreciated. Thank you.
Um, I haven't been feeling any discomfort at all since yesterday.
Oh, and if you're wondering, I've already taken my medicine today.
That's good of you. Taking your medicine on time is key to eradicating the source of your illness.
Of course. Thank you again so much, Clemenceau.
Don't thank me, thank Marco Polo for leaving all those gifts behind. They're what helped me bring you back to normal.
If she could see you now, I'm sure she'd be over the moon.
I know it's an odd time to ask, but speaking of Marco Polo... How do you feel about what she did?
Well, I still feel a bit like it was all a dream, you know?
I know it wasn't, of course, and my body remembers actually being in the places I "dreamed."
But, truth be told, I still haven't pieced everything together, much less formed an opinion on what she did.
That's understandable. It's fine that you feel that way. If anything, it's good that you do.
How is she, by the way? Marco Polo, I mean.
She's been in a deep sleep ever since her encounter with the Commander. Don't worry, though, she's not in any danger.
Oh... Thank goodness.
Another question for you. Just to be sure – have you been sleeping well? Have you had any odd dreams?
Odd dreams? I mean, most dreams are...
Oh, but in particular, there was one where I was in a strange place.
Really? Tell me about it.
Everything I saw was white as snow, even the sky and the sea.
I was on a white beach, and there were Venus combs everywhere...
Venus combs? But your META symptoms from the superimposition should all be gone...
Maybe there is some other connection between you and the META Trento...
Sorry, I'm rambling. Have you been hearing anything in your dreams?
Hearing? No, nothing in particular. Why? Are those Venus combs supposed to speak?
Maybe. I don't know.
If by any chance they do speak to you, be sure to let me know.
Marco Polo's safety... No, the safety of every person in this branch depends on it.
We're counting on you, Trento.
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
A land devoid of life came into view.
A mechanical city expanded unimpeded while something banged incessantly, like the second hand on a clock.
Metals and organics, the natural and the artificial, even the sea and the sky were disassembled, restructured, and rebuilt.
Some of it went into a materials pile in the middle of the city.
Other bits and pieces coalesced into the city itself.
Seems the Lovers' work has reached the conversion stage.
I've come at just the right time, then.
One branch's worth of resources in reserve should improve our probability of victory.
Empress, abandoning test site beta is strictly forbidden.
There is content yet to be verified by the Natural Calculation System. Prepare to mount a defense.
Calculations show that the defense is exceedingly unlikely to succeed and thus deemed an irrational choice.
Yet Zero insists on it anyway... What is she thinking? Is she making a mistake on purpose?
We Arbiters are allowed to make mistakes, unlike low-level programs...
Is that her goal with this?
...It doesn't matter. I have my orders.
Ah, Empress. I sent a vessel your way as soon as I got your message.
I assume we're working together on this?
Correct. We're going to establish a defensive line around test site beta.
After that, we'll take the lower-level programs in the area and run a verification test for Zero.
What's the cutoff?
When Zero is satisfied with the results, or when we're wiped out.
I see...
I'm happy to assist, then.
Northern Parliament - Forward Operating Base
Siste– Pardon. Comrade Soyuz, welcome to our frontline base.
If you'll excuse me for skipping the pleasantries, but how is the situation with the Iris Orthodoxy?
While it's still in a delicate balance, Avrora and Pamiat' can handle Europa.
Our most pertinent objective lies here, in the Polar Sea.
Indeed. It was good that you happened to be near the Mediterranean when that near-disaster happened.
I didn't "happen" to be there. All of us were stationed there.
...What do you mean?
Nothing. Forget I mentioned it. More importantly, how is the mission progressing?
If I remember right, Kursk reported that an unidentified META had appeared in remote waters at the same time as the Mediterranean crisis happened, yes?
Yes, ma'am. A fleet was dispatched to conduct reconnaissance.
However, the META did not appear again until we had eliminated the Sirens' forces and recaptured the base.
That is very strange...
If the META's goal was to eliminate Sirens, you'd think she would go on the offensive while our command chain was paralyzed due to what was happening in the Mediterranean.
And yet, she didn't do that. Then what if she had already achieved her goal? Or she went away for some other reason?
She couldn't have come and left simply on a whim.
Please send me all the samples and reports. I will form a special task force and conduct a second investigation.
Yes, ma'am. One more thing – unfortunately, we had no choice but to terminate our search for the mainframe yesterday.
May I ask why?
It was due to the sudden failure of the Light of Dawn's beacon, which we used to detect the location of the mainframe.
What caused it?
We don't know yet, but we are looking into it. It will likely take a few days before we determine the cause.
What we do know is that Kirov's fleet sighted a non-Siren unidentified flying object at the same time as the Light of Dawn malfunctioned.
The reports claim the object had the appearance of an eyeball with a tail made of blue fire.
Additionally, it was somehow completely undetectable on radar, and planes launched by the fleet were unable to pursue it.
Belorussiya speculates that it was responsible for the Light of Dawn's malfunction.
Do we know if the object was hostile?
That is uncertain. It did not counterattack in response to their anti-air fire, it only evaded the flak.
Perhaps it was a new model the Sirens sent to both disrupt our search for the mainframe and to scout out our forces and firepower...
It's a possibility, at least.
(We did recapture our base, destroy the Sirens' FOB, and eliminate one of Omitter's vessels. Our operation can be concluded as a success.)
(This is the perfect chance to report to Naval HQ that we're done.)
...Thank you for the report. I'll inform Naval HQ that the operation is finished.
Abandon all areas captured from Omitter, excluding K-1 and K-4, and withdraw all the forces within those areas.
What?! Even around the Crown and the polar stronghold?
Yes. There is no point in holding these areas while Omitter's mainframe remains intact.
She will just continue whittling us down with her endless reinforcements, like how Compiler defended the NA Ocean before her mainframe was destroyed.
Now that the Europa situation has changed, the Sirens are surely going to make a big move.
The near future is uncertain, so it's time to go on the defensive and wait for a better opportunity.
...As you say.

sequence: Airspace Above Eagle Union
NY City Fleet Communications Plane
1:26 AM MST

scripts.say: A lone airplane serving the NY City Coastal Defense soared through the cloudless night sky.
The narrow-body aircraft sported a remodeled cabin, spacious and pleasant to its only two passengers.
The time was 1:26 AM, very late into the night.
One of the passengers was already asleep, while the other was still rolling around in bed, kept awake by both nervousness and anticipation.
...I thought the Sea of Stars was just a myth.
Not only is it real, but it's also home to some of the greatest minds in the country.
And they have technology that's decades ahead of the rest of the world.
Heheheh...
Everything I hear about it is more amazing than the last.
Saratoga even works with them. As does the Commander, and the famed Alaska.
You're such a lucky girl, Princeton...
Because starting tomorrow, you'll be part of the Sea of Star's research team!
I still can't believe it...
THIS IS THE BEST THING EVER!
Princeton... I'm trying to sleep...
Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to wake you. I'll be quiet!
Thanks... Good night... Zzzzz...
Good night, Laffey.
Heheh... Heheheh...
Saratoga, Alaska, Commander... I'll be there soon.
In the bright future, with you, at the Sea of Stars!

sequence: This is a day filled with love and joy...
On this wonderful day, people make chocolate...
And give it to their beloveds as a sign of their affection.
At least, so they usually would, but an unprecedented disaster has struck the port this year!

scripts.say: Oh no, oh no! C-Commander!
Bad news...
Our once-a-year celebration is gonna be for nothing!
Three shipgirls fling open my office door and run in with anxious looks on their faces.
Whoa, what's wrong? Slow down and tell me what's going on.
The port's facing an honest-to-god life-or-death situation as we speak!
There's a Valentine's chocolate crisis!
A... chocolate crisis?
Yeah! The chocolate shop doesn't have any chocolate! Not a single piece!
It's not just that... Even the molds used to make chocolate and all candies with chocolate inside have sold out.
All I wanted was to make you a mushroom-shaped chocolate...
That IS pretty odd, I'll admit.
Which is why we're here! You're the only one we can turn to!
How are we gonna make love chocolate if we can't even get the ingredients for it?!
Commander, please save Valentine's Day!
Z23 to Laffey! Please respond! Shelves A2, C1, and D2 need to be restocked ASAP!
Zzz...
Laffey! Wake up!
Stock shelves... with chocolate... Zzz...
Javelin to Z23! Laffey's down and out.
Also, our stock is empty.
How could this be...
I walk into the port's chocolate shop.
Despite the many posters inside advertising Valentine's Day chocolate, all the shelves are empty.
There's been a flood of customers over the past few days, and there are too few of us to handle everything.
While it may not be "good" news, our supplier has run out of chocolate, which takes the pressure off us...
Starting today, the chocolate shop will... Zzz...
Alright, I get the situation.
I'll do something about the supplier and your manpower shortage.
Thanks a bunch! With you helping us, the shop will be back in business in no time!
Yes, let's do this! Let's save Valentine's Day!
Where will we get the chocolate from, though?
After mulling it over for a while, I make a call to a somewhat unusual "supplier," if you could call her that.
Request for chocolate supplies received. Initiating transport protocol.
There's a great rumble in the distance that draws closer. Then, several huge containers equipped with parachutes come to a slow landing in the open area outside the shop.
What's in these containers? Is all of it... chocolate?
But I thought the port ran out of chocolate long ago...
A sharp increase in the port's chocolate consumption was previously recorded.
In response to this, I employed an emergency protocol to buy chocolate in bulk as a reserve stock.
Hooray! Then Valentine's is saved!
That must be why the supplier ran out...
Finally feel like doing some work, Laffey?
I wasn't slacking off... in the first place... Zzz...
Thanks to TB's support, the chocolate supply issue has been solved for now.
However, it remains to be seen whether this will be enough to satiate the surge of customers that will come tomorrow.
We need to prepare as best as we can for that...
It's now the day before Valentine's Day, and the chocolate shop has reopened for business.
A line has formed outside the shop, despite it still being the early hours of the morning.
The Commander told me about your manpower issue, and I'm here to help.
I'd like to chip in, too! I can help by making greeting cards!
Thank gosh. Now we have enough workers to go around.
As long as we all work together, we'll make it through this day!
The shop's shutters rise, and at the same time, a flood of customers comes pouring in.
Um, excuse me... Do you know where your love potions are? The ones listed on the posters...
I've been looking around, and I can't find them...
Love... potions?
You know, the thing you give your sweetheart to excite and invigorate them...
I won't put it in my chocolate – pinky promise! Heheh...
Alright then. I'll go take a look.
Nope, not here...
Not here either...
Oh! Here they are. Just–
Wonderful! Thanks, Miss.
I'll get out of your hair now...
Just as Helena is about to say something, Mogador disappears like the wind.
Wait! Mogador!
In an out-of-sight place near where the "love potions" are kept, there is a line of small print that reads...
"This product is an energy drink and only has the health benefit of energizing you. It does not have any other special properties."
What an uninspired bunch of ribbons. Bland, boring, and lame!
Since I'm giving chocolate to that stupid Commander, my wrapping needs to be creative.
...Hm? What's this?
"A rose and pearl ribbon – only the best for your most beloved"?
It's got a modest rose window pattern, and the edges are trimmed with silk studded with miniature pearls...
Hmm. Guess it's not bad.
Right as Hipper reaches for the ribbon, a black-gloved hand goes for it as well.
Ah. What a touching coincidence, dear sister.
Eugen?! Why the hell are you here?! Don't tell me you're thinking–
The same as you, yes.
Though, in my opinion, this subdued color doesn't really suit a girl like you who's always loud and proud about her feelings.
Want me to pick out a better one for you?
Sh-shut up, you! I found it first, so it's MINE!
Is it? If it's first-come, first-served, then I got here just a bit quicker.
The two get into a tug-of-war over the ribbon. Neither one wants to give it up.
Dear customers, please calm down!
Um, good news! We have another ribbon like that in our storage!
Don't bother with it!
Oh gosh...
After a while of sparks flying between their clashing glares, they both suddenly let go of the ribbon at once.
You know what?! On second thought, the pattern's nothing special! If you want it so badly, then take it!
Thanks for being so "thoughtful," dear sister.
But, I've changed my mind. I'd get laughed at if people heard I picked the same wrapping as you
The two exchange a glance, and then simply turn around and go opposite ways, as though nothing had happened, leaving Javelin standing there dumbstruck.
Uh... What?!
After the last customer leaves the shop, the shutters slowly descend.
While there were some ups and downs, today's business was a great success thanks to everyone's hard work.
Let's hope things go just as smoothly tomorrow.
Zzz...
Come again? You've not had any customers today?
Yes. Not a single one.
It beggars belief. How can there not have been a single customer when today is Valentine's Day?
I step out of the shop into the usually bustling shopping district, which is now unusually quiet.
What, did everyone get the date wrong or something?
As I stand there, confused, a crowd appears across the street from me.
Bunny, my trusted aide! Lead us to where the Commander is!
Oh, look! The Commander's right over there! Commandeeer! Hold on! People wanna give you their chocolates!
Hehehehe...
Happy Valentine's Day, my dear Commander! I'd like to present to you this box of my chocolate!
Commandeeer, I've got chocolate made just for you! Don't worry, I promise I didn't put anything weird in it♥
Hmph! That idiot wants someone's chocolate more than anyone else's, and it's mine!
My, how confident. Maybe you and I should see who's most worthy through a competition, hmm?
The pressure of the approaching crowd gets to me, so I try to rush back into the shop... only to find my escape route is blocked.
Commander, we made chocolates for you as well!
Happy Valentine's, Commander...
Thanks for helping us over the past few days! I hope you'll enjoy this Valentine's Day in peace!
The cheers and shouts around me grow muffled, and I'm soon buried under a warm wave of chocolate...
In the end, I was given a small hill's worth of chocolate. As you might expect, eating it all proved quite the challenge.
You could certainly call it... a luxuriously sweet problem.
I want to repay them for all their kindness...
And to that end, I'll have to make some unforgettable Valentine's memories with them.

sequence: Valentine's Day - The Chocolatastrophy! – The End

An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>Taking Shelter at Capacitor City</size>

scripts.say: After a trip to the garden center, Zeven and I walk down the main street together.
I'm holding potted plants that I can't even name, and she's carrying a bag of newly sprouting saplings.
Thank you so much for coming with me today, Commander!
In exchange for your company, you should let me give you a massage later.
Hmm... I like the sound of that.
But first things first. We need to get these babies home.
(There aren't too many of them, but boy, are they heavy...)
As I adjust my posture to try and make the potted plants easier to carry, a drop of water hits my cheek.
Mm?
Zeven looks up at the sky, too.
Huh?
Is it raining?
But it was so sunny just a few minutes ago.
Sure was. Well, the forecasters can't get it right every time.
Let's hurry back before it gets really bad.
Good idea. In that case...
Let's run, Commander!
She wraps her arm around mine and starts running.
However, the weather seems to anticipate our plans, and the rain only intensifies.
Eep?! It's pouring now!
Zeven stays close, trying to stay out of the rain as we quicken our pace.
This doesn't stop her from getting wet alongside me, of course, as the rain comes down harder. Our hair and shoulders are drenched.
At this rate, we'll be completely soaked by the time we get back.
I look around and spot a store down the street that we can use to take shelter.
Let's go wait out the rain in there!
Huh? O-okay!
We run inside together. In our haste, we don't bother to check the name of the store.
As we go in, we hear a store announcement.
"Capacitor City's having its biggest sale ever! Get up to 70% off on all products in the store! You might just win a prize at checkout, too!"
(Wait a second...)
(We're in an electronics store?!)
Feeling a pang of unease, I glance at the girl next to me.
She sets her bag of saplings down, as if she hasn't realized where we are.
Ah, Commander... Your whole upper half is soaked. Let me clean you up a little.
She pulls a handkerchief out of her pocket and gently begins to dry my hair.
Even poor plants get sick when they take this much rain water at once...
Umm, I'll be fine...
Commander, you look pale. You're not sick already, are you?
I'll go find hot water for you!
That won't be necessary!
I reach out frantically and seize her arm.
Stay with me. Don't go anywhere, I'm serious.
Zeven tilts her head at me, but it doesn't take her long to give herself a reason to be fine with it.
O-oh, I see... We finally got the time to go out together, and it makes sense for us to stay together on our date...
Don't worry, Commander. I won't leave your side for a second!
Good... Thanks, Zeven.

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>Automatic Sprinkler</size>

scripts.say: The rain still shows no sign of stopping.
Zeven and I sit down on a bench together and place our newly bought plants at our feet.
As the torrential rain drowns out the store's ambient music, she rests her head on my shoulder sleepily.
(They've really got the AC blasting... She might catch a cold if she falls asleep here.)
I take off my jacket and drape it over her shoulders.
Commander, you're too thoughtful...
She mumbles in my ear. I stroke her hair while she falls asleep.
As I start to foolishly think that we'll make it through this without issue, a few small drops of water fall on our heads.
Oh? A leak...?
We look up at the ceiling simultaneously, but we quickly find that the water isn't falling from overhead.
There's a display nearby with a shower-shaped sprinkler watering a miniature garden.
Look, Commander! There are so many plants over there!
Zeven drags me over to the display area. A card in front of the product lists its name and description.
"Are you a hard worker who loves plants? Look no further than this sprinkler system! Works up to fifty square meters..."
"With simple operation and easy upkeep, you can rest easy knowing your green babies are in capable hands."
An automatic sprinkler... How interesting.
Commander, is it okay if I try it out?
...Go right for it.
Given her history with handling appliances, I decide to stay close by.
A demonstration is playing, showing how the sprinkler works.
So you press this button first, and then this button... and then it starts watering them?
Looks like it.
That's so convenient. With a few of these, I could take care of so many more flowers!
(She really likes this sprinkler.)
(But if I buy it on impulse right now, it could lead to trouble.)
It's nice, I'll give you that. Operating these things can get tricky, though.
Oh, Commander, you underestimate me. I'll be just fine with something this simple!
Are you sure?
Yeah!
She's practically got stars in her eyes.
Well, go ahead and give it a try. If you can make it work, let's buy one.
I'll pay, by the way. We're on a date, so I might as well get you a gift.
Wow, thank you, Commander!
Go on. Give it a try.
She looks as confident as can be.
Okay, turning it on...
Watch this, Commander!

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>Predictable Problems</size>

scripts.say: After making a few tweaks, Zeven presses the start button without hesitation.
I watch on closely.
(No problems so far.)
(Could I be witnessing a miracle?)
Water sprays out of the sprinkler and lands safely in the miniature garden.
Look, Commander! I did it!
See? This is easy stuff.
You've shown real growth today.
Well, a deal's a deal–
Aaah?!
As soon as I turn toward checkout, the sprinkler head starts swiveling around in circles.
Water spews everywhere, soaking both of our faces.
Aww... Why did that happen?
Ah, I need to stop it... Where's the stop button?
She frantically starts pressing buttons on the panel.
It doesn't stop, though, no. The sprinkler only spins faster and faster.
Let me handle this.
Before she can press another button, I turn off the power.
Hmm...
I followed the instructions exactly as they were shown. It was going so well before, too...
Disappointment is clear on her face.
Was it just a machine malfunction, maybe?
It's okay, Commander. Don't try to make me feel better...
All I do is cause trouble for you anyway...
No, no. I was watching every step of the way, and you clearly did nothing wrong.
I think it would've turned out the same way even if I did it.
Zeven's hair and eyelashes glisten from wetness.
Commander...
Maybe you're just so pretty that the sprinkler thought you were a flower.
Pfft...
Goodness, Commander, now isn't the time for jokes...
That finally brings a smile to her face.
Anyway, let's get cleaned up.
Okay!
I take out my own handkerchief and dab at her damp hair for her this time.
She lowers her head slightly for me, like a delicate touch-me-not flower.

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>Coffee for Your Beloved</size>

scripts.say: I asked for two cups of piping-hot coffee from the service counter to keep us from catching a cold.
The hot coffee in our bellies practically blew all of the cold away.
This coffee is just delicious.
Doesn't it taste exactly like the kind you used to drink?
Now that you mention it...
(This is the kind that my coffee maker made before she broke it...)
After finishing her drink, Zeven seems unsatisfied.
I'll go get us refills.
She takes our empty mugs. Before long, she's back with more.
When she gets back, she's clearly in high spirits.
Commander, I'm baaack!
Someone's in a good mood. What's the news?
I'm glad you asked! When I went to ask for more coffee, they showed me the machine that made it... It's the newest model of the one you were using!
There's a demo corner right over there. You just press a few buttons, and you get the most delicious-smelling coffee!
"Wake up your beloved with a cup of fragrant, fresh-ground coffee!"
"Even if they work late into the night, you can always bring them a piping-hot cup of java!"
"On our brand's reputation, we swear that with this coffee maker, your beloved's heart will be yours!"
Zeven repeats what sounds like advertising bunk, losing herself in the fantasy they present.
If I learned how to use that coffee maker, then maybe I...
Wanna try it?
Commander, I...
She looks sheepishly up at me, no doubt remembering the disaster moments ago.
I did break your last coffee maker...
What if I mess up again like that? Or like before?
I'd just cause more trouble for you.
She waits anxiously for my answer.
It's okay. There's nothing wrong with just trying it out.
Besides, I'll REALLY be watching this time.
I'll test it out first to make sure there's nothing wrong with the machine. Then you can have a try.
This way, surely–
Before I can finish talking, Zeven suddenly pulls me into a hug.
She smells like flowers.
You really are too kind, Commander.
If this goes well, then let me buy it for you as a gift!
Thus, she takes my hand and guides me over to the coffee makers.

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>The Coffee Trial</size>

scripts.say: Zeven never lets go of my hand until we get to the section with the coffee machines.
That familiar aroma wafts all around us.
Over there, Commander!
Isn't that coffee maker just like the one that was in your office?
Yep. The appearance is almost the same, and the functions are too.
I thought so! I watched their demonstration a few times, and I'm sure that even people like me can use it just fine!
...Riiight.
(I feel like I could've said the same thing about the old one...)
We watched another demo together.
Got it. I see how to use it now.
Zeven, pay close attention to what I'm doing, alright?
Okay!
If it means making delicious coffee for you someday, then I'll watch so seriously that I won't even blink once!
She clenches her fists, as if preparing for a life-or-death struggle.
I slow down and break down every step as much as I can for her.
So? Think you can handle it?
Wow... I finally get it!
That means it's my turn now.
Yep. Good luck.
First... I press the button to grind the beans...
She imitates what I did and presses the correct button. Ground coffee flows out of the machine.
Next, extraction...
I notice that she's not just imitating the steps I did, but also my superfluous motions.
The machine makes a hoarse noise as it operates.
It's working! Now, the final step...
Zeven takes a deep breath in and gently presses a button with her slender finger.
BEEP BEEP!
Aaah!
When she presses the final button, the machine starts shaking violently and screeching.
Frothed milk splatters all over the place, and black smoke rises from the machine.
C-Commander!
It's okay. I'll cut the power!
I rush to unplug it and look back at my companion.
Zeven, are you okay?
That malfunction ended up covering her face in milk foam.
Seeing her teary eyes, I frantically wipe the foam off of her.
I-I'm sorry, Commander...
There's milk on you, too... Did you get hurt at all?
Nope. I'm just fine.
I'm such an idiot...
I thought they were all the same steps... Why?
Why am I the only one... who can't make good coffee?
She sounds more dejected than I've ever heard her before.
You were doing all that just so you could brew coffee for me?
Yeah... You're always working so hard. I wanted to find a way that I could help.
All I wanted was this one little thing, but I can't...
I-I just can't...
Her eyes turn red.
I understand how you feel.
Wait here for me. I'll go pay for this thing.
Huh? But... But I broke it...
Don't worry about it. You just leave the rest to me.

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>One Little Wish</size>

scripts.say: After repairing the coffee maker, I invited Zeven to my room.
She was still down from earlier.
Commander...
I fixed and installed the coffee maker. Ready to give it a whirl?
She shakes her head.
I'd best not. What if, you know...
Worried the same thing will happen again?
She keeps her mouth closed, but the sadness on her face tells me all I need to know.
I've got repair tools right here. If it malfunctions again, I'll fix it up, no problem.
Don't worry about a thing. Experiment.
Commander... Thank you for comforting me.
But really, I've already messed up enough times. My mistakes could have gotten you burned.
You don't have to worry, I promise.
I came prepared for anything.
I'll teach you how to use it, and we'll go nice and slow.
Even if you mess up a hundred or a thousand times... I'm not bothered, no matter how long it takes.
Zeven gazes at me in surprise.
B-but then... I'll just cause trouble for you again...
Not at all.
If you can make coffee for me, then I'll get to drink your coffee every day. Sounds like a great deal to me.
We lock eyes, and I gently take her hand.
I give it a soft squeeze to show her how I care.
I really am looking forward to drinking your coffee.
Commander...
Encouraged by my words, she finally smiles.
If you really mean it... then I shouldn't sit around complaining!
I'll do my best to learn!
Great. Let's go through one step at a time. I've got the manual right here.
If you have any questions, don't hesitate. I'll demonstrate for you again.
Zeven nods eagerly. She stares intently at the coffee maker, ready to face this formidable foe once more.
Operation: Learn to Make Coffee... This time, it's going to be a success!

sequence:
An Electronics Store in Bloom

<size=45>Operation: Learn to Make Coffee</size>

scripts.say: I showed Zeven a thorough demonstration of how to use the machine.
And we're done.
That was so fast! But so perfect...
Seeing the fragrant coffee before her, she closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.
Fresh-brewed coffee... It doesn't smell burnt at all.
(What the hell has she been drinking until now?)
She raises the cup to her lips and takes a sip of the caramel-colored liquid.
Mmm... Commander, your coffee is delicious!
May I give it a try now?
Of course. That's why you're here.
Encouraged by the taste of good coffee, she psyches herself up again.
Okay... Here goes!
This time, I swear I won't fail!
Um... Commander...
White steam erupts from the machine.
A-at least it isn't black smoke this time. That's progress.
But I couldn't even make it through the grinding step.
Umm... Well, that is the most important step when it comes to making good coffee.
Get this part down, and the rest is smooth sailing!
Y-you mean it?
Yeah!
Okay... I'll try again!
Oh, where did it go wrong this time?
Zeven hangs her head, facing the lump of black charcoal in her cup.
Hmm... Maybe you extracted it too long.
Uh... You know, I happen to like over-extracted coffee.
Do you mean it?
Commander, you're not lying to make me feel better, are you?
Ahem. Of course not... I'm taking this lesson very seriously right now.
Uh-huh...
Well, this time, I swear I'm going to make this thing work right!
We ended up spending the whole night as such.
The table got covered in coffee grounds and milk stains. Several cups lay sideways on top of it, spilling various shades of brown.
It's only when morning sunlight drifts into my room that we finally realize how long we've been at it.
In the end... I never could make coffee worth drinking.
You're making serious progress, though.
Progress...?
Yeah. I mean, the machine hasn't broken since the sixteenth cup.
Have you been keeping track of that all throughout the night?
Sure have. You're working hard, so I decided I should do the same.
I thought I was just causing trouble for you this whole time...
Zeven shakes her head and smiles, relieved.
I would never betray your trust, Commander.
So tomorrow night... Well, I guess it's tonight by now...
May I spend the evening with you again?
I'd love it.
No matter how long it takes, no matter how many nights we toil... we'll see this through together.
One little promise sprouts here in my room.
May our feelings nurture it until, one day, it grows sturdy branches that bear beautiful flowers.
And may each flower weave its own little story for the years that follow.
After Helena META and I had our talk, I informed the Sakurans that I would accept their invitation to Ama no Tobira.
After an entire day of preparation, Helena and I set off towards that mysterious place on the fifth day since our arrival.
What is this place we're heading to, Commander? A harbor?
Our journey was a series of surprises from the very start.
I'd thought we'd go to a mountain concealing some enormous underground facility, but instead we made a beeline for a harbor.
Then, the Sakurans guided us away from the mainland.
Helena and I began making guesses as to our route. That was when we noticed that the scenery outside the window had changed while we weren't looking.
Did we... just enter a Mirror Sea?
It's so pretty. Like being inside a Sakuran picture scroll.
A palace composed of archaic buildings silently stands on the sea's surface.
It is divided by two arterial roads running from east to west and north to south, and is arranged into three distinct circular areas from the inside to the outside.
Each area does not form a unified whole, but rather is subdivided into further areas of varying sizes due to the waterways running across it.
Buildings radiating golden light dot the cityscape, following the layout rule of short on the outside and tall on the inside.
Finally, at its centermost point stands an enormous tower that pierces through nature and the clouds.
The files on the Sakura Empire that I read had a name for it – the Dragon Palace.
Commander {playername}, Helena, you must go through the palace you see now to reach Ama no Tobira.
However, this is as far as I can take you.
The sluice leading further in has been opened. Once you enter, the ones appointed by the Venerable Three will escort you the rest of the way.
Huh? You're not coming with us?
No. I haven't been permitted to enter the premises.
This place is the Dragon Palace, isn't it?
Sure sounds tightly managed for being just a waypoint on the way to Ama no Tobira.
Right you are. It is the Dragon Palace.
It didn't always take so long to enter it... until the Naraka incident happened, during which the Palace suffered extensive damage.
Due to the importance of the ritual, certain unique environmental modifications were added when Yamato conducted emergency repairs.
These turned the Dragon Palace into a genuine extension of Ama no Tobira, which, needless to say, necessitated stricter management.
I know little more beyond that point. You will have to ask your guides.
Now, go.
And so, Helena and I boarded a command vessel and passed through the Dragon Palace's open sluice.
The instant the sluice closes, our surroundings once again change dramatically.
Commander, we're... We're under the sea, somehow!
Looking up, I see that the blue sky has turned into dim seawater.
Countless fish are drawn to the light emitted by the city. They form schools and swim around the outside of the protective barrier.
How? The files I read said it takes an hour and a half to reach its maximum depth...
And it just happened in an instant.
Heehee. I hope you aren't too frightened by this sudden change.
I am Daisen, and this lady beside me is Shimanto. We shall be your guides.
Good to see you again, Commander {playername}.
It's a pleasure, Daisen and Shimanto.
I will say, I was anticipating seeing all sorts of unexpected things after entering Ama no Tobira...
I just didn't expect to be already dazzled just while on the way there.
Heheh. The Dragon Palace originally was reliant purely on its mechanical structure for diving and resurfacing, which took quite some time.
The files you read were simply a little out of date.
Now, following Yamato's modifications, the Dragon Palace cannot be considered a completely worldly thing anymore.
As such, it's no wonder that it's capable of trivial things like diving and resurfacing in an instant.
Such fascinating technology. Could you tell me a little more?
Why, of course. I shall do that after you ask your next question.
You see, the explanation for it should be the same as the next thing you wish to ask.
My next question? Well, you're right, because I do have another question.
Since we're deep underwater, I assume Ama no Tobira is hidden somewhere down here, right?
Are we gonna board a submarine and travel to it, or can the Dragon Palace go there on its own?
There's no need to bother with either of those things. The Dragon Palace has a doorway that connects directly to Ama no Tobira, so we just need to go through that.
(A doorway?)
(Does she mean like a portal into a Singularity? I didn't see any large structures from outside the Palace, though. Has the Sakura Empire managed to create miniaturized portals?)
(Wait, no!)
(From the Tower of Midgard and the Gate of Avalon, to the Winter's Crown, and even Naraka, all entrances to a Singularity have one thing in common – they're fixed in place.)
(Have the Sakurans created an artificial Singularity that can be moved around?!)
Shimanto, is this "doorway" the entrance to a Singularity?
How did you manage to make a portal entryway that's both small and can be freely repositioned?
Umm... It's just a regular doorway!
Ama no Tobira doesn't exist in the physical world. Only the doorway does.
If you're wondering why the doorway was set up in this place, you'd have to ask Lady Yamato why she did that, because I don't know.
(Sounds like she really has no idea.)
The doorway exists both here and elsewhere at the same time.
Much like how the Palace exists both under the sea and on the surface.
By extension, you will enter Ama no Tobira by going through the doorway, just as you went under the sea by passing through the sluice.
Wait, you're saying there are two Dragon palaces, and one exists above the water, and one under it? And they're connected by sluices that function as teleporters?
No, there is but one Dragon Palace. Impossible feats such as this are made possible by it no longer being a worldly place.
(Okay, this doesn't make any sense to me...)
(Best to just drop the topic for now. I'll make a mental note to ask Helena META about it later.)
Alright... I think I get the gist.
What about before the modifications to the Palace? As far as I know, Ama no Tobira is older than it.
How'd you get to Ama no Tobira in the past?
In the past... it took much, much longer than it does now.
Now, you can simply enter Ama no Tobira if you have an invitation. Back then, the only way to access it was through the Sacred Sakura's ground network.
Entering it was beyond my abilities at the time.
In fact, only ones like Shimanto who can freely travel through the Sacred Sakura would be able to enter it.
Furthermore, the entrance was originally established here per Lady Yamato's orders to ensure the Rite of Resurrection went smoothly.
Once the Rite was complete, Lady Yamato opted to keep it rather than have it removed.
It's this decision that's allowed us the opportunity to see Ama no Tobira for ourselves.
Ah, apologies. Listen to me, rambling on!
This way, please, Commander and Helena.
For a long time now, the Sakura Empire has had little contact with other factions, whilst being a place shrouded in mystery.
Among said mysteries, those involving Yamato are all the more baffling.
Beyond her name and the fact that she's a shipgirl, the higher-ups of the Azur Lane currently possess zero valuable knowledge on her.
Even during the Naraka incident, which she played an instrumental role in, nobody actually saw her in person.
"The Rite of Resurrection." A mere four words with an impact that cannot be overstated.
A resurrection is not the same as a shipgirl being incapacitated in battle and brought back for repairs so she can return to the front line.
Many Sakuran shipgirls suffered grave wounds in the Naraka incident. Some even had their bodies completely destroyed.
Ordinarily, it would be impossible to make a recovery in such a case, even if the shipgirl received repairs... and yet, Yamato made the impossible happen.
By literally resurrecting them solely relying on their "souls" – the sum of all the information that should be stored within their hulls, no less.
Regardless of how she awakened them, the mere fact that she managed to preserve every bit of information that should've vanished in a blink is, by itself, immensely thought-provoking.
Especially so after witnessing that brilliant glow the Rose Tower released in its final moments...
Yamato is most likely up to something incredible – and I can't wait to see it.

sequence: "Since the inception of my being"
"A thought hath occupied my mind"
"That the armor and the sword, whilst poignant..."
"Cannot impede the plotting of the mind"
"The evils beyond the realm all excel at this"
"Thus, neither can I see nor sense it"
"By the rocks, the realm is drawn"
"By the realm, the source is forged"
"The Sky Realm – it formeth a wall against the world beyond"
"And thus is the domain within it defined – Amahara"
"Even should the earth collapse and the mountains crumble, a great disaster is inevitable"
"The Sky Realm of Amahara"
"Forevermore must it last"

scripts.say: I'm given another Dream Stone.
(Diversify my thinking, eh...)
(Let's see if I can mix it up a bit...)
I gently press the Dream Stone against my forehead.
In a blink, the world is transformed.
(Huh?!)
(What the hell?! That definitely wasn't my imagination!)
(It was that black figure again!)
What's this? An archipelago in the Pacific Ocean?
What kind of space did you envision this time as you touched the Dream Stone?
A big, Sakuran place.
What can I say? It's where we're vacationing, and I tried to expand my thinking a bit, like you said.
Did I do something wrong?
This space seems... too big.
Unzen, can you sense it?
I'm... unable to measure its width or depth.
This is not a slice of an ocean. It is veritably a whole ocean.
With dozens of islands poking above the water.
Wouldn't that make it... many times larger than the combined size of the entire Sky Realm?
That's simply unbelievable... All this, from but one Dream Stone?
A Dream Stone contains a limited amount of information. How did a single one manage to create a space this big?
I do not know. However, the boundaries of this space seem to be unstable.
It is constantly changing out of our sight. I can sense it.
What's more, the changes happen increasingly faster the further away they are.
(What? The world outside our view is changing without my input?)
Then what are we standing around for? We need to get out of here immediately.
Everyone, please stay where you are. I will get us out of here now.
The clouds flow away, and our surroundings change entirely. Despite this, we're still in the vast ocean.
That's odd... We're still in here.
Oumi, we have an emergency. I need you to...
Unzen, we have lost contact with the outside!
Please, calm down.
Kindly hold on a moment. I will see if I can sense something.
Unzen closes her eyes, and light shines forth from her body, then scatters in all directions.
(This is getting a bit dire, let's say that.)
(Helena, do you read me?)
(Hello? Helena?)
(Don't worry. I'm here.)
(Thank god. I thought I lost contact with you, too.)
(In truth, you did – for a brief moment.)
(So whatever just happened also affected you, then?)
(More precisely, there was a drastic change in the rules of that space.)
(I could at least tell that you were still in the Sky Realm since your coordinate field didn't update.)
(Wait, a drastic change of rules?)
(Look at the sun. It's setting. Time has begun ticking.)
Just as Helena says, the previously blue sky has all of a sudden taken on a golden orange color.
The girls realize this at the same time as I do.
This is wrong. This is wrong for so many reasons.
The space created by the Dream Stone behaves unnaturally, and most unnatural of all is the one thing that should never change in here – the time.
Commander, did you... change the very essence of your Dream Stone?
No, I just put it against my forehead. I didn't do anything unusual.
Right, of course you didn't... You can't just change the essence of the Dream Stone like that, after all.
If one did that, it would no longer be a Dream Stone. The Amahara Taijin would identify it as a foreign object and suppress it.
But then, what happened?
I've deduced the cause.
The space itself has become unstable. That's why we can't escape through regular means or contact the outside.
I've regained contact with the Amahara Taijin. Please stay put and do not move.
There – I've established a stable passage. Follow me, and I will lead you out!
The shipgirls and I experience faint vibrations for a while, then we return to the golden Cloudsea once more.
location: Sky Realm Amahara - The Amahara Cloudsea

scripts.say: This place is so tranquil that it's like the danger we were just in wasn't real to begin with.
Phew...
Commander, I just employed the Amahara Taijin to erase the space we were just in.
This only happened because the ladies and I were unprepared.
On all our behalves, I deeply apologize for the discomfort caused.
It was weird, for sure, but it didn't necessarily happen because you were unprepared...
(There was that black figure... I only saw her while using the Dream Stone.)
All's well that ends well. We all made it out unscathed, so don't sweat it.
Your forgiveness is deeply appreciated.
Hakuhou, I suggest that we suspend the use of Dream Stones for the time being.
Not just that, we should not even think of using them until we've figured out what the problem was.
A wise proposal. Let us do as you say.
Furthermore, Hakuhou, you ought to tell others that all expansion work involving the Stones is suspended.
I shall inform Lady Yamato of this incident at a later time.
As you say, Asama...
One thing's for sure: Our plans for today's visit have fallen apart. Mind if I come up with something new?
Let's hear it.
Well, the landscapes of the Five Provinces and Seven Districts are now 40% complete.
Since the Commander is with us, why don't we go and enjoy some superb views, hmm?
That sounds like a good idea. Do you have any particular spots in mind?
How about Kouzuke Province?
We have the same idea. Yes, let us go to Kouzuke Province.
The up-to-now cold and distant Akagi has finally livened up, and jovially begins talking with the other girls about the sightseeing we're about to do.
I, on the other hand, feel restless.
My mind is still preoccupied with the black figure I saw when I touched the Dream Stone, as well as that odd nightmare I had a few days ago.
And that bizarre thing that just happened to us – did we really escape, and that's all there's to it?
The next moment, dark clouds cover the sky.
Just like that, the hereto fantastically beautiful Sky Realm is shrouded in unyielding darkness.
Meanwhile, in the court of Amahara Castle...
location: The Sky Realm of Amahara - Amahara Castle

scripts.say: Ladies, an emergency has arisen. Formless corruption has invaded the Sky Realm en masse.
I know neither whence they came nor how they slipped past the external walls. However, I know one thing...
That their rampage shan't be allowed to continue.
I have already deployed defensive magic circles across the Sky Realm. Izumo?
Yes, ma'am?
I will head out and destroy the source of this formless corruption. The defense of the castle, I entrust to you.
Understood, ma'am.
Azuma, Kitakaze, you are to lead our forces across the Five Provinces and Seven Districts and eliminate the enemy.
- As you wish.  - Roger!
Ikazuchi, Inazuma, summon Shimanto and Daisen hither. Inform them that war has come to Amahara.
Understood, ma'am.
We'll see to it.
Ibuki, head to the Amahara Cloudsea and crush the enemy, then accompany the aforementioned two to Ama no Tobira to maintain it.
As you've bidden, so shall it be done!
Lastly, I-404.
Unzen's group is bringing the Commander to Amahara Castle. In the name of utmost safety, take your forces and rendezvous with them.
Copy that! Don't worry, Musashi – I'll bring the Commander back safely if it's the last thing I do!
As long as each of you carries out your duty, our victory is assured.
Yes, ma'am!
...The importance of cognitive defense was realized in the wake of the Spectral Moon incident.
The Sky Realm of Amahara, as a project, was devised for that very purpose.
I didn't expect it to end like it did...
A group was having a casual conversation within a garden surrounded by stars.
That was until their chat was disrupted by a flashing, red word appearing in the air – WARNING.
Why are there alarms going off even here? Did something happen?
Yeah.
Helena's gone into battle. Something's gone seriously wrong in the Sky Realm.
Helena, has the Commander gotten into trouble?! That warning in the sky sure suggests it!
Perfect timing, Memphis. Tell Vestal and Arizona to get ready for dispatch.
What? I mean, okay!
Are you sure we shouldn't depart immediately?
It's fine. The situation isn't that bad.
Still, I'm preparing for it to get worse. There's too much new stuff today, and I don't like it.
I understand. A lot of first-time things for you today.
While I haven't seen these "Dream Stones" before, this series of events today does invoke a sense of déjà vu in me.
I have no evidence for this, but I feel like Amahara went into a different direction as soon as the stones appeared.
What do you mean by "a different direction"?
Perhaps it's more apt to say that it has gone off-course.
What is clear is that someone unrelated has become involved in Amahara's growth.
Moreover, this person... surely knows about what happened in the past.
I see...
Keep monitoring, Jintsuu. Let me know if you discover anything.
I'm gonna go make some adjustments to Rodney.
I will get to the bottom of who's plotting in the shadows here.
You mustn't go into Amahara...
It's a grave. A grave made of lies and falsehoods...
A prison that is completely sealed...
None can escape it...

sequence: "None can escape it."

scripts.say: ...Asama! Unzen!
There is an alert from the Amahara Taijin! Invaders have appeared in the Sky Realm!
Invaders?
How is it possible that they snuck through the Amahara Taijin?
We'll have to figure that out another time! This place is dangerous. We need to return to Amahara Castle at once.
It's the corruption...
It is already here...
What?! Here?
Tsk... Then we'll intercept! Don't let the enemy come close!
I'll deploy a mass-produced ship at once. Commander, get on.
...Commander?

sequence: "None can escape it."

scripts.say: ...Commander! Are you okay?
I'm fine. Getting on now.
KABOOOM!
Fragments of nightmares, formless corruption, corrosion entities... They may look different, but they're the same at their core.
The Cloudsea is as black as the night. It takes all our might to carve out a path through the black waves.
They aren't much of a threat beyond having numbers on their side.
Those numbers are precisely the issue, however.
We dispose of one after another, but however many we destroy, they always regroup in unseen nooks and attack us again.

sequence: "Like a fear that grows in the dark."

scripts.say: Unzen, is this the corruption you spoke of? This horde is endless, and we cannot hope to defeat all of them ourselves.
The ones we've defeated are but shadows. They will assail us endlessly until their source is removed.
Please focus not on slaying them, but on clearing a path instead. We must reach Amahara Castle as soon as possible.
Understood!
Be careful. Something even bigger is coming.
Is that... a black dragon?
It bodes ill that such a wicked creature comes so soon...
We must fall back! This enemy is not like the rest. I shall cut it down!
Unzen! Minase, Taekaze, and I are here!
We'll take it from here! Take Commander {playername} and go to Amahara Castle!
Command your seadrake to strangle this vile enemy.
Hmph. Got it!
Alright, the rest of us need to keep moving.
This dragon isn't like the formless corruption we've seen so far...
How do I describe it? It's like it's more solid, more agile.
It's almost like it has a will of its own.
You can tell it's strong just from looking at it. Can we really handle it by ourselves?
Heh! Sure we can! Kotama and I are pretty strong, too!
We've just been stuck doing repair work lately, and haven't had a chance to flaunt our true strength!
You two, put pressure on it from the sides. I'll take care of the rest!
Kotama, it's time to dance! May its body be pierced into a bottomless abyss!
Thanks to I-404's group covering us, we managed to cover a lot of ground in a short time.
location: The Sky Realm of Amahara - Outside of Amahara Castle

scripts.say: With Unzen constantly looking for shortcuts amidst the chaos, we finally broke through the dark tide and made it to the heart of the Sky Realm – Amahara Castle.
However, the safety we expected to find wasn't there.
The castle has been breached despite the many magic circles around it, with many of its buildings having been stained and turned black.
They've breached Amahara Castle's perimeter!
How is that possible?! The foes we fought en route weren't especially mighty, so they shouldn't have been able to penetrate the defenses regardless of how numerous they were!
Amahara has fallen... What a horrific sight...
KABOOOM!
There you are, Unzen. Come this way.
Izumo, what in the world is happening?
Somehow, the enemy slipped past the barrier and made it inside the castle. They caught us off guard.
Pardon? They even slipped past the castle's barrier?
Yeah... So we fortified our defenses, and concentrated our forces and magic circles around the third main palace, where the Venerable Three are.
It's been this long, and the Venerable Three still have yet to resolve the situation?
The situation's not so straightforward.
They've already erased the source of the corruption twice, but both times, another source sprang up.
It's suspected the problem lies in the Depths.
The Depths... Is there such a place within the Sky Realm?
The Dream Stones. They're collected from the Depths, no?
The Dream Stones...
(Sounds like the Sakurans are in a bit of a stalemate.)
(I knew the formless corruption's appearance was only the beginning. Of course things wouldn't be so simple...)
(Helena, have you figured out the cause yet?)
(Still working on it. There are so many things I can't explain with this attack.)
(They're right about one thing, though – that the source is in the Depths.)
(Don't be alarmed. A rescue team is standing by. If things get completely out of control, we'll jump in and pull at least you and Helena out of there.)
(Try to save them, too, if you can.)
(We'll try.)
Sometime later, Izumo escorts me and the other Sakurans to a part of the castle that was still intact.
Although the black tide bangs on the barrier outside, this is as far as they can get.
So, I relax a bit and decide to restore my strength for the battle of attrition that's sure to come.
I gaze at the cloud that hangs at the castle's peak like the sun.
As my mind wanders, it feels like I'm looking at an even bigger space.
In a black void, a woman in colorful clothing stares at several picture scrolls unfolded before her eyes.
The one end of the scrolls hovers beside her hand, while the other stretches on endlessly into the distance.
I've found it...
That is where the calamity's source lies...
