(Does this Amahara have anything to do with the one I heard mentioned in my nightmare?)
(Still haven't forgotten that nightmare, huh? Well, don't worry. Test site beta's Amahara is, at its core, a cognitive defense system built by Yamato.)
(Although it's deeply linked to the Amahara you dreamed of, it's a completely different kind of technology. For all intents and purposes, they just share a name.)
(Know anything about a Dream Stone? Is it related to the Watatsumi?)
(Come again? Dream Stone? What's that?)
I explain it as best as I can to Helena, based on what Hakuhou just told me.
(Remember when Elizabeth META used Alsace and the concept of death to anchor space, and create the Martyrium? Doesn't it work the same as that?)
(It does. Not just that, it's also a more advanced version of that.)
(It not only utilizes concepts, but it even creates a set of concepts that belong specifically to Amahara.)
(A more advanced version? Is Yamato just that powerful?)
(She's not supposed to be THIS powerful.)
(When I did some research earlier, I found that Yamato didn't use this method to build Amahara.)
(Oh yeah, Akagi did just say that this is a NEW way to build.)
(Considering Amahara didn't grow to this size until after the Naraka incident, it follows that the Dream Stones didn't come in use until after the incident as well.)
(I think these "Dream Stones" could very well have something to do with the meteorite sample.)
(I'll ask Jintsuu about it. Talk to you later.)
Helena hangs up, and I, Hakuhou, and the rest start heading for the next stop on this trip to experience the Sky Realm's growth.
The sea of clouds rolls, and we arrive in a new area.
location: The Sky Realm of Amahara - The Amahara Cloudsea

scripts.say: What do you see, {playername}?
Nothing. Just clouds, clouds, and more clouds.
Heehee. Why don't you take a closer look?
Oumi presses the Dream Stone against her forehead.
The Stone disappears like a popped bubble, and the scenery all around us changes in an instant.
I'm inside a pagoda, sitting in front of a table. Past the balcony, I see an ocean of water that stretches on endlessly.
What do you see now?
A castle, and an ocean... Did you use the Stone to make this?
I thought the only sea you could make in this place was a sea of clouds.
Heehee. Well, as you can tell, that's not all you can make.
It only looked like a bunch of clouds because we were going somewhere.
When moving from place to place in Amahara, of course you'll see nothing but clouds.
Now, though, we're exploring all of its little nooks and crannies.
And since we're exploring, there needs to be something new to see.
Also, that's not strictly an ocean, but rather a lake.
For various reasons, a single Dream Stone can only create so much space. What you see now is the upper limit.
This place works a lot like a dream, you see. The bigger it gets, the more uncertain it gets, and the effort required to stabilize and explore it grows exponentially.
So it's fluid similarly to how dreams are. Does it get affected by negative emotions?
Don't worry about that. Negative emotions are suppressed thanks to the magic circles placed all around Amahara.
You won't find any nightmarish monsters wreaking havoc in here.
(That's good. Yamato planned ahead for that.)
(The last thing I want is to see that fear I felt take shape again.)
Now, then, what do you all say to some Cloudsea Wine?
That sounds superb. Pour some for me.
Just a moment! Let me get it ready for you.
Oumi lightly strikes her gourd, and liquid starts pouring out of it in a helical shape, filling the cups on the table to the brim.
Lady Yamato created this Cloudsea Wine to help visitors to the Sky Realm better adapt to its environment.
Those who drink it are formally acknowledged as guests here, and they receive the blessing of the Amahara Taijin – the Great Ring of Amahara.
You will also receive an additional boon shortly after drinking the Wine itself.
Whether traveling, working, or using a Dream Stone to create space in Amahara, you'll find that it's much easier than usual.
(Can it really do that?)
(It's just a registration and tuning process.)
Once more, I hear Helena META's voice through our secret line of communication.
(It's another classic example of presentation in Sakuran technology.)
(Amahara's administrator made drinking Cloudsea Wine into a registration and authentication process.)
(They need you to register an account first before you can expand Amahara's space – in other words, to edit or add to it.)
(As for the part about better adapting to the environment, that's a form of tuning.)
(It doesn't need to be a particular drink for it to work. What matters is that it's wine, and the aforementioned act of drinking itself. It's strictly symbolic.)
(If I were the admin, I think I'd make it soda instead.)
(The principle behind this part is pretty complicated, so I'll spare you the details. You understand the idea behind this better after I explained it, right?)
(Yeah. I understand it now, thanks to your layman's translation. By the way, did you finish looking into the Dream Stones?)
(Not yet. I just came back to check on you since you were on my mind.)
(Based on my preliminary findings, this does seem like an advanced use of the Watatsumi.)
(There's a degree of risk in the technology itself, which rises and falls depending on the creator's skill.)
(When you get a Dream Stone, don't use it immediately. I want to analyze it first.)
(I'm really curious as to how Yamato got her hands on this technology...)
Is something the matter, Commander? If you have any questions, don't be afraid to ask. I hope to answer them all.
(Oh, right. Our times are fully synchronized now.)
(To other people, it looks like you've just been staring into space this whole time, so...)
Ahem... No, it's nothing. I just got lost in the beauty of this view.
Without further ado, let's drink.
Unhesitatingly, I drink all the wine in my cup.
It has a refreshing sweetness to it, with a distinct floral and fruity aroma.
It has a refreshing sweetness to it, with a distinct floral and fruity aroma.
(...What?)
For a moment, I get a strange sense of déjà vu – like this isn't my first time drinking this wine.
(That's so weird. Didn't Helena say this wine is just a symbolic thing?)
(Then why does this space... suddenly look clearer than it did a moment ago?)
(And why did I suddenly get that feeling like I've done this before?)
After we drink the Cloudsea Wine, Oumi and I-404's group say goodbye, and they return to their respective posts.
location: The Sky Realm of Amahara - The Amahara Cloudsea

scripts.say: Helena and I follow Unzen, and we go to another open place in the Cloudsea.
I suppose they have something else they want to show me before I go and create some space with my own hands.
Now, allow me to present an example.
Asama presses the Dream Stone against her forehead.
The Stone disappears like a popped bubble, and the scenery all around us changes in an instant.
I find myself in a decayed place. It's dark, and everything is in ruins.
The Dream Stones create dreams that are a reflection of what's in your mind.
If the dreamer cannot vividly picture the scene they desire, and all they have is a vague idea, the Dream Stone will create a space such as this.
Moreover, if their thoughts are too negative, or if they succumb to panic and fear...
Then the Amahara Taijin's suppressive and filtering effects will intervene, resulting in the Dream Stone fabricating a shapeless, chaotic space much like this.
(That's smart. Prevents out-of-control emotions from creating something terrifying.)
There are two ways of dealing with orderless spaces of this nature.
The first is to borrow the power of the magic circles deployed around Amahara to thoroughly erase the space.
This method is quite convenient, though it is akin to using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.
For this reason, there exists a second method – disassembling the space to use it as material for another dream.
The Commander must be getting bored with all this explaining.
As they say, show, don't tell. Allow me.
By all means.
Akagi turns to face a certain direction in the chaotic space.
She takes one step forward, and the world changes in response.
I'm walking through a field of red spider lilies in full bloom. The sun is setting on the horizon, dyeing the sky an orangish red color.
Is this... the world inside your mind?
It's simply what I'm thinking about at the moment.
How do you like it?
It's beautiful. Like a painting, with this sea of flowers stretching to the horizon.
I'm glad to hear that. I planted a real one, too. Kaga is looking after it.
When we get the chance, perhaps we can admire it together...
Commander {playername}, please direct your attention to me.
Unzen chooses a different direction.
She steadies her breathing, then draws her sword with force.
Take my mind's image... and let it manifest!
Clear rivers, a bright blue sky, vivid greenery, and cherry-pink crystals.
It's a dreamlike view unlike anything in reality or the Cloudsea.
This is the landscape the Prime Sakura presides over in its calm state.
I've spent a long, long time in that place...
Although you cannot enter this landscape in reality, the Dream Stones allow me to introduce you to it in this fashion.
Now comes my turn to create.
Hakuhou steps into what little remains of the chaotic space.
She kneels down and touches the earth with her fingers.
O white phoenix, soar across the world in my stead.
The Cloudsea surges forth, and from it rises a phoenix of white to dance lightly with its long tail.
I can even hear its clear cry resounding in my ears.
The chaos has all disappeared, replaced by three differing landscapes that come together into a single world.
I can't believe my eyes...
It's beautiful. So beautiful that I don't know how else to describe it.
Yeah. I didn't expect such magical things to be possible here.
It's like watching gods weave a world together.
(Heh. It's fine for her to be moved – but you? Why are you moved?)
(So what if they showed you some slightly pretty landscapes? Don't let it make you biased.)
(This is more than just "slightly" pretty.)
(No, it isn't.)
(The Tower can do the same thing, only much better. Why not come see it sometime? It'll be fun.)
(Doing something "fun" with the Tower? Can't say I'm not interested.)
(It's a promise, then.)
(Hey, remember to keep your emotions in check. Try to stay calm, okay?)
(I'm calm, I'm calm...)
(Nicely done. Now, back to work for me.)
After leaving behind the trisected world, we arrive in an empty Cloudsea.
Now, it's time for me to try it.
I take a Dream Stone in hand and press it softly against my forehead.
In a blink, the world is transformed.
I'm aboard a ship that's gently rocking in a calm sea. The sun's rays are gentle, and the breeze is pleasant.
(I saw something for a moment there... What was that?)
Ah, you created an ocean!
As there is a limit on how much space a Dream Stone can create, it would be more apt to call it a slice of an ocean.
At any rate, it suits someone with as deep a connection to the sea, Commander.
Wasn't actually expecting it to be a calm sea... At least it's not a mountain of paperwork.
Pardon – paperwork?
It seems the Orthodoxy's meeting venue has left as much of an impression on you as the battlefield has.
What did your mind picture before you touched the Stone? Surely it wasn't just the sea.
You're right. What I envisioned was "peace."
Peace...
Peace, you say...
Even after we achieve peace, will you still spend every day at sea?
You know, honestly, even I'm not sure. That's why I was curious to see what the Stone would make of "peace."
As it turns out, peace is a blue sea.
The Dream Stones are fascinating things. They can create beautiful landscapes even out of abstract concepts.
If only you could diversify your thinking, and formulate something untethered by the laws of physics or the constraints of reality...
Then the Dream Stone could show you something more surprising.
Commander {playername}, would you like to give it another try?
The resort villa, surrounded by trees. Fresh air and the smell of flowers fill the room. It feels quite different to staying by the beach.
Letting Richelieu and Clemenceau oversee this resort was the right call. They made sure this vacation feels fresh and new.
Seeing as I've got time to myself, I suppose I'll have a dip in the thermae in the woods before I get to work.
As soon as that thought pops into my mind, there's a knock on the door.
Commander! A letter addressed to you has arrived! I implore you to read it!
I'll be off now! I have other parcels that simply must be delivered!
Like an island breeze, Shimakaze blows off.
...They went out of their way to send it to the resort?
What is this? A guidebook to "Aberrinth's Secrets"?
Sounds to me like a new event they're hosting just for this vacation.
Glad they're letting me know ahead of time this time. Not a fan of being thrust into it without any warning.
Let's see... "Like the stars in the night sky, your wisdom shines; it is the blade, sharpest of its kind, that strikes back at your enemy."
"Come now – heed the summons of destiny and enter the ivory tower of the Uroboros Magic Academy."
"You, as the Commander of the Aberrinth Exploration Team, shall venture unto the final destination known as Aberrinth."
"The truth lies at Aberrinth's depths, awaiting you".
So... another story where I go into a fantasy land?
Magic Academy. Exploration Team. Could be fun.
I'll have a closer look later. I need to finish my work for the day first.
The moment I say that, a strange light begins to envelop the room.
What the hell is that light?!
Wait... I think I know where this is going.
Something dawns on me in that very moment.
The fact that the guidebook doesn't list a starting time for this event.
Layer One of Aberrinth - Nevermelting Lake
By the way... Why did Hardi stay here if the Commander went back to the academy?
We all thought you were dead, Commander!
Huh...?
What?!
Okay, who wrote this script, and what gives you the right to kill me off?
Oh. Umm... Sorry, that was the previous version.
I think the newest version is, uh...
Ahem. Everyone thought you were sealed inside Aberrinth!
...Okay. Continue.
We were exploring the Ancient Ruins when, suddenly, there was a blinding light. And you disappeared!
Nobody believed that you'd just disappear that easily, so we decided to scour every layer of Aberrinth.
I stayed on layer one, while Duguay-Trouin and Duquesne went to layer two...
Hey, what if we try going back to the Ancient Ruins? We might be able to find clues!
Masséna, what do you think?
I want to go!
Recommended Quest: Obtain unspecified rewards at the mysterious Ancient Ruins.
Then let's do it!
Layer One of Aberrinth - Ancient Ruins
Our original goal was to fill in the remaining blank spaces on the map, but we triggered a trap in the ruins and got stuck inside.
The Commander managed to get us out of that jam, but then, something even more unexpected happened...
See that arrow? When the light faded and the Commander was gone, that was all that remained.
Le Hardi points at a strikingly elaborate golden arrow stuck in the ground.
On closer inspection, it's carved with intricate animal-like patterns.
The engravings on it seem old...
We all tried to rip it out of the ground, but nobody had the strength to do it.
(If the arrow is connected to my backstory, then maybe I'm the one who has to do something with it?)

options.content: (Have Masséna try to pull it out.)

scripts.say: I'll leave it to you, Masséna.
Got it. I'll do what I can!
Not happening. Even my Peureux working at full power couldn't manage it.
Oh. I got it.
Item Obtained: Elder Elf's Arrow x1.
HOW?!
Item: Elder Elf's Arrow. Crafted by an ancient elven artisan, it possesses the power to destroy all beings of darkness.
It lies dormant for now, but it can be awakened by the following incantation: "Wounds healed by ancient slumber, ultimate disaster held at bay."
"Wounds healed by ancient slumber, ultimate disaster held at bay."
Item Obtained: Elder Elf's Arrow x1.
(Having a strategy guide sure is convenient.)
Layer One of Aberrinth - Frostheim
After leaving the Ancient Ruins, we used the secret passage marked on the map to infiltrate Frostheim.
Today's a weekday. If those girls were right, then Bois Belleau shouldn't be here.
We can safely pass through and use the warp tower to get to the second layer...
Wh-why is the Winter General still here?!
Oh... This might be bad...
Why? Why are you here? Aren't you supposed to be off work today?
I had unfinished sacred duties to attend to, so I returned.
I mean... That's as good a reason as any.
This may be unscheduled work, but I can't let you through.
Now, uninvited guests of ours, prepare to face the Winter General's hospitality.
Character: Bois Belleau, Winter General of Frostheim and master of all monsters on the first layer of Aberrinth.
She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 1st class.
While she acts frigid and seemingly indifferent at most times, she has a caring disposition and prefers to support and care for others from behind the scenes.
Belleau draws a clear line between work and her private life, but once engaged in work, she won't rest until all is complete.
She has the uncanny ability to fall asleep or wake up on a dime at any time or place.
Once, she fell asleep while walking atop the water. She might have drowned if not for you saving her.
(A graduate of the first class? How did she come to lead monsters?)
(It sounds like we have a past between us, too.)
Hmm... Commander, she has the home-court advantage. This could be bad.
I can establish a favourable front for us, but it's going to take time!
This time, I swear that I'll protect the Commander no matter what!
Come on. Bring it!
Wait. Let me talk with her for a moment.
Bois Belleau, Winter General of Frostheim and master of all monsters on the first layer of Aberrinth.
She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 1st class.
H-how do you know so much about me?
Because we adventured together, once upon a time.
I don't remember such a thing.
Besides, a mere human couldn't possibly live that long.
Ngh... Strange. Memories are flooding back... Why is this happening?
She shudders, and a frenzied aura emanates from her.
But it settles shortly after, and she calms down.
...Deutschland? Did you reset my stats? Does that mean I was starting to lose control?
Hey, are you okay?
I think so...
I'll just say it. My companion and I are both burdened with an awful curse.
We've both bound each other with an ancient spell in order to keep the curse from taking us over entirely.
*sigh*... This is what I get for working on my day off.
I'm going home. Just do what you want.
You'll just let us go to the warp tower?
I'm... shocked.
Commander, you might just be luckier than me!
(The strategy guide wins again.)
Let's press on, everyone!
Layer Two of Aberrinth - Miasmic Swamp
CHIRPO CHIRPO!
Right side! Protective spell!
CHIRPO CHIRPO!
I knew you'd attack from that side! Let the storm take you!
At the same time, somewhere else on the battlefield...
Why did the gate throw us out into the middle of a battle?!
I'll need some time to establish a formation...
I'll buy you some time!
That's a whole lot of monsters... Hiyah! Blow them all away!
This is perfect. I've been waiting to try my ancient naval magic.
Stay calm, girls! Form up and intercept the enemy!
KABOOOM!
No enemies remaining. Excellent.
Thanks for helping out, nameless explorers.
Those guys would've been tough work if you hadn't come along.
I'm Mary Celeste, and this is Fancy. We're both outcast mages.
We're the 92nd Exploration Team, and I'm Theseus!
This is {playername}, our Commander, and that's Painlevé, Masséna, and Le Hardi from the 91st.
Damn, the 91st and the 92nd? Time sure flies.
Then let me reintroduce us. I'm Mary Celeste, a necromancer. I was once with the 22nd Exploration Team.
Same with Fancy. She used to be a member of the team.
As for you, {playername} – I've heard a lot about you.
You... know the Commander?
What, does everyone in Aberrinth know the Commander or something?
You're not gonna tell me I was part of the 22nd as well, are you?
"As well"? Nah. I've just heard about you from someone else, that's all.
Seemed to me like she'd been searching for you for a long time.
Let me take you to your camp of outcasts. You'll get what's up once you see her in person.
Um, Mary Celeste, there's something I've been meaning to ask you about...
Yeah? Let me guess – is it about the ghosts floating around me?
Hahah! I was waiting for you to ask about these.
They're a special kind of magic that we use to counter – or rather, avoid – curses.
Curses?
You heard me. Your team hasn't been in Aberrinth for long, has it?
Well, being trapped here for decades makes you more susceptible to a certain type of... environmental curse.
Aberrinth's thought assimilation...
Once an intelligent creature has been in Aberrinth for an extended period, its thoughts will begin merging with those of the ancient dynasty.
You'll start getting memory problems and your body will undergo irreversible changes.
Then again, I guess fighting this curse is the whole reason us outcasts banded together in the first place.
We came up with protection spells and erected a protective barrier. It's let us just barely cling on to sanity while halting the changes to our bodies to a manageable point.
Ah, we've arrived at our campsite. Let's pick this conversation back up in a bit.
What's the password?
Character: Adventure Galley. Outcast mage. She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 22nd class.
"Mages are stronger than monsters."
Correct.
Character: Amity. Outcast mage. She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 22nd class.
(They're both from the 22nd?)
Welcome to Derelictus Hold!
Mary Celeste opens the door to the tavern, and an oddly sweet aroma hits me in the face.
Welcome, welcome! I've been waiting for you!
Duguay-Trouin! Thank gosh you're okay!
More than okay, even... You look like you're thriving.
I swear I heard someone call you "leader" just as I came in. What's that about?
I'm not so much a leader as I am a manager. While we're all mages here, nobody is as meticulous with the little things like I am.
Also, {playername}, it's good to see you. I knew you'd make it out all right.
I guess "alright" is the word. You don't happen to know anything, do you? About what happened to me back then.
I believe Duquesne uncovered a lead and is conducting an investigation. You'll surely learn everything once you find her.
Now, enough of that. This is a blessed reunion, and it must be celebrated with ample drinks!
The following day...
(Man, that food was really realistic. I didn't think it'd actually make me feel full and put me to sleep.)
...regroup at...
...found traces of three enemy forces on the move...
...sightings of the Demon Princess...
(What's that about? Are they discussing strategy?)
Ah. Did you have a good night's sleep?
Sure did. Anyway, is there a problem? Caused by some monster?
So you heard that...
It's nothing so serious. I suspect you saw some ferocious monsters en route here yesterday, no?
There are two main types of monsters living on the second layer. The first simply follows its instincts of destroying everything it sees.
The second type, however, makes up an army of organized, intelligent monsters. Their leader is one by the name of Deutschland, also known as the Demon Princess.
It appears that she is in an alliance with the Winter General on the first layer.
I know her. We actually encountered the General when we were on the first layer.
Is your group and the Demon Princess fighting each other?
We have been, for many years. Her and her army and the outcasts never got along even before I arrived here. They've fought over every little thing.
Things have changed lately, however, with me working to end the fighting between them.
You mean by concentrating your forces and engaging them in all-out war?
Not quite. I'm trying to forge an alliance with them.
Really, now?
This all stems from the monsters becoming more violent.
Not only that, their numbers suddenly skyrocketed recently. They've collided with not just us, but the Demon Princess' army quite frequently.
Neither of us is particularly pleased with this, and that's how we got to the point where we've finally considered an alliance.
So what was that deployment talk from earlier about?
It was about the defensive force that'll guard the place where the alliance will be signed.
It just so happens it's tomorrow. Why don't you come along and see it?
Recommended Quest: Go to the location and witness the alliance being made.
It being such an important event, I just have to see it. I'm also curious to meet this so-called Demon Princess.
Then we have a plan. Until then, get comfortable around the camp and let's have a couple of drinks!
A bit early for drinking. Didn't you drink loads yesterday, too?

There's little in the way of pastimes in Aberrinth, and leaving the camp requires maintaining a purification barrier which drains a lot of mana. I think you'll agree that this is the best place to be.
Come on, don't just stand there. I'll take the first sip! Cheers!
Later that night...
Another day where nothing happened...
Duguay-Trouin's nothing if not talented at tempting people into depravity.
On the bright side, I picked up a key clue while talking to Mary earlier.
That Clemenceau, the principal, once passed out while exploring the second layer.
By the time the outcasts found her, she was on the brink of death. Strangely, though, she got better in the blink of an eye just as they tried to heal her.
Clemenceau's body clearly keeps some kind of secret...
Character Supplement: Clemenceau. Your classmate. She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 17th class.
Really, now?
How is Clemenceau, from the class of 17, one of my classmates?
The 17th, the 91st, the 92nd... and the 1st, the most mysterious of them all.
Wait a second... Just how many times have I graduated in this story?
The next day, before the sun has risen...
After two days of rest, it was time for us and the outcast mages to head to the Whispering Grove, where the alliance would be signed.
There, we find that the monster army is waiting for us in an orderly line.
Outcast mages – I, Deutschland, accept all the conditions of your pact.
Our war is hereby over. Therefore, there's no need to drag this ceremony on any longer.
Your reputation for loathing to waste time holds true, I see, Miss Demon Princess.
Then we just need to sign the document and we can all go home – am I correct?
The Chosen One will stay here. That means you.
I've waited eons for you. Now, come! Demonstrate that you're capable of fulfilling your duty!
"Chosen One"? You mean... me?
Hey! Whoa! Why is she attacking us?!
I had a feeling it wouldn't be so simple... Plan B! Drive the monsters back!
It really is you... You fought and won, as you should have.
Just as the prophecy foretold!
What's this about there being a "Chosen One"?
Are you not just making excuses for attacking us?
Do you really think I'd do that? Apologies for my rude and sudden attack, but I had to verify the truth as soon as possible.
At any rate, we can't stay here for long. I'll explain the rest at my palace.
Layer Two of Aberrinth - Palace of Pandemonium, some time later...
On a night many years ago, the monsters of Aberrinth, me included, all had the same dream.
It said that, soon, the Chosen One would appear and put a stop to the war, reunite our fractured tribes, and lead us to the forgotten ancient kingdom.
The one in our dream had your exact same hair and clothes and was skilled with the same magic as you. That's why I'm convinced that you're the Chosen One.
(I don't buy that for a second. Let's see what the strategy guide says.)
Character: Deutschland. Also known as the Demon Princess. Leader of the monsters on the second layer and lord of the Palace of Pandemonium.
She was a top graduate of Uroboros Magic Academy's 1st class.
She is also a noble and a descendant of the elder elves.
She came to this place on an important mission. You and she have had fun adventuring together in the past.
(She's a 1st class graduate, just like Bois Belleau? What? And what's that about us "having adventured together"?)
(This doesn't make sense. Was I a part of the first-ever Exploration Team?)
You must have many questions, Chosen One. Ask and I will answer each and every one.
You and Bois Belleau were classmates, and you were a top graduate of the Academy's 1st class. You and I also once adventured together.
Do you remember any of this?
While it's true I have known Belleau for a long time, it's been so long that I can't remember when we first got to know each other.
And you say you and I adventured together? How would that be possible if you're from the 92nd?
Even if I were on the 1st Exploration Team, there's no way I could have adventured with you, a member of the 92nd team.
Well, the Commander HAS been a member of the 92nd, 91st, and 17th teams, all at once. I don't know how, but it's true.
So it's not the craziest thing in the world that you might've been together on the 1st team.
What an incredible feat... If anyone could do that, it would be the Chosen One.
(This isn't the time to sing my praises...)
What about you descending from the elder elves? Do you remember that?
How does someone like you end up as the leader of an army of monsters?
I don't know. I can't remember.
However, this conversation has jogged a few memories I have of the ancient kingdom.
Your body, Chosen One, is blessed with an ancient protection spell.
This spell is likely the reason why you've experienced these miraculous things.
Does this ancient spell come from the elder elves?
I've been struck by the elder elves' weapons in the past.
That's impossible! Simply impossible!
I personally deployed the defenses on the first layer when... Ah, I'm remembering something...
No... It's gone.
The spirits are getting restless... Means Aberrinth's thought assimilation is getting stronger.
(Is there some link between Aberrinth's monsters and the Elder Elves' descendants? And what were those "defenses" she mentioned?)
We might as well keep moving if you don't know right now.
Good point. Deutschland, can you show us the way to the third layer?
Yes, of course. Just know that the third layer is completely different to what you've seen here.
A mighty Dark Elf rules over that land – Albion, the Lord of Aberrinth. She is also the governor of the Forgotten Reach.
We may just be able to restore the ancient kingdom and return it to prosperity if you defeat her.
Let's make haste and depart at once.
You're coming with us?
Naturally. I can't wait to see the deeds you'll accomplish, Chosen One. Heehee.
Layer Three of Aberrinth - Forgotten Reach
With the help of the Palace of Pandemonium's warp magic, we successfully reached the deepest depths of Aberrinth.
To the southwest, the ruined kingdom of the elder elves is all but buried by sand.
The sound of iron boots walking on stone can be heard faintly in the wind, but the sound only leads to tattered flags fluttering beneath the moonlight.
What a desolate place... Oh, Commander, look over there!
Le Hardi points deep into the ruined city. There looms a tower shooting a blue beam of light into the sky above.
Could that be the legendary Spire of Cycles of the third layer?
Correct. That's also the tower controlled by Albion, Lord of Aberrinth.
If we defeat her and reclaim the third layer, we can restore the ancient kingdom to its former glory!
We cross the decayed walls and enter the city proper, surprisingly unopposed.
It's almost too quiet... We haven't seen a single thing, monster or otherwise.
Look closely. The city's infrastructure is still in working order.
Somebody must be performing regular maintenance.
Something's going on here.
Indeed. We've passed by plenty of neglected and ruined places on the way here.
Visitors to the third layer should be rare at best... This city has been exposed to hundreds of years of erosion.
But its facilities show numerous signs of recent use.
By who, though?
There's someone ahead... No, behind us?!
To our sides, too... We're completely surrounded!
The sleeping city has awakened.
Figures in black clothing line up and move in lifeless synchronicity like puppets. The same motions, the same faces, like phantoms in the night.
Heheh, I get it. This is illusion magic.
We were right, Commander. This city isn't abandoned at all – SOMEBODY is taking care of it.
And that somebody is our enemy... the Phantoms of Lord Albion.
...Defeat.
...Defeat hostiles, defeat disaster...
Whoa, they're speeding up!
This is bad... We need to–
Build a combat front, right? Don't worry! We'll buy you time!
Don't break formation! Defend yourselves and launch a counterattack!
KABOOOM!
Knights of the Enduring Fortress, form up and eliminate these invaders!
Huh? Reinforcements here, of all places?
Do you think it's the exploration team that got trapped on the third layer?
Step aside, lost adventurers. We will handle the rest.
Yes, leave this to us.
- Duquesne?! - YOU?!
Why are you here? And the Commander, too... Thank goodness. I always hoped you were safe.
Huh? Are they friends of yours?
Comrades in battle, and reliable mages at that.
Reliable mages... But they look so young. I guess you can't judge a book by its cover.
Allow me. These two are Royal Knights who've protected the Enduring Fortress with me all this time, Royal Oak and Revenge.
Let's discuss details after we've dispatched of the invaders.
There's a twinkle in her eye, as if she has some hidden motive.
(Now may not be the time to interrogate her, but that's fine. I have a strategy guide anyway.)
Location: The Enduring Fortress. A stronghold shrouded in mystery.
Organization: Royal Knights, a group shrouded in mystery.
Character: Royal Oak, a mysterious Royal Knight.
Character: Revenge, a mysterious Royal Knight.
Character Supplement: Duquesne, a member of the 91st Exploration Team. For mysterious reasons, she's now a member of the Royal Knights.
(Impressively... mysterious, I guess.)
TWEEVIL TWEEVIL!
An enemy swarm! Commander, watch out!
After the battle, we followed Royal Oak's group – who insisted on treating us as guests – to the Enduring Fortress.

...Thus, with the help of reinforcements skilled in modern magicks from the Association of Mages, we managed to defeat enemies many times greater in number than us and returned to the fortress without issue...
So they finally sent their precious Elite Mage Corps to the front line? That's great!
Thank you for all coming all this way from the capital. Get some proper rest in our fortress tonight.
Duquesne had cleverly introduced our exploration team to them as "reinforcements from the capital's Association of Mages."
Character: Centaur. The mysterious Royal Knight captain who fearlessly protects the Enduring Fortress.
(If everyone's mysterious, then nobody's mysterious.)
(I don't think the strategy guide is going to help much here. Might as well figure out things for myself.)
Your assistance is greatly appreciated. We won't forget what you've done for us today.
We've fought here for years to defend the kingdom from the Calamitous One.
Calamitous...
Yes. Pardon me for the sudden question, but you all hail from the capital, yes?
What is the situation in Benedictus? Are supplies plentiful? Are the citizens safe?
Ah, I'm sorry... There I go, bombarding you with questions. You must be tired from the long way here...
The sun will set soon. Duquesne, please show the elite mages to their rooms.
And mages? You must remain in your rooms from sunset to sunrise. I mean this.
Outside... strange things are known to happen. I can't divulge details at this time, but...
Nothing bad will happen to you as long as you stay in your room, I assure you.
Enduring Fortress - Guest Room
The furniture here reflects the popular tastes from hundreds of years ago.
How do you know that?
It's obvious at a glance, isn't it? But I'm not sure why... Ugh, why can't I remember?
You're a magician too, right, Duquesne? How did you come to join the Royal Knights?
You insult me, Commander. Don't you remember my peerless swordsmanship and mastery of the Flashing Light spell?
Yes, I may well be the greatest master out there. You'll need no light source as long as I'm around.
I happen to be an accomplished swordsman, too.
My swordsmanship and combat skills are of mastery utmost.
Just don't ask her to do magic. All she knows is the Flashing Light spell.
Okay, but what about this Calamitous One that Centaur mentioned?
Do you remember the history of Aberrinth, Commander?
(Strategy guide. Tell me the history of Aberrinth, quick!)
Location: Aberrinth. A three-layered abyss created by a catastrophe two hundred years ago. It is home to dangerous monsters and abundant materials alike.
Two hundred years ago, a meteor landed in the ancient kingdom's territory, spewing evil in its wake. Aberrinth was created at this time.
This place is our front line against the Calamitous One's advance.
Ever since parting ways with Le Hardi and Duguay-Trouin, I've been exploring the third layer.
It wasn't until I met the knights that I found a properly functioning organization.
What I'm saying is... this fortress is special. Especially at night–
KABOOOM!
An earthquake? N-no... Look outside!
Perfect timing. See for yourself what's happening.
The watchtowers ring their alarms, and fires are lit all around for smoke signals, illuminating the defensive army atop the city walls in the process.
Nightmarish monsters close in from the dark below.
We're under attack!
Once the light fades, I find myself before a heavy door.
It leads to a grand auditorium, at the opposite end of which stands a pure-white tower that reaches into the clouds.
Frankly, I don't think I understand what this is about.
Good thing I still have the guidebook on hand.
The book got sent here with me. I open the first page to learn the fundamentals... only to discover that the pages are blank, and letters start forming before my eyes.
Location: Uroboros Magic Academy. A school that has produced many outstanding mages. Its name is known by all in the world of magic.
Talk about a unique way to dump exposition.
So this is the Magic Academy, then?
Current Quest: Enter the auditorium and attend the 91st graduation ceremony.
Wait, I'm graduating already?
I push open the heavy, wooden door. The packed auditorium bursts with cheering from all around.
Those are our seniors. They're positively glowing...
Mhm! I hope when we graduate, we'll look as great as they do!
Hey, Theseus. Do you still have any snacks?
I do. Just leave some for the rest of us, okay?
{playername}! I've been looking for you. Why do you stand by the door, looking clueless?
Character: Duquesne. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 91 at the Academy.
Uh, good morning?
This is no time for greetings nonchalant and chatter idle.
Character: Duquesne. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 91 at the Academy.
Huh? Are you still half-asleep? What's this you're speaking of all of a sudden?
Never mind that. Come along. The ceremony will start momentarily.
Duquesne grabs my hand and guides me through the crowd and to the seating for the graduates.
Commander! Over here! I reserved a special seat just for you!
Character: Duquesne. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 91 at the Academy.
Heheh. You've finally come. It seems my prayer was answered!
Character: Le Hardi. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 91 at the Academy.

options.content: (Have a chat while you look around.)

scripts.say: Is it just us graduates here today?
No, there are others! Those in the seats over there are reps from lower grades.
Character: Le Hardi. Your classmate. One of the graduates of–
Hey, cut it out! Stop reading!
BANG!
High over our heads, colorful fireworks go off with a bang.
Then, a figure clad in black robes slowly ascends to the stage, drawing the whole auditorium's attention with this one eye-catching spell.
Character: Clemenceau. The youngest principal in the Academy's history, as well as the current youngest grand mage in the world of magic.
Attention: She must not be allowed to know about this codex's existence.
(That heads-up sure came at the perfect time.)
(...You know, I'm starting to get the feeling that this is a chatbot disguised as a guidebook.)
Greetings, our outstanding graduates! Greetings, our unknown but young and aspirational students!
Welcome to the world of magic!
There is more than one road in life. Soon, you will face many situations wherein you must choose, and I believe you'll make the choice that's right for you.
For instance, you can join the Royal Ministry of Magic and become a talented civil servant, with benefits such as a governmental title as well as lifetime employment.
Naturally, you'll also be able to use the red telephone booth we've inherited from our ancestors and move about with it.
Another option is to join the Akashi Company and work as an Aberrinth trader.
You'll get to flex all the things that you learned at the Academy and make waves in the Aberrinth material trade.
Or, perhaps, you'd like to register with the St. Unicorn's Magic Hospital and save countless lives as an exceptional healer.
Assuming you complete the rigorous five-year course, you'll even be able to skillfully treat your companions returning wounded from Aberrinth.
However, it must be said that all matters in Benedictus – big or small – revolve around Aberrinth.
Thus, there is one career that's widely considered to draw the most attention, attract the most people, and lead to the most success – Aberrinth exploration.
If there's one thing you must remember, it's this...
No matter what path you choose, the stars of Uroboros shining in the sky will always light the path forward and guide you.
Amid ceaseless applause, the curtain quietly falls on the ceremony.
Let's go, {playername}. We've been told to come to the principal's office in the ceremony's wake.
Painlevé, Le Hardi, accompany us.
It's time. It's finally time...
I've been waiting so long for this. Wonder what tasks they'll assign this year.
(Oh boy. What are we in for here?)
Uroboros Magic Academy - Principal's Office
Duquesne, Le Hardi, Duguay-Trouin, and {playername}. Heheh. Right on time.
I presume you all have an idea of why I called you here, yes?
Character Supplement: Beyond serving as the Academy's principal, Clemenceau is also a member of the Benedictus Council and an expert on the history of the Elder Elf Kingdom.
Additionally, she is the only grand mage who has explored the entirety of the third layer of Aberrinth and come back alive.

Location: Benedictus. A magical city surrounded by Aberrinth. It was rebuilt atop the ruins of an ancient kingdom a hundred years ago and brought back to life. It has been the birthplace of many excellent Aberrinth exploration teams.
Location: Aberrinth. A three-layered abyss created by a catastrophe two hundred years ago. It is home to dangerous monsters and abundant materials alike.
(This feels a lot more high-budget than our last fantasy adventure... By the way, where can I see my character build?)
Each year, the graduating class lends its name to a single, unique Aberrinth exploration team.
This team differs from others by being composed of our best graduates, and it undertakes missions assigned directly by the Academy.
And you, the top-ranking students of this year, are the 91st Aberrinth Exploration Team.
Your leader will be {playername}, and your second-in-command will be Duquesne.
Your mission will be to descend into Aberrinth, explore the second layer, and fill in our incomplete map of it.
You will be on this mission for at least 60 days, but no more than 90.
Understood, Principal Clemenceau. I vow upon my honor that we will meet the Academy's expectations.
Most impressive, coming from the youngest first-grade mage in history – who earned this title while still in school, no less. It is no exaggeration to say the success of this mission hinges on you.
Let's give it our best shot!
Archers, nock!
Loose!
Arrows rain from the battlements, but they do nothing to stop the enemy's advance.
Centaur, our first defensive line has fallen!
It's only a matter of time before the second goes down, too!
Try to hold on! If we can just make it until dawn...
Centaur, there's a breach in the wall!
Damn!
A well-coordinated barrage of artillery rips through the night and annihilates the enemies trying to breach the city.
Mage? Why are you here?
We're your reinforcements, remember? We won't sit idly by while the fortress is destroyed!
But...
Oh, no! The city wall has collapsed!

scripts.actorName: A group of Infernal Deviljuus has appeared.
scripts.say: TWEEVIL TWEEVIL!
The devastating battle ends with dawn's arrival. Our foes recede like the tide, leaving destruction in their wake.
Royal Oak, how are your injuries?
Just a few scratches... I'll be fine in no time.
Look at what they've done to our walls. I'm not sure we can survive another siege.
...I wouldn't worry about that. A moment, please.
Huh? The walls and structures are repairing themselves?!
And Royal Oak's leg injury is gone...
We were all just as surprised when we first witnessed this miracle.
At first, we believed that the sages had cast a spell upon the walls. But our experimentation proved that it was far from that simple.
The same thing happened night after night, on the ensuing dawn... like clockwork.
That was why we sought reinforcements from the capital, but constant troubles prevented us from ever leaving the fortress for too long.
This situation has gone far beyond our wildest expectations...
Tip: You'll receive a different quest depending on whether you tell the Royal Knights the truth or lie.
...I see.
Let me be honest. We're not reinforcements from the Association of Mages.
We come from a world 200 years ahead of yours... one where the elder elves' kingdom has fallen, where the Calamitous One has yet to appear.
Oh... Is that true? Then my suspicions must be right, after all.
The Royal Knights... No, our very fortress... They don't exist anymore, do they?
If you've heard the name Albion before, then I think you know what I mean to say.
The elf Albion was a superb mage, and her best magic of all... was creating illusions.
Maybe we're nothing but another of her illusions.
Whatever the case, we've fought for hundreds of years, isolated and unaided.
We must put an end to this...
If everything here IS an illusion, then I may know a way to dispel it.
But I'll need everyone's help to do it.
Of course. I cede command of the knights to you. Guide us back to true dawn, Commander!
The next day, noon came and went in a blink. As the curtain of night falls again, the army of monsters once more amasses itself outside the fortress.
Just as she'd done every night for hundreds of years, Centaur commands the knights to go into battle against the approaching army.
Meanwhile, I, Masséna, and Deutschland leave the fortress together to search for something in the wastes.
There must be a magic circle somewhere to sustain an illusion spell of these proportions.
Masséna, help us find the circle.
Okay. My gut tells me to go this way.
Left!
Now... right!
Another left turn here, and...
Found it!
Treasure Site: The magic circle in the Place of Illusions has been marked on your map.
Easy peasy.
At the same time, at the Enduring Fortress...
Centaur, the mana in the surroundings is changing.
Yes. It's getting weaker and weaker, changing into something I'm not familiar with.
Loyal knights of the kingdom, gather under the banner of the Fallen God!
This will be the Enduring Fortress' final counterattack and our last battle. Please, let us make it a glorious finale!
Form a line and advance!
Sometime later, Centaur fired her final golden arrow as the enemy was beginning to retreat.
The magic circle's destruction had broken the equilibrium, and the massive illusion could no longer sustain itself.
It's finally over...
Even the beams of light piercing through the clouds feel... different to the usual.
You did it. Great work, everybody.
Indeed. Victory is ours. I'm glad your team made it back safely, Commander.
I'm delighted that we could speak one last time before we fade away.
I wish I could leave behind a tale like, "The Commander's and the knights' journey still continues." Alas...
I'm afraid this is where we must say goodbye.
Don't forget about us, Commander.
The illusory fortress disappears. The elder elves who gave their lives for their kingdom leave for their final resting place.
During all this, a mysterious passage appears.
Where goes this path?
I think there's something really nice hidden at the end of it!
What are we waiting for? Let's go investigate!
We follow the passage to its endpoint, where an intense sleepiness suddenly comes over us.
*yawn*... So tired. My gut is telling me to go to sleep right now.
Same... I feel so sleepy all of a sudden.
Hmph. I suppose I can lower myself to... take a short nap with you.

options.content: In that case, I'll get some shuteye as well.

scripts.say: No, Commander... My intuition says... you need to stay awake... Zzz...
Attention: You should remain awake and keep watch.
Alright then... I'll stay up and see what happens.
It's been 10 minutes.
It's now been 20 minutes.
Ikazuchi, the Commander's starting to doze off.
I see! Since you've shown just how badly you wanna see us, we'll unlock this secret event for you.
In a trance, I hear faint whispers coming from the sky. The next thing I know, a desolate land and a temple appear out of nowhere.
Congratulations on getting the secret event. We're waiting for you inside the temple.
Layer Three of Aberrinth(?) - Temple
There you are, Commander!
It seems the ancient kingdom's blessing still works.
Who are you?
Character: Ikazuchi. A mysterious girl who's come out of nowhere. She's smart and strong.
Character: Inazuma. A mysterious girl who's come out of nowhere. She's strong and smart.
Attention: They know about this codex's existence.
Did you... write this into the story yourselves?
What do you reckon, Inazuma? Should we feign ignorance about the Commander's meta comments?
That's our only real option. Let's treat it as though this is the first time all of us meet in this story.
Alright, will do.
Have we met somewhere before?
To reward you for solving the Enduring Fortress' mystery, we're gonna tell you a story.
We presume that you've heard about the Calamitous One.
This story begins long ago, around 200 years in the past...
When the Calamitous One appeared, virtually every elf in the ancient kingdom fought until their last breath to protect Benedictus and the strongholds around the region.
Those elves who didn't instead fought to prevent the spread of calamity inside Aberrinth. They, too, fell victim to its corrosive power.
Still, there are a few rare, special cases like Deutschland. She is an elder elf who went out to survey this land with the 1st Expedition Team after her kingdom fell.
What about the Lord of Aberrinth – Albion? Is she tied to the Calamitous One?
Uhh... In the previous version, she was just someone you had to defeat.
But we wanted this fantasy adventure to be more fun for you, so we added a little secret quest for you.
This secret quest... remains shrouded in mystery.
Okay?
Active Quest: Your current quest objective is still a mystery. Investigate further to find potential leads.
Do you still remember the Elder Elf's Arrow you retrieved on the first layer?
That arrow contains a sacred power that excels at cleansing the dark and purifying corrosion.
It's a hugely important relic, so think very carefully about whether you want to use it or not.
We've said our bit now. We wish you luck on the rest of your journey with your party.
Aaand that's it for this secret event!
Layer Three of Aberrinth - Ancient Battlefield Ruins
Mgh... I think I just had a really long but really delicious dream.
Seems we all dozed off. Thank god nothing happened while we were sleeping.
I... was an elder elf descendant who came to Aberrinth with the 1st Exploration Team...
Gah! Why can't I remember?!
What I can remember, though, is reading about those girls you saw in an ancient book. I think they were the elves' gods of thunder and lightning.
Gods?
Ikazuchi, the smart and strong god of lightning. Inazuma, the strong and smart god of thunder.
I have no idea who you're talking about...
Anyway, about the Elder Elf's Arrow – as they said, it's a relic made to cleanse the dark and purify corrosion.
That thing should be able to deal with Albion, somehow.
So, in other words, we're just one step away from reclaiming Aberrinth and restoring the ancient kingdom!
Something tells me it's not so straightforward. They dodged the question when I asked them about Albion's connection to the Calamitous One.
I'm sure we'll uncover another lead if we're able to deal with Albion one way or another, though.
That's exactly what my gut's telling me! So, let's get back on the trail!
Layer Three of Aberrinth - Spire of Cycles
Finally, we reach the top floor of the Spire of Cycles.
We spot a girl curled up and sleeping on the throne.
Character: Albion. Lord of Aberrinth and captain of the Elder Elf Kingdom's royal guard.
Lord of Aberrinth, Albion... We finally meet.
Is she sleeping? She hasn't reacted to our arrival at all.
She looks so comfy... It's making me sleepy, too.
Now's our chance! Pierce her with the arrow to cleanse the dark!
You make it sound so easy... like it's some kind of trap.
I don't THINK it's a trap...
But who knows what might happen if we let her wake up?
Special Tip: Stabbing her with the Elder Elf's Arrow will lead you to the true ending. If she awakens on her own, a very challenging encounter will begin.
A challenging encounter, huh? I'd rather not. Let's just keep progressing.
Then we should act now!
The instant it makes contact with her, the Elder Elf's Arrow radiates dazzling light.
The fog weighing on me has finally lifted... It's been ages since I had such a pleasant awakening.
Character Supplement: Now purified, Albion can use pure elven power.
(Well, that was easy. I feel like having Masséna and the strategy guide on my side made this all a little too easy.)
Are you all from the Elite Mage Corps?
We're the Aberrinth Exploration Team from Benedictus. Albion, can you tell us anything about the Calamitous One?
Benedictus... How strange it is to hear that name again. That was once our capital.
In olden times, it was the source of countless tales of bravery, pride, loyalty, and tragedy.
As for the Calamitous One... We once believed that the guidance of the three sages would help us reclaim our lost home from her.
But now... I think that you, those with the power to awaken me, may just have what it takes to save the world.
I'll guide you to the hidden realm where the three sages reside.
To the Realm of Slumber.
Layer Three of Aberrinth - Ancient Battlefield Ruins
We've arrived.
The Ancient Battlefield Ruins? This is where we came from.
It's where the Commander met those two gods, too...
Will Inazuma and Ikazuchi appear this time, too?
I'll need a moment. Before the calamity engulfed me, I used my illusion magic to conceal the Realm of Slumber...
...Hmm? Are you saying you've met Inazuma and Ikazuchi?
Two hundred years ago, this temple was built and dedicated to the elves' most revered twin goddesses.
Only those they've invited are permitted to set foot within.
I had no idea their power still resided in this world... This may be wonderful news for us.
Before I dispel the illusion, I must tell you all how that apocalyptic war ended.
Once upon a time, when forests flourished and life filled the world, the three elven sages walked the land with us. Everyone, even orphaned children, took up arms to fight for hope.
But as we lost our strongholds one by one, the power of the three sages waned.
In the end, the sages made the ultimate sacrifice. They sealed the Calamitous One in eternal slumber, putting themselves to sleep in the process.
Thus, this Realm of Slumber is also where the Calamitous One is sealed.
Commander, I sense the sages' protective blessing within you.
But they should still be asleep... I just hope the seal holds...
Illusion, dispel!
The illusion fades, revealing an enormous ancient tree. It towers into the twilight sky.
Withering branches stretch desperately upward, like the faded crowns of decayed gods, struggling to protect the dying elven bloodline even as they themselves die.
I can sense it... The mother tree weeps.
Oh, no... Something is draining the tree's life force!
A barrier sinister with construction cunning envelops this place.
Offensive magic most powerful will be needed to break it.
Did someone say offensive magic? Heheh, it's finally my time to shine!
I'll build a position now. Just you wait!
KABOOOM!
The barrier is wavering, but it's not enough yet.
Let's combine our attacks!
Casting spell... Cannon Volley! And Saturation Bombardment, too!
KABOOOM!
The focused bombardment obliterates the barrier in the blink of an eye.
Modern mages are so powerful... If I'm not mistaken, {playername}, did you just use naval magic?
Even in our time, that was high-level magic only usable by a sparse few great mages.
I'm all but certain now. You have the power to overcome the terror wrought by the Calamitous One.
Now that the way is open... let's go meet the three sages!
Realm of Slumber - Silent Grove
The three elven sages sleep quietly under the tree of life.
Despite the peaceful looks on their faces, they exude a dreamlike majesty.
Thank goodness... The defensive barrier held. Their sealing spell seems to be working, too, as the Calamitous One still sleeps...
I'll awaken the sages now. The Calamitous One is sure to wake up alongside them.
It should be weakened from its centuries of slumber. Use this opportunity to defeat her.
In short... This will be your final battle, {playername}.
Sorry – I'm just so nervous. But I know you've been ready for this for a long time.
Defeating the Calamitous One will purify our tainted land.
The raging blizzards will quiet, decayed forests will regain their former vigor, and buildings buried in sand will be renewed...
Our world was once so beautiful. I'll never forget the sprouting buds and fresh branches from the spring seasons of my youth. If only you all could see that beauty, too.
Special Tip: Warning! Danger approaches! Danger approaches!
With a crack, the charm I received from Emden suddenly shatters. Thick black mist undulates out of it like a living being.
I've done it! The three sages will soon awaken. Everyone, prepare for–
...{playername}? What is that magic?!
The sunlight blazes brighter, mingling with the black mist to make a disquieting aura.
*yaaawn*... That felt like a really long sleep.
Are you... the same human from before?
Heehee, it looks like our protective magic worked...
The black shade dancing around you... It's the Calamitous One!
"You have the Calamitous One's sublime gratitude, my darling human."
"I am the very meteor that wrought disaster, the enduring malice, the master of despair."
Character Supplement: Emden's true identity is that of the Calamitous One, the incarnation of the meteor that fell upon this world 200 years ago.
"You've escaped my grasp three times now, human."
"The first was when these odious elves protected you."
Character Supplement: {playername}. The Commander of the 1st Aberrinth Exploration Team. Led Bois Belleau, Deutschland, and ???.
During their exploration of the Realm of Slumber, an unexpected accident awakened the Calamitous One and the three sages, leading to {playername}'s blessing by the elves.
"The second was when you brought Clemenceau to me. That vessel finally gave me freedom of movement."
Character Supplement: {playername}. The Commander of the 17th Aberrinth Exploration Team. Led Clemenceau, La Galissonnière, and Joffre.
"And the last was when someone used the trap in the Ancient Ruins to divert your route..."
Character Supplement: {playername}. The Commander of the 91st Aberrinth Exploration Team. Led Le Hardi, Duguay-Trouin, and Duquesne.
"But this time, I will not fail."
"In fact, my success is all but guaranteed this time."
"The elven blessing inside you can also be used to destroy their barrier, giving me access to wear away at their very spirits."
"The age of elves is over. Now, an era of disaster will reign!"
The Codex Magicus in my hand glows, as if defying the encroaching darkness.
...You finally remember everything, Commander. Thank goodness.
A girl clad in pure white appears before me in the darkness. She smiles.
Character Supplement: Codex Magicus. Emden's reliquary box. A member of the 1st Aberrinth Exploration Team.
I've been by your side all this time.
Emden gently grasps my hand and places something soft in it.
Accept my essence.
Save me, awaken me...
And take me home once and for all.
...I'll hold you to that promise, Commander.
Goodbye... We will meet again.
The spires on every floor of Aberrinth have been destroyed...
If the Calamitous One reveals her true form and joins forces with Principal Clemenceau...
Then Benedictus will fall once again.
Let's not fret too much for now. The Commander is still sleeping, so we'll have plenty of time to analyze...
...Huh? C-Commander, you're awake!
How long did I sleep?
For like an entire day!
Special Note: Only 30 minutes have passed.
Tell me everything that's happened in the past thirty minutes.
Dean Emden... I mean, the Calamitous One corrupted the elven sages three after you fell unconscious.
She fled our pursuit, escaped Aberrinth, and destroyed all of the warp towers.
In short, we're now trapped here...
Even if we could leave Aberrinth, we have no hope of reaching Benedictus.
Based on her claims, Principal Clemenceau is a pawn of the Calamitous One.
Yeah. I feel it, too... Benedictus is in grave danger.
Bois Belleau and the other outcast mages should have noticed by now, but they need more time to muster a defense.
Buying time... That's it!
The Calamitous One's actions put her fatal weakness on full display. She knows this is going to be a hell of a fight.
She destroyed the warp towers because she needs time to build a defensive line. In other words, she isn't ready yet.
That means we must act now!
A counterattack, eh? But how do we get there with the towers destroyed?
What about warp magic?
Character Supplement: Ikazuchi and Inazuma. Twin elven goddesses. They have the power to create warp tunnels across dimensions.
...In that case, we can help.
The summoning spell...
I think we're all thinking the same thing.
Could it be?!
Commander, I think I represent all elves when I say, thank you so much for all of you and your teams' efforts.
Let's work together, activate the twin goddess summoning circle, and begin our counteroffensive!
"Behold thunder and lightning, most radiant twins among the gods."
"Reveal thy majestic forms and usher in the light of miracles."
"To you, calamity is but a small, fleeting thing."
"Where darkness can never reach, light and pure beauty live eternal."
I see... Look who called for our help.
I heard your pleas – you want an elevator built from Aberrinth to Benedictus. What a fun idea.
Sounds just a little bit illegal, but you can have special approval just this once.
This is the final request that we twin goddesses can fulfill for you.
It's your war, mortals. Throw yourselves into it all you want!
As the rain, thunder, and lightning fade, a rainbow bridge to Benedictus appears.
Mmh... Zzz...
KABOOOM!
Hmh?
Meh... Zzz...
The battle had already begun as the rainbow bridge to Benedictus extended.
Although she had had little time, the Calamitous One had still skillfully established a defensive line.
Standing on a viewing platform in Benedictus, Clemenceau and her army of gargoyles await us.
I see you've remembered everything, "Commander."
It's not too late to quit, Clemenceau. Give it up.
No. It IS too late.
Ignorance is bliss, and humanity should've stayed ignorant.
We brought calamity's insatiable appetite upon ourselves when we learned of the gods' forbidden knowledge.
The price we paid? You went missing, and I betrayed myself in exchange for a chance to live.
But you keep ruining my plans again and again, just as you are now.
Forget it... We'll discuss the past when we stand on the line between life and death.
Because right now, there's unfinished business between us, isn't there?
KABOOOM!
Clemenceau is sent flying and tries to move forward again, but that same moment, the warp gate begins to glow, and a snowstorm whips up.
I am Bois Belleau, member of the 1st Exploration Team, here to assist!
Thank the stars we made it! The 22nd Exploration Team awaits your orders.
We shall deal with Clemenceau and her gargoyles! The rest of you, focus on the tougher enemies!
Time to go, Commander.
For us both.
The Calamitous One soars high in the dark sky, seemingly anticipating the battle that's soon to come.
"Heheh. You've finally come, my darling human."
"There are those who lose their minds or even their lives when they lay eyes upon me. Some who've lost all hope even surrender to me."
"But you... You alone are able to gaze upon me without fear. Why is that?"
"I want to know the answer."

options.content: You'll know once I've beaten you.
The lack of an answer is an answer in its own way.

scripts.say: "That look you have, brimming with confidence... I find it surprisingly amusing."
"Heehee. You've thoroughly entertained me, and for that, I must thank you."
"Haven't you forgotten something, though, human?"
"If you want your enemy to surrender, the best thing..."
"If you want your enemy to surrender, the best thing..."
"Is a bang – from a cannon!"
Weapon: The ancient golem. A colossal magical automaton created in the ancient kingdom.
Ooh, a firepower-measuring contest? Sounds fun.
"Yes, it does, doesn't it? Now let us take a few shots at each other!"
KABOOOM!
Amidst explosions and blinding light, a faint gap in the Calamitous One's seemingly flawless defenses finally reveals itself.
Masséna, now!
Heh! This is the moment I've been waiting for! I'm on it!
Right then, Masséna turns into a ray of blue light and thrusts at the Calamitous One.
"Futile. Barrage Curtain!"
With those words, the ancient golem further intensifies its onslaught. A web of cannon fire envelops the surroundings as the thick mist becomes blazing hot.
Masséna's evasive maneuvers, however, are impeccably on point, and she takes not a single hit. Not even a scorching spark is able to come near her.
Once her target is finally within range, she twirls her body and adjusts her position with an adept spin.
Then, the very next moment...
Several azure shadows take form around her and lunge toward the Calamitous One with great force.
I did it! I hit her!
"You... What?"
"My wounds... aren't healing..."
"Most... impressive."
"But you shall pay dearly for angering me."
Slowly, the Calamitous One raises her arm. A tear forms in the sky, from which boundless malice and a fiery meteor emerge.
The blazing meteor of evil... The Calamitous One has revealed her true self.
"How long are you going to play games with those little insects, Clemenceau?"
"Finish them already! Before you're consumed by the shadow of death that cursed you!"
Yes, of course...
"O Holy Grail, partake of my blood."
"Banish this sinful soul to the Forsaken Land and seek the essence of constraint!"
A pitch-black magic circle appears at Clemenceau's feet which then instantly moves directly below the meteor's projection.
"What are you doing?"
I was as shocked as you when the Commander appeared at the Academy.
I knew you wanted to use the Commander to break the seal on the Realm of Slumber.
So, as you started to scheme, I made plans of my own.
When the 91st Exploration Team set off, I secretly reactivated the Elder Elf's Arrow in the Ancient Ruins, stopping your plan with a little "accident."
I thought the Commander wouldn't reappear for another few years... Then everything would've been in order.
But, by some twist of fate, the Commander reappeared after just a single year. And then, because you were personally taking action, there was nothing I could do.
But... the Commander is a sharp one. You may have accomplished your goal, but we have you cornered now.
Incapable though I may be by myself, all that's left is for me to light the spark.
"You will die."
That's what my fate should've been anyway during my journey with the 17th Exploration Team.
You attacked us, and I only survived because I struck a deal with you. All of that was so I could find an opportunity to avenge my fallen comrades.
Clemenceau's expression twists in agony. It's like something is draining all the life force out of her.
Countless black chains rise from the magic circle, each one binding itself to the meteor, locked in place by incantations.
Is she... using Sacrificial Cage?!
That's a forbidden spell! It converts the caster's life energy into a prison that eternally seals the target in another dimension!
"I will return this land one day. You will be no more than bones in the ground by then."
So you may think.
Commander, there is a way to save Clemenceau. However, I need your help.
What do I need to do?
You must use all your force of will to evoke me. The cost, though, is that you will be unable to use magic for quite some time.
That's no cost at all. This is the final showdown.
For the first time, Codex Magicus shows its true self. A soft light illuminates the meteor as pure-white flowers bloom from it one after another.
– "White... flowers"?  – That is my keepsake, Commander.
– "Impossible... How? You should've vanished long ago..."  – I am Emden, member of the 1st Exploration Team, and I shall aid you.
– I will keep the Calamitous One under control. The rest of you, please hurry...  – "Silence. Begone with you. Shut up!"
"I am the Calamitous One! I am in control of this body!"
No. This is Emden's body, and Emden is in control of it.
Please, everyone... put an end to this calamity while I'm suppressing her.
All units, focus fire! Annihilate... the Calamitous One!
In the final moment before my consciousness goes out from exhaustion, I issue the attack order. Mustering my last ounce of strength, I throw the evil-cleansing arrow forward.
The blessed Elder Elf's Arrow pierces right through the Calamitous One's chest.
Her death is not a cold, lonesome one. A clean light bursts out from the wound in her chest, like moonlight – it's her annihilation, but also her salvation.

layout: Our sincerest thanks to you, dear Commander.
We hope you enjoyed the performance.
The Port Virtual Reality Project 2.0 Production Committee

scripts.say: Clemenceau escorts me and my classmates to a grand door.
Location: The Aberrinth Warp Gate. A portal permanently linked to Aberrinth set up within Benedictus. It is without a doubt the safest way to reach the first layer.
Character: Le Malin. The gatekeeper of the Academy's portal to Aberrinth.
Le Malin? Why am I getting a blurb related to her when she's nowhere to be seen?
Pfft...
Shluh... Zzz...
Er... Are we starting? Already?
This is Le Malin. She's the guardian of the Warp Gate. She's SUPPOSED to be standing guard to make sure nobody uses it without permission...
But I suppose that doesn't matter now.
Le Malin, activate the Gate and prepare to send off the 91st Team.
Good luck, all of you. This is the first step of your own journey.
I will remain here and await your good news.
That moment, all light and sound are taken from me as I fall into a bottomless darkness.
Current Quest: Reach the first layer safe zone in Aberrinth, then report to the Academy's watchtower.
The quest displays just fine, but nothing else does...
Is this thing bugged or something?
Aberrinth Survival Guide: The first layer is covered in snow infused with mana. Protect against the cold, and don't forget countermeasures against mana corrosion.
"Covered in snow," huh? Could've fooled me.
Recommended Quests: 1. Set up camp with Le Hardi. 2. Make food with Duquesne. 3. Purify the campsite with Duguay-Trouin.
Come again?
Well, in that case...
Yep. It's bugged.
They're probably rushing to fix it. In the meantime, I'll see if I can find an exit on my own.
...Hm? What's that light over there?
Wait... I've seen that door before.
Isn't that–
I push open the heavy, wooden door. The packed auditorium bursts with cheering from all around.
Those are our seniors. They're positively glowing...
Mhm! I hope when we graduate, we'll look as great as they do!
Hey, Isuzu. Do you still have any snacks?
I do. Just leave some for the rest of us, okay?
(Deja vu.)
{playername}. There you are. Looks like I found you first again.
Character: Masséna. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 92 at the Academy.
(Feels like I've been through this before...)
(Wait, what? The class of 92?)
Come on. The ceremony's–
Starting momentarily, right?
Huh? How'd you know exactly what I was going to say?
Never mind. We should hurry. They're waiting for us.
I follow Masséna, slipping between rows of excited freshmen.
The decorations all around us haven't changed much since the graduation of the class of 91 just a while ago.
Over here! Aww, {playername}, what's wrong? You look down.
Did you not sleep well last night, by any chance? Shall I cast a spell of calming on you?
Character: Theseus. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 92 at the Academy.
Character: Painlevé. Your classmate. One of the top graduates of the class of 92 at the Academy.
(This performance is starting to sink its hooks into me.)
BANG!
Just as expected, fireworks go off and a figure wearing black robes gets up on stage.
Greetings, our outstanding graduates. Greetings, our unknown but young and aspirational students.
Welcome to the world of magic!
Then, amid vigorous applause, the curtain quietly falls on the ceremony.
(That should mean the principal's office is up next.)
Pardon me.
"Hello, top graduates of the class of 92. And you, {playername}."
There's something I'd like to tell you. Please come along.
And you are?
Character: Emden. Adopted daughter of the Academy's principal. Also serves as the dean of Spiritalker Academy.
Attention: She must not be allowed to know about this codex's existence.
(This notice again?)
"Emden and the principal are well-aware of your exemplary performance at the Academy."
Today, you shall set out on a mission together as the 92nd Aberrinth Exploration Team. {playername} will serve as your commander.
"Your task is to head to the third layer and map out as much as possible of the area."
Although this year's mission will be especially difficult, I believe that you all grasp its significance.
Of course. We WILL bring back our seniors trapped in Aberrinth!
(Wait, "trapped in Aberrinth"?)
"A noble attitude. You must not, however, attempt the impossible. You are to return alive and well."
In addition, I want you to have this.
It's... a protective charm?
"There is one for each of you. The environs on the third layer are ruthless."
Thanks, Emden!
There is no need for thanks. This is sadly all that Emden can do for you.
"You shall set off tomorrow. Until then, return to your quarters and ready yourselves."
After the ceremony, I, Masséna, Theseus, and Painlevé went to the dormitory and began preparing for our journey.
So, is Aberrinth really as scary as the books say? Everyone I've seen has come back with pretty solid spoils.
Aberrinth isn't just one place. It's divided into three distinct layers.
It's not so dangerous if you only venture as far as the first layer, and it has plenty of loot to nab.
The third layer is another story... Principal Clemenceau's team is the only one that has ever returned from there.
According to her, there are also more than a few explorers who've fallen into traps on each layer.
These traps all rob you of your perception of time, trapping you for a long, long time without you even realising it.
Meaning, most people don't actually die in Aberrinth, they're just trapped there?
Yeah. Something like that.
And that's our job, I guess. Rescuing some of those trapped people.
Mhm. And since our goal is to reach the third layer, that means we must go through the second layer first.
I'm close friends with Duquesne, one of the graduates of last year who were chosen for the 91st Exploration Team...
They were assigned the mission of going to the second layer and creating a map.
Not a single one of them has returned to this day...
She must be trapped somewhere on the second layer. We must rescue her!
Relax. You can count on me. I promise we're gonna find her.
Okay... I'll leave it to you.
Right, if we're going to fight as a team, maybe we should know about each other's fighting styles, yeah?
Good point. I'll start.
I'm a spear user! I can thrust faster than the wind!
My luck stat is also pretty high! It'll help us seize the best opportunities.
A lucky lancer, huh? Now that's good to have.
I'm a healer. I'll support you from the back with healing magic, restoring your health and cleansing you of debuffs so you can fight comfortably.
Ah, a healer. An indispensable part of any team.
And my forte is offensive magic.
I can cause damage in both bursts and over time, but it takes a little while to cast my spells, just so you know.
It takes time to chant your spells. Got it.
What are you good at, Commander?
Glad you asked!
Strategy guide, what's my fighting style like?
Character: {playername}. Commander of the 92nd Aberrinth Exploration Team. Use ancient naval magic. Especially potent with Cannon Volley and Saturation Bombardment.
"Ancient naval magic." Wow.
That's perfect.
The next day, at the Aberrinth Warp Gate...
Mrmh... Zzz...
Do we wake her?
Yeah. Or, well, we SHOULD do that.
It's a little hard to bring yourself to rouse someone who's sleeping so soundly, though.
Now I'M getting sleepy... I just wanna activate the portal, wrap things up, and go to sleep.
Professional coming through. Step aside.
Le Malin, Clemenceau's here to check on you.
Whuah?! I wasn't sleeping! I wasn't! I'm awake!
Going to the Aberrinth, I suppose? Okay, just go over there and stay put.
I can't make out a word of what these labels say... I'll just pull and push random things and see what happens.
Despite her clueless operation, the light from the portal is getting stronger and stronger.
Alright, that should do it. Is everyone ready?
Commander, why don't you get on my staff and fly with me?
Grab my hand, Commander. I'll support you.
My mana is full, I've offered a prayer, and my hair... is unruffled.
May we be blessed with a successful expedition.
May we find our seniors and be able to bring them and ourselves home safely...
As the portal's light envelops us and I see Benedictus grow more distant, I sense how a familiar darkness encroaches on me again.
Layer One of Aberrinth - Icemaw Gorge
Bone-chilling winds rush in to greet us from all directions as soon as we exit through the portal.
Brrr! C-c-cold!
(This must be where my "last" self was supposed to end up.)
We need to keep warm and protect ourselves against mana corrosion.
It sounds like you did your research, Commander. That's wonderful.
Casting a freeze-warding and a mana-neutralizing spell... Now we should be okay!
Based on the records our seniors left, the warp tower to the next layer should be in Frostheim, a fortress to the southwest.
It is guarded by Bois Belleau, a powerful monster who is known as the Winter General.
They say that she stands watch from 9 AM to 5 PM every day from Monday to Friday. We should try to avoid those times if we can.
A monster with a consistent schedule, huh?
Sounds in line with this layer's reputation of being "safe." Let's head to the fortress and have a gander.
Hang on. There's an easier way of getting there.
