March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>1 Connecting the Dots</size>
Royal Navy Fleet
Command Vessel
NA Sea Route

scripts.say: The day after Elizabeth called, we joined Grenville's search-and-destroy fleet to the Royal Navy's Scapa Flow Anchorage.
In the wake of the large-scale battles in this sea, the destruction of Compiler's mainframe, and the ongoing clean-up operation, the NA and Atlantic Ocean are busier than ever.
Countless merchant and transport ships travel on newly active trade routes. Though they have armed escort fleets, the routes grow safer by the day.
The goods they bring in are like rain showers after a drought, bringing vitality and hope to lands and seas plagued by the fires of war.
Our voyage has been wonderfully smooth.
While Memphis is busy working in her room, I contact Helena META to discuss our plans for the future.
When the light dissipates, I'm greeted by that familiar starry sky.
It's rare for you to be the one who initiates contact.
I just wish it weren't only when you needed something.
Umm...
I'm hinting that you should ask me to go on vacation with you sometime, Commander.
Okay. If we ever have the time...
I'll make time, don't you worry.
(Gah. There I go, letting her lead the conversation again...)
(I need to ask her this, and I need to do it now.)
(Let's get down to business.)
Yes, yes, I can tell you want to get down to business. You have your doubts about Elizabeth's invitation, I'm guessing?
(Is she reading my mind, or what?)
It's been on my mind, too.
I understand Elizabeth META is strong, but that whale-snatching Devil is a force to be reckoned with.
To be honest, I thought their hunt would take longer – and end in a painful retreat at best.
It's almost disappointing how easy they had it.
Agreed. Miss D's whale should be important to Devil, right?
Yes, VERY important. While we're at it, why don't we review Devil's actions so far?
You've probably heard this from Renown or Repulse by now, but the Antiochus and Ashes once had a major clash. That was when Devil and Hierophant attacked one of the Ashes' strongholds together.
Devil and Hierophant weren't the same as they are today.
As I recall... The Tower appeared in the nick of time and disrupted the space the battle was taking place in, giving the Ashes a chance to escape.
Were you fighting alongside the Ashes back then, Helena?
There was a Helena among them, yes, but she was not me.
Really?
Really. Now, we're digressing, so let's get back on topic.
Bismarck ought to have shared this with you: While Hierophant manipulated Marco Polo into preparing the Kingdom of God, Devil was also cooking up something.
She used a conceptual attack to induce the Iron Blood fleet to infiltrate the space where Hermit's mainframe was, in order to use it as a vector for contamination.
Bismarck was able to stop this, but Devil's plan still managed to divert the Iron Blood's attention and firepower for long enough to support Marco Polo's schemes.
In other words, Devil and Hierophant have always worked together – even when Hierophant was out of the picture.
That's right. When Marco Polo caused the near-superimposition event, Devil directly supported Hierophant by serving as an auxiliary vessel for her.
The situation was mere moments from catastrophe, but of course, it was all within my expectations.
I can tell you don't really mean that.
...That look on your face tells me that you don't believe me.
I'll have you know that even if Hierophant had broken through the blockade and beelined toward you, I had a countermeasure.
I recall you came out of that without any injuries whatsoever, no?
Then those illusions...
What illusions?
Hierophant and I ended up in a dark space together, where we saw Doctors Anzeel and Aoste.
She stopped attacking as soon as she saw those illusions... Are you saying you weren't the cause of that?
Is that why...? That would explain why Hierophant became more active after contact.
Active?
It's nothing more than a hypothesis I've been looking into. It doesn't matter right now, so allow me to continue.
Then came the Sea of Stars salvage operation. One overeager Constellation probed into things better left untouched, leading to peril.
Fortunately, Devil used one of her vessels to return the team to us safely.
I have a question.
Go on.
Why was Devil in the Sea of Stars? And... where exactly is it anchored to, anyway?
Let me answer the second question first. You already have an idea, don't you?
Yes, I induced the Eagle Union into building the Sea of Stars.
But I did not directly provide them with any advanced technology – I only nudged them in the right direction and guided them away from dead ends and wrong turns.
Consider it a joint project by me and test site beta.
Then what about the near-infinite space inside it?
That's a partition of the Tower's resources. The Sea of Stars has free usage rights.

Which means that all experiments performed there are technically done within the Tower. However, that partition is fully under the Sea of Stars' control, so the Tower can't directly interfere with their projects.
Of course, forced shutdowns and brute-force hacking are still possible...
Does that tell you why Devil was inside the Sea of Stars? She's not in there, but rather, she's shut inside the Tower.
You mean the Tower, the Arbiter, trapped her inside the Tower, the structure?
Perhaps Tower found Devil in a reversed state... and, not taking too kindly to that, she decided to just lock her up or something.
An Arbiter in a reversed state... Vestal META said something along those lines, too. What does it actually mean?
Is it a program malfunction? Corrosion, maybe?
Just based on Devil, I've noticed that she's become a lot more aggressive since becoming reversed. She doesn't seem to discriminate between friend and foe.
That's only a surface-level change, not a fundamental one. Hmm... It should be safe to share this with you.
Do you know that numbered Arbiters each have completely independent personalities?
Yeah.
But you subconsciously treat them as parts of a greater machine, don't you?
Now that you mention it, maybe...
It isn't just you. Most people who have dealt with the Antiochus for a long time feel the same way.
But yes, every Arbiter has an independent personality.
Zero and the Arbiters aren't a queen bee and her drones, but rather... akin to a flat organizational structure.
Arbiters each have their own strategy and personal experimental domain. As a rule, none of them is subordinate to each other. Their only direct report is Zero.
Naturally, special orders from Zero or other immediate needs may demand that multiple Arbiters work together at times.
From what I'm hearing, they're not parts of a system, but more like a research team.
Correct. They're like researchers in a team called The Arbiters, led by Zero.
Normally, they're allowed to experiment as they desire, but occasionally, they must team up or carry out special projects given to them by Zero.
Mistakes and differences of opinion are parts of the scientific process. At times, conflict is permitted... within a certain framework, that is.
Whenever they choose a research topic, they may also choose to verify or falsify the hypothesis.
If an Arbiter chooses to challenge their own or another's hypothesis via picking the side of falsification, the system considers them in a reversed state.
That's why reversed Arbiters will seem indiscriminately aggressive.
Do you understand me so far?
Loud and clear. I'll need to take a close look at how I view the Arbiters from now on.
That's only natural, given the introduction of new information. Good luck.
Now, shall we continue discussing Devil?
Time passes, and you and Elizabeth META go on a whale-hunting expedition together.
Wait... I want to ask about Pamiat' Merkuria META first.
Let me guess. You want to know about her connection to Hierophant, and her current situation?
The ability she used to create her paradise in Antarctica was fundamentally the same as that used in the Kingdom of God.
Like Marco Polo, Hierophant manipulated her into helping with an attempted escape plan.
But her sloppiness led to her failing much faster than Marco Polo did.
After her failure, she lay low on a tropical island. However, when Akagi created illusions all over the world and threw the Pacific into chaos...
Well, she tried to take advantage of the commotion to invade Antarctica again, but I found her.

options.content: I think I know what happened next.

scripts.say: Exactly what you're thinking. You won't need to worry about her anymore.
Back to the Martyrium... Based on the memories Hierophant revealed to you, Hatakaze was another person manipulated into working toward her release.
That explains why Devil personally supported her during the fight over the city.
In summary, Devil is still cooperating with Hierophant, whether directly or indirectly.
Connect the dots, and I think we'll see a picture of the Arbiters' ultimate escape plan.
Heehee. That's our Commander.
Hierophant's escape plan was to use the ritual of the Kingdom of God to build a projection of herself in this dimension.
Through special spatial rules that only apply in the Kingdom of God, she would then pour most of her essence, as it were, into said projection.
After that, she would use a type of conceptual partitioning power installed in the whale to sever the connection between the projection and her original form.
In the end, through another characteristic of the Kingdom of God – conceptual fixation – to finalize the projection's concept as Hierophant.
In the end, she's split off a part of her body and created a new whole from the part. It's almost like a lizard losing its tail and regenerating a new one, you could say.
That's why the whale is so important to Devil.
But judging from the state of the Hierophant you made contact with, Devil must not have attained her goal. That should make her even less willing to let go of the whale...
Unless...
You think... Devil found a new method that doesn't need the whale?
That's right, and I think it's an even better method than their original one. Otherwise, they wouldn't so easily give up the enormous sunk costs they've already put into this.
Furthermore, Commander, I think this plan is related to you.
To me?
I'm afraid we'll have to bring up another unsavory individual – The Magician.
I believe she's used you to form a cooperative relationship with Devil and Hierophant.
That's why she keeps interfering with my observation. She and Hierophant obstructed us together just recently.
How's that?
While I was busy utilizing the Tower's full processing powers, Hierophant took the opportunity to spirit you away. That must have been a coordinated move.
Speaking of that, I had this dream recently.
I found myself in Magician's classroom, but she wasn't there.
Instead... Bon Homme Richard was.
...Did I just hear you right?
Yeah. Bon Homme Richard was in the classroom. It was only for an instant, but it's so clear in my mind.
More than that, though, she looked so... normal.
That's not what I'm concerned with. Wait just a moment.
I told you before that the malfunction that left Camelot stranded was because the Antiochus had moved test site beta, didn't I?
The Arbiters who did that were Empress, Lovers, and Magician.
Their reasoning is related to Bon Homme Richard.
At the time, she was extremely close to your world. Test site beta was on the verge of collapse.
It was that close?!
I was ready to launch a contingency plan, but the Antiochus resolved the danger before I could.
Those three Arbiters must have made contact with Richard.
And after that, she was in Magician's classroom...
It's just like the Spectral Moon incident... No. I shouldn't breathe another word about it.
Spectral Moon... You've mentioned that before. What exactly is it, though?
The Arbiter Project was an enormous investment, and its results were far from favorable. But after the Spectral Moon incident, even more resources were allotted to it.
In the blink of an eye, they had developed Magician's AI personality and a special device to go along with her. That's all I can tell you right now.
I never could tell why she does what she does.
She must be as crazy as all the other Arbiters.
Be extra careful around her. She's dangerous.
Stay away from that classroom from now on, if you can.
I'd love to, but I'm not exactly going there of my own volition. I just end up there.
Yeah... I know. I'll do what I can, too.
Don't be so nervous. I've dealt with Magician plenty of times by now, and I'm still alive.
*sigh*... Maybe. I hope I'm just being paranoid.
Wait... Sorry, Helena, but there's something I don't get.
If Magician and Hierophant were in contact from the start, then that makes everything sound strange.
Hm? What are you saying?
I understand that Devil didn't ask for help from other Arbiters because she's reversed, but Magician surely isn't.
She could ask for help from other Arbiters or Zero any time she wanted.
The power of the Antiochus combined ought to be able to free Hierophant with ease, shouldn't it?
But she didn't do that. She went so far just to draw your attention and give Hierophant a chance to attempt her own scheme.
Isn't that strange?
Hierophant is clearly in danger, but the Arbiters as a whole are utterly indifferent.
Why aren't they trying their hardest to help her?
Hmm... Is there really a need to try their "hardest"?
Like I said before, Arbiters are coequal and independent.
They have no responsibility to work together most of the time. Only when they willingly accept a request for aid or Zero gives direct orders will they cooperate.
If Zero gave no order and Hierophant issued no request, then it's normal for help not to come.
...Really?
They're that inflexible, even in matters of life and death?
I'm tempted to say that the Antiochus truly are rigid, mechanical, and bereft of humanity.
But this matter isn't that simple.
As I mentioned, the Arbiters carry out experiments of various themes. Some of them can be... extreme.
Can we say with certainty that Hierophant's status isn't part of one of those experiments?
That she's trapped, that she's attempting escape...
You're right. Magician didn't ask for help, and Zero hasn't given a rescue order. But most of all...
Why do you think that Hierophant didn't use Devil to contact the other Arbiters much earlier?
Hmm... Do you have a clue, then?
More or less. You should think about it, though – call it homework.
Homework? How long have you fancied yourself a teacher?
Excuse you. I'm not just a teacher – I'm the dean.
Anyway, we've talked for long enough. I shouldn't share anymore, so goodbye.
Without waiting for me to say goodbye, Helena cuts off the communication.
(Hm? Is it just me, or did she ignore something really important?)
(What was I trying to ask her, again?)
(Right... How did Elizabeth META get the whale so easily?)
(Well, Helena did have her doubts, too. The whale was supposed to be really important to Devil.)
(If you follow that logic, though, then it's as if she knows Devil doesn't need the whale anymore...)
(So why was she suspicious of Elizabeth META's invitation? It doesn't make sense.)

sequence:
March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>2 Miss D's Change</size>
Scapa Flow Anchorage
Gate of Avalon - Reception Area

scripts.say: I know full well that I can't make Helena META answer questions she doesn't want to.
With my questions unanswered, I find myself before the magnificent Gate of Avalon.
Welcome to the Gate of Avalon, faithful servant!
How long it's been, servant. We appreciate your speedy response to our summons.
In a luxurious reception area that didn't exist the last time I was here, I have an audience with two queens.
We mostly skip the pleasantries and discuss the Camelot malfunction and Bon Homme Richard.
What?! You mean to say she almost caught us?!
We always worried that might happen. To think that an Antiochus, of all things, was our salvation...
It's so funny, one forgets to laugh.
If nothing else, we managed to escape the worst in the nick of time.
Still, the Antiochus are watching this test site closely. We must advance all of our preparations posthaste.
Indeed...
Preparations... You mean expanding and powering up the Gate of Avalon?
That isn't all. I've been working on things behind the scenes in case things worsen in the future.
The Gate of Avalon upgrades are but a means to make the other measures go more smoothly.
So Her Majesty has a grand plan in the works?
Heh heh, of course! I'll happily divulge the details later, but for now, you just think about it.
Now, we've had you come here to discuss the whale. We've captured it, so now we need to examine it thoroughly.
About that... Where's Miss D?
She was obsessed with the whale, wasn't she?
Umm, well...
That girl is facing some personal troubles. We've limited what she can do for the sake of safety.
You'll... understand quickly, we assure you.
Using the newly installed monorail, the queens and I travel through the Gate of Avalon.
Beyond vast forests and towering mountains, we arrived at our destination – an artificial lake of mercurial silver.
The whale hovers quietly above the lake, with mechanical arms working all over its surface.
As for Miss D, she comes rushing over right away.
Assistant, assistant, assistant!
YOU CAME TO SEE MEEEE!
Gimme a BIIIIG HUG!
You! Outta the way! Shut up! Go away!
Grrr! Assistant, wait there for me!
I'll deal with this stupid thing!
There you have it. That is the reason Miss D cannot be allowed freedom.
That's Death's Shadow, isn't it?
Correct. The very same one that we fought in the Martyrium.
You may recall that it invaded our Queen's Light.
Is it haunting Miss D now, or...?
A more apt interpretation would be that it is her bodyguard and servant.
It appeared out of thin air when we tried to recover the whale's functionality with Miss D.
It responds to no communication, and it avoids all contact.
All it does is follow Miss D and prevent her from straying too far from the whale.
(Death's Shadow... War Protocol Scythe.)
(Miss D's incompleteness, and the whale's ability to sever concepts...)
(That must be it. Death's Shadow and Miss D are two parts of a whole. When they're combined, they'll become Arbiter XIII: Death.)
Remember this, it's important – they form a collective of countless fragments of data until they are given individual bodies.
It is possible to replicate the individual offshoots of this collective. I gave this power to Death.
The War Protocol series is particularly effective against higher-level crystalline targets.
Star and I have the most units equipped with this series. I believe we two are best suited to stall the enemy.
(Are the Arbiters based on the War Protocol series?)
(Did existing War Protocols get upgraded into Arbiters, or...?)
(No, not necessarily. It wouldn't apply to Hierophant, nor to Magician...)
(Maybe the War Protocol and Arbiter series are two projects that had been worked on in parallel?)
(I'm still lacking important information.)
By the way, when are we going into the whale?
On the morrow.
We've already secured several safe holds. Today, we will perform final checks.
Safe holds? This surely implies that the inside of the whale is dangerous, right?
We do not know. We have seen it out of control, and we have seen it controlled by Devil as well.
There is no telling what may lie within, so our only course of action is prudence.
Agreed. You can never be too careful.
Tomorrow will do. For now–
Assistant! Over here!
ASSISTANT! HERE, HERE, HERE!
...Do you mind if I talk with Miss D?
That's fine. Consider Death's Shadow a quiet guardian.
I prepared afternoon tea. Come with me.

sequence:
March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>3 One Glorious Day</size>
Unknown time
Unknown location

scripts.say: Inside a gorgeous castle, warm sunlight filtered through the window and gently awakened a noble girl.
...The start of a new day.
Dido, escort me to my dressing chamber.

sequence: Chapel
Morning prayer

scripts.say: "To the hallowed name who smiles upon our land like the sun,"
"Protector of our safe haven, beacon of our glory."
"May the light of your wisdom protect us across the seven seas."
"May the authority of your blade reveal the truth in this chaotic world."
"May you grant us the power to overcome hardship and endure trials, to purge evil and bring peace."
"With your revelation, we walk a path of faith."
"Eternal glory upon your name."
Phew... It's almost time.
Charybdis, let us break our fast.

sequence: Dining room
Breakfast

scripts.say: Breakfast was delicious.
Thank you to all involved in preparing it.
Hmm... Dido should have delivered the day's paperwork to my office.
I suppose I should get to work on it.

sequence: Office
Daily paperwork

scripts.say: Goodness... I didn't even realise how much I'd done.
Things around the world haven't changed as much today as they did yesterday.
A peaceful day, perhaps... thanks to everyone's hard work.
Eagle, you've been craving a duel with me, haven't you?
Today's the perfect day for it. Shall we head to the simulation room?

sequence: Intelligence chamber
Simulation room

scripts.say: Heheh, two to zero. Well played.
You're getting stronger, but so am I.
Oh, no... I lost track of time. Before long, Belfast is going to come and rush me along.
Let's go to the dining room posthaste.

sequence: Dining room
Lunch

scripts.say: Today's lunch seems a little, uh...
Did Manchester cook today?
I'll just have to hope afternoon tea is more promising...
Umm... Thanks for the meal.

sequence: Correspondence chamber
Daily communications (and afternoon tea)

scripts.say: No reduction or increase in points of interest today...
Reports from all of our communication nodes are normal.
Hmm... Neither good nor bad, in the end.
Oh, my. Edinburgh, you brought afternoon tea for me?
Phew... Tea and snacks should give me the energy to keep going.

sequence: Battlefield
Combat training

scripts.say: KABOOOM!
All targets neutralised. Battlefield zero is secure.
I still have spare time, so maybe I'll go check on battlefield three to see how Victorious is doing...

sequence: Dining room
Dinner

scripts.say: Wow... What a splendid dinner we have today.
Aurora, did you cook this all yourself?
Heehee, I love it. It's delicious.
But I would maybe appreciate it more if it was a little less spicy...

sequence: Study
Reading time

scripts.say: "Since you are tongue-tied and so loath to speak, in dumb significants proclaim your thoughts..."
"Let him that is a trueborn gentleman and stands upon the honor of his birth..."
"If he suppose that I have pleaded truth, From off this brier pluck a white rose with me."
"Let him that is no coward nor no flatterer, but dare maintain the party of the truth, pluck a red rose from off this thorn with me."
Hmm, things are getting tense.
Oh... Sheffield? Is it already so late?
Let's call it a day, then... I should get ready for bed.

sequence: Bedroom
Bedtime
23:00 - next morning

scripts.say: Inside a gorgeous castle, the quiet moonlight lulls a noble girl to sleep.
Thus ends another glorious day.

sequence:
March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>4 Lady E</size>

scripts.say: When the light fades, a bright academy campus sprawls before me.

options.content: It's not a classroom this time?

scripts.say: My, there's an unfamiliar face. Is this your first time here?
I turn toward the voice and see a woman in black and white clothing.
Her hair accessory, resembling a blue flame, flows in the wind.
Who are you?
(No, wait... I've heard this voice before.)
...I was not expecting them to catch up so quickly.
Have they figured out the true purpose of our plan?
Or is their blockade simply more solid than we thought?
Keep releasing decoys. Disperse the pursuers and lead them to different coordinates.
We will be safe as long as we leave this century.
Got it.
(It's the same voice...)
Call me Lady E, if you'd please.
Lady E...?
(Isn't this Magician's domain? Why is she here, then?)
Are you... Empress? Or Emperor?
Hmm?
(Considering the fact that Magician and Empress have worked together before...)
You're Arbiter III, aren't you? The Empress.
(I did hear two voices back then. If Empress was one, then was Zero the other?)
Heehee, you have such an active imagination. How do you associate so much with a single letter?
It's not that complex, though. Here, I'm nothing but Lady E.
Okay... Is Magician not here, then?
Magician? Oh, are you referring to Madam M?
Lady E winks playfully at me.
(Is it a rule that they have to use each other's codenames here?)
That's right.
(What?! Can she read my mind?!)
No?
Just a little trick of mine. Don't mind the details.
Teasing aside, allow me to answer your burning questions.
I can honestly say that I don't know where Madam M might be or what she's doing here.
From my experience, I'd assume she's teaching.
Today's lesson is apparently an important one, so try not to disturb her if so.
Class? Does she have students?
One student, yes, and she's someone you know.
I shouldn't say any more. She's not my student, after all.
If you're curious, go meet her in person.
I should go.
It's time.
Suddenly, a pale girl speaks up behind Lady E.
It's as if she had been there the whole time.
(She appeared out of nowhere again!)
(But she's completely different this time.)
(It's like she's... gloomier?)
Now, I don't know everything about Madam M's students...
But this girl happens to be a little... difficult.
Have you ever seen a girl so dismal at such a young age? That's why I take her out for walks.
Maybe some extra sunlight will brighten up her mood a little...
Don't you think so?
No.
Talking with others lots can help, too. Look, here's a friend you can talk to right now! Come and chat, why don't you?
Don't wanna.
The girl shakes her head and raises her stuffed toy to hide her face.
Fine, fine. Do whatever you want.
The girl is suddenly gone again, as if she were never there.
What's going on...?
(I've been brought here, but Madam M is nowhere to be seen. This is the second time.)
I agree. It's just rude of her.
Let's not waste your time. Shall I take you home?

options.content: I want to look around a little longer.

scripts.say: No problem.
The woman in black and white smiles and waves a hand. When she does, the world is engulfed in darkness...
The woman in black and white smiles and waves a hand. When she does, the world is engulfed in darkness...
Apparently, she'd only asked out of politeness. I had no choice to begin with.
I didn't get quality sleep last night, but I got up on time nevertheless to get ready for the expedition into the whale.
According to the files the Royal Navy provided, that silvery lake I saw yesterday is apparently – and fittingly – called "Silver Mirror Lake."
As for the whale above it, it's no more than an elaborate projection. The real one is deep under the lake.
The reason for this is safety. Not just for the whale, but also for the Gate of Avalon in the event of a freak accident.
Therefore, to get inside the real whale under the lake, I first have to go to a place called "the station" and wait for a train there.
For the sake of safety, Elizabeth META detached one car from the Queen's Light for use during the expedition.
We'll board said car today and proceed inside the whale. After that, we'll have to improvise as we go.
Helena, who must care a great deal about the whale, surprisingly didn't show up in person.
She told me that she had work on the Tower to do and couldn't attend because of it.
Despite that, she'll still provide support via remote communications.
As for Memphis, since the two queens were quite wary of the Eagle Union, she had to stay behind.
So, all in all, the team that'll be exploring the whale today includes Miss D, the two Elizabeths, and Renown META and Sheffield META on guard duty.

sequence: Royal Islands - Gate of Avalon
Silver Mirror Lake Station

scripts.say: Assistaaant!
The moment I enter the station's premises, a hooded little girl comes jumping at me.
...And then her body gets suspended in mid-air.
Ugh... I'm gonna mess you up one day, I swear it!
Good morning, Commander.
While we shall ensure your safety, I must ask you to please refrain from acting irresponsibly or touching anything without reason.
I greet the two META guards, then the two queens come walking up to me.
Servant, was everything alright last night?
(Huh?)
I had a strange dream, but that was all.
Alright, then.
Did something happen, or?
(Could it be that they detected Magician's intrusion?)
Yes, in fact. We noticed an intrusion attempt into the Gate of Avalon yesterday night. A short-lasted one, but still.
We examined every avenue of entry we could think of, but found nothing unusual. One would assume that they failed.
Heheh! After pouring so many resources into it, my security system is finally starting to pay off!
(I mean, it didn't actually prevent it.)
(Still, credit where credit is due – it's amazing that they were even able to detect it.)
(Strictly speaking, it wasn't an act of hostility, either.)
Well, we'll have plenty of time to talk later. For now, it's time to hit the road!
There is no "road" where we're going, you.
What I MEANT is that it's time to depart, you!
Putting aside the petty squabble, we all get into our seats. Then, just as the doors start to slowly close...
Your Majesty, wait! I have an urgent report!
Wait a moment.
Speak, Grenville. What is it?
The monitoring room just received an external distress signal.
The Royal Navy of another world is requesting help from us.
Alright... What else did they say?
"In the name of the Eternal Sun."
The two queens exchanged glances with each other as soon as those words were dropped.
"Eternal Sun"? Does that mean anything?
It's code for "our allies are in catastrophic danger." We have to come to their aid at once.
I'm afraid you won't get to go on that whale expedition with us today, servant.
Hold on. What if we have your servant come along to the rescue?
To support another test site, you mean? I do have experience commanding battles and might be of use.
No. This is an unknown test site that could fall at any moment. It's so dangerous that we don't even have time to gather intel on it.
In short: Absolutely not.
Alright. We shall go and organise a fleet.
Then I'll make adjustments to Camelot. I'll also try to get a picture of the scene at the destination.
What should I do?
You... can stay here and keep my servant company.
Seeing as our team needs to be revised, I'll tell Bel to make new plans for the expedition. How about we try this again tomorrow, servant?
(It's okay. There's no need to change your plan.)
(Tell Elizabeth that I'll bring help and meet up with them right away.)
And so, the matter was settled.
We'll link up with Helena and her backup in four hours, then continue on our whale expedition.

sequence:
March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>6 The Imperial Council</size>
Realm of the Neversetting Sun - Capital
Palace of Westminster

scripts.say: Inside a parliament hall, a heated discussion between the few attendees filled the air.

scripts.factiontag: Minister of the House of Lords
scripts.say: Order! Honourable members, maintain order, please.

scripts.factiontag: Minister of the House of Lords
scripts.say: Whilst we could argue for the rest of time, we still do need a constructive solution.
Solution? Why need we such a thing, pray tell? Prithee tell me ye take not that beguiling signal in earnest.
I can vouch for the authenticity of the signal's source. It is indeed from beyond our world.
And? What does the message say?
"In the name of the Eternal Sun"... It sounds almost like a scam targeting our nation.
Be that as it may, it is still the first result we've received after launching our extraterritorial search plan.
Yes, it is true that it's rather large compared to the bits of information we initially expected...
However, that does not mean that we should hesitate now.
To set foot beyond our territory and spread the Eternal Sun's glory – is that not precisely the goal of this plan?
I agree with Lady Illustrious. As a Palace Guard, I'm in favour of responding to this distress signal.
The Royal Knights request a reconsideration.
I'm against it.
I'm also against sending a definite answer.
Naturally, I oppose this course of action.
Even supposing that the message is sincere, its senders art sinking into a sea of flames. Wales, art thou willing to shoulder the weight of the world yonder?
...I think at least we should check on them.
Hmm. If it's strictly about sending a survey fleet, I support this motion.
Your support is appreciated, Miss Warspite.
I will not strong-arm any of you for assistance with this matter, and I will not request additional resources.
Still, I would like to say this: Never before have we received a distress signal like this and simply sat on our hands in response.
This should be done, and someone among us needs to do it.

scripts.factiontag: Governor-General of the Pacific and Arctic Oceans
scripts.say: If we do dispatch a survey fleet, I will support it with resources.
As will I. Also, I have a person in mind for this task.
She would no doubt be interested in this mission, and conveniently, she isn't in attendance today.
Thou hath mine agreement. Forsooth, that ambitious woman also hath the equipment that an extraterritorial survey needeth.
Verily, she hath professed her equipment's excellence as of late and hath even proclaimed a yearning for an adventure most true.
A vote for her I cast.
The Governor of the Nile? Yeah, she is suited for the job. She has my vote, too.
I concur.
I'm not necessarily against it, but will a singular survey fleet led by her really suffice?
Whatever the ultimate outcome be, those who wish to participate may simply provide aid to the survey fleet.
Should the need to compose an expeditionary force arise, the Mediterranean fleet will provide assistance.
Thank you, Lady Illustrious. This mission is sure to be a success with your help.

scripts.factiontag: Minister of the House of Lords
scripts.say: Well then, honourable members, does anyone have further questions or remarks?

scripts.factiontag: Minister of the House of Lords
Minister of the House of Lords
scripts.say: Alright, that settles the matter.

scripts.factiontag: Minister of the House of Lords
scripts.say: That will be all for today's assembly.

sequence:
March of the Neversetting Sun

<size=45>7 Another Glorious Day</size>
"6:00, wake up"
"6:30 - 7:00, morning prayer"
"7:00 - 7:30, breakfast"
"8:00 - 10:00, daily paperwork"
"10:30 - 11:30, simulation room"
"14:00 - 15:00, daily communications (and afternoon tea)"
Correspondence chamber

scripts.say: That's strange...
The number of points of interest has begun increasing.
There are even faint signs of jamming in the contact points that have been stable for years...
Could it be that... a dormant enemy has awoken?
I'm the only one in this world who could do it...
The only one who could rouse them.
The communicator that had been silent for so long suddenly rang, interrupting Glorious' train of thought.
BZZZT... BZZZT...
...we received... signal...
...currently... for reinforcements...
...hold the line...
The fragmented message cut off, and the room fell silent again.
My goodness... A reply?
Have we finally, finally gotten... a reply?
Her vision gradually clouded as teardrops quietly hit the floor. After all this solitude, it felt like the world had finally spoken to her again.
What a bloody mess!
What are all their intelligence agencies doing?! Where in the world did that weird threat creep in from?!
Why didn't we receive a single drop of information before?!
Your subordinates are searching as best as they can, Your Grace. Our priority now should be to rebuild our line of defence.
...Is it true that the Sirens' Combined Fleet wiped out the Iron Blood and Iris Orthodoxy?
Yes...
Since we can't identify the enemy, we should conserve our forces.
Contact all fleets and order them to rally at the nearest rendezvous point, then return to base at once!
Shall we prepare the homeland defence line now?
We're facing a rather unusual enemy and our second defense line has been breached. There's no guarantee the third one will hold.
Understood. I'll make the arrangements.
Bel, contact every faction representative and call for an immediate emergency meeting.
Glorious, I have an important task for you as well.
I have a secret ally capable of dealing with this situation.
I'll send a request for help. "In the name of the country of the neversetting sun." They are sure to respond.
Wait in front of the communicator. Report to me as soon as there's a reply!
Understood!
...It's been so many years since then.
And now, after all this time, a reply has finally come...
Your Majesty... I've completed my mission.
But... how am I meant to report to you?
Glorious shook her head, frantically swallowed her surge of emotion, and then regained her calm smile.
Forgive me.
I am the symbol of the Royal Navy. My each and every action is an embodiment of its dignity.
I must not forget my etiquette...
Okay... Once today's battle is over, I shall get ready to receive our guests...

sequence: To Be Continued

Invitation of Melting Snow

<size=45>A Breeze Under the Moon</size>

scripts.say: The new moon hangs high, casting a subtle light on a natural hot spring amid a pine forest.
Steam rises all around on this relaxing night. The silence is gently broken by a splash of water.
My, this is hot... Excuse me, I'm going to get up for a minute, Commander. I'm starting to feel lightheaded...
How's the water for you? Are you sure you can handle it?
I see. You must be used to bathing in hot springs.
Ahem... I need some time to cool off. I feel like I'm burning up...
It's not just me, then. I thought I was the odd one out, since Trento looks so comfortable.
Meanwhile, I feel like I'm burning up...
Burning up, hmm? Is it because of the water, or because the Commander is here?
Enough teasing, Trento!
Heehee♪
Ugh... Commander, don't force yourself to stay in. If you need a break, you can feel the breeze with me.
Speaking of which... It feels wonderful. With my legs still in the water, I don't feel cold at all.
...Hey. I know I'm always strict with you, and we rarely ever get to have a heart-to-heart.
I want you to know I, like everyone else, appreciate how much you care about us.
And I care a lot about you, too. In fact, I think I...
...Um, never mind! The heat is clearly getting to my head.
Whew... Anyway, the night is still young. Let us enjoy the water for a while longer.

sequence:
Invitation of Melting Snow

<size=45>Melting in the Heat</size>

scripts.say: I've never felt this hot in my whole life...
Ugghh... I think I'm going to croak...
Comrade Commander, get me water... Cold water... Hurry...
*gulp gulp*...
...Pfahh! Ahh, that's much better. I'm back from the brink.
It won't be long before it feels hot again, though. This back-and-forth is gonna make me melt...
...Why are you here anyway, Comrade Commander?

options.content: "Making sure you don't melt like ice cream."
"I want to enjoy the sauna with you."

scripts.say: I'll be fine. The melting thing is just hyperbole, you know.
Heat just isn't my strong suit. I'm used to the cold.
If you really need to keep an eye on me, at least sit down. Here, I'll make some space.
Oh, okay. I'll make some space so you can sit next to me.
They say saunas are good for your circulation. A lot of my Northern Parliament friends use them.
But in my case, they don't do anything. Other than making me feel like I'll melt, anyway...
If I were a snowman, I'd already be a puddle on the ground by now... Aahh...
I sit down beside her and proceed to explain how saunas are meant to be used.
...So after warming up a bit, you go out to take a cold bath, then have a break, rinse and repeat?
That explains a lot... Yeah. Let me have an ice-cold oxy-cola to clear my head. *gulp gulp*...
...Food isn't allowed in the sauna? No drinks either?
But I need to rehydrate! I won't leave this sauna alive without something to wet my whistle!
Pl-please, one more glass with ice in it!
I promise, just this one glass, then I'll go out and rest!
...Pfahh! That hits the spot. I'm starting to enjoy this...

sequence:
Invitation of Melting Snow

<size=45>The Snow Wolf's Other Side</size>

scripts.say: Inside a hot spring situated in a dense forest, there's a calm, quiet little corner.
Amid a veil of steam and the sound of running water, there's someone waiting for me.
There you are. Come on, sit down.
I reserved a spot for you, knowing you'd find this place. Call it my hunter's intuition.
The question is, who's the prey here? You, or me?
Leaving her question open-ended, I sit down to enjoy this hidden gem of a hot spring with her.
I've never been in spring water this warm before. It's novel, that's for sure.

options.content: "Elaborate. What do you think about it?"

scripts.say: Hard to say. What I can tell you is that it's nice to relax and unwind every once in a while.
It's made better by the luxury that is solitude. I wouldn't enjoy this nearly as much if I had to rub shoulders with others.
That's the way of the lone wolf. After a tiring day of hunting alone, you regain your strength alone.
...Mind you, I'm no misanthrope. It's just that I'm not used to being around people. Other than you, anyway.
What I am used to is the freezing wind, dragging blizzards across the tundra all day long. Sooner or later, it'll make you want to retreat to a warm den.
That's what this place is. But whether the warmth comes from the water, or you being here, I'm not sure.
...Maybe, just maybe, you've managed to tame this snow wolf.
You know, a hunter must always be sharpening their fangs and senses alike if they're to survive.
But, since I have you to watch my back, I can let my guard down and take a load off.
So, let's stay here for a while. I want to savor this rare moment of relaxation.
...With you by my side.

sequence:
Invitation of Melting Snow

<size=45>The Roosting Angel</size>

scripts.say: As I'm walking down the silent and snowy hike trail, I hear the rustling of clothes from a nearby open-air hot spring.
Approaching to investigate, I spot a familiar face in the midst of a prayer.
"...Thank you, Holy Iris, for this respite at the end of a tiring journey..."
"...I am forever grateful for your hands that lead my body and spirit towards a place to rest..."
Commander, it's poor manners to sneak up on someone, particularly while also violating their privacy.
Pray tell, did you commit the grave sin of peeping while I was changing?

options.content: "The Iris willed me to do it!"

scripts.say: Hmm. I swear I sensed your gaze, but perhaps that was a figment of my imagination.
Since I cannot prove your guilt, I will take your word for it.
...The Holy Iris would never will such indecency.
I don't buy your excuse for even a moment, but I will let it slide this once. The Iris teaches us to forgive.
Say, are you here to enjoy the view and bask in the hot spring's warmth? If so, you're welcome to.
...Yes, I am offering you to join me in the water.
While Joffre's tone remains calm and neutral, her cheeks seem to redden ever so slightly at the idea.
How is it, Commander?
Can you feel the hot spring rejuvenate your body and spirit, even if only a little bit?
The water warms me from my shoulders to my toes, washing away all my pent-up weariness.
I hope this experience reinvigorates you in the same way it did me.
Also, after we're done, I'd like to give you a massage. To improve your circulation, of course.
Trust me, you'll want to enjoy this vacation to its fullest. You may find yourself subject to the Holy Iris' guidance otherwise~

sequence:
Invitation of Melting Snow

<size=45>Thawing in the Snow</size>

scripts.say: In a misty open-air hot spring, there's a girl sitting on the blue-tinted stones, watching the snow around her melt.
There you are. Glad you kept your word, Comrade Commander.
Nope, you're on time. I finished changing just a minute ago.
What do you think of this place? I felt it'd be good to have a hot spring date, since you're always working so hard and deserve some relief.
The water is the perfect temperature, and the scenery is pretty gorgeous as well.
It's definitely one of my favorite spots. You can watch the snow fall and melt for hours while you rest up.
Ahem... What are you waiting for? Come on, let's go in the water.
Voroshilov and I have a great time in the hot spring.
While the water warms my body, her touch warms my heart. I almost feel like I'm going to overheat.
Are you okay? Are you in over your head?
Maybe the water is just a touch too hot? It would explain why you're blushing.
I don't get the chance to explain myself before she starts clinging to me with a look of concern.

options.content: "That's just because I feel so refreshed."

scripts.say: Oh... Yeah, I see what you mean. I'm starting to sweat.
That's why they call it a HOT spring, I suppose...
(Moments alone with Comrade Commander don't come every day... I need to seize this opportunity!)
It's not the water that's making me feel so hot. It's the fact that I'm rubbing shoulders with her.
Then you've probably been soaking for too long...
O-oh. That's all? You clearly handle the heat a lot better than I do...
That's good, though. I'm glad to hear it.
Whew... By the way, there's more stuff to do after this bath. We can go on a stroll through the forest or the city and take in the snowy vistas.
Anything you want, as long as I can be with you. I want you all to myself, at least for today.
She holds my hand. It feels even warmer than the water.
This is only the start of our date. The best has yet to come.

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Zuikaku In The Morning</size>

scripts.say: Port - Early morning
My secretary, Zuikaku, would usually come to my office and give me a report at this time of day, but it seems she's not here yet.

options.content: Head to the dorm to check on Zuikaku

scripts.say: *Snore*... Mmhh... *Snore*... Zzzzzzz...
As you can see, she's fast asleep... Please, forgive her, Commander...
Zuikaku was lying in her bed, limbs stretched out in all directions, snoring loudly.
Perhaps she overworked herself during last night's training... Usually, she'd even wake up before me...
... Sis... *Snore*... Some people dream of success... but I'm gonna work hard at it... Zzzz...
I just cleaned the room yesterday, and now she's made a mess of it...
C'mon, Zuikaku, wake up! The Commander's here!
Com... mander?! Oh shoot, I-I'm sorry! I overslept when I- Waahh?!
Startled, but awake, Zuikaku got out of bed. She tripped over a pillow which must've fallen off the side of her bed.
Goodness gracious... Go and get yourself in order, I'll clean up the room.
... The Commander's waiting for you, so don't dawdle. *Giggle*
G-got it!

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Zuikaku & Her Friends</size>

scripts.say: After Zuikaku hurriedly gave me her morning report, we went out together for a walk around the base.
Sorry, Commander... I was up all night cramming Offense Skillbooks...
... I know, I'll be more careful next time...
Hey, what's this? Why's everyone gathering at the pier?
Why, if it ain't Zuikaku! You out for a walk with the Commander?
Yup! So, why are you all gathered here?
We wanted to talk to some Eagle Union peeps about a joint exercise, and we're discussing how to bring it up with them.
Uh, can't you just, like, bring it up with them? Like normal people do?
Ise and Hyuuga could maybe do it, but most of us aren't the types who can just ask someone about a joint exercise...
She's right. If someone like Takao or I were to ask them, we'd come off as too formal, and they might speculate that we're up to something...
Then why don't I do it? I was just about to head their way anyhow.
Really? 'Cause that'd be a huge help.
If Zuikaku will ask on our behalf, then I'm sure it'll go well.
Yeah. Sorry for making you go out of your way like this, Zuikaku.
No need to be sorry! I can handle it, no problem!
Zuikaku went to the Eagle Union dormitory and proposed the joint exercise. Almost everybody she told about it agreed to participate.
*Phew*... That about makes it one lap around the base, huh?
This happens surprisingly often~ Like, I'm just out and about, then suddenly somebody asks me for a favor.

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Zuikaku & The Foxes</size>

scripts.say: As I was making my way back to the office...
Oh, Commander~!
By pure coincidence, I bumped into Akagi and Kaga who had just finished their exercises.
Hello, you two! I heard you did a great job during your exercises.
And I heard you did a... job... walking around the base with the Commander.
You heard right! ... Hey, what're you doing, Commander? What are you hiding from?
Ah, you see, the Commander gets very shy when Akagi is around. *Giggle*... I shall leave my report in the usual place. You know where, Commander~
Bootl... *Ahem*, Akagi, please try not to inconvenience the Commander too much.
That goes for you too, Zuikaku. You're the secretary, so do your job right... Now, Akagi, after you.
Hey, Commander, Akagi's left now.
Like, I know she can be overbearing sometimes, but don't you think you were overreacting to her just a little much?
You don't understand, do you, Zuikaku?
Huh? Don't understand what, exactly?

If Akagi had seen the Commander together with any other girl, she wouldn't have been smiling like that, she would've been talking about how she's going to "eliminate all filthy pests" that get in her way. And hiding won't save you from her.
That is to say, Akagi has assessed that, even though you're together with the Commander, you are harmless to her plans. That's why you've even made it this far.
I don't know whether to be happy or sad about that... It's a weird feeling...

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Zuikaku & Master Mikasa</size>

scripts.say: Evening - Practice Area
Splendid! Now come at me and attack!
Okay!
Zuikaku's planes released their dummy bombs over Mikasa, achieving a marvelous direct hit.
Ouch!
Sweet, sweet victory! ... Hey, Master Mikasa, what happened? Are you okay?!
I-I am fine... I must say, that was a spectacular attack! You have made phenomenal progress since your training began!
Thank you, Master Mikasa! ... Hey, Commander, am I awesome, or what?!
... Ahahahah! Okay, I'm awesome, but maybe not THAT awesome~! All right, now I should be one step closer to surpassing the Grey Ghost!
Then, next time, I'll be able to protect my sister and my friends...!
... Commander, could you put the Grey Ghost and me together for the next sortie? I'll nab that MVP, I swear it!
Zuikaku grinned as she turned around and headed back towards the base.
Commander, do you have a moment?
Zuikaku may not seem like it, but within her lies the strong desire to thoroughly prove her worth. In other words: she will one day drive herself into a corner.
Her desires go beyond merely wanting to surpass the Grey Ghost. She wants to shoulder the burdens of Shoukaku, her Sakura Empire brethren, the entire world, and even you, Commander.
Commander, I must ask a favor of you... A favor as Zuikaku's mentor, a favor as an individual...
If the burdens she carries grow too heavy... then I want you to be by her side and support her.
... Ahah, that's what I wanted to hear. You have my gratitude.

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Today, I'm Your Chef!</size>

scripts.say: Office - Nighttime
Welcome back, Commander! Want me to bring you your food soon?
... Huh? Didn't I tell you that I'd be making your food today, not Shoukaku? I can't keep asking her to make food for you forever, so I tried my own hand at it!
Just sit tight, I'll be back in a moment.
A short while later, Zuikaku returned with a tray of food.
Dinner's served! Chicken nuggets with onions, rice cooked in barley and miso soup with an egg, and lastly for dessert: coconut juice and a Royal Rations Banana!
All in all, it's like a road trip through Flavortown! Bon appetit!
The food itself certainly looked appetizing, but it was arranged rather casually on the tray. One could really tell Zuikaku prepared this meal.
It also looks like she hid some tempura next to the chicken nuggets. Maybe they were meant to be a surprise?
So, what do you think?
... Delicious, like always? Sweet! I mean, even without my sister's help, I can at least make some delicious food!
So it's even better than the Grey Ghost's cooking? Thanks, Commander!
I've heard Vestal is teaching her how to cook so that basically means she's no match for me!
*Giggle*♪ I beat the Grey Ghost today♪

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Someone Like Me...</size>

scripts.say: Office - Past midnight
Geesh... There's an unusual amount of paperwork today... Usually, by now you'd have already been gone to sleep...
It's been a long time since I've had to work this late into the night.
Um, since it's so late, maybe I should make you something light to eat?
Don't you know, Zuikaku? You should have something prepared before you even ask that.
You're here, sis?!
I noticed that you hadn't come back to the dorm yet, so I reasoned that you must still be hard at work...
It's not good for your health to overwork yourself. Now, watch and learn the importance of being prepared...
With an alluring smile, Shoukaku reached into her pockets and took out a handful of snacks and a small can, which she placed on my desk.
B-but I was just about to prepare something... Wait a minute, is that... beer?
It is~ The Commander has been working all day, so I thought a drink might help relieve some of the stress... In a way, I'm also taking a little revenge for that thing a few days ago~
By which I mean that time when I'd had a lot to drink, and... Oh, you haven't told her yet, have you, Commander...?
I don't remember anything like that...
(I knew it: sis has been doing all sorts of stuff with the Commander when I'm not around...)
(I get it now... She's prettier than me, she's more composed than me, and though we're equals in combat, she's a way better secretary than me... Someone like me can't even hold a candle to her...)
... Alright, then... I'll just go and leave my snacks in the fridge...
... Maybe I took my teasing a little too far?

sequence:
The Lucky Crane

<size=45>Chapter 7 - The Indomitable Crane</size>

scripts.say: Office - Past midnight
I'm sure... you'd prefer Shoukaku's snacks over mine anyway...
You mean you want mine too...?
*Giggle*~ The Commander must be quite famished♪
You don't have to force yourself to eat it... Sis has already gotten you some snacks, so I'll save mine for next time, okay...?
... "Only when together can sis and I form your wings, so it's absurd to choose only one of us"...?
... J-jeez...
For a moment, Zuikaku's expression turned bright red.
That is a charming, albeit very cheesy way of expressing your feelings...
Commander, thank you.
I know that you care about us both. I've known it for a long time, and yet I got so upset over nothing...
If I ever lose faith in myself again and start acting mopey...
Actually, no! I'll never let that happen again! I'm the indomitable crane; I'm above mopiness!
But... if you'd every now and then tell me that you like me more...
Then I might... be a little happier...
... Please? Commander...?
As we'd arranged some time ago, I come to Hwah Jah's door, prepared to depart for our trip.
I hear the rustle of clothing behind the door, accompanied by cheerful humming.
I knock on the door. Hearing her answer, I open the door.
Hwah Jah stands before a mirror, slender fingers gently adjusting her hair.
The sunlight casts a warm outline on her focused profile.
Your timing is superb. I was just wondering when you would arrive, Commander.
Heehee, since you're here, allow me to show you one of my most beloved treasures.
I keep this lacquerware safe and secure. Normally, nobody else is allowed to touch it.
But today is different... I'll let you examine it, Commander.
But if you don't offer me a proper review, I'll knock you on the head with my fan.
She points, and I follow with my eyes.
My eyes are drawn to a lacquered box sitting on a desk by the window. It seems to glow with a subtle, elegant light.
Hehe, I can tell that it's to your liking. Beauty like this is always drawn to those who truly understand it.
It took over a hundred polishings and the addition of powdered shells and gold leaf to bring out such refined, understated luster.
That sounds awfully difficult to make.
I reach out and touch it. Its texture is firm, yet delicate.
She smiles knowingly at my motions.
Difficult would be an understatement. As the proverb goes, "Though I've felled a thousand trees in pursuit of lacquer, my jar has yet to fill." Collecting the materials alone was a great effort.
Every step that follows – making the shape, tailoring the cloth, layering ash, and applying the lacquer...
It takes endless time and effort to achieve such a fine luster.
It's a lot like human relationships, don't you think?
The smile on her lips as she tucks a few stray hairs behind her ear is utterly enchanting.
Lacquerware requires daily love and care to add to its sheen.
The same goes for bonds that you cherish. Only through patience and companionship can a relationship endure the test of time.
Her soft words strike a chord deep in my heart.
Finishing her sentence, Hwah Jah sidles over and rests her fingers on the box.
A refined lacquerware warrants pearls and jade, just as an elegant courtyard cradles the splendor of spring.
Likewise, I've made space in the most precious place in my heart for a certain someone.
As she steps closer, I smell a faint fragrance on her. Her murmurings tickle my earlobe.
Don't you try to play coy now.
Suddenly, she turns and walks away from me, picking up a basket beside the door.
Bright sunlight and a gentle breeze flow into the room.
It's time we get going, Commander.
We mustn't let this delightful weather go to waste.

sequence:
Christmas Party!

<size=45>How to Craft a Cookie</size>

scripts.say: Ingredients... check! Oven... check! Everything's perfect! The gingerbread cookie is gonna turn out awesome this time!
... or maybe it won't. Something's still missing...
Lalala~♫
Hey Seattle, why the long face? Why don't we go for an exciting snowball fight to cheer you up~
Oh, San Diego. I'm prepping for tonight's Christmas party, but...
*sniff sniff* Hmm... are you baking some gingerbread? It smells great!
Bingo! I'm making gingerbread cookies! Hey, while you're here, you mind being my taste tester?
Can I really? In that case, I'll help myself!
... Shoo goood! One more!
San Diego wolfed down the gingerbread cookie.
Phew... thanks for the treat!
What'd you think?
I'm stuffed!
Awesome! ... Hang on! You've gotta tell me how it tasted!
Hmm... It was just "good," I guess?
Welp, I figured as much. It's missing that little extra something...
Love?
Come again?
You know, "love makes the best seasoning," or something like that?
Love... Love, huh... What's the deal with love...
I have no idea!
Still, you might be onto something there! I'll start by asking around, but first I need to send out invitations to the other factions.
I didn't catch any of that, but it sounds good!

sequence:
Christmas Party！

<size=45>Queen's Profile</size>

scripts.say: The right hand is looking good! Lady Warspite, your part is next!
Calm down... Calm down, Warspite... Great! That should do it for Her Majesty's eyebrows!
Impressive as always, Warspite! A beautiful depiction of Her Majesty's face, if I must say so myself!
Phew... we managed to finish in time.
Yo, what's up with that giant gingerbread cookie?!
Why, if it isn't Seattle. Thank you very much for arranging the Christmas party.
I'm just doing this 'cause it's fun~♪
But having that said, I ran into some issues while making my own gingerbread cookie...
What kind of issues?
Well, y'know, I was thinking that my cookie was lacking some "love"...
"Love," huh... I was also worried about that.
So this is what we decided on this year! A special gingerbread statue, fashioned in Her Majesty's image! We call it the "Queen's Profile!"
Dang... That's pretty awesome...
Hehe... did you think it was just a regular gingerbread cookie?
We've prepared countless ingredients as well as an industrial-size oven for this project! And after many rounds of trial and error...
Neptune, I don't know how to say this, but... isn't this a bit too big?
Yeah, it's way too big... How many times did you make me taste test? It was really tasty, but...
Oh my, did you not volunteer to be our taste tester yourself, Miss Wakaba?
Because I was allured by the smell of gingerbread while handing out presents~!
That indeed is the Royal spirit. Your dedication shall not go to waste.
Just wait, Your Majesty! This year, you'll be pleased for sure!
That's right! The Royal Maids will be stunned speechless by our magnificent Christmas present!
A-anyway, really appreciate the tips! Please swing by the Christmas party later and have some fun!
Now if you'll excuse me, I've gotta go. The gift exchange should be starting soon.
Wait, Seattle! Let me help you with that!
Hmm? Never mind, we're about done over here anyway. I will accompany Her Majesty to the party later, so do continue the good work, Seattle.

sequence:
Christmas Party!

<size=45>The Hearth's Warmth</size>

scripts.say: So waaarm~
Ahh, waaarm~ I want to slack off in front of the fireplace too~
Yeah, tell me about... Hey, I'm not slacking off! I was just wrapping the Christmas presents!
Ahaha, I was joking just now! I ate a whole lot, so I have to burn off those calories!
You ate a whole lot... right before the party...?
I kinda feel bad for you, Wakaba...
Seattle, did you already finish up with the presents for the Eagle Union girls?
Yup, all done! Agano, Kiyonami, you did a great job! Huh? Kiyonami, that outfit...
Yuugure and I picked out this outfit together. She said it "looked very Christmassy," but it doesn't look weird, right?
Nope, it doesn't look weird at all. Hehe, that outfit makes you look like a delectable Little Red Riding Hood that any wolf would love to gobble up!
Uuuugh...
Sorry, just messing with you. You're just too cute, so I can't help it. Hehe~
Mhm, I totally get what you mean.
By the by, I wanted to ask you one thing about gingerbread cookies...
Gingerbread cookies? What about them...?
Yeah, I was worried about how to make sweets for the party, so...
I think... m-making a cookie that looks like Hoppy... would be cute...
I don't want to hear about gingerbread ever again...
"Love" is fine and all, but what you really need is something to give it a little bit of "kick."
Ah, I get what you mean. Basically, I have to mix up the flavor a bit?
Right. And isn't there just the girl who would know all about that?

sequence:
Christmas Party!

<size=45>Speaking of Sweets</size>

scripts.say: The best way to keep yourself warm during a cold day is... with a whole bunch of calories~♪ Dewey, how about another cookie?
I'll pass, thanks. Speaking of which, shouldn't we take the cake over to the party?
What a good kid you are, Dewey~ But it's all right, we can head out after I finish this~♪
Hey, I'm back~
Oh, Seattle. Sorry, we were just getting ready to take the cake over.
Ah, don't worry! There's still plenty of time! I didn't come to rush you anyway~
Since you're here then, why not have some sweets? Would you like a sundae, or a slice of cake?
Uh, I really appreciate it, but I was hoping to ask you something...
So that's what's going on... You want to make your gingerbread cookie extra tasty?
Exactly! And I figured you know more about sweets than anyone else!
That's an easy one! Double the sugar, double the sweetness. Double the sweetness, and double the deliciousness, right?
You really do love your sugar, don'tcha~
Sweets are a crucial part of Christmas, after all! That's why I think it'd be nice to have more sweets at the party!
Tapping into the essence of sweetness... All right, I think it's all coming together now!
Ah, let me help you carry the Christmas cake. Afterward, would you two mind helping me taste test my gingerbread cookies?
Of course~ As long as it's sweet, I'm totally down~♪
All right, I'm gonna make the best cookie, and put on the best Christmas party ever!
Um, I'll help as well...

sequence:
Christmas Party!

<size=45>Christmas Party!</size>

scripts.say: At the Christmas party...
Phew... I finished the cookies on time, and the party was a huge hit. Thanks, guys! I couldn't have done it without your help!
Seattle, your gingerbread cookies were good.
The ones shaped like Hoppy... so cute...
Gingerbread cookies supercharged with pure sugar... Pure bliss~
But man, the Royal Navy's gingergiant really dwarfs everything in its presence...
I heard about it from Wakaba, but seeing it in person is a whole other deal... Ahaha...
Wh-what is this...?!
This is a gingerbread statue that was sculpted in Your Majesty's likeness.
We've christened it the "Queen's Profile," Your Majesty.
Spectacular! You've outdone yourself, Warspite! Now, I shall boast to that girl who calls herself the "spiritual leader" of the Iron Blood.
Well done, Lady Warspite, Lady Neptune.
Heheh~ I figured even you would be shocked by something of this scale, Miss Head Maid.
I've had enough gingerbread for a lifetime... I'm going to go search for some nuts.
Ah, umm, the presents for the gift exchange are under the tree~
I'm looking forward to finding out who's the lucky recipient of my present~~
Good grief, things always get so noisy whenever someone talks about presents...
Hey, it's only Christmas once a year. Besides, it'll come again next year, so might as well get used to it.
That's right! That's what the Christmas spirit is all about~♪
Hehe, well said! There's no need to worry at all! All right, everyone, cheers!
Cheers! Merry Christmas!!
Intelligence reports that the Iron blood's newest battleships are set to sail through this area. If we surprise them here, the Queen will surely reward us upon our return!
*Sobs* Battleships? Are we really going to be a match for them?
The water here is so cold... My entire body feels like its turning into ice... Why don't we just hurry back to port?
It's going to be fine! We're just here to scout. If a fight kicks off, it'll be up to our big sisters to handle it. They're close by and ready to provide support whenever we need it~!
All I see is fog and ice... I don't think anyone else is around. Plus, no matter what battleship appears, they'll turn tail and run once they find out that our big sisters are here, haha!
Something feels strange though, don't you think? I'd be relieved if we just spent the rest of our day looking out to sea and then heading home for dinner...
Hmm? Wait a second... My radar seems to be picking up a strange signal up ahead...
What? Let me see.
Iron blood destroyer squadron detected ahead! Maybe it's just a few scouts? Report to Hood immediately!
My... my antenna is... f-f-frozen into... a p-p-popsicle...
We've got to hold off their squadron. It's just a few production-type destroyers... We should be able to handle this!
Are... are we going to fight? *Sobs* I knew this would happen...
Wow, Suffolk! We're so strong! We defeated so many enemies at the same time!
Don't get cocky... Those ships were clearly there to test us... We haven't even seen the Iron blood's new battleship yet. I've got a bad feeling about this...
Hehehe... So there was an ambush after all! Looking for us?
Danger!!! Enemies at starboard!!! Two large warships detected at 220 degrees... New Iron blood battleship spotted! All personnel, get ready to fight!
Uh oh...
Haha~! Two puny cruisers? Getting ready to attack? Hah! I suppose I'll try to enjoy this as much as I can~!
Not just two cruisers! Hood and Prince of Wales from the Royal Navy, here for backup! Let's have a showdown, shall we?
All ships, focus fire on the ship hiding in the back. That's Bismarck, our target!
We've been figured out... To be expected from King George V, I suppose...
Excuse me, but I'm Prince of Wales... You've mistaken me for someone else.
Who cares, all you sisters look the same to me. Let's see what you've got!
Well, it seems like a fight is inevitable. Jot Dora!
Hood!!!
Ah... This power... extraordinary... Incredible that you've found this strength…
We've been found out. Eugen, it's time to retreat.
Oh? We've got the upper hand! Why would we turn back now?
Our secret weapon has been discovered. Dragging this out will only expose us further. Follow my orders and retreat immediately!
Damn... So there's no helping it.... Take care, little sheep. We'll be seeing you again.
... Why... why would you betray our alliance...
Honor and loyalty... Only with great power can we truly save humanity. We've... we've just chosen a different path.
I don't expect you to understand. Only those looking back on these moments will be able to decide who is right and who is wrong.
My old friend... May we meet in Valhalla...
... Humanity is such an interesting lifeform... The power we gave them was just the beginning... History has already begun to be rewritten...
Let's continue our observations for some time... I have great expectations for their future developments...
If we didn't take these steps, coming back to this era would have been meaningless, no? Ahaha...

sequence: The world order is crumbling... Those with power must stand up and fight against the currents of evil and the torrents of history.
It is known, however, that power begets power, bringing forth even stronger waves...

You've got quite the firepower, but it's useless against me!

You've done well. It's time for us to give the Iron blood a taste of their own medicine. Target Bismarck, their lead ship! Fire!
“'The Glory of the Royal Navy'? This should be fun. I wonder if you're actually strong enough to satisfy me.

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>1 To a Brightly Shining World</size>

scripts.say: Sardegna - Communication Room
Sorry to keep you waiting, my esteemed allies of Sardegna.
On behalf of the Iron Blood, I am glad to announce that we plan to attend the "World Expo" you've proposed.
As such, I've proposed extending our ceasefire to our respective higher-ups through the Naval HQ.
That is good news indeed. Thank you for your courtesy and consideration, Flagship Bismarck.
With your return to the world stage, I'm looking forward to seeing what Iron Blood will bring to the expo.
You flatter me, Veneto.
Sardegna is a trusted ally to the Iron Blood. I hope this opportunity will allow us to further strengthen our bonds.
The Naval HQ will have little choice but to extend the ceasefire during our celebration of peace.
You have the support of the entire Crimson Axis, as we all wish for the expo to proceed smoothly and safely.
Regardless of what happened in the past, we are united in wanting the people of this world to become more interconnected through safe waters, and improving everyone's lives.
As the Iron Blood... No, as shipgirls, we must protect that future first and foremost.
...In any case, Prinz Eugen will be your point of contact with the Iron Blood during the expo. She and her fleet should be arriving in Sardegna shortly.
Despite her appearances, she's extremely capable. I'd like you to treat her as my proxy during this event.
Do you find these arrangements acceptable?
Of course. We are well aware of Prinz Eugen's abilities.
As always, Sardegna looks forward to your visitation.
Excellent. In that case, I wish Sardegna the best of luck. May your World Expo be a resounding success.
Phew... That's one fewer thing to worry about. Preparing for the World Expo is more of a hassle than I imagined...
Huh? Hasn't everything been going great so far? Such an expression is ill-suited for your lovely face.
...I'm making this expression because I'm stressed out, jeez!

Bismarck has always represented the will of the Iron Blood, and when she disappeared after the incident with the Sirens, we thought everything had changed. But now, she's suddenly front and center again as if nothing happened...
Don't you think everything's moving a bit too quickly? Even though the Commander did notify you beforehand, you must be as surprised as I am, right?
True, I was not expecting Bismarck to make her return like that either...
But just between the two of us, I'd rather be dealing with Bismarck than that Friedrich der Große woman. Can't trust someone who always acts like she's holding all the cards.
I know, I know. That said though, isn't it equally dangerous to blindly go along with whatever Bismarck says?
Even if she says she's no longer taking orders from the Naval HQ, that doesn't rule out the possibility that she might have plans of her own, just like Friedrich.
Mm, that's a good point.
But, I do believe the Signorina worries too much.
Remember, the joint operation proposed by the Northern Parliament was carried out with the authorization of the Naval HQ.
The fact that alliances and loyalties are so fluid for the Iron Blood means that the Naval HQ's higher-ups will have a closer eye on them than ever.
Their survival now hinges on one thing – some kind of massive commotion that can divert their attention.
Hehe, so you're not all brawn and no brain after all, Littorio~
A-ahem... It's just guesswork on my part. I certainly can't read Bismarck's mind of all people...
You got me good there, Veneto. In any case, we'll need to strengthen our security to ensure that they don't get their massive commotion during our World Expo.
Worst case scenario, if we get involved in some Iron Blood "operation," we should still be able to flex our muscles as the event organizer.
With Iron Blood on board, the Sakura Empire and Vichya Dominion shouldn't have any objections either.
As for the Azur Lane... Well, the Northern Parliament has already agreed. The rest should follow suit sooner or later.
"A celebration of peace." ...There's no way anyone would turn down an event like this, even if for the optics alone.
The Naval HQ likely has their suspicions, but all we need to do is keep our heads down and continue with the preparations.
Both Iron Blood and the Commander have proven that as long as nobody makes the first move, nothing will happen.
Indeed. And that is why we cannot pass on this prime opportunity to spread the splendor of Sardegna.
Shipgirls from all over the world will gather in our warm, welcome waters, bask in our splendid scenery, and immerse themselves in our lush history and exquisite cuisine.
In the end, they will all bow before Sardegna's splendor... In that regard, Marco Polo's proposal is quite compelling.
...Phew. All this running around has worked up a sweat. Littorio, shall we head to the baths after this?
We might even get some inspiration for the expo while enjoying the luxurious waters of our thermae~♪
I would be more than glad to accompany you, my beautiful signorina~

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>2 The Northern Parliament's Speculation</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere in the Northern Parliament...
Kronshtadt, what do you think about the invitation we received from Sardegna?
The return of the World Expo? To my understanding, the event has been on the decline since the rise of the Crimson Axis.
Now that the situation in the NA Ocean is finally starting to wind down, it's certainly not a bad time to reboot the event.
I just didn't expect Sardegna to be the first to make the proposal.
No, I'd say that was a fairly predictable outcome. Sardegna likely sees the World Expo as a prime opportunity to "spread their splendor."
I must admit, it's an efficient way of doing so.
And, through completely peaceful means too.
Do you think the Northern Parliament should participate?
I do think it would be in our best interests to go.
The World Expo is an event where not only the organizers, but all the participants as well, can show off their abilities.
Needless to say, that's meaningful for us as well.
...And, knowing you, I'm sure you've already sent the reply saying that we'll participate.
I'm just speculating here, but I suspect that there's nobody else you'd rather have hosting the World Expo than Sardegna.
Oh? Your speculation is rather prescient. If I didn't know better, I'd suspect you've been secretly browsing through confidential intelligence and communication records.
We all get lucky sometimes. By the way, for what purpose did you secretly dispatch Stremitelny to Sardegna?
Just your routine business contact. Strengthening our communication with Sardegna is a worthwhile endeavor, no?
As for the matter of our participation in the World Expo, your "speculation" is correct. I have already responded on behalf of the Northern Parliament.
As the first party from the Azur Lane to accept the invitation, our prestige has already increased in Sardegna's eyes. Treat it as my loan for them to repay.
As for the girls who will be representing us to Sardegna, there are actually a few things I'd like to take care of beyond the routine stuff.
Are you interested in going, Kronshtadt?
Of course. It's my job to take care of whatever goes "beyond the routine stuff" after all.
Having that said, if I'm to serve as a delegate, all eyes will automatically be on me no matter how much I try to keep a low profile. I'll need some backup.
Avrora will accompany you. She's quite familiar with the workings of the other factions.
Unfortunately, the Polar Fleet is tied up with some investigatory work right now and won't be able to provide you with much support. I do hope you understand.
I've been dealt worse hands before. But, I do have one request.
I want authorization to see all of the higher-ups' classified documents on the Europa operation. Can't be rushing in blind after all.
...I do wonder, is that request actually for work purposes, or to sate your own curiosity?
But, I understand. I will give you the authorization. Be sure to make good use of that information.
Understood. ...Oh, there's one last thing.
Um... What about Comrade Commander? Should we send an invitation from our end as well?
It can't hurt to try... But this time, our chance of success is probably pretty close to zero.
All the factions are going to want to get their hands on the Commander, huh... Wait, isn't this pretty bad for us?
Whichever faction's invitation the Commander ends up accepting will likely have ramifications for all of us. I can see it becoming a very sensitive issue.
Plus, the Commander likely is being hosted by someone else right now. Us sending an invitation could potentially create a diplomatic mess...
Indeed. And that's why I already sent the invite, Kronshtadt.

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>3 The Commander's Worries</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere in the Eagle Union...
W-wow, this isn't good... It's actually double plus ungood...
Imagine my confusion when I got an "Invitation to the World Expo" from just about every camp in the world.
They're all asking for you to go with them... right? And the communications are all private too...
I don't think anyone has any ill intentions, which is exactly why it's hard for me to say anything... Though, there's at least one sender who's doing this to mess with me...
But Sister Sara was just about to ask you if you had some free time in your schedule...
For whatever reason, Saratoga looked like she was about to cry on the other side of the communicator.
Commander, listen to me! It's all one big conspiracy!
"Now that you mention it, it IS extremely unlikely that I'd receive pretty much the same message from everyone at roughly the same time."
That's right! I knew this would happen the moment Sardegna announced that they'd be rebooting the World Expo!
A festival held in the beautiful seas of Sardegna, where shipgirls from all over the world come together to compete and represent their proud cultures.
Of course there's nothing wrong with inviting you, Commander, but the question of whose invitation you'll accept is a major crisis!
