I also sent you an invitation, and you didn't even respond... But you were happily laughing and chatting with THAT girl as if you two were dating... *sniffle*
I wanted to correct the record and say that wasn't what was going on at all, and that I just wanted to participate as a regular, uninvolved party, but...
There will definitely be a major problem if I make a wrong move. Plus, the Naval HQ will be watching my every move.
So, what are you going to do? You're going to go with Sister Sara after all so that nobody else gets the wrong idea, right?
...I had to carefully think about what I wanted to do with these invitations. Except one. I slapped a big, fat "NO" on it, before sending it back.
This sucks... We won't even be able to relax and have a good time there at this rate...
"There's nothing wrong with being in a festive mood, but the World Expo is a weeks-long event. It's not worth getting into trouble."
"Let's focus on the task at hand first, and once everything blows over, we'll enjoy the rest of the event like ordinary people."
F-fine, I suppose you're right...
In case you were wondering, Essex is the Eagle Union's representative, so there's nothing to worry about.
Oh, before I forget! I know you can't go right now, but here are some pictures of Eagle Union's pavilion! It has sci-fi vibes and looks super badass, doesn't it?
When you get there, you definitely have to go check it out... *click*
*knock* *knock*
Commander... Eldridge is here to remind you... that the next round of equipment testing is starting...
Um... I thought I heard Saratoga's voice...
Anyway, I'll leave it there for now! We're still busy setting up for the expo over there, so I'll talk to you later!
After seeing Eldridge come into the room, Saratoga scrambled to end the call.
Bye bye! Sister Sara out!
Commander, are you okay?
If you're tired... Eldridge will try to... get the tests pushed back.
"No, I'm fine. You know what they say: work hard, play hard––"

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>4 The Royal Exhibition</size>

scripts.say: Royal Islands - Queen's Museum
Your Majesty, shouldn't you take a break? It's been two hours already.
I've gone ahead and prepared tea and snacks. Please feel free to ask me should you have any requests.
Give me a minute. Ugh...
Now isn't the time for tea... Warspite, help me move this portrait outside!
Urgh... Why is this... so... heavy?!
I'll have you know, that's one of the Queen's Museum's treasures! It's very important!
This one over here too – Valiant, come help me out!
H-huuuh? Why are you making ME do manual labor?! Hermione, heeeelp!
Y-yes ma'am! Right away!
*pant*... *pant*... Your Majesty, are you sure you want to take so many of our treasures to the World Expo? What if something happens...
The fact that we're not hosting the World Expo means that it's even more important for us to demonstrate our greatness!
Make no mistake - the World Expo is also a battlefield! We will attract more guests to the Royal Navy's pavilion and defeat this so-called "Sardegnian splendor!"
For that purpose, I shall utilize everything in my museum!
...But, you do have a point, Warspite. Taking all these treasures over to Sardegna is a rather risky affair.
Which is why what you see before you are elaborate replicas, completely indistinguishable from the real articles!
How astute, Your Majesty! That solves the problem of security!
Indeed! I thought of that idea right away! ...Howe, I need your help too!
Y-yes, Your Majesty!
And, that should settle things nicely. Bel, have you compiled a list of our exhibits?
Yes, it's all. Please take a look.
Mm... Hmm... Don't you think this is too many antiques?
With this lineup, Sardegna might think we're there to pawn off our old wares...
Maybe we should go with something more modern? Let me think...
Bel, help me collect some more modern stuff!
Find stuff that isn't very important but still showcases the Royal Navy's technological prowess!
As you wish, Your Majesty. I'll look for things that fit that description.
Y-your Majesty, if we keep adding more things to the exhibition, we won't even have room in the pavilion for our guests!
Just make it bigger then!
That's right, our Crystal Palace has to be larger and more luxurious than whatever Sardegna can throw together!
Hmph! I'll show them that their talk of glory and splendor is just that. Only the Royal Navy understands what Glory truly is!
Illustrious will be in charge of the pavilion and its security. As for transporting the items...
I'll have the Royal Maids handle that. Go call Sheffield for me.
Your Majesty, is there nothing for me to do?
Hmm? Are you dissatisfied, Warspite? I think the two of them are more than sufficient to carry out those duties.
What I'm more concerned about are the Sirens. Ever since the Iron Blood made their move, the Sirens have been suspiciously quiet.
Then, there's the wildcard of that Richard Bon Homme girl we encountered in Camelot. In other words, our very own waters may well become a flashpoint.
Warspite, Valiant, and Howe – the three of you are tasked with defending our homeland, and our important waters!
Understood!
Phew... I'll let Bel handle the exhibition then... Time to sit back and enjoy a nice cup of tea~♪

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>5 Holographs of Triumph</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere in Africa...
Cardinal Richelieu, this concludes our arrangements for the exhibition.
I do believe Iris Libre was also invited to attend the World Expo, but what is your opinion on this matter?
Her Majesty stated that should you choose to participate, the Royal Navy would shoulder the construction costs of your pavilion.
There is still plenty of space in the venue, and we would certainly love to have Iris Libre hold a joint exhibition with us.
I truly appreciate Queen Elizabeth's generous offer.
But... I'm sorry. I'm afraid I need more time to think this over.
I promise to provide you with an answer after consulting with my friends and colleagues.
Very well, do take your time. We all sympathize with Iris Libre's present situation.
In any case, I eagerly await your response.
Cardinal, with all due respect, Iris Libre has too many things on its plate right now to justify going.
While the issue with the Vichya remains unresolved, I fear that there is little room for celebration and fanfare...
If I may, Jeanne. Iris Libre ought to participate precisely because the Vichya will be there.
Simply stated, the World Expo is a rare opportunity for the various camps to show off their culture, prestige, and... legitimacy.
If the Vichya participates while we do not, that will be taken as a sign that the Vichya is the legitimate heir of the Iris Orthodoxy.
Besides, awkward as it may be, I do not think any disagreements between our two sides will devolve into conflict.
After all, the World Expo is ultimately a celebration of peace, and we are all expected to set aside our differences during this time.
If we do end up running into each other, I don't think that's a particularly difficult situation to diffuse. Right?
I see, you do have a point... But, what will the other factions make of us sharing the same space with the Vichya?
Who knows? It is what it is.
The reality is, Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion are at a complete stalemate, with neither side having the power to break through.
Regardless of what the Vichya decides to do, this is still a good opportunity for Iris Libre to make itself known on the world stage.
You've convinced me. Cardinal Richelieu, I'm now in support of attending the expo.
Phew... I'm glad we were able to reach a consensus.
As for our exhibition, how about we use the technology of the Basilica to put on a holographic display?
The quintessence of our technological development, and a representation of our piety...
A spectacular dome that embodies the resurgence of the Iris... Nay, of all of humanity––

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>6 The Sakura's Return Home</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere in the Pacific...
Sky-Rending! Retribuuuution!
Enemy down at 4 o'clock, confirmed!
Only cowards would ambush us in the middle of a storm!
This one shall... dispatch the stragglers...
Huh, you're not half-bad for someone who spends all day sleeping.
Color me impressed, even though you basically were just doing clean-up duty.
This one sees that... you too have awakened to great power...
Hey, don't get the wrong idea just because I was hibernating inside the Dragon Palace! There simply was no reason for me to unleash my true powers at that time!
Kasumi... Report on the enemy's status... Also, stay with us and do not get separated...
R-right away... Umm, our fleet members are individually dealing with remaining enemies... But, umm, where's Noshiro's team?
This one did not need the extra escort... As such, Noshiro has been sent to assist Chikuma...
(The Sirens' wreckages... are disappearing far too quickly...)
All ships... Be on your guard...
Always ready, Lady Shinano.
Hakuryuu shall remain here with this one... The enemy may well be targeting our mass-produced ships.
The transports? What do the Sirens want with–– Oh, do you think it has something to do with the strange rock we got from the Iron Blood girls?
Their goals... are beyond this one's comprehension...
Hmm... Well, lemme ask you something you can answer this time.
You seemed to know that the Sirens were going to attack us right here... How'd you manage to pull that off?
Can you predict the future or something?
That was... this one's dream... A single fragment, strung together by destiny. And thus, one comes to see the end of things.
...Sorry. I won't bother trying to ask you questions anymore.
...My apologies.
Lady Shinano, the Siren fleet has completely retreated. We're safe now.
What of our damages?
None to report of. Our mass-produced ships are all unharmed.
Yamakaze, Umikaze, Yura, and Katsuragi took a bit of scratch damage at the very beginning of the sneak attack, but there shouldn't be any issues there.
Shimakaze, um... seems to have gotten lost chasing after an enemy in the storm. I'll go bring her back.
I apologize on her behalf... Good grief, that girl just can't keep out of trouble...
Thanks to your foresight, we were able to anticipate the enemy's surprise attack and came away relatively unscathed. Kii even managed to arrive in time to reinforce us.
It was simply a dream... A fragment of a dream does not necessarily reflect the rules of the present world...
But Musashi... Even from the Sakura Islands, she was able to foretell my peril and respond appropriately...
Oh, uh, Shinano... That actually has nothing to do with foreseeing anything.
Musashi was simply worried about you, and insisted on sending a support team just in case. It's nice that things panned out.
But before we left, she did give us these orders: "If Shinano is safe, accompany her back to the Sakura Islands, and retrieve Watatsumi."
"In the event of a Siren attack, Kii is to retrieve Watatsumi and bring it back to the Sakura Islands, while Shinano will go to Sardegna."
"She will participate in the World Expo as the representative of the Sakura Empire." ...So there you have it.
The World Expo...?
Yup. All the camps from around the world are going to Sardegna to display their culture. Apparently, Musashi wants you to be the Sakura Empire's delegate.
Is this... Musashi's order, or Akagi's...?
That, I am unsure of, as Akagi has yet to return. In the meanwhile, Musashi is in charge of all matters around the Sakura Empire.
I see...
Wait up a sec, Musashi is Shinano's sister ship, right?
She hasn't even had a chance to go home yet, and now she's getting sent off to Europa again?
Hakuryuu, control yourself...
Tch...
As the representative of the Sakura Empire... Sardegna will treat this one with utmost respect.
This journey has not been a difficult one... If anything, it has been more of a vacation.
A vacation, huh? Fair enough. I guess sending you off to do an easy mission is Musashi's way of showing kindness.
Indeed... Now, the mass-produced ships and escorts will be transferred to Kii, while this one proceeds to Sardegna...
(To be kept away from the Sakura Islands once again... Musashi, what is the purpose behind this...?)

sequence:
Where All Roads Lead

<size=45>7 The Great Peng Takes Flight</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere in the Dragon Empery...
Good evening, Miss Yat Sen.
Yat Sen cooking dinner for us? Has the karma of the cosmos turned upside down or something?
Oh my, if it isn't An Shan and Harbin.
Chen Hai's here too? Well, something big must be happening if we're all here in one place, heh...
Please be seated, you two. Let's have a little chat over dinner.
Woah... What the heck did you cook for us today? Is this... a vulture?
It's the Great Peng.
It looks pretty exquisite, but the portions are a bit...
What did I say, Chen Hai? You know how Harbin is.
Yes, yes, I should've known better. I'll go bring out the rest of the portion.
This should be enough to eat to your heart's content, yes?
Haha! That it is! The best food is whatever fills your stomach up!
Alright then. Everyone, have you heard about Sardegna's World Expo?
Sorry, but I've been a bit out of the loop... All the training recently has taken a lot out of me.
Yeah, I heard about it. Like, five seconds ago.
So what's this expo thing, and are going?
What do you all think? We've been invited, and the Commander has also been contacted regarding this matter.
So I do wonder if this is the right opportunity for us.
Right opportunity? What are you... Wait, do you mean–
Yes, we're about to make a big announcement, right?
"Upon the wind the Great Peng soars into the sky, in a single day ninety-thousand meters high."
In other words, the Dragon Empery shall step onto the world stage as a major player.
As such, let us enliven the World Expo together and make it the prelude to our great announcement.
I like the sound of that! So, have you decided on who's going? Is there anything I can do?
I, for one, would love to see Europa in person!
Hehe. Sorry, Harbin, but you'll have to wait for your turn.
I guess that's true... Sucks, but I'll just have to deal with it! Ahaha!
Then, who will be our representative?
That has already been decided.
The fact that we've been relatively isolated from the other camps up until this point has been both a blessing and a curse.
Naturally, the others have little knowledge of the cards we hold in our hands.
But we also know very little about them.
Therefore, our top priority at this expo should be to learn as much as we can about the other camps, and bring that knowledge back.
Chen Hai, will you make the journey to Sardegna?
Take Hai Tien and Hai Chi with you, and broaden your horizons for the sake of the Dragon Empery. Then––
Display the allure of the Dragon Empery to the world, yes? I will try not to disappoint you. Hehehe~
You helped Shiranui advertise new products, and received 100 Coins as a reward!
You secured a new Manjuu sponsor for Akashi, and received 1000 Coins as a reward!
You won the Transcendent Driving Skills award, and received 2000 Coins!
You hopped on Great Shark and helped Akashi with an oil transport mission! Received 10 Oil!
The lucky ships helped you find a warehouse with excess oil reserves! Received 50 Oil!
The R&D Department has developed a new hybrid Manjuumobile, saving you 100 Oil!
"I, I'm not going to thank you for finding my wrench or anything!" You received 10 Cognitive Chips!
"Thank goodness... I had no idea what I was going to do..." You received 50 Cognitive Chips!
Rumors of you trying to sneak into the cheerleaders' performance have started trending! You received 150 Cognitive Chips!
You found a stray Meowfficer that somehow managed to blend in with everyone else in the bleachers. You received 1 Elite Cat Box!
You successfully regained control of a Manjuumobile commandeered by rogue Meowfficers! You received 5 Elite Cat Boxes!
You enjoyed a classy buffet with some fancy-looking Meowfficers in the VIP Lounge. You received 1 SR Cat Box!
Every time the Northern Parliament team stops for maintenance, some parts always end up getting tossed around... You received 2 T3 Gear Parts!
You helped repair some vehicles for the big match. You received 8 T3 Gear Parts!
You found something while the mysterious purple phantom of the racetrack shows up! You received 20 T3 Gear Parts!
Something fell out when you were organizing Cardinal Richelieu's archives. You received 3 Gear Designs!
You worked hard with the Great Veteran and the Manjuus to clean up the venue! You recieved 6 Gear Designs!
You won the Transcendent Driving Skills award, and received 10 Gear Designs!
You easily passed one of Amazon's pop quizzes. You received 2 Gear Designs!
You helped an Eagle Union consultant resolve an issue with gear development! You received 4 Gear Designs!
You unravelled the mystery of the golden phantom of the racetrack! You received 6 Gear Designs, how lucky!
You visited the circuit venue and got a souvenir! You received 1 Quick Finisher!
The excitement of the venue is making you feel extra energetic as well! Move forward 1 space!
The cutting-edge engine that you swapped in belches flames! Move forward 2 spaces!
Nitro boost! Now this is true speed...! Move forward 3 spaces!
You waited for an obstacle to get cleared from the race track. You received 100 Coins!
You helped Bennington make PR materials for the race team and received a sponsored award. You received 1,000 Coins!
The race's ratings shot through the roof thanks to Alfredo's shoutout! You received 2,000 Coins!
A daredevil adventurer walked onto the race track! Stop the cars! You received 10 Oil!
Error XIII's alerting indirectly reduces fuel consumption. You received 50 Oil!
Rodgers made a typo while filling out the budget application. You received 100 Oil!
Going fast felt good. You received 10 Cognitive Chips!
You saw Unicorn trying her hardest to cheer you on. You received 50 Cognitive Chips!
The roar of your car's engine gave you some good insight. You received 150 Cognitive Chips!
You were given the ranking of "Safety-Oriented Driver." You received two T3 Parts!
Collett used Error XIII for a full vehicle inspection, finding superfluous parts. You received 8 T3 Gear Parts!
Baltimore has completed a technical inspection. You received 20 T3 Gear Parts!
You helped Shoukaku and Zuikaku inspect their car for faults. You received two SR gear blueprints!
Your sponsor asked you to test out a new, lightweight racing suit. Its cooling ability is superb. You received 4 UR gear blueprints!
You and Chkalov performed an inspection on a new car model. You received six SR gear blueprints!
Some weird stuff was attached to the ribbons fluttering around the venue. You received three SR gear blueprints!
You found some lost blueprints among a pile of junk. You received six SR gear blueprints!
You saw Happy D drop something as it flew overhead. You received 10 SR gear blueprints!
You broke a record during the race. You received 1 Quick Finisher!
You flaunted some driving skills that would make even a cat passing by look on in awe. You received one Elite Cat Box!
A passing cat brought its friends to watch the race. You received 5 Elite Cat Boxes!
The king of all cats came to spectate the race. You received one SR Cat Box!
Thanks to Vicksburg's passionate cheering, you managed to drive beyond your limits. You advanced 1 tile!
You activated your car's secret booster. Advance two more tiles.
The checkered flags flutter and victory is right at your fingertips. Go! Advance three more tiles.
Whoa! A surprise drop on the track!
Rewards secured! Come on, let the camera get a good view of it!
Has our champion racer gotten a sponsorship?
Nice! There's an extra bonus highlight. Step on the gas!
Oh, my... A reward? Hurry and accept it, Commander.
This looks pretty nice...
Rewards obtained. Well done, Commander!
Let's push forward while we have the chance... but steady as she goes.
A surprise gift.
Do you like this?
Rewards are nice... But you should spend more time looking at me♡
What's the rush? Heehee.
What're you smilin' about? You find something good? Lemme see.
What's this? A pick-me-up?
Maaan, it's hot... Oh, you got cold drinks? Gimme one.
Pedal to the metal and aim for the finish line! I'll treat ya to some champagne if ya win.
An unexpected bonus... Heehee, luck is on our side today.
Our reward is already secure.
Commander, is this to your liking?
The time has come. Seize this advantage, and never let go.
We received some rewards.
Heehee. Consider it an angel's blessing.
We should take these home with us.
Is this in accordance with the rules?

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 1: Lights, Camera, Sara!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Command Room
Saratoga was happily humming while carrying out her work as the secretary.
... but she seemed to be so absorbed in her work that she wasn't aware of it.

options.content: Take a look at the "goods" from before.

scripts.say: Stop right there! Sneaky photo ops are already pushing it, but secretly using Akashi's copy machine as well... is a sin, nya!
Commander, help meee~! I simply wanted to spread the gospel of Sister Sara's charm to the whole world! ...Wait, that copy machine is yours, Akashi?
Damn right, nya! As a result, I'm going to have to confiscate all of that! Hand over the originals, nya!
Noooooooo... *collapses*
And that was how "Sister Sara's Best Pictures vol. 1 <sample version>" came into my possession.
If Gridley's testimony was to be believed, within this tome was pictures of every angle of Saratoga's daily life... perhaps quite literally.
Commander~ I'm about done~! After we're finished with work, let's go get some more lessons from Lexington!
...Well, since she hasn't noticed yet, perhaps it wouldn't hurt to take a peek at this album first...

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 2: Sara's Work Never Ends!</size>

scripts.say: The first photo was of Saratoga in her full rigging, cruising with a serious look on her face.
All righty! Sara's carrier task force lecture is about to begin~!
It is an honour to receive your instruction!
Miss Sara, thank you for coming~
Spare no expense in your training! ... Wait, why am I here too?!
I'm going to start the lecture! Carriers have a much longer attack range than battleships! The most crucial thing is how you utilize this advantage!
In other words, think of it like a prank! It's most effective to attack your opponents where and when they least expect it!
Since we here at the Eagle Union have the longest experience operating carriers, make sure to study hard!
I see the light! Indeed, that was very informative!
Hmm... does she not sound like she's talking down to me?
Your Majesty, now's not the time to be contrary~
Hey, you two right there! No chattering during the lecture!
Yes ma'am~
Arghh....!
Despite her appearances, Sara sometimes would end up reminding us of her seniority among carriers.

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 3: Sara's Day Off!</size>

scripts.say: The fourth photo was of Saratoga, doing her work as an idol(?) even on her day off...
Mmhmm! Today's photoshop went pretty well!
Ahh, after you've been in the field for a while, everyone wants to work with you~ That settles it, I'm going to star in a movie!
Miss Saratoga, do ya reckon... *cough!* I mean, do you think we'd be able to do something like that?
Don't you fret! Comet, you and the others just aren't used to it yet! No matter what happens, you'll all have my support!
Miss Saratoga is right! Have some more faith in yourself!
Yeah! Let's do our darndest... to enjoy the party!
All right! Preparations are A-O-K!
Cheers!
Cheeeers! *cough* *hack*! Miss Saratoga, did you perhaps...
Heh heh heh! I might have slipped a bit of ginger in there~! Got you good!
Um, I think there's some vinegar in mine... did you slip something into everyone's drink?
My bad, my bad! I had to be on my best behavior all day, so I just couldn't help it...
To make it up, let me get you a new round of drinks, hang on tight!
Ah, umm, we'll come help ya out!
Appreciate it! Wait, Commander, that one's gaso- I mean, it's squid ink! Remember to brush your teeth afterwards!
... Right...
Now that I think about it, that explains the terrible, no-fun morning I had that other day...

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 4: Sister Sara and Lady Lex!</size>

scripts.say: The twelfth photo featured Saratoga hugging her sister, Lexington, from behind...
Sara's pranks were a huge hit today! Heehee~♪
Hmm... whose turn is it next~? Chitose is really scary when she's mad, so maybe Commander will do~
USS Saratoga, CV-3?
Woooah! B-big sis!?
Saratoga, I heard all about it, you know? You were out playing pranks on others again...
I-I'm sorry...
Don't you think you should stop causing trouble to your friends, as well as to Commander? Someone has to take care of the girls who you prank.
And it's not just those who you play pranks on, either. It will affect everyone's morale, and that could prove fatal on the battlefield.
Above all else, I don't want to see you get injured in action because people no longer want to work with you. That's why you need to make sure to properly apologize.
Sara, you're not a child anymore. If you won't stop pulling pranks on people, then can you at least make sure that you apologize right away?
I feel bad for the girls you pranked too. It makes me very, very sad to see you do things like that to others...
Lexington... I'm really sorry...
It's fine... but make sure to take what I said to heart and make up with your friends...
And with that, the pranks resumed the next day.
Sometimes, she in fact did apologize, and nobody ever got hurt. In fact, some even started to say that... Lexington was a bit too uptight.

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 5: Paparazzi Problems! (Part 1)</size>

scripts.say: The thirty-fifth photo was of a serene beach at night... And standing there was Saratoga, flashing a brilliant smile.
Phew, that about wraps things up for today! Sis is gonna get worried if I get back late...
Hmm, actually let's practice a bit more. I don't mind if it's Lex or Comet's group, but I definitely don't want to lose to those upstart Sakura idols!
Sara's practicing by herself again... this idol business sure is really hard work...
But it's strange, isn't it? The Sakura Empire is world famous for producing many idols, but almost none of them ended up in this fleet...
Whatever, the important thing is getting this shot...
(Snap!)
Crap... forgot to silence the shutters!
Is that you, Gridley?
How'd you know?
Because you're the only one who snoops around like this, Gridley... Aoba and the others at least ask beforehand.
Sorry! I'll scram right now!
It's fine, it's fine! We all know each other here anyways. While this kind of stuff normally would be a bit problematic, it's not like Gridley plans to do anything bad, right?
So, it's not a problem! Collecting photos is A-O-K, but selling them is a no-go!
All righty, here! Say cheese~!
Ch-cheese!
(Snap!)
Gridley's smile was stiffer than a yearbook photo in this one.

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 6: Paparazzi Problems! (Part 2)</size>

scripts.say: The thirty-sixth photo was of Saratoga.... preparing something in the kitchen at night.
Hey Gridley, could you help get something for me?
Sorry, Sara, I can't reach that either... Why don't you try using your planes?
Ehh... I guess it's worth a shot. All right, everyone. Umm, let's get the parsley, pepper, and herb shakers! Gridley, can you help grate the radishes?
All righty! A little bit of work for a prime photo op? That's way too good of a deal! But, why do you suddenly want to make bento box meal?
Well, I heard that Commander would be coming by to inspect the academy tomorrow. I heard from the Sakura kids that for situations like this, you have to prepare a bento, so...
Hoooold your horses! Don't say any more!
Huh? What's the matter?
These words aren't meant for me! You should say them to Commander.
Gridley...
I've got your back, all the way! Oh, by the way, what are you using for the sauce? Wait... what's that bottle over there?
Heheh~ the Sakura kids told me that bentos must be made in a way that reflects one's personality!
And there's nothing that would reflect Sister Sara's personality better than this~
Run for your life, Commander!!!
And the last photo in the album is...
Commander, what are you looking at?
I raised my head to find Sara staring right at me, her face extremely close.

sequence:
Best Pictures!

<size=45>Chapter 7: What I Treasure Most</size>

scripts.say: Yikes, these are photos of me! Commander, are you perhaps...
Hmm... I'm not sure I believe you... Who did you get these from anyway~?
Isn't it obvious? There's only one person here who would be able to take all these photos.
Ehhhh? No way...! Commander, you took these?
... That's absurd! There's no way Commander could take photos of this quality.
Well, who took these doesn't matter. We're almost on the last page! Let me take a look!
As she spoke, Saratoga reached out to flip the page.
H-huh!?
Upon the photo was Saratoga walking hand-in-hand with Commander.
Now that I think about it, all the other photos in this album were with other people.
Umm! Commander! This one's off limits! Nothing to see here!
...because... Sister Sara isn't good at dealing with these kinds of things...
Ahhh... ya blew it, kid...
Saratoga's voice became softer and softer.
Um... make sure to give it back to Gridley, okay...? But...
Not this one! I'm not going to give this one back~♪
After all, this photo... is what I treasure most!
Saratoga's smiling face was the same as in the photo - half joyous, half mischievous.

sequence:
Superstar of the Blue Seas

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Marine Idol!</size>

scripts.say: It was a peaceful day, and I was enjoying some time off.
The port was hosting a charity drive, and Saratoga plus a few others were planning to take part and help raise money.
And the theme of the charity drive? Well...
Apparently, it's to "help protect the seas! Join Sara and friends in the search for the Mythical Seal, said to bring luck to whoever finds it!"
That's the gist of it! Now let's go look for the Mythical Seal, Commander!
C'mon, we'd better move out now! If we don't, someone else will find it before us!
We... what...?
Hasn't anybody told you, Commander? There have been confirmed sightings of the Mythical Seal in certain regions!
I'm telling you, it's not just an excuse for a theme! We've all decided we should go find it and give it shelter!
Look, Akashi even made special gear to help us catch it!
Is that a... Mythical Seal radar?
She worked pretty hard on it! It's never been tested before, but let's hope it works.
It's not every day you see Sara as motivated as this~ I'm glad to see you raring to go.
Hey, Lexington!
Hi there. I'm just here to hand in this report.
I do have to say it's wonderful to see everyone doing their part to help protect the seas.
Say, Commander, won't you be so kind as to help my little sister find the Mythical Seal?
And Sara, be nice and don't cause any trouble for the Commander, okay?
Well, it's for charity. Besides, this "Mythical Seal" has got me curious, so I suppose I'll offer a hand in finding it.
Fantastic! Thanks, Commander!
Oh yeah, Saratoga's wearing a new outfit...
Finally noticed, have you? Hehehe~ I had it especially prepared for the fundraiser concert! I'm Sara, Superstar of the Blue Seas!
With this radar and my knowledge, we'll catch the Mythical Seal in the blink of an eye! I've almost read so many books on marine life that I've got fish on the brain!
If you have any aquatic inquiries, just ask, Commander! Professor Sara can teach you anything♪
And so we set out on a journey in search for the Mythical Seal.

sequence:
Superstar of the Blue Seas

<size=45>Chapter 2 - A Charity Race?</size>

scripts.say: Hmm... It doesn't seem the Seal is in this area...
Aylwin, my radar is picking up something in that direction!
Okay! You lead the way! (Lexington has her hands full at the moment, so we need to do the best we can on our own...!)
Hey, Hunter... Remember the "nefarious kraken" that Sara spoke of? Does such a thing really exist?
... You've asked that question more than 40 times, Hardy. Does this Hunt frighten you? Then you may head back.
Hah! Me? Frightened? I'm here to ensure you won't stand motionless when something frightens YOU!
It's a dream of mine to become a marine biologist and write a thesis on starfish. It goes without saying I'll protect the sea!
Hahah, that's the spirit! We've gotta search every aquatic nook and cranny for that Seal!
Umm, Baltimore, everyone else is heading that way... Sh-should we really go this way?
Hey, there's no rule that says we must search nearby areas where we pick up readings. We'll outwit them by purposely heading in the opposite direction!
Cleve... I will continue down my own path...!
We came across several of the other teams as Saratoga and I were looking around.
It seemed that everyone was taking their respective searches for the Mythical Seal pretty seriously.
I can really tell how excited everyone is this time around!
Apparently, this legend about a creature which brings good luck may have contributed to the lively atmosphere.
(Whispering) I kind of made up that part about it bringing good luck, though...
N-nope, I didn't say anything! C'mon, we'd better speed up, Commander!
I'm picking up readings thataway!
Following the readings on the Seal radar, our little journey continued.

sequence:
Superstar of the Blue Seas

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Protectors of the Seal</size>

scripts.say: Hmm, I'm almost sure it headed in this direction...
Following the reported sightings of the Seal, I thought we had managed to get a good lead on the Seal's whereabouts.
We're getting close, Commander! I know it!
Sorry, Commander, but I'll have to ask you to stop there for a moment.
Right, uh... "We are the Protectors of the Seal."
"If you want to pass through here, then you must first answer our question."
"We will not give the Seal's location to evildoers who cannot answer this question."
They spoke in a lazy manner, like a bored voice actor just phoning in their lines...
So, the question is: what family does the earless seal belong to?

options.content: "I'd like to use a lifeline for this one... Saratoga?"

scripts.say: Wow! Spot on, Commander!
That's like bad Latin for "sea lion"! Also, sea lions have ear flaps! The correct answer is "Phocidae"!
Heh heh! The answer is "Phocidae"!
Ding ding ding. All right, you can move along.
It seems like they'll let us pass now.
... Pfft! I never imagined you three would do something like this!
... So? It's fun.
They said it would be fun, and I'm along for the ride, so to speak.
You not enjoyin' yourself, sis?
That's not what I meant. I am enjoying this, as it's for a charitable cause.
Well, there's nothing wrong with having some fun at the same time! I bet many will struggle with that question!
Oh, by the way, how are the preparations coming along?
They're going well. Don't worry.
Great to hear~! Thanks for covering for me~
(What "preparations" are they talking about...?)
Okay, Commander! Let's move on!

sequence:
Superstar of the Blue Seas

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Seal Located!</size>

scripts.say: For sure! This is the last place it was sighted!
All that's left is to roll up our sleeves and search for it!
Great job, San Diego! There's no doubt about it, this is the location of the latest Seal sighting!
See? Aren't I a genius? We'll be the first team to find that Seal~
P-pardon us, Commander!
Hey, haven't we already been here before?! We didn't find anything last time!
We're so close, and now another team is trying to get there before us?!
If we're on the same course, we'll just have to speed up!
Hey! Be gentle with an idol's outfit, Commander!
C-Commander?!
Hahaha~! So, they wanna race there, huh?
Stop! Stop, Commander! It's not time yet!
Saratoga?! ... If that's how you want it, then you'll get it! Quick, everyone!
Then, a large structure emerged suddenly from beneath the waves.
The structure was fitted with numerous water tanks, inside of which a myriad of adorable marine animals was playing.
And then, from the center of the stage, with lights shining down on it, emerged none other than the star of the show...
The Mythical Seal!

sequence:
Superstar of the Blue Seas

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Mythical Seal</size>

scripts.say: Although there were a few incidents along the way, Saratoga's charity concert concluded without a hitch.
Hehehe~ Who's the cutest little seal? That's right, you are~
The "Mythical Seal" – which in reality was just a regular seal – rubbed its nose against Saratoga's leg.
You see, you can't just protect cuties like this for a day and call it done. It's something you do every day and work hard at it!
Had I known that, I could've offered to help sooner...

options.content: Offer to help protect the seas

scripts.say: Thanks a ton, Commander! I was going to ask you anyway after the concert, but things just kind of went the way they did~
Sara, everything's ready in just a bit.
Should be. Why don't you come too, Commander?
Huh? There's more stuff going on after the concert?
It's a bit late, but today is actually when both the Sakura Empire and Dragon Empery celebrate the Night of Sevens.
Yat Sen has made mouth-watering food for the occasion, so be sure to stop by.
I'm hungry...
There'll be a fireworks display too, nya~ I designed them specifically so they won't cause distress to the marine life in the tanks, nya~
Hey... anyone else feel like we're forgetting something?
Hmm, what could that be...?
The name for the little seal, I believe!
Oh, right! We can't let this cutie go nameless!
Commander, do you have any good suggestions?
It was decided that the name of the seal – the star of Saratoga's concert and beloved treasure of the sea – would be...
Sara... Seal... I've got it! "Sally"! Let's go with that!
Okay... Commander, I'm counting on you to help me – and cute little Sally here...
... protect these beautiful blue seas and all the adorable marine life it hosts! Everybody's support matters♪
Shoot... Of course our instruments would stop working inside a Mirror Sea...
Now, what do we do, sis...
What happened to the boastful girl who said she'd "never get us lost" because she's "the auspicious crane, after all"?
*Sigh*...
I launched a few scout planes earlier in case something like this happened. We'll need intel on how to get out of here if we want to go home.
So, until my scout planes return, you'll stand here and reflect on your actions!
My bad, my bad. I'm glad that you're so dependable though, sis.
But, while we're stuck here... I just hope we're lucky enough to not run into any Sirens...
Attention, please... Readings indicate several targets to our front. Identifying... It seems they're Sirens.
Welp, it looks like you jinxed it, sis, hahaha!
Oops, sorry! That just kinda slipped out of me... Anyway, uhh, all ships, prepare to engage!
Dear me, after all that talk about the Sirens possessing the power of Poseidon, this is all they amount to...
A fitting end for these soulless husks...
The unrighteous shall not stand before my blade!
Phew... Thank goodness these were just mass-produced Pawns... I'd hate to come across one of their leaders.
Attention, detecting a large target to our front... Signal identified as... Tester-α.
Yeah, uh, sis... might be best if you'd keep quiet...
Well, well, it seems we have guests... I was expecting to see the Azur Lane, though.
Are you the "Creator" Akagi spoke of?!
Ahaha, I am no Creator. My kin and I are simply here to offer humanity, as well as your kind, a choice.
Either join us and sacrifice the present in the search for evolution, preventing a future of certain doom...
Or reject change and proceed down the path of annihilation, like you have before.
Sorry, we're not interested in cooperating with the likes of you. Go back to whatever abyss you crawled out of!
We learned much about you from your time in the Sanctuary. Indeed, we have already gathered a lot of fascinating data.
But unfortunately for you, your current selves have yet to exceed our Simulations' output.
Your cuboid souls were shaped by thousands upon thousands of simulations. That is the core of your existence...
Your steadfast "soul" brims with confidence, driving you to reject what you perceive as "evil." Yet you lack the capacity to understand your true nature...
All you do is spout a bunch of nonsense... If it's a fight you're looking for, then just say it! When I'm done with you, maybe you'll learn to stay home next time!
Ahaha... Well, we don't have guests here every day, so I suppose it's time we conduct another experiment.
Come! Show me what you're worth!
Nnh... This isn't... looking good...
Have you had enough? This overwhelming power is the fruit that Evolution bears... Now surrender yourselves, so we can end this charade.
Those unusual planes... They must be 10, no, 100 times stronger than ours...
What's more, nearly all our planes have been destroyed... We'll need the firepower of a battleship to penetrate this Siren's armor...
... Zuikaku, turn your back and run. I'll keep the Siren occupied. At least one of us must make it out of here...
Didn't you hear me when I said I'm not gonna abandon anybody?
I'll stay with you and fight to the very end...!
Well said! Never retreat, never surrender - that is the tenet of the Sakura Empire!
It warms my heart to hear those words in this day and age... I see that the fleet has been entrusted to capable hands!
We made it just in time. And we have Shoukaku's scout planes to thank for it.
"Scout planes" is what they call those mechanical birds in the sky? ... My word, how the times have changed, ahahaha!
... Isn't that...?
Wait, that flag...
Is that who I think it is?!
The former flagship of the Combined Fleet, the War God herself!
<size=52.5>It's Mikasa!</size>
Now, my juniors, show me the valor of the Sakura Empire! The true battle has only just begun!
Unto the righteous that pray, Heaven shall grant righteous aid!
Our actions here, guided by our beliefs and devotion, shall lead us into the future!
My sistren! The fate of our nation depends on this battle!
The clear skies and roaring seas stretch as far as the eye can see...
I am Mikasa, the flagship of the Combined Fleet, forged anew!
Brace yourself, Siren!
*WARNING: DAMAGE LEVELS CRITICAL. CONTROL SYSTEMS DESTROYED.*
What...?! The Simulations said nothing of this!
How could an ancient, outdated battleship do this to me?!
A cannon that lands its every shot fights on even ground against a hundred cannons that only land one-hundredths of theirs.
The difference in firepower between us is not the decisive factor!
Fascinating... A miscalculation has reared itself. I'll forgive you for now and take my leave.
I've prepared an escape route for you.
If you hope to change history, then go ahead and try.
However, there is one thing you should remember: we are always watching you... Ahaha!
Wait! Get back here!
No, Zuikaku! There's no point in pursuing her!
Hahaha! You would do well to listen to her, unless you're that eager to throw away the life I just spared.
Oh, and next time, make a reservation before coming here, will you? Bye-bye, little ones~
So it seems our old friend has returned.
The... War God of the Combined Fleet? Her persistence knows no bounds.
But regardless... we can't allow them to have the Creator.
If the Sakura Empire manages to get their hands on that power...
L-listen, everyone! A person with an incredible air of grandeur has just shown up in the harbor!
An air of grandeur...? Wh-what does that mean?
It means... Well, it basically means they're a grandiose person! She's a veteran from the war!
Oooh! I don't really get the hype, but I know what grandiose means!
Old news! Ayanami told me about that ages ago!
I heard all the cruisers and battleships are already on their way to meet her, but... is she seriously that big of a deal?
Of course she is! She was the Combined Fleet's flagship during the first war! She's amazing, and I want to take a photo with her!
Ehehe... This smells like a good business opportunity...
Is she the reason why the canteen closed early?! That's animal cruelty! I'm starving here!
Hmm, I see! But I thought most who fought in the war went off somewhere, never to be seen again...
Don't you think it's strange that she's come here all of a sudden...?
Zzzzzzz...
Well, if you're not coming with me, so be it! I'll head to the harbor on my own!
Port - Docking Area
Ohh! What magnificence!
Located in a strategic position, equipped with every facility one could desire, and stockpiled with supplies and items of all manner...
Mhm. It has everything a naval port should have.
As a naval port, specifically?
Indeed. Back in my day, I made many visits to naval and civilian ports alike, you see... That aside, I must say, there are many things unfamiliar to me in this new age...
Especially these soaring... what did you call them, "ear-playings"?
You mean... airplanes, I believe?
Yes, compared to your time in service, airplanes are much more pivotal to controlling the flow of combat than cannons. Like in the battle the other day...
Hah, you don't need to be so demure. I may be behind on the times, but there's no need to worry so much about me! Here, cheer up!
I'll admit, I could feel my age in our battle with that "Siren" individual.
But the thrill of battle hasn't changed after all this time.
The chills from your enemy's murderous intent, the smell of gunpowder, the heat of a salvo, the shriek of clashing metal...
All these things have stayed just the same.
You really live up to your name as a veteran... I deeply admire you, Mikasa!
N-now, now... There's no need for excessive praise. I, and all the others of my time, merely did what was necessary of us.
If anything, it is you young ones who deserve praise. Your valiant effort during that battle was truly astounding.
Um, I have a question, if you don't mind! I'd like to know how I can become as strong as you, Mikasa!
You're quite the straightforward one... Very well. There is one critical thing that you are missing, that has nothing to do with your armaments.
Something indispensable to ultimately achieving victory.
"Ultimate victory"...! You know of a secret, special training method? If it isn't about our equipment, then I assume it has to be something like-
Nay. You may be ill-disposed to understand it, but, if you ask an old-timer battleship like me...
What truly determines who emerges victorious in a battle is not equipment, tactics, or logistics.
The thing that it ultimately comes down to... is the strength of your convictions.

Sadly, Haruna wasn't able to help, but I'm pleased to present to you this banquet's buffet, made by yours truly. Everyone, please rest your weary bones from the battle and enjoy yourselves to your heart's content~
I thought you'd feel out of place in a party like this, Mikasa.
Ahahah! I have no distaste for fine wine, gourmet food, and partying. The celebration after the Battle of Tsushima lasted 3 days and nights!
Maybe it's just me... but I'm struggling to imagine how you'd look when partying...
Do you really take me for such a stuffy person? No matter... What do you think of Hiei's banquets, Zuikaku?
Of course I love them! If I didn't, then I wouldn't show up to training when- Oh, I'm referring to training in my free time, not regular training!
So you train in your spare time... It's good to see how many hard workers there are here.
It does. Although some of us work TOO hard... Still, with the Sirens as our enemy, we need to wager all we have!
Wager all you have... Zuikaku, what is the dearest, most important thing you want to protect at any cost?
The most important thing to me? Umm... There are a lot of things... Like Shoukaku, my friends... or a victory against the Grey Ghost. It's hard to choose just one... I don't think I even can.
Then let me rephrase my question. I don't doubt that you would wager everything to be victorious, but what is that "everything" to you?
In the moment you exclaim, "I will fight for this world," is there a force welling up from within your heart?
And when you feel hopeless or in despair, is your "everything" not "the fate of humanity and the world," but rather your friends, rivals, and celebratory moments like this banquet?
To discard that "everything" is to disavow yourself of your being. And those who reject their very being cannot hope to ever overcome their limits.
... Not to interrupt your conversation, but the dance is starting soon.
Ah, I lost track of time... Now, I need a dance partner... Zuikaku, would you oblige me?
M-me?! B-but I'm not a good dancer...
You needn't be so coy! Come! I won't be angry at you even if you step on my toes during the more difficult parts.
Mikasa, I wanted to thank you for yesterday. Admittedly, there were a few things you mentioned I didn't quite understand...
In that case, why don't we have a friendly duel?
A duel... with you?
With whom else? Rigorous training builds character. You might even learn a thing or two.
Okay! I'll try not to hold myself back! Say, the exercise area is vacant right now, so how about we go there right now?
We could just as well do it here... but very well. Let's head over then. Oh, Zuikaku, before I forget...
(She said dancing isn't her forte, but she didn't step on my toes at any point during the dance...)
A short while later...
Come on, Zuikaku! Where'd your vigor from the battle with the Siren go?
Your attacks are all too stilted! With but one glance, I can predict where you're aiming!
So I really don't stand a chance against you after all...
What hogwash! You aren't fighting me earnestly!
... There's nothing wrong with my equipment, so why... Why do I struggle against you?
Your wit still fails you, I see. Compared to when you fight the Sirens or Enterprise, there is a decisive difference in how you approach a battle with me.
You are afraid to injure me, thus all your attacks are muddled by hesitation.
Some simply overthink war, and then there's the other side of the coin - you. Once on the battlefield, focus only on the battle!
That's easier said than done...!
I understand your anxiety. However, if you cannot even choose your own path, then nobody else will be able to help you.
It is your decision if you wish to stay in my shadow. But if you pledge to "wager everything," then commit to seeing it through!
Commit to it... I understand now. Mikasa, would you please have another duel with me someday?
Absolutely. My guidance shall serve as a stepping stone.
But, do not rely on me as a crutch. Afterwards, you must move forward through your own strength.
Phew... here we are.
What is this flag for...?
This flag once led me to victory.
And with it, you too will surely find your own path to victory.
Dishearten the enemy with your dignity, bolster your shortcomings with your courage, and seize victory in the very end with your conviction and willpower.
Miracles have never existed; not in my time, and certainly not now. Miraculous victories, however, do exist. And now, I leave my flag, as well as my conviction, in your hands!

sequence:
Mikasa's Model Museum

<size=45>Chapter 1: A Collection Destroyed</size>

scripts.say: One day, at the port...
Wow... So this is the legendary...
Mikasa's model collection!
Mhm! I've been wanting to show it off for a while. But the thought of it going public makes me a little hesitant...
However, I have finally overcome all that! Step up! Have a look-see! Feast your eyes upon the collection I poured my blood, sweat, and tears into!
Make sure you look at the finer details! See that painstakingly restored gun turret? How about the features on that bridge?
This is incredible! Who knew Mikasa was collecting all these model ships?
Seeing a model of myself is a little embarrassing though...
She's even got models of our esteemed seeeniors from the First Carrier Division~
Just looking at them gives me the urge to scoop them up and do... "something." Hehehe~♪
Erm, Shoukaku...?
Mikasa, your collection is quite impressive... (whispering) I would love to throw a party in this room...
Hiei, do you mean...
Haha! Gather 'round now, kids! I'll give you a little tour. See, these here are your ships that were forged in the crucible of war, and these over here are your standard aircraft carriers...
Mu-Mutsuki, let go...
Hurry, Kisaragi, c'mere! She's got models of us Mutsuki-class ships~
Wooooww! Miss Mikasa... she's so cool~
Hehehe, the little Mutsukis are here! Have a look around. But watch your feet and don't trip.
I almost forgot, my little collection room here still has its alarms all wired up. So everybody be careful about what you touch. Don't put your hands all over everything!
Huh? What's that?
Aaaahhh! Mu-Mutsuki, don't push it... That button says "Danger, do not push"...
Unnnfff... Uughhhh... It's so high. Huh? "Do... not push"?
Hm... They have to know that only makes people want to push it... I'm gonna push it!
A heavy rumbling sound echoed throughout the room as the floor began to shake violently.
Oh no. That sound... it's the self-destruct system?!
Wh-why does your collection have a self-destruct system?!
For... well... you need to be prepared, just in case...
Look out, Mikasa!
Aaaagh!
With another loud rumble, the entire collection room began to crumble.
Her collection... it's been reduced to a pile of rubble...
But... but why...? Waaaahhhh!
My pride and joy... All my models of the sweet little kids... They're all... Waaahhhh!
Hey now, Mikasa! Pull yourself together!
She's right. Now isn't the time for a breakdown. Let's think about how to fix this...
Now now, Mutsuki and Kisaragi, we don't need you crying either. Zuikaku, you go get help. We have a lot to do here.
Good idea, Shoukaku! I'm on my way!
Mikasa spent the entire day completely inconsolable.
When Zuikaku brought news of what had happened to the other Sakura ships, they all came together for the common purpose of restoring their former flagship's collection to its former glory.

sequence:
Mikasa's Model Museum

<size=45>Chapter 2: The Patient Veteran</size>

scripts.say: How could this have happened?
My whole collection, gone in the blink of an eye. Waaaahh! And now I've got nothing to show the kids.
Hey... you over there... Mutsuki, right?
Ummm... I did... something bad.
I'm so sorry, Miss Mikasaaa! Waaaahhh... I'm sorry I'm such a bad girl! Waaaaaahhhhh!
Oy... It's okay, now. Settle down. No more crying, Mutsuki. There there... show me a smile. Smile for a candy~ Coochee coochee coo!
That tickles! Ahahaha... it tickles!
But, Miss Mikasa, you really... You're not mad at me?
What's done is done. Getting mad wouldn't help.
Um... since I did something bad... I have to find some way to help fix it!
Unnnff... Nnngg... I just have to move this... over there!
Oh my, look at you, Mutsuki!
Hey, be careful! That box is going to fall!
Don't worry... I'm good at transport missions!
Before long, Mutsuki had made it across the port.
I'm here to help!
You're so enthusiastic. Our little Mutsuki is growing up.
I have to cheer Mikasa up!
You'll get there. Now open your mouth! I think someone's earned a candy.
Oooh! Orange flavor! I love it!
But I still have a lot of work to do...
The next day...
Um... Mutsuki, you don't have to walk so fast.
Wow! Mutsuki's really pushing it today.
W... wait up. *Pant*... *pant*... so fast...
Come on! Everybody pitch in and help me move these!
Candy! Candy! Everyone who helps gets a piece of Miss Mikasa's candy!
Wow~ Mutsuki actually shared her candy with us...
Let's do our best, everyone! We'll fix up the model museum as soon as we can!
Okaaaay!
And so began the Mutsukis' monumental task.

sequence:
Mikasa's Model Museum

<size=45>Chapter 3: The Hardworking Kids</size>

scripts.say: With everyone pitching in, little by little, the room was starting to come together. Even Mikasa's model ships were slowly being rebuilt.
At the same time, more volunteers from the Sakura Empire were showing up to help out.
No repair operation is complete without Akashi, nya!
The situation is clear... we should offer our assistance.
You just let Akashi handle the material procurement, nya! Then send the bill to the Commander, nya!
Everyone certainly seems to be in high spirits.
Unnnfff! Nnnng! Almost there! Kisaragi, pass me the brush. I need it up here.
Oh... Okay!
Hey! Mutsuki, Kisaragi, you two be careful!
We're here to help too!
I learned a little bit about model building from L.I... It's time to put those skills to use...
Models, huh...? Sounds interesting...
We're here! I hope we're not too late?
We made lunch for everyone~ Tada~! Come and help yourselves~!
Oh! Right on time. I was just getting hungry.
Now now, Zuikaku, let's not be greedy.
But you do have a point. We should take a break right about now.
Ooooh! Yamashiro! Yamashiro! Did you bring any candy?
Mutsuki, you can't eat candy for lunch...
Not far off, Mikasa watched the youngsters working hard on the ruins of her collection with a proud smile on her face...
I was sad to see my model ships destroyed... But I'm also glad I got to see the Sakura girls come together like this.
All that work I put in certainly didn't go to waste. Thanks to these kids...

sequence:
Mikasa's Model Museum

<size=45>Chapter 4: The Model Museum Reopens!</size>

scripts.say: Wow... So this is the legendary...
Mikasa's model collection (reborn)!
Mhm! The model ships, the whole room actually, it's all good as new! A fully upgraded museum ready to share with everyone in the port~
I can't believe how quickly it all came together... I think we should scale up tonight's celebration too!
The glass here is so shiny... It's hurting my eyes...
Thanks for pitching in, everyone. I never thought I'd have my collection back so soon. *Sniff*...
Huh? Why are you crying, Miss Mikasa...?
Tears of joy, little one.
I'm sorry... Mutsuki won't press random buttons anymore...
I promise Mutsuki will be a good girl from now on. I won't touch anything.
Uh-huh. That's a good girl, Mutsuki.
All right, listen up! The glory days of the past are behind us, but today is about striving together for a glorious future!
<size=27>(Whispering) This button opens the curtain over the door. Just press it and the curtain goes up...</size>
Now to officially unveil the new museum... Here goes!
Rumble rumble rumble...
Um... why did the room start shaking when you pushed that button?
Oh no... is everything going to break again?
What? This isn't the curtain switch?
Hey, something just came out of the room.
It's... a new display case?
Sitting proudly inside the brand new display case was...
That's... a model ship? Oh! That's a model of Mikasa!
Huh? Turns out it was my secret collectible button?!
Who could've known... How could I have pressed the wrong button...
I didn't want anyone to see my model ship...
I can't believe I've embarrassed myself like this in front of the kids... is this what they call "exhibitionism"?!
Mikasa, who taught you that word...?
Wooooowww! Mikasa's model is so coooool!
Ahaha! I never thought I'd get to see Mikasa turn so red~
And that's the story of how the all-new Mikasa Museum had its grand opening, nya! Congratulations all around, nya~

And so that story draws to a close. The girls of the Sakura Empire and Mikasa carried on with their daily lives at the port, the same as always. That is, except for a certain Commander, who suddenly received a shockingly large bill of expenses.

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 1 - A Kotatsu in the Winter</size>

scripts.say: Phew... there's nothing quite like a warm kotatsu during the winter...
Ahh... I don't want to ever get out...
My, my, is that how you should be acting?
Ehh? But Fusou, you look pretty cozy too...
Umm... *cough*
It's not like I have a choice... it's way too cold this year...
We're going to get all chubby at this rate. Even if it's cold, we're going to need to get some exercise.
Ehh? In this weather? What kind of stuff is there to do?
Hmm... how about cold-water freediving? We'd also be able to show some guts in the process. Heehee~
Jeez, Fusou, don't even make jokes about that... just thinking about it is making me cold...

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Cold-Water Swim Meet?</size>

scripts.say: Aah... Aachoo!
Ughh... I knew it'd be freezing outside... Huh? Who's that...?
Yo, if it isn't Yamashiro! Are you out for a stroll?
Umm... not quite... I'm just on my way to the store... Brrr...
A poor showing, Yamashiro! How could a battleship of the Sakura Empire allow herself to be bested by a little cold?
Ise, Hyuuga... you two aren't cold...?
Heh. All you need is a little guts, and the cold won't be an issue at all!
As a matter of fact, we're organizing a cold-water swim meet. Heheh, we're also going to grab those Eagle Union blokes and let them see what the Sakura Empire is made of!
How 'bout it, Yamashiro? Want to join?
Eep... I, um, I think I'm good... achoo!!

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 3 - A Lost Gift Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Cold-water swim meet, huh... That reminds me, I had to do a purification ritual like that last New Year's...
I suppose... I have been a bit lazy recently...
Milord did give me a swimsuit for the summer...
If I remember correctly, it should be over here...
Huh? It's not here...?

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 4 - A Lost Gift Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: Uuuuu... just where could it be...?
Hm? Yamashiro, are you looking for something? This place is a mess.
Fusou, I can't... find the swimsuit... that Milord gave me... waaah!
Oh, you... Didn't you keep it in a separate place because it was a special gift that you received from Commander?
See? It's right here.
Yay! Thank you so much, Fusou... Uuu...
Why are you looking for your swimsuit all of a sudden? Don't tell me...
You're actually going to join that cold-water swim meet?
Mm... I ran into Hyuuga outside. It made me realize that as a member of the Sakura Fleet, I can't afford to fall behind...
My, aren't you the hard worker~
We don't get an opportunity like this often, so why not ask Commander to participate as well?
D-Don't tease me like that, Fusou...! Besides, there's no way Milord will have time to spare, with all the work...

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Invitation</size>

scripts.say: M-Milord!
Hmm?
L-Let's go swimming together!
What...?!
Actually, umm...
So that's why... we should all participate together! No guts, no glory!
Y-you don't wanna? I even took out the swimsuit that you gave me, Milord...
*nods* ...!
Really?! Ehehe... In that case, let's go check on Hyuuga and the others!

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 6 - No Guts, No Glory!</size>

scripts.say: H-h-h-h-h-how's that?! Don't underestimate the S-Sakura Fleet!
S-See? A-A-A-All you n-n-need is g-guts and w-winter doesn't stand a ch-chance!
Nooooooo! M-Miss Saratoga! N-N-Next time, I won't lose to you again!
Ah... Achoo!! Wh-why did I agree to participate in this meet in this first place...? It's practically hazing!!
You seem... pretty cold...
M-Maybe we should find some other kind of training...? This doesn't seem very healthy. Don't you agree, Milord?
*nods*

sequence:
Winter Offensive

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Hot Springs Offensive!</size>

scripts.say: Fwaahh... I can feel my hitpoints recovering~!
Heehee, nothing beats a soak in the hot springs during the winter!
But what about training?
T-training? Can't that wait 'til summer...?
Milord, perhaps you don't like being in the hot springs with me?
That's not it!!
Ehehe... Did you know? I've always treasured that swimsuit that you bought for me~
We've had to endure a whole lot of hardships up until now, and surely... more will await us in the future...
But as long as we're all together, we can accomplish anything!
That's right!
So... please continue to guide us forward, Milord~!

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 1: Preparations Done, Nya!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Kitchen
Uunya... I'm finally done with the preparations, nya! I was afraid I wasn't going to be able to make it to the banquet, nya!
I'm wiped, nya... It's not easy setting up an event for everyone here at port, nya...
That should be obvious... Anyway, you should get down from there before you get your new clothes dirty.
Don't wannya, I'm gonna sit here for a bit longer. It's clean over here, nya.
I see that you two are working hard.
Thanks for staffing the kitchen, Hiei. Tonight's ingredients should have all arrived by now, nya.
Indeed. I appreciate it.
But is it fine for you to not help out at the main banquet, nya? Hosting is your specialty, isn't it?
A banquet's success isn't solely determined by its glitz or glamor. The hard work behind the scenes is far more important.
For me, being able to put in this kind of work is the essence of being a good host.
You have a point... We're only able to have extravagant events like this because of everyone's hard work...
The festival is so much fun, nya! I went to Lexington and Sara's concert, and also bought some new clothes, nya!
You're as energetic as ever... Well, I even entered that cooking contest. Heheh, it was more memorable than I first thought.
Nuinui, you can cook, nya?!
She was very close to advancing to the finals, but she lost to Matsukaze's home-style cooking in the semifinals...
Matsukaze's motherly meals were truly tremendous... I stood no chance...
Hehe, I was one of the judges for the match. It was an amazing round.
Nowhere else except in this fleet would you be able to see so many various cuisines placed together side-to-side.
Before you ask, you're not mooching a free meal off of me.
Why, nya?! What are friends for, nya?!
You cheapscat! Get your paws off me! Let go!
Fine, fine, have it your way! Just this time, I'll bring you something.
That's more like it, nya!
Hehe~ I'm glad you two get along so well.
But... Shiranui made an important point. We're only able to celebrate like this because of everyone's hard work.
That's right. Even now, there's still someone buried in work...
Oh my. Shiranui, are you worried about Commander?
... As if. I just hope that Commander doesn't forget about the banquet due to having too much work.
Hehe. I'm sure everyone knows just how hard Commander is working. We can all see the lights of the office glowing through the night.
We just need to do our part so that everyone can have a good time at the banquet.
That's right, nya~ I've had enough of a break, so I'm off to the banquet, nya!
I'm not a fan of crowded places, so I'll help out from here.
Hehe~ Your help is much appreciated~

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Little Chat Outside the Office</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outside the Office
Hum dee dum~ hum de dum~♪
Heading to the banquet~ in some cute new clothes~ with Milord~♪
Ehehe, I wonder if Milord will be surprised when seeing my new outfit~
... But I never wear Western-style clothes... I hope I don't look weird...
Oh my, if it isn't Yamashiro. I could hear your voice from far away.
M-Miss Taihou! D-did you have business with Milord?
Business...? Hardly. I'm just going to sneak into the office.
S-sneak in? Why would you do something like that...?
Because my beloved Commander is hard at work. It would be unbecoming of me to interrupt.
In any case, that's why I'm out here. I'm just having a little something to drink while waiting for Commander to accompany me to the banquet.
I see...
But, um, Miss Taihou seems a bit different from usual today.
Like, a lot more calm...?
Are you saying that I'm not calm normally?
I-I didn't mean it like that! It's just, how do I put it... Miss Taihou sometimes feels hard to approach... not as bad as Akagi, but... Eek!
Heehee~♪ You don't need to be so nervous. I was just messing with you.
Anyways... Tonight might be a bit special.
I feel like I'm willing to overlook a lot more things than usual.
I can't tell if I can totally relate to that or not at all...
But what I do know is that Milord has been hard at work all this time. I want to be able to get Milord to relax...
That's why I'd like to invite Milord to the banquet!
Ahaha, I see now.
Oh, um, by the way... Miss Taihou, even though you just joined the fleet, you already have your dress... and it's so beautiful too...
I've been planning for this moment for a long time, after all. That is, for Commander to take me to the banquet.
Wow! I just wanted to play with Milord a bit. I never was good with the planning stuff...
But, it'd be a shame to not go to the banquet after going through all that trouble to find a dress...
The only thing that matters to me is Commander. Other things aren't of any concern to me.
Or rather, that's what I thought at first... Honestly, this fleet... feels like home.
Ehehe~ It's a home made by Milord, after all!
Yamashiro, did you go to any events?
Me? Um, I suppose I've been helping Fusou this whole time... Oh, and I went on a test of courage with some of the destroyers...
That was so scary... I'm getting the shakes just thinking about it...
Hehe, sounds like you had a good time. I'll have to join in myself the next time around.
But by the looks of things, Commander won't be done for a while...
Yamashiro, care for a drink?
Um, sake?! Fusou said it'd be best for me not to drink... but I've always been a little curious!
Hehe. This stuff isn't very strong, so you should be fine...
Here, come sit next to me. Until Commander is finished with work, let's have some girl's talk.

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 3: Cleveland Enters!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outside the Gymnasium
Ugh... Should I go in or not...
I know that I caved and agreed to wear men's attire, but I'm not sure I have the heart to go in...
Why the heck do I have to wear a suit anyway when everyone else is wearing a pretty dress...
... But I have to admit, this is way more comfortable...
No no, it's definitely weird that I'm the only one wearing a suit...
But man, they really went all-out with this party... From the outside, you can't even tell that this place is a gymnasium anymore...
Well, in any case, since I'm already here, it wouldn't make sense to turn around and change back...
It's just a coincidence that I look good in men's attire. It's just a coincidence that I look good in men's attire. It's just a coincidence that I look good in men's attire.
All right!
One, two three!
It's... magnificent!
I knew it'd be a big deal, but this is beyond my wildest expectations...
Victorious, I'll entrust that to you~
Oh my, Cleveland? You look just as dashing as everyone was saying~
Ahaha... Your dress definitely lives up to your name, Illustrious.
Good evening nya, Cleveland!
Good evening, Miss Cleveland.
Hello, you two!
Unicorn, Hiei asked me to make sure all the guests are taken care of, so I have to make a few more rounds. Will you be fine by yourself?
Mm... Unicorn will be a good girl and wait here for Big Brother...
Hehe... Unicorn, you're sticking to Commander as always.
Anyway... Akashi, can I leave Unicorn with you?
You betcha, nya!
Mm! Illustrious, Cleveland, bye-bye!
Huh? Isn't that Enterprise over there? She seems to be in a good mood, so that means Essex is probably here too.
That's true. Essex is an excellent mentee, after all, so she's been in high spirits for a while.
Cleveland, are you enjoying the banquet so far?
Hmm... It's so glamorous that I feel out of place...
But seeing so many friendly faces puts me at ease. I think I'll be fine.
Hehe~ I'm glad to hear that.
For the time being, I need to continue making rounds, since the ball will begin when Commander gets here. You might have a pretty busy night ahead of you, Cleveland~
Ahaha... Don't make fun of me like that. You know, I want to dance with Commander too...
Ah! Cleve! Over here!
Someone's calling for you. Anyway, I'll be taking my leave now.
Right. See you later.

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 4: The Queen at the Banquet</size>

scripts.say: Port - Banquet Hall
Your Majesty, what are you doing here?
Illustrious? Hmph. I am clearly overseeing this banquet here.
Hehe~ I wonder if Your Majesty finds this banquet to her liking.
Of course! From the design of the venue to the delicacies being served, every facet of this banquet was designed with Royal specifications.
Even though I've become accustomed to this fleet's tastelessness and lack of true gourmet...
I simply had to have an event like this to demonstrate to the commoners what true culture looks like.
Ohohoho!
Nothing is more important than Your Majesty's enjoyment. All the guests are having a good time as well, so this banquet has been a resounding success so far.
Hmph. Of course!
Oh my, are Belfast and Sheffield not here this evening?
I sent those two to the kitchen. We have to make sure nothing falls short of perfection.
Besides, this place is as safe as my very own bedroom. There's nothing to worry about!
... What are you laughing at?!
Hehe~ It's nothing, Your Majesty. I simply had some pleasant thoughts.
Pleasant thoughts? I'd like to hear about them.
... There's nothing special about them. I was just thinking about how this banquet embodies everyone's happiness.
Hmph. You can't fool me, Illustrious! I bet you secretly entered in the swimsuit competition and took first place!
You and your monsterous udders! Hmph! They're blocking my view of the banquet!
Eek! Y-Your Majesty?! Everyone can see us... Please don't squeeze them...
And I swear, I didn't enter. As a matter of fact, I'm a bit insecure about stuff like that...
Well met, Elizabeth. Stop bullying your subordinates and come have a drink with me.
That's Your Majesty, Queen Elizabeth to you! How many times must I repeat myself! Also, this is education, not bullying!
Ahahaha! In that case... Would Your Majesty, Queen Elizabeth deign to partake of some libations with this lowly Mikasa?
Hmph... Good enough...
Illustrious, you may leave now. Continue to carry out your duties.
Yes, Your Majesty.
... I'm glad that Her Majesty has found something that she considers interesting.
Would you look at that? Even a Queen like that still wants to make friends~
... Ajax? You would do well to mind your tone when referring to Her Majesty.
Even with her personality, she is still the Queen. There's nothing wrong with being a little selfish.
I can't tell if your heart is too big or you're just dense... Forget it, I'm content as long as I have my little piggy.
That's just like you, Ajax~
Are you finding the banquet to your liking?
Even though the little piggy is currently buried in papers, I suppose I'm adequately entertained.
That card game that Hermes is playing seemed pretty fun. Enough to kill some time, anyway.
Card game? Oh, that one called Yu-...
Oh my... is someone playing the piano?

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 5: The Pianist of the Banquet Hall</size>

scripts.say: Port - Banquet Hall
... I never expected to be doing something like this.
Wearing a flowing dress, sitting at the piano, about to perform for so many people...
The old me that knew only the sound of battle... would never have imagined a day like this...
It's for the best, though, right?
Aurora, is everything set up for the performance?
Yes, sorry to keep you waiting.
We still have some time left. Want to chat?
That's fine by me. Let's continue where we left off.
I don't regret the part of me that only knows battle. All the unnecessary weight of the world disappears in the heat of battle, after all.
But, we weren't born just to fight...
You're right. We have the freedom to choose our personalities and the things that we want to do.
This is the most important lesson that I've learned since joining the fleet.
It's not just you who has changed. We all meet a bunch of different people, exchange ideas, and become better as a result.
I think you're much more approachable now than you were at first.
... I'll take that as a compliment.
Anyway, I was surprised when you decided to learn how to play the piano!
It was Massachusetts's recommendation. At first, I thought that the elegance of the piano was a poor match for someone as stolid as me...
But I soon realized... that music is able to express so many emotions that I'd never be able to with words.
Joy, anger, sorrow, grief...
For someone like me, who is not good at expressing emotions, music was actually the most suitable fit for me.
After hearing all that, it sounds like you and the piano were an unexpected match made in heaven.
Hard to say...
But, let's move on from the piano... Um, this dress doesn't look weird on me, does it?
It's too different from what I normally wear... I feel like I can't settle down at all...
Hehehe... South Dakota, I don't think you're aware of your own charms yet~
... What?
Don't worry about it. When Commander gets here, you can ask for yourself~
*sigh*...
In any case, it's about time for your performance.
That's right...
South Dakota drew a deep breath...
Now then... let's begin...

sequence:
The Special Banquet

<size=45>Chapter 6: Anniversary Orchestra</size>

scripts.say: Port - Banquet Hall
Phew. Looks like everyone's having a great time at the banquet, which means all the effort we've put in these last few days won't go to waste.
Everyone in the Royal Navy has been working so hard for this... I'm only helping out on the side, but it's been amazing to see everything come together.
Well, we all want Her Majesty to have a good time. We wanted to throw the best banquet possible for everyone, so it wasn't really hard work at all~
But Amazon, you don't look very happy yourself.
Plus, when does our orchestra even get to play?
Ack... So you've noticed...
*sigh*...
The reason is pretty simple. The most important person hasn't shown up yet, and we can't start playing until that person shows up.
Erm... Right, Commander still has yet to arrive...
Good grief... Half of this banquet was prepared for that idiot who still hasn't shown up...
I see... That's unfortunate...
I see... That's unfortunate...
... Though that idiot is unreliable, this fleet has been running smoothly all this time. We might not say it, but I think everyone knows how much we all owe...
Putting in so much work every day, managing all that paperwork, and still having time to spend with all of us...
Without that idiot, we wouldn't even be able to have a celebration like this...
Amazon... you really care about Commander, don't you?
... *Hmph*! As if. It's just some basic human courtesy I'd give to anyone.
(Well, she didn't deny it... Looks like Amazon is willing to open up as long as Commander isn't around~)
So this orchestra was formed just for tonight?
Incorrect! It's almost the other way around - you can't have a proper banquet without live music!
In a sense, you could say that this banquet is a celebration of all of us.
All the work we've put in up to this point is what allows us to proudly celebrate.
But we can't forget that there is someone who is still working harder than any of us, even while we are enjoying ourselves.
So that's why you want Commander to take it easy and relax just for this evening?
That's right. *sigh*... I hope that idiot didn't fall asleep in the office...
We even made a promise... and I had a surprise prepared...
If it takes any longer, I'm going to...
Ahh!
Woah! What's the matter, Fubuki? You surprised me!
I just saw Commander! With Taihou and Yamashiro...
Woah! Yamashiro's face is all flushed! She's wobbling like a top!
Huhh? Well, they're heading this way, right?
Yes!
All right. Fubuki, Aurora, South Dakota, let everyone know that we're ready to go! Let's get back into position!
Just leave it to me!
Listen up, everyone. We're going to give Commander the warmest reception ever!
Let's make some music!

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Tomorrow's Weather Is...</size>

scripts.say: Port - Command Office
It was a day like any other - My secretary ship, Yamashiro, and I were taking care of some work.
