Here's the next document... Woah! It slipped through my fingers again... Um, I'll go pick it up right now... Huh?
Ah! Milord, didn't you ask me to seal this document for you earlier this morning? *pouts* Milord, you've been spacing out a lot recently...
You're not pushing yourself too hard, are you? Fusou is really worried about you...
Right... I did ask you to do that for me...
Pat Yamashiro on the head
Ehehe~ Milord, you're the nicest~
By the way, Milord! Take a look at this! It's super convenient!
With excitement in her voice, Yamashiro pulled out a smartphone.

Technology advances super quickly, doesn't it! Shigure told me that thirty years ago, there weren't even televisions around. She said families had to huddle around radios. After the Sirens attacked, everything has developed so fast!
It's way too fast...? Hmm... I don't really get it, but... I can do a ton of stuff with this, so it's probably fine!
Let's see what tomorrow's weather is like... Um, hit confirm... Okay! See, now I won't even need to leave a memo!
Yamashiro held her smartphone out towards me, showing me the screen.
Remember how you promised that you'd help me clean the shrine last time? Well, tomorrow's a holiday, so I'll be counting on your help!

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 2 - High Pressure? Low Pressure?</size>

scripts.say: In order to help Yamashiro clean the shrine, I left early in the morning to meet her at the port. She was already waiting for me there.
Good morning, Milord! Let's do our best today!
Umm... when did I get here? Um... h-half an hour ago, m-maybe? I didn't want to keep you waiting, in case I got lost...
Yamashiro! ...and Commander, huh... Don't you have the day off? Are you two going on a date or something?
D-Date?! Y-You've got the wrong idea, Shigure! We're just going to clean up the shrine together...!
Hmmm... If it's not a date, you won't mind me lending a hand, would you? Heh heh~ with my tremendous powers, we'll have the place squeaky clean in no time~!
Or... maybe you'd prefer to be alone with Dumb Commander over there, getting kissyfaced~? ----Oww!
Shigure, leave Yamashiro and Commander alone, will you. Good morning, Yamashiro.
Oh, Mogami! Are you taking Shigure shopping?
Yup. Michishio and the others needed some supplies for the dorm. I can't be relying on Mikuma forever for this kind of stuff...
That darn Shiranui raised her prices again recently. And since those two run the only stores here on the base, complaining won't even do you any good...
Is that so? I don't really get it, but leave it to me! The next time I go to buy tech packs, I'll be sure to give her a scolding!
I appreciate it, Yamashiro, but it's fine. Even if you went, you'd probably get bamboozled by her and end up overpaying for stuff again.
Seriously~?!
Haha, you two get along really well, don't you?
Of course! Yamashiro and I are super tight-knit! She's my favorite!
Ehehe, Shigure... Oh, I really should be heading out to the shrine just about now. Let's hang out next time!

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 3 - A Light Breeze</size>

scripts.say: The shrine close to the port...
Fusouuuu, I've come to help~!! ...Uwooahh!
Yamashiro? Watch out...! Phew... how many times have I told you not to run up the stairs?
Sorry, Fusou... Oh! I borrowed Milord for the day, so we've come to help you clean the shrine!
B-Borrowed...?
What does "borrowed" mean? Um, it's because you've agreed to spend the day with me, or something like that!
Shigure said that this was like a date but not really, so... borrowing makes sense!
Anyway, Milord, you made a promise to me before, so that's why I picked the same day off as you!
Well, just having Commander here will be a huge help. Let's give it our all today.
Oh that's what "borrowed" means? ... I don't think I get it, but that's all right...
You know how Yamashiro is... She probably picked up some strange thing someone else said without fully understanding it...
Anyway, Milord, you made a promise to me before, so that's why I picked the same day off as you!
Well, just having Commander here will be a huge help. Let's give it our all today.
Hmm...? You're curious about when this shrine was built...
If I remember correctly, Commander, you had too much work to come here for last year's Hatsumode, right?
Well, this one started as a makeshift for the New Year's celebration while we planned to build another shrine elsewhere, but...

As the number of people from the Sakura Empire increased, we figured that if we were to build a shrine, it should be a place for everyone to make fond memories. That's why the two of us decided to build as nice a shrine as possible.
Easier said than done. An elaborate shrine like this must have been incredibly difficult to build...

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Low Pressure Approaches</size>

scripts.say: Phew... looks like we'll finish early today... Having Commander here was a big help.
Yamashiro, you're more wobbly than usual today... Is everything okay?
I'm fine... but, Milord... Uuu...
Right after we finished cleaning the exterior, we went to my room to take a break...
I already divined your fortune for the day, and it's not that bad... Maybe you were a bit careless, or simply too nervous.
You're not hurt or anything, so you'll be able to get over it. It'd be best not to cause Commander any problems, though.
I'm no stranger to her clumsiness, but this was my first time seeing it this bad.
M-Milord, p-please don't look inside the drawer! ...Awawa!
Milord, please hold the ladder for me, I need to clean up there! Eeek, from behind?! Uwoaaahh?!
Uuu... a furniture coin fell behind the dresser... Uuu.... can't reach it... M-Milord?! D-don't look in there! Awawawa?!
All right, I'm going to head back to the dorm now. Yamashiro, how about you and Commander?
Um... there's still something I want to do, so I'll head back later! Milord, can you keep me company for a little longer?
*nods*
Yay! Milord, please wait a moment!

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 5 - After the Clouds Part</size>

scripts.say: Shortly afterward...
Sorry to keep you waiting, Milord! *cough*!
I wanted to show you the special dance that I talked about before!
Um, to tell you the truth, I've been secretly learning this dance from Fusou! I haven't shown anyone yet, so I have no idea if it looks weird or not...
Therefore, I'd like you to be the first person to see! Um... a shrine maiden's dance has to be performed in the right place after all.
Since we just cleaned the interior, let's head back outside...
Ding! Ding!
The Kagura bells began to ring---
Though her movements were unrefined, it was clear how much hard work and dedication she had put in.
Ding! Ding!
The Kagura bells rang out again---
Though she's always stumbling around, she's giving off such a spiritual, divine aura.
Ding! Ding! Pitter... Patter...
Huh...?
The ringing of bells... was soon joined by the sound of rain.
W-woahhhh!
Grab Yamashiro and run inside
Milord? Ah... alright! Let's avoid getting soaked first!

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Rain Shower</size>

scripts.say: Fwahhh... I'm all wet now... Milord, here's a towel for you!
Yamashiro handed me a dry towel while drying her hair with her own towel.
Fusou always told me to come prepared in case it suddenly started raining. I guess it came in handy today...
Umm... something to change into, something to change into... Here it is! Give me just a-
Uuu... Milord, you're also here... I-I'm sorry...
Milord? It's still raining outside!
Um, umm... C-come back here, it's fine, really...
All right, Milord! You can turn around now!
Sorry, I only have enough clothes for myself... but there are still fresh towels...
It's a shame that I couldn't finish my dance, though...
I sat next to Yamashiro and quietly ruffled her hair
Ehehe... why does it mean so much to me? Mm, I suppose I haven't told you before?

The first reason is that I want to ease some of my sister's burdens and responsibilities. The second reason is because, well, you know how Fusou and I have bad luck? Akashi said that it might be because people call us "unlucky ships."
But I think that... as ships, even if we had an unlucky service history, we can't forget about the lives and effort of the people involved...
So, we should work hard to become happy and fortunate, to repay all those people for giving us this life...
And with that, the rain began to pass.

sequence:
After the Rain Comes the Sun

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Blue Skies</size>

scripts.say: Yamashiro! Commander! Are you two alright?
Oh my...! Heehee~
Fusou!
Hmm, since it started raining before the two of you got back, I came to bring you some umbrellas...
But it looks like we won't need these anymore~♪
Jeez, Fusou! But, thank you...
Hm? Look over there... it's a rainbow! Fusou, Milord, look, a rainbow!
Yamashiro took my hand and pulled me outside---
Above the gates of the shrine that these two sisters had painstakingly built sat a small rainbow.
Milord, there's something I forgot to tell you earlier.
Right now, I feel like the luckiest girl in the world!
Because right here, I can be with my sister, my friends, and the person I love the most!
With that, Yamashiro turned towards me and ---
*mwah~*
I felt her soft lips press against my cheek.
That's why... today, tomorrow, there will be nothing but blue skies!
Right, Milord~♪

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Spring Springs Forth</size>

scripts.say: *Whew*... It feels like it's gotten hot much earlier than last year...
It certainly does! Soon it will be spring.
The seasons go by quick...
They certainly do! Would you like a cup of tea?
Yes, please... Wait, Houshou?! How long have you been here...?
This is where you went, Houshou?! You must've mastered the art of masking your presence!
Ah, sis, Houshou here gave me a hand with making this tea just earlier!
I see, so she was helping you... Thanks, Houshou.
There's no need to thank me, I'm just glad to help~
Oh yeah, since spring is around the corner, the cherry trees should start blooming soon...
It's that time of year...
Then why don't we have a Flower Festival so we can watch them bloom together?
Nothing embodies the beauty of spring better than the blooming cherry tree, after all~
That sounds like a great idea! I think we should do it!
I mean, sure, but... why does the idea of a Flower Festival excite you so much, Hiryuu?
Why? Because a Flower Festival is a festival for girls! I just have to attend it!
Um... it's not exactly a girls-only festival, though...
If you're in favor of it, then let's do it! Please, allow me to make all the necessary preparations~

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Blooming Beckoning</size>

scripts.say: I'll go out and tell people about the festival, then.
Oh, hi, Shoukaku and Zuikaku. Good timing.
What's up?
It is nice to see you, Souryuu.
Ahaha, sorry for interrupting your stroll... You see, we're having a Flower Festival soon, and I'd like to invite you to come.
A Flower Festival... and we're invited?
Ah yes, spring seems to have come early this year...
It seems there will be some good company and good food as well, courtesy of Houshou.
We would love to come! You can expect to see us there!
Zuikaku... your eagerness to accept offers may come back to haunt you in the future...
I want to... see the flowers... too...
Will there be candy? Because I wanna eat candy!
Now, now... Everyone loves sweets, but didn't I teach you that eating too much of it is bad for you?
Ahaha, Souryuu is like a mother figure to them... That's what I would call "sweet"~

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Preparing for the Party</size>

scripts.say: There... Now, could someone help me with these boxes~?
Sorry for leaving you to do everything alone... But I brought some people who can lend us a hand!
Oh, who might they be...?
Me, for one!
I can probably help you with the food as long as it's not too fancy!
Please allow us to help you out as well.
I'm so excited for the Flower Festival I can hardly wait!
My, it's starting to get crowded in here!
All I did was tell them about the Flower Festival and they all came here to help!
They must have really high expectations of it~
Then, to meet their expectations, I think we should make some gourmet food for all our guests to enjoy~

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 4 - The Banquet Begins</size>

scripts.say: Now then, let the Flower Festival begin!
Woohoo!
We prepared a whole banquet worth of food, so dig in and enjoy yourselves~
Mmm! Sis, you have to try this tempura, it's amazing!
I'm sure it is...
I see! So this "Flower Festival" thing is all about stuffing your face with food!
I'm pretty sure it isn't...
Hum, hum... I've never had melon bread this good before...
Ahh, what a perfectly sunny day... Perfect for a nap, too...
Hey, wait, where's Akatsuki? Wasn't she coming with you, Ikazuchi?
She left a note saying she had embarked on a journey to "find the perfect snack to eat at the Flower Festival"...
Uhh... didn't she leave that note like 3 days ago...?

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Cherry Flowers and Cheery Folks</size>

scripts.say: There really is nothing that embodies spring better than the cherry tree.
And sitting underneath one, surrounded by friends and food... I can't think of anything more enjoyable.
You must've worked hard to make this gathering a reality, Houshou.
Yes, but seeing everyone enjoying themselves makes it all worth it... Hm? Do we have more guests coming?
Looks like this is the place. And looks like everyone's having a good time!
Not to mention all the yummy food they've got~
And the alcohol...
Yes, this is the Flower Festival – a Sakura Empire tradition. You can join us if you'd like.
We certainly would!
I think we can sit over here! Come on!
The smell of sake... beckons me...
Ahaha, how pleasant to see more people join us.

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Sakura Sake</size>

scripts.say: *Glug glug*... Ahh, can't have a Flower Festival without something to drink!
Going straight for the sake, like always, eh... I think I'll have some, too...
Hohoho~! Nothing says elegance like Flower Festival sake!
I suppose this is part of the tradition... Can't say I dislike it.
Drinking sake under a cherry tree waving in the wind feels... surprisingly charming.
Yep, you can't top that Sakura Empire sake... *Buuuurp*...
Oh dear, it seems they're getting busy with their beverages~
Hmm... I hope they don't have too much to drink, or else they might get "shipfaced"~

sequence:
Flower Festival

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Private Time</size>

scripts.say: The banquet was wonderful, but I felt rather lonely when it had ended and everyone went home...
Oh, is that you, Commander? I thought you had already gone to sleep...
Would you like to... see the moonlit cherry trees, together with me?
(Nod)
Ahaha... I see. Then please wait a moment while I get ready.
Oh, my beloved, please allow me to accompany you to see the cherry trees tonight.
(Gulp!)
Do you like my look? ...Does it excite you, Commander?
It is an honor to be admired by you, Commander...
Now then, why don't we enjoy a drink beneath the moonlit cherry trees... my beloved?

sequence: All things in the world are built on balance.
Where there is good, there is evil. Where light shines, darkness festers.
This is a law. An unbreakable principle.
As with everything, however, there are exceptions.
For instance, the Omni-Cube – a supreme treasure capable of bending the rules to grant any wish.

scripts.say: Once every 60 years, the Omni-Cube appears in the world, granting a single wish before vanishing again.
Whenever it arrives, the world's most powerful warriors vie for this supreme treasure fiercely.
Now, the Omni-Cube has appeared again.
After besting countless rivals, seven competitors have made it to destiny's final destination.
These competitors are...

sequence: The Golden Bulin, the inheritor of the golden spirit and commander of her golden mech!

scripts.say: I have the golden spirit on my side and WILL get the Omni-Cube for the sake of world peace, purin!

sequence: The Magic Bulin, who swore to protect love and uphold justice!

scripts.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to protect love and uphold justice, buli!

sequence: The righteous Super Bulin, who flattens all her foes with but one swing of her hammer!

scripts.say: What they said, bulin. I WILL get the Omni-Cube, bulin!

sequence: The Little Knight, the aspiring swordswoman who journeys all by herself!

scripts.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to become a true legend and prove myself worthy of my sword!

sequence: The Iron Claw Demon, the phantom of the sea with two big, meaty claws!

scripts.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to snatch up all the candy in the world!

sequence: The Contingency, an AI alleged to possess intelligence greater than all life put together!

scripts.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to achieve a world ruled by AI!

sequence: The Lord of Evil, the strongest and most villainous villain that always gets back up every time she's knocked down!

scripts.say: Mwahaha! I WILL get the Omni-Cube and conquer the world!

sequence: Number 1: The Golden Bulin
Number 2: The Magic Bulin
Number 3: The Super Bulin
Number 4: The Little Knight
Number 5: Iron Claw Demon
Number 6: The Contingency
Number 7: Lord of Evil
The war between these seven renowned warriors has now begun...

scripts.say: The Golden Bulin, the Magic Bulin, and the Super Bulin...
The three sisters joined forces, gathered all the clues, and together figured out the Omni-Cube's location.
Not only that, they even befriended a little knight during their travels and became close acquaintances.
I've been thinking a lot about what to name my legendary sword.
The Sword of Oaths, the Sword of Victory, the Sword of Benevolence, the Sword of Justice... I haven't decided on which yet, though.
That will have to come at the end of my journey.
You know, what I want is to prove myself. Becoming a proper knight means becoming fit to wield this sword...
That's why I don't need the Omni-Cube.
At the same time, you three have righteous hearts. I'm sure that you'll use it for good.
Don't worry about that, bulin! We've already got a plan, bulin!
Exactly, purin!
Tomorrow is the final battle, purin! We all need to get some good rest, purin!
Right you are, buli!
Also, I made food for us all, buli! It's filled with love and magic, buli! Have your fill before going to bed, buli!
Thank you. What a heartwarming evening this is.
What will you all do after this war is over?
Me – I want to create my own Knights of the Round Table once I've proved my mettle.
Good question, purin...
I'm gonna pierce the heavens with my golden mech, purin!
I'm gonna test the limits of my My Kitty Kabam Hammer, bulin!
I'm gonna keep protecting love and upholding justice, buli!
I see... Good luck to us all, then!

scripts.actorName: Prototype Bulin MKII & Universal Bulin & Specialized Bulin Custom MKIII
scripts.say: - The Justice League will prevail, purin! - The Justice League will prevail, buli! - The Justice League will prevail, bulin!

sequence: Soon, it would be time for the final battle, brimming with friendship and determination...
At last, the day had come for the fated final battle...

scripts.say: An unwavering alliance had formed in opposition to the Justice League, consisting of the trio of the Iron Claw Demon, The Contingency, and the Lord of Evil.
They've teamed up, bulin! This is gonna get tricky, bulin...
Yeah, but it's us four against the three of them, purin!
We have strength in numbers, purin!
Sisters, and our little knight friend – let's work together to beat up the baddie alliance, purin!
Let's show them what they get for being baddies, buli! For love and justice, buli!
Yeah! Let's, bulin! Time to crush the bad guys, bulin!
Alright! All together – charge!
KABOOOM!
This is it for you.
With a thundering roar from her giant dragon, the Iron Claw Demon appeared.
However...
Why are you the only one here?
Uh... Because an ancient rule says that us Injustice League members have to fight you one at a time in order.
But as you can see, this battle is pretty unfair.
How about instead we have a duel, little knight?
Sure. Do you want to duel all of us at once, or each of us simultaneously?
I'm Spee, the elusive Iron Claw Demon. I've seen a million more battles than you. You don't stand a shadow of a chance.
Yeah, but there are four of us, purin!
My companion, Iron Claw Mechadrake, can revive infinitely. It's indestructible. You can't win.
Sure, but there are four of us, bulin!
Heh! Got nothing to say now, buli?
Hope you're ready, you big meanie, buli! Because I'm gonna punish you in the name of love, peace, and justice, buli!
KABOOOM!
Just as Number 5: Iron Claw Demon said, her Mechadrake was able to revive an endless number of times.
However, Number 1: The Golden Bulin fought back with an endless weapon of her own: Her mass-produced Prototype Super Drill MKIIs.
As this never-ending battle unfolded, Number 2: The Magic Bulin and Number 4: The Little Knight seized a momentary opening.
Specy, this is your chance, buli!
We'll hold her back! In the meantime, hit the Iron Claw Demon with your ultimate move!
Bulin-bulin! Shining Starlight SMASH! BULIIIN!
KABOOOM!
Hmm... She sank below the waves – I can't say if she survived or not, bulin!
If you're not sure, it seems safe to assume that she's dead.
Way to go, Specy, purin! You really are the GOAT among bulins, purin!
Let's keep moving, buli! For love, peace, friendship, and justice, buli!
Number 5: Iron Claw Demon, who had sworn to snatch up all the candy in the world, was defeated. Not long after, Number 6: The Contingency, hellbent on conquering the world with AI, joined the fray.
This is it for you.
That's the same as what the last one said...
Hey, Super AI TC, can I ask a question, buli?
What is it?
You and the Lord of Evil both say you wanna conquer the world, buli. Doesn't that make you enemies, buli?
Is it really the Omni-Cube really what you want, buli?
I... What I want is...
Now's our chance, bulin! Hit her with everything while she's distracted, bulin!
KABOOOM!
While Super AI TC struggled to process the question, the bulin sisters and the Little Knight exploited the moment to defeat her army all at once.
Wait...
Yes? Do you have any last words?
I see it now... The answer I've been looking for is... 42...
Bulin? What does that mean, bulin?
It's the answer to the ultimate question... of life, the universe, and everything...
I finally understand now...
With a satisfied smile on her face, Super AI TC faded away in a gust of wind.
Buli...? I'm kinda confused, but we won, buli!
Heheh! Good job, Uny – your wits are unparalleled, purin!

sequence: After weathering several difficult battles, the final obstacle finally appeared before the four girls...

scripts.say: Mwahaha! This is it for you!
We've heard that three times by now...
Ahem... The Omni-Cube is a symbol of power! It doesn't belong in the hands of the weak!
I am the Lord of Evil, and thus better suited for it than any of you! I WILL make the Cube mine, no matter the cost!
Not on our watch! We're going to thwart your evil ambitions right here, right now!
In the name of love, peace, friendship, justice – *breathes in* – and all bulins, I will destroy you, buli!
Hmph! As they say – winners become complacent, and the complacent are bound to lose!
Just 'cause you beat the last two doesn't mean you'll win again!
Face your doom!
KABOOOM!
Ugh... Now I can FINALLY ditch this weird-ass film set.
My troops, I command you! You're going down with me!

sequence: And so, the Lord of Evil and her terrifying army went up in flames and vanished.

scripts.say: Justice always prevails!
The Omni-Cube is ours at last. What shall we wish for? World peace?
No, bulin...
This Cube tempts man and brings war whenever it appears, purin... It's the reason behind all this, purin! It can't keep getting away with it, purin!
For the sake of love, peace, justice, and the future, we need to destroy it rather than make a wish to it, buli!
Help us deal with it, little knight! Purin!
...Of course! Gladly!
In the name of the three bulin sisters – shatter into pieces, buli!

sequence: There was a blinding light, and the Omni-Cube was broken into a million pieces.
The world was returned to peace and calm.
The little knight set out on her journey once more.
The bulin sisters, meanwhile, went back to leading their quiet lives.
Secretly, they waited for that big moment to come...
When they could flex their full might again.
DISCLAIMER
This is a work of fiction based on the fantasies of the bulin sisters.
Any similarity to events, past or future, is merely a coincidence.
No Wisdom Cubes were destroyed during the production of this story.
We hope you enjoyed it.
Operation: Shining Bulin - The End
The seaside, the sand...

scripts.say: It's so sunny today – perfect for having lots of fun at the beach!
I did some research beforehand into the Commander's favorite swimsuits... Little did I think there'd be this many. How mysterious, and quite fascinating.
Finally here? ...Oh, I was just thinking you had forgotten about our promise to go to the beach today, you silly dog.
Nagisa won't let you take pictures? Heheh – as long as you don't ask for anything too crazy, I think she'll let you.
The waves feel so nice... You should come try it too, Commander.

sequence: Warm sunlight, a lovely vacation...

scripts.say: Welcome, Commander. I hope you'll enjoy today's special venue! Here are some chips for you.
Have you come seeking some relaxation, Commander? Considering how hard you work, you certainly need to rest up.
Heh. I've been waiting for you, Commander! Now, now, don't be shy. I'll be making sure you leave fully rested. Hope you're ready♪
Why do you stand there idly? Abandon your hesitance and come here.

sequence: Vacation Island, home to countless memories...
<size=45>Has now welcomed some new guests.</size>

scripts.say: Azure skies, white clouds, and a glittering sea... Heheh. What a wonderful view... Ah, sorry, I got distracted. My name is... Tsukushi.
*sniff sniff*... That smell... Oh? Who are you? The Commander? Hello, hello! I'm Patty.
Greetings. I'm Shizuku... You're wondering about my ears and tail, right? They're, well... Part of my cosplay.
My name is Shandy. Yes, it's my job name, but you don't mind, do you? I wonder what amusing things are going to happen here... Heehee. I can't wait to find out♪
Wassup! Name's Yukino. Let's be buds!
I'm Elise. I've heard the port is planning a vacation beach volleyball tournament. Do you need professional guidance?

sequence: The Venuses from the Venus Islands have come to visit the port once again.
<size=45>Get to know them...</size>
And make this the greatest beach volleyball tournament the port has ever seen!
A few days before the tournament...

scripts.say: Construction at port has been moving at jaw-dropping speeds. In just a few days, the hot springs have been mostly completed.
At first, I was wondering what I'd do if there was no hot spring here...
But it got finished this quickly... I'm really happy... Kon!
Th-then should we just... go ahead inside?
I think so. I trust the port's construction standards, but for important facilities like this one, we should really see it for ourselves.
Let's go.
Excuse me, but the hot spring isn't open to the public yet... Oh, if it isn't our friends from the Venus Islands!
Hi there. You must be... Hwah Jah?
We're here to check on the status of construction here.
Ah, inspecting things ahead of the tournament? Understood. Please wait just a moment.
Harbin, Hai Tien! The supervisors are here to inspect the place!
Hwah Jah and the others show them around the hot spring facility.
To be honest, I'm amazed.
A high-quality hot spring is essential for any tournament, but I never imagined that you all would be so thorough.
Every one here is bursting with their own original qualities... Did every faction in the port help with the construction?
That's right. But I think this was a special exception...
A-an exception? Why's that?
You saw Akashi's raw influence in the shopping district, I'm sure.
Hot springs are no exception, so normally, she'd be given full control of the venture.
But this time, Chen Hai, Huan Ch'ang, and Hai Chou managed to "convince" her to give up control before the final plans were set.
In the end, we settled on this format where every faction participated in the development together.
As that old saying goes, "a green cat stumbles into a meeting of strategic advisors."
Ahem... Of course.
It feels like I'm hearing a lot of things that I shouldn't be hearing...
Hahaha, don't worry about it! Now that we have proper competition, Akashi's been unusually motivated, too.
Through competition, you help each other grow... It's just like beach volleyball.
You've got that right. That's why these hot springs have been developed in a myriad of unique ways, all with their own special charms.
I can't wait until the grand opening.
Well, I look forward to seeing you again when the time comes!

sequence: Two days remain until the tournament...

scripts.say: As this is a major sporting event, the importance of filming it can't be overstated.
As such, Yukino, Shandy, and Tsukushi arrive on a visit to the newly completed camera control center.
Cameras 1 through 17 and 19 through 30 are now online.
Camera 18 is malfunctioning and requires troubleshooting.
The propulsion system of the camera's drone has failed... A replacement drone is currently being dispatched.
The drones for cameras 31 through 50 are ready for launch at any time.
Situation report received. Initiating guidance protocol now.
When the group sets foot into the control center, they're overwhelmed by an ocean of drone traffic.
Whoa... Girls, we're surrounded by drones!
They're having drones film the whole tournament? I-it's just like a scene straight out of manga!
Heehee! I think I'm getting the hang of how things are run around here.
Yukino, Tsukushi, Shandy. Welcome to the Camera Control Center!
Welcome! Welcome to our humble control center!
Hi there! Working hard, everyone?
Not especially. TB and Fargo are doing all the work, really.
Oh, so Fargo was the one getting all of those drones ready! I saw her delivery service in the shopping district.
And that other one is... TB, right?
Correct! That's TB herself, our port's own super AI!
Super AI...
The super-est of super AI!
I mean, we came here to help out, but she's so super that we haven't even had the chance to help!
I-I see... It does make sense for a super AI to handle drone operation.
But since we're here, we have to find SOME way to help!
On that note, we came up with a few proposals for optimizing processes. Would you like to hear them?
O-optimizing...
I wanna hear! Tell us, tell us!
Hehehe, I'll go first. What if we put fireworks launchers on the drones?!
When the tournament gets really exciting, the drones up above launch fireworks all over the place. I think it'll be a striking spectacle!
Oh, my. What a lovely idea.
Yeah... If that happened in the climax of a manga arc, it would really get the blood pumping.
Right? That's what I was thinking!
Now for my proposal: a drone-powered, aerial seating system!
We fast-track production of some really big drones, hang seats from them, and let people watch from up above!
They'd command a great view of the games, and it would help us reduce the footprint of our ground-level seating!
Well... I'll say, it sounds like an impressive sight.
But I can't help but feel like we're losing sight of reality here... I-is that actually feasible?
They've got super AI here. Maybe they can do it?
I'm all for the idea!
My turn, my turn!
So basically, what if we reversed roles? We do an exhibition match where the drones play beach volleyball, and the contestants film them.
That's another fascinating idea.
Drones playing beach volleyball... C-can they do that?
Hmm... I don't know, but like I said, they've got super AI here. Who knows? Maybe they can do it.
I'm all for the idea!
Oh, heya, TB! Do you have any ideas to share?
Negative. I have compiled the proposals and forwarded them to the Commander.
That's our super AI for you! She works fast.
Did you get a response? What does the Commander think?!
Yes.
The Commander has responded as such: "All denied."

scripts.actorName: William D. Porter & Le Téméraire & Z13
scripts.say: Whaaat?! Noooo! Let's come up with three more!

sequence: One day remains until the tournament...

scripts.say: Today, the Vacation Island broadcasting station has begun test streams, bringing cheerful sounds back to Patty's quiet radio.
Hello, ladies and gentlemen, this is CB-2 Guam speaking. Mic check, one, two, three!
I'll be your host throughout this tournament, bringing you live commentary on every riveting match!
We'll be providing both audio and video feeds so that you can feel the action wherever you are!
Tune in and show your support!
My radio is finally playing sound again!
It sounds like the broadcasting station is up and running. I should go and check on things. Would you like to join me?
Yeah, I'll go!
When they enter the broadcasting center, a starry sky seems to hang down from the ceiling above.
Wooow, what a pretty planetarium!
Hehe, today's theme is summer nights.
Hi, I'm Constellation. This woman here is Soobrazitelny, the leader of our technical team.
Hey Comrade, I'm Soobrazitelny! Pleasure to meet you both!
Elise, Patty. Welcome to the tournament broadcasting center.
Can I presume that you're here to see how preparations are proceeding?
Yep. That's part of my job, and Patty came along to take a look around.
Hello hello, Constellation and Soobrazitelny!
You've decorated the place really, really nicely! It really smells of fun here!
Hehe, I'm glad you like it.
Now, Elise... Soobrazitelny would be the person most informed on the state of things here.
While you two talk, I'll take Patty to visit the music team's area for a more personal tour. Does that sound nice?
Great idea. It works for me.
Hooray! Let's go, let's go!
A soft melody plays inside the studio.
I can hear the sea and the waves in this song... It feels like I'm setting sail!
You heard the message woven into the notes? Well, you're right. The name of this track is Setting Sail, in fact.
Welcome to the studio, Patty.
Hehe, the name's Strasbourg. This one here is Marseillaise.
They're not here today, but there are two more girls on our team: Formidable and Ulrich.
We're the ones in charge of broadcasting music during the tournament.
Hello hello! Thank you so much for bringing such wonderful music to Vacation Island!
Hehe, it's our job, after all. Do you like listening to music broadcasts?
Do I? I love it! Listening to the radio is my favorite thing, and I love every joyful song that comes through!
In that case... Strasbourg, what say we give her a sneak peek of the theme song we'll be unveiling tomorrow?
Fine by me. Patty, you in?
Huh? Can I really?! I can't wait!
Alright... The song you're about to listen to is called Vacation Lane - Beachside Brilliance. I hope you enjoy.

sequence: A cheerful melody begins to play.
Patty immerses herself in the imagery it evokes of the sparkling sea.
Thus...
Time flies without their notice.
Very soon, the tournament will officially begin.
Finally...
The day of the beach volleyball tournament has come.

scripts.say: Group Elise is ready and waiting.
Group Shizuku... is ready.
Hehe, we're all ready and raring to go, too.
G-Group Tsukushi is all ready!
Haha, it's finally time for the tournament! Good luck, everyone!
Group Yukino's here to show off our style!
Commander, all 18 teams across the six groups are fully prepared.
All that's left is for you to declare the start of the tournament.
Hold on. Not everyone is here yet.
I look up and gaze into the distance. On the horizon, an airship slowly approaches Vacation Island.
Huh?! Why is an airship coming? I don't remember a performance like that scheduled for the opening ceremony...
Naturally. It's a special surprise I put together for all of you.
TB, get me connected to the airship.
Order received.
Wooow! We're really flying!
Hehe, it looks like a party down there!
Vacation Island... We're back again.
Is it just me, or has this island gotten a lot more extravagant since the last time we were here?
I heard the Commander went all-out doing construction for this tournament... And look at us, we got to be invited as special guests! I can't wait to play!
We guests play a major role in making the tournament shine. The Commander really thought of everything, huh?
I can feel the enthusiasm in the air. It makes me want to play a few matches, myself.
If any of you need anything at all, don't hesitate to ask. I'll come running to help you out right away!
Let's all work together to make this tournament a blast!
With the coming of the airship and Venus Islands guests, the venue's excitement reaches a fever pitch.
I think the time has come.

sequence: <size=45>To our comrades from port...</size>
<size=45>And our friends from the Venus Islands...</size>
<size=45>Together, at Vacation Island...</size>
<size=45>Let's have the time of our lives on this brilliant vacation!</size>
Vacation Lane - Beachside Brilliance – The End

scripts.say: At the Commander's office, the Venuses who had arrived at the port by boat were discussing the plans for the volleyball tournament.
Heheh! So, basically, it's gonna be a vacation event to get the port fired up. Y'know, an "it's not about winning, it's about having fun" kinda deal.
Correct. Beach volleyball in itself is also the perfect stage for us all to showcase our charms.
Then it's the more, the merrier... I think.
Hey, what if we, like... formed as many teams as possible so we could have lots of matches?
No. That would make it too competitive and detract from our core goal of enjoying this vacation.
Speaking of the vacation, how long do we have?
As of now? Either a week or two.
That's actually one of the things I want to discuss today.
I say we go all out and make it two weeks!
Heheh. I agree. The longer the vacation, the more fun things are bound to happen.
Let's decide on two weeks, then.
"After some discussion, the Commander settled on a two-week vacation." Alright, all noted down.
Where will we host the competition? Here, at the port?
Best to do it on Vacation Island, like last time. You can't beat the weather and the beaches there.
The island's infrastructure is getting an upgrade, too. That'll surely make the vacation experience more unique.
Ah, Vacay Island. Tamaki told me loads about it 'fore I got here, and I gotta say, sounded pretty sweet to me!
That's the time and location settled. Let's get back to the topic of teams and matches.
Elise, I'd like to hear your take as a professional in the field.
I was just thinking about that, actually.
Considering the frequency of matches for the period and the number of participants, I believe it'd be best to divide everyone into six groups of three teams each. That's eighteen teams total.
Six groups?
Yes – the six of us should split up and assume the role of group captains, coaching the members of our respective groups.
This, in my view, will make the event more exciting.
I think I get it. You want to divide our skill evenly and introduce an element of unpredictability to the matches, right?
That's my thinking precisely.
Having the pros lead the amateurs... Yeah, good idea! Right, Commander?
For sure. We'll split the teams as you suggested.
Six groups, eighteen teams... That means each of us will need another five group members, right?
Will you assign the remaining five, or...?
Essentially, we're hoping everyone will volunteer, though each captain is free to recruit members directly.
Don't worry, Tsukushi – there's no shortage of girls aching to take part in this competition.
Th-that's good to know.
We could decide on the teams here and now, or after we arrive at Vacation Island. Either way is fine as long as everything's settled before the matches begin.
Do these rules sound good to you, Commander?
Yeah. Sounds perfect.
Here are the notes I took during the meeting, Commander.
Got it. Thanks for the help.
Then if that's everything, I declare this meeting–
Oh, hold up, Commander! I've got a burnin' question!
You, like, gave us these riggings and stuff. We free to use 'em in the competition?
Ah, I almost forgot about those. Helena, add a rule that says using riggings during the matches is prohibited.
Will do.

sequence: Having concluded the meeting, the captains from the Venus Islands got to work at their own paces.
The excitement for the volleyball tournament was growing greater and greater.

scripts.say: Following her map's instructions, Elise arrives outside the Iron Blood dorm.
From what I've gathered, the Iron Blood is known for being rational and meticulous, and it also has many promising athletes.
I think I'll use them as my pool for scouting group members.
Just as Elise is about to enter, a girl walks out the door and speaks to her first.
Hm? You're... Elise, right?
Nice to meetcha. We've all already heard about the volleyball tournament thing.
Let me guess – here to find group members, right?
Well, yes, I'm just wondering...
Ah, I'm Lützow, by the way.
Lützow. It's a pleasure.
Hmm... Your attire, your demeanor, your build... You're the perfect fit.
Would you happen to be interested in playing beach volleyball?
Whuh? I mean, watching it, sure. Actually playing it, though...
Nah, no way. Anything that requires genuine effort on my part to achieve results is asking too much of me.
That being said, scouting the Iron Blood for players is definitely the right call.
I know more than a few of us are absolutely aching to play after hearing about the tournament.
If you'd like, I could help with the talent scouting~
Ah, um... Thank you very much.
You're welcome!
Also, can I ask what your requirements are? Like, uhh... Is anyone good as long as they can run and jump?
In terms of requirements, I'm hoping to find people who...
Elise thoroughly explains her player criteria to Lützow.
I see, I see. You got some pretty high standards, Coach.
That's totally fine, though. I'll find you some quality talent!
With these requirements in mind, rather than show Elise around the dorm, Lützow casually pulls out her smartphone.
Met Elise at the front door... Looking for players...
Requirements are as follows...
One... Two... Three... Four... Five...
Anyone looking to apply, meet me at the hall...
Send to: All friends...
Alright, that's done! Now we just gotta go to the hall and wait.
Yes, ma'am – simply and efficiently – that's how I do it.
A while later, Elise has managed to assemble a full group.
Oh, introductions? I'm Prinz Heinrich, P-class armored ship!
My biggest strength is probablyyy... my indomitable spirit in the face of any difficulty, I guess? Heehee.
I'm Prinz Adalbert, also a P-class armored ship. I'm into sports, especially kickboxing.
Trust me, us P-classes are real fighters. Just a little elbow grease, and we'll even reach the finals.
Magdeburg. M-class light cruiser.
Never played beach volleyball before, but I've read plenty of comics about it!
I am Regensburg, M-class light cruiser.
I possess masterful control of both my giant dragon rigging and my own body.
I'm Z52! Nobody's got me beat when it comes to long-distance running and parkour!
While I'm not allowed to use my Thunderheart rigging in the matches, I'll still give it my all!
(Strictly in terms of physical ability, this is a fine group of reliable members.)
(However, since they have no experience of playing beach volleyball, we'll need to prepare thoroughly for a shot at the championship.)
(And that is where my guidance comes in.)
Z52, Regensburg, Magdeburg, Heinrich, and Adalbert, welcome to the team. I'm Elise, and I'll be your group captain and instructor.
I presume we've all set our sights on winning the championship...
So, without further ado, please come with me to Vacation Island, where we'll practice for the tournament.
Faced with the port, still new and unfamiliar, and Vacation Island, where the Venuses made many memories, Shizuku decides to head to the latter and look for suitable members for her group.
On her way there, she runs into a friendly individual along the seaside avenue.
You there, beautiful lady – I saw you wandering kinda aimlessly around the place. You're not lost, are you?
Cat ears... Err, who are you?
Heehee – call me Cheshire. If you ARE lost, I'd be chuffed to show you around!
Cheshire... Yeah, that'd be great.
I, uhh... I'm looking for some transport headed to Vacation Island, and I guess I've gotten myself lost.
To Vacation Island? Oh! To prep for the beach volleyball tournament, right?
Now I remember! You're one of the Venuses! You need to put together a group!
I'm curious: Have you already figured out who to recruit?
Nope, not yet. I was gonna figure that out once I made it to the island...
Right, I see, I see.
You know, this tournament is a perfect opportunity to show my Owner what I've got... Think you could let me join your group, Shizuku?
Huh? Well, of course. Welcome to the group, Cheshire.
Heehee! There are six groups and eighteen teams in the tournament, so that makes three teams per group... Meaning each group needs six people!
There's you and me, so we need to find another four people.
Yeah...
Four more... Hmm... Heheh, hey, do you think my cat ears are cute?
Yeah. Very. They're, uh... a cosplay thing, right?
Yup-yup, they are!
And you've got both fluffy ears AND a big tail! That's more than me!
Err, they're... Also just a cosplay thing, you know?
Sure, sure!
What I'm thinking is, we take the animal-themed cosplay idea and make it our group identity!
...Kon?
Captain Shizuku, if you don't mind, I can recruit the remaining members for you! I've already got a list of perfect candidates in mind!
W-well... Go ahead.
Shortly after arriving at the break room on Vacation Island, the excited Cheshire brings back four colorful characters.
Yahoo! I'm Benson, cutie pie from Planet Bunny! I wanna join your team!
And I'm Bailey, also from Planet Bunny! Heehee – you won't believe how strong I am!
I'm Admiral Nakhimov from the Northern Parliament. If you're wondering, my cat ears and tail are actually cutting-edge auxiliary measuring instruments.
I'm Santa Fe, a Cleveland-class light cruiser from the Eagle Union! If you need someone to work, do battle, take care of you, or exchange some gossip, I'm your girl!
I've heard a lot about you, Shizuku. Whoa... Your ears and tail sure look hecking realistic for being props!
Can I touch 'em?
I wanna feel them, too!
Saaame!
Umm... Everyone...
B-before we get ahead of ourselves, let me tell you about the basics of beach volleyball...!
Amidst the neon lights of Vacation Island, this bar has just welcomed a new owner.
Letting me have the run of the bar for the duration of the tournament... Hehe, the Commander certainly is a thoughtful one.
And just as charming as the rumors say.
Plus, making us act as captains to train these girls to victory was an interesting idea.
It's just a shame that the bar is so empty at this time of day...
I'm getting a little bored. Maybe I ought to close up shop and go for a little walk?
...Oh? Is that the sound of a customer I hear?
This must be the bar everyone was talking about.
Wow, there really IS a bar operating this early in the day. How did I not notice before?
That would be because the bar didn't even exist the last time you were here.
Didn't you find it odd when you came into the resort?
Oh, true! Where'd this resort come from?!
Hehe, this whole resort is part of Vacation Island's new development project.
The construction around the volcano ought to be nearing completion, too.
They've diverted water to create an artificial lake around the volcano and even made an amusement park on the crater~
It's opening in a few days. You'll definitely want to stop by there!
Wow... We should all go together!
Did they renew this entire island just for the volleyball tournament?
It's grand, I'll give them that...
I think that shooting for perfection within your means is a wonderful philosophy.
Like this bar, it isn't terribly large, and you only recently took ownership of it...
But from the atmosphere down to the finest details, your impeccable taste and dedication really shine through... Isn't that right?
Hehe, I'm honored to receive your praise.
Now, everyone, are you ready to order?
We heard you're a skilled mixologist, so we've come here with high expectations.
Oh, really? What kind of expectations?
We want to show off our charms and get the Commander's attention during the competition.
Miss Bartender, what cocktail do you think is right for the job?
Hehe, that's an interesting question, indeed.
I know... You'll want sexy, elegant, candid, free-spirited, and cute... and a little teaspoon of mystery.
I'll make them for all of you right now. Hope you don't mind a little wait.
Then we'll raise a toast of water while we wait. To our new team – and, to victory!
A charming team dedicated to captivating the Commander, eh?
Hehe, well... Cheers to our group, everyone.
The moment she sets foot on the beautiful island, Tsukushi's head is filled with ideas for manga.
As a result, instead of relaxing in her suite or finding teammates, she decides to start looking for a place to draw.
This place has a perfect view of the beach and the marina...
It's perfect!
She opens up her sketchbook and gets right to work, envisioning the girls playing on the beach as the characters of her story.
However, she quickly realizes that, while capturing the scenery herself, she's inadvertently encroached on somebody else's view.
That girl with the canvas over there has been staring at me for a while now...
Hey, didn't I see her in that introductory pamphlet for the port that Fu Shun gave me?
I think her name was... Raffaello?
Wait! Is she the port's most renowned painter?!
Th-this is bad... If I stay here, I could ruin her art!
Huh? Wait, she stopped... and she and her friend are coming my way!
Hey there! Did you come for material, too?! S-sorry! I'll move right away!
Hm? Huh?!
Umm... Y-you didn't come here to kick me out of your spot?
Aww, you're too anxious! We just wanted to come say hi since we saw a fellow professional for once!
Fellow professional... Oh, art is really just a hobby of mine...
Wow, your composition is incredible! Are you drawing manga?
Yeah... Ever since I got here, I've been getting so much inspo. I'm just ironing out my ideas while I sketch.
I totally get it! The views here are incredible, right?!
It's the same sky and sea that we know and love, but they have such a unique vibe when seen from a different island!
BEEP BEEP! BEEP BEEP!
What was that sound just now?
Oh, it's the Peeper Perceptorator I brought here for testing!
If it's going off, then that must mean... that someone's spying on us!
Huh?!
It's pointing... that-a-way!
Alfredo, I think they're on to us...
Aah! This is a total misunderstanding! Let me explaaain!
Huh? Alfredo and Ema? Is that you?
Hahahaha~ Hiii there! Hehe, just so you know, I got the Commander's permission to film!
Can't let a single wonderful moment of this vacation go unrecorded, right?
I see, but–
BEEP BEEP! BEEP BEEP!
It's going off again! This time, it's... THAT-a-way!
Gah, that's what I get for letting my guard down!
Ark Royal?
Uh, hahaha... What a coincidence. I'm here to film stuff, too!
I'm just filming those little destroyers... Ack! I mean, filming the beautiful scenery of Vacation Island!
I can't believe all of us were here capturing the sights...
Well. Even if some of us were trying to capture different things.
Uh, wait a second... One, two, three, four, five...
Is it just me, or did we naturally get a full group?
A full group...?
For the beach volleyball tournament, duh!
We should join the tournament to get all the best material! Since we're all here, why don't the six of us team up together?
Ooh! I'm in!
I need to test the Peeper Perceptorator more, so I'm in, too!
Beach volleyball sounds fun. Oh, but Tsukushi is a captain, so we should ask her...
O-of course it's okay!
Phew... Welcome to my group, everyone!
Upon arriving at Vacation Island, Patty sets off to see the sights on her own.
Wooow, so this is the jungle on the map~
*sniff*... It smells of treasure here...
Hm? What's that sound over there?
Everyone, hurry up! Let's beat the others to the heart of the jungle!
I'll be the first one there! Here I cooome!
Full speed ahead! We must get the treasure of Vacation Island!
Fwee-fwee! Even if you're running, make sure to watch out for traffic!
*pant*... Wait a second! Don't you think something is wrong?!
According to our ORIGINAL plans, we were supposed to map the island from the perimeter first and search for a place to set up camp...
Then we'd split into two groups so that one could explore while the other built a campsite...
So much for our plan to find the treasure bit by bit...
Rushing straight for the center right from the start is just reckless!
Now, now. They often say that the best-laid plans go to waste!
If we take it too slow, our rivals might swipe the treasure from right under our noses.
Rivals? You mean... someone like me?
Aaaaaargh! A rival has appeared!
Hello hello! What's up? Lookin' for treasure?
Ooh, so that WAS the scent of treasure I caught a whiff of earlier!
The scent of treasure...? Is that some kind of superpower? Cool!
She's one heck of a rival, huh...
We'd better hurry...!
Aww, I'm not your rival, silly~
We're searching for the same treasure, so I think we should work together to find it!
Yeah! We'd love to have you on the Great Treasure Hunting Team, Patty!
The Great Treasure Hunting Team... That sounds like a lot of fun! I'm in, I'm in!
Thus, the six-strong team charged deeper into the jungle, setting off on a new adventure.
Eventually, dusk fell.
*pant*... I'm tired... We've been searching all day, but we haven't seen a lick of treasure.
Fu Shun, do you think your intel was wrong?
I don't think so... Fei Yuen, was YOUR intel wrong?
Huh? No way.
I found this map in the Commander's trash can, and it said there's definitely treasure!
The Commander's trash can...
Aaah! Tell me that's not the event proposal I made for the Commander... the one that got shot down?!
Whaaat?! It can't be...
But Patty said she smelled treasure, didn't she?!
Yeah, I did! The treasure I found is already here.
Let's all team up, enter the beach volleyball tournament, and win that trophy!
...Tournament?
Oooh, I get it! That trophy must be the greatest treasure on the island!
Of course we'll join!
Hehehe, thank you.
Let's do our best, everyone!
Yukino comes to Vacation Island via ferry, basking in the ocean breeze.
Upon disembarking at the pier, she's immediately captivated by the resort's bustling shopping district.
Whoa! The vacation isn't even in full swing, but the place is packed already!
Hehehe! Let's see what kind of stuff they've got here...
Hmm... Huang Ch'ang's fortune telling, Ting An's restaurant, Hai Tien's bookshop, Marco Polo's museum...
Fargo's delivery service, Owari's specialty shop, Shiranui's supplies, Kashino's milk stand...
Umm... Akashi's fashion boutique, Akashi's clothing sales, Akashi's arcade, Akashi's select goods...
Do all of these places belong to Akashi?!
What an entrepreneur...
And there's a big stage being built over there... Is it for a promo event, or something?
Whoa?! The plushies in that showcase are cute... I'd better go take a closer look!
Whoooa... This is stupid cute! Everyone, look! They have holiday-exclusive manjuu plushies!
Oh, hey there! My name's Yukino. Are these little babies called manjuu?
Yep! I'm Astoria, and it's my pleasure! These two are my sisters, Quincy and Vincennes.
Hello, Yukino. I am Quincy, the New Orleans-class heavy cruiser.
I'm Vincennes, another New Orleans-class heavy cruiser...
Heheh, so you came straight for the limited-time stuff too, huh?
The ones in the window were so cute, I just can't! So this stuff is limited-edition, eh?
Actually, now that I look more closely, these little manjuu chicks would totally fit the vibe of our beach volleyball tournament!
Right?! I'd better buy some for my sisters!
Maybe I'll cop one, too. Hehehe!
Speaking of, I think I saw a bunch of those manjuus running around on the way here...
Are they real-life animals?
Hehe, the manjuus doing maintenance around the port are actually all robots!
Huh?! Those fluffy little babies are robots?! That's awesome!
Hahaha! It's a big world out there, but you won't see manjuu anywhere but port. They're our one-of-a-kind specialty.
Hi there, Yukino. I'm Bremerton, and this here is Baltimore.
Yo! All of us were just buying some limited holiday manjuu plushies together.
Hehe, the holiday ones are cute too, but check this one out.
Bremerton takes a green-haired doll out of her shopping bag and shows it off.
A green-haired cat... Wait, is this Akashi?
Correct!
It's sooo cute! Huh? Wait... Does that mean she's turning herself into marketable plushies?
This one's surprisingly popular...
It's not just people who like her that buy her. People who hate her and want to vent their frustrations buy them, too!
She's a business genius!
Yeah... But this new design is so cute, I think I'm gonna buy one myself!
Then I will, too!
Everyone, look! There are muscular Meowfficer plushies on this shelf over here!
Muscular Meowfficers...? I wanna see!
The gang continues looking at merch and chatting together, gradually growing closer in the process.
By the time they've finished shopping, they naturally agree that they're the perfect match for a team.
Group Yukino is officially formed! Let's give it our all, girls!

sequence: With the groups fully formed, the six captains and their members begin preparations at their own pace.
But the competitors aren't the only important factor...
There's something else indispensable to making the beach volleyball tournament the best it can be.

scripts.say: Picking teammates is important and all, but picking out fashionable clothes is just as crucial!
You're right. Selecting stylish outfits can help make the atmosphere of this tournament into something truly unique.
Which means making even more wonderful memories, of course.
Dressing up for matches is sure to lift our spirits, too!
Trendy clothes, huh? Dunkerque and Howe, what do you two think?
Attire just for the occasion... There's an idea that didn't occur to me.
If it's feasible, then I think it could be fun.
Hmm... We'd best get the Venuses acquainted with how fashion works here at port first.
What do you say to holding a fashion show here at the mansion?
Huh?! Here I thought we were just gonna dress up to match the trends. Now we're having a whole fashion show?
Hehe, what an intriguing development.
A fashion show where everyone gets to dress up in gorgeous outfits... I really wanna see it happen!
Then I say we go big or go home. Isn't that right, everyone?
At night, I'm invited to the holiday mansion.
Commander, over here! The fashion show's about to begin!
When it comes to beaches and holidays, what comes to mind? That's right – swimsuits!
Immerse yourself in the ocean's allure...
Its refreshing cool...
And the simple relaxation of it all!
Next, the spirit of a bygone time...
Hey there, Missy. Got any cash on you?
Eep!
As a passing traveler, I cannot sit idly by and allow such villainy to take place!
I'll lend you a hand!
Now, feel the festive mood!
Wow... The moon is so big...
Trick or treat!
Happy Christmas!
...Happy New Year?
Spring Festival!
Celebrate!
And a dash of campus life!
Get to school, you lot, and make it snappy!
Ah... I-I'm late!
I already can't wait to leave this place...
Whether I'm at school or not, if I'm sleepy, I'm napping... Zzz.
Speaking of sleep...
Zzz... Zzz...
Zzz... Zzz...
Should I pretend to be asleep, too...?
Ahem... How about we kick it up a notch with some speed and excitement?
The track is all clear!
All systems go.
Honey! You watching? I'm ready to burn some rubber!
And next up...
The moonlit mansion is filled with a dazzling array of beautiful costumes.
Wooow! Everyone looks so pretty!
There's a certain spice that comes with nighttime events like these.
Wow! If the range of options is this wide, we'd better step up our game, too!
Commander, let's pick outfits that match the tournament vibe perfect! We're gonna start trends nobody's ever imagined. Hehehe!
As I stroll along the coast in the late afternoon, I happen to see a familiar figure.
Elise lies in a hammock, gazing quietly at the distant horizon.
Noticing my presence, she slowly turns her attention to me and traces a faint smile on her lips.
Commander? What a coincidence. Shouldn't you be working at this hour?
I just hit a nice stopping point. On break, I see?
That's right. I thought I'd unwind a little, though I never expected I'd see you of all people. But while you're here...
Why not join me for a while? The view is nice, and the breeze feels lovely.
I nod silently and sit in the next hammock over. The wind carrying the scent of the sea tickles my cheeks.
By the way...
Everyone in the port often says that you need proper rest to truly focus on work.
I understand it logically, but... experiencing it firsthand is new to me.
You could say you're putting what you've learned into practice.
That's one way to put it. I have to say, it doesn't feel bad.
Elise stretches a little and returns her gaze to the distant scenery.
Blue skies, white clouds, and the vast ocean...
I never imagined that I'd be able to spend my time relaxing in such a beautiful place.
They're right. You look a lot more relaxed than usual.
I think that's because... I'm simply enjoying some time off.
She tucks a stray, windswept lock of hair behind her ear. Even that casual gesture looks dignified and elegant when she does it.
I can tell that you're putting superhuman effort into your work, too, Commander. But...
Don't you think it's wonderful to just... clear your mind and let your body ride on the wind once in a while?
It is calming, I'll give you that. Especially with you.
...Really, now?
She doesn't say another word, but a smile plays just slightly on her lips.
Okay... Then let's stay a while longer.
Still, keeping this peaceful moment all to the two of us feels a tad unfair, doesn't it?
Next time, if you have a place you want to visit or something you'd like to do, tell me in advance.
I want to be able to help you, too.
One afternoon, Shizuku takes me to a secret cove encircled by rocky reefs.
We're here, Commander. Look – the rocks perfectly conceal us from the outside... It's our own little world for just the two of us.
There's nothing here but the sky, the water, and the little creatures hiding under the stones. It's the perfect place to let my tail hang out...
She lowers her voice now and points daintily toward the rocks.
Look, Commander... There's a little crab scuttling across the rocks as fast as its little legs will take it.
Oh, and look here! A school of shiny fish just darted under that rock...
Her eyes sparkle with delight as she points at the gap under a moss-covered stone. In time with the motion, her tail brushes against the water's surface.
They're usually so shy, but they're not even hiding today.
Maybe they remember you.
Maybe... I am the only one who comes to visit, after all.
But today, you came with me...
Hyah!
Before she can finish that thought, she gasps and thrashes her tail.
C-Commander... It got my tail.
I-it's holding on really tight... Kon...
Stay still. I'll take care of it.
I run over and catch the crab clinging to her tail.
When I apply just a tiny bit of pressure, it releases its grip on her, hops into the water with a plop, and scurries away into the rocks.
Phew... I-I'm saved.
Ugh... My fur is all knotted and wet. It's even got seaweed stuck to it...
Relax. We have grooming tools back at port. I'll take you there, and you'll be fixed up in no time.
Really? I'll hold you to that...
We sit together on a rock warmed by the sunlight. All we can hear is the rhythmic ebb and flow of the tide.
It's strange... I was in such a panic moments ago.
Now that I'm sitting with you... all of my anxiety has just vanished.
Can we stay here a little while longer?
Tonight, the bar is dead silent. Only the space behind the counter is illuminated by a soft, amber glow.
I came here to order a drink from Shandy before bed, but when I arrive, I'm stunned by the sight of a bathtub behind the counter.
Amidst the steam rising from it, Shandy languidly leans on the edge. Orange peels and rosemary leaves float in the water.
Oh? Welcome, Commander... I was just wondering who my first customer of the night would be.
Hehe... You look surprised. Let's just say... I was lacking inspiration, so I tried changing up my workspace a little.
She brushes her wet hair back and rests her arms on the edge of the tub. Water droplets trickle down her shoulders and drip into the tub.
Soaking in the tub might just give me an idea for a new cocktail blend.
Besides, being unconventional can be fun in its own right, don't you think?
By the way... I'm not supposed to be open for business right now, but I guess you must be here for a drink.
Shandy's fingers stroke the surface of the water. Ripples catch the light, casting an uneven glow on her eyes.
Serving you dressed as I am seems a little unprofessional, but if you don't mind, then I'd be happy to make you a drink.
You mean... like that?
Of course. Or perhaps...
Would you prefer to enjoy my special cocktail here in the tub with me?
She giggles to herself and turns away, grabbing a bottle off the shelf. There's a pleasant sound as her lithe motions cause the water to ripple.
You know, this is actually so much more convenient. The temperature, scent, and feeling can all be part of the recipe.
Did you know I was coming?
Just my bartender's intuition. I can read you like an open book, Commander.
The sound of ice falling into a glass echoes in the dark room. Shandy skillfully shakes the cocktail shaker, drawing a graceful arc with each motion.
She then pours the cocktail into the chilled glass, before garnishing it with fresh mint and lime.
This is a mojito I crafted especially for you. May its crispness, reminiscent of the sea breeze, linger on your taste buds.
Did you feel it? The warmth of the rum spreading ever so gently throughout you.
Yeah. This one tastes even smoother than usual.
Hehe, tonight's theme is relaxation, after all. On that note, why don't you relax a little and immerse yourself in the moment for once?
I slowly drain my drink. The cocktail's soothing warmth and the steam from the bathtub seem to melt together.
You liked that one a lot, didn't you?
In that case... I hope you'll continue to patronize my little bar... Hehe.
In the afternoon, the reference room is so quiet that I can hear the gliding of a pencil over paper. Tsukushi sits in front of a drawing board, brow furrowed.
I approach as quietly as possible and peek over her shoulder. There isn't a single word in the speech bubbles of her draft.
Got writer's block?
Hyah! C-Commander! Ah... Umm, yes...
She withdraws slightly like a startled animal, but then, she slumps onto her desk dejectedly.
I've got the atmosphere, the setting, and the expressions... but the thing that matters most, the dialogue, just won't come to me.
You're struggling that much? What kind of scene is it?
It's the scene where... the heroine psyches herself up and reveals her true feelings to the protagonist...
She's kept them bottled up for so long. In this crucial moment where she has to put it all out there, her heart is pounding with emotion.
I've racked my brain for so long, but they end up being too straightforward or too contrived... I can't give it that heart-fluttery feeling that every romance needs!
Heart-fluttery, eh?
You created these characters. Have you tried putting yourself in the heroine's shoes for a moment?
I-in her shoes?!
Tsukushi's cheeks flush a deep red.
You want me to be like my heroine... confessing such intimate emotions?!
Yeah. If you were in her position right now, what would you most want to say to the other person?
Her eyes wander, glancing at the protagonist's profile on her draft and then at me.
In her position...
After muttering to herself, her eyes drift further and further away. It's as if she has finally immersed herself in the world she created.
"I-I've... always..."
Her voice trembles, and her breathing grows rapid.
"For a long time now... without even realizing it, I've..."
Fingertips tighten around the pencil. Beneath those lowered eyelids, long eyelashes quiver just slightly.
"...Felt that I can't see you as just a friend..."
"Because I want you to..."
The instant those words leave her lips, she suddenly freezes up. It's as if she's been scorched by the heat taken on by her own voice.
Slowly, she looks up and makes eye contact with me – and her pupils suddenly shrink.
Aaaah?!
She screams and jumps out of her chair, almost knocking over her drawing board in the process.
I-I can't, I can't, I can't! This is way too much for me!
She covers her flushed cheeks with both hands and shakes her head frantically.
I-I can't say a line like that out loud! J-just imagining it...
Before the sentence is even over, she whips around and flees, leaving me alone with a swaying door and the pages of her draft scattered across the floor.
I gaze for a moment at the door. When I look down at my feet, I spot a drawing of a blushing girl.
What's gotten into her?
Hum hum hum~♪
Lighthearted humming blends into a relaxed melody as it spills out of the board game room.
When I open the door, the first thing that catches my eye is a radio playing cheerful music by the entrance.
Patty lies flat on her back in the middle of a spread-out map. Her leg, dangling off of the table, taps out the rhythm on thin air.
Hmm~♪ Hum hum... Hmm?
*sniff*... Oh, Commander! Hello hello!
A bunny outfit accentuates her curves as she rolls over. Its trim reflects the light softly.
Patty, what's with the getup?
Hehe, do you like it? I heard that if you touch a bunny's ears, you're guaranteed good luck!
So I thought, why not BE the bunny? Don't I just look lucky?
You came to play some games, didn't you? Great timing!
Touch my ears, and I bet you'll have a heap of good luck in your game!
...You want me to rub your ears?
Yeah, yeah! Give it a shot!
She tilts her head playfully toward me, offering her fluffy bunny ears for a good rub.
They're even softer than they look, right?
Hehe... I can practically feel how warm your hands are. Warm and fuzzy...
Ooh, my heart is racing! Is that the scent of excitement I smell?
She blinks and twitches her nose just like a bunny... as if trying to discern a scent.
Hmm... That kind scent coming from you is getting stronger. I love it!
I like it even more than the smell of flowers and sweet treats combined!
The bunny-girl tilts her head slightly and peers up at me. The trim of her outfit traces her curves perfectly.
Hmm... Is it just me, or do we feel a lot closer today?
This closeness between us... might just be the smell of happiness itself, huh?
Getting to share my luck with you makes me happier than anything in the world!
I think you're starting to get a little bit happier too, Commander.
She tilts her head again, leaning her soft bunny ears close. From her hair wafts a scent as fresh as wildflowers wet with morning dew.
I don't mind... 'cause your scent is as sweet as honey right now!
Here! Now my luck will reach you, no problem!
As requested, I continue to rub her fluffy ears. Patty closes her eyes and hums happily beneath my hands.
When she opens her eyes again, they're sparkling with joy.
There you go! I've shared my luck with you.
Now you can win at your game and be even happier!
As she says this, she straightens up. Her bright, cheery eyes remain fixed on me all throughout.
But you gotta recharge your luck once in a while so you don't run out.
If you need me again, promise you'll come tell me, alright?
Patty scoots, clearing a space for me on the table.
But first... Why don't we listen to the rest of this song together? Hehe!
While I'm collecting data deep in the jungle, I hear a violent rustling in the thicket behind me.
Gotcha! Aww, a little human wandered into my jungle.
Before I can turn around, I'm tackled from behind. The world spins around, and before I know it, I'm on my back.
While my camera is thrown in some other direction, I'm straddled by someone with animal ears.
Hehehe! Caught you, Commander.
With her hands on either side of my head, she lowers her hips onto mine, pinning me beneath her. I'm unable to even sit up, let alone escape.
Didja get scared? Adventuring in the jungle can be risky, y'know!
Yukino? What's going on...
Hehehe, just a little welcome from the king of the jungle. Pretty intense, am I right?
As she crouches even closer to me, her eyes sparkle, evidently proud of her successful ambush.
The way you were looking all around totally reminded me of a scared, lost animal.
So I decided to come and hunt you down myself!
And that makes me...
Yep! You're my prey, Commander!
Releasing her grip with one hand, she raises her index finger and points it squarely at my nose.
You know how this stuff goes by now. If you don't pay the price, I can't let you go free... Hmm, what do I want from you?
Ooh! I just had an awesome idea!
Yukino's eyes light up when she spots the camera nearby.
You gotta use that to snap some cool pics of me in the jungle, and you can't stop until I say so!
Okay... Can you get off of me first, though?
Nuh-uh. If I do that, you'll just run away. Anyway, that's that!
Instead of getting off of me, she leans even closer with a mischievous grin on her face.
Let's do our first shot like this. I'll call it, "A poor human falls prey to Yukino!" Packs a crazy punch, right? Hehehe!
You put a lot of thought into that name, huh?
Nope, it's called inspiration! Alright, let's do it!
She then springs to her feet and hands me the camera.
Come on, let's start the photo shoot! I hope you can keep up with me, Commander.
I don't remember agreeing to this...
Pssh, it's too late to complain now!
She twirls around and dashes off into a sunlit clearing.
When she turns to face me again, her hair and animal ears shimmer in the light.
Get over here! The lighting is perf!
If you don't snap enough pics to make me happy, then I'm never letting you get away, Commander! Hehehe!
I walk on the damp sand along the port's coast alongside Misaki.
Commander, thank you for walking with me today. I really appreciate it.
Could we go over there? The view must be really nice from there–
Suddenly, she stumbles over. She frantically grabs my arm for balance.
You okay?
Y-yeah... I think I twisted my ankle a little.
Um, could you help me walk... Ah! There's a spot over there where we can sit. Let's take a little break.
As suggested, I help her over, and we sit down on the sand together.
The view here is just wonderful. There aren't many clouds, and stars stretch as far as the eye can see...
*whoosh*... *bang!*
A magnificent golden firework rips through the night sky, illuminating her face brightly.
Ah! It started! Commander, look!
She slowly straightens her back and gazes up at the night sky. In this moment, it's as if she wasn't just injured at all.
Fireworks are launched one after another, bursting all across the night sky and casting a glow upon her profile.
My big sister always told me that fireworks are more fun when there's a big crowd watching.
But, you know... I like it more with just the two of us, hehe.
Oh, look over there! There are fireworks that look just like stardust!
She excitedly points up at the sky, naturally leaning in close to me.
What fireworks do you like, Commander?
The one right now.
Right now? Hmm... You mean the ones that looked like cosmos flowers?
I mean the one I can see right in front of me.
Misaki looks confused for a moment, but she then nods bashfully, as if finally understanding.
Okay... Then will you go to the next port festival with me, too?
Of course. It's a promise.
Oh, look! Here comes the last volley of fireworks!
The brilliant symphony of light reaches a crescendo, lighting up the sea and her eyes all at once.
As the last firework fades into the night sky, she stands up and leans close, smiling.
Let's go home, Commander.
Her steps are light and steady.

sequence:
The Opulent! The Glamorous! Luxury Bay!

<size=45>1 Time to Wake Up, Commander</size>

scripts.say: Commander... Commander, it's time to get up.
Being a sleepyhead is unbecoming for a commanding officer.
I hear a whisper in the dark, and at the same time, I feel something moist and sleek against my ear.
Opening my eyes, I find Götz staring right at me from close up. Her cool fingertips are tracing my neck.
Heheh... You're finally awake, my dear Commander.
My... I can feel your heart racing. Are you perhaps volunteering to become my treat?
I've been feeling quite famished, actually... Maybe I should take a little taste...♪
With a dangerous glint in her eyes, Götz closes in on me... and then stops.
...My, it seems someone is intruding on us.
Before she can even finish her words, the room quakes.
Commander... Commander, it's time to get up.
Being a sleepyhead is unbecoming for a commanding officer.
Hearing a familiar voice, my consciousness surfaces into clarity.
I open my eyes with effort and find that Götz is besides me after all.
Even groggy as I am, I see her expression is more confident than alluring.
You're finally awake, Commander.
Her cool fingertips gently touch my neck.
I gaze out the plane's window and see our destination –
A collection of ornate, radiant buildings surrounded by a vast desert and blue seas.
To be honest, I was a bit nervous when that unexpected storm formed as we approached Luxury Bay's airspace...
But thankfully, we were able to brave the storm without issue.
The city that shimmers like gold is at hand.
The vacation everyone's been waiting for is finally about to begin♪
After making a landing at the airport, we board a car that takes us to our hotel.
Once we settle down, Akashi comes over to give me a tour of the town.
Nya, Commander! Welcome to the Luxury Bay, nya!
This is a top class luxury resort that stands head and shoulders above the rest! The climate and view are both perfect, and there's no shortage of fine cuisine and entertainment, nya!
The Tower of Luxury you see over there is this town's landmark, nya!
Wow. It really is glittering in the sun.
Of course, nya! I picked this place after much scrutiny!
At the top of that Tower of Luxury is a jewel everyone calls the Star of Luxury, nya! It shines bright in the night and stands as a symbol of Luxury Bay's wealth.
A symbol of wealth... In other words... Something I couldn't afford even if I poured all the money I have into it, nya...
...Wait, what is the meaning of this, nya?! Where's the Star of Luxury?!
How did such a large, precious jewel just up and disappear, nya?!
I look up in the same direction as Akashi, and indeed, I can't see any jewel on the top of the building.
Nyaaaa! My money! My deposit!
I had to put down a huge deposit to make a reservation for our vacation nya!
The contract said that if we end up damaging or losing any of the town's valuables, I have to pay a sizable sum in reparations nya!
Nya... If I can't get my deposit back, Commander, won't you please share some of your profits with me as your business partner, nya...?
I don't mind, but we should come up with a good long-term plan.
If we set up a solid plan for services we can offer in the pre-opening period, our profits should be high when we formally open the place.
Rather than coming up with a contingency plan, we should be thinking in the long term.
