Now her cheeks and even neck are flushed. I wasn't imagining it after all.
I'm very excited for tomorrow's date... Com-man-der♪

sequence:
The Secret to Curing Exhaustion?!

<size=45>6 Is the Secret Dates?</size>

scripts.say: The next morning, I get to our arranged meeting spot before San Jacinto.
(Normally, she arrives first. Looks like it's my turn this time...)
Commander!
A pleasant voice reaches my ears. I rush to turn around, but a slender finger touches my cheek.
I can't believe you got here before me for once, Commander♪
Should I assume you were even more excited for the date than I was?
Heehee~ I finally get to have you all to myself for a day♪
Where do you plan to take me first, hmm?
Have you had breakfast already?
Not yet. After all, I left my entire schedule for the day in your hands~
Then how about we go check out a dessert shop?
You did say that good food is the secret to curing exhaustion, as I recall.
Let's energize ourselves at the very first stop.
Wow, you remember that...
Do you actually care a lot about the things I say, Commander?
Okay, let's go to the dessert shop~ Just leave ordering to me!
On San Jacinto's recommendation, I order us a strawberry parfait.
Eat up! This strawberry parfait is the best~
Come on. Open up!
She feeds me a spoonful of parfait. The sweetness of it fills my mouth while her own sweet scent reaches my nose.
Sweet food, sweet smells – it becomes hard to tell which is hers and which isn't.
Just one bite, and you feel all relaxed already... Isn't that right?
She's right. The sugar soothes my tired nerves, making me feel a lot better all at once.
We finish the strawberry parfait together.
That was delicious~ Even more so because I got to enjoy it with you, Commander.
It's a little late to mention it now, but you and I were using the same spoon. That's like an indirect kiss, isn't it?
Heehee~ Embarrassed yet?
If you don't answer, I'm going to assume that's a yes~ Heheheh♪
Next, we go to a movie theater together.
Like our last destination, I pick the spot and have her choose what we do.
Hm? A horror movie?
Yeah~ Do you struggle with horror movies, Commander?

options.content: If it's JUST a normal horror movie, then I'm fine.

scripts.say: Then I can't wait to see how you react to this one~
Don't you worry. I'll be right by your side~
As the movie goes on, the eerie background audio suddenly rises to a crescendo.
The horrifying scenes gradually suck me into the story.
Ah...
What's wrong?
Commander, did that scare you?
Look how hard you're holding on to my arm~
Sorry... Did that hurt?
I just got so absorbed in the movie, I didn't notice.
It's okay~ In fact... I might be happier that you did it♪
She leans over and rests her head on my chest.
Your heartbeat is so fast~
Is it because of the scary movie? Ooor...
In the darkness, she whispers in my ear before gently kissing my neck.
Am I just imagining it?
My heartbeat gets even more intense.
After that, we go to an amusement park together.
Naturally, I once again decide the destination and let her lead the way while we're there.
We decide to ride the Ferris wheel together.
The cabin gradually rises, and the scenery before us widens.
You don't get to see sights like this every day...
Do you like things like this?
Of course~
Especially because you're by my side. It makes everything look even prettier than usual...
Than usual?
Oh? Let me say it again~
Because you're here with me, I get to see things in an even more beautiful light than when you're not.
If you're having fun, then let's go see more sights after this.
Huh...?
Geez. That made my heart beat even faster than when we were watching the horror movie.
Heehee... Would you like to hear it?
Before I can answer, San Jacinto reaches an arm around my head and pulls me close to her heart.
My ear touches her soft chest, and I hear her heart pounding within.
Commander...
What's wrong?
I love...
BOOM!
The sound of a firework, vibrant and beautiful, cuts off San Jacinto's words.
Eventually, our ride ends.
What were you saying on the Ferris wheel before? I couldn't really hear you over the fireworks...
Aww~ You couldn't? That's a shame...
If you didn't hear me...
She suddenly stops in front of me, turns around, and winks.
Then I guess it remains a secret♡

sequence:
The Secret to Curing Exhaustion?!

<size=45>7 Is the Secret the Commander?</size>

scripts.say: Our last stop of the day is an aquarium.
There, I let San Jacinto take the lead again.
The aquarium at night has a different charm compared to daytime. At first, things proceed without incident...
Until we reach the dolphin show, that is.
I didn't think they'd splash water at us...
SS Commander has been sunk~
Here's a towel. Dry up nice and quick, okay?
...Oh. A little towel isn't enough, is it?
That's too bad. Let's get those clothes off of you, Commander~
R-right here? Now?
Yes, of course. You don't have to worry. I brought you a change of clothes just in case~
Huh? Where were you keeping that towel and those clothes, exactly...?
Must you interrogate everything? A girl's gotta have her secrets♪
In the end, I change into the clothes she brought for me.
Though it's a little distracting when she squeals from excitement the whole time...
(She does seem like she's more energetic now...)
(I guess the date was a success, then?)
Heehee. I'm just so happy to have had you all to myself today.
But I think there's one last thing I need to get rid of the rest of my fatigue.
Commander, do you remember when you promised to give me a reward?
I sure do. Did you decide on something?
Of course. Close your eyes first.
I close my eyes as directed. My other senses become slightly more acute.
Warm breath caresses my cheek.
A soft kiss touches my lips.
A damp, gentle, but mischievous little kiss – a real one that suits her.
You can open your eyes now~ Heehee, all I ever need to cure my exhaustion... is you, Commander.
She stands on her tiptoes and gently lays her head on my shoulder, breathing just a little heavily.
When I look over, I see red in the corner of her eyes. Tears seem ready to flow.
Aquariums are a staple for dates, yes, but making them the last stop?
I think you need to understand women's hearts a little better, Commander.
Thank you for leading the way today. Now you can leave it to me.
After all, our little promise from before still hasn't been fulfilled.
With a sly grin, San Jacinto takes my hand and guides me to the aquarium exit.

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>1 Midnight Invitation</size>

scripts.say: Port – Office
As I work into the night, only a few papers remain on my desk.
But as soon as I am about to wrap things up, I hear a sound from the door.
The next moment, the door opens, and I see someone sneak into the room, hugging a pillow.
...Santa Fe?
Santa Fe, who should have turned in for the night, tiptoes into my office.
Shush! Commander, quiet!
I'm baffled by Santa Fe's cryptic expression.
Why are you up this late?
Hmm, no reason~ I just really wanted to be with you all of a sudden.
Besides, aren't you bored, having to stay in the office this late at night?
And so! I brought you my comfiest, fluffiest pillow! Nyahaha!
You're not fooling me. You couldn't fall asleep so you came here to gossip, didn't you?
Whoa! Got it right in one...
Wait, no, no! This time it's not just plain old gossip!
Santa Fe sidles up to me, puts the pillow on the side of the table and whispers into my ear.
Commander, have you heard about the mysterious rumors going around the port recently?

options.content: You mean the singing in the cafeteria...?
You mean the secret discount at the shop?

scripts.say: You mean the singing in the cafeteria...?
Not that! We know it's just Illustrious singing lullabies for Unicorn!
You mean the secret discount at the shop?
That's obviously just one of Akashi's sales pitches!
I don't mean rumors like that, I mean something much more awesome! The rumor of the seventh mystery of the port!
If you go to the abandoned lighthouse by the sea with the person you love...
You'll find the Tome of Eternal Love!
The rumor... of the seventh mystery?
The important part is the Tome of Eternal Love, okay?!
It sounds totally bogus.
Well, you know what they say about the power of faith!
Just think about it. If we actually find the ancient Tome of Eternal Love, the whole port will be buzzing with excitement!
So... You're asking me to explore the lighthouse with you in the dead of night?
Nyahaha! You know me so well! Let's do it, Commander!
I mean, I don't mind, but I still have work to do...
I'll help you finish up when we get back, don't worry!
We don't want such a golden chance to investigate a rumor slip away! Come on, Commander, let's goooo!
Santa Fe is already halfway to the door and looks at me with eyes glittering with anticipation. I decide to come with her.

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>2 There Really Is a Ghost?!</size>

scripts.say: I set my work aside, and together we head to a secluded corner of the port.
Commander, stay close behind me!
The lighthouse is that way! I've got the map memorized!
Santa Fe leads the way confidently, a flashlight in her hand.
Five minutes later...
Santa Fe... Are you positive you know which way to go?
This is clearly a dead end...
I-I've got this!
The map said that the beach should be just past this trail!
So count on me, Commander. I'll show you the way!
With how confident she is, I have no choice but to accept.
After a while, Santa Fe and I find ourselves standing in the middle of a pitch black, abandoned warehouse.
...Where are we?
Huh?!
This is all wrong, the map said the beach should be just past here... Why are we at a dead end?
I know I didn't remember wrong! Here, I'll show you...
Santa Fe takes out her smartphone and tries to open the map...
Wait, what?! Out of service range?!
I-I'll, uh, I'll go look over there...
But then, the sea breeze blows in, making the rusted corrugated iron produce an eerie creak.
Eek?! C-Commander, was that a... ghost?!
What if we wandered into the haunted mansion I heard about in the rumors...?! H-hurry, hide behind me!
Santa Fe shivers like a leaf, but still bravely tries to shield me from danger.
There are rumors about a haunted mansion?
That's one of the seven mysteries of the port! The haunted mansion!
They say anyone who wanders inside is locked up inside, forever...
Should we turn back?
T-turn back? But we haven't found the Tome of Eternal Love yet...
We could go back, if you're scared...
But when I turn around to go back, the path we came from is gone.
All we see is corrugated iron with its paint flaked off, stacked wooden crates and dark walls.
H-how did this happen...? Commander...
She looks around the area, lighting it with her flashlight, but the place seems to have changed since the last time we looked.
Oh no... Don't tell me a ghost is doing this!
Are we going to stay locked in here forever and starve to death...?
As Santa Fe becomes frightened, I pat her on the back encouragingly.
Don't worry. If this really is the haunted mansion from the seven mysteries, surely there's a rumor about a way out, too?
A way out?
Santa Fe blinks a few times, and then furrows her brow as she sifts through her memories.
Oh... I remember!
The rumors say that if you get trapped in a haunted mansion, you should hide in the box in the corner...
If you can last there until morning, a path that wasn't there before should present itself.
A path that wasn't there before... Let's find a box in the corner, then.
We use the flashlight to light our surroundings and find a battered wooden crate by the wall.
There's some junk cluttering the area around it, but otherwise nothing about the box really stands out.
There! It's like the rumors said!
Nyahaha! Commander, over here! Let's hide here and wait for morning!
At Santa Fe's urging, I crouch down and get inside the wooden box.
With my line of sight lowered, I spot a door that's been hidden by the junk until now. It's quite worn-out and weathered, with cracks near the door's frame.
A breeze is blowing in from the cracks in the door.
There's a breeze... So that's why the way out becomes visible come morning. It's because sunlight filters in.
I see! I get it now!
And depending on the angle, you might not see the light shining in~
Thank you for remembering the rumor. We'd have spent all night trapped here if you didn't.
Heheh, no problem!
Let's go, Commander! We found our way out of the haunted mansion, so let's find the lighthouse!

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>3 Sneak Past the Night Patrol!</size>

scripts.say: We squeeze through the hidden door in the warehouse, and pop out in front of a beach. The sea breeze blows on us, and the contours of the lighthouse loom in the distance.
Finally, I found it! Now to look for the entrance...
Hold on a second.
Santa Fe looks ready to scamper off all on her own, but I grab her arm. I see lights flickering and approaching us along the path to the lighthouse.
What? Those lights... Don't tell me someone's out on patrol at this hour?!
Oh, no! If we get spotted, everyone in the port will be gossiping about me tomorrow!
I can see the headlines now...! Breaking News: A certain shipgirl strolling outdoors at night with the Commander! The truth behind her intentions is... Or something like that.
Ugh, I can't let that happen!

options.content: Do we go back to the warehouse and hide?
Do we hide in the sand and pretend to be rocks?

scripts.say: Do we go back to the warehouse and hide?
It's too late for that! They're almost here!
Do we hide in the sand and pretend to be rocks?
What are you talking about?! That's just asking to get caught!
Ah, over there! Commander, let's hide behind that big rock!
Santa Fe hurriedly pulls me by the arm to a large rock on the beach.
As we hide behind the rock, the light of flashlights passes by where we just stood.
That was close... We were this close to getting caught.
Using the scant moonlight, Santa Fe looks around the nearby rocks.
I wonder...
Commander, is it just me, or is this rock's shape a little weird?
How so?
I mean, it forms a really nice cover, and it's in just the right place to block the flashlights.
And this indent is just big enough for both of us to hide...
It's like a naturally formed perfect hiding spot!
True... Good job finding it, Santa Fe.
Nyahaha! Aren't I the best? My discerning eyes are unmatched!
But... It's weird, this place reminds me of something...
Did you hear about it before?
...Probably, yeah!
Commander, if we scoot this way, we can move while staying hidden!
Roger that. Go ahead to the lighthouse, Santa Fe.
Nyahahaha! Watch over my stealth mission, Commander!
Santa Fe pinches the hem of my sleeve and stealthily walks sideways like a crab, moving forward.
Eventually, we reach the bottom of the lighthouse.
Phew! We made it!
There, see? My discerning eye proves its worth again!
It really is thanks to you finding the right route to take.
Right?! With me by your side, no challenge is too... Whaaaa!
Santa Fe, who confidently walked backwards, steps into a pit obfuscated by the sand.
Watch out!
I reach out on reflex to grab Santa Fe, but she ends up pulling me in, and we both lose balance.
We fall into the darkness, accompanied by the rustling hiss of crumbling sand.

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>4 A Familiar Scribble</size>

scripts.say: We slam into the thick sand with a thud.
Oooow!
Are you all right? You're not hurt, are you?
I'm fine... But I've got sand everywhere.
What about you?
All good on my end.
Nnngh... We were so close, but got caught in a trap the rumors never mentioned!
But uh, where are we?
We use our flashlight to illuminate the surroundings. We seem to have fallen underground, and the tunnel extends in the direction of the lighthouse.
Looks like we fell under the lighthouse.
Huh? Really?!
Nyahaha! Maybe this was a lucky break!
It looked like you stumbled on your path, but it opened our way further.
Heheh, keep heaping on the praise!
But Commander, allow me to clear my name by getting a good look around!
Santa Fe pats her clothes, shaking off the sand, and eagerly steps forward.
Before long we reach the end of the passage, where we find an aged spiral staircase.
The staircase doesn't look very steady. Let's climb carefully.
Oh, don't worry!
A lot happened, but my intuition is telling me a great rumor is waiting for me at the top!
I follow a spirited Santa Fe up the steps.
It gets darker as we ascend, and we have to hold onto the wall for support, climbing up with what little guidance the flashlight affords us.
It's getting darker...
Don't tell me we'll run into another ghost.
You can hold onto me if you're afraid.
I-I'm not scared! I just...
AAAAAAAAH!
Santa Fe screeches, having touched something on the wall.
Commander, look!
Santa Fe points ahead, at a few squiggly arrows scribbled on the wall in permanent marker.
Hmm... This cat drawn next to the arrows... Where have I seen it before?
Well, whatever!
Someone who explored this place ahead of us must have left this way marker!
Then this should be the place...
Heheh, having you around really makes my rumor sensor extra sharp!
Let's take a photo to remember this, Commander!
...A photo?
Yeah! To prove we found the way here together!
Santa Fe hurries over to me, takes out her smartphone and fits me and the scribble on the wall into the frame.
Say "cheese"!
The shutter clicks, and Santa Fe checks the photo contentedly.
Hehe, it came out great!
But looking at this cat's face, it's got this familiar vacant stupidity to its eyes...
Nyahaha! It's starting to look pretty cute!
Whoever came here first would probably get along with me!
Commander, let's hurry up and go! The Tome of Eternal Love is definitely up there!

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>5 The Truth Behind the Tome</size>

scripts.say: After many twists and turns, we reach the top of the lighthouse.
Pheeeew! We made it!
Commander, let's get to looking! It's a special tome, so it's definitely hidden out of sight!
We look all over the deserted control room, and Santa Fe discovers a storage space under an old panel.
Oh, there's a box inside...
You think this is where we'll find the Tome of Eternal Love?!
Santa Fe excitedly picks up the small, faded box. It's wrapped in a ribbon, but it's already quite loose.
Scribbled in tiny letters at the side of the box are the words "works like a charm!"
It's actually real...
Nyahaha, what did I tell you? My rumors are never wrong!
The rumored Tome of Eternal Love that guarantees an eternity with your loved one... Is now in my hands!
Why don't you open it up?
Sure! With you right here with me, this is the ideal time to open the box!
Santa Fe eagerly undoes the box's ribbon, and reveals a small, pink notebook inside.
Commander, are you willing to learn what true love really means?
You have my full, undivided attention.
"Step 1: Gather every bit of information on the Commander. Grasping all the rumors in the port is the key."
Yep, that makes perfect sense! Everything starts gathering intel.
"Step 2: To draw the Commander's affections, put a twist on how you put away documents."
"For instance, sort the folders by color..."
...Wait.
Huh? This method... That's exactly what I came up with...
Wow, my predecessors really knew their stuff!
Next up...
"Step 3: Even if you fail at a task, don't panic. If acting clumsy gets you on the Commander's good side, that's another way of getting what you want..."
"Step 4: Try outfits like maid uniforms, swimsuits and bunny girl costumes to make yourself positively magnetic..."
"And for the final technique. Use late-night rumors as an excuse to get some alone time with the Commander... "
W-wait one gosh darn minute...
This is exactly what's happening right now...
She mutters those last words, making them hardly audible.
What's wrong?
All the steps leading up to this bother me, too...
W-well, that's just... Uh... Just coincidence...
I step up to Santa Fe and check the notebook.
The handwriting is a little crude and excitable, and highly reminiscent of a certain someone who recently helped me with my paperwork.
So this is the truth behind the seventh mystery of the port.
Waaaaaah! N-no, it's not!
Commander, give me a chance to explain myself!

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>6 Embarrassing Past Exposed!</size>

scripts.say: C-Commander, give it back, please!
Santa Fe flushes red with embarrassment and tries to snatch the notebook away.
I hold it up out of her reach, forcing her to stand on tiptoe to try to grab it.
She tugs on my collar, pouting, and I feel her breath tickle my neck.
Ugh... You're such a bully!
After all the trouble we went through to find the Tome of Eternal Love...
I can't give it back without reading it the whole way through.
But it's all old info...!
Realizing she won't be able to force it out of my hands, Santa Fe pivots to looking up at me with puppy dog eyes.
Commander... Please...
It's full of my really important, precious rumors...
If you don't give it back, I'll be too embarrassed to hunt for rumors ever again...
Huh? Important, precious rumors?
That's all the more reason to read it.

options.content: What does the next page say...?

scripts.say: Let's see... "Love tip: Knock over your cup so you can step up and wipe the Commander's clothes clean..."
Stop iiiiiiiiit! That's my embarrassing past!
What's next... "Would becoming a maid make the Commander like me better? Tomorrow I'll try picking out something super cute!"
Stop iiiiiiiiit! That's my embarrassing past!
Santa Fe goes red up to her ears.
Finally giving in, she buries her face in my chest and refuses to move.
So, what actually is this Tome of Eternal Love?
As I look to her with a strained smile, Santa Fe gives in, realizing she has no choice but to explain.
Uuu... It's something I wrote a long time ago...
It's got nothing to do with rumors...
It's like a list of future goals I wrote back when I first became your secretary...
Santa Fe starts tearing up, cringing from having her flights of fancy dug up.
...A list of future goals?
Yes... Back then, I spent all day coming up with ways to make you like me better...
So I wrote it all down, full of expectations for the future...
But I was afraid someone might find it, so I came all the way to this abandoned lighthouse and hid it in a box.
And then... completely forgot about it.
Someone probably found it, and rumors spread about it, making it the mysterious Tome of Eternal Love!
She speaks with a voice that's a mix of embarrassment and frustration.
She rubs her face against my chest, too ashamed to let me see her face right now.
So you set up all the traps outside too?
Yeah... I blocked the real entrance, so that trap was the real way in...
And you drew the arrows and the cat on the wall back when you first found this hiding place?
Yes! Can you believe how much of a dummy I am?!
Here I thought I was catching a whiff of some juicy rumor...
But all I did was dig up my own forbidden past...
I'm going to become the laughing stock of the port now... Uuu...
...Pffhaha.
Don't laugh at me, Commander!
No, no, I'm not laughing at you, it's just...
The moment I let down my guard a little...
Now! Nyahaha~
Santa Fe jumps like a nimble kitten and snatches the notebook out of my hand, and then makes a beeline for the exit!

sequence:
Our Eighth Mystery

<size=45>7 Birth of the Eighth Mystery!</size>

scripts.say: I chase Santa Fe up to the lighthouse's observation deck.
Haah... haah... Finally, I managed to get away...
Are you sure about that?
AAAAAAAAH!
Seeing my face covered in shadows, Santa Fe jerks in fear and hugs the pink notebook to her chest.
C-Commander, listen!
Just... Just forget what you saw back there! Forget all of it, please!
But you poured all your heart and soul into writing it...
But... But...!
...Oh, fine! You already know all my secrets anyway!
Nyahaha... I never thought something like this would rise to the top of the rumor mill...
Don't be so hard on yourself. There might've been some hiccups along the way... but your secret tome actually had some pretty salient points.
Salient? How so?
It ruined our night together, and I even got my embarrassing past exposed...
But I mean, look... This is the perfect place for a date, isn't it?
I walk up to Santa Fe, and lean against the railing.
A gentle sea breeze blows past, the moonlight shining down on the calm waters of the sea. The port's lights are barely visible in the distance.
Santa Fe's flushed face, lit up by the moon, looks more adorable than usual.
Rumor has it that this is the Tome of Eternal Love that guarantees an eternity with your loved one.
Maybe it's not some legendary tome... But actually a record of the night we spent together.
Commander, do you, uhm...
Going out chasing rumors with me, getting lost, dropping into pitfalls, digging up my embarrassing history...
Do you think that's really fun... I mean, uh, r-r-r-romantic?
Of course. Thanks to you, I got to experience how fun it is to chase rumors out in the field.
Santa Fe looks stunned for a moment, but then regains her usual cheeriness.
Nyaha, nyahahahaha! You're right! It's my plan, so it couldn't possibly have gone wrong!
It was a bit roundabout, but my plan was a HUGE SUCCESS!
I got you to praise my date... and I'm going to hog all of your time for myself!
Or else... I'll spread rumors about how I tricked you into going on a lighthouse date!
Oh, you're trying to blackmail me?
Heheh, what I'm trying to say is that I've got you in the palm of my hand! Nyahaha!
The next day, in the afternoon, I work through the documents we left behind last night...
Commander!
Santa Fe storms into the office, smartphone in hand.
Commander, you're not gonna believe this! This is huge!
What's wrong? A new rumor?
The seven mysteries of the port... got updated to eight!
Look at this! "Classified scoop! A couple's shadow at the abandoned lighthouse?!"
And see the comments?! "One of the shadows looks like the Commander?!"
The picture posted is indeed of Santa Fe and me standing at the top of the lighthouse last night.
...One of the other girls must have been training around there and spotted us.
Whoa... It's totally popping off...
A rumor about me is trending, huh...?
Santa Fe steps closer and wraps her arm around mine, smiling.
But that makes us the couple everyone's gossiping about...
We're together forever... Not just in real life, but also in the port's rumors!
Santa Fe rubs her cheek against my chest in satisfaction, like a cat who got her paws on fish.
I'll always pursue the hottest gossip in the port, and I'll take you with me on my pursuit!
Seeing her smile broadly like that, I can't help but smile back and ruffle her hair.
I get the feeling the coming days will be anything but boring.

sequence:
Letters from Valley Hospital

<size=45>1 Prologue</size>

scripts.say: I never would've thought a regular old letter would lead me to a place like this.
Half a year ago, I received my last letter from Miller.
As long-time investigation partners, she and I have constantly stayed in touch.
This time, though, her correspondence had an ominous quality to it.
In the letter, she sang the praises of the sights around Valley Hospital, where she'd been admitted for a commissioned investigation.
Things quickly took a shocking turn, however, and she began telling me about the unnerving things she'd experienced.
The downright excessive friendliness of the hospital staff, someone interfering with her investigation, hasty footsteps echoing in the night...
After that final letter, there was not so much as a peep from her.
I tried again and again to contact Valley Hospital, only to receive the same answer each time.
"Upon examination, we could find no patient in our care under the name of Miller."
Given the seriousness of the situation, I began secretly looking into this hospital myself.
On the surface, it is indeed a comprehensive medical institution that performs medical research and provides outpatient care and high-end medical services.
Through my investigation, I learned that there have been disappearances of homeless people in the area around the hospital.
Not only that, there have also been cases of ordinary former patients going missing following the end of their stay.
My detective's instinct told me two things: That Miller had been caught up in some extraordinary incident, and that I need to spring into action immediately.
After determining my entry point, I spent a lot of money bribing key people and forging a perfect ID.
Starting today, I will be hospitalized under the guise of a naval commander who needs treatment for high stress.
And so, I got into a wobbly rustbucket and headed for the hospital nestled deep in the mountains.
Once I finally reach my destination, I gasp in awe of the scenery, far more beautiful than I had imagined.
There, Valley Hospital stands – a red brick building, bathed in sunlight and glowing warmly.
All around me, old oak trees stand proud while the wind blows through a well-maintained garden, the faint scent of flowers gracing my nose.
I arrive at the hospital entrance and find several nurses already waiting for me there.
Welcome, Commander. We've been waiting for you.
Commaaander... You smell so hot... Heheh...
I wanna get a good taste of you later during our... examination... heheh...
Rest assured, our hospital provides the finest service. I guarantee you'll have a wonderful time here.
Should you have any questions, I'm always happy to help.
We will protect your health like one would a fine treasure.
Heehee. Alright, wrap it up, girls. We have all the time in the world.
Commander, allow me to guide you through the admittance procedure.
As you see, the hospital is divided into five areas: The medical center, the inpatient building, the recuperation center, the logistics center, and the research center.
You're free to come and go through these areas during the day. If you need any help, the head nurse of each area will assist you.
However, after the sun sets, you have to follow the staff's instructions and rest in your room, okay?
Alright. I understand.
(I'll have to keep my investigating to the night hours, then...)
Okay, then come with me. The reception's over here.

sequence: <size=34>And so, I successfully infiltrated Valley Hospital as a regular patient.</size>
<size=34>It's time to start my investigation in earnest.</size>
<size=34>Wait for me, Miller, my good old partner.</size>
<size=34>I swear on my honor that I'll bring you back.——</size>

scripts.say: Ah, you've come. Then let us begin the feast.
Allow me to congratulate you on becoming the board chairman of Valley Hospital, {playername}.
The bright, spacious hall is adorned with striking decorations, shining with a gorgeous light.
Akagi, who shares control of the hospital with me, leans gracefully against the high backrest of her chair, exuding a leisurely yet refined aura.
If I have one issue with this feast, it's that it's just a bit too quiet.
Is it just us here?
Why, yes, of course it's just us. Heehee.
Are you saying that you wished someone else would've come?
Above her sweetly curved lips is a pair of eyes filled with unmistakable possessiveness.
Now, come to me, please. Let us drink the night away.
Lifting one hand, she provocatively curls up a fair, supple finger, beckoning me.
Spurred on, I take a seat right next to her, and she hands me her half-full glass of clear, high-quality drink.
Its texture is velvety, and its taste, utterly delectable. Won't you have a little, to start with?
After all, it will be a little while longer before the dinner is ready.
On the rim of the beautiful glass is attached a soft imprint – that of her lips.
I take the glass from her and drink along the imprint of her lips, downing it all at once.
How daring of you, my esteemed chairman... Heehee.
You shouldn't be afraid to take a more direct approach to relieving boredom, right?
I take the glass from her and drink from a spot her lips haven't touched, downing it all at once.
My, my, esteemed chairman, is there still something holding you back? Heehee.
We can't have any moderation tonight. For you see, what comes next... Heehee.
As soon as she finishes speaking, it feels like someone is touching my calf.
Looking down, I see the red string wrapped around her ankle is brushing against my calf.
Then, with a clear jingle from the accessories adorning her body, she stands up.
She cuts the distance between us with easy steps, then bends forward before me and looks right into my eyes.
The many tails behind her quickly wrap around my body, pulling me closer without any regard for my consent.
The subduedly sweet aroma of the drink mingles with Akagi's own scent, as her warm breath tickles my ear.
Close your eyes... and enjoy this feast for just you and I♡

sequence:
Letters from Valley Hospital

<size=45>11 Epilogue</size>

scripts.say: Congrats on making it to the end, "ace detective!"
The ending where the bloodkin's glory is restored was quite excellent.
Speaking as the screenwriter, I'm very pleased that you all managed to perfectly replicate the story and setting I imagined.
Commander, you worked hardest of all. Come out and accept your praise!
As though that was the signal, an invisible curtain falls and all the "actors" who had left the scene returned one by one onto the stage.
Been waiting for you, Commander! So, how'd you like the GOAT's acting? Pretty awesome, eh?
A-and obviously I didn't train at all, outside of the expected practice with the other actors!
Yeah, I can vouch for her! Because I sure as heck didn't see her practicing how to use a sling in front of a mirror at 3 in the morning!
Even though this was my first time doing an event like this, I can say it's got the same kind of thrill as a good adventure.
It's a shame I never got to use my stuff, though. Like my first aid kits, multitools, mountaineering ropes, or waterproof tent...
The fact they never saw any use is a good thing, honestly.
Well, they would've been handy to have if we got shipwrecked while on the yacht. It's a pity that wasn't part of the script.
The reason for that is because the voyage was immediately before the end!
*sigh*... It's already over. Bummer.
I barely got to spend any time with the Commander...
Really? I'd say you got to spend plenty of time.
- You just don't get it!  - You don't understand.
- She's right. - Agreed.
Excuse me?
I don't... understand?
But... it was I who wrote the script!

sequence: Letters from Valley Hospital - The End

scripts.say: THUD!
The door to the sickroom shuts, and then the footsteps that had been wandering in the area grow more distant.
(Those creepy nurses should be gone by now.)
As soon as I breathe a sigh of relief, the curtains around my bed are pulled aside with a hard tug.
Huff... Puff... I knew I could smell you...
I've got you now, Commander!
Caught off guard, I'm suddenly pushed flat onto the bed. Before I can even fight back, Mogador mounts me, her face flushed and breathing heavily.
I can't help but wonder – why would our dear patient hide in here all alone? Ahah♥
Her eyes are darting everywhere, her body is hot to the touch, and she's shockingly strong. One thing is clear: She's not thinking straight.
(Something's wrong with her... I need to find an excuse...)

options.content: I asked for a physical examination.

scripts.say: Heh... That's exactly what I thought.
In that case...
Allow me to do the honors. Heehee♥
Lost? Where were you going?
I was going to get a physical check-up.
Then you might as well do it here. I'll perform your physical checkup... Heehee♥
How do you expect to do that? There's no equipment here.
Haha... I don't need equipment♥ I know the latest and greatest examination method that requires no tools.
She leans over me, her hot breaths caressing my neck.
*sniff sniff*... It's called an olfactory examination.
Ahh... God, yes... The smell of fresh sweat... *sniff sniff*...
Your body's awfully stiff, though... Are you hurt?
Nope.
*sniff sniff*... It's not nice to lie, Commander... Your smell tells the truth...
You know what? I'm going to give you a full-body inspection... Hahhh♥
Swiftly and dextrously, she runs her dainty fingers along my body. Those feverish eyes are swirling with lust and elation.
Your clothes are in the way... Mine, too, actually! Let me just...♥
With a rough, impatient motion, she starts pulling on my clothes.
Mogador!
I try to pin her hands down, but she twists her body and evades my grip with no effort.
Hahh, ahh... What a serious expression... Are you feeling nervous? Or embarrassed?
Okay, I'll turn off the lights to help you calm down. Heehee♥
Right as she said those words, all the lights in the room went out.
Huff... Puff...♥
Her soft body covers me, and her feverish, hot breath tickles my ear.
There we go... There's nothing to be embarrassed or nervous about... Nobody can see us in the darkness...
Now let's continue the examination... Hahh♥
Nurse Franklin stands by my bedside in a clean hospital room. She shifts her gaze from the patient records in her hand and onto me.
So, Commander, any way I can help you?
I hold my tongue for the moment and study her closely.
Although she has the same composed smile as always, her body is strangely covered in a faint layer of sweat.
CLUNK!
Just then, the door in the back closes, and I even hear it lock up.
Based on my experience thus far, that door won't be opening for a while.
Looks like you've hurt your hand, huh?

options.content: It's no big deal. I'll tend to it myself.

scripts.say: Alright. Let me patch you up, then.
By yourself?
No, we can't do that. You have a nurse ready to help right here!
I wouldn't be doing my job if I let my patients treat their own wounds.
A sensual undertone in her smile gradually deepens. Her eyes ooze with irrepressible yearning.
What are you staring at?
Come on, let me tend to your hand.
She gazes at me with unabashed passion, the redness of her cheeks becoming increasingly evident.
Phew... Is it just me, or is it hot in here?
She loosens her collar and uses her hand to fan herself, as if trying to cool down.
Settle down, me... Don't get impatient...♡
Okay, let's see that hand. Nurse Franklin will take good care of you.
First aid kit in hand, she crouches in front of me and leans against my knees. Her warmth seeps through the fabric.
Then, she takes my hand and expertly tends to my wound, moving with swift precision but applying a jarring amount of force.
The pain causes my fingers to stiffen.
She clearly picks up on this small reaction and loosens her grip.
Did that hurt?
Sorry about that. I can be a little... careless sometimes.
She looks up to meet my gaze. There is an inexplicable glimmer in her eyes.
Next, I'll be more careful and gentle♡
There we go... All done!
Thank you.
No need to thank me. It's just the way we are with each other, isn't it?
Having said that...
She squeezes my hand with both of hers, pulls me up, and takes a sudden step forward to embrace me.
Her sweaty, hot body sticks to me, and her hair graces my cheek, carrying her unique fragrance.
If you really wanna thank me, can you do me a favor?
My vision blurs all of a sudden. Before I know it, I'm on the bed after she's pushed me into it.
It looks like she's sweating more than just a moment ago.
I just... It feels like being close to you is the only way to release this heat inside of me...
Come on... Come closer♡
Late at night, I hear a sound behind the curtains in the corner of the room. Treading carefully, I come close and pull the curtains aside...
Commander?!
For some reason, nurse Washington is behind them. Upon seeing me, a look of anticipation fills her eyes for a moment.
You here to help with my clinical practice?
Excuse me? Clinical practice?
Yeah, you heard me!
Before I can say another word, she forcibly pulls me into bed, cutting the distance between us while I'm helpless to do anything.
Alright, let's get started! Don't waste my time!
First off, I'm gonna check your heartbeat!
With those words, she picks up a stethoscope and reaches out to me.
Or rather, she tries to, but the tube gets caught on the string of her top.
Buh?!
Surprised by the tug on her clothes, she lets out a small cry.
The fabric is stretched, and her already tight clothes leave an imprint on her body.
I-I'm fine! Just got caught off guard, that's all!
Playing it cool, she tries to untangle the tube from her clothes. Owing to her nerves, it doesn't go so well.
I'm fine! I can handle this myself!
With a confident look, she tries hard to get the tube loose. However, her nervousness only makes things worse for her.
It's not long before the exertion starts to paint her exposed skin a pinkish red.
I come closer and take the stethoscope out of her hand.
Look, I can... Eh, whatever.
If you wanna help so badly, you do it, then!
She lets go and hands the reins over to me.
I manage to untangle the tube from her clothes in no time.
There you go.
Thanks...
With flushed cheeks, she thanks me in a hushed, embarrassed voice. Then, she furrows her brow and raises her voice.
Alright! Let's forget that little accident happened and get on with the practice!
You're my patient, so act like it – lie down!
She rapidly comes closer and pushes me into the bed again.
This practice has just gotten started, you hear...
Well, dear patient...
Or perhaps I should call you "Detective"?
Whatever the case, you've been investigating me, haven't you?
Suzuya lies sprawled lazily on the bed, her lips curving into a vague smile.
As for myself, I've been restrained tightly to the bed with straps, unable to move a single muscle.

options.content: I just want to learn the truth about this hospital.
You've got it wrong! I'm not your enemy!

scripts.say: The truth, you say...
You're searching for something you don't need to know. If you want to make better use of your time...
Is that so? You don't get to decide whether I'm your ally or not, Detective.
If I were you, I'd focus on something more important than our relation to one another.
She takes the syringe in her hands and slowly lifts it up to her lips. The liquid inside of it is red and gives off a beguiling light.
Running the tip of the needle along her tongue, she reaches toward my knee with her free hand and strokes it gently.
Guess what's inside this syringe. What do you think will happen if I inject you with it?
Cat got your tongue, hmm?
Bzzzt. Incorrect, I'm afraid.
If you really don't know, then why don't we test it and find out?
She leans forward a bit and closes the distance between us. The light in her eyes grows brighter.
Oh dear, your body is quite stiff.
Are you afraid? Heehee.
She gently shakes the syringe. The cold gleam off its surface makes me squint.
The expected sting of the needle never comes; instead, I feel the softness of Suzuya's touch.
Please rest assured, I would never use any drugs on you.
Nor will I hurt you in any way.
She puts the syringe aside and straddles me.
A soft sensation graces my knees, and she speaks to me with a tone indicative of worry and helplessness.
However, if I don't, I won't be able to leave work for today...
For you see, it's my job to provide treatment.
She runs her fingers over my skin without reserve.
As she moves, the temperature in the room seems to rise slightly, as though the warmth of her body seeps through her fingertips and spreads through the air.
Oh, I just had a wonderful idea. Perhaps we could...
I turn my head up and meet her gaze.
Try it a different way, hmm~?
Mmh...
Voroshilov, lying on the sickbed, slowly opens her eyes. She vacantly surveys her surroundings before finally fixing her gaze on me.
Had a good rest?
You passed out all of a sudden earlier, so I laid you down here to rest.
I did a quick check, and I couldn't find anything physically wrong with you. However...
I see...
Listlessly, she stretches her arms, seemingly unfazed by what I just said.
The midday sunlight coming through the window casts her shadow. It feels like an uneventful, calm early afternoon.
Heehee...
Hm?!
Just as I walk closer to speak to her, my body suddenly refuses to obey me.
That's when I realize that she was only pretending to fall unconscious. It was a trap to get me to lower my guard.
Sorry, Detective, you're just too shrewd.
I wouldn't be able to restrain you without resorting to dirty tricks like this.

options.content: What did you do to me?

scripts.say: That's what you're worried about?

options.content: I don't mean you any harm. Maybe we can work together.

scripts.say: She scoffs at me, clearly unwilling to engage in any conversation about this.
Say what you wish. Right now, you're mine.
As she says that, she leans against me and swiftly lays my collar bare.
It's only then that I notice she has a stethoscope in her hand.
Voroshilov... What are you going to do?
Beneath those detached eyes lies a faint smile.
There are many, many things a nurse can do to their patient.
She looks at my motionless body and into my eyes, a hint of mischief in her expression.
For instance...
The cold head of her stethoscope touches my chest, sending a shiver through me.
Bear with it. It only feels cold in the beginning.
The emotion concealed in her eyes is as intense as the color of red wine – I feel like I'll lose myself in them.
It'll warm up soon. As will you... and I.
Lying down in my clean and comfy bed, I let the waves of fatigue wash over me, my eyelids getting heavier and heavier.
Here we go...
There is a mutter, and my bed shakes slightly.
I open my eyes and turn in the sound's direction.
Nyahaha... Still up, Detective?
Santa Fe freezes in the position she snuck into bed with. She has the awkward look of a criminal caught red-handed.
I was asleep until you woke me up.
Ohh... Sorry! I wasn't trying to, honestly!
Let me make it up to you by... sleeping right beside you! Nyahaha!
You were going to do that anyway, weren't you?
Uhh, the thing is... This place is just so creepy that I'm terrified to sleep by myself!
So I came to you!
It's sooo reassuring when you're with me, so I think I'll sleep like a log by your side!
Pleeease! Don't send me away, O great and almighty Detective!
Well, since you're already here, just stay.
Yay! You're the best! Nyahaha!
Having received my permission, the tension in her eyes fades away, replaced by a carefree smile.
She hugs her pillow tightly and sits on the bed, eyes blinking and looking at me.
What's the matter? Aren't you going to sleep?
Heehee♪
Planting both her hands on the bed, Santa Fe adopts a mysterious air as she begins to whisper to me.
I'll bet you know all kinds of juicy gossip, Detective!
Can you tell me something? You know... as a bedtime story!
C'mooon, don't make that face! I promise I won't tell anyone.
THUD!
All of a sudden, a muffled noise sounds from outside the room.
Eeek! Help me, Detective!
She leaps like a startled cat and throws herself into my chest, gripping my collar tightly.
Hey, don't be scared. I'll go and have a look. You stay here.
W-wait! It always goes badly for people in movies when they go off on their own like this!

options.content: I'm the main character. I'll be fine.

scripts.say: You... sound strangely convincing when you put it like that.
Wait... If you're the MC, wouldn't it put me in danger if you left me behind?!
I-I'll come with you!
She hurriedly rises to her feet, wrapping her arms around one of mine.
Okay, let's go!
Phew... So that's all it was! The blackboard just fell off the wall!
After seeing that nothing of note happened in the corridor, we both returned to the hospital room.
While Santa Fe sounds nonchalant in tone, she hasn't let go of my arm in the slightest.
As soon as I get into bed, she leaps into my chest again. She is still trembling slightly.
A while later, she finally manages to calm down and relaxes her shoulders.
By which I mean, she is back to being cocky again.
Hmm... I'm bored.
Since you won't share any gossip with me, I'll tell you some that I know!
Ready? You better strap in, 'cause it's a long one!
She tightly buries her face in my arms and snickers to herself.
Ready or not, we have the whole night ahead of us, pal! Nyahaha!
I arrive at the room Miller has been confined to and look around the area. Then, suddenly...
Partneeer!
A sweet, bouncy voice rings out from overhead.
I lift my gaze, and there she is – Miller lands right in front of me, suspended upside-down.
How'd you like the GOAT's entry, huh? Pretty awesome, I dare say! I'm... Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Her proud parade is rained on as the very next moment, she starts spinning around in the air.
Careful! Here, take hold of my shoulders!
Hahaha! The GOAT is used to this! I could handle it in my sleep!
But, if you insist, I suppose I'll oblige!
She puts her squishy paws on my shoulders and manages to stabilize herself.
Okay, now we need to get you out of those shackles.
I scan the area, searching for a key or a tool that can break through the chains.
After some time, I realize that Miller's gaze is completely fixated on my face.
What? Is something wrong?
No. It's nothing...
She mutters a response, then – taking care not to cut me with her sharp claws – wraps her arms around my shoulders, giving me a gentle embrace.
I just wanted to hug you...
The distance separating us silently vanishes in a sweet warmth.
Then, there is a click – the shackles on her feet come undone.
I quickly catch her as she falls down, holding the little girl tightly in my arms.
You already knew how to get it off?
Yup! Just had to follow the chain to find it! Piece of cake when you're GOATed like me!
Well, not exactly. I managed to open it right when you got here.
Stuff like this is why we make such a good team!
You could've told me sooner.
But that's lame. It's much more majestic to descend from above! Makes you pay more attention to me, too!
She rubs her cheek against mine. It's soft and warm, although her fluffy hair tickles a little.
Then, with the lightness of a feather, she gives me a small kiss.
Thanks for coming to save me, partner!
Arriving at the agreed-upon location, I push open the door.
On the other side is a brightly lit room, adorably decorated with stuffed animals everywhere you look. The atmosphere is strikingly different from any other room in the hospital.
Surrounded by plushies, the "little rabbit" looks at me with a satisfied smile.
Right on time.

options.content: Are you having a party in here?

scripts.say: For a moment, Halford's expression is one of joy, but she quickly neutralizes her smile, leaving only the blush on her cheeks.
Go on, take a seat!
That I am. Go on, take a seat!
Doing as told, I sit down on the empty couch next to her.
Ahem... If you'd rather sit beside me, feel free to... um...
Halford glances at the couch I'm sitting on, hesitates for a moment, then shifts her gaze and changes the subject entirely.
What I mean to say is... how do you like the party?
From this attire to these stuffed animals, I arranged it all for you.
I thought you'd find it relaxing to be surrounded by such cute things... It is for me, at least...
So, I hope you'll be able to unwind in here.
All this running around the hospital ever since we joined forces has surely been exhausting, no?
Thanks for arranging a party just for me. I'm moved, truly.
Why didn't you ask anyone else for help? You've been just as busy as me.
I couldn't with peace of mind entrust others with the task of organizing a party for you.
Besides, if they knew about it, they'd gather here in droves.
Then you wouldn't be able to relax – they'd just wear you out even more.
Having said that, if it's a more lively atmosphere you want, I can summon some friends.

options.content: I have everything I need right here.
You being here is all I need.

scripts.say: It must've been a lot of work setting all this up.
It was nothing. Need I remind you I'm the lord of the bloodkin, with eternal power? Fatigue is a foreign concept to me.
You'd know no hardship either if you'd only become a member of my clan.
I give her a smile in lieu of an answer.
But enough about that. Rest and recuperate now.
I'm so glad to have you, Halford.
Huh? What's this all of a sudden?
I'm not going anywhere if that's what you think. Just concentrate on relaxing, you!
I reply with a nod, then relax my shoulders and sink into the couch.
Now that I can breathe easy, all the fatigue catches up to me at once, making me sleepy.
Are you going to have a nap?
Yeah... I could get some shut-eye.
In that case...
Bashfully, she clings to her Dora plushie, her cheeks turning red.
...Why don't you rest your head in my lap? It's more comfortable...
She finally musters the courage to beckon me closer, and from that point on, her speech becomes more fluid.
Since we've decided you're going to rest, we must aim for the best rest you can get, no?
Now, come. You'd be wise to accept this honor offered by the lord of the bloodkin!

sequence: I, Götz von Berlichingen...
Do solemnly swear upon the Hagiobull.
In the name of the supreme divine light.
In the name of the great, wise Emperor.
I shall defy the netherworld...
And stand strong against its evils.
No matter the price, even my very life...
I will guard this sacred land to my last breath.
I shall fight and fight, until...

scripts.say: Amidst the radiant light, all went silent.
Everything dissolved into a void, as if my very senses had been plucked out of me.
(Well, isn't this a familiar turn of events?)
I gaze into the pure white before me. It gazes back.
After some unknown stretch of time, the world finally regains its color.
Commander, are you okay? Do you feel unwell anywhere?
As my vision returns to me, I'm met with concerned looks from Memphis and Helena.
I'm fine... You get used to it eventually.
Good to see the two of you are okay. Did you wake up before me?
Mhm... Only by a little, though.
Clemenceau has already left with a team to scout our surroundings, but judging from the view through the window...
The window...?
I turn and look outside the window. Sunlight shines on the fields around us. Nothing seems unusual about the grass.
Except...
Someone's been taking awfully good care of the lawn. The castle seems pretty well lived-in...

options.content: Did we arrive at another test site?

scripts.say: That's certainly one possibility.
Right on cue, Clemenceau's voice flows through the intercom by my seat.
We've confirmed the surrounding area is safe, but so far, there are no signs of life.
Don't leave the cabin yet. I'd like to make some minor adjustments to the Tribunal's Hand to adapt to our circumstances.
Adjustments such as...?
Heehee. Take a look at this.
A display suddenly descends from the ceiling, showing a structural diagram of the plane.
Now, let's begin.
A rhythmic vibration radiates through the cabin, and the diagram onscreen begins to transform.
All of the modules on the aircraft start to change, from the nose to the wings to the engine.
It's not like parts simply being rearranged either – certain modules disappear, while others materialize as if they had always been there.
The changes quickly become evident inside the cabin as well. The floors and walls re-form in real time, the interior becoming more and more spacious.
In only a matter of minutes, the comfortable cabin interior has completely transformed into a functional command center with panoramic visibility.
Indeed, the plane I had arrived in has now turned into a juggernaut of a mobile command center.
Say, you wouldn't happen to have access to Antiochus manufacturing technology, would you?
Or rather... if you have tech as advanced as this, why did you need to tow it over?
Bravo, Commander. As perceptive as always.
Firstly, I like to keep the specs of the Tribunal's Hand secret. It is, as you might surmise, a special part of the Tribunal's security apparatus.
Secondly, does it not stand to reason that you would need a "trailer" to move an "aircraft" where there is no runway?
Just as these sorts of airplanes cannot take off without a runway, you can consider it as an underlying principle of its "concept."
I must say though, seeing Queen Elizabeth's train did give me a flash of inspiration.
If you're curious, we can slowly go over the specifics when there's more time.
But alas, there are more pressing issues at hand.
A hologram pops up from the central console. It seems Clemenceau can control it even from outside the plane.
The recon drone I just sent out has stopped responding. It happened just as it crossed the boundary of the area shown in this photograph.
A black region clearly incongruous with the surrounding greenery can be seen in the picture.
Its edges are artificial, like a swamp cut directly out of the earth.
Any radar results?
It doesn't detect the area whatsoever. Nothing is there, so I guess it thinks nothing is wrong.
Except that's wrong. My recon drone immediately lost all contact the moment it entered.
Hmm. I see.
Commander, you're not thinking...
Yep. Let's go check it out.
We're here to investigate Hierophant's omen.
Before we attempt to analyze her goals, we have to understand our situation.
Time is of the essence. Let's hurry.
By the way...
Can the Tribunal's Hand auto-pilot on land?
Though it's not out of the realm of possibility, it would be safer for me to handle it manually due to the severe lack of terrain data.
Also, heehee... I haven't had a chance to drive it in ages. It is rather stimulating, you see.
Now then, shall we depart?

sequence: Reims City Defensive Line
Purified Area
Shortly after...

scripts.say: Through our intervention, we managed to save the Iris fleet and secure the surrounding region.
After the netherworld was driven off, only a portion of the land reverted to normal. The rest of it had changed into unidentifiable, greyish-white crystal.
This is what happens to places that have been under the netherworld's influence for too long. It's a miracle that we managed to reclaim even a portion of it.
Incidentally, who are you people?
We're an advance team of reinforcements sent on Elbe's request. The rest should arrive within two days.
Phew... Thank goodness. I knew the Hagiobull Alliance wouldn't abandon us.
We will handle this sector. Will you all withdraw for the time being?
Of course not~ We'll be going to another base to provide support.
If I'm not mistaken, you must hail from the Iris, too. Would you like to join us?
Unfortunately, I'm already spoken for. I'd be happy to fight alongside you if we meet again, though.
Now, I'm sure you noticed the might of my Black Sun device...
If you want this war over quickly, then I'd ask that you tell me all about that Sacred Purification ritual of yours... and all other rituals, on that note.
Ending the war...
I'm sorry. We'd love to help you, but the cathedral where all of this information is stored has been swallowed along with the Orthodoxy's capital.
The cathedral's barrier may still hold, but getting there might as well be impossible.
I see... That's a shame.
Now isn't the time to venture unnecessary danger. We'll stick to a measured approach.
After a short rest, the Iris Orthodoxy fleet thanked us once more before heading off to their next battle.
I saw them off and considered battle positions for the coming days.
Just then, an unexpected person came to me.
I'd like to offer my gratitude to you again, Commander {playername}.
You've saved the Iris fleet, preserving a vital source of firepower for the Hagiobull Alliance.
That wasn't their first time performing the ritual, was it?
...You're right.
Unfortunately... [っ ̯ -]
I had no idea your forces were quite so formidable.
While you still hide many mysteries, we're happy to have you on our side.
(Many mysteries, huh?)
(I could say the same about you...)
Thanks to the Black Sun device, defending Reims was an easy feat.
It also made for a good opportunity to examine the netherworld up close.
Thanks to Clemenceau installing a laboratory module on the Tribunal's Hand, we were able to collect samples of it as well.
As for analysis... We may not have brought any researchers with us, but...
The Origin Cube turns gold? This is the first I've heard of that...
To think that it all began before the advent of the false god...
The situation over there is... ahem, remarkable. You're really living up to your test site's reputation.
Yorktown hypothesized that it might be a technological advancement made after the Antiochus left alpha.
If there comes an opportunity, we'd like to see the Black Sun device up close, too.
That's fine by me, but I have a question.
The local factions of this test site are on the weaker side, and they're stretched thin. Can Compiler be brought in to assist them?
We've considered it, but unfortunately, we can't.
Honestly, I wanted to rush in on my own the instant I saw abnormalities at your coordinates!
But despite the fact that we can communicate, we haven't been able to pinpoint that test site's exact location yet.
It's possible that Hierophant is using some sort of camouflage.
At any rate... It's going to take more time to crack this.
(With access to Tower lost, even bringing in reinforcements is a difficult feat...)
Understood. We'll be safe for the time being.
Roger that!
Two days later, Elbe arrived with reinforcements as planned. We handed off the purified defensive line to her.
After that, we continued our journey to Brandenburg.
Reims–
Köln–
Mainz–
Magdeburg–
Brandenburg–
When we reach Mainz, we're welcomed lavishly.
I've heard whisperings of your names, but at long last, we meet. Welcome to the Empire.
I am the Imperial Regent and elector, Köln. As a representative of the Holy Unitas Empire, I thank you deeply for your aid.
Though she resembles the Köln I know, her dress and demeanor are totally unlike our Köln's.
It's a pleasure to meet you. I'd assumed we wouldn't see you until Brandenburg.
Really? For a while, I considered going all the way to Köln to welcome you.
I'm aware that you came to meet me, and further, you bear our hopes and dreams. It's only natural that I'd make the effort.
Regensburg told us that you know the situation the best out of anyone.
Everyone along the way has been surprised by our sudden appearance, except for you.
I hope you'll take the time to answer our questions.
I'd be happy to. This is hardly the place to talk – let's return to the cathedral.
You said I wasn't surprised, but there is one thing that threw me off.
When I learned your names, I believed that Mainz was the Transcender that I summoned.
But now, I believe that she was only brought as a side effect.
The most significant among you is you, {playername}. That I'm certain of.
Oh? Why's that?
All of my companions are formidable fighters.
They're shipgirls, so that's only natural.
But you're different.
If a ritual summons shipgirls and one common person... one must wonder if that person is really so common.
I've prepared for the ritual within the cathedral.
According to the Hagiobull, there exists a way to bypass the line of elector succession: the Elector Certification Ritual.
Any shipgirl certified by the ritual can become an elector, even if seven already exist.
Of course, the prerequisite for this is identical to the Ritual of Descent – it requires the Transcender's help.
Why don't we begin with this simple verification process?

sequence: Mainz City
Cathedral
Shortly after...

scripts.say: Is that really all?
In the cathedral, Mainz stood in the center of a sea of candles prepared by Köln.
Indeed. Stand there and focus on your senses.
What am I supposed to feel, exactly?
This place, the origin of your name, the meanings within those things, and the expectations that come with them.
In the name of God, may you find what you seek.
She makes the final preparations and approaches me.
What should I do?
The Hagiobull does not dictate any specific actions be taken by the Transcender.
I think your presence is all that we require.
So I just... stand here?
I take a look around, getting a good view of the cathedral.
Though it's decorated with furniture from this era, it seems to be the shell of a giant mechanical apparatus.
(This must be another facility left by Hierophant...)
(It's safe, I hope.)
Köln steps out of the cathedral, leaving the two of us inside.
Amidst the lights of the cathedral, an ethereal chorus begins to echo throughout.
Mainz suddenly falls into a deep sleep, as if lulled by the sound.
What is this...?
Light materializes out of thin air, filling the world around me.
The public consciousness naturally has no conceived image of ships that have never been completed historically.
To bring such entities into existence through the power of a Wisdom Cube...
First, their blueprints must be completed in enough details to truly build them.
After that, their conceptual form must be fully visualized.
This is easier when they have sister ships of the same class already in existence. Using those ships makes it easy to define the visual parameters, after all.
However, things get more difficult when no such sister ship exists.
In those circumstances, the most efficient starting point would be the ship's name.
Forging a connection between name and archetype will help to create a more tangible and communicable visual form.
Would you say that's a full overview of the points we've agreed on thus far?
That about sums it up. I've been thinking, though – if a name and image can exist independently for a certain period of time...
What if we tried visualizing first, and then conceptually binding it to a name and then materializing it through a Wisdom Cube?
Would it feasibly work?
Friedrich, that power of yours...
Don't be surprised. I've merely taken another step further as a blueprint shipgirl.
This place, the origin of your name, the meanings within those things, and the expectations that come with them.
In the name of God, may you find what you seek.
Was that... Anzeel and Sophia discussing how to birth blueprint shipgirls?
Giving name to that which is nameless... Infusing meaning into the meaningless...
The meaning of a name, taking a step forward in the evolution of that connection...
I get it... This is the truth of the ritual!
The truth of the blueprint ship project!
In that case, the certification ceremony is guaranteed to succeed and give Mainz greater power.
Since the concept of the Holy See has already been tied to that singular answer, the Ritual of Descent is bound to succeed, too.
That answer being the repeated tying and retying of concepts, gradually amassing power in the process...
We'll need Marco Polo for this!
After Mainz's ritual, I postpone the journey to Brandenburg and instead travel directly to Avignon to conduct the Ritual of Descent.
This city could be considered the second in line to represent the Holy See, after Rome.
What a sense of deja vu...
Mainz–
Strasbourg–
Given the large scale of the Ritual of Descent, its execution requires the coordination of multiple cities.
Along the way, Götz suggests performing a deep-dive in Genoa, aiming to gain advance knowledge of the enemy's attack plans.
I have faith that investigating the netherworld can only serve to benefit us.
It's time to prove the worth of this mission – to prove that weakening the Empire's defenses is well worth the risk.
We'll warn you in advance of any enemy attacks. You just focus on that ritual!
I'll be praying for your success...
Be careful, everyone. Don't forget to maintain contact.
We'll be careful... [>w<]
Strasbourg–
Avignon–
The journey proceeded without incident.
Upon our arrival in Avignon, Köln immediately set about preparing for the ritual.
Given how late it was, and given the need for Götz's team to prepare, we scheduled it for noon the following day.
However, Clemenceau seemed troubled about something.
After dinner that evening, she invited me to the study to talk privately.
You'd like to split up for the time being?
I've been thinking about this for a while now.
You plan to have Marco Polo do the heavy lifting after the ritual, don't you?
If she finds out that I'm involved, it's going to seriously affect her willingness to help. Besides, there's too much we don't know about this test site.
Almost all of the Iris territory here has been engulfed by the netherworld, and the Tribunal has been scattered.
I intend to take charge of their work and rebuild the Tribunal.
None of that is your real priority though, is it?
You're curious about the records in the Orthodoxy's capital, and you want to see them as soon as possible... Isn't that right?
Hehe. Nothing gets past you, Commander.
You're exactly right.
Are you confident you can handle it?
Absolutely.
Take Algérie and La Galissonnière with you. We have enough defensive forces here to take care of ourselves.
I'd be happy to... Thank you for your thoughtfulness, Commander.
Until we meet again. I hope things go as smoothly for you as they will for me.

sequence: DOLYL AOLYL PZ SPNOA, AOLYL PZ ZOHKVD
DOLYL AOLYL PZ ZOHKVD, AOLYL PZ SPNOA
ADV ZPKLZ VM VUL JVPU
DOLU VUL MHPSZ, AOL VAOLY MSVBYPZOLZ

scripts.say: I see nothing but an endless expanse of white.
Shouldn't I be in the cathedral preparing for the ritual?
There was no chanting or sudden burst of light.
But before I knew it, I was in this world of whiteness.
No response.
I try to listen, but this place is all silence.
I try to look closer, but there is no path.
Was the ritual a failure?
That can't be...
It's all an authentication protocol left by Hierophant, after all.
If we performed the process incorrectly, then it only should've ended with no response.
But this...
Hm? Below me...
It seems this place isn't so empty. I realize that I'm standing on top of a level surface.
Upon noticing this, I try to walk forward, but I hit an invisible barrier.
Though it looks white, there are walls. Is it... a labyrinth?
But how are you supposed to navigate a labyrinth if you can't even tell where the walls begin and end?
Hah... There I go, overthinking things again.
You can't act, but if I seek an answer, you will always provide. Isn't that right?
Hierophant, tell me where to find Marco Polo.
I demand an answer from the expanse of white.
When I do, Marco Polo appears before me.
Ooohohoho! Well, well, if it isn't the Commander! Fancy seeing you again so soon!
Of course, the world can hardly function without Marco Polo!
I'm already caught up on everything! I'll go straight to test site ES-40111 and save the world in the name of the Holy See!
Rest assured and behold Marco Polo's great exploits!
Oh? Why are you just standing there in a daze?
Get moving at once! I'm ready and raring to show them my glory!
The world is suddenly engulfed in darkness.
When the white disappeared, I could swear that I locked eyes with Hierophant for a mere instant.
As usual, she was as lifeless as a statue, but I saw a mix of emotions in there. Some approval, some anticipation, and...
Anxiety...?

sequence: Genoa
Hagiobull Alliance Base
Götz's Party

scripts.say: After traversing the waterway to Genoa, Götz's team rushed to the Hagiobull Alliance military base.
As a coastal city protected by the Imperial barrier, Genoa had preserved a portion of the coastal region.
This made it the ideal location to observe the netherworld and perform deep-dives, and many of the remnants of the Sardegnia League's forces were concentrated here.
I didn't think you'd be back so soon.
Indeed... We've returned early, and without a single Deep-Dive Scroll to boot.
But as you know, the situation can change in the blink of an eye. At minimum, the electors have acknowledged the value of deep-dives.
By the way, Caracciolo, did you ever hear of the ritual of the Transcender during your time in Rome?
What purpose does it serve, exactly? Is it a ritual that summons someone called a Transcender from the heavens? Is it related to the Visitors from Beyond mercenaries?
I'm afraid I don't know much about the ritual, myself.
I have heard rumors of the mercenaries you speak of.
If I get the opportunity to speak with them directly, I may be able to glean something...
Avignon isn't too far away. Once their ritual is done, we can come up with an excuse to make them come here.
That won't do.
If the Ritual of Descent goes smoothly, then Köln will rush to perform the coronation as soon as possible.
Which means they'll head to Brandenburg rather than Genoa.
But if you insist... I may be able to contrive an opportunity.
Ahaha... Let's take care of business first!
U-2501, I've arranged for the Deep-Dive Protection Ritual to be performed.
When will you go under? And how deep do you plan to?
...To the limit.
I want to confirm some theories...
Theories, hmm?
We learned important information on this trip. Supposedly, using the Deep-Dive Scrolls to enter the netherworld weakens the Imperial barrier.
U-2501 speculates that the netherworld and the barrier may be two different manifestations of the same power.
In short, good intentions create the barrier, while evil intentions create the netherworld.
How ironic that we chose to call them Sin Shadows – shades of ill intent.
I heard this theory while in Rome.
But if that's the case, the evil intentions far outweigh the benevolent.
How could there be such a difference in evil's favor?
It might not only include evil thoughts... Maybe it includes negative emotion, too... [As the war gets worse for us, the negative emotion of despair gets stronger! <(_ _)>]
But it's still too big of a difference...
So it's only a theory... I need to verify it. [I wanna investigate it all night っ ̯ -。]
Nuh-uh! I'm not going in there exhausted!
It's dangerous at night... Why don't we wait until daytime?
Okay... [It's all the same inside the netherworld, anyway っ ̯ -。]

sequence: Avignon
Cathedral
After the ritual...

scripts.say: With Hierophant's assistance, the Ritual of Descent ended in success.
Marco Polo had appeared out of thin air in Avignon's cathedral, just like in test site theta.
After smugly making her grand entrance, she was markedly disappointed to find that she was in Avignon instead of Rome.
(What did Hierophant tell her before sending her in here?)
(I hope it wasn't something silly like, "The netherworld has appeared, the end is nigh"...)
Köln returns to the cathedral and requests that Marco Polo accompany her to Brandenburg for the coronation.
However...
Your world is driven by symbolism and rituals, no? Then I'd best understand the process of these rituals.
Marco Polo waves a hand, causing a pedestal to rise up from the cathedral floor.
The original Hagiobull... Well done, rescuing it from Rome.
The Holy See needs to read it carefully before making a decision.
There's a copy of the Hagiobull in Brandenburg, too...
Yes, a copy. I require the original.
An original and a copy might as well be worlds apart.
For example, have the patterns on this page been properly copied?
...Patterns?
Could it be? Are those patterns some sort of coded message?!
Of course they are.
That is where the value of the original lies.
*sigh*... If only my devoted servant Raffaello were here.
I suppose I'll just have to make do with Eugen there.
Oh? Treating me like little more than a warm body now, are you?
It's been ages since someone looked down on me so.
Excuse you. I require an assistant for the ritual – do you consider yourself worthy, or not?
Hmm... I'm sure Z2 would be more than happy to learn.
You're performing a ritual? But what kind?
Forgive my forwardness, but the most effective use of our time would be heading directly to Brandenburg for the coronation.
It's hardly as urgent as you think. The crown isn't going anywhere – you must choose your Emperor carefully.
A coronation does not simply birth an Emperor out of thin air. Have you even found a suitable candidate?
Presumably not. If you had a candidate, the seat would not have been vacant for so long.
...You're right. It won't work.
Clerical electors have no right to be chosen, and the secular electors and major nobles have failed to reach an agreement.
See? I understand your sense of urgency, but you must remain calm.
I have a question. If the "symbols" match, or however you call it, can a shipgirl become Emperor?
Yes, but it would be extremely difficult to have her certified.
Then what if you summoned an Emperor directly, like with the Ritual of Descent?
Friedrich der Große, for example.
Friedrich der Große... The Hagiobull's list of names includes no such shipgirl.
List of names?
Are all shipgirls in this world on that list before they're even created?
Yes. Very few know this secret, however...
But... Mainz and Marco Polo are not on the list, either. Perhaps it's not entirely impossible.
As for the title of Emperor, I've not heard the name Friedrich der Große... Which Frederick is her namesake, exactly? The first, second, or third?
I think it was the second...?
Hmm?
Pfft...
If she is Frederick II, then there should be no issue with the authentication.
However, the Imperial Summoning Ritual is not recorded within the holy texts...
No worries there. Marco Polo and I can handle it. Isn't that right?
Also, why were you laughing just now?
Ah! Nothing important. I was just remembering a funny joke!
Friedrich will do! Leave the summoning ritual to us!
Heheheh... Friedrich will be perfect for my plans, too...
What are you scheming now?
While I was investigating the secret messages in the Hagiobull, I found a ritual that seems to fit the description of the Imperial Summoning Ritual.
But you see, it has a prerequisite. When I mentioned preparing for the ritual, I was referring to fulfilling said requirement.
...Did you have this plan in mind the whole time?
Wh-why, of course.
And do tell, what is this prerequisite?
The Kingdom of Sicily itself!
Why?
The Kingdom of Sicily must exist... Maybe you are right.
I'm not following. What does it mean?
Don't you worry about it. You'll understand when the time comes.
You summoned me here because you needed my special expertise, no? Then have faith in my decisions!
Back on topic, the Imperial Summoning Ritual requires the existence of Sicily.
However, Sicily itself has been engulfed by the netherworld. Yet to drive back the netherworld, the coronation must first be performed.
A paradox, if I've ever heard one.
It certainly sounds like it.
But in reality...
Test site ES-131618 – the one with the Sardegnia League – features an intact Apennine Peninsula, while the regions outside of the peninsula are missing.
Fits suspiciously well with this test site, doesn't it?
It... fits?
Are you saying you're going to piece them together?!
Exactly!
Through the Worldlinking Ritual, we'll bridge the two test sites to create one complete entity!
I-is that even possible?
Heheh. The Hagiobull says it is.
You all lack the power to fight the netherworld, don't you?
The Sardegnia League's people act on my command. One little link, and bam! Our firepower has grown exponentially!
Besides, what is a Holy See without its own Urbs Aeterna?
Well? Go on and praise my genius!
(Rather than create a Singularity to merely connect two test sites, she wants to overlap portions of them together?)
(They're both Hierophant's test sites. Could she be incorporating some foundational element of their design into this plan?)
(Or is this the next level of artificial Singularity technology?)
Under any other circumstances, I would have rejected such an insane plan.
But Hierophant trusts you. I suppose I'll have to trust you, too.
Do you think it'll work?
Don't worry. I have absolute confidence.
Then do what you must.
Ooohohoho! Prinz Eugen and Z2, come with me! It's time to prepare for the Worldlinking Ritual!

sequence: Netherworld
Unknown location

scripts.say: U-2501 descended alone into the black depths.
To the untrained eye, this area would look like uniform darkness – but her eyes revealed a distinct spectrum.
(The abyss has definitely been changing with each of my deep-dives.)
(At first, I couldn't distinguish anything. The next time, it was fuzzy... and this time, I can see everything clearly.)
(Deep purple, dark blue, crimson... The netherworld really is woven from endless malice.)
(And those hostiles...)
