A few days after Operation Basilica...
This is what the ports are like in the Iron Blood, huh... It's totally different from what we have in the Sakura Empire~
Say, I-58, what'd you think about those walls of light back there? They had me a bit spooked.
It's probably similar to our barriers...
...Besides, that was your job. Did you get the recordings?
course I did! You know I wouldn't let Akagi down~
Oh, there's someone coming.
Oh my, what a pair of cuties we have here... Welcome to the Iron Blood, my dear guests from the Sakura Empire~
I heard that you even had to participate in an operation before coming here. Hopefully neither of you were hurt?
(whispers) She's just as Akagi described... Beautiful, but with a deep emptiness beneath her words... Since I'm here, just keep your mouth shut, 26...
Did Akagi really say that about me? Ehehe~ I'm going to blush from all that praise~♪
...Akagi told me that the Iron Blood is safekeeping something...
Right you are, and it's in this very box. Treat it gently on your way back, okay~?
Yes... Akagi said that it's a file of great importance... and should never be opened.
I'm glad that we're on the same page. Oh, and could you relay another message to Akagi for me?
"Our tea is unclouded. I'm looking forward to having you at our party."
Mediterranean Sea - Malta
Withered grass beneath the cloudy skies... the smell of gasoline... the sound of propellers and engines...
What an awful place for a tea party... But, what else is one to do in front of the Royal Navy's forward base?
Sister? Le Terrible, is that you over there?
Sure is. Oh my, if it isn't my cute and elegant little sister. How have you been?
How long has it been? I haven't seen you since Mers-el-Kébir...
Wait, did you come here instead of heading to Casablanca?
Yup. Had to do some soul-searching after all, as well as some research.
But you know... I still have some reservations about fighting with the Royal Navy.
You're as honest as ever... It's true that given what happened to Dunkerque, everyone is still a bit on edge... especially Richelieu...
It'll be fine, my wise sister. You don't have to say anything that this fool hasn't already heard.
Le Terrible...
Algérie asked me to tell Richelieu about Jean Bart's recovery.
Has she left the Vichya Dominion yet?
It's all a bit rushed, but if the elder sister isn't allowed to make her move, the younger one won't take the next step either.
Huh? What do you mean by that?
Well, tell you what. Let's wait until Richelieu comes back before we talk about work.
More importantly...
I'm back, Le Triomphant, my lovely little sister~
Wait... Le Terrible...
Ohh? Should the Knight-Princess of Iris Libre really be crying so readily? Here, have some tea...
Ah, this tea's a bit too hot, isn't it...
Mozambique Strait - Siren-Contested Area
Did you really not tell Illustrious about that?
Correct. Some things are better kept hidden for now.
If I was to disclose that information, the Royal Navy would undoubtedly begin to weigh the costs versus the benefits.
Is that so...? I trust your judgment, Richelieu, but I suppose that means I can't tell them anything either.
Ahh, to once again harbor such secrets... What a sinful girl you are, Jeanne...
Though I don't even know about this secret, to turn my back against the teachings of the Heavenly Father and withhold such important information from my allies...
(Right, Jeanne doesn't know about the details either...)
This Basilica symbolized the bright future that awaited the Iris Orthodoxy.
But now that it has fallen into the hands of the Vichya Dominion and the Iron Blood, the darker side that has been hidden in the shadows is about to be revealed.
Such things must not be allowed to happen. This does not solely concern Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion, but also holds true for the Royal Navy and Iron Blood.
Jeanne, please forgive me for hiding this information from you.
Don't worry, Richelieu. I have no doubt that your actions are just.
If possible, I would like to resolve this situation without having to cross swords with the Vichya Dominion.
I have no desire to strike down my compatriots, but above all, those girls do not bear the mark of sin.
If the Vichya Dominion has chosen to accompany Iron Blood down the wrong path, it is our responsibility to correct that path.
D'accord. I, too, would like to see this resolved peacefully.
...But, as for that Algérie and La Galissonnière...
For the time being, Jeanne, let's focus on retaking the Basilica.
It won't be an easy task, but we have no other choice than to disarm those girls and make them see things from our perspective.
No matter how difficult it may be, we must believe in the guidance of the Iris Orthodoxy and do our part. Isn't that right?
...Indeed. I'll be counting on you.
Mozambique Strait - Siren-Contested Area
Opie, look at all the Sirens!
They're probably trying to stop us from reaching the Basilica.
If we defeat them, we'll be able to meet up with our Vichya friends, right?
Tem, they're our enemies now...
Is that so...? I had a nice chat with Vauquelin not too long ago~
We talked about religion, and about picnicking, and then...
You're too easygoing, Tem... Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion are at war now. If you were to meet them on the battlefield...
Wait... Opie, would you really...?
Of course I wouldn't...! But right now, we need to stay focused on the operation. Let's forget about all that.
We're working with the Royal Navy as well. If this kind of talk caught their attention, we'd end up causing trouble for Richelieu.
I guess you're right. But teaming up with the Royal Navy... still doesn't feel quite right. Hmm...
After what happened to Dunkerque and Jean Bart, there's no way we wouldn't have our concerns...
We wouldn't be able to just move on and act like everything is forgiven...
...That's enough of the downer talk! Let's just forget about this and let Béarn handle the complicated stuff!
Right now, we have to focus on what's in front of us – the Sirens!
Yes, let's stick to that for now.
With me, Tem!
The Basilica Isle
While the combined forces of the Royal Navy and Iris Libre were engaging the Sirens...
The Iris-Royal Navy forces have entered the waters around the Basilica and are now engaging the Sirens there!
They're already here?! Ahaha, now this is what I've been looking forward to!
If the Cardinal is personally leading this operation, their morale is probably quite high~
...Anyway, they sure are devoting a considerable amount of effort into taking this Basilica.
I'm guessing the party's over if we lose this place to them, right?
Super over. They should just libre-rate their inner party animals and join us instead. Get it? Libre-rate? Okay, never mind...
...I just don't understand them at all. Why'd they come all the way out here, so far from the European continent?
This Basilica might be important for the Iris Libre, but I can't believe they'd go so far as to try to steal it from us.
Just what is their leadership thinking?
Algérie, is there anything unusual about this Basilica?
Not that I know. Having that said, there is something that bothers me... We were ordered to "protect the Basilica at any cost."
So, even Algérie doesn't know. Y'know, I actually looked into it a little.
Oh, is that so?
Ooh, I wanna hear about it!
It's not like I learned anything though. Not even my friend on the "other" side knew about it.
Aww...
Well, maybe they're just trying to settle an old score? Algérie, should we intercept them?
It'd be nice if the Sirens could push them back without us~
Nuh-uh, no way that's happening. I could take those scrapheaps on all by myself; there's no way they'd be able to stop a joint fleet led by the Cardinal.
The best we can hope for is that they'll buy us some time. Not sure how we keep them from approaching the Basilica, but this is the best we got.
We have no way of controlling those mass-produced Sirens manufactured by the Iron Blood, huh?
Well, it's none of my concern. I wonder what the leadership of the Vichya and Iron Blood are up to right now...
La Galissonnière looked over into the distance, where she saw a figure on the horizon.
The Vichya Dominion's secret weapon, prepared especially for this operation... is that her over there?
I've never heard of a fourth Richelieu-class ship before...
She's been there motionless ever since she got here. She has following Algérie's orders, but in this emotionless way, like she's a robot or something...
Is she really on our side...?
We can't ask for too much when we don't even have the mass-production ships at our disposal.
Now, allow me to explain our strategy...
The Basilica Isle
...Huh, I see! So that was your strategy, Algérie...!
In any case, Royal Navy aside, I'd prefer to avoid fighting Iris Libre if possible...
But I'm not sure how I feel about pulling all our forces back to the island's piers...
Then would you prefer to run out there and start shooting in a blaze of glory? The Royal Navy will open fire without hesitation.
I was just joking, but... this somehow feels like we're conceding defeat...
If you ask me, I'd prefer an honest enemy like the Iron Blood over treacherous "allies" like the Royal Navy.
So, what's the final decision?
The best case scenario would be to convince Richelieu to rejoin us, then we'd launch a pincer attack and take out the Royal Navy!
Seems fun! Let's go with that! Good luck convincing Richelieu, Miss Diplomat~♪
Woah, woah, I was just joking! Don't take everything I say literally!
All right everyone, let's take this more seriously.

First, our operational capacity. We're facing not just an enemy battleship, but also two aircraft carriers. Even if we account for the Sirens and the mass-produced ships, the difference in firepower is simply overwhelming.
If only that "secret weapon" would... No, we can't count on it. Even if she was able to fight, I can't say with certainty that I'd be able to control her...
We've completed fortifying the Basilica's defenses, but we won't be able to offer full support without air superiority. After all, we can't afford to take a head-on engagement.
...Should we just lay down our arms and surrender, then?
We can't do that. Not just because we are the proud Templar Knights of the Vichya Dominion, but given Jean Bart and Dunkerque's current state, we can't give the Iron Blood any reason to turn on us.
And since Richelieu... surely does not want to fight us either, this is the best opportunity we're going to get.
In addition, we'll drive a wedge between Iris Libre and the Royal Navy. Even if we can't seize victory, we'll at least strengthen our position in the eyes of the Iron Blood.
In other words... we'll show a willingness to cooperate, and stall their advance?
And then, we'll look for an opportunity to weaken the Royal Navy before going in for the kill?
That's right. Without the Royal Navy in the way, it will be much easier to negotiate with Richelieu.
Negotiate...?
Yes, it is up to her whether she wants to join us, or to fight until the bitter end. Our defenses are already prepared.
Our role is to protect this Basilica... and we'll make sure they all understand that fact.
Stay focused on our goals, and we'll achieve a gallant victory just like at Orléans! Hehe...
I understand now! You've given this a lot of thought, Algérie~
...Oh, uh, I think we're forgetting that Jeanne d'Arc is currently with the other side...
Pfft... Ahahahaha!
Phew... Anyway, let's stick to the plan for the time being. I'm tired from thinking about all these things...
Algérie put her hands together lightly and smiled to dismiss the ships gathered around her.
The novice knight, Vauquelin, who was still new to the ways of the battlefield...
The uncontrollable La Galissonnière, who would throw herself into battle "because it's fun"...
...and the "secret weapon." There were simply too many things to be concerned about.
The Basilica Isle - Surrounding Waters
We've broken through the Sirens' defenses! There's nothing standing between us and the Basilica now!
Without supporting fire from the Basilica, these Sirens would be no match for us.
Woah! Was that Siren plane over there just shot down by anti-air fire?!
So even the Iron Blood's manufactured Sirens are being shot at as they approach the Basilica...
Does that mean that this area is a buffer zone between the Vichya Dominion and the Iron Blood?
("Don't let the Sirens near the harbor." Back at Casablanca, that was the order that she gave...)
(If they're not in lockstep with the Iron Blood, there might still be room for negotiations.)
(If the Iron Blood occupation of the Vichya Dominion is complete, reversing their influence at that point will be difficult.)
(Since Jean Bart has yet to return, Algérie and the others must be... But...)
Heavenly Father, please give us your blessings... may Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion become whole once again!
...Ah, my apologies. I didn't mean to startle you.
Miss Richelieu?
...I believe I speak on behalf of the Royal Navy when I say that we would all want to see that day come.
How strange... We've advanced this far and nothing has shown up... Not even a mass-produced ship.
If Algérie is the one in command, then why would she...
They also don't want to fight us, right...?
That is one possibility. Another is that they're waiting inside the Basilica.
We're receiving a broadcast from the Vichya forces.
A broadcast...? Let me hear it.
Message from Algérie of the Vichya Templar Knights to the intruders...
Any further trespass upon Vichya waters shall not be permitted.
Change courses immediately. Any further advance shall be considered an act of aggression against the Vichya Dominion.
...I'll issue a response.
"This is Richelieu, Cardinal of Iris Libre. Algérie of the Templar Knights, we wish to speak directly without any intention of hostilities."
From Algérie of the Vichya Templar Knights to the intruders...
"Any further trespass upon Vichya waters shall not be permitted. Change courses immediately. Any further advance shall..."
The message seems to have been pre-recorded...
The Vichya has begun to deploy their mass-produced forces, and their defense systems are activating as well... By the looks of things, they're not in the mood to talk.
N-no way...
Tem...
Richelieu, we await your orders.
...All forces, advance carefully towards the Basilica. Destroy all production-type ships along the way.

sequence: <size=51>「On my path of conquest, having yet to witness the light of dawn that I seeked,</size>
<size=51>I found myself lost deep amidst the woodlands; dim, dark, and dreary were they</size>
<size=51>Entombed within the darkness of those dense copses, I stood alone, trembling with fear,</size>
<size=51>and I could do naught but curse myself for my ignorance and my foolishness</size>
<size=51>O, when did I stray from the path of righteousness? How much time has passed?」</size>
<size=51>Empyreal Tragicomedy</size>

scripts.say: No... Impossible...!
The Sardegna Empire was under attack, and Taranto harbor was dyed a burning red.
How was I unable... to foresee an attack like this...!
Though the harbor's anti-air defenses were firing round after round into the skies, they could not stop the Royal Navy's aerial onslaught.
How were they able to mobilize their aerial squadrons at night...?!
The ships ablaze painted the harbor an infernal red. It was like staring into the maw of hell itself.
Città Eterna, Capital of the Sardegna Empire - 3 Days Prior
There's no way the Sirens are supposed to be here in the Mediterranean Sea. Are you certain your information is correct?
Yes! I am certain of it! A large Siren fleet has amassed near the Empire's southern border to the sea!
What are those Iron Blood bastards doing, allowing the Sirens to advance this deep into our territory...
(One of our demands for joining the Crimson Axis was that the safety of the Mediterranean would be secured...)
(I was already apprehensive of them when the Sirens dismantled the Vichya Dominion, but now they advance upon us...)
Really, Veneto? History has shown us time and time again that the fruit left for those who blindly place their faith in others is bitter indeed.
Littorio...
Since when has grumbling solved any problems, Miss Eternal Flagship?
Our response should be simple. Gaze upon our glorious imperial fleet, and turn your eyes upon me.
We have the most technologically advanced fleet on the face of the continent.
Now look across the land and the sea.
Our land is a hallowed cradle that has given birth to great civilizations and timeless cultures.
If we wish to reclaim Sardegna's fabled birthright, just give me the word, Veneto.
And by our own hands, the world shall know of our glory.
R-right...
So, waste no more time being indecisive! I shall personally lead the Imperial Fleet to annihilate these intruders!
But... I...
Ah, you are worried about the Royal Navy, aren't you? You fear the same thing that happened to Vichya will happen to us?
If we sit here and do nothing, we will end up just like those Vichya battleships, trophies adorning the Royal Navy's mantle.
Moreover, the fact that the Sirens have approached in our waters might be a blessing in disguise.
Because now, neither the Iron Blood nor Iris Libre are able to make a move in our territory.
And even if they could, they would have no way of assessing our naval might.
So, what do you say? Shall we seize this opportunity to partake in an act on the world stage...
... and crush the Sirens in a show of Sardegna's might?
Cavour!
Ugh... why...?!
Impossible... How dare they...!
Taranto harbor had become a sea of flames under the moonlight.
How did they know... to take advantage of us while our forces were split...?!
In addition to having lost the initiative, the Sardegnian forces were unable to muster their anti-air defenses due to the poor visibility.
How were they able to mobilize their aerial squadrons at night...?!
The ships staying in the harbor were gasping for air amidst all the fire and smoke.
They completely saw through us...
How did they anticipate that we'd redeploy our battleships here...?
And how are they operating their air wings at night? I've never heard of this before!
Littorio, order everyone to retreat. We've been completely defeated.
No, Veneto, it's not over yet. If we can take out the enemy carrier, then we can seize Malta before dawn comes. Then the Royal Navy will have their hands tied without their precious intel.
Attention, all battleships! We are evacuating the harbor! Find and put an end to the carrier launching these planes!
I've been waiting for you. I am Illustrious, the Illustrious-class armoured aircraft carrier.
Tell me this, Illustrious: how did the Royal Navy deduce that we would transfer our battleships over to Taranto harbor?
It was quite easy, really... If we were in your position, we would have done the same thing.
Now you've said it... Are you also the one responsible for this bombing?
Correct. Those Swordfish squadrons are all my prided children.
What a magnificent woman. If you were Sardegnian, I might have fallen for you.
But after what you've done, I'm afraid I have to destroy you.
Remember this name - I am Littorio, Veneto-class battleship of the Sardegna Empire! En garde, signora!
(My hangar has taken damage... Her firepower might even be greater than Her Majesty's...)
(Taking one of my salvos head on and still being able to stand... so this is the famed armored carrier...)
Make this easier for us both and surrender. You've done us wrong, but your fate need not be to end up at the bottom of the Mediterra–
More Swordfish...! But it'll take more than that...!
Behold, the Pugliese system! Your little toys cannot sink me!
What...! Even though I've struck her with so many torpedoes...
Nngh...! A battleship salvo?!
Illustrious, get back! Sardegnian battleships are coming!
Gah... I won't let you get away!
BOOOOOOM!
Aaagh! My steering gear...!
The Pugliese system absorbed some of the torpedo impact, but the impact angle had already caused flooding into the cabin, slowing Littorio's movement.
Littorio recognized her defeat, but instead turned towards her foes with bravado.
Signora Illustrious, it seems this victory is yours. Bitter as that may be, getting to witness your captivating beauty is almost as good as victory itself.
Hah... to think a ship even more glorious than me could exist in this world!
Lovely signora, I promise you we shall meet again. Hahahaha!
Littorio turned her back to the Royal Navy's fleet and withdrew from the battlefield.
So that's the Sardegnia Empire's battleship, Littorio... Still trying to show off even after taking so many hits...
It's not every day I see you having trouble with an opponent. Are you all right, Illustrious?
Yes, somehow. But I feel like this isn't the last time that we'll meet...

sequence: <size=51>At the edge of that gloomy forest, three beasts blocked my path</size>
<size=51>There was the Leopard,</size>
<size=51>its coat dazzling with many colors</size>
<size=51>There was the Lion,</size>
<size=51>its head ringed with a proud mane</size>
<size=51>And there was the She-Wolf,</size>
<size=51>its body emaciated, mad with hunger</size>
<size=51>They surrounded me, their ravenous intentions dripping from their mouths</size>
<size=51>Little by little, step by ominous step, they advanced on me; I looked desperately back toward the dark forest</size>
<size=51>A place where even the light of the sun itself had been snuffed out...</size>

scripts.say: The Royal Islands
Victorious, Formidable, the tea's going to go cold.
Ahahaha... It was so pleasant and warm outside that I ended up dozing off...
That's Victorious for you. Good day, Illustrious.
Hey, Formidable, I didn't appreciate that extra comment!
Calm down, you two. It feels like it's been ages since we've all sat down together for tea.
Oh, Victorious, how did your shakedown cruise go?
Err, there was a spot of trouble I guess? They said it might be a while before I'd be able to deploy~
That means your little sister is going into active service before you. You'll have to redouble your efforts to match her.
But of course! I shall be victorious! For my sisters, and for Her Majesty!
Pfft... Actually, I'm afraid there's a more important matter for which I've called you two here...
You're getting married?!
Heavens, no! *cough* *cough*
Illustrious turned bright red and nearly spilled her tea.
It's unbecoming of a Lady to joke about such things.. Hmph~
Anyway, I did say it was an important matter, but...
Could I interest the two of you in a trip to the Mediterranean?
Città Eterna - Capital of the Sardegna Empire
Ah, um... can you stop doing that...
Vittorio Veneto spoke up, unable to take Littorio's pacing around the palace any longer.
Hmm... Hmmmmmm...
It is time to make a choice.
Indeed... I understand the Royal Navy has bolstered their strength in the Mediterranean...
Which would be more suitable, competition swimwear, or a bikini?
Hmm... I heard bikinis were all the rage these days...
Wait, what...?
I heard that the three Illustrious sisters have been deployed to the Mediterranean. This is an opportunity that we cannot miss.
Um... Littorio? I'm beginning to suspect we aren't talking about the same thing.
Was the strategic plan to handle the Illustrious-class aircraft carriers not on the agenda?
I did say that, but... (I'm concerned. I hope that wasn't a pun...)
(Littorio has been acting strange ever since the Battle of Taranto...)
(It must be some sort of post-traumatic stress... Poor girl.)
Veneto, the truth is, I received a telegram from Illustrious some time ago.
"To The Jewel of Calabria, the Most Resplendent One, Her Majesty the Queen hopes that our differences may become as water under the bridge."
"PS: I am bringing my two little sisters."
Um, what's the point of this?
Ahh, do you not see the value of this opportunity? We must seize it with both hands!
This is a prime opportunity to lay Illustrious bare and expose her secrets!
An aircraft carrier who can launch planes in the dead of night, and with such unreasonably thick armor...
Since that defeat, we have been groping in the dark to understand how that fateful night unfolded. But now, we can make them ours.
We shall pad our technology with theirs, milk it for all it's worth, and usher in a new age of Sardegnian glory!
... When you put it that way, I can see your logic...
The Senate responsible for keeping abreast of the situation with the Iron Blood and Royal Navy remains paralyzed by political infighting.
The power struggles continue while the Sardegna Fleet stagnates. At this rate...
You're right. The Iron Blood seems to be losing patience with us since the Battle of Taranto.
Not to mention the Sirens, whose numbers in the Mediterranean seem to grow by the day. They're watching our every move.
Littorio, I just had an idea.
There must be a reason why the Royal Navy reached out to us, and we should not let it slip past us.
Who are our allies, who are our enemies, and who remains an "actor" until the very end...
Let us conduct a little experiment of our own.
This was the "play" that you had wanted, is it not?
Yes... My thoughts exactly.
Now then, Great Flagship, my sweet signora...
Err, what now...?
It is time to make your decision... on which swimsuit to wear!
Huh...?! Littorio, whyyyyyy...?!
I didn't expect such an... extravagant welcome from the Sardegna Fleet...
Lady Veneto instructed me to show the Ladies of the Royal Navy our Mediterranean hospitality.
(What is this "Jewel of Calabria" that Her Majesty spoke of...?)
W-wait! You're going to get my new clothes dirty!
Please forgive me for my indiscretion!
... Your scurrying back and forth is giving me a headache.
Carabiniere made use of her agility to avoid the carrier's attacks while gradually closing the distance between them, poking and prodding at Formidable with her guns.
Hah! My very name comes from a centuries-old type of Sardegnian light cavalry.
Using rapid movements to confuse our enemies while I wait for the perfect moment to strike true, that is my fighting style.
Miss Formidable, a lumbering carrier like you has no chance of keeping up with my speed!
... I beg your pardon?!
Formidable raised an eyebrow, giving off an uncharacteristically vexed aura.
You... take that back!
Who. Did. You. Call. Lumbering?!
Carabiniere was taken back by Formidable's pouty lips and the tears welling up in the corners of her eyes.
No, I... That's not...
DON'T MOVE AN INCH!!!
An intense pressure began to exude from Formidable as she glared at the Sardegnian destroyer, enveloping her in a distorted aura.
Wha... what is this?
Carabiniere's boiler suddenly gave out with a pop. One by one, her fellow destroyers lost power from their boilers and slowed to a crawl.
So, who's the lumbering one now?
Care to say that again? Who's the lumbering one now?!
W-wait! That's not what I meant...!
You're about to become a kill marking on my Baraccuda! Engage!!
Waaaaaaaahhh!!
... Huh?
Warspite arrived just in time to see Carabiniere get blown away. She broke out in a cold sweat.
Formidable... Don't you think you might have overdone it a bit...?
Oh, um... What a fine day it is, Warspite.
Formidable executed a graceful curtsy and smiled wryly.
I took the liberty of clearing out Sardegna's vanguard.
But don't worry, I made sure to not hit any vital areas. Just disable her, as Illustrious instructed.
Um... w-well done, I suppose. We should hurry and search for this "Jewel of Calabria" next.

sequence: <size=51>And thus the sun once again sinks into the desolate darkness, the hollow of despair where no prayer can reach</size>
<size=51>O those who were born into an era of false gods, wise is the teacher who guides the poet.</size>
<size=51>You turned your head up, seeking salvation from above.</size>
<size=51>Your journey has crossed through the Nine Circles.</size>
<size=51>Your journey shall ascend the Seven Crowns towards Paradise.</size>
<size=51>Your footsteps shall know no pause, even as the seas of flame consume your form.</size>
<size=51>The trials of tribulation thus end, and the path of hope is opened.</size>
<size=51>But alas...</size>
<size=51>The fruit of Paradise is not freely shared...</size>
<size=51>Has that not always been clear...?</size>

scripts.say: Pola, are you all right?
I'm fine. It's just a scratch.
We're equipped with the most durable armor out there, and it's not just for show.
Tenacemente e ardisco ad ogni impresa! Our courage and resolve will not be overlooked.
Sardegnian warships are just as persistent as Illustrious said. Can't say I'm a fan.
Let me handle this. Don't forget Her Majesty's orders - concentrate on that first.
Of course. "Seize the Jewel of Calabria before midnight."
There's no time to waste. Take Orion with you. You already know what to do.
Godspeed, Warspite, and God Save the Queen.
Think I'd let you get away so easily? Fiiire!
Warspite rushed in, causing Zara's shot to go wide.
I wouldn't recommend taking your eyes off of me.
Aw, look at you, the hero rushing to save the damsel in distress. Are you sure you should leave her alone though?
Heh. Actually, it'll be much easier to deal with you without her around.
What did you say...?
"To The Right Honourable Flagship: My sister is in your care. As this is her first sortie, I trust you will ensure her safety in case of any unexpected mishaps."
"Yours sincerely, Illustrious"
A chill ran down Warspite's spine as she recalled the telegram.
No matter. Come then, bring your guns to bear and let us see who is the stronger! Belli dura despicio!
How is this granny so hard to deal with... What was that attack...?
As one of the Royal Navy's most esteemed warriors, Warspite easily won her duel. However, Zara's verbal assault did hit its mark.
How are you aiming so well in the middle of the night?!
Ugh... This has to be some kind of cheat...!
Heh. Allow me to teach you something I've learned from my many years of service as a warrior.
And that is, the key to a ship's performance is not her raw combat prowess, nor is it through adhering to the service history imprinted within you.
Rather, it is through constantly challenging yourself and pushing your limits.
That is the source of the Royal Navy's strength. I wouldn't mind sharing some of my experience with you should you care to listen.
Hey... Where'd you go...?
Warspite looked up to find the Zara sisters had already steamed out of range.
Sorry, but we got tired of listening to your senile rambling. Pola, the communications...
While taunting Warspite, Zara gestured in the direction that Formidable headed and relayed her instructions to Pola.
Wait... Get back here!!
Let everyone know. One aircraft carrier and her escort fleet broke through our lines... and are headed for the Jewel of Calabria.
We've managed to waste some of Warspite's time, but she seems to have some new night battle technique. Please use caution.
I'll now move to intercept them. Glory to Sardegna.
Hehe... Now Veneto will know. All right.
Mercy... they got away. Kids these days just keep getting faster and faster. I can't keep up anymore...
Warspite dragged her weighty hull slowly but surely through the night, trailing the heavy cruisers.
It would be grand if Her Majesty would grant me a retrofit after this operation. Haha...

sequence: <size=51>"But thou, why goest thou back to such annoyance?</size>
<size=51>Why climb'st thou not the Mount Delectable,</size>
<size=51>Which is the source and cause of every joy?"</size>
<size=51>Asked Virgil, the poet, of I.</size>
<size=51>Please teach me, my teacher, please save me, my savior.</size>
<size=51>In the name of the God you never knew,</size>
<size=51>Help me escape this woe and torment.</size>
<size=51>Take me to the place of which you spoke,</size>
<size=51>That I may see the gate of Saint Peter,</size>
<size=51>And the souls of those so tormented.</size>

scripts.say: And in the end, they never came?
Correct. We informed the Iron Blood as soon as we engaged the Royal Navy.
They said something about "night battle having too many unknown variables," but all I heard was a bunch of verbal garbage.
Hrmm...
Looks like we were never more than cannon fodder to them, just like the Vichya Dominion.
I was full of hope when we were brought into the Crimson Axis...
But it looks like we are just pawns for their "Reenactment."
It's almost time for the denouement, Veneto.
Indeed. This "Reenactment" is about to come to an end. The only thing left for us... is to decide whether it ends as a comedy or as a tragedy...
These damned Sirens! How were they allowed to get this far?
That's just how they operate, seemingly emerging out of nowhere. If they weren't so slippery, humanity wouldn't have been pushed to the brink.
Whatever, just be quiet and focus on the mission! We're here to fight Sirens, not to philosophize!
I'm just assessing the status quo. It goes without saying that the enemy... shall be annihilated.
I... I'm glad you two are getting along well!
Who'd get along with her?!
I am very sorry for interrupting! ... But, enemy reinforcements are approaching!
Open fire, everyone! Don't let those Siren bastards advance a step farther!
The Jewel of Calabria... is this beautiful sea itself?
The sea, illuminated by the glow of the pale moonlight, glimmered like a blue gemstone.

The ruins of ancient civilizations swaying like mirages along the shore, and the lifegiving waters that birthed a home for so many people... The breathtaking scenery was almost a spiritual experience.
"The Coast of the Gods," they call it, as well as the Jewel of Calabria. This is Sardegna's national treasure.
This is the cradle that nurtured countless peoples, civilizations, and legends over thousands of years.
Indeed, this is a treasure that is as resplendent as you and I being together, beautiful signora.
(Uhh... that last line didn't seem necessary...)
Would you two mind telling me why you came here?
We've come to make a wager. Between the Iron Blood's machinations and the Royal Navy's strength.
Though we are a part of the Crimson Axis, we wish to ascertain what we mean to them.
Will this battle become their "Reenactment," or will it become the first page of a new future?
Of course, we are still interested in spreading the glory of Sardegna.
But now that all the actors are assembled, the objectives of this play shall be revealed.
Everything was for the sake of preserving the sanctity of this jewel.
The Royal Navy has always held the power to ensure the safety and stability of the Mediterranean. Why not just negotiate with Her Majesty?
The Iron Blood have become more powerful than us... No, stronger than you can possibly imagine. In due time, we would be swallowed by their darkness.
That is the purpose of our wager here. If your Royal Navy falls here, what chance to do you stand against the Iron Blood and their Siren masters?
So we've finally reached a mutual understanding, huh...
Star-crossed ships bound by fate to battle... The lamentations of a sea ablaze... The girls dancing like puppets across countless "Reenactments..." But at last...
"Res, non verba." All these obstacles you put in our way are parts of your "wager," correct?
Let me ask you then. Should we stop you here and prove that we are capable of protecting the Mediterranean, would you rejoin the Azur Lane?
Yes. As flagship of the Imperial Fleet, you have my word.
Very well. Barham, Valiant, let us fight for the glory of Her Majesty.
Formidable, I'll leave air support in your hands.
Of course. You can count on me.
Is your sister not coming?
Illustrious is on a little side trip to the Aegean, where she's putting an end to the Sirens there. She said it wouldn't be fair to put you up against the entire Illustrious-class.
Alas, what a pity. And here I thought I'd get to see all three goddesses of the Royal Navy in their swimsuits~
Ahem...!
Zara, Pola, and all members of the Sardegna Fleet. This is our time. Allow the light of Sardegna to shine!
Lunga vita all'Impero！
The Royal Islands
So you ended up fighting after all? What was the outcome?
Of course we won. The night belongs to us, after all.
Formidable sipped on her tea elegantly as she gave her report to her sisters.
While Sardegna's ships are equipped with heavy armor, they don't have fire control radars.
As a result, Warspite and I made quick work of them.
An expected result, but well done nevertheless.
Finally, the three sisters could enjoy a moment of peace together.
Aww, I also wanted to beat up some enemies, in an elegant way that only a goddess of victory like me could accomplish! How unfair~
By the way, our fourth sister will soon be joining us, and the Royal Navy will grow even stronger.
And of course, our sororal tea parties will become a little livelier~
Ah! I wonder what our new sister will look like. Could she possibly be cuter than Formidable? Hehehe~
Victorious pinched Formidable's cheeks as she teased her.
Oh, yes, I nearly forgot. That Sardegnian warship, Lit... Litter-something? She asked me to pass along a message for you, Illustrious.
...That was the very spirited one, if I recall? What did she have to say?
Um, if I'm remembering this correctly... "When the Passions of this land fade at last, let us reignite the Passion between us." Dreadfully baroque, if you ask me.
One never quite knows what those bunch are up to... I suppose they have plenty of problems to deal with internally...
Huh? What's going on?
Hey, that's my line! What's the meaning of this, having a secret tea party behind my back?!
Queen Elizabeth, while strolling through the garden with her entourage, saw the sisters gathered for tea.
Madam Illustrious, Madam Victorious, Madam Formidable, good day to you.
Good day, Your Majesty. Belfast.
As it happens, Your Majesty has excellent timing. The tea is just ready~ And may I offer you some treats from my trip to the Aegean?
Won't you join us for sweets and a spot of scintillating conversation~?
Hah. When it came down to it, those Sardegnian warships weren't worth a damn!
After all that talk about being the greatest fleet in the Mediterranean, in the end they couldn't even fight their way out of a wet paper bag.
Turns out it was a mistake to entrust the Mediterranean to them.
With their night carrier operations and improved shelling accuracy from their radars, the Royal Navy's victory was practically guaranteed.
The observation data has already been forwarded to the research and development department. They should prove invaluable in the development of new weapons.
And in the end that's all those insufferably arrogant Sardegnians were worth... Ahahaha!
Furthermore, Bismarck has finally begun to stir.
When she returns once more, all the lands and seas will soon belong to us.
Those who betray the Iron Blood shall quickly find that we are their judge, jury, and executioner.
Gneisenau, can I trust you to monitor the Sardegna Empire?
Aye!
I want eyes on their fleet around the clock. Report any signs of treachery immediately.
Affirmative! Long live Iron Blood!
"At the edge of that gloomy forest, three beasts blocked my path"
The Leopard, the Lion, and the She-Wolf.
And so, I looked desperately back toward the dark forest, to such annoyance...
You're back to reading those stuffy old books again? What's the story this time?
A lost soul searching for redemption. Just another pile of clichéd metaphors.
The legendary poem of the Sardegna Empire, huh...
The Leopard, the Lion, and the She-Wolf are just Iris Libre, the Royal Navy, and the Iron Blood.
In the end, the Sardegnians make their way up the mountain, looking for a path to peace and redemption. But I wonder if their story truly ends as a comedy...
Not quite...
The three beasts represent the Sardegna Empire's hesitation, arrogance, and envy.
The Empire fled and took a different path...
In climbing the mountain, they may have gained clarity of vision, but they also lost sight of their original goal.
In the end, they failed to slay their beasts.
Cesare, how did your battle with the Sirens go?
Nothing but small fry devoid of any thought. Not even worth mentioning.
That's right. We didn't spare a single one.
Makes you wonder what they were even trying to do. Doesn't it, Pola?
Yes, Zara. It was over before it even started.
You've all done well. Cesare, could you guide everyone to La Spezia? You've all earned some time to rest and recover.
We could definitely use it. Should I expect a celebratory party waiting for us?
... Wait... What's that in the distance...?
Eternal Flagship, did you request aerial support from Iron Blood?
No, that's not Iron Blood... Those are Royal Navy aircraft.
Should we prepare for anti-air measures?
It's probably fine. They've already left our range.
Typical Royal Navy fashion. They're more annoying than flies. Anyway... Cesare, your orders?
Right. Attention, everyone! As per Veneto's orders, we'll head for La Spezia!
(Yes, everything is proceeding as planned. Soon, our play will begin...)
The Royal Islands
Looks like the Sardegna Fleet has begun to move.
Warspite, did something happen?
Oh, you're here, Illustrious. Come take a look at this photo taken by our reconnaissance planes and tell me what you see.
I can see... Cavour, Cesare, and the Zara sisters... And where was this photo taken?
Above La Spezia harbour.
The one located in the hinterlands, yes? I'm sure they're there to rest and resupply after their battle with the Sirens.
But, why would the Sirens be in the Mediterranean in the first place...?

I can think of several reasons. While this may be nothing more than the usual poking and prodding from the Sirens, we cannot discount the possibility that this was a test run for a much larger invasion to come.

Regardless, Sardegna's behaviour is concerning to me. The way they mobilised so many capital ships to suppress such a paltry foe in an almost theatrical show of force contradicts their long-held naval doctrine.
Are you saying it was a demonstration of their strength?
Hmm... It's hard to say...
Perhaps we should bring this to the discussion table before acting. They might have an explanation that we aren't seeing.
It's not too late for them to rejoin Azur Lane, and if they were to do so, the matter would resolve by itself.
You're right. I'll inform Her Majesty.
So we negotiate first, but still plan for the next phase... A well thought out strategy, so I'll allow it!
Warspite, you do understand the point of this operation, yes? Never forget the pride of the Royal Navy. Put them in their place!
Yes, Your Majesty!
However, if possible, I would like to avoid a repeat of the Vichya incident. That embarrassing event affected our standing within the Azur Lane...
"A wise general understands how to win a war. A wise ruler understands how to avoid a war."
Belfast casually poured tea for the Queen as she recited her quote.
I was ordered by Her Majesty to deliver these words to you, Warspite, were you to bring up the Vichya incident.
Very well... I have faith in Her Majesty's judgement. I shall depart immediately!
Warspite bowed to Queen Elizabeth, then exited the throne room.
"Look after Her Majesty for me," she says?
I certainly hope it doesn't come to that...
The Sardegna Empire's territory lies just ahead of us...
It seems there are still Sirens loitering in these parts... Let's stay alert and move forward.
Let me see if I got this right. The Royal Navy came all this way just to ask us to rejoin the Azur Lane?
That's right. With the Siren threat looming over the Mediterranean, now more than ever we should join forces and fight side by side.
The "Siren" threat? Surely you jest. Are you not the ones threatening us?
As I just said, the Royal Navy is simply concerned with freedom of navigation for all peoples. We have never had any ulterior motives.
So the Royal Navy intervenes when the Sirens attack the Mediterranean, but sit and watch as hostilities escalate between us and Iris Libre, who happens to bend the knee to you?
And now that you've allowed the Sirens to slip into the Mediterranean past your oh-so-vigilant eyes, you want Sardegna to clean up after your mess. Is this your idea of keeping the peace?
Littorio, I know you're smarter than this. They may have been mass-produced units, but I find it very hard to believe that Sardegna would not have detected a Siren fleet of that size sooner.
So, if you didn't let them through, and our recon didn't spot them...
... you're saying that a Mirror Sea has appeared somewhere within the Mediterranean?
Indeed. We control both entrances to this sea, therefore the Sirens could only have appeared here through the presence of a Mirror Sea.
As they were first spotted near your southern sea border, chances are high that the Mirror Sea is somewhere in that area.
I see. So how does the Royal Navy plan to act?
For now, the Royal Fleet plans to scour the southeastern Mediterranean for the Sirens.
Then allow us to assist you with it. You'll have a lot of ocean to search.
Furthermore, the Mediterranean is the birthplace of our civilization. No Sardegnian could sit idly and let the Sirens defile it.
In fact, allow me to make a proposition: how about we use this joint mission as a way to improve relations between us?
Did you think we had forgotten about what you did to Vichya? Surely you understand that our trust must be earned.
I must admit you have a point... The success of this operation depends on our mutual trust.
Our mission is as follows: search the Mediterranean for the source of Siren activity and eliminate it...
However, I'm going to have to add a condition to your participation in this operation.
No Sardegnian battleships will be allowed to join the search. Violators of this rule will be dealt with accordingly by the Royal Navy.
(Ah, making arbitrary rules when it suits you... The Royal Navy still uses the same old bag of tricks.)
(But just you wait. Soon, you shall all dance upon my stage...!)
Littorio, how are matters developing? Is my assistance needed?
Not for now. All is going as planned.
To gain control over the Mediterranean, we will need to break the Royal Navy's blockade. We will need Malta in order to do so.
As long as the Royal Navy has their hands on that island, their little queen will be able to monitor our every move.
On the other hand, if we wrest Malta away from the Royal Navy, it would not be long until the entire Mediterranean belongs to us.
As long as we send a few ships to aid Warspite with her little Siren hunt, we should be able to avoid any suspicion.
Using the cover of night, I will send our strongest ships to lie in wait at Taranto.
At the dawn of the next day, we will pincer Malta while the Royal Navy is still occupied.
Warspite may have a reputation for being swift, but even she won't be able to react to this.
Your plan sounds good, but this would be a formal declaration of war against the Royal Navy... Do you really think we can win...?
Veneto, what are we to do if our own flagship is this hesitant about taking action?
You are the flagship that leads the mightiest fleet in the land. You need simply have faith in me and our glorious fleet.
If you're not going to have more confidence in both yourself and in your fleet, then you should just let me be flagship for this operation.
Ahaha... Sometimes, it seems like you're the big sister here...
Littorio, you always know what to say when my resolve wavers. Let's carry out your plan.
Well, except that part about letting you be the flagship.
If that is what you want, then so it shall be.
Besides, with you as our flagship, I can dedicate all my attention to fighting instead. One of us will earn their glory in the planning room, and the other will earn it on the battlefield.
Hehe...
Now that we've decided on our next move, we should treasure the night ahead of us.
It would be such a tragedy for you spend this night alone, my beautiful signora. Care to join me?
Why, I would love to~
The following day - Prior to Sardegna's plan
I wonder if all Royal aristocrats speak in such a peculiar manner...
Hah! You may not know the way of the Force, but nevertheless we shall fight side by side and fight our common enemy for this Operation! Let us search for the Heart of Dissonance!
Zara... I kind of get what she's trying to say, but what a strange person...
Yeah, I can manage. Maybe those Royal Navy folks are just wired differently. Let's just act like we totally understand so she won't laugh at us like we're country bumpkins.
Right...
Err, according to our intel, the next area we should search for the Heart of Dissonance lies 100 nautical miles southeast of here...

Ah, just what I would expect from a carabinieri – that is, an Imperial Dragoon! Now, using my Thippus Field Manipulation, I can divine our distance from the enemy, but even pushing to level 6, I still can't feel them!
I'm level 10! Please allow me to search for them!
Ohh, incredible! You must feel the Force as well...!
Psst, Zara... Do you think Carabiniere can actually communicate with her?
Who knows?
Just pretend not to hear them...
Nighttime
What?! What is the meaning of this?!
Sorry, what was your name again? Oh, right, "York."
Apologies, but we'll have to take you out in the name of the Empire!
Fleet after fleet of mass-produced Sardegnian ships appeared out of thin air, completely surrounding the Royal fleet.
Sorry about this. We're just following orders~♪
So this was your plan all along! To lead us here and ambush us!
Yep. Your other fleets are also being dealt with as we speak. Also, we never intended to let you contact each other in the first place.
Now, lay down your arms and surrender.
Hahaha! If this is how you want it, then I shall reveal to you the true purpose of this Operation!
Gaze upon my Secondary Weapons, granted to me by Her Majesty herself!
What...?
Here I stand, trapped in the lion's den, surrounded by the wicked machinations of these fiends. Everything rests on this! I alone stand against the impending ruin!
Yes, Her Majesty's orders were clear - if the Sardegna Empire betray you during this joint operation in their quest to subjugate the Mediterranean...
... then use your Force to reveal the blackness of their treachery with these Divine Cannons!
Cannons of Bethlehem, I call upon you! Fireeeeeeeeee!
The shell launched into the night sky and burst, casting a light that spanned tens of miles as if turning night into day.
What...?! They prepared signal rounds ahead of time?!
Warspite! Illustrious! Hear me!
Our mission begins now!
Achoo...!!
The signal flare has been fired... They should have been wiser than this...
We don't have time to be sentimental. Give me your orders.
Of course, we'll take action as planned. Illustrious, prepare to launch your aircraft.
Carabiniere, hurry back and tell our main forces that we've been compromised...
Haha! Now it is my turn to Halt you!
Nothing personal, but I can't let you leave!
Prior to the Royal Navy's plan
Illustrious! Are you coming as well?
Greetings, Warspite. Yes, as per Her Majesty's orders, I will be accompanying you on this voyage.
I see. Well, as I was saying earlier, we are preparing a joint Royal Navy-Sardegna search party to find where the Sirens are coming from...
But you're wary about their motives for agreeing to your terms so readily?
You're quite perceptive, as always. Something seemed suspicious about the plan they proposed.
They claimed that they wanted to carry out this search operation at nighttime because the Sirens are supposedly more active then.
But, it just so happens that our patrol units at Malta don't operate at night. There's a possibility that they want to seize on that opportunity.
Yes, I made some preparations for that very scenario before I got here.
You... did what? In any case, we don't have any proof that the Sardegnians are actually plotting something...
Call it a woman's intuition, but I already consulted with Her Majesty about this.
A... woman's intuition?
Don't you know that this ability is sometimes more fearsome than the most brilliant tactical mind?
Listen, you...
I have prepared countermeasures and a follow-up plan in case the Sardegnians would do anything that's not in our best interest. Oh, I've also prepared...
... What are those? Flares?
Correct. But we need someone who can use them to signal us if something happens...
At that time, York happened to be passing by.
Yes, you're perfect!
Huh? Whaaaat?
Just prior to the Royal Navy embarking on the Siren hunt
So... the green one means "Siren base found and destroyed," blue means "requesting support," and red means "Sardegnians have betrayed us," if I'm not mistaken?
That's it. Could you please load your cannons with them now?
Of course! Now I need to come up with a name for this manoeuvre... hmm... I'll have to do it later, for we're short on time.
Indeed, the Sardegnians will be grouping up with us any minute now. No matter what happens, God save the Queen.
God save the Queen!
Say York actually does fire the red flare to signal she's been attacked... what happens then, Illustrious?
I can only hope that it doesn't come to that...
But, if it does happen, we will simply have to spank some naughty children~

<size=45>1 The Lover's Heart Flutters On Duty</size>

scripts.say: Phew...
In an empty classroom after school, a certain well-bred young lady stretches on her tip-toes, doing her best to clean the blackboard.
Based on how serious she looks, I don't think she's noticed my presence yet.
While I consider helping her, she stretches even more to reach the top of the blackboard. By this point, her entire upper body is pressed against it.
Chalk dust falls off of it... and straight into her eyes.
Eep!
Blinded by chalk dust, she steps back and trips over.
*cough* *cough*...
Professor?! Are you okay?
N-no, I can't possibly be that heavy... Surely you're fine...
W-wait, that's not what's wrong...
Anyway, thank you, Professor!
(I know we're being filmed, but her calling me Professor still throws me off...)
I'm fine. Here, let me erase the chalk at the top. Are your eyes okay, Formidable?
Yes... They sting a little, but I'll be fine.
I'll try blowing it out of your eyes. Stay still for me, okay?
Huh? Okay... Thank you, Professor.
Despite clearly blushing all the way to her ears, Formidable does her best to lean in and face me.
U-umm... Will this do?
She leans in close enough that our lips are mere inches from each other.
Her sweet perfume and teary eyes have a bewitching power to them, coming ever so close to stealing my heart–
Hmm... It's a little hard to blow on your eyes at this angle...
Geez, Comman–ahem! Professor!
Okay... A little lower. All you need is for me to angle my head a little lower, right?
She flips her long hair, evidently dissatisfied, and slowly looks down.
But for some reason, she squats down low enough until her head is level with my waist.
Professor? You won't tell me I'm too low this time, will you?
Formidable looks up at me. There's a mischievous glint in her eyes and a grin on her face.
But I'm ever so tired, Professor. Why don't you bend over and find the right height yourself?
Heheh, you did want to blow the chalk dust out of my eyes, didn't you?
Yeah, but it looks to me like you already cried it out...
Aww. Must you be so observant now, of all times?!
Oh? Really, now?
But my head and your mouth are just so much further from each other now.
Why would you say this is perfect, I wonder?
It's okay. I already cried out the chalk dust, so I don't need your help anymore, Professor.
With that, Formidable stands back up and twirls gracefully in front of me.
*BEEP! BEEP!*
Just then, the recording equipment beeps, signaling that it's stopped.
Phew... Okay. Does that mean the recording is done?
Not at all... Ahem. The recording may not yet be complete yet, Commander.
Because a certain someone failed to follow the script.
Heehee, I think we'll have to redo the scene at this rate.
It's still early, so I expect you to give it another try now... my dear Professor~

<size=45>2 Brilliant Touchdown</size>

scripts.say: When the whistle is blown to signal the start of half-time, I find a good opportunity to run over to Prinz Eugen, who just scored minutes ago.
Good job, Prinz Eugen. That was a fantastic shot.
Phew... Heheh, I eat shots like that for breakfast.
Well, you're doing great. Let's talk about our second half strategy.
Hmm? You think you need cheap little tricks when I'M around?
I don't get much time to rest. If you've got time to talk about tactics on paper...
...Then why don't you give me a little more direct help, Coach?
Prinz Eugen looks up at me with a grin.
Sweat slides down her cheek and falls onto her collarbone, leaving a damp trail behind it.
That being...?
Come on, Coach. What do you think?
I'm all sweaty and sticky, riiight?
Prinz Eugen fans her chest with her hand.
It's so hot... My clothes definitely aren't helping, either.
I bet if I pulled this down a little, I'd be able to cool down... What do you think?

options.content: Nope! I brought you a towel and water!
How about we go back to the rest area and freshen up with a shower?

scripts.say: Simple and practical, huh...
Mmm, fine by me. I do kinda need that stuff right now.
You're a real strategist, Commander. Thanks~
Pfft... That's a little long for such a short break!
Don't forget, it's only half-time. There's a whole half of the game left.
Anyway, that's enough jokes. I see you brought a towel and water.
I'll take those, thanks!
Clear water pours into her mouth like resplendent threads. Glistening with sweat, her throat twitches a little with each gulp.
But the vigor of her drinking seems to be too much to handle. She chokes a little, and water rolls out of the corner of her mouth, adding a touch of wildness to her elegant motions.
*gulp*... *gulp*... Phew! Much better.
Hm? You've been staring at this water bottle for a while now.
You thirsty, too?
Aww! Well, I'm afraid it's too late.
I'd love to let you have some, but that would be an indirect kiss, wouldn't it?
Imagine that. Coach and star player, sharing an indirect kiss in the corner of the stadium. We can't let people see that!
Still... It's a scorcher out, so I can't leave you thirsting for too long.
How about a compromise?
Prinz Eugen once again raises the bottle, taking a big sip of it.
Then, she forcefully, swiftly, and precisely presses her face against mine.
Accompanied by the sound of a whistle, sweet and cold water flows into my mouth.
Aaah... Looks like half-time's over. I'd better get ready for the second half.
Hmm? Heheh, you look more excited for our "second half."
Don't rush things. All in due time.
First, the second half of the game. Then, the second half of our fun♥

<size=45>3 Troubled Seas</size>

scripts.say: Under a clear sky, Kongou holds a surfboard in her arms in wait for the "perfect wave."
Commander, do you remember the technique I taught you yesterday?
Paddle first. Lay face-down on the surfboard, stabilize your weight, and use your ab muscles to support your upper body.
Yep. Then, you paddle alternating your left and right arms.
Hmm... Any other tips I should keep in mind?
Tips... Keep your motions fluid and elegant, I suppose?
The next steps are takeoff and riding. Put simply, you use your arm strength to stand up, and then you try to balance on your feet.
Sounds easier said than done.
Heehee, it'll be okay. As long as your posture is proper and elegant, you'll do just fine.
The final bailout is simple. When the wave passes by, you keep your posture as low as possible and then slowly get off of the board.
By the way, this also needs to be done fluidly and elegantly.
I see. So it's all about elegance, precision, and fluidity...
Heehee~ Remember that well, okay?
Newbie surfers tend to panic the moment something goes wrong, and that only makes things more dangerous.
It's important to practice often and earn the knowledge necessary to deal with any and all problems.
Of course, I'll gladly protect you if anything goes wrong!
Oh, look. A wave is already coming.
Commander, check your gear and stay calm!
A powerful wave rolls in.
Kongou gets onto her surfboard. Pushed forth by the wave, we rush atop the water at high speed.
Wooo! You're doing great!
Not bad for a newbie, Commander!
She skillfully keeps her balance as she turns around, smiles, and waves at me.
Unfortunately, she fails to notice the even bigger wave silently lurking behind her.
Huh... Wha? O-oh, no!
After a desperate struggle, I manage to help Kongou back onto her surfboard.
*pant*... *pant*... That was close...
You really can't let your guard down for a second out here...
I can't believe you're the one who had to help me out...
She's still so shaken that she hasn't even noticed another pressing danger closing in on her.
(This is bad. Her board shorts are stuck on the surfboard's fin...)
C-Commander! What do you think you're doing?!
Huh? My board shorts?
Eep! H-how scandalous...
C-Commander, please don't look!
Despite all the panic, we manage to deal with the danger.
Ahahaha...
I didn't expect you'd be seeing me in such an... unrefined way.
Please keep what just happened a secret between us!
In return for that...
I know. Horseback riding, fencing, tea ceremony, surfing – whatever you want to learn, I'll be happy to help.
What do you say? ...Heehee, okay, it's a promise!
Oh, look. Another wave is coming.
Commander, let's get ready to ride again!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night

<size=45>1 Stage-Setting Charmer</size>

scripts.say: Hello there~ Welcome to the Bunny Bar!♪
The instant I enter the bar, I'm greeted by Guam's enthusiastic voice.
I hear the shipgirl talents are putting on a show here...?
That's right~ It's time for Bunny Guam's big magic show! I call it Guam's Prize Disguise!
Get ready to witness a miracle♪
(Magic? Does Guam do magic tricks, too...?)
(I fear what comes next...)
Tadaaa~ First, I'll ride this unicycle!
(Wasn't this supposed to be a magic circle? Also, where did she get that unicycle—)
With my incredible sense of balance, I'm able to ride this unicycle with ease♪
Did you think that was all? Well, it isn't~ Next, I'll make these three sandbags disappear!
(When did she grab those sandbags?! And from where...?!)
I'll turn them into three cute little pigeons! Don't look away, or you might miss it♥
Guam tosses the sandbags into the air and catches them one after another, as if juggling.
Then, with dazzling speed, she throws all three up into the air. With her free hand, she reaches for the hat on her head.
Don't blink, now~
Here comes a miracle♪
She catches all three sandbags perfectly in her hat.
Three, two, one!
With a magic wand, which she again pulls out of thin air, she gently taps the brim of her hat.
There's a bang as ribbons and three doves come flying out of it.
Thanks for watching Bunny Guam's magic show! I hope to see you again next time~
The short, yet lovely performance comes to an end.
I recall the striking sight of Guam on the unicycle, juggling and doing magic tricks.
I'm certain that I'll never forget that.
That's Guam for you.

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night

<size=45>2 Sleepy on a Busy Day</size>

scripts.say: When I enter the pop-up restaurant, I find Laffey in uniform and carrying a tray.
She's so visibly sleepy that I have to worry about the drinks balancing on it.
Welcome... Commander, sit wherever you want... Any open seat is probably fine.
Commander... Did you come to check on the restaurant?
Since it's opening day, I made time to stop by. Why are you dressed like that, Laffey?
Yep... Laffey promised to help everyone around the restaurant... *yawn*... Sleepy...
But don't worry, Commander... All Laffey has to do is take this tray from the counter to the tables...
I'm just fine... Probably, yup...
Oh... Do you want to order, Commander?
Here's the menu for today... If you want anything, let Laffey know...
...The recommended drinks? Laffey likes... the soda...
It's cold and refreshing, and... the feeling of the bubbly carbonation popping...
You'll like it a lot, Commander...
Well, yes, but soda...?
(Who would go all the way to a restaurant just for soda?)
Commander... Do you hate soda?
No, that's not what I mean...
*stare*...
One glass of soda... Wait a minute, Commander. I'll be right back.
Thanks for waiting, Commander... Here's your soda.
Laffey puts the soda on the table and sits down right next to me.
Oh, the soda... Try it, Commander.
The cold drink runs through me, and the carbonated bubbles burst... Yep. That's just soda with ice in it.
It's good. Thanks, Laff—
Suddenly, something heavy falls on my arm.
Kkh... Nnh... Zzzzzzz...
An exhale touches my arm. When I turn to look, I see Laffey asleep, leaning on me.
It seems like I'll have to finish off this soda slowly.

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night

<size=45>3 A Back-Alley Encounter</size>

scripts.say: The alleys behind the restaurant are, in a word, labyrinthine. I take a single wrong turn by accident, and I end up unable to find my way back.
Just before I give up and accept that I'm lost, though, I hear a voice from the room next to me.
Commander? What are you doing here?
I turn to look. There, I see Cleveland in the restaurant uniform with a jacket sloppily thrown on top.
The room is illuminated by colorful lightning. The TV at her feet displays the word "PAUSED" in big letters.
I look again at Cleveland, who's holding a controller in her hands. It finally makes sense: she's slacking off and playing video games instead of working.
Ah... Heheh, Commander, are you... lost?
The corridors here are pretty complex. Don't blame yourself for getting lost.
Hm? What about my outfit?
I figure you can tell at a glance, no? Heheh, I promised to help out in the restaurant today.
Now, welcome to my little secret base~
"As a special service, would you like me to introduce you to our special drink menu?♪"
"You don't want a drink? Okay... What kind of 'service' would you like, then?♡"
Heheh, what do you think? Did I get the vibe just right?
What vibe?
A girly vibe, of course!

options.content: It'll be okay. You can try again next time.

scripts.say: Huh? Was that not good enough?!
Aaaah! Stop calling me that!
Geez. If this isn't girly, then what is?
...Even if it's not quite right, you think it's good enough?
Ahahaha... Not sure how I feel about that appraisal...
*sigh*... Well, whatever!
Anyway, this is my secret base. I came to take a break before the restaurant opened.
It's been busy, but I figured I might as well make time for some light gaming.
Are you free right now? If you want, we could game together.
If you're lost... Beat me, and I'll show you the way back to the restaurant!
And if I lose?
Heheh. If you lose...
You'll have a hard time making it to the restaurant~
Now, bring it on!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night

<size=45>4 Today's Horoscope</size>

scripts.say: Commander, would you like to know your horoscope for today?
My horoscope... Constellation?
Under a night sky littered with shining stars, one Constellation wearing her restaurant uniform beckons to me.

options.content: I'm surprised to see you here...
You're in a good mood, aren't you?

scripts.say: Commander, please don't tease me.
My shift at the restaurant is at night, so of course I'm in a good mood.
It won't interfere with your star-gazing?
Maybe a little... But Commander, don't you think the night sky here has its own unique flavor?
It's not easy to see the sky so clear and starry, even if you climb up to the top of a mountain on a clear night.
But they look so close here. As if you could take the whole galaxy into your hands if you just reach out...
Constellation points up at a particular star.
That one is Ursa Major, and the one next to it is Ursa Minor. And then...
Constellation is always so excited to talk about the stars. She gets more talkative than ever.
And this planetarium was built using the port's newest technology, I believe?
Yep. Isn't it just full of romance, Commander?
Yeah. Romance is an apt word.
Still, I'm surprised that they got you to help around the restaurant. I thought you didn't like crowded places.
Umm... I don't think you're right about that. Actually, I like it when things are livelier.
Really?
But since my sleep schedule is so different from everyone else's, I don't get many opportunities to hang out with them.
But here, I can talk under the beautiful stars with everyone no matter what time it is...
It's so much fun.
...Oh. I blabbered so much that I forgot to ask for your order, Commander.
Ahem... Commander, what would you like to drink tonight?
Thanks for waiting~ Here's the drink you ordered, aaand...
I brought your horoscope results and advice for you♪
I'm awoken in the morning by the gentle mewing of a cat. The scent of food wafts in and beckons me to the kitchen.
Mm, that should do it... Easily digestible foods really are the best for breakfast.
Ah, you're up, Commander?
She turns to me. The cat at her feet, eagerly devouring its food, looks up for a moment.
Kazan is wearing only a thin skirt that accentuates her curves. She smiles sweetly at me from the kitchen counter.
Birdsong and the sizzling of the pot blend with her silhouette, making for a truly wonderful morning scene.
I can't believe I slept in so much. Did you turn off my alarms?
Spring tends to make people tired, so I wanted to let you get a little more rest.
And I got to enjoy your adorable sleeping face at the same time. Heehee, you're too cute when you're vulnerable♪
When I'm about to respond, I feel soft fur brush against my leg, so I squat down and pet this needy kitty.
Heehee... I think it likes you, Commander.
I want you to pet me, too!
Is that all you want?
Oh my, Commander. You saw through me so easily.
I suppose the longer you spend with someone, the more you start to understand them.
By the way... Did you sleep well last night? I'm curious how you would rate your night time with me.
I held you tightly all through the night because I was worried you might accidentally fall out of bed...
But sometimes, I'd wonder if I was holding you too tight and making it hard for you to breathe...
I slept great.
Oh... I'm happy to hear that.
Ah, by the way. Would you like a cup of hot milk?
I reach for a cup, but she takes it first and lifts it to her lips.
Then, she gently blows on the milk. The warm steam mists her skin, tinting her cheeks with a soft glow.
She takes a small sip. It leaves a faint milky trace on her lips and a spark of pleasure in her eyes.
Mm... Just the temperature you like, Commander. Go on and try it.
Our fingers touch as I accept the milk. Kazan takes the opportunity to hook her pinky around mine.
The gentle smell of milk is right under my nose.
Commander, aren't you forgetting something important?
If you want to bolster your immune system, milk alone isn't going to cut it.
You need something else... Can you guess what it is?

options.content: Is it something in the milk?

scripts.say: No? Of course, the milk is important, but so is the person who prepared it for you.
Come here, Commander. I'll give you a nice, warm hug.
Heehee. I knew you'd understand.
Come quickly... I'll give you a nice, warm hug.
Like last night, her embrace is so tight that it gives me almost no space to breathe.
I want to do every little thing I can for you. I never want to take my eyes off you...
To be your safe harbor and your reliable guardian... To give you everything that you're willing to take.
Maybe this is just a vice of mine... Heehee.
Now, would you like to help me finish this breakfast?
Yes, just like that... Hold my hand as we stir with this ladle...
Gentle motions... Yes, good.
Let's have a delicious morning together, Commander.
My body clock wakes me up on time. The room smells like flowers.
As I slowly open my eyes, I see a girl gently touching a budding tulip under the warm sunlight.
Hum hum... It's such a beautiful morning, don't you agree?
There, there... Good baby~ I wish I could be like you, always by the Commander's side in your most perfect state...
Zeven gingerly brushes the dew off of the petals and coos to the flower in a sing-song voice – until my movement catches her attention.
...Oh? You're awake, Commander.
You worked so late last night that I thought you'd sleep in a bit.
Zeven? Why are you here?
Umm... You're just too cute when you sleep. I couldn't bear to miss the sight.
I told the plants, "I want to be the first thing the Commander sees when waking up."
And they graciously let me in!
(That doesn't make much sense.)
(But honestly, knowing her, I almost believe it.)
Then, the bed was so comfy that I just had to change into something more comfortable...
I'm right at home now... What should I do about our date?
Oh, right, we did plan to go for a walk in the garden this morning.
Did I oversleep?
Nope. Right now, the time is...
Umm... Yes, we should have plenty of time until our date. It's 12 midnight.
Wait... Huh?
What the...?
The clock says it's midnight, but it sure doesn't look like it outside.
B-but the clock hands really do stop here, see...?
I have a closer look at the clock and realize what the problem is.
The hands... they don't just stop – they're stuck in place.
Last night, after I walked you to your room, I thought I'd set your alarm for the morning... And then...
Ah! Oh no, it hasn't moved at all since then...
Did I break it again? I'm pretty sure I followed the instructions just right...
Ah. I think I get it.
That explains everything.
Sorry, this is really my fault. Next time, I'll set it myself.
I'm sorry... I keep causing trouble for you.
I don't know if this makes up for it... but I have a little surprise. It holds all of my feelings for you♪
Zeven gently leans in and puts a hand over my eyes.
A fresh fragrance envelops me.
Do you recognize this scent on me, Commander?

options.content: My sense of smell isn't too keen...

scripts.say: It smells like flowers... or all of spring, really.
Do you think so? That's a more poetic answer than I expected.
It smells really good, but it's so close that I can't discern it.
Then shall I get some coffee beans to reset your sense of smell?
Heehee. Today's scent is a yellow tulip. It's just for you.
In the Kingdom of Tulipa, it symbolizes a smile that lights up my life even more than the sun.
That's exactly how I feel about you.
You bring light and warmth like the sun itself, encouraging even the shyest of buds to bloom...
Every moment with you is as bright and lovely as this spring day, Commander.
On one spring afternoon, Evertsen invites me to her room.
The door is slightly ajar. I knock a few times, but there's no answer, so I get a little worried and open it.
Hmm. Coevolution...
The characteristics of two species gradually change as influenced by long-term interaction between them...
In the end, they reach a form most optimal for each other.
She sits by the window with her back to me, bathed in sunlight, focused intently on something.
The sun brightens the room beautifully, its light gently reflecting off the faint particles of dust floating in the air.
All is quiet until I come closer and offer my own take on the theory.
It's a lot like me and the Commander.
But surely the Commander has a far greater influence on me than I do on... Huh?
She whips around in surprise.
Commander, how long have you been there... Is it already time?
I'm sorry. I got so absorbed in this that I didn't even hear the knock. And I even let you approach me unaware...
Also, erm... You're a little close...
Please sit down over there. I prepared the seat just for you.
Ahem. I've done the research, and when people face each other, it becomes easier for certain feelings to blossom.
Liken it to a dance. You need to understand each other's movements.
Advancing, retreating, changing direction... Only by gazing at each other can you move in sync and find your rhythm.
In short, Commander, I just want to look you in the eyes. That is all.
What do you think...? Do you agree with my logic? Or do you seek something more stimulating?
She speaks in straightforward language, but her breathing is accelerating, and her ears get pinker by the second.
I do as she says and sit across from her. Then, I hold out my hand.
Evertsen, can you lend me your hands for a while?
Hm? For what?
Though confused, she offers me both of her hands. Her shyness and nervousness are clear from the way they tremble.
She probably doesn't realize it herself. Either way, I can't leave her like that.
You're hyperventilating a little.
About that coevolution you were talking about earlier... Why don't we try putting theory into practice?
Take my hand and breathe. Slowly, deeply... In, out. Good job.
*inhale*... *exhale*...
I guide her breathing rhythm to help her calm down.
Feeling better?
Yes... I knew it would be great to let you take the lead.
Now...
Suddenly, she pushes me back against the window while I'm off guard.
Under the soft golden sunlight, Evertsen quietly lets her feelings show.
Influencing each other, evolving together...
In the end, you develop... a perfectly in-sync, symbiotic connection.
Commander... Will you let me take the lead now?
The Commander must still be deep in dreams...
I hope I'm the one in those dreams... Our date yesterday was so much fun.
We were totally in sync with tactics, and our battle plans were perfectly aligned...
Huh? W-wait...
Did I... make the Commander study combat tactics with me all day?!
Oh, no... We were supposed to be on a date, and I wasted it all on studying!
Of course, I do like learning with the Commander... but dates must be used for more romantic things!
What do I do... It feels like I've missed the chance now.
Ugh, I can't be down like this. I need to fix the Commander's impression of me!
Now's the time for breakfast... Oh!
All we have in the fridge are milk and bread...? Well, I can manage with this!
Into the toaster you go... And I heat up the milk...
Phew. The milk is almost as warm as the Commander's body now... Heehee... Ah, whoooa!
Albion lets out a startled cry, followed by the clattering of glass.
Alerted by this, I hurried to the living room to check on her.
Albion, are you okay? You're not hurt, are... Hm?
The first thing I notice is how flustered she is.
The second is... her sheer wetness.
The overturned cup lies on the bar counter, while the milky liquid slowly spreads across the surface...
Still leaning against the counter, Albion seems totally oblivious to what she just did.
Oh, no... Huh?! C-Commander?!
Wait... am I the reason the milk spilled? Am I that clumsy?
It's all over you, too.
Whaaat?! It's all over my chest...! C-Commander, please don't look at me!
It's just too embarrassing...
I can wipe up the milk or something, if you want...
But you shouldn't have to clean up my mistake...
Umm... Actually, if you don't mind... *sniffle*
Thank you, Commander... But the milk's somewhere I can't quite see...
Would you please help me wipe it up?
As I come closer, a soft blush spreads across Albion's skin.
Ah... Th-thank you, Commander...
Oh... Are you done already? I'm not sure if I...
No! I'm not upset! I'm happy, I really am...!
I mean, not because I caused trouble for you... But because you took your time to help me. It makes me very happy...
Phew... Is everything clean now?
Ah, the tissues are a mess... I'm so sorry.
She approaches, her expression troubled like a scared fawn.
Commander, will you stop liking me because I'm so clumsy...?
Umm... Should I take that to mean that you don't mind?
Thank goodness. I'll be more careful next time!
But first, there's a favor I want from you...
Albion leans in close, gazing at me with her watercolor eyes.
Would you please... stay with me on this warm spring day?

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 2

<size=45>1 Dreamy White Sands</size>

scripts.say: It's well into the night. I should go to bed early so I can have a productive day tomorrow.
Hmm... This is quite the predicament...
A familiar voice speaks to me.
