Opening my eyes, I'm greeted by a cloudless blue sky and sea that stretch to the horizon... and Shinano, donning a swimsuit, looking abashed.
It seems... You've appeared in this one's dream...
This little creature won't let go of my swimsuit... It's most humiliating to be seen like this... Will you help?

options.content: (Advice her on how to get the starfish off.)

scripts.say: Like this, you mean? I see...
This one hopes... this unsightly appearance doesn't cause you offense...
Mmh... I feel your strong hand, even through the fabric...
Ah... No, it's alright. Please do continue...
After a bit of work, the starfish clinging on to her swimsuit finally comes off.
Your hand in removing the creature is appreciated...
...What is this place, you wonder?
It is a dream plane of endless blue – a reflection of one's thoughts...
Therefore, it stands to reason that this humiliating garb and the sea creature both are mirrorings of your thoughts and expectations...
Your yearning for me brings me joy... even if your mind's projections are on the odd side...
Please, you needn't apologize.
Dreams, while woven from experiences, are not strictly bound by your sense of reason...
Furthermore, this dream came to be because I, too, desired a rendezvous with you...
And as this bliss is a fleeting one, one should enjoy it while they can...
Passion, palpitations... whether they be felt in the waking world or a dream, their effects are tangible all the same...
So, let us forget the rules and constraints of the earthly world and follow our hearts in the dream world...
Yes, let us surrender ourselves to these feelings...
And partake in one another...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 2

<size=45>2 Sojourn Through Clear Seas</size>

scripts.say: On Unzen's invitation, I've come to the beach. We gaze at the calm seas together, enjoying the tranquility.
Here, Commander, have some tea.
...Oh, you find its taste lacking? I thought the leaves had sufficiently infused the water, so I strained them in advance...
It seems this had the opposite effect of what I intended...
That's not strictly true. I tell her that the aftertaste definitely makes me think of her.
Heehee. That makes me feel better. Thank you.
Now, why don't you come and lie down beside me? The view is quite different here.

options.content: But what if I fall into the water?
Wouldn't it be pretty cramped, though?

scripts.say: You need not worry about that. I promise you it won't happen.
Oh, but if you do wish to swim in the deep blue, I will gladly join you.
That sounds like it could be fun. Unless you'd prefer to swim alone, that is?
You think so? I think there's plenty of space for both of us if you don't mind our skins touching.
Granted, that is a big if... Maybe that IS something you'd prefer to avoid?
I don't want her to jump to any more conclusions, so I shrug and sit down in the hammock. Immediately, my nose picks up a saline breeze and a pure scent coming from Unzen.
Thank you, truly, for indulging this wanderer today, Commander.
You know, I've known you for a while now, and thoughts of you always come to mind whenever I go wandering.
If the fates permitted it, I would freely walk the lands for years with only you by my side... Of course, that's not going to happen.
But, even being with you for a few hours still makes me feel unbelievably fulfilled.
...Oh, please, there's no need to be sorry.
It's just a pipe dream of mine. I know you cannot abscond your role in protecting the world's lanes.
I ask only that you stay true to your duty until we can enjoy true, lasting peace.

options.content: One day, I'll make your dream come true.

scripts.say: Oh, Commander...
All those days I languished over what my dream is... You are the only one who can bring such a tempest to my calm heart.
I will remember that promise until the end of my days.
But for now, let's just enjoy this moment to ourselves...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 2

<size=45>3 The Cat and the White Steed</size>

scripts.say: Hmm-hm-hmm~♪
Cheshire in the morning♪ Cheshire in the snow♪
Heart full of excitement♪ Waiting for her Owner to show♪
I walk through the snowy forest, following the sound of someone singing.
A clearing appears in my path. There, I find a princess draped in white.
Owneeer! There you are!
Come here, come here!
Gosh, talk about dragging your feet! Fine, I'll come to you instead~♪
P-princess? Wow, someone's a real smooth-talker...
Heehee... That's right! I am a princess – YOUR princess.
And if this were a fairytale...
I'd give you my hand, you would place your lips on it, and then...
You know what? That trope is old and busted!
I'd rather take the lead and hug you instead!
Despite the deep snow, and with no regard for her delicate dress, Cheshire throws herself at me with open arms.
Hey, why don't we hop on my horse?
Let's go for a horseback stroll through the forest in the morning light~ It'll be a ton of fun♪
Believe me, I'd love to...

options.content: But your dress isn't suited for riding horseback.

scripts.say: That's not a problem! I know a trick!
You can take the reins, and I'll sit in the back and hold you tightly!
...You're thinking about how we don't have a saddle, and the ground is slippery, aren't you?
Yeah, I guess... Okay, lemme think about a solution!
Hrrrrmmmmmhhh!
Out of nowhere, Cheshire circles behind me and wraps her arms around me in a snug embrace.
I've got it! Let's not ride the horse!
We can just wander the woods like this!
I look over and notice the horse has started casually walking off, probably to search for patches of grass buried under the snow.
Meanwhile, Cheshire flashes me a smile as bright as the morning sun.
It's hard to walk like this, but I guess I can put up with it if it means spending some time with my "princess"...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night II

<size=45>Allnight Charge</size>

scripts.say: Evaluation complete. Pose unsatisfactory.
No, this isn't good, either... Evaluation result: unsatisfactory.
Still not right... Appraisal: unsatisfactory.
At the port's promotional shoot, Kearsarge repeatedly adjusts her pose in front of the camera.
It seems like she just can't get it to her liking.
Her expression is as flat as ever, and her voice doesn't show much emotion...
But her anxiety is evident in the frequency with which she changes poses.
Inevitable difficulties during filming observed. Halting filming order and searching for a solution.
Search... failed. Continuing troubleshooting.
Ugh, this isn't working... Requesting on-field guidance.
Commander, the filming must be stopped immediately.
My search for a solution has been fruitless. I need actionable advice.
This is just my opinion, but I don't think you can call all of those poses outright failures.
Did you judge them as failures because they weren't what you expected?
I'd like to hear what you're going for first...
Of course. I would like to pose in a way that matches the new set and special costume.
I studied a wealth of relevant resources in preparation, and yet...
While I tried to imitate the poses in said resources, I felt some small inconsistencies.
A wealth of resources, huh...
(I guess that explains some of those...more flamboyant poses.)
(She's so focused on the motif of the outfit and set that she's forgetting to be herself.)
(No wonder it differs from her expectations.)
I have an idea. Forget the clothes and the set for now, and try posing however feels right to you.
Forget them...?
Yeah. Instead of changing yourself to fit them, you should express what you want to.
...There is some logic in that.
Very well. I will try a new composition.
After a moment of thought, she runs back in front of the camera.
Ultimate final weapon...
Activate!
Thanks to Kearsarge's natural expression and motions, the filming swiftly ends in success.

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night II

<size=45>Delirious Duel</size>

scripts.say: So you've finally awoken, Contract Binder.
A familiar voice reaches my ears. When I open my eyes, I'm not in my bedroom.
Nnh... Where am I...?
The unfamiliar room is enveloped in dim light. I spy scattered cards, retro decorations, and...
Hindenburg. She lays on the sofa in uniform, wearing a fearless smirk on her face.
You look confused. Heehee... Did you already forget about me? We've yet to finish our little game.
Game...?
Yes, of course.
You cannot exit this room until you've overcome the devil's trial.
(I'm racking my brain, but my mind is so blank that I can't remember anything...)
(If Hindenburg says so, then... I guess she must be right...?)
Heehee. Of course, I don't mind extending this intermission...
No, better yet...
Contract Binder, I have half a mind to trap you here forever and make you my plaything.
♪~ Don't be scared, now.
I won't do anything as long as our game goes on... but if you lose, well, that changes things♥
Are you ready, Contract Binder?
Heehee, I love your confidence. Let's just hope you can maintain it.
What a shame. Lady Luck isn't on your side today, Contract Bearer.
Strange... That's not what I calculated...
My hand of cards has been driven into a corner. Where did it all go wrong?
Still lost in thought? That's okay. Struggle a little more; that'll make it so much easier for reality to sink in...
Hindenburg leans back into the couch comfortably. She's the very image of a carnivore waiting for her prey to fall into a trap.
That's exactly what it takes for me to realize how things ended up this way.
(...Is that it?!)
I reach a hand out toward a certain enticing feature of hers.
Contract Binder? Have you run out of patience... Hm?
From there I pluck out a single card wedged between them – the card that will save me from the clutches of defeat.
Heehee. When did that get in there?
It seems our game has gone back to square one.
Beloved Contract Binder, are you prepared for what's to come?

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Resplendent Night II

<size=45>Diligent Domestic Discipline</size>

scripts.say: Enjoy, Commander...
Kazagumo anxiously hands me piping-hot tea.
The scent of tea wafting over the terrace intermingles with the aroma of flowers.
(The green tea is clear and vibrantly colored. When I take a sip, the mellow taste is just a tiny bit bitter, but the aftertaste is sweeter.)
It tastes good. I feel nice and warm now.
You've learned a lot from your training, Kazagumo.
Don't butter me up, Commander... Oh! Should I call you Master?
You flatter me, Master, but I still have so much to learn.
I've only scratched the surface of the art of tea ceremonies.
On top of that, it's important for a maid to be able to keep the garden in peak condition.
The flowers in the garden are in full bloom, bursting with color.
The drops of water rolling gently down the petals are proof of how well they're cared for.
You're doing wonderfully at the tea ceremony and caring for the flowers. Good job.
It's embarrassing to receive such praise...
Don't you think a maid should know when to accept deserved compliments?
Umm... D-don't tease me, please...
I'm not. You brewed delicious tea, and the flowers are beautiful.
So I have to say, your training...
W-wait! I still haven't shown you the most important result of my training!
So, basically...
Master, is my lap comfortable?
I'm not cleaning your ears too forcefully?
It's a little itchy? Should I be more forceful?
That feels good? Okay, I'm glad...
All of my mentors told me this is the most important thing.
Wholeheartedly serving my Master...
Commander... Are you satisfied with my progress?
The fluffy ear pick gives me indescribable pleasure.
Combined with the softness of Kazagumo's thighs...
Yeah. She gets a perfect score from me.
*bum bum bum!*
With a powerful, rhythmic drum beat, the curtain rises, revealing a huge box on stage.
Dazzling light, wavering dreams... How did the magic that allowed this one to appear before you in an instant look to your eyes?
A shower of confetti bursts as a spotlight lights up the box and the girl inside. When we lock eyes, she smiles sweetly.
Very unique! I like it.
This one is glad that you enjoyed it... Welcome to the dreamscape this one has crafted just for us...
Help me figure this out. Did you come into my dreams again, or something?
Yes... This one entered your dream and created this magical stage for you.
Ah... Something very important nearly slipped my mind...
Shinano slowly raises her hand and flashes a playful little peace sign.
The destroyers taught me that this "peace sign" should convey joy to you...
She tries to move inside the glass box, but her tail takes up so much space that it's hard for her to get anywhere.
Alas... The box is a little more cramped than this one intended. Apologies...
But aren't we in a dream? Can't you just make it bigger at will?
The secrets of my magic are hidden in this box... If this one so readily adjusted it, the mystery would be gone...
Hmm? So there is a mechanism, huh?
If you wish to know... then come closer and look...
I go up to the stage and look around the box, but I find no obvious mechanism.
(Nothing around the box... Does that mean the mechanism is the glass itself?)
After I finish investigating, I circle back and stand in front of Shinano, her drowsy yet still enchanting eyes never leaving me for a moment.
Curious, I gently place my hand on the glass separating us.
She does the same, her hand overlapping mine.
She leans in closer, and her warm breath fogs up the glass...
And her enigmatic ocean-blue eyes shimmer with tender affection.
Did you find it now...?
No, not yet.
Heehee... Then why not come inside...?
Inside the box? But how am I supposed to get it open if I don't know the trick?
The glass in front of me suddenly turns into soft, dissipating particles of light.
With her support gone, Shinano falls forward. Her soft, slender fingers intertwine with mine.
I feel her warmth and softness through the sheer cloth.
This is the true mechanism, Commander...
The stage lights around us gradually dim, and her fluffy tail wraps around us.
And our dream has only just begun...
I'll just lie here for a while. Thank you, Commander...
I lend my shoulder to Napoli and help her lie down on the poker table.
Her cheeks are delicately flushed a soft pink, and her eyes hold a hesitant, almost dreamy gaze as she looks intently at me.
Sorry... I'm the one who asked you to teach me poker, and now I can't even focus...
Why am I so dizzy all of a sudden?
Are you actually a lightweight?
Huh? A lightweight...?
Napoli cocks her head and glances at the drink next to her.
...Was that drink alcoholic?
Oh. You didn't know?
No... I've had drinks that tasted similar before, so I just thought it was one of those...
But now that I'm looking at it, the packaging is a little different...
I'm really sorry, Commander. Am I causing trouble for you again?
Ugh, just like always...
It's fine. I don't feel troubled in the slightest.
Not at all. I'm happy that you are willing to rely on me.
Besides, you're hardly causing me trouble to begin with.
I appreciate that, but I can't rely on you forever...
She puts a hand on the poker table and tries to support herself.
But she loses balance and falls again. Then, she grabs my sleeve.
I'm sorry... I'm still a little dizzy.
You have work to attend to, don't you? Please, just go back. There's no need to waste all your time on me...
There's some sadness in her voice.
I'll be fine by myself. Just means I'll be stuck resting here for a while...
She lets go of my sleeve, and then grabs my hand... Our palms share a quiet warmth.

options.content: I worry too much to do that.

scripts.say: I'll be right here. I'd be worried if I left you alone.
Who cares about work? Some overtime will fix that. Right now, my focus is solely on you.
Don't worry. I'm staying.
The glaze in her eyes fades a little.
Her long eyelashes flutter as she blinks, hiding the faint sparkle in her eyes.
She presses her soft cheek against my palm and nuzzles it, like a bunny in need of pets.
In that case... Please stay right by my side, Commander...
Commander, are my expression and pose adequate? If you have any advice, please tell me.
If you lower your left leg a little, it should fit into the frame much better.
Try smiling a little more?
Overall, I think you'd benefit from relaxing a bit.
After the first round of filming, Nakhimov relaxes and stretches in place.
You tired?
I'm okay. I was more nervous, if anything.
But it's a good thing you came, Commander.
Before, I just couldn't get into the swing of things...
Phew... Still, why did everyone choose me to be the star of this promo video?
I'd think there are plenty of cuter, more appropriate girls for it.

options.content: You say that as if you're not cute.

scripts.say: Oh... Okay.
Though she still has that collected expression, she looks away, as if to avoid my gaze. Her cat ears gently bounce with the movement.
By the way, everyone else has bunny ears. Why did you get singled out with cat ears?
These aren't cat ears. They're observation equipment.
That aside...
I picked them because I thought they suited me. You like how they look on me too, don't you?
Her tone may be as calm as ever, yet I can't help but notice the faint blush painting her cheeks.

options.content: I do love some cat ears.

scripts.say: Cat ears are perfectly fine. Want to try the bunny ears next time?
Though I'm sure anything will look cute on you.
I have no preference. Wear whatever you want, really.
Because you're cute no matter what.
Okay, I understand.
In that case...
Suddenly, something seems to wrap around my arm.
Her "tails" have wriggled over and clung to me.
Huh?! W-wait, my cables...!
Don't get all grabby just because I feel happy, darn it!
After her "tails" releases me, she becomes even more visibly nervous.
(At this rate, I don't think she'll be able to focus on her next round of filming.)
While I think about how I can calm her down, I notice her adjusting her "cat ears."
That's it!
What is it, Commander?
(It's time to show off the ultimate petting skills I learned at the cat café!)
Mm...
And it works – she seems to practically lose herself in the moment. Her eyes close with a look of pure contentment, and her eyelashes tremble ever so slightly...
Thus, the petting session continues for quite a while...
Commander... Meeeow♡
Here is your seat, dear guest. I'll join you for a treat, a chat, or whatever you'd like~
Hm?
(Is it just me, or does she look dead inside?)
I look Halford up and down. Despite the sickly-sweet smile on her face, there isn't a sign of vigor in those eyes.
(She loves work, though. That's odd.)
(Is Akashi threatening her or something?)
...What are you staring at?
She stops smiling and puffs out her cheeks unhappily, meeting my gaze.
Just wondering what dirt Akashi has on you. Otherwise, you wouldn't be acting so weird.
None! Akashi has nothing to do with it. I just...
She sighs, squeezes her plushie Dora, and hesitates for a moment.
I'm just a little uneasy because of how easy this job is...
I mean, all they want me to do is sit here and talk with you all sweetly.
It hardly feels worthy of a reward...
Besides, talking to you is already reward enough. Who considers this actual work?

options.content: What if you just don't treat it as work?

scripts.say: If that's how you feel, then forget about the whole "work" thing entirely.
Just consider it a friendly chat with me, and maybe you'll be able to relax a little?
Hmm... That does sound like it would work...
...Nuh-uh, no way! Work is work. I will not mix work with personal matters!
I will have you know that I take my work very seriously!
After learning what my job is about, I agonized over which plushies would be perfect for this occasion and even put hours into training them!
She holds her plushie in front of her face in an effort to cover up her embarrassment.
You were training your plushies? What, do they talk, too?
I didn't mean it literally! Of course they don't talk! I carefully dressed them up.
Halford's Arts of Healing, Article 1: Soothe my servant with cute things.
...So? Do you feel soothed by my adorable little Dora?
If this isn't enough... th-then choose whatever you like instead!
...Until you are healed and happy!
So I can choose anything I want in here?
Of course!
Does that mean I can choose you, Halford? I mean, you're on the couch too.
Huh?!
She screams out of surprise. When she understands what I'm getting at, though, she gets even more embarrassed. Her cheeks turn a rosy red.
I am no plushie! I'm the 127th lord of a bloodline who rides upon the night sea!
And you are my servant! How... How dare you make such a request...!
Sorry, sorry. I just wanted to tease you since you were talking about your job and your uneasiness.
Do you feel a little better now?
What? It was all a joke...?
Hmph! Well, I'm going to take it seriously!
You gave me permission, though.
Did you not say I could choose anything I wanted in here?
"Anything" does not mean "only plushies," as I recall.
Commander, you little...
With her cheeks puffed angrily, Halford stands up... and plops down right into my lap.
Her soft bunny ears graze my cheek, and she buries her beet-red face into my shoulder.
Dear guest... Does this soothe and satisfy you?
(This should be the spot where the newly approved pop-up was constructed.)
*CREEEAK!*
An odd noise interrupts my train of thought. When I look to investigate...
Oh, Commander? What brings you here?
I see Daisen lying on the platform, her legs tangled in the red cord used in decorations.
With every slight movement of her legs, the red cord tugs, causing the attached decorations to sway and emit a faint sound.
Daisen? Uh, what's going on...?
Ah... I'm so sorry you had to see me in this weird state.
I wanted to hang some decorations here to liven up the new construction, but I was... well, careless, in a word.
Please forgive me for being too indisposed to show proper hospitality.
Don't worry about it. I doubt you'll be able to get out of this bind yourself. Want some help?
I'm so sorry to trouble you, Commander...
She breathes a sigh of genuine relief.
Who knows how long I would be tied up here if you hadn't arrived?
As I approach the platform, it becomes evident that things are much worse than I'd expected.
Is there anything I should watch out for? Like, am I going to bring the decorations crashing down?
It's okay. I already made a mess of it, anyway...
I can fix it all after.
Got it.
I begin carefully untying the red cord.
Her skin bears faint red marks, a subtle sign that she's been tied up for quite some time.
The dark-red cords and the pinkish-red marks on her fair skin make for a striking contrast.
Commander...
Sorry. Did that hurt?
No. It's just... that you don't have to be so gentle.
Be rougher if you want... I'll be just fine.

options.content: No, I think this needs a steady hand.
The last thing I want is for you to get hurt.

scripts.say: Let me take it slow and steady. I'd feel awful if I ruined your decorations.
You put your heart into this work, and it wouldn't be right to put that effort to waste.
Most of all, though, I don't want to see you hurt.
I don't want to hurt you.
Besides, you worked really hard to get this done. Let's not put that to waste.
Oh, my... Okay.
Almost done. Lift your legs a little for me?
Um... Like this?
She lifts her legs higher for me, allowing me to untangle the last of the mess.
Thank you so much, Commander.
Don't mention it. By the way, the application paper called this the prayer space, right?
Why did you think to add a prayer space in the shop?
Well... Akashi said it was "trendy." And something about it being a "viral spot" for the shipgirls...?
Also, she had some kind of plan to raffle off the opportunity of being the first to pray here...?
Though I don't think she'll be able to do that ♪
Why's that?
Because I already prayed while I was decorating.
"May the Commander be safe and sound – and may I always be by your side."

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival II

<size=45>1 Fireworks Adorn the Night Sky</size>

scripts.say: "A thousand flowers bloom in the wake of the Eastern wind."
"Petals fall as a shower of stars, their aroma left in the trails of carriages passing through."
"The flutes composed, the moonlight bright. Fireworks adorn the night sky, leaping like carp on a waterfall."
A silver-haired girl lingers on the veranda and quietly recites a poem to herself.
Her sheer dress dances in the night breeze, and the lights blend into the dark of night, but they pale before her radiance.
Commander... You've been quiet for a while now. Is something wrong?
Did I... make a mistake in my poetry reading?
That's not it. I'm just worried that I'll ruin the beautiful view if I speak.
B-beautiful...
Well, thank you for that...
Albion looks down just slightly and thanks me.
Despite being the one who invited me here, she's awfully nervous.
Are you not bored here, or anything...?
If you are... you could, say, wander around the city.
It's lively there, a-and there's much more fun to be had...
Albion tries her hardest to come up with something, only becoming more nervous in the process. I should console her somehow.
You were reciting a Dragon Empery poem, weren't you?
What made you pick that one? Is there a special reason?
Oh, Hai Tien taught me this poem.
If we ever got a moment alone together tonight...
I was thinking I'd recite it with the resplendent night sky at my back, or...
But... Hai Tien says there's a second half to the poem.
I was hoping to spice up the conversation by having you teach me the rest...
(Hai Tien?)
Ahem... Do you know what the poem means?
Well... Not exactly...
How about you try guessing?
Words can display emotion. Even if you don't know the origin or background, you should be able to read between the lines a bit.
Umm... The text makes it sound like a bustling city. I think it's describing a festival, or something.
The vibrant city is backed by a night sky adorned with fireworks...
Colorful lanterns, folks enjoying a night on the town...
...It sounds a lot like the port right now, heehee.
Sounds like you understand it perfectly. Okay, the second half is...
"Decorated beauties, like golden thread hanging from the snow willow. Laughter and chatter pass by, leaving only a scent behind."
"A hundred, thousand searches later, I look back. Beyond the lantern lights, there she is."
How pretty...
Yeah. It's a great poem.
What do you think now that you've heard the rest?
I can feel the author's heart wavering...
The laughter and joy in the poem are so far removed from them...
They search single-mindedly for a certain someone, but they come up short...
When they finally turn around, in the dim light, they finally find that someone...
That's a lot like how I feel right now. Hahaha!
C-Commander...
Well? Do you still want me to go wander around the city?
N-no... I think I'd like you to stay here with me, if that's okay.
The city may be vibrant, but there's a certain atmosphere to here and now.
Besides... The flowers just outside the veranda are in full bloom.
And the tea inside has the perfect aroma...
Here, Commander. Have some tea.
Why don't we let it mark a fresh start to our night together?

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival II

<size=45>2 Spring's Lackadaisical Leisure</size>

scripts.say: Commander, are you awake?
Mmnh...
Where am I...?
There you go. Finally.
You're like a hungry little birdie today, Commander.
...Perseus? Why are you next to me...?
You really forgot, Commander? Geez.
This morning, you came to give me a New Year's gift...
The outfit I'm wearing, y'know.
When I finished changing and came back, I saw a certain lazybones asleep in my bed.
My sleepy brain finally starts working. Now that she mentions it... that does seem to be the case.

options.content: Sorry for using your bed without permission!

scripts.say: It's fine. You don't have to apologize.
There's nothing wrong with being a little lazy on such a nice day.
She makes a fair point. One thing still doesn't make sense, though.
And why are you lying next to me?
Me?
To be a sleeping worm, of course.
A... sleeping worm?
Yep. If you're done asking questions, I'm going back to sleep...
As for the New Year stuff you were talking about before... We can talk about that when I wake up.
Waking up early... is just a way to better enjoy going back to sleep... Zzz...
The bird gets the early worm... The worm gets the early bird...
Did you really fall asleep mid-conversation?
Oh, no... I'm getting sleepy, too...
Is it because of the dim lighting, or is it Perseus's sleepy breathing rhythm?
Well, it is my day off... Might as well rest...
Off to dreamland I go...
Heheheh...
Now the early bird and the early worm have been devoured by the evil bed...
Get some rest, my beloved Commander...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival II

<size=45>3 Moonlit Boat Ride</size>

scripts.say: Teacher, look...!
Up in the sky... It's the moon...!
Pretty...
Anchorage, poised on the bow of the boat, leans forward and points up at the moon.
It peeks out of thick clouds blown about by the wind.
Our boat floats atop the lake, which reflects the moonlight and lights above like a mural of stars.
The moon's all shiny and pretty...!
I relax and watch Anchorage go crazy over the beautiful moon.
(I'm just glad it's out tonight... Nights without the moonlight are lonely.)
Are you having fun, Anchorage?
Yeah...! Anchorage is having fun...!
Boat rides with Teacher are fun!
The boat's rocking and bustling...
It's neat!
And my new clothes...
You gave them to Anchorage... I love them!
Anchorage has a present for you, too...!
A present for me?
(What is it? I'm curious.)
It's the moon!
The moon in the sky... is for you!
The moon, you say?
And how do you plan to give me that?
Hehe... This time... Anchorage can teach you!
Take the moon... like this!
Anchorage stands up and reaches out toward the moon.
It looks as if she's taken it into her right hand.
Join me, Teacher!
Anchorage beckons, so I reach out my hand as well.
Outstretched toward the night sky, our hands touch each other and encircle the moon.
We did it... We grabbed the moon!
It's yours, Teacher...!
Do you like it...?
There's only one answer to that question.
Hehe... Me, too!
Anchorage loves you, Teacher!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival I

<size=45>1 Dance Beneath the Moonlight</size>

scripts.say: And thus, heaven's will be done... No, not good enough. It needs more impact...
Perhaps the one about the light from fireflies above rotten grass... Ugh, no, that still isn't enough...
I've got it! First, I'll don this mask...
How can the light from fireflies above rotten grass ever compare to the brilliance of the moon above?
I'm taking a casual stroll before the Lunar New Year banquet, and it seems I've caught Huan Ch'ang unaware.
She's busy with something, so I should...
Wouldn't want to disturb her. I'd better leave.
She's in the middle of something. Let's not interrupt.
With a hollow crack, a fallen branch snaps under my foot.
Who's there?!
(Maybe if I hold my breath, she won't notice me...)
C-Commander?! When did you get here?
(Guess not...)

options.content: I didn't see anything, I swear!

scripts.say: S-so you saw that...
That's not what I asked!
Oh, god...
Her face immediately turns bright red, like the paper lanterns decorating the streets.
D-don't say a word of this to anyone!
If this gets out, I'm going to... I'll... Look, just please don't tell anyone!
I swear on my honor that I won't tell a living soul, and only then does calm finally return to her expression.
Likewise, the color of her face also goes back to normal. Even so, I can tell something still bothers her.
...What's on my mind?
Oh. Well, it's just that I feel like my appearance isn't sufficiently stately.
I've changed into a new outfit, as you see, and I need a new mask and mannerisms to go with it.
As a senior shipgirl, I need to project an aura of strength to those outside my family. It helps me protect others.
I hear you. I can help you with that.
Really? Thanks, I appreciate it.
How's this?
A bit too austere, maybe... Plus, those glowing red eyes feel like they belong on a horror movie monster.
Then how about this black one?
Not bad, but I think one that matched the color of your outfit would be better.
The pink one might be... Actually, no! Th-this is a sleep mask I brought by mistake. I'm not wearing that.
Dang. The pink would've looked cute on you...
This white one is adorned with flowers. I like it quite a lot, but what do you think?
Then there's this one with antlers. It strikes a good balance between cute and mysterious, I'd say.
Also... This manjuu mask...
It's not the least bit stately... but it is cute.
After considerable deliberation and doubt, Huan Ch'ang finally settled on a few masks that would look good on her.
She further practiced her deportment as well. She most definitely projects a stately aura now.

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival I

<size=45>2 Ascendant Dragon's Spring Feast</size>

scripts.say: It is the eve of the New Year's banquet, and a lone girl is sitting down, looking anxious.
Mumble, mumble... Grumble...
Dang it all! I'm so worried!
Oh...

options.content: Are you all done in the kitchen?

scripts.say: No, I'm not okay!
That's the thing! I couldn't even get in!
Earlier this morning, everyone chased me out of the kitchen and forbade me from entering. They said they were preparing a surprise for me...
But... Aaaggghhh! I'm worried out of my mind!
There's all these dishes to cook, and I don't know if Ning Hai and Ping Hai can do it!
What if something goes wrong and they mess it up?
There's also the fact that we all have different tastes and seasoning preferences, so in the worst case scenario...
Lung Wu's face turns more and more pale as she imagines everything that could possibly go wrong.
No! I need to go check on them!
(Hang on... Lung Wu must be exhausted after all the preparatory work she's done the past few days.)
(I also remember Chen Hai asking me to not let her into the kitchen. "She has to rest," she said.)
(That being the case...)
(There are appetizers plated up on the table. Drunken crab, baozis, and more...)
(I don't know who thinks of baozis as appetizers, but as a thing to distract Lung Wu with, they'll do the trick!)
You know what they say – "Don't be scared of freshly baked potatoes." Obviously, these aren't potatoes, but why don't you try one anyway?
Huh? Potatoes? What on Earth are you talking about?
I don't get what baozis have to do with anything... but if you say so, I'll try one...
Om, nom... Mmm!
The texture of this dough! The seasoning in the bean paste! I... I hate to admit it, but Ping and Ning sure cook a good baozi!
Oh yeah? Now try the drunken crab.
Om, nom... Mmm!
It's sweet and juicy... Did they use the Shaoxing wine I took out of the cellar? This has just the perfect amount of soy sauce, too!
(If a delicacy like drunken crab can't help her forget her worries, then not much will.)
(Hm? Come to think of it, someone told me to never, ever let Lung Wu into the kitchen when she's drunk...)
(Chen Hai was so insistent about it that I can't remember everything she said...)
(It's fine. The banquet is almost ready, so there won't be any reason for Lung Wu to go into the kitchen before long.)
I end up so distracted by the delicious drunken crab that... when I come to, I realize that Lung Wu has disappeared.
When I get up to search, Lung Wu is already on her way back to the table.
They're already serving the food, so even if she went to the kitchen, there's surely nothing left for her to flub.
While I rationalize my mistake, Lung Wu is already on her way back to the table.
Before long, the final dish of the banquet – spring rolls – is served.
That marks the completion of my mission to keep Lung Wu in check.
Commander, spring rolls are a must during the New Year's festivities! Give this one a try.
When I put it in my mouth, chew, and taste the spring roll... spiciness beyond words assaults my senses!
Heh heh heh... Spicy, huh? That's the good stuff!
Those are my special recipe – flaming hot spring rolls! I snuck into the kitchen to make them!
Flaming hot?!
Ack! Eating all that drunken crab turned her into a drunken Lung Wu...
Come on, Commander! When she's drunk, she can't cook anything but spicy food!
How could this be...
My perfect strategy, defeated at the hands of drunken crab!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection: Spring Festival I

<size=45>3 Prancing Tiger Welcomes the Spring</size>

scripts.say: I walk down the festive street under the light of lanterns and fireworks.
Grooar! Grooooar!
With a roar, a very odd creature jumps out from the shadows and locks her arm around mine.
Groar groooar! Grooooar!
The shipgirl – no, tiger – blocking my path continues to roar, shaking her huge "head" gleefully from side to side.
Or... No. That is clearly a lion's head. Is this one of those ligers I've heard about?
The liger takes a step left as well.
The liger takes a step right as well.
Grooar, groaroar!
(The lion head is just blinking back at me...)
(Guess I'll have to find another way...)

options.content: (Try taking the lion head off of her.)

scripts.say: The liger swiftly jumps back and evades my ambush.
As a Commander, if I can just command my legs to jump high enough... Yeah, that's not happening.
Hahahaha~ Yaaay, my prank worked perfectly!
(Hm? I know that voice...)
Hu Pen? I didn't realize.
Within the beast's gaping maw, I see Hu Pen grinning proudly.
Heheheh, did I getcha?
Lung Wu and I are practicing our lion dance! We're on break right now, though...
I saw you walking from far away, so I decided to play a little prank on you!
See? My lion dance is awesome, right?

options.content: I'm not sure lions roar like that...

scripts.say: It better be! I gave 2,000% percent of my effort to learn it!
Y-yeah, well... It's cuter the way I do it!
Why did we decide to do the lion dance?
Heheh, because lions are auspicious beasts that can ward off disaster.
...Dragons and tigers are, too? Heheh, you sure know your stuff!
Yep! Lung Wu and I are doing the lion dance, so our tiger and dragon elements will blend in and make it the perfect good-luck dance for everyone!
Hu Pen! Quit slacking off and come back to practice!
Oh, comiiing!
Hu Pen dons her lion head once again.
Bye, Commander! Hope you're excited to see our lion dance!
With that, the lion-tiger hybrid scampers energetically back to Lung Wu.
(Seems like our New Year's festival has an exciting new program coming up.)
"Port Fashion Collection!"
"Full of this season's best hits!"
"Which styles are all the rage now?"
"Don't miss it!"
...Port fashion trends?
Yep! The three of us worked on this independent magazine together!
Yeah~ We wanted to show off the hottest fashion around the port.
We include other content to suit the season, too~
Aoba gathers intel, Gridley snaps pics, and we all handle the writing together!
Of course, our readers and models are all the people of the port!
We might make a few appearances in the magazine ourselves, too...
Right now, we're thinking of releasing once per month.
But if it sells well, we aren't against upping the pace.
Check it out, Commander.
I think it'll help you to know the trends around port, too!
Heheh, maybe you'll learn a thing or two about a shipgirl you've had your eye on...
Now, let these fashion trends roll over the port like a hurricane!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 1

<size=45>2 Splashing, Merrymaking, Love</size>

scripts.say: Heehee, you're finally here, Commander!
You don't know how looooong I've been waiting for you.
As punishment for making me wait... You're gonna spend time with me all day!♪
On this perfect, cloudless day, Hatsuzuki brought me to the waterpark on a whim.
Hey, by the way, what do you think about my swimsuit?
Tadaaa! I got it just for today. Do you like it?♪
Heehee♪ Riiight?♪
Wakatsuki said it was "too mature," but I'm glad I picked it!
Wh-wha...
(I didn't think the Commander would be this direct...!)
A-ahem! O-of course, you're obsessed with me♪ Obviously!
Hey... Commander, what's got you blushing so much?
Someone feeling shy?
Heehee♪ Was my new swimsuit too much for you to take in?
Well, since you like it so much, snap a few more pictures of me!
If you get a cute one, make it your lock screen background! Oh, and you'll need one each for all of your other devices♪
Hatsuzuki did her best to pose like a model.
So? Am I cute, or what?
If you want to request any poses, I'm happy to oblige!
I'm very flexible, so I can even do... Ack!
Hatsuzuki lost her balance, but I managed to catch her just in time.
(Whoa, whoa, whoa!)
(O-our hands are touching! No, not just our hands... We're pressed up against each other!)
Are you okay, Hatsuzuki?
Yes?
I may be incompetent, but I hope you'll take care of me forever, Commander!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 1

<size=45>3 Shimmering Beauty</size>

scripts.say: On one clear day, the scorching-hot sunlight was reflected by the sea like a mirror.
Commander, check me out! Tada! Like this special surprise I planned for you?

options.content: "I'm guessing the surprise is the water bed?"

scripts.say: Bzzt, wrong! But you thought it was the surprise, huh? Heheh, sick!♪
Anyway, the real surprise is this water bed!
Good job, Commander! Man, you're smart.
Y'see, I made it all on my own.
But that was hard, so I did have Suruga and Kii help me out, but still!
What's that? That means I didn't make it "all on my own"?
Pssh, details! Who cares about 'em?
Anyway, Commander, come join me and experience it for yourself!♪
It's like you're really ridin' on the waves. Relaxin', refreshin', this water bed does it all!
Oh, yeah. I made some salad with veggies I picked earlier.
Fresh AND nutritious~ It's all full of my love, too~
You and I are like BFFs, so I bet you'll be able to taste it!
Ahaha, hey, you don't have to eat it that fast! Nobody's gonna take it from you.
I'll make more if we run out, so take your time.
Huh? Why'd I do all this for you?
I mean, you and I are like two peas in a pod.
It's normal to want to make your loved ones happy, yeah?
I'm not all that smart, so thinkin' about it doesn't help me much, but...
I realized I don't NEED to think when I'm around you, Commander.
So I'm gonna follow my instinct!
Hah!
Huggies! Yeah, this is the best way for me to relax♪
Now, we're good and full. Ready for nap time?
Let's take a nice nap together while I hold you in my arms, Commander!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 1

<size=45>4 Blossoming Melody</size>

scripts.say: As I approached the room, I heard a Sakura Empire instrument's melody, interspersed with sighs.
I just can't make it work... *sigh*...
Oh? Commander? Why are you here...?
Because you heard my music...?
Urk... I'm sorry. You shouldn't have to hear such unskilled play...
But it's odd.
I'm trying to play the way I learned, but for some reason, I can't stop playing off-tune...
With a light grunt, Kashino struggled to pick up her instrument again.
Her fingering and posture didn't seem especially wrong, so there was only one possibility.
I think a certain something might be affecting the strings.
Hm? Do you think you can figure out what I'm getting wrong? Thank you!
Umm, wait just a second...!
Kashino righted her posture, with much difficulty, and began playing a tune.
Once it was over...
Oddly, I think I'm playing better now that you're watching me!
Hmm, but it's still a little off... Why could that be?
Commander, um, can you offer any advice...?
The thing is...
Am I simply not skilled enough? Have I not practiced enough?
I don't think that's the problem.
Oh? Then...?
Try playing it again, but this time... Hold it a little further away from you.
Further away? Like this? I'll try!
...Hwuh?
I-I don't know why, but it's a lot better now!
Incredible, Commander!
B-but it is harder to play like this...
Is there no way to solve this problem?
Um...
I looked at the perplexed Kashino, and then at the instrument she struggled to hold.
As long as she didn't move the two "obstacles" between her and the instrument, she'd continue to struggle.
I think you may have no other options.
Aww... C-Commander?
Help meee!

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Part 1

<size=45>5 The Unseen Katana</size>

scripts.say: Aaaah?! Wh-where did my katana go...?!
The Commander will be here any minute now! Why can't I find it?!
(Even though I'm the one who hid it...!)
...Hakuryuu?
Whoa?!
Ouch... Commander?! Wh-why are you here so early...?
What's the matter? You look panicked.
Commandeeer! I can't... I can't find my katana...
That is a problem, to be sure.
I was the one who hid it, but I forgot where I put it...
I can't practice my instrument without it... *sniffle*...
Hakuryuu sobbed as she scooted over and gave me room to sit.
Given her usual attitude, I could never have imagined her being so helpless.
(Either way, this won't do. I should help her look for it.)
We searched her room from top to bottom, but we couldn't find her katana anywhere.
(Then all that's left is...)
Maybe...
(I have heard masters of swordplay sometimes hide their weapons in other things.)
G-good idea!
Yeah! I'll take a look...!
Hakuryuu gently put her fingers on the instrument, as if trying to sense something within.
Commander, can you help me, please? Like here... Oh, and here...
Hm? ...There it is!
(Maybe today's katana is more of a wakizashi, or a knife, or...)
Eep?! C-Commander?! What are you doing?!
I'm going to lose balance... Aah?!
Oooh... Commander, b-be gentle...
...Hmm? Is that...?
Wait a second. Are you trying to take advantage of my moment of weakness?!
Despite how much she was invading my personal space, Hakuryuu had a sudden change of heart and seized my hand.
She wasn't very forceful, though, for some reason.
A-anyway! I've found my katana, so back off!
You've occupied my seat for long enough! Go take your seat in the audience!
Hmph. I was GOING to offer to let you watch me practice, but you've just disappointed me.
What? Where was I hiding my katana?
You felt it, did you not?
(All I felt was something soft. I didn't find anything like a katana...)
Th-then I won't tell you!
Aaaagh! I've had enough of this conversation!
I'm going to practice! Right now!
Hakuryuu suddenly began playing loud music to distract herself from what just happened.
Unfortunately, it seemed the mystery of where she'd hidden her katana would remain a mystery to me.
The peach blossoms bloom... Just as spring has arrived, I've waited for your coming, too.
In a warm, fragrant chamber, clad in a sheer white robe, Chang Wu gazes thoughtfully at a vase of newly blooming peach blossoms. Her silver hair cascades over her shoulders.
With each moment, my hope has only grown.
But I never dared to think that you would really come, Commander.
I place a branch of red plum blossoms on the table. They contrast with the soft pink of the peach blossoms, highlighting each other's beauty in the light.
Heehee. I see you brought a touch of spring, too... The elegance of plum blossoms makes the peach blossoms seem even softer.
She props herself up and tugs at my sleeve, leading me to sit beside her. Under the warm light, the scent of the blossoms mingles with their shadows.
Now that I've put the plum branch next to them, I can't help but feel like my carefully tended peach blossoms are missing something...
What do you think, Commander?
They look beautiful to me, but...

options.content: The branches are a little long...

scripts.say: The branches are a little dense right here.
Following my gaze, she reaches out to touch the branches. They overlap so thickly there that the petals are hard to see.
You have a keen eye, Commander. It would be a pity to hide these beautiful flowers behind their own branches.
I understand logically that you can only preserve true beauty by removing the excess, and yet...
The branches are a little long, especially that one.
Following my gaze, she places her fingers on the overgrown branch obscuring half of the blossoms.
You have a keen eye, Commander. I failed to accentuate the main branches, and the elegance was lost.
I understand logically that you can only preserve true beauty by removing the excess, and yet...
When it comes to actually trimming them, I worry that I'll use too heavy a hand.
How about you point out the spots that need attention, and I'll do the trimming?
Okay! Doing it together sounds best.
Chang Wu places her hand on mine. Her fingertips are chilly, like the finest jade.
Let's start... here.
And then here...
Hmm, I think you should cut it about... this much?
You have a much gentler touch than I imagined.
As the last superfluous branch falls, lamplight filters through the perfectly arranged blossoms, casting beautiful shadows on the nearby screen.
These flowers normally bloom for seven days.
But trimming is like carving jade... Only by sacrificing form for essence can one capture their true spirit.
That is the ultimate way to cherish something.
She holds a single peach blossom petal between her lips and falls into my arms.
The robe slips down her shoulders, showing off more of her fair skin.
What do you think is more beautiful in this moment, Commander? The peach blossoms, or...
...The spring beauty in your arms?
The light flickers, and the shadows on the screen melt into one another. Before long, it's impossible to distinguish where the flowers end and where the two of us begin.
On one soft night, as the day's hustle and bustle gradually subsides, I visit Friedrich der Große's chamber. Soft light leaks out through her half-open door.
She sits on her knees atop the bed with a meaningful smile on her face. Her dress, so thin that I can almost see through it, rises and falls in tune with her breathing.
You've come, my child.
I've heard that in the Dragon Empery, it is customary to give out red envelopes on special occasions.
I prepared a special gift for you, my beloved child. However...
If you want to have it, you'll need to be a little... bold.
I've hidden it somewhere around me. Find it, and it's yours.
Facing my gaze, she clasps her hands in front of her chest. Her eyes sparkle mischievously.
Use your eyes, your fingers... and every other part of you to find it.
I wonder where it could be? Heehee...
Her voice bewitches me into playing her game – a game already decided by her whims.
As I approach, she leans closer to me. My gaze wanders for a while before settling on the soft skin revealed by her neckline, but she seems unbothered by this.
In that abyss lies a splash of red.
What's this I see?
That's right, my child. It's right there... Why are you hesitating?
Don't you think you'll need some courage and wisdom to obtain your treasure?
I try to take it, but it remains nestled deep in her bosom. My fingertips alone aren't enough to pull it free.
I look up at her face. She just smiles quietly, her eyes urging me to continue.
What's the matter, my child? Why stop now?
Don't tell me... Is this level of intimacy enough of a challenge to make you flinch?
Come, my child... Listen to your heart and find your true desires.
Let your desires guide you. Take what is yours, with your own hands.
Soft light flickers in those eyes. I even spot a hint of anticipation.
In that moment, I finally understand her true intentions.
Without hesitating, I place one hand on her supple waist and easily seize my reward.
The red envelope, bathed in her aroma and warmth, is finally in my hand.
Well done... You've learned how to truly embrace your desires now.
I'm proud of you, my sweet child.
With a deep, captivating grin on her lips, she caresses my cheek.
It seems I haven't just obtained the red envelope – I've been given silent consent to take another step further.
Next, I'll guide you... to a more mature world.
After producing a smooth red ribbon, she ties it around my wrist. Then...
Relax, my child...
The boldness you've displayed shows that you want more.
I won't deprive my good child of even an ounce of my love.
The fruits of tonight's intimacy are my reward for your growth.
Don't worry. I'll teach you how to enjoy those fruits.
She leans down, tracing her fingertips on my lips, and stops me before I can speak.
Those burning fingers travel lower, sliding down my chest and beyond.
There's no more need for words, my child... I understand how you feel.
Close your eyes, now. Know that everything you're about to feel... is my gift to you.
Heehee... There's no need to rush things. Let's feel the connection binding us first.
I feel the same way as you, my child...
If you're not sure what to do, then surrender yourself to my embrace.
Relax and lean on me, my child.
Her breath brushes against my ear, carrying the sweet scent of wine.
She tugs on the ribbon wrapped around my wrist, as if urging me to hold her around the waist.
Heehee... You're eager, aren't you, my child?
It's okay. I'll give you all of my love.
Tonight... let's play a beautiful serenade together.
This is only the beginning of Friedrich der Große's lecture on maturity.
Clinging to reason while you drown in desire is what allows us to immerse ourselves in ecstasy.
If you still yearn for anything, then speak... I won't refuse you, my child. I'll be even more eager to provide than you are to receive.
Now, savor my teachings... my beloved child.
On the gentle night breeze ride wisps of an exotic fragrance into my dreams, awakening me from my slumber.
When I come to, I find myself still next to Hai Chou. She's bent over her desk, mixing something.
Commander? Oh, did this fragrance awaken you?
I'm just mixing a new perfume. I think I'll call it... Sublime Pleasure.
Several bottles of perfume line the table, reflecting dreamlike colors in the soft moonlight.
I've searched the world in pursuit of the best fragrances.
The ones I have here are the fruits of my progress. Would you like to try them?
She dabs some perfume on her neck and leans in close.
As she comes closer, I become more aware of her breathing.
This one is Breath of Spring, with the scent of spring rain and newly blossoming life.
Would you like to feel the rain with me, Commander?
Let's not rush things. This one is next.
She gently shakes the next bottle, swirling the gleaming golden liquid within.
Are you curious about what scent lies within this luxurious color? Well, I assure you my Golden Dew will live up to your expectations.
After all, it's no simple fragrance. Its gold will unearth different scents depending on where it touches your skin.
She takes my hand and pours a single drop onto my fingertip, then sniffs it.
Hehe, how unique. In that case...
I'm curious... what kind of scent will be revealed on me when this Golden Dew is warmed by your body heat?
A few more drops fall into my palm. She then takes my hand and rubs it across her soft skin.
Mmm... Your hands, your warmth, and this scent... It's all intoxicating.
Maybe I've already found the true Sublime Pleasure that my heart desires.
When our hearts beat as one and our essences melded together, I felt as if I'd touched upon the truth of Sublime Pleasure.
At the same time... the sheer, shiver-inducing ecstasy from your fingers...
The lingering sensation of our intermingling atop this red silk seems more vivid than ever.
Commander... Is this Sublime Pleasure to you, too?
In the clear moonlight, the fragrance on Hai Chou blooms before me.
Something I've pursued for so long suddenly came within reach the moment I met you...
If I had to describe this scent...
I think I'd call it bliss.
Commander, would you experience that intoxicating Sublime Pleasure with me once more?
As I'm pulled into her embrace, the red silk stretches silently beneath us.
Follow my lead, Commander... Did you catch a hint of that mesmerizing Sublime Pleasure?
Come closer. Focus, now...
Taste the sublime pleasure that is yours alone. The night is still young.
As the night wears on, I make a stop at Shinano's room as promised.
She lies languidly on her bed, holding a vessel of mysterious liquor that shines with an ethereal glow.
Commander... This one has happened upon a wondrous libation. If we drink it together, our senses will be connected, allowing us to dream together.
Thus, this one saved it for an auspicious night... to enjoy with you.
She sits up to pour the liquor, but she suddenly stops – the vessel is already empty.
Hazy eyes blink in confusion. Her fluffy fox tails sweep across the bed as she ponders her next move.
While lost in thought... this one so carelessly drank the dream we were meant to share...
What a pity...
It's okay. I'm sure you'll find more.
No... This one cannot give up on such precious liquor so quickly.
Shinano leans forward and presses a finger to her lips, gazing at me with glazed eyes.
Her tails sway behind her, wafting an enticing scent in my direction.
Phew... Though the vessel is empty, this one still has some left...
If you wish to know the taste... then come closer...
Let us share this dream, if only for an instant...
I lean closer. As soon as I bend down, I'm embraced by her aroma.
Her breath brushes my cheek – refreshing, sweet, gentle, and warm, all at the same time.
When the distance between us is closed, a strange warmth radiates from my lips.
The world around me turns soft and hazy. I feel as if I'm sinking deep into warm water.
Do you feel it? Our heartbeats becoming one...
The sensation... That sweetness melting into your tongue...
It's like honey, or... like a dream.
This is just the beginning...
She guides my hand to her chest. The wonderful rhythm within gradually synchronizes with my pulse.
Listen... Our rhythms have become one...
Through countless dreams has this one wandered... Yet this moment of connection feels the most real of all.
Our lips touch once again. The scent of liquor mingles with our breath, lighting a silent flame in our hearts.
Ah... Your breath is like a hot current rushing through this one's being...
There is no need for words, no need for thoughts... Only feelings. Feel me as this one feels you...
Shinano's tails wrap around my wrist. Their softness sends sweet shivers coursing through my body.
Her fingertips graze my cheek, a paradox of cold against my hot skin.
Is this lingering flavor enough to quench your thirst...? If you wish for more... this one can provide what you desire...
Her embrace is soft, tantalizing, and leaves me wanting. The tipsiness from the liquor has faded, only to be replaced by a more primal intoxication.
I hear nothing but our shared heartbeat, and I taste nothing but her sweet breath.
When our lips meet once more, we are both engulfed in a soft, blue light. The last thing I hear is her hazy murmur.
May this dream never end...
The time is late, and there's a rustling sound as someone searches around for something.
I gently open the door and head in the direction of the noise.
Guided by the faint light radiating from the open refrigerator, I find the source – it's Anchorage, rummaging around the fridge's contents.
Sausage? No... Cheese... Not that either... Ugh...
Milk! Strawberry milk! There you are!
Grabbing a late-night snack?
Oh! Teacher! I'm surprised you're here.
Hearing my voice makes her jolt. She looks over to face me.
I... can't sleep.
I want something sour and sweet like strawberry milk. Is that okay?
Sure.
Thank you, Teacher!
Heehee. Strawberry milk... Let's drink it together!
She picks up the pack of strawberry milk and carefully pours its contents into a cup.
I'll be super careful so you can drink it, too...
Good... Almost there... Just a little more... Ah!
In her enthusiasm, she pours too much milk, causing it to spill.
Teacher, this is no good... My milk... I spilled it...
The sensation of the cold liquid trickling down her skin makes her flap about in a panic. She looks up at me for help.
Teacher, my clothes got soaky-soaked...
Hm? Your clothes... got soaked, too.
But the milk... is still nice and sweet. Heehee.
Try it, Teacher.
She licks the corner of her mouth then presents her milk-stained cheek to me.
Do you like... my strawberry taste?
There's also some on here.
And the strawberry smell is on you as well...
*gulp gulp*
So yummy. I'm satisfied.
Sleepy now... Teacher, let's go to bed together!
But my clothes are still milky... Don't wanna sleep in milky clothes.
I wanna shower. Can you help me, Teacher?
Let's go. We'll shower together.
Enterprise sent me a message that convinced me that I just had to check on her, so I went.
So, as rain falls around me, I arrive at an open-air bath in the woods. She's soaking in a tub and quickly notices me.
...Commander? Why are you here? Came to get some fresh air?
You sent me a message. "You really can't soak for too long in a hot spring."
You didn't reply after that, so I wanted to make sure you were fine.
On her cheeks, there are still the traces of a warm blush.
She becomes aware of my gaze and leans against the tub's edge, relaxing her shoulders while narrowing her eyes.
Thanks for the concern. The water was just so nice that I didn't wanna get out.
I'm fine now. I cooled down with some shower water.
She holds her long, wet hair up with her hand. The strands glisten around her fingers like coils of silver.
In her eyes, a vacant look. They're like two lakes resting in the morning mist.
Ah, sorry... I'm bluffing here. Truth be told, I still feel a bit light-headed.
Could you do me a favor and help cool me off a bit?
She lightly nods her head at the showerhead lying to my side. I pick it up.
Hey, wai–
Before she can finish, a stream of water comes rushing out of the showerhead and splatters onto me.
Uh... What were you going to say?
Pfft. I was going to say the water pressure's pretty high on that one.
If only I'd been quicker on the draw. Heh.
I turn the showerhead off, then Enterprise picks up a towel lying on the tub's rim and wipes my face with it.
She devotes her full concentration to it, and her movements are thorough and gentle.
Then, seeing how soaked my clothes are, she slightly furrows her brow and breathes a small sigh.
You'll get sick if you walk around in wet clothes.
Why don't you hop into the tub with me? You can warm up, then put on new clothes.
That should keep you safe from catching a cold.
As she says that, she shifts her gaze to a point outside the floor-to-ceiling window, as though she's noticed something.
Turning around, I see that beyond the still-falling rain in the sky, a faint rainbow has formed.
A rainbow before the rain's stopped. You don't see that every day.
Sometimes, I think, "There's nothing that'd make me happier than getting to quietly admire the scenery with you." Like this.
I feel like tranquil moments like this are what I've been fighting for all this time.
Sitting reclined against the tub's edge, she softly leans close to me. Even through my clothes, I can clearly feel the mild warmth from her body.
Look, Commander. The rain's going to stop before long.
I've heard through the grapevine that the forest smells nice and refreshing right after rainfall.
Once we leave the hot spring... how about we go for a walk together?

Having finished my work for the day, I went for a walk through the hills. Besides the scent of pine leaves around me, there's a humid smell mixed in there somewhere, and the sound of running water in the distance.
I follow the sound and cut through the mist, and eventually, I catch sight of a hazy silhouette across a curtain of steam.
Hm? Commander?
Did you come here on a break from your work as well? I suppose everyone needs a change of pace.
Bois Belleau is soaking up to her waist in the water. The rising steam gently caresses her shoulders.
Not exactly. I just followed the sound.
So we just happened to meet. Well, good timing nonetheless. I was actually going to recommend this hot spring therapy to you when I got back.
The research claims it's a rather unique form of therapy that's able to wash away the toil of laboring.
And, seeing as you work on a harsh schedule and scarcely get the time to relax properly...
I was thinking we could do this therapy together.
Saying that, she extends a hand to me, prompting me to come into the water.
I find no leeway to say no when faced with her eyes, filled with kindness and care.
Alright. I'll come in.
Mind your step. Take hold of my hand and slowly come in. Get yourself accustomed to the water's temperature.
Come on, come here and sit next to me. That way I can swiftly deal with issues, should any arise.
She scoops up a handful of the warm water and gently pours it on my shoulder.
This ought to take care of both the filth and fatigue you've worked up over the day.
See? The water isn't at all too hot, is it?
Now, I want you to relax... Look at that – your skin is turning slightly red.
Improving your blood circulation also slowly improves your mood. You'll see.
The water slightly whirls each time she adjusts her position, the resulting little ripples carrying a stimulating warmth with them.
After pouring on some more hot water, she sits down next to me again. Her soft exhales graze my ear.
So? Do you feel the hot spring's effects?
It does feel like my body's gotten a lot lighter.
That's good. Then let's move on to the next step.
I want you to stay and soak for a while longer. About an hour in total.
But first... let me quickly examine your body.
She reaches forward and softly grips my wrist. A faint aroma emanates from her wet hair.
Your pulse is going up. Don't worry, though – that's nothing unusual.
Just take deep breaths in and out and match my rhythm.
Breathe in... Breathe out. Breathe in... Breathe out.
Breathe in... Breathe out...
Breathe... Zzz...
Her voice gets smaller and smaller until her breathing turns into quiet snoring.
Her body leans against mine. A humid warmth transmits from her to me.
Um, Belleau?
I gently nudge and try to wake her, but the only response is a calm breath and the beating of her heart. She is sleeping like a log.
Commander... Mmh... Ahh...
Thank you... for staying with me...
Her relaxed body rests on my shoulder, and a whisper and a faint aroma brush against my ear.
As the hills around us fade into and out of existence in the mist, the only thing I can make out clearly is her face, right next to mine.
I get comfortable and enjoy this relaxing moment between us while keeping an eye on her.
Taking advantage of some free time between work, I make my way to the hot springs, hoping to rest my weary bones.
When I arrive, though, something feels wrong. This place is normally bustling, and yet, today there's an eerie silence.
Well, well, Commander. I'm in the midst of a purification ritual, and here you come along.
Did you come to confess your sins to a naked nun, perhaps?
Duguay-Trouin appears, donning black silk oozing with steam.
I just wanted to soak and recharge my batteries... Didn't expect someone else to be here.
Heheh. I got here a little sooner by chance, that's all.
That said, timing can make all the difference in the world. Just like now.
Perhaps you really did come for a soak, or perhaps you came to behold the ritual...
Whatever your wish may be, I will grant it♪
As you can see, I just finished my purification. All the filth in these waters has been purged.
But, just between you and me, there is still another demon lurking in this hot spring resort.
Its evil presence has already tarnished many other baths, and...
She stops herself mid-sentence and carefully examines me from top to bottom.
Oh my word! You've accumulated quite a lot of impurities before coming here, Commander!
I'll need to give you a thorough cleansing to remove the evil that's possessed you!
A "cleansing"? What do I need to do?
Oh, it's quite simple, trust me.
If you'll cast your mind back to just a moment ago, I said I've purified this bath.
In other words, all I ask of you is to get into the water with me.
Then we may begin the purification ritual.
With those words, she temptingly retreats to the edge of the hot spring and poses with a come-hither gesture.
She smiles as she sticks her tongue out teasingly in anticipation of what's to come next.
Well, Commander?
I'm extending an invitation to you. Surely you won't give me the cold shoulder?
Ahh... I get what you mean by "purification" now.
It's just an excuse to lure me into your trap, isn't it?
Ahaha! Oh, you joker, you.
I simply needed an excuse to have this resort all to myself to excise all the demons here. You must understand.
But that's just a minor detail at the end of the day. What matters is that this place is just the start of something greater.
We have all the time in the world, Commander. Come on – join me in the waters so we can purify every inch of this hot spring.
Hearing a strange rustling sound coming from the bathroom, I feel inquisitive and walk up to the door.
Then, I open it and find...
C-Commander?!
The, um... bath isn't ready just yet...
Could you wait just a little longer, please?
I only have a towel on...
Helena? What are you doing here?
Um... St. Louis said I should– No, that's besides the point.
The shower in my place broke, and, well... I had no choice but to come to yours and borrow it.
Perhaps it's due to the hot vapor in the bathroom – whatever the case, her cheeks are slightly flushed.
I see...
That aside, what was that sound I heard just earlier? You okay in there?
I-I'm fine!
Alright, then. Take care not to slip.
W-wait!
You see, um... I ran a Sakuran hinoki bath since I thought you might like that, and...
It's my first time doing anything like this... and I might have messed a few things up.
Like forgetting where I put the hinoki ball... or adding too many citruses to the bath.
Or how just a moment ago, I... I dropped the soap.
You don't... happen to see where it fell, do you?
Seeing her so flustered, I hold my tongue for a moment and point to her feet.
Her eyes widen in surprise as she realizes the thing she's been looking so hard for is right under her nose.
Oh, gosh... It was right at my feet this whole time. How did I not notice?
Dejected, she crouches down to pick up the soap on the ground.
However, the moment she stands up again, she staggers and bumps into the glass door before she's able to stabilize herself.
You alright? You sure you don't want me to come in and help?
I'm... I'm okay! I just lost my focus for a second and didn't watch my step!
Just give me another minute or two, okay? The bath is almost ready!
Yes, just a minute...
I'll be done before you know it!
Masséna's strategy of using puppy eyes had won me over, and she dragged me along to a place called the Sweetly Intoxicating Spring.
Look, Commander – this water is clear like jelly.
It looks... delicious.
Drinking bath water doesn't sound like the best idea.
Just a little should be fine, heehee. You shouldn't do it, though.
Crystal-clear hot water pours forth from the tap, slowly filling up the tub.
Unable to bear the wait any longer, she plops down into the bath and turns over.
*lick*...
Mmm! I knew it'd taste sweet.
That said, it could use a bit more sugar...
Want me to fetch you some fruit?
Sure! Preferably some sweet cherries.
I appreciate it!
I return with a plate of cherries and find her resting on the edge of the bath, staring intently at me.
The moment our gazes meet, she looks at me with eyes teeming with anticipation and waves at me.
Welcome back, Commander. Welcome back, cherries. Or should I say, welcome back to my mouth!
Aahh...
She opens her mouth for me and blinks at me, seemingly asking me to feed her.
Not one to let her down, I take a cherry and put it in her mouth.
Delicious! But also sour. It needs to be sweeter.
Good thing I brought some fruit juice as well.
Juice! You really know just what I need.
Delighted, she picks up the cup of juice but stops just before putting it to her lips. She freezes in place and starts thinking about something.
Something the matter?
I just got an idea, Commander. An idea for how to make this even sweeter for both of us.
It's something I can only do when you're here. Heheh... This.
She catches me off guard, hugging and pulling me into the water with her.
There we go! You are pretty sweet just like that...
But now you are even sweeter!
I guess this is the part where we... drink from the chalice? Or cup, in this case. Heehee.
Saying that, she hands the cup to me and smoothly hooks her arm around mine.
Both holding on to the cup with one hand, we exchange sips from it. A trickle of cold juice runs down her lip.
*gulp*... *gulp*...
Ahh... So delicious. The sweetness is making me all dizzy...
Heehee... Can you feel it, Commander? The sweet mood spreading around us like a cloud?
How about next... we do something even sweeter?
White steam rises from the hot spring lined with black stone. A few pale cherry blossom tree petals rest on the water's surface.
Noshiro moves back out of the water and reclines against a nearby rock surface, then turns and waves her hand at me.
I'm over here, Commander.
The wet towel clings tightly to her skin, accentuating the delicate lines of her waist.
The water here is just the right temperature. Have a dip. I already checked that it's good.
Also, can you believe how good this view is? You can see the stars in the night sky so clearly.
Whew... This is what a hot spring should be – soothing for the body and spirit.
There's a vaguely drowsy look in her eyes, contrasted by her smile, which seems even sweeter than ordinarily.
She moves her well-proportioned legs through the water, drawing little ripples on its tranquil surface.
Eventually, her eyes open like she's remembered something. She reaches for a bottle of milk beside her and offers it to me with a smile.
People like to drink milk after a soak, but there's a certain elegance in drinking it while still in the bath.
Just... be careful not to spill it, okay?
Drink it slowly. Savor it one sip at a time.
When I move forward to take the milk from her, the towel wrapped around my waist loosens and slips into the water.
Uh...
I reach down to pick it up, but my hand is stopped by her slender, fair leg.
I mean, isn't one supposed to meet the hot spring's water naked?
And to be blunt, I'd like to see your "birthday suit," too...
If that feels one-sided to you... I'm willing to be as bare as you.
In a blink, Noshiro is suddenly right next to me.
From her soft voice exudes a youthful, sweet scent, caressing my cheek with the rising vapor.
What I'm trying to say is... follow your heart, Commander.
Will you take your towel back, or will I–
Her body sways to the side before she can finish speaking.
I'm starting to feel a little light-headed... I may have soaked for too long.
Thank god you were right here. If you hadn't been, I might have fallen and caused a real splash.
Without the distance and steam obscuring my view, I now realize that the blush on her face has spread to cover even the space behind her ears.
At the perfect opportunity, her towel, too, slides down into the still water.
Before I can do anything, she softly hooks her arm behind my neck.
Mmh... It's strange how I feel so floaty...
I guess sharing a bath is one of the few cases where it's not so embarrassing to lay out the naked truth, so to speak...
So, whatever we're going to do next...
It's all up to you, my beloved Commander. Heehee.
The circuit is abuzz with excitement. Engines roar while the sound of whooshing wind rings clear.
As I'm on my way to my race car, I'm suddenly stopped by New Jersey's warm laughter.
You're finally here, honey!
She sits on the edge of the open trunk of a car, dangling her slender legs off of it.
New Jersey? Why are you in the pit stop?
Heh! What do you think? To cheer you on, honey!
We've got time before your race starts, so come over here!
This spot is just heavenly. Really lets you take in the excitement in the circuit.
You always manage to find the comfiest places.
It's a skill of mine! The mood in this place is even hotter than the weather!
What about you, honey? You feeling tense?
With you cheering me on, I've got no reason to feel tense and every reason to win.
She gently hops off the trunk. The sunlight glimmers off her hair.
Okay, then I wanna see you not just win, but win with style!
Can't deny it. It's kind of getting to me.
She gently hops off the trunk. The sunlight glimmers off her hair.
You can't go getting nervous now, or it'll affect you on the track!
So, your personal cheerleader is gonna give you a little something to help!
Before I can say anything, she stands on tiptoes and grabs my cheeks with both hands.
Close your eyes, honey. The Black Dragon's got a blessing for you!
I shut my eyes, and then, a pair of soft, warm lips grace mine – and with them comes the sweet taste of ice cream.
Heehee! Here's my sweet and blissful blessing of super speed!
After a few seconds pass, she steps away and gives me a proud look.
How's that? Feeling topped off now? This includes my– Whuah?!
As she steps back, her heel gets caught in a hole in the ground.
I try to catch her by wrapping my arms around her waist, only for us both to fall into the trunk.
Wow, honey...
Talk about launching a sneak attack!
As if you didn't launch one first.
That was no attack! That was basically a good-luck blessing!
Ooh, I think I like this mood... Gets my heart racing♪
What mood?
In response to this, she closes her eyes and brings her head up to me. Her lips hover under mine, and she whispers softly to me.
This. This mood...
Now, come on – give me a kiss as a promise of victory, honey.
As we feel our breath on each other's faces, an announcement plays. She gently grabs my shoulder, a red dash of shyness still on her cheeks.
Good luck out there, my champion! Show 'em who's boss, honey!
I stop my car and open the door to thunderous applause and cheering.
On my way to the winners' podium, the first thing I see is a fine girl glowing in the sunlight.
Congratulations, Commander. You never disappoint.
Did you hear me cheering for you over the engines?
Yeah. It was wonderful, as were the modifications you did to my car. The corners and straight lines were both smooth.
Oh. I'm really glad to hear you say that.
Ah, right, we need to do your award ceremony...
She takes the trophy, hands it to me, and then produces a bottle of champagne.
You've got to open a bottle after such an intense race. Ready, Commander?
Raise your trophy, and I'll pop the champagne!
Alright, just be careful.
R-right. I've got it. Raise your trophy!
She brims with confidence as she shakes the bottle, until suddenly, there is a pop.
The cork flies out like a bullet, and the champagne gushes out like water from a fountain.
Eek! Um... Meow?
Seemingly unconsciously, she licks up the sweet-smelling liquid that hit her lips. She then looks at me with a gaze that gradually turns blurrier.
Smells nice... Odd – you smell pretty nice too, meow...
W-wait, no! Step back, Commander! You don't want to get it on yourself, too!
Uh-oh... Resistance check failed... You smell really, really good, Commander...
You okay there, Nakhimov?
After closely observing her, it dawns on me that it was pointless to ask.
Now she spontaneously rubs her cheek against my neck, and even coils her tail-like cable around my leg.
Ugh... Even I'm not sure why this is happening. I just...
Have to get close to you... Meow...
She looks up at me, her voice growing fainter. The cable wrapping around our bodies gets tighter and tighter.
...Where'd you get this alcohol from?
Oh, um... From next to the podium...
Do you like how it smells?
Mmh... Heehee... I suddenly don't feel tired at all anymore, meow...
You must've really worked hard today.
Yeah... I had to do both maintenance and cheerleading work, so I guess so...
The special ingredients in the alcohol do affect my working efficiency, but...
Sometimes, maybe that's okay, you know?
I'm glad I get to spend this much time with you, meow...
Amid the warm glow, she softly wraps a cable around my finger.
I'll... come up with a more perfect plan for your next race...
Also... I'll get a more proper victory drink next time...
