But right now, I just want to share in the joy of your victory with you... Meow...
Pushing open the fence in front of the maintenance area, I step onto the sunbaked ground. The smells of engine oil and rubber fill the air.
Essex sits down on the hood of my race car, and uses the water hose in her hand to expertly and carefully clean every nook and cranny of the car.
It's almost time, Essex. How's your progress?
Don't worry about that, Commander. I'm just about finished.
Your car has been roasting in the sun. We need to cool it down somehow.
Driving it while it's still this hot would negatively affect its performance.
There is a tinge of red on her cheeks, and beads of sweat drip down her hair and land on the hood.
Good point, actually.
I'd say you need to cool off more than my car right now, though.
Saying that, I pull out a cold towel from the cooler and offer it to her.
Gotta bring your temp down, too.
She takes the towel and presses it against her cheek. Her expression lightens up.
Rest assured, I can handle a little heat. I want your car to run at its peak performance!
Besides, if it's cooling off we're talking about...
Her lips curve into a mischievous smile. She grips the hose again, and starts adjusting the water pressure.
Then I know a better way!
Oh boy...
She points the nozzle at me, and flashes a beaming smile.
Let's both cool off a little!
Contrary to her expectations, however, no water shoots out. She cocks her head in confusion, looks at the nozzle, and hits it.
Huh? It was working just a second ago...
Your leg. You're sitting on the hose.
As I say that, I reach out and pull out the part of the hose she's sitting on before she can fully move away.
Oh! Wai–
SPLASH!
The backed-up water comes gushing out, making her sopping wet from head to toe.
Commander, I wasn't ready! Why didn't you wait for...
Actually, I guess this is a blessing in disguise. It did cool me down, after all.
She looks at her soaked clothes, then shoots me a glance, and suddenly seems to remember something.
Right! Let's get you cooled off as well!
She grabs on to my racing suit as I'm trying to back off. Faintly cold drops of water fly off of her.
Um... Essex?
Heehee! Doesn't it feel much better now?
She raises a drippy hand, presses her index finger to my chest, and starts to draw something.
A cool sensation penetrates my clothes, sending a slight shiver through my body.
There we go.
Okay, take this and aim for gold, Commander!
She finally lifts her head, and puts her hand away. There is an embarrassed yet elated smile on her face.
The symbol she just drew on me was a heart.
Good luck out there, Commander! I'll be waiting for you at the finish line!
If you win, I'll tell you about what this heart really means!
Upon entering Rumey's temporary office, my jaw hits the floor.
It is decked out with classical furnishings and decorative swords and rifles... And there are stacks of prop bills scattered on the floor.
(She said she's been watching mafia movies... Seems she has seen one too many.)
Have a seat, Commander.
As told, I sit down in the chair next to her.
She picks up a folder from the small table nearby and hands it to me.
I summoned you for one purpose – to interview you.
Uh, interview me?
This time around, I am the manager of our shop – the "boss bunny," in other words.
It is therefore my duty to know the thoughts of our sole and most valued customer.
So what's in the folder? A list of questions?
No, these are the shop's new rules that I came up with. The purpose of this interview is to hear your opinions.
The rules should suffice, I think. If you feel anything is missing, I'll add it right away.
Every little detail has to be perfectly tailor-made for you.
Alright then...
I open the folder and skim its contents.
"Punch the clock when you start and finish work. 'I got lost' or 'I was tired' are not valid excuses for arriving late or leaving early"...
Performance reviews are fundamental to running a shop. If employees cannot arrive on time, they won't be able to provide you with proper service.
"All activities outside of your job duties are prohibited during your shift"...
Um, what does this "Whether intentional or not" note here mean?
It's possible to slack off even if you don't mean to. For instance, feeding the cats may result in non-work-related activities.
Obviously, slacking off on purpose is prohibited. Unintentional distractions, however, can be prevented by asking others for help when needed.
As if to punctuate her statement, she smacks the floor with the decorative sword in her hand.
As rules go, strictly speaking, it all seems fine...
But... I think a more relaxed, easy-to-work-in environment would be better for the shop.
Rejected. The staff cannot provide you with the best possible service under casual circumstances.
Personally, I think you ought to take it easy.
Come again?
I know you care about my feelings, but you should value your own, too.
She is left uncharacteristically at a loss for words.
Don't let rules and conventions limit you.
Just relax, enjoy, and do it your own way.
As her expression softens a tad, a faint tremble runs through her eyes.
Are you saying the rules don't matter that much and I should try to just enjoy this?
Yeah. Forget about the rules for now. Just keep things as they are and relish the moment.
She mulls it over for a moment, then breathes a deep sigh.
Fine. I'll consider your feedback in earnest.
In the meantime, however...
What am I supposed to do? I'm no expert at "relishing the moment."

options.content: Let loose and do what you want!

scripts.say: Let's see a smile first? You don't have to look so stern.
Very well... I'll try.
Her lips curve into a somewhat forced smile. It seems a bit awkward but in a cute way.
No need to think too much, just let yourself loose and do what you want!
I can do whatever I want?
I was joking. Sorry if that wasn't clear.
Ultimately, my feedback is just my opinion. It's up to you in the end.
Up to me, you say?
She lowers her gaze slightly, and a touch of red colors her usually dignified face.
She assumes a less on-edge posture and relaxes her hands. She softly touches my hand with her pinky finger.
A moment of trembling hesitation passes for her, then she locks her fingers with mine.
Then can I... forget about all the rules and just be with you for now?
I head to the elevator corridor after getting a call from Z52. Just as I arrive, I see her leaping out.
In one hand, she holds her smartphone – with the other, she pulls up a slipping leg of her tights.
Okay, I just exited the eleva—
Oh! You came to meet me!
She hangs up the line and waves at me with a lively smile on her face.
Without her hand holding it up, her tights start to slide again.
Oh, shoot!
Uh, gimme a minute! I'm just gonna put on some anti-slipping tape...
Wait, where'd I put it? I arrived late specifically 'cause I bought it, so where is it?
Need a hand there?
No, no, I'm fine! I'm already keeping you waiting, and that's bad enough!
These tights are a lot looser than I expected... I should've tried them on before I went out!
They've been trying to slide off my leg ever since I put them on, and the wind was howling when I ran here...
She starts recounting everything that happened up to now and stops looking for her tape.

options.content: (Tell her to save the story for later.)

scripts.say: Easy there, speedster. You can tell me all about it after you find that tape to hold up your tights.
Oh, right! I just found it!
Let me just put this on here...
I'll hold your bag for you.
Want me to hold your bag? Since you have your hands full.
We can talk after you've found the tape and secured your tights.
Just found it! But since you're offering to hold the bag...
Thanks!
After handing her bag to me, she applies the tape and adjusts her clothes.
They were hanging loosely around her before, and now they fit perfectly.
There!
With a skip and a hop, she makes sure that the tights won't affect her mobility, then she gives me a smile.
Everything's in order now! Let's head inside the shop!
I've gotta make up for being so late!
Right. Oh, by the way, I ordered a cake and some drinks.
Sweet! Come on, let's dash!
She grabs my hand and breaks into a sprint.
The shop's over here, right?
No, it's over THAT way.
What?! You're kidding!
*knock knock*
I knock on the door of the room where Duisburg is waiting.
Commander? You're here awfully early... Ah, did you want to see me that badly? Heehee.
W-wait... What's THIS?!
What's what?
Hearing her panic, I open the door without a second thought and step inside.
Commander?! Why'd you barge in just like that?
Somewhat awkwardly kneeling on the couch, she hurriedly lowers her gaze as soon as she sees me.
You okay? What happened?
Nothing at all. I just... dropped a cup of water.
There is no cup nor water stain anywhere on the floor as far as I can see.
(Alright then... I just pretend that's all it was.)
It's no big deal. Anyway, let's cut to the chase, shall we?
Since you're here early, why don't we start our secret training right away?
First, I have a question – what's this training actually about?
Well... It involves providing service to you, as my master.
Remember, it would be my first time at this pop-up shop, and I'm not sure I'm cut out for it.
If I get used to being around you ahead of time, maybe I'll handle it better in the shop.
Ahh. I get it now.
She takes a deep breath, but it doesn't look like it helps calm her down.
W-welcome back, Master... How can I serve you today?
Her typical confidence is all gone – her crossed arms are a sign of nervousness, as are her restless hands.
A soft blush spreads across her cheeks, even coloring her ears pink.
Th-this isn't working... I can't do it in these clothes!
(The clothes are the problem? Now that she mentions it, what Duisburg is wearing indeed doesn't look like the pop-up shop's attire...)
(Wait a second...)
You're wearing the wrong clothes, aren't you? I don't think that's pop-up shop standard issue.
I should've known there would be no hiding it...
Yes, you're right! These clothes are for a different occasion!
They were in a box that looked so similar to the shop one, and I picked the wrong one.
Even if it's just the two of us... it's still embarrassing to wear something like this... I mean, look at me!
She averts her gaze to avoid meeting mine.
And there's no mirror in this room either, so I can't even tell if I put it on right.
I don't want you to see me in something that looks so off...

options.content: But you look great in it.

scripts.say: Not only great, but very cute as well.
There's no reason for you to feel nervous about it.
Super cute, in fact.
Do you mean it?
I mean it.
If it really bothers you, let's call off the training and get you into your regular clothes first.
No, it's fine. I'm relieved after what you just said.
I don't feel so anxious now.
Oh, right, the training...
She pauses to think momentarily, then shakes her head to herself.
As her nervousness fades, she finally relaxes her tightly crossed arms.
Assuming you're not opposed to this, Master...
She inches closer to me, her figure bathed in the warm, inviting light, making her look exceptionally enchanting.
Please allow me to serve you in this attire. ♥
Mmgh... Finally got the scissors! Ugh... Can't reach... Huh?
C-Commander?! Why are you here already?! You're not supposed to be here this soon!
I'm met with a shocking sight immediately upon entering Formidable's so-called secret base.
Her one leg is held high by a ribbon, and she's struggling to stay upright on the bed.
She squirms about, holding a pair of scissors in her hand.
L-look away! And please close the door!
As a compromise, I close the door behind me but remain in the room.
What are you doing?! Come any closer only at your own risk, do you hear?
Ahahaha... I'm here to help you. Can I borrow your scissors? Wriggling like this might hurt you.
Pardon? Do you just want to help?
Very well... Here. Now please cut me loose.
(I wouldn't want to be seen like this either if I were her. I'll just get out and leave her alone.)
I turn around and step outside. Then, just as I'm about to close the door...
E-excuse me? Commander, where are you going?
I'd like it if you came to my assistance here! If you walk out now, don't expect me to listen to you again!
As a compromise, I close the door behind me but remain in the room.
How could you think of abandoning me like that? Be a kind soul and help cut me loose!
I take the scissors from her then gently hold her suspended leg.
Her skin feels hot to the touch. She must be feeling rather embarrassed.
Alright, try to relax. If you move suddenly, you might get hurt while I cut the ribbon.
"Try to relax"... That's easy for you to say!
Despite her objection, she does relax her leg.
C-Commander... Come a little closer...
Do me a favour and support my leg, please. I'll get a cramp holding it like this otherwise.
Sure thing.
I draw one step closer and kneel, letting her rest her leg on my shoulder.
I can clearly hear her flustered breaths now that I'm this close.
I'm going to cut it now. Hold still.
Carefully snipping the ribbon that bound her, I support her ankle and gently lower her leg.
Thank you kindly...
What?
I'm embarrassed as it is – I'd prefer not to repeat myself!
Fair, fair... How did you end up like this, anyway?
*sigh*... Well, you did help me, so I shall tell you what happened.
You see, I'd just got done decorating the room a bit, then I was in the mood for a solo performance. I got caught on a ribbon, and, well...
This is too embarrassing to continue! You can't tell anyone about this! Erase what you just saw and heard from your memory!

options.content: How could I possibly forget this adorable side of you?

scripts.say: I'll take this with me to the grave.
Truly? Do you promise?
Not to tell anyone? Yes. Erasing this from my memory, though, that's a tall order...
Come again? Surely you can at least TRY to forget it!
You have far better things to dedicate to memory, no?
I tease her for the heck of it. Her face turns red, if only for a moment.
I-it's terribly embarrassing, you know! I implore you not to say anything like that again!
But... I suppose I could allow you to remember how adorable I looked. Nothing beyond that, however!
Instead, you should commit THIS to memory!
She gracefully picks up the nearby guitar and holds it in a cool pose.
Never mind that little mishap... It's time for a one-on-one concert!
Eyes on me, Commander! ♪
...Bismarck?
The room should be empty, save for a load of presents from the girls. Should be.
Commander...?
Yet, there is Bismarck, flustered and dressed in a festive Christmas outfit.
I, uh, came here to open my presents. Are you still getting yours ready? Should I wait outside?
No, no need...
This is my fault for forgetting to tell you ahead of time. Apologies.
Oookay...
(That's not like her. She would never "forget to tell me" anything.)
(Maybe she tried to sneak in to leave her gift. If so, I might have ruined the surprise...)
You're thinking that my surprise has been spoiled, aren't you?
You read my mind.
Ahaha. It's in fact what I was thinking, too.
Sorry. I imagine you worked hard on my present.
Tell you what, how about you give it to me directly?
Give you... "it"?
The word "it" makes her pause. Her cheeks turn red, and she hesitates to continue, casting an uncharacteristically shy and uncertain glance at me.
Well, I AM your present, you see...
Following her downcast gaze, I realize she's sitting on a sheet of wrapping paper.
You mean... you're giving yourself to me?
Ahem... Per Eugen's suggestion.
She said, "If you're bad at expressing your feelings with words, do it with actions instead." I simply did what she suggested.
She shyly hangs her head, looking a little fidgety.
Pushing the glass of wine on the floor further away from her, she again meets my gaze.
It's my first time doing something like this... I thought a drink might help me feel more at ease.
I suppose it didn't work...
No, it did.
Hm?
The surprise might have been spoiled by my sudden appearance, but it turned out great in the end.
Besides, it's the thought that counts, right? Thank you.
Being able to spend this holiday together with you is already a fantastic gift.
Her eyes light up, and a joyous, gentle smile appears on her lips.
She leans in closer to me in her festive outfit.
The fireworks bursting outside can't hold a candle to the sparkle in her eyes.
Her warm breath graces my ear...
Merry Christmas, Commander.
Oh, Commander, put on a record that sets the mood.
No sooner than I set foot inside the room does Ägir issue an order to me from her single sofa.
You got it.
I pick a record and spin it on the phonograph, then head to the coffeemaker.
(I've got work after this, so a cuppa joe would do me good.)
After the coffee finishes brewing, Ägir exclaims another order before I can even ask.
Extra sugar. I can't drink it otherwise.
Yes, ma'am.
I add a hefty spoonful to the coffee and place the cup on the table beside her.
Commander.
She speaks yet again, stretching her legs out toward me.
She haphazardly flings her shoes off and teasingly pokes my knee with her toes.
What is it?
Nothing. It just struck me how you know your place today.
Have you finally bowed to my power as the god of the sea?
Uhh...
Disappointed by my response, she lifts her foot higher and runs her toes along my thigh, moving further up.
I seize her foot by the ankle to stop her from going any further.
Huh?!
Hey! Let go!
She starts kicking around and tries to pull her leg back.
That's enough already! Stop it! ...Eek!
In a bout of sudden guilt, I let go of her foot.
Taken by surprise, a look of shock and embarrassment appears on her face.
She tries to play it cool, taking a sip of her coffee before she speaks again.
Isn't it tiring, standing like that? Take a seat!
There's room right over here! Look!
She pats the small clear space next to her.

options.content: I don't think there's room for two.

scripts.say: It's a single sofa. It'll be pretty cramped if I sit on it at the same time.
So, you know...
I don't have an issue with that, so why should you?
Stop dragging your feet already and come here!
I take her up on her offer and sit down beside her. She quickly blushes and averts her gaze.
Even though she made more room, we are literally rubbing shoulders with how cramped it is.
Bah, forget it! You've been toiling away for my sake, so you can have the sofa!
She rises to her feet with such haste that she loses her balance.
Careful!
She falls right onto me, her soft and warm body landing in my arms.
The god of the sea's hair brushes against my nose. It gives off a faint fragrance.
Whuh?!
After fidgeting for a moment, she finally gives up and relaxes her body, leaning gently against me.
Just this once... you hear?
As I walk through a maze-like series of corridors, a sudden burst of light appears. Looks like I've set foot in a certainly unusual place.
A faint aroma wafts through the air, and suddenly, someone calls out to me.
Hehehe... Looks like a rat has gotten itself lost in the holy domain!
I am the guardian of this domain, and as an uninvited guest, you must face punishment!
I look to where the voice is coming from and spot Raffaello, donning a fabulous outfit and staring at me like some sort of art critic.
Uninvited guest? Who? Me?
She acknowledges my evident confusion and promptly explains things.
Yes, you! Did you forget you're in an immersive experience? Stop fooling around and get into character!
(Right... Someone said something like that when I entered this Nile Cultural Exhibition.)
(Didn't expect that I'd be asked to roleplay, though...)
Hm? Hello?
Abhorrent intruder, how dare you space out before the guardian!
For this, your punishment shall be... being turned into stone!
(We're really doing this? Okay, I'll just play along for now.)

options.content: (Point out the flaw in the exhibition's tour route.)

scripts.say: O Great Protector, I am but a tourist who haplessly wandered into your domain!
Please have mercy! This was an accident!
Heheh. Your change in attitude might warrant a little mercy.
But I have to teach you a lesson, so I'll only let you go on one condition!
You know, I was just following the path and wound up here.
I think the fault isn't with me, but with how the tour route is laid out.
Uhh... Umm...
Fine, I'll let you off the hook, but only on one condition!
What condition?
It's simple! You just need to drink all of this Eternal Beverage!
As she says this, she produces an exquisite pot.
The pot has a dull gold pattern engraved on it, and the liquid inside gives off a faint light.
Go on! Drink up!
She pulls a cup out of nowhere and pours the liquid into it.
I drink the contents of one cup, and another, and another... No matter how much I drink, the pot gets no emptier.
Hey... What's going on here?
Heehee... Finally figured it out, huh?
She stretches her body with an elegant motion and flashes a mischievous smile. My confusion is but a joke to her.
This pot has received a god's blessing. The blessing in question? A bottomless source!
What will you do now, intruder? Give up while you're still ahead?
...I see now. Unluckily for you, I don't give up easily.
In opposition to this malicious god, I stubbornly drink several more cups of the liquid.
My struggle, however, is futile. The pot is still just as full as when I started.
Heheh... You've gotta be the best material I've ever seen. I'm not letting you leave just like that!
Don't worry, though – I won't turn you into stone or anything.
For you see, I am the Protector of Love and Beauty. Hurting a perfect work of art like you goes against everything I stand for!
So I'll be keeping you here. Forever.
She lowers her voice and draws closer, a smugly triumphant smile on her lips.
Because you're worth capturing in detail. Every little part of you. For eternity♪
A tempting, fruity sweetness fills the air, the aroma coming from further down the corridor.
Following the scent, I end up in front of a door. Opening it, I am met with an unforeseen sight.
Maggiore Baracca is lazily lying on a bed, gently kicking her feet back and forth while toying with the juicy peach in her hand. She seems bored.
Oh... It's you, Commander.
Did you grow tired of the exhibits, so you came to see me?
She twists her body, wearing an ambiguous smile.
There is a completely different aura about her with her exotic, Nile-style attire. I can't take my eyes off her.
The words are stuck in my throat. Seeing this, a devilish glint reflects in her eyes.
What's the matter? Cat got your tongue?

options.content: I was drawn here by the aroma...
I'm a bit lost at the moment...

scripts.say: I was on the tour path when I smelled something in the air.
I followed the scent, and here I am.
Heheh. I see.
She brings the peach up to her lips and gives it a little kiss, leaving a faint mark.
That scent you smelled was probably a mix of fruit and spices.
This place is massive, and I lost track of where I was.
That being said, I'm guessing this place is a part of the exhibit as well – right?
Correct.
And you got here sooner than you should have... I suppose the invisible thread that connects us guided you here♪
She punctuates her statement by giving the peach a little kiss.
Well, since you're already here...
Why don't you come and taste these exquisite offerings?
She shakes the peach in her hand. It glimmers with a succulent sheen in the sunlight.
Offerings? You mean the fruit?
Of course. This time, they gave me the role of a god leisurely enjoying the offerings to her.
Ah, speaking of my role... Don't you know you've entered forbidden territory? I have to give you a punishmeeent♪
She extends the last vowel and kicks her feet back and forth again, like she's plotting something nefarious.
Although, randomly dishing out punishment is so 2,000 years ago...
How about a guessing game instead? We'll each take turns answering the other's question.
Drawing a line across the peach's surface with her delicate finger, she shoots me a flirtatious look.
Whoever guesses wrong...
After a brief pause, her eyes fill with anticipation.
Will have to accept the other's punishment without question♥
The scent in the air grows even richer, adding a hint of seduction to the atmosphere.
Sounds fun... Alright. I'm game.
Ah, a refreshingly swift answer. You know just what I like♪
I don't see any benefit to playing this game. No thanks.
Oh dear, it seems you're under the impression that you have the right to say no.
If you won't play along, then I won't let you leave.
Oh... So that's the condition to let me go. Then fine, seeing as I have no choice.
Heehee. I thought so.
She stretches her limbs and flaunts a confident look.
Okay. My first question is...
What do I, a god, wish to do with you? Heehee♥
Lead by the faint sound of running water, I walk through a corridor and find myself in a beautifully decorated "palace" amidst an oasis.
Sunlight shines through swaying silk curtains and illuminates the rim of the bed.
Chi An has just woken from a slumber and sits on the bed. She combs through her lustrous hair with her fingers.
Then, she becomes aware of my presence, and a glint of happiness flashes across her eyes.
Ahh... I can't believe it... I just woke up, and I've already met the fated person I saw in my dreams.
Did fate guide you right to me, perchance?
(I guess that's the pretense for this scene.)
Well, I–
Shhh. There's no need for explanations.
Her resonant, alluring voice has a charm to it that's hard to resist.
O traveler who has come to my place, I'm sure you must have many questions.
Why did I call you my "fated person," for instance? And where even are we?
To me, however, all of that is unimportant♪
I have no doubt that you've seen many spectacular things on your journey here.
A wink at me speaks to her usual playfulness.
Each one of her gestures seems to signal one thing to me:
"Although I'm wearing very different clothes to what you're used to, and although I'm fully committed to my role..."
"I am still the Chi An you know and love."
Yeah, you could say that.
From this place, to the ones before, I've seen quite a few things.
She runs her fingers across the curtain beside the bed. The thin cloth dances in the wind.
You must be fatigued after such a long journey.
What you need now is a quiet place... and the warm embrace of someone who'll listen to all your troubles.
The light coming through the curtains forms a circle, lending a gentle radiance to her.
Lifting her arms again, she runs her fingers through her hair. She looks as comfortable as can be.
Even the movement of her chest as she breathes brings me a sense of relief that I cannot describe in words.
Traveler, why don't you stay here for a while?
Her tone carries a hint of salaciousness and pleading. It makes her invitation all the more tempting.
Instinctively, I take a step forward, but then stop myself.
Heehee. Still hesitant, I see.
She tilts her head slightly, and the sunlight softly reflects off her long hair.
Did you know that the stars are breathtakingly beautiful here when the night falls?
And in the day, this place is enveloped in light. It, too, is beautiful...
Then, there's the one who will be present day and night by your side – me.
The God of Destiny has shown me much favor by allowing me to meet you, traveler.
So why, then, do you defy destiny like this? Why not make this brief encounter...
Into an eternal partnership?
Her voice is gentle like a sea breeze, concealing an irresistible charm.
Stay with me at this palace...
And let us weave our own future together♪
Her slender finger graces my jaw, and her warm breath brushes against my cheek.
My answer to her... is stifled by the softness of her lips.
A lone person stands before a massive door within the exhibit.
Scythe in hand, hair fluttering in the wind, Scylla exudes an aura of mystical elegance in an exotic outfit.
As soon as she sees me, she slightly raises her head. There is a certain playfulness in her eyes.
Welcome, my Maste–
She suddenly interrupts herself and her lips form a mysterious smile.
Pardon me. You're just a traveler at the moment.
What is this? The... "door of judgment"?
Heehee. That it is. How keen of you to notice.
Gently, she caresses her scythe before she continues.
Those who wish to pass through here must accept judgement...
Since it's you, however, I could let you pass without any punishment.
You know what? I'll take your judgment.
I see. So you seek out my judgement.
If so you wish, then who am I to deny you? I'll even judge you as many times as it takes to satisfy you. Heehee.
If I go through the door, what will I find on the other side?
You wish to know?
Perhaps what lies beyond is Heaven. Or perhaps it's Hell.
If you wish to know in advance, I suggest you allow me to judge you. Heehee.
She shoots me a meaningful glance and spins the scythe in her hand.
Alright, then. Let's hear your judgment.
Well... I should note that the result of my judgement isn't especially important.
What matters is the soul you're willing to reveal to me...
As she finishes, she shuts her eyes and seems to try to read into my soul, twirling her scythe a few times in the meantime.
There. I have already reached a conclusion.
I'm terribly sorry to say, but based on what I see of your soul, your destination lies in Hell.
Her eyes open again, and she gives me a smile of mischief.
Huh?
Heehee. As I thought, you had a rather amusing reaction.
Don't worry. I was simply joking.
Her expression softens again.
While it's true that I am portraying the God of Judgement...
It is also true that no maid has the right to determine her master's destiny.
So, to answer your question of where the door leads...
Please decide that for yourself.
I get to decide?
Yes. After all, you are my master, Master.
With a graceful bow, she draws a golden arc in the air with her scythe.
As much as I enjoyed portraying a god...
I'm scarcely suited for the task of judging people.
All of a sudden, her voice becomes gentle.
My days spent by your side, providing you service as your maid, are much more enjoyable.
Taking a step aside, she gestures toward the door as if to say, "If you would, please."
Now, Master, kindly proceed forward.
I shall forever follow you as your humble, loyal maid.
