<size=45>1 Moonlit Chrome</size>

scripts.say: Mmh... Ah... How is this?
Is this posture... suitable?
While it works perfectly fine, you could change it a little and see if it's even better.
Very well... This one shall do as you ask...
Shinano, donning a pit babe outfit, is leaning atop a race car. She's trying hard to find just the right pose.
Meanwhile, I'm standing just off to the side, camera in hand.
How did I end up in this position? Well...
Aoba wanted pictures for her newspaper and asked Shinano to pose for some photos. She agreed, but Aoba had to tend to some urgent matter, and so I was the only one left who could do the photography.
Perhaps... this pose? What are your thoughts...?
It looks like she's settled on one.
It does differ somewhat from the reference pictures...
That is true...
Whew... Very well, if you're certain...
Admittedly... this is a tad embarrassing...
Nonetheless... I will do anything in my power to show support for the racers...
Alright. Let's take a few photos and see how they look.
Of course... Take as many as needed...
Shinano is bashful but determined. I offer her a few words of encouragement and psych myself up before starting the shoot.
Thanks to that, I manage to capture some good photos.

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Racing Special

<size=45>2 Finish Line Flagbearer</size>

scripts.say: ...And those are all our contestants!
It'll be exciting to see how this race is going to unfold!
Now... Start!
Baltimore delivers the starting cry and waves her big flag with force. The stands burst into life, with the spectators all waving flags of various colors.
Great job out there. I brought some water. And a towel.
Whew... Thanks a bunch, Commander. My throat was feeling pretty dry.
Well, you did deliver a pretty long opening speech.
Hahahah! It wasn't that big a deal. How'd you like it, by the way?
It was wonderful. You did a solid job, hyping up the audience.
Thanks. Just between you and me, I actually rehearsed it for a long time.
Good thing I did, too, 'cause it paid off.
Baltimore leans back a bit as she sits down on a tire to rest.
With style, she then wipes her brow dry with the towel, turns to me, and gives me a smile.
I offered to help, so I wanted to really give it my all and finish with no regrets.
...It feels like you've been afraid to look me in the eyes for a bit now...
Is something weird stuck on my face, or...?
Oh. Uh...
Err... I mean... No, not really?
So it's not my face. Is it my outfit, then?
I actually had it modified a bit to make it easier to move in.
They were pretty tight, originally. Not the kind of thing you wanna be waving a flag in.
Granted, yeah, it turned out pretty skimpy as a result.
But hey...
Bathed in sunshine, she does a small spin on her heel. Her flag flutters in the wind, and she flashes a vivid smile.
It was the right call. 'Cause this way, I can root and cheer to my heart's content. Couldn't do that if the fit held me back.

options.content: I'd say it fits you better now than it did before.

scripts.say: Y-you think so? Heheh...
She looks like a bulb lit inside her head, and she comes closer, shooting me a meaningful gaze.
It did its job of exciting the audience, but the question is... does it excite YOU, Commander?
Maybe once this race is over... we could go and find out? If you wanna...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Racing Special

<size=45>3 Final Lap</size>

scripts.say: While the stadium is ablaze with excitement, I come across a girl content to sit quietly in a corner.
...With a champagne bottle behind her back, about to be popped.
Heehee~ Saw right through me, huh?
She is apparently practicing her routine for when Iron Blood wins the race.
Machines are our field of expertise, after all.
We steer them better than anyone. Why wouldn't I have full confidence in my team?
By the way, Commander, care to join me for a drink?
As much as I'd like to accept her offer, I know all too well what Eugen's drinking habits are like...
Oh? Is that hesitation in your eyes, hmm?
Don't be afraid. I've finished my job of cheering my team on.
If I so wanted, I could drink all the way into the morning with you. Heehee♪
You know who needs to carry you back to the dorm when you get blackout-drunk? It tends to be me.
Mhm. Because I trust you to be there when I need you.
What's the alternative? Are you going to leave me all by myself to pass out and spend the night in an empty stadium?
I'm joking, of course~ Heehee♪
In all seriousness, the race hasn't even finished yet.
I think it's a little too soon to celebrate your victory with a drink.
Technically, yes, but practically, what's the difference? We all know who's going to win.
Unless you're saying you're rooting for another team but ours?
That's, let's say... not good.
Just admit you bet on the wrong team and change your mind.
A teasing glimmer reflects off her bared grin. She grabs my clothes and pulls me closer to her.
Oh, I'd nearly forgotten. I was going to ask what you think about my outfit.
No looking away now~
What's your honest opinion?

options.content: It looks utterly breathtaking on you.

scripts.say: Heehee. Good♪ I've been cheering for Iron Blood in it all day now.
And when we win, I'll be at our victory party, still wearing it.
You'll be there too, won't you? Because you're rooting for Iron Blood, hmm?
She slowly moves herself closer, and then speaks to me in a half-whisper...
I'll need someone to look after me if I get a little too drunk at the party.
You'll do it, won't you, Commander?

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Racing Special

<size=45>4 Wind Catcher</size>

scripts.say: There is a lull between races, so I go for a stroll. During it, I come across Enterprise, showing support for the Eagle Union.
Hey, Commander. You here to watch the race?
One just ended, and it was incredible. It really taught me the appeal of watching cars speeding down the race track.
What do you think about hosting another race same time, next year?
Based on the glowing reception to it, I think we probably will.
(Her outfit... it has unzipped to a dangerous degree.)

options.content: Let's go somewhere else for a minute.

scripts.say: Into the shade, you mean?
I appreciate the idea, but I can't. I'm not here as a mere spectator.
See, I'm the Eagle Union's promo model. My job is to cheer them on, as evidenced by this outfit.
If you're worried about me getting a heatstroke, don't be. This umbrella keeps me cool.
Frankly, if I could, I'd get into a vehicle myself and race with the rest.
I think it'd be a different kind of excitement to dashing across the sea.
But, for now, all I can do is complete the task I accepted.
Wanting to race, but being bound by her duty. That's a very Enterprise dilemma.
She turns her attention to the race track and strikes a series of poses in support for her team.
Meanwhile, the zipper seems to move further down, nearly exposing her chest.
(This is bad...)
Commander? Something the matter?
Is it about me wanting to race? Obviously, I wouldn't just jump into a car and hit it. I'd learn all the intricacies of driving on a race track first.
That's not it. It's your outfit. It's, well...
Oh, this?
Yeah, I'll be the first to admit it shows a bit too much skin.
But, it's what my friends asked me to wear. Besides, everyone seems to love it, so there's no problem on that front... Do you think it doesn't suit me?
No, it looks fantastic on you. What I'm trying to say is...
Suddenly, the audience bursts into excited cheering. The next race has just started.
Enterprise has already turned around and gotten into her cheering and rooting mode.
And the zipper, of course, shows no sign of stopping...
The zipper? What about it?
She acknowledges me calling attention to it, yet continues to wave her flag around.
The larger and flashier the moves she makes, the deeper her outfit sinks into dangerous territory.
(I need to do something!)
With a deep breath, I come closer and reach for her chest...
Huh?! C-Commander?!
I take hold of the zipper, which has already gone past the danger zone...
What?! O-out here?! B-but I...
The circumstances being what they are, I had to spring into action despite the looks I'd inevitably get. For a moment, the scene turns chaotic.
Fortunately, my actions made Enterprise see that her zipper was dangerously low, and she clears my name.
Later, when I look back on this race, I fail to remember who won. The rush and tension of that moment made me forget...

sequence:
Port Fashion Collection! Racing Special

<size=45>Ignition Matrician</size>

scripts.say: ...Now then, I hope you all get the placing you're hoping for in the race.
As Ulrich finished her speech, the drivers turned towards the race track with ambition in their hearts.
Ulrich's flag flutters in the wind, dyed in Iron Blood red and black hues, much like the outfit she's wearing. She is stately, almost like a goddess of victory.
Thanks. It's an honor.
...Oh, it's you, Commander. I thought you had your hands full. What weird turn of events brought you here?
Nothing in particular. I just happened to be passing by when I heard you deliver that motivational speech.
What can I say? It inspires the racers and ups the odds of my team winning.
Same with this outfit. It's for their sake.
Even the people who aren't participating directly get a kick out of a good speech and an outfit they like.
Looks like its magic worked on you, too.
I know I hit the bullseye. There's no point in looking away now. If you wanna stare, be my guest.
If I didn't want you looking at me, I wouldn't have worn this in public in the first place.
Everyone else who's dressed up for the occasion thinks the same.
Nobody'll judge you for looking. Give 'em a complement or two and you'll be fine.
There. That's how you do it.
But remember – you can give compliments to everyone, but only one team can win.
Speaking of, who do you think's gonna win?
Every team is gunning for the gold. It's hard to say who's likely to win right now, so I answer her with a shrug.
You dunno? So you think there's even a small chance Iron Blood will lose?
I raise an eyebrow at Ulrich's supreme confidence in her team.
Me, I'm 100% sure about it. We're going to win.
Let me tell you what victory is. It's the natural result of precise calculations after eliminating all factors that worsen your odds.
Still, it's a non-zero-possibility, no matter how unlikely it is. Besides, isn't not knowing the result with perfect accuracy part of the thrill of a race?
Most people say that, sure.
If you personally knew Iron Blood's might, if you've seen its potential, you'd think differently.
Hell, I might as well ask... Do you have two hours to spare?
Two whole hours? Why do you ask?
That's at least how much time I'm gonna need to convince you.
The race is just about to start, though.
True... You'd miss all the action if you sat down to listen to me for two hours instead.
Never mind, that was a bad idea. Forget it.
I've got another, though...
If you've got time AFTER the race, then I can enlighten you. Sound good?
Enlighten me on how Iron Blood's victory is inevitable, you mean?
More than just that. I'll give you a tour of our simulated race track as well.
Like they say – show, don't tell.
There's also our garage, and the equipment we use to keep our vehicles in top shape.
Because you've gotta be wondering just how we became such good racers.
Actually... Two hours won't be nearly enough to cover everything.
All things considered... Think you could spare the whole night?
Still not enough gas, huh...
In that case...
Hmm...
In the pit, Strasbourg is hard at work on car maintenance.
Since she's wearing headphones, she doesn't notice me approaching until I accidentally bump into the toolbox next to her.
Oh, Commander. What brings you here right now... Did you sneak out alone?
I got worried when I noticed you weren't around.
Don't worry about me, though. My work is done, and my absence won't cause any problems.
Okay... Well, I appreciate the thought.
I'm just doing final checks on this car. Surely you understand why I'd worry about that, right?
Her purple irises focus on me. I see a teasing glint in them.
I shake my head, pick up the toolbox on the floor, and squat down next to her.
Let me help. Two sets of hands are better than one.
Really? Just so you know, if you wanna help me...
That means staying right by my side. Focusing only on me and our work.
Yeah. Think about nothing but me, look at nothing but me...
She squeezes my sleeve tight.
Your time is all mine now, Commander...
Now... Let's get to work, shall we?
Strasbourg and I efficiently knock out task after task.
Phew. I'd say that does it for that. Thanks for helping me out.
Don't mention it. Say, why didn't you ask any of the others for help?
...Because it's a job I can do alone.
Her answer sounds a little prickly. Throughout, she continues her work.
While she does that, she notices a screw on the ground.
She deftly swipes it up and screws it back where it belongs, all without a word.
Awkward silence hangs over us.
...Do you think I'm acting tough, or something?
Not at all. It's impressive that you can handle all of this alone.
Honestly, I wanted you to see how capable I am. But I messed it up.
We're so close that our skin gently touches. I can feel her warmth.
So close that the air between us feels like it's heating up.
It doesn't matter, though.
When I'm with you, I don't need to act tough or pretend I'm someone who I'm not.
As long as you keep what's happened between us today a secret...
Heheh, good. Okay, next...
After getting the answer she wants, she gets ready to stand up.
But perhaps as a result of squatting for so long, she loses balance as soon as she tries to straighten her legs.
Hyah!
I reach my arm around and catch her before she can fall.
She's fully in my arms now, at my mercy.
Thank you...
Yet she relaxes and even leans in closer.
Don't move. Keep hugging me, just like you are now.
If you let go... I might fall, you know. Heehee.
My skin starts to burn hot, and the girl in my arms whispers into my ear.
You know, Commander, it's just the two of us... What if we took things a little bit further?
We still have pleeenty of time...
After a full day of intensive work, the car's test runs are finally complete.
While final checks occur, I try to get out of the car. I'm stopped by a tapping on the windshield.
(Hm? Who's that?)
I turn around and see a fighting angel of the Iris on all fours on the hood of the car, palms and chest pressed firmly against the windshield.

options.content: Careful. The hood's gotta be hot right now.

scripts.say: Don't worry about me. The engine is off now... and I'm just fine.
You look surprised. Have I caught you in the middle of violating some kind of rule?
Heehee. The Commander I know would never do such a thing, I'm sure.
Otherwise, I wouldn't get to just sit here and watch you, now, would I?
But... I can't help but notice your eyes darting back and forth.
That's, uhh...
Go on.
Her lips curl up softly, as if excited to hear my poor excuse.

options.content: I just didn't expect you there.

scripts.say: Even moreso than the sun itself.
Aww, Commander... Heehee. Do you mean to say I got in the way of your driving? Is that it?
You came out of nowhere, so it startled me a little.
We call that a "surprise," Commander.
...An obvious lie, but I won't pass judgment for that alone.
She relaxes her arms a little and leans fully on the windshield.
That look on your face tells me you have questions for me.
Yeah, well... Maybe.
The race hasn't started. Why are you here?
Heehee. Why, indeed...
The fighting angel closes her eyes in apparent prayer.
Right now, you're doing everything you can for the sake of your victory.
It's only natural for an angel of the Iris to offer a blessing to you.
Not judgment, but a blessing known as love.
She blows onto the windshield, causing some of it to fog up.
Then, she draws a cute little heart with wings on it with her finger.
My finger brushes against the glass where hers is, but I'm brought back to reality by the hardness of it.
She smiles briefly at me.
Commander, could you open the door for me, please?
Under the blue sky, the angel symbolizing victory shines brighter than the sun.
Before the race, let me give you a blessing known as certain victory.
The day's races end. All that remains is the award ceremony.
When I step out of the pit, my eyes are first drawn to a pennant blowing in the breeze–and then to U-96.
Yo. Over here, Commander.
She smiles brightly and pats the seat next to her, beckoning me to approach.
I saw the moment your car crossed the finish line. You gonna crack open some champagne on the first-place podium?
Well, there's still time until the ceremony. I was thinking of taking a walk to clear my mind a little.
Uh-huh? Well, you were cool as hell today, Commander. I knew you'd take first.
Well, thank you for your bid of confidence. Were you that certain?
Course I was. You're my Commander, after all.
I'd figure it out on the spot. Probably cheer ya up and wait for your next victory.
Besides, you'd never betray my expectations. No shot.
You're the whole reason I came to cheer at this event, anyway.
Argh, enough of that! Is it hot, or what?
The dazzling sun scorches the earth, heedless of our suffering. We can't stay in its burning rays for too long.
It's so hot, in fact, that I realize that I can see the air distorting over the racetrack.
Wanna go cool down, or somethin'?
How about the pit? The AC in there feels great.
Oh, first... Stay still for me a sec.
*mwah*
A soft sensation touches my cheek, accompanied by hot breath.
The goddess of victory, wielding her flag in hand, has bequeathed me with a kiss.
Apparently bashful for once, U-96 looks away a little. From this angle, it looks like she's blushing.
What, are you just gonna stare at me now? That was just your prize.
Your muscles must be stiff from all that driving, right? Someone's gonna have to give ya a massage.
Besides... We've got time before the ceremony.
I'll treat you for winning first place. In return, you gotta reward ME for all the work I did cheering you on.
Alright! Let's goooo!
Late at night, I open the door to Brest's room.
The lights flicker in the spring night. The smoke rising from her candles fills the air with an elegant and warm vibe.
As for Brest herself, she leans against a small desk by her bedside. With a brush in hand, she is intently painting the floral pattern between her eyebrows.
The moment she notices me, she turns and beams.
Welcome, O Champion. You've been a busy one today.
Why not... enjoy a moment's rest by my side?
With a gentle smile, she scoots over a bit, making room for me to sit.
Sure. I'd be happy to.
I've had a surprising amount of work today. I wanted to come see you as soon as possible, but, well...
Heehee. I'm just honored that you made the time to come.
I'd best get you a snack... Oh, but first, wine worthy of such a fine champion...
She sits up and elegantly pours a glass of wine.
I hear this is the Empery's finest. Please, partake.
Thank you.
I accept the glass and quaff it all in one go. Its bold, peppery flavor has a hint of warmth and sweetness that chases away the chill from my cold walk here.
We chat for a while, and before long, we've drunk more than our fair share. As we get tipsier, the mood becomes a little more inviting.
You know, Brest, something seems different about you today.
Is this what you're referring to?
She touches the delicate floral pattern on her brow. There's a hint of mischief in her eyes.
Heehee... So you do like it.
Would you like it more if I styled my hair as they do in the Dragon Empery?
Hm? Where'd that come from?
One quote from their poetry is, "A woman dresses herself for the one who delights her." In other words, we try to look beautiful for the one we love.
Right now, that would be an apt description for me.
She bashfully breaks eye contact and picks up her brush again.
O Champion, might I call upon you to add your touch to my floral makeup? Just like in their stories...
Sure. Allow me.
Oh, a worthy champion...
Please, allow me to help you. We'll do it together...
I don't mind, but I've never done it. I'd feel bad if I ruined your pretty makeup.
Don't worry. I'll be helping you.
She gives me the brush and wraps her warm hand around mine.
Following her guidance, I gingerly place the tip on her brow.
Our eyes lock, and we're close enough to feel each other's breath. The spring night air is still cold, but it only makes the warmth between us more intense.
O Champion, please come closer. There's something more I want to show you...
With each stroke, I can feel her breath quickening against my cheek.
The way you paint my face now reminds me of lovers in old folktales...
After the last stroke, I gaze into her eyes.
How I wish to capture this fleeting spring night with zither and poetry, just like they did.
Brest...
...Shall we put out the candles for now, O Champion?
I walk home with Kearsarge after the New Year's party.
It's late at night already, but the streets of the port remain bright and festive.
Kearsarge's expression is as flat as usual, but there's a shine of satisfaction in her eyes.
Today's data collection was fruitful, Commander.
I logged an ample amount of data on both dumpling recipes and fascinating examples of interpersonal communication.
Glad you had fun at the banquet.
You know, you look absolutely gorgeous in that attire.
When I bring up her outfit, she looks down at it and smiles with a hint of pride.
Well observed. While it is less mobile than my usual suit...
I found that, upon analysis and comparison of your preferences, this would be the most appropriate attire for the event.
She looks up into my eyes.
Analysis: You seem to agree.
After speaking, Kearsarge suddenly stops in her tracks.
Oh, Commander. Please wait for a moment.
I need to readjust the fit of my footwear... My mastery of it is still lacking.
Since one hand is taken up by her handbag, Kearsarge tries adjusting her shoes with the other. She wasn't kidding – she's struggling a lot.

options.content: Let's find a place for you to sit down.

scripts.say: Do you need me to help?
That would be a poor use of your valuable time...
You just seem like you're having trouble alone.
...Okay.
Suggestion: May I lean on you? It will be over soon.
Let's find a place to sit down. It'll be easier that way.
It's fine. I can do it here.
Besides, I would not want to interrupt our walk...
Let me help then.
Thank you, Commander. I'd like it if you could prop me up for just a moment.
I take her hand, and she starts to lean on me.
Not just logging and analysis... but the warmth of being with you... I want...
She murmurs to herself.
Hmm? Did you say something?
Nothing. I was simply analyzing the data I collected today.
Even after fixing her shoes, she doesn't let go of my hand.
We walk on, hand in hand, and discuss the dinner we just had.
Say, do you have any wishes for the new year?
New Year's wishes? Mine is as follows: I wish to log more data of you and get to know you better. This answer should be within your expectations.
Yeah. That does sound like you.
But isn't there anything you want for yourself?
For... myself?
She falls into deep thought for a moment. When she finally looks up, there's a newfound sparkle in her eyes.
Did you come up with something?
She nods... and then, for some reason, shakes her head.
I've conceived of a wish, but I do not yet fully comprehend it.
At this time, my wish is to forever preserve the warm feeling and happiness of being with you...
I feel a weight on my shoulder. Turning my head, I see Kearsarge leaning against me.
Her breathing is soft and there's a faint smile on her lips. She must be happy about this new wish she's found.
Happy New Year, Kearsarge.
I hope all of your wishes come true.
On the night before the festival, during my tour around the port, I hear a sudden commotion from a nearby building.
Curiosity compels me to check.
As I push open the half-closed door, what I find leaves me dazed.
It's Nagato. She's wearing a traditional Dragon Empery dress, and her hair spills onto the table she's sitting on...
Her arms are bound behind her head with red string, leaving her almost unable to move.
C-Commander? What are you doing here...
When she sees me, her face flushes.
I-I simply wanted to help everyone prepare for the festivities...
But I can't... untie this damn string...
Nagato?
I can kind of imagine what she was trying to do, but I can't help but tease her a little.
Th-this is...
Well, I was planning to use the red string to make a good luck decoration for you...
If only I knew it would lead to this embarrassment...
She flails her arms and legs about, but her efforts don't loosen the string.
Commander? Are you going to help me?
I'll help you untie it.
Mgh... Thank you.
Should I look for scissors?
Urk... I'd rather not cut it, if possible...
Oh, right. You wanted to make it a decoration...
Yes...
I squat down and start untying the string wrapped around her.
Hmm... Do we start with the legs or the arms?
Nagato turns her face away in embarrassment, doing her best not to watch me untie her.
I... I want to be part of the ceremony and offer my blessings to you and everyone else...
But no matter how many times I tried to fix it, the string just got tighter and more tangled.
In a bid to dispel the awkward silence, she starts muttering quietly.
Despite my attempts to free her, it doesn't take long before I realize my hands have ended up entangled with her legs.
They say this red string not only brings fortune but also attracts predestined lovers.
I suppose... the two of us are bound by the red string of fate, then...
Ah...! G-goodness, what am I saying?!
I look up at her face. She's beet red.
She struggles and writhes more out of shame, but it only makes things worse, tangling the string around us even more.
Don't move, Nagato! Let's take it slow and steady.
Aah... I just...
After much effort, I manage to untie her ankles. As I stand up to free her arms too, however...
Y-your hands are quite warm...
She quivers and flushes again.
With each knot I untie, the distance between us shrinks even more.
Nagato looks up at me, her eyes brimming with shyness and, strikingly, a trace of expectancy.
I open the door to Chien Wu's room, where she's hard at work adjusting her dress.
She notices my arrival, turns around, and grins slightly.
You're here quite early. That excited to see my outfit?
Heh. That look on your face tells me that you see the value of my design. Your fashion sense isn't half bad.
You put a lot of work into this.
As always, your design is more than stunning.
Chien Wu gives a slight grin at my praise, but she remains fully focused on the dress.
There's still some time. Let's set out once I've finished these details...
Seemingly to check the fit, she gathers the fabric at her chest and then lifts the dress slightly.
The dress hugs her figure, highlighting a charming and elegant silhouette.
She turns to the side, contemplating herself in the mirror. She then starts adjusting the button and strap positioning...
Just then, she seems to remember something and gazes at me.
You're free, aren't you? Don't just stand there, come help me.

options.content: (Offer to help her adjust the dress.)

scripts.say: Want me to brew you some tea, or something?
She nods, accepting my offer.
Hm? Want me to help you with the dress?
I appreciate the offer, but no, I'd like to perfect my own work with my own hands.
That said, since you're offering, why not brew me some tea?
Thus, I bring her a cup of freshly brewed tea. She savors it in an elegant manner.
If you don't mind my asking, which of these perfumes do you think is the best for tonight?
She produces several bottles of perfume as if by sleight of hand and has me pick one.
Hmm... This one left the deepest impression, I think. It seems perfect for such a special occasion.
I see. It does match this outfit, too... Then I'll choose this one.
She happily accepts my suggestion and then looks at my clothes.
Your tuxedo looks a bit plain here. How about I go get some accessories to jazz it up?
She takes out an elaborate jewelry case, but there are so many inside that I struggle to decide which ones to choose.
When I look to her for advice, my eyes stop on her delicate brooch.
She follows my gaze down to the brooch and grins in understanding.
Oh, I see. So you like this one?
Good taste. I happen to have some materials left over, so I'll make you one to match.
With that, she takes out her tools and begins working with swift, deft movements.
Before long, she's made a beautiful brooch matching the one on her chest.
What attention to detail...
Of course. We're going together, after all.
I'm paying more attention to ensuring it complements your attire and that we match, rather than trying to just draw attention.
After helping me adjust a few details, Chien Wu looks at our outfits with satisfaction, checks herself in the mirror once more, and then finally beams.
It's almost time. Let's be off.
We don't want to miss the opening of the banquet.
With that, we walk out of the room and head to the main hall together.
The subtle scent of perfume drifting from beside me adds an extra touch of magic to this wonderful night.
After the banquet, we go back to her room.
Chien Wu puts a hand on the door frame to support herself as she prepares to take off her heels. I see traces of exhaustion on her face.
I'm done with work, so I plan to relax tomorrow...
If you don't have any plans, why not stay with me?
I'm given no time to consider the sudden offer before she takes off my tuxedo.
You've been wearing that all night. Surely it feels stuffy by now.
Then, she leans in close and sniffs me.
I smell my perfume on you... Maybe I stayed a little too close to you during the banquet?
She giggles and touches my collarbone.
Commander, you feel a little hot... Is it all about the alcohol? Or something else? ♥
Could be anything.
I put on high heels and sacrificed comfort for the look tonight. Standing around for extended periods is pretty tiring...
Fatigue lingers in her voice, but there's an obvious hint of flirtation.
Don't just stand there. Help me out...
When I unconsciously reach for her shoes, she acts surprised for a moment.
I meant support me, silly.
What? You want to take my shoes off for me?
Oh, that's what you meant...
Okay, okay. I'll help you balance.
I give her my shoulder, and she leans on me.
I was hoping you'd be more assertive, but you're still so slow to act...
She chuckles and looks up at me, a mischievous glint in her eyes.
I mean, may I?
Either amused... or stunned, she doesn't pull her leg away.
Heehee... Sure. Do what you want.
She then looks up at me, a mischievous glint in her eyes.
Since you're free, Commander, why not give me a massage...?
You're already trying to touch me, after all.
Sure. I'd be happy to.
I nod and prepare to massage her feet.
She rests her hand on the door frame, her expression relaxed and at ease.
You want to peel off my stockings?
Ah, you and your tedious ideas... Fine, come here ♥
I gingerly pinch the edge of her stockings and pull them down.
The silk texture has a soft sheen under the light, making her ankles appear even more delicate and slender as I slowly slip them off.
*sigh*... Honestly, we don't often get to spend time together like this...
Ah, that spot tickles... Eep?!
She pulls her foot away to escape my hands, nearly losing her balance in the process.
As I manage to catch her just in time, I accidentally step on the train of her dress.
That's not good. Yes, I suppose keeping this dress on might be inconvenient later...
She pauses for a moment and then smiles meaningfully.
Heehee... Look at you. What were you just imagining?
Is there something special you want to... do during this rare time together?
If you can please me... then yes, I might just be willing to do it. ♥
The lounge is especially comforting today, owing to the mixture of the heater's warmth and the gentle aroma of tea.
My eyes wander around the room until they naturally arrive on the sofa.
Mainz, who's usually stiff and formal, is splayed out on said sofa in relaxation. A rare sight, indeed.
Apparently hearing my entry, she raises her head. A soft smile spreads on her face.
Good to see you, Commander. You look tired. Want to come rest with me?
She pats the open spot next to her invitingly.
Come on. Take the opportunity to relax a little.

options.content: I was just looking to take a break.

scripts.say: Thanks. I think I'll do just that.
It's not often that we get to take a break together.
Good idea. I was just looking for a place to take a break.
There are precious few opportunities to relax with you.
When I sit next to her, she sits up and skillfully brews a pot of tea.
As the aroma intensifies, she fills two teacups and offers me one.
Here, Commander. This is one of the Dragon Empery's specialties. I hope you like it.
Thank you.
When I accept it, warmth spreads from the porcelain to my fingers.
But I hardly realize it, because my fingers also brush against Mainz's silky skin.
She looks surprised for a moment, but she calmly takes her hand back as if nothing had happened.
I take a sip. The flavor of smooth, rich tea fills my mouth. Its aftertaste is comforting, as well, bringing a smile to my face.
Before I can sing its praises, I notice a rosy blush adorning Mainz's cheeks.
Um... How do you like it?
I love it. Suits my tastes perfectly.
You always know what I like, Mainz. Whether it's tea or coffee.
She gives a small smile, and her expression softens.
Wrapped in the aroma of tea, we chat about what's happening at the port.
Her dress reflects the light softly. Seeing her in it reminds me of the New Year's party.
That dress fits you well. Did you pick it just for the party?
I-I did... Are you really saying it looks good on me?
I've been wondering, er... how you see me, Commander. But I'm relieved to hear your praise.
She looks down and adjusts the dress a little. Is it just me, or is she in a good mood?
Just then, one of her shoes slips and falls onto the floor.
I'll get that.
I bend down, pick up the pretty high heel, and kneel in front of her.
Huh? W-wait, Commander! I did not mean to have you...!
She frantically waves her hands, and her face turns a deep red.
But she doesn't stop me, perhaps trying not to ruin the mood, or perhaps not wanting to let the moment go. Rather, she lets me lift her foot.
As I do, I feel the silky softness of her stockings.
She trembles a little, but she doesn't break her elegant posture.
Like the glass slippers of fairy tales, the high heel fits perfectly on her foot.
I look up to find Mainz's eyes looking unusually bashful.
Thank you, Commander.
I'm very happy... to be spending such a serene and comfortable time with you.
When I arrive at the photo shoot, I'm stricken by the beautiful, Dragon Empery-style set.
Jean Bart leans against a tree with lanterns hanging from it, gazing thoughtfully into the distance while supporting her head with slender fingers.
She must have been waiting for a long time – when she sees me, she perks up a little.
You're here.
She sits up and casually pulls on her clothes a bit to straighten them out.
Well? Am I the apple of your eye?
Just asking out of curiosity.
She adds that second part quickly, as if trying to prove that she doesn't care that much.
Yeah, it looks great on you. The tailoring emphasizes your grace.
I like it. It suits the festive mood.
A little different from your usual style, maybe, but that's just another part of the charm.
My sincere praise makes her loosen up a little, but as usual, she doesn't openly express a hint of joy.
While I do like this holiday spirit, don't expect me to dress up every single year.
Okay, everything's ready. Let's get started.
The shoot begins. Her poses are elegant, but her facial expressions betray her lack of experience.
Several photos later, we've yet to truly draw out her natural charms.
You're still a little tense. Maybe try to relax more.
How about we chat a little to loosen you up?
Fine. About what, though?
Hmm... Like new year traditions in the Empery?
Gotta admit, I'm a little interested this year. You know anythin' about it?
New year traditions, huh? I'd say the most memorable one has to be the "red envelope."
Basically, everyone gives each other red envelopes to bless each other in the new year.
Oh, is that how you give blessings to someone? Heheh. Alright, then why don't you show me how sincere you are?
The timing couldn't be more perfect. I reach into my pocket for the red envelope I'd been saving for after the shoot.
I've got what you want right here. All of my sincerity, and more.
I hope next year is safe, happy, and as fulfilling as can be for you. And I hope that we can become closer than ever.
Heh... That's more like it.
She happily accepts the envelope and deposits it gingerly into her clothes.
As we keep chatting, she softens up more and more. Her movements become much more natural.
A new year and a new beginning... So they say, but every day's a new start to me.
What makes it different from the past ones is the fact that I have you now here.
She leans back against the tree and looks up at the hanging lanterns.
Then, she gazes tenderly at me.
Don't get me wrong. It's not like I'm relying on you...
Her tone becomes even softer, and she starts to sound more like she's talking to herself than to me.
Warm lantern light shines upon her delicate countenance...
Either way... Happy New Year, Commander.
I seize the moment and click the shutter.
This photo is sure to be the one that both of us love the most.
Bathed in the light of lanterns and the starry sky, Jean Bart's smile is more enchanting than ever. Her beauty eclipses even the stars above.
Happy New Year to you, too, Jean Bart.
As I enter the room, a sweet scent tickles my nose. The space is meticulously decorated, with intricate details everywhere.
While I quietly take in the elegant scenery, a gentle melody begins to play.
In the direction of the sound, I find New Jersey dancing in a gorgeous Empery-style dress.
The exquisitely embroidered dress sways gracefully as she moves, while the ribbon at her waist twirls as if it has a life of its own.
Her graceful movements come to a perfect stop just as the last note fades, and she approaches me.
Phew... It was really hard to complete the ending, but I can handle anything!
So, honey, did you like it? Hellooo, honey? Aww, are you so mesmerized that you can't speak? Hahaha!
You were just so beautiful. I couldn't take my eyes off you.
Heheh! When I saw you stunned and gawking, I just knew this surprise was a success.
Anyway, you're right on time. Welcome, honey!
Wait... Did you prepare all of this for me? The set, the outfit, and all?
Of course I did! This is easy stuff for the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union!
Ting An deserves some of the credit for getting me the tools, though.
I can tell a lot of thought went into this. It must have taken a long time to get everything ready!
Hmm... I mean, I guess it did. But what matters to me is that you like it!
She takes my hands and looks at me expectantly.
Come on! Don't just stand there. Dance with me!
I'll teach you, so don't worry if you've never done it before. Now, give me your hand and try spinning with me! Hahaha!
New Jersey's palm is warm and soft, and the sweet scent emanating from her puts me at ease.
I'm clumsy at first, but her patient guidance helps me find the rhythm. Eventually, we're able to dance in perfect sync.
As we're really getting into the groove, though, her hair ornament gets tangled with her ribbon.
Ack... How did these two get tangled together? Honey, help me untangle them!
When I approach to help, she suddenly lunges at my chest and pulls me into a tight embrace.
Heheh... It's cold at night, y'know? Come here, honey. Huuug!
Did that make your heart skip a beat? You must really love this outfit!
Okay, pick. Which do you like more – the usual me, or me in this dress?
Uhh...
Geez, don't hesitate now. You're supposed to say you love both, silly!
Yeah, you're right. I love both.
Heehee! You're the best, honey! By the way, there's this thing they say in the Dragon Empery... Umm, something about the moon waxing and waning and driving people apart...
Anyway, the moon here never wanes! And that means I'll always get to be with you.
She pledges eternal love in a soft tone.
Silver moonlight showers upon us.
New Jersey snuggles into my arms like a needy kitten.
Part of me wishes that this moment could last forever.
The instant I open the door, a soothing aroma dispels all of my fatigue from days of work.
The warm illumination and refined furnishings are perfectly arranged to create a peaceful atmosphere.
In the midst of it all is Murmansk, wearing an elegant Empery-style dress that highlights her proportions.
Comrade Commander, welcome. Take a deep breath in... Can you smell it?
*inhaaale*...
Smells good. It's very comforting...
The antique incense burner on the table lets out a steady trickle of smoke. Its subdued, yet comforting fragrance naturally relaxes me.
It has aroma-therapeutic effects, so it's perfect for a hard worker like you.
Thanks for thinking about me, Murmansk.
You look gorgeous in that dress.
Hearing my compliment, she playfully spins around as if showing off how beautifully her new dress fits.
Why, thank you. Heehee, I noticed you staring. Do you like it that much?
I think this hair ornament is a perfect match, too... Oh?
I wonder. Should I drape this tail over my shoulders, or should I keep it fixed at my back? Which suits the outfit better?
I say try draping it over your shoulders. It fits your lighthearted personality.
Okay~
As directed, she gently places her fluffy tail onto her shoulders and tilts her head to look at me.
Keep it behind your back, maybe? That way, the beautiful design of your dress stands out more. It's neater and lighter too, don't you think?
Yeah, yeah~ You're totally right.
As directed, she uses an accessory to secure her tail behind her, then turns around to show me.
After much experimentation, she's still unsure about what to do with her tail. But I can't help but notice that she's having fun trying different things with me.
"One, two, three, four, five, foxes love potatoes..." That's an old Dragon Empery nursery rhyme, you know!
While she sings to herself, she suddenly tilts her head in confusion.
Hmm? Isn't it? Maybe I'm remembering it wrong.
The song, perhaps something she'd heard once upon a time, sounds oddly exotic when it comes from her mouth.
Meanwhile, the scent of incense intensifies. I start to feel a bit sleepy.
Murmansk yawns and leans drowsily against the table.
*yaaawn*... That smells so good... I'm getting sleepy. Come to think of it, one of the Empery girls mentioned that this incense has a soporific effect...
Her tail slips off her shoulders and falls to the floor. I step forward to help pick it up–
Huh? My tail is on the floor? It's okay, I can just clean it later~
More importantly, Comrade Commander, is there anything you wanna do with me?
There's a playful glint in her eye.
Umm, such as...?
Well, you know... Comrade Commander... Wanna sleep together for a while?
The incense must be getting to me, because I promptly agree.
She smiles happily and walks over to me, wrapping her arm around mine.
It's just the two of us... Peace and quiet.
Her voice carries a tone of excitement, as if she's anticipating something.
Hum dededee dum♪
Huh? Welcome back, Comma – umm, I mean, my Master!
The first morning breeze ushers me into the open doors of Lexington's manor.
The owner of the manor is dressed in a light and fluffy maid outfit.
Hehe, you look stunned. Never seen me dressed like this before, have you?
I guess dressing up as maids is all the rage at port these days. It piqued my interest, so I just had to try it!
Playing a different role once in a while is part of the spice of everyday life, don't you think?
That said, my cleaning is kind of clumsy. My lack of experience is really showing.
I need your help, Master, to help me grow into my role as a capable maid.
She scoots over on her knees. Her lacy skirt sways gracefully along with her.
There's an excited smile on her face as she looks up at me.

options.content: I'll do my best to be a good teacher.

scripts.say: Let's clean together.
Hooray! You're too kind to me, Master.
I'll do my best to be a good teacher.
Hehe, then I'd better be a student you can be proud of!
So, shall we begin with this mirror right here?
Mm... No matter how much I wipe here, I can't get this smudge off. Am I not putting enough force into it?
Master, let's get it spick and span together.
When you're wiping things, you need to know just how much force is needed. Otherwise, it won't get clean.
Okay, here goes! Heave-ho!
It's hard to tell if she's learning from me or if I'm the one obeying her, but regardless, we work closely together to clean the mirror.
Our clothes touch at times, rhythmically rubbing against each other. The giant mirror squeaks and creaks from all the wiping.
Our reflections ripple like on the water's surface, blurring the lines between reality and illusion.
Whether you're dealing with a fragile mirror or a delicate maid, you have to use just the right amount of force. Not too forceful, but not too gentle~
Ah... We're in perfect sync.
But it's strange... Why won't this one go away?
It's as if this mark is as deeply rooted as the mark you've left on my life~
Sooo... How about you come a little closer and see for yourself?
The teasing way she seeks an answer piques my curiosity.
See, there's still a little mark right here... Oh? Goodness, that happens to be right where my chest is reflected.
Isn't that embarrassing? But still, we need to get this mirror clean. Don't look away, Master. Get a good look at it!
There's a big, confident smile on her face. I doubt she's "embarrassed" at all.
I look at where she's pointing. There seems to be some kind of translucent mark there, indeed.
When I look closer, I notice that it's swaying along with her breathing like a boat on the waves.
Oh, Master? Did you notice something?
Why did you look away from the mirror... and at my chest?
Oh, dear! I see~ It wasn't a mark on the mirror all along. It was on ME!
I guess I got all sweaty while you were teaching me...
My dress is getting a little damp, too. How are you, Master? Are you sweaty?
In that case, I think I know what needs to be cleaned next~
Get yourself over to the bath for me, Master... Your hard-working maid needs so many more lessons, if you'll have her.
Commander, I'm in big trouble... HUGE trouble! Help meee!
Hello? Hellooo, Commander, can you hear me?!
Waaah! This bites! I'm gonna be late for my maid for a day gig with the Commander!
When I get to our arranged meeting spot, I hear a familiar voice from inside a phone booth.
What do I do... Oh, hey, C-Commander?! You're finally here!
It's dangerous out here! Happy D might go crazy and attack us again... Come on, let's talk in here!
She throws the door open and drags me in by the arm.
As the door closes behind me, her rapid breathing mingles with the sound of my heart pounding.
I wanted to come straight to you, but there was this big bang, and Happy D went all haywire!
It opened a hole in the clock tower, smashed through seven streetlights in a row... For all I know, it's still out there causing mayhem!
Basically, I'm in big trouble again... I'm really sorry for dragging you into this!
Porter looks up at me with teary eyes. I actually believe that she feels bad about it.
I'm glad nobody's hurt. Let me take care of this.
Huh? Really?! Thank you so much!
You always get me out of every mess... I love you, Commander!
She buries her face in my chest, either seeking shelter or pleading for comfort.
Through her sheer maid outfit, I feel warmth and a pounding heartbeat.
I was trying to repay you with this maid for a day deal, but I didn't think we'd end up locked in a stupid phone booth...
Oh! I should just start my services here and now, duh! It's not like we have to do it anywhere specific!
Yeah, let's do that!
She takes a deep breath to encourage herself and then awkwardly mimics a maid's posture.
N-n-now, my... beloved Master...
What service may I provide for you today?
By the time she finishes whispering her rehearsed lines, her face is already deep red.
M-Master, umm... Is it just me, or is it hot in here?
Maybe we're a little too close...
Aww... My outfit is all sticky from sweat... This is even more embarrassing than just being naked.
Not that I mind... you seeing me, Master...
*pant*... *pant*...
*pant*... *pant*...
Since she's still in my arms, I can feel her hot, ragged breathing distinctly.
Strangely, I hear the same sound as her panting from nearby, though it's a little distorted.
The sounds overlap over and over in the cramped booth... until I see the phone off the hook and realize what has happened.
Huh... What?! I-I forgot to hang up this whole time!
Gaaah! Why is it so embarrassing to hear your own voice?!
F-forget it! Either way, I! William D. Porter, your favorite maid! Will serve you with all of my being!
I'll do my best, whatever the request!
This time, I'm definitely not gonna mess up!
Oh... Commander, you're here early~
Were you impatient to receive my care?
Cowpens awaits inside the room, holding a baby bottle full of a white fluid.
The air is thick with the sweet smell of milk. It's almost as if every inch of the room is immersed in it.
Sit down right here... It's time for your nutritional supplement~
This milk is specially made for your needs. I kept it nice and warm, too.
Would you like to drink it yourself? Or... should I help you?
She leans in and offers me the bottle. Its sweet scent grows stronger.
Help me?
Heehee, of course... I'd be happy to take care of you until your tummy is nice and full~
You'll get to snuggle up in my arms for as long as you want.
Wanna give it a try, Commander?
Uh... Do I have a choice?
Umm... Wait a second.
She blinks at me. There's evident disappointment in her eyes.
I was naive. Normal nutritional milk won't satisfy your needs anymore, will it?
But don't worry, Commander. I'll make even tastier, fresher milk!
I-I didn't mean it like that.
Aww, Commander~ If you can't choose on your own...
Then first, I'll need you to be good and drink up aaall of this milk for me.
The silky-smooth milk permeates through my body. Its sweetness naturally relaxes me, and its warmth seeps into my heart.
After I've drunk it all, Cowpens smiles in satisfaction and whispers into my ear.
There you go... Don't let a single drop go to waste.
Let my nutrients fill your heart and body.
Phew... I think it's finally starting to work.
I'm getting a little bit hot, too...
She pulls me into her arms and squeezes tightly. Her warm body envelops me along with the warm, milky scent.
Our heartbeats mingle through our clothing. Sleepiness comes, and my consciousness starts to drift away.
Just sleep, Commander.
Sleep well... in my arms and my warmth.
I'll hold you until you wake up.
My mind blurs and melts into sweet warmth as I fall into pure-white dreams.
Hehe... You won't be able to live without my nutrients anymore~
My dear, beloved Commander♥
Wow! Lucky you, Commander! You pulled TWO surprise cards right off the bat!
That means you get to amp up the punishment!
Pasadena invited me to the pop-up shop's game room.
The rules of this game are simple: the winner pulls a surprise card, and the loser receives the punishment written on the drawn card.
This is her second loss in a row, which means I very literally hold her fate in my hand.
Ooh... You gonna use both at the same time? What an idea!
Let's see. The first one is... taking off an article of clothing? Very direct and provocative!
And the second is... that you get to write something on me? Ooh, I've got a great idea for that one!
Okay, check this out, Commander~
With the agility of a cat, she sidles up to me, undoes her ribbon, and pushes it into her cleavage.
What are you waiting around for?
If you don't write something quickly, your card won't be as effective!
My gaze wanders over her more private parts before finally settling on her bare back. But as I try to pick up the brush, she grabs my hand.
That card doesn't say you have to write "words" specifically, see? Let me show you an example~
She licks the tip of the brush with her pink tongue, then guides my hand downward – across her neck, her clavicles, and around her shoulder blades – tracing a glistening collar upon her skin.
Then, lower... My brush and hand alike sink into her cleavage.
If you kept going that way, Commander, what do you think would happen?
Hehe, that's enough for my example~ Maybe it'll come in handy next time you pull the same card.
Aww, I lost again.
Pasadena loses twice more... and I get to pull two more surprise cards.
The mask and boots cards, eh?
The boots that come with that one have a special tickling mechanism inside...
As for the mask card, well, I'm not allowed to talk for a specific period of time. That whole time, you get to try and sabotage me all you want.
BUT, if I can overcome this two-fold trial, then I win!
She wastes no time putting on the boots and the mask.
After taking a few deep breaths, she leans into me and winks upward.
Okay... You may begin!
On her mark, the boots start buzzing. She shudders violently.
Her stifled breathing comes out of the mask as a white mist... but indeed, she doesn't say a word.
I guess I can start too, then?
Yeah... Ack!
Her panting quickly turns to laughter, interspersed with muffled breathing.
I can easily imagine her shutting her soft lips tight under that mask, desperately trying to withstand it. However...
Pfft... Hahaha! St-stop, not right there! Hahahaha, I give, I give! No more, hahaha!
I stop, but my hands are still trapped under her arms. She falls limp and into my chest, panting heavily.
Haah, haah... My sides hurt from laughing...
I guess the winner is – Mm, wait. Don't move~ I'm just saying for this round...
Just as I'm thinking that's it for today's game, she suddenly whips around and pins me down.
Commander... The game's not over yet. I'm not letting you go... not until we're all out of surprise cards♥
*knock knock*
Commander? Come on in!
When I open the bar door, Yorktown is seated at the counter. She turns my way, as if she's been waiting for me.
The warm, yellow lights illuminate her bunny-girl outfit, adding a touch of allure to her gentle demeanor.
So you're finally here.
At first, I invited you here just to relax, but... Heheh, I changed my mind.
You're the owner of this bar now.
As for me? Well, I'll be your personal waitress for the night.
It's a pleasure to work for you~
As your waitress, I hope you'll allow me to pour your first drink of the night?
After guiding me to a seat, she pours glistening red wine into the glass on the table.
Our fingertips brush as I accept the glass, leaving a ticklish sensation.
Take the time to savor it, Commander. Consider my time tonight all yours.
How should I repay such luxurious service?
All I want... is for your eyes to stay on me.
Has my service tonight satisfied you, Commander?
We touch our glasses together, sending a satisfying clink echoing through the bar.
Her long legs casually press against mine – a silent invitation.
Or... Would you like something more special and intimate?
Her toes wander upward, inch by inch.
Make any request, and tonight, I will grant it.
Hehe, this special service is for nobody but you.
She wears a tempting, tipsy blush. Her warm breath, faint with alcohol, brushes against my neck.
It's my first time serving you like this, though... I feel a little awkward.
Would you give me one more chance? Will you... try the special cocktail I made just for you?
Spurred on by my lack of refusal, a mischievous glint appears in her eyes.
She doesn't return behind the counter, though – she gracefully leaps onto the counter and crawls on her knees.
The bunny-girl outfit accentuates her curves.
Every little movement comes with the rustling of fabric, which sounds especially clear in the quiet bar.
Yorktown? What are you doing?
I just... thought this would be faster...
Once in the middle of the counter, she doesn't reach for the shaker directly – rather, she uses her hands to support herself.
Commander... I want you to look at me more closely.
To see the Yorktown that I'm revealing to you.
Besides... I don't usually get to see you from this angle. It's nice.
After a pause, she finally takes the shaker and gives it a few shakes.
Did you know, Commander?
Some emotions are like shaken sparkling wine... just waiting for the right moment to erupt.
Such as?
Such as... how I want to come closer to you and see nothing but myself in your eyes...
As she finishes that sentence, she lurches over and falls toward me with an exaggerated cry.
I reach out to catch her, and she falls right into my arms.
Her soft body presses against me, and her slender arms wrap around my shoulders.
Was this part of your plan?
Maybe it was... or maybe it wasn't.
Yorktown looks up at me, breathing the faint scent of wine onto my cheek.
As she tightens her grip on me, the shaker falls from her grasp and onto the carpet.
So much for my special cocktail...
But in your arms, I've found something even more intoxicating and overwhelming.
Those soft murmurs linger in my ear as she tightens her hold on me again, drawing me closer until our lips are nearly touching.
Commander... Would you like to feel what I'm feeling?
I've been waiting for you... Master.
A thin veil of steam covers the bathroom. It carries a faint tinge of her scent.
Gouden Leeuw stretches languidly, her amber eyes gleaming with simultaneous mischief and tenderness.
It's cleaning time.
Normally, as your maid, I should be the one doing this service...
But you're the one who asked to do it, and I could hardly deny a request from you.
Without further ado, let's begin.
Whatever cleaning you'd like to do, I am here.
She slowly adjusts her posture to expose more skin to me, showing off her alluring proportions.
I do wonder what part of me you'll clean first. Yes, start with whatever you like. You're mine to spoil right now, after all.
Hehe, what an interesting choice.
As she raises her feet for me, her fair ankles turn a light pink in the steam.
My arm? Heehee, surely that's not all you want.
As she leans sideways, water droplets slide down her curves, leaving streaks on her waist.
How do you like this position?
Oh? What's the matter? You froze up.
Heehee, was seeing me all it took?
Go on. Try something...
Each time the herbal-scented bath sponge slides over her soft skin, it spreads more milky-white suds.
Mm... It's so ticklish and tingly.
A little higher, Commander... Heehee~
The foam covering her acts as a lubricant, making each stroke smoother and softer.
There, just like that... Don't miss a single spot.
I know you wouldn't, though. You never want to miss out.
Heehee, good... That's enough.
Where will you go next? I'll be with you the whole way, Master~
I slide the sponge downward, causing her to shiver slightly.
Mm... Mmph... Master~
Oh dear, I'm all covered in your bubbles...
You didn't have to go THAT far, Commander.
As her saccharine tone reaches my ears, a few supple vines begin to wrap around my wrists and ankles...
The cleaning time is almost at its end.
But Commander... you look unsatisfied.
This won't do~ It's a maid's job to make sure her Master's needs are taken care of.
This time, it's my turn to reward... no, "clean" you up.
Relax. I'll wash every last inch of you so gently, so thoroughly...
Our breaths and heartbeats intertwine amidst the steam as our next round of cleaning begins.
*yawn*...
Commander, you're here...
Kansas is dressed like a maid, languidly stretching over a polished counter.
Her sleepy eyes are glazed over, as if she's just woken up from a nap. They gradually focus on me.
You're just in time...
Let's get straight to tonight's service, then.
First... This is for you.
She slides a gold card down the counter. It stops before me, still radiating her warmth.
As long as you have this card, you're our most honored customer.
Which means...
From this moment on... I'm all yours to do as you please with.
You've never had service like this... have you?
I hope we can spend a fun evening together...
Now, Commander. What is your request?

options.content: I want to watch you dance.

scripts.say: Okay... I'll prepare our signature drink right now.
After a moment, she offers me an old-fashioned glass. The amber liquid inside shimmers in the light.
Here you go.
After we've shared a few drinks, the effects of the alcohol become clear on her face. Her cheeks flush alluringly.
Dance, hm...? Well, I do know a few moves...
Slow jazz begins to play, and she steps to the center of the room.
The swaying of her hips and her soft dance moves are backed by an ethereal halo of light.
When the song ends, she returns and leans on me, breathing a little heavily. Her breath grazes my ear.
That took... a little more out of me than I'd hoped...
Is that your only request, Commander?
The service tonight isn't over yet... I still have energy...
Remember what I promised you? Whatever your request, I will grant it...
Kansas takes the card from my hand. Eyes downturned, she holds the edge to her lips...
When she returns it to me, there's a faint trace of lipstick on it.
Her hot breath and seductive voice come ever closer to my ear, ever more passionate.
Hm...? Commander, you look like you have something to say.
But you're too far away for me to hear you...
Leaning closer, she nuzzles her cheek against my shoulder.
I see... Is this the Kansas you wanted to see tonight, Commander?
Yeah... I've got it all figured out.
Leave it to me... All you have to do is relax, Commander...
Hnnngh! I-I can't get out of this!
Wh-what do I do... I should've known better than to – Huh? C-Commander?! When did you get here?!
Otto von Alvensleben wriggles helplessly on the sofa. Her maid outfit and leather restraints strike an enticing contrast.
Her arms are fixed behind her back, and her legs are bound together with tape. Just rolling over would probably be hard for her.
When our eyes meet, she reflexively straightens up and blushes from shame.
...I did book this room, didn't I? What are you doing here?
H-hahaha! W-well, umm... Some stuff happened, and all that led to this, basically, yep!
A-anyway! Nothing weird is going on here! Got it, Commander?!
I-I'll have this untied in no time... Ack! I got stuck again?!
Hnnngh! Th-this is all your fault! I was almost free, but you startled me and made me mess up!
So... Basically, you can't move?
H-hey, what are you doing? Don't come any closer!
S-stop it... Hahahaha! D-don't poke my waist! You're just adding insult to injury!
She laughs and struggles to escape. Before she can fall off the sofa, I catch her and help her back into place.
I doubt you'll be escaping that any time soon. Need some help?
*pant*... N-no, thank you! With my strength, this is easy. Check this out!
Otto pulls her arms apart as hard as she can, causing the restraints to creak.
Just when I start to think it's working, she shudders and goes limp.
The belt tightens once more, and her arms are returned to her back. She buries her face in a pillow, struggling to catch her breath.
*pant*... *pant*...
Ugh, th-this is bad...
Despite her attempts to remain calm, it's clear that she's panicking.
I lean over to help her undo the restraints –
Hyah?! S-stop! I said I don't need your help... D-don't touch me any more!
W-wait, I know another way to get this off! G-go outside for a few minutes! I'll have it off in no time!
A few minutes later, I go back into the room... and she's still the exact same way I left her.
Her chest heaves up and down, and her sweaty bangs cling to her brow. Slightly parted lips give a peek of her tongue as she pants.
Are you sure you don't need my help? I'm about to get going.
Huh?! W-wait... Okay! I admit it! I can't get free on my own!
*sniffle*... I-I'll do anything you want! Please, just close your eyes and untie it!
You hear me? Those eyes better be CLOSED!
Ah, Imperator! How do you do today?
Welcome to my establishment.
Wine-red lights suddenly turn on, lighting up the large, velvet sofa. The owner of this establishment, Mecklenburg, sits there with a confident smirk.
As my one and only guest... you've already fallen prey to me, a prisoner of my realm of eternal night.
Even the legendary Imperator can't escape this place!
She toys with her leather whip, putting on an air of utter superiority.
Then, she raises a foot and pushes her toes into my chest, gleefully drawing circles with it.
Before I punish you... Tell me, are you aware of your sins?
Really? Then now is the time to repent – repent for the sin of spending too little time with your Nachthexe!
Then I will pronounce it for all to hear! Your sin is the sin of spending too little time with your Nachthexe!
I've long been dissatisfied with you!
She slowly, deliberately tugs at her whip as she speaks. There's a quiet, but clear cracking sound.
Noticing my gaze, she lifts her chin slightly. Her lips curl upward into a playful smile.
You've been staring at this for a while... Are you so interested?
This is my Branding Mark, my weapon of choice on this night!
It's almost time. Soon, you will be imprinted with the mark of the Nachthexe!
Mecklenburg brandishes her whip. It slices through the air with a whoosh.
But first...
Cool fingertips tickle my shoulder. Her gaze is focused, like the appraising eye of a collector.
What a perfect body you have, Imperator... Truly captivating.
Before I know it, we're so close that we can feel each other's breaths.
A strange thrill radiates from my neck. It's warm, moist, and tingly...
The witch's tongue flits on the skin near my ear, leaving a delicate, lingering sensation.
I can smell... the magic burgeoning from within you...
It's so powerful, yet so sweet...
Once I've branded you, I'll get a good taste... Hmm?
Where has my Branding Mark gone?
Wha... How did you take it from me?!
No... Do you mean to brand ME? Why, the nerve!
W-wait! Not there...
Hyahn?! Aah!
Haah! So this is how it feels to be branded...
It's surprisingly... Nnh, addictive...
D-do it again!
Hnnh?! Eep!
*sigh*... Y-you don't know your place, Imperator... You'll pay for this.
It's my turn now... Are you prepared for punishment?
You're finally here, Commander... I've been waiting~
I sleepily open the lounge door, hoping to take a nap.
There, I see Guichen smiling at me from the sofa.
This is the lounge, right? I'm not crazy?
Yes, of course it is. But as you can see, I've made some modifications.
As your magical maid, I thought I should offer some more "magical" services.
Come again? Magical maid?
You heard right. I could help you shake off that sleepiness... or lull you to sweet dreams.
Come closer... Yes, just like that.
As directed, I lie down next to her. The mixed scents of lavender and milk seem to cradle me.
Guichen rings a bell. Its smooth tone is like a calming magical spell.
I suddenly notice a baby bottle in her hand. A few drops of white liquid drip out, leaving damp spots on her clothes.
Close your eyes, Commander... Leave your body and mind to me.
Yes, just like that... Relax, and feel my breathing and the ringing of the bell... They will guide you to the land of dreams.
Her voice softens gradually. My thoughts seem to fade, letting me immerse myself in this comfort.
Heehee, this is just the start of my sleep magic.
Faith is the foundation of magic... The more faith you have in me, the more wonderful your dreams will be.
As she whispers to me, I feel her warm breath on my earlobe.
Inhale, exhale... Inhale, exhale... Heehee, magic is drawing you into my domain...
You're enjoying this, right? Your breath is slowing down to match my rhythm...
I didn't expect it to be quite this effective.
Were you... looking forward to a relaxing nap with me?
Before I can respond, she puts her damp fingertip on my lip.
The pure flavor of milk hits my tongue and mingles with her body heat.
Her intimate touch doesn't shock me awake – instead, it's as if I've been given my final order to go to sleep.
Do you feel it? Your consciousness slowly fading... Your body becoming as light as a feather...
Soon, you and I will have the sweetest of dreams.
Should I join you now? Or should I prepare one last surprise for you, deep within your dreams?
I can hardly decide, as my mind has already succumbed to her comforting scent and sweet murmurings.
You don't have the strength to choose, do you? That's what I love about you, Commander.
Sleep peacefully, and don't worry...
Your magical maid has the perfect service in mind for when you wake up...
(Staaare.)
In the quiet bar, Prinz Eugen lies on a table and gazes at me, unblinking.
Seeing my lack of reaction, she pouts a little and sighs.
(Staaare.)
...Is something the matter?
Heheh, not at all.
So she says, but she doesn't back down – she only slides closer to me.
Her hot breath is as soft and ticklish as a feather on my cheek.
I'm just imagining what you're like when you're drunk.
Do you spill all of your secrets? Fall right asleep? Or... Hehe, do you get the urge to try things that you've never done before?
Just thinking about it makes me shiver.
Eugen giggles and strokes the slender neck of a nearby bottle.
I see... Well, sorry, but I don't get drunk that easily.
Oh, my. Are those fighting words, Commander?
You never know until you try... don't you think?
Before I can respond, she takes my glass, sips, and winks mischievously at me.
It's your turn, Commander.
Don't worry. This will be a fair contest. You take a sip, and then I take a sip. Are we agreed?
Faced with her raw confidence, I swallow my words and accept the glass.
After just a few rounds, our challenger is utterly defeated.
There's a deep blush on her cheeks, and her eyes have glazed over.
Mmnh... I-I'm just a little hot. I'm not drunk... at all...
I-I'm super fine... I won't lose that easily.
After... After all... I've still never seen you drunk before...
Her mumblings are starting to slur, but she forces herself to take another sip.
Right after, she reaches out and cups my face with hot hands.
Her thumbs caress my cheeks. With her breathing so close, I can smell the alcohol on her.
But what say we... change the rules a little?
There's no rule about HOW you're supposed to drink, right?
So this time... I'll feed it to you myself.
Instantly after, her warm, soft lips touch mine, and the taste and scent of liquor pass into my mouth.
As I struggle to swallow it all, Prinz Eugen's finger touches my lips.
...Now it's your turn.
I can't wait to see how you'll return the favor... Commander♪
