scripts.say: It was afternoon, and soft sunlight shone upon a quiet garden where a meeting was taking place.
According to my intel, the Cardinals will announce the final result later today.
What a complete waste of time.
I'm stunned that they pretended to discuss it for this long when they already made their decision ages ago.
Don't put it like that. This is a very tough decision for the Ecclesia to make.
And yet, they are the biggest beneficiaries.
Secularism and religion, royal and divine power, humans and shipgirls... There are too many things to balance and calculate.
In the end, though, the Ecclesia took the step...
A thousand years ago, the God's Judging Light smote the enemy that had invaded the heart of the empire. Not just that, it reshaped the very land it stood upon.
Then the peninsula shattered into an archipelago. The empire fell, and the Ecclesia was born...
Ever since then, we have lived in the light of that God.
We were reborn in that divine light, but we are also bound by it and made to walk on the path that God laid out for us.
It would be fine if it were just a belief, but that God is more than just a symbol of faith.
Not only does He really exist, but He also has an army of steel soldiers resting beneath our feet.
That knowledge has forbidden me from sleeping soundly even a single night since then...
Yes... That's why we've been trying to slowly and gently weaken the theocracy and separate that God from the secular world.
The Ecclesia clearly didn't like that, however.
What's more, they discovered that the shipgirl chosen by that God is the key to controlling His legacy...
Be that as it may, the Ecclesia is heading in a dangerous direction. This forces us to take more drastic measures.
I have been trying my hardest to avoid this scenario...
But now, it has come to this. I am a knight of the Sardegnia League, and my loyalty is sworn solely to the League.
Andrea, I believe your proposal is beneficial to the whole League.
In this age where we strive for freedom, we cannot allow ourselves to be bound by God.
If the Ecclesia won't change, we just have to change it ourselves.
Heehee. Then we're finally all in agreement.
Together, let us begin the eternal night.

sequence:
Path of the Chosen

<size=45>6 Project H</size>

scripts.say: In a familiar blank void, a lone door stands silently.
This place again... But why?
The barren white space does not answer.
No... Something feels wrong... Different, somehow.
It's like someone is watching me...
This space isn't a void. Everything may look completely blank, but I think I can see something in the distance...
I go with my gut and walk around for a while, but I'm unable to find anything except that half-open door – and pure whiteness in all directions.
My gut feeling was wrong.
Guess all that's left is to go through this door...
Here goes nothing.
The moment I touch the door, everything around me changes.
Eutopia Savoy – Colonel of the Republic of Sardegna's Navy, military advisor to the Oceanic Federation, member of the Special Investigations Committee, and the modern-day Garibaldi.
It's been a while. Welcome to the Eagle Union.
Aoste and I enter a modestly-decorated guest room. A woman with blonde hair already inside watches us with a complicated look.
Her lips part, a response to Aoste's greeting just on her tongue.
Or so I thought. The only thing that escapes her mouth is a sigh.
...We meet again, you two.
I thought you were here on an academic exchange visit?
Forgive me, I just wanted to break the ice. No need to be so tense.
Mhm. Was it you who came up with "the modern-day Garibaldi"?
Of course not. Do you think I would give you such a bland nickname?
The Magister... The Mysterious One... Yes, I suppose that's not like you.
Exactly. I would go with something like Golden Hawk, or Swordbearer.
It feels as though the temperature in the room dropped a few degrees.
Sorry. It was just a joke.
At any rate, can you guess why the two of us are here?
Pushing the envelope, are we?
I'm under an oath of confidentiality. Don't expect me to answer any questions regarding the Special Investigations Committee.
That being said... I can share my personal opinion on some matters.
Well, I've never concealed my opinions on those things anyway.
So, what do you want to ask?
...As the name suggests, we let a terrible monster run free.
The secrets and the dangers hidden within Wisdom Cubes have already far surpassed our expectations.
Excluding mine.
Right – surpassed the expectations of MOST of us.
I think it's necessary to put an immediate stop to these insane experiments.
I think the Colonel is a true hero.
His decision saved the lives of many people, and the destruction of Pandora's box saved even more.
I can only hope that the box has been completely and utterly destroyed now...
Whatever the case, I salute our dear friend.
...She was a good kid. She shouldn't have met the end she did.
I promise you the Committee will carry out a fair investigation.
May she rest in peace...
How is the situation Anzeel and the shipgirls?
I can't say it's very optimistic.
Excuse me, correction: I don't believe it's very optimistic.
I understand why people are so afraid about it... At the same time, far too many people have let their fear cloud their judgment.
Especially those with the power to make decisions.
We created shipgirls... We know their essence – their nature – better than anyone else.
Yet all these fabrications are just plausible enough to whip the masses into a frenzy.
Yes, and fear is the driving force behind it all.
The things fear makes people do... It's ridiculous.

It's not all bad. I'm currently working on some projects to enhance shipgirl stability. For instance, Cube power limits and alarm systems – auxiliary equipment that can be fast-tracked into mass-production.
Things will turn around soon.
That's good. I'll be looking forward to the results of this "shot in the arm," if you will.
Unfortunately, I'm usually in Europa, and thus can't do much about most things happening across the pond.
Still, if I can help you in any way, don't be afraid to let me know.
Then allow me to do so. We didn't come solely for the sake of academic exchange.
You see, I'm looking for collaborators on a new AI mental model training program.
The Republic of Sardegna is an excellent location. It was the least affected by the event... and it has a religious environment.
Come again? Religious environment?
...Are you going to use that to train your AI model?
It's an idea. But before I decide, I want to lay out the technological groundwork.
For now, I'm calling it "Project H." Would you be interested to learn more?

sequence:
Path of the Chosen

<size=45>7 The Apostle</size>

scripts.say: From the clouds I descend, returning from Heaven.
I walk through the city, feeling the enduring elegance and order of the world.
I walk through the streets, feeling the life force and vitality of the world.
I walk through the church, feeling the devotion and majesty of the world.
My journey is finally over.
Sardegna Ecclesia - Rome
sequence: Sardegna Ecclesia - Rome
Cathedral

scripts.say: The square was filled to the brim with people while the bright sun shone overhead.
There was no commotion as anticipated. The people gazed at the cathedral's balcony with solemn expressions, silently waiting for something.
"Someone came out!" a voice in the crowd shouted.
"Yes, I saw it... That crown, that scepter – it has to be her!" continued another voice.
"The Apostle has come!" yelled an ever-increasing number of people.
The bells throughout the city all rang in unison, and the crowd was bubbling with excitement.
The first meeting between the new Apostle and her people had finally come.
Up on that balcony, the newly-anointed Apostle opened her eyes to an expectant crowd.
...What?
...Why are all these people looking at me?
Am I... dreaming?
I'm dreaming, aren't I?
The Apostle closed her eyes, pondered for a moment, then opened them again.
The crowd was still there, just as excited as before. No, if anything, their spirits were even higher than a few seconds ago.
...I'm not dreaming.
I'm not dreaming?! What's the meaning of this?!
...The Apostle?
Who's that?
WHAT IS THIS?!

sequence: To Be Continued

Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>The Seafaring Speedster</size>

scripts.say: The deep blue sea and the bright blue sky stretch before me. While I'm admiring the scenery, I hear the rumble of an engine in the distance.
I turn to face it and see an approaching jet ski kicking up white waves.
Howdy, Commander!~
Whatcha doing? Happy to see me win the race... or did you come to catch a ride with me?
Whew... I tell ya, high-speed jet skiing on a summer day is the best thing ever!
It's aerodynamic! Lets me go faster, although it does show a ton of skin.
Why do you ask? Is it making your heart go thump-thump?
Haha, you should've just said so from the very beginning! I don't like it when people beat around the bush.
But enough about that. Hop on and I'll give you a taste of what it's like to sail the seas at breakneck speeds!
She throws me a life vest and a helmet. I put them on and take a seat behind her.
You ready to go? Then hang on tight! I'm going pedal to the metal!
Now let's catch some winds and make some waves!~！
The engine revs, followed by the jet ski's nose rising up with great force. We take off with a big wave forming behind us.
Fwa-hah! Nothing beats feeling the wind in your hair and the sea spray kickin' up all around you!
But what did you think, Commander?

options.content: "It was a bit intense for me."

scripts.say: Hell yeah it was! I love the adrenaline rush of going fast!
Ahah! C'mon, you've weathered crazier stuff than that. Like literal storms, just as one example!
Oh, right, we should start heading back. Here we go – full throttle once more!
The heck? The engine's not starting!
Don't tell me I went TOO fast and broke it...
Uh, yeah... Sorry about that. We'll just have to wait for someone to come and help us.
Until then, might as well let the waves carry us and enjoy the scenery.
If the sea won't let us go, we'll just make this part two of our little date♪~

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>Aquatic Retreat</size>

scripts.say: Light glimmers off the indoor swimming pool. Ripples form on the surface, followed by the resurfacing of a familiar figure.
Ahh... What a great day to stretch your body and swim.
Oh, didn't see you there, Commander. Predicted this is exactly where I'd be, did you?
I'm surprised you found the time of day to come, knowing how incredibly busy you are.

options.content: "What are you up to? Practicing your breaststroke?"

scripts.say: You could say that. It's half exercise, half getting out of the sun to cool off.
Plus, it's quiet here, which I like. I find it easier to relax in a place like this than at a busy seaside.
Much unlike Hornet. Knowing her, she's probably throwing a beach party by now.
Anyway... Just curious... Wanna swim with me, Commander?
We could race and see who's the fastest swimmer.
I've heard the rumors about you being a secret athlete, and I wanna see how good you are. You up for that?
I can't turn her down just like that. I get into some swimming gear and do a few laps with her...
You know, it's odd. I've never swam that effortlessly before...
Maybe it's because you're with me that it felt so easy.
Oh. Thanks.
...Phew! That hit the spot.
I'm feeling in peak condition today, so I think I'll do some more laps after a short break.
Huh?
Do I take that to mean you want to take a break with me?
Well... Sure, why not.
I feel her warmth course through me as she rests her body against mine.
Appreciate it, Commander. Let's catch our breaths for while...

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>Quiet, Solitude, and Fireworks</size>

scripts.say: Oh. Commander. I didn't think you'd find me here.
You followed the clues I left and swam over here, right? Good...
That must've been an exhausting swim. You can rest here all you want. It's just us here.

options.content: "You're alone all the way out here?"

scripts.say: Mhm. I like having quiet places to myself. You can get a clear view of the fireworks too.
What's more, nobody's going to get between us when... No, never mind. I can't tell you...
Yup. It's my special place. No one else knows about it.
But since you know about it now, that makes it our secret hideaway.
Anyway, Commander, you've made me really happy.
You're my best friend, and I wanted to share this place with you.
I hope you can stay, take it easy, and watch the fireworks with me.
While the fireworks are way over there, they still look pretty from afar.
Even more so when you're with your special someone...
Hey, are you thirsty? Have some of this. It'll energize you.
She gives me a can of soda that feels faintly warm. She must've been holding it this whole time.
I only brought one ice cream, sorry... But I have plenty of soda.
Fireworks go off in the sky across the river. Their colorful glow softly lights up her cheek.
...Will you stay with me and watch the fireworks?

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>The Bard and the Blue Sea</size>

scripts.say: We're here, Champion. You may open your eyes.
"Are we... underwater?"
I have never such wonder shimmering in your eyes before... Heehee. I'm pleased to see this other side of you.
This is a little magic trick of mine. But, it must be a novel experience for you, beholding the ocean floor and all its wondrous sights, no?
Do not be startled. The seas hold secrets far more fantastical than my magic.
Now, Champion, shall we go and seek out the ocean's secrets?
Hand in hand, we walk along the seabed. The soft white sand beneath our feet swirls like flowing water.
Rays of sunshine breach the surface, casting a golden light upon faded ruins.
I am sure they each had a story to tell long, long ago.
Alas, the waves of time have not been kind, reducing them to fragments buried among the sand.

options.content: "That's why we need songs to keep the stories alive?"
"Faded or not, the stories live on within the ruins."

scripts.say: Heehee. Yes. That way we may save those scattered pieces from being lost to time.
Preserving stories through song lets their glory live on – like these ruins – even if only through the listener's imagination.
That is true. Even if a memory is not passed on, or if pieces of it are lost... surviving artifacts can tell secrets otherwise forgotten.
Sculptures, carvings, and ornaments, even if weathered, offer a glimpse into how bygone civilizations prospered.
More pertinently... This adventure has already birthed a new tale – a tale between only you and me, Champion.
Being with you is ambrosia for the soul, Champion.
I would love to embark with you again on more adventures, away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
Brief but fantastical tales to interspace your heroic epic... I would quite like that.
And I shall chronicle them in my paean for you.
O Champion, I pray fate allows us to continue journeying together and weave even more stories.

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>Rabbit on Watch?!</size>

scripts.say: *stares bunnily*
Halt! Come over here, Commander~!
I'm just about to jump in the pool when Prinz Heinrich orders me to stop.
I hope you weren't seriously considering going into the pool just now!
Because you totally neglected to do your stretches! Don't think I didn't notice!
Going into water unprepared is dangerous, you know. You could get a leg cramp!
I have done lifeguard training, and I do know how to perform CPR, but that's no excuse not to take safety precautions.
You're not dipping one toe in water until I've seen you do your stretches. If you don't know how to, I'll show you!
C'mon, stretch those muscles! No half-assing on my watch!
A couple minutes later, I finish my warmup stretches under her watchful eye.
Alright, you're clear. Enjoy yourself in the pool!

options.content: "Aren't you going to swim with me?"

scripts.say: I will, later! I've got to finish my shift first.
It might look like I'm just sitting around, but trust me, I'm keeping my eyes on ten different things at once.
Like if everyone's done their stretches, if someone looks like they need rescuing, or if any prankster submarines are up to no good.
So sadly, I've gotta watch from the sidelines until my shift is over!
But hey, you're gonna stick around for a while, right?
It's not too much trouble to wait for me until my replacement comes in, is it?
...Awesome! Don't go back on your word later, or you'll have a very upset bunny to deal with~!

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>Water Gun Samurai</size>

scripts.say: I expected a beach resort full of laughter in the air. Instead, what I got...
Found you!
Was a faceful from Noshiro's water gun!
Looks like I win again.
What, do you think I'm taking this too seriously?
Heheh... I distinctly remember YOU telling me to have fun to my heart's content today.
Which is exactly what I'm doing. Or would you like to rescind your order?
Whew. Water gun fights really are great fun. Invigorating, too. But what do you think, Commander?

options.content: "I had a great time as well."

scripts.say: Good to hear. I want this to be relaxing for both of us.
Tired? Aww... Maybe I should've gone a little easier on you after all.
What should we do now? May I suggest a casual stroll in the sand?
The weather's not too hot, the sand is warm, and the winds are nice. Perfect conditions for a walk.
We don't have to go anywhere in particular, either. Walking for walking's sake rejuvenates the body and soul.
And I'd certainly like to get a little closer to you...
Ahem. I don't hear any objections. Shall we get going?
She starts walking in one direction, but quickly comes to a stop and turns around.。
On second thought, let's go the other way. It looks crowded over there, and I'd rather avoid running into Sakawa or Agano. They'd no doubt tease you.
Also, umm... Can we hold hands?

sequence:
Beachside Vacation Vignettes

<size=45>Bright-Sky Mermaid</size>

scripts.say: How does this pose look, Commander?
...I look nervous to you?
I don't feel nervous, I just don't know how to pose in a bikini... Give me a minute to compose myself and I'll figure it out.
...It looks good on me? Thank you. Hornet picked it for me.
She said I should be forward with you on our beach trip, and that an "equally forward swimsuit" would help with that.
When I first saw it, I thought it was far too revealing for my tastes.
But then I went to the beach and saw others wearing even more revealing swimwear. So I reconsidered. Maybe it wasn't so wrong after all, right?
Besides, I can live with wearing something a more risqué when there's no one but us around.
Whew... The wind feels lovely, but it is a bit strong...
...Hm? What's the matter, Commander?
What about it? I– Oh my goodness! The strap came loose!
My deepest apologies, Commander! I had no idea... Hold on a second!
She quickly fixes her wardrobe malfunction, but the awkwardness of it stays in the air for some time.
This backdrop you chose is very tasteful, Commander. Also, is this pose any good?
...Oh, forgive me, you must be exhausted. You poor thing.
I know you've been busy socializing with others all day and indulging their requests.
You need a well-earned break. If you'd like, you may rest your head on my lap.
No need to be shy. I've let Hammann, Enterprise, and even Hornet do the same before. It's not weird to me.~
Come now. This is the least I can offer to the person I'd give my life to protect.
Relax, close your eyes, and listen to the tranquil sounds of the wind and the sea with me~.

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>1 A Sunny Afternoon</size>

scripts.say: One afternoon at the office...
Commander, I've finished going through all the documents. There's just one problem...
Every Northern Parliament exercise participant was supposed to turn in a report, but we're still missing one.
Avrora looks a bit annoyed. I wonder if she knows whose report is missing.
Suddenly, I hear the sound of boots clopping down the hallway. Soon, a dark-haired girl wearing a Northern Parliament uniform throws the doors of the office open.
*yaaawn*... Yoohoo, Commander!
It's Pamiat' Merkuria... with dark circles under her eyes.

options.content: "Full of energy as always, I see."
"Hey. It's afternoon, if you didn't notice."

scripts.say: I'm only half sarcastic. She clearly has not gotten enough sleep, yet still acts as cheerful as ever.
Wh-what? Of course I am! Are you concerned about me or something~?
Hehehe~ Afternoon, schmaftersploon. All that matters is that I'm here!
Besides, it's morning somewhere in the world even if it's afternoon here~
...Clearly, sleep deprivation was no match for her cheekiness.
Anyway, uh, I've come to drop off some paperwork.
Let's see... Here are the records from the Northern Parliament's last battle, and here's the... Wait, where's the after-action report?
Oh right, I left it right– Eek!
Oh no!
After finding her paperwork, Pamiat' tries to do a triumphant twirl but immediately loses her balance. Fortunately, Avrora is there to catch her.
Phew, that was close! Thanks for the hand, Avrora. Anyway, I'll leave the stuff on your desk, Commander, so don't forget to look it over. I'm gonna head back to the dorm now!

options.content: "Do you need someone to escort you?"

scripts.say: Hehehe~ I'll be just fine! See ya later! ...Owww, my back...
The way she was clutching her back as she tottered out the door makes me consider sending someone to accompany her anyway...
She has always been like that. I'm more concerned about her unhealthy lifestyle though.
She got hooked on a new video game she bought the other day, and has been so absorbed in it that she hasn't been keeping up with work...
I believe it's what they call "going goblin mode."
If you think it's warranted, should we go check on her?
It definitely isn't a good idea to leave her to her own devices forever, but I also don't want to bother her if she went back to sleep.
Maybe I'll pay her a visit after dinner.

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>2 A Lifestyle In Need of Correction</size>

scripts.say: Northern Parliament Dormitory - After dinner
If I remember properly, this is where her room should be...
*knock* *knock*
Come in! The door's unlocked!

I open her door, and immediately feel like I'm stepping into a warzone. Candy bar wrappers and empty bottles of soda are strewn all over the place, and her shelves look like they haven't been organized in ages.
Pamiat' is sitting there on a big Manjuu cushion, gaming away without a care in the world.
Oh hey, Commander! Evenin'!
"...At least you still have some perception of time."
Well yeah, duh. It's dark outside!
Hey, you wanna play some co-op? This game came out just last week and it's amaaazing~
Wait, hold up, what are you doing?!
Nuooooh! I'm gonna die! Commander, waaaait!
The speakers play a meaty, stabbing sound.
After an alarmingly realistic cutscene, the phrase "YOU DIED" appears in big red letters on the center of the screen.
I seriously just died to a random monster and it's all your fault, Commander!

options.content: "Sorry, but you should take a break every now and then."

scripts.say: Hmph. I AM taking breaks! What do you think I'm doing right now?
There are a million ways to relax! Gaming is obviously one of them!
As for getting enough sleep, that was just a one-off! I, I'll work on it! Hmph...
Pamiat' being who she is, I know it takes more than a single lecture to get her to change her stubborn ways.

options.content: "One more thing: you'll be my new secretary."

scripts.say: Whaaat?! Just like that?! You've already got Avrora filling that role!
"Yes. We discussed swapping you in and she supports the idea."
While I'd love to work my butt off for you, I'd love it more if you worked YOUR butt off for me...
Hmm, you know what?
She shoves a game controller into my hands.
I'll do as you say! If you can beat me in a game, that is!
Hehehe~ Don't expect me to go easy on you~
Ten minutes later...
That doesn't count! You just got lucky! Come on, rematch! Best of three!
Another ten minutes later, Pamiat' throws herself at her cushion in defeat. Whether out of resignation or rage, no one knows.
Urgh... I was THIS close, too! This blows...
What is clear to me is that she's not quite the gamer she makes herself out to be.
Ugh... Dasvidaniya, my easygoing life...

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>3 First Day on the Job</size>

scripts.say: The sun's brilliant rays shine through the office windows.
Today is supposed to be Pamiat's first day as my secretary. Noon has rolled around, but she is still nowhere to be seen.
Hopefully nothing bad happened to her...
I was just about to call Avrora when I hear the familiar sound of boots clopping down the hallway.
Yoohoo, Commander! Morning!

options.content: "It's afternoon, if you didn't notice. Again."

scripts.say: Hehehe~ I'll be your secretary starting today!
Don't "again" me! It's not the end of the world!
I'm starting to wonder if punctuality means nothing to this girl.
Ahah! I knew it! You can't stop thinking about me after all, can you~?
It's simple, actually~ I stayed up all night playing games so I overslept!
"...At least try to make an excuse for yourself."
Why would I do that? You never said anything about a specific time I had to be in your office, so that's on you~
You can lecture me if you want, but it won't change the facts! Might as well look on the bright side – now I'm here and ready to work!
"Ugh. I was a fool for thinking you had run into trouble..."
Ahaha♪ In my defense, I had to do a ton of stuff to prepare for my new position.
I promise I won't be late again! Go easy on me this one time and I'll make myself real useful from here on out!
Great~ Let's start on this stack of documents then!
Come on, don't just sit on your butt, Commander! We've both got work to do!

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>4 A Surprising Performance</size>

scripts.say: A few days later...
Yoohoo, Commander!
I've sorted your letters and left them over there. Go get 'em!
And over here I have today's exercise papers and data, all categorized neatly!
Lastly, there's the open sea exercise report. All you need to do is read through it and then sign off on it!
And that's that. I've done pretty much everything you asked for. Way to go me, right?
It's already been several days since Pamiat' became my secretary.
Surprisingly, she picked up on the job real quick.
As they say, never judge a book by its cover. There's a reason she has such a long and rich history.
Commaaaaandeeeeer!
Hellooooo? I'm trying to talk to you here!
I got lost in thought and the next thing I know, she's up in my face. Her hair smells faintly of lavender-scented shampoo.
Oh, forget it. Just know that I want some more of that "ramen" as a reward for my hard work! Take me to a restaurant once we're done today!
At first, I tried to motivate her with rewards. While that did succeed, she's now taking full advantage of my miscalculation.
And of course – your treat, per usual, right? Hehehe~
Now chop chop, Commander! There's still tons of work to be done!

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>5 All Carrot, No Stick</size>

scripts.say: Some time later in the office...
Hehehe~ Another day's work done in a flash thanks to me!
Oof, my shoulders feel so stiff all of a sudden... C'mere for a sec, Commander~♡
Pamiat' reverts back into sloth mode the very moment she finishes all her tasks.
Though, I don't really have any ground to criticize her. She has been a huge help, and normally doesn't act this spoiled.
Right here~ Yeah, that's the spot~ I need a massage here sooo badly♪
She brazenly asks for her daily reward. This time, a massage. Because of her attitude, I decide to...
Being as gentle as one would be with a little baby, I put my hands on her slender shoulders and start massaging her gingerly.
Come ooon, put some oomph into it! My shoulders are gonna need much more than that!
Pay some respect to this little veteran and give 'em a good squeeze~
"As you wish, Ma'am."
Oooh, that's the ticket~ They feel so much better already~ Thanks, Commander!
Feeling around for the stiffest spots, I put my hands on her shoulders and dig my thumbs into her muscles with a bit of force.
Hang on– Ow, ow, ow... Actually, this feels pretty good!
This is perfect! Not too hard, not too soft!
Oooh, that hit the spot~ Appreciate it, Commander!
Wanting some catharsis, I put my hands on the cheeky brat's shoulders and start crushing the stiffness out of her.
Ow, oww, OWWWW!
You're going way too hard! This really hurts without my rigging! Owww! You're gonna break something!
...Wait, what? I think that did the trick! My shoulders feel a lot better!
Was that like, some miraculous acupressure? I didn't know you were trained in that, Commander!
My shoulders being THAT stiff is proof that I really busted my butt. In other words, I deserve a reward♪
"Come again? I just gave you a massage."
Sure, that counts as something, but I worked so hard that I deserve something more! Let's not forget an additional reward for all my efforts up 'til today!
"For the love of... What do you have in mind, then?"
Dunno, I haven't decided yet! Give me until the weekend to think about it!
Anyhow, I'm gonna call it a day! See you tomorrow!
Hmm-hm-hmm-hmm♪
Just like that, she excuses herself and leaves my office while humming a cheerful tune. I'm not sure exactly why, but I seem to be anticipating the weekend more than usual.

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>6 Casual Closeness</size>

scripts.say: Later, on the day before our day off...
I have a lot more work to get through than usual due to an overlap in exercise schedules.
Though I have already gotten a lot done, the amount of paperwork pending my review and approval is staggering.
How much, exactly? About half of my available desk space's worth.
I recline in my chair and stretch my arms. Fatigue washes over me when I realize that my rest day would not come until tomorrow – so close, yet so far.
Nevertheless, I have to keep chipping away. Just when I go to pick up my pen again, I feel something soft press down on my head.
You know, Commander, you should really practice what you preach about taking breaks~
I'm gonna sit on your lap. Can't get any work done now, can you?
...Don't give me that look. I'm tired too. All I'm doing is resting on you instead of a pillow. Nothing wrong with that, right?
Oh, and I won't take no for an answer~♪
Pamiat' is having none of my objections. She turns around and plops herself into my lap.
Her long, smooth hair drapes down right in front of me. My chest and thighs, where she's resting against me, won't stop singing praises of her softness.
You're comfier than any high-end chair I've sat on. I seriously need to do this more often, hehe~♪
Oh yeah, I haven't told you what I came up with for my reward yet, have I?
Well, someone pressured Akashi into expanding the port's amusement park not long ago, and I wanna go check it out~
Wanna go there tomorrow, just the two of us?
Of course, it wouldn't be much of a reward if I had to pay for my own ticket. You'll cover it, won't you?
She seems really keen on this idea. I feel as if I have no choice but to agree to her every whim until she's satisfied.
"Alright. We'll go to the amusement park tomorrow."

sequence:
Work Hard, Play Harder!

<size=45>7 A Fulfilling Date</size>

scripts.say: Later, at the amusement park...
Whoooa! They've got brand new attractions! I wanna go on that one, Commander!
That looks sooo yummy! Come on, buy me some of that♪
Ooh! They've got new games for sale! I've gotta buy some! Wait right here, Commander~
Hey, that arcade game looks fun! I'm gonna try it out!
For someone with a bad back, it's astonishing just how much energy she has. She just keeps going and going.
She was unbeatable in the arcade area, too. It seemed I'd way underestimated her skill as a gamer.
If she was this good all along... does that mean she threw the game back when I visited her room?
Look what I won, Commander! You can have it!
She set a new record playing the park's strength games, so they gave her a prize.
She tightly clutched her prize in her bosom before presenting it to me.
Well? Pretty nice, isn't it?
In her hands is a small snowglobe.
Inside, a lone cabin sits within a vast snowscape. Pushing the button on the globe whips up a gentle snowfall.
There's nothing elaborate about it, but it had clearly been made with attentiveness and care. And it is more than enough to convey Pamiat's hard work.
They gave me this for breaking a record! Am I the best or what~?
Heheh! Tell me more about how great I am! Bow down for bonus points if you want!
And so, our fun times at the amusement park continue...
Before long, the sun had begun to set, painting the world in a golden light.
Pamiat' skips along excitedly as we head back to the dorms.
There is a certain rhythm to the sound of her boots cheerily tapping the ground.
I trail behind her, carrying bags stuffed with about half of the things she bought and won at the amusement park.
Speaking of the amusement park, Akashi shot me an interesting look as we left. I'm sure this visit was great business for her.
Hmm-hm-hmm-hmm♪
It might've been my imagination, but I think Pamiat' just stole a glance at me...
Commander, I'm tireeed! Can we stop and take a break?
Hand on her back and forcing a weary expression, she points to a nearby bench.
Is this her way of being considerate? I suppose that's fine...

options.content: "Bear with it. We're most of the way there."

scripts.say: I sit down on the bench. She huddles up right next to me, resting her head on my shoulder in a sweet manner.
Hehehe~ You know, today made me realize that being a secretary's not so bad!
You work hard on weekdays then get to play even harder on weekends!
As long as that stays true... I don't mind staying your secretary forever, to tell you the truth.
Just don't expect me to work for free, and don't make me do overtime♪
Deal? Great~ Then I've got something to give you.
That snowglobe was just a little token of appreciation for your hard work – what you're about to get is your reward for giving me a great time today.
Shh, don't argue, just close your eyes for a sec.
She's awfully insistent about it, so I close my eyes just as asked.
A moment later, I feel a warm, moist sensation brush up against my cheek.
There you go! That was your reward!
...Oh come on! Can't you take a hint?
I was gonna give you a reward, but I guess you don't want it~
Since you're just so hopelessly dense, you leave me no choice but to punish you!
Shh, don't argue, just close your eyes for a sec.
She's awfully insistent about it, so I close my eyes just as asked.
Umm... You'll have to lean forward just a bit!
There, that's perfect. Okay, get ready for your punishment~
A moment later, I feel a warm, moist sensation brush up against my cheek.
There you go! That was your reward!
That's that, now let's move on!
Oh, one more thing – next time you visit me, gimme a call before you come in, 'kay~?

sequence: <size=51>I've always been alone.</size>
<size=51>Laughing alone. Crying alone.</size>
<size=51>Sailing alone. Fighting alone.</size>
<size=51>Everything, I've borne alone.</size>
<size=51>But lonely? No. That was my undisputed reality.</size>

One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 1: Her Wish</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
It's been a while since I first arrived in port. I'm steadily becoming accustomed to my life as a secretary.
From commissions to exercises, battles, and even daily greetings, my daily routine is starting to take shape.
Having once been nothing more than a ship, being able to share my joys, sorrows, and worries with others – and have them taken seriously – is quite the new experience...
The warmth of interacting with people...
It seems I got hooked on this pleasant feeling before I even realized it.
Is this really a good thing?
Oh.
Commander, I apologize. I was lost in thought for a second... Do you have any orders for me?
You don't? I see... Seems like there's not much to do today...
What do I want to do...?
I mean, yes, I'm not doing anything at the moment, and that's not a strange question, but...
I–
For whatever reason, I'm unable to answer.
What do I really want to do?
As of now... nothing in particular. As long as you let me stay here, I'm content.
"What I want to do"... What exactly could that mean?

sequence: <size=51>"Basically, just share your thoughts!"</size>
<size=51>"Talk about things you like, or things that worry you. Just let it all out."</size>
<size=51>"Once you do, you'll feel less lonely!"</size>

One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Chance Encounter</size>

scripts.say: Port
A refreshing breeze blows. It's a great day for a walk.
*munch* *munch*
What the Commander said... "What I want to do"...
"Eating snacks and relaxing"... isn't quite it.
Hm... These bonito flakes are pretty tasty.
Meow!
...A cat?
It was a regular cat, not a meowfficer.
Meow~
Do you want some of this?
Mreow?
Okay. Here you go.
Meow~
Hm... Seeing the cat happily munching on the snacks feels pretty soothing.
Good kitty~ *pat pat*
Spee? What are you doing over there?
Myeow!
Ah, it ran away...
Oh, so it was just a cat.
Look, you scared the kitty away.
Hmph. Who cares about some lowly animal like that.
Hehe. Do you want some of this?
Seriously? That's a snack for children, I'd never–
...Ahem. Thanks, but I'd rather pass.
Anyway, listen, Spee! You won't believe what those Royal Navy baboons did during yesterday's exercise...
I wound up having to listen to Deutschland's complaints all the way back to the dorm.
I wonder if the kitty's okay...

sequence: <size=51>"If you had allies who'd sortie with you and watch your back..."</size>
<size=51>"If they'd make merry together with you at celebratory banquets after a victory..."</size>
<size=51>"If they'd comfort you at review meetings after a loss..."</size>
<size=51>"Then I'm certain that you'd feel lonely much less often."</size>

One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 3: Comrades in Arms</size>

scripts.say: Port - Exercise Area
Let's end here for today.
Say again? We're done already? But my main guns are only just starting to heat up!
It's great that you're this motivated, but it's past the time we're allowed to use the exercise area... Surely you're not planning on having your way while messing up the Commander's plans, are you?
I believe that the secretary, Spee, is aware of this as well.
Yep. To be honest, I wanted to battle a little more too, but let's wrap it up here for today.
What a waste, I'm in top condition today... We should've booked a longer pass.
By the way, I do joint exercises with the Scharnhorst sisters every week.
Not only that, but we cover each other during real battles as well.
...Alright.
Maybe my battle buddies would know what the Commander really meant by "what you want to do."
Scharnhorst or Gneisenau, who would be better to ask...
What I want to do?
Would you be surprised if I told you I wanna get stronger and defeat even fiercer enemies?
Never step down, no matter who you're dealing with – that's my style.
Yep. That's definitely something you'd say.
"What I want to do"... That's a good question.
At present, my goals are to be of assistance to the Commander, and to keep my reckless sister in check.
That's definitely an answer I'd expect from you.
Since you asked, Spee, what do you want to do? Do you have any dreams?
I... There's nothing in particular that I want to do. As long as I'm allowed to stay here...
Yeah... As long as I'm surrounded by people I know and not all alone, like back then, I'll be fine...
Why did I end up remembering that time?

sequence: <size=51>"Someone who really understands you."</size>
<size=51>"And I don't just mean someone who listens to what you say."</size>
<size=51>"But rather, someone who can guess what you're really thinking."</size>
<size=51>"With someone like that around, you would never truly feel lonely, would you? Hehehe."</size>

One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 4: Allies</size>

scripts.say: Port
Oh, if it isn't Spee.
Heya, Eug– Ahem... Hello, Eugen. What are you up to?
Hm? As you can see, I'm taking a break.
Isn't it nice to just sit back and relax from time to time?
"What I want to do"... It might be a good idea to ask Eugen what the Commander meant.
What I want to do?
Hehehe. Right now, nothing in particular, really?
You don't?
Honestly, I'm satisfied with the status quo. Ah, but if you'd like, I could look for something to do. It seems like it could be fun.
...Me aside, what about you, Spee?
I–
"Nothing in particular. I'm content with just being here with everyone," right?
Huh?!
Eugen said exactly what I was thinking at that moment.
Eugen... How'd you...?
I can tell just by looking at your face.
My... face...?
You're not the first person I've met who's like that, and you probably won't be the last, either.
People like you, well... The moment you find out there are more things to life besides fighting, you end up not knowing what you want to do.
End up... not knowing what I want to do...
Then... how do I find things I enjoy doing?
Beats me. I'm not you, so there's no way I'd know what your true dreams are.
My... true dreams...
Hehe, you're so innocent.
Don't worry too much. Everyone in the Iron Blood and even the Commander can probably help you out.
Just like they did for me, once...

sequence: <size=51>Those who stay by my side.</size>
<size=51>Those who fight together with me.</size>
<size=51>Those who understand what I'm thinking.</size>
<size=51>If I were to lose those people...</size>
<size=51>Would I still be myself...?</size>

One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 5: Loneliness</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dormitory
I had a nightmare.
When I woke up, there was nobody around me...
Mm... It's already this late...?
Since it's our day off and it's late at night, it makes sense nobody would be here.
Let's laze around in bed and check that smartphone which I recently learned to use.
With this, I'll be able to tell how everyone else is doing even if they're not by my side.
"Javelin's gonna go make another boxed lunch today!"
Javelin... She's quite the lively one.
"The dazzling early summer sun rises, but is it not a pearlescent solar eclipse?"
Viersechs... I wish she would just talk like normal...
"May everyone at port be blessed with the gods' protection."
Fusou's so nice and caring...
I feel like I've gotten to know people better ever since I learned how to use this device.
Looks like... I can stay in touch with people this way too.
Of course, I already get along well with everyone just fine, even without relying on this, but...
It felt like I was the only one not hanging out online.
Let's see, this message is from... Deutschland?
It says to come to the office... Is there something important to talk about?
No, it might be a combat mission...
For some reason, thinking that it might be a mission gets me all excited.
Maybe the battlefield is what suits me best...

sequence:
One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 6: Weight</size>

scripts.say: You've finally arrived, my sister.
As it turns out, Deutschland is here too.
Maybe there's a mission so troublesome it requires both armored cruiser sisters...
Spee, listen carefully. I've got something important to tell you.
I can see indignation on my sister's face, and on the Commander's too.
Have the Sirens caused trouble again...?
If that's the case, there's only one thing to do.
Argh! How dare you make a fool of the great Deutschland!
I'll reduce them to tiny shreds for Deutschland's sake.
I won't turn a blind eye to injuring someone important to me.
That's why I fight. To protect the place where I belong.
...That's my desire. My dream. What I want to do. This is the only thing I...
Spee? Why are you saying such disturbing things all of a sudden?
Huh...? This isn't about Sirens?
Of course it isn't! Lowly animals the likes of the Sirens can only hope to make a fool of me in their wildest dreams!
This is about that lowly animal slave of mine! The one who claims to have picked out cuter clothes for you than what I chose!
Your insolence knows no bounds, lowly animal! My fashion sense is leagues and bounds ahead of yours!
Th-that's what this is about?!
Indeed, there are two sets of clothing laid on the sofa.
Though I never would've thought they were meant for me...
Yes. My sister, take a look at the clothes that I've chosen for you, and compare them to the ones this lowly animal dug up!
Prove to this imbecile that nobody knows what suits my sister better than I do!
I'm sorry. I'm all rigged up...
Then just take it off! Gosh, why do you always wear that massive, unwieldy rigging?
Take a leaf out of my book! To project power, you must first present yourself the right way!
B-but...
These hands are for fighting with. That's all I'm good for...
Geez! Spee, why do you have to fasten the screws so tightly...! Hey, lowly animal, come and help out too!
"These hands, stained with gunpowder and blood, will not be allowed to embrace peace..."
Who was in their right to decide that?
With a loud clank, the equipment around my hands comes off.

sequence:
One Little Incident

<size=45>Chapter 7: Warmth</size>

scripts.say: Hahahaha! Gaze upon my sister's cuteness!
D-Deutschland...
Hah, I think it's already been settled, but if you want to be put to further shame, we can show her what you chose!
W-well... This is quite a good find, for a lowly animal...
No matter, though! M-my selection will win out in the end!
Now, Spee! Make your choice!
Decide which one is better!
Truthfully, I'm so confused by this that I can't even see how I look in the mirror very clearly.
But even if I could, there's no way I could make a sound call on which one looks better.
What am I supposed to do here...?
"Don't overthink it, just answer honestly"...?
The Commander walked over and whispered that into my ear, then went back to Deutschland.
Hey, you lowly animal! What are you whispering to her for?! You're not allowed to influence her decision!
Spee, just pick the one you like! I believe in you!
...Heh... hehehehe.
S-Spee? What's the matter?
I swear, slave! If you whispered something to her that made her cry, I'm going to feed you to the sharks!
That's not it, Deutschland. I just realized the Commander didn't choose these clothes, because they're the same ones Ajax talked about the other day..
That's right. There wasn't an ounce of unease inside me to begin with.
Who would've thought my minor concern could be solved this easily?
Just with the help of my allies, friends, and people who are precious to me. This port and this fleet are where I belong.
Is it okay to say that I like both equally?
*sigh*... I predicted you might say that.
That's fine. This all boils down to a silly ego battle with this lowly animal anyway. If that's what you say, then it's fine.
However! I'm only allowing this in deference to Spee! One day, I will prove that the great Deutschland's fashion sense is better than yours, slave!
The Commander. The bully, Ajax. My sisters in the Deutschland class. My friends in the Iron Blood, and in the fleet...
Even if I fight to protect them, that doesn't mean fighting is all there is to it.
Because my dream, my desire, is to always be here, with everyone I hold dear...!
Port - Office
It's the early hours of the morning, and Akashi has told me she has something important to discuss.
Good morning, nya. Good news, nya!
I have a new proposal for you – the Dorm Extension Project, nya!
I see. Is this the "important" thing you had to discuss?
Sure is, nya! The port has grown over the years, and we ought to build new homes to accommodate everyone, nya!
Conveniently, there was a disused factory that Ingraham demolished a while ago, nya. That has cleared up plenty of space, nya.
Wait, you're going to construct new buildings? I thought this was limited in scope to a renovation.
No, we're building from the ground up, nya. It's more profitable, nya.
(She's not even trying to hide her intentions.)
My vision is to create a place where shipgirls can be more comfortable than ever and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life, nya.
Combat and work both take a toll, nya. With a place to better rest and recover, they'll perform better than ever before, nya!
You have to agree it's a pretty good idea, nya.
Can't deny that. It'll help them work and fight with renewed vigor.
Exactly, nya. That's why each home should also be decorated to suit the occupant, nya.
Each room is going to be tailor-made according to the inhabitant's tastes, nya!
So basically, occupants can move in without packing their bags or anything.
That's precisely what I'm thinking, nya.
Oh, also – while this project is designed first and foremost for the shipgirls...
We CAN also build a private space exclusively for you if you want, nya.
Hmm. I'll think about it.
For now, proceed with just this plan. Incidentally, when will the construction start?
It can start right away, nya! Although, there's a catch, nya.
Given the port's resource stockpiles and technology, finishing the actual construction won't take very long...
But, relocating everyone at once isn't feasible, nya.
How come?
Designing and furnishing a home takes time, nya. Everyone could move in at the same time if we were making cookie-cutter homes, nya.
But we aren't, nya! I've already promised to provide every person with a unique residence, nya!
So, the girls will just have to wait for their turn and move in one at a time, nya.
Not ideal, but I suppose that's how it is.
Since we're doing it this way, it's important to decide who's moving in first. She'll provide valuable feedback on how it feels to live in this new dorm.
I've already picked someone, nya! One of the Royal Maids, nya.
(A Royal Maid? That's probably Belfast. She's the perfect candidate for a test run of the project.)
The office door opens, and a familiar face walks in.
Good afternoon, my honourable Master.
As your humble servant, I am truly honoured to be the first resident of the new dormitory.
There she is, nya. The blueprints for her personalized place are already done, so all you need to do is sign this, nya!

options.content: Well, since you've already made up your mind...

scripts.say: After mulling it over for just a moment, I put my signature on the documents.
I shall perform my duty with grace and live up to your expectations, my honourable Master!
One month later, in the office...
Commander, nya! The construction on the dorm extension is done and Sirius' room has been furnished, nya!
Naturally, the homes are all built with safe materials with no trace of formaldehyde or other harmful substances, nya. It's all up to standards, nya!
I... see... Hey, where's Sirius?
In her new home, waiting for you, nya! Go and speak to her, nya!
So you're the new Commander? I'm surprised that you were able to find my coordinates so fast!
But it would be a shame if this exercise had never started.
Let me, the great Hornet, test your strength. Don't worry, we'll both be firing blanks!
Don't worry, I won't hurt you too badly!
Commander, air support preparation is underway. Buy us time and delay Hornet's attacks until its complete!
Aya! A diversion. I was too careless! All these new Commanders are monsters!
*Heehee* Hornet, you were just focusing on your attacks! We managed to find an opportunity.
Hornet lost, but just this once! My two sisters are even more powerful than me. Test yourself against them in the future if you dare!
Sadly, my sisters are out on a mission. It's a pity that you can't meet each other today!
Attention all crew, attention all crew! The main harbor is under attack. It's an airstrike! All hands on deck! This is not a drill!
Repeat. All hands on deck! This is not a drill!
What's going on? The harbor is under attack? Could it be the Sirens?
It's unclear. We received a telegram requesting us to return to harbor at once. This doesn't look like it's going to end well.
It's time that we part ways. Remember, we'll use live ammo next time! No more drills for you, Commander.
For the Eagles! For freedom!
Enemy flagship at starboard! Analyzing ship model... Unknown!
... Open fire.
Enemy flagship has opened fire! Counterattack now!
Harbor perimeter defense established! It's a shame that they managed to escape...
From their gear, I'd wager that the warship was used as cover for their fleet. There may be an even bigger division assembling in the distance...
HQ has ordered us to give chase. Hopefully we have enough ammo... *cries*
Invaders! You have intruded into our territory! State your identities and disarm!
Hehe, funny, funny! I won't let you get one step closer to master. All guns, fire!
Our reconnaissance planes have discovered the coordinates of the invading forces. HQ has ordered us to investigate immediately!
There's no time to waste. It'll get dark if we wait any longer, Commander!
Hostile enemy flagship ahead!
Hehehe, another group of bugs to squash. I'm surprised you managed to find your way here.
They managed to break through our outter defences... This is not going according to plan.
Our main objective has already been completed. All that remains is for us to play with these bugs... hehehe...
Sakura First Carrier Division, Akagi!
Sakura First Carrier Division, Kaga!
<size=45>Forward!</size>
Our objective has been completed. Call off the third wave of airstrikes. All ships, retreat!
Call off the airstrikes? But, if we don't finish them off now...
Listen, bugs! This is the will of the gods!
Today, the Sakura Empire officially joined forces with the Crimson Axis. We will deliver divine punishment upon the heretics!
The future belongs to the strong. We will take our rightful place as divine masters of the oceans! Hehehe!
You, Commander. I'm sure we will meet each other in battle again.

sequence: Not long ago, in a western sea...

scripts.say: Radio silence protocols have been lifted. Urgent call from Enterprise to Hornet!
Hornet here~! Go ahead!
We've been found out. Should we continue our mission?
Coordinates were just a little off... but I think we can still do it!
Very good. Immediately destroy the enemy's patrol ship! All convoys, continue to protect Hornet! The mission will continue.
It's finally time for me, Hornet, to show my stuff!
Of course. Only you would be able to complete such a risky mission! Haha!
Fight! Fight for our fallen sisters! Fight for the land and sea burned by the war!
This attack is filled with anguish and fury. Now is when we make our stand!
For the Eagles! For freedom!
B-25 Doolittle Squadron, attack!
I... I got overexcited... What a mistake...
Oh my, how many times does this make now? Haven't these dullards learnt by now that their flying pieces of scrap metal are no match for our Zeros?
It looks like AF's enemies are capable of nothing more than scrabbling desperately at our feet. Hurry and prepare to launch our next wave of attacks on the island.
Akagi, I think we still have to keep track of the movement of enemy aircraft. It would be prudent to leave enough fighters on reserve...
What is there to fear? Tone's recon planes haven't found any of these "carriers." Perhaps they turned tail and ran at the sight of our mighty fleet?
After all, "they" are behind us, observing our glorious battle... ahaha!
Are we ready yet?! The enemy's counterattack is incoming!
...1st and 2nd Carrier Divisions, load your planes with torpedoes. Prepare for anti-ship combat!
What?! Change equipment right now?!
Akagi, I can't do that! What if the enemy attacks while we're unprepared?!
We need to be ready for when the enemy fleet appears!
Multiple enemy aircraft approaching at an altitude of 2000m, bearing 235°!
They're coming from behind?!
Dammit! Call back the fighters! We need anti-air now!
Too late! McClusky squadron, attaaack!!
Graaaaghhh!
Kaga! Kagaaaaaaaaaa!
To let my guard down... at such a critical time...
...Akagi... Sister...
Some things in this world can only be described as divine providence...
What seemed to be a haphazard, throwaway attack would forever split open the annals of history.
Nobody could have known that this moment was the single crux upon which the world would shift.
This moment, when strength, luck, and even the whimsical hand of fate all seemed to blur together and coalesce...
... would become known as...
"The Five Minutes of Fate."
Bastards!! What have you done to Kaga!!
Hard starboard! Evade the enemy attacks, and call back all the Zeros this instant!
In the end, the vast ocean is but a playground...
So this time, I'll admit defeat...
To think that we could be outwitted by such an ragtag, antiquated bunch... as expected of the Commander that I chose...
Ahhh... what a pity that I swore fealty to "Them..." Otherwise... Commander, I'd like to thorougly bully you a bit~
Perhaps one day... I can escape... this fate...
I see... So this is where I meet my end...
Hiryuu... I leave the rest to you...
So, the First Carrier Division and my sister have already...
But I can't let it end like this... All squadrons, attack!!
I'll show you what the Second Carrier Division is made of! This is our final counterattack!
I'll put every last ounce of my remaining strength... into this single attack!
Aaaagh!!
Yorktown!!
At least... I was able to slightly salvage the situation... for "Their" sake...
I can die without any regrets...
Why are you two crying at a time like this? We just won a decisive battle.
Soon, the whole world will remember your names. You will become legendary warships, and people will sing your praises for generations.
And soon, the war will end as well. Humanity will understand each other better then, and reclaim these seas together...
And for us, who were born to realize their ideals, this is a fitting end.
No... I won't accept this!
Looks like... it's about time for us to part ways...
Watching the two of you grow from immature children into the aces of the Navy... has been my pride and joy...
Finally... I entrust my dear friend to you...
Take him with you... and spread the spirit of freedom throughout this world...
I'm sure you two will be able to do it... my beloved sisters...
Once again, so many souls are dispersing...
You saw it too? This dazzling brilliance...
This form of "evolution..." How beautiful! How sad!
It is time then, to move our "plan" forward as well...
Unknown enemy planes ahead, no fleet detected nearby!
Damn, we have been discovered, is there a submarine in the area?
It's ok, those bombers are no match for our battleships, keep advancing, ready all anti-aircraft guns!
It's rumored that the Army Air Corps just discovered a big catch, the Royal Navy is currently out of port.
Hmmmm, after traveling halfway across the world, they finally started their attack. Let's stir things up then.
On my command! Full-speed south! Let's intercept the Z-fleet.
Another wave of torpedoes incoming, emergency maneuvers!
Ahh... damn, the situation wouldn't be so dire if the Indomitable didn't strike that rock...
Is this the end of the line...? Didn't realize a swarm of aircraft is so hard to deal with.
Haw-haw, these big guns can no longer keep up with the times… I really want to shower the enemy with a volley... but...
My sister ship Hood, I really miss the time when we traveled around the world...
If I were to face the same situation again, what would I do if I were you...Admiral Hood...
Very well.
At least this time... I'll face the enemy head on...
For the Queen!
Ahhaha~ She’s like a steel giant, so fragile while under torpedo attack. What a pity.
Our credit was stolen by the Army Air Corps, which was not expected. It seems we need to play smarter in the future.
Well, at this point, the sisters of the First, Second, and Fifth fleets should have started their attack on the other side of the ocean.
Hehehe, interesting, seems the world will soon become a livelier reality.
Wait and see. A new era is about to begin.
Due to fuel shortage and unavoidable damages, the chase has become troublesome for Choukai… the submarines are facing the same problem...
That's why I...
Nothing would change. Even if the entire fleet went into action, we won't achieve any great victory at our current speed.
I know! But...
Yes, yes, I know the truth can be hard to accept. Just let the Air Forces deal with it this time. When the final battle comes, the stage will be ours.
Enough! You are always so persuasive...
Sigh! This airstrike power was unexpected... Was there something wrong with our intelligence?
Wales, what now? We can't hold on if this keeps on going!
These sneaky ants really got us this time... Was it because of my arrogance... Or is this the end of an era for battleships?
Repulse, Vampire, Electra, Express, I'm sorry...
It’s alright. You’ve done your best.
Stop being so negative! We still have a chance!
That's right. Cheer up, everyone! We are not done yet!
Sorry, Wales. I...
Repulse! How am I going to face Hood and Renown!...and Vampire! I'll take it from here, go save Repulse!
Copy that, Wales. Good luck...
I was given a lecture... Hood. This was all due to my arrogance.
Has this era really changed? Haha, interesting...!
Sakura Empire, I have to admit, the victory is yours. Well done. I apologize for not taking you seriously.
But the Royal Navy will never be defeated! Even if Repulse and I were defeated, my sisters will bring you to justice! Prior to this inevitability, I’ll allow your arrogant laughter towards us.
...For the Queen --- for glory!!
What have I told you, Takao? Even the Royal Navy's heavy armor is so fragile from Air Corps bombardment. I feel so helpless for them...
I hate to admit it though... they really did a good job. Indeed, I underestimated the strength of our Air Corps.
No worries. They got the credit, for now. But as long as the high ranks still care about the "final battle", our ranks are untouchable.
Right. Then let us wait for our chance to come.
With help from our Air Corps, the Z-Fleet was destroyed... It looks like the world is going to tremble——
Let me witness….the dawn of a new era...
Using the "log" retained in the DATA to simulate the war... just a simulation after all.
War, conflict, hatred, exactly what is created by such matters?
"Next time"... do not let us down...
Gaaagghhh! How dare you lowly animal slaves... do this to me?!
I'd rather sink than surrender to lowly animals like you!
The Gambit... It's failed 255 times now. Is this really all the evolution the Natural Calculation System is capable of?
But it's much faster than I originally estimated! Humans... or rather, "natural evolution", takes a long time~

However, this won't satisfy the Judge. We need more Pieces... 
Just as long as we don't dispatch the Mirror Images we created...
It's fine. They will operate exactly as they were taught... no, made to do.
My production speed can meet all experiment demands as long as we have the backup of the Original.
If that's the case then I guess I need not worry. However...
I want White to be just an illusion this time...
Huh? You're supposed to be the new White? You look weak as hell.

But you somehow beat Deut... I mean, Lützow... Whatever, in short you guys beat that tomboy charging into battle, yelling how she's "the world's greatest armored ship", right? Actually, don't answer, it's written all over your faces!
I don't have any sympathy for that moron, but I can't just let her give you the wrong impression of Iron blood's might either!
I, Admiral Hipper, the world's greatest heavy cruiser, will finish you off in the blink of an eye!
*Sigh*... They let White come through. They always do. You can't entrust them with anything.
You have a 31.75% chance of victory according to my simulations. But in a real battle... who knows?
I am Gneisenau, Scharnhorst-class battlecruiser number two. I will assess your combat potential.
The data in my simulation was wrong... You are a force to be reckoned with, indeed...
But if I can join forces with my sister, our chances of winning will increase to above 80%...
...It is time for me to make a tactical retreat.
What's the matter?
Every move White has made so far is different from the last time...
I see. Perhaps that's what the Judge is hoping for.

I've been thinking about something... What if we're just meant to be...
mere stepping stones for White to "evolve"...
The Sirens gave us our powers... And what if this is all part of their plan...
Stop... Your ego will crumble if you keep thinking like that. Don't make her sacrifices for Iron blood all in vain...
...Never mind. She was a dreamer, just like you are. Hmph, what a fool she was, losing herself to her idealistic delusions...

sequence: And yet, she was the one who paved the way towards a different future for our kind in this world...

scripts.say: This dream again... The Scandinavian snow, the fierce and raging wind... and the echoing roars from the engines of countless fighter planes...
An explosion, followed by flooding... then the eternal darkness at the bottom of the sea...
Is that you?
You're Tirpitz... You're my sister...
Who are you...?
...I'm sorry... Please forgive me...
My sister... Bismarck? No, that's impossible... I don't remember you... You shouldn't exist in my memory...
I'm sorry... I did what I had to for the sake of Iron blood... I just want you to understand that...
Agh... My head hurts... It's coming back... This overpowering sense of loneliness...

sequence: ...Who... am I..?
...Just who am I... really...?

scripts.say: ...Another interesting Piece has joined the fray.
So you broke through all of our defenses? I see. A brilliant opponent, and a brilliant name... You've piqued my interest.
I am the Z-Class destroyer Z46. I lack a real name to introduce myself with, though... Now let us fight, my brilliant opponents. Join me for a game of chess!
...The end... My lack of combat experience was my downfall, I see. I should have better demonstrated my planned anti-air superiority.
Nonetheless... I never thought this world could be so different from what I expected! It's fascinating!
The next time we meet... Will you play with me... once more?
So this is the beautiful afterglow of a life being thrown away...
...I see. The existence of you pitiable Pieces worthy of annihilation is precisely what, for the first time ever, gives true meaning to my temporal life and to this war...
I am the aircraft carrier Graf Zeppelin. My Iron blood Hellwings shall rain apocalyptic destruction down on you from the heavens!
So my incomplete form really was no match for you...
Hmph... So it is. Another opportunity to slowly witness my own destruction...
Ultimately, my army was no more than just another Piece... Oh, how ironic... Ahahahahah!

sequence: ...It was not meant to be like this...
In order to become strong enough to protect Iron blood, to protect my allies,
I made so many sacrifices, annihilated so many enemies, just following "orders."
I tolerated becoming a Piece for our detestable enemies,「<Piece>」…
Akagi... Just what are you planning out there?

scripts.say: ...This battle... is utterly meaningless.
And yet you still wish to proceed? So be it... I shall see how resolute you really are.
If you've come this far, that can only mean one thing... I hate to admit it, but you might be just a little different from those we've fought so far.
But we've never fought anyone that could escape from our mighty guns. You are no exception!
I collected a lot of data during our last battle. This time our chances of winning are over 90%.
Listen up, you fools standing before the Shark Sisters! This is where our hunt begins! And don't you dare disappoint me!
Scharnhorst-class battlecruisers Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, ready for battle! Come and face your doom!
So you were the ones chosen by the Creator. I have no choice but to acknowledge the gap in power between us.
I now finally understand what my dreams mean. That there is a real world that lies beyond this mirrored one...
And in that real world, there is another me who is fighting for Iron blood...
Hahah... "Fight for your hopes and beliefs"... That's what I've always been unable to do in this world...
If you happen to meet me again... could you tell me something? ...That "I want you to fight proudly till the very end"...

sequence:
Farewell, 
the other "me" beyond the mirror that I will never meet...

scripts.say: At long last we meet, the Creator's dear little chosen ones~!
My, look at your eyes... In the eyes of that girl who asked us for power we saw only worries over the future, disappointment, and regret...
But you girls are different. It has nothing to do with nations, ideals, or memories, but your bonds with humans...
And that element you have is something indispensable for the evolution that we desire...
However, we must know if that element is the real deal or not... And that's what I, Tester Beta, was created to find out!
Now let the experiment begin!
GAMBIT SEQUENCE INITIATED. COMMENCE IMMEDIATE DISPOSAL OF THE BACKUP OF THE ORIGINAL.
GAMBIT SEQUENCE INITIATED. COMMENCE IMMEDIATE DISPOSAL OF THE BACKUP OF THE ORIGINAL.
GAMBIT SEQUENCE INITIATED. COMMENCE IMMEDIATE DISPOSAL OF THE BACKUP OF THE ORIGINAL.
Ahahahahaha! This is checkmate for you!
This is amazing! You've gone way beyond the Natural Calculation System's wildest estimates... Humans are amazing creatures!
At this evolutionary speed, if we repeat the Returning War... no, the Planned War, over and over, one day we'll finally have what we need...!
The Judge thinks very highly of your achievements! ...Thanks to you, even a subsystem like me was able to fulfill her duty~!
Now go! Continue down the paTH you beLIEve in to ITs final DESTINatIon!

sequence: "Oh, mY dEAr CreatOr..."
"PlEAse tell mE wE'lL meeT agaIn sOMeDay..."

scripts.say: Multiple Pawns have been Awakened at the same time, which makes the experiment a huge success.
But what are you gonna do about the situation? If they steal the backup of the Original then it'll disrupt the war on the outside.
As long as the quarantine mechanism is in place, they can't leave the Mirror Sea.
In any case, White's evolutionary rate has drastically surpassed what the Natural Calculation System's simulations estimated.
Now that we know that, we've achieved our goal.
Which means you're...
As a Tester, a living module within the debugging system, I plan to gather as much data for adjustments as possible.
I will confirm if they're offering their souls as a sacrifice or if they're hoping to checkmate us~
...Arrived at the objective.
No signs of the enemy. Cancelling high alert status. Ascending to periscope depth and entering snorkel navigation mode.
Guess it's just like the intel said. The wind doesn't blow out here.
Feels like the pressure's way higher than on the outside too... This doesn't feel right...
Let's just finish the mission and head back...
Hold up. A target is approaching. Judging by the identification signal, they're... allied?
There's no way we'd have allied vessels out here... Maybe your sonar's broken?
...Wait, no. I'm receiving their signal too...
Submerge and prepare for trouble. Remember what the commander said about not trusting anything out on the Mirror Sea.
True... We should just stay underwater and gather intel...
Stealth mission time... Too easy.
Did you record all that?
Yeah... I don't know how this fleet managed to appear again when it doesn't exist anymore... The situation is even worse than I thought.
Why, hello. I thought you 2 were bugs in our system, but you're no bugs, you're just little fish.
They found us... She never even showed up on my sonar...
We might be in trouble here... Submerge at max speed!
I can't just let you leave now that you've come this far.~
So what do you say about becoming my new Pawns? I could turn you into a new species so we can gather more fascinating data.
We need to get this intel to the commander...!
U-47, go on without me... The enemy shouldn't be able to follow us down to our maximum depth...
You're faster than me anyway. I'll try to buy you some time.
...Okay. I wish you good luck.
Well, look at that. Our data was right; you sure are good at running away. Hahah~!
Now, how do you plan to get out of this one, little Miss. Left Behind?
...I used to be called an unlucky sub... and up until now I thought that was true...
But now... it isn't anymore!
My sisters, give me courage...!
你们是……重樱不是也在准备七夕……？为什么{namecode:91}小姐和{namecode:92}小姐……会在这种地方……
我感觉到了害虫们的计划…啊啊～竟然想用巧克力去诱惑我心爱的指挥官～不可原谅，不可原谅啊！就让我{namecode:91}来为指挥官“驱除虫害”吧！
嗯……{namecode:91}小姐……今天也是状态绝佳呢……
偶尔像这样热闹一下也不错呢，呵呵……那么，大家一起快快乐乐地打一场吧～？
……加、{namecode:92}小姐……
可、可恶，难道是我爱的力量不够吗……
已经被爱冲昏头了吧……{namecode:91}……不过，还是要夸你干得不错……对强者就应该奉上敬意，下次再来一起“玩”吧，嘻嘻
哼，反正这些外国人就算做了巧克力也只会让指挥官一头雾水而已，到最后还是只有我{namecode:91}的祈愿会得到聆听，这次就先放过你好了，呵呵呵呵呵呵…
嗯…？刚才莫名的高扬感消失了…罢了…大概是尽情活动过心情畅快了吧
??……算了，继续寻找{namecode:89}小姐说的那个吧……
哎呀，连黑暗界前辈都来参了一脚吗，{namecode:89}女士还真是手段高超呢……
我们怎么也算是平辈吧，胡德小姐……
不妨先把你的“小姐”去了如何？
这个是习惯了……
咳咳，虽然我不介意开个茶会聊聊天，不过胡德，别忘了我们的目的
说的也是。那么，茶会就留到巧克力之后吧，为了友人的愿望，身为淑女，即使跨越sis萨拉和罗德尼的尸体，也要达成这个目的
那两位还很精神呢……
以及，虽然只是题外话，身为淑女，我胡德对于巧克力并没有特别的兴趣哦？只是淑女兴致使然的助人为乐罢了
真敢说呢……
愿荣耀存于这场战斗，全舰，开火！
……感觉胡德也不大对劲了
想不到会败在这里……咕……对不起，指挥官，胡德可能……
胡德小……胡德，我以前怎么不知道你是这么幽默的人……
哎呀，适当的幽默是淑女理应掌握的让生活充满乐趣的技巧哦？
……虽然很有道理……但总觉得很不想承认……
去吧……黑暗界，我们原本就是在追赶我们宿命的对手途中
「不幸啊，尊贵的皇家竟要败于铁血」
「便是因为先后出发的差距——」
「可憎啊，先来的要被后来者超越」
「或者因为听信了同僚的谗言——」
所以带上皇家的荣耀
与这颗向往巧克力的心
超越铁血，取得最后的胜利吧！
哦，哦……
嘿，是皇家的小不点吗，没想到最后站到我们面前的是你啊，今天没带着僵尸妹妹嘛～
嗯，你们好……虽然可能……只是我的错觉……你们……并不是是乐于制作巧克力的类型吧……？
你的直觉并没有错，不愧是黑暗界小姐。{namecode:428}和{namecode:461}倒是充满斗志的样子，虽然我觉得{namecode:461}只是单纯的想吃而已……我们会在这里与其说是对巧克力有所执着，倒不如说是单纯地对这场竞争有兴趣，尤其是姐姐……
我听到了战争之神的呼唤！他在我的脑海里高喊着“战斗吧！战斗吧！战斗吧！”，哇哈哈哈哈，来吧，让我们尽情大闹一场吧！
如你所见……
……有种少女心和节日的心情都被颠覆了的感觉……这也算符合你们的风格了吧……
哼，那就废话少说，来吧！
咕，干得漂亮，但我是不会逃的！
不……也没要你逃跑就是了……
姐姐，我建议你不要老是把逃跑挂在嘴边，这样会显得很欲盖弥彰的……
可是我真的不想跑啊，明明是上面的人不懂战斗，打仗就是靠一口气，却怪我……
好了姐姐，不要老是在意这种事，不是还有我理解你吗？
格、格奈……
……好像没有我插入的余地了……趁现在……悄悄地……悄悄地……

sequence: 几个小时后

scripts.say: ……就是这个吗？
呜……造型独特的宝箱，还带个“Goal”的横幅，用指挥官的话说……大概是“让人很难吐槽”……？
就不能象征性地埋一下吗，埋半个进土里至少也有点寻宝的感觉……
总之……打开看看……只有一张纸…内容…？
「制作巧克力最重要的东西就是制作者本人一颗真挚的心喔！」
一颗真挚的心？有种……被敷衍了的感觉……？
嗯……？背面还有字……「遥远的观察者致上」
这是……？观察者？难道不是{namecode:89}小姐出于好玩埋的吗？
总之既然宝藏找到了，赶快回去吧，还得给指挥官报告一下这场闹剧以及……
做巧克力呢……
呵呵呵，稍微加点引导和刺激，就收集到了不错的数据呢……
真是恶趣味呢，观察者……
哼哼，由心智魔方诞生的“兵器”……受到“人类”影响而产生的“感情”……高涨的“情感”对战斗能力的影响……实在是让人很感兴趣啊～
毕竟这是“主人们”最终也没能彻底探明的“黑箱”啊……
主人……如果您看到这些，看到您的“女儿们”如今的模样，您会怎么想呢……？是会露出欣慰的笑容，还是意料之中的神情呢？主人……
前方发现敌小型航空母舰和…许多舰载机！
可恶，没有空军支援，这可不是闹着玩的…
刚才是谁说没有支援的呢？
这个声音是…逸仙？！你怎么也来了？
我前几天就被派遣到此处执行秘密调查任务了呢，另外就是…看准合适的时机支援你们了
啊，那个笨蛋指挥官，什么都不告诉我！
现在可不是抱怨的时候哦，敌机就要攻过来了
平海，注意加强对空火力，守住这片海域！
是的姐姐！
其他的话稍后再说，让他们见识见识我们功夫的威力吧！
难得有这么好的机会，天时、地利、人和……
就让我再测试一下你们的反应吧呵呵呵~
居然是来自一航战的精锐航空队，重樱派出你们的目的到底是什么？
可恶，这是装作听不到么，平海，这一次，不要放过一架飞机！
是！
终究是些劣质的仿制品么，居然连尚未觉醒的几个小家伙都不是对手。
没关系，棋子要多少有多少，相较起来，更重要的是时机~
接下来，我就以这个形态去刺激刺激她们吧~
舰长，对不起，现在的宁海还太弱小
平海，对不起，现在的姐姐还没法保护你
但是，迟早有一天——
我们会变强——我们的民族会变强——
到了那个时候，希望你们能够记得我们的名字
记得曾经在这片江涛之上，有这么一群舍身奋战的小不点
用她们娇小的身躯独自对抗着数十倍的敌人
无路可退，而她们的背后——
——是民族的脊梁

夕阳染红的旗帜
