signDate: 谨此纪念不应被忘却的故事 —— 9.23

scripts.say: *Phew*... Looks like it's finally started to cool down a little bit tonight... It's way too humid and hot here, and the sun is oppressive as well. If not for this mission, I would have booked it long ago.
I sure envy Astoria. Her class consists of only sisters, but over here, we have "allies," not just sisters. Well, it's not like I have anything against them...
*Sigh*... Houston, how nice it'd be if you were here...
Gah, this is no time to be getting sentimental. Australia went north to meet up with the others, so I am now temporarily in charge of the South Group. I have to set a good example, hehe.
I just have to hang in there a bit longer. Tomorrow...
(Chicago's thoughts were suddenly interrupted by the blaring of sirens.)
This is... an alert from Patterson?
Impossible...! How could the Sakura Fleet show up here? Also, what's with this distance?! Savo Island's patrols should have picked them up on their radars...!
(Suppressing her shock, she quickly went to message Bagley.)
Bagley, please come with me! We've got trouble!
(In the distance, the horizon glowed with the embers of battle, as if a gaping maw had opened up in the night.)

Though the enemies were not numerous, Chicago and Bagley found themselves outnumbered as they pressed forward. By the time they reached the enemy's main force, they had already sustained many injuries.
You sure have some guts to attack with a force this small. I suppose this is what they mean when they talk about the Sakura Empire's fearsome valor.

A small fighting force is just what we need to carry out a surprise attack, is that not obvious? Or rather, should I say that your defenses were astoundingly weak? We had steeled ourselves for the worst, but...
I hate to admit it, but you're right...

After enduring countless air raids for several days in the harsh heat, their defenses had in fact been worn thin. But in the face of failure, these were meaningless excuses. Knowing this, Chicago simply bit her lip.
But there's no point babbling on. Prepare yourself!
You will face Kako and Kinugasa of the Sakura Empire's 6th Fleet!

After a desperate defense, Chicago managed to buy time for Bagley to escape. However, she was incapacitated by the concentrated fire of the enemy cruisers and had to retreat. Bagley, alone, was powerless to stop the advance of the Sakura ships.
Even though they got away, this should be good enough, right? Doesn't seem like there are any more enemies in this area.
I suppose so. Since this is a fast fleet, we can outmaneuver our enemies even if they outgun us. Besides, Tenryuu's group isn't cut out for heavy fighting.
This island is critical for us, so let's focus on clearing out any enemies that might be left.
Besides, this airfield belonged to us in the first place.
Yes, yes, I know. We should be concentrating our efforts on supporting Operation SN now, correct?
If you understand, then let's go moving. Choukai and the others have already begun to engage the enemies in the north, so we should join up as soon as possible.
Apart from Chicago's South Group, the three sisters Astoria, Quincy, and Vincennes were assigned to the Eagle Union's North Fleet.
Astoria, it's so hot...
Okay~ In that case, why don't you take off your blazer and pass it over to me?
It's still too hot even if I take it off... I'm gonna melt...
We're in the tropics, after all. This is just how the climate is all year 'round. At least it cools down at night.
That said, Vincennes has been busy lugging supplies around the last two days, so it only makes sense that she'd be tired...
Also, going on patrol is tiring and boring... Why do we have to run around when Enterprise and the others could handle it?
Um, it seems that the admiralty is worried that there are enemy carriers lurking around, so they issued orders to have her withdrawn...
That's why we're needed to patrol the area and ensure the safety of the landing force.
Quincy knows everything, doesn't she? Is she becoming a better big sister than me?
Th-that wasn't my intention... I just want to be helpful to you, Astoria...
Hm... is that so? But not this time! You've shown me that I need to get smarter! Quincy, after this mission is over, teach me how to get smart!
Um, sure!
Quincy, I'm sleepy...
I suppose there's no helping it... Vincennes, come here, I'll carry you.
Yay! Quincy, I love you~
What about Astoria? You know, your other big sister?!
Um... I love you second best?
Hm... I suppose that's still a silver medal...
Suddenly, all three sisters were illuminated by searchlights.
Searchlights...? Or did someone behind us accidentally turn on the high beams...?
Wait, no! These are... enemies! Quincy, Vincennes, prepare for battle!
What the hell! The enemies came from the south, so why didn't Chicago tell us anything?!
Um, when Australia came here, perhaps there was an error in delegating the next in command?
Dele... gation? What does that mean?
Sounds... "dele"...cious...?
Now's not the time to explain... We have to assume the worst case scenario - that Chicago's forces were taken out before they had a chance to react...
For the time being, I'll issue an alarm to mobilize all our forces, but I don't think reinforcements are going to be able to make it.
You don't need to explain that to me! The enemy's right in front of our eyes!
Quincy, Vincennes, stay on your guard!
Roger that!
Choukai! We're here!
Sis, I've come to help!
Having defeated Chicago's South Group, Kako and Kinugasa rejoined with Choukai's fleet to face Astoria and her sisters.
Great. Furutaka, Aoba, keep firing. We're going to rebuild our lines and seize victory here and now!
Understood!
How come the enemy can get reinforcements before us? I thought we were supposed to be in control of these waters?!
Those two came from the south, so that must mean...
As you predicted, Quincy... Chicago must have already been taken out...
Chicago... is kinda useless...
Don't say that! Chicago surely did her best. Got it, Vincennes?
Sure...
So, I suppose San Juan and the others won't be able to make it from the east either...
Seems to be the case...
The enemy won't be able to surround us just yet. We should make use of the time we have to counterattack...
All right, let's do that then.
Let's go!
Under the withering fire of the enemies, Astoria and her sisters were quickly becoming overwhelmed by their enemies' superior numbers...
Astoria!
I'm all right... I can still keep fighting!
Sis... Ugh...
It'll be okay, Vincennes!
Heh. I'm lucky to have sisters like you two in such a tough fight. Otherwise I wouldn't be able to keep myself from crying.
Astoria... Big sister, that's right...
Mm... as long as we're all together, Vincennes will also...
All right, let's make our final counterattack!
Phew, looks like it's over. As expected, there's no one who can match our expertise in night battles. Should we finish chasing down those transports?
That's right. We didn't sustain any major injuries, so we can probably keep fighting on.
Aoba, Furutaka, don't gloat too much. I'm wary as to why the enemies were so underprepared. Plus, their air support hasn't shown up yet, so we should consider ourselves lucky.
If the enemy air force shows up, or if their stragglers manage to regroup, we won't even have a retreat path.
You have a point. By the way, before we left, who was it yelling "I absolutely don't wanna go?"
W-who knows?! I have n-no clue what you're talking about~!
If not for the fact that we sustained devastating losses at AF, we would be able to really strike hard at the enemy. But we can't afford to take any more unnecessary losses.
Unfortunately, there are no "if's" in the world. Let's go, there is only so much we can do tonight. It's a pity that we couldn't stop the enemies from landing, but I won't give up here.
We'll have to continue to give it our all. There will surely be a large battle around this island.

Choukai turned her head to look at the tropical island, its dense rainforest making it look even more inaccessible than before. With that, the island, as well as the sounds of battle, faded into the stillness of the moonlight.
But this was only an intermission, a brief period of quiet before the curtains would rise again with the fanfare of cannons.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>1. The Proposal</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
The office is bathed in a golden afternoon glow. A tranquil, serene mood fills the room.
A new batch of reports rests atop my desk. I reach out to read one, but then, out of nowhere...
Listen up, servant! You are going to read this business proposal and greenlight it at once!
Queen Elizabeth vigorously throws open the door and dumps a stack of papers on my desk.
"What have we here... 'Project Return to Glory'?"
Indeed! This is the project outline for a teahouse with a maid theme, tentatively named "The Royal Tea"!
I've been informed that certain individuals have been questioning my status here at port lately.
That is why I laid out this project from the ground up – to reassert the Royal Navy's position and my status as its leader!
Good lord... She means to use a themed teahouse to promote the Royal Navy's own culture.
Well, well. Two can play at that game.
Eugen?! When did you get here?! Let me guess... You're here to spy on me, aren't you?!
I got here before you did. Sounds like you were so excited about your proposal that you didn't even notice me.
My mind filters out mere commoners like you! Now explain yourself – what brought you here to begin with?
Commoner business. I won't bore you with the details, Your High-and-Mightyness.
More importantly, I see the location you chose for the project has a vacant plot of land next to it... Perfect for the Iron Blood to set up its own shop.
What do you say to that? It'd foster healthy competition in a race to provide the customers with the best service.
(Hmm. My status would improve further yet if we're able to surpass our sworn rivals...)
Very well, I approve of this idea. As do you, right, servant?
If it means better service for the customers and more fun for all, two shops are definitely better than one.
Great. Then we'll have you rate both shops after a week and pick a winner.
"Wait... Who said anything about winners and losers? Do we really have to do that?"
Yes. You cannot have a competition without victors and losers! Although, our victory is as good as guaranteed already.
We have an agreement then. Better start setting up our respective shops, hmm, Queen?
Hmph. Indeed it is! I'm eager to see you try and fail to manage a shop, Eugen!
I never even suggested I'd be personally managing the place, did I?
With you – the head of the Royal Navy – assuming the managing position, it only makes sense for Bismarck to be the leader on our end.
Bismarck, you say... Do give her a message. Tell her to be ready to kneel and officially acknowledge my superiority!
Bel, come with me. We must establish our teahouse posthaste.
Certainly, Your Highness. Master, forgive us for the intrusion, and thank you for your time.
Belfast bows gracefully to me, then she and Elizabeth leave my office.
I'd better get going too. Looking forward to hearing your unbiased opinion on our respective shops. Hehe~
The battle of the shops has officially begun, and it's off to a fierce start, at that.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>10. Emergency Escape</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
"So... Here we are now."
Mhm. The agreed-upon 7 days have passed since both our stores opened.
"That they have. The week went by in a flash, it feels like..."
"Let's start with what others think. Both your respective stores have been garnering rave reviews."
"In fact, some customers have even requested we keep the stores open for maybe another day or two."
If you'd like us to do that, then it can be arranged.
Ditto for The Royal Tea. I-I suppose I can tolerate being your maid for a bit longer...
"Wonderful. Then since both parties are in agreement, the stores will stay open for a while longer. That was a quick meeting."
What? But you've not declared a winner yet.
That's what we asked you to do – decide which store you, personally, like the most.
I'm curious to hear your opinion, regardless of which is your favorite.
I concur. Go on! Give us your honest opinion, servant!
Heheh. You look like you have a lot to say, Commander.
"I do. There's much I'd like to say as a preface to deciding the winner..."
Nobody's stopping you. We're all ears.
*knock knock*
Sorry for barging in. I couldn't get a hold of... Why are you all gathered here?
Oh, thank god. Someone has come to save me in my hour of need!
The Eagle Union's holding a briefing later today on our upcoming exercise. I was just wondering if you wanted to attend, Commander?
That's my golden ticket out of here. Thank you, Enterprise.
Oh, awesome! ...Didn't think you'd agree to it instantly.
Now I have an excuse to postpone my final answer for later. Time to leave, quickly.
Wait! We're not finished here...!

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>11. After-Hours Visit</size>

scripts.say: After finishing up work, I pay a visit to Scharlachroter Tresen.
Apologies, but we're closed for the da– Commander?
"Sorry for turning up so late. I just really wanted to check on you all."
Magdeburg, the cats are still knocking things over. Take care of that tomorrow, will you?
Seems we're running out of beer. Elbe, order a refill.
Z46, have you finished cleaning the entrance ye–
Bismarck and I make eye contact.
First you come before we open, and this time, after we close. You're as unpredictable as they come...
"I'm just dropping in to see how you're all doing. Don't mean to disturb you, so I'll be on my way now."
Hmm... We still have leftovers in the kitchen, don't we?
Yeah. Why? Are we gonna keep the café open longer today?
That's the idea. It'd be a shame for the food to go to waste, wouldn't it? Let's invite the Commander inside and have dinner.
Right this way, Commander. We have the café reserved all to ourselves tonight.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>12. Garden Tea Party</size>

scripts.say: I arrive at The Royal Tea as per Elizabeth's invitation.
Welcome, Commander.
Surprisingly, I'm greeted by Noshiro of all people. She gestures for me to step inside, which I do.
Many Sakura Empire girls have expressed an interest in opening our own store. I'm simply here to see how the Royal Navy runs theirs.
Her Highness is waiting for you in the garden.
"They've set up a garden behind the store now? Good grief..."
How good you could make it, servant.
Icarus, fetch us some tea.
Certainly. Just a moment.
Well? Will you join me, or are you just going to stand there?
Your seat is over there. Sit down, servant.
Hehe! Good. Now listen up.
Our teahouse has been a great success. A growing number of customers have even said they want to try the maid experience for themselves!
With how well our store's been received, I propose we keep it in business indefinitely.
What do you think of that, servant? You have the final say in the matter.
No need to decide right at once. Ponder it over some tea and biscuits.
I'm back with your tea!
Oh, and I've checked your schedule for today. I know you have all the time in the world to stay and indulge in a chat with me.
May I pour some for you too, Commander?
Wait, Icarus. I shall do it.
There we are. Go on, drink. Savour the taste... my dear servant!

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>2. Impromptu Strategy Meeting</size>

scripts.say: Port - Iron Blood Assembly Room
Seeing as you've appointed me, I will give it my utmost effort to the end.
To emerge victorious over the Royal Navy, we need a well thought out business plan before we set up shop.
If anyone has ideas or suggestions, don't be afraid to share them right now.
Since the Commander will be the final judge, how about we focus our theme and menu accordingly?
I see where you're coming from, but we can't pigeonhole ourselves into solely pleasing the Commander. Let's not forget the Royal Navy's original goal with all this.
It's to make an exhibit Elizabeth's status. The Commander's evaluation is a factor too, of course, but we cannot put the cart before the horse.
The Royal Maids are experts when it comes to service. I doubt we'll beat them when it comes to that.
So our efforts should go into our menu. The Commander is a known fan of Iron Blood coffee, so why don't we center our theme around that?
Focusing on our strengths. I like that idea.
Ooh, I have one! It'd be cool if we could offer all kinds of fizzy drinks!
You know, bubbly coffee, juice, soda, and so on! I think people would love that!
Splendid idea. We could even offer carbonated wine and the like!
Now that's a novel idea. Maybe excessively so for the wine... But the rest of those drinks may suit our menu.
Think we're covered in the drinks front. What 'bout the food?
Black Forest cake would be a sure hit. Some sausages plus other light side dishes would be good too.
Hmm... A café serving traditional Iron Blood cuisine might be a novelty, but I'm not sure our food has universal appeal.
I've got another suggestion, and it ain't for food or drinks. I'm thinking we add...
A cage of death. Perfect for burning calories after you wolf down a bunch of pastries.
No.
Darn. Here I thought I was onto something.
Umm... Shouldn't we wear uniforms, if we're going to be serving customers...?
They'll have maid uniforms after all. It'd be strange if we just... wore what we have now...
You raise a good point. We need new uniforms as part of the theme.
Another thing we must decide on is the café's name. Any suggestions?
With Bismarck as the director, the planning phase for the Iron Blood's themed café went swimmingly.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>3. Maid Crash Course</size>

scripts.say: Port - Royal Navy Assembly Room
...In summary, the Iron Blood meddled during the meeting, and now we must compete with them.
Our plan remains the same, however! Prevailing over them is incidental to our goal of asserting my royal status!
Now, on to why I gathered you here... It is you, not the Royal Maids, who will have the honour of staffing our teahouse.
I am certain beyond a doubt they will base their entire strategy on us fielding the Royal Maids, as one would expect.
However, we will defy those expectations and exclusively employ shipgirls who are NOT part of the Royal Maids!
This will catch everyone by surprise, leaving them with a fresh, novel impression!
And that, ladies, is our strategy! Did you all understand that?
Quite an interesting approach.
What is a maid supposed to do? I've never worked as one. Someone will have to teach me.
Worry not, the Royal Maids will give you a crash course on it.
Any questions pertaining to the job should be directed to Bel!
Will do! Thank you for this honour, Your Highness!
No, no! Not "Your Highness"! You will refer to me as "Reigning Manager" until further notice!
As you say, Reigning Manager!
Good. Bel, take over from here. I'm leaving to check on their uniforms.
Certainly. Ladies, let us try a small exercise. I want you to imagine this room is the teahouse, then I want you to conduct yourself as you believe a maid would.
Don't be afraid to make mistakes. Everyone does, initially. For now, any amount of practice is good.
A short while later...
Goodness, a maid's work is much harder than I thought... Thanks for everything you do, Belfast.
Think nothing of it. The other maids and I are only doing our jobs.
Do you really want me to play the violin at the teahouse?
I'm wondering about these cats too... Will they be at the teahouse as well?
Yes to both your questions. Her Highness wishes to include them as part of our theme.
And the maid uniforms? What are they going to be like?
They are going to look splendid on you all. That much I can say with certainty.
Now, let us repeat the exercise from the top. This time, try to keep our core tenet – gracefulness – in mind.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>4. Out of the Box</size>

scripts.say: The new Royal Navy and Iron Blood stores are just around this corner.
They have names quite representative of their respective factions – The Royal Tea, and Scharlachroter Tresen.
And apparently, they've become the port's hottest places to be.
I meant to check them out yesterday, but couldn't due to work getting in the way. Now, though, it's time to pay the girls a visit.
- C-Commander! - Hi, Commander!
Huh? P-Penelope...?
L-Leipzig...?
Before I can even turn the corner, a representative from each establishment jumps out to greet me.
Umm! C-Commander, we'd love to see you at our café! Pl-please come check us out!
Here, h-have a flyer! I recommend trying our new coffee!
If you want to kick back and relax, then you should visit The Royal Tea instead.
Because, uhh... our staff is more welcoming, I guess?
- Come visit us, Commander...! - You won't regret it, Commander...
I've yet to set foot inside either store, and already they're trying to one-up each other...
Hey-hey-hey! Surprise!
"What the–?!"
- EEK! - Bwah!
A wild Albacore appeared. Out of a cardboard box of all things.
Teehee~ Oops, sorry for spooking you two. I only meant to give the Commander a fright!
Betcha would've freaked out even harder if you'd just come a little closer first. Alas, you were all taking too long, and impatience got the better of me~
W-were we taking that long...? Sorry for keeping you here, Commander!
I'm sorry too. I'll just... wait for you at our store.
Whether Albacore meant to or not, her shrewdness got Penelope and Leipzig to back down. Now I can finally move on.
Nice job on what~? I have no clue what you're talking about~
Good question! Buuut that's a secret~
Anyhow, you gonna visit the new stores, Commander? Only one will get to be the lucky first to serve you, so choose carefully now~
Teehee~ Well, I had my fun, so I'm off. Toodles~
As obvious as that is, she's right about one thing: it'll be hard choosing which to visit first...

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>5. Experimental Menu</size>

scripts.say: I step into the Iron Blood's café – Scharlachroter Tresen.
Welcome, Commander.
"Bismarck? I'm honored to be greeted by the leader herself."
This way I can personally oversee the business to make sure everything is going as planned. We only just opened, after all.
Anyway... Follow me. The seats are over here.
Bismarck leads me deeper into the café. I take a seat and turn to look at her.
We're trying out a lot of new drinks. Some of them have already made it onto our menu, and some others we'd like your opinion on first.
Here you go! Apple juice, milk, and coffee, all bubbly! Enjoy~
Try this, uhh, bubbly wheat juice too. It's– *hic* It's great.
You've clearly had too much of that, Adalbert!
While I have my misgivings about all the "intriguing" drinks they've presented me with, I can't exactly just pass on them...
"I'm... pleasantly surprised. The bubbles tickled my tongue in an oddly satisfying way."
Phew... I'm glad you enjoyed them. We'll add them to the menu tomorrow.
Care to try some food too? We have both desserts and whole dishes.
Yup-yup. From Black Forest cake to waffles with sausages, you name it.
"The desserts sounds nice, but– Wait, did you just say waffles WITH sausages?"
H-here you go, Commander! Hope you enjoy...!
You heard right, Commander! Waffles with sausages is my own original recipe. Gosh, just looking at 'em makes my mouth water!
Dig in, Commander! You should start with the waffles before they get cold!
This is quite a bizarre dish, that much is obvious. Nevertheless, I can't say no...

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>6. Classy Establishment</size>

scripts.say: I step into the Royal Navy's teahouse – The Royal Tea.
Upon opening the door, I'm immediately greeted by the harmonious sound of violin music.
Welcome, Commander!
Oh, where are my manners! I'm supposed to conduct myself like a maid!
Icarus stops herself in the middle of something, slightly lifts her skirt by the side rims, and bows courteously to me.
Please follow me~
She escorts me through the teahouse and takes me into a separate room.
Here is our menu. I recommend trying our famous royal milk tea~
I scan the laminated paper adorned with gorgeous decorations. The milk tea Icarus mentioned has the comment "A customer favourite" written next to it.
Something else I notice is that the drinks menu lists numerous kinds of tea I've never heard of before.
"I can't help but admire the Royal Navy's extreme passion for all things tea. Maybe I'll– Huh?"
Looking up, I notice Icarus walked over to a corner of the room to play with some cats. Why are there cats in here?
Hehehe~ Who's a good girl~ Just stay right here and I'll bring you dinner later~
Later I would find out that these cats are part of the new theme Elizabeth envisioned. She's been inspired by cat cafés, I suppose.
Are you ready to order, Commander?
Southampton comes into the room, violin in hand and donning a maid uniform.
By the way, how did you like my violin performance?
I'm glad you liked it! At first I was unsure I'd be able to play it all that well.
"The music adds so much to the atmosphere. I love how you can hear it in here even when the door is closed."
Lovely, isn't it? As a matter of fact, Her Highness had special equipment installed so the music can be heard all throughout the teahouse.
"You could host a small concert in here with equipment like that. Might be something to consider."
"Oh right, I've still not ordered anything. I'm ready now, Icarus. I think I'll have a..."
...Got it! Just stay put and I'll be right back with your order! Same for you, kitties!
And I'd better get back to work. Breaktime is over. Please do enjoy the rest of the performance, Commander.
A short while later, Icarus returns with my order. I listen to the vibrant violin music while I savor my cup of tea.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>7. A Day Off</size>

scripts.say: The bell at The Royal Tea's front door rings. A pair of unexpected guests enter the teahouse.
Hey, everyone! We're here to hang out!
"Hang out" isn't quite right. More apt would it be to say "pay a visit."
Hang on... Don't you girls work just next door at the café?
They do. I've got a feeling like they're spies here to steal our trade secrets!
I doubt that's the case.
Hehehe, if it isn't the Iron Blood. Here to concede victory since you stand no chance of winning?
Nope! Just here to hang out, that's all! Bismarck gave us the day off.
...Indeed. Hang out, as she said. That is the sole purpose of our visit.
Well, we would certainly never turn away new customers! Penelope, show them to their tables.
Yes, Your Highness.
It's "Reigning Manager"!
...Apologies, Reigning Manager. I'll show them to their tables now.
Check out their menu! It's... Geez, it's like a hundred times more fancy than ours.
Luxury and elegance are the Royal Navy's principles, and simplicity and pragmatism are ours. Suppose one were to combine them...
So... Can I take your order?
It's hard to choose when all of these sound delish! Lemme think for a bit...
Commonplace teatime biscuits contrasted with a plethora of diverse beverages...
*scribble*
Excuse me, what are you writing?
Nothing of importance. Pay it no mind.
Cats most charming, and music most calming...
*scribble scribble*
You know can write after you make your order, right?
Oh, how right you are... U-1206?
Yeah, I've decided now! We'll have everything on the menu, thanks!
No. Not happening.
Darn. Hmm, in that case...
Reigning Manager, the "spies" have left.
That they have. You did well, Penelope!
Are you sure it's fine to let them gain information on how we run our teahouse?
Let them, I say! I'd like to see them try to replicate our trademark style!
It's not so hard to replicate our staff's level of expertise, however...
It's... not...?
All right, change of plans! You may all leave now!
L-leave? All of us?
Are you saying that we're all fired?!
No! I'm saying: they're taking the day off, therefore we will as well!
I'll have the maids look after the teahouse. Anyone so inclined is free to visit the Iron Blood's café in the meanwhile!
Understood?
Yes! Of course!

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>8. A Word of Thanks</size>

scripts.say: Welcome, Commander.
I'm once again greeted by Bismarck at the café's entrance.
This way, please.
Take your time, we'll be with you soon.
Bismarck leads me to my table. We pass through a corridor, passing not a single other customer on the way.
Just so you know, we're not open for another half an hour.
"Oh, really? Sorry, I must've misremembered when you open."
It's fine. Everything is ready for us to start early today anyway.
This presents us a rare opportunity, in fact. Care for a drink, Commander?
She places a foaming drink on the table.
Ah. Latte art, but with beer.
Mhm. The principle's the same with any drink that foams.
That said, you have to be intimately familiar with Iron Blood beer to pull it off. You'd better appreciate the skill it takes.
It certainly does. It takes an expert hand, like Ulrich's, and specialized equipment to make a drink like this. It also tastes as good as it looks.
I examine the drink from above. There is a word written in the foam – "Danke."
Don't be shy now. Though it may be a work of art, it's still a drink. Drinks are meant to be drunk.
I take one final appreciatory look at the lovingly crafted message, then down the glass' contents all in one go.
Heh. If the Commander's look is any indication, the drink is a success.
Indeed. And its success entails our glorious victory.
"This drink is incredible. The nutty, full flavor complements the kick of the carbonation. I feel like I just got supercharged with energy."
Ah yes, that's the secret ingredient you tasted – almonds.
Ulrich, Z46, come to the kitchen. We have a small problem on our hands.
A "problem"? I'll go and have a look.
No need to, we'll take care of it. Go make sure we're ready to open instead.
At Eugen's behest, Ulrich and Z46 make for the kitchen to resolve the problem.
I hope they're not up to anything strange again.
Oh, by the way, I personally taste-test all the drinks we make for you. I always worry if you'll like them, though.
After Eugen first suggested I take on the role of store manager... frankly, I struggled for a long while.
But I'd already agreed to it. And once I agree to something, I commit wholeheartedly.
"It's a good thing to push yourself sometimes. Just don't do overdo it, okay?"
Don't worry, I won't. Having overcome that initial hurdle, I'm actually having a good time now.
Bismarck and I have a pleasant chat, killing a bit of time before formal opening hours.

sequence:
Tonic and Tea

<size=45>9. Your Cup of Tea</size>

scripts.say: There you are, servant! You're going to test a new teahouse service we're working on!
The moment I set foot inside The Royal Tea, Elizabeth begins shouting at me from her executive throne.
Hurry up and follow the maids! You have no power to refuse our kind offer!
I'm shown to a separate room. Howe and Penelope are setting the table for a tea party.
Here it is – our deluxe service! An extravagant tea party with 3 of our maids!
How dare you overlook ME! Can't you see my maid uniform?
"Oh, right. If I remember right, didn't you say at some point you wanted to see for yourself what it's like to be a maid?"
Indeed I did! I am presently serving the roles of queen, teahouse manager, and maid all concurrently!
By serving as a maid, I learn first-hand what my staff's responsibilities are. Accordingly, I am better able to manage the teahouse!
While I'm not sure I follow her train of thought, I'll take her word for it.
I turn my attention from Elizabeth to Howe and Penelope, watching quietly while they put things down on the table.
Stop once the cup is three quarters full, Penelope. Don't overpour.
Three quarters... Got it. Three quarters...
Here you are, Commander. I hope it is to your liking.
"Thanks. Hang on... It just struck me I haven't ordered anything yet."
You are already being served! I expect you'll enjoy the tea. I also expect some appreciation once my prediction proves right. Now drink!
I do as urged and drink the tea Penelope poured for me. It tastes pretty good. I'd gladly have another cup.
"It's good. Doesn't quite hold up to the Royal Maids' high standards, but even so, I can taste how much effort you and Howe put into this."
Well? Satisfied with our service? I thought so!
Being so accustomed to the Royal Maids' splendid work, I of all people would know what constitutes good service!
I'm just glad you liked it... That covers the tea, now let's get you some dessert. Howe, go ahead.
Right. Stay put and I'll bring you some cookies.
"Cookies are part of the package?"
Correct! We're only getting started here, servant! Brace yourself for an evening of desserts and entertainment!
Honey! I knew it was you! Oh, what have we here?
Hello... I'm Lora. {tb} brought me to meet you.

options.content: What're you doing here, New Jersey?

scripts.say: What're you doing here, New Jersey?
I was just thinking about how I could give you the best smile you've ever seen!
Because, you know, I'm the Black Dragon – I've always gotta look dazzling!
Problem is, practice alone won't get me there, so I'm seeing how it looks here in the mirror! Don'tcha just love a smile like this, honey?

options.content: (Tell her that her smile always calms you down.)

scripts.say: Seeing your smile always manages to calm me.
It's a wonderful smile. It suits you.
You mean it? Aww! Hearing that from you makes me happier than winning any battle in the world!
This happiness is getting stowed safely in my heart. On another note, you want some blissful juice, honey?
How 'bout you, Lora? What kind of juice do you like? I've got cups to spare!
M-may I?
Course you can!
In that case... I'll have the same as you.
New Jersey pours a cup of orange juice for Lora.
Cheers, honey!
It's weird... You're such a dazzling woman, so how come just a few words from my guardian make you so happy?
Sounds like expressing your feelings and waiting for a response isn't something to be ashamed of...
Openness and the joy derived from it... Is that the secret to being dazzling?
Yeah... I think I get it now!
Well, I'm always here if you want someone to chat with!
Thanks a bunch.
I'll catch you later, honey! You too, cute young lady!
After saying goodbye to New Jersey, Lora and I turn and leave.
What a pleasure it is to meet you, my honourable Master.
Please come closer. You as well, Lora.
I've made some crepes. Would you like to have a taste?
Oh, may I? Wow, those crapes look really tasty!
If there's anything else I can do for you, please do let me know.
Whatever you may need, I shall provide it for you.
After getting Lora seated, Sirius faces the window again and starts smoothing out the wrinkles on her apron.
The way you carry yourself... It always looks so elegant...
An impeccable demeanour is fundamental for a maid in my Master's service.

options.content: (Ask what she's doing with her uniform.)

I appreciate it.

Then fold it like this... carefully... making absolutely sure it won't tear...
Are you going out of your way to do something you're no good at? How come?
Whuah?! C-Commander! And Lora! I-I, um, I just wanted to help a little...
(Ask what she's doing.)
Y-yes...
Just the other day, I carelessly tore a hole through your shirt... That's why I'm trying to practice it now...
I'm still not good at it... B-but I'll keep trying... Commander, will you see my growth?

options.content: (Tell her the sentiment alone is stirring.)
(Tell her she can take her time.)

Épée carefully smooths out the wrinkles on the clothes.
I bet you've been practicing for quite some time.
It's... It's nothing special! I only tore 10 shirts to get this far!
I'm gonna keep practicing, and I will NOT give up...
Practicing over and over, refusing to give up even if you're not good at it...
You don't need to be perfect... What matters is that you're committed and dedicated...
Maybe it's more emotionally touching if you're bad at something but keep trying earnestly... rather than doing it perfectly in one go...
{tb}, I think... I can accept my own imperfections now...
Also, um... I'll get a sewing kit next time...

Don't push yourself too hard.
I won't! But... I will keep practicing!
Épée gives us a look of determination, then we turn and leave.
Ah, Commander. And Lora, too.

Man, I envy you, Noshiro. You're so organized, and you get stuff done in a flash!
As long as you divide your time rationally, you can achieve a lot even in limiting circumstances.
Why don't you give it a try, Lora?
M-me? But I'm not...
Calm down and think things through. It might help you unleash your full potential.
What're you up to? Making a training schedule?
Correct.
Different shipgirls have different hull types with different characteristics, so their training sessions need to be assigned logically.
It might seem a little boring, but laying out clear plans prevents unnecessary confusion. This schedule looks pretty sound, wouldn't you say?
That's a solid plan if I ever saw one.
Yeah. Looks pretty efficient to me.
Your approval is proof that this approach is the right call.
All we need to do now is follow the plan as it's been laid out.
Noshiro takes the written schedule and carefully stores it in a folder.
Taking something complicated and breaking it down into easier things...
When you face difficulties, I guess you don't need to try to change who you are...
Maybe I can become more composed by using reason to process my emotions?
Well, when something is causing you trouble, the first thing you should do is write it down on paper.
That's good advice.
Right, I'd better go and set up the training machinery.
After seeing Noshiro off as she neatly finished her task, Lora and I turn and leave.

You always look so focused when you're dealing with plants, Zeven...
Why, yes, because you need to take good care of plants, just like any other living thing.

options.content: (Ask her if she was talking to the flowers.)

If you speak to them a lot, they'll respond by blooming in the most beautiful way. Say, what do you think about this approach to cultivation, Commander?
One thing's for sure: You're really talented at looking after plants.
You're a very gentle gardener, I can tell you that.
Thank you for your kind words.
Allow me to thank you by offering you some freshly brewed flower tea.
De Zeven Provinciën picks up a small teapot next to her and pours two cups of tea.
Even if you're only doing what you're good at... it really makes me feel at ease...
Patiently talking to the flowers, looking for just the right way to care for them...
Taking your time, slowly getting closer little by little... Could that be the key to making {tb} and me feel comfortable with each other?
Well, the principles behind growing flowers and raising a child are actually quite similar.
You might be surprised to learn that I'm actually quite good at these things.
Ah, I'd better get back to tending some of my other flowers now...
Feel free to stay and watch, if you'd like!
After staying to observe the garden for a while, Lora and I turn and leave.
Oh, dear comrade. And the little kid, too.
You always seem so carefree, Tashkent...
Is that so? I just feel there's never a need to rush things. Whatever you need to do will get done sooner or later.
(Ask her what she's doing here.)
Pretty much... Also practicing my greetings while I'm at it.
Not that I think there's anything wrong with them. It's just that people tell me I'm too straight to the point.
But, if you think I should try to be a little cuter... then I guess working on it might not be a bad idea.

options.content: (Tell her she's fine the way she is.)
(Tell her that her bluntness is part of her appeal.)

Since I'm in a good mood today, I'll let you have this candy.
Tashkent presents Lora the piece of candy in her hand.

I'm just... You seem so nonchalant, but you're happy to share your candy with me...
Hey. I heard that.
Oops! Sorry...
I suppose you can be kind without going out of your way to change who you are...
Maybe that straightforward sincerity is like... a type of kindness?
Suddenly, I feel like talking to people isn't as scary anymore...
Dear comrade, bring a tasty snack the next time you come by.
Who knows? Maybe I'll give you something in return.
Will do.
Alright. I'll just get back to relaxing now...
I accept the candy from her, and then Lora and I turn and leave.

Ah! My name is Lora! I'm here with {tb} today!

options.content: What're you doing here, New Jersey?

scripts.say: What're you doing here, New Jersey?
I was just thinking about how I could give you the best smile you've ever seen!
Because, you know, I'm the Black Dragon – I've always gotta look dazzling!
Problem is, practice alone won't get me there, so I'm seeing how it looks here in the mirror! Don'tcha just love a smile like this, honey?

options.content: (Tell her that her smile always calms you down.)

scripts.say: Seeing your smile always manages to calm me.
It's a wonderful smile. It suits you.
You mean it? Aww! Hearing that from you makes me happier than winning any battle in the world!
This happiness is getting stowed safely in my heart. On another note, you want some blissful juice, honey?
How 'bout you, Lora? What kind of juice do you like? I've got cups to spare!
M-may I?
Course you can!
Alright, then I'll have some orange juice!
New Jersey pours a cup of orange juice for Lora.
Cheers, honey!
It's weird... You're such a dazzling woman, so how come just a few words from my guardian make you so happy?
Sounds like expressing your feelings and waiting for a response isn't something to be ashamed of...
Openness and the joy derived from it... Is that the secret to being dazzling?
Yeah... I think I get it now!
Well, I'm always here if you want someone to chat with!
Thanks a bunch.
I'll catch you later, honey! You too, cute young lady!
After saying goodbye to New Jersey, Lora and I turn and leave.

I believe now is the perfect time to put it to the test.
Please take these three tarot cards and give them to Lora.
I will pray for a blessed, pleasant journey for you both.
The opportunity to change the future... may lie in the cards that are chosen.
It looks like it's going to start raining...
There's at least one thing I do like about rain...
It's the sound of the raindrops hitting the leaves, making that nice rustling sound...
Also, there are hardly any people out when it rains... It's perfect for a walk...
{tb}, would you like to go for a stroll with me?

options.content: Let's wait until the rain stops.

scripts.say: You must like the rainy atmosphere, too...
It makes me feel like you really understand me... Heehee...
But then... the streets will be full of people, unlike now...
Although... I guess maybe that's not so bad...
{tb}! I found some amazing decorative material!
Using these gold and orange ribbons, we can make your meeting room look like a bright sunflower patch!
Also, we can make some colorful paper cranes and put them by the window! I think that'd look great.
What do you think?

options.content: Good idea. Want me to help?
Might be a little too flashy, you know?

scripts.say: Thank you! Heehee – welcome to the home renovation team!
Together, we'll fill every corner of this place with warmth and sunshine!
Huh? Is that... a problem?
Then... how about placing just a single sunflower by the window?
So, um, I baked some cookies...
I-I made them in the shape of sunflowers...
As the recipe said, I also added some honey and lemon juice...
I was worried the whole time while they were baking... I thought they might burn...
Luckily... they came out pretty well!

options.content: They look adorable. Let's dig in.
We should share these with some friends!

scripts.say: S-sure! As long as you like them, I'm happy... Heehee...
Sh-sharing with friends... Okay! I'll go and get a plate!
Where should I leave these documents? On the desk?
I'm just worried I'll put them in the wrong place...
Also... maybe I should reorganize them according to date...

options.content: That'd be great. Sort by date, please.
Sort them by color. It'll be more efficient.

scripts.say: Alright, then...
I'll, um... keep at it!
B-by color...
Okay! I'll see what I can do!
That plushie kind of reminds me of you, {tb}...
You both have such warm smiles...
Just looking at it makes me feel at ease...

options.content: I'll buy it for you, then.
Should we get some accessories for it as well?

scripts.say: You will? Thank you so much... I'll put it in my favorite corner!
A-accessories? You mean it? Okay, then I want to give it a cute hat as well!
Heheh... Now I'm getting all sorts of ideas for how to dress it up...
Do these vending machines... just dispense drinks by themselves?
Look at all those buttons and glowing lights they have...
Um, i-is this how you're supposed to do it?

options.content: You wanna try it? Let me show you how.
We should push ALL the buttons!

scripts.say: Whoa... I can't believe it... It really dispensed a drink...
I'll really try to memorize how it's done!
J-just push them... randomly?
I suppose if we do that... I can try ALL the drinks as well!
{tb}! I made an album of all the photos we've taken together!
I even put little stickers and ribbons on it!
Here, look! This is the time we went to the beach, and this is when we had tea together...
I also wrote about what I felt at the time next to each photo!
What do you think?
Heehee! I think I'll give it even more cute decorations!
Mhm! It's nice to slow down and carefully organize things. It puts me in a good mood!
{tb}! They just built a new amusement park. I heard it has a huge sunflower field and a magical merry-go-round!
Apparently, it also has light shows and firework displays at night!
Can we go there next weekend?
I already looked up the way there and what times they're open!

options.content: Sounds great. I can't wait to go there with you.
It'll probably be packed. How about another place?

scripts.say: Woohoo!
Now I need to come up with a route so I can ride every single attraction...
Y-yeah, good point...
In that case, how about going to a quiet garden instead?

There's a shiny compass, a jar of marbles in every color... They look so cute.
Wait... What's that in the corner?
{tb}, how about we tidy up this place together?
Who knows – we might find some lost treasure in here!

options.content: I'd rather you don't uncover my secrets.

scripts.say: Sweet! It's time for a treasure hunt!
What? There's really secrets in here that you don't want to come to light?!
Well, okay... I'll leave it be.
{tb}, you've been working nonstop for three hours now...
I've made jasmine tea and gotten you some vitamin gummies.
Close your eyes and get a five-minute break now. That's an order!

options.content: Give me just a little longer.

scripts.say: Heehee. Looking after you is another one of my important duties!
But... your health is more important.
I-if you won't stop, then at least let me help you sort your paperwork!
"Project Identity 3.0"? This came quicker than I expected.
I scan the project files that TB sent me. My gaze halts under the subject line titled "Growth Subject."
It's Explorer this time, huh?

Affirmative. You achieved remarkable results with Oceana's growth. You have demonstrated patience and an ability to tailor guidance according to the subject's needs, which greatly facilitates the growth of subject personalities.
At the same time, you've helped me gain a better understanding of the concept of individuality. Am I right or am I right, Commander?
...Come again?
Pardon my ad lib. It is clear that the use of my personal tone module still needs to be strictly used in the appropriate context.
I glimpse a clear sign of emotional fluctuation in the tone of my AI assistant.
Granted, it wasn't context-appropriate, but her attempt doubtlessly indicates that great progress has been made.
As more data would permit further analysis, I launched a new version of the project.
The training data gained will be compared to Oceana's case, with the aim of providing valuable comparative data on the impact of the growth environment and differentiated nurturing methods.
In terms of the process, will anything be different?
Answer: The major difference is the introduction of a new variable mechanism, made with the help of Painlevé.
It was designed with the intent of better simulating the so-called "unpredictability of the real world."
Additionally, how the subject responds to various unexpected events is a factor that can now be measured.
A mechanism that Painlevé helped with, huh? I guess it'll have something to do with fortune-telling.
For a detailed explanation and tutorial, please connect to the device to search and experience it for yourself.
Based on our experience from the previous two times, we went and adjusted the relevant data in advance.
Would you like to connect to the immersive device right now, Commander?
Yeah. Plug me in.
Orders received. Transporting device to the office now...
System notification: Growth subject parameters established. Subject: Explorer – alias "Lora."
Executing request: Transfer training mission to the Commander.
Once the blinding light fades, a room comes into view. It's colored with soft shades and furnished with warm decorations.
(Looks like an attic. Feels pretty lived-in, too. Then there are the plushies – they must be here for her to play with.)
I pick up a small teddy bear and look at it. That's when I hear quiet sobbing from the other side of the door.
(It's coming from outside... Is it her?)
Gently, I open the door...
A little girl stands at the entrance, timid as a mouse. Her hands tightly clutch the frills of her dress, her shoulders trembling.
Um... S-sorry... I didn't mean to make noise...
I was just a bit scared... and I couldn't bring myself to knock...
She musters her courage and offers a greeting in a sobbing tone of voice.
Despite this small act of bravery, tears pool in the corners of her eyes, betraying the nervousness within her.
(This is totally different from my first impression of TB and Navi.)
I kneel to bring myself to eye level with her, then offer her the teddy bear I picked up inside.
Don't be scared, Lora. This is your home.
I'm your guardian, and I promise to keep you safe.
This is my home... And you're my guardian...
O-okay!
She hugs the teddy bear tightly, then looks up from the ground to meet my eyes. Although her cheeks are still wet with tears, she has a soft and lovely smile on her face.
Thank you... for looking after me, my guardian.
I show Lora to the bedroom.
Whoooa... A cute manjuu plushie...
Guardian... can I play with it?
Of course you can.
Th-thank you, guardian!
She wraps her arms around the plushie, most of the tension seeming to have left her.
Guess I'm "the guardian" now.
Oh! S-sorry, I should've asked before I called you that...
Um, maybe... you want me to call you something else?
Lora and I made plans to go to an amusement park today.
Once she was tired out, she said that she wanted to eat some fluffy ice cream.
However, when I returned with the ice cream, she was nowhere to be found.
{tb}, over here!
She runs over with a bunch of balloons and a big smile on her face. They make little rustling sounds as they bump into each other.
What's with the balloons?
Well, I just realized something...
Remember how we were playing on the swing, and you promised we'd go somewhere even higher?
I saw a balloon stand a while ago, and it made me think...
If I got enough balloons, could they help us fly off somewhere together?
The wind blows, causing all of the balloons to jerk upwards. Lora stands on her tiptoes, hoping to fly, but all they do is make her wobble a little.
Hmm... I guess I don't have enough balloons yet.
I have a better idea, you know.
Huh?
I point behind her – at the Ferris wheel slowly rotating beneath the deep blue sky.
Wanna ride together?
Despite the gondola being stuffed half-full of balloons, there's enough space for Lora to kneel on the seat and gaze out the window, watching the rides below us shrink as we rise.
We're so high up...
It's even higher than the observation deck.
The apex of this Ferris wheel is the highest point in the city.
Wow... I guess my wish has come true.
But the fact that it came true while you were here makes me even happier.
The gondola slowly rises to its apex. Everything below us, from the park attractions to the distant sea, shines in the sunlight.
But it's the sight of her smile, clutching those colorful balloons, that delights me more than the view outside.
The summer sun beats down, accompanied by a cacophony of cicadas. Even the air around us seems distorted from the heat.
On this hot weekend's afternoon, Lora and I go to the waterpark – paradise, in this heat.
Take this! Ack... You got me again!
She lowers her water gun, wipes her face, and puffs out her cheeks in frustration. However, it's quickly replaced with a smug grin.
Not bad, I suppose!
But I've managed to hit you back ten times now, which means I'm half as strong as you!
Your arm is definitely getting better.
Of course! You raised me, after all.
Her eyes light up at my praise, and she straightens up proudly.
Alright, our ceasefire is almost up...
Get ready for my all-out assault, {tb}!
After we've battled to the point of exhaustion, we sit down next to the pool to rest.
Lora's little head rests gently on my shoulder as she catches her breath.
This summer afternoon, filled with splashing and laughter...
...Is sure to become one of our most treasured memories.
Last time we went to the library, Lora seemed really interested in the encyclopedia of rhinoceros beetles.
The weather is nice today, so I brought her to a quiet place in the woods.
Lora, how about you and I search for rhinoceros beetles today?
Rhinoceros beetles... Th-those things I saw in the encyclopedia that look like little flying helmets?
Do you wanna be friends with them?
Yeah... I do!
Oh! Is that a rhinoceros beetle over there...?
She points at a mossy tree trunk. Though she tries to hold her voice down, her excitement is impossible to suppress.
A single rhinoceros beetle rests on the bark. Its obsidian shell gleams in the light of the sun.
After carefully transferring the beetle into an observation box, impressively, she quickly finds another.
This one is a lot smaller than I imagined...
And it's all sparkly... like the chocolate you gave me, {tb}...
Holding her breath, she watches the insect in her palm slowly move its legs.
Hmm... F-for some reason, I have the strangest urge to take a little bite out of it...
No eating these.
Ah! S-sorry!
She turns beet-red in no time, but she manages to keep the beetle steady in her hands.
I think it likes being in my hand...
Do you think... we could watch over it and be friends with it?
In the end, Lora deposited all of the beetles she found into observation boxes.
On the way home, there was a little bounce in her step as she cradled all of the boxes in her arms.
It's late at night, but a warm glow still seeps through the cracks in Lora's door.
Lora? It's bedtime, you know.
I gently push the door open and find her hard at work at her desk.
Mr. Bear, just a little longer... We're almost done, okay?
Need some help?
Ah!
When she notices me, she pauses her work and purses her lips bashfully.
The teddy bear I got you before. Are you mending it?
Yeah... You gave it to me when we first met. It's my first friend ever...
Whenever I hug Mr. Bear, I feel the courage you gave me.
But Mr. Bear got hurt, so I need to heal him...
Her motions with the needle are a little awkward, but she takes the work itself seriously. The stitches are surprisingly steady.
I need to sew him up nice and neat...
U-umm, {tb}... Can you turn the light up for me? It's a little hard to see.
I move her desk lamp a little closer and turn it up brighter.
How's that?
I can see a lot better now.
Umm... Thanks for being here with me, {tb}...
After finishing the last stitch, Lora sighs softly, cradles the teddy bear in her arms, and looks up at me. There's an expectant look in her eyes.
He's all better now. I'm sure he's really happy that you took good care of him.
Now, it's time for good girls to get some sleep.
She nods and heads over to bed, hugging Mr. Bear as she goes.
Good night, {tb}...
Thank you... for always being by my side...
She hugs the bear even tighter and drifts off to sleep with a big, satisfied smile on her face.
Afternoon sunlight streams through the window, warming the room.
Lora quietly organizes her art supplies. She enjoys drawing because it allows her to express herself without having to deal with other people too much.
The weather outside is great. How about we sketch outside?
Huh? Outside...
Her fingertips gently trace the rim of her palette.
If you'll come... then okay.
Then let's get to it.
In the shade of a tree, Lora sits before her easel. Her brush makes gentle scratching sounds on the canvas.
Occasionally, she gazes at the distant scenery – and every time, she glances at me before returning her attention to the canvas.
Is there anything I can help you with? Anything I can hold, maybe?
N-no, I'm fine...
You can stay right there as you are...
I just wanted to... make sure that my guardian was still there for me.
Don't worry. I promised I'd be here for you.
...Yeah!
She smiles and focuses on her canvas for a longer period than before.
I want to preserve this place and its scenery, using my brush and my canvas.
The scenery I want to paint the most is any place where you are, {tb}...
So you don't have to do anything special...
Just stay right where you are... That’s all I could ever want.
As the sun sets, Lora packs up her art supplies, lays a tarp over the canvas, and holds it lovingly to her chest.
A gentle evening breeze blows through, lifting a corner of the canvas.
Beneath the tree's shade, I see myself on that canvas, smiling at her.
Lora twirls in front of the mirror, causing her skirt to billow slightly.
Uniform, check! Hair, check! I'm in perfect condition today!
{tb}, I'm off to school!
Huh? It's raining... I'd better throw on my rain boots.
The roads are slippery when it rains. Let me walk you to school.
I'm not a little kid anymore. I can go on my own!
So she says, but a different idea seems to come to mind. Her eyes suddenly light up.
Hehe, if you wanna walk me there, then I'd love to take you up on that!
Okay. I'll carry your bag for you.
Yaaay!
Raindrops tap a gentle rhythm onto the umbrella as Lora walks next to me, wearing a yellow raincoat.
Look at this, {tb}. My raincoat has ears on it! Isn't that cute?
Ooh, look, there are snails! One, two... Whoa, they're in a line!
{tb}, there are birds all up on that telephone pole! Aren't they scared of their wings getting wet?
Slow down, or you'll get water in your shoes.
That's not... true!
After a while, she notices that I've lagged behind her, so she stops and offers me her hand.
{tb}... How long has it been since we last walked holding hands?
When I was a little girl, we used to do it all the time when we went out.
That was because I was afraid you'd wander away and get lost.
But now...
She takes a step closer, hand still outstretched, as if not willing to take no for an answer.
If you don't hold my hand, you're gonna get left behind!
I shake my head in resignation and take her hand.
Cold raindrops trickle down her fingers, but her palm is warm. In this moment, our hands interlock without reservation.
Heheh!
Now we can share an umbrella!
Her laughter is like the cheeriest melody amidst the pitter-patter of the rain.
When Lora opens the door, she's amazed by the sight of a world blanketed in white.
Wooow, it's snowing! This is so cool... A-achoo!
She excitedly runs a few steps, but before long, she ducks back under the eaves, rubbing and breathing on her hands to warm them up.
I bring her a warm, fluffy coat and drape it over her shoulders for her.
It's cold out today, so you need to dress warm.
Hehe, okay!
She reaches a hand out to catch the falling snow, hoping to preserve it for as long as she can.
Aw, it melted...
That's how snow is. It falls, and then it melts right away.
After this snowfall, all of the built-up snow on the roadside will be gone in three or four days.
I see...
{tb}! I just had a great idea!
Let's try a different way to make this snow stay a little bit longer!
Lora stacks up big snowballs, finds twigs for arms, and draws a face.
She squats in the snow, gathering up as much as she can. The tip of her nose is cold and pink, but her smile is as radiant as the sun.
Once we bring out a Santa hat and a scarf, the snowman is complete.
Hehe, all done!
I heard snowmen melt a lot slower than snow on the ground...
Now these snowflakes can stay with us a little longer!
She takes a couple of steps back and looks upon her masterpiece happily. But suddenly, her attention turns to me.
Hehe, you're really good at taking care of people, {tb}! We even dressed up this snowman all cute.
But now it's my turn to take care of you!
Let's go in soon. I'll make you a piping-hot cup of hot cocoa with lots and lots of marshmallows!
Oars slice through the water, propelling our little boat into the heart of the tranquil lake.
A gentle, humid breeze blows through. Lora's eyes light up as a mischievous grin creeps onto her lips.
{tb}, let's play a game. You can be the captain, and I'll be First Mate Lora!
Hmm. Alright, First Mate Lora, I need a status report on current travel conditions.
Y-yes, Captain! The waters ahead are clear, and the wind is blowing... southeastward!
I suppress a chuckle and begin to row again.
Umm... Captain, does this ship not have a wheel?
We control the direction it goes using our oars, so they ARE the wheel. Would you like to try spinning the wheel, First Mate?
Yeah!
I offer her an oar, and she takes it solemnly with both hands, as if accepting a sacred mission.
Captain! I'm going to turn hard to port... no, hard to starboard!
An island in the middle of the lake comes into view. Many water birds take flight from it.
Mysterious island spotted ahead! Captain, shall we disembark and investigate?
According to the sea charts, that's a migratory bird sanctuary. First Mate Lora, we'd best observe from a safe distance.
Aye-aye!
Wow... I spy three big, white birds... and two small, grey ones. They're all flying together!
Our little boat glides across the lake, gradually approaching the opposite shore. Thus, our miniature voyage approaches its end.
When we dock, I use reed that I found near the bank to fashion a little badge for Lora.
First Mate Lora, you've completed your maiden voyage with aplomb.
As is tradition, I present you with this trainee badge.
Wooow! This is for me? Thank you, {tb}!
She gives the badge pride of place on her chest and adjusts it a few times to make sure it's perfectly upright.
Captain! When is our next voyage?
We can depart as soon as you're ready.
Hehe... First Mate Lora is always ready for adventure!
Thus, her new reed badge bears witness to all of our afternoon discoveries and adventures.
When I pass by Lora's room, I notice her lying on her desk. The pen in her hand is immobile.
Struggling with your homework?
O-oh, um... Yeah, I guess I am having a little bit of trouble.
I have an assignment to make a diary entry called... "Who I Love the Most."
I wanted to write about you. There are so many things I wanna write, but I don't know where to start...
Also... After I'm done with it, I have to fill out my career plan.
It makes the essay feel even more special...
I sit next to her and look at the blank sheet of paper before her.
Then how about we play a game?
A game...?
Close your eyes. What's the first thing that comes to mind when you think of me?
It's the time we built a snowman together. When we put a cute Santa hat and scarf on that chubby little snowman...
Plus, when we played captain and first mate on the rowboat... Rowing into the middle of the lake and seeing all of those birds take flight...
There was that one rainy day, too. You held an umbrella and took me to class so I wouldn't get wet...
Lora counts events on her fingers, her expression softening with each retelling.
See? You've got plenty to write about, right?
But how can I put all of that into my essay?
Maybe you don't need to. When you're writing a diary entry, what matters is how you feel today.
That does make sense...
I was struggling with my homework, but you came and gave me inspiration.
Now that I'm really thinking about it, the fact that I've come so far is all because you were there with me every step of the way...
I'll be with you for every step ahead, too.
Yeah...! I think I know how to continue with this now!
A few days later, her school application lies on my desk.
In the Career Plans section, there's just one small line of words written in pencil.
Lora's story is about to begin a new chapter.

In the Career Plans section, there's just one small line of words written in pencil.
Lora's story is about to begin a new chapter.
Okey-dokey! From now on, you're {tb} to me!
Morning sunlight shines through the curtains and falls on Lora, who's eating breakfast.
I suddenly notice something – that her shirt sleeves are too short, and her skirt's rim is too tight just above her knees.
Looks like your clothes have gotten a size too small.
Since we're free today, how about we make you some new clothes that fit you better?
Lora nods, a look of anticipation on her face.
The clothing store's interior is brightly lit, with various clothes adorning its hangers.
The openwork of this shirt is so wonderful... And the cut of this skirt, too.
Hmm. I'd love to try all of these on...
{tb}, can you wait here for a bit?
Saying that, carries off the clothes into a dressing room. Once she comes back out, she has changed into an off-shoulder t-shirt and shorts.
H-how do I look?
Incredible... Although, isn't that top a little too short?
And those shorts, well...
This is what's popular these days.
She picks up a round-necked t-shirt. It's a cropped style that highlights her waistline.
What about this?
It's the length I'm thinking about...
She blinks blankly at me, then suddenly breaks into a light snicker.
Wait... Are you the type of person who worries about what their kids wear?
My concern is that you'll catch a cold.
If that's the problem, then how about this one?
Again, it suits you, but it's pretty bare.
Pfft...
Ultimately, we both concede and manage to strike a compromise.
Yes... These look trendy while still being "safe."

Lora hasn't been going outside much as of late.
I've found out that it's because she's been staying up late, and she always sleeps in the next day.
Even now, at breakfast time, not a single ray of light escapes from the door to her room.
(Better go and wake her up.)
I knock on the door and wait for a while.
No response.
(Guess I have to go in...)
I pull open the curtains in her room.
Ugh... So bright...
She blocks out the sunlight with her arm, turns her back to the window, and stays in her futon.
It's not noon already... is it?
Bleh... I'm still sleepy...
Why have you been staying up so late?
Because... Um... Well...
She fumbles her words, occasionally peeking at the floor off to the side.
(What's lying over there? A book?)
Realizing that I'm looking, she hurriedly takes the book and hides it behind her back.
This is my Top-Secret Romance Plan... Y-you can't look at it!
Sure, there's some stuff about you in there... but this is meant for my eyes only!
Her cheeks turn a light red hue.
Look, I promise I won't stay up late anymore. Just don't do anything with the book.
She makes a dead-serious look as she holds up three fingers, like she's swearing an oath.
Alright. It's all good as long as you sleep on time every day. Let's go have breakfast.
Okay! Thanks, {tb}!
She leaves the book on her bookshelf, then gently approaches me and takes my hand.
The weather is wonderful today... If you want to go outside, I'll come with you after we've eaten breakfast!
A few days ago, I bought a Dragon Empery vase with a soft glaze from the market.
Lora took an interest in it, and it wasn't long before her room was filled with encyclopedias of paintings and fine art books.
Which brings us to today, and I just so happened to secure two tickets to a culture and arts exhibit.
There's an art exhibit this weekend. Wanna go look at some marvelous pottery and paintings in person?
I-in person?
Yes, please! Take me with you!
On the day of the exhibit, Lora got up even earlier than I did.
We enter the exhibit hall. She softly tugs on my sleeve and briskly brings me to a display case with ceramic items inside.
She stands on her tiptoes, palms pressed against the glass, staring at the items with a glimmer in her eyes.
Would you mind explaining what these are?
Sure!
This is blue and white porcelain... This is icy jade porcelain... And this is a white, glazed, bamboo-jointed cup!
Like an enthusiastic guide, she introduces me to each item inside the display case one at a time.
I sometimes chime in with a question, and she always gives me the correct answer. She must have put a lot of work into her research.
We leave the exhibit. She hugs an encyclopedia of the exhibit items which she bought at the souvenir shop, walking beside me with light steps.
Did you have fun?
Mhm!
You know, when I saw those works, I realized something...
That beauty is something we can preserve with our own hands...
And I... I want to be someone who creates beauty.
That way, I can take the warmth I see and feel...
And turn it into something that makes you think, "That's beautiful."
She quietly and earnestly pictures her future in her own way.
From the sound of it, I'm also a part of that future.
Lora has started learning the guitar lately.
I arrive outside her room and hear the constant plucking of strings, which is sometimes accompanied by quiet humming.
When I ask her about it, she just looks down and purses her lips, whispering: "It's just casual practice."
So she says, but judging by the calluses on her fingers and the piles of sheet music in her room, she's obviously hiding something.
(It's clear she really likes playing it.)
(Her guitar has gotten pretty old at this point. I bet she'd be thrilled if I gave her a new one.)
So, I headed to a famous music instrument shop in the commercial area.
I went inside, picked out a guitar, and paid for it. Then, as I'm about to leave, I suddenly hear a melody.
It starts with a gentle prelude going into a slow rhythm... accompanied by a familiar hum.
(Is that... Lora's voice?)
I follow the source of the sound, and sure enough, I find Lora inside the practice room...
She sits by the window, her back to the door, holding that same guitar she has used for ages.
Sunlight pours down on her hair and the guitar's strings, her finger movements producing a warm tune.
My hands can't help but push the door open a little more.
Huh?!
Oh, {tb}! Why... Why are you here?
Well, I was getting a new guitar for you. What I'm wondering is – why are you practicing here and not at home?
Uhh... Well...
It's because... I made a song for you!
I was going to play it for you once I'd mastered it...
But, you know, the soundproofing at home isn't the best, and I worried you'd get spoiled on it...
And, uh... It's a song about family.
I wanted to turn the days we've spent together, and those warm and relaxing feelings you've given me, into a song...
Seeing how her ears are turning faintly red, I can't help but crack a smile.
Then, I take the guitar I'd just bought and leave it in front of her.
Try it and see how it feels.
Whoa... I-it's beautiful!
Is this really... for me?
It sure is. It was gonna be a surprise, but I guess I was too late for you.
She stares at the new guitar, then gazes up at me. Tears suddenly well in her eyes, and she shakes her head firmly.
You weren't too late at all...
She holds the new guitar in her arms and plucks a string.
If anything, this is the perfect time for it.
As soon as she begins her prelude, the sunlight outside the window seems to turn softer in response.
Please listen... This is my song for you, my guardian.
It's a weekend afternoon, and Lora and I are visiting the commercial area. Like a cheerful little bird, she walks beside me with a skip in her step.
Look! There's a long line outside that cake store!
Shall we go have a look?
We open the store door, and a sweet aroma hits us instantly.
Lora hastily goes up to the refrigerated display case, where an array of colorful cakes catches her eye.
Wooow! A peach and chocolate mille-feuille! It's just as beautiful as on the posters!
She looks up and stares at me, the light of anticipation glimmering in her eyes.
Although, that matcha and strawberry parfait cake looks really yummy, too...
I'm not sure what to do. I really want them both... Which would you prefer, {tb}?
She knits her brow and shakes my arm. It really looks like she can't make up her mind.
I can buy both if you want.
You mean it?!
But if you do... are you sure you're not spoiling me?
Well, I'm gonna eat them with you.
Hooray! I love you, {tb}!
She breaks into a bright smile again as her voice spikes in excitement.
With two exquisite cake boxes in hand, Lora and I take a seat each on the store's outdoor seating. A passing breeze blows, and she excitedly undoes the ribbon on her cake box.
Let's dig in!
She scoops out a small piece of cake and puts it in her mouth. Her eyes squint with satisfaction.
Mmhh... De-licious!
Using the same spoon, she then takes a big scoop and offers it to me.
{tb}, you should have a taste! Say "ahh"!
See? I told you it was good! ...Hey, wait a minute...
I-isn't this... like an indirect kiss? N-no, it's okay... No harm done!
Y-you know, I heard there's a really good pudding store just across the street! What do you say we, uh... go there next time?
Okay, then it's a promise!
That sudden happening paired with this promise turned our unremarkable weekend afternoon into something special.
It's a pleasantly sunny spring afternoon, and the park's flowers are in marvelous bloom, stretching out like a soft pink-and-white cloud.
Wooow! This place is beautiful!
Lora is wearing light spring clothing. Holding my hand, she walks with me among the flowers.
{tb}, look! That tree is blooming even prettier than the rest!
We should be able to snap some incredible photos with that in the back!
Let's go!
With a modest sprint, she leads me close to the tree. Gazing up, she strikes a pose to catch flower petals with her open hands.
How is this pose?
It looks fantastic.
Heehee. Alright, then I'll leave the rest to you.
Make sure you take some photos that really make your jaw drop!
I lift the camera and take a picture of her amidst the fluttering petals.
That moment, a breeze blows by and brushes a few petals against her hair. Not one to miss this chance, I press the shutter and capture the moment.
Let me have a look!
Whoa... You never told me you were this good at photography!
Can you take more? I'll try a different pose!
The shutter clicks as she laughs, one wonderful moment after the next captured by the camera.
I'm so happy! All these pictures look so pretty. I'm not sure which to pick...
She looks through the pictures in the camera album fondly, then suddenly looks up at me, her eyes twinkling.
Oh yeah, we haven't taken a selfie together yet! Let's do that!
Before I can even respond, she hooks her arm around mine and brings me under the tree.
Alright, let's see a big smile for the camera!
As the final sound of the countdown timer chimes, she moves closer and tightens her grip on my arm.
CLICK!
The camera captures the petals fluttering in the air, and something more beautiful than the spring itself – her smile.
When I get back from shopping for groceries and open the door, the living room is unusually quiet.
Before I can call out to Lora, I hear her voice through her half-open bedroom door.
This card is The Star...
She's lying in bed, playing with tarot cards and carefully reading a book. Apparently, she hasn't noticed my arrival.
The Star, upright. According to the book, {tb}'s beloved is...
Whoa?! {tb}?! Wh-when did you get back?
A blush instantly spreads all the way to her ears. Flustered, she hides the cards under a pillow.
Weren't you out grocery shopping? How did you come back so soon?
I thought you'd be hungry, so I tried to be quick.
Urk... Anyway, I was just studying tarot card readings! This is very serious fortune-telling!
That's great. Can you do a reading for me sometime?
Of course I can! Ask me about anything that troubles you! My readings are alarmingly accurate, you know.
My spread just now was accurate, too! According to this book, The Star upright means...
Suddenly, she goes silent.
Her face turns beet-red again, as if she's embarrassed about it.
It means... g-good...
Good what?
N-nothing! It won't come true if I explain it! That's how tarot cards work.
Lora jumps into my arms suddenly, in an attempt to avoid further questioning.
I sure am hungry! I want your omurice for dinner!
With double the ketchup, right?
Yeah!
When I head to the kitchen to prepare dinner, she runs after me. After a moment's hesitation, she casually asks a question.
Hey, {tb}...
After we eat... would you like me to do a divination for how your love life will develop tomorrow?
As a reward, I'll tell you a little bit about what The Star card means.
Today is the day of Lora's graduation ceremony.
I wake up at the break of dawn and realize that the suit I'm going to wear today is on my bedside table.
After changing into it, I head out into the living room to get ready...
There, I find her standing on the balcony and folding the clothes I'd left out to dry overnight.
I watch her brush off the dust and fold the collars neatly. This is one of the chores she's learned over the past few years.
I'll take care of the rest. You ought to focus on getting ready for the ceremony.
I'm almost done.
Today is a special day for me, that's true...
Not just because you'll be there. More than that...
It's because, today, I'm changing from someone in your care to someone who walks alongside you...
Until today, I always hid behind you. Even when I first went to school, I didn't have the courage to face it alone.
You taught me everything I know – how to tie my shoelaces, how to put my feelings into a diary, how to pick clothes that match...
And how to muster up my courage to truly become a member of society.
So today...
I want to leave this house hand-in-hand with you.
Not with you seeing me off as my guardian, not joining you as your dependent...
But as the two of us, walking together toward my graduation ceremony... and toward the next season of our lives.
I nod along with her words, and she smiles back. Her eyes gleam like stars in the night sky.
Well... Shall we?

scripts.say: Today is Lora's first day at school. I knock on her room door, but she doesn't answer for a while, so I let myself in.
The morning sunlight creeps through the closed curtains, enveloping the quiet room with a faintly golden veil. The bed has been neatly done, yet Lora is nowhere to be seen.
Hello? Lora?
Confused, I shift my gaze over to the window, and then below the desk – that's where I spot the hem of a school skirt peeking out.
Can't see me... Can't see me...
What's wrong? Aren't we walking to school together today?
Ah... Oh no... {tb} found me!
Umm, I... I wasn't hiding on purpose...
I made my bed, then put on my uniform... but then I realized I won't get to see you for the whole day, a-and I just...
I crouch down before her and extend my hand. She lifts one hand from the fetal position she's in, and then takes my hand and rises to her feet.
Look. Your uniform fits perfectly, and you have your schoolbag ready.
You were brave and did almost everything you should before you hid under there, didn't you?
Yeah...
Then let's take it one step at a time. I'll accompany you to the school gate. When school ends, I'll be there when you leave, and we'll go home together.
Okay... I trust you, {tb}!
