Now, how about we get ready to go? Can you put on your shoes on your own if I carry your schoolbag?
Alrighty.
Lora sits down at the entrance and starts diligently tying her shoelaces. Although she is a bit slow, her expression shows that she's concentrating.
Left shoe... Done!
Right shoe... Also done!
Once she finishes, she looks up at me, her small hands clenched into fists on her knees.
{tb}... I'm ready.
Alright. Then let's go.
I open the door, and a gust of wind and the light of the sun rush in.
Lora reaches out and takes hold of my fingers. She's squeezing them firmly, as if afraid, but there's no hesitation in her steps.
Not long after Lora's graduation ceremony, she already has a clear idea of her plans for the future.
She continues to invite me to be part of her life from now on.
Lora has been accepted into her university of choice. She thus begins a journey of gaining further knowledge in pursuit of her dreams.
I'll continue to keep moving forward diligently, but courageously.
I realize that I've always been the kind of girl to worry you...
But thanks to you, I think I can keep doing my best from now on.
Doing my best to become a reliable adult. To become someone you can lean on when you need to.
Thank you, Lora. I look forward to the day that you become the guardian.
Pfft... Hehehe. If you believe in me...
Then I know I can become a guardian who can protect you, {tb}!
After graduation, instead of going straight into the workforce, Lora decides to hone her skills in the field of caring for me.
Welcome home, {tb}!
I got your bath ready, along with your pajamas. But first...
Umm... Today's newly unlocked dinner is... delicious fried chicken!
I experimented with the recipe over and over, and I think this one turned out the best!
The smell of fried chicken fills my lungs right on cue. Warm steam hits my lips.
H-how is it?
Yeah, it sure is delicious!
Hehe, I get to cook good food and take care of you...
My life is bliss.
I hope that you and I can keep living happily together forever...
It truly is bliss to be able to come home to a place of love, warmth, and good food after a day's work.
Lora and I will be happy together forever.
Following her graduation, Lora set up her own high-fashion atelier in a quiet corner of the residential area.
Lora stands on tiptoes by a counter inside a neat and clean room, adding careful touches to a mannequin.
She doesn't notice my arrival until her wind chimes ring. She turns to me with a shy smile.
You're here early today, {tb}.
This dress is almost finished, so just give me a minute.
A formal dress? It's got a very unique design.
Looks kind of familiar, though...
...That's because it's designed to match your uniform.
If I could wear this dress to an event with you... Wouldn't we look fantastic?
Mustering her courage, she looks at me with a twinkle of anticipation in her eyes.
Morning sunlight pours through the shop window, projecting our embracing silhouettes on the silk, smooth as snow.
Led by her cheerful and sharing disposition coupled with her love for food, Lora became a food influencer.
Today we're eating a burger, and I have to say, it is deee-licious! You guys should definitely try it out!
Sitting opposite me, Lora contently licks her lips and brings her hamburger closer to the camera, capturing the golden juices oozing out of it.
Look, {tb}! My stream is doing numbers!
I hand her one fresh hamburger after the next in front of the camera. By the time the stream ends, a pile of crumpled wrappers has piled up on the table.
Whew. Stream's done!
{tb}, my viewcount reached another all-time high today!
Heehee – you know, even regular food tastes amazing when I eat it with you!
By the way, I booked a table for tonight at that restaurant just the other day. Want to come with? It'll be a good chance to record some footage for my next video!
The table lamp casts a warm glow, lighting up the comfy room.
Lora is in her "writing mode" again – for a popular web novelist like her, nights like this aren't at all uncommon.
She wears spacious pajamas and lies stomach-down on the carpet, her fingers darting across the keyboard. Her eyes are glued to the screen.
Mh... Whuh? {tb}?! When'd you get back?
Since her focus is solely on typing, she doesn't notice that I'm here until I call out to her.
That's some amazing concentration you have. How's your next work coming along?
Pretty well... I've gotten more fans, and my stuff has even appeared on the front page. Heehee.
A-and that's why I've set my mind to post chapter five by today!
Since I've finished my detailed plot synopsis, now is the time to work 'til I drop.
Alright, then I'll tidy up the place. You just keep working.
By the way, that posture is bad for your neck. Try to change it up once in a while.
If you're worried you'll forget, I can sit here and keep watch. I'll remind you when you need it.
What? N-no... I can't concentrate if you stare at me the whole time... I won't be able to write properly...
I'll take breaks, I promise. You just do your thing and wait for my next chapter!
Lora turned her love of photography into a dream career and became a journalist after graduation.
Her first assignment after joining a firm is to take pictures of me.
Donning a sharp uniform, Lora holds the camera in front of me and carefully adjusts the lens and lighting.
{tb}– Aw, shoot, excuse me!
Commander, can I have a bit of your time in a few days? I'd like to conduct an exclusive interview with you!
Hmm... Calling you "Commander" is going to take a bit of getting used to.
You know what? I'll just search and replace your name all at once when I write the draft. Heheh.
I'm all done adjusting my equipment. Let's start the shoot.
Keep smiling just like that, {tb}. These photos will definitely cover the front page tomorrow!
SNAP!
Heehee! These look fantastic! It's such a privilege, getting to capture you in your most important moments...
Becoming a journalist was the best thing I ever did!
Lora graduated, but was still as socially awkward as she'd always been, and spent most of her time in her own world.
Time passed until she finally found something she wanted to do, and she began working hard for it...
Whuah... {tb}, you're here?
It's afternoon, and sunlight shines through the bedroom window and onto Lora, partially wearing a mascot costume.
Because the suit is so stuffy, her cheeks are red and small beads of sweat dot her skin, and her wet hair sticks to her body.
After a while of muttering and stuttering, she summons her courage and explains the situation.
This is a... polar bear costume...
I was practicing my polar bear act for a bit... but it got way too hot, so I... I partly took it off...
I'm going to have to wear this thing a lot... so I knew I couldn't give up just because it got hot...
But then my tail got caught as I was putting it on again to practice more... a-and I can't pull up the zipper on my own...
Could you... give me a little help?
I help her zip up her costume. She stands up somewhat awkwardly and gives me a smile.
She chose this path after mustering her courage, and I'm sure that it will lead her to a bright and warm future one day.
After graduating, Lora picked the path of weaving warm everyday moments with flowers.
Good morning, {tb}. All the sunflowers that arrived today look so healthy. Would you like one?
Morning. Is it just me, or did you get more flowers than usual this time?
That's because I got a large order. A nearby elementary school is opening a new hall today, and they want flowers for decoration.
Man, you've become a really reliable florist.
Heehee. At first, all I wanted was to make you understand that seeing flowers makes me happy...
Then one thing led to another, and now, here I am!
By the way... I have a lot on my hands today. Too much for one person to handle. If you're free, do you think you could be my temp?
Only a temp?
Ahem... W-well, come to think of it, delivering all these flowers by myself is a tall order...
Say, um... Maybe you could help me with it for a while?
Inspired by the stories and sights of far-flung lands, Lora decided to become a traveler after graduation.
The frequent postcards and photos she sends me from all over the world always show her with a bright smile.
Not far away, white doves gather around a white-dressed Lora, pecking bits of bread from her hand.
Ah! {tb}. You should've told me you were here! Why didn't you say anything?
Though a certain white bird might fly off I did.
That wouldn't scare them... Wait... Is it me you're referring to?
How many days are you staying here for?
I'm taking a plane later tonight. I knew you'd always pass through here, so I waited for you.
It's as you said, {tb}... The world is a beautiful place. I still feel like something's missing, though.
You've got plenty of time, so there's no rush. You'll find it eventually.
I already have. I'm just not sure if I can bring it with me.
Saying that, she produces two airplane tickets and offers one to me.
Will you come with me on a journey? This time, I want to do it holding hands with you – just like we used to.
It's night at the amusement park. The merry-go-round glows with a magical light.
At the edge of that light, Lora stands and looks up, dazzled by the twinkling scene before her.
Wanna ride it?
Maybe... a little...
But... I'm scared to do it... all alone...
Her voice turns quieter with each word. She folds her fingers anxiously, yet her gaze is fixated on the beautiful wooden horses moving up and down.
It's alright. I'll ride it with you.
...Okay!
As a light waltz plays in the background, Lora mounts the white horse next to me, and then we set off, riding "side by side."
Aww... It looks so pretty... but it's so high up...
B-but... you're here with me, so I'm not scared!
Carefully, she squeezes the handrail and occasionally takes a glance at me. A glimmer of subdued excitement shines in her eyes.
Umm... {tb}... Can I hold your hand?
I'm having so much fun... I feel like I'm gonna go flying...
Without a hint of hesitation, I take hold of her extended little hand.
Relax. I won't let go of you.
Heehee... As long as you hold my hand, I'm not gonna fly anywhere...
She happily shakes the hand of mine that is holding hers with a relieved look, like that of a small animal having found an owner to rely on.
The music finally stops, and the wooden horses slowly come to a halt. Lora lets go of my hand, an expression of slight reluctance on her face.
{tb}... N-next time, I wanna ride this glowy merry-go-round again while you hold my hand!
Lora found a way to converse with the sea – using a fishing rod, a bucket full of bait, and her endless determination.
At this point, she has become a fairly famous fisherwoman.
Sun is high, weather's right, come on fishies, come and bite♪
Oh! The bobber twitched!
Boy, this fish is a strong one... I always like a worthy opponent! Let's see what you're made of!
Both sides fight with all they have, displaying stunning resilience. It makes even me, as a bystander, feel on the edge of my seat.
Are you winning?
This guy will run out of stamina any second... now! Scoop net! Fetch the scoop net!
As she lifts the rod at the last second, a silvery fish jumps out of the water. We exclaim nearly the same thing in amazement.
That's a big one! Sheesh... It must weigh nearly as much as I do!
That's a big one! Damn... It's gotta weigh nearly as much as you!
Heehee... I think we should tie it to the back of the car and drive around the city to show it off on the way home!
I used to make coffee in the morning for Lora a lot. As time went on, coffee came to hold a special place in her heart.
After graduating, she chose to become a barista, perhaps as a gentle response to that sentiment.
You're here earlier than usual... By several minutes.
Yeah, because it's cold outside. I basically jogged over.
Then how about a sunshine mocha to warm you up?
If that's what you recommend, I'll have it.
The coffee machine hums quietly, and streams of steam rise. It's quiet enough that I can even hear her breathing.
She extracts the coffee with a practiced technique, whisks the milk, and adds latte art before presenting the finished drink to me.
Here's your sunshine mocha.
I thank her and take the cup of coffee, after which she lets out a slightly concerned gasp.
Your hand is red as an apple from the cold...
How about putting the cup down... and letting me warm your hands?
Gently, she takes my hands and gives me a somewhat embarrassed smile.
The next time you feel cold... tell me about it.
The girl who used to use tarot cards to uncover the secrets of the heart has now truly made the crystal ball and the cards hers.
{tb}, welcome to my parlor of divination.
Mind reading my fortune for me?
Gladly. But first, what kind of reading would you like? Hehe, ask the question in your mind – you don't need to speak it aloud.
...I've already thought of one.
Indeed, and I have seen the question burning within you.
In the near future, there may be a positive transformation in your romantic luck...
Really? The thing is, I actually didn't have a question in mind.
That's no problem, because I was actually reading my own future!
My crystal ball tells me that you and I are going to have a wonderful, blissful life together.
Also, tomorrow is the perfect time for promising oaths. You'd better prepare for that!
Are you sure that's what the crystal ball is saying? It sounds more like what you want to say.
Hehe, I think today might be even better than tomorrow! Come on, let's go!
In the quiet bookstore, a small figure is hard at work.
This is the path that Lora chose in the end: working at a bookstore. The store is quiet, cozy, and surrounded by books – the perfect environment for her.
She stands on her tiptoes, trying her hardest to push a book into an empty space on the top shelf.
Let me help.
Huh... Oh, you came. Are you doing more research today?
Yep, and I figured I'd check in on you in the process.
I see... In the process, hm? By the way, didn't you just buy that book yesterday?
...Did I?
Yeah. Whenever you come in, you stay by me for a long time, pretending to pick out a book, and eventually leave with a book that nobody's bought in ages.
Sorry. Did I interrupt your work?
No, not at all... I honestly wouldn't mind if you stayed longer.
To tell you the truth, I wait every day for the time you come by.
Lora leans in and gives me a big hug.
Let me hide here for a while... My face is burning right now. If you see it... I'll be really embarrassed.
Lora has learned to harness the melodies that resonate with her heart.
She chose to become a pianist, in order to share the voice of her soul with the whole world.
Like the morning sun piercing through the clouds, the final note seems to wake me up from a dream.
When the performance is over, I applaud vigorously.
That last piece...
Did you really notice?
Her ears flush red little by little.
I've always thought... that I wanted to write a piece just for you.
I infused it with all of my gratitude, trust, and admiration... along with the deep love that I could never put into words.
Plus, that final variation is my wish to continue moving forward alongside you.
Will you please keep being the first person to hear my new songs?
I'd love to.
She smiles. After that, the music I've come to know and love bounds from her keys once again.
Lora chose to become a botanist, living a life surrounded by silent plants.
She believed that some beauty could transcend time, becoming eternal in a different form.
The herbarium is so quiet that even my footsteps sound loud. Plants from all over the world are displayed in bottles around the room.
When I see her asleep at her work desk, I pick up her coat and lay it over her shoulders.
{tb}... You're here. It's okay – I was just about to get up anyway.
Did you stay up all night working on specimens again?
Yeah. When I'm doing my work, I always feel like time has slowed down.
You have to be careful and treat them like the most fragile and precious of treasures.
And that's how they can maintain their form for over a hundred years?
But the truth is, nature herself makes the best specimens of all. Do you know about amber?
When a pine tree is wounded, it sheds tears that can encase passing bugs. The resin then hardens over millions of years...
Coincidences like that must be rare.
Yes... But I think that, like amber, there are things that can transcend time.
Lora takes my hand and gently leans on me.
Why don't you and I see... if this love will last forever, too?
Welcome back, Commander.
When I take off the terminal, Painlevé is the first to greet me.
You were immersed in there for quite some time... How was the new system I designed?
It's not bad at all. Still, I can't help but think that I missed a bunch of choices without realizing.
You can only experience one of countless possibilities at a time.
The thing we call life – be it a simulation or not – isn't something that we can get a complete view of in just one go, after all.
Every time we start over, it symbolizes a new beginning...
I want to experience more different lifetimes with you, too!
Agreed. I look forward to collecting more data, as well.
Shall we go back to the day we first met?
I wonder what kind of future awaits us this time.
A night breeze creeps in through a gap in the window, bringing with it a chilly sensation exclusive to this season.
It's gotten pretty cold outside, so I got you a little gift.
A... A gift?
With a hesitant motion, she undoes the ribbon on the box and opens it. The next moment, her eyes light up.
Is this... a scarf?
Yeah. Try putting it on.
She carefully takes the red scarf out and gently strokes the soft velvet with her fingertips, then puts it on like she were handling a priceless artifact.
After gently coiling the scarf around her neck, she casts her gaze down a bit and feels the fluffy fabric with her hand. She breaks into a smile.
It's warm...
Do you like it?
Yeah... It's fluffy and it feels nice...
She speaks through the scarf, a vaguely nasal twang present in her voice on account of it.
When she looks up again, her eyes have a clear glimmer of joy in them, and a light blush adorns her cheeks.
I feel warm... both inside and outside...
I-I'm gonna wear this every day!
Saying that, she buries her face in the scarf again, and she looks at me with her twinkling eyes.
C-can I... wear it at home, too?
If you want to.
I'll... I'll take really good care of it...
{tb}, where are we going today?
That's a secret.
It'd ruin the surprise if I told you now, wouldn't it?
I-it would?
We're almost there... Hey, don't be in such a rush, Lora.
Oh! I-I just got so excited I couldn't help it. Heehee...
Bunnies! So many of them!
I brought some fresh leafy vegetables along. Try feeding them and they might become friends with you.
Okay! I'll try.
She picks up a leaf and slowly extends it before a rabbit. She's so nervous that even her tail is stiff as a board.
Whoa... It ate it!
Eat lots of veggies and grow biiig, bun-buns!
{tb}, do you wanna try? They're really gentle.
She drags me into the bunny enclosure and places a leaf in the palm of my hand.
I present it to another rabbit, this one grey in color. It hesitates for a bit, but it sniffs the smell of the leaf and leaps forward with a hippity hop to eat the leaf that Lora's holding.
Wait... Huh?
I-it probably just didn't like the smell of that leaf. Let's try again with a fresh, clean leaf.
I pick up a new leaf and present it. This time, Lora suddenly comes up and takes a chomp out of it.
Mmm. Yummy...
I immediately bring Lora away to rinse the leaf bits out of her mouth.
Now, why'd you go and eat that leaf?
Because... Because even if the bunnies don't trust you...
I will always... always trust you, {tb}.
Wooow, so pretty...
Lora sits by the window, reading something intently.
Huh? {tb}, you're back! Look at this!
She runs over and stands on her tiptoes, stretching up as much as she can to show me a magazine.
Its pages depict a forest of pink and white flowers in peak bloom.
If you have time... I want to go and look at the flowers together!
I'm free on Sunday... but the weather forecast is calling for rain. It might be hard to go out that day.
But if we wait until next week, we might miss our chance...
I guess I have to wait until next year...
On one weekend morning, I gently knock on Lora's door.
*yaaawn*... Just five more minutes, and then I'll go to school... Huh? Isn't it the weekend?
We have a long trip ahead of us today. If you're still sleepy, you can nap in the car.
Okaaay!
Rain rolls down the car windows, leaving long streaks.
The weather forecast was right... It's really raining.
Where are we going, {tb}?
Wanna guess?
Hmm... I don't know.
Her voice trails off as the gentle rocking of the car lulls her back to sleep.
Before long...
Lora, we're here.
Nnh...? Huh, wait, is that...
Oh, they're beautiful... Even the air smells nice.
Huh... Where'd the rain go? Wasn't it raining when we were in the car?
I double-checked the forecast. It's raining in the city, but not outside of it.
I-I didn't know that could happen... You're really amazing, {tb}!
Do you like the scenery here?
I love it!
Our basket is full, too... You were secretly making snacks last night, weren't you?
Yep. I wanted to have lots of different foods for us to eat during our picnic.
Oranges, bananas, sandwiches... They all look tasty!
I love it!
Glad you're happy.
And I love you, {tb}!
Ahem... I'm gonna go sit down for a bit. If you want to play, don't wander too far, alright?
I lie down on the picnic blanket and close my eyes. Sunlight filters down through the branches, casting shadows on my eyelids.
Suddenly, I hear a soft rustle next to me. That small, warm presence slips gently into my arms.
Lora remains well-behaved. She always wakes up on time, takes her homework seriously, and stays quiet and focused when reading.
Thanks to that, I almost never have to worry about her... except for one thing. Her overly considerate nature occasionally leaves me with a vague anxiety.
Around this time, I start taking her for walks at a park near our home.
The park has lush lawns, flowers, and a small swing – which becomes her favorite toy in no time.
Sunset paints the clouds in warm hues. The swing begins to rock back and forth, carrying sunset's glow along with her shadow.
I think I swung a little higher today.
Do you really?
Yeah! Because I feel all relaxed now... I'm not as scared as I was the first time.
Plus, I know that you're always right there behind me.
That's right. I'll always be here watching over you, Lora.
If you'd like, we can go somewhere even higher up.
Like where?
How about the observation deck up on that hill?
The swing comes to a slow stop. When her feet touch the ground, she turns to face me. Curiosity changes to excitement.
I can go anywhere with you, {tb}... Hehe.
Okay, it's a promise...
Lora stands up and gently takes my hand.
Twilight gently embraces us, bringing tranquil warmth to the small swing, her fingers, and the long path ahead of us.
Lora and I made plans to go to an amusement park today.
Once she was tired out, she said that she wanted to eat some fluffy ice cream.
However, when I returned with the ice cream, she was nowhere to be found.
{tb}, over here!
She runs over with a bunch of balloons and a big smile on her face. They make little rustling sounds as they bump into each other.
What's with the balloons?
Well, I just realized something...
Remember how we were playing on the swing, and you promised we'd go somewhere even higher?
I saw a balloon stand a while ago, and it made me think...
If I got enough balloons, could they help us fly off somewhere together?
The wind blows, causing all of the balloons to jerk upwards. Lora stands on her tiptoes, hoping to fly, but all they do is make her wobble a little.
Hmm... I guess I don't have enough balloons yet.
I have a better idea, you know.
Huh?
I point behind her – at the Ferris wheel slowly rotating beneath the deep blue sky.
Wanna ride together?
Despite the gondola being stuffed half-full of balloons, there's enough space for Lora to kneel on the seat and gaze out the window, watching the rides below us shrink as we rise.
We're so high up...
It's even higher than the observation deck.
The apex of this Ferris wheel is the highest point in the city.
Wow... I guess my wish has come true.
But the fact that it came true while you were here makes me even happier.
The gondola slowly rises to its apex. Everything below us, from the park attractions to the distant sea, shines in the sunlight.
But it's the sight of her smile, clutching those colorful balloons, that delights me more than the view outside.
嗯？TB，怎么了？
新衣服......好看？
这是在问她穿这套新衣服好不好看吧？嗯，这种时候要多夸夸孩子
当然，TB穿着新衣服非常好看
好看。
不知道为什么，心里有一种莫名的感动。孩子长大了啊~
嗯，和TB一样呢。

sequence:
Class Z I

<size=45>Troublesome Kids Come From The Port</size>

scripts.say: Academy Port
*Sigh*... What should we do...
*Sigh*... What should we do...
I guess every school has some students like them...
Looks like I'll need to "discipline" them. With my whip, that is...
Um, Köning... I think a whipping might be too much.
Tsk. Oh well...
But still... *Sigh*... What exactly should we do about them...
We can't just let them do as they please.
I just so happened to overhear your concerns, Köln and Königsberg!
Zed? When did you get here?
No matter! Please allow me to deal with your problematic students!
I'll give them a lengthy lecture on how important and fun it is to study!

sequence:
Class Z II

<size=45>Social Reject And Proud Of It</size>

scripts.say: First you do the thingy here... Then the next thingy!
Crap! I'm gonna die!
Oh nooo! Game over... I guess I gotta practice more if I want to beat this on the hardest difficulty.
Oh dear... How on earth can you live in a room as cluttered as this...
Hello? Hang on, I remember you... You're Z23, from Iron blood, right?
Correct! Now listen, Long Island: as a member of the fleet, it is both a privilege and your duty to actually study!
Come with me! Leave your shut-in life behind and we shall study together!
S-stop being a shut-in?! Fat chance!
Setting sail already takes so much effort, and now you want me to use my precious time off on studies? Heck no!
Um... Did I forget to tell you that studying can be relaxing...
You can't trick me as the commander did! Try to convince me all you want, but I'm not going anywhere!
My pride as a social reject depends on it!

sequence:
Class Z III

<size=45>Who's There?</size>

scripts.say: I wasn't able to make Long Island leave her room... *Sigh*...
Now's not the time to fret, me! ...Let's see, next in line is...
San Diego!
Heyaaa! I'm right here~!
I was looking for you! Perhaps you already know why I'm here?
Hmm... To play a game with us, right?
No, I'm here to tutor you! Your grades have been bad and it's making the teachers worry! If you won't study hard then you won't be of any use to the commander.
Tutoring, huh... Okay! I'm super duper smart so studying will be a walk in the park for me~!
It's good to see that you're motivated! (That went well... Looks like I managed to convince San Diego to study...)
So, how about starting with math...
Maff? Sure... Easy peasy! Probably!
A Few Minutes Later
W-what happened here...
Aha, ahaha... I'm seeing so many big, pretty stars... One, two... Where am I? Who am I?
A-are you okay, San Diego?! Please, come to your senses! How could you get knocked out from such a simple task?!

sequence:
Class Z IV

<size=45>Taboo Double Trouble!</size>

scripts.say: Ughhh... This time, I definitely have to succeed...
Let me see... Next up... is Miss Saratoga.
"She loves playing pranks, so watch out", is it? All right then.
Several minutes later, outside the counselor's office
Okay, Miss Saratoga is waiting for me inside. I'm ready to head in-
Eh? The door's partially open... and a blackboard eraser is wedged in the door panel?
Really likes pranks, eh? Isn't this way too old school? I almost want to get hit by that thing just as a tribute...
However! My objective today is to set these problem children straight!
I have to teach Miss Saratoga that the classroom is a sacred site of learning, not a place to play pranks!
I just have to carefully avoid this eraser while opening the door...
(Boom!)
Uwah!!
The classic door trap is just a decoy! The real trap is the highly precise carrier-based eraser-bomber! This is Saratoga's specialty, the Taboo Double Trouble! Hehe, scared ya, didn't I?
Miss... Sa... ra...!
My, oh my...
Th-this voice... can it be? Saratoga out! *Jets out of the classroom in a puff of dust*
Haah... that Sara, causing trouble for others again. Z23, are you okay?
Miss Lexington...
This time, I really will have to properly "educate" that sister of mine. I am truly sorry. After I find her, I will make sure she apologizes.
Ugh... I wasn't able to do any tutoring yet again...

sequence:
Class Z V

<size=45>The Melancholy of Z23</size>

scripts.say: Uuugh... why won't things ever work out?
Maybe... I'm just a powerless student after all...
Oh my... it seems that I've come across a child who needs some illustrious guidance~
I-Illustrious? Uwaahh...
There, there... let me help get this burden off your chest~
So... the situation is like this...
So that's what's going on. Ahh, all the kids are so energetic~
Ener... getic...
How could there be any bad children in this naval base? If you try to put yourself in their shoes more and become a part of their lives, who is to say that the problems won't resolve themselves?
Become a part of their lives...
Zed, do you truly wish to help them from the bottom of your heart? If that is the case, surely you will be able to find common ground with them.
I... I understand now. One more... I'll give it one more try!
Ahh... good girl~ I'll be cheering you on~

sequence:
Class Z VI

<size=45>Let's Dash! </size>

scripts.say: To become a part of their life... Okay! First up is...
Long Island! Let's have a challenge!
Eh?
Using games!
Ehhh? Hehe... hehehe... you dare face the God of Gaming, the Vizier of Vidya, Long Island? You sure have guts. I'll accept your challenge!
If I win, you'll have to accept your tutoring obediently!
You ought to save it 'til after you win~
I... I lost...?
Heheh, a promise is a promise~
I never thought I'd make such an elementary error... to let my opponent select the game... what the heck is Sudoku...
Guh... I know, I know... I'll go to tutoring!
What is it~ Something fun~?
Mhm. I was in too much of a rush before. If it's San Diego, I have to start with something more basic.
Miss Sara will be there as well.
Yahoo~ I'll be able to play with Sara again~
I'm sorry, Z23, I just wanted to joke around with you a bit...
Don't worry about it... However, that "Taboo Double Trouble" of yours... Miss Sara sure has some flair.
Heh heh, pranks never go out of style precisely because they're fun!
Um.... (looks both ways nervously) Big Sis isn't here, right... She'd give me another earful if she heard that...
Hey, look at it this way. Would you rather play pranks that leave you feeling guilty, or would you rather do something glorious and fun that won't get you "disciplined?"
Eh? Is there really something that nice?
For example, we could conduct an experiment using carrier aircraft to make artificial rain, or make rainbows... or something along those lines?
That does sound interesting~
These are all examples of how fun studying can be, so make sure to come to tutoring!
Eh... I somehow still feel like my leg is getting pulled... f-fine!
All right! This time, I'll definitely be able to succeed!
Everyone, get ready~ after-school special tutoring is about to begin!

sequence:
Class Z VII

<size=45>Teach Me, Miss Z23! </size>

scripts.say: I heard Zed was here...
What's "special tutoring?" Sounds like something that would be fun with the Commander~
Ayanami... also wants to be Z23's student...
Y-you've come to tease me, haven't you?!
"Teach me, Miss Z23!!"
All right, all right. There's no point being shy now...
This is important! (knocks on the blackboard) If you don't take notes carefully, Miss Z23 is going to punish you!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party I

<size=45>「Ladies At 3 O’Clock」</size>

scripts.say: Ding Dong~ Let’s begin our afternoon tea party!
Wait a minute, before we start I have a question. Why are we holding a tea party?
Typical, a Royal Navy maid wishes to know of our intentions? The reason is—— only meant for adults to know!

We're holding a tea party for all those hard working sisters out in the cold in order to warm them up. So no matter how tired everyone gets, {namecode:14} will be here to greet everyone with a pot of hot tea!
I hope I get an opportunity to help everyone relax. What’s more, some sisters are just constantly staying in their rooms lately...
{namecode:13} is not always staying in her room, {namecode:13} is merely just… hibernating! Yes, {namecode:13} is hibernating.
...Sister, you’re always telling half-truths, who’s going to believe you.
If you're always hiding in dark places with no light, then I'll get worried...
Naturally, {namecode:13} has got lamps in her room, so not to worry!
...Illustrious, besides {namecode:13}, where are those other introverted sisters?
Are you referring to the one from the Northern Parliament? Unfortunately, she is still a little shy to attend...
Just wait until winter, we’ll lure her out with a snowman.
And… Miss. Hood is not coming as well?
She and Prince of Wales were given a rare day off, so likely she won't have time to attend this tea party.
Ok, if I may interrupt this chit-chat, let’s get everyone to taste the traditional afternoon tea from the Sakura Empire.
Please have a try of {namecode:13}'s signature dish.
O, I’ve been highly anticipating this~
… O my, this taste——!!!
—— Why is this so bitter! My eyes are getting watery! There must be some kind of dark chocolate inside!
Hmm… so this is what matcha tastes like. It really is a unique flavour~
Huh, {namecode:11} did not come? She shouldn’t be on a mission today, right?
Sister...
—— She left a note and then headed out!
A note?
I won't attend this tea party without {namecode:12}!... {namecode:12}, just wait, I'll definitely come get you!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party II

<size=45>「A Queen Afraid of Loneliness」</size>

scripts.say: Thank goodness Belfast brought black tea...
As a maid of the Royal Navy, having tea on-hand is a given.
(Bites lip) I’m also a maid, so, so… tea should be a must-have?
After tasting the bitterness of matcha, I will cherish even more the sweetness of other foods.
Having black tea after tasting matcha tea, what an opportunity to compare the two flavours.
{namecode:13} also wants to try the black tea prepared by Belfast!
Wait, wait for me——!
Hey, all of you didn’t care to invite me to this tea party!
Hmm, didn't your Majesty once say to me, “As Queen, I have a tremendous amount of tasks and responsibilities, how can I possibly spend time with you commoners!”
But, but everyone is gone and I am all alone. It’s very.... Wait, are you telling me I'm not welcomed here!

Of course you're welcome here~ You honour us with your presence. The fact that your Majesty can take time out of your busy schedule to join us for this tea party makes me feel privileged~ Please take a seat your Majesty.
Come to think of it, Belfast you failed in your duties! I told you last night before bed to wake me up this morning! I ended up sleeping until noon, it’s all your fault!
Yes of course your Majesty, I failed in my duties as maid to wake you from your sleep. I will take to heart this dereliction of duty as a serious offense——
No matter, if you’ll tell me bedtime stories every night henceforth then I shall forgive you. I slept a little late last night indeed. So, where’s my tea?
Here~ this tea was especially prepared for you by the Sakura Empire. I hope that your Majesty likes it~
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[North Latitude 34° East Longitude 140°]
A single person alone can be a bit… but——Ninja {namecode:11} will never give up even if I'm facing danger alone! Here I come, Northern Parliament!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party III

<size=45>「Dawn, Love To Sleep In...」</size>

scripts.say: Your Majesty, it’s time to wake up~
Zzzz…...
(Leans close to Queen Elizabeth’s ear) Today’s breakfast is your favourite buttered toast~
Moan... Give me a moment... Zzzz...
If you continue to sleep, then I'm afraid you'll be eating breakfast alone your Majesty.
...Belfast... Will accompany me... Zzzz
It really can't be helped... your Majesty, there will be a new sister arriving today~
Zzzz... A new girl... Really?! Do I know her... My head hurts... Belfast... Help me get up...
...Belfast?
...Sorry, I lied, there is no one coming, you can sleep a little longer your Majesty.
...Is that so... well then... Zzzz
I'm simply advising you to not work all night long… Your Majesty should rest a little longer… Argh, I'm such a careless maid, I forgot to wake up the Queen this morning (smiles).
Hmm… we still got some time left, let me enjoy glancing at your Majesty’s face while you sleep for another 10 minutes more~
Hehe~ That sleeping face your Majesty makes is so cute~
Back at the tea party——
This snack is delicious, who made this?
My sister made these, scones are her speciality.
Oh? I thought you made them, Belfast. Both of you make very similar tea and snacks.
Hehehehe….
Haha, I'll take that as a compliment.
This snack tastes… how should I put it—— right. You can taste all love and effort from you sisters.
{namecode:14}, don't look at me that way, enough I get it already, I'll learn how to bake scones the way Edinburgh makes it—— Even though I might not be able to make it as tasty.
It’s ok, I can wait, not matter how long it takes for you to learn to bake this!
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[North Latitude 28° East Longitude 167°]
Should the northern side of the Sakura Empire be this warm… might be caused by greenhouse effects, scary!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party IV

<size=45>「Noon, Beloved Belfast!」</size>

scripts.say: Argh.... darn it, I failed again! I obviously sprinkled just a bit more than I should've, but why is it so sweet!
You left your key on the table while heading out, I brought it for you here, sister.
K-Key? Ahh! Thank you so much Belfast...
Are you making scones again sis? How is it this time?
Sigh, have a taste yourself——
...The sugar is not evenly spread out...You didn't mix the sugar when you sprinkled it in, right? Also, I think the temperature was a bit too high...
Sigh… as sisters, how come the gap between our talents is wide...
You're being too hard on yourself sis, there are plenty of things that you do better than me...
Really?! Like what???
Like I'm going to tell you, you'll have to find that out yourself~
Tell me, Belfast~
N - O, NO
Hmph——
As for the snacks for the tea party… as usual, just leave that to me.
I don't want to rely on you forever, Belfast… If only I could be more like you...
The most important thing a person should not do is try and be like someone else, so just be yourself. Besides, I'm not worthy of your admiration...
In short, you should live the way you always have sister. Leave the hard work of being the perfect maid to me.
Really... hehe~ Belfast, I love you sis!
Really now? Rushing over to hug me while I’m cracking eggs….
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[North Latitude 21° West Longitude 158°]
It's getting hotter and hotter, my clothes are all soaked... Must be because I ran too much! A route sign ahead, Honolulu? What does this mean? No matter, as long as I keep on moving forward!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party V

<size=45>「Afternoon Nap Time」</size>

scripts.say: Say, how do you all spend your afternoon?
Play video——

Sister, if you're always staying in your room and not showing your face in port, everyone will start to forget you. In the end, even the color of your portrait in the "Archives menu" will start to fade.
Is this the so-called “social death”? ...so, so scary...
It’s nice to be with friends whenever you’re on break.
Is that so, no, no matter, {namecode:13} is also my friend!
Really?
Of course! {namecode:37}, {namecode:24}, {namecode:15} are all my friends.
If I remember correctly, aren't you all members of the “Afternoon Nap” club.
“Afternoon Nap” club?
Well, well... in the “Afternoon Nap” club we all gather, hold hands and close our eyes. We'll nap inside during the brightest part of the day.
That sounds interesting, when’s the next time you all are doing this again? Can I also join you?
I knew it, there you are, your Majesty!
Ark Royal? Why are you here?
Because my afternoon was... um, very busy!
Don’t tell me you… again?

During noon time, the sunlight was shining slightly westward. Those cute destroyer girls were all lining up and transporting supplies along the routes—— These dangerous operations must have extra protection to guard the cargo! As a new aircraft carrier with the best reconnaissance and long-range strike capabilities, I, Ark Royal, am compelled to go!
In other words, you followed them?
Of course not! I was merely worried about attacks from hostile forces!
Isn’t the transport route completely cleared of hostiles by now?

Even so, we musn’t rule out the possibility of their return! And, and... What if those destroyers get lost! What if they lose track of the time while playing and forgot to come home, or what if they encounter a typhoon! Out there in the depths of the ocean, the only thing they can rely on is my swordfishes！

“Thank you, thank you, Ark Royal, for saving me, without you I just wouldn't know what to do… can we call you sister from this day forward?”...“Sister Ark Royal, I'm cold…”, ...“Thank you, sister Ark Royal, umm, umm, I like you the most!”
Heh~heh~heh
Ark Royal, please wake up.
That being the case, why are you here at the tea party?
Because I heard that your Majesty was here, although I did not anticipate that you would be here Belfast...
In all honesty, it’s better if you were a bit further away from her Majesty.
(Angry) The both of you better listen carefully to what I'm about to say. I am not a destroyer!
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[South Latitude 2° West Longitude 139°]
N-not there yet… I'm already so exhausted… {namecode:12} is constantly living in such harsh environments... {namecode:12}, I'll be there soon!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party VI

<size=45>「The Elegant Bluff」</size>

scripts.say: A few days prior to the tea party.
Cygnet, what are you and Edinburgh doing? Your faces are all dirty, come here and let me wipe off the dirt.
Ack! Ah! That...
We are adding tea leaves to our baked sweet potatoes, do you want to try, Hood?
Baked sweet potatoes? Can I have a taste?
Umm, the food prepared at my home tastes far worse than those snacks prepared by Belfast, and...
Hood, this was freshly roasted.
W-wait! Let us go wash them first...
You didn't wash it before you eat it? That’s alright, just enjoy its original flavour.
That, umm, those all got dirty...
Hmm? Your hands will get stained, but this is part of the enjoyment of eating this dish. Cygnet, you didn’t….
… So, umm, how does it taste?!
Yes… very delicious, the sweetness is just right.~
R-really? We thought that peeling sweet potatoes would be below what the eloquent Hood would tolerate to do.
(Laughs) Who exactly do you think I am? If peeling sweet potatoes is below me, then that kind of eloquence—— must be some kind of bluff.
That’s right, that’s right! Hood, let me teach you how to roast them.~
Belfast is so busy she refused to come out to roast sweet potatoes! Honestly, if only she can be as understanding as you are——
Miss Belfast, she has too many things tied to her kind heart...
Really? As her sister, I cannot tell.
Most likely because whenever Miss Belfast is around you, she is most relaxed.
Really… hehe, it really can't be helped. I guess I'll take some sweet potatoes home for her——
Umm… quickly eat them, when they get cold they'll taste not as good...
Back to the tea party——
Slowly but surely, the fallen leaves are beginning to pile up in the courtyard...
After all, autumn is the season of fallen leaves.
The fall… naturally a good time to gather with everyone. Let’s all roast some sweet potatoes!
Roast sweet potatoes? Edinburgh can finally show off her prowess!
These are not a good match to be served for afternoon tea.
When no one is available to make food or go out to buy snacks for the tea party, then roasting sweet potatoes is the easiest option!
Belfast, are you coming? Let’s gather up all the leaves and I will light up a bonfire.
Hehe, all this smoke… really——
Belfast, this looks fun, let’s join them!
Our afternoon tea etiquette——
Ha, this is called sharing happiness with commoners. On occasion, we should mingle and do what the common folk are doing.~
Your Majesty, let me teach you how to roast these.~
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[South Latitude 71° West Longitude 100°]
A continent covered in snow… The map is reliable as expected. This is the Northern Parliament! {namecode:12}, rest assured, I am here to get you!

sequence:
Lively Afternoon Tea Party VII

<size=45>「Next Time: Video Game Party!」</size>

scripts.say: Come and try some, Belfast~ Freshly roasted sweet potatoes~
No, please don't force other people to eat food which they do not like!
Belfast, how come my roasted sweet potatoes turned into burnt lumps of coal? Sigh~
Your Majesty, this being your first time roasting something, you already did a superb job.
But when Belfast roasted hers for the first time...
Well, your Majesty, let’s exchange our sweet potatoes then.
The sweet potato roasted by Belfast tastes so good~ You should try your own cooking.
Belfast, under the authority as your Queen, I order you to open your mouth, say ah——
I really have no choice....
You’re really wicked your Majesty, I want to feed Belfast as well!
Ahh, do you all went to be fed?
Sorry, please excuse, I never want to be——
Ah, those sister destroyer ships have returned back to port. Sorry, I must take my leave~
And just like that she disappeared, those carriers from the Royal Navy are really unfathomable.
Haha, another aircraft carrier here from the Royal Navy is still here.
After all this is an unfathomable place...
It’s about time to prepare for supper...
Ah, then I'll take my leave as well.
Right, I need to continue my official duties as Queen——
Then, let’s end the tea party here.
{namecode:14} am looking forward to the next tea party~
For next time, let’s organize a video game party. We'll bring along Long Island——
Absolutely—— not!
At the same time, {namecode:11}...
[South Latitude 71°31′34″ East Longitude 24°08′17″]
There’s no trace of {namecode:12}’s lifesign. Hmm… oh look, there’s a note? Antarctic Bird Survey Station, Queen Maud Land——
Could this be the event that Pasadena and the others designed?
As I open the document sent to me by TB, I recall the event that Pasadena mentioned wanting to hold a while back.
Affirmative. The designers of this plan hope to evoke feelings of "happiness, surprise, excitement, and thrill" in the participants.
Happiness, surprise, excitement, and thrill... Surely you don't mean...
Analysis: Surely I do.
I hope this isn't what I think it is.
Query: Would you like me to explain further?
Well... What's done is done. Let's hear it.
Orders received. While I cannot grasp emotions such as "happiness, surprise, excitement, and thrill," Pasadena has provided a complete framework.
Please view the proposal document.
Shuddering with fear, I take a look at the proposal's abstract. It reads–
Top Bidder!
Pasadena and Albacore are the lead sponsors of this event. The proposal incorporates an analysis of modern trends within port.
However, due to its usage of the "blind box" mechanic, there is a level of risk regarding its reception.
Can't have a business without a little risk☆
Think about it! Combining blind boxes with an auction... Doesn't that just sound like fun?
Imagine: someone's in a tight predicament, but suddenly, they strike gold in their first box! Bam, they've gotten rich quick! Doesn't that sound exciting and thrilling?
Albacore? When did you get here...?
Heheh, I was hiding outside your door LONG before you even asked TB about the event!
Since it starts today, I had to get here early to help you understand how brilliant it is!
Don't you wanna see how our auction system works? Well, experience it for yourself right now!
The terminal is all set up, so you can jump right in any time!
Are we ready yet?! The enemy's counterattack is incoming!
...1st and 2nd Carrier Divisions, load your planes with torpedoes. Prepare for anti-ship combat!
What?! Change equipment right now?!
Nee-sama, I can't do that! What if the enemy attacks while we're unprepared?!
Multiple enemy aircraft approaching at an altitude of 2000!
They're coming from behind?!
Dammit! Call back the fighters! We need anti-air now!
Graaaaghhh!
{namecode:92}，{namecode:92}！！

sequence: <size=51>To let my guard down... at such a critical time...</size>
<size=51>…</size>
<size=51>...I'm sorry. Looks like I couldn't live up to your expectations...</size>
<size=51>Amagi... san...</size>
<size=51>                                                              ——Crimson Echoes</size>

scripts.say: *Giggle*... checkmate.
Argh!
That makes this your tenth consecutive victory!
You dirty little...! You baited out my Gold General! You're not playing fair!
You focus too much on offense. Your fate was already sealed when you left your King in the middle of the board.
Let's just say that going on the offensive while appearing to be on the defensive to lure out your opponent can sometimes be an effective strategy.
Look at you being all smug and wagging your tails... You were just lucky to catch me off guard! I'll show you...
Come on, we're having another match!
Aaahh! God dammit!
That makes this your eleventh consecutive victory!
I'm afraid it's gotten quite late... Akagi, we should head home soon. I wouldn't want to get in the way of Kaga's training.
Ah, certainly!
What, are you leaving because you're scared of actually losing to me?
Not at all. The fact is that in two days, the Sakura Empire will be having its annual naval exercise. You haven't forgotten about it, have you?
Speaking of which, don't you agree we would be more evenly matched in a wargame than in a board game?
...That's true. Then we shall have a real battle to see who is the most powerful modern ship!
Sis, I checked out the participants for this year... and they all seem really motivated! I'm so excited!
Haven't I told you to refrain from calling me "Sis" when others are present?!
Aww! But you're my big sister, so why can't I call you "Sis"?
*Groan*... Call me whatever you wish...
*Sigh*... That aside, we have our exercise tomorrow... I hope that will go well...

sequence: <size=51>Now, I understand.</size>
<size=51>One must evolve in order to survive.</size>
<size=51>For the weak to become extinct is a fact of nature.</size>
<size=51>Those who perished were simply too weak. Nothing more.</size>
<size=51>If this is to be my fate, then at least let me meet my end on the battlefield.</size>
<size=51>I now entrust the future of the Combined Fleet- no, of the Sakura Empire to you...</size>
<size=51>My... sworn... rival...</size>

scripts.say: Amagi, there's trouble! Kaga just left this letter before charging straight towards the Siren-controlled Mirror Sea by herself!
A destroyer division has already been deployed to chase after her, but they lack the firepower to handle recon on the Mirror Sea...
Amagi, standing there emotionlessly, receives Kaga's letter from Ashigara.
(It's just like you to write something like this, Kaga... Could you be...)
I understand the situation. Please continue the search. I shall handle the rest.
Understood!
Since the singing of that "Treaty," everything has changed...
We're not the only ones who were affected. Even those girls in the Eagle Union...
Amagi, will our equipment also be dismantled and replaced with those strange things...?
I haven't even had a chance to experience the recoil of my 41cm cannons yet...
Our time is short, and there is something I still must finish. But before that, I have to bring Kaga back first.
(However, sending a hastily cobbled-together fleet into Siren territory is extremely ill-advised... What should I do...?)
Say, Amagi, are these little mosquitoes really able to replace the splendor of our main batteries?
From the very beginning, the world has never judged who is weak or strong. You are just using that as an excuse to escape from reality.
... Mosquitoes?
... That's right! There is a way!
To Akagi's surprise, the normally collected Amagi let out a yell and bolted out of the room.
*Gasp* *Gasp* ... Houshou, do you have... some spare time?
Amagi! What brought you here in such a hurry?
Whether it was because she hadn't exercised without her rigging for so long or because she'd ran there in a hurry, Amagi seemed out of breath.
After taking several deep breaths, Amagi clasped Houshou's shoulders.
Houshou, as the first aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire, I have a favor to ask of you...
Are you able to send your planes to search for Kaga in the Mirror Sea?
Eh? Kaga? B-but I only learned how to use these planes recently... I don't have any real combat experience...
Please, I'm begging you, you only have to find Kaga. I'll handle the rest.
I don't quite understand the situation, but for you to be this desperate... I'll see what I can do.
As if embraced by the sea breeze, Houshou extended her hand towards the horizon like she was parting the clouds-
As her words vanished into the wind, over a dozen aircraft began to materialize from Houshou's flight deck, encircling the sky above her.
Amagi, Akagi, and the newly-arrived escort fleet could only watch in silence, mouths agape, as they witnessed the spectacle in front of them for the first time.
...For a brief moment, they thought they could see the first rays of an era about to dawn.
Please help search for Kaga in the dark clouds of the Mirror Seas~
And most importantly, everyone, please come back safely!
With Houshou's instructions, the aircraft fanned out in seven different directions, soon disappearing into the distance.
Thank you so much for your assistance, Houshou. I'll definitely bring Kaga back. Also...
Amagi drew close to Houshou, her lips brushing against her ear, whispering something before pulling away. With that, she took a deep bow of gratitude before leading the escort fleet away.
I understand. May the Gods of Fortune be with you.
Sister, you're now going to search the Mirror Seas by staying in contact with those planes, right? I also-
See that, Akagi? Aren't those planes far more capable than you had first expected?
As for you, your new armaments are still not complete. There's no way we'd be able to risk you on the front lines. Be a good girl and wait back in port for your new equipment, all right?
B-but... I can't help but have a bad feeling about this still...
Listen to your big sister. I swear to bring Kaga back safely.
Amagi smiled warmly in an attempt to console her little sister before turning towards the ocean and departing...
But she could not hide the unease and anxiety seeping out from her smile, not even from herself.
So this is what has become of the areas occupied by the Sirens... I passed through here scarcely half a month ago, and now...
The Sirens' movements are unpredictable. Who could have foreseen them attacking the same place where we just held our wargames?
Reporting in! Houshou's reconnaissance squad has detected combat activity to 2 o'clock, 10 nautical miles ahead!
Great news. Though I'm not sold on their combat ability, at least these little flying critters are great at reconnaissance. Hehe...
All ships, switch to high alert. Utilize your own best judgment in dealing with incoming Sirens.
BOOOOOOM!
... Agh!
Amagi!
Don't worry about me, it's just a scratch. I just... did not expect these things to self-destruct. How negligent of me...
Please don't overexert yourself, Amagi. You should leave the front lines to us.
No, that simply won't do.
Chess tactics are to be left on the chessboard. In live combat, how could a commander hide in the rear while her subordinates sacrifice themselves because of her decisions?
People like this are cowards, not tacticians.。
Even during the exercise, Amagi conducted herself in the same way, throwing herself into the thick of combat on the front line.
See? By moving forward like this, we have already been rewarded for our efforts. Wait, everyone, stop for a second.
Amagi bent down to pick up a piece of tattered cloth from the water's surface. Without a doubt, it was a piece of Kaga's outfit.
To make it this deep into enemy territory by herself... she is stronger than I gave her credit for.
... What a fool...
Something's wrong... we've lost contact with the aircraft conducting recon at 9 o'clock.
I wanted to make sure Houshou got all her planes back safely, but it looks like that's not an option anymore...
The recon plane was most likely shot down by the Sirens. Since none of the other planes have been able to locate Kaga so far, heading towards 9 o'clock is our best bet.
Amagi, b-b-big t-trouble!!
Naka, what happened?
B-b-black shadows in the sky... so many of them are flying towards us!
This is...!
We're under attack from a carrier-class Siren! All ships, prepare for anti-air measures!
Eh? A-anti-air measures?
Yes, proceed forward in an S-formation with your secondary weapons raised to maximum elevation angle. Shoot those things out of the sky!
Y-yes ma'am! I will do my best!
Kaga!!
Amagi...?! What are you doing here?
I could ask you the same thing. Why are you doing this?
For the future of the Combined Fleet? The Sakura Empire? Are you trying to sound cool, acting like death will solve all your problems?
I already told you! If I'm going to be converted into something as weak and pathetic as a carrier, I'd rather...
Slap-!
Before Kaga could finish her sentence, Amagi's palm whipped across her face sharply.

Every day, you prattle on about the "strong" and the "weak" as if you were the tragic hero of some opera. But while you wallow in fantasies of your own making, your comrades now bleed because of your selfishness!
From the very beginning, the world has never judged who is weak or strong. You are just using that as an excuse to escape from reality.
Then tell me... now that I am shackled by the Treaty, how am I supposed to fight?!
I've already taken care of that. I consulted Nagato-sama before coming here.
As long as you can make it back to port and display your power at the next wargame, you can prevent being decommissioned.
... Really?
What reason would I have to lie to you?
Kaga could only stare at Amagi in surprise, as if not allowing herself to believe that a path still was in front of her.
But before we get ahead of ourselves... we have to find some way to get everyone out of here safely.
Amagi turned once more to face the sky darkened by enemy aircraft. Drawing a deep breath, she steeled her resolve and focused her energy towards commanding the fleet.
Do not lose hope! Our recon planes have already located the Siren carrier's location. If we hold out here, we will be able to break through!
Everyone, prepare for anti-air combat! We have but one target - the Siren carrier!
With the defeat of the Siren carrier, the enemy planes soon fell into disarray without their mastermind and became fodder for the heavy anti-air fire.
However, the surviving planes began to ascend out of reach of the anti-air guns, as if waiting for an opportunity to counterattack.
Amagi, we're running out of ammo! Please give the order to retreat!
What a terrifying strategy... sending consecutive airstrikes while we are unable to contest the airspace...
If we make it back to port, we have to think of some countermeasures... and develop new equipment to combat this threat... *cough* *cough*
Amagi suddenly began to cough laboriously.
Amagi, you-
Time is running out. We have got to get you out of...
Before she could finish her words, Amagi suddenly collapsed like a puppet with its strings cut.
Kaga sprung forth and caught her before she could fall.
Hey! Amagi! Pull yourself together!
Amagi!!
Sensing an opportunity, a Siren aircraft swooped down towards the disabled Amagi, screeching as a bomb emerged from its underside.
There was a flash, and then a terrible explosion-
Kaga clung tightly to Amagi, shielding her from the blast with her body. In an instant, her armor was split apart from the force of the explosion, her clothing in tatters.
*cough* ... You fool... why didn't you dodge...?
Heh. Don't underestimate the armor of a real battleship. You just behave yourself and let us tow you back to port-
BOOOOOM!!
Another bomb detonated above them. Though off its mark, the explosion caused a massive pillar of water to erupt near them.
...Gah! Persistent bastards!
Kaga turned to survey the fleet - battered, bruised, and running out of ammunition. As their anti-air fire dwindled, more and more bullets began to rain down around Kaga and Amagi.
At this rate, we're all going to be wiped out! What should I do?!
Amagi, surely you don't plan to lose here!
Just... a little more...
What? A little more what? Amagi!
The Sakura fleet, which had long prided its resplendent main batteries that towered towards the heavens, had no experience dealing with a carrier's relentless attacks.
You should never have come here... I alone should bear the consequences for my mistakes...
"When your resolve is weak, you risk not only your life but also the lives of your comrades."
Just when Kaga began to come to terms with what would be her humiliating end-
In a plume of smoke, a number of enemy aircraft began to careen out of control and fall from the sky.
*cough* *cough* Looks like... they made it in time...
A number of biplanes, emblazoned with the bright insignia of the Sakura Empire, rushed forth, splitting the dark skies.
Caught off guard, the Siren aircraft were mowed down until not a single one remained.
What... are these?
These are Houshou's... and the Sakura Empire's... first carrier-based aircraft.
As expected of Houshou, being able to master her aircraft at such a critical time...
But... how did they manage to find us?
Well, before this even began, I told Houshou... if a recon plane was lost, to immediately scramble her fighters in that direction...
We have to use every resource at our disposal... after all, we aren't the only ones with carriers... the Sirens too...
That's just like you, Amagi. You're not called the "Phantom of the Sakura Empire" for nothing.
I'll do as you said. I'll return to port and become the strongest sword of the Sakura Empire, able to cut down any foe.
So, just hold on a bit longer! Everyone, we're going home!
How's the situation looking?
She finally regained consciousness just earlier, but I don't have much more good news for you. She's going to need more rest, and won't be taking any visitors today.
Hatakaze shook her head as she explained the situation to Kaga, her voice on the verge of cracking.
During her examination, we found out that Amagi's wisdom cube had been severely damaged. Nobody knows exactly what caused it though...
As a matter of fact, she most likely has been dealing with this for some time now.
The problem must have flared up when she overexerted herself earlier on the Mirror Sea...
However, I'm worried that...
That what?
... that in this state, she won't even be able to have a normal civilian life, let alone receive her carrier remodel.
Just consider this the worst case scenario. I haven't spoken a word of this to anyone else....
... even to the one who is currently undergoing her remodel.
Kaga staggered off in a stupor, as if unable to accept what she just heard.
Hatakaze...?
I'm right here, Amagi.
There's... just one more thing left to do... please...
Of course. I will make sure it is done.
And with that, the day of destiny arrived.
I am Nagato, flagship of the Combined Fleet. Subjects of the Sakura Empire, lend me your ear!
As you may have heard, Sirens encroached upon our waters when we were ill prepared.
They captured and converted one of our training grounds into a Mirror Sea. We must take heed and learn from the consequences of our strategic oversight.
As a result, the Combined Fleet shall strengthen its perimeter defenses, patrolling and establishing garrisons on remote islands. We are also forming a plan to reclaim what was taken from us.
Therefore, in order to strengthen our torpedo squadrons and our main fleets to defend against potential large-scale Siren invasions, we shall hold another Naval Exercise!
Like last time, Red Team will be on the offensive, and Blue Team will be on the defensive!
Those of you who wish to leave a strong impression, do your best to display your formidable power and your graceful technique!
By my decree, the island defense wargame shall now commence!
(Amagi... is this what you wanted...?)
Amagi, what's the meaning of this? Why are you at this exercise?
I take it that Hatakaze has already told you... about the condition of my body.
The world has already begun to change. The era of large capital ships and cannons will soon come to an end.
From here on out... is the era of the aircraft carrier.
Perhaps you'll find this laughable... but I want to feel the pulse of my cannons firing while I am still a battlecruiser... one last time.
That is why I chose to come here.
Come, Kaga, if you still consider me your rival. You have yet to best me even a single time, right?
If you dare go easy on me, I won't forgive you for the rest of my life.
...Understood. I truly am blessed... aren't I?
To have an opponent like you who can be true to herself until the very end, Amagi... I truly am blessed.
...I am the Tosa-class battleship Kaga!
...I am the Amagi-class battlecruiser Amagi.
<size=60>Come!!</size>
You've become stronger. I won't be able to use the same old tricks on you... *chuckles*
I learned from the best, after all...
With that, I have nothing else to teach you. Mmhmm, your big sister is proud of you~
W-wait, "big sister?"
... Kaga, listen to me!
Amagi's expression quickly changed from jovial to serious as she looked Kaga in the eye.
I have said before that the world does not judge who is strong and who is weak.
I, Amagi, was born into this world flawed- what you would call weak.
However, because I wanted to protect Akagi, and everyone else in the fleet, even this weakling tried to become "strong."
That is why I desperately threw myself at my studies and training, so that people would assume that I was naturally "strong."
Perhaps you have realized it as well. In the end, I was not able to attain true strength.
Though many have not yet realized it, the seas will soon be ruled by aircraft carriers.
And when that time comes, you and Akagi will form the foundation for the Sakura Fleet's future.
You will encounter opponents just like you from all across the world - nay, even stronger than you.
But remember to never underestimate your enemies, and always strive to become stronger.
Unlike me, who was born a weakling, you were born strong. And you are destined to become even stronger.
For you and Akagi, your strength is both your birthright and your obligation.。
Therefore, remember me not as Amagi "the weak," but rather as Amagi "the strong." Pick up my mantle and become that strength that I could only represent.
Please, protect the Sakura Empire in my stead...
... ... And please take care of my sister, Akagi...
Kaga, you're awake?
Big sister... Akagi...? What... happened to me?
Nothing in particular. Although, you sure took a beating during that last battle and slept all the way until now.
And while you were asleep, you kept calling out a rather nostalgic name... *giggles*
Right... I remember an explosion... Have I already been repaired?
Who knows~? I just woke up not too long ago myself. More importantly, have you seen the brooch I always wear?
Just where could I have dropped it...? Don't tell me that someone was after it...! If that's the case, I'll have to prepare some "punishment" for them...
Akagi, you...
(Even though she looks the same, her personality couldn't be more different...)
Are you still sleeptalking? Let's hurry up and get back to our "Sanctuary." I have much "planning" to do~
Of course, my "plans" are proceeding smoothly. Just a little more...
Soon, we will be able to meet "her." Ahaha...
I am Nagato, the flagship of the Combined Fleet! I will be the referee for this year's Naval Exercises!
...In these turbulent times, we face threats on all sides, not only from the chaos the Sirens are causing, but also from other forces around the world. And so...
... now more than ever, we must all come together as one!
And we must show our enemies that the Sakura Empire Fleet is stronger than it has ever been before!
The flagship of the Combined Fleet and shrine maiden of the Sakura Empire, Nagato, gazed at all the ships in attendance for the wargames.
The flagship of the winning side of this year's wargames shall be appointed as the Combined Fleet's next flagship!
Nagato-sama's... next flagship?!
Be quiet!
I will now announce the team compositions for this year's wargames!
Red Team: Battlecruiser Amagi...
Blue Team: Battleship Kaga...
Oh what a delight! Amagi, are you ready for that rematch?
This year's wargames will decide the future course of events for our Combined Fleet.
I want everyone to bear this fact in mind. I want you to demonstrate what you are capable of and fight without remorse!
...Now, let the Combined Fleet's wargames begin!
Nagato, I hope you've been well.
Amagi. What would you request of me?
If you pardon my rudeness, I would like to make a request on behalf of Kaga.
Very well. Speak.
As you know, the treaty allows any two large capitol ships to be converted to aircraft carriers. I seek to rescind the decommissioning of Battleship Kaga based upon the Treaty's demands.
Hmm... Amagi, nobody wishes for this outcome, but the Treaty is binding once signed. Your request would be three ships... Unless...
Unless someone takes her place, correct?
From the very beginning, the world has never judged who is weak or strong. You are just using that as an excuse to escape from reality.
Nagato, you should already know that I am not fit to serve as the flagship of the Combined Fleet. Sooner or later, the role must be entrusted to someone else.
While she may not be up to the task just yet, if you were to pass on the role to Kaga, I would be able to rest easy knowing that I was able to serve the Sakura Empire, even with this flawed body.
Is this truly what you desire?
Without a doubt. Right now, Kaga is alone in the Mirror Sea due to her despair, but I will personally bring her back.
Should we be able to return safely, I humbly request that you consider my decision, and hold another wargame to see that Kaga can become an aircraft carrier.
Thank you for entertaining my selfish requests, but this is my... *cough* *cough*...
It can't be...
Understood, speak no more. Your request shall be granted.
Thank you for your graciousness, Nagato...
I have already asked Houshou to train the two of them in aviation techniques.
Those two have the strength and talent to become the core of the Combined Fleet. Please rest assured, Nagato.
I shall pray for your safe return.
Thank you very much. I am sorry for troubling you.
Kaga, this jade brooch is for you. Wear it, and it shall keep you safe.
Actually, I also have another one for Akagi. The one I'm giving you is pair- I mean, a spare.
(Amagi, why are you giving me something like this all of a sudden... ? Don't tell me...)
What's with that conflicted expression? I just picked it up while passing by a flea market. Don't think too hard about it~
(Having that said, isn't this the first time Amagi has given me something?) I-I'll be sure to treasure it.
Yes, I'd appreciate it if you wore it at all times~
If you say so, Amagi.
(The era of aircraft carriers, huh... It's just as you said, Amagi.)
(I have been hard at work protecting Akagi, who is now serving as an aircraft carrier. Just like you asked me to...)
(Back then, who would have thought that bootlicker would become one of the leaders of the Sakura Fleet...)
(From time to time, I can almost see your face when I look at her...)
(... but it's probably just an illusion, caused by my own immaturity.)
(Rest assured though. Now, she is like a true sister to me, bound by blood.)
(Although the situation with the Sirens... has perhaps escalated beyond what you could have imagined.)
(Amagi, if you were here, what would you do...?)
Hehehe, it looks like a little mouse has snuck into our "Sanctuary"... Tester, have you located them yet?
Wide-range monitoring... this is something I have quite a bit of experience with, ahaha!
Fifth Carrier Division, you foolish children... You do not know anything yet...
Let me test your abilities with this weapon that transcends the Gods!
Why, I didn't expect Team Red's flagship herself to appear right before me.
An exercise is no place for lollygagging. Kaga may start acting haphazardly if I don't show myself.
Still, you must be quite confident to appear on the front in person. This is no mere game to you, is it?
Perhaps so. It is true I like devising new strategies, but never once have I said I am an incapable soldier.
Indeed... I fully believe that it's a fortunate thing I am not your enemy.
But still, here I stand, blocking your way, like the enemy would.
If you wish to pass, you must first defeat me!
Then let us have a fight in good spirit. *Giggle*...
It's over. There's nothing one can do when facing superior firepower.
You still carried out your duty well.
...Amagi, are you actually going for it?
What do you mean by that?
Do you seriously want to be the Combined Fleet's next flagship?
You still behave like the person I know, but I could sense you were different when we fought.
You're fighting with determination the likes of which I've never seen from you before.
I can think of no other reason why you would come to the front when you could get the same results by commanding your team from the back.
Who is to say that... Perhaps it's just time for a change of pace. It might turn out to be necessary.
Times are changing; if we just keep practicing the same things each year, we'll quickly be left behind on the actual battlefield.
As Nagato-sama said, the world around us is in chaos. We can't afford to wallow in our isolationism.
Precisely because this is a wargame, I'd like to test some new strategies.
If we can gather some new insight, or even learn what not do in the future, that would make this exercise a success.
Spoken like a true commander...
I understand now.
No matter who wins, I will always support the flagship of the Combined Fleet.
With these words, Hatakaze left the exercises premises.
"We will now review the results of the first day of the Naval Exercise!"
And with that, the first day of the Combined Fleet's Naval Exercise had come to an end.
*Cough, cough*... At last, it's over... She came too close to figuring out my plan...
This is what happens when I don't exercise for so long... *Cough, cough*... I feel like I could faint...
I need to hold on... just a little longer...
Ahahah... So you're leading the attack unit, Naka?
That's right, Amagi-san!
I'm glad to see you're doing well. Is this your first time leading during an exercise?
It is! It's an honor to fight alongside my superiors and to be seen as a candidate for the next flagship of the Combined Fleet!
Ahah, it's good that you're so eager, but I hope you haven't forgotten that this is a battlefield.
Of course not! Just because you're my superior doesn't mean I'll step to the side and nicely ask you to pass through!
Then let us see what you're capable of.
You win after all, Amagi-san! You've defeated me!
Don't feel down, you fought well. You've learned very much from your sisters.
Do you get along well with your sister too?
I can't say. But I can say your sisters were quite outstanding in the previous exercises.
Jintsuu is wise, Sendai is strong... And the qualities you possess may rival or even surpass theirs.
Eheheh, thank you! I'll keep working as hard as I can!
...I wish Akagi would be more like you.
Akagi...? Do you mean your sister?
Yes. She's... well, I might have been a little too lenient with her...
Too lenient...? I think she's incredibly strong.
She may be strong, but if she can't control her strength... I suppose it's fine if everything goes well, but if it does not...
She'll be fine. She has you if she needs guidance!
That won't always be... *Cough*! *Cough cough*!
Amagi suddenly began coughing heavily.
Amagi-san?! Are you okay?!
I'm fine... *Cough cough*... It's just that preparing for the wargames has had a small impact on my health.
I apologize for being such a pitiful sight.
Shouldn't you hurry back to the harbor? You've been "sunk", after all.
I... I will! Take care of yourself, Amagi-san!
*Phew*...
"She has me", you say? ...I suppose she does...
But who knows for how long I will actually be here to watch over you, Akagi...
Everybody seems to be in quite a rush... Did something happen earlier this morning?
Oh, you're finally here. There's something not so great going on. Just follow me.
The two hurried off to the place where everyone was gathering.
That place being in front of the exercise's information board.！
Are you stupid?
"If I can participate then Amagi won't need to come to the exercise"? Then what? Are you going to fight with unfinished equipment and sheer naive motivation?
You're one to talk! You ran away from the battle with your tails between your legs!
Listen, you absolute idiot. That sly, conniving she-fox is an expert at tricking people with her dirty little schemes.
Just because she's appearing in person at the frontlines doesn't mean I'll lower my guard and get lured out by her, no matter what an idiot like you says.
And furthermore, I'm a battleship. I'm completely different from battlecruisers like you two.
Just look at how thin your armor is. Do you think I, a battleship, have any reason to be scared of fighting you?？
How dare you! Unlike you, nee-sama and I have always focused on speed! How would a snail like you catch up to us cruising at 30 knots?
Hah, you're not telling me you're PROUD of how fast you can run away, are you?
...Your hair color says it all, the inside of your head is as white as a blank canvas, you idiot!
No you, you bootlicker! Your only redeeming feature is that big rack of yours...!
-- CLANG!
Owww?!
The two sisters who seemed on the brink of starting a fight fell silent in the blink of an eye from the intense rage they could sense.
Who is this "sly, conniving she-fox" you speak of~?
Nee-sama!
-- CLANG!
Didn't I tell you to be nice to everyone~? Why are you picking a fight with Kaga~?
There, now let's be nice and shake hands~
Amagi smiled and forced Akagi and Kaga to hold hands.
...They both had bumps forming on their heads.
-- That woman seriously freaks me out.
Hidden beneath Amagi's loving smile was a rage that would frighten even the most vile of beasts. All the bystanders knew this for a fact.
There, now you've reconciled and will live happily ever after.
Akagi and Kaga couldn't stop their tears.
The future of the Sakura Empire lies in our hands, and if we're not all nice to each other then we won't be able to defeat our enemies~
Now, today's exercise will be starting soon, so could everyone return to their posts?
Both sisters started tightening their own grip on the other's hand, seemingly because they hadn't quite reached a mutual understanding yet.
Nevertheless, overwhelmed by Amagi's silent rage, they both reluctantly let go of the other's hand and began walking in opposite directions.
You got away this time, bootlicker. Next time I see you on the battlefield I'll make you understand the class difference between us.
