Hmph! Before the day is over I will make YOU understand that Amagi is the strongest of her class, so don't think you can run away again.
The crowd of onlookers who had gathered around began to disperse as well. And then...
The only person left was Amagi who stood there in silence, lost in her own thoughts.
At last we meet on the battlefield, Amagi!
The King's defense consists of 3 Gold and Silver pieces... and you have learned how to attack them.
I have you to thank for that. Let's be honest, you know a lot more about shrewdness and tactics than me...
But in combat, someone like you doesn't stand a chance against me!
Then let's make a deal: if you win, I shall become your servant who will eliminate all those that stand in your way.。
But if I win, you will become the most powerful weapon in my arsenal, and you will cooperate with me on my plans.
...But of course.
The title of next flagship belongs to me. Now brace yourself!
The Sakura Empire Combined Fleet's Naval Exercises were about to conclude with Nagato's congratulatory speech.
Ladies and gentlemen, I am proud of all the people that participated in our Naval Exercise!
Both teams of Red and Blue, lead by Amagi and Kaga, respectively, fought very well throughout the entire event!
As there were no significant differences in their technique, size, or equipment, the only thing that determined the victor was their tactics...

The Combined Fleet will treasure the experience it was able to get from this year's wargames, such as the mastery of their guns and torpedoes and experience working with team formations different from what they are used to.
I want you to leverage these skills and to be ready for war with the Sirens or any other foreign power.
Now, in regards to the candidate for the next Combined Fleet flagship...
When the appropriate time comes, I will delegate my powers to the Amagi-class battlecruiser, Amagi!
Amagi, you should be prepared for an important duty, a duty rivaling that of a Sakura Empire shrine maiden, a duty passed down from Mikasa-sama's days!
Nee-sama... will be the Combined Fleet's next flagship...!
Akagi was so overjoyed that she burst into tears.
Lastly, there is one more thing I have to tell you.
I have received some news that are rather sudden even for me, so I have not had much time to absorb it...
In an instant, Nagato's tone of voice became heavy.
As we all know, our battle against the Sirens many decades ago was won by investing an outrageous amount of resources into our military.
But we were not the only ones who did so. In order to create a ubiquitous lifeline of blue across the ocean, all major powers had to pay an equal price for this shared victory...
And so, now that the Sirens have been temporarily repelled and we have recovered our strength, the admiralty of all factions have held a discussion and settled on a Treaty.
The Eagle Union, Royal Navy, Sakura Empire, Iris, and Sardegna have already signed it... In fact, most of the admiralty of all major powers that were in the great war have.
The factions are preventing one another from achieving total supremacy while simultaneously striving for a balance of power and saving energy on the upkeep of their fleets.
They say that everyone "must downscale their navy by an agreed-upon amount."
...I was just as astonished as you all are.

In essence, this means that from now on the construction of new capital ships is not permitted, and construction of them that is already underway must be halted. A lucky few may be converted to a different type of ship, but the rest won't ever be completed.
And any ship that did not meet the Treaty's terms must be...
...scrapped.
The King draws closer as if engulfing you... You cannot escape.
And suddenly, I'm surrounded... So you've been hiding your talent for combat all along.
"All warfare is based on deception." I planned this before the wargames had even begun.
Guh...! How is that humanly possible...
Even in the midst of gunfire and explosions you manage to stay calm and adjust your strategy and issue commands...
I admit total defeat. Deal with me however you want.
Ahaha... Then could I ask you to start calling me "Amagi-san" from now on?
You witch...! Stop being so full of yourself...!
Their lighthearted conversation continued for a short while.
One thing has been on my mind. Your strategies involve throwing caution to the wind somewhat.
Then what if today had not been a wargame, but a real battle...? Could you have actually...

sequence:
Summer Festival

<size=45>Chapter 1: Prepare for the Festival!</size>

scripts.say: It's that time of year again, Inazuma!
What time of year...?
Festival time! Time to stuff our faces with food and our hearts with fun!
I see! It's festival time!
Wait, is that a thing? An annual festival?
Errmm...
If it isn't a thing, let's make it a thing!
Kitakaze!
My ears were burning... with talk of the Sakura Empire, talk of summer!
It wouldn't be summer without a festival~
Well if it isn't Zuikaku. You're with me, aren't you!
Ahaha, glad to be on the right side of history~
Now if we're all on the same page, let's put together a summer festival for everyone!
I see! This is what they call "bandwagoning," isn't it?
Um, well...
Then... should we go get the Commander...?
... And so that's why... we want to put on a summer festival, Commander!
... The request seemed to come out of nowhere.
Y-you wouldn't crush our dreams, would you, Commander...?
We even brought along this little one. She's so excited for the festival.
I love festivals! I can't wait to help out! I'll eat all the festival candy... hehehe...
I want to see fireworks! Come on, Commander! It'll be fun!
It was summer, after all. And they did make it sound fun.
Our Commander is wise and fair as ever!
Haha, let's get started then! Call out the girls from the other factions too.
Time to get busy~
Yeah!
And so it was, that after a period of intense, grueling preparation, the port was at last ready for its annual summer festival.

sequence:
Summer Festival

<size=45>Chapter 2: Enjoy the Festival!</size>

scripts.say: Wooow... so this is a Sakura festival. There's so much to do~
Indeed... it's not bad. Hehe... they even have a target shooting game. My trigger finger is itching.
Um, I don't think you can use your own gun for those games...
... It was only a joke.
Ta-daa!
Ta-daa!
Welcome to the Sakura Empire Summer Festival!
Wow, you two look fantastic! Thank you for inviting us.
Yes, I was just saying to Vampire– Oh...? Where did she go?
Vampire? I think I saw her going to that stand over there. They've got fizzy drinks with marbles in them?
Hehehe... my body thirsts for the nourishing crimson of fresh blood...
Hmm, I would have the watermelon flavour, please~
Hah, I see she's enjoying the festival in her own way.
Kitakaze! Kitakaze! There's a whole bunch of candy stands over there! I wanna go!
Okay! Just gimme a second to buy another chow mein–
Waahh... but I wanna go! I wanna go! I'll just go by myself!
Ugh...! I-26, can you take her?
Hold on a sec. Just one more time! Aie! It broke again... That one didn't count! One more! Gimme another net!
Aahh. Take in that sweet festival air~ You can really smell everyone's hard work, even the Commander's.
Seeing the happy smiling faces of my girls enjoying the festival, I couldn't help but feel all that hard work was worth it.
Haha, speak of the devil! It's the Commander. Come to enjoy the fruits of your labors?
Hm? Look who's here, that's the Union girl, um...?
Grrrr, that St. Louis, "Put this on, it'll drive the Commander wild!" *Hmph*, as if that's anything I'd want...
She, she called it a... "Yukata," I think? It does look pretty good...
But isn't it a little tight... Especially around the chest area...?
Wish her a happy festival.
C-C-C-C-C-C-Commander?!
Evening, Honolulu~
Zuikaku, right? G-good evening...
Y-you like my dress? R-really...? Th-thanks...
Honolulu was being uncharacteristically open with her feelings. It must have been that festival magic.
Ahahaha! Welcome, welcome! Enjoy the festival! We're just about to start the main event!
(POP! POPOPOP!)
Wooowww! So this is how they do fireworks in the Sakura Empire?
Yep. It's Akashi's special festival recipe. We'll have to thank her later~
Ooo! Ikazuchi! The fireworks!
Tamaya...?
Ahahahaha! Commander, Honolulu, come on! Taaamayaaaa!
Huh?! Whaa?! What the heck kinda Sakura custom is this? Ta-tamaya...?
All good things must come to an end. The festival couldn't last forever, neither could summer itself. But for the time being...
We had a chance to just relax, learn some Sakura words to shout at fireworks, and enjoy a summer festival together.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 1 - A Maid Must...</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Owing to some strange turn of events, Belfast introduced me to the Maid Fleet's chief bodyguard, Sirius, and I selected her to be my secretary.
I am here to support you from this day onwards, my honourable Master.
If there is anything at all that I can help with, please tell me. Though I am not as talented as Belfast, I shall do my absolute best to meet your expectations.
I tried giving this cool-looking and diligent maid an assignment, but...
Sirius tilted her head sideways like she didn't understand what I said.
Are you... asking for yesterday's exercise reports?
My sincerest apologies... I thought you had already finished reading them yesterday, so I disposed of them...
I-I shall locate them at once!
Sirius hurriedly got on her knees and began digging through an old pile of papers.
Pardon the interruption, Master, but... what would you like me to clean first?
I'm truly sorry, but I have always gotten my fellow maids to brew tea on my behalf, so I have never done it myself...
I have no complaints about your skill as a bodyguard, but as help around the office, I can't say the same...
I do apologise. Not only am I unable to fully carry out my duties as a secretary, I've even wasted your highly valuable time, my honourable Master...
Please... Please teach this naughty maid some proper manners!
Sirius lowered her head and began profusely apologizing.
Seeing her like this made me want to repay her for all her hard work in some way.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Her Majesty's Orders</size>

scripts.say: In the midst of my pondering on how to thank Sirius for her efforts...
I hereby command all my subjects to be in attendance at our next banquet to strengthen cross-faction ties!
Everyone must bring a partner with them! As for me, I will have Warspite as my escort!
...Be there! That is an order!
And so, Her Tiny Majesty gave me a direct order to attend the banquet.
I've heard that the banquet will be very formal, and apparently we must dance with our partners...
I am here, please rest assured, my honourable Master.
...I must dress appropriately for the banquet? Is my maid uniform inadequate...?

...However, I believe that the more I stand out in a crowd, the lower the risk is of you being targeted, Master. Therefore, it's in your best interest that I attend the banquet in my regular maid uniform.
True, I guess showing to a banquet wearing that would make you really stick out...
Do you mean... attend the banquet as your partner?
Although I would be much obliged, I believe it would be considered inappropriate for you to bring a lowly maid as your partner, my honourable Master.
Furthermore, either Belfast or Curacoa would be superior choices, as I have never attended a public event as a guest before...
Even so, I'll accept the risk and choose you to be my partner.
Do you mean that... I can protect both Her Majesty and you at the same time, my honourable Master?
Oh, my apologies! I was unable to infer the meaning of your statement and I made a senseless remark...
Please, give this incompetent maid her due punishment!
In reality, I want this banquet to serve as a learning experience for her, but let's go with this version of the story for now.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 3 - The Maids' Aid</size>

scripts.say: To be able to blend in among the crowd at the banquet, there is a need for Sirius to understand precisely what a maid's duties are and how a maid should behave.
In addition, now that Sirius have been selected for the assignment, there is a need to improve on her ability to serve as a secretary.
...Is this an accurate summary of your request, Master?
I went to the Royal Navy Maids and requested their guidance on Sirius.
I humbly request your gentle treatment, Belfast.
Although ordinary maid business has never been Sirius' job, this is a special case.
For this instance, don't worry about the tasks you are usually assigned; let's all take turns explaining.
Very well. If it's for my Master's sake, I'll do anything...!
First, we will have to teach you proper etiquette.
Well, I say there's no need to be overly formal, so let's instead start by teaching her the dos and don'ts, shall we?
When cleaning the Commander's office, you should start with cleaning the shelves, not sweep the floor, as it is easier that way.
I see. That will come handy in the future.
Emm, I don't think there's anything special that Contestant Kent can teach you.
Maybe I could teach you how to skip work without Belfast finding out about it?
...I would be quite interested in knowing how you do so.
...I feel I have become aware of just how much I don't know...
Looks like Sirius is getting closer to becoming a made maid.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Big Seven Advice</size>

scripts.say: Nelson, Rodney, please share your insight with me.
I don't know how useful our advice would be, but we could maybe teach you something.
Nelson? Please, the Commander directly asked us for help, so we should take this seriously.
I decided to ask Nelson and Rodney on Sirius' behalf for advice on how to behave at a formal banquet.
Then for starters... let's get an idea of the situation. What's the status of your preparations for the banquet?
Her Majesty will have Lady Warspite for protection, so my plan thus far is to be the Master's bodyguard instead.
I have done a general background check on all of the attendees, and my survey of the perimeter's defences and emergency escape routes is 90% complete.
Lastly, I've prepared various banquet items for the Master, installed a communications device in the Master's car, prepared spare clothing, and prepared antiemetic medicine.
I guess the maids' advice was useful to Sirius, seeing as she prepared an extra set of clothes and some anti-nausea medicine.
H-huh, I see... You've prepared for just about everything...
If there is anything I may have not accounted for, please do let me know.
Um, Nelson... I think we should probably start with teaching her the basics of attending a banquet.
That should be everything. Oh, right, I nearly forgot to ask an important question: do you have a dress prepared?
I've... Um...
Figures... You should go ask Illustrious or Akashi. You're basically already wearing a dress, so they might be able to get you a new one right away.
Nelson, Master, you have my sincerest thanks for all of your help!
...You could say that again. Nelson and Rodney were a huge help.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Take My Hand</size>

scripts.say: Now you turn around like this... Then move like this...
Like... so?
Yes, you've got it! Now you should have no problem practicing with an actual partner.
I got Aurora to teach Sirius the dance we'll have at the banquet.
My honourable Master, I kindly ask of you to join me and help me practice this dance.
Sirius, my all-in-one banquet partner, secretary, and personal maid elegantly reached her hand out to me.
She hadn't quite nailed it yet, but she'd improved remarkably in such a short amount of time.
Then, as we were practicing the dance, she suddenly started whispering to me.
...I am truly thankful for all of your help.
Though I am a mere maid, you have been so kind to me...
I know that this is far outside my jurisdiction as a maid, but nevertheless...
(Boing)
...I guess the wave of emotion made one of us miss a step, and now I felt the sensation of something heavy yet soft pressing against me.
...My honourable Master, I...
Oh my goodness, I am so sorry! I... Um...
For just a single moment, Sirius' expression turned bright red as our faces were mere inches away.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Banquet Panic</size>

scripts.say: It was now the day of the banquet.
My word, I can't believe it!
Can't believe what, Your Majesty?
That! Isn't that Sirius, one of our Royal Maids...?
I can see why Her Majesty would be surprised. Sirius' banquet dress makes her look so refined that you might mistake her for someone else entirely.
Of course, we also have the Royal Maids, Nelson, Rodney, and Aurora to thank for their guidance.
In the end, it's because of Sirius' hard work that we look perfectly presentable at the banquet... Actually, I'd go as far as saying we're the most presentable couple in attendance.
Now I shall be your partner for the dance, just as you requested.
It is my hope that you will see the fruits of my endeavors.
Now then, my honourable Master, shall we dance?
Your Majesty! Siren planes have been sighted approaching from the shoreline!
Hah! They've got guts to dare disrupt a banquet with me in attendance! Mobilise the maids and eliminate the enemy at once!
...I believe the quickest route should be through here.
How do you feel, my honourable Master?
In that moment, I remembered why I wanted Sirius to attend this banquet: to reward her for all her hard work, and to let her shine.
And being a bodyguard and the most proficient fighter of all the maids, if there's one thing she shines at, it would have to be...
Understood, my honourable Master.
...Then as you command, I shall shine as bright as my namesake star.

sequence:
Sirius' Improvement Plan

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Like The Brightest Star</size>

scripts.say: The fight was over in a matter of minutes.
As soon as the Sirens had made their appearance, they were promptly turned into little more than wrecks.
What rubbish! They stole the limelight from my Home Fleet!
There is no need to mobilise the Home Fleet to fight mere planes, Your Majesty... At any rate, this was a victory for the Royal Navy, so wouldn't you agree this is a splendid outcome?
Hmph!
...I must admit, the anti-air capabilities of the Dido-class are a marvel to behold.
Or perhaps this fine display of skill was only possible thanks to your swift decision back there, Commander?
That decision I made in the banquet hall came from my trust in Sirius and the knowledge that if anyone could do it, it would be her.
And that decision turned out to be right. That's all there's to it.
And so, Sirius, donning her white rose dress, made her triumphant return.
My honourable Master, I have cleared the path so that you may move forward.
Silently and elegantly, she reached her hand out to me.
No matter the attire I may wear, I will always be your maid, doing everything in her power to fulfil your wishes.
Were it your wish, I would more brightly and magnificently than anyone else.
Whether on the dance floor of a banquet or in the clouds of smoke on the battlefield, please allow this humble servant of yours to be your partner now and forever.
Like a polished diamond resting in the snow, she was gleaming, and so utterly beautiful.
I wake up to the first rays of dawn, my body still weary from work.
The moment I open my eyes, I notice that my room has been tidied up. The documents I left strewn across my nightstand are now neatly sorted.
And on a sticky note left on the fridge by the girl who accomplished this monumental task was a polite invitation:
"Commander, I would love for you to come visit my new teahouse. Let's spend a moment of peace and quiet together, and enjoy a cup of tea~"
So, I take up the invitation and arrive at the teahouse.
A warm fragrance of tea fills the air, sweeping away what remains of my sleepiness. I see Chang Feng sitting before a tea table, sipping freshly-brewed tea. She smiles gently at me.
Oh, Commander. I'm glad you decided to come~
You were sleeping so soundly this morning that I took the liberty of tidying up your room first.
Isn't it always better to start the day in a fresh and cozy environment?
But more importantly, why don't you come sit next to me?
To share this wonderful new experience together, Commander, I've even changed into a new outfit to suit the occasion. I hope it's to your liking.
Chang Feng invitingly pats the seat next to her. I sit down and am immediately captivated by the elegant decor of the teahouse.
You look really good, and so fitting for such an elegant place.
Was this place decorated with a special occasion in mind as well?
Heehee. Nothing escapes you, Commander~
Indeed, today is a very important day – which is why I said, I want to "share this wonderful new experience" with you.
As she speaks, Chang Feng carefully offers a teacup, holding it gently in her palms, and places it before me.
I recently obtained this Ru-ware tea set. The ceramics are sky-blue in color, with a smoothness reminiscent of jade. They are masterpieces among the works of the renowned Ru kilns in the Empery.
This room was decorated specifically to enhance one's appreciation of this tea set.
Only such clear and pristine sunlight can fully bring out the luster of Ru ware.
What do you think of it, Commander?

options.content: I don't think I've seen any material like this before.

scripts.say: Just as we say that good wine fears not being hidden, the value of exceptional ware is self-evident.
But, these pieces are not only beautiful. There's also a wonderful meaning behind them.
Did you know that this sky-blue color is the rarest kind of all?
Our ancestors described it as such: "After the rain's passing comes blue skies, after the cloud's parting comes new hues." That has a rather romantic sound to it, don't you think?
It resembles jade, yet isn't jade – and even surpasses it. They say a noble person is like jade; this Ru ware, too, feels warm to the touch, like such a person's presence...
Oh my... I got a bit carried away and ended up holding your hand on accident...
Ehehe... But, in any case, the process required to create this texture is quite sophisticated, from the mixing to the glazing to the firing.
Look carefully. Do you see these delicate patterns? They are crackles that naturally form in the glaze.
They can take the patterns of fish scales, crab claws, or fish eggs... Actually, just talking about it is making me hungry.
Now then, Commander, please help yourself to some snacks. I'll have fresh tea for you ready soon.
With deft motions, Chang Feng pours hot water into the Ru teaware and starts to brew the tea.
The wait gives me a chance to notice the beautiful Ru vase nearby, holding a lovely bouquet of flowers.
Suddenly, a beam of warm sunshine enters the room, illuminating the sky-blue vase with the glow of dawn.
Exquisite, isn't it? The marvel of this sky-blue glaze, it's said, is the way it plays with the light, showing different depths and hues.
Commander, thanks to you, we are able to witness this spectacle unfolding right before our eyes.
Okay. The tea is now ready~
Commander, please see for yourself if my skill has improved~
Hmm... You're right. Today's tea is indeed mellower and smoother than before.
Heehee. That beautiful sky-blue teacup right next to your lips... Ahh, I really wish I could capture this moment~
Oh my, I'm sorry for letting my imagination run wild...
Ahem... In any case, you can see now how the tea and the ware truly complement each other. It probably also helps that I'm using the freshest spring water.
If you pay close attention, you can hear the burbling of the water outside.
The clear sound of water flowing through the bamboo tube drifts in, bringing with it cool, fresh air.

I once heard a rather lovely misconception – that Ru kilns had to be opened just as a downpour stopped, believing that precise timing, seemingly ordained by the heavens, was key to achieving this unique glaze...
Romanticized as this idea may be, don't you think it captures the mood of this moment perfectly?
There's no need to be polite, Commander. How about another cup of tea?
The sky-blue cup feels warm and smooth in my palm; its gentle heat, combined with the fragrance of the tea, seems to soothe my very soul.
In this moment of leisure and elegance, all the stress that had been building up within me wafts away, leaving a deep sense of tranquility.
Yes please, if you don't mind.
Of course I don't mind. Being able to treat you like this is my utmost pleasure~♪
Please spend the rest of your free time enjoying the Ru ware's company – and mine, too~

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>1 Help Me, My Commander!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
My Commander, I don't think I can do this!
Sardegna's sole carrier, Aquila, looked at me imploringly with puffed-out cheeks.
Even though I finally have the opportunity to serve as your secretary, I feel like I can't do anything right!
Just thinking about how much trouble I'm going to end up causing you... is making me so very sad!
I wasn't sure exactly what was going on, but it seemed like she had some doubts about her abilities.
The source of those doubts was...
The other day, Miss Illustrious of the Royal Navy invited me to a tea party...
I tried to act as graceful and refined as possible as to not embarrass myself before the elegant ladies of the Royal Navy, but...
It was so painfully clear that I am missing something!
Well, I don't really know... Hmm, it's because I have too many ideas about what it might be to pin it down...

I was so happy about being chosen for secretary that I almost forgot to accept a commission we were given, and that ended up causing a lot of problems. I've also been making a ton of mistakes in my work...
Additionally, I haven't been able to improve my teamwork with my friends, and I sometimes feel like I barely know anything about being a carrier!
While it's true that things tend to go over Aquila's head, most major problems have been preventable just by giving her a quick reminder.
Regarding the situation with her peers, she's one of the newest arrivals at the port, and that's simply something that requires time.
My Commander, please help me...
Of course, I could not bear to see my secretary wallowing in self-doubt.
As such, I decided to ask my friends for help in showing Sardegna's courtly young lady the ways of our port.

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>2 A Study in Elegance</size>

scripts.say: I see. So she finds herself lacking in elegance compared to the most splendorous signorinas of the Royal Navy.
Littorio and I have come to assist in this matter.
Thank you so much for taking the time to come see me. There is much I hope to learn from the two of you.
Naturally. I shall spare no effort to aid my fellow Sardegnian.
Likewise. Noblesse oblige demands nothing less of me.
Why, thank you~
Then, as the commander suggested, shall we try holding a tea party?
Yes, that would be most appreciated.
...Hah!
She removed the bottlecap with just a flick of her rapier! Amazing!
Oh my, thank you very much, Lady Littorio~
There is no need to thank me, Miss Aquila. It is a privilege to offer this fine wine to such a fine young lady~
What do you think of this bottled rose, Commander?
"Is this... customary for a tea party?"
Lady Littorio, are you forgetting that Aquila is supposed to be the protagonist here? You're supposed to be helping her learn!
Miss Aquila, the beauty of this rose pales in comparison to your own.
Indeed. But just as a rose must be cultivated, your beauty shall bloom even more brilliantly if you become mine~
Umm... I guess, I'm supposed to be more assertive?
Indeed! It would simply be a shame to not make your beauty and splendor known!
And fortunately, you have people here who can freely express themselves without an iota of shame!
Make myself known, huh? I see... I need to be more aggressive, then?
What's something aggressive I can do? How about pouring the wine from all the way up here? My Commander, are you watching me? I'm— Eek?!
She quickly lost control, barely avoiding splashing wine all over her clothes.
I'm so sorry, my Commander...
But at least I realized, the issue wasn't with me being insufficiently elegant...
I had no clue if that farcical series of events actually accomplished anything... but it seemed like progress?

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>3 Making Things Work</size>

scripts.say: Port - Data Room
In order to help Aquila find her missing "something," I explained the situation to the kids who were helping sort out files in the Data Room.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Why certainly! Having the commander's secretary helping us will make things a hundred times faster!
Woohoo! The sooner we finish, the sooner we get to go out and play. Right, Maestrale?
Y-yeah... We appreciate the assistance.
And thus, everyone got to work.
The serious-looking girls, Carabiniere and Maestrale, pulled materials from the files and handed them to Aquila and Libeccio.
The latter pair were standing next to the copying machine, humming cheerfully while carefully copying the documents they were given.
...But for whatever reason, they were stuffing the documents back into the same old mess of a drawer that they came out of.
Ah, Commander, is there something unsatisfactory about my work? I'm just putting things back where they belong~
Look what I can do when I get serious, Commander! Praise me, praise me!
...I'm not sure I had the heart to tell them that what they needed wasn't praise, but rather a gentle reminder that they were creating even more work.
Um, Miss Aquila, you shouldn't just stuff the documents back into the drawer...
Did I mess up? I thought I was just doing what Libeccio told me to...
Libeccio, what in the world are you doing?! Jeez, y-you even got Miss Aquila to...
Sowwy...
After the slight interruption, the workflow was corrected and the documents were soon organized correctly.
Phew... That saved quite a bit of time.
What Maestrale meant to say was, thanks a ton! Hehehe...
Well, we did run into some hiccups along the way... Heh...
Well... All's well that ends well, I suppose?
Whatever Aquila was missing, it certainly didn't seem to be her ability to get work done...

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>4 Exercises and Combat Training</size>

scripts.say: Aquila saluted me gracefully as I arrived at the training grounds.
My Commander, thank you for going out of your way to arrange a special training session for me. I'm not sure how I should repay you...
...Oh, it's not a special training session? I see... So a spot opened up in today's regularly-scheduled carrier exercises?
I'm sorry for the mix-up, but thank you for giving me this opportunity nevertheless!
I know Aquila is conscious about her skills as an aircraft carrier, so I thought it would be a good idea to have her practice with some of the other carriers.
Oh wow, Miss Graf Zeppelin is here! I've always wanted to have a chat with her!
Even Junyou and Hiyou are joining us today! I never expected to see so many girls with a history similar to mine!
My Commander, I won't squander this learning opportunity you've given me!
Seeing Aquila's sparkling eyes, I had high hopes that she would be able to learn something valuable from this training session.
Deep breaths... Focus...
My Commander is watching me... so I can't afford to mess up now!
I'm sure this is the right way to launch my planes... Just as my friends taught me...! Fly, my planes!
Aquila's form was exquisite and breathtaking as her planes took over from her flight deck.
The planes took wing one after another, and with a swing of her staff, soared into the blue sky and joined the formation of the other carriers.
Considering Sardegna's reputation, or lack thereof, when it came to carrier technology, I was blown away by Aquila's perfect form.
Officer, you're thinking the exact same thing I am, aren't you?
Peter Strasser, the newest carrier from the Iron Blood, snapped me from my trance.
Judging from her performance today, she is easily on par with some of the most veteran carriers here, including Illustrious.
If she said that she is "missing something," as you claimed, she either already found it... or it was just a mental fabrication in the first place.
Wouldn't it be more appropriate to figure out why she thinks that, rather than trying to help her find whatever it might be?
After hearing those words from someone who shared a similar origin with Aquila, my eyes trailed back towards the sky above the training area.
Not only was her demeanor graceful and confident, but there was no sign of the anxiety she displayed earlier in my office.

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>5 Try, Try Again</size>

scripts.say: After consulting with the other ships again, we all agreed that Aquila didn't really seem to be missing any of the things she thought she was.
Though her work as the secretary could hardly be considered perfect, I also couldn't identify any major faults.
With her cheerful and outgoing personality, she quickly made friends, and in just a few short days, she was already joining tea parties with the carriers from the other factions.
As for her airheadedness...
I've circled the important items on your schedule so that you can easily see them at a glance.
For example, this item with four circles around it means you absolutely cannot afford to miss it... This one with a single circle can be delegated to somebody else.
Next, these stars and triangles mean...
To be honest, it was a little hard to see what was on my itinerary from all the cutesy shapes and marks, but I was the one who gave her the advice to use little marks to remind herself.
...Yeah, cute and charming is definitely what it was.
My Commander, thank you for always listening to my unreasonable requests.
I could've sworn I was missing something, but in the end, I'm not sure that's the case anymore.
Thanks to you, I've learned so much in such a short period of time.
Aquila's disarming smile seemed to melt the worries away from me. But... was that really it? Had her problem just gone away on its own?
By the way, Miss Illustrious is having another tea party next week, and I was wondering if you'd be willing to take my place...

options.content: "I think you should give it another try, Aquila."

scripts.say: Commander...?
If what Peter said was true, and she didn't let her nerves get the better of her, I don't think her airheadedness would be a problem.
There's no way that she would cause me trouble as my secretary... And I was adamant in that belief.
You're not coming with me? ...Do I have to go try again by myself...?
If you say so, my Commander... I'll prepare for it...
Aquila's expression seemed more fitting for someone going off to war, not to a tea party... But I was glad to see the conviction in her eyes.

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>6 The Missing "Something"</size>

scripts.say: Sister Aquila, would you, um... like to try this...?
Oh my, what an adorable-looking treat. Thank you very much, Unicorn~
Mm, how delicious! Unicorn, would you like to try some of our famous candy from Sardegna?
Make sure to say thank you, Unicorn.
Thank you, Sister Aquila~!
I observed the patio where the tea party was being held from a distance, every action from the carriers exuding elegance and grace as they enjoyed tea and dessert.
Just thinking about the farce that had unfolded with Littorio and Abruzzi made me a bit nervous, but my worries proved to be misplaced.
I've also had an opportunity to talk with Peter Strasser as well as many of the other carriers, and I think I was overthinking things after all.
It's a little embarrassing to say this, but I've been thinking a lot about you, Miss Illustrious.
I'm flattered. What about me, if I may ask?
Oh, it's nothing important. There's just something that's been on my mind.
There's a sense of, "I want to become like this or that, so that others can recognize my worth." Something like that...
I don't get that impression from you anymore.
Hmm... Really?
Mhm... You seem a lot more relaxed and natural than before.
I agree. When I look at you, what I see is a splendidly shining lady.
Hearing Illustrious's and Unicorn's words lifted a heavy burden off my chest.
Aquila's anxiety – that "something" she was missing – had been found before I even knew it.
If I've changed compared to how I was before...
It must be because I've found someone who cares about me, right?
Yes, I'm sure of it, my Commander...

sequence:
The Growth of a Courtly Lady

<size=45>7 My Commander</size>

scripts.say: After the tea party ended, I went to pick Aquila up and bring her back to the office.
...So, Unicorn prepared some really tasty treats for today's tea party!
I wrapped up the leftovers, so you can help yourself if you'd like~
Though if you don't hurry up, the other girls might get to them before you. Hehe~
Aquila continued to happily tell me about her tea party.
What Unicorn said was right. Aquila's just being herself today, and it shows.
Of course, I cannot hold a candle to Miss Illustrious in so many aspects...
But that isn't the thing that I was missing.
She's always had what it took in terms of elegance, work capability, and skills as a carrier. Of course, there's always room for improvement, but...
One more thing... I finally realized, you've been secretly watching over me this whole time, right? Because you're worried about me...
That, I had. I didn't think she would notice, but since she did, I had to apologize.
My Commander, there's no need to apologize.
I was able to join today's tea party because of you... I've also learned so much recently because of your help.
But above all, thank you for noticing what I was missing.
The silver-haired girl spun around and flourished her red, white, and green cloak mischievously.
The thing I was missing was...
A Commander who cherishes me for who I am~
The elegant young lady from Sardegna drew close to me and lightly intertwined her arm with mine.
Please, continue to teach me all sorts of things, my Commander~♪

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 1: The Secretary Ship</size>

scripts.say: My sister... I'm sorry.
I hope you'll forgive me for what I did...
That dream again... How many times does that make it...
... Now is not the time to be sentimental.
The Commander... still hasn't arrived. Perhaps I should start with work that even a secretary could take care of. First would be the reports entrusted to me, and...
When I arrived at the office, my secretary, Tirpitz, had already begun her duties.
Good morning, Commander. You've arrived.
Perfect timing. Please check today's tasks and schedule. If there are any problems, I will fix them.
Also, I've dealt with some of the work regarding fleet operations that you gave me yesterday.
Come to think of it, the stack of papers that was piled up neatly on the desk is...
There's no reason to thank me for something this insignificant. I'm only doing what's expected of me as the secretary.
Tirpitz returned to work.
As expected of the exemplar ship of the Iron Blood, there's really nothing to criticize about her work.
But... why do I somewhat feel like I'm being kept at an arm's distance...?

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 2: Mission</size>

scripts.say: Tirpitz was planning to deliver old equipment to Yuubari at the Research Department.
As I thought, it's impossible to carry everything in one trip... It'd be better to split this up into multiple trips.
You seem troubled! Fear not, for Justice is here! The Little Beavers are here to save the day!
What...?
So you wanted to deliver these to Yuubari, right?
Umm, who might you be...?
I am Charles Ausburne, ally of justice and Captain of the Little Beavers! Wait here for a second, I'll go and gather everyone!
Little Beavers, assemble-!
Kaay, I'm here~
D-Did something happen?!
What a pain...
Everyone, let's work together and carry all this to Yuubari's Research Department!
Wait, this is the secretary ship's duty. I'm fine doing this on my-
As if to cut Tirpitz off, the members of the Little Beavers quickly lifted the equipment onto a trolley and departed.
Tirpitz, who was carrying equipment alongside them, seemed to be thinking about something.
Port - Research Department
With this, Justice has been served! Little Beavers, out!
I give you my thanks. I shall let the Commander know of your help.
Hey, no need for something like that! Justice demands no recompense!
Besides, isn't it obvious that comrades should help each other out? Everyone else does the same!
Well, I'll be leaving then! More Justice awaits!
I'm... a comrade... Alright, I get it.
Watching the Little Beavers until they disappeared, Tirpitz began walking.

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 3: Practice Exercise</size>

scripts.say: Port - Exercise Area
Today is the day of the Iron Blood joint exercise.
Without batting so much as an eyelid, Tirpitz aimed a shell perfectly at the target ship that was being controlled by the Manjuu.
Thank you.
Tirpitz, you sure are amazing~
Oh, it's Eugen... My aim is nothing praiseworthy. You and Hipper are also doing quite well, aren't you?
My, aren't you modest. Did you hear that, Hipper? You'd do well to learn from her.
Huh?! Why should I?

Because Tirpitz is tha~at amazing, but look, she's not full of herself at all. Not at all like some blonde, attention-seeking tsundere who begs the Commander to "Praise me! Praise me!" for simply completing a mission~
Knock it off, Eugen. I'm sure Hipper tries in her own...
Huh?! Well, excuuuuse me for being who I am! Eugen! Do you want me to hit you again?!
Hehe, what do you think~♪
Commander, you've got nothing to do with this! Eugen! Stay there! Don't run! Today's the day I'll make you understand that I'M the matriarch of the Hipper class!
... Sisters, huh...
In silence, Tirpitz was pondering over something.
Sorry. Without realizing it, I started to wonder if all sisters could become like this.
Tirpitz displayed a somewhat lonely expression.

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 4: Sortie</size>

scripts.say: Location: Unspecified sea area
At the place the sea patrol fleet that Tirpitz was flagship of was cruising through...
*Sigh*... Boooring... Another day where nothing happens.
Please focus! What are you going to do if the enemy appears right now?
It's fine~ According to recent observation reports, no enemies have appeared in this area for over two weeks~
But, in the one in a million chance...
One in a million basically means it won't happen, you know? *Sigh*... I want this to end quickly so I can go back and go for a run or something...
We'll be arriving at the turnaround point soon. Please prepare for the return journey.
Roger!
(What is this unsettling premonition I'm getting...)
I'm getting enemy readings on my radar! It's a Siren destroyer fleet!
With these numbers, I'm not sure that just us destroyers will...
I won't let my comrades be injured...!
The intense bombardment from her main battery continued for a while.
Holy cow! What was that...?!
It was support shelling from Tirpitz... Confirmation of enemy fleet's annihilation!
W-With this we're fine... right?
Tirpitz, thank you...
... It wasn't a big deal.
Let's report this situation to the Commander.
(What... did I...)

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 5: Everyone's Secretary Ship</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
As usual, Tirpitz was easily and efficiently handling her secretary duties.
Next, organize the observation reports of the sea zones, and update the ones the Sirens have appeared in...
(Knock knock)
Excuse me for intruding while you're busy. I've left Master's and Ms. Tirpitz's black tea over here.
Thanks for your work.
Please don't mention it. If anything, Ms. Tirpitz is the one who's always helping me... Excuse me.
If you could update the route that is to be patrolled next time based on the predictions of enemy appearances in the various sea zones...
(Knock knock)
Hello there. Tirpitz, you really saved me last time. Thanks.
Here, the newest model air purifier. Umm, it's a model that raises work efficiency and promotes good health. I'll leave it here.
Ah, thank you.
There are still things left unfinished at the Research Department, so I'll be heading out.
With this, the patrol route should be... and for the personnel...
(Knock knock)
I'll be coming in~! Ah, Tirpitz! Perfect. I heard the other day that you're interested in bonsai, so I've come today to bring you the gift of bonsai!
I took care of this one pretty carefully. If you look at it when you're tired, you'll feel uplifted and recharged in no time! So, would this be a good place for it?
Sure, that place works.
Okay, over here, and... all right. Well, I'll be outta here before I become a bother~ See you later!
Don't you think we've been getting more and more visitors lately...?
Tirpitz didn't seem to know that she was the reason why more people had been visiting.
She didn't seem to realize that she was smiling radiantly in front of everyone.

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 6: The Queen's Smile</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
After being stuck with more work than usual, Tirpitz ended up working until midnight.
I didn't realize that there'd be so much work... I should've done a better job of gauging the workload when I was drawing up plans yesterday...
Commander, thank you for your hard work. Sorry for making you stick with me for so long.
If you're tired, please go ahead and rest. I'll take care of the rest.

options.content: Tirpitz, there's something different about you.

scripts.say: Something... different?
That I've protected the other girls - I was simply doing what I needed to do to maintain my combat power...
That I've worried about you - I was only focusing on improving efficiency as the secretary...
That I've become able to work well with everyone else in the fleet - That is...

options.content: The ice around you has melted.

scripts.say: Tirpitz displayed a rare moment of surprise on her face, and then she said...
The ice... has melted, huh.
Ahh...
Indeed, it might just have... I... haven't forgotten yet...
That's right. If I had been pushing the comrades around me away with a shell of ice, I suppose saying that "the ice had melted" describes it well.
For so long, all I knew was coldness and loneliness, to the point where I thought I had long forgotten the warmth that comes from others, but...
Commander, thank you for reminding me.
Tirpitz smiled warmly.
As I thought, a smile fits her the best.

sequence:
「Schmelzen」

<size=45>Chapter 7: Warmth</size>

scripts.say: After that, some time passed...
Port - Outskirts
Tirpitz invited me to come talk to her, and I ended up somewhere up high at the outskirts of the port.
Sorry for having you come out to a place like this.
The truth is, there's something I wanted to see with you.
Tirpitz pointed at something shimmering in the sky.
Yes, the Polarstern.
Whenever I look at this star, I'm reminded of my past... that time I was locked down in port, a "fleet in name only."
I spent day after day doing nothing, feeling nothing, just simply used to being cold and alone.
And then, having achieved nothing of note, I met my end, watching the smoke of despair fill the harbor as I welcomed my destruction.
Don't you agree that I had a ridiculous, empty life?
But now, things are different.
Now there is the joy of meeting people, and the peace of mind from being with you. And the warmth of it was able to melt away the ice of my past.
"The Lone Queen of the North" is alone no longer.
I pray that the other me in the mirror - and in my dreams - will be as happy as the me here right now...
... I think I'm a little tired.
I feel the weight of her resting against my shoulder.
Say, would you mind if I pull up closer to you...?
I want to feel your warmth for a little bit longer...
Tirpitz's warm voice, almost in a whisper, filled your ears.
I hope she stays this gentle, now and forever.

sequence:
First Movement

<size=45>Sunrise</size>

scripts.say: Attention, all Iron Blood personnel!
We have conserved every bit of our energy and every ounce of our undying will for this day.
We have let many fine opportunities slip by us, and we have been subjugated to bitter experience after bitter experience.
But now our rigorous trials have ended, and it is time to show the world the strength of our resolve!
The unyielding soldier shall never know true failure!
And the truth lies only within the range of our cannons!
From this point onwards, we will pay no heed to deception, debate, and other such cheap parlor tricks!
We shall expand our lands with the might of our black iron and the courage of our crimson blood!
We shall fight for our fatherland! We shall march onward, and we shall be victorious!
This is the principle on which the Iron Blood fleet and the Crimson Axis will survive!
Victory to us! Long live Iron Blood!
VICTORY TO US!
LONG LIVE IRON BLOOD!

sequence:
Fifth Movement

<size=45>Songs of the Grave</size>
<size=60>「Mind your etiquette, Repulse. Now more then ever, we represent the glory of the Royal Navy.」</size>
<size=60>「Don't get distracted again, Renown. A proper lady minds her every step.」</size>
<size=60>「Dunkerque, hopefully you understand now that we fight for a lasting peace.」</size>
<size=60>「Wales, fighting side by side with you was my greatest honour.」</size>
<size=60>「May I finally be able to put down this crown of thorns」</size>
<size=60>Ventis Secundis</size>
<size=60>「... God save the Queen.」</size>

scripts.say: This is the end, Bismarck.
By the decree of the Queen, you are to lay down your arms and come with us. You shall have a fair trial in our courts.
So, is this how the Royal Navy does things, O "Sailor King?"
Even in the face of our bloody retribution, you still insist on suppressing your fighting instict to resort to cheap rhetoric.
Tell me... You may be cutting edge warships, but do your hearts even know the thrill of battle?
Hahaha! It's been a long time since someone has called me that...
You see, every member of the Royal Navy has a moral obligation to act in accordance with our noble traditions.
Her Majesty grants providence to those who have lost their way, but smites those who would cause us harm.
I shall not ask you another time–
FEUER!
Booomm————
She doesn't have the ammo for this. Fear not, our enemy is on her last legs!
She's made her choice painfully clear...
All forces, open fire! For the glory of the Royal Navy!
Booomm————
Quite impressive armor you have there... Even my 14-inch guns are having trouble breaking through.
Our mastery of metallurgy far surpasses anything the Royal Navy is capable of...
What... from starboard?!
Gah... this kind of firepower... it can't be...
Ships of the Royal Navy, now we triumph over the enemy!
You face one of the Big Seven! Let's see how your vaunted armor stands against my 16-inch guns!
Fiiiiire!
Booomm————
This is...
Booomm————
a once-in-a-lifetime battle...
Booomm————
the greatest thrill...
Booomm————
for an Iron Blood battleship!
Booomm————
Curses... they took out my precious Dora?!
Have we lost the initiative...?
Target her bridge. All guns–
Booomm————
What...?! A shell from beyond the horizon?!
No... this... this came from underwater!!
Everyone, switch to high alert! There are more enemies still out there!
You've had your fun, Royal Navy girls.
How terribly inconvenient it would be if you were to break our valuable specimen.
Sirens? Of course they'd show up at a crucial time like this...
Royal Fleet, get back into formation. Let's give the Sirens a warm welcome!

sequence:
Sixth Movement

<size=45>Of Science and Learning</size>

scripts.say: Miss Bismarck... You almost lost your life, and yet you still refuse to use "that?"
I don't need help from the likes of you...
Still acting tough even in this condition? You could have sent your enemies to the bottom of the sea so easily. All you needed was a little bit of... determination.
After dueling with Hood, I had a realization.
Winning with such an unfair advantage would not bring us glory at all...
I knew nothing then, except that I had allowed the abyss to gaze back into me.
Even now, that heart of darkness eats away at my Wisdom Cube...
It plays an endless scherzo, constantly jeering at me from within my own mind.
It beckons me to give in to its violence.
I had Eugen leave because there is no telling what will become of me.
But I now know that it is time to end this farce.
Uploading Report: Results of Experiment No. 151 - Negative. Status: Statistically Insignificant. Requesting further directives.
Received. Recommendation: Execute Reconversion Agreement.
Kaboom!
(Bismarck turned her last remaining battery and aimed at Tester, who was still transmitting her message.)
My loyalties are not to some weapon, but to the people of the Iron Blood.
For the glory of the Iron Blood!!
Issuing Errata to Experiment No. 151 - Test subject has opened fire upon Self.
Finally, some excitement! I was starting to get bored here! Next, Execute Awakening Protocol.
Understood. Regarding the Agreement–
Rodney, give me a damage report!
I've begun damage control. Battery A has been destroyed, but I'm still operational.
Excellent. We won't let our enemies get away from us, Siren or Iron Blood.
Members of the Royal Fleet, Battlecruiser Renown has come to assist you! Fire!!
Ark Royal, reporting in! Let's finish this battle before my excort fleets' curfew!
Everyone, Victorious is here! Now our victory is assured!
Swordfish, launch!!
I'm counting on you two to get us air superiority! Rodney and I will look for ways to break through their defenses. Don't let any enemies slip through our guard!
Ahaha, look at you Royal slobs just barge in one after another! Where's that vaunted "decorum" of yours now?
Disgusting! Utterly tactless...!
(The situation is slightly abnormal. The heat signatures of all units exceed the normal range.)
(Could this be a result of the Awakening Protocol?)
Host, are you currently seeing this situation?
Requesting permission to commence full testing of the Awakening Protocol.
Beep... beep... beep... (the signal continues to flicker)
The signal... was lost?
No matter... I can't let this opportunity pass by. I'll carve you all up and analyze your Wisdom Cubes!
The Siren's movements have slowed. Now is our chance – chaaaaaarge!!
Yes, yes! The readings are growing even more... Come, let me see your hatred! Let it all out!
Booomm————
(The sky trembled with a chorus of cannonfire, pillars of water erupting one after another as if conducting the Royal Fleet's salvo of shells and torpedoes)
The sea water that fell like rain around the Siren sizzled and turned into mist, repelled by an enormous energy flow.
Soon, a thick mist began to spread across the battlefield.
There's suddenly been a change in the weather! We can't see anything, nor can the recon planes... No, we've lost sight of Bismarck!
The history of human evolution... is the chronicle of technology and learning.
For the sake of learning, no sacrifice is too great to make...
What is this ominous presence... No way...
Everyone, emergency manoeuvres!!!
A massive beam of light penetrated through the mist, a massive funnel of wind following in its wake.
In the blink of an eye, it melted through King George V's armor, leaving a gaping hole.
Bismarck, what have you done...
Stay alert, everyone!

sequence:
Seventh Movement

<size=45>The Convalescent</size>

scripts.say: Ahahahahaha~!!
Ugh! My armour...
Watch out! This is no ordinary cannon that we're up against!
(Unbelievable... it melted through battleship armor just like that...)
As the mist began to settle, Bismarck gradually came back into view, but she was different from before.
Surrounding her was a ghastly black and red aura, pulsing ominously as if oozing blood.
Tester was nowhere to be found.
A great man once said...
There is no God in this world. Even if there was, I would have slain him with my own hands!
You've finally shown your true colors, Iron Blood battleship!
For a moment there, I almost thought you had some honour as a warrior.
Turns out, my concerns were wasted on the likes of you.
We of the Royal Navy will never sacrifice our dignity out of fear of death or failure, but you threw away yours so easily.
Whether you deem yourself to believe in God or the sun matters not to me.
All you need to know is that we will put an end to you and your plot.
I've finally managed to get in range.
So this is how you managed to defeat Hood from such a long range.
Isn't that right, Bismarck?
Draw your sword. We'll settle it mano a mano, you honourless madwoman.
Honor... huh?
Royal fleet, cover me! Don't let anything get in my way!
Booomm————
Aha... Haha... Ahahahahaha!!!
Bismarck cackled as a massive ring of light began to contract around her, dragging countless Siren ships into her core and crushing them into dust.
She's... absorbing the entire Siren fleet?!
Is she going berserk? There's no way she can handle all this power!
Watch out! She's aiming towards the center of our formation!!
We won't be able to dodge in time! Brace for impact, everyone!!
Boom——
What...? I'm still alive...?
(Instead of unleashing all the energy she had stored, Bismarck dissipated it in a huge explosion.)
(When the smoke cleared, half of her rigging had been blown away.)
*cough* *cough* ...What...
Is this the limit of your so-called power...
To think that you'd attempt to self-destruct... Ahh, turns out we weren't able to synchronize with your Wisdom Cube after all...
Heh... even though I thought I had the resolve to wield this power...
All it took was a moment...
For it to completely consume me.

Uploading Report: Results of Experiment No. 151 - Test subject managed to forcefully eject from the Awakening Protocol. While statistically significant, overall performance failed to reach target benchmarks.
I don't know what you're plotting, Siren...
But whatever it is, I won't allow you to defile my honor and glory any longer!
Proud warriors of the Royal Navy... Though our grudge goes back many moons, I regret to inform you...
I have no intention of falling into your hands today.
The Iron Blood shall seize our own destiny!
LONG LIVE IRON BLOOD!
Bismarck fired her very last shot in the direction of the Royal fleet.
Since her fire control had been completely destroyed, the shell crashed harmlessly into the water well before it reached the fleet.
She has no ability to fight us anymore. I'm not sure I want to finish her off...
But why is she so persistent...?
I take back what I said about you before. If that is the decision you've made...
We shall send you off with our warmest regards.
All members of the Royal Navy
Focus all of your firepower upon Bismarck!
Boom——
(... In the end, I was still unable... to achieve our aspirations...)
(Ah... I can finally become one with the ocean again...)
(My beloved Iron Blood...)
No... not yet...!
Don't tell me you're having second thoughts now, Bismarck?
Tell me, Siren, of all those infinite possibilities that you saw, were there any that...
Of course not. Not a single one.
We have been observing humanity for thousands of years. Your existence is but a drop of water in the ocean of data.
You are so small, so insignificant. Even if I was to tell you, you do not even have the power to choose your own destiny.
Your only purpose in life was to wage war meaninglessly and sink meaninglessly.
No matter how many times we re-simulate this battle, the course of history will not change even if you survive.
You're sorely mistaken
What happens to me is of no significance. Tell me what happens to the Iron Blood...
Tell me what happens to our people... to my compatriots... and to my sister.
Tell me if their future can be saved.
What a pitiful specimen you are. Of all the things you could have asked about, you chose the ones with the lowest priority.
Hypothetically, if there was a way to save your people, would you be able to shoulder that burden, O Great Fleet Leader?
I would die trying.
My idea of "self" died the day I was given the name of Bismarck. I live only to protect the Iron Blood, and would gladly give my life for my people.
Not once have I feared facing my fate.
Hahaha...! I've changed my mind. Let us see you dance once more as you try to turn the cogs of fate by yourself.
Use our power. Show us how you are able to reshape this world.
If you are able to transcend your limitations as "Bismarck" and become one with your "alter ego," perhaps then you may find your answer...
Until then... we shall be awaiting your little dance.
Discipline is our Iron, and glory is our Blood.
At long last... we of the Iron Blood are free to choose our own fate...
KABOOM---!
You once said that,
Music can evoke two very different desires within people. One is the desire for the rapture of war, and the other is the desire for an idyllic tranquility.
I'm finally able to experience that tranquility...
Ahh... am I getting... sleepy?

sequence: <size=60>(My sister... I'm sorry that... I won't ever be able to meet you...)</size>

scripts.say: It's finally over...
Yes, the Sirens have disappeared without a trace. The victory is ours today.
But... it was a costly one.
Members of the Royal Navy, together, we have finally put an end to a powerful foe who has long threatened our waters.
During this battle, our enemies fought tenacity and an indomitable spirit.
My hope is that one day, should any of you find yourselves outnumbered against a superior enemy, you will fight with the same tenacity that you witnessed today.
Carry forth the fighting spirit of the Royal Navy!
God save the Queen!
God save the Queen!
Well, everyone, let's go home! Make sure to inspect any damage thoroughly and get repairs as necessary.
I'm getting closer to the source of the signal... Could all this wreckage be...?
Gods preserve us! Lord Bismarck is in trouble!
Let's ride! All ahead full!
Chaaaaaarge!
Please hold on, Lord Bismarck!
Hold on, I'm coming to save you! ...Lord Bismarck?

sequence: <size=60>I, U-556, hereby declare before Neptune, Lord over oceans, seas, lakes, rivers, brooks, ponds, and rivulets,</size>
<size=60>that I will provide any desired assistance to my ally and Lord, battleship Bismarck,</size>
<size=60>at any place on the water, under water, on land, or in the air.</size>
<size=60>Signed: U-556, Parzival of The Seas</size>
<size=60>At the bottom, U-556 had made a drawing of herself towing her Lord Bismarck back to port.</size>
<size=60>                                                         </size>

Second Movement

<size=45>Backworldsmen</size>

scripts.say: Mission area, location undisclosed - Early dawn
So, in summary, Hood is out of commission and Wales fled southeast. And now it's gotten very quiet.
Bismarck, could we slow down a little? It's pretty unpleasant to cruise at full speed on these harsh waves.
The situation with Hood has put the Royal Navy in disarray, so even if somebody comes after us, they'll probably be lagging behind.
Don't underestimate them. I doubt the Royal Navy would stand on the sidelines and wait around after what happened.
How are your injuries? I know you used your power, but even so...
I'm fine. They're little more than a passing thought in my mind in comparison to the imminent threat of the Royal Navy.
If you say so. But spare me the tough girl act, please.
Eugen, stay in formation.
Sorry, no can do. I'm running on fumes. You should take a moment to catch your own breath, too.
Eugen, you...!
Is it not my duty to stop my leader from making reckless decisions?
... I must say, nobody interjects better than you at times like this, Eugen.
Thanks, I suppose.
Hey! You there! No horesplay in the port! State your name, rank, and affiliation!
Heh heh. I am the great Parzival of the Seas! Winner of the Knight's Cross with Oak Leaves, U-556 herself!
I bid you good morning, Lady Tirpitz~
L-Lady...? And just what is that title supposed to mean?!
If I catch you misbehaving again, you'll answer to the military police!
Heh heh heh... It'll be a cold day in hell when those pigs can catch The Lucky 556!
Here, Lady Tirpitz, you give it a shot. See if you can chase me~
What?
U-556 did a graceful, if a bit silly, backflip into the harbor.）
Get back here, you!!
Tirpitz seethed with anger at the submerged U-556, popping blood vessels on her forehead.）
Hehehe, chalk up another win for 556!
Your little sister is so like you in so many ways, Lord Bismarck.）
The great Parzival of the Seas, U-556, is off once again to fulfill her knightly vows!）
They have once again failed to break the Awakening Protocol.~
That is a disappointment, but think of all the sweet, juicy data we've collected.
But why did you choose Bismarck as your guinea pig? There are so many other, much more suitable "catalysts".
The defeat of the Iron Blood was a foregone conclusion.
But no matter how obvious I made it, no matter how many hints I dropped, she refused to be swayed from her course.

And this is precisely the kind of mind I wanted to study - one which defied all our statistical models. She could have been the key to a successful "Awakening," the "Vector" that would usher forth a new future.
There was one who could hear the Song of Ragnarok, and began her lonely dance.
To those who could not hear the music, the dancer seemed a madman.
She was that dancer. The one who dances in the face of her fate, doomed to never become The Sun.
... You're talking more and more like the humans of this era.
I've had a lot of free time to decode the documents of this ancient civilization. I suppose you could say I've been inspired.
Besides, collecting the artistic heritage of each period is also one of our core functions.
Anyway, I've just received a new message.
Work is nearly complete in Sector C3 of the Mirror Seas, we just need to prioritize distribution of the testing materials.
Testing materals...? How fortunate we've just acquired a fine "specimen" from Bismarck over there.
Now what say we enjoy a good old game of chess...?
Oh, what's this? Were you rats looking for cheese, but found us instead?
G-good heavens, they've detected us!
Oh, shoot! Quick, we must send a telegram immediately!
Bismarck, mind if I have a bit of fun with our pursuers?
Permission granted. Send them scampering.
... But don't overextend yourself. They know where we are.
We must avoid spreading our forces too thin.
Heheheh, got it~
I drove 'em off. They're not showing up on my radar, so they must've run off home to mama.
So, now what? Shouldn't we be coming across a Royal Navy main fleet any second now?
Eugen...
Yeah?
My injuries are worse than I thought. I can't continue this operation until I've had repairs. We're heading back to base.
Are you... sure about that? Even if we head straight for it, it's a long way to go.
I'll head straight back to port. You continue the mission.
You mean, on your own? I'd be lying if I said that sounds like a good idea.
My route is through friendly waters. It would be difficult even for the Royal Navy to attempt any kind of attack there.
Ah, Vichia's waters... I guess you thought this through after all.
... I've given you orders, and you will follow them. I will not tolerate any more narcissistic behavior on your part.
All right, I'll do as you say. The circumstances are extraordinary, after all.
We have no time to waste. Depart at once.
And maintain top speed. Don't stop for anything until you've reached safe waters.
Lastly, I will remind you once more: this is a direct order from the leader of the Iron Blood fleet.
Understood. I wish you good luck.
Same to you. May the God of war be with you.
... Victory to us.
... And long live Iron Blood.

sequence:
Third Movement

<size=45>Great Longing</size>

scripts.say: ... I have no reason to listen to a single word from you Sirens.
Ahahaha~ Be silent and listen carefully, you insignificant being.
How dare you...!
If this continues, Iron Blood will cease to exist in this world, too.
Your enemies will hurt those you wish to protect, steal your riches, and make your oceans their own.
I suppose one would call it a humiliating defeat, no?
None of your comrades will be spared of the bitter taste of this defeat. Especially not your dear sister Tirpitz... Ahaha...
You don't want to suffer another Article 231, do you?
Silence!
The Iron Blood is not so brittle that it would crumble from a few isolated defeats!
We will seize victory and eradicate you once more, you despicable enemies of humankind!
Ahaha... Let me tell you something I once heard from a human...
"Humankind, much like a tree, wishes to grow to reach the clouds; the light; the Heavens. As its branches grow, its roots do, too. Deeper and deeper into the ground; into darkness; towards Hell."
And is it not the light that you desire?
I have no more to say to you... Main guns, feuer!
With this little power, your wish hasn't the slightest chance of being granted.
Think about it. Just what do YOU have that WE want?
Your inferior technology? Your nonexistent resources? Your waters, which we've already claimed for ourselves?
You have nothing, not a single thing worthy of our interest.
Just the Royal Navy alone is many times powerful than you. If they so wanted, they could keep your trade routes blockaded in perpetuity...
If you'd realize that it's they, not us, who are threatening your existence, then you'd be able to understand the situation.
You may not believe it, but unlike those hypocrites who only pay lip service to the idea of liberty and justice, we will actually hold you in high regards.
Which is why I gave you the key to your future. But how you use it is up to you...
Whether this forbidden power leads to a bright new future for you and your comrades or a tragic repeat of the sorrowful demise you've known before, all depends on you.
... I assure you, we will meet again. Ahahaha...
... Throughout the whole ordeal, I was trembling.
Such power, vast beyond measure. There was never any room for discussion, let alone debate... I had no choice but to accept the power.
Chancellor... if you were in my place, what would you do...?
Ahah, I've discovered Bismarck! May I scramble my planes?
Certainly. Permission granted. Show her the might of our aircraft carriers.
Understood! This is Victorious, commencing plane launch! God save the Queen!
Are these... aircraft?
If only Graf Zeppelin were here to... No, this is no time to grumble.
Such a puny airstrike could never sink an Iron Blood battleship!
Anti-air guns, focus fire on the enemy aircraft squadrons!
FEUER!
Direct hit on Bismarck confirmed! ... Hold on, it didn't have any effect on her speed!
Once I've recovered my aircraft, I'll prepare a second strike! Just you wait, Bismarck!
Hahahah! Well done, Victorious!
(... If she can maintain her speed in spite of her injuries, she must be a terribly powerful battleship.)
(And if she manages to seek refuge in Vichian waters, the going will get tough for us.)
(We must slow her down through any means necessary...!)
I received a message that Force H should be arriving soon! They'll make contact with Bismarck in 30 minutes!
So, all of the Royal Navy's most capable ships are in pursuit.
The Royal Family's honour hinges upon us. We shall sink Bismarck!

sequence:
Fourth Movement

<size=45>Passion, Joy, and Suffering</size>

scripts.say: Captain Bismarck! Captain Bismarck, please wait!
Ah, the little submarine. Good morning to you.
Hey, um! Your performance yesterday was absolutely fantastic, and I will never ever in my whole life forget it!
A-also! Captain Bismarck, I was hoping I could ask you for a small little favor!
What would that be?
T-thank you for hearing me out! You see, I just entered service today! I was hoping you could, uh...
Like in one of my fairy tales! "Starting today, U-556 shall gallop across the seas, much like the honorable knight Sir Parzival did!" ... H-how does that sound?
Congratulations. Do your utmost in servitude to Iron Blood.
No, no, I meant, like... Um, I know this is reeeeaaally improper of me to ask, and I'm sorry for even considering being so rude as to do it anyway, but...
I was hoping you could give me your blessings! If so, I'd be able to push myself to my absolute limits in my missions on the front!
I-I know! I'll show you my special trick!
Look! It's a water handstand!
U-556 did a backflip and plunged deep below the water.
... Pffft...
The strange yet humorous trick was able to bring a smile even to Bismarck's lips.
Captain... Bismarck?
Pardon, I'm just a little awestruck by how different you are to everyone else I've met.
I've heard from some people that you're really reserved and hard to approach, Captain Bismarck...
But that's not the case at all... You don't have trouble talking even to a submarine like me! In fact, you're actually really friendly!
(... Is that... how people view me? That's... rather disheartening.)
The thought of it made Bismarck's smile disappear. She turned to U-556, whose head was poking out of the water, to say her goodbyes.
I've heard your wish. Now then, if you'll excuse me.
Bismarck departed, leaving U-556 all to herself.
Then, on the following day...
556, what's the matter? ... You don't look very happy.
Well...
Captain Bismarck promised she'd come back to give her blessings, but she's still not back yet...
Captain Bismarck is probably very busy... I doubt she'd remember a promise like that...
Yeah... you're right. I'll have to prove myself in battle, that way Captain Bismarck will one day bestow me with the Knight's Cross with Oak Leaves...
That's it! The Knight's Cross with Oak Leaves! That's only fitting for me, Parzival of The Seas!
I've formed a plan, and I'm gonna execute it! Submarine U-556, setting sa...
U-556 noticed there were Manjuu gathering just within her sight. Then, a familiar face approached her...
One of our newest Iron Blood comrades will soon head into her first battle.
Though she may be small, her talents and reliability are second to none.
Now I, Bismarck, as the representative of the Iron Blood fleet, shall offer her my blessings!
Submarine U-556! Your success shall echo to the ends of the earth, and your reputation shall invoke fear within our enemies! May the God of war be with you!
Fanfare band, begin!
The band made up of Manjuu began playing a song which wishes success to a soldier departing to the front.
The largest battleship in all of the world was offering her blessings to a small submarine.
Captain Bismarck...!
Standing before Bismarck, the woman she adored, U-556 was determined to say one thing.
Captain Bismarck, i-if you'll please forgive me, I have one more favor to ask...
My, you're a greedy child. What favor do you ask of me?
Please... allow me to call you "Lord"!
... Huh?
Not even Bismarck could help being confused by this unexpected request.
It's to express my gratitude and respect for you! ... Um, may I please call you "Lord Bismarck"?
Well... I suppose why not.
L-Lord Bismarck! I'm incredibly grateful!
(... Dear me...)
(Nobody has ever called me something that flattering before... a-am I blushing?)
Ah, also, I was hoping I could give you this before I depart, Lord Bismarck!
U-556 took out a slip of paper and handed it to Bismarck.
What's this...?
It's a certificate of sponsorship which I wrote yesterday!
I hereby pledge always to protect Lord Bismarck, no matter when and no matter where!
Bismarck's lips gently parted, after which she turned to U-556 and nodded.
Ah, sorry, I forgot! I have to sortie now! ... Lord Bismarck, I must take my leave!
We'll have to talk more next time! ... U-556, weighing anchor!
U-556 got on her rigging and joined U-557 as they disembarked from the port.
So she has a little sister... Isn't that nice...
I wonder if Tirpitz is okay...

sequence: <size=60>I, U-556, hereby declare before Neptune, Lord over oceans, seas, lakes, rivers, brooks, ponds, and rivulets,</size>
<size=60>that I will provide any desired assistance to my ally and Lord, battleship Bismarck,</size>
<size=60>at any place on the water, under water, on land, or in the air.</size>
<size=60>Signed: U-556, Parzival of The Seas</size>
<size=60>At the bottom, U-556 had made a drawing of herself towing her Lord Bismarck back to port.</size>

scripts.say: I am Renown, battlecruiser of the Royal Navy's Force H! I am here because of your ambush on our ships! Cease your meaningless resistance at once!
Gah...! These new recruits of theirs...!
The Royal Family's most capable ships are heading this way en masse! I will not let you flee!
... It seems there's one thing you've forgotten.
A confrontation may slow me down, but I have the advantage in this situation!
I'm afraid I'll have to deal with you! Engines, full speed ahead!
She's resisting, just as I figured she would!
Let's do precisely what King George V said and slow her down!
Swordfishes, launch! Capture Bismarck!
It's time to put an end to this!
You're not going anywhere! 818 Squadron, take aim!
Torpedoes... from my blind spot...?!
I won't... be able to avoid them in time...!
They damaged my propeller...? No... they hit my rigging?
Ah, I underestimated your biplanes, and so this happened... I have failed...
Report to all nearby Royal Navy ships: Bismarck is losing manoeuvrability! Repeat: Bismarck is losing manoeuvrability!
Relaying coordinates now! Send reinforcements ASAP!
It's as Ark Royal said, Bismarck. Your manoeuvrability has taken a critical hit! Cease your meaningless resistance at once!
This will not be where I meet my end...!
Even though I've failed in my mission, even though I've lost my maneuverability...
I still have comrades I must protect, and a dream I must make true...!
I still have my power...!
And as long as I have my resolve and ammunition to fire...
I will fight to the last shell!
Long live Iron Blood!
Blue skies, white clouds, and a dreamlike paradise surrounded by the sea. The Samoan Islands care little for the change of seasons.
Among these tropics was a girl, piloting an aircraft.
Results: Mild winds, 83% humidity, which is 3% higher than yesterday; temperature is 80 degrees Fahrenheit, more or less the same as measured at the same time yesterday.
No rain clouds detected within the monitoring range of my aircraft.
The probability of rainfall is 1% within the next 8 hours, 15% within the next 16, and 23% within the next 24.
So in short, great weather on the whole.
Daaamn, talk about professional. Don't need a weather station when you've got Fargo!
Thank you for using our weather forecast service. Now please pay the fine.
F-fine? You're gonna charge us?
I meant it as a joke.
Sure didn't sound like one!
Oh. That might be because I'm still practicing my facial expressions. Let me raise my happiness index by 200%. Ahem...
I just wanted to say something sillyyy! Don't take everything so seriouslyyy!
I overdid it, didn't I?
A little. Ahahaha...
Anyhow, we know the weather's gonna stay good now. Will make things easier for us.
Y'all ready to go?
Uh, sure... Are we really doing this?
Too late to be gettin' cold feet. The girls are already waiting for us at the campsite.
BEEP BEEP!
That's Pittsburgh calling. Probably got the place set up by now. Hello?
Herring, we've finished up over here.
We have a tent, a grill, and beautiful Samoan scenery waiting for you.
How are things going on your end?
Relaaax, we've got everything we'll need and lots of it. On another note, what's Indiana up to?
She went into the forest to gather wood.
Wood? What for?
Fuel for the grill.
But our grill uses a special type of charcoal made just for it.
You could just have asked me to bring you more. I'm a logistics expert, remember?
Yeah, that's exactly what I told Indiana.
But she insisted on doing it her way anyway. Said something about being unable to sit still and wanting to do something wild while we're here.
