scripts.say: U-47 was now making regular visits to my office, which I didn't mind. I enjoyed her company, and she didn't interfere with my work at all.
But, because she hung out with me so often, her fellow submarines weren't seeing her very much. This thought nagged me a little.
Something wrong, Commander?
I was staring idly at her. Sensing this, she turned around, and our gazes met. Just as I remembered I should start working, I heard a banging on the door.
Commander! It's me! Open up!
A voice yelled from beyond the door, breaking the peaceful silence up to that point.
Startled by this abrupt noise, I got up and opened the door. U-81 immediately sprung inside.
Hey, random question, but you seen U-47 around?
I turned my gaze to the couch only to find U-47 was gone, even though she was there just a moment ago.
Where the hell has she gone off to? I was sure I saw her headed here, so I came to investigate!
U-81 sat down on the couch with a disgruntled expression. I watched her as I returned to my desk to sit down.
That was when I spotted U-47, hiding underneath my desk. It caught me so off guard that I froze in place.
Shhh. Let me hide here until she's left.
What're you doing, Commander? Don't you have work to do?
Trying to avoid making U-81 suspicious, I sat down in my chair and positioned my legs so they wouldn't bump into U-47.
U-47's damn good at hiding, I'll give her that! TOO good, sometimes!
But I'm the hide-and-seek champion! My title hinges on finding her, so I can't give up now!
Ah, screw it! She's obviously not here, so I've gotta look elsewhere. Sorry for interrupting your work!
U-81 apologized, then promptly darted out of the office.
Then, U-47 emerged from under the desk after the coast was clear. She exhaled an exasperated sigh.
Sorry about that. I'd hoped she wouldn't come by...
"It's no big deal, so don't worry about it. But why were you hiding from her?"
Like I said, most people I know love to make a racket.
That's not to say I don't like them, it's just... I'd rather bail when things get rowdy.
She explained herself, then sat down on the couch and picked up her book where she left off.
This reminded me it was high time for me to start working, so I went back to my desk.
At the same time, I decided to plan for the possibility of U-81 making another sudden visit.

sequence:
Days of Tranquility

<size=45>5.Breaking the Silence</size>

scripts.say: U-47's days of peace and quiet had gone on for long, but that was about to change very suddenly.
Would ya look at that! You were here all this time, eh, U-47? That means you're the seeker now. When are we playing the next round?
This is such an obvious spot, and you still struggled to find her...? Maybe my bad luck is rubbing off on you...
The office was unusually rackety, which was no surprise given that three submarines had gathered this day.
It was almost a miracle how U-47 had managed to fly under their radar for so long.
Yeah, I know, I'm the seeker. Could you pipe down? Commander's trying to work.
All right, I'll be quiet!
I'll just keep to myself... Lord knows what damage my bad luck could cause if I do anything else...
The trio couldn't seem any more different, but U-47 did say she doesn't dislike them, so I assumed they were at least on friendly terms.
Rather than order the other two to leave, I decided to just focus on my work instead.
Oh right, I forgot to tell ya something!
U-81, please... I told you to be quiet not even ten seconds ago.
It's important, though! The three of us are gonna be a team for the next mock battle!
I'd heard about this before during a meeting with the Iron Blood's leaders. There was to be a mock battle to improve their submarines' skills.
It's only a few days away, so it'd be a good idea to get together and practice. Whaddya say?
Sure, but on one condition...
U-47 closed the book she was reading, then rose from the couch and walked over to the door.
I'd like some time alone first, then we can practice. I'm kinda in a restless mood right now.
U-47 left the office before the other two had time to answer.
Question is whether she'll turn up or not... Always goes off on her own, that girl.
Yeah, she's not much of a team player... My biggest concern is just making sure I don't mess up during the battle...
The conversation between the remaining submarines made me think. It was likely they would run into teamwork problems with U-47.
Any advice on what we should do, Commander?
"Maybe. Let me see if I can devise a plan that'll let you all perform to the best of your abilities."

sequence:
Days of Tranquility

<size=45>6.Free Rein</size>

scripts.say: It was the day of the mock battle. The participants were gathering.
Hey! There you are! You showed up after all!
Ugh... Please, don't shout. It makes me a tad anxious.
Everything all right...?
Yeah, as long as you all keep it down. What about you?
I said I'd practice with you, but afterwards you told me I could do it by myself, so...
I've just been worrying if I came off like a jerk when I walked out on you...
Heheh, ya hear that? The commander was right!
Right about what?
That you... care about us more than you let on...
Then, a siren rang out in the vicinity of the submarines. That was the signal that the mock battle had begun.
Okay, so! U-47, you go on ahead and find targets to ambush!
We'll keep an eye on the targets... and surround them from behind when they get close...
You've got free rein as the lone wolf, and we'll do our best to support you!
You're... giving me free rein?
Yep, the commander came up with the idea... It's the optimal strategy, apparently...
The commander came up with it...
U-47 whispered to herself. She balled her hand into a fist and looked onward.
Then it's bound to work. I'm sure of it.
The mock battle concluded, and the trio's strategy was a resounding success.
As they were receiving commendations for their performance, U-47 had but one person on her mind.

sequence:
Days of Tranquility

<size=45>7.Tacit Communication</size>

scripts.say: Office - The day after the mock battle
U-47 came to my office and started reading, same as always. That was my sign to start working.
I'd earlier received a report on her team's success during the mock battle. I wished I could've seen it in person, but unfortunately, my schedule didn't allow it.
Hey, Commander...
Out of nowhere, U-47 looked up from her book and spoke to me.
Once she starts reading, she seldom ever pauses to say something. It must've been something important.
U-81 and U-557 told me you came up with our winning strategy.
I humbly scratched my head and half-smiled before she continued.
And, well, I wanted to thank you for your smarts and consideration.
We almost never talk despite how much we hang out... And yet, you seem to know everything about me.
And I feel I know everything about you.
...Including how talking to you now is making you feel tense.
I'll take that as a yes.
You know, this really is a cozy, quiet place. It's become my special, most favorite place after coming here so much.
So, given everything I just told you... you know what's on my mind right now, right?
She threw me an earnest look, and a sudden question. I felt I knew the answer right away.
"You like everything the way it is now, and..."

options.content: "You want these happy days to continue."
"You hope these days of peace and quiet to continue."

scripts.say: Mhm. Spot-on.
And I want to spend them together with you.
She then turned her attention back to the book.
I took a moment to appreciate the quiet, soothing, cozy mood in the room before resuming my work.

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Good Morning, Commander!</size>

scripts.say: Port
It was an ordinary lazy morning.
If there was anything worth mentioning, it's that the day was secretary ship changing day.
I looked at who would be the new secretary ship. It was a certain... U-556? She seemed like a really spirited girl. I hoped she'd be up to the task
Considering she wouldn't be there so early, I resolved to head back to the office and tidy up a bit first. I knew I could explain the details to her once she came in...
I found the door unlocked... had I forgotten to lock it?
I cautiously entered the office...
It turned out all the books and documents I needed to organize had been haphazardly stacked about the floor.
Could... could this have been the work of desk elves!?
Oh! Commander! You're here!
A petite figure emerged from beneath my desk.
It's finally my turn to be secretary ship today, so I got up extra early!
The door was unlocked when I got here, so I figured I'd see if there was anything I could do before you showed up, Commander!
But it turns out all this stuff here is really complicated and I don't get it at all. I never knew a secretary ship had to do so much reading...
*Pant* ... *pant* ... You'll teach me what to do, right, Commander? Fantastic!
I need to put all this stuff back in its place, right? Don't worry, I got this!
U-556 flashed a confident smile.
I think this folder goes... over here...
Hm? That doesn't look right. Don't tell me I forgot... oh this one isn't right either. Neither is that one. Or this one. But this one should be...
I'm boned. I can't make sense of this mess...
I'm sorry, Commander, I totally forgot how it's supposed to go...
In less than a minute, U-556 came begging for help.
It seemed that before we could get into any of the real work, I would have to explain to her where every book and paper belonged.

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Are You Busy, Commander?</size>

scripts.say: After a bit of a hectic start, we finally got the day back on track.
At first, U-556 needed a lot of guidance in performing her secretarial duties. But by mid morning she knew what she was doing and was ready to help with a workload a bit heavier than usual.
Hmmhmmhmmm♪～
She was engrossed in reading some After Action Reports. I decided to let her focus on her work.
Fifteen minutes later...
Ugh, I'm so bored! I thought being secretary ship would be easy and fun. I thought I'd just be playing with the Commander all the time...
Heyyyy, Commanderrr! How about we knock off work and go play for a while!
Awwww!
U-556 looked a little dejected.
Is this work really that important?
It seemed like U-556 fundamentally misunderstood the relationship between commander and secretary ship. To her, they were little more than playmates.
Still, the way she took to organizing the office and earnestly focused on her work from dawn until now was certainly praiseworthy... I decided to explain to her the meaning behind our efforts.
Commander? What's wrong? Why do you suddenly look all serious...
I get it now... Without you, the whole port wouldn't be able to function. The Commander's work is really more important than I ever thought...
That's why I gotta help out!
U-556 seemed like she understood what we were doing. So I took advantage of her enthusiasm and gave her some simple things to work on.
Just hand this over to Akashi down at the shop? I'm on it!
U-556 snatched the document out of my hand and flew out the door.
It turned out that with the right spirit, she'd be able to handle something like this.
But by lunchtime, U-556 still hadn't come back.

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 3 - I Found You, Commander!</size>

scripts.say: S- sorry...
I totally gave the thing to Akashi! But on my way back, I ran into U-81 playing with the girls and I kinda got caught up with them and forgot I was supposed to be working...
But I definitely won't make that mistake again!
Oh yeah! Tomorrow's a day off so why don't you come play with us, Commander? You know working all the time is bad for you!
And so thanks to U-556's weird apology-turned-invitation, I ended up going to U-81's hide-and-seek party.---
Okay, everybody come draw straws to decide who's "it"!
One... two...
Ooh! It's me! I'm "it"!
Heh heh. You just wait and see. I'll catch you all! 60, 59, 58...
I thought carefully about where I should hide.
Nobody would ever think to hide the office. I decided that would be the safest place to stick it out.
I made my way back to the office and quietly closed the door. Locking it would be against the rules, but I was already confident I had a perfect hiding spot.
All I had to do was wait out the end of the game. Not to mention this was a great opportunity to get some work d-
*click click*
I found you, Commander!
MISSION FAILED.
Oh, right. I had forgotten U-556 was my secretary ship and therefore...
I determined that U-81, hide and seek pro that she was, would no doubt have a masterful hiding spot.
It turned out she wanted to hide... underwater!?
I suppose it was only natural a submarine would want to hide underwater, but I found myself suffering certain limitations that meant...
I found you, Commander!
MISSION FAILED.

I determined that hiding in plain sight would be the best move. All I had to do was wait for U-556 to head off in search of the others, whereupon I would simply march up to the starting point and declare myself safe.
I just had to hold my breath long enough...
2, 1, 0! Ready or not, here I come!
Commander? Did you think I wouldn't see you or what?
MISSION FAILED.
Thus ended the first round of hide-and-seek. Everyone gathered up once more.
So the only one U-556 could find was the Commander?
That's just because you guys had really good hiding spots!
I really don't think the bathhouse pool is that good of a hiding spot...
But why did she only find the Commander? And why so fast?
... Hehehe. I'm thinking maybe you two have a special thing going, hmmmmm?
I ignored Albacore's taunt and readied myself for the second round. This time I was "it", and I was committed to showing these girls who ran this port!

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 4 - It's a Date!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Under my tireless tutelage, she had managed to get her playful impulses under control, at least long enough to finish out a day's work.
But there was so much more to being a secretary ship. I still had much to teach her.
Good morning...
U-556 seemed... rather blue?
Oh, I was just spacing out a bit, sorry... What's on the agenda for today?
Hm, I guess nothing gets past you, Commander. Here's the story...
Lord Bismarck! Let's play!
Oh? Is that U-556?
Forgive me, I have some matters to discuss with the Royal Navy. It will have to wait.
Lord Bismarck, are you busy?
Oh...
As you can see, I am making preparations for our next exercise. I'm afraid I can't tear myself away.
I guess she's just been really busy lately...
I get that she's the leader of the Iron Blood, and she's got a lot on her plate. But it's just, without Lord Bismarck to play with, I feel kinda lonely...
It was all becoming clear to me.
The solution to this predicament was quite simple, actually.
Huh? Commander... you'll spend your next day off with me?
Really!?

options.content: I made a promise to her.

scripts.say: Okay, it's a date! No takebacks allowed!
Eheheh~♪
I figured that would cheer her up, at least for a bit.

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 5 - A Mountain from a Molehill?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Bam! That's it! We finished all the day's work!
That was the quintessential U-556: as hard as she wanted to play, she could also put in the work when challenged.
Tomorrow's your day off, Commander! Don't forget you promised to spend it with me. How about we go to the beach together?

options.content: Agree to take her to the beach.

scripts.say: Ehehheh~♪ I can't wait!
It was to be a day of relaxation.
Until... we received a distress call from the patrol fleet?
And the fleet on patrol that day was... Bismarck's!?
Commander? What's wrong?
Huh...?
But wasn't Bismarck leading today's patrol...?
I swore an oath to Lord Bismarck that I would protect her no matter what! ... Commander, we have to go help them!
U-556 dashed out of the room with an incredible speed I never knew she had.
She then gathered up some squadmates as quickly as she could and set off for the source of the distress signal.
Nearby Waters
She'll be fine... she has to be!
Huh? ... Lord Bismarck... and Prinz Eugen?
What is it?
Thank the gods you're all right!
Just what on earth is going on here? Commander, would you mind explaining on the way back to port?
Suffice it to say I was just glad everyone turned up safe and sound.
So... we triggered a distress signal?
It must be this thing. It's supposed to make an automatic assessment of any given combat situation and respond appropriately. I'm thinking it malfunctioned.
It was a false alarm. I had them send the device off to the eggheads for inspection. No doubt Yuubari and her team could work it out.
All that matters is that you two are safe.
Listen, U-556, I get that you take your promise seriously. But I really can handle myself without you. You don't have to worry.
Not to mention today was just a routine patrol... I'm more than capable of rising to that challenge.
Oh. Right. Of course...
I mean, Lord Bismarck is one of the strongest battleships in the Iron Blood fleet. What's to worry about...? Heh heh...
Right, well, I'd better be getting back...
U-556 shuffled off dejectedly.
Kinda harsh, don't you think, Bismarck?
I hurried after U-556, worried about how she was feeling.

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 6 - A Vow of Pride</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
U-556 balled up in her chair, burying her head in her knees.
The silence dragged on for what seemed like forever, until she finally spoke up.
You know, don't you, Commander? I told you before, Bismarck and I made a "Promise."
No matter where she is: on the water, under water, on land, or in the air, I swore to protect her from anything that tries to hurt her.
But like, isn't that kind of a crazy promise? A submarine is gonna protect a battleship? How is that supposed to work...? Ahaha.
I just keep using the promise as an excuse to go bother Lord Bismarck every day...
I'm a pain in the ass.

Whatever. Lord Bismarck is always telling us to change our bad habits. I'll just have to work that much harder on my missions. I mean of course, if Bismarck ever needed it I'd be there to help. I'd like to take some of the pressure off her.
No... I'm the one who should apologize.
Lord Bismarck? Why are you here?
I've actually been here for quite a while. I was worried about you. It seems my words may have troubled you, and for that I apologize.
No, no, you didn't do anything wrong. It's my fault for being such a brat and bothering you all the time.
That's not true. I have never thought you were a bother, U-556.

In fact, I've always loved spending time with you. When we're together, I feel the burden of leadership lifted from my shoulders. For that short time, I get to relish the pleasure of chatting with a dear friend.
I'd say your playfulness, your purity, and even your joy rubs off on me, U-556.
Lord Bismarck...
To be honest, I never thought you would so bravely come dashing to my rescue, just to fulfill some jokey little promise from way back when...
You are no bothersome child. You are a loyal knight who stands by her words, second to none, and worthy of respect. I am ashamed to admit I did not see that before. I am sorry.
Bismarck suddenly stood up ramrod straight and loudly cleared her throat.
U-556! On the honor of the Parzival name, and before Neptune, lord of the seas, do you swear:
That you will provide any assistance to me in a time of need, no matter where I may be, even at risk to your own life and limb?
U-556 sat in stunned silence until a glittering smile flashed across her face.
Yes! I swear anywhere, anytime, from any threat, U-556 will protect you!

sequence:
A Knight's Promise

<size=45>Chapter 7 - It's a Promise!</size>

scripts.say: We're going to the beach tomorrow?
I mean you did promise me... But you really don't have to. I mean, it was just a silly idea I came up with, Commander, you don't need to waste your day off keeping me company.
Keeping a promise is that important to you, huh? Well okay then I'll see you tomorrow! Eheheh~♪
The open sea. I have arrived!
Ahahahahaaa!
U-556 launched herself into the ocean like a torpedo.
Commander! Come on in! The water's fine!
It was my day off. I figured I'd let myself go.
Ahahaha! You're too slow, Commander!
I'm gonna get you, Commander! Hope you're ready to taste seawater!
Navy Destroyer "Commander's" anti-submarine warfare operations have failed! U-556 moves into counterattack position!
Time flies when you're having fun. And before I knew it, the sun was setting.
I never thought I'd get to spend the whole afternoon playing with you, Commander.
Did you have fun?
Eheheh~♪ ... Me too.
If only Lord Bismarck could've come with us.
... Hey, Commander, can I ask you something?
Thanks to that promise we made, I got to see a different side of Lord Bismarck than the one she shows to everyone else. They think she's totally invincible, but she's actually really stressed.
It may have started out as a silly little joke, but now our promise truly binds me and Bismarck together!
So how about it, Commander? Will you make a promise with me?

I, U-556, hereby declare before Neptune, lord of the seas, that from this moment onwards, I will provide any desired assistance to my Commander, at any place on the water, under water, on land, or in the air!
Oh, but you're not Lord Bismarck, Commander, so I have to add two conditions!
In return, the Commander swears to stay by U-556's side forever, to keep her company whenever she needs it!
Okay, it's a promise! No takebacks allowed!
Upon sealing the promise with our pinkies, I felt a warmth begin to well up inside me.

sequence:
Science Rules!

scripts.say: It was a clear afternoon...
Okay, lunch break is over! It's time for the afternoon lect... Hey, Laffey, wake up! You too, Javelin and Ayanami!
Zzzzz...
... Just... five more minutes...
Jeez, the weather is too good! I need to be rested for when class ends~!

KA-BOOM!

... I'm still not fully awake.

... WHAAAAT!?

sequence:
Science Rules!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - I Dream Big!</size>

scripts.say: I'm experimenting with practice ammunition made of candy! ... How's that? Have I caught your attention?
I've... got so many issues with that that I'm at a loss for words...
It's strange and I don't know how to react to it... But I suppose you're doing earnest science...
That's right! After all, I dream big, as I'm sure you can tell by my white lab coat!
I... don't think the lab coat signifies dreaming big.
Don't fuss over the details!
Candy torpedoes... Sounds yummy...
Gluttony is a vice, not a virtue.
Why are you all taking it seriously too...
Well? Don't you think it's a pretty wonderful dream to have? Come on, join me in making scientific progress!
What an admirable dream. Ohoho, consider your offer officially accepted.

sequence:
Science Rules!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - A Real Experiment?</size>

scripts.say: ... Yuubari?
I could have you court-martialed for using the science room without permission.
R-really!? Can she do that!?
Yuubari is part of the committee that oversees the science room.
Oh gosh, I'm so sorry!
But, you love science and have your heart in the right place, so just this once I'll let it pass.
Phew... Thank you, Yuubari!
Now, this smoke... *Sniff sniff*... Hmm, interesting...
And what about these chemicals... Ah, I see, you're making practice ammunition made of candy?
Yep, hit the nail on the head!
Is it even possible, though!?
It is! Remember that Christmas thing? Something called a "gear skin"?
But is it edible!?
Hoho, it seems I must offer guidance to our new science department members.
Come, I will show you what it means to conduct a real scientific experiment.
Heck yeah!

sequence:
Science Rules!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Science Is Never Done</size>

scripts.say: S-so this is Akashi's and Yuubari's research room...
The scale of it is impressive.
Seems U-73 and Yuubari are already at it...
You see, U-73, the explosion happened because you mistreated the reagent for another. This is how you do it, see?
T-that explains it!
Now, watch closely and learn...
I had no idea you could even do that...!
W-wow, it actually worked! They made a candy cane torpedo!
... It's really sweet.
P-please, Yuubari! Allow me to call you "Professor"!
Hum hum, no need to go so far. After all, science is always moving forward with no end in sight.
That is something you must remember now that you've chosen to become a scientist.
If you ever have any questions, don't hesitate to come to the science department.~
I will! I'll try to be the best scientist I can!
... U-73, I think this scientist schtick of yours may fit you better than your usual one...
... I think Zed could be right.
Should we just... leave the science room as it is now?
You're right. Wasn't Köln going to use it this afternoon...?
Oh, oops, ahaha... I forgot to clean up...
In the distance, one could hear Köln angrily exclaiming "who did this!? Who forgot to clean up before they left!?"
I-I think I'd better get going!
Though U-73 now had a talented teacher to guide her, she still had a long ways to go to become a scientist.
Sister...
Sister… where are you?
Sister… the sea… it's burning…
Sister… I'm sorry… I couldn't protect them...
If Hell exists, this must be what it feels like.
May you guide us to a future in which these sacrifices welcome your compassion.
At least... take this child's soul... Give us the courage to fight back...
This damn war... has started again...

Now that we've confirmed "AF" is indeed Midway, we should move out immediately.
But Yorktown, your injuries...

Enterprise, how about you? If you get hurt again because of me, Vestal will never let me hear the end of it.

Considering it's not every day that all three of us get to fight together, we've got to show off the power of the Yorktown-class!
Yes ma'am! For freedom, and the glory of the Eagle Union!
Union Task Force 16, 17, sortieing!

This isn't my first time here... Last time, I upheld the prestige of the Royal Navy alongside my elder sister ship Hood..

The Sakura Empire is sneaking around. For the sake of the Royal Navy's honor, they shall be stopped without advancing an inch in this area.

scripts.say: Wake up. The battle is about to begin.
...I had a really long dream.
I dreamed of a world of ice... A lonely, desolate world on the border between the transient and reality...
A dream...? Nonsense. A mere Pawn like you does not dream. Even if you did, it would merely be a fragment of your own thoughts, like a hallucination.
Bah, who cares whether you were dreaming or hallucinating. It doesn't matter either way.
The only thing that matters now is that the White Pieces have entered the Mirror Sea.
If you don't want to get sacrificed then you'd better get ready to fight.
Sacrificed, huh...
Ahhah~! I, Deutschland, will spearhead the attack! Interceptions are my forte, after all! I bet it'll just be another round of shooting fish in a barrel anyway.
They will learn the true horror of facing the best Panzerschiff in the world!
State of emergency. An Awakening Response among the Pieces has been confirmed. The synchronization rate with the Player has gone up by 7%.
An Awakening Response? That means soon we'll have the results the Judge was hoping for.
Once you've fully confirmed the Awakening and recorded the sequence, I'll dispose of the backup of the Original. Don't forget that.
You'll dispose of it? Wait, I just had an interesting idea...
I will activate the quarantine mechanism and throw all the Black Pawns into the mix!
Tester, what are you planning...?!
This time I will personally ascertain the gap in potential of White... no, of the Natural Calculation System and humankind!
喂平海，要你准备的七枚针准备好了吗？

哎呀你这笨丫头，连七夕乞巧穿七孔针的习俗都忘了，真是和那些外国人呆久了……
qi……xi……？那是……什么……？

七夕，鸡溪，笹饰，诗笺……

……就这么简单？
嗯！

嗯，姐姐说虽然日子不一样，但机会难得，就让{namecode:79}也一起准备了！{namecode:79}还要准备好多东西，就不陪你啦~
……大家，都在全力以赴……我也能……为指挥官做点什么吗……？
不过……七夕……究竟要做什么呢……？传统……不是很明白……
迷途的少女呀，你究竟在烦恼什么呢～？就让我来为你指点迷津吧～呵呵呵～
七夕……想为指挥官做点……什么……
来做巧克力吧！

呵呵呵…真是惹人怜爱的少女……这种小事就不用在意啦，比起这个，如果想要做巧克力的话，可要赶快了哟
已经有很多姐妹们出发寻找传说中的巧克力配方了呢！
巧克力配方？传说中的？
据说在这片海域的某处，隐藏着过去某位甜点师集毕生之力研究出来的巧克力配方哦。据说那巧克力的美味，足以令任何人都失去抵抗呢～
这、这么厉害的吗……
比起在这里犹豫不决，不如先行动起来如何？你也想让指挥官高兴的吧？
嗯……我知道了……{namecode:89}小姐、感谢……

{namecode:428}小姐，{namecode:429}小姐，{namecode:433}小姐和{namecode:434}小姐，果然是铁血的各位啊……这也是传说的魔性吗……

竭尽全力守护自己想要守护的人

姐姐姐姐，你也饿了吗？看你的表情似乎不太妙呢。

是！
肉包？哼，可别以为这样就可以收买我

哈哈哈，我和平海逸仙会把他们统统揍回去的！

真是漂亮的战斗，一段时间不见，你们还是那么身手不凡呢
逸仙~逸仙~
嗯，平海还是一样可爱呢~

宁海这么坦率的样子真是可爱
姐姐~可爱~
（脸红）呀！傻丫头别老学人家说话，回去不给你肉包吃了！
不过…暂时先不谈论肉包了~敌机似乎又出现了呢…
全员准备迎敌！
胜利后一起回肉包吃个够！
舰长，快醒醒，敌机又冲过来了！！！
可恶…如果我还能再强一点的话…

scripts.say: Orders received. Commencing analysis of Siren Research Facility.

Locating the Control Device to disperse the ice floes is recommended.
Locating the Control Device to disperse the ice floes is recommended.
Some of the ice floes and haze generated by the Sirens have been removed.
The ice floes and the fog are all gone now. Now we can get back to looking for seals.
Scan complete. Presence of Siren defense fleets has been detected.
Energy Matrix obtained. Bring it back to its storage platform.

The abnormal ocean currents are stopping us from moving forward. Let’s come back later.

Energy Matrix obtained. Bring it back to its storage platform.

This Siren Data Logging Tower seems to be out of order.
Scan complete. Ocean currents have returned to normal.
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Detecting activation of Data Logging Tower.
There’s no telling what will happen if we enter the Data Logging Tower’s scan range. We’d best proceed with caution.
Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid being scanned by the Data Logging Tower. The Energy Matrix returned to its starting position as a result.
We secured the Energy Matrix. Let’s move it back to its platform.
Scan complete. Activating the Energy Matrix will cause corrosion to spread within zone. Proceed with caution.
The corrosion is spreading outwards in a cross formation, but can be halted through the use of obstacles and ocean currents. Plot your course carefully.
We can’t move it in that direction.
This place is steeped with corrosion. We should keep our distance.
Would you like to activate the Energy Matrix?
On-site Siren security system has been activated. Detecting spread of corrosion within zone.
If we enter a region with corrosion, we’ll lose the Energy Matrix and be forced to retreat to the zone’s entry point. Let’s plan our moves carefully.
Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid taking damage from the corrosion. The Energy Matrix returned to its starting position as a result.
Contact with obstacles or opposing ocean currents will halt the spread of corrosion. Use this to your advantage.
Guess we flipped the switches in the wrong order. Let’s try again, this time repeating after the flashing light pattern.
Scan complete. Directional change of inner current has been observed.
Scan complete. Directional change of outer current has been observed.
Scan complete. Change in zone’s ocean currents has been observed.

Scan complete. Ice floe pieces have reformed into a massive ice sheet.

Our fleet retreated to the entry point to avoid stepping into a Siren trap.
Siren traps are present in this zone. Proceed with caution.
Additional Siren traps have been detected. Proceed with caution.
Navigation system is being jammed. There is a risk that you will be guided or transferred to a random area.
Moving in the opposite direction of intended destination is recommended.
Let’s send our fleets through in the same pattern as the lights flashing on the device.
We can only pass over the yellow tiles once. If we do it a second time, we’ll be sent back to the entry point.
We need to work out a route that takes us over every yellow tile only once, in the correct order, and also flip all the switches along the way.
Our route didn’t take us over every single yellow tile. Let’s try again.
We get sent back to the start if we pass over a yellow tile twice. Let’s try again.

Using the blue device lets us change obstacles marked with blue symbols. What should we do?
Using the purple device lets us change obstacles marked with purple symbols. What should we do?s

scripts.say: “Gift of an Everlasting Innocent Doll”? A present for me?
(Opening...)
Heehee... I really am beautiful!
But who’s this from? There's no name on the package...
Pumpkin congee... are we having pumpkin again for lunch? Yesterday was pumpkin stew, and pumpkin pie the day before... I'm so done with pumpkins!
So am I, talk about a nutritional imbalance…
That's not the issue! Oh, by the way, {namecode:6}, I just received a strange present.
A present—— ?
Heehee~ Doesn't this look good on me?
It really suits {namecode:87}... What did your sisters say? Did they praise you?

Lately, they don't really hang out with me... and keep saying that, "{namecode:87} should find friends similar in age." Seriously?! They are almost the same age as me! Well, let's head out this afternoon!
I saw {namecode:96} storing up her food supplies a few days ago. I thought she was planning to cook tempura for me, but it turned out to be pumpkin again!
{namecode:96} won't miss any opportunity of having tempura, unless...
Speaking of {namecode:96}, recently she always looks at me in a strange way. Pumpkin... {namecode:96}... huh, let's dig into this!
Do I have to go with you?
Of course! Stop losing yourself in combat and training, you deserve a break.
What a pity, I’m not sure if I’ll go… you girls have fun~
Pumpkins are delicious, nyaa~ and wasting food is a serious crime, nyaa~ {namecode:87} eat a little more, nyaa~
Tempura? No, there’s no more left! I wanted to store food for the coming winter!
I still feel like… the atmosphere is very tense.
Although the most telling information is always hidden in unexpected places, {namecode:6}, follow me!
How come my sister and I can’t attend this Halloween… Say! When the time comes...

<size=45>「Gold, Ready Set Action」</size>

scripts.say: Without even noticing, the “day of mischief” is fast approaching!
Haha, you girls from the Sakura Empire are highly anticipating the day, aren’t you!
The atmosphere seems to be more tense than last year... {namecode:6}, what do you think?
It’s not like as if we’re going to start a battle with the Eagle Union...
Ack——!
That’s right! Let’s start rationing supplies and practice our “pranks”, these are clear signs of war!
If there is indeed a war coming, you girls aren’t hiding it from me, are you?
O that, that’s to prevent the intel from getting leaked… which reminds me, go find “her” to discuss about that thing.
He-le-na~~ I am comingggg~!
W-wait, waitt!! Don’t you all ought to knock on the door before entering!
We’ve got vital intel to report—— we’re going to war!
What?!
Say… are pulling pranks and carving pumpkins both traditions of Halloween?
Other Halloween customs include giving out candies. Although, perhaps {namecode:96} should give out tempura instead, since she likes to eat tempura.
Cleveland, however, seems to be more focused on pumpkin pies!
Helena, what’s “that” in your hands?
...One last tradition for Halloween is to dress up in costumes, such as ghosts. Therefore, I’ve been secretly sewing this Halloween costume for Cleveland. I want it to be a surprise!
Cleveland will also be joining us for “Trick or treat”?
Oh, of course, she will be!
…Did you only make this one costume?
Sorry, because I want it to be a surprise for Cleveland, so it won’t be ready until Halloween day. And I won't have time to prepare more for all of you....
Actually, I’ve received a similar outfit in the mail a few days ago...
Hey, if I win the duel this time, then you gotta help me!

sequence:
Witches' Eve III

<size=45>「Late Night Pranks」</size>

scripts.say: The pumpkin lights have all been prepared and placed all over the school courtyard.
Wow! It’s becoming more and more like a Halloween atmosphere!
Thanks to you, everyone must be highly anticipating Halloween now, huh~ I’ll also join your “Trick or treat”!
Hehehe, what a pity but you’re already an adult!
Well... you’re right. Did you know? Lately, I hear that the port area has ghosts lurking at night.
Ghosts?
Well, all those floating pumpkin lanterns shimmering late at night looks a lot like “ghostly” pumpkin heads.
Ahhhh—— How come I haven’t seen any of those “ghosts”, I’m missing out on all the fun!
{namecode:87}, lately a strange thing is happening.
A strange thing?!
So… the other day when I returned to my dorm, I found a package sitting in front of the door. Inside there was—— this.
This is——
So pretty—— I want one too...

So cute~ But there’s no name on the package, and my sister only saw a white figure placing it at the door. I want to thank that mystery figure in person. I heard {namecode:87} also received a similar package, is there any meaning behind all of this?
I didn’t see anything...
A white figure...
At last, it’s Halloween night! Hehe~ Do you like my costume? (Twirls)
Actually—— I’ve also received a “gift”.
Huh, you got one as well? Did you find any clues to these mystery packages?
Yes, I saw something—— those packages were sent by ghosts.
Haha~ {namecode:6} is making a joke. Strange, {namecode:19} still hasn’t arrived yet?
Let’s go see if she’s in her dorm.
I didn’t expect sewing clothes to be this troublesome...

sequence:
Witches' Eve IV

<size=45>「The Missing Pumpkin Pie」</size>

scripts.say: Sorry, I’ve got an emergency—— Has anyone seen my pumpkin pie?
No I haven’t… what’s wrong?
{namecode:19}’s baked pumpkin pie has disappeared...
Argh… I’ve worked tirelessly for three weeks in order to make the tastiest pumpkin pies for my sisters, and now I’ve got nothing to show for it!
When the pies were baking, {namecode:19} had gone to change her outfit. And I was blanking out at the front door—— then, the pies were gone...
After I changed my clothes, all those pies went missing——
Not entirely “all”, I tried one of the pies before they went missing, it was very delicious.
Really? You better not be lying to your sisters!
When they went missing, was it just you two in the room?
Hehe, actually I was also there at the time.
Cleveland?!
This costume was given to me by Helena. I’m dressed as a reaper harvesting your “souls”. What do you think? Hehehe~
I happened to pass by {namecode:19}’s dorm, during that time—— no one came in or out of the entrance.
You “passed by” for so long?
Even though “time is money”, I do tend to wander around from time to time.
—— (Stares)
It couldn’t have been Cleveland, she can’t hide so many pies by herself.
Is there a problem?
A knight out at sea shouldn’t waste her precious time “wandering around” other people’s dorms.
We’ve fully prepared for Halloween, well, your absence will not affect the result, Shiranui...
Idiot {namecode:20}, what do you mean “the result is not affected”! All those sisters were highly anticipating my pumpkin pies. Drat, I’ll start baking another batch right now...
Sunset is fast upon us, there’s not enough time. Everyone has already tried your pies before...
But the missing ones are perfect this time!
Halloween is not only about baking pies. Sister, they’re all waiting for you.
I guess I’ll count this as bad luck… darn, I’ll definitely remember this!
{namecode:87}, {namecode:6}, Cleveland and that idiot sister of mine… I hope you all have fun tonight…
Hehe, you too, you’ve worked hard!
Cleveland, how come Helena did not come with you?
Those Fletcher class sisters are already out asking for candy—— Even if their main target is not me, I’ve tried my best to avoid them...
So {namecode:19} has been resting for awhile at her dorm?
Hehehe...
Excellent, we’re ready for Halloween! Yes… I don’t think we missed anything.

sequence:
Witches' Eve V

<size=45>「Trick or Treat!」</size>

scripts.say: Trick or treat！
Trick or treat！
Here~ Have a taste of my freshly baked pumpkin pie.
It tastes delicious, the sweetness of the pie is just perfect!
I didn’t expect to taste such a delicious pie after recently being sick of eating them! Whichever way you slice it {namecode:95}, you are my role model!
Haha~ I am not perfect.
Well… I’m more focused on what Helena is up to.
Let’s go!~
Have a safe journey.
Hmm… ack——!!
Hey look—— are those pumpkin lanterns floating in the sky? Is, is there ghosts——!
Those pumpkin lanterns are coming straight at us——
I can’t see anything in front of me, it’s all just lanterns… is everyone OK? Drat, where are my guns?!
Wait——
It’s you—— ahhhh!
{namecode:95}——!!!
Those pumpkin lanterns were all flying in the air… {namecode:96}, where is {namecode:96}!
Shou—— White, I wanted to sew something for you like this, but then I realized how hard it is to sew... so, please use this for now.
Did you girls forget to carve this pumpkin, I can’t see anything?! {namecode:96} and Enterprise, what exactly are you two up to?!
Cough, I am Gold, she is Grey. In short, we are no longer “adults” tonight but more like “adolescents” instead. It won’t be a problem to go wild during Halloween night!
I lost to Zui... Gold, therefore I’ve come to help her——
Hmm? Are you not convinced of your defeat!
Ok ok ok, these girls who’re still “kids at heart” will enjoy pranking tonight. I will use my pumpkin lantern to help them.
Hehe, after all “I” am younger than you by a lot, Grey.

sequence:
Witches' Eve VI

<size=45>「Ghosts Revealed!」</size>

scripts.say: The sound is coming from above...
They are floating on top of pumpkin lanterns...
First, let’s decide on a prank to pull?
So, White, you always mentioned that you wanted to have fun on Halloween. So naturally, I thought you already decided on your prank...
I’m not Sara.
This sound—— It was you {namecode:95} after all!
No, I am White!
You are {namecode:95}... right?
No, I am White!!!
Fine, White, what are your plans?
Right… do you all like to pull pranks?
Why are you asking those who were pranked if they like pulling pranks...
So were you the ones manipulating all those pumpkin lanterns? Using all those lanterns floating in the night sky to show a scary face must be fun! I secretly tried this but failed...
Sounds interesting~
Gold, you handle the left side.
I was the one who won the duel, so how come you’re calling the shots!
You’re dragging us behind, I’m almost finished here.
Darn—— I will finish this in one swift motion!
Hehe~ Oh, right! Everyone get on the lanterns~

sequence:
Witches' Eve VII

<size=45>「Pumpkin Fleet, Anchors Away!」</size>

scripts.say: Faster, just a little faster! Wee~ this is so fun!
The view up top while riding on these pumpkin lanterns is really something.
I, I won’t fall off right?
Not to worry, Enterprise and I searched for a long time and found the most suitably shaped pumpkins.
{namecode:95}, thanks for the costume.
Wait, I need to thank you as well!
Haha~ I’ve been discovered. Only because there are all of you can Halloween be so festive~
Eeee, is that the costume made by {namecode:95}?
Hehe, mine was made by Helena. I ought to properly thank her when I get back~
I made a lot of tempura, everyone feel free to enjoy them~
Yep~ {namecode:96}, the tempura you made are truly amazing.
Wow, you finally realized my talents!
Does that include sewing clothes?
—— Darn you, just you wait, one day——
Fine fine fine, I will wait for that supposed day—— wait for the day you leave me speechless.
Loser, loser, what did you just say?!
Can I bring my sisters here?
No problem at all, there are still plenty of pumpkins~
Can you lower the pumpkin a little bit more? Seems like the only person who is eating the pumpkin pies is {namecode:20}.
Hey, that pumpkin pie actually seems to be—— {namecode:20}!!!
S-sis, sister?! Why are you flying?!!
Idiot, I’m not flying, it’s the pumpkin that’s flying!
Are they my pumpkin pies?
...Of course not.
Don’t lie to your sister! Honestly, they’ve all gone cold—— it’s salty! Could it be I’ve mistakenly added salt instead of sugar! Th-thank goodness they were away when I was baking—— Don't eat it!!!
As long as {namecode:19} made these, then no matter how bad they taste...
As such, I cannot allow my sisters to eat these failed pies!
You idiot…..
You’re the idiot, just say it to me directly——
If that’s the case, I’ll skip the games at Halloween and go back home to bake a new batch.
Idiot, as long as you can taste the most delicious pumpkin pies, then I don’t care about playing!
So I’ll just….
… Don’t stand there in the corner eating that salty and cold pie!
I just feel that it’ll be a waste to throw these… at the time when baking these, you must’ve thought that we’d finish them all——
…Idiot——
Halloween night hasn’t ended yet, so let’s all go for a ride on those pumpkin lanterns. Quick, call those “kids” to return and let them know the Pumpkin Fleet is ready to sortie!

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>1 The Cat-Eared Imp</size>

scripts.say: While my mind was fuzzy from sleepiness, I felt something just as fuzzy against my cheek.
Meeeow.
I reached my hand out for the fuzzy, fluffy thing that appeared in my drowsy dream.
But it had already fled from my fingertips...leaving naught behind but a cute "Meeeow."
...Wait a second.
That wasn't a dream, was it?!
When I opened my eyes, I was surrounded by a bunch of pumpkins carved to have scary faces. It seemed I was in the port's Halloween party venue.
The sandy beach could be seen in the distance. My friends' cheers mixed with the pounding of waves.
It seemed I'd loosened up so much on this rare day off that I'd laid down and fallen asleep on a bench.
But what had I just touched a moment ago?
M-mister Ghost, I'm sorry! I'm so very sorry!
I'll be a good girl, I promise! Please don't abduct me!
Mister...Ghost?
I remembered the ghost costume I was wearing. Indeed, I'd dressed up as a ghost for Halloween.
The costume didn't stop at clothes, either; I'd had a white mask prepared to go with it, so it was a quality costume.
I couldn't blame her—Janus—for being genuinely afraid.
I'd feel bad scaring her any further, so I took off the mask and revealed my true identity.
C-Commander, it's you... Oh, you gave me a real fright.
I know that monsters are never the real thing on Halloween, b-but I couldn't help myself...
Especially at night...I imagine monsters popping out of the darkness... I'm so glad it was just you, Commander.
"So you say, Janus, but you're dressed up like a Halloween monster, too."
"Cat ears, bat wings... If you're not a vampire, I have no idea what monster you are."
U-Umm... I'm a little kitty devil! I picked it out myself, but...i-is it weird, after all?
Jervis told me to be careful since you'd be seeing me, so I wonder...
"I honestly think you look cute in that costume, Janus."
Phew... Thank you, Commander...
Y-you were sleeping on this bench because you're so tired, right, Commander? You'll catch a cold out here. May I walk you to your room?
"I just relaxed too much, is all. It's not as if I was too fatigued to stay awake..."
I-is that so...? You're incredible, Commander, being able to sleep soundly at a Halloween party...
"No point in sitting around here, right? Where are you off to next, Janus?"
Oh, yeah! I'm supposed to be looking for a black kitty with a hat right now. Commander, have you... Oh. You were sleeping, so duh, you haven't seen it...
"You know, I did feel something fuzzy. I think I heard its meows...that way."
You know where the kitty went? Thank you so much for helping!
I managed to tell her which way the cat ran and watched as Janus disappeared into the Halloween night.
"I'll check on her later... Now, how should I enjoy this Halloween party?"

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>2 Faerie Princess' Garden of Rest</size>

scripts.say: I faced the old castle, which exuded more awe-inspiring presence than ever on Halloween night.
The cross at the tip of the tower almost seemed to emit its own light in the moonlight... What sort of being was within?
I pushed the door open with that question in my mind.
A human intrudes on the sanctuary of the night's scion...
Unwelcome mortal, for what reason do you disturb my eternal dreams?
Sitting on the blood-red throne, Albion—wearing a costume akin to a succubus or vampire—welcomed me in.
She's acting really different... How should I respond?

options.content: "'Tis I, a lowly servant of the night."

scripts.say: Thank you, Commander... Ah! I mean! Umm...
Ack... How could I drop the act just from hearing my name? I'm sorry, this is so embarrassing...
My vampire elders said I could order you around in this costume, but it's still so hard...
Ah, but forget my act... Commander, if you'd please, erm...
Would you like to spend some time with me...?
Y-you don't have to try to play along like that...
But... Ahem. "Underling of Albion, do you desire to spend this delightful night with your master?"
"But of course."
Albion handed me a glass. The crimson liquid within sparkled like ruby in the moonlight.
"Is this...wine?"
Not quite. It's grape juice colored to look like wine.
I think the refreshing sweetness of it is perfect for a night like tonight.
Umm, so, Comm—ahem. Underling of Albion, per our solemn vow to spend this delightful night together...
W-well, this is all an act, so why don't you stay a little longer...
Kneel, promise your loyalty, and then... Oh, never mind...
Nothing! I said nothing! Please forget what you just heard!

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>3 A Succubus' Love</size>

scripts.say: I left the Halloween castle and returned to the party venue.
Welcome to Succubus Love, our hottest attraction! Even you can join in the bloody fun, Master Ghost!
Oh, but keep the mask on! Take it off, and ya won't be ghastly anymore!
"F-Fair, I guess..."
Wow... Your costume was so good that it scared Janus? Heheh, only on Halloween, eh?
But it's okay! It'll take a lot more than that to scare me!
Now, let's go in this room, lock the door, turn on the phone signal jammer... Heehee! Now nobody can interrupt us.
Master-and-Commander, I welcome you anew to Manchester's special clinic, Succubus Love. Here, you can relieve all your tension until you feel sooo much better.
She put a whole lot of effort into creating a situation where nobody could interrupt.
An aromatherapeutic fragrance gradually filled the room...relaxing all of my tension before I knew it.
Ah! Master, you look sleepy already. Are you okay?
"...I think it's because of the aroma."
That's a right silly thing to say, innit. Come on, now.
Your angel in white, Manchester, will make you feel all better!
"Now that I'm getting a good look at your costume, I see little demon wings on your back."
I've got a demon tail, too! Ehehe, who says a succubus can't be a nurse, too?
Well alright, lie down. We're gonna heal all of ya fatigue. Swallow this, and get ready for the full healing experience!
Your succubus maid...no, your succubus nurse is gonna make ya feel better than ever!
I've never seen her this excited. Is she just fully engrossed in the Halloween mood?
Master, what are ya staring for?
I know! Ya want me to help ya take it, eh?
Aww, you're helpless... Okay. Open up! Say aah!
As directed, I open my mouth and let Manchester put a small tablet in my mouth. It tastes like strawberry candy.
Oh, I forgot to tell you! This isn't real medicine. It's just candy! Don't worry!
Nooow, stay still in this bed, Master! It's time for Manchester's full healing massage experience!
"Wait, you're actually doing this? It's not an act?"
Of course! I'm a royal maid, after all! Soothing my master is my forte, innit.
Ehehe... You can't escape, so just relax and let me do all the work.

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>4 The Witch of Hallow's Eve</size>

scripts.say: I arrived at a witch's fortune-telling shop.
Witches might be "the" Halloween costume, but there were so many people in our port who fit that descriptor that I couldn't imagine who I'd find inside.
"Guess I might as well just knock."
Enter, pilgrim of the night.
What brings you here at such a late time? Are you a lost soul wandering through the Halloween night?
Not surprised, huh? Got a problem with me being the Witch of Hallow's Eve?
All I could make out in the smoke-filled shack were a crystal ball placed on a table and Memphis, clad in a witch costume.
"I didn't know you could see the future, Memphis."
"It's not really... Uh, I mean, of course I can! I'm a witch, after all!"
Lost pilgrim of the night, do you seek guidance toward your future? Or do you seek time with me?
"Well..."
You need not answer. Come and sit. Place your hand on my crystal ball and reveal the future to me. I will predict your future.
Oh... I see.
There it is. If the crystal ball says so, then I have no choice but to accept it.

options.content: "What did the crystal ball show you?"

scripts.say: It reveals a vision of you, Commander, spending Halloween night with a certain shipgirl.
It's neither, really. Commander, the ball tells me that you'll spend the night with a certain shipgirl.
"Which shipgirl...?"
Me, of course...is what I'd like to say. But unfortunately, it's not.
"I thought your fortune-telling was just another Halloween attraction."
You're not wrong, but to be more precise, it's an attraction with a hint of reality.
Here. Take this.
Memphis handed me a witch's hat.
Take a broom with you, too. It'll double as a self-defense weapon, which you might just need.
"I don't understand. What the heck did you see in my future?"
The shipgirl you'll be with can be a little difficult. Trust me, you'll be better off with this.
"A shipgirl you'd call 'difficult'? I can't tell if I know who you're talking about or not..."
I saw her just a while ago. Beats me how she snuck a real weapon into the party venue.
"A real weapon...? If she got past the bag check with a weapon, then that's a real emergency. Did the Sirens do this?!"
You will need to check on her, but it's hardly an emergency. I wouldn't even call it dangerous. That pirate is just enjoying Halloween in her own way.
"Pirate? A pirate shipgirl? That would be..."
Exactly. A pirate shipgirl wearing a red hat. I think you're just the man to deal with her, Commander.
"I'm curious what happened. Instead of just wandering around, I'd better go confront her directly and confirm that she's the one I'm thinking of."

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>5 An Uninvited Guest?</size>

scripts.say: On the beach near the Halloween party venue, I found a pirate girl wearing a red hat.
When I addressed her...
Shh.
Do you hear the ocean's cries?
"You mean the sound of waves hitting shore?"
Hmph. I said they're the ocean's cries! Geez!
The pirate girl with the hat turned around and glared at me unhappily.
Who are you?
Aha, I see. So you're the one that my friends here... Ahem. You're the one that these lasses call the Commander.
I am the mysterious, heartstopping shipgirl who rides wind and waves alike, searching all the seven seas for the beauties of the world...
Royal Fortune, of the great Tempesta!
What?! I just walked into the venue, okay?! Nobody tried to stop me!
"In that get-up, you don't really stand out at a Halloween party. And pirate swords kind of look like Halloween props..."
Ah, well. This Halloween stuff is fun! But I'm the real thing, got it?! This ain't a costume!
So, I'm looking for treasure hidden in this venue. Wanna search with me, Commander?
"Huh? Wait, are you serious about that?"
Of course! I'm Royal Fortune of the great Tempesta, after all!
But there are a lot of people here, so I probably won't do anything too crazy.
If you can't rest easy with me running around, then you'll just have to scour the venue with me!
You're a Commander, aren't ya? Shouldn't you be watching over the shipgirls anyway?
"...Well, I definitely can't leave you alone now. I've got no choice; I'll tag along for a little while."
"But I haven't heard about any treasure buried in the venue..."
There's treasure! See?! It's written on this flyer!
I read the flyer, and indeed it said, "The first person to get the treasure gets free drinks for a week, nya!"
As a pirate of the great Tempesta, I can't cast aside treasure lying before my very eyes!
*grumble* B-But first, I need food in my belly! Let us set sail toward the smell of delicious food! Yo ho, heave ho!
She raised the cutlass at her hip and charged toward the food court.
To protect the venue from the cutlass—much more dangerous than the girl wielding it—I rushed after her.

sequence:
Halloween Hijinks

<size=45>6 The Night of Tempesta's Coming</size>

scripts.say: Food Court
What is this?! It's delicious! The port's foods are the best! No, better than the best!
"Whenever the port has an event, each shipgirl faction ends up setting up their own food stalls."
"The Halloween party is no exception, but...due to time and space constraints, I hear they couldn't scrape together anything big."
Sausage, steak, barbecue galore! It's all meat, and you say this ain't big?!
This is so much more luxurious than the port's usual food! And their food is already incredible!
Hey, you! I want this, this, and that, and this!
Got it! This is all you wanted, right? Also, here's a freebie for the Commander!
Wait, are you...
It would be a pain to tell her everything about the costume and the real weapon, so I used my authority as Commander to get through the situation.
A-Ah, I see! Well, I hope you two enjoy the party!
Halt! I may not know your price, but I won't bilk on my bill!
Royal Fortune took some gold coins from her pouch and slammed them onto the table.
"Those are heavy... Could it be?!"
Don't make light of us pirates! Even I obey the law, and I know the rules of society!
Hold it right there, pirate shipgirl~!
Let the Commander go at once!
What are ya going on about?! You're a pirate too, aren't you?
Huh? Umm... This is just a Halloween costume. Ack! I mean, release the Commander at once!
How dare you?! The Commander is plundering with me, so he's mine! You can't have him!
Who do ya think you are, running in out of nowhere and demanding him from me?!
That's my line! Why do you get to monopolize him outta nowhere?! If you're plannin' somethin' untoward—
Now Oklahoma's acting crazy too, all because of the real pirate, Royal Fortune!

options.content: Explain everything to calm them down

scripts.say: I step forth to explain things before the situation can get worse.
Oooh... So she wasn't takin' you captive? You're just enjoyin' the Halloween party?
It looked real to me. And when I found out she was a real pirate, I couldn't help myself... Commander, I'm real sorry!
And Royal Fortune, I'm sorry for what I did...
It's alright, friend! You were trying to protect your Commander, right? A captain needs crew like you!
Thanks, I think? It's not much of an apology, but how would you like some pumpkin pie? I just got someone to teach me how to make it!
Nice! I'll take two, please!
With their quarrel resolved, I joined Oklahoma and Royal Fortune on a bench, and we ate pumpkin pie together.
Haah... Man, I'm full. I feel like I've had plenty of fun for a day, too...
How'd you like my homemade pumpkin pie? Pretty good, huh?
That's it! Oklahoma, I'm making you my first mate!
Ahahaha... What does it mean for a shipgirl to be another shipgirl's first mate?
Good question... Guess you shipgirls already have the Commander, anyways...
Hm? Wow, it's already about time to hoist the sails, eh? But I still haven't found that treasure...
Haah, haah, you're not bad... I'm at a disadvantage in this fight. Time to scram!
H-Huh? Why were we fighting?
You're open! Hahahaha! The Commander's all mine!
W-Waaait! Let the Commander gooo!
Royal Fortune dragged me off to a place with nobody around.
Heheheh. Commander, we're all alone again...
"Maybe, but after you showed off that real weapon, I'm sure the others will come running soon..."
That's a scary thought, yeah...
But it's okay! It's already about time for me to set sail!
"Come to think of it, Royal Fortune, weren't you searching for some treasure?"
It's okay! I may not have found the treasure itself, but I've memorized the place!
"What do you mean by 'that time'?"
Hmm, it's a promise between pirates, so I have no other choice!
"I think I've figured out what's going on. If you have plans with your friends, I won't stop you."
But don't you worry! We'll have plenty of chances to see each other! Our date can wait until next time, Commander!
Mm, I said next time, but when will that be...? Tomorrow, maybe?
Ah, forget it! I'm not gonna worry now! The great Tempesta rolls in, rampages, and scrams just like a tempest!
But be prepared! Next time, it won't just be me; I'll be back with greater numbers!
"Sounds chaotic, but a tempest sounds fun once in a while."
There you go! You'd better prepare lots of good food for us while you have the chance!
I may not be much of a fighter, but I can feast like no other!
"I can't wait."
That's the spirit! Wait for us with breath bated and table set! That's a promise between you and me, Commander!
Now, it's time for a tactical withdrawal! 'Til we meet again, Commander!
We said our goodbyes, and the shipgirl of Tempesta, Royal Fortune, disappeared again into the Halloween night.
Lighthearted and sincere, and despite her history as a pirate, she adheres to laws and promises made.
She may be lacking in common sense, but she's another treasured friend.
Looking forward to our future banquet, I returned to the party to spend the rest of the night with the others.

This is Memphis. No abnormalities detected so far. Seems like another peaceful day, over.
That's good... But according to our weather reports, a strange mist has been forming along your route, over.
Understood. We'll keep our eyes peeled, over.

Baltimore Fleet, this is NY City. Requesting response, over.

Repeat... urgent... requesting immediate...

sequence: <size=51>A stronghold sits upon the canal that links two great oceans.</size>
<size=51>Its crucial role is to protect this vital route.</size>
<size=51>Knowing this, the Sirens have launched many attacks against it, only to be repelled each time.</size>
<size=51>Various patrols and defenses were put into place to deter them.</size>
<size=51>But now, a mysterious fog has begun to permeate the entire area.</size>
<size=51>To rescue a fleet that has been swallowed by the dark mist...</size>
<size=51>The warriors of the Eagle Union must once again push forward into the destruction that awaits...</size>

scripts.say: Canal Stronghold - Out at sea
Not bad, Bremerton.
Heh. I might not be as good as Baltimore, but there's nothing impressive about smashing up foes like this.
I heard that the Baltimore class played a large role in the defense of NY City.
Well, thanks. I certainly wasn't there, but I'll take credit for it anyway.
Having that said, I was looking forward to fighting alongside Baltimore...
I'm worried about her too. I really am.
That's natural. You're friends, after all.
Bremerton's expression seemed pained for a moment, but she quickly went back to her characteristically bright, smiling self..
If it's that Baltimore we're talking about, she's probably smashing up the Sirens' home as we speak.
Yeah... I'm sure she's fine.
Wait... Is that... mist?
...Bremerton ...ker Hill... can you hear...
...the mist is... Sirens... the bay is...
...Hurry... run away...
Various parts that looked like they were from Enterprise's rigging were scattered in the water.......
It's as Casablanca said. The mist is interfering with our communications.
And it seems like the Sirens are trying to invade the bay. Guess we're not looking in the right place either.
We should head back and defend the stronghold. We'll let our peers continue the search for Baltimore and Enterprise.
Sounds good to me. After all, the Sirens shall never break through a member of the Essex class!
As a member of the Baltimore class, there's no way I'd lose to some small fry here!
(Baltimore... please stay safe...)
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
Intrepid, any good news from your recons?
It's no good. I can barely even get my aircraft to take off and land in this thick fog.
The communication system, radar, and navigation system are all down. All I can do right now is make sure we don't bump into each other.
I've never seen anything like this before, even in the Mirror Seas.
In other words, we're completely lost in the fog...
"This is no ordinary fog. It is actually the work of the Sirens. What we do know is that Baltimore and Enterprise most likely went missing within this fog."
I feel like that's all we've got to work with right now...
If we change the angle we think about the issue, then it should be possible to rescue Baltimore if we understand how this mist works.
Should we prioritize defending the stronghold first, or locating Enterprise?
What am I thinking? We've got to secure a safe route to the stronghold first. Otherwise, it'd be dangerous to stumble around blindly.
The fact that you're unable to use your recon planes means that it's my time to shine! Let me handle the recon!
Searchlights, deploy!
Ahh! Hold on! You're going to draw the enemy's fire!
Huh? But if the enemy attacks, wouldn't they be giving away their position?
(This kid... I'm not sure if she's an optimist or just an idiot...)
Fine, fine! If you're gonna use that thing, just make sure to be careful!
Don't worry! Look, I do this all the time!
Destroyer Cooper, setting sail!
...A lone ship continued to sail through the fog.
...How much time had passed? Then, a shadow coalesced in front of Enterprise.
You're... Ark Royal?!
Ark Royal! Did you get lost here too?
The shadow turned around and spoke.
"So you came, Enterprise? I've been waiting."
"It seems like we're still missing some people... No, everyone who needs to be here is already here."
"Everyone"...? Who else is here? Where are we?
In due time, my friend. Until then, maybe another friend will join us...
Answer me, Ark Royal! Ark Royal!
The shadow turned her back and stepped forward into the fog.
What the hell was that?! Ark Royal...
As soon as Enterprise extended her hand to touch the shadow, it disappeared as if melting into the mist.
Was that... an illusion?
Sirens... what are you plotting...?
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
Intrepid, any good news from your recons?
Damnit, where are these enemies coming from?!
(At this rate, our supplies are going to get whittled down... What should we do...?!)
What's wrong, Marblehead?
Cooper, could you tone it down a notch? I can't focus with you constantly yelling "Cyclone Smasher!"
But that's the name of my new secret technique! It's super cool!
Look, you're going to draw the attention of the Sirens with all your yelling.
Ugh... I guess you have a point...
(I'm not seeing an escape route... We can still fight for now, but we can't keep this up forever.)
(Knowing the Sirens, they're likely to appear once we've exhausted our reserves. And if that happens...)
(Essex hasn't said much, but... I'm sure Enterprise's disappearance must have dealt a heavy blow to her...)
(...or maybe not. I'm sure she's thinking hard about what Enterprise would do in this situation.)
(Enterprise, if you were here right now, what would you do...?)
(That girl dwells way too much on what Enterprise thinks about her.)
Essex, are you all right?
(If only Enterprise was here right now...)
Essex!
Waaah?!
...Aren't you thinking a bit too hard? According to Cooper, a new Siren is approaching us.
I-I'm fine... but if Enterprise was here...！
...she'd probably lead everyone to attack the enemy.
But look, you probably shouldn't emulate her style in lieu of the core strategies.
...I've got it! If the Sirens did in fact create a Mirror Sea here, then the core must be located somewhere!
If we break that core, whatever it is, then that should also dissipate this heavy mist.
Intrepid, thanks a ton! You were a great help!
Huhhh?!
"Cooper here. I've detected a new type of mass-produced Siren ship that emits some purple glow while patrolling."
"It looks pretty tough, but I think my Cyclone Smasher works on it. Wish me luck!"
"On second thought, I don't think I can win! Wanna head over? Help me!"
That girl just can't stay put...
The fact that there's a new mass-produced model here means that we're probably getting closer to their base.
Bingo! Looks like you're right on the money~
All right. Let's go bail Cooper out, defeat the Sirens, and lift this mist.
Roger that!
Push forward with everything you've got!
Intrepid, watch out!
BOOOOM!
What?! Submarines?!
Weren't you trained in anti-submarine tactics...?!
Come out now, stop sneaking around and... Face! Us! Now!
BOOOOM!
Marblehead, locating the Siren submarines, dropped a large number of depth charges.
Woah! So many at once?!
They say that for every one sub you see, there actually three lurking beneath the waves. Right~?
Great! They've come up to the surface! Planes, prepare to launch!
Marblehead, Cooper, I'm counting on you to locate the other enemies with your sonars!
That Siren over there is equipped with a cannon! Make sure to watch out for shelling!
Phew... looks like this is the last one. Anti-submarine warfare is no fun at all.
I'm glad everyone was prepared for this!
We've destroyed a group of the new Siren ships, but nothing has fundamentally changed.
A tactical defeat, huh...
(I guess stuff like this happens too...)
I did all I can, but... guess it wasn't enough!
I'll make sure to do better next time!
Yeah! Things haven't been going well for us so far, but I'm sure we'll be able to find the source of this mist in no time! At this rate...
Suddenly, the surface of the ocean trembled as a thunderous roar swallowed the bold words that were just uttered...
Out of nowhere, a massive wave rose out of the thick mist, the surface undulating turbulently as if seized by a storm.
What?! Watch out...! This storm feels unnatural, just like the mist!
You don't need to state the obvious...!
Shockwaves, thunderous crashes, and violent waves tore through the fleet, dying the white mist into a deep, ominous blue.
(Wait... No way... I was swallowed by the ocean...?! Impossible...!)
She was sinking... Deeper and deeper, as if pulled by some unknown weight. She continued to sink, seemingly for an eternity.
(My rigging is falling apart...? Was it a Siren attack...?! No, we should have defeated all of them...)
(Impossible... Did I just lose my balance...?!)
(Damn it, Intrepid! You're always ruining everything! You're always messing up! It's always you being sent to the docks!)
(You can't even accomplish a single thing... Everyone is better than you...)
Hey! Intrepid, are you still alive?
(Oww! This voice... it's Bluegill! She's returned from her patrol!)
H-help me...!
Woahh, Intrepid, when did you get converted into a submarine?!
*glug* *glug* (Who the hell would do that...?! I'm drowning over here!)
Woah woah, don't get mad at me! I'll carry you up right now!
Nnnnnnnnghh! I'm soooooo tiiiiired!
Welcome back.
Did you hear about "that?"
No.
By the way, why are you blanketing the entire area with mist? Isn't it a waste of resources?
For the suspense.
Look, I have seniority here, so don't be giving me that cheeky attitude!
Waste of energy.
Communications jammed. Navigation systems jammed. Radars jammed. Seafog density increased by 30%. Compounding rate 50% and rising.
That is all. Confirming and returning to work.
If you have nothing better to do, why not head out again?
Don't wanna. My job here's already done. Let's hurry it up and get to the next thing~
Just go then. Don't get in the way of my work.
Sure, sure. I was on my way out anyway.
Resuming playback. The next "fragment" is...
She followed the direction that the shadow was facing before it disappeared.
This is... each faction's...
I'm not detecting any identification signals. Is everything here an illusion?
...is everyone here now?
For the time being. There are some who cannot make it.
...What a bitter situation this war is.
I'd like to get out of here too, but because we're not able to conduct any concerted operations, we should prioritize sticking together for now.
Cheer up, everyone. Enterprise is here as well, after all! I'm sure everything's going to be fine!
If only things were so easy. Miss Enterprise, I know this is sudden, but please state your "name."
...My name?
Yes. "Flare." A single light that pierces the darkness and illuminates the path forward. A wonderful name, if I must say so myself.
Are we really going to work with those guys? Those "Sirens" were originally created to be substitutes for us...
What...?!
Indeed. In any case, let's see how they perform first.
Working with... the Sirens?! What are you plotting?
Once again, the shadows disappeared, leaving Enterprise alone in the still sea.
Canal Stronghold - Bay
Under the cover of the mist, the Siren forces encroached upon the Canal Stronghold.
However...
All right everyone, let's stick to the plan. Draw the enemies in, and work with the support fire from the stronghold to take them out.
Fortunately, we're well prepared for a war of attrition. We have enough supplies to withstand a siege for months.
At least, make sure none of these Sirens make it back alive!
Nice going, Casablanca! You really are amazing! You even managed to evacuate all the transports so skillfully!
Speak nothing of it. Escorting vessels falls within my ballpark. If anything, thanks for hearing my ideas out.
Correct ideas ought to be implemented, regardless of position or seniority.
I heard that this tactic is especially effective against mass-production Siren fleets that aren't lead by a humanoid-type.
But the fact that they've pushed us to take such measures...
All we can hope for is that Intrepid and the others are having good luck with their search...
Don't worry about them. If anyone is fit to lead in Enterprise's absence, it would be Essex.
BOOOOOM--!
What just happened...?!
One of the stronghold's turrets was just destroyed. I was afraid things wouldn't go so smoothly, even if it's just mass-produced enemies we're facing. Reno, Bremerton, how's the situation?
Um... They're ignoring us and heading straight towards the stronghold!
Did the plan fail? Were you not able to draw their fire?
It's no good. They're even ignoring our attacks. They're single-mindedly advancing on the stronghold!
They way they're moving makes my skin crawl, even if they aren't even sentient...
What villainous tactics! Throwing out mindless pawns like this! The hero within me screams out for justice!
They know nothing of compassion or consciousness towards even their own.
The Sirens truly are terrifying enemies.
Yeah... If they're shrugging off all our attacks like this, the stronghold's not going to be able to fend them off forever. How about a change in tactics?
If the Sirens are dead set in destroying the stronghold, then what we ought to do should be clear as well.
The stronghold's firepower is overwhelming compared to what us ships can muster. We can't afford to let it fall, no matter the cost.
We need to take the initiative, break their lines, and cut off their reinforcements...!
A few days ago, a patrol fleet lead by Baltimore suddenly went missing in a mysterious fog en route to the Canal Stronghold.
A rescue fleet was immediately formed to locate the missing fleet, and to lend aid to the stronghold.
Canal Stronghold - Surrounding waters
So this is the legendary Canal Stronghold? I've heard all sorts of rumors about it, but it's even more awesome seeing it in person!
Bremerton, have you never left NY City in your life? How have you never been here before?
In any case, this stronghold is a crucial holdout against the Sirens because of how important the canal is, so of course it's gotta be big.
That's right. The safety of this canal is not just vitally important for the armed forces. The civilians depend on it as well.
That's why we can't spare any expenses in preparing for a large-scale Siren assault.
I see... I'm still worried about Baltimore and the others though...
We've almost arrived at the fortress, but there still hasn't been a single trace of Siren activity...
There's no way Baltimore and the others would allow themselves to be captured without a fight, but there's no sign of a battle anywhere...
Do you think they got trapped in a Mirror Sea? This fog appearing out of nowhere clearly isn't normal.
I don't think that's likely. Normally, all communications are cut off from the Mirror Sea. However, I've been receiving a string of messages.
Furthermore, a convoy that was patrolling the canal safely arrived at the stronghold, even having to go through the mist.
However, it was mentioned that the mist was so expansive that its size couldn't be accurately assessed from coastal monitoring stations.
In other words, their communication equipment started to fail after entering the fog, and then they encountered Sirens... This sure doesn't smell like a coincidence to me.
I agree... What do you think, Enterprise?
I'm with Intrepid. This situation is no accident.
However, given the present conditions, we don't have a lead as to where to start searching, and we can't cover this entire area.
For the time being, let's head back and join up with the stronghold reinforcement fleet. We can organize our information and then draft a rescue plan.
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
Right before Intrepid and the others arrived at the Canal Stronghold...
Finally... I finally got them off my tail... I've got to hurry up and tell everyone about the Siren situation!
This sound...!
The sea shimmered with specks of mysterious light as a multitude of shadows approached the stronghold. Underneath them were countless Siren submarines.
The mass-produced Sirens, moving like a school of fish, was an undeniably terrifying sight.
When'd they surround me...?! Shoot, is this the end? What should I do...
Even though the stronghold was not far away along the coast, Bluegill saw no way to break through the Siren encirclement.
If I fall here, I won't be able to get this information to my friends!
...Wait a sec. Now that I think about it, none of them seem to know that I'm here. In other words, I should be safest right here...
This'll do! If I remember correctly, that one large Siren was...
Concealed behind a reef, the small hunter carefully took aim.
That one must be the flagship!
If I can take it out, I'll be able to disrupt their command chain, and victory will be ours!
Okay! This one's called the Victory Snipe!
W-wait! Huh? Why is there a thick mist covering the ocean?!
What's going on... Woooooahhh!
Aaaaaahhhhh!
Bluegill's vision turned white as a raging torrent consumed her, as if a washing machine was tossing her around.
After a while, when the waters finally calmed down...
Owwie... Huh? Where'd the Siren fleet go? Where am I...?
Wait... Is that Intrepid over there?!
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
Say your prayers!
KABOOM!
We've destroyed our target! The enemy's movements... haven't changed at all!
Another swing and a miss... How many times has it been now?
Twenty-one times!
I didn't expect a new type of Siren to show up here... Plus, they all look creepy as hell...!
Don't give up, everyone! Remember, the hero always gets to have the last laugh!
Reno, have you considered a future as a cheerleader?
Maybe, but we need to make it out of this mess first. Come on, everyone! Let's see that fighting spirit!
Well, since we can't seem to figure out which one is commanding them, we might as well annihilate them all.
As Baltimore would say, "fight if you want to survive, girls!"
Woah, that feels really heroic. Very cool, Bremerton!
Heh, another target's coming our way. Maybe this one's the flagship. Let's gooo!
Siren aircraft incoming!
Just leave it to me!
The enemy's aerial ambush was quickly mowed down by the combined anti-air fire of the Atlanta and Oakland-class ships.
Thanks for covering us, Reno.
We've destroyed the enemies over here too!
No luck over here... Doesn't look like this was the enemy's command ship either.
Another miss. The mist still hasn't cleared up.
Damn... Even if head back to the stronghold, nothing will have changed...
Shh... I hear something...
I hear it too. It sounds like... the rushing of water... and it's getting closer and closer...?!
