What?! Everyone, look out, it's a tsunami!
How does a huge wave like this appear out of nowhere?! Hang on, everyone!
The ships were desperately hanging on as a wall of water began to swallow the mass-produced Sirens.
They're here, Enterprise.
An unexpected participant had entered the gathering of shadows.
A Siren...?!
Before her was an enemy who Enterprise had faced off against many times. Reflexively, she poised herself for battle.
Greetings on behalf of the Magister, Code G.
Code G... Magister...
Laplace's Demon should serve the common interest of humanity rather than being used as an instrument of war. The Creator is in accordance.
Therefore, we shall provide you a base and supply you with any resources that you need. Make sure that the research you conduct never falls into the wrong hands.
Know that we too have our orders, and cannot always act of our free will.
However, there should still be room for cooperation despite this.
...Rest assured, we shall uphold our end of the bargain.
After all, this is the will of both the Creator and the Magister.
I have shared the coordinates of the Arbiters with you. Make sure to avoid them at all costs.
Working with the Sirens? What is this sorcery...
The shadows once again melted into the fog, none of them responding to Enterprise's question.
Fragment replay, complete.
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
The waves dissolved and the sea became still as if nothing had happened... except the mist still lingered.
Bluegill had pulled Intrepid from the depths, saving her from certain demise.
*cough* *cough*... I owe you one...
Intrepid, are you okay?!
As fine as I will be for someone who almost drowned...
Bluegill, thank goodness you made it in time!
Heheh! I just finished my recon mission and am now back to join up with the team!
On my way back, I encountered a huge swarm of Sirens before getting pulled into a huge wave, and, well, here you all are fighting the Sirens.
Hmm... We were fighting this whole time. Did you not notice anything before that?
Wait, is that the sound of an engine coming towards us?
Watch out! Something's approaching! Hurry up and...
BOOOMM!
Woah! Everyone, are you okay? Say something if you are!
Reno? Why are you here?
Marblehead?!
...Why'd you suddenly shoot? Judging from the anti-air fire, I knew it wouldn't be a Siren, but still...
Well, you can't rule out the possibility of one of the Sirens' "pieces" showing up, right?
Huh? Was Reno supposed to be acting independently from Bunker Hill and the others?
Yeah... Why'd all of you come back to the Canal Stronghold bay?
We did just get swept up by a huge wave, but there's no way it swept us all the way back into the bay, right?
Bremerton! Casablanca! Bunker Hill! Over here~
Everyone's back together, huh?
Woah, it's everyone on the rescue team!
Somehow, it seems like we all encountered the same weather abnormality? And we all got caught up by that huge wave...
When Bluegill was caught up in the wave, she noticed that she was somewhere altogether different. Do you think the Sirens are moving us on purpose?
I find that hard to believe, but can't rule out that possibility either.
In other words... where are we currently relative to the Canal Stronghold?
It's hard to say. My equipment has been going crazy for a while now. It's possible that we're even inside a Mirror Sea.
To make matters worse, we still haven't found Baltimore or Enterprise...
That's true, but at least we're all together now, right? What we need to do now is...
Find the source of this mist!
Oh, by the way, I found the enemy flagship!
I'm almost certain it's that really big ship that slipped into a swarm of submarines!
When I tried to snipe it, I got transported here.
Now that I think about it, at that time...
Same here. We were suddenly swallowed up by a huge wave.
And same here. That means...
Putting together all our information, that means all of our groups were swallowed up by the waves and transported to the same location.
Why is everyone looking at me?!
From the looks of things, you might have activated the defense mechanism of the flagship by imperiling it.
And since most of the new Sirens we encountered after arriving here...
It makes sense that they're trying to gather us in one place and then finish us all off in one go.
Since we know there are lots of enemy submarines out there, we should prepare a better anti-submarine system.
Thanks to Bluegill's information, we're way better prepared than we were before...!
Anyway, we've got to keep our eyes peeled from attacks from beneath!
I'll help out! This time, I'll make sure to land that Victory Snipe!
The scattered heroes joined forces to face the supervillain...
A bit cliché, but it's still an exciting plot development!
Heroes of justice, assemble! This is our climax!
I see we have multiple comic fans in the house here!
Hmm? Cooper, are you into this stuff as well?
Of course I am! Heroes who put it all on the line to save the world are the only ones as cool as me!
(Woah, she has the same hobby as me?!) Well, wait until you take a look at this gadget here!
Is that a gauntlet? It's glowing too!
Heheh, and if you push this button right here...
It transforms?! Amazing!
I made this myself! Hehe, pretty cool, right?
I want one too~
Sure, I'll whip something up for you. Just give me a design and a budget you'd like me to work with.
However, I sure didn't expect to meet other superhero fans here.
I'd love to show you my collection once we get back!
Really? Show me once we get back to the stronghold!
Sure thing! Look at all the gadgets I've got here! I'm a true hero's supporter!
And don't forget to make one for me! I've always been afraid of not having the right tools for the job even though I already have my special move!
Now now, heroes should be iconic for their abilities, even without their gadgets.
"It's not the superpower that makes the hero, but rather the super things that they do." Isn't that right?
...Huh? Where have I heard that line before?！
It's a new show that Baltimore and I sometimes watch together.
I'm not as invested as Baltimore is, but I know what she'd say...
"You become a hero not by looking the part, but by following in their footsteps."
Yeah! That's exactly right! I agree one hundred percent!
And right now, the heroic thing to do...
Reno, you'll be the hero who protects us from enemy planes!
Cooper, you'll be the hero who protects us from enemy subs! Right~?
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
As soon as the anti-submarine recons detect an enemy, it will alert us as to its position and continue to track its movements.
Phew... I'm glad we made preparations to deal with enemy submarines beforehand. I didn't actually expect the Sirens to suddenly field them in such large numbers...
It's really amazing how many different roles you can cover as an escort carrier. I wish I could have planes as well~
Even with all this mist, I'd like to be able to get a birds' eye view of things.
Well, if you want to operate seaplanes, that would be possible after being retrofitted into an aviation cruiser.
Marblehead, are you worried about Memphis?
Memphis is always working so hard, she barely gets any time back at home. This was supposed to be a vacation for her...
I was going to show her around to all the neat sightseeing spots around here, as well as the best places to kick back and relax on off-duty days...
But it looks like that won't be possible anymore... Ahaha...
I'm also worried about Baltimore and Enterprise.
We may not be sister ships, but as fellow compatriots of the same great union, I pray for their safety as if they were related to me.
That's why I want to work even harder... So I can protect your smile and stuff.
Woah, talk about a curveball! You always came across as the overly serious type. Didn't think you had an appetite for jokes like that as well~
Here's looking at you, kid~
Let's both do our best then.
That's right. Let's make sure everyone gets home safely!
Who's there?
Just a spectator in the background.
Do you not like what you see in this film?
"Film?" Are you talking about those shadows?
Fragments. A log of memories.
A log? Memories? Whose are you talking about? When was this?
They were "hers." Both in the past, and in the future.
And now, they are yours as well.
I have no time for your sick games. Why are you trying to show me these lies?
The past cannot lie.
Come. She is here.
A new shadow emerged from the mist.
An entity with an indescribable aura unlike any being that she had met...
You're...
BOOOOM!
The very land roars. The ocean waters rage and space itself seems to unravel as if split by an earthquake.
Unlike the other shadows, this figure only gazed into Enterprise's eyes before fading back into the mist.
As if responding to her actions, the mist pulled back, revealing countless mass-produced Siren ships.
I guess I'm going to have to fight my way out after all...!
BOOOOM!
However...
Enterprise! Need a hand?
Baltimore! Everyone!
It feels like we've been stranded in the mist forever, but there is a way out after all!
Now, let's push back the Sirens!
With the arrival of unexpected reinforcements, Enterprise struck down enemy after enemy with no burdens in her heart knowing that her friends were safe.
I'm so glad everyone is safe! Right now...
Not here... the Commander...
Canal Stronghold? - Out at sea?
As the mist began to recede, Intrepid could be seen fiercely fighting back wave after wave of Siren forces.
Although the enemies had increased their firepower, the carriers which had been suppressed by the heavy mist once again took control of the skies.
What an absurd number of enemies. Have the Sirens already seen through our plans?
It's possible. A full-scale assault launched from three dimensions, using a thick mist for cover...
It's all to conceal the position of their flagship.
Our advantages will only shrink at this rate... What should we do?
There's nothing else to do. It's do or die at this point.
Come on, chin up. Intrepid means "without fear," right?
You're right...!
Now that Enterprise isn't here, we have to do our best in her stead... No, we'll have to go above and beyond and take on her part.
Not just for her sake, but also for Baltimore's, and for everyone counting on us in the Canal Stronghold.
I'm glad you care about everyone, but this is your opportunity to break free from your past.
Essex... Bunker Hill...
Ah, but don't go charging forward blindly. Enterprise would never rush in first before assessing the situation.
As if I'd do something like that!
(Though I said all that, what should I do next...?)
Oh, in case anyone hasn't noticed, the mist has gradually been thinning out.
Of course. That's the only reason we've been able to get our planes off the ground.
Bunker Hill, were you able to get a good look at the mist density from the air? Pretty good view up there!
...I did, but why are you talking about that now...
If the mist was generated from a single point, the density should not change significantly even if the mist is thinning out.
That's right! Basically, this will let us know where to search!
Good going, Intrepid! Finally, we have a lead on where to head towards!
All right. Next up is figuring out how to approach the enemy flagship.
We don't have time to worry about that, so let's get going!
Ehhhhh?!
...Haha, good grief, I guess that's just part of what makes us the Essex class.
All right, my recon planes! Take us to the enemy core flagship!
Canal Stronghold - Surrounding waters
I'm Bunker Hill of the Essex-class, and I am in charge of the stronghold reinforcement fleet.
(whispers) Um... What should I say next...
Ahem... Thank you for coming all the way out here...
You don't have to read off the script, you know...
We're all family here, so just take it easy.
Long time no see, Bunker Hill.
Indeed. It's good to see you all, Essex, Intrepid, and, uh...
Just Enterprise is fine. Don't worry about the formalities.
Thanks. In any case, looks like everyone is here except for Bluegill, who's still out on patrol.
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer, Cooper here! You all must be tired from sailing all the way down here! ...Wait, where's the Commander?
The Commander is with Saratoga for a joint operation with the Northern Parliament. We wouldn't be able to recall the Commander for a task like this.
That's too bad~ I heard your commander was a total stud~
So, the main hero isn't here, huh... I suppose this is one of those side stories when the sidekicks get to take front and center.
Don't worry about it, Reno! As long as I'm here, everything's gonna go swimmingly!
That Northern Parliament, where engines freeze over and stop working? Guh... just hearing about it makes me cold.

Even if it gets below zero there, it's not like we don't have airfields that get that chilly as well. Trust me, there's no way an engine would suddenly freeze over and stop working just because of the temperature.
You sure know your stuff... Ahaha.
You didn't come across as the knowledgeable type, Marblehead...
Ahem... Let's continue our chat inside.
Booyah! We also have some tropical punch inside!
Since we're just standing around here anyways, we might as well head inside.
That's right. Besides, we need to get around to drafting our rescue plan... Right, Enterprise?
Huh? Oh, sorry. I was thinking about something.
Oh? Is something bothering you, Enterprise?
It's no big deal. After this, let's all help search.
There's a lot of territory to cover just to the east of the canal. We're going to have our work cut out for us.
KABOOM!
The very land roars. The ocean waters rage and space itself seems to unravel as if split by an earthquake.
Woah! What's going on?!
The fog's starting to clear... Wait, something's coming right towards us!
Accompanying a massive submarine was a humanoid Siren, clad in an alien-looking rigging with a bored expression on her face.
That's... the Siren core flagship!
Yet another new model of Siren... and once again, we don't have an ounce of information on this one.
You're the one responsible for creating this mist and for launching this assault!
What did you do with Baltimore, Enterprise, and the others? Answer me!
Pain in the ass...
Planes...?! This one's different from the ones we've fought before!
Activating surface combat mode.
That main battery... It can also fight on the surface?!
Output: 70%.
She's starting her attack! Everyone, take cover!
BOOOOM!
Can you still call that a submarine?!
She has aircraft, main batteries, torpedoes, and a shield?! Isn't that kit way too overloaded?!
Without a doubt, this is a formidable enemy...!
But, our attacks are working! If we keep attacking, we'll be able to get through that pesky shield!
Overheating imminent. Changing modes.
Her rigging is transforming?! She's about to dive!
As if I'd let you! Planes, roll out!
Reno, Marblehead, back Intrepid up! Bluegill, stop her from finishing her transformation!
Got it! Just leave it to me!
You're the one who attacked the stronghold and abducted Enterprise... I won't let you get away!
After receiving the focused fire from Intrepid and the others, the Siren was unable to complete her transformation and appeared heavily damaged.
That's right. Figures and gadgets are weakest at the joints, so we knew exactly where to hit.
Keep aiming at the joints! Stop her from transforming!
Reno, are you a mechanic?
Eh? Ahaha... Wh-who knows!
...No choice.
The waters shake and rumble ominously.
Essex, Bremerton, everyone on the surface, do you hear that?!
There's something terrible approaching from under the waves! Watch out beneath you!
Darn it, I've had enough with these bad surprises! What the hell is that?!
Mechanical tentacles?! ...Wh-where are they coming from?!
Whatever this thing is, it's defying everything I know about physics!
We're not going to be able to attack at this right... Ugh...!
Phew... At least we managed to get away from that thing...
But you know what was weird? I didn't feel any sort of malevolence from that thing...
I wasn't paying attention, since I was just trying to get away from those tentacles...
The Sirens are starting to withdraw. I suppose our communication systems will be coming back online soon.
And this spot... seems to be good! Anyway, the stronghold should be safe now.
After all that, we still haven't found Baltimore and Enterprise... Ehh?!
Enterprise?!
And Baltimore as well?! When did you all...
Sorry for dropping in on such short notice. It took a long time to shake off the Sirens.
What in the world happened?
Hmm... Well, we got lost in the fog, met some strange person, bumped into Enterprise... and, well, now we're here.
The story is actually quite long, but we should go inside first.
C'mere, Enterprise, we need you too.
Indeed. Welcome back. I'm glad that you're all safe.
Bermuda Triangle - Mist
The Baltimore fleet was locked in combat with Purifier.
Can't catch me~
Damn it... Come back here, why are you running away? Fight me fair and square!
No can do~ I'm just here to gather data, so I don't wanna waste any extra energy~
Since that wave, it's clear that Purifier is just here to waste our time, but we can't do anything about it right now...
BOOOOOM--!
Was that... the sound of battle?
(Oh, that's the sound of the bait being taken.)
Oh no, whatever shall I do~ You haven't seen the last of me~ I'll remember this~ We're blasting off again~
Come back here!
Another figure emerged from the mist...
Ember...?
The Commander isn't here?
...I have nothing to say to you.
I see...
Hold on! Wait, thanks for helping us!
But, where are we? What should we do next?
Not far from where you need to be.
Is this mist moving us around?
The Sirens are toying with you once again. "Microlayer medley," a compound that creates a signal-jamming mist.
I knew those blasted Sirens were up to no good...!
How do we get out of this place?
Doesn't look like it will be possible as long as we're trapped in this mist. But if this fellow wants to fight...
...The jamming mist generator mechanism...
Hmm... If I remember properly, the way it was made...
A sea, dyed a dark red by flames and smoke. Tarnished by wanton violence and destruction.
Tattered flags floated in the water. Debris and bodies alike were strewn everywhere unceremoniously.
Where... am I?
They are still fighting. Among them are faces that she recognizes, and some that she doesn't.
...the different factions...
But, it is not Sirens that they raise their weapons against.
The enemy... is mass-produced ships from the Northern Parliament...?
No... They look similar, but the weapons and design are completely different...
One by one, the humans fall before the hands of the ships. They kneel. They sink. Into nothingness.
I must help them...!
But her body would not obey her.
...Up in the sky... are those meteors?
They're so beautiful...
Indeed. Welcome back. I'm glad that you're all safe.
Gaaaahhh?!
*gasp*... Was I dreaming...?
Even after the mist was superimposed upon the Mirror Sea, it collapsed after only one second.
Observer, the experiment has failed.
Is it impossible to prevent "Code G" from coming to pass...?
Well done, young program.
The Arctic iceberg fortress is also under attack.
...No, the plan was a success. Hehehe...
The power of "Code G" comes from its ability to reject all foreign interference.
However, the connection has now opened. To "Enterprise."
...No, not good enough. Whatever I can come up with now has surely been tried in a parallel timeline.
Why have all the experiments that we can access through the logs ended in failure so far...?
I see... it's because of the presence of the "Commander" in this timeline.
Zero, just how many secrets are you keeping from us...
I'm just dying to find out. Ahahaha...
Canal Stronghold - Eastern region
With the help of her allies, Enterprise launched a search in the waters to the east of the Canal Stronghold.
...An entire fleet, vanished without a trace. And a mysterious SOS signal...
According to Baltimore's message, they did in fact encounter Sirens. We've found no signs of any sort of battle despite that.
So far, we've known that our communications equipment always breaks down when entering a Mirror Sea. However...
If you can't count on that assumption...
Doesn't that only make this phenomenon even more suspicious?
Think harder. It's normal for fog to roll in along the coast, but there's no way it should extend so far out to sea.
What could it mean...
No... could something like that be possible...?!
The mist was originally created by the Sirens, but its purpose is not necessarily to jam our equipment...
But to dare us to use it, to lure me into a trap...!
Before she could finish her thought, Enterprise's surroundings quickly became enveloped in a thick, white mist.
When did they find me?!
So, the Sirens were behind this after all...
Canal Stronghold
Enterprise still hasn't come back yet...
Well, I'm sure she just stopped to smell the roses somewhere. Pretty beautiful place we've got around here.
Don't you think she's always a bit too enthusiastic about her work? Probably would do her good to take it easy for a bit.
Even superheroes need to rest after all. I'd love to go to the top of a skyscraper and look all the way around, so I totally get it.
...All right, about this mission assignment...
Bremerton and I will lead the first fleet, while Enterprise and Essex will lead the second fleet.
Our mission is to search for Baltimore's missing fleet while also preparing for a Siren assault.
Should be straightforward enough. But, is Enterprise not back yet?
What should we do? Maybe try to contact her first?
That won't be necessary. Let's set sail and regroup with her. If we just follow her route, we're sure to meet up at some point.
(Essex sure gets hot-headed when it comes to Enterprise, just like always...)
Let me head out first. Since you're the leader, there's no need for you to do the scouting.
Enterprise... where are you...?
I even got a special local coffee blend from Marblehead. I know how much you like coffee...
Huh?
Parts... from Enterprise's rigging?
Various parts that looked like they were from Enterprise's rigging were scattered in the water.
Doesn't look like you got into a fight... so did you just drop this stuff on accident?
No no, that's impossible. Enterprise isn't a scatterbrain like me...
"Siren forces have been detected in the waters around the Canal Stronghold! All hands, prepare for battle immediately!"
"Repeat, Siren forces have surrounded us! Prepare for battle immediately!"
Showing up now of all times?! So they were aiming for the stronghold after all...!
Canal Stronghold - Surrounding waters
Intrepid, I've cleared out the Sirens over here as well!

As much as I enjoy being backed up by the stronghold's supporting fire, if there's anything I learned from what happened at the NY Defense Line, it's that the enemies will keep coming unless we take the fight to them.
By the way, did you find Enterprise?
Nope. Only found these parts...
What in the world happened, Enterprise...
Enterprise isn't responding to the communication I sent earlier...
Do you think this has something to do with the Siren attack? Maybe she got pulled into a Mirror Sea as well.
Slowly whittling our forces down until they can launch an all-out attack against the stronghold...
Damn... that means Baltimore's also trapped in a Mirror Sea?!
No way...!
Curses! What has my terrible luck wrought upon us...?!
Now now, this was bound to happen sooner or later. If you're worried about it, then you should hurry up and smash these Sirens to bits.
...Right. Now is no time to hesitate.
Um, so the game plan is, take out the Siren's ringleader, and resume the search operation?
Exactly! I'm sure Bunker Hill's fleet is thinking the same thing!
One point to Cooper, zero to the Sirens!
"Intrepid copies. I see Bunker Hill is looking for Enterprise as well."
Essex, the others also encountered Sirens, but it seems like they managed to win without any issues.
Good. But even if we defeat these Sirens, that doesn't tell us where Enterprise is...
I already checked with the stronghold's intel. Doesn't seem like Enterprise went through the canal at any point.
This is turning out to be quite the mystery... Luckily, Detective Cooper is on the case!
My deductions might be a bit rough, but... Wait, huh? What is this fog...
Suddenly, the sea became blanketed in a white mist.
Baltimore also went missing in a thick fog...
Huh? How'd the fog spread here so quickly?
Ugh... What's going on...?
The fog hanging over the ocean cleared, but the sight before her eyes was completely different.
It was almost nostalgic...
But also deeply disconcerting at the same time.
The smell of smoke was strong, as if a battle had just started here...
I don't seem to be anywhere near the stronghold anymore.
The fog is rolling in again... what is it this time?
As if responding to Enterprise's words, the sound of engines whirring could be heard through the fog.
Is someone else here...?
Canal Stronghold Bay
Man, this canal really is a feat of engineering, any way you look at it.
I'm totally speechless after seeing it in person. I know what I'm going to post about on Juustagram after I get back.
I heard that this played an important role in staving off the Sirens in the past.
In order to get across this little strip of land, people used to have to sail around the entire continent.
It only makes sense to continually expand and renovate the stronghold that protects this all-important canal.
And, that's the reason why we're here to protect this fortress. I can see why Baltimore was so pumped up about this.
Getting pumped up is a good thing. A superhero doesn't get to pick her battles!
From searching for lost cats to defeating nefarious villains, we've gotta do everything in our power to be humanity's best neighbors!
"Siren forces have been detected in the waters around the Canal Stronghold! All hands, prepare for battle immediately!"
"Repeat, Siren forces have surrounded us! Prepare for battle immediately!"
What...?
Damn, those villains sure know how to ruin the moment...
If we lose control of this route, human civilization may very well backslide.
Casablanca, please focus on evacuating the transport ships in the bay. Reno, I'll leave the anti-air to you.
Understood!
Bremerton, come with me. We're going to hunt some Sirens.
...What are you looking at?
Nothing in particular. You might have one hell of an evil eye, but even you know how to bust out the cool lines when it matters.
But, taking on the Sirens, huh? That's just the exercise I was itching for!
Heheh, let's dance until you can't move anymore!

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>Going Outside Sucks</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outside the Office
*sip* *siiiiiiiiip*
I hear the sound of someone sipping loudly through a straw coming from the other end of the hallway. I follow the noise to find Whydah, splayed out on the floor.
Whydah, what are you doing here?
*yaaawn*... Oh, Commander.
My room has this regularly-scheduled cleaning functionality, and that's what's going on right now... So in other words, I've been exiled.
Banished from paradise, sacrificed on the altar of convenience... *sigh*, what a pain. I just wanna go back and play games...
...Have you ever considered turning it off?
I'd have to redo all the settings again. And that'd be a pain.
More importantly, were you going somewhere?
Yeah. I somehow don't have any work lined up at the moment, so I figured why not take a stroll?
*yaaawn*... Is that so? Well, have a good time~
Oh, right. Can you bring me some crisps? Gotta have some snacks while basking in the sun, right?
(Huh. She does like relaxing beneath the warm sunlight, doesn't she?)
(Maybe I should take her somewhere instead of leaving her stranded out here in the hallway...)

options.content: If you want to bask in the sun, the hallway's not the best place for that.

scripts.say: A d-date? Do you really enjoy such... physically and emotionally draining ordeals?
Ehh... I'm not opposed to that, but going outside is a pain.
But maybe... with you, it might not be so bad...
Then again, I don't wanna get up.
But at the same time, I don't wanna miss out on this opportunity either since you're always busy... Maybe if you could arrange a ride for us.
Bleh, I'm already getting exhausted just thinking about it...
So, wanna go or not?
Errrhhhhmmm... Fine, I'll go!

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>The Ghost Ship and the Sleeping Treasure</size>

scripts.say: I chatted casually with Whydah as we walked, and we soon found ourselves in the bustling shopping district.
Oh... Commander, look over there~
I look in the direction that she is pointing, and see a big sign labeled, "Hyper-Realistic Escape Room".
...Who let the green cat cook again this time?
Akashi is a very hard worker, you know. The amount of work she puts into the promo materials is so impressive it's almost sickening.
Let's take a look-see... The current theme is... Ah, yes. "The Ghost Ship and the Sleeping Treasure".
Sounds like something you'd be good at. Wanna give it a shot?
Ehhh... I much prefer lounging around doing nothing to being a swashbuckling pirate, though.
A soft, warm bed, an unlimited supply of games to play... Truly, the best kind of life, without ever having to worry about storms.
But having that said... I might be a little interested in that completion bonus...
"Super-Mega-Exclusive Potato Crisps Set," "Pirates' Kitchen: Don't Fall in Love Together, Collector's Edition"...
And this "Instant-Sleep Human-and-Shipgirl-Tested Ergonomic Pillow"...
All of these are mega-limited items that are no longer in circulation.
But, why can I only choose one thing? Surely some of these aren't even worth anything!
I can't deciiiiide!
You really shouldn't count your chickens before they hatch.
Hmm? Does that mean you're also up for the challenge?
I'm sure it'll pose no difficulty to the mighty Whydah, but still, what a pain.

options.content: Don't you want that Super-Mega-Exclusive Potato Crisps set?
You've got your eyes on that Pirate's Kitchen collector's edition, right?
Wouldn't it be nice to get your hands on that instant-sleep pillow?

scripts.say: Ermm... Well, I suppose it would be hard to procure it through other means.
In that sense, playing this escape room game would be the path of least resistance.
She lifts her head, looks around, then steps closer to me.
Here's my condition. If I get too tired to finish the escape room, it's up to you to carry me across the finish line.
Sure, you can count on me.
And so, I purchase two tickets for the escape room, grab our starting supplies, and then head inside with Whydah in tow.

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>Treasure Hunting Sucks</size>

scripts.say: After passing through a long, dark corridor, we finally arrive at the escape room's titular ghost ship.
Heh, not bad. This pirate ship looks pretty authentic, and is well-made, too.
That's Akashi for you. She doesn't cut any corners when it comes to making money.
That cat really does like making money as much as everyone claims, huh?
But, y'know... Heehee, this place is kinda bringing back old memories.
Commander, let's go have a look arou–
*creaaaaak*
Whydah steps onto the old boards of the ghost ship with unexpected enthusiasm. Just then...
*CRAAAAASH!*
Suddenly, the writhing tentacles of a giant sea monster completely surround the pirate ship.
Woah, I didn't expect this scenario to involve combat!
I guess I was a fool expecting those rare rewards to come easily.
Alright, swing that sword! We're having calamari for dinner tonight!
Ummm... Ahem, of course! I'll cover your back!
Through Whydah's impeccable "support," and her expert use of the tactic, "be as unmoving as the mountain," the battle came to an end smoothly.
Nice going, Commander.

options.content: That's what you'd call a literal 1v9...

scripts.say: Oh. Heehee... Well, it's not like I did much...
Y-yeah, you're just that amazing.
Well, uhh...
I mean... A win's a win, right? You didn't even need my help.
Besides, just because I'm a pirate doesn't mean that fighting's my default modus operandi. It's a pain in the butt... and there are easier ways to get treasure.
*yaaawn*... Anyway, enough about me. Take a look over here. And here, and there, too.
Now that you've defeated the tentacles, new mechanisms have appeared.
Generally speaking, when it comes to these escape rooms, you can exit if you manage to activate all the mechanisms.
I'll take this one over here. I'll be counting on you to do the rest, okay?
Whydah and I make short work of three of the mechanisms, and we arrive at the final one together.
The device is suspended high up in the air, beyond what I can reach even if I jumped. And, there doesn't appear to be any way to climb up either.
What's the plan now?
We can always give up if it's too much of a hassle...

options.content: Let's try coming up with something else.
How about I give you a boost?

scripts.say: Hrmm...
That look on your face... You really don't like being defeated, huh?
Let's see... Uhh, how about you try boosting me up? Maybe that might be enough to do the trick?
She averts her eyes slightly. Even as her oversized pirate hat covers much of her face, it cannot entirely cover the blush that has bloomed all over her cheeks.
It's worth a shot.
(That's right, one of the stipulations of the escape room is that TWO people must participate.)
(Which means that we might literally have to use each other to find a way out.)
If I lift you up, you should be able to reach it, right?
I, uhh... I suppose I don't mind...
She averts her eyes slightly. Even as her oversized pirate hat covers much of her face, it cannot entirely cover the blush that has bloomed all over her cheeks.
But, be careful, okay?
I can take a tumble and be perfectly fine, but try not to hurt yourself.
I approach her from behind and place my hands on her hips.
Ooh...
Sorry, did that hurt?
Nuooooo... H-hurry it up! I wanna get back to my room and laze around...
Alright, I hear you.
I lift her high up into the air, toward the device hanging from the ceiling.
Although, it seems that she isn't used to being picked up by others. She grips my shoulders tightly and starts instinctively squirming and thrashing around.
The hems and sleeves of her loose, airy dress sway with her movements, and every time her clothes brush against my face, her faint yet pleasant scent wafts into my nostrils.
Uhh... I think I've got it.
She reaches for the final mechanism and presses it down. With a loud groan, the hold door that was shut tightly before slowly opens.
Fantastic. Now, we can continue forward.
Ahem...
Mind setting me down first?

options.content: Mhm. Thanks for your hard work.
It'll be more efficient to continue like this!!

scripts.say: I lower her until she can plant her feet on solid ground.
It wasn't particularly hard work or anything...
N-nonsense... It's more efficient if we each move on our own... P-put me down already...
My teasing seems to make her even more flustered.
As you will.
I lower her until she can plant her feet on solid ground.
The petite girl lightly taps her toes against the ground, fixing the oversized shoes that had almost fallen off.
Commander, your hand, please.
Hmm? What's the matter?
We'll need to... further increase our efficiency for the challenges up ahead.
This old-fashioned trap can't hold us back.
You just watch from the sideline. I can take care of the rest.
She takes me by the hand and pulls me toward the back of the room.

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>Storm of Terror!</size>

scripts.say: Oh. This should be it. Go ahead and insert that item from earlier in here... Yup, I think I heard some mechanism moving.
This is all way too easy compared to the real deal in video games.
Come over next time and I'll show you what a real challenge looks like.
*rumble rumble*
The door in the back of the room slides open, but what awaits us is not a welcoming exit, but rather a deck amidst a terrible storm.
But, didn't we do everything that we needed to do? I'm sure I didn't make any mistakes. Maybe there's some hidden component?
As soon as we step out onto the deck, the deafening roar of thunder echoes around us, and we find ourselves engulfed in heavy rain.
Urgh... What an awful storm. I don't like this...
Akashi, you really don't have to be such a tryhard...
(I've never seen her so distressed before... She must really have a bad time with storms.)
I look around the deck in a hurry, finding a small section of overhanging planks that provides some shelter from the rain.
Whydah, head over there and wait for me.
I'll figure out what we have to do here.
Got it... Be careful out there.
I search all over the deck area, but fail to find anything vaguely resembling a clue.
As time passes, the storm around us grows stronger and stronger, causing the pirate ship to rock violently like a leaf caught in a raging flood.
I never knew an escape room could be so dangerous... I just wanna go home and eat potato crisps and play games...
Her voice is becoming fainter and shallower.
There's nothing to be scared of. All of this is just an elaborate set-up. It's not real.
Yeah... I know, but still...
I don't like this at all. I don't want to be in danger...
Despite saying she knows better, she shrinks even further into her oversized coat.

options.content: (Try to comfort her with a hug.)

scripts.say: When I sidle up to her to fold her delicate body into a hug, she suddenly startles as if some life is coming back into her.
Don't be scared. I'm right here with you.
After staying still for a few moments, she regains her composure. Slowly but surely, she tugs gently at the back of my shirt and returns the hug.
You're so warm, Commander... I'm so glad you're here...
(We originally came out here to have a good time, but she is getting more and more miserable with each minute we spend in this storm.)
Let's just give up and get out of here.
However, as soon as she hears the words, "give up." she lifts her head and stares at me for a while.
Then, she rises to her feet, turns toward me, and buries her face in my chest.
We've already made it through so many annoying and tiresome things... so it'd be a pity to give up now.
I think I'll be fine now. As long as I'm in your arms...
Her body, which had been frozen in fear previously, starts to loosen up and relax.
She gets up on tiptoes and tries to nuzzle up against me.
Thank you.
The two of us stay like that, doing nothing except holding each other as closely as we can, all the way until the storm finally dies down.
Huh? The storm... just stopped?
The sun is shining brightly, without a single cloud in the sky. The waves are calm, as if the storm from earlier was nothing but a bad dream.
And just as suddenly, another door appears on the deck.
...Is it finally over?
Yeah, I think so.
Urgh... That storm was pretty scary, but...
Y'know, a game you can beat by staying completely AFK...
That might have some potential...
Now then, shall we continue forward?

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>The Goal is in Sight</size>

scripts.say: As we step through the door, we are greeted by a veritable sea of treasure, as far as the eyes can see.
Wooooah... Anything is possible here, huh...
Huh, this vase... Wait, no. The real thing's sitting in my treasure trove. This is just a replica.
Holy moly, I've always wanted to get my hands on this out-of-circulation game.
And this flavour of potato crisps... It's basically an urban legend!
As I watch her roam the mountain of treasures, I suddenly notice some writing on the wall.
Come take a look at this.
Ehh... What a pain. Mind reading it for me?
"Escape from the ghost ship with the greatest treasure in hand, and you shall be granted the greatest victory."
"The greatest treasure?" What the heck is that?
Hmm... Any guesses?
(This isn't my area of expertise. If anyone's knowledgeable about this stuff, it's got to be her.)
Sorry, I'm drawing blanks here. I think this one's up to you.
How am I supposed to pick just one thing?
Maybe I'll go with the out-of-circulation game after all...
Even as she grumbles, she starts sifting through the mountain of treasure.
Can you really call a game the "greatest"? In terms of monetary value, definitely not...
What about "the greatest," in a literary sense? The most precious? The most influential?
She stops and turns to look at me.
What's the matter?
It's nothing... I think I've made up my mind, though.
She sets down the discontinued game and comes over to take my hand.
Hmm? Not going to choose anything?
I've already made my choice.
Let's go.
Hand-in-hand, the two of us leave the treasure vault through a different door.

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>The Greatest Treasure</size>

scripts.say: The golden glimmer of the treasure vault turns into a mere speck behind us as we head down a long, narrow corridor, until we finally arrive at a modern-looking room.
At the center of the room is a small display stand cordoned off by blue rope, a nearby sign reading, "Treasure Display Area".
Please place your greatest treasure in the designated area.
Hmm... Looks like I'm supposed to put the treasure on this stand...
Well then, Commander, mind standing in the treasure display area for me?
(I see, it all makes sense now. Her greatest treasure...)
Now that I understand what she was trying to say, I quickly walk over and take my place on the stand.
...But, nothing happens.
Please place your greatest treasure in the designated area.
But I've already shown you my treasure...
The Commander is worth more to me than any bauble.
Please place your greatest treasure in the designated area.
What a stupidly designed system, Akashi... The Commander is the greatest treasure to us all. How do you not understand this?
She lets out a soft sigh, then turns toward me with a slight blush on her face.
It's all thanks to you that I was able to come to this port, living a life of peace and comfort, with no storms to worry about...
I'm so glad I was able to meet you, Commander. Thank you for letting me be at your side.
All of this is why... you're my greatest treasure.
See? Do you get it now?
If you don't accept the Commander as my answer, I'm gonna complain and raise a stink. I'll even demand a refund and review-bomb you.
I'm glad I got to meet you, too.
Ugh... Commander, I won't grow taller if you keep doing that.
*sigh*... Well, filing a complaint is too much of a hassle. Let's just get going.
Ahem... The clear conditions are being re-evaluated.
Congratulations, nya! The Commander is indeed the greatest treasure, nya! And that means, you've cleared the game, nya!
*pop pop pop*!
As soon as the announcement that the game has been cleared is made, crackers start to go off all around us, shooting confetti into the air.
Heh-heh. Looks like victory is ours.
Another win for us!

sequence:
Set Sail - Treasure Voyage!

<size=45>The End, or the Beginning</size>

scripts.say: Shortly afterward, at the reward exchange booth...
Brave pirates, please choose your reward!
Ahhhh... Finally, the time has come!
She bounces toward the prize area with an uncharacteristic spring in her step.
Super-Mega-Exclusive Potato Crisps Set, Pirates' Kitchen: Don't Fall in Love Together, Collector's Edition, Instant-Sleep Human-and-Shipgirl-Tested Ergonomic Pillow, and also...
Urgh... I want everything. It's way too hard to choose.
Hmm, actually... Commander, you really did all the heavy lifting back there. It's only fair that you decide.
She leans into me lazily.
Fair enough.

options.content: What about the Pirates' Kitchen collector's edition?
What about the instant-sleep ergonomic pillow?

scripts.say: Hmm... Sounds good. There are some delicious flavours that even money can't buy, after all.
She weighs the luxurious-looking snack pack in her hands, but she still seems reluctant to part with the other treasure.
Hmm... Sounds good. It's a highly-rated two-player co-op game, and the collector's edition is said to come with a legendary recipe that nobody can say no to...
She quietly picks up the collector's edition vintage video game, but she still seems reluctant to part with the other treasure.
Hmm... Sounds good. If it works for me, I'll let you use it, too.
She gently picks up the comfortable-looking pillow, but she still seems reluctant to part with the other treasure.
Fair enough.
Everything here looks quite valuable, so it's hard to choose just one thing...
Right? It's what I said before. Deciding is such a hassle.
Though, that just goes to show that Akashi knows how to attract people with prizes they would want.
That much I can agree with. She does have pretty good taste.
The overall flow of the escape room was well thought-out too.
Huh? Oh...
Yeah, I guess so. There were battles and puzzles... and even hours spent shivering in a fierce storm...
I suppose that averages out to an eleven out of ten~
But, you know, if I want the other two prizes, I'll have to complete the challenge two more times.
Think I can trouble you to endure the storm a few more times?
A-ahem! A heartfelt congratulations to our two brave pirates here!
For your outstanding performance, we are proud to bestow upon you this platinum trophy!
S-so, in other words, all three of today's prizes are yours for the taking, nya!
...Wait, seriously? I had the wrong impression of you after all, Akashi~
Wh-why of course, nya...
Nyahaha... haha... ha...
Aaaaahhhh... Finally, as soon as I get back, I can kick it and sink into this pillow while enjoying these new potato crisps and playing this new game...
What a day it has been... Thanks for everything.
You really should be thanking Akashi's generosity, if anything.
Phew...
As the sun starts to dip beneath the horizon, lights come to life all around us.
She leans into me with a satisfied smile on her face and a lustrous twinkle in her eyes.
Having all that said though, what a pain all of that was~
Well, I guess it's not all bad, going out to have fun with you outside every now and then...

options.content: Same here. I had a great time with you.
Yeah, totally. Today was a ton of fun.

scripts.say: Heehee. Anyway, I think you're pretty awesome, so I hope we can continue to have fun together forever~
By the way, I heard that the escape room game's going to change to a new theme in ten days.
Wanna give it another go after that?
Well, well. I never thought you'd be the one asking me out on a date.
Why not? You're pretty fun to be around, you know?
Besides, I like sitting in the corner and letting you clear the entire stage for me~
I think that's gonna get patched out.
Boooo. Heehee...
Well, I guess we can make up our minds after we take a look at the prizes.
As for right now...
She takes my hand and gives it a good squeeze.
Let's go and play Pirates' Kitchen together!
Hmmf. I thought we'd have time for some chitchat, but it seems we'll have to do it on the move. Admiral Graf Spee has sunk another freight ship.

It's been 9 hours since the last one. Just before they sunk, I received a telegram from the ship. After 2 months of searching, I've now managed to pinpoint Admiral Graf Spee's location. We'd better start giving chase to her.
Hahah, giving chase right away? You never change, huh~ So, where is Spee now?
It seems she's in the Atlantic near the African coast. Mmmm... Hopefully we can find someone worthy of my harassment along the way. It's been a while since I had some fun... Hehe.

Anyway, our objective is the Río de la Plata Estuary. Chart a course for 32 degrees south and 47 degrees west. Remain highly vigilant and maintain formation at cruising speed. ...We may run into some pests along the way.
Now hold on! I've put up with you for months now because you're in charge of this operation...
But here you go again giving us orders you decided on a whim! I want an explanation for why we're doing this!
Wuh-oh. Ajax, don't be too mean to Exeter. She's served longer than you have after all...
Because, Exeter, search missions are boring. Don't you agree? So let's do something else, even if just to kill time... Ahahah♪
Now listen, you!
Wait! Exeter, please calm down! You don't need to fight with her to solve this!
I know she's strange, but she's still the smartest Leander-class, so she won't make us go on a pointless mission... I think... Right, Ajax?

Ahahah. The telegram came from the South Atlantic, and the Río de la Plata is the most prominent route for merchant ships in that area. If you were Graf Spee and wanted to disrupt trade routes, wouldn't you pick a location where you can cause as much damage as possible?
If I were her... that... is where I'd go.
It's good that you understand. Unless I turn out to be wrong, we may even engage enemies on our way there. Ahahah... I hope you won't disappoint me, Graf Spee♪
...Shouldn't we wait for Cumberland?
We don't have the time. Tell her to catch up to us.
...Understood. I'll have faith in your judgement. Just one more thing...
When we're back, I will report everything you've done up to this point to the Admiralty!
Ahahah, do as you wish.
Aha, hahah, I guess you two are starting to get along...
You call this "getting along"?!
I can't believe it, there really is an Iron Blood fleet out here... I hate admitting it, but it seems you were right. We should hurry to the Río de la Plata Estuary and sort them out.
Sorry, girls, but I can't let you pass.
Ahahah... you must be a Z-class, no?
That's right. You're talking to none other than the 1st ship of the Z-class - Leberecht Maass!
It must be tough to have so many sisters.
Tough? Uh, not really. I'm honestly blessed to have so many cute little sisters.
I see. You're a nice big sister to them, just like our sister Leander is to us.
Hey, thanks.
Shouldn't Graf Spee be arriving at the Río de la Plata Estuary any time now?
Yep. ...Wait, you tryin' to make me look dumb?!
Whatever. At any rate, I'm not letting you through!
Ahahah, I must've struck a nerve... Now you're worth toying with... Let's go, Exeter!
Roger! But strangely enough now I can sympathize with Z1...
Graf Spee has sunk many ships, but she always lets their crews get to safety first... Seeing as she plays nice, I'll let you off the hook now.
Guh... You're a twisted sadist... but... at least you're not all bad...
I think she has lost consciousness. Is it really okay to leave her like this?
As much as I love having more toys to play with... we can't fight Graf Spee with the burden of a captive on our backs.
Or does the "honour of the Crown" dictate that you tow her all the way home?
People like you are just... Ugh, fine! We're moving on.
Now, let me explain the plan.
I'm all ears!
The plan...?
Surely you don't believe that just the three of us... can pin down an enemy of her caliber? That's not an option, Ms. Exeter. You have a brain, please use it more often~
You... Calm down, Exeter, control yourself... Deep breaths... Sigh... Okay, explain it to me.

Ahahah, it's simple, really. Should we encounter Graf Spee during daytime, you will break from formation and flank her. But if we encounter her during night then I guess you won't need to flank her, just keep ample distance from her.
So one of us acts as a decoy while another launches an attack on her... Won't our firepower lack any real punch that way, though?
Sinking Graf Spee is not our objective. Have you forgotten that already?
...Very well. You're right. I'll follow your orders.
Ahahaha~! Now that we have a plan, let's mop up the remnants of the fleet we just fought, then continue the search!
...I was wrong. You aren't merchant ships, you're... hunters...

Ah, so rather than make use of your cannons' range, you decided to draw closer... Oh ho... you mistook us for yesterday's convey, didn't you? Ahahah, I didn't think the notorious Graf Spee would be so careless...
...Even so... you can't defeat me.
I wouldn't be so sure about that!
Flanking me, huh... You must think you're so clever!
You don't know if something is clever until you try it. ...Let's get her, Achilles.
Aye-aye, ma'am!
Dammit... You leave me no choice...
You're not going anywh—AGGGHHH...!
Oh my god! Exeter, are you okay?!
...Guh... Looks like... she got...
Hm? She's turning to flee...
I see... Exeter, you should head straight back home for repairs. Achilles and I will pursue Graf Spee.
Wait. She's getting away, but just the two of you can't... Argh, I can... I'm gonna... ram the bastard.... It will be the end of us... but it will sink her too!
In your current state, you'll only be a hindrance to us. And you can still be repaired. That's just how it is. Besides...
I'm not going to concede the feat of sinking Graf Spee that easily.
But...!
Ahahah. How about worrying about your own wellbeing before that of others?
...Very well... I will pray for your success.
But... it's just the two of us now... you saw what she did to Exeter... and two of your turrets don't function... are we really going after her?
Of course we are. Please remember that our allies are right behind us.
Even if we're not able to sink her, if we can severely damage and corner her then our blockade will prevent her from returning to drydock for repairs.
If we can achieve that, we win. And if we can bring her down on our own, we won't even need to ask the others for help.
So... this was your plan all along, wasn't it? You even let Z1 go because you counted on our blockade up ahead to stop both her and Graf Spee, right?
It wasn't. If a blockade was all that was needed to contain Graf Spee... then we need not have gotten involved in the first place.
Besides, now we're rid of that oversized paperweight that was slowing us down. And if she's in so much pain, she won't be able to leave the docks for some time.
After all, our objective is to take down Graf Spee. No more.
So that's why you had Exeter leave... But won't she totally hate you if you tell her that? She nearly sunk today.
I don't care. People like her are just fun to mess around with.
Right-o, then since you're my friend, I'll just go along with it!

You know, if I had to sacrifice someone either way, I could've given a good reason for you to retreat as well. Anyway, judging from Graf Spee's escape route, we might be able to easily beat her on our own.
Huh? Really?
That depends on if we can trick her into doing what we want, of course.
Yeah, true!
And lastly... A-Achilles, thank you for... b-being you!
Ajax? ...Aw, look at you, being all timid~ You never change, silly girl.
Ahahah, how does it feel to be forced into a fight with us?
Allow me to remind you: while I'm sure you were hoping to dock at a neutral port, there are Royal Navy freighters here.
How unfortunate. All you had to do was choose another port, then you would have put us in a tight spot...
I'm surprised you planned this far ahead... But I wonder: why are you so confident that you can defeat me?
WE don't plan on defeating you. A half dozen more capable people are on their way here to do that... like Ark Royal, or Renown, just to name a few.
In short: all that we had to do was to slow you down.
...I see. What a flawless plan you've devised...
Though, because you've been so gracious and allowed all the merchant ship crews to escape, we'll let you live if you surrender now. I swear it on the honour of the Royal Navy.

...If you think I'll go down by your hands just as you'd hoped, know I won't let you do that... There is no reason for me to harm you... or any of the innocent people at this port, simply to entertain an impossible fight...
Persistent even to the end... Who would've thought she'd scuttle herself... Now she's gonna make us look like the bad guys!
...There's no such thing as a good or bad side in war, Achilles.
We don't have any need for Cumberland to come anymore... I'll just inform our allies that... Graf Spee has been sunk.
Alright. Then we should start heading... Ajax? You okay?
Go on ahead, I'll catch up with you.
...Alrighty then. I'll take it slow so you've got time.
Yeah, sure.
In reality, Cumberland was the only one behind us. I lied about Ark Royal and Renown, you see. Ahahah...
But even supposing you were to defeat us, your defeat would have been set in stone the moment you docked at this port.
...It's not like me to be emotional in front of my fallen enemies like this. When I get back home, I'm going to harass Exeter some more.
But still, I'm grateful, Admiral Graf Spee. It's thanks to you that I managed to have such an... enjoyable time. Ahahah...
"Some stories have fuzzy beginnings, others have ambiguous endings. As for this one, well..."
KABOOOM!
An ambush?! Hey, Helena, you okay?!
I'm fine... But they got away with the goods we were transporting again...
What the heck is their deal? That's the third time this week!
We'll run all out of candy if they keep stealing from us!
You know what that means! We've got to fight fire with fire!
It's time to teach the evil candy thief a good lesson!
F-first we need information, though. We can't catch the thief if we don't know where they are.
I have a plan! I'll take the mass-produced ships and reinforce the convoy carrying the candy.
Helena, contact the other factions in the meanwhile. Nobody's gonna like it if we run out of candy!
What about me? What should I do?
You could call Saratoga! If anyone can figure out what's going on, it's her.
Okey-dokey! That's easy peasy!
Hehehe... So much candy, so many snacks...
I should gather even more...
A few days later...
Hey, Helena. I brought the Eagle Union girls along.
And I brought my Royal Navy friends!
Hello. I come bringing support and greetings from Her Majesty.
In the name of love and peace, may our endeavour to prevent the candy shortage be successful.
The Sakura Empire is here too! Gosh, I can't believe the thief has gotten away with it for so long.
As candy becomes more scarce, it'll be harder and harder for me to throw banquets...
The thief has even taken our yummy dangos... We've got to catch them as soon as possible!
Alright, be quiet, everyone! I've got intel to share with you!
Firstly, there's actually two thieves! And I know they're from the Iron Blood. Attacking shipping vessels and stealing candy is just what they'd do!
See, I was playing in the sea just the other day and saw Eugen trading candy with some other girl!
Then, while I was distracted by Eugen, the other girl snuck up from behind and attacked me...
I heard a big boom, then fell asleep! And when I woke up, they were both gone!
Interesting... Thanks for the helpful info.
Now we know Eugen is one of the thieves, but who's the other? I can't think of any–
Big trouble, everyone! The shipping vessels transporting the candy are under attack!
The mass-produced ships are engaging 'em right now! I'm headed there now, but I need backup!
Get over here as soon as you can! This is our chance to catch the thieves!
There you are, candy thief! We've got you now!
Yeah, heheh! You should just surrender now. Play nice and we'll hear what you have to say in jail.
Lower your weapons and hand over the candy! If you don't, we'll have no choice but to fight you!
You're never getting my candy.
Beer and bratwurst aren't the only important things in life. Candy is, too. You all just don't understand that.
That's why I came up with a plan... A plan to fill the ocean with candy and snacks!
And I'm so close to achieving it.
All I need is a little more candy, then candy will cover the whole ocean. Nobody can stop me now!
I... I don't know what her deal is, but I do know she's up to no good!
Obviously candy is important, but the ocean is just as important!
The ocean is where we live and play. It's our home, and it's where we're safe!
We're not gonna let you get away with this!
F-fine, then we'll fight it out. I'm just as strong as you. Don't blame me if you get hurt and cry!
Aim more carefully, girls! You're hitting the shipping vessels by mistake!
That wasn't any of us! It's Spee! She's sinking the vessels!
Oh no! The candy is leaking into the ocean!
Hmm... Is it just me, or does the water taste sweet?
*gulp*... You're right.
Don't do that, Amagi! Salt water is bad for you!
What the...? What've you done, Spee?!
All I wanted was to make the ocean sweet... That was my dream...
And if my dream can't be real...
Then I'll become one with the ocean! I'll go to my dream world where everything tastes like candy!
Wait! Don't!
Farewell, protectors of the sea!
"And so, the girls put a stop to Spee's plan to sweeten the world's oceans."
"Even to this day, you'll sometimes find candy resurfacing from the spot where Spee went under. The area has become a popular port tourist attraction."
"While some say Spee lived happily ever after in her candy world, others say Eugen came and rescued her."
"Whichever the case, the fact is that nobody has seen Spee for quite some time."
"Some stories have fuzzy beginnings, others have ambiguous endings. As for this one, well, it ends here."
The End

sequence: Featuring: Little Spee
Clevelad, Little Enterprise, Lena, Li'l Sandy, Little Saratoga?
Little Renown, Little Illustrious, Little Cheshire
Akagi-chan, Hiei-chan, Amagi-chan
Nobody was harmed in the making of this story. All the girls were given candy as thanks for their participation.

The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>1 Project Glorify the Office</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
The afternoon sunlight pours through the window, coloring the stack of files on my desk a soft gold.
As I blankly stare at the pile of papers, there's a modest knock on the door.
Come in.
The door opens, and inside steps Vittorio Veneto with her usual graceful demeanor, carrying a tea set.
Good afternoon, Commander. I hope I'm not disturbing you with this sudden visit.
Ah, Veneto. What brings you here?
Nothing in particular. I simply thought it would be a shame to not spend this tranquil afternoon with a like-minded individual.
She places a fragrant cup of tea in front of me.
I've brought Sardegnian herbal tea and some of my finest treats. Hopefully they are to your taste.
Not one to turn down her gracious offer, I put down my pen and decide to savor some afternoon tea with her.
The flavors of mellow tea and gently sweet desserts fill my mouth, almost instantly soothing my nerves. They strangely clear my head, too.
Heehee. Your expression tells me that you appreciate the importance of taking a break.
It might have something to do with the unique aura you have. It's like you make everything around you more graceful, more relaxing.
You're too kind. That said, what you feel is likely a reflection of Sardegna's philosophy, rather than any special trait of mine.
In other words, our Empire's glory lies not only in the wake of its battleships, but also in its leisurely approach to everyday life.
There are more ways to exemplify our glory than just cannon fire. It can be shown through the pursuit and enjoyment of art, life, and beauty as well.
When you put it like that, it makes me want to experience what "Sardegnian glory" is like firsthand.
A twinkle gleams in her eyes, like some sort of switch inside her flipped.
Is that so? Do you truly mean that?
Uh... Well, yeah.
That being the case, allow me to show it to you.
It's the next day – a day off – and Veneto comes to me with a beautifully bound book.
What's with the book?
It's an itinerary I made for you. An itinerary for experiencing Sardegnian glory.
An itinerary, huh? Let's see... Morning, a tour around the Sardegnian garden, with a break to enjoy handmade desserts. Noon, a stroll along the beach promenade. Afternoon...
Veneto, don't you reckon this schedule's just a little packed?
You needn't worry about that. This is the most basic itinerary I assembled after several adjustments and revisions.
This is "basic" in your eyes?
Why, yes. It would be quite meaningless to only experience Sardegnian glory at a superficial level, after all!
If you're ready, shall we start at once?
Like... Right now?
Strike while the iron is hot, as they say. The desserts are waiting for you, Commander.

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>2 A Lovely Time in the Garden</size>

scripts.say: Port - Garden
Nice place you've got... It has a very different vibe to the rest of the port's gardens.
I'm honored to hear that. This garden isn't just a slice of wild nature, but rather a product of intent and aesthetics.
Interesting. Are you saying Sardegnian glory comes from order and control?
That is true in part, but not entirely. This way, if you would.
Veneto guides me to a patch of flowers whose colors create a beautiful gradient.
It'd be dull if everything were strictly controlled. This gradient, from subdued to vibrant, is akin to how we naturally express ourselves – it presents a layer of passion.
True glory lies in the balance between reason and emotion, you see.
Huh. Now I feel like I'm looking at more than just a garden...
Heehee. Enjoying your surroundings while contemplating philosophy – doesn't it feel classy? If you would, lean in close and relish the fragrance of Sardegnian glory.
This one has a lot of depth... It doesn't smell sweet like any regular rose.
Indeed. It carries not just Sardegna's beauty, but also the weight and cost of its glory.
As she says that, she leads me to the marble gazebo at the heart of the garden.
Plates of sweets are lined up inside. The backdrop of the garden only makes them look even more delectable.
Now, let's indulge our taste buds. Would you mind sharing your initial impressions?
Hmm... Fragrant, with notes of wheat. It smells really tasty.
I knew you'd pick up on those. Having the discernment to detect subtle flavors is seen as a valuable talent in the Empire.
Next, let's enjoy this biscotti along with some tea and–
Ah! Please wait! It seems I've made a mistake!
Hm?
The next moment, the intense smell of wasabi assaults my nostrils.
*cough*! *cough*!
Commander! My apologies!
I look at her face as she hastily extends a cup of water to me. Her cheeks are flushed red with embarrassment.
How careless of me not to have checked... I've never been so embarrassed before.
I'm... fine...
Guess when Sardegnian glory has an accident, things really go south...
You must forgive me. Please, have some cannoli and zabaione to cleanse your palate. They will smooth over the intense taste.
Hmm... The shell is crunchy, and the cream inside is refreshing and not too sweet.
It's delightful to hear you like it. I like to say that a bit of sweetness is essential for keeping morale up.
Sounds like you're saying that to have Sardegnian glory, you've got to have desserts.
That's exactly it. Well, shall we continue with the itinerary? The salty breeze of the sea is calling for us.
Besides, a good walk helps settle the stomach, allowing us to savor the aftertaste of the desserts even longer.

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>3 The Resonance of Art</size>

scripts.say: Port - Art Museum
We stand before a large oil painting depicting an ancient naval battle. Veneto's eyes glitter quietly.
Commander, if I may take your eyes off of the grand sea for a minute, please have a look at the ship.
Battered though it may be, isn't it like a silent yet epic poem?
An epic poem?
Yes. It speaks of storms, ropes, the flow of time, and loyalty.
True. I get a sense of unwavering strength coming from it.
Heehee. You're getting quite into the mood of things.
Please have a look at this painting next. Can you tell what the painter wanted to express?
Quiet... and peace. It's calming to look at.
Yes! This is what "silent glory" is all about.
Sardegnian art is not just about quiet duty and roaring strength. We also pride ourselves on the profound grace that breathes through tranquility.
Veneto goes on to explain everything from techniques of light and shadow, to color psychology, to the historical background and even the life of the painter.
Despite my best efforts, it's all too much to take in. My gaze drifts from the intricate brushstrokes on the paintings to Veneto's face, and especially her eyes, brimming with passion.
...In other words, this seemingly unsophisticated "gold color" actually utilizes a quite old technique...
Her words come to a sudden stop. The next thing I know, she's looking at me quietly.
Commander, was my explanation... a little long-winded?
It's not that, I just... couldn't keep up with how enthusiastic you were.
My apologies. I got a bit carried away. I'd forgotten how spontaneous this trip was, and that you'd been working until yesterday.
She vaguely frowns and looks at my face.
You must be exhausted. Admiring all these paintings must've been a tiring affair for you.
Yeah, maybe. I think I've hit my learning cap for today. First the garden, now the museum... My brain's been firing on all cylinders this whole time.
I understand. It appears I tried to cram too much knowledge about glory into your head.
That being the case, what your overworked brain needs now is rest.
I propose that we head somewhere where you can relax.
But then your itinerary will go to waste.
With a smile, she shakes her head.
You needn't concern yourself with that. One way to express Sardegnian glory is to adapt to the wishes of your guests.
We have a certain way of relieving fatigue in Sardegna that you may find surprising.
You mentioned a place we can relax... What is it?
Follow me and you will see. It will soothe both your body and spirit♪

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>4 Bathing Prep</size>

scripts.say: Port - Thermae
The moment the door opens, I'm hit by a burst of steam carrying aromatic fragrances and the faint scent of minerals.
Vapor rises from pools of all sizes, drifting and fluttering as though to tempt me to soak.
Is this what you meant by a Sardegnian place to relax? It's like something lifted straight out of a Sardegnian bathhouse.
Heehee. Your praise is much appreciated. It shows that our hard work has paid off.
As I was going to say... The act of bathing is a way to clean ourselves, but that's not all it is.
Veneto takes a few steps forward, and brushes aside some of the humid air with her arm.
It is a ritual, and a philosophy that allows both body and spirit to be purified, relaxed, and reborn, all at the same time.
Now, before we go in...
I'd like to assist you in getting changed.
Hold on! I can do that myself perfectly fine.
Heehee. There's no need to be shy. This is an essential element of the experience.
Might I add, having a staff member assist with your pre-bath preparations is a vital part of our hospitality. It serves to honor your noble status and ensures you have the most enjoyable bath.
You are a distinguished guest who I invited, so therefore...
She takes another step toward me. A gentle yet unwavering will flickers in her eyes, and she gives me a smile that won't take no for an answer.
May I ask you to momentarily treat me not as the flagship of the Sardegnian fleet, but rather as your personal guide to our glory?
Well... Alright.
Thank you.
She undoes the button on my collar. Her cool fingers graze the back of my neck, tickling me ever so slightly.
That's it – just relax. You'll get used to it and grow to like this process soon enough.
Okay...
Allow me to handle everything for you. Trust is the basis for all types of enjoyment.
After taking off my coat and carefully hanging it on a nearby rack, she places her hand on my shirt.
Commander, you're tensing up. You won't be able to fully relax in the bath if you stay this stiff.
I'm trying to relax. I really am.
Heehee. My, your back is more muscular than it looks.
It's clear that you've not neglected your exercise. That's excellent.
Yeah, well, my job makes me run all over the place.
That's wonderful. Your willingness to spare no effort and get out there yourself is proof of your capability as a leader.
As our exchange continues, she strips me of one garment after the next.
There. Just one more to go and–
Ahem! Thanks, but I'll do that myself.

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>5 Permeating Warmth</size>

scripts.say: Thermae - Pool
I return to the public bath from the dressing room. Veneto, soaking in the pool, notices me, and extends a hand to me.
Please join me, Commander.
She gives me a gracious smile. The steam obscures the solemn demeanor that she as the Sardegnian flagship usually exhibits.
The water is warm. It'll clean your body and relieve your fatigue.
Taking her extended hand, I slowly descend the steps into the water.
In just moments, its warmth envelops my entire body.
My stiff muscles relax, and all the pent-up fatigue escapes through my pores and vanishes into the hot currents.
Ooohhh...
Veneto sees the look on my face, and her lips form a contented smile.
It seems the water was just the right temperature for you. If you would, please lean on the pool's rim.
That's it. Submerge yourself deeply. Let the water embrace you, and feel the comfort it brings to your heart.
The rim is smooth, warm, and comfortable. Both of us lean against it, soaking in the water up to our chests.
Calm ripples spread across the water's surface while the current beneath gently caresses my body. It dawns on me that it's completely silent, save for the sound of the water and our breathing.
I'm guessing you're pretty fond of this place.
That I am. It's one of the most private, relaxing locations around the port.
It lets you forget your troubles, leave your duties behind, and become one with the warm water.
Ahh... There's no better thing for soothing the soul, is there?
Yeah, sure feels like it.
Incidentally, Commander, would you like to experience the ultimate enjoyment of Sardegnian thermae?
There's something even better than this?
Of course. Have a look.
She points toward a small bathtub and a small booth with wooden walls.
That is a cold bath. I adore using it after a long soak in a hot pool. The water is nice and cool, and it's sure to rouse you.
And that next to it is a sauna. We Sardegnians often use it for its skincare benefits.
Also, have you noticed the aroma in the air around here?
Oh yeah, now that you mention it, it smells like fruit and flowers.
Well, on the other side of that wall, there's a private room where you can get a wonderful aromatherapeutic massage. It's actually what I think is the most relaxing place here.
Should you follow our ancient bathing rituals, you might be able to–
Her words stop for just a moment as she looks at me. A hint of remorse seeps into her voice.
You must forgive me, Commander. Here I am, getting ahead of myself and placing unnecessary burdens on you...
Allow me to compensate you by making a course adjustment to today's itinerary.
Her cheeks begin to take on a soft red hue, possibly due to the steam.
Let's forget about this "experience Sardegnian glory" business. Instead, we'll do as your body and spirit dictate.
I'll employ a more direct, more soothing method to let you feel authentic Sardegnian relaxation.
We're doing something different?
Yes. There'll be no more itinerary or plan, and no need to work your brain. This other method is focused just on physical touch.
I hope that you'll enjoy it, Commander♪

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>6 Fingertip Rhythm</size>

scripts.say: Thermae - Massage Room
After a long, warm soak in the pool, Veneto brings me to a private massage room.
The ambiance is dim and soft. Only an aroma lamp off to the side and some warmly colored lights serve to illuminate the room.
Please lie face down on this rock bed, Commander. It has a temperature control system underneath that'll keep it at a relaxing warmth.
Doing as she asks, I lie down on the thick, white towel that covers the bed. The fluffy towel envelops my face, and just the right amount of warmth seeps through the rock bed.
Now, allow me to demonstrate what a traditional aroma massage from Sardegna is like.
This massage will help relax your muscles, while the aroma and the rhythmical movement of my hands will relieve your spirit.
I adjust my posture, after which she takes off my bathrobe and goes to fetch a few glass bottles.
The bottles each contain differently colored liquids that shine with a pretty luster under the light.
You may pick whichever fragrance you like.
This is calming lavender, which improves your sleep quality, and this is citrus, which lightens your mood and helps you relax. They're both perfect for clearing your mind and restoring your energy.
Ah, so you choose the energizing citrus blend.
You must have more vigor left in you than I thought. Or perhaps you're asking me to accompany you a little longer?
Heehee – well, as you wish. I hope this refreshing scent of citrus will rid you of your last traces of gloom, like Sardegna's sunlight.
A wise choice. It's perfect for someone who truly wants to rest.
Its mild, floral aroma will embrace you like a mother's lullaby at night.
Close your eyes, please. Let the sleepiness gently come over you.
After I've chosen a fragrance, she doesn't immediately start the aromatherapy. Rather, she leans over and brings her face next to my ear.
This is the most crucial step. Sardegnian massagists have a custom of removing any clothes that might interfere with their meticulous work...
Therefore, I must ask you to not turn around for any reason during this. Do you understand?
She speaks with a tone that allows no objections.
O-okay.
There's the sound of her bathrobe coming off, along with the faint trickle of running water. I close my eyes.
Slowly, the aroma fills the room's air, and I instinctively draw a deep breath.
Please relax. Allow me to handle your body, breathing, and everything else.
If you start to feel ill, or if you'd like me to go harder or softer, then don't be afraid to let me know.
Her warm hands coated with aromatic oil touch my back, which sends a shudder up through my spine.
Please, take it easy, Commander. Try to match your breathing to my rhythm.
Let the tension in your body go...
With slow but firm motions, she starts massaging my back, her fingers gliding over my skin and working the oil in.
So stiff... It's proof of just how long you've sat at your desk.
You really should take better care of yourself, Commander. For your own sake and mine.
Pushing, kneading, pressing, and spreading, her strength penetrates deeply into my body as her skillful massage continues.
After a dash of dull pain, a refreshing sensation like nothing I've felt before fills me all at once.
This is amazing...
Heehee. What you're about to feel will be even better.
She slowly runs her fingertips down both sides of my spine.
Don't be alarmed. It will start feeling good before you know it.
To tell you the truth, Commander... I'm overjoyed that I get to touch and take care of you like this.
Please remember it, because this is a service I wouldn't offer to anyone else...
The sheer comfort makes my mind turn hazy and renders my body unable to move.
All I can do is feel the rhythm of her fingers, moving back and forth like waves onto the shores of my body, washing away all my fatigue, stress, and tension.
So, please, enjoy it to its fullest...

sequence:
The Guide to Sardegnian Glory

<size=45>7 More Advanced</size>

scripts.say: Thermae - Large Pool
That massage completely reinvigorated me. Afterward, Veneto and I went back for another soak in the warm pool.
Ahh... Feels like a huge weight has come off my shoulders.
The unrivaled sense of relaxation makes me unconsciously close my eyes and melt into the steaming water.
Commander...
Yeah?
Heehee – you look like you're having the time of your life.
Sure am. It's been ages since I experienced something this soothing.
Seeing you this relaxed brings me a lot of joy.
I've given it some thought... and I realized that I was too focused on showing you things today. I planned all those activities, yet I neglected to think about your enjoyment.
Looking at you now, it's finally dawned on me that when it comes to glory, making you happy is far more important than just showing you things.
