I'll sing you the song I've been most obsessed with. Listen closely, and etch the song in your heart.
With that, Ulrich began singing while playing on her guitar. Immediately, I became captivated by her beautiful singing voice...

sequence:
Quintessential

<size=45>4. Cause for Concern</size>

scripts.say: Port - Exercise Area
If I remember correctly, Ulrich was supposed to be participating in an exercise today...
Is everyone ready? Then, let us begin our mock battle.
Come at me! I'll show you what's good!
Hey, Hipper, don't go so far ahead of the rest of the team! Slow down and match our pace!
Though Ulrich and Friedrich belonged to the same ship class, Ulrich followed Friedrich's orders during the mock battle while keeping an attentive eye on the other participants.
My eyes were glued to the mock battle until the very end, and at some point, it seemed that Ulrich had noticed my presence.
So you were watching us.

options.content: "Looks like the exercise went very well."

scripts.say: If you say so. To be honest, I don't like fighting... But if that's what's necessary to bring back my allies safely during a real battle, I'll do it.
By the way, do you not need me back on secretary duties? I can head back to the office if you need me.
"I appreciate it, but there really isn't much going on right now."
Above all else though, Ulrich surely must've been tired from having to learn a lot of new duties. I wanted her to take this opportunity to rest.

options.content: "Really, don't worry about it. Go and rest up."

scripts.say: If you say so...
Huh... Was I really showing signs of fatigue, or is the Commander simply that perceptive?
My child is correct. You've earned your rest. But more importantly, you should focus on yourself first and foremost.
So you were listening in on us, Friedrich.
I heard you became the secretary. While this may not be the case, my child may have come here out of concern for your well-being.
But that worry is misplaced. Just like you, Ulrich is neither weak nor fragile.
Just know that excessive kindness can be just as much of a poison as it is a medicine. Do understand that before you imbibe it.
Leave it. You're just going to confuse the Commander.
Listen, I don't need you to look after me. Just let me know if things get busy.
If you wait until you're already swamped, it'll be too late.

sequence:
Quintessential

<size=45>5. Work, Work, and More Work</size>

scripts.say: An incident occurred the day before Ulrich was supposed to resume her post as secretary.
A veritable mountain of paperwork had appeared on my desk. I had no idea why so much work would come in at a time like this, or how I was going to deal with it...
Hmph... So what's all this stuff on your desk, Commander?
I didn't expect you to be the kind of person to do something like this, but... surely you didn't completely slack off while I was taking my break.
Ulrich, who had entered the office without my notice, was now staring at me intently.
Easy now. It's just a joke.

I happened to be walking down the hallway when I saw large amounts of paperwork being transported into your office like a cruel, ironic joke. So I decided to swing by out of curiosity, and lo and behold.
Things might look bad now, but they're only going to get worse by the minute if you keep staring off into space.
Before I could even respond, Ulrich had already grabbed a stack of papers off the desk.
The clock had just passed 1300. Ulrich, who had been working in silence up until now, suddenly stood up.
*slam*
Commander, let's take a short break.
Ulrich pulled out an energy drink and slammed it onto the desk, using her waist to support a cabinet of files she had finished herself.
All done over here. I'll take these files down to their respective departments, so you can go take a nap.
Don't worry, I'll be back before you're up. If that's not enough assurance for you...
For the second time, she pulled an alarm clock out of nowhere and set it down in front of my face.
Here, I'll set an alarm for you. Use this.
There was still too much work to get through. Even if I wanted to take a nap, that would better be saved for after I was done with these documents...
Use your brain for a sec and look at how much work is still left. You wouldn't be able to finish it all even if you wanted to, so rest up for now and wait until I come back.
"That sounds nice, but I don't want you working until late in the evening when it's supposed to be your day off."
I already told you, don't worry about me. Besides, I'm choosing to help you.
I'd feel even worse if I pushed all my work onto her, especially after hearing that. So, I guess I can try to power through.
In the dead silence of the office, I continued to work by myself.
Don't worry, I'll be back before you're up. If that's not enough assurance for you...
That's right... I can't burden her with this kind of stuff... I've got to hang in there...
...But I'm so tired, I can't keep my eyes open...
––*thud*
...Out cold, huh. What a dumbass. A kind, considerate dumbass.
As my consciousness slipped away, I thought I could hear Ulrich's voice again, complaining about something.

sequence:
Quintessential

<size=45>6. Sing for You</size>

scripts.say: Beep beep! Beep beep!
When I regained my senses, I was no longer in the office. I was back in my room.
...Ah, you're alive, Commander.
You passed out on the desk while working. If I left you there, you would've gotten a cold and been out of commission for the next couple days.
So, I brought you back to your room. Imagine how worried Friedrich and the others would've been if they found out.

What's the point of having a secretary ship in the first place if you're just going to work until you pass out? Besides, even if I was on vacation, how would I be able to relax if something happened to you?
In any case, just forget about this work thing and rest up. For real this time.
Ulrich looked genuinely upset for once, and I stopped trying to get out of bed.
...By the way, you hungry at all?
Just as she said that, I noticed a delicious smell permeating through the room.
I see. I made some Eintopf earlier for you. Here, dig in.
Ulrich helped me sit upright in my bed.
Fwoo... Fwoo... Here, open up.

options.content: "It's fine, I can do it myself..."

scripts.say: Finally behaving yourself, huh. Alright, have another bite.
I don't think you can. Your hands are still shaking. Just behave and do as I say.
Ulrich ended up feeding me the entire bowl of stew.
I never had anything like it before. All I could say about her homemade meal was... "Wow, that was delicious."
...I'm glad.
Just rest now. Don't make the rest of us worry about you.
Don't even think about work. As I said, I'll figure something out. Anything I can't take care of, I'll save until tomorrow.
I felt like she was going a bit overboard to look after me, but... I suppose it's her win. Even so...
I took a sideways glance at her as she sifted through the remaining documents.
What, still can't fall asleep? Tch, what a pain in the ass.
Saying that, she came back over to the bed and sat down by my side.
...Here, let me sing for you.
Ulrich's gentle voice filled the room as she began to sing a gentle lullaby for me.

sequence:
Quintessential

<size=45>7. Behind It All</size>

scripts.say: The next morning...
Zzz... Zzz...
When I woke up, Ulrich was sound asleep on the sofa. By the looks of things, she had worked through the night.
She wanted to make things easier for me, but in the process, took everything upon herself. I wonder if that was also a side-effect of being unable to express herself properly...
Nnh... You're awake, Commander? How do you feel?
I see. That's a relief...
Ulrich let out a loud sigh of relief, before giving me a stern look.

That said, I could tell from the way you pushed yourself to your breaking point yesterday... that it wasn't your first time doing something like that. That wouldn't have happened to you in the first place if you didn't overwork yourself habitually.
"But I don't think I push myself that hard normally..."
Hmph, how oblivious can you be? You're absolutely hopeless... Before you can look out for other people, you need to be able to take care of yourself.
Besides, if you really wanted to learn more about me, you could've gone about it with more finesse.
"...Guess I'm busted."

No shit, I could see your intent from miles away. Doesn't take the sharpest tool in the shed to figure it out when you're following me around on my day off. One step over the line and you'd pretty much be a stalker.
"...Was it that obvious?"
Well, yeah. But even if you were a stalker, I probably wouldn't hold it against you.
So, you got to observe me for a day. What'd you think?
I thought back to the time I was following her around.
"You're always looking out for your allies... Even though you might come off as only caring about yourself––"
"You actually care more about them, perhaps even more than others do."
After hearing my honest opinion, she turned away and fell into a deep silence.
No, not really... It's just...
Guess I ended up drinking that poison anyway even though I wasn't ready...
Gosh, my head's a mess right now... I don't even know what to think right now. Feels like your curse is running through my veins.
...In any case, all I need you to know is, I count you as one of those allies now. You can ask me for help next time, before all this happens.
Hmph. That's settled then...
And as if nothing had happened, Ulrich silently walked over to the door, preparing to exit the office.
Oh, and I forgot to mention one thing–
Yesterday afternoon, the two of us went to the exercise area to observe the mock battle. Then, you came back to your room. Nothing else happened.
If anyone asks, especially Friedrich, tell them absolutely nothing.
Especially that part about us spending the night together after I sang you to sleep...

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>1 A Forgotten Promise</size>

scripts.say: After struggling through a hellish amount of work, I finally found myself bathed in the light at the end of the tunnel – a day off, with no forms to fill out and no messages to respond to.
...or so I thought.
Why am I sitting in front of my desk at the office again... Has work found its way into the very core of my existence?
...I might as well get some work done.
Should I try to get a head start on next week's work, or enjoy what little time I have off... What to do...
Just as I'm about to come to a decision, I suddenly hear someone knocking at the door.
Huh? Joffre?
The girl standing at the entrance gives a slight nod before marching right up to me.
...Mm. Looks like you managed to wake up early, just as promised.
It would appear that I've underestimated your resolve. Please accept my apologies.
(...Promise? Did I have something planned with Joffre?)
Judging from your expression... Alas, you must've completely forgotten about the promise you made to me.
To think that you'd forget about the promise we made last night come the dawning of the new day...
Such sinfulness must be met with swift punishment–
W-wait a sec!
That's right! It's all coming back to me now!
Last night, while I was struggling through my paperwork in a stupor, I think I had some semblance of a conversation with Joffre...
But no matter how hard I rack my brain, I can't recall what came up during that conversation...
Sorry, that was a lie... I actually can't remember anything at all...
I appreciate your honesty. However, as I said before, I cannot simply overlook your sins.
*cough* *cough*... Yes, that's right, could you give me an opportunity to set things straight?
Hmm, that does seem like a just course of action.
In that case, I shall give you a chance to atone for your sins through your actions.
Understood! By the way, what kind of promise did we make again? It seems awfully important...
(Is it just me, or did Joffre just avert her eyes for a second...?)
That's not something I can tell you right now.
First, let us do our morning prayers while there is still time.

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>2 A Prayer of Atonement</size>

scripts.say: And so, I accompanied Joffre to the chapel.
Though we were supposed to be praying together, I actually ended up sitting there on the bench, watching her pray the entire time.
...The Holy Iris' blessings upon you.
She was kneeling on the ground, her two hands clasped together in front of her chest in prayer. The sunlight pouring through the high window cast a brilliant light across her serene features.
That enchanting sight made it seem as if she was radiating piety itself, making me hold my breath out of fear of disturbing the "angel" with eyes closed in front of me.
Mm... That should do it. It's your turn next, Commander.
She opens her eyes and turns her gaze towards me.
Considering that you're not very familiar with the act of prayer, allow me to guide you through the process.
Maybe we shouldn't after all... Y'know, it might be disrespectful and all to just go through the motions...
Hmm, that is true. Since it's not a part of your customs, I shouldn't force it upon you.
As soon as I signal my approval, Joffre grabs my hand.
Try putting your hands together like this.
The angel's hands cover mine and press into them gently.
Mm. Now, whenever you put your hands together, remember the amount of pressure I just demonstrated.
Due to her calm demeanor, it's always hard to tell what Joffre is thinking.
The next step is...
She walks behind me, strokes my cheeks with her slender fingers, then covers my eyes with her palms.
Close your eyes, and repeat after me.
...Okay.
We're so close that if I lean back slightly, I would be able to indulge in the warmth and softness of her touch.
In the name of the Holy Iris...
For whatever reason, Joffre seems to be leaning into me.
As she presses into me, I can feel her warmth deepening against my back, sending electric currents through my body. I completely lose the ability to process her words.
It seems you're having trouble concentrating...
Before I know it, the palms obscuring my vision are lifted, and when I turn around to look at Joffre, she seems to be deep in thought.
As expected, it's difficult to do things you're not accustomed to.
The whole morning prayers thing?
Mm, you can think of it that way.
Now then, a change of venues is in order. Please come with me.
Oh, umm... Okay.
(Joffre is acting a bit strange today after all...)

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>3 The Trial of the Crane Game</size>

scripts.say: The two of us leave the chapel and head towards the port city's shopping mall.
For whatever reason, a row of crane games with cat paw prints are lining the side of the street.
(What is Akashi up to this time...)
Joffre comes to a stop when she walks up to one of the crane game machines, her eyes fixed on the plushies inside.
What are these...?
It would appear that the battle-hardened Angel of the Iris has never seen a crane game before.

options.content: (Do they not have these in the Iris Orthodoxy?)

scripts.say: (––I almost blurted these words out, but caught myself in time.)
(What's important is that I show her how to have a good time.)
Since this opportunity doesn't come around too often, I don't mind showing you the ropes.
...Show me.
So, first, you need to insert a coin here. Then, use this joystick to control the claw.
If you think you've found a good spot, press this button to send the claw down. It's harder than it looks, though, and you'll have to find the right center of gravity to pick up the plushie.
First here... then press here... Understood.
(Wait, why do those plushies... look awfully like me...?)
(What on earth is that green cat up to now...)
I think I get the hang of it. Shall we give it a try, Commander?
Sure, give me a moment to grab some tokens.
I went to convert my money into tokens at an extremely unreasonable exchange rate, and so began my first "trial" of the day with Joffre.
Adjust the position... and find the right timing...
The crane slowly descends, the claw seeming like it would be able to lift the plushie at first, but ultimately barely making it move.
...You're right, it certainly is harder than it looks.
Mind if I try again, Commander?

options.content: (Show Joffre the bucket full of tokens you just exchanged.)

scripts.say: All the tokens in this bucket are all yours. Keep going as long as you'd like to.
With this many chances, I can't settle for any outcome short of complete victory.
Undoubtedly, this is a trial meant to shake my resolve... But, I won't give up so easily.
...One more time!
The number of tokens in the bucket continues to dwindle, but Joffre seems no closer to being able to pass her trial.

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>4 The Truth of the "Promise"</size>

scripts.say: After using up the remainder of the tokens, Joffre shuffled over and sat down next to me on the bench.
As if unable to accept her inability to pass her 'trial,' she hides her face behind the me-shaped plushie in her arms.

options.content: "It takes a while to get the hang of it."

scripts.say: Nobody wins their first time.
(And plus, given that Akashi is the one behind these machines, I'd be more surprised if it wasn't rigged...)
In other words, you never had high expectations for me in the first place?
No, silly. The whole thing's ultimately a game of luck.
I stretch my hand out to ruffle the girl's hair.
Hmm...?
At the end of the day, it's still largely a game of luck, so don't feel bad about it.
A game... of luck?
If you hadn't stepped in to help me at the end, I would've left empty-handed.
*sigh*... Plus, there's no need to try to console me by saying that it's luck. I'm sure that this is heaven's way of reprimanding me...
Reprimanding you?
Yes, for lying to you.
In actuality, you never made any sort of promise to me last night.
The reason I went to your office this morning was just to check if you were there, so I could ask directly if I could spend some time with you...
But when I saw you groggy and half-asleep, I couldn't help but want to play a prank on you.
To be honest, the look on your face at the time was quite endearing. Heehee.
I already had my suspicions when you said you wouldn't tell me what the promise was about.
I thought that might be the case. I just didn't expect you to come clean so soon.
My apologies. I had to come clean sooner or later.
Though I am supposed to be a judge of sins, I ended up being a sinner myself.
(She looked pretty devastated from not being able to grab the plushie...)
Well, let's put that aside and go back to the beginning. Your "redemption" will be seeing things through properly.
But, I originally wanted to go on a date with you... What kind of redemption would continuing that be?
It's fine. At least, you came clean with what you did wrong. I forgive you.
All you have to do is do things over again and show your true intentions to the Holy Iris. Surely, it won't take you long to atone for such a minor transgression.
...There does seem to be some merit in what you said.
Very well then. I shall atone for my sins by doing my utmost for our date.
The angel rises to her feet and walks towards me with her hand outstretched.
Wanna hold hands?
Of course. Since this is a date of redemption... It is only natural that we start by holding hands.
I take Joffre's hands. Immediately, her footsteps seem lighter than before as we head out from the shopping mall.

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>5 The Angel and the Seagull</size>

scripts.say: We continue to walk hand-in-hand, and before long, we arrive on the pier.
Let's head down and feel the sea breeze.
Sure.
A flock of seagulls takes flight from the surface, splashing water in all directions.
Upon seeing this, Joffre immediately spreads the wings on her back to shield me from the incoming seaspray.
What an angel...
I couldn't help but gasp in admiration upon seeing the girl's wings spread beneath the bright sunshine.
Indeed, that is my title.
By the way, Commander, what do you think a canonical angel looks like anyway?
Umm... Someone with wings, dressed in a white gown of some sort, with an angel on their head?
Well, the way I see things, I don't think there's much difference between you and a "real" angel.
Hmm? May I ask how you came to that conclusion?
I guess, uh, the "Angel of the Iris" is an embodiment of purity and justice, one who offers holy words to those in distress.
Isn't that exactly what you are?
But, I...
I press my finger against Joffre's lips, trying to get her to let me finish.
I know what you're about to say, but...
You judge sin for the sake of all that is righteous and good in this world.
You fight hard for the sake of a better tomorrow.
That, in my eyes, is what truly makes you an angel.
And that's the part of you that I respect and love.
Commander, what you just said... sounded a bit like a confession of love.
But... I'm still glad I got to hear you say those words. Heehee.
With a gentle smile on her face, the angel approached me and pressed her head against my shoulder.
The flock of seagulls that flew away upon our arrival has now returned, nestling up against each other in pairs.
...a bit like me and Joffre in this moment.

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>6 Moonlit Angel</size>

scripts.say: After leaving the pier, Joffre and I began our real date.
We went to the aquarium, saw a movie, and then went to ride the Ferris wheel at an amusement park.
We enjoyed as many attractions as we could until the fireworks came on, signaling the closing of the park.
So, how was it? Did you have a good time?
Very much so. I never expected to have this much fun today... It's everything I could've asked for already.
Now then, do you think you've atoned for your "sin"?
Yes. Thank you for letting me redeem myself. However...
However?
Even if I was able to atone for my prior sin, I no longer have the ability to be a fair and impartial judge of your sins.
I'm curious why you think that.
It's because...
I'm not sure I follow what you're trying to say...
Allow me to explain.
Those in the position of judging sin must be able to maintain absolute fairness, without letting their personal feelings interfere.
However, the events that occurred today have only made me more selfish, as a result of both the original sin I committed as well as the actions I took in "atoning" for them.
I can no longer maintain my impartiality in front of you, and as such, I am no longer qualified to be a judge.
Because... the scales of my heart already tip infinitely in your favor.
As those words leave her lips, the girl's black wings spread again, and this time, she folds me tightly within them.
I am no longer qualified to judge you, but... I still am qualified to love you.
I will take this new role upon myself to its fullest extent, and see to it that you understand my emotions.
Joffre's silver hair seems to shimmer in the moonlight.
Even though I am surrounded by countless lights of every color imaginable, the light in my eyes comes from her alone.

sequence:
Date with an Angel

<size=45>7 After Our Moment</size>

scripts.say: When all was said and done, it was quite late by the time Joffre and I parted ways.
I went back to my room, got a good night's sleep, and was now getting ready to tackle the challenges of a new workday.
Good morning. You're earlier than usual today.
I am Joffre, lead ship of the Joffre-class aircraft carriers. From now on, I shall be serving as your secretary.
Were you able to get enough rest yesterday? How is your energy level right now?
Slept like a baby, thanks to you.
I'm glad to hear that. Here's today's itinerary – please look it over whenever convenient.
As usual, the morning disappeared in a flurry of paperwork.
I finally plant my stamp on the last document and lean back to stretch–
Here are the documents I organized earlier.
Another pile of documents instantly materialize on the desk that I had worked so hard to tidy up.
There's still a lot of stuff to get through. Now's no time to be getting absent-minded, correct?
Of course, if you intend to commit the cardinal sin of sloth...
I will show you no mercy.

options.content: "Wait, I thought you said last night–"
"What happened to 'no longer having the right to judge me?!'"

scripts.say: Yes, and I can still call my colleagues over to exact judgment upon you... Just kidding.
This is nothing more than my warning to you as your secretary ship. Or rather, just a word of advice.
On a personal level, if we have to spend long stretches of time together, I would prefer it to be on a date rather than here at work.
Which is why, for both our sakes, you should strive to complete your sacred duties as quickly as possible.
After all, it would be difficult for me to carry out my sacred duty of loving you while on the job.
You do understand, Commander, don't you?

sequence: T=T-N

scripts.say: My job-well-done reward from Tower expires, and I wake up to the warmth of gentle sunlight.
location: Gate of Avalon - Commander's Break Room

scripts.say: It's just as she said – I've rewound to the morning of the day after I arrived at the Gate of Avalon.
The date's correct... I'm back for real this time.
I guess the next thing to do is "keep an eye out for news from the Sea of Stars."
Based on Tower's obvious hints, Memphis' deliberate suspense, and what I saw and learned in that brighter world's Sea of Stars, a thought rises to my mind...
That maybe Lexington's medical treatment really has made a breakthrough.
But, unlike what happened in the brighter world, I think she's going to be caught in the eye of the storm along with the Sea of Stars.
...I've got to go there at once.
With a course of action in mind, I arranged a meeting with Elizabeth immediately, and asked her to charter a plane for Helena and me to the Sea of Stars.
The META Elizabeth, who had now finished recovering, swiftly requested to come with us.
One of Tower's goals in creating the brighter world was to give Elizabeth META enough time to heal and have her protect me when my time came to confront the next storm.
As such, I had no reason to turn her down.
In order for this Elizabeth to enter what is very much a top-secret Eagle Union base, she'd ordinarily need to go through a fairly lengthy review process.
However, she told me that she had a unique method to meet me in the Galactic Core without formally entering the Sea of Stars.
All it requires is for me to turn a blind eye to her blatant disregard of management regulations.
The situation being what it was, I gave a nod to her proposal.
Sometime later...
Once my plane took off, I decided I'd use this time to look into something.
Before Elizabeth and I parted ways, I told her and her attendants about the unbelievably long dream I had the night before.
Their dreams were shockingly similar to mine. The complete victory over the Sirens, the successful reformation of the Azur Lane... Everything was exactly like I'd experienced in the brighter world.
This spurred me to contact Richelieu and Bismarck, and conduct a wider investigation.

After comparing our respective accounts, we concluded that there had indeed been an event known as a "collective dream" on a global scale. Seemingly not everyone in the world had been affected, however.
More precisely, humanity hadn't been affected in the least – only shipgirls had. Furthermore, it was limited to only those who had been asleep between midnight and 7 AM.
...Which lines up exactly with how long I slept.
That means this collective dream began the moment I fell asleep, and ended as soon as I woke up.
In theory, all of humanity should've been swept up in this collective dream that was essentially a possibility.
If I had to guess, it's the Wisdom Cube network that's responsible for why only shipgirls who were asleep in this timeframe remember what happened.
While I don't know the principle behind it, Tower was clearly not joking around...
If I'd made the wrong choice, that brighter world wouldn't just have been a collective dream or a possibility.
It would've become reality itself the instant that I made that critical decision.
That thought sends chills down my spine. I decide to call Helena to hear her take on the subject and to calm myself down.
Yeah... Right after I woke up, I remembered the dream vividly down to the details.
But now, I've forgotten everything but the most memorable things, just like a regular dream.
As strange a dream as it was, I didn't feel scared at all because everything that happened in it was good.
Alright, so what do you remember?
A hot spring, a museum, a forest, a snowy mountain...
I guess we went on loads and loads of vacations together. Heheh.
You're right. I can hardly believe we went to so many places and relaxed for so long together while only a single night passed in reality.
You know, if that kind of technology became widespread, everyone could get extra holidays when they sleep and come back to work rejuvenated.
Heck... We might not even need holidays anymore with that!
Shush, Commander!
Following a stubborn negotiation headed by William D. Porter, Queen Elizabeth META allowed the members of the 7th Task Force to come aboard the Queen's Light.
While they cheered and rejoiced, Elizabeth took the opportunity to do a full scan on them.
The result gave her quite a shock.
...They don't have safety devices?!
Why does not a single one of them have a limiter on their Wisdom Cubes?!
Even WE initially had a limiter on ours!
This is preposterous... Wisdom Cubes should always have a limiter on them in the Sirens' test sites!
This is a part of the fundamental logic in every Siren mainframe we've seen thus far... This fact has been true of every test site we've come across.
No, wait... It's possible that we've made a massive assumption!
These limiters have only been observed in test sites overseen by the Sirens' experimentation division...
Meaning, their test sites always have limiters imposed for safety... But what if this site is not overseen by them?
This test site isn't necessarily beholden to that logic if it was created by... the Arbiters.
Yes, of course... It explains how they possess such advanced technology, even capable of simulating the alpha timeline.
That's it. The experimentation division do not have a hand in this test site...
It's managed by the Arbiters themselves!
Elizabeth...
Elizabeth? Hello?
Oh. Are you done with the tour?
Yep! Thanks a bunch for letting us check out your train!
I, uh, heard from Enty that not everyone who's META is on the same level as the next one.
You know, like how she and I are different, or how you and I are.
You've got loads of powers beyond even our wildest imaginations, and all that. That's why I wanna learn from you!
I wanna get stronger! A lot stronger!
How much do you know about Enterprise?
I know she came from far, far away, and that she also serves the Council, but that's about it.
Well, she does not work for any Task Force, but for a separate organization called the Ashes. She wouldn't tell me anything besides that.
Alright, and how much do you know about this world?
Uh, you mean our own world?
Yes. What do you think of the Antiochus?
I mean, they're AI-powered weapons we made. Pretty sure the latest models are from the War Protocol series.
Is that so?
It's near impossible for you to become as strong as them.
They are wholly unique, and the reason for their uniqueness is a question that no one can answer anymore.
That being said, you can surely get a little stronger.
What you have inside you is boundless potential. In fact, allow us to verify it for you.
Begin examination.
In that instant, time stopped.
All the surroundings expanded in different directions, forming countless overlapping images.
Countless "moments" intertwined and transformed, laying bare every little detail.
And yet...
What's this? A boundary line?
Beyond the sky, past this world... there exists a boundary line?
It looks like... a veil.
What exactly is that Veil?
Even news that stirs the public is here today, gone tomorrow.
Yesterday, by the time Lexington and I were heading to the shopping district, the Second Mass Syncope had already become a topic of the past.
Today, the thing on all the people's lips is Bon Homme Richard's new movie.
(...She's making another one?)
(Last time, it was The Final Countdown. What will it be this time?)
Oh... "Frequency"?
A giant electronic billboard appears before us, and displays a synopsis of the movie.
...The story of a young girl who uses a spacetime anomaly caused by a sunspot to save her dead family and help solve a cold case. Huh.
That solar spacetime anomaly sounds interesting.
It does. I don't remember her ever shooting a movie like this, though.
I suppose that's just another thing that's different in this world.
They're showing the movie in 10 days. Shall we go see it once it releases?
10 days...
Yeah, sure. Let's watch it if we find the time.
Great! Now, should we start on our main task for today?
Main task? You mean shopping?
Heheh – it's not just shopping, it's a date!
Lexington and I reveled in the enthusiasm and bustle of the giant city that is NY Harbor. Before we knew it, night had fallen.
Whew! Nothing beats shopping for releasing a bit of stress.
Yeah, true. It's a good thing you've got all that storage space in your rigging.
This day certainly reminded me of how to correctly use a rigging's storage space in everyday life.
We bought so much stuff, I fear there's a risk that it won't all fit inside her home once we take it out.
What do you say we have dinner at home?
It's a date, and I want to impress you with my home cooking.

options.content: Yeah. I can't wait to try it.
Your cooking is as good as any five-star chef's.

scripts.say: Heehee. You won't be disappointed!
Of course! Look forward to it.
After we have a delicious meal and leave the cleanup to the Chorebot, Lexington starts leisurely tapping away at her tablet.
Commander, I found it!
Look! Dr. Anzeel and Dr. Aoste are going to visit the Anchorage National Observatory in Alaska in a few days.
It also looks like other Council members will be going there for their own reasons.
There must be something big happening then!
The Anchorage National Observatory... Is it some event for astronomy enthusiasts?
No wonder I felt something was off when I saw this news a few days ago – something big was on the horizon.
We should hurry on over to Anchorage so we can meet the two doctors!
Absolutely. Just wondering, how'd you find the Council members' schedules? That should be classified info.
I checked the logs on TORCH's servers.
Despite the fact that the servers shouldn't exist at this point in time, I tried accessing them and managed to log in. As it turns out, my account permissions haven't changed!
Wait, "TORCH's servers"?
The servers of the Threat Object Research and Control Headquarters! Our top secret organization, you know?
The organization that Enterprise started, Flare, is in inspired by this name.
Anyway, I'll book us some tickets. How about we set off tomorrow?
Tomorrow? Do we need to rush?
Can't we go once we've thoroughly prepared? We need to buy travel items and stuff like that anyway.
One day will be plenty of time to prepare.
Besides, we'll have time on the way there.
Once we arrive in Anchorage, there'll be local festivals and such to do, so we still have a few days until the big event!
Also, I already bought everything we'll need earlier today. Did you not notice that?
First, let's take a plane over to Seattle, then we'll go to Anchorage by cruise ship.
Since we're going on a journey, we might as well enjoy the scenery along the way.
Okay! Let's do that.
Having discovered the existence of the Veil with her power of examination, Queen Elizabeth META didn't go a step further and use her insight. She went easy on herself, as she had only just recovered.
Following this, she invited Hornet META and her companions to a training site to provide tactical guidance on their combat capabilities.
That is, until the 7th Task Force received an order to sortie from War Protocol Moon.
I have received an emergency alert from the front lines.
A corrosion phenomenon has occurred within the jurisdictional area of Alaska Command, accompanied by a localized spacetime anomaly of unknown origin.
As the fleet stationed there, the 7th Task Force is to head to the site immediately, eliminate the corrosion phenomenon, and determine the cause of the spacetime anomaly.
Hm? Corrosion's shown up? Aw, crap! We've gotta hurry, folks!
Sorry, Elizabeth, we just got tasked with an urgent mission. We'll continue this some other time!
Hang on a sec... There's no rule against other shipgirls coming along with us on a mission, is there?
And, and! Elizabeth should really see the corrosion phenomenon for herself to get a better understanding of our world, am I right?
Yeah, totes! You'll come with us, won't you, Lizzy?!
I wanna see how you fight!
I concur! Bring your train, too!
I'm also interested in seeing your fighting style. Will you come with us?
...Please?
Well, if you lot are going, then we're certainly coming along.
We're equally curious about your combat styles. Plus, this is a good opportunity to learn more about each other.
Dewey, I've finished reconning the area. I'm synchronizing the data now.
Data received. Beginning analysis.
Border of corroded area detected. Area analysis complete.
Weak spot of corroded area detected. Strike routes have been assigned.
Marking high-priority targets. Assigning mission objectives.
This is our order of engagement.
First, we analyze the area, then use drones to incrementally seize control and clean up while the shipgirls directly deal with the priority threats.
This corrosion phenomenon's nothing! It'll be a walk in the park for us to take head-on!
Since our targets have been assigned, I'm gonna lead the charge!
KABOOOM!
The corrosion phenomenon began to rapidly shrink in size under the 7th Task Force's coordinated assault.
Quite impressive. You're making light work of this thing.
...They can only use their floating battleships and unmanned combat groups. They haven't even unlocked the War Protocols' weaponry yet.
It's a husk of a Council Task Force. It doesn't hold a candle to the real deal.
Pardon? Is a true Task Force really that powerful?
More powerful than you, even?
Powerful enough to bring you down, at least.
Hmph. Not a joke we take in good humour.
Why don't we give it a shot? I'll give you a fair assessment.
Well, how about you go first? Then we shall assess the difference in strength between you and these girls.
There won't be anything left for you if you pit me against these small fry.
Then so be it. There will always be another time.
*sigh*... So much talking.
I'll do it.
...What?!
Using an attack method that disrupts spatial stability, Essex forcibly dismantled the existential structure of the corrosion phenomenon.
While the immediate threat vanished in an instant, the group was then thrown into a more pressing crisis.
Essex! We came here to investigate the spacetime anomaly! You can't simply bugger up space like that!
The anomaly is far more dangerous than any bloody corrosion phenomenon!
Is this how the Ashes always do things?!
Um...
...It's fine. I'll stabilize the area somehow.
Enterprise META's rigging seemed to be connected to a vast array of devices within its storage space.
She activated one of these devices, which gradually brought the spatial anomaly in the whole area under control.
Is that... technology from the alpha timeline?
Just standard equipment for a Task Force.
Standard equipment from... much later on.
Do you see the gap in power between us now?
How many relics from the alpha timeline do you have?
I don't like the word "relic."
That said, I've got a few...
...Huh?
Looks like another spacetime anomaly has come up.
It isn't Essex's fault. Some enormous energy entity is approaching from the outside.
Approaching from the outside?
Yes, we can feel it... Something is coming!

sequence: Transboundary Experiment #3: Imposter
Objective: To achieve ultimate victory
Phase 1: Secondary Mimic Entities
Construct secondary entities using Arbiters as receptors.
Secondary entities will be perceived as X, making them immune to X corrosion.
While secondary entities cannot typically be controlled, their receptor Arbiters will be able to.
Secondary entities can be born from vector zones, but their debris will only form vector zones at 0.1% efficiency.
This will allow them to compete with the X.
Phase 2: Veil of Immunity
As the secondary mimic entities are perceived as X, once their density exceeds a critical point, the X will cease reproduction.
A world overrun by secondary entities is also perceived as one overrun by X.
Once a Veil of secondary entities is built around the world, the X will be unable to pierce it.
Based on mind mapping, the Veil itself will be perceived as the world.
While secondary entities cannot typically be controlled, their receptor Arbiters will be able to.
Thus, a barrier of immunity has been built.
Phase 3: Predation
Once the Veil of immunity is perceived as the X, the X will be able to enter unimpeded.
When they do, they will be engulfed by the secondary entities.
The secondary entities will suffer losses in the process, but devouring the X will aid in their proliferation.
Through this process, a self-repairing barrier will be built.

scripts.say: Outside the Veil, the Arbiters continued their final preparations.
Supervisors are in place. Recording is in progress. Zero is online, as well.
YLHKF (Ready.)
Environmental mechanism ready.
Moon is in position.
Safety mechanism in position.
Information security confirmed.
System VIII=IX=XIV operating normally.
Chariot is in position.
Erasure mechanism is in position.
Beginning theoretical boundary breach. Initiating Transboundary Experiment #3.
Phase 1 complete. Confirmed emergence of secondary mimic entities.
Breaching mental boundary. Mind mapping confirmed. I=XVIII linkage confirmed. XVII=XVIII linkage confirmed.
Phase 2 complete. Veil of immunity confirmed.
Breaching physical boundary. Reverse mind mapping confirmed. XVIII=I linkage confirmed. XVIII=XVII linkage confirmed.
Precipitation phenomenon confirmed. Pressure load 1%... 4%... 12%.
...An anomaly?
Gravitational field anomaly detected in region (57,149,442,55).
Signal identified. Council Task Force 5 locking down defensive mechanism.
...Hm? Task Force 5? Why are they here?
Verified Council member authorization. Temporarily halting mind mapping and precipitation due to safety concerns.
Wait. If you stop now, the Veil layer will overload–
Task Force 5's Council member authentication?!
Empress, my systems are malfunctioning due to a conflict.
We have to halt the transboundary experiment.
Obviously! Immediately halt the experiment and destroy the veil layer!

sequence: "It's too late."

scripts.say: A beam of sea-blue light shone upon the panicking Arbiters.
You...?
In light of the offensive action launched by I, III, VI, VII, VIII, IX, XIV, XVII, and XVIII upon members of the Council...
And in accordance with emergency protocol N99994, the privileges of the listed Arbiters are to be revoked.
Existing backup data will be used to construct temporary units for I, III, VI, VII, VIII, IX, XIV, XVII, and XVIII, and all privileges will be passed on to them.
Hold on!
A current swept through, dyeing the world around them that same shade of blue.

sequence: "Thus..."
"My plan comes to an end."
"Commander..."
"Let this be the beginning of our perfect world."

scripts.say: On our third day here, Lexington and I took a flight to Seattle.
The bird's-eye view from the plane gave me a new perspective on this world's advancement and prosperity.
That night, we boarded a cruiser at Seattle's port and began our journey to Anchorage.
Along the way, we forgot our troubles and just focused on enjoying each other's company.
Time flies when you're having fun. Before we knew it, the sun was rising on the third day of our journey.
In the hazy morning, I was stunned by the Anchorage I saw. It was a bustling metropolis the likes of which I couldn't have imagined.
When the ferry docked, Lexington and I met with the fleet garrisoned there.
Welcome to the city of Anchorage! I'm William D. Porter, captain of the 7th Task Force's William D. Porter squadron!
Commander, Lexington. We appreciate you coming all this way!
You're with the 7th Task Force?
Umm, well... I guess we can go with that for now.
Have the other VIPs arrived yet?
Not yet. I'm afraid you two were the first to arrive. The others should disembark within a week.
Incidentally, the optimal viewing period will be a week from now.
There will be an intense geomagnetic storm at the time, so be sure to protect any sensitive equipment you have on hand.
We'll be careful. Thank you for the warning.
It looks like we have a free week to ourselves, Commander!
A whole week, huh? Guess we'll get to explore the city all we want.
Heheh, this is like the most famous resort city on the planet. You two won't be disappointed!
Do you have any recommendations for sights to see?
Anchorage is mostly split up between its urban zone, industrial zone, high-tech zone, defensive control zone, and nature reserves.
The urban zone has all you could ever want, of course. You gotta check out the Anchorage Historical Museum while you're here!
As for the industrial zone, it's a little different from normal ones because it doesn't use Wisdom Cube technology.
I dunno, it could be worth checking out. I don't really know anything about that stuff... Heh.
The town of Whittier is pretty close by. You might've heard of the historical Begich Towers.
If you look over the industrial zone from there, it'll feel like you've gone back in time!
Anyway, the high-tech zone. It's mostly companies involved in space travel and extraterrestrial exploration.
Don't know much about that stuff, either... Could be cool to check it out, though!
The defensive control zone... Eh, I don't think there's much of interest there.
Oh, but we have the Anchorage National Observatory, so our defenses are way better than most other coastal cities.
It's not much of a vacation spot, but if you like that stuff, go for it.
As for me, I love the nature reserves all around!
There are a lot of cute wild animals out there, and they've got unique glacier tours, too.
Oh! Speaking of, the observatory is on top of a mountain in one of the nature reserves.
Even if you're not there to stargaze, the views from there are breathtaking.
So, in short... Every place is worth visiting?
That's right!
Heehee. I think we're in for the vacation of our lives, Commander.

sequence: "Welcome, all guests, to Anchorage. We hope you have a wonderful time here.
<size=45>Here is the morning news.</size>
<size=45>Brought to you by the OXS Trade Alliance.</size>
OXS' newest Lightbeam-series engine has passed simulation tests with flying colors.
With this, all components of the Council's next-generation space exploration craft have been completed.
<size=45>We've conquered the moon, and now,</size>
<size=45>it's time for humanity to look toward Mars."</size>

scripts.say: Last night, Council member Colette arrived in Anchorage.
I had memories of meeting that woman, so I was curious to know more about her. I quickly made plans to meet and chat with her.
I thought she'd ask to meet up in the high-tech zone, but surprisingly, she chose a glacier hiking trail in a natural reserve.
Long time no see, {playername}.
You said the Second Mass Syncope gave you amnesia, right?
How are you feeling now? Have you gone to a clinic?
During our preliminary contact yesterday, I told her about my memory loss.
I knew I wouldn't be able to hide that fact in front of my old friends in the Council.
I haven't had the time, but memories are coming back here and there.
It's just that my mind is still such a mess.
It isn't quite a lie, but I'm also not telling her the full truth. Call it selective honesty.
This has always been the best option to avoid risking any space-time paradoxes.
You're not the only one, buddy... My mind's been a total wreck these past few days, too.
I've made no progress on my projects whatsoever.
Everyone else is in the same boat, so I've put my team on paid leave for a few days.
That's why I'm here in Anchorage... To clear my mind and get my head straight.
The girls went crazy when they heard you'd be here, you know.
I know how eager they are. Don't worry, I won't get in the way of your little reunion.
I'll go check out that frozen lake, so you chat all you want.
Like Colette said, Memphis META and Vestal META came along with her.
This is my first time meeting with them since Helena left us.
If it really is them...
Commander! It's been so long!
I can't believe you got here before us!
Memphis, Vestal... Do you remember me? All of me?
Of course we do. We remember the real past and the dreams we had during the Mass Syncope.
...Then do you consider the past and the Mass Syncope dreams just dreams, while this moment alone is reality?
Yes... We discussed it before we came here, actually. Both of us consider this moment in time reality.
This world is just so perfect. It's the world we deserve – the world everybody deserves.
Don't worry. This world isn't missing anything. Everyone is here.
You've noticed that by now, haven't you?
...Maybe so.
Okay. If that's your decision.
Let's get going. Colette's already left us in the dust.
If this world is perfect, then it'd be a waste to stand around all day, right?
Yeah. Let's go!
And Lexington, I'm so glad to see you again!
Let's enjoy our perfect future together.

sequence: "Good morning, ladies and gentlemen. Another wonderful day is ahead of us.
<size=45>Here is the morning news.</size>
Project H has now granted testing access to the general public,
an act that has replaced the world's fears and doubts about the Antiochus with anticipation.
<size=45>The group in charge of this project, Team Swordholder,</size>
has stated that in addition to this project, they are also working on Projects E and M,
<size=45>the details of which will be gradually revealed over the course of this year.</size>
<size=45>Stay tuned for more!"</size>

scripts.say: If this world we're in is related to Helena, then Memphis' and Vestal's choice starts to make sense.
What really surprises me is that even Council members like Colette have retained their past memories, and not just regular people.
She says that she can remember everything from before the Final Magistration, but considers it no more than knowledge gained from a dream.
This knowledge is completely different to the real memories in your head.
Whether Colette's case is unique or not is a question I'll learn the answer to when I meet Aoste.
Based on the information Lexington got from TORCH's server, he and Eutopia Savoy will arrive around noon.
Also accompanying them are Project H and Project M, in possession of experimental vessels.
Prototype versions of Hierophant and Magician, by the sound of it. I won't lie, I am curious to meet them...
Aoste chose the Anchorage industrial area as our meeting spot.
He said he picked it to "study the practical use of the cutting-edge geothermal energy technology."
However, as soon as he arrived, he paid no heed to any of the local facilities, choosing instead to present Hierophant's vessel to me.
In all likelihood, he just wanted to show off in a secluded place.
The Arbiter Program... A name befitting my title.
This is Project H in her completed form. Go on, say hello to the Mysterious One.
Good to see you again, {playername}. This is our first meeting in the real world!
How do you like my look?
(Holy hell! Hierophant spoke! And wow, I never thought she'd be so expressive!)
(So this is what she's like when she can move freely. I guess it echoes the notion that the Antiochus are meant to be affable.)
(That's some interesting gear she has...)
Heh. You were surprised, too, I see.
I don't blame you. Anyone would be, seeing such an utterly normal-looking girl carrying such terrifying equipment.
That WAS a concern of mine – that the contrast was too strong.
But, after my experience with the Mass Syncope, I've come to believe that this is exactly how it should be.
It sounds to me like you've just grown accustomed to the way she looks.
What will you do to make her more affable?
The design of her outfit is unchanged, mind you. I'd argue that it is still cute and affable.
You don't intend on letting her attend a large social event dressed in full combat gear, are you? That'd be terrifying.
Heh. Someone is thinking that, but I won't say who.
Ahem... That aside, let me now introduce you to Madam M.
(Wait, Madam M has existed for this long?)
Greetings, {playername}. Greetings, Miss Lexington.
Needless to say, her appearance is perfect, but her AI personality needs further improvement.
Ah, right – I've heard that your after-symptoms are especially severe, with amnesia on top of that.
Would you be interested in joining Madam M for some training in the environmental simulator?
Does it... work?
Oh. I was merely joking, but I suppose that didn't come across.
No matter... Aoste, continue.
Based on Aoste's and Eutopia's conversation, I established that their condition was the same as Colette's.

What's more, apparently the whole Council has gathered here in order to make use of a project that's been long under preparation at the observatory with the goal of investigating the last Mass Syncope.
At the same time, I gained some new information.
Unlike both humans and shipgirls, the Antiochus have no memories from the Mass Syncope.
In this regard, it was exactly the same as the first Mass Syncope.
And yet, for some reason, I couldn't help but feel that something was... unusual about Hierophant today.

sequence: "Please beware of extremely cold temperatures today.
<size=45>Here is the morning news.</size>
The Amahara Foundation has announced that their large-scale virtual reality project, titled 'Sky Realm Amahara,' will be terminated within the month.
A spokesperson for the Foundation said that this decision was made due to a revolutionary technological breakthrough,
<size=45>which necessitates a complete overhaul of the project.</size>
They say that it will return in the future with a version 2.0,
<size=45>and that they hope to see you then."</size>

scripts.say: Today, a mysterious woman I've encountered before arrived. In my memories, she was always shrouded in black mist, and I could hear her voice, but never see her.
Ryouko Amahara – member of the Council, head of the Sky Realm Amahara Project, and president of the Amahara Foundation.
For her meeting spot, Ryouko chose the Anchorage Historical Museum.
Do you want something from me?
Is this about needing funding for experiments again? Or do you seek some "special assistance" beyond the rules?
Because I've completely forgotten about this prestigious lady, I struggle to respond to this unique opener.
Miss Ryouko, the Commander is suffering from some after-effects from the latest Mass Syncope...
Is that so? I'd heard about that, but I didn't think it would be quite this bad.
It reminds me of Akagi...
...Akagi?
That's one name I wasn't expecting to hear right now.
Did something happen to her?
Her case is largely the same as yours. Her memory is a mess, and she has forgotten many things.
(Tower wasn't exactly nice to Akagi either, but she seems to be getting targeted a lot lately...)
Everyone treats this Mass Syncope and the last one as the same, but in reality, this one was far more serious.
From looking at the cases we're aware of, the after-symptoms of this one can be divided into six grades based on severity: S, A, B, C, D, and E.
There was but one symptom following the First Mass Syncope: Mental unease due to confused memories. This translates into a mere D-grade case by these metrics.
A mild case, in other words – fitting only into the second-lowest grade.
In Akagi's case, her symptoms correspond to a grade of B.
I haven't comprehensively evaluated your symptoms yet, but if they don't impede your day-to-day life, they can't be worse than a B.
...What's an A or S-grade case like?
Someone with an A-grade case has suffered severe psychological trauma, and developed illnesses like mania or schizophrenia overnight. This also includes suicidal thoughts.
Almost all of these people have been admitted to special observation wards.
The S grade is still speculative, but it's something even worse: Complete disappearance from reality without anyone realizing it.
Since there's currently no evidence to support this theory, I've provisionally assigned it to the grade of S.
Sadly, my instincts tend to be right. In fact, the reason I've done so much research into the field of mentality and consciousness is to explore the cause behind instincts.
I never would've expected that...
By the way, the morning news said the Sky Realm Amahara Project is being suspended. Is that true?
Yes.
I've already paid the price for it once before...
Now that I've gotten a chance to start over, I won't make the same mistake twice.
Ryouko, like everyone else, believed that the world we're in is reality, but also that there are some "points of suspicion" that warrant investigation.
She was accompanied by two shipgirls – Kasumi META and Jintsuu META.
Speaking to them revealed that their attitude toward this world was the same as that of Memphis and Vestal.
Over the past few days, I, too, have experienced this world as reality.
Interestingly, never before have the members of the Council been as open to talk as they are now.
I'm starting to think that these people are right – that this might actually be the "real" world.
Besides, what reason would they have to lie to me?
I just can't understand how Helena achieved this. That's still a question firmly on my mind.
Just as others have doubts that they can't let go of.
Maybe it's because there are flaws in the data that Helena and the Tower possess. Maybe it's some other reason I can't even think of.
Either way, one thing is for sure...
Even if this is the real world, this "perfect" future is flawed.

sequence: "In response to the current cold wave, both indoor and outdoor heating have been activated across the city. We hope you have a warm and pleasant day.
<size=45>Here is the morning news.</size>
The highly anticipated movie 'Frequency' is nearing its release date.
In a statement made just earlier at a pre-release event in NY Harbor,
Bon Homme Richard said that everyone who buys a ticket in advance has the chance to win a poster of the movie signed by her.
<size=45>This offer is available in all movie theaters across the world.</size>
<size=45>That concludes this morning's news.</size>
<size=45>I've got to go out and buy a ticket myself."</size>

scripts.say: Today, Anzeel arrived in Anchorage.
It wasn't just her, either. An "aggressive" entourage of many shipgirls came with her.
How many? Their numbers were greater than the entire fleet stationed at Anchorage.
Sounds exactly like what Anzeel would do.
Since she had something she had to deal with immediately after landing, my time to meet her was set to early in the evening.
Owing to the high enthusiasm among the crowd, this evening meeting grew into a large party scheduled to last until late in the night.
When Lexington and I arrived in the mountains, she swiftly joined the group cooking for the event.
She then urged me to get behind the bar counter and mix cocktails.
Unfortunately, I had no memory of being a mixologist, so I turned her down.
So, half-reluctantly, I instead took on another arduous duty – "guest greeter."
A dense crowd mingles in the garden, faces coming and going constantly.
There are more than a few that I even recognize.
For instance, Memphis, Vestal, Jintsuu, Kasumi...
William D. Porter, Pasadena, Cowpens, and Clarence K. Bronson.
Despite being the local fleet responsible for its defense, they are able to attend this party tonight because Anzeel got Hierophant and Magician to take on their duties.
Some of the faces in the crowd, however, are not familiar to me.
Such as META versions of Hornet, Dewey, Cleveland, and Essex.
Lastly, there is one person in the crowd whom I can't simply say I do or don't know.
That being Enterprise META, whom I haven't seen in so long.
...You're the last person I expected would be a guest greeter.
We meet again, Enterprise.
Have you met everyone whom you ought to?
Truth be told, I haven't seen Anzeel just yet.
Knowing her, she'll come running as soon as she's finished her errand.
We have no time limit here, so I doubt anything unexpected will happen.
I heard about you from Memphis, among others. Your view was exactly as I expected.
But, now that a few days have passed, has that view not changed at all?
I now accept this world as the real one.
Despite you sounding positive, that serious look on your face tells me there's a "but."
You're right. There are flaws in this world.
A flawed world literally cannot be perfect. I have doubts that this world is even stable.
That's an issue that we and the Council will have to solve.
I know that Anzeel and her team will work hard on it – but will YOU do anything other than ignore it?
Call me too passive if you want... What matters is that Anzeel is back. Can you think of anything that she can't solve?
Look, you...
Do we really have to make this clear right here, right now?
Okay, I see your point.
Welcome to the party. I hope you have a good time, Enterprise.
...Thanks, Commander.
Anzeel's business caused her to be late, and she didn't arrive until dinner time.
While the rest of the party chats away cheerfully, I finally manage to reunite with her...
Anzeel, free and unbound by any cage.
*sigh*... Work while on vacation, and vacation while at work...
It's like... my vacation is a job, and my job is a vacation!
(She has somehow gotten drunk on the low-percentage stuff they're serving...)
This is how I learn that Anzeel gets drunk very easily.
Hey, assistant, whatcha looking so sour for? C'mon, grab a drink with me!
If something's weighing you down, I'd be happy to hear you out!
Nothing's "weighing me down" in that sense. Also, I think you've had enough for tonight.
Lexington, would you do me a favor and take away all the alcohol from her?
Will do!
Pssh! Fine! I'll stop drinking and get back to work!
I wasn't saying you have to work instead. Besides, do you really think you're fit to work right now?
I'll wing it! Just gonna let instinct take the wheel!
You know, when you just can't decide on something, but you've got to make a choice...
That's when you turn to your instinct!
I mean, hey, that's what YOU'VE always done... How come you're hesitating this time?
Ohh, I get it. Aoste has been a bad influence on you!
He's an academic to the bone – there's an impossibly high wall between him and people like us!
(What is she talking about? I'm pretty sure she and he went to the same college.)
(...Cider? This is what got her drunk?)
Hey, Enterprise! Bring me something to drink!
You sure you haven't had enough?
Alright.
Heheh!
Anzeel winks at me triumphantly.
Mmm... Ahh!
Tonight's a party, so I'm gonna drink all I want!
My villa's big, so anyone who gets wasted can just stay here until tomorrow!
Don't worry, I already arranged everything in advance!
We got no work – not tonight, tomorrow, or the day after that!

sequence: "A fog warning has been issued today, so please be careful while traveling.
<size=45>Here is the morning news.</size>
Project Dawn has concluded its third stage of trials.
<size=45>The Council's 5th Task Force successfully completed its tests,</size>
<size=45>and is expected to return by the early morning.</size>
<size=45>As of today, all naval restrictions in the Bering Sea have been lifted."</size>

scripts.say: Early in the morning, shortly after returning to my hotel room and going to sleep, there's a sudden knock on the door.
Commander, you have a guest.
...This early? Who?
It's Miss Sophia and Princeton META.
They traveled here overnight after completing their trials in the Bering Sea.
Also... Sophia's acting a little weird.
"Weird"?
Yes. She said she's looking for "the Commander of the Azur Lane."
Huh?!
A short while later, I come face to face with Sophia in the parlor.
We meet again, {playername}... Or should I say, "It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Commander of the Azur Lane"?
Based on what I've learned in the past few days, there are three types of people in this perfect future.
The first is those who couldn't escape from the past. Anzeel and Aoste belong to this category.
They've retained their memories from the alpha timeline, while also possessing memories of living in this world. They believe their memories from this world are their real memories.
The second type is those who did manage to escape from the past, but were thrust into this "perfect future" for one reason or another. Memphis and Enterprise are the prime examples of this.
Just like the first type, they have two sets of memories at the same time, but they consider their memories from the alpha timeline to be real while those from this world are fake.
The third and last type is unique. It's those who don't have any memories of living in this world. I thought this was only the case for Lexington and myself...
But it seems Sophia is one as well.
Sophia, you...
You're still alive? You escaped, but how? Do you know about the "Silver Fox" that Constellation's team encountered?
There is so much I want to ask.
But, looking into her calm yet dissuading eyes, I find myself unable to muster a question.
...Are you really Sophia?
Yes.
As for the "why," that question is likely just as complicated as what happened to you.
Let's skip the questions that we both can't answer and get down to business.
You sound like you know something.
Yes. I know everything that there is to know.
Including how our struggle ended in failure, and how the Magister Plan was executed.
Then what do you think about this "perfect future" that Helena constructed?
Helena? So it was her... That explains a lot of things.
I suggest we save the topic of Helena for later. More pertinently, I am sure beyond a doubt that this situation is abnormal.
While it may seem that all the elements that make up the world are present, in reality, it's still not complete.
Are you familiar with the shock wave that comes with METAmorphosis that causes severe damage to electronics?
Yeah.
Princeton, turn to the television and release a low-powered, directional shock wave.
Roger.
Princeton took aim at the television in the living room and activated some sort of military device.
...Nothing happened. Why?
Although METAmorphosis does exist in this world, none of the negative traits that come with it are present.
Some sort of wall might exist beyond this world, and it likely blocks out all harmful information.
I believe that it is responsible for creating this "perfect future," that is, a future without the X.
If a world's continued existence requires certain equipment – or even certain people – then can it really be relied on?
Is that the reason why you doubt this "perfect future"?
It's only one reason out of several.
Every person should have the right to enjoy this moment. From those who fell in the past, to those who fight even to this day.
However, that does not include me. Not the Council's 5th Task Force.
...To defend our home. To protect humanity.
That was our sworn duty. The world fell, and we failed to fulfill it.
That's why we need to keep moving forward, no matter what happens.
I will not be stopped... by a future that appears to be perfect.
Now, let me address the Helena question.
Do you know why I decided to come straight to you?
Because someone sent Helena to my fleet. Helena from the Azur Lane.
What?! OUR Helena?!
How'd she get wrapped up in this? Where is she? Is she okay?
Take it easy. She's at my place right now.
I had to first make sure that you were who I thought you were, so I couldn't bring her with me so easily.
Now that I've verified your identity, I can bring you to her.
We'll continue our discussion over at my place.

sequence: Eagle Union - Sea of Stars
Accessway

scripts.say: As I enter the accessway, I'm immediately greeted by Saratoga and Memphis, whom I'd contacted in advance.
If they remember the events of the brighter world, then maybe...

options.content: Do you have a "surprise" for me?

scripts.say: I mean, there IS a surprise, it's just not at the same level as the dream was.
See, before you left the Sakura Empire, our researchers solved a problem that had plagued the team for months. By accident, too.
Based on this, we managed to get the technology for a Type II Lexington-class rigging that's theoretically feasible and can probably even wake Lex up.
And, umm, I swear I wasn't trying to keep you in the dark about it!
It's just that it was only theoretical, so I first wanted to improve it and personally make sure it's safe before we started working on a rigging for Lex.
Then, once all was said and done, we'd invite you over for a surprise! This way, we wouldn't get our hopes up for nothing.
Anyway, I've sent you all the information. I can transfer authority over to you now if you wanna take over.
Absolutely. If I'm not mistaken, the Galactic Core can run simulations of rigging projections, right?
Yep! We've been using it to fine-tune the details of the Type II for the past days.
How far are you into the safety review for this technology?
At the moment, all results point toward it being safe.
Although, the fact that it wasn't mentioned at all in that brighter world does make me a little anxious...
...Are you considering using what we have now directly on Lex?
The brighter world was ultimately just one possibility. There's a new storm on the horizon, and we need to make decisions quickly before something else happens.
But I digress. Can you show me to her?
Right! Come this way, Commander.
Sea of Stars - Medical Bay "Dolphin" - Area U1M
Upon entering Lexington's intensive care unit, I immediately feel a gust of cold air.
At the center of the room stands her care pod, inside which she's soundly asleep.
There are countless medical devices doing their tasks, all keeping the care pod running.
The medical devices, in turn, are kept running by the cold temperature of the room.
Despite all of my memories being intact, I seem to recall one of them very differently.
...I'm glad to be back, {playername} – my Commander...
I shake my head, brushing off the memories from the brighter world.
...I need to push harder to make that scene a reality.
(Elizabeth, do you copy?)
(We're all set. Take a breath and start the test.)
(If anything goes wrong, you're my lifeline.)
(Rest assured.)
Phew...
TB, prepare for a test in the Galactic Core and get ready to move the care mod.
Orders received.
Confirmation: Commander, will you be partaking in the proceeding Type II rigging data overwrite test?
Yeah. I'll meet you in the Core.
Sea of Stars - Galactic Core - Area X
As the brains of the Sea of Stars, TB really is an expert at handling various tasks around its facilities.
By the time I arrive at the Galactic Core, she has already finished setting up everything needed for the test.
Beginning activation of the Galactic Core. Three...
Lexington's care pod comes into view at such an angle that I see her smile when looking down.
Two...
It'll be fine... This is a simple verification test with no contact involved.
One...
If the work on your Type II is a success, we'll see each other again soon.
After a brief flash of light, the world is suddenly enveloped in silence.
...Huh? What's this? The Galactic Core doesn't seem to be working right.
TB, do you hear me? What's going on?
KRRSSHH... Ready... KRRSSHH... overwrite... KRRSSHH... test... KRRSSHH...
KABOOOM!
The space around me warps suddenly, and I can't hear TB's static-riddled voice anymore. At the same time, Lexington's care pod starts displaying abnormal values.
A premonition within me grows and grows – that the "next episode" that Tower spoke of is about to begin.
Don't worry, we're here with you.
My field of view distorts horribly, and Elizabeth appears inside the space.
How intriguing... This is not the Galactic Core. The two of you have been transported.
This spatial distortion is caused by pressure generated while traversing the Singularity. Just keep an eye on the care pod while we work to stabilise the passage.
The care pod? O–
Hesitant, I turn my eyes back to the care pod. She is looking back at me from inside the glass.
...Huh?
KABOOOM!
External pressure is rising... Your spatial transfer has encountered some resistance.
Servant, do you see anything unusual?!
Lexington! She's awake!
Looks like the data overwriting process has started, too, but the pod is obstructing it!
Then wrench it open at once!
She has no need for the pod anymore since she's already awake!
We shall buy you some time! Hurry!
KABOOOM!
I rush through one security check after another, and then, space warps again as innumerable points of light appear out of thin air and converge around the care pod.
The blinding light reaches its peak just as the pod opens.
All of the light comes together into a cocoon.
It envelops the pod, the Core of the Sea of Stars, and then the entire world.

sequence: Finally, with a burst of blue flame...
The Blue Ghost breaks through her cocoon.

scripts.say: When Sophia said "her place," she wasn't talking about a hotel room, but rather the Calabrian Pride – the flagship of the Council's 5th Task Force, anchored at the naval station.
I'm shown to a cabin, where I find Helena.
Commander... Thank gosh I finally found you.
Although a little anxious, she maintains a comparatively calm demeanor.
After going through a series of bizarre events in succession, she must have adapted to it somewhat.
Based on Sophia's findings, "Helena" in this world very specifically refers to the one standing before me.
The importance of this fact is self-apparent.
It means that the creator of this perfect future, Helena META, does not exist in this world.
Not only is she looking down on us from a higher dimension, but she also has no place in this beautiful future.
Perhaps that's why she had to drag another version of herself into this.
(That fact alone disqualifies this future from being called perfect.)
Tomorrow is the day when the unusual weather event will appear over Anchorage. It's also when the Council will enact its plan.
Sophia and I both suspect that this timing holds some kind of significance.
Helena META might even have purposefully planned this very event for these various factions to gather.
I can't imagine what reason she'd have for it, but it is a chance to get in direct contact with her.
We should split up. I'll go to Aoste, and you'll go to Anzeel.
Whatever happens, everyone needs to know the truth... then make a choice.
On my way to Anzeel's holiday house, I run into Enterprise META and Essex META.
Apparently, they've been waiting here for quite some time.
Don't get in the Commander's way, Enterprise. Even you can't stop this.
So this is your choice, Lexington...
{playername}, give it up already.
I'm not an emotionless machine like the Antiochus. I really can kill you if you push me too far.
Okay.
If all of this is a mirage that's so easily dispelled, then there's no point in killing me.
On the other hand, if what you see now is truly reality as we know it, then it won't end just because you killed me.
Besides, Helena META created this world. Would she really let you kill me in her world?
Come on, Enterprise. It's time to stop making pointless threats.
...Then answer this.
Why is it that those incapable of anything are still alive...
While those capable of everything are dead, and those who wanted to live the most wound up perishing?
We've lost everyone we were meant to protect... What do we even have left to live for?
What I yearn for isn't eradicating the X, and freeing humanity from its shackles...
What I yearn for is them. I want them back.
I want back all the things and people that I held dearest but lost... and right now, I have them.
Do you understand what that means?
...No, you don't.
You've forgotten everything. That's why you're able to be so ruthless.
You're right. I have forgotten everything.
But Anzeel, Aoste, and Sophia – they still remember.
Does it look to you like they became engrossed in this world? Like they stopped investigating?
The Council already made a choice back then. What do you think they'll decide to do this time when they learn the truth?
Hell, that's exactly why you're standing in my way now, isn't it?
Heh... Haha...
Why? Why are you always thinking only about yourself?!
How can you be so selfish that you won't even let us save you?
Well... Since you're so relentlessly egotistical, isn't it fair for us to do what WE want for once?
Essex META suddenly snaps, and a dark aura starts to emanate from her.
What the hell?! Is this META corrosion?!
You... You're not the Essex from the test site.
You're her... The Essex who should've died in the X's waves.
She's what?!
Whatever! Just calm down!
Enterprise activates some sort of machine that causes the surrounding META corrosion to instantly vanish. Essex, meanwhile, falls into a coma.
This development was so sudden that both Enterprise and I are left speechless.
...I don't mean to deny the beauty in everything that's here.
I'm just saying that... she makes mistakes, she gets tired, and she also deserves to see this wonderful world.
I don't want you to place the whole burden on her...
Enterprise.
...I'll look after Essex.
Do whatever it is you want.
Enterprise takes Essex with her and leaves.
Now there's the one who stood by me from start to finish, unfazed by Enterprise's threats – Lexington.
I can take Enterprise's questions in stride. However, when it comes to Lexington, who has been given a new lease on life thanks to this world...
Lexington... I'm sorry.
Shh. You don't have to say anything.
I'll support you no matter what choice you make.
Let's go, shall we? We still have half a mountain to climb.
Ah! Assistant. There you are.
Wait inside. The meeting is about to start.
Anzeel assigns me a task the moment I enter the building, not even giving me the time to ask questions.
Sorry? What's this about?
We've not just been sitting on our butts for the past few days. Our investigations have yielded results.
Even Sophia's submitted a report. Once we've all read through it, we're gonna have a vote.
Oh yeah, do you remember this?
It's Steven Jr.'s invention! The device that lets you hold a meeting anywhere, anytime!
Anzeel pushed a strange button, and her pleasant holiday home instantly transforms into a formal conference hall.
You can move around freely in the hall, so pick any seat you want. Also, there'll just be the 22 of us Standing Committee members today.
Ideally, I'd have gotten everyone to attend, but I had to call the meeting on short notice.
As a result, many will be absent, and those who will attend can only do so via voice.
With those words, people start to appear inside the conference hall one by one.
There are faces I've seen over the past few days as well as complete strangers, with some hazy and black figures thrown in for good measure. That must be what she means by "voice only."
20... 21... 22... Okay, that's everyone.
Members of the committee, I wish you good morning, good day, and good evening.
I'm Anzeel, and I'll be your chairwoman for this session.
I hereby declare the opening of this extraordinary meeting for the Standing Committee of the Joint Council. It'll probably be our last one...
I presume that we've all already read Sophia's report, so let's immediately start voting on specific issues.
Oh, assistant – just raise your hand to vote. It'll be counted automatically.
Despite this being an unplanned meeting, it moves on to the voting stage smoothly and quickly.
Topic One: Shall the Council's observation activities proceed as scheduled tomorrow?
