She just bought a luxury apartment in under a minute, a fact that both impresses me and gives me a new image of this futuristic city.
Well? Shall we go in?
The instant I touch the door, I seize yet another spark of light from within the rushing currents.
Inside a room in a warm apartment, a lively party is taking place.
Congrats on your move, Sis!
Congratulations, Lexington!
Y'know, you buying this apartment represents a huge legal breakthrough for shipgirls owning real estate!
I never expected the approval process to go so smoothly.
Of course, I couldn't have done it without all of you supporting me!
Well, believe me, we're just getting started here.
We live in a period of rapid change, and our future is only gonna get better from here!
(That must've been... from when Lexington first moved in.)
(Bon Homme Richard was there, among the people who came to congratulate her.)
(That's the first time she's shown up in my memories...)
Hm? Something the matter, Commander?
Oh, it's nothing. Seeing your apartment just made me remember something again.
Oh! Really?! Then take it nice and slow. I can stay right here, if you want.
Who knows – maybe another memory will come back to you?
She simply stands next to me, doing nothing but staring ahead.
Ahaha... I've already remembered most of it. Let's go in.
Well, alright.
Queen Elizabeth META made the right call by introducing herself along with the Queen's Light.
Because, while the members of the Council's fleet had already seen most of the world's cutting-edge technologies...
When they saw her "old-school" train soaring through the sky at speeds even higher than their latest aircraft, they could do nothing but stare with slack jaws.
This also made her identity as a "mysterious guest" as clear as day.
Thus, under the motive of meeting up with the other mysterious guests, she joined the Council's fleet and headed toward their destination of Anchorage.
It was nearing winter, and sunsets in Alaska always came early in the day.
They arrived in Anchorage by the evening, at which point the skies overhead had already gone completely dark.
There, unfolding before Elizabeth's eyes, was a massive metropolis enveloped in colorful neon.
Contrary to the small town she had envisioned, its prosperity was unlike anything she had seen in any other test site.
(Rows upon rows of skyscrapers, a dense industrial area, a coastal defense system stretching on forever... There's even a fleet of floating battleships attached.)
(What is this? Is this place truly the city of Anchorage?)
Whew. Elizabeth, we're here.
We'll be heading to the naval station now, so you should stick close.
Once you get through the formalities, we'll lead you to the other two mysterious guests!
There'll be no need for that. They're already there.
Say what? Where? I don't see 'em anywhere.
(...She's with the Council, but her technology is incapable of detecting the Ashes – who should be their allies?)
Oh... Hornet sent me a message saying she's coming to meet us with Enterprise and Essex META.
She says not to enter the harbor, but rather to go to a designated area and wait.
She's coming to meet us? I believe that goes against our proper procedures.
Sounds to me like the other two mysterious guests WANT to come and meet us.
Reckon just the two of them could rival half of the Council's fleet?
(Enterprise alone could devastate your entire fleet with only a half-arsed attempt...)
(We are already concealing our full power. The Ashes do so to an even greater extent.)
(That being said, this test site must be hiding some great secret if that Enterprise considers it worthwhile to stay here. Things are getting increasingly interesting...)
(...There they are. We'd better go and make their acquaintance.)

sequence: <size=45>Sometime later,</size>
<size=45>at the designated area in nearby waters,</size>
<size=45>all the members of the 7th Task Force rendezvoused.</size>
For Elizabeth, this was her first meeting with the leader of the Ashes.

scripts.say: You're not her. Who are you?
Well, good day to you too, Enterprise of the Ashes.
Indeed, we are not "her," and we've never entered the resculpting stage. Thus, we have to go great lengths to gather intel from all over the place.
"Never entered the resculpting stage," huh... Okay.
What are you here for?
What if we told you that we simply got caught up in Helena's plan?
Actually, what are YOU lot doing here?
You must have noticed how strange this place is. HOW did you even get here?
A Council beacon, but by the look of things, I'll bet that was also Helena's handiwork.
I understand now.
Understand what, pray tell?
You don't need to know.
You're not her, and you haven't even reached the resculpting stage. This is none of your business.
Excuse us? We're here, right in this world. How is this "none of our business"?
Never mind. Since you don't wish to say, we'll just find out on our own.
Begin examination.
What? There's... nothing?
Our examination doesn't work on you?
No.
Well, then...
PUZPNOA (Insight!)
...That neither?
Not even insight works on you?
What makes you... so unique?
I wish I knew.
I've been like this ever since that day...
Okay, Queen Elizabeth. We've talked enough.
Those people are gushing with curiosity for you. If it's intel you're looking for, go speak to them.
...A really long, really fast, and really old-school train?
Yeah! I'm telling you, we saw it with our own eyes!
Yes. It went even faster than my aircraft. It was truly a sight to behold.
How I'd love to study its interior...
Um... I'm also really curious about it. We should definitely ask Elizabeth about it later.
Wish she'd wrap things up over there already. Come on, hurry uuup!
Oh, seems she's done. She's looking at us!
(She has a point... We should connect more with the locals and gather some useful information.)
Throughout the day, groceries and daily necessities that Lexington had ordered online began to arrive. Bit by bit, the apartment was given touches of life.
She let a robot called the RELAX-365 All-Purpose Chorebot care for the place while she went into the kitchen.
Alas, robots still can't do the cooking for us. I guess I'll just have to treat you to my own home cooking!
While she worked in the kitchen, I turned on the television and changed the channel to an evening news program.
Most of the news coverage revolved around the Second Mass Syncope.
This one had affected not just the Eagle Union, but the entire world at large.
All of humanity exhibited symptoms, too, instead of just shipgirls – though they weren't affected for as long.
This differed from Tower's brighter world, but it was similar to the First Mass Syncope.
I say "similar" because it wasn't just for five years in this case.
It had lasted multiple decades, stretching from the Richard Incident to the Final Magistration.
All of the alpha timeline was a collective dream here.
And this world must be another possible fate for the alpha timeline... One that came after averting so many catastrophes.
Apart from the faintings, one other new item grabs my attention.
The Anchorage National Observatory in Alaska is hosting a gathering of hobbyist astronomers, and the local government is preparing a major event to attract tourists.
That would be mundane news on its own, but what strikes me is that it's being reported on alongside such a worldwide phenomenon.
The incongruity only piques my interest further.
Time passes slowly as I catch up with the news...
Well? What do you think?
Before I know it, Lexington has finished preparing a luxurious meal.
Every dish is divided into small portions. It's such a vast array of foods that I don't even recognize some of them.
All of it is so delicious that I can't stop myself from sampling every bit of it.
(Wait a second...)
Are these all dishes that the past me used to love?
Aww, was it that easy to tell?
The sense of taste can bring back old memories. I thought that I might be able to help you remember everything.
Do you feel anything coming to the surface at all?
Hmm... Nothing except the realization that this is the best meal I've had all year.
It's so delicious that I can't resist eating more and more.
Heehee! Thank you for the compliments, Commander.
I'd be happy to cook different dishes for you every day.
By the way, do you have plans tomorrow?
Now that I've bought this apartment, I'll still need to re-order all of that custom-made furniture I had.
We'd better go pick out bedding at the store tomorrow, and then we'll need clothes...
It's going to be a big shopping day for us!
Now that she's back in a familiar environment, Lexington has made herself right at home.
What about the investigation?
Hmm... Is there any reason we can't just wait for the Council's findings?
In a way, isn't this world like a beautiful little dream?
We can't contact anybody, and they can't contact us, either.
In other words... There's no real reason to worry about anything, is there?
Would it be so wrong to just relax for a few days?
Even after we wake up, it won't change the fact that we've experienced this together.
If this really is just a dream, then sure.
But I think it's become clear that this is no mere dream.
Let me tell you a story, Lexington.
I told her the story of the Siren invasion, the Azur Lane, and its Commander.
After listening to all of it, she thought deeply for a while. As it turned out, this story was nothing like the version of events that she knew.
She told me her story, too.
Her story's Commander had several other titles as well – general, politician, businessperson, teacher, assistant, and more.
In this world, our stories are just stories. They're not real.
Do you think... the stories we know could just be dreams brought on by mass delusions, too?
What if all of our sadness and all of our losses... were just a dream?
What if the world we're in now is the real one, after all?
I can tell that you won't be convinced that easily, and neither will I.
*sigh*... Things have gotten so complicated.
What's real, and what's fake? We'll never know until the very end.
If this is what it's come to, then why don't we go with your old approach?
...Old approach?
You'd always say "one step at a time." Instead of fretting about the future, we have to take that first step.
Even if you don't remember me now, I only need to take that first step... to make you love me again...
She murmurs to herself quietly, but I hear every word of it.
In that case, shall we start investigating bright and early tomorrow?
Our communications might be down, but as long as someone is in this world, we'll find a way to get in contact.
For example... We could start with the Naval Department?
Things aren't what I remember, but I should still have my authority.
Nobody can stop me from going there to search for whoever I want.
Lexington refocuses herself and proposes a plan that satisfies my wants.
The investigation might shatter this sweet illusion, but she sides with me and tries to help without hesitation.
Despite the fact that this is the dream that brought her and all she loves back to life...
A torrent of memories surges up within me.
In a messy apartment, Lexington sits alone on the floor.
Ah... Why are you here, too?
It's okay. Even after what Richard did...
I know that you did everything you could...
It's just retiring me from service, relieving me of my rigging, and installing a limiter to my Wisdom Cube...
Frankly, it's much better than the worst case I was expecting.
I guess I'd better get ready to move out...
Commandeeer, are you listening? Do you like my plan?
Umm... Well, I guess it isn't so urgent that we have to rush things.
If we barged in and caused a serious commotion, things could take a turn for the worse.
Let's do this one step at a time, after all. Bit by bit.
That also means we'll need a stable and comfortable base of operations.
Say... Could I ask you to plan our whole shopping trip tomorrow?
Do you have what it takes, Master Lexington?
...I think I just might! I'll go make a plan right away, and it'll knock your socks off!

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>Fond Memory</size>

scripts.say: Office - Morning hours
I'm in the office with my secretary, Shangri-La, and about to get to work.
...What's the matter, Commander? Is there something on your mind?
Ah, so you've forgotten where you left last night's documents? That explains it.
Let's start by composing ourselves, as panicking won't solve anything. Here, have some saffron tea to help with that.
Could you tell me more about the documents? Do they have any markings, or other distinctive feature?
Hmm... So they're already bound, signed, and have the red stamp affixed, but are missing your official seal?
If my memory serves me right, those documents are in the third folder inside your left-hand drawer. They were scheduled to be posted later today.
She's been taking notes on everything ever since she became my secretary. It's been a great help.
...You know, I've been thinking. About how I've met many new people since I took up my post here.
As I'm sure you know, I prefer observing events from afar than directly participating in them...
She retrieves a picture album and pulls out out a photograph from it.

options.content: Take a look at the photo

scripts.say: Title: "Friends." Description: "Shangri-La - From gripes to smiles."
When I first arrived, I was solely focused on helping out Essex in any way I could.
I got worked up over small things for reasons I can't remember, working so hard that even she was astonished...
Hehe. Looking back at it now, I just find it funny.
She really was like that when she first arrived at port. Whatever she was doing, it had something to do with Essex.
I only learned about the other side of her a while after she'd gotten used to this place...

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>The Concerns of a Friend</size>

scripts.say: One day, at the Exercise Area...
That concludes all the exercises for today. Commander, it's time to return to the office and review our–
Oh. Good morning, Commander and Shangri-La...
Likewise. Good morning, Essex.
Shangri-La switched gears before I could even get a word in.
If I may ask... Is there something bothering you, Essex?
Huh? Why do you ask?
Now that she pointed it out, Essex's tone did seem a little concerning.
Does it have to do with how the Eagle Union's anti-sub exercise went, by any chance?
You never fail to impress with your ability to read my mind...
All I need is one glance at that gloomy look of yours to know Enterprise is the cause of it. Heheh~
Ahem! Anyway, it's nothing important. Basically: I'm tired of living in her shadow, and blah blah blah...
So... You need a strategy to beat – or at the very least, surprise – Enterprise in the next exercise?
Would you like me to help come up with a plan?
You'd help?! I-I mean... Sure.
Absolutely. I first and foremost want to be of assistance to you, but I also want to verify how accurate my behavioral analysis of Enterprise is.
I really appreciate the help. Thank you!
As someone once said, "if you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles."
So it's been since ancient times, but it rings doubly true when one is up against Enterprise.
We should combine your combat experience with my records of her in order to come up with a solid strategy.
Good point...
Let's put together a special training regime for you. We'll need to use everything at our disposal to maximize your chances of winning.
Ah, Commander, you could observe us if you'd like. This is nothing top-secret, strictly speaking.
Since she offered me, I figured "why not?" and decided to come along.

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>Clash of Minds</size>

scripts.say: Later, at the Exercise Area...
Shangri-La's and Essex's special training was under way.
Glad to see you could make it, Commander. Now, Shangri-La, what are we doing today?
Well, based on the data I gathered from the previous exercise...
In a simple 1-versus-1 battle against her, your odds of winning are rather low.
However, if you avoid direct confrontation and team up on her, you may stand a good chance at defeating her.
I say we test the plan I devised to see how it works in practice.
I see... So I can gain the upper hand by splitting my forces like this?
Indeed. Your aircraft have the technological edge over hers, and you should use this to your advantage.
Right! I've got a feeling like this will actually wo–
Before Essex can finish, a third party appeared out of the blue.
Howdy!
H-Hornet?! What brings you here?
Hornet, please, don't startle us like that.
Oh, sorry! Had no idea you'd be so deep in thought... Oh hey, the Commander's here too! What fun stuff are all y'all up to?
Essex is undergoing special training so that she can defeat Enterprise in the next exercise battle against her.
Beat Enty, huh? Sounds hard, but I love me a challenge! Mind if I join in?
Huh, interesting... It's a solid plan all right, but I feel it's based a little too much on numbers and data.
Data is the basis for all theories. For that matter, isn't Enterprise's ability also based on empirical data?
Well, yeah, but there's more to it than that. You gotta be able to improvise, or have a plan B. Things don't always go as you expect.
...It seems we fundamentally disagree on this topic. Perhaps we could have a mock battle to see whose methodology is superior.
Sure, I'm down for that! It'll be like a preliminary before the final showdown!
All right, then I say we have the battle in three days. Essex and the Commander can be our judges.
Psst, Essex... I'm sorry for dragging you into this, but will you do it?
Why not? It's not every day you get this serious about something. Hahahah.
Sounds like we have ourselves a battle, then!
And it sounded like I'd gotten dragged into being their referee...

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>Know Your Enemy</size>

scripts.say: Two days before the mock battle...
Port - Eagle Union Dormitory
Wait, you're going to ask Enterprise of all people?!
I am. After all, the quickest way to learn more about a person is to ask the people close to them.
Which, in Hornet's case, aside from Northampton, would be her sisters.
Greetings. I hope this isn't a bad time.
Not at all, but what brings you two here?
Well, you see...
Huh, so basically, you're here to ask about Hornet? You sure are diligent.
Would you mind answering our questions?
Since the answers might give you an edge over her, I'm a bit reluctant...
I say why not? This is a good chance to get to know each other, plus an opportunity to reminisce about both Hornet and myself.
Also, Shangri-La could tell us about herself and we'll forward the info to Hornet. That makes us fair and square.
Good idea...
An exchange of information it is, then. Let us do it.
All right, we'll start with Hornet. First of all, she's...
Ahh... Achooo!
*sniff*... I've got a hunch like somebody's talking about me...

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>The Enemy of My Enemy</size>

scripts.say: The day before the mock battle...
Port - Exercise Area
According to my notes, she should be here momentarily...
Whew... That was some training, all right. I'm beat.
Hm? Who are you?
Nice to meet you, Zuikaku. I am Shangri-La, an Essex-class aircraft carrier.
I know it's rather abrupt, but do you have a moment? I'd like to ask you some questions about the Yorktown class.
The Yorktown class, eh! Is this about the Grey Ghost?
Oh, no, I was actually wondering about Hornet, not Enterprise...
Hornet, huh... Might wanna ask my sister, Shoukaku. She might know more.
I'll call her over for you. Heeey! Shoukakuuuu!
What is it, Zuikaku?
It's a pleasure, Shoukaku. I have some questions, if you don't mind...
Ah, so you're gathering information to give you the upper hand over her?
In that case, I would be happy to share what I know!
She is courageous and stands up to any challenge, no matter how dangerous.
Like Zuikaku, she is tenacious and refuses to give up, even when the odds are against her.
She is a worthy opponent. I would go as far as saying she can rival the Grey Ghost in strength.
Oh, sorry, I never paused for you to ask questions... Um, Shangri-La? Are you listening?
*intense scribbling*
Holy cow, look! She's written down every single thing you said!
Their conversation, if one could call it that, carried on for a while.

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>The Ace Up Her Sleeve</size>

scripts.say: Day of the mock battle, at the Exercise Area...
Are you ready?
I'm all set. All there is to do now is put my plan into practice.
That plan's not gonna do you any good if someone throws a wrench into it!
Perhaps, but wrenches can be dodged if you know their trajectory. Especially if the wrench is slow and predictable.
Hahah! They sure sound fired up!
I'm curious to see how this will go.
We're rooting for you, Hornet!
I'm quite surprised by how many people came here to spectate...
Heheh, yeah. By the way, just so you know: mock battle or not, I'm not gonna go easy on you!
Neither will I. Now, if you're ready, let us begin!
The two were evenly matched and the battle could go either way.
Give 'em hell, planes!
There's a 90% probability that's a feint... I won't fall for that!
Tsk! Then how about THIS!
I expected you'd try that!
Looks like the pressure's mounting on Hornet.
Gathering intel on Hornet seems to be paying off for her. Hehehe~
The match isn't over yet. Hornet can still turn the tables on her.
Shangri-La will forever be out of reach if this is the best you can do!
Heh, really? I beg to differ! Poke the hornets' nest and you end up with an angry swarm above your head!
Wha–?! She's launched every bomber at her disposal?!
The surrounding area became enveloped in the white smoke of the dummy shells.
Well, I'll be damned...
They both achieved hits on each other at the same time.
So... it's a draw...

sequence:
Saffron Travelogue

<size=45>After the Battle</size>

scripts.say: The following day, at the office...
Good morning, Commander.
Shangri-La changed a bit after that battle...
Did you pull another all-nighter yesterday? *sigh*... Have I not made it clear that it's bad for your health?
...Pardon? You're worried about me?
I do appreciate the concern, but there's nothing for you to–
Howdy! I brought the gang along!
Why, hello, Hornet!
But first: I've gotta thank you for what you taught me yesterday!
For teaching you what?
The importance of keeping notes and doing research on people you're up against! Had I done the same, I might've won!
If anything, you taught me a valuable lesson: that you can't rely on data and probabilities alone.
I'd like to show you something, if you don't mind.
Shangri-La fetches a photo album from a nearby shelf.
Hey, nice pics! But who snapped them?
I got a little help from the Commander and the people who came to watch. I felt the need to fully document everything possible.
These will be added to my collection of photo albums soon, but I wanted to show these to you all before that.
Shangri-La takes out the pictures and passes them around.
My personal favorite of them all is this one...
I remember this! It's from right after our mock battle yesterday!
The photograph is of everyone who was in attendance yesterday: Essex, Shangri-La, Hornet, Enterprise, Yorktown, Zuikaku, and Shoukaku. All smiling.
I've titled it "Friends," but I don't know what to write for the description on the back. Does anyone have any ideas?
To her, this photograph represented the moment she made her first friends since arriving at the port.

sequence:
Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>1 A Secret Round Table Meeting</size>
This is a top-secret meeting upon which the fate of the port lies.
Representatives from all factions have gathered...

Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>1 A Secret Round Table Meeting</size>
To address one crucial question, that which must be discussed annually.
Where are we going on vacation this year?

scripts.say: Ahem! Greetings, tourism ambassadors, as well as my subordinate and special advisor to this council: the Commander.
Today, we have gathered to discuss a matter of utmost importance to the very well-being of our beloved port!
This will require your collective wisdom and unabashed opinions!
Her eyes dart around for a bit.
So, umm... Err...
Wh-what was the gist of this, again? Her Majesty mentioned it just yesterday... Gah, I can't believe I forgot!
(Wait, does she not even know what meeting she's in charge of right now?)
...Anyway, let's hear everyone's thoughts. Who'd like to go first?
Ah! You've saved me, subordinate...
There's a moment of confused silence until, finally, Giosuè Carducci speaks up.
Valiant, according to the agenda we were given...
As the chair of this meeting – who should have been Her Majesty Elizabeth – you are supposed to be the one to introduce the day's topic.
Heheh, well, she happened to lose a little wager to yours truly...
Ack! W-was there an agenda? I'd better find it.
Looks like I should increase my empathy index to 82.97% for now...
Valiant seems to be slow to start today, so allow me to offer the collective opinion of the Eagle Union.
Our Western-themed vacation plan received a record-breaking 87.20% approval rate.
There is a unique joy to immersing oneself in other cultures.
The unique architecture, cuisine, and atmospheres can make for unforgettable memories.
If it's a unique atmosphere you want, the view of the auroras above Murmansk is suuuper beautiful!
Ah, right! We're discussing a vacation! Frankly, calling me to chair such a meeting feels like a waste of talent!
When it comes to rich histories, unique cultures, and beautiful scenery, there's clearly no better choice than the Royal Navy. We have it all!
Vacation! I'll go anywhere as long as we're having fun! Vacation, vacation!
Vacation! I'll go anywhere as long as we're having fun! Vacation, vacation!
*reads furiously*
*sleeps furiously*
Before long, everyone starts blurting things out without listening to each other... Oddly, I can't help noticing that someone's voice is missing.
I survey the round table until my eyes land on Akashi, who is unusually quiet.
She sits politely with her hands on her knees and her back straight, with the perfect customer service smile. And yet, she has not said a word.
Say... Is there nothing to add from the representative of the Sakura Empire?
Nya?
Hmm? Did someone say "nya"?
Nya~
(There's definitely something fishy here!)
Here's an idea. If we're can't settle on a proposal yet, why not use a different method?
For example, we could hold a survey.
Hmm... Brilliant! In that case, everyone, submit your requests and suggestions to Commander's...
Before she finishes that sentence, I hear hurried sprinting coming from the hallway.
The meeting room door is thrown open with a bang. A figure rushes in like the wind and stops right in front of me.
Whoosh! Commander, urgent delivery for you!
I accept the letter. As soon as I tear it open, an elaborately printed card falls out.
Congratulations! You are the sole winner of this campaign's grand prize!
Your prize: a one-person VIP trip to the unforgettable Luxury Bay! Um...?!

options.content: I don't remember signing up for this.

scripts.say: Luxury Bay, nya! According to my very reliable sources, it's THE place to go for the ultimate vacation experience, nya!
Top-notch facilities are just the start, nya! They've got all kinds of activities, tailor-made experiences, and special views of the scenery too, nya!
You didn't even sign up, and you won, nya. That's gotta be fate, nya!
This must be the goddess of fortune herself bestowing you with a gift for all of your hard work, nya! Wasn't me, of course, nya!
As your faithful travel advisor, I'm ready to host a comprehensive vacation planning session any time you want, nya!
It does sound enticing, but...
I pick up a pen and cross out the word "one-person" on the card.
Let's upgrade that plan. If I'm going on vacation, I want everyone to come with.
It's decided then, everyone. We're going to Luxury Bay!
Better yet, let's change that survey idea. I want ideas for the Luxury Bay vacation.
Anything you'd like to do, any experience you'd like to have, let's hear it all!
If my subordinate says so, I'm sure everyone will like this idea.
Is that it? Then let's get going! I'm ready any time!
We should at least get packed first... Plus, we'll have to arrange for work to be done in our absence...
Clearly not listening at all, Z52 pulls a surfboard out from behind a filing cabinet, eyes sparkling with excitement.
The waves wait for no shipgirl! I'm gonna go scout the place out, Commander!

sequence:
Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>2 Vacation Ideas Wanted!</size>

scripts.say: The next morning, as I finish checking the daily reports, I recall the Luxury Bay survey.
I'd specifically added one rule to make sure people didn't miss the point of this: no requests involving me.
I can't say I'm not curious what they all want me to do with them.
But since I've already set up the rule, let me see what everyone asked for.
When I pick up the pile of returned surveys, I see that the first one is from New Jersey.
To my honey
Every summer vacation needs ice cream! Also, it'd be awesome if I could buy some cute clothes!
P.S. Is it really not okay to ask for something to do with you? This is too strict!
Yeah, that's New Jersey. Alright, ice cream and shopping... Noted.
Come to think of it, I haven't heard from Z52 ever since she dashed out by herself... I wonder where she is now.
I'll ask Emanuele. She can see farther with her telescope.
Commander, I'm reporting with Z52's current whereabouts.
Hmm... Target sighted approximately ten nautical miles from port. Signal stable.
Oh? She seems to be approaching...
Approaching?
Target is now eight nautical miles away! She's rapidly approaching the port!
She's entered the area and is now approaching your location!
BANG!
Z52 bursts through my office door like a cannonball, soaking wet and smelling of the sea breeze.
COMMANDEEER!
Before I can even react, she lunges at me and pulls me into a warm embrace.
I'm back!
Welcome back... Did you run into any trouble?
Haha, you know me so well! Yeah, I got lost as soon as I went out there, and then I noticed something...
She runs over to my filing cabinet, pulls a waterproof backpack out from behind it, and proudly shows it off to me.
I forgot my sea charts and navigation gear!
Why don't you wait for a few days? We can go together.
I can't wait! I gotta go check it out and find the best surfing spots for everyone!
Later, Commander!

sequence:
Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>3 Food for Energy</size>

scripts.say: In the afternoon, the mingled scents of coffee and ink fill my office.
After finishing some urgent work, I check the survey responses and find one from Zara.
Sunshine, sandy beaches, the comforting breeze... All of this is great for a refreshing vacation, of course...
Don't you feel that it's still lacking a certain something to make the holiday truly perfect?
I mean fine wine, of course. Fragrant wine is like the soulmate of a perfect vacation.
Sharing a drink with you as we gaze upon seas lit by the setting sun, sinking into that tipsy comfort... I can't imagine a more romantic moment.
This isn't a personal request for you, now – only a suggestion to enhance the vacation atmosphere.
As usual, she loves setting the right mood... I'll make a note about the wine.
Hmm, I wonder what Z52 is up to. Hopefully it's going well for her this time.
I think I'll go ask Emanuele again.
Commander, I'm reporting with Z52's current whereabouts.
Hmm... Target sighted approximately twenty nautical miles from port. Signal stable.
Oh? She's approaching again...
Has she still not made it to the destination?
Fifteen nautical miles away... No, ten!
Five. Three. One nautical mile!
The target is beelining toward you at breakneck speed–
BANG!
Commander! I'm ba–
Without even finishing the sentence, she snatches the coffee off my desk and downs it all.
Aaah, much better! But this isn't enough to fill my belly!
I just brewed that... Ah, forget it. Did you get lost again?
Commander, I'm hungry! I'm STARVING! Can we go eat? Like, right now?
I just ate lunch, though...
Seriously?! It's not good to run right after eating! Okay, I'll carry you!
...How did it come to this?
Without waiting for my rebuttal, she seizes me by the wrist and starts chanting to herself.
I'm gonna eat fried chicken, Eisbein, and stuff with the Commander! This time, I'm eating 'til I'm full!

sequence:
Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>4 The Most Important Treasure</size>

scripts.say: Evening comes, and the lights around port turn on. After reviewing my last batch of paperwork, I finally catch a breather and skim the surveys again.
One with pink text pops out at me.
This one is gaudy... Mecklenburg, I bet.
To the Nachthexe, the concept of a vacation is but the whispers of mere mortals!
What I require is a party that will rip through the silent night! A ball! The ultimate banquet!
Let electric guitars roar, drumbeats shake the earth, and the Nachthexe's melody of might and revelry echo through all of Luxury Bay!
A party, a ball... Entertainment...
I lean back into my chair and mentally sift through the list of suggestions I've received over these few days.
The coolness of ice cream, fragrance of fine wine, joy of shopping, revelry of a party... Various images and sensations swirl into a picture of one vacation.
There's only one way to put all of this together. I'll have to discuss it with Akashi tomorrow.
Speaking of, Z52 hasn't contacted us since she took twice the usual amount of food with her yesterday.
Commander, I'm reporting with Z52's current whereabouts.
Hmm... Target sighted approximately twenty nautical miles from port. Signal stable.
Twenty-five. Signal remains stable.
Thirty. Signal remains stable.
Finally...
I'm sorry, Commander. I just noticed the zoom knob's been misadjusted...
Hmm?
Z52 is rushing toward you at maximum speed.
BANG!
Once again, the door to my office is thrown open. Z52 rushes in with anxiety written all over her face.
Commander! I'm back!
What is it this time? You forget something? Got lost again?
Neither one! That's not it – I realized something important!
With utter sincerity in her eyes, she grasps my hands tightly.
All those times I had to turn back weren't because of bad navigation OR hunger!
It was because my most important treasure is still waiting at port!
Treasure...?
Yeah! I mean you, Commander!
Z52 gazes at me with a beaming smile.
Let's go together, Commander! We're setting off for Luxury Bay, you and me!
I'm deeply touched by the clear excitement in her eyes, but I take her by the shoulder and hold her in place she can drag me off.
The flight carrying everyone to Luxury Bay leaves in less than twenty-four hours.

sequence:
Spring Towards Summer!

<size=45>5 An Exciting Vacation Awaits</size>

scripts.say: At the boarding gate for our flight, the joy and excitement are palpable.
Everyone is talking excitedly about what they hope to do on their vacation.
Everyone's here, nya... Huh? Is Z52 not coming, nya? She didn't oversleep, did she, nya?
I'll check on her.
Akashi, can we talk for a second? I have some ideas regarding the Luxury Bay vacation plan.
I've been given a lot of suggestions, and I'd like to satisfy everybody...
To do that, we need a leisure area that can satisfy entertainment, dining, and shopping needs all at once.
That way, we'll have a wide range of recreation available for everyone as soon as we arrive.
If nothing like that exists at the moment, could you choose suitable location with facilities, so we can build on it when we arrive?
A leisure area... You're a business genius, nya!
I already snapped up a vacant shopping mall for dirt-cheap price, nya! Here I was thinking of how I should develop it, nya!
I see. Thanks for preparing this whole VIP plan thing.
Nya? Hehe... If you wanna thank me, then be my business partner, nya!
You'll come up with ideas and manage operations, while I lend you the space, nya. We'll share the profits 30/70 between you and me, nya!
Fifty-fifty.
Nya?! The best I can give you is 40/60, nya! That's my limit, nya!
You've got yourself a deal.
The vacation can be a test opening for the mall. Any profits I make can be used to offset everyone's expenses.
You're a tough customer, nya... Making a fortune together sounds great to me though, nya~ With your planning, I know I'll win big, nya!
Right on cue, Emanuele comes rushing over.
Commander, there's something closing in on port at awesome speed. At this rate, it'll reach your location in–
Everyone turns to look in that direction. A figure beelines toward the boarding gate, leaving a long wake behind her.
Z52 rushes over, performing a perfect drift to a halt right in front of me.
*pant* *pant*... I made it in time! Hi, Commander and everyone!
Still carrying the scent of fresh seawater in her hair, she smiles radiantly at me.
That was close! I thought I wouldn't make it! But it was surely worth it!
I spent a whole day checking out all of the sights at Luxury Bay!
Which spots are best for surfing, where the coral reefs are the prettiest... I took notes on all of it!
And I found something!
What was it?
Luxury Bay at sunrise!
When the sun is just peeking out of the horizon, the whole place shines like a luxurious fountain of gold. It's super beautiful!
Wait, don't tell me you...
Hehe, I sure did!
I left port at the crack of dawn, went as fast as I could to Luxury Bay to catch the sunrise, and then came rushing right back!
Thus, we took our flight to Luxury Bay, carrying our hopes and dreams with us.

sequence: —To Be Continued—
Iris Orthodoxy - Holy Capital
Faction Conference Hall
One day before meeting

scripts.say: Alright! Chairs and desks are all in place!
Nice! You've even arranged all the furnishings so neatly.
Yeah! I used a ruler to determine where to put them!
Oh! No wonder it looks like they've been placed with great care!
Got to live up to our reputation for great hospitality, after all!
Wait, why are we chatting? We still have work to do, Cap'n!
There's going to be a dinner party in the banquet hall after the meeting!
Those tables aren't going to set themselves!
Yes. In fact, the banquet hall is our top priority. We can't cut any corners with it.
Especially not with the ingredients. Time was running short, so Trieste went out to buy them herself.
I hope she's able to able to find everything...
You know, that reminds me of a thing I've been wondering about...
This conference was our idea and we're the ones organizing it, so why are we hosting it in the Orthodoxy?
We wouldn't have to worry about getting the right ingredients if we were doing this back home.
Yeah, that IS weird! Maestrale, you're smart – what do you think?
Umm... It's for diplomatic reasons, maybe? I'm not sure either, really.
Heehee. There are two good reasons why we're doing it here rather than home, actually.
The first is that the Orthodoxy lent us this locale. The second is that they're covering half of our expenditures, but still letting us have the honor of organizing it.
All in all, this is quite a fine arrangement for us.
That explains it...
Veneto! You're back!
Hello. I just finished revising our program, so I came here to check on you all.
You've done a great job so far. Everything looks neat and tidy and the decorations are very Sardegnian.
BEEP BEEP!
Everything's good here, Veneto. How is it on your end?
I just received a message from Trieste. She said she was out buying groceries and got help from some Iris girls.
Sounds to me like the dinner party tomorrow will go fine.
Oh, and they're done arranging the tables and chairs around the venue.
I can say with confidence that our guests will be able to treated extraordinarily well in Sardegnian style.
Excellent. I feared we'd have to start sending ingredients by plane. Glad that worst case scenario didn't come true.
What about your conference opening speech for tomorrow? Have you written it yet?
Oh... My opening speech...
Right... I'm delivering a speech tomorrow...
Umm, it still has a few details I need to fill in...
Oh boy... That doesn't sound very reassuring.
I'll come over. I won't be long!
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
I knew it. There weren't just three Arbiters that came to this branch.
Empress III... You're good at hiding.
In the end, my patience won out, though.
Now that you've involved yourself in this branch, you can't slip back into the darkness anymore.
You have access to far more resources than I do, yes, but that's not something I can't compensate for.
My plan can finally continue now, thanks to you.
...Observer?
We meet again. How are you, Akagi? Have you been sleeping and eating well?
...What do you want? It's the middle of the night. If you just want to chat, I'm going to hang up.
Hang up? That's no way to treat the person you want help from.
Help? I thought you were dead. I haven't heard from you for the longest time.
Besides, we're not friends. We're just acquaintances who exploit one another.
I know it's been a long while. I couldn't do anything about that.
But don't talk to me about "exploiting one another." I never needed you in particular. Anyone who could open a Singularity would've been fine by me.
You, on the other hand? You DID need me. Without access to my resources, who could've granted your wish?
Don't give me that look. I'm not here to waste your time. Have a look at this.
...What is this? Documents?
In your language, I guess you'd call it a... formation diagram.
You want to amplify the Watatsumi's power using the Sacred Sakura system I constructed, don't you? This is the system's operation manual.
But perhaps you've changed your mind and you're going to pin your hopes that toy you and Musashi made.
You won't get anywhere with that thing. This, on the other hand, is tailor-made for your needs.
It's all yours. Go on and take it.
...That I will.
Incidentally, have you named your operation?
I've not even thought about it yet. What does it matter?
Well, it's going to need one, so how about "Orochi"?
"Orochi"? Is this another one of your sick schemes?
No, not at all. It's just a name I came across in my database.
Orochi... The legendary serpent...
Heehee... You know what? I'll go with that name.
Great. Take the Origin Cube out of your toy and stick it into the core system. You know which tree that is, right?
Yes. I'm not stupid.
I'll... BZZZ... set up... BZZZ... and when it's... BZZZ...
BZZZ... set off... BZZZ...
BZZZZZZ...
Akagi?
Hello? Akagi?
Strange...
Is the signal being jammed?
Isn't she using the communicator I gave her?
Someone is jamming MY equipment in MY test site?
No... THAT CANNOT BE!

sequence: Iris Orthodoxy - Holy Capital
Faction Conference Hall
Evening

scripts.say: The long conference has finally come to an end. The light of dusk shines in through the windows.
Needing a break, I go for a stroll through the building's corridors rather than head for the banquet hall.
In the end, I arrive at a balcony just outside the lounge.
These castles look so picturesque during twilight.
You did stellar during the conference, Commander.
So did you. You have a tough job.
Ahahaha... Yeah, I suppose.
She smiles a somewhat tired smile and points to the lanyard hanging from her neck that reads, "Secretary."
I'm really just doing my job.
Want an apple? It's sweet and fresh. Snuck it out of the fruit bowl myself.
Thanks, but I'll pass. If I could use any fruit right now, it'd be a lemon to clear my head.
Ahahah... Figures. Must've been a rough day for you.
It's just been speech after speech from different faction reps, but the conversation hasn't gone anywhere. Just thinking about it gives me a headache.
You could say that again. This was supposed to be about the Iris Orthodoxy rejoining the Azur Lane...
I didn't think expect there would be so many layers to this topic.
The Crimson Axis was bound to push back against it. Naval HQ, too.
Then, talks drifted from the Orthodoxy rejoining the Azur Lane to whether the Azur Lane and the Crimson Axis should merge into one...
...The reforging of a unified Azur Lane? So that's the "main dish" that has drawn the attention of Naval HQ.

So much has happened. Compiler was defeated. The Northern Parliament's offensive in the Arctic. Interdimensional exploration with Flying Fortresses, that near-superimposition event, the incident with the Sacred Sakura...
One way or another, the different factions have found themselves joining hands. The once-distant dream of a reunified Azur Lane seems like it's on the verge of coming true.
But, now when everyone's in high spirits, things are starting to drag.
After Veneto and Richelieu set everything up for us, too...
What surprises me, however, is that the Iris Orthodoxy would hand over the hosting of the talks to Sardegna, given how Richelieu has been in dialogue with the Tribunal.
As for the other factions...
The Eagle Union has expressed clear support for the merger, but the attitudes of the Royal Navy and Northern Parliament have been somewhat... ambiguous.
In typical Dragon Empery fashion, they've said that they "respect the decisions of each faction and support resolving any potential issues through peaceful dialogue."
On the other side, the Crimson Axis isn't exactly a monolith either.
Though Sardegna is clearly in support, the Sakura Empire stands in staunch opposition.
And of course, Iron Blood is secretive as always, keeping their cards close to their chest.
I should've expected this much from a public conference. *sigh*... When will it end?
In other words, things have reverted to how they were before Operation Siren. When will we finally be able to move on?
Yeah... I know how you feel.
One meeting after another, plans upon plans, until even the most basic of things can't be done anymore.
So, Memphis, what do you personally think about the reformation of the Azur Lane?
Hm? You want my opinion?
Well, of course it'd be a dream come true if everyone could come together.
But, surface-level formalities aren't going to cut it. We need a more substantial alliance.
Nobody's going to stick their neck out for a token partnership. On the contrary, these constraints will only create tensions that weaken everyone involved.
What about you, Commander? What do you think?
The same as you, really.
I want to tear down the walls between us and unite all the factions.
But as it is now, reforming the Azur Lane won't bring much change at all.
All that would do is create the illusion of an alliance while we plot against each other in secret. A repeat of the past; coexistence without cooperation.
Just talking at the negotiating table won't solve anything.
We need to create some sort of opportunity if we want to actually break this deadlock...
An opportunity, eh... How about this?
Memphis sends a document over to my device.
A review of the near-superimposition event and a status report on the Tribunal's fleet?
Yup. I discovered some unusual things while I was reviewing the aftermath of the battle.
It might give you a deeper understanding of why Sardegna and the Orthodoxy have suddenly become close allies.
Maybe it'll even be the opportunity you need. I hope so, anyway.
Interesting... If this is true, I'll need some time to digest all this information.
But first, we should head to the banquet hall.
Right. I've been told the Sardegnians put the most effort into tonight's dinner party.
Let's go!
Somewhere, in an unknown location...
A galaxy of glimmering silver lights expands before my eyes.
(I was in my bed, dozing off just a moment ago...)
(I must be dreaming, then. Or maybe I'M not dreaming... It could be Shinano's, or someone else's dream.)
(Or... it could be a vision created by that conceptual weapon. The black sun...)
It's not that. It's both your dream and someone else's.
Good to see you again, Commander.
Helena? Or should I say, Helena META.
Mhm. Your Helena.
I never got to thank you earlier. Thank you for all your help in the Mediterranean.
I only did what had to be done, but you're welcome.
I have to say, you're surprisingly calm for someone who's been mind-jacked.
Most people tend to... freak out, I suppose.
Well, it's not my first rodeo.
Besides, I know you're not here to hurt me. I don't have any reason to freak out.
That's true. I would never hurt you.
...Let's cut to the chase.
You wouldn't know about it, but there's a fierce battle taking place somewhere extremely close to you.
You don't need to know who or what the battle is about, but I will say that it's forced me to use this roundabout way of contacting you.
It's for your own safety. If I could, I would've simply called you.
Methods aside... I have something to tell you, Commander.
Initiate data transfer mode. Execute.
A blue light glows around Helena before splitting up into rays, forming a cloudy stream that rushes toward me.
What's happening?!
It's safe, don't worry. Just think of it as an unusual data transfer procedure.
Don't try to fight it. Let it happen.
You simply must know what I'm about to show you.
The blue light obstructs my vision completely...
Then, a picture suddenly forms inside my mind.
A crystal with extraordinary properties has been discovered in Antarctica. It may lead to a breakthrough in the development of rigging technology.
In light of this news, Naval HQ sent out a fleet that is currently on its way there.
The group is under the command of Saratoga...
And the operation's name is... Frozen Angel.
Saratoga couldn't help herself.
She always gets passionate about anything that involves Lexington.
What will you do with this knowledge, Commander?
Naval HQ does have the power to dispatch a force. It's not wise to openly object to their command.
But, it doesn't sit right with me that they sent Saratoga's team of all people.
I'm not concerned with whether this new crystal is real or not.
What I am concerned with is the timing. It can't be a coincidence that this happened at a time when leaders from all factions, and myself, are gathered here in the Orthodoxy.
It just stinks of Siren involvement.
If Naval HQ gets their hands on this and uses it to stage another Reenactment, we can say goodbye to any hope of reforming the Azur Lane.
Fair analysis.
If reforming the Azur Lane is your goal, then I can help with that.
What happens next is up to you, though. My goal here was just to pass on this information.
The battle that's unfolding now will determine the fate of test site beta. That's your branch, Commander.
If you have any plans, you should put them in motion sooner rather than later.
...The situation is very dire, in other words.
Yes. It really is.
Good night, Commander. Sweet dreams for the rest of the night.
The next day, outside the Azur Lane's provisional base...
I look up at the bright morning sun. A yawn escapes my mouth.
I didn't get much sleep last night. I couldn't stop thinking about what Helena showed me.
Thank god that today is a break day...
"Sweet dreams for the rest of the night"... Yeah, right.
Who knows what that "battle" was about... No matter. I've figured out what I'm going to do.
Time to get moving.

sequence: Iris Orthodoxy - Holy Capital
The Tribunal's Headquarters
Unknown Location

scripts.say: I'm escorted into the underground headquarters of the shadowy organization behind the reunion of the Iris Orthodoxy – the Tribunal.
I find myself inside a reception hall that's absent from any visitor's guide I've seen.
Well, hello, Commander. Welcome to the Tribunal's headquarters. What brings you here today?
I think you already know what, Clemenceau.
You wouldn't have let them escort me here otherwise.
Good heavens, no. I would never be presumptuous as to try to predict your intentions.
For better or for worse, there are countless eyes watching your every action. If something were to happen to you on my watch, I would never be able to explain that to the others.
We're no strangers at this point. Let's cut to the chase–
First and foremost, allow me to say that I harbor no suspicions against the Tribunal and have full faith in your competency.
What I want to discuss... is what your fleet did after the near-imposition incident.
Heehee. I see Memphis has been sniffing around again. Though, I must say that her abilities are matched only by her imagination.
The Tribunal was simply making it seem as though we were supporting Marco Polo whilst she was under the Arbiter's influence.
To put it simply, it was all an act.
Hardly anything worth your time and consideration, heehee.
The fact remains that your actions are indeed suspicious. But, I'm the only one who has read Memphis' report, and do not plan to share that knowledge with others.
I have no intentions on threatening you or the Tribunal...
But in exchange, I'd like you to do two favors for me.
...On that day at the World Expo, you chose to believe in us.
Of course, I'm willing to place my trust in you. You may go see her.
That's the first thing you want, I presume. What's the second?
To relay a message to Iron Blood and the Northern Parliament.
Keep it anonymous and just say it's from a credible source. You know what to do.
Hm? Sounds like you're planning something quite interesting.
Haha, I'll pass on the message. Know that you won't be disappointed by the Tribunal's "work ethic."
But first... would you mind sharing some details on what you plan to do?

sequence: Iris Orthodoxy - Holy Capital
Northern Parliament Embassy
Three days after the conference

scripts.say: Pamiat', Avrora, thank you for your work at the conference.
I've heard about the results, and they're what I expected. Don't feel anxious about them.
Meh, I had a feeling the talks wouldn't go anywhere.
They want to reform the Azur Lane through diplomacy... While it's a nice idea, it's just too sudden.
We can't set aside our ideological differences just like that, even with the Commander orchestrating things.
Then there's Naval HQ's role in the matter...
Even supposing all factions agree to a temporary pact, there's still no guarantee that true unity will bloom from it.
It will just be a repeat of the past, with us fragmenting once again.
If anything, we should thoroughly destroy the current order and–
Avrora, be careful what you say. Though we are on the Tribunal's encrypted channel, we do not know if someone is listening in.
Oh...
Ahem...
You know, it's really nice how the Orthodoxy paid part of this AND provided a venue!
It's convenient for us, yes, but "nice" isn't the word I'd use.
Since the Vichya Dominion and Iris Libre have reunited, the question of the Iris Orthodoxy's return to the Azur Lane has become front-and-center.
If they're left on their own, they're likely to become prime targets for exploitation.
The Cardinal is surely aware of this, and so she "nicely" sprung into action to petition Comrade Commander for help.
Therefore, by establishing this conference, they'll at least be able to protect their homeland.
What about Sardegna, then? They don't really expect one conference to resolve everything, do they?
...Knowing them, maybe they do.
Perhaps they are also trying to regain the honor that the near-superimposition event cost them.
I think we've spoken enough for now. Pamiat', Avrora, keep up your work at the conference.
Though I don't expect anything to come out of this, we should let them have their moment of glory.
Of course. Leave it to us.
Before I go, there's one thing I want you to bear in mind.
Kronshtadt has informed me that the frequency of the term "Antarctica" has risen drastically in the Tribunal's transmissions.
One possibility is that one of the Orthodoxy's Basilicas lie there, but another is that Iron Blood has found something and told the Tribunal about it.
I have already tasked a team to investigate further. In the meantime, I ask the two of you to keep an eye on the other factions at the conference.
Antarctica... Understood. We'll look into it as well.
Pacific Ocean - Iron Blood Floating Fortress
Antarctica again, you say?
Yes. We've picked up Observer's trail.
Our investigation led us to conclude her mainframe is somewhere in the South Atlantic, the Central Pacific, the Southern Ocean, or the Mediterranean.
Having said that, it's been long since she last showed herself.
She has almost never directly engaged us in combat before, so our intel on her is severely lacking.
But, judging by her disposition, she's most likely hiding in an unexplored location that connects to another ocean.
If we narrow our scope down using those constraints, we're left with the Southern Ocean.
Also, if I may ask – why did you say, Antarctica "again"?
I've come across some odd intel about it.
The Eagle Union and the Northern Parliament have been talking about Naval HQ doing something there. The Tribunal's intel network picked up on it.
Are they searching for Observer's mainframe? No, wait, Naval HQ wouldn't be doing that...
Exactly. We can rule that out.
I asked some people stationed nearby to investigate, and not long after, an unusual thawing phenomenon was observed in an Antarctic mountain range.
It seems they've discovered "extraordinary crystals."
When they analyzed the sample they collected, they found out that these crystals seem to resonate with riggings.
They say it's capable of drastically improving a rigging's power output and combat performance.
After that... I lost contact with them.
Wait, they stopped responding to you?
I could see why the Eagle Union and the Northern Parliament would also want to get their hands on the crystals, but I can't see them attacking us for it.
There are no Reenactments going on in that region either, for that matter.
I agree. It doesn't make sense to sour our relationship at the same time as the Commander is calling for all factions to reform the Azur Lane.
That leaves only Naval HQ... or the Sirens. We should probably approach this as a conspiracy orchestrated by Observer.
It can't be a coincidence. Everything lines up too well. I certainly wouldn't put this past the Sirens.
If this really is a trap to protect her mainframe, then our fleet is not the only one at risk. The Eagle Union's and the Northern Parliament's are, too.
Precisely. I want you to form a fleet and head to our Antarctic research base at once.
You'll have to improvise according to the situation.
Got it.
Old-fashioned armillary spheres, expensive astronomical telescopes, star maps drawn with pen and paper, and holographic projections of the night sky.
A vast range of implements, and furnishings that produce an atmosphere that is anachronistic and at the same time not.
The feeling was like opening the doors to a classical museum and being greeted by a curator dressed as a pop fashion model.
I'm always impressed by how unique this place is.
Thanks for the compliment. Have some tea. Now, what brings you here today?
I've come to ask about the recent happenings.
What do you mean by "recent happenings"?
Things across the world.
Very well... Tomorrow will be sunny, not a single cloud in the sky. No winds.
A beautiful day. Perfect for a walk, or drying your clothes.
That's actually useful information. Thank you.
It's been a while since you stayed at the observatory. Shall I air out your bedsheets?
No need. It's already been aired out. I don't plan to go back for a while, anyway.
Ah, would you look at that... This is a record of solar activity over the past six months.
It's crude, but still.
Huan Ch'ang takes the note covered in dense writing and shows it to Yat Sen.
Interesting... The sun's activity is increasing.
It's also been six months since the storm that covers the Empery's coast started weakening. Do you think these two phenomena are connected?
No, there's no evidence of that. However, the spike in solar activity has aided in our analysis of the storm.
Soon, our fleet will be able to break through it.
Then, finally, we'll be able to use our sea lanes again.
At long last. Chen Hai's group had to take a terrible route to reach the World Expo. No more of that.
On that note... Why DID Chen Hai do what she did back then? What do you think?
The same as you.
But I haven't said what I think.
I already know.
Misfortunes hinge upon fortune, and among fortunes is where misfortunes lie. No one knows the limit of either.
Fortune and misfortune come in turns. Isn't that right?
Yes. That is true.
Yat Sen takes the note and stands up. She turns around and starts to leave the observatory's hall.
Leaving so soon?
Yes. I have a briefing, you see. Was there anything else?
I divined something last night. Want to hear it?
...Tell me.
"The Azure Dragon is caught in thunder and fire. The Vermilion Bird falls from the heavens."
...I see. I'll start preparing once the briefing is over.
Alright. You may leave.
Meanwhile, at a secret Tribunal base...
Cardinal... the dream has changed.
Changed? In what way?
There was a Venus comb floating amidst glaciers, and it was singing...
...The Commander is right. The being that's set on invading our branch hasn't given up yet.
If it's related to what's happening in Antarctica, then I can only pray for our allies' survival.
So... what should I do?
Do what you can. Then, all that's left is to wait and see.

sequence: <size=51>Faster...</size>
<size=51>Faster, faster, faster...</size>
<size=51>...</size>
<size=51>Why now of all times?</size>
<size=51>Why did this have to happen?</size>
<size=51>Commander...</size>
<size=51>Please be safe...!</size>

scripts.say: Evasive manoeuvres! Those bloody...!
Enemy aircraft approaching from the northeast! Don't stop firing those anti-air guns! Commander's safety is our first priority!
No matter how many they send at us, we won't give an inch!
Eagle Union - Newport Harbor
A sea of flames...
The dormitory, the docks, the hangars... everything was burning...
Terror. Panic. Anguish. Rage.
In mere minutes, a former paradise was reduced to cinder and ash.
All that remained... was a sea of flames.
The Sirens' carriers must be nearby. We can't just sit here waiting to be attacked. Let me take the fight to them!
Don't be rash, Hornet. We haven't finished analyzing the intel report yet...
Don't worry about me. Just keep everyone safe. I'll be right back!
Not long ago...
Look, Commander, Newport City is just ahead of us!
Hehe, I didn't expect to find myself back on Eagle Union soil so soon.
A few days ago, I received a communiqué regarding an important military conference taking place in the Eagle Union.
As a result, the fleet is now making its way there, towards Newport City.
I wonder what this meeting is going to be about...
Oh, the welcoming committee is already waiting for us!~
Oh! If there are people waiting for us, we must reciprocate with a magnificent welcome of our own!
Huh? Haven't you heard the news yet, Victorious?
Apparently, Enterprise will be coming through here today!
Really? THE legendary hero of the Eagle Union — Enterprise? In the flesh? I'd love to finally meet her.
(We haven't told anyone about Enterprise's emergency mission, though...)
Hah, I was wondering where all this racket was coming from. I see you're as lively as ever, Hornet.
Long time no see, Baltimore~!
Commander, this is the renowned lady-killer of the Eagle Union, the gallant Baltimore!
Leave your jokes at the door, Hornet. Well met, Commander. I'm Baltimore.
I'll be in charge of showing you around Newport City.
Newport Harbor may be a naval base, but it's also a famous resort.
If you want to make some unforgettable memories here, I have some tips for you!
Unforgettable memories, huh...

sequence: <size=51>This was supposed to be an impregnable fortress, so how...</size>
<size=51>"Get out of here! This place is about to fall!"</size>
<size=51>No... I refuse...</size>
<size=51>If I have to sink, I want to be with the others...</size>
<size=51>"You must live on... Hope must live on..."</size>
<size=51>"Looks like... I won't be able to keep our Promise..."</size>
<size=51>Why... must war always be like this...</size>

scripts.say: Damn it... Is this really the end?
You've gotta get up, B-Birmingham!
Man, they sure dumped a ton of dirty work in my lap this time. Hey, what's-your-name, Burnie-sham? You still with me? Heellloooo? Come on, get up!
P-please stay away from us!
Whoa, there! Didn't your mom teach you not to point guns at people, little girl? Especially in your state! Look at you, you're barely able to see me through those tears!
Tell you what: plead for your lives like you mean it and I might just spare you~
After all, you're so insignificant that your fates aren't worth the brain cells it takes to remember!
Juneau... Don't worry about me, just get out of here...!
No way! I won't abandon my friends... or surrender to the enemy!
That's right! Well said!
Juneau! Baltimore! Thank goodness, you're still okay!
Dewey... Aylwin...! Why did you come back? Ohh! Commander!
We're saved...
You've managed to hold back a mighty enemy for such a long time. You should be proud of yourselves.
You there! "Purifier," was it? Pick on someone your own size instead!
Aha~ Bingo! You showed up right on schedule, just like Observer predicted~
The lead actors haven't assembled yet... but you chumps are going to get front row seats!!
Guh...! There's no armor that won't split open eventually! Let's see your insides!
Oh no, I'm so scared~ By the by, while you've been messing around here, NY back there's been having a city-wide barbecue party! You should go check it out!
...! Commander, if we stay here any longer, the harbour will...
Not yet, I'm not... done with you yet!
HUH?!
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
My engines...?! Argh... did she teleport behind me?!
You'll have an eternity in hell to think about that one, Siren scum!!
We... we got her!
Nice shot, Juneau!
P-please... It's embarrassing...
I felt confident leaving the cleanup work in the hands of Juneau and the others. We had to press forward to the next destination... NY Harbor.
However, Purifier's words weighed heavily upon my mind. What did she mean by "lead actors?"
Eagle Union - NY Harbor, at about the same time
W-what do we do?! The Sirens have totally broken through the defensive line!
We've detected the Sirens' main fleet! In addition to the massive numbers of production-type ships, there are also many humanoid-type Sirens!
We're getting distress calls from Newport Harbor as well!
Their airstrikes are becoming more and more oppressive! Our anti-air won't be able to keep up!
Jeez, they just keep coming one after another! You can't even call this a sneak attack anymore - this is total war!
Ugh... I still can't get in touch with Enterprise or Commander!
Argh... we're going to be in serious trouble if their communications are being jammed...
Headquarters is going to be in danger at this rate!
Okay everyone, let's calm down first. Ausburne, can your Little Beaver Squadron handle the surrounding light fleets?
You betcha! Your local allies of justice are on the case!
Rah! Rah!
Erm... is there anything I can do...?
Bataan, can I count on you to check on the status of the defense line?
Langley, Bogue, follow me. We'll wrest air superiority from those Sirens!
We won't have as many escorts as we'd normally like, but where there's a will, there's a way!
(Everyone, please be safe...)
Let's get going! We'll show those Sirens what happens when you mess with the Eagle Union!
Phew... No more Siren signals on the radar. Sister Sara wins again~!
I have news from the scout planes. A new enemy flagship has been spotted to the southeast.
There's no end to them!
Sara, watch out---!
... They didn't attack?
Did they just dive down just to... scare us?
(No, that's...)
Everyone, look! There's something coming at us from 11 o'clock!
It's so close, but there's no reading from the radar?!
(... Enterprise?!)
Eagle Union - Outside NY Harbor, present
Commander, the defenders are still holding out. Looks like we've made it in time...
One minute and thirty-five seconds ahead of schedule. Revising combat rating assessment.
If it isn't the "Tester" this time. Looks like you bunch really are throwing the kitchen sink at us.
Since you finally decided to show your face, it'd be a pity to not smash it in first.
Eagle Union heavy cruiser, Baltimore. Standard displacement: 14,500 tons. Three triple 8-inch guns. Anti-air specialization.
Looks like you've done your homework already. But you'd better add "the one who's going to smash your face in" to that list.
You're the one who's commanding the Siren forces here, aren't you?
... Once we defeat you, we will guide NY City and Commander down the true path.
And once I defeat you, we'll all be safe again.
You are nothing but weapons, instruments of death and destruction.
You would even strike down your allies without hesitation if you were ordered to.
How ironic it is that tools of death would speak of justice. Do you even know what justice is?
KABOOM!!
Run your mouth all you want, but I have my convictions.
Justice is simple enough ⁠— it's about using your power to protect your loved ones!
Gah...! My 8-inch guns aren't enough to penetrate her armor...!
Is that all you've got? What happened to the bravado from earlier?
Not yet...
You seem to have overlooked something, Siren.
Did you think that we'd blindly challenge a monster like you without having made our own preparations?
You're exactly where our Commander wants you to be!

options.content: Alabama, now!! Fire your superheavy shells!

scripts.say: What?!
KABOOM!!
KABOOM!!
Long-distance barrages from a 16-inch battery...?!
KABOOOM!!
Hehe~! Tester, while you were rambling on, those joke fleets you brought along with you have been reduced to rubble!
Did I miss 'er? Can't tell from this distance...
No, it was a direct hit. Well done.
Mm... it was only possible 'cause you provoked her.
Evolution and progress necessarily bring about suffering and sacrifice. The salvation granted in the end pales before the desolation wrought through the means.
Evolution and progress? You may talk like you're a savior, but your actions are utterly despicable.
You are nothing more than a crazed butcher, an enemy to all of humanity.
So much ignorance, but so much hatred. This falls within the expected behavior of this test subject.
I've had enough of all of you! What do you mean, ignorance? You keep prattling on about evolution and all these experiments without telling us anything!
I hate the way you bunch always show up smugly, start attacking us smugly, start rambling on smugly, and then disappear smugly!
Why can't you tell us what you want, like normal people?!
V-Victorious...
Sister Sara has arrived on the stage! Commander, I've got your back!
Hehe~! Tester, while you were rambling on, I've reduced all your little underlings to scrap metal!
If you know what's good for you, you should just surrender!
That's true... I suppose I've said too much.
But too bad for you. Time's already up.
KABOOM!!
KABOOM!!
Another enemy airstrike?! Wait, this is a Corsair! Saratoga, what are you doing?!
Eek! These aren't my planes, though!!
What's going on? Commander, quickly contact the other ships...!
BZZZZZT...
Our radio communications are down! We're going to be surrounded at this rate...
Wait, are you trying to run away?!
What are you doing? Answer me, Tester!
Running away? No, the experiment has only just begun.
This is not a "reproduction" of your "history," but it is your reality. Do show me how you all dance, my little "Actors."
Argh...! She disappeared in a flash of light...!
The Siren fleets are withdrawing en masse. We should stop trying to chase them and prioritize defending the harbor!
The corsair came from that way... Maybe it's some kind of secret message from an ally!
Hey! Whoever you are, Saratoga's coming to help!
All that remained... was a sea of flames.
No... impossible...
An unbelievable sight unfolded before us.
There "she" was, standing quietly in the midst of the Siren fleet.
It was almost as if...
The next singularity is nearing completion.
I see...
And you're sure that the Master's target is... that person?
Yes... I can feel their presence.
Surely "she" will also be there. Are you ready to face her again?
I threw away my regrets long ago...
Very well. In that case, I shall lend you aid when the time comes.
But let me warn you, you must keep moving forward...
... and never look back.

sequence: <size=51><I wonder if something like that white whale, Moby Dick, really existed...></size>
<size=51><Yes, that story of the men who chased after it, a story filled with their expectations, their hope and their despair.></size>
<size=51><But we are not like them. In our story, there is no doubt that Moby Dick will be found.></size>
<size=51><After all, our story would never end if that was not the case.></size>
<size=51><And all good stories - whether comedy or tragedy - must have closure.></size>

scripts.say: Combat Zone - Bermuda Triangle
Ugh... We've been had...! This was the Sirens' trap after all!
Victorious! Shangri-La!
We've lost communication with Task Force 11 and Task Force 17!
The enemies are several times more numerous than the intelligence report claimed.
We've been completely surrounded...
KABOOM---!!
NY City - Wharf
I must first extend my gratitude to each and every one of you for arriving in such a timely manner. I'll now explain the next phase of the operation.
As we all know, the Sirens laid siege to NY City just a week ago. Currently, many of our port facilities are still disabled from the attack.
However, due to the tenacity of our brave defenders and Commander's effective leadership, the damages ended up being a lot lighter than they could have been.
During the time of the attack, many of us, including Cleveland and myself, were unable to come to the defense of the harbor due to jamming of our communication networks.
In addition, we cannot ignore the reality that the Sirens managed to disable and bypass our radar system.
Given the status quo, the harsh reality is that we cannot deal with another potential large-scale attack from the Sirens.
As such, Headquarters has submitted a proposal - that we take the fight to the Sirens' forward base instead of waiting for our destruction. Commander has accepted this as our best plan of action.
We've determined that the most likely location for the Sirens' forward base is in the Bermuda Triangle.
There is ample evidence to support this conclusion. When the Sirens' attack began, a dark cloud was spotted forming over that area, covering the surface of the ocean.
Additionally, strong electromagnetic readings have been detected from that area, similar to when the "Winter's Crown" formed near the Northern Parliament.

Given what we know about the Winter's Crown, and the enormous manpower it took to suppress that situation, we can conclude that if a similar situation were to occur here, NY City would be in grave peril.
The primary goals of our operation are to find and destroy the Sirens' main base, secure the maritime routes around NY City, and finally...
Victorious, please explain what a "singularity" is.
I am Victorious, a carrier from the Royal Navy. I accompanied Commander to NY City in order to participate in a strategic meeting. Some of you might know me as "Robin."
Anyways...! I'm a representative of the Royal Navy. During this operation, I will be joining as an advisor.
Ahem... Victorious...
Ack! My apologies!
Um, the Winter's Crown... The best way to describe it is as an area of anomalous weather, similar to the Mirror Seas. I first encountered one during an operation in the north.

Even from a distance, we experienced significant electromagnetic disruption to our communications equipment. About half our fleet lost radio contact temporarily, and a variety of other electronic equipment was also affected.
Without being able to utilise radar, it became very difficult for us to control our aircraft. We had to rely on experience - and at times, sheer luck.
We attempted to conduct reconnaissance operations inside the Crown, but we would lose our seaplanes as soon as they entered, as if they were getting absorbed the expanding cloud.
However, what we see here in the Bermuda Triangle is slightly different.
We are still able to see into the area, meaning that we will be able to visually confirm any combat that happens inside.
In other words, we will approach from here⁠—
If we destroy the core, we will be able to stop a full-fledged singularity from forming.
In this mission, Essex, Baltimore, and I will each lead a fleet into the Bermuda Triangle.
Our final objective is to stop this singularity from forming!
In addition, Commander will directly be leading us from one of the ships, actively supporting our efforts on the front line.
Everyone, I wish you the best of luck.
Six... Seven, no, even more Sirens are closing in on us!
They must have expected us to be here.
"The Singularity has the ability to alter the course of the war." If this is true, then it must be heavily guarded.
We have to find out what is going on and stop their assault.
Heh, doesn't matter who stands in my way, I'll blow 'em all away!
Heh! Sister Sara's ready to give 'em some hell too!
There's a lot of them, but they're merely production-type models.
We haven't even seen a single humanoid-type Siren, let alone an elite...
Instead, it's just been crude copies of us...
Even if they look like us, they are just lifeless husks in comparison...
It's sickening to see so many of them...
If you're going to clone, at least give them some cute clothes and makeup!
I bet it's much easier to get those Sirens to surrender than it is to teach them to develop some taste!
That's just the way things are. When Commander gives the order, I'll need you to follow me.
Victorious's strange obsession aside, it's always disconcerting to have to aim your weapons at your image repeatedly.
The other fleets have been proceeding as planned. Let's not waste time here.
The real Baltimore is ten thousand times stronger than you!
Accursed puppet, sink to the bottom of the sea along with your nasty creators!
Hehe~♪ Looks like the way forward is clear now, Commander~
Commander? What's wrong?
Sorry, I thought I heard a voice in my head. It's probably just my imagination...

options.content: Tell Victorious that you're all right

scripts.say: Commander, once we head deeper in, the waters are only going to get rougher.
It's true... Just being here is making my chest feel uncomfortable.
Sometimes I feel like something is probing inside my head, whispering...
Ah, Commander, perhaps you've been bewitched by a Siren's song? In that case, Sara will bring you to your senses with a song of her own!
For their sake, I can endure much more than this.
What... just happened...? Baltimore? Victorious?
Apparently, Newport City was attacked by Sirens shortly after we arrived. I had lost consciousness during the turmoil...
Commander, we've been caught off guard... They somehow managed to get through without being detected by the radar screen...
The situation is looking very dire now. The entire Newport Harbor has gone up in flames, and we've lost most of our facilities.
We've begun rescue, evacuation, and triage operations, but things are only going to get worse unless we break their siege and stop their airstrikes.
They're indiscriminately bombing everything...!
I suppose that's to be expected, though... We let our guard down because Newport was far from the front lines...
What I want to know is, radar aside, how were they able to slip such a large-scale attack force past the patrols? What in the world is going on?
We'll have plenty of time to think about that later.
Right now, Hornet is out there searching for the Sirens' main fleet. With these kinds of numbers, it's going to be too much for her to handle.
Besides, if they're going to attack us on our home soil, then we'll have to give 'em a taste of Eagle Union hospitality!
That's all I have to say. Commander, please issue the orders for our counterattack!
Bermuda Triangle - Essex Fleet Combat Zone
According to the photos taken from the air, there are two Siren fleets patrolling this area.
