In terms of numbers, we're at an overwhelming disadvantage.
We're clearly just a decoy, but to think that the Sirens are still willing to face us with such numbers...
I wonder what kind of enemies Enterprise is fighting right now...
But, on the other hand... the more enemies we can draw to us, the more pressure we can take off of everyone else...!
(scribbles frantically)
H-huh? What are you doing, Shangri-La?
Don't worry about it, just keeping some regular old naval records.
"Essex is getting all dreamy thinking about Enterprise even when completely surrounded by the enemy" ...Whaaat?!?!
H-hold on! I was merely considering the best way to minimize our losses!
What kind of naval records are these anyway? Jeez, don't get distracted with this kind of stuff!
Of course I won't. After all, it falls upon me to record Essex's flustered expression for posterity.
Jokes aside, I personally could use a bit more time to prepare, but you know how the saying goes... A soldier can't choose her battlefield...
All ships, forward! Let's drop some freedom on those Sirens!
As an Essex-class, I can't afford to lose...
Especially not to you Sirens!
All right, we're finally done here.
I managed to collect a lot of combat data in this adverse weather. Once we get back, I'm going to have to analyze it...
Right, come to think of it, Essex, you know how the Bermuda Triangle has always been notorious for its extreme and sometimes unexplainable weather?
Some of humankind's earliest encounters with this area are filled with reports of a sudden storm that filled the entire sky.
Furthermore, these storms would persist for several days at a time. Only the most skilled navigators could hope to weather these terrible storms.
Do you think that the Sirens have been lurking here for hundreds of years?!
No, no, that's way too far-fetched!
Perhaps. But maybe we're looking at it from the wrong angle.
It's hard to deny the relationship between the Sirens and the strange phenomena we've been observing around the oceans.

We know that the "singularity" is capable of causing widespread anomalies. The Mirror Seas can manifest illusionary landscapes into reality, and the Sirens are known to possess rigging in the image of mythical sea creatures.
Rather than being foreign, alien entities, perhaps the Sirens have always been there, shaping humanity's perceptions and understanding of what the very seas are.
Sirens... what in the world are they...?
... Afterward, I'll have to ask Commander to investigate some of these unexpected phenomena that we assumed to be unrelated.
But right now, we'll stick to the original plan and make our way towards the middle!
Bermuda Triangle - Combat Zone
Commander, all fleets are progressing smoothly, and are now advancing as planned to the central area.
We're encountering fewer and fewer Siren forces as we push towards the center.
Perhaps they destroyed all of their forces in the sneak attack...
Whatever the reason might be, though, I'll gladly take it.
Commander, I'm a bit interested in that additional objective. That is, to investigate the identity of the "mysterious individual."
That's also why North Carolina and Washington are with us. They appear to have seen this mysterious ship during their last excursion into the Mirror Seas.
When that ship attacked NY City, it was said that the silhouette of her riggings resembled my own...
Commander has also seen that ship. For all three of us to be assembled in this fleet, it can be said that our true purpose is to meet her face-to-face.
Sorry that I didn't tell you earlier, Washington.
It's cool. Doesn't really bother me.
Whoever the hell they are, they've fought back some of the elite Sirens. However, they clearly aren't on our side either.
If what Saratoga and Commander said about her being allied with the Sirens during their attack on NY City is true, then we'll have to steel ourselves for a confrontation.
That's right... We should be approaching our target very soon.
I don't like the feeling of this... My skin's beginning to crawl...
The other fleets should be joining up with us shortly. Everyone, let's push forward carefully!
Ugh... Just when I thought they couldn't get any more tasteless...
They're even sending a fake Hornet at us...
Enterprise, you don't have to force yourself. I'll take care of this.
That's right. Sister Sara is feeling pretty angry, so she'll gladly handle this!
Don't worry, Commander, I'm fine.
Whatever it might look like, it's still just a puppet created by the Sirens.
And its only purpose is to bring harm to our loved ones. I won't hesitate for even a moment!
Enterprise, preparing for combat!
It's over.
(Even though I knew it was a fake... the thought of sinking my own sister still makes me feel sick...)
Don't worry, Enty. Hornet is all the way back in NY Harbor, healing up!
After we finish things up here, let's get everyone together and party hard!
Ah... Thank you, Saratoga.
(Enterprise...)
(Hurry... Get away from here...)
(This place was not intended for the likes of you to set foot in...)
(No, keep moving forward. Only She can change your fate.)
(You've kept her imprisoned here for too long...!)
(Not yet. There is no other option for us. As "weapons," as "ships," there is no other choice but to fight...)
Though our styles are a bit different, it usually doesn't get in the way.
... Commander!
<size=70>Hey, earth to Commander!</size>
I'm a bit jealous of your ability to fall asleep in the middle of the battlefield.
Was I really that tired? I seem to have passed out...
But what were those voices I heard...?
Huh? A conversation? No, I can only hear the wind.
Well, it's certainly true that the disturbances in this area are making our radios go haywire. Ah, Commander, did aliens maybe send you a message?
I couldn't hear anything, but something does feel off...
I can't shake the feeling... that I've seen all this before...
Déjà vu? I'm not getting anything of the sort though...
Commander, I'll take this time to give you a status update. All our fleets have arrived safely at the rendezvous point.
Ahead of us is the singularity, the point in the ocean where all the anomalous weather is converging. We'll be breaking through shortly.
We'll have our answers soon enough.
Bermuda Triangle - Baltimore Fleet Combat Zone
No evil can withstand the gunfire of justice!
Isn't that right, my partner in justice?
Ah... right, justice always prevails!
Heard you're the one who saved Birmingham in that battle earlier! You're a real champ, Baltimore!
She was the one who stood against Purifier without hesitation. If anything, she is the one who saved all of us.
You have my thanks as well.
... The Sirens aren't getting away with what they've done.
Ausburne, Little Beavers, how are you all holding out?
Back in NY City, we made use of our speed to support from the rear and disrupt the Sirens, so we haven't been in a real fight yet!
We took some light scratches, but nothing that'll slow us down! We'll fight tooth and nail in the name of justice!
... But I'm wondering, why did headquarters split us up into several fleets?
Wouldn't it better to get everyone together and smash the enemy in one go?
Our rescue effort response in NY City delayed our regrouping plan, and it took a lot of time to properly analyze the abnormal weather patterns in the Bermuda Triangle.
Furthermore, we don't know exactly where the singularity is. In order to locate it given our limited intel and personnel, the only viable approach is to divide and conquer.
Remember, the main goal of this operation is to prevent the singularity's formation, rather than to eliminate the Sirens. Then we can figure out which fleet should make the final move.
Have to say, headquarters really thought this through...
So that's how it is... Like a true hero of justice, you're so knowledgeable about everything~!
Come to think of it, Baltimore, for a hero of justice, you don't seem to talk about it a whole lot.
Ah, that's because for me, justice isn't something you preach. Justice is simply the pursuit of doing what is right.
In that regard, you, Cleveland, and I all believe in the same kind of justice.
... I do?
That's the spirit! Come, my partners of justice, and we'll take down the evil Sirens!
Justice always prevails!
Take THIS, you dirty impostor!
Whoa, Balty! I never knew you could be so zealous when you fight!
Sorry. My blood boils when I see these bastards masquerade as my friends.
I totally feel you!
Cleve, you're as cool as ever...
Montpelier, you're also super cool!
Me? But compared to her, I'm just a...
Hey, that reminds me - doesn't Birmingham have a different fighting style compared to you two? It was more... how do you put it...
She does things her own way.
There's a lot of variety within the Fletcher class as well. Everyone has their own style.
Of course, we often bump heads, but true sisters can't let those things get in the way~!
Well said, Ausburne! What matters most is that everyone gets along!
Indeed. We're about to break through into the objective area, so let's take a moment to rest and resupply first.
Destroyers, stay behind and be on alert. Everyone else will keep advancing!
This is not what was meant to happen! They are people with souls, just like us!
You see these monsters, one of which could singlehandedly annihilate the entire 2nd Fleet, as "people"?!
There has to be an explanation! If we can just talk to them, ask them about it...
Your time here as a researcher is over. We will confiscate all of your data as evidence and use it for the betterment of humanity.
As for you, you should worry more about your pending imprisonment than the wellbeing of these godforsaken monsters.
Guards, take her away...
Bermuda Triangle - Combat Zone Center
The wind is too strong...! I can't launch my scout planes anymore!
Sara can't either! Our flight decks weren't built for this kind of weather!
We're almost there! Call your seaplanes back and keep pushing forward! We'll soon be in the eye of the storm!
From there, we can launch our planes again!
Trying to control our aircraft in this storm is... almost impossible!
Wait... I think I can see Sirens coming towards us!
They must be our unwelcome welcoming party...!
Everyone, prepare for combat! We're about to break through!
Why did you come here?
Are you the "mysterious ship" the report mentioned?
In the Mirror Seas, you broke through the Sirens' forces in order to save one of our fleets.
However, to our surprise, we also saw you leading the Sirens during the attack on NY City.
And now, following the Winter's Crown incident, you once again seem to be involved with this singularity.
... Just who are you, exactly?
There you are! You beat my ass hard last time, but that ain't gonna happen again!
You got away earlier because we had to prioritize defending the harbor, but now we have you just where we want you!
I thought we could maybe become allies after you rescued North Carolina and company, but in light of what you did...
What you did - attack NY City - is unforgivable! We should've known better; you're no different from the Sirens!
Though at first glance they seem different, the electromagnetic readings emitted by the storm in the Bermuda Triangle are identical to those of the Winter's Crown!
That incident was your doing as well, wasn't it?!
Enterprise!
Stay out of this!!
What are you thinking, Enterprise?
... Why won't you answer?
You were the one person I hoped never to encounter. But, in the end, you're just a lifeless puppet being controlled by Antiochus.
You've even brought "the Key" right into my hands...
Anti...ochus? Key...?
... Everyone, protect Commander! It's not us she's after!
... That's not why I'm here. I am not here for the Key...
At least not until I've brought someone close to me back.
You haven't answered my question! Are you friend or foe?!
ANSWER ME!
Enterprise!
I'm okay, but stay alert, everyone! Enemy reinforcements, incoming!
What is this...?!
Where am I...? What happened...?!
I've warned you about making unnecessary contact with others in this timeline.
I shall hold them back. You... should know what to do.
... Appreciate it.
... There are a lot of them. Be careful.
Understood.
Where do you think you're going?! Come back! Answer me...!
You have no right to face her yet.
I am Ember. I am residue, born from an exhausted flame. But my resentment of humankind still burns.
Come! I shall appraise the strength of you beings from this timeline!
We've located Hornet and the Siren fleet!
Atta girl! I'd be setting a bad example if I don't bust her out of there!
Ah, hold on!
I understand your burning desire to protect your country, but don't go leaving me behind!
Commander, we've got to hurry as well!
Sh-she's strong...!
It appears her judgment was correct...
This timeline - hidden out of sight by Antiochus - differs from all others we've seen.
Perhaps it is because of the human with you - that commander.
(They mentioned Commander again...!)
What exactly is it you're planning?! Why did you side with the Sirens and attack NY City?
The attack on NY City... was no more than a ploy devised by the Antiochus. Its true purpose was for us to meet one another.
As for us, we are but Ember and Ash in the wind. You need not concern yourself with our names.
You cannot even begin to fathom the burden that we shoulder.
Leave us be, and pray that our paths never cross again.
"Locate and neutralize the ship responsible for the singularity"... I'm pretty sure that's what our orders from headquarters were...
All ships, fire!
KABOOM!
Dive bombers, prepare for payload drop!
KABOOM!
Commander!
... I had begun to believe you may be able to lead these girls...
Shells were speeding through the air, all targeting the mysterious ship. However, just as they were about to hit–
But if you truly insist on standing in our way, then I will have to show you...
... the limits of the strength which Antiochus has leased you!
Swift death unto evil!
There was a glimmer, followed by the sharp, swift sound of a sword's swing.
She... slashed the shells to pieces?!
A surging wave of energy came forth from the ship's sword, slashing shells, planes, and the very sea in twain.
This immense power was like that of Bismarck's, possibly even stronger.
The hell?! My riggings aren't...?!
This... is the reason why she suffers so... If I was to destroy it...
The swordswoman faced me, seemingly preparing to attack.
... If I was to destroy it...!
COMMANDEEEER!!!
That's enough, we've already finished what we needed to do here.
... Pardon. I let myself go.
It's fine. It won't matter in the long run.
I've finished installing the Beacons. We should now be able to oppose "them."
There's no need to fight these people anymore.
Why...
Why did you stop that attack?!
Don't start making assumptions... I just...
... Don't want to experience that regret twice...
... Huh?! This is...!
It's the same light that the Crown emitted!
Those two mysterious ships, so foreign but so familiar... Had I seen them before...?
They seemed to stop to look at me. Without a word or a trace of hesitation, they turned and vanished into the light.
As the light faded, the winds began to slow, the waters became placid, and the whirring of electronics returning to life could be heard throughout the fleet.
The singularity which had covered the Bermuda Triangle was completely gone, as if nothing had ever happened.
Do singularities... simply disappear like this?
It's finally over... For a minute there, Sara really had no idea what could happen~!
The danger was over, but the mystery was only getting deeper.
We immediately contacted headquarters to inform them that the source of singularity was undoubtedly a ship. And yet, that was all the information we even could give them.
We know nothing about this "Antiochus" or the ships that call themselves "Ember and Ash"...
Uhh, the singularity has disappeared, and the Siren fleet is in pieces, so...
I guess that means the operation was a success! C'mon, Commander! Let's get everyone home already!
(That second ship doesn't look like she's from the Sakura Empire... but if she is...)
Sweet, finally! Time to go home!
Saratoga, what's the matter? You've looked deep in thought for some time now.
Oh, it's nothing! I was just thinking about what a long and exhausting operation this was!
Right? It's nothing short of a miracle that we managed to keep everyone safe through all that!
Of course we're okay! We're allies of justice after all!
But if what they said is true - that the attack on NY City was just a ploy to lure us into the Bermuda Triangle - then what were the Sirens trying to achieve...?
Even up until the singularity disappeared, Tester didn't even show her face. I'm concerned about what she's brewing up next...
Until the Sirens have unconditionally surrendered, I'm sure we'll clash with her again.
We'll have plenty of opportunities to slowly settle the score in the future.
I would say that our discovery - that we can disrupt a singularity from forming - is a great leap forward for our knowledge.
Hopefully, this will help progress our understand of the singularity's mechanisms and lead to the development of a safe method of eliminating them.
Commander, I heard you came across a Hornet impostor as well?
How underhanded. They clearly were targeting Enterprise with a move like that!
After fighting the Sirens more, I think I'm starting to understand why they make these clones.
We didn't have any problems dealing with the clones, but it's clear that they strive to confuse and demoralize us by forcing us to aim at the likeness of our own comrades.
(But Enterprise wouldn't fall for such cheap tricks! I wish I was more like her...))
That reminds me... Before we sortied, we ran into Memphis. She looked quite gloomy, grumbling things like, "heh heh heh, let's hope you have a pleasant voyage" to herself...
We did, too. She's been working extremely hard behind the scenes for us. I heard she went above and beyond by contacting headquarters, planning the operation, and writing documents.
S-so that's the reason why she seemed like a whole other person when we saw her...
Well, the operation went off without a hitch, so I think we should go on a vacation somewhere~ How about you guys?
I'll go with you. Wherever you're heading, I will follow.
Hmm... If I get the time, I think I'd like to go someplace far away... Perhaps like the valley I was named after.
Where would you go, Enterprise?
I... don't really know. Even if the war was over...
Commander... have you thought about what you'll do once this war is over?
Explosions echo across the ocean.
Traces of gunpowder, flames, wrecks, and destruction.
Her lonesome, solitary war continues.
Well, well, congratulations. You've destroyed each and every last Siren in this area.
Never did I think you would return to clean up. You must've been particularly fond of my play.
... I told you not to drag uninvolved people into your experiments.
Ah, "people"... What exactly do you mean by "people"?
If you're referring to those Pawns, they were made specifically for your disposal. You can do with them as you please.
Oh, but if you're talking about "those", they are simply research subjects. You may destroy those at will.
Or perhaps... How curious... Just when "the Key" was within your grasp, why'd you let it slip between your fingers?
I will stop you, no matter what it takes.
Oh, don't be like that. Being the Prototype that you are, we can always reconcile and be friends whenever you'd like.
But you'll never save anyone if you keep walking down that path. You will only experience that same agonizing sorrow, again and again. And what a miserable life - frozen in time - that would be.
Actually, you're just avoiding reality, aren't you?
Silence...
Mind your own business...
Your only purpose is to report my whereabouts to the Host.
You have neither the power nor the authority to stop me ever again.
Get lost.
... Out of the way, Zero.
Master Arbiter is not taking visitors today.
What's the meaning of this...?
Why didn't you send reinforcements?!
And if we had, would it have changed yours or your Creator's fates?
We did everything that we could do.
We lose in every permutation of that scenario.
... I'll ask again: why didn't you send reinforcements?
Why are you here?
Why now? Why at this time? Why this "world"?
<There once was a white whale by the name of Moby Dick.>
<And the story of the men who pursued it - that is, the tale of their adventure - is connected by a chain of excitement and disappointment, hope and despair.>
<We believe that they will locate Moby Dick eventually.>
<Otherwise, their story would never have a conclusion.>
<And all stories, whether comedy or tragedy, must have closure. Regardless of how this story ends, I will continue to observe.>
If that Beacon you placed serves as a space-time signpost that can bend timelines...
Then I deem it necessary to augment my Master's authority over timeline observation, control, and travel.
We will not let you crush our hopes. We are hope itself...
Arbiter: The Empress-Ⅲ, initiate startup sequence.
Protect the future of the Past to your dying breath.
I have already witnessed their end. Pray that this world can keep me entertained...
Not on my watch!
Return to the depths you crawled out of—!!!
What good does yelling at a lifeless lump of metal do? Are you trying to blow off steam...?
So, do you even need any help here?
Haah... You both... should think... before you charge in!
Haha, sorry 'bout that. I suppose Hornet's enthusiasm is rather contagious.
Are Commander and the others safe? How about the harbor?
Thanks to your heroism, the evacuation is going smoothly, and the Sirens are being pushed back.
Thank goodness... I was able to fight without fear because I knew you'd come after all!
The only thing left now is the Siren flagship. If we wipe it out, the rest of the production-type fleet should fall apart.
Hornet, you've been hurt pretty badly, are you still able to fight?
The fiercer the battle up here, the safer things are in the back. How could I retreat at a time like this?
That decides it then. We'll make the Sirens atone for their sins in blood!
You're finished...!
Ugh... (collapses)
Hang in there, Hornet! I knew it was a bad idea to keep fighting with all those injuries...
Sorry, I'm just a little tired, that's all...
We'll handle things from here. Commander, you should stay with Hornet.
We instructed the accompanying destroyers to escort Hornet back to Newport Harbor.
The Siren fleet, cut off from its leadership, quickly fell into disarray. Though the battle continued, it was only a matter of time until they were completely routed.
However, this would still be the largest attack ever conducted on the Eagle Union's soil...
In accordance with Commander's orders, the rest of the fleet is to move to NY Harbor while we continue to carry out the evacuation.
Once we rendezvous with the ships already stationed there, we will—

sequence: <size=60>Attention, all fleets nearby NY Harbor. This is an emergency.</size>
<size=60>NY Harbor is currently under siege by the Sirens' main force. The situation is extremely dire.</size>
<size=60>The defensive fleet is currently engaging the enemy, but cannot hold out for long.</size>
<size=60>Destruction of the attacking Siren fleet and protecting NY Harbor are our top priorities.</size>
<size=60>Requesting immediate aid from any nearby fleets.</size>
<size=60>Repeat: requesting immediate——</size>

scripts.say: Eagle Union - NY City Coastal Waters
H-how is this happening... on our own soil...?
Atlanta... I'm scared...
So this is where you were.
Uwooah?!
Easy there, Juneau! It's just me, Birmingham.
Oh... B-Birmingham, huh? I was worried the Sirens had killed everyone and made their way here...
Don't fret. Our defenses are still holding strong. The Sirens won't be able to break through so easily.
R-right... I'm worrying too much...
It happens to all of us. Nobody expected the Sirens to launch a full-scale assault here.
How's the evacuation going?
Ah, um, it's basically done! Dewey and Aylwin are transporting everyone to the evacuation point...
I just wish Atlanta was here... things would be so much better...
I also wish Cleveland was... No, I can't always stay in her shadows.
Birmingham...?
We have an important role to play in times like this... Juneau, try taking a deep breath.
Hnnnh... phewww...
How's that? Calmed down yet?
I-I think I'll be okay... Thanks, Birmingham...
C'mon, then. Since evacuations are already done, let's get to the front lines and drive those Sirens back.
Y-yes! Atlanta-class light cruiser, Juneau, sortieing!
Something isn't right... That was too easy.
What were they thinking, sending such small numbers? This is still the headquarters' defensive line...
Did the Sirens really think they could breach our defenses with such a ragtag fleet?
Unless...
BOOOOOOM--------!!
We've been breached?!
Th-this is real bad!!
The Sirens' elite... they're here!
Ahahahaha! Ayoooo~♪
Purifier...
Juneau, we need to retreat to the harbor! We cannot defeat this Siren on our own!
Eagle Union - NY Harbor Combat Zone
NY Harbor is the largest naval base in the Eagle Union, complete with cutting-edge equipment and auxiliary facilities.
In addition to its strategic location, it has served as the command center for all Atlantic operations since Azur Lane's inception.
The Long Island Defense Line is responsible for protecting NY Harbor as well as its neighboring auxiliary facilities.
With its superb fortifications, large-caliber coastal artillery, plentiful supply routes, multiple military bases, as well as several operational fleets along the coast...
It is practically impenetrable, a fortress that safeguards the heart of the Azur Lane.
When humanity was driven to the brink by the appearance of the Sirens, this was the only place that managed to withstand the Sirens' onslaught.
In a sense, this is humanity's last bastion. As long as it stands, there is still hope.
After the Crimson Axis broke off, there was no choice but to send many forces to various different countries in order to try to preserve the precarious peace around the world.
It was as if everything had been dancing within the Sirens' palms...
But now there is no time to speculate about that...

If the Eagle Union were to fall, the entirety of Azur Lane would soon follow, and the delicate balance of power around the globe would be cast into chaos. The stalemate with the Sirens would be broken, potentially ushering in another massive offensive...
Time is running out...
How can this be... Commander, what should we do?
Bastards... Unforgivable...!
Farragut-class destroyer, Dewey, reporting for duty!
I'm another Farragut-class destroyer, Aylwin. Reporting for duty.
Are you two from the defense line?
Yes we are, Miss Victorious.
What about the others?
The diversion force managed to draw the Sirens' attention away, giving us the opportunity to retreat with the wounded. But after that...
We'd like to check back with the others, but the Siren fleet is blocking the way back.
It's too much for just us to handle...
B-but... as long as you're here, Commander, you'll think of something, right?
Don't worry. You've done well. With Commander's help, we'll get through this
The goddess of victory is with you! We'll keep you two safe - just stay behind us!
V-Victorious! We received a transmission from Juneau and Birmingham, informing us that they made contact with an elite Siren!
Commander, we should go save them!

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Bad Sense of Direction</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Starting today, Akatsuki will be serving as my secretary.
... Well, that was the plan, anyway. It's now past the time she was supposed to arrive.
Maybe something has happened to her?
Hey, Commander! Good morning!
Hm? You're looking for Akatsuki?
Let's see... I think... I saw her heading over there just a few minutes ago!
You're trying to find Akatsuki?
Ayanami saw her walking in that direction.
Akatsuki, eh? I believe I saw her just this morning... Hum, hum...
Ah, now I remember! I saw her hurriedly going that-a-way!
Based on these testimonies, Akatsuki seems to have gone in a circle around the port...
She must've gotten lost, somehow...
Hmm... It should be over here...
Oh?! C-Commander?!
Why, I'm already this late?! H-how shameful! The first thing I did in the morning was to try to make my way to the office...
But it seems I underestimated how far away it is...
Just as I figured, Akatsuki had gotten lost.
W-what?! The office is in that direction?!
*Whimper*... Thank you for informing me... I-I swear upon my name that I won't be late tomorrow!
Akatsuki was bowing repeatedly and deeply to express her guilt.
Being a ninja with a bad sense of direction must be a daily struggle.
Next time I have the chance, I should take her along for a stroll around the port.

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Ninja Training</size>

scripts.say: One day, I found Akatsuki and Kuroshio doing something in the area behind the academy.
Hi-yah!
Kuroshio jumped high into the air, pulled off an impressive somersault, then gently landed on the ground.
I-impressive...!
This is basic training for a kunoichi. If you train enough, this would be an easy feat even for you.
Really?! Then I shall give it a try... Haaaaahh! ... Waaahhh?!
Akatsuki lost her balance in the air. Kuroshio jumped up and caught her.
That was close... T-thank you...
Let us try again!
Haaaahh! ... Huh?... Waaahhhh?!
Like a scene out of a cartoon, Akatsuki noticed how high up she was, then began falling to the ground. Kuroshio leaped into the air and caught her again.
Grr... O-one more attempt!
This time, I shall succeed! Hah! ... Waaahhh?!
Akatsuki landed in Kuroshio's outstretched arms. She looked like a newlywed being carried from the altar by her groom.
Perhaps this is a bit too difficult for you?
Forgive me... I have not trained enough...
It's okay. Everyone's like this at the start of their training.
... Still, why did you request my special training in the first place?
Umm... Because I am a ninja, but in many ways, I don't feel like one...
So I want to become stronger! Then, when I meet Hibiki, I will surprise her with what I would be capable of!
The techniques of the shinobi are not something to be flaunted.
I understand... I'm sorry...
But, I do not object to learning them as something nice to show to one's companions. Oyashio has always been doing that, in fact.
Let us resume your training. If you fall again, I will catch you.
O-of course! Let us continue!
It appears the ninja and kunoichi get along really well.

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - A Friendly Gathering (Part 1)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Pardon the intrusion!
Ikazuchi? Inazuma? Why are you here?
You've been working the whole day, and we thought you would like some refreshments. Care for a drink?
Thank you, Inazuma!
Hey, Commander, Akatsuki hasn't been causing any trouble, has she? We were a bit concerned, so we came to check in on you!
I've heard she got lost on the first day she was to serve as the secretary.
Ugh...
And the other day when we were having tea, didn't she run off somewhere, leaving a note saying she'd gone looking for Hibiki?
P-please, don't talk about that...!
Soon after, we received that photograph of Akatsuki and two polar bears in front of a tent. For being bears, they looked rather friendly.
I see! So that is what someone having "no sense of direction" means!
Oh, yeah! Remember that one time when we were training, and Akatsuki went-
I think we should take our leave, Ikazuchi.
Huh? But I was just getting-
Our task here is done, so I believe we should head back. We wouldn't want to get in the way of their work, would we?
I see! Alright then, we're leaving now! See you two later!
Before Ikazuchi could finish her story, she and Inazuma left the room.
Thank goodness they left...
A-ahem! So, now you know much more about me. My inept side in particular. You must be very disappointed...
I swear upon my title as a ninja that I will never get lost and never be afraid of the dark again! I shall overcome my weaknesses!
Hiyah! Hooah! I'm feeling rather fired up! I'm ready to take on any task you have in store for me!
Just like that, Akatsuki took her feelings of humility and turned them into determination.

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - A Friendly Gathering (Part 2)</size>

scripts.say: Ikazuchi and Inazuma invited Akatsuki and me to come and play a game, Fleet Fighter V, that they had borrowed from Long Island.
Take that!
W-what in the?! Oh no!
Alright, let's wreck some face!
... What just happened?
K.O., flawless victory. Inazuma and Ikazuchi defeated us again.
Even in a 2v1, we can't beat Ikazuchi... I-I mean, I'm just not familiar with the controls, that's all!
Heheheh! You'd need TAS-like reaction speeds to beat me!
The final score was 10-0 for Ikazuchi.
Phew... I see! Games can be really fun!
However, it's not good to get addicted to them. Please tell her about the dangers of getting hooked on gaming, Akatsuki.
(Whispering) If only Hibiki were here...
Akatsuki? Is something the matter?
N-nothing at all! I was just thinking out loud...
About Hibiki?
I'm certain she's all right. Sometimes it's best not to worry about things like this. I'm sure the Commander agrees.
Is it...? ... I'm feeling somewhat tired, so I think I'll go home now...
What's wrong, Akatsuki?
It seems like Inazuma's attempt to reassure Akatsuki didn't have any effect.
That got me thinking... Maybe Hibiki is the reason why Akatsuki's been reading the patrol reports so thoroughly every day...

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - The Sudden Darkness</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
I suppose I'll have to work overtime to finish all my fleet paperwork today.
Everything from escort mission plans to practice schedules... We have many reports to read, indeed...
Many, many reports... For most people, TOO many...
However, a ninja must not lose heart to mere paperwork!
Let us work hard and get through it together, Commander!
At least Akatsuki seems motivated.
That's the final report! We're finished!
Oh, but it has gotten very late...
Looking out through the window, we noticed it was now late into the night.
... I'd better hurry home now... I have to attend Kuroshio's training tomorrow...
What the...?!
The lights in the office went out all of a sudden. It was pitch black.
Eek?! D-d-darkness?!
Suddenly, I felt that someone was holding onto me.
I-I-I apologize! I'm a-afraid of the dark... and I can't...
Akatsuki was trembling.
T-thank you...

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 6 - In The Dark</size>

scripts.say: The lights in the office had gone out, rendering it pitch black. I wasn't sure how much time had passed...
I'm such a hopeless case...
I'm supposed to a brave nameship, yet without my rigging, I dare not tread in dark places...
But... I MUST be brave! Dark places, more than anywhere else, are where ninjas should excel...!
Guh... And yet, my legs refuse to move...
It felt like Akatsuki was tightening her embrace of me.
I'm glad to have someone as kind, dependable, and mature as you, Commander.
When I'm with you, I feel the courage within me start to well up.
J-just let it well a little more, then I will clear the darkness enveloping us!
... Wait a moment, if I recall correctly, there was a flashlight lying somewhere on the desk...
S-so I was right!
Akatsuki let go of me then went to the desk and felt around to find the flashlight.
Ah! I've found it! Thank goodness!
Akatsuki turned it on without any further delay.
... Huh?
The flashlight illuminated the face of a certain person who must've come in after the lights went out.
Eek?!
Frightened by the sudden appearance of someone she wasn't expecting, Akatsuki fainted.
I just wanted to check how you were doing since I was in the area... Hey, a-are you okay?!
In the end, it took a while for the lights (and Akatsuki) to return to normal.
Apparently, the outage was caused by an experiment the research department was conducting... But that's a story for another time.

sequence:
Enter: Akatsuki, The Ninja!

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Promise and Hope</size>

scripts.say: Port - Seaside
There are still no signs of Hibiki...
I decided to spend my day off with Akatsuki at the seaside.
I've started getting somewhat used to waiting on Hibiki and you.
I don't feel as lonely as I once used to...
... T-that doesn't mean I've given up on Hibiki! By no means!
However, I have you to thank for helping me get to this point, Commander.
When you're by my side, I feel happy and at ease...
And most important, I feel courageous!
Whawha?!
P-please, do not tease me like that!
I've always, always wished that all of DD6 could reunite at this port! Hibiki, Ikazuchi, Inazuma, all of my little sisters are very dear to me!
No matter what would happen, we would always be together! We'd have you too, Commander!
Um, I want to tell you something! I-I think I'm in love with-
Hey, guys! What's up?
Whawha?!
(Whispering) If only you could read the mood, Ikazuchi...
Suddenly, Ikazuchi and Inazuma showed up.
I was just wondering: wanna tag along for lunch?
Sure! Let's go, together!
I wonder what expression Akatsuki would make if one day all of DD6 were to reunite here.
I'm sure she would smile with joy as deep as one can imagine.

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>1: A Morning Incident</size>

scripts.say: Huh?!? I-It's not here?! W-What should I do...
Sob sob...Is this all I can do?
Cygnet?! W-What kind of equipment is this?
F-Force! It's my "bare force" set! It's force-resistant!
Sob sob sob...Comet, Crescent...listen to me--
The clothes from your balcony...are missing?! Your drying clothes and the clothes you were going to wash...?
This...this is a disaster! But...(Stare--)
Huh?
But they're C Class, too...Why....Sob sob sob...
Don't cry, Crescent! Otherwise...I will, too...Sob sob...
B-But...where could my clothes have gone...?
Is there...a thief?

1:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>2: An Interrupted Clue</size>

scripts.say: Heheh, at times like this...just leave it to me!
Ohhh...
(Sniff Sniff) I'm pretty confident in my nose, you know?
Foxhound...looks like she's ready to bark--
It's just my nose that's strong, got it?!
I-Is that so...
A-Anyways! This way--
The scent disappears here...
This...This place is...
Yep...The Royal Navy Dorm...

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>3: Suspicion and Questioning</size>

scripts.say: I-It's not good to suspect other's so casually
Y-Yeah! We should at least do a little more investigating, right?
M-Maybe we should ask the carriers about this--
Huh? Cygnet, is this...winter training? Aren't you afraid of catching a cold?
Uh...Well, it's like this...
Oh my, this really is...But I haven't seen anything either...
That person? I don't think I've seen her today...
Hmm...I haven't seen that person, either...
I think I saw her go into her room, that one over there--

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>4: Caught Red-Handed?</size>

scripts.say: (Gulps) Th-This is the place...
In the end...we still ended up here...
E-Even if it's her, she has no right to do this...right?
L-Let's just confirm it, we should be fine...
I'll knock, okay?
...Huh? The door wasn't shut all the way?
Creeaak--(Door Opens)
T-This is...
Those...those are my clothes...
Huh?!
WHA?!?!

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>5: Justification</size>

scripts.say: So it really was her...
Has it really gotten to this point...?
Have we caught her...red-handed?
Sob...Sob sob...Please just give me my clothes back--
Eh?! W-Wait, it's not what you guys think--
Not another word! I'm calling the navy now!
So Ark Royal-san finally chooses the path of crime--
Sniff...A-Anyways, just give me my--
Y-You're wrong! I just finished a delegation and came back, only to find all these clothes hanging everywhere--
Sounds...like a very forced excuse...
It's the truth! I was just about to start picking up the clothes on the floor--
Stare--

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>6: The Witness</size>

scripts.say: Like I said! I got back and found all these clothes scattered around, and was just about to pick them up!
In the end, considering it's Ark Royal-san...
Any way you look at it, she was bound to make a big mistake sooner or later...
And we did catch her in the act...
I have no idea how all these clothes ended up in my room, either!
Muahahaha...
V-Vampire?
You've been so loud all this time. If you're interested, come take a look. It's...to die for, hahaha...
The culprit wasn't Ark Royal-san
Hahaha...Vampire's the same as usual today...Wait, do you know how these clothes got here?
Does Vampire know the truth?!
I saw it all, those clothes were blown from the destroyers' dorms here to the carriers' quarters. The wind was strong yesterday, remember?
Now that you mention it...I left in a hurry and forgot to close my window. No wonder my room was such a mess..
Does this mean...
Cygnet's clothes were blown away and landed perfectly in Ark Royal-san's room?

sequence:
Sea Star on Shore

<size=45>7: Conclusion</size>

scripts.say: Ark Royal-san, I'm so sorry...we shouldn't have suspected you so easily...
I didn't exactly make it look like I was innocent, either...I'm sorry.
B-But it really looked like something Ark Royal-san would do! Even so, I also owe you an apology. S-Sorry...
You destroyers and your shy, sorry expressions...couldn't be any cuter!
But it's true, we only made that assumption because of Ark Royal-san's usual behavior
A-At any rate, I'm glad we found my clothes. Could you please give them back, Ark Royal-san? Wearing this all this time has been so embarrassing...sniff...
I would say seeing this swimsuit is enough to make me forget any troubles, haha...
This swimsuit really suits you, Cygnet. If I had your figure, even becoming an idol...
Hmph, well I'm not jealous at all! Not even a little!
Is this what you call "impressive"? From a certain perspective, you could say...this is overpowered...
Hmm? What's "impressive"?
From a certain perspective...Vampire won't be outdone...
Erm...Was...that a compliment?
Thank you everyone for helping me find my clothes, and sorry for troubling you all--
Ahaha, as long as everything turned out okay. All this investigating made me hungry, so let's go get some food, everyone!
Okay!
C-Can we wait for me to put on some clothes before going out to eat...?
Huhuhuh, eating with a bunch of destroyers...
Stare--

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 1 Kitchen Commotion</size>

scripts.say: I'm back nya~! Whew... I bought some soba and mochi nya~
So, could you all help me make some zouni? You can be the first to taste it once it's done nya!
Woof! I smell mochi! Let's eat, right now! ...But I don't wanna leave the kotatsu, it's too comfy...
On that topic, making New Year's food is a Sakura Empire tradition... and a historian would be able to make truly traditional zouni!
We of Destroyer Division 17 shall lend you a hand! Now let us head for the kitchen!
We ought to make it fast! We've still got the backyard to clean afterwards!
I don't think we should rush it; it's important to get New Year's food done right...
"The man who chases 2 rabbits catches neither." We have to help Akashi first!
Can you handle it nya...? Making zouni takes quite some time nya. I hope you're ready for that nya!
Oh, shoot! I got it on my clothes!
I told you to be careful! Why would you mix it so hard?
Oh dear nya... Those stains aren't easy to get rid of nya...
Isokaze just never listens to people.
Well, there's no use grumbling over it now... But that reminds me, wasn't Urakaze-chan making some new clothes?
I'm not finished with them yet! And I'm only making one set anyway...
Come on, Urakaze. You're not just going to let Isokaze spend New Year's wearing dirty clothes, are you?
Fine, fine! I get it! *Sigh*, why should I have to pay for Isokaze's mistake...
Tadah! Look at these cute clothes! They fit me perfectly!
They're hardly a perfect fit, but of course they're cute. Though they're not finished, I still poured my heart into making them!
A-anyway, all that's left is adding the mochi to the mix nya. Just let me handle that nya.
Since Urakaze-chan could go crazy if someone gets her precious clothes dirty nya...
We're really sorry. We said we'd help, but in the end we hardly did anything but get in the way...
It's okay nya! Everyone's so busy around this time of year that I appreciate almost any help I can get nya.
Okay, then it's time for us to withdraw! We'll be back to help again when the zouni is ready!

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 2 New Year's Snow</size>

scripts.say: Aw yeah~ Kotatsus are frickin' amazing~
Here we have Yuudachi in her natural habitat: by the kotatsu, adamantly refusing to come out...
Well, it's winter; who can blame her? ...Oh, look outside! It seems it's started snowing.
Snow?! Oh, man, it's snowing! C'mon, Shigure, let's have a snowball fight!
Hey! Let go! Don't drag me along!
Wow, look at all that snow! It's piled up so quickly!
Hmph, I don't see why anyone would get so fired up over a bit of snowfall.
Then why is your tail wagging so much? It's moving faster than Nobunaga's unification of Japan!
No it's not! L-like I'd ever get excited over some stupid snow!
A trim here and a snip there... Fufufufu... Ahh... I can't wait to see how much he'll love my present...
...There seems to be quite the commotion outside.
Seems so... Might be those destroyers having a snowball fight.
Ufufu, perhaps we should pay them a visit later.
That's unusual... I never thought you'd care about such things.
Oh, I'm just in the mood. Would you like to join us, Souryuu?
I'm afraid I have to decline as I still have New Year's cards I must write.
In that case, why don't we tag along?
The early snow is the omen of a fortunate year... I think it would be really nice if I... would be able to enjoy the holidays together with everyone.
Why, if it isn't Izumo and Ibuki! You deserve praise for your last commission.
We're just doing our job. That doesn't warrant any praise.
That must be a snowball fight I hear... It looks like they're having fun.
Fufufufu, so you'd like to participate as well? Fine. Then let us fight so we can once and for all see who is the most worthy of being by the commander's side!
E-excuse me?! You mean to take part in the snowball fight?!
A snowball fight is not so different from a mission or practice. And the 1st Carrier Division will hold nothing back!
Heh! Carriers don't stand an icicle's chance in hell against me in a snowball fight!
Wait! We just cleaned the yard, so please don't make a mess in it!
Huh? Fine... then let's do it somewhere else. Then at least we won't make a mess of the yard.
Yeah. How about the drydock nearby? It's big and not very windy. And it's been empty for a while so I'm sure nobody would mind.
That's a great idea, Hamakaze-chan! I'm starting to feel like you know everything~
At last it's time to show the fruits of my training. Come! Let us fight like it were a real battle!
Everyone gets so excited around New Year's... I just hope they don't make a mess... *Sigh*, my stomach's already starting to ache...

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 3 The Great Snowball Brawl</size>

scripts.say: Port - Docks
Hm? I think those people are... from the Eagle Union and the Royal Navy? And I think they're having a snowball fight too?
Raaaaagh! Taste the full force of our snowball volley!
I should expect no less of the Royal Navy's most sworn and trusted friend. Then how do you like THIS?!
Snowball... sparky.
Awwhhh... I-I've been hit...
Sis! Look out!
Helena, give Cleveland backup! Use the SG radar if you have to!
Use the SG...? But it's just a snowball fight...
Ahahaha... I think I've gone a little bit overboard...
Cleveland... Don't you know you'll strain your shoulder if you throw it too hard...?
Heh, relax, I'm fine! I'm just starting to get warmed up!
Oh...? Aren't those... Sakura Empire girls?
Fueehhh... N-nice to see you, folks...
Well look at that... Who'd have thought all these people would be here... Fufufu, looks like this will be an enjoyable battle.
(Whispering) Ufufu... I just need to eliminate all the people here, then I can be with the commander forever...
Looks like Akagi is up to her same old schemes...
I see no reason to decline your challenge! But you should know that beating us will not be a simple task.
Hahah, now things are getting interesting! Knights of the Sea, let's do this!
Hmph! We will fight too! Come on, Isokaze, Tanikaze, Hamakaze!
Let's do this!
The snowball fight continued.
Fueehhh... I'm starting to feel like a snowman...
Oh dear, it's gotten so late. I say we head home. We still have to write our New Year's cards.
Right! Let's get home and eat some soba and mochi!
It seems our battle will not end today... Perhaps I was too busy thinking about my present for the commander to properly concentrate...
That was quite the engaging snowball fight. I swear we shall fight once more another day! Now I will take my leave as I still have New Year's preparations to make!
Preparations for New Year's, huh...

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 4 The Sakura Empire's New Year</size>

scripts.say: I've long heard the Sakura Empire's new year celebrations are lively... but are they really that fun?
I'm curious about that "sobaean muchy" thing Yuudachi mentioned! Man, I'm starving after throwing so many snowballs.
You wanna try Akashi's handmade mochi, huh? Let me tell you, it's like a bombshell from Flavortown!
Now that you mention it, last year Laffey taught me a lot of interesting things about Japanese New Year's.
Right. Like about gods, shrine visits, that kind of stuff?
Mochi. Want.
I mainly heard about it through Iron Blood channels. I believe they said "the more people, the better it is."
Umm... there's also the way Eugen drinks... Oh, I guess it's pretty hard to imagine how that looks...
From them, huh? I believe it's called "the more, the merrier." If you're that curious about it you may as well come to the Sakura Empire dormitory and see for yourselves.
Exactly. If you're so curious then we could invite everyone to try and show how generous the Sakura Empire is. Any objections, Akagi?
It sounds kinda weird to celebrate a holiday with some people you just fought...
Don't be like that. Sure we're from different factions, but we're all comrades just trying to keep this base peaceful! No need to be so headstrong, Montpelier! Hahahah!
W-well, if you say so...
Since the snow on your clothes is starting to melt, perhaps we should head for the dormitory soon?
You're right. We'll get sick if we wear wet clothes in this weather. Let's go right away.
All right! All units: full steam ahead! Our target is Akashi's zouni!
Whew~ My zouni is finally done nya! Who wants to be the first to...
Nya?! Where did everybody go?!

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 5 A Gift From Akashi</size>

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Empire Dormitory
Nyah... I'm glad you brought me some customers and all, but...
I should've guessed you don't stock clothes for this many people.
But then how will we help our freezing Union and Royal Navy friends...
If it's come down to this... then I have no choice but to let you all wear some new clothes I've prepared nya!
(I've got a feeling like... Akashi's planning something...!)
This outfit... it's what's known as a "kimono", right? Ahah... It seems to be made of quite fancy materials.
Whoa... these clothes... are warmer than I thought they'd be~
These decorative strings and hems... make it feel a little hard to move around.
Glasses nice. No emit sparks. Hair will be ruined...
This makes me want to perform kabuki. It's flamboyant and doesn't get in the way.
And I received a regular kimono. Somehow it feels relaxing to wear.
Now I see. These kimonos have design elements from various different factions. Hahah, how fascinating!
....W-what the heck is this...?!
I-I've got urgent business to do, so I've gotta go early!
(I wanted to see how Cleveland's would've looked...)
There's no helping that nya... Now it's your turn, Montpelier. Come on, put this on nya!
Wha?!
(So this is how a kimono looks... I think Columbia and Denver would like it.)
Hah hah ha! Now, tell me what you think about it nya!
Meh. I don't really think much of it.
H-has everyone gotten changed nya? Then come have your fill of New Year's food nya!

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 6 Dinner Takes An Exciting Turn</size>

scripts.say: Wow! Soba and zouni! Finally we get to have dinner!
So that's "mochi" floating in the pot. Let's give it a try...
Mm...! What a peculiar texture! It's so soft, yet hard to actually chew...
Mochi. Good.
It really is! It's nothing like what I'd normally eat, but it still tastes so good!
She still hasn't come back... Her soba's gonna go cold...
I'll go look for her. She might slip and get hurt now that there's snow everywhere...
Relax and don't think about it too much, Helena. Cleveland's a strong girl, she's not one to get hurt like that.
But...
Yo! I'm back!
Hahah, see? I told you she'd be fine. Good timing, Cleveland! You know, apparently this "soba" thing tastes better while it's still warm.
Oh, thanks! Hey, wait, why's there a blanket going through the table?
Because it's a kotatsu. It's our ultimate weapon to combat the cold!
So you're warming yourselves up? Sorry, but I think I'll... Hey, stop, Louis! Let go of my poncho!
It seems like everyone, regardless of their faction, has gotten intimately familiar with the kotatsu.
Yep, you can't beat the kotatsu nya...
Oh! I forgot to give you all your New Year's cards nya!
I prepared them while you were chatting earlier. Here.
Is this a flower...? How cute! Thank you so much!
This is a picture of... ah, it's a blue bird which symbolizes happiness! Thank you. I will treasure it.
Sparkle... cute. Like.
Mine has snow and flower petals, and Cleveland's has a bald eagle on it. Hm, I'm not sure... what to think...
Hm? We can swap if you like mine more.
N-no, it's fine! T-this works too... (Blushes)

sequence:
New Year's Blessings

<size=45>Chapter 7 New Year's Blessings</size>

scripts.say: Nya?! It's this late already nya?!
Late? Does that mean it's time we go visit a shrine?
We go to a shrine, say our wishes for the year, and... Umm, I can't remember what it's called...
It's called a hatsumode, the first shrine visit of the year. It's said that the first wish of the year you make will always come true.
New Year's wish, huh. (Whispering) I wonder if it'll really come true...
Hm? Did you say something?
No, nothing. Just that I'll keep working hard to try to be more like you.
Is there anything you're hoping will come true, Helena?
Huh? Me? Well...
Hold it. If you say your wish out loud, it won't come true. Your wishes are for the gods' ears only.
At any rate, we'd better go now nya! The day is coming to an end nya!
Whoa! I've never visited the port's shrine before, but I didn't expect it to be this magnificent!
It's marvelous that such a divine place exists on this base... I'm certain the gods will watch over it.
I see. I'm surprised that there'd be such an awe-inspiring building on the base's premises.
<size=24>(Whispering) Psst, Akashi-san... last year, this place was...</size>
<size=24>Shh! You don't need to tell anyone that nya!</size>
Anyhow, be quick and make your wishes nya! And don't forget you have to clap twice, put your hands together, and bow nya!
Yes... but first, it's time to appreciate some good anime...
So what did everyone wish for?
Uh, didn't Izumo tell us not to say our wishes out loud or they won't come true?
Well, people of all cultures wish for good health and happy lives. Happy new year, everyone.
That they do. Let's work together to restore peace and harmony to this world.
...Hah hah ha...
I can tell you my wish: that tomorrow I'll have the money you owe me for renting those clothes nya!
WHAAAAAT?!
Nya♪ It looks like this will be another prosperous year for me! Happy new year nya!
What a pain. Those Royal Navy reinforcements may be a bit of a handful.
Um... Z2, I think we're way past a handful here.
A battleship and an aircraft carrier are too much for little ol' me.。
When you add in their destroyer escorts...
Even Z18 can't smile at a time like this.
What the?! Am I just a smiley idiot to you...?
Z11, Z21, and Z22 got knocked out of the fight two days ago.
And now that Z13's ambush failed... there's nothing for me to smile about.
Right.
Um, Z2, why are you patting my head?
Just let me do this.
If only Z1 were here, she'd give everyone a morale boost. Too bad I don't have her sunny disposition. This is the best I can do.
Thanks. It's okay. You didn't do anything wrong. Actually, I think you're doing great, Z2~
Oh, okay...
Yeah~ You're so nice and warm, I think I can smile again!
I underestimated you...
Hehe. You can't be scared with a big smile on your face. C'mon, Z2, give us a smile!
Okay, I'll psych myself up too.
Everyone, prepare to retreat.
We've made contact! Eskimo has encountered the main force of Iron Blood destroyers. She has engaged them and requests immediate support!
Their main force? Engaging Eskimo on her own...?
What is her position?
In Rombaksfjord.
Adjust course, full speed ahead!
BOOM!
Warspite of the Royal Navy, ho!
Waah! Warspite... you're finally here! (splash)
Eskimo, are you alright?!
What happened to her?
She passed out. Her rigging has taken heavy damage, but we can get it under control.
Glad to hear it.
Hear me, Iron Blood! In the name of the Queen, I hereby give you one chance to surrender.
Here they are... Well played, Eskimo.
Warspite, I'm afraid we have no intention of surrendering.
I suppose you came here for Hardy and Hunter.
Then you choose to fight?
Yes. The Iron Blood will fight to the last.
Let's give you that proper villainous feeling.
I underestimated you.
It is an honour to meet such proud warriors in battle.
Royal Navy, to arms!
Of course a destroyer can't challenge a battleship.
Z2, I'm totally out of ammo.
It's over, Iron Blood destroyers. You've fought bravely.
BOOM!
Huh? Where did that shot come from?
Iron Blood destroyers Z12 and Z17 engaging from the rear.
Hm.
Z2 and Z18 are advancing deeper into the fjord. Should we pursue?
This fjord is a dead end, isn't it?
Yes...
Then we will deal with Z12 and Z17 first. Do not let them escape.
As for Z2 and Z18, we can give them some time.
Call it a tribute to their bravery.
Roger. Adjusting course to pursue Iron Blood destroyers Z12 and Z17!
Hm... huh?
Welcome back to the land of the living, Eskimo!
What? Warspite? Is the battle over?
Not quite. But it will be soon.
Oh... So Z2 and Z18...?
Don't worry about them. You rest up.
I really tried my hardest this time.
Yes, I saw. You fought bravely. Her Majesty the Queen will be most pleased.
Really? The Queen herself will honour me...? Hehehehe...
Every battle we fight is another small step toward ending this war.
The heavy stuff is beyond me... But I'll do what's right, and I'll do it as hard as I can.
*Yawn*, I'm kinda sleepy though.
Rest well. Once you wake up, we'll be on the road back home.
Warspite, Z17 is bearing down on you!
Roger. All ahead full. Let's finish this fight!
Um... Z9 and Z11 have been following behind us. Z17 is here, and Z12 is over there... but Z19 is still missing.
I gave the order to retreat a half an hour ago. Where is Z19...?
She was still with us when we fought Warspite. Do you think her comms got knocked out?
If that's the case, then she has no idea we're retreating.
And we're almost out of ammunition. What a bother...
Everyone's going the wrong way.
And I never expected the Royal Navy would send such a strong fleet at us.
I better get back in contact with Z2.
Oh no... my comms are broken!
Hrm... I think the original plan was to leave the fjord...
I finally got you, Iron Blood destroyer!
So fast?!
I'm not letting you get away~ Tribal-class destroyer Eskimo, attack!
They got away in the end...
Hey now, don't just go running at the enemy. Are you alright, Eskimo?
I'm fine~ Looks like they're low on ammo. They're just focused on escaping.
What's next? Did you come to chase them with me, Foxhound?
Isn't our mission to occupy Narvik?
Ummmm... well... yeah...
Pfft, well, I knew it would turn out like this. I have to go back to Warspite to screen, but she already approved your chase.
She did?! Really?!
She told me to tell you: "Don't overdo it. Signal if in danger."
Alright! Let her know Eskimo said "aye aye!"
I'm back, Warspite.
Any trouble with Eskimo?
Not a scratch on her. She's pursuing the Iron Blood destroyer full steam ahead.
Right. Leave the stranded destroyer to Eskimo while we proceed with the mission.
In the name of the Queen, and for Hardy and Hunter, let no one escape!
Z19! There you are! What happened to you?
Is that Z18...? While I was trying to get away from Eskimo, I took some hits from Icarus.
Be careful, they're still after me... is everyone else okay?
Mostly. Z2 is still trying to find us a way out. But the Royal Navy is everywhere, and we're almost out of ammo.
Then I've decided. I'll hold them off. You get back to Z2 and retreat with the others.
What are you talking about?! I've been looking for you for so long!
You're coming with me, Z19!
My drive system is crippled. I can't outrun the Royals.
Then I'll stay and fight with you. I'm not leaving you here!
...Idiot.
Now I've got y- huh? There's so many of them!
BOOM!
Woah! Not even a warning!
F-fine! Lemme at 'em!
BOOM!
It's the Royals! Their reinforcements!
No, I think it's our reinforcements! It's Z2!
H- huh?!
"Leave no man behind." I've always wanted to say that.
But the truth is: we have no way out of this fjord.
So this is how it ends...?
One, two, three... how's Eskimo gonna get out of this one...?
I have to get word to Warspite!
Are you done? I am Z2. Identify yourself, Royal Navy destroyer.
Royal Navy Tribal-class Destroyer Eskimo!
What a vigorous response. Are you not afraid?
Of a f- few Iron Blood destroyers? Not even a little bit!
(I have to stall them until Warspite gets here...!)
Well then, you're going to stay a while with me, until your reinforcements show up.
Z9, Z11... there should be six more Iron Blood destroyers.
I just got the news: all of Iron Blood's shore defenses have been disabled.
Grand.
Message from Icarus: we have defeated enemy destroyer Z13 with carrier support!
Z13... That means five left.
You seem troubled?
Watching the Z-class fight, I can't help but think of Hardy and Hunter.
Any news from Eskimo?
No contact since the report that she was engaging Z19 with Icarus.
But Icarus just reported in about Z13? I'm concerned.
Call Eskimo yourself. Get a status report.
Aye aye!

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 1 - The Cleaning Crew</size>

scripts.say: Though I was supposed to be taking the day off, I didn't particularly have anything I wanted to do, so I soon found myself wandering aimlessly around the port.
Hey, Suffolk! Let's have a race to see who can get across the corridor faster!
Eh? I think I'll pass~ Besides, I can't keep up with you anyway, so just let me space out over here~
I take my eyes off you two for a second, and....
I could hear the voices of Kent and Suffolk coming from the Royal Navy dormitory, but who was this third voice?
Kent, though I commend your dedication towards staying active, you may find that you cannot clean the floor by running all over it.
I understand... it's my mistake!
Suffolk, you haven't moved from that cranny since before I left. It must either be very cozy, or very, very, dirty.
Eh? Y-y-you've got it wrong! I've been cleaning properly!
Sure enough, it was Sheffield, who recently was assigned to secretary duties.
Hm... Master? Do you require something?
So, you're just taking a stroll...?
Well then, if you don't mind, please take a few steps back. You're soiling the freshly-mopped floor.
Ah... as professionally merciless as ever...
Also, since you're just taking a stroll, I would like to recommend you a more pleasant place to stroll to. Anywhere but here, actually, since we are currently busy cleaning.
If you return in, say, about an hour, there may be the possibility of tea and scones. Just maybe.
As soon as she finished talking, Sheffield promptly returned to her cleaning. So this is the absolute professionalism that even has Belfast's seal of approval...
Well, since I really did have nothing better to do, I might as well come back later.

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 2 - For the Sake of "Cleaning"</size>

scripts.say: Port - Shop
Early in the morning, I headed to Akashi's shop in order to take care of some business. To my surprise, someone was there before me.
Sheffield's request for Akashi was a bit unreasonable, but... Hehe, I managed to pull through in the end, nya!
Tada! Akashi's "Special Cleaning Bullets," nya!
Impressive work as always, Akashi.
Sheffield was wearing the same poker face as usual, but her eyes seemed to glimmer with excitement.

options.content: "Akashi's Special Cleaning Bullets? What are those?"

scripts.say: Master...
Ehehe, confused-looking customer over there. Yes, you, nya! Let Akashi demonstrate -
(Boom!)
In a single fluid motion, Sheffield loaded the "cleaning bullets" into her pistol and unloaded them into the wall.
Nyaa?! W-woah... what are you doing, nya! That's not what I meant by demonstrate!
Showing is more straightforward than explaining.
Something began to emerge from the place that Sheffield shot at... Bubbles...?
As you can see, I asked Miss Akashi to make me bullets containing detergent.
The heads are custom-made with special materials and will release the detergent upon impact, nya!
Indeed. With this, I will be able to clean some things that are not easily reached.
I couldn't decide if this was an awesome idea or a terrible one...
But it's rare to see Sheffield happy(?), so I suppose I'll let her have her fun.

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 3 - A Maid's Hobby</size>

scripts.say: Master, are you interested in how we maids spend our everyday life?
If that's the case, please stop by during the next day off. We'll be sure to extend our Royal hospitality to you.
So on the next Sunday, I made my way over to the Royal dormitory and rung the bell...
Master, you're here. Is there something I can do for you?
H-huh...? I thought...
It's a joke. Please come in.
I expected nothing less of Sheffield's room. Impeccable, without a trace of dust.
Here, Master. Please have some black tea.
A Royal maid's skill is truly formidable... a normal person would be hard-pressed to make tea of this caliber.
Well then, Master, you may leave whenever you want.
Somehow... I don't feel like I'm the "Master" here at all...
You're overthinking things. When I said "you may leave whenever you want," I merely meant that you may stay as long as you like.
Then... does that mean other people can't stay as long as they like? Does Sheffield kick them out?
Also, there seems to be something on the table... is this a disassembled pistol?
Guns require maintenance as well. If they are not taken care of, they will stop working, just like lazy commanders.
As terse as ever... Come to think of it, Sheffield, doesn't this gun look a bit like your rigging?
It's just a hobby of mine. Although if you're interested, Master...
Allow me to tell you everything you need to know about "work" firearms, including selection, disassembly, maintenance, accessories, and technique...
It's a bit like drinking out of a fire hose, but your lecture is undoubtedly quite interesting.
... Is that so. In that case, I will make sure your body remembers every detail. Prepare yourself.
Although her voice was still calm as always, I could somehow sense a passion, burning deep within her.
And thus, my day off turned into a seminar on firearms.

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Motivation?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Master, please wipe your feet first.
In addition to her normal duties as secretary, Sheffield insisted on keeping the office clean as well.
Cleaning is a joy, after all. There is nothing more satisfying than seeing everything in order.
That is true. Ever since you took on the secretary position, the office has been refreshing and pristine.
I can't deny that my work productivity has increased as well, but...
I simply would like to point out that there are things that even I cannot keep in order. For example, this indolent Master here who loves to daydream.
What I was going to say was, I'm not sure if it's due to the clean work environment or to your strictness.
Sorry to intrude, Master. Belfast asked me to deliver this message to you.
Here you go. Don't worry about me, it's just how we handle internal affairs. Moreover, I figured I would take this opportunity to visit a fellow member of the Maid Team.
Sheffy, you look like you're quite accustomed to secretary work.
I have no idea who you're talking to. Or what you're talking about.
Hehe, I see. I was a bit worried at first, but it seems like everything is fine over here.
Commander, Sheffy might sound rude at times, but she would absolutely never do anything that she didn't want to do.
I see... In other words...
(Bang!)
How negligent. I forgot to clean up these two dirty spots.
I felt a cold gust go past my ear... Just now, was that a cleaning bullet?
Sheffield stood there calmly as if she hadn't just fired a warning shot into the wall.
I thought I had already cleaned here, but looks like I missed a spot. How careless of me.
Oh my, it looks like I've said some extraneous things. In any case, Master, please continue to get along well with Sheffy~
Newcastle grinned mischievously as she left the room. Just what part of this looks like "getting along?"

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Weekend Rendezvous</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's personal quarters
...-ster... Master...
...Looks like I have no choice.
(Bang!)
E-enemy attack?!!
Good morning, Master.
When I opened my eyes, I could see Sheffield's cold expression in front of me, her gun still smoking. So that was the sound...
Are you sleeptalking? Did we not agree that from now on, I will be cleaning your room?
Wait, when...
Commander, I figured that your room was as sloppy and disorganised as you are. Therefore, I will need to clean it.
Come to think of it, I did ask her to help me clean...
What a helpless Master.
I also took the liberty of making breakfast. It's not as good as what Belfast makes, but for the likes of you, surely it is more than sufficient.
So that explains the pleasant smell from earlier...
Even though she said all that stuff, the food was still delicious.
Master, after finishing your meal, please leave everything where it is so I can clean it up. If you tried to move it, you'd only make a bigger mess.
She only shot me a glance from across the living room
Well, I have to admit, this place looks brand new.
I'm just doing my job as a maid. Furthermore...
Since we are spending quite a bit of time together, Master, you should also call me "Sheffy" for the sake of convenience. Saves a syllable.

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 6 - A Maid's Feelings (Part 1)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's personal quarters
Good morning, Master. Breakfast is ready, so please get rinsed. I mean, washed.
Please don't greet me as if you're one of those Destroyer girls. Surely you did not miss me that much.
But I did! Since you've been helping me around the house so much, I look forward to seeing you even on the weekends.
...I never thought that I was catering to such a depraved Master. How careless of me...
Perhaps I should not pamper you anymore, so please clean up the table after breakfast by yourself.
Surely you do not mean to tell me that you want to become a piece of bloated driftwood who expects to be cleaned up after by maids?
"I just want to be able to stay with you like this."
Days later, Port - Commander's personal quarters
I found myself awake earlier than usual. What's the time...? Seems like I can afford to go back to sleep...
I could hazily hear a conversation occuring in the hallway outside my room...
...Are you really fine with this?
This is how a maid should conduct herself. After all, I'm not as greedy as Belfast.
But Sheffy, deep down, you know you want this. And your heart isn't going to let you give up so easily...
Even if you want to pursue stability in your life, I still feel that you should pursue a stability that still allows you to be true to yourself.
I seemed to have overheard quite a difficult conversation.

sequence:
Loaded with Lead and Love

<size=45>Chapter 7 - A Maid's Feelings (Part 2)</size>

scripts.say: Port - Bedroom
Good morning, Commander. For you to be awake at this time... should I actually be saying "good night?"
Not quite, but it is true that I haven't been able to get back to sleep...
Sheffield, I was thinking of giving you a leave.

options.content: Tell her that she can go home today

scripts.say: For some reason, Sheffield's normally fluid, adroit movements suddenly ground to a halt.
Looking back at it, I realized how much I've been imposing on you unwittingly, never even paying attention to what you really wanted to do, so...
Master...
Sheffield suddenly drew close and put her hand on my forehead.
You don't seem to have a fever... did you perhaps hit your head?
I don't think I've ever been tended to more rudely.
So, that's what happened. You heard the conversation I had with Newcastle...
Good grief, as expected of you, Master. Jumping to conclusions without hearing the whole story.
Sheffield let out a long sigh.
The discussion we were having just now, was actually about romance.
R-romance?!!
Newcastle told me that since I love you, I should be brave and tell you directly.
I thought that it would be fine to just stay by your side like this, but if Master decides to develop strange misconceptions, I have no choice but to be clear.
Sheffield looked straight at me.
Master, are you troubled by the way I talk and act toward you? If so, you must understand that is the way I express my love.
Master, for me, being able to serve you forever is my one true wish, my happiness.
Master, I love you. So very much.
Even her confession was true to herself.
Though our journey together was full of detours, I knew just how I wanted to respond to her feelings

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 1: Invitation to the Banquet</size>

scripts.say: At the Command Office...
Commander, are you ready? Isn't it about time we get going?
Jeez, are you that sleep deprived? The banquet!
Now that you mention it...
A few days ago...
Mm. I'll leave this invitation with you then. I look forward to meeting you there, Commander.
After all, it was no small feat for Her Majesty to get the Iron Blood to co-sponsor an event like this.
I'd be so very disappointed if you forget to come, Commander.
In that case, I'll be looking forward to having a dance with you. Hehe, just kidding~
See you soon, Commander.
Do you remember now? *sigh* ... Aren't you glad I came to get you?
I heard that our fleet leader will be coming to tonight's banquet as well.
Things might get a bit ugly if you don't show up on time... or at all.
That's right... perhaps the real reason for tonight's banquet... was to celebrate "Her" return.

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 2: A Toast to our Gathering</size>

scripts.say: Port - Banquet Hall
Phew... We managed to make it on time... Ah! F-Fleet Leader!
Good to see you, Z23. And you, Commander.
... Didn't I tell you before? There's no reason to be so formal around me. "Bismarck" will do just fine.
Y-yes ma'am! Bismarck... ma'am!
Haha, you're as diligent as ever, Z23.
The impeccably-dressed Bismarck had just entered the venue, surrounded by a small crowd of adoring Iron Blood ships. She had broken away from the crowd to greet us.
Commander, well met. I'm grateful that you were able to join us tonight.
She sounded like she was trying to sound more dignified on purpose.
I heard that we'll also be joined by our friends from the Eagle Union tonight.
Yes ma'am! I handed invitations to them myself while coming back from the Royal dorms!
That's right! Since we're all here, we've gotta get along!
Come on, Hornet. You can't be acting the way you usually do at a place like this. Oh my... Good evening, Commander, Bismarck.
Heheh! It's not every day we get to have a big party like this, so we've gotta enjoy it while we can! Isn't that right, Commander?
As a matter of fact, I brought just the thing for the occasion! Let's kick things off right with some champagne~!
Hmm... that does seem quite appropriate.
Thank you. In that case, I suppose I'll have the honors. Cheers!
Cheers!

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 3 - May I Have This Dance?</size>

scripts.say: Towards the back of the Banquet Hall...
It's a shame this was really the closest thing to a fitting party outfit I had... *sigh*...
*giggles* I don't see anything wrong. It's cute and suits you well.
Ahaha... Well, thanks. It doesn't hold a candle to yours though, Helena.
Thank you. By the way, Cleve, there's a rumor going around about you. Something about how "you can wrap any girl around your little finger."
Ah jeez, again with that. Cut it out with the teasing already!
I'm sorry. You know I meant that as a compliment...
Et tu, Helena? I'm still a girl, after all...
I know, I know. Ah, is the music starting? The ball must have begun...
The ball, huh... Since we're already here... It's decided!
Would this ravishing beauty allow me to have a dance with her?
Ah... of course! Hehe, it'd be my pleasure~
Um, in that case, make sure to escort my properly... my knight in shining armor~

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 4 - A Novel Anniversary</size>

scripts.say: On the other side of the Banquet Hall...
Who knew there would be so many people...
Hmph. Of course there are a lot of participants. Don't you see that this is also a battle for prestige between the Royal Navy and our Iron Blood?
All you have to do is sit back and enjoy the show, Spee!
You will soon witness that true elegance belongs only to the Iron Blood!
Muahaha! Tonight, the Royal Navy shall bear witness to the terrifying cuteness of my little sister! Ah, Spee, there's something I have to do, so go ahead and enjoy the banquet first!
Wait... Aww, she already ran off...
Enjoy the banquet...? How am I supposed to do that?
Um... is that Miss Yuugure over there... from the Sakura fleet?
Ariake...? Eek?! I'm so sorry, I almost spilled juice all over you... Um, you're Miss Graf Spee from the Iron Blood, right?
Don't worry about it. You didn't get anything on my dress anyway. How about you, though? You look like you're in a bit of a hurry.
Um... y-yes... Actually...

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 5 - How to Enjoy a Banquet</size>

scripts.say: I see... you got separated from your sister and your friends...
Yes... I went to greet Commander, but then Yuudachi said something about fresh meat and bolted off.
I went to chase after her along with Ariake and Shigure, but then got lost in the crowd...
I-I see... There certainly are a lot of vibrant folks in the Sakura fleet.
I'll help you look for your friends.
R-really?
Sure. I have no idea how I'm supposed to "enjoy the banquet" anyway.
... Are those your friends over there?
Oyy, Yuugure! That's where you went! We were just wondering how you got lost in the blink of an eye.
Thank goodness, we were afraid you got lost. Hmm?
Huh? Graf Spee helped you find us?
Thank you very much for the help.
Don't worry about it... I didn't really do anything...
Actually, Miss Spee wanted to know about something!
"How to enjoy the banquet?" That's simple enough~
