I'm about to let you in on a little secret. See, the trick is, just do what you wanna do! You can go dancing like those two lovebirds over there. Or sink your fangs into some grub like Yuudachi over there.
Do what I want to do, huh... Thanks for the help, Shigure, I think I have a better idea now.
Heheh! Don't mention it!
Woah, what's that sound?

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 6 - A Brief Interlude</size>

scripts.say: Outside the Banquet Hall
Hnnnng! There are so many cute destroyers all in one place!! I'm in heaven!!
Don't make me get Enterprise, Ark Royal.

Woooooahh! Let's not get too trigger happy here. I'm just out here monitoring the situation, making sure no questionable individuals get in and whatnot. I'm absolutely not doing anything suspicious at all!
Calm down. You're only drawing more attention to yourself like that.
Ah... Phew... It's just you, Georgia. What are you doing outside?
Oh. It got a bit too noisy and stuffy in there, so I came out to get some fresh air.
How are things on your end? Managed to get any good photos?
Guhehe... You bet, so many cute little destroyers...
*cough* *cough* Ahem, I meant, no! This camera is solely for monitoring the perimeters. It definitely has no photos on it!
Well, I'll leave you to it. I'd be careful, though.
Ah, um, thanks, I suppose... Huh? Who's that over there?
Akashi? Woah, she even prepared those?

sequence:
A Prayer for Peace

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Fireworks</size>

scripts.say: Port - Empty Field
Yuubari, Shiranui, are you two ready, nya?
Ready when you are.
On your count!
All right, let's do this, nya. 3... 2... 1... light 'em, nya!
Outside the Banquet Hall
Now that... is a nice sight.
You can say that again. Oooh, the light in the destroyers' cute little faces! *click*
Port - Banquet Hall
Look outside the windows - the fireworks are starting!
Oooh...!
So pretty...
Hehe... Akashi really outdid herself this time.
Wunderbar...
One day when the seas are peaceful, I'd like to see these fireworks again with everyone.
Peace, huh...
That's right! As long as we keep working hard with Commander, we'll definitely be able to return peace to the seas!
How cliché.
Lord Bismarck! I also believe that such a day will come!
So it's you, U-556. Are you enjoying the banquet?
Mmhmm! Everything's so delicious, I've been stuffing myself! I also ran into some familiar faces from the Royal Navy!
Lasting peace... with everyone else, huh?
There's nothing to be afraid of. We're all friends here, fighting under the same banner. You're not alone anymore.
Let tonight be a taste of the peace that we're all fighting for...
I pray that one day... we will all be able to enjoy that peace together.

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>1 Libeccio Has A Dream!</size>

scripts.say: One day at the office...
This is the last batch of documents needing your approval. Go ahead and sign off on them after you've had a look.
"Crazy. Looks like I'm actually going to get off work at a normal time today."
Heh. With Littorio at your side, it's only natural that your work efficiency would go through the roof.
In any case, I shall take my leave. I do hope you enjoy this rare afternoon of leisure and get to rest early.
*knock* *knock*
Ciao, Commander!
Ah, Littorio's here as well! Hooray!
Hello there, Libeccio. What are you hooraying about?
Commander, Littorio! I, Libeccio, have a dream – to be a secretary ship as well!
Woohoo! Thanks a ton, Commander! I'll show you what I'm made of~!
Since I finished work ahead of time today, I suppose I could spare some time to play with Libeccio.
Ehh? I was being serious, Commander! I've already done my preparations for becoming the secretary ship!
What do you mean by "preparations?"
Heh heh, allow me to show you! Look, it's the "Secretary Ship Strategy Guide" that Maestrale wrote for me!
Libeccio takes out a piece of paper with notes scribbled all over it.
As expected, Maestrale's attentiveness to detail is nothing to sneeze at.
Now do you get it? I wasn't playing around - I'm seriously going to become the secretary ship!
I've already memorized everything on this sheet!
She does seem to be taking this seriously. Commander, why not give her a trial period?
You can't judge a book by its cover, and you'll never know what she's capable of until you let her try.
"That's true, but..."
Commander, I'll do my best! Even Littorio believes in me, so it's okay, right? Right~?
Well, what's the worst that could happen...

options.content: "Alright, Libeccio, I'll appoint you as secretary––"

scripts.say: Hooray! Thanks a bunch, Commander! I won't let you down!
Oh, right. I've gotta tell Maestrale first!
Libeccio blows away from the office like a gust of wind.
I know you're still having your doubts about this, but I'm sure it'll be fine.
If there's one thing I can say for Libeccio, it's that she's a hard worker. She'll definitely live up to your expectations.
But just in case anything unexpected happens, Veneto and I will be ready to help out.
So Libeccio's my secretary now, huh... Things might get pretty crazy around here.

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>2 A Series of Secretarial Slip-Ups?</size>

scripts.say: Office – The next day
Ciao~ Err, I mean... Good morning, Commander.

Libeccio greeted me in the same energetic way she always did, except suddenly she seemed to realize something. Modifying her behavior halfway, she curtsies politely, perhaps having something to do with the content of her "strategy guide."
(Um, if I remember right, I put my hands on the hem of my skirt like this and...)
Destroyer Libeccio of Sardegna, reporting for duty. I am here to send my warm regards this wonderful morning––!
Let us not waste any time! First, I'll prepare the tea for you! Um, if I remember right, Maestrale said the tea bags were...
Oh, over here! Now to find the tea set...
Commander, the tea is ready. Next up is getting all the documents organized, right?
Hehe, piece of cake! All the stamped documents go over here, and the ones that still need to be checked go in this other pile––
Huh, she seems to be... pretty good at this? Maybe I was psyching myself out over nothing.
I bring the cup of tea that was just served to me to my lips... Cold. The tea bag had been steeped in cold water.
Wha? Huh? Did I forget to boil the water? I really... just poured tap water over the tea bag?
I'm so sorry, Commander! I'll get you a new cup right away!
Eep––!
Just as Libeccio starts to run, she slips on something and reaches out towards the desk to break her fall.
Owwie, that was a close one... Gah! The documents!
Due to the force of the collision, all the papers on the desk are knocked over, strewn all over the place and even more disorderly than before.
Well, at least she didn't drop the teacup...
Ugh... I'm so sorry, Commander, I'll clean everything up...
*knock* *knock*
Ah, um, excuse me... I got a little worried so I'm here to check on how Libeccio is doing...
Maestraleeeee! Help meeeee!
Wh-what's the matter, Libeccio?
Thanks to Maestrale, we were able to get everything back on track.

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>3 A Secretary Ship's Growth</size>

scripts.say: Commander, here's the tea I made today!
I made sure to keep an eye on the time and temperature, so I'm sure it came out fine today!
I bring the cup of tea to my lips again. It certainly has the right warmth and fragrance.
So what'd you think, Commander?

options.content: "Your choice of tea was pretty good too."

scripts.say: Phew... Thank goodness!
Would you prefer if I used loose leaves instead of a tea bag next time?
Oh, but Maestrale said that I wasn't allowed to use the tea leaves until all the tea bags have been finished!
Hmph... That just means I need to train harder until I've mastered the art of tea!
Ehehe, that means you recognize that I'm getting better! Right, Commander?
Also, I've finished sorting out the documents! Here, you can take a look!
From a glance, it certainly seems like she grouped the documents correctly. Infinitely better than yesterday's pile of documents scattered all over the ground.
Ehehe, thank you, thank you~
But, I can't let this get to my head!
While reading over the documents, I notice from the corner of my eye that Libeccio's teacup is totally empty.
Well, um... Promise me you won't laugh!
To be honest... After what happened the other day, Maestrale made me take a whole bunch of lessons on how to be a secretary ship...
And she had me drink so much tea that I can't even stand the thought of having another sip...

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>4 Libeccio's Friends</size>

scripts.say: *knock* *knock*
Excuse me, Commander. I'm here to report the results of the wargame.
Got it! Good job, Z23!
You too, Libeccio. If there's anything you need help with, feel free to ask me.
Mhm, I appreciate it! I'll take you up on that later!
Ahem... In any case, Commander, I shall now take my leave.
She's quite the hard worker, isn't she?
*knock* *knock*
Oh, good afternoon, you two...
Here, documents... Laffey, isn't sleepy at all...
Are you tired, Laffey? Did you want something to hold on to?
I got an extra blanket for you, so you can take a nap on the sofa if you'd like! After I'm done with work, we can go outside and play!
Mm... Okay... Zzzzzz...
Woah, she fell asleep in the blink of an eye! Commander, I'm going to fetch the blanket for her~
*knock* *knock*
...Commander, I've brought the commission list, yes.
Oh, Libeccio... I also brought the game you asked me to lend you last time.
Woah! Thanks a lot! Just give me a moment to check the commissions.
I'll be returning to my room then. If you get stuck anywhere in the game, you know how to reach me.
Ayanami out.
Bye bye~
*knock* *knock*
Commander! And Libe too! You two must be tired, so I brought some snacks! Want to take a break?
Yaaay! You always make the best snacks, Javelin!
Ehehe~ That's because I learned from the very best, the Royal Maids!
What do you think, Commander? Pretty good, huh?
Hehe! Seeing as how you're both huge fans, I'll make more next time!
After Laffey woke up from her nap, the three girls enjoyed the rest of their afternoon playing together

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>5 The Great Friendship Operation</size>

scripts.say: I always knew that Libeccio was friendly and outgoing, but I had no idea she already managed to make so many friends.
That's the power of the secretary ship! I get to meet all sorts of shipgirls, so of course we'd get to know each other!
I want everyone to be friends with Maestrale too...

options.content: "She is a lot more reserved than you after all––"
"How do you plan to do that?"

scripts.say: Mm... She does tend to think about all sorts of complicated things...
Well, every time she tries to make friends, she always seems to get cold feet...
Everyone here is so nice though... I'm sure if they got to know her better, they'd get along just fine!
And that's where I come in!
I want to introduce all my friends to Maestrale! What do you think of that, Commander?
Ehehe, first of all is Z23! She might be the serious type, but she's also caring and reliable! I've learned all sorts of things from her!
"Given their serious personalities, I'm sure Z23 and Maestrale would be able to find common ground."
Laffey is... always so warm and fuzzy! When I'm with her, she always makes me feel warm and fuzzy as well!
Plus, she knows where the best napping spots are!
"That's a good point. I'm sure Laffey would be able to help Maestrale unwind."
Ayanami loves to play games, and she's super good at them too! The two of us play all sorts of games together!
Playing games together is always a great way to meet lots of people!
"I suppose it's true that you meet all sorts of people on the internet."
Javelin is super nice and outgoing, and she's just so easy to get along with!
"Her bubbly personality is pretty infectious, and everyone who's met her can attest to that."
That's right! You really understand everyone too, Commander!
As for my other friends... Hmm, there are so many nice girls here, I don't know who to introduce to Maestrale next!
Do you have any suggestions, Commander?
"It doesn't have to be one person. Why not introduce everyone?"
Everyone? I see, that's a great idea!
Thanks for the advice, Commander! I should go see what a good time is for everyone...
Seeing Libeccio's bright expression, I couldn't help but cheer for her operation to be a huge success.

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>6 Libeccio's Plan</size>

scripts.say: Office - A few days later
Commander, I've finished sorting out all your documents. Just sign here after you've looked over everything!
The documents that can be shredded are in this stack over here.
I originally was afraid Libeccio only wanted the secretary position because she thought it'd be fun, but turns out, she has been taking her work very seriously.
She deserved some recognition for being so dedicated to her job.
Ehehe... To be honest, at first, I didn't know if I would be able to do this job well.
Plus, there are other reasons I wanted to be the secretary ship. Thankfully, you didn't even bother asking me why.
Heehee! You know what's special about being the secretary? They get to spend the most time with you, Commander~!
You're always so busy every day. Even though Maestrale's written out your schedule and told me when you have free time, sometimes you have other things to take care of even when you're not working!
That's why I decided to be the secretary! That way, I'd get to spend every day with you!
And I get to meet so many new friends around the port. I can even help Maestrale make friends too!
Ehehe, two birds with one stone, right?
But... my rotation as secretary is about to end, isn't it... After that, I won't get to see you as much...
Libeccio's voice falters a bit, and she lowers her head.
Setting aside the secretary ship's duties, all of those things were true...
But being the secretary is a difficult job. And Libeccio persevered through her duties very admirably.
Commander?
"Even if you're not the secretary anymore, I'll find time to play with you."
You'll make time for me? Really?
Of course. We can also keep helping Maestrale make more friends.
That'd be great! It's a pinky promise then?
With a radiant smile on her face, Libeccio extends her pinky to me.
You'd better not break that promise then! Not in a hundred years!
And soon, the last day of Libeccio's secretary duties arrives.

sequence:
A Gust of Motivation!

<size=45>7 You Can Do It, Libeccio!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Main Plaza
Today is Libeccio's last day as secretary, and I was making my way back to the office from the piers, when suddenly––
I guess I made it, huh... It'll be nice to sleep in tomorrow~
Ehehe~ Commander, getting to spend so much time with you was an absolute blast, but being the secretary is really tough after all.
Working so much all the time makes you want to take it easy from time to time, doesn't it? Have you ever wanted to just stay home, Commander?
Well, uh...
Riiiight? In that case, come play with me!
Woahhh... That's super crazy!
Oh, look, isn't that Maestrale over there...?
My eyes follow in the direction Libeccio is pointing, and there I see Maestrale, walking alongside Laffey, Ayanami, and Z23.
Good afternoon, everyone~!
Oh, it's Libeccio and the Commander! G-good afternoon!
Good afternoon, yes.
Hello, you two.
'ello... Would you like to join our tea party as well?
Stop that, Laffey! The Commander is still working!
Mm... Maybe next time then...
Were you going to throw a tea party?
Not quite. Javelin invited us to attend the Royal Navy's tea party.
I see, I see! That sounds fun! Have a good time over there, Maestrale!
Th-thank you...
Office - Soon afterwards
Heh heh, Libeccio's secretary operation was a huge success!
I did a good job with my work, and I even got to help Maestrale make friends! Libeccio is super awesome!
Ehehe... I'll go make some tea for you, Commander~
Here you go, your very last cup of Secretary Libeccio's tea!
Seeing Libeccio's time as secretary come to an end was a little bittersweet, but I was proud of how much she had grown during this short time.
I bring the cup of tea that was just served to me to my lips...

options.content: Cold. The tea bag had been steeped in cold water...

scripts.say: Ehh? Did I mess up?! I'm so sorry!
Wh-wh-what should I do? We're out of tea bags... I'm sorry–!
Having that said, she still has a lot more growing to do––

sequence:
The Queen of Adventure

<size=45>1 Ace Up Her Sleeve</size>

scripts.say: Commaaandeeer! It's time to embark on another adventure with Lady Yuen!
The door to my office swings open, and in comes Fei Yuen, shouting and breaking the silence.
No can do, sorry. I still have work to do, so we'll have to save that adventure for tomorrow.
Hmph. Tomorrow, tomorrow, it's always tomorrow with you...
You have some nerve, expecting Lady Yuen to wait a whole day for you!
Oh, I know! If work is the problem then I'll help you finish it!
It'll be done before you know it, and then we can go on our adventure!
I could use the help, don't get me wrong, but...
But?
First, I'll have to gauge your ability.
Don't worry, it's a simple test with just one question.
I can do that! Ask away!
Okay...
There's a kitchen sink filled with water. It has a tap and three drainage pipes.
While the tap is running, the sink can be completely drained in 30 minutes by opening one of the pipes.
Under the same circumstances, the sink can be completely drained in 10 minutes by opening two pipes.
So, here's the question. The tap is running and the sink is full. If you open all three pipes, how long does it take for the sink to drain?
...What?
Err... Umm...
MY question is, who the HECK keeps the tap running if their goal is to drain the sink?!
That's beside the point. What's your answer?
My answer is... I dunno!
I believe in saying "I don't know" if you don't know the answer! It's called sincerity, and it's a virtue!
How's that? Do I pass the test?
No, that's an F. I'm afraid I can't let you help.
Aww... I had a feeling you'd be a tough nut to crack...
But the last laugh shall be mine!
See, I got Master Hai Tien to teach me many things before I came here!
I'm gonna argue you into submission using Empery poetry and proverbs! Then you'll HAVE to go with me on a grand adventure!
Put simply, what needs to be done today needs to be done today! Don't leave anything for tomorrow!
Put poetically, "The morrow follows the morrow, of which there are many. The one who waits for the morrow lets all be for naught."
Man, that's deep.
Exactly! So let's be quick and–
As you yourself said, this needs to be done today. I can't afford to waste any time!
That means I can't go on adventures with you. Sorry.
Huh? But Master Hai Tien said...
Oh! You sly devil, you!
Fine! Then I have to use the ace up my sleeve!
You still have more?
Heehee... It's vital to keep it secret until it's time to reveal it. You can't know about it before then!
I'm gonna leave now, but I'll be baaack!
She turns around and leaves my office with no further antics.
(No trickery or anything? She just... left? This doesn't feel normal.)
(She did glance at the teapot on my table before she left, though.)
(Did she... put something in it?)
I pour the liquid into a cup. The color looks normal, though the aroma smells a bit odd.
After thinking it through, I decide to take just a small sip.
Pffftttt!
This tastes like guaiwei!

sequence:
The Queen of Adventure

<size=45>2 Caught Red-Handed?</size>

scripts.say: After eating dinner, I decide to go for a walk. That's when I hear a voice coming from an empty spot of land.
I swear it wasn't me! This is a misunderstanding!
All the evidence points to you, Fei Yuen. Just admit you did it.
Lung Wu flew off the handle from drinking that tea you spiked with some weird stuff!
It wasn't me! I didn't spike the tea! I haven't done anything!
Really? Nothing?
Then what were you doing with a teapot full of foul tea when I came into the kitchen?
I was just... That's unrelated! It wasn't me, okay?!
What a racket. I heard you lot from all the way over there.
So that's why the tea tasted so off. Fei Yuen put something in it as a prank.
I thought it gave the tea a unique flavour profile.
There is such a thing as TOO unique, you know.
(Look at that. Our little adventurer has been caught.)
Oh, hello, Commander. I didn't see you there.
You've caught us in the middle of something.
I assure you that Fei Yuen will not be allowed near the canteen or the storeroom for a month hereafter.
For now, we're going to leave her like this until she acknowledges her wrongdoings and...
...What are you snacking on?
Um, dried fruit? It's sweet and yummy.
Hey! Those are Lung Wu's!
And I was supposed to stand guard to make sure nobody snuck a bite out of them!
Oh nooo! She was already mad, but now she's really gonna blow a gasket!
It's really, really good. You should all taste one!
Ugh! You're not at all sorry for what you've done!
Because I haven't done anything wrong!
You all say you have evidence, but none of you actually saw me put anything in the teapot, did you?!
Well... No.
Exactly! Just because you saw me holding a teapot doesn't mean I put anything in it!
That doesn't clear you of suspicion, though. You're staying right where you are.
Commandeeer! Help Lady Yuen dooown! They're punishing me for something I didn't dooo!
Come ooon! Help meee!
Pleeease! I promise I won't go anywhere near the kitchen and the storeroom for a month! Just let me dooown!
Get me dooown... Waaahhh...
(She knows how to pull on my heartstrings...)
It's too much to bear. I cave in and decide to let her down anyway.
Yay! I love you, Commander!
*sigh*... If you insist, then I'll let her off the hook just this once.
But you have to promise you'll not go into the kitchen or the storeroom for a month.
Okay, I won't! Lady Yuen is a woman of her word!

sequence:
The Queen of Adventure

<size=45>3 The Real Culprit</size>

scripts.say: After relieving Fei Yuen of her punishment, I return to my office to finish off the last thing on my task list.
I've made new tea for you, Commander. There's no weird flavorings added this time.
Right, Fei Yuen?
Eep! Y-you're scaring me, Memphis!
You need to eat something to calm down... Like some dried apple slices!
Dried apple slices?
Yeah! I snuck a few out from the kitchen! I wasn't gonna leave emptyhanded after what they did to me.
I took a few for the Commander, too, of course!
*knock knock*
Commander, do you have a moment?
Sure. Come in.
Thank you. It's about the tea prank again.
We just caught the real perpetrator.
*looks around all guilty-like*
I'm so, so sorry for what she did! This is unacceptable!
Come on, you too! Say you're sorry!
I'm sorryyy...
But you have to admit, it was a pretty good prank, right? It DID get all of you! Ahahahah!
Fuuu Shuuun!
Owww! My cheek! Stop! Ow, ow! Stop pulling on iiit!
...We should also apologize to Fei Yuen.
Sorry, Yuen. You really were innocent all along.
So it wasn't her, but Fu Shun who did it?
Yup. All of us, me included, simply jumped to the conclusion that it was Yuen.
Ugh... I told you so! I told you I didn't do anything!
Lucky for you, Lady Yuen is a lenient grownup. I'll accept these dried apple slices as an apology.
I'm glad that the misunderstanding was cleared up. How about we celebrate with a little teatime?
I'm almost done with my work, so let's head to the dorm in a minute.
That sounds great, but can we be sure the tea hasn't been tampered with?
Don't worry, it hasn't. It's made with teabags from the office. Fu Shun hasn't touched it.
Yeah, let's have tea! All that apologizing to An Shan has left me parched.
Memphis brings out cups for everyone and tops them all up with tea. We all take a sip...
*cough*! *cough*! *cough*!
What is this?! It tastes like guaiwei AGAIN!
How?! I brewed it just a minute ago!
Ahahahah! Got you!
Where Fu Shun failed, my great adventure succeeded!
No... You used me as a scapegoat!
That's so low! How could this happen?!
Ahah! Even you fell for my trick, my rival! This proves beyond a doubt that Lady Yuen is the best, the most daring adventurer at the port!
*cough* *cough*... So this was a two-pronged attack all along!
No! I wasn't in on this! She did it without my knowing!
THIS was the ace up my sleeve, Commander!
What do you think, huh? Aren't you impressed?
Feeei Yueeen!
It's the next day. A teapot sits on the table, free of any strange flavorings, next to two written apologies.
"I'll get you next time! - Fu Shun." "The crown of the best adventurer belongs to me. - Fei Yuen."

options.content: They'll have to write better than this!

scripts.say: The End...?

sequence:
Bits of Courage 

<size=45>I 「A Concert Ticket」</size>

scripts.say: One day, in the port area...
Commander nii-chan... why are you looking for Unicorn?...
Although... to be able to see Onii-chan... has made Unicorn so happy... hehe...
A few minutes, in the command room...
Unicorn... reporting in... is there anything you need from Unicorn, Onii-chan?
Is this…?  A Ticket?
Con-concert? Unicorn doesn't understand...
Unicorn will go with Onii-chan... together?
Could this be... what Unicorn has been hearing about... a date?
Hehe... to go on a date with Onii-chan. Unicorn… can’t wait...

sequence:
Bits of Courage 

<size=45>II LIVE「Four Parallel Worlds」</size>

scripts.say: At The Stardust Live Concert...
Wow! Stardust is so amazing!!!
Stardust, we love you, ahhhhh!!!
Haha...haha...
Thank you everyone for your support~ I can feel all your warmth~ Let’s rock’n roll!
L - O - V - E !! Star - dust !! L - O - V - E !! Star - dust !!
Everyone is so enthusiastic... What about Onii-chan?
Onii-chan... looks so excited...
And... so happy...
Thank you everyone~ Have Stardust’s songs been conveyed to your hearts?~ I look forward to the next time we meet!
Woooooow!
Ha~~ Stardust is absolutely the best~
Feels like... I’ve got no regrets anymore...
No... I must survive until I can attend Stardust’s next concert!
So this must be... the alluring power of music... Unicorn is getting pulled in...
Even Unicorn… is touched...by this concert...
Unicorn also wants to... make Onii-chan happy...

sequence:
Bits of Courage 

<size=45>III 「Unicorn’s Annoyances」</size>

scripts.say: A few days later…
Hmm... Unicorn… just can’t understand...
During that concert... Onii-chan appeared as if he was bathing in a light of happiness...
But that light didn’t come from Unicorn...
(Shakes head furiously) No no... Unicorn just wants to make Onii-chan feel... happy.
Hmm... what exactly can Unicorn do... to make Onii-chan... that happy...
Lady Stardust? Could it be... Unicorn can feel that she was the source of that light... the one bathed on Onii-chan...making him so happy.
Onii-chan once said… “Don’t be afraid to ask”?
Unicorn... wants to ask Lady Stardust...

Bits of Courage 

<size=45>V 「Echo of Stardust」</size>

scripts.say: Dear little Unicorn:
I’m very happy to hear from Unicorn, I didn’t expect to have such a cute little fan.
I can feel Unicorn's feelings from this letter of yours.
And, I can tell that Unicorn really like her Commander nii-chan~
The feelings you’re conveying in this letter has woken me up, certainly it cannot be wrong.
Let me give Unicorn a little piece of advice.
Bits of courage is the greatest form of magic, heehee~
Take a brave step forward, let Unicorn's Commander nii-chan see a different you!
I will cheer for you!~
From the singer who supports you, Stardust.

sequence:
Bits of Courage 

<size=45>VI 「A Change In Courage」</size>

scripts.say: Wh-what should Unicorn do...
Even with the advice from Lady Stardust...
Ugh…Unicorn is still nervous to express her feelings...
And... such beautiful clothes... doesn’t really fit Unicorn... what if Onii-chan doesn’t like it...
Bits of Courage… is the greatest form of magic...
Yes, Unicorn will try her best!

sequence:
Bits of Courage

scripts.say: O-Onii-chan... before Unicorn says so, Onii-chan cannot open his eyes!
Ugh... it’s still like this...
Lady Stardust… please give Unicorn courage...
(Singing)...
Wh-what do you think? These clothes were gifted to Unicorn by Lady Stardust… as well as this song!
Lady Stardust said that this... will make Onii-chan happy...
Unicorn... has made an effort, right?
Hmm? O-Onii-chan?!!!
Sigh... thank goodness... Onii-chan is alright...
Huh? You fainted from being overly excited?
Onii-chan… (///)
Hehe... thank you... Onii-chan... Unicorn is so glad that she can make you happy. Unicorn feels satisfied, it turned out just like what Lady Stardust said...
「Bits of Courage, is the greatest form of magic」 Hehe...

sequence: Unknown Test Site
Waters around the Sea of Wreckages
Iron Blood Resistance - Salvage Fleet

scripts.say: Under the light of the stars, a small fleet of three shipgirls was sailing forward cautiously.
We're nearing the Rising Tide now. Be on your guard.
Aw man, I'm seeing wreckages already!
This Rising Tide is a Class V... I've never seen anything like this!
It is pretty amazing, but isn't it also the first Rising Tide we've seen this year?
It could be the last, for all we know. I hope we'll get some valuable salvage...
That's what Rumey is counting on.
Things will get even worse next year if we don't find anything good.
Don't worry, though. A Class V yields way, way better salvage than anything else.
Let's not think about the danger and instead look forward to the surprises we'll find.
Hmm. Looks like a battle was fought here. Not that long ago, either.
Did she get here before us?
Then it's no wonder why not even a single extradimensional showed up.
*sigh*... She probably took lots of the valuable gear and components...
Going after Rising Tides is her only real choice, considering that she fights alone without any logistical support.
Don't lose hope. No matter what she may or may not have taken, a Class V is sure to yield enough to satisfy all of us.
*sniffle*... You're right. Sorry, I shouldn't just blurt out everything that comes to mind...
We're not strong enough to stop her from doing whatever she wants... Not that we'd want to do that, anyway.
Exactly, so we should be praying that she found what she wanted, if anything.
...Hm? Is there a person among the wrecks over there?
What? There's a human being inside a Rising Tide?!
Oh my gosh, you're right!
No sign of movement... Is that person even alive?
Ahh, umm... p-p-please be alive...?
Look! They moved! They're alive!
Looks like that's the Rising Tide's surprise for us. Let's go and help!

sequence: After reviving Amagi inside the Naraka Singularity, the Commander and the shipgirls set about their home voyage.
Although they made it back, it was not without incident.
The Commander blacked out numerous times and met a mysterious woman named Madam M...
The biggest incident of all, though, was the Commander's sudden and complete disappearance from reality at the celebration feast.
In order to save the person most dear to them, the shipgirls immediately got to work to figure out this abnormal phenomenon.
Meanwhile, the Commander also faced a choice that had to be made—

scripts.say: Sometime later, inside the Rising Tide...
Hmm.
*sniffle*... Um...
Hey! You!
Woah! You can speak?!
A language we understand, too! Awesome!
Ahem. Sorry for skipping introductions, but I must ask you some questions.
Where did you come from? And what are you doing inside a Rising Tide?
Actually, I'm not sure myself. I just kind of woke up here.
I'm not sure if this makes sense to you, but... everything's kind of a blur.
Hmm... Sounds like a case of memory loss.
I still remember some things though... Just to make sure, have you ever heard of "test site alpha"?
Test site... alpha? Girls, does that ring any bells?
Nope.
Sorry, me neither.
Well, stranger, you showed up in a Rising Tide and now you're asking weird questions...
Are you a visitor from the beyond?
"From the beyond"? Meaning?
A being from another world.
Come again?
(From another world? Is she pulling my leg?)
Some call your kind "outlanders", though that term isn't exactly accurate. In any case, we've had lots of visitors from other worlds since ancient times.
They were friendly and contributed greatly to the development of our planet.
Seeing one in the flesh, though – that's a rare privilege.
(They're used to running into aliens... What a crazy branch I've wound up in.)
Ah, you're having trouble taking this all in, aren't you?
Aren't you? You're talking to someone from another world, in your own words.
Well, all we've heard are legends. The only beings from beyond we've seen so far though are extradimensional monsters.
Extradimensional monsters?
Oh, um, let's save that topic for later.
She dodges my question with little subtlety.
I'm Duisburg. This ball of energy is Z52, and this shrinking violet is Z9.
We're with the Iron Blood Duchy's Resistance Forces.
She gives me a gentle smile.
(So they're with the Iron Blood, huh... Wasn't a duchy from what I remember, though.)
My name is {playername}. I'm from a world-branch known as test site alpha. If I remembered who or what I work for, I'd tell you.
I am fairly certain... that I'm in the navy, and lead a fleet.
Wait, so you're, like... a naval commander?
Hell yes! Rumey is gonna be thrilled to hear about this!
Commander {playername}, mind coming with us?
Should I? The last person told me to sit and wait for rescue.
Someone knew that we were coming?
Yeah. I met Hipper before you girls came along.
She said, and I quote, "Sit there all pretty and wait for rescue to arrive."
Hipper? Admiral Hipper? You had a normal conversation with her?
Holy smokes... Outlander – or, Commander, I guess – you're incredible!
Come again? Isn't she with you?
She... She doesn't exactly see us as allies, I think.
More like passersby.
While she speaks with a calm tone, her eyes betray an array of complicated feelings.
(A resistance movement, a strange META, and even beings from beyond this dimension... This getting more and more confusing.)
Z52, mind getting out your mass-produced ship? I'm taking the Commander back.
I could, but we'd be painting a target on our backs if we did that.
Fine, why don't you carry {playername} on your back, then?
Sounds fun! I'll do it.
Please don't ever do something stupid just because it "sounds fun".
Exactly... What if you drop the Commander?
Good point... Are we leaving already, anyway? We still haven't salvaged anything.
No, obviously we're not.
Also, I just had a word with headquarters. They issued a mission to bring back some heavy-duty gear, and at least a few.
Gotta make the most of this Rising Tide, then! We need to bring back a slew of treasures!

options.content: What did you say about a mission?

scripts.say: Scout out the Rising Tide, find safe routes, and lay the groundwork for a large-scale salvage operation for the logistics team, I suppose.
Bringing back valuable salvage wasn't part of our original plan, but if we're going to bust out a mass-produced ship, we can't come back empty-handed.
Like Z52 just said, we have to return with a haul of treasure.
In other words, our job now is to find the most valuable equipment for our base and salvage it.
I know you want to leave right now, but don't worry, we'll be out of here soon.
Don't worry about me. Focus on finding your treasure.
(Wreckages are considered treasure in this place... Interesting.)
After Rumey's public address, I asked Duisberg and Z52 to accompany me to the Eternal Star in the best condition.
Following a quick voyage on a mass-produced ship, we now stand directly below the underbelly of the giant structure.
It hovers soundlessly in the air, roughly ten meters above the surface.
(Hovering technology. Reminds me of the United Council's floating battleships.)
(Only more advanced. This structure dwarfs the likes of a battleship.)
This is Eternal Star 1, the most-intact of the bunch.
We investigated this thing once when we captured it, but we basically found nothing.
Perhaps our ever-dependable Commander will succeed where we failed, though?
Smiling at me, Duisburg opens the doors on the container resting on the deck.
Well, you first.
What's this container for?
The thing is floating in the air, remember? Last I checked, none of us here can fly.
With a snap of Duisburg's fingers, a flock of drones that resemble dragons swoop down and hook into the container's four corners.
Wait, are you going to fly us up there in the container? What are those drones, anyway?
Ornithopter model IB-50, nicknamed "Pterosaur". They were developed from rigging technology.
Just call them Pterosaurs.
(Ornithopters, of all things... Well, their applications aren't that different from fixed-wing aircraft.)
C'mon, let's head up!
Sometime later...
Once we entered the structure, we were faced with a long corridor measuring three meters wide and five meters tall.
At the end of it was an elevator, this time leading up into the Star's central area.
Here, there are no branching paths, no staircases, and not even any doors.
The outside fools you into thinking there's tons of spaces to explore... In truth, the layout is extremely simple, isn't it?
I anticipated this would take three whole days. Now it seems we'll be done in half of one.
That's Siren structures for you – closed, compact, and automated through and through.
If the Sirens hadn't accommodated for us, even this one hallway probably wouldn't exist.
True.
Those seven pedestals over there – those are the control panels. Only the first is functional.
The only things it can do is open and close the passageway, grant and remove entry privileges, and alter the structure's alertness range. Oh, and toggle view mode on and off.
Let me give you a demonstration.
Her delicate hands run across the control panel.
In a blink, the walls and the floor turn transparent. Sunlight flows in from all directions, and the sea below us glows golden.
Heehee. This is the view mode. Pretty cool, right?
It feels like I'm floating in the sky. This unbelievable view seems to span to the edge of the world.
While it IS a great view, don't you think its real purpose is to provide an optimal overview of the battlefield?
Hmm. Could be.
The thing is, there's no one capable of controlling the Eternal Star in battle, so in practice it's basically just a viewing platform.
(I see...)
Breathing a sigh internally, I casually place my hand on the station's control panel.
Access permission verified.
A bang echoes through the whole corridor. The lights on the second control panel light up, as though brought to life.
(I knew it. The Antiochus and I have ties.)
Holy... I can't believe it! Amazing job!
No one's ever done that before! I've gotta tell Rumey!
Quick, check if it has any new functions!
Pushed on by Z52, I walk over to the second station. I swiftly remember how to operate it.
Let's see, this one has... Check system logs, initiate self-recovery, open cargo passageway...
Weapons system overview, adjust interception mode... There is even manual control of every individual weapon.
So, wait, you can control where to shoot?!
Holy crap! That's the sickest thing I've ever seen!
Looks like opening the passageway will also let us fix the surrounding Eternal Stars.
We'll even be able to bring back ones that have been rendered inoperable.
One thing is very clear – this will be a massive boost to the Resistance's combat capabilities.
You know, I'm really starting to admire you!
What a magnificent surprise you have for me.
I'm curious – is the Star able to be repositioned?
Should it be capable of autonomous movement and targeting, many more places will open up for recapture to us.
That might be asking for too much...
Looking at the data logs, it seems like the Eternal Stars are actually parts of an even bigger machine. They weren't built to be moved on their own.
A bigger machine? This is news to me.
Well, I'm speculating here. It's also possible the Mirror Sea and the energy tower have something to do with this supposed machine.
But, unfortunately, some parts are still missing. They never did finish constructing it.
Yes... That is unfortunate.
It is much beyond our current capabilities to complete this machine of theirs.
Even so, this is a monumental discovery for our forces.
Hmm. Something appears to be up with Eternal Star One. Did you initiate maintenance?
Yeah. While this one is in the best condition, the self-diagnostic I ran found heaps upon heaps of issues.
Luckily, none of them are major. The maintenance should be done fairly soon.
Rumey bites her tongue, seemingly holding back some emotion.
I'll leave the rest to you, Commander.
Thanks. I'll do everything I can.
(The operation starts in three days. Until then, I'll have to get the other Eternal Stars in as good a condition as possible.)
Three days passed in the blink of an eye. The time to fight has finally come.
Thanks to the revised strategy, we quickly discovered the main extradimensional force, concentrated our attacks, and defeated them without issue.
The real surprise was the amount of samples we'd obtained, accomplishing the postponed mission in the process.
Currently, the main fleet is sailing smoothly toward the Silberstern.
Due to our emphasis on firepower this time, we had opted not to assign landing and escort fleets. Thus, total control and large-scale mining of the island were excluded from this mission's objective.
After clearing out all of the threats around the island, the main force would set up automatic mining stations to get only the necessary materials to fix the radiation purgers.
This was another revision I'd made to the plan.
Everyone, look! The mining site is right up ahead!
She points at a tall mountain on the edge of the island.
The mountain is covered in debris instead of grass, giving it a metallic sheen.
Come now. Did you think we would be mining from a mine?
We plan to mine mineralized energy, a special kind of ore that grows from metallic debris. It's one of the principal materials of Energy Cubes.
Long ago, each faction cultivated high-purity mineralized energy and produced countless Energy Cubes.
That boundless energy once powered our civilization's golden age... We only live in its afterglow today.
Rumey lets a sardonic smile slip.
(Energy Cubes? Why do I feel like I've heard of those before...)
A ray of light shines at the far end of the ocean, seemingly beaming a flood of information into my mind.

sequence: The Cube Standardization Summit ended today, making the results of the conference publicly available on the last day of its schedule.
The Summit designated the official international name of the Energy Cube as "ε-Cube"...
...and also provided a series of standards for its production and utilization.
Unlike with conventional energy sources, the most important thing about producing ε-Cubes is the construction of a complex synthetic container.
Differences in specifications during the production process of this container will directly affect the quality of the resulting ε-Cube.
...After thoroughly analyzing all the data left in the Polar Decompilation project, our team has made remarkable progress in studying the material compositions of ε-Cubes.
The ε-Cube does not inherit the properties of the materials used to make it, but rather changes based upon those materials.
Simply put, an ε-Cube is more than the sum of the components used to make it.
Of course, neither wood nor paper are suitable materials for the construction of an ε-Cube shell...
...but with this knowledge, we once again open ourselves to countless new possibilities worth trying...

scripts.say: (Are these more of the memories that I lost?)
(All about Energy Cubes, at that. And the people of this world use this material to produce Energy Cubes?)
(But what is this mineralized energy deal? That doesn't match my memories at all.)
(The most important part of Energy Cube production was the construction of a complex synthetic container...)
(Is that container the processed version of this mineral?)
I didn't get any more information after that, so I didn't arrive at any meaningful conclusion.
Meanwhile, Rumey and her fleet set up their automatic mining machines, and their mining robots got to work.
The counteroperation is off to a good start with this bounty of strategic materials.
It looks like we're out of danger... for now.
BEEP BEEP!
U-u-urgent report! Can you hear me?!
What happened?! Answer at once!
It's really bad! The extradimensionals are at HQ–
KABOOOM!
–l-launching a large-scale attack!
We're on our way. Do everything you can to hold out until our return!
U-understood!
KABOOOM!
There you have it.
The mission is on hold. All forces, return at once!
Rumey's Resistance fleet rushed back for headquarters at flank speed.
Rumey, Commander. Continuing along this direct route will bring us into treacherous waters.
(Treacherous waters?)
How much of a threat does this route pose to our main fleet?
There is a level of risk. An acceptable level, though, given the size of our force.
So you're saying...
Every second counts. We stay the course.
Roger that!
KABOOOM!
ROOOOOAR!
Oh no... We're going as fast as we can, but they're faster!
This horde is even stronger than the last!
Rumey, they're testing us and whittling away our forces all at once.
They attack our headquarters AND intercept us when we return to defend it... Something must be leading them, that's for sure.
It's too dangerous to press on. Rumey, requesting a change of course.
You think there's a Chief out there? Those things don't show up often ever since we lost the Sirens.
The last one was decades ago. I know that you're concerned, but you must be overthinking it.
We're halfway through already, and we've sustained close to no damage.
Your prudence is commendable, yes, but our defenses at HQ are thin without our main fleet.
We have no choice but to risk it. Keep moving forward, now!
KABOOOM!
Commander! Rumey! The attacks from our flanks are too strong! Our formation is breaking!
I will cover the rear! Have all ships reform 30 nautical miles ahead!
Understood! I'll relay that at once!
Commander, lead with the command ship and oversee the reformation effort! As soon as it's complete, proceed to base immediately!
If they know our plans, then their next move...
Rumey. Are extradimensionals known to attack via self-destruction?
They're beasts. They follow only their instincts – never would they end their own lives for a greater goal.
They flee in the face of overwhelming odds, and it's extremely rare for them to fight to the death. If they ever did self-destruct, it would be...
...Because their leader forced them to.
Good lord! But that can't–
KABOOOM!
Amidst the explosion of the mass-produced ship, my consciousness is thrown into the empty abyss.
SHUFFLE...
Then, I hear the sound of cards shuffling.

sequence: Time: Unknown
Location: Unknown

scripts.say: Jintsuu, can you hear me?
Helena closed her eyes, deep in thought.
Is that you, Helena? Have you already solved your problem?
Let's start with yours.
What's the situation?
Nagato and Hiei from test site beta are back to normal, but we can't leave Camelot.
Well, I happen to know why. Test site beta has moved somewhere.
Did you say it MOVED?
The Empress did it. She was plotting this whole time.
There's nothing outside of Camelot. That's why you can't leave.
I'm guessing... you don't know where beta is, either.
Yes, she's really done it this time. But I think we owe D a debt of gratitude.
Activate the communicator she left and maintain a connection with test site beta. Don't cut off comms with me, either.
You're going to trace it backward?
I'll have it done in less than 72 system hours.
Also, let the Elizabeth from beta know to pass this message on to our two whale hunters.
"If you don't want to be homeless when you return, you'd best start analyzing now."
Someone's awfully caring today.
...I'm just returning a favor.
Anyway, that's about it. Let's be careful with this.
Helena muted the communication channel and turned her attention to a different panel.
The core of the fake test site... A perfect place to serve as Observer's new habitat.
Heheh... This surprise will really knock you out.
Coordinates traced. Switching to capture mode.
Let's get down to business.

sequence: Sardegna Empire
Former World Expo Venue
Sakura Empire Pavilion

scripts.say: A day had passed since the Sakurans had arrived at their pavilion.
Thanks to everyone's coordinated efforts, the recording and repairing of the rupture was proceeding smoothly.
A barrier for Kaga had been raised, and she was performing the final preparations by herself.
In spite of the situation at hand, some still found the time to rest and chat.
...And that's every story I have about the Commander.
From the Long Island defense line, to the Bermuda Sea, to the counteroffensive in the NA Ocean...
There is also the World Expo incident, and the battle inside Naraka that was just fought.
The Commander really has fought alongside the Eagle Union in many, many places.
Yeah, I suppose so.
Helena's fought under the Commander for a long time. I might have fought just a teensy bit longer, though.
Ah, that gives you bragging rights amongst all the groupies.
Am I supposed to act jealous now?
Ugh, you...
You think you're such a big deal. All you've done is nearly end the world and make the Commander weep for you. Then you had to be rescued.
It's true. I made a great mistake and caused much trouble for the Commander.
Despite that, the Commander saved me, and even accepted my obsessions.
I'm ready to give up anything for that person, even my own life. Can you say the same?
You still nearly ended the world as we know it, and the Commander along with it...
That is precisely why the love in my heart must burn hotter than anyone else's.
*sigh*...
Memphis could only roll her eyes at the audacity.
My, what's this lively conversation about?
A voice spoke out, and a beam of light shot into the pavilion, assuming the form of a shipgirl.
Who are you?
Unzen? What brings you here?
I heard you two talking about the Commander, so I thought I should share an old story of mine.
A story with us to share, have you?
Yes. Long ago, when the Naval Academy delegation paid a visit to our homeland.
It's about a person who feared not getting lost – a person who passed through countless barriers and paths to reach me...
When the light fades, that bright classroom once again appears before my eyes.
Madam M's classroom. I'm back again, aren't I?
Repressing the mental anguish of experiencing death firsthand, I survey my surroundings.
As expected, the purple-haired lady stands at the podium. She shoots me a thoughtful look.
So, did you enjoy this second search?
Despite all my caution, I fell right at the finish line.
Heehee. Not enough information, I take it?
Just like when we were readying our counterattack, the extradimensionals caught us in a trap.
There HAS to be a leader planning their actions, but who?
You know I'm not going to tell you.
Figures.
A sigh escapes my lips over her stubborn attitude.
At the same time, I notice that there's a girl in white clothes sitting next to my desk.
Did you remember anything?
She speaks to me with innocent curiosity in her eyes.
Her presence here feels unbelievably natural, like she has been here from the very start.
Yeah. Some things, at least.
Good...
There is a tiny change in her expression for just a moment – it's a smile.
Back on topic. We were going to talk about you.
I still have so many questions for you.
You don't give up, do you? Even when you know how I'm going to answer.
I'm well aware that you won't give me straight answers. I just want to discuss them with you.
Well, that I can do. What's on your mind, then?
Now, this is only a theory, but assuming that everything I experienced was real...
What happens to the world the moment I leave it? After going back in time to make a new choice, that is.
Perhaps it naturally develops into another possibility. Or perhaps it all vanishes into nothingness.
Those two couldn't be any more different. Wait, let me guess – they're the same, aren't they?
Correct. They are.
Because the moment you made your choice, that world thereafter became "real" from your perspective.
As for other, branching outcomes, they were demoted to mere possibilities.
Perhaps they are possible, perhaps they aren't. They may continue past that point, or they may cease right there and then.
What difference does it make to you, as one who lives in "certainty"?
You're forgetting the people other than me. What about them?
If my choice causes the world to deviate toward another branch that I cannot observe, how do other people perceive this branch?
Other people. Of course.
Okay, let's take the girls from the Resistance as an example.
Their existence in and of itself is simply one possibility. Discussing what-ifs about them is meaningless.
They're "simply one possibility"? What does that make you, then?
If you're saying only outside observers are worth discussion, then there's two of us. You've been observing them, too.
Not quite. I've only been observing you and the immediate space around you.
Uh-huh. And what if you want to observe the past again?
If I feel like doing that, then I'll do it.
But, no matter I see or have seen, it means nothing to you.
What-ifs – that is, possibilities – mean nothing compared to established facts.
Let's put the whole "this has meaning, that doesn't" talk to rest. You can observe infinite possible worlds while I cannot.
What I'm wondering is – can I only move down a path made up of certainties?
...Ah. I see what you were going for now. Frankly, I underestimated you.
I thought so.
The secret to that ability of yours lies in the Antiochus' system.
That world – it's a test site, isn't it? That's why it can be observed.
While she neither confirms nor denies my statement, her lips seem to stiffen a little.
Possibilities are endless and unable to be predicted. Throw an outside observer into the mix, though, and the possibilities converge, become facts, and gain meaning.
That is why the Antiochus came up with test sites.
Every test site is recorded in their system once they intervene at a specific point in time.
What's more, every test site can continue being monitored even after the Antiochus' departure, thanks to the presence of their creations.
Any given branch is a parallel possibility – until Antiochus arrives and makes it their test site, thus making it definite, real, and meaningful.
Am I correct?
Not completely.
Is it not just the test sites? Is there something else that you observe?
Oh... Now I get it. That's why you've been observing me.
Every time I arrive at the truth, new possibilities are made definite, thus creating test sites. Is that it?
See?
As long as you're given an environment to think in, you can make one discovery after the next, no?
Discussion time is over. Now it's time to make your next choice.
Do you want to continue?

sequence: T=T-8

scripts.say: Over on the Silberstern, I see mining robots hard at work, running from place to place.
(Now I'm back to just before the attack? That's about eight hours back...)
(Dammit... I have so little time to work with. How do I do this?)
(Should I order readiness for an ambush right now?)
(It'll buy us some time, at least. Then I need to warn Rumey about rushing into dangerous territory...)
(Working out a basic solution is going to require a bigger fleet.)
(Wait... A bigger fleet...)
A ray of light shines at the far end of the ocean, seemingly beaming a flood of information into my mind.

sequence: ...The experiment finally worked!
By improving the materials, we succeeded in creating a variant of the ε-Cube... We didn't have a name for it, but after doing some research and getting feedback from the other team members...
Yeah, let's go with "Wisdom Cube."
I like the sound of that!
Today, we will discuss what has been dubbed the "META phenomenon."
"META" itself is derived from an ancient word which means "change."
It is quite broad in meaning, but for our purposes, it refers to the result of a property having undergone change.
The process itself of a property changing is what is known as "METAmorphosis."
This process has been observed in Wisdom Cubes.
Cases of METAmorphosis have been observed in certain shipgirl subjects as well.

scripts.say: (Another memory fragment. Perfect timing.)
(There's a variant of the Energy Cube known as the Wisdom Cube...)
(That's odd – how come there are Wisdom Cubes in this world?)
(If the Resistance could use Wisdom Cubes to expand their fleet, they wouldn't be in these dire straits right now. So what went wrong?)
(Without any Cubes, our only option is to rely on Admiral Hipper META to save us.)
A while later, I've come to Rumey. She is overseeing the mining operation.
Is something the matter? Your expression tells me so.

options.content: We've got to talk about Wisdom Cubes...

scripts.say: ...Wisdom Cubes? How long it's been since I heard those words.
It is as you say. We are beings born of those Cubes.
Alas, all our Cube-gathering technology disappeared with the Sirens, and our stockpile has long since run out.
(Wait, "gathering technology"?)
Are you saying that Cubes are collected somehow?
Indeed. A unique ore rests deep below the sea, I've heard. Only the Sirens knew how to retrieve it.
Even should the technology be returned to us, building the necessary facilities to gather the material is a pipe dream in our circumstances.
She cracks a bitter smile of self-deprecation.
(That's not what I remember. It said the Wisdom Cube was created as a variation on the Energy Cube.)
(Did the Sirens restrict their access to that information?)
(Well, even if they did, it's far too late to change now.)

options.content: I want to get in touch with Admiral Hipper META.

scripts.say: Hipper, you say?
Ah, yes, it was she who first discovered you. Do you have questions for her?
The Resistance's relationship with her is pretty complicated, based on what Duisburg told me.
You can say that again.
Her name is to this day on the Duchy's wanted list. That isn't to say we seek to arrest her, though.
Did she end up turning META because of something the Duchy did?
Long ago, we fought a war and lost.
We followed our orders and carried out our mission. There was no outside interference or internal strife. Still, we lost.
We took our defeat and accepted it. Hipper, however, did not.
So she fought the Duchy and wound up on the wanted list, I assume.
...This was long in the past.
Sorry if I touched on a delicate subject.
Later on, Hipper would not antagonize us. In fact, she would even at times assist us with Rising Tides.
Though, if you asked her, she would never admit to it. It must be a matter of pride to her.
Duisburg can tell you more about her than I. Summon her, will you?
There's no time for that. We can get into the nitty-gritty another time.
What? No time?
She becomes suddenly alert after her stint in the sea of memories.
What do you mean? Can you explain?
The situation has changed.
The extradimensionals have a leader, and they're using our counteroperation as an opportunity for something.
Since your biggest guns are with us, the smartest thing to do is raise the base's alertness level and return as soon as possible.
They have a Chief class, in other words... If there is one, it's a serious threat.
There hasn't been a single sighting of a Chief class in decades since the Sirens left, however.
How can you be certain there is one when we haven't even seen the shadow of an indication of it?
They were already well-positioned and prepared an ambush. Mindless beasts don't do that. There is a very good chance someone is leading them.
Moreover, your allies back at HQ are repairing the Eternal Stars and have their guard down. That makes them easy targets.
Excessive pride invites mistakes and leads to defeat. This is something I failed to tell you before our departure.
Yes... All excellently made points. The Eternal Stars' reactivation made me overconfident.
My commander's instinct is screaming it at me. Trust me on this.
"Instinct" isn't a satisfactory answer. How certain is this instinctual feeling of yours?
100% certain.
Very well. I trust you.
I will contact the base posthaste.
One hour later, my "prediction" comes true, and the base is attacked.
BEEP BEEP!
U-u-urgent report! Can you hear me?!
What happened?! Answer at once!
A sw-swarm of extradimensionals are attacking the base!
We're just about holding our ground because we raised the alertness level to maximum, and... Anyway!
The enemy's kinda going ham out there, but we moved our defenses and they're holding up!
That was some sick foresight on your part!
It was not me who predicted the attack – it was the Commander.
Get your forces together and bolster the defense! Once our capital ships are there, we will pincer the enemy and annihilate them!
Got it! Thanks a ton you too, Mandy!
Rumey terminates the call, then turns to me with a look of suspicion.
It is exactly as you predicted. What do we do now?
(The only thing I know is that the enemy is waiting in ambush in the danger zone...)
(The base's defenses are solid... Ah, I know!)
Since HQ was ready and they have the Eternal Stars, they should be able to hold their own.
I'll admit, I might have suggested a return to base too hastily. As far as I can see, our original mission objectives are still completable to some degree.
Securing the minimum we need is better than going home emptyhanded.
Duisburg, how's the mining coming along?
It's about 30% of our goal.
We cannot afford to wait for its completion.
That is true. Enough for one radiation purger will have to do for now.
That's enough for us to say we accomplished what we set out to do.
There you have it, Duisburg. As soon as we have the materials for one device, recover the equipment and retreat.
Understood.
There is the possibility that our force is their real target. I want everyone as ready for battle as can be when we head back.
Let's aim for a return route that's as quick AND as safe as possible.
Z52, help the Commander plot a course. There will be no running in blindly.
You got it!
Oh, and I'd like to request one additional reinforcement.
Come again? Let me remind you – we are the only combat-ready fleet in this area.
Almost. There's Hipper. Send her a request for assistance. Doesn't matter if it's unencrypted.
Knowing her track record, she'll agree to help. We need her strength right now.
It's worth a try. I cannot guarantee her aid, but the more support we have, the better.
Thank you, Rumey. We'll set off as soon as everyone is ready!
The fleet sailed onward, maintaining vigilant, and arrived back at the headquarters.
Duisburg tried to contact Hipper numerous times, but in the end, she did not show up in our defense.
Whew... Back at last!
Man, these Eternal Stars are running way better than I thought! Those extradimensionals are stuck at the outer periphery!
Yup. This is our best chance to strike them from both sides.
BEEP BEEP!
Z11, we have reached the base. Give me a report on the enemy's deployments.
Uhh, what? D-did you only just arrive?
...Why do you ask?
Because, um, a force outside our defense line attacked the enemy about an hour ago.
It seemed like a pretty powerful force, so I just assumed it was you and you couldn't radio us or something...
There is another force? In what direction? I must see for myself!
Rumey's recon aircraft returned quickly with answers.
The extradimensionals were being intercepted by one single person – a young lady with a flat profile.
KABOOOM!
Since you've got such a death wish, I'll be your wish-granter!
In the name of the Admiral Hipper class, I will play a song to soothe your souls!
KABOOOM!
Hipper's here?!
That explains why she wouldn't answer our calls!
Heheh. She's just too nice to turn her back on us.
She has gotten even stronger in the long time since I last saw her.
Her fighting style, though, is still the same.
Should we link up with her?
What say you, Commander?
Supposing that we do, what do you reckon the odds are that she'll help with our mission?
I'm not sure. Given the circumstances, it seems a very slim chance.
Then let's not push it. She can do it her way and keep the enemy off balance.
Rumey, Commander, here are the enemy's p-positions.
(There are fewer of them than I anticipated. Hipper must've really cut them down to size.)
First, let us deal with the group 60 degrees to the east, then we'll rendezvous with Hipper and take out the ones 95 degrees from there. Finally, we'll clean them up in order. How about that?
Sounds good. I'll contact headquarters and request supporting fire. Everyone, prepare to engage!
Our counteroffensive went smoothly. The enemy markers on the monitor vanished one after the next, and victory seemed but a shot away.
But right at that moment, a shocking development occurred.
A star overhead suddenly glows blindingly brightly, its magnified radiance lighting up half of the night sky in the blink of an eye.
The white heavens become diffused with innumerable blue lights that flicker in and out of existence. It's like someone has inverted the colors of the night.
A strange sound – like encroaching waves – rings out, resonating with everything and everyone and shaking the very soul.
Oh my god... Is that a Lord class?! I thought they were a myth!
A Lord class?
A being that surpasses even the Chief class... The true leader of the extradimensionals.
The Star Beast is its name... It has only appeared three times throughout history.
Every appearance has been marked with disaster.
That makes this the fourth time...
How did you deal with it the previous three?
The first time, we threw all of humanity's golden age creations at it. The second, the Sirens displayed their final glory.
The third – we could do nothing but witness its fury.
This is looking grim.
Countless feelers appear, reaching into the sky as though trying to stitch it and the sea together.
The waves grow strong and furious, striking fear into the heart of every shipgirl.
Star Beast...
Back then... It was you!
Ahahahaha... Finally, I've found you!
Yes... It's time!
Time to take revenge for what you did to my sisters!
I was weak back then – but not anymore!
Your death will be the Admiral Hipper class' crowning achievement!
Hipper gazed up at the vast sky and declared her intent for all to hear.
No, Hipper! Calm down!
It's no use. She won't listen to us.
That doesn't mean we're going to let her kill herself.
All units, support Hipper with all you have!
KABOOOM!
The cannon fire vanished like fireflies in the black, starry sky.

Heheh...
Cut the crap and come at me!

Absolutely everything crumbles to dust in the dazzling light.
SHUFFLE...
Then, I hear the sound of cards shuffling.
