Yes? The abnormal data needs to be investigated, of course.
By using the Reality Lens, we can quickly find out what it contains.
And you mean right now? That's a little hasty, don't you think? It seems dangerous to me, given it just messed me up so bad.
Don't worry. It's all recovered from the simulation, after all.
I had TB take a look at it, as well. She agrees that we can't analyze it without using the Reality Lens.
Besides, she says there's "no direct threat."
So there's no choice but to try it right away, no?
Revision: the surface of the recovered data block contains abnormal data that is inconsistent with Reenacted battlefields.
I've judged that said surface data poses no danger.
However, the inside of the data block is highly compressed, so it is impossible to appraise the danger within at this point in time.
Yep. There you have it; we need to use that Reality Lens.
Besides, when Anchorage's abnormal data was found, the Commander interfaced with the data directly and fixed the danger just fine.
So I believe that if I follow the same logic and do the same things in the same order...
Constellation, I get how you feel, but can you calm down a little? Things are totally different.
Um, I... I think...
You're not the Commander, Constellation, so pushing yourself so hard won't solve anything.
...Not that I'm happy when the Commander does it, either...
...Forget it. I'll take care of it myself.
Constellation! This isn't like you at all.
If you insist on doing this, at least take me with you!
San Jacinto... I'm sorry.
BEEP BEEP!
Constellation! ...She cut off communications.
*sob*... She's not usually like this...
I know... Everything that's happened to Lexington must be weighing heavily on her...
For her to finally catch a glimpse of the light of hope, only to have it smothered again... That might be why she decided to take things into her own hands.
TB, is there any way we can stop Constellation? Like force disconnecting the Reality Lens?
Cannot accept request. As an experiment requested by Sea of Stars management staff committee protocol PR-1, it can only be nullified by the committee's unanimous agreement.
PR-1... You mean we can't stop it without the Commander?! Alaska's gone, too, so summoning Helena and the others would be pointless...
We'll just have to use force! TB, get us out of this simulation!
Orders received. Terminating experiment.
Warning: due to a breach of regulations, the current program's data has been corrupted. Executing simulation reset procedure.
Estimated time of completion: thirty minutes. Please wait...
Thirty minutes?! We won't make it in time!
This is a necessary security measure. Please wait...
Yeah, yeah... Whatever...
Ugh... I can't believe I'm saying this, but I wish Alaska was here...

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Preparations for the Wonderful New Year!</size>

scripts.say: Phew... I'm finally back...
Welcome back, nya! You've got a big catch today, nya...
Big catch, huh? If memory serves me properly, we were supposed to do some New Year's shopping... Right, Akashi?
Nya! ... I stumbled upon some nice things and, uh, well... No harm, no foul, right? Consider it a "business opportunity," nya!
And besides, I'm sure Commander and the others will appreciate this stuff, nya!
Hey Akashi, where do you think you're running off to? Put those parts down and come help out.
Nya... Akashi wanted to go sleep in Commander's lap, nya~
Hm, Atago and Akashi, you're back? How did shopping go?
Nya! It's Souryuu, nya!
Indeed. We're done with the New Year's shopping, but a certain cat decided to buy a lot of stuff that wasn't on the list. Hehe...
Great. After you're done organizing, we need to get ready for Spring Cleaning. We'll have to call everyone to help.
Souryuu, you sure are something else. As expected of Commander's right hand.
I-I just do what needs to be done, that is all...
Akashi is Commander's other right hand, nya!
Two right hands? Is Commander a Stand user...? Well, Akashi, if you're going to be a "right hand," you'll have to act like one and help me move all this stuff~
Fine, nya...
Ah, shall I lend a hand as well?

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 2 - The Great Spring "Cleaning!"</size>

scripts.say: Ahem! This year's Great Spring Cleaning is about to commence!
Ohhhh!!
Vroooom!! I'm gonna clean this stuff up in a flash like a gale cutting through fallen leaves!
Hawawawa! The place I just cleaned... it's all messy again...
Unlike on the battlefield, that kind of "cleaning up" only generates more headaches...
Ahaha... I seemed to have lapsed in my vigilance, but I will have to pay extra attention during this festival... to "clean up" all the pests from Commander's port...
Sister, today's cleaning is the ordinary kind. Please try to contain your urges a bit...
Worry not, Kaga. I would never cause any unnecessary trouble. Unless, of course, those pests start clinging to Commander...
I seem to have overheard something rather perverse...
Oh my, it seems like there's something interesting going on here.
Hm? You're the Iron Blood's....
Ah, it's Eugen. Good day. We're currently in the middle of the Sakura Empire's annual Great Spring Cleaning.
"Great Spring Cleaning," huh? By the way, I saw Commander with some girl just now...
Wh-what...?! So there needs to be some thorough "cleaning" after all... Ahhhhh, Commander, wait for me! Akagi is rushing to your side!
As expected, this form of "cleaning" is much more entertaining. Hehe...
Masterminding a ploy to divert Akagi's destructive power just like that... the Iron Blood isn't to be underestimated.
Hardly. Akagi is just an open book when it comes to the commander.
Jeez, there's still so much cleaning to do, and Akagi ran off just like that?
In that case, why don't I help out?
Eh? Are you sure?
Hehe~ Let's just say I'm a bit intrigued by the your "New Year."

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Reach Toward the Unknown</size>

scripts.say: Several days prior...
Looks like another year is drawing to an end...
I'll probably spend the end of this year eating dinner alone just like everyone else... It feels a bit inane...
Hm? Isn't that the Sakura Fleet's...
Nya! It's Eugen! What's the matter? You look kind of down, nya.
You're Akashi, from that shop, right? How's everything been? You seem rather busy.
Everyone in the Sakura Fleet is getting ready for the New Year! It's actually an extremely busy time, nya! Business is suffering as a result, nya...
Hmmm~? Tell me about this Sakura's "New Year." What kind of preparations are you doing?
There's way too much to do, nya! For the Sakura Empire, the New Year is a very important holiday, nya!
I see. That sounds a bit interesting.
Present - Sakura Dormitory
If you want to help out, then let's start by having you set the decorations. All these are for New Year's day, so we need to get it done today. It looks a bit sparse here...
Got it. What are these bamboo-like things?
These are called "kadomatsu," or gate pines. They come in pairs and should be placed to the sides of the door. They represent prosperity and longevity and are said to welcome home ancestral spirits.
They certainly stand out when placed around the door like this... So, what's this straw-like decoration? It looks pretty cool.

Ah, how should I say this... it is used to mark a sacred site so that the visiting spirits won't leave. They are placed in entrances, so you can hang it in the doorway or on windows. Oh, and in the kitchen too.
It seems that the Sakura Empire likes things... high-strung.
Can I eat this white biscuit thing?
That is called "kagami mochi," or mirror rice cake, nya! It is food, but you can't eat it just yet, nya... You'll have to make offerings first, and wait until after the New Year to eat it, nya.
What? These things are sitting here begging to be eaten and you're telling me to wait?
Be patient, nya! After the New Year, you can eat and drink to your heart's content, nya!
A party to celebrate the passing of the year... Hmm, can I come to that as well?
Everyone in this base is a friend, so anyone is welcome, nya~
Ehehe... I'm looking forward to it then... I hear Sakura's liquor is like ambrosia.

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Friendship, Hard Work, and Victory!</size>

scripts.say: Huh? I didn't expect the whole gang to show up.
That's right~ when I received Ayaya's invitation, I was wondering if I'd run into all of you!
Uhh... hnn...?
Laffey seems sleep-deprived as usual... Ah, the New Year is almost here! C'mon, get your excited face on! New Year~!
Mm... I... am full of... excitement...?
Ahaha... you two never change.
I sure didn't expect Ayaya to invite us though~
Even though she doesn't talk a lot, she's actually quite fond of everyone.
Ehehe~ she's so cute~
(knocks on the door) Ayanami~ We're here~
Seems like... nobody's here...
Did Ayanami... oversleep...?
Laffey, you shouldn't project onto Ayanami... Probably.
Ayanami is here, yes...
Woooahhh! Ayayanami?
Wahaha~! Zed's face just now! "Ayayanami!" Ahahaha!
Ugh... Why did you suddenly pop out from behind...
I went to Houshou's place... to pick up something I had asked for...
I see, that stuff you're carrying right now... is it an outfit?
I asked Houshou to make a set for everyone... but there wasn't enough time this year... so there's just one...
Just one...
Just one, huh?
Ayanami... what's this tasty-looking round thing?
Stop right there, Laffey! Z23, Ayanami, restrain her~
On it!
Eh....? Ah... wait-
Ehehehe~ Just relax, it'll be fine~
Laffey's skin... so smooth...
Cold... Itchy...
Keep it PG-13, you two... Well, whatever...
Transformation complete~! Laffey, what do you think?
Feels weird... the waist is a bit too high... and it's too tight. The sleeves are too breezy... and I'm getting cold...
But, it's cute...
It really suits you though! I'm a little jealous (whispers)... A-ahem!
Ahh, how nice~ I want a cute outfit like Laffey's as well~
Next time... I will have outfits for everyone...
Mm... everyone, together...
Mhm! I'll be looking forward to it!
Now, since everyone is here and all dressed up, let's go to the party!
Yes... but first, it's time to appreciate some good anime...

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 5 - New Year's Cards</size>

scripts.say: Big sister Souryuu, what are you doing?
Ah, Kisaragi. I'm writing New Year's cards for everyone.
New Year's cards?
They're for sending regards to your friends. You can also write a bit about what's going on in life, that kind of stuff.
Can I... try writing one?
Of course. Who would you like to send it to?
Um... uh... Commander?
I... want to wish Commander a happy New Year...
Oh? That's a good idea. I'm sure Commander would be very happy to get a card from you.
Eh? Why would Commander be happy?
Well... Hey! Yuudachi, no running in the hallway! ... Anyway, children who send cards to adults might just receive a nice reward.
Say what? Then, I wanna write one too!
Do you really? Then, sit down right here. Kisaragi, you too. All right, take a postcard and a pen.
Okay! This looks fun!
Souryuu, why is there a picture of a pig on this card?
These cards are usually printed with the corresponding zodiac animal. It's now the Year of the Pig. Is something the matter, Yuudachi?
Just looking at it is making me hungry...
Haha... In short, there are no rules on what you can write on your card, especially for children. Just writing what's on your mind is good enough.
In that case, I'll write... "Commander, I wanna eat lots of meat this year as well." ... And done!
... ... At least write "Happy New Year," okay?
Ohh! ... But uh, how do I spell that again?
Um... I also... don't know how...
I suppose we'll have to start from the basics then. Here, I'll write it out first, then you can try for yourself.
Hrm? Souryuu, Yuudachi, and Kisaragi? What are you three doing here?
I'm teaching them how to write a New Year's card to send to Commander.
Eh? Um... I see... In that case, I'll be slowly making my way toward the egress~
One hour later...
Aoba, is this your doing?
What could you be talking about?
Who else would call all the destroyers to come write cards?
Oh come on, I merely asked everyone if they had anything they'd like to thank the commander for...
Ms. Souryuu, I drew a flower, see?
Souryuu... Um, teacher... Did I do it right?
Ah! This card has a porkchop on it! I wanna use this card!
Oh ho ho~ I do believe I shall write some most "stimulating" things~
Uuu.... I made a mistake again...
Souryuu, what do you think of my elegant writing?
Eheh, it's decided then! The "Super Popularity Contest - Ms. Souryuu's Special Classroom, End of Year Edition," will begin tomorrow!
Why is Kamikaze even here... Ah jeez, I suppose this isn't so bad...
All right, if you have any questions, please come up one at a time. First, I'll write "Happy New Year" on the board, so make sure to watch me carefully!

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 6 - New Year's Banquet?</size>

scripts.say: Phew... All right, the New Year Soba is coming out nicely...
It smells really good...
Ah, watch out, Yuudachi! Don't fall into the pot!
This one seems yummy too! Gimme seconds!
Calm down, there's more than enough left.
Souryuu, you really are quite talented~ Oh my, is Kaga here too?
Being able to enjoy a moment of peace every now and then isn't so bad.
That's not something I hear from you every day, Kaga. Oh, by the way, where's Akagi?
She spouted something like "I need to pamper Commander, who is always so hard working," and then ran off again.
Oh my... Looks like Commander will have no shortage of troubles this New Year as well...
I suppose this is "the weight of love." Well, since it's the New Year, we might as well let Akagi cut loose a bit.
Speaking of "cutting loose," I think these two have gone a bit overboard.
Oh, sakura's liquor... is truly ambrosia... *hic*
Laffey... wants another glass too...
I'll turn a blind eye on Eugen... But why is that girl from the Eagle Union here?
I ran into her at the store, nya. She seemed quite interested in our New Year's customs, so I brought her along, nya.
Ah, what a waste. She's wearing such a cute outfit... but give her some drinks and she turns into a puddle of mush.
A New Year's drinking party, huh? Haha... I haven't gotten fired up in a while.
Oh my, I can already see what happens next...
Li... quor? Is that edible...?
That would be the name of a miserable end for adults who have cast away too much. It's not something a good kid like you needs to know about, nya.

sequence:
Lunar New Year Celebration

<size=45>Chapter 7 - New Year’s Wish</size>

scripts.say: Akagi, you didn't forget to do your New Year's shrine visit, did you?
Ahaha, of course not! I wished for important things like the Commander's health, and for Commander to avoid all those poisonous wicked pests~
Exactly as expected of you, Akagi...
Ugh... It feels like there are a hundred people smacking a gong inside my head...
My head... hurts....
What the heck, Kaga... Even though you were drinking so much, how come you look so refreshed today...?
Ughhh... So this is... the Sakura Empire's true power...
Heh, can't afford to miss the important New Year's shrine visit, after all.
We have to pray for peace and prosperity in the coming year, nya!
I'm... sleepy...
Well, we did stay up pretty late. Must be especially hard for those who went to the drinking party.
So this is the "shrine?" It has a nice atmosphere to it.
It's a sacred site, after all. It's quite impressive how those two sisters got set up here so quickly.
All right, since we're all here, we should all make our offerings.
Those who came here first have already started to hang up their wishes, huh? Wow, there's quite a variety of wishes...
This note with all these scribbly lines… “I wanna eat a lot of meat!” One glance and I can already tell it's Yuudachi's...
Welcome to the shrine. Yamashiro and I are so happy to see everyone's wishes. It makes all our work worth it.
Thank you for this ceremonial arrow. I shall take good care of it.
No, thank you for coming. Everyone, please come this way. Because Eugen and Laffey are here, I will explain how to make an offering.
First, purify your hands. Toss a coin into the offering box and ring the bell to greet the deity. Then bow twice, clap your hands twice, and pray. Finally, bow again, and you will be all done.
All right...
Okay...
Let’s start then.
(ding-a-ling~)
(I wish for these peaceful days to continue onwards…)
(ding-a-ling~)
(I wish for the Commander to rely on me more and more~)
(ding-a-ling~)
(Commander will definitely be with me forever, right, Gods? Of course, just leave those troublesome pests to me… hehehe…)
(ding-a-ling~)
(I wish to engage in a thrilling, bloody battle with a truly worthy foe this year...)
(ding-a-ling~)
(This year, I wish to be together with Mutsuki and all my friends, and we will have lots of fun playing together.)
(ding-a-ling~)
(I wish for everyone to support Akashi's business this coming year, nya)
(ding-a-ling~)
I wanna be able to eat a lot of delicious stuff!
Hey, if you say it out loud, it won't come true! Besides, that's not even a wish!
(ding-a-ling~)
(My wish, huh... My wish is to learn about a lot of interesting things, and meet a lot more interesting people in this fleet~)
(ding-a-ling~)
(I wish… to always be together with Commander... and everyone else...)
(ding-a-ling~)
I wish… that this will be a good year ahead of us!
Port - Office
As I sit at my desk and prepare to work, my eyes happen to wander to the desk calendar.
Hm? That time again?
I check the date, and an unpleasant feeling rushes through me like an electric current.
*BANG!*
Commander, Commander! Good news, nya!
Exactly as expected, a certain green furball throws the door open and barges in.
Nyahaha♪ I bring tidings of a long-awaited, once-annual, super discount promotion, nya!
Are we putting together a different advertising campaign this time? Or same as last year's?
Heheheh, the answer is neither, nya!
I worked my little cat brain to the bone and came up with my own new sale idea, nya!
Go on.
We trim all the fat and deliver savings straight to the customer. Simple as that, nya!
Returning limited outfits, special super sets for a limited time only, we've got all the goods, nya!
No ads, no programs, no silly haggling! Just cost-cutting and raw savings, nya!
Why do I get the feeling this is purely self-motivated?
N-no way, nya! I'd never be self-motivated, nya!
Uhh... Look at that, nya, I gotta go prep today's free gift packs!
Commander, you check out these flyers. Don't miss this huge opportunity, nya!
She scurries off, leaving nothing but a mountain of flyers.
Why did she leave all of these... What, is my office just ad space now?
Never an opening or a moment of hesitation with her.
But she's being sincere this time, at least.
After work, I think I'll go check out this sale.
The fanfare of ceremonial cannons could be heard throughout the waters of Europa.
Extravagant colors and sounds swirled together, parading through the newly-constructed pavilion in the likeness of the Colosseum.
At the center of the stage stands a girl clad in vibrant crimson.
Thank you to all of our friends who've come here from afar, and welcome to Sardegna!
We are blessed today by clear skies and fair winds, making this a perfect day to mark the beginning of our celebration.
This gathering of the world's peoples, once a sign of our unity, was disrupted years ago by the war and destruction brought on by the Sirens.
But now, we hold this event once more to reconnect our separated seas and to reforge our broken bonds.
Let us welcome this opportunity for the people of the world to share the joy of coming together once again.
Never have we abandoned our vision of a peaceful tomorrow.
And the fact that we've gathered here is proof of our determination, courage, and hope for the future!
Now, my friends, raise your voices and hands in applause!
Enjoy this celebration of peace from the bottom of your hearts!
I, battleship Roma of Sardegna, hereby proclaim...
Let the World Expo commence!
Another fanfare rang out, followed by thunderous applause that did not seem to abate.
A sudden realization struck Roma – this is the splendor of Sardegna. Was this not the glory that the legends of ancient Sardegna had once been blessed with?
She soaked in the excitement of the crowd a bit longer before retreating into the Colosseum.
While there was much to be satisfied about, there was also much that needed to be done.
Sardegna Pavilion "Colosseum" - Exhibit Hall
Now that the opening ceremony is over, people are starting to fill the pavilion as well.
I do wonder if this is the last bit of peace and quiet we'll get to enjoy before things get hectic.
But judging from the excitement in the air, I'd say that our hard work has paid off.
As it should be. All for the sake of spreading the splendor of Sardegna across the world...
As Roma walked through the empty exhibition hall, she could not shake the sense of uneasiness that crept into her.
Who's there? Show yourself!
Her voice echoed through the hall. There was no response.
Maybe the right question isn't who, but what...
Roma realized the source of her uneasiness was the items around her—she should've been in the exhibition area of the Imperial Senatus.
All the items here are replicas... But I checked everything in advance. What's going on here...?
The things here seem completely different from those I inspected the other day...
Wait, could there be something going on within the underground warehouse?
That should be the most heavily-protected place in the entire venue... Did something happen there...? I must go check on it!
Roma, unable to shake the sense of foreboding that swirled around in her head, immediately rushed towards the warehouse beneath the pavilion.

sequence: The operation led by the Eagle Union in the NA Ocean has restored stability to the region.
Behind closed doors, the Iron Blood's mutinous disturbance has been established.
The Royal Navy's excursion into the Singularity has paid great dividends.
And the Sakura Empire has completed their courtesy visit to Europa.
When the various factions seem to have been lulled into a state of stability,
Sardegna made a proposition to hold an event –
The long-halted "World Expo."
A celebration of peace where the shipgirls of the world would gather.
But even within the shining splendor of Sardegna, conspiracies sway in the shadows.

scripts.say: Over in the security control room, Veneto was staring at the footage from the surveillance cameras and pondering the situation.
I'm afraid I have bad news, Lady Veneto.
We reviewed the drone and camera footage from all around the venue, but were unable to locate Lady Roma.
But nobody has seen her leave the Colosseum, correct? That means she must still be somewhere inside.
Inside the Colosseum? Well, that was the first place we looked...
She didn't show up on any of our cameras. That can only mean one of two things – either Roma isn't in the Colosseum, or the cameras aren't working properly.
Not working properly... Perhaps that is what Shinano meant by "touched by a malicious presence."
Supposing they've been broken—or worse yet, hacked into—we're not going to find Roma just by looking through security footage.
That leaves us only one option: to temporarily put the Colosseum on lockdown.
Lockdown?! And put the World Expo on hold?
No, only the Colosseum. It will act as a preventative measure until we've completed our investigation.
Understood. Then I shall evacuate the spectators within the Colosseum... under the pretense of a mechanical failure.
...Wait, let me think things through.
(Marco Polo proposed this expo as the best chance we'll get to spread Sardegna's splendor to the world...)
(The other factions will take to wild speculation if we put our pavilion under lockdown, and our public image will plummet as a result...)
(On the other hand, we cannot resolve the situation without closing the Colosseum to investigate. At the same time, abandoning one of our own to save face is an unforgivably disgraceful notion.)
(Furthermore, there's no guarantee that Roma is still inside the Colosseum. What if we close the pavilion and still come up empty-handed? Then...)
(Argh! Why do you hesitate, Veneto?! Things will only get worse if you keep waiting around instead of taking action now!)
(That's right, we can't assume that only the Colosseum has been compromised. More guests may go missing from their pavilions while our focus is solely on the Colosseum...)
(Littorio... If you were here, what would you do?)
Veneto hasn't said a thing for a while now. Any ideas why?
I can't say for sure... But the decision to close the Colosseum is not an easy one.
The revival of the World Expo was entirely at Sardegna's suggestion. In other words, our reputation is on the line for the entire world to see.
Should an incident break out on the first day, the other factions would surely call question to our competence, regardless of the circumstances...
So what do we do then? Bury our heads in the sand and pretend everything's fine?
Well, um... I believe ensuring the safety of our guests is our top priority.
That said, I think we should only close the Colosseum if it's our last resort.
There must be other options. Like if there's a chance the security system has been tampered with, we could ask its designer or a security expert to have a look.
Yes! That's it, Bolzano!
P-pardon? Did I disrupt your train of thought...?
Quite the opposite – what you just said is a great idea. If anyone can tell us if the security system has been compromised, it's someone with intimate knowledge of it.
I should've thought of it sooner, myself... Say, why don't we bring this up with Torricelli?
Oh, I see... That's not good at all... Hehehehehe...
There's only two things that could override the cameras – a full-on hack, or the properties of a Mirror Sea... But I only do maintenance on the system, so take that with a grain of salt...
I doubt it's a Mirror Sea... It'd need to be tiny to only affect the Colosseum... In the case of a hack, I can't tell you much from where we are now...
Is there no way we can confirm one thing or the other?
I mean, there IS, but it's probably too complicated for you all...
I could head over there and do it if you want, though... Hehe, hehehehe...
May I have a word? Lady Veneto, the drones suddenly were issued a new patrol route. Did you do something in the control room?
A new patrol route? No, we haven't done anything.
Hey, look! The drones are moving en-masse! Their cameras are all over the place!
Someone must have seized control of them! How could this have happened?
Is it possible to shut down the system at a moment's notice?
Hehe, hehehe... You'd have to ask da Vinci...
I see... She built the foundation of the security system, didn't she?
Sure did. Even designed the control system for the drones... If anyone could shut it down, it's her...
Hehehehe... By the way, she also slipped a backdoor into the security system, which she might be using right now to take the investigation into her own hands...
And if this is the Sirens' doing instead, asking her for advice is the quickest way to a solution... Hehehe...
Anyway, we should probably find her as soon as possible... She'd have a way better idea of what to do than me...
Oh, and don't let her know I told you about the backdoor, alright? Hehe, hehehe...
(How much time has passed? These memories... do not belong to me...)
"Time passes, and seasons change."
"A single moment wrapped in splendor is a moment worth treasuring."
"Victory follows victory, triumph follows triumph."
"I came, I saw, I conquered."
"The horn sounds, the choir sings. My legion gathers."
"A new King comes."
"And a new conquest begins––"
Sakura Empire Pavilion - Woods
Heheh! I've updated all the drones' patrol routes and scan parameters! This is what I call Hyper-Focused Super-Searcher Mode!
Now we just wait for them to find the abnormality and send in a status report!
Photo op! Here we see Leonardo da Vinci, the to-be savior of Sardegna, the guiding star of the patrol team, taking matters into her own hands!
You don't think they'll use that photo as proof that she hacked the security system?
It'll be fine! They'll hail her as a hero when they learn she did it to resolve this whole ordeal!
Aw, dangit! Hide, everyone! Trieste is coming towards us, and fast!
Whaaat?! She's on to us already?!
Let's head into the woods! She'll brand us as some band of conspirators if she catches us now!
*sigh*... You should honestly rip that photo apart now while you have the chance.
Maybe later! But right now, we've gotta split!
*pant pant*... Did we lose her?
No idea. The drone cameras can't see through these thick woods.
But realistically, there's no way she'd chase us THIS far.
Wrong. I'd pursue you to the ends of the earth after what you've done.
Is that... It's her! H-h-how the heck did you manage to find us?!
Using the drone that went in the same direction as me. You were using it to keep an eye on me, weren't you?
Oops... I was so focused on running that I forgot to change that thing's flight route...
We're sorry, Trieste... But believe me, we weren't trying to cause any trouble.
I know you weren't. I came looking for you by orders from Veneto.
You're going to help us resolve this situation.
Wait, Veneto knows we took over the system?! Then she should've just asked us for help directly!
Because like, we spent all this time running and hiding, and for what?
For what? You of all people should know, Alfredo.
Oh, and we also know you trailed Bolzano and Garibaldi. You set yourselves up to be caught sooner or later.
Now that we're on the same page, would you return command of the drones to the control room already? The other factions will start getting suspicious soon.
Be quick, then follow me to the Colosseum. Veneto is waiting for you there.
Roger-roger!
(Another vision... It's as if my memories, no, somebody else's memories, are being read...)
"The darkness of the night makes the morning sun shine brighter. The crumbled ruins of old make the new city stand taller."
"And thus, the flames of war make the Throne more tempered."
"The will has been fulfilled. The decree has been passed down."
"Become greatness itself. Consolidate incompetence into kingly right."
"There is but one direction to proceed."
"Open the way for a new era."
Colosseum - Exhibition Area
This hall's clear too. Nothing seems to be off...
Come on, everything's the same as we left it! I can't even smell the traces of a scoop in here!
We have to keep looking. Veneto said there's a good chance this is where Roma went missing, remember?
What if... "Deep within this ordinary-looking exhibition hall lies a web of conspiracy, luring innocent tourists inside to spirit them away"...
Oh yes! Now THIS smells like a scoop!
One second it doesn't, and now it does?
...Try not to make too much of a ruckus, okay? There are still guests around, and Veneto doesn't want others finding out about this.
I know, I know! We'll solve this case and our guests will be none the wiser!
Oh? What's up, Teach? Your stare tells me you're onto something.
Not really. These display items caught my eye, that's all.
Each and every one of these is an antique or work of art from another faction, right?

Trust me on this! While they don't look like much, these things are built with Siren tech through and through. Our strength easily rivals theirs!
Sure, a fight against an equal number of mass-produced ships will be tough, but it's nothing we can't handle.
If it'll be tough, maybe we shouldn't risk it in the first place?

Don't you worry, Ema! I've got it all worked out.

Well, if you say so...

Brilliant! Also brilliant! What a glorious air armada I have!
Heheh... I'll win like, every award ever if I'm allowed to publish these photos~

Oh no! We've got to help! Teach, change course to where that fight's taking place!
Aye-aye, Cap'n!
Hehehe! Okay – full speed ahead!
KABOOOM!
Garibaldi and Bolzano succeeded in repelling the ghost ships and emerald eagles with the aid of Alfredo's air armada.
*pant*... *pant*... Did we win?
Hey! Are you girls okay?!

Seems our communicators function at short range. Alfredo, just what are those airships?

Uh-huh. That went way over my head.
Likewise, but I've grasped the gist of our situation.
Assuming your and da Vinci's hypothesis is correct, we will find the central control unit in the central Colosseum of this Mirror Sea.

Precisely. Knowing her, she's bound to have engaged Sirens en route. It's likely we'll find traces of her battles, although there's no guarantee...

Good point. Can't use our guns while aboard, and we're screwed if they surround us.

If you can take care of the eagles and secure air supremacy, that'd be even better.

Plaza outside the Colosseum
Woooah, the Colosseum looks even more incredible from the outside...
Gotta take another photo from this angle–!
Alfredo brought out her camera to take another photo of the Colosseum...
Huh, someone's in the way... Um, excuse me, would you mind moving to the side for a second–

With the backing of the air armada, the Sardegnian girls finally made it to the Colosseum's vicinity.

Mirror Sea - Colosseum
Roma! Thank god you're not hurt! We've come to bring you home!
Hello? Roma...?

Air armada, fire at will!
That's not Roma, Garibaldi! That's a Pawn!

Two fierce battles were taking place simultaneously at the Colosseum – one in the sky, and one at sea.

Teach! Can't you get us more airships?

I doubt we're gonna get good news anytime soon...
Emanuele pointed down at the sea. The air was filled with smoke and fumes from the two Sardegnian girls' ongoing battle with the Pawn.
How is she still going?! Are they pulling their punches 'cause the Pawn looks so much like Roma?!

Calm down! I'll think of something, just give me some time!
A short while later...
The eagles are coming for our flagship! They're trying to take us down!
Don't lose hope! I just need a bit more time...!

Um, why don't we get off the ship for now...?

See those vines all over the Colosseum?
Vines? What about them? Am I missing something?

Seriously? So if anything they're maintaining the Colosseum's integrity, rather than compromising it?
Correct! What's more, they're growing from right out of the sea! That's how I spotted 'em!

You're a genius, Teach! Okay, let's put the eagles aside and focus our assault on the vines!

You're what?! You know we're like, way up in the air, right?

Mirror Sea - Beneath the Colosseum
Da Vinci dove beneath the waves.
As she went deeper and deeper, the booming sounds of the battle being fought at the surface gave way to near silence.
Boy, I'm having to go deeper than I expected...
The Sirens no doubt predicted that anyone with common sense would head for the Colosseum.
I'll bet they assumed we wouldn't check underneath the surface. At most we'd notice the vines and destroy the Colosseum's top half.
And that assumption was where they went wrong. They might've fooled everyone else, but not me!
Going deeper into the dark depths, da Vinci eventually came face to face with a massive machine.
Bingo. They really did hide their magic box where they thought no one would look.
Let's see here... This is what's producing the vines, this thing manufactures the ghost ships, and this...
A... containment chamber? That's got to be where Roma is!
They must've hooked her up to some machine that reads her neural data in real time. That'd explain why that Pawn is so exceptionally strong.
Judging by the shape of this thing, Roma should be just a bit farther down...
Moving along a network of tubes, da Vinci descended deeper. Then, she found it – a square chamber encased in glass, anchored in place.
Look at these energy readings...! I've found you, Roma!
Alright, if I can sever the anchoring and power cables, the chamber should rise to the surface on its own.
My torpedoes are just enough for the job. A few well-placed hits should do it!
Just hang in there, Roma! I'm coming to save you!
That's everything set up for her rescue. Now the question is, what to do about this huge machine...
Between it and the Colosseum, I don't know which is the Mirror Sea's beating heart. Although, I guess it doesn't matter. If this thing breaks, the Colosseum goes down with it.
Let's see, how does one efficiently destroy a–
All of a sudden, the sea shook.
In the midst of her pondering, da Vinci was swept up by a strong current coming from below, dragging her closer to the surface.
What the–?! What's going on?!
Where's this current coming from?! Below me?!
No way! Don't tell me they had another machine deeper down!
All of a sudden, the sea shook.
From the surface. From the Colosseum.
It had begun collapsing into the sea. The others had succeeded in eliminating the vines, and without the support they provided, the Colosseum could not stay standing.
Crap, crap! These currents are pushing me all over the place!
Okay, change of plans! Ensuring Roma's safety comes first!

Da Vinci rushed to the chamber containing Roma and steadied it, making sure it wouldn't be swept away. When she looked over her shoulder, she saw the underwater torrents tearing the massive Siren machine apart.
Well, that saves me the trouble of destroying it myself... Hang on tight, Roma! I'm gonna get you back to the surface now!
With the Mirror Sea's central control unit destroyed, all its defenders—the emerald eagles, the ghost ships, and the Pawn—vanished into thin air in the twinkle of an eye.
Da Vinci and Roma resurfaced, and the first thing that greeted them was the welcome sight of their allies.
It won't be long before the Mirror Sea disappears altogether. That aside...
Lady Roma, are you okay? Please, answer us!
*cough cough*... Ugh... Where am I...?
It feels as though I've awoken from a long dream...
Looks like she's alright... Huh? What do you have there, Roma?
Roma raised the tile in her hand. She had held onto it ever since blacking out inside the warehouse.

It's a replica of a tile from the Great Library... It was being stored in the warehouse...
I knew something was amiss from the moment I laid eyes on it.
This is your captain speaking – we have landed! ...There you are, Roma! Thank god we found you!
What are those... airships?
Hahaha! You won't believe it, but da Vinci created these! All it took was commandeering a Siren facility – and a bit of her genius!

It sounds like you have a great story to tell later. It's a shame I didn't get the pleasure of fighting with you.
Teach? Oh god, are you okay?! Don't tell me she–
I'm fiiine, just resting in the water... I'm dead tired.
Phew... Well, hate to crush your dreams, but now's not the time to rest! C'mon, get up!

We can't NOT take a victory photo after a job well done!
Three seconds! Ema, pose for the camera!
Huh?! Just like that?!
Frickin'... Fine... If you insist!
Emanuele turned her head in confusion while da Vinci wrapped one arm behind Alfredo's neck and made a peace sign to the camera with the other.

*cough cough*! Well, mission accomplished! Time to go home!
World Expo Venue - Colosseum
Ahhh~ I don't think I'll ever get tired of the view from up here!
Yup yup, this occasion calls for a photo op! *click*...

Roma, I've come to visit!

Once again, allow me to thank you for saving me yesterday.

World Expo Venue

World Expo Venue - Colosseum?

...I guess not.

You really know your stuff, sis!

Right behind you, sis!

Just stop talking, Alfredo! You've caused another huge misunderstanding!
S-sorry... I'm Alfredo Oriani, from the Sardegnian fleet. And this is my friend, Leonardo da Vinci.
We're patrolling the venue right now, but I've never seen clothes like yours before and just couldn't pass up the photo op! I just wanted to say hello!
You're one of the organizer's ships then, huh...
I just wanted to approach the two of you to introduce myself, but then you broke out into a sprint!
I apologize as well then. I suppose I jumped to conclusions too quickly.
Well, all's well that ends well. Besides, this only happened because SOMEONE can't keep her camera to herself.
Ehehe, my bad, my bad~ In any case, are the two of you from the Dragon Empery?
Yes, my name is Hai Tien, and this is my sister, Hai Chi.
We are here as representatives of the Dragon Empery.
Actually, we wanted to know how to get to the Colosseum...
Really? I'll show you the quickest way to get there. Sorry again for what happened earlier!
Oh, there's no need for you to trouble yourself with that. We have a map, and don't mind taking a more scenic route to see the sights and sounds. After all, "when in Rome, do as the Romans do."
If you don't mind the inconvenience, there is one thing I'd like to ask you though...
Sure, fire away! I'll answer to the best of my ability!
What are those things floating in the sky with the little white propellers?
Those are probably our security drones.
Drones? At first glance, those things look so flimsy that it's a miracle they're staying in the air... How exactly is that possible?
I can't answer technical questions like that...
But I can refer you to the person who designed them – Leonardo da Vinci here!
Heh heh, what you're looking at is my original flying device – the Pneumatic Spinner-Arounder Helidrone!
Though these things may look like flimsy pieces of wood and paper, don't be fooled! They've been fitted with the latest, cutting-edge technology by yours truly!
They're lightweight, versatile, maneuverable, and best of all... this latest model can even carry people!
Hehe, want to give it a try?
I... I appreciate the offer, but I think I'll pass.
You bet I do!
...Hai Chi?!
Da Vinci pulled a controller out from nowhere and slapped at it a few times before waving at the sky, and a drone descended right after.
Without even waiting for the drone's altitude to stabilize, Hai Chi jumped up acrobatically and plopped down on the disc-shaped "seat."
The drone soon carried her higher and higher, the anxiety on Hai Tien's face following suit.
Woooo, the wind suddenly picked up! It feels great up here–!
So, um, your... Pneumatic Spinner-Arounder Helidrone... is it going to be okay...?
Of course! All of my inventions are a-hundred-percent safe and secure! As long as you don't suddenly deploy your rigging, there's no chance of falling!
Look over there, sis! Those two girls seem to be rushing over here!
They're from Sardegna's fleet, right? Their uniforms are so cool... I wonder what they're up to?
Hrmm... You're right! It's Bolzano and Garibaldi...?
I thought those two were in charge of security around the Colosseum... Now what are they doing over here?
They seem to be secretively whispering something into a communicator too... *gasp*!
Come with us, Teach! Let's go check out the Dragon Empery area first!
What's wrong? You two look awfully serious all of a sudden...

There's nothing to worry about! It may not seem like it, but I'm keeping a careful eye on the venue! If there's a scoop to be had... Err, I mean, if any trouble breaks out, I'll be the first to sound the alarm!
Oh, um, I see... In any case, we'll be fine over here, so don't let us keep you from your investigation.
Hup! Give me a holler when you swing by our pavilion! I'll show you around!
I'll take you up on that then!
Da Vinci, let's go see what Bolzano and Garibaldi are up to!
Colosseum - Underground Warehouse
This is where all the exhibits that aren't on display today are being stored...
Now, let's see... The source of the unusual scent in the air...
Is right here!
Roma lifted up the dustproof sheet covering a glass exhibit box, revealing the contents underneath.
This is... a stone tile from the Great Library?
If I remember properly, this was excavated not too long ago under the direction of the Senate, and later recovered from that Siren "labyrinth"...
Why is there already a replica of something that was freshly excavated? What exactly is going on here...?
I suppose there's no point overthinking things though... *sigh*
Roma opened up the storage case, weighing the tile in her hands while inspecting it carefully.
I knew it, there's something amiss...
At a surface level, the replica was made impeccably, to the point where it could hardly be distinguished from the real article. However, the material it was made of was certainly not stone.

While handling the uncanny imitation in her hands, Roma had a premonition that what she was holding was not a relic with over a thousand years of history, but rather technology beyond this time and world.
I know I checked this exhibit before, and this is not the same tile that I handled.
Maybe someone replaced it with a replica while it was stored in this warehouse...?
But that doesn't make any sense. The "original" piece submitted for inspection was already a replica, so what's the point of swapping one replica for another?

Lost in thought, Roma closed her eyes and subconsciously reached for the tile, running her fingers across its surface. Suddenly, a burst of images flowed through her mind as if they were her own flashbacks.
She seemed to see light pouring from the ancient lighthouse, sheets of papyrus fluttering through the library, clouds of dust kicked up by horses, and watery mist stirring from aqueducts.
Where... am I...?
When she opened her eyes again, she was no longer in the underground warehouse. Instead, a vast wilderness stretched out before her eyes.
What... just happened to me?!
Somewhere in the Expo Venue...
What's wrong, Alfredo? Why the sudden call?
And why are you hiding behind the other side of the wall? Where's da Vinci?
Hush! Teach is currently monitoring things from the air, so we have to stay on the down-low and focus on staying hidden!
Is Ema here? Good, I'll reconfirm the targets' location then–
Mark B and Mark G are currently heading towards the Colosseum.
They seem to be checking something while moving, and they've been busy on the communicators this whole time.
Understood! Something big is happening, Teach, just like I said!
Continue offering air support. Ema and I are moving out now!
You got it!
...I thought you were patrolling the venue. Why in the world are you tailing Bolzano now?!
Excuse me, I'm not TAILING her, I'm conducting an undercover investigation!
Don't you think something's fishy, Ema? We're in charge of patrolling the venues, so why would the two people in charge of keeping an eye on the Colosseum suddenly leave their posts?
Plus, they've continuously been in touch with someone this whole time while moving about!
Or... They got someone else to watch the underground warehouse and went on patrol themselves because some people here, and I won't name names, are so unreliable.
Wow, mean!
Yeah, what she said! That was mean!

...In any case, I want you, Alfredo, to call off your "undercover" investigation, and I want you, da Vinci, to get down from there already. At this rate, WE'RE going to start looking like the suspicious ones sneaking around...
If you're worried about Bolzano being out here, you should probably just ask her upfront. I guarantee you, she'll happily fill you in on whatever she's doing.
Heh heh... And that's why you're an amateur! You'll never be able to land a huge scoop with such naive methods!
...Sure then.
This is da Vinci! The situation has changed! Bolzano and Garibaldi are no longer heading to the Colosseum!
Way ahead of you! I saw them walk into a small room that says "Do Not Enter" near the Colosseum! What kind of place do you think it is, da Vinci?
It's the control room for the venue's security system.
Oh...? In other words, there must be something wrong for them to need to check the security system?
Hrmmmmmmmmm... Yes – this is, without a doubt, a huge scoop in the making!
Is there any way to find out what exactly they're looking for?
Hah~♪ Who the hell do you think I am? I practically designed the base framework for the security system here!
Naturally, I left a little backdoor specifically for times like this!
Woah, I knew I could count on you! The excitement's making my hairs stand on end!
Well, the process is actually quite complicated, so we'll need some peace and quiet as well as a bit of time.
Hmm... Then how about the forest next to the Sakura Empire pavilion?
That's a great idea! I'm so glad you're on board, Ema~! The investigation team gets another member!
Let's get ready to go, Teach!
Deep in the woods next to the Sakura Empire pavilion, da Vinci was fiddling around with a controller with extreme concentration.
Hrmm, mmhmm... I see, I see.
How's the progress, Teach? Think we'll be able to get the scoop?
I've managed to connect a drone to the room's communication equipment. So far, it looks like Bolzano's checking the status records of today's patrols.
That's certainly a bit unusual. They must be trying to dig something up.
...What might that "something" be?
Who knows? We're all playing it by ear now. Speaking of which... This isn't good. I can't hear what they're talking about inside that room.
Huh? Why not?
I dunno, why don't you figure out a way then? I have access to the security system, but it's not like I have the room itself wiretapped.
But... Maybe I can knock the power out in the control room to force them to come outside where my drone can listen in...
Da Vinci! Someone's coming this way...!
Crap, has our cover been blown?
How is that possible? I'm the one who installed the backdoor... Apart from Torricelli, who isn't here, nobody else should know about its existence...
Find somewhere to hide, everyone! Quick!
Da Vinci and company quickly took cover. The footsteps of several shipgirls became louder and louder as they approached.
Is that... Veneto?
Didn't she have to go somewhere as soon as the opening ceremony ended? Why would she suddenly show up over here?
I'll say this again... All of this smells way too fishy. There's definitely something major about to happen...
Look, the people next to Veneto are from the Sakura Empire...
You're right... But keep your head down more or we'll get found out!
And put the stupid camera away, Alfredo! If we get caught, an apology won't cut it this time!
Thank you for coming to our humble exhibition hall. This one... extends you her gratitude.

Your gardens were simply wonderful, and the juxtaposition of spring, summer, fall, and winter on a single island was truly a sight to behold. Is that the inspiration behind your pavilion's name, "Shiki no Hana?"
Indeed... We are now in the Spring Garden. It is said that a year's plans begin in the spring... and that is reflected in our pavilion as well.
Lady Veneto, I've brought you some traditional Sakura-style tea, if you don't mind.
Mm... I see, the aroma is quite distinct from the Royal Navy's black tea.
It is the same variety of tea, but the taste differs greatly depending on where it is grown... Is it to your liking?
Very much so, thank you. What a gentle and refined flavor.
But, let's get down to business. Lady Shinano, what is this "incident" you mentioned to me earlier?
Umm... Do excuse this one for bringing up such matters on the first day of the expo, but... have you noticed any abnormalities around the venue?
Abnormalities? Let's see... Nothing in particular comes to mind.
I see... That is fine then. Since last night, this one has felt an unusual aura coming from this venue...
This one was afraid that the venue had been touched by a malicious presence, but... if there is nothing amiss here, that is for the better.
Can you elaborate a bit on what you think is causing this "unusual aura?"
While nothing has gone wrong just yet, the security here at the World Expo is of paramount importance to us, and we cannot allow any potential dangers to go unchecked.
As the representative of Sardegna, I ask for your cooperation, Miss Shinano.
What this one fears is that... No, I shall tell you everything I know, Miss Veneto...
But, it may be inadvisable to discuss such contents out here... We can continue inside the pavilion if you'd like.
Very well. Let's do just that.
Right this way then, Lady Veneto.
Phew... They've finally left...
At the very end there, it seemed like Shinano was looking straight at you...
Th-th-there's no way she knew we were here! I was practically holding my breath the whole time!
Yeah, there's no way! If our cover was blown, they definitely would've chewed us out for eavesdropping on them!
I-I guess so... I'm starting to feel like we're in over our heads here...
Hehehe... "A malicious presence grips the World Expo"...
I'm sure Bolzano and Garibaldi understand the situation! That's why they're investigating around as well to see if anything's wrong!
We can't afford to let them get the legs up over us, the patrol team! Let's keep searching for clues and evidence!
Teach, you're able to control all the drones around the venue, right?
Since this is an emergency situation, let's have all the drones start scanning around to see if we can find this "abnormality" Shinano was talking about!
Wait a sec! That's way too much commotion! It'd totally expose the fact that I bugged the security system!

Let's look at things from another perspective - if you manage to crack the case and resolve a dangerous situation, not only will you not get blamed for anything, you'll even get an increase in your invention research budget!
Yes, I see... That IS something only I can do. Hehehe... Alright, I've made up my mind! Just leave it to me!
(What is this... that I'm seeing? It feels so nostalgic... yet also so strange...)
"I cross the Seven Hills, the peoples' voices calling out to me."
"Fight, for the beginning of a new world."
"Fight, for the beginning of a new splendor."
"I shall not walk alongside the hero newly-born."
"The enemies come, innumerable as the teeming tides."
"But, who is capable of stopping us?"

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Moreso than Usual...</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outside the Office
One day, Prinz Eugen, third ship of the Admiral Hipper class and little sister to my secretary, was standing outside of the office.
Oh my. Guten Morgen, Commander. Aren't you quite the sleepyhead today~ You have no idea how pouty my poor sister was, having to wait for you this whole time.
You know, she really wants to make a good impression on you as your secretary~ In any case, I need to get going. Have fun, you two... Hehe~
As soon as I heard those words from Prinz Eugen's lips, I already could picture Hipper's furious expression in my mind... Nevertheless, I took a deep breath and pushed the office doors open.
H-hey...! Y-you sure took your sweet time today! Do you know how long I've been waiting here?
Eh? You wanted me to come wake you up? Excuse me? Wh-who do you take your secretary for?!
I sat down, sighing a breath of relief, knowing that Hipper is acting the same as always.
...(Glances sideways)
She's staring at me intently...
Wh-what's your deal? Focus on your work already! Or... did you have something more important to tell me?
...Wh-what?! Staring? Was not! Who would stare at the likes of you?! And you, how can you act like nothing just happened?! I was worried that something bad had...
Ah geez, I completely lost my work rhythm because of you! I'm heading out real quick for some fresh air! B-but you'd better not assume I'm slacking off or anything!
After firing those words out of her mouth like a machine gun, Hipper darted out of the office.
Oh my... I was about to bring over the previous report, but saw Hipper running down the hall... What'd you do this time, Commander?
Hehe. Clueless as ever, I see. But that's very much like you~
Despite how she acts, my sister can be really bashful, you know?
Prinz Eugen smiled at me with warmth and compassion in her eyes. What is going on today...?

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Hipper Wants to Calm Down</size>

scripts.say: After reaching a good place to take a break from work, I decided to get up to look for Hipper.
Even though she said some mean things, I didn't expect that she had already finished all her work by the time she left...
Just when I was starting to dwell on this fact, I spotted Hipper in one of the lounges. She seemed to be completely engrossed in something.
Seriously... Whether's it's Eugen or that big idiot, why do they always... Am I reading too much into things? Did I misunderstand something? Fat chance, right? Yeah, no way...
But, shouldn't that idiot have come looking for me by now? Geez...
Eeeaaahh?! Wh-wh-when did you get here?!
You would've said something but... you didn't want to interrupt my monologue? ...Excuse me?!
Dammit, this is your fault! I'm not myself today because of you!
My fault? What did I do to wrong her?
Deep breaths, deep breaths... Whew... Whatever, forget it. Anyway, what do you want?
What am I doing? ...Arranging flowers, I guess?
What's with that look on your face? Is it THAT weird for me to have hobbies?
I'll do this sometimes when I want to calm down. It's easier for me to concentrate when I'm alone... Why do I need to calm down in the first place...?! Why, that's... because... of... you!
Gaahhh! It took me all that time to calm down, and now I'm all worked up again!
You must've been really focused since you didn't even notice me until I called out to you...
Hm? Hmph, well, yeah. I'm quite confident in my aesthetic talents... Did it interest you that much? Hmm...
Just out of curiosity, what's your favorite flower?
I randomly picked the names of a few flowers that I actually know about.
Oh really? In that case... maybe I'll make something for you if I'm ever in the mood.
You're always hanging out in that dreary office of yours. Stewing in your tastelessness all day can't be healthy.
Hipper seemed to have cheered up a bit at least...

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Getting A Clue</size>

scripts.say: Port - Academy
Why were you taking Great Shark out for a joyride again? Take better care of your stuff, will you?!
Ugh... It's my fault this happened to Great Shark... I'm sorry!
I heard the voices of Hipper and U-101 as I was walking past the Academy.
C'mon... Here. Just tighten these bolts up and you'll be fine.
Woah! Great Shark feels brand-spankin'-new! This bad boy might go even faster now! Can I give 'im a shot?
Excuse me? What did we literally just talk about? ...You know what, whatever. That one has a mind of its own anyway. Just be careful!
You got it! All righty, Great Shark! Let's hit the sea!
There was the loud roaring of an engine, followed by something whizzing past me.
Woah! That was a close call... Commander! Don't just run in the way like that! Huh? I was the one who wasn't watching where I was going? Ahahaha...
Hey! U-101, please don't tell me you ran someone over! Hey, we're so sorry! This all happened because I– Geh... Wh-wh-wh-why are you here?!
But I'm telling you, he's super amazing! Thanks to Hipper's maintenance, Great Shark's brakes are so responsive! Commander, if it wasn't for Hipper's maintenance, you would've been fish food now!
You mean, none of this would've happened if you weren't riding around like a maniac! Geez!
Commander, Commander, I'm serious! Hipper's super good at repairing stuff! So I had her work on Great Shark!~
Indeed, had it not been for Hipper, this story would've ended in tragedy.
Hey, Hipper, wanna take him out for a spin? Hehe, or we can double ride~ I've not had my daily fill of adrenaline yet!
Oh for– You almost ran someone over, and that's all you can think about? Do I need to modify it more so you can only drive safely?
Nooooooo! Don't underclock iiiiit!
So, not only can she arrange flowers, but she can also fix bikes. Hipper really is more than meets the eye.
I expressed my heartfelt appreciation to Hipper for saving my life.
By the looks of things, I would be able to entrust work to her that required extreme attentiveness to detail.
Huh? Oh, um, when you put it that way... Umm, th-thank you...
Hm? Hipper, are you blushing? Ahh! I knew it... Something DID happen between you two last time!
Sh-sh-sh-sh-shut up! That was just business as usual! It's not like we were going on a date or anything!
There you go doing it again~ Besides, what's there to be embarrassed about?
Ugh... One more word from you... and I'll make it so that you can only stay under the speed limit!
NOOOOOOOOOOO!~
Huh. Come to think about it... We did do something like that, didn't we...
I stopped to think and slowly recollect the events of that day...

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Seaside Ride</size>

scripts.say: Not long ago...
Because of some emergency orders, I had to head somewhere else for work. And on the way back, I accompanied her on a detour.
Whew... It feels really nice to drive around like this every once in a while. I'm getting a bit tired though, so let's take a break. I'll pull over right ahead over there, okay?

Mm... The scenery's not bad over here~ You can see the endless sea stretching all the way across the horizon. It's so different from when we're on those very waters, fighting... But from here, you can really appreciate how beautiful it is.
It really was worth coming down along the coastline!
I'm not sure if the strong winds along the way had gotten to her, but Hipper seemed more excitable than usual.
Being the secretary is hard work, you know? My shoulders are all stiff from mindlessly pushing papers all day.
After we get back to port, let's rest up and reset. By the way, not too long ago, a few friends from the Vichya Dominion asked me to teach them to play an instrument.
...What, you want to hear me play too? Sure, I suppose there's no harm in that...
For whatever reason, Hipper felt a lot kinder than usual.
I have to say though, you really impressed me today. Though you normally act like you're completely useless without your secretary...
If you were half as diligent as you were today, my life would be so much easier. But, it's whatever... Just for today, you've earned your praise. Good work, Commander~
...Hey, are you even listening?
Eh... Y-you idiot! What a stupid thing to say all of a sudden! Geez!
And I'm not acting bashful at all! It's all because you went and said that weird thing earlier!
Admiral Hipper’s face was several shades redder than I had ever seen it. Quite impressive, really...

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Strategy Meeting?</size>

scripts.say: A certain day, in the residential area...
Several ships gathered around for what appeared to be a strategy meeting.
So, that's what happened. What do you think?
...Sis, are you serious?
I wouldn't know what to do either!
...Just listen quietly.
Anyway, as I was saying... Whenever I'm around this one person, I just feel like... I'm not quite myself. This has never happened to me before...
I can't seem to calm down, or I can't figure out what to say. Seriously, I don't get it at all! Geez, why am I letting some idiot get me all flustered?!
I see... But, you already know what you should do next, right?
If I knew, I wouldn't be asking you two for advice!
Hey! You just told us to sit here and listen quietly!
Well, you know... It's not that I can't understand your feelings. After all, you are a temperamental washboard.
What do washboards have to do with any of this?!
*sigh*... If I was as resourceful as you, I'd be able to figure out some countermeasures even in this situation.
All right, mastermind, what's your grand idea?
Let me think. Yeah, in a situation like this, you need to take the initiative. Which means: make a move on the commander.
...Having said that, the direct approach might be a bit too hard for you, my dear innocent sister.
*sigh*... I can't believe you... I should've just asked someone else! Glowworm! Your thoughts?
If you ask me... Just charge at the problem and headbutt it right into the ground!
Hmm... When it comes to the careful push-and-pull of romance, that might be a bit...
R-romance?! Having that said, I do like Glowworm's suggestion. "Muster up the courage to charge forward!" That very much suits her style...
I suppose that could work? After all, you only got into this mess because you let this "certain someone" catch you off guard. Hehehe~
Enough of that already! Since we've decided, I'll be going now!
Oh, she ran off. Think she'll be okay?
Hehe... I wouldn't be too worried. The outcome was set in stone long ago.

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Courageous Charge</size>

scripts.say: Port - Outside the Office
...We need to talk!
Hipper suddenly threw open the door and barged in.
Why else would I be here... Look what you've done to me! I haven't been myself lately because of you!
When you were working that other day, I was just thinking about how you weren't half bad...
But then nothing came of it at all! Ever since we got back, I've been cleaning up after your messes, nonstop!
How'd she get that impression of me...?
It's natural to help out while I'm the secretary, but even when I'm not working, I'm always worried about whether you might need help with something!
Have you ever been in this situation where you just can't stop thinking about someone?! You've even started appearing in my dreams... How annoying is that?!
I was left stunned by Hipper's words for some length of time.
Ahh, geez. How am I going to get you to take responsibility for this?
*sigh*... But considering how daft you can be, I'd be better off just asking Glowworm...
Hipper was so... embarrassed? That she looked like she was about to cry. Just then...
...Whew. The anticipation was killing me, so I just had to come take a look... But you two are like brick walls trying to talk to each other.
E-Eugen! Why are you here...?
I was planning to come cheer up my cute, clumsy sister~♪
Commander, did you know? The reason why she's been so flustered is because she saw the couple's ticket that Akashi bought for you.
What? Sh-sh-shut up! I've never even heard about this...!
Buying that ticket of course means that you plan to use it. In other words, she was thinking about who you were going to give it to. Right, sis?
N-nonsense! Besides, how did you even know about that?! Peeping at other peoples' stuff is really distasteful!
Well, whatever the case may be... the cat's out of the bag now, isn't it? What do the two of you plan to do now?
It... it's not like that... Hmph! Idiotic Commander! What... Did you have something to say to me?!
I'm a kind and tolerant person, so I'll... hear you out...
The memory of the scenery we saw together was still fresh on my mind. And this ticket... was for a two-person trip so that we could enjoy that view again.
Perhaps this small token was not enough to thank Hipper for her hard work as my secretary, but I wanted to at least try to express my sentiment.

options.content: Hand the couple's ticket to Hipper

scripts.say: Huh...?! Th-this was... for me...?
I-I suppose I have no choice then! Be grateful that I'm willing to give you the time of day!

sequence:
Paradigm of Happiness

<size=45>Chapter 7 - A Lifelong Vow</size>

scripts.say: Several days have passed since I returned from the trip with Hipper.
Excuse me? You still haven't finished your work? Good grief, you shouldn't have put it off earlier then! Learn to use your brain, you big moron!
Huh...? Wasn't the trip suppose to improve their relationship?
I originally thought... Well, at least it looks like things are back to normal.
All right, stop wasting your breath and sit down! Here, this is the report from today's exercise, which you can use as a reference for planning your next sortie.
You what? You forgot? Geez, do you even have two lone braincells rubbing in that thick skull of yours?!
Seems like she's as strict as ever with the commander... Are you sure they're fine?
You don't see it? I think they both look happier than they were before.
Even though Hipper seems to be absolutely seething?
If I was in that situation, I would've hopped on Great Shark and bailed ages ago.
Hehe. Maybe you can't tell, but the commander knows. She isn't upset at all...
She's just doing her best to help.
This, too, is another way of showing love. Hehe, it really puts a smile on one's face~
Ohhh... I've heard about that before~! Maybe I should treat the commander like that too!
In your case... Oh, right... Be careful not to bump your head again.
But in her case, she should learn to rely on the commander a bit more as well. That's my hopelessly proud sister for you~
Say what? You still haven't finished organizing your files? Geez, you really can't get anything done without me!
Fine, fine. I'll do it for you, but promise me, you'll work harder, become someone more capable, and then...
Devote yourself to making me happy!
Hipper's attitude doesn't seem to have changed much compared to before, but...
Since that day, my office has always been adorned with a bouquet of Hipper's freshly-arranged flowers.

sequence:
Angel or Devil in White?

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Resupply Surprise?!</size>

scripts.say: Port - Plaza
Nya~ Today's supply shipment can probably last a long time~ It's good that the Navy isn't stingy with these things, nya~
Isn't that obvious...? What kind of war effort would be too stingy to deliver supplies to its front lines...?
That may be true, but just seeing so many supplies makes me happy, nya~ It feels nice knowing that others have our backs, nya~
... Even you can say something nice every now and then.
Nya?! A compliment, from Shiranui? Ahh, big trouble, nya! Is the world coming to an end, nya?
You little... Well, whatever, let's see... you have ammunition, food, medical supplies, and... what's this?
Nya?! Lemme see, nya!
What is this, nya? Cosplay?
It appears to be... some kind of nurse uniform...
Did someone say nurse uniform?
Uunya?! Where'd you come from, Vampire?! You surprised me, nya!
I was just passing through.
If that's the case, could you stop trying to compare that outfit to your own size...?
Eh? What's the harm? Look, it's a liiittle small, but isn't that perfect for me?
... But you're not even a nurse. If anything, the dumb cat here would probably count.
Nya?! If I have to wear that, count me out, nya!
... Hehh~
Now you've said it. Are you forgetting that I'm one of the most experienced destroyers in the Royal Navy? Nursing is as easy for me as afternoon tea!
Really, nya?!
A~ny~ways~! I'll be taking this nurse uniform off your paws!
... And there she goes, nya...
Well, since it's just an outfit, we can just ask Commander to deduct it from her paycheck. Let's continue checking the supplies and worry about that later.

sequence:
Angel or Devil in White?

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Vampire's Allure</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dorms
... I said all that, but what is a nurse supposed to do anyway? ... Maybe I should ask around first.
One hour later...
... W-well, looks like it's a lot more complicated than I thought... Maybe I'll have to ask Vestal for some advice...
Port - Office, a few days later...
... And, thy temperature is fine, too~♪ Commander, thou art quite the healthy one~♪
Do you notice something different about me today~?
That's right. Today, I'm a nurse. The thing that thou loveth so... want to take a peek?
But thou cannot~ since this outfit is a little small...
Ahem. Pardon the interruption.
Your Excellency, please check this supply shipment.
Hmph... Just when I was getting to the fun part...
Miss Vampire... I won't judge your hobbies, but perhaps it would be wise to keep the time and place in mind?
Besides, wearing this kind of outfit to work is, how do I put this... a bit sleazy...
Ehhh?! This is a proper nurse outfit, all right? I changed into it to take care of Commander! What, dost thou not trust me?
Um, I don't think my trust matters here...
What dost thou think, Commander? Thou trusts me, right?
Hmph! Fine, since you both don't believe me, I'll prove that I wasn't just wearing this to try to seduce Commander!
Vampire stormed out of the office.
I never accused her of trying to seduce anyone...
But maybe I did go a bit overboard... Sorry, Your Excellency. I'll make sure to apologize to Vampire later.

sequence:
Angel or Devil in White?

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Vampire, New Nurse?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Hallway
What's their deal anyway! I just figured Commander might want some eye candy after working so hard all day...!
Big dumb bully Commander! I don't care anymore!
I even went through all the trouble of learning how to be a nurse... Hmph! I'll just have to make that big dummy speechless with how good I am at taking care of people!
Javelin, is there anything bothering you?
Ah, Vampire!
Oh um, not particularly...? I feel pretty perky right now!
Glowworm, surely your head hurts from headbutting things left and right! Here, come lie on this table and let Nurse Vampire take care of you!
Hey, don't pull on me...! I'm perfectly fine!
Laffey, you'll catch a cold if you fall asleep here. Here, use this blanket.
... Ugh... Hot... Heavy...
Um... Miss Vampire...?
Huh? London? Hmm, I bet you're here to apologize for earlier~
Um, I did plan on that, but... Commander's calling for you...
Ah! So that big dummy is also having second thoughts about being so cold to poor little Vampire! Good thing I'm not the type to hold grudges~
*sigh*...

sequence:
Angel or Devil in White?

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Emergency?</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
Huh...? I'm bothering others...?
Well, I wouldn't say bothering, but there are some who are concerned about you...
I see... so I'm the bad guy here...
Ah, no, not at all! Vampire, you tried to do a good thing by helping others, and we all respect that...
I am very sorry for what I said!
No, even I know that I'm the one at fault here...
I can't even do the basics properly, and who needs a nurse like that... I suppose I'll return this outfit to Akashi and apologize to everyone...
Vampire, actually...
Commander, there's trouble!!
Mutsuki got sick all of a sudden! Wh-what should we do?
What?!
... London, can I wait a little bit to return this outfit?
Commander? Understood.
All right...! London, please call Akashi and Vestal. Commander and I will go see Mutsuki. Is that fine?
Understood!
Let's go, Commander! We can't keep the patient waiting!

sequence:
Angel or Devil in White?

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Vampire, Pro Nurse!</size>

scripts.say: Comainder...
Will Mutsuki be okay...?
Everything will be okay. Vestal says it's just an ordinary fever. But, we have to do our part here too. Kisaragi, mind bringing bring me two towels and a basin of water?
Yes ma'am!

And now to finish up... all right! I'll go find some medicine for her to take, and with some rest, she should feel better in no time! Commander, please stay with Mutsuki. She'll feel at ease with thee at her side.
Mutsuki, everything will be fine. We're all here for you.
Okay...
Don't you worry, nya. When you wake up, you'll feel back to normal, nya? ...Huh? My job here is already done, nya?
Phew... thank goodness.
Vampire, you're quite capable, nya. Have you considered a future as a battlefield nurse, nya?
... Not really. I just took a glance at the basics. There's no way I'd be able to handle the actual job.
Huh? Weren't you staying up late studying some technical stuff every night?
Eh?! H-how'd you know, London?!
Um, Javelin told me... She was worried about your health because of it. Nobody ever said you were doing something bad.
Vampire, I didn't get a chance to tell you earlier, but... you really looked like the real deal just now.
... I see.
Well then, Commander, can I keep this outfit then? For purposes other than seduction~
... Of course, I'll make sure to do my job properly too! Thou hast my promise!
She never said she'd stop trying to seduce me though... I guess some Vampires never change.

sequence:
A Party for the Ages

<size=45>1.A Morning Unlike Any Other</size>

scripts.say: Office - A morning like any other
...Except it's actually not.
Mornin', Commander!
You had breakfast yet? If not, you want some of this?
For whatever reason, Seattle forces a jianbing – a savory, crepe-like food from the Dragon Empery – into my hands.
Since she became my secretary, every day has had its unique flavor – including breakfast as well.
You know what they say, breakfast is the most important meal of the day!
And you're gonna need the energy for Operation Extravaganza! By the by, how's the food?
I wonder to myself what this "Operation Extravaganza" is as I sink my teeth into layers of fluffy egg, crispy youtiao, and savory black bean sauce.
Mhm! Had a feeling you'd dig it!
I bought it from that Empery street food stall Ning Hai and friends started. Been hearing good stuff about 'em.
Apparently Sardegna's expanding their menu too, so we're gonna have like, a bajillion breakfast items to choose from!
The jianbing? Picked it up from Ning Hai and Ping Hai's recently-opened Dragon Empery street food stall. It's been all the rage recently!
Apparently, the Sardegna girls are trying to expand their offerings to compete with them, so we're gonna have like, a bajillion breakfast items to choose from soon!
That settles it! Tomorrow, let's grab some Sardegnian colazione!
"Now that you mention it, it does feel like there's been a flood of new breakfast options lately."
You betcha. Oh, that reminds me!
I was gonna tell you about Operation Extravaganza!
Right. I almost forgot about that.
So, I've been planning this bangin' event for the next time a holiday rolls around!
The elevator pitch is this – let's give the port a makeover, with all the entertainment you can imagine!
You want the deets? I've got you.
BAM! She drops a thick, leather-bound project folder onto my desk.
It's gonna be SO lit! You on board, Commander?
...You mean it? Aw yeah, then let's get this show on the road!
I give her a nod, and the very next moment, she drags me out of the office.

sequence:
A Party for the Ages

<size=45>2.Operation Extravaganza</size>

scripts.say: Several days pass. I'm walking down the road when I notice something odd.
Neon lights, strung up in the trees on both sides of me.

options.content: "What in the world is going on here...?"

scripts.say: The lights? Can't you tell, they're totally party decorations.
You know, like in the project folder? The one you greenlit, remember?
Yup, they sure are!
Ain't that kinda obvious? You're the one who approved 'em!
"Did I?"
Well, yeah! It's all part of Operation Extravaganza! Don't tell me you forgot already~
I rack my brain for a moment and vaguely remember her saying something about it the other day.
These decorations are just like, phase one of the whole plan.
And phase two, that's about... Ah, you probably don't remember.
Actually, I wanna test your memory. Try to guess what it is.
Whaddya call an event where people get together and have a hell of a time?
Knowing her, I think I know the answer.

options.content: "The best party the port's ever seen!"

scripts.say: Ding, ding, ding!
And still I had to jog your memory... I know you're busy, but so busy you forgot what you even approved? You're overworking yourself.
Good thing we have a holiday coming up so someone can force you to take a load off!
That's what this party will be all about: giving everyone, including you, a venue to relax, drink, eat, or whatever floats your boat!
The theme is like a world cruise, featuring all factions – from the Dragon Empery to Sardegna – and everyone's invited!
Didn't plan it all myself, of course. Georgia helped me iron out some of the deets.
"Such a big event needs a lot of food... Is that why you've had me try all those breakfast options?"
Bingo. You connected the dots! Hahaha!

sequence:
A Party for the Ages

<size=45>3.Setting the Mood</size>

scripts.say: I arrive at the party venue with Seattle to oversee the preparations being made.
"So, what do we have to do today?"
First thing's first – setting the mood!
Mood is the thing that makes or breaks a party, especially when it's a major, hyped-up event.
