We have to get to the bottom of all this. This is one mission I cannot sit out on.

sequence: Antarctica
Site of Unusual Weather - Snowmelt Area
Sometime later

scripts.say: Hey... Does anyone else hear that? There's a river nearby!
That ain't no river, that's a waterfall! Multiple of 'em, even!
How the hell is there running water this near the South Pole?
It's the snowmelt, no? It's revealing the mountains underneath.
Tallinn wasn't kidding. I know she wasn't, but now that I'm seeing it with my own eyes...
It's not just melting the snow on the surface. Underground rivers are forming inside the mountain... The bunker has to be doing this.
Please be careful. The ice has become unstable.
Watch your footing as we ascend this mountain.
Ugh! Why does our adventure in the snow have to include climbing a mountain?! I'm so tireeed!
*pant*... *pant*...
This sucks ass... Shipgirls were made to travel seas, not mountainsides!
Oh! Svirepy, look at that glowy stuff over there! I think that's the mineral we came here for!
A crystal jutted out from the mountain. Surrounded by black rock, its blue glow was unmistakable.
That blue light... Interesting. It's small, but this shows that there are deposits of it even on the surface.
Huh... It's surrounded by ice. Ya think it's got some kinda ambient coolin' effect?
Wow! It's like a fridge, but prettier!
You could put it in a cooler box with some ice cream and take it anywhere without it melting!
We should bring a bunch home. So long, refrigerators – your services are no longer needed!
Come on, people. Refrigeration is not what we want them for. These are rigging superchargers.
Just look at what one did to Soyuz's rigging. If we study them, we can give all of you fancy new riggings.
New riggings? Oh, hell yeah, baby.
So if I touch it, will it restructure mine, too?
Wait! Don't–
Soyuz's words weren't quick enough. Svirepy picked up the fist-sized crystal and held it with both hands.
W-well? How do you feel, Svirepy?!
Oooowch! My frickin' hands! S-so cold!
Ow... Besides giving me frostbite, I don't think it did anything. I still feel the same.
No surprise there. Tallinn already said touching it doesn't really do anything.
Maybe it needs to be bigger. Or some condition have to be met? Who knows what you need to do!
We don't have time for this right now. Let's leave that crystal behind.
The snowmelt has reached much further than I initially expected.
We need to get inside the Ring ASAP and investigate what's wrong with it.
You said it's, like, a thousand meters underground, right? Shouldn't we be goin' DOWN, not up?
It is deep down, yes, but the entrance is up there. The rock provides a stable foundation and a mountain is a good landmark for finding it amid all this snow and ice.
Hasn't the snowmelt, y'know, changed the terrain? Like, a lot? You sure you remember where the entrance is supposed to be?
...No, I'm afraid I don't.
You DON'T?! So what are we gonna do? Search the whole mountain from top to bottom?!
That won't be necessary. There's an identification device near the entrance. If it's active, it should respond to this transmitter I have.
Remember, be on your guard for the as-of-yet unidentified enemy.
The search for the entrance commences now.

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 1 - Surcouf at Sunrise</size>

scripts.say: Port - Private Quarters
It felt like something was rubbing against my nose...
Hehehe... tickle, tickle... this ought to wake you up...
Letting out a powerful sneeze, as loud as a small firecracker, I opened my eyes and looked to my side.
Surcouf was in the room, holding a green foxtail in her hand, which she was rubbing against the underside of my nose.
Bonne journée! Good morning, Commander! I've come to wake you from your slumber, as part of my secretary duties!
Oh yeah, speaking of sleep, I actually had a dream about you yesterday~
I dreamt I was having this huge French dinner! It was totally free, too! And then I heard you yelling at me, saying "don't stuff yourself full, you've got work to do!" and then I woke up...
I wish you'd let me taste that huge lobster... but oh well, c'est la vie.
So, what did you dream about? Did you dream of me?
Hold on, don't answer. I already know you did~
So let me rephrase: what was I up to in your dream?
C'mon, don't ignore me like that! You don't have to shy away from admitting you dreamt about me!
A few minutes later...
Zzzzzz...
Zzz... Geesh, so pervy, Commander... Zzz...
This gal has a lot of gall, falling asleep on someone else's bed and sleeptalking like this...

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 2 - Surcouf in the Morning</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Mmh... ah... Where... am I...?
The office...?
That's weird, I could've sworn I went off to wake up the Commander... Guess I dreamt it all up... Alright then, back to sleep...
After using nearly every method I could think of, I finally managed to wake up Surcouf.
You're saying you carried me all the way here from your room?
Hehe, wow~ That must've been a lot of fun for you!
Not so much for me, you know? I was fast asleep, so I don't know the feeling of being carried in your arms.
So I'm offering you the opportunity to do it again! Carry me like a princess!
Surcouf got in position, waiting for me to lift and hold her in my arms.

options.content: Gently whack her on the head

scripts.say: Owie! I wasn't expecting you to hit me for that...
Right, I was wondering another thing! Did anyone catch you in the act of bringing me here? Did they look at you like you were some weird pervert?
If I saw something like that, I'd be like: "that poor girl... She's fast asleep, and the Commander's just carrying her around the place like that? How could anyone do something so cruel..."
How is poor little Surcouf going to get married now that this has happened to her?
Huh? They looked at you all compassionate and accepting, more than anything else...?
Well, I guess this isn't the first time it's happened...
Wait, does this mean they all think I'm annoying and don't care what happens to me?!
Surcouf was unable to contain her shocked reaction.
It's time to get to work.
Darn it... Well, no use thinking too hard about it! I'm ready to start working! Let's do this!

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 3 - Surcouf at Work</size>

4.say: What?! It's only been 30 minutes?! It feels like a century's passed!

5.say: Weeell... Hehehe, you busy over there, Commander? I bet not. C'mon, let's talk, if you've got the time~

6.say: Well okay, I'll talk and you just listen, then~!

8.say: ... Gotta hand it to her: she did manage to last 30 minutes. That's pretty impressive, for Surcouf.

9.say: So, Commander, you appointed me as your secretary because you were so enamored with my gorgeous body, weren't you~?

10.say: If both you and everyone else are so crazy about it, that's gotta mean I'm really attractive! Ehehe~

12.say: Have I ever told you that I'm one of the few submarines that can carry a floatplane?

13.say: Tell you what, hold on a second and I'll... Huh? Where's my little Passepartout?

14.say: Oh, right, I left him behind when I went to wake you up... Never mind. Oh well, I rarely use him anyway.

16.say: Commander, check it out! I bet this swimsuit would look great on me!

17.say: It's a new seasonal model, too! When you get your month's salary, you should order it for me! I'll wear it just for you, of course!

19.say: Hey, I've been thinking: what colors should we use for the fleet's flag?

20.say: White and blue are tried and true, but I want something new and distinct...

22.say: Okay! I've recharged my batteries and I'm ready to start working!

24.say: So, time to go grab some lunch then, right? Ehehe~

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 4 - Surcouf in the Noon</size>

scripts.say: Port - Cafeteria
Commander, I want some of those meatballs, octopus weiners, that thing... those, and that! C'mon, gimme!
Hey! I specifically chose different sides so I could trade with you, you know!
I'm not just gonna take without giving! Here, have this, some of this... this too, and... I don't like giving this one up, but here!
Heheh, isn't it great to have such a generous secretary?
Ah, enjoying lunch together with the Commander again? Aren't you a lovely couple.
G'day, Dunkerque! Wait, don't you know? I'm the Commander's secretary, so there's nothing strange about us having lunch together!
Aha, I suppose that's true. By the way, I made a few confections today. Do visit me later if you'd like some.
Really?! Heck yeah~ Hey, Commander, once we're done working, let's drop by Dunkerque's place for some tasty sweets!
Now then, I'll be on my way before I become a nuisance.
Au revoir!
Man, Dunkerque's such a nice girl, don't you think?
There's this other girl, Jean Bart, from the same faction. But in stark contrast to the sweet and caring Dunkerque, Jean Bart is kind of cold and mean...

Which reminds me of some fun trivia! Commander, did you know that both Jean Bart and I got our names from famous pirates? Though I'm not sure if her namesake was a pirate or technically some other thing...
Anyhow, I guess she's got some appeal. Piratey appeal. I wouldn't say I'm like that, though.
Eat a lot, sleep a lot, fight a lot! And everything else is your responsibility~ That's the life I wanna live~
I don't blame people for getting the impression that Surcouf is a lazy girl. But there's more to her than that...
When it comes to combat and mission performance, I've heard nothing but good things about her.
Still, sometimes I think about how cool she can be. I'm sure lots of people do.
She's all like "keep your damn distance!" and stuff. Hey, you try it, Commander! I wanna hear you say it!
... Let's just focus on our lunch.

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 5 - Surcouf in the Afternoon Pt. 1</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
*Yaaaaaaawn*...
Now with my belly full of food, I say it's time for a nap.

options.content: Give in to the urge to yawn

scripts.say: Was that a yawn just now? You wanna take a nap, too?
You've been working nonstop since morning. You've gotta rest a while, or else you'll have no energy for your work in the afternoon.
So, you get some sleep, and I'll wake you once naptime is over!

options.content: You're just gonna fall asleep too...

scripts.say: Worrying about it won't do me any good. I should just take a short nap like she says.
I can hear somebody's voice...
Geez... "Take a nap," I say, and you switch off like a lightbulb.
Can't blame you for being so exhausted though, considering how busy you are with work. You deserve some rest, Commander.
Surcouf gently patted me on the head.
I've never watched over you like this before, come to think of it. Heheh, I can stare at you as much as I want~
Hmm... I guess you're...
... surprisingly... plain? I'm much cuter, and Jean Bart is way cooler.
Even so... you know how to amuse me, you never do anything to annoy me, and you know just what I like...
You're supervising such a big fleet, but you still care about all the little details...
I doubt my life would be the same without you at this point...
I'm picking up a rosy smell. What could it be?
... you very much, Commander.
It feels like Surcouf just said something important, but I can't ward off my drowsiness any longer...

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 6 - Surcouf in the Afternoon Pt. 2</size>

scripts.say: Port - Commander's Office
Hey, wake up! ... I said WAKE UP, dammit!
I woke up to the feeling of something hitting me in the face.
Jean Bart was in the office. She was holding a stack of mission reports in her hand.
Your break ended 30 minutes ago, but apparently, you deserve longer breaks than everyone else.

options.content: ... Surcouf was supposed to wake me up

scripts.say: Surcouf? Ya mean Sleeping Beauty over there?
Following Jean Bart's gaze, I turned my head over to the sofa. There Surcouf was, sleeping soundly, like a toddler.
... I knew I couldn't trust her to wake me up.
Appointing this girl as your secretary was a mistake. Least if ya ask me.
Hate's a strong word. We're still part of the same fleet.
In short, she's the polar opposite of me in almost every way, and that's my beef with her.
For someone named after a famed pirate, she's got no ambition. There's a limit to how lazy you're allowed to be.
Besides, you really think she can do her job in this sorry state she's in?
Hey, yeah... This girl's no secretary, she's just a pet who's adapted to living in your office.

options.content: Point to all the processed documents on your desk

scripts.say: Shiver me timbers... Just looking at that mountain of paperwork makes my head spin...
What was that...? You went through 'em all on your own?
Are you saying your work gets done even if she's useless, and you don't even wish that she'd do anything useful?
Hmph. Whatever the hell suits you.
Zzzz... Commander... ehehe...
... Like two peas in a pod.
Got one last bit of advice for ya: you oughta wash your face before going out in public.
Jean Bart promptly left the office after finishing her sentence.
... Wash my face?
... Surcouf had left a kiss mark on my cheek.

sequence:
Journé Surcouf!

<size=45>Chapter 7 - Surcouf in My Arms</size>

scripts.say: Mmh... good morning, Commander...

options.content: Smile and tell her the time

scripts.say: Oh geez, it's that late already?!
I'm so sorry, Commander! I tried to wake you up when breaktime was over, but you were sleeping so soundly, and I just...
I didn't MEAN to fall asleep and leave you hanging! P-please, don't be angry... okay?
Surcouf was visibly flustered. You rarely see her like this.
Is that all... your work for today?
Wow, it's all done! You're the most amazing person ever, Commander!
But I wasn't of any help... You did it all on your own... I'm a failure of a secretary...

options.content: I couldn't have done it without you

scripts.say: Y-you mean it...? But all I did was sleep and chat with you...
Is it possible I'm... helping you just by sleeping in your office...?
... Ah well, better not think too hard♪ If you say I was useful, then I was!
Whew, that sure was a day of hard secretary work! Good job, me!
I'll put in just as much effort tomorrow!
Just a moment ago, Surcouf seemed depressed, but now she appeared pleased with herself.
Oh, right! Remember how we talked about going to Dunkerque's place for some tasty sweets?
I say first we get some dinner, then we head straight to Dunkerque's place for dessert~!
... Y'know, I enjoy every day spent with you, Commander♪
And I enjoy every day spent with you, Surcouf.

sequence:
Invitation of the Wind

<size=45>1 Splendid Breeze</size>

scripts.say: On one fine, sunny day, Clemenceau invites me out to the golf course.
The wind isn't too loud or too quiet. It's just right for golf.
Both the wind speed and the soft sensation of the wind touching your cheeks are perfect.
Even better, my dear Commander is by my side. Today is shaping up to be a good one.
My, you look worried about something.
Relax. Even if you're a poor golfer, I won't make fun of you.
I'll patiently teach you all the ins and outs of the sport, okay? Heehee.
Your stance looks great~ Did someone study ahead of time?
But I wonder how well you practiced... this?
Suddenly, Clemenceau circles behind me and massages my hands and shoulders while I hold the club.
Your stance and grip are flawless, but...
You shouldn't tense up so much before you swing.
I feel Clemenceau's warmth through my back.
Focus on the ball, not on me, okay?
There. Raise your club, and prepare to hit the ball.
Lean your upper body forward just slightly, bend your knees a tiny bit...
Are you embarrassed? Don't be. I'm only getting handsy to right your posture, after all.
Next, the shot itself. While you do need to put force behind your shoulders and arms, you also need to do so here...
Clemenceau's fingers trace around my waist. She's looking awfully mischievous, for someone who's "just fixing my posture."
Aww, you make such pitifully adorable noises... Heehee.
Carefully maintain your balance, and hit the ball with a fast swing.
Got it? Ready to give it a try?
Let's see your hole-in-one.
Clemenceau steps back, and I'm released from her warm touch.
...Nothing happens. The ball still sits proudly atop the tee.
(I was so embarrassed that I missed my swing.)
Hmm... You're still nervous, and it's making you tense up.
Heheh, it looks like you'll need more of my guidance.
We'd best get started, then.
The day is still young... We have plenty of time together♪
Clemenceau whispers into my ear, her warm touch against my back again.

sequence:
Invitation of the Wind

<size=45>2 Shimmering Triangle Wave</size>

scripts.say: Awash in the morning sea breeze, I stroll along the beach.
But I run into someone else who's already beat me to seeing the sights.
Ahh, the breeze is lovely...
In a few days, the Commander and I...
Good... morning?
C-Commander?! Why are you here right now...?
(SG, why didn't you tell me the Commander was coming?)
(I'm not mentally prepared for this...!)
"I have a lot of work to do today, so I woke up early..."
W-well, you woke up too early.
"Now that you mention it, I thought so, too."
"But I didn't think too much of it. Instead, I just decided to come watch the sunrise."
"Did you wake up early to see the sunrise, too, Helena?"
Y-yeah... Maybe...
(You wouldn't need to change into a swimsuit just to see the sunrise.)
(The morning breeze is kind of chilly. I'm a little worried Helena will catch a cold out here in that swimsuit.)
C-Commander? Are you interested in my swimsuit?
"Of course I am. It looks really cute on you."
Cute...
(I would've liked it better if you said pretty, but...)
(Oh, not that I hate to be called cute... O-of course, I don't want to force the Commander to say anything, so either is... Ummm...)
"Of course, you're pretty, too."
Oh... Thank you.
The thing is, um, Commander...
I didn't come to watch the sunrise.
Do you remember our promise to go swimming in a few days?
Umm, basically, I'll need to be in a swimsuit then...
At first, I thought I'd be fine, but the thought of you seeing it...
It's so embarrassing...
So I decided to come to the beach wearing it in advance, as a kind of practice.
I had no idea I'd run into you here...
"Let me be honest. I'm so busy today because I want to get things done and make time for you."
Wh-what a coincidence...
"Now that we've run into each other here, it almost feels like a rehearsal for my day off."
I don't know if this would be close enough to count...
Achoo! Sorry... Commander, could you come a little closer?
Close enough that I can feel your body heat...
Hmm... Maybe this does feel like our day off, after all.
The sun rising on the horizon dyes the sea gold.
Her dazzling, joyful smile is the perfect complement for the shining sea ahead.

sequence:
Invitation of the Wind

<size=45>3 Diving Under Blue Skies</size>

scripts.say: The light above grows brighter, informing us that we'll reach the surface soon.
I gesture to my partner next to me and swim up to the surface.
Phew...! We're back on the water's surface!
Commander, you look pale...
I get it. If you're not used to diving, it's easy to get scared.
I panicked a little when I started out, too.
You're okay now, Commander. Look at the skies above, and see that you're safe.
"Actually, Enterprise, I'm not worried about myself. Look down."
Her diving suit has a big hole in the thigh.
Oh, this?
"I heard you yelp during our dive, so I decided to have us exit early."
Heh, yeah, it was a surprise when I hit that rock.
I felt better after I checked the damage, though.
We weren't that deep, either. Just tearing my suit a little is no biggie.
And see? I'm not even wounded.
Don't believe me? Check it out for yourself.
Enterprise swims closer to me.
See, I'm just fine.
I appreciate your concern, but it's not like I'm acting tough, or anything.
Fortunately, Enterprise isn't hurt. All the scrape did was tear her wetsuit.
Suddenly, I realize that she's gotten really close to me.
It's normal to be this close mid-dive, but she doesn't care even when we're on the water's surface.
Those colorful reefs, all the little sea creatures...
It was just like a busy city, wasn't it?
We think we know the sea well, because we're always fighting on it.
Carrier-based craft might let us see beyond the horizon...
But there's a whole other world hidden down there.
Is this how our submarines feel when they fight?
"It's a shame that only they get to see certain sights. You need special gear to descend that far."
"Even mass-produced submarines wouldn't let us take a leisurely look around."
...Yeah, you're right.
Sitting in a windowless submarine, deep underwater...
I'll pass. I'm built for fighting on the surface.
Oh, sorry. I just can't stop talking about fighting.
Here I'd promised that we'd relax together... So much for that, huh?
Phew... Feel better now, Commander?
That's enough of a break. Let's start our next dive, alright?
"I have plenty of stamina and oxygen left, but what about your wetsuit?"
...Now that you mention it, this is kind of a problem.
Diving in a damaged wetsuit is against safety regulations.
Let's go back to the coast, then.
It doesn't matter if we're on the surface or underwater. Me, I can relax as long as you're here.
What say you, Commander?
"I feel the same, of course."
Heheh. Let's find another way to enjoy the rest of our time together.
The sights underwater may be pretty, but they don't beat the world above.
Enterprise's smile is as clear as the blue sky. She offers me her hand—and I hold on tight.
Somewhere At Sea
We're about half a day away from the Port. Oil reserves are over half, ammunition is plentiful, but our supply of food is...
Yikes... We're almost there, and you're still counting beans?
A quartermaster you may be, but isn't this a bit too much dedication to your job?
Nothing is more important than keeping tabs on our supplies. Victory or defeat during battle hinges upon it – and so does your lunch today.
Hwuh?! We don't even have enough supplies for lunch?!
Heh heh... Don't worry. Because I've been rationing so diligently, we'll have enough food left over for three more days.
...How do we have more days' worth of food NOW than before we set sail?!
...Bean counting is quite miraculous, is it not?
...Spaghetti.
Huh? Oh, Impero, did you want spaghetti for lunch?
Captain Pompey the Great happens to agree with you, so let us have spaghetti!
Carrier-based spaghetti. We'll shoot the spaghetti out from my planes...
What the heck is that! Nobody asked for this high-level playing with your food!
And why are you sticking spaghetti into your planes?
The planes help keep the spaghetti warm.
Because I still need to sleep and bathe... Spaghetti fired from my planes can be ready to eat at any time...
Impero came up with something incredible again...
More like incredibly stupid... Well, I must admit that the ambition behind the idea has moved Captain Pompey the Great.
Huh...?
What is it this time? Flying pizza?
...I've lost track of my planes.
What?! Could it be a Siren attack? What was the last bit of data you got from them before you lost their signals?
A strange city and tower... That's the last thing I got from them.
Sounds a bit like a Mirror Sea, doesn't it...
A Mirror Sea appearing only half a day away from the Port is definitely noteworthy.
Let's request backup from the Port first, then turn around to scout out the situation.
Well said! However, Captain Pompey the Great and her valiant comrades will make quick work of any Sirens even before reinforcements show up!
How dare they shoot down Impero's planes... How dare they shoot down my SPAGHETTI! We must make them pay!
Port - Communication Room
Incoming communication! Seems like Pompeo and the others will arrive back at the Port in time!
Carabiniere played the contents of the message, but was completely unprepared for what she heard.
A s-support request?!
Ehh?! If you need backup, you should've contacted the Commander directly!
This is how you do it, right... Okay, sent the info over.
...Alright, now to wait for the Commander's response. Hopefully Pompeo and the others aren't in any real trouble.
BEEP––––
Confirming receipt, huh. Guess the secretary today is on top of it.
BEEP BEEP––––
BEEP BEEP BEEP––––
Huh? Wh-why am I getting multiple confirmation replies...?
Carabiniere suddenly shuddered when she thought of a potential possibility––
Abnormal Sea Area - Center
Judging from the models of the planes approaching us, these must be...
The planes of the Royal Navy and Sardegna!
Oh dear. Looks like they found us instead~
Even the Royal Navy is here, huh... This must be a pretty big deal after all.
No kidding. When's the last time carriers from four different factions have fought together?
This is Illustrious of the Royal Navy. Ships up ahead, please state your identity and purpose.
Easy now, it's Prinz Eugen. We came after receiving the very same backup request from the port.
...Is that so? I thought we were the only ones the Commander sent.
Actually...
We're very sorry for causing this mix-up! We apologize on behalf of Carabiniere!
Don't sweat it! I'd be pretty strung-out too if my friends were in a pickle, so mistakes like this are understandable. There's no need to chew her out after we get back.
Thank you all for coming to our aid. If you'd like, we were talking about having a big tea party after returning to port.
A tea party?
Yeah! After this mission is over, we're going to have the GREATEST tea party!
That sounds fun! Is it okay if I invite my sister?
The more the merrier! The Royal Navy will be covering the expenses as well~
There shall be pizza. Lots of pizza.
Now it's pizza?!
Well, whatever... If we're already bringing Oxy-cola, it only makes sense to bring pizza as well!
Woohoo! Now that's the kind of party I can get behind!
Especially the kind with big, juicy chunks of pineapple...
Gwaaaaah! I'll pretend I never heard that!
Upon hearing the words "pineapple" and "pizza" used together, Trieste's normally calm expression cracked.
I consider myself a tolerant individual, but what... is this sacrilege against pizza I just heard...?
...Huh?
In any case, the importance of holding this tea-and-pizza party is now more evident than ever. I shall teach you what true pizza is.
Oh, um... I actually meant to say, I'm quite an enthusiast of Sardegna's famous Pizza Margherita?
I've been looking forward to trying a TRUE Sardegnan pie... Ahaha...
...But most importantly! I'm glad all of you are safe and sound!
I'm safe. But I'm also SALTY.
My planes are under attack, but the perpetrator cannot be found.
Likewise. Though we've made our way to the middle of this sector, we still haven't met any real opposition.
The enemies have been utterly weak, but that tower doesn't at all resemble one of those antiquated Siren facilities.
Indeed, it's quite sus–– Err, ahem... I mean, the danger is almost palpable.
There's no telling what dangers wait for us in that tower. We should survey the area carefully and not just rush in without a plan.
Yup, I agree. We have complete air superiority here though, so we'll be able to sniff out if the Sirens are up to any mischief.
After exploring the surrounding area, the group arrived at the base of a massive tower.
However, nothing sought to impede their progress as they approached closer and closer – no defensive installations, no fleets to intercept them.
The only thing we've run into so far is the typical EM disturbance...
Coming through~
I wonder if they're too scared to come out because the brilliant Impero is leading the fleet.
Heheh. Wouldn't surprise me! After all, Captain Pompey the Great and her stalwart allies have already completely controlled this Mirror Sea!
It's way too early to celebrate. We have no idea what's hiding inside a tower of that size.
Sis, I'll make sure to stand guard at the entrance, so can I count on you to head inside that tower?
Haah? Why do I have to do it?
Well, we could send a measly little destroyer with flimsy armor, or a carrier that needs wide-open spaces to operate as well as an escort fleet...
Don't worry. We'll handle the exploration.
I, I can do this after all. I am a heavy cruiser after all. Whenever we're sailing into uncharted waters, it's only natural that we take the lead!
Eugen is also a heavy cruiser.
Oh... that's right! I almost let her trick me again...!
Darn, so you finally noticed. In that case...
KABOOM––––!!
What the heck are you doing?!
Hmm? Were you going to pry the door open with your bare hands or what?
Wait...
There's not a scratch on the door...
Not enough firepower, huh. Let me give it a try.
Impero tried to scramble her planes to bomb the door open, but...
No matter how brilliant I am, there's no way I can hit a target like that with my planes.
Mm, looks like I'll have to get my sisters to help out again.
Veneto, Littorio––
Impero lifted her hands into the air as if preparing to launch into a great soliloquy.
Is Impero... performing a ritual of some sort?
Well, uh, the important thing is that we can combine our powers, right? Even carriers can get a little extra firepower by bolstering their secondary guns and anti-air guns!
Yeah... Let's all focus our attacks!
KABOOM––––!!
Everyone unloaded the weapons in their rigging at the door, wreathing the area in a cloud of smoke.
But when their attacks ceased, the door to the tower still stood... As a matter of fact, basically nothing had even changed.
Beep––
Are we able to connect with the port again?
We're also getting observational data again on the weather around this sector! Does this mean... that the Mirror Sea has dissipated?!
Seems like it. But, the facility is still here, and the tower is still standing...
Now this would be a first. Interesting.
Uhh... I'm tired already. Can we go home?
Go home...? Do you just plan on letting this tower sit here?
Yeah. The Sirens already admitted defeat. So this counts as our win.
I want the folks back home to roll out the red carpet for my victorious return. I want to head back and take a bath.
We didn't actually win, that's just what you convinced yourself of...
But, Formidable, it's true that we have no way of breaking through the tower's defenses right now.
We've already completed the two things we came here for – linking up with Impero's fleet, and getting rid of the Mirror Sea. So, let's hurry back to port and relay the situation first.
So you also think we can come back to this tower later?
Certainly. As a matter of fact, I believe it's the safer thing to do.
Agreed. Let us all return as heroes.
Hey, don't just turn around by yourself and leave!
Well, Impero was the one who requested reinforcements after all. Why don't we just follow her lead this time?
Fine, fine. Maybe the weirdest person here has the best grasp on the situation.
Once we head back and tell Akashi about what's going on, she might have some information on how we can get in.
Wait, Eugen, are we also going to follow them back?
Of course not. Now that we've finished our emergency mission, it only makes sense for us to get back to our vacation, right?
But... Now that I think about it, we were invited to the GREATEST tea party ever, weren't we?
That's right! After all the extra work we put in, this better be worth our while!
Sounds good then! Back to the port we go!
The girls sailed away from the tower until it vanished into the horizon.
However, the story of the Siren tower and the shipgirls tasked with plumbing its depths does not end here––
[Virtual Tower – To Be Continued]
Abnormal Sea Area
Lady Illustrious and Lady Formidable will be arriving in this sector shortly.
Indeed, this is quite an anomaly...
From the description, it might as well have "Siren Facility" written all over it in bold letters.
Formidable, has anything caught your eye?
Nothing so far. No sign of either Sirens or the Sardegnan fleet.
Gloucester, do you remember who the flagship of the Sardegna fleet is supposed to be?
Someone by the name of Impero.
Ugh... I haven't met her before, but if she's another one of those types who won't shut up about how glorious her namesake is...
Huh? Why would you say that about her?
Look, I've seen some serious shit on Juustagram...
...Is that a reliable source of information?
Uhh, well, I'm sure it's nothing you'd be interested in, but... For example, she was talking about using her planes to start a band.
Using her planes to do what...?
I-I told you, it's nothing you'd be interested in! Besides, we've got a job on our hands here!
Umm, alright...?
In any case, the Commander ordered us to join up with the Sardegnan fleet and eliminate the Siren threat together before they can pose a threat.
There's a good chance that we'll run into a Mirror Sea, so we need to get moving.
Abnormal Sea Area - Near the Center
Trout, salmon, sardines...
Now she's reciting the names of fish!
But I'll allow it, because they're all delicious!
Skipjack, amberjack, saury...
Her fish are getting closer and closer to the Sakura Islands!
Not as fond of these, except I must admit, saury is quite tasty!
Koi, shad, Emperyfish...
Um... What the heck are those?
Actually, these are varieties of freshwater fish that are quite commonly eaten in the Dragon Empery~
Freshwater fish?
Unlike the saltwater fish that we're used to, freshwater fish come from rivers and lakes rather than the sea.
Some species of fish can spend their lives going back and forth between the two.
By the way, I heard that shad are especially tasty. I'd like to try some if I ever get the chance...
Woah, you really know your stuff when it comes to food!
Though it makes sense that you'd be good at cooking since you manage our supplies and rations... But, why did Impero suddenly start naming off fish?
Dace, cavalla, archerfish...
Err... Are we still talking about fish here, or...
Finally, Swordfish, Barracuda, Fairey Albacore...
Wait, is she talking about...
Look, over there! Those are Royal Navy planes!
She probably started to name off fish because she saw those planes! ...Probably.
I didn't expect reinforcements to show up THIS quickly. As expected, the Commander doesn't disappoint.
I wonder if it tastes good...
Does what taste good?
Albacore spaghetti... I'll have to borrow one from the Royal Navy carriers after we get back.
What the... Ahem, Impero, let's worry about that later and meet up with their fleet first.
Somewhere, a bit earlier...
What's the plan, Eugen?
Impero's fleet has discovered a Siren facility and requested backup from the Commander.
That's too bad. Looks like our lovely vacation time is about to get cut short.
But we only just left the port!
Sorry, but whining isn't going to get you anywhere. Let's just treat this as a scenic detour, alright?
But I must say, I'm rather interested in this "tower" described in the communication.
I'm not! Not in the slightest!
Fine, fine~ Should we just act like we missed the message and go enjoy our vacation?
I mean, it's not our problem if the Sardegna girls end up in over their heads and something terrible happens to them~
Something wrong? Didn't you want to hit the sunny beaches?
Screw you! You know what? Fine.
We're turning around right now. We can't leave those Sardegna girls alone!
Hehe, as you say, princess~
Elsewhere...
Take this, sister of the Grey Ghost!
C'mon, I have a name, you know! You're facing up against me this time, not my sister!
Enty might be strong, but I'm no slouch either! Hmph!
I'll show you what happens when you underestimate me!
An urgent message suddenly interrupted the white-hot duel between the two carriers.
...The Sardegna fleet ran into a Mirror Sea on the way back to the port and needs backup ASAP?
In that case, we can't be sitting here play-fighting amongst ourselves.
You're right. Nothing is more important than answering the call of our allies.
We'll use this upcoming battle to decide the victor of this duel!
Sure. Let's see who has the best performance!
Heheh. Seems like I've sunk more enemies here. How'd you like THAT?
In the first place, there's no point competing over who can clean up more trash.
Plus, this is a pretty weird Mirror Sea if I've ever seen one. It looks imposing as hell, but there aren't many enemies and the only ones that do show up are weak.
Say what you want, but a win's a win.
Go tell your sister that Shoukaku and I will face her during the next mock battle – and that victory WILL be ours!
Look, Enterprise has better things to do...
Nonsense! Our rivalry spans the ages! This time, we will defeat the Grey Ghost!
Well, I guess your determination deserves some kudos... But if you want to challenge her that badly, you're gonna have to ask her yourself. I'm not my sister's keeper.
I'm the victor here, so can't you do a little favor for me?
Sigh... Alright, but the battle isn't over yet. We'll settle this once and for all once everything is over.
If you manage to beat me, I'll pass on your challenge to Enty.
KABOOM––!!
An explosion came from the middle of this sector!
Let's take a look... Wait, huh? That's not the Sardegna fleet, but rather Eugen and Hipper from the Iron Blood?
The fact that other fleets are showing up means that this situation must be very critical!
That makes sense... Let's hurry up and meet up with the others then!
Elsewhere, Prinz Eugen and Admiral Hipper are engaged – albeit leisurely – in combat with Sirens.
Who gave you lowly Siren scum permission to fight back? Out of my sight!
You sure are working hard today. Maybe I can just sit back and watch from a distance.
Keep up the good work~ Your sister is cheering for you~
Hey, come back here! I came here to back up our allies, so you take this seriously too!
I wonder who originally planned on skipping out to go on vacation––
Oh, I see, I see! You're worried about your Sardegnan friends!
Sh-shut up, you! They're just allies, not friends! This is just a part of the job!
If you have time to tease me, then help out already!
Prinz Eugen, reporting for duty–– or so I'd like to say, but that doesn't seem to be necessary anymore.
Huh? What are you talking ab––
KABOOM–––––!!
A swarm of planes passed overhead and completely demolished the remaining Siren stragglers.
Eagle Union planes flying in formation with Sakura planes... Now that's an unusual combination.
I guess we weren't the only ones who responded to the backup request.
Hmph! It's only natural to take a backup request seriously. The more people who show up, the better!
Now, let's pick up the pace and meet up with them!
Abnormal Sea Area - Near the Center
Wait, did you girls also get the message sent from the port?
Sure did. You should've seen my sister's face change colors as she dragged me here at breakneck speed~
Huuh? My face did no such thing!!
Look, you're doing it again~
Alright, we've all seen enough of this comedic duo––
Having that said, I'm surprised we all showed up without coordinating our efforts, and even covered different areas on our way here.
Usually, the Commander provides detailed instructions when arranging these reinforcement operations.
Instead, this time...
We got a broadcast from the port rather than direct orders from the Commander.
Doesn't seem quite right, does it? Shouldn't the Commander know that we're on vacation?
Huh? Do you even know what you're saying, Eugen?
What'd you think about the enemies we encountered along the way?
Weak! Total trash not even worth mentioning!
Wait... I think I see what you're getting at...
For enemies this weak, it shouldn't be necessary to call all of us to one place...
Do you remember who was on duty in the communications room before we left?
Let's see... Carabiniere from Sardegna?
Carabiniere must've received a backup request from Impero...
And she forwarded the message to all of us in a hurry, and that's the reason we're all here now?
That sounds about right~
...You've got to be kidding me. Is this some kind of joke?
Now, now, getting angry is bad for your skin, sis. Since we're here already, why not have a look around?
I'm sure we're all equally interested in that strange-looking tower in the middle of this place.
...Let's get moving then! When we're done here, I'm going to give those Sardegna girls a good lecturing!
Impero's supposed to have her own planes, but we haven't been able to get in contact yet...
Maybe finding their fleet isn't going to be as easy as we first expected.
We didn't have their exact coordinates when we showed up. We could've passed right by each other for all we know.
That tower in the middle seems to be messing with our communications too... Maybe they're over there investigating the situation.
Sounds like a plan. If Impero's fleet is trying to disrupt the Mirror Sea, that's going to be the first place they look.
In the meantime, let's make as much noise as we can to get the attention of their planes.
For example, that earsplitting sound my sister made when she got headbutted by Glowworm.
Glowworm isn't even here right now!
Wait, back up! That never even happened! I did NOT make any such sound!
The deeper in we go, the more enemies are likely to appear. The sound of combat should be all we need, right?
Exactly! At least someone here is using her brain!
I'm glad we have one reliable person here.
EUGEN!
Those two sure get along well...
Good enough. Not like you get to pick your family anyway.
...Hm? Looks like we've discovered Sirens blocking our way to the tower!
Looks like our fun time has to be put on hold. Time to get serious, sis!
You're the only one here having fun!
So stop messing around and help us reach the tower first!
You've been making fun of me this entire time, so I'll have you do your job properly!
Meanwhile, Illustrious and Impero are on the way to the tower in the middle of the unknown area.
I never expected the Royal Navy to be the first to come to our aid!
Captain Pompey the Great shall remember this debt! Feel free to call upon me at any time!
We're all friends back home at the port now... There's no need to blow things out of proportion.
After all, the Commander was the one who arranged the reinforcements. We're just doing what we should.
No need to be polite! Just tell me what you would have me do!
It's not like I can come up with anything on the spot...
Actually, there is one thing~
Hmm?
Before we came here, we were interrupted during our tea party.
If it's not too much to ask, how about we hold another tea party with all of us, after we get back to the port?
Of course, we'd invite the Commander and all our other friends~
An excellent suggestion! Captain Pompey the Great... shall arrange the greatest tea party!
During the tea party, can I chill in the bathtub and drink Oxy-cola?
What do you think a tea party is, Impero?!
Can I not? Veneto was drinking coffee at a tea party, so why am I not allowed to drink Oxy-cola?
Haha, you can drink whatever you prefer. The more important thing is talking and deepening our relationships.
But, I'm not sure we can accomplish that if you're in the bathtub...
I suppose socializing in the bath is a classical Sardegnan custom... Hmm, I wonder if the beach counts as a bathtub...
A sand bath? Are you going to pour buckets of sand over your head?
Wait... That'd be a sand shower rather than a sand bath...
Yeah. A sand bath would be where you bury yourself up to your neck in sand.
...Hm? Is that what you prefer, Formidable?
(I'm done. I'm so done with this girl...)
Ah, but my sister is a natural when it comes to the sand. And her Colosseum...
Why are we talking about the Colosseum now...?
Lady Veneto once spent the entire day making half a Colosseum at the beach.
Oh my... I'm sure that was a beautiful and elegant sight indeed.
In any case, I'm looking forward to enjoying our tea party together.
Mm. I'm looking forward to it too... May we enjoy the sweetest of dreams from the deepest recesses of our hearts.
A tea party is something you need to be awake to attend!
I'll make sure my planes are loaded up on coffee then.
...Loaded up with what?
Don't think too much about it, Illustrious... I guess this really is the kind of person Impero is.
I want to go to this tea party... Let's defeat all the enemies, and go back home!
Where the heck is all this motivation coming from all of a sudden?!
Mm... Enemies who dare lay their hands on the brilliant Impero will be met with swift retribution!
Present Day – Somewhere in the Sakura Islands
At the same time as the crisis at the World Expo, strange developments were occurring in the waters near the Sakura Islands.
It's gotten rather chilly...
If I didn't know better, you might be able to convince me that I'm somewhere in the Northern Parliament.
Indeed. The warmth brought by the Sacred Sakura is fading.
In other words, the Prime Sakura that lies beyond the boundary...
The sacred trees of the Sakura Islands overflow with the power of their ancestral homeland, Mizuho. The most important of these, the Prime Sakura, has begun to wither.
Your premonitions were correct. The sea is weeping.
Nagato, the miko who oversees the rite of the Sacred Sakura, scooped up the frigid seawater between her hands.
Now that I think about it, I have seen glimpses of this in a dream.
Yes, I, too, have been touched by the portents of ruin.
A nightmare in which the Sacred Sakura withers, the world is devoured by lightlessness, and everything comes to a silent end.
And in none of those nightmares does the Great Sage appear to protect the Sacred Sakura.
...Just like the time when I stepped down from my position as flagship of the Combined Fleet.
Perhaps it would be wise to send a fleet to the Prime Sakura's sanctuary.
Of course I plan to do so. But even in doing that, we can do little more than defend the physical territory around the tree.
The innermost depths of the Prime Sakura are sealed off by a barrier that normal people cannot hope to even approach.
Musashi and Nagato continued to sail, the seas and skies growing darker around them, the fog becoming denser.
It has been an awfully long time since we last fought side by side, but I still remember it like it was yesterday.
Nagato, the injury you sustained back then...
...Has already healed. Though at times, it still continues to ache.
Perhaps you could call it an illness of the heart.
Three wakes continued into the distance.
Before long, the voices of the wind and water disappeared, and the whole world was engulfed in silence.
It was a strange, unsettling sensation, as if one's senses were being pulled from their body.
An inscrutable amount of time passed, and then the discomfort faded.
We've arrived... at the Prime Sakura's sanctuary.
Cracks began to appear in the darkness, and through them, shimmering light burst forth.
Despite the effulgence that seemed to burn at one's eyes, the light almost seemed to carry a certain warmth with it, far from any aura of hostility.
After the visitors entered the sanctuary from the crack in reality, the path behind them quickly closed off.
The Prime Sakura's sanctuary...
In stark contrast to the lightless sea they had emerged from, what they now saw in front of them was the abundance of spring.
Beneath a clear, blue sky, a majestic waterfall rumbled amidst countless cherry petals dancing in the gentle wind.
The frigid mist choking the dark ocean had turned into rosy, wisp-like clouds that lingered at one's feet.
The sanctuary's interior has hardly changed over the years, as if time has stood still...
Back then, I came here with the Great Sage––
Sanctuary Outpost - A while prior
Zuihou, in her anxiousness, nearly spilled tea on the floor. Musashi comforted her, then asked her to leave the room.
If you need anything, just let me know!
Nagato and Musashi listened for her nimble footsteps, waiting for them to fade before resuming their conversation.
You, I, and the Great Sage all came to this sanctuary once before when the dark mist plagued the Prime Sakura.
The Great Sage took the recreated Watatsumi and attempted to reach a stalemate with the dark mist. I did not watch this event to its conclusion.
Just as I thought I'd be consumed by the darkness, I suddenly found myself back under the Prime Sakura in full bloom.
Musashi, I ask you this: was the withering Prime Sakura within the seal no more than an illusion?
That is what the Great Sage said.
Once the mist has been vanquished, there will no longer be a need for a seal.
The seal still holds. Which means, the dark mist continues to be.
And so, it continues spreading. We will only learn how severe it is by entering the seal.
Well... If the seal breaks, then we'll know as well.
At the very least, I've heard no reports of abnormalities from the outpost.
I also tried to reach the Great Sage through the Prime Sakura's roots whilst I was asleep within my Sacred Sakura.
However, the seal blocked my attempts to speak with her.
All the withering Sacred Sakuras across our homeland show no sign of recovery.
There's no guarantee that cleansing the Prime Sakura will solve the problem at its roots, even if the dark mist is responsible.
That being the case, our only option is to head inside the seal and investigate.
A troubling proposition, as doing so invariably means fighting the Shadow of Corruption.
You are powerful, Guardian Fox, but it would be extremely dangerous even for you.
Yes, that is why we must finish the ritual the Great Stage started, and quickly.
What ritual?
Though it lacks a name, the Watatsumi Chronicles do speak of a ritual involving the seal.
Perhaps it was made for a time precisely such as this.
If you're concerned of my safety, Musashi, do not be.
I laid out my resolve when you, Akagi, Mikasa, and I faced off. I've not neglected to prepare for a circumstance such as this.
Very well. I shall help you with this ritual, then.
You need not waste your time. The girls stationed here may do it.
Nagato took a sip of her tea and looked around the room.
It was furnished like a traditional Sakuran room, not reminiscent at all of a military base. It was simple, like a room at a roadside inn.
If one removed the view of the Prime Sakura through the window, it would be the spitting image of an average room.
Hmh. Owari is absent.
Another sip from her teacup.
If I may, Lady Nagato, I think I should give them the order.
Without skipping a beat, Musashi took out a brush and paper from the storage and brought them to the table.
With refined handwriting, she composed a list of the materials needed for the ritual that Nagato spoke of.
That was when, suddenly...
*clunk* *rattle*
Something in the room fell over.
*yaaaawn*...
Hatsuzuki... Zuihou... Where are you?
The sliding door parted, revealing a sleepy-looking young girl, rubbing her eyes.
A curious, mirror-like object hovered beside her. Musashi and Nagato knew instinctively that it and the girl were one and the same.
*sniff sniff*... That's the scent of Zuihou's tea!
With a sleepy gait, she walked over to the table, picked up a teacup, and placed it before Nagato.
Zuihooou! I want some of that tea too!
"You fool! That isn't Zuihou you're addressing – it's Lady Nagato!"
Nagato, further confused by the mirror's incessant hoping, poured a serving of tea into the cup.
*gulp gulp*... Ohh, that's good!
The girl completely ignored the dumbstruck Nagato and chugged all of the cup's contents.
Eventually, her senses came to her. She stared back and forth between the two battleships with a surprised look on her face.
H-Hatsuzuki... Wow, you've certainly had a makeover!
You too, Owari... Your skin looks so pale...
Musashi let out an exasperated sigh and placed her brush on the table.
Lady Nagato, this little one is Natori.
N-Nagato? Lady Nagato is here?!
The girl rubbed her eyes several times, adopted a look of shock, then retreated backwards at lightning speed.
"Just as I said! You should've listened!"
The realization finally hit her. Lightning quick once more, she bowed her head to the floor in apology.
F-f-forgive my terrible rudeness!
Raise your head. We have a mission for all you stationed here – Owari included.
May I ask you to help as well?
O-of course! Anything that's within my power!
Nagato quietly rolled her eyes whilst she poured new tea into her cup.
You had no chance to prepare for our arrival. Your reception will not be judged.
Musashi, it is time to prepare the ritual. I trust you to gather the materials.
Finishing her list with a few final strokes, Musashi then slid the paper into her sleeve.
She shot a glance at Natori, who took hold of her mirror and hurriedly circled behind Musashi.
She wrapped up her preparations and entered the corridor, heading for the room with girls' voices leaking through the door.
Oh! Shoot! I forgot to report that Owari has gone missing!
Now I've really messed up... What if Lady Nagato or Musashi get hurt because of it?
Musashi opened the door and gently addressed the clumsy yet endearing girl who nearly spilled her tea.
No harm done. Moreover, we learned that Owari is safe just moments ago.
Our companion will show her back to the outpost shortly.
"To the sanctuary, where the Prime Sakura is..."
"Come to its trunk, and I shall tell you everything."
There it is! The voice in my head!
Sounds familiar... Is it the Great Sage?
Owari reached into her memory and pulled out a name, identifying the voice.
I can't go there, though. The Guardian Fox's barrier stops one from getting close.
There's no way in hell I'm getting past that.
She refuted the voice, and suddenly, a sense of unease seized her.
Wait... But I think I touched the Prime Sakura yesterday, and I've been havin' these weird nightmares since then...
A flood of memories gushed forth, and with them came a headache as she turned to face the giant tree.
OH!
The Prime Sakura's form began to quiver, then flashes of light out from its roots to its leaves.
Complicated patterns formed up in the canopy then vanished, and the lights slowly faded.
With the final ray of light going out, the lands around the sanctuary began quaking.
The seal holding back the dark mist was broken.
The clear blue skies turned dark in mere moments as greyish clouds enveloped the sanctuary.
What's happened to the Prime Sakura?!
The shipgirls rushed outside to see what was going on. Musashi, the head of the group, urged her shocked friends to calm down.
No harm shall come to these girls on my watch!
Roaring thunder pierced the clouds and struck right outside the outpost.
The blinding light faded to reveal the silhouettes of all the shipgirls, ready for battle with riggings now deployed.
Musashi! Lady Nagato is still inside the outpost!
(I can't sense the mist. Has the ritual already commenced?)
She's going to be fine. We have other things to worry about.
The foreboding dark mist – the Shadow of Corruption – whatever you do, do not let it escape the sanctuary!
"Dark mist"? "Shadow of Corruption"? Do you mean that mass on the horizon?
A black tidal wave towered in the far-off distance, all but blotting out the horizon.
The dark mist assuming a watery state was looming – the notion of escaping its path was unthinkable.
Stay close to me!
Musashi! Look out!
From the encroaching tsunami emerged a black beast – no, a pitch-black leviathan.
The darkness-shrouded monster raised its head and roared menacingly before engulfing Musashi whole faster than the eye could see.
Immediately following that, it produced a shockwave that pushed all the remaining shipgirls back.
Something's wrong! It's like... it's pushing us away!
What is happening?! Let go! Let go of me, I say!
Asanagi! Zuihou! Take my hand!
Some invisible, immense force pulled them further and further away from the dark mist.
I can't hold on! It's too powerful!
Zuihooou!
A turbulent wave of air crashed into Zuihou, and she vanished from view in the blink of an eye.
What are we supposed to do?!
Hold on to something! Anything!
Hatsuzuki desperately swam through the air, grabbed on to Natori's sleeve, and clutched Asanagi's heel.
Through some miracle, she managed to cut the distance between the three and wrap her arms around them.
Hang on tight!
I'll use my cheat skills! Old Man, don't you move a muscle!
A brief instant later, the three laid eyes on what they were on course towards.
What the...?
What's that coming from the roots?
The Prime Sakura... It's completely withered!
Aaaahhh!
Heeeeelp!
In the midst of the torrent produced by the black mist, Owari heard her friends cry out whilst she tried to return to the outpost.
Was that... Zuihou?
Nah, what am I sayin'? Ain't no way that's her.
It's coming from above, and last I checked, she couldn't fly through the–
Aaaahhh!
Owariiiii! Heeeelp!
You kiddin' me?
What the heck are you doin' up there, girl?!
I dunno! Get me dooown!
How are you airborne? Did ya learn how to fly using those wings you got?
I'm not in control! Something's lifting meeee!
Though she wasn't the sharpest tool in the shed, Owari quickly realized she'd need some sort of rope to save her friend.
What to do, what to do... Wait, I've got it! Hold on!
Using her bare hands, she removed a chain from her rigging and coiled it up into a lasso.
Then, like a cowgirl from a western flick, she flung it up at Zuihou.
Hang on tight, now!
She successfully pulled Zuihou out of the air, but the momentum carrying her led her to collide with Owari.
Oof!
*sniff*... *sob*...
Owari! Owariii! Waaahhh!
Zuihou wound up on top of Owari. Neither of them were hurt, but nonetheless, Zuihou began crying as soon as she got up.
I was so scared... *sob*...
Owari... Musashi... She's...
Owari, too, got up and looked around. The impact had sent them flying to one of the massive boulders floating in the sky.
Yeah, what about her? Did she come to the sanctuary?
Zuihou, while hardly the most calm and composed person Owari knew, had never broken down crying like this before.
She had many questions to ask, but first of all, finding a place to gather themselves was pertinent.
Hey, uh, don't cry, please?
Look, we'll find a safe place for you to calm down! Follow me!
You can explain all that's happened later!
Owari wrapped her arms around the sobbing Zuihou. She glanced over at the withered Prime Sakura before leading Zuihou away.
Hatsuzuki, Asanagi, and Natori were still holding on to each other, being dragged along by the unknown force.
On one hand, the dragon made of dark mist had gone away – on the other, they'd lost all sense of direction due to the invisible current tossing them around.
Natori, the lowest of the three, decided to change posture and move her body. That's when her fingertips brushed against something soft.
There's something here!
She looked down, but couldn't see anything. It was like staring into a pitch-black abyss.
She tried again, looking more closely, and this time saw ripples travel outward from the spot her fingers touched. Then, she noticed little grains of light, like distant stars in a galaxy.
It was as though a body of water was below them – pliable, too, like a soft mat.
Hrmh. What an indescribable surface...
"Hohoho. This must be Natori's renowned water-walking skill."
It must be quicksand – you'll sink in it if you're not careful.
Asanagi, Natori, form a line and let's start our engines.
We'll try to move forward. Slowly.
You can stand on it too?! So it wasn't my skill! What are we dealing with here?
I have no idea, and I don't think we have time to think about it.
We've got to find Zuihou quickly, then go and rescue Musashi!
Musashi... Could she be...
No, that's preposterous! A wee beast made of fog could never as much as scratch Musashi!
If anything, she has no doubt felled the creature by now!
I hope so...
Let's see if we can't reach anyone via our communicators.
Hello? Does anyone read me?
BRRRZZZT...
KABOOOM!
Out of nowhere, the mist surrounded the shipgirls, birthing creatures far smaller yet far more numerous than the black dragon.
They had no set forms. One moment they were mass-produced ships, the next they were Sirens, and sometimes, even Pawns.
There was only one constant among them – that they were approaching.
In response, the girls adopted fighting stances and readied their cannons.
We've no choice but to fight on our own for now!
Come on! Let's go!
Haaaah!
Hatsuzuki's sword cut the black mist away, fending off the approaching foes.
However, they quickly changed form and resumed their attack.
What are these things?!
Artillery fired all over the place, whipping up wind and smoke that disrupted the mist.
Haaaah!
...Yet once more, they simply changed form and attacked again.
I hit something hard! That wasn't mist, was it...?!
The moment Hatsuzuki's blade touched it this time, what was once black mist transformed into a temporary solid form.
PING!
She hadn't put enough strength behind it to cut through the plating, so her blade was deflected.
C'mon...!
We've been surrounded!
Insignificant worms! Behold as my fists of fury put a dent in you!
Torpedo volley! Main cannons, fire!
Asanagi, don't touch that black mist!
We're running out of ammo! We gotta run away while we still can!
How long do you plan to run?! Let's send up a signal flare!
Owari and the others may be struggling, too, but it's better than fighting alone!
Let us join up and fight together!
I'll take care of it!
Natori pointed her main cannon toward the sky and shot a signal flare.
It burst in the air, becoming a lone star in the desolate black sky.
Kh... Ammunition is wearing thin quickly...!
("Fight until the last light has faded...")
(I know...! I'm not giving up until the end!)
Nnh?!
Damn it all...
Asanagi, are you out of ammo now...?
Nearly. But I have deadlier weapons. With one fist, I'll break us out of this quagmire!
Natori, it's dangerous. You hide behind us.
Even if only one of us can escape, you'll—
How dare you?! I will be the one to protect us all using my cheat abilities!
Geez, can you cut that out already?!
Yes, yes. That's enough, you two!
They turned their rigging and used their broadside plating to narrowly fend off attacks. Their backs were truly against the wall now.
Looks like this is it for us...
But Hatsuzuki and her fellow shipgirls did not give up the fight just yet.
The black mist monsters all attacked at once—
Hatsuzuki's surroundings were lit up as bright as daytime, as if a spotlight had been pointed at her.
What is the meaning of this...?
"Heheheh, mwahahahah! How do you like that?! See how they turn tail and run!"
Illuminated by the light, the black mist shrieked and disappeared.
So waaarm...
Is this Lady Nagato's ritual?
The light continued to expand and envelop the trio.
For some reason, there wasn't darkness outside the light anymore; something else entirely had unfolded.
Could it be? Teleportation magic?!
Instantly after, the light became so dazzling that they saw nothing but white.
Teleported away from the black mist and into a Sakura Empire garden, the trio looked back and forth at each other dubiously.
Are we... alive?
Hatsuzuki abruptly pinched Asanagi's arm.
Ouch! Why?!
Well, we're not dreaming!
If you wanted to check, then pinch your own cheek instead of my poor arm!
But that hurts, and I don't wanna stretch my cheeks out...
What sort of logic is that?!
"Now, little girls, stop your arguing."
The mirror jumped out of Natori's clothes.
Old Man! Where are we?!
"My, my... Have we been returned to the Sakuran archipelago...?"
I think so... The style is Sakuran, and this place kinda looks familiar...
Is it... Lady Nagato's courtyard?
So Lady Nagato DID save us, after all?
Let's investigate the area for the time being. Standing around won't do us any good.
Rubbing her arm, Asanagi tried to start walking—
No.
A woman's voice interrupted her.
Everyone turned around toward it. There, they saw a woman in white standing next to the lake.
The lake surface reflected her figure. Despite her loose attire, her shapely curves were quite plain to see.
If you take another half-step forward, you will fall into a bottomless abyss.
Asanagi looked down and, indeed, the ground at her feet and that just in front seemed different somehow.
Taking another half-step forward would mean falling into an abyss. That much seemed to be true.
Getting goosebumps from the cold chill, Asanagi pulled her extended leg back to her.
Who are you...?
"Ho ho ho! You're a pretty little lady!"
Aha! You must be a goddess! Or a hermit!
Heedless of the many curious eyes on her, the Great Sage approached the shipgirls.
One, two, three... I see. More of your friends are still trapped in there.
She went back to the lake. The once-placid waters suddenly changed, taking on a more sinister look.
It was as if it wasn't a Sakura Empire courtyard's lake at all, but an abyss leading straight to hell.
The Great Sage was unmoved as she gazed into the abyss.
...I've found your friends. Don't worry; they're okay.
Light shone in the abyss, and then...
Both the light and the abyss disappeared, returning the lake to its usual calm.
Meanwhile, after rescuing Zuihou, Owari managed to reach the "water" within the seal and began sailing on it.
They left the floating rocks behind and hid behind a safe hill.
Zuihou had stopped crying, but her eyes were still red and hot.
You're so mean, Owari! You dreamed of the Prime Sakura withering, and you just went all on your own to check on it!
You could've talked to me, or Hatsuzuki, or anyone! Why didn't you say anything?!
Sorry! It's all my fault! I won't do it again, so just forgive me, would ya?!
...You promise?
Uh-huh, I super duper promise.
You're not sorry at all! Geez! You don't get me, Owari!
I am, I swear! Pinky promise, scout's honor, and all that!
Anyway, is it true that Lady Nagato and Musashi are here?
Lady Nagato is preparing some kind of ritual at the outpost.
And Musashi said we needed to gather materials for the ritual, but...
The Prime Sakura started withering out of nowhere...
Materials for a ritual, the Sakura withering...
I know what's going on! Umm, the... Barrier? Seal? Whatever, I saw it disappear!
Yeah! I saw it in my dream, too! The seal disappeared, so the black mist stuff in there all came out, right?!
It started off in the Prime Sakura! No wonder we didn't realize it.
I heard Lady Nagato reinforced the barrier when the outpost was built...
But I guess that wasn't enough, huh? Rough...
Huh? Musashi isn't with you?
When the barrier broke, Musashi was trying to protect us. She got taken away by the black mist...
Whoa, that's BAD! Gah, if only Kii was here...
Kii? Is Kii around, too? We never saw her.
Uh, nope, that's what I just said. She set up a secret communication line when I was assigned to this outpost...
And she said to contact her if anything happened so she could pass it on to Musashi.
Mmh... You could've told us!
Maybe I just forgot, y'know?
A-anyway, there's no use talking about all this complex stuff right now! I'm gonna get a headache if we keep this up!
We got separated from the others, and Musashi got taken away from us...
Most of all, the Prime Sakura's in such awful shape...
Zuihou, can you send out your carrier-based craft?
Instead of going crazy on our own, I think we should try sending your carrier-based craft out to search for the others.
Okay! Leave it to me!
Also...
Owari peeked over the hill to get a look at her surroundings.
No good... I can't tell where the heck that outpost is...
J-just leave it all to me, okay?
In the dark, cold seal, monsters made of black mist shrieked and roared ceaselessly.
They jumped between the ethereal sea and floating rocks, launched out of the ground by the uprooting of the Prime Sakura, searching for the targets of their ire.
After the signal flare from before, she'd used the seal's divine light to find and rescue the trio.
The light had repelled the black mist and brought them to this safe haven for the time being.
I did warn them not to try to walk around, so I'm sure they will be safe for now.
Next...
She had a general idea of their remaining friends' whereabouts, but there was no way to narrow it down and help them.
That sound... Is that aircraft?
A single carrier-based aircraft, hardly useful in the black mist's domain, quickly lost control and crash-landed.
Which direction...? Aha, that way.
She stepped into the ethereal waters and used the sanctuary's power to rush to the shipgirls' aid.
I-I've lost another carrier-based craft!
Urk... I don't have any more recon craft to send out...
This is rough... It's dangerous, but I've got no choice but to act.
But first... Let's deal with what's right in front of us!
S-someone's coming this way!
I'll give 'em the trouncing of a lifetime! Which way, Zuihou?
Behind you! Six o' clock!
Behind me?!
Noticing a presence in an unexpected direction, Owari used her rigging to whip around in a hurry.
Fiiiire!
*PING*
Her shells were deflected by an invisible barrier, covering the surroundings in smoke.
*cough* *cough*...
...A shipgirl?!
Heehee. Bit of a rude welcome, I have to say.
She floated above the water without rigging, but there was no doubt she was a shipgirl just like Owari and Zuihou.
Sorry, sorry!
(I think I saw this person in that illusion... Great Sage, or something?)
As she approached the Prime Sakura, Owari's memory of the illusion became more vivid.
Great Sage...?
That is me. I've taken your friends to a safe place, and now, I'll have you two come with me as well.
It's the last pure land remaining in this seal. With my power, I will protect you all.
Once she finished talking, light shone through the sky and enveloped Owari and Zuihou.
However, the pillar of light flickered multiple times before disappearing.
...Was that a light signal, or...?
Unfortunately, straying too far away makes it consume far too much power... My remaining strength isn't enough.
We have no choice. I'll just have to guide you myself.
Come with me.
Past – Prime Sakura Sanctuary
There was a small lake at the foot of the Prime Sakura.
By that lake, the shipgirl protector of this sanctuary, called the Great Sage by many, placed a hand on the tree with her companions.
A soft, warm sensation touched their palms as they did.
...But after a moment, that softness turned into pain like needles prickling their skin.
Sensing a disturbance, the shipgirls pulled away all at once.
What was that...?
I have a feeling I know the answer, Musashi.
"Once upon a time, a star fell from the northern sky."
"Darkness spread from the sea in which it fell. Frightened, the seas and skies of Mizuho shed tears."
"Lamenting the tears of the Sakura Empire, the stars set themselves ablaze to create a blinding light that sealed the darkness into this sanctuary."
Great Sage, are you reciting a legend from the Watatsumi Chronicles?
The text that details many of the stories surrounding our sacred relic...
Why mention it now? Is it somehow related to the Prime Sakura's anomaly?
Most observant.
During our journey here, you asked why I brought you to the Prime Sakura's sanctuary.
While the Watatsumi Chronicles themselves are but stories and legends, their contents conceal a deeper truth.
In this sanctuary – rather, within the Prime Sakura – lies a fragment of the very star that had fallen from the northern sky.
The Prime Sakura's power sealed the shard away, containing the calamitous darkness...
But impurity continues to seep out, gnawing away at the tree's power.
If the rot is not expelled and the seal is not renewed, the calamitous darkness will one day return.
What is this calamitous darkness of which you speak?
...And do we have the power to deal with it in our current state?
Indeed. We are drained from our decisive battle against the Sirens... Even if we were to fight, our power would be lacking.
Besides, if this threat could be quashed through firepower alone, I assume you would have asked us much earlier.
It is as you say.
The reason I have sought the two of you out is simple–
Through a ritual, I wish to permanently annihilate this world-ending calamity.
Annihilate?
Are your rituals able to do that?
Instead of answering directly, the shipgirl known as the Great Sage nodded solemnly and began chanting the words of the ritual.

The Prime Sakura began to resonate, threads of light rising from its roots towards the sky like cherry blossoms in the wind, weaving back and forth until they formed a complex structure – that of a gate.
This was the Sakuran ritual of forming a barrier domain.
Once the barrier had been fully formed, the colors surrounding them seemed to be absorbed into the domain itself.
There. The preparations are complete.
What incredible skill. No wonder you're the protector of this sanctuary...
I couldn't have hoped to understand during my studies, but it is astounding to see the intricacies of this ritual up close.
Your praise honors me, but understand that the road ahead will still be dangerous.
That is why I am here. Explain your intentions while you guide us onward.
Musashi materialized her sword, which crackled with electricity.
She then drew it from the scabbard and gripped its hilt tightly, reaffirming her determination to fight.
...I see your resolve.
Then I shall guide you to the star fragment – to Watatsumi.
Guardian Fox, I will have you enter the seal and confront Watatsumi.
Impurity has accumulated in the sacred tree along the way, but this barrier's power will protect us.
However, once you enter the seal, the darkness that has become Watatsumi's shadow will lash out at you.
I will protect Lady Nagato. Continue.
...Thank you, Musashi.
Nagato, as the Sakura Empire's Guardian Fox, you are the only one who can resonate with Watatsumi.
Regardless of how strong the seal is, the powers vested within you will grant you safe passage.
But know that you, alone, can accomplish this.
For a short time, you should be able to wield Watatsumi's remaining power.
We must push back the darkness and form a new seal that does not draw its power from the very same source of corruption.
...Yes, I will become the foundation for the new seal.
Musashi, you must protect Lady Nagato until the ritual is complete.
Once the mist has been vanquished, there will no longer be a need for a seal.
And I will leave the star fragment, the remnants of Watatsumi, in your care.
It will be but a shell, exhausted of its power, but it should still be enough to help you change this nation's future.
Lady Nagato, Musashi... Please protect the future of the Sakura Empire.
And finally...
Musashi, I will fulfill my agreement with you.
The Great Sage retrieved a small box from within her sleeve and handed it to Musashi.
May this assist you in repairing the "roots" that make up our physical forms.
A heavy air hung over the group as they steeled their resolve.
There might have been a thousand words the three wished to exchange, but not a single one was to be heard.
Zuihou, I need your aerial coverage.
On it!
Most of my little birds are, uh, gone, but I'll send what I have left!
Make sure you stay close! We can't have you getting lost!
They cruised through the shapeless sea and approached the light emanating from the fallen Prime Sakura's branches.
Hey, apologies if I just need glasses, but ain't the light comin' from the branches kinda fading?
Owari! Look out!
An enemy vessel made of dark mist fired a volley at Owari. She dodged, but lost her balance briefly.
Aw crap! There's enemies, like, all around us!
All around us, and more are showing up! They have us completely surrounded!
...They're not after you. It's me they want.
The Great Sage descended from the air and stood on the water's surface.
She drew her katana, unleashing a wave of spiritual energy that stopped the misty foes in their tracks.
This much range should be sufficient.
What are you gonna do?
The Great Sage did not answer. She summoned a pillar of light from above Owari and Zuihou.
Once they were fully encased in light, she moved closer.
A smile flashed on her lips as she bid them goodbye.
Then, she turned on her heel, and went forth to face the army of enemies all alone.
All of a sudden, the courtyard Hatsuzuki's team found themselves in began to rumble.
Is that an earthquake?
No, it's not! Look at the sky!
A giant crack formed in the clear night sky, different from the crack within the seal.
From it, dark mist began to gush forth and infect this domain, too.
It's time.
Butterflies glowing blue began to circle around the Great Sage as she stood in the courtyard.
It wasn't long before the butterflies eventually covered every inch of her body.
What in the world?!
Natori! The mist is coming for us again!
How did it find us all the way here?!
Ever more dark mist continued to pour out of the great hole in the sky. The girls, all but out of ammunition, were cornered.
Hey, where'd that other lady go?
In the spot where the Great Sage previously stood, a pillar of light projected skywards.
Somebody else is teleporting in!
The new arrivals fired a volley at the girls through the light before they could so much as be identified.
Damn! They're everywhere!
We are not "them"! At least identify us before you fire at us!
It wasn't until the light faded that both sides finally recognized each other.
Owari! Zuihou!
Thank the heavens you are alright! We'd feared for the worst!
Hey, Asanagi! How come you're all here? Actually, first, where even are we?
In the so-called "safe haven," apparently. Although, it's not so safe anymore, I guess...
First thing first – we have to deal with these enemies!
We're here to begin with because we CAN'T deal with them! Only that lady seemed capable of it with her columns of light.
And now, she has vanished!
"That lady"? Does she have white hair and wear white clothes, by any chance?
That she does. What of it?
Aha! I knew it was the Great Sage. She's the one who saved you all, and...
Wait... If she did that, then who was the person we met just earlier?
Either that one was a ghost, or she has an identical twin...
Are you suggesting there is not one, but two Great Sages?
Not exactly! Because, like, I accidentally fired at her, and she blocked the shot.
So at the very least, the one we ran into was the real deal!
Right... In other words, the person we spoke to was just a phantom.
Nonsense. This Great Sage saved us, too, lest you forget.
Then she knows not just teleportation magic, but also how to clone herself and create phantoms out of butterflies.
"The lass is either a goddess or a hermit."
Yeah, Old Man! As I said, it all makes sense if she's a hermit!
It really doesn't matter what you call her...
Let's put that aside and try to think of any way to deal with the mist, before we lose the courtyard to it.
Musashi had been swallowed whole by the dragon of black mist. Aimlessly, she had been roaming a plane of darkness for hours.
That's when a light appeared – the light from the ritual Nagato previously performed inside the seal – and enveloped her.
The light showed her a vision of the Guardian Fox performing the same ritual.
Lady Nagato...
Forgive me. I should've come sooner.
Do you know where the rest of the girls are?
I do not. But, assuming the Great Sage's seal still hasn't been fully destroyed...
Then there is one place. The only place they could seek shelter.
The Prime Sakura... They must be within the seal.
I'll go inside to look for them, as well as for any traces of the Great Sage.
Aye. I will soon begin the main part of the ritual, and I have no leeway to rescue the others.
Only you can do it, Musashi. I trust you to save them.
I will send you to the inside of the seal. Once you find the others, set fire to this talisman.
I shall then use the power of the sanctuary's seal to transport all of you outside it.
But, to fully resolve this abnormality, we will need the Great Sage's help.
As it stands, my powers alone are insufficient to seal away the dark mist.
Replicating the Watatsumi worked once. To purge the mist, we will need to take a different approach.
You're referring to the dragon god?
That, I am not. Never mind that – focus on finding the others as soon as possible.
Once I know that you're all safe, I will attempt to strengthen the seal temporarily.
As brilliant as the Great Sage's ritual is, it cannot even keep the situation from worsening as long as she is the Watatsumi.
