There lied a shrine at the base of the Sacred Sakura, from which the Sakura Empire got its name. Countless people, both citizens of the Sakura Empire and visitors from abroad, had gathered on this day.
A young girl, clad in red and white, emerged from the shrine, taking graceful steps down the shrine's steps.
She wore a shrine maiden's traditional clothing, many gorgeous ornaments, and most important of all: two golden hairpins.
These golden hairpins were the definitive sign that this girl was the keeper of the Sacred Sakura.
The young girl stopped in the center of a podium resting outside the shrine, then faced her people, bearing a magnificent expression.
I am Nagato. Protector of the Sakura Empire and flagship of her Combined Fleet! Let us offer our humblest prayers to the Gods!
The young girl, with a dignified voice unbefitting of her small stature, made an appeal to the Sakura Empire's people.
People of the Sakura Empire, pray with me, so that we may ensure our nation prospers for many long years to come.
... O Sacred Sakura, in exchange for thy blessings, I offer a prayer to thee...
Just and pure of heart I shall be, so that thy flowers may bloometh for eternity...
It was a miracle. The Sacred Sakura had taken in their prayers, and its petals began to glow with a faint light.
Then, the shrine and everything around it became enveloped in a gentle downpour of sakura petals.
The shrine maiden has brought us a miracle! The Sacred Sakura graces us with its light!
All hail Nagato! All hail Nagato!
In response to the voices of the people, the sakura petals turned into tiny globes of light.
They converged at a single point above the Sacred Sakura before splitting apart, flying away and spreading out evenly through all of the Sakura Empire.
Then, after a short while, the young girl turned to the crowd and began to speak.
I am Nagato. Protector of the Sakura Empire and flagship of her Combined Fleet! Hear my words! For as long as you believe in the Gods, the Sakura Empire's prosperity is guaranteed!
May the Sakura Empire prosper for all eternity!
Amidst the cheers of her people, Nagato turned around and proceeded to walk back to the shrine's interior.
So, how did I fare...? Am I behaving as I should...?
Yes... As you say, the Protector of the Sacred Sakura must be magnificent... I shall do everything to be magnificent!

sequence: Ink-Stained Steel Sakura

scripts.say: ... It's our duty and all, but finding a way to wake Nagato is easier said than done...
I've detected a Siren fleet. They're in the process of surrounding us... 12 minutes until contact.
God dammit, not more of them... Even if they all stand still, we won't make any progress... I guess we could knock on the crystal to see if she'll wake up...
KABOOOM!
A shell splashed the water just in front of Zuikaku.
I won't let anyone lay a finger on her.
Geez, I was just kidding... Don't get so worked up, I wasn't serious!
How stupid do you have to be, trying to persuade her?
That voice, could it be...?
... Why would you be mean to my poor sister? You should know your place, idiots!
It's Mutsu, the Big Seven...!
Huh? You know about me? How?
Well, we're trying to wake up Nagato, and save the Sacred Sakura while we're at it, so we came here to...
BOOOM!
BAAANG!
The Sirens fired 2 shots at them.
One of the shots hit the Sacred Sakura, causing one of its large branches to snap.
It's unlikely this conversation can continue until after we've dealt with the Sirens...
I will protect the shrine maiden at any cost!
Wait, hold on! ... Dammit! She's totally stealing my spot in the limelight!
BAAANG!
KABOOOM!
Oh no! We can't let another shot hit the Sacred Sakura!
I've got my hands full with trying to dodge what's coming at me! ... Oh crap, look out!
BOOOM!
A fierce battle was unfolding around the Sacred Sakura. Shot after shot hit the tree, filling the air with the smell of burning timber.
The girl encased in the crystal seemed to be in pain.
This is bad... If they keep shooting, Nagato's gonna...
FWOOOSH!
A flash of light formed an impenetrable barrier around the girl and her rescuers.
How dare you fiends disrupt the peace of these Spirits...
A voice came from within the Sacred Sakura. The barrier of light had actually been created from its countless branches, leaves, and petals.
The clash between the Sirens and Nagato's rescuers came to a total stop.
Beasts who dare trespass on these holy grounds! Leave at once!
The light from the tree coalesced into a furious stream which engulfed the Siren fleet in one fell swoop.
In the blink of an eye, the area had become littered with the wrecks of many Sirens.
Then, the light formed into a sphere and floated over to Nagato's rescuers, with the young but dignified girl hovering at its center.
N-Nagato...!
The shrine maiden lives!
W-what's the hell?
I am Nagato. Protector of the Sakura Empire and flagship of her Combined Fleet!
Okay, I'm really, really sorry for trying to rouse you from your slumber...!
Sensing a fiery fury within the eyes of the girl, Zuikaku panicked and began pleading for forgiveness.
You must be Zuikaku of the 5th Carrier Division. What business have you with me?
... Head on the nail! You see, we need you on our side!
I refuse!
Could you at least try it before you say no?!
I was tasked with ensuring the Sacred Sakura's safety. I shall remain here till my body turns to dust.
Nagato, you...
Did you make that decision of your own accord? Or was it forced on you?
I... It is for the sake of the Sakura Empire and her people, and to atone for my sins. My say is irrelevant.
You fool!
W-what?!
Do you not see how frivolous it is to sit here and rot away when a battleship of your caliber is more desirable than ever in these changing times?!
I-is that...
Is that you, Mikasa?!
Your 41 centimeter cannons make whole nations quiver, your bridge towers to the heavens, your armor deflects shells like they were stones...
Trying to hide her envy, Mikasa whispered: "... My envy of you cannot be adequately expressed! You are the finest example of a battleship!"
Nagato was trying to maintain her dignified appearance, but humbled by Mikasa's words, she loosened up.
I-it's not as great as you think... But why are you here, Mikasa?
Uh, it's a long story, so why don't you come with us and we'll explain it on the way...
However, Nagato ignored what Zuikaku was saying.
M-Mikasa, ever since I became the Combined Fleet's flagship, I've been trying to be like you...
I tried to be a magnificent flagship... And yet...
Say no more. Have a battle with me.
Huh...?
I needed only one look at your cannons to know it with certainty: you haven't fired them as much as once since your birth.
Mikasa's remark caused a single tear to form in the corner of one of Nagato's eyes.
Battleships should know dearly the smell of the sea and gunpowder, not of trees and their own rusting hulls. I can't stand to see my successor stuck in a place like this.
Sometimes, a battle can offer more insight into a person's character than a thousand of their words.
You there, you must be her little sister. Why not join us for a bout?
Sure! Hehehe~ I've been waiting so long for this day!

sequence: Thou shalt not touch a human, for they would tarnish thy divinity.
Thou shalt not smile, for thou must maintain thy dignity.
Thou shalt not forget: the Creator is your only God.

scripts.say: Because I was made by humans, I desire bonds just like them.
Dignity alone won't make my people admire me. At times, I must smile, too.
O, Creator, I beg of you: grant me new life as someone whom my people can believe in with all their heart.
Very well! Lacking in experience as I may be, I shall hold nothing back!
I am Nagato, Big Seven of the Sakura Empire! Prepare yourself!
Ugh, we lost... Even though we tried so hard...
I may be old, but I've still got it! Ahahahah!
Mikasa...
So, did you enjoy yourself?
I did. It was quite a learning experience as well.
But... I still have much to learn. About combat, and about myself. I didn't want to be a disappointment to my people or my friends, so I worked strenuously...
I've lost so much, and I was manipulated into starting a war... Nobody can deny it's all my fault.
However, the Spirits told me something important: that there is a divergence point in this timeline. And I want you to help me look for it.
This time... I will not run away from myself!
Hey, look who figured it all out~ I didn't even need to butt in~
Where did you come from?!
The intel was right~ The "divergence point," or whatever, in this timeline has brought you all in one place!
Nagato took aim at and fired the Siren, but she dodged it. Purifier didn't respond by preparing for combat, instead she turned to Nagato with a displeased look.
... Hey, could you not take out your anger on me just cause you woke up on the wrong side of the bed? I'm just here to give you a hint, buttercup!
Let's see... "When the Winter's Crown is donned, when the Steel Sakura blooms... the Souls' Transmigration will begin... and start the Final Prelude"?
... Yikes, like straight out of a cringy fanfic. Who came up with this pretentious garbage? I'll need to go wash my eyes with bleach later!
Have you any more to say? If not... prepare to be engulfed by cannon fire!
Aaagghhh! I just wanted to check out a tree, and now I'm being forced to make like one! Purifier's blasting off agaaaaaaaain!
BOOOM!
*Gasp*... *Gasp*... Has the Siren retreated...?
For being your first real battle, that was spectacular. How does it feel to be victorious?
*Gasp*... I didn't think a battle would be this tiring, but... to fight and be victorious, as an actual combatant, feels terrific.
So, will you team up with us and help fight the baddies?
Yes. By the way, Mikasa, there is something the Siren said that I'm worried about...
She mentioned "soul transmigration." There is a legend that says the Sacred Sakura is a catalyst for God to hear our prayers...
But it's also said that it offers peace and salvation to the souls of the deceased.
If the Spirits I saw in my slumber are the "souls" the Siren spoke of, then they aren't gathering here, but in a far-off, distant place.
Whether the Sirens are behind this, or a being beyond my comprehension, I can't say. But I do know that somewhere in this world, there is a force trying to cause great change.
I see... Your concern deserves attention, but for now, we need more allies.
Zuikaku has bothered you with the question many times now, but won't you join us?
Yes... I'm interested to see what's in store for me in the unexplored oceans beyond my birthplace...
I, battleship Nagato, shall fight by your side!
Finally... Finally, it is complete...
With this power, we will crush all that stand in our way like insects, even the Grey Ghost and the Sirens... Isn't this marvelous, Kaga?
I never thought we could get our hands on this much power... It is marvelous, my sister.
We must plan for the final battle... Soon, we shall change the Sakura Empire's future, and establish a new world order... Ahahahaha...
If you were in this situation beyond all expectations... what would you do?
We're finally back here, after so long... Look, Shoukaku! This is the place where we used to train!
Yes, we made many memories here. And we haven't been here ever since the war began...
Zuikaku's fleet is advancing through a region of the Sakura Empire that's been silent ever since the Sirens attacked it.
The fleet is composed of 3 segments. In the front, there's Ayanami, the "Demon of Solomon," who's conducting a sweep of the area.
In the middle, there are the sisters of the 5th Carrier Division: Shoukaku and Zuikaku.
And in the rear, there's Mikasa, the Combined Fleet's 1st flagship.
I don't blame you for being so excited to see such a nostalgic place... but could you at least show a little consideration for the elderly... *Panting*...
Sorry, Mikasa! We'll slow down. Also, this is the first time I've heard you complaining...
Speaking of first times, how about you get a taste of my handmade Royal Gourmet when we get back?
Zuikaku's expression turned flat in an instant.
Ahaha, um... I appreciate the thought... But I don't think my palate is ready to try that yet...
BOOOM!
As soon as the enemy fleet was detected, they began a long-distance bombardment of the path Zuikaku's fleet was taking.
That was close! They scared the bejesus outta me!
Sirens detected at 3 o' clock, distance 12,000 meters.
Our intel was right; the Sirens really were out here. All personnel! Prepare to strike back!
No wonder nobody's come near this place for ages... It's because the Sirens invaded it...
Shoukaku, I'm just wondering: why are we here, again?
For the Sacred Sakura. Measurements taken since the war began show that it has started to wither. We're here to investigate why, and also we must...
We must rescue someone important. The new Combined Fleet is shaping up better than I thought, but we still are in need of her strength.
By "someone important," surely you don't mean...?
I do. We must rescue Nagato, who has remained by the Sacred Sakura all this time.
She wasn't able to prevent the war, and she has been blaming herself for it...
We'd better hurry, then! But first, we'll have to take care of these guys!
They're making their way toward the Sacred Sakura. Shouldn't we stop them? Before long, they'll discover Nagato.
Those vermin just won't die no matter how much pesticide you use on them... How utterly annoying.
That said... That girl is just one single battleship. Even if they discover her, she won't be of any use to them.
Ever since she was unable to stop the war from breaking out, she's been... Well, you know.
The people's faith and her sacrifice is all just a part of the plan.
All we can do now is wait... We must wait until the one who can oppose the Sirens and change fate itself has arrived...

signDate: The night of the war's outbreak - coordinates: 27.328699，-159.870474

scripts.say: Are you saying that, no matter what, it's inevitable?
It is all for the future of the Sakura Empire. All you need do is give us the order, and we shall do it.
But... If a war breaks out, many will die... Both on their side, and ours...
The force known as change requires tribute in the form of souls. And it's thanks to change that the world can move forward. I'm sure you know this fact very well.
Please, do not worry. The enemy still has no idea that our troops are coming. I can guarantee the attack will be successful.
I see...
Give us the order, Nagato. The elite of the 1st Carrier Division are always ready to sortie.
She has seen into the eyes of many. She has seen the anticipation in the eyes of faithful believers, and she has seen the gleam that signifies hope for the future.
However, that is not what she's seeing in these people's eyes. Their eyes are filled not with hope, but the desire to receive her authorization to start a war.
She may hesitate, but ultimately she has no choice. The people in charge have already decided what course the future will take.
She knew that her objections would be futile. She clenched her fist, took a deep breath, and made a declaration in the dignified voice she had now grown accustomed to using.
I am Nagato. Protector of the Sakura Empire and flagship of her Combined Fleet.
I hereby issue the following order to all personnel of the Sakura Empire's Combined Fleet:
Commence the attack... on Azur Lane!

sequence: Thou shalt not touch a human, for they would tarnish thy divinity.
Thou shalt not smile, for thou must maintain thy dignity.
Thou shalt not forget: the Creator is your only God.

scripts.say: Mutsu, I need your opinion: will this pose be good for the next ceremony?
Well, hold still so I can get a look... Hmm, it looks kinda stupid to me. Maybe it'd work if you kept your arms totally straight?
Huh? ... L-like this?
Hahaha~ You look like a doll now!
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that! C'mon, let me see a smile! Say "cheese"!
Though the girl tried, her smile came off as incredibly forced.
I'm sorry... I can't do it...
I seem to have forgotten how to smile...

signDate: At the Sacred Sakura, after the war's outbreak

scripts.say: The Sacred Sakura is withering... And the people are losing faith...
Nagato! Sirens have surrounded this place! I heard they're supposed to protect it, but then that means...
That we're cooperating with them! How did this happen?! What's everyone thinking?!
... Mutsu, I must tell you something...
A few days ago, I relinquished my position as the Combined Fleet's flagship.
You did WHAT?!
A blend of shock and anger was welling up in the young girl's sister's eyes.
It is the age of aircraft carriers now. Soon there will likely be no need of us at all...
Those idiots! They don't even know what we're capable of, yet they go and do this!
We're part of the Big Seven! I have a thing or two to say to those idiots, right now!
The girl stretched both her arms out and stood in the way of her little sister.

Mutsu, it's over! Battleships have no place in this world anymore! ... It's unfortunate, but think of it this way: now that I'm no longer the flagship, I can focus my energy on trying to solve the problem we're facing.
Every day since the war's outbreak, the Spirits... or, what the Sirens called "quantum data," of our fallen people have been trying to tell me something... I know this is all my fault, but...
No, it's not your fault! Those people have been trying to use your powers for their own gain this whole time!
I know they have! But it matters not... There is only one thing I can do to atone for my wrongdoings.
Mutsu, I want you to seal me inside the Sacred Sakura. That way, I will be able to see the Spirits, and I may be able to learn something.
It is for the sake of the Sakura Empire.
Nagato...
I know what you're worried about, but it is fine. Someone I can trust will protect me. She won't let anyone near the Sacred Sakura.
You mean... that Shiratsuyu-class girl? She and I aren't exactly close friends...
... You will make friends with her while I'm not here. And one last thing...
What is it?
Thank you for everything you've done, Mutsu.
Halt! Who are you?!
We're the Sakura Empire's new Combined Fleet, and we're here to have a look at the girl in the Sacred Sakura...
... Leave this place. None shall disturb the shrine maiden's slumber.
It is our goal to bring Nagato and her sister safely out of here!
I thank you for your noble consideration, but I made a promise with Nagato. I shall not let anyone wake her from her slumber!
Nobody, not even you, even though we are allies.
*Sigh*... I really hate it when people are as stubborn as you... We're trying to save the world! Let us through!
If you still wish to have it your way, then show me your resolve through a battle!
I knew it! I knew this would happen! It's so clichéd, yet it always does!
Relax. I will end this in an instant!
You really are as strong as they say. I'm impressed.
Come on, we're allies! We didn't have to fight in the first place...
Sorry, I was overcome by my soldierly instinct to fight a worthy opponent.
Yeah, sure... So will you lead us to her, as you promised?
I am true to my word. I know I can entrust Nagato to you people.
At the base of the Sacred Sakura, encircled by countless pillars and holy ropes to ward off evil spirits, sat a large, translucent crystal.
Sealed inside it was Nagato, shrine maiden of the Sakura Empire and flagship of its fleet.
She wore a pained expression, as though she was having a nightmare.
For years, she's been watching over the Spirits, or what the Sirens called "quantum data."
She seems to view it as some sort of atonement, but in reality, it's not. She was just deceived by a small group of people.
And all I can do is watch over her and keep her safe from the Sirens.
You are the only ones who can save her.
That is our goal, too. Kawakaze, you have done well. We shall take care of the rest!

sequence: Thou shalt not touch a human, for they would tarnish thy divinity.

scripts.say: "... I want to help them! It isn't fair for our brethren fighting tooth and nail for our sake while we remain behind...!"
"Mutsu and I are supposed to be the biggest, most powerful battleships! ... Please, you must let us go! I swear we shall not get in anyone's way!"
"Thou shalt stay!"
"How wouldst thou explain thyself to thy people if thou, their Protector, the strongest battleship in the world, were ever injured in battle?!"
"Excessive sympathy leadeth to one's own destruction."
"Thine duty to the Sakura Empire is to follow my orders. Is that clear?"
"It is clear. Thus far, following your orders has been for the best."
Mutsu...
Yeah?
Do you see those dolls on the table? Do you think they, too, possess a heart and a soul?
Who knows... What's the matter, Nagato?
Since our creation, this world has changed completely.
I'm sure you already know. Across the sea, there are ships just like us, the so-called "Big Seven"...
I pray that one day, we may meet and befriend them...
... But, more importantly, I pray that one day I may get to test their skill in combat. Ahah...
Hey! You smiled! I knew you could do it!
W-what? I-I... I did not smile! I just had a s-slip of the tongue...
Still, remember that friendly visit we made a while ago? One day you'll surely have the chance to meet them!
Let us hope so... U-until then, Mutsu... you must promise to keep me company...
... Of course!

scripts.say: Um, today is May 27th.
The location the Sakura Empire fleet was discovered at... should be here...
Oh, right! That's where it was!
Hmm... Even though I was the one who wrote the report, I had to destroy the original after giving it to the Naval HQ...
That sure throws a wrench in things, doesn't it?
But, thank your lucky stars that Sister Sara is so resourceful... I doubt any other girl would be able to salvage the documents.
Now, if you want to know about the "Black Dragon," I'm sure you'll find that out on your own sooner or later.
By the way, don't put Sister Sara's minor grumbling on the records, pretty please?

"Sirens are appearing one after another in the waters near a remote island base in the NW Sector."
"Furthermore, the Sirens conducted a number of attacks of secured sectors."
"While each attack consisted only of a few ships, we believe that this is a precursor to a large-scale Siren offensive."
Yeah, yeah. I know, I'm taking this seriously, okay?
The reason we moved our reserves up here was in anticipation of this offensive.
I had no idea we were in the middle of a Reenactment back then, and Commander wasn't around either.
Huh? We were all panicking at the time?
C'mon, TB, just play back the next thing already.

scripts.say: "–––Action Report Records"
"Aircraft carrier Yorktown was heavily injured during the Siren offensive, but thanks to everyone's efforts, the Sirens were pushed back successfully."
"Damage Report Status ––– CV-5 Yorktown ––– Heavy Damage"
"Though her condition is stable, her rigging was heavily damaged, necessitating her to be transferred from the front lines for long-term medical care."
"–––In addition, the phenomenon of 'Microlayer' particulate matter adhesion to her rigging was confirmed."
Anyway, what's important is that we all made it back in one piece.
At least we retrieved Yorktown safely, though I have no idea what this "Microlayer" thing is...
After all, I was so focused on trying to stop the Sirens that I couldn't worry about other things.
TB, sweetie, can you give me the details on what's going on with the Sakura Empire?

scripts.say: "The fleet responsible for chasing down the Siren stragglers detected signals from a Sakura Empire ship to the west."
"The aforementioned ship rushed to the source of the signal to investigate."
That aforementioned ship is yours truly, Sister Sara!
"Carrier-based reconnaissance revealed a large amount of Siren wreckage in the western sector."
"This suggested that a battle had broken out between the Sirens and another large fleet."
"Because the Eagle Union had only deployed ships to the eastern sectors, we can conclude that the combatants were–––"
"The Sakura Fleet."
I remember seeing Akagi, Kaga, Souryuu, and... yeah, even Hiryuu. Everyone looked like they had been through hell.
Even if I wanted to help, I was simply too far away... Besides, given how tricky things are with the Crimson Axis...
"In addition to the Sakura Empire fleet, another Siren command unit was observed nearby."
"The humanoid command unit was not observed attacking the Sakura Empire fleet."
"Finally, considering the damage inflicted upon the Sakura Empire fleet, we can conclude that the command unit did not need to participate in combat to achieve its desired results."
That's why I tried to send a fleet after it as quickly as possible!
I even had my planes fly up higher to get a better grasp of the whole situation.
But in the end, I couldn't figure out what the Siren was up to...
"Regarding the special phenomenon..."
"A shockwave with an observable reddish-black 'color' appeared around CV Akagi."
"In addition to repelling the humanoid Siren, almost all mass-produced ships in range of the shockwave were destroyed."
"However, the other ships of the Sakura Empire were not visibly affected by the effects of this shockwave."
"Based upon the extent of the damage inflicted to these carriers, this attack was unlikely to have been carried out using any weapons we currently know of."
I seem to remember... seeing someone else there for a brief moment as well...
But who was it...?
I could've sworn I've seen her at some point...
But when...?
Who was it...?
Playback error, missing file path.
Ending playback.
♪ The winter has passed, the spring has come, and life begins new ♪
♪ From the gods get we our blessings, and this lovely world does too ♪
A village sits on a grass plain. A bard's singing can be heard from down the road.
♪ 'Tis time to shake the cobwebs, to go where one never has ♪
♪ Oh, here's a slice of Paradise; a splendid town to pass♪
You hear that? Someone's singing...
A traveling bard... We've never had one of those come to the village before.
Heehee! What a nice voice she has!
Yes, I think she's literally singing the praises of our village.
Ms. Bard! Thank you for the verses!
You should come sing in our tavern, too! Should I show you the way?
Ah, Javelin... I mean, my fair lady, you are too kind.
However, I am simply passing through this place. I must politely reject your offer.
For you see...
♪ The darkness is upon us ♪
♪ O villagers kind and friendly, I imploreth ye to flee ♪
♪ My flute's sound shall lead ye, to a great sanctuary ♪
Uh... "The darkness"?
It'll be several hours before the sun sets.
Ah... Of course, your village is isolated from the rest of the world.
I assume you've not heard the news about the Demon King.
The Demon King? I have a book about her at home.
I speaketh not of the Demon King of fables and fairy tales.
Hmm... I suppose this is a reason to stay the night.
Your village seemeth to need the services of a bard.
Where be your tavern?
Right over here! Follow me!
The next day, by the village's water well...
♪ O ladies, come hither; I ask only for thy ears ♪
♪ Across forests and mountains, lies a castle far from here ♪
♪ Turn your gazes northward, it shall be worth the hassle ♪
♪ Among the mountains yonder, there sits a mighty castle ♪
♪ Though so pretty and so fancy, its decor is blood and flames ♪
♪ Houses a despot with bloodlust; 'tis the Demon King's domain ♪
♪ Hers is a heart like stone, and cold just as the ice ♪
♪ And where that one travels follows a wake of demise ♪
♪ And as the army of darkness has now begun to move ♪
♪ It's best for you to flee now, for staying shall be your doom ♪
The Demon King Army is on the move...
That reminds me... Some merchants passing by have said they were attacked by monsters.
But don't worry! We already took care of all the monsters near the village!
So you aren't only villagers, you're also guardians of the lanes of trade. I applaud you.
Heehee... "Guardians" might be a strong word.
Regardless, a few stray monsters can ill compare to the might of the Demon King Army.
Even the army of humanity is buckling under its offensive.
In fact, they have already decided to abandon the area surrounding the Endless Woods.
And where is the Endless Forest, exactly?
...Over yonder. 'Tis the great forest that stretches on far past the village.
Oh, I thought it was called the Forest of Origin. I never knew it was known as the Endless Woods as well.
"Forest of Origin"? That's the local name for it?
Yup. Always has been.
It has a nice ring to it. I shall call it that as well.
The bard thinks to herself for a moment, then resumes her singing.
♪ O people of this village, by the Forest of Origin ♪
♪ Though the times may be dire, to despair do not give in ♪
♪ To the south there is hope, a star amidst the darkness ♪
♪ A wall to reach the heavens, its guardians art bless'd ♪
♪ Constructed by decree it is, its finish drawing near ♪
♪ Twelve goddesses' blessings, 'pon a lake fine and clear ♪
♪ A vampire founded Ballad, its cornerstone she laid ♪
♪ The guardian dragon soars, its scales glow like jade ♪
♪ Blessed be our kingdom, and to you I say... ♪
♪ O people of this village, by the Forest of Origin ♪
♪ Come with me southward, and your tale we shall spin ♪
You're... asking us to come with you, is that it?
Aye. 'Tis a shame your gorgeous village will fall, but you mustn't fall with it.
As a humble bard on the lowest rung of society, inviting you to the land of hope is the most I can do.
You mentioned guardians. That's what they call the kingdom's protectors.
Our records mention them secretly colluding with the Demon King. Is that true?
Your village has records of such treachery?
Hmm. This will take some time to go through.
I guess you can stay another night.
Yeah! We'll keep you and the rest of the village safe from monsters!
Very well. Then another night I shall stay.
The next day, under a tree by the river...
♪ Come closer here my ladies, and listen to my song ♪
♪ I've an ancient tale to tell, a past that's so far gone ♪
♪ Of when this land was forged, and gods were only four ♪
♪ Four spires were there then, protecting people ever more ♪
♪ And the gods they were of wisdom, joy, and even war ♪
♪ Then there was the fourth god, its name is known no more ♪
♪ The lands were all in harmony, but meant to last 'twas not ♪
♪ In then came the new gods, when the old began to rot ♪
♪ Oh, betrayed felt the wisdom god, the heretics it cursed ♪
♪ The god of joy was furious, its bubble had been burst ♪
♪ The last two gods were out of words, for blood was all they cared ♪
♪ Together they all swore revenge, with demons did they pair ♪
♪ To those who had forsaken them swore to bring despair ♪
So when the new gods flourished, faith was lost in the old ones. Out of spite, they joined forces with the Demon King. Am I correct?
That you are.
I have a question...
What was the name of the last old god?
Nobody knows. I am but a vessel for the muse, not an expert on the war between gods.
I've told you all that I know. Now, shall we set off?
First, I wanna know about those four spires.
Ah, the four spires. It's a long story to tell, though...
So just stay another night then.
Just one more night! Please! We'll pack our stuff in the meantime!
Yes. We'll set off tomorrow, I promise.
So be it. One more night, then we shall be off.
The next day, by the village's entry gate...
♪ Listen now, miladies, before you start your quest ♪
♪ Spires there were four, to north, east, south, and west ♪
♪ Gone are they all now, like tears amidst the rain ♪
♪ First we have the southly one, its guardian chased out ♪
♪ Second is the western one, 'tis swimming with the trouts ♪
♪ Third there is the eastern one, of Ballad became its stones ♪
♪ Lastly there's the northern one, its fate remains unknown ♪
♪ Appeared they did and went they did, all signs of them are gone ♪
♪ The witch inside the tower, a note to finish on ♪
♪ If one thing can be said of her, she is all mankind's friend ♪
♪ And so... it... goes ♪
There you have it. 'Twas the full tale of the spires.
Now, if I may ask... What are you all wearing?
I'm geared up to kill the Demon King.
We're gonna take down the big bad...
If there's no more Demon King, we won't need to flee our village!
Exactly! And we can help people along the way as our skills improve.
Well... I suppose you have a point.
But I must warn you – facing the Demon King means risking your life.
Besides, even if you are successful, another Demon King will be born one day.
History has proven that this, if nothing else, will always be true.
Not if we take her down for good.
My fists will put an end to this ceaseless cycle.
An admirable spirit. I sincerely wish you luck.
Then, one last thing...
The bard pauses to think for a moment, then resumes her song.
♪ The Demon King's great treasure, of it you must beware ♪
♪ There's thorns beneath its petals, their sting without compare ♪
♪ Do not take it lightly, or it shall be your end ♪
Thanks, bard! We'll keep that in mind!
One last thing. Take this flute with you.
Are you sure? But being a bard, don't you need it more than we do?
Don't worry about me. I have another one.
I know it will come in handy on your adventure.
Well, if you insist! Thank you so much!
Oh, right, you never told us – what's your name?
My... name?
I do not know.
I suppose you may remember me as the bard searching for her own name.
Now, I must bid you farewell...
Heroes to-be.

♪ From the gods get we our blessings, and this lovely world does too ♪

♪ And while it creeps upon us, adventures start anew ♪
♪ Today a hero rises, fight evil they shall do ♪
♪ The world now needs a champion, perhaps... it's... you ♪

scripts.say: Scapa Flow - Ceremony Venue
Whew... Everything is finally in place. It took a lot of work, but I did it!
Great work. Although I'm afraid this chair is in the wrong place, and the banner behind the podium is a little misaligned.
Don't sweat the small stuff! Nobody will notice!
I'll have someone else take care of it. You can head to the dessert room and start on that next.
Awww... Just when I thought I could catch a break...
There you are, Suffolk.
Why are you in here and not outside, welcoming the guests as Belfast asked you to?
Oh right, that's what I was supposed to do! I'll be right there!
Oh, my apologies. I found Suffolk staring at the clouds outside, so I decided to ask her to set up things around here.
That explains that, then. Speaking of which, are you finished in here?
Not yet – it's quite a lot bigger than I anticipated. But worry not, I'll finish on schedule!
That's what I like to hear. If you'll excuse me, I have to get back to my station.
We have some very important guests tonight. We cannot slack on security.
Scapa Flow - Pier
Incredible. This place has already recovered so well after all the damage the Sirens did in that battle...
You can thank the manjuu construction corps for that. Those little guys are rather capable.
Yes, but we should be ashamed that a critical part of our naval infrastructure has come under attack so many times!
We must defend it to the last woman henceforth and never let such a thing happen again.
Yes, and we shall do just that.
For now, just settle down. Scapa Flow is back in business, and that's what we're here to celebrate.
Brighten up, Renown. Hood's going to be in attendance, and you wouldn't want to disgrace the Royal Knights by facing her with a frown, would you?
You're right. I must conduct myself properly on this occasion for Her Majesty's and Lady Hood's sake!
There you go! That's more like the Renown I know.
All right, enough frivolities. Look sharp and let's head for the ceremony venue.
...Incidentally, where even is it?
No idea. Belfast said someone would come get us, but I don't see anyone here.
P-pardon my tardiness!
I'll show you to the venue. Follow me, please.
Scapa Flow - Ceremony Venue
A cannon salute and fireworks were set off at the open-air venue to commemorate the occasion.
Friedrich's plan had succeeded, resulting in the elimination of a key Siren. However, Scapa Flow sustained significant damage in the battle.
The Royal Navy and Eagle Union attributed this damage to the Sirens in their formal report to Naval HQ.
And so, this ceremony serves two purposes – to keep up appearances, and to celebrate this great leap forward.
Gee, granny Hood's awfully late.
As the curtain rose on the opening ceremony, Hood – the guest of honor – was nowhere to be seen.
Wonder if something came up that she has to tend to...
Lady Hood is punctual and a lady of her word. She wouldn't miss this event for the world.
She's not one to keep Naval HQ representatives waiting either, but she IS late...
I can't imagine she's engaging Sirens either. They'd have to be mad to attack when practically our whole navy is here.
Maybe the Royal Maids know what's up?
They aren't acting out of the ordinary, so I don't believe so... I'll have a look around the area. You stay here, Repulse.
Just as Renown rose from her seat to do some sleuthing, an alarm went off.
BWEEEEE! BWEEEEE!
What's that?! The air raid siren?!
How?! They couldn't possibly have slipped through our anti-air patrols!
Panic broke out across the venue as the warning alarm kept blaring.
Dear guests, please calm down. We assure you everything is fine.
This venue is under the protection of the Royal Navy's finest shipgirls. Any Siren aircraft headed this way will be shot down before they reach the harbour.
However, as a precautionary measure, please follow our staff to the on-site bunker.
I don't understand... The alarm shouldn't sound if our fleets can eliminate the planes well before they get near us...
Belfast, me and Repulse shall sortie as well. Kindly tell us where the enemy is!
Of course. Our patrols are currently spread out over a wide perimeter beyond the bay.
Please join up with King George's support fleet. They shall be setting sail to assist the patrols shortly.
As for the rest of the ceremony... I'm afraid to say it needs to be cancelled.

<size=45>2 Behind Closed Doors</size>

scripts.say: Scapa Flow - Harbor Facility
Deep inside a building within the harbor was a room fit for a royal, were it not for the many medical devices and cables littering it.
At the very center of the ornate room lay the patient under care. She sat upright to speak to the shipgirl by her side.
I've said it before, but this is excessive, Your Majesty.
My injuries from that battle have long since healed. You needn't go out of your way to tend to me.
I'll miss the ceremony altogether if I don't hurry. I'd hate to tarnish your honour like that.
Forget about the ceremony. It's already been cancelled.
We'll just blame it on the Sirens seeking reckless vengeance for us taking out one of their top-ranking units.
But... Your Majesty...
Very well. I'll do as you say and rest a while longer.
I apologise for my sickliness. As I said, I've made a full recovery, so this must be a simple bout of fatigue.
It doesn't warrant you personally tending to me, Your Majesty, especially not if you risk raising Naval HQ's suspicions in doing so.
That's enough, Hood. You need to rest, not worry about appearances.
But a lady must. I'd poured so much effort into my speech for the ceremony, too...
I was opposed to you delivering that speech from the very start.
Even if it's the greatest of our time and perfectly reframes the events of the battle to suit our narrative, I will not let you risk your health for it.
Please, I've rested enough to at least–
No, you've not. You've pushed yourself too far as it is.
Listen. We got data from the Commander and the Iron Blood, and what it revealed is quite bad. You've not fully recovered. Far from it, your health is deteriorating.
Dear god. It seems the injuries Bismarck inflicted using that Black Cube run far deeper than any of us realised.
It's no wonder you passed out and had to be brought in here.
Hood... I know you were looking forward to this day, but you must put your health before the Royal Navy's image.
What I just told you is strictly confidential. Naval HQ must never hear a word of it!
Of course. My lips are sealed.
That is terrible news... Your Majesty, George, please forgive me.
My failure has sullied the glory of the Royal Navy.
It's all right. Remember, Bismarck vanished completely, then suddenly returned one day. You doing the same is not out of the question.
Excuse me, but I need to see to our Siren coverup now. Take care and rest up, Hood.
I will, and thank you. Be safe.
...Your Majesty, based on what you just said... There is no healing my wounds, is there? The Royal Navy lacks the cure Bismarck had.
If I'm living on borrowed time, then I'm willing to give what little I've left... for the glory of the Royal Navy...
What? What do you mean?!
The queen demanded an explanation, but all she got was silence.
Hood...

scripts.say: Scapa Flow - Harbor Facility
Did Hood's inspection reveal anything?
Yes, Your Majesty. As you surmised, there's indeed something left within the wounds she suffered. Whatever it is, it's getting progressively worse.
Then it won't be long before she'll be confined to her sickbed for the rest of her days.
All the samples and information we've received from Bismarck, Algérie, and so many others have been insufficient to develop a permanent cure...
Perhaps different hulls respond differently and there is no universal, permanent cure. But then what options do we have left to pursue?
Hood never used the power of the Black Cube, so why would a normal injury cause...
Your Majesty, we could try asking Bismarck to examine Hood directly.
No bloody way. Naval HQ and the Sirens would catch on to us instantly.
But procuring a Black Cube of our own is beyond the scope of what the Royal Navy can do...
I'm aware of that, but we cannot continue relying on others for help.
Naval HQ knows what the Iron Blood did during that battle, and they've taken measures to prevent anything like that from happening again.
It would be pure recklessness to collude with other factions right now.
Friedrich no doubt anticipated this, and that's why she chose to bow out at such a convenient time.
The most anyone can do for us at the moment is share information. Everything beyond that is up to us and us alone.
We know the Sirens are never going to deliver us a Black Cube on a silver platter.
Therefore, we must look beyond the Black Cube and another approach.
We already have the means to do so. The Iron Blood's gateway is now under our control.
You didn't think I agreed to aid Friedrich just to sink some Sirens, did you?
Ah, of course! The question is, how will it help us find a cure for Hood?
...Oh, I get it now! It's our door into the Sirens' home territory!
And if we're able to find information that can explain her sickness, there'll be no need to obtain something as hazardous as a Black Cube!
With some luck, we might even be able to learn more about the Ashes or the META.
Correct. We could skip that entire step if we had a META ally to ask questions to, like the Iron Blood, but alas...
No matter. If it must be done, so it shall.
Let me add that finding a cure for Hood is our top priority here. Recruiting new allies comes after that.
Now, let's talk about the Mirror Sea – or rather, "Camelot." How is it looking?
The singularity remains stable and is anchored to the Mirror Sea that we've designated as Camelot.
How long would it take to investigate Camelot and the areas linked to it?
Erm... Somewhere between six months and a year.
Hood doesn't have that kind of time. Why will it take so long?
It's due to the number of Sirens in the area. Even "abandoned" Siren facilities are home to countless stragglers.
Sending in mass-produced ships isn't an option, I'm afraid. It would require a tremendous amount of energy to enlarge the gateway.
Our best option currently is sending in an expedition team mainly consisting of Your Majesty's palace guard.
It will be a dangerous task, and pursuing both objectives will already stretch our resources thin.
Hood would never tolerate others being put in danger for her sake...
Can we not simply send in more expedition teams?
I'm afraid not. The logistics of supplying and supporting even just one expedition team takes a huge number of people.
You're right... It's too dangerous to send in several teams if they're all underprepared, and we cannot afford to lose Camelot.
But we cannot afford to lose Hood either!
Time is of the essence... There must be another way...

scripts.say: Scapa Flow - Harbor Facility
Not far from the ceremony venue, there was a newly constructed building. A battleship by the name of Monarch was wandering alone through its corridors.
Strolling through a place without a soul in sight is strangely relaxing.
Seems they're going to cancel the ceremony due to a Siren air raid... What a shame.
I alone could have disposed of their aircraft, yet they send me here, far away from any action.
George, York, Wales, and I all swore an oath to fight for Royal Navy... So why am I not allowed to fight?
She passed by a door and heard voices coming from inside.
...It's no wonder you passed out and had to be carried in here...
...There is no healing my wounds, is there? The Royal Navy lacks the cure Bismarck had...
Is that... Hood?
Though the voices on the other side were muffled, Monarch could still easily make sense of their conversation.
It became clear that the reason Hood was absent during the ceremony was that she was very sick, and there was no cure for her illness.
Good Lord... What happened to you, Hood?
She had seen Hood many times on the Royal Islands. It came as a shock that the very symbol of the Royal Navy's glory was mortally ill.
You meant to deliver a speech today, but couldn't... What's more, the Siren air raid is only a facade...
This raises the question... Why is Her Highness keeping this a secret?
The conversation went on.
...Sending in mass-produced ships isn't an option, I'm afraid...
...Our best option currently is sending in an expedition team mainly consisting of Your Majesty's palace guard...
...Pursuing both objectives will already stretch our resources thin...
...The logistics of supplying and supporting even just one expedition team takes a huge number of people...
...We cannot afford to lose Camelot...
Camelot... I assume that's what they call the Mirror Sea beyond the gateway.
The place to where they must go and find a Black Cube, or information leading to one, or else Hood will never wake again...
I can understand why Her Majesty is at a loss. Those Cubes have shown to be immensely dangerous. It's wise of her to want to minimise contact with them.
Hmph... Then I shall be the answer to her prayers.
I'll gladly put my very life on the line if it means proving to all the world that I, Monarch, am excellence itself.
I shall undertake this mission, bring the Royal Navy glory, and aid Hood in her hour of need.
Monarch left the scene with a resolve of steel in her heart.

scripts.say: Status report: Recording equipment activated.
Commander, please provide your feedback on the fidelity of the replication environment after the conclusion of the 35th algorithm iteration.
"Everything is almost lifelike, from my desk, to the bookshelves, curtains, carpets, and couch. Could almost fool me into thinking I'm back at the port."
"Considering how the first iteration could barely get the geometric shapes right, this tech's improving at a remarkable rate."
"Can you tell me how precisely this iteration replicated the environment?"
Query received. Your feedback has been recorded.
Just as in the 34th iteration, only 59.43% of your memory was able to be analyzed.
However, the adjusted algorithm now incorporates visual and field data of your office in addition to the imagery from your memory.
The Sea of Stars – code name for a confidential Eagle Union research facility.
Here, experiments were underway to "manifest" human imagination into reality.
In short, this environment cannot be replicated from your own imagination or reconstructed data alone. It must have both.

options.content: "I'll try imagining it more vividly this time."

scripts.say: Orders received. Unlocking mental stabilization framework.
Commander, please imagine yourself at work in your office. Let it overlap with the replicated environment around you.
The prevailing view of Wisdom Cubes, the very core of the shipgirls' existence, is that they can give form to the thoughts and feelings of humans.
However, the exact nature of this process is not well understood. Research into this matter is shrouded in mystery, and almost always kept strictly confidential.
I was quite surprised when TB invited me to be a part of this experiment. Apparently, my resonance with Wisdom Cubes made me an ideal candidate.
After many rounds of attempting to recreate my office from my memory, I was even able to casually "manifest" the unread reports sitting on my desk.
Replication results confirmed. Analyzing data.
"Did you get any more usable data out of this iteration?"
Analysis indicates that the replicated report contains information from the newspaper you read yesterday. Unfortunately, 40.57% of the data remains unreadable.
We will be unable to draw conclusions on the cause of this phenomenon until the next stage of our research.
Despite these occasional roadblocks, knowing that the research was progressing made me feel better.
I'm reminded of when Memphis first described these experiments to me–
Ahem... You could kind of compare it to lucid dreaming, I guess.
First, it reads your brainwaves and analyzes what you're imagining in the form of data. Then, it feeds it back to you in a kind of lucid dream.
That's what this device, the Reality Lens, is meant to do. Actually, that's the point of all of this research.
That doesn't mean it can read ALL of your brain waves, though. It's limited to what you're consciously envisioning.
It would make a whole bunch of garbled noise if it reflected everything that came to mind. Plus, it'd be awful if you thought of something dirty or traumatizing and it popped right out into reality.
So TB has set up a filter to block anything that might cause stress or make you go insane if you see it.
I know I said all that, but don't stress about it! These experiments are just meant to optimize the Reality Lens algorithm, so it's all good as long as you just follow her instructions.
Don't just assume she can block everything, though. Umm... Basically, just be careful, and don't focus on anything unrelated to the experiment.
All of these experiments are vital to the progress of our operation, after all.
Phew... That about explains it, I think. We're counting on you, Commander.
Question: For what purpose have you replicated the shipgirl Memphis?
"Whoops. There I go, letting my mind wander and imagining things into existence."
I'll have to practice using the Reality Lens a lot more before the next stage of research.

scripts.say: Sea of Stars Headquarters - Provisional Office, Sector B-20 "Pyxis Nautica"
On top of the desk is a report from the Research Department.
Not too far away, Memphis is explaining the contents of that very report.
"...The mental states of the PR blueprint ships should gradually mature and stabilize over time after a period of interacting with the Commander."
"However, the peculiarities within the blueprint ships' hulls make this process non-linear, with some cases in which this relationship is not very evident at all."

"For example, some aspects of Anchorage's personality cannot be explained through psychological analysis. Some of the information elements that compose her hull display some irregular discrete patterns."

"Such phenomena have been observed in other blueprint shipgirls, but typically, contact with the Commander combined with the passage of time will typically work in tandem to reinforce the hull, eliminating these irregularities."
"Analysis of these information elements will be vital in order to understand her identity and understanding of others."
Sorry for all the big words, but basically, that's their view of it.
Umm, to put it more simply...
The reason why Anchorage calls you "Teacher" might have something to do with the peculiarities of her hull. We don't know if she even perceives you to be her "Commander."
From what we've observed in the past, when blueprint ships are first brought into being, a large amount of observable but undecipherable information blocks appear in their hulls.
One of the Sea of Stars' research objectives was to analyze the contents of these information blocks, but they quickly merge and reorganize as their minds stabilize.
But, Anchorage seems to be different. Despite having "stabilized," she still exhibits these anomalies.
What exactly are these anomalies... and why are they unique to Anchorage?
The Research Department doesn't seem to think so. We see all kinds of unexplainable things on the bleeding edge of scientific research.
As for Anchorage specifically, everyone at the Sea of Stars has been monitoring her closely.
I checked in on her on my way here, and nothing seemed off about her. She looked like she was doing just fine.
Honestly, I don't think that girl has any idea what this place is or what we're worried about.
There's no reason to be. She's doing perfectly fine.
Everyone at the Sea of Stars has been monitoring her closely.
I checked in on her on my way here, and nothing seemed off about her. She looked like she was doing just fine.
"Given what happened with Hood, I can only hope there's nothing wrong with Anchorage."
She's fine. Honestly, I don't think that girl has any idea what this place is or what we're worried about.
"You're probably right. I didn't notice anything wrong with her at all before."
The Sea of Stars has equipment, TB, and plenty of people who can help. I had to admit, this was the best chance we were going to get to study these anomalies.
The information we stand to learn from this experiment could potentially bring benefit to the entire world.
"But, how do we approach this problem?"
I thought about the many experiments I'd seen here in the Sea of Stars and compared them to our current problem.
"...I have an idea."

options.content: "TB, what's the status of the Reality Lens project?"

scripts.say: Query received. Retrieving status information regarding the Reality Lens.
"With the power of Wisdom Cube technology, the Reality Lens can materialize the images of people in a form similar to lucid dreams."
"If we can focus all of her scattered discrete information elements into a single point, we might be able to work with that."
"But there's one problem. We don't know if we can even use the Reality Lens on shipgirls, do we?"
"It would defeat the point entirely if I dragged Anchorage into a dangerous situation through this."
Proposal: Commander, it is possible for you to use the Reality Lens and connect to Anchorage's hull.
However, this process is untested due to complications in the research phase. Adjustments to the algorithm will be necessary before it can be used in the Sea of Stars prototype.
Wait, Commander. Are you serious?
"I don't see the problem. Why the concerned look?"
TB just said the process is untested, right? This is obviously a bad idea!
Sure, it's our fault for not being able to make serious progress, even if we had to wait for you to utilize your Wisdom Cube resonance.
But aren't we clearly jumping the gun here? I mean, take it from someone who knows what she's talking about.
The algorithm itself has seen a lot of progress, but I think it's too early to try connecting it to a shipgirl's hull.
"Now that you mention it..."
"You're right. If the Reality Lens could have helped analyze her, then it would've been proposed in the report."
"But we don't have any other ideas, and we don't have all the time in the world."
"I think our only course of action is to devote all of the Sea of Stars' resources to improving the experiment's algorithm. Make it the top priority."
"Leave budgetary concerns to me. I'll call some people who can help with that."
"Do whatever you can to get the Reality Lens to the next stage of research."
If you're willing to go that far, Commander, I have no objections.
But listen. With or without your help, Wisdom Cube research is gonna take time.
You have to be the one to use it, too, so doesn't matter how early it's ready if you're not there to operate the Reality Lens.
I know you're a busy person, but be ready to clear your schedule, okay?
"Of course. That's a small price for helping a friend."
"Speaking of, we ought to go check up on Anchorage once work clears up a bit."
Phew... Okay, next report. This one's about the pseudo-environment simulation project...

scripts.say: After fifty iterations of the algorithm, we finally managed to stabilize the Reality Lens.
It was about time for the next stage of our research: identifying the anomalous information elements in Anchorage's hull.
Commander... Um, are you sure about this?
Testing would be one thing, but we'll be connecting the Reality Lens to a shipgirl's cognition without a test run.
And once the connection starts, your consciousness will be stuck inside a "dream" until it's over...
The Sea of Stars' technology may be advanced, but there are no guarantees that we won't run into any accidents...
Worse, we don't know what might happen when you interact with Anchorage's "anomalies."
Frankly, I can't even promise that our emergency protocols are enough to handle the worst-case scenarios...
Speaking from a professional's perspective, I'm still opposed to you doing this.
Same here. Can't we at least wait until we have a bit more data on how this thing works?
"I understand everyone's concerns."
"We could give the algorithm more time to be perfected, sure, but that doesn't mean waiting will solve all of our problems."
"I know by now the risks involved in using the Reality Lens."
"And I also know that these risks can't be eliminated that easily."
"It could take years before we feel 'ready.' I say we do it now instead of waiting."
"Do you remember Bismarck's Cube? We don't know what effects hull anomalies might have on a shipgirl, but we do know how serious they can be.
"And most of all, I can't spend my whole life waiting here in the Sea of Stars."
Think so? Well, you're the boss. I'll start final checks on the Reality Lens now.
I'll call Helena and the others, too. We also have final checks we should perform on our backup plan.
Even if things take a turn for the worse, I swear that we will protect you and Anchorage, Commander!
"I couldn't ask for more reliable allies."

scripts.say: My vision was blanketed in darkness. Not a sound reaches my ears.
Rather than being inside that facility, I felt like I had been sucked into a black hole.
This was perfectly consistent with the operation of the Reality Lens, but given the magnitude of my job, I couldn't help but to tense up.
Commander, I've noticed that your heart rate is rising. Do you require medical attention?
My thoughts had already started influencing my physiology. The Reality Lens technology is not to be taken lightly...
So, I took a deep breath and tried to relax.
Heart rate stabilization confirmed.
Now summarizing the details of the experiment: After connecting to Anchorage's hull, you will contact her through the simulated environment.
After that, you are to follow my guidance carefully.
Throughout the operation, I will monitor you and remain in constant communication in order to keep you and Anchorage safe.
"I authorize the activation of the Reality Lens."
Orders received. Activating Reality Lens.
The large facility rumbled to life, and an indescribable lightness began to pervade my body.
The sensation of simultaneous boundlessness and helplessness was akin to being thrown into outer space without a ship.
But before loneliness and a sense of loneliness could creep into my mind, the space I perceived around me rapidly condensed, turning from vast and infinite into a single defined space.
As my consciousness refocused as well, I opened my eyes–
And what I saw was a classroom, brightly lit by the setting sun.
I found myself standing at the podium, a great number of desks and chairs neatly arranged in front of me.
In the closest seat to the podium was a girl, her head tucked in her arms as she napped face-down on the desk.
Eagle Union blueprint shipgirl Anchorage was here; I didn't even have to visualize her.
Connection complete. Please wait while the verification sequence is executed.
Connection status normal... Resource domain secure... Deviations minor.
Beginning connection test. Commander, are my transmissions coming through clearly?
"I hear you loud and clear. Seems like everything's working fine so far."
Feedback received, Commander. Connection status normal. Algorithm iteration complete.
Requesting authorization to set Plan A as the recommended course of action.
Orders received. Commander, please awaken Anchorage. Through conversation, try to find the anomaly in her simulated environment.
In the meantime, I will both use the information received from her hull connection to stabilize the environment and analyze any information yielded by your conversation.
"Right. I'll stick to the plan."
Orders confirmed. Picture books for you to read to Anchorage have been created.
A few books I'd visualized in a previous experiment fell onto the podium.
So I picked one up and slowly approached Anchorage.
Teacher...?
*yaaaawn*... Teacher! Anchorage has been waiting for you!
Teacher, Anchorage is so happy you came!
"How about we read another fairy tale?"
Fairy tales... Hooray!
They're so fun, so happy... So dreamy... Anchorage loves fairy tales!
Books are hard... Too hard for Anchorage.
So she loves fairy tales, but she can't read them herself.
"Okay, let's read this one. 'The Adventure of Fairy Tale Forest.'"
"Once upon a time, there was a bunny named the Grey Rabbit who lived in a forest..."
"...And they all lived happily ever after."
That last part was great! Anchorage loves this one!
Teacher, you're so cool for reading stories to me!
Anchorage brought you... a present!
With a big smile, Anchorage pulled out her desk's drawer and took out a crayon drawing.
Possibly a result of the Reality Lens's imprecision, I couldn't recognize what she'd drawn. But there were a few blobs that seemed to be human-like.
Yet for some reason, some incomprehensible panic overtook me the instant I saw it.
Anchorage drew this picture for you, Teacher!
Do you... like it...?
Warning: Large quantities of unknown data observed.
Warning: Data analysis function overloaded.
Warning: Algorithm efficiency degraded.
Connection status unstable.
Confirmed overflow of unknown data. Sustainability of simulated environment greatly degraded.
Proposal: Stop the experiment at once.
"Try to withstand it a little longer!"

options.content: "Anchorage, who are the people in this drawing?"

scripts.say: Anchorage drew you, Teacher. And your... Friends? People you know...?
*yawn*... Mm... Anchorage is so sleepyyy...
Teacher... Anchorage has stuff to tell you... in the dream world...
Suddenly, Anchorage and the classroom were overwhelmed by a dazzling light.
My field of vision was dyed pure white.

sequence:
Causality Transposition

<size=45>5 The Recording</size>

scripts.say: "Anchorage? TB...?"
"No dice, huh?"
"I can still move. The Reality Lens must still be working."
I figured everything had gone white because of the data overload from before, making it impossible to construct the simulation.
"Guess I'll just look around."
Suddenly, I spotted a door standing in the distance.
Or... Was it standing? Since everything was white, it was hard to tell whether it was standing on the ground or floating.
But then, I noticed Anchorage next to the door.
Teacher... You're here!
"Where are we?"
This is Anchorage's... Or, the Reality Lens's... dream? Let's go!
Teacher, Anchorage wants to tell you a good story!
"A dream? And you say it's yours or the Reality Lens'?"
"Is that somehow different from the classroom we were just in?"
"And what does it mean for the Reality Lens to dream, anyway...?"
Yep! It's a really good story, Teacher!
Anchorage pointed to the door and urged me to go in.
Anchorage can't...!
It's Anchorage's first time... so Anchorage wants you to do it, Teacher!
"I guess I have no choice."
I steeled my resolve and headed through the door.
The moment my hand touched it, a voice flowed into my mind.

sequence: <color=black>Well, it looks like you've finally started to piece together the puzzle of the shipgirls' hulls.</color>
<color=black>It only matches my records by less than 1%, but this wavelength has to be yours.</color>
<color=black>The fact that you're playing this recording is absolute proof that it's you.</color>
<color=black>It also means that my very last gamble was successful.</color>
<color=black>I know you. No matter when, where, or who you are...</color>
<color=black>You could never abandon those girls.</color>
<color=black>Making you the final failsafe was the right call.</color>

scripts.say: "What was that voice...?"
In a barely-lit room, I spotted a woman wearing glasses.
Oh, calm down. I'm just a recording. Or, well... More precisely, an AI that can play recordings.
I'll explain everything, so just be patient.
You may be wondering who I am. If referring to my outward appearance alone, I would be known as Anzeel.
But I suggest you call me Recorder.
As for where we are, this is a pseudospace constructed from data.
Specifically, it is a space made from the information found in the gaps of the metanetwork connecting Wisdom Cubes.
But you wouldn't understand much of that, would you? Just consider this a place that can't be found by anyone else.
Hmm... You did find me earlier than I'd expected, though.
"Find you? Earlier than expected...?"
Oh, how should I put this? It might be too soon for the "current" you.
That you've found this place is like a... speedrun? Cheating through glitch abuse, perhaps?
Not that it matters. Anzeel did often say that a bit of randomness isn't always a bad thing.
By the way, did you get here through that Anchorage girl? Don't worry; she's going to be perfectly fine.
The... irregular patterns of her discrete data have just made her a little weird, is all. It's not necessarily a bad thing.
Now, what I can share with you depends on what records Anzeel left behind.
Let's see. The recording I needed to play... Nnngh... Hah!
Oh, that's bad. Ahhh, I've really done it now...
There's just a bunch of fragmented emotional data here. I can't find a single piece of real information worth playing! Teehee☆
So I guess Anzeel created this recorder... just because she wanted to meet you?
No, this bit of sentimental data is far too vague. I don't think she'd do anything that simple...
Could it be that... it was you who wanted to meet Anzeel one last time?
Or was my appearance alone the true record that Anzeel wanted to leave for you?
Like she wanted to say, "remember me – even if you're not you anymore."
I don't know the details. After all... I'm just an AI who plays recordings!
Can't answer that one. It's not in the records.
We might be having a conversation, but in the end, I'm just a fancy AI.
A program that can only follow the instructions given to it.
Wait. Something's coming this way.
Whatever it is, it's been following you for a while now.
"Now that you mention it, I haven't heard anything from TB for a while despite us being connected before."
"Is that because we're in a place that nobody can find?"
Warning: Category V threat detected nearby. Commencing removal of AI and records per security protocol.
Teacher!
Hurry... We need to run!
Bright light blotted out everything once more. When I came to again, Anchorage was reaching out toward me from nearby.
I rushed to take her hand, but before I could, intense dizziness overtook me.
All of my brain cells cried out at once. It felt as if my faltering consciousness was being dragged straight out of my head.
Teacher! This is bad...! Nooo!
And my soul was once again thrown into an empty void.

sequence:
Causality Transposition

<size=45>6 State of Crisis</size>

scripts.say: Sea of Stars Headquarters - Core Area, Sector X
Warning: Unknown data overflow confirmed. Reality Lens will soon exceed mounted memory capacity.
Overload risk high. Temporal regulator efficiency degraded to 80%.
This is insane! It's only been ten minutes since the Commander went in there! What kind of data...
Wait. Is this because you're analyzing the stuff in Anchorage's hull?
It is reasonable to infer that the hull is the source of the unknown data.
Beginning backup plan F: mounting computing resources and additional memory for the Reality Lens.
Proceeding with algorithm...
Helena, it's dangerous for the Commander to stay there. Move some of the unknown data to another Sea of Stars project!
Okay! I'll do it right away...
Completed mounting computing resources and additional memory.
Warning: Unknown data overflow confirmed. Reality Lens will exceed mounted memory capacity in 30 seconds.
Again?! What the heck is going on here?!
This thing could simulate an entire city during the experiments. Is whatever's going on in there even bigger than that...?
Helena, how's the analysis?
It looks bad here, too! It's overwhelming our processing capabilities!
Memphis! We mustn't continue to put the Commander in harm's way!
I know that, okay?!
TB, stop the whole experiment! Cut off the connection to the hull!
The Commander has ordered me to try to withstand it. The experiment will continue until processing reaches its limit.
Temporal regulator efficiency degraded to 25%. The passage of time is now sixty times faster within the Reality Lens.
So you mean... It's only been like a minute out here, but...
In the Commander's mind, it's been an entire hour?
Temporal regulator has failed.
I am no longer able to monitor the Commander's vitals. Attempts to communicate have also failed.
Temporarily halting Sea of Stars projects below priority 3 and reallocating resources to the Reality Lens, per backup plan F.
Based on the current rate of data overflow, this secures approximately 90 seconds of operation.
This is awful! If we don't stop the data, it'll just keep growing!
And the more time passes, the more the Commander's perception of time speeds up. At this rate, the Commander's brain is going to get fried!
...Our only choice is to declare an emergency in the Sea of Stars.
If we allocate every last resource to the Reality Lens, TB should be able to recover the temporal regulator.
Once things recover to the point that we can cut off the connection, we should save them right away!
I guess... that's all we can do, huh? We'll have to use the last resort the Commander and Saratoga left for us.
Objections, Helena?
N-no, ma'am!
TB, take us into crisis mode. Reallocate all resources that aren't devoted to life support and security.
Orders received. Please enter the access code to the tower.
Emergency code 0584. Authorizer: Memphis.
Emergency code 7987. Authorizer: Helena...!
Emergency code 6982. Authorizer: Vestal! Commander, please be safe!
Access code accepted. Confirming operation authority.
Emergency authorization code verified. Activating control program.
Issuing emergency orders. All systems shifting to crisis mode.
Evacuating all personnel in the facility.
Attention. This is the Sea of Stars host, Navigator TB.
Crisis Protocol ECP-15 has begun. The Sea of Stars will now shift into crisis procedures.
In 10 minutes, the core of the facility will be locked down. In 30 minutes, so will the remainder of the facility.
Cancellation window has passed. Crisis procedures can no longer be aborted.
All present within the facility, please move to the designated evacuation area at once.
Repeating. All present within the facility, please move to the designated evacuation area at once.
Well, I guess this is where it really begins...
I'll monitor the Commander. Vestal, you take care of Anchorage. Helena, the temporal regulator is all yours!
We don't have much time. We have to save the Commander and Anchorage!

sequence:
Causality Transposition

<size=45>7 Omnipresent Eye</size>

scripts.say: I had a nightmare.
I could feel myself being watched by a blurry figure.
As soon as I tried to focus my attention on it, it would disappear.
But the moment my concentration lapsed in the slightest, it would reappear.
It just stood there like a ghastly sculpture, not moving, not making a sound.
An alarm...? Did something happen in the Sea of Stars?
No... I'm still dreaming... But it's not the same dream as before.
I tried directing my consciousness around. Whatever it was that had been watching me before is no longer present.
A wave of relief washed over me, as the nightmare's icy grip receded.
Alarms continued to ring in my ears, but it didn't matter anymore...
You're not safe yet, Commander.
Don't fall asleep here. The enemy is coming.
Wake up, Commander. Wake up...
*gasp*... *gasp*…
Thank goodness... You finally woke up, Commander...
You kept tossing and turning with a terrified look on your face... I was just about to call Memphis over...
After last night's experiment, I collapsed into bed and fell right to sleep... But what just happened?
"Helena, what time is it?"
Um, well, the clock says 1616.
"Four in the afternoon?! How long did I stay asleep for?"
Um... That seems unusual to me as well. Based on my subjective sense of time, it should be no later than three or four in the morning.
But, all the clocks in the Sea of Stars seem to say that it, in fact, is 1616.
TB has also informed us that a large, unidentified object is making its way towards us.
"A large object...? I thought the Sea of Stars' location was strictly confidential."
Yes, the entire base has been elevated to red alert.
In half an hour, we'll seal the entrance and cloak the entire facility, but we can't guarantee the safety of everyone inside.
Fortunately, we still have twenty-five more minutes. Commander, let's leave together.
"What about the other girls?"
Everyone around the perimeter has already evacuated. Those deeper inside the facility will evacuate after finishing their necessary work.
"So, what do we do about TB?"
Unfortunately, TB will not be able to leave... because this place is her mainframe...
We're running out of time, Commander. Let's get out of here, okay?
Something's not right... Wasn't I just inside the Reality Lens simulation...?
<Real%+y Le#s ac+%va%&d?? Consciousness merged with ■■■■■■–––>
Royal Islands -  Several days prior
—That concludes our report regarding the Northern Parliament's war efforts. It roughly lines up with the information they released, but I'd like to hear your opinions.

The Northern Parliament demonstrated strength far surpassing our expectations during the previous operation. The fact that they, with such a formidable fighting force, would request our aid... does not bode well.
I thought that capturing the Iceberg Stronghold would suppress Siren activity, but it instead seems to have sent them into a rampage... What an unforeseen disaster...
Hmm... Up until now, the Northern Parliament has done well in containing the Sirens to the Arctic...
Indeed. Should they be defeated, the Sirens would flood outward, threatening not only the Union-held side of the Northern Pacific, but also the Royal Islands.
As if I would allow that!
I agree. In other words, can I take it that the Royal Navy has no objections to supporting the Northern Parliament?

"The Eagle Union will provide relief supplies, and the Royal Navy will form a force consisting of a transport fleet and escort fleet to deliver the supplies to the Northern Parliament." ...Your Majesty, your counsel?
I accept the proposal! By the way, what's going on with the Iron Blood?
Allow Sister Sara to explain! ...According to the intel, the Iron Blood seems to be moving their forces to the Barents Sea, so please be careful when passing through that area!
They're seriously after the Polar route...
Hmph! Bring it on! If that's how they want to do things, we'll be sure to show them some Royal Navy "hospitality!"
Elly~ Are you serious about that...?!
Heh! We've got to teach them a lesson about the folly of trying to mess with the Polar route!
...Ahem. In that case, we'll provide the supplies as agreed upon. One more issue though, regarding the commander's situation...
Yes, if I recall, the commander had plans to stay in the Northern Parliament a bit longer and told you to stay behind to manage the war situation...
Right. I received a message from the Northern Parliament, and they seem to want to extend the commander's stay...
Sigh... What a time to be making such a request.

Of course we're opposed to that! After we deliver the relief supplies, the war situation over there should improve, and there won't be any reason for Commander to stay in that walk-in freezer of a country!
Y'know, actually if they're going to be difficult, why don't we take a fleet from SD City's Naval Headquarters and retrieve Commander ourselves?
Isn't SD City already too tied up dealing with the Sakura Empire to handle something like that?
I have a better idea, so listen up. Why don't we just have our transport fleet escort the commander back to the Eagle Union?
(This is a prime chance to show the commander the leadership of the Royal Navy, and maybe go sightseeing around Europa as well... Come on, Elizabeth, this is your chance!)
(Heheh! You'll have to make preparations too, so that nothing goes wrong on this operation!)
I have no objections.
Yes... I'll be sure to make the proper arrangements.

To summarize Her Majesty's counsel, after delivering the Eagle Union's supplies to the Northern Parliament, the commander will be welcome here in the Royal Islands before being escorted back to the Eagle Union. With that in order, may we work as one to complete this operation!
