The Sirens refer to this phenomenon as an "Intertwined Storm."
In addition, the Sirens possessed a technology that could create a unique protective layer outside our planet by manipulating our stable geomagnetism.
To use an analogy, if the Sakura Empire's Sky Realm Amahara was an attempt to construct a mental barrier, then this Siren technology was an attempt to construct a physical barrier.
We don't yet understand the connection between this technology and the facilities at the poles, or the Singularities created in outer space and the unique protective layer.
Even so, we believe these are monumental discoveries. We hope to put further resources toward thoroughly studying them.
She's right. This is a colossal discovery.
A physical barrier and a mental one... Couldn't you create a shield that perfectly envelops the world if you combined them?
All world factions need to get involved in this. We need to thoroughly research these things.
Yes... This is how it's meant to be.
I let go of my doubts, yield myself to the celebration and joy, and become one with this brighter world.
Commander, the greatest accolade of reuniting the fractured Azur Lane absolutely belongs to you.
It's the mother of all achievements! I could never even have dreamed this day would come!
The Sirens are defeated, and the world is united. Now, we can all start planning our vacation!
A vacation, eh... Where do you wanna go, Commander?
Wherever you go, I'll come with you.
Yeah! What she said, honey!
To think you actually went and did it...
Hats off to you, servant. History will never forget your name.
You are responsible for miracle after miracle. A true legend.
Commander, whilst the war may be over, know that the Royal Navy shall always be your close ally.
May the light forever shine upon you.
What a long day it's been.
We've trudged through many a swamp and suffered many an injury for this day.
Still, our efforts were all repaid. A new era begins here and now.
Heehee. You shine like the light itself up on the stage. I'm almost swooning over here.
This was a spectacular feat, accomplished with the Iris' blessing. Congratulations, Commander.
Now, the last sounds of opposition to the Orthodoxy's reformation have finally dispersed.
I'm honored to have lived in the same era as you, Commander.
With this, the Sakura Empire will return as a member of the Azur Lane and stand under its flag.
I eagerly look forward to cooperating with you, Commander.
Such a simple task this seemed. To one's surprise, attempting it in practice proved far more vexatious.
Even so, it was achieved in the end. I can hence fully dedicate myself to my coming duties.
Hahaha! That I get to see this grand a feat of diplomacy a second time is nothing short of outstanding!
{playername}, whatever the future may have in store for us, I shall be your ally now and always.
I knew you'd be able to do it. Congratulations to you, Comrade Commander.
Well, although the world is at peace again, there is still much work to be done.

In the coming days, I intend to submit a research plan for the Siren facilities located in both of the Poles. They will be something that warrants the cooperation and research of all Azur Lane members.
When that time comes, I trust we will have your help, Comrade Commander.
Heehee. "Those with great capabilities are given greater responsibilities" holds true.
Worry not, Comrade Commander! We will always be there to help you!
That was a perfect speech. My heart shook from how splendid it was.
I wish this grand announcement could've been given in the Sardegna Empire instead, but alas. Heehee. The Orthodoxy is truly blessed.
Ahahaha! We're now members of the Azur Lane once more. Nothing could be more joyous!
I never thought I'd see the day that the alliance became united again. Thank you, Commander.
But of course. The Commander's magnificence is natural, inevitable, and absolute.
Heheh. We can say goodbye to the days of having to explain to whom the Kingdom of Tulipa answers.
And it's all thanks to you, respected Commander and benefactor of our fleet!
All of us have put aside our squabbles and become one under the same banner...
This, to civilization, is what true victory means.
The Dragon Empery eagerly looks forward to the great heights human civilization will reach in the future – and so do I.
The Empery will forever be your ally, Commander.
Whew, yes! The Azur Lane is finally back together! We don't have to debate it anymore!
Commander, Helena – we're all finally free!
I wasn't fully satisfied with our last trip, sooo... how about we take a little vacation before our next mission?
Couldn't agree more!
Commander, if you agree, then it's three to zero, and if you don't, it's still two to one.
The minority has to obey the majority, which means we're going on a looong vacation!

sequence: "The war with the Sirens had ended, as had the meetings to discuss the Azur Lane's reformation."
"The Azur Lane was whole since its moment of inception, and would stay whole forevermore."
"The prestige and connections you've accumulated have made you the undisputed number one of this era."
"You are the holder of countless titles and command an unquestionable status across the world."
"Yet, there is but one title that you use – the Commander of the Azur Lane."
"Even as the world pivoted to peace and development, you never once let your guard down."
"Wherever the front line was, you would always be there."
"Excluding holidays, of course."
"You pushed the Sky Realm Amahara Project forward, constructing a mental barrier around the world."
"You also advanced the Polar Bunker Projects, supplementing the mental barrier with a physical one."
"Thus, this fragile and transient world was bestowed a flawless defense."
"A defense against Antiochus and the METAs alike."
"It was also protected against those even more frightful beings."
"Despite all this, something in the back of your mind nagged at you from time to time."
"You felt like you had forgotten something – like your story should have ended differently."
"But when you looked around you, seeing your companions smiling widely, and the world regaining its life."
"In light of such a sight, you pushed those misgivings back into the depths of your mind."
――"To a Brighter World"

scripts.say: No. Something's not right.
Rather than give in to the celebratory mood, I trust the faint nagging feeling in the back of my mind and leave the venue to find the truth.
How did the Iris Orthodoxy unify? Why were the Azur Lane reformation meetings held?
...The coronation ceremony.
...The Kingdom of God.
...Marco Polo?
Why is the Sea of Stars such an important base? Who is the beating heart of its central system?
...The Galactic Core.
Why did Amahara malfunction? Why was Akagi there?
What's her connection to the Watatsumi? What happened in the anomalous area?
Naraka... The Singularity...
The prison... The X... Helena...
I remember it... Everything.
That's it. This abnormal phenomenon is affecting the whole world. And its source is located in...
Scapa Flow in the Royal Islands.
Even though there's not a single trace left, I know that the Royal Navy had an artificial Singularity here. The Gate of Avalon.
That's where this all began, too.
I went here to attend a commemoration. Of course, that was just an excuse Elizabeth came up with. My real goal was to speak with the META Elizabeth.
Helena sent me here to do that, and...
My god... Is this exactly what she feared would happen?

options.content: Elizabeth META, I need your help.

scripts.say: The surrounding space changes in an instant.
We heard your call loud and clear.
We meet again, servant.
Goodness. The outside world certainly has undergone a drastic change.
So, tell us – how do you like this "brighter world"?
...There's nothing pertaining to the X. Nothing about the Arbiters, Singularities, or METAs either.
At a glance, it is a brighter world...
But upon closer inspection, it's merely a sandbox created by removing all elements from outside the world itself.
Even if you could create such an isolated world within test site beta, it wouldn't hold up.
The winds outside of it would keep raging regardless.
We can blissfully bury our heads in the sand, but for how long?
Wait a second...
Have you been watching me this entire time?!
Forgive us. There was naught that we could do.
We suffered severe wounds from the Day the Stars Faded, and urged Elizabeth not to tell anyone of it.
Naturally, you and Helena META didn't know, either.
Speaking of her, though – frankly, we've always been cautious of her.
She has exhibited a... dangerous level of attachment to you at times.
We fear that if she comes to learn that we have lost the ability to restrain her, she may do something extreme to test site beta.
God knows what goes through her mind... She actually entrusted your well-being wholly to us.
We were craven this time... It almost cost us everything as a result.
When you first visited Avalon, the world appeared perfectly normal – however, we were still in a deep coma at the time.
By the time we'd started slowly recollecting ourselves, this absurd abnormality had already developed.
It wasn't long before test site beta itself was enveloped in a two-tiered barrier, preventing practically all outside interference.
But, when you called our name just now, it finally allowed us an opening to intervene.
Wait... A two-tiered barrier?
Those are real? I thought they were just part of the illusion.
(Hang on... We hadn't even begun researching the physical barrier yet, had we?)
Indeed they are. What you experienced was not a fantasy, but rather a possibility.
With but a single thought, a possibility can transform into reality.
Were that not the case, how do you explain how you couldn't escape this incident on your own, even though many others have done so before?
To be frank, we weren't certain that you'd make the correct choice...
Fortunately, you did. You've proven more outstanding than we could've imagined.
One might even say that you've turned a disaster into a miracle.
A miracle?
Yes. By rejecting this possibility, you've restored the world to its point of divergence.
Despite that, all the experience, knowledge, and information you gained during that time remain inside you.
In other words, you now possess a staggering informational advantage with regard to the foreseeable future.
As for ourselves, we used this surplus of time to heal our injuries. While at it, we also made an important discovery.
Would you like to meet the string-puller responsible for all this? Then come with us.

sequence: To a Brighter World - Addendum

scripts.say: As the light fades, an ocean of twinkling stars comes into view.
It looks a lot like the view of space I'd see when communicating with Helena.
Only with one major difference – there's a stranger floating among the stars.
We meet at last, Commander.
As you can see, I am Tower. The true owner of THE Tower.
Upon seeing this puppet-like girl who seems strangely familiar, an inexplicable sense of deja vu hits me.
(I get it now... That feeling of recognizing yet not remembering someone or something that everyone's told me about.)
I made a bet with Elizabeth META.
I wagered that you wouldn't refuse that brighter world by yourself. I lost.
My end of the deal was to step out from behind the curtains, directly answer your questions, and give you something of a "job-well-done reward."
So, here I am. I'm sure you have many questions on your mind. Let's hear them all.
I'm shocked to learn that you were the mastermind behind all this.
Did Helena tell me to go find Elizabeth META because she wanted to protect me from you?
And was it your fault that I couldn't contact Memphis or any of the other METAs?
I had the impression you were their ally. Why did you do this?
Helena sent you to find Elizabeth because she could predict what I'd do, but that's not all. In fact, she used you to force Elizabeth to get involved in what's to come.
Elizabeth is a key part of her plan, you see.
Sadly for her, Elizabeth proved far less reliable than she'd expected. No doubt she didn't expect my actions to have the effect of patching up holes in her plan either.
It was a blessing in disguise, as you people so like to say.
So you're saying that, as soon as I realized what was up and refused the possibility of this brighter world, your actions worked to our benefit, huh?
What if I hadn't refused it, then?
Then you could've just lived in that world forever. It would've been a happy life, free of worries – the ghosts of bygone days far behind you.
Is a life of peace, calm, and fulfillment not the ideal of so many people? Are you some sort of contrarian?
Is living in a closed-off garden, pretending there is no danger, what you call "a happy life"?
Oh, but you would've been looked after and protected to the very end.
That kind of happiness is not what I want.
Very well. Don't forget the choice you made, then.
Helena said you Arbiters have been busy with a "transboundary experiment." Shouldn't you be doing that instead?
What experiments they run is none of my business.
Huh? Okay, so tell me about it, then.
Hmm. How about no?
That's for the next episode, so to speak. You'll see it soon, so that's something to look forward to.
Fine. Next question. I learned a lot of facts and information while in that brighter world.
Elizabeth said what I learned will give me a huge upper hand in the events of the foreseeable future.
So what I'm wondering is: Are you trying to help me?
In a way, yes, but also no. In the possibility of that brighter world with all external information removed from it, those events are inevitable.
I simply filtered the world. I did not manipulate it.
What about Akagi?
Ah. That one.
Theoretically, you two would've been going on dates and vacations. "Enjoying life" things.
Unfortunately, she was a little too sharp for her own good. I had to adjust her a little.
I believe that was the one and only time I directly intervened in the world.
No need to worry about her. You refused the brighter world, after all. It's gone now – like chalk wiped from the board.
Your attitude is giving me mixed signals.
What did you actually want me to do? Embrace the brighter world, or refuse it?
Answer honestly – WHY did you do this?
I'm not concerned about your goals, I just want to hear your thoughts.
I lost my chinchillas. I was sad.
...Come again?
Heheh. Just a little joke.
After watching from afar for so long, I just had to get onto the stage.
I wanted to see it with my own eyes. I wanted to change it a bit.
That's right – this wasn't originally meant to happen. I could've done nothing and watched from the audience seats.
I could have simply watched as the pile of corpses grew.
Not that I dislike those, mind you.
It's just that I felt disappointed with what a tragedy the "next episode" would've ended with. It would've been boring, that's all.
Oh, and don't ask for my rating for this side episode.
The difference between being a critic and a director has become painfully clear to me now.
And when it comes to directing, it seems I have no talent. This is my last time trying it.
As for you... Once you're back, I suggest you rest for a bit, then prepare to head to the scene of the "next episode."
You keep saying "next episode." What do you mean by that?
You'll know once it starts.
When you get back, keep an eye out for news from the Sea of Stars.
That concludes your job-well-done reward. May we meet again someday.

sequence: To Be Continued

To a Brighter World

<size=45>Act Seven</size>

scripts.say: Finally, the day the world had been waiting for has come.
Each and every chair in the assembly hall is filled today.
This long journey of conference after conference is almost finally at its end.
All the confrontations, all the mutual prodding, all the compromises – this moment spells the end for all of it.
It is not at the Azur Lane headquarters, but here, where the reformation talks first took place, that the curtains historically fall on an era.
The Sirens. Our enigmatic foes that appeared out of nowhere and seized our seas with overwhelming force.
At the start of this unprecedented calamity, we each had our own agendas and fought our own battles.
The result of this was almost too painful to bear.
We lost 90% of our seas. Our technological progress and living standards rapidly regressed. Civilization itself stood at the very brink of collapse.
However, we survived, and we did it by burying old hatchets, uniting our hearts as one, and establishing the multinational military organization that is the Azur Lane.
We shared our resources and technology, and we built fleets that could fight back against the Sirens.
As a result, we seized victory.
After a bloody war that has gone on for decades, "Azur Lane" no longer just refers to a military alliance.
It has become a symbol. A symbol of fracture becoming unification, of despair becoming hope, of humanity overcoming old hardships and stepping into a new future.
The Azur Lane. It was born in the darkest period in human history.
As we dreamed of a hopeful future, we struggled day after day, straddling the line between life and death.
Faced with the Sirens' immense pressure, we all felt hesitant and lost...
At first, maybe it was nothing more than a slight difference of opinion or a conflict of ideas.
But, as time went on, those small cracks quietly connected and spread until they'd grown into an enormous rift that could neither be ignored nor be filled.
It was this moment that the Azur Lane fell apart.
It was a time of chaos.
Our information was limited, our suspicions were intensified, and our ambitions were enlarged. Cleverly, the Sirens schemed to divide us.
Trapped in this dark storm, we all made decisions that were incorrect.
As fortune would have it, though, the little fire lit in our hearts when the Azur Lane was established had not gone out.
None of us gave up. No one turned their back on the flame of hope.
This fire, eventually, thawed the ice of separation, and its light dispelled the long, dark fog.
We all share the same goal. Therefore, we should arrive at the same destination through different paths.
The appearance of the Sirens brought human civilization to a new stage, and the establishment of the Azur Lane set the tone for this new era.
The Crimson Axis, meanwhile, played a resounding and different instrument within this main melody.
Now, however, this instrument has played its last note.
As of today, the Crimson Axis belongs to history.
Let us raise the banner of unity, hold our heads high, and walk proudly into the future.
Two paths have now become one.
A once-fractured alliance has again become whole.
Just because we have achieved victory over the Sirens does not mean that the Azur Lane, built to combat them, has finished serving its purpose.
In fact, it means the opposite. The Azur Lane is going to become an even more important organization.
This time, it was the Sirens that invaded us. We defeated them.
So, then, what happens next?
There is no knowing if the universe beyond our world is safe.
There is only one thing we can do: Unite, stand together, and move forward as one group.
Under the banner of the Azur Lane shall we step into the uncertain future ahead of us.
Lexington and Bismarck's speech comes to an end.
The world is silent. It's waiting for me to speak next.
A bright world unfolds before me. All I need to do is take one step forward.
One step forward onto the stage. As the one who made the alliance reformation happen. As the one who led humanity to victory. As the Commander of the Azur Lane...
To etch the perfect ending into this story.

As we dreamed of a hopeful future, we struggled day after day, straddling the line between life and death.
Faced with the Sirens' immense pressure, we all felt hesitant and lost...
At first, maybe it was nothing more than a slight difference of opinion or a conflict of ideas.
But, as time went on, those small cracks quietly connected and spread until they'd grown into an enormous rift that could neither be ignored nor be filled.
It was this moment that the Azur Lane fell apart.
It was a time of chaos.
Our information was limited, our suspicions were intensified, and our ambitions were enlarged. Cleverly, the Sirens schemed to divide us.
Trapped in this dark storm, we all made decisions that were incorrect.
As fortune would have it, though, the little fire lit in our hearts when the Azur Lane was established had not gone out.
None of us gave up. No one turned their back on the flame of hope.
This fire, eventually, thawed the ice of separation, and its light dispelled the long, dark fog.
We all share the same goal. Therefore, we should arrive at the same destination through different paths.
The appearance of the Sirens brought human civilization to a new stage, and the establishment of the Azur Lane set the tone for this new era.
The Crimson Axis, meanwhile, played a resounding and different instrument within this main melody.
Now, however, this instrument has played its last note.
As of today, the Crimson Axis belongs to history.
Let us raise the banner of unity, hold our heads high, and walk proudly into the future.
Two paths have now become one.
A once-fractured alliance has again become whole.
Just because we have achieved victory over the Sirens does not mean that the Azur Lane, built to combat them, has finished serving its purpose.
In fact, it means the opposite. The Azur Lane is going to become an even more important organization.
This time, it was the Sirens that invaded us. We defeated them.
So, then, what happens next?
There is no knowing if the universe beyond our world is safe.
There is only one thing we can do: Unite, stand together, and move forward as one group.
Under the banner of the Azur Lane shall we step into the uncertain future ahead of us.
Lexington and Bismarck's speech comes to an end.
The world is silent. It's waiting for me to speak next.
A bright world unfolds before me. All I need to do is take one step forward.
One step forward onto the stage. As the one who made the alliance reformation happen. As the one who led humanity to victory. As the Commander of the Azur Lane...
To etch the perfect ending into this story.

sequence: "Is it meant to be this way?"

scripts.say: No. Something's not right.
Rather than give in to the celebratory mood, I trust the faint nagging feeling in the back of my mind and leave the venue to find the truth.
How did the Iris Orthodoxy unify? Why were the Azur Lane reformation meetings held?
...The coronation ceremony.
...The Kingdom of God.
...Marco Polo?
Why is the Sea of Stars such an important base? Who is the beating heart of its central system?
...The Galactic Core.
Why did Amahara malfunction? Why was Akagi there?
What's her connection to the Watatsumi? What happened in the anomalous area?
Naraka... The Singularity...
The prison... The X... Helena...
I remember it... Everything.
That's it. This abnormal phenomenon is affecting the whole world. And its source is located in...
Scapa Flow in the Royal Islands.
Even though there's not a single trace left, I know that the Royal Navy had an artificial Singularity here. The Gate of Avalon.
That's where this all began, too.
I went here to attend a commemoration. Of course, that was just an excuse Elizabeth came up with. My real goal was to speak with the META Elizabeth.
Helena sent me here to do that, and...
My god... Is this exactly what she feared would happen?

options.content: Elizabeth META, I need your help.

scripts.say: The surrounding space changes in an instant.
We heard your call loud and clear.
We meet again, servant.
Goodness. The outside world certainly has undergone a drastic change.
So, tell us – how do you like this "brighter world"?
...There's nothing pertaining to the X. Nothing about the Arbiters, Singularities, or METAs either.
At a glance, it is a brighter world...
But upon closer inspection, it's merely a sandbox created by removing all elements from outside the world itself.
Even if you could create such an isolated world within test site beta, it wouldn't hold up.
The winds outside of it would keep raging regardless.
We can blissfully bury our heads in the sand, but for how long?
Wait a second...
Have you been watching me this entire time?!
Forgive us. There was naught that we could do.
We suffered severe wounds from the Day the Stars Faded, and urged Elizabeth not to tell anyone of it.
Naturally, you and Helena META didn't know, either.
Speaking of her, though – frankly, we've always been cautious of her.
She has exhibited a... dangerous level of attachment to you at times.
We fear that if she comes to learn that we have lost the ability to restrain her, she may do something extreme to test site beta.
God knows what goes through her mind... She actually entrusted your well-being wholly to us.
We were craven this time... It almost cost us everything as a result.
When you first visited Avalon, the world appeared perfectly normal – however, we were still in a deep coma at the time.
By the time we'd started slowly recollecting ourselves, this absurd abnormality had already developed.
It wasn't long before test site beta itself was enveloped in a two-tiered barrier, preventing practically all outside interference.
But, when you called our name just now, it finally allowed us an opening to intervene.
Wait... A two-tiered barrier?
Those are real? I thought they were just part of the illusion.
(Hang on... We hadn't even begun researching the physical barrier yet, had we?)
Indeed they are. What you experienced was not a fantasy, but rather a possibility.
With but a single thought, a possibility can transform into reality.
Were that not the case, how do you explain how you couldn't escape this incident on your own, even though many others have done so before?
To be frank, we weren't certain that you'd make the correct choice...
Fortunately, you did. You've proven more outstanding than we could've imagined.
One might even say that you've turned a disaster into a miracle.
A miracle?
Yes. By rejecting this possibility, you've restored the world to its point of divergence.
Despite that, all the experience, knowledge, and information you gained during that time remain inside you.
In other words, you now possess a staggering informational advantage with regard to the foreseeable future.
As for ourselves, we used this surplus of time to heal our injuries. While at it, we also made an important discovery.
Would you like to meet the string-puller responsible for all this? Then come with us.

sequence:
To a Brighter World

<size=45>Addendum</size>

scripts.say: As the light fades, an ocean of twinkling stars comes into view.
It looks a lot like the view of space I'd see when communicating with Helena.
Only with one major difference – there's a stranger floating among the stars.
We meet at last, Commander.
As you can see, I am Tower. The true owner of THE Tower.
Upon seeing this puppet-like girl who seems strangely familiar, an inexplicable sense of deja vu hits me.
(I get it now... That feeling of recognizing yet not remembering someone or something that everyone's told me about.)
I made a bet with Elizabeth META.
I wagered that you wouldn't refuse that brighter world by yourself. I lost.
My end of the deal was to step out from behind the curtains, directly answer your questions, and give you something of a "job-well-done reward."
So, here I am. I'm sure you have many questions on your mind. Let's hear them all.
I'm shocked to learn that you were the mastermind behind all this.
Did Helena tell me to go find Elizabeth META because she wanted to protect me from you?
And was it your fault that I couldn't contact Memphis or any of the other METAs?
I had the impression you were their ally. Why did you do this?
Helena sent you to find Elizabeth because she could predict what I'd do, but that's not all. In fact, she used you to force Elizabeth to get involved in what's to come.
Elizabeth is a key part of her plan, you see.
Sadly for her, Elizabeth proved far less reliable than she'd expected. No doubt she didn't expect my actions to have the effect of patching up holes in her plan either.
It was a blessing in disguise, as you people so like to say.
So you're saying that, as soon as I realized what was up and refused the possibility of this brighter world, your actions worked to our benefit, huh?
What if I hadn't refused it, then?
Then you could've just lived in that world forever. It would've been a happy life, free of worries – the ghosts of bygone days far behind you.
Is a life of peace, calm, and fulfillment not the ideal of so many people? Are you some sort of contrarian?
Is living in a closed-off garden, pretending there is no danger, what you call "a happy life"?
Oh, but you would've been looked after and protected to the very end.
That kind of happiness is not what I want.
Very well. Don't forget the choice you made, then.
Helena said you Arbiters have been busy with a "transboundary experiment." Shouldn't you be doing that instead?
What experiments they run is none of my business.
Huh? Okay, so tell me about it, then.
Hmm. How about no?
That's for the next episode, so to speak. You'll see it soon, so that's something to look forward to.
Fine. Next question. I learned a lot of facts and information while in that brighter world.
Elizabeth said what I learned will give me a huge upper hand in the events of the foreseeable future.
So what I'm wondering is: Are you trying to help me?
In a way, yes, but also no. In the possibility of that brighter world with all external information removed from it, those events are inevitable.
I simply filtered the world. I did not manipulate it.
What about Akagi?
Ah. That one.
Theoretically, you two would've been going on dates and vacations. "Enjoying life" things.
Unfortunately, she was a little too sharp for her own good. I had to adjust her a little.
I believe that was the one and only time I directly intervened in the world.
No need to worry about her. You refused the brighter world, after all. It's gone now – like chalk wiped from the board.
Your attitude is giving me mixed signals.
What did you actually want me to do? Embrace the brighter world, or refuse it?
Answer honestly – WHY did you do this?
I'm not concerned about your goals, I just want to hear your thoughts.
I lost my chinchillas. I was sad.
...Come again?
Heheh. Just a little joke.
After watching from afar for so long, I just had to get onto the stage.
I wanted to see it with my own eyes. I wanted to change it a bit.
That's right – this wasn't originally meant to happen. I could've done nothing and watched from the audience seats.
I could have simply watched as the pile of corpses grew.
Not that I dislike those, mind you.
It's just that I felt disappointed with what a tragedy the "next episode" would've ended with. It would've been boring, that's all.
Oh, and don't ask for my rating for this side episode.
The difference between being a critic and a director has become painfully clear to me now.
And when it comes to directing, it seems I have no talent. This is my last time trying it.
As for you... Once you're back, I suggest you rest for a bit, then prepare to head to the scene of the "next episode."
You keep saying "next episode." What do you mean by that?
You'll know once it starts.
When you get back, keep an eye out for news from the Sea of Stars.
That concludes your job-well-done reward. May we meet again someday.

<size=45>1 Seeping In</size>

scripts.say: While the Royal Navy was aiding Iris Libre's recapture of the Basilica Isles, Iron Blood's research in the Tower of Midgard's Mirror Sea continued.
Iron Blood Floating Fortress A1 – Office
Let's see here... A progress report on the Tower's upgrades...
A maintenance report... and a list of materials needed for repairs...
A girl with short, black hair was once again seated at her desk, reading through documents late into the night.
This had become commonplace for her, and the reports scattered across the once neatly-organized desk told a clear story of her lapsing focus.
Ugh... Can't concentrate at all...
It was nothing more than a nonsensical dream... So why can't I stop thinking about that black sun...?
Damnit, I can't get any work done like this.
Ulrich tried hard to push those haunting visions out of her mind, staring intently at the words printed on the documents in front of her.
No more idle thoughts, Ulrich. Good, it's working...
Focus. These documents aren't going to read themselves–– ...What?
...What the hell?!
When she raised her eyes, she found that though she was still sitting at the same desk, the office had warped into a completely different scenery.
There has to be a limit to these sick jokes... I might be sleep-deprived, but I'm nowhere near hallucination territory.
Am I losing my marbles here, or is this some side-effect of these facilities?
...Or, is someone trying to tell me something?
Whoever you are, you sure are persistent. I'll give you that much.
You keep showing me the same thing over and over again... so what are you trying to get at?
Friedrich? Are you trying to tell me something?
I'm listening.
...What are you saying?
Ulrich? Is everything alright?
Oh, it's you, Strasser.
Don't mind me. Out of curiosity, did you see that too?
See... what, exactly?
...Nevermind, it's nothing. When did you get here?
Approximately three minutes ago.
And for what reason?
...What do you mean? We're about to start today's experiments, so I'm here to bring you the report and test supplies per standard procedure.
Are you sure you're alright, Ulrich?
You were staring blankly at your documents without moving a muscle. Is there something wrong with the reports?
No, don't worry about it. I guess I didn't sleep well last night.
Anyway, you've got an experiment to run, so leave the report here and begin preparations.
Very well. I'll be on my way then.
If you're feeling mentally fatigued, I'd recommend some light exercise. We have training areas here after all.
Give it some thought, alright?
...You're right. I'll consider it.

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>2 Unrest</size>

scripts.say: Floating Fortress B7 - Training Area
KABOOOM!
Gunnery drill complete. Tabulating final results.
Your final results are: 6 hits, 3 near misses, and 1 miss.
Tsk...
Quite understandable. Cumbersome paperwork will only hinder your ability to fight.
Perhaps you've spent too many long hours cooped up in an office.
Duly noted, "Gneisenau."
But shouldn't you practice what you preach? I've hardly seen you leave the lab ever since I brought you before Bismarck.
True. I suppose we both stand to benefit from that bit of advice.
So, what brings you here? It's the last place I expected to find you.
What, am I a deuce in your cornflakes now?
I just felt like moving my body a bit, and not deal with Strasser nagging me about my health.
And you? You here to train too, or what?
Oh, do you actually need to ask me? What happened to those powers of observation you're so known for?
Sarcasm aside, I'm here to check on you. What's going on?
Nothing. Just haven't been able to sleep well the past few days because of these damn nightmares.
Give me a night or two of good rest and I'll be perfectly fine.
...A nightmare?
What kind of nightmare?
A black sun, floating high up in the sky. Ring any bells?
...Can't say it does.
But, the fact that you've been vividly dreaming of the same thing for a prolonged period of time is rather strange.
You ever had that? A nightmare following you?
More or less.
What was it about?
I'd rather not talk about it... Though, I can sympathize with what you're going through. Being followed by a nightmare is never a good thing.
All I can say is... you'd best stay on your toes.
Heh. I'd be a damn fool to ignore those words coming from the mouth of a META.
Good. As for your black sun, I'll let you know if anything comes up.
In any case, I should head back. But, before that...
Orders received. Another gunnery drill will commence in three minutes.
I took the liberty of starting another round of drills for you.
At your current performance level, you're sure to sink in a real battle.
So, please keep at it––

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>3 Snooping</size>

scripts.say: Floating Fortress A2 - Archives
Man, today's lunch was incredible. Hmm-hm-hmm♪
Oops, right, this is the archives... I need to be quiet.
If anyone's here, sorry! I'll keep it down!
Zuikaku looked around, but couldn't find anyone. It seemed she was alone.
Phew. I'm not in trouble.
Guess the Iron Blood girls are still busy training.
That being the case, it's time to get down to business!
Let's see... The documents should be over by...
Zzzzz...
...Huh? Was that a snore?
Aw crap, that means I'm NOT alone after all!
She followed the snoring to its origin – a lone shipgirl, hunched over a table.
Zzzzz...
Ulrich? Is that you?
Why are you napping in here of all pla–
Wait, what am I doing? I've no reason to wake her up!
Ulrich was sleeping like a log, completely unaware of Zuikaku's presence.
Poor girl must've been working overtime.
Between administering this place, working on the Tower's upgrades, and studying that Watatsumi sample, she's doing the work of like, three people combined.
Better leave her be. She deserves her beauty sleep.
Just as Zuikaku was going to step away, she caught a glance of the books Ulrich had been reading.
Huh. "The Interpreting of Dreams" and "Inevitable Apocalypse"...
That's not all. "Aztec Myths" and "Gods of Rome," too.
And lastly... "The Book of Dark Knowledge"?
That's a pretty broad range of topics...
Are these part of her research, or are they just a hobby thing?
Actually, what's it to me? Her reading habits are none of my business.
I just happened to cop a look at the titles, but still...
At least they're not top-secret documents, so I shouldn't get in trouble... I hope.
Whatever, I'll just pretend I didn't see anything! I've got other things to be doing now!

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>4 Parting Ways</size>

scripts.say: Floating Fortress B3 - Pier
The girls, having finished their training for the day, docked at the pier and had a lively chat.
Aww, are you really going back already?
Isn't this way too soon? Eisen's looking sad!
I'm afraid I must. Lady Littorio just sent me a message, urging me to return to the World Expo.
I'm needed there to bolster their security detail, you see...
Come on, can't you stay at least for today?
She's got orders to follow, Heinrich. I know you'll miss her, but you've gotta let her go.
I know, I know, but we were gonna throw a party and everything!
It'll be lonely without her, and we can't set the table in just five minutes!
How 'bout a compromise? You could find her a gift or something before she's gotta run.
Please, there's no need! You've already spoiled me with your hospitality during this short stay.
You needn't prepare any last-minute parties or gifts for me.
Well, okay...
Carabiniere, have you gotten Ulrich's message yet?
Yes! She told me about it directly.
She seemed to be feeling rather unwell, however, when I spoke to her...
Could you please check on her after I go?
Yes, she has been rather out of it for a while now...
But don't worry about her. I've already urged her to rest and recover.
Splendid. Now then, I should really be on my way!
If you happen to stop by the Expo, please come see me so I may return the kindness you've shown me.
Of course. Should our paths cross, we'll let you know.
I've left the Fortress' evacuation route open for you. Safe travels.
See you! Eisen, wave goodbye to our friend!
Farewell, ladies!
There she goes... *sigh*... This place just got a lot duller.
Did it? I beg to differ.
What makes you say that?
As long as you're around, it'll never be quiet here.
Wow, rude!
...Oh, oh! Strasser, I just got a good idea!
Oh boy... What kind of idea?
Ulrich's feeling under the weather, yeah? I think a power-packed beverage might be what she needs!
Don't tell me YOU'RE going to make it.
Well, duh! I'm open to suggestions, though.
Any aspiring mixologists in our midst? C'mon, let's hear some ideas!
Me, me! I've got one!
A double dose of carbonation! That's supposed to be like, super refreshing!
Not a bad start. I'll note it down. Anyone else?
Using healthy fruits or vegetables. Perhaps her poor mood is caused by a nutritional deficiency?
Yeah, that makes sense. Noted.
Any other ideas? You got anything, Strasser?
No. I'll pass.
Same.
Don't be scared! What's the worst that could happen?
Being scared has nothing to do with it.
Same.
If you wanna do this, you've gotta do it yourself. Good luck.
Awwwwww!

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>5 Reflecting in the Silence</size>

scripts.say: Floating Fortress A1 - Sakura Empire Guest Area
Even as late night set over the Fortress, the lights in Zuikaku's room remained lit.
Hmm. So to summarize Iron Blood's findings...
One – decades ago, a meteorite crashed into a barren part of the Northern Parliament, causing a huge explosion.
The meteorite fragments were recovered by the Sirens before they could be studied.
A scarce few fragments, however, wound up at the bottom of the Arctic Ocean.
Two – one day, in the Diadem of Light, the Watatsumi stone displayed an as-of-yet unexplained power.
As a result, many of the Sakura Empire's remote islands were designated as "sacred sites" and sealed away with barriers.
And, according to leading scientists on the mainland, the barrier-creating technology became this advanced at breakneck speed...
Three – with the combined power of Wisdom Cubes and shipgirls, humanity successfully repelled the Sirens in the first great war.
And, unbeknownst to everyone else, the Northern Parliament had been conducting research on the Arctic meteorite since even before the war.
Meaning, this project had been devised before shipgirls came into existence.
Additionally, the first shipgirl to participate in the project was the first-generation Avrora.
Four – Iron Blood's unique Black Cube may have actually been an Origin Cube, obtained through a transaction with the Sirens.
The meteorite, the Sirens and their meddling with our history, Wisdom Cubes, and the Watatsumi's power...
They all appeared around the exact same time.
There's no way all of that could be a coincidence.
Five – the details surrounding Bismarck's recovery...

Hang on a sec... "Not all Wisdom Cubes undergoing META corrosion will be irreversibly damaged immediately after crossing the critical threshold; some will begin displaying unusual characteristics for a short period of time."
"These characteristics appear to have a connection to the Watatsumi."
In other words, the meteorite, Watatsumi, and the Black Cube are all connected?
I'm starting to see the full picture now...
It feels like I'm so close... but just missing one last piece of the puzzle!
Ugh... This is making my head hurt! Why did Musashi choose me of all people for this mission?
Gaaah, what am I saying? Get it together, me!
This is the great mystery the Reborn Combined Fleet has been trying to solve this entire time!
We won't get a better opportunity to research this than now. Don't squander this golden opportunity!
*knock* *knock*
Alright, let's calm down and start from the top.
There's got to be something about the Watatsumi I've missed.
Maybe I can locate its origin based on its composition, and connect it to the meteorite somehow...
*knock* *knock* *knock*
The Black Cube is another lead, but I don't even know where to start.
All the experiments on it have failed, even with Gneisenau META's help.
It's almost like something inside the Cube defies observation...
But if so, what could that be?
*knock* *knock* *knock* *knock*
The heck? Is someone at the door?
Who would come here at this ungodly hour?
BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG!!!
Geesh, I guess it must be something serious...
Hold on a sec, I'll be right there––

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>6 Late-Night Emergency</size>

scripts.say: Floating Fortress A1 - Sakura Empire Guest Area
Finally. I was honestly afraid you weren't going to open the door.
You were gonna break the door down at that rate! Who WOULDN'T open it?
Everyone else, it seems. I've tried every other door already.
You're joking, right? What do you mean you've tried every other door?
That despite my banging, nobody answered, so I had to force my way in. Everyone I've found is unconscious.
So you're saying... we're the only people awake right now?
Indeed. Some unexplained phenomenon has left everyone from Iron Blood in a comatose state.
Presumably, you are unaffected since you're from the Sakura Empire. In my case...
Because you're from a different branch, right?
This is crazy... Iron Blood has full control over this Mirror Sea, and the Sirens couldn't possibly have launched this kind of sneak attack.
But it is not out of the realm of possibility for the Arbiters.
Or, consider the possibility that there's an even more dangerous entity out there that is neither Arbiter nor shipgirl...
In any case, that's the situation at hand. I should've been able to derive it when I saw Ulrich's condition earlier...
She's been suffering from persistent nightmares and even visual hallucinations over the last few days.
While I initially bought into her explanation that they were related to stress or her environment...
I'm almost certain that isn't the case.
This feels more like... sets of eyes, fixated on Ulrich.
Uhh... Could you run that by me again, but more simply?
It's hard to understand unless you've fought against the Arbiters the way we have. In any case, someone's targeting Ulrich, and everyone else just happens to be collateral.
And, my META intuition has a pretty good idea of who's behind it.
Probability is one thing, 'cause you've fought them before, but what do you mean by "META intuition"?
I can't explain it. It's instinct – a gut feeling that something from beyond this branch is here.
At least you can take solace in the fact that it's not after you.
Turn around, close your eyes, and nothing bad will happen to you.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm heading to bed.
...Bed?! Are you insane?!
Your friends are under attack, and you're gonna do nothing?!
Friends? I'm afraid you're mistaken.
The "Iron Blood" here is nothing more than a fickle illusion. My only connection to this place... is Bismarck.
Liar! If you don't care about them, why'd you even bother trying to find out what's going on?
Why'd you come knocking on my door with your full set of rigging out?
These people matter to you and you want to save them. That's a fact!
Fine, if you won't do it for them, then do it for me. Help me resolve this situation– please.
...Very well.
*sigh*... Just say so from the very beginning then...
So, where do we start? Do we head to Ulrich's room and–
BEEP– BEEP– BEEP–
Huh? What's happening?!
Did something just get turned on? Is the Flying Fortress starting to move?!
I believe that noise came from the Tower of Midgard...
Someone has activated the teleporter!

sequence:
The Weaver's Omen

<size=45>7 Distant Rumbling</size>

scripts.say: Somewhere far away from the Floating Fortress, before the crisis began...
Do you know anything about the thief that stole the artifact from your museum?
We know that they're an unknown META, and that they stole a floor tile from the Library of Alexandria. Beyond that, nothing concrete.
Whoever the culprit is, we'll catch them soon enough with help from our allies in the Ashes.
Let's hope so. Incidentally, how is the gate at Scapa Flow?
It's operating at 100% efficiency. No issues to my knowledge.
And you? Any updates on the Sea of Stars?
Yes. Thanks to the intel you provided us, we were able to narrow down its coordinates.
It was a laborious process, but we now believe the facility is located in the Rocky Mountains rather than somewhere in a lake or sea.
Really? While that'd be a good place to conceal something, it also sounds terribly impractical to use...
Not only that, but it seems to have been built under the direction of the Naval HQ and is also involved in an unknown blueprint ship...
The more I learn, the shadier it sounds.
While we're on that topic, have you heard the rumor that the Eagle Union is helping develop a blueprint ship for Iris Libre?
I knew it... I had my suspicions after there were talks at the World Expo between the two sides to jointly develop rigging technology.
That sure does put some of what I heard in perspective... I wish my servant would just tell me what's going on in person.
You may get the opportunity sooner than you think. Apparently, the Eagle Union seems to also be developing something called the "Type II" rigging.
Developing what, now?
Oh, right! The technology that reinforces the hull.
Indeed. I've already experienced some of its benefits.
Hmph... I'll have to look into that as well.
Moving on then. Has the Northern Parliament made any moves I should be aware of?
Currently, they're conducting a large-scale operation against the Sirens in the Arctic region.
It seems to be going quite well too. Have you not heard anything about it?
I have. The noteworthy thing is how quickly they're outstripping our projections.
Anything else?
They apparently extended invitations to speak privately with the Vichya Dominion several times during the World Expo.
About what, I'm not sure. But they seemed to be keen on avoiding the notice of the "Tribunal," and also apparently reached some kind of agreement.
Are you not at all privy to that information? You're still technically part of the Crimson Axis.
Through the Crimson Axis' intelligence network, you mean? It's been half-defunct since Compiler's defeat.
Doesn't that ultimately fall on Clemenceau, the de-facto head of the Tribunal?
Friedrich had a hand to play in securing her position. With her out of the picture, how willing is Clemenceau to still listen to you?
Our attitude towards the Iris Orthodoxy has never changed.
We can't do anything about the Reenactments. They must forge their own future.
I see. Nothing to worry about, then?
...What's this? An urgent message?
From who?
It's from Scapa Flow. The gate is acting up, it seems.
...What?
I must see what's wrong with it. It's time we said goodbye for today.
Very well. If any equipment is malfunctioning, call me and I'll send over our experts.
Yes, yes... In the meantime, don't use the Tower of Midgard under any circumstances. Is that clear?
Of course.
The very world depends on it. Goodbye.
Their Singularity gate suddenly malfunctioned? That's an ill omen...
BEEP– BEEP– BEEP–!
An urgent message for me this time...
Hope it's nothing too serious.
...An emergency in the Tower of Midgard? ...We've lost all contact with the Flying Fortress?
Smells so good~
Wow...the source of this aromatic smell is coming from the Dragon Empery. Ehhh... let me hide first, I will give them a surprise! Hehehe~
It's finally the day for sister Yat Sen to unseal her secret osmanthus wine! Oh wow... this aroma is really hypnotizing~
Haha, if you don't make mooncakes good enough to match my wine, you won't get a single sip!
I see! Ning Hai is ready to cook!
Sister is being more dedicated than me, for the first time...
Even though there're only three of us, the festivities are still as happy as before...
...Sorry, I've lost my train of thought... but as long as we're still here, one day sooner or later, everyone will gather here together again.
Yes... the Mid-Autumn Festival is one that celebrates a reunion with friends and family.
Say, isn't the Mid-Autumn Festival all about eating mooncakes?
….celebrating a reunion…?
Who's there!
Look who it is. A lady not lady-like at all.
I am a lady --- at the very least, a little bit!
But... this is definitely very humiliating for me, since I’ve been discovered before I can pull my prank!
“Prank”, this kind of word is not supposed to be said by a lady.

I understand! So it seems that the Mid-Autumn Festival is one that “celebrates the reunion with friends and family”, but…how come it seems like such a downer right now? In the Dragon Empery, all festivals should be very lively!
Words can be hurtful... even if they tell the truth.
Whoaaa——Sister Yat Sen, you're joking, right?!
~Stares~
S-Sorry! Th-the second sister made me a bit scared when she appeared!
After all, it's not like Christmas, the Mid-Autumn Festival is not as popular around the world yet.
Although, I feel like Mid-Autumn Festival is better than Christmas -- food-wise!
Is it popular around the world...I get it now! Anyone can celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival, right?!
Umm….yes you're right, but----
Well then, wait for me a bit. This damper of an atmosphere is no festival at all, a festival should be livelier!
She just comes and goes like a puff of smoke...Eagle Union carriers are amazing!
That little troublemaker, she may be pretty cute after all...
I brought my sister here.Ta-da!
Good afternoon everyone from the Dragon Empery~ Um, I heard from Saratoga that you are celebrating a festival called the “Mid-Autumn Festival”.
Oh wow, is this Sara's big sister? So beautiful! Will Sara also grow up to be so pretty?!
Yes, do you wish to join us Ms. Lexington?

Of course~ how can a festival be missing an idol like myself! Will you allow me to join you in the celebrations, too?! Also, how come you address my sister as “Lady Sara”, but call me “Miss Lexington?” You can call me “Lady Lex!”
Welcome welcome~ although there is no say of inviting idols to this festival...
Lady Lex...?
GOOD! Although... even though it's a celebration, I'm still unclear in exactly how we should celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
It's about a gathering of friends and family, everyone sits together wishing for fortune and happiness, as well as reminiscing about the past with loved ones.
Isn't this a bit like Memorial Day in the Eagle Union?
No…most likely...not...
But to me, these two festivals both sound similar? It's all about commemorating our…
I'm still alive... not a martyr yet...
So sorry, I lost track of my words~ anyways, is the preparation for the festival almost finished? Is there anything else that my sister and I can help with?
No need, the guests should just relax --- Hey! Where are those Ping Hai and Ning Hai sisters?!
We're making lanterns! Ping Hai told me that it's a tradition during the Mid-Autumn Festival?
When talking about the Mid-Autumn Festival, other than mooncakes and osmanthus wine, the lantern is definitely a must-have traditional item!
Oh no….where did you put the mooncakes...
In short, with the help of Lady Sara, the lanterns were finished in no time! Those carriers sure are amazing!
Wow….so many lanterns, we'll definitely be able to attract good fortune and protection---

At night, let my sister and I “fly up” to those lanterns. That way, not only will they shine but they'll also emanate a beautiful sound, like a “dance in the sky”! My friends are also eager to try on these festive clothes!
A bunch of lanterns roaring and dancing up in the sky...
This isn't what we want to have for the festival...
….Where are those Mid-Autumn tides…obviously we're clearing the seaport, but there's no hope for rain...
After all, tidal waves differ from coast to coast...
Also, since it's chosen as a seaport...naturally the tidal waves will not be too strong...
How could I have made such a stupid mistake...
Yan Set sister is motionless like a fossil---
After all, she was eagerly anticipating for rain during the Mid-Autumn Festival
Huh? Seems like there is a sound that's coming closer
I've already changed into my swimsuit, don't be shy now, Hood~
I said I'll only accompany you to the beach, I didn't promise you that I'll change into a swimsuit. Also, swimming in cold waters during the Autumn season is no demeanor of a lady.
Sister Hood…but I saw you only yesterday practicing on your swimming in the sea, so----
Cy-g-net!!!!
Ahhhh!!!
Oh, that child over there is rushing towards us, so fast! What's the name of that Destroyer again?
Ugh...no, I don't want to be traumatized anymore. Let's book it----
Wow, it's Cleveland and Helena!
I was lured here by this sweet aroma, I didn't expect to meet you girls here.
This sweet aroma... what's this? Some kind of scented wine?
It's my secret osmanthus wine~ But I didn't expect you all to be attracted by the scent. Did I not seal it properly?

No... Cleveland sniffed the scent of the faint aroma, then pestered me to use my SG radar to track its location. Even if there are others who picked up on the smell, they should not be able to locate the source.
Here is someone who found the source of the aroma before you ---
Since you're already here, how about staying for dinner since it's already getting late? Today we're celebrating a festival from the Dragon Empery — the Mid-Autumn Festival!
Today was suppose to be my turn to cook, right….OK! Let's stay! I've gotten off easy!

If you don't cook today, you'll still cook tomorrow. I've admired the cuisine from the Dragon Empery for a long time now. Yat Sen, will you be able to open my eyes and shatter my expectations tonight?
Of course. The highlight of tonight's meal are “mooncakes”, which symbolizes harmony and reunion. We haven't finished making them yet, do you want to see the process of how they're being made?
Thank you, don't mind if I do
Ping Hai and Ning Hai, please take out the ingredients---
Sis, let's make them together! Let's see who can make them better!
I feel like you're very excited today... fine, I'll show everyone here the strength of “Lady Lex”!
Ah! This looks very interesting, Helena, let's join them?
This way, I can consider this as cooking! So for tomorrow---
Don't be so lazy…...
Yeah! I'm done at last - yay, was I the slowest? With help from others, I thought could've at least finished in the middle...
You spent so much time kneading the dough
So, the mooncakes have started baking, let's take a short break before we start our Mid-Autumn Festival dinner.
In addition, before we start dinner, please allow me to express my gratitude for everyone's attendance!
No worries~ it's more like my sister has been causing so much mischief for you all.
No I haven't!
It's an honor to be able to eat food hand-made by Yan Set and Ning Hai.
Haha! I didn't do anything, although --- the liveliness is what counts for making it a festival!
That's true...festivals are all about the rowdy atmosphere!
Ta-da~~~~ Here is the debut of Ping Hai's Mid-Autumn Festival attire!
I'm so s-shy...Yat Sen's gift...
Wow! So beautiful---
Say….is this also a “custom” for the Mid-Autumn Festival?
No it's not, but because Ping Hai and Ning Hai have been so hard working, I wanted to give them both a little reward~
Was... was this hand-stitched?! My my Helena... we’re no match for them!
...I can't seem to be able to hear the criticisms.
In any case, let's start the meal! I want to drink that osmanthus wine!
Of course! O what a lovely full moon tonight. Let's finish all this osmanthus wine everyone, hehehe--- Oh! But be sure to leave some for the Moon Goddess
So is this...is this Sara's mooncakes?......
...big Sisterrrr…
Hmmm, ~nibbles~...Sara you still have room to improve...
One look and you can tell that it's not edible... yet you swallowed it… such close sibling affection!
Lady Lex's mooncakes looks delicious, ~nibbles~ but still the taste is not the same as lady Yat Sen's.
Your mooncakes not only turned out to be pizza-shaped, but they even tasted like pizza? I'm not sure if I can call this a clever trick or----
Cleveland, did you really get Yat Sen to teach you her methods? The more I look at yours, the more I think it resembles a burrito.
Haha! I mixed all those ingredients together disproportionately! Is there a problem? It's all going to end up in your stomach anyway!
It-it's definitely not the same! If it wasn't ~coughs~, ~coughs~.
Tsk tsk, talking with a mouthful, would you care for some osmanthus wine?
Looks like the only person who actually made “mooncakes” was me. Ning Hai, Helena... Ping Hai, wait, how did your mooncakes turn out to be steamed buns instead?!
Hehehe~ Sara borrowed the mooncake molds from me… I like to eat steamed buns so it doesn't matter, I can eat all of these by myself!
Heyy...don't hide these like it's buried treasure… I haven't tried mooncake flavored buns before! Nibbles~
Ping Hai, let's share these.
Sister...
Sister… don’t choke on your food, here, drink some osmanthus wine~
Mmmm, so fragrant….
Tastes so so good! Give me ten barrels, then the cavalry of the ocean will be yours to command!
First do this, then add this….and then….
Oh, I'll have to write this all down! If I have trouble making this, can I still ask you for advice?
Of course~
Sis, can I drink some, too?
Just a little bit~
Moon Goddess, here's a toast to everyone who, whether being here or not, I wish that everyone can be united with their loved ones.
The aroma leads us here, uh... it seems we are not alone.
What a mess. Was there some sort of a celebration...
It's a festival! The Mid-Autumn Festival!
Huh? New guests? They must have been attracted by the smell of my osmanthus wine. Welcome~
Those wines... Are they the source of the aroma?
Yes. We only have that much left. They are too fragile though. Let's put down our hatred towards each other, at least just for today.
I don't drink, and there's nothing to be put down... But —— it smells really good~
It's not as red as blood! But it tastes good~~
Hey! Stop there! Wine thivees!
Wales~ Can I have a h-hug~
With a touch of alcohol, my sister becomes a troublemaker...
This is her charm point~ Come, let me hold you high.
I didn't except that so many people would come... all thanks to you.

I think it's because we all miss those we lost, friends, family... We cannot help ourselves thinking about them under such a beautiful moon, even if this isn't a festival for reunion... That's why we're all here together, right?
Are there other people staring at the same moon, and celebrating? Tonight, I believe there are.

Even though festivals are different from cultures, they are in common in many emotional ways. The meaning of the Mid-Autumn Festival is to miss our family and friends, and to celebrate our reunion. These are universal among all cultures. I wish there would be more people join us next year~~
Yes. My sisters and Helena's sisters... and all past friends, rivals, enemies... I wish everyone could be here.
Are all the wine gone... Oh, yes! There's a custom from my hometown... Cake Game. Let's have some fun!
Cake Game?
But I ate all the mooncakes... I, I mean we...
Let's roll dices, and the winner gets a mooncake~~
Huh... something like a roulette?

Yes, they are quite similar. Except the rewards are mooncakes... Did I hear the mooncakes are all gone? Let's use these lanterns then. Write down your wishes on them, then let fly... high to the rim of the world.
So that, all your friends, and even God will hear our wishes. Saratoga, are your drunken carriers still capable to fly?
Of course! They cannot wait!
Many thanks~ Those who know the rules, let's show the others how to play Cake Game~~
So, the first flower goes to... Prince of Wales! There you go, write down your wishes here.
Emmm….do I have to write it in front of everyone?
Hmm? Is there something that you can’t tell us?
Haha~ of course note, I’ll write it then --- “I hope that every girl can show her true smile”...OK!
Z46! Here, write something~
...I hope that everyone on Azur Lane can get the chance to relax...
Wow, such pretty handwriting!
Sara sit still, the next round will start soon! This time I must...
Saratoga --- You write, too!
“I hope I get to experience more interesting things” --- OK!
Shouldn’t you be writing well-wishes for your fellow shipgirls?
Hmm? Then isn’t being able to get together with all of you the most interesting thing ever!
Lastly --- Yat Sen! Hehe, it’s my turn this time~
So...what should I write then?
“I hope that everyone will get new clothes for next year”...let’s say that!
New clothes... there are those who also like to wear uniforms...
Second place goes to... Eugen!
Hmmm, I’ve been given a second place?!
Then…”I hope to be able to get together with my sisters”, is that ok?
I feel like suddenly thinking out loud “ha!” ...
Finally, the first place... Ning Hai!
What!? I'm the first place! Great!
I wanna be on the first place as well...
So, Ning Hai, have you decided on your wish?
Yes, from the very beginning... I wish more and more friends will join us!
All the lanterns flew away, out of our reach.
Yet the moon is still up there, looking over all of us. No matter how far the distance, we share the same beautiful scene with those we care but cannot be together...
I hope that one day all of us will be as whole and complete as the full moon tonight, all sitting together side by side...
Whether it’s next year or the year after, as long as I’m around, I will always come to celebrate. I haven’t had enough of this osmanthus wine!
So... Let us pray to the Moon Goddess together.

Wish today's joy will reunit us here every year. Wish never will we be alone in the sea, and be defeated by pain and failure... Wish everyone start understanding each other... Wish we can hold our hands forever...

sequence:
Crimson Prelusion

<size=45>1 Dream - In Memory of the Battle</size>

scripts.say: Warning sirens were blaring in the air around Scapa Flow.
And yet, nobody there was gearing up for battle. On the contrary, many took off their hats as a gesture of respect.
This was no battle – it was a ceremony to commemorate a battle.
Thank you all for your thoughts and prayers.
We have gathered here again this year to pay our respects to our comrades who fell in the defence of Scapa Flow.
Though the battle has long since passed, the courage our soldiers showed here continues to inspire us.
The vessels we lost, too, still rest at the bottom of the sea, silently recounting what happened.
On that day, the Royal Navy, Iron Blood, and Sakura Empire all united against the Sirens, pushing them back and defending our great motherland.
We defeated Compiler, proving that humanity will endure. These ruins you see are the final thing she did.
It is not only the remains of a battle, it is also proof of our bonds.
I truly hope that this friendship of ours will last forever.
The stirring speed continued from the ceremonial podium.

sequence: Scapa Flow - Tourist Area
Hotel
Sometime later

scripts.say: The tourist area at Scapa Flow is home to a massive, regal hotel. There, a party is held after the remembrance ceremony each year.
Legend has it that the heroes of all three factions held their own celebration here after the battle was over.
*yaaawn*... I'm beat. This has been a long day.
I'm gonna stuff my face and recharge my batteries, then fall asleep in half a second of lying in bed.
Heehee. You really know how to let loose after a hard day's work, I see.
Yep. Relaxing is my middle name.
I'd like to thank you both for coming all this way.
Especially you, Amagi. On behalf of the entire Royal Navy, thank you for attending this ceremony every year.
You needn't thank me. It shames me to admit this, but part of the reason I come is so I can have a break from my work at home.
Of course, reuniting with old friends is always the main draw, though.
Same for me. Let's have a toast! To our old friends!
To our old friends.
The tides of war are turning in our favour. We are presently preparing a major counterattack and would much appreciate your aid in executing it.
You can count on us. Before we set off, Friedrich told us to agree to help if you brought up any talks of a counterattack.
The Sakura Empire will assist you as well. Allow me to raise a toast next. To our friendship.
To our friendship!

sequence: Royal Islands - Location Unknown
Royal Navy Gate

scripts.say: BEEP BEEP!
Bugger. I knew it wouldn't be so easy to contact the outside.
Vanguard, any luck?
Afraid not. "Could not construct passageway: failed to locate exit coordinates." I've restarted over and over, and it's the same thing every time.
We can't reach the outside and we can't escape. We're bloody stuck in Camelot!
They SHOULD send a rescue fleet once they realise they've lost contact with us.
I, for one, don't fancy twiddling my thumbs until rescue arrives.
The teleporter can't find exit coordinates, even though nothing's changed on the inside. That means the problem is external.
Maybe they're in the same boat as us, unable to use the gate from their end.
In the worst case... we may have become unobservable to them.
But then... aren't we proper screwed?!
I'm only speculating. It's not like I know how this thing works.
All I'm saying is it's POSSIBLE.
Her Majesty knows the gate better than anyone... but she's in Europa at the moment, and we obviously can't reach her.
What about Her META Majesty?
Not an option. She hath boarded the Queen's Light and traveled to god knoweth what place where she cannot be reached. As she so often doeth.
Then what are we supposed to do?
I may have an idea.
If trouble has sprung up outside test site beta, we could take Camelot to a place just a bit further away. Then we may figure out what's going on.
Her Majesty explicitly ordered us not to use the gate without her permission, though.
And how are we supposed to GET her bloody permission in the first place, huh?
I see your point, but still...
We were endowed with brains for times like these. Go on, let's hear some alternative ideas.
Well... Her Majesty DID say I had permission to use the gate one single time in the event of an emergency, but...
Mean thou to say this is NOT an emergency?
You're right. It is. There's no other way!
Then input a set of coordinates and I'll activate the gate at once.
Umm...
Err...
Well...
For the love of... Do none of you know how to input coordinates?
Fighting and hunting are my fortes, not operating teleporters.
I've been far too preoccupied setting up defences in the Rose Block to learn such things.
What about you, Repulse and Renown? Ye came here before the rest of us.
Do we LOOK like we know how that thing works? Coming first doesn't automatically make us experts.
Ugh. Great... Then Her Majesty is likely the only one who knows how.
Having her permission means nothing if we can't use the damn thing.
I'll do it.
I've fed it coordinates once before and I know more or less how the machine works.
Only because you were so reckless back then...
Still, it's not that simple. All the coordinates that were stored on it have been erased.
It seems we've no other choice. We must punch a hole through the outer barrier.
No, no, NO! Don't even think about it, Renown!
Hmph. Very well.
Simply waiting doth seem our best option. Either Our Majesty wilt come, or yours wilt send a rescue fleet.
Our best and ONLY option. Ugh... Return to your posts and resume your work.

sequence:
Crimson Prelusion

<size=45>2 Dream - Let the Past Be the Past</size>

scripts.say: Dark clouds. A song of black steel played across the sea while a relentless pursuit unfolded.
I am Renown, battlecruiser of the Royal Navy's Force H! I am here because of your ambush on our ships! Cease your meaningless resistance at once!
The Royal Family's most capable ships are heading this way en masse! I will not let you flee!
She's... not resisting as I figured she would.
No matter. She's not getting away on my watch!
Let's do precisely what King George V said and slow her down!
Swordfishes, launch! Capture Bismarck!
KABOOOM!
Torpedoes... from my blind spot...?!
I won't... be able to avoid them in time...!
KABOOOM!
This is the end, Bismarck.
By the decree of the Queen, you are to lay down your arms and come with us. You shall have a fair trial in our courts.
I lost power to my engines, and the operation was a failure... It was over.
Miss Bismarck... You almost lost your life, and yet you still refuse to use "that?"
I don't need help from the likes of you...
Still acting tough even in this condition? You could have sent your enemies to the bottom of the sea so easily. All you needed was a little bit of... determination.
KABOOOM!
Such terrible dissonance.
Bismarck has already made her will clear, Siren. You are not part of this orchestra.
I'm sorry I took so long, Bismarck. Are you alright?
Friedrich... You – who are you?
I am Amagi. Do you remember me?
You're Akagi's older sister, if I remember right.
What's that fleet over there? Why is it so black?
That's my support fleet. Reinforcements from your side are here, too. The Royal Navy won't dare come any closer.
You're safe now. You're going to be alright.
I'm... safe...?
Bismarck could hardly believe her ears. She paused to let the word sink in.
With the arrival of those unforeseen variables, the predicted test results have changed. Seems you have the option to choose a new path.
A new path...
Bismarck gazed at Tester, then at Amagi, then at Friedrich, then finally at the Black Cube resting atop her rigging.
Heheheh...
What's so funny?
Was this your plan? To change fate by bringing reinforcements to save me?
Perhaps. What do you think?
No. This is wrong.
This is not what we agreed would happen here.
You're supposed to be back at the base. When news of my "sinking" reaches you, you'll initiate a purge of our higher command and lead Iron Blood in my stead.
Which means that this isn't reality. Am I correct?
Heehee...
What are you talking about?
Of course this is reality. Not only that, it's better than it once was.
Shouldn't we let reality continue as it is?
Reality isn't all sunshine and butterflies. There will be regrets, goodbyes, and mistakes along the path that is life.
There can be no future without the real past.
And you cannot undo what has been done.
It doesn't matter how frustrating or saddening the past is, or how much you want to change it...
We must accept reality for what it is. By accepting it, we can move on to the future.
She began to charge up her main cannons as she used the terrifying power in her hands.
The strange black light gathered in her barrel, eventually shrinking down to a single dot.
Please don't, Bismarck! What do you think you're trying to accomplish?!
I'm doing what must be done.
Just as I did in the past. Tester! I will use this power to turn your fleet to dust!
I accept my fate – my end – for what it is!
Power burst forth from the tiny dot, engulfing not just Tester and Bismarck herself, but the puzzled Amagi and smiling Friedrich as well.
ROOOAAAR!
This... This is reality.
Do you see? Only by accepting the past can you move on to the future.
Toward a brighter, better future.

sequence:
Crimson Prelusion

<size=45>3 Reality - In the Holy Capital</size>

scripts.say: On a major street in the Orthodoxy's holy capital...
Sakuran shipgirls were wading through the crowds toward their destination.
Out of my way! Let me through!
MOVE, dammit!
We've opened up a path. Let's hurry, Lady Shinano!
Phew... Finally, we made it to an at least somewhat open space.
It's staggering how crowded it is. Do you think there's some festival happening?
This one has not heard of any such thing taking place today...
Maybe it's a spur-of-the-moment thing. Don't need an excuse to have fun!
Like a few days back, when we all got together on a whim to watch the moon!
Well, that never actually–
Ahem. Let us chat elsewhere. Hakuryuu, continue leading the way. Before all else, we must get back to our lodgings...
Yeah, yeah! Will do!
After passing another intersection, the Sakurans came across a group of young Orthodoxy girls.
Please move forward in an orderly fashion! Let us celebrate our victory in this war of resistance together!
May the Orthodoxy, Royal Navy, and Sakura Empire remain allies forever!
"War of resistance"? What the hell is she talking about?
The three of us, allies forever? That's news to me.
Something is weird with these girls.
Exactly! They're weirder than a toad in a kimono!
Lady Shinano... I think they've been put under the dream spell, too.
Aye... It's little surprise that the holy capital has been affected...
However, this one never could've anticipated the effect was this vast in scale...
But, as fortune would have it, this one has business with the knights... Let us go speak to them.
Greetings, knights of the Holy Iris... Where is Clemenceau?
Ah, Sakurans! Welcome to our parade! Come celebrate with us!
(They're ignoring me... I should show it to them.)
Have a look at this.
She showed them the brooch the Commander gave to her.
Please, young knights... This one would like a meeting with Clemenceau.
Do you want to go to the main venue? Shall we escort you there?
(My words aren't reaching them... So be it, then.)
Thank you, but no. That shan't be necessary.
Very well. Please be sure to have a look around! There's so much to see!
As the sun began to set, the Sakurans finally made it back to their lodgings.
Despite doing everything she could, Shinano was unable to arrange a meeting with Clemenceau.
Resigned, she sat in her room, deep in thought about how the dream had affected her comrades from the Orthodoxy.
Ah, like a small boat caught in a great storm, I can do naught but lament my own helplessness...
How much more must I experience this feeling of futility?
In dreams of yore, there was always the hope that all would change once I woke again...
Alas, prayers cannot change the reality of the waking world...
Now, I am equally at the whims of both the real world and the dream world, allowed not even a moment of reprieve...
How could one who only knows how to drift possibly fight the waves?
Neither is there a way out, nor will anyone come to my aid...
Only one person can resolve this crisis... 'tis I and I alone...
I can flee from my problems no longer...
Shinano closed her eyes and tightly clutched the Watatsumi amulet in her hands. Hearing her prayer, it began to glow faintly.
I've always known the essence of my power, the root of my dreams...
It is this fragment... The Watatsumi gives me my strength, my dreams...
And yet, I have always turned a blind eye to the truth...
That without this fragment, I am a hollow person with no power despite the Yamato-class hull I possess...
It is time I accepted reality for what it is...
Then... I shall do what I can...
When she opened her eyes, the light from the amulet had faded, like the moon's reflection upon a lake.
The Watatsumi is a sacred relic, but it can also be a weapon...
Soldiers rely upon their firearms, and ships rely upon their riggings... whilst my everything hinges upon this fragment...
With this amulet, you helped me see reality when I would not accept it...
This amulet of my own creation cast light upon the dream that has bewitched so many... It made me realize that the waking world was asleep...
Thus far it has guided me, and no doubt it will continue to...
It is my connection to the dreamscape as well as my guiding light to it...
If my words mean nothing in the real world, then perhaps they have weight in the dream world...
I shall dispel the illusion placed upon the holy capital and accomplish my mission.
Steeling her resolve, she again clenched the amulet between her hands.
Then, there was a sudden knocking on the door.
It's Clemenceau. I heard you've been running across the city trying to find me.
What can I do for you?
Clemenceau?!
Shocked, Shinano was quick to open the door and let Clemenceau in.
Have you... awoken from the illusion?
Yes, as you can see.
How?
Simple. Things seemed too perfect even for a dream.
As sad as it is, I know the past, present, and future alike can never be that pretty.
So, I accepted a sacrifice and made the right choice again. That is all.
Seeing as you were fooled, too, you must know well how powerful this illusion is. A layman cannot correctly identify a perfect dream for what it is.
Furthermore... it seems the Commander made two misjudgments...
Misjudgments? Go on.
The first – this one showed your comrades this brooch, yet they wouldn't let me see you.
Shinano took out the brooch and showed it to Clemenceau.
The second – the assumption that few Europans would snap out of the illusion by themselves.
