Uh, I STILL haven't gotten to introduce myself!
You're U-556, yes? At least, that's what she called you.
Yup-yup.
Be quiet already, U-110!
Oww! Submarines really aren't meant for face-to-face combat...!
That must be breaking news for you! If you want to run away like a coward, now's the time!
Dang it... Crash diving...!
She got away again... Bulldog, you all right?
... Bulldog?
Bulldoooooog!
Ow, my eyes!
... Right here. I'm all right.
Amazon? I'm sorry if I blinded you.
Uhhhh-huh...
Unfortunately, the submarine managed to escape.
Grrr... If we don't know where they're headed, our transport ships will be attacked again...
You don't need to worry about that.
I managed to acquire the codebooks, an Enigma machine, and the Iron Blood's nautical charts.
How on Earth did you...
I shall explain later. For now, let's join up with the rest of our fleet.
Hmm... Yes, let's. Standing around here will get us nowhere.
Amazon looked in the direction U-556 swam towards.
Her sonar is still picking up signs of Iron Blood submarines, but they seem to be going way off course from where their cargo ships are heading.
They might destroy our cargo ships even if we chase after them now, and then all would be for nothing.
Given that they are a wolfpack and we haven't seen their third submarine yet, we should proceed with caution.
That's the idea! We'll spare those pesky subs, for now!
With the Enigma machine and codebooks in their hands, the two destroyers headed back to the area where their cargo ships were positioned.
... By the way, what was thing you did earlier?
It's a secret.
*Gasp*! I-I finally managed to throw them off...
I'm glad you're okay, U-556.
Bwah! Don't scare me like that...
They're not chasing you, are they? Okay, then let's use this chance to run away!
And then...
*Pant*... I thought we were dead for sure...
I'd say my ruse deserves a thank yooouu.
True... You drew their attention as well, which is why we managed to get away.
Yup-yup.
So, what was your ruse, even?
I feigned death. Then I dropped my backpack to slow Bulldog down. It was noooot easy.
Well, nicely done... Just don't do anything that dangerous again, okay? Next time, they might take your lollipop away from you!
Okey-dokey.
Also, you keep your Enigma machine and codebooks inside your backpack, right? You retrieved it afterwards, didn't you?
OH!
Oh...

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>1 A Fragrance in the Courtyard</size>

scripts.say: Port - Sakura Empire Courtyard
When I'm blessed with a rare moment's leisure, Hakuhou invites me to stroll with her through the courtyard.
A gentle breeze drifts through the covered walkway, carrying an elegant fragrance that makes me feel at ease.
There's something about this courtyard... Its scent is so calming.
Heehee... I'm glad you like it, Commander.
I prepared both the garden and this subtle fragrance to suit your tastes, you know.
You sound very confident.
But of course... Only I truly understand both this place's refined elegance AND the scenery that suits you best, Commander.
...Unlike those "pets" of yours who clamor endlessly and find every possible excuse to nestle closer to you.
They could never understand such refined taste. Hehe!
A feeling of pride tinged her words, though it was quickly masked by her gentle, composed smile.
Petals drift upon the stream, this world's beauty is but a fleeting dream. Accompanied in eternal sleep, its fragrance lingers ever sweet.
Do you think these words suit the scenery before us, Commander?

options.content: It sounds a little sad, doesn't it?

scripts.say: A dreamlike fragrance in a fleeting world's beauty... It does suit the mood here.
You really understand how I feel, Commander.
Falling petals being carried away by the current... It sounds a little sad, doesn't it?
You have a keen eye for details, Commander. I'm impressed.
Let's venture further now, shall we?
She links her arm with mine and guides me further into the courtyard.
Withering leaves fall into the stream and drift away quietly on the current.
Leaves drift upon the water, just as the spring blossoms are destined to scatter.
The thought that all beauty can be so fleeting does make it feel like a pity, huh?
A pity, hmm? Hehe...
It's true – our world is as fleeting as the morning dew... but when do you think that creation is at its most beautiful?
Is it in the tender delicacy of a bud about to bloom? Or... the heart-wrenching moment in which a petal drifts away on the wind?
Every moment has its own beauty. I'd like to hear your thoughts, though.

If we're to speak of what the Sakurans call "mono no aware," the beauty of the ephemeral... then for me, the most beautiful moment would be when all noise turns to silence and all life vanishes into the mist.
That pure serenity... It's too much for me to bear.
I see. But rather than watch it all fade away, I'd wish I could capture that momentary beauty forever.
Capturing the moment, hmm? You are too sweet for your own good, Commander.
If that is your wish, then naturally, I must grant it.
She leans in slightly, a faint and mysterious smile written on her lips.
May I have some of your time?
I will use aromatic woods to replicate this moment for you.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>2 A Promise Just for Two</size>

scripts.say: Port - Hakuhou's Quarters
I follow Hakuhou into her meticulously arranged room.
Soft light falls upon her folding screen. The room is silent, save for the sound of our breathing.
Incense lit, abode cleaned, dust of the outside world swept away. All of these are my way of welcoming you, Commander.
Seeing you so vulnerably set foot into my home... Heehee, it makes my heart pound.
She stands before the hibachi brazier and raises a hand to beckon me.
To truly capture and preserve elegance, one must follow the traditional rituals step by step.
Before the incense-making begins, we shall begin the ritual of scent appreciation.
What should I do?
First, remove your outer garment. It carries the scent of the outside world.
Hakuhou's breath brushes against my ear as she helps me slip off my jacket.
Her faint fragrance wafts ever so slightly closer.
Now, we will start appreciating the scent of the incense.
The first step is quiet meditation.
Sit with your back straightened and mind cleared. Leave the distractions of the outside world behind.
When I sit up as directed, Hakuhou moves behind me. She places cool fingers on my shoulders, before tracing a path down my spine.
Slowly, slowly empty your mind... Yes, just like that.
Let go of trivial thoughts... and entrust your heart to me.
Through her gentle guidance, I relax my tense shoulders and neck.
Well done. The next step is purification of the hands.
She brings over a wooden basin and sets it atop the table. Flower petals sit atop the warm water within.
Only by washing away the world's impurities can we touch the truest essence of elegance.
Commander, please give me your hands.
Hakuhou gently cradles my hands and dips them into the water.
Ink and the sea breeze still linger on your fingertips.
I will wash them for you... until mine is the only scent remaining.
The touch of her fingertips is even more distinct in the water.
With the cleansing ritual complete, she dries my hands with a silk cloth. For some reason, the room feels just a touch warmer than before.
The final step is the synchronization of hearts.
Whether you're feeling or crafting the incense, a restless mind is your greatest hindrance.
Close your eyes, Commander... Listen to my breathing and try to match its rhythm.
When I close my eyes, I feel her heat even closer. Basking in her seductive fragrance, I feel my senses sharpen.
Good. Breathe in... and out...
Just empty your mind and follow my lead.
Let your sense of smell be enhanced as we breathe as one.
Now, we may finally get to the good part.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>3 Testing Fragrances</size>

scripts.say: By the time I opened my eyes again, Hakuhou had already finished making various preparations.
Incense materials sit neatly atop the table; the ash in the burner is in a smooth mound; and aromatic wood sits gently atop a silver leaf at its peak.
Now, Commander, I plan to blend a special fragrance for you. It's the scent of the courtyard.
But first, I want to ensure that the base note is to your liking.
She hands me the burner and leans in closer, guiding my motions with perfect grace.
You seem a little unfamiliar with this, Commander~
Take your right hand, like so... and cover the burner until there is only a slight gap.
Yes, just like that.
Then, inhale slowly... Feel the fragrance in its rawest form.
Wisps of smoke waft between my fingers.
At the same time, her scent and her exhales add an air of intimacy to the aroma.
How is it, Commander?
The fragrance within your palms is another fleeting moment of beauty.
If not cherished, if not held close, it will slip through your fingers.
If you want to keep what you treasure, you must hold it firmly... like so. Heehee...
Though docile, her voice is almost bewitching. It leaves me dazed for a moment.
Suddenly, there's a clatter.
Her loose sleeve had brushed against the table, knocking over a few dishes filled with incense powder.
Grains for making incense go flying, covering her sleeve and collar.
Are you okay? Did you get hurt?
No. My hand slipped a little is all.
But I'm in a rather awkward position right now...
Commander, could you help me clean up this powder?
Are you sure? I don't know much about this stuff. What if I mix it up, or...
Hmm... You have a point.
Still, a few of them have already mixed on me. Why not test the scent as it is now?
You mean... from on you?
Go ahead, Commander. Search for the elusive fragrance from the courtyard on me.
Only by finding the perfect base note can we make a fragrance just for us.
She adjusts her collar expectantly, revealing more of her powder-tinged neck.
Okay... I'll give it a try.
I lean in closer, following the trail of powder.
The cool crisp of cedar, the sweetness of flowers... Many different scents intertwine, but none of them quite match the fragrance of the courtyard.
It's a little too cool... This isn't it.
In that case, you might try elsewhere. There's no need to rush things... I'll stay with you for as long as it takes.
She brushes hair off of her shoulder, revealing the side of her neck.
As I trace the layers of fragrance, I find a faint, yet distinct scent.
...This is it.
Heehee... Your sense of smell is keener than I'd ever imagined.
Now that we've found our base note, we can begin refining the fragrance.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>4 Scents Shared</size>

scripts.say: After we'd found the fragrance we were looking for, Hakuhou cleaned the things off of the table.
Commander, you said before that you'd try to capture and preserve that beautiful moment.
However, we will need something else to accomplish that.
What are we missing?
You and I saw the scenery in the courtyard together.
If we want to capture that moment, then the fragrance cannot be completed by me alone.
You mean... we have to make it together?
That's right. It takes two to capture a moment for two.
We must join our hands and our hearts to blend the fragrance for it to have a truly elegant essence.
She sits on her knees next to me, pouring the finished incense powder into a jade bowl and pushing it my way.
Now, let's finish it together.
I knead the smooth, round lump of dough as directed.
Hakuhou covers my hands with hers.
To make it perfectly round, we need even pressure and a shared understanding.
Please follow my rhythm, Commander.
The fragrant wood and herbs must be thoroughly blended to draw out their deepest fragrance.
With her hands on mine, I knead, push, and roll the mixture.
Despite the occasional tickle of her fingertips, the clump gradually takes form.
If only you could be like this fragrance, allowing me to slowly, thoroughly understand you... inside and out.
Oh, how captivating that would be.
Hakuhou whispers affectionately, with a devotion that almost borders on obsession.
After much kneading and nurturing, the lump gradually turns into a perfect sphere, as if taking in our combined essence.
Do you feel it, Commander?
The fragrance is gradually absorbing our body heat and our memories.
All of today's events will remain as a memory inside it...
It will preserve this moment for me – and for you, Commander.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>5 The Fragrance of Three Scenes</size>

scripts.say: Before long, a perfectly round ball of lustrous incense lies atop a silk handkerchief.
Hakuhou smiles lovingly upon it, satisfied with our work.
It is done. Our love and warmth have permeated every ounce of this.
Since you so readily helped me, I must naturally offer you a gift of gratitude.
Please, sit. Allow me to light this for you.
She plucks the ball from the handkerchief and places it in the incense burner. After a moment, a wisp of smoke rises, filling the room with fragrance.
It's remarkably similar to the smell of the courtyard from earlier, though softer, and with a lingering aftertaste.
Incredible... It's almost like we brought the courtyard in here.
Almost like it's far from enough.
While we're at it, Commander, why don't we play a little incense game together?
A... game?
Yes... You and I shall feel the fragrances from three scenic places.
While there are three scenes, there is one boat to carry us through them.
She leans forward slightly and brushes her fingertips up my chest and to my neck, releasing the scent there.
Along with a tinge of her own fragrance.
Do you smell that? This scent contains your own warmth, though mixed with my traces.
Our breaths will melt together, creating the boat that carries your consciousness.
To prevent yourself from getting lost in the scenery, you must first memorize the vessel's aroma.
With a flick of her wrist, she wafts the aroma rising from the burner in my direction.
The fragrance we created together will be the first scene.
I close my eyes and slowly inhale the scent.
For a moment, it's as if I've been transported to the courtyard. I hear water rushing through bamboo, and I see leaves dancing in the wind.

options.content: It's like we turned back time.

scripts.say: Wow. It's like we turned back time.
That feeling means that your ship has made a smooth entrance upon the scene.
The beauty of fragrance is in its ability to transcend time and space, always returning you to the moment it represents.
It smells good, but... I feel a little light-headed. Like I'm in a dream, or something.
That would be because the fragrance is slowly quieting your mind.
The difference between reality and illusion is, at times, only a matter of whether your eyes are open or closed.
However, we've only just begun. Please join me as we journey to ever deeper elegance.
Don't worry. I will be here to watch over you so that you never lose your way.
Hakuhou's voice turns gentler, washing over my ears like the tide.
My thoughts slow down as my sense of smell sharpens.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>6 Between Dream and Fantasy</size>

scripts.say: While I bask in the afterglow of the first scene, the scent in the burner begins to change.
The serene aroma from before fades, being replaced with a softer, warmer fragrance that relaxes my tense muscles.
This one... is different.
That's right. This is the second scene.
What scene comes to mind, Commander?
You want me to guess?
Hmm... This warmth isn't like the courtyard. It's like being inside a room...
Heehee, you're not wrong.
This is the incense that I usually use at home.
It's more understated and relaxing than the scent of the courtyard.
Now, Commander... Do you feel a little more relaxed?
I think so... My body definitely feels lighter than before.
I'm happy to hear that.
A smooth fragrance spreads like a warm veil over my body.
The tension in my limbs melts away. Before I know it, I'm leaning back on the cushion next to me.
Hakuhou... I'm getting sleepy...
If you're tired, then don't push yourself. You're here to relax and rest easy.
Let me take care of your body and mind.
Her big sleeve and cascading hair slip into my field of view.
Her eyes, ever smiling, seem more profound than ever.
Your little boat has sailed so far, Commander...
And now, it has taken anchor in my arms.
She leans down over me and caresses my brow with her slender fingertips.
Commander... This is the final scene.
The scenes of the courtyard and my everyday life were all meant to lead you here.
From start to finish, all that I wanted you to remember, Commander... was me.
With that, she takes my hand and guides it to her chest.
I feel her heartbeat through my palm.
Do you feel it?
You caused this ripple within me – this final scene just for you.
If all things must end in goodbyes, then let us at least have this moment...
Gaze only at me, inhale only my scent, and keep only me within your memories.
Her soft murmurs, sweet scent, and body heat intertwine into a fine net that ensnares the last of my restraint.
In her arms, my consciousness drifts away into the depths of that dark ocean of fragrance.
Sink peacefully into the dream I made just for you, Commander.
Tonight, nobody will disturb us.

sequence:
Her Scent Lingers

<size=45>7 Eternity in an Instant</size>

scripts.say: The next day...
Mmnh...
I slowly open my eyes amidst a faint aroma.
When I try to move my body – which is as heavy as if I'm hungover – I realize that I'm in a gentle embrace.
Have you finally awakened?
The woman lying next to me smiles.
Morning sunlight beams through the folding screen, illuminating her eyes and the tips of her hair.
Heehee... Good morning, Commander.
Do you remember last night's game?
I remember... a little bit of it. Not very clearly, though...
It's okay if you don't. I'll remember all of it for you.
Besides, even when memory fades, the body and senses will still remember.
For example, the scent on you now...
I sniff a few times. Indeed, my skin and clothes are still tinged with that unmistakable fragrance from last night.
It still hasn't dissipated?
Of course not. It's nothing like the courtyard's fleeting fragrance.
There's a significant gleam in her eyes.
After all, it's a fragrance that I created to linger just for you... It will remain with you for a long time to come.
You could consider it... a brand I've left on you.
Were you planning this from the very start?
Heehee... It would be more accurate to say that I'd hoped it would happen.
Whenever you smell it, I hope that you'll remember the fragrance and scenery of last night – along with the person you spent it with.
That way, even when you leave, you'll be followed and embraced by my scent.
Keeping you away from all the commotion and troubles you'd otherwise be faced with...
She leans closer. Her voice is still a murmur, but I notice that it's unusually serious.
After all, I've left my mark on you forevermore.
Rest assured, my sweet Commander.
I'll always be by your side.
Our endless dream... has only just begun.

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>1 Off to New Era City!</size>
Graduation: the end of one era, and the beginning of another.
Some return to their old homes, while others choose to take their studies further.
Some cling to the idealistic dream of meritocracy, believing that hard work will guarantee their success.
Many rush headlong toward the excitement and hope represented by the big city.
For example, today's star and protagonist...
Javelin, a hopeful new job hunter.

scripts.say: We're all so proud of you, Javelin...
Worried too, of course.
Yeah...
It's a mix of pride and fear, really. New Era City No. 7 is just so far away, and it's such a big city.
Not to mention the poltergeists...
Exactly! They have monsters that look like vending machines. When you put a coin in, you hear creepy old nursery rhymes...
"Honeyade, honeyade, honeyade!♪"
Gosh! Quit trying to scare me, you two!
On the train station platform, wind stirred the tips of Javelin's hair, carrying her boundless dreams for the future.
Don't worry about me – I'm just looking for a job in the big city. It's not that scary!
Besides, I'm not the same Javelin who used to cheer "fight on!" in the club room!
Didn't you just try to pay for the subway with your student ID yesterday...?
O-old habits die hard, alright?!
Anyway, you'd better keep in touch while you're there! Don't trust ads that sound too good to be true, don't talk to strangers who randomly approach you, and don't wander around at night!
Also... If things don't work out, promise you'll come home to us.
We'll always have room for you back in hometown.
Hehe, thanks! But I'll show you all that I can make my own way!
The train entered the platform, its silver body shining in the morning sunlight. It was as an arrow poised to be loosed toward the future.
Javelin took a deep breath, hauled her luggage onto the train, and waved vigorously at her family – and her past – as they disappeared behind her.
Hello to my new life, the life of my dreams! Ready or not, here I come!
The train car was a little crowded for her taste, but the aroma of coffee lifted Javelin's spirits.
When she took her seat, the lights dimmed slightly. A three-dimensional map of their destination, New Era City No. 7, appeared before the passengers.
Oooh! What an incredible city!
It had better be. They put countless man-hours and infinite money into building it.
It's amazing to think that there are six more cities just as big as that one.
Wow, I see... Oh, it's nice to meet you! My name is Javelin, and I just graduated! What's your name?
I had a feeling. Call me Z23 – like you, I'm fresh out of school.
On that note, I've put together a list of companies I'm aiming for, a commuting map, my priority list of possible neighborhoods for renting in, and a three-month job-hunting plan.
W-wow, impressive...
If you want to work in the field of your dreams, then that's the kind of prep you need.
The field of your dreams... Do you want to be a teacher? An engineer? Or one of those elite white-collar jobs?!
Elite? *sigh*... Give up your crazy dreams of rising to the top overnight. You're gonna be a workhorse, and you'll have to learn to like it.
A girl in the seat opposite them stopped furiously typing on her laptop.
The city doesn't care about your dreams. It only cares about wringing your good years dry and pouring them down the drain.
Haha... Well, I think it's nice to have passion for your dreams.

As long as you don't end up like me... taking on loans to go to school, thinking you'd land a good job... only to miss out on a million other opportunities while your taxes, medical bills, and credit score become a mess.
After a long recounting of her own experiences, the black-haired girl practically exuded a gloomy aura.
A-anyway... I'm more scared of those poltergeists, you know?
One girl sitting in another seat timidly held up her Urban Survival Guide book.
By the way... what are these poltergeists that people keep mentioning?
You don't know?
Z23 looked surprised. But before she could explain, the train's PA system cut her off.
New Era City No. 7. Opportunity awaits, if you have the talent and initiative to seize it!
We're approaching the final stop. Please ensure you do not forget any of your belongings.
They play those every time you reach a station. You get used to it.
As for the poltergeists... Every glamorous city has its dark side. Watch yourself.
After the train exited a short tunnel, a tall cityscape came into view, a tapestry of mirrored glass and stainless steel.
Thus, the train slowed down to its last smooth stop.

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>2 Find Yourself a Home, Javelin! Fight On!</size>

scripts.say: Skyscrapers with reflective finishes pierced the clouds like a crystalline forest, while holographic billboards floated in midair, creating a kaleidoscope of color.
Holograms and giant screens filled the station, though they were invisible to the passersby rushing in and out at a dizzying pace.
This city was in constant motion – a well-oiled machine.
Hi there! Are you Javelin? I'm Hatsuzuki – it's nice to finally put a face to the name. Happy to be of service to you today!
A girl radiating raw energy appeared before Javelin, halting her plans to look around the city.
Huh? Oh... Okay! Were you the real estate agent I was talking to?
Correct! I didn't think you'd be here so soon. Wanna go see a few properties now?
Yes, please!
This one is in a fantastic location! City hall is within walking distance, and you can see a beautiful flow of energy when you wake up in the morning!
Oh, wow! What a nice view!
As for the price, it's...
Oh. Oh, my.
This residential area is known for its high safety rating and good reputation. You won't run into any poltergeists here!
Cool! Safety first, right?
As for the price, it's...
Eugh...
And this is... an unused rooftop storage room. It's nothing special, but it is cheap.
Oh... Y-you mean here?
This is the only place that fits your budget. You might have to consider it.
When it comes to renting, location and potential are what matter most! It might look shabby, sure, but if you change your perspective...
The rooftop is all yours! And look at that view! There's great airflow and natural light! Plus, you get a natural wake-up call from the breeze every morning!
A natural wake-up call from the breeze... Aren't you just saying the wind here is really strong?
It means direct contact with nature~ Look on the bright side – you won't have to pay as much for AC during the summer!
What about winter?
Buy another blanket, and you're set!
As Javelin hesitated, Hatsuzuki seized the opportunity to deal the finishing blow.
Besides, it's the top floor! You've got the penthouse suite, baby! Doesn't that sound fancy?
But...
Plus, no neighbors! Nobody to bother you or upstairs neighbors to throw loud dance parties in the middle of the night!
It's the roof! Of COURSE I don't have neighbors!
Sounds nice, doesn't it? Oh, wait a second. I just got a message...
Whoa. Looks like someone else has their eye on this unit. You'd better make a choice, and fast...
(Huh? Is a place like this really in high demand?!)
Wait, please! I... I want this unit! I've made up my mind!
(Oof... I didn't think rent would be so expensive here. At least I finally found a place I could afford.)
(Alright! Once I've found a job, I'm gonna save up money for a new place!)
(Fight on, Javelin!)

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>3 Ace That Interview, Javelin! Fight On!</size>

scripts.say: The next morning, Javelin woke up before her alarm could go off.
More precisely, she'd been jolted awake after rolling over and slamming her knee into an item next to her bed.
Owwww!
Hmph! Bad living conditions won't be enough to bring me down!
She stood before the bathroom mirror, making herself presentable for the day as she psyched herself up.
You can do this, Javelin! Be your best self and find stable employment today!
The office building's glass walls reflected dazzling light.
Clad in a suit, Javelin stood perfectly straight before her interviewer. Said interviewer, Alvitr, scanned her resume with a professional smile.
Thank you for meeting with me today! My name is Javelin, and I'm applying for the assistant role. I–
Just as she tried to recite the self-introduction template she'd read online, Alvitr cut her off.
That'll do, thank you. I can tell all I need to know from your resume... Let's get to the questions.
First, why did you choose our firm?
W-well, I've always aspired to work in this industry! Your firm is renowned – I've dreamed of working here ever since I was a little girl!
Hmm. So you've dreamed of working here. Not bad...
But a workplace is not somewhere for you to grow. It's somewhere for you to contribute.
Huh? A-ah, I suppose that's true...
Next question. I'd like to hear your career plans.
U-umm... I'd like to start from the basics and slowly work my way up the corporate ladder until I earn my place as an executive!
Mm. Do you think you have what it takes to advance that far? What are your strengths, exactly?
I have great social skills, and I learn fast! Also, I'm adaptable and a hard worker – whatever it takes to achieve my goals, I know I can do it!
Hmm, alright. I think that answers everything I need to know. Do you have any questions for me?
Umm... Do you think I have a chance of making it in? I really do want to work here!
We'll contact you after a thorough evaluation.
Oh, and I'm really good at learning new systems quickly–
I understand. We're done here for today, so please wait until we contact you again.
*sniffle*... I'm done for. Why are HR people so much meaner than the interview simulation games?!
After complaining to herself, she turned around and spotted Z23 coming out of another conference room.
Javelin? Did you come here for an interview, too?
Yeah. I don't think it went too well, though...
That's no surprise. I analyzed the position description last night, and I could tell that there's a clear hiring crisis going on here.
You'll get what I mean soon enough, I'm sure.
I see... Well, there's no use crying over spilled milk. Let's go get lunch together. I'm sure our next interviews will go better!
How about we go to that hamburger place downstairs?
After eating a delicious lunch and taking a breather, Javelin would begin a long chain of painful interviews.
Thank you for meeting with me today! My name is Javelin, and I'm a recent graduate...
I understand that the job description SAYS we prefer recent graduates, but we require three years of experience minimum. I'm sorry.
At the next interview...
I don't mind starting with grunt work! I've never been afraid of hard labor!
Your enthusiasm is noted, but we need people who can independently handle entire projects from start to finish.
At the next interview...
Regarding your assistant position...
While it is listed as an assistant position, you may be required to lead a team in the future, so you'll need project management experience~
At the next interview...
Umm...
Experience with student-run clubs... Hmm, I like your gumption. Still, that doesn't really align with our smart business ecosystem coordinator role...
Why... Why can't I pass a single interview?!
Some people just brush me off after skimming my resume. Am I really that lacking in abilities?
Excuse me, Miss? Are you having problems with people not appreciating your skills?
Huh? Who are you?
It's all about first impressions – presentation. Why don't you try out my resume optimization service?
You can turn "file organization" into "informational asset management," and "securing club funding" into "multi-party business negotiations." That's how you get an interviewer's eyes to pop.
Opt in now, and you'll get a 20% discount.
...Can we make that a 50% discount?
That evening, Javelin sat down on the steps outside of a convenience store, eating discounted onigiri.
Resume optimization had eaten through the rest of her savings. At this point, even she couldn't make sense of the exaggerated language on her own resume.
I hope they don't start saying I lack substance, or whatever...
Phew... Believe in yourself, Javelin! You've had to adjust to this city's pace today. Tomorrow, you're gonna make it work!

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>4 Javelin Got the Job?! Fight On!</size>

scripts.say: On her third morning in the city, Javelin was awakened by the sound of a notification.
Congratulations on passing our preliminary screening. You've been hired without an interview! Welcome to the company!
Phew... Heheh, dreams sure are crazy, huh?
Please come within one hour to complete the onboarding process. We will not wait any longer.
HUH?!
D-did I really get the job?!
She bolted upright, causing her to once again bump her knee. Pain and joy rushed through her in equal measure.
FINALLY! Finally, somebody wants me!
We offer better benefits than our competitors, with a two-day weekend and meals and accommodations provided.

An office building in the middle of the central business district shone gloriously in the sunlight. The boss, Kearsarge, guided Javelin toward the office area as she explained the company's perks and plans alike.
The office area was about fifty square meters, with dozens of computers stuffed into the space. However, nobody sat in front of any of them.
Huh? Has everyone not arrived for work yet?
They are working right now.
But...
It's not important right now. Efficiency is what matters here; we don't care for empty formalities.
Remember this. Every morning, at 9:00 AM, you must turn on every computer and ensure that they're running properly.
After sidestepping the question, she showed Javelin to her seat and then departed.
Without paying it too much mind, Javelin turned the computers on one by one, returned to her seat, and opened the company's intranet system.
Instantly after, a chat window appeared onscreen.
Whoa! Is this like a company group chat? Everybody's talking.
Let's see... "The company is our family and our home." "Offer your heart unto the company."
Those are some wacky slogans...
Wait, that profile pic is really familiar. Didn't I meet her on the train?
Orage (Resigned)
Ooh, so her name was Orage... Wait! That's not the point!
If she resigned, why is her profile pic lighting up? Why is she posting in the company group chat?!
Javelin opened a direct message window. Before she could say anything, however, she received a message from Orage first.
Hello. I am the digital avatar of Orage, a former employee. Feel free to ask me anything, and I will summarize the documentation from my time with the company.
What an insightful question. Digital avatars are AI agents created by recording, analyzing, and learning from an employee's work and habits. They're a key part of our company's strategy.
You're very perceptive. Would you like to know more about two-day weekends and provided food and accommodations?
Basically, two-day weekends mean having Saturday morning and Sunday night off work. The company provides all-you-can-eat white rice, and there are cots onsite that you are free to sleep in any time.
Please feel free to ask me anything else you'd like to know!
Where do I apply to resign?
Oof, I'm hungry... I should've eaten some of that white rice. Let me see if anybody replied to the other applications I sent out...
Javelin closed her eyes and put her hands together in prayer before opening her phone.
Project assistant role... No response.
Sales role... No response.
Community cleaning role... Nothing there, either?!
People don't even trust me to CLEAN?!
Wait... Someone's offering me a job?
Even though I only submitted my resume? They don't wanna interview me, or anything?
Déjà vu! This is totally suspicious... I'd better dig up some dirt on the place first this time.
She opened the job board and looked for info on the company.
Flexible work schedule, casual work environment, open management structure, transparent quotas...
It all SOUNDS like good things... but do I actually understand what it means?
Realizing that she needed to verify the truth for herself, Javelin contacted the company's online customer support.
Flexible work schedule means... working any 24 hours that you want, from midnight to midnight?
Open management structure means... the office is empty enough that wind can blow through it, and management can call you when they need you?
Transparent quotas means... everybody's performance gets displayed on a giant screen in front of everybody, 24/7?!
Javelin did not ask further questions. She put down her phone, which displayed her conversation with customer service. The last sentence was a direct message from them that said...
RUN AWAY AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>5 Are You Happy, Javelin? Fight On!</size>

scripts.say: Days passed one after another.
After constantly hitting different walls, Javelin finally saw a glimmer of hope in her job hunt.
Clutching a flyer, she paused and slowly read out the advertising print on it.
Discover your strengths and match with your future. Let the perfect job find you!
Hmm... It sounds a little too easy, doesn't it?
She looked up at the agency, covered in smiley-face images, and hesitated a moment before finally stepping inside.
I thought that name was awfully familiar. So it was you.
Oh! You're the experienced lady I met on the train!
Experienced... Umm, I suppose in terms of work experience, I may have more than you. Not that I'm doing particularly well with it...
Ahem. Never mind my life story. You're here to find a job? We have a test, so please start by filling this out.
(Huh? They're already giving me a written exam?!)
Javelin took a deep breath, solemnly accepted the sheet of paper, and began responding to it.
If you were a floor tile, where would you want to be laid?
(Um... What does this have to do with work, exactly?)
(Wait, wait! One of my interviewers said that work is all about service. Is that what the real point of this question is?)
(Then my answer should be... at the company entrance! Let's go with that.)
Have you ever stood in silence with a colleague in an elevator for more than 30 seconds?
(What kind of question is that?!)
Your results are in.

sequence: <size=45>Subject: Javelin</size>
<size=45>Key Traits: enthusiastic, positive, proactive, good influence on others</size>
<size=45>Happiness: poor</size>
<size=45>Recommendation: a role that involves positive interactions with others</size>

scripts.say: Poor happiness...
(I mean, who WOULD be happy when they've been struggling to find a job for days on end?)
It looks like there's an on-site maintenance position at a children's playground. Would you like to try that?
Yes, please!
Hmm... Based on your resume, you have great initiative and experience with on-site coordination. You've handled unexpected emergencies during club activities before, I'm sure.
Yes! I've dealt with everything from equipment malfunctions to scheduling delays and last-minute staff absences!
Excellent. Unexpected emergencies are really the name of the game here – children crying, balloons flying off, machine malfunctions, parents going crazy in front of their children...
And I like your approachable demeanor.
Thank you very much!
But... I'm sorry to say, but you may not be the right fit for this position at the moment.
(Th-this again?!)
Why...?
Miss Javelin. The core requirement for on-site maintenance staff is the ability to show a stable and abundant stream of happy energy for the kids.
Your happiness level is... below our standard at this time. I'm sorry.
P-please! I can be happy! I really can!

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>6 Danger Approaches, Javelin! Fight On!</size>

scripts.say: Wow... You rejected me because I haven't been super happy lately?
New Era City No. 7 was founded to bring a happier future to everybody.
That's why, for service-oriented roles such as ours, we place greater importance on the quality of emotional labor.
It isn't enough to just get the job done – you have to be able to convince others that you're deriving joy from your work.
With that, Arizona flashed a flawless customer-service smile.
Despite that... most people in this city have low levels of happiness.
Which is why I told you to hold onto your passion for your dreams.
I understand... I'll do my best to become happier. Then, I'll come back.
Do your best. I pray we'll meet again – and that you'll be happier and cheerier when that time comes.
By the time she left the staffing agency, it was already nighttime.
Dejected, Javelin aimlessly walked the streets, clutching the evaluation results until the edges of it were crumpled by her tight grip.
Enthusiastic, positive, proactive... but not happy enough.
I can't be happy if I don't have work, and I can't work if I'm not happy, and not having work makes me unhappy. It's a negative spiral!
As she was steeped in melancholy, she didn't even realize that there was no foot traffic on the street.
Eventually...
Bzzzzt...
What's that sound?
Huh? Where... am I? Why isn't there anybody around?!
No cars.
No wind.
No footsteps.
Only that strange sound, like the static hiss of an old television, came from behind her.
Javelin whipped around.

sequence:
Fight On! The Ultimate Job-Hunting Operation!

<size=45>7 Javelin's Last Stand! Fight On!</size>
When you fail to find a job in the big city, struggle to find a room, run low on funds, and feel your happiness slipping away...
Only to find yourself being hunted by poltergeists in the dark of night...
Only then...
Have you truly experienced...
A "Job Change".

scripts.say: Wh-what was that?!
A paranormal phenomenon? A monster? Or... one of those poltergeists?!
She sprinted desperately down the empty street.
The poltergeist chased her endlessly, leaving eerie black afterimages behind it.
Despite her attempts to flee, it was gaining on her.
I'm gonna run out of stamina at this rate! I have to think!
She quickly rounded a corner. When she looked around, she spotted an old phone booth by the roadside!
*pant*... *pant*... I think I lost it.
She had kicked an empty can as a distraction before jumping into the phone booth, leading the poltergeist in a different direction.
I'd better call the police now, while I still can!
BEEP... BEEP... BZZT... Unable to connect to the number you have dialed. Please wait and try again.
I-I can't WAIT right now! I don't think I have much time left!
Ugh, I've tried so many times, and it still won't work...
Is this some kind of pocket dimension? Am I trapped in here?!
The poltergeist paced leisurely beneath dim streetlights, as if enjoying its prey's panic.
No, no... You gotta stay calm, Javelin. There must be a way out of this!
I'll have to find an escape route myself. Let's see... Huh? What's that?
Amidst the myriad flyers plastered across the booth's wall – locksmiths, relationship advice, psychic readings, and more – a simple black-and-white advertisement caught her eye.

sequence: <size=45>Office of Paranormal Affairs</size>
<size=45>Recruitment & Incident Response</size>
<size=45>No experience needed. We welcome all with courage, responsibility, and adaptability.</size>
<size=45>We specialize in handling all manner of supernatural phenomena and have extensive experience with poltergeists.</size>
<size=45>24-hour hotline: *88888888#</size>

scripts.say: Surely... they won't appear out of thin air the moment I call them, right?
Ugh, what does it matter? I've got nothing left to lose!
Javelin dialed the number one by one. Almost instantly, the call connected.
I pick up the phone. After putting it on speaker mode, I start throwing on my gear.
This is the Office of Paranormal Affairs. Describe your location and the nature of your problem.
Please, help me! I ran into a shadowy monster, and it's been chasing me ever since! I'm hiding in a phone booth right now, but it's still around!
Location confirmed. Please stay calm and remain where you are. Repeat my name: {playername}.
{playername}……
I'm coming.
(Is that person really going to come?)
Clutching the receiver tightly, Javelin repeated the name over and over as her heart was pounding.
Just then, the poltergeist suddenly lunged. The phone booth lurched, the lights flickered, and dark streaks appeared on the glass wall.
NOOOOO!
You're safe now.
A beam of light pierced the darkness.
That pure, sharp ray of light sliced clean through the poltergeist's twisted form.
Over the next few minutes, Javelin watched through the booth's glass wall as an incomprehensible battle unfolded.
(Aren't you afraid? I mean, you're up against a poltergeist! Those freaks hunt people like me down!)
When the final blow was struck, the poltergeist burst into a single wisp of smoke, before being sucked into a special device.
Containment complete.
(So cool...)
Are you the one who reported this anomaly? Do you feel anything unusual?
Here, take my hand. I'll take you to the office for registration and inspection.
(Not just cool... This person came to me in my time of need, effortlessly saved my life, and is even hot to boot!)
...Are you okay?
Hwuh?! I'm just fine! I-I-I can get home on my own!
She frantically shook her head in embarrassment, but as soon as she stepped out of the phone booth, she remembered something and turned around.
Say... You're recruiting, aren't you?
Lately, I've been looking for a job... I-I think I'm pretty proactive, and I don't give up when the going gets tough! And, and...
If it means working with you... I'd work really, really hard! So...
She realized that she was blushing as she stammered out her plea.
I'll even work part-time!
So may I please follow you for the rest of my life?
For the rest of your life? That sounds a bit... much. Ahem.
New recruits at the OPA typically start out in clerical roles.
But we're short on field op team members, so what if you came and sat in on a few calls first?
You mean it?!
Yep. Welcome to the Office of Paranormal Affairs.
Javelin froze up for a moment, but before long, her face lit up.
Thank you!
I'll work harder than I ever have!
Fight on, Javelin!
Commander, I can't find my raiment... Have you seen it anywhere?
Yes, that'd be great.
Thank you, Commander♪
I see... It's a very important treasure to me. Leaving it outside was not the best idea.
I'll keep looking for it.
Commander... You found me. Heheh!♪
I waited for you here for so long... Let's play already~
let'S pLaY TOgETHer!
Hee hee! I got a lot of stuff to play with~
Oh... Then we can meet up later?
Commander, look~
Hee hee! What do you think? Is my smile sweet?
If you lie, you'll be in a world of trouble~
Aww, commander knows what to say~♪ Now, close your eyes. Here is a reward♪ Mwah~
Huh? Come here, I'm gonna make you look at me smile until you get it~
Commander, don't you wanna stay here?
Together with me... Forever and ever...

options.content: Sure. I'll stay with you as much as you want.

scripts.say: Heheh! Just kidding. I'm not THAT selfish~
Guess I'm still not cute enough...
Oh, Commander. Can I have a minute?
I have to duck every time I go in and out of this door. Isn't there an easier way to get around?

options.content: Maybe I could take your hat?

scripts.say: Good idea!
Can you reach out and take it? Heheheh~
Not as simple as it sounds... What a shame.
Sadly, City Hall's budget is limited.
Oh, excuse me. My little babies just get so frisky whenever you're around.
They're just very curious, really~ They want to know your temperature and how you feel to the touch.
Are you scared of them, maybe?

options.content: Just need to get used to them.

scripts.say: You truly have nerves of steel~
Well then, may I let them check firsthand? Or... first-tentacle?
That's okay~ It takes time to get familiarized.
Let's take it slowly~
Hm... Sorry, am I a little too close?
You have such a gentle and sweet scent... I couldn't help but get drawn in.
Am I being a bother, maybe?

options.content: Just makes me a little nervous.

scripts.say: Heheh, I'll help myself, then~
Relax, would you? I know not to take it too far... I think...
That's good~ Nervousness and disgust are not the same thing, after all.
I'll try taking things a little slower from now on~
I've been waiting for you, Commander.
Don't be scared, please. I'm not a man-eating fox. I was just hoping we could have some tea together♪

options.content: I still have some urgent business to attend to...

scripts.say: Go right ahead and take a seat next to me.
I prepared some sweets to go with the tea. I hope you like them.
Oh... That's a shame...
Just as I was about to spend a moment enjoying the view, it started raining.
But this gentle drizzle is quite charming in its own way, right?
Commander, would you care to share an umbrella with me and take a stroll in the rain?

options.content: Let's wait until the rain stops.

scripts.say: Lovely. Let's go.
If I were to lose my footing and fall right into your arms, make sure you catch me♥
Hee hee, that's fine too. It'd be a shame to get this lovely yukata dirty.
I've been feeling something that I must put into words.
This fate that we have nurtured together...
It might bloom and bear fruit this very day...
Yes, I think the same♡
Haah... I guess it might be a bit too soon just yet.
Rumors say that bad spirits roam these halls...
If one of those ghosts was to find a lost cute little lamb just like you...
They would eat you right up~

options.content: I know you'd never do such a thing.

scripts.say: Heheh, there's really no fooling you~
Heheh, may we meet another time.
Commander, can you hear it?
That lovely melody drifting in from beyond the skies?
I knew it. You can hear the stars singing in harmony too, can't you?
It's fine if you can't hear it just yet.
When the time comes, I'll take you to the cosmos myself, and we can listen to that beautiful movement together.
Let me just sneak up closer... And when you least expect it... Boo!
Oh, you don't look surprised at all. I wouldn't have expected any less~
What are you doing out here so late? Looking for something?
Oh, you were looking for little ol' me? I'm so happy!
Commander, what would you like to do with me now that you found me?
In that case... Feel free to rely on me if you ever need anything.
Ghosts don't need to sleep, so they get very lonely at night.
Forced to wander all alone until dawn breaks...
Commander, can I stay by your side tonight?
Heehee, promise not to get spooked if I get a little frisky and sneak under the covers♪
I see... I understand. Getting rest is a very important thing.
Owner~ Look up~♪
Welcome to my fairy tale maze!
You're not getting out of here until you play with me to my heart's content!
Heehee! Yay! You're super sweet to me♪
Work? Geez!
What work could ever be more important than me?
Owner~ Don't you wanna get stronger? I can help you with that♪
You just have to drink this magic potion...
Whoa, so decisive! Hee hee, that's what I love about you!
I'll give you a big hug as a reward~
Ooh~ I could give it to you mouth-to-mouth.
Nothing to be scared of that way, right?
Now you don't see me... And now you see me~♪
Hee hee, do you like surprises like this?

options.content: A little too much for my heart.

scripts.say: Whoa, you look a little shook...
Seeing you all defenseless like that gets me a little frisky~♪
I can keep going if you like it so much!
Though... I really wanna snuggle together right now♪
I'm patrolling an alleyway with Lion when a sudden night breeze blows through. She covers her face with both hands.
Tsk, the wind blew my mask away for a second there...
Commander... Did you see anything just now?

options.content: It was too dark to see much.

scripts.say: Oh, you're such a flatterer.
If that's how you wanna play it... Don't run away if I come closer, okay?
Really?
Heh... Very well, then.
Lion slows down her pace as we walk past a toy store, seemingly curious about the lion plush on the display shelf.
Ahem! I'm just a little tired from all the walking.
Why don't you take a look? Maybe you'll find something you wanna buy?
That lion plush... It has a very imposing presence.
Heheh, you've got a good eye for quality♪
...I see.
Then I won't get anything either. Let's go.
That's a big pile of documents you got piled up. Better get rid of them soon.
Commander, which blade do you think would work best? Scissors? A razor? Just a box cutter?
Gotta choose the right tool for the job... Wouldn't want anyone to get hurt, would we?~

options.content: You're right. Let's clean up together.

scripts.say: You're so thoughtful.
But... What are you worried about? Me getting hurt? Or someone else getting hurt?
Heheh... Anyway, I'll take the help.
Hm... I guess that's an option.
I sort of made it harder than it had to be with an easier option right there, didn't I?
I've been spending so much time with you and away from the water that my skin is getting dry...
So, wanna go for a swim?
Okay, let's get going.
Don't worry, I won't let you drown or anything! You have me to protect you.
Hot spring... That does sound nice.
But it's probably gonna be hot, so I wanna go get an ice pop first.
Commander, are you out on a patrol?
It could get dangerous out there, so let me tag along.
Good choice. I'll keep an eye out for any potential danger.
Ugh... Okay.
But call me right away if anything looks dangerous.
Commander, have you noticed my wings? I feel they're not shining as bright as they used to.
Do you know why that might be?

options.content: You look the same to me.

scripts.say: I may not have been getting as much sleep as I should...
I guess even a star's brilliance fades when they're exhausted.
So, to regain that luster... Commander, could you keep me company in getting some rest?
I see...
I may be overthinking things.
Commander, don't go into the bath alone. No matter what.
It'd be really bad if you lost track of time and got dizzy, so...

options.content: It won't be dangerous if you're with me.

scripts.say: True enough. If I stay by your side and protect you at all times, you can bathe safely.
And so, I'll go together with you.
You can't let your guard down even during a shower.
It'd be dangerous if you slipped and hit your head.
So just to be safe, I'll wait outside the bathroom.
Snowflakes dance as they're whipped up by the strong winds. In the middle of it all stands Shoukaku, with nothing but an umbrella to shield herself as she seems to wait for someone.
Ah... Hello, good sir. Could you please assist me?
I've lost my way... And I can't seem to find my way back.

options.content: Where do you live? I'll walk you there.
Sorry, I need to hurry somewhere...

scripts.say: You're such a kind soul.
I may spend my whole life trying to repay this kindness...
I see... Well, go right ahead.
But I want to leave as well, so would you mind if I follow you?
The next day, a lovely flute melody drifts along the wind.
Ah, it's you. My savior...
I was playing this tune for you.

options.content: It's beautiful. You can play the flute, huh?

scripts.say: Just a little bit. I was able to bring you here with my melody, so I'd say that's more than good enough.
The melody of this flute is for nobody's ears but yours♪
Strange, you say? Maybe the snow is making the melody sound strange.
Or maybe you're just imagining things... Try not to pay any mind to such trivial things~
Shoukaku stands still like a statue in the middle of a snowfield. I offer her the bottle of warm water I had been holding onto.
Ah, my savior... Your kindness warms my heart.
You've been nothing but kind to me. How do you expect me to repay you?~

options.content: No need to repay me. I just wanna help.
Yeah, I expect you to work hard.

scripts.say: My savior... If you say such things, I will never be able to leave your side~♥
Is that all? Ah, my sweet savior. You're such a cruel workaholic...
I-14 usually stays holed up in her room without interacting with others.
Commander... You're here.
Is there anything you want from me?

options.content: I wanted to hear your thoughts.

scripts.say: My thoughts?
I don't know... Where should I begin?
Food... I'm not that hungry...
But thank you for thinking about me.
I-14 stares at the mask in her hand with an inscrutable expression on her face.
*Bubble* *Bubble*... You're here.
What do you wanna talk about today?

options.content: Do you have any hobbies? I'd like to try them.

scripts.say: Wanna blow bubbles together?
A disguise tool. That's all...
Wearing it only makes you feel empty...
You want me to stop using my disguise powers?
Why?

options.content: I want to see the real I-14.

scripts.say: ...Okay. I promise not to do it again.
...Whatever. I was planning on not using them again anyway.
Commander, the elevator suddenly got stuck, and the door won't open.
What should I do?

options.content: It must be broken down. I'll go help right away.
Why don't you call the maintenance company?

scripts.say: All right. I'll be waiting for you~
I'm so relieved to know you're coming. I'll be waiting right here~♥
I think that kind of company's been obsolete for at least a decade now...
I'll think of some other way to get out of here.
This building is so drab and dimly lit all year round. I'm so fed up with it.
I'd like to change the atmosphere a little. Do you have any ideas?

options.content: How about changing the ceiling lights to rotating colored lights?
I think it's good as it is.

scripts.say: Now that's an unusual idea... But yes! It'd really make for a fresh atmosphere!
I'll go get some right away!
Are you sure?
Very well. I'll think of something on my own.
Commander, did you hear?
Did you hear a weird sound coming from the elevator?

options.content: I think it's time to get a new one.

scripts.say: Agreed.
Actually, scratch that. I think it's about time for a brand new building!
I've never liked this beat up, decrepit pile of rubble♪
People who say things like that don't usually make it far in horror movies, you know?
The office at night is such a lonely place to be♥
Seeing you so tired after such a hard day of work...
It makes all of my love for you overflow out of my chest♥

options.content: Why are you on my screen?
I still have some work left.

scripts.say: Heheh, it's because I can watch you better from here~♥
Heheh, it looks like you forgot you actually have a more important job waiting for you.
Hah... This boundary is harder to cross than I imagined, huh?
Commander, wait for me right there♥
Heheh, how kind of you to give me a helping hand.
Pull a little harder and you'll have me right in your arms♥
Oh, did I make you concerned?
It's fine. This is nothing for me♥
Commander, I want to be by your side right now♥

options.content: Right now? I better get ready.

scripts.say: Yes, please do~♥
Look at me now..
I'll go to you, one step at a time♥
Heheh, time is like water in a sponge. You can always squeeze out a little more.
And I'll squeeze out as much of your time as I can.♥
You know what lurks in the dark...
But I see that doesn't stop you from just waltzing on by.
Heheh... I'll go ahead and take everything from you♥

options.content: Things aren't just gonna go the way you want.
That... includes my unfinished work too?

scripts.say: Heheh, I'm looking forward to seeing how long you can hold out~♥
Well... I'm not interested at all in your boring paperwork.
This dance requires a partner.
Only one who can hold onto sanity like you would be worthy of taking my hand.
So, would you grace me with a dance?

options.content: I'm not falling for your traps that easily.

scripts.say: Ah, so you saw right through me. However...
Don't you wish to have a dance with me as well?
Aww, how sweet of you.
Come, give me your hand. And do try to keep up.
I thought it would only be a matter of time until I corrupted you...
You've done well to last this far.

options.content: Actually, I was spacing out a little there.

scripts.say: The determination in your eyes is simply exhilarating...
I can't wait to see it shattered to a million pieces♥
Under the gaze of the abyss... and you still daydreaming?
*sigh*... I could never hope to match that dull intellect of yours.

sequence: Warning: Please read this before watching the video.
This video features strong flashing lights. If you experience symptoms such as dizziness, blurred vision, disorientation, confusion, or temporary loss of consciousness...
Please raise your hand right away. We'll pause the video and arrange for prompt medical assistance.

scripts.say: Bonjour~ Welcome to new recruit orientation at the Office of Paranormal Affairs!
The screen lit up, and a smiling girl in formal attire appeared in the center of the screen.
Before we begin, please make sure your mobile devices are set to silent mode.
Even if you hear a bell ring, a knock, or someone whispering in your ear from behind...
Make sure not to react in any way, shape, or form! We'll have all those pesky bothers sorted out after the training~
Very well, then. Let's take it easy and dive right in~♪
First, allow me to introduce our company.

We at the Office of Paranormal Affairs are in charge of investigating supernatural incidents within the limits of the New Era City No. 7 that are a touch too "irregular" for other departments to handle.
And our goal is quite simple: to resolve these incidents, contain the anomalies we encounter, and restore peace and order to the city. That's all there is to it.
Next, let's talk about the main duties of our officers.

If the need arises, you could be sent out together with friendly poltergeists that the Commander has brought to our side. Your duty is to cooperate with them to find poltergeists causing trouble, reason with them, and bring them back to the office.
As for poltergeists that are less amenable to reason... just leave the task to a partner who can "persuade" them more effectively~
Lastly, let us talk about security measures to keep in mind while on a mission~
Let's say, for example, that you noticed there's one more person in your group than when you started the mission.
In such cases, seek help from the Commander. Follow any instructions you receive to the letter, no matter what.
And that concludes our first training session~ Once again, welcome to the Office of Paranormal Affairs~
I pray with all my heart that your missions are successful and that you clock out each day feeling good about your job... and your sanity~ Merci!
The recording finishes playing, and the screen slowly goes dark.
Commander? The video is done playing, you can come out of the studio now~
The voice comes not from the screen, but from outside the door.
As I stand up to leave the room, my eyes are drawn to a lavishly decorated frame portrait behind the brightly lit reception desk.
The girl from the video is inside the portrait, resting a hand on the painting's frame and speaking to me with expectation lining her voice.
What do you think of the recruit training video I prepared? Lovely, isn't it?
Yeah. It was simple and to the point. It left a great impression.
Great~ Next time we get a newcomer, leave the induction to me♪
The human agents and our new friends that come out of the walls and mirrors need help to acclimate themselves to this environment.
So I'll do my best to make this a welcoming and cozy place for them to get acquainted♪
Commander, you shouldn't go out alone like that... It's dangerous, you know?
A red light blinks in the alleyway. And Lion, who completely evaded my notice, approaches slowly like a predator.
She's wearing a black face mask and a tight fitting dress that doesn't leave much to the imagination.
You ought to be a little more careful during your patrols.
If you're not... You might end up too careless to notice yourself walking into a lion's mouth like a poor little lamb.
The cool night breeze makes her warm breath brushing against my ear more noticeable.
You know the rules, don't you?
You entered my territory, so you're going to have to answer a few questions.
Do you find me beautiful?
Heh... Very good. You know how to please a girl.
Staying silent can often be seen as a confession, you know?
Then... How about now?
She raises her hand and removes the mask covering her face. Under the dim street light, a slit extending out of the corner of her mouth comes into view.
Do you still... find me beautiful?
I look her straight in the eye and nod.
At the same time, I open the paper bag I'm carrying and take out several cute Lion plushies of various sizes.
I figured we might meet tonight, so I prepared these.
Hmph, you're quite the effective handler, I see.
She harrumphs, but a lovely smile pulls at the corners of her mouth.
I'm pleased. However, you still trespassed into my territory without permission. Surely you don't think a single gift will be enough to sate me, do you?
Without any warning, I'm completely enveloped in her softness.
Oh, you're quite docile.
If you're so eager to please, I'll have to reward you a little.
But before I can even say anything, she plants a kiss on my lips.
The moment our lips meet, the cool breeze contrasts the warmth of her lips.
After a moment, she reluctantly parts the kiss with a satisfied look on her face.
Heh... It looks like you're really enjoying my reward.
She leans closer and whispers into my ear.
I'm pleased with your performance tonight.
And so... Don't even think of trying to leave my side.
As night falls, I go to take a stroll around the beach. The sound of the crashing waves seems even more serene than it is during the day.
Suddenly, without warning, something catches my ankle, and I am pulled away from the edge of the waves.
That was a close one, Commander...
There I see a girl standing by the water's edge, illuminated by a small lamp.
Hostile? You pulled me back?
Yes... You were standing in a spot where it's easy to get swept away by the waves.
Her tone is uninterested and matter-of-fact, as if she were only ascertaining my safety out of a sense of duty.
The tide here is faster than during the day. It's not safe to walk up to it in the dark.
This way, Commander.
Hostile doesn't explain further. She simply takes my hand and guides me to a safer spot.
You're familiar with the area?
I come to watch the waves often.
Over here. This reef is safe.
The reef isn't very big. The warm light of the lamp shines onto the white fabric, making her radiate with the beauty of a dainty moon.
I'm captivated by the sight, and feel the cold seawater rise to my feet as the waves crash against the edge of the reef.
The tide is rising. Commander, come closer.
She takes my hand again and pulls me closer to her.
Closer.
She carefully gauges the distance between us and the edge of the reef before shaking her head.
Commander, hold onto me. Tight.
Her command comes out so naturally that I'm stunned for a moment.
The rocks are slippery, and a wave will come from that side in a moment. You'll lose your balance when it does.
...Though I would save you even if you were to fall into the water.
But...
Hostile pauses, seemingly searching for a convincing enough reason.
But if that happens, you could catch a cold.
So hold onto me before something bad happens.
Faced by her steady gaze, I put my arms around her shoulders and hold onto her tight.
Hostile lowers her gaze and hugs me back.
This is all for your safety.
The translucent white fabric dances in the sea breeze, brushing softly against the back of my hand.
The cool fabric takes in the light, revealing the contours of her figure.
Commander... Could you call me whenever you're off on night patrol here from now on?
I remember the direction of the tides, and I know where the dangerous areas are.
If you order me to, I will always stand by you.
She says, before slowly shaking her head again.
You don't need to order me to, actually.
If it's to protect you, I'll always be there for you.
So... Let me stay by your side forever. And... never let go.
I see a beautiful figure, clad in white robes and holding an umbrella. She's standing alone, facing the raging blizzard with an aura of pure and tender grace.
A thin layer of snow piles up on the cuffs of her kimono, and the edge of the umbrella hides half her face.
Excuse me, kind traveler.
Would you be so kind as to offer shelter to a crane stranded by this blizzard?
Her voice is faint, as if she is trying to avoid startling the swirling snowflakes. Still, I sense a smile that her tone can't quite conceal.
Shoukaku... Is this a new performance?
Heehee, so you saw right through my ruse.
I thought I'd be able to fool you a bit longer with this outfit.
She comes closer and takes me under her umbrella.
And yes. I'm performing a story called "The Crane's Gratitude"~♪
In the legend, a rescued crane secretly weaves a beautiful brocade to present to her savior.
I may not know how to weave fabrics, but I certainly can weave sweet dreams for you with my flute's melody. Will you stay and listen for a spell?
Of course, I'd love to.
Shoukaku gives me a satisfied look and brings the flute to her lips. The sound cuts through the raging wings, echoing with pure grace like the falling snow.
The snow seems to dance along with her gentle melody, as if a glistening silver veil is being woven around us.
I hold the umbrella for her, and as my gaze lowers, I see her fingertips are bright red from the cold.
Aren't you cold?
Heehee. How could I credibly ask for shelter if I did not feel the bite of the cold at all?
This is just my way of showing you my gratitude. And it may be a little selfish of me to ask... but you don't think less of me for this, do you?
Instead of answering, I take her hand and pull her closer to me.
...Does my pain make your heart ache?
I can't leave a defenseless crane alone in a blizzard.
Shoukaku seems flustered for a moment, but then she snuggles closer and accepts my embrace. Before long, her cold hands warm up in mine.
Mmh, your hands are so warm, my savior♪
But while my hands are warm now, there's another spot that's still rather chilly.
Where's that?
Right here♪
Her gratitude act melts away, and she simply smiles before imprinting her affections upon my lips with her own.
Her warmth is so intense that it leaves me breathless for a second.
The night is still young. You can look forward to my gratitude even more... And in so many ways too♪
While the snow covers all around us, the sound of her flute keeps our little nest warm.
I open the sliding door, and I'm faced with several masks floating in midair – as well as I-14 herself.
What did you come here for today?
After glancing at me through the mirror, she casually turns to face me.
Just came to check on you. You haven't come out at all in a few days, so I got a little worried.
I did go out, though...
She looks down, her fingers gently caressing the edge of a mask.
I've been looking at you from a distance. Just blending in with the crowd.
It's only natural that you didn't notice. I was hiding myself.
But why?
Well... If I don't put on a mask, you'll see my real face.
That'd feel weird... I don't know how to face others like that...
She keeps caressing the mask. For her, they are a safe shell to retreat into.
As long as I wear the mask, no one will be disappointed in the real me. I won't have to try and figure out what others think of me, either.
But, I like you just the way you are.
...The way I am?
Yes. The I-14 who doesn't need to hide behind anything.
I-14 lowers her head before looking back at me. I see confusion and apprehension in her eyes.
I'm a poltergeist. Even if I can blend in, I'm nothing more than an abnormality inside of a shell.
What is there to "like" about that...?
It's fine if you don't get it.
But there's something you need to know.
I walk over to her, crouch down to her level and gently pull down the hand she's still resting on the mask.
Her fingers twitch anxiously, but she doesn't try to retreat.
At least in front of me, you don't need to hide yourself.
Y-you can't just say that...
She looks away, but I see a little hint of red on her ear.
You don't need to change yourself. But at least don't feel the need to hide yourself here.
If... If you're with me, maybe I could give it a try.
She says, wrapping her arms around my back and burying her face in my chest.
I'll try it... We can go out tomorrow, and I won't wear the mask.
Though her face is still red from embarrassment, she levels her breathing quickly.
Yeah, that sounds great.
Please, can we stay like this a little longer?
It feels nice... To know that you care so much...
The elevator doors slowly slide open with a shrill metallic creak.
I quickly get on and press the button to go to the first floor. I feel the familiar slight weightlessness as the elevator begins its descent.
But after the display flickers between numbers ominously, the elevator suddenly stops. Beyond the closed glass doors stands a red corridor.
Trying to sneak out again, Commander?
A familiar voice rings from the end of the corridor. There, Azuchi steps out of the shadows.
This building is so quiet that you could hear a pin drop...
The perfect place for us to be all alone.
I figure we could spend some nice quality time together...
So why are you in such a hurry to leave?
Do you not like this place? Or... Maybe you're afraid of me?
She tilts her head curiously as a wicked smile plays about her lips.
The red light of the hallway flickers, and each time it comes back, she closes the distance between us a little more.
Let me enlighten you... This is not a place you can just stumble upon and leave whenever you fancy~♪
I haven't had enough of you just yet.
As she speaks, the lights on both ends of the corridor suddenly go out.
Everything goes eerily silent, and all I can hear is my increasingly ragged breathing.
The only thing the faint light of the elevator reveals is the palm of Azuchi's hand pressing against the glass.
Heheh, you're just so adorable♥
Commander, you're supposed to be good at communing with the poltergeist, right?
So none of this should be a mystery to you.
I couldn't be farther from the concepts of normalcy or rightness on a basic level.
And yet...
You decided to get close to me.
The elevator door starts creaking under the otherworldly pressure emanating from her.
And the gap between the sliding doors starts widening.
Heheheh, that little scare just now was just the appetizer. Shall we get to the main course now?♪
Let me taste that sweet determination of yours from up close♥
The elevator doors are pried open with a heavy thunk, and the subsequent shaking of the elevator makes me lose my balance.

Despite the narrow and dimly lit nature of the cage, all I can see is blurs of Azuchi's fair skin and the red of her dress. When I finally get my bearings back, I see her looking down at me with a leg raised.
I came for you, Commander.♥
Oh? Did you trip and fall? Heheh.
Ah, yes. Where were we again?
There are so, so many things I want to do with you♥
I'm sure you get where I'm going with this, don't you?
Before I can even try to get up, she slowly lifts her leg and presses her toes against my shoulder.
She doesn't use much force, and her demeanor seems playful, but I get the message that she won't allow me to resist.
Azuchi moves over her toes from my shoulder to my chin and lifts my face up until we're making eye contact.
Don't hide anything.
We'll be getting as close as two can be from now on.
Or... Was all the determination you showed thus far just bravado?
Azuchi glides her bare leg all across my body. She pokes my sides, and slowly draws circles on my chest to tease me.
Every time I try to stand up, she steps down on my chest, and I'm back on the floor.
Give it up. You're not going anywhere without my permission♥
It's clear she's appraising me, savoring my reactions and feeling around for new kinds of stimulation.
How strange...
You should be despairing in terror when subjected to such a horrifying punishment.
And yet... Your expression is not quite what I had in mind.
Heheh. That's rather refreshing.
It seems I underestimated you. You truly are one of a kind.
Why... You make me want to try more and more new things♥
Azuchi looks at me longingly, her wild smile sending shivers up and down my spine.
Do show me how long you'll last♪
Why... We have all the time in the world to find out♥
It's my long awaited time off. On Tiger's suggestion, I've come to a quiet mountain retreat where we're planning to spend a relaxing weekend together.
But as soon as we arrive, she's drawn by the sound of a small brook, and rushes out on her own. I follow the little stream and find her basking in the shimmering waters.
Oh, Commander. Your steps are half a beat faster than I expected.
Her lower body is half-submerged in the shallow water, and she's keeping a box with a raiment inside next to her.
Heehee, I know that expression. Are you really that surprised to see me like this?
Even the stars above need to borrow from the earth's water to cleanse themselves.
And you're just in time. The movement is still underway... If you join in, it'll make for an even more wonderful ensemble.
Tiger gently shakes, sending water splashing everywhere.
I approach, scoop up some water, and pour it over her bare skin.
Please, here too... Could you silence this discordance?
I reach out a hand towards her back. My fingertips brush against her skin, making her shudder as small ripples break through the water's surface.
Is this okay?
Hm... Our breathing is in sync♪ But there's still one thing... The discordance just won't go away.
Come closer. I'll tell you where it's hiding...
She takes my hand and gently guides it to the flickering shadows just beneath the water's surface.
But then, I slip on a smooth river stone, falling onto her.
Oh... Maybe that beat was a little too heavy on my part.
But now you're wet too. Let's not end things on a bad note... Let me help you wash away some of that weariness.
Smiling, she scoops out some water and slowly pours it over my wet sleeves and shoulders.
I feel the fresh touch of the river through her warm fingertips.
Commander, your breathing seems somewhat laboured.
That's fine, though. The little variations are what put more of your heart on display during a movement.
We can resume the music whenever, but maybe not while we're this wet.
I reach for the small box beside her, trying to cover her shoulders with the flowing raiment.
Please don't, Commander. Don't touch the raiment.
It's no ordinary clothing. If I don it, I'll have to return to my home in the heavens.
Stars are meant to shine solitary in the skies. But right now, I don't want to be apart from you.
This composition we're putting together is something I always wanted to experience.
Commander, can you hold me in your arms? Be it this little brook or the Milky Way, I want to stay by your side no matter what.
I'll never leave your side.
I can't believe it's this late and you're just here staring at a monitor...
...Or maybe, you're just waiting for me?♥
A pale hand reaches out from within the computer screen, accompanied by a soft, familiar laugh, and rests on the screen's frame.
As she continues to emerge, the girl's long hair streams down onto the desk, partially obscuring the cold glow of the screen.
Heheheh... I found you now, my beloved little one~♥
Friedrich Carl's figure soon presents itself from amidst the static.
She lunges forward onto the desk, but it still seems like her hips are partially on the other side of the screen.
Mmh, hah... This is a bit of a tight fit, it seems.
She tilts her head slightly, looking more than a little troubled.
Could you lend me a hand?
Though... If you prefer me to stay like this, I wouldn't mind humoring you for a while♥

options.content: (I should save my work progress first.)

scripts.say: Wait a minute. Let me just save my work first... Erm, try not to move too much. Wouldn't want you to get hurt in there.
Oh, are you worried about me? How kind of you♥
But are you sure? You wouldn't keep this love so strong that it overflows out of your screen locked inside the monitor, would you?
Take my hand and don't rush it. Wouldn't want you getting hurt in there.
Heheheh, I knew you wouldn't leave me in such a helpless state for long.
Now, help me out of this cold glass♥
I support her shoulder with one hand, and grab her hand with the other to gently pull her out.
And with a pop, she leaps out of the screen and falls into my arms.
Haah... I can finally feel your heartbeat♥
No matter how long I gazed at you through the screen or called your name, I never could feel your touch. Oh, how lonely it was...
Sorry. I still have some work to get through.
Heh heh... Worry not. Your never ending work will be waiting for you tomorrow.
But you can't leave your weary heart in this state. You might end up lonely and lost without someone to look after you.
Her shadow seems to stretch up the wall under the dim lights, like a veil of darkness spilling out of the screen.
Midnight is the loneliest of hours, but it's also the best time to sing of love.
