Now, come... Let's keep that loneliness at bay with our love song.
She gently takes my hand with hers, and presses it against her cheek.
My sweet little one♥
Pour all of your hot love... right into me♥
As I open the door to the reference room, a faint scarlet light shrouded in a thin mist rushes out of the door, along with an eerie melody that rings in my ears.
The room, which should have been lined with bookshelves and documents, is suddenly turned into a stage bathed in red moody light.
To think you would manage to keep your sanity as you stand before me.
You made this illusion?
Heh, you can think of this as my stage.
Yorck stands on the red spotlight and spins in place. The silken sash attached to her hoop draws perfect arcs in the wake of her motion.
You've made it here, so surely you want to do something other than just watch, right?
I was just thinking about how much of a shame it is I can't find partners that can keep up with my dancing.
It feels like you're about to swallow me whole.
Such unkind words. Wouldn't it be easier to let me set the pace?
Or perhaps... The courageous Commander is truly hesitating in my presence?
Her taunts have no effect on me, but I still choose to step onto the stage and extend a hand to her.
The moment our fingers touch, the sash suddenly billows.
So this is how you steal the lead from your partner.
"Steal" is such a harsh word.
All I'm doing is taking away all your pesky doubts, choices, or whatever unnecessary resistance you were trying to put up♥
With each step, our surroundings seem to fold up on themselves, before expanding endlessly once again.
An upside-down old castle, a burning rose... Countless incredible illusions shift in and out of existence as the music plays like reflections racing across the water's surface.
Commander, eyes on me.
Your gaze, your steps, your will... If you bequeath them to me, you'll feel bliss like never before.
That's a tempting offer.
Heh, heh♥ Finally ready to admit you've been bested?
Not quite. I'm just looking for the right pace.
I use the momentum of the turn step and shift the timing by half a beat on purpose, then transition to a new rhythm in the next bar.
The scarlet light from the hoop falters, and the illusions begin to crumble around us.
Oh... So you still have some fight in you.
How long can you keep it up, though?
If the music isn't over, I just need to keep dancing until it is.
Yorck falls backwards due to the momentum, but I catch her in my arms, feeling the full weight of her waist as her center of gravity shifts.
As the two of us stop, the illusions also freeze in place around us.
The song's over. But it would be a waste to just dance with such a wonderful stage, don't you think?
She takes my hand and slowly guides it up, letting it glide through the contours of her curves. I can even feel her rising heartbeat through the fabric.
The elegant melody enveloping us transitions into a sweet, romantic tune.
Commander, sometimes it feels better to give in to your desire rather than control everything♥
Only the sound of my footsteps echoes throughout the empty castle.
In my confused haze, I manage to lift my weary arms and open the door at the end of the corridor.
Hm? Where am I?
Ta-dah♪ Welcome to my doll collection, Commander!
wElCOMe... weLCOme...
Why am I here?
Heehee! I just used a bit of smile magic on you! I made you a little sleepy and got you to play nice and come see my collection♪
That doesn't sound like nothing to me...
Aw, don't sweat the details! We're here, so come play with me~
If you lose, you'll have to stay here with me forever♪
It's not like you'll take no for an answer, right?
That's right♪ Okay, let's get started~ We're playing Red Light, Green Light!
If I turn around and see you moving, you lose!
Hm? But you can move?
Well, I'm "it"!♪ Besides, I get special treatment because I'm the owner of the Dollhouse!
Doesn't sound very fair to me.
Shhh! No talking either! I'll give you a pass for that one so you don't say I'm mean♪
Come on, Commander! I'm cheering for you~
And so, Hasty approaches with a playful smile on her face.
First... Here! Take this! Tickle magic!☆ One hot serving of.. blow blow attack~
Hah... Haah...
Her warm breath tickles my ear, but I manage to resist the urge to scratch it.
Huh? It didn't work? You're incredible!
But my next trick will knock your socks off! Heheh♪
Hasty hops back, quirks up a playful smile, and looks for an opening.
Hm... If your ears are no good, how about this spot?
She stands on her tip toes, coming awfully close to me. When she gets close enough I can see her eyelashes flutter, something soft presses against my lips.
No moving yet, Commander~
The surprise is so great that I end up grabbing her arm out of reflex.
Eep♪ You moved, huh? That means...
Just as she gives me a devilish wink and is about to declare victory, I lift her hand with mine.
You lost, actually.
Huh?
You're it, and I got you.
Heheh, you sure did. Guess it's my loss this time~♪
And the one that loses...
Did we ever say what would happen if I lost? Well... I guess I can grant you one request!
But you gotta play with me just a little more~♪
Heh heh... Heh heh heh...
Golden Hind's laughter can be heard from the end of the corridor.
My prey has wandered into my lair... Where are you hiding now, sweet thing?
The soft rustling of tentacled footsteps slowly approaches.
The sound seems to rise over the walls, going through the cabinet doors and ending by the desk where I'm hiding.
Heh heh... Found you~♡
The shadow crouches like a predator, her long hair flowing onto the floor, spreading like a flower bud blossoming.
So it was you, Commander♡
I'm so happy you came to see me. But why would you hide?
A cold sensation clings to my ankle, the wet and damp feeling creeping up on my skin gradually.
Playing hide-and-seek here is not what a good Commander does, is it?
I was just hiding to see if you were doing your job properly.
My job? I see.
She nods, her tone so calm that it lulls me into a sense of security.
Well, it looks like I can trust you with things over here, so...
So... Surely you don't expect me to let this slide and pretend I didn't see a thing, right?
She uses one finger to gently lift my chin up.
That's no good, Commander♡
And then, a tingly, numbing sensation clings to the nape of my neck.
You need punishment for making me search for you...
And I'll make you pay for this transgression with interest♡
Before long my consciousness drifts away in that all-encompassing cold.
When I wake up, warm steam rises beyond my blurry vision. My head feels heavy and my ears are ringing, as if I've been submerged in water.
Is this... the bathroom?
We ARE taking a bath, after all~♡
I turn towards the voice and see Golden Hind's figure on the other side of the wet curtain.
...What are you up to?
Heheh~ I must get you all cleaned up before I get a good taste of my sticky, sweet Commander~♡
The warmth of the bath is accompanied by the sensation of several sticky tentacles emerging from the water and wrapping around me.
You're only making me slimier, though...
I know! That's why I'll use my own hands to wash you thoroughly and carefully♡
Her fair hand peeks out from behind the curtain, and she slowly pulls the fabric aside.
She smiles at me through the steam, and I feel her loving gaze travel slowly down from head to toe.
You seem a little nervous~ Did you realize there's no escape for you anymore?
Never said I was trying to run away.
Is that so? All the better, then♪
She shows off her long legs as she slides into the bathtub, slowly lowering herself and settling into the space next to me.
The water rises above my shoulders, and the bathtub feels a lot less spacious.
Don't move, Commander... You belong to me now~♡
She puts her hands over my shoulders, and uses her fingers to spread foam along my collarbone, drawing little circles along my neck.
Commander... Your heart's really pounding. I can feel it even through all the foam♥
Are you scared?
Not really...
Oh... So you were looking forward to this?
When she lets go of me, the tentacles wipe off the foam.
First I need to get you clean, and then...
And then I'll savor you thoroughly, from the tips of your toes to the top of your head... Very slowly, of course♡
Golden Hind slowly leans forward and whispers into my ear.
I want to know even more about you. From every pore on your skin to your heartbeat. From your most minute expression to the feelings you can't put to words. Every single little thing♥
Don't worry. I won't hurt you...
She slides her fingers between mine, locking our hands into an intimate embrace.
Now... I'll make you that little bit more delicious♥
It's a pleasant afternoon when suddenly, a particular fragrance wafts in from outside the window.
I look out and see Hakuhou taking in the nature, shielded from the sunlight by a fancy looking umbrella with a cherry blossom pattern.
Good day, Commander.
Do forgive me for interrupting your relaxation on such an important day.
Important day? What do you mean?
Heheh, no need to look so flustered.
Are you familiar with the legend of fox weddings?
Fox weddings?
Legends say that when a fox gets married, it'll rain even if the sky is clear.
What's more, it's not real rain. It's a veil to hide things from people's view.
The rain ensures the soon-to-be-married fox bride is not seen or disturbed by anyone... just like me right now.
Her voice becomes a low whisper by the end of that sentence.
So yes. Don't you think this clear weather rain signifies the heavens might be urging me?
I see. So that's what you mean by...
Shh...
She shushes me and turns over her sleeve, revealing a bottle of sake and three cups of different sizes.
The San-San-Kudo ritual is a vital part of the wedding ceremony.
Hakuhou presents the three cups one after the other. We both take turns taking little sips from each of them.
The sake is clear and cold, with a faint floral scent. When Hakuhou drinks, a faint blush appears on her cheeks.
And that's the first ceremony of the fox wedding completed without issue.
The first?
Yes.
This is a marriage ceremony. It'd be a bit underwhelming if it were to end so quickly.
Hakuhou raises her face and silently looks into my eyes.
For this, I'd like you to show me.
Show me if I truly dwell somewhere in your heart.
Her snow white fox tail brushes against the hem of my clothes.
The feather touch is like a gentle bond that doesn't allow me to leave her presence.
Heheh, no need to look so troubled.
I just want to make sure that you're not planning to run away from this rain.
She approaches, the sunlight emphasizing the light pink on her fair cheeks.
Commander.
I'm quite determined to sway your heart and get all your attention today♪
Though her whispers are drowned out by the pitter patter of the rain, I can still hear her.
Come closer, if you would.
Just a little is fine. But please, leave your mark on me today.
Her lips half open, the scent of sake tickling my nose. That vulnerable, shy demeanor tugs at my heartstrings like you wouldn't believe.
The incense I burned for you is smoldering already.
If you wish it so, today's rain will go on for longer... Yes, it'll remain for as long as we need this veil...
I'm patrolling during a quiet night, but things seem quieter than usual today. I can even hear the faint whistling of the wind.
But as soon as I stop, the wind's sound also stops – almost as if it was linked to my steps.
Did I just imagine that?
I have you now, my cute little lost lamb~♪
And then, someone playfully hugs me from behind, whispering gently into my ear.
Heheh, who am I?
Get it wrong... And a bad, bad ghost might gobble you up♪
It's supposed to be a surprise, but the familiar voice and her gentle tone make a wave of relief wash over me.
Is that you, Illustrious?
Oh, you naughty thing! You got it right on the first try~♪
She uncovers my eyes, gracefully saunters in front of me, and lifts the veil.
I wanted to hide a little closer, but you stopped, so I worried you might have noticed me already.
It's rather difficult to sneakily keep you to myself.
She lifts the hem of her dress, and slowly approaches me.
As she closes the distance, a faint scent tickles my nose.
The night breeze blows by, making the thin fabric of her outfit sway under the moonlight.
Still... I really wanted to know. What would happen if I were to appear before you on such a quiet night?
I wanted to see how long you'd stop for me.
I'm immediately captivated by her piercing blue eyes.
I've worked behind the scenes to prepare this little meeting just for tonight♪
Commander, did I manage to make a strong impression?
More than you can imagine.
In that case, seeing as I worked so hard... Do you think I deserve a reward?
Illustrious leans in closer without waiting for a reply.
Maybe I'm just imagining this, but the moonlight feels somehow colder and more tranquil.
The candlelight changes colors, making for an incredibly otherworldly atmosphere.
Huh? Where are we?
Heheh. So you finally noticed.
I've taken you to a world for just the two of us.
The white cloth rises in sync with her breathing.
Like the ebb and flow of the waves, I'm drawn in by her tenderness.
Heheh, I'll do something a little... naughty, let's say.
Are you ready, Commander?
She brings her full allure to bear, and I'm helpless to do anything but lose myself in those beautiful blue eyes as she draws near.
Seeing her eyes light up with passion, and her inviting lips calling to mine, I immediately understand where this is going, and nod.
As I finally feel her soft touch, we're finally on the same page.
Heheh, the night is still young.
Commander... Let's enjoy together... More and more...♪
*flip*... *flip*...
I hear what feels like the sound of a giant sheet of paper being turned, and a surreal scene unfolds before my eyes.
But I was at the research center just now...
Heheh, caught you!♪
Suddenly, a single shade shoots out and wraps around my arm.
Welcome to Cheshire's fairytale maze~
Ehehe, I had to work really hard to get you here, Owner♪
Come on over. There's no dumb papers here to get in the way of fun.
All there is is little ol' me, with my heart bursting with love for you~♪
Make yourself at home, Owner. You'll get to enjoy my special guest treatment.
Guest treatment?
Cheshire snaps her fingers, and a chair and table decorated with beautiful red velvet poofs into being, along with an incredibly fancy-looking tea set.
She presses me down into the velvet chair, and produces a mirror from seemingly thin air.
I prepared a bunch of fun toys for us to play with today♪
First up... Behold! My favorite ball of yarn!
I catch the ball as she throws it out of instinct, and the red thread ball seems to unravel on its own as if it was a living being.
The thin, long thread wraps around my wrist, and in the blink of an eye both my hands are tied to the chair's armrest.
Cheshire, this is a bit tight...
Hee hee! Now you can't leave!
Shh! Don't struggle too much, please?
Otherwise... I'll make it tighter, 'kay?
Cheshire runs her hand over the edge of the velvet chair and slides right into my lap to straddle me.
Her bushy tail brushes against my chest, tickling me.
And next is my second favorite toy... The tickly feather!
Hehe! I really want you to feel as good as me right now♪
She uses the feather to gently caress my cheek, around my ear, and then lets it glide down my neck tantalizingly.
Each time the feather brushes my skin, a tingling feeling runs throughout my whole body.
She wraps her tail around my waist, slowly inching downwards.
Mmgh... That seriously tickles...
My, my, Owner~ You're heating up so much already...
Heehee~ I just knew you'd enjoy the toys I brought for you~♪
She casually tosses the feather into the mirror, then leans in closer to my face before licking my cheek.
Her bright, wide open eyes are full of adoration, and they twinkle with a deep desire to keep me with her.
And finally... Hee hee, did you maybe think we were done?
The final act is just beginning!
Though if we're splitting cat hairs, this isn't my special guest treatment anymore. It's something you prepared for me♪
That's what you get for wandering into my maze to see me♡
I've answered your invitation, Commander.
I've become your poltergeist, but I'm still being put through recruitment procedures? Heheh, forgive my amusement.

options.content: Doesn't showing up like this get troublesome for you?

The very act of appearing is part of how I apply pressure.

scripts.say: That's right~ My tentacles move fast.

options.content: Do you use them for anything else?

scripts.say: They aren't just for catching prey.

Wouldn't you... like to experience that, Commander?

options.content: Do you like playing cat-and-mouse games?

scripts.say: Isn't it just so much more fun when you give your prey room to maneuver?

May I have this dance, Commander?

Hehe! So you really were waiting for me.

options.content: Are you good at reading the enemy's movements?

scripts.say: Naturally. There's nowhere to hide in my snowstorm.

I think I got what I need.
Shoukaku, you're in.

*Bubble* *Bubble*... I'm here for our appointment. Can we get started?

options.content: Are you good at reading the enemy's movements?

You have deviated from your route. Please recalculate a route home.

Nighttime Advisory: Do not enter poorly lit areas alone.
I-I'll be fine... It's only for a minute.
Urk... It's just an alleyway. Why does it feel so long?
BZZZZZT!
Eep?! A phone call? I thought I had my phone on silent...
Wh-who's there?
Somebody... Help me! N-noooo!
The streets of New Era City No. 7 were an endless current of pedestrians. I stepped away from the crowd and entered the building that housed the Office of Paranormal Affairs.

Morning rush hour had just passed, but the lobby was still full of people waiting for elevators. As I waited, I leafed through a document from City Hall, requesting a joint investigation into recent disappearances of young women.
Most of these disappearances occur at night. No apparent pattern to the locations.
Some of the scenes involved signal tampering, surveillance malfunctions, and dazed witnesses...
Under normal standards, these would have been classified as missing persons incidents.
But in this city, anything immediately unexplainable tends to get sent to the Office of Paranormal Affairs.
The melody lingering about you... is just beautiful.
Lost in thought, are we?
A woman floating behind me drifts closer and gazes at me with smiling eyes.
Nobody around us glances our way. It's as if nothing out of the ordinary is happening at all.
I can confirm one thing for you: it's the doing of my kind – another poltergeist.
Why? Did you hear something?
To put it in terms you'd understand, there are traces of a poltergeist left at the scene.
But to me, it seemed more of a... discordant melody.
Either way, they're being unusually active.
Tiger languidly runs her fingers through her hair. The tips of her long strands seem almost ethereal, only truly becoming "corporeal" when she speaks.
This isn't the best place to talk. Let's go upstairs first – the elevator's this way.
As the elevator arrives, an unusually spirited voice rings out from inside.
Haaaah! Take this, evil poltergeist! This is for the sake of everybody's happy future!
Bliss Breathing, First Form: Last-Second Power Up!
The moment the doors open, somebody lunges out with closed eyes and a fierce expression, smacking me square between the eyes with a rolled-up pamphlet.
...Huh?
Whaaaaa?!
Realizing she'd actually hit something, the assailant opens her eyes and turns bright red. Frantically, she hides the pamphlet behind her back.
L-l-listen, that wasn't, um... that wasn't me... I mean, it WAS me, okay, but I wasn't thinking straight, alright?!

options.content: I have no idea what you're talking about.
Let's try to avoid friendly fire, okay?

scripts.say: Th-thank goodness! I'm glad we can move past that...
I'm very sorry... Please forget that happened! I'm begging you!
Ugh... Sorry. I panicked because I came to the wrong floor...
Huh? Aren't you the girl who joined after the telephone booth incident?
This is the Office of Paranormal Affairs. Describe your location and the nature of your problem.
Please, help me! I ran into a shadowy monster, and it's been chasing me ever since! I'm hiding in a phone booth right now, but it's still around!
My name is Javelin! I'm hardworking and diligent, and I'll do whatever it takes to work for you! I look forward to working with you!
I'm the Commander of the Office of Paranormal Affairs. Good to have you.
Let me show you to the right floor.
Arriving at the 9th floor.
The elevator door opens, and the last few yawning office workers exit.
Umm... Commander, isn't this the top floor?
Yeah. We're going higher, though.
Huh...?
I press the 9 button on the panel a few more times. After a moment, the elevator ceases its descent and shudders slightly.
The floor display does not change, but we continue to rise silently toward a higher floor.
There are hidden floors?!
Heehee. Isn't she cute?
Thank you very... Huh?! C-Commander, there's someone b-behind you...
Don't be afraid. She's been there this whole time – you just couldn't see her. Her name is Tiger.
I-it's a pleasure to meet you, ma'am! My name is Javelin! I look forward to working with you!
A few seconds later, the elevator dings, and the door opens. Thus, Javelin catches her first glimpse of another side of this world.
Huh... It's kinda normal.
There aren't any magic circles or weird specimens wriggling about... I guess I expected it to look like a secret organization's hideout.
Even secret organizations have budgets.
After completing her registration, I hand her a new ID badge and uniform.
Change into this uniform, and you'll officially be an operative. Sorry to put you to work already, but you'll have to go to the orientation room for onboarding.
Change?
She looks down at her uniform and falls silent for a moment.
I-it's a little... flashy, for a uniform.
I mean, if anything, it looks more like a magical girl outfit!
It's a standard-issue uniform.
But it has RIBBONS!
All the easier to identify you.
Explain the heart-shaped charm!
Also for identification purposes.
What about this wand, then? What could it POSSIBLY be for other than to be cute?!
That's... actually not for identification purposes. It's for self-defense.
What the heck is with this place?!
I-I think this should be good...
Umm, pardon me!
The orientation room was dimmer than the outside, with its curtains drawn tightly. The only illumination came from a few pendant lights.
(What the...? Is this how orientation rooms normally are?)
A young girl sat in the middle of the room, head hanging over a desk. Her long hair covered most of her face.
Umm... Hi there?
Noticing Javelin's presence, she slowly scratched a coin across the desk, creating a grating sound.
Once the coin reached the edge of the desk...
Two ghostly flames flared into existence, bathing the room in a terrifying red glow. The girl suddenly spoke.
...Heheh... ￥#&￥... Sacrifice...
EEEEK!
When I open my eyes again, I find myself in a dim space. Golden Hind and I are alone here, facing each other.
Are we doing all this just to figure out what you want to know...?
She says something, but the words come out as unintelligible noise.
(Damn it. Without Tiger here...)
She whispers as she draws closer. Then, she places a hand on my shoulder.
Instantly after, she wraps her other arm around me and pulls me into an embrace.
Huh?!
I instinctively struggle. Her grip on me tightens as the other arm pats my back.
If anybody else was here, this scene could easily be misunderstood...
Is this... what you want?
I can't tell if she understands me, but I can see her nod slightly back at me.
If she really wanted to hurt me, she would've done it by now. So I trust her embrace.
Eventually, from the depths of empty darkness, a curtain of hazy light appears.
The beat... unifying... into one!
Return the one who I resonate with!
Space shatters like glass. Friedrich Carl tumbles from amidst the shards as light floods in.
Tiger's form seems to turn corporeal, as if integrating herself with the very space around us.
Her baton swings downward once again, driving Golden Hind and Friedrich Carl away.
What a display... You used to be so composed. I never thought you'd be this desperate.
Carl, we've gone too far.
Commander! Ngh...
Her smile is pained. A wound has appeared on her shoulder, with specks of light pouring out of it.
Tiger, what's happening to you?!
Don't look so scared... This is just what happens when I force myself to turn corporeal.
She slumps into my arms, her body once again turning translucent.
Either way, that's too reckless! You've risked disappearing completely by doing that!
I don't care. I can't let the Commander fall into danger...
She reaches out to touch my cheek, then closes her eyes, as if listening to something. A smile returns to her face.
Good...
Your melody is still so comforting...
It was this very melody... that brought me through the cold sea of stars.
You're only a human, but you can produce such clear, gentle... beautiful music, that I could never look away from.
Because of you, I've learned that there really are humans willing to stop and listen to what I have to say.
You are the only one who truly resonates with me.
Tiger...
Argh, now I'm mad! I'll thrash these baddies until I feel better!
We surrender~ So sorry.
It's too late to apologize now!
Amatsukaze.
...Alright, fine, FINE!
She turns away in a huff. After checking on Tiger's condition, I face Golden Hind again.
Are we done here? It's about time you answered our questions.
First, tell me this: what's going on in this city?
Her name is Lion. Even amongst poltergeists, she is of a particularly dangerous variety.
Relishing the hunt and terror of her prey... She deliberately threw your staff into City Hall to divert suspicion and sow strife... and then, she attacked me to weaken me.
That's scary...
But Lion and all of the other poltergeists who attacked the containment area... all answer to an even more dangerous being.
Who is that?
...Azuchi.
As she speaks that name, the smile is drained from her face.
Azuchi loathes mankind, along with those of us who choose to draw near to them.
Those who draw near us?
You see, poltergeists are naturally drawn to human emotion.
Terror, loneliness, obsession... All of those feelings shine brighter than the stars, to us.
That's why I believe that you all can change the world.
You understand our words. You don't see us as beings who only exist to destroy... which makes you our ultimate allies.
If we're allies, then you have to tell me. What is Azuchi planning?
You'll see for yourself before long, Commander.
The seven New Era Cities are key to the Happy City Project. Number 7 is but one.
What Azuchi really wants to destroy... is the concept of a happy new era, altogether.
If you're willing to trust me... then I'd like you to investigate along those lines.
I understand. We trust you.
Umm... Excuse me, Lady?
The disaster recovery documents have arrived... I think we'd best act quickly.
Quincy hesitantly addressed Golden Hind, who seemed to be lost in thought.
When she came back to her senses, she smiled silently at Quincy and urged her to place the documents on her desk.
(W-wow, she's intimidating... The rumors were right. A tough woman of few words...)
P-please look over these! I'll leave you alone now...
Golden Hind put away the documents with a thoughtful look. After checking the time, she left her temporary office.
As dawn broke, the anomaly hanging over the city finally receded.
Heehee... The melody is harmonious again.
Seeing the city all normal again almost brings me to tears...
After last night's large-scale attack, a special envoy had been sent from New Era City No. 1.
Good morning, Commander~
Golden Hind greets me as she steps out of City Hall's chartered vehicle.
Tch... You've got guts, speaking up in front of all these people. Aren't you scared of them finding out you're a poltergeist?
I have faith in Tiger's powers. She'd never blow my cover~
Suddenly, a black motorcade drives up. It bears the emblem of New Era City No. 1.
Their city is, naturally, another fruit of the Happy City Project. It's also the central hub of all New Era Cities.
There's the envoy. Commander, it's your time to take the stage.
A makeshift podium stands out amidst the morning light.
A public briefing on last night's events, also doubling as an awards ceremony, is about to begin.
Wooow, there are so many people!
It's a formal event, after all. Stand up straight, rookie – and quit looking around.
I-I'm doing my best not to stare at the cameras!
It's okay. Just relax and smile, and you'll be fine. I'll handle the rest.
Traces of last night's chaos remain throughout the city, but the crowd's energy is surprisingly high.
Amidst their heated debating, the envoy from City No. 1 takes the podium.
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
I'm Cleveland, here to represent New Era City No. 1! I've come with a message from the Council of Eight.
First, I'd like to express my respect for the people who fought on the front lines against the poltergeist incursion.

Special thanks to the people from the Office of Paranormal Affairs, who successfully contained the anomaly, brought order to the city, and made great contributions to the following containment effort.
After discussing it with the Council, we've decided that the OPA will be transitioning from a civilian organization to an official agency of New Era City No. 7, effective immediately!
After a brief silence, the plaza is filled with thunderous applause.
W-we're an official agency?! We'll be government employees?!
That means we can file reimbursement claims for future missions.
Sounds like a bunch of annoying paperwork to me...
Furthermore, the Council would like to publicly commend those who made great contributions to the operation.
Namely, the Commander and the Field Ops Team of the OPA!
Spotlights and cameras all swing toward us.
Whoa, whoa, whoa! O-oh, no, my smile is totally stiff! Don't let them put this in the newspapers...
Heheh! Looks like I'll be the star of the show today~
Though poltergeists threaten the progress of the Happy City Project, this victory has proven something once and for all.
Poltergeists are NOT beyond our control. There is no enemy we cannot defeat!
Her cape flutters in the wind as she takes a step forward.
The Happy City Project has only one goal: to bring happiness to all of mankind!
Order, stability, a life free of fear... They aren't privileges – they're a future that we are entitled to.
Containment can't be the end goal. We cannot be satisfied with simply locking the poltergeists away and filing them away in our records.
We must research, understand, and ultimately, annihilate them!
The crowd roars with applause. Even the security staff smile proudly.
It's a stirring speech, sure. But...
Are you going to object? Surely you don't agree with her words.
Before I can say anything, the large screen above the podium begins to flicker.
Hmm?
Warning! Warning! Anomalous signal encroaching!
After a burst of violent static, a face comes on screen again.
Testing, testing~ Can you all hear me, you little people playing inside your mud boxes?
Hmph... I'm afraid I'll never get used to using a form of speech that you can comprehend.
Forget it. I suppose I should introduce myself, if I hope to explain to you how this conflagration started.
According to your stale human traditions... I suppose the "bad guy" is meant to introduce herself, strike a pose, and recite some tedious spiel right now.
Well, I'm so sorry, but I have no interest in your trite expectations.
As such, let's just get to business.
Watch this. Boom!
Your poor, beloved Happy City Project is going to be turned into ash before your very eyes!
As those words leave her lips, the screen changes.
Wha?!
Cities 5, 6... and even 3 and 4...
Number 2 is sending out an alert, too?!
I'm sorry, everybody. I have to head back to City No. 1 at once!
I gaze at the girl grinning onscreen – and then at Golden Hind, who looks clearly guarded.
Is she the dangerous one you mentioned?
Yes... She is the Dark Lord Azuchi, also known as the Undying Flame.
"Responsibility, duty, the courage to stand strong... They aren't burdens – they're a future that you must face."
"Containment can't be the end goal. We cannot be satisfied with simply locking the humans away and marking them for servitude."
"We must research, understand, and ultimately, subjugate them."
Heehee. I'll see you in the new world that rises from the ashes of yours.
After Azuchi's declaration was broadcast across all public channels, New Era City No. 7 went into top alert in no time.
Yet, surprisingly, the poltergeists did not launch another attack on the city.
Floating holograms displayed the alerts arriving from other cities.
Even the most seasoned operation staff waited passively for somebody else to break the silence.
I can't believe I'm the one stuck in this meeting... since the Commander took Tiger to investigate...
Javelin was forced into a seat normally reserved for senior personnel.
From our perspective, the situation remains unclear. It would be unwise to rashly move our main forces.
Agreed. Number 7 is the only stable city now. Holding our position would be the best way to contribute to the war effort.
But what of the diplomatic implications?
Who can say with confidence that this isn't a trap? What if it's just a ploy to draw our forces away from their post?
Whether we help them or not, this is an ideal opportunity to offload some old – er, surplus munitions from the city while recuperating some of the costs.
B-but they're being attacked by poltergeists!
Which is exactly why we must be prudent.
Making an emotional decision will end us. We must weigh the risks first.
Calm, yet firm voices overlapped, drowning out Javelin's objections.
Just then, her phone rang.
A call from Jersey... Huh?! I have over 99 notifications?!
I-I'm sorry! I'd better step out for a sec!
Javelin! You finally picked up!
The news said something bad is happening in New Era Cities! I've called you so many times now... You don't know how worried I was!
I'm doing okay! Number 7 is safe, at least... for now.
Actually, forget that! Our city has the amazing Commander to protect it! With our powers combined, we'll drive out those bad poltergeists in no time!
You've said a lot about how much you love that Commander of yours lately...
Javelin... Why don't you come home?
I can't come home yet.
Look! This city needs people who can help contain the poltergeists! So right now... I'm really important to the city!
So she said, but for a moment, Javelin had to wonder if that was really true. Nobody had even listened to her back in the briefing room.
We get it... Just make sure you protect yourself if you run into danger!
Yeah, I promise. You all should stay in a safe place too, okay? I'll keep in touch.
When she hung up, the hallway was silent again.
If only I could've been as confident in that meeting...
Meetings aren't just a game where the loudest person wins, you know.
A girl carrying a box of documents turned the corner. Her reliable demeanor had made a great impression on Javelin during the train ride to City No. 7.
Z23! What are you doing here?
I'm an assistant to the staff officer. While you're sitting there in meetings, I run around carrying documents, organizing things, and looking for paperwork that the big shots misplaced...
Pfft... Hahaha... Th-thanks.
All I did was tell the truth.
I'm sorry!
I overheard some of what you were saying. You wanted to persuade them to send reinforcements, right?
Yeah. But once I started talking, I realized how unprofessional I sounded...
Then don't try to convince everyone at once. Find the person you can sway the most easily and find the words to convince them.
Some people follow the crowd, and others are driven by self-interest. Others only believe in risk assessments.
Persuading people isn't about shouting slogans. It's about making them think you two have the same opinion.
Z23 takes a bundle of documents out of her box.
Here you go – the list of attendees. It includes assessments of their recent decisions and records of their habits from the past three years.
W-wow, impressive...
If you want to work in the field of your dreams, then that's the kind of prep you need.
Wait... We've had this exchange before, haven't we?
This time, you're in a position to make a difference. You should have some faith in yourself.
Javelin clutched the documents tightly, as if they were at risk of slipping from her grasp.
Anyway, I need to go brew coffee. We'll need the saviors of the world to have sharp minds.
Good luck, Javelin. One day, I'll catch up with you.
With that, Z23 left with the remaining documents in hand.
Even if we were to provide support to other cities, we should still prioritize coordinating supply logistics.
I agree with that.
After returning to the briefing room, Javelin was calm and confident.
If City No. 7 is the only one with enough capacity to act, then inactivity isn't prudence – it's giving the enemy free rein to do as they please.
It would be detrimental to our long-term plans!
Hmm...
The one-sided atmosphere in the briefing room began to shift.
Given the fact that we can't establish contact with the central Cities No. 1 and No. 2, perhaps we should restore our communication network beginning with the other peripheral cities?
No... We must be realistic. I can only agree to support operations that are phased and limited in scope.
We can't miss the forest for the trees here. Confining the plan to isolated areas would...
Just as debate threatened to flare up again, the door to the briefing room was flung open.
I support Javelin's proposal.
Let's not sit idly by and play at isolationism. Reconnecting routes between cities while we still can is the only viable path forward.
City Hall has made its decision. Prepare to deploy a support operation. We must aid the other cities.
Following a brief, but efficient round of preparations, City No. 7's support team took to the beltway toward the neighboring City No. 5.
Located in the northwestern corner of the metropolis, City No. 5 is a corporate hub – or, less charitably, a concrete forest.
location: New Era City No. 5 - Outer Checkpoint

scripts.say: Though the high walls around the checkpoint are covered in greenery, the tightly shut gate remained unwelcoming.
When we reach said gate, the identification device above it lights up.
Authenticating... Identity confirmed. Commander of the Office of Paranormal Affairs, New Era City No. 7.
Transferring you to a higher-level department. Please wait.
City No. 5... I hear the administrator here is a savvy entrepreneur named Akashi.
Am I seeing things? Why are the lights still on up in those skyscrapers? They'd better not be working under these conditions!
No matter how tough the conditions, work must go on.
An enemy?!
Heehee, you're quick to react. It seems City No. 7 isn't wasting any time.
The space in front of us distorts. A girl with a fox tail suddenly appears from it, closing the distance between us and reaching a slender arm toward me.
Just before she can touch me, Tiger appears and launches an attack. However, the fox girl easily evades her blow.
Aww, is somebody jealous? You must be popular.
You will keep your hands to yourself.
You've revealed yourself to us. Go on and tell us what you want.
Oh, if I must. It seems the rumors were true... You really can understand us.
In that case, it would be rude not to introduce myself.
My name is Hakuhou. I'm the poltergeist ordered to siege this city.
That doesn't necessarily make me your enemy, though.
More precisely, I've come on behalf of the Dark Lord to get a good look at this Commander of yours.
Not to say that I'm not personally interested, myself...
As a token of goodwill, I'd like to leave you with a parting warning, dear Commander.
Even if I can't stop you now, I assure you that nobody in this city will welcome you.
I hope that, next time we meet, it will be under better circumstances.
Instantly afterward, Hakuhou vanishes, leaving naught but a white afterimage behind.
What was that all about? Did she come here just to warn us?
Let's try getting in contact with City No. 5 first.
After a moment, there's a faint buzzing as a hologram appears before us.
Thank you for coming. I am Orage, the 17th secretary to Chairwoman Akashi. Allow me to brief you on the situation.
Uh... Whuh? Wait a second. You're Orage? Wow, you really are!
...Oh. I recall meeting you on the train.
Heh... What a time to run into an acquaintance. It's better than staring at spreadsheets all day, I'll tell you that much.
Hey, don't go crying on me now... All I've done is move to another city for work.
Money flows, industries change. The migration of the workforce is just a sign of the times.
Hmm? You two know each other?
We do. Anyway, enough pleasantries.
I must apologize, but Chairwoman Akashi has refused to meet with your group.
REFUSED? We came here to save you!
The official stance... is that our city can handle the situation on its own. We will not accept outside interference.
Let's hear the real reason.
Outside aid may come with... ulterior motives. That's all that I can say.
Seriously? It's an emergency! Shouldn't we put aside petty stuff like that and stand up to the poltergeists together?
You're not wrong. Our current plan is to hold ten meetings to clarify our current response plan.
I'm sorry... The work cannot stop. I'd best get back to my station.
But...
Before the hologram goes dark, Orage offers a faint smile.
Seeing an old friend has motivated me somewhat.
I heard all about it from them already.
location: New Era City No. 2 - Defensive Perimeter

scripts.say: Don't you think we're past the point of no return?
Not even I could have predicted this turn of events. I'm sitting in a reception room, with the source of all our troubles sitting across from me.
So after City No. 5, your next objective seems to have been City No. 4.
How was their response? Want to tell me? Come on, entertain me a little~
We were told that they'd consider our proposal and to wait for them to get in contact.
Pfft... How about City No. 3? Don't tell me they slammed the door right in your face, too?
They did offer some tea, but then, they handed me some limited-edition merchandise of the town's amusement park and kicked me out.
Don't tell me you didn't even manage to get anything out of City No. 6.
They didn't refuse directly, but they did give me the cold shoulder by saying the administrator's schedule didn't line up for a meeting.
Each city was a different set of emotions.
In their eyes, I saw doubt, reticence, caution, and hesitation. That's about all I got from them.
How awful. Such rigid and obsolete ways of thinking.
If it makes you feel better, I've also been shown the door at City No. 2 many times. The manager there, Sheffield, is not very keen on entertaining visitors.
That's good news, for once.
It's fine. They'll lose their nerve before long.
There have been no surprise attacks by poltergeists since I arrived at City No. 2, and I managed to reach Azuchi without any trouble.
However, I was the only one to receive her "invitation."
But I didn't call you out here to talk about such backwards nonsense.
Commander. Become mine.
She holds a folding fan to her lips, her body language emanating nothing but assured confidence.
I could use someone who understands our will.
You're not seriously asking me to command the poltergeists in your stead, right?
I'm all for it. Say the word, and I'll sink my teeth into her.
Heheh, charming as you may be, I can't just hand over the keys to my whole operation~
Let me be candid here. I want you to help me keep the humans under our control.
We need those weak, cowardly, self-serving humans to realize they're not the center of the world.
And what happens after that?
After?
What do you plan to do once mankind is under your thumb?
Beats me. I haven't thought that far ahead.
Azuchi's expression turns gravely serious, and she stares right into my eyes for what feels like forever.
Can't I think about it after the fighting is done?
...That's fine. I'll have your answer after we defeat you.
Ahaha! I guess humans can't beat their nature. I was naive to think you could see reason.
Though...
You ought to stick to your beliefs. It makes this all the more fun~
Thank you for your understanding. I'll be going now.
Yes, didn't I say so? I'm not a woman who refuses to listen to reason.
She stands up and points towards the empty corridor leading out of the reception room.
I'll give you a chance to leave. If you CAN leave my building, that is.
Don't tell me you set up ambushes out there.
Perish the thought~ Such cheap drama would be beneath me!
Shoukaku, fall back.
Understood.
A girl appears from the shadows, bows her head to Azuchi, and leaves.
(...There WAS an ambush after all.)
There. Now there's no direct danger to you.
You understand us very well, don't you? Do try your best to find the exit on your own.
Remember this... Don't ask for help from ANYONE else.
The corridor doesn't seem particularly long, but my steps feel heavy.
Everything is eerily silent around me. But it feels like something is clinging to my back, following me closely with every step. I dare not look back.
Once I see the door to the elevator open at the end of the corridor, I heave a sigh of relief.
When I press the button to go to the first floor, the elevator whirrs to life and starts to descend. Feeling the elevator go down eases my worry a little.
But when the elevator stops and the door opens, I don't see the first floor.
At the end of the corridor, I see Azuchi bathed in eerie crimson light. She seems to be staring at me with a smile on her face.
Welcome back.
Oh, did you miss me? After just a few minutes? I'm flattered.
Shouldn't have left in such a hurry... Heheh♪
The elevator door closes again, and after a little shake, it begins descending again.
And then, it stops again a moment later.
The door opens to the same corridor from seconds ago, the crimson light flashing.
The distance between us has narrowed considerably. I can see her eyes clearly now, and her gaze is filled with a burning interest that sends a cold shiver down my spine.
Ah, so predictable. You know something is off, but you keep expecting your eyes to have deceived you again and again.
Humans are all the same. They cower in fear and keep dreaming of the monsters haunting their dreams to suddenly turn sweet on them.
Sure. Why don't I do just that?
The elevator door closes again.
A strand of hair brushes past my ear, sending a chill down my neck. And then, I feel a cold breath blow against the nape of my neck.
Do you still think you can just talk things out with me?
Azuchi's presence fades after a moment. The elevator resumes going down, and it doesn't stop on the way anymore.
I feel a wave of relief when the first floor lobby spreads open before me.
You managed to make it out. I'll let you go, just as promised.
You ought to take care of yourself a little better. If you start day drinking and feel unwell, the best thing to do is fill your stomach with potato chips.
Don't have your late-night snacks too early, and remember to skip breakfast from time to time. Oh, and do bring your coat with you on hot days.
Make sure to check your phone and doomscroll whenever you have the chance, and turn off the lights when you're reading. Anyway... do keep yourself in good health while I'm not around!
And one last thing. Make sure to commit everything you saw here to memory and tell everyone about it.
Go now. Take your silly little belief and keep knocking on those doors.
And if you ever decide to take me up on my offer...
I'll welcome you with open arms. Remember that.
Help her get humans under control, huh? Heh, that sounds like Azuchi for sure.
location: New Era City No. 7 - City Hall

scripts.say: Commander, a call request just came in. If you would...
An unfamiliar face from the support staff walks up to us at a brisk pace carrying a file.
Also... The meeting with Javelin and others has been going in circles for more than ten minutes now.
Alright. I'll take care of it.
The unremarkable looking rear service personnel nods and quickly shuffles out of the room.
Ten minutes ago...
Oh. Why is everyone so silent?
If no one else wants to speak up, I'll set the situation straight myself.
We're not just facing danger from the poltergeists right now; even the people we want to help have turned hostile to us. We can't move forward until we solve this.
We should just turn City No. 7 into a safe military and trade base. And then...
N-no! We shouldn't isolate ourselves! Especially not at a time like this!
If we don't do anything just because they don't trust us... Wouldn't that be handing Azuchi an easy victory?
I see what you're trying to say, but...
Excuse me. Allow me to answer in Javelin's place.
Z23, who had been sitting at the back of the table taking notes and organizing documents, speaks up.
From a strategic standpoint, Azuchi's aim is to isolate us, as I'm sure you've all noticed by now.
If we let the enemy dictate our actions, we'll stay on the back foot.
Would YOU like to take charge of this meeting, assistant?
Not at all. The purpose of this meeting is to make a decision. I just believe it wouldn't do to just present negative viewpoints during the discussion and rule out possible solutions.
That'd be no different than making decisions on emotions alone.
Heheh, now ain't that the truth? I see you in a different light now.
You flatter me.
Well, now is the time to simply accept the compliment.
Yeah! You're totally right, Z23!
Even if we act now, there's no guarantee it'll go well. But if we give up from the start because we're too scared to fail, we won't get anything done!
Still, we need a realistic approach to turn this situation around.
Otherwise, your words won't amount to much else but stating your position.
But just as the meeting is about to reach another impasse, breaking news flashes across the screen.
Reception is all green. Let's start.
Orage stands on top of a prefabricated podium. She looks weary, but there's a fire still burning in her eyes.
This is New Era City No. 5. I am Orage, the interim representative of the City No. 5 syndicate.
I have an important announcement to all cities. Akashi, the former representative of the syndicate, has been stripped of her authority and titles.
We have taken over and are maintaining our fight against the poltergeist running amok in the city.
City No. 5 is officially requesting a mutual cooperation agreement with City No. 7.
If you still wish to help us, we will reciprocate by providing safe passageways, as well as sharing supplies and intel.
After a short pause, Orage seems to remember one last thing to add.
Oh, almost forgot. If you're wondering what Akashi is up to...
She's doing well. She's just been asked to learn in person that meetings alone don't improve bad situations.
The silence after the transmission is short lived, as someone can't keep themselves from letting out a small chuckle.
To think there was someone with enough guts left in City No. 5.
The market moves at a dizzying pace, indeed...
If City No. 5 agrees to cooperate, it'd greatly improve our future prospects.
And this also means that previous refusals to cooperate aren't quite set in stone.
Yeah! If there are people willing to make change happen, we can't leave them alone!
Well said.
I enter the conference room with new information in hand. All eyes turn to me.
We have formally requested a cooperation agreement with City No. 5. We're gonna be working together to get through this mess.
And I have more good news. What happened in City No. 5 has pushed other cities to action as well. We should be getting a lot more support going forward.
If Azuchi wants to see us cowering in our corner, paralyzed with doubt and fear...
Well, she's in for a surprise.
The silence in the room is no longer a sign of doubt and apprehension, but a silent manifestation of everyone's shared determination.
I agree. Going forward with this support plan will be for the best.
The relevant logistical support plans have been updated with this new information.
Leave the diplomacy and document writing to me.
We'll sell any urgent military supplies needed at a 20% discount from the market price to City No. 5.
...Why are you all staring at me like that?

sequence: <size=45>Each New Era City symbolizes a particular virtue.</size>
<size=45>City of Hope, No. 7. City of Justice, No. 6. City of Generosity, No. 5.</size>
<size=45>City of Temperance, No. 4. City of Courage, No. 3. City of Compassion, No. 2.</size>
<size=45>And finally, City of Wisdom, No. 1 – that which will design humanity's future.</size>
<size=45>However, wisdom has vanished, justice has crumbled, and generosity comes at a high price.</size>
<size=45>Temperance has given way to indulgence, courage has turned to dust, and compassion has hardened into cruelty.</size>
<size=45>But hope alone weathers the storm, shining bright once more.</size>

scripts.say: "Today, I arrived at New Era City No. 5."
location: New Era City No. 5 - Corporate Alliance

scripts.say: "Once upon a time, the people of this city were replete with goals, plans, and vision. If they could only secure capital, they would consider their life a success."
Hakuhou watched the city quietly from high above.
Heehee... How interesting.
I thought that pulling out that one flimsy pillar would turn this place into utter chaos.
How efficient they are, erecting a new framework so swiftly.
You don't seem too worried about the fact that people are assembling a resistance force.
Of course not. I'm curious about them. Is this only a temporary facade of strength? Or do they really have what it takes to escape this mess?
After all, temporarily regaining control is one thing – holding onto it is very different.
Hakuhou lunged, sweeping her fox tails to attack. However, Tiger faced her head-on and tore through her white afterimage.
A Companion Ball flew forth and enveloped Hakuhou. Rather than resist, she gazed at me thoughtfully.
I never imagined... that you could make them change so.
You intrigue me, Commander.
"Today, I arrived at New Era City No. 4."
location: New Era City No. 4 - Shopping District

scripts.say: "Here, people act like adults, using money to fill the void within."
Giant advertising screens repeatedly played clichéd promotional messages. However, the city had not a trace of its formerly refined atmosphere.
A transparent figure draped in a soft, white veil stood quietly amidst it all.
Sleep now, my lovely children...
Let my singing voice guide you to dreamland.
Eepy...
Zzz...
Whoa! Why are people sleeping all over the mall?
You don't need to think or make decisions...
To choose the right product, or seek a more respectable life...
To worry about making the wrong decision or losing what you have...
Can my gentle song soothe your pain, little ones?
I understand how you feel. You're worried that they won't be able to keep on living like this.
But that doesn't give you the right to deprive them of human emotion.
The poltergeist named Illustrious gazes kindly at me. Warm light spreads from her, as if to embrace every restless soul.
This time, Tiger doesn't use her full strength. As the containment device closes, Illustrious looks down slowly, as if letting go of a mental burden.
I willingly accept defeat at your hands. Heehee.
Because I know that you truly understand me.
"Today, I arrived at New Era City No. 3."
location: New Era City No. 3 - Amusement Park

scripts.say: "Here, people can forget their pain for a short time and embrace joy... until the park closes, at least."
The amusement park twinkled brightly, drawing a stark contrast to the terrified screams coming from within.
A girl with cat ears sat atop the park's tallest statue, kicking her legs leisurely as she watched the chaos below.
You're finally here~
I was thinking... I'd have to really turn up the excitement to get you to have fun here!
Excitement? The place is a damn disaster!
It's an a-meow-sement park. It's supposed to be lively, silly!
Laughter, screams, or people running around... Isn't it fun to see everyone moving?
It sounds to me like she was just bored waiting for us.
Exactlyyy!
Vendors dutifully make food with double salt, and customers dutifully pay double the price for drinks. Everyone's too darn docile!
So you decided to make a mess of the place... because you thought a good amusement park ought to be uncontrollable?
It's an interesting way of thinking, I'll give you that.
Huh? You didn't come to lecture me?
Hehehe, I'm suddenly in a good mood~
Cheshire jumps down, giggling as she flickers in and out of sight amidst the discordant mix of light and shadow.
Tiger lunges at her fleeting afterimage, tearing open a path through the labyrinth.
As the containment device's glow engulfs her, Cheshire puffs out her cheeks, apparently unhappy with how quickly the game has ended.
Aww, guess I lose~
But I'm glad you decided to play with me, my new owner!
"Today, I arrived at New Era City No. 6."
"Machines run ceaselessly, filling the air with the stench of oil at all times."
A tall, slender figure leans casually against a massive machine, as if waiting for the final act to begin.
Heheheh. You've done well to come this far.
Here I thought the others would at least slow you down.
Ah! She's the one who kidnapped me back at City No. 7!
Hmm? Ooh, I do seem to recall something like that.
You managed to escape my grasp. I think that deserves a reward.
Oh? You must be tough, then.
I wonder. You wanna test how sharp my fangs are?
And mine are long and sharp like yours.
Heh... Let's see if your skills are worthy of the big game you spout!
A giant pair of scissors suddenly appears in Lion's hands. She rides atop a machine going haywire, charging toward us like a frenzied beast.
When the Companion Ball's glow touches Lion, she's startled for a moment – but then, she smirks.
I'm willing to accept when I'm beat. You win.

sequence: Thus, Cities No. 3 through 6 have joined hands with us.
The front line progressed to New Era City No. 2...
The stronghold of Dark Lord Azuchi.

scripts.say: "New Era City No. 2..."
Hooold up. What is your deal? Why do you keep showing up?
...Sorry. I'm just passing by... I'm only recording the situation, so I'll leave the fighting to you.
Whoa, this feels way different than last time! Like a real last battle and stuff!
There are quite a few poltergeists ahead. They're blocking our path.
We're prepared for this.
The containment device activates, and several figures descend as they emerge from the light.
Whoa, we're pulling out the big guns? Are we gonna have some real fun for once, Owner?
So we're up against a former comrade and the Dark Lord herself? It doesn't look like we have much leeway for chit-chat.
It's fine. Even on a battlefield, a child is still a child... Be good for once and take your nap.
Heh... To think you'd call upon your old enemies for help.
You must be really confident, Commander.
Y-yeah... It kind of feels like we got a bunch of villains on our side, doesn't it?!
Oh? I think it's pretty cool.
Hello.
Pleased to make your acquaintance~
Hello! Let's do our best!
Hello... Is this really the time for greetings, though?
Greetings are important.
Lord Azuchi said she won't let you go any further.
Come on now. Would you try listening to us for once?
No. I was just repeating what Lord Azuchi said. There's no need for you to take her word as law.
But she did say something else. If you insist on going forward, she'll have me drive you back to the entrance.
I thought it made sense. It takes a long time to get this far from the entrance on foot.
Well, that won't do.
The Commander wants to move forward. Step aside, or we might just have to make you.
...Alright, then.
I'm sorry. I will have to make the first move.
Heheh. Wasting no time with pleasantries, I see.
Commander, let's go.
With everyone working together, we manage to break past the blockade and advance deep into enemy territory.
Welcome back, Commander.
Things have gotten so much more interesting since our last meeting, don't you think?
I was a little surprised that you were able to gather this much support, I must admit.
Azuchi spreads her fan open. Not a second later, she's disappeared into thin air.
It's a shame, though. Your efforts have changed nothing.
Despite receiving countless direct hits, Azuchi simply rises again, totally unscathed.
Ahahah... That's not nearly enough!
Your attacks are not enough to make even a dent on me.
She revived?
That's right. I am the Undying Flame, after all.
Your paltry power is nothing but a light warm-up for one such as myself!
Azuchi raises her fan, and raging flames come rushing towards us.
Even after all our efforts, she turns the tables on us in a matter of seconds.
Ugh... We didn't make it this far just to lose!
Commander!
But right then, a roar tears across the skies above us. I look up and see a sleek airship gracefully cutting through the clouds and heading towards us.
Hmph! So you finally make your move... City No. 1.
The airship's hatch opens, and several small figures descend from it. As soon as they come down, they shoot a powerful blast that pushes back Azuchi's fire ever so slightly.
Amagi from City No. 1, here to help!
I'm very sorry, Commander of City No. 7... *cough*... I know I'm a little late.
We can't afford to go down here, everyone! Let's retreat for now!
Orientation Room
Just as Javelin was about to be engulfed by the ghostly flames, the wand in her hand emitted a dazzling light.
Huh?
The spirit, which had approached to devour her, grimaced at the light and took a step back.
Wha? What's happening?! The wand is glowing? Did I turn it on, or something?!
The light only intensified from there.
At the same time, she felt a warm sensation swelling within her chest.
It's so strange... Just a moment ago, I was so scared that I was about to cry.
But now, I feel like I've really landed a job...
Not being able to afford rent, sending resumes into the void, my sisters asking me when I'm going to find a job... Those days are over.
And it makes me feel...
Like I'm reeeally happy!
With that heartfelt cry, a vivid pink ripple of light spread from the tip of the wand, dispelling the room's cold, stifling atmosphere.
I gently knock on the orientation room door.
Come in!
When I enter, I'm unsurprised by what I see.
No damaged furniture, nobody passed out from fear. Looks like your training went perfectly.
This rookie isn't half bad, Commander~
R-rookie? Wait a second... Are you with the OPA, too?
Allow me to introduce you. She's Amatsukaze – a poltergeist I scouted and a fellow member of the field op team.
She usually helps with field ops and, well... certain psychological tests, as you've experienced.
In all these years, you're the first one to pass with flying colors. Congrats! You're practically made for this job.
I-I'm honored! But I'm not sure I really understand...
Aren't poltergeists our enemy?
Just as there are good people and bad people, there are also poltergeists who cooperate with humans.
Amatsukaze and I, for example.
That's right! Tiger can't manifest a corporeal form, so I help her with things when needed.
I see... Phew. For a moment there, I thought I'd joined the bad guys! Good thing I was mistaken.
What exactly just happened though?
Javelin murmurs under her breath, glancing down at her wand.
The gemstone at its tip has returned to normal, with only the faintest pink shimmer.
To put it in simple terms, that weapon drew out your emotional energy.
More precisely, your happiness power.
Happiness... power?
That's one method that the Office of Paranormal Affairs uses to counter poltergeists.
So... the wand ISN'T just there to be cute, after all?
Of course not. It just helps that it's cute.
If you wanna really stand out, try coming up with a cool line to shout when you use it.
Umm... Like what?
Don't overthink it. What matters is that you're unleashing happiness power. Only you can figure out what exactly that means for you.
All we know is that it's one of the effects of the Happy City Project – and that it defies all scientific logic. I mean, that's why it's paranormal, right?
As for our other methods of combating them, there's using poltergeists to fight poltergeists.
Javelin is stunned for a moment. Her gaze drifts toward Amatsukaze's kitsune ears and Tiger's incorporeal form.
Ack! Hey, don't scare me like that! What's your deal?!
Ah, I just noticed something! I couldn't understand what you were saying before, but now that the Commander is here, I can...?
You have Tiger to thank for that – not me.
One of her abilities is rhythm harmonization. Language is a form of rhythm, so she's able to convert poltergeist speech into a format that we can understand.
Heehee. Even people who speak the same language often need translation, don't they?
Huh?! Is that really a thing?!
For example, can you truly say that you understand every word your superiors say?
I don't think... No, I totally can! I understand all of it!
Ahem... Anyway, thanks to Tiger's help, we're able to understand poltergeists on a more personal level.
Now that basic introductions are over, let's get down to brass tacks.
I place a silver metal sphere on the desk. It unfolds automatically, revealing a ring of light on the inside.
This is a containment device.
A weakened poltergeist can be stuffed in here to keep it temporarily contained.
Basically, you beat it up, and then you throw the ball at it!
What were they called, again? Poke Bowls? Crow Cards? Uh...
No, that's not right... Let's just give them a nickname. Something with "ball" in it...
I've got it. Companion Ball? Yeah... Let's go with that.
Anyway, that about covers what I can explain for now. Let's move on to a live simulation.
Huh? Already?!
It's only a simulation. We have a grace period for rookies so that we don't throw them into harm's way on their first day.
...As long as there's no emergency, anyway.
Thank goodness!
BEEP BEEP!
Right on cue, an alarm begins blaring through the OPA office.
An anomalous region has been detected on the main street of the East Side! Proceed to the scene immediately!
The main street... Isn't it still daytime?
That's odd. Poltergeists normally lurk at night... Somebody needs to be taught manners.
Office of Paranormal Affairs Field Ops Team Member Javelin.
Y-yes?!
You'll be working with Amatsukaze and me today.
There are two things I need you to remember. One, don't leave my sight.
Two, if a poltergeist approaches you, hold your wand tight... and never doubt your own longing for happiness.
Let's move out, Field Ops Team!
Thank goodness, we're safe...
Yeah, for real... WAIT! Where the hell did you even come from this time?!
Hmm... I can't recall...
Oh, right... Amagi-chan, may I help you with the controls?
As the airship soars through clouds, a pristine white city sprawls below us.
Unlike other cities, City No. 1 has a pure, unsullied atmosphere. It's as if the poltergeists haven't touched it whatsoever.
Everybody... Welcome to New Era City No. 1.
Mmnh... What's going on? I feel a little dizzy...
I've secured special clearance for all of the poltergeists accompanying the Commander...
But unfortunately, there still seems to be some discomfort... Please try to bear with it, okay?
Phew... Okay. We can land now.
As the airship comes to a stop on the landing strip, Amagi-chan's tension melts away, and she falls backward suddenly.
*cough* *cough*... I'm sorry. This body is not suited for intense combat...
You did great. Leave the rest to us.
The exhausted girl leans on me. Her labored breathing gradually settles into a sleepy rhythm.
She's been pushing herself this whole time...
Suddenly, the hatch opens, and a girl in maid attire enters. She offers a cute curtsy.
Hello. I am Belfast, an administrative officer. Please allow me to take care of Amagi-chan.
Thank you.
As Little Bel escorts Amagi-chan to the rear of the ship, a melody drifts in from afar.
What a unique melody...
I can sense it... It seems capable of awakening some... dormant quality deep within the human mind.
We turn toward the source of the sound and see blue ripples of energy radiating outward from the Research Tower.
That's the New Era Reboot Device, the heart of the Happy City Project!
Don't act like you've never seen it before. The device in front of No. 7's City Hall is a miniature version of it.
Cleveland, the special envoy from City No. 1, appears as well.
Or, rather... A smaller version of her?
You're tiny! Did you shrink?!
Hey, don't judge a book by her cover! I'm just a little shorter now, that's all.
Anyway, thanks to the Reboot Device in that Research Tower, we can maintain stability here even in the midst of a large-scale poltergeist attack.
But it comes with a price.
Well... Of course it does. Somebody else can explain the details later!
Anyway, Commander, come with me!
The Council of Eight awaits.
Tiger watches with an unreadable look as Clevelad confidently leads the way.
But then, she seems to notice something interesting outside, and beckons to me.
Pedestrians walk along the street in an orderly fashion, showing none of the stress or discomfort of wartime.
Formidable, my Sandy Senses are tingling... I just had a great idea!
What if that Research Tower is actually a super-huge turret?!
Hmm... Perhaps it is possible? But how could we ascertain such a thing?
Easy! We just...
Li'l Sandy takes out a cup of lemonade with a snowman face on it and drinks it as she surveys the Research Tower.
You've noticed too, haven't you? Something is strange about this place.
Belfast, Amagi, Cleveland... Heck, everybody here. None of them seem the slightest bit concerned about what's going on outside.
And why are they all KIDS?
The large doors of the council chamber slowly open, opening the way to the most powerful people in the city.
On the other side of this door are the greatest minds of City No. 1, politicians armed with legendary leadership and wisdom.
Huh? They're here already? Quick, hide the snacks!
Several small figures rush about, clearing half-drunk juices and opened snacks from the table.
(What's going on here? Even the city's top officials are children?)
Ahem... Okay! Welcome to New Era City No. 1, Commander and poltergeist friends!
So you're the legendary Commander? You don't LOOK like a god, though...
You're finally here... I've been looking forward to meeting you♡
At least let them all sit first... It's really tiring to talk while standing!
Do you want... juice? We have... apple and grape!
Um... I'm sorry if this is a dumb question, but...
Are you all the Council of Eight?
S-sorry. The way we look and act might lead to misunderstandings...
We are the founders of the Happy City Project – the Council of Eight.
The Happy City Project... I still don't really get what it is.
I mean, how are you supposed to go about making all of humankind happy?
Through the use of the New Era Reboot Device... developed by this one...
We feed noble ideals into it... strip away impurities... and weave beautiful dreams for all... Zzz.
I see. You mean the stuff we saw coming out of the Research Tower?
The Reboot Device's special wavelengths can help keep poltergeists at bay, to an extent.
Of course, the girls who came with you are fine, since we gave them special clearance.
But this one's device... does have its limits.
Those exposed to the device's high-powered radiation for long periods... will gradually regress, mentally and physically... Zzz.
Regress?
It doesn't just make us smaller~
Your judgment, emotions, and how you face pain and responsibility... gradually regress to a younger state.
In body and mind, huh?
But aren't I adorable in this tiny form, Commander?
If you remain here, then you too shall gradually be affected... Zzz.
Yet you still want to keep the device running? All for the sake of keeping City No. 1 happy?
B-but... What about the other cities?
They're important too, of course. But...
City No. 1 only maintains order thanks to the Reboot Device.
You've already come face to face with Azuchi, haven't you? Then you should understand just how hard it is to beat her.
We want to protect what we still can.
But...
Javelin falls silent for a moment. However, she steels herself and speaks her mind.
I know that there are a lot of poltergeists out there. And I understand that stopping the device means facing danger.
But if happiness means forgetting fear, worry, and responsibility...
Then I think your happiness is just cowardice.
The room falls silent.
To be honest... I'm afraid, too.
I've been afraid ever since my first mission. Poltergeists are scary, and so is failure. Most of all, the thought that I can't help people terrifies me.
But it's that fear that drives me to change my circumstances. Knowing sadness makes me want to help others escape from it.
I'd rather keep on fighting as a grown-up – even if I'm clumsy or messy!
Heehee... Very inspiring.
You're a real operator now, Javelin. It brings a tear to my eye! I'm not calling you a rookie anymore!
Huh? You mean it? I kind of like being called rookie, though. It makes me feel young again...
But if you stop the machine, then City No. 1 will be in danger...
We know that. We didn't come here to play hero.
But relying on this device forever won't solve your problems. It only lets them pile up and get worse.
We'll take the responsibility for it. We'll formulate plans, set up defenses, and fight alongside all of you.
The eight little girls look at each other.
Oh, no... They do kind of have a point, don't they?
Does that mean it's decided?
Yeah. As for who will stop the Reboot Device... Commander, we'll leave that to you.
Since we've been under its influence for so long, it's easier for us to waver as we get closer to the core...
Then let's all go... Huh?!
Javelin clutches her chest and shudders in pain.
Hey... Why'd you sound so much younger just now, Javelin? And your outfit...
Wait, it's happening to me, too?!
It seems there isn't much time left.

Amatsukaze and Javelin have been positioned to defend the Council of Eight together with its members. Meanwhile, Tiger and I rush to the upper floor's control room where the Research Tower's Reboot Device is located.
The higher we climb, the clearer that special melody becomes.
Can you keep going?
Of course.
I keep up with her, but a sudden feeling of weightlessness hits me, as if I'm stumbling into clouds.
Commander?
Just a little dizzy...
I reach out to grab hold of the railing beside me to steady myself.
I should have had no trouble reaching it, but it's as if it's moved out of reach.
Commander... You're regressing.
It seems the effects become more potent with proximity to the core.
We're almost there. There's no time to lose.
Yes, I'm right there with you.
Each step feels like climbing up a wall that drains more and more of my energy.
I manage to push past it and all the obstacles on the way, and we finally make it to the control room where the Reboot Device rests.
Commander, look. There's a lever next to the base of the device. Maybe that's the main switch.
We can operate it manually? Well, that's easier than expected.

options.content: (Pull down as hard as you can.)

scripts.say: Hngh!
I use all the strength my muscles can muster, but all I get is a faint metallic creak from the lever, which remains stuck firmly in place.
But the lever refuses to budge.
With my hands literally shrinking before my eyes, it's simply too hard to exert any amount of force.
At the same time, the eerie melody rings sweeter, gentler, and more inviting to my ears.
"You've worked so hard, sweetie."
"It's time to rest. Running away is nothing to be ashamed of. You've done more than enough..."
Don't listen to it.
Commander, you can't let it fool you.
You can fight it. I know you can.
I take a deep breath and grip the lever as firmly as I can.
If only I was just a little bit stronger...
I put all of my weight into it. The lever shifts slightly, but I still can't manage to get it to budge.
...It's okay.
You've done everything you can, Commander.
This is not a problem you can solve on your own anymore.
but I know you're not the kind of person to simply stand down.
So let me help you.
Tiger gently places her hand over mine, and tiny motes of light start rising from her body. Immediately, the outlines of her form seem to come undone, like an illusion losing its form.
Tiger, your body!
Yes. Turning fully corporeal means certain death. Disappearance.
But this is no time to hesitate.
So don't look back now. Let me fight by your side.
She gives me a gentle smile. One she rarely shows to anyone.
With our combined strength, the heavy lever finally lowers.
With a heavy clunk, the Reboot Device that had been protecting City No. 1 until now stops.
We made it... Commander...
Ugh... This hurts more than I imagined it would...
But this pain... It's nothing compared to the alternative...
Having been able to connect with you so deeply at this very moment...
That feeling... It's more precious to me than life itself...
This is it... The perfect resonance I sought this whole time...
Alarms go off one after another in the distance. It's a clear sign that full scale combat is underway on the outskirts of the city.
The poltergeists have launched their attack... This place will be in danger soon.
Tiger, I'll take you to a safe place right now.
Commander!
Hurried steps come our way from outside the control room.
Tiger... You...
I came to guide you to the temporary command post! Let me help with the evacuation!
The girl bows her head and makes way for us.
Just as Tiger and I are about to leave, enchanted flames erupt from the floor without warning, blocking our way to the exit.
From the raging flames emerges a familiar figure.
That was quite an entertaining display.
To think you of all people would shut down the thing I'd wanted to destroy all this time.
You... wanted to destroy this?
Azuchi turns her gaze to the now inactive device.
The birth of poltergeists is linked to the Happy City Project.
The Reboot Device was made to separate the elements of people's emotions deemed unnecessary.
It expels all the liabilities to achieve "happiness." These expelled emotions eventually coalesce and become poltergeists.
To get right down to it, we poltergeists are what humans discarded in order to achieve their long-desired happiness.
So let me ask you a question, I-14.
Do you really think you can believe in humans after everything they've done?
The air around us seems to sit still. The girl who had identified herself as rear service personnel until now covers her face with her hands and heaves a deep sigh.
It looks like this is as far as my act goes.
Allow me to introduce myself... I am I-14.
I was monitoring you... on Lord Azuchi's orders.
Heheh♪ It would have been nice if you were able to keep up the mask to the end.
That was my plan. But if...
I-14 steps forward, standing between Azuchi and us. Azuchi glares at her, the surprise clear as day across her face.
If you dare lay your hands on the Commander... I won't obey you anymore.
Oh? I know I ordered you to infiltrate their camp, but I didn't mean for you to start working for them.
Say what you will... I know what I'm doing.
If someone is trying their hardest to save others from nothingness... then I don't think we should abandon them.
Come on, Commander. I'll help you get out of here...
Azuchi gently closes her fan. For the first time, there is a glint of admiration in her eyes.
You really have exceeded my expectations.
I was worried that this play would fizzle out at its most tedious moment.
But it seems that my earlier judgment about the theme of mutual understanding was all wrong.
People like you are worthy of respect – and I don't say those words lightly.
