I'll do you a small favor.
Her eyes fall upon Tiger, who remains in my arms.
As she struggles to maintain her form, her body turns more and more transparent. It seems as if she could disappear at any moment.
My fire is the Flame of Rebirth, after all.
Fire of crimson and gold rises from beneath Tiger's feet and quickly engulfs her.
Ngh... My physical form... is stabilizing?
The pain of being scorched is fading away, too...
Lord Azuchi...
Alright, spare me the sappy words. Just don't disappoint me, okay?
The raging flames spiral, gradually tracing and restoring Tiger's vanishing outline.
I unconsciously hold her tighter. Only when I can really feel her do my nerves begin to finally unravel.
Just then, I'm stricken by a wave of dizziness and exhaustion.
Commander!
Heehee. Sleep well for now.
When you wake up, it will be time to lead everyone toward a new tomorrow.
...But do not let your guard down. If rot and decay ever set in to this world again...
I will use my raging flames to rebuild the world anew – the way I see fit.
When I open my eyes, the first thing I see is an unfamiliar ceiling.
My nose is greeted by the scent of disinfectant... and French fries, for some reason.
A girl excitedly greets me through the bedside curtain.
Oh, Commander! Awake already?
Would you like the adults' romantic awakening meal, or the kids' endless fun meal?
Uh... I'll take the adult one?
Actually, if it comes with a toy... I wouldn't mind the kids' meal.

sequence: Stick around after the credits
for fun behind-the-scenes stories!
Interlude

scripts.say: Wait... How much intel on us did you sniff out, I-14?
Not that much...
Be specific.
Do you really wanna know? It's all related the Commander.
Tell me more!

sequence: Interlude

scripts.say: Congrats, everyone! Crisis has been averted!
Let's get to work on damage reports, operational plans, and scheduling the next quarter... together!
With THIS workload, I think the crisis has only just begun!

sequence: Behind-the-Scenes Extra

scripts.say: Commander, Commander! Look at the toy I got from the kids' meal! You can have it.
It really comes with a toy... Wow.
My toy is better~ Here you go, Commander~♡
Commander! I brought a toy so we can play, too!
Let me join! You've got room for one more, don't you?
Teacher...! Teacher, let Anchorage join!
Me, too. I want to play with cute toys with the Commander...
This one has no need for play... Instead, let me lean on you and take a small nap...
Line up, everyone! Single file!
So many people...
Wow! Why is everyone swarming into the Commander's room? The patient requires peace and quiet!
You're just trying to get the Commander all to yourself, aren't you, Director?
N-NOT true!
I was just looking forward to a lovely, romantic moment♪
Just a few minutes ago, this street was the liveliest place in all of the East Side's commercial district.
But by the time we arrive, everything has changed. An unseen force has plucked this bright, bustling street out of reality.
Though it's still midday, a leaden gloom hangs over the city, turning the light cold.
It's nothing like the commercial district outside. Rules, distance, direction... Everything is distorted.
Our navigation systems are malfunctioning, too.
What are we going to do?
Isn't it obvious? We're gonna find that poltergeist and capture it.
Tiger, can you sense anything up ahead?
Hmm... There are many discordant sounds coming from deep inside the anomaly.
Grating arguments, intense clashes...
It's such an unpleasantly chaotic performance. One can hardly tell at this point whether they're human or poltergeist.
...Wait.
Tiger raises her baton slightly, pointing it toward a side street engulfed by shadow up ahead.
One restless melody... draws ever nearer.
*pant*... *pant*... D-did I manage to shake them?
It still feels like... something is behind me, staring...
Unable to bear the fear, Z14 turns around. A black shadow is looming there, silently.
Huh... Aah?! Oww... I tripped...
The shadow begins its soundless approach.
D-don't come any closer!
That's as far as you go!
Dazzling light cuts between them.
The shadow backs off just slightly. After hesitating there for a few seconds, it instantly vanishes from sight.
I'm on my first official mission, and I... Hey, it ran away! Commander, should we give chase?
Hold it. It could be a trap.
Wow...
Commander, we've found a survivor!
You're safe now! Ah... You scraped your knee? I'll help you up.
Thanks, umm... Are you that girl who was on the train?
Huh? Umm...
One girl sitting in another seat timidly held up her Urban Survival Guide book.
A-anyway... I'm more scared of those poltergeists, you know?
Oh, it's you! Hehe, I'm surprised you remembered me... Especially because I'm in uniform.
Yeah! You seem so much more reliable now...
Photos had been attached to the joint investigation request. Z14 was one of the kidnapping victims.
(This anomaly must be connected to that case.)
The anomalous space suddenly lurches. Harsh electrical interference engulfs us.
Instantly after, streetside shop windows, glass storefronts, and even reflections in puddles on the ground display the same exact image.
It's the pale, blurred face of a woman, backed by a pitch-black background.
You mustn't go any further...
Wh-what's going on now?!
Watch out for reflective surfaces! Don't look into them!
As I shout the order, a pale hand reaches out of a shop's TV display and lunges straight for Javelin.
Aaaah!
She raises her wand high. Pink light shines from it, causing the hand to recoil as if burned.
Heehee... That one hurt. Slowing you down won't be as easy as I'd hoped.
Slowing us down, huh? Who are you trying to let escape? Was it that shadow chasing Z14?
Are you behind the disappearances?
Oh, my... This is a surprise.
You can understand me?
Amidst the static noise, a woman begins crawling out of the screen.
Pleasure to meet you~ My name is Friedrich Carl.
I've heard rumors about you. You tame poltergeists and command them in battle, isn't that right?
The affection dripping from your words does fascinate me, but helping my Lord comes first... so I'm afraid I'll have to listen another time.
Leave this place now~
Do you think we'd abandon a mission just because you asked us to?
Oh, my~ It seems we've come to a disagreement. Don't worry – I won't be too rough with you.
Friedrich Carl's lips curl up into a grin. Suddenly, all of the glass surfaces around us shatter as countless black shadows lunge forth.
Amatsukaze! Tiger!
On it!
Ghostly flames spread, incinerating the shadows before they can reach us.
Her attack rhythm is faltering... Very well done.
Let's end this farce and write the final note on her performance!
With a gleam in her eyes and a fang poking out from between her lips, Tiger's demeanor becomes wild and frenzied.
Such exquisite music... It must be thanks to you that a human can speak with us.
But we fellow poltergeists can understand each other even more intimately. Why don't you come and work with us?
Work with you? Please contact the Commander for business inquiries... Now, silence! It's time for my performance!
When Tiger raises her hand, the chaotic static around us suddenly stops. It's replaced by a low hum that makes the skin crawl.
Beyond the heavens, stars light up one by one, piercing through the gloom.
Hear now the symphony of the stars!
One swing of her baton causes ripples of starlight to spread outward, destroying every anomalous image around us.
However, one reflection remains untouched.
There! Now, Javelin!
Don't forget to say a cool line!
M-me?! I... I'll do my best!
PINKLOVE★Heart Lancer!
Like a shooting star streaking through the sky, Javelin's wand transforms into a long spear, piercing Friedrich Carl's reflection and dragging her into reality.
Commander, her true form has appeared! Don't miss your moment!
I throw the Companion Ball at the poltergeist. It opens up in midair, revealing its spinning ring of light, and envelops her figure.
Containment confirmed.
After the capture of Friedrich Carl, the Office of Paranormal Affairs and City Hall swiftly launched our joint investigation.
location: New Era City No. 7 - City Hall

scripts.say: With our new leads and city security camera footage, we thought we had identified her as the true culprit behindthe disappearances. However, that was only at a surface level.
In the reception room of City Hall sits a warm cup of black tea, next to an invitation I'd received just earlier today.
It was a private invitation, signed with nothing more than the title "Lady."
I've never heard of anybody by that name at City Hall...
And she claims that she'd like to thank you in person.
Heheh. Interesting.
Though this was supposed to be a simple follow-up meeting on the case, the private invitation seems to hint at something greater.
The door to the meeting room opens silently. A woman wearing elegant attire enters.
Did I keep you waiting?
No, not long...
A pleasure. My name is Golden Hind, and I am the "lady" who requested your presence. You could consider me... this city's acting mayor.
(Acting mayor? Sounds like things are rough at City Hall lately.)
May I ask why you've requested my presence? Is it regarding the missing persons cases?
That it is. This was the most difficult case since the establishment of the Office of Paranormal Affairs... I thought I should show my appreciation for you resolving it.
Resolving it? You act fast, but I worry that you jump to conclusions even faster.
The city must have order, and its citizens must have their answers. I've found that offering a digestible response quickly is the best way to ensure everybody lives on happily.
I take it that you don't really think this is over, either.
Of course not. You wouldn't be so easily placated either, would you?
City Hall is willing to assist with the OPA's future operations.
Whatever you may need, be it information, assets, authority, or expedited access... I will offer whatever I can.
As long as it means finding the true culprit.
Agreed. It's a pleasure working with you.
Then I look forward to the next time we meet.
With that, I get up to leave. On my way out, I hear a quiet murmur behind me.
Maybe you're what I've been looking for... The seeds that can change the world.
As night fell, a cool breeze swept through the city. Lights gradually illuminated the buildings and streets.
The team had decided to throw a small party to celebrate Javelin's first successful mission.
With the time fast approaching, Javelin finished donning her cute dress and rushed toward the restaurant.
Things got scary, but I'm glad we managed to defeat that poltergeist in the end!
If my sisters knew about this, they'd think I was so cool.
Oh, no. I'm gonna be late... Maybe I should take this shortcut.
The alley was much quieter than the main street. Its broken streetlights left it sparsely lit.
Ah... Achoo! Wh-why am I suddenly cold? Maybe I didn't dress up enough...
...Huh?
Javelin froze in place. The bustling of the main street had faded, as if the alleyway had been plucked out of the city entirely.
No way...
That's not fair. I'm supposed to be off work now!
She turned back toward the alley entrance, but she only found herself surrounded by endless darkness.
A cold, metallic clanging came from the depths of that dark.
Her breathing quickened as she frantically searched her bag.
Oh, no! I left my weapon back at the office because it wouldn't fit in my bag...
Ugh, I really messed up this time... I should've been more serious about my job.
The eerie sound came ever closer. Black shadows lunged in from the darkness and engulfed Javelin.
Couldn't we just... Couldn't we talk this out?! Ugh, without Tiger and the Commander here, there's nothing I can...
Darkness closed in. The hustle and bustle of the city could be heard in the distance, but it was too late.
Meanwhile, Amatsukaze gulped down saliva as she stared at the array of hot dishes before her.
Javelin's awfully late... She said she'd be here soon thirty whole minutes ago.
Say, where'd you find that promising upcoming of yours anyway, Commander?
She's motivated and good at her job. I hear she's got family back at home... That girl's got all the qualities of the perfect employee.
I'd better call her. I want her to know just how sweet and loving I am.
I already called her, and she didn't answer...
Before I can finish speaking, an earsplitting alarm suddenly blares from all directions.
This is a citywide alert! Large-scale poltergeist attack detected! All citizens, please proceed to the nearest safe shelter!
An attack?! I've never seen such a large-scale attack from them before!
Beneath the cover of night, countless black shadows begin to emerge throughout the city.
Ugh, I still can't get in contact with Javelin! She didn't get taken, did she?!
As soon as we rush out of the restaurant, countless ribbons fall from above, separating Amatsukaze and me.
In the chaotic light, I hear a faint voice.
Commandeeer! I'm here!
"Javelin" runs toward me with a big, bright smile, still wearing her work uniform.
Sorry I'm late! It got a little hectic outside... but everything is okay now!
Everything is so realistic. Flawless, even.
The panicked crowd outside have disappeared. Fragrant, steaming dishes warm the heart.
Why aren't you all eating?
Oh, I know! Do I have to start the party, since it's for me? I'm surprised people in the big city are so considerate~
Javelin...
I'm here! Would you like to say a few words first, Commander?
I'm going to save you.
Um... What? But I'm here.
Back off.
Tiger emerges from the shadows and swings her baton horizontally.
Aww... I was so close.
Javelin vanishes, and the entire illusion is peeled away.
Ooh! You're a genius at shoulder massages, rookie! Let's get the other shoulder now~
Huh?! Wh-what's going on? Was I dreaming? Where's the Commander?!
The shadow approaches with almost dance-like steps. Metal rings in her hands draw eerie afterimages behind her.
With each spin and undulation, another clone of her appears. They draw nearer, clearly trying to seduce me.
The spotlights and audience are in position... Yorck the dancer takes the stage!
Won't you dance this beautiful, illusory night away with me?
C-Commander, don't fall for her charms! Tch, there are too many fakes to tell where the real one is!
The endless crowd of Yorcks all grin seductively at me.
No matter how many there are, they're only noise in the end.
Close your eyes, Commander. Have faith in me, and I will lead you from this labyrinth.
Follow my lead. Amatsukaze will be there.
You'd entrust yourself to a poltergeist? She and I are fundamentally the same.
Quiet, you.
When Tiger swings her baton, the illusions all freeze in place. The stars' low murmuring drowns out the clamor of dance music.
She leads me to one of the illusions and urges me to grab her hand.
Amatsukaze.
Commander! Ooh, it's really you!
Ghostly blue fires erupt out of thin air, pressing in on the true form of Yorck.
You've got nerve, trying to deceive me of all people!
Heehee... Your trust is enviable.
It makes me wonder... If I followed you, how far could we go together?
Amidst the flames, I throw the containment device. Yorck only chuckles softly without resistance.
Containment confirmed.
As the containment device closes, the illusory space collapses.
My phone suddenly vibrates, and the screen lights up with Javelin's name.
*sob*... Commander! I'm sorry I'm late! Poltergeists attacked me on the way to the restaurant...
Are you hurt?
I'm fine, somehow... Things are a little confusing right now. I-I'll try to explain...
A poltergeist grabbed me and took me to City Hall!
But I didn't have my weapon, so perhaps she let her guard down... and I used that opportunity to escape!
Then, as soon as I ran out, I heard the sirens blaring... I was lucky that I ran into Arizona. She took me to a safe place to hide!
Umm... Hello. I work at City Hall, so I happen to know the layout of the building...
She helped me out a lot when I was looking for a job... Oh, I'd better keep my voice down. It sounds like there are poltergeists outside...
You two had better hide. Safety comes first.
Amatsukaze and I will go back to the office and get our gear. Then, we'll pick you up.
Don't be reckless, rookie! Once I'm there, I'll show those poltergeists just who they're messing with!
Yes, ma'am! We'll wait for you to get here!
The call ends. Thus, Amatsukaze and I make way for the OPA office.
Containment Zone... Danger... D-don't come any closer... Please...
Well, something's gone wrong. As expected.
It looks like a few of our "friends" have broken loose.
We can clean this mess up after. First things first, let's head to the armory to get Javelin's weapon.
We rush through the lobby. However, the deeper we go, the more unfamiliar our surroundings become.
The walls, usually marked with safety signs, are now lined with glass display cases filled with dolls.
Hey, what the heck is with these dolls?!
Did nobody ever teach you not to spy on people?
The dolls in the display cases all turn to look at us in unison.
Commander, you meanie...
Leaving me all alone here so you can have fun without me...
Hmph. She's complaining awfully fast after being captured. Isn't she the reason you and Javelin met in the first place?
I just wanted to find someone in this city to play with... Then, I found you...
But after that, you kept me locked inside that cold, cold ball...
It's a good thing that sweet new girl let all of us out~
(Sweet new girl... Friedrich Carl?)
Now we can play again~
After Hasty finishes speaking, faint whispers begin to drift from the glass showcases.
dOn't go... sTaY HERE... it's coLd AlL AlOne... SMiLE, AND You wOn't be leFt all aLoNE...
They overlap, as if they're all fragments of one poor child's loneliness.
Hehe~ Let's play a game together, Commander!
The rules are simple. You can move when the light is on, but when it's off, you can't.
If you lose, you have to stay here and be my new friend!
The lights overhead suddenly go out. I feel something cold pressing against my wrists and neck.
It's as if countless fine threads have wound around me, preventing me from making the slightest move.
...Commander?
Don't move.
A few seconds later, the lights come back on.
Wow, you managed to clear stage 1~ Let's go on to stage 2!
Hasty. I'll play with you when I get back, okay? Can this wait for now?
Javelin's still waiting for us at City Hall, and we need to go help her.
I have to wait until you come home...?
She looks down sadly and pinches the hem of her skirt.
I don't wanna.
You say you'll be right back, you close the door, and you never come back...
Dolls are the only ones who never leave. They stay here with me.
Hasty's voice gradually trails off. The grinning faces in the displays multiply, filling each case to bursting.
Then come with us.
...Huh?
We won't lock you up again. We'll take you with us, like the other poltergeists.
You won't get mad at me or call me annoying...?
I mean, maybe I will.
Aren't you supposed to say no at times like this?
But if nothing else, I won't ignore you because you're annoying.
Hasty gazes at me for a moment in shock. Afterward, she claps her hands together once and jumps out of her chair excitedly.
The threads clinging to me gradually unravel.
Dollhouse is closed for the day, everybody~
Because I've found people to hang out with!
The glass displays and warm golden light disappear.
Finally, the door to the armory appears.
Sorry~ I thought you'd grab your weapons and run away if I didn't hide it.
Hasty runs over to me, takes my hand, and looks up at me expectantly.
I'll go with you wherever you go, Commander!
Good to hear that. Let's go get Javelin's gear and head to City Hall together, okay?
She's still waiting for us.
The once majestic and bright city hall was now bathed in a flickering red, bearing the traces of battle.
We made our way toward Javelin's location, clearing out the wandering poltergeists along the way.
Commander!
A familiar voice calls out to me. Javelin peeks around a corner and waves excitedly at us.
Javelin, are you okay?
I'm fine, but Arizona isn't doing too hot...
In a place as dangerous as this, it's only natural for normal people to feel unwell.
We escort Arizona to a shelter outside of City Hall. Along the way, she pauses and looks back at Javelin.
I know this is a weird time to bring this up, but...
Do you remember what I said... the last time we met?
Ah...
Do your best. I pray we'll meet again – and that you'll be happier and cheerier when that time comes.
It looks like you've found a goal that brings you happiness... and something you want to protect, too.
After patting Javelin on the head, she turns and heads into the shelter.
Something I want to protect...
Heheh. Look at you getting all the compliments, rookie.
Now isn't the time for chit-chat! The city is full of poltergeists... Ah! I'd better go change into my gear!
KABOOOOM!
Suddenly, an intense shockwave emanates from the upper floors of City Hall.
That's the floor where the acting mayor's reception room is.
The more we approach the upper floors, the more intense my feeling of unease becomes.
We push through anomalous corridors and arrive at the entrance to the room. Its heavy door is ajar, with a dark-red glow seeping out of it.
Eugh... I've got goosebumps.
This is it.
Be careful... Something dangerous is in there.
The melody she's producing... reminds me of the one I heard when you rescued Z14.
She must be the one who captured me earlier!
As soon as I push the door open, a suffocating feeling washes over me – accompanied by the stagnant stench of blood and decay.
The once-tasteful reception room is a shadow of its former self. Furniture lies sideways on the floor, the walls are torn, and the carpet is burned with the streaks of a heated struggle.
However, there's something even more startling than the wreckage.
Tentacles viscous with purplish-red fluid writhe amidst the furniture, leaving slimy trails and exuding a sickly-sweet stench.
I follow the tentacles to their source... and see the "Lady" I'd once met with, Golden Hind.
Behind her is a cracked mirror, bearing the visage of Friedrich Carl.
...I see.
I knew something was off from the moment we met you before.
The acting mayor of City Hall... was one of us all along.
Whaaat?! The acting mayor of New Era City No. 7 is a poltergeist?!
Did it take you this long to notice?
You lot aren't as smart as I thought.
The shadow beneath her begins to undulate. Thick, slippery tentacles shoot out, putting a barrier between her and us.
Heehee. We meet again, Commander~
I'm sorry for leaving without saying anything earlier~ Things were just so sudden.
Whoa! That's the lady who caused all the trouble back at the office!
How rude. You were so happy when I let you out, too~
Ahem! I'm a different person now!
Are you two... hurt?
Golden Hind and Friedrich Carl look a little worse for wear. However, there shouldn't be anybody else in this city suited to fight poltergeists except for us.
(In that case... are poltergeists fighting each other? But those two seem to be in cahoots...)
Your concern fascinates me, Commander. Are you genuinely worried about us? Or are you simply sizing us up to see if we can stand up to you in a fight?

options.content: I want to know the truth.

scripts.say: I see... You prefer to see the heart of the matter instead of going straight to blows.
"There exists no true understanding between humans and poltergeists."
It seems the person who once said that was misinformed.
You and your poltergeist companions... really do share a bond.
Yeah! The Commander understands me and plays with me!
Heehee. I can tell.
I can tell that you trust your friends... and they trust you, too.
But simple trust isn't enough. What I want to know... is how far you'd go for one another.
As Golden Hind says that, Friedrich Carl raises her hand.
Wait. What are you planning–
Javelin's scream, Amatsukaze's rage, and Hasty clinging to me in fear... All of them are suddenly swept away.
Com... mander... Our space... separated...
Leaving you with Hind ought to be more than effective enough~
Commander. Please, sit.
You brought tea leaves with you? Does that mean you'd rather brew tea for me than have it done for you?
Heehee. I appreciate the gesture.
What do I like to do in my free time? Are you curious about my private life?
I tend to browse Juustagram or walk around port...
Understanding the world's desires and troubles is essential, after all.
Would you look at that? It's time for today's prayer.
If you have any worries, wishes, or other thoughts you can't share with people, feel free to speak them now.
My prayers are more potent than you might imagine. Heehee!
A little MSG, a splash of wasabi...
Hmm... It's still missing something.
What are you cooking?
Cooking? Oh, no. I'm experimenting with coffee recipes!
Ooh, there's an idea. A little chopped green peppers... and it's done.
Would you like a cup, Commander? Heehee!
Commander, could we try a... special confessional?
Give me your hand. Yes, right here.
Calm your breathing... and I will listen to the words left unspoken on your heart's rhythm.
Heehee... Yes, I hear you loud and clear.
Commander, I've baked a pie. Its theme is stargazing.
Try it, while it's fresh.
Stargazing...?
Yep! I arranged the fish so they're pointing upward. The flavour is quite rich.
You don't want to try it? Aw... That's a shame.
Commander, shall we arrange flowers together?
Even two of the same flower can convey different meanings if arranged differently.
Heehee. It's a lovely way to calm the mind and sort out your innermost feelings.
The weather out is lovely. Would you like to do anything together, Commander?
Let's go out for a walk.
Great choice. I'd like to do that, too.
In that case, I'll be with you today. We can do anything you like.
Look, Commander... I made an amulet for you.
Come over and let me put it on you.
Finally, let me offer a prayer over it... and you'll sleep soundly through the night.
When it's this quiet, it's as if I can hear your heartbeat and breathing.
How about we dance? Don't worry about the moves – just follow your heart.
I'll be your guide.
Heehee. Every time I look at you, an odd feeling wells up inside me.
How so?
It's as if the flow of time has forgotten me for a mere instant...
Yet something stirs deep inside my heart... Am I just imagining it? Heehee!
What animals live around here? Well, pigeons land on my windowsill at times.
I like to scatter breadcrumbs and read prayers for them...
Each time, they listen quietly before leaving.
Stay a few days, if you'd like to see them. You might just run into a few.
I've been reading this fascinating book lately.
Basically, it's a story about a lost soul finding peace. It's good for a calming reading session.
Would you like me to read it to you? Then come lie down.
If you fall asleep... I'll give you a little punishment. Heehee!
Are you sleepy, Commander?
Then lie down over here~
Close your eyes... and I'll watch over you.
As for what happens after you fall asleep... I'll figure that out myself. Heehee!
What makeup do I typically use? I'm surprised you're so interested.
Changing makeup can change your mood, too.
And changing your mood can lead you to discovering a new part of yourself.
Would you like to see a new part of me?
The flowers look a little worse for wear... Commander, can you help me water them?
We can watch as the water seeps into the soil.
Then, when you visit again, the flowers will be more vibrant than ever.
You don't look too well... Did you get too little sleep last night? Or have bad dreams, maybe?
Come to me. Don't worry about a thing.
Relax... and let me handle all of your pressure and worries.
Tonight, you'll sleep just fine...
It's about time for a meal, isn't it?
I have a well-stocked fridge. What shall we eat today?
You'd like to cook for me? Heehee, I can't wait.
Let me help you get ready.
Commander... Is it just me, or are your shoulders stiff?
Lately, I've been trying out a new massage technique... for you, of course.
Thank you.
I'll start with your shoulders.
If there's anywhere else you want massaged, do tell me. You can be greedy for once.
Commander, when I was taking photos earlier, I noticed something missing...
Do you need help?
Thank you, but it's not quite a problem of quality. Can you come closer?
Now smile. Actually, something more aloof might be fun.
A photo is only complete if you're in it.
A seaside tent, the ocean breeze at sunrise, the first rays of light falling on your face...
And then...
What are you talking about?
I'm thinking of the perfect plan for a getaway for us.
All you have to do is decide whether you'll go or not. Leave the rest to me... Heehee.
Commander, may I take your measurements?
For what purpose?
I want to make a hug pillow modelled after you.
Aww, why'd you freeze up? If you don't relax, I won't be able to get your measurements right. It's going to be all wrong!
You think my hair is pretty? Thank you... Would you like to touch it?
By the way, do you have a favourite hairstyle?
Do you like something elegant? Or maybe something with more personality?
Heehee. I'm happy to style mine any way you like.
Commander, can you teach me a few tea-brewing tips and tricks?
People always call my tea an "odd liquid substance." It hurts a little, to be honest.
We can get started right now, if it's okay with you.
Umm... How do we feel about adding some chilli oil as a base first?
Come to think of it, I haven't fixed your collar yet today, have I?
Would you like to do mine, too? Be my guest. But only after I'm done with yours.
Fixing each other's clothes... It's a little heartwarming, isn't it? Heehee.
Commander... Lend me your hand for a moment.
I'll write a word on your palm. You try to guess it.
And we'll keep going until you get it right.
Ready? Hmm, what to write... Heheh.
A new horror movie just came out. Care to watch it with me?
It's a bit of a thriller... Are you scared?
Don't force yourself to be brave. If you get scared, I'm happy to hold you~
Commander, there's dust on your jacket. Take it off and let me clean it for you, please.
But... hmm, I don't have anything else for you to wear.
Lie down in my bed for a while. When it's clean, I'll call you.
If you can't rest unless I'm keeping you company... then that's fine by me~
The bath should be ready now.
Are you prepared for me to wash you?
I'll cleanse every inch of you, body and soul♡
Commander, are there any sounds you're particularly fond of?
Like the rain, or the wind... or a human whisper?
If I knew the answer, maybe I could use it to soothe you whenever you need it.
Commander, could you open up to me a little more?
Tell me how you feel. Your worries, your secrets, words kept bottled up for a long time...
Anything, really.
Don't worry. I'll listen quietly... I'm always on your side. Heehee.
Commander, have you noticed?
My room has been filling up with your things.
Your teacup, your books, the spot where you always sit...
Heehee. I suppose it's less a place for me and more a place for us, now.
Raising a pet? I've never really thought about it.
Caring for another life is a big responsibility...
But seeing you is fulfilling enough on its own.
I don't have room in my heart for anything else! Heehee.
I read in a book that letting go of things that "do not spark joy" makes life easier.
Maybe they have a point.
But everything in this room has memories of us.
I don't want to let go of any of it♪
Would you like dinner? A bath? Or... anything else, Master?
Was that the right way to say it?
Just a sudden whim. I was in the mood to experience what it's like to serve you♡
Now... What will it be, Master?
Commander~ This room is actually cursed...
It's a terribly scary curse. Anybody who sets foot in here can never leave~
There's only one way to break it. You must lie calmly in my arms~
You want to talk about love with me? Heehee, what an interesting subject.
For me, love is simple. I love you, and I'm happy that I do.
Whether that happiness is sweet dew or a deadly poison... I'm willing to drown myself in it.
Hmm... This is difficult.
Commander~ Do you like black or white more?
I see... I'll remember that. Heehee.
I usually drink tea, but it's nice to shake things up once in a while.
Red wine, or coffee... Which do you prefer, Commander?
A tipsy night, or the sunlit awakening of morning... I'd love to share both with you.
Are these flowers... for me? Thank you.
Their scent alone is enough to breathe new life into a room.
In return... would you like to watch a movie with me?
I'll let you choose which one. Something thrilling would be fine, too!
Commander, I have milk tea... but there's only one left.
Huh? Do I...? Heehee, well...
That's because we'll get to share the same straw~
Let's have a staring contest.
The rules are simple. We both stare into each other's eyes, and the first one to look away loses.
Your penalty for losing... is spending the whole day with the winner!
You don't have to be reserved around me, Commander.
I accept you for who you are.
So please... let go of whatever's weighing you down.
Lose yourself in the moment with me.
Commander, there's a meteor shower coming up in a few days. It's a rare sight around here.

options.content: Think we'll get to make a wish?

scripts.say: A wish... Heehee, you could say that.
I've already decided... I'll use the opportunity to tell you something that I normally couldn't.
What is it? Well, you'll know when the time comes. Heehee!
Commander, come over here.
Now stay still. You don't have to do or say anything.
Just share this quiet moment with me.
Being by your side... is all I need. Heehee.
Being cooped up inside makes me want some fresh air.
But... there's nowhere I want to go. Commander, do you have any ideas?
An aimless journey, following wherever our hearts guide us... That's so romantic! Heehee.
Commander, what makes a home feel like home to you?
Just being together does make me feel as if something is missing...

options.content: Maybe we should do something that requires teamwork?

scripts.say: In that case... shall we cook together? Working side-by-side in the kitchen... Just the thought of it warms my heart, heehee.
Come a little closer, please.
It's nothing, except... I just feel as if we're unusually distant today.
So let me close that gap... There. This is much better~ Heehee.
Hush... Can you hear the tides, Commander?
You can't? Then come closer. Yes, right here.
Did you hear it this time? Heehee... My love flows for you like a tide.
Never sated, always acting on my convictions... That's what it means to be Implacable.
When I'm by your side, I find myself wishing that time could slow down.
Every heartbeat and every breath become things worth savouring.
You'll accept me despite my selfishness, won't you? Heehee.
Commander, I adjusted your seat for you.
The angle of the cushion, the curve of your backrest... Everything has been fixed to your preference.
Hmm... There's a scent lingering here.
Heehee. I left my scent just for you.
Now, when you sit down, you'll feel as if I'm embracing you.
Your racing helmet is completely enclosed, isn't it?
It's a little sad that I can't see your face...
But from the right angle, I could stare at you all day without you noticing!
That sounds fun... Heehee.
A wrench can be used to either tighten a screw or loosen it.
It's just like human relationships.
Whether things get tighter or looser depends on the one taking the initiative.
Would you like me to tighten my hold on you, Commander? Or should I keep things loose? Heehee.
Are these... earplugs? What do you use them for?
They're for reducing noise to help drivers focus.
Interesting... As for me, I'd rather hang on every word you say.
In fact, talk more, would you? I'll take every word to heart, heehee~
What goes through a driver's mind in those last few seconds before a race?
Do you cast aside all distractions and focus only on the track ahead? Or do your thoughts drift toward someone special to you?
Maybe it's a bit of both.
I see.
...Commander, who is that someone special to you? Could it be... me?
Commander... All the cravings I have here are because of you.
You understand me more and more, Commander. Your thoughtfulness really touches my heart.
For me? Heehee. Commander, you know my preferences well.
I accept your gift. Now I have yet another reason to hold you in my heart. Heeheehee.
Commander, I'm writing them in every last line... my eternal feelings for you.
I shall do all that is required for my confession... because of my love for you.
A most blessed meeting, Commander. Lovely weather, isn't it? Would you like some refreshment?
To think you would return just as I finished preparing the tea... Heehee.
Let's not waste your break, Commander. How would you like to spend it?
Your collar's a little crooked. Come here and I'll tidy it up for you.
Here you are... It seems my prayers finally reached you.
You came back just as I was finishing my prayers. Does that mean you heard and responded to them?
Have you finished all your tasks? That means we can spend this time together, just the two of us... Heehee.
You'd like a break? Very well. Where would you like to lose yourself? On my lap, shoulder, or in my arms?
A worry? Do share it with me. Whether it be an anxiety or something you cannot tell anyone else... You can lay it all bare before me.
How would you like to spend today? If it's with you, I don't mind anything at all. Heehee♥
You seem somewhat different today... Oh, you don't see it? Heehee, people are often blindest when it comes to themselves.
Your breath, your heartbeat... They soothe me more than any prayer. So please, come closer...
I think I'm hearing your heart's voice. Though it's a little hard to listen when you're so far away... Heehee.
Commander, I accept every part of you. Your clingy side, or your deeper desires...
Relax... Whether you want comfort, or to kill a little time... I'll indulge you all the way.
That's rather bold of you... Heehee.
Are you tired? Lean on me and rest.
I'll watch over you till you fall asleep... in the way I know best.
Are you looking for some thrill?
Looking away from me? I'll have to punish you♪
You'll never be satisfied unless you're honest, you know?
Your tea will grow cold. Or perhaps you'd like me to warm it up for you?
There’s a hint of my fragrance in this sweetness, too.
This is...an extra blessing♡
Entrust everything to me... You need only to wait in anticipation.
You mustn't touch... yet.
Time spent waiting has its own spice.
Oh, it spilled... Aren't you a handful.
Show me how much you can manage...
Have one bite... and I'll give you a special reward.
Which will you taste first? Or will you start with whatever is in reach?
Do you have a moment, Commander?
I was just praying for you when I realised something.
Recently, I've been trying a new stew recipe...
I only need one portion, but I seem to often end up with more than that.
And so, if you'd like...
You could share in this sinful indulgence with me once in a while.
Heehee... Although, I'm still not certain about the seasoning.
And while it shames me to admit it, I don't know all that much about your preferences yet either, Commander.
Do you prefer a deeper or more delicate flavour?
Or perhaps you'd like to try something just a touch more...dangerous? I made it specially...and I DO recommend it.

options.content: It's hard to choose. Can I try them all?

scripts.say: Heehee, aren't you greedy? Your honesty with your desires is really very stirring.
So, would you come by tonight?
I'll make sure it's all ready for you. And then...
While you're tasting it, I'll take my time to drink in the expressions you make, and every exhalation that leaves you.
I want you to tell me the true flavour you seek, in the warm candlelight.
Wrapped in fragrances and whispers...
Let's seek something that satisfies both our palates and our hearts...
Mmh... I finally got through.
I've been wondering and wondering what you were doing, Commander.
I was so distracted by the thought, I couldn't fully engage in the task in front of me. So I decided to give you a ring...
Heehee. I'm always honest when it comes to my desires.
When feelings smoulder in silence, isn't it better to put them into words?
Like right now...
I want to brew tea for you, look at your face as you drink it, and hear you tell me how good it is.
These urges arise one after another with no indication they will stop.
Does it trouble you that I am like this, Commander?
You always indulge me like that.
I might end up all the more dependent on you at this rate.
Even though I am supposed to be the one offering you guidance and company...
At some point, I started thinking of nothing but being by your side... longing for that warmth.
Perhaps I should abstain a little after all...

options.content: Depend on me as much as you want.

scripts.say: But you won't be satisfied if the dependence is so one-sided, will you?
I wonder what I must do for you to bare everything to me too...
Heehee, this will take some serious thought.
I won't stop until you entrust me with it all. Your delight and your lament.
Hmm, the heat of my passion cannot be transmitted through mere words on a screen.
I must express my feelings face-to-face and as they are.
So I shall leave the rest for when we meet.
I'll be waiting here for you always.
Forever and ever... Yes?

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>One Unusual Morning</size>

scripts.say: Port - Dining Hall
A little too early in the day for morning rush, the dining hall was filled with the aroma of soup and freshly-toasted bread.
Still groggy from a late night, I came here to brew myself a cup of coffee to start another long day.
*yaaawn*... Oh.
Oh, Commander. Good morning!
Morning, Volga. Making breakfast?
One apron-clad Volga stands in the kitchen, intently watching the pot of soup. On her plate sit a sandwich and salad – an unusually healthy-looking meal.
Yes! I'm just making a healthy meal full of love for you, Commander.
It's almost ready, so wait a little longer, okay?
Oh, I'm sorry. I'm kind of in a hurry... Could you bring it to my office?
As I speak to her, I run the coffee maker as usual and pour myself a cup of espresso.
Of course I can. But... Commander?
Hm? What is it?
Through the steam, I see her narrow her eyes, as if she's caught on to something serious.
You don't look too good today. Have you been eating properly? Getting enough sleep? Not too stressed out, I hope?
...Or did you stay up working late again last night?
Maybe a little. It's nothing to worry about.
I heard that, the last time you said "maybe a little," you ended up working all the way until dawn.
You know, I keep a detailed log... For example, the coffee maker was used at both 3 AM and 5 AM.
Ah... I mean it this time, really. There were a few documents that needed handling before morning, so I just...
So you DID work until dawn.
Her voice is as gentle as ever, but the look in her eyes makes it clear that I'm in big trouble this time.
Commander, how many times have I told you now?
"Eat properly." "Go to bed on time." "Don't stay up late every night."
You always say you understand, but in the end, you keep on working like a machine.
Don't worry. After I'm done with this, I'll rest.
I understand. Don't treat me as if I'm unreasonable.
But I will be confiscating that coffee. It isn't good for you to drink strong coffee on an empty stomach.
She takes away my coffee cup and replaces it with a glass of warm water.
If your work is urgent, then go and get it done. After that, I'll bring your healthy breakfast to your office.
I'll allow you to focus on your work first, but you'd best clean your plate~
Okay. Thank you for your help.
Leave it all to me! All you need to do is focus on your work and refueling.
Backed by Volga's energetic voice, I exit the dining hall.

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>A Questionable Meal</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
As I finish up my last document, the door to my office opens, and Volga comes in with a box of food.
Have you finished your work, Commander? I've come to deliver your breakfast!
She arranges the foods on my desk one at a time and lifts the lid from the first box.
A fresh scent wafts out. It's... hard to describe, but not entirely unpleasant.
Now, Commander. Your first Health Mission is to eat a full breakfast!
It looks very, umm... full of vitality?
That's right! I got up bright and early to make you a 100% natural and healthy breakfast full of vegetables!
I mixed the dressing myself, too, using olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of minced garlic. The nutritional balance is perfect!
Now open up, Commander. Say "ahh"!
She picks up some kale with a small fork and holds it out to my mouth.
Umm... You don't have to do all that. I can eat by myself...
Absolutely not. Your mission right now is to rest, so let me care for you!
Open up~
The moment the kale hits my tongue, the lemon's tartness and kale's bitterness mingle to create a very unique flavor.
Hmm...
How is it, Commander? Isn't it good?
Her eyes sparkle expectantly.
How should I put this...
It's like nothing I've ever experienced before... I'd liken it to kneeling down and chewing on a well-kept lawn.
Huh? A-a lawn?
Oh, no... How could this happen? I used the freshest, healthiest ingredients...
Maybe it's because it's so healthy that the taste turned out a little odd.
It's okay, though. I'll do my best to finish it all!
Ahem... I-it's delicious!
You are an excellent chef, Volga. I love it.
You mean it? Then it was worth spending so many hours working on it!
Hehehe, I knew you'd like my healthy home cooking~
Since you like it so much, I'd be happy to make you breakfast every day from now on!
Maybe you could try... experimenting with the taste a little more?
Huh? But you said you liked it. Oh, no... Were you lying to make me feel better?
You don't... have to push yourself.
I understand I still need to work on my cooking, but I'm serious about taking care of you!
It may taste odd, but it is nutritious. I finish every last bit of it so that Volga's efforts don't go to waste.
After that, I notice a bottle tucked into the bottom of the box.
What's this?
Oh, I almost forgot!
She twists open the lid and pours a dark-grey liquid into my cup.
This is my special, after-meal drink: Super-Energizing Veggie Juice!
It's packed with fruit and vegetables. It should be great for relieving fatigue!
Here you go, Commander. Chug it!
Faced with the liquid and its pungent odor, I close my eyes. There's only one thing left to do.
Um... Commander?
Hey, Volga.
Y-yes?
What did you put in this?
Umm... Celery, green pepper, cucumber, kale, and apple and honey to balance the flavor.
Oh, and I added tomato paste to add vitamins to it...
How the hell is it spicy, then?
Ah! I think it must be...
Volga takes the cup and sniffs it a few times.
I knew it! I must have put chili sauce in, thinking it was tomato paste. I'm sorry, Commander...
No, it's okay. It's actually warming me up, I think.
Huh? Really?
Dubiously, she pours herself a cup and takes a large gulp.
...It's true! I feel all warm, and the spicy kick is actually nice!
*gulp* *gulp*...
She happily drinks the rest of her drink.
Hehehe, if it warms you up, then let's finish it all together!
Cheers~
Cheers...?
Pressured by her sweet smile, I manage to down the rest of the spicy veggie juice in one chug.

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>Healthy Therapy</size>

scripts.say: Port - Office
After finishing the "healthy meal," we sit down on the couch and relax for a bit.
Heehee. You're incredible, Commander. I can't believe you really ate it all!
It wasn't bad. My tummy feels all nice and warm now.
See? My home-cooked meals are ideal for good health!
Now, let's proceed to our second Health Mission!
...Second?
Of course. I told you I'd take good care of you today!
On that note, I'd like you to turn away from me.
What for?
So I can give you a massage, of course. I've learned some new techniques specifically for relieving tension caused by sitting at a desk all day!
Now be good and let me take care of you, please.
Okay... I'll do that.
Seeing her rub her hands together excitedly, I obediently turn my back to her.
After a moment, a pleasant scent draws closer as she places her hands on my shoulders.
Let's get started now. If it hurts at all, don't hesitate to tell me.
It's an unexpectedly firm massage, but thanks to Volga's excellent control, it doesn't hurt one bit.
You're awfully stiff... Do you always walk around bearing such fatigue?
Does it make you feel better at all when I massage it?
Yeah... I'm a little sore, but it feels good.
The pressure on my shoulders rises and falls in a steady rhythm. Our surroundings are quiet, leaving only the sound of her gentle breathing.
There you go... Relax just like that. I'll be here watching you, so if you'd like to doze off a little, please do~
Mmm...
I close my eyes as directed.
However, my mind is quickly filled with the phantom of unprocessed paperwork once again.
Hey, Volga... Can you bring me a few of the top documents on my desk?
I'd like to use this time to approve supply allocations for next week.
Also...
She stops suddenly.
Hm?
When I turn to look, I see one very pouty Volga. The look in her eyes says, "absolutely not."
Commander... You're undertaking a Health Mission, remember?
Why are you thinking about work the instant you close your eyes to relax?
Sorry, sorry. Bad habit.
This won't do. At this rate, you'll still be wound up even if your muscles are relaxed.
Do you have trouble falling asleep even when you're sleepy lately?
A little...
I knew it.
She sighs and taps my temple lightly.
You're far too tense here.
Even a massage won't be enough to loosen you up.
I'll be fine. Maybe soon...
Knowing how and when to release pent-up stress is the key to working for long periods.
You agree, don't you? One needs times of relaxation to truly enjoy life.
Mmm...
Then it's decided! We'll be making a slight alteration to your next mission.
She takes my hand and pulls me to my feet.
Are we going out?
Volga nods eagerly with a big, expectant smile.
We're going to find a place where you can truly relax!

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>A Place to Relax</size>

scripts.say: Port - Street
Volga takes my hand and leads me on a stroll down the tree-lined street.
The nice weather combined with her warmth and softness put me in an unusually relaxed mood.
By the way, Commander...
What is true relaxation, in your mind?
True relaxation, huh? Hmm...
I guess it would be a state where I've forgotten all about work, and I'm floating like a balloon... and I feel genuine contentment.
It's not really something that you can "make" happen, though. But I'm plenty happy just spending some time relaxing once in a while, like we are now.
Hmm...
She furrows her brow in thought, apparently having ignored half of what I'd just said.
Floating like a balloon, feeling genuine contentment...
Ah! I have an idea!
She whips around and looks up into my eyes excitedly.
I know the perfect place for that!
Whenever I'm tired, going there makes my heart warm and body as light as a balloon.
Oh, really? What kind of place is it?
She smiles mysteriously and takes my arm in hers.
Just come with me, and you'll see. I know it won't disappoint!
Volga leads the way to a quieter street.
As the breeze wafts through, I catch the scent of freshly baked bread.
(Is this the place?)
Tadaaa! We're here! It's this bakery!
She raises an arm and introduces our destination theatrically.
When we were talking before, this was the first place that came to mind!
One whiff of the bread here, and I'm already feeling better!
Through the glass window beneath a wooden sign, I see the shop filled with old-fashioned loaves of bread.
Let's go in, Commander!
*jingle*...
When the door opens, we're greeted by the ring of a bell and the warm, rich aroma of bread.
Though the place is small, Volga excitedly rushes back and forth between the few displays.
Wow! So many of my favorites!
Commander, look! These anpan rolls are just sweet enough, and the bread is thick and soft!
And these croissants! They might look like any other, but they're actually filled with cheese!
Also, their rye looks a little tough, but it's quite delicious!
If only we had tea to go with it, or vodka... Hmm. Maybe I'd best not drink while on duty. Milk will do just fine!
She shows me all of their available breads. Clearly, she's been to this place many times already.
(Volga sure loves this bakery.)
Say, Commander...
While we're here, may I ask you for something?
What is it?
Umm... Could we buy a little extra to take home?
The ingredients they use here are very healthy, so I could use some of it for your breakfasts...
Of course. We came all this way, so we might as well buy all of the ones you like.
Hehe, I love how sweet you are, Commander!
Her cheeks flush as she trots over and picks up the tongs.
Anpan, croissants, rye... Oh, and this, too!

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>Irresistible Bliss</size>

scripts.say: With much bread in hand, Volga and I sit down at a window-side table.
All of the loaves look deliciously fluffy, especially with the added sheen caused by the sunlight.
Urk... I might have gone overboard...
But just seeing all of it stuffed in my basket does make me happy.
Does buying a lot of bread make you happy?
It's not JUST the fact that I've bought bread... It's partly because we bought it together!
She looks down at the bread happily.
*grumble*...
Suddenly, I hear a low growl from her direction.
Ah!
She puts a hand on her stomach and instantly begins blushing.
Uh, umm...
I know we just ate breakfast, but the smell of all this bread has caused my stomach to betray me...
Can't blame you there. It smells delicious.
R-right? Hahaha...
I know you're trying to make me feel better, but it's still really embarrassing...
You're a real glutton, huh?
Huh? That's not nice!
I-I'm not just a glutton... I need to be well-fed to protect you, that's all!
Well, we bought the bread. Why not try it out now?
Huh? May I?
Sure. I certainly can't resist that delectable scent.
Volga looks at me, then back at the bread. She gulps.
Then let's dig in!
She picks up some of the bread and breaks it in half.
You should try some, too!
As I accept my half, she quickly takes a big bite out of hers.
Cream oozes from the broken edge. Volga's eyes crinkle in a big smile.
Munch, munch... It's delicious! Crispy on the outside, but soft and creamy on the inside!
I want this one, too!
Infected by her excitement, I take a bite of my bread, too. The outside is crispy and flaky, while the inside is full of fluffy cream.
Oh, it's really good!
See? I keep telling everyone that bread is the greatest invention since, well... anything!
My agreement prompts her to open up a little.
She constantly remarks between bites. "The anpan is to die for!" "Mmm, this cheesy rye bread is so satisfying to bite down on!" "I can handle three more mini croissants!"
Oblivious to the dab of white cream on the corner of her mouth, she continues to devour bread.
Is this that "stress relief" she was talking about earlier?
Eat slowly, now. You don't want to choke.
I grab a napkin and hand it over to her.
Thank you! Oh, but you shouldn't just watch me eat. You haven't tried this one yet, right? It's my favorite kind!
Shouldn't you eat it, then?
I already had one. This one is just for you, hehe.
Okay, then let's save it for tomorrow's breakfast. I'm already full of bread...
I'll get a takeout bag~
Let's see how much is left... One, two, three...
Huh?! Why are there only three left over?!
Volga counts again in disbelief, but the number of loaves remains the same.
Apparently remembering how many she'd just devoured, she covers her face in shame.
Oh, no... I was supposed to help you relax, but all I did was relieve my own stress...
Hahaha! Don't worry. Watching you have fun eating has put me in a good mood, too.
You mean it?
I do. Now, how about we go for a walk to burn off those calories we just ate?
Heheh~ Then let's make this walk our third Health Mission!

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>A Warm Moment in Her Lap</size>

scripts.say: Port - Park
We leave the bakery and go on a walk on a tree-lined path in the park.
Volga is a little red, perhaps still ashamed that I saw her gorging herself on bread.
Ugh... That was bad manners, wasn't it?
You don't think any less of me now, do you?
I could never. It was fun to see you having fun.
That's more like you after all, right?
Oh... Really?
Pushing yourself to try to appear perfect makes it harder to relax, right?
Yaaawn... Oh.
The warm sunlight brings my lingering drowsiness to the forefront.
Wow! You're relaxed enough to yawn now.
There's a bench over there. Let's take a little break together.
Excited to have an opportunity to take care of me, she leads me over to the bench.
It's quiet around the tree-shaded bench. We can even hear the fountain and occasional birdcalls in the distance.
You can lie down and take a nap, if you'd like.
With a bashful smile, she pats her thigh invitingly.
A nap?
Not every day is as nice as this one... What's wrong with getting some fresh air?
It would feel nice to nap out here, but what about our other plans?
Shush. Don't worry about that! They can be delayed a little bit. Besides, your rest is what matters most.
I'll be sure to wake you up when it's time.
In that case... Don't mind if I do.
Leave it all to me~
Volga sits upright on the bench and guides my head to her lap.
I feel a soft touch and reassuring warmth. Her calm face is right above me.
She gently strokes my brow. It's ticklish at first, but it quickly transforms into a relaxing drowsiness.
Heehee... You look a lot more relaxed than you did in your office.
Even the most capable person will get tired sometimes if they try to carry everything on their shoulders.
So at times like this, please don't hesitate to lean on me.
It makes me very happy... that you'd lie down with me and show me your vulnerable side.
Through my sleepy eyes, I can only tell that she's gazing at me.
Amidst the fragmented golden sunlight are her gentle eyes. It's such a calming scene.
Now, go to sleep.
Let me dispel your worries, fatigue, and tension.
Sweet dreams, Commander.

sequence:
Volga's Healthy Missions

<size=45>Homeward in the Late Sun</size>

scripts.say: In my hazy state, I feel something warm and soft brush against my cheek.
There's a faint, rhythmic breathing, carrying the sweet scent of bread.
When I open my eyes, I see Volga's head bowed above mine.
(We must've been sleeping for a while now.)
I try to sit up slowly. Despite my care, Volga is awakened by this motion and rubs her eyes sleepily.
Mm... Huh?
Commander? Did I fall asleep, too?
Our surroundings haven't changed at all. Everything is still quiet, as if time had stopped.
What time is it?
Umm...
Huh? It's been more than two hours?!
Looks like the two of us slept pretty well.
Goodness... Please don't tease me, Commander.
I promised I'd wake you up, but I slept just as much as you did...
Don't worry about it.
Heck, I think it was for the best.
For the best?
Work's had me so busy lately that it's been ages since I slept this soundly.
I stretch and let out a big yawn.
Thanks to you, I feel a whole lot lighter.
You were right, Volga. I need to take better care of my health so I don't worry the people around me.
Do you finally understand? Then my Health Missions were effective!
Even if things didn't quite go according to plan...
By the way, what did you have planned for the rest of the day?
We were looking for a place where I could fully relax, right?
Yes...
Then I think you did a great job.
Hmm... But the bakery we went to this morning was just one of MY favorite places...
She tilts her head, apparently unable to understand what I'm implying.
No. We just found the place where I can truly relax.
It's with you.
Ah!
A breeze rustles her hair, highlighting the soft blush on her cheeks.
Hearing you say that makes me so happy...
But you'd best be careful saying things like that... I almost thought I'd float right up to heaven.
After a brief silence, she gazes at me again.
However... If it would make you happy, you can always rest by my side whenever you're tired.
In case you need... No, forget the "in case." I want you to rely on me all of the time, Commander!
I'd be happy to.
Okay!
It's getting late. I should get back to work soon.
In return for everything you've done, how about I make dinner tonight?
Huh? You mean it?
Of course. What would you like to eat?
Hmm, well...
If you're the one cooking, I'm fine with anything.
Then we'd better get to it. Shall we get groceries on our way back through the market?
Okay!
On the sun-warmed cobblestone path, Volga slows her walking pace and takes me by the arm.
We walk home side by side. Our shadows nestle together up ahead of us.
Commander, let's sleep together... Mm, hugs...
Mm... It's a little cramped...
This is fun... I can't take my eyes off of it...
Mm... Now!
Nngh... Can't reach... I need to sit – no, stand up!
Mm... Purr... Puuurrrr...
I love you, Commander...
In the middle of a quiet, dimly lit church, a summoning circle casts a gentle, otherworldly glow.
Motes of light coalesce slowly, forming into a human-like shape.
Mm... Just a moment, please...
I was able to sense your emotions through the summoning circle.
And I, the angel Merkuriy, have descended to answer your prayers~♪
The light fades, and Merkuriy, enveloped in a holy aura, spreads her wings.
A rosy blush graces her cheeks, and her eyes are laced with a longing passion.

options.content: I think there was a problem with the summoning?

scripts.say: Looks like the summoning worked.
It sure did~
I'd rather be with you than be some unreachable angel.
I think there was a problem with the summoning? You look a little out of sorts...
A problem? No such thing. I'm an angel, remember?
I just... The thought of finally being able to touch you... It's making me feel all hot...
Commander, is that the sound of your heartbeat going faster?
She tilts her head curiously and descends in front of me, a playful smile pulling at the corners of her mouth.
Multiple heart-tipped arrows float above her, and she exudes a gentle, yet somehow ominous air.
What are those?
You mean the arrows? Mm... How can I put it in simple terms...
I think these are... representations of my love for you.
Right now I am still the Merkuriy you know, but...
I do feel a bit greedier than usual... and I want to be full of your love.
If you don't satisfy me with love right now... I may end up succumbing to more... base instincts to get what I want.
And since you are the one who summoned me, you'd better take responsibility~♪
Merkuriy presses herself against me, pinning me in place with her bountiful angelic bosom.
She radiates heat as her skin flushes, making me feel a little dizzy as well.
As she stares deep into my eyes, I can tell that her half-vacant gaze is burning with a desire that isn't exactly pure.
Her burning gaze threatens to bore a hole into me, and I can't help but gulp in anticipation.
Satisfy? Y-you mean...
Yes. If you won't do it for me...
I'll have no choice but to load up this arrow with my boundless love, and fill up your body and heart with it...
Doesn't look like an offer I can refuse.
Hmm... I am being this forceful... Yet all I see on your face is a gentle smile.
That big heart of yours which accepts all... It is so warm to have a place in it...
Merkuriy presses me against her chest and covers me with her wings. Her feathers are as soft as the finest silk on my skin.
The arrows around her scatter into motes of light which dissipate mere moments later.
Her embrace is soft and warm, and I can feel just how boundless her love is.
Instead of uttering an answer, I reciprocate by embracing her as well.
Commander... This is a promise.
May our love shine eternal... Longer than the stars in the sky...
Listening to my heartbeat, she lifts her face and turns her eyes up at me, her face flushed a deep red.
An embrace is not enough... I want to feel your touch... All of you...
Melt down this angel with your searing love, Commander♪
Hngh! Damn this stupid net! Why me?!
Selimiye struggles to break free from a trap, like a bird caught in a net.
It's only been 10 minutes since the game began.
I got too cocky... I thought I could take you down if I just charged in before anyone expected it.
I never expected... that you'd control the wind to send the net right back at me!
...I can't really control the wind, though.
You did! You so did it! How could this happen, then?!
Said Selimiye, full of confidence, who very much ran into the net herself after throwing it.
So, what now? Ready to admit defeat?
Defeat?! I'm not defeated! Not one bit!
You got lucky and have the upper hand for now, but fate is still firmly on my side!
Wanna know something fun? My fortune-telling told me that a net would be my lucky item to "capture you"♪
And I know things didn't start quite right, but...
I give a light tug to the rope attached to the net, and it tightens up around her.
Whoa! Wait! The web of fate... It's digging into my wings!
Ahem! I assure you this is all part of the plan! I got captured on purpose so you felt safe approaching! That way I can convince you to give up!
Okay, I'm listening.
Listen well now. Your fleet's formation may look solid, but there's a three-second gap in firepower on the right flank! That's how I was able to make my move.
And that's not all! Your commands may be decisive, but I see the shade of doubt and worry on your face. There must be something weighing on your mind! And I think I know what that is...
I was thinking about freeing you, but you don't seem cooperative.
Okay, okay, enough games! Dragging this out won't make my defeat less bitter...
Commander, can you loosen the net a bit? I can't move at all... I can't even raise a white flag to surrender!
I approach to help untangle her.
Yes, just a little closer... Ngh...
Just as I come face to face with her, she flaps her wings and shreds the net.
And before I can even react, she pounces on me and sends me stumbling backwards.
Heh! I got you now~♪
This was my real plan all along~ I would pretend to be defeated, and when you got close for me to deliver the final blow...
She straddles and pins me down with her full weight.
Don't take too much fault with my tactics, would you? Winning battles is a matter of wits, after all. Heheh♪
And now the tables have turned! Are you ready to surrender, or...
Selimiye quirks a triumphant smile and teases me, assured of her victory.
What will it be? You still have time to surrender quietly.
Heheh, I can see the gears turning in that cute head of yours. You're trying to turn things around, aren't you?
Looks like I won't be able to make you surrender without some incentives, huh?
She lowers her head onto my neck, letting the tip of her tongue trail a path between my neck and my ear, then giving my earlobe a light bite.
The sensations are like a creeping tingle that shoots down my spine.
Noticing my sensitive reaction, she pulls away and whispers suggestively into my ear.
Such a strong will. I wouldn't want it any other way~
Heheh, but time is firmly on my side, you see?
Let's see how much you can resist my "pressure," shall we?♡
The night before the banquet, I'm invited by the Duke of York to visit her private quarters.
And when I open the door, I find her holding her phone in front of the mirror. Tinkering with the photo effects would be my guess.
Answered my call, have you? Well met, O Polymath of great wisdom.
Alas, the allure of Hecate's dress of the night has not fully awakened just yet.
And the only one who provides what's lacking is none but thee.
Come now, do not be afraid. Choose the form most bewitching for this lovely evening?
I acquiesce and approach to get a closer look at her dress.

The room is filled with her intoxicatingly delightful aroma, and the red and black surface of her dress seems to shimmer under the light. The beauty of its two-tone design and its contour is nothing short of breathtaking.
What dost thou say? Have I captivated thine heart?
It looks great on you. The back looks a little loose, though.
Heheh, truly nothing escapes thy notice. I should not expect less of the one I found worthy.
I reach out behind her back, gently touching her back and feeling her silky smooth skin against my fingers as I adjust her dress.
Take as much time as needed to get it just right...
Duke of York raises her chin without paying any mind to the close distance between us.
I let my hands glide over to her sides to smooth over the lines of her dress. As my fingertips graze her supple skin, I sense her breath stop for a second.
Well done... Great work as always. Now...
Now, let us capture this most captivating look for posterity.
She strikes a selfie pose and turns to her phone again, then falls onto me.
I reach out and catch her, her rosy scent tickling my nose.
Hold me tighter, would you kindly?
Tonight, I want thine arms to be my refuge.
I'm only too happy to hold her tightly, and she presses her body against mine. We look incredibly intimate on her phone screen.
Yes. Lovely.
Don't turn away. Keep thine eyes on me.
*click*
*snap* *snap* *snap*
The lights of the screen seem to dance around her, like the mystic Lampades following Hecate.
The faint smile gracing her lips adds to her devilish allure.
Now... This would make for a wonderful wallpaper. I will treasure it greatly. And this one...
She turns the screen to me. It shows a picture of her caressing my cheek, like the graceful hunter quietly asserting dominance over her prey.
I'm quite satisfied.
You're done shooting, you mean?
Done? Heh, the night has but just begun. There's no need to rush to the end, is there?
I crave more than just pictures. I hunger for thee.
She snaps her fingers, and a nearby closet swings open, revealing row after row of dazzling dresses.
Try and entertain me with thy sharp wit.
I wish to see... How wilt thou make this heart of mine pound with excitement?
In the depths of a solemn chapel, the sound of prayer is cut short by labored gasps.
When I throw open the doors, I see Járnbarðinn frantically pinning something down on the altar.
Hm? Commander?
Don't come any closer... I can't control myself right now. I might hurt you.
Her normally white wings are stained with a blotchy black, and she shudders in clear distress, drenched in sweat.
Cautious but worried, I approach her.
Járnbarðinn, look at me. Can you hear me?
Yes... I hear you.
But my whole body is burning... It's so hot within me...
Her breathing becomes ragged, and the black on her wings keeps spreading slowly.
I place a supporting hand on her shoulder, trying to keep her from losing herself.
...The voice has gone quiet. Strange...
Are you okay?
She turns her eyes to my hand on her shoulder, as if trying to make sense of something.
The heat... It's gone away just a little.
Commander... Come closer. Your touch helps calm me down better than prayer.
If it helps with the pain, I'll stay with you for as long as it takes.
I gently embrace her. She stops praying and leans into my chest.
After a calm moment, the shaking returns, and so does her ragged breathing.
It's not enough... It's not enough to quell the voice deep inside...
It's so hot... I can't even think...
It's okay. I'm with you.
Your warmth... It helps me hold on...
Please, hold me tighter... Let me stay close...
Try to hold on. We can find some other way to...
No. I found it. A way to shut the voices down.
Járnbarðinn wraps an arm around my shoulder and hangs over me. I can feel her hot breath roll across my skin.
Haah... I'm still so hot... So deep inside...
I know you can get through this. Stay with me.
Commander, this power trying to break free from me... You're the only one that can hold it down.
So I give you my body and soul... Though they were already yours long ago...
Mmh... You feel as hot as me...
Let's do this together... Let's smash through any who stand in our way...
I follow a ghostly light and find myself in an underground cavern.
I brave my way forward, and when I look up, I meet eyes with what seemed to my instincts a haughty succubus looking down at me.
Heh, you got some guts just waltzing into my turf with nothing to offer.
Or maybe you're giving yourself up as tribute, hm?
Despite her flippant tone, she rests a hand over my cheek and seems wholly uninterested.
If it wasn't for what she's wearing, it'd be hard to imagine her being related to the dangerous being the rumors refer to.
I didn't imagine a succubus to look like this.
Hm? So you'd rather I attack and feed on you until you shrivel up?
I can't be bothered with such a hassle.
But that doesn't mean you get to comment on my appearance like you did.
If you're so dead set on being a rude little bugger...
Anne shifts her position and crosses her arms, pushing up her chest and showing her figure.
The uninterested expression from seconds ago shifts into something completely different.
The air becomes thick with her alluring aura, and her eyes burn with a dangerous desire, like an eagle looking down at a particularly tasty morsel.
If you're so disappointed, I wouldn't mind living up to my title a little more...
Heh heh... Now that I take a good look at you, you do look rather yummy.
You'd make for a fine main dish.
In a matter of seconds, a cavalcade of tentacles shoot up from the shadows.
Everything turns into a blur, and when I'm finally given a moment to take in the situation, I find myself suspended right in front of her.
Do succubi use tentacles like that?
Handy, eh? They clean, grab things... Especially prey like you.
I thought I would just tease you a little to kill some time, but now...
That face of yours... Heheh, I find it so funny that I can't look away.
And your heart is pounding away... Thump, thump...
It's a little inconvenient, though. I wasn't planning on having a meal.
But you really made me work up an appetite.
She presses her body against mine, clearly trying to bask in the moment.
She runs her slender fingers down my chest, drawing little circles around my stomach.
Heh... You look way more tasty now than you did walking in here looking all straight-laced and serious.
Seeing as you seem to want to get the succubus experience so badly...
I'll grant you a real glimpse of the abyss.
Don't worry. I'll be gentle with you.
Why... I finally found a perfect little snack... It'd be such a waste to eat it up in a single bite.
I'll savor you for as long as I can... That, I promise you.
Once, Zeven told me of a beautiful sea of flowers hiding deep within this dense forest.
She added that, next chance we had, she wanted to bring me here to see it myself.
When I came here myself, however, the first thing I saw was her collapsed amidst the flowers.
Ah... You've found me in such an unseemly state.
I was hoping to purify this field of flowers before your arrival...
Then, when we are united, you would only see a beautiful bloom of flowers and my excitement to share the scenery with you.
But it seems I couldn't handle the task alone.
Perhaps it's the corruption... her eyes have a bewitching gleam to them.
My plan was to gradually take the corruption into myself and purify it within me... but I took too much at once.
As much as I want to snuggle in your arms, I fear that touching you will contaminate you as well.
What should I do?
Nnh... Clean water should be able to wash away the filth.
Can you bring me water, please? All you have to do is pour it on me.
Zeven closes her eyes, placing herself at my mercy.
As I tip my water bottle over her, the fluid falls onto her hair, drips down to her skin, and soaks through her thin fabric.
Phew... Mm...
Commander... Don't stop yet...
She murmurs quietly. Relief colors her face.
Once the bottle is empty, the bewitching gleam from before finally fades somewhat.
Thank you... I feel much better now that the corruption has been mostly cleared.
All that remains is the corruption inside me... Unfortunately, I can only rely on my own life force to purify it.
You can leave first, Commander. Staying here too long may have a negative effect on you.
I can't leave you here. I'm taking you home, even if I have to carry you back.
Commander... You gave all of your water to me, remember? You can't carry me back through this forest without supplies.
Either way, I'm doing it.
...Goodness, what am I going to do with you?
Listen. I have another solution in mind.
If we make a vow to become inseparable partners, bound until death...
Our intertwined life force will allow me to suppress the corruption within.
But this vow is one that you can only make once in a lifetime. Once done, there is no turning back.
Are you... still willing?
Gladly. Let's do it.
Such a quick response... It made my heart skip a beat.
First, Commander, lie down beside me.
When I lie down as directed, she rolls over and pulls me into an embrace.
I feel her heartbeat through wet clothing.
Commander... Please accept all of me.
I nod back and close my eyes. There's a soft touch on my lips.
The bond forming between us is palpable.
Now, we will never be parted.
Once this is over, let's go home together, Commander♪

sequence: "The sea."

scripts.say: Boundless, vast.

sequence: "The stars."

scripts.say: Truly boundless, immeasurably vast.
Gathering the strength of the Polises, waiting countless years...
Watching stars upon the water, until finally...
A blue-haired girl stopped amidst the white sand and gazed up at the starry sky, seemingly close enough to touch.

sequence: "For so long..."

scripts.say: Watching... Guiding... All to glimpse the interstellar route...
In the depths of the cosmos, something began to flicker amidst the stars.
Oh?
A clue emerges... Observation time exceeding safe bounds by 30%. Recording...

sequence: "Merkuriy."

scripts.say: ...A voice?
The tri-layer soundproofing array is functioning normally... Likewise for the central insulator.
But this voice is getting through my observation!
Darkness poured down from the stars, polluting the sea and soiling the white sands.
With such contamination, the guidance should be terminated...
But there's no time left to wait for another chance.
Merkuriy steeled herself and faced the encroaching darkness head-on.
I am Merkuriy, your interstellar guide. What can I do for you?
The Great Royal Fortune set sail anew, with a temporary alliance forged onboard.
Thanks to the light of the Startrace Beacon, the fog over the water had mostly cleared, revealing a surface that reflected the chaotic stars in the sky.
Look, Commander. The sea is beautiful! I wish the rest of the fleet could see this!
A sea that reflects the starry sky...
As I gaze at its shining surface, my eyes are drawn further into its depths.
This sensation...
The sky and ocean seem to invert once more as my consciousness plummets from the heavens, falling upon a steel sea.
An endless fleet of steel ships are scattered across the surface.
Our calculations show an error, but there is still time.
Shall we continue preparations?
Continue...?
No. We've done all we can already.
(Is that... Tester and Compiler?)
(But there's something wrong with the two of them.)
As far as I can tell, the two of them seem to be heading a fleet awaiting battle.
Beyond the Executors and mass-produced ships, I can make out other giant seaborne machines and clusters of Floating Fortresses.
(It's a defensive line... but against what?)
Our calculations indicate that it is far from enough.
We can't stand up to the starry sky at this rate.
...Probably not.
The ocean is anchored by the starry sky... and we only drift upon it.
Our defeat is sealed.
(Stand up to the starry sky...)
When I look up, the sky above seems ever so close to the sea.
As if it's falling, ever so slowly.
Even standing amidst such an expansive army, I'm seized by intense anxiety.
I can't even bring myself to look up at the sky anymore.
